Radiyo y’abaturage ya Huye (RC HUYE mu magambo ahinnye y’igifaransa) ni radiyo.
Ku nshuro ya Gatatu, Radiyo y’Abaturage ivugira mu karere ka Huye (RC HUYE), ibicishije mu kiganiro “Tumenye Isi Yacu” kuri iki cyumweru taliki ya 26 Ukuboza 2010 yahembye
abanyeshuri bitwaye neza mu kiganiro. Abahembwe bavuze ko bavomye ubumenyi muri iki kiganiro. Ku ruhande rw’Ubuyobozi bwa RC Huye butangaza ko iki ari igikorwa cy’ingenzi, kuko mu mumaro wa Radiyo kwigisha biza ku isonga, akaba ariyo mpamvu byagize akamaro mu kongerera ubumenyi rusange abakurikirana Radiyo.

"Ntukitiranye n'ikinyamakuru Kangura."
Kanguka cyari ikinyamakuru cyigenga cyo mu Rwanda. Cyashinzwe n'umunyamakuru Vincent Rwabukwisi. Cyanengaga ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana.
Ikinyamakuru Kangura cyashinzwe mu 1990 kugira ngo gihangane na Kanguka.
Mu 1987, Vincent Rwabukwisi yatangije ikinyamakuru cyigenga cyitwaga "Kazagwa". Nyuma cyiswe "Ejo Nzamera Nte". Mu 1989, cyahawe izina rya Kanguka.
Mbere, Kanguka ntiyandikaga ibya politiki. Mu 1989, yatangiye kunenga politiki ya Leta. Yarwanyaga ivangura rishingiye ku moko n'uturere. Umucuruzi Valens Kajeguhakwa yateye inkunga Kanguka.
Mu 1990, Rwabukwisi yafashwe avuye i Nairobi. Yari yagiye kubaza ibibazo umwami Kigeli V Ndahindurwa. Yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 15. Yafunzwe amezi 10, arekurwa muri Nzeri 1991.
Ku wa 11 Mata 1994, Rwabukwisi yarasiwe iwe i Nyamirambo, i Kigali. Yari Umuhutu, ariko yakekwagaho gukorana na FPR Inkotanyi.
Ikinyamakuru "The New Times" cyanditse ko Kangura yashinzwe nk'igisubizo kuri Kanguka. Cyanditse ko Hassan Ngeze yahinduye inyuguti za nyuma z'izina Kanguka.

Kigali Daily News (izwi kandi nka KDN) ni urubuga rwo kuri internet rwo mu Rwanda rutangaza amakuru atandukanye mu rurimi rw'Icyongereza. Urubuga, rwatangijwe mu 2022, rutangaza inkuru zijyanye n’amakuru y’igihugu, politiki, imibereho, imyidagaduro, siporo ndetse n’inkuru z’abantu.
Intego ya Kigali Daily News ni "gukusanya no gusangiza inkuru z’u Rwanda isi yose," hifashishijwe itangazamakuru ryihuta kandi riboneka kuri internet.

Intara y’Istanbul cyangwa Intara y’İstanbul (izina mu giturukiya: "İstanbul ili") n’intara muri Turukiya. Umurwa mukuru w’intara y’Istanbul witwa umujyi wa Istanbul. Intara y’Istanbul gatuwe n’abaturage bagera kuri 12.915.158 (abagabo 6.498.997 n’abagore 6.416.161), batuye kubuso bwa km² 5343.
Umuyobozi w’intara: Hüseyin Avni Mutlu
Umuyobozi w’umujyi: Kadir Topbaş

Akarere k’Adalar (izina mu giturukiya: "Adalar ilçesi") ni akarere kari mu ntara y’Istanbul y’igihugu cya Turukiya. Akarere k’Adalar ni kamwe mu turere 39 tugize Intara y’Istanbul. Akarere gatuwe n’abaturage bagera kuri 14.341 (abagabo 7.692 n’abagore 6.649), batuye kubuso bwa km² 15,85.
Iryo zina ryakomotse ku magambo 2 yo m’ururimi rw’igiturukiya ariyo («ada» 'ikirwa' na «-lar» 'ubuke: ibirwa').
Umuyobozi w’akarere: Mevlüt Kurban
Umuyobozi w’umujyi: Mustafa Farsakoğlu

Jean Kambanda (yavutse ku wa 19 Ukwakira 1955) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyarwanda wabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Guverinoma y'agateganyo kuva ku wa 9 Mata kugeza ku wa 19 Nyakanga 1994, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Mu 1998 yemeye ibyaha bya jenoside imbere y'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR), akatirwa igifungo cya burundu. Ni we mukuru wa guverinoma wa mbere wahamijwe icyaha cya jenoside n'urukiko mpuzamahanga.
Kambanda yize ibijyanye n'ubucuruzi n'amabanki, akora igihe kirekire muri Banki y'Abaturage y'u Rwanda ("Union des banques populaires du Rwanda"), aho yageze ku mwanya w'umuyobozi. Muri Mata 1994 yari visi-perezida w'ishyaka MDR mu ntara ya Butare.
Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Nyuma y'iyicwa rya Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana, Kambanda yashyizweho na Komite y'ibibazo ("Comité de crise") nka Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Guverinoma y'agateganyo. Ku wa 14 Gicurasi 1994 yavugiye ijambo muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda i Butare, ashishikariza abarimu n'abanyeshuri kwiga gukoresha imbunda no gushyiraho bariyeri ku mihanda yose.
Ku wa 28 Gicurasi 1994, guverinoma ye yagiranye amasezerano na Paul Barril yo gutanga intwaro n'amasasu no guhugura abasirikare.
Kambanda yafatiwe muri Kenya muri Nyakanga 1997, ajyanwa gufungirwa i Arusha muri Tanzaniya. Ku wa 1 Gicurasi 1998 yemeye ibyaha byose uko ari bitandatu, birimo jenoside, gucura umugambi wa jenoside, gushishikariza mu ruhame gukora jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu.
Ku wa 4 Nzeri 1998 yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Muri 2000 yasabye kwisubiraho ku kwemera ibyaha, avuga ko yabihatiwe, ariko ku wa 19 Ukwakira 2000 Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rwa ICTR rwanze ubujurire bwe, rwemeza igihano.
Kambanda yafungiwe muri gereza ya Koulikoro muri Mali. Mu Ukwakira 2024, ari muri gereza yo muri Senegali, yatanze ubuhamya hakoreshejwe amashusho mu rubanza rwa Eugène Rwamucyo mu Rukiko rwa Rubanda ("Cour d'assises") rw'i Paris; yavuze ko atemera igihano yahawe.

Michèle Alliot-Marie (10 Nzeri 1946) wari Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u Bufaransa.Akaba ari bamwe mubagize inteko ishinga amategeko mu bufaransa, zimnwe mu nshingano zagiye iyagize harimo Kuba umuyobozi w'ingabo Kandi ari umugore umwe mubagize ishyaka ry'abanyaburayi
Michèle Alliot-Marie.
Yavukiya mu gihugu cy'ubufaransa ku italiki ya 10 Nzeri mu mwaka wa 46,Se umubyara ni Bernard Marie wahoze ari umusifuzi w'umupira wa Ruhago mu makipe mpuzamahaitwa nga,Nyina yitwa Rennée Leyko akomoka mu gihugu cya Polonye

Akarere k’Arnavutköy (izina mu giturukiya: "Arnavutköy ilçesi") ni akarere kari mu ntara y’Istanbul y’igihugu cya Turukiya. Akarere k’Arnavutköy ni kamwe mu turere 39 tugize Intara y’Istanbul. Akarere gatuwe n’abaturage bagera kuri 175,871 (abagabo 86.741 n’abagore 81.380), batuye kubuso bwa km² 506.52.
Iryo zina ryakomotse ku magambo 2 yo m’ururimi rw’igiturukiya ariyo («Arnavut» 'umuntu w’Alubaniya' na «köy» 'umudugudu').
Akarere gahana imbibe.
Mu majyaruguru: Black Sea
Mu burasirazuba: Akarere k’Eyüp
Mu majyepfo: Akarere ka Başakşehir, Akarere k’Esenyurt n’Akarere ka Büyükçekmece
Mu burengerazuba: Akarere ka Çatalca
Umuyobozi w’akarere: Hürrem Aksoy
Umuyobozi w’umujyi: Ahmet Haşim Baltacı

Olusegun Obasanjo (izina mu kiyoruba: "Olusẹgun Ọbasanjọ" cyangwa "Mathiew Àrẹ̀mú Olúṣẹ́gun Ọbásanjọ́" ; 5 Werurwe 1937) ni Perezida wa Nijeriya.
Muri Kanama 2021, Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika washyizeho Olusegun Obasanjo nk'uhagarariye amahoro mu ihembe rya Afurika.

Abdoulaye Wade yavutse ku italiki ya 29 Gicurasi (05) 1926 muri Saint- Louis muri Senegali. Yabaye umunyapolitiki, umwarimu muri kaminuza ndetse n'umwunganizi mu by'amategeko. Perezida wa gatatu wa Senegali kuva mu mwaka 2000 kugeza 2012. Azwi cyane nk'umwe mu banyapolitiki bagize uruhare mu kwimakaza demokarasi no gusimburana ku butegetsi binyuze mu matora, muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba.
Mu mwaka 1974, yashinze ishyaka rya politiki ryitwa Senegalese Democratic Party, ryaje kuba imwe mu nkingi ikomeye y'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bwa Leopord Sedar Senghor (1960-1980) na Abdou Diouf (1981- 2000). Nyuma y'imyaka mankumyabiri n'itanu mu bikorwa bitavugwa rumwe n'ubutegetsi, gufungwa kenshi, yatorewe kuyobora igiihugu u mwaka 2000 atsinze Abdou Diouf, biba ikimenyetso gikomeye cyo gusimburana ku butegetsi binyuze mu matora mu bihugu bikoresha ururimi rw'igifaransa.
Ubuzima bwe bwite n'amashuri.
Abdoulaye Wade yakiye i Saint-Louis mu gihe Senegali yari ikiri mu bukoroni bw'Ubufaransa. Ise yari umucuruzi w'umukire ukomoka mu gace ka Kebemer gaherereye mu majyaruguru y'igihugu, kandi yari yarabanye mu ngabo za Senegali zakoreraga Ubufaransa.
Yize amashuri abanza muri Duval muri Saint-Louis n'ayisumbuye mu ishuri ryaa William Ponty i Dakar muri Senegali mbere yo kubona buruse yamujyanye kwiga i Paris, mu Bufaransa. Yize muri Lycee de Condorcet i Paris, nyuma akomereza amashuri makuru muri za kaminuza zitanduanye i Paris zirimo Sorbonne, Besancon cyangwa Grenoble, na Dijon, aho yize amategeko, ubukungu, ubugenge, indimi, imibare n'andi masomo atandukanye, aho yasoje icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza 1950, ndetse yakuye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga muri Sarbonne. Nyuma yabaye umwunganizi mu by'amategeko ndetse n'umwarimu wa kaminuza. urwego rw'amategeko, yimenyereje umwuga muri Besancon, aho yakuruwe n'umugore wari wubatse witwa Vivian Vert babyaranye abana babiri, Karim Wade na Sindiely Wade Ubwo yagarukaga muri Senegali muri 1960 nyuma y'ubwigenge, yabaye umuyobozi w'ishami ry'amategeko muri kaminuza ya Dakar, aho yanigishaga.
Umwuga mu by'amategeko n'ubuzima bwe bwa Politiki.
Mu gihe yari akiri mu Bufaransa, Wade; wari umunyamategeko ukiri muto, yifatanyije n'imiryango w'abanyeshuri bo muri Afurika ndetse n'amatsinda yarwanyaga ubukoloni. Yagize uruhare muri federasiyo y'abanyeshuri b'abirabura bo muri Afurika biga mu Bufaransa (FEANF); umuryango wavuyemo abayobozi benshi mu bihugu byo muri Afurika nyuma yo kubona Ubwigenge.
Mu mwaka 1958, yasubiye muri Senegali atangira gukora nk'umwunganizi mu mategeko. Yamenyekanye cyane mu mwaka wa 1963 ubwo yaburaniraga Mamadou Dia, wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Senegali, washinjwaga gushaka guhirika ubutegetsi. Nubwo Mamadou Dia yaje gukatirwa igifungo cya burundu, Wade akomeje kuvuga ko urwo rubanza rwari rukomeye kandi rudakwiye.
Muri Nyakanga (07)1974, Abdoulaye Wade yashinze ishyaka rya politiki yise Senegalese Democratic Party (PDS), nyuma yo kugirana ibiganiro na Perezida Leopard Sedar Senghor akamuha uburenzira. Icyo gihe, Perezida Senghor wabaye perezida wa mbere w'iki gihugu, yatumiwe mu nama y'Afurika yunze ubumwe, aho Wade yari yatumiwe nk'impuguke yagombaga kubaganiriza ku buryo hashyirwaho ifaranga rya Afurika. Icyo gihe, aba bombi baraye muri hoteli imwe ariko ntibigeze bahura. Nyuma, Wade abifashijwemo na Moustapha Niasse wari ukuriye ibiro bya Perezida Senghor, barahuye amusaba uburenganzira bwo gushinga ishyaka ariko ritari irimurwanya, ahubwo iryo kugira uruhare mu kubaka igihugu. Nyuma ishyaka rya Wade ryabaye urubuga rw'abashakaga impinduka mu miyoborere y'igihugu.
Mu matora yabaye mu mwaka 1978, Ishyaka rya PDS ryabonye imyanya 17 mu myanya 100 yo mu nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Wade aba umudepite. Muri uwo mwaka, Wade yiyamamarije umwanya w'umukuru w'igihugu ahanganye na Senghor, ariko aatsindwa ku ajwi 18%, Senghor wafatwaga nka Se w'ubwigenge agira 82%. Nubwo Wade yagize amajwi make, ariko yari intangiriro y'urugendo. Nyuma yaho muri 1981, Senghor yasimbuwe ku butegetsi na Abdou Diouf ndetse n'ishyaka ryari ku butegetsi rirahinduka. Nyuma Wade yakomeje guhatanira ubutegetsi mu matora yo muri 1983, 1988, 1993, ahanganye na Diouf ariko agatsindwa. Muri urwo rugamba rwa politiki, Abdoulaye Wade yafunzwe inshuro nyinshi kubera ibikorwa bye byo kwamagana ubutegetsi buriho. Wade yahishuye ko yahisemo kujya ku ruhande rutavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, kandi yanabipfira.
Mu matora yo muri 1993, Dakar habaye imyigaragamyo ikomeye. Muri Gashyantare (02) 1994, abapolisi 6 batwikiwe mu modoka mu modoka yabo barapfa bituma Wade atabwa muri yombi. Nyuma y'amezi atanu ari no myigaragambyo yo kwiyicisha inzara, Wade yarafunguwe mu gihe benshi bari bazi ko ari iherezo ry'ibikorwa bye bya politiki ku myaka 68 gusa. Mu mwaka wa 1995, Wade yabaye Minisitiri muri guverinoma yiswe iy'ubumwe ku butegetsi bwa Diouf ariko ayivamo nyuma y'imyaka ibiri (1992), ahabwa iina ry'iritazirano rya Sopi.
Uko yabaye Perezida wa Senegali (2000-2012).
Mu matora yabaye muri Werurwe (03) 2000, Abdoulaye Wade yatsinze Perezida Abdou Diouf ku majwi 58.5%, aba Perezida wa gatatu wa Senegali. Iyo ntsinzi yabaye amateka kuko ari bwo bwa mbere mu mateka ya Senegali ubutegetsi bwari buhindutse binyuze mu matora hagati y'amashyaka ya politiki. Yabaye Perezida ku myaka 73 y'amavuko, nyuma y'imyaka 26 atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi.
Ku butegetsi bwe, Wade yatangije imishinga ikomeye irimo harimo kubaka umuhanda wa Dakar -Diamniado, kwagura ibikorwaremezo byo gutwara abantu n'ibintu. Wade yateje imbere umushinga wo kubaka ikibuga mpuzamahanga cy'indege cya Diamniadio ndetse yubaka igishushanyo cyo kongera kuvuka kwa Afurika cyafashwe nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubwubatsi buhanitsi muri Afurika n'ibindi. Yanamenyekanye nk'umuyobozi washyigikiye kwishyira hamwe kwa Afurika no guteza imbere ibikorwaremezo ku mugabane.
Nubwo yageze ku bikorwa byinshi, ubutegetsi bwe bwanenzwe ku bijyanye n'imiyoborere, gukoresha nabi ububasha, ndetse no gushaka ko umuhungu we, Karim Wade, yamusimbura ku butegetsi. Ibi byateje impaka mu gihugu no mu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bwe.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, Wade yongeye kwiyamamariza kuba umukuru w'igihugu ku nshuro ya gatatu, byakuruye impaka zishingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya Senegali ryo muri 2001, ndetse hakorwa imyigaragabyo ikomeye. Ubwo abari bahatanye bageraga mu cyiciro cya kabiri, Wade yatsinzwe na Macky Sall wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Intebe we ku majwi 65.8%. Nyuma y'itangazwa y'ibyavuye mu matora, yabyemeye atazuyaje maze ashimira Macky Sall ku ntsinzi ye, bifatwa nk'ikimenyetso cyo kwimakaza ihame rya demokarasi.
Ubuzima bwe nyuma yo kuva ku butegetsi.
Abdoulaye Wade ubu ufite imyaka 100 y'amavuko, yavuze ku butegetsi akomeza kugira uruhare mu bikorwa bya politiki muri Senegali ndetse no gushyigikira ibikorwa by'ishyaka rya DPS. Yagize uruhare mu bukangurambaga bwo gufunguza umuhungu we Karim Wade wari warakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 6 azira kunyereza umutungo wa Leta. Karim wari warafunzwe muri 2015, yarekuwe mu mwaka w'2016, nyuma yo guhabwa imbabazi na Perezida Macky Sall.
Mu matora aheruka yatsinzwe na Bassirou Diomaye Faye, Wade yahamagariye abanyasenegali kumutora mu matora yari ahanganyemo na Macky Sall wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Intebe ku butegetsi bwe. Ubu Wade atuye mu Bufaransa, aho afite ubwenegihugu bwaho.
Abdoulaye Wade afatwa nk'umwe mu banyapolitiki bakomeye babayeho muri Senegali ndetse no muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba. Yagize uruhare mu kwimakaza demokarasi, guhangana mu bikorwa bya politiki no kwimakaza ihererekanya butegetsi binyuze mu matora. Nubwo ibikorwa bye byagiye binengwa mu bihe bitandukanye, umurage we ukomeje gufatwa nk'igice cy'ingenzi cy'amateka akomeye ya Senegali. Taliki ya 4 n'iya 5 Kamena (06) 2026, Muri Senegali hizihijwe ubuzima bwa Wade wabayeho mu bihe bitandukanye na n'ubu ugifatwa nk'intangarugero, by'umwihariko Perezida Faye.

Denis Sassou Nguesso (yavutse ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 1943 i Edou) ni umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Repubulika ya Kongo, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva mu 1997, nyuma yo kuba yarakiyoboye bwa mbere kuva mu 1979 kugeza mu 1992. Ni umwe mu bayobozi b'ibihugu bamaze igihe kirekire ku butegetsi muri Afurika. Mu gihe cya manda ye ya mbere, yayoboye ishyaka rimwe rya gikomunisiti, Parti congolais du travail (PCT). Mu 1990, yemeye amashyaka menshi, ariko mu 1992 atsindwa amatora ya perezida. Yagarutse ku butegetsi mu 1997, inyeshyamba ze, Cobras, zifashijwe n'ingabo za Angola, zimaze guhirika Perezida Pascal Lissouba mu ntambara y'abenegihugu. Kuva icyo gihe, yatsinze amatora ya 2002, 2009, 2016, 2021 na 2026, kandi mu 2015 yahinduye Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo ashobore kongera kwiyamamaza. Ubutegetsi bwe bwakunze kuvugwamo ibirego bya ruswa no kunyereza umutungo wa leta.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Sassou Nguesso yavukiye i Edou, umudugudu uri hafi y'Oyo mu majyaruguru ya Kongo, mu bwoko bw'Abambochi. Ni bucura bw'abana ba Julien Nguesso, wari umutware w'abahigi, na Émilienne Mouebara. Yize amashuri abanza i Fort-Rousset (ubu ni Owando), hanyuma mu ishuri nderabarezi rya Dolisie kuva mu 1956 kugeza mu 1960.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Mu 1960, mbere gato y'uko igihugu kibona ubwigenge, Sassou Nguesso yinjiye mu gisirikare. Yahawe imyitozo ya gisirikare muri Aligeriya, hanyuma mu ishuri ry'abasirikare barwanira ku butaka rya Saint-Maixent, mu Ubufaransa. Yabaye umwe mu basirikare bakuru ba mbere b'umutwe w'abasirikare barwanira mu kirere wa mbere w'ingabo za Kongo, washinzwe na Marien Ngouabi mu 1965; nyuma yayoboye uwo mutwe, ingabo n'akarere ka gisirikare ka Brazzaville, hanyuma ishami ry'ubutasi. Yabaye koloneli mu 1978, nyuma aba jenerali mu 1989.
Intangiriro y'umwuga wa politiki.
Mu 1968, Sassou Nguesso yagize uruhare muri kudeta yahiritse Perezida Alphonse Massamba-Débat, ishyira Marien Ngouabi ku butegetsi, maze aba umwe mu bagize Inama y'Igihugu y'Impinduramatwara. Mu Ukuboza 1969, yatorewe kuba umwe mu bagize komite nkuru ya mbere y'ishyaka rishya rya gikomunisiti, Parti congolais du travail (PCT). Ku ya 18 Gicurasi 1973, yagizwe umuyobozi w'umutekano wa leta, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Ingabo n'Umutekano afite imyaka 32.
Ku ya 18 Werurwe 1977, Perezida Ngouabi yarishwe. Komite ya gisirikare ya PCT iyobowe na Sassou Nguesso yahise ifata ubutegetsi; yayoboye igihugu by'agateganyo, mbere yo guha umwanya Jenerali Joachim Yhombi-Opango, akaguma kuba visi-perezida wa mbere wa komite na Minisitiri w'Ingabo.
Manda ya mbere (1979–1992).
Ku ya 8 Gashyantare 1979, Sassou Nguesso yagizwe perezida w'agateganyo, hanyuma ku ya 31 Werurwe 1979 yemezwa nk'umuyobozi wa komite nkuru ya PCT na Perezida wa Repubulika. Nubwo yafatwaga nk'uri ku ruhande rw'Ubumwe bw'Abasoviyeti, yagiranye umubano ukomeye n'Ubufaransa, kandi ikigo cy'Abafaransa cya peteroli Elf Aquitaine cyagize uruhare rukomeye mu bucukuzi bwa peteroli ya Kongo. Kuva mu 1986 kugeza mu 1987, yayoboye Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Afurika (OUA).
Mu 1990, yemeye amashyaka menshi, maze mu 1991 Inama y'Igihugu imwambura ububasha bwo kuyobora, akomeza kuba umukuru w'igihugu w'icyubahiro gusa. Mu matora ya perezida yo muri Kanama 1992, yabaye uwa gatatu n'amajwi 17%, ashyigikira Pascal Lissouba watsinze icyiciro cya kabiri.
Intambara z'abenegihugu no kugaruka ku butegetsi.
Mu Ugushyingo 1993, intambara y'abenegihugu yadutse nyuma y'impaka ku byavuye mu matora y'abadepite, imitwe yitwaje intwaro ishyigikiye Lissouba irwana n'iya Bernard Kolélas (Ninjas) n'iya Sassou Nguesso (Cobras). Sassou Nguesso yamaze amezi arindwi i Paris mu 1996, agaruka muri Mutarama 1997 kwitegura amatora ya perezida.
Ku ya 5 Kamena 1997, ingabo za leta zagose inzu ye i Brazzaville, bituma intambara ya kabiri y'abenegihugu yaduka hagati y'ingabo za leta n'umutwe we, Cobras. Ku ya 18 Nzeri, ingabo za Angola zinjiye mu ntambara zimushyigikiye, maze mu Ukwakira Lissouba ahunga igihugu; ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1997, Sassou Nguesso yarahiriye kuba Perezida. Yakuyeho Itegeko Nshinga rya 1992, arisimbuza itegeko ryamuhaye ububasha bwinshi. Imirwano yakomeje kugeza ku masezerano y'amahoro yo mu Ukuboza 1999, ishyira iherezo ku ntambara yasize abantu bari hagati ya 8 000 na 10 000 bapfuye n'abagera ku 800 000 bavuye mu byabo.
Perezida kuva mu 1997.
Mu matora ya perezida yo ku ya 10 Werurwe 2002, umukandida w'ingenzi utavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi akaba yarivanyemo, Sassou Nguesso yatsinze n'amajwi 89,41%. Muri Mutarama 2006, yatorewe kuyobora Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe. Muri Nyakanga 2009, yongeye gutorwa n'amajwi 78,61%, mu gihe abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bari baretse kwitabira amatora.
Mu 2015, yateguye kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga rishya ryamwemereraga kongera kwiyamamaza; ryemejwe n'amajwi 92,96%, ariko abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavuga ko ubwitabire bwari buke. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2016 (60%), mu 2021 (88,57%) no mu Werurwe 2026 (94,82%). Mu matora ya 2021, umukandida wa kabiri, Guy-Brice Parfait Kolélas, yapfuye azize COVID-19 bukeye bw'amatora.
Nk'umuyobozi w'akanama k'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe gashinzwe ikibazo cya Libiya, yagize uruhare mu gushaka umuti w'icyo kibazo, ndetse muri Ukuboza 2024 asura Tripoli na Benghazi. Yashishikarije guverinoma z'u Rwanda n'iya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuganira kugira ngo intambara yo mu burasirazuba bwa Kongo irangire. Yateguye kandi inama y'Ibibaya Bitatu ("Sommet des trois Bassins") i Brazzaville mu Ukwakira 2023, igamije kurengera amashyamba y'inzitane. Kuva muri Nzeri 2025, ayoboye inama y'abakuru b'ibihugu bya CEMAC.
Mu Mata 2007, imiryango ya Sherpa na Survie yareze mu Bufaransa abakuru b'ibihugu bitanu b'Afurika n'imiryango yabo, barimo Sassou Nguesso, ibashinja guhisha umutungo wanyerejwe muri leta, mu rubanza ruzwi nka «imitungo yabonetse mu buryo butemewe» ("biens mal acquis"). Mu 2010, Urukiko rusesa imanza rw'Ubufaransa rwemeye ko ikirego gikurikiranwa. Mu Nyakanga 2007, umuryango Global Witness wagaragaje ko umuhungu we, Denis Christel Sassou Nguesso, yaba yarakoresheje amafaranga y'ubucuruzi bwa peteroli mu kugura ibintu by'agaciro i Paris na Dubai.
Mu Ukwakira 2021, izina rye ryagaragaye mu nyandiko zizwi nka "Pandora Papers", zavuze ko mu 1998, nyuma gato yo gusubira ku butegetsi, handitswe ikigo cyitwa Inter African Investment mu birwa bya Virginie by'Abongereza, ahantu hazwiho kudasoresha. Guverinoma ye yahakanye uruhare urwo ari rwo rwose muri icyo kibazo. Muri Mutarama 2026, yavuzwe mu kibazo cya ruswa gifitanye isano n'ikigo cya peteroli cyo muri Noruveje, Petronor; guverinoma ye ibyita gusebanya.
Ku butegetsi bwe, ubukungu bwagiye buzamuka, ariko igihugu gifite umwenda munini, kandi abaturage benshi baracyabaho mu bukene nubwo igihugu gikungahaye kuri peteroli n'amabuye y'agaciro.
Sassou Nguesso yashakanye na Antoinette Tchibota. Afite abana benshi; umukobwa we, Édith Lucie, yashakanye na Perezida wa Gabon, Omar Bongo, mu 1989.

Yoweri Kaguta Museveni Tibuhaburwa (yavutse ku ya 15 Nzeri 1944 i Ntungamo) ni umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Ubugande, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva mu 1986. Nyuma yo kurwanya ubutegetsi bw'igitugu bwa Idi Amin, yayoboye umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa National Resistance Army (NRA) mu ntambara yo mu ishyamba yo kurwanya ubutegetsi bwa Milton Obote, maze mu 1986 afata Kampala, aba perezida. Ku butegetsi bwe, Ubugande bwagize iterambere ry'ubukungu, kandi bwahanganye n'inyeshyamba za Lord's Resistance Army; ingabo z'Ubugande zagize uruhare mu ntambara ya mbere n'iya kabiri za Kongo. Kubera ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryakuyeho imbibi za manda (2005) n'iz'imyaka (2017–2018), yakomeje kongera gutorwa, kugeza ku manda ye ya karindwi mu 2026. Kugeza mu 2026, ni umwe mu bayobozi b'ibihugu bamaze igihe kirekire ku butegetsi ku isi, akaba afatwa n'imiryango myinshi n'itangazamakuru nk'umunyagitugu.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Yoweri Museveni yavutse ku ya 15 Nzeri 1944 i Ntungamo, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'Ubugande, ku babyeyi Amos Kaguta (1916–2013), wari umworozi w'inka, na Esteri Kokundeka Nganzi (1918–2001). Ni Umuhima wo mu bwami bwa Mpororo (ubu ni igice cya Ankole). Izina rya «Museveni» rikomoka ku ijambo ry'Icyongereza «"seven"» («karindwi»): se yari umusirikare wo muri batayo ya karindwi ya "King's African Rifles" mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose.
Amashuri n'ibikorwa bya mbere bya politiki.
Museveni yize mu mashuri ya Kyamate na Mbarara, hanyuma mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Ntare kuva mu 1961. Yize ubukungu n'ubumenyi bwa politiki muri Kaminuza ya Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya, kuva mu 1967 kugeza mu 1970, mu gihe icyo gihugu cyari kiyobowe na Julius Nyerere kandi cyakiraga impirimbanyi nyinshi zirwanya ubukoloni. Yanditse igitabo cy'ubushakashatsi kuri Frantz Fanon, kandi ahamenyanira na John Garang. Muri kaminuza, yashinze kandi ayobora urugaga rw'abanyeshuri b'impinduramatwara b'Abanyafurika (USARF), ayobora itsinda ry'abanyeshuri ryagiye mu bice byari bigenzurwa na FRELIMO muri Mozambike, aho bahawe imyitozo ya gisirikare. Mu 1970, yagarutse mu Bugande, yinjira mu rwego rw'ubutasi ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Milton Obote.
Urugamba rw'inyeshyamba.
Nyuma ya kudeta ya Idi Amin yo ku ya 25 Mutarama 1971, Museveni yahungiye muri Tanzaniya, ashinga umutwe wa Front for National Salvation (FRONASA). Mu 1979, yagarutse mu Bugande ayoboye inyeshyamba zafashijwe n'ingabo za Tanzaniya, mu ntambara yahiritse Amin, maze aba Minisitiri w'Ingabo.
Ishyaka rye, Uganda Patriotic Movement, ryatsinzwe mu matora ya 1980 yagaruye Obote ku butegetsi, ayo matora akaba yarateje impaka nyinshi. Avuga ko yaranzwe n'uburiganya, Museveni yashinze umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa National Resistance Army (NRA). Ku ya 6 Gashyantare 1981, ari kumwe n'abarwanyi bagera kuri mirongo itatu, barimo Paul Kagame, yigaruriye ububiko bw'intwaro bw'ikigo cya gisirikare cya Kabamba. Yubatse buhoro buhoro umutwe wa politiki wa National Resistance Movement (NRM) n'ingabo zawo, NRA, zabonye inkunga y'abaturage kubera imyitwarire myiza yazo. Ku ya 26 Mutarama 1986, nyuma y'urugamba rwa Kampala, NRA yafashe umurwa mukuru, maze Museveni arahirira kuba perezida.
Perezida w'Ubugande.
Ubukungu n'imibereho.
Kuva yafata ubutegetsi, Museveni yashyize imbere kugarura amahoro mu gihugu cyari cyarashegeshwe n'intambara no kuzahura ubukungu. Mu 1987, yaretse ibitekerezo bya gikomunisiti, yemera amabwiriza y'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI) na Banki y'Isi, maze Ubugande bufatwa nk'«umunyeshuri mwiza» wa FMI. Ubukungu bwazamutseho impuzandengo ya 6,5% ku mwaka mu myaka ya 1990, n'irenga 7% mu myaka ya 2000, kandi ubukene bwagabanutse inshuro eshatu mu myaka makumyabiri. Yashyizeho imyanya yagenewe abagore mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, kandi mu 1997 atangiza amashuri abanza y'ubuntu. Ubugande bwagabanyije cyane ikwirakwira rya SIDA. Kuva mu 1991 kugeza mu 1992, Museveni yayoboye Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Afurika (OUA).
Mu 2006, ubutegetsi bwe bwashyize iherezo ku bikorwa by'inyeshyamba za Lord's Resistance Army mu majyaruguru y'igihugu.
Akarere k'Ibiyaga Bigari.
Museveni yashyigikiye umutwe wa FPR-Inkotanyi w'inshuti ye Paul Kagame, wafashe ubutegetsi mu Rwanda muri Nyakanga 1994, ugahagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu ntambara ya mbere ya Kongo (1996–1997), u Rwanda n'Ubugande byashyigikiye inyeshyamba za Laurent-Désiré Kabila zahiritse Mobutu Sese Seko. Muri Kanama 1998, mu ntambara ya kabiri ya Kongo, ingabo z'Ubugande zinjiye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kurwanya Kabila, zishyigikira n'inyeshyamba za Jean-Pierre Bemba. Ingabo z'u Rwanda n'iz'Ubugande zashinjwe gusahura umutungo kamere wa Kongo. Mu 2000, ingabo z'ibihugu byombi zarasanye inshuro eshatu i Kisangani, bituma umubano wa Kagame na Museveni uzamba. Ingabo z'Ubugande zavuye muri Kongo mu 2003, maze mu Ukuboza 2005 Urukiko Mpuzamahanga rw'Ubutabera rutegeka Ubugande kwishyura indishyi Kongo kubera ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu ryakozwe muri iyo ntambara.
Amatora n'ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga.
Muri Gicurasi 1996, Museveni yatsinze amatora ya mbere ya perezida yari abaye mu myaka 16, n'amajwi 74%, maze mu 2001 yongera gutorwa n'amajwi 69,3%, atsinda Kizza Besigye. Muri Nyakanga 2005, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yavuguruye Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo ashobore kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu; muri uwo mwaka, kamarampaka yongeye kwemerera amashyaka gukora, nyuma y'uko yari yarabujijwe kuva mu 1986. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2006 (60%), mu 2011 (68%) no mu 2016 (60,75%), buri gihe atsinda Kizza Besigye. Mu 2018, yasinye itegeko rikuraho imbibi z'imyaka 75 ku mukandida ku mwanya wa perezida.
Mu matora yo ku ya 14 Mutarama 2021, yatsinze umuhanzi akaba n'umunyapolitiki Bobi Wine n'amajwi 58,6%, nubwo habayeho ibirego by'uburiganya n'ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu ; yarahiriye manda ya gatandatu ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2021. Mu matora ya Mutarama 2026, yongeye gutorwa n'amajwi 71,65%, imbere ya Bobi Wine (24,72%), mu bihe byaranzwe n'ifatwa n'ishimutwa ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, ihagarikwa rya interineti n'urugomo. Bobi Wine yamaganye ibyavuye muri ayo matora. Museveni yarahiriye manda ya karindwi ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2026.
Itegeko rihana ubutinganyi.
Muri Gashyantare 2014, Museveni yasinye itegeko rikaza ibihano ku butinganyi; Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwaritesheje agaciro muri Kanama 2014. Ubutegetsi bwe bwakomeje gushyiraho ingamba zikaze zirwanya abaryamana bahuje ibitsina.
Mu 1973, Museveni yashakanye na Janet Museveni, na we wabaye umunyapolitiki; bafitanye abana bane, barimo Muhoozi Kainerugaba, jenerali mu ngabo z'Ubugande. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000, yabaye umuyoboke w'Itorero ry'Abapentekote. Yanditse igitabo cy'ubuzima bwe, "Sowing the Mustard Seed" (1997).

Alpha Oumar Konaré (2 Gashyantare 1946) ni Perezida wa Mali na Perezida wa Komisiyo ya Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.
Muri Nzeri 2021, Alpha Oumar Konaré, yari mu bitaro byihutirwa muri Maroc mu bitaro bya Cheikh Zaid i Rabat.

Anna Maria Agnes "Agnes" van Ardenne-Van der Hoeven (wavutse ku wa 21 Mutarama 1950) ni umunyapolitiki n'umudipolomate w'Umuholandi wagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru. Yabaye umwe mu banyamuryango b'ishyaka Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), aho yagiye anagira imyanya itandukanye muri guverinoma y'u Buholandi ndetse no mu rwego rwa dipolomasi.
Agnes van Ardenne yavukiye i Maasland mu Buholandi ku wa 21 Mutarama 1950. Mbere yo kwinjira muri Guverinoma y'u Buholandi, yabaye Visi Perezida w'umuryango CORDAID, ukora ibikorwa by'ubutabazi n'iterambere, ndetse aba n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Komite y'igihugu ya UNICEF mu Buholandi.Hagati ya 1994 na 2002, yari umwe mu bagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Buholandi. Muri icyo gihe kandi yari mu ntumwa z'Inteko zoherezwaga mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Inama y'u Burayi (PACE).
Minisitiri ushinzwe ubufatanye mu iterambere.
Kuva mu 2002 kugeza mu 2007, Agnes van Ardenne yabaye Minisitiri ushinzwe Ubutwererane Mpuzamahanga n'Iterambere muri guverinoma ya Minisitiri w'Intebe Jan Peter Balkenende. Mu mwaka wa 2004, ubwo u Buholandi bwari buyoboye Inama y'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi, yayoboye inama z'abaminisitiri bashinzwe ubufatanye mu iterambere.Mu gihe yari kuri uwo mwanya, yibanze ku gufasha ibihugu bifite intege nke n'ibyugarijwe n'intambara, harimo na Sudani. Yanashyize imbere ko nibura 50% by'ingengo y'imari y'u Buholandi yagenerwaga ubufatanye bw'ibihugu byombi ishyirwa mu mishinga yo muri Afurika.
Mu 2006, yahagaritse inkunga y'amadolari ya Amerika agera kuri miliyoni 150 yagombaga guhabwa guverinoma ya Perezida Mwai Kibaki wa Kenya, bitewe n'impungenge zerekeye ruswa.Nyuma y'umutingito wabaye muri Kashmir mu mwaka wa 2005, yabaye umwe mu bayobozi ba mbere baturutse mu mahanga basuye Pakisitani kugira ngo barebe uko ibikorwa by'ubutabazi byakorwaga.
Gushyigikira uburezi n'ubuzima.
Mu 2006, yongereye inkunga u Buholandi bwatangaga mu burezi bwo mu mashuri yisumbuye na kaminuza, ayigeza kuri miliyoni 110 z'amayero ku mwaka. Yanongereye kandi umusanzu watangwaga muri gahunda ya Education for All Fast Track Initiative (FTI) awugeza kuri miliyoni 150 z'amayero.Muri uwo mwaka kandi, yasezeranyije GAVI inkunga igera kuri miliyoni 100 z'amayero mu myaka ine yo gushyigikira gahunda zo gukingira abana no guteza imbere ubuvuzi. Yanatanze indi nkunga ya miliyoni 201 z'amadolari ya Amerika kuri UNICEF, igamije gufasha abana bibasiwe n'intambara, ibiza cyangwa ibindi bibazo gukomeza amashuri.
Nyuma yo kuva muri guverinoma.
Nyuma yo kuva muri guverinoma mu 2007, yabaye Uhagarariye u Buholandi muri FAO, WFP na IFAD i Roma kugeza mu 2011.Hagati ya 2011 na 2014, yabaye Perezida w'Inama y'Ubuhinzi bw'Indabo n'Ibihingwa by'Ubusitani mu Buholandi. Kuva mu 2017, ni Perezida w'Ikigo cy'u Buholandi gishinzwe igenzura ry'ubuhinzi bw'indabo n'ibihingwa by'ubusitani.
Mu miryango mpuzamahanga.
Hagati ya 2003 na 2007, Agnes van Ardenne yabaye umwe mu bagize Inama y'Abaguverineri mu mwanya w'uhagarariye u Buholandi mu Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere (AfDB), Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere ya Aziya (ADB) ndetse no muri Banki y'Isi (World Bank).
Mu miryango idaharanira inyungu.
Kuva mu 2013, ni Perezida w'Inama y'Ubutegetsi y'African Studies Centre (ASC) yo muri Kaminuza ya Leiden, ikigo gikora ubushakashatsi ku Afurika.Kuva mu 2012, yabaye umwe mu bagize Inama Ngishwanama y'Ubuzima bw'Ibidukikije n'Ibikorwaremezo (RLI) mu Buholandi.Yanabaye Perezida w'Inama y'Ubugenzuzi ya Van Hall Larenstein, ishuri rikuru ryigisha ibijyanye n'ubuhinzi, ibidukikije n'iterambere rirambye. Ni na we uyoboye Inama y'Ubutegetsi y'Marga Klompé Foundation, umuryango ukora ibikorwa by'imibereho myiza n'iterambere ry'abaturage.
Ku wa 30 Werurwe 2012, Agnes van Ardenne hamwe n'abandi banyapolitiki bakomeye bo mu ishyaka Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), barimo ba Minisitiri b'Intebe bahoze ari bo Ruud Lubbers na Piet de Jong, bashyize umukono ku nyandiko yamaganaga icyemezo cya guverinoma ya Minisitiri w'Intebe Mark Rutte cyo kugabanya ingengo y'imari yagenerwaga ubufatanye mpuzamahanga n'iterambere.

Bwana Antipas Mbusa Nyamwisi (15 Ugushyingo 1959) ni Minisitiri w’Ubutwererane bw’Akarere muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Muri Werurwe 2023, Antipas Mbusa aba umunyamabanga wa Leta, ushinzwe kwishyira hamwe kw'akarere.

Dr. Abu-Zeid yavutse taliki ya 29 Nyakanga 1935, ahabwa impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ishami ry’ubwubatsi muri Kaminuza ya Cairo, na M.Sc. (kuhira) mu 1960 n’impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga (PhD) muri Kaminuza ya California mu 1962. Ni umunyeshuri mu kigo cy’iterambere ry’ubukungu, IBRD. Dr. Abu-Zeid yakoze imirimo, itandukanye y’ubushakashatsi muri Minisiteri y’ihira kugeza ubwo yabaye Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi ku gukwirakwiza amazi no kuyabungabunga. Yari Perezida w’Ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi ku mazi gicunga ibigo cumi na kimwe by’ubushakashatsi bikora mu nzego zitandukanye z’amazi yo kuhira no kuyabungabunga. Yatanze inyandiko nyinshi binyuze mu bushakashatsi bwe bwa siyansi. Mu 1986 yahawe umudari w’icyubahiro w’icyiciro cya mbere na Perezida wa Repubulika ya Misiri kubera uruhare rwe rukomeye mu kongera inyungu z’amazi y’agaciro. Yari Visi Perezida wa ICID kuva mu mwaka 1986-1989

Jean-Marie Guéhenno (yavutse ku wa 30 Ukwakira 1949 i Paris) ni umudipolomate w’Umufaransa. Kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2008, yabaye Umunyamabanga Mukuru Wungirije w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye (Loni) ushinzwe ibikorwa byo kubungabunga amahoro ("Peacekeeping Operations").
Ni umuhungu w’umwanditsi Jean Guéhenno na Annie Guéhenno, wari mu barwanyi ba "Résistance" mu gihe cy’Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi. Yize muri École normale supérieure no muri École nationale d’administration (ENA), nyuma akora muri "Cour des comptes". Yayoboye ishami rishinzwe igenamigambi rya politiki mu Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’Ubufaransa (1989–1993), hanyuma ayobora Institut des hautes études de défense nationale (IHEDN) kuva mu 1998 kugeza mu 2000.
Yashyizweho na Kofi Annan, ayobora ibikorwa bya Loni byo kubungabunga amahoro kuva ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2000. Muri icyo gihe ibyo bikorwa byagutse kurusha ikindi gihe cyose, bigera ku bakozi bagera ku 130 000 mu butumwa 18. Yavuye kuri uwo mwanya mu 2008.
Kuva muri Werurwe kugeza muri Nyakanga 2012, yabaye Intumwa Yihariye Wungirije ya Loni n’Umuryango w’Ibihugu by’Abarabu muri Siriya.
Yahawe impeta ya "Légion d’honneur" (Officier) n’iya "Bundesverdienstkreuz" y’Ubudage (Commandeur).

Ibireti (izina ry’ubumenyi mu kilatini: "Tanacetum cinerariifolium"; izina mu gifaransa: "pyrèthre") ni ikimera kivamo umuti wica udukoko uva mu ndabo z'umweru n'umuhondo zijya gusa na zimwe bazi ku izina rya Marigarita. Kubera uwo muti wabyo byashoboye kubaho imyaka n'imyaka byirinda.

Icyiyoni ni inyoni ijya kuba nini, yirabura, Irangwa n'amabara abiri: Umukara wiganje n'ibara ry'umweru mu gituza, abanyarwanda bagereranya na karuvati. Icyiyoni ni inyoni izwiho kumenya kwihahira kandi iraramba cyane,mu muco w'u Rwanda bakunze kubicamo umugani batebya iyo bashaka kuvugako umuntu ari mukuru cyane bavuga ko afite imyaka nk'iy'icyiyoni.
Indeshyo n' Ibiro by'icyiyone.
Iyi nyoni ubusanzwe ireshya na 30cm cyangwa 35. Ishora gupima garama ziri hagari ya 400 na 600 bitewe n’aho yakuriye n’ibyo irya. Tubamenyeshe ko icyiyoni kirya byose. Ibyiyoni tubona mu Rwanda no muri kano karere sibyo byonyine bibaho kuko hari n’ibiba muri Aziya no muri Groenland kandi byo biba ari binini cyane. Umunwa wacyo uba ukomeye kandi ufite ingufu kuko bigifasha kubaga inyama zo kurya no kwica ibikoko runaka nk’imbeba, uruvu, ibiharangara, inzoka n’ibindi. Kubera ko hari amoko menshi y’ibyiyoni, ntuzagire ngo byose biba bifite amababa y’umweru ku ijosi. Hari ibindi biba bisa n’umukara hose.
Kimwe mu bintu abahanga bakundira icyiyoni ni uko kigira uruhare runini mu gusukura aho kiba. Ibyiyoni bikunda kurya imyanda abantu baba bataye cyangwa ishobora kubagiraho ingaruka mbi.
Ibivugwa ku cy'iyone.
Hari abantu bavuga ko icyiyoni kiri mu nyoni zizi ‘ubwenge’kurusha izindi kuko kiibasha kwikemurira ibibazo gikoresheje intoki zacyo. Amoko y’ibyiyoni amwe n’amwe abasha kwigana amajwi rukana y’ibikoko cyangwa abantu. Rimwe abahanga bigeze kugerageza ubwenge bw’icyiyoni bagafa intongo y’inyama bayizirika ku mugozi utambitse. Kugira ngo iriya nyoni ibashe kugera kuri iriya nyama yagombaga kugenda hejuru yawo akirinda kugwa kandi igakora ibishoboka byose iriya nyama yagwa. Cyarabikoze kandi ngo nticyari cyarabitojwe mbere. Kizwiho kandi kwiba ibintu runaka kitanakeneye haba mu kubaka icyari cyangwa gukoresha ikindi kintu icyo aricyo cyose.
Ubushakashatsi bwerekana ko ibyiyoni bikiri bito bigira amatsiko cyane. Ibyiyoni bikuru bikunda gushishikazwa n’ibintu bibumbabumbye kandi by’umuhondo kuko ngo bituma bitekereza ko byaba ari amagi ya bigenzi byabyo. Ubwo bitegerezaga ibyiyoni mu ishyamba aho byari bituranye n’ibirura, abahanga baje gusanga mu masaha runaka ibyiyoni bijya byigana ibirura iyo biri kumoka kandi ngo ibi basanze ari uburyo biriya bikoko byombi birushanwamo kuririmba.
Ibyiyoni bitera amagi ahantu hihishe, ahari byanga ko izindi nyoni nini byazaza kubirira amagi gusa bihura n’akaga k’inzoka hamwe n’ibihangara biyarya iyo hatabayeho kuyacungira umutekano. Iyo bimaze guturaga ariya magi, ibyana bitangira kwiga kuguruka hakiri kare ariko biri kumwe na bya nyina.
Ubusanzwe kimwe mu byerekana ko inyoni zatangiye kumenya ubwenge ni uburyo ziguruka kuko bituma zibasha kujya kwishakira icyo kurya.
Abahanga baje gusanga ibyiyoni bucana inyuma. Rimwe bigeze kwitegereza icyiyoni k’ikigabo ubwo cyasuraga ikigore gusanga nta kigabo gihari hanyuma kiracyimya!Iyo icyiyoni cyabengutse ikigore mbere yo kubana birabanza bigashaka ikibanza bizubakamo icyari hanyuma bikabona kubana.
Kubera ko birya byose, bishaka ikibanza bikurikije ubwinshi bw’ibiryo biboneka mu karere bituyemo. Ubwinshi cyangwa ubuke bw’ibiribwa nibwo bugena uko ahazahwirwa icyari hazaba hangana. Icyari kiba cyubakishijwe udushami duto tw’ibiti, ibyatsi, imigozi ishishuye ku biti ndetse n’icyondo. Mu gice cy’imbere haba hashashemo ibyatsi byoroshye, amababa ndetse n’ubwoya bw’inyamaswa runaka.
Gutera amagi biba mu mpera ya Gashyantare kandi ibyiyoni bitera amagi ari hagati y’atatu n’arindwi. Ibyana bita bya nyina bikajya kwibeshaho nyuma y’iminsi 45.Ubusanzwe abahanga bemeza ko icyiyoni iyo cyorowe aribwo kiramba kuko gishobora kumara imyaka 40 ariko iyo kiba mu gasozi ntikirenza imyaka hagati ya 13 na 15.

Pome (izina ry’ubumenyi mu kilatini: "Malus domestica" ; izina mu gifaransa: "pomme") ni igiti, urubuto n’ikiribwa.
Uru rubuto rwa pome ruba mu muryango w'ibimera witwa "Rosaceae".
Pome ni urubuto ruzwi cyane mu ngere mberabyombi cyane cyane ku Mugabane w’Uburayi, aho abaturage bamaze igihe kirekire barurya, naho bimwe mu bihugu by’Afurika nk’u Rwanda bikaba bibonye izi mbuto vuba, ndetse zikaba zigihenze cyane.
Nubwo usanga igiciro cyazo kiri hejuru usanga ari zimwe mu mbuto zikunzwe na benshi cyane ku isi, naho muri Afurika zigakundwa n’abifite. Ahanini usanga izi mbuto zikundirwa kuba zikungahaye kuri Vitamini C.
Aya makuru avuga ko muri garama 100 z’urubuto rwa pome, habamo ubushobozi bwa anti oxidant, bungana n’ubwa garama 1500 za vitamini C ibonetse mu zindi mbuto cyangwa ishobora gutangwa nk’umuti kwa muganga.
Aya makuru avuga ko atari byiza guhata uru rubuto rwa pome mbere yo kururya, kuko igishishwa cy’inyuma ari cyo gikungahaye cyane muri vitamini C kurusha uduce tw’imbere.
Aya makuru akomeza avuga ko nibura byakabaye byiza umuntu ashoboye kurya urubuto rumwe rwa pome ku munsi, ibi bishobora gutuma atagira ibibazo bikomoka ku kurya ibinyamavuta byinshi binakungahaye kuri "cholesterol".

Ikirunga cya Bisoke kiri muri pariki nasiyonali y'u Rwanda na pariki natiyonali ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Umusozi wa Bisoke ni ikirunga gikora giherereye mu misozi ya Virunga mu gice cya Albertine Rift, ishami ry’iburengerazuba rya East African Rift. Uherereye ku mupaka w’u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ariko impinga yawo iri mu Rwanda.

Umupira w’agatebo cyangwa Basiketi (izina mu cyongereza "basketball") ni umukino ukuzwe cyane, Ukinwa n'amakipe abiri agizwe n'abakinnyi batanu batanu, bagamie gutsinda amanota batera umupira mu gatebo(basket) kari ku butumburuke bwa metero 3.05, Uyu mukino usaba kwihuta, ubuhanga mu guhererekanya, no gutsinda amanota mu gatebo.
Komiseri wa shampiyona w'umupira w'agatebo (Basktetball) muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika(NBA), Adam Silver, avugako irushanwa ry'umupira w'agatebo (Basketball) rizajya rihuza amakipe y'i Burayi ko rigomba kwigarurira abafana nkuko umupira w'amaguru umaze kwigarurira abawufana.
Mu mwaka ushize nibwo NBA Yatangaje ko mu myaka ibiri iri imbere izafatanya n'ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira wagatebo(Basketball) ku Isi(FIBA), hagatangizwa irushanwa rishya rizajya rihuza amakipe akomeye i Burayi.
Kimwe no mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika, no mu Rwanda umupira wagatebo(Basketball) ufatwa nk'umukino wo mu miyi, by'umwihariko ntuzwi nk'umukino w'abagore bo mu cyaro. usa amatsinda y'abagore mu bice by'icyaro mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda barimo guhindura iyi mitekerereze.

Aritisho (izina ry’ubumenyi mu kilatini: "Cynara scolymus" ; izina mu gifaransa: "artichaut") ni ikimera n’ikiribwa.
Inyowe ari nyinshi ibyimbisha inda ikanabangamira imikorere y’amara. Itera kwihagarika neza, igatera agasabo k’indurwe k’umwijima kuvubura neza indurwe, kandi izwi cyane kubera ko yongerera umwijima imbaraga.

Inyanya zikungahaye kuri vitamini A na C. Zongerwa mu biryo kugira ngo zibyongerere uburyohe. Inyanya kandi zishobora gutunganywa zigakorwamo ikinyiga (sauce tomate). Mu rwego rw'ubukungu, inyanya zinjiza amafaranga mu ngo ndetse bikagera no mu rwego rw'igihugu n'isi..
Inyanya zikunda ahantu hari amazi ahagije, zikazirana n'ahatagira amazi. Ubutaka bwiza ku nyanya ni ubufite ubusharire bwa 6-7. Ikigero cy'ubushyuhe cyagombye kuba dogere 20-27. Imbuto z'inyanya ziba mbi iyo ubushyuhe buri hejuru ya degere 30 cyangwa bukaba munsi ya dogere 10.
Guhitamo ubwoko bw'inyanya bwo guhinga ni ingenzi cyane mu gihe hifuzwa umusaruro mwiza. Muri rusange hariho amoko abiri y'inyanya amenyerewe. Inyanya ngufi n'inyanya ndende.Inyanya ngufi (habariwemo n'izivangiye igice n'ingufi) ni ubwoko bugira igiti kigira ihundo ry'uruyange ku mutwe. Ziba ngufi zikaba igihuru mu gihe izivangiye igice ziba ndende.
Ubwoko burebure bukomeza gushamika n'indabo nshya kandi bugakura bujya hejuru cyane. Ubu bwoko buzana inyanya nyuma y'igihe kinini. Ubu bwoko bugomba kushingirirwa no kugabanyirizwa ibisambo bityo bugasaba akazi kenshi.Mu Rwanda duhinga ubwoko bwiza bw'inyanya buturaka i Burayi no mu bigo by'imbuto byo muri Kenya.
Anna F1 ni ubwoko bw`inyanya butanga umusaruro utubutse, budasaba akazi kenshi, kandi budapfa gufatwa n' indwara zifata inyanya. Ni inyanya zigurishwa ari mbisi, zitanga umusaruro mwiza cyane iyo zihinzwe mu mahema yabugenewe.
Anna F1 igira urunyanya rukomeye, rufite ishusho y'igi, rukagira ibara ry'umutuku tukutuku. Ni bumwe mu bwoko bw'inyanya buva muri Kenya budapfa guhangarwa n'indwara ya kirabiranya imunga igiti, iminyorogoto n'izindi.
Anna F1 ni ubwoko bukura vuba: mu minsi 75 nyuma yo kugemekwa. Kugira ngo zibe zeze neza biterwa n'igihe/ikirere. Nko mu bwoko bwinshi mu buturuka muri Kenya, umusaruro wa mbere uba ari muke ugereranyije n'andi masarura akurikira. Anna F1 zitanga umusaruro ku kigereranyo cya toni 74 kuri hegitari, n'ibiro 35 kg kuri buri runyanya mu buzima bwarwo bwose.
Inyanya zo mu bwoko bwa Roma ni inyanya zifite amafufu. Inyanya z`amafufu nka Roma muri rusange zigira ifufu rinini imbere, zikagira ubuhwa buke cyane n'igishishwa gikomeye. Roma zijya kugira ishusho ya mpandenye kandi zikaremera. Zirakomera kandi kuruta izo mu bundi bwoko ndetse n'iz'ubwoko bugira amafufu. Inyanya za Roma ziri mu bwoko bugufi, ni ukuvuga ko urunyanya ruhira rimwe aho kugenda rushya buhoro buhoro bigendanye n'ikirere. N'ubwo zishobora kuribwa ari mbisi izi nyanya biba byiza iyo zitetswe.
Ubwoko bw'inyanya bwa Bingo:
Bingo zihingwa mu murima mugari, zitanga inyanya nini kandi zoroshye. Igiti cy'urunyanya gishamikaho amababi agaye arinda igihingwa gutwikwa n'izuba. Ni ubwoko wahitamo ku bucuruzi bukorerwa ku masoko yo ku muhanda. Zizwiho kugira icyanga no kuba nini cyane.
Cherry tomato ni ubwoko bw’inyanya nto ziburungushuye. Zigira ibara ritukura, umuhondo, icyatsi kibisi ndetse n’umukara. Ziribwa cyane cyane ari mbisi kubera ko ziryohera.
Inyanya zo mu bwoko bwa Plum zizwi nk’izitegurwamo ikinyiga gitekwa mu masupu cyangwa kibikwa mu bikopo. Izi nyanya zifite ishusho y’umwiburungushure, zikagira ubuhwa buke cyane ugereranyije n’ubundi bwoko bw’inyanya kandi zikagira umubiri ukomeye, bituma zibereye gutunganywa mu nganda.
Gutegura umurima w'inyanya.
Gutera inyanya bitangirira ku guhumbika, aho babiba umurama ukamera mbere y'uko ingemwe zigemurirwa mu murima zizakuriramo. Ubuhumbikiro bugomba kuba bunoze nta binonko birimo kugira ngo imbuto zizamere neza. Ni byiza guhitamo ahantu hari amazi kandi umurima ukaba udaheruka guhingwamo ibihingwa byo mu muryango umwe n'inyanya.
Ubuhumbikiro bwigiye hejuru bugizwe na cm 15-30 z'uburebure bukaba bwajya hasi yaho mu gihe cy'izuba ryinshi ariko bukajya hejuru yaho igihe cy'ubuhehere. Umurama uhumbikwa mu mirongo itandukanyijwe na cm 6. Ubuhumbikiro butwikirizwa isaso kandi ubutaka ntabwo bugomba kumagara. Ubuhumbikiro bwigiye hejuru bworohereza uburyo bwo kuyobora amazi.
Kureka ubuhumbikiro bugakomera bikorwa bagabanya amazi maze ingemwe zikagerwaho n' izuba mu gihe cy'iminsi 6-9 mbere yo kugemura. Kuvomerera neza ingemwe amasaha 12 mbere yo kuzigemeka mu murima wabigenewe. Ingemwe nziza ni izigeze ku kigero cy'amababi 4-5, zimaze hafi ibyumweru 4.
Kugemura bikorwa nimugoroba cyangwa igihe ikirere cyijimye kugira ngo ingemwe zidapfa.Urugemwe rushyirwa mu mwobo ku buryo amababi ya mbere asigara hejuru y'ubutaka. Ingemwe ndende zinanutse zigomba guterwa mu mwobo muremure. Gutsindagira ubutaka cyane mu muzenguruko w'imizi no gusuka amazi ku muzenguruko w'urugemwe kugira ngo ubutaka bufate. Ni ngombwa kuvomerera vuba bishoboka nyuma yo kugemeka.
Intera isigara hagati y'urugemwe n'urundi iterwa n'uburyo ushaka guteramo byaba gutera ku murongo umwe umwe cyangwa ibiri ibangikanye. Iyo hakoreshejwe imirongo ibiri ibangikanye intera igomba kungana na cm 60 hagati y'imirongo na cm 40 hagati y'urugemwe n'urundi. Ibi bitanga ingemwe zigera ku 33,000 kuri hegitari. Iyo hakoreshejwe umurongo umwe umwe ku ntera ya cm 40 hagati y'ingemwe bitanga ingemwe zigera ku 16,000 kuri hegitari.
Ikoreshwa ry'amazi n'ibikemewe.
Amazi adahagije mu gihe igihingwa icyo ari cyo cyose kigikura bigabanya umusaruro n'ubwiza bw'imbuto. Inyanya ntizihanganira na mba kubura kw'amazi mu gihe zitangiye kuzana uruyange, mu gihe zikigemurwa no mu gihe zitangiye kuzana imbuto; mu kindi gihe zishobora kwihangana gato. Nyamara inyanya ntabwo zikunda amazi menshi akabije.
Uko wayobora amazi kose bishobora gukorwa uhereye hejuru ku butaka, uminjira make make, amazi anyuze mu gihombo, aho kuvoma amazi ku isoko ugahita uyamena ku bihingwa mu murima. Uko byakorwa kose biterwa n'ubushobozi bw'umuhinzi. Kubika amazi mu murima bishobora gukorwa hafashwe amazi acunshumuka, amazi y'imvura ava mu migezi, amazi y'imvura, kuzamura amazi avuye hasi mu butaka.
Gusasiza ibikoresho byabugenewe bikorwa hatwikirwa ubuso bw'ubutaka. Gusasira ni ngombwa mu buhinzi bw'inyanya kuko bigabanya kugenda kw'ibitunga igihingwa, bibika ubuhehere n'ubushyuhe mu butaka bikanabuza ibyatsi bibi kumera.
Gushingirira inyanya ukoresheje inking z'imigano, imishingiriro y'ibiti cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bikomeye bifata igihingwa bigatuma amababi n'imbuto bitaryama hasi. Gushingirira bishobora gutuma umusaruro wiyongera n'imbuto zikaba nini, bituma inyanya zitabora kandi bikoroshya isarura.
Ubwoko bw'inyanya ndende bwagombye gushingirirwa kugira ngo byorohe kuzikata, gukata ibisambo, gusarura n'indi mirimo yose ikorerwa igihingwa. Ubwoko bw'inyanya bugufi bwagombye gushingirirwa mu gihe cy'imvura kugira ngo imbuto z'inyanya zidakora hasi ku butaka.
Uburyo butandukanye bwo gushingirira burashoboka. Igihingwa kiba kigomba gufata neza ku mushingiriro, bigakorwa mu ntangiriro nko mu byumweru bibiri nyuma yo kugemeka.
Uduti tw'umuceri, udushumi twa pulasitiki, udushumi tumatira dukoreshwa mu buhinzi bw'indabo, n'ibindi bikoresho byose umuntu yakwifashisha bishobora gukoreshwa mu guhambira urunyanya ku giti. Guhambira bikorwa ku buryo ihundo ry'inyanya riba rishyigikiye.
Gukata ibisambo cyangwa gutoranya umumero ugomba gukurwaho mu rwego rwo kurinda inyanya kugunduka bishobora gutuma inyanya zikura vuba zikaba nini kandi ku buryo bungana. Gukuramo ibisambo bituma umwuka winjira neza mu rugara rw'amababi, bikagabanya indwara zifata amababi bikorohereza kutera umuti ndetse no gusarura.
Ubwoko by'inyanya ndende bugomba gukurwaho ibisambo iteka kugira ngo zidakururumba. Urugero gukata ibisambo bikorwamo biterwa n'igihe cy'ihinga icyo ari cyo. Mu gihe cyose bakata ibisambo, ni ko banakuraho indabo zitari ngombwa kugira ngo bacungane n'umubare w'inyanya wifuzwa.
Ibyatsi bigomba kubagarwa bikavanwa mu murima w'inyanya kuko bicuranwa n'igiti cy'inyanya urumuri, ibigitunga n'amazi. Ibyatsi kandi biba indiri y'indwara n'ibyonnyi. Ibyatsi bibi bibagarwa hakoreshejwe intoki cyangwa isuka.
Ibitunga igihingwa n'inyongeramusaruro nkenerwa.
Iyo inyanya zigeze aheza ubona ko zikeneye ibizitunga ni ngombwa ko hajyamo inyongeramusaruro uhereye igihe zitangiye kuzana imbuto. Ifumbire ikomoka ku matungo n'iyo mu ngarani ni zo nziza mu kongerera umusaruro umurima w'inyanya ushaka umusaruro w'umwimerere.
Ifumbire isukika ikoze mu bimera cyangwa ingarani iba ngombwa cyane cyane igihe imbuto zimaze kuza kugira ngo izindi zikomeze ziyongere. Naho ku musaruro utari umwimerere, inyongeramusaruro z'ubwoko butandukanye zishobora kongerwamo kugira ngo umusaruro utubuke.
Guhangana n'indwara n'ibyonnyi ku nyanya.
Indwara z'ingenzi zifata inyanya ni ukubora zikiri nto, cyangwa kubora zikuze, naho byonnyi by'ngenzi by'inyanya ni imiswa, isazi zera, udukoko turya amababi ("Tuta absoluta") n'utumatirizi.
Iyi ndwara ituma urunyanya ruraba vuba kandi rugapfa burundu rwose rutabanje guhinduka umuhondo cyangwa ngo amababi abanze azane ibibara. Igiti cyose kirapfa. Ubusanzwe bikunda kuba mu gihe igipimo cy'ubushyuhe kigera kuri dogere 32o C cyangwa hejuru yaho. Urunyanya ruraba rugifite ibara ry'icyatsi kibisi. Iyo igiti cy`urunyanya rwarabye bagikase usanga intimatima ibobereye n'amazi y'umukara, kandi wakanda igiti cyatemwe hakaza amazi yera, y'umuhondo cyangwa y'ikijuju anyerera. Iyo indwara imaze gukura kubora kw'intimatima bishobora gucukura umwobo muremure mu giti cyose.
Cyumya ("Fusarium oxysporum" sp. "Lycopersici").
Amababi y'inyanya yo hasi ahinduka umuhondo ubundi akuma. Ibiti byinshi by'inyanya bishobora kugaragaza ibyo bimenyetso. Amababi y'uruhande rumwe ashobora kwandura mu gihe ayo ku rundi ruhande ari mazima. Amababi yanduye yihungura ku giti. Iyo ibiti byanduye biri hejuru gato y'ubutaka n'agati gatereyeho amababi ubitemye hagaragara amatembabuzi y'ikijuju kivanze n'umutuku.
Uduhumyo duturuka haba ku mbuto haba no mu butaka. Dukunda kwangiza cyane ahari ubutaka bworoshye bw'urusenyi. Dukunda kuba ahari igipimo cy'ubushyuhe buri hagati ya dogere 25 na 320 C. Imiyege ishobora kuguma mu butaka no mu gihe nta gihingwa cy'inyanya cyaba kiri mu murima. Gishobora kandi kuguma kubaho mu mizi y'ibyatsi bibi.
Indwara y'ibibara ku mababi y'inyanya ("Alternaria solani").
Ibibara biza ku mababi kubera iyi ndwara y'ubushye biba ari ishusho y'uruziga kugeza kuri mm 12 z'umurambararo, bikaba ikijuju kandi kenshi bikagira ishusho y'uruziga ari cyo gitandukanya iyi ndwara n'izindi ndwara zizana ibibara ku mamabi y'inyanya.
Ububore ("Phytophthora infestans").
Ibimenyetso by'ububore ni ibibara bitameze kimwe bitanazira rimwe by'icyatsi kijya kuba umukara, n'ibibara bisa n'ibyinitse mu mazi bigaragara ku mababi. Ibyo bibara nyuma bihinduka ikigina maze amenshi mu mababi yafashwe akaraba ariko agakomeza gufata ku gihimba.
Kubora k'umutwe w'urubuto(Physiological disorder).
Iyi ndwara iterwa no kubura k'umunyungugu wa Kalisiyumu no kuvomerera nabi ku buryo budahoraho. Iyo ndwara ifata umutwe w'urubuto. Itangira isa n'ikibara gisa n'icyinitse mu mazi kigenda gikura kigahinduka ikigina cyijimye gicukuye umwobo. Ubuso bw'aho yafashe burijima kandi bugakanyarara. Ahaboze haruma.
"Virusi zifata inyanya".
Virusi zifata inyanya kenshi zikwirakwizwa n`udukoko nk'isazi yera, utumatirizi n'inda z'ibihingwa. Ikimenyetso gikomeye cy'iyi ndwara ni amababi ahinduka ibara ry`umweru cyangwa umuhondo werurutse cyangwa ishusho y'udupande dushushinyije ku mababi mu mabara y'icyatsi amwe yerurutse andi yijimye. Kenshi na kenshi indwara ziterwa na virusi zituma igihingwa kigwingira mu mikurire yacyo, ibice byacyo nk'igihimba n'amababi bigata isura y'umwimerere.
Indwara ziterwa na virusi ku nyanya harimo:
Ibyonyi bikunda gufata inyanya.
Ubukoko bw`ingenzi bw`ibyonnyi bufata inyanya ni igitangangurirwa gitukura,ubukoko bw'ikijuju, inzoka zo mu mbuto, isazi yera, udukoko turya amababi y'inyanya n'utumatirizi.
Izi ni isazi zera munsi y`ibabi.
Isazi nkuru zigira hafi mm 1 y`uburebure.
Izi sazi ni ibyonyi bibi cyane ku nyanya. Isazi zera zifata inyanya kuva zikiri ingemwe kugeza igihe zimaze gukura. Zinyunyuza amatembabuzi mu mababi, zigatuma igihingwa gicika intege.
Igihingwa kigaburira izo sazi bigatuma amababi yafashwe ahinduka umuhondo. Ariko kwangiza gukomeye guterwa n'izi sazi ntabwo guhita kugaragara nk`izindi ndwara ziterwa na virusi, bwo bugaragara nyuma. Isazi zera zohereza virusi zitera indwara mu nyanya. By`umwihariko ni yo itera amababi y`inyanya kuba umuhondo no kwihinahina(TYLCV). Umubare muto w`izi sazi ntabwo uhita utera igihingwa kononekara by'ako ako kanya, ariko n`ubwo zaba nke ni ngombwa ko zigenzurwa mu turere zikunda kugaragaramo cyane.
"Inda" ("Aphis gossypii", "Myzus persicae").
Inda zangiza ibihingwa nk'inyanya, ipamba, ("Aphis gossypii," green peach aphid ("Myzus persicae") zinyunyuza amatembabuzi y'igihingwa, bityo bigatuma igihingwa kidakura neza. Utu dukoko tubyara kandi ibizi byanduye bimatira nk' ubuki bibuza igihingwa gukura, bikanambura ubwiza imbuto igihe zigeze ku isoko. Izo nda zishobora kandi kwanduza indwara ziterwa na virusi nka virusi itera ububore bwa concombre.
Tuta absoluta ni agakoko kangiza kibasira inyanya cyane cyane n’ibindi bihingwa byo mu muryango umwe n’inyanya (solanacea).
Tuta abusoluta yibasira cyane cyane amababi n’ibihimba. Ishobora kandi kuboneka munsi y’urugori rw’urubuto ndetse n’imbere rimwe na rimwe.Ubwone bukabije bw’aka gakoko butuma amababi yuma ndetse rimwe na rimwe n’igihingwa cyose kikuma.
Bayirwanya bakoresha imiti nka mamectin benzoate na Abamectin bayisimburanya kugira ngo irwanye udukoko dukuze n’ibyana cyangwa amagi yayo.
Igihe cyo kwera kiba gitandukanye, kuva ku minsi 55 kugeza ku minsi 105. Ni byiza gusarura imbuto zihishije neza ariko zigikomeye. Amoko menshi agira inyanya z`umutuku wijimye. Inyanya zasaruwe zigomba gushyirwa mu gicucu mu gipimo cy`ubushyuhe kiri munsi ya dogere 25oC n'ubuhehere buri hagati ya 80-90%.Urumuri si ngombwa ku nyanya zeze imburagihe. Inyanya zikiri icyatsi zishobora gusarurwa zikazagurishwa haciyemo igihe.
Gufata nabi inyama zimaze gusarurwa bishobora kwica ubwiza bwazo ku buryo bworoshye. Inyanya zasaruwe bisaba kuzitondera kugira ngo batazikomeretsa cyangwa ngo bazivange n`izangiritse. Ni byiza ko inyanya zisarurwa mu gihe igipimo cy`ubushyuhe ari cyiza nka mu gitondo cyangwa nimugoroba. Umusaruro w`inyanya uratandukana bitewe n`ubwoko bwazo,bitewe n`uburyo zahinzwe n`uburyo zitawemo.
Gufata neza umusaruro w'inyanya.
Inyanya zigisarurwa ziba ziteguye guhita zigurishwa ako kanya. N`ubwo inyanya zishyirwa mu mboga zipfa vuba, zimara iminsi itatu cyangwa ine zibistwe ku gipimo cy`ubushyuhe bwo mu cyumba zirimo, zikaba zamara iminsi irenga icyumweru mu cyuma gikonjesha. Zishobora guhita zitunganywa mu ruganda iyo zimaze gusukurwa. Inyanya zishobora kubikwa mu dukopo mu ruganda ruzitunganya kandi zikabasha kubikika igihe kinini. Urusukume rw`inyanya rukorwa mu nyanya zikiri nshya kandi zishobora kubikika mu gihe kinini gishoboka mu gakopo gafunze neza umwuka utinjiramo. Inyanya zibitse mu dukopo zishobora kubikika igihe gitandukanye bitewe n`aho zateganyirijwe gukoreshwa.

Epinari ("Spinacia oleracea") ni igihingwa kiribwa cyo mu bwoko bw’imboga gikomoka muri Aziya yo hagati n’iy’iburengerazuba. Amababi yazo aribwa nk`imboga. Epinari ni igihingwa kimara umwaka umwe (biragoye ko cyaramba imyaka ibiri) kigira uburebure bwa cm 30. Epinari zishobora kwera mu turere dukonja.
Epinari ni imboga zifite intungamubiri nyinshi zitanga ingufu, amafufu, Poroteyine, vitamini A, B, B1, B2, B3, B6, B9, c, E, K n’imyunyungugu nka Kalisiyumu, Ubutare, Manganeze, Potasiyumu, Sodiyumu na Zenke.
Epinari zera neza mu turere tudashyuha kandi zishobora kwihanganira urubura rugwa bwa mbere. Epinari ziramera zikanakura neza ahari igipimo cy’ubushyuhe kiri hagati ya dogere selisiyusi 4 na 16 ariko zishobora no kwihanganira igipimo kiri munsi ya dogere. Epinari zikunda ubutaka burimo ifumbire, buhitisha amazi, bufite ubusharire buri hagati ya 6,4 na 6,8. Epinari ntizihanganira ubutaka busharira cyane. Iyo ubusharire buri ku rugero rwo hejuru cyane ni byiza gushyiramo ishwagara.Igipimo cy’ubushuhe bw’ubutaka nticyagombye kurenga dogere 21.
Gutandukanya amoko ya epinari bishobora gukorwa hagati y’amoko amaze igihe kinini ahingwa n’andi akiri mashya.
Amoko amaze igihe arangwa no kurabya vuba mbere y’igihe mu gihe cy`ubushyuhe. Naho amoko akiri mashya akura vuba vuba cyane ariko ntahite arabya ngo azane imbuto. Amoko ya kera kandi agira amababi ananutse kandi akagira ajya kurura mu gihe amoko mashya yo agira amababi agaye n’utubuto twiburungushuye.
Amoko ahingwa mu karere k’ibiyaga bigari ni aya akurikira:
a. Ubwoko bwatubuwe bwera vuba No 7- Early hybrid No.7: "(Spinacia oleracea." (F1) ni ubwoko bwa epinari zihagaze kandi zigara, zitanga umusaruro utubutse w’amababi aryoheye ijisho asa n’icyatsi kibisi kijimye mu rugero. Ubusanzwe baziteka ku mwuka cyangwa bakazitogosa kugira ngo zigumane intungamubiri kandi zikorwamo salade nziza. Epinari ni igihingwa gifite akamaro haba ku karima k’igikoni cyangwa ku muhinzi uhingira kugurisha ku isoko. Ubu bwoko bwa Epinari bubasha kwihanganira indwaranka ububembe (CMV) kandi iyo zimaze gusarurwa zibasha kwisazura zikongera kwera neza.
b. Ubwoko bwa Epinari bwitwa “Bloomsdale long standing”:Ni ubwoko bwa epinari bukura bujya ejuru bugira amababi menshi kandi abyibushye y’icyatsi kijimye kandi yihinahinnyero afite inkondo nini kandi ndende. Ni ubwoko bukururumba cyane kandi bwishimira ubutaka.
c. Ubwoko bwitwa Giant noble”:ni ubwoko bwa epinari ziba nini zikanasa neza, zigira amababi akatakase zikanagunduka mu mikurire ku buryo zigera kuri cm 60. Ubu bwoko bugira amababi aryoha.
d. Ubwoko bwa “New Zealand spinach”: Ni ubwoko bwa epinari nini zikura zisagamba kandi zibasha kwihanganira igihe cy’izuba ryinshi. Zihanganira indwara n’ibyonnyi kandi zigira amababi mato afite ishusho ya mpandeshatu agaye y’icyatsi kijimye. Uko bazisoroma kenshi ni ko zirushako gutanga umusaruro. Imbuto zazo zitinda kumera, ni yo mpamvu mu kuzihumbika bisaba kubanza kuzinika mu mazi mu gihe cy’masaha 24.
Epinari zikunda ahantu hahehereye cyane, bityo mu gihe amazi y’imvura adahagije ni ngombwa ko zivomererwa buri minsi 7-10. Epinari kandi zikenera azote nyinshi napotasiyumu biboneka hakoreshejwe inyongeramusaruro zabugenewe zishyirwamo hagendewe ku bipimo byavuye mu isuzumwa ry’ubutaka.
Potasiyumu ntabwo yangiza ibidukikije cyane bityo igomba gushyirwa mu murima bitewe n’ibipimo by’ubuitaka byabonetse. Uburyo azote ishyirwamo byo bitandukana bitewe n’akarere kuko nko mu gihe cy’imvura nyinshi ishobora kutaguma mu butaka. Mu turima tw’igikoni si ngombwa gushyira inyongeramusaruro mu murima wa epinari kuko ziba zahinzwe mu murima usanzwemo ifumbire ihagije.
Ibimenyetso by’iyi ndwara.
ibibara biza ku mababi bisa n’ibyinamye mu mazi bikagenda bikura bihinduka ikigina. Iyo indwara ikomeye ibice byanduye birihuza epinari zigasa n’izibabutse. Ubu burwayi buterwa n’igihe ubuhehere bukabije; mikorobi zigakwirakwizwa n’ amazi areka muri epinari.
6. Umugese (White rust Fungus "Albugo occidentalis)".
Ibyonnyi bya epinari.
1.Agasazi kangiza amababi ya epinari (Spinach Leaf Miners "(Pegomya hyoscyami)": ni udusazi tunanutse (6.5 mm) dutera amagi ku gice cyo munsi cy’amababi ya epinari. Ubu bukoko bukiri buto bwinjira mu mababi bukayacukura, bugacukura imiyoboro muri ¼ cy`amababi. Igishishwa cy`inyuma cy`amababi kirinda ubu bukoko kuribwa n`amavubi cyangwa utundi dusimba duhiga ubukoko bwo mu mirima.
Epinari zihinze mu gace ubu bukoko bwiganje zisaba kuzigenzura cyane kandi hakagira igikorwa vuba kugira ngo hirindwe ko byaba icyorezo gikomeye mu gihe byaba bitinze. Uburyo busanzwe bwo kwirinda bugira akamaro cyane mu kurwanya ubu bukoko.

Amababi ya Epinari ashobora gusarurwa vuba igihe cyose yamaze kugara bihagije kandi ashobora gusarurwa hakoreshejwe intoki cyangwa imashini. Epinari bashobora kuzisarura basoroma amababi gusa mu turima tw’igikoni cyangwa se bagakatana n’igihimba. Iyo ari epinari yo kujyanwa ku isoko zikatanwa n’igihimba, bigakorwa n’intoki. Iyo ari epinari zo gutunganywa mu nganda bisaba ko zisarurishwa imashini zabugenewe.

Ubugari cyangwa Ubugali, Ugali ni ibiryo.
Ubugari bw’imyumbati ntibugaragaramo intungamubiri zihagije. Aya makuru avuga ko ubusanzwe imyumbati ubwayo igira intungamubiri zitandukanye, ariko kugira ngo igere ku rwego rwo gukora ubugari, bisaba ko ibanza gutonorwa ikinikwa ikanumishwa ku zuba. Ibi bituma nta gishya umubiri ushobora gukura mu bugari bitewe n’inzira zose bucamo kugira ngo bube bwagerwa ku rwego rwo kuribwa. Nk’uko aya makuru akomeza abivuga, ngo mu gihe urebye, nko ku byubaka umubiri ("proteins") usanga ubugari bubonekamo bike cyane ku buryo ntacyo byapfa kungura umubiri. Ibitera imbaraga nabyo ni ikindi gikenerwa mu mubiri, ariko usanga nabyo ari bike cyane mu bugari.

Itungo ("ubumwe": Amatungo)
Ihene n’intama zifatwa nk’inka z’abakene kubera ko zitanga inyama, amata, impu n’imyenda bihagije ku byo umworozi aba acyeneye iwe, binashobotse akaba yasagurira isoko ku bisigaye. Intama n'ihene zirahendutse mu kuzigura kandi kuzibona ziroroshye kurusha inka.
Aya matungo kandi atuma uzigama ukaninjiza mu buryo bworoshye. Aho aborozi batagera ku ma banki, ihene n’intama ni ishoramari ribarinda kugwa mu bukene.

Injangwe (Felis catus) ni ubwoko bw’inyamabere z’inyamabere ntoya. Ni bwo bwoko bwonyine bwororerwa mu muryango wa Felidae kandi bakunze kwitwa injangwe yo mu rugo kugira ngo butandukane n’abanyamashyamba bo mu muryango. Injangwe irashobora kuba injangwe yo munzu, injangwe yumurima cyangwa injangwe isanzwe; ibyanyuma bigenda byisanzuye kandi birinda guhura nabantu. Injangwe zo mu rugo zihabwa agaciro nabantu kubusabane nubushobozi bwabo bwo guhiga imbeba. Ubwoko bwinjangwe bugera kuri 60 buramenyekana mubyanditswe bitandukanye.
Injangwe isa na anatomiya nandi moko ya felid: ifite umubiri ukomeye uhindagurika, refleks yihuse, amenyo atyaye hamwe ninzara zishobora gukururwa zahujwe no kwica umuhigo muto. Iyerekwa ryayo nijoro no kumva impumuro nziza. Itumanaho ryinjangwe ririmo amajwi nko gutema, gutobora, gushimisha, gutontoma, gutontoma no gutontoma kimwe nururimi rwihariye rwinjangwe. Inyamanswa ikora cyane mugitondo na nimugoroba, injangwe ni umuhigi wenyine ariko ubwoko bwimibereho. Irashobora kumva amajwi acogoye cyangwa hejuru cyane mugihe cyamatwi yabantu, nkayakozwe nimbeba nandi matungo magufi. Isohora kandi ikamenya feromone.
Injangwe zo mu rugo z’abagore zirashobora kugira inyana kuva mu mpeshyi kugeza mu mpeshyi, hamwe nubunini bwimyanda akenshi buva hagati yinjangwe ebyiri. Injangwe zo mu rugo zororerwa kandi zikerekanwa mu birori nk'injangwe zanditswemo, zikunda kwitwa injangwe. Kunanirwa kugenzura ubworozi bw’injangwe z’inyamanswa mu gutera no gutembera, ndetse no gutererana amatungo, byatumye umubare munini w’injangwe zororerwa ku isi, bigira uruhare mu kuzimangana kw'inyoni zose, inyamaswa z’inyamabere, n'ibikururuka hasi, kandi bituma abantu bagenzura.
Injangwe zororerwa bwa mbere mu burasirazuba bwo hafi ahagana mu 7500 mbere ya Yesu. Byari bimaze igihe kinini bitekerezwa ko gutunga injangwe byatangiriye muri Egiputa ya kera, kuko kuva nko mu 3100 mbere ya Yesu byahawe injangwe muri Egiputa ya kera.

Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (26 Gashyantare 1954) ni Minisitiri w’intebe wa Turukiya n’umunyapolitiki wo mw’Ishyaka ry’Ubukiranutsi n’Amajyambere. Yavukiye i Istanbul muri Turukiya taliki ya 26 Gashyantare 1954.

Urwiru cyangwa Umwamikazi ni uruyuki rumwe rukumbi mu muzinga rubyara izindi nzuki bityo zikororoka.
Inzukikazi zikiri ntoya nizo zitanga ibi biryo bigaburirwa ibyana by’inzuki n’umwamikazi. Ibi biryo babikoresha nk’inyongera, nk’intungamubiri ziba mubiryo, mu buganga, mu gutaka no mu biryo by’amatungo.

Muri rusange, ubworozi bw’inkoko zaba iz’amagi cyangwa se iz’inyama ntibusaba ahantu hanini ho kororera, bukaba bukemura ikibazo cy’ubutaka buke. Mu by’ukuri ubworozi bw’inkoko bukwiranye n’igihe tugezemo cyo kubyaza umusaruro mwinshi ubutaka buto dufite. Urebye ubworozi bw’inkoko, uburyo bifashisha mu cyaro naho bareka inkoko murugo zonyine ntibaziteho cyangwa zikitabwaho gacye.
Kuva ku munsi umwe kugeza ku byumweru 4, imishwi y’inkokoz’inyama igomba gushyirwa ahantu hashyushye. Kugira ngo ushyushye imishwi ushobora gukoresha imbabura, cyangwa se amatara y’amashanyarazi. Ubushyuhe bugomba kuba buringaniye, atari bwinshi cyane, ariko na none atari buke cyane. Imishwi ubwayo
irabikwereka. (a)Iyo hakonje cyane, imishwi yegera imbabura, (b) haba harimo ubushyuhe bwinshi imishwi igahunga imbabura. (c)Iyo hari umuyaga imishwi yigira uruhande rumwe, naho haba hari ubushyuhe buringaniye (d) imishwi ikaba imerewe neza yisanzuye nk’uko bigaragazwa n’igishushanyo gikurikira.
inkoko zitanga inyama.
Ubworozi bw’inkoko z’inyama ni ubworozi bumara igihe gito cyane, bityo bukazanira uwabukoze inyungu ku buryo bwihuse. Inkoko z’inyama zariye neza zikabona n’ibya ngombwa byose zikeneye, zishobora gutanga umusaruro nyuma y’iminsi mirongo itanu gusa ! Ni ukuvuga mu gihe kitageze ku mezi abiri. Icyo gihe
inkoko imwe uyibaze iba ipima ikilo n’igice (kg 1,5).
Inkoko zitera amagi.
Kuva ku cyumweru cya 20 kugeza inkoko zishaje, zirya ibiryo byagenewe inkoko zitera (Aliment super ponte). Mbere y’ibyumweru 2 ngo inkoko zitangire gutera, umworozi agomba gushyira mu nzu y’inkoko udusanduku zizateramo kugira ngo zizatangire gutera zaratumenyereye. Iyo inkoko zatangiye
gutera, umworozi agomba kunyura mu nzu yazo nibura inshuro eshatu ku munsi kugira ngo akuremo amagi yatewe. Ubworozi bw’inkoko z’amagi burashimishije cyane. Nyuma y’amezi ane gusa, inkoko ziba zatangiye gutanga amagi. Inkoko imwe yatangiye gutera ishobora kugeza ku magi 320
ku mwaka, kandi ishobora kurenza umwaka itera. Amagi rero nta kibazo cyayo kuko igihe utabonye isoko ry’ako kanya
ushobora kuyabika icyumweru kirenga mu bushobozi bwawe.

Akarere ka Maltepe (izina mu giturukiya: "Maltepe ilçesi") ni akarere kari mu ntara y’Istanbul y’igihugu cya Turukiya. Akarere ka Maltepe ni kamwe mu turere 39 tugize Intara y’Istanbul. Akarere gatuwe n’abaturage bagera kuri 427.041 (abagabo 213.523 n’abagore 213.518), batuye kubuso bwa km² 53,06.

Abaturukiya (mu Giturukiya: "Türkler"), cyangwa se Abaturage ba Turukiya, ni bwo bwoko bunini mu moko y’Aba-Turk (Turkic peoples), kandi ni bo bagize umubare munini w’abaturage ba Turukiya ndetse n’aba Shipure y’Amajyaruguru. Muri rusange bavuga indimi zitandukanye z’Igiturukiya. Mu mateka, bakwirakwiye mu bice byinshi byahoze bigize Ubwami bwa Ottoman, bigatuma no muri iki gihe hakigaragara imiryango y’Abaturukiya imaze ibinyejana byinshi ituye mu Burayi bw’Amajyepfo, mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati no mu Majyaruguru ya Afurika. Ingingo ya 66 y’Itegeko Nshinga rya Turukiya isobanura ko “Umuturukiya” ari umuntu wese ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Turukiya, bivuze ko iri jambo rishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bw’amategeko ritandukanye n’ubwoko. Nubwo bimeze bityo, abenshi mu baturage ba Turukiya (hafi 70–75%) ni abo mu bwoko bw’Abaturukiya. Ku bijyanye n’idini, umubare munini wabo ni Abayisilamu bo mu murongo wa Sunni, naho hari n’umubare ugaragara w’abakurikiza Alevi (Alevism).
Kuva 1058, Abaturukiya bafata ubuyobozi bw’ahagenzurwa, cyangwa higanje Abayislamu kugeza mu kinyejana cya 20. Bahebuje cyane mu bugome, no kutagira imbabazi kurusha
Igitero cy’abaturukiya, ahagana mu burasirazuba, cyahagaritswe n’Abamongoli, baje bava muri Aziya yo hagati, ku ngoma ya Genghis Khan (1207-1227), uyu kandi yayoboye ingabo nyinshi cyane, yambuka igipande kinini cya Aziya yitwaje itoroshi n’inkota. Imigi 50.000 by’imigi minini n’imito iratwikwa. Miliyoni 5 z’abantu bicwa urw’agashinyaguro, muri abao bapfuye, 630.000 by’abakristo ni abo muri Aziya, y’iburengerazuba mu majyepfo y’inyanja y’umukara ("Asie mineure").
