Yuhi V Musinga (1883 - 1944), amazina ye y'amavuko Musinga, yari umwe mu bategetsi ba nyuma b'ubwami bw'u Rwanda. Yabaye mwami (nyuma y’iyicwa rya murumuna we basangiye se Mibambwe IV mu 1896, yashyigikiye kungurana ibitekerezo n’abakoloni b’Abadage, ariko ahura n’ubuyobozi bw’abakoloni bw’Ababiligi igihe bwakiraga manda y’Umuryango w’ibihugu mu gutsindwa n’Ubudage mu gihe intambara ya mbere y'isi yose.
Buhoro buhoro yambura mwami uburenganzira bwe, ashaka gushyira idini Gatolika mu rukiko rwa Nyanza, Ababiligi barangije kwirukana umwami ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 1931 bashinjwa "kwikunda no kwifuza".
Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo, umwami yirukanywe mu gihugu cy’abaturanyi cya Kongo mu Bubiligi, azarangiza iminsi ye i Moba, naho umuhungu we, igikomangoma Charles Rudahigwa, yitwa mwami wo mu Rwanda ku ya 16 Ugushyingo 1931 ku izina rya Mutara III Rudahigwa.

ibintu bitangaje k'uMwami Mutara III Rudahigwa.
Nakubwirako umwami Rudahigwa ari we wambere washakanye n'umwamikazi bagashyingiranwa imbere y'Imana; hari muri mutarama1942, Rudahigwa ni we mwami wa mbere u Rwanda rwagize wize akaba yarasimbuye se akiri kuntebe y'ishuri Rudahigwa kandi ya kundaga siporo ibyo byatumye ashinga ikipe ariyo bitaga' Amaregura' iyo kipe yari gizwe na batware kandi niwe mwami watunze imodoka, akagendera no mu ndege.
Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa yashakanye na Rosariya Gicanda, uyu akaba yarishwe igihe cya Genoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda 1994..
Rudahigwa yatabarijwe ku musozi wa Mwima i Nyanza ku wa 28 Nyakanga 1959.

Kigeli V Ndahindurwa niwe mwami wa nyuma w'uRwanda akaba yarabatijwe akitwa Jean-Baptiste Ndahindurwa.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'uburere.
Kigeli yavutse kuya 29 kamena 1936
I Kamembe, mu cyahoze hitwa Ruanda-Urundi, yima ingoma kuya
28 nyakanga 1959 kugeza 28 mutarama 1961, mbere gato yuko Ububiligi butanga ubwigenge muri iki gihugu.
Igihe yari mu buhungiro muri Amerika, ntabwo yigeze yima uburenganzira bwe bw'ingoma kandi yafatwaga nk'umwami wa Jura w'u Rwanda, ayobora umusingi utanga ubufasha bw'ikiremwamuntu ku Rwanda.
Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yamwohereje muri Tanzaniya ku ya 2 Ukwakira 1961, nyuma aba muri Uganda na Kenya. Amerika yamuhaye ubuhungiro bwa politiki muri Nyakanga 1992 kandi yabaga muri Virginie kugeza apfuye mu gitondo cyo ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2016. Ibisigazwa bye byimuriwe mu Rwanda n'icyemezo cy'ubucamanza maze ahambwa ku ya 15 Mutarama 2017 mu karere ka Nyanza, hafi ya murumuna we Mutara III Rudahigwa.

Kigeli IV Rwabugiri (1840? - Ugushyingo 1895) yari umwami w'Ubwami bw'u Rwanda mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19. Yari umwe mu bami b'abaNyiginya baheruka ku ngoma yari ku butegetsi yari yarakomotse ku gisekuru cye mu binyejana bine byabanje kugeza kuri Yari umututsi ku izina ry'amavuko rya Rwabugiri. Niwe mwami wa mbere mu mateka y'u Rwanda waje guhura n'Abanyaburayi. Yashyizeho ingabo zifite intwaro yakuye mu Budage kandi abuza abanyamahanga benshi cyane cyane Abarabu kwinjira mu bwami bwe.
Rwabugiri yarushijeho kugenzura ubutaka, amatungo, n'abantu bo muri Afurika yo hagati. Rwabugiri ntiyashoboye kugeza ubutegetsi bwe ku bwiyongere bw'butaka gusa, ahubwo yanashimangiye ubutegetsi mu ntore za politiki zamenyekanye nk'Abatutsi b'amoko. Mbere, ahanini bari abatware baho ubu bari bagize umuyoboro wemerera Umwami kwubaka ubumwe bw'igihugu mukarere gashya.
Rwabugiri yabaye umwami hagati y'imyaka 1853-1895. Yatanze (yapfuye) mu Gushyingo 1895, ubwo yari mu rugendo muri Leta ya Kongo Yigenga, nyuma gato yo kuza k'umushakashatsi w’umudage Count Gustav Adolf von Götzen. Umuhungu we wamureraga, Mibambwe IV Rutarindwa, yatangajwe ko ari umwami ukurikira.

Rosalie Gicanda yavutse mu mwaka wa 1928 yitaba Imana kuwa 20 Mata 1994. Yari umwamikazi wa nyuma w’u Rwanda, akaba umugore w'u Mwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Yabaye umwamikazi kuwa 13 Mutarama 1942 kugeza taliki 25 Nyakanga 1959.
Azwi mu mateka y'u Rwanda kubera ubuzima bwe bwaranzwe n'ubugwaneza.
Yamaze indi myaka ibiri gusa, ku ngoma ya Mwami Kigeli V Ndahindurwa kugeza irangiye mu 1961.
Amakuru yo kwitaba Imana kwe.
Ku ya 20 Mata 1994, ubwo jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu mwaka w'1994 mu Rwanda yatangiraga ku mugaragaro i Butare, itsinda ry’abasirikare bayobowe na Liyetona Pierre Bizimana, ryayobowe na Kapiteni Idelphonse Nizeyimana, ryashimuse uwahoze ari umwami hamwe n’abandi bari batuye aho yari atuye.
Bahise bimura abari bajyanywe bunyago inyuma y'inzu ndangamurage y'igihugu barabarasa. Umwe mu barokotse ni umukobwa muto, waje kuvuga inkuru y'ubwo bwicanyi. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, nyina w'umwamikazi na we aricwa. Abisabwe n'umupadiri, Umuyobozi wa Butare, Kanyabashi, yakuye umurambo w'umwamikazi Gicanda maze ahambwa mu gikari iruhande rw'urugo rwe.

Akarere ka Kamonyi ni kamwe mu turere umunani tugize Intara y'Amajyepfo mu Rwanda. Gafite ubuso bwa 655,5 km² n'abaturage 450 849. Kagizwe n'imirenge 12.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Kamonyi gahana imbibi n'uturere dutanu: Muhanga, Ruhango, Nyarugenge, Gakenke na Bugesera.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 12, utugari 59 n'imidugudu 317. Gafite ubuso bwa 655,5 km² n'abaturage 450 849. Ubucucike ni abaturage 688 kuri km². Ibiro by'akarere biri mu Murenge wa Gacurabwenge, mu Kagari ka Gihinga, mu Mudugudu wa Ryabitana.
Akarere ka Kamonyi kagizwe n'imirenge 12:
Amateka n'ubukerarugendo.
Akarere ka Kamonyi gafite ahantu nyaburanga hatandukanye. Ijuru rya Kamonyi riri mu Murenge wa Gacurabwenge. Aho ni ho Umwami Yuhi Mazimpaka yari atuye. Umuhungu we Cyirima Rujugira yatuye ku musozi wa Gaseke, mu Murenge wa Kayenzi. I Muganza, mu Murenge wa Karama, hari ishyamba ryashyingurwagamo abami.
Akarere ka Kamonyi keramo imyumbati. Ubutaka bwahujwe ku buso bwa hegitari 2 800 bwo guhinga imyumbati.

Nyamugari ni umwe mu mirenge 12 igize Akarere ka Kirehe, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda.
Mu 2022, Umurenge wa Nyamugari wari utuwe n’abaturage 42 938. Abenshi muri bo babaga mu cyaro. Mu 2020, i Kiyanzi hashyizweho ahantu hakorerwa imirimo ya gasutamo. Abaturage bamwe bavoma amazi mu mugezi wa Kagera.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Nyamugari uri mu Karere ka Kirehe. Akarere ka Kirehe gafite imirenge 12 n’utugari 60. Ubuso bw’Umurenge wa Nyamugari ni kilometero kare 97,94. Umurenge wa Nyamugari ugizwe n’utugari. Tumwe muri two ni Kazizi na Kiyanzi.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Nyamugari wari utuwe n’abaturage 36 754. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, abaturage bari 42 938. Muri bo, abagabo bari 20 867. Abagore bari 22 071. Abana bari munsi y’imyaka 15 bari 17 018. Abaturage 39 961 babaga mu cyaro. Abaturage 2 977 babaga mu mujyi. Mu 2022, ku kilometero kare imwe habaga abaturage 438.
Ubukungu n’ibikorwa remezo.
Mu 2020, u Rwanda rwashyizeho ahantu hakorerwa imirimo ya gasutamo i Kiyanzi, mu Murenge wa Nyamugari. Kiyanzi iri ku muhanda uva i Rusumo ujya i Kigali. Abashoferi b’amakamyo bambuka umupaka bahabona ububiko bw’ibicuruzwa. Bahabona kandi aho kurara. Aha hantu hashyizweho mu ngamba zo kwirinda COVID-19.
Abaturage bo mu Kagari ka Kiyanzi bagira ikibazo cy’ibura ry’amazi. Bavoma amazi mu mugezi wa Kagera, ku mupaka wa Rusumo. Mu 2022, mu Murenge wa Nyamugari hari ingomero ebyiri. Abahinzi bari biteze ko umushinga w’Urugomero rwa Rusumo uzabafasha kuhira imyaka.
Mu 2023, abaturage bo mu Kagari ka Kazizi batangiye kubaka ibiro bishya by’akagari. Babyubakaga mu muganda.

Fred Rwigema (wavutse tariki 10 Mata 1957 apfa tarki 02 Ukwakira 1990) yari umunyapolitiki n' umusirikare w' umunyarwanda. Amazina ye y' ivuko ni Fred GISA RWIGEMA. Ni umwe mu ntwari z' u Rwanda zaharaniye gutahura bamwe mu banyarwanda bari barahunze birukanywe mu gihugu cyabo kuva mu 1959. Kuri ubu RWIGEMA afatwa nk' Intwari mu bihugu nka Uganda na Mozambique kubera ibikorwa yahakoreye nk'umusirikari uko yagendaga abirwanirira.
GISA ni umwe mu banyarwanda barenga ibihumbi bakuriye mu buhungiro.
Mu mwaka w' 1985, Rwigema yashinze ishyaka rya FPR (Rwanda Patriotic Front) riri kumwe n' umutwe w' ingabo wiswe RPA (Rwanda Patriotic Army).

Akarere ka Kirehe ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Gaherereye mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Gafite ubuso bwa 1 118,5 km² n'abaturage 460 860. Kagizwe n'imirenge 12.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Kirehe kari ku birometero 133 uvuye mu Umujyi wa Kigali. Ibiro by'akarere biri mu Murenge wa Kirehe, mu Kagari ka Nyabikokora.
Umugezi w'Akagera ni wo mupaka w'akarere na Tanzaniya mu burasirazuba. Mu majyepfo, akarere gahana imbibi n'Uburundi na Tanzaniya. Mu burengerazuba hari Akarere ka Ngoma. Mu majyaruguru hari Akarere ka Kayonza.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 12, utugari 60 n'imidugudu 612. Gafite ubuso bwa 1 118,5 km² n'abaturage 460 860.

Ubukungu n'ubukerarugendo.
Ubukungu bw'akarere bushingiye ahanini ku buhinzi n'ubworozi. Mu Murenge wa Mushikiri, abahinzi b'ibitoki bagurisha toni zisaga 200 z'ibitoki buri kwezi. Muri 2025, abafatanyabikorwa b'akarere batanze miliyari 6 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda mu ngengo y'imari ya 2024/2025.
Akarere ka Kirehe gafite umupaka mpuzamahanga wa Rusumo. Uyu mupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Tanzaniya. Mu karere hari amahoteli arimo East Gate Hotel na Matunda Resort Beach Hotel. Isumo rya Rusumo riri ku mupaka w'u Rwanda na Tanzaniya, mu mirenge ya Kigarama na Nyamugari.

Harry Lillis Crosby (Tacoma, Amerika, Ku ya 3 Gicurasi 1903-Alcobendas, Espanye, ku ya 14 Ukwakira 1977), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Bing Crosby, yari umuririmbyi w'umunyamerika (crooner) akaba n'umukinnyi ufite umwuga w'ubuhanzi wo mu kinyejana cya kabiri yatekerezaga ko Inyenyeri ya mbere ya Multimedia, Bing Crosby nigikorwa cyagurishijwe cyane kandi cyatsinze cyane mu kinyejana cya 20 kwisi.
Crosby yari umuyobozi mu kugurisha amajwi, kurutonde rwa radiyo, no kwinjiza amafaranga menshi - umwe mu bantu bakomeye kandi bakomeye bo mu kinyejana cya 20 ku isi. Yari umwe mu bahanzi ba mbere ba multimediya. Hagati ya 1934 na 1954, Crosby yari afite ibicuruzwa byiza cyane bidasanzwe hamwe na alubumu ye, amanota menshi kuri radiyo, ndetse na firime zizwi ku isi.
Akenshi afatwa nkumwe mubakinnyi ba muzika bazwi cyane mumateka kandi nijwi ryabantu ryanditswe kuri elegitoroniki muri iki gihe.
Icyamamare mu buhanzi bwa Crosby ni rusange, ni ngombwa cyane kuvuga ko yari umwe mu bashishikarije abandi basemuzi bakomeye b'abagabo bamushyigikiye, nka Frank Sinatra, Perry Como, Dean Martin, John Lennon, Elvis Presley, Michael Bublé Bamwe.
Bing Crosby yagurishije inyandiko zirenga miriyari 1 kwisi yose kugeza ubu3 4 birashoboka ko wagurishijwe cyane mumateka, ndetse nindirimbo yagurishijwe cyane kwisi yitwa Noheri yera, hamwe na kopi zirenga 50.000.000 zagurishijwe kwisi yose.5
Crosby yari azwi cyane kandi azwi cyane hagati mu kinyejana cya 20 rwagati ku isi, ku buryo ubushakashatsi bwakozwe icyo gihe bwerekanye ko Crosby yari azwi cyane kandi yubahwa kurusha Papa Piyo wa XII icyo gihe.
Imbonerahamwe yatsindiye iracyashimishije: amakarita 396 ku giti cye, harimo 41 yakinnye. Niba ubaze inshuro nyinshi "Noheri yera" yatsinzwe, ibyo byazana iyo mibare igera kuri 43, kurusha The Beatles na Elvis Presley hamwe.
Crosby yari afite imbonerahamwe zitandukanye buri mwaka hagati ya 1931 na 1954, wongeyeho afite inshuro 24 zitandukanye zizwi cyane muri 1939 wenyine.
Bing Crosby yafashe amajwi arenga 2000 yafashwe amajwi yubucuruzi hamwe na radio zigera ku 4000, hiyongereyeho urutonde runini rwerekana amafilime na televiziyo, niwe muhanzi wanditswe cyane mu mateka.
Bing Crosby yatsinze amanota 41 No 1 ku rutonde (43 harimo imitwe ya kabiri n'iya gatatu kuri "Noheri yera"), kurusha Beatles ifite (24) na Elvis Presley ufite (18).
Amajwi ye yageze ku rutonde inshuro 396, arenga Frank Sinatra (209) na Elvis Presley (149) hamwe.
Crosby yari ijwi ryindirimbo 13 zatowe na Oscar, enye muri zo zatsindiye igihembo cya Akademiki cyindirimbo nziza: "Sweet Leilani" (Ubukwe bwa Waikiki, 1937), "Noheri yera" (Holiday Inn, 1942), "Swinging ku nyenyeri "(Genda Inzira Yanjye, 1944), na" Muri Cool, Cool, Cool of nimugoroba "(Hano Haza Umukwe, 1951).
Bing Crosby yahawe inyenyeri eshatu kuri Walk Walk of Fame ya Hollywood: imwe yo gufata amajwi, imwe kuri radio, n'indi ya firime.
Bing Crosby niwe muhanzi wanditswe cyane mu mateka hamwe n’indirimbo zigera kuri 400 zagurishijwe ku isi, ibyo bikaba byagezweho ko nta muntu urimo Frank Sinatra, Elvis Presley, The Beatles na Michael Jackson wegereye guhuza.
Crosby yanditse amajwi ane muri Grammy Hall of Fame, iki kikaba ari igihembo kidasanzwe cyashinzwe mu 1973 mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro amajwi "afite ireme n'amateka".

Félicité Niyitegeka (yavutse mu 1934) Ni Umubikira w'umunyarwandakazi ubarwa mu ntwari z'igihugu, yavukiye i Vumbi, mu cyahoze ari komini ya Runyinya, muri perefegitura ya Butare
. Ni bucura y'umuryango w'abana 10, Félicité yize mumashuri abanza ya Astrida, hanyuma yiga ayisumbuye mu ishuri rya Save mumashuri acungwa n'ababikira. Arangije amasomo ye mu myaka ya za 1950, Félicité yahawe inshingano yo kuba umwarimu n'umugenzuzi mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda, mu ishuri rya Muramba. Icyo gihe yahawe na “Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat”, yitwa “Demoiselles”. Paruwasi ya Nyundo na seminari ya Nyundo yari imaze gushingwa ihabwa umwepiskopi w'umunyarwanda, Nyiricyubahiro Aloys Bigirumwami.
Félicité yavukiye mu muryango ufite kwizera Gukomeye muri Kristo, ise Simon Sekabwa yari umukiristu bikomeye. Félicité yabaye umugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika wabaye Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat2. Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat intego yabo ni ugukorana bya hafi na musenyeri, Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat bitwaga Kinyarwanda "Abakobwa ba Musenyeri", Nyiricyubahiro Bigirumwami yohereje Félicité i Lourdes kugira ngo ahugurwe, aho ikigo cy’amahugurwa ku Isi cy’abafasha ba Apostolate giherereye.
Tugarutse mu Rwanda, Félicité yabaye umwe mu bayobozi ba Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat. Umuyobozi wa mbere w’ishuri rikuru “Notre-Dame d'Afrique” rya Nyundo, umwepiskopi yamwohereje i Lourdes mu 1963, kugira ngo ajyane nabandi bagenzi be bo muri Afurika bahugurirwe hamwe. Yagarutse nyuma y'imyaka itandatu ashingwa kuyobora ubuyobozi bwa Centre Saint Pierre, ikigo cya diyosezi cyari ishinzwe amahugurwa n’umwiherero wa Auxiliaires de l'Apostolat. Icyubahiro cye cyambutse umupaka kugera i Goma, muri Zayire (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo), aho yakoranye na bagenzi be..Félicité yahoraga yifuza kwitangira umurimo, cyane cyane ku babikeneye cyane. Yabigaragaje muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Mu gukora urutonde rw'intwari z'igihugu, abayobozi basanze ubutwari bwe mubuzima bwe bwose bumwemerera kuba kurutonde maze yegurwa kuba intwari y'igihugu cy'u Rwanda. Ibi byatewe n'icyemezo cy'inama y'abaminisitiri yabaye ku ya 12 Nzeri 2011.

Bitandukanye n'inzibutso za jenoside nyinshi mu Rwanda, Urwibutso rw'Intwari z'igihugu i Kigali ntirushobora kugera ku bantu. Uruhushya rwihariye rutangwa na minisiteri y’urubyiruko, siporo n’umuco rurasabwa kugera kuri uru ruganda ruto rw’imva n’imva hafi ya stade Amahoro.
Igitangaje kurushaho ni uko iyi atari urwibutso rwa jenoside gusa. Ahubwo, intwari icumi zibukiwe hano ziratandukanye na Jenerali Majoro Fred Rwigema, umuyobozi w'icyamamare w'ingabo z’ingabo z’inyeshyamba zo mu Rwanda (RPA) wishwe ku munsi wa kabiri RPA yateye u Rwanda mu Kwakira 1990; Agathe Uwilingiyimana, wahoze ari Minisitiri w’intebe w’Abahutu wishwe mu minsi ya mbere ya jenoside; n'abasirikare benshi batazwi.
Byinshi mu mva zabo byashushanywaga kuri marble yijimye yijimye kandi irimbishijweho zahabu. Bashyizwe mubutaka bunoze, bubungabunzwe neza nabarimyi babiri. Kurinda imva kubintu, ibisenge birinda bikingira hafi kurubuga rwose. Kurinda imva abacengezi, abarinzi babiri bitwaje imbunda barinda urwibutso igihe cyose. Agace gato kazengurutswe "ikigo cyabashyitsi" kirimo inzu yerekana ishusho yerekana hasi. Usibye amashusho yavuzwe nabandi,

Guhana kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage (DEX) ni uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru bukora mu buryo bwo kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage, ni ukuvuga, nta buyobozi bukuru. Kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi byemerera urungano rw’urungano rwo gucuruza amafaranga.
Kwinjira mu gitabo kuri Switcheo Guhana Kubera ko abakoresha badakeneye kohereza umutungo wabo mu kuvunja, guhana kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage bigabanya ibyago by’ubujura buva mu bucuruzi bw’ivunjisha. Kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi birashobora kandi gukumira ibicuruzwa biva mu mahanga cyangwa ibicuruzwa byahimbwe binyuze mu bucuruzi bwo gukaraba, kandi ntibizwi kuruta guhanahana gushyira mu bikorwa kumenya ibyo umukiriya wawe asabwa.
Hariho ibimenyetso bimwe byerekana ko kungurana ibitekerezo byegerejwe abaturage byagize ikibazo cy’ubucuruzi buke ndetse n’isoko ry’isoko. Umushinga 0x, protocole yo kubaka ihererekanyabubasha hamwe no guhinduranya ibintu bigerageza gukemura iki kibazo.
Bitewe no kubura inzira ya KYC, kandi ntaburyo bwo guhindura ibikorwa, abakoresha barahomba niba bigeze bibasirwa ijambo ryibanga cyangwa urufunguzo rwihariye.
Impamyabumenyi zo kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage.
Kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi birashobora kugira ibice bikomatanyirijwe hamwe, aho kugenzura kugenzura kuvunja bikiri mu maboko yubuyobozi bukuru. Urugero rugaragara ni IDEX ibuza abakoresha leta ya New York gushyira ibicuruzwa kuri platifomu.
Muri Nyakanga 2018, Bancor yoherezwa mu nzego zegerejwe abaturage ngo yibwe kandi ihomba igihombo cy’amadorari 13.5M mbere yo guhagarika amafaranga. Muri Tweet, Charlie Lee, uwashizeho Litecoin yagize icyo avuga avuga ko kuvunja bidashobora kwegerezwa abaturage niba bishobora gutakaza cyangwa guhagarika amafaranga y’abakiriya.
Abakora ibikorwa byo kungurana ibitekerezo byegerejwe abaturage barashobora guhura ningaruka zemewe n’ubuyobozi bwa leta. Akarorero kamwe ni uwashinze EtherDelta, mu Gushyingo 2018 yakemuye ibirego muri komisiyo ishinzwe kugurizanya no kugurizanya muri Amerika ku bijyanye no gukora ivunjisha ritanditswe.

Melchior Ndadaye (n. Murama, 28 Werurwe ya 1953 - Bujumbura, 21 Ukwakira ya [1993]]) yari umunyabwenge na umunyapolitiki Burundian wabaye uwa kane Perezida wa Repubulika y’Uburundi kuva 10 Nyakanga kuva 1993 kugeza yiciwe ku ya 21 Ukwakira muri uwo mwaka. Yabaye umukuru wa mbere w’ibihugu by’Uburundi ukomoka abahutu, ubwoko bwinshi mu gihugu cye, akaba na perezida wa mbere yatowe mu buryo bwa demokarasi mu matora ataziguye mu amateka y’Uburundi.
Ndadaye yaje ku butegetsi biturutse ku kugwa kwa leta ya gisirikare iyobowe n’amoko mato Abatutsi mu rwego rw’inzibacyuho ya demokarasi yakozwe na Perezida Pierre Buyoya, mu rwego rwo kubuza igihugu kugira a [[Intambara y'abanyarwanda | Ndadaye yatsinze Buyoya, umukandida w’ishyaka rimwe kugeza icyo gihe UPRONA, mu matora ya 1 Kamena ya 1993 nk'umukandida wa FRODEBU. Ndadaye yagerageje gukora politiki ishyize mu gaciro igamije gushaka entente hagati y’amoko yombi. Icyakora, ntabwo yari ishyigikiwe n’imirenge ikaze abahutu, bakomeje ibikorwa byo guhungabanya umutekano n’inyeshyamba na nyuma ya guverinoma ishingiye kuri demokarasi, kandi na yo yagombaga guhangana n’abatavuga rumwe n’ingabo z’igihugu, ndetse no muri amaboko y'abatutsi, bakekaga ivugurura ryabo.
Nyuma y'amezi atatu gusa Ndadaye yimitswe, ku ya 21 Ukwakira, habaye yagerageje guhirika ubutegetsi, Nadadye asimburwa na François Ngeze nk'umuyobozi ya leta " de facto ". Kuri uwo munsi, perezida yajyanywe ku biro mu kigo cya gisirikare, aho yiciwe amaraso. Nubwo amaherezo ihirikwa ry’ubutegetsi ryatsinzwe kandi guverinoma ishingiye ku itegekonshinga ikomeza guhagarara, iyicwa rya Ndadaye ryateje ubukana bwa politiki hagati y’amoko yombi, bitangiza Intambara y'abenegihugu mu Burundi, izakomeza kugeza 2005.

Akarere ka Gasabo ni kamwe mu turere dutatu tugize Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda. Gafite ubuso bwa 430,3 km² n'abaturage 879 505. Kagizwe n'imirenge 15.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Gasabo gaherereye mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'Umujyi wa Kigali. Mu majyepfo, gahana imbibi n'Akarere ka Kicukiro. Mu majyaruguru hari Akarere ka Gicumbi. Mu burasirazuba hari Akarere ka Rwamagana. Mu burengerazuba hari Akarere ka Nyarugenge.
Icyicaro cy'akarere kiri mu Murenge wa Remera, mu Kagari ka Nyarutarama. Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 15, utugari 73 n'imidugudu 485. Gafite ubuso bwa 430,3 km². Muri 2022, kari gatuwe n'abaturage 879 505.

Akarere ka Bugesera ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Gaherereye mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Gahana imbibi n'Uburundi.

Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Bugesera gahana imbibi n'Uburundi. Gahana kandi imbibi n'uturere twa Ngoma, Rwamagana, Kicukiro, Nyarugenge, Kamonyi, Ruhango na Nyanza.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 15, utugari 72 n'imidugudu 581. Gafite ubuso bwa 1 337 km². Muri 2022, gafite abaturage 551 103.
Akarere ka Bugesera kagizwe n'imirenge 15:
Buri kagari kayoborwa n'Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa. Afatanya n'ushinzwe imibereho myiza n'iterambere (SEDO). Akagari ni rwo rwego rwegereye abaturage.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamata ruri mu Karere ka Bugesera. Ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abasaga 45 000. Bishwe muri Nyamata no mu nkengero zayo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Ubukungu n'ibikorwa remezo.
Akarere ka Bugesera kari mu birometero 15 uvuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali.
Ikibuga muzamahanga cy'indege cya Bugesera kiri kubakwa mu Murenge wa Rilima. Muri 2019, sosiyete Qatar Airways yemeye gufata imigabane 60 % y'iki kibuga.
Mu Murenge wa Gashora hari inganda nyinshi. Muri zo harimo Imana Steel Rwanda, uruganda rukora ibyuma by'ubwubatsi. Mu Murenge wa Ntarama hari uruganda rukora amasabune n'impapuro z'isuku.
Amazi n'amashanyarazi.
Muri Mutarama 2025, mu Murenge wa Nyarugenge hatashywe ibikorwa remezo by'amazi. Byatwaye miliyoni 750 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda. Harimo umuyoboro w'amazi wa kilometero 28,2. Uwo muyoboro uha amazi abaturage basaga 11 400. Hubatswe kandi ibigega 2 n'amavomo 27. Amavomo 7 yari yarangiritse yarasanwe.
Mu Murenge wa Musenyi, ingo 292 zahawe umuriro w'amashanyarazi. Akarere kateganyaga ko abaturage bose bazaba bafite amashanyarazi mu 2024.
Muri Kanama 2024, hatangijwe imirimo yo gushyira kaburimbo ku mihanda 7 yo mu mujyi wa Nyamata. Iyo mihanda ifite uburebure bwa kilometero 2,1. Imirimo yari iteganyijwe kumara amezi 8.
Akarere gafite amasoko menshi. Muri yo harimo isoko rya Nyamata, irya Ntarama, irya Musenyi n'irya Rilima.
Ubuhinzi n'ubworozi.
Abaturage benshi b'Akarere ka Bugesera batunzwe n'ubuhinzi. Bahinga cyane cyane ibihingwa ngandurarugo. Muri byo harimo ibirayi, ibigori, soya, ibijumba, imyumbati, amateke, intoryi n'ingano. Bahinga kandi umuceri n'ikawa. Abahinzi bahura n'imbogamizi nyinshi. Muri zo harimo imihindagurikire y'ikirere, ubutaka busharira no kubura imbuto.
Aborozi borora inka, inkoko, intama, ihene n'imbata. Bahura n'imbogamizi zirimo kubura ubwatsi, kubura amazi, ibirondwe n'indwara. Mu Murenge wa Mayange hari umushinga wa ABUSOL wo korora inkoko zitanga amagi. Muri 2021, wari ufite inkoko zisaga 80 000.
Mu myaka 30 ishize, Akarere ka Bugesera kari gafite amashuri yisumbuye 2 gusa. Muri 2024, kari gafite amashuri yisumbuye 71. Icyo gihe, umuyobozi w'akarere yari Richard Mutabazi. Amashuri yigisha imyuga arimo Nelson Mandela TSS na Ruhuha VTC.
Ibitaro bya Nyamata bitanga serivisi z'ubuzima ku baturage 434 668 bo mu Karere ka Bugesera n'uturere duturanye. Bigenzura ibigo nderabuzima 15.
Bugesera FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'Akarere ka Bugesera.

Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Gatsibo ni umwe mu mirenge 14 y'Akarere ka Gatsibo. Ugizwe n'utugari 4:
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Gatsibo wari utuwe n'abaturage 36 690. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 40 940.

Akarere ka Kayonza ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Gafite ubuso bwa 1 935 km² n'abaturage 457 156. Kagizwe n'imirenge 12. Ni amarembo ya Pariki y'Akagera.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Kayonza kagizwe n'icyahoze ari uturere twa Rukara, Kabarondo na Cyarubare. Kagizwe kandi n'imirenge 2 yahoze ari iy'Akarere ka Muhazi: Nyagatovu na Mukarange.
Akarere ka Kayonza gahana imbibi n'Akarere ka Rwamagana mu burengerazuba n'Akarere ka Gatsibo mu majyaruguru. Gahana kandi imbibi n'uturere twa Ngoma na Kirehe, n'igihugu cya Tanzaniya.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 12, utugari 50 n'imidugudu 421. Gafite ubuso bwa 1 935 km². Muri 2022, gafite abaturage 457 156, ni ukuvuga abaturage 236 kuri km². Kazwiho ahantu nyaburanga, imisozi, ibiyaga n'amashuri menshi.
Akarere ka Kayonza kagizwe n'imirenge 12:
Akarere ka Kayonza ni amarembo ya Pariki y'Akagera. Iyi pariki iri mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya. Ibamo intare, ingwe, inzovu, inkura n'imbogo. Muri pariki hari amacumbi arimo Ruzizi Tented Lodge, Wilderness Magashi na Karenge Bush Camp.
Ubukungu bw'akarere bushingiye ku buhinzi, ubucuruzi n'ubukerarugendo. Muri Ukuboza 2020, abafashamyumvire 29 bahuguwe ku buhinzi bubungabunga ubutaka. Bahuguwe na Mennonite Central Committee (MCC) ku bufatanye na PAM. Bagomba gufasha abahinzi 2 000 bo mu karere.
Mu karere hari amabanki n'ibigo by'imari birimo Banki ya Kigali na Umwalimu SACCO. Amashuri arimo GS Kabare, GS Kabarondo, EP Barebereho na ES Cyinzovu.

Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera ni pariki y'igihugu iherereye mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya. Ifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 1 122, ikaba igizwe na savane, imisozi n'ibishanga. Yitiriwe uruzi rw'Akagera rutemba ku mupaka wayo w'iburasirazuba, rukisuka mu kiyaga cya Ihema no mu biyaga bito.
Yashinzwe mu 1934, ikaba ari cyo gishanga kinini kirinzwe muri Afurika yo hagati n'ubuhungiro bwa nyuma bw'inyamaswa zo muri savane mu Rwanda. Kuva mu 2010 icungwa ku bufatanye bwa RDB n'umuryango African Parks; nyuma yo kuhagarura intare n'inkura, ubu ibamo inyamaswa eshanu zizwi nka "Big Five".
Pariki iri mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya. Igizwe na savane, amashyamba, ibishanga n'ibiyaga bigera kuri cumi na bibiri, birimo ikiyaga cya Ihema. Ibiyaga n'ibishanga by'urufunzo biyihuza bigize hejuru ya kimwe cya gatatu cya pariki, bigatuma iba igishanga kinini kirinzwe muri Afurika yo hagati.
Pariki y'Akagera yashinzwe mu 1934 n'ubutegetsi bw'Ababiligi bwategekaga u Rwanda icyo gihe. Yari ifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 2 500, kandi yari izwiho urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rukungahaye. Yari ituwe n'imbwa nyinshi zo mu gasozi ("Lycaon pictus"), ku buryo yigeze kwitwa "Parc aux Lycaons"; icyorezo cyaziciye, maze iza nyuma zibonwa mu 1984.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, impunzi zatahukaga zatuye muri pariki, maze intare zose zari ziyirimo zicwa n'abahinzi n'aborozi.
Mu 2009, RDB na African Parks basinye amasezerano y'imyaka 20 ashobora kongerwa yo gufatanya gucunga pariki, maze mu 2010 hashingwa "Akagera Management Company". Mu myaka itanu yakurikiyeho, hashowe miliyoni 10 z'amadolari, ku nkunga ya Howard G. Buffett Foundation, mu kongera umutekano no kugarura amoko yari yarazimiye. Hubatswe uruzitiro rwa kilometero 120 ku ruhande rw'iburengerazuba, hashyirwaho kajugujugu y'ubugenzuzi, itsinda ryihariye ririnda inkura n'itsinda ry'imbwa zirwanya ba rushimusi.
Pariki ibamo inyamaswa zo muri savane nka twiga, inzovu, imbogo n'imparage, ndetse n'amoko y'inyoni agera kuri 500. Umubare w'inyamaswa z'inyamabere wavuye ku 4 000 mu 2010 ugera ku 13 500 mu 2018.
Inkura z'umukara zazanywe muri pariki zivuye muri Tanzaniya mu 1957; mu myaka ya 1970 zari zirenga 50, ariko ubuhigi butemewe buzigabanya kugeza ubwo iya nyuma iboneka mu 2007. Muri Gicurasi 2017, inkura z'umukara 18 zavuye muri Afurika y'Epfo zagaruwe muri pariki, naho muri Kamena 2019 hazanwa izindi eshanu zivuye mu busitani bw'inyamaswa butatu bwo mu Burayi, bikaba byari ubwa mbere bikozwe.
Mu Gushyingo 2021, inkura z'umweru 30 zavanywe muri Afurika y'Epfo zizanwa muri Akagera, naho muri Kamena 2025 hazanwa izindi 70, bikaba ari bwo bwimuka bunini bw'inkura bwanditswe. Akagera ni yo pariki yonyine mu Rwanda ibamo inkura.
Twiga zo mu bwoko bwa "Masai" zazanywe zivuye muri Kenya mu 1986; mu 2024 zari zimaze kugera kuri 78.
Ahagana mu 1990, pariki yari ifite intare ziri hagati ya 250 na 300, ariko zose zishwe nyuma ya Jenoside. Muri Nyakanga 2015, intare zirindwi zivuye muri Afurika y'Epfo zagaruwe muri pariki, ziba intare za mbere mu Rwanda nyuma y'imyaka 15.
Ubukerarugendo n'abaturage.
Kuva African Parks itangiye gucunga pariki mu 2010, umubare w'abayisura wavuye ku 8 000 ugera ku 44 000 mu 2018, bituma pariki yibeshaho ku kigero cya 80%. Mu 2025, Akagera yabaye pariki ya mbere ya African Parks yibeshaho ku mafaranga yinjiza ubwayo. Abasura pariki bashobora gutembera mu modoka bareba inyamaswa, ku manywa cyangwa nijoro, gutembera mu bwato ku kiyaga cya Ihema bareba imvubu n'ingona, no kureba inyoni.
Buri mwaka, 10% by'amafaranga ava muri pariki agenerwa abaturage bayituriye, binyuze mu bikorwaremezo nk'amashuri n'amavuriro. Uturere twa Gatsibo, Kayonza na Nyagatare duhabwa ayo mafaranga tukayakoresha mu mishinga ifitiye abaturage akamaro, nk'amashuri y'imyuga, amavuriro, amakoperative n'ubuvumvu bwa kijyambere.

Akarere ka Rwamagana ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Ni ko karimo icyicaro cy'Intara. Umujyi mukuru wako ni Rwamagana.
Akarere ka Rwamagana gafite ubuso bwa 682 km² n'abaturage 484 953. Kagizwe n'imirenge 14.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Rwamagana kashyizweho n'itegeko muri Mutarama 2006.
Kagizwe n'icyari Akarere ka Muhazi n'icyari Akarere ka Bicumbi. Kagizwe kandi n'imirenge 2 yari iya Gasabo (Fumbwe na Mununu) n'imirenge 3 yari iya Kabarondo (Kaduha, Rweru na Nkungu). Hiyongereyeho icyari Umujyi wa Rwamagana.
Akarere ka Rwamagana gahana imbibi n'uturere dukurikira:
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 14, utugari 82 n'imidugudu 474. Gafite ubuso bwa 682 km². Muri 2022, gafite abaturage 484 953, ni ukuvuga abaturage 711 kuri km².
Akarere ka Rwamagana kagizwe n'imirenge 14:
Radjab Mbonyumuvunyi ni umuyobozi w'akarere kuva muri Gashyantare 2016. Jeanne Umutoni ni umuyobozi w'akarere wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza.
Ubukungu n'ibikorwa remezo.
Ubutaka bw'Akarere ka Rwamagana burera. Akarere kazwi cyane ku kwera ibitoki.
Akarere gafite ibikorwa remezo byinshi. Harimo IPRC Gishari, ikigo nderabuzima cya Gishari n'ishuri rya Polisi y'u Rwanda (PTS Gishari). Harimo kandi amashuri, imihanda igezweho, amahoteri, amabanki, uruganda rutunganya amazi rwa Muhazi, Bella Flowers na gereza ya Nsinda.
Isoko rya kijyambere rya Rwamagana riri mu Murenge wa Kigabiro. Mu Karere ka Rwamagana hari kandi ishami rya Banki Nkuru y'u Rwanda mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ibigo by'amashuri birimo GS Gishari, GS Ruhunda, GS Gati, GS Nsinda, GS Kavumu, Centre for Champion na EP Nyagahinga.
Akarere ka Rwamagana gacumbikiye amakipe menshi y'umupira w'amaguru. Classic FC ikina mu cyiciro cya gatatu. Muhazi United FC ikina mu cyiciro cya mbere kuva muri 2022.

Louise Mushikiwabo (wavutse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 1961) ni umunyamabanga wa kane akaba n'umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango mpuzamahanga de la Francophonie. Yabanje kuba Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane mu Rwanda kuva 2009 kugeza 2018. Yabaye kandi Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma. Yabanje kuba Minisitiri w'itangazamakuru.
Ku ya 12 Ukwakira 2018, yatorewe manda y'imyaka ine ku mwanya w’umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango mpuzamahanga wabavuga ururimi rw'igifaransa (OIF) mu nama ya Francophonie yabereye i Yerevan, muri Arumeniya.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Louise Mushikiwabo yavutse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 1961 i Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda. Se yari Bitsindinkumi, Bitsindinkumi yakoraga ubuhinzi, Nyina yari Nyiratulira, mubyara wa Alexis Kagame umufilozofe mu by'amateka. [6] Yabayeho mu bwana bwe i Kigali. Umuhererezi mu bana icyenda, barumuna be barimo Lando Ndasingwa, wabaye umucuruzi akaba n'umunyapolitiki uzwi cyane mu Rwanda mbere yo kwicwa mu 1994 mu gihe cya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu mwaka wa 1994, na Anne-Marie Kantengwa, wigaruriye hoteri ya Lando (Chez Lando) nyuma y'urupfu rwe kandi akora mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda kuva 2003 kugeza 2008.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye i Kigali, Mushikiwabo yagiye kwiga muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda (ubu ni kaminuza y'u Rwanda), mu mujyi wa Huye mu majyepfo, mu 1981. Yarangije kaminuza mu 1984, afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu cyongereza, hanyuma akora muri make nk'umwarimu w'amashuri yisumbuye. Mu 1986, yavuye mu Rwanda yerekeza muri Amerika, naho yatangiye kwiga impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu ndimi no gusobanura muri kaminuza ya Delaware, naho igifaransa kikaba ururimi rwe rwihariye. Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye mu 1988, yagumye muri Amerika, atura mu gace ka Washington, DC. Yatangiye umwuga akora mu mashyirahamwe aharanira inyungu, mbere yo gufata umwanya muri Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere (ADB); mu rwego rwo kugira uruhare muri ADB yabaye muri Tuniziya igihe gito, amaherezo aba umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho muri banki.
Mu 2006, Mushikiwabo yanditse igitabo, ""Rwanda bivuga Universe"," yafatanije na Jack Kramer, umunyamakuru Amerika na KALIMANZIRA Marine. Igitabo kirimo igice cyandika ku buzima, gisobanura amateka y’umuryango wa Mushikiwabo, ubuzima bwe bwa mbere mu Rwanda, ndetse n’ubunararibonye bwe amaze kwimukira muri Amerika. Irasobanura kandi itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda mu buryo burambuye, uhereye ku mateka ndetse no ku bitekerezo bya Mushiwabo uba i Washington, kuko yakiriye amakuru avuga ko benshi mu bagize umuryango we bishwe.
Muri Werurwe 2008, Mushikiwabo yatumiwe na Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame gusubira mu gihugu cye cy'u Rwanda no gufata umwanya muri guverinoma ye. Yahawe umwanya wa Minisitiri w’itangazamakuru, asimbuye Laurent Nkusi. Mu ntangiriro za manda ye, Mushikiwabo yari ashinzwe gufata icyemezo cyo gufata ingamba zo kurwanya amashyirahamwe menshi y’itangazamakuru ryaho yari afite inkuru zisebanya kuri Kagame. Ikinyamakuru kimwe, Kinyarwanda -ururimi rwa buri munsi "Umuco", cyari cyasohoye inkuru igereranya perezida na Adolf Hitler, kandi Inama Nkuru y'Itangazamakuru (HCP) yasabye guverinoma guhagarika uruhushya rw’iki kinyamakuru. Nkusi yari yaranze iki cyifuzo, kandi mu gihe Mushikiwabo atigeze ahagarika ku mugaragaro impapuro, nyamara yahagaritse gucapa mu Kwakira 2008. Muri rusange Mushikiwabo yashishikarije bagenzi be gushyigikira ubwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru, ariko kandi ashimangira ko itangazamakuru ryubahiriza amategeko akomeye y'u Rwanda yerekeye guhakana Jenoside mu Rwanda. Mu mwaka wa 2009, yatanze itegeko ry’agateganyo kuri radiyo ya Kinyarwanda yatangajwe na British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), kubera ko yavugaga ko ryerekanaga ibiganiro "biha uburenganzira bwa jenoside n’abahakana jenoside"; BBC yahakanye iki kirego, ivuga ko na guverinoma bifite ibisobanuro bitandukanye kuri jenoside.
Usibye kuba ashinzwe gufata ibyemezo bya minisiteri, Mushikiwabo yanasohoje inshingano z'umuvugizi wa guverinoma mu gihe yari Minisitiri w'itangazamakuru. Urugero, igihe u Rwanda rwagiranye ibibazo na dipolomasi n'Ubudage nyuma y’ifatwa ry'umuyobozi mukuru wa protocole ya Perezida Paul Kagame, Rose Kabuye, Mushikiwabo yaganiriye n'ibitangazamakuru mpuzamahanga kugira ngo asobanure neza uko leta y'u Rwanda ihagaze. Yakoresheje ubuhanga bwe bw'indimi, abasha gutanga ibisobanuro mu ndimi zose zemewe z'u Rwanda, Kinyarwanda, Igifaransa n'Icyongereza.

Minisiteri y'Ibikorwa Remezo ("Ministry of Infrastructure", MININFRA) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe politiki y'ibikorwa remezo mu gihugu hose.
Ibyo bikorwa remezo ni ubwikorezi, ingufu, amazi n'isukura, n'imiturire. Kuva muri Kamena 2026, Minisitiri w'Ibikorwa Remezo ni Damien Murwanashyaka.
Icyerekezo cya MININFRA ni uguha igihugu ibikorwa remezo bigezweho. Ibyo bikorwa remezo bigomba gufasha iterambere rirambye ry'ubukungu n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage.
Inshingano z'ingenzi za MININFRA ni izi:
Ibigo bishamikiye kuri MININFRA birimo Rwanda Energy Group (REG), WASAC, RTDA, Rwanda Housing Authority na RwandAir.
Mu mwaka wa 2018, Claver Gatete yasimbuye James Musoni ku buyobozi bwa MININFRA. Ku wa 31 Mutarama 2022, Ernest Nsabimana yasimbuye Gatete. Gatete yagizwe Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu Muryango w'Abibumbye.
Muri Nzeri 2023, Jimmy Gasore yasimbuye Nsabimana. Ku wa 10 Kamena 2026, Damien Murwanashyaka yasimbuye Gasore. Uwo munsi, Claudien Bizimungu na Armand Zingiro bagizwe Abaminisitiri ba Leta muri iyi minisiteri.

Akarere ka Gicumbi ni kamwe mu turere dutanu tugize Intara y'Amajyaruguru mu Rwanda. Gaherereye mu burasirazuba bw'iyi ntara. Umujyi wako mukuru ni Byumba. Gafite ubuso bwa 828,9 km² n'abaturage 448 824. Kagizwe n'imirenge 21.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Mu majyaruguru, Akarere ka Gicumbi gahana imbibi n'Akarere ka Burera na Uganda. Mu burasirazuba hari uturere twa Nyagatare na Gatsibo. Mu majyepfo hari Akarere ka Gasabo n'agace gato ka Rwamagana, ku nkengero z'Ikiyaga cya Muhazi. Mu burengerazuba hari Akarere ka Rulindo.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 21, utugari 109 n'imidugudu 630. Gafite ubuso bwa 828,9 km² n'abaturage 448 824. Ubucucike ni abaturage 541,5 kuri km². Umujyi mukuru w'akarere ni Byumba.

Akarere ka Kicukiro ni kamwe mu turere dutatu tugize Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda. Gafite ubuso bwa 166,7 km² n'abaturage 491 731. Kagizwe n'imirenge 10.

Mu burasirazuba hari Akarere ka Rwamagana. Mu burengerazuba hari Akarere ka Nyarugenge. Icyicaro cy'akarere kiri mu Murenge wa Kagarama, mu Kagari ka Rukatsa.

Ubukungu n'ubukerarugendo.
Akarere ka Nyaruguru kazwi ku bukerarugendo bushingiye ku iyobokamana. Ubuhinzi bw'icyayi ni bwo shingiro ry'ubukungu bw'akarere. I Kibeho ni ho habaye amabonekerwa ya Bikira Mariya.
Akarere ka Nyaruguru kagizwe n'imirenge 14:

Akarere ka Ngororero ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Uburengerazuba mu Rwanda. Kagizwe n'imisozi miremire n'ibibaya. Gafite ubuso bwa 679 km² n'abaturage 367 955. Kagizwe n'imirenge 13.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Mu burengerazuba, Akarere ka Ngororero gahana imbibi n'Akarere ka Rutsiro. Mu majyaruguru hari Akarere ka Nyabihu. Mu majyaruguru ashyira iburasirazuba hari Akarere ka Gakenke. Mu majyepfo hari Akarere ka Karongi. Mu burasirazuba hari Akarere ka Muhanga. Ibiro by'akarere biri ku muhanda Muhanga–Ngororero–Mukamira. Biri ku birometero 46,6 uvuye i Muhanga.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 13, utugari 73 n'imidugudu 416. Gafite ubuso bwa 679 km². Muri 2022, gafite abaturage 367 955, ni ukuvuga abaturage 551 kuri km².
Ubutumburuke bw'akarere buri hagati ya metero 1 460 na metero 2 883. Umusozi muremure ni Bweru, mu Murenge wa Muhanda. Ufite ubutumburuke bwa metero 2 883. Izindi mpinga ndende ziri mu ishyamba rya Gishwati. Ubushyuhe buringaniye ni 18 °C.
Akarere gafite amazi menshi. Kari mu kibaya cy'uruzi rwa Nili. Umugezi w'ingenzi ni Nyabarongo. Indi migezi ni Rubagabaga, Mukungwa, Satinsyi, Muhembe na Kibirira.
Ahantu nyaburanga ho mu Karere ka Ngororero harimo Umukore wa Rwabugiri, Pariki ya Gishwati-Mukura n'inzuri za Gishwati.

Uru rupapuro rugizwe n'urutonde rw'abami ("mwami", plural "abami") bu Rwanda. The Kingdom of Rwanda was one of the oldest and the most centralized kingdoms in the history of Central and East Africa.
Its state and affairs before King Gihanga is largely unconfirmed and highly shrouded in mythical tales.
This article contains a list of kings of Rwanda. The Kingdom of Rwanda was ruled by sovereigns titled "mwami" (plural "abami"), and was one of the oldest and the most centralized kingdoms in the history of Central and East Africa.
Its state and affairs before King Gihanga I is largely unconfirmed and highly shrouded in mythical tales.
Due to a lack of clarification surrounding the oral traditions, many different dates are suggested for the reigns of the kings. This article, from Ruganzu II Ndoli onwards, uses the chronology of Jan Vansina, who has written much on the histories of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda and Burundi.
Pretenders since 1961.
On 28 January 1961, during the Rwandan Revolution, the country abolished its monarchy and became a republic (retroactively approved by a referendum held on 25 September of the same year). Afterwards, Kigeli V Ndahindurwa continued to maintain his claim to the throne until his death on 16 October 2016 in Washington, D.C. On 9 January 2017, the Royal Council of Abiru announced Prince Emmanuel Bushayija as the new heir to the throne. Prince Emmanuel adopted the regnal name Yuhi VI.

Akarere ka Nyabihu ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Uburengerazuba mu Rwanda. Ibiro byako biri mu Murenge wa Mukamira. Gafite ubuso bwa 531,5 km² n'abaturage 319 047. Kagizwe n'imirenge 12.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Nyabihu gahana imbibi n'uturere twa Rubavu, Musanze, Ngororero na Rutsiro. Gahana kandi imbibi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Ibiro by'akarere biri mu Murenge wa Mukamira, mu Kagari ka Rubaya, mu Mudugudu wa Cyivugiza. Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 12, utugari 73 n'imidugudu 473. Gafite ubuso bwa 531,5 km² n'abaturage 319 047.
Akarere kazwi cyane kubera ahantu nyaburanga, imisozi n'ibiyaga. Kazwi kandi kubera amashuri menshi n'ibiranga amateka.

Akarere ka Rusizi ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize Intara y'Uburengerazuba mu Rwanda. Kari ku Ikiyaga cya Kivu. Gahana imbibi n'Uburundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Gafite ubuso bwa 940,95 km² n'abaturage 485 529. Kagizwe n'imirenge 18.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Mu majyepfo, Akarere ka Rusizi gahana imbibi n'Uburundi. Umugezi wa Ruhwa ni wo mupaka. Mu burengerazuba hari Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ikiyaga cya Kivu n'Umugezi wa Rusizi ni byo bitandukanya ibihugu byombi.
Akarere kagizwe n'imirenge 18, utugari 93 n'imidugudu 596. Gafite ubuso bwa 940,95 km². Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, kari gatuwe n'abaturage 485 529. Umujyi wa Rusizi ni umwe mu mijyi itandatu yunganira Umujyi wa Kigali.
Akarere ka Rusizi kagizwe n'imirenge 18:
Akarere ka Rusizi gahinga umuceli mu kibaya cya Bugarama. Gahinga kandi icyayi, ikawa, imbuto, urutoki, ibigori, ibishyimbo n'imyumbati. Aborozi borora inka, ihene n'ingurube. Mu Kiyaga cya Kivu harobwa amafi n'isambaza.
Ahantu nyaburanga ho mu Karere ka Rusizi harimo Ikiyaga cya Kivu, amashyuza ya Bugarama n'ishyamba rya Cyamudongo. Harimo kandi Pariki ya Nyungwe, Umugezi wa Rusizi n'Ikibuga cy'indege cya Kamembe.

INDA MU BANGAVU (youth pregnancy).
Ubushakashatsi bw’urwego rw’igihugu rw’imiyoborere, RGB, bwagaragaje ko abanyarwanda bavuga ko ikibazo cy’abangavu batwita imburagihe kibabangamiye kurusha ibindi byose. Iki ni ikibazo gihangayikishije isi muri rusange cyane cyane ibihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Abana b' abakobwa batangira kwishora mu gikorwa cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina bakiri bato bityo bamwe muri bo bikabaviramo ibyago byo gutwita cyangwa bakanahandurira indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (Sida, imitezi, mburugu,uburwayi bw'umwijima...).
Amakimbirane mu miryango (Intonganya, kurwana hagati y'ababyeyi, ubusinzi...) ni imwe mu mpamvu itungwa agatoki na benshi, bavuga ko ariyo ntandaro nyamukuru ituma abana bishora muri izo ngeso, kuko abana bahatakariza uburere, bakabura ibyingenzi baba bacyeneye kugira ngo babeho bishimye
Inda mu bangavu mu turere dutandukanye tw'U Rwanda.
Hirya no hino mu turere tw’igihugu hagaragara ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije gukumira inda ziterwa abangavu ariko hakibazwa impamvu aho kugabanyuka cyangwa ngo bicike imibare igenda izamuka.
Nko mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo, uturere twa Nyanza, Huye, Gisagara na Nyaruguru turi mu dufite imibare myinshi y’abangavu batewe inda
Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage mu Karere ka Huye, Kankesha Annonciate, yavuze ko abangavu batewe inda barenga 600.
Ati “Ubushize twavugaga ko dufite abangavu 338 batewe inda ariko ubu twarabaze neza dusanga bageze kuri 699; ni abana benshi cyane.”
Mu Karere ka Nyanza ho imibare yavuye ku bangavu 200 igera ku basaga 450.
Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage mu Karere ka Nyanza, Umutesi Solange, yavuze ko abangavu baheruka guterwa inda barenga 450.
Ati “Iyo turebye nk’imibare dufite kuva mu kwa karindwi ku mwaka ushize dusanga dufite abangavu 455 batewe inda. Abo ni ababyaye ushobora no gusanga hari n’abandi bahohotewe batabyaye ariko iyo mibare iratwereka ko ari ikibazo kiremereye.
Akarere ka Gisagara.
Mu Karere ka Gisagara, ubuyobozi buheruka gutangaza ko hamaze kubarurwa abangavu 623 batwaye inda zitateguwe harimo abahetse impinja n’abagitwite.
Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Gisagara, Rutaburingoga Jérôme ati “Dufite abana batewe inda bagera ku 198 bari munsi y’imyaka 18 n’abandi 425 bari munsi y’imyaka 20. Muri rusange ni umubare munini, ni icyorezo, ni ikibazo gikomeye cyane dusaba ubufatanye bwa buri wese ngo tugihagarike burundu.”

Jimmy Gatete (yavutse ku wa 11 Ukuboza 1982 i Bujumbura) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda.
Gatete yagiye agaragara mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda. Yatsinze ibitego bikomeye mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu 2004 (CAN) byabonye ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’u Rwanda (Amavubi) ijya mu irushanwa rya CAN. Igitego cyamamaye cyane mu mateka y’u Rwanda birashoboka ko ari igitego cye kuri yo muri Gana kuri Stade Amahoro i Kigali muri Werurwe 2003 bigatuma u Rwanda rutsinda 1-0 maze rubaha itike yabo muri Tuniziya umwaka ukurikira.

Ni igihe kigufi cy’izuba, aho riva atari ryinshi, n’irivuye rikaba ridakakaye cyane. Ni igihe abahinzi baba basarura banahunika imyaka bahinze mu bihe by’imvura y’umuhindo. Icyo gihe gitangira ku wa 15 Ukuboza, kigasoza ku wa 15 Werurwe.
