Carole Umulinga Karemera ni umunyarwandakazi wavutse 1975 n'umukinnyi wa filimi umubyinnyi, umucuranzi w'inanga gakondo ya saxofone ndetse akaba n'umwanditsi. Karemera yashinze ikigo k'imyidagaduro ndetse akaba akibereye n'umuyobozi Ishyo Art Center.
Umilinga yavutse mu 1975 i Buruseli mu bubirigi, n'umukobwa w’abanyarwanda bari mu buhungiro. Akiri umwana, Karemara yari umuhanga mu mibare kandi arota gufungura ubucuruzi bw'ihariye bwo gukora imigati. Karemera yize muri National Conservatory of Theatre and Dance i Buruseli. ninaho yarangirije amashuri ye ya kaminuza mu 1994, ise,yari umunyamakuru, yasubiye mu Bubiligi biturutse kuri Jenoside yo yakorewe abatutsi yabereye mu Rwanda. Karemera yavumbuye u Rwanda kuri moto mu 1996. Yakinnye mu makinamico menshi, nka The Trojan Women by Euripides, Umugore w'umuzimu ya Kay Adshead, na Anathema, mbere yo gutangira umwuga we wa film. Hagati ya 2000 na 2004, yagize uruhare runini mu Rwanda muruganda rwa sinema.
Umukinnyi wa filime.
Mu 2005, Karemara yakinnye nka Jeanne muri filime ya Raoul Peck "Rimwe na rimwe muri Mata", ivuga kuri jenoside yabereye mu Rwanda. Muri uwo mwaka, yahisemo gutura i Kigali. Amaze kwimukira mu gihugu, Karemara yagize uruhare mu mishinga y’umuco, harimo no gukina amakinamico mu tubari no mu mihanda yo mu mijyi y’u Rwanda, kugira ngo amateka rusange akomeze amenyekane kandi asigasirwe. Afatanije na Cécilia Kankonda, yashyizeho "katedrali yumvikana" yaririmbwe mu majwi yo kwibukwa aho abitabiriye amahugurwa bashoboraga kuvuga ibyo bibuka ku Rwanda mbere ya 1994.
Mu 2006, Karemara n'abandi bagore barindwi bashinze ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya Ishyo i Kigali kugira ngo bashyigikire umuco mu murwa mukuru, utari ufite ikinamico kugeza icyo gihe. Karemera niwe muyobozi mukuru wiki kigo gifite byinshi mu guteza imbere umuco harimo ibitabo, kwiga kuyina, gukina ikinamico ndetse nibindi.
Karemara yakinnye nka Beatrice muri film ya "Juju Uruganda" 2007. Yabonye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri Festival Sinema Africano mu Butaliyani. Yanditse ikinamico "Chez l'habitant", ivuga ku byabaye ku bagore i Buruseli, Kigali na Sevran.
Karemara yabaye umunyamabanga wungirije w’urusobe rwa Arterial, ndetse n’uhagarariye umuryango wa Arterial Network mu Rwanda. Yakinnye mu mukino wa "Battlefield wa" Peter Brook mu 2016, ashingiye kuri "Mahabharata". Muri 2018, yahawe igihembo muri Les Journées théâtrales de Carthage, yishimira ibikorwa bye mu ikinamico mu Rwanda.

Uwayezu Ariel (azwi muri muzika nka Ariel wayz) ni umuhanzikazi w'umunyarwanda wavukiye mu karere ka RUBAVU, mu ntara y 'Uburengerazuba,akaba ari umwana wa gatanu mu muryango w'abantu umunani.
Ariel Wayz ntakidasanzwe kubona yarakuze akunda umuziki kuko yakuze nyina akunda kuririmba muri orukesiteri (orchester) yitwa INGERI mu imyaka ya 1990. Mu gihe abandi banyeshuri bibandaga mu gukurikirana ayandi masomo asanzwe, weyibanze gusa mu muziki aba aribyo akurikirana nk'umwuga kuko nizo zari inzozi ze.
Intangiriro y'urugendo rwe.
Uwayezu Ariel ni umwe mubari bagize itsinda ryari rikomeye mu muziki nyarwanda ryitwa symphony ryari rigizwe n'abanyeshuri barangije kwiga umuzika ku Nyundo. Uwayezu Ariel ubu afite imyaka 22 gusa ni umukobwa ukiri muto afatwa nkumwe mubahanzikazi bazamuka vuba mu Rwanda rufite.
Uwayezu Ariel yize umuziki mu mashuri makuru(secondary) mu ishuri ryigisha umuziki n'ubuvanganzo rya Nyundo akaba abafite Advanced certificate (A Level) muri muzika.
Inkuru ye y'urukundo.
Uwayezu Ariel yaje gukundana n'umuhanzi mugenzi we uzwi ku izina rya Juno Kizigenza.
Byaravuzwe cyane kuko bose bari ibyamamare muri muzika, aho haje gushira amezi atandatu bakundana.
Ariel yasohoye indirimdo ye ari kumwe n'umukunzi we yitwa Away byatumye abona ikiraka cyo kuririmba mu mikino ya basiketi. Gusa ntabwo byakomeje kumuhira kuko uwo yitaga umukunzi we yaje ku mutenguha.

Mutesi Jolly yavutse taliki 15 Ugushyingo 1996, akaba yarize amashuri ye y'incuke n'abanza mu gihugu cya Uganda akaba ari naho yavukiye. umwaka wa gatandatu we w'amashuri abanza yawize mu Rwanda ku kigo cya Remera Academy ya mbere.
Mutesi jolly Nyampinga w'u Rwanda wa gatanu.
Mutesi jolly ni umwe mu bakobwa batangiye guhagararira u Rwanda mu marushanwa y'ubwiza. kurwego mpuzamahanga, ndetse no mu bindi bintu byinshi bitandukanye mu gihugu nyuma yaho atorewe kuba nyampinga w'u Rwanda wa gatanu nyuma ya Genocide yakorewe Abatutsi 1994 mu Rwanda, akaba yarambitswe ikamba taliki 27 Gashyantare 2016.
Yakiriwe na ambasaderi w'u Rwanda Gen.Maj Charles Karamba muri Tanzaniya ubwo yaragiye gutegura umushinga we w'irushanwa ry'ubwiza rya miss East Africa.
Mutesi Jolly wambaye ikamba ry'ubwiza nk'umukobwa wahize abandi mu bwiza umuco ndetse n'ubwenge umwe muri ba nyampinga bazwiho kugira ibitekerezo cyane kandi bakabishyira mu bikorwa niwe kandi wagaruye irushanwa rya Miss East Africa ritaherukaga gututumba akaba yarashyizemo imbaraga uko ashoboye kandi byatanze umusaruro kuko ryaje kwegukanwa n'umunyarwandakazi Shanitah muri 2021. Ibyo birori byakataraboneka byabereye mu gihugu cy'abaturanyi cya Tanzaniya ahitwa Milimani cityhall

Assia Mutoni ni Umunyarwandazi wavutse 14, Nyakanga 1993, wamenyekanye nka Rosine muri filimi yakunzwe cyane "Intare y'ingore", Ni umwanditsi akaba n'umukinnyi wa filimi nyarwanda guhera muri 2012. ubu amaze gutsindira ibihembo inshuro 8 bitangwa nabahemba abakinnyi ba filimi bitwaye neza, zimwe muri filimi amaze gukinamo ni City Maid, Intare y'Ingore, Seburikoko, Impeta Yanjye, Giramata nizindi.
Ubuzima bwa Assia muri make.
Assia yavukiye i Nyamagabe gusa iwabo bimukira I Kigali afite umwaka umwe gusa, amashuri abanza yayize kuri Remera Catholic primary school, ayisumbuye ayiga Lycee de Nyanza na RHC Gasogi aharangiza muri 2012,Kaminuza ayiga muri UTB mu bijyanye n'Ubukerarugendo aharangiza muri 2016. Yatangiye gukina filimi muri 2012, filimi yahereyeho harimo Rwema, Ntundekure ariko iyatumye amenyekana ni Intare y'Ingore muri 2015 aho yatumye atwara igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umukobwa watowe nabantu benshi muri 2016. Muri 2021 akaba yaratoranyijwe mubakinnyi bazitabira iserukiramuco Silicon Valley African Film festival ribera muri Amerika..

Willy Ndahiro ni umunyarwanda wavukiye i bujumbura, mu Burundi iya 1, mata 1976, yamenyekanye nka Paul muri filimi nyarwanda yakunzwe cyane "Ikigeragezo cy' ubuzima", Ni umuyobozi ndetse n'umukinnyi wa filimi nyarwanda kuva 2006. Byatumye aba umuyobozi wa komite ishinze abakinnyi bamafilimi mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2014-2015, ubu akaba ari umuyobozi w'urugaga nyarwanda rureberera abakora umwuga wa Cinema mu Rwanda (Rwanda Film Federation).. Zimwe muri filimi yayoboye akanakinamo ni "Ay'urukundo"," Kanyarwanda","Anitha" na "Ikigeragezo cy'ubuzima".
Ubuzima bwa Willy muri make.
Willy Ndahiro yavukiye mu Burundi muri 1976, muri 1993 yaje mu Rwanda yinjira mu gisirikare cya Rwanda Patriotic Army (APR) afatanya n'abandi guhagarika jenocide yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994, nyuma yakomereje akazi mu ngabo zirinda perezida kugeza 2004. Willy avuye mu gisirikare yasubiye kwiga mu gihugu cy'u Burundi aho yari yaracirkirije amashuri ye arangiriza mu bijyanye n'indimi(Lettreture), muri 2006 nibwo yatangiye inzira yo gukina filimi atangirira kuri filimi yahise ituma amenyekana "Ikigeragezo cy'ubuzima", muri 2010 yayoboye ndetse akina muyindi filimi yakunzwe cyane "Ay'urukundo". Willy kandi yagiye ashinga studio zitunganya amafilimi harimo iyakoze filmi nyinshi yitwa"Vision Production Ltd" Willy NDAHIRO ubu ni umuyobozi wa Rwanda Film Federation,rukaba ari urugaga nyarwanda ruhuza abakora umwuga wa Cinema mu Rwanda.

Ndjol ni Umunyarwanda wavukiye muri kongo iya 23, Ugushyingo 1962 i Goma. Wamenyekanye cyane mu gukina filimi zo gusetsa mu Rwanda nka Kanyombya kuko yatangiye kuzikina 2001.byatumye amenyekana cyane kuko afatwa nkumwe mubantu bifatizo muri filimi zo gusetsa mu Rwanda. Yakinnye harimo "Bwenjye naguhenze,"Buhahara","abatubuzi","ibikuruka", "nyabingi" nizindi.
ubuzima bwa Kanyombya muri make.
Kanyombya yavutse kuri mama we Gaudence Mukandutiye na papa we Jean Baptiste Sakumi, avukira mu muryango w'abana 7 gusa hasigaye 5. Yize amashuri abanza kuri ecole primaire ste Andre i Goma, akomereza ayisumbuye muri Tuugane Institute ahava muri 1992 ahita ajya mu gisirikare yaje kuvamo muri 2002. Mu gisirikare yarwaniye mu ngabo za RPA zafashe igihugu muri 1994, Avuye mugisirikare nibwo yatangiye gukina filimi kugeza nanubu ntiyigeze ahagarara. Kanyombya ubu afite umugore babanaga nuko baza gusezerana imbere y'amategeko muri 2012 kandi bafitanye abana 2 ndetse n'abandi barera. Kanyombya avugako impano yo gusetsa yayikuye ku muryango we kuko ngo bose abazi basetsa haba abavandimwe n'ababyeyi be.

Jeannette Bahavu (amazina yose: Usanase Bahavu Jeannette) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Azwi ku ruhare rwa Diane muri filime y'uruhererekane "City Maid". Azwi kandi muri filime y'uruhererekane "Impanga".
Mu 2023, Bahavu yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Mu 2018, Bahavu yakinaga muri filime y'uruhererekane "City Maid". Iyi filime yacaga kuri Televiziyo y'u Rwanda (TVR). Bahavu yakinaga uruhare rwa Diane, mushiki wa Nick. Yakinnye kandi muri filime "Umuziranenge". Yagaragaye no mu mashusho y'indirimbo "Ku ndunduro" ya Social Mula.
Mu 2018 kandi, Bahavu yatangiye gukora itangazamakuru kuri Authentic TV. Yayoboraga ikiganiro "Christian Celebrity Show". Iki kiganiro cyacaga buri wa Gatandatu.
Nyuma, Bahavu yamenyekanye muri filime y'uruhererekane "Impanga".
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, Bahavu yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane ("People's Choice") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards. Ibi bihembo bitegurwa na Ishusho Arts, iyobowe na Jackson Mucyo. Igihembo cyari imodoka. Iyi modoka yatinze gutangwa. Bahavu yayihawe ku ya 16 Gicurasi 2023.
Bahavu n'umugabo we Ndayirukiye Fleury bamenyanye mu 2015. Batangiye gukundana mu 2016. Basezeranye imbere y'amategeko ku ya 17 Ukuboza 2020. Ubukwe bwabo bwabaye ku ya 27 Werurwe 2021. Ndayirukiye Fleury ni we ureberera umwuga wa Bahavu.

Seburikoko ni Urukurikirane rw'urwenya rwo mu Rwanda rwakozwe na Misago Nelly Wilson abikora binyuze muri, Afrifame ltd. Ikiganiro cy'iminota 15 kinyura kuri Televiziyo y'u Rwanda (RTV) buri wa mbere no ku wa kane saa kumi n'ebyiri na mirongo ine n'itanu (4h45 PM GMT) guhera muri Werurwe 2015. Uruhererekane ruzaba rugizwe n'ibihe 4 byanditswe na Mutiganda Wa Nkunda hamwe na 'Rurema Misago Nelly Wilson' kandi bikayoborwa na Jones Kennedy Mazimpaka hamwe na samples studios. Irimo itsinda ryitsinda rigizwe n'umunyarwanda wamamaye wumunyarwenya Gratien Niyitegeka nk'umuntu w'icyubahiro Seburikoko, Antoinette Uwamahoro nkumugore we Siperansiya, Erneste Kalisa, Ngabo Leo, Mediatrice ya Muhutukazi (uzwi cyane kubera uruhare muri radio yisabune yo mu Rwanda yitwa Kankwanzi)), n'abandsi benshi.
Seburikoko yabaye porogaramu ikunzwe cyane kuri Televiziyo y'u Rwanda kandi mu mpera za sizoni 4 muri Werurwe 2016, televiziyo yategetse izindi sizoni 4 zizakomeza muri Werurwe 2017.
Ku nshuro ya 5 ya Rwanda Movie Awards, Urukurikirane rwa TV rwatsindiye ibihembo 8 birimo Urukurikirane rwiza rwa TV, Umuyobozi mwiza, Umukinnyi wa mbere witwaye neza ndetse n’umukinnyi wa filime maze akomeza gutsindira 4 kuri serivise nziza za TV, umuyobozi mwiza, umukinnyi wa cinemateri mwiza na injeniyeri mwiza.
SEBURIKOKO avuga inkuru y'umugabo witwa Seburikoko wiyita SEBU kubera izina yumva muri we nk'umutunzi mu baturanyi b'umudugudu w'impimbano wa Gatoto. Ntakintu akorera umuryango we kuko amara umwanya wose anywa inzoga, agurisha ibintu byo munzu yaguzwe n'umugore we Siperansiya ukora ibishoboka byose kugirango atunge umuryango.

Kevine Kagirimpundu (wavutse 1991) ni Umunyarwandakazi w’umucuruzi, ni umuyobozi mukuru akaba ari nawe washinze Uzuri K&amp;Y.
Afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no guhanga no kubungabunga ibidukikije byubatswe mu 2015, yakuye muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda..Akaba yarize amashuri yisumbuye muri lucee
UZURI K&amp;Y ni uruganda rwo mu Rwanda rufite icyicaro i Kigali mu Rwanda kandi rwanditswe muri RDB kuva muri Kamena 2013, rukora umurongo winkweto z'ufunguye. batezimbere tekinike yumwimerere yo gukora inkweto nyafurika, imiterere idasanzwe, hamwe nuburyo bwihariye bwo gutegura ibikoresho.
Ibyo Kevine avuga nyuma yokwihangira umurimo.
Ubu twafungutse mumitekereze dufite ibitekerezo byo gupima ibikorwa byacu. Gupima ubucuruzi bigomba gutegurwa kandi ntitwari dufite igitekerezo cyo kubikora mbere yuko twinjira muri mu mwuga
Ibyo wamenya kuri Uzuri.
UZURI K&amp;Y numushinga wabaafrica bishize hamwe muguteza imbere ibidukikije no kurwanya ibyangiza ibidukikije. Yashinzwe ifite icyerekezo cyo kwerekana Afurika nkinkomoko yimyambarire irambye, uruganda rwimibereho rukora ibisubizo bifatika mugutunganya imyanda mukweto.

Misago Wilson (wavutse 14 Ukuboza 1985), Tumuzi nka Nelly Wilson Misago, azwiho gutunganya filimi mu Rwanda. Ni Umuyobozi Mukuru w' Ikigo Zacu Entertainment, gikora nikanatunganya filime nyarwanda. "Azwi cyane nk'umwanditsi w'uruhererekane rw'amakinamico aca kuri" televiziyo azwi cyane nka "Inshuti", Seburikoko,"City Maid, N' Indoto". Ni umwanditsi na producer ushobora gukora muri filime gusa ubusanzwe abikora kuri televiziyo. Yakoze kandi anatunganya urukurikirane rw'ikinamico "Ejo Si Kera" ku bufatanye na Imbuto Foundation kuri televiziyo y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Yavutse ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1985 i Gisagara, mu Rwanda. Muri 2009, yabonye impamyabumenyi mu by'imari yakuye mu Ishuri ry’Imari n’amabanki, (kuri ubu izwi ku izina rya kaminuza y’u Rwanda Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubucuruzi n’Ubukungu: UR-CBE).
Muri 2013 yashakanye n' umukunzi we w'igihe kinini, Hilarie Uwabimfura. Ibirori by'ubukwe byabereye i Remera -Kigali. Ni se w'abahungu babiri. Muri Mutarama 2014 umuhungu we w'imfura yavutse naho uwa kabiri avuka muri Gashyantare 2018.
Misago ashishikajwe cyane no gutunganya film no guhanga. Akunda umuziki no kureba filime cyane cyane izitambuka kuri TV mu gihe afite akanya. Akunda gutembera nko kwishimisha no gushaka inshuti nshya.
Muri 2009 Wilson Misago yinjiye Inyarwanda Ltd nk'umunyamakuru. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yabaye umuyobozi ushinzwe kwamamaza mu Inyarwanda Limited, ari naho yaje kuzamurwa ku mwanya w'umuyobozi. Muri 2012, yakoze nk'umunyamakuru wa radio kuri City Radio no gukora imyidagaduro n'inkuru kuri inyarwanda.com. Muri 2013, yakoze seri" "Ubu n'ejo"" itaramenyekanye. Ariko, muri 2014, Misago yakoze seri y'urwenya "Inshuti" yacaga kuri TV10. Urukurikirane rufatwa nkurukurikirane rwa mbere rwa TV rwakorewe mu karere. Intsinzi yayo, yatumye akora urwenya rwa "Seburikoko" yabaye imwe mu ma kinamico azwi cyane mu Rwanda. Urukurikirane rwanyuze kuri Televiziyo y'u Rwanda.
Hanyuma mu mpera za 2014, yahimbye kandi akora "City Maid", indi filimi yanyuze kuri RTV. Yamamaye cyane muri rubanda. Muri 2017, yanditse kandi ayobora Little "Skater". Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yashinze isosiyete ikora amajwi n'amashusho 'Afrifame Limited', ikora ibijyanye no gutunganya filimi na serivisi zifotora.
Niwe washinze 'ZACUTV', (VOD) yambere mu Rwanda byerekana ibiganiro bya Sinema mu Rwanda. Yashyizwe ahagaragara ku mugaragaro mu nama ya Transform Africa 2019.
Mu mwaka wa 2022 hagati, ZACU TV yaguzwe n'ikigo mpuzamahanga Canal+ Group mu rwego rwo gukomeza gutunganya ibijyanye n'amajwi n'amashusho mu Rwanda, gukungahaza isoko rya filime zikorewe mu Rwanda, gutekereza kubuhanga n'impano by'abakinnyi n'abayobora ba filime ndetse nabandi bahanzi ba filime bahazaza muri rusange. Ubu ZACU TV iboneka kuri decoderi ya Canal+ uhereye ku ifatabuguzi "Ikaze" kuri shene ya 99.

Ysolde Shimwe ni umunyarwandakazi ndetse akaba n'umunyamideri wamenyekanye cyane nk'umwe mubashinze ikigo cy'ubucuri gikomeye cya Uzuri K&amp;Y ndetse akaba ari n'umuyobozi wacyo mubigenda no guhanga udushya.
Ysolde Shimwe yavukiye mu 1992 mu murwa mukuru w'u Rwanda i Kigali ndetse aranahakurira yakuze akunda ibintu byose bigendanye nubugeni. Yaje kubona buruse yo kujya muri Kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda aho yagiye kwiga ubugeni ndetse no guhanga udushya muri 2015, akaba akunda cyane ibigendanye n'ubugeni ndetse ndetse no gutanga umusanzu we ngo igihugu gishyikire amajyambere arambye.
Muri 2013 Ysolde Shimwe yashinze ikigo Uzuri K&amp;Y cyibanze cyane mu gukora inkweto za made in Rwanda z'ubwoko bwinshi, bahawe ibihembo byinshi biytandukanye na RDBIkigo gishinzwe iterambere mu Rwanda ndetse na Jack ma foundation, ikigo cy'ubucuruzu cyo mubushinywa. Sibyo gusa ahubwo bakora n'amahugurwa kubantu bose babyifuza bakabigisha gukora inkweto kugirango nabo bajye kwihangira imirimo. Uzuri K&amp;Y ifite umwihariko wo gukoresha abagore benshi kandi bakabafasha no kwiteza imbere.
.Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere mu Rwanda
. Kevine Kagirimpundu

Mutiganda Janvier (wavutse ku ya 18 Ukwakira 1989), ni umukinnyi wa filime mu Rwanda wagize uruhare runini nk'umwanditsi wa sinema ndetse na producer muri filime nyinshi zica kuri televiziyo.
Yavutse ku ya 18 Ukwakira 1989 i Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Muri 2013, yarangije icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu buhinzi. Icyakora yaje kwimukira mubakinnyi ba firime no gukora film kubera ishyaka rye rya sinema. Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, amashusho ye 4 yambere yerekana ibihimbano yashyizwe ku rutonde mu marushanwa ya Global Dialogues Amateka magufi yo gukora amarushanwa. Muri 2014, yanditse, atunganya kandi ayobora filime ye ya mbere ya "Rayila", Ninkuru yumubyeyi wataye umwana we akiyahura. Iyi filime yamamaye cyane kandi yegukana ibihembo mu birori byinshi bya firime ndetse no mu mamahanga.
Muri 2014 kandi, yanditse sitcom izwi cyane "Inshuti yanyuze" kuri TV 10 mu Rwanda hagati ya 2014 na 2015. Ifatwa nkurukurikirane rwa mbere rwa TV rwakozwe mu Rwanda. Yasohotse kandi kuri YouTube kandi yakira abafana benshi. Muri 2015, Janvier yakoze nka producer kuri firime ngufi "Ishaba" yakozwe mu mahugurwa yo gukina amafilime yakozwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika rya Mashariki (MAAFF). Amashusho yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime kandi asohoka kuri DVD na Africalia mu rwego rwo gukusanya filime ngufi za Afurika nziza. Nyuma y'umwaka, yagiye mu mahugurwa yo kwandika filimi ya Maisha Film Lab i Kigali, aho yakoraga nk'umwanditsi kuri series zizwi cyane zisetsa "Seburikoko zanyuze" kuri televiziyo y'u Rwanda muri Werurwe 2015. Hagati aho, yakoraga akazi ko gutunganya filime n’umunyamakuru kuva mu 2013 mu bitangazamakuru byinshi byaho. Nyuma yaje gukora firime ngufi, "La Femme Nue" yatoranijwe kunshuro ya 3 muri MAAFF.
Nyuma yo kuva mu mwuga w’abanyamakuru mu 2016, yibanze cyane ku gukina amafilime aho yayoboye ibiganiro bya TV "City Maid" kuri ubu bica kuri Televiziyo y’u Rwanda. Muri icyo gihe, yakoze serial ya "Virunga School" yerekana kuri TV. Hanyuma yanditse, akora kandi ayobora film ye ya kabiri ngufi "Ibanga ry'umunezero" muri 2017. Hagati aho, yashinze isosiyete yigenga itunganya firime yitwa 'IZACU'. Muri iyi sosiyete, yakoze filime ye ya mbere yise Nameless nyuma ayishyira mu mahugurwa ya Takmil ya Carthage Film Festival 2018. Muri aya mahugurwa, iyi filime yaguzwe n’igihangange cya Orange Studio y’Abafaransa kandi iyi filime ikaba yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Friborg mu Busuwisi. Nk'umuproducer, yakoze A Taste of our Land yatsindiye ibihembo byambere bya firime nziza muri PanAfrican Film Festival 2020 na AMAAs 2021.

Edouard Bamporiki (yavutse Ukwakira 24, 1983) ni umuhanzi w'umunyapolitike w'umunyarwanda. Kugeza ubu afite umwanya muri guverinoma y’u Rwanda nka Minisitiri ushinzwe umuco muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’umuco Bamporiki yabaye umukinnyi umukinnyi wa filime n'umwanditsi n'umusizi.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Bamporiki yavukiye mu karere ka Nyamasheke, Intara y'Uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda. Yize amashuri muri ako karere. Muri 2003, igihe Bamporiki yari afite imyaka 20, yinjiye mu ikinamico episodic yacaga kuri radiyo y'igihugu. Ibi byamuhaye kwiyerekana mugihugu cyose nk'umukinnyi w'umuhanga.Afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko yakuye muri Université Libre de Kigali (ULK).
Mu 2013, Bamporiki yatorewe kuba Umudepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda, Urugereko rwo hasi. Muri 2019, yagizwe Minisitiri muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’umuco na Perezida Paul Kagame.Mbere y’inama y’abaminisitiri, yari Perezida wa komisiyo y’igihugu y'itorero ry'u Rwanda.
Bamporiki n'umukinnyi wa firime. "Long Coat" ni imwe muri filime zizwi cyane - binyuze mu nkuru y’umuntu warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ndetse n'umwe mu bahungu b'uwakoze icyaha, iyi filime yibanda ku gusiga amateka ye. Bamporiki yanditse, akina, ayobora kandi akora ikinamico y'iminota 63 yerekanwe bwa mbere muri 2008. Byamushirishije mu karere ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu gumutwara igihembo cya mbere mu ireukiramuco rya filimi nyafurika ribera i newyork.
Bamporiki yari yakoze début ye muri "Munyurangabo", filime ya Lee Isaac Chung aho yatorewe kuba umukinnyi mwiza muri Cannes. Yatunganije kandi "akina mu Rwanda: Fata Babiri" mu 2010 hanyuma umwaka urangiye, yakinnye muri "Kinyarwanda", ikinamico yamateka, hamwe na Cassandra Freeman. Aheruka kugaragara kuri ecran muri 2015 ubwo yakinaga ikinamico y'urukundo "Umutoma".
Muri 2017, Bamporiki yasohoye igitabo cyiswe "Umwana wanjye, Ninkuru ndende: Ibitekerezo by'abakoze Jenoside". Gushyira ahagaragara igitabo cyitabiriwe na madamu wa perezida w’u Rwanda Jeannette Kagame.

Ntarindwa Diogene ni umunyarwenya uzwi ku izina nka Atome cg Gasumuni, yavukiye mu gihugu cy'u Burundi mu 1977, Atome wamenyekanye mu gukina byendagusetsa, ni Umwanditsi n'umukinnyi wa filimi, ikinamico na comedy. yamenyekanye mu ikinamico nka Gasumuni.
Atome yatangiye gukina ikinamico muri 1994, yabikoze cyane yiga muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda mu iishami ry'amategeko muri 1996. muri 2002 yagiye gukomeza amasomo i Liege mu Ububiligi ibijyanye na Art Dramatique naho akomeza gukina aho yagaragaye mu ma kinamico arimo Koulsy Lamko, Corpx et voix, Paroles rhizome. muri 2008 yagarutse mu Rwanda agaragara cyane akina asetsa muri forum yari yateguwe n'Imbuto Foundation Rwanda.
Atome mu gisirikare.
Atome mu rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu 1994 yarimo nk'umusirikare, avuga ko yakigiyemo akiri umusore muto niyompamvu urugamba rurangiye yagiye gukomeza amashuri.

Kansiime Kubiryaba Anne (yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1986) kandi uzwi cyane ku izina rya Anne Kansiime, ni Umugande w'umunyarwenya, akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime. Bimwe mu bitangazamakuru byo muri Afurika byamwise "Umwamikazi wa Afurika wo gusetsa".
Yavukiye i Mparo mu gake ka Rukiga y'ubu, mu burengerazuba bwa Uganda. Igihe yavukaga, Mparo yari mu gace ka Kabale. Se ni umunyamabanki uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru, naho nyina ni umugore wo mu rugo. Kansiime yize amashuri abanza i Kabale. Amashuri ye yisumbuye, yize mu ishuri ry'isumbuye ry'abakobwa rya Bweranyangi i Bushenyi. Afite impamyabumenyi y'isumbuye mu buhanzi n’imibereho yakuye muri kaminuza ya Makelele, kaminuza ya kera ya Uganda kandi nini muri Leta.
Dukurikije ibibazo byafashwe amajwi yatanze mu 2014, Anne yatangiye gushyira kuri YouTube amashusho yerekana udukino dusetsa. Yakiriye ibitekerezo byiza kandi bimutera inkunga yo kohereza izindi videwo. Icyerekezo cye cyerekanwe kuri tv y'abaturage muri Kenya ituranye na Uganda yamuhaye umwanya wo gukora, gukina no kwerekana ikiganiro gisetsa rimwe mucyumweru. Nibwo yazanye na Don't mess with Kansiime yerekana urwenya. Kugeza mu Gushyingo 2014, umuyoboro wa YouTube umaze gukusanya abantu barenga miliyoni 15. Amashusho ye yo kuri YouTube yakira ibihumbi n'ibihumbi kandi yagaragaye kuri BBC yibanze kuri Afrika. Yakinnye mu nzu zuzuye abafana muri Blantyre, Gaborone, Kigali, Kuala Lumpur, Lagos, Lilongwe, London, Lusaka na Harare.
Anne Kansiime abinyujije mumuryango we utanga imfashanyo, The Kansiime Foundation, ashyigikira abana batishoboye ariko bafite umucyo mubakomeza mwishuri. Ubu afasha abana barenga 35 haba mu mashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye.
Anne Kansiime nawe ari mubucuruzi bwo kwidagadura. Ayobora Kansiime Backpackers kandi iherereye ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Bunyonyi, ikagenzura neza ikiyaga cya Bunyonyi mu Karere ka Kabale, muri Uganda.

100 Days ni filme y'ikinamico yo muri 2001 yayobowe na Nick Hughes ikorwa na Hughes na Eric Kabera inkuru y'ino filme igaruka kuri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994. Umutwe wa filime ugaragaza uburebure bw'igihe cyo kuva jenoside yatangira ku ya 7 Mata kugeza ihagaritswe hagati muri Nyakanga 1994.
Iyi filime niyo filime ya mbere yakinwe ikozwe ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, ikaba yibanda ku buzima bw’umukobwa muto w'umututsi wabaye impunzi ashakisha uko yarokora ubuzima bwe mu gihe cya Jenoside. Amashusho y'ino filme yafatiwe ahantu Jenoside yabereye mu Rwanda.

Eric Kabera (wavutse 1970) ni umunyamakuru w' umunyarwanda, umukinnyi wa firime akaba ari nawe washinze akaba na perezida w’ikigo cya Sinema cy’u Rwanda.(Rwanda Cinema Center
Kabera ni we washinze kandi akaba na perezida w’ikigo cya Sinema cy’u Rwanda(Rwanda Cinema Center), umuryango ugamije guteza imbere inganda za firime mu gihugu. Kabera yabanje gushyiraho Ikigo nk'umuryango uzahugura abakora amafilime mashya ariko, kuva 2005, iki kigo cyamenyekanye cyane mugutegura iserukiramuco rya cinema ngarukamwaka. Iserukiramuco rya sinema mu Rwanda, ryiswe "Hillywood" kubera izina ry'u Rwanda ryiswe "Igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi", ni umunsi mukuru w'ingendo. Bitewe n'icyifuzo cya Kabera cyo kwerekana amafilime ku bantu benshi bashoboka, iserukiramuco ntiribera mu murwa mukuru wa Kigali gusa ahubwo ni filime, cyane cyane izakozwe n'abakora amafilime yo mu Rwanda. Kabera yatangaje ko ibirori bizatera intambwe yo kutibanda gusa ku kibazo cya jenoside; kurusha ibindi bibazo byimibereho y'u Rwanda.

Sometimes in April ni filime y'akozwe n'abanyamerika muri 2005 ivuga kuri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, yanditswe kandi iyobowe n'umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Hayiti Raoul Peck. Abakinnyi bagize itsinda barimo Idris Elba, Oris Erhuero, Carole Karemera, na Debra Winger.
Bitandukanye na "Hotel Rwanda", yahawe igihembo cya PG-13 kandi ikaba yaravugaga mu buryo bwihishe inyuma ya jenoside aho kwerekana ku buryo bweruye, iyi filime yari izwiho kwerekana ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, ryayihaye TV-MA. Byongeye kandi, amashusho atandukanye yashyizwe mu Rwanda yafatiwe muri Kigali no hafi yayo, hagaragaramo ahantu nyaburanga nka Hotel des Mille Collines ndetse na kiliziya ya Sainte-Famille.
Filime yabanje kwerekanwa kuri HBO. Nyuma yaje gutangazwa na PBS hanyuma isesengurwa n’umunyamakuru jeff Greenfield hamwe na Paul Bonerwitz hamwe n’abandi.

Osita Iheme, (yavutse ku ya 20 Gashyantare 1982) ni umukinnyi wa fiimi muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane mu gukina uruhare rwa Pawpaw muri filime Aki na Ukwa hamwe na Chinedu Ikedieze. Osita Iheme ni we washinze Inspired Movement Africa yashinze kugira ngo atere imbaraga, ashishikarize kandi akangure imitekerereze y'abasore bo muri Nigeriya n'Abanyafurika. Muri 2007, Iheme yahawe igihembo cya "Lifetime Achievement Award" muri African Movie Academy Awards. Afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi bazwi cyane muri Nijeriya. Mu mwaka wa 2011, Osita Iheme yahawe igihembo cyo kuba umwe mubagize iteka rya Perezida wa Repubulica Goodluck Jonathan.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Osita Iheme akomoka muri Mbaitoli, muri Leta ya Imo, muri Nijeriya. Iheme yakuriye muri Leta ya Abia kandi afite impamyabumenyi ya MBA yakuye mu Ishuri Rikuru ry'Ikoranabuhanga, Ghaziabad (IMT). Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye muri IMT, yabanje gushaka kuba umunyamategeko ariko akomeza umwuga we wo gukina filime mu 1998, abanza kugaragara mu nshingano ngufi muri filimi.
Mu rwego rwo guhemba uruhare rwe mu ma filime asetsa ya muri Nigeriya, mu 2011 yahawe igihembo cy’igihugu cya Nigeriya cy’umunyamuryango w’itegeko rya Repubulika (MFR) na Perezida Goodluck Jonathan.
Filimi ya Osita Iheme hamwe na mugenzi we Chinedu Ikedieze muri filime "Aki na Ukwa yo" mu 2002 kiracyavugwa cyane kandi aba bombi, cyane cyane imiterere ya Osita, bagiye bagaragara muri memes kuva mu 2019 kuri Twitter no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ibi byaje kumuhesha umufana munini cyane kwisi yose.
Amashusho yagaragayemo.

Chinedu Ikedieze, (yavutse 12 Ukuboza 1977) ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Nigeriya, rwiyemezamirimo n'umushoramari udasanzwe. Azwi cyane mu gukina na Osita Iheme muri firime nyinshi nyuma yo gutera imbere nka bombi muri filime "Aki na Ukwa" 2002. Yagaragaye muri firime zirenga 150 mu mwuga umaze imyaka 20. Yakinnye mu ruhare rw'umwana muri filime nyinshi mu buzima bwe akiri muto kubera igihagararo ndetse n'imiterere y'umubiri. Azwi nka Aki kubera ibikorwa bye muri film "Aki na Ukwa". Mu 2011, yashakanye n'umuhanga mu kwerekana imideli Nneoma Nwaijah maze bombi babyarana umwana wabo wa mbere mu 2012
Chinedu yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye muri Aba, muri Leta ya Abia. Amaze kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye yakurikiranye Impamyabumenyi ihangane mu buhanzi bwa tiyatere ndetse n'impamyabumeny mu itumanaho rusange yakuye mu kigo gishinzwe imiyoborere n'ikoranabuhanga, Enugu (IMT). Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye muri IMT, yabanje gushaka kuba umunyamategeko ariko akomeza umwuga we wo gukina filime mu 1998, abanza kugaragara mu nshingano nto. Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere muri filime Evil Men 1998. Yiyandikishije mu ishuri rya Flimi rikomeye rya New York mu 2004.
Ibyo yakoranye na Osita Iheme.
Yinjiye muri Nollywood muri 2000 maze azamuka cyane muri filime "Aki na Ukwa" mu 2002 aho yakinnye cyane muri Aki ari kumwe n’undi mukinnyi muto Osita Iheme. Aba bombi bakunze kwitwa "Aki Paw Paw" kuva iyi filime isohoka kandi bagaragaye hamwe muri firime nyinshi mu bakinnyi ba mbere. Chinedu na Osita bombi bakomeje kubungabunga chimie ya ecran na offscreen ishimwa cyane na Nollywood.
Mu 2007, Ikedieze yahawe igihembo cya "Lifetime Achievement Award" muri African Movie Academy Awards. Yahawe kandi icyubahiro n'Iteka rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Repubulika ryatanzwe na Perezida wa Nijeriya icyo gihe Goodluck Jonathan kubera uruhare yagize muri Nollywood no mu kuzamura ubukungu bw'igihugu.
Imyitwarire ye hamwe nabakinnyi bato bakinnyi ba filime Osita Iheme muri film ya "Aki na Ukwa yo" mu 2002 iracyavugwa cyane kandi aba bombi cyane cyane imico ya Osita yagiye agaragara muri memes kuva muri 2019 kurubuga rwa Twitter ndetse nizindi mbuga nkoranyambaga ku isi. Osita yashyizwe ku rutonde rw'abakinnyi bakize muri Nijeriya.

Aki na Ukwa ni filimi yakorewe muri Nigeriya muri 2002 iyobowe na Amayo Uzo Philips. Muri filime hagaragaramo Osita Iheme na Chinedu Ikedieze. Filime yatangije umwuga wo gukinana ari abakinnyi bombi Osita na Chinedu kandi iyi film yaranze ubufatanye bwabo bwa mbere. Iyi filime yashimiwe cyane ko yafunguye ibitekerezo byiza kandi iyi filime yafashwe nka imwe muri filime nziza kurusha izindi zose muri sinema yo muri Nijeriya ahanini hagamijwe kumenyekanisha Osita Iheme na Chinedu Ikedieze mu nshingano zabo bakina abiyita ba PawPaw na Aki.. Aba bombi bahagurukiye kuba ibyamamare maze bahinduka ijuru ryose muri Nijeriya kubera imikorere yabo muri filime kuva yasohoka. Kuva icyo gihe, aba bombi bakinnye hamwe muri firime nyinshi mu nshingano zabo. Chukwuka Emelionwu wari uwatunganije iyi filime yashimiwe kuba yararemye abantu baranga "Aki" na "PawPaw".
Abavandimwe babiri bateza akaduruvayo mu rugo rwabo, mu ishuri ryabo ndetse no mu mudugudu wabo wose.

Munyurangabo ni filime nyarwanda yasohotse muri 2007 iyobowe na Lee Isaac Chung. Yafatiwe amashusho yose mu Rwanda hamwe n'abakinnyi b'abanyarwanda, niyo filime yambere yerekana inkuru mu rurimi rw' iKinyarwanda. Yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2007 ku ya 24 Gicurasi, kandi yegukana igihembo muri AFI Fest 2007. Umunyamerika Roger Ebert impuguke muri filimi yayise filimi y'igitangaza."
Nk 'uko ikinyamakuru "The New York Times" kibitangaza ngo mbere yo gukora iyi filimi, umugore wa Lee Isaac Chung, Valerie yari yakoze urugendo mu Rwanda nk'umukorerabushake wo gukorana n’abagizweho n'ingaruka na jenoside yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994, Chung yari yamuherekeje mu Rwanda yatekereje gukinira filimi muri Kigali muri 2006. Chung ahita aboneraho akanya ko kwerekana ukuri kubijyanye nuko u Rwanda rwari rumeze akoresheje abanyeshuri yari amaze iminsi yigisha gukina filimi. Chung yanditse filimi ku mpapuro icyenda abifashijwemo n'inshuti (gusa nyuma yaje gushaka abandi banditsi bamufasha kunoza neza inkuru harimo Samuel Gray Anderson. Chung yafashe amashusho ya Munyurangabo mu minsi 11, akorana n'itsinda ry'abakinnyi babanyarwanda.
Iterambere ryakurikiyeho.
Lee Isaac Chung yakomeje gufasha abo bakinanye kuburyo ubu bakora amafilimi yo mu Rwanda bikabagirira akamaro abinyujije muri Almond Tree Rwanda.

Abouna (Arabic, English: "Our Father") ni filimi yo muri Chad yakinwe muri 2002,iyoborwa na Mahamat Saleh Haroun. Yafatiwe amashusho ahitwa Gaoui na N'Djamena, Tchad.
Abahungu babiri (Tahir na Amine) babyutse mugitondo basanga se yataye umuryango wabo. Barumiwe, batangira kwitwara nabi. Mugihe bareba firime, batekereza ko babona se avugana nabo,bakiba firime kugirango babone izo kureba. Nyina wabo (Achta) amaherezo yihebye maze abohereza ku ishuri rya Koran. Ntibishimye, bateganya guhunga kugeza umuhungu w'imfura akundana n'umukobwa utumva (Khalil).
Gukina no gutanga umusaruro.
Ahidjo Mahamat Moussa wakinnye Tahir wimyaka 15, yahawe abahungu ngo ahitemo gukina murumuna we Amine. Yahavuye ahitamo Hamza Moctar Aguid wimyaka umunani kuko yumvaga ko Aguid ashobora kuba murumuna we. Nyuma ya buri munsi wo gufata amashusho, film yoherejwe ibirometero 2600 i Paris kugirango itunganyirizwe. Gusa nyuma yo gutegereza iminsi myinshi, iyo ijambo ryagarukaga rivuga ko ntakibazo, gufata amashusho byarakomezaga.

Touki Bouki,(Urugendo rwa Hyena) ni filime y'ikinamico yo muri 1973 yo muri Senegali, iyobowe na Djibril Diop Mambéty. Yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1973 no mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 8 rya Moscou.Iyi filime yagaruwe mu 2008 muri Cineteca di Bologna / L'Immagine Ritrovata Laboratoire na World Cinema Foundation. Yatoranijwe nka firime ya 93 ikomeye mubihe byose byakozwe na Sight and Sound Critic's Poll.
Mory, umushumba w'inka ufite charismatique utwara moto yashizwemo igihanga gifite amahembe y'inka, na Anta, umunyeshuri w’umukobwa, bahurira i Dakar. Abanyamahanga kandi barambiwe ubuzima muri Senegali, barota bajya i Paris bakazana gahunda zitandukanye zo gushaka amafaranga y'urugendo. Mory yaje gutsinda kwiba amafaranga, n'imyenda myinshi, murugo rwabakire bahuje igitsina bakize mu gihe aba barimo kwiyuhagira. Anta na Mory amaherezo.barashobora kugura amatike y'ubwato bugana mubufaransa. Ariko igihe Anta yinjiye mu bwato ku cyambu cya Dakar, Mory, yiteguye ku gatsiko kari inyuma ye, yahise afatwa no kutabasha kuva mu mizi, maze ahunga asara asanga moto ye ifite amahembe y'inka, ariko abibona. yangiritse mu mpanuka yahitanye hafi uwagenderaga wari wayitwaye. Ubwato bwahagurutse hamwe na Anta ariko ntabwo ari Mory, wicaye iruhande rw'ingofero ye hasi, yitegereza moto ye yamenetse.

Black Girl (1966) ni Filime yo muri Senegali yanditswe numwanditsi / umuyobozi Ousmane Sembène, yakinnye na Mbissine Thérèse Diop. Umutwe wayo wigifaransa ni La noire de…, bisobanura ngo "Umukobwa / umugore wumwirabura wa…", cyangwa " Iyi filime yibanze kuri Diouana, umukobwa ukiri muto wo muri Senegali, wimukiye i Dakar, muri Senegali yerekeza muri Antibes, mu Bufaransa gukorera umugabo n'umugore b'Abafaransa. Mu Bufaransa, Diouana yizeye gukomeza akazi yakoraga nk'umubyaza, kandi ateganya ubuzima bushya bw'isi. Ariko, ageze muri Antibes, Diouana ahura n’umugabo n'umugore, bamuhatira gukora nk'umukozi. "Cairo Station, cyangwa THE IRON GATE" (Arabic "Bāb al-Ḥadīd"), ni filime y’akinwe muri 1958 ikinirwa mu Misiri iyobowe na Youssef Chahine. Iyi filimi yinjiye mu marushanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 8 rya Berlin. Iyi filime yatoranijwe mu Misiri nka filimi nziza y’ururimi rw’amahanga mu irushanwa rya 31 bya Osama. Kuva mu myaka ya za 70, iyi filimi yongeye gushimisha n'ibisekuru bishya by'abakunzi ba filimi mpuzamahanga. Insanganyamatsiko zerekanwa muri filimi zirimo itsinda ry’abakozi bo mu mijyi, ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, no gukandamiza igitsina gore.
Ubusobanuro bw'amateka.
Cairo Station yatangiye bwa mbere mu 1958. Hamwe n'ihirikwa ry'ubwami bwa Misiri muri 1952, ubushobozi bwa Youssef Chahine bwo gukemura insanganya z'abakozi bo mu mijyi, ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina no gukandamiza igitsina gore byari ngombwa kubigaragaza kuko byerekanaga ubuyobozi bubi. ubwo ubushobozi yari afite bwamwereraga gusunika imbibi za Sinema yo muri Misiri, ikintu ubusanzwe batashoboraga gukora kuko inganda za filimi zashyizwe mugihugu muri 1966. Mu guhimba filimi umuhanzi Chahine yagerageje kwerekana neza umuryango wa Misiri nkuko byari bimeze mu myaka ya za 1950 kandi abikora abiha Abanyamisiri ndetse n’amahanga kugira ngo basobanukirwe neza imibereho ya Misiri uko yari imeze.

I Am Not a Witch ni filime yikinamico yakozwe mu 2017 ku rwego mpuzamahanga yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Rungano Nyoni muri filime ye ya mbere. Yerekanwe mu gice cy’abayobozi ba Fortnight mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2017 kandi yegukana igihembo cya BAFTA kubera igihembo cyambere cyatanzwe n’umwanditsi w’Umwongereza, Umuyobozi cyangwa Producer wa Nyoni hamwe na producer Emily Morgan mu bihembo bya 71 bya Filime by’Abongereza. Yatoranijwe muri Filime Nziza Y’ururimi rw’amahanga mu bihembo bya 91 bya Academy, ariko ntabwo yatowe.
Umwanditsi-umuyobozi Rungano Nyoni yakuye igitekerezo mu nkuru zifatika zo gushinja abarozi muri Zambiya. Mu bushakashatsi yakoze kuri iyo filimi, yagiye muri Gana kandi amara igihe mu nkambi y’abapfumu, yitegereza ubuzima bwabo bwa buri munsi n'imigenzo yabo.
I am not a witch yakusanyije intsinzi nyinshi hamwe naba nomination mubirori byinshi byingenzi bya firime nibihembo bya firime, harimo gutsindira ibihembo bya 71 bya British Academy Film Awards ibihembo byambere byatanzwe n'umwanditsi wumwongereza, Diregiteri cyangwa Producer hamwe nabatoranijwe 10 nabatsinze batatu muri Independent yu Bwongereza Ibihembo bya Filime 2017. Yatsindiye igihembo cya Feature Fiction mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Adelayide 2017.

District 9 ni filime y'ibikorwa bya siyanse yo mu 2009. iyobowe na Neill Blomkamp mu mashusho ye ya mbere yakinnye, yanditswe na Blomkamp na Terri Tatchell, ikorwa na Peter Jackson na Carolynne Cunningham. Ni filimi yafatiwe amashusho muri Nouvelle-Zélande, Amerika na Afurika y’Epfo. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Sharlto Copley, Jason Cope, na David James, kandi yakuwe muri filime ngufi ya Blomkamp yo mu 2006 "Alive i Joburg".

Waiting for Happiness (cyangwa: Heremakono) ni filime y'ikinamico yo muri Mauritania yakozwe muri 2002 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Abderrahmane Sissako. abakinnyi nyamukuru ni umunyeshuri, wagarutse iwabo i Nouadhibou, umutoza w’umwana, hamwe n’abagore baho. Iyi filime irangwa nuruhererekane rwerekana ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw'abantu bavugwa mu mico yabo yihariye y’umuco nyafurika n’abarabu, mu gihe hari ibyo bakura muri tropes yigihe cya Tayeb Saleh cyo kwimukira mu majyaruguru (موسم الهجرة إلى الشمال). Abareba bagomba kwisobanurira ibyabaye nta ruhare runini rw'abavuga cyangwa umugambi, ibyinshi bikaba bigarukwaho mubindi bikorwa muri opus ya Abderrahmane Sissako, harimo amashusho kuri saro yogosha hamwe nicyumba cyamafoto, nacyo kiboneka muri "La Vie Sur Terre". Iyi filime irerekana ibihe bisanzwe bya Mauritania byubwiza, urugamba, kwitandukanya, no gusetsa, bibaho mumatsinda atandukanijwe muburyo butandukanye, nkabagore ba Bidhan banywa icyayi no gusebanya, abimukira bo muri Afrika yuburengerazuba banyura muri Mauritania kugirango bagere i Burayi. Umusore w'intwari wagarutse akorana naya matsinda yose nk'umuntu wo hanze, mugihe arwana no kwibuka ndetse nimvugo ye y'icyarabu ya Hassaniya, ariko ahitamo ahubwo igifaransa.. Waiting for Happiness yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2002 mu gice cya Un Certain Regard.

The Battle of Algiers ni filimi yakinwe n'abataliyani bafatanyije n'abanyalijeliya yakinwe muri 1966 ivuga kumateka yanditswe na iyoborwa Gillo Pontecorvo na Star Jean Martin na Saadi Yacef. Ishingiye ku bikorwa byakozwe n’inyeshyamba mu gihe cy’intambara ya Alijeriya (1954–1962) kurwanya leta y’Ubufaransa muri Afurika y’Amajyaruguru, icyagaragaye cyane ni Intambara izwi ku izina rya Algiers, umurwa mukuru wa Alijeriya. Yafatiwe amashusho ahantu hateguwe na Roberto Rossellinimu buryo bwa newsreel style: umwirabura n'umuzungu hamwe no guhindura ubwoko bwa documentaire kugirango hongerwe kumyumvire yukuri kwamateka, hamwe nabakinnyi badafite umwuga babayeho kurugamba nyarwo. Amanota ya film yahimbwe na Ennio Morricone. Bikunze guhuzwa na cinema yo mubutaliyani.
Iyi filime yibanze cyane cyane ku barwanyi b'impinduramatwara Ali La Pointe mu myaka iri hagati ya 1954 na 1957, igihe abarwanyi b'inyeshyamba za FLN bishyira hamwe bakaguka i Casbah, umurwa mukuru wa Alijeriya. Ibikorwa byabo byahuye nabaparakomando b'Abafaransa bagerageza kugarura akarere kari karafashwe. Filime cyane ivuga kubyerekeye imitwe yitwara gisirikari hamwe nuburyo butemewe, nkiyicarubozo, byakoreshwaga nimbaraga zabakoloni. Alijeriya yashoboye kubona ubwigenge bw'Abafaransa.
Filime yarashimiwe cyane. Imitwe yombi y'inyeshyamba hamwe n'abayobozi ba leta basanze ari ibisobanuro by'ingenzi ku ntambara yo mu mujyi. Ifite umwanya wa 48 kuri "Filime 250 za Critics "' "Amajwi ya Sight &amp;amp; Sound" 2012, ndetse n’umwanya wa 120 ku "rutonde rw’ikinyamakuru Empire" ku rutonde rwa "Filime 500 zikomeye mu bihe byose". Yatoranijwe kugirango yinjire kurutonde rwa " Filime 100 zo mu Butaliyani zigomba gukizwa ". Ikibazo kijyanye na sociopolitiki, film ntabwo imaze imyaka itanu yerekanwe mubufaransa 1971.

The Season of Men ni filime y'ikinamico yo mu 2000 y’Abafaransa-Tuniziya iyobowe na Moufida Tlatli. Yerekanwe mu gice cya Un Certain Regard mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2000. Umutwe wa filime, Igihe cy'abagabo, werekeza ukwezi kumwe kwumwaka abagabo baza ku kirwa cya Djerba.
Umusore w'imyaka 18 ku kirwa cya Djerba, Aïcha, yashakanye na Said, ukora muri Tuniziya igihe kinini cy'umwaka. Mbere yuko ashobora kubana na we muri Tuniziya, Said amusaba ko yamuha umuhungu. Ku kirwa cya Djerba, Aïcha abaho ategekwa na nyirabukwe, hamwe n'abandi bagore bake, mu gihe abagabo babo bakorera ahandi. Aïcha yaje kubyara umuhungu kandi yemerewe kwimukira muri Tuniziya hamwe n'umugabo we. Ariko, umuhungu we Aziz afite ibibazo by'ubuzima, bigatuma Saïd amwanga. Aïcha asubira i Djerba, kuri iyi nshuro ari kumwe n'umuhungu we Aziz n'abakobwa be babiri bakuru. Iyi filime ikoresha ibintu byinshi byagaragaye hagati ya Aïcha n’abakobwa be bato batuye i Djerba mbere y’ivuka rya Aziz hanyuma igaragara muri iki gihe, aho Aziz afite imyaka umunani, mbere yuko asubira i Djerba. Filime irangira Aïcha na Aziz bakorana bombi bakora imyenda, bakora kaseti Aïcha agurisha. Filime irangira umukobwa muto wa Aïcha Emna agenda, Aïcha na Aziz babana i Djerba.

Yeelen (Bambara kuri "umucyo" / "urumuri") ni film yo muri Mali yakinwe muri 1987 iyobowe na Souleymane Cissé. Ifata amashusho mu ndimi za Bambara na Fula, kandi ishingiye ku mugani wabwiwe n'abaturage ba Bambara. Nubwo ibihe bitarasobanurwa neza, birashoboka ko byashyizweho mu kinyejana cya 13 mu bwami bwa Mali, kandi ni inkuru yo gushakisha ubutwari irimo ubumaji no kuvumbura.
Irimo Issiaka Kane nka Nianankoro, umusore wumunyafurika ufite imbaraga zubumaji. Niamanto Sanogo akina nka se wa Niankoro, ukurikirana umuhungu we binyuze mu bihugu bya Bambara, Fulani na Dogon byo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba akoresheje inkingi y'ibiti by'amayobera kugira ngo amuyobore.
"Yeelen" yahuye nitsinzi ikomeye, ahabwa igihembo cyabacamanza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1987. Yatowe kandi igihembo cya Golden Palm umwaka umwe. Yatowe muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga muri Film Independent Spirit Awards. Umuhango ngarukamwaka wa 4 wo gutanga ibihembo byumwuka wakiriwe na Buck Henry - igitaramo cyuzuye (1989) | Filime Yigenga kuri YouTube
Ni mwanya # 94 mu "Nganji" kinyamakuru "The 100 Best Films w'isi Cinema" mu 2010.

Chronicle of the Years of Fire (Arabic ; French ; aya mazina yombi asobanura "Chronicle of the Year of Embers ") ni filime yamateka yikinamico yo muri Alijeriya yakinwe muri 1975 iyobowe na Mohammed Lakhdar-Hamina. Irerekana Intambara yo kwigenga ya Alijeriya nkuko bigaragara mumaso y'umuhanzi.
Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya "Palme d'Or" mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1975. Yatoranijwe kandi nk'iyinjira muri Alijeriya muri Filime Nziza y'indimi z'amahanga mu bihembo bya 48 bya Academy, ariko ntiyakirwa nk'umukandida.

Yaaba ni filime y’ikinamico ya Burkinabé yo mu 1989 yanditswe, yakozwe, kandi iyobowe na Idrissa Ouedraogo, "imwe muri filime zizwi cyane zo muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara". Yatsindiye igihembo cya Sakura Gold mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Tokyo mu 1989. Iyi filime yatoranijwe muri Burkinabé muri Filime Nziza Y’ururimi rw’amahanga mu bihembo bya 62 bya Academy, ariko ntiyemerwa nk'umukandida. Iyi filime "yavuzweho na documentaire ngufi Parlons Grand-mère", yafashwe igihe yatunganyirizwaga na Djibril Diop Mambéty.
Mu mudugudu wa Mossi muri Burkinafaso, Bila (Noufou Ouédraogo), umuhungu w'imyaka icumi, agirana ubucuti n'umukecuru witwa Sana (Fatimata Sanga), washinjwaga kuroga n'umudugudu we. Gusa Bila "aramwubaha", akamwita yaaba (Nyirakuru).
Igihe mubyara wa Bila, Nopoko (Roukietou Barry), arwaye, umugabo w’umuganga ashimangira ko Sana yibye roho y’umukobwa. Sana akora urugendo rurerure kandi rutoroshye ariko amaherezo aratsinda kugirango abone imiti irokora ubuzima bwa Nopoko, ariko aracyafatwa nk'umurozi.Sana amaze gupfa, impamvu nyayo ituma yangwa mu mudugudu iragaragara, ariko urukundo n'ubwenge yashoye muri Bila na Nopoko birakomeza.

Of Good Report ni filime y’urukundo yo muri Afurika y'epfo yakinwe 2013, iyobowe na Jahmil XT Qubeka. Filime yari ifite Mothusi Magano na Petronella Tshuma mu nshingano zabo. Mu bihembo bya 10 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards, yari bifite ibihembo byinshi, kandi yegukana igihembo cya Afurika Movie Academy Academy cya Filime Nziza. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto 2013.
Muri Nyakanga 2013, mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya 34 rya Durban, filime yatoranijwe mbere yo gufungura iri serukiramuco yatangaje ko yabujijwe na Fondasiyo y’igihugu ya Filime na Video kubera ko irimo "porunogarafiya y’abana", iki cyemezo cyaje gukurwaho nyuma y’ubujurire n'abatunganya firime.
Filime ivuga amateka y'umubano w'urukundo rudakwiye hagati y'umwarimu w'ishuri ryisumbuye numwe m'ubanyeshuri be b'abakobwa.

Beauty ni filime yo muri Afurika yepfo ya 2011 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Oliver Hermanus. Yerekanwe bwa mbere mu gice cya Un Certain Regard mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2011. Iyi filime yatoranijwe nk'iyinjira muri Afurika y'Epfo muri Filime nziza y'ururimi rw'amahanga mu bihembo bya 84 bya Osama, ariko ntabwo yakoze urutonde rwa nyuma
Filime yakiriwe neza n'abayireba. Isubiramo ryegeranya Rotten Tomatoes ivuga ko 83% by'abanegura umwuga bahaye filime isuzuma ryiza, naho impuzandengo ya 6.8 kuri 10. Abenshi mu banegura bashimye imikorere ya Deon Lotz, Peter Bradshaw wo muri " "The Guardian" 'yise "Igikorwa gikomeye, ariko cyihishe kandi kitoroshye". David Parkinson wo mu kinyamakuru Empire Magazine na we yashimye Lotz, kandi mu nyenyeri eshatu kuri eshanu zasuzumye incamake y'urubanza rwe agira ati: "Nubwo iri zina, hari imbaraga mbi kuri ubu bushakashatsi bwo gutwarwa n'uburakari."
"Ubwiza" bwahawe igihembo cya Queer Palm mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2011. Umukinnyi Deon Lotz yakiriwe bidasanzwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Zurich 2011 kubera ibikorwa bye muri iyi filime.

Wedding Party ni filimi yo muri Nigeriya yakinwe muri 2016 iyoborwa Kemi Adetiba. Yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 8 Nzeri 2016 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto muri Kanada no ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 2016 muri Eko Hotel na Suites i Lagos. Iyi filime yasohotse ku isi yose ku ya 16 Ukuboza 2016, iba filime yinjije amafaranga menshi muri Nijeriya; agahigo kaciwe muri 2017 nurukurikirane rwayo "Ubukwe".
Filime yakozwe na ELFIKE Film Collective. yayobowe na Kemi Adetiba. ELFIKE Film Collective ni ubufatanye bwamazu ane akomeye atunganyiriza filimi muri Nijeriya: EbonyLife Films, FilmOne Distribution, Inkblot Productions na Koga studios.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere i Toronto ku ya 8 Nzeri 2016 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto (TIFF). Muri Kanama 2017, filime yashyizwe ahagaragara kuri Netflix.

Kaddu Beykat (Letter from My Village cyagwa "Lettre paysanne") ni filime yo muri Senegal yo mu 1975 iyobowe na Safi Faye. Niyo filime ya mbere yerekanwe yakozwe n’umugore wo muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara yatanzwe mu bucuruzi kandi izana amahanga ku muyobozi wayo. Ishingiye ku rukundo, ivuga ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw'abantu bo mucyaro cya Senegal.
Ngor ni umusore uba mu mudugudu wa Senegali wifuza kurongora Coumba. amapfa yo mu mudugudu afite ingaruka kubihingwa, nuko Ngor ntashobore kubona inkwano ya Columba. Yagiye mu murwa mukuru wa Senegali, Dakar, kugira ngo agerageze gushaka amafaranga menshi. Agaruka ku baturage maze abwira abandi ibyamubayeho mu mujyi. Iyi nkuru yerekana ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw'abaturage, ivuga uburyo bw'ibaruwa yandikiye inshuti ye, izwi nka Faye.

The Nightingale's Prayer ni film yo mu misiri yakozwe muri 1959 iyoborwa na Henry Barakat kandi ishingiye kuri novel y'umwanditsi ukomeye Taha Hussein. Irimo Faten Hamama na Ahmed Mazhar.
Mu 1996, mugihe k'imyaka 100 ya Sinema yo muri Egiputa, iyi film yatoranijwe murimwe mu mafilime 150 meza yo muri Egiputa. Yakiriye igihembo cyishimiwe n’ishuri rikuru ry’imashusho y’ubuhanzi n’ubumenyi kandi yatoranijwe muri Filime nziza y’ururimi rw’amahanga mu bihembo bya 32 bya Academy, ariko ntiyemerwa nk'umukandida. Yinjiye kandi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 10 rya Berlin.
Mu 2020, Peter Bradshaw wo mu "kinyamakuru The Guardian" "Isengesho rya Nightingale" nka filime ya 19 ikomeye muri Afurika yabayeho mu bihe byose, ayita " melodrama yo kwihorera bidasanzwe, cyangwa Umugani w'ubwiza-na-nyamaswa."

Ko te Times Amashuri Makuru (THE), i mua ko te Times Amashuri Makuru Yongeyeho (THES), we moheni Ingarangi e whakaatu ana i nga korero me nga gufata e pa ana ki te maatauranga teitei.
TPG Capital yaguze uburezi bwa TSL muri Charterhouse mu masezerano miliyoni 400 zama pound muri Nyakanga 2013 maze ihindura TSL Education, muri yo Amashuri Makuru ayigiramo uruhare, nka TES Global. Kugura kwa TPG byagaragaje impinduka ya gatatu nyir'ubwite mu gihe kitarenze imyaka icumi ya Times Higher Education, yari isanzwe ifitwe na News International mbere yo kugurwa na Exponent Private Equity mu 2005.
Muri Werurwe 2019, itsinda ryigenga ryigenga Inflexion Pvt. Equity Partners LLP yaguze Times Amashuri Makuru muri TPG Capital, ibaye ba nyirayo ba kane mumyaka 15. Nyuma yo kugurwa nitsinda ryigenga ryigenga, Times Higher Education yakozwe nkikigo cyigenga kuva TES Global. Ishoramari ryakozwe na Inflexion yihariye yo kugura isoko ryo hagati.
Umujyanama wihariye wo kugura na Inflexion ni Houlihan Lokey, isosiyete ishora imari yafashije mbere amatsinda menshi y’abikorera ku giti cyabo kubona amashyirahamwe y’uburezi yunguka. Nyuma yo kugura, Houlihan Lokey yavuze ko itsinda ry’Amashuri Makuru risanzwe rizakora kugira ngo rihuze ibyifuzo by’ibicuruzwa n’ibicuruzwa, kandi harebwe no kugurisha abakiriya bahari.
Kuva ku nomero yacyo ya mbere, mu 1971, kugeza mu 2008, The Times Higher Education Supplement (THES) yasohotse mu buryo bw'ikinyamakuru kandi yavutse, kandi ifatanya n'ikinyamakuru The Times. Ku ya 10 Mutarama 2008, yasubukuwe nk'ikinyamakuru. Yasohowe na TES Global, kugeza mu Kwakira 2005 yari igabana rya News International Rupert Murdoch. Ikinyamakuru cyateguwe na John Gill. Phil Baty ni umwanditsi mukuru, kandi ashinzwe gukwirakwiza mpuzamahanga. Ni n'umwanditsi w'ikinyamakuru World University Rankings.
Iki kinyamakuru kirimo inkingi mpimbano yanditswe na Laurie Taylor, "Poppletonian", igaragaza ubuzima muri kaminuza ya Poppleton.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, Times Higher Education yahawe igihembo cyiswe "Ikinyamakuru cy’ubucuruzi cy’icyumweru" na "Media Business Brand of the Year" n’ishyirahamwe ry’abanditsi babigize umwuga.
Muri 2019, byavuzwe cyane ko Elsevier usanzwe akorana na THE mu rwego rwo gukusanya urutonde rwabo muri kaminuza, yateganyaga kwigarurira Times Higher Education burundu.
Muri Kanama 2020, Times Higher Education yatangaje ubufatanye n’ikigo gishinzwe gushaka abakozi SI-UK hamwe n’umushinga w’amacumbi Casita, byerekana ko cyinjiye mu kwinjiza abanyeshuri mu mahanga no ku masoko y’imiturire y’abanyeshuri.
Ku ya 11 Nzeri 2020, Studyportals ikorera mu Buholandi yatangaje ko yagiranye amasezerano na Times Higher Education, izasura abanyeshuri basura urubuga rwa Times Higher Education berekeje ku rubuga rw’abanyeshuri ba Studyportals igihe cyose abanyeshuri bareba amasomo ayobowe na kaminuza THE THE iri mu Urutonde rwa Kaminuza Yisi.
Urutonde rwa kaminuza.
Ingingo nkuru: Ibihe Byisumbuye Amashuri Yisumbuye ya Kaminuza Yisi
Times Higher Education yamenyekanye cyane mugutangaza buri mwaka Times Higher Education - QS Urutonde rwa Kaminuza Yisi Yambere, yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Gushyingo 2004. Ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2009 Amashuri Makuru ya Times yatandukanije na Quacquarelli Symonds, icyo gihe umufatanyabikorwa mu gukora Urutonde, maze asinyana amasezerano na Thomson Reuters gutanga amakuru aho. Iki kinyamakuru cyashyizeho uburyo bushya bwo kugisha inama abasomyi bacyo n’inama y’ubuyobozi kandi ibisubizo byatangajwe buri mwaka guhera mu gatasi 2010 kugeza 2013, ubwo THE yasinyaga amasezerano mashya na Elsevier.
Kimwe nu rutonde rwa Kaminuza Yisi Yose, Times Higher Education nayo itangaza izindi nzego nyinshi:
Times Amashuri Makuru akora urukurikirane rw'inama, ihuriro hamwe ninama nyunguranabitekerezo umwaka wose. Iyobowe n’abanyamakuru b’ubwanditsi, ibyo birori bihuza abayobozi n’abayobozi ku isi baturutse mu masomo, guverinoma n’inganda kugira ngo bungurane ibitekerezo, baganire kandi bateze imbere ejo hazaza h’imiyoborere yo mu mashuri makuru, guhanga udushya n’ubushakashatsi.
Iki kinyamakuru gikoresha ibihembo bibiri buri mwaka, "Times Higher Education Awards" (cyatangijwe mu 2007) na "Times Higher Education Awards Asia" (cyatangijwe muri 2019). "Times Higher Education Leadership and Management Awards" (Thelmas) yatangiye kuva 2011 kugeza 2018. [citation ikenewe]. Kaminuza Yisumbuye Yisumbuye Yumwaka wa 2020 Abatsinze, batoranije kaminuza yuburezi mu Bwongereza ibihembo bya kaminuza yumwaka wa 2020.

Divine Carcasse (Umubiri w’Imana) ni filime y’amoko yo muri Bénine yo mu 1998 yayobowe n’umukinnyi wa filime w’Ababiligi Dominique Loreau.
Iyi filime ivanze n’ibihimbano n’amoko, iyi filime ikorewe ku modoka ya Peugeot yo mu 1955, mu ikubitiro yari ifitwe na Simon, umwarimu wa filozofiya w’abanyaburayi baba mu mahanga, iyi modoka iza kuba iy'uwitwa Joseph, uyikoresha nka tagisi kugeza igihe izatereranwa mu mahugurwa y’umukanishi. Ngaho harasakaye kubice byakoreshejwe numuhanzi Simonet Biokou mugukora igishusho cy'intama y'Imana Agbo. Imodoka yafashwe hagati yibyara nibicuruzwa nyuma yubukoloni. iyi filimi ikaba yarashyizwe kurutonde rwa filimi 20 nziza zakorewe muri Africa mu gihugu cy'ubwongereza

Mandabi (Igifaransa: Le Mandat, "The Money Order") ni filime yo mu 1968 yanditswe kandi iyobowe n'umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Senegali Ousmane Sembène. Iyi filime ishingiye ku gitabo cya Sembène cyitwa "The Money-Order" kandi ni filime ya mbere y’umuyobozi mu rurimi rwe kavukire rwa Wolof. Kubera ko benshi mu baturage ba Senegal batumva igifaransa, Sembène yashakaga guhanga sinema kubavuga Wolof. Iyi niyo filime ya mbere yuzuye ururimi nyafurika kuva muri Afrika y'uburengerazuba.
Umuyisilamu wo muri Senegal udafite akazi, Ibrahima Dieng, abana n'abagore be babiri n'abana barindwi i Dakar. Mwishywa we, Abdou, yohereje we kugira amafaranga kuva Paris agaciro 25.000 y'amanyarwanda, akaba yarakijjwe no gukubura mu muhanda. Ibrahima akabika amafaranga ye wenyine, akazigamira mwishywa we, agaha mushiki we umugabane.
Nyuma yuko iyi filime itari imaze imyaka igera ku bantu bareba sinema, yasubiwemo mu mwanzuro wa 4K maze itangwa mu iserukiramuco rya Lumière rya 2019 ryabereye i Lyon mu Bufaransa. Muri Kamena 2021, iyi verisiyo yasubiwemo yerekanwe muri sinema mu Bwongereza.

The Land (Arabi) ni film yo mu misiri yakinwe muri 1969 iyoborwa Youssef Chahine, bishingiye kuri novel yakunzwe ya Abdel Rahman al-Sharqawi. Iyi filime ivuga amakimbirane hagati y'abahinzi na nyir'irsambu mu cyaro cya Egiputa mu myaka ya za 1930, ikanagaragaza isano iri hagati y'inyungu z'umuntu ku giti cye hamwe n'ibisubizo rusange ku gukandamizwa. Yinjiye mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1970.

Soleil Ô ( [sɔ.lɛj o] ; "Oh, Sun") ni filime yikinamico yo mu gifaransa-Mauritanian yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Med Hondo.
Filime "Soleil", yakozwe mu myaka ine n’ingengo y’imari iciriritse cyane, ivuga amateka y’umwimukira w'umwirabura winjiye i Paris ashakisha “abakurambere be ba Gaul”. Iyi manifeste ya firime iramagana ivangura: Abimukira bashaka cyane akazi n’aho baba, ariko ugasanga imbonankubone batitaweho, bakangwa, kandi bagasuzugurwa, mbere yo kumvira umuhamagaro wa nyuma wo kwigomeka.
Umutwe werekeza ku ndirimbo yo mu Burengerazuba bw'Ubuhinde ivuga ububabare bw'abirabura bo muri Dahomey (ubu ni Bénin) bajyanywe muri Karayibe nk'abacakara.
Muri 2017, "Soleil" given yahawe gusanwa na Cineteca di Bologna ayobowe na Med Hondo. Inkunga yaturutse mu muryango wa George Lucas Family Foundation n'Umushinga wa Sinema ku Isi, mu rwego rwo gusana aba nyuma bise umushinga ndangamurage w'Afurika.

Tsotsi ni film yanditswe na tuyoborwa Gavin Hood na Petero Fudakowski muri 2005 nibwo yasohotse. "Ni uguhuza" igitabo cyitwa Tsotsi, cyanditswe na Athol Fugard Afurika yepfo / Ubwongereza bukorana. muri Afurika y'Epfo, hagaragaramo Presley Chweneyagae nka David / Tsotsi ("izina rya Tsotsitaal" ryitwa "inkozi y'ibibi"), umusore wibye imodoka gusa abona umwana yicaye inyuma. Irimo kandi Terry Pheto, Kenneth Nkosi, Jerry Mofokeng, na Rapulana Seiphemo.
Amajwi y'iyi filime agaragaza umuziki wa Kwaito wakozwe n'umuhanzi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo Zola ndetse n'amanota ya Mark Kilian na Paul Hepker agaragaza ijwi ry'umuririmbyi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo wigaragambyaga akaba n'umusizi Vusi Mahlasela.
Iyi filime yakunzwe cyane, ishimwa cyane cyane iyandikwa, icyerekezo, ndetse n’imikorere, cyane cyane ibya Chweneyagae na Pheto, sinema n’uburemere bw’amarangamutima. Yakomeje gutsindira igihembo cya Akademiki cya 2006 muri Filime nziza y’ururimi rw’amahanga kandi itorwa muri Golden Globe muri Filime Nziza y’indimi z’amahanga, iba filime ya mbere yo muri Afurika yepfo ndetse na filime ya mbere nyafurika idakozwe mu gifaransa yatsindinze. Muri 2009, yasubiwemo kumugaragaro muri Tamil nka "Yogi".

Timbuktu ni filime y’ikinamico ya Mauritanian-Igifaransa yakozwe 2014 iyobowe kandi yanditswe na Abderrahmane Sissako. Iyi filime yibanze ku bikorwa bigufi bya Timbuktu, muri Mali na Ansar Dine, kandi bigira uruhare runini mu gutera amabuye rusange mu mwaka wa 2012 abashakanye batashyingiranywe muri Aguelhok. Yafatiwe amashusho muri Oualata, muri Mauritania, "Timbuktu" yatoranijwe guhatanira Palme d'or mu gice cy’amarushanwa akomeye mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2014, aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Ecumenical ndetse n’igihembo cya François Chalais. Yatoranijwe muri Mauritania ihatanira igihembo cya Akademiki ya Filime Nziza Y’amahanga, ikomeza gutorwa itwara igihembo mu bihembo bya 87 bya Academy. atorewe kandi igihembo cya BAFTA igihembo cya Filime Nziza itari mu Cyongereza mu bihembo bya 69 bya British Academy Film Awards. "Timbuktu" yahawe igihembo cya Filime nziza mu bihembo bya 11 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards, aho yatorewe ibindi bihembo icumi. Muri 2017, "Ikinyamakuru New York Times" cyayishyize ku rutonde rwa filime ya cumi na kabiri nziza yo mu kinyejana cya makumyabiri na rimwe.

Queen Sono ni ikinamico yo muri Afurika yepfo yerekanwa kuri televiziyo yakozwe na Kagiso Lediga yerekanwe kuri Netflix ku ya 28 Gashyantare 2020. Uru rukurikirane rukinamo Pearl Thusi, Vuyo Dabula, Sechaba Morojele, Chi Mhende, Loyiso Madinga, Rob Van Vuuren, Kate Liquorish, Khathu Ramabulana, Enhle Maphumulo, Abigail Kubeka, Connie Chiume, Otto Nobela na James Ngcobo na Featuring Mario Diederiks. Nibikorwa bya mbere bya Netflix.
imaze kurekurwa, yakiriwe neza n'abayireba, bashimye icyerekezo, sinema, uko ibikorwa byakurikiranye ndetse n'ibitaramo, cyane cyane Soi, Dabula na Kubeka, maze bavuga ko ari "igihe cyiza." Ku ya 28 Mata 2020, Netflix yavuguruye urukurikirane rwa season ya kabiri. Icyakora, ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 2020, byavuzwe ko Netflix yahagaritse uruhererekane kubera ibibazo by’umusaruro byazanywe n'icyorezo cya COVID-19.
"Queen Sono" akurikira inkuru y’umukozi w’ibanga wo muri Afurika yepfo wihishe ukemura ibibazo by’ubugizi bwa nabi mu gihe akemura ibibazo mu buzima bwe bwite.

Queen of Katwe film y'amateka yakiniwe muri Amerika iyoborwa na Mira Nair yanditswe na William Wheeler. Iyi filime yakinnye na David Oyelowo, Lupita Nyong'o, na Madina Nalwanga, iyi filime igaragaza ubuzima bwa Phiona Mutesi, umukobwa utuye i Katwe, agace ka Kampala, umurwa mukuru wa Uganda. Yize gukina chess ahinduka Umukandida w'umugore nyuma yo gutsinda muri World Chess Olympiads.
Iyi filime yakuwe mu kiganiro n'ikinyamakuru cya ESPN n'igitabo cyanditswe na Tim Crothers, iyi filime yakozwe na Walt Disney Pictures na Filime ya ESPN. The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind ni filime yikinamico yo mu Bwongereza yo mu 2019 yanditswe, iyoborwa na Chiwetel Ejiofor. Filime ishingiye kuri memoire y'izina na William Kamkwamba na Bryan Mealer. Yerekanwe mu gice cya Premieres mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance 2019 kandi itangira kunyura kuri Netflix ku ya 1 Werurwe 2019. Virunga ni filime documentaire yo mu Bwongereza yakinwe muri 2014 iyobowe na Orlando von Einsiedel. Yibanze ku bikorwa byo kubungabunga abashinzwe parike muri pariki ya Virunga ya Kongo mu gihe havutse imyigaragambyo ikaze ya M23 mu mwaka wa 2012, kandi ikora iperereza ku bikorwa by’isosiyete ikora peteroli yo mu Bwongereza Soco International mu murage ndangamurage wa UNESCO. Soco International yarangije gushakisha peteroli muri Virunga muri Mata 2014. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tribeca ku ya 17 Mata 2014. Nyuma yo gutambuka kuri Netflix, yatorewe igihembo cya Akademiki ya Best Documentary Feature.
"Virunga" yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi harimo na Peabody Award. Feature documentaire Award ku DOXA documentaire Festival mu Vancouver, Canada; igihembo cy'umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wavutse muri Hot Docs i Toronto; Igihembo cya Zahabu ya Rock mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime Ntoya; n'Ibikorwa no Guhinduka Hamwe (ACT Now) Igihembo cya Crested Butte Film Festival. Yatsindiye gongs ebyiri muri One World Media Awards muri BAFTA - Inyandiko nziza. Iyi filime kandi yatorewe igihembo cyiza cya Documentaire nziza muri Tribeca Film Festival. Filime yatorewe igihembo cya Akademiki kubera ibihembo bya Documentaire Nziza ya 87 ya Osama Awards.

Beats of No Nation ni film yo muri Amerika yanditswe, itunganywa,ifatwa amashusho, no iyoborwa na Cary Joji Fukunaga. Bikurikira umuhungu muto wabaye umusirikare mugihe igihugu cye cyari gifite intambara iteye ubwoba. Iyi filime yakorewe muri Gana ikinwamo na Idris Elba, Abraham Attah, Ama K. Abebrese, Grace Nortey, David Dontoh, na Opeyemi Fagbohungbe, iyi filime ishingiye ku gitabo cyo mu 2005 cyitwa izina rimwe na Uzodinma Iweala, igitabo ubwacyo cyiswe izina. nyuma ya alubumu ya Fela Kuti.
Yerekanwe mu gice cy’amarushanwa akomeye mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 72 rya Venice, aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Marcello Mastroianni. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu gice cyihariye cyo kwerekana iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Toronto mu mwaka wa 2015, ikanasohoka kuri Netflix ku isi yose ndetse no mu isohoka rito na Bleecker Street ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2015.

Òlòturé ni filime yo muri Nijeriya yo muri 2019 iyobowe na Kenneth Gyang uhereye ku mashusho ya Yinka Ogun na Craig Freimond. Irimo Sharon Ooja, Beverly Osu, Ada Ameh na Blossom Chukwujekwu.
"Òlòturé" avuga amateka ya Òlòturé (Sharon Ooja), umunyamakuru ukomoka mu gihugu cya Nijeriya ukiri muto kandi utagira ubwenge, ujya mu bwihisho kugira ngo ashyire ahagaragara icyaha cyo gucuruza abantu. bayteguriye i Lagos, yerekana uburyo abakora imibonano mpuzabitsina bashakirwa gukoreshwa mu mahanga.
Inyandiko ya "Òlòturé" igice gishingiye ku gutanga raporo y’umunyamakuru w’iperereza wo muri Nijeriya, Tobore Ovuorie. Gufata amashusho byatangiye ku mugaragaro ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 2018 ahitwa i Lagos, muri Nijeriya.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2019 mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage muri Tuniziya. Muri Nzeri 2020, Netflix yabonye uburenganzira bwo gukwirakwiza filime. Isakara ryatangiye ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2020. Nyuma yiminsi mike isohotse, "Òlòturé yagaragaye" muri firime 10 za mbere zirebwa kuri Netflix.

Cook Off ni filime yo gusetsa y'urukundo yo muri Zimbabwe yasohotse muri 2017 yanditswe kandi iyoborwa na Tomas Brickhill. film ikinamo Tendaiishe Chitima, Fungai Majaya na Tehn Diamond. Gutunganya iyi filime byahoraga byibasirwa no kunanirwa kw'amashanyarazi, imbogamizi z’ingengo y’imari, imyigaragambyo yo kurwanya leta n’imvururu zadutse mu cyiciro cya nyuma cya Perezidansi ya Robert Mugabe. Yabaye filime ya mbere yasohotse muri Zimbabwe nyuma ya Mugabe yamaze imyaka igera kuri 40. Iyi filime kandi yabaye filime ya mbere ya Zimbabwe yerekanwe kuri Netflix. Yitabiriwe n’itangazamakuru mpuzamahanga kuva yashyirwa ku rubuga rwa Netflix muri Kamena 2020. Ni filime ya kabiri ya Zimbabwe yitabiriwe n’amahanga nyuma ya "Neria". Iyi filime irashimwa nka imwe muri filime nziza kurusha izindi zose muri Sinema ya Zimbabwe nyuma ya "Neria" na yellow Card kandi yafunguwe ku buryo bwiza cyane bwatanzwe n'Abanyazimbabwe. Iyi filime izwiho gusenya imyumvire y’inganda za firime zo muri Zimbabwe zari zamugaye kubera ibibazo by’ubukungu ndetse na hyperinflation muri iki gihugu.
Iyo umubyeyi urera abana wenyine Anesu (Tendaiishe Chitima) yinjiye rwihishwa mu marushanwa yo guteka kuri tereviziyo n’umuhungu we, agomba gutsinda ibyo nyina atemera ndetse no guhangana n’abatetsi babigize umwuga.
Filime yakiriye ibihembo bike yanatoranijwe mubirori bya firime. Yatwaye ibihembo bine byose mu birori bya firime, harimo bibiri buri kimwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cambria 2020. na Zimbabwe International Film Festival. Iyi filime kandi yahawe ibihembo bibiri by’ubuhanzi byatanzwe n’inama y’ubuhanzi ya Zimbabwe muri 2019.
