The Gods must be Crazy ni film yo gusetsa yo mu mwaka 1980 yanditswe, inakozwe, Itunganywa kandi iyobowe na Jamie Uys. ubufatanyabikorwa mpuzamahanga muri Afurika y’Epfo na Botswana, ni film yambere muri The Gods must be Crazy series.
Iyi filime yashyizwe muri Afurika y’Epfo, ikinamo umuhinzi wo muri Namibiya San Nǃxau ǂToma nka Xi, umuhigi-uhiga mu butayu bwa Kalahari umuryango we wavumbuye icupa ry'ikirahure ryamanutse mu ndege, kandi bizera ko ari impano yatanzwe n'imana zabo. Igihe Xi yiyemeje gusubiza icupa ku mana, urugendo rwe ruba ruhujwe n’umuhanga mu binyabuzima (wakinnye nka Marius Weyers), Umwarimu w’ishuri ry’umudugudu mushya (Sandra Prinsloo), hamwe n’itsinda ry’iterabwoba.
"The Gods must be Crazy" yarekuwe na Ster-Kinekor muri Afurika y’Epfo, aho yakoze amateka yinjiza amafaranga menshi, ikaba yarasohoye amafaranga menshi mumateka yinganda za firime za Afurika y’Epfo. Iyi filime yagenze neza mu bucuruzi no mu bindi bihugu, harimo na Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika, aho yatanzwe na 20 Century Fox, aho ibiganiro by’umwimerere bya Afrikaans yashyizwe mu cyongereza. Nubwo byagenze neza, iyi filime yakunze kunengwa kwerekana ubwoko kandi bigaragara ko atazi ivangura muri Afurika yepfo. Film yakurikiwe ni ikindi gice "The Gods must be Crazy" part II yashyizwe ahagaragara Columbia Pictures mu 1989.
"The Gods Must Be Crazy yafatiwe amashusho" i Tsumkwe, muri Namibiya, ndetse no muri Botswana. Nk’uko Uys abitangaza ngo N! Xau yasubizwaga mu rugo rwe mu butayu bwa Kalahari buri byumweru bitatu cyangwa bine kugira ngo atababazwa n’umuco. Mu gihe mu mijyi, N! Xau yize kunywa inzoga n'itabi. Uys yavuze ko yishyuye N! Xau $ 300 mu minsi 10 ya mbere yakoraga, ariko ko amafaranga bivugwa ko yatwawe n'umuyaga. N! Xau yahise yishyurwa n'inka 12. Mu 1985, Uys yavuze ko yohereje N! Xau $ 100 buri kwezi kuva yafata amashusho, N! Xau yakoresheje mu iduka ry’ubucuruzi ku bilometero 60 uvuye aho yahigaga; Uys yavuze kandi ko hashyizweho konti y’amadolari 20.000 y’izina rya N! Xau.
"The Gods Must Be Crazy" yakunze kunengwa kubera ko bigaragara ko ikomeje imyumvire ishingiye ku moko n'ivangura n'ivangura muri Afurika y'Epfo. Muri Amerika, ngo iyi filime yatowe n’inama y’igihugu y’abavoka b’abirabura n’indi mitwe irwanya ivanguramoko ubwo yerekanaga mu nzu ya Street ya 68 mu mujyi wa New York.

From a Whisper ni firime yikinamico yo muri Kenya yanditswe kandi iyobowe Wanuri Kahiu. Iyi filime yakiriye nomination 12 kandi yatsindiye ibihembo 5 muri African Movie Academy Awards muri 2009, harimo "Ishusho" Nziza, "Amajwi Yumwimerere" ", Umuyobozi" mwiza, "Amashusho yumwimerere meza" na "AMAA Achievement muguhindura". Iyi filime kandi yatsindiye igihembo "cyiza cyo kwerekana inkuru nziza" mu iserukiramuco rya Pan African Film &amp;amp; Arts 2010, kandi ihabwa igihembo cya BAFTA / LA "Festival Choice" Award 2010. Nubwo iyi filime yibuka isabukuru yimyaka 10 ry’iterabwoba ryabaye ku ya 7 Kanama muri Kenya mu 1998, ntabwo ivuga ku gisasu cy’iterabwoba. Iyi filime yerekana inkuru ifatika y’inyuma y’icyo gisasu, ifata ubuzima bw’abahohotewe n’imiryango yabo bagombaga gutora ibice by’ubuzima bwabo byangijwe n’icyo gisasu.

Hyenas (French) ni filime yo muri Senegali yo mu 1992 yahinduwe na Friedrich Dürrenmatt ikinamico ya comedy iturutse kuri "The Visit" (1956), iyobowe na Djibril Diop Mambéty. Inkuru yimbitse y'urukundo no kwihorera irasa no kunegura ubukoloni na mpatse ibihugu yabagaho muri Afrika. Yinjiye mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1992.
"Hyenas" (Hyenas) avuga amateka ya Linguere Ramatou, umukecuru ugeze mu za bukuru, ukize usuye umudugudu yavukiyemo wa Colobane. Linguere atanga igitekerezo kibangamiye abaturage ba Colobane kandi abaha ibintu byiza cyane kugirango abemeze. Uyu mugore warakaye, "w'umukire nka Banki yisi", azaha Colobane amahirwe yo kumwicira Dramaan Drameh, umucuruzi w’umudugudu waho wamutereranye nyuma y’urukundo no gutwita mu buryo butemewe n’imyaka cumi n'irindwi.

Sambizanga ni film yo mu 1972 yakozwe n'umuyobozi Sarah Maldoror. yashyizweho mu 1961 igihe Intambara y’Ubwigenge ya Angola yatangiraga, ikurikira urugamba rw’abarwanyi ba Angola bagize uruhare mu ishyaka rya rubanda riharanira kwibohora muri Angola (MPLA), umutwe wa politiki urwanya ubukoloni umugabo wa Maldoror, Mário Coelho Pinto de Andrade, yari umuyobozi. Iyi filime ishingiye ku gitabo cyitwa "A vida verdadeira de Domingos Xavier" ("Ubuzima nyabwo bwa Domingos Xavier") cyanditswe n'umwanditsi wa Angola, José Luandino Vieira.
Iyi filime yafatiwe ahantu muri Repubulika y’abaturage ya Kongo (izwi kandi nka Congo-Brazzaville) mu byumweru birindwi.
Benshi mu bakinnyi bari abadafite umwuga bagize uruhare mu bikorwa bimwe na bimwe byo muri Afurika birwanya ubukoloni, nka MPLA n’ishyaka nyafurika riharanira ubwigenge bwa Gineya na Cape Verde (PAIGC). Imiterere ya Domingos Xavier yakinwe n'umuny'Angola uba muri Kongo, Domingos Oliveira naho imico ya Maria yakinwe n’umuhanga mu bukungu Elisa Andrade ukomoka muri Cape Verde

Come Back, Africa ni filime yo mu 1959, filime ya kabiri ndende yanditswe, yakozwe, kandi iyobowe n'umukinnyi wa filime wigenga w’umunyamerika witwa Lionel Rogosin.
Iyi filime yagize impinduka zikomeye kuri sinema nyafurika, kandi iracyafite akamaro gakomeye mu mateka n’umuco nkinyandiko ibungabunga umurage w'imijyi yo muri Afurika y’Epfo muri 1950. Ishobora gushyirwa mubikorwa nka raporo, documentaire, firime yamateka cyangwa sinema ya politiki, kubera ko yerekana ibintu byabaye. Ku rundi ruhande, irerekana ubusobanuro bwibintu bifatika hamwe nigitekerezo gikomeye cyimyitwarire y'abantu nkivanguramoko.
Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Venice 1959. Rogosin yateye inkunga kandi ashyigikira ihunga rya Bloke Modisane muri Afurika y’Epfo ndetse n'igihe cye cy'inzibacyuho i Londres, aho yanditse igitabo cye Blame me on history. Rogosin muri icyo gihe yahaye ruswa abayobozi muri Afurika y'Epfo maze abasha gukura Miriam Makeba mu gihugu yanga kwishyura ingwate kugira ngo ashobore kumwereka filime mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Venice. Iyi filime hamwe no kuririmba kwa Makeba hamwe n’imisatsi ya "afro" byatumye abantu bumva ibintu kandi iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cyiswe "Italian Critics Award". Ntabwo byashobokaga kuvana abahanzi birabura muri Afrika yepfo icyo gihe, kandi ntibishoboka ko aba bahanzi bakora umwuga hanze yigihugu. Rogosin yasezeranye na Makeba mu masezerano, anamutera inkunga y'ingendo n'amafaranga yo kubaho mu Bwongereza no muri Amerika. Yashakishije kandi umukozi ushinzwe kwamamaza, anategura isura ye mu Mudugudu wa Vanguard mu mujyi wa New York ndetse no ku ncuro ya mbere kuri "The Steve Allen Show"

fundi-Mentals ni urwenya rwo muri Kenya rwo muri 2015 rwayobowe na Alexandros Konstantaras, nawe wari inyuma "y'inzu ya Lungula" yagaragayemo umucamanza Ian Mbugua, iyi comedi yamaze gutorwa muri Afurika Magic Viewer Choice Awards y'uyu mwaka mu bakinnyi beza muri comedi. Muri filime hagaragaramo Charlie Karumi, Gerald Langiri na Lizz Njagah.
Igitekerezo cya Fundi-mentals kizenguruka mubuzima bwa Fundis ebyiri (intoki), Joseph (Gerald Langiri) numufasha we Moses (Charlie Karumi) bakunda kwibwira ko ari Fundis nziza mumitungo ya Kinoo nubwo uburyo bwabo budasanzwe bwo gutunganya ibintu. Ariko iyinjira rya sosiyete nshya ya Multinational Service Company mumujyi itera ibi byose mukaga. Kugira ngo birinde gusohoka mu bucuruzi, bamenyesha abakiriya babo b'abakobwa ubwoko bushya bwa serivisi ya Ex-press hamwe n'ingaruka zishimishije.
Kurekura no kwakirwa.
"Fundi-Mentals" yarekuwe ku ya 12 Gashyantare 2015, i Nairobi. Yapimwe basanga igombwa kurebwa nabantu barengeje imyaka 18+ kandi mugihe cyo gusohora abayitabiriye bari bakuru gusa. Isubiramo kuri Kenya Buzz Wangechi Maina yaranditse ati: " "Witege ko uzabona Fundi-Mentals" bashize amanga babiganiraho [igitsina] muburyo uvuga ku mibonano mpuzabitsina na bagenzi bawe, nta kintu kibujijwe. Ibi bituma "Fundi-Mentals" bifitanye isano. "

Disconnect ni filime yo gusetsa yo muri Kenya yo muri 2018 iyobowe na David 'Tosh' Gitonga na Michael Jones. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo umukinnyi w'amafirime ukomoka muri Kenya Brenda Wairimu n'umukinnyi wa filime Nick Mutuma uyobora abakinnyi batandukanye bakora ubushakashatsi ku bijyanye no gukundana i Nairobi. Iyi filime izerekanwa kuri Netflix ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2020 izabe filime iheruka gukorerwa muri Kenya inyuze kuri Netflix, nyuma ya Poacher na Daisy Sincerely.
Iyi filime irazenguruka gukundana rwihishwa hagati yinshuti ebyiri nziza, Celine (yakinnye nka Brenda Wairimu) na Josh (Nick Mutuma), ninshuti zabo magara mumurwa mukuru wa Kenya. Celine afite ikibazo cyo kwinjira muburyo bukwiye, kandi akenshi yishingikiriza kumpanuro ninkunga yamarangamutima yinshuti ze zirimo TK (Catherine Kamau-Karanja) umusazi, Judy (Patricia Kihoro) umurwanyi wamasengesho, Robin (Pierra Makena) Mushiki wa Celine na Preeti (Aseem Sharma) mugenzi we bakorana. Inshuti magara ya Celine ni Josh, yakinnye na Nick Mutuma, nawe ufite itsinda ryinshuti z'abasore zimufasha kuyobora umubano we numukuniz we mu mujyi; igizwe na Otis (Pascal Tokodi) na Jennings (Arthur Sanya).

The First Grader ni filime yikinamico ya biografiya ya 2010 iyobowe na Justin Chadwick. Irimo Naomie Harris, Oliver Litondo, na Tony Kgoroge. Iyi filime ishingiye ku nkuru y'impamo ya Kimani Maruge, umuhinzi wo muri Kenya wiyandikishije mu mashuri abanza afite imyaka 84 nyuma yaho guverinoma ya Kenya yatangaje ko amashuri abanza ari buntu ku isi mu 2003.
Producer ukomoka muri Amerika witwa Sam Feuer yasanze inkuru kurupapuro rwambere rwa LA Times ahitamo We, hanyuma, ashaka umufatanyabikorwa Richard Harding, yafatanije na BBC Films maze aha akazi Ann Peacock kwandika amashusho. Filime yakozwe n’abongereza yafatiwe ahitwa Rift Valley muri Kenya, nubwo mbere byavuzwe ko izafatirwa muri Afrika yepfo. Umuyobozi Chadwick yagize ati: "Twashoboraga kuyirasa muri Afurika y'Epfo, ariko Kenya ifite izo mbaraga zidasanzwe, zidasobanutse zirangwa mu bana, ndetse n'abantu twakoraga film".

The Constant Gardener ni filim iri ituruka muri England and German yasohotse muri 2005 iyoborwa na Fernando Meirelles. Amashusho yakozwe na Jeffrey Caine ashingiye ku gitabo cya John le Carré cyo mu 2001 cyitwa The Constant Gardener. Iyi nkuru ikurikira Justin Quayle (Ralph Fiennes), umudipolomate w’Ubwongereza muri Kenya, ubwo yageragezaga gukemura ikibazo cy’iyicwa ry’umugore we Tessa (Rachel Weisz), uharanira Amnesty, asimburana n’ibintu byinshi byerekana amateka y’urukundo rwabo.
Iyi filime yafatiwe amashusho ahitwa Loiyangalani no mucyaro cya Kibera, igice cya Nairobi, muri Kenya. Ibintu muri kariya gace byagize ingaruka ku bakinnyi ndetse no ku bakozi ku buryo bashizeho Constant Gardener Trust kugira ngo batange uburezi bw'ibanze kuri iyo midugudu. Uyu mugambi washingiye ku buryo budasobanutse ku rubanza rwabayeho i Kano, muri Nijeriya. Impapuro za DVD zasohotse muri Amerika ku ya 1 Mutarama 2006 no mu Bwongereza ku ya 13 Werurwe 2006. Ubwitonzi bwa Justin ariko bwitondewe kubihingwa bye ninsanganyamatsiko yagarukaga, aho ishusho ya firime yakomotse. Hubert Koundé, Danny Huston, Bill Nighy, Pete Postlethwaite, na Donald Sumpter bakoranye. Iyi filime yagenze neza kandi yinjiza amafaranga menshi kandi yegukana ibihembo bine bya Oscar, yegukana umukinnyi wa filime witwaye neza muri Rachel Weisz.

18 Hours ni filime y'ikinamico yo muri Kenya 2017 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Njue Kevin ku mugaragaro bwa mbere. Abakinnyi barimo Nick Ndeda, Sue Wanjiru, Brian Ogola, Isaya Evans na Shirleen Wangari. Iyi filime "ikurikira inkeragutabara ya rookie irokoka amasaha 18 muri ambulance ubuzima bw'impanuka yo mu muhanda yangiwe kwinjira mu bitaro." Iyi filime, yakoze amateka nk’ifoto ya mbere yo muri Kenya yatowe muri filime nziza muri rusange muri Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards (AMVCA) yegukana ibindi 4 bahatanira ibihembo muri 2018.
Igitekerezo cya filime cyatangiye mu 2015 ubwo Njue Kevin, umwanditsi &amp; diregiteri, yasomaga inkuru ku kinyamakuru. Ni inkuru yahumetswe n'amakuba yabayeho, aho umugabo yavuye ambulance mumasaha 18 kuko ibitaro byigihugu bya Kenyatta(Kenyatta National Hospital) byavugaga ko bidafite uburiri bwa ICU(ICU bed). Nibwo twatangiye gukina hirya no hino twibwira ko iyi idashobora kuba filime ikomeye; twibwira ko ari filime yo kwishimisha ariko ikanakoreshwa mu guhindura imibereho. Producer, Phoebe Ruguru yahise yomekwa hanyuma iterambere ry'imyandikire ritangirana no kuvugana n'abaganga benshi n'abatekinisiye byihutirwa bari barinjiye rwose kandi bafite uruhare mu mushinga hose. Njue yabitangaje, kubw'ibyo twagombaga kuba abizerwa mu buvandimwe, nkuko Njue yabitangarije BBC Gahuzamiryango.
Igikorwa cyo gukina cyari cy'itabiriwe n'abantu kandi cy'itabiriwe n'abakinnyi ba Kenya nubwo umusaruro wakiriye ibyifuzo by'abakinnyi ku isi yose harimo bamwe bo muri LA, Hollywood, London, nu Budage. Ihamagarwa rya casting ryashyizwe k'umurongo kandi ryakiriye abasaba 1000 hanyuma 25 (makumyabiri na ba tanu)gusa binjira muri filime. Nyuma yo kwandika, Njue yahaye akazi umuhanzi w'inkuru maze akambika ibyumweru 4 mu nzu ye i Nairobi aho bakoze ibishushanyo n'amashusho kugira ngo basobanure inkuru.
18 Hours yafunguriwe mu nzu y'imikino muri Afrika y'Uburasirazuba ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2017 kuri premier yagurishijwe. Abanyamakuru benshi bishimiye itangizwa ryabo barimo umukinnyi ukomoka mu gihugu cya Kenya, David Rudisha, wagize uruhare mu gikorwa cyo kwamamaza kugira ngo baharanire ubutabazi bwihuse muri Kenya. Filime yakiriwe neza muri Kenya hamwe n'ibisobanuro byerekana ubutwari bwa Njue Kevin n'itsinda rye gukora filime 18 Hours

House of Lungula ni filime yo gusetsa yo muri Kenya yasohotse 2013 iyobowe na Alexandros Konstantaras. Yibanze ku mibonano mpuzabitsina y'Abanyakenya basanzwe. Ijambo "lungula" risobanura "igitsina" mu mvugo ya Kenya, Sheng. Muri filime hagaragaramo Gerald Langiri, Lizz Njagah na Ian Mbugua. Langiri akina ari umugabo ukora cyane ukeneye amafaranga kugirango yishyure inkwano y'umukunzi we, naho Njagah akina ari umugore wahisemo gukina umukino wa tit-tat-tat amenye ko umugabo we afite ihabara. Mbugua afitanye umubano wihishe nundi mukoba muto wakinnye yitwa Sara Hassan, akaba yikundira abagabo b'inararibonye bafite amafaranga. Filime yagenewe abarengeje imyaka 18+ nishyirahamwe ry'ubuyobozi bwa firime muri Kenya.
"House of Lungula" yagaragayemo ibikorwa byinshi bya muzika byari byakozwe n'abahanzi bo muri Kenya. Ni Sisi Band yakoze "(Give it all to me) Inzu ya Lungula", niyo yari amajwi nyamukuru ya firime. Muri iyi filime kandi hagaragayemo Chuom 32 hamwe na Doreen Nyawira akora "House of Lungula OST".".

I Want to Be a Pilot ni filimi ngufi yasohotse 2006 yegukanye igihembo gikomeye cyane cya Oscars muri 2006, ituruka muri Kenya - Mexique yanditswe inayoborwa na Diego Quemada-Diez. Iyi filime imaze kubona ibihembo mpuzamahanga birenga 50, harimo "igihembo cy’abateze amatwi" mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Los Angeles, kandi yitabiriye iserukiramuco rya firime risaga 200 nka Sundance, Locarno, Telluride, Edinburgh, Amiens, Los Angeles, São Paulo, Manhattan, Silverdocs, Bermuda, San Francisco.
Filime ivuga amateka y'umuhungu wibasiwe n'ubukene muri kamwe mu turere dukennye cyane two muri Kenya ureba mu kirere kandi arota kuba umupiloti w’indege.

Intellectual Scum ni film ngufi yo muri Kenya yasohotse 2015 iyobowe na Njue Kevin. Yakozwe na Rocque Pictures, iyi filime ni uguhuza ingingo itavugwaho rumwe 'Wowe Umunebwe (Umunyabwenge) wo muri Afurika!' yakozwe na Field Ruwe, umunyamerika ukora umwuga wo gutangaza amakuru muri Zambiya.
Mu ndege y'ubucuruzi, umunyabwenge w'umunyafurika (Field Ruwe), yicaye iruhande rw'umuzungu (Walter). Mu kiganiro cyabo, kikaba ari ubugome bukabije, inyangamugayo ndetse na bamwe mu bavangura amoko, Walter ashinja 'Abanyabwenge' kuba afurika iri aho iri ubu.
Amafoto yibanze kuri firime yatangiye ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2015 arangira ku ya 20 Ugushyingo 2015. Urukurikirane rw'indege kuri firime rwafatiwe,amashusho ku ndege nyirizina ku kibuga cy'indege cya Wilson bitandukanye no gukora sound stage.
Uyu muyobozi, Njue Kevin, kuri iki cyemezo yagize ati: "Twari gukoresha inshuro ebyiri ingengo y’imari itari ku kibuga cy’indege nyirizina. Iyo ku ngengo y'imari idahwitse, ugomba gukora ibyo ugomba gukora. "

Kibera Kid ni filime ngufi yashyizwe mu gace ka Kibera i Nairobi, Kenya. Yanditswe, iyobowe kandi ifatanya na Nathan Collett ku bufatanye n’abaturage ba Kibera. Iyi filime y'iminota cumi n'ibiri yagaragayemo abakinnyi ba filimi muri Kibera mubikorwa by'ingenzi. Yakinywe mu birori bya firime ku isi yose harimo iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Berlin kandi yatsindiye ukomoka muri Hollywood. Byanditswe na BBC, Reuters hamwe na Al Jazeera Icyongereza. Muri Mata 2009, hafashwe amashusho yerekana amashusho ya Kibera Kid. Filime ndende yuzuye yibanda ku makimbirane ashingiye ku moko ndetse no kwiyunga. Iyi filime yagize ingaruka nini kuko yatumye hashyirwaho Hot Sun Foundation itoza urubyiruko rwo mucyaro gukora firime zabo.
Kibera Kid ninkuru ya Otieno, impfubyi yimyaka 12 yo muri Kibera abana nitsinda ryabajura bagomba guhitamo ubuzima bw'agatsiko no gucungurwa. Inkuru ni ibihimbano ibintu byerekanwe ntabwo ari ukuri. Ubugizi bwa nabi n'ubukene birasanzwe muri Kibera, nyamara hari benshi bazaharanira ubuzima bwiza nubwo ibintu bimeze nabi.

The Letter ni filime documentaire ifite iminota 84 yo muri Kenya 2019 iyobowe na maia Lekow afatanyije na Christopher King. Yatoranijwe nkumunyakenya winjiye muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga Yamamaye muri 93 Awards Academy, ariko ntabwo yatowe.
Umusore yasuye umudugudu wa nyirakuru kugira ngo amenye ko yashinjwaga kuroga.

The Rescue ni film documentaire yasohotse 2021 iyobowe kandi ikorwa na Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi na Jimmy Chin. Bikurikiranye gutabara ubuvumo bwa Tham Luang, ubutumwa bwa 2018 bwakijije ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru mu buvumo bwamazi. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 48 rya Telluride ku ya 2 Nzeri 2021, ikaba yarasohotse mu ikinamico muri Amerika ku ya 8 Ukwakira 2021.
Filime ikurikira gutabara ubuvumo bwa Tham Luang.
Muri Werurwe 2019, byatangajwe ko Kevin Macdonald azayobora filime yerekanwe ku gutabara ubuvumo bwa Tham Luang, hamwe na National Geographic Documentary Films igiye gukorwa. Muri Gashyantare 2021, byatangajwe ko Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi na Jimmy Chin bazasimbura Macdonald nk'umuyobozi.
Abakinnyi ba firime bagize ikibazo cyo kubona uburenganzira ku nkuru, aho National Geographic yashoboye kubona uburenganzira ku nkuru zinyuranye, mu gihe Netflix yari yarabonye uburenganzira ku bunararibonye bw'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru, ibabuza kuvuga amateka yabo muri filime.
Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 48 rya Telluride ku ya 2 Nzeri 2021. Yerekanwe kandi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 2021 rya Toronto ku ya 12 Nzeri 2021, aho yatsindiye igihembo cy’abaturage cyo guhitamo inyandiko. Greenwich Entertainment izakwirakwiza film muri Amerika.
"The Rescue" yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Documentaire mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Midburg.

Pumzi ni film ngufi ya siyanse y'impimbano yo muri Kenya yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Wanuri Kahiu. Yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance 2010 mu rwego rwa gahunda yayo nshya ya Afurika. Uyu mushinga watewe inkunga n’ikigega cy’ubuhanzi cya Changamoto, ndetse n’ikigo cya Goethe Institut na Focus Features. Kahiu yizeye kwagura bigufi muburyo bwuzuye. Filime iri mucyongereza, ariko umutwe ni Igiswahili bisobanuye"Umwuka".
Pumzi igwa cyane mubwoko bwa Africanfuturism. Irerekana uko ejo hazaza hazaba umuco (uherereye kumugabane wa Afrika) utuwe cyane nabirabura. Byongeye kandi, yakozwe na sitidiyo yo muri Afrika yepfo igizwe nitsinda ryabashinzwe gukora no kumenyekanisha uburyo bushya bwibintu ndangamuco biva mubihugu bya Afrika. "Pumzi" ihuza neza na motif ikunze kuboneka muri Africanfuturism, ariko ntibigarukiraho gusa, kuba hari ahantu nyaburanga hatagira uruhare runini rw'amazi.

Poacher ni film ngufi ya Kenya / Ubwongereza yasohotse 2018 iyobowe na Tom Whitworth. Iyi filime yitabiriwe n'abantu benshi nyuma yo gusohoka muri Netflix muri Nzeri 2020. Yabaye kandi filime ya mbere yo muri Kenya yasohotse binyuze kuri Netflix.
Yakozwe mu buryo butangaje bwa firime, "Poacher" ivuga amateka y’umuhinzi wihebye uhura n’ibibazo nyuma yo kwiba igiti cy’amahembe y’inzovu mu gatsiko k’iterabwoba. Iyi filime irashaka kwerekana ikibazo gikomeye mpuzamahanga cy’ubucuruzi bw’inzovu mu buryo butemewe hifashishijwe ibibazo by’abaturage, inzovu ziri mu kaga muri Afurika.
"Poacher" yafashwe amashusho muminsi itandatu muri parike yigihugu ya Tsavo yuburengerazuba bwamajyepfo yumurwa mukuru wa Kenya, Nairobi. Umusaruro warimo abanyamuryango n'abakozi barenga 30. Umuyobozi Tom Whitworth yasebeje umuyobozi wa mbere ukiri muri filime ku ya 10 Mata 2018, atangaza ko sinema yakozwe na Nathan Prior na Ishmael Azeli. Byagaragaye ko filime ngufi yabanje gutekerezwa nk'ikinamico ya TV.
"Poacher (2018)" yarekuwe muri Kanama 2018, imaze kwerekanwa mu iserukiramuco rigufi kugeza ku ngingo (STTP), atoranyirizwa igihembo cya "Best Editing" Award "." Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Kenya mu nzu mberabyombi ya ANGA IMAX ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2018 muri "Kalasha International Film Awards" i Nairobi. "Poacher" yanerekanywe mu "iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema mpuzamahanga rya" Moscou 2018 muri Nzeri 2018 i Moscou. Iyi filime yanyujijwe kuri Netflix ku ya 30 Nzeri 2020.

Rafiki (drama film yo muri Kenya iyoborwa na Wanuri Kahiu. "Rafiki" ninkuru y'urukundo rukura hagati y'abakobwa 2 bakiri bato, Kena na Ziki, hagati y'umuryango n’igitutu cya politiki gikikije uburenganzira bwa LGBT muri Kenya. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mpuzamahanga mu gice cya "Un Certain Regard" mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2018. niyo filime ya mbere yo muri Kenya yerekanwe muri ibyo birori.
Kena afasha se John Mwaura kuyobora iduka rito ryorohereza i Nairobi mugihe yiyamamariza amatora yaho. Kena abana na nyina, utari mubyukuri kuvugana na John. Kena atangira gukundana na Ziki, umukobwa wabaturanyi ufite umusatsi wamabara, nawe wabaye umukobwa wa Peter Okemi, mukeba wa John muri politike. Kena na Ziki bafite gahunda nyinshi z'urukundo, kandi bahita begera cyane, ariko hariho amakimbirane yo kwerekana urukundo rwabo kumugaragaro kuko abaryamana bahuje ibitsina bitemewe muri Kenya.

Rise and Fall of Idi Amin, izwi kandi ku izina rya Amin: The Rise and Fall, ni filime yerekeye ubuzima bwa "Idi Amin mu" 1981 yayobowe na Sharad Patel ikinwamo na Joseph Olita nka Idi Amin. Olita yakinnye kandi nka Amin muri filime "Mississippi Masala yo" mu 1991.
Irasobanura ibikorwa n’ubugizi bwa nabi bitavugwaho rumwe n’uwahoze ari umunyagitugu wa Uganda, Idi Amin Dada, igihe yazamukaga ku butegetsi mu 1971 kugeza igihe yahiritswe ku butegetsi mu 1979 biturutse ku ntambara ya Uganda na Tanzaniya. "Rise and Fall of Idi Amin" yari ifatanije n’Ubwongereza, Kenya, na Nijeriya, aho amashusho menshi yakorewe muri Kenya, hashize igihe kitageze ku mwaka Amin avuye kubutegetsi..
Nubwo yiswe filime ikoreshwa nabi, birasobanutse neza ku byabaye n'amatariki y'ibyabaye byerekanwe, birimo igitero cya Isiraheli, intambara na Tanzaniya, no gufata no gufunga umunyamakuru w’Ubwongereza Denis Hills (wigaragaza muri filime).
ubwo yasohotse ku rwego mpuzamahanga, amajwi menshi yarahinduwe kubera amajwi atumvikana neza. Filime yatsindiye ibihembo bitanu, harimo umukinnyi mwiza, mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Las Vegas.

Anne G. Mungai (wavutse 1957) ni umuyobozi wa firime yo muri Kenya. Azwi cyane muri firime ndende, "Saikati" (1992). Azwiho gucukumbura inkuru z'abakobwa b'Abanyafrika bakiri bato n'ingorane bahura nazo mu gihe bagenda muri Afurika nyuma y'ubukoloni.
Anne Mungai yahawe impamyabumenyi mu kigo cya Kenya gishinzwe itumanaho rusange akomereza aho. Niwe washinze-umuyobozi w'ikinamico y'abana ya Shagilia. Mu 1993, Mungai yafatanyije gushinga Abagore muri Sinema muri Kenya, ifatanya n’abagore b’abanyafurika muri Filime na Video nka komite y’agateganyo y’igice cyayo cya Kenya.
Umwuga wo kuyobora Anne Mungai watangiye mu 1980 n’igice gito cya mbere yise "Nkomani Clinic." Kuva icyo gihe, yayoboye filime nyinshi ngufi-ndende, ndetse na filime ye ya mbere "Saïkati." Iyi filime, kimwe n’ibikorwa byinshi bya Mungai, yibanda ku miterere y’umugore uba muri Afurika mu gihe gitandukanijwe n’imigenzo gakondo y’umuco nyafurika n’izanwa mu bihugu by’iburengerazuba mu gihe cy'abakoloni.

Shuga, izwi kandi ku izina rya MTV Shuga, ni urukurikirane rw'ikinamico rwa televiziyo rwatangajwe bwa mbere mu Gushyingo 2009 kuri MTV Base mu rwego rwo kwitwa "MTV staying alive Ignite!". Ibice byayo bibiri byambere byahawe inshingano na MTV Networks Africa ifatanije na MTV Staying Alive Foundation, PEPFAR, Ubufatanye bw’umuryango urwanya virusi itera SIDA (HFG) na Guverinoma ya Kenya, mu rwego rwo gukwirakwiza ubutumwa bugamije gukwirakwiza ubutumwa ku myitwarire yimibonano mpuzabitsina no kwihangana
Iyi filime yaje gukundwa cyane kandi yerekanwa mu bihugu 40 bitandukanye bya Afurika mbere yuko isohoka ku rwego mpuzamahanga kuri televiziyo zirenga 70. Ikinamico yatekerezaga ko ari urukurikirane ruvuguruzanya cyane nabasekuruza bakuru ba Kenya kuko rwarimo amashusho amwe yarimo ibintu byerekeranye n'igitsina. Yabonye igihembo cya Zahabu muri Gicurasi 2010 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’itangazamakuru ryabereye i Hamburg mu Budage mu cyiciro cy’ubuzima rusange kubera kwibanda ku rukundo, amarangamutima, n’imyitwarire y’imibonano mpuzabitsina mu rubyiruko rwo muri Kenya.
Kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus, Shuga yagiye mu gitaramo gito cya nijoro cyiswe MTV Shuga Alone Together kigaragaza ibibazo bya Coronavirus ku ya 20 Mata 2020. Iki gitaramo cyagombaga gutambuka amajoro 65 kandi abayishyigikiye barimo Umuryango w’abibumbye. Urukurikirane rushingiye muri Nijeriya, Afurika y'epfo, Kenya na Côte D'Ivoire kandi inkuru isobanurwa n'ibiganiro kumurongo hagati yabantu nyamukuru. Inyandiko yanditswe na Tunde Aladese na Nkiru Njoku. Nibo banditsi bakuru kuri iki gitaramo kandi banayoboye ibice. Gufata amashusho, kumurika no kwisiga byakozwe nabakinnyi ubwabo.

Something Necessary ni film yikinamico yo muri Kenya yasohotse 2013 iyobowe na Judy Kibinge. Yerekanwe mu gice cya Sinema y'isi muri iki gihe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Toronto 2013.
Kenya 2007: Nyuma y'ibyavuye mu matora ya perezida atavugwaho rumwe, urugomo rwadutse. Agatsiko k'urubyiruko rudafite akazi rwatewe n'abanyapolitiki bajya mu mihanda hirya no hino. Anne akanguka mu bitaro avuye muri koma asanga ubuzima yagize mbere yihohoterwa butakibaho. Umugabo we yarapfuye kandi yashyinguwe mbere yuko agira amahirwe yo kumuririra. Umuhungu we Kitur ari muri koma kandi The Haven, umurima we n'inzu, byangijwe kandi byarasahuwe. Yagiye kuba umuforomo, umugore aba umupfakazi udafite akazi n'umuhungu uri mu bitaro uharanira kubaka umurima we. Ikirenze ibyo, ni umugore wa Kikuyu utuye mu gace ka Kalenjin, mushiki we yemera ko adahari kandi ko agomba gusubira mu rugo kugira ngo abe mu bwoko bwe. Ariko kubijyanye na Anne, ari murugo kandi ntazemera ko hagira umuntu umutera ubwoba.
Mugihe filime yegereje, Joseph yitegereza nyina akora yibaza icyo byose bivuze. Yahisemo gusibanganya amateka ye y’urugomo maze ava mu mudugudu kugira ngo atangire ubuzima bushya i Nairobi hamwe n’umukobwa w’inzozi ze. Mugihe ibi bibaho, Anne asanga kwizera kwe kugaruwe muburyo butunguranye kubwimpano itazwi bimuha ubutwari nimbaraga akeneye cyane guhaguruka, guhangana namateka ye no gukomeza.

Stories of Our Livesni film yo muri Kenya, yasohotse muri 2014. Iyi filime yakozwe n’abanyamuryango ba The Nest Collective, ihuriro ry’ubuhanzi rishingiye ku mujyi wa Nairobi, iyi filime ni anthologiya ya firime eshanu ngufi zerekana amateka y’ubuzima bwa LGBT muri Kenya.
Vignettes eshanu zigize film nizi zikurikira:
Kate (Kelly Gichohi), umunyeshuri wigometse wigaga mumashuri yisumbuye - ahura na Kwizera, umunyeshuri mugenzi we muri koridoro yishuri. Batangira umubano wibanga, kugeza umuyobozi wishuri afashe ingamba zo gutandukanya bombi bahagarika Kate mwishuri. Mugihe yari kure yishuri, Kate atabishaka akora imibonano mpuzabitsina numuhungu mubaturanyi be. Agarutse, Kate abwira Kwizera kubyerekeye guhura numuhungu. Ibi birakaza Kwizera, biganisha ku kurangiza umubano wabo.
Nyuma yo kugirana amasezerano n’ubucuruzi n’uwigana disiki(disc duplicator), Patrick (Paul Ogola) yaguye ku kabari kabo bahuje igitsina ubwo yagendanaga ninshuti ye magara, Kama. Kama agaragaza imyumvire mibi kubyerekeye akabari uko banyuze hejuru. Nyuma Patrick yaje gusubira muri club ijoro ryose, yizeye ko ntawe uzabimenya. Kama yerekana Patrick avuye mu kabari, kandi bafite guhangana gukabije. Patrick yahunze kugira ngo ahunge urugamba.
Abakozi bo mu mirima Ray na Athman babaye inshuti magara imyaka myinshi. Kubabazwa nubusabane bwa Athman nubusabane na Fiona mushya, Ray yagiranye ikiganiro kibi na Athman kubyerekeye umubano wabo. Athman yongeye gushimangira ko adashishikajwe n'imibonano mpuzabitsina na Ray. Biyunze, noneho Ray abaza Athman niba ashobora kumusoma. Umukinnyi yatunguwe nikibazo aragenda, ntibyoroshye. Bombi bongera kwiyunga bukeye, ariko Ray ahitamo kuva mu murima.
Jeff (Mugambi Nthiga), umushakashatsi wasuye u Bwongereza mu nama - aha akazi umuherekeza Roman mu gihe cy'isaha imwe mu cyumba cye cya hoteri. Roman (Louis Brooke) arahagera, yumva impungenge za Jeff, agerageza kumutuza. Jeff abaza niba bashobora kuvuga bike mbere yo kwishora mubikorwa byose. Bombi baricara bakaganira kubyerekeye isano iri hagati yubwoko. Roman noneho aha Jeff massage, bigatuma Jeff adahangayika.
Liz (Rose Njenga), yerekana gahunda zidasanzwe zo guhunga we na mugenzi we Achi mugihe abadepite baho bakangisha kubahiriza amategeko arwanya abaryamana bahuje ibitsina.
"Stories of Our Lives" Yatangiye nkumushinga winyandiko na Nest Collective. Iri tsinda ryazengurutse Kenya, rifata amajwi yabajijwe n'abantu bavuga ko ari LGBTIQ. Iyandikwa ryabaye ishingiro rya firime vignettes. 15,000 y’amadorali yavuye muri Uhai / EASHRI - ikigega cy’uburenganzira bw’imibonano mpuzabitsina muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba gifite icyicaro i Nairobi, muri Kenya - kikaba cyarafashwe amashusho n’itsinda mu gihe cy’amezi umunani hakoreshejwe kamera imwe ya Canon DSLR.

Togetherness Supreme ni film yo muri Kenya yasohotse muri 2010.
Ukurikije ibyabaye, "Togetherness Supreme" ni inkuru ya Kamau, umuhanzi, ushakisha impinduka hagati y’amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko mucyaro. Kamau yahagurukiye kurwanya se n'umuryango we kugira ngo yinjire mu muryango uhanganye n'incuti ye Otieno. Kamau na Otieno barwanira impinduka za politiki kubatuye mu bukene bukabije, ariko bafatiwe hagati y’amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko asenya igihugu cyabo kandi, bahanganye kubera urukundo rwa Alice, umukobwa w’umuganga. Nyuma y’amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu ateganijwe (amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu cya Kenya yo mu Kuboza 2007), akajagari kadutse mu ihohoterwa kandi isi ya Kamau irasenyuka.

To Walk with Lions ni film yo mu 1999 iyobowe na Carl Schultz ikinwamo na Richard Harris nka George Adamson na John Michie nka Tony Fitzjohn. Bikurikiranye imyaka yakurikiyeho Ntare wunganira Adamson. Nyuma yo gushyingiranwa na Joy Adamson wa "Born Free" fame, Adamson yamaze igice cya nyuma cyubuzima bwe arinda intare n’ibindi binyabuzima muri Kora National Reserve, Kenya. Ahura na ba rushimusi na ruswa ya leta imubuza gushaka kubungabunga inyamaswa.
Tony Fitzjohn (John Michie) aje gukora kuri Kora, kubungabunga intare, kubavandimwe babiri bageze mu zabukuru, George na Terence Adamson (Ian Bannen). Ku munsi we wa mbere, Fitzjohn yirengagije inama za George zo kutiruka kandi hafi yarakubiswe. Kumenyeshwa ubu nuburyo umuntu wa nyuma wujuje umwanya we yapfuye, Fitzjohn yanditse ahantu hose nk'umusazi ahitamo kugenda. Nyuma yumunota wanyuma uhinduye umutima, hamwe n'icyana cy'intare cyamuzanye muri pariki kugirango amutoze kandi yongere yinjire mwishyamba, avumbura umuhamagaro wukuri mubuzima bwe.

De Voortrekkers ni film idafite amajwi yasohotse 1916 yamenyakanye nka filime ya mbere muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yakozwe na African Film Productions kandi iyobowe na Harold M. Shaw, yerekana " Great Trek " ya Boers yo mu myaka ya za 1830, isozwa n’imyidagaduro ya hegemonike y’Intambara y’amaraso yabaye ku ya 16 Ukuboza 1838, igihe Abanyafurika bitwaje intwaro. yatsinze ibihumbi byinshi Zulus. "Abakomoka kuri voortrekkers" bavuga ururimi rw’Ubuholandi cyangwa "abapayiniya" bitabiriye Great Trek bubahaga filime kandi barayikoresha mu kwibuka ibirori, bikaba bigize igice cy’amakimbirane menshi mu mateka ya Afurika y'Epfo. Abanyafurika babigaragaje mu byumba by’ishuri imyaka ibarirwa muri za mirongo kandi barabigaragaza buri mwaka mu birori mbonezamubano bizihiza isabukuru y'intambara.
"De Voortrekkers" yerekanwe muri Afurika y'Epfo ahitwa Krugersdorp ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1916, hasigaye iminsi ibiri ngo isabukuru y'imyaka 78 imaze ibaye. Nyuma yaje gukwirakwizwa mu magambo ahinnye muri sinema zo mu Bwongereza, Amerika, Kanada, n'ahandi hanze ya Afurika ku izina rya "Winning a Continent". Intertitles zikoreshwa muri firime y'umwimerere no mubisohoka nyuma ikoresha imiterere ya ecran yerekana inyandiko mucyongereza no muri Afrikaans.

"Sarie Marais" (1931): film ya mbere yo muri Afrika yepfo ifite amajwi.
"Sarie Marais" kandi yari umutwe w'ishusho ya filime ya mbere yo muri Afurika y'Epfo ivuga, iyobowe na Joseph Albrecht () kandi yakozwe mu 1931. Ifoto yafatiwe i Johannesburg, "Sarie Marais abasha" gupakira byinshi mugihe cyiminota 10 yo kwiruka. Iyi firime yashyizwe mu nkambi ya POW yo mu Bwongereza, yibanda ku itsinda ry’imfungwa za Boer uko zigenda zireba ijisho ry’abafashwe n’abongereza. umunsi umwe imfungwa itera ijwi ryw hejuru aririmba agira ati "My Sarie Marais". Ishyaka rye rifata izindi mfungwa, bikabaha ibyiringiro by'ejo hazaza.

African Jim, izwi kandi ku izina rya Jim Aza i Jo'burg, ni filime yo muri Afurika y'Epfo yasohotse muri 1949, iyobowe na Donald Swanson kandi yakozwe na Eric Rutherford. Irimo Daniel Adnewmah, Dolly Rathebe, Inkspots nyafurika, Sam Maile, na Dan Twala. Birazwi cyane nka republika ya Afrika yepfo film ya mbere yuburebure bwa Afrika.
Jim yavuye mu gace k'imiryango gushaka umutungo we i Johannesburg. Akimara kuhagera, abambari batatu baramukubita. Iyo agaruye ubwenge, umuzamu w'ijoro wa gicuti amwitaho. Abifashijwemo n'umuzamu, Jim abona akazi muri club ya nijoro nk'umukozi. Yahawe amahirwe yo kuririmbira kuri stage hamwe numurimbyikazi wikipe, Dolly. Mbere yuko atangira bwa mbere, amenya abambari bamusahuye kandi yumva ko bategura ubujura. Jim agomba guhitamo uburyo bwo guhagarika icyaha kandi akiri mugihe cyo gukora.

Daar doer in die bosveld (Icyongereza: "Far Away in Bushveld") niyo film yambere yakozwe numuyobozi wumunya Afrika yepfo Jamie Uys. Yasohotse bwa mbere mu 1951. Filime iri mu rurimi rwa Afrikaans, ururimi rwihariye rwa Afrika yepfo.
Iyi filime ni urwenya ku muhinzi ufite isoni witwa Hans Botha usabwa gufata umwarimu ukiri muto witwa Martie du Toit. Hans ageze aho bisi ihagarara gufata Martie arumirwa rwose kubera ubwiza bwe kandi abasha kuvuga gusa interuro, "It looks like rain.." na It was an accident." Bombi bahura ningorane nyinshi munzira; ahanini bitewe n'imodoka ya kera ya Hans. Igihe bombi bageze aho Martie yerekeza, Martie atose kandi yemeza ko Hans ari igicucu. Hans, ariko, akunda byimazeyo Martie.

Kimberley Jim ni filime yo gusetsa y'umuziki yo muri Afurika y’Epfo yasohotse 1963 yayobowe na Emil Nofal ikinwamo Jim Reeves, Madeleine Usher na Clive Parnell. Umugambi wayo ukurikira umuririmbyi w'umunyamerika witabira kwihuta kwa diyama ya Kimberley muri Afrika yepfo mu mpera zikinyejana cya 19. By'umwihariko, "Jim Reeves na Clive Parnell bakina abantu bakundwa na con-men binjiza amafaranga yo kugurisha imiti y’ipatanti no gushuka kuri poker... babiri bashora amafaranga yabo mu guteza imbere ikirombe cya diyama ariko bagomba kurenza umucuruzi waho ugoramye", nk'ukoincamake ibivuga.
Reeves, umuririmbyi wo mu gihugu, yakunzwe cyane mu myaka ya za 1960. Nk’uko ikinyamakuru Billboard kibitangaza ngo " Reeves yamuritse mu mahanga mu Bwongereza, Ubuhinde, Ubudage, ndetse no muri Afurika y'Epfo". Muri film, umuhanzi aririmba igice cy'indirimbo imwe muri Afrikaans. Amajwi y'indirimbo 14 yarimo indirimbo "Kimberley Jim," "Strike It Rich," "Nakuze," "Ubuzima bwanjye ni Gypsy," "Navutse Kugira Amahirwe," "Rag Fashioned Rag," "Diamonds The Umusenyi, " Inshuti Y'umunyamahanga Gusa, " Gwa kandi Ukurikire, "" Umukinnyi ukina urusimbi "na" Dolly hamwe n'amavi yataye. "
Inyuma nyinshi zafatiwe amashusho mu gace ko mu mujyi muto w’Ubwongereza mu gihe imbere yafatiwe kuri sitidiyo ya Jamie Uys mu majyaruguru y’umugi wa Johannesburg. Nyuma Reeves yavuze ko yishimiye uburambe bwo gukora firime kandi ko azatekereza gukoresha byinshi mu mwuga we. Iyi filime yasohotse mu 1965 nyuma y'urupfu rwa Reeves azize impanuka y'indege.

Death Drums Along the River (yitwa Sanders muri Amerika) ni filimi yasohotse muri 1963 mu Bwongereza n’Ubudage bakoranye n’amahanga, bakoresheje abantu bavugwa mu gitabo cya Edgar Wallace cyo mu 1911 cyitwa "Sanders of the River" na filime ya Zoltán Korda yo mu 1935 ishingiye ku gitabo, ariko yashyizwe mu nkuru itandukanye rwose. Ifata amashusho aherereye muri Afrika yepfo, igaragaramo Richard Todd na Marianne Koch bayoboye itsinda ryabakinnyi b’abongereza, Abadage na Afurika yepfo. Harry Alan Towers yakoze firime nyinshi muri Afrika yepfo ku nkunga ya Film ya Constantin mu Budage bw’Iburengerazuba hamwe n’abakinnyi baturutse muri kiriya gihugu. Iyi filime yagurishijwe mu Budage bw’Iburengerazuba nka imwe mu mafilime yakunzwe cyane ya Edgar Wallace, ariko ntaho ahuriye cyane n’igitabo cya Wallace cyitwa "Sanders of the River", cyangwa filime zabanjirije iyi zishingiye kuri icyo gitabo, usibye izina Sanders n'ubwato. "Zaire", nubwo hano ari ubwato buto bwa moteri aho kuba parike. Intambara hagati y’ibikorwa bya Wallace yasimbuwe n’inkuru isanzwe y’iperereza irimo ubwicanyi na magendu ya diyama. Abakoloni b'impimbano ntibahawe izina, ariko mu rwego rw'ibihe Dr Jung abaza Sanders icyo azakora igihe azahabwa ubwigenge

Coast of Skeletons ni filime yo kwidagadura yo mu Bwongereza na Afurika yo mu 1965, iyobowe na Robert Lynn ikinwamo na Richard Todd na Dale Robertson. Ni urukurikirane rwa filime yo mu 1963 "y’urupfu ku Ruzi", kandi kimwe n’iyo filime, ikoresha abantu bavugwa mu gitabo cya Edgar Wallace cyo mu 1911 cyitwa "Sanders of the River" na Zoltán Korda yo muri 1935 ishingiye kuri roman, ariko igashyirwa mu inkuru itandukanye rwose. "Coast of Skeletons" yarekuwe mubudage nka "Sanders und das Schiff des Todes" / "Sanders hamwe nubwato bwurupfu".
Nyuma y'ubwigenge, ubukoloni bw’Abongereza butavuzwe izina aho Komiseri Harry Sanders amaze imyaka myinshi akorera yirukanywe n'abapolisi b’Ubwongereza. Sanders rero asubira i Londres, aho yahise abona akazi mu isosiyete y'ubwishingizi, ishaka ko yakurikirana umushinga wo gucukura diyama mu mazi magari yo muri Afurika y'Epfo.

Sandy the Seal ni film yumuryango w'ubwongereza mu 1965 iyobowe na Robert Lynn ikinwamo na Heinz Drache, Marianne Koch na Gert Van den Bergh. Iyi filime yakozwe kandi afatanije na Harry Alan Towers, yafatiwe amashusho muri Afurika yepfo muri Technicolor na Techniscope II hamwe n’uruhererekane rwakorewe ku kirwa cya Seal, muri Afurika yepfo. Iyi filime yasohotse mu Bwongereza na Tigon British Film Productions mu 1969.
Umuzamu w'amatara asanga kashe yakomeretse yasizwe na ba rushimusi. Azana kashe k'umugore we n'abana babiri biga inshingano bareba kashe bise Sandy. Sandy aherekeza abana mubyababayeho no mubikorwa byabo maze avumbura ubwato bwaba rushimusi ba kashe bateganya gusubira ku kirwa cy'umucyo kubutaka bw'agaciro.

The Naked Prey ni filime yo muri Amerika yo mu 1965 yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Cornel Wilde, nawe ukina mu mwanya wa mbere. Bashyizwe muri veldt yo muri Afrika yepfo, imigambi ya firime yibanda kumuyobozi wa safari ugerageza kubaho mubuzima bubi bwa veldt, mugihe agerageza kwirinda urupfu rwatewe nabarwanyi ba Afrika bihorera. Iyinkuru ishingiye kuburambe bw'umushakashatsi w'umunyamerika John Colter. Amashusho yamamaye yinjije abanditsi Clint Johnson na Don Peters mu gihembo cya Akademiki cyiza cyumwimerere.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya San Sebastián 1965, nyuma isohoka muri Amerika ku ya 23 Werurwe 1966. Iyi filime yakozwe ku ngengo yimari itarenga 700.000 $, iyi firime yafatiwe ahantu hose muri Afrika yepfo.
"The Naked Prey yafatiwe" amashusho muri Afrika yepfo. Amashusho ya firime yari afite impapuro icyenda gusa. Amazina yatangije iyi filime yaherekejwe n’ibishushanyo byerekanwe n’umuhanzi waho Andrew Motjuoadi.

Shangani Patrol ni filime y'intambara ishingiye ku gitabo kitari ibihimbano "A Time to Die" cyanditswe na Robert Cary (1968), hamwe n’amateka ya Shangani Patrol, hamwe na Brian O'Shaughnessy nka Major Allan Wilson na Will Hutchins nk'umuskuti Frederick. Russell Burnham. Harimo n'indirimbo "Shangani Patrol" ya Nick Taylor (recording 1966).
Ku buyobozi bwa Major Wilson, irondo rikurikirana umwami Ndebele Lobengula wahunze hakurya y'uruzi rwa Shangani. Bagabanijwe ku mbaraga nyamukuru, batewe igico na Ndebele impi kandi, usibye abagabo bake boherejwe nk'imbaraga, bose baricwa. Ubwo ni bwo butwari bw'irondo rya Shangani ku buryo Ndebele watsinze yagize ati: "Bari abagabo ariko na ba se bari abagabo mbere yabo." Ukurikije uko umuntu abibona, ibyabaye byari rimwe mu makosa akomeye no kwibeshya kwa gisirikare muri iki gihe cy'amateka, cyangwa igihagararo cyanyuma cyintwari cya bake. Ibyabaye byari bifite akamaro gakomeye mubwongereza, Afrika yepfo, na Rodeziya bihwanye na ' Custer's Last stand '. Ngiyo inkuru yabo, yavuzwe muri firime ya 1970 yafatiwe ahitwa Matabeleland, Rhodesia (ubu ni muri Zimbabwe).

Animals Are Beautiful People (nanone yitwa Beautiful People) ni documentaire y’ibidukikije yo muri yo mu 1974 yanditswe, yakozwe, iyoborwa, ifatwa amashusho kandi ihindurwa na Jamie Uys, ivuga ku nyamaswa zo muri Afurika yepfo, zerekanwe nibintu bisetsa. Boesman na Lena ni ikinamico ngufi yakorewe muri Afurika y'Epfo ikozwe na Athol Fugard, Swartkops mudflats hamwe na Port Elizabeth mur Cape Town y'iburasirazuba, yerekana ingaruka ya apartheid ku bantu bakeya, hagaragaramo "umugabo n'umugore bagenda bava mu mujyi umwe bajya mu wundi.
Mubisanzwe hamwe nibindi bikorwa byinshi bya Fugard, ikinamico yibanda ku bantu batari abazungu kandi ikubiyemo ibintu byo kwigaragambya. "Boesman na Lena" batewe inkunga n'ibyabaye mu 1965 igihe Fugard yari atwaye mu umuhanda wo mu cyaro muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yabonye umukecuru ugenda mu muhanda izuba ryamwishe, ku bilometero uvuye aho agana, maze amuha lift. Yaratsinzwe ararira ashimira. Yamubwiye ko umugabo we yari amaze gupfa kandi ko yari yagiye mu rindi sambu. iyo Fugard adahagarara, yari kurara kumuhanda. (Byari akamenyero muri Afurika y'Epfo ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina abahinzi birukana imiryango y'abakozi igihe umukozi yapfaga.) Icyatangaje Fugard nuko umugore yari afite ububabare ariko akaba ataratsinzwe. Ibi byamuteye kwandika ikinamico.

Funeral for an Assassin ni filime yo muri Afurika yepfo yasohotse muri 1974 iyobowe na Ivan Hall yasohotse muri Amerika mu 1977.
Michael Cardiff numuntu uharanira impinduramatwara wabigize umwuga watojwe cyane muburyo butandukanye bwo kwica, gucengera no guhunga amategeko. Amaze gutoroka gereza ashyira ibintu bimuranga ku mubiri wangiritse kugira ngo agaragare ko yapfuye mu gihe ateganya kwihimura kuri guverinoma. Cardiff akoresha ubuhanga bwe mu kwica umucamanza ukomeye bituma urupfu rwe rusa nkimpanuka kugirango atere ibikoresho biturika bitunguranye mu muhango wo kumushyingura witabiriwe n’abimuka n’abanyeganyeza ubutegetsi. Gusa kapiteni wa polisi udahuje ibitekerezo ari kuri gahunda ze.

No Gold for a Dead Diver ni film yo muburengerazuba bw'Ubudage yasohotse muri 1974 yayoborwa na Harald Reinl fatanyije na Star Horst Janson, Monika lundi na Marius Weyers. Igishimishije kubyerekeranye ninyanja ndende ishakisha ubutunzi bwashyinguwe, yafatiwe amashusho muri Afrika yepfo. Amashusho ya firime yateguwe n'umuyobozi wubuhanzi Dieter Bartels.
Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa kw'abayahudi muri(1975), film yasohotse muri Amerika ifite izina rya Deadly Jaws.

Albino (izwi nka The Night of the Askari, Death in the Sun and Whispering Death) ni filimi yasohotse muri 1976 yakozwe n'abadage iyoborwa na Jürgen Goslar na Star Christopher Lee, James Faulkner na Sybil Danning yafashwe amashusho mugihe cy'intambara ya Rhodesian Bush. Filime ishingiye ku gitabo "The Whispering Death" cyanditswe na Daniel Carney.
Terrick (James Faulkner), umupolisi w’Ubwongereza muri Afurika yepfo mu cyaro cya Rhodesia, ategereje ko umurimo we urangira ndetse n’izabukuru hakiri kare mu murima we hamwe n’umukunzi we, Sally (Sybil Danning). Icyizere cya Terrick cyo kubaho mu mahoro hamwe na Sally kiracika intege, ariko, igihe inyeshyamba z'abirabura b'abirabura zateye umurima. Sally yafashwe ku ngufu akicwa n'umuyobozi w'inyeshyamba, albino izwi gusa na moniker "Urupfu rwongorera" (Horst Frank). Ababajwe n'agahinda, Terrick n'abakozi be bo mu mirima, bayobowe na Katchemu (Sam Williams) bahisemo kwihorera Sally bonyine. Nyuma baza kumenya ko inyeshyamba zahamagaye abaturage baho mu nama yo kubanyapolitiki no kubateza igico "Urupfu rwongorera". Icyakora ishyaka rya Terrick rifungura umuriro imburagihe, ryica kandi rikomeretsa bamwe mu baturage bari bahari.

Killer Force, izwi kandi ku izina rya The Diamond Mercenaries, ni filime ishimishije yo mu 1976 iyobowe na Val Guest ikinwamo na Telly Savalas, Peter Fonda na Christopher Lee. Byari ubufatanye hagati ya Repubulika ya Irilande, Ubusuwisi na Amerika kandi yafashwe amashusho cyane muri Afurika y'Epfo. Umugambi wayo ni agatsiko k'abagizi ba nabi bategura ubujura bukomeye mu kirombe cya diyama.
Umuyobozi w’umutekano Harry Webb afite ubwoba ko ubujura bwa diyama bugiye kubera mu ruganda rukora ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y'agaciro mu butayu. Yahise abasha gukundwa cyane, na Claire Chambers, umukobwa wamamaye cyane n'umukobwa w'umuyobozi w'ibirombe. Arimo gusura umugabo akunda, Mike Bradley, ushinzwe umutekano kuri iki kirombe.
Nelson, umuyobozi w’ibirombe, aha Bradley ubutumwa bw'amatsiko - kwiba diyama. Arashaka kugira uruhare kuri Bradley kugira ngo amuhuze na Lewis runaka witegura kwiba ikirombe abifashijwemo n'itsinda ry'abacanshuro ndetse n'ibikoresho byaho bizwi nka Padiri Noheri. Webb, itamenyeshejwe uburiganya, idahwema gukurikirana Bradley, wavuganye na Lewis. Hamwe n'abacanshuro mugikorwa cyo kwinjira mu kirombe, Bradley yerekanye ko ari Padiri Noheri, wateguye iki gikorwa cyose. Hamwe na Webb ikurikirana, Bradley yahungiye mu butayu hamwe nabandi barokotse.

Kill or Be Killed (bwa mbere yasohokeye muri Amerika nka Karate Killer irongera isohorerwa muri Afurika y'epfo nka Karate Olympiad) ni filime yasohotse muri 1977 muri Afurika y'Epfo / Amerika karate film iyoborwa na Ivan Hall. Iyi filime yakorewe muri Afurika y'Epfo, iyi filime yiswe "Kill cyangwa Be Killed" muri Amerika mu 1980 kugira ngo yunguke menshi mu gukina filime z'ubuhanzi bw'intambara zo muri Amerika. Urukurikirane rwo kwamamara rugaragaza imiterere ya James Ryan Steve Hunt agerageza gukinira ikipe ya von Rudloff kandi ubwamamare burenze umubiri wa Ryan ahantu hose, usibye izina rya film.
karate yo mubuyapani.
Uburyo bwo kurwana muri film bwerekana uburyo bwiza bwa karate yu Buyapani, tubikesha Ishyirahamwe rya Karate ry’Ubuyapani (Afurika yepfo). Shihans Stan Schmidt na Norman Robinson bakoze choreografi ya karate ya firime, ndetse banagaragara muri iyi filime nk'abanyamuryango babiri bagize ikipe ya karate ya von Rudloff.

Target of an Assassin ni film yo mu 1977 iyobowe na Peter Collinson ikinwamo na Anthony Quinn na John Phillip Law. yafatiwe amashusho muri Afurika y'Epfo mu 1976 ikitwa Tigers Don't Cry ariko ntabwo yashyizwe ahagaragara muri Amerika imyaka hafi icyenda. andi mazina arimo "African Rage", "The Long Shot", and "Fatal Assassin".. Ukurikije igitabo cya Jon Burmeister cyitwa "Running Scared".
Filime yakiniwe mubitaro byo muri Afrika yepfo. Anthony Quinn wamenyekanye cyane akina nk'umuforomo w'umugabo, Hobday, washinzwe kwita kuri perezida w’amahanga (Simon Sabela). Hamwe n’iterabwoba ryinshi ryangiza ubuzima bwe, umuyobozi arinzwe cyane kumasaha. Hobday abasha gushimuta umurwayi we ku nyungu z'umuntu ku giti cye, atazi ko sniper yahawe akazi agerageza guhitana ubuzima bw'umuyobozi w’amahanga igihe yari afunzwe na Hobday. Ibi biganisha kumurongo wamatsiko y'imigambi iganisha kumiterere yikirere hamwe n'imodoka ya kabili kumusozi muremure.

Kill and Kill Again ni film y'ibikorwa yo mu 1981 iyobowe na Ivan Hall. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo James Ryan nka Steve Chase wahawe akazi ko gukiza umuhanga Horatio Kane, washimuswe n'umuhanga Marduk. Chase akoranya itsinda ryabacanshuro basanga inzira igana ku gihome cy'umugome hanyuma ugasanga barwanira ubuzima bwabo uko bafashwe.
"Kill and Kill Again" ni urukurikirane rwa film "" kandi yatangiye gufatwa amashusho muri kamena 1980. Iyi filime yafatiwe mu Burayi no muri Amerika hamwe n'abakinnyi ahanini bakomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yasohotse i New York ku ya 8 Gicurasi 1981. Yakiriye ibitekerezo bibi byatanzwe na "Variety" na "The New York Times" basanze filime "idashimishije" kandi ifite "umugambi mubi".
"Kill and Kill Again" yasohotse i New York ku ya 8 Gicurasi 1981. Ku ya 12 Kanama 1980, "Umunyamakuru wa Hollywood" yatangaje ko hateganijwe filime ya gatatu muri uruhererekane. Kugeza mu Kuboza 2013, nta filime ikurikirana yagiye mu bikorwa.

Boetie Gaan Border Toe ni filime yo gusebanya 1984 yashyizweho mugihe cy'intambara y'umupaka wa Afrika yepfo. Iyi filime yayobowe na Regardt van den Bergh, ikaba ikinamo Arnold Vosloo, Frank Dankert na Frank Opperman. Umusaruro wafashijwe n’ingabo z’Afurika yepfo (SADF).
Boetie van Tonder, umusore wo muri Afrikaner, ashobora kwinjizwa mu gisirikare cya Afurika y'Epfo. Nubwo mu mizo ya mbere yiyemeje kurwanya umurimo w’igihugu no kwanga amabwiriza, ahita abona ihumure ari kumwe n’abasirikare bagenzi be mu gihe bahuye n’imyitozo ikaze y’amahugurwa y’ibanze ndetse no koherezwa ku mupaka wa Angola.
Umusesenguzi w’ubuvanganzo Monica Popescu yasobanuye ko "Boetie Gaan Border Toe" hamwe "n’uruhererekane rwayo"", Boetie Op Maneuvers", nk'ibikorwa byerekanaga urukundo rw’intambara yo ku mupaka wa Afurika y'Epfo kandi byibanze cyane ku "myitwarire idahwitse y'abasirikare ba SADF". Keyan Tomaselli wo muri kaminuza ya Johannesburg yanenze iyi filime "kwamamaza".

King Solomon's Mines ni film yasohotse muri 1985, iturutse kuri novel yitwa King Solomon's Mines yanditswe na H. Rider yajonjogoye. Irimo Richard Chamberlain, Sharon Stone, Herbert Lom na John Rhys-Davies. Yahinduwe na Gene Quintano na James R. Silke kandi iyobowe na J. Lee Thompson. Iyi verisiyo yinkuru yari yoroheje, urwenya, iganisha ku gusebya "Indiana Jones" (aho umukinnyi wa francise Rhys-Davies yagaragaye mubice bibiri). Yafatiwe amashusho hanze ya Harare muri Zimbabwe.

Master Harold...and the Boys ni filime y’ikinamico yo muri Amerika yo mu 1984 yakozwe na televiziyo ikorwa na Athol Fugard, yakuwe mu ikinamico ye yo mu 1982 yakinnye izina rimwe, iyobowe na Michael Lindsay-Hogg. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere kuri Showtime ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 1984 ndetse inerekanwa kuri PBS mu rwego rwo kwerekana "ibitaramo bikomeye" ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 1985.
Iyi filime yahinduwe na Athol Fugard ikinamico ya autobiographical ibera mu 1950 Afurika y'epfo mugihe cya apartheid. kwerekana uburyo ivanguramoko rishingiye ku nzego, urwikekwe cyangwa inzangano bishobora gutwarwa n'ababa munsi yacyo. Ikinamico y'umwimerere yarabujijwe muri Afurika y'Epfo. Filime yagizwe PG-13. Jock of the Bushveld, ni filimi yasohotse muri 1986 yo muri Afurika y'Epfo, iyoborwa na Gray Hofmeyr itunganywa amashusho na Duncan MacNeillie hamwe na Duncan MacNeillie Production na Toron International. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Jonathan Rands, Jocelyn Broderick na Michael Brunner mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Gordon Mulholland, Wilson Dunster mu nshingano zunganira n'imbwa "Umfubu". Iyi filime ishingiye ku gitabo cyanditswe n'umwanditsi wo muri Irilande James Percy FitzPatrick wagiye muri Afurika y'Epfo mu myaka ya 1800 kandi akibonera ibintu byinshi byabereye mu mashyamba.
Mu 1886, Percy Fitzpatrick w'imyaka 20 ukomoka mu mujyi wa Cape Town yerekeje ku kirwa cya Delagoa muri Transvaal gucukura zahabu. Agezeyo, abuza icyana cy'imbwa, Jock, kurohama arakirera. Iyo amaherezo Percy ageze iyo yerekeza, nta zahabu iba ikiriho, nuko atangira kuba umuyobozi. Nyuma yaho, we na Jock babayeho mubyabaye byinshi birimo inyamaswa zo mwishyamba hamwe nabashoferi batwaraga abacakara.

Place of Weeping (ikinamico nka Afrika - Land der Hoffnung), ni filime y'ikinamico yo muri Afrika yepfo yasohotse muri 1986 yayobowe na Darrell Roodt ikanakorwa na Anant Singh muri Place of Weeping Productions. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo James Whyle, Gcina Mhlophe na Charles Comyn mu bakinnyi ba mbere mu gihe Norman Coombes, Michelle du Toit, Kerneels Coertzen na Patrick Shai bagize uruhare runini. Iyi filime isobanura mu buryo burambuye ku matsinda y’imico myinshi yo muri Afurika y'epfo n’uburyo Afurika yepfo yaguye kubera ibikorwa by’abanyafurika yepfo n’amakimbirane mu butegetsi bukandamiza Afurika yepfo. Iyi niyo shusho yambere yo kurwanya ivanguramoko yakozwe muri Afrika yepfo. Filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku ya 5 Ukuboza 1986. Filime yakiriwe neza nabayireba.

Platoon Leader ni film ya Cannon Films yo mu 1988 yakozwe mu ntambara ya Vietnam kandi iyobowe na Aaron Norris; ikinamo Michael Dudikoff na Michael DeLorenzo kandi yafatiwe amashusho muri Afrika yepfo. Rishingiye ku nyandiko ya James R. McDonough yibuka izina rimwe. Iyi filime ivuga kubyerekeranye na liyetona mushya w’abasirikare bageze muri Vietnam kugira ngo yigarurire platoni ye ya mbere. Asanga agomba kwigaragaza no kugirirwa ikizere nabagabo banditswe niba ashaka kubayobora.
Lt. Jeffrey Knight, umusirikare mushya wo mu Ishuri rya Gisirikare rya Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, yajyanywe mu ndege ku birindiro biri muri Vietnam, aho ahurira na platon ye, itsinda ry’abasirikare bakomeye b'intambara. Platon Serija McNamara asobanurira Knight ko platoni idakeneye umuyobozi ukurikiza amategeko. Ibikorwa bya Lt. Knight nabyo byamaganwa nabagabo be bose usibye Pvt. Parker, umukoresha wa radio.
Kuri rimwe mu irondo rye rya mbere, Knight yasitaye atitaye ku kirombe cyanjye cy'urugendo kandi aricwa. Parker noneho amaradiyo ya evac hanyuma McNamara ategeka ingabo kwimukira muri LZ kugirango zivemo. Nyuma, mu gihe Lt. Knight arimo gukira ibikomere mu bitaro bya Gisirikare, Major Flynn amubaza niba ashobora kongera gufata icyemezo maze Knight arabyemera. Knight asubizwa mu ndege asubira ku birindiro bya platon ariko ntiyakirwa n'abantu be asanga ibikoresho bye byabuze aho yari atuye, kuko batari biteze ko azagaruka. Bamenye ko Knight yagarutse, abasirikare bihutira gusubiza ibintu bye hanze y'ibiro bye mbere yuko agaruka. Knight amenya ko agomba gufata ubundi buryo kugirango abagabo be bamwubahe.

Skeleton Coast ni filime y’intambara y’abacanshuro yo muri 1987 yakozwe na John Cardos muri firime eshatu za mbere kuri producer Harry Alan Towers. Nibwo bwambere muri Towers 'Breton Film Productions.
Mugihe cy'intambara yo muri Angola umukozi wa CIA Michael Smith akorana ninyeshyamba za UNITA. Yafashwe n’ingabo za Angola, yoherezwa muri gereza kugira ngo abazwe n’umudage w’iburasirazuba witwa Major Schneider. Se wa Smith, Koloneli Bill Smith wahoze mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru Colonel Bill Smith ntabwo yizera leta ya Amerika kurekura umuhungu we. Koloneli yagiye muri Afrika yepfo y'uburengerazuba aho yishyuye Elia amayobera kugirango amenye amakuru yukuri kubyerekeye umuhungu we aho yari ari imbohe. Colonel Smith aha akazi abacanshuro barindwi azajyana muri Angola gutabara umuhungu we.
Kapiteni Simpson, umuyobozi w’inzego zishinzwe umutekano z’ikirombe cya diyama afite umugabo uhanze amaso Coloneli atinya ko ashobora kuba akora magendu ya diyama. Umugore wa Elia, Opal akomeje kugirana umubano utemewe na Simpson amumenyesha ko Coloneli yishe umuntu w’umutekano we, mu byukuri yishwe na Rick Weston, umuyobozi w’ingabo bwite za Smith. Rick yamenyesheje Coloneli ko yari umukozi wibanga wa Angola. Elia yahise amenya ko Col. Smith yamwishyuye amafaranag yamiganano. Binjiye muri Angola, abacanshuro bafatanya na Sekassi, umuyobozi wo mu bwoko bwa Jonas Savimbi w’inyeshyamba kugira ngo bashyigikire gutabara Michael Smith.

Alien from L.A. ni filime ya siyanse yo mu 1988 iyobowe na Albert Pyun ikinwamo na Kathy Irlande nk'umukobwa ukiri muto usura umuco wo munsi ya Atlantis. Filime yagaragaye kuri "Theatre Science Theatre 3000". Iyi filime ishingiye cyane ku gitabo cya Jules Verne cyo mu 1864 "cyurugendo rugana hagati yisi" hamwe n’ibintu bito byerekeza kuri "Wizard ya Oz".
Wanda Saknussemm (Kathy Irlande) Ni umukobwa wari warananiranye ahora yamabaye amarinete manini ndetse afite nijwi ridasanzwe,uba i Los Angeles kandi ukora kuri restora. Nyuma yo kujugunywa n'umukunzi we kubera "kutagira amarangamutima", Wanda amenyeshwa ibaruwa ivuga ko se, umuhanga mu bucukumbuzi bw'ibyataburuwe mu matongo, yaguye mu rwobo rutagira epfo na ruguru arapfa. Yerekeje muri Zamboanga muri Afurika y'Amajyaruguru ("Afurika Yimbitse" avuga ko ibahasha yagarutse) maze mu gihe anyuze mu bintu bya se, ahasanga ibyo yanditse kuri Atlantis, bigaragara ko ari ubwato bw'abanyamahanga bwaguye mu binyejana byashize bukarohama hagati mu Isi. Wanda ahura nicyumba munsi yinzu ya se maze atabishaka ashyiraho urunigi rwibintu amaherezo bituma agwa mu mwobo muremure.

Act of Piracy ni filimi yasohotse muri 1988 yakozwe yagati ya Amerika na South African thriller film iyoborwa na Yohana Cardos na Star Gary Busey, Belinda Bauer na Ray Sharkey. Mugihe bishimira ingendo zidasanzwe muri Ositaraliya, ubwato bwumuryango bufatwa nabaterabwoba. Bazwi kandi nka Barracuda.
Ted Andrews (Gary Busey) yemeje uwahoze ari umugore we Sandy (Belinda Bauer) kureka abana babo Mark (Mathew Stewardson) na Tracey (Candicé Hillebrand) bamuherekeza n'umukunzi we Laura Warner (Nancy Mulford) mu rugendo mu bwato bwe buhenze cyane muri Ositaraliya, aho ateganya kugurisha ubwato. Icyakora, nyuma yiminsi mike, biragaragara ko Laura ari umunyamuryango w’umutwe w’iterabwoba uyobowe na Jack Wilcox (Ray Sharkey), wifuza ko ubwato bwaba ishingiro ry’ibikorwa bye. Jack afata yacht, nuko ubwa burashimutwa, kandi kubwibyo, Mark na Tracey babikwa nkingwate. Hamwe na Sandy, Ted atangira gushakisha Wilcox, no gutabara Mark na Tracey.

Fiela's Child ni ikinamico yo muri Afurika y'Epfo yanditswe na Dalene Matthee kandi yasohotse mu 1985. Igitabo cyanditswe mbere muri Afrikaans ku izina rya Fiela se Kind, nyuma kiza guhindurwa mu Cyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikidage, Icyesipanyoli, igitaliyani, Igiheburayo, Isilande na Sinhalese, n'ibindi.
Matthee akemura ibibazo by’ibidukikije, insanganyamatsiko zishingiye ku ivanguramoko no kuvangura amoko. blue-buck burenze guhigwa kandi inzovu ziricwa. Umubano hagati y'abazungu nabandi birabura uragoye. Nubwo ibi mbere ya Apartheid mugihe tekiniki habaye uburinganire imbere y amategeko, gahunda y'amategeko yabogamye kandi ishyigikira abazungu. Inganda zo mu nyanja zibabajwe no kwinjiza amato akoreshwa na parike.
Ibice byo kugarukira.
Mu gitabo cyanditswe na Dalene Matthee icyerekezo cyo kugarukira, aho umuntu abasha guhitamo uwo ari we n'icyo agomba kuba afite, uruhare runini. Mu gitabo, Benjamini ari mu ntera ntarengwa kandi ntazi umwirondoro we. Na none, igenamiterere risobanurwa ko riri murwego ntarengwa bityo bibera kumpande zombi z'umusozi .
Igitabo cyakozwe muri firime mu 1988 gikinwamo Shaleen Surtie-Richards nka Fiela. Filime muri 2019 yakinnye na Zenobia Kloppers nka Fiela.

Mapantsula ni filime yo muri Afurika yepfo yo mu 1988 iyobowe na Oliver Schmitz kandi yanditswe na Schmitz na Thomas Mogotlane. Ivuga amateka ya Johannes 'Panic' Themba Mzolo (Mogotlane), umujura wigihe gito, yashyizwe inyuma ya Apartheid. Iyi filime yakoresheje ibintu byagaragaye hagati y’igihe cya Panic yatewe n’umugororwa we w’ivangura rya 'Stander' (Marcel Van Heerden) hamwe n’ibibera mu mujyi wa Johannesburg mu mujyi wa Soweto byerekana akarengane abirabura bo muri Afurika yepfo bahuye nako mu gihe cya apartheid ndetse n’urugamba rwabo rwo gutora. Iyi filime ikoresha cyane imyigaragambyo ya politiki, ubugome bwa polisi, n’itandukaniro rishingiye ku moko kugira ngo tugaragaze ingaruka za apartheid ku Birabura bo muri Afurika yepfo. Yerekanwe mu gice cya Un Certain Regard mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 1988. Iyi filime yatoranijwe nk'iyinjira muri Afurika y'Epfo muri Filime nziza y'indimi z'amahanga mu bihembo bya 62 bya Osama, ariko ntiyemerwa nk'umukandida.
Dukurikije amagambo magufi yabanjirije iyi filime, Amapanstula ni ijambo rikoreshwa kuri "udutsiko two mu muhanda wo muri Afurika y'Epfo tugaragazwa n'imiterere yabo y'imyambarire n'umuziki." Ikomeza ivuga ko, "Mu gace kabo gakabije nta mategeko abaho kandi kubaho kw'ibikwiye ni gahunda y'umunsi."

Red Scorpion ni film muri Amerika yo mu 1988 yakinnye na Dolph Lundgren kandi iyobowe na Joseph Zito. Lundgren agaragara nk’ingabo zidasanzwe z’Abasoviyeti zoherejwe kwica umuyobozi w’inyeshyamba zirwanya abakomunisiti muri Afurika, gusa ashyigikiye inyeshyamba. yakozwe na lobbyist Jack Abramoff kandi yafatiwe amashusho muri Afrika yepfo yuburengerazuba ku nkunga ya Afrika yepfo yo muri apartheid. Iyi filime yasohotse muri Amerika ku ya 21 Mata 1989.
Liyetona Nikolai Petrovitch Rachenko, umukozi wa Spetsnaz w’Abasoviyeti yoherejwe mu gihugu cya Afurika aho ingabo z’Abasoviyeti, Cekosolovakiya na Cuba zifasha guverinoma kurwanya umutwe w’inyeshyamba zirwanya abakomunisiti. Ashinzwe ubutumwa bwo kwica umuyobozi w'inyeshyamba. Rachenko yinjiye mu mutwe w'inyeshyamba no kugera kure cyane y'intego yari afite, ateza ibibazo mu kabari kabo maze atabwa muri yombi azira imyitwarire idahwitse. Yashyizwe mu kagari kamwe n’umuyobozi wafashwe n’umutwe kandi arizera ko byoroshye guhunga. Amaherezo ageze mu nkambi y'inyeshyamba, ahura no kutizerana n'inyeshyamba. Mwijoro, agerageza kwica umugambi we, ariko inyeshyamba zitizera ibikorwa bye.
Kevin Thomas wo mu kinyamakuru "Los Angeles Times" yasobanuye ko ari "igitabo gisekeje kizwi cyane", ko nubwo Lundgren afite charisma, bishoboka ko byangiza umwuga we. Stephen Holden wo mu "kinyamakuru The New York Times" yanditse ko physique ya Lundgren ari yo nyenyeri nyayo ya filime, kuko ivuga amarangamutima kuruta uko yakinnye.

Space Mutiny (izwi nka Mutiny in Space) ni film yasohotse muri 1988 muri Afurika y'Epfo ikorwa na American filimi yerekeye ubwato bwitwa "Southern Sun"".." Kuva ubwo iyi filime imaze guteza imbere umuco nyuma yo kugaragara mu gice kizwi cyane kuri televiziyo "Mystery Science Theatre 3000".
"The Southern Sun" ni ubwato bwibisekuruza, cyangwa ubwato bugenda mu kirere burimo abantu benshi, intego yabo ni ugukoloniza isi nshya. Urugendo rwabwo kuva kwisi yambere (bivuze ko ari Isi) bumaze ibisekuruza cumi na bitatu, kuburyo benshi mubayituye bavutse kandi bazapfa batigeze bakandagiza ikirenge hasi. Ibi ntibishimisha abanzi, Eliya Kalgan (John Phillip), wafatanije naba pirate binjira muri sisitemu ya Corona Borealis yegeranye n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ubwato MacPhearson (James Ryan). Kalgan yateguye umugambi wo guhungabanya uburyo bwo kugendesha ubwato bwa Southern Sun no gukoresha Enforcers, abapolisi b'ubwo bwato, kugira ngo bashimute ubwo bwato kandi babuyobore kuri ubu buryo. Kuri ubu, abatuye "Southern Sun"' nta kundi byagenda uretse kwemera "ubuntu" bwe.

A Dry White Season ni filime y'ikinamico yo muri, Amerika yo mu mwaka 1989 yayobowe na Euzhan Palcy ikinwamo na Donald Sutherland, Jürgen Prochnow, Marlon Brando, Janet Suzman, Zakes Mokae naSusan Sarandon yanditswe na Colin Welland na Palcy, ishingiye ku gitabo cya André Brink cyitwa A Dry White Season. Robert Bolt nawe yatanze umusanzu wo gusubiramo amashusho atemewe. Yashyizwe muri Afirika y"epfo mu mwaka wa 1976 kandi ivuga kubyerekeye ivanguramoko. Brando yatorewe muri Oscar nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza.
Mu 1976, muri Afurika y'epfo mu gihe cya apartheid, Ben Du Toit (Donald Sutherland) ni umwarimu w’ishuri ryo muri Afurika yepfo ku ishuri ry’abazungu gusa. Umunsi umwe, umuhungu w’umurimyi we, Gordon Ngubene (Winston Ntshona), yakubiswe n’abapolisi bera nyuma yo gufatwa n’abapolisi mu myigaragambyo y’amahoro hagamijwe politiki nziza y’uburezi ku birabura muri Afurika yepfo. Gordon asaba Ben ubufasha. Ben amaze kwanga gutabara kubera ko yizeraga abapolisi, Gordon na we yafashwe na polisi kandi akorerwa iyicarubozo na Kapiteni Stolz (Jürgen Prochnow). Bitandukanye n'ubushake bw'umugore we Susan (Janet Suzman) n'umukobwa we Suzette (Susannah Harker), Ben agerageza kumenya byinshi ku ibura ry'umurinyi we wenyine. Nyuma y’ivumburwa ry’ubwicanyi bwakozwe na Gordon n’umuhungu we bombi, Ben yahisemo kugeza iki kibazo imbere y’urukiko na Ian McKenzie (Marlon Brando) nk'umunyamategeko ariko aratsindwa. Nyuma yaho, akomeje gukora wenyine kandi ashyigikira itsinda rito ryabirabura, barimo umushoferi we Stanley Makhaya (Zakes Mokae), kugira ngo afashe abandi bateze imbere imibereho.

Have You Seen Drum Recently? yasohotse 1989, ni film ikaba ikoresha amafoto aturuka muri "Drum" archives ikaba ivuga inkuru kinyamakuru n'inyandiko ku buzima bw'umuco na politiki ya Afurika y'Epfo. Mu myaka ya za 1950, "Ingoma" yibanze ku birabura bo mu mijyi baba mu isi yiganjemo ivanguramoko. Harimo ingingo zerekeye umujyi wa jazz umujyi w'ubugizi bwa nabi, ibihimbano na siporo byerekanaga ibyiringiro, ibyifuzo no kwiheba byumujyi, umujyi wigishije abirabura.
Iyobowe na Jürgen Schadeberg, iyi filime ikubiyemo amashusho ya Oliver Tambo nk'umunyamategeko, Trevor Huddleston yerekanye ko yamaganye isenywa rya Sophiatown, Nelson Mandela wagaragaye mu bakinnyi bateramakofe, Chief Luthuli wegukanye igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel ndetse n'umuririmbyi Miriam Makeba. Umuziki winyuma ushingiye kumuziki wo muri 1950, harimo itsinda rinini, jazz, swing, kwela na.

'4 Play (yasubiwemo muri" Nollywood nka 4 can Play" by De-Kross Movies, kuko gukwirakwiza mpuzamahanga) ni filimi yasohotse muuri 2010
yakorewe muri Nigeria na Ghana ikozwe mu bwoko bwa romantic blue comedy yayobowe na Frank Rajah Arase, Star Majid Michel, Yvonne Okoro, John Dumelo, Jackie Appiah, Roselyn Ngissah na Juliet Ibrahim. 2016 ni filimi yasohotse muri 2010 ikorerwa muri Gana mu buryo butaziguye iganisha ku bikorwa bya Siyansi. yayobowe na pseudonymous na Ninja. Iyi filime igaragara mu mwaka wa 2010 kandi ikurikira Abanyagana bagomba kurokoka itsinda ry’abanyamahanga bashaka gutera Accra bizeye gukoloniza isi mu mwaka wa 2016. Filime yamenyekanye cyane kuri trailer idasanzwe nukuntu yari ifite ibibazo byingengo yimari.
