Iyi trailer yerekanwe ku gice cya 2015 cy'ibiganiro bitinze nijoro "Conan", irimo umushyitsi TJ Miller. Filime yacitsemo ibice bibiri, kimwe nibisanzwe ku isoko ryerekanwa na videwo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba.

Adams Apples ni urukurikirane rw'amafilime yo muri Gana, yakinwe na Yvonne Okoro, Joselyn Dumas, John Dumelo, Naa Ashorkor Mensa-Doku, Anima Misa Amoah, Adjetey Anang, Helene Asante, SoulKnight Jazz, Jasmine Baroudi, Vincent McCauley, Roselyn Ngissah, Fred Kanebi. Urukurikirane rugizwe na firime icumi zerekana amakinamico, azwi ku izina rya "chapters", yakozwe na Ken Attoh kandi iyobowe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso.
Urukurikirane film bukurikira ubuzima mu muryango wa Adam, bakaba bagizwe na Doris Adams (Anima Misa Amoah), umupfakazi wa ikintu KALIMANZIRA umudiplomate, n'abakobwa be batatu; Baaba (Okoro), Jennifer (Dumas) na Kuukua (Mensah-Doku), berekana uburyo bakemura umuryango wabo utoroshye, ubuzima bw'urukundo, amabanga ya buri muntu, ibinyoma no kwicuza. televiziyo drama series, na title kimwe kwerekanwa muri Gashyantare 2013, kandi kuva batangiye airing ku DSTV 's Afurika Magic televiziyo yashyizeho nyuma y'umwaka igice cya cumi cy'urukurikirane rwa firime.

Agony of Christ ni film yo muri Gana yo muri 2009 iyobowe na Frank Rajah Arase. akaba ari film yamenyekanye cyane kuko iganisha ku kwizera kwa muntu kuko igaragaza Umwuka wera ndetse n'umwuka wa sekibi imbaraga hagati y'umupadiri ndetse n'abapfumu hakabikorera ku musore umwe uba utazi icyo gukora.
Umusore yahunze umudugudu we kuko umupadiri gakondo yashakaga ko yicwa. Yakijijwe nabakristo bamutoje ubumenyi bw'ubukristo aravuka ubwa kabiri. Yagarutse mu mudugudu we aho basengaga imana nto. Igikorwa cye cyo guhindura abantu bose bo mu mudugudu kuba umukirisitu cyaburijwemo n’umupadiri w’igihugu, wemera ko ibyo bibaho bityo amushora mu ntambara yo mu mwuka.

Aloe Vera ni filim yasohotse muri 2020 yo muri Gana ikaba yarateguwe kandi itunganywa amshusho na Manaa Abdallah afatanyije na Anny Araba bose bari bayobowe na Peter Sedufia."
Amatsinda abiri yabantu atuye mumudugudu umwe, Aloes na Vera. Hariho uguhangana gukabije hagati yabo kwihanganira no kubana kandi buri ruhande rurangwa nibara ryarwo. Iyo abana b'abayobozi b'umujyi ', Aloewin na Veraline, bakundanye bagomba gushaka uburyo bwo guhuza iyo miryango yombi nubwo bangana. Umuganda nyuma uba umwe bitewe nubusabane hagati yabo bombi.
Izina ry'iyi filime ryatangajwe mu mwaka wa 2019, hamwe n'itangazo rivuga ko umuyobozi Peter Sedufia yubaka amazu 100 mu rwego rwo gushinga umudugudu wo gufata amashusho mu gace ka Dabala, mu karere ka Volta muri Gana. Abakinnyi Priscilla Opoku Agyemang, Nana Ama Mcbrown, na Roselyn Ngissah nabo bagaragaye ko bakinnye muri firime. Worlasi yazanywe no gutanga amajwi ya firime. Sedufia yavuze ko iyi filime ari "kuzamura umushinga we mbere kandi igamije guha abantu ikintu gifite agaciro n'igihe cyabo." "Aloe Vera" yari ifite ingengo yimari ingana na N58.204.500 ariko yagiye hejuru yingengo yimari N77.606.000 kubera amatariki yo gufata amashusho nyuma yimvura nyinshi yangije ibikoresho byo gufata amashusho. Imvura kandi yangije cyane firime, Sedufia yavuze ko byagaragaye ko ari ikibazo gikomeye.

Ama Ata Aidoo, "née" Christina Ama Aidoo (wavutse ku ya 23 Werurwe 1942) ni umwanditsi wo muri Gana, umusizi, umwanditsi w'amakinamico n'umunyeshuri. Yari Minisitiri w’uburezi uyobowe na Jerry Rawlings administration. Mu 2000, yashinze Fondasiyo ya Mbaasem yo guteza imbere no gushyigikira umurimo w’abanditsi b’abagore b’abanyafurika.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Aidoo yavutse ku ya 23 Werurwe 1942 i Saltpond mu mu gace ko hagati muri Gana, Amakuru amwe arimo Megan Behrent, kaminuza ya Brown, na Afurika Ninde wavuze ko yavutse ku ya 31 Werurwe 1940. Yakuriye mu rugo rw'umwami wa Fante, umukobwa wa Nana Yaw Fama, umutware wa Abeadzi Kyiakor, na Maame Abasema. Yakuze mugihe cy' ubwongereza bushya bwa neocolonialism bwaberaga mu gihugu cye. Sekuru yiciwe na neocolonialiste, ibyo bikaba byaratumye se yibanda ku kamaro ko kwigisha abana n'imiryango yo mu mudugudu n'amateka yabayeho. Ibi byatumye afungura ishuri rya mbere mu mudugudu wabo maze bituma Aidoo yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Wesley Girls aho yahisemo bwa mbere ko ashaka kuba umwanditsi.
Aidoo yize amashuri yisumbuye ya Wesley Girls i Cape Coast, kuva 1961 kugeza 1964. Amashuri yisumbuye, yiyandikishije muri kaminuza ya Gana, muri Legon aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Arts mu Cyongereza ndetse yandika n'ikinamico ye ya mbere yise "“Dilemma of Ghost”", mu 1964. Ikinamico yasohowe na Longman umwaka wakurikiyeho, bituma Aidoo aba umukinnyi wa mbere w’amakinamico wo muri Afurika.
Niwe filime ya documentaire ya 2014, "Ubuhanzi bwa Ama Ata Aidoo", yakozwe na Yaba Badoe.
Ikinamico ya Aidoo irimo "The Dilemma of Ghost", yakorewe i Legon mu 1964 (yatangajwe bwa mbere 1965) na Pittsburgh mu 1988, na "Anowa", yasohowe mu 1971 ikorerwa i Londres mu 1991.

Azali ni film y'ikinamico yo muri Gana yasohotse 2018 iyobowe na Kwabena Gyansah. Yatoranijwe muri Gana muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga igaragara mu bihembo bya 92 Awards Academy, ariko ntabwo yatowe. Bwari ubwambere Ghana itanga firime nziza muri Oscar award.
Umukobwa ukiri muto, Amina, abana na nyina, nyirakuru na nyirarume mu mudugudu muto hanze ya Accra. Abaho ubuzima bwiza ariko burambiranye nyina yifuza kumubohora. Nyirakuru yifuriza Amina kurongora umusaza ukomoka mu mudugudu wabo. Nyina wa Amina arigaragambya kandi agurisha Amina ku muntu atazi atizeye ka azabona ubuzima bwiza muri uyu mujyi. Mu rugendo rwe Amina ahura numusore nawe wagurishijwe akiri umusore kandi muburyo bumwe, aba inshuti ye yonyine. Bombi bahunze hamwe nitsinda rito ry'abana nabo bagurishijwe. Mugihe bombi batangiye imirimo itandukanye binyuze muri Accra bagerageza kubona ibyo bakomeza.
Iyi filime yatowe mu byiciro 15 muri Gana Movie Awards 2018. Yakiriye nomination 19 muri Golden Movie Awards 2019.

The Boy Kumasenu ni filime yasohotse muri 1952 yakorewe muri Gana n'abakozi ba firime yo mu Bwongereza. Yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Sean Graham uhereye ku nyandiko ya Graham na John Wyllie. Amanota yari Elisabeth Lutyens. Filime yamenyekanye kandi igira ingaruka mubuzima rusange bwabaturage. Yagaragaje ibimenyetso by'ejo hazaza byatumye bijyana no kurwanya ubukoloni n'impinduka mu mibereho mu bwigenge bushya bwa Gana.
The Boy Kumasenu yari filime ya mbere yagaragaye yakozwe na Gold Coast Film Unit, yashakaga gukora film zombi zigisha kandi zitanga amakuru kugirango zikwirakwizwe muri Gana ndetse no mumahanga. Uyu muyobozi yari Sean Graham, wari umunyeshuri w’umwanditsi w’inyandiko John Grierson, nubwo Graham yahisemo gukora cyane mu mvugo ya sinema izwi. Umucuranzi Guy Warren yari umwe mu bakinnyi, yakinnye nka Yeboah.
Yafashwe amashusho mu 1950 na 1951 i Accra, Kedze na Keta, hamwe nabakinnyi batabigize umwuga, ikorerwa i Londres. Yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Gana mu 1952 ariko abayikoze bagize ikibazo cyo kuyikwirakwiza muri Gana, kubera imyizerere y’uko Abanyafurika bakunda filime zo guhunga. Ariko, byaje kugaragara ko ikunzwe cyane. Yahawe impamyabumenyi n'Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Venice kandi ryerekanwe bwa mbere mu Bwongereza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Edinburgh 1952; yerekanwe no mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Berlin 1953. Yatorewe igihembo cya Filime y'Ubwongereza ya Filime ya Filime nziza mu 1953.
Iyi filime ivuga amateka y’umuhungu witwa Kumasenu wimukiye mu mujyi wa Accra avuye mu mudugudu muto w’uburobyi, yatewe inkunga na mubyara we Agboh imigani ikabije y’ibitangaza byo mu mujyi. Ashonje, yiba umugati afatwa n'abapolisi, ariko arokorwa na muganga n'umugore we basanga akora. Agboh agerageza kwiba Kumasenu muganga, ariko Kumasenu yanga imigambi ya mubyara we.

Broken Mirror ni filimi yo muri Gana yasohotse muri 2014 ikozwe na Media 5 Studio Productions. James Gardiner, Fred Amugi, Jackie Appiah, Roselyn Ngissah, Mikki Osei Berko, Victoria Lebene Mekpah na Jasmine Baroudi ni abakinnyi bingenzi. Yanditswe na Pappa Deric kandi yakozwe na David Owusu hamwe na Mikki Osei Berko nk'umuyobozi. Ninkuru yumugore uhinda umushyitsi mugihe amahirwe y'umukunzi we ahindutse neza, nyuma yo kumuhagararaho mubihe bikomeye.
Thompson yakinnye na James Gardiner, ni umunyeshuri urangije kaminuza udafite akazi ufata ububaji kugira ngo abeho. Umukunzi we Priscilla (Jackie Appiah) yamuhaye inkunga y'amarangamutima ndetse n'amafaranga. Priscilla udakize kandi akora akazi ko kudoda, ahora ashimishwa na bagenzi be Evelyn (Roselyn Ngissah) na Angela (Victoria Lebene Mekpah) kubera urukundo rwe no gushyigikira byimazeyo Thompson. Kumwizera kumutsindira mugihe cyImana birakomeye kandi arabikora mugihe cy'umwaka.
Barashyingirwa, barishima kandi bategereje umwana wabo wambere, mugihe Thompson yakiriye amashusho yerekana Priscilla nundi mugabo. Ibi bimuha kumva ko ariganya kandi biganisha ku gusenyuka. Evelyn amenyesha umukunzi we Priscilla mugihe runaka. Hari ukuntu yemera ko Priscilla yamwibye kandi niwe uri ku mashusho hamwe na we.

The Burial of Kojo ni filime yikinamico yo muri Gana yasohotse 2018 yanditswe, yahimbwe kandi iyobowe na Blitz Bazawule. Yakozwe na Bazawule, Ama K. Abebrese na Kwaku Obeng Boateng, yafatiwe amashusho yose muri Gana ku ngengo yimari iciriritse, hamwe nabakozi baho ndetse nabakinnyi benshi ba mbere. Iyi filime ivuga amateka ya Kojo, usigaye apfira mu kirombe cya zahabu cyatawe, mu gihe umukobwa we muto Esi yagendaga mu gihugu cy'umwuka kugira ngo amukize.
Yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi i New York ku ya 21 Nzeri 2018, mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Urban World, aho ryamenyekanye nk'Imvugo Nziza (Sinema y'Isi). Iyi filime yakiriye ibihembo icyenda mu bihembo bya 15 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards kandi yatsindiye bibiri, harimo Filime Nziza Yambere Yakozwe n'Umuyobozi. CYatanzwe na ARRAY kandi yasohotse kuri serivise ya Netflix ku ya 31 Werurwe 2019, ibaye filime ya mbere yo muri Gana yerekanwe bwa mbere mu bihugu byatoranijwe ku isi, kuri Netflix.

Coz Ov Moni 2 (FOKN) -lni film y'umuziki wa Gana yasohotse 2013 yakozwe na FOKN BOIS kandi iyobowe n'umukinnyi wamafirime wigenga wo muri Gana King Luu. Filime numuziki uvugwa byose ni mucyongereza cya Pidgin, ariko subtitles zirerekanwa. ni filime yamenyekanye cyane muri Gana kuko ikurura abakunzi bumuziki ndetse na filimi.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Gana ku ya 23 Ukuboza 2013 mu nzu mberabyombi ya Gana i Accra, yerekanwe muri Amerika ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2014 i Cantina Royale mu mujyi wa New York ndetse no mu Bwongereza ku ya 24 Nzeri 2014 i Hackney Attic i Londres. Iyi filime kandi yerekanwe mu minsi mikuru itandukanye ya firime, harimo iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Afurika (Tinapa), iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Durban (Durban), Norient Musikfilm Festival (Bern) na Fantastic Fest (Austin). Nyuma yaje gusohoka kuri DVD, hamwe no gukuramo ubuntu kuri Soundtrack kuri buri kopi yaguzwe ya firime.

The Cursed Ones ni filime yo mu Bwongereza ya 2015 yayobowe na Nana Obiri Yeboah ikorwa na Nicholas K. Lory. Amashusho yumwimerere yanditswe na Maximilian Claussen. Iyi filime ivuga amateka y’umunyamakuru wacitse intege ndetse n’umupasitori ukiri muto ufite ibitekerezo, urwanira kubohora umukobwa uregwa ubupfumu mu maboko ya gahunda yononekaye n’imiziririzo hagati muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba.
Filime yahawe ibihembo 3 bya African Movie Academy Awards mu 2016 "kubuyobozi bwiza", "Sinema nziza", hamwe nubushakashatsi "bwiza". Yatowe mu bihembo 13 bya AMAA byose hamwe, bituma iba filime yatowe kurusha izindi mu 2016.
Filime yafatiwe ahantu hose muri Gana. Abenshi muri iyo filime bakorewe mu mudugudu umwe wo mu karere k'iburasirazuba bwa Gana.
The Cursed Ones berekanwe kuri Hackney Picturehouse i Londere mu Bwongereza mu rwego rwo gutoranya ku mugaragaro iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Afurika ryitwa Royal African Society. Mu 2016 film kandi screened mu marushanwa ya Pan African Film Festival i Los Angeles, muri Atlanta Film Festival, ku Helsinki African Film Festival, 27 ngarukamwaka Emden International Film Festival, na New York Iserukiramuco rya Filime nyafurika mu kigo cya Lincoln gishinzwe ubuhanzi aho cyatanzwe na Human Rights Watch.

Da Yie (izwi kandi ku izina ry'icyongereza Good Night) ni filime ngufi yasohotse muri 2019 iyobowe na Anthony Nti. Muri 2020, yatsindiye iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Clermont-Ferrand kandi yari mu bahatanira ibihembo bya BAFTA Los Angeles Awards. "Filime Da Yie" yakozwe na Anthony Nti, Chingiz Karibekov na Dimitri Verbeek, ikwirakwizwa ku isi yose na sosiyete mpuzamahanga yo gutunganya no gukwirakwiza filimi Salaud Morisset.
Umusore Matilda na Prince bajyanwa murugendo ruhindura ubuzima numuntu utazwi..
Kuva yatangizwa, iyi filime yatoranijwe mu minsi mikuru irenga 130 ku isi. Muri Gashyantare 2021, yakoze urutonde rwibikorwa bya firime ngufi ya Live ibihembo bya 93 bya Academy.

Drexciya ni filimi yo muri Gana yasohotse 2010 akaba documentary film ntoya yayoboye na Akosua Adoma Owusu afatanije na California Institute wa Arts (CalArts). Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu ikinamico mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi Rotterdam 2011 kandi yitabira "Video ya Changing Same" mu nzu ndangamurage ya Studio i Harlem, muri New York.
"Drexciya" yerekana ikigo cyo koga rusange cyatawe giherereye i Accra, muri Gana cyashyizwe kuri Riviera. Riviera icyarimwe yari iterambere ridasanzwe, rigizwe nizamuka ryiza cyane hamwe na hoteri yinyenyeri eshanu. Kuva mu myaka ya za 70, Riviera yaguye mubihe bidasanzwe. Iyi documentaire ngufi yahumetswe n imigani ya afro-futurist yakwirakwijwe nitsinda rya Drexciya ryitwa Detroit. Bavuga ko Drexciya ari umugani w’amazi utuwe n’abana bataravuka b’abagore b’abanyafrika bajugunywe mu nyanja mu gihe cy’ubucuruzi bw’abacakara ba Trans-Atlantike. Aba bana bamenyereye kandi bahinduka kugirango bahumeke mumazi.

Fix Us ni firime yo muri Gana ya 2019 yakozwe na Yvonne Nelson kandi iyobowe na Pascal Amanfo. Filime yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi muri Gana Movie Awards.
Abakobwa batatu bakiri bato bafite icyifuzo cyo kuba superstars bahurira ahakorerwa igenzura aho bari bafite inzozi zisa, babaye inshuti hanyuma nyuma ubuzima bwabo bwarose ariko bumva ko hari ikintu kibuze mubuzima bwabo nyuma yo kugera ku bwamamare n'ubutunzi.
Abakinnyi benshi b'Abanyafurika bamenyekanye ko bakinnye muri iyi filime, barimo Yvonne Okoro, igikomangoma David Osei, na Michelle Attoh. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu gukina imbuga nkoranyambaga Hajia4real n'umucuranzi Irene Logan.
"Fix Us" yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Gana ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2019 mu nzu mberabyombi ya Silverbird i Accra, nyuma yerekanwa muri Gana ndetse no mu tundi turere twa Afurika. Muri 2020 firime yerekanwe kuri Netflix.
Pulse Nigeria yashyize ahagaragara "Fix Us" nk'imwe muri filime nshya nziza zo muri Gana z'umwaka, aho ikinyamakuru "Glitz Africa" kivuga ko yakiriwe neza nyuma yo gusohoka. Amakuru ya Kemi Filani yanenze iyi filime, avuga ko ikubiyemo "gukina nabi, kuvuga inkuru ziteye isoni, gukomeza kubaho nabi, gutura ahantu hamwe n'ibibazo byinshi bibabaza."

Heart of Men (Yongeye gusubizwa muri Nollywood nka Forbidden Fruits na Henrikesim Multimedia Concept for International distribution) ni filime ishimishije yo muri Gana no muri Nijeriya yo mu 2009 yakozwe &amp; iyobowe na Frank Rajah Arase, ikinwamo na Majid Michel, John Dumelo, igikomangoma David Osei na Yvonne Nelson. Yakiriye nomination eshanu muri Awards ya 6 ya Afrika Movie Academy Awards.
Muri rusange iyi filime yanenzwe guteza imbere ubwambure muri firime no kumenyekanisha amashusho yoroheje kuri Nigeriya na Gana yo mu rugo. Yashyizwe ku rutonde rw'inyenyeri 3 kuri 5 kuri Nollywood Reinvented yashimye ubuziranenge, imiterere n'amanota ya muzika, ariko ugasanga umugambi utoroshye kandi amashusho yimibonano mpuzabitsina yarenze.

House of Gold (yasohotse nka Family Runs kuri DVD) ni filime yo gusetsa yo muri Gana yo muri Nijeriya 2013, yakozwe na Yvonne Nelson ikayoborwa na Pascal Amanfo. Irimo Majid Michel, Yvonne Nelson, Omawumi Megbele, Mercy Chinwo, Ice Prince Zamani, Eddie Watson na Francis Odega.
Iyi filime ivuga amateka y’umucuruzi w’umucuruzi ukunda gusabana, Dan Ansah Williams upfa azize kanseri kandi yabwiwe ko asigaje ibyumweru bitandatu ngo abeho. Afata icyemezo abifashijwemo n’avoka we guhamagara abana be bose basubira mu rugo, abenshi muri bo bakaba baravutse batashyingiranywe ndetse n’ibintu bitandukanye bitemewe. Ubumwe bwongeye kuzunguruka ibintu byinshi bitunguranye nkuko buri mwana agarutse afite gahunda, itanga ibisubizo bisekeje.
Yasohotse ku ya 12 Mata 2013 muri Gana no ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2013 muri Nijeriya. Nubwo iyi filime yagiye ihura n’ibitekerezo bitari byiza, yakiriye ibihembo muri Golden Icons Academy Movie Awards 2013, 2013 Gana Movie Awards, 2014 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Awards na 2013 Zulu African Film Academy Awards. Yatsindiye ibihembo bitandatu kuri icya nyuma, harimo ibyiciro: "Ishusho nziza", "Umuyobozi mwiza", "Umukinnyi witwaye neza", "Umukinnyi witwaye neza" na "Sinema nziza".
Inzu yamamaza "Inzu ya Zahabu" yasohotse kuri YouTube ku ya 4 Werurwe 2013. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Gana ku ya 12 Mata 2013 no muri Nijeriya ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2013, mbere yo kujya ahagaragara muri rusange muri Nijeriya. Yasohotse kuri DVD ifite umutwe wa "Family Runs" mu Gushyingo 2013 na Henrikesim Multimedia Concept.

I Told You So ni firime yo muri Gana yo mu 1970. Filime yerekana abanya Gana nuburyo bwabo bwo kubaho muburyo bwo gusebanya. Iratanga kandi ubushishozi mubuzima bw'umukobwa ukiri muto utakiriye inama za se mugihe agiye kurongora umugabo, ntacyo yari azi kumugabo agiye kurongora, ahubwo yakiriye inama za nyina na nyirarume kuko agendera k'ubutunzi n'imbaraga umugabo afite.
Uyu mukobwa ukiri muto yaje kumenya ko umugabo agomba kurongora yari igisambo cyitwaje imbunda. Ntiyishimiye ibyabaye byose. Papa abajije uko byagenze, asubiza ko umugabo yagombaga kurongora ari umujura witwaje imbunda; ise yarangije avuga ati "Nakubwiye gutya".

John na John ni firime yo muri Gana igaragaramo inshuti ebyiri bombi bitwaga John. John umwe yashutse umugabo amugurisha zahabu mpimbano. Inshuti zombi zarimo zihunga n'amafaranga, ariko imodoka yabo yagenze nabi barara mu nzu y'abashyitsi. Igihe bakuraga amafaranga mu gikapu cyabo, yaguye hasi itera impungenge mu bashyitsi ndetse n'abakozi muri hoteri aho abantu bose bashakaga kwiba amafaranga
Igishimishije, iyi filime niyo yagurishije cyane kurenza uko babikekaga, ariko yanze kwemerwa muri Afrika yepfo kuko hasohotse yo indi bisa yitwa Skeem yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Tim Greene mumwaka wa 2011.
Muri 2017 abanyamakuru ba Ghanain begereye Greene kugira ngo barebe ibyo Asamoah avuga ko yahawe uruhushya rwo guhuza iyo filimi, ariko we akaba atari ayifite. Asamoah yemeye kugura uburenganzira bwo gusubiramo, ariko ntiyigeze akurikiza amasezerano. Nta kirego cyemewe n'amategeko, kubera ko ikiguzi cyo gukurikirana urubanza rw'umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge kirega Asamoah kitari kuba ingirakamaro.

Kwaku Ananse ni film ngufi ya 2013 iyobowe na Akosua Adoma Owusu. Filime ngufi ikomatanya ibintu byigice cya autobiographical hamwe numugani wa Kwaku Ananse, umunyamayeri mu nkuru zo muri Afrika yuburengerazuba na Karayibe bigaragara nkigitagangurirwa numugabo. Umugani wa Kwaku Ananse uhujwe ninkuru y'umusore wo hanze witwa Nyan Koronhwea, witabiriye gushyingura se. Mu gihe cyo gushyingura, yasubiye mu ishyamba ashakisha se. Iyi filime yakinnye n'umucuranzi w'icyamamare Koo Nimo n'umukinnyi w'amafirime w'inararibonye Grace Omaboe.
Amashusho yanditswe hamwe n’umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Pakisitani n’umunyamerika akaba na rwiyemezamirimo Iram Parveen Bilal. Iyi nyandiko yandikiwe MaameYaa Boafo, umunyamerika wavukiye muri Pakisitani wavukiye muri Gana, wahoze ari umukinnyi wa mbere nka Nyan Koronhwea. Ariko, itsinda ryababyaye mumujyi wa New York amaherezo ryafashe umwanzuro wo gusubiramo imico mugihe cyabanjirije umusaruro hamwe na Jojo Abot, umuhanzi ukomoka muri Gana.
Dushingiye ku migani ikungahaye yo muri Gana, iyi filime ngufi y’ubumaji ihuza ibintu byanditswe mu buzima bwa Owusu n’imigenzo ya rubanda kugira ngo ivuga amateka y’umukobwa ukiri muto w’umunyamerika wagarutse muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba gushyingura se, ariko akavumbura umwirondoro we wihishe kabiri.
Kwaku Ananse ni umugani gakondo wo muri Afrika y'uburengerazuba kubyerekeye ikiremwa kigizwe numuntu nigitagangurirwa, kimara imyaka ikusanya ubwenge bwose bwisi mumasafuriya y'imbaho. Mugihe agerageza guhisha inkono mugiti, ntashobora kubona uburyo bwo kuyishyira hejuru mumashami yacyo. Iyo umuhungu we muto, Ntikuma amweretse inzira, Kwaku Ananse ararakara cyane, ajugunya inkono hasi. Iraturika kandi ubwenge burashira. Umuntu wese arihuta, yizeye gukiza ibyo ashoboye.
Nyan Koronhwea asubira kwa se Kwaku Ananse wavukiye muri Gana kumuhamba. Bari barabuze umubano hagati yabo kera. Yatandukanye ibyiyumvo by'ubuzima bwa se n'umuryango umwe muri Gana undi muri Amerika. Yarengewe n’ishyingurwa, asubira mu isi y’umwuka ashakisha Kwaku Ananse.
"Kwaku Ananse" yatorewe kuba Golden Bear mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Berlin kandi yegukana igihembo cyiza cya Filime ngufi mu bihembo bya 9 bya Afurika Movie Academy Academy Awards. Iyi filime kandi yakiriye abacamanza badasanzwe mu Ishyirahamwe Cinémas et Cultures d'Afrique 2015 i Angers, mu Bufaransa.

Love or Something Like That ni film yo muri Gana no muri Nigeriya yasohotse muri 2014 iyobowe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso. Irimo John Dumelo, Joselyn Dumas na OC Ukeje. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere i Londres ku ya 28 Ugushyingo 2014 muri Odeon Sinema. Yakiriye nomination ebyiri muri 11 ya Afrika Movie Academy Awards.
Filime ivuga inkuru ivuga ku bashakanye bashya no kurangaza bahuye nako mukazi nyuma gato y'ubukwe. Kwarley Mettle (Joselyn Dumas) yaryamanye n'umukunzi we, Henry Dominic (OC Ukeje) atabishaka, imyaka ibiri mbere yo gushaka. Ibi byatumye asaba ko umugabo we, Alex Walker (John Dumelo) yakoresheje uburinzi igihe cyose baryamanye. Henry na Kwarley bongeye guhura nyuma yo kwinjira mu bitaro bye kwivuza. Henry amaze kumenya uwahoze ari umukunzi we, yahise ava mu bitaro atamuvugishije. Kwarley yagiye muri dosiye ye y'abarwayi, kugira ngo arebe ko arwaye kanseri na AID. Yabonye aho atuye hanyuma amusura. Agezeyo, amubwira ibyamutengushye.
Iyi filime yabonye ibitekerezo bibi kuri 360nobs.com, yashushanyije isano iri hagati ya film na "Tango with Me", indi film iyobowe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso. Yagaragaje ko muri filime zombi, abashakanye bibagora gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina kubera ikibazo cyo gufata ku ngufu. Yagaragaje kandi ibibazo bidasanzwe byo gushyingiranwa nk'ingaruka muri filime zombi. "Tango hamwe Nanjye" Urukundo cyangwa Ikintu nkicyo byombi byarangiye abagabo bumva bafite icyaha cyo kutita cyane kubo bashakanye. Byongeye kandi, Devil in Details indi filime yakozwe nuyu muyobozi, yagaragajwe nkufite ibiganiro nka firime mugihe cyo kugisha inama abashakanye. Yanenze kandi Kwarley kuba yarakubiswe nyuma yo kubona Henry bwa mbere nubwo afite dosiye ku meza ye. Hanyuma, iyi filime yasobanuwe ko ifite ishingiro ridakwiriye kubera ko ubu ari ibisanzwe ko abashakanye bipimisha virusi itera sida mbere yo gushyingirwa mu nsengero, tutibagiwe ko umugeni yari umuganga.

Nakom ni filime yikinamico yakozwe mu mwaka wa 2016 iyobowe na Kelly Daniela Norris na TW Pittman. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya 66 rya Berlin mu gice cya Panorama kandi yatumiriwe kuzerekanwa bwa mbere muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru mu iserukiramuco rya new diroctorss i New York.
"Nakom" inkuru yimbitse yaturutse mu majyaruguru ya Gana, Nakom akurikira Iddrisu, umunyeshuri w’ubuvuzi ufite ubuhanga ugomba gusubira mu mudugudu w'iwabo nyuma y'urupfu rutunguranye rwa se maze agaharanira ko umuryango we ubaho.
"Nakom" yatsindiye igihembo cya Audience Choice mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 37 rya Durban. Yatorewe igihembo cyiza cya mbere cyiza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 66 rya Berlin. Mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Seattle, ryatowe mu marushanwa y'abayobozi bashya. Yatorewe igihembo cyigenga cyigenga cya 2016 John Cassavetes

Nana Means King ni film yo muri Gana ya 2015 iyobowe kandi yakozwe na Nana Obiri Yeboah, ni firime yakunzwe cyane muri Gana ndetse no ku isi yose muri rusange.
Nana Kwame, umwimukira utemewe n'amategeko wo muri Gana ukorera mu Bwongereza wabuze byose kubera ubuhemu, asanga yatangiriye kuri odyssey ku giti cye cyo kwivumbura. Yambuwe ibintu hafi ya byose, aho atuye, ndetse n'icyubahiro, agomba kubona inzira anyuze mu butaka butamenyerewe bw'abimuwe kandi batagaragara. Ni muri iyi saha y'umwijima, ku batishoboye cyane, ubuzima bwe buhinduka mu buryo butunguranye iyo abonye ubwiza n'urukundo bikura mu butayu bwa beto. Nubwo indorerwamo ari Shauna, ahita amenya ko ibyahise bishobora kuba gereza twaremye kubwubwenge bwacu. Mu gufasha kuvana Shauna muri gereza ye ni bwo yaje kurekurwa wenyine.

No Tears For Ananse ni filime yo muri Gana yayobowe na Sam Aryeetey kandi yanditswe na Ato Kwamina Yanney mu 1968.
Filime ya rubanda isobanura uburyo amayeri Ananse agerageza kurenza umuryango we kubera igitutu cyo guha umuryango we burimunsi. Yigize nk'uwapfuye abwira umuryango we kumushyingura mu isambu ye, bityo aribwa n'abakozi bashinzwe ibiryo mu murima igihe cyatinze. Umuryango washyizeho umutego ukoresheje igishusho cyometseho kole. Ananse abonye igishusho atekereza ko ari kizima nuko atangira no gukubitaho urushyi arumirwa. Bukeye bwaho, yafashwe n'umuryango ndetse n'abaturage.

No Time To Die ni filime yo gusetsa no gukundana yo muri Gana yo mu 2006 yakozwe na Wolfgang Panzer, Umudage, umwanditsi akaba n'umuyobozi kandi yayikoranye na King Ampaw, igihembo yatsindiye nk'umuyobozi akaba n'umukinnyi wa Gana. Filime yari iyobowe na King Ampaw. Umuziki wahimbwe na Ben Michael Mankhamba umucuranzi wa gitari wa Malawi, umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w'indirimbo. Imyambarire yateguwe na Lisa Meier. Yakozwe mu 2006 muri Gana no mu Budage. Ni firime ivuga icyongereza imara iminota 95. Yatoranijwe mu Kuboza 2016 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime rya Afurika Diaspora (ADIFF) i New York.
Asante, umushoferi utwara imodoka zo gushyingura muri Gana, akeneye uwo bashakanye ariko akazi ke gakanga abadamu benshi. Atangira kureba umukiriya (Esi) wapfushije nyina, akamenya uburyo bwo kumuganiriza. ariko se akabuza uwo mubano kagati ya Esi na Asante. Asante arakomeza ahinduka umushoferi wambere wimodoka yo gushyingura i Accra ubashije kurongora. Iyi filime yari iyo gusobanura umuco nyafurika werekana impinduka mumigenzo yo gushyingura abanyafurika kubera ingaruka zabakoloni muri Afrika.

One Night in Vegas ni filime yikinamico yo muri Nigeriya 2013 iyobowe na John Uche. Irimo Jimmy Jean-Louis, John Dumelo, Yvonne Nelson, Sarodj Bertin, Van Vicker, Michael Blackson na Koby Maxwell. Filime yibanze ku Bashakanye bo muri Gana bagerageza kunoza umubano wabo bafata urugendo i Las Vegas. Biteganijwe ku ngengo y’imari ntoya kandi ifatwa amashusho mu gihe cyiminsi 19, iyi filime yamenyekanye ku isoko rya Nollywood USA kubera ko iyi filime yiteguye kuzamura umurongo wa filime nyafurika ikoresheje inzira y’iburengerazuba ku bwiza bw'umusaruro n'ibipimo. By'umwihariko gukoresha uburambe bw'umukinnyi w'amafirime w'umunyamerika (Tim " Black Magic Tim " Wilson) kugirango akore Cinematografi na Muhinduzi. filimi yarekuwe kumugaragaro muri Ghana yari ubwa mbere hasohotse turnout mu mateka ya Silverbird Theatre mu Accra Mall. Film yerekanywe ku muryango w'Abibumbye i New York City, Ku Library of Congress mu Washington DC, Mu Pan Film Festival Afurika, Dublin muri Irlande, Haiti, Nigeria ku Nyakanga 18, 2014, Maryland, Virginia, California, Ubwongereza, Afurika y'Epfo, na Siyera Lewone.

The Perfect Picture ni firime yo muri Gana yakozwe kandi yanditswe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso mu 2009.
Mubintu bisa nkubuzima butunganye, abagore batatu beza bagiye kuzuza imyaka mirongo itatu,bagerageza bashize amanga kugirango bahindure ubuzima bwabo nubwo ibizazane bitabura. Hamwe nubukwe busa nkaho bugiye kurimbuka kuva mbere, kugeza kumukandida udashoboka no gukurikirana urukundo rutagira iherezo, inshuti eshatu ziziga amasomo akomeye yubuzima, imbogamizi zubukwe, impfu zo gukundana nibihembo bya guseka neza mu gihu cy'akababaro. Ishusho Yuzuye itanga ubushishozi bwamabara kandi asetsa mwisi aho ibintu byose bitunganye nkubuzima bwawe ninshuti zawe.

Potato Potahto ni filime yo gusetsa y’urukundo yo muri Gana yo muri 2017 yakozwe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso ivuga amateka yo gutandukana muri societe y'uburengerazuba bwa Afrika nuburyo bigoye.
Potato Potahto ni firime yo gusetsa yo muri Gana-Nigeriya ikurikira ubuzima bwabafatanyabikorwa babiri bahatirwa kubana ubuzima bwabo munzu imwe nyuma yo gutandukana.
Iyi filime ifatanije n’amasosiyete yo muri Nijeriya Ascend Studios, ku ya 19 Mata Imyidagaduro Virgo Sun Ltd na Lufodo Productions ikaba yari iyobowe n’umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Gana, Shirley Frimpong-Manso. Irerekana ibintu by'akajagari bibaho iyo abashakanye batanye bagumye hamwe murugo rwabashakanye, buri wese afata ubufasha bushimishije bwabahuje igitsina. Iyi filime yafashwe mu gihe cy'ibyumweru bibiri, ku bufatanye n’abatunganya amafilime yo muri Suwede, Abafaransa, Abongereza, Nijeriya na Gana.
Ibirayi Potahto yakiriwe neza na rubanda, kubera intsinzi Shirley Frimpong-Manso yagezeho mbere. Filime yagaragaye 7.9 nabakoresha kuri Nollywood Reinvented. Ibirayi Potahto yabonye imyiyerekano mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes, Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Durban ndetse n’Iserukiramuco rya Filimi ry’Abongereza. Iyi filime kandi yagaragaye mu rwego rwo gutoranya iserukiramuco rya Filime Afurika kuva ku ya 27 Ukwakira kugeza 5 Ugushyingo. Ukuboza 2019, Potato Potahto yongewe kumugaragaro kurutonde rwa Netflix.

Potomanto (yakomotse ku ijambo ry'igifaransa "portmanteau") ni filime yo muri Gana ya 2013 - Nijeriya yerekana ibikorwa bya Shirley Frimpong Manso. Irimo Olu Jacobs, Yvonne Okoro na Adjetey Anang. Yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Sinema ya Silverbird, Accra, muri Gana, ku ya 20 Ukuboza 2013.
Uwahoze ari umupolisi urakaye, Andane, akazi ke ni ugukora iperereza no gufata abafatanyabikorwa bahemutse afata indi sura iyo yahawe akazi ko gukora iperereza ku mugore w’umucuruzi ukize. Yatsitaye ku mpeta y'abasaruzi b'ingingo n'abacuruzi bashuka abasore babasezeranya kubajyana mu mahanga. Umukwe wumukire numukozi wihishe nawe ukora iperereza kugirango afate abacuruza urugingo. Bishyize hamwe bagerageza guhagarika kanseri yatwaye ubuzima bwa benshi mu rubyiruko mu baturage.
Nollywood Reinvented yahaye firime amanota 55% anashimira inkuru yayo no kuyobora. Ghanafilmindustry.com yakurikiranye hamwe ninyenyeri 4 kuri 10 maze asoza avuga ko film yagerageje guhendwa no gukomera.

Rebecca ni filime yo muri Gana-Nijeriya 2016 iyobowe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso, ikinwamo na Yvonne Okoro na Joseph Benjamin. Nk’uko Manso abitangaza ngo iyi filime yasohotse bwa mbere i Londres, mbere ya Gana kubera ubukungu bw'igihugu bigatuma igabanuka ry'abakunzi ba filime. Iyi filime ni filime ya kabiri yakinnye igaragaramo umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Nijeriya Yvonne Okoro.
Filime itangirana na Clifford (Joseph Benjamin) na Rebecca (Yvonne Okoro) bazimiye mu ishyamba nyuma yuko imodoka yabo isabye gusanwa. Byagaragaye ko Rebecca yasezeranijwe na Clifford kuva mu bwana bwabo ko bazabana. Mu gihe Rebecca yacecetse mu rugendo rwose kandi asa nkaho atababajwe n'amagambo yavuzwe n'umugabo we mushya, Clifford agaragaza ko adashaka gushyingiranwa nawe neza kuko yashakaga gusohoza icyifuzo cye cyo gupfa kwa se. Clifford yarumwe nikiremwa cyomwishyamba kandi ibi biganisha kubiganiro byambere hagati yabo. Rebecca amufasha gukira igikomere cye. Aramuhishurira kandi ko mbere yakundaga kandi akagaragaza ko atamwitayeho kubera ko atamwubaha kandi ko amukunda. Nyuma y'ibiganiro birebire hagati yabo, batangiye gukundana. Rebecca ashimuswe nabagabo babiri, nyuma byaje kugaragara ko byateguwe nuwahoze ari umukunzi we. Rebecca asubira kwa Clifford maze asobanura imigambi ye yose yo guhimbira urupfu rwe no guhagarika umushoferi we kumukurikira amuroga. Nyuma yo kumva no kubona ukuri kwinginga kwe, Clifford aramwakira mugihe bombi bategereje itsinda ryabatabazi.

Run Baby Run ni film y'ibikorwa yo muri Gana iyobowe na Emmanuel Apea ikinwamo na John Apea yasohotse muri 2006 aho yakunzwe cyane nabayireba byatumye abaknnyi bayo bahabwa ibihembo. Iyi filime yakiriye nomination 8 kandi yatsindiye ibihembo 4 muri African Movie Academy Awards muri 2008, harimo ibihembo "byamafoto" "meza", Umuyobozi mwiza ndetse na "Screenplay nziza".
Enoch Sarpong Jr., umunyeshuri wo muri Gana uba mu Bwongereza, asurwa na mushiki we muto ukomoka muri Gana, wari wibeshye afata ivalisi itari yo ku kibuga cy'indege. Ivalisi irimo kokayine nyinshi. Enoki yahisemo kugurisha ibiyobyabwenge, icyakora ba nyir'ibiyobyabwenge bahise bahura na we, bamwirukankana hirya no hino mu Bwongereza na Gana.

Sankofa ni filime yerekana ikinamico yakozwe na Etiyopiya yo mu 1993 iyobowe na Haile Gerima yibanze ku bucuruzi bw’abacakara bwa Atlantike. Iyi nkuru igaragaramo Oyafunmike Ogunlano, Kofi Ghanaba, Mutabaruka, Alexandra Duah, na Afemo Omilami. Ijambo Sankofa ryakomotse ku rurimi rwa Akan rwo muri Gana risobanura "gusubira inyuma, gushaka, no kubona ubwenge, imbaraga n'ibyiringiro", nk'uko byavuzwe na Dr. Anna Julia Cooper. Ijambo Sankofa ryibanda ku kamaro ko umuntu atagendera kure cyane ya kahise kugirango atere imbere ejo hazaza. Muri filime, Sankofa agereranwa ninyoni n'indirimbo n'ingoma z'ingoma y'Imana. Filime ya Gerima yerekanye akamaro ko kutagira abantu bakomoka muri Afurika batandukana n’imizi yabo. Gerima yakoresheje urugendo rwimico Mona kugirango yerekane uburyo imyumvire nyafurika yerekana indangamuntu harimo kumenya imizi yumuntu no "gusubira aho yaturutse" (Gerima).
Filime itangirana numusaza Divine Drummer, Sankofa (yakinnye na Kofi Ghanaba), akubita ingoma nyafurika aririmba imvugo ngo "Umwuka utinda w'abapfuye, haguruka." Ubu ni uburyo bwe bwo gushyikirana nabakurambere b'igihugu cya Afrika, cyane Gana. Yizera ko kuvuza ingoma ari ngombwa mu kugarura umwuka w'abakurambere be biciwe muri diaspora nyafurika. Inkuru ikomeza kugaragaza Mona (Oyafunmike Ogunlano), wabayeho Afurika na Amerika ntangarugero kuri film shoot muri Ghana. Afite isomo ku Kigo cya Cape Coast, atazi ko cyakoreshejwe mu mateka mu bucuruzi bw’abacakara kubera ko kuva kera atandukanijwe n’imizi ye yo muri Afurika. Mugihe Mona ari kumurongo wicyitegererezo, ahura numusaza wamayobera Sankofa wavuzaga ingoma mugutangira film. Sankofa akomeje kwibutsa Mona gusubira mu mateka ye kandi akaba umunyamahane cyane mu bijyanye no gukomeza ahantu h'abasekuruza bera, bityo agerageza kwirukana ba mukerarugendo b'abazungu mu kigo cy'abacakara. Iyo Mona ingingo kujya A Kureba imbere castle ubwe, Mona agerageza guhunga urugo rw'abacakara ahura na ba shebuja b'abaja bera agerageza gutekereza avuga ko akomoka muri Amerika kandi ko adakomoka muri Afurika. Ba shebuja b'abacakara ntibitaye ku byo Mona yavuze maze bamusunika ku muriro, bamwambura imyenda, bamushyira icyuma gishyushye ku mugongo.

Side Chick Gang ni ikinamico yo muri Gana ya 2018 / filime isetsa iyobowe na Peter Sedufia.
Inshuti eshatu z'abakobwa baretse akazi kabo nkabashitsi kugirango bakore akazi gahemba menshi kandi meza kuruta akazi kabo ka kera ako kazi bakise "sidechic gang". Agatsiko ka Sidechic gatanga serivisi kubagore gusa. Ibi bituma abagabo batishimira cyane gukundwa gutunguranye kwerekanwa ryabo. Akazi kabaha gukandamiza abagabo cyangwa abasore bakundana bashuka abagore babo cyangwa inshuti zabo. Agatsiko kafashe akazi kumutunzi ukize maze wamwungukamo menshi bitewe ningeso ye guca inyuma uwo bashakanye. Umukuru muri opposition yabo ni abagabo bababaye bungukiwe na serivisi za side chicks.

Single and Married ni filimi isekeje yasohotse muri 2012 ikorerwa muri Ghana na Nigeria, yakozwe na Yvonne Nelson afatanyije na Pascal Amanfo. Irimo Yvonne Nelson, Chris Attoh, Nadia Buari, Tana Adelana, Kofi Adjorlolo, Eddie Watson na Jane 'Efya' Awindor. Filime "yibanze ku ikinamico, amayeri n'amabanga mato yanduye y'inshuti eshatu z'abagabo, ubuzima bwabo bw'imibonano mpuzabitsina, kuba ingaragu cyangwa bashakanye. Iyi filime yahawe ibihembo icumi muri Gana Movie Awards 2012 kandi yegukana ibihembo bine muri ibyo birori, birimo Ishusho Nziza, Ubuyobozi Bwiza (Ururimi rw'Icyongereza), Umukinnyi mwiza mu ruhare rwo gushyigikira (Icyongereza), na Sinema nziza. Urukurikirane, "Ingaragu, Yubatse kandi rugoye", rwasohotse mu 2014.
Jay (Chris Attoh), casanova, yatunguye inshuti ze, arasaba umukunzi we Kimora (Yvonne Nelson). Inshuti ya Jay, Raymond (Kweku Elliot) casanova ubu nawe yashakanye n'umwe mu nshuti za Kimora, Paula (Nadia Buari), ntabyitayeho. Andy (Eddie Watson), "mubi" muri batatu, atekereza ko Jay ari hafi gufungwa ubuzima bwe bwose.
Umwaka umwe nyuma yubukwe, Jay araryamana na Judith (Jane Awindor), kandi ahora abeshya Kimora. Jay amaherezo aratandukana na we, kuko yamutunze cyane; asohoka mu nzu ye, Jay yikubita kuri Raymond, na we usohoka mu nzu ya nyirabuja, bityo amenya amabanga ya mugenzi we. Ikigaragara ni uko Paula, umunyamategeko, ahora ahugiye mu kazi kandi ntajya abona umwanya wa Raymond, mu gihe Kimora na we yanze guha Jay. Paula ahura Raymond na Yolanda (Itz Tiffany), inshuti ye ishaje, maze Raymond atangira gukundana nawe.
Iyi filime yerekana filime yasohotse kuri YouTube ku ya 25 Nyakanga 2012, kuri ubu ikaba imaze kubona miliyoni zigera ku icumi, ikaba imwe mu zerekanwa cyane na Nollywood. Yasohotse muri Gana ku ya 22 Nzeri 2012, yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Sinema ya Silverbird, Ikirwa cya Victoria, Lagos ku ya 28 Nzeri 2012.
Single and Married ifite ibihembo icumi muri Gana Movie Awards 2012, harimo Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu ruhare runini (Icyongereza) kuri Nelson, Umukinnyi mwiza mu nshingano zunganira (Icyongereza) kuri Attoh, Ishusho nziza - Ubufatanye bwa Afurika, Guhindura neza, Ubuhanzi bwiza n'umuziki mwiza (Indirimbo y'umwimerere). Amaherezo yatsindiye Ishusho Nziza, Kuyobora neza (Ururimi rw'icyongereza), Umukinnyi mwiza mu nshingano zunganira (Icyongereza), na Sinema nziza.

Sinking Sands ni filime yikinamico yo muri Gana yo mu 2010, yanditswe yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Leila Djansi, ikinwamo Jimmy Jean-Louis, Ama Abebrese, Emmanuel Yeboah A. na Yemi Blaq. Iyi filime yakiriye ibihembo icyenda kandi yatsindiye ibihembo 3 muri Afurika ya Movie Academy Awards 2011, harimo ibihembo bya "Best Screenplay" &amp; "Best Makeup".
Iyi filime ivuga amateka y'abashakanye, Jimah na Pabi, ishyingiranwa ryabo rikaba urugomo no guhohoterwa iyo Jimah ahindutse isura mu mpanuka yo mu rugo.
Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nabantu benshi banenga firime nyafurika hamwe na NollywoodForever.com basoza bavuga ko "Filime nziza nabatura mbikuye ku mutima. Ibi birerekana abo bantu bose bafite ibitekerezo bigufi bizera ko ukeneye glitz, glamour na brazilian kuboha kugirango ukore firime nziza utakora. Ubukorikori muri firime bwari buteye ubwoba no gushimwa. Gukina byari ingingo nkuko byari bimeze kuri sinema. "

Somewhere in Africa: The Cries of humanity ni film y'ikinamico yo muri Gana ya 2011, iyobowe na Frank Rajah Arase, yakinwe na Majid Michel, Martha Ankomah na Kofi Adjorlolo. Yakiriye kandidatire 7 mu bihembo bya 9 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards harimo ibyiciro: Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu nshingano zambere, Ibyagezweho mu majwi, Ibyagezweho mu ngaruka ziboneka no kugerwaho na Make-Up. Majid Michel niwe wahawe igihembo cyonyine cya film.
Nollywood Reinvented yayihaye amanota 43%, ashima amajwi yayo, cinematografi hamwe namashusho.
Yakiriye kandidatire 7 mu bihembo bya 9 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards ku byiciro: Ibyagezweho mu Gushushanya Umusaruro, Ibyagezweho mu Gushushanya Imyambarire, Ibyagezweho muri Make-Up, Ibyagezweho mu majwi, Ibyagezweho mu mashusho, Umukinnyi mwiza / Umukinnyi utanga ikizere, n'umukinnyi mwiza muri Uruhare Rukuru. Majid Michel niwe wahawe igihembo cyonyine cya film.

Stab in the Dark ni filime yo mu Cyongereza yo muri 1999 yo muri Gana yakozwe na Bam Nemesia, Ltd ikayoborwa na Veronica Quarshie. Byari amafaranga kandi yatsinze bikomeye, yatsindiye Filime Nziza muri Gana Movie Awards mu 2000.
Umugore agambaniwe mu gihe inshuti ye ikundanye na se nuko umuryango ukamufasha kumuzana mu rugo. Uru rukurikirane rwa firime eshanu (A Stab in the Dark 1,2, Ripples: A Stab in Dark 3, Ripples 2, and Ripples 3) ikurikira ubuzima bw'abakobwa bakiri bato mu makinamico yo murugo kandi byerekana itandukaniro ry'ibibazo byimibereho mu ikinamico. In A Stab in the Dark, umuntu nyamukuru, Effe, numukobwa mwiza cyane ukunda gukundana cyane, kandi mubisanzwe washakanye nabagabo. Effe yavuye mu rugo kugira ngo ahunge nyina anenga imyitwarire ye kandi agumana n'umuryango w'inshuti ye. Igihe yari mu rugo rw'inshuti ye Kate, Effe aryamana na se wa Kate kandi byangiza imbaraga z'uwo muryango. Amaherezo, muri film ya gatanu, Effe yahisemo guhindura ubuzima bwe aho kwangiza imiryango nubukwe, bifasha kurokora urugo no kongera kugirana ubucuti na Kate.
A Stab in the Dark niyo yambere mu rukurikirane rwa firime eshanu ngufi zose ziyobowe na Veronica Quarshie kandi zasohotse hagati ya 1999 na 2003.
"A Stab in the Dark" hamwe n’ibikurikira bizwiho kwibanda ku buhemu bw’abagabo nk’isoko y’amakimbirane yo mu miryango, igikoresho cy’umugambi kidakunze gukoreshwa muri sinema yo muri Gana na Nigeriya.
"A Stab in the Dark" hamwe nibisobanuro byayo bifatwa nkibimwe mubikorwa byiza bya Quarshie. "A Stab in the Dark" yatsindiye amafaranga kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi, harimo na FIlm nziza muri ibihembo bya Gana Movie Awards mu 2000.

Zinabu ni filime yo muri Gana yo mu 1987 iyobowe na William Akuffo na Richard Quartey.
Zinabu avuga amateka "y'umupfumu winjiye mu bukristo."
Filime yafashwe mu 1985 ikoresheje kamera ya videwo, aho kuba kamera ya firime. Video yari igikoresho gishya muri kiriya gihe, ariko Akuffo yamenye ibyiza amashusho ya videwo yari afite kuri firime, kubera ko selile yari ihenze kandi itanga imbogamizi zo kuyikwirakwiza. "Zinabu" yabaye firime ya mbere yo muri Gana yakozwe kuri videwo.
Mu gihe cyo gutunganya "Zinabu", guverinoma ya Gana yashyizeho itegeko ribuza kureba amashusho, mu rwego rwo gukumira ingaruka mbi batekerezaga ko filime z’Abanyamerika n’Ubushinwa zitabifitiye uruhushya zigira ku muco wa Gana. Iri tegeko ryakuweho mu 1987, ahanini bitewe nakazi ka Akuffo. Filime yakiriye bwa mbere muri Globe Cinema. Kwerekanwa byari bigamije kwigana firime isanzwe: umukinnyi wa videwo ntabwo yabonaga abari aho, kandi Akuffo yari mucyumba cyo kwerekana.
"Zinabu" nicyo kintu cya mbere cyerekana amashusho yo muri Gana, gitangira uburyo bushya bwo gutunganya amafilime kavukire yakura mu ntangiriro ya za 90. Mu 1988, hasohotse filime ebyiri za videwo, ariko iyi zigera kuri zirindwi mu 1991, zirenga 50 muri 1993. Akuffo yakoze kandi ibisobanuro bitatu kuri "Zinabu".

Sandra Nkaké (wavutse 15 Ugushyingo 1973) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Kameruni akaba n'umuririmbyi
Nkaké yavukiye i Yaoundé, muri Kameruni mu 1973. Afite imyaka 12, yimukiye mu Bufaransa. Nkaké yakundaga umuziki kuva akiri muto, cyane Prince yavumbuye akiri ingimbi. Icyakora, yifuzaga kuba umwarimu wicyongereza kandi yiga i Paris ahitwa Sorbonne. Igihe yari afite imyaka 20, yerekeje ibitekerezo kuri theatre, yerekana uruhare kandi aba umukinnyi. Nkaké yagaragaye bwa mbere muri "The Crucible" mu 1994, iyobowe na Thomas Ledouarec. Umwaka ukurikira, yagize uruhare muri "Le Dindon".
Mu mwaka wa 2008, Nkaké yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere "Mansaadi", ashyigikira iyi nyandiko n'ibitaramo birenga 200 ku isi, birimo ingendo muri Afurika na Berezile. Yanditseho icyubahiro Donny Hathaway kuri Album ya Stéphane Belmondo ya "2011 Ever After". Muri 2012 alubumu ye ya kabiri "Nothing for Granted" yasohotse, yandikiranye na mugenzi we Ji Drû. Iyi alubumu yasohotse kuri label ya Jazz Village. Ijwi ryerekana Nkaké ryamuteye kuba ikirangirire mu bugingo bwubufaransa. Yabonye igihembo cya Frank Ténot mu birori bya Victoires du Jazz muri Nyakanga 2012. Muri Nzeri 2017, yasohoye alubumu ye ya gatatu "Tangerine Moon Wishing", akaba yarabonaga ko ari amateka ye bwite.

Koffi Gahou (22 Ukwakira 1947 - 24 Kanama 2019) yari umuhanzi, umukinnyi wa filime, n'umuyobozi.
Gahou yavukiye i Cotonou ku ya 22 Ukwakira 1947. Yize kuva 1986 kugeza 1989 mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi bw’ikinamico muri Kaminuza ya Sorbonne Nouvelle Paris 3, abona uruhushya rwo kwigisha. Kuva mu 1985 kugeza 1986 Gahou yakoraga umwuga wo kwimenyereza muri Conservatoire national supérieur d'art ikinamico i Paris maze mu 1988, yimenyereza umwuga muri Institut international de la marionnette. Guhera mu 1974, yize ubwe mu buhanzi bwa plastiki, imashini zometse ku rukuta, amashusho, ndetse n’imbere. Gahou yinjiye mu bakozi ba Leta nk'umuhanzi kandi akora ibitaramo mu itsinda rya "Cerveaux noirs". Yashinze kandi itsinda ry’ikinamico "Zama Hara", yagize imurikagurisha ryinshi ry’ibikorwa bye muri Afurika, Uburayi, Cuba, na Amerika.
Gahou yakoze imyenda "Yovo Helou e, Akowe helou e" mu 1990. Irerekana imbata zifatanije amaboko inyuma, kandi byari byiza cyane. Mu 2000, Gahou yakinnye murumuna wa Boubacar, umuhinzi, muri film ya Jean Odoutan "Barbecue Pejo".
Mu mashusho ya videwo muri Mata 2019, Gahou yasabye ko yishyurwa miliyoni 30 z’amafaranga CFA y’umudepite wo muri Bénine yategetswe kumuha n’Urugereko rwa 3 rw’ubucuruzi rw’urukiko rwa Cotonou. Iki kibazo cyaturutse mu marushanwa yo mu 2007 Gahou yatsinze ariko ntiyabona amafaranga yigihembo. Gahou yapfuye ku ya 24 Kanama 2019 i Abomey. Umuhango wo kumushyingura wabaye ku ya 25 Nzeri.

Faissol Fahad Bolade Gnonlonfin (wavutse 1985) n'umuyobozi wa firime akaba n'umu producer.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, Gnonlonfin yakoze ifoto ye ya mbere, "Obalé le chasseur", agaragaza umuturage wo muri Bénine winjiye mu itsinda ry’abahigi. Yize kuriyi ngingo imyaka ibiri kandi yitegereza impaka hagati yabahiga gakondo nabashinzwe kubungabunga inyamaswa. Nk’uko uwahoze ari umwarimu Jean-François Hautin abitangaza ngo umuzungu ntabwo yashoboraga gufata amashusho neza umuhango w'abahiga. Filime ya kabiri ya Gnonlonfin "Ni ici ni ailleur" isuzuma icyerekezo cyo kurwanya ikoreshwa rya gaze ya shale muri Ardèche, ikayihuza no gukuramo umutungo muri Afurika.
Nyuma yo kwibanda ku documentaire, inyinshi muri zo zabonye ibihembo, Gnonlonfin yatangiye gukora ibihimbano mu 2014. Muri 2017, yakoranye na Berni Goldblat hamwe na sosiyete ikora Les Lesms du Djabadjah kuri "Wallay". Yasohowe cyane, itorwa mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage 2017. Muri Werurwe 2018, Gnonlonfin yayoboye amahugurwa yo gutunganya amashusho muri Burkinafaso. Gnonlonfin yashinze isosiyete ikora Merveilles Production kugirango ishishikarize abakora firime. Yibera cyane mubufaransa ariko amara hafi amezi abiri mumwaka muri Bénin.

Amédée Pacôme Nkoulou (wavutse 1988) ni umuyobozi wa film muri Gabon.
Nkoulou yakiriye impamyabumenyi ye mu 2007 hanyuma ajya kwiga ibijyanye na sinema ndetse n’amajwi yerekana amashusho muri Institut Supérieur de l'Imashusho et du Son muri Ouagadougou. Yagarutse muri Gabon mu 2011 akora akazi ko kwimenyereza umwuga mu mishinga myinshi. Yabaye umuyobozi wungirije kuri "L'oeil de la cité ya" Samantha Biffot (2012), Dialemi ya Nadine "Otsobogo" (2013) na "Sans Famille ya" Pauline Mvélé (2013). Muri 2014, filime ya mbere ya Nkoulou, "Moane Mory", iminota 20 ngufi, yasohotse nyuma yimyaka ibiri yo kwitegura. Ku nkunga yatanzwe n’ikigo cya leta cya Gabon Igis, iyi filime yerekana inama yabereye mu imurikagurisha ry’ubuhanzi hagati y’umunyeshuri ukiri muto Isa na Jack, umurangi uri mu myaka 40, bikura mu rukundo. "Moane Mory" yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ry’iburayi ryabereye i Libreville no muri firime ngufi mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2014.
Filime ye ya kabiri, "Une vie après le bloc", yasohotse mu 2016. Iyi documentaire isuzuma abaganga babiri bo muri Gabon bashiraho pacemakers na prostateque yivi. Filime ya mbere ya Nkoulou ngenge yitwa "Boxe Libreville", yasohotse muri 2018. Irerekana umusore wifuza guterana amakofe, Christ, igihe yitoza i Libreville hagati y’amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu cya Gaboniya 2016. "Umukinnyi w'iteramakofe Libreville" yinjiye mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Filime ngufi na Hagati muri Vision du Réel. Yabonye igihembo cya documentaire nziza muri Festival de cine africano de Tarif muri Espagne. Yerekanwe mu bindi birori byinshi bya firime, harimo Internationales Dokumentarfilmf Festival München na Ecrans Noirs muri Kameruni.

Samantha Biffot (wavutse 1985) ni umwanditsi wa sinema wa Gabon-Igifaransa, utunganya amafilime akaba n'umuyobozi wa firime.
Biffot yavukiye i Paris mu 1985. Yabayeho mu bwana bwe hagati ya Gabon, Koreya y'Epfo n'Ubufaransa, kandi uburere bwe butandukanye bwagize imico myinshi nyuma yo gukina film. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi ye, yize muri École Supérieure de Réalisation Audiovisuelle i Paris aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ya sinema mu 2007. Amashuri arangije, Biffot yarangije kwimenyereza gukora kuri televiziyo na firime nyinshi mu Bufaransa. Biffot yasubiye muri Gabon mu 2010 aho yashinze isosiyete ya "Princesse M Production" hamwe na Pierre-Adrien Ceccaldi. Mu mwaka wa 2011, yateguye amahugurwa mu kwerekana amashusho, gukora, gushushanya no gutunganya mu rwego mpuzamahanga mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’inkiko z’ishuri i Libreville.
Mu mwaka wa 2013, televiziyo ye "L'Œil de la cité" (Ijisho ry'umujyi) yahawe igihembo cy'uruhererekane rwiza rwa Afurika mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican ya Ouagadougou. Uruhererekane rwasuzumye ibyaha by’imihango n’ibibazo by’ibidukikije n’imibereho, buri gice kigira imyitwarire irangiye. Yavuze ko yayobowe nuruhererekane "rwabanyamerika Tales kuva muri Crypt", kandi urukurikirane rwe rwakozwe na Institut Gabonais de l'Image et du Son. Mu mwaka wa 2016, Biffot yasohoye documentaire Africa Who Wanted to fly, yerekana ubuzima bwa shebuja wa Gabon kung fu, Luc Bendza. Iyi filime yahawe igihembo cyihariye cy’abacamanza mu iserukiramuco Escales Socumentaires de Libreville ndetse no kuba Filime Nziza mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry'i Burundi mu mwaka wa 2017. "Africa Who Wanted to fly" yanerekanwe muri Internationales Dokumentarfilmf Festival München no mu iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika ryabereye i New York.

The African Who Wanted to Fly (French) ni filime yo muri Gabon ya 2016 iyobowe na Samantha Biffot. Igice gishingiye kubuzima bwa Luc Bendza. Filime yakozwe mu ndimi ebyiri, Igishinwa n'Igifaransa, kandi yari ifite insanganyamatsiko y'icyongereza.
The African Who Wanted to Fly yakozwe na Neon Rouge, afatanije na Theatre Company Theatre (Ubufaransa). Scenese yafatiwe amashusho muri Gabon, no mu Bushinwa. Umuziki wari ugizwe nindirimbo zishinwa.
Urebye filime Big Boss, umwana wo muri Gabon yavumbuye Kung Fu ahitamo kujya mu Bushinwa afite imyaka 15 gusa. Yize ko azaba umunyafrica wambere wize ibihangano bya Kung Fu. Ahinduka inararibonye muri yo.

Idahosa Trails ni film yikinamico yo muri Nigeriya 2017 yanditswe, yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Stanlee Ohikhuare. Irimo Charles Okafor, David Schifter, Liz Benson, Osas Ighodaro, Frank Donga. Ishingiye ku bunararibonye bw’umunyamakuru w’umunyamerika witwa Thomas Book (ugaragazwa na David Schifter) ushaka kubaza arikiyesipoki Benson Idahosa(ugaragazwa na Charles Okafor) ashingiye ku myumvire ye ku ruhare Idahosa yagize mu gukira mu buryo bw'igitangaza umuyobozi w'icyamamare muri Umujyi wa Benin, gukira kwe kwabayeho nyuma yimyaka itandatu muri koma. Iyi filime yasohotse mu mpera z'Ukwakira 2017 na Mighty Jot Studios mu mujyi wa Benin, muri Nijeriya.
Igitabo cya Thomas kiri mu rugendo rugana mu mujyi wa kera wa Bénin, muri Nijeriya, kugira ngo ukore documentaire y’iperereza ku mihango y'ibanga yakozwe mu gihe cyo kwimika Oba nshya. Ntiyashoboye kubona amakuru ahagije kubera urwego rwo hejuru rwibanga ruzengurutse imihango. Mugihe yitegura kuva mu mujyi, yumva inkuru yumukuru wamamaye waho wari umaze kubyuka muri koma yimyaka itandatu ahitamo kwandika inkuru. Yizeye ko inkuru izaba indishyi zimwe na zimwe kubera ko atabonye amakuru ku cyicaro gikuru, yahisemo kujya mu bitaro. Mu bitaro, umuforomo atanga ubufasha bwo gusobanura igihe abaza umugabo. Arashoboye kubaza ikibazo kimwe mbere yuko abagize umuryango wumugabo binjira kugirango bahagarike ikiganiro cye. Mu kiganiro kigufi, Thomas yashoboye kubona izina ryumugabo, izina Idahosa. Ageze mucyumba cye cya hoteri yumva izina rimwe kuri TV ya Idahosa World Outreach. Yibwira ko Idahosa igomba kuba yaragize uruhare runini mu gukira k'umusaza. Yandika aderesi na nimero ya terefone yerekanwe, maze yerekeza ku cyicaro gikuru cya Idahosa World Outreach mu mujyi wa Benin. Ageze mu rusengero, Thomas ahura n’umupasitori ukiri muto uzwi ku izina rya Pasiteri Osas (Kunle Idowu) amusaba kugaruka bukeye kugira ngo abonane na Benson Idahosa. Pasiteri ukiri muto aha Thomas igitabo cyo gusoma kuri Idahosa. Kubera umunezero witerambere rishya, Thomas yongeye guhindura indege atangira kwitegura iyi nkuru nshya ya Idahosa. Ageze mu cyumba cye cya hoteri, Thomas yahinduye igitabo n'amaso asinziriye, maze agwa mu kantu maze yisanga mu kongera gushyira mu bikorwa inkuru ivugwa muri iki gitabo. Bukeye, Thomas ahura na Pasiteri Osas maze bahagarara ahantu henshi batatsinzwe ahantu hatandukanye aho pasiteri ukiri muto yasezeranije Thomas ko bazabona Idahosa bakabona inkuru ye. Iminsi ibiri irashize kandi Thomas ntashobora guhura na Idahosa ariko buri joro agarutse mucyumba cye cya hoteri, akomeza gusoma igitabo kuri Idahosa. Kimwe nijoro rya mbere, arasinzira asoma igitabo maze yibonera kongera gushyirwaho inkuru zerekanwa muri iki gitabo. Yakomeje gukurikira Pasiteri Osas agamije kujya kubaza Arkiyepiskopi Idahosa. Umunsi umwe mbere yuko Thomas ateganijwe kugenda, yatunguwe no kumenya ko Idahosa yapfuye. Ubu buvumbuzi buganisha ku guterana amagambo hagati ye na Pasiteri Osas biganisha ku maso. Mugihe ibintu bitunguranye, Thomas Yatewe nimpanuka isiga Pasiteri aryamye hasi nta bwenge. Yari afite amatsiko yo kumva uruhare rwa Idahosa mu gitangaza kigaragara cy'umusaza yabajije mu bitaro. Pasiteri Osas yatekereje ko Thomas azi urupfu rwa Idahosa maze akeka ko yashakaga gusa kubaza abantu ubuzima bwabo umurimo wa Idahosa wagize ingaruka nziza. Thomas, ubu urujijo agomba guhuriza hamwe ibimenyetso kuko abonye imbaraga zo gutangira urugendo rwo kuvumbura; kubona ukuri, kwizera n'agakiza.

Tatu ni filimi yasohotse 2017 muri Nigeria iyoborwa na Don Omope. Yanditswe na Jude Idada kandi yahinduwe mu gitabo "Tatu", cyanditswe na Abraham Nwankwo mu 2014. Filime yakiriye ibihembo byinshi muri 2018 Magic Magic Viewers Choice Awards. Iyi filime kandi yahawe ibihembo byinshi muri Afurika Magic Choice Awards 2018.
Muri Tatu, tubona ubuzima bw'umubyeyi no kugerageza gukiza igitekerezo cy'umukobwa we w'ikinege watanzwe nk'igitambo cyo guhongerera ibyaha.
Tatu yarasiwe ahantu muri Lagos, na Abuja. Yafashwe amashusho mu gihe cy'amezi 12.
Tatu yarekuwe bwa mbere mu ikinamico muri Nyakanga 2017 muri Nijeriya, kandi yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Eko Hotel Convention Centre, ku kirwa cya Victoria. Muri 2019, iyi filime yongewe ku rutonde rwa Netflix mu gihe iyi sosiyete yakomeje gushora imari mu nganda nyafurika.
Tatu yakiriwe neza na rubanda. Kuri benshi mubareba, firime yari ifite ubushobozi butujujwe. Kuri Nollywood Reinvented, firime yari ifite amanota 52%.

Angela Aquereburu (wavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1977) ni umwanditsi wa sinema, atunganya amafilime akaba n'umuyobozi wa firime.
Aquereburu yavukiye muri Togo umubyeyi ukomoka muri Guadeloupe. Ashishikajwe n'ubuhanzi kuva akiri muto, yize muri Togo na Pointe-a-Pitre, Guadeloupe mbere yo kwimukira i Paris kwiga mu ishuri ry'ubucuruzi rya ESCP. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu kwihangira imirimo. Aquereburu yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa filime Jean-Luc Rabatel kandi akora mu bakozi imyaka myinshi. Mu mwaka wa 2008, ubwo yari mu biruhuko muri Togo, yamenye ko kuri televiziyo hari amakinamico gusa, maze afatanije n’umugabo we bazana igitekerezo cyo gukurikiranya filimi yitwa motorcycle taxis. Umwaka ukurikira, Aquereburu na Rabatel bimukiye i Lomé maze bashinga isosiyete ikora amajwi n'amashusho Yobo Studios. Igitekerezo cyabo cyo kwerekana tagisi cyashingiweho kuri "Zem", mini-serie ya episode 26 yiminota itanu, ifatanije na Canal + Afrique.
Umushinga we ukurikira wari urukurikirane rugufi rwa filimi ya "Palabres". Muri 2017, yatangije "ibitaro IT", bikemura ibibazo byabaturage nka malariya no kwera uruhu kandi byibanda ku mico Idriss na Tania. Aquereburu yavuze ko yatewe inkunga n'inda ye ya kabiri yo gukora iki gitaramo. Grey's Anatomy yagize uruhare runini. Yatsindiye igihembo cy'uruhererekane rwiza mu iserukiramuco rya Vues d'Afrique i Montreal.

Amal Bedjaoui (wavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 1963) ni umuyobozi wa filime yo muri Alijeriya, producer, n'umwanditsi.
Yavukiye muri Algiers, yize ibijyanye no gukina filime muri kaminuza ya New York. Yarangije muri Institut des hautes études cinématographiques hanyuma abona Master of Advanced Studies in Sinema muri kaminuza ya Paris 1 Pantheon-Sorbonne mu 1987. Amaze imyaka itari micye akora nk'umuyobozi wungirije akaba n'umuyobozi ushinzwe gutunganya ama filime kandi nk'umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ibikino. Filime ye ya mbere ngufi, "Une vue imprenable", yasohotse mu 1993. Filime ye ya kabiri ngufi, "Shoot me Angel", yasohotse mu 1995, ahabwa igihembo cya Panorama mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Berlin.
Mu 2002, yashinze isosiyete ikora filimi ya ML Productions. Umwaka ukurikira, yayoboye kandi akora firime yiminota 58 "Un Fils"."Un fils" ivuga amateka ya Selim, indaya y'umusore n'umubano we na madamu mukuru. Igice kinini cya firime gihinduranya hagati y'umunsi usanzwe kumanywa, nka Selim guhura na se, hamwe nijoro aho ubushakashatsi bwerekeranye nigitsina. Yavuzwe nk "icyitegererezo cy’ubwenegihugu bushingiye ku gitsina." Bedjaoui ni umukobwa wumudiplomate akaba n'umunyapolitiki Mohammed Bedjaoui.

Roma wa la n'toura (Icyongereza: Rome Rather Than You; Igifaransa: Rome plutôt que vous) ni filime y’ikinamico yo muri 2006 yakorewe muri Alijeriya-abafaransa n’Ubudage iyobowe na Tariq Teguia ikinwamo na Samira Kaddour na Rachid Amrani nk’urubyiruko babiri bashaka kuva muri Alijeriya n'intambara y'abenegihugu ya Alijeriya kugira ngo bagire ejo hazaza heza. Nibikorwa bya Teguia byerekanwe bwa mbere. (Yabanje gukora filime ngufi na documentaire ya 2002.) Filime yatsindiye igihembo cyihariye cyabacamanza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Friborg 2007.
Kamel w'imyaka 20 n'inshuti ye, Zina w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu, bashakisha muri Alijeriya Bosco ucuruza abantu kugira ngo babone pasiporo mpimbano kugira ngo bashobore kuva mu gihugu berekeza i Roma.
"Abanenga ibinyamakuru bitandukanye," Robert Koehler yashimye "Umukinnyi wa mbere wa Tariq Teguia... Nubwo ibihe bya nyuma biteganijwe, kugerayo ndetse na nyuma yacyo byerekana Teguia kuba umuyobozi w’amasezerano akomeye ". Koehler yemeje kandi "ibihangano bisanzwe, byoroshye imikorere" ya Kaddoui na Amrani. Mu "kinyamakuru Slant", ariko, Eric Henderson yabonaga ko iyi filime "yatekerejwe mu bwirasi, yiyitirira ko yakozwe, kandi ikaba ndende".

Omo Ghetto (English translation: Child of the Ghetto) ni filimi yasohotse 2010 muri Nigeria iyoborwa na Abiodun Olarenwaju, Star Funke Akindele, Rasheli Oniga, Taiwo Hassan, Yinka Quadri na Eniola Badmus.
Filime ishingiye ku ngeso mbi za societe nitsinda ryiganjemo abagore.
Olusegun Michael wo muri "Gana ya none" yashimye uwo mugambi, gukina, insanganyamatsiko no gusobanura uruhare muri iyi filime, avuga ko ari filime "idakora, ishimishije kandi ihishura". Muri 2017, Azeezat Kareem wo mu kinyamakuru Encomium Magazine yashyize ahagaragara "Omo Ghetto" nka imwe muri filime ebyiri zatumye Eniola Badmus amenyekana cyane mu nganda za firime zo muri Nijeriya. Yashyizwe kandi muri Legit.ng film eshanu "zitazibagirana" za Funke Akindele.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu imurikagurisha, mu nzu mberabyombi y’ubuhanzi, Iganmu ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2010.
Urukurikirane rwa filime yitwa "Omo Ghetto: Saga" yasohotse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 2020.

Tobong'u Lore, izwi mu Cyongereza nka Cultural Festival, ni umunsi mukuru w'umuco kavukire uba buri mpeshyi i Turkana, mu majyaruguru ya Kenya. Iri serukiramuco ryakiriwe n’abaturage benshi b’abasangwabutaka begereye ikiyaga, kandi rigamije guteza imbere amahoro, guhanahana umuco, n’ubukerarugendo. Abantu ba El Molo bategura ibirori i Loiyangalani buri kwezi kwa Kamena, naho abaturage ba Turkana bakira ibirori i Lodwar muri Mata. Tobong'u Lore ifatwa nk'imwe mu minsi mikuru minini y’umuco muri Kenya, ikaba yarabaye ikibanza cyo kugaragaramo abanyapolitiki bakomeye bo muri Kenya.
Muri 2019 abayobozi ba Turkana bagabanije gukoresha amafaranga muri ibyo birori bava kuri miliyoni 70 Shillings yo muri Kenya bagera kuri 33, bakoresha amafaranga kugirango bakemure ikibazo cy’amapfa yaho.
Iri serukiramuco rigaragaza umuco waho, ibidukikije, n’umurage wa kera. Abitabiriye amahugurwa bambara imyenda gakondo mugihe c'imihango. Ibikorwa birimo karnivali yiminsi itatu, hamwe numuziki n'imbyino ziva mumatsinda yaho, hamwe nijambo ryabayobozi baho. Bihuye n'imigenzo yaho, ibirori birakomeza kugeza izuba rirenze. Imurikagurisha riteza imbere ubukorikori bwaho n'ibiryo. Kurinda inyamaswa ni iyindi nsanganyamatsiko ivugwa mu munsi mukuru.
Kugaragara kwa politiki.
Abayobozi benshi bo muri Kenya bitabiriye ibirori, kandi abanyapolitiki bamwe bakoresheje ibyo birori kugira ngo batangaze amatangazo ajyanye no kwiyamamaza kwa politiki. Muri 2019 iri serukiramuco ryitabiriwe n'uwahoze ari Minisitiri w’intebe Raila Odinga na Visi Perezida William Ruto; muri 2020 Guverineri Kivutha Kibwana yakoresheje ibirori nk'ahantu ho gutangaza ko yifuza kuba perezida mu matora ari imbere.

Ismail Abou El Kanater, wavutse 1957 ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Maroc. Yagiye muri firime nyinshi za Maroc ndetse nizo mu mahanga.
Ismail yatangiye umwuga we w'ubuhanzi abikesheje imyitozo muri Konserwatoriya i Casablanca, kandi yize hamwe na Aziz Saadallah, Khadija Asad n'abandi, kandi yitabira nk'umukinnyi mu ikinamico (Ghoul) na (Our Right to Land). Mu ntangiriro ya za mirongo irindwi, yitabiriye, hamwe n’abanyeshuri ba Conservatoire, mu gushinga itsinda (Pocket Theatre) no gukora ingendo yikinamico muri Alijeriya. Mu 1973, yakoze mu ikinamico ya Tayeb Saddiki nka (Maqamat Badi Al-Zaman Al-Hamdani), (Sidi Abdel-Rahman Al-Majdoub) na (Al-Sufoud), no mu bishushanyo bimwe na bimwe bya tereviziyo byakozwe na nyakwigendera umuyobozi Hamid Bin Al-Sharif, yongeyeho ikinamico yitwa The Deserted Village, aherekejwe na Khadija Asad na Al-Shuaiba Al-Athrawi, Touriya Jabrane, na zhour maamri. Yitabiriye kandi ai kumwe n'umuyobozi Abd al-Rahman al-Khayyat mu ikinamico (Dirham al-Halal) ari kumwe na Naima al-Mashriqi, Aziz Mawhoub n'abandi, ndetse no muri filime ya televiziyo umuntu ufite uruhare rwe gusa we na Naima al-Mashriqi kandi iyobowe numugabo wanyuma.

Amor Hakkar (yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1958), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Alijeriya akaba na producer, umwanditsi wa sinema ndetse n'umukinnyi ukora ubu mu bucuruzi bwa firime mu Bufaransa. Afite isosiyete ikora firime "Sarah Films".
Yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1958 mu mudugudu w’imisozi Aurès mu karere ka Khenchela muri Alijeriya. Afite amezi 6, yageze mu Bufaransa ari kumwe n'ababyeyi be. Kuva icyo gihe, babaga i Besançon, mucyaro, umujyi wa Founottes. Se Chays Hakkar yamugizeho ingaruka zo kwiga siyanse.
Mu 1990, Hakkar yayoboye filime ye ya mbere ngufi yise"Teach me to count to infinity". Noneho mu 1992, yakoze film yambere yise "Bad Time for a Thug". Wari umurimo ukorana na Pierre-Loup Rajot, Sylvie Fennec na Serge Giamberardino kandi wakozwe na sosiyete Rage au cœur film.
Mu 1994, yatangiye gufata amashusho mu Bufaransa no mu Butaliyani filime "Ailleurs c'est beau aussi" hamwe na Mado Maurin na Pierre Remund. Hanyuma mu 1998, Hakkar yimukiye mu karere kavukire ka Aurès gushyingura ibisigazwa bya se, aho yafashe amashusho ya firime ya televiziyo yitwa "Timgad, la vie au cœur des Aurès", documentaire y’iminota 52 kuri TV 5 y’Ubufaransa. Hagati aho, mu 2001, yatsindiye igihembo cya Marcel Aymé kubera igitabo cyitwa "La cité des fausses notes". Mu 2005, Hakkar yashinze isosiyete ikora firime Sarah Films.
Muri 2015, yayoboye filime "Celle qui vivra" hamwe na Meryem Medjkane, Muriel Racine, Nicolas Dufour, Hichem Berdouk na Caroline Fouilhoux. Iyi filime yatewe inkunga na sinema y'umwimerere na Florence Bouteloup ndetse na filime yasohotse mu makinamico mu 2017. Muri 2018, yayoboye filime "Le Choix d'Ali".

Urgent ni filimi yasohotse 2018 ikorerwa muri Maroke, yanditswe kandi iyoborwa na Mohcine Besri. filimi yagaragayemo Rachid Mustafa, Fatima Zahra Bennacer, Said Bey, Youssef Al-Alaoui, Ghalia Bin Zawia and Younes Bouab. Rachid Mustapha. filimi yakozwe na Elisa Garbar, Lamia Chraibi na Michel Merkt. Iyi filime yerekana uruhande rwijimye rw’ibitaro bya Leta bya Maroc, bigaragazwa n’ubwinshi bwa ruswa, kutita ku bantu, ubucucike bukabije n’intege nke, no gucuruza imitima y’abantu binubira ubukana bw’ububabare.
Umugabo ahagarara ku muyaga ku kiraro, ararusimbuka arangirira mu bitaro nyuma yo kuvunika. Idris n'umugore we Zahra bajya mu bitaro hamwe n'umuhungu wabo urwaye, kandi abo bashakanye barihebye kubera ko badashoboye gutanga amafaranga akenewe yo kubagwa. Hussain, umuvandimwe wa Idris ufite ibibazo, yahisemo kubaha amafaranga azabona ku bashakanye bo mu Busuwisi bazakira umwana we w'ejo hazaza.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime rya Marrakech 2018 (MIFF). Nyuma muri 2019, yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Palm Springs no mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tangier National 2019.
Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Al Husseiny Abou-Deif igihembo cya Filime nziza y'Ubwisanzure mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Luxor. Yakiriye nomination esheshatu muri 15th Africa Movie Academy Awards.

Athmane Ariouet yavutse ku ya 24 Nzeri 1948 ni umukinnyi wa sinema, ikinamico na filimi zica kuri televiziyo muri Alijeriya. Ariouet ufatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi beza kandi bazwi cyane muri sinema yo muri Alijeriya, yahawe ibihembo byinshi mu mwuga umaze imyaka irenga mirongo itanu.
Ariouet yavutse ku ya 24 Nzeri 1948 i Amdoukal muri Barika, muri wilaya ya Batna. Yabanje kwitabira konserwatori ya Algiers kuva 1969 kugeza 1972.
Mugihe cyishuri, yari afite ishyaka ryo kuba umukinnyi wa filimi mwiza. Yemeje bose gutsindira igihembo cya mbere kubera inkoranyamagambo yakoze mu gifaransa. Yatinze, kuba umwizerwa mu gukina yatewe inkunga n’umwarimu w’igifaransa Henri Vangret. Nyuma yize ikinamico yicyarabu hamwe nabakinnyi bakomeye Mustapha Kasdarli, Taha Laâmiri na Allal Mouhib. Umukino we wa mbere wa sinema yakinnye muri 1963 "Le Résultat". Mu 1981, yakinnye muri filime ya televiziyo "The Executioner Cries" iyobowe na Abder Isker.
Filime ye yo mu bwoko bwa "Carnaval Fi Dechra yo mu" 1994, ifatwa nka filimi idahwema kwishyiriraho politiki. Iyi filime yayobowe na Mohamed Oukassi, ni filime isetsa yerekana umuryango wa Alijeriya usebanya. Icyakora, yabujijwe gukina nyuma ya filime. Mu 2002, yagarutse muri sinema akina na filime "El Arch" iyobowe na perezida. Ukuboza 2003, yasohoye filime ye ya mbere "Er-roubla" yakoranye na ENTV.
Mu 2004, yasezeye mu gukina nyuma ya filime "Chronique des années pub" aho yahuye n’ibibazo by’amafaranga ndetse no guhagarika ikinamico. Icyakora, mu 2017 mu ihuriro rya buri munsi rya El Moudjahid, uwahoze ari Minisitiri w’umuco Azzedine Mihoubi yavuze ko “iyi filime yari mu cyiciro cyo gutunganya” kandi amaherezo yasohotse mu 2018. Muri Nyakanga 2020, Ariouet yahawe imidari ya “Achir” yashyizwe ku rwego rw'igihugu iyobowe na Perezida wa Repubulika Abdelmadjid Tebboune.

Bullion ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Uganda 2014 yakozwe na Henry Ssali kandi iyobowe na Phillip Luswata. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Allan Tumusiime, umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Kenya Ainea Ojiambo, umuririmbyi Juliana Kanyomozi na mushiki we Laura Kahunde, umunyamakuru wa radiyo na Veronica Tindi w’uruganda rushimishije, umunyarwenya Anne Kansiime, Michael Wawuyo n'umuhungu we Michael Wawuyo Jr. ndetse no kugaragara k'umunyamideli n'umucuruzi. Sylvia Owori.
Collins Jjuuko, umushoferi wimodoka ya bullion arashaka cyane amafaranga yo guha umukobwa we ugiye kubagwa umutima mubuhinde. Yifatanije nitsinda ryabakozi ba banki bafite umururumba kwiba imodoka ya bullion. Nyuma y’ubwo bujura, bagenzi be bamutwara amafaranga yose nuko arafatwa. Iyo avuye muri gereza, aba ashaka kwishyura.
Umusaruro na premiere.
Filime yakozwe na Henry Ssali munsi ya Ssali Productions. Niyo filime ye ya kabiri yakoze nyuma yo gukora Kiwani muri 2008. Yakozwe nubuyobozi w'umutunzi n'umucuruzi Sudhir Ruparelia nawe wari umuyobozi mukuru yabyaye Kiwani. gutunganywa ndetse no gukina filimi byatangiye mu 2009 mugihe amashusho yoherejwe hanze muri 2014. Icyo gihe yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Mata 2014 i Munyonyo Kampala.
Igenzura ryabakinnyi ba film ryatangiye muri 2009. Allan Tumusiime, wigeze gukora kuri filime ya mbere ya Ssali Kiwani, yakinnye nka Collins Jjuuko. Umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya Makutano Ainea Ojiambo yatowe nkumuntu wanyuze kuri Phillip Luswata nawe wakoraga kuri Makutano. Ssali kandi yateye umuririmbyi Juliana Kanyomozi wari watangiye umwuga we wo gukina filime ye ya mbere Kiwani.

Devil's Chest ni filime y'intambara yo muri Uganda yasohotse 2017 ivuga ku nyeshyamba za Lord Resistance Army mu majyaruguru ya Uganda. Yanditswe, yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Hassan Mageye hamwe nabakinnyi Hasifah Nande Nakitende na Samuel Rogers Masaaba mu nshingano zabo. Yerekanwe bwa mbere i Gulu mu Kwakira 2017 n i Kampala muri Gicurasi 2019.
Mu gihe cya Lords Resistance Army (LRA) mu majyaruguru ya Uganda, umugore wo mu mudugudu ahatirwa kuba umugore w’umuyobozi w’inyeshyamba Joseph Kony, umugabo wishe umugabo we. Aba umusirikare kandi arwanira umudendezo.
Filime yakiriwe neza muri Uganda no muri Afrika yose kubera amateka yayo, gukina ndetse nicyerekezo. Yakiriye ibihembo byinshi (icyenda) mu bihembo bya 5 bya Uganda Film Festival Awards muri 2017 kandi yatsindiye ibihembo bine birimo Filime nziza n’umuyobozi mwiza. Yatowe kandi mu bihembo bya Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards 2018 (AMVCA) ibihembo bya Filime Nziza yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba na Filime Nziza Muri rusange. Bimwe mubice bya tekiniki, inkuru nibikorwa bya firime ariko byanenzwe. Collins Kakwezi wo mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Amakula yise iyi filime umushinga uteganijwe avuga ko ibikorwa byabuze kandi ko umuyobozi w'inyeshyamba, Joseph Kony yagaragajwe nk'umuntu mwiza binyuze ku mukinnyi Samuel Rogers Masaaba.

Bella Agossou wavutse 1981 ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Bénine muri sinema zo muri Esipanye.
Agossou yatangiye umwuga we muri Benin nk'umukinnyi w'amafirime hamwe na sosiyete "Sonangnon" yaremye kandi itezwa imbere na we. Icyakora, nyuma yimyaka 4 ashinze isosiyete, yimukiye muri Espagne mu 2002. Nyuma yize indimi z'Igikatalani n'Icyesipanyoli kugira ngo akore umwuga wo gukina filime. Yakinnye muri filime "Un cuento de Navidad" (Christmas Tale) afite uruhare runini rw’umugore ushakishwa na polisi kubera kubura impapuro nk’abimukira batemewe. Nyuma, yakinnye cyane mu mafilime menshi yo muri Afurika no mu mahanga harimo "Los Nuestros", "Moranetta", "A cuento ya Nadal" na "Palmeras en la Nieve". Ku ya 13 Nyakanga 2017, Agossou yeretse abanyamakuru iduka ryitwa "NOK".

Adrienne Ako Anomgbo Koutouan (wavutse 1969) numukinnyi wa filimi na comedi muri Cote d'Ivoire.
Koutouan ni umwe mu baturage ba Tchaman kandi yavukiye mu mudugudu wa Abobo-Té muri komine ya Abobo hafi ya Abidjan. Yifuzaga kuba umukinnyi wa filimi kuva akiri umwana, nubwo iki gitekerezo kitakiriwe neza n'ababyeyi be. Yatangiye umwuga we mu myaka ya za 1980 mu itsinda ry’ikinamico "Fétiche éburnéen". Mu 1986, Koutouan yagizwe umubyinnyi mwiza muri ballet ya Coryte d'Ivoire.
Koutouan yahawe ibihembo byinshi, harimo kwitwara neza mu bagore mu iserukiramuco rya Namur mu Bubiligi mu 1998, kwitwara neza mu bagore mu iserukiramuco rya M-Net ryabereye i Johannesburg mu 1999, ndetse n’umukinnyi wa Afurika witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco rya Pabbah muri Nijeriya mu 2002. Mu mwaka wa 2006, Koutouan yahawe igihembo cya Gold Standard mu iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou kubera kwitwara neza mu rukurikirane rwa "Quand les éléphants se battent". Azwi cyane muri Coryte d'Ivoire kubera uruhare rwe nka Rosalie mu rukurikirane rwa "Faut pas fâcher". Muri 2008, Koutouan yakinnye nka Infirmière Antoinette muri Dr. Boris ari kumwe na Ahmed Souaney.
Ku ya 14 Mata 2019, Koutouan yahawe icyubahiro mu birori byo kwizihiza imyaka 30 amaze ari umukinnyi wa filime, ahabwa itandukaniro riturutse kuri guverinoma. Yageze ku ntera ya ofisiye mu cyubahiro cy’umuco, na Minisiteri y’umuco na Francophonie. Umugatolika wubahaga Imana, Koutouan na we yagize misa mu cyubahiro cye.

Françoise Ellong (wavutse 8 Gashyantare 1988) ni umuyobozi wa firime n'umwanditsi wa filimi muri Kameruni.
Ellong yavukiye Douala, muri Kameruni mu 1988. Afite imyaka 11, yimukiye i Brunoy kubana na nyirarume, maze yandika inkuru ye ya mbere. Ellong yitabiriye amarushanwa y'abanditsi bato bavuga igifaransa mu 2002. Kubera amarushanwa, yagize ubushake bwo kwandika amashusho.
Mu 2006, filime ye ya mbere ngufi, "Les Colocs", yarasohotse. Ellong yayoboye filime ye ya mbere yerekana, "WAKA", mu 2013. yanditswe na Séraphin Kakouang, bishingiye ku nkuru y'umwimerere ya Ellong. "WAKA" yahawe igihembo cyihariye cy’abacamanza mu iserukiramuco du Cinéma Africain de Khouribga, ndetse n’igihembo cya Dikalo mu iserukiramuco rya Pan-African Cannes. Yerekanwe mugutangira ibirori bya Ecrans Noirs. Filime ye ya kabiri yerekana, "Buried", yasohotse muri 2020. Nibijyanye no guhura kwinshuti zo mu bwana numukino wagaragaje amabanga. Ifata amashusho mu mudugudu wa Nkassomo, yatewe inkunga na raporo yamakuru yabonye kuri tereviziyo.
Usibye kwandika no kuyobora, Ellong yasohoye igitabo "Journal Intime d'Un Meurtrier" mu 2008. Muri 2016, yatangije blog "Le Film Camerounais", bituma ibihembo bya LFC. Ellong yasabye ko hajyaho inkambi z’abakinnyi ba Thierry Ntamack mu 2020, Ntamack amaze kuvuga ko 10 ku ijana gusa by’abakinnyi ba Kameruni ari beza.

Christiane Chabi-Kao (wavutse ku ya 30 Kamena 1963) ni umuyobozi wa filime wo muri Bénine akaba n'umwanditsi.
Chabi-Kao yavukiye i Marseille mu Bufaransa mu 1963. Yize muri Kaminuza ya Reims Champagne-Ardenne kuva 1984 kugeza 1986. Mu 1990, Chabi-Kao yasubiye muri Afurika. Yasohokanye na filime ye ya mbere, "Les enfants esclaves", mu 2005, documentaire isobanura abana b'abacakara bigezweho.
Mu 2007, yayoboye filime "Les inseparables". Ivuga amateka y'abavandimwe Yawa na Abi, se bamugurisha ku mucuruza w'abana, maze nyina ajya mu ishami rishinzwe kurengera abana rya Polisi kugira ngo amenye uko byagenze. Iyi filime yakozwe na UNICEF na Radiyo na Televiziyo y'igihugu ya Bénin (ORTB), isohoka nk'uruhererekane rwa firime enye. Chabi-Kao yanditse iyi filime mu rwego rwo gukangurira no guhagarika icuruzwa ry'abana. Yakiriye igihembo nyafurika Numerique mu iserukiramuco rya Vues d'Afrique ryabereye i Montreal mu 2008, anahabwa igihembo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi na Televiziyo rya Panafrican 2009 rya Ouagadougou. Nyuma yo kumenyeshwa itegeko ribuza kwerekanwa ku buntu, Chabi-Kao yateguye kwerekana filime ku banyeshuri 300 ba Burkinabe.
Mu 2009, yasimbuye Monique Mbeke Phoba nk'umuyobozi w'ikirori cya Lagunimages i Cotonou. Nkumuyobozi, Chabi-Kao afasha kwambara iserukiramuco rya firime ryizina rimwe. Yakoreye iserukiramuco imyaka itari mike mbere yo kuba umuyobozi, ahabwa inkunga na Deutsche Welle Academy yo kwiga uko bategura ibirori. Chabi-Kao yanditse akanayobora ibiganiro bya televiziyo "bigizwe n'ibice 14" muri Les Chenapans muri 2013. Irerekana ubuzima nintambara byingimbi batanu bo muri Bénin, kandi ikoresha abakinnyi badafite umwuga.

Nyirarugero Dancille ni umunyarwandakazi w'umuhanga akaba yarabaye umwarimu muri kaminuza ndetse akaba yari umunyapolitiki aho yagizwe guverineri w'intara y'amajyaruguru y'U Rwanda muri werurwe 2021, ubu akaba yarakuwe kuri iyo mirimo akaba yaraginzwe Komiseri cyangwa umuyobozi wa Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo gusezerera no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abari Abasirikare.
Ubuzima bwabanje n'amashuri.
Nyirarugero Dancille ni mubyeyi wavutse mu mwaka wa 1970, akaba afite abana 4 harimo abakobwa batatu n'umuhungu umwe. Guverineri Nyirarugero Dancille yavukiye mu murenge wa muhoza, avukira mu karere ka Musanze mu ntara y'amajyaruguru, akaba yarashakanye na Nkundimana Fidele mu karere ka Nyabihu.
Nyirarugero Dancille yize amashuri abanza ku ishuri rya Rungu mu murenge wa Gacaca mu karere ka Musanze ayisumbuye ayigira muri Lyce Notre Dame de Citeaux i Kigali, yakomereje ikiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza muri kaminuza ya Ines-Ruhengeri, kubera inyota yarafite yo kunguka ubumenyi yakomereje ikiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza i kampala kuri kaminuza ya makelele yasoje muri 2009, Nyirarugero Dancille yaje gukomeza kw'iyungura ubumenyi mu budage muri 2017 aho yakuye indi myamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza.
Nyirarugero Dancille yahawe akazi ku bwarimu ko kuba umwarimu kuri kaminuza yigagaho ya Ines-Ruhengeri nyuma yo kugira amanota menshi, yakomereje imirimo ye mu ishuri rikuru rya Muhabura Integrated Polytechnic College(MIPC) Aho yarakuriye ishami rya Business Studies. Muri Werurwe 2021, nibwo Nyirarugero Dancille yahawe imirimo mishya yo kuba guverineri w'intara y'Amajyaruguru.
Nyirarugero Dancille ni mubyeyi ubibonako rwose akunda gusenga, aho asanzwe asengera mu itorero Anglican muri Diyosezi ya Shyira Katedarali Yohani Umubatiza Wera, akaba ari umwe mu bagize Korali y’ababyeyi yitwa Jyana Umucyo. Umwana wanjye mukuru yarangije Kamunuza, ukurukiyeho arangije umwaka wa mbere muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, uwa gatatu ari mu mashuri yisumbuye mu mwaka wa gatandatu mu gihe bucura ari mu mwaka wa kane w’amashuri yisumbuye”.Uwo muyobozi wazindukiye mu kazi kuri uyu wa Kabiri aho yigisha mu ishuri rikuru rya MIPC.

Mureshyankwano Marie Rose yavutse 1968 mu Rwanda, ni umugore akaba umunyarwandakazi w'umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Mureshyankwano afite impanyabushobozi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cy'akaminuza mu byigisho by'iterambere. Kuva mu 1992 kugeza 1994, na none kuva 1997 kugeza 2001 akora akazi ko kwigisha mu mashuri abanza imyaka irenga 12 umwarimu mu mashuri abanza mu Karere ka Rutsiro. Kuva 2001 kugeza 2005 yari umwarimu mu ishuri ryisumbuye kuri Bumba Complex School.
Yavutse mu muryango w' abana icyenda: abakobwa batandatu n’abahungu batatu, akurira mu muryango warimo amatungo, inka n’ihene. Icyo gihe hari muri Komine Karago muri Gisenyi, ubu ni muri Nyabihu. Ubu bafite abana batatu, barimo babiri biga muri kaminuza. Yaje kujya mu muryango wa FPR Inkotanyi muri 2000.
Mureshyankwano muri 2005 yagiriwe icyizere cyo kuba umwe mu mutwe w’abadepite. Yakomeje kuba umudepite kugeza mu 2016. Kuva mu 2016 kugeza 2018 yabaye Guverineri w'Intara y'Amajyepfo, naho muri 2018-19 akora nk'umujyanama mu bunyamabanga bukuru bwa FPR-Inkotanyi.
Senateri Mureshyankwano Marie Jose yatanze ubuhamya bw'urugendo rwe mu mashyamba ya Congo ndetse asobanura neza uburyo nuko inkotanyi zarokoye umugabo we zikamukiza indwara y ‘ ubuhutu.Ikiganiro cyabereye mwihuriro ry’urubyiruko ryiswe “Ingano Cyungano'’
