MUKAMABANO Madeleine yavutse mu mwaka wi 1955 avukira mu Rwanda, yize amashuri abanza mu rwanda, 1973 yakomereje amashuri yisumbuye mu gihugu cya Uganda, mu gihe Uganda yari mubibazo bya politiqwe kubwa president ADIAMINI Dada. Madelene yaje gufashwa naba diplomate babafaransa bamutwara mu mujyi wa paris, aho yari ajyiye gutegerereza burse yo gukomereza amashuri mu gihugu cyubwongereza muri kaminuza ya stanford. Kubera imbogamizi nyinshi yahuye nazo, yafashe umwanzuro wo gukomeza icyiciro cyagatatu cya kaminuza muri Moderne letter in Sarbonne.
Yakomeje umwuga we muri mission yarafite muri Togo, yabaye umwarimu mu gihugu cya cote d'Ivoire ndetse yaje kuba umu consultant muri Ethiopie.
Mu mwaka wa 1999 yakoze kuri radio yumuco yabafaransa(radio france culture). Yakoranye umwete numurava bimuha amahirwe yo kugirwa umuyobozi wibiganiro mbarankuru kuri iyo radio. Yanditse raporo eshanu zivuga ku kugarura amahoro mubanyarwanda nyuma yibyabaye muri Genocide yakorewe abatutsi mu mwaka wi 1994.
Mu mwaka 2000,yakoze film mbarankuru kiuri Genocide yakorewe abatutsi mu mwaka wa 1994, ahura nabarokotse Genocide ndetse nabakoze genocide, iyi film yakunzwe nabenshi, ituma abanyarwanda bongera kwiremamo Icyizere Cyo Kubaho. Iyi film yaje guhabwa igihembo kizwi nka Bayeux Calvados-Normandie Prize for war correspondents.
Mu mwaka 2003 yabaye umujyanama mukuru wabatunganya inkuru kuri Radio France culture, bakorera kumugabane wa Africa. Yakomeje kuyobora ibiganiro ndetse ikizi nka African Debate. Iyi mirimo yose yayifatanyaga ninshingano yari afite muri European Union nindi mishinga itegamiye kuri leta. Mu mwaka wa 2010 Yagaritse Umwuga witangazamuakuru aho yari amaze imyaka 20 yose muri uyu mwuga.

Mukakalisa Jeanne d’Arc ni umwe mubategarugori bagize inteko Ishingamategeko umutwe wa Sena, akaba yaratorewe kuzajya mu inteko Ishingamategeko umutwe wa Sena nk’uko byemejwe n’inama nyunguranabitekerezo y’imitwe ya Politiki mu Rwanda.aturuka mu Ishyaka PDC.Iyinama y’iri huriro ry’imitwe ya politiki yemewe mu Rwanda yateranye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 20 Nzeri 2012, niyo yemeje uyu musenateri bashya.Uyu musenaterari akaba yarafatanyishe nabanyarwanda muri gahunda ya ndumunyarwanda akaba yemezako ndumunyarwanda ari urukingo rw'ejo heza h'u RwandaAkaba yarayoboye comite ya sena ishinzwe gutanga amakuru kubinyobwa bikorerwa mu Rwanda

Kirabo Kacyira Aisa (yavutse muri 1964 apfa ku ya 12 Kanama 2025) ni umunyarwandakazi w'umunyapolitiki ndetse w'impuguke mub'ubuveterineri w'abigize umwuga. Kacyira akaba yarabaye n'umuyobozi wungirije wa UN HABITAT.
Kacyira afite Impamyabumenyi ihanitse m'ubumenyi bw'amatungo mubijyanye no kuvura ndetse no kwita ku amatungo, yakuye muri Kaminuza yitwa James Cook muri ositarariya. Kacyira kandi yize muri kaminuza ya Makerere iherereye muri gihugu cy' Ubugande, kandiKacyira yakuye impamyabumyenyi ihanitse ya Masters ku buvuzi.
Kirabo Kacyira yabaye Guverineri w'intara y'iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Intara nini ituwe n'abasaga million 2.5 z'abaturage. Kacyira kandi yabaye umu Diplomate w'u Rwanda arugaraiye mu bindi bihugu.
Kacyira kandi yabaye umuyobozi wungirije akaba nu munyamabanga mukuru w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye Habitat kuva mu gushyingo 2011, kugeza mu 2018, muri porogaramu n’imishinga bya Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi mu Rwanda (Minagri) ndetse n’imiryango itegamiye kuri leta irimo Oxfam na Care International.Muri iyo mirimo ye yabaye umuyobozi mwiza mu ibyo yarashinzwe cyane no guteza imbere umujyi wa Kigali.
Dr Aisa Kirabo Kacyira kurubu ni Ambasaderi uhagarariye u Rwanda muri Ghana muri 2020, Kirabo Kacyira Aisa afite icyicaro muri icyo gihugu akabifatanya no kuruhagararira mu bihugu birimo Benin, Togo, Sierra Leone, kote divura na Liberiya. Rero umunyamabanga mukuru w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, Guterres Antonio, yahaye Umunyarwandakazi, Kirabo Kacyira Aissa, inshingano zo kuyobora Ibiro by’uyu muryango (United Nations Support Office in Somalia: UNSOS) bifasha Afurika Yunze Ubumwe mu butumwa bw’amahoro muri Somaliya. Kirabo Kacyira yinjiranye muri izi nshingano ubunararibonye bw’imyaka 30 akesha imirimo itandukanye yakoze yaba ifite aho ihuriye na dipolomasi, politiki ndeste n’iyo yakoze mu miryango y’iterambere cyangwa iy’ubutabazi, imbere mu gihugu, ndetse no mu karere no ku rwego ruri mpuzamahanga.
Dr Kacyira kandi yayoboye Umujyi wa Kigali kuva muri 2006 kugeza muri 2011, akaba ari umwe mu mijyi yihuta cyane mu iterambere k'umuvuduko udasanzwe. Mugihe yari ayoboye umujyi wa Kigali, Aisa yahawe igihembo na UN HABITAT muri 2008, mu rwego rwo gushimira urwego rw'isuku,umutekano ndetse n'iterambere rirambye.
Dr Kirabo Aisa Kacyira ni umubyeyi wubatse kandi akaba afite abana bane.

Onechi Lwenje (wavutse 1985) ni umukinnyi wa sinema ya Zambiya. Usibye gukina, Onechi numwanditsi wamamaye, umukinnyi wa firime na producer. Kugeza ubu ayoboye Isosiyete y'Itangazamakuru yitwa 'Landmark Communications Limited'.
Onechi yavutse mu 1985 i Lusaka, muri Zambiya avuka ku munyamakuru w'inararibonye na nyina w’umuhinzi mu muryango ufite barumuna be batatu. Se Patson Victor Robert Lwenje yakoraga mu biro bya diplomasi i Beijing mu Bushinwa, aho Onechi yari afite imyaka ibiri n'igice icyo gihe. Patson kandi yari umunyamakuru mu myaka ya za 1980, asesengura umuziki akaba n'umwanditsi w'imyidagaduro.
Onechi yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri mpuzamahanga rya Beijing, Nkwazi Primary na Gospel Outreach Christian Academy. Nyuma yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Kabulonga Boys ryisumbuye kandi arangiza amashuri mu 2002. Hanyuma, yakurikiranye amasomo mu micungire yamakuru muri ZCAS. Numushinga wa Microsoft Sisitemu yemewe kandi yakoraga muri NCC Phoneix Contractors hamwe na Mediterranean Shipping Company mumyaka mike.
Mu 1999, Onechi yifatanije nu mushinga wa Zambiya kugirango bakore ikinamico ishingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko yo kurwanya imiti n’ibiyobyabwenge kandi ikinamico yiswe "Don't". Yakinnye muri ako gakino mu turere duturanye mu mashuri agera ku 10. Hagati aho, yatakaje imyaka mike yubuzima muri sosiyete itwara ibicuruzwa. Hanyuma mu 2005, yatangiye guhimba imivugo maze yinjira mu binyamakuru n'ibitabo byinshi birimo 'Nkhani Kulture' mu 2010 na 'Nkwazi In-Flight' muri 2013.
Muri 2017, Onechi yinjijwe nka perezida wa 48 wa Rotary Club ya Lusaka Central abaye umuhererezi ufite uyu mwanya kugeza ubu. Nka perezida, yakoze imishinga igaragara nko kubaka ibitaro by’amagufwa by’Ubutaliyani, ikigo cy’amahugurwa cy’urubyiruko cya Kabulonga n’umushinga wa Vita-Nov wo gutanga ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi ku bitaro bya Chongwe n’ibitaro by’abana by’ubuvuzi bya kaminuza (UTH) bivura indwara z’umutima n’umuriro.. Hanyuma yubatse icyumba cy'ishuri mu cyaro cy'akarere ka Chibombo.

Kenneth Yannick, (yavukiye: 30 Ukwakira 1995), ni umunyaBene ukina comedy. Niwe washinze Cotonou Comedy Club, ifatwa nkigitaramo cya mbere gihagaze neza muri Benin.
Yannick yavutse ku ya 30 Ukwakira 1995 i Cotonou, muri Bénin aho yakuriye na nyina wenyine. Mugihe yize, yabanje gukora icyiciro cya gatanu cyerekeza kubinyabuzima kuko ubuvuzi aribwo yashyize imbere. Ariko, nyuma yaje guhindukirira imibare igana inzira. Hanyuma, Yannick yamaze umwaka mwishuri rya Polytechnic rya kaminuza ya Abomey-Calavi (EPAC) ryabaye ibyago. Yatangiye gukora videwo ngufi zisekeje muri 2013. Nyuma ya baccalauréat, yarangije amasomo yubwubatsi.
Mu mwaka wa 2008, yavumbuye igihagararo hamwe na "Papa est en haut", Gad Elmaleh yerekanaga aho ayireba kuri mudasobwa. Muri 2013, yatangiye gukora amashusho asetsa kuri interineti no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga ya dogiteri muri physiologiya, yabaye umwarimu wa siporo, imwemerera kubona amafaranga ahagije yo kwishyura ubukode no gufasha umuryango we. Hanyuma, hagati ya 2015 na 2016, yagerageje gusetsa imbere yinshuti muminsi mikuru y'amavuko.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Yannick yakoze igitaramo cye cya mbere cyo gusetsa imbere y’abantu 600 batazi stand up comedy byabereye mu kigo cy’ubuyobozi bw’igihugu n’ubucamanza (ENAM). Nibwo bwambere comedi ihagaze muri Bénin. Nyuma ku ya 4 Kanama 2017, yashinze Cotonou Comedy Club (CCC) ari kumwe n'inshuti Jean Morel Morufux (Morel) na Fadil Romxi. Ni ubwambere igitaramo cyahariwe guhaguruka gitangwa muri Bénin.

Edgar-Yves (Edgar-Yves Monnou Junior), umufaransa wavukiye muri Bénine ukina comedy. Ni umunyamuryango wa Golden Comedy Club ya Paris.
Ni umuhungu w'umunyapolitiki wo muri Bénine Edgar Yves Monnou. Monnouh akiri umwana, umuryango we wimukiye mu Bufaransa kubera ko se yari ambasaderi wa Benin i Paris.
Ubwa mbere, ntiyashakaga gukora urwenya. Icyakora, inshuti ze zamubwiye gukora amashusho kuri enterineti. Icyo gihe, yari i Nantes aho yiyandikishije na sosiyete ya café-théâtre kugirango atezimbere gukina amashusho ye. Muri 2013, yashinze club yo gusetsa ya West Side i Nantes. Hamwe nimyiyerekano, akabari kuri café-théâtre kuzura kandi buri wa gatatu hari abantu 120. Yakinnye igitaramo cye igihe cyose, gatatu mu cyumweru.
Yabaye inkingi kuri Rire &amp; Chansons muri 2017. Hagati aho, yahuye na producer wa Jeff Panocloc Philippe Delmas. Delmas yahaye Monnouh kuza i Paris kuri Theatre ya Apollo. Muri uwo mwaka, yimukiye i Paris maze akora ibitaramo byinshi byo gusetsa bihagaze mu makinamico atandukanye i Paris. Urugendo rwatangiye ku ya 22 Mata muri Comédie de Toulouse, nyuma yimukira ku ya 28 na 29 Mata i Metz kuri café-theatre Le Burlesque, ku ya 21 Gicurasi ahitwa Les Fous rires de Toulouse na 7 Kamena kuri Théâtre de l'Ouest i Rouen.

Pierre Zinko (wavutse 1969), uzwi cyane ku izina rye rya stage Eléphant Mouillé, ni umuririmbyi wo muri Bénine, umunyarwenya n'umukinnyi. Ni umwe mu banyamuryango bashinze 'Sèmako Wobaho theatre na sinema'. Ni n'umukinnyi uzwi cyane mu ikinamico no muri sinema.
Zinko yavutse 1969 i Bohicon, muri Bénin.
Ku myaka 12, Zinko yatangiye ari umukanishi wa moto. Muri kiriya gihe, ibitaramo byayo byubuhanzi byagarukiraga mubyabaye gusa. Mu 1986, yabonye impamyabumenyi ye ya nyuma yo kwimenyereza umwuga. Hanyuma Wet Elephant yimukiye i Cotonou agamije gushinga amahugurwa ye. Ariko, atangira imishinga yubuhanzi muri Cotonou ubwo yahuraga na Pipi Wobaho.
Mu 1996, Wobaho ari kumwe n'incuti ye magara Simplice Behanzin uzwi ku izina rya Pipi Wobaho bashinze "Sèmako Wobaho ikinamico na sinema" kugira ngo barusheho kunoza ireme rya sinema n'ikinamico. Ubufatanye bwabo buganisha kubikorwa byinshi byikinamico kuri Bénin. Mu mwaka wa 2010 hamwe n’isosiyete Sèmako Wobaho, babonye disiki ya zahabu ku nshuro ya 4 y’ibirori "Umunsi w’Afurika" babinyujije mu isosiyete yabo y’imikino mu cyiciro cya firime za TV. Icyakora, baratandukanye mu 2013. Muri 2008, isosiyete yakoze firime izwi "If it was you?", urukurikirane ruva mubufatanye nabandi banyarwenya benshi bo muri Bénin. Muri 2012, aba Sèmako Wobaho bombi bakoze film "Capricious Apprentice".
Wet Elephant yakoze ibitaramo birenga 500 muri Bénin. Afite umwuga yamamaye hanze kuva 1986 kugeza 2019 hamwe n'ibihembo birenga 100 ndetse no kugaragara 200 mumashusho yindirimbo zabahanzi. Yagaragaye kandi muri firime zigera kuri 41, muri zo 20 ziyobowe na we nk'umwanditsi-umuyobozi ndetse na producer.Muri 2019, yijihije imyaka 25 amaze akora umwuga w'ubuhanzi.

Yohann Kouam (wavutse 1982), ni umukinnyi wa firime w’Abafaransa kimwe na producer, umwanditsi wa sinema ukomoka muri Kameruni. Yakoze firime ngufi zamamaye cyane.
Yohann numuyobozi wa firime y' ubufaransa. Se ni umucungamari naho nyina ni umunyamahoteri.
Yize gutunganya firime muri Institut des arts de diffusion i Buruseli, hanyuma yiga Ubuhinduzi mu Bufaransa. Nyuma yaje kuba umufasha wigisha mumashuri yisumbuye gutanga amasomo yindimi.
Muri 2007, Kouam yakoze film ngufi "Fragments de vie". Yakiriwe neza, yakoze film ya kabiri ngufi ya "Les dimanches de Léa" mu 2010. Yaje gukora filime ngufi "Yagarutse" mu 2013, yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Muri 2016, yakoze film "Kuva San Francisco hamwe nUrukundo".

Ariane Astrid Atodji ;(yavutse 1980), ni Umukinnyi wa firime Kameruni ndetse akaba n'umwanditsi. Yakoze documentaire nyinshi zamamaye cyane harimo "Koundi et le Jeudi national" na "La souffrance est une école de sagesse".
Yavutse mu 1980 i Nguelemendouka, muri Kameruni. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Yaoundé hanyuma yitabira amahugurwa ya firime mu kigo cya Goethe muri Yaoundé. Hanyuma yimukiye muri LN International Film School ya Yaoundé kugirango akomeze kwiga.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yayoboye "filime ye ya mbere ya Koundi et le Jeudi national" yakozwe ku nkunga ya Goethe Institute. Yatsindiye igihembo cy’abacamanza kidasanzwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Dubai (DIFF) kubera iyi filime. Muri 2014, yayoboye documentaire ya kabiri "La souffrance est une école de sagesse".

Josza Anjembé (wavutse 1982), ni umukinnyi w’amafirime w’umufaransa kimwe n’umwanditsi akaba n’umunyamakuru ukomoka muri Kameruni. Yakoze firime nyinshi zamamaye cyane zirimo "Le bleu blanc rouge de mes" "cheveux" na Baltringue.
Yavutse mu 1982 i Paris mu Bufaransa na se wa Kameruni,; n'umubyeyi w'umufaransa akaba umuforomo. Josza afite musaza we w'impanga. Yakuriye i Bondy kugeza afite imyaka 7 hanyuma yimukira muri Les Lilas, Seine-Saint-Denis mu mijyi ya Pantin na Pré-Saint-Gervais.
Nyuma ya baccalauréat (igice cya ES), Josza yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu 2004 mu itumanaho muri kaminuza ya Paris 8 Vincennes-Saint-Denis. Kuva 2004, Josza yakoraga nkumunyamakuru wa TF1 hanyuma akorera Fance 5 na France 2. Hagati ya 2009 na 2011, yari umunyamakuru w'amashusho kuri televiziyo ya Afrika 24. Muri 2011, Josza yakoze documentaire, "Massage à la camerounaise". Filime yatoranijwe na Festival International de Programs Audiovisuels (umunsi mukuru wa FIPA wa Biarritz), ndetse n'iya Montreal na Créteil.
Muri 2012, yahawe inkunga ya Fondation Bleustein-Blanchet. Muri 2014, yitabiriye "Talents en court" ya Jamel Comedy Club, kikaba ari igikoresho yizeye ko azakora film ye ya mbere ngufi. Hagati ya 2013 na 2016, yakoze nk'umunyamuryango w'ibirori "Buzzons kurwanya igitsina". Muri 2014, yakurikiranye amahugurwa yungirije umusaruro mu kigo gishinzwe politiki mpuzamahanga y’ibiribwa n’ubuhinzi (CIFAP). Hanyuma yakurikiranye amasomo yo gusesengura amashusho muri Institut national de l'audiovisuel (INA). Muri Werurwe 2014, documentaire ikwirakwizwa no ku nteko ishinga amategeko. Muri 2012, yayoboye documentaire ya kabiri, "KRUMP: amateka ya Krump mu Bufaransa". Kuri firime, yakurikiranye itsinda ryababyinnyi imyaka ine. Filime yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco ryimico yo mumijyi i Paris. Filime ishingiye kuri KRUMP (kuri "Powerful praise of a radically elevated kingdom", cyangwa "IKingdom Radically Uplifted Mighty Praise"), ni imbyino ihumekwa n "imbyino ya clown", yahimbwe mu 1992 na Thomas Johnson.

Charles Mensah yari umukinnyi wa firime wa Gabon, umwanditsi wa sinema akaba n'umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro. Azwi cyane ku izina rya "The Gentleman of African Cinemas", Mensah yagize uruhare muri documentaire nyinshi zamamaye cyane nka "Équateur", "Les Couilles de l'éléphant" na "Lybek, ipfunwe ry'abazima". Yakoze nk'umuntu uharanira iterambere rya sinema yigenga yo mu majyepfo mu mwuga umaze imyaka irenga mirongo itatu.
Yavutse mu 1948 i Omboué, muri Gabon. Yapfuye ku ya 3 Kamena 2011, afite imyaka 63.
Mu 1976, yakoze ibihimbano bye bya mbere, "Obali" afatanya na Pierre-Marie Ndong. Hanyuma mu 1977 yakoze umushinga wa kabiri "Ayouma" afatanya na Ndong na Patience Dabany. Intsinzi yo gukora amafilime, Mensah yagize uruhare mu gutunganya, kuri iyi nshuro hamwe na filime "Équateur", yasinyiye Serge Gainsbourg. Hamwe n’umukinnyi wa filime uzwi cyane Henri-Joseph Koumba Bididi mu 1995, Mensah yagize uruhare muri televiziyo "L'Auberge du Salut", filime yuzuye ya Gabon.
Nkumuproducer, Mensah yitabiriye ibikorwa byinshi birimo: "Le Damier de Balufu Bakupu Kanyinda" mu 1996, "Dôlè (l'Argent)" na Imunga Iwanga mu 2000, "Les Couilles de l'éléphant" mu 2001 na "N'Djamena City" iyobowe na Issa Serge Coelo mu 2006. Yagize kandi uruhare muri documentaire ngufi kuri "Lybek, le crunch du vivant". Kugeza mu 2009, yari afite umwanya wo kuba Umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo cy'igihugu cya Sinema ya Gabon (CENACI), ubu kikaba kizwi ku izina rya Gabonese Institute of Image and Sound (IGIS). Muri uwo mwaka, yabaye perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abakora amafilime muri Pan-Afurika (FEPACI) ndetse no muri komisiyo ishinzwe ikigega cyo gufasha amafilime y’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’igifaransa. Muri 2011, yakoraga muri Bididi's "Le collier du Makoko" yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga harimo na Cannes.

Henri-Yozefu Koumba Bididi yavutse 15 Nyakanga 1957), ni umunya Gabo ukora filimi, akandika filimi ndetse anakora kuri Tv nka televiziyo manager umusaruro ahanini utaziguye muma documentary films. Yakoze documentaire nyinshi zamamaye cyane harimo "na Necklace ya King" na "Le Singe Fou". Usibye icyerekezo, yanakoze, yandika cyangwa ayobora inyandiko nyinshi kuri tereviziyo.
Yavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga 1957 i Omboué, muri Gabon. Yarangije amashuri ya firime muri École supérieure d'études cinématographiques (ESEC) mu Bufaransa.
Mu 1983, Bididi yakoraga nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe gukina filime "Équatur" iyobowe na Serge Gainsbourg. Hanyuma mu 1986, yasinyiye muri firime ngufi "Le singe fou". Yahawe igihembo kubera kunenga abanyamakuru b'Abarabu mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage ndetse anahabwa igihembo gikomeye cya Filime ngufi mu iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo rya 10 rya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) mu 1987.
Kuva mu 1988 kugeza 1991, Bididi yari umuyobozi w'ishami rya radiyo na televiziyo byo mu karere ka ' Haut-Ogoué '. Kuva mu 1991 kugeza 1994, Bididi yazamuwe kuba umuyobozi wungirije mushya wa Radio Télévision Gabonaise (RTG). Mu 2000, yakomeje gukora nk'umuyobozi wa tereviziyo akaba na producer wa filime ye ya mbere yakinnye, "Les Couilles de l'éléphant". Iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 17 rya Afurika ryabereye i Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Mu 1994, Bididi yayoboye ibice bibiri bya serivise ya "L'auberge du Salut".
Muri uwo mwaka, yayoboye filime yerekana "Le collier du Makoko", iyi ikaba ari filime ihenze cyane muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara yarashwe hamwe na miliyoni 4 z'amayero. Filime yateguwe mu myaka 4, aho gufata amashusho byatwaye amezi atatu. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza mu maserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ya filime kandi yegukana igihembo cy’abacamanza kidasanzwe ndetse n’igihembo cyo gusobanura abagabo mu iserukiramuco rya Khouribga 2012 ryabereye muri Maroc. Yatsindiye kandi igihembo cyo Gusobanura mu iserukiramuco rya Ecrans Noirs 2012 ryabereye muri Kameruni nk'icyo gihembo cy’amajwi meza na posita nziza muri FESPACO 2013. Muri 2013, iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cy'abari bitabiriye iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Masuku 2013 ryabereye i Gabon.

Manouchka Kelly Labouba, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Gabon akaba n'umwanditsi wa sinema cyane cyane ayobora firime ngufi. Yakoze firime nyinshi zamamaye cyane zirimo "Marty et la tendre dame", "Le guichet automatique" na "Le ubutane". Usibye icyerekezo, ni n'umunyeshuri, umukinnyi wa sinema, umwanditsi akaba n'umukoresha wa kamera.
Mu 2005, yize Filime &amp; Media Studies muri kaminuza ya California, Santa Barbara. Hanyuma, mu 2007, yabonye Master de Recherche, Ubuhanzi muri kaminuza ya Bordeaux Montaigne. Nyuma yaje kurangiza impamyabumenyi ya MA Critical Studies hanyuma Ph.D. Kwiga Sinema n'Itangazamakuru muri kaminuza y’amajyepfo ya Californiya kugirango abone kandi yarangije afite Impamyabumenyi mu bucuruzi bwimyidagaduro.
Mu 2004, yakoze "Bouchées d'Amours" ngufi. Yatoranijwe kumugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ryabanyeshuri rya 2004 Chartres. Mu mwaka wa 2008, yatangiye gukina sinema ya mbere "Le ubutane", yamamaye cyane mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime.yi minota 40 ngufi yashyizwe mu gutoranya ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage mu 2008, gutoranya ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi na Televiziyo bya Panafrican 2009 rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO), guhitamo ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya Ecrans Noirs ryo mu 2009, guhitamo ku mugaragaro muri Filime Nyafurika y'Abagore ya Ouagadougou 2010 Umunsi mukuru. Yatoranijwe kandi mu marushanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime ngufi rya Abidjan 2010 (FFAA) na Iserukiramuco rya Filime ryigenga rya 2012. Yatsindiye kandi igihembo cyumuyobozi wambere witwaye neza muri 2009 Eacrans Noirs Festival.
Muri 2010, yayoboye firime enye: "Bébé Portable", "Combien Ca Coute?", "Enfant De Ta Mére", na "Le Menteur &amp; Le Voleur" aho nyuma yaje gushyirwa mu majwi mu iserukiramuco rya Ecrans Noirs 2010. Yakoze kandi nk'umuyobozi wungirije wa mbere muri filimi ngufi 3: "La Particuliére", "Les Bonnes Maniéres", na "La Guerre des Ordures". Muri 2011 yayoboye "Le guichet automatique" yashyizwe mu guhitamo kumugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya Ecrans Noirs 2011.
Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, yakoze nk'umwanditsi wa firime nyinshi ngufi zirimo: "Kuva DWG kugeza DWJr: The Black ManÕs Burden" (2006) na "Michel Ndaot: Entre Ombres et Lumiéres" (2008).

Waithira, ni filime yo muri 2017 yo muri Kenya- Amajyepfo y’Africa yerekana ubuzima bwa film yerekanwe na Eva Njoki Munyiri kandi yafatanije n’umuyobozi ubwe hamwe na Stefan Gieren na Jean Meeran muri Team Tarbaby. Iyi filime ivuga ku mateka y’umuyobozi Eva Njoki Munyiri n’amasangano yayo n'amateka yibagiwe ya Kenya, umuco wa pop na diaspora.
Waithira yakiriwe neza kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Hari screened mikuru nka DIFF y'Epfo &amp; guhura, Iserukiramuco rya Filime Nyafurika, Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Créteil, n'ibindi Muri 2018, iyi filime yari ihagarariwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry'inyandiko rya Munich.

Marie-Clémence Andriamonta Paes (wavutse 1959), ni umukinnyi wa firime w’Abafaransa wo muri Malagasi. Yakoze inyandiko nyinshi zamamaye cyane zirimo: "Angano." "." "." "Angano." "." ".", "Mahaleo" na "L'opéra du bout du monde". Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni producer numwanditsi.
Yavutse mu 1959 kuri se w’umufaransa na nyina wa Malagasy. Yarangije impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Sociology na Marketing CELSA-Sorbonne Diploma.Yashakanye na César Paes, akaba n'umuyobozi wa filimi uvuka muri Franco-Berezile.
Mu 1988, yatangije uruganda rwigenga rukorera i Paris rwitwa 'Laterit Productions' hamwe n'umugabo we César. Isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa yiyemeje gukwirakwiza no gutangaza. Hamwe numugabo we César Paes, yanditse kandi akora documentaire nka "Angano." "." "." "Angano." "." "." "Umugani wo muri Madagasikari", "Indirimbo n'amarira ya Kamere", na "Soup ya Awara". "Awara Soup" yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi muri Cinéma du Réel, Festival dei Popoli na Dok Leipzig. Filime ze nka "Saudade do Futuro", "Mahaleo", "Opera yo mu nyanja y'Ubuhinde" "n'indirimbo za Madagasikari" zasohotse mu ikinamico mu Bufaransa no muri Amerika. Muri documentaire ye, umuziki ni ikintu cyingenzi kandi umuziki ukoreshwa nkibintu byerekana inkuru. Amenshi muri firime ayobowe na Clémence yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mu iserukiramuco rya Cinéma du Réel.

Siatta Scott Johnson (yavutse 1974), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Liberiya akaba n'umunyamakuru utangaza amakuru. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire izwi cyane "Iron Ladies of Liberia". Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni umunyamakuru ndetse na producer. Ni n'umunyamuryango washinze itangazamakuru rya Omuahtee Africa.
Yavutse mu 1974 i Buchanan, muri Liberiya. Nyuma yakuriye mu cyaro cya Grand Bassa. Mu ntangiriro ya za 90, Johnson yahunze avuye muri Grand Bassa intambara itangira. Nyuma yaje gutura muri Monrovia mu gihe intambara yarangiraga mu 2003.
Amashuri amaze gufungura nyuma y'intambara, Johnson yarangije icyiciro cya kabiri cya Bachelor of Arts mu itumanaho rusange yakuye muri kaminuza ya Liberiya. Hanyuma, yafashe impamyabumenyi muri raporo za politiki yakuye muri kaminuza ya Liberiya, nyuma mu bitangazamakuru avuye mu ihuriro ry’abanyamakuru bo muri Liberiya ndetse n’ubutumwa bw’umuryango w’abibumbye muri Liberiya (UNMIL). Afite kandi impamyabumenyi mu itangazamakuru yakuye muri Liberia Institute of Journalism. Yakoze kandi nk'umunyamakuru akaba na producer muri Downtown Community Televiziyo Centre (DCTV).
Mu 2007, yakoze documentaire yamamaye cyane "Iron Ladies yo muri Liberiya" afatanije na Daniel Junge. Iyi documentaire yahawe icyubahiro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Dallas, Target Ten Filmmaker nka Documentaire nziza yuwo mwaka kandi ibaye Filime Nziza Yaturutse Isi Y’Amashuri mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime Isi ryabereye i Prague. Usibye ibyo, film yanagaragaye mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime.
Usibye sinema, ni umunyamakuru uzwi cyane muri Liberiya aho yakoranye n'ishyirahamwe ry'abanyamakuru b'abagore bo muri Liberiya (FeJAL). Yakoze kandi muri Beyondmedia Education i Chicago, muri Amerika. Johnson amaze gusubira muri Liberiya, yakoze mu kubaka itangazamakuru ry’urubyiruko rwo muri Liberiya. Nyuma yaje gukora ubuvugizi bw'itangazamakuru mu nama ishinzwe impunzi muri Noruveje (NRC) aho yateguye ibiganiro bya radiyo ku bagore bo mu cyaro mu mushinga witwa “ABAGORE B'UBWENGE”. Yakoranye kandi na Medica Mondiale Liberia nk'ushinzwe itumanaho aho yorohereza impinduka mu myitwarire mu bagore bo mu cyaro batuye mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Liberiya. Johnson yabaye producer wa gahunda ya tereviziyo yitwa 'Amajwi Yingenzi' yari gahunda kubakobwa b'ingimbi n'abangavu. Muri 2012, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru n’umuyobozi uhanga muri Smart Media Liberia. Muri 2019, yongeye gutorerwa kuba perezida w'ishyirahamwe ry'abanyamakuru b'abagore bo muri Liberiya.

Kalifa Dienta (yavutse 1 Mutarama 1940), yari umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Mali. Yari azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filime yakunzwe cyane "A Banna". Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, yari n'umwanditsi akaba n'umukinnyi wa sinema.
Yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1940 i Macina, muri Mali, yitaba Imana ku ya 2021 i Bamako, muri Mali. Yize sinema i Moscou.
Mu 1980, yayoboye filime "A Banna" yakiriwe neza cyane n'abayireba kandi atoranywa mu minsi mikuru mpuzamahanga ya firime.

Djibril Kouyate (yavutse 1942), ni umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka muri Mali. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zamamaye cyane nka "The Tieman", "Tiefing" na "Walaha".
Yavutse mu 1942 i Bamako, muri Mali.
Muri 1969, yakinnye bwa mbere mubuyobozi bwa mbere na "l'artisanat". Hanyuma yakoze film "Le retour de Tieman" (1970), "Le drapeau noir au sud du berceau" (1976) na "Le Mali aujourd'hui" (1978). Nkumukinnyi, yakinnye muri firime: "Verloren Maandag" (1974), "Ta Dona" (1991), na "Macadam tribu" (1999). Mu 2000, yakinnye muri firime yitwa "Code inconnu" yamenyekanye cyane aho imico ye nka 'Youssouf' yashimiwe cyane.

Awa Traoré, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Mali. Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, Traoré ni umuyobozi wungirije, uwahimba ndetse n'umwanditsiwa filimi.
Traoré yatangiye umwuga we muri film ya "L'enfant noir" 1995. Nyuma yaje kuba 'umuhigi' muri filime ngufi ya "Denko yo" mu 1993 iyobowe na Mohamed Camara. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema mpuzamahanga rya Clermont-Ferrand, igihembo cya filime ngufi nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Friborg ndetse n’igihembo cya Golden Danzante mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Huesca.

Ladji Diakité, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Mali. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zamamaye cyane nka "Duel à Dafa" na "Fantan Fanga". Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, Diakité ni umuyobozi wungirije hamwe nuwashushanyaga imyambarire.
Yavukiye i Bamako, muri Mali. Diakité yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buvanganzo yakuye muri Ecole Normale Supérieure. Yize kandi muri Centre national du cinéma et de l'image animée (Ikigo cyigihugu gishinzwe gutunganya film).
Mu 1991, yinjiye muri filime "Ta Dona nk'ushushanya" imyambarire. Hanyuma mu 1997, yakoze muri film "Taafé Fanga" nk'umuyobozi wungirije.
Mu 2001, yayoboye filime "yumukobwa La Rencontre des chasseurs". Mu 2006, yagiye muri firime ya tele "Duel a Dafa". Hanyuma mu 2007, yayoboye "Duel à Dafa" hanyuma "Fantan Fanga" afatanya na Adama Drabo mu 2009. Iyi filime yakiriwe ku mugaragaro iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) 2009. Hagati aho, yabaye umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe umusaruro w’ikigo Centre de la cinématographie du Mali (Ikigo cy’igihugu cya Cinematografi ya Mali: CNCM).

César Paes (yavutse 1959), ni umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka muri Burezire ariko utuye mubufaransa. Yayoboye inyandiko nyinshi zamamaye cyane zirimo: "Angano." "." "." "Angano." "." ".", "Mahaleo" na "L'opéra du bout du monde". Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni numuproducer, umwanditsi akaba na cinematografi.
César Paes yavutse mu 1955 i Campos, Rio de Janeiro, Burezili. Yashakanye na Marie-Clémence Andriamonta, akaba n'umuyobozi wa Franco-Malagasy.
Mu 1988, yatangije isosiyete yigenga itanga umusaruro ikorera i Paris yitwa Laterit Productions hamwe n'umugore we Marie. Isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa yiyemeje gukwirakwiza no gutangaza. Hamwe numugore we Marie, yayoboye documentaire nka "Angano." "." "." "Angano." "." "." "Umugani wo muri Madagasikari", "Ku barwanyi bacecetse", "Saudade do Futuro" "n'indirimbo za Madagasikari" batsindiye ibihembo byinshi muri Cinéma du Réel, Festival dei Popoli na Dok Leipzig.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, yafatanije kuyobora documentaire "L'Opéra du bout du monde" ikaba ari inkuru yo gushiraho opera yo muri iki gihe kuva ku kirwa cya Reunion ivuga ko abapolisi ba Louis XIV bageze mu birwa byo mu nyanja y'Abahinde.

Kamal Hachkar (yavutse ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1977), ni umukinnyi wa firime ukomoka muri Maroke n'ubufaransa, akaba n'umuhanga. Kamal azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filime "yamamaye cyane Tinghir-Yeruzalemu: The Echoes of mellah".
Yavutse ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1977 i Tinghir, muri Maroc mu muryango wa Berber. Afite amezi atandatu gusa, yavuye muri Maroc ari kumwe na nyina yerekeza mu Bufaransa, aho se yakoraga nk'umukozi kuva mu 1968. Icyakora, yagiye asura Tinghir buri gihe mu biruhuko. Kamal yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu mateka yo hagati y’isi y’abayisilamu muri kaminuza ya Sorbonne. Mu 2005, yabaye umwarimu nyuma yo gutanga icyemezo cy'ubuhanga bwo kwigisha amashuri yisumbuye.
Muri 2013, Kamal yakoze umushinga wa documentaire yambere, "Tinghir-Yerusalemu: Les Échos du mellah". Iyi filime yashyizweho mu gihe cyo kurinda Abafaransa muri Maroc ivuga ku buzima n’imibereho y’imiryango y’abayisilamu ya Berber n’abayahudi i Tinghir mu bihe bikomeye. Nubwo, byari ingingo itavugwaho rumwe muri Maroc, yanenzwe n’abayisilamu. Nyuma, Ishyaka ry'Ubutabera n'Iterambere naryo ryinjiye mu kunegura bavuga ko ari ubutumire bwo guhuza umubano hagati ya Isiraheli. Icyakora, iyi filime yakiriwe neza ndetse n'ibihembo byinshi mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ry’igihugu cya Maroc.

Hamid Bénani (yavutse ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 1940), ni umuyobozi wa firime muri Maroc, umwanditsi wa sinema akaba n'umukinnyi wa sinema. Umwe mu bahanzi bubahwa cyane muri Maroc, Bénani yakoze filime nyinshi zamamaye cyane nka "Wechma", "La prière des absents" na "L'enfant Cheïkh". Ni n'umuproducer, umwanditsi n'umwanditsi.
Yavutse ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 1940 iMeknes, muri Maroc. Yize idini mu ishuri rya Koran. Nyuma, yarangije amashuri yisumbuye muri Poeymirau na Moulay Ismaïl yisumbuye.
Mu 1958, Bénani yakiriye imyitozo mu ikinamico n'amahugurwa yo guhanga no kwandika yateguwe na Minisiteri y'Urubyiruko na Siporo. Hanyuma mu 1964, yagiye mu ishami ry’amabaruwa ya Rabat kugira ngo abone uruhushya muri filozofiya. Mu 1965, yatangiye kwiga amafilime muri Institut des hautes études cinématographiques (IDHEC) aho yahawe mu 1967 mu gice cyitwa "Direction, production and management". Hagati aho, yitabiriye amahugurwa y’ikinamico yabereye i Sorbonne no muri EPHE2 yakozwe nabafilozofe Jacques Derrida,Roland Barthes na Paul Ricœur
Mu 1968, Bénani yinjiye kuri Televiziyo ya Maroc. Nyuma yaje kuba umuyobozi w'ishami rishinzwe ububanyi n'amahanga. Mu 1969, yeguye kuri Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision (RTM). Mu 1970, yashinze isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa yitwa "Sigma 3" ku bufatanye na Ahmed Bouanani,Mohamed Abderrahman Tazi na Mohamed Sekkat. Muri uwo mwaka, isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa yakoze firime yambere ya "Wechma". Iyi filime yerekanwe muri federasiyo y’amahuriro y’amafirime ya Maroc (FMCC) kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi ndetse n’ishimwe mu minsi mikuru ya firime, aho iyi filime ifatwa nk’amafilime yashinze ya sinema ya Maroc.
Nubwo iyi filime yakunzwe cyane mu banegura, Bénani yagombaga gutegereza imyaka igera kuri makumyabiri kugira ngo ayobore filime ye ya kabiri yakinnye, "La prière des absents (Isengesho" ry'Abadahari), ku ikubitiro yiswe 'Amabanga y'inzira y'amata'. Iyi filime yakuwe mu gitabo kizwi cyane cyanditswe n'umwanditsi Tahar Ben Jelloun. Mu 2011, yayoboye filime "L'enfant Cheïkh". Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya Tangier kandi ryakiriwe neza n’abari bitabiriye ibirori. Kandi film yatsindiye igihembo kumashusho meza.
Usibye icyerekezo, yasohoye igitabo yise "Le dernier chant des insoumises" (Indirimbo ya nyuma y'inyeshyamba) munsi y'ibendera rya Editions du Sirocco. Igitabo cyatsindiye igihembo cya Grand Atlas muri 2019.

We Could Be Heroes ni film ya siporo ya documentaire yo muri Maroc yo muri 2018 iyobowe na Hind Bensari kandi yakozwe na Habib Attia na Vibeke Vogel kuri Bullitt Films. Iyi filime yibanze ku buzima bwa Azeddine Nouiri, wabaye nyampinga w’imikino Paralympique, watsinze imbogamizi z’umubiri zatoranijwe mu mikino Paralympike ya Rio 2016 hamwe n’inshuti ye Youssef akiri umwana.
Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 2 Gicurasi 2018 muri Theatre ya Scotiabank. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Jury mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Documentaire Hot Docs. Iyi filime kandi yatsindiye "Igihembo cyiza cya International Documentary Award" mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto. Filime yatsindiye Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Tangier.

475: Break the Silence, (Umutwe wumwimerere: "475: Trenquem el Silenci") ni Sinema yo muri maroke yo muri 2013 yerekana filime ngufi iyobowe na Hind Bensari. Iyi filime yibanze ku buzima bwa Amina Fillali, umukobwa w’imyaka 16 ukomoka mu mujyi muto muri Maroc. Yiyahuye akoresheje umuti wicimbeba amaze gushyingiranwa n'umugabo wa musambanyije. Yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu mu 2014.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. iyi filimi Yagize uruhare mu myigaragambyo muri Maroke mu gushyiraho itegeko rishya ryemerera abagabo baregwa gufata ku ngufu gushyingiranwa n’abo bahohotewe. Iyi filime yamamaye cyane mu kinyamakuru New York Times no mu muyoboro wa ARD wo mu Budage ndetse no kuri interineti. yashimishije abayireba kuri TV 2M muri Maroke kandi ikwirakwira mu bihugu birimo Danemark, Porutugali, Kanada igurishwa ku miyoboro irenga 20 ku isi.

Hind Bensari (yavutse 1987), ni umukinnyi wa firime wa Maroc. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wakoze firime ya documentaire yamamaye cyane: "475: Break the Silence" na "We Could Be Heroes".
Yavutse mu 1987 i Casablanca, muri Maroc. Icyakora akiri muto cyane, yimukiye i Londres. Bensari yahawe impamyabumenyi mu by'ubukungu no mu burasirazuba bwo hagati yakuye muri kaminuza ya Edinburgh. Afite kandi impamyabumenyi mu bukungu mpuzamahanga bwa politiki yakuye mu ishuri ry’ubukungu n’ubumenyi bwa politiki i Londres. Yashakanye n'umucuruzi wo muri Danimarike, ubu akaba atuye muri Danimarike.
Muri 2014, yagarutse muri Maroc kugirango akore filime ngufi ya documentaire ya mbere yari "475: Break the Silence". Yagize uruhare mu myigaragambyo muri Maroc kugira ngo ishobore gukuraho itegeko rishya ryemerera abagabo baregwa gufata ku ngufu gushyingiranwa n’abo bahohotewe. Iyi filime yamamaye cyane mu kinyamakuru New York Times no mu muyoboro wa ARD wo mu Budage ndetse no kuri interineti. yemejeje kandi abayireba kuri TV 2M muri Maroc kandi isakaza mu bindi bihugu birimo Danemark, Porutugali, Kanada kandi igurishwa ku miyoboro irenga 20 ku isi. Ni n'umuvugizi wa TEDx.
Ku ya 2 Gicurasi 2018, yasohoye filime "We Could Be Heroes" yerekanwe bwa mbere muri 2018 Hot Docs yo muri Kanada Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime. Iyi filime ishingiye ku nkuru y’inshuti ebyiri zamugaye, Azzedine na Youssef, barota kuva muri gereza bakazitabira imikino Paralympique ya Rio. Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Jury mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Documentaire Hot Docs. Iyi filime kandi yatsindiye igihembo cyitwa "Best International Documentary Award" mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Toronto, ibaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa Afurika wakiriye igihembo. Hanyuma film yatsindiye Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Tangier.

Sam Uche Anyamele, ni umukinnyi wa sinema yo muri Nigeriya.
Anyamele yavukiye Isolo, muri Lagos nk'imfura mu muryango hamwe na barumuna batandatu: abahungu batatu n'abakobwa batatu. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Faronbi Isolo (1988 kugeza 1993) no mu gace ka Ukwa k'ubutegetsi bw'ibanze muri Leta ya Abia nyuma aza kwiga mu ishuri ry'ikibonezamvugo rya Isolo (1993 kugeza 1999). Yarangije icyiciro cya mbere mu burezi bw’ubucuruzi mu 2007 n’iyamamaza n’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu kuzamura imiyoborere muri 2009 muri kaminuza ya Lagos. Yashakanye n'umukunzi umaze igihe, Osarhieme Edokpolor, aho ubukwe bwizihije ahitwa Off Ugbor Village Road muri GRA.
Yakundaga gucuranga ibikoresho bya muzika mu Itorero ry'Inteko y'Imana. Mu 2004, yagaragaye kuri tereviziyo ya mbere hamwe ninkuru ya Wale Adenuga ", No pain No Gain"".". Mu mwaka wa 2006, yatsindiye igihembo cya Afurika Movie Academy Academy (AMAA) ku bakinnyi bafite ibyiringiro byinshi kubera uruhare mu "munsi w’impongano". Yakoze kandi nk'umunyamabanga mukuru w'ishyirahamwe ry'igihugu ry'abakora umwuga wo gukina ibihangano bya Nigeriya.
Muri 2019, Anyamele yagizwe ambasaderi w’ikirango cya Max Garden Estate. Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yatangajwe ko yakiriye Mykmary Fashion Show yabaye ku ya 31 Kanama 2019.

Ifeanyi OnyeaboIfeanyi Onyeabo (1971–2019), yari umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane muri firime"My Mother’s Heart,5 Apostles", "Darkest Knight" and "One Good Turn".
Afatanije na mugenzi we Steve James, yashinze isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa, SIC Entertainment Production Nigeria Limited. Yahawe igihembo muri African Film Academy Award (AMAA) kubera filime ye "New Jerusalem".
Muri Nyakanga 2014, Onyeabor yongeye gufungirwa muri Kirikiri Maximum Prisons n'Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Lagos rwicaye i Ikeja kubera uburiganya bivugwa ko miliyoni 8.8. Nk’uko amakuru abitangaza, yakusanyije miliyoni 88.8 zose hamwe na Steve-James mu Kuboza 2008, agamije gukora firime ebyiri; "Young Amazone" and "Tribes""."

Aïcha Macky (8 Mutarama 1982), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Nigeriya ndetse na sociologue. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa documentaire"".
Yavutse ku ya 8 Mutarama 1982. Igihe yari afite imyaka itanu, nyina yapfuye amaze kubyara. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Master I muri Audiovisual and Creative Documentary muri Institut de Formation aux Techniques de l'Information et de la Communication (Training Institute for Information and Communication Technologies: IFTIC) muri Nigeriya nyuma arangiza icyiciro cya kabiri cya Master II muri Sociology no muri Gukora Film documentaire muri Kaminuza ya Gaston Berger muri Sénégal muri 2013.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, Macky yerekanye bwa mbere bugufi "Moi et ma maigreur" yari yerekeranye n'imyumvire yoroheje y'abatuye Nigeriya. Amaze gutsinda bwa mbere, yakoze bwa kabiri bugufi bwa "Savoir faire le lit", butera kwibaza ku makimbirane hagati y'ababyeyi n'abakobwa bo muri Nigeriya ku bijyanye n'uburere bw'imibonano mpuzabitsina. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yakoze filime ye ya mbere yerekana filime "L'Arbre sans imbuto" yibanze ku rugamba rw’umugore ufite ubugumba, guhuza ubuzima bwe. Iyi filime yarashimiwe kandi yegukana ibihembo birenga 50 mu birori ku isi. Nyuma yaje kugurwa mbere numuyoboro wa NHK wu Buyapani. Muri Kamena 2016, filime yatsindiye igihembo cya documentaire muri Afrika Movie Academy Awards (AMAA).
Usibye gukora firime, ni n'umwarimu w'abarimu muri sinema igendanwa. Ayobora abakiri bato kuzamura ireme muri firime ngufi zivuga ku makimbirane nyayo mu bihugu bihana imbibi nka Nijeriya, Libiya, Kameruni, Burkina Faso na Mali. Yatsindiye igihembo cya Alumni of Young African Leaders Initiative (YALI), iyi ikaba ari gahunda y'Abanyamerika yatangijwe n'uwahoze ari perezida Barack Obama. Nyuma yaje guhabwa izina rya Ordre des Arts et des Lettres na minisitiri w’umuco wa Repubulika y’Ubufaransa kubera ubwitange yagize mu mibereho myiza y’abaturage ba Nigeriya na sinema.
Macky yazamuwe mu ntera ya Knight of Academic Palms yo muri Repubulika ya Nigeriya hanyuma Knight of Arts. Yakoze kandi nka Ambasaderi-wagenwe na Oasis Niger incubator center ishinzwe kongerera ubushobozi abagore n’abakobwa. Hagati aho, ni umwe mu bagize komite mpuzamahanga ishinzwe umurage wa sinema nyafurika (CPCA).

Akounak Tedalat Taha Tazoughai, ni filime yumuziki yo muri Nigeri ya 2015 iyobowe na Christopher Kirkley yakozwe na Sahel Sounds, L'Improbable na Tenere Films. Niyo filime yambere yisi ya Tuareg -ururimi rwimpimbano. Filime ishingiye kubintu byabayeho mubuzima bwa Mdou Moctar.
Filime yafatiwe ahitwa Agadez, muri Nijeri. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Nibyunvikiro byikinamico ya Prince yo mu "1984 Imvura yumutuku".

100 Bucks ni filime ngufi yo muri Namibiya 2012 yayobowe na Oshosheni Hiveluah, yunganirwa na Cecil Moller, hamwe na Mutaleni Nadimi. Filime yibanze ku nkuru note y'amadolari 100 ya Namibiya, iva mu maboko y'ubutunzi ikajya mu maboko y'abatishoboye kandi binyuze mu maboko yibye.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Audience Choice muri 2012 Namibia Film na Theatre Awards. Mu 2011, Oshosheni yakiriye Focus Features Afurika muri gahunda ya Prize "100 bucks." 100 bucks yatsindiye kandi igihembo cya Namibian Theatre 2012 na Film Audience Choice. "100 bucks" yerekanwe i Londres n’umuryango udaharanira inyungu AfricAvenir Windhoek ndetse no muri New York mu 2012 mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Diaspora

Tjitji: Umukobwa wa Himba, ni filime ngufi ya Namibiya yasohotsemuri 2015 iyobowe na Oshosheni Hiveluahkandi yakozwe na Virginia Witts. Iyi filime yibanze ku buzima bwa Tjijandjeua 'Tjitji', umunyeshuri ukiri muto, watsinze kandi wifuza cyane Himba ufite inzozi z’ibanga zo kuzaba icyamamare 'Talk Show Host'. Iyi filime yamenyekanye kubera guca imyumvire ku bagore.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yari ifite nomination mu byiciro Umuyobozi mwiza, Amashusho yumwimerere meza, amanota meza yumuziki wumwimerere, Cinematografi nziza, na Filime Nziza Nziza muri Namibian Theatre na Film Awards 2014 yabereye muri Theatre yigihugu ya Namibiya (NTN). Nyuma, yatsindiye ibihembo bya cinematografi na firime yerekana inkuru muri Namibian Theatre na Film Awards muri 2014. Yakiriwe neza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Bangalore ryabereye i Bangalore, mu Buhinde mu 2015. "Tjitji Umukobwa wa Himba na we" yari filime ngufi ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Afurika muri 2015.

Ndabaramukije!, ni Sinema ya Namibiya yasohotse muri 2017 iyobowe na Philippe Talavera kandi yakozwe nka firime ya Ombetja Yehinga (OYO). Irimo Adriano Visagie, Odile Muller, David Ndjavera mu nshingano zabo hamwe na Monray Garoëb. Iyi filime yibanze ku buzima bwa Carlito 'Kado', wakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka itatu kubera uburiganya, asiga umukobwa w’umukobwa utwite kugira ngo yirwaneho ku isi.
Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu Kwakira 2017 mu nzu yububiko. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 2019 muri Canal Olympia Ouaga 2000, i Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, umukinnyi wa mbere Adriano Visagie yatsindiye igihembo cya Sotigui nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatowe kandi nka filime nziza muri Afurika yepfo muri 2018 Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards (AMVCA) ndetse no gutoranywa muri sida 2018 i Amsterdam.

Krischka Stoffels, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Namibiya. Krischka yakoze firime nyinshi zizwi cyane harimo "Gesie muri die glas" na "Tjiraa". Usibye icyerekezo, ni na producer, umwanditsi, cinematografi akaba n'umwanditsi.
She was born in Windhoek, Namibia.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakoze filimi ngufi, "Gesie muri die glas", yatsindiye igihembo kidasanzwe cyo kuvuga muri Namibian Film and Theatre Awards. "Nitsinzi", yakoze Tjiraa ye filimi ya kabiri ngufi. Iyi filime ikurikira Vezuva, umukobwa ukiri muto wa Ovaherero wagarutse avuye kwiga mu mahanga, mu Budage, gusa yaje kubona ko mubyara we washatse yitabye Imana, kandi ko nk'uko bisanzwe, biteganijwe ko azashyingira umupfakazi wa mubyara we. Iyi filime yatewe inkunga na komisiyo ishinzwe amafilime ya Namibiya kandi yatoranijwe kugira ngo yerekanwe mu birori mpuzamahanga bya filime, harimo iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime rya Afurika Diaspora.

Perivi John Katjavivi, ni umukinnyi wa firime w'Abongereza na namibiya. Yakinnye filime nyinshi harimo "Eembwiti," unseen na "Film Festival Film." Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni numuproducer, umwanditsi, ukora kamera, umukinnyi, cinematografi akaba n'umwanditsi.
Katjavivi yavukiye Oxford mu Bwongereza kandi afite barumuna be batanu. Se Peter Katjavivi ni umunyapolitiki n'umudipolomate wa Namibiya, currently umuvugizi w'Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Namibiya, nyina ni Umwongereza Jane Katjavivi.
Muri 2016, Katjavivi yakoze filime ye yambere "The Unseen". Iyi filime yerekanwe mu birori byinshi bya firime harimo na Busan, mu marushanwa yabereye i Durban. Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime Nziza muri Innsbruck no muri Otirishiya. Muri 2019, yakoze "Filime ngufi ya Film Festival", afatanya na Mpumelelo Mcata. Filime ifite Premiere yisi kuri 69 ya Berlinale muri Gashyantare 2019. Usibye sinema, yanditse kandi byinshi kuri "Windhoek Indorerezi", "Afurika ni Igihugu" na "OkayAfrica".

Mabata Bata, ni filime yerekana ikinamico ya Mozambike yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Sol de Carvalho ikaba yarayikoranye hamwe na Rodrigo Areias na Ricardo Freitas kuri Bando à parte Promarte Films. Filime yakuwe mu nkuru ngufi “The Day Mabata Bata Exploded” yanditswe n'umwanditsi wa Mozambike Mia Couto. Filime isobanura ubuzima bwa Azariya, umwungeri ukiri muto wimfubyi wita ku bushyo bwinka. Nubwo arota kujya mwishuri, nyuma aherekejwe na Mabata Bata, impfizi nini yubushyo kugirango akomeze ubuzima bwe.
Amashusho ya firime ya TV yasohotse ku ya 30 Mata 2017 muri Porutugali na 1 Gicurasi 2017 muri Berezile. Ku ya 30 Mutarama 2019, iyi filime yasohotse mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi Rotterdam mu Buholandi. Filime yafatiwe hirya no hino muri Chibuto, Gaza na Mozambique.

Shyaka Kagame (yavutse 1983), ni umunyaRwanda uba muri Swiss. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "Bounty" ishimwa cyane.
Yavutse mu 1983 i Geneve mu Busuwisi ku babyeyi b'u Rwanda.
Mbere yo kwinjira muri sinema, yize siyanse(science) ya politiki. Mu 2009, Kagame yatangiye umwuga we wa filime nk'umuyobozi wungirije hamwe n’umukinnyi wa firime wa Geneve Frédéric Baillif. Muri Kamena 2017, Kagame yerekanye bwa mbere "Bounty". Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori byinshi bya firime. Inyandiko irihariye kubera nta majwi arenga, kubazwa cyangwa isura ya kamera. Filime ivuga kubibazo bijyanye numwirondoro wabirabura babasuwisi.

Sébastien Kamba (wavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1941), niUmukinnyi wa firime muri Kongo. Umwe mu bakora amafilime yambere mu nganda za firime zo muri congo, yayoboye filime ngufi ku bufatanye n’abakora amafilime y’Abafaransa.
Yavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1941 i Brazzaville, muri Repubulika ya Kongo.
Yimukiye mu Bufaransa, yiga mu biro bishinzwe ubufatanye bwa Radiofonique. Nyuma yaje kwimenyereza umwuga kuri tereviziyo i Paris ndetse anaba umwarimu. Mu 1964, Kamba yakoze filime yambere yimpimbano ya congo, film ngufi ya politiki "Le Peuple du Congo-Léo vaincra". Yakozwe ku bufatanye n’itangazamakuru rya tereviziyo.
Mu 1966, yakoze "Kaka yo nayo ngufi" hanyuma "Mwana keba" muri 1970. Mu 1973, Kamba yayoboye filime ya mbere yagaragaye muri Repubulika ya Kongo: "Al Rançon d'une alliance", yakuwe mu gitabo cyitwa 'La légende de Mfoumou Ma Mazono' cyanditswe na Jean Malonga. Mu 1992, yasohoye igitabo "Cinématographique et Parti Unique" (Cinematographic Production and Unique Party. Urugero rwa Kongo).
Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2019, i Brazzaville habereye igikombe cya mbere cy’ibikombe bya sinema muri Congo cyiswe "Les Kamba's Awards" mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Kamba.

Imoh Umoren (wavutse ku ya 13 Kanama 1982), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Nigeriya ukora cyane cyane firime zo mu Buhinde. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa film ya 2017 "Abana b'ibyondo". Umoren afatwa nkumukinnyi wa mbere wakoze firime wicecekeye wumukara numweru mubikorwa bya firime ya Nollywood.
Yavutse ku ya 13 Kanama 1982 muri Nijeriya. Se yari umunyapolitiki naho nyina yari umwarimu wa kaminuza. Umoren avuga ko nyina yagize uruhare mu mwuga we wo gukina filime. Ababyeyi be bombi bapfuye akiri ingimbi, kandi yarezwe na bene wabo kugeza ubwo yikubise wenyine afite imyaka 16.
Afite imyaka 9, Umoren yatangiye kwandika urukurikirane rusekeje rwitwa "The Wickeds" hamwe ninshuti ye magara Richie. Yinjiye nka producer muto muri 'Common Ground Production' kandi akora kumurongo mpuzamahanga witwa "The Station". Nyuma, yinjiye mubikorwa bya TV bya francise nka "Project Fame", "MTV yo kuburira mbere", "Ntuzibagirwe Amagambo" "n'imbyino za Street Guinness".
Afite imyaka 26, yakoze filime ye ya mbere yerekana "Lemon Green" Filime yamenyekanye cyane. Hanyuma muri 2010, yayoboye film ngufi "All Sorts Of Trouble". Muri 2013, filime ye ya TV Yagize "Umunsi" mwiza yatowe nka Cinematografi nziza. Muri 2015 yayoboye firime black and white silent movie "Hard Times", imutsindira AMVCA yambere. Kuri filime ye y’ibyago "The Happyness Limited", umukinnyi wa mbere Tope Tedela yatowe nkumukinnyi mwiza muri Afurika muri Afrika Magic Viewers 'Choice Awards (AMVCA).
Umoren yaje kwandika no kuyobora film yamamaye cyane"Children of Mud" ishingiye ku nkuru ifatika. Filime yakiriye nomination 7 mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime zitandukanye zirimo: (NEA) na AMVCA. Filime ye y'ibyago yakurikiyeho "Dear Bayo" yerekanwe mu birori 11 bya firime kandi yatsindiye ibihembo 6 mu iserukiramuco rya Nollywood mu Bwongereza andi maserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ya firime. Umoren yayoboye kandi filime "Lagos:" "Sex, Lies &amp; Traffic" yafatanije na Gbemisola Afolabi.
Nyuma yarangije gutunganya ikinamico yigihe "The Herbert Macaulay Affair", biopic ivuga kuri Herbert Macaulay, muri 2018. Muri 2020, yakoze urukurikirane rw'ikinamico "Umuyoboro wa 77".

Tunde Babalola, ni umwanditsi muri sinema yo muri Nigeriya na televiziyo yo mu Bwongereza. Azwi cyane mu kwandika inyandiko zerekana filime zishimwa cyane nka "Last Flight to Abuja,Critical Assignment", October 1 na "Citation".
Yavukiye kandi akurira mu Bwongereza. Nyuma yaje kwimukira muri Nijeriya hamwe n'ababyeyi n'abavandimwe. Se yari umucungamari naho nyina akora muri Banki Nkuru. Babalola iyobowe na nyirarume, Liyetona-Koloneli mu ngabo za Nijeriya, Babalola yahatiwe gusaba ishuri rikuru ry'ingabo rya Nijeriya (NDA). Icyakora, nyina ntiyamuhaye uruhushya. Niyo mpamvu, yemerewe kwiga Dramatic Arts muri kaminuza ya Obafemi Awolowo.
Afite imyaka 14, yanditse inyandiko ye ya mbere ya firime in "The Raw". Amaze gusubira mu Bwongereza, yinjiye mu muyoboro wa 4 maze yandika ikinamico ya sitcom ikurikirana yitwa "In Exile". Nyuma yaje gukorana n'imiyoboro myinshi: BBC, Televiziyo ya Carlton na Televiziyo ya Chrysalis.
Muri 2015, yinjiye nk'umwanditsi akaba na producer wa comediyo yerekana urwenya "Rib Busters: Urwenya". Muri 2015, Babalola yatsindiye ibihembo byumwanditsi mwiza w’urwenya kuri filime "Inama" n’umwanditsi w’ikinamico mwiza wa filime October 1 muri Afurika Magic Viewers 'Choice Awards.

Pat Nebo, (?-2023) ni umuhanzi wo muri Nigeriya wapanze umusaruro nkumuyobozi wubuhanzi. Yakoze nk'umushinga wo gutunganya amashusho muri firime harimo"October 1", ""76", "Being Mrs Elliot" and "Okafor's Law". Yakoze kandi nkuwashushanyije muri firime nke.
Mu 1993, yatangiye umwuga we wo gutunganya ibicuruzwa hamwe na firime yo murugo "Ti oluwa ni ile". Muri uwo mwaka, yakoze mu bice bibiri bya "Ti oluwa ni ile". Mu mwaka wa 2009, yagaragaye muri sinema ya mbere muri filime yitwa "Figurine" aho yakinnye nka 'Umubitsi w'ishyingirwa'. Icyakora, yakomeje gukora "nkuwashushanyije" muri firime nyinshi nka Araromire, "Arugba", "Symphony ya Alero" na "Kuba Madamu Elliot". Usibye gushushanya umusaruro, yanakoze nk'umuyobozi wubuhanzi muri firime: "The Figurine", "Terefone Swap", "IHalf of a Yellow Sun" na "76".

Prof. Branwen Kiemute Okpako (yavutse 25 Gashyantare 1969), yavukiye muri nijeriya gusa akorera umwuga wo gutunganya amaflimi mu budage. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane"The Education of Auma Obama", "Dirt for Dinner" and "Landing".. Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni n'umwanditsi, producer, sinema, umwanditsi wa firime ndetse numwarimu.
Yavutse ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1969 i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Afite imyaka 16, yimukiye i Wales. Mu 1991, Okpako yabonye impamyabumenyi ya B.Sc. mu bumenyi bwa politiki yakuye muri kaminuza ya Bristol, mu Bwongereza nyuma akaza gukurikira amasomo ya MFA ahwanye na filime iyobowe na Academy ya Filime na Televiziyo yo mu Budage Berlin GmbH, Berlin (DFFB) mu 1999.
Yashakanye na Johannes Brandrup, nyuma baza gutandukana.
Mugihe mu mwaka wa nyuma wa DFFB, yakoze firime ye ya mbere ya "Dreckfresser" mu 2000. Filime yibanze ku bapolisi ba mbere b'abirabura mu Budage bw'Iburasirazuba. Filime yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mpuzamahanga harimo Intambwe Zibanza: Igihembo cy’Abadage Newcomer Igihembo cya Film Documentary 2000, IG Media Award i Dok Leipzig mu 2000, Igihembo cyatanzwe kuva kugurisha 2000. Yatsindiye kandi igihembo cyiza cya Filime nziza mu cyumweru cya 24 cya Duisburg. Mu 2001, iyi filime yahawe igihembo cya Leta ya Bavariya Igihembo cyiswe “Intare ikiri nto” ndetse na filime nziza yo gutanga impamyabumenyi mu iserukiramuco rya Docs Dubrovnik. Usibye sinema, Okpako ni Umwarimu wungirije mu ishami rya Sinema n’itangazamakuru rya Digital muri kaminuza ya California, Davis.

Andy Amadi Okoroafor numukinnyi wa firime wo muri Nigeriya nkumuvugizi wa TED. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa film ya "Relentless ya" 2010. Usibye gutanga icyerekezo, ni umwanditsi, producer numuyobozi wubuhanzi. Niwe washinze sitidiyo yo guhanga 'Clam'.
Yavutse ku ya 8 Gashyantare 1966 i Bauchi, mu majyaruguru ya Nijeriya. Yari afite umwaka umwe igihe intambara yatangiraga i Biafra. Nyuma yaje kwimukira i Paris mu Bufaransa maze akora nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ubuhanzi mu kwamamaza, imideli n'amashusho y'indirimbo. Ni na TED-Mugenzi.
Mu Bufaransa, Okoroafor yamaze imyaka 5 yubuhanzi ayobora amashusho yindirimbo, kuva kuri alubumu kugeza ku mashusho yindirimbo. Yashinze sitidiyo yo guhanga yitwa 'Clam' na 'Clam magazine' mu 1999. Iki kinyamakuru gisohoka kabiri mu mwaka mu Buyapani, Amerika, Uburayi, na Berezile. Mu imurikagurisha rya 2017, yayoboye igitaramo "show Never Surrender", i M. Bassy i Hamburg, mu Budage. Muri iki gitaramo harimo gufotora no kwerekana amashusho murukurikirane, "Aphrike Yinshi". Hamwe nuruhererekane, yakoranye na mugenzi we bafotora hamwe nuwakoze firime, Andrew Dosunmu.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Okoroafor yakoze filime "Relentless", filime ye ya mbere. Mu Kwakira 2010, iyi filime yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ryabereye i Londres, ryerekanwa ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2010 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Afurika ryabereye i Port Harcourt ku nshuro ya mbere muri Afurika.

Anne Njemanze, ni umukinnyi wa sinema muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri filime "Domitila", "Tinsel", "Ìrètí" na "Colorless".
Yashakanye na mugenzi we ukina filime muri Nollywood, Segun Arinze, nyuma biba ubukwe bw'igihe gito. Abashakanye bafite umukobwa umwe, Renny Morenike, wavutse ku ya 10 Gicurasi.
Ugushyingo 2013, yongeye gushaka Silver Ojieson. Icyakora, yamaze kandi amezi atarenze umunani kugeza muri Nyakanga 2014 kubera ibibazo by'ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu ngo.
Nyuma gato yo gutandukana nubukwe bwa mbere, yahuye nimpanuka yabereye i Calabar, muri leta ya Cross River. Kubera iyi mpanuka, Owerri wavukiye muri leta ya Imo yangiritse cyane mu gihe Njemanze yagumye ku ngoyi imyaka 2.
Mu 1995 yatangiye gukina na firime yo mu rugo "Rattle Snake". Nyuma yaje kuba umukinnyi w'amafirime uzwi cyane hamwe na filime gakondo yo murugo "Domitilla" na "Domitilla II" afite uruhare runini. Nyuma yaje gukina muri firime "Yukuri Kwatura" aho hamwe na Liz Benson.

Sophie Rammal Alakija (wavutse 7 Gashyantare 1985), ni umukinnyi wa sinema muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri "Halita" na "Assistant" Madams.
Alakija yavutse ku ya 7 Gashyantare 1985 mu muryango wa kisilamu ukomoka muri Efik (umuryango wo mu bihugu byambukiranya igihugu cya Calabar) ukomoka muri Libani.
Yagaragaye muri "Holla kuri" videwo y'indirimbo y'umuhungu wahoze ari umukunzi we Wizkid nk'umubyinnyi wa mbere mu mwaka wa 2010.
Yakinnye muri firime nyinshi zizwi cyane, zirimo:"Drawing Strands", "Getting over him", and "Small Chops". Muri 2017, yakinnye muri "serivise za Scandals", ni ubufatanye hagati ya Gana na Nijeriya. Muri 2019, yakinnye muri "serivise ya Halita" hanyuma akurikirana ibiganiro bya TV "Assistant Madams". Yakinnye kandi mu mugore "w’umuyisilamu" wa Timini Egbuson mu 2020.

Obianuju Blessing Okeke, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Uju Okeke, ni umukinnyi wa sinema muri Nigeriya. Yagize uruhare muri "Mission to No Where" and "the Barrister".
Anyamele yavukiye muri Leta ya Anambra. Yize mu buhanzi bwa teatre yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Nnamdi Azikiwe. Mu 2012, yashakanye n'umukunzi we kuva kera, Melekh. Ibirori byera byabereye mu rusengero rwa Saint Barth Anglican i Lagos.
Mu 2006, Okeke yakinnye nk'umukozi muri firime ya Teco Benson "yise Mission to No Where". Mu 2007, yatsindiye igihembo cy’umukinnyi wa Nest uzaza muri Ibihembo bya African Movie Academy Awards (AMAA) kubera uruhare rwe rwiza muri iyo filime. Muri 2018, yahawe icyubahiro n’ishami ry’ikinamico n’ubushakashatsi bwa firime, kaminuza ya Nnamdi Azikiwe, Awka, muri Leta ya Anambra.

Aline Munezero (yavutse mu 1994) ni umukinnyi wa filime w'Umunyarwandakazi. Azwi ku izina rya «Bijoux» mu rukurikirane rwa filime "Bamenya". Azwi kandi ku izina rya «Milika».
Aline Munezero yatangiye gukina filime mu 2016. Yari umwe mu bahataniraga igihembo cy'umukinnyi wa filime ukunzwe cyane wa 2016 muri Rwanda Movie Awards.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Aline Munezero yavutse mu 1994, i Kigali. Ni imfura mu bana batanu. Umuryango we utuye mu Murenge wa Kimironko, mu Akarere ka Gasabo. Akiri umwana, yayoboraga abandi bana mu mikino.
Aline Munezero yatangiye gukina filime mu 2016. Mu 2017, yavuze ko yari amaze gukina muri filime zigera ku munani. Muri zo harimo "Gica", "Umugabo wanjye", "Nyirabayazana", "Sakabaka", "Bazirunge" na "City Maid". Icyo gihe yari azwi ku izina rya «Milika».
Yari umwe mu bakinnyi 10 b'abagore bahataniraga igihembo cy'umukinnyi wa filime ukunzwe cyane wa 2016 muri Rwanda Movie Awards. Ibi bihembo byateguwe na Ishusho Arts.
Nyuma yamenyekanye ku izina rya «Bijoux» mu rukurikirane rwa filime "Bamenya". "Bamenya" itambuka kuri YouTube. Aline Munezero yagaragaye kandi muri filime za televiziyo no mu mashusho y'indirimbo.

Musanase Laura (wavutse 1993), ni umukinnyi wa filimi mu Rwanda. Umwe mu bakinnyi ba filime bazwi cyane mu Rwanda, Laura azwi cyane ku ruhare 'Nikuze' muri televiziyo izwi cyane yo mu Rwanda "City Maid".
Yavutse mu 1993 muri Tanzaniya, yakuriye mu Rwanda mu muryango ufite barumuna be batandatu. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Bright Academy mu Karere ka Nyagatare. Nyuma yaje kwiga i Lycee de Kigali amashuri yisumbuye arangiza amashuri avuye mu ishuri ry’abakobwa rya FAWE. Kuri ubu atuye mu karere ka Gasabo mu murenge wa Gisozi.
Urugendo mu iterambere.
Laura, mukinyamakuru kitwa new times yasobanuye ko yatewe imbaraga zokuba umukinyi wa filime namugenziwe warusazwe akina filime ndetse ahabwa incingano zikomeye zo gucyina city maid.aho yatangiye akina arumukozi wo murugo hanyuma azakwamamara abumukinyi mwiza wa filime aho yaje no gukina muri filime yitwa ejo sikera kandi we mubyukuri nago yacyekagako yabasha gukina filimeariko yaje gukina neza kandi anabyiyumvamo.
Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere kuri televiziyo sitcom "City Maid" afite uruhare runini 'Nikuze'. Uruhare rwe rwamamaye cyane muri rubanda. Yaretse iyo nshingano imyaka mike, aho abafana bagaragaje akababaro kabo. Icyakora, nyuma yaje kwemeza ko, azagaruka serial vuba. Yatoranijwe kandi mu cyiciro cy’abakinnyi beza muri Rwanda Movie Awards.

Philbert Aimé Mbabazi Sharangabo (wavutse 1990), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Rwanda. Yakoze filimi nyinshi harimo, "The Liberators," "Versus" and "I Got My Things And Left."
Yavutse mu 1990 i Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mbabazi yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ishami rya sinema yakuye muri kaminuza y’ubuhanzi n’ubushakashatsi i Geneve (UMUTWE - Genève, Haute école d'art et de design). Mugihe cyishuri, yakoze firime ebyiri "The Liberators" na "Versus". Filime zombi zerekanwe mu birori byinshi bya firime birimo Vision du Réel Nyon, Internationale Kurzfilmtage Winterthur, Tampere, Oberhausen na Uppsala Festival Festival. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi muri 2017, yasubiye mu Rwanda.
Muri 2019, yayoboye filime ngufi"I Got My Things And Left" yatsindiye igihembo kinini mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Oberhausen. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya firime rirenga 20 nk'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Rotterdam, International Kurzfilmtage Winterthur, Internationale Kurzfimtage Winterthur, Genda Nijmegen, Indie Lisboa na ISFF Hamburg, FIFF Namur n'ibindi. yatangije isosiyete ikora firime yitwa 'Imitana Productions' ifite icyicaro i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Nyuma yaje gukora filime ye ya mbere ya "Republika" (Spectrum).

Bounty, ni film documentaire yu Rwanda yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Shyaka Kagamé kandi yakozwe na Florence Adam muri Les Productions JMH.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori byinshi bya firime. Inyandiko irihariye kubera nta majwi arenga, kubazwa cyangwa isura ya kamera. Filime ivuga kubibazo bijyanye numwirondoro wabirabura baba mubusuwisi
Iyi filime ivuga ku buzima bwa buri munsi bwabantu batanu baturutse mu nzego zitandukanye: Bacary, Winta, Jeffrey, Rili na Ayan aho bose bavukiye cyangwa bakuriye mu Busuwisi..

Kickin 'It With The Kinks, ni filimi ngufi yo mu Rwanda yo mu 2016 iyobowe na Cynthia Butare nka filime yatewe inkunga na Mundia Situmbeko na Selina Thompson.
Muri 2011, Butare yakoze "Kickin 'It With The Kinks" kumushinga we wa kaminuza. Filime yakira igihembo cya documentaire nziza mu ishami rye. Nyuma mu 2016, Cynthia ari kumwe n'inshuti ye Mundia, bahisemo gukora verisiyo ndende ya firime. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Imfura, ni filime ngufi yo mu Rwanda yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Samuel Ishimwe ikaba yarayikoranye na Daniel Schweizer na Jean Perret kuri Haute École d'Art et de Design (HEAD) na Imitana Productions. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Moses Mwizerwa mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Kijyana Yves na Nyirababikira Hadidja mu nshingano zabo.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Bibaye umusaruro wambere wu Rwanda washyizwe mumarushanwa ya Berlinale Short. Muri make yatsindiye icyiciro cya silver Bear Jury Igiciro cya Berlin International Festival Festival.
Iyi filime ivuga ku nkuru yashyizwe mu Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside.

Samuel Ishimwe Karemangingo (wavutse 1991), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Rwanda. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime ngufi "Imfura i", aho abaye umukinnyi wa mbere w’amafirime u Rwanda uhagarariye Berlinale. Usibye kuba umuyobozi, ni n'umukinnyi wa sinema, umwanditsi, injeniyeri y'amajwi, umwanditsi wa sinema na producer.
Yavutse mu 1991 i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Nyina yamusize akiri uruhinja abura ababyeyi be n'umuryango we mugihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye muri 2010, Ishimwe yatangiye gukora nkumunyamakuru nabafotora kuri 'igitekerezo.com'. Mu mwaka wa 2011, yakoze filime ngufi ya mbere "Paying debts" yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema mu Rwanda. Muri uwo mwaka, yitabiriye amahugurwa ya documentaire muri Uganda yakozwe na Maisha Film Lab. Igihe yari muri Uganda, yakoraga nka producer wungirije kuri documentaire ngufi "Invisible soul". Nyuma mu 2011, yitabiriye amahugurwa yerekanwe kuri firime yitwa 'K-dox' yakozwe na James Longley. Muri kamena 2012, Ishimwe yarangije amezi 3 yibanda cyane kubijyanye no gukina film muri Kwetu Film Institute. Hanyuma muri Nzeri 2012, yitabiriye gahunda yo kwandika no kuyobora yitwa 'A Sample of Work'.
Yanditse inyandiko ya "Crossing Line" kandi yatsindiye igihembo mumarushanwa yo kwandika inyandiko yateguwe na Goethe Institut Rwanda. Nyuma yaje gukora nk'umunyamakuru n'umufotozi nyuma yo kurangiza muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda. Hanyuma yagiye mu Busuwisi kugira ngo akomeze kwiga. Muri kamena 2017, Ishimwe yabonye impamyabumenyi ya firime muri Haute école d'art et de design (Ishuri ry’ubukorikori n’ubushakashatsi rya Geneve - UMUTWE).
Muri 2017, yakoze "Imfura" bisobanura ngo "First Born'. Iyi filime ivuga ku nkuru yashyizwe mu Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside. Nibikorwa byambere byu Rwanda byashyizwe mumarushanwa ya Berlinale Short. Muri make yatsindiye igiciro cya silver Bear Jury Igiciro cya Berlin International Festival Festival. Filime ye iragenda kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mubirori bikomeye bya firime kwisi; Ishimwe yahise yigaragaza nk'inyenyeri igaragara ya sinema yo mu Rwanda.

Armand Kajangwe, ni umunyarwanda - umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Busuwisi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime nka "The Asylum", na "Dirty Singles".
Ku ya 7 Mata 2009, Kajangwe yinjiye mu isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa byuzuye yitwa 'Crooked Seas Inc.' yashinzwe na Craig Leblanc ifite icyicaro i Ontario, muri Kanada. Yakoze nk'umuyobozi, umuyobozi w'amafoto, n'umuyobozi ushinzwe imbuga nkoranyambaga.
Muri 2016, Kajangwe yagize uruhare mu gutangiza urubuga rwa mbere rwa videwo muri Afurika. Ihuriro rizwi ku izina rya 'www.journal.rw' ryatunganijwe kandi rikoreshwa na Village Innovation, uruganda ruhanga ruherereye mu Rwanda aho Kajangwe ari umuyobozi mukuru. Ihuriro rirashobora gutanga inzira yo gusangira ibisobanuro bihanitse bya videwo.

Cynthia Butare, numunyarwanda - umukinnyi wa firime wu Busuwisi kimwe naba videwo. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "Kickin 'It With The Kinks".
Yavukiye i Geneve mu Busuwisi. Yabaye i Geneve kugeza arangije amashuri yisumbuye hanyuma yimukira mu Bwongereza kwiga amashuri makuru.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Digital Media and Communication nyuma arangiza Master's in Documentary Practice muri kaminuza ya Manchester Metropolitan.Muri 2011, yakoze "Kickin 'It With The Kinks" ku mushinga wa kaminuza. Filime yakira igihembo cya documentaire nziza mu ishami rye. Nyuma mu 2016, Cynthia ari kumwe n'inshuti ye Mundia, bahisemo gukora verisiyo ndende ya firime. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Muri uwo mwaka, yatangije isosiyete ye bwite, 'CB Production'.
Akiri ingimbi, yatangiye kwandika mu 2003. Nubwo yahagaritse kwandika nyuma yimyaka itatu, yatangiye blog 2012. Muri 2013, Butare yahawe igihembo cya Blog nziza y'umwaka na BEFFTA. Icyakora, yimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2014. Igihe yari mu Rwanda, yakoze filime ye ya kabiri ya documentaire, "Ishimwa: Kuva Amaraso Yera Kuri Grace". Yerekanwe mu rwego rwo kwerekana iserukiramuco rya sinema mu Rwanda. Kuri ubu arimo gukora umushinga witwa "The Return".

Jean Luc Mitana (yavutse 29 Nzeri 1983), ni umunyarwanda ukina filimi. Yabaye umukinnyi wa sinema muri firime zitandukanye zirimo "Behind the Word", "Kai the Vendor" and "Strength in Fear".
Yavutse ku ya 29 Nzeri 1983 i Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mu 2006, yinjiye mu itsinda rya Almond Tree Films Collective maze mu 2009, Mitana akora kuri filime izwi ku izina rya "Maibobo" iyobowe na Yves Montand Niyongabo kandi yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Rotterdam mu 2010. Yatanzwe mu iserukiramuco rya Sinema Africano d'Asia e Amerika Latina ya 2011 i Milan, mu Butaliyani. Yayoboye "SAA-IPO" mu 2010. Yafatiwe amashusho i Kigali iterwa inkunga na Tribeca Film Institute. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tribeca 2011 hanyuma ryerekanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Durban 2011 na AfryKamera International Film Festival, Polonye mu 2011. Hanyuma muri 2014, yakoze muri documentaire "Inyuma y'Isi" iyobowe na Marie-Clementine Dusejambo. Muri 2014, yitabiriye impano ya Berlinale, aho yari muri Studio yo gutunganya.

Lansana Mansaray (wavutse 1992), bakunze kwita Barmmy Boy, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Siyera Lewone. Umwe mu bakora amafilime azwi cyane muri sinema ya Siyera Lewone, Mansaray azwi cyane muri filime zizwi cyane "Youth", "Charity" and.. Usibye gukora firime, anatunganya firime, umukinnyi wa cinemateri numuraperi.
Yavutse mu 1992 i Freetown, muri Siyera Lewone.
Mansaray ni we washinze WeOwnTV akaba n'umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro muri Freetown Media Center. Hamwe na WeOwnTV, yakoranye n’imiryango myinshi irimo: Defence for Children International, Studios ya NOVA (UK), Inama y’Ubwongereza Siyera Lewone, UNICEF Sierra Leone, Save the Children Sierra Leone, Ivuriro ry’umugore n’umugi wa Hull UK 2017.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yayoboye filime ye ya mbere "Youth". Muri uwo mwaka, yakoze nk'umukinnyi wa sinema muri filime "y'abagiraneza". Yakomeje gukora nka cinematif mu myaka iri imbere muri firime; "Barwanyije" (2011) kandi "Ubumuga ni Ubushobozi".
Usibye bo, yakoze nk'umukinnyi wa sinema mu bikorwa byinshi byegukanye ibihembo "nka" "Decisions" in 2011, "Girl Rising" in 2013, "They Are We" in 2014, and "Meet the Africans: Many Rivers to Cross" in 2013, aho nyuma yatsinze Igihembo cya Emmy. Mu mwaka wa 2014, yasuye u Bwongereza kugira ngo abonane n'incuti zimwe na zimwe, ariko byabaye ngombwa ko yongerera igihe cy'amezi atanu kubera icyorezo cya Ebola muri Siyera Lewone.
Muri 2018, yayoboye filime documentaire "Survivors", ishingiye ku kibazo cya Ebola. Nyuma yaje gutorwa muri Emmy's Best Social Issue Documentary, aho ibaye filime ya mbere yo muri Afrika yuburengerazuba yakiriye ishimwe.

Bolot Feray, ni filime yo gusetsa ya Seychellois yo mu 1995 iyobowe na Jean-Claude Matombe kandi yakozwe na Marie-Therese Choppy. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Alain Belle mu ruhare rw'icyubahiro aho nka Charles DeCommarmond, Jenita Furneau, Antonia Gabriel na Marie Lista bagize uruhare runini. yari ishingiye ku ikinamico kandi yerekana umuryango gakondo wa Seychellois.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime ifatwa nkimwe muma firime meza yo muri Afrika. Ikinamico yabanje kwandikwa na Geva René.

Selbe: One Among Many (mu ntangiriro nka Selbé et tant d'autres, ni filime ya documentaire yo muri Senegal yo mu 1983 iyobowe na Safi Faye kandi yakozwe na Pierre Hoffmann kuri Faye Films.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.
Iyi filime izenguruka ku buzima bwa buri munsi bw’umugore wo mu mudugudu wa Senegal, Sélbe, ikanasuzuma uruhare rw’ubukungu n’imibereho y’abagore bo muri Afurika bo mu cyaro.

Ousmane William Mbaye (yavutse 1952), yavukiye muri Senegal azwi mu gukora filimi. Mbaye azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire "Mère-Bi" "ishimwa cyane" na film Doomi Ngacc, "Fresque" na "Kemtiyu, Cheikh Anta". Usibye gukora amafilime, ni numu producer mukuru, utunganya umurongo, umwanditsi wa sinema, producer wamahanga, umuyobozi wamafoto, uwandika amajwi, umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro, umwanditsi, na producer.
Yavutse mu 1952 i Paris, mu Bufaransa. Nyina, Annette Mbaye d'Erneville akomoka muri senegali.
Mbaye yahuguye muri Conservatoire Libre du Cinéma Français (Konserwatori Yubusa ya Sinema y'Abafaransa). Nyuma yize muri kaminuza ya Paris 8 Vincennes-Saint-Denis aho yatangiriye gukina amashusho. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yimukiye muri Senegali. Nyuma yaje kuba umuyobozi wungirije. Kuva 1990 kugeza 1997, yabaye umuhuzabikorwa nuwashinze Rencontres Cinématographiques ya Dakar (RECIDAK).
Mu 1979, yakoze kandi ayobora filime ye ya mbere ya "Doomi Ngacc". Mugufi yatsindiye Bronze Tanit mu iserukiramuco rya Filime ya Carthage. Kuva mu 2000, yatangiye gukora documentaire nka "Président Dia" na "Kemtiyu, Cheikh Anta". Mu 2003, yakoze documentaire ngufi "Xalima la plume" yerekeye umucuranzi wa Senegal Seydina Insa Wade. Nyuma yaho gato yatsindiye igihembo cya Documentaire muri Festival ya Milan. Mu 2005, yayoboye documentaire "Fer et verre", yibanze ku muhanzi wa plastiki wo muri Senegal Anta Germane Gaye. Muri 2008, yakoze "Mère-Bi" ngufi, ishingiye kuri nyina.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, yakoze documentaire yerekana ubuzima bwa "Kemtiyu, Cheikh Anta" ivuga ku buzima bw’amateka ya Senegal, umuganga, n’umunyapolitiki Cheikh Anta Diop. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza n'abayinenga kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Yahawe igihembo cya EU / ACP mu iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) 2017.

Saphine Kirenga ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Ni n'umuforomo. Azwi ku ruhare rwa Kantengwa muri filime y'uruhererekane "Seburikoko".
Saphine Kirenga yatsindiye kenshi igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza muri Rwanda Movie Awards.
Se wa Saphine Kirenga ni Kirenga Louis. Yari umunyezamu w'Amavubi na Rayon Sports. Yapfuye Saphine akiri muto. Saphine Kirenga yize ubuforomo mu mashuri yisumbuye. Aho ni ho yavumburiye impano yo gukina filime.
Saphine Kirenga yakinnye filime ye ya mbere mu 2012. Iyo filime yitwa "Amapingu y'Urukundo". Nyuma yamenyekanye ku ruhare rwa Kantengwa muri "Seburikoko". Yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza muri Rwanda Movie Awards imyaka itatu ikurikiranye.
Muri Werurwe 2020, Rwanda International Movie Awards zatanzwe bwa mbere. Saphine Kirenga yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza ("Best Actress"), kubera filime "Shady Commitment". Iyo filime yatsindiye kandi igihembo cya filime ndende nziza.

Uwamwezi Nadege (yavutse 1993), ni umukinnyi wa filimi mu Rwanda. Umwe mu bakinnyi ba filime bazwi cyane muri filimi zo kuri televiziyo mu Rwanda, Nadege azwi cyane ku mazina nka Nana cyangwa Catherine mu biganiro bya televiziyo, nka "City Maid". Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi n'umunyamideri.
Uwamwezi Nadege Yavutse mu 1993 mu Rwanda. Yafunguye butike yitwa 'Nana Fashion Shop' ifite izina rye. Afite umwana umwe w'umuhungu umwe kuva yashyingirwa bwa mbere, witwa Ganza Benny Lucky. Nk’uko ibihuha bivugwa, ngo yaba akundana n'umuririmbyi Kizito Mihigo. Ariko nyuma yaje kubihakana, avuga ko ari inshuti gusa. Icyakora, vuba aha byavuzwe ko bategura ubukwe. Icyakora, yongeye guhakana ibyo aregwa. Uwamwezi Nadege nibwo muri 2021, ahari mu kwezi ku gushyingo, aha nibwo Nana yafashe indege yerekeza mu Bubiligi ku mugabane w'iburayi, aho niho ndetse aho umugabo bashakanye aba ndetse atuye ndetse anakorera. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n'itangazamakuru nuko Nana yavuze ko ibintu ahanini urebye byamugoye kumva ageze i Burayi ari byinshi bitandukanye ariko cyane cyane n' ibiryo, ikirere no kuba nta bantu baziranye, ibaze nawe se nkubu uyu muturanyi waha dutuye ntabwo rwose yagusuhuza, ariko iwacu mu Rwanda umuturanyi aba ari nk’umuvandimwe wawe agutira ikintu na we akagutiza ikindi ariko hano rwose umuntu aranapfa ukigira ku kazi ke ahubwo agahamagara polisi ngo ko murimo kugufungira umuhanda wabo.
Uwamwezi Nadege yize amashuri yisumbuye muri APAKAPE, aho yize ibijyanye na Computer Science and Management, aho yabonye impamwabumenyi ya A2, aho mbere yo kwinjira muri Filime muri 2013.
Mbere yo gukina, Nadege yari umuririmbyi waririmbye ku izina rya 'Queen Nadege'. Yari mu itsinda ryitwa 'The Queens' aho baririmbaga 'Ryajambo' mu 2009. Yinjiye muri Kwetu Film Institute yiga ikinamico. Nyuma, yamenyekanye gukina na Kennedy Mazimpaka, amaze kubona ubuhanga bwe bwo gukina i Kwetu. Mazimpaka yamuhaye uruhare ruto muri filime "Rwasibo", yaje kuba umukinnyi wa mbere wa sinema. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yakinnye muri filimi ica kuri televiziyo "Mutoni" nk'uruhare rwo kuyobora. Nyuma, yakinnye muri firime nyinshi zizwi cyane na zirimo, "Catherine" na "Nkubito ya Nyamunsi". Muri 2016, yakinnye muri "City Maid". filimi imaze kumenyekana cyane m'ubantu kandi yakundaga kwitwa Nana.

Mukakamanzi Beatha numukinnyi wa filimi mu Rwanda. Umwe mu bakinnyi ba filime bazwi cyane mu Rwanda, Beatha azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe nka 'Rosine', naho muri "Giramata" nka 'nyina wa Giramata'.
Yavukiye mu Karere ka Gatsibo.
Filime ye ya mbere yakinnye yaje muri firime "The Deadly Spear." Nyuma ya firime, yakinnye muri firime nyinshi zizwi nka "Rwasibo", "Intare yinngore", "Giramata n'inzindi", "It's Not the End", "Dreams", "Enemy of Love", "Conclusion", and "Make Milk".. Hanyuma yinjiye muri serivise izwi cyane ya "City Maid".

Didier Kamanzi (yavutse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1985) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Azwi ku izina rya Max Well, umupolisi yakinnye muri filime "Rwasa".
Didier Kamanzi akina kandi rugby mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda. Ni n'umunyabugeni.
Didier Kamanzi yavutse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1985, mu Uburundi. Ni umwana wa gatatu mu muryango w'abana batandatu. Nyuma yatahutse mu Rwanda. Mu 2017, yari atuye i Nyamirambo, mu mujyi wa Kigali.
Didier Kamanzi yatangiye gukina filime mu 2010. Yamenyekanye muri filime "Rwasa", aho yakinnye ari umupolisi witwa Max Well. Yakinnye kandi muri filime nyinshi, nka "Ryangombe", "Rwasibo", "Igitekerezo", "Catherine", "Urugamba" na "City Maid".
Mu 2017, Kamanzi yari mu bakinnyi 10 b'abagabo bahataniraga igihembo cy'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane wa 2016 muri Rwanda Movie Awards.
Didier Kamanzi akina rugby. Mu 2011, yari kapiteni w'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda, Silverbacks, mu mukino wa rugby w'abakinnyi 15. Mu 2017, yakiniraga ikipe ya Thousand Hills RFC. Ni n'umunyabugeni ushushanya amashusho.

Satanskoraal ni filime y'ibikorwa yo muri Afurika y’Epfo 1959 iyobowe na Elmo De Witt kandi yakozwe na Jamie Uys kuri Jamie Uys Filmproduksies. Niyo filime ya mbere yo muri Afrika yepfo yafashwe amashusho mumazi.
Umugambi wa firime uzenguruka umukinnyi ukize ninzobere muri korali ifasha abahanga kuvumbura uduce twa korali yabuze ku nkombe za Mozambike. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Ponie de Wet mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Tessa Laubscher, Gabriel Bayman na Lindea Bosman mu nshingano zabo.

The Great Kimberley Diamond Robbery(Die Groot Diamantroof van Kimberley), na none mu ikinamico nka The Star of the South, ni filime yo mu 1911 yo muri Afurika y'Epfo y'Abirabura n'umweru byicecekeye iyobowe na RCE Nissen kandi ikorwa na Rufe Naylor muri sosiyete ya Springbok. Iyi niyo filime yambere yikinamico yo muri Afrika yepfo mumateka ya sinema yo muri Afrika yepfo.

Man in die Donker (Man in the Dark), ni filime yo mu 1962 yo muri Afurika y'Epfo y'Abirabura n'abazungu Neo-noir iyobowe na Truida Louw Pohl ikaba yarayikoranye na Aletta Gericke, Truida Louw na Renée van der Walt kuri Trio-Films. Iyi niyo filime yambere yo muri Afrika yepfo iyobowe numugore mumateka ya sinema yo muri Afrika yepfo. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Babs Laker na Dawid van der Walt mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Cor Nortjé, Mathilde Hanekom na Elsa Fouché mu nshingano zabo.

Majuba: Heuwel van Duiwe (Majuba: Hill ya inuma), ni filimi yakozwe muri 1968 muri Afurika y'Epfo iyi film iyoborwa na Dawidi Millin afatanyije na Roscoe C. Behrmann na Hyman Kirstein.
