Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Roland Robinson, Reinet Maasdorp, na Patrick Mynhardt mu bakinnyi ba mbere hamwe na Siegfried Mynhardt, Anna Neethling-Pohl na Morné Coetzer mu nshingano zabo.
Filime yatewe inkunga nibyabaye mu Ntambara ya mbere ya Anglo-Boer, Intambara yo ku musozi wa Majuba
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yumwimerere yo gusohora sinema yakoresheje amasaha agera kuri atatu nyamara abayagurisha baho bagabanije firime kugirango berekane burimunsi kuko yari ikunzwe cyane: verisiyo yagufi ni ibisigaye byose byaciwe mbere kandi amashusho ntiyigeze abikwa.

The Fourth Reich (El Cuarto Reich), ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Afurika y'Epfo mu 1990 iyobowe na Manie van Rensburg ikaba yarayikoranye na Gert Basson, Mark Jaffee, David Selvan, Bill Shapter na Reg Wessels muri Zastron films. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo itsinda ry’abakinnyi ba Afurika yepfo, Ryno Hattingh yakinnye nka Robey Leibbrandt. Abakinnyi bashyigikiwe barimo Marius Weyers, Grethe Fox na Percy Sieff. Inkunga nayo yari nyinshi bakina amakinamico yo muri Afrika yepfo.
Iyi filime ivuga ku buzima Robey Leibbrandt, umukinnyi w'iteramakofe wo muri Afurika y'Epfo witabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 1936 yabereye i Berlin. Mugihe mu mikino yakundwaga nabanazi agerageza kumushakira umukozi muri Afrika yepfo. Leibbrandt yakiriye ingengabitekerezo y'Abanazi, byaje kurangira abaye umukozi wa Abwehr kuri Reich ya gatatu. Nkumukozi wa Abwehr, mu 1939 Leibbrandt yayoboye igikorwa cyo guhirika guverinoma y’Afurika yepfo ishyigikiye ubumwe, ndetse no kwica Jenerali Jan Smuts, icyo gihe akaba yari Minisitiri w’intebe w’ubumwe bwa Afurika yepfo.The Fourth Reich niyo yakozwe muri firime ihenze cyane mumateka ya sinema yo muri Afrika yepfo. The Fourth Reich yakinnye neza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime kandi yakiriwe neza kandi isubirwamo neza.

Die Rebellie van Lafras Verwey, ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Afurika y’Epfo yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Simon Barnard ikaba yarayikoranye na Katinka Heyns na Genevieve Hofmeyr muri Sonneblom Films and Moonlighting Films Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Tobie Cronje mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Chantell Phillipus, Neels van Jaarsveld na Cobus Visser mu nshingano zunganira. Iyi filime isobanura ubuzima n'umwuga bya Lafras Verwey wakoze nk'umwanditsi mu bakozi ba Leta muri Pretoriya imyaka mirongo itatu. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Gupfa Storie van Klara Viljee (The Story of Klara Viljee), ni filimi yasohotse muri 1992 muri Afurika y’Epfo iyoborwa na Katinka Heyns na vyahinguwe n'Ivyabona Chris Barnard kuko Sonneblom Films. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Anna-Mart van der Merwe mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Regardt van den Bergh, Hennie Oosthuizen na Trix Pienaar mu nshingano zabo.
Iyi filime ivuga ku buzima bwa Klara Viljee, umukobwa wo mu mudugudu muto wo kuroba igihe yabuze se n'umukunzi we mu nyanja. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Debbie, ni Sinema yo muri Afrika yepfo yasohotse muri 1965 iyobowe na Elmo De Witt kandi yakozwe na Jamie Uys kuri Jamie Uys Filmproduksies. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Suzanne van Oudtshoorn mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Leon le Roux, Gert van den Bergh na Dawid van der Walt mu nshingano zabo.
Filime irazenguruka umukobwa wumwangavu Debbie Malan wagiye mumujyi agasama atashyingiranywe. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Daryne Joshua (wavutse 1992), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "zamamaye cyane Noem My Skollie" na "Ellen: Die storie van Ellen Pakkies". Usibye gukora firime, ni n'umugiraneza, umwanditsi, uwashushanyije animasiyo, uwashushanyije amajwi, itangazamakuru n'umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho.
Yavukiye kandi akurira i Cape Town. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Livingstone. Ni umwarimu kuri Sinema n’Ubushakashatsi bwa Sinema muri Cape Peninsula, Kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga.
Afite imyaka irindwi, yatangiye gukina muri filimi ngufi. Muri kiriya gihe, yakoze no kugurisha imigani mu inshuti ze muri Bridgetown. Nyuma yaje kwiga muri AFDA, Ishuri ryubukungu bwo guhanga no kubona impamyabumenyi itandukanye. Niwe washinze, umwanditsi akaba n'umuyobozi wa Gambit Films yashinze akimara kurangiza. Gambit Films yakoze ikinamico ya mbere ya Afrikaans ya Cape Town, "Suidooster" ica kuri DSTV na Kyknet.
Muri 2016, yayoboye filime ye ya mbere "Noem My Skollie". Filime yatoranijwe nkuwinjiye muri Afrika yepfo muri Filime nziza y’ururimi rw’amahanga mu bihembo bya 89 bya Academy. Iyi filime yatsindiye ibihembo bya RapidLion kubera amashusho meza na Filime nziza yo muri Afurika y'Epfo muri 2017. Intsinzi ya firime, yakoze film ye ya kabiri yerekana "Ellen: Die storie van Ellen Pakkies". Byari bishingiye ku nkuru y'impamo ya Ellen Pakkies. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi Rotterdam (IFFR) ku ya 27 Mutarama 2018 kandi ryishimiwe cyane. Yasohotse muri Afurika y'Epfo ku ya 7 Nzeri 2018. Muri 2018, yanditse inyandiko ya firime ngufi "nimero 37" iyobowe na Nosipho Dumisa. Inyandiko yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Afurika yepfo Filime na Televiziyo (SAFTA).

Dirk de Villiers (26 Nyakanga 1924 - 28 Ukuboza 2009), yari umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Ufatwa nk'umukinnyi wa filime wamamaye cyane na 'Godfather' mu nganda za firime zo muri Afurika y'Epfo, de Villiers yakoze filime nyinshi zishimwa cyane mu mwuga umaze imyaka irenga mirongo itandatu.
Yavutse ku ya 26 Nyakanga 1924 mu isambu ya Villieria i Douglas, mu majyaruguru ya Cape, muri Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango ufite barumuna be batanu. Nyina yapfuye afite imyaka ine naho se ni umuhinzi wakomeje guhinga yarazwe na Cornelius Valkenburg de Villiers. Nyina amaze gupfa, Dirk na murumuna we Niel boherejwe kwa nyirasenge. Nyuma yaje gukurira ku nkombe z'umugezi wa Vaal aho yagiye mu mashuri menshi yo muri Jagersfontein, Marquard na Betelehemu.
Yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa filime Addy kuva 1950 kugeza yahukanye mu 1973. Abashakanye babyaranye abana batanu barimo Gys de Villiers. Gys kandi ni umukinnyi w'icyamamare akaba n'umwanditsi w'amakinamico muri sinema no muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yagiranye umubano na Miems Swanepoel imyaka mike kuva 1992.
Ku ya 24 Ukuboza 2009, yahuye n'indwara y'umutima maze yihutira kujya mu bitaro by'Urwibutso rwa Chris Barnard i Cape Town. Icyakora, yapfuye ku ya 28 Ukuboza 2009 afite imyaka 89, azize indwara y'ibihaha no kunanirwa k'umutima.
Mu 1942, de Villiers yatangiye gukina amakinamico menshi ya Johannesburg Afrikaans Amateur Abakinnyi (JAATS). Hanyuma yashinze ishyirahamwe ryamakinamico hamwe na Schalk Theron. Hamwe n'ikinamico, yize ibijyanye n'ubukanishi, aho yaje gukorera ku cyambu cya Cape Town. Hanyuma yagiye i Londres mu masomo y’ubuhanga bwo mu nyanja. Amaze kugaruka, yabaye injeniyeri w'ubwato.
Yatangiye umwuga wa film nkumukinnyi wa film "Kruger Millions" iyobowe na Ivan Hall. Muri filime, yakinnye nk'umuhemu wo mu mutwe wa Cavalier wiyahuye. Yakinnye kandi muri firime,, Kniediep, Kruger miljoene en Stadig oor die klippe. "Tunga niggie yanjye", "Kavaliers". Yayoboye filime ye yambere "yumukobwa Jy Is My Liefling". Iyi filime yakinnye na Franz Marx mu nshingano ze za mbere na Min Shaw. Nyuma yo gutsinda mubucuruzi muri firime, yakoze firime "zamamaye, Die Geheim Van Nantes". Filime yahinduwe na serivise izwi cyane ya Springbok Radio, ikinwamo amajwi yose. Mu 1968 yakoze firime ye yambere yuzuye, "You Are My Darling" kandi ashingwa nkumukinnyi wa firime wabigize umwuga.
Mu 1972, de Villiers yakoze firime ishimishije "My Broer Se Bril". Hanyuma mu 1974, yayoboye filime ebyiri "Met Liefde Van Adele" na "Nyiricyubahiro". Hagati aho, mu 1976, yakoze filime ye ya mbere "yamamaye ku" "rwego mpuzamahanga Glenda" na Die diamantjagters. Mu 1978, yakoze ikinamico "yerekanwe na euthanasiya yitwa Besluit om te sterf". Hagati aho, de Villiers yashinze Roodepoort Amateur Theatre Organisation (RATO). Zimwe muri firime yakunzwe cyane zirimo: "Geheim van Nantes", "Kalahari Harry", "Die Spaanse Vlieg", "Daan en Doors op die dieggins", "Broer se bril", "Tant Ralie se losieshuis", "Die lewe sonder jou", "Die drie Van der Merwes", "Met liefde van Adéle", "My naam ni Dingetjie", "Witblits en Peach Brandy", "Dingetjie en Idi", "Die wit sluier en Kaalgat tussen bapfa daisies".

Arende, ni Sinema yo muri Afurika y’Epfo 1994 iyobowe na Dirk de Villiers. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Ian Roberts na Gavin van den Berg mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Diane Wilson, Keith Grenville na Percy Sieff mu nshingano zabo.
Iyi filime ivuga ibyerekeranye n’Intambara ya Anglo Boer nubuzima bwumuhinzi wigometse Boer Sloet Steenkamp na Kapiteni wingabo zUbwongereza James Kerwin. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Raouf J. Jacob (wavutse 1988 muri Siyera Lewone, Afurika y'Iburengerazuba), ni umukinnyi wa firime, producer akaba n'umuyobozi wa firime. Jacob azwi cyane kubera filime nyinshi yatsindiye ibihembo muri filime za "Siyera Lewone:" "A Culture of Silence". Ni n'Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa &amp; Rurema akaba n'uwashinze sitidiyo / filime za Worldwide Cinema Frames LLC hamwe na Global Cinema Film Festival ya Boston (GCFF) yashinze mu 2006.
Mu 2005, yakoze filime CRY"," "America", yakoze ubushakashatsi ku byago bibabaje no gukurikira. Yakoze kandi urukurikirane "a Blind World"".". Uruhererekane rwasesenguye Umunyagitugu w’Abanazi Adolf Hitler ' Igisubizo cya nyuma cy’ikibazo cy’Abayahudi ', Jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994, itsembabwoko rya Darfur muri Sudani, itotezwa ry’umuryango wa Baha'i muri Irani ndetse n’ingoma y’uwahoze ari intwazangabo Pablo Escobar muri Kolombiya.
Muri 2014, Jacob yashyize ahagaragara film documentaire ":" "A Culture of Silence" Yabaye umuyobozi, umwanditsi, producer, umukinnyi wa cinemateri, umwanditsi hamwe nivanga amajwi ya firime. Iyi filime yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi, harimo Filime nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya New York City 2014, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Boston 2014, ndetse n’iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Roxbury 2014. Iyi filime kandi yerekanwe ku Isoko rya Filime rya Cannes 2014 (Marché du film de Cannes), Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Afurika rya Silicon n'ibindi!

Survivors, ni filime ya documentaire ya Siyera Lewone yo muri 2018 - iyobowe na Banker White, Anna Fitch, Lansana Mansaray, na Arthur Pratt. Iyi filime yakozwe n'abayobozi bane ubwabo hamwe na Sara Dosa, Samantha Grant, Justine Nagan, na Chris White. Iyi filime ikurikira icyorezo cya Ebola gikwirakwira muri Siyera Lewone cyanduye abantu 8.704 ikica 3.589 n'uburyo intwari za Siyera Lewone zirandura iki cyorezo.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yatorewe kuba Emmy's Best Social Issue Documentaire mu 2018, ibaye filime ya mbere yo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba yakiriye igihembo.

Wako, ni Sinema ya Uganda yasohotse 2015 iyobowe na Zziwa Aaron Alone kandi yafatanije n’umuyobozi ubwe hamwe na Natuhwera Brighton na Wamasebu Eric kuri Zaron Motion Pictures, Brina Motion Pictures na Punchside Filmz. Nibisobanuro bya firime yambere "Hadithi za Kumekucha: TUNU". Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Geoffrey Echakara mu mwanya wa mbere mu kuyobora hamwe na Natuhwera Brighton, Robert Ernest Bbumba na Zziwa Aaron Alone mu nshingano zabo.
Iyi filime yafashwe amashusho hagati ya 2014 kugeza hagati ya 2015 mucyaro no mu mijyi ya Kampala. Iyi filime ivuga ku nkuru y’umugizi wa nabi w’igitsina gabo w’imyaka 23 witwa Wako wavuye muri gereza akabahambiriye gutangira ubuzima bushya, ariko yaje kumenya ko mushiki we arwaye kanseri.
firime yagiye ahagaragara binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2016 muri Theatre La'bonita. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Muri 2015, iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime nziza cyane mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime rya Arusha muri Tanzaniya.

Albert Samama Chikly (24 Mutarama 1872 - 28 Ukuboza 1934), yari umukinnyi wa firime akaba n'umufotozi. Ufatwa nk'imwe mu nkingi za mbere muri Sinema y'isi, Albert yari umufotozi, umukinnyi wa firime, technophile, adventure, umunyonzi w'amagare akaba n'umupayiniya wa Seventh Art.i.
Yavutse ku ya 24 Mutarama 1872 i Tunisi, muri Tunisiya, avukira mu muryango ukize wa Tunisiya ukomoka mu Bayahudi. Se David Samama, yari umunyamabanki wa Bey washinze ikigo cya banki nyuma gihinduka Banki ya Tuniziya. Nyina yari umugore wo mu rugo. Albert yakomereje amasomo ye hamwe na Charles Lavigerie hanyuma akorana n'Abayezuwiti i Marseille. Yari ingenzi yagiye muri Cape Horn, Ubushinwa na Ositaraliya kenshi ndetse akiri muto. Yakiriye izina rye 'Chikli' mu buvandimwe bw'abashinzwe kuzimya umuriro bo ku kirwa cya Chikly, ikirwa gito ku kiyaga cya Tuniziya.
Yashakanye na Bianca Ferrero, umugore wavukiye mu Butaliyani ukomoka i Savoy, wari umucuranzi. Abashakanye bari bafite umukobwa umwe Haydée Tamzali. Nyuma yaje kubona ubwenegihugu bw'Ubufaransa maze yinjira mu idini rya Isilamu n'umuryango we. Albert yapfuye mu 1934 muri Tunisiya afite imyaka 62 ashyingurwa mu irimbi rya Borgel.
Mu 1996, filime ngufi ya biografiya "Albert Samama Chikli, yafashe amashusho yimashini zisekeje" yayobowe na Mahmoud Ben Mahmoud mu cyubahiro Albert Samama.

Sanni Assouma Adjiké, ni umukinnyi wa firime wa Togo. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime ngufi "Le Dilemme d'Eya".
Mu 1995, Assouma Adjiké yayoboye filimi ngufi ebyiri: "L'Eau sacree" na "Femmes Moba". Yakoze filime ye ngufi "Le Dilemme d'Eya" mu 2002. Iyi filime yakozwe na UNESCO ihabwa ibihembo bibiri bidasanzwe by’abacamanza: Union Economique et Monétaire Ouest Africaine (UEMOA) na Plan International mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO). Muri Gicurasi 2003, filime yatoranijwe kugirango yerekanwe mu nama mpuzamahanga ya televiziyo ya Leta (INPUT).

Fatuma (mu ikinamico nka Hadithi za Kumekucha: Fatuma), ni Filime yikinamico yo muri Tanzaniya 2018 iyobowe na Yorodani Riber kandi ikaba yarakozwe n’umuyobozi ubwe hamwe n’ababyeyi be; John Riber na Louise Riber. Nibisobanuro bya firime yambere "Hadithi za Kumekucha: TUNU". Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Beatrice Taisamo mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Ayoub Bombwe na Cathryn Credo mu nshingano zabo.
Iyi filime ivuga ku buzima bwo mu cyaro bw’umugore n’umukobwa we aho ahura n’ibibazo byinshi iyo umugabo abangamiye ubuzima bwumukobwa we. Yafatiwe amashusho mu karere ka Arusha muri Tanzaniya. Iyi filime kandi yayobowe na radiyo 'Kumekucha' yanyuze muri Tanzaniya muri 2016 na 2017.
Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yatsindiye ibihembo bine mu cyiciro cyihariye cya Filime z'Igiswahiri mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Zanzibar 2018 ryerekana amashusho meza, Umukinnyi mwiza, Umuyobozi mwiza, na Sinema nziza. Umukinnyi wa filime Catherine Credo yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza naho Jordan Riber yegukana igihembo cyumuyobozi mwiza.

Thembi Mtshali-Jones (yavutse 7 Ugushyingo 1949), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika yepfo. Ufatwa nk'umwe mu bahanzi bazwi cyane muri Afurika y'Epfo, Thembi azwiho kuba afite uruhare mu biganiro byinshi bya televiziyo bizwi cyane nka "Sgudi 'Snaysi", "Stokvel", "Umutangabuhamya" "ucecetse" na Imbewu. Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi uzwi cyane, umwanditsi w'amakinamico akaba n'umuhanzi wungirije ushinzwe kwigisha muri Global Arts Corps muri Kosovo ndetse n'umutoza muri Kamboje.
Yavutse ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 1949 i Sabhoza, umudugudu uri hafi ya Ulundi, Durban, Afurika y'Epfo. Ababyeyi be baratandukanye nyuma gato yo kuvuka kwe. Nyuma yaje gukurira mu mujyi wa KwaMashu aho yarangirije amashuri ye. Mu gihe cy’ishuri, yarasamye bityo ahatirwa kuva ku ishuri.
Mu 1998, yigaga muri kaminuza ya Gallaudet i Washington DC, muri Amerika nyuma aza muri kaminuza ya Louisville, muri Amerika mu 2004. Umusanzu mu bijyanye n'ubuhanzi, yagizwe umuturage w'icyubahiro wa Louisville na Meya maze ahabwa amajwi yo gushimira na Sena ya Kentucky. Nyuma guverineri wa Kentucky yamuhaye izina rya Cyubahiro Kentucky Colonel, icyubahiro cyinshi muri Kentucky.
"Impano" ye yo gukina yavumbuwe na Welcome Msomi aho Thembi yakoreye muri Umabatha yumwimerere. Nyuma yinjiye muri 'Musical Ipi Tombi', maze aba umugore wambere nka 'Mama Tembu'. Yakoze ingendo mpuzamahanga nyinshi zirimo West End na Broadway. Nyuma yaje kujya muri Amerika kuzamura umwuga we wa muzika aho yahuye nabacuranzi bakunzwe Hugh Masekela na Miriam Makeba. Bazengurutse u Burayi na Afurika imyaka myinshi. Mu 1987, Thembi yagarutse muri Afurika y'Epfo yinjira mu Isoko ry'ikinamico. Ku ikinamico, yabonye amahirwe yo gukorana na Janice Honeyman muri Black Follies.
Mu Gushyingo 2019, Thembi yahawe igihembo cyitwa The Living Legend Award mu iserukiramuco ry’amakinamico ry’abirabura ryabereye muri Carolina y'Amajyaruguru, muri Amerika kugira ngo atandukanye serivisi yakoreye sinema yo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye mu bicuruzwa byamamaye cyane "Mama kuri Mama" mu iserukiramuco ry’imikino ry’abirabura. Ikinamico yari ishingiye ku gitabo cyanditswe na Sindiwe Magona. Nyuma Magona yanditse igitabo kivuga ku mibereho 'Theatre Road: Inkuru yanjye ni inkuru ishishikaje ya Thembi Mtshali-Jones', yasohotse kugira ngo ihure n'imyaka 70 ya Mtshali-Jones.

Tajouj, ni filime y’urukundo rw’amateka ya Sudani yo mu 1977 iyobowe na Gadalla Gubara. niyo filime yambere yerekana ishusho ya filimi muri Sudani. Ivuga ku nkuru itangaje ivuga ku rukundo rudashimishije rw’abakunzi babiri bagana intwari, yashyizwe mu cyaro cya Sudani y’iburasirazuba, ikanagaragaza umukinnyi uzwi cyane Salah bin Albadya. Ifatwa nka imwe muri firime nziza muri cinema nyafurika.
Filime yakiriwe neza nabayinenga. Iyi filime yatsindiye Sitati ya Nefertiti, igihembo kinini cya Egiputa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Cairo mu 1982, inegukana ibihembo mu birori bya firime byabereye muri Alegizandiriya, Ouagadougou, Tehran, Addis Ababa, Berlin, Moscou, Cannes na Carthage.

Xolile Tshabalala (yavutse ku ya 9 Mata 1977) ni umukinnyi wa Afurika yepfo. Azwiho uruhare muri serivise nyinshi za tereviziyo zizwi cyane zirimo "4Play:Sex Tips for Girls", "Secrets &amp; Scandals", "Blood &amp; Water" and "Housekeepers".
Yavukiye i Vrede, muri Leta y'Ubuntu. Yiswe na nyirakuru ubyara se. Yarangije mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubuhanzi afite icyubahiro ndetse na 'Best Performer Performer'.
Mu masomo ye mu ishuri ry’igihugu, Xolile yagize amahirwe yo gukina na Thembi Mtshali-Jones, ari naho yamubereye umujyanama. Bakinnye hamwe mu ikinamico "Crucible" yerekanwe ku Isoko ry'Isoko. Uyu mukinnyi wa filime nawe yakinnye. Yakinnye kandi mubikorwa byinshi bya Televiziyo nka, na Soul City season 7, aho yakinnye mushiki we Zama. Ntabwo bigarukira gusa kuri ecran, Xolile yakinnye kandi mumikino itandukanye irimo "Undi Mwana".
Mu 2005, yafashe ikiruhuko cyo gukina. Nyuma yagiye muri Amerika kwitabira ishuri rya Filime rya New York. Yagarutse muri Afurika y'Epfo mu mwaka wa 2010 akina 'Noma' muri televiziyo ya "4Play: Sex Tips for Girls." Hanyuma yakinnye cyane yerekana 'Mandi Mbalula' muri serial "Fallen", ikinamico yo mu 2011. Muri 2013, Xolile yagaragaye nka 'Gugu' muri "High Rollers" yacaga kuri SABC 3.

Winnie, ni filime yerekana ubuzima bwa Sinema yo muri Afrika yepfo yasohotse muri 2017 yayobowe na Pascale Lamche ikanakorwa na Christoph Jörg na Steven Markovitz kuri Pumpernickel Films, Submarine Films, Big World Cinema.
Iyi filime ivuga ku buzima bwa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela n'urugamba rwe adacogora rwo gukuraho Apartheid muri Afurika y'Epfo. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu rwego rwo kwerekana iserukiramuco ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu 2019. Muri uwo mwaka, Lamche yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi mwiza wa documentaire mpuzamahanga mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance. Yatowe kandi muri Afurika Movie Academy Awards ibihembo bya Documentaire nziza.

Pascale Lamche (yavutse Nyakanga 1960), ni Umufaransa -Umukinnyi wa firime muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi nk'umuyobozi wa firime nyinshi zizwi cyane harimo "Stalingrad", "Black Diamond", "Pakisitani Zindabad", "Ubwiza bw'Abafaransa", "Ushinjwa # 1: Nelson Mandela", "Sophiatown" na "Winnie". Usibye gukora firime, ni na producer, umwanditsi akaba n'umukinnyi wa sinema.
Yabonye icyiciro cya mbere cyicyubahiro BA impamyabumenyi yamateka ya none yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Sussex na Sorbonne. Yatangiye umwuga wa firime i Londere mu kigo cyigenga cya firime, Cinema Action, akora mu kigega cy’iburayi cyandika mu 1989. Icyakora, nyuma yaje kwimukira i Paris gushinga ICONE, umushinga wo gukorana na firime na televiziyo. Yagize amahirwe yo gukorera i Londere na Paris nk'umuproducer n'umuyobozi wigenga. Aherekeza hamwe na societe "ntoya" yo gukora documentaire. Nyuma yinjiye muri 'La Cie Phares et Balises' maze aba umuyobozi wa International Co-Productions for Kamera Continentales.
Muri 2017, yakoze filime documentaire "Winnie", ivuga ku buzima bwa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela n'urugamba rwe rwo gusenya Apartheid muri Afurika y'Epfo. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu rwego rwo kwerekana iserukiramuco ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu 2019. Muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi mwiza wa documentaire mpuzamahanga muri Sundance Festival. Muri Mata 2018, Lamche yasobanuye ko uwahoze ari minisitiri w’umutekano n’umutekano Sydney Mufamadi mu kiganiro n'abanyamakuru.

Jeanne d'Arc Mujawamariya yavukiye i Kigali, Nyarugenge. Ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, kuri ubu akaba ari Minisitiri w’ibidukikije. Yahoze ari Minisitiri w’Uburezi (mu buryo busanzwe, Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Ubumenyi, Ikoranabuhanga n’ubushakashatsi) muri guverinoma y’u Rwanda ndetse na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Burusiya.
Kuva mu 2003 kugeza 2005, yabaye umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye muri guverinoma y'u Rwanda maze mu 2005 aba umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe amashuri makuru muri minisiteri imwe. Kuva mu 2006-Werurwe 2008, yabaye Minisitiri w’uburezi. Muri Mutarama 2008, Mujawamariya yitabye komisiyo y'inteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda ikora iperereza ku gukomeza "ingengabitekerezo ya jenoside" mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda. Abadepite benshi bari muri iyo komisiyo banenze Mujawamariya na Joseph Murekeraho, umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye, kubera ko bafashe ibihano bidahagije ku barimu ndetse n'abashinzwe gutegura integanyanyigisho bakwirakwiza imyumvire yo kurwanya abatutsi mu mashuri. Muri Werurwe 2008, Mujawamariya yagiye kuba Minisitiri mu biro bya Minisitiri w’intebe ushinzwe uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango, uyu mwanya yari afite kugeza muri Werurwe 2011 ubwo yabaga umuyobozi wungirije / umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga cya Kigali kizwi cyane mu Rwanda nka KIST.. Mujawamariya yari ku buyobozi bw'ikigo kugeza ku ya 1 Werurwe 2013, ubwo yagenwaga na Perezida w'u Rwanda kuba Ambasaderi mu Burusiya. Ugushyingo 2019, yabaye Minisitiri w’ibidukikije.
Mujawamariya yabonye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza yakuye muri maze mu 1997 ahabwa impamyabumenyi y’ubumenyi muri chimie yakuye muri kaminuza imwe. Yakomeje kubona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga. muri chimie physique mu 2001. Arubatse, afite abana batatu n'umugabo we. Azi neza cyane Ikinyarwanda nk'ururimi kavukire, akamenya neza Icyongereza, Ikirusiya, Igifaransa; Igiswahili akivuga neza biringaniye

Cécile Murumunawabo Yavutse 1968 akaba ari umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Yatorewe kuba mu mutwe w’abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda mu 2013. Ni umunyamuryango wa Rwanda Patriotic Front (FPR), uhagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali akaba n'umunyamabanga wa kongere y'abagore ba FPR.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Murumunawabo yavutse 1968 kandi afite Masters mubyigisho byiterambere.
Murumunawabo ni umwe mu bagize urugaga rwo gukunda igihugu cy'u Rwanda (FPR) kandi yatorewe kuba Umutwe w'Abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda mu 2013. Mbere, yakoraga mu biro bya Madamu wa Perezida w'u Rwanda. Muri 2013, Murumunawabo yagizwe umunyamabanga wa kongere y’abagore ya FPR. Yongeye gutorerwa kuba umunyamabanga muri 2019 n'amajwi 85.3 ku ijana.

Nyirasafari Espérance ni umunyamategeko akaba n'umunyapolitiki mu Rwanda, akaba umwe muri ba Visi Perezida ba Sena y'u Rwanda, guhera ku ya 17 Ukwakira 2019. Yashyizweho muri Sena na Perezida w'u Rwanda, ku ya 22 Nzeri 2019.
Mbere yibyo, yabaye minisitiri muri Minisiteri ya Siporo n’umuco, kuva ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2018, kugeza ku ya 22 Nzeri 2019. Mbere yibyo, kuva 5 Ukwakira 2016 kugeza 18 Ukwakira 2018, yari Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango.
Espérance yavukiye mu Rwanda ku babyeyi babanyarwanda; bombi bishwe muri Jenoside yo mu Rwanda muri 1994, akiri muto. Nyirasafari Espérance ni umubyeyi wubatse akaba nyina w’abana bane barimo abahungu batatu n’umukobwa umwe, Nyirasafari yanabaye umudepite mu nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda.
Mu 2009, yabaye umunyamabanga uhoraho muri minisiteri y’ubutabera mu Rwanda., ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2016, bivugwa ko yari umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda. Yasimbuye Diane Gashumba aba minisitiri muri Migeprof, wabaye Minisitiri w’ubuzima mu Rwanda. Mu ivugurura ry’abaminisitiri ryo ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, Espérance Nyirasafari yagumanye inshingano ze muri Migeprof. Nka minisitiri ashyigikiye kubahana hagati y’abashakanye kugira ngo bateze imbere umuryango.
Mu ivugurura ry’abaminisitiri ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2018, Espérance Nyirasafari yagizwe Minisitiri w’imikino n’umuco. Yinjiye muri guverinoma ivuguruye ya Perezida Paul Kagame wagabanije abagize guverinoma kuva kuri 31 bakagera kuri 26. Inama y'Abaminisitiri ni abagore 50%, ikora u Rwanda, hamwe na Etiyopiya, ibihugu bibiri bya Afurika byonyine bifite uburinganire muri guverinoma zabo.
Espérance Nyirasafari numubyeyi wubatse. Nyirasafari yigeze kuba umushinjacyaha mukuru wa Repubulika. Espérance Nyirasafari yavuze ko yakoze amahano kubera kwitabira umuhango w'iyimikwa ry’umutware w’Abakono, mu nyandiko yatangaje kuri Twitter isaba imbabazi Perezida Paul Kagame. Kuko abarizwa mu Ishyaka rya FPR-Inkotanyi.

Pélagie Uwera (wavutse 1974) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, kuva mu 2019 akaba umwe mu bagize Sena y'u Rwanda, atorerwa kuba Senateri uhagarariye iNtara y'Amajyepfo.
Pélagie Uwera yahawe impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bumenyi bw'imibereho n'impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bushakashatsi bwiterambere yakuye muri kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali. Kuva mu 1998 kugeza 2009 yari umwarimu w'ishuri ryisumbuye.
Kuva 2012 kugeza 2019 Uwera yari Komiseri wa komisiyo y'igihugu ishinzwe amatora mu Rwanda. Umwe mu bagize Komisiyo barindwi, yabaye indorerezi ya Commonwealth mu matora rusange ya Botswana 2014. Muri 2018 yongeye kuba indorerezi ya Commonwealth mu matora rusange ya Siyera Lewone ya 2018.
Muri 2015 yahataniraga itike y'Ishyaka Riharanira Demokarasi no Kurengera Ibidukikije nk'umukandida mu Nteko ishinga amategeko umutwe w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ariko yatsinzwe na Francois Xavier Kalinda.
Mu bakandida 23 bo mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo mu matora y’Abasenateri 2019, Uwera yari umwe mu bakandida batatu batorewe guhagararira Intara. Mu Kwakira 2019, yatorewe gukorera muri komite ishinzwe imyitwarire ya senateri, nk'umuyobozi wungirije wa Chrysologue Karangwa. Mu Gushyingo 2019, Uwera na senateri John Bonds Bideri batowe nta guhatanira guhagararira u Rwanda mu Nteko ishinga amategeko ya Pan-Afrika.

Médiatrice Ahishakiye (yavutse 1978) ni umugore akaba umunyarwandakazi, umunyapolitiki wo wu Rwanda, ubu ari mu bagize Umutwe w'Abadepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda..Ahishakiye ahagarariye Intara y'Amajyepfo naho akarere ke ni Akarere ka Huye. Ahishakiye mbere yakoraga nk'umwarimu, umunyamabanga w'inama njyanama y'akarere ka Gisagara, ndetse akaba n'umwe mu bagize njyanama y'akarere ka Gisagara mu ntara y'amajyepfo. Mu matora y’abadepite yo mu 2018, Ahishakiye yatorewe kuba mu mutwe w’abadepite nk'uhagarariye abagore mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda.

AYINKAMIYE Speciose ni umunyarwandakazi wavukiye mu Rwanda akaba umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, kuri ubu akaba ari umwe mu bagize umutwe w’abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda. Ayinkamiye ahagarariye Intara y'Iburengerazuba akaba ahagaririye akarere ka Rubavu ari naho havukiye. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2000 kugeza mu mwaka 2001, AYINKAMIYE yari umwarimu. Kuva mu mwaka 2002 kugeza mu mwaka 2018, yakoraga mu myanya itandukanye mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda. Muri Nzeri 2018, AYINKAMIYE yatorewe kujya mu mutwe w'Abadepite mu nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda. AYINKAMIYE ari mubuyobozi bwa KCB Bank Rwanda Limited iyi banki ifite inkomoko ni ikicaro gikuru muri Kenya.

Alvera MUKABARAMBA ni umunyarwandakazi wavukiye mu Rwanda kuwa 9 Werurwe 1960, ni umuganga w'abana ndetse akaba n'umunyapolitike kuva mu mwaka 1999 kurubu atuye mu murwa mukuru wa Kigali mu Rwanda.
Hon. Alvera Mukabaramba afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (Doctorate) mu buganga yakuye muri kaminuza ya, iri mu mujyi wa mu igihugu cy' Uburusiya. Ni inzobere mu ubuganga no kwita k'umikurire y' abana (PhD in) ndetse kaminuza yamuhembye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (doctorate) muri Philosophy.
Hon. Alvera Mukabaramba yinjiye muri politic y'u Rwanda mu 1999, icyo gihe yari abaye umwe mubagize inteko y'inzibacyuho y'ighugu (National Transitional Assembly) kugera mu mwaka wa 2003. Kuva muri uwo mwaka wa 2003 kugera mu kwezi k' ukwakira 2011, yari umusenateri mu inteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda (Rwanda's bicameral parliament). Kuva tariki ya 10 Ukwakira 2011 yagizwe minisitiri wa leta ushinzwe imibereho myiza n'iterambere muri minisiteri y'ubutegetsi bw'ibanze (Ministry of local government) aho yari asimbuye wari umuze kwitaba Imana mu ibitaro by'Iburuseli mu Bubiligi, kuva icyo gihe, yagumishijwe muri guverinoma kandi agumana inshingano ze mu ivugurura ry'abaminisitiri, harimo n'iryo kuri 31 Kanama 2016, hanyuma akomerezaho kuba umunyamabanga wa leta ushinzwe imibereho myiza y'abaturage kugera mu mwaka wa 2019. Ubu ni umusenateri akaba na visi perezida sena ushinzwe imari n'ubuyobozi kuva 2019 kuzagera 2024 aho manda yabo izaba irangiye.

Christine Muhongayire (yavutse 1978) ni umunyapolitiki mu Rwanda, ubu ari mu bagize Umutwe w'Abadepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda.
Muhongayire ahagarariye Intara y'Amajyepfo kandi ni umunyamuryango wa Rwanda Patriotic Front. akarere ke ni Akarere ka Nyaruguru.
Muhongayire ni umuyobozi wa komite ishinzwe imibereho myiza mu mutwe w’abadepite.

Mukabagwiza Edda (wavutse 1968) yari umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda kandi yahoze ari umudipolomate. Kuva 2013, yabaye umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda.
Mukabagwiza mbere yari minisitiri w’ubutabera muri guverinoma y’u Rwanda (2003–2006), kandi yari Komiseri Mukuru akaba na Ambasaderi wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda muri Kanada na Cuba (2007-2013).
Yatorewe bwa mbere mu mutwe w’abadepite mu 2013, yongera gutorwa muri 2018. Ni umwe mu bagize ishyaka rya FPR-Inkotanyi. Muri 2018, Umutwe w’abadepite wamutoye nka Visi Perezida wungirije ushinzwe kugenzura no gushyiraho amategeko.
Edda Mukabagwiza n'umuntu uzwi muri politiki y'u Rwanda no mu mirimo rusange. Yakoze mumyanya itandukanye muri guverinoma y'u Rwanda kandi yagize uruhare mugukemura ibibazo bya diplomasi., Yabaye Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu Bwongereza. Muri urwo rwego, yari ahagarariye inyungu z’u Rwanda kandi ashinzwe umubano w’ububanyi n’amahanga na guverinoma y’Ubwongereza ndetse n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa mpuzamahanga., Yabaye umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe imibereho myiza muri Minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu,byumwihariko yari ashinzwe kugenzura gahunda n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage ku nzego z’ibanze.
Imirimo muri politiki.
Hon. Mukabagiwiza Edda ni Visi Perezida wungirije ushinzwe ibibazo by'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko kuva ku ya 19 Nzeri 2018. Mbere yiki gikorwa, yari Umudepite, Umutwe w’abadepite kuva Ukwakira 2013 kugeza Kanama 2018.
Mbere, Hon. Mukabagiwiza yabaye Komiseri Mukuru akaba na Ambasaderi wa Repubulika y'u Rwanda muri Kanada na Cuba (2007-2013); Umuyobozi w'itsinda rya Commonwealth ry'abakomiseri bakuru muri Kanada (2012-2013); na Perezida w'ihuriro ry'Abadipolomate b'Abanyafurika (AWDF) muri Kanada (2012-2013).
Yabaye kandi Minisitiri w’ubutabera, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda kuva mu Kwakira 2003 kugeza Kanama 2006; Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Minisiteri y'Ubutabera n'imibanire y'inzego (Ugushyingo 2000-Ukwakira. 20030); Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ishyirahamwe rya “HAGURUKA (1999-2000) n’umujyanama mu by'amategeko muri Minisiteri y’ubutabera n’ububanyi n’inzego (1997-1999).
Hon. Mukabagiwiza yakoraga nka “In ishinzwe amategeko ya” muri minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi (1996-1997) ndetse na Visi Perezida wa Pro-Femmes/Twese Hamwe (1999-2000)
Mubuzima bwe bwose, Mukabagwiza yitangiye gukorera abaturage b’u Rwanda no guteza imbere inyungu zabo haba mu gihugu ndetse no hanze yacyo. Uruhare rwe muri guverinoma na diplomasi rwagaragajwe n'ubushake bwe bwo guteza imbere gahunda y’iterambere ry’u Rwanda no gushimangira umubano n’ibindi bihugu.

Mário Bastos (wavutse 1986), uzwi cyane ku izina rya stage Fradique, ni Umukinnyi wa firime muri Angola. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "zizwi" cyane Alambamento, "Independência" na "Ar Condicionado". Usibye kuyobora, ni n'umwanditsi, producer, umuyobozi wungirije hamwe n'umwanditsi.
Yavutse mu 1986 i Luanda, muri Angola.
Mu mwaka wa 2008, Fradique yize muri New York Film Academy maze ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buhanzi bwiza (kuyobora) muri Academy ya Art University i San Francisco. Muri 2009, yakoze film ye ya mbere ngufi, "Alambamento". Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime ngufi nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Luanda kandi yari ihitamo ryemewe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Vancouver ndetse na Tenerife International Film Festival.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Fradique yashinze isosiyete ikora filimi Geração 80 hamwe na Jorge Cohen na Tchiloia Lara. Muri 2011, yize muri Berlinale Talent Campus kugirango akomeze amasomo. Kuva mu 2010 kugeza 2015, yakoze kuri documentaire ye ya mbere yuzuye, "Independência". Iyi filime yibanze ku rugamba rwo kwibohora rwa Angola nyuma iza gutsindira igihembo cy’umuco wa Angola ku rwego rwa Sinema. Ifatwa nkimwe muma firime meza yibihe byose muri cinema nyafurika. ] Iyi filimi kandi ngo yabonye iki gihembo kuko Best documentaire muri Cameron International Film Festival no yari guhitamo Official ku Durban International Film Festival, iLuxor Film Festival Afurika Pan African Film Festival.
Yayoboye kandi amashusho yindirimbo zubuhanzi-abahanzi bo muri Angola nka Nástio Mosquito na Aline Frazão. Muri 2020, yakoze filime ye yambere yimpimbano, "Ar Condicionado", ikaba Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Rotterdam. Nibwo bwatoranijwe kumugaragaro muri Uganda mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Friborg mu 2020. Yakiriwe neza mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Hon. Kanziza Epiphanie ni umunyarwandakazi wavutse mu mwaka 1972 avukira mu muryango w’abana 7 mu murenge wa Gatunda mu karere ka Nyagatare mu intara y'uburasirazuba.
Kanziza Epiphaie yize amashuri abanza kuva mu mwaka wi 1979-1987 kuri Groupe scolaire Mutumba Nyagatare, bimwe mubyaranze imyigire ye mu ishuri ribanza ni ugutsinda neza amasomo ndetse yatsindwa akababara cyane, ibi byamufashije gutsinda neza ibizamini bya leta, bityo akomereza mu mashuri yisumbuye muri Notre Dame du Bon Conseil Byumba ishami rya normal technique maze abona amanota meza mu ibizamini bisoza amashuri yisumbuye 77% mu mwaka 1996, akomereza muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali (ULK) mu ishami rya Relation Internationale (Imibanire y’Ibihugu).
Kanziza Epiphaie mu mwaka 1995 yabaye Field Officer in International Red Cross Committee (CICR), 1996 kugera 2004 yigishije muri groupe scolaire Cyabayaga I Nyagatare, mu mwaka 1999-2004: yabaye Coordinator wa CNF Mimuli Sector, Nyagatare District, nyuma yakomeje akazi k'uburezi muri groupe scolaire Bibare I Gatsibo kuva 2005 kugera 2008. 2008-2010: yakoze mu mushinga African Initiative for Mankind Progress Organization (AIMPO) ashinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage mu karere ka Musanze. 2010-2014: Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu MINALOC yarihiye abanyeshuri muri Kaminuza ihereye ku bagize amanota menshi nawe azamo yiga Relation Internationale (Imibanire y’Ibihugu). 2016-2018: Mediator Committee Ruhango Cell, Gisozi Sector, Gasabo District. 2012-2020: Coordinator of Women’s Organization for Promoting Unity (WOPU)

Eddy Munyaneza (yavutse 24 Ukwakira 1981) ni Umukinnyi wa firime mu Burundi. "Munyaneza ufatwa nk'umwe mu bakora amafilime akomeye" mu Burundi, azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire zizwi cyane "Le troisième vide" na Lendemains. Usibye gukora firime, ni umwanditsi, producer n'umwanditsi.
Yavutse ku ya 24 Ukwakira 1981 mu mudugudu muto wegereye umujyi wa Gitega mu Burundi. Yarangije amashuri mu 2002. Nyuma yaje kurangiza icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza muri sinema i Saint-Louis, muri Senegali.
Mu 2004 yabonye amahirwe yo gukorana na sosiyete yitwa 'Menya Média' aho yatoje ibijyanye no gutunganya amajwi n'amashusho. Muri 2009, yitabiriye nk'umukanishi muri filime ngufi "Na Wewe", iyobowe na Ivan Goldschmidt. Iyi filime yaje gutorwa muri Oscars mu 2011.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yasohoye filime ye ya mbere yerekana "amateka ya Histoire d'une haine manquée". Iyi documentaire ivuga inkuru yukuntu barumuna be batutsi na we ubwe yakijijwe nabaturanyi babo b'Abahutu mugihe cya jenoside yo mu Burundi mu 1993. Filime yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi muri Festival International du Cinéma et de l'Audiovisuel du Burundi (FESTICAB). Muri uwo mwaka, yahawe igihembo cya Prix Spécial kubera uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican ya Ouagadougou (FESPACO). Hagati aho, yahawe igihembo cy'ishimwe na perezida w'u Burundi, Pierre Nkurunziza, i Kirundo. Icyakora, yanenze perezida Nkurunziza kuba yarahataniraga manda ya gatatu.
Muri 2016 yasohoye film ye ya kabiri ya documentaire, "Le troisième vide". Harimo amajwi y’imyivumbagatanyo ikaze y’imyaka ibiri ya guverinoma ya Nkurunziza aho abantu bari hagati ya 500 na 2000 bakorerwa iyicarubozo bakicwa, naho 400.000 bakajyanwa mu bunyage. Amaze gusohora filime, yakiriye telefoni itazwi akangishwa urupfu. Ni yo mpamvu yahunze igihugu mu mpera za 2016 maze atandukana n'umugore we n'abana batatu. Icyakora, yasubiye mu Burundi muri Nyakanga 2016 no muri Mata 2017 kugira ngo abone andi mashusho ya "videwo ya Le troisième". Nyuma yumwaka, film yahawe igihembo cyinyandiko nziza muri Guido Huysmans Young African Makers Award (YAFMA).

Vivienne Roumani-Denn n'umukinnyi wa firime wumunyamerika. Azwiho kuba umuyobozi wa firime zishimirwa "Abayahudi ba nyuma bo muri Libiya" no "hanze". Usibye gukora amafilime, ni n'umuhanga mu kuvuga amateka, producer, umukinnyi wa sinema, ushushanya kuvuga n'umwanditsi.

Roues libres (ikidage: Nachtfahrt), ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Cote d'Ivoire 2002 iyobowe na Sidiki Bakaba ikaba yarayikoranye na Ayala Bakaba na Berti Dichi. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Adama Dahico, Placide Bayoro, Daouda Traoré na Michel Gohou mu nshingano zabo.
Yafashwe amashusho yose muri Abidjan, Côte D'Ivoire. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime harimo umuyobozi mwiza muri l'Association des Professionnels du cinéma de Côte d'Ivoire.

Zeresenay Berhane Mehari (wavutse 1974), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Etiyopiya. Azwiho kuba umuyobozi wa firime "zizwi" cyane Difret na "Sweetness in Belly".
Usibye sinema, ni umwe mu bashinze kandi akaba n'Umuyobozi w'Ibintu by'umwimerere kuri Televiziyo ya Kana, Televiziyo ya mbere yashyizwe ku buntu ku kirere, yigenga muri Etiyopiya.
Yavukiye i Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya mu muryango ufite barumuna barindwi. Nyuma yaje kwimukira muri Amerika mu gihe murumuna we na mushiki we bimukiye mu Buholandi, undi muvandimwe akaba muri Suwede.
Nyuma yo kwimukira muri Amerika, Mehari yize filime muri kaminuza y’amajyepfo ya California School of Cinematic Arts arangiza impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Arts. Mugihe yiga, yashinze isosiyete ikora 'Haile - Addis Pictures'.
Yatangiye gukora nkumufasha wibikorwa mubice bibiri: "Byose kuri Eva" na "The seven Year Itch" muri 2000 ya tereviziyo ya "Backstory". Noneho yabaye umufasha wibikorwa byigice "M * A * S * H: Comedy Under Fire" muri 2001 Urutonde "rwamateka vs." "Hollywood". Nyuma muri 2006, yabaye producer wa "Leila" ngufi iyobowe na Hanelle M. Culpepper. Nyuma yumwaka, yakoze firime ye ya mbere "Coda".
Mu 2005 yamenyeshejwe na avoka Meaza Ashenafi na murumuna we. Hanyuma hamwe na we, bavumbuye ikibazo cya Hirut Assefa n'umuco wa “telefa” mugihe bakora ubushakashatsi kuri Meaza no gukorera mumuryango we. "akoresheje" ibyabaye, yayoboye filime yumukobwa yitwa Difret muri 2014, yungutse ibitekerezo byiza. Umuyobozi mukuru wa firime yari umukinnyi wa filime uzwi cyane muri Hollywood, Angelina Jolie. Nubwo yagize amahirwe yo gufata amashusho muri 2009, nyuma yaje gutegereza kugeza muri 2012 gufata amashusho kubera ibibazo byo gukina. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere muri Sundance Film Festival muri Mutarama 2013. Filime yatsindiye ibihembo byabitabiriye iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Berlin, iserukiramuco rya muzika rya Park City, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Amsterdam ndetse no mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Montreal. Icyakora, muri Nzeri 2014, muri Etiyopiya herekanywe bwa mbere ku mugaragaro abayobozi ba filime bavuga ko iyi filime yahaye Meaza 'inguzanyo nyinshi'. Ariko, nyuma yaje kurekurwa n'imanza ebyiri kandi ifite ibigwi muri Etiyopiya.
Muri 2019, yakoze igice cya kabiri, "Sweetness in the Belly", film ya kabiri yakinnye na Dakota Fanning na Yahya Abdul-Mateen II. Cyari gifite umwanya wambere mugice cya Discovery cyumunsi mukuru wa firime ya Toronto. Filime yahinduwe nigitabo cyizina rimwe ryanditswe na Camilla Gibb.

Umshana (lit. 'The ' ni filimi yo muri Eswatini black and white drama film iyoborwa na Bi Phakathi na vyahinguwe n'Ivyabona BIP Films isohoka muri 2015. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Mbali Dlamini na Delani Dlamini mu nshingano zabo hamwe na Lisa Mavuso, Temakhosi Nkambule, Fineboy Mhlanga mu nshingano zabo.
Nibintu byambere byose- Siswati yerekana firime kandi yafashwe amashusho mubwami bwa Eswatini.

Dhalinyaro ("Urubyiruko") ni filime yikinamico ya Djiboutian 2017 iyobowe na Lula Ali Ismaïl aho yabaye umuyobozi wa mbere wa firime ya Djiboutian. Yakozwe na diregiteri ubwe hamwe na Alexandra Ramniceanu, Jean-Frédéric Samie na Gilles Sandoz kuri Samawada films. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Amina Mohamed Ali, Tousmo Mouhoumed Mohamed, na Bilan Samir Moubus mu nshingano zabo. Niyo filime ya mbere yerekanwe mu mateka ya sinema ya Djibouti yagaragaye bwa mbere muri Nyakanga 2017.
Filime ikurikira abakobwa batatu bakomoka mubyiciro bitandukanye byubukungu. Yatewe inkunga na Organisation de la Francophonie, kandi ikorerwa muri Kanada, Somaliya, Ubufaransa na Djibouti. Yafashwe amashusho yose muri Djibouti. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Seasons of a Life, ni filimi yasohotse 2010 nka Malawi Legal drama film iyoborwa na Shemu Joyah na vyahinguwe n'Ivyabona FirstDawn Arts. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Bennie Msuku ayoboye hamwe na Neria Chikhosi, Flora Suya na Tapiwa Gwaza bagize uruhare runini.
Ikinamico yemewe ninkiko yibanze kumukozi wo murugo wasambanijwe numukoresha we uharanira kwiha ku imbaraga no kuzamura imibereho ye. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Göteborg muri Suwede ku ya 31 Mutarama 2010. Iyi filime kandi yatorewe ibihembo mu birori bya Kenya, Cairo, na Zanzibar. Yatowe mu byiciro 8 mu bihembo bya 6 bya African Movie Academy Awards, harimo abahatanira ibihembo byiza byerekana amashusho meza hamwe n’umwimerere mwiza. Umukinnyi wa filime, Tapiwa Gwaza yatsindiye igihembo cya Nollywood kubera ibikorwa byiza byakozwe numukinnyi ushyigikiwe.

Fahavalo, Madagasikari 1947, ni Filime ya documentaire y’intambara ya Malagasi ya 2018 iyobowe na Marie-Clémence Paes kandi yakozwe na diregiteri ubwe hamwe na Agnès Contensou, Viviane Dahan muri Laterit Productions, film za Cobra na Silvão Produções.
Iyi documentaire iragaragaza uburambe bwabanzi ba fahavalo 1947 barwanya abategetsi ba gikoloni cyabafaransa muri Madagasikari nabatangabuhamya bazima. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime harimo na Documentaire zigihembo cyisi ku nshuro ya 42 ku iserukiramuco rya Filime ku isi ndetse no kuvugwa bidasanzwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage.

Teresa, ni Filime ngufi Equatoguinean 2010 iyobowe na Thato Rantao Mwosa kandi yakozwe na Library of National Gineya. Iyi filime yanditswe na Guillermina Mekuy Mba Obono, umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe amasomero, Ububiko, Inzu Ndangamurage na Sinema. Muri firime hagaragaramo Elena Iyanga, Betty KB, na Dina Anguesomo mubikorwa byingenzi. Niyo filime ya mbere yo hagati yakozwe muri Gineya ya Ekwatoriya.
Filime izenguruka mubuzima bwingimbi bwabanyeshuri batatu: Teresa, Rocío na Yolanda bayobowe nibyabaye. Iyi filime ifite umwanya wa mbere mu kigo ndangamuco cya Esipanye cya Malabo no mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’umuco ry’Abafaransa ryerekana Malabo. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Cape Verde, Urukundo rwanjye ni filimi yasohotse 2007 muri Cape Verdean iyobowe na Ana Lúcia Ramos Lisboa. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Neusa Cardoso na Eric Bridges Twahirwa mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Olivia García, Isabel Fontes na Cleophas Kabasita mu nshingano zabo. Filime yakiriwe neza.

The Day of My Wedding, ni filime ngufi ya Botswana yo mu 2007 iyobowe na Thato Rantao Mwosa kandi yakozwe na Thato Rantao Mwosa nka SaBantu Productions. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Erickka Jones mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Souleymane Sy Savane na Audrey Aduama mu nshingano zunganira.
Filime yafatiwe muri Boston no muri Massachusetts, muri Amerika. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Roxbury, muri Amerika ku ya 4 Kanama 2007.

Afarit el-asphalt, ni filmi yasohotse 1996 yo mu Misiri iyoborwa na Oussama Fawzi na yakozwe na Hany Gerges Fawzi afatanyije na Aflam Guirguiss Fawzy. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Mahmoud Hemida na Salwa Khattab mu nshingano zabo aho nka Hasan Husni, Lotfy Labib, Gamil Ratib na Mohammed Tawfik bagize uruhare runini. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Lokarno mu Busuwisi ku ya 11 Kanama 1996.

Abi foq al-Shagara (Data Hejuru ku Giti), ni filime yo mu Misiri yo mu 1969 ikinamico yerekana urukundo yakozwe na Hussein Kamal ikorwa na Abdel Halim Hafez kuri Sawt al-Fann. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Abdel Halim Hafez na Nadia Lutfi mu mwanya wa mbere aho nka Mervat Amin Jenita Furneau, Samir Sabri na Salah Nazmi bagize uruhare runini.
Filime yafatiwe muri Alegizandiriya no mu micungararo yayo. Filime yabaye amashusho yuwo mwaka cyane kubera gusomana. Filime ifatwa nkimwe muri firime nziza zigeze gukorwa mu Misiri. Nibigaragara bwa firime ya nyuma yakozwe n'umukinnyi wa filime Abdel Halim Hafez mbere y'urupfu rwe ku ya 30 Werurwe 1977 kubera kunanirwa kw'umwijima nk'ikibazo cya "Schistosoma mansoni".

Nous aurons toute la mort pour dormir, ni 1977 filime ya documentaire ya Franco - Mauritanian iyobowe na Med Hondo kandi ikorerwa muri Les Films du Soleil Ô.
Iyi filime yafashwe amezi 4 kuva ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1975 kugeza ku ya 5 Werurwe 1976, mu gace kahoze ari Sahara ya Esipanye. Iyi filime ivuga ku ntambara yitwaje intwaro ya Polisario Front mu burengerazuba bwa Sahara kurwanya ubukoloni bwa Espagne. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza n'abayinenga kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Berlin mu Budage bw'Iburengerazuba muri Kamena 1977.

Gambia: Take Me to Learn My Roots, ni film ya documentaire ya Gambiya yasohotse 2019 iyobowe na Bacary Bax kandi yakozwe na Bud Sugar. Iyi filime ivuga ku butumwa bw'umubyeyi umwe bwo kwigisha abahungu be b'amoko avanze ku mizi yabo yo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba. Filime yakorewe mu Bwongereza (Kingston kuri Hull, East Riding ya Yorkshire) no muri Gambiya (Brikama). Filime yakiriwe neza nabayireba.

Po di Sangui (Igiti cy'Amaraso), ni filimi y'amakinamico y'AbafaransaBissau-Gineya yo mu 1996 iyobowe na Flora Gomes kandi yakozwe na Jean-Pierre Gallepe. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Dulceneia Bidjanque mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Djuco Bodjan, Dadu Cissé, Adama Kouyaté na Edna Evora mu nshingano zabo.
Iyi filime yafashwe nkumugani nyafurika mumudugudu wamashyamba ya Amanha Lundju. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Mapule's Choice, ni Filime ngufi yasohotse 2008 iyobowe na KaiKaizer Matsumunyane kandi yakozwe na Tumelo Matobako. Filime ivuga ku buzima bwa Mapule, umusore ukora imyenda ukomoka muri Maseru ugomba guhitamo hagati yo kubika ibanga no kwikiza. Iyi filime yerekanwe kandi itorwa ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Zanzibar mu 2009.
