Honorable Mukabalisa Donatille,Yavutse muri Nyakanga 1960,Akaba ari Perezida w’Umutwe w’abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda.
Kuva mu 1981 kugeza 1998, yakoraga muri gahunda y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe iterambere i Kigali mu myanya itandukanye. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2000 kugeza 2003, yari umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko y’inzibacyuho mu Rwanda akaba na Perezida wungirije wa Komisiyo ihoraho y’ubukungu n’ubucuruzi.
Kuva mu 1981 kugeza 1998, yakoraga muri gahunda y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe iterambere i Kigali mu myanya itandukanye. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2000 kugeza 2003, yari umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko y’inzibacyuho mu Rwanda akaba na Perezida wungirije wa Komisiyo ihoraho y’ubukungu n’ubucuruzi.
Mu matora y’abadepite yo mu 2003 yatorewe kuba umwe mu bagize umutwe w’abadepite ku rutonde rw’ishyaka riharanira ukwishyira ukizana kwa buri muntu kandi atorerwa kuba umuyobozi wungirije wa komisiyo ihoraho ishinzwe ibibazo bya politiki n’uburinganire.
Kuva mu Kwakira 2011, yari Umusenateri (Urugereko rwo hejuru) kandi yatowe n'abasenateri kuba Umuyobozi wungirije wa Komisiyo ihoraho ishinzwe ibibazo bya politiki n'imiyoborere myiza.
Nyuma yimyaka ibiri muri Sena, ku ya 4 Ukwakira 2013 yatorewe kuba Perezida w’Umutwe w’abadepite / Inteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda. Hon. Mukabalisa Donatille kandi ni Perezida w'ishyaka riharanira ukwishyira ukizana kwa buri muntu.

Murumunawabo Cécile (Yavutse 1968) ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Yatorewe kuba mu mutwe w’abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda muri 2013. Ni umunyamuryango wa FPR Inkotanyi ariwo, Rwanda Patriotic Front (FPR), aho ahagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali akaba n'umunyamabanga wa kongere y'abagore ba FPR.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Murumunawabo yavutse 1968, avukira mu buhungiro, kandi ndetse afite icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu iterammbere n'amajyambere. Murumunawabo ari mu Banyamuryango bashinze umuryango Imbuto Foundation, kandi akaba ari umwe mu bagize inama jyanama yuwo muryango. Murumunawabo ni umu Krisito wavutse ubwa kabili.
Murumunawabo ni umwe mu bagize urugaga rwo gukunda igihugu cy'u Rwanda (FPR) kandi yatorewe kuba Umutwe w'Abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda mu 2013. Mbere, yakoraga mu biro bya Madamu wa Perezida w'u Rwanda. Muri 2013, Murumunawabo yagizwe umunyamabanga wa kongere y’abagore ya FPR. Yongeye gutorerwa kuba umunyamabanga muri 2019 n'amajwi 85.3 ku ijana.

Letekidan Micael (wavutse 1997), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Eritereya. "Azwiho" uruhare rwa 'Awet' muri filime Feuerherz ishimwa cyane.
Yavutse mu 1997 i Asmara, muri Eritereya. Igihe "yakinaga muri firime yintambara ya Feuerherz", umuryango we wakiriye ubutumwa bwiterabwoba butazwi. Ni yo mpamvu bashatse ubuhungiro bwa politiki mu Burayi.
Mu 2008, Micael afite imyaka 10, yakinnye muri filime yo mu Budage "Feuerherz", nyuma yitwa Icyongereza nka "Heart of Fire". Yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 25 Nzeri 2008. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu ntambara yo kwigenga ya Eritereya na Etiyopiya, ikaba yari ishingiye ku mibereho y’umuhanzi w’umudage Senait Mehari wavukiye muri Eritereya. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza n'abayinenga kandi ishima uruhare rwa Micael nk'umusirikare w'umwana, 'Awet'.

Kampeta Sayinzoga ni umuyobozi mukuru wa Banki ishinzwe iterambere ry'u Rwanda(BRD).
Madamu Kampeta Sayinzoga yarangije kaminuza mw'iterambere ry'ubukungu nububanyi n'amahanga i Witwatersrand muri afurika y'epfo(South Africa) akomereza impamyabumenyi y'Icyiciro cya Kaminuza (Masters Degree) mw'iterambere ry'ubukungu nisesesengura yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Nottingham.
Madamu Kampeta yinjiye muri BRD afite uburambe kubukungu bw'u Rwanda, yabaye umuyobozi w'Ibiro bya Minisitiri w'intebe. Yakoze kandi muri Minisiteri y'Imari n'Igenamigambi aho yagiye akora kumyanya itandukanye kandi yubuyobozi harimo no kuba umunyamabanga uhoraho, Mbere yo kwinjira mu mirimo ya Leta kampeta yakoraga muri Banki y'Isi yakoze kandi munama z'ubutegetsi z'amabanki nka The Trade and Development Bank, Banki y'iterambere y'Afurika y'iburasirazuba(EADB), Rwanda Euro Board Committee, GT Bank, no mu kigo Cy'Igihugu Cy'Imisoro.

Shana Elizabeth Dowdeswell (1 Mata 1989 - 12 Ukuboza 2012), yari umukinnyi wa filime wa Hollywood ukomoka muri Zimbabwe.
Dowdeswell yavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1989 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Se Roger Dowdeswell yahoze akina umukino wa tennis wabigize umwuga. Nyina Laurie Smith numuproducer wakoze firime "The New Twenty". Shana yimukiye mu mujyi wa New York, muri Amerika maze yiga mu Mujyi no mu Gihugu, PS 3, arangije amashuri yisumbuye ya PPAS. Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina afite imyaka umunani, nyuma akina Anne Frank mu bicuruzwa muri Paper Mill Playhouse.Yagiranye umubano muremure numukunzi we Cameron Moneo. Yari afite murumuna we Jesse. Se wabo wa Shana, Colin Dowdeswell, yahoze ari umukinnyi wa tennis wabigize umwuga.
Ku ya 7 Ukuboza 2012, Shana yagiye mu mujyi wa New York City Greenwich bar bita The Basement maze anywa amacupa menshi ya whisky. Agarutse, yaratsitaye maze asohoka mu muryango. Ugenda n'imbwa yavumbuye umurambo we atazi ubwenge, yihutira kujya ku kigo nderabuzima cya Beth Isiraheli. Nyuma yipimisha, byagaragaye ko muri kiriya gihe harimo alcool mu maraso 0.39, bikubye inshuro eshanu amategeko leta yemerera gutwara. Yapfuye ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2012.
Mu 2002, Shana yagaragaye muri ' "Miracle" ' ya Frank Higgins akina nka 'Eva', umukobwa wikunda. Muri 2003 yakinnye nka verisiyo ikiri nto ya 'Jenna' muri film "13 Going on 30". Ariko, gukina kwe kwakuwe muri firime nyuma yuko abitabiriye ikizamini bakiriye nabi umwimerere. Nyuma yaje gukina inyuguti enye zitandukanye mubyiciro bitatu byibanze byerekana Amategeko &amp; Iteka franchise. Hanyuma yakinnye muri filime izwi cyane nka "Mercy", "Family of the Year", and "Body of Proof""." Hagati aho, Shana yagaragaye no muri filime "The Stream", "The Winning Season", "Asylum Seekers", and "Choose" before her death.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwe mu mwaka wa 2012, hasohotse filime eshanu: "The Big Wedding" (2013), a short film "Going South" (2013), "An Ornament of Faith" (2013), short film "Wish You Were Here" (2013), and "Mistress America" (2015).

Alois Moyo (yavutse 28 Ukwakira 1966), ni umukinnyi wa filimi mu budage akaba yaravukiye muri Zimbabwe akaba na producer. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Power of One" na "Iron Sky" kimwe na "serivise ya Tatort".
Yavutse ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1966 i Bulawayo, muri Zimbabwe. Ubu atuye mu Budage.
Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umukinnyi wa teatre mu 1986 akina ikinamico "Citizen Mind". Mu 1980, Moyo yashinze ikinamico ya mbere nyafurika yitwa 'Amakhosi Township Square Cultural Centre' (ATSCC) muri Zimbabwe ikaba yarakoreshejwe nka karate-club ihinduka ikigo ndangamuco muri Zimbabwe. Kuva mu 2005 ajya mu kuba mu Budage kandi akora nk'umukinnyi wa teatre, firime na TV. Yatangiye gukina sinema mu 1992 akoresheje filime "Power of One" iyobowe na John Avildsen aho yakinnye nk'umukinnyi w'iteramakofe wo muri Afurika ndetse no guharanira ubwisanzure. Igihe yabaga mu Budage, yakoze umusaruro we wa mbere mu kidage witwa "Die Zofen" mu 2005 hanyuma "Afurika Montage" muri 2007. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwayo, yakoze umusaruro wa kabiri mu Budage "Steinstunde der Menschheit" mu 2008.

Umar Krupp, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Gana na producer. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "House of Gold" na "Amakye na Dede".
Yavukiye i Accra, muri Gana.
Muri 2015, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Pan Africa Cinema Awards (PACA). Krupp yatowe nka Producer mwiza wa Afurika muri Nollywood Entertainment and Leadership Awards (NELAS) muri 2019 kubera gukora firime "Accra Hustlers". Muri 2019, Krupp yayoboye "Ama" yasohotse mu ikinamico muri Mutarama 2020. Muri 2018, yakinnye muri filime "Babani". Nyuma yaje gutsindira ibihembo bine muri Golden Movie Awards harimo; City People Entertainment Award for Face of Ghana Movies.Muri 2020, umukinnyi wa filime Serwaa Akoto uri hafi kuza yaburiye umukinnyi Umar Krupp ku bijyanye no gutandukana na Krupp no kwishyura ibibazo umukinnyi wa filime.

Qwasi Blay Jnr., ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Gana. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri firime "Adoma" na "Grilled". Yagaragaye muri firime cumi neshanu na seri enye za TV.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Yavukiye muri Gana nk'umwana wa gatatu mu muryango ufite barumuna be batanu: abagabo bane n'umugore. Yarangije amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye muri Great Lamptey Mills. Hanyuma yakomereje amashuri muri Aburi Secondary Technical (SHS). Amashuri makuru yayize muri kaminuza ya tekinike ya Koforidua ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse (HND) mu kugura no gutanga.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina mu 2016 akiri umwana, agaragara muri "Gray Dust", "Grilled", na serial "Deju Vu". Yahawe Best Entertainment Male honor at the tertiary level and best male entertainment act at the maiden edition of the Social Media Entertainment awards. Nyuma yaje gutorwa nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu mwanya wa mbere mu nshuro ya 9 ya Gana Movie Awards kubera uruhare muri filime "Adoma".

Alphonse Menyo, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Gana, azwi cyane muri filimi "Freetown" and "Gold Coast Lounge"
Yavukiye i Accra, muri Gana. Se, Bernard Menyo, yakomokaga muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Yahoze ari umunyeshuri w'ikigo cy'igihugu cya Filime na Televiziyo (NAFTI). Bernard yatsindiye igihembo mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) kubera filime "Whose fault". Nyina wa Menyo, Eugenia, yakomokaga muri Gana yakoraga mu muryango utegamiye kuri Leta.
Menyo yize muri Ghallywood Academy of Film Acting i Accra, muri Gana yiga sinema namakinamico. Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina amakinamico mu 2009 akoresheje ikinamico. Muri 2015, yakinnye bwa mbere muri sinema muri filime yigenga y'Abanyamerika "Freetown" iyobowe na Garrett Batty. Filime yerekanwe mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime , kandi yatorewe ibihembo byinshi bya Gana Movie Awards.
Menyo yerekanwe bwa mbere muri firime "Utopia". Filime yakiriye ibihembo bine muri Ghana Movie Awards. Muri 2017, "Utopia" yabaye firime yonyine yo muri Gana yatowe kandi yerekanwa mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Helsinki (HAFF). Muri 2017, yakinnye muri triller y'urukundo rugufi "Black Rose" iyobowe na Pascal Aka. Muri 2018, yinjiye muri Pascal Aka ubutaha, akina muri firime ngufi ya "Ruswa". Menyo yatsindiye igihembo cya Yaa Asantewaa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Black Star kubera uruhare rwe ndetse anegukana igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bagabo mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi ryabereye i Kinshasa, muri Kongo.
Menyo has received several awards and nominations for his acting performances. In 2019, he won the Best Actor award at the Ghana Movie Awards for his role in Gold Coast Lounge. He was also nominated for the same award in 2020 for his performance in the film Last Night in dutamovie21
Yatoranijwe kugirango ahagararire Gana muri Theatre y'urubyiruko ya 2019 muri Egiputa. Nyuma yumwaka, yakinnye 'Daniel' muri film ya "Gold Coast Lounge". Ku ruhare rwe, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi muri Gana Movie Awards 2019.

Étalon de Yennenga ni igihembo gihabwa abantu b'icyubahiro bagize uruhare muri ecran ya silver ya Burkinabe, gitangwa na Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican ya Ouagadougou (FESPACO), mu rwego rwo gushimira Filime Nziza. Yatangiye bwa mbere mu 1972, ifatwa nkigihembo cyubahwa muri cinema ya Afrika.
'Étalon de Yennenga' bisobanura Stallion ya Yennenga bivuga Umuganwakazi Yennenga, umugani washinze ubwami bwa Mossi, ubwoko bukuru muri Burkinafaso. Inkuru ya Yennenga yatangiriye mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 12 mu bwami bwa Dagomba bwa Mossi. Abasirikare b'umwami wa Dagomba, Nedega, bari intwari kandi hafi buri gihe batsindaga imbaraga zose. Umukobwa wa Nedega, Yennenga, wari umugore w'ifarashi, kandi yari umuhanga mu gukoresha amacumu, amacumu n'umuheto.
Irasangiwe na Burkina Faso abakora amafilime azwi cyane, Idrissa Ouedraogo. Ouedraogo yatsindiye igihembo cya Yennenga mu 1991 kubera filime "Tilai". Uwatsindiye iki gihembo ni Voltaïque Kollo Daniel Sanou mu 1983 hamwe na film ye "Pawéogo" (The Emigrant).
Muri 2005, FESPACO ya 19, ibihembo bibiri bishya byiswe "Stallion". Igikombe cya Stallion Award cyakozwe numucuzi wa Burkinabe Ali Nikiméa. Igihembo cya Yennenga gisanzwe gihinduka igihembo cyiza cya Yennenga, naho ibihembo bishya byitwa Yennenga Silver Standard na Yennenga Bronze Standard.

Thamsanqa 'Tamy' Moyo (yavutse 5 Mutarama 1998) numuhanzi wumuziki muri Zimbabwe. Yamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo "Ndibereke ya" "2016 ndetse anagira" uruhare muri film ya Gonarezhou 2020.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Yavutse ku ya 5 Mutarama 1998 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Ise Richard Kohola ni umunyamakuru muri Star FM Zimbabwe izwi cyane nka RK. Yarezwe na nyina Doris Moyo na sekuru Makwara.
Afite imyaka 7, yatangiye kuririmba cyane cyane muri korari nkuru. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Lusitania nyuma yiga Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Westridge mu mashuri yisumbuye. Afite imyaka 13 igihe yari muri Form One, yifatanije nabahanzi bazwi cyane Joe Thomas, Oliver Mtukudzi, Stunner, Ba Shupi, na Alexio Kawara. Nyuma yaje kuba Ambasaderi w’umwana muri Childline Zimbabwe, aba umuhererezi wa Zimbabwe wabaye ambasaderi. Mu mwaka wa 2008, Tamy yashinze Korali Nyafurika yo muri Uganda, afatanije n'abandi bakozi batatu mu gitaramo cyo gufasha mu busitani bwa Madison Square i New York.
Muri 2017, Tamy yatumiriwe gukina muri film "Gonarezhou" hamwe na producer wa firime, Sydney Taivavashe. Filime yakozwe ku bufatanye na Parike ya Zimbabwe hamwe n’ikigo gishinzwe imicungire y’ibinyabuzima. Muri filime Tamy yakinnye nka 'Chipo' nka sinema ye ya mbere. Muri uwo mwaka, yatowe bwa mbere muri National Arts Merit Awards (NAMA awards) kubera kuba indashyikirwa mu nshingano ze.
Muri 2019, Tamy yatorewe kuba umuhanzi mwiza w’umugore ukomoka muri Afurika yepfo mu birori bya All Africa Music Award (AFRIMA) byabereye muri Gana.

Tariro Mnangagwa (wavutse 1986) numukinnyi wa Zimbabwe no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Azwiho uruhare muri film ya "Gonarezhou" 2020. Ni umukobwa muto wa perezida wa Zimbabwe, Emmerson Mnangagwa.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Mnangagwa yavukiye i Harare kwa Perezida Emmerson Mnangagwa na Jayne Matarise, wapfuye ku ya 31 Mutarama 2002 azize kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Mnangagwa afite barumuna be batanu: Farai, Tasiwa, Vimbayi, Tapiwa, na Emmerson Tanaka. Afite kandi barumuna be batatu bavukana kuva se yashyingiwe bwa kabiri. Mnangagwa yabonye Impamyabumenyi mu mafoto yabigize umwuga muri Cape Town's CityVarsity. Yarangije kandi icyubahiro mu micungire ya siporo muri kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga ya Cape Peninsula.
Nyuma yo gusubira muri Zimbabwe, Mnangagwa yifatanije na Akashinga, ishami ry’abagore barwanya inyamanswa. Nyuma yaje kuba umunyamuryango w’ingabo z’abagore barwanya ishimutwa ry'inyamanswa zitwa International Anti-Poaching Foundation.
Nyuma gato, yatumiwe gukina muri film "Gonarezhou" bafatanya gutunganya film, Sydney Taivavashe. Filime yakozwe ku bufatanye na Parike ya Zimbabwe hamwe n’ikigo gishinzwe imicungire y’ibinyabuzima. Muri filime Tariro yakinnye nka 'Serija Onai' ndetse anakora film.

Olympia, ni Ikinamico y'urukundo muri Amerika yo muri 2018 iyobowe na Gregory Dixon nk'umukinnyi wambere kandi afatanije na McKenzie Chinn, Gregory Dixon, Lucy Lola Manda na Elliott Lonsdale kumashusho 30, Isosiyete ikora umurongo wa firime. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo McKenzie Chinn mu mwanya w’icyubahiro mu gihe Charles Andrew Gardner, Ericka Ratcliff, LaNisa Renee Frederick na Penelope Walker bagize uruhare runini.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Yagaragaye bwa mbere ku ya 22 Nzeri 2018 mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Los Angeles. Hanyuma yerekanwe ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2018 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Chicago ku ya 5 Mata 2019 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya RiverRun.

Tale of Four, ni filime ngufi yo muri Amerika yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Gabourey Sidibe nk'umukinnyi we wa mbere ikanakorwa na Kia Perry, Lisa Cortes na Shannon Gibson. filimi igenda izunguruka mubagore bane batandukanye bafite inzira enye zitandukanye aho igishekeje ubuzima bwabo bwose burahura. Ishingiye ku ndirimbo ""Four Women" yaririmbwe na nyakwigendera umuririmbyi akaba n'umurwanashyaka wa politiki Nina Simone.
Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Ledisi Young, Meagan Kimberly Smith, Dana Gourrier na Aisha Hinds. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere muri Nzeri 2016 mu mujyi wa New York, muri New York hanyuma yerekanwa ku ya 25 Kamena 2017 mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Nantucket. Yatsindiye igihembo cya filimi ngufi nziza mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Urbanworld 2017.

Ben &amp; Ara, ni Filime yikinamico ya Kameruni iyobowe na Nnegest Likké ayikorana na Joseph Baird, Constance Ejuma, Q'orianka Kilcher, Matthew Norsworthy na Samone Norsworthy for Nursing Tybalt Productions, Wonder Worthy Productions na N- vision production. Filime izenguruka abakandida 2 ba PhD, umwe w’umuyisilamu wo muri Afurika undi agnostic, aho batangira gukundana nyuma yo guhurira mu nzu ndangamurage ariko nyuma bakavumbura ko urukundo hagati yimico itandukanye n’amadini rushobora kugira ingaruka.
Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Joseph Baird na Constance Ejuma mu nshingano zabo, hamwe na Akuyoe Graham, Q'orianka Kilcher, Michael Chieffo na William Mark McCullough mu nshingano zabo. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi ndetse ikanerekanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime. Yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Nzeri 2015 mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi ryigenga rya Miami. Muri 2016, film yatsindiye ibihembo byamafoto meza n’umukinnyi mwiza mu iserukiramuco rya Filime Indie. Umukinnyi w'amafirime nyamukuru Constance Ejuma yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Nevada. Muri 2016, iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime nziza ya Diaspora muri African Movie Academy Awards (AMAA).

Finding Samuel Lowe: From Harlem to China, ni film documentaire ya Jamayike 2015 iyobowe kandi ikorwa na Jeanette Kong. Filime irazenguruka uwahoze ari umuyobozi wa tereviziyo, Paula Williams Madison na bakuru be bombi; Elrick na Howard Williams bagiye gushakisha kugira ngo bamenye uko byagendekeye sekuru wabo w'abashinwa witwa Samuel Lowe, wasize nyina wabo w'umushinwa-Jamayike Nell Vera Lowe, mu myaka ya za 1930 muri Jamayike.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Igitaramo cyacyo cya mbere ku rwego rw’igihugu cyabaye ku ya 14 Gicurasi 2017, Umuyoboro w’isi wa Doc World kandi washyizwe kumurongo ku buntu guhera ku ya 15 Gicurasi - 13 Kamena 2017. Iyi filime yerekanwe ku ya 8 Gashyantare 2014 mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Afurika.

Evolutionary Blues: West Oakland's Music Legacy, ni film documentaire yo muri Amerika yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Cheryl Fabio ikaba yarakoranye numuyobozi ubwe hamwe na KTOP hamwe na Sarah Webster Fabio Centre yubutabera. Iyi filime irazenguruka umucuranzi wa West Oakland na Oakland Blues aho yasobanuye iterambere nyuma y'intambara yagize ingaruka ku Banyamerika ndetse n'umurage wabo wa muzika.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Grand Lake Theatre ku ya 27 Nzeri 2017.

Kbela, ni filime ngufi yo muri Berezile 2015 iyobowe na Yasmin Thayna ikorwa na Princeton yo muri Berezile LAB. Filime yibanze ku ivanguramoko ryinjira mu buzima bw'abagore b'abirabura muri Berezile.
Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yasohotse mu Buholandi ku ya 24 Mutarama 2019 mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime Rotterdam. Ku ya 28 Ukwakira 2019, yasohotse mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Carolina y'Amajyaruguru, muri Amerika. Muri 2017, iyi filime yahawe igihembo cyiza cya Afurika Diaspora Igihembo cya Afurika cyatanzwe na Africa Movie Academy Awards (AMAA).

The Nyakuron Cultural Centre (or NCC) ni ikigo cya leta gifite kandi kigenzurwa gishinzwe kubungabunga, guteza imbere sinema n’umuco muri Sudani yepfo.
Centre ya Nyakuron yubatswe nyuma y’amasezerano ya Addis Abeba yo mu 1972, arangiza intambara ya mbere ya Sudani. Iki kigo cyafunguwe ku mugaragaro mu 1976 kiyobowe na Abel Alier.
Uruganda runini rwarimo ubusitani bunini, ikibuga cyo hanze, inzu yimyidagaduro, club nijoro hamwe na kazino. Benshi mu minsi mikuru yumuco yaho ndetse n’amahanga ikorerwa muri santere, irimo; Iserukiramuco ryamahoro rya Hagana, Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Juba, igitaramo cya Kilkilu Ana, amarushanwa mpuzamahanga ya bokisi ndetse n’imurikagurisha. Uretse ibyo, iranakodeshwa mubikorwa byihariye nk'ubukwe.

Cheik Doukouré (wavutse 1943), ni umukinnyi wa firime wa Gineya. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa film yamamaye cyane "Le Ballon d'Or". Uretse filime, kandi ni filime screenwriter na film producer.
Yavutse mu 1943 i Kankan, muri Gineya kandi yize amashuri abanza i Conakry. Mu 1964, yavuye muri Gineya yimukira i Paris mu Bufaransa. Yarangije impamyabumenyi y’ubuvanganzo bugezweho muri kaminuza ya Sorbonne mu 1964, mu nyuguti zigezweho kandi icyarimwe muri Cours Simon hanyuma muri Konserwatori ya rue Blanche mu 1965.
Igihe yari mu Bufaransa, yatangiye umwuga we nk'umukinnyi mu ikinamico no kuri televiziyo. Mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 70, Doukouré yatangiye kwandika amashusho yatangiranye na "Bako, l'autre rive" mu 1978 hanyuma ikina umukino "uzwi cyane wa Black Mic Mac" mu 1986.
Mu 1986, yerekanye sinema ye ya mbere muri firime "Les Ripoux". Yakinnye kandi muri filime ishimwa cyane 1994 "Un indien dans la ville". Mu 1991, yerekanwe bwa mbere mu buyobozi na Blanc d'ebene ibera muri Gineya mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Mu 1993, yashinze isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa muri Gineya: 'Bako Productions'. Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yasohoye igice cye cya kabiri "Le Ballon d'Or". Filime yibanze ku muhinzi wo muri Afurika wabaye umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru. Mu 2001, yakoze firime "Les Films de l'Alliance" hamwe n'umwanditsi we Danielle Ryan.
Muri 2001, yakoze kandi akora muri "Paris selon Moussa". Mu 2003, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umugabo usobanura mu nshuro ya 18 y'iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) kubera uruhare yagize i Paris nk'uko Moussa abitangaza.

Étienne Goyémidé (22 Mutarama 1942-17 Werurwe 1997), yari umunyaCentral African w'umwanditsi w'ibikino na filimi. Azwiho kuba umwanditsi "wibitabo byamamaye cyane" "Le silence de la forêt" and "Dernier Survivant de la caravane"
Yavutse ku ya 22 Mutarama 1942 i Ippy, muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique mu muryango w'abahinzi. Kuva mu 1991 kugeza 1992, yari Minisitiri w’uburezi n’ubushakashatsi. Mu 1993, yahawe inkunga n'ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ibitabo mu Bufaransa. Nyuma yaje kugirwa Minisitiri w’uburezi hanyuma aba Ambasaderi w’icyubahiro wa UNESCO. Yabaye kandi muri Troupe des Griots mbere yo kuyobora Troupe yigihugu ya Afrika yo hagati. Goyémidé yapfuye ku ya 17 Werurwe 1997 afite imyaka 55.
Goyémidé yabonye impamyabumenyi mu bumenyi bw'uburezi kimwe na dipolome y'Icyongereza. Nyuma yaje kuba umwarimu ayoboye ishuri risanzwe ryabarimu i Bangui. Nyuma yaje gukora mu ishami ry’uburezi kandi yari umuyobozi w’icapiro. Yabaye kandi umuyobozi wa Troupe yigihugu bya Afrika yo hagati.
Mu 1984, yanditse igitabo cye kizwi cyane cyitwa "Le quiet de la forêt (Guceceka kw'ishyamba)". Iyi nkuru yibanze ku nkuru y’umukozi wa leta wo muri Afurika yo hagati uta ibintu byose ngo ajye gutembera mumashyamba ahura na pyinga pygmies. Igitabo cyaje guhuzwa na sinema mu 2003 na Didier Florent Ouénangaré na Bassek Ba Kobhio. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yari no mu gutoranya abayobozi ba Fortnight mu bayobozi ba Cannes 2003. Mu 2003, yakiriwe mu buryo budasanzwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime 2003 ryitwa Francophone de Namur (FIFF).
Hanyuma mu 1985 yanditse igitabo cyitwa "Dernier Survivant de la caravane (Umucikacumu wa nyuma wa Caravan)". Yibanze ku bucakara bw’Abanyafrika birabura bwakozwe n’abayisilamu bo muri Afurika y'Amajyaruguru aho Ngalandji avuga ikinamico y'umudugudu we mu gihugu cya Banda. Yatsinze amarushanwa ya RFI kubwinkuru ngufi nziza mururimi rwigifaransa inshuro nyinshi.

Barlen Pyamootoo (yavutse 27 Nzeri 1960), ni umwanditsi ukora na filimi wo muri Mauritius. Azwiho kuba umuyobozi wa firime "Bénarès".
Yavutse ku ya 27 Nzeri 1960 i Trou d'Eau Douce, muri Maurice nk'umwana wa gatatu mu muryango wa Tamil ufite barumuna be umunani. Igihe yari afite imyaka 12, nyina yavuye mu rugo ajya gukora mu Budage. Mu 2006, nyina yishwe na bisi igihe yabaga muri Trou d'Eau Douce.
Mu 1977, Pyamootoo yagiye muri kaminuza ya Strasbourg hamwe na se yiga igifaransa n'indimi. Hanyuma yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Diplôme d'études (DEA) mu bumenyi bw'indimi na DEA mu bumenyi bw'uburezi. Nyuma yaje kuba umwarimu w’amabaruwa mu Bufaransa kuva 1987 kugeza 1993. Mu 1995, yasubiye muri Maurice yitangira kwandika no gutangaza. Niwe washinze kandi akayobora ibigo bibiri byandika "Alma" yashinzwe mu 2005 na "L'Atelier d'écriture" yashinzwe mu 2009.
Amaze kugaruka, yanditse igitabo cye cya mbere "Bénarès". Icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 39. Hanyuma mu 2002, yanditse igitabo cye cya kabiri "Le Tour de Babilone". Muri 2008 yanditse "Salogi" icyubahiro nyina. Yatangiye kwandika igitabo gikurikira "L'île de poissons toxiques" mu 2002 hanyuma ahagarara muri 2005. Yatangiye imirimo muri 2013 nyuma asohoka muri 2017.
Mu 2005 yakoze filime ye ya mbere "Bénarès" mu rwego rwo guhuza igitabo cye gifite izina rimwe. Iyi filime ivuga ku basore babiri bazengurutse Maurice aho bahura n'abagore babiri babashimishije. Hamwe na firime, Pyamootoo abaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa firime wa Maurice wakoresheje igikerewole cya Maurice muri film.

Nasib Farah (yavutse 1981), ni umunyasomaliya uba muri danimarke. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane My COUSIN PIRATE,"Warrior from the North" and "Lost warrior". Usibye gukora amafilime, ni umunyamakuru, umusemuzi, umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro, umufasha wigisha akaba n'umugiraneza.
Yavukiye muri Somaliya mu 1981. Mu 1990 yahunze Mogadishu n'umuryango we nyuma y'intambara yo muri Somaliya. Icyakora, yabuze umuryango we igihe yarokoka hanyuma ahungira ku mupaka yerekeza muri Etiyopiya, mbere yo guhaguruka mu Budage arangije atura muri Danimarike. Ku ikubitiro yari impunzi itaraherekejwe nyuma akurira mu kigo cya Croix Rouge cyo muri Danemarike Avnstrup hafi ya Lejre.
Yashakanye n’umugore wo muri Danemarke, babyarana abana.
Yatoje nk'umucuruzi kandi akora nk'umunyamakuru wigenga imyaka mike. Nyuma yaje gushinga umuryango udaharanira inyungu wibanda ku gufasha abandi basore bo muri Somaliya binyuze mu kwigisha no nyuma y’ishuri. Yifashishije iryo shyirahamwe kugira ngo agaragaze ibyamubayeho, Farah yatangije gahunda ya tereviziyo y'abaturage yitwa 'Qaran TV' ku baturage ba Somaliya muri Danimarike.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Farah yagize uruhare runini muri filime My COUSIN PIRATE, iyobowe na Christian Sønderby Jepsen. Icyakora buri gihe yakeneraga gukora nk'umuyobozi aho kuba umukinnyi.
Muri 2015, yakoze "filime yambere ya Warriors kuva mumajyaruguru". Yamamaye cyane kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Muri 2018, yayoboye documentaire ya kabiri "Lost Warrior ari" kumwe n'umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Danemarike Søren Steen Jespersen

Leroy Gopal (yavutse 6 Nyakanga 1979), ni umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka muri Zimbabwe na afurika y'Epfo, akina komedii kandi ni umuhanzi ijwi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Yellow Card" and "Strike Back".
Yavutse ku ya 6 Nyakanga 1979 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Igihe Gopal yari afite imyaka 14, se yarapfuye. Afite mukuru we, Claudia Gopal Muvuti wahoze ari nyiricyubahiro Zimbabwe.. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Blackiston hanyuma ayiga ayisumbuye mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Gateway na Prince Edward Senior School. Afite impamyabumenyi ya BA (Icyubahiro) muri Live Performance na Motion Picture kuva AFDA, Ishuri ryubukungu bwo guhanga. Ni umwe mu banyeshuri babiri batsindiye igihembo cyiza cya M-NET Umunyeshuri Wumwaka 2003 na 2004 bikurikiranye. Gopal yashakanye n'umukobwa wo muri Afurika y'Epfo, Keletso Molefe kuva 2017. Abashakanye bafite abana batatu: Kiki Leroy Gopal, Didi Tadiwa, na Mimi Naima.
Mu 2000, yerekanye sinema ye ya mbere hamwe na firime "Yellow Card" aho yakinnye cyane nkumukinnyi wumupira wamaguru 'Tiyane Tsumba'. Kuva mu 2006 kugeza 2007, yakinnye 'Thabang Ngema' mu ikinamico ya SABC 3 "One Way" yamenyekanye cyane. Muri 2012, yagaragaye muri sitcom ya SABC 1 ", Ses'Top La" muburyo bwa 'Oleshe'. Muri 2013, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu gukina urwenya muri Afurika yepfo wa Filime kuri uru ruhare. Hamwe nitsinzi kandi agaragara nkumukinnyi wabishoboye, yahawe akazi ko gukina "serivise za Mzansi Rukundo: Kasi Style" muri 2013. Uruhare rwe ni umugabo wo muri Kenya witwa 'Joshua Pembe'. Yakinnye kandi muri make "Binyuze mu Guhaguruka kw'ibaba" ryerekanwe no mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes.
Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri filime "Seal Team 8" nk'umunyagitugu wa Tongo 'Tonga'. Hanyuma yagaragaye kuri "serivise ya Mzansi Magic" hamwe na 'Abomama' yaje kuba umuntu uzwi cyane murukurikirane. Muri 2014, yakinnye muri politiki ya SABC1 "Ihawu le Sizwe". Nyuma yaje gushinga 'Creation Station Entertainment Company'. Leroy yayoboye kandi amashusho yindirimbo Zimbabwe kumuririmbyi Audius Mtawarira.

Paul Marcel Berenger (yavutse ku ya 26 Werurwe 1991), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Ositaraliya wavukiye muri Zimbabwe.
Berenger yavutse ku ya 26 Werurwe 1991 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Ariko rero, yahatiwe kwimukira muri Ositaraliya.
Afite imyaka 11, yagize ishyaka nyuma yo kubona mukuru we kuri stage akina ishuri ryibanze. Ariko, yatangiye gukina igihe yimukiye muri Ositaraliya. Berenger yagaragaye bwa mbere muri sinema hamwe na film ya 2008 "Two Fists, One Heart.". Nyuma yaje gukina muri firime ngufi nka "Brittany", "Die Krankenhaus", "The Army Within" and "Impasse".

Christopher Hoffman (yavutse 15 Gashyantare 1981), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Zimbabwe akaba numuhanzi uzwi. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri filime "Lions for Lambs", "Molly's Game" and "Saints &amp; Sinners".
Yavutse ku ya 15 Gashyantare 1981 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Afite musaza we w'impanga, Matt Hoffman.

Tomas Lutuli Brickhill (yavutse ku ya 25 Werurwe 1978), ni umukinnyi wa firime, umwanditsi, akaba n'umucuranzi muri Zimbabwe. Yayoboye filime yamenyekanye cyane muri 2017 muri "Cook Off".
Yavutse ku ya 25 Werurwe 1978 i Londere mu Bwongereza. Se, Paul Brickhill yahoze ari umusirikare wa Zimbabwe (ZIPRA) akaba n'umuvuzi w'abasirikare. Kubera iyo mpamvu, yari mu buhungiro mu Bwongereza icyo gihe Tomas yavutse. Ariko, nyuma gato y'ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe, umuryango wasubiye muri Zimbabwe. Nyuma yo kugaruka, ise yayoboye ibihangano n’umuco byiswe 'The Book Café'. Se amaze gupfa muri 2014, Tomas ayoboye Café. Afite abavandimwe batatu: Liam, Amy na Declan. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Prince Edward, Harare kuva 1991 kugeza 1996.
Yavuye muri Zimbabwe mu 1997 yimukira mu Bwongereza maze yiga muri Surrey Institute of Art ; Design, Ishuri Rikuru rya Kaminuza mu 1999. Yize Filime nyuma akora imirimo itandukanye agerageza kunguka ubumenyi butandukanye muri Surrey arangiza na Bachelor of Arts (BA) muri Cinematography na Film / Video Production muri 2001. Hanyuma yigishije amasomo ya firime ya Raindance Film Festival, BBC na VMI imyaka mike.
Yatunze kandi Paw Paw Jam Productions, isosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’umuziki nyafurika ndetse no gufata amashusho mu Bwongereza. Usibye sinema, ni n'umucuranzi aherekejwe n'itsinda 'Chikwata'.

Maggie Lloyd Williams (wavutse 1975), ni umukinnyi wa filime wa Zimbabwe akaba n'umwanditsi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serivise za tereviziyo nka"Silent Witness", "Secret Diary of a Call Girl", "" and "The Low Down".
Yavutse mu 1975 i Masvingo, muri Zimbabwe.

Kevin Hanssen, ni umukinnyi wa firime Zimbabwe, umwanditsi akaba n'umucuranzi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Mind Games", "Mugabe" na "The Telling Room".
Mu 1994, yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Arts muri UNISA, Afurika y'Epfo. Ni n'umunyamuryango washinze Over The Edge Theatre Company. Yakinnye mu ikinamico 'A Man Like You' yakinwe mu makinamico menshi ya Zimbabwe.
Yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mu minsi mikuru mpuzamahanga.

Mame Bineta Sane (yavutse 3 Gashyantare 2000), uzwi nka Mama Sané, ni fumukinnyi wa firime muri Senegal. Azwi cyane ku ruhare nka 'Ada' muri filime y’ikinamico ndengakamere ya "Atlantika".
Yakuriye i Thiaroye, mu nkengero za Dakar, muri Senegali. Ntabwo yize amashuri asanzwe ku ishuri. Yatangiye gukora akazi ko kudoda muri Thiaroye.
Ntabwo yigeze akina ikinamico iyo ari yo yose mbere ubwo yatoranyirizwagamo uruhare muri firime ya "Atlantika ya" 2019 iyobowe na Mati Diop nka firime ye ya mbere. Sane ntabwo yigeze yiga kwishuri mugihe Diop yamutumiriye gukina. Muri iyo filime, Sane yakinnye cyane 'Ada', uhigwa bukware n'umukunzi we, Souleiman, hamwe n'ubwato bw'abandi basore, yabuze mu nyanja.
Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu murwa mukuru wa Dakar mbere yuko isohoka muri Senegali. Filime yari ifite ibitekerezo byiza cyane kubayinenga kandi yerekanwe mubirori byinshi bya firime. Filime yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2019. Ku bw'uruhare rwe, nyuma Sane yahawe igihembo cya César ku bakinnyi benshi basezerana mu bihembo bya César 2020 ndetse anahatanira igihembo cya Lumières ku bakinnyi benshi basezerana mu bihembo bya Lumières 2020 ndetse no mu bihembo bya Black Reel ku bagore. Ibikorwa Byiza Byagezweho muri Black Reel Awards ya 2020.

Amadou Mbow, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Senegal. Azwi cyane ku ruhare nka 'Issa' muri filime y’ikinamico ndengakamere "Atlantics". Usibye kuba umukinnyi, anashushanya ibishushanyo mbonera kandi akunda amafoto.
Yavukiye kandi akurira i Dakar, muri Senegali.
Umuhungu wumucuzi wa Senegali ukomoka muri Fulani ukomoka i Futa, Amadou Mbow numuhungu wa nyina na murumuna wa bashiki be batatu. Mu myaka ye y'ubwangavu, basketball yari ifite umwanya wingenzi mubuzima bwe. Nyuma yimyaka itari mike akora imyitozo muri DUC (Dakar University Club) imwemerera kongera ubumenyi, reaction ndetse no kwiyemeza. Amaherezo yahisemo kureka siporo kugirango arusheho gushimishwa nisi yerekana amajwi yimenyereza nkumuntu wiyigisha.
Muri 2019, Mbow yatoranijwe muri firime "Atlantics" iyobowe na Mati Diop nka firime ye ya mbere. Muri iyo filime, yakinnye nk'umupolisi ukiri muto 'Issa' woherejwe gukora iperereza ku muriro udasanzwe utwika mu buriri bwa Ada mu ijoro ry'ubukwe bwe. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu murwa mukuru wa Dakar mbere yuko isohoka muri Senegali. Filime yari ifite ibitekerezo byiza cyane kubayinenga kandi yerekanwe mubirori byinshi bya firime. Filime yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2019. Muri 2020, Amadou Mbow yatoranijwe muri Césars 2020 mubyiciro bya "Ibyahishuwe".

Diankou Sembene, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Sénégalese. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare nka 'Mr Ndiaye 'muri firime yikinamico yurukundo ndengakamere "Atlantics".
Muri 2019, Sembene yatoranijwe muri firime "Atlantics" iyobowe na Mati Diop nka firime ye ya mbere. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu murwa mukuru wa Dakar mbere yuko isohoka muri Senegali. Filime yari ifite ibitekerezo byiza cyane kubayinenga kandi yerekanwe mubirori byinshi bya firime. Filime yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2019. Nyuma neza filimi, yakoze mu televiziyo serial "ZeroZeroZero" na filimi ngufi "ruswa""."

Isaac Godfrey Geoffrey Nabwana, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Nabwana IGG, ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Uganda akaba na producer. Uwashinze studio ya firime Wakaliwood, Nabwana azwi cyane kubera urugomo rwubusa muri film ye. Nabwana yatangiye kwamamara nyuma yo kohereza trailer ya film ye Who Killed Captain Alex? kuri YouTube muri 2010 hanyuma nyuma ya firime nyirizina muri 2015. Filime yabonye umwanya wo gusenga none yicaye kuri miliyoni 6.4 kuri YouTube.
Nabwana yavukiye muri Uganda ku ngoma ya Idi Amin mu 1973. Mu ntambara yo muri Uganda Bush, bivugwa ko we na murumuna we birukanywe na kajugujugu. Iyi kajugujugu irashobora kugaragara muri Who Killed Captain Alex?.
Nkuko atari yarigeze aba mu ikinamico, yishingikirizaga ahanini kuri barumuna be n'inshuti ibisobanuro bya firime zasohotse mu ikinamico. Yagiye mu masomo yo gusana mudasobwa, ariko ahatirwa kureka ishuri nyuma yukwezi kwa mbere kubera kubura amafaranga. Kubwibyo, yatangiye kwiga gukora firime nibice byayo muburyo bwo kwigira wenyine hamwe nubunararibonye bwe bwo kugerageza-kwibeshya hamwe na kamera nibikoresho byo gutunganya. Afite imyaka 32, yatangiye gukina film nkumwuga. Mu 2005, Nabwana yashinze Ramon Film Productions: izina ryakomotse kuri nyirakuru, Rachel na Monica, nyuma rizwi ku izina rya Wakaliwood.
Ibikorwa bye bya firime bishingiye murugo rwe aho yatangiye gukora no gufata amashusho yindirimbo kuva 2009. Ramon Production yitabiriye firime zirenga 44. Zimwe muri firime zizwi zakozwe na Ramon Productions Who Killed Captain Alex?,Bad Black, na "Tebaatusasula". Filime "Who Killed Captain Alex?" izwi nka firime yambere yuzuye ibikorwa muri cinema ya Uganda.
Igihe Alan Hofmanis, umuyobozi mukuru mu iserukiramuco rya firime rifite icyicaro mu mujyi wa New York, yagiye muri Uganda, yahuye na Nabwana maze asaba ko yakora documentaire kuri Ramon Film Productions, Hofmanis kuva ubwo yimukira muri Uganda kugira ngo afashe kumenyekanisha sinema ya Wakaliwood ku isi. Yahawe kandi gukina filime ya "Bad Black mu" mwaka wa 2016 Nabwana kandi yiswe "umukinnyi wa mbere wa filime wa Mzungu Uganda."
Nabwana yatsindiye ibihembo 6
Uburyo bwo gufata amashusho hamwe ninsanganyamatsiko.
Nabwana yafashe amashusho ye mu Luganda, imvugo ya Baganda, ubwoko bunini bwa Uganda. Nabwana azwiho ibikorwa nubugizi bwa nabi bivanze no gusetsa muri film ye. Afata ibyemezo muri firime ye bikabije bigizwe ahanini no kurwanisha imbunda Kung-fu nubuhanzi bwintambara. Nabwana afite kandi ibihangano bye yise 'Video Joker' (cyangwa VJ muri make) kugirango atange ibisobanuro kuri firime aho avuga urwenya no gutaka amagambo adasanzwe. Iyi mico yagaragaye muri firime zose za Nabwana.

Rokhaya Niang, numukinnyi wa Sénégalese. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwamamaye muri firime "Le prix du pardon", "L'Extraordinaire destin de Madame Brouette" na "Teranga Blues".
Mu 2001, Niang yatangiye sinema ye ya mbere akina na film "Le prix du pardon" iyobowe na Mansour Sora Wade. Intsinzi ya firime, yatoranijwe muri film "L'Extraordinaire destin de Madame Brouette" mu 2002. Filime zombi zatoranijwe mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican ya Ouagadougou (FESPACO) mu 2003. Icyakora, filime yakunzwe cyane ya sinema yaje binyuze muri firime ya "Teranga Blues yo" mu 2007 iyobowe na Moussa Sene Absa ubwo yakinaga nka 'Rokhaya'.

Maïmouna Gueye Fall, ni Umukinnyi wa filimi muri Sénégalese. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Climb", "Payoff, Cuties," "Bacon kuruhande".
Nyuma yo gushyingiranwa n’umugabo w’umufaransa, yagiye mu Bufaransa mu 1998. Ariko, nyuma y'amezi make, yahukanye nyuma yo guhura n'ivanguramoko n'umugabo. Nyuma yo gutandukana, yimukiye i Paris.
Gueye yatangiye gukina umwuga wo gukina akina na Sophocles "Antigone" iyobowe n'umwanditsi wa Haiti, Gérard Chenet. Mu 2004, yakinnye mu kindi gikinisho, guhuza Igifaransa na Monologues "du vagin" izwi cyane na Eve Ensler. Nyuma yaje kwimukira mu ikinamico maze akora amakinamico azwi cyane, "Souvenirs de la dame en noir" and "She is black, but she is beautiful"
Nyuma yo gukina amakinamico menshi, amaherezo yaje kugaragara muri sinema afite uruhare rwa mbere muri filime "Payoff" mu 2003. Nyuma yaje kugira uruhare runini muri film "Touristes?Oh yes!" iyobowe na Jean-Pierre Mocky mu 2004.
Niwe washinze 'Afrokids', club yimyidagaduro y'abana itanga amarangi, gusoma, kubyina, kuvuga inkuru, n'amahugurwa ya DIY.

Moussa Touré (wavutse 1958), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Sénégalese. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "zizwi cyane Toubab Bi", "TGV" na "La Pirogue". Usibye icyerekezo, ni umutekinisiye, umwanditsi, producer n'umukinnyi.
Touré yavutse 1958 i Dakar, muri Senegali.
Yatangiye umwuga wa sinema nkumutekinisiye. Hanyuma mu 1987, yerekeje kuri firime akoresheje firime ngufi maze ashinga uruganda rwe bwite rwitwa 'Les Films du Crocodile'. Mu 1991, Touré yakoze filime ye ya mbere yerekana "Toubab Bi". yahawe ibihembo muri Cannes Film Festival. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa mbere, yakoze film ye ya kabiri "TGV" mu 1998 abifashijwemo na Makéna Diop. Nyuma mu 1999, filime yegukanye igihembo cyabaterankunga mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 9 rya Afurika.
Mu 1996, yagize uruhare runini muri filime "Les Caprices d'un rivière" iyobowe na Bernard Giraudeau. Muri 2005, yakoze documentaire "5x5" yakiriwe neza. Muri 2011, Touré yagizwe Umuyobozi w'Inteko y'abacamanza mu 2011 Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican rya Ouagadougou (FESPACO). Hanyuma muri 2012, yayoboye filime ye ya gatatu yerekana "La Pirogue", filime yerekana igice. Filime yafashwe amashusho kandi ihindurwa hifashishijwe imikorere ya Hollywood. Muri 2020, yayoboye filime "Red Dust" ikorwa na Luxembourgish yambaye imyenda ya BAHN na Dakar ikorera mu nzu itunganyirizwamo 'Les Films du Crocodile'. Filime izasohoka mu 2022.

Samba Félix N'diaye (6 Werurwe 1945–6 Ugushyingo 2009), yari umukinnyi wa firime wa Sénégalese. Imwe mu nkingi za mbere mu nganda za sinema zo muri Senegali, Ndiaye afatwa nka se wa documentaire nyafurika. Yakoze Documentaire zamamaye cyane "Trésors des poubelles", "Ngor, l'esprit des lieux", "Les malles" na "Geti Tey". Usibye icyerekezo, ni umwanditsi akaba n'umukinnyi wa sinema.
Ndiaye yavutse ku ya 6 Werurwe 1945 i Dakar, muri Senegali. Yahoraga yitabira club ya firime yikigo ndangamuco cyabafaransa i Dakar yabikoraga akamenyero. Nyuma yaje kwiga amategeko nubukungu muri kaminuza ya Dakar. Nyuma yize muri kaminuza ya Paris VIII ahabwa Masters muri Sinema na Audiovisual Studies. Hanyuma yifatanije na Institut Lumière kwiga cinematografi no gutunganya. Yapfuye ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2009 i Dakar afite imyaka 64 azize ibibazo bya malariya yo mu bwonko. Nyuma yaje gushyingurwa mu irimbi rya Yoff.
Mu 1974, yayoboye documentaire ye ya mbere "yitwa Perantal", mu rwego rwo kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri sinema. Mu 1978, yakoze "Geti Tey" ngufi yaganiriye ku ngorane abarobyi b'abanyabukorikori bahuye na Kayar, Hann cyangwa Soumbédioune ibikorwa byabo bibangamiwe n'uburobyi. Nyuma yibyo, Ndiaye yakoze urukurikirane rwa firime eshanu ngufi ziteranijwe ku mutwe wa "Trésors des poubelles" mu 1989. Muri uwo mwaka, yakoze "Aqua" ngufi, "metonymy yo mumijyi" itagira amagambo.
Mu 1994, Ndiaye yakoze filime ye ya mbere ya "Ngor, l'esprit des lieux" ivuga ku baturage ba Ngor, umudugudu uherereye mu nkengero za Dakar. Kuva mu mpera za 1990, ahanini yari ahangayikishijwe na documentaire zishingiye kuri politiki maze akora "Lettre à Senghor" mu 1998. Nkumwanditsi, yanditse documentaire yu "Rwanda, pour mémoire" yibanze kuri jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Muri 2007 mumyaka ye ya nyuma, Ndiaye yakoze documentaire "Ibibazo à la terre natale". Muri 2012, yatsindiye igihembo mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cordoba kubera filime ye "Trésors des poubelles".

Mathew Nabwiso, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Uganda. Nabwiso azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Imbabazi", "Rain" and "Kyaddala". Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi, umuyobozi na producer.
Yavutse nkumwana wa karindwi wumuryango urimo abavandimwe cumi n'umwe. Ababyeyi be bahoze ari abadepite Frank Nabwiso na Mama Christine Nabwiso wa Jinja. Yize amashuri abanza ya Mwiri na Kamuli Boys kumashuri abanza. Nyuma yize muri Busoga College, Mwiri kuri O-level nyuma yiga muri Namasagali College, i Kamuli. Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu kwamamaza muri Kupuro Institute of Marketing. Mbere yo kwinjira mu gukina, yari afite akazi k'igihe cyose nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe kugurisha isosiyete ikora ICT. Ariko yaretse akazi kugira ngo akore umwuga binyuze muri sinema. Yashakanye na mugenzi we bakinana, Eleanor Nabwiso wanakinnye muri serivise za "The Hostel". Abashakanye bafite abana bane.
Muri 2006, yakoze sinema yumukobwa akina na firime "Battle of the Souls".Muri 2011, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba filimi "The Hostel" yanyuze kuri NTV Uganda, ikundwa cyane. Nyuma yo gusoza uruhererekane, yashinze isosiyete ikora firime 'Nabwiso Films'.Muri 2013, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Afurika Magic Viewers 'Choice Awards (AMVCA), kubera filime "A Good Catholic Girl". Nyuma muri 2016, yatorewe umwanya wa 'Dumba' muri film "Imvura" muri AMVCA. Muri 2020, yahawe igihembo cya Film Act muri Vine Awards kubera uruhare yagize muri sinema ya Uganda.

Arnold Oceng, rimwe na rimwe uzwi ku izina rya Snakeyman, (yavutse ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 1985), ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka mu Bwongereza no gihugu cya Uganda. Oceng azwi kunshingano muri "Grange Hill," "Adulthood" na "Brotherhood""."
Yavutse ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 1985. Mu 1986, igihe yari afite umwaka umwe, umuryango we wimukiye i Brixton, mu majyepfo ya Londere nk'impunzi.
Yatangiye gukina afite imyaka 6 nkumuhanzi wabana. Muri iryo shuri, yakinnye nka 'King Herod' mu ikinamico ku ishuri ribanza rya Kiliziya Gatolika ya Corpus Christi ku musozi wa Brixton. Mu 1999, yatangiye gukina bwa mbere nk'umuhanzi w'umwana afite uruhare rwa 'Calvin Braithwaite' mu bice 73 bya filimi y'abana ba televiziyo ya "Grange Hill". Urukurikirane rwakunzwe cyane kandi rwarakomeje kugeza 2004. Kuva icyo gihe yakinnye mu ruhare ruto rwo gushyigikira muri tereviziyo nyinshi zirimo, "Casualty", "The Bill" na "Sold". Oceng yerekanye sinema ye ya mbere muri 2008 "Abakuze". Nyuma yaje gukurikira afite uruhare runini muri firime zigenga zo mu Bwongereza, "4.3.2.1." na "My Brother The Devil"
Muri 2014, yakinnye na Reese Witherspoon muri filime The Good Lie, ibaye umwanya we wa mbere muri Hollywood. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yakinnye nka 'Charles' muri filime "A United Kingdom" yari afite umwanya wa mbere muri BFI London Festival Festival. Hanyuma yakinnye muri biopic yo muri Danemarike "The Greatest Man" yerekanwe muri 2016. Muri uwo mwaka, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba filime '. Muri 2017, yatorewe igihembo cy’umugabo witwaye neza muri Filime muri Screen Nation Film na Televiziyo Awards yabereye muri hoteri ya Park Plaza London Riverbank ku ya 7 Gicurasi 2017. Muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi muri National Film Awards UK kubera uruhare yagize muri '

Sam Bagenda uzwi cyane ku izina ry'ubuhanzi Dr. Bbosa, (yavutse ku ya 31 Werurwe 1965), ni umukinnyi w'icyamamare akaba n'umuririmbyi wa Uganda. Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuririmbyi, Bagenda yaje kuba umukinnyi wamamaye, uzwi cyane kubera uruhare muri Malayalam Movie "Escape from Uganda" and film "That's Life Mwattu". Hagati aho, Bagenda yatorewe kandi kuba umukinnyi wa Uganda w'ikinyagihumbi mu 2000.
Bagenda yatangiye kuririmba muri Korali Itorero Anglican Itorero rya Mutagatifu Pawulo i Mulago akiri muto. Ariko, umupadiri wa paruwasi amaze kumwirukana muri iryo torero, yaje kwifatanya nabandi banyamuryango bo muri korari yitorero maze ashinga korari Ivanjili "Sun Rose-85" mu 1985. Ukuboza 1986, yinjiye bwa mbere muri The Ebonies akomeza gukora nk'umuririmbyi wijwi ryimbitse, ari kumwe na nyakwigendera Jimmy Katumba, baririmbye mu minsi mikuru myinshi nyuma baza gukora ballad ikunzwe cyane "Twalina omukwano neguf". Igitaramo cye cya mbere gikomeye cyabaye muri Mutarama 1987 ubwo hafungurwaga ikinamico ya Bat Valley.
Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere nka 'padiri' mu ikinamico ya "Dollar". Igihe yari ageze ku rwego rwo gukundwa cyane nk'umuririmbyi, yahuye n'umwanditsi w'amakinamico n'umuyobozi, JWK Ssembajwe. Mu 1993, yakinnye 'Dr. Sam Bbosa 'muri "seri izwi cyane za Uganda That's Life Mwattu". Yabaye icyamamare mu bitangazamakuru nyuma yuruhererekane, aho bakunze kwita 'Dr. Bbosa 'mubaturage.

Owas Ray Mwape, ni umukinnyi wa firime wa Zambiya, ni umukinnyi akaba n'umwanditsi. Umukinnyi wa firime ufite ubuhanga bukomeye, Mwape yatangiye umwuga we nkumukinnyi kandi azwi cyane mubikorwa bya Mwansa the Great", "" and "Fever
Yavukiye i Ndola. Yabanje gushyingiranwa n'umunyamuziki w'indirimbo uzwi cyane wo muri Zambiya, Saboi Imboela. Nyuma baje gutandukana aho Imboela yerekanye ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu ngo rya Owas. Icyakora, nyuma Owas yahakanye ibirego n'ibihuha bitari byo kuri we na Imboela.
Mwape yatsindiye ibihembo by'igihugu byumukinnyi witwaye neza mumyaka itatu ikurikiranye ya 1990, 1991 na 1992, abaye umunya Zambiya wenyine wageze kuriyi ntsinzi kugeza ubu. Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere kuri filimi "Kabanana" kuva 2004 kugeza 2008. Nyuma yaje gukina filime nyinshi hamwe na serial nka "The Lawyer", "Redbag", "Complicated Affairs", "Justice at Stake", "The Wife", "Mwansa the Great", "Chidongo", "The ticket", "A beautiful Lie" and "Guilt".. Muri 2013, yashinze sosiyete ye bwite itunganya filimi 'Owas Films' maze ahindukira akora amashusho yigihe cyose. Muri 2015, yayoboye filime ebyiri "Chenda" na "Secrets Untold" aho iyi ifite premier yayo muri Ster Kinekor i Lusaka.

Becky Ngoma, ni umukinnyi wa filime wa Zambiya akaba n'umwanditsi. Umukinnyi wa firime, Mwape yatangiye umwuga we nk'umukinnyi kandi azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri "Mwansa the Great", "I Am Not A Witch" and "Temzu Town". Usibye gukina, ni umuyobozi na producer.
She was born in Lusaka, Zambia. She is a graduate of TV production at Zambia Institute of Mass Communication (ZAMCOM).
"Yakoze nk'umukinnyi w'amafirime" n'umwanditsi mu biganiro byinshi bya televiziyo 'nka, Kabanana, Ikinamico ya mbere muri Zambiya na "Love Games na Fever" ndetse no muri firime, "Suwi" na "Mwansa the Great"".". Hagati aho, yakoraga kuri opera ikunzwe cyane yo muri Afrika yepfo,"Generations". Ni n'umwanditsi wa seri izwi cyane "Zuba", telenovela ya mbere muri Zambiya, yerekana kuri Zambezi Magic. Yakinnye kandi muri filime ashimwa cyane kuri "I Am Not a Witch" yabaye filime yatsindiye BAFTA afite uruhare 'Bwalya'.
Yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi kubuhanga bwe bwo kwandika-kwandika nka; Igihembo cya Filime, Televiziyo na Radiyo Zambiya 2014 (Zafta) igihembo cy’umwanditsi mwiza, igihembo cya Zafta cya 2016 kuri filimi nziza, na 2018 ibihembo by’abagore bo muri Zambiya ku mugore w’umwaka.

Carlos Miguel V. Conceição (yavutse 5 Kanama 1979), ni Umukinnyi wa firime ukomoka muri porutigali wavukiye muri Angola. Conceição azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "Goodnight Cinderella", "Serpentarius" na "Bad Bunny". Usibye kuyobora, ni numuproducer, umwanditsi wamashusho hamwe nuwashushanyije amajwi.
Yavutse ku ya 5 Kanama 1979 muri Angola. Mu 2002, yabonye impamyabumenyi mu Cyongereza, afite ubuhanga mu buvanganzo bwa Romantike. Nyuma yaje kubona indi mpamyabumenyi, kuri iyi nshuro muri sinema, mu ishuri rya Theatre na Lisbonne mu 2006.
Yatangiye umwuga mu 2005 nka videwo yindirimbo nuwatunganya amashusho y'ubuhanzi. Muri 2013, yakoze "Versailles" ngufi, yari mu marushanwa muri Lokarno Festival, Curtas Vila do Conde na Mar Del Plata Festivals. Filime ye ya "Goodnight Cinderella" 2014 yagaragaye bwa mbere mucyumweru cya Critics ' Festival ya Cannes. Muri 2017, filime ye "Bad Bunny" yongeye kugaragara i Cannes.

Mukakarangwa Clotilde (yavutse 1 Mutarama 1966) ni umugore akaba umunyarwandakazi, ubarizwa mu ishyaka rya Parti Democrate Centriste (PDC). Ku wa 24 Nzeri 2020 nibwo Ihuriro ry’Igihugu ry’Imitwe ya Politiki mu Rwanda ryatoreye Hon. Mukakarangwa Clotilde kwinjira mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Umutwe wa Sena asimbuye umwe muri babiri bari basoje manda yabo.
Mukakarangwa Clotilde afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'ikiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza muri siyansi.
MUKAKARANGWA Clotilde ubu ni umusenateri akaba na visi perezida w'akomisiyo w'ububanyi n'amahanga, ubufatanye n'umutekano muri sena yu rwanda.

Uwimanimpaye Jeanne d'arc (yavutse 1978) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Yabaye umunyamuryango w’Umutwe w’abadepite kuva mu 2008. Kuva mu 2013 kugeza 2018, yabaye Visi Perezida w’Umutwe.
Uwimanimpaye Jeanne d'Arc yarangije muri Economics muri kaminuza nkuru yu Rwanda. Mbere yo kwinjira mu Nteko, yakoraga nk'umwarimu w’ishuri ryisumbuye, ndetse no mu nzego z'ibanze nk'umugenzuzi w'imbere mu karere akaba n'umukozi ushinzwe imibanire rusange.
Uwimanimpaye yinjiye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko mu matora y’abadepite yo mu Rwanda mu 2008, nk'umwe mu bahagarariye abagore batandatu mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yagiye mu Bwongereza nk'indorerezi y'amatora ya Commonwealth ku matora rusange yo mu Bwongereza 2010.Mu matora y’abadepite 2013, Uwimanimpaye yasubijwe mu mutwe w’abadepite nk'uhagarariye abagore mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Mu Kwakira 2013, yatorewe kuba Visi Perezida wungirije ushinzwe kugenzura no gushyiraho amategeko, ahabwa amajwi 70 kuri 80. Nk’Umuvugizi wungirije, yerekanye icyifuzo cyo kwemerera Perezida Kagame kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu, nyuma y’uko icyifuzo cyari kimaze gusinywa miliyoni 3.8
Abasaba barashimira perezida Kagame kuba yarahagaritse itsembabwoko no kuzamura ubukungu vuba
Uwimanimpaye yatoranijwe nk'umukandida wa FPR-Inkotanyi mu matora y'abadepite yo mu 2018, atorerwa guhagararira Akarere ka Gatsibo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Yeguye ku mwanya wa Perezida wungirije, asimburwa na Edda Mukabagwiza wa FPR-Inkotanyi. Muri Nzeri 2019, Uwimanimpaye yasabye ko hakorwa iperereza ku kibazo cy’amafaranga cyerekeranye n’amasoko yatanzwe n’ikigo cy’ubuhinzi cy’u Rwanda, kandi anenga amasoko yatanzwe n’ikigo cy’amakoperative y’u Rwanda.

Gangbé! ni film ya documentaire yumuziki yo muri Bénine 2018 iyobowe na Arnaud Robert kandi yakozwe na Aline Schmid kuri Intermezzo Films.
Iyi filime ishingiye ku rugendo rwa Gangbé Brass Band, itsinda ry’umuziki rigizwe n’abanyamuryango 10 bo muri Bénine ryitwaye neza hamwe na jùjú yo muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba ndetse n’umuziki gakondo wa Vodou hamwe n’iburengerazuba bwa jazz hamwe n’amajwi manini, mu nzira ijya i Lagos kugira ngo bakore hamwe na Femi Kuti kuri Shrine. Filime yakiriwe neza nabayireba.

Sara Lalama (yavutse 14 Gashyantare 1993), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Aligeriya. Yagize uruhare muri "seri za" televiziyo Masha'er, "Le rendez-vous" na "Hob Fi Kafas El Itiham".
Yavutse ku ya 14 Gashyantare 1993 i Constantine, muri Aligeriya.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Theatre y'Ubufaransa. Yatojwe sinema muri Toulon Regional Conservatory (Ecole De Musique Toulon Initiation), mu Bufaransa imyaka ine. Muri 2013, yakinnye filime ya mbere muri mu ikinamico "Asrar el madi" yerekanwe kuri Aligeriya 3. Amaze gutsinda muri serial, yatumiriwe gukina urukurikirane "rwurwenya, La classe" muri 2014. Muri serial, yakinnye nka 'Nourhane'. Hanyuma muri 2015, Lalama yakinnye cyane 'Yasmine' muri "seri ya televiziyo Hob Fi Kafas El Itiham" iyobowe na Bachir Sellami.
Muri 2016, yakinnye bwa mbere muri sinema 'Nedjma' hamwe na film "El boughi". Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye nka 'Quamar', muri "ikinamico Qoloub Tahta Ramad" iyobowe na Bachir Sellami. Muri 2017, yakinnye muri serial "Samt El Abriyaa". Kuva mu 2019, yagaragaye ku ikinamico "Masha'er yatangajwe" muri Aligeriya na Tuniziya. Muri uwo mwaka, yitabiriye umukino wo "kwidagadura wo muri Alijeriya witwa Chiche Atahaddak".

Brahim Haggiag (1934–1997), yari umukinnyi wa filimi muri Alijeriya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri filime "Intambara ya Algiers", "Patrouille à l'Est" na "L'opium et le baton".
Mu 1966, yatangiye gukina umukino wa mbere afite imiterere ya ' Ali La Pointe ' muri filime "Intambara ya Algiers" iyobowe na Gillo Pontecorvo. Filime yabaye icyamamare muri uwo mwaka maze Haggiag atoranywa muri filime "L'opium et le baton", "Les hors-la-loi" na "Chronicle of the Year of Fire".

In Search Of Voodoo: Roots To Heaven ni film ya documentaire ya biografiya yo muri Bénine 2018 iyobowe numukinnyi wamamaye wa Hollywood uzwi cyane Djimon Hounsou kandi afatanije numuyobozi ubwe hamwe na Eric McGaw.
Iyi filime ishingiye ku bintu byabayeho mu buzima bwumukinnyi Djimon Hounsou kandi yibanda ku nkuru z’umuntu ku giti cye, umuco, ndetse n’umwuka za Voodoo, muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba. Filime yakiriwe neza nabayireba.

Souhila Mallem (yavutse ku ya 13 Kamena 1988), bakunze kwita Bibicha, ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Alijeriya.
Yavutse ku ya 13 Kamena 1988 i Algiers, Alijeriya. Yize amategeko mu ishami ry'amategeko muri kaminuza ya Algiers 1.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakiriye porogaramu yatewe inkunga na 'Cevital group' yo gushyigikira ikipe y'igihugu ya Alijeriya isakaza umuyoboro wa ENTV. Muri iki gitaramo, yabonywe n’umuyobozi Djafar Gassem, nyuma atanga uruhare muriserial "Djemai family 1" nka 'Faty'. Hanyuma yakinnye muri serial "Dar Bahdja" nka 'Zina'. Nyamara gukina filimi yakunzwe cyane byaje mu ruhare rwa 'Bibicha' muri serial izwi cyane ya "Bibiche na Bibicha". Nyuma yaje gukina nka 'Princess Abla' muri serial "Sultan Achour 10" nizindi nshingano nka 'Sabrina' muri serial "El Khawa" ndetse na 'Lila' muri sitcom "Wlad Hlal".

Merouane Guerouabi (yavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1989), bakunze kwita Bibich, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Alijeriya akaba n'umunyarwenya.
Yavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1989 i Algiers, Alijeriya. Se El Hachemi Guerouabi yari umuririmbyi wo muri Alijeriya akaba n'uwahimbye Chaâbi akaba n'umwe mu ba Masters bakuru b'umuziki wa Chaâbi ukomoka muri Alijeriya. Mbere yo gukina, yari umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru.
Nyuma y’abakinnyi benshi batatsinze, Guerouabi yahisemo kwandika igishushanyo cya mbere cyacishijwe kuri interineti mu 2013 hamwe n’izina rya "MGDZ".
Muri 2017, yagaragaye mu kiganiro kuri televiziyo "Huitième Jour" (J8).

Numidia Lezoul (yavutse 10 Gashyantare 1996), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Alijeriya. Yavukiye mu ishami rya Tizi Ouzou. Yize umuziki n'umurage wa Andalusiya imyaka 8. Muri 2016, yatangiye umwuga wo gukina afite uruhare runini 'mushiki wa Bouzid Zahra' kuri tereviziyo ya "sitidiyo ya Buside". Hanyuma yagaragaye muri "seri ya Taht almuraqaba yo muri 2017" nka 'fiancée wumunyamerika Abdullah'. Muri uwo mwaka, yitabiriye umukino wo "kwidagadura wo muri Alijeriya witwa Chiche Atahaddak".

Meriem Oukbir (yavutse 26 Gashyantare 1991), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Alijeriya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare 'Dalya' muri filime "Wlad Lahlal". Yarangije kaminuza muri 2013. Igihe yari muri kaminuza, yatangiye umwuga we w'icyitegererezo. Muri 2016, yagize uruhare rukomeye rwumukobwa wa Zahra murukurikirane "rwurwenya". Maryam yageze ku ntsinzi nk'umukinnyi wa filime kubera uruhare rukunzwe rwa 'Zahra' muri serie "On Watch", aho yakiriwe neza na rubanda.

Ângelo Torres (yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1968), ni umukinnyi wa filimi Porutugali akaba n'umuyobozi wa São Toméan. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Kunta", "Hay Road" na "Magnetick Pathways".
Yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1968 muri Gineya ya Ekwatoriya. Ababyeyi be bari São Toméans naho Torres afite abavandimwe 24, nubwo batatu gusa bakomoka kuri se na nyina. Afite imyaka itandatu, yavuye muri Gineya ya Ekwatoriya yimukira muri Cuba, aho yize ibijyanye n'ubuhanga kugeza afite imyaka 21. Amaze imyaka irindwi muri Cuba, yimukiye muri Porutugali yiga mu kigo cya Polytechnic i Lisbonne. Nyuma, yatangiye gukina umukino wa mbere muri "Por Por preto". Arubatse kuri Galician n'umugore afite umukobwa umwe, Mar.
Gukina sinema ye ya mbere yaje kunyura muri firime "A Ilha dos Escravos". Yatorewe kuba Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu mwaka wa 2012, kubera filime yitwa "Estrada de Palha". Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye igihembo kimwe kuri firime imwe muri 18 Festival Caminhos do Cinema Português.

Miguel João de Andrade Hurst (yavutse ku ya 6 Kamena 1967), uzwi cyane nka Miguel Hurst, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Angola akaba n'umuyobozi wa filimi ukomoka mu Budage no muri Porutugali. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime"Foreign Land", "Le pacte du Silence" and "Filhos do Vento"
Yavutse ku ya 6 Kamena 1967 i Freiburgo mu Budage arahakurira kugeza ku myaka icyenda. Kuva mu 1977 kugeza 1979, yabaga muri Gineya Bissau hanyuma yimukira i Lisbonne, Porutugali kuva 1979 kugeza 2003. Muri kiriya gihe, yize mu ishuri rya Theatre na Sinema rya Lisbonne nyuma ashinga itsinda ry’imikino rya Pau Preto i Lisbonne. Mu 2003, yimukiye i Luanda, muri Angola maze agirwa umuyobozi w'ikigo cya Angola Institute of Audiovisual and Multimedia Cinema (IACAM).
Mu 1995 yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba "Teatro Nacional D.Maria II-Lisboa". Mu 2007, yakoze nk'umwarimu muri disipuline Intangiriro yubuhanzi muri Universidade Independente, Luanda. Hanyuma guhera mu 2005, yakoraga ku mateka yikinamico mu kigo cyigihugu gishinzwe amahugurwa yubuhanzi umwaka umwe.
Hagati ya 2010 na 2016, akora muri Goethe-Institut Angola (Instituto Cultural Alemao), aho yaje gusaba umushinga Christiane Schulte umushinga wo kwerekana umuco wa sinema wa Angola. Yabaye umuyobozi wubuhanzi muri Semba Comunicação, akina kuri televiziyo "Fora de Série". Nyuma yaje gukorana na opera nyinshi nka "Sede de Viver", "O Comba", "O Testamento" na "Minha Terra Minha Mãe". Hagati aho, mu 2015, yasohoye igitabo cyitwa "Angola Cinemas", ku bufatanye n’umufotozi Walter Fernandes. Nkuwashinze, umuyobozi nuyobora ibicuruzwa bya Pau Preto Theatre Group, atunganya amakinamico menshi arimo; "Os Condenados", "Museu do Pau Preto", "Cabral", "Alimária", "Idéia Karapinha", Quem, "Inyenzi yo" "Kuririmba" na "Woza Albert".

António Tavares (yavutse 1960), n'umwanditsi wa Porutugali na Angola. Ni n'umunyamakuru, umwarimu n'umunyapolitiki wo muri Porutugali.
Yavutse mu 1960 i Lobito, muri Angola. Mu 1975, afite imyaka 15, yimukiye muri Porutugali nyuma yo gukoronizwa muri Afurika. Nyuma yize amashuri yisumbuye i Porto. Nyuma, yarangije amategeko mu ishami ry'amategeko muri kaminuza ya Coimbra. Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu by'amategeko agenga itumanaho muri kaminuza imwe. Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yatangiye gukora nk'umwarimu mu mashuri yisumbuye mu Ishuri ryisumbuye Domingos Rebelo (Escola Secundária Domingos Rebelo), i Ponta Delgada, nyuma mu ishuri rya Dr. Joaquim de Carvalho (Escola Secundária Dr. Joaquim de Carvalho), muri Figueira da Foz.
Hagati aho, yinjiye muri politiki ya Porutugali maze aba umuyobozi muri komine ya Figueira da Foz kuva 2005 kugeza 2009, nyuma aba umuyobozi mu nzego z'umuco, imijyi n'ibidukikije kuva 2009 kugeza 2013. Kuva mu 2013 gushika 2017, Tavares ni visi perezida wa komine.
Muri 2013, yakiriye icyubahiro mu gihembo cya Alves Redol kubera igitabo cyitwa 'O Tempo Adormeceu sob o Sol da Tarde'. Tavares yanditse igitabo "kizwi cyane nka Palavras que Me Deverão Guiar um Dia" aho yari yarangije igihembo cya Leya 2013. Ariko, muri 2015 yatsindiye igihembo cya Leya kubera igitabo "O Coro dos Defuntos" (Korali y'abapfuye). Yashinze kandi ikinyamakuru yo mu karere 'A Linha do Oeste' n'ikinyamakuru 'Litorais'.

Érica Sofia de Jesus Chissapa Bicho (yavutse ku ya 22 Ukuboza 1988), uzwi cyane nka Erica Chissapa, ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umunyamakuru wa Angola. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime"", "Voo Directo" and "Jikulumessu".
Yavutse ku ya 22 Ukuboza 1988 i Huambo, mu kibaya cyo hagati cya Angola. Nyuma yaje kwimukira i Luanda afite imyaka ibiri gusa kandi abana na ba sekuruza, asize ababyeyi be na barumuna be batatu mu gihugu cye.
Afite imyaka 14, Erica yinjiye mu ikinamico. Mugihe yari mu myitozo yitsinda ryamakinamico i Luanda, yatumiriwe gusimbura umwe mubakinnyi bakinnye, wagombaga gufungura nyuma yiminsi itatu. Hanyuma yimukiye kuri seri ya televiziyo abitumiwe n'umukinnyi Orlando Sérgio. Ariko, ntabwo yatsinze ikizamini cyambere. Nyuma yaje gutsinda guhitamo miniseries, ariko ikibabaje nuko umusaruro wahagaritswe nyuma yimitwe ibiri yanditswe. Icyakora, yakomeje kwigaragaza mu ikinamico ya Angola hamwe nitsinda ryamakinamico 'Henriques Artes'.
Mu 2005, yakinnye muri opera yisabune "Sede de Viver" anakina nka 'Kátia'. Intsinzi imaze gutsinda, yatumiwe kugira uruhare runini muri Brezil-Angola "ikorana na Minha" "Terra Minha Mãe". Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakinnye muri filimi ya Porutugali - Angola "Voo Directo". Muri uruhererekane, Érica yagize uruhare nka 'Weza Oliveira'. Muri 2014, yatumiriwe kujya mu ikinamico "Jikulumessu" n'umuririmbyi Coréon Dú.

Luís Filipe Duarte Ferreira da Silva, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Filipe Duarte (5 Kamena 1973 - 17 Mata 2020), yari umukinnyi wa filimi muri Portugal akaba n'umuhanzi w'ijwi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Variações: Umumarayika Murinzi", "Cinzento e Negro" na "Urusaku".
Yavutse ku ya 5 Kamena 1973 i Nova Lisboa, icyo gihe avukira mu gihugu cya Porutugali na Angola. Yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Espagne, Nuria Mencía. Abashakanye bafite umukobwa umwe, Antonia wavutse muri Werurwe 2011. Duarte yapfuye ku ya 17 Mata 2020, ubwo COVID-19 yafungwaga bwa mbere muri Porutugali, afite imyaka 46 azize indwara ya myocardial.
Duarte yarangije amasomo yikinamico kuri theatre kuri Theatre ya Lisbonne na School of Film. Hanyuma yarangije amahugurwa yabakinnyi mu kigo cyubushakashatsi no guhanga amakinamico. Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina akina amakinamico menshi ayobowe n'abayobozi b'amakinamico bazwi cyane Adolfo Gutkin, Rogério de Carvalho, Geraldo Touché, Francisco Salgado, Carlos J. Pessoa, Laila Ripol na Miguel Seabra.
Kuri televiziyo, yakinnye kuri filimi"Teorema de Pitágoras", iyobowe na Gonçalo Galvão Telles. Hanyuma yinjiye muri "serivise ebyiri za televiziyo A Ferreirinha", iyobowe na Jorge Paixão da Costa na "João Semana", na João Cayatte. Amaze kuba umukinnyi uzwi cyane muri serial, yagize uruhare runini muri serie ya "Ecuador" yari ishingiye ku gitabo cyanditswe na Miguel Sousa Tavares. Muri 2013, yakinnye cyane 'João Belmonte' muri seri ya televiziyo "Belmonte".
Hagati aho, Filipe yakoraga amajwi asanzwe yerekana amakatuni na firime zirimo umuntu uzwi cyane 'Sanosuke Sagara' muri animasiyo ya "Samurai X""." Igihe yapfaga mu 2020, yafataga amajwi y'ikinamico yo muri Berezile "Amor de Mãe", yerekanaga kuri SIC, yinjira mu bakinnyi ba filime "Nothing Ever Happened" iyobowe na Gonçalo Galvão Teles.

Eric Santos (yavutse ku ya 31 Mutarama 1972), ni umukinnyi wa filimi n'umwanditsi wa Porutugali. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Scoundrel", "The Compass", "Jikulumessu" na "Kaminey".
Santos yatangiye umwuga we mu 1996 akoresheje filimi "Praça da Alegria". Kuva icyo gihe yagiye mu ikinamico, filime, urukurikirane, muri Angola no mu Giportigale.
Niwe washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa 'Cast 39', Ikigo gishinzwe impano gikorera muri Porutugali.

Carlos Paulo Simões (yavutse ku ya 11 Kamena 1951), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Angola akaba n'umwanditsi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Operation Autumn", "Konseye wa Bordeaux" na "Cacau da Ribeira".

Ciomara Otoniela Morais (yavutse ku ya 14 Werurwe 1984), ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Porutigali wavukiye muri Angola ufite inkomoko ya Macanese. Morais azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime "Querida Preciosa", "" and "A Ilha dos Cães"
Yavutse ku ya 14 Werurwe 1984 i Benguela, muri Angola.
Mu 2005, yakinnye bwa mbere muri filimi ya "Morangos com Açúcar". Muri uruhererekane, uruhare rwe nka 'Salomé' rwamenyekanye cyane kandi yakiriye imirimo myinshi mumyaka iri imbere kuri tereviziyo. Bamwe muribo barimo, uruhare 'Leonor' muri "Diário de Sofia", uruhare 'Masara' muri "Equador" hanyuma muri "Makamba Hotel". Hagati aho, yimukiye mu ikinamico akina umukino wa mbere "A Balada da Margem Sul" iyobowe na Hélder Costa.
Yakoze sinema ye ya mbere muri firime ya 2009 "The Abused" afite uruhare ruto. Uruhare rwe rwa mbere muri cinema rwanyuze muri 2011 rwamamaye cyane "All Is Well" with the role 'Leonor'. Yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Festival du Cinéma Africain de Khouribga (FCAK), Maroc na The Carthage Film Festival, Tuniziya mu mwaka wa 2012 kubera uruhare yagize muri filime "". Muri uwo mwaka, iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime nziza y’igiportigale mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ryigenga rya IndieLisboa.
Muri 2012, yerekanwe bwa mbere "mubuyobozi no kwandika hamwe na firime ngufi Encontro com o Criador". Hagati aho, yanavuze kuri firime ya animasiyo 'Nayola'.

CYIZA Beatrice (yavutse 23 werurwe 1983), avukira muri zayire, congo y'ubu, ni umwana w'umuhererezi mu muryango avukamo. Ise akaba yitwaga Athase NTIBANYURWA Nyina akitwa Beatrice BAZIZANE.
CYIZA Beatrice Ni Umuyobozi mukuru, W’Ibidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere muri Minisiteri y’ibidukikije mu Rwanda, agenzura iterambere n’ikwirakwizwa ry’amategeko, ingamba na gahunda bijyanye no kurengera ibidukikije, imihindagurikire y’ikirere no kurwanya umwanda. Binyuze mu myanya itandukanye n'amahugurwa, yakusanyije ubunararibonye mu micungire y’ibidukikije.
Mbere yo kwinjira muri Minisiteri y’ibidukikije, yakoraga mu kigo cy’u Rwanda gishinzwe kubungabunga ubuhinzi nkumuhuzabikorwa w’ubuyobozi ushinzwe amasomo, kwagura no gukoresha ubushakashatsi.
Mbere yibyo, yabaye umuyobozi ushinzwe igenzura n’ibidukikije mu kigo gishinzwe imicungire y’ibidukikije mu Rwanda (REMA) ndetse anakora nka Nagoya Protocol Focal point mu myaka irenga 7.Nkigihugu cyibanze kuri Protokole ya Nagoya, yayoboye imishinga itandukanye igamije kugenzura uburyo bwo kubona umutungo wa genetike ategura ingamba na gahunda zitandukanye.
Mubushobozi bwe nk'umukozi ushinzwe kugenzura no gukurikirana ibidukikije; yakoze ibikorwa byo kugenzura ibidukikije kumishinga itandukanye ikorwa kandi akurikirana iyubahirizwa ry'amabwirizwa y’ibidukikije.

Hon. Umuhire Adrie (yavutse taliki 25.07.1977) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, senateri watowe ahagarariye mu ntara y'amajyepfo. Umuhire afite Impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu inyigisho z'iterambere.
Guhera mu Kwakira 2019,yabaye umusenateri na perezida wa komite ishinzwe imibereho myiza n'uburenganzira bwa muntu, iyi mirimo aracyayikomeje (Senator and the chairperson of the committee on Social Affairs and Human Rights from October 2019- ongoing), kuva mu mwaka wa 2006 kugera Ukwakira 2019 yakoze muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda ishami ryigisha ubugeni cg ubuhanzi n'ubumenyi bw'imibereho (Assistant Lecturer at University of Rwanda, College of Arts and Social Science from 2006 up to October 2019), sibyo gusa kuko kuva 2011 kugera 2016 yabaye umwe mu bagize akanama k'abagore bashinzwe imibereho myiza mu murenge wa Ngoma mu akarere ka Huye, mu intara y' amagepfo (A member of National Women Council in Charge of Social Affairs in Ngoma Sector of Huye District /Southern Province: 2011- 2016), mu nama y'abasenateri yabaye kuwa 30 Werurwe 2021, umuyobozi wa sena Hon Adrie Umuhire yavuze ko ubushakashatsi bwabo bwakozwe mu turere 12 muri 30, bugaragaza iterambere ry'ubumwe n'ubwiyunge ko bishoboka niba abaturage bose babishishikarijwe.

Thérèse Bishagara Kagoyire (yavutse ku wa 25 Ukuboza 1952 – apfa ku wa 8 Nyakanga 2019) yari umushakashatsi mu by'ubuzima, umwarimu akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyarwandakazi.
Kuva mu Ukwakira 2011 kugeza apfuye, yari Senateri watorewe guhagararira Intara y'Iburengerazuba mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Umutwe wa Sena.
Bishagara yari afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza ("Master's") mu bijyanye n'ibinyabuzima, by'umwihariko "Molecular Biology Sciences".
Mu Ukwakira 2011, Bishagara yatorewe kuba Senateri uhagarariye Intara y'Iburengerazuba muri manda ya kabiri ya Sena y'u Rwanda. Muri Sena yari umwe mu bagize Komisiyo y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga, Ubutwererane n'Umutekano, kugeza apfuye.
Senateri Bishagara Kagoyire yitabye Imana ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 8 Nyakanga 2019, aguye mu bitaro bya Johns Hopkins i Baltimore muri Leta ya Maryland, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, aho yari yaragiye kwivuriza. Umurambo we wagejejwe mu Rwanda, maze inshuti, umuryango n'abayobozi batandukanye bamusezeraho bwa nyuma.

Bakundufite Christine ni umunyarwandakazi wavutse taliki 29 Nzeri 1970, Afite ikiciro cya Gatatu cya kaminuza muri business (Master of Business Administration). Ubu ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'umuhanga mu by'ubukungu mu Rwanda. kuri ubu ni umudepite mu inteko ishingamategeko umutwe w'abadepite mu karere ka Gatsibo mu intara y'iburasirazuba. Yatorewe kuba mu inteko ishingamategeko mu mwaka wa 2018, mbere yakoraga nk'uyobozi w'ikigo, umucungamari n'inzobere mu ibaruramari.
Bakundufite Christine yabaye umuyobozi w' urwunge rw' amashuri rwa Bumba kuva 2003-2005(Headmistress at Groupe Scolaire Bumba), kuva 2005-2011 yabaye umucungamari muri OCIR-CAFE (Accountant at OCIR – CAFÉ), 2011-2012 yakoraga mu kigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe iterambere ry'ubuhinzi n'ibyoherezwa mu mahanga (NAEB) aho yari ashinzwe gutegura no gukurikirana ingengo y'imari (In charge of Budget at NAEB), 2012- 2018 yakomereje imirimo ye muri NAEB/price ar'inzobere mu ibaruramari. Ubu ni umwe mu abagize inteko ishingamategeko y'u Rwanda, akaba n'uhagarariye abagore mu inteko ishingamategeko mu Rwanda kuva mu mwaka wa 2018.

UWINGABE Solange (yavutse 5 ukwakira 1970) ni umunyarwandakizi w' umunyapolitiki, ni umuvugizi w ' imitwe ya politiki yemewe mu Rwanda, akaba yaratowe uwo mwanya ku wa 25 werurwe 2021 ubwo inteko rusange y imitwe ya politiki yateranaga mu gushiraho abayobozi b'amanda yarikurikiye. UWINGABE yabanje gukora imirimo itandukanye aho yakoze mu bigo bitanga ubwishingizi mu Rwanda, mbere yo kuba umudepite mu nteko ishinga amategeko mu Rwanda.
UWINGABE Solange ni umunyepolitiki uzwi akaba afite impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu bijyanye n’Amategeko, mu bijyanye n’ubucuruzi, aho yayikuye mu yahoze ari Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda. Mbere ya 2018, yakoze mu bigo by'ubwishingizi bitandukanye mu Rwanda, aho yagiye ayobora amashami atandukanye yabyo atandukanye ndetse akaba yaragiye akora mu myanya ushinzwe abakozi ndetse akaba yaragiye aba umujyanama mu by’amategeko. Uwingabe ni uwo mu Ishyaka rya PSR, akaba ari umuvugizi wa NFPO.
