Christine Nkulikiyinka (yavutse ku 1 Gashyantare 1965) mu w'u Rwanda ariwo Kigali. Ni umudiporomete w'u Rwanda ndetse ni n'umukozi wa leta. Ubu akaba ahagarariye u Rwanda mu burayi bw'amanjyaruguru.
Kuva 1985 yize ikidage mu mahanga arangije agaruka mu Rwanda, Kuva 1991 kugeza 2005 yakoraga muri ambasande y'u Rwanda mu Budage, Yatangiye akazi kubunjyanama n'umusezeguzi mu 2006, yakoze no muri Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'amahanga i Kigali, Yize muri kaminuza ya Ludwigshafen mu Binganye n;ubumenyi ngiro aho yaje kubona ni impamyabumenyi y'ubucuzi bwa mbukiranya imipaka.
Akaba avuga indimi zingera kuri enye(4) arizo ikidage, icyongereza, ikinyarwanda n'igifaransa.
Ambasaderi Christine Nkulikiyinka yateguye igikorwa Muza mahanga cyo kunamira abacu bazize Genocide yakorewa Abatutsi muri 1994 Cyabaye kakoreshejwe ikorana buhanga kubera icyorezo cya kovide-19. Yasobanuye ko kwibuka ari igikorwa gikomeye kandi gifite akamaro ku banyarwanda kandi gifite n'uburemere bikwiye kubahirizwa.
Ambasaderi Christine Nkulikiyinka arubatse kandi afite abana babiri

Uwimana Consolée yavukiye mu Karere ka Burera mu mwaka wa 1971. Amashuri abanza yayatangiriye i Burera, akomereza i Cyabingo mu Karere ka Gakenke, naho ayisumbuye ayiga muri Lycée Notre-Dame de Cîteaux i Kigali. Yize ibijyanye n’ubukungu, nyuma akora igihe kinini muri Banki y’Abaturage, aho yagiye akora imirimo itandukanye.
Uwimana Consolee yahoze ari perezida wa sena yu Rwanda. Uwimana ni rwiyemezamirimo akaba n'umunyamabanki wa bizobereyemo
Hon Consolee Uwimana Yakoze ibushakashatsi mu turere twose tw'u Rwanda uko tungana ari 30 atuzegurukamo ashaka imibare yabasigajwe inyuma na amateka ariko yasanze imubare ukiri hasi cyane, gusa ibibazo bahura nabyo aribyo byinshi. Muri ibyo bibazo basanze abana babo batajya ku ishuri uko bikwiye.
Hon Consolee yifatanyije na bagore bo mu karere ka Gakenke ku italiki ya 25/10/2014 wari umunsi mukuru wahariwe umugore wo mu cyaro, umuco nyarwanda wagaragaye ko ubazitira mu iterambere.
Mu matora yabaye ku itariki ya 2 Mata 2023, nibwo ku cyicaro cy’ishyaka rya FPR Inkotanyi hazwi nka Intare Conference Arena, nibwo kongere y’igihugu ya cumi na gatandatu ya FPR yatorewemo komite Nyobozi nshya y’igihugu bituma Uwimana Consolée atorerwa kuba visi perezida mushya waryo, asimbuye Bazivamo Christophe, Uwimana yabonye amajwi 1945 ahagarariye 92.7% yabatoye bose aho yungirije umuyobozi mukuru Paul Kagame.
Consolee Uwimana arubatse kandi afite abana batatu.

Madam Valentine Uwamariya (wavutse ku ya 14 Gicurasi mu mwaka 1971) akora ubu ni Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango mbere yari Minisitiri w’uburezi mu Rwanda, yashyizweho na Perezida wa Repuburika yu Rwanda muri Gashyantare mu mwaka 2020.
.Madam Valentine Uwamariya yavutse ku ya 14 Gicurasi mun mwaka1971 mu Murenge wa Shangi mu Karere ka Nyamasheke. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye muri Groupe Scolaire Sainte Famille, Nyamasheke. Yakomeje amashuri ye kandi abona impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Chimie Organic yakuye muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda. Mu mwaka 2005, Uwamariya yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Electrochemistry yakuye muri kaminuza ya Witwatersrand muri Afurika y'Epfo. Nyuma yaho, mu mwaka 2007, yabonye buruse yo kwiga Porogaramu ya PhD muri UNESCO-IHE naho mu mwaka 2013 abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga.
Uwamariya Valentine yabaye umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe amahugurwa, iterambere ry’ibigo n’ubushakashatsi muri Rwanda Polytechnic iherutse gushingwa mbere gato yuko aba Minisitiri w’uburezi.

Christine Nyatanyi (16 Nyakanga 1965 - 26 Nzeri 2011) yari impuguke mu by'ubukungu n’umunyapolitiki, yabaye umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe imibereho myiza muri minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu, kuva mu Kwakira 2003 kugeza apfuye muri Nzeri 2011.
Yavukiye mu Rwanda ku ya 16 Nyakanga 1965. Yize muri kaminuza nkuru y’ubukungu ya Kharkiv, i Kharkiv, muri Ukraine, ari naho yakuye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Economics mu 1987. Nyuma yize muri "Odessa Institute of National Economy", arangiza mu 1991 afite Masters mu bijyanye n’inganda.
Nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994, Nyantanyi yakoranye na komite mpuzamahanga ya Croix-Rouge (ICRC), muri "Department of Tracing", i Goma, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ni Nairobi muri Kenya. Mu 1997, yagizwe umuyobozi ushinzwe umushinga mu nama ya "Flemish ishinzwe impunzi", ifite icyicaro i Buruseli mu Bubiligi. Mu Kwakira 2003, yagizwe Minisitiri w’igihugu ushinzwe imibereho myiza muri Minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu cy’u Rwanda, akora muri urwo rwego kugeza muri Nzeri 2011.
Nyatanyi yapfuye ku ya 26 Nzeri 2011, mu bitaro bya kaminuza ya Saint-Luc, i Buruseli mu Bubiligi, nyuma yo kuvurwa igihe kirekire. Umurambo we usubira i Kigali, yurira Brussels Airlines ku wa gatandatu, 1 Ukwakira 2011. Nyuma yigihe kinini cyo kumusezeraho mu teko ishingamategeko na misa ya requiem kuri "Kiliziya Gatolika ya Regina Pacis" i Remera, mu nkengero za Kigali, umurambo we washyinguwe mu gihugu. Yasabiwe mu irimbi rya Rusororo i Kabuga, ku wa mbere, 3 Ukwakira 2011.
Ibihugu byunze ubumwe byahaye igihembo Christine Nyatanyi, mu 2008, mu rwego rwo kumushimira ibikorwa bye ndetse no kubazwa ibyo akora muri gahunda y'igihugu y'u Rwanda Ubudehe '.

Madeleine Ayinkamiye yari umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Yagizwe Minisitiri w’Imibereho Myiza y'Abaturage mu 1964, bimugira minisitri wa mbere w'abayeho w'umugore mu Rwanda.
Ayinkamiye yakoraga mu biro bya minisitiri kuva ku ya 6 Mutarama 1964 kugeza ku ya 8 Ugushyingo 1965. Niwe minisitiri w’umugore wenyine mu Rwanda hagati y’ubwigenge bw’u Rwanda mu 1962 na Mata 1992.

Jeanne d'Arc Debonheur ni umunyamategeko n'umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda wabaye Minisitiri w’impunzi n’imicungire y’ibiza kuva ku ya 30 Kanama 2017.
Yavutse ku ya 19 Mata 1978, kandi yiga mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda mbere yo kwiga kaminuza. Mu 2012 yahawe impamyabumenyi ya masters ny nategeko muri Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda.
Debonheur yatangiye umwuga we mu 2008, akora nk'umwanditsi w'urukiko mu rukiko rw'ubucuruzi, rufite icyicaro i Musanze na Nyarugenge, akora muri urwo rwego kugeza mu 2011.
Kuva 2011 kugeza 2012 yakoraga nka Legal Drafter ndetse n'Umujyanama mu Mutwe w'Abadepite mu nteko ishingamategeko imitwe yombi. Mu gihe cy'amezi atatu, kuva muri Mutarama 2013 kugeza ku ya 23 Mata 2013, yabaye umuyobozi ushinzwe amategeko muri "Rwanda Environmental Management Authority" (REMA).
Kuva ku ya 24 Mata 2013, Debonheur yabaye inzobere mu gutegura amategeko no kuba umujyanama mu by'amategeko muri Sena y'u Rwanda, akora muri urwo rwego kugeza ku ya 29 Kanama 2017.
Ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, yarahiriye kuba Minisitiri w’u Rwanda ushinzwe imicungire y’ibiza n’impunzi.
Jeanne d'Arc Debonheur ni umubyeyi wubatse ufite abana batatu.

Aloisea Inyumba (28 Ukuboza 1964 - 6 Ukuboza 2012) yari umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, akaba yari Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango ndetse akaba umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa wa komisiyo y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge.
Mu gihe yigaga ibijyanye n'imibereho n'imibereho myiza muri kaminuza ya Makerere muri Uganda, yinjiye mu Rwanda Patriotic Front.
Amagambo yo kumushyingura yatanzwe na Perezida Paul Kagame.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Aloisea Inyumba yavutse ku ya 28 Ukuboza 1964 muri Uganda, avuka ku babyeyi bavuka mu Rwanda. Yavutse nyuma y’impinduramatwara yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1959, aho hashyizweho Repubulika yiganjemo Abahutu benshi, no gutoteza abatutsi. [2] Mu gihe ababyeyi be bari bakibera mu Rwanda, kandi mbere yuko avuka, se yiciwe mu bwicanyi bwakorewe abatutsi; nyina yaratorotse hamwe na barumuna be batanu maze umuryango uhungira mu mutekano wa Uganda.
Inyumba yabayeho mu bwana bwe muri Uganda, arangiza amashuri ye, hanyuma akomereza muri kaminuza ya Makerere i Kampala, abona impamyabumenyi mu mibereho myiza y'abaturage. Mu 1985, yabonanye bwa mbere na Paul Kagame, undi wari impunzi iva mu Rwanda icyo gihe yari mu gisirikare cy’inyeshyamba cya Yoweri Museveni. [4] Nyuma y'umwaka umwe, Museveni yigaruriye igihugu maze azamura Kagame na mugenzi we wo mu Rwanda Fred Rwigyema kuba abayobozi mu ngabo z’igihugu. [5] Kagame na Rwigema bafashe iyo myanya, ariko intego yabo nyamukuru kwari ukugaruka mu gihugu cyabo, kugira ngo borohereze impunzi nuko inyumba nawwe yemera kubafasha.
Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa FPR muri Nyakanga 1994, Inyumba yashyizwe muri guverinoma nshya y’inzibacyuho. yari iyobowe Perezida Pasteur Bizimungu. [8] Yari yashyizweho ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Uburinganire n'Iterambere ry'Umuryango, atangira gahunda ikomeye yo kumvisha uruhare rwabo abagore mu kubaka Rwanda.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, yongeye kugirwa inshingano yari yarahoze ari Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango, uruhare yagize kugeza apfuye mu 2012.
Ubuzima bwa muntu n'urupfu.
Inyumba yashakanye na Dr Richard Masozera, wahoze ari Umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo gishinzwe indege za gisivili mu Rwanda (RCAA). Bombi batangiye gukundana igihe bombi bari abanyeshuri muri kaminuza ya Makerere i Kampala. Babyaranye abana babiri, umukobwa n'umuhungu.
Inyumba yapfuye ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2012 iwe i Kigali. Yari arwaye kanseri yo mu muhogo, kandi yari aherutse gusubira mu rugo nyuma yo kwivuriza mu Budage. Inyumba yahawe imihango yo gushyingura leta mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda i Kigali kandi amagambo ye yatanzwe na perezida w’igihugu, Paul Kagame. Kagame yamusobanuriye ko ari umuyobozi utitanga "wari umukandida mwiza kandi usobanutse neza". Abandi batanze ibiganiro mu muhango wo gushyingura barimo Minisitiri w’ibikorwa by’inama y’abaminisitiri Protais Musoni na visi guverineri wa Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda, Monique Nsanzabaganwa.

Fanfan Rwanyindo Kayirangwa ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda wabaye Minisitiri w’abakozi ba Leta n’umurimo muri guverinoma y’u Rwanda, kuva ku ya 31 Kanama 2017.
Afite Impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga, yabonye mu 1997, yakuye muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda. Yagize kandi Impamyabumenyi ya amasters of Laws, mu 2010 muri Kaminuza ya Witwatersrand, mu Johannesburg, South Africa.
Mbere ya 2004, Rwanyindo Kayirangwa yakoraga mu bucuruzi bwa serivisi z'imari. Kuva mu 1998 kugeza 2004, yabaye umujyanama mu by'amategeko akaba n'umukozi ushinzwe inguzanyo muri Banki y'Ubucuruzi y'u Rwanda, uyu munsi icuruza nka I&amp;amp;M Bank Rwanda Limited.
Kuva 2004 kugeza 2017, yakoraga mu bucamanza bw'u Rwanda. Mu 2004, yagizwe umucamanza w'Ubutabera bw'Urukiko Rukuru rw'u Rwanda. Mu 2008 yimuriwe mu Rukiko Rukuru rw'Ubucuruzi. Yagizwe Visi-Perezida w'Urukiko Rukuru rw'Ubucuruzi mu Rwanda mu Kwakira 2013.
Mu ivugurura ry’abaminisitiri ryo ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, Fanfan Rwanyindo Kayirangwa yagizwe minisitiri mushya w’abakozi ba Leta n’umurimo, asimbuye Judith Uwizeye, wabaye Minisitiri mu biro bya Perezida.

Solina Nyirahabimana ni umudipolomate w’umunyarwanda akaba n'umunyapolitiki wabaye Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango muri guverinoma y’u Rwanda kuva ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2018.
Muri 2020, yagizwe Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe Itegeko Nshinga n’amategeko.
Nyirahabimana yabaye Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu Busuwisi, mbere yuko ahamagarwa mu 2013.

Pauline Nyiramasuhuko (yavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1946) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda wari Minisitiri w’imibereho myiza y’umuryango no guteza imbere abagore. Yahamijwe icyaha cyo kuba yarashishikarije ingabo n’abasirikare gufata ku ngufu mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Yaburanishijwe muri jenoside no gushishikariza gufata ku ngufu i "Butare " mu rukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rw’u Rwanda (ICTR) i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya. Muri Kamena 2011, yahamijwe ibyaha birindwi akatirwa gufungwa burundu. Nyiramasuhuko ni we mugore wa mbere wahamwe n'icyaha cya jenoside na ICTR, n'umugore wa mbere wahamwe n'icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu.

Odette Nyiramilimo (yavutse 1956) ni umunyarwandakazi akaba umuganga ndetse n'umusenateri. Yabaye umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe imibereho myiza muri guverinoma ya Paul Kagame kuva muri Werurwe 2000 kugeza Ukwakira 2003.
Nyiramilimo, yavukiye i Kinunu, perefegitura ya Gisenyi muri 1956. ni uwa cumi na karindwi mubana ba se cumi n'umunani, yabyawe n'umugore we wa kabiri.
Yarangije kaminuza muri 1981 ari umuganga w'ubuvuzi muri kaminuza nkuru y rwanda Butare.
Ku myaka itatu, abantu benshi bo mu muryango we baguye mu ntambara yo gushaka ubutegetsi nyuma y'ubwigenge. Nyuma yo kwirukanwa kuko yari umututsi Nyuma yaje gushyingiranwa na Jean-Baptiste Gasasira, na we wari umuganga, maze nyuma baza gushinga ubuvuzi bwihariye bwo kubyara no kuvura abana i Kigali buzwi nka Le Bon Samaritain (" Umusamariya Mwiza ")Nyiramilimo yari umwe mu banyarwanda bagera ku 1.000 bahungiye muri Hotel des Mille Collines mu gihe cya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994
Amateka y'ubuzima bwe yanditswe mu burebure mu gitabo cya Philip Gourevitch Turashaka kukumenyesha ko ejo tuzicwa n'umuryango wacu. Dr Odette Nyiramilimo ni umwe mu badepite bari bagize abadepite bo muri EALA bahagarariye u Rwanda, aho yaje no kuba umwe mubakuriye Komite y’abadepite ba EALA muri afurika y'iburengerazuba, aho bakiraga abantu benshi batandukanye.

Hon Fatou Harerimana ni Visi perezida w'inteko ishinga amategeko Umutwe wa Sena, kandi Hon Fatou Hareriman yaje gutorerwa kuyobora kuba Umuvugizi w'ihuriro rw'igihugu Nyugurabitekerezo ry'imitwe ya politike.
Taliki 19 Mutarama 2018 yatangije ukukaguramba ku bahohotera abagabo mu Karere Ka musanze, aho Senateri yavuze ko bidakwiye ko umugore ahohotera umugabo yitwaje ko yasubijwe agaciro. naho taliki 22 Mata 2017 yari Mu Karere Ka Huye mu murenge wa Karama aho ya giye mu gikorwa cyo kwibuka Jenoside Yakorewe Abatutsi ku nshoro 27 nibwo yibukije abatunge ko nabo ar'inshingano zabo kwiyukakira Urwibutso rwayo rukomeye.
Nyuma yaho gato aho yaravuye mu karere ka Karongi taliki 27/08/2017 aho yaragiye gusobanurira abayobozi b’Inzego zitandukanye, amahame Remezo Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda yubakiyeho Hon Fatou niwe wa rubakuriye.
Yagiye kwigisha "Ndi Umunyarwanda" ku kigo cy’ishuri Intwari kiri mur Murenge wa Rwezamenyo kibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi niwe wari umuyobozi mukuru.

Hon sen. Gertrude Kazarwa afite imyaka mirongo itanu ni rindwi(57) yubukure, ni umunyapolitike wo mu Rwanda kandi ni umusenateri mu nteko ishinga amategeko ya kabiri ya sena y'u Rwanda.
Yasuye yabanyeshuri bo muri Tumba College of Technology aho yari yaje kwibutsa urubyiroka ruharererwa rwiga ikoranabunga ko rwabyaza umusaruro imbuga nkoranyambaga ntibahere mu makayi, ahubwo bagomba kurikoresha banahangana n’abapfobya Jenoside.
Yagize uruzinduko yakoreye mu ihuriro, aho bareberagahamwe imiyoborere yashimye uko ihuriro rifata imitwe ya politike Kubahiriza amahame Remezo, Hon sen,Gertrude Kazarwa niwe waruyoboye iri huriro, taliki ya 15 Mutarama 2019 yitabiriye Inama yari isanzwe y’igihembwe y’abagize inama njyanama y’Akarere, hanacyirwa indahiro y’umujyanama mushya uhagarariye umurenge wa Gahengeri Hon sen. Gertrude Kazarwa nawe yarayitabiriye, yaje kunyarukira ku karere ka Ngoma taliki ya 30 werurwe 219 aho yari yagiye kwifatanya n'urubyiruko mu gikorwa cy'umuganda wasozaga ukwezi kwa Werurwe 2019
Hon sen. Gertrude Kazarwa ni umundamu w'imyaka 57 kandi arubatse afite n'abana.

Francine Tumushime, ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda ukora nka minisitiri i w’ubutaka n’amashyamba (Minilaf), kuva ku ya 31 Kanama 2017. Nyakubahwa Francine TUMUSHIME yagizwe Minisitiri w’ubutaka n’amashyamba kuva ku ya 30 Kanama 2017, afite inshingano zo kurengera, kubungabunga no guteza imbere ubutaka n’amashyamba.
Tumushime yayoboye ikigo gishinzzwe abakozi ba leta yu Rwanda guhera mu 2012. Ing. Francine TUMUSHIME afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buyobozi bw’ubucuruzi, afite impamyabumenyi muri ' Project Management from Maastricht School of Managementt, mu Buholandi. Afite kandi impamyabumenyi y’ubuhinzi mu buhinzi na "Diplôme de Candidature" mu bumenyi yakuye muri kaminuza nkuru y’Uburundi
Mbere yo gushyirwa mu Nama y'Abaminisitiri, Eng. Francine TUMUSHIME yabaye Umuhuzabikorwa wa Banki y'Isi ishami rishinzwe gushyira mu bikorwa imishinga imwe muri Minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi. Yakoze kandi imyaka irenga nkumuhuzabikorwa wigihugu wumushinga uterwa inkunga na IFAD ushinzwe guteza imbere imishinga mito n'iciriritse yo mucyaro muri Minisiteri yubucuruzi ninganda.
Kuva mu 2012, kugeza muri Werurwe 2016, Hon. Francine Tumushime yabaye umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe iterambere ry’abaturage n’imibereho myiza muri minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’ibanze (Minaloc). Ubwo yavaga i Minaloc ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2016, yasimbuwe na Sheikh Hassa Bahame.
Ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, yarahiriye kuba minisitiri w’abaminisitiri w’ubutaka n’amashyamba. Ubutaka n’amashyamba byakozwe muri minisiteri y’umutungo kamere, muri Kanama 2017, bituma minisiteri y’ibidukikije iba icyicaro cyayo kandi isenya minisiteri y’umutungo kamere.

Mpembyemungu Winifrida (yavutse 1972) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, ubu ari mu bagize Umutwe w'Abadepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda.
Mpembyemungu yahoze ari umuyobozi wa karere ka Musanze. Muri 2013 inzu ye yibasiwe n’ibisasu, bituma umwana yicwa abandi babiri barakomereka. Muri 2015 abantu batandatu bakatiwe igifungo cya burundu, kubera ibi nibindi bitero bya FDLR iterwa inkunga.
Muri Mata 2016, abagizi ba nabi bateye iwe nijoro, bituma umugabo araswa yicwa n'inzego z'umutekano.
Muri Kamena 2018, Mpembyemungu yatsinze byimazeyo uwahoze ari Depite Marie Therese Murekatete kugira ngo abone itike y'abagore yo mu Rwanda Patriotic Front mu karere ka Musanze.
Mpembyemungu Winifrida ari muri politiki, kuvuga muri 2000, ubwo yarari mu gusoza icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza mu bijyanye n’iterambere (Master of development studies) muri Kaminuza nkuru yigenga ya Kigali (ULK).

Nirere Béatrice ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda wahamwe n'icyaha cya jenoside kubera uruhare yagize muri Jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994. Igihe yacirwaga urubanza mu 2009, yari umwe mu bagize umutwe w’abadepite mu Rwanda, inteko ishinga amategeko umutwe w’igihugu.
Mu 1993, Nirere yari guverineri wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza muri perefegitura ya Byumba. Muri uwo mwaka, yahunze ingabo z’u Rwanda Patriotic Front (FPR) yimukira mu nkengero za Kigali. Ababibonye bavuze ko mu gihe cya Jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994 Nirere yari umwe mu bari bagize umutwe w’interahamwe zateguye ubwicanyi bw’Abatutsi b’Abatutsi, uruhare rwa Nirere hamwe n’interahamwe rwakomotse kuri politiki ye. Nirere yemeye ko yahaye abayoboke ba Interahamwe imyenda n'ibindi bikoresho, ariko ahakana ko atigeze akorana nabo. Yashinjwaga kandi gushyiraho no kugenzura bariyeri aho abatutsi bafungiwe mbere yuko bicwa.
Muri Nzeri 2008, Nirere yongeye gutorerwa kuba mu mutwe w'Abadepite nk'umunyamuryango wa FPR uri ku butegetsi. Nyuma y'amezi atanu ari umwe mu bagize inteko ishinga amategeko, yashinjwaga itsembabwoko maze aburanishwa mu rukiko rwa gacaca i Giporoso, mu Karere ka Gasabo. Ku ya 2 Werurwe 2009, Nirere yahamijwe icyaha cya jenoside maze akatirwa gufungwa burundu. Ikibazo cyo gusimburwa kwa Nirere mu nteko kivugwa muri Gicurasi yakurikiyeho, kubera ko yari atarasimburwa na FPR. Umuvugizi w’iyo nzu, Rose Mukantabana, yazamuye iki kibazo kubera ko amategeko y’inteko ishinga amategeko arenze iminsi icumi.

Uwacu Julienne ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umunyapolitiki mu Rwanda, wabaye minisitiri w’imikino n’umuco n'a siporo,yari mu baminisitiri muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, kuva ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2015. Mu ivugurura ry’abaminisitiri ryo ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, Julienne Uwacu yagumanye inshingano ze.
Yavukiye mu Rwanda, ahagana muri 1979.
Umwuga wa politiki watangiye mbere ya 2008, ubwo yakoraga nka Visi Meya w'Akarere ka Nyabihu, ushinzwe ubukungu n'iterambere. Muri 2008, yatorewe kuba inteko ishinga amategeko, akora muri urwo rwego kugeza muri Gashyantare 2015. Igihe yari mu nteko, yabaye umuyobozi wungirije wa komite y’inteko ishinga amategeko y’ububanyi n’amahanga, ubutwererane n’umutekano. Muri 2015, yabaye minisiteri wa siporo n’umuco mu Rwanda (Minispoc); umugore wa mbere wakoraga muri urwo rwego, asimbuye Joseph Habineza, waQvanywe muri guverinoma.
Uwacu Julienne uyu munsi rero akaba ashinzwe ubudaheranwa muri Minisiteri shyashya y’Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda n’Inshingano mboneragihugu (yitwa Minubumwe. Uwacu Julienne kandi akaba yiciwe ababyeyi muri Jenoside, aho i Se bamuziza ko yashakanye n’Umututsikazi. Uwacu yavutse ku babyeyi babiri badahuje amoko abahutu n’abatutsi. genoside yakorewe Abatutsi yabaye afite imyaka igera kuri 13, ku itariki 8 Mata 1994, kuwa Gatanu saa munani nibwo ababyeyi be bombi bishwe. Nyina yari Umututsikazi, papa akaba yari Umuhutu. Uwacu Julienne kandi yabaye Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside, CNLG (National Commission for the Fight Against Genocide).

Annoncée Manirarora (wavutse ku ya 30 Kamena 1976) ni umunyarwandakazi w'umunyapolitiki mu Rwanda, kuri ubu akaba umwe mu bagize umutwe w'abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda.
Manirarora ni umwe mu bagize urugaga rwo gukunda igihugu cy'u Rwanda. Intara ayobora ni intara y'uburengerazuba n' Akarere ka Ngororero.
Manirarora mbere yakoraga mu Muryango w'Abibumbye kandi afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu bushakashatsi no gukumira Jenoside.
Annoncée Manirarora (wavutse ku ya 30 Kamena 1976) ni umunyapolitiki mu Rwanda, kuri ubu akaba umwe mu bagize umutwe w'abadepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y'u Rwanda. Manirarora ni umwe mu bagize urugaga rwo gukunda igihugu cy'u Rwanda. Intara ye nintara yuburengerazuba naho akarere ke ni Akarere ka Ngororero.

Uwumuremyi Marie Claire (yavutse 1979) ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda. Kuva mu 2018 yabaye umwe mu bagize Umutwe rw'Abadepite mu nteko ishingamategeko y' u Rwanda.
Uwumuremyi Marie Claire mbere yo kuba umudepite yakoraga kuri Biro y'Ubutaka, nk'umukozi ushinzwe ubutaka mu Karere akaba n'ushinzwe guha agaciro ubutaka mu Karere. Yabaye Perezida w'Inama y'Abagore (CNF) mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Ku munsi mpuzamahanga w’abagore bo mu cyaro 2011 yashishikarije abagore bo mu Murenge wa Tumba, mu Karere ka Huye, gukoresha amahirwe leta itanga, no guteza imbere ubucuruzi bwabo bafata inguzanyo.
Muri Nzeri 2018 yabaye umudepite mu Karere ka Nyanza, Intara y'Amajyepfo, nk'uhagarariye abagore. Mu Kwakira 2018, yitabiriye ibirori by’umunsi w’ibiribwa ku isi, ashyigikira gahunda ya Girinka ya guverinoma y’u Rwanda (Inka imwe ku muryango ukennye). Ukuboza 2019 yatorewe kuba muri Komite Nyobozi y’umutwe w’Abadepite bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Commonwealth (CWP). Muri Kamena 2019, ubwo yavugaga mu muhango wo kwibuka wabereye mu Murenge wa Mukingo, mu Karere ka Nyanza, yibukije abamuteze amatwi akamaro ko kwibuka jenoside yo mu Rwanda.

Rose Mukantabana (wavutse ku ya 31 Kanama 1961) ni umunyamategeko uharanira uburenganzira bw'umugore. Yahoze ari Perezida w’Umutwe w’abadepite mu Rwanda kandi ni we mugore wa mbere watorewe uwo mwanya. Yatorewe kuba umuyobozi w’umuryango w’inteko ishinga amategeko nyafurika kuva 2013-2015.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Rose Mukantabana yavutse ku ya 31 Kanama 1961 mu Karere ka Nyanza, Intara y'Amajyepfo, u Rwanda. Yarangije amashuri yisumbuye atangira gukora mu bakozi ba Leta mu 1980, abanza muri Sosiyete y'u Rwanda ishinzwe ubwishingizi nyuma muri Minisiteri ishinzwe abakozi ba Leta. Mu 1992, yinjiye muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda arangiza impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu 1996. Muri uwo mwaka, yatangiye gukorera Ishyirahamwe Haguruka, umuryango utegamiye kuri leta wibanda ku burenganzira bwa muntu n’uburenganzira bw’umugore n’abana. Amaze imyaka icyenda muri iryo shyirahamwe, yatangiye kuba umufasha mu by'amategeko kandi akora kugeza ku muhuzabikorwa ushinzwe amategeko. Nyuma gusukura Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa y'Igihugu, Mukantabana asubira kw'ishure. Yize mu Bubiligi, yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse "impamyabumenyi yihariye mu burenganzira bwa muntu" yakuye muri Université Saint-Louis Bruxelles.
Mu 2002, yabaye visi perezida wa Pro-Femmes, umuryango w’amahoro wahuzaga ingufu za ONG 43 zigamije iterambere ry’umugore n’uburenganzira. Mu 2005, yatangiye gukora nk'umuhuzabikorwa w’igihugu w’umuryango uharanira uburenganzira bw’umugore uterwa inkunga na USAID maze mu 2007, yimukira muri ActionAid International Rwanda, abanza kuba Umuhuzabikorwa w’Uburenganzira bw’umugore nyuma aba umuyobozi ushinzwe gahunda. Mu mwaka wa 2008, yatorewe kuba Umudepite uhagarariye intara y’Umujyi wa Kigali. Ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2008, yatowe na bagenzi be badepite kugira ngo abere Perezida w’Umutwe w’abadepite mu Rwanda kugeza mu 2013 ku majwi 70 kuri 100 na. Amatora ye yamugize umugore wa mbere uyoboye inteko ishinga amategeko. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yatorewe kuba umuyobozi w’umuryango w’inteko ishinga amategeko nyafurika (APU) kugeza mu 2015.

Donatille Mukabalisa (yavutse ku ya 30 Nyakanga 1960 i Nyamata) ni umunyamategeko n'umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, cyane cyane Perezida w'Umutwe w'Abadepite. Yatorewe kuba Perezida w’inteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda mu 2013 nyuma y’amatora y’igihugu.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Donatille Mukabalisa yavutse ku ya 30 Nyakanga 1960 i Nyamata. Yigisha amategeko muri kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali.
Yakoze mu ishyirahamwe ry’ubuzima ku isi arangije amasomo ye ndetse n’imyaka 16 muri gahunda y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe iterambere.

Fred Kudjo Kuwornu (yavutse ku ya 6 Nzeri 1971), ni Umutaliyani, umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Gana, producer, uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu akaba n'umwarimu ufite icyicaro i New York.
Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire zizwi cyane nka "Blaxploitalian Imyaka 100 Yirabura muri Sinema y'Ubutaliyani", "Imbere ya Buffalo" na "18 IUS SOLI". Inyandiko ze zivuga ku nsanganyamatsiko za politiki n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage, nk'ivanguramoko, umubano hagati y'amoko, ubudasa, Abanyafurika-Abataliyani ndetse n'irangamuntu ya Diaspora mu Butaliyani na diaspora ya Afurika ku isi. Niwe mutaliyani wambere ukomoka muri Afrika abaye umuyobozi.
Yavutse ku ya 6 Nzeri 1971 i Bologna mu Butaliyani kwa se uva Gana na nyina w’umutaliyani. Se Perviss Kuwornu akomoka mu mudugudu wo mu karere ka Volta, muri Gana, wageze mu Butaliyani mu 1965 yiga ubuvuzi. Se wize ibijyanye no kubaga umutima nubuvuzi rusange nyuma arangiza kaminuza. Nyina Alessandra Giacomelli ni Umuyahudi wo mu Butaliyani wo muri Bologna. Kuwornu yakuriye i Bologna, nyuma yimukira muri Gana, Ferrara, Roma.
Amashuri yisumbuye mu Butaliyani no muri Amerika, yabonye impamyabumenyi ya siyanse ya politiki n'itangazamakuru, yakuye muri kaminuza ya Bologna. Ku myaka 16, Fred Kuwornu atangira ubunararibonye bwe nk'umuvugizi wa Radio Estense, radiyo yo muri Ferrara, bityo anonosora ubuhanga bwe bwo guhanga hamwe n'ishyaka rye rya muzika, mu myaka intsinzi ya Rap n'inzu mu muco w'Ubutaliyani. Umwuga we nka DJ uzakomeza kumyaka 15 iri imbere kumaradiyo atandukanye, nka "Radio Bologna International", na "Radio Jam FM." Ku izina ry'irihimbano “Freddy Ajya mu nzu” akora nka producer wa label Mantra Vibes, amenya imbyino imwe yise “Ifirimbi” (1998) na “Sun Train” (1999). Azahagarika umwuga we wa radio igihe azaba yimukiye i Roma gukora muri sinema na TV.

Imen Nouel (yavutse ku ya 13 Mutarama 1985), rimwe na rimwe nka Imen Noël, ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Alijeriya. Azwi cyane mubikorwa bya tereviziyo na sinema nka "Krim Belkacem", "Rayes Korso" na "Kugeza ku mperuka".
Yatangiye umwuga we nkumunyamideli Muri 2004, yatorewe kuba Miss Ubukerarugendo muri Alijeriya. Muri 2005, yatumiriwe gukina urukurikirane ruzwi cyane rwo gusetsa rwo muri Alijeriya "Nass Mlah City 3". Hamwe na serial, yamenyekanye cyane kandi amenyekana nkumwe mubastari bazamuka bakina ikinamico uri Alijeriya. Muri 2009, yabaye umunyamuryango wa muzika "Al saha". Mu 2011, yinjiye mu Tunisia umuyoboro ' Nessma ' ari umwanditsi kuko gore kuvuga show "Memnou Al Rjel" (babujijwe Bagabo).

Idrissou Mora-Kpai (yavutse 14 Nyakanga 1967), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Bénine. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane "Indochina Traces of" the Mother, "Arlit The Second Paris", na "Si-Gueriki Umwamikazi Mama". Niwe wahawe igihembo cy’igikomangoma cy’Ubuholandi kubera ibyo yagezeho mu buhanzi agamije guteza imbere imibereho myiza mu majyepfo y’isi.
Yavutse ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1967 i Béroubouay, mu majyaruguru ya Bénin mu muryango w'aborozi. Se yari Mora-Kpai Sounon Dangnon naho nyina yari Bougnon Yarou Signangui.
Yarangije impamyabumenyi ya BA muri kaminuza ya Konrad Wolf Film ya Babelsberg, mu Budage. Yakoze kandi nk'umwarimu wasuye muri Kaminuza ya Cornell, Kaminuza ya Dukena kaminuza ya Pittsburgh. Kuri ubu aba muri Amerika. Ni Assistant Professor mu ishami ryitangazamakuru ryubuhanzi, siyanse nubushakashatsi muri Ithaca College.
Afite imyaka 13, yimukiye i Cotonou maze yiga mu mashuri yisumbuye. Afite imyaka 19, yagiye muri Alijeriya hanyuma yimukira mu Butaliyani no mu Budage. Hanyuma yize muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru muri kaminuza yubuntu ya Berlin kuva 1988 kugeza 1993. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yize ibijyanye no gutunganya amashusho muri kaminuza ya Konrad Wolf Film kuva 1994 kugeza 1999. Muri iki gihe cya kaminuza, yakoze firime ebyiri ngufi, "Transient" na "Fake Soldiers".
Mu 1999, Idrissou yimukiye i Paris maze ashinga isosiyete ikora ibintu yitwa 'MKJ Films'. Hamwe n'inzu itunganya, yakoze documentaire ye ya mbere, "Si-Gueriki" mu 2002. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yitabirwa n’amahanga. Yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime Rotterdam (IFFR), Sinema du Réel, Paris ndetse n’iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Copenhagen (CIFF). Nyuma film yaje guhabwa igihembo cyiza cya Documentaire muri Festival International du Film Francophone de Namur.
Muri 2019, yakoze film documentaire "Amerika Street". Irasobanura urugamba rwa buri munsi rwumuryango nyafrica wabanyamerika i Charleston, muri Caroline yepfo nyuma yubwicanyi bwa Walter Scott 2015. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwe mu birori byinshi bya firime.

Pantheon ni filime ngufi y’igifaransa yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Ange-Régis Hounkpatin ikorwa na Myrina Mané kuri TS Productions. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo William Edimo mu mwanya wa mbere hamwe na Bass Dhem, Sophia Elisabeth na Hugo Marí. Filime irazenguruka Saloman, umushoferi wa tagisi wimyaka 35 akaba umuhungu wumwimukira wa Bénin.
Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku ya 22 Kamena 2017 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Palm Springs, muri Amerika. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi ihitwamo kumugaragaro kugirango yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika 2017, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Atlanta 2018 na Filmfest Dresden 2018. Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Bridging the Borders muri Palm Springs International Festival ya Filime ngufi 2017. Muri uwo mwaka, filime yakiriye icyubahiro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Kolkata.

Ange-Régis Hounkpatin, ni Umufaransa - Umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Bénine akaba n'umwanditsi.
Yavukiye kandi akurira i Cotonou, muri Bénin.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye, Hounkpatin yimukiye mu Bufaransa kwiga ubuvanganzo. Amaherezo yinjiye mu ishuri rya Femis rya sinema muri 2009. Yakoze filime "Rêves de intare" mu mwaka wa nyuma aza gutsindira igihembo cy'urubyiruko mu iserukiramuco rya Côté Court of Pantin mu 2014. Filime ye "Cage" yahisemo mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Champs-Élysées mu 2016. Mu mwaka wa 2015, yakoze filime "Vindicte" yafatiwe muri Bénin maze atoranywa mu iserukiramuco rya Devant Festival rya Paris mu 2016. Iyi filime kandi yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Cinematografiya mu iserukiramuco rya Filime ryabereye i Toronto.
Muri 2017, yayoboye filime ye ya gatanu ngufi "Pantheon". Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi ihitamo kumugaragaro kugirango yerekane iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika 2017, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Atlanta 2018 na Filmfest Dresden 2018. Filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Bridging the Borders muri Palm Springs International Festival ya Filime ngufi 2017. Muri uwo mwaka, filime yakiriye icyubahiro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Kolkata.

Ernest Napoleon, numurusiya - umukinnyi wa firime muri Tanzania.
Yavukiye i Moscou mu Burusiya kuri se wo muri Tanzaniya na nyina w'Uburusiya. Igihe yari afite imyaka 5, umuryango we wimukiye muri Tanzaniya. Amaze kuba i Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya imyaka 14 na Los Angeles imyaka 8, kuri ubu yimukiye i Stockholm, muri Suwede.
Afite imyaka 3, yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikinamico ya Noheri yise "Umwaka mushya muri" "New Year's in the old Soviet Union". Igihe yari muri Tanzaniya, yakoraga kuri EATV, televiziyo nini muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba icyo gihe. Yakinnye kandi nkumu DJ muri 'Club Billicanas', club izwi cyane muri Afrika aho yabaye umuhanzi ufata amajwi ya Bongo Flava, injyana yumuziki muri Afrika yuburasirazuba. Yakoreyeyo ku izina rya 'MC Napo'.
Ernest akiri ingimbi, yimukiye i Los Angeles ahabwa impamyabumenyi ya mudasobwa. Hanyuma yize gukina no kwandika imyaka 7 akiri i Los Angeles. Abifashijwemo n'inshuti na bagenzi be, yakoze filime ye ya mbere ya "Going Bongo". Iyi filime yatewe inkunga n'ubuzima bw'abaganga babaga mu Bwongereza, Dr Lewis Burger, aho Ernest yakinnye. Filime ye ifatwa nka firime ya mbere mpuzamahanga yakozwe na Tanzaniya ndetse na film ya mbere yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba yemerwa na iTunes.
Muri 2017, yakoze film "Kiumeni" yafatiwe i Dar es Salaam. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma iza gutsindira ibihembo bibiri mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Zanzibar. Niwe washinze inzu itanga umusaruro, "Enigma Pictures". Muri 2017, yagizwe perezida wa 'D Street Media Group', isosiyete mpuzamahanga ikora no gukwirakwiza. Yakoze kandi TV Series "Mother City" na firime ya gatatu "Peponi". Muri icyo gihe, yafatanyije gukora filime yo mu Bwongereza "Reka Ntamuntu Umenye" izenguruka inkuru yukuri ivuga ku mugaragu w’umunyamerika.

Pablo García Pérez de Lara (yavutse 29 Ukwakira, 1970), ni umunya Esipanye ukora ndetse akandika filimi. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa documentaire nyafurika z"izwi cyane" nka Tchindas.
Yavutse mu 1970 i Barcelona, Espanye. Yize muri Centre d'Estudis Cinematogràfics de Catalunya (CECC).
Mu 1996, yatangiye gukina bwa mbere muri firime "Fuente Álamo, Caress of Time nkimpano" yumushinga watanzwe na Barcelona Alternativa festival. Yarangije filime muri 2001 hanyuma ahitamo muri SEMINCI muri Valladolid. Filime yari yatoranijwe kumugaragaro muri Karlovy Vary. Hanyuma muri 2007, yakoze firime "Butterfly" ikora igice cyemewe cya Karlovy Vary na San Sebastián. Muri 2015, yakoze documentaire yamamaye cyane "Tchindas" afatanya na Marc Serena. Yatoranijwe mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime kandi yegukana ibihembo 14 mpuzamahanga. Film nyuma yatsinze Outfest 's Grand Jury Award for Excellence mu sinema.
Mu 2002, yakoze filime ngufi "Alicia Portrayed" yatoranijwe muri Cannes Festival's Critics 'Week 2003. Hagati aho, Pablo yakoze documentaire ebyiri "Son de Galicia" muri 2006 na "Mura, un poble de cine" muri 2010 kuri tereviziyo. Nyuma yaje gukora nka "cinemateri wa" documentaire Familystrip yamenyekanye cyane muri 2009. Muri 2011, yakoze documentaire "Oblidant a Nonot". Yakiriye igihembo cya City of Alcalá muri Alcine 2011, ndetse nigihembo cyabateze amatwi muri l'Alternativa de Barcelona 2011 na Filime ngufi nziza mu rurimi rw'amarenga muri Cinemobile de Sevilla 2011. Noneho muri 2012, yabaye umukinnyi wa "cinemateri wa film El efecto K. El montador de Stalin" yerekanwe mumunsi mukuru 60 mpuzamahanga kwisi.

Stefanos Pavlakis (yavutse 1974), ni umukinnyi n'umwanditsi wa filimi ukomoka mu Bugereki. Yagize uruhare runini muri sinema ya Bénin akora documentaire zizwi cyane,"The Eye of the Beholder", "Studio Harmattan" and "Drive Through"
Muri 2003, yarangije impamyabumenyi ya BA muri Film &amp; Photography muri kaminuza ya Edinburgh Napier. Hanyuma muri 2005, yarangije MFA nyuma aza kubona Ph.D. muri kaminuza ya Dundee, Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art and Design.
Mu mwaka wa 2009, yatangiye gukorana n’amasosiyete abiri akorera mu mujyi wa Berlin 'Expedere', 'Uruganda rw’Inkuru' maze akora documentaire ngufi, amatangazo n'ibikorwa byerekana.

Pablo César (yavutse 26 Gashyantare 1962) ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Arijantine. Yagize uruhare muri sinema muri Afurika akora firime zizwi cyane "Equinox, Ubusitani bwa Roza", "Los dioses de agua" na "Aphrodite,"mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika.
Yavutse ku ya 26 Gashyantare 1962 i Buenos Aires, muri Arijantine. Ni umwarimu muri Fundación Universidad del Cine Buenos Aires kuva mu 1992.
Ku myaka 6, César yatangiye gukora urwenya. Hanyuma afite imyaka 10, yanditse kandi asohora akanyamakuru ke ka mbere. Nyuma yaje kuyigurisha ku ishuri ribanza, Champagnat College. Mu 1975, musaza we José María, yamuhaye amashusho yakoresheje cyane. Hanyuma mu 1977, yanditse inyandiko akora firime ngufi. Hagati aho mu 1980, yahawe igihembo cya mbere mu cyiciro cya "Experimental" mu marushanwa ya Rosario Foto-Cine Ateneo kubera filime ye ngufi "Del génesis". Filime ngufi kandi yavuzweho ibihembo byiza byo gutunganya no guhabwa igihembo cya gatatu (nta cyiciro) mubakora amafilime ya Círculo de Mar del Plata hamwe na UNCIPAR. Mu 1983, yakoze filime "De las caras de los espejos" maze filime yegukana igihembo cya mbere cya UNICA, Umuryango mpuzamahanga w’amafirime yabatarabigize umwuga murii uwo mwaka.
Azwiho kuba intangarugero mu gutunganya amafilime hagati y’ibihugu byinshi na Arijantine nka Tuniziya, Mali, Benin, Angola, Etiyopiya, Ubuhinde na Namibiya. Mu 1991, yakoze filime yamamaye cyane yitwa "Equinox, the Garden of the Roses" hamwe na Tuniziya. Hanyuma mu 1996, yafatanije nu Buhinde gukora "Unicorn," "the Garden of the Fruits". Mu 1998, yakoze firime "Aphrodite," afatanya na Mali.
Yashyizwe kandi mu nama y'abacamanza mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime birimo, Amiens (Ubufaransa), Iserukiramuco rya Sinema rya Montreal (Kanada), Kelibia (Tuniziya), Huy (Ububiligi), Hyderabad (Ubuhinde), FESPACO (Burkina Faso), na Villa Carlos Paz. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yari mu ntumwa zajyanye na Perezida wa Arijantine Cristina Kirchner muri Angola. Nyuma y’amasezerano y’ubufatanye bw’umuco yashyizweho umukono na guverinoma zombi, César yayoboye filime "The Water Gods", ivugwa ko ari yo ya mbere yatunganijwe muri sinema hagati ya Arijantine na Angola.
Muri 2018, yayoboye film "Pensando en él". Iyi filime ishingiye ku mubano uri hagati y’umusizi w’umuhinde watsindiye Nobel witwa Rabindranath Tagore n’umwanditsi wo muri Arijantine, Victoria Ocampo, ubwo basuraga Buenos Aires mu myaka ya za 1920.

Heidi Specogna (yavutse 5 Mutarama 1959) ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Busuwisi. Yagize uruhare muri sinema yo muri Amerika yepfo no muri Afrika akora firime zizwi cyane, "Das kurze Leben des José Antonio Gutierrez", "Cahier africain" na "Tupamaros".
Yavutse ku ya 5 Mutarama 1959 i Biel / Bienne, mu Busuwisi.
Yize mu ishuri ry’itangazamakuru i Zurich hanyuma akora nk'umunyamakuru mu bitangazamakuru bitandukanye byo mu Budage n'Ubusuwisi. Nyuma yize mu Ishuri rya Filime na Televiziyo mu Budage i Berlin kuva 1982 kugeza 1988. Amaze kurangiza muri iryo shuri, yabaye umwarimu muri Film Academy Baden-Württemberg ku ma firime ya documentaire kuva 2003. Mu 1985, filime ye ngufi ya "Traces" yatsindiye igihembo cya Bern.
Yibanze cyane kuri sinema yo muri Amerika y'Epfo na Afurika kubera gukina amashusho cyane cyane binyuze mu nzu ye bwite yashinzwe mu 1990. Mu 1991, yakinnye bwa mbere hamwe na documentaire "Tania la Guerillera" ivuga ku barwanyi bo muri Boliviya ' Tamara Bunke '. Mu 1993, yakoze filime "Rosa" ivuga ku bikorwa bitemewe n’umukoresha wa radiyo kuri Rote Kapelle. Hanyuma mu 1996 yakinnye nka "Tupamaros", umutwe w'inyeshyamba kuva Uruguay, muri documentaire y'izina rimwe.
Muri 2011 yakoze documentaire ya "Carte Blanche" yibanda kuri Repubulika ya Centrafrique. Filime ye "Ubuzima Bugufi bwa José Antonio Gutierrez" yatsindiye igihembo cya Film yo mu Busuwisi 2007 kubera documentaire nziza ndetse nigihembo cya Adolf Grimme. Hanyuma filime "Carte Blanche" yahawe igihembo cya filime nziza y’ururimi rw’ikidage i Duisburg mu 2011 nyuma iza guhabwa igihembo cy’itangazamakuru Gatolika. Filime "Goal hunter's ship" bwahawe igihembo cyabacamanza bagize urubyiruko muri Leipzig naho 'inkuru yumukobwa' yise "Esther und die Geister" yahawe igihembo cyuburenganzira bw’ikidage. Muri 2017, filime ye "Cahier Africain" ishingiye kuri Repubulika ya Centrafrique yibasiwe n’ibibazo, yakiriye igihembo cy’amafirime cy’Ubudage Lola, ndetse n’igihembo cy’amafirime yo mu Busuwisi kubera filime nziza mu bihembo by’Ubudage by’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, ndetse na the Silver Dove in Leipzig muri 2018 igihembo cya Adolf Grimme.
Muri 2019, Specogna yahawe igihembo cya Konrad Wolf muri Academy yubuhanzi. Muri 2020, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Solothurn ryeguriye gahunda idasanzwe “Rencontre” kuri Specogna kubera kwibuka uruhare rwe muri sinema nyafurika.

Arcade Assogba, ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Bene. Yagize uruhare runini muri sinema ya Bénin atanga amahugurwa menshi yo gutumanaho hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga mu birori bitandukanye by’umuco muri Bénin nko mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Ouidah ndetse n’ibirori mpuzamahanga bya Benin, Fitheb. Azwiho kandi kuba umuyobozi wa firime ngufi, "ZanKlan".
Kuva mu 2006 kugeza 2009, Assogba yize sinema muri Institut Cinématographique de Ouidah (ICO). Nyuma yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bumenyi bw’abantu n’imibereho yakuye muri kaminuza ya Paris 1 Pantheon Sorbonne naho impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko yakuye muri kaminuza ya Abomey-Calavi muri Bénin.
Assogba yatangiye umwuga wa sinema nkumuyobozi wungirije wa mbere kuri firime nyinshi zerekanwe muri Benin. Yakoranye n'abayobozi mpuzamahanga bazwi nka Sylvestre Amoussou, Jean Odoutan, Pablo César na Heidi Specogna na Pascale Obolo muri firime nyinshi. Muri 2018, yerekanwe bwa mbere mubuyobozi hamwe na documentaire "Crossing." "." ".". Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa firime, yakoze Short "ZanKlan" mumwaka umwe. Muri make yakiriwe neza nabanegura kandi yerekanwa kandi atsindira ibihembo mubirori byinshi bya firime. Muri 2019, film yatsindiye igihembo cya 2 cyiza muri Rebiap festival international de film, Benin.

Claire Andrade-Watkins, ni umunyamateka akaba n'umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka muri Cape Verdean na Amerika. Ni intiti itandukanye y’amateka nyafurika n yibanda ku mateka ya Amerika na Cape Verdean, ndetse n’Abafaransa nyuma y’abakoloni. Hagati aho, yitwaye neza muri sinema nyafurika ivuga Igiporutugali, sinema za diaspora ya Africana, hamwe na firime y'Abanyamerika b'Abirabura ndetse n'abayikora.
Yize muri Lincoln School Providence, abona impamyabumenyi ya BA muri Simmons College nyuma abona MA na Ph.D. wo muri kaminuza ya Boston.
Andrade-Watkins ni Umuyobozi washinze umushinga wa ' Fox Point Cape Verdean ', umushinga w’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu baturage mu 2007. Afite isosiyete ikora kandi igakwirakwiza, 'SPIA Media Productions, Inc.'. Yashinzwe mu 1998 kandi izobereye mu bitangazamakuru byo muri Afurika Diaspora.
Niwe mwarimu wa mbere wigisha amasomo yamabara muri kaminuza, akaba na Porofeseri wambere wuzuye wamabara muri Visual and Media Arts mbere yo kwimukira mu kigo cyubuhanzi bwa Liberal Arts &amp; Interdisciplinary Studies. Ni n'umwanditsi w'ibitabo byinshi birimo,"Society for Visual Anthropology", "Research in African Literature", "The Independent Film and Video Monthly", "American Historical Review", and "CinémActionn".

Francisco Manso (yavutse 28 Ugushyingo 1949), ni producer akaba n'umukinnyi wa filimi wo muri portigali. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane,"Napomuceno's Will", "" and "O Nosso Cônsul em Havana".
Yarangije amategeko muri kaminuza ya Lisbonne. Mu 1976, yarangije muri firime muri Centro de Arte e Comunicação Visual (Ar.Co) maze, mu 1979 kugeza 1980, arangiza amasomo y’ubuhanga bw’amajwi maze aba umuyobozi wungirije muri televiziyo rusange Rádio e Televisão de Portugal (RTP).
Mu 1978, yimukiye muri sinema nk'umuyobozi wungirije wa mbere wa filime "O Meu Nome É", iyobowe na Fernando Matos Silva. Ibyo byakurikiwe na "O Príncipe com Orelhas de Burro", iyobowe na António de Macedo, mu 1979. Mu 1980, yimukiye muri Gineya Bissau akora kuri filime "Acto dos Feitos da Guiné" iyobowe na Matos Silva. Mu mwaka wakurikiyeho, yasubiye muri Porutugali maze akora kuri filime "Guerra no Mirandum ya" Matos Silva yo mu 1981.
Nyuma yo gukora nk'umufasha imyaka myinshi, umurimo wa mbere wa Manso wo kuyobora ni 1983 hamwe na filimi ya televiziyo "A Epopeia dos Bacalhaus". Yahinduye kandi filime ye ya mbere yerekanwe kuri tereviziyo, "Terra Nova, Mar Velho", muri uwo mwaka. Iyo filime imaze gutsinda, yakomeje kuyobora filime na documentaire nka, "A Aposta" (1987), "Na Mão de Deus" (1989), "Nostalgia" (1994) na "O Espírito da Cor" (1994).
Mu 1997, Manso yakoze filime ye ya mbere yerekana sinema, "O Testamento do Senhor Napomuceno", ashingiye ku gitabo cyitwa "The Will Will and Testament of Senhor da Silva Araújo" cyanditswe na Germano Almeida kirwa cya Cape Verde. Filime yatanzwe ku rwego mpuzamahanga kandi yerekanwe mu minsi mikuru ya firime, ihabwa ibihembo byinshi harimo bitatu mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Gramado. Mu 2000, yakoze TV mini-serie "Almeida Garrett". Inyandiko ye, "Memórias de um rio - Avieiros, os nómadas do Tejo" mu 2004, yahawe igihembo cyihariye cya Lusophony mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 10 ry’ibidukikije - Cine Eco 2004.
Muri filime yakurikiyeho yakoresheje cyane cyane amateka, nka firime "O Último Condenado à Morte" ya 2008, yabayeho mugihe cya Revolution Liberal muri Portugal muri 1821/22. Mu mwaka wa 2011, yakoze filime "O Cônsul de Bordéus" yari ishingiye ku buzima bwa Aristides de Sousa Mendes ndetse n’ibikorwa yakoreye ikiremwamuntu mu gihe cyo gutoteza Abayahudi.

Marc Serena (wavutse 1983), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Espagne, umunyamakuru n'umwanditsi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire nyafurika "izwi cyane" nka Tchindas, "Peixos d'aigua dolça" na "Umwanditsi ukomoka mu Gihugu kitagira ibitabo".
Yavutse mu 1983 i Manresa, muri Espagne, ubu akaba atuye muri Barcelona.
Muri 2011 afite imyaka 25, yanditse igitabo "Urugendo kuri 25" cyagize amahirwe menshi muri Aziya. Nyuma yaje gusohoka mu ndimi eshanu zirimo Igishinwa n'Igikoreya. Muri 2014, Serena yasohoye "Un-African love?" ikusanya amajwi yibibazo aturuka mubihugu 15 bya Afrika. Hanyuma yayoboye urubuga rwa documentaire "Double Epidemic" muri 2015. Muri uwo mwaka, Serena yanditse kandi ayobora filime yamamaye cyane "Tchindas", afatanije na Pablo García Pérez de Lara. Film nyuma yatsinze Outfest 's Grand Jury Award for Excellence mu sinema.
Hamwe no gutsinda muri film, yakoze film ye itaha "Double Epidemic" mumwaka umwe. Muri 2018, yayoboye filime "Peixos d'aigua dolça" hanyuma "Umwanditsi wo mu Gihugu kitagira amaduka y'ibitabo" muri 2019. Hagati aho, muri 2009, blog ye yahawe na Lonely Planet nka blog nziza yingendo zitari Icyongereza.

Alexis Tsafas (yavutse 1956), ni producer numukinnyi wa filimi wo mubugereki. Yagize uruhare runini muri sinema ya Cape Verde akora firime zizwi cyane, "A menina dos olhos grandes", "Tunnel" na "Zenaida".

Júlio Silvão Tavares (yavutse 1959), niUmukinnyi wa firime muri Cape Verdean.
Kuva mu 1979, yize umuco gakondo wa Cape-verdean, aho yashinze Itsinda rya Theatre Experimental igihe yari producer numuyobozi wa gahunda yumuco 'Dragoeiro' yatambutse kuri Televisão de Cabo Verde (TCV) kuva 1993 kugeza 1997. Kuva 1994 kugeza 1996, Tavares yari umuyobozi wa gahunda yumuco 'Articultura' kuri Rádio de Cabo Verde (RCV). Ni n'umuyobozi wa sosiyete ikora firime yitwa 'Silvão-Produção Filmes' yashinze mu 2004.
Hagati aho, yakoze firime "O Desafio" mu 1999. Mu 2005, yerekanwe bwa mbere muri firime na "Batuque, Alma de um Povo".Ku itsinda rya muzika rya batuque Raiz di Tambarina, n'imizi y'iyi njyana ya muzika i Santiago, Cape Verde. Iyi filime yerekanwe i Lisbonne mu Gushyingo 2010, nyuma yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Diana C. Zollicoffer (wavutse 1977), ni umukinnyi wa filime muri Seychellois akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime ukora cyane mu nganda za firime z'ubuhinde. Azwi cyane nka producer wibikorwa byamamaye cyane nka "Schmoolie the Deathwatcher", "Bridget na Iain" na "Bayou yibagiwe".
Yarangije muri Duke Ellington School of Arts, Washington DC.

Mosonngoa ni filimi yo muri Mosotho yasohotse 2014 ikaba filime ngufi iyobowe na Lemohang Yeremiya Mosese kandi yakozwe na Hannah Stockmann. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Siphiwe Nzima-Ntskhe mu mwanya wa mbere mu gihe Masele Tokane, Chaka Phehlamarole Khalechene na Retselisitsoe Sekake bagize uruhare runini.
Filime yakiriwe neza nabayinenga kandi yerekanwa mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Tseko Monaheng, numukinnyi wa filimi muri Mosotho. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri filime "This Is Not a Burial, It's a Resurrection", "Five Fingers for Marseilles" and short film "Behemoth: Or the Game of God".
Mu 2005, Monaheng yavumbuwe n'umukinnyi w'inararibonye akaba na producer, Silas Monyatsi mu gihe cyo kwerekana ikinamico ya SIDA "Ke Khetho Eaka". Nyuma yaho mu mwaka, yakoze mu filimi ngufi "Untitled" iyoborwa na Kaizer Matsumunyane. Hagati aho, yakinnye mu makinamico menshi ya radiyo kuri SIDA. Mu mwaka wa 2006, yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikinamico yo muri Afurika y'Epfo hamwe na Soul City's "Untitled Stories" harimo "Mapule's Choice" na "Monna Motsamai".
Yakinnye kandi muri firime nyinshi za Mosotho harimo na Lemohang Yeremiya Mosese ya firime ngufi yamamaye cyane Behemoth: Cyangwa Umukino w'Imana nk'uruhare runini 'Umubwiriza'. Hamwe no gutsinda muri make, yahise atoranyirizwa mumushinga utaha wa Mosese"" muri 2019. Filime yerekanwe no mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Yakinnye kandi muri firime "zaho: Kau la poho" (2008) na "Lilaphalapha".
Muri 2017, Monaheng yakinnye muri firime yo muri Afrika yepf. Yabigizemo uruhare nk'umupolisi urya ruswa. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi ihitamo kwerekanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto (TIFF) kuva ku ya 7 kugeza ku ya 17 Nzeri 2017. Muri 2018, yatangiriye kuri tereviziyo yo muri Afrika yepfo hamwe nikinamico "Rhythm City". Icyakora, yageragejweho uruhare mu Kwakira 2017. Monaheng kandi yifatanyije na productions ku: "Mantsopa" na "Qomatsi" ndetse bitandukanye 'Lesedi' FM darame radiyo.

Behemoth: Or the Game of God poster
Behemoth: Or the Game of God ni filimi yo muri Mosotho yasohotse 2020 ikaba filime ngufi y'amayobera iyobowe na Lemohang Yeremiya Mosese kandi yayikoranye na Hannah Stockmann. Muri filime hagaragaramo Tseko Monaheng nka 'Umubwiriza' mu mwanya wa mbere.
Filime yakiriwe neza nabayireba kandi yerekanwa mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime.

Aletta Bezuidenhout (yavutse ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1949, 13 Gashyantare 2024), ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Kenya wavukiye muri Kenya, umwanditsi akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime. Akora azwi muri productions ya:"Weerskant die Nag", "Committed" and "Spoon", "Lament for Koos" and "Mother Courage"."."
Yavutse ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1949 i Nairobi muri Kenya. Se yari injeniyeri. Yakoraga mu Nama Njyanama ya Transvaal yubuhanzi (Truk). Yatoje kandi arangiza BA Drama muri kaminuza ya Cape Town.
Yashakanye n'umucuranzi Colin Shamley, icyo gihe umukinnyi Tertius Meintjes nyuma na Anthony Perris.
Yize ikinamico muri kaminuza ya Cape Town nyuma atangira umwuga we wo gukina i Kruik. Nyuma, yimukiye muri old Transvaal akora muri Sosiyete na Theatre y'Isoko. Hagati aho, yakoraga mu nama nyinshi zo mu karere zishinzwe ubuhanzi, nka 'Truk en Kruik'. Nyuma yaje gutangira gutoza abandi bakinnyi.
Mu 1970, yagaragaye muri "The Space" nyuma aza gukorana na "Dusa Stas Fish" na "Vi", "The Resistible Rise of Arturo UI" and "Treats". Mu 1974, yashinze isosiyete ikora, 'The Company'. Hagati aho, yagize uruhare mu ikinamico akina amakinamico nka "Desire", "Mother Courage" in 1977, "Women of Troy", "Lament for Koos" and "The Minotaur's Sister" mu 1985.
Usibye gukina, yakoraga nk'umwanditsi w'amakinamico kandi akora "Time of Footsteps", "Silent Envelope", "Angel in a Dark Room" and "Little Big Worl". Muri ecran ya tereviziyo, yakoraga kuri serial "The Lady of the Camellias", "Thicker than Water" and "Die Sonkring and Orion". Some of her popular films include: "Djadje", "Committed", "On the Wire", "Country of My Skull" and "Paljas."

Amr El-Bayoumi (wavutse 1965), ni Umunyamisiri n'Umunyamerika akaba n'umuhanzi wijwi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Kapiteni Phillips","The Fifth Estate" and "Psychosis"..
Yavutse mu 1965 i Alegizandiriya, mu Misiri. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Bailey i East Lansing, muri Leta ya Michigan. Kuri ubu abarizwa i Washington DC n'Umujyi wa New York. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko, yimukiye i Los Angeles maze ahabwa akazi ko kuba injeniyeri.
Yakinnye ibitaramo byinshi muri Amerika, Ubwongereza, na Misiri. Muri 2008, yakinnye muri firime ngufi "11 Missed Calls" yamufunguye kugirango yerekane impano ye. Hanyuma muri 2009, yatoranijwe kubindi bigufi "NASA and the Space Pen" nka 'abavuga'. Nyuma yandi mafirime abiri: "Drift" na "Loose End", El-Bayoumi yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime hamwe na firime ya "gatanu ya" 2013. Muri filime, yakinnye nka 'General'. Mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2013, yashoboye kwigaragaza muri Amerika "Kapiteni Phillips" nk'umunyamuryango wa Maersk Alabama.
Yagaragaye muri serivise nyinshi zizwi cyane kuri tereviziyo zo muri Amerika mu bihe byashize zirimo: "House of Cards", "Mr. Robot", "The Blacklist", "Madam Secretary", "Quantico" and "Person of Interest".

Garth Breytenbach (yavutse 14 kamena 1979), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "", "Beyond the River" and "Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom".
Yavukiye i Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yakoraga i Londres, akora umwuga wo kwakira abashyitsi. Ariko, nyuma yaje kwimurirwa mu gukina amashusho. Yize rero arangiza muri CityVarsity School of Media Studies, Cape Town. Hanyuma yize muri Creative Arts College, kugirango arangize Impamyabumenyi yo gukina Kamera.
Ishyaka rye ryo gukina ryaje ubwo yitabiraga amakinamico i Cape Town ndetse na Festival ya Grahamstown. Garth yaremye Mugaragaza ye gukinira mu 1993 na benshi muri Afurika y'Epfo "mayaruka" serial. Muri iyi filimi, yagize uruhare ruto rwa 'Jacques Venter'. Muri 2005, yakinnye muri mini-seri, "Triangle" iyobowe na Craid R Baxley. Hanyuma yakoze uruhare rukunzwe 'Pvt. Slug Skinner 'muri 2008 yerekanwe kuri videwo ya "Starship Troopers 3: Marauder". Kuva mu 2014, yagaragaye kuri filimi rusange akina na "Black Sails" nyuma muri "Deutschland 86" (2018).
Muri 2017, yakinnye muri mini-serie ya "Madiba" na firime "Beyond The River". Icyakora uruhare rwe rwamamaye cyane muri 2017 rwanyuze muri firime yamafirime yuburengerazuba bwa Afrika yepfo 5 "Fingers For Marseilles" hamwe ninshingano 'Officer De Vries'. Muri 2013, yagaragaye kuri film "Long Walk to Freedom" ahanganye na Idris Elba. Muri 2018, yakinnye nka 'Ajax', umurwanyi w'Ubugereki muri BBC na Netflix mini-seriyeri "Troy: Fall Of A City" (2018).
Azwiho kandi gukina amakinamico yamateka nka "Mandela:Long Walk to Freedom", "Winnie Mandela", "Verraaiers" and "Goodbye Bafana". Usibye uruhare rukomeye, Garth yanagaragaye mu nshingano zo gusetsa, cyane cyane muri seriveri ya "Hammerhead TV", irimo abakinnyi bazwi cyane Bevan Cullinan, Brendan Jack na Chris Forrest

Veena Sood (yavutse 21 Ugushyingo), ni umuturage wa Kenya ariko uba Canada,akina filime afite Indian Punjabi mubisekuru bye. Veena azwi cyane mubikorwa byikinamico no gusetsa mu mwuga umaze imyaka irenga 3.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Yavutse ku ya 21 Ugushyingo i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Se yari umuganga na nyina, umuforomo. Igihe yari afite imyaka 7, bimukiye muri Kanada. Afite imyaka 16, yarangije amashuri yisumbuye nyuma afite imyaka 20, arangiza kaminuza afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse y’ubuhanzi.
Murumuna we Manoj Sood nawe ni umukinnyi, mugihe murumuna we mubyara we Ashwin Sood (mbere yashakanye numuririmbyi uzwi cyane Sarah McLachlan) numucuranzi. Umwishywa we Kama Sood ni umukinnyi wa firime ufite icyicaro i Vancouver, BC.
Yashakanye na J. Johnson ku ya 30 Kanama 2008.
Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse y’ubuhanzi mu bijyanye n’ikinamico rya Drama, Veena yafashije mu gushinga 'Loose Moose Theatre Company' ya Calgary hamwe na shebuja Improv Keith Johnstone, nyuma aza gukorana na Vancouver TheatreSports League. Mu 1991, yatsindiye igihembo cya Jessie kubera ibikorwa by'indashyikirwa kubera uruhare rwe muri Green Thumb Theatre ikina "2 B Wut UR". Mu mwaka wa 2006, yahawe igihembo cya Leo kubera Abashyitsi bitwaye neza n’Umugore muri Dramatic Series yatsindiye kubera 'Preety' mu gice cya Godiva cyitwa "Flipping Switches".
Yagaragaye muri firime nyinshi; Imagine Entertainment's "Wedding Season", "Welcome to Marwen" (Robert Zemeckis), Corner Office, "The X-Files", "BattleStar Galactica", "Caprica", "Stargate", "Away", "Peacemaker", "Lucifer", "A Million Little Things," na firime nyinshi za tereviziyo. Afite impano mubikorwa bye byo gusetsa, Mu mwaka wa 2006, yakinnye muri filime "Nina's Heavenly Delights" aho avugana n’imvugo ya Scottish / Ubuhinde. Hagati aho, yagaragaye kuri tereviziyo y'Abanyamerika, cyane cyane kuri filimi 3 zikurikirana za siyanse yo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru: "X-Files" mu 1993, "Stargate SG-1" mu 1997 na "Smallville" mu 2001. Uruhare rwe muri filime "Touch of Pink", yakiriwe neza muri Festival ya Sundance.
Akenshi avugwa nkumukinnyi wikinamico wamamaye wakinnye muri firime zizwi nka "The Accused", "Loyalties", "The Women of Marwen".. Yitwaye neza kandi muri serivise za tereviziyo:: "Ghost Wars", "The Indian Detective", "Corner Gas" "Animated" ndetse no murubuga rwa "Yoga Town".
Yakiriye icyubahiro cyinshi muri Alliance ya Sinema yo muri Kanada, Televiziyo na Radiyo harimo igihembo cya Lorena Gale Woman Of Distinction Award mu Gushyingo 2017 ndetse n’igihembo cya Sam Payne kubera uruhare mu bantu no kuba inyangamugayo mu 2014. Muri 2019 yahawe igihembo n'ikigega gishinzwe ubuhanzi ku nkombe y'Amajyaruguru (FANS) igihembo cy'umuhanzi w'icyubahiro kubera kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu ikinamico.

Fadia Stella (yavutse 30 Ukuboza 1974), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Kenya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime Caramel (film) na "Déjà mort".
Yavutse ku ya 30 Ukuboza 1974 i Nairobi, muri Kenya.
Mu 1998, yakinnye bwa mbere muri filime "Déjà mort" afite uruhare ruto nka 'inshuti ya Alain'. Nyuma muri 2007, yakinnye cyane muri firime "Caramel". Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 20 Gicurasi muri 2007 Iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes mu gice cy’abayobozi ba Fortnight. Nyuma, film yakinnye no muri "Caméra d'Or". Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi ikwirakwizwa mu bihugu birenga 40.

Ruth Ndulu Maingi (yavutse 22 Gicurasi 1983), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Kenya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "18 hours","The Distant Boat" na "Midlife Crisis".
Yavutse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 1983 i Machakos, muri Kenya nk'uwa kane mu muryango hamwe na bavandimwe be batandatu. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Kathiani na Township School Primary School i Machakos. Yarangije impamyabumenyi mu bwishingizi nyuma y'amashuri yisumbuye.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo kubyina. Ariko, nyuma yaje kwimukira mu buhanzi kugira ngo akore umwuga maze yinjira mu ishuri ry’imyidagaduro ry’igihugu cya Kenya imyaka ibiri. Muri 2007, yinjiye mu bitaramo bya Kigezi Ndoto. Hanyuma muri 2008, yimukiye mu Buhinde "akinira" "Sauti Kimya" na Githaa.
Muri 2011 yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime na "Marshal yo muri Finlande". Muri uwo mwaka, yatoranijwe kugira ngo ayobore muri televiziyo "Lies that Bind", byatangiye kuri televiziyo. Muri uruhererekane, yakinnye 'Salome', umugore wa gatatu n'urukundo nyarwo rwa Richard Juma, n'umugore wa gatatu. Noneho muri 2013, yakinnye mu ikinamico izwi cyane ya Swahili "Mama Duka" afite uruhare runini. Ku ruhare rwe, yaje guhabwa icyubahiro muri 2014 Magic Magic Viewers Choice Awards 2014.
Yagize uruhare runini nk'umutoza muri serivise ya tereviziyo "The Team", hamwe na Media Focus kuri Afrika yakozwe na Dreamcatcher. Muri 2014, yakinnye muri firime ebyiri: "The Next African Film Maker" na "Orphan". Muri 2018, yakinnye bwa mbere muri Nollywood muri firime "Family First" iyobowe na Lancelot Imasuen.

Anthony Oluwakayode Oseyemi (yavutse 17 Mutarama 1977), ni umwongereza akaba umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika yepfo ukomoka muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri firime na teleserial ', ' and "Isidingo".. Usibye gukina, ni n'umwanditsi, umucuranzi na producer.
Yavutse ku ya 17 Mutarama 1977 mu Bwongereza mu muryango wa Nigeriya. Nyuma yaje kwimukira muri Afurika y'Epfo. yakuye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n'ubuhanzi muri kaminuza ya Londere y'Amajyaruguru. Yarangije icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu Bwongereza. Amaze kwiga, yasubiye muri Afurika y'Epfo arahatura.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina kuri stage mu rwego rwo gukinisha urubyiruko rwa Lewisham. Hanyuma yakoze ibitaramo byingirakamaro kumugezi murwego rwo kwerekana imurikagurisha mpuzamahanga ryabereye i Londres. Yakinnye kandi muri Tricycle theatre na Albany hamwe na Project Phakama. Hagati aho, yagize uruhare runini mu ikinamico "Amen Corner" yakozwe na James Baldwin. Yafatanije kandi gukina "Performance" hamwe na Multi media production aho yanagize uruhare. Muri kiriya gihe, yanagize uruhare mu bashyitsi kuri televiziyo nka ITV ya "The Bill" (2003) ndetse n'ikinamico ry'ubuvuzi rya "Holby City" (2005).
Kuva 2002 kugeza 2003, yagize uruhare rugaruka muri serie "Is Harry On the Boat?" no muri 2005, yakinnye umushyitsi mugice cyiswe "Viva Liberty" murukurikirane "rwurwenya Coming Up" kuri seri ya 4. Nyuma kubona arts impamyabumenyi ye Performing, akora inshingano iya mbere mu filimi nyinshi harimo: "Jacobs musaraba," "Room 9," "Traffick" na "Isidingo." Yakinnye kandi muri seri, "Wild at heart", "The runaway", "Strike back", and "The Book of Negroes". Muri 2012, yagaragaye mugice cya e.tv ya antologiya ya "Mzansi Urukundo: Ekasi Style".
Muri 2017, yakinnye cyane muri 'Congo' muri filime "Five Fingers for Marseilles" muri Afurika yepfo y’iburengerazuba bwa Marseilles iyobowe na Michael Matthews. Nyuma yaje kwerekanwa mu gice cya Discovery mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto 2017 kandi ryishimiwe cyane. Hagati aho, yanakinnye muri comedi y'urukundo "Hectors Search for Happiness", hanyuma muri Amerika yerekana amashusho "Team 8: Behind Enemy Lines '."
Usibye gukina, yanditse kandi ibiganiro bya tereviziyo ya Afrika yepfo "Tempy Pushas" kuri SABC 1. Hanyuma yanditse urukurikirane rw'icyumba "cya 9" rumuha ibihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo bya Afurika y'Epfo muri 2014 ndetse anaba umunyamuryango wa mbere.

Joy Anwulika Alphonsus (yavutse 31 Kanama 1987), uzwi cyane nka Joy Alphonsus, ni umukinnyi wa filimi wavukiye muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwa titre muri firime " yatsindiye ibihembo.
Yavutse ku ya 31 Kanama 1987 muri Nijeriya. Ubu aba muri Otirishiya.
Yagaragaye bwa mbere muri sinema muri 2018 hamwe na firime yerekana " muri Otirishiya iyobowe na Sudabeh Mortezai. Muri filime yakinnye umwanya wa titre. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 30 Kanama 2018 mu rwego rwo kwerekana iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 75 rya Venice. Filime yaje gutumirwa mu gice cya Giornate degli Autori. Filime yerekanwe kandi itangwa mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Mu Gushyingo 2018, Alphonsus yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Seville. Muri Mutarama 2019 yahawe igihembo cya Max Ophüls muri Saarbrücken kubera uruhare rwe; muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye igihembo cyo gukina Diagonale. Muri 2020, yahawe igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza wumugore muri Australiya.

Aubrey Poolo (yavutse 30 Ugushyingo 1976), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime ', ' and "Madiba"..
Yavutse ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 1976 i Attredgeville, umujyi wa Pretoria, Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango w'abanyapolitiki. Yarezwe na nyirakuru abifashijwemo n'abasaza ba Pan Africanist Congress of Azania (PAC).
Akiri muto cyane, yinjiye muri gahunda ya tereviziyo "Legae la bana". Muri 2010, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime "". Filime yerekanwe mu gice cya Un Certain Regard mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2010. Yatoranijwe kandi nk'iyinjira muri Afurika y'Epfo muri Filime nziza y'ururimi rw'amahanga mu bihembo bya 83 hanyuma ikora urutonde rwa nyuma rwatangajwe muri Mutarama 2011. Intsinzi ya firime, yatoranijwe muri televiziyo yo muri Amerika yo muri 2017 ya "Madiba" kugira ngo agire uruhare ruto.
Muri 2017, yakinnye cyane 'Unathi' muri firime yo muri Afrika yepfo yuburengerazuba bwa firime yitwa "Fingers for Marseilles" iyobowe na Michael Matthews. Nyuma yaje kwerekanwa mu gice cya Discovery mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto 2017 kandi ryishimiwe cyane.

Mduduzi Mabaso (yavutse 1 Mata 1976), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime na teleserial "Blood Diamond", "Machine Gun Preacher" na "Hotel Rwanda".
Yavutse mu 1976 i Alexandra, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yamaze imyaka 3 y'ubwana bwe muri Transkei.
Yabanje gushyingiranwa na Veronica Maseko kandi bombi bafite abana babiri. Nyuma yashakanye na mugenzi we bakina filime, Fatima Metsileng. Mabaso yamusanze mugihe cya shampiyona ya kabiri ya "Zone 14" muri 2007. Bashyingiwe nyuma yimyaka mike babyara abana babiri. Rero, afite abana bane: Ntokozo, Mpumi, Njabulo na Zolile.
Mu 1992, yagaragaye bwa mbere mu ikinamico "Divide na Rule". Mu 2004, yatangiye gukina filime muri firime y'Abanyamerika "Hotel Rwanda" iyobowe na Terry George. Iyi filime yari ishingiye kuri jenoside yo mu Rwanda, yabaye muri mata 1994. Hanyuma yakinnye mubikorwa byinshi byunganira muri firime, "Catch a Fire", "Heartlines" and "Blood Diamond". Yakinnye kandi mumikino yo kuri stage: "Cry The Beloved Country", "Madiba’s Magic", "Behind the Curtains", "Shaka Zulu" and "Tasha On The Rocks".
Muri 2006, yagize uruhare runini muri make "Sekalli le Meokgo" iyobowe na Tebho Mahlatsi. Iyi filime yaje guhabwa Filime ngufi nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Durban 2007.
Mu 2007, yatumiriwe gukina mu isonga kuri televiziyo yo muri Afurika y'Epfo "Rhythm City". Yakinnye nka 'Suffocate Ndlovu'. yakoze premier yayo kuri tereviziyo yubusa kuri televiziyo e.tv ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2007. Uruhererekane rugenda rwerekanwa muri Afrika yepfo hamwe nibisobanuro byiza. Hagati aho, Mabaso yatsindiye igihembo cya Golden Horn igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu isabune ya TV hanyuma igihembo cya Golden Horn kikaba umukinnyi mwiza muri Filime yerekana uruhare rwe 'Ndlovu' muri serial.

Amr Arafa (yavutse 9 Ukuboza 1962), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Egiputa. Ufatwa nk'umwe mu bakora amafilime meza muri sinema yo mu Misiri, Arafa azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filime zatsindiye ibihembo bya "Africano", "Zahaymar", "Helm Aziz" na "Akher Deek Fi Masr".
Yavutse ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1962 i Cairo, mu Misiri. Se Saad Arafa nawe yari umukinnyi wa firime cyane. Saad yavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1923, apfa ku ya 1 Nyakanga 1998. Yakoze firime nyinshi zizwi mu gisekuru cye nka "Al E'iteraf", "Marzooka" na "Demoua 'Fi Lailat El Zefaf".
Mukuru wa Amr, Sherif Arafa nawe ni umukinnyi wa firime uzwi cyane mu Misiri. Yavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1960. Muri firime ze zizwi cyane harimo, "Birds of Darkness", "Mafia", "Halim" na "Welad El Am".
Mu 2005, Arafa yimukiye muri Amerika kugira ngo arangize amashuri. Hanyuma yamaze igihe kinini muri Amerika imyaka 11 mumashuri yigihe gito. Yashinze kandi isosiyete ye bwite ishinzwe imicungire y’ubucuruzi, nyuma yizeza ikarita y’icyatsi mu 2015.
Yatangiye umwuga wa sinema mu 1983 akurikiza inzira ya se. Mu 1991, Amr yashinze uruganda rwe bwite, FinalCut Film Production. Kuva icyo gihe, yakoze kandi ayobora firime nyinshi, iyamamaza, serivise za televiziyo na documentaire.
Mu 2001, yayoboye kandi atunganya filime ye ya mbere ya "Africano". Iyi filime yafatiwe muri Afurika y'Epfo kandi yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2001 mu Misiri. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma ikerekanwa mu bihugu bya Afurika byegeranye ndetse no mu Burayi. Muri Koweti, iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2001 mu gihe mu Bugereki, yasohotse muri Archive Film Archive ku ya 28 Gashyantare 2012.
Nyuma yo gutsinda filime yumukobwa, yakomeje gukora umwuga wo kuyobora neza muri firime: "Akher Deek Fi Masr" (2017), "Men 30 Sana" (2016), Urukurikirane rwa TV "Saraya Abdeen" (2015), "Abu El Nil" (2013), "Helm Aziz" (2011), "Zahaymar" (2010), "Ibin el-Qunsul" (2009), "El Shabah" (2008), "Gaaltany Mogreman" (2006) na "El Sefara Fel Emara" (2004).

Likarion Wainaina (yavutse 20 Kanama 1987), ni umuRussiya uturuka Kenya ukina filimi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filimi ngufi izwi cyane "Between the Lines" na "Bait" ndetse na filime ya Kenya yahawe ibihembo byinshi mu mateka, "Supa Modo". Usibye gukora firime, ni n'umukinnyi wa sinema, umwanditsi na producer.
Yavutse ku ya 20 Kanama 1987 i Moscou, mu Burusiya ku babyeyi bava Kenya. Igihe yari afite imyaka ine, yimukiye muri Kenya n'umuryango we. Afite mushiki we na barumuna be babiri.
Yatangiye akora firime hanyuma yimukira mu ikinamico. Yabaye umunyamuryango wa theatre ya Phoenix Players i Nairobi kuva 2007. Nyuma yaje gukora nk'umuyobozi w'ikinamico. Hagati aho, yanakoraga mu nganda za firime nka gaffer na cinematografi. Nkumukinnyi wa cinemateri yakoraga kuri documentaire nyinshi, kwamamaza no kuri televiziyo. Muri 2013, yashinze isosiyete Kibanda Pictures.
Muri 2013, yakoze firime ngufi "Between the Lines" yaje kuba Filime ya mbere yo muri Kenya yerekanwe kuri ecran ya IMAX muri Kenya. Muri make yakiriwe neza hanyuma atorwa muri AMCVA awards 2015 igihembo cyiza cya Media Media Award. Hanyuma yayoboye filime ngufi "Bait" muri 2015, yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime Amasaha 48. Ifoto yatsindiye kandi ibihembo byinshi birimo Umuyobozi mwiza, ibihembo byabateze amatwi hamwe nigihembo cyabacamanza. Yatoranijwe kandi nka imwe muri firime ngufi zerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2016. Muri 2018, yakoze firime ngufi, "My Faith", yatsindiye Filime Nziza yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Mashariki.
Muri 2018, yatangiye gukina filime ya "Wavamizi". Hanyuma muri uwo mwaka, yerekanwe bwa mbere muri firime na "Supa Modo", yamamaye cyane. Filime yagaragaye bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 68 rya Berlin. Nyuma yaje gutoranywa nkumunyakenya winjira muri Filime nziza yindimi zamahanga mu bihembo bya 91 bya Academy, ariko ntibyatoranijwe. Hamwe nibi bihembo byose, film ibaye firime yahawe ibihembo byinshi muri Kenya kandi ikunzwe nabanegura.
Yakoraga kuri tereviziyo yamamaza amata ya Pascha na Santa Maria. Yayoboye Filime icyenda za Magic Magic Original Films (AMOF) hamwe na sitcom ya TV yitwa "Classmates". Muri 2016, yakoze filimi "Auntie Boss!" cyanyuze kuri NTV nyuma y'urupfu rw'umuyobozi wambere Derrick Omfwoko Aswani. Hagati aho, yari umukinnyi wa sinema amashusho yindirimbo za Sarabi Band yakoze 'Tumechoka' na 'Haujali' ndetse na cinematografi mumashusho yindirimbo 'Loneliness' yaririmbwe na Liron.

Hamilton Dhlamini (wavutse ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1969), rimwe na rimwe nka Hamilton Dlamini, ni umukinnyi wa filimi Afurika y'Epfo, umwanditsi w'amakinamico ndetse n'umukinnyi wa filime. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime na "teleserial Isithembiso", " The King's Messenger".
Yavutse ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1969 mu mudugudu wo mu cyaro i Sebokeng, muri Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango ufite ubukungu bubi.
Yashakanye ninzobere mu mirire, Martha, aho bafitanye abana batatu. Yabanje guhura na Marita muri lift.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina mu ntangiriro za 1984 abinyujije mu ikinamico. Yakinnye kandi nk'umucuruzi muri Koreya muri SABC 1 sitcom "Mzee Wa Two Six". Mu ntangiriro za 2008, yagize uruhare runini mu biganiro bigufi kuri SABC1, byahujwe "n’ikinamico ya King" Shakespeare ya William Shakespeare. Nanone, yakinnye cyane kuri SABC 2 sitcom "Stokvel" hamwe n " Mojo Khumalo '. Muri 2008, yakinnye muri serie "Ten Bush" iyobowe na Mncedisi Shabangu. Ku ruhare rwe, nyuma yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Naledi Theatre igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza. Hanyuma muri 2009, yakoranye na William Kentridge hamwe na Handspring Puppet Company kuri "Woyzeck muri Highveld".
Muri 2006, yakinnye muri firime ya Regardt van den Bergh "Kwizera nk'ibirayi". Kuri iyi nshuro, yatsindiye ibihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo byo muri Afurika yepfo (Safta) kubera umukinnyi ushyigikiye neza uruhare rwe. Muri 2007, yatsindiye igihembo cya Zahabu kubera Umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Filime. Muri 2018, yakinnye 'Banzi Motaung' muri televiziyo izwi cyane "Isithembiso". Muri uwo mwaka, yongeye gutsindira igihembo cya Golden Horn igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza muri opera yisabune ya TV 'Isithembiso'.
Yashinze kandi uruganda rwe rukora ibicuruzwa, 'Ndlondlo Productions'.

Hon. Jacqueline Muhongayire wavutse kuwa 28 kanama 1961 ni umwe mu badepete bahagarariye u Rwanda mu muryango w'ibihugu bya Afurika y'iburazirazuba kuva 2007 kungeza 2012, yagiye atorerwa manda ya kabiri ikaba yari kuzarangira muri 2017 aho yari afite icyicaro i Arusha muri Tanzania kandi ni umunyapolitike mu ntekoshinga amategeko y'u Rwanda
Hon. Jacquline Muhongayire yabaye Minisitiri wa EAC mu gihe kingana n'umwaka umwe kuva muri Nyakanga 2013. Mbere yaho yari imaze igihe kingana n'imyaka itanu ari umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga Amategeko umutwe wa Afurika y'iburasirazuba (EALA), Mbere yuko yereka muri (EALA) Hon. Jacquline Muhongayire yari amaze imyaka cumi n'ibiri (12) akora nk'umudepite, Kandi yari umwe mu bagore 12 bari mu inteko ishinga amategeko y'inzibacyuho.
Impamyabumenyi (Amashuri yize).
Hon.Jacqueline Muhongayire ku myaka 60, afite impamyabumenyi ya Kaminuza mu icungamari, kandi afite indi mpamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no gucunga imishinga, kandi ndetse Hon. Jacqueline Muhongayire Yize ibinganye na politike ndetse n'ububanyi n'amahanga muri kaminuza ya (Free University) y'iburuseli mu Bubiligi.
Hon. Jacqueline Muhongayire arubatse kandi afite abana batatu(3).

Maryam Touzani (yavutse ku ya 18 Nyakanga 1980), niUmukinnyi wa firime muri Maroc. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime yamamaye cyane "Adam".
Touzani yavutse mu 1980 i Tangier. Mu 2003, yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Masters mu Itumanaho n'Itangazamakuru i Londres. Hanyuma yatangiye umwuga we nkumunyamakuru yibanda kuri sinema.
Yashakanye na mugenzi we bakorana amafilime n’igifaransa-Maroc Nabil Ayouch.
Ubwa mbere, yakoraga nk'umwanditsi w'amashusho hanyuma akayobora firime ngufi na documentaire. Muri 2011, yakoze "Quand ils dorment". Yatsindiye ibihembo 17, harimo nk'abacamanza badasanzwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Huesca, iserukiramuco ryujuje ibisabwa na Oscars. Hanyuma muri 2014, yakoze documentaire ye ya mbere "Sous Ma Peau Vieille". Filime yamenyekanye cyane muri Maroc, yaganiriye ku buraya muri Maroc. Intsinzi yiyi documentaire, yayihinduye muri firime yerekana izina "Much Loved" byasohotse muri 2015. Filime yayobowe numugabo we Nabil Ayouch mugihe yakoze inyandiko.
Mu mpera za 2015, yakoze "plage ye ya kabiri Aya va à la plage". Filime irazenguruka mubindi bice byimibereho, kuriyi nshuro yerekeranye no gukoresha abana bato nkabakozi bo murugo.
Muri 2017, yanditse filime "Razzia" hamwe n'umugabo we, umuyobozi Nabil Ayouch. Yakinnye kandi 'Salima' muri filime. Hanyuma, muri 2019, Touzani yayoboye filime ye yambere, "Adam". Filime yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes mu gice 'Un Certain Regard'. Noneho nyuma muri Festival ya 12 International du Film Francophone de Namur ya Angoulême. Yatoranijwe nkuwinjiye muri Maroc muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga Mpuzamahanga mu bihembo bya 92 bya Academy, ariko ntiyatowe.
Muri uwo mwaka, yabaye umunyamuryango wa Academy ya Oscars.

Nashwa Mustafa (yavutse 15 Ukwakira 1968), ni umukinnyi wa firime mu Misiri. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "El-Rehla", "El-Farah" na "Mahmoud the Egyptian".
Yavutse ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1968 i Cairo, mu Misiri.
Yashakanye na Mohammed Emad, wabaga muri Amerika igihe kirekire. Icyakora yagarutse muri Egiputa gukora ubukwe bw'idini akurikije imigenzo yabo. Bashakanye mu 1993 babyarana abana babiri, Maryam na Abdulrahman. Umuhungu we Abdulrahman yashakanye muri Nyakanga 2019.
Yatangiye umwuga wa tereviziyo mu 1991 akoresheje "Conscience of Teacher Hikmat". Yakinnye 'Abeer' muri uru rukurikirane. Hanyuma mu 1999, yatangiye gukina filime na "El-Farah". Mu 2001, we yakoze mu ikundwa Misiri Adventure comedy film "Africano", aho yagize uruhare 'Zainab'. Iyi filime yasohotse mu ikinamico kandi yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2001 mu Misiri.
Muri 2013, yakiriye porogaramu ya tereviziyo "Cash Tagisi", yari verisiyo yo mu Misiri yerekana imikino mpuzamahanga yo mu Bwongereza "Cash Cab (umukino w’Abongereza)". Gahunda yatambutse kuri MBC Masr.
Muri 2017, yakoze gahunda ya tereviziyo"Three in One". Muri 2018, yakoze ikinamico ya "Selfie Ma'a el-Mot", yakinwe bwa mbere kuri Theatre ya Miami. Mbere ikinamico yitwaga "Selfie Ma'a Sayedna", ariko nyuma yaje guhinduka kubera inshingano zishami rishinzwe kugenzura itangazamakuru.

Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ambasaderi Christine NKULIKIYINKA yavutse ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1965. Ni umudipolomate w’u Rwanda akaba n'umukozi wa Leta.
Yize muri kaminuza ya Ludwigshafen y'ubumenyi ngiro kandi abona impamyabumenyi mu bucuruzi.
Kuva mu 1991 kugeza 2005, yakoraga muri Ambasade y'u Rwanda mu Budage, abanza kuba umuyobozi, nyuma aba umunyamabanga wa mbere akaba n'umujyanama wa Ambasade ya kabiri. Amaze gukorera muri Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga i Kigali, yatangiye akazi ko kuba umujyanama n’umusemuzi kugeza mu 2006.
Indimi avuga: Avuga Ikidage, Icyongereza, i Kinyarwanda, n’Igifaransa.
