NTWARI Gérard: Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda i Buruseli

Muhongayire Jacqueline
Muhongayire yavutse kuwa 28 Kanama 1961, yari umwe mu badepite bahagarariye u Rwanda mu Muryango w’Ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba kuva mu mwaka wa 2007 kugeza muri 2012. Yagizwe "ushinze ibikorwa by’Umuryango w’Ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba kuri uyu wa kane 11 Nyakanga 2013."
Muhongayire afite impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza mu icungamari, ndetse n’impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no gucunga imishinga.,Yize kandi ibijyanye na politiki n’ububanyi n’amahanga muri Kaminuza ya Free University y’i Buruseli mu Bubiligi.
Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 11 Nyakanga 2013, "Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda Paul Kagame yagize Muhongayire Jacqueline Minisitiri ushinze ibikorwa by’Umuryango w’Ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Muhongayire asimbuye Mukaruriza Monique wayoboraga iyi Minisiteri kuva yajyaho. Muhongayire yari umwe mu badepite bahagarariye u Rwanda mu Muryango w’Ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba kuva mu mwaka wa 2007 kugeza muri 2012, aho yaje gutorerwa manda ya kabiri ikaba yari kuzarangira muri 2017 aho yari afite icyicaro Arusha muri Tanzania. yabaye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Rwanda imyaka igera kuri 12 mbere yo kujya muri Muryango w’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, ndetse yagiye anashyirwa mu myanya ikomeye, kuko mu mwaka w’1995 yari umwe mu bagore 12 bari mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y’inzibacyuho mu Rwanda. Icyo gihe yari igizwe n’abadepite 70. Muhongayire, mbere y’uko ajya mu Nteko y’Umuryango w’Ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba.yabaye muri Forumu Nyarwanda y’abagore bari mu Inteko Ishinga Amategeko,"

Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Hadija Ndangiza Murangwa (wavutse 1975) numunyapolitiki wu Rwanda. Yari umujyanama ushinzwe ingamba mu kigo cy’abacungamari ba Leta bemewe mu Rwanda (ICPAR). Ni umusenateri mu nteko ishinga amategeko muri Sena y'u Rwanda, yashyizweho nu Rwanda.
Afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse (Masters) mu by'amategeko mpuzamahanga y’ubucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza ya McGill (2003) Montreal, muri Kanada
Imwe mu mirimo yakoze.
Hadija yari umunyamuryango wa Kigali International Arbitration Centre (KIAC) afite icyemezo cya Associate of the Chartered Institute of Arbitration (London).
Yari umujyanama ushinzwe ingamba no gutekana k'w inzego mu kigo cy’abacungamari ba Leta bemewe mu Rwanda (ICPAR).
Hadija Ndangiza Murangwa ni impuguke mu by'imisoro, n’umwuga mu by'amategeko, afite uburambe buhagije mu bijyanye n’ubujyanama bw’imisoro haba mu Rwanda ndetse no hanze yarwo aho yagiye agira inama inzego nyinshi zo mu karere nka "TradeMark" Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ndetse n'Ubunyamabanga bwa Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Ni umunyamuryango w’Ikigo Mpuzamahanga cy’Ubukemurampaka cya Kigali (KIAC). Yakoze akazi k’ubujyanama mu bigo mpuzamahanga nka International Finance Corporation (IFC), Umushinga wo guhuza imisoro muri EAC n’ibindi.
Yagiye mu nama z’ubutegetsi z’ibigo bitandukanye mu Rwanda nko muri Banki Itsura Amajyambere (BRD), Ishami rishinzwe ubuvuzi mu gisikare (MMI) no mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima (RBC)

Zethu Dlomo-Mphahlele (yavutse ku ya 31 Werurwe 1989), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika yepfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare 'Madi' muri televiziyo y'Abanyamerika "y'Abirabura".
Yavutse ku ya 31 Werurwe 1989 i Lenasia, intara ya Gauteng, Afurika y'Epfo. Nyuma yaje gukurira muri Mmesi Park, Dobsonville, Soweto. Yabanje kwiga mu Ishuri ryigihugu ryubuhanzi. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yarangije Impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu buhanzi bwa Dramatic muri kaminuza ya Witwatersrand.
Muri Nzeri 2018, yashakanye na mugenzi we umaze igihe kinini bakundana Lebogang Mphahlele.
Muri 2012, yagize uruhare runini muri televiziyo ya sci-fi Televiziyo "Room 9" kuri SABC 1. Yakinnye nka 'Detective Alice Kunene' murukurikirane. Hagati aho, yagiye agaragara ku bitaramo mpuzamahanga byinshi; nka HBO ikurikirana "numero ya mbere" yabategarugori bashinzwe iperereza muri 2008 nka 'Baone Magasane'. Hanyuma muri 2013, yagaragaye muri firime yaje 'Kwihangana' muri firime "yamashusho Mary na Martha" iyobowe na Phillip Noyce.
Muri 2014, yanagaragaye mu gitabo cy’Abanyakanada Broadcasting Corporation (CBC) na BET International (BET) mu "gitabo cya Negro" aho yakinnye nk'umushumba utwite 'Sanu'. Muri 2014, yatangiye gukina filime "muri Lobola ya Fanie Fourie" nka 'Dinky Magubane'. Ku bw'uruhare rwe, yatsindiye ibihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo byo muri Afurika y'Epfo (SAFTA) muri 2014 ndetse na \ ibihembo bya Filimi na Televiziyo bya Afurika y'Epfo (SAIFTA) mu mwaka wa 2013 mu cyiciro cya 'Umukinnyi mwiza muri Filime Yerekana'. Nyuma yumwaka, yagize uruhare runini muri saison ya 1 ya "serivise Ayeye" nka 'Sibongile'. Muri 2015, yatowe kubera umwanya wa 'Madi' muri saison ya gatatu ya "Black Sails", urukurikirane rwa Starz Network. Yakomeje gukina ibice 16 mu bakinnyi basubiramo afite umwanya wo kuba umukobwa wa Bwana Scott, Madi kugeza shampiyona irangiye. Urukurikirane rwamumenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Hagati aho, Dlomo yatsindiye igihembo cya 'Brett Goldin Nziza Nziza' mu bihembo bya Naledi Theatre 2014/2015 kubera abantu benshi bakinnye mu ikinamico "Wabonye Zandile?" iyobowe na Khutjo Green. Muri 2017, yimukiye muri Afurika gukina muri telenovelas izwi cyane muri Afurika yepfo "Isibaya". Muri serial, yakinnye nka 'Nonhlanzi' bita 'LethuHlatshwayo'. Hanyuma, yagaragaye mumikino ibiri: "Jero" iyobowe na Dominique Gumede, hanyuma muri "Play" iyobowe na Khutjo Green.
Mu mpera za 2017, yagaragaye muri filime ya mbere yo muri Afurika yepfo y’iburengerazuba yitwa 5"Fingers for Marseilles". Yakinnye imico nka 'Lerato'. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto nyuma ryasohotse muri sinema muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika muri Nzeri 2018. Muri 2018, Dlomo yakinnye muri firime ya "Mandela's Gun" iyobowe na John Irvin. Yakinnye nka Winnie, muka Nelson Mandela muri film. Filime yari ifite umwanya wa mbere ku isi i New York, Harlem NY. Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yinjiye mu ikinamico rya Mzansi Magic Ku cyumweru nimugoroba "Ubushyo" afite uruhare 'Lwandle'.
Mu mwaka wa 2020, yakoze muri firime ngufi "Hotel on the Koppies" yanditse kandi iyobowe na Charlie Vundla. Hanyuma yinjiye hamwe na SABC 1 mini-serie yitwa "Amazing Grace" hamwe ninshingano za 'Sarah'. Amaherezo mbere y’icyorezo cya COVID-19, yakinnye 'Lindo Cele' mu rukurikirane rw'ikinamico "Erased" telecast binyuze kuri Moja Rukundo.

Ahmed Fawzi Saleh (yavutse 1 Mutarama 1981), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Egiputa. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa film izwi cyane "Poisonous Roses". Usibye gukora firime, Saleh numuntu uharanira imibereho myiza.
Yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1981 i Alegizandiriya, mu Misiri. Yabonye impamyabumenyi mu mateka yakuye muri kaminuza ya Suez Canal hanyuma abona impamyabumenyi yo gufata amashusho mu Ishuri Rikuru rya Sinema rya Cairo mu 2009.
Muri 2008, yabaye umuyobozi wungirije wa Rashid Masharawi. Ku buyobozi bwa Masharawi mu 2010, Saleh yakoze "filime ye ya mbere ngufi ya Living Skin" yerekanwe bwa mbere muri 2011. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime.
Hamwe nitsinzi yumukobwa mugufi, yahise akora poisonus rose muri 2018. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku Isi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya 47 Rotterdam mu gice cya Bright Future. Iyi filime yaje guhitamo nkumunyamisiri winjira muri Filime nziza ya International Feature muri 92 Awards Awards, ariko ntiyatowe.
Yatanze kandi nk'umukorerabushake mu bikorwa byinshi by’imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Misiri.

Nadim Tabet (wavutse 1982), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Libani. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime izwi cyane "Imwe muriyi minsi".
Yavutse mu 1982 i Beirut, muri Libani.
Kuva akiri muto, yakundaga gukora firime. Yatangiye gufata amashusho hamwe nibihimbano bibiri bigufi muri videwo, iyambere "Caravane" muri 1997 hanyuma "Kodak colr" muri 1998. Nyuma yimukiye mu Bufaransa mu 1999 kugira ngo akomeze amasomo ye mu bumenyi bwa muntu na sinema muri kaminuza ya Sorbonne. Hagati aho, ayobora ikabutura "Histoires extraordinaires du cinématographe" mu 1999. Yakomeje kuyobora ikabutura mu myaka yakurikiyeho, nka "Martine et Alia" mu 2001, "Passé présent futur" mu 2002, na "L'Arche de Noé" mu 2003. Muri 2005, yakoze "Violante" ngufi, na "Le Liban en automne" muri 2006. Bombi bakiriye neza kandi Tabet yakoze ubutaha bwa"Jeunes et innocents" muri 2007. Hanyuma muri 2008 yakoze "Spring 75" na "Souvenirs d'un été" muri 2011. Muri 2014, yakoze "Eté 91" ngufi.
Mu 2001, Tabet yashinze iserukiramuco rya sinema ryo muri Libani. Kuva mu 2011, yabaye umwe mu bagize komite ishinzwe gutoranya iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Oberhausen. Amaze gukora filimi ngufi yamamaye cyane, yayoboye filime ye yambere yumukobwa"One of These Days" muri 2017. nyuma yaje gutsindira igihembo cyiza cyambere cyambere muri Festival ya 22 yabarabu. Muri 2019, yayoboye urukurikirane rwa "Faraya" hamwe nundi mukinnyi wa firime wo muri Libani Mounia Akl.

Nadia Al-Iraki (yavutse Faten Fathy ; 3 Kanama 1963 – 16 Gicurasi 2021) yari umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Iraki. Yagize uruhare muri firime "Africano", "Can't Complain", "Theyab Al-Lail" na "Dokkan Shehata".
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina umwuga mu 1997 hamwe na televiziyo ya "Theab Al-Lail". Urukurikirane rwamenyekanye cyane kuri tereviziyo aho yakinnye nka 'Fatima'. "Intsinzi yuruhererekane", yakiriye serivise nyinshi za tereviziyo mumyaka yakurikiyeho, harimo: Zeezinya mu 2000, "Leqaa ala al hawaa" muri 2004 na serial izwi cyane "Raya wa Sekina" muri 2005. Hagati aho, yari yakoze mu Misiri Adventure comedy film "Africano" tuyoborwa Amuri Arafa. Yagize uruhare runini nka 'Customer' muri film. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori byinshi bya firime.
Hanyuma Nadia yakinnye muri "serivise za tereviziyo: Al-andaleeb hikayt shaab" muri 2006 na documentaire "Ntishobora Kurega" muri 2007. Muri uwo mwaka wa 2007, yatumiriwe gukina filime yerekana "Keda Reda", ibaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa sinema uzwi cyane. Nyuma yuruhererekane rwa tereviziyo nyinshi, yamenyekanye cyane kuri televiziyo ya "Selssal El Dam" na "Al Qaserat 2013".
Yapfuye ku ya 16 Gicurasi 2021, nyuma yo kwandura COVID-19.

Georges Schoucair numu producer ukomeye wa Libani. Schoucair ufatwa nkumwe mubatunganya amafilime atanga ikizere muri sinema yo mu burasirazuba bwo hagati, yakoze firime nyinshi zamamaye kandi zatsindiye ibihembo. Yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere rya sinema muri Libani ndetse na sinema nyafurika.
Niwe washinze inzu n’umusaruro we bwite, 'Abbout Productions' yashinzwe mu 2003. Icyakora, isosiyete yashinzwe mu 1998 na Joana Hadjithoma na Khalil Joreige. Uretse ibyo, ni na we washinze iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Maskoon Fantastic i Beirut, rifatwa nk'ibirori bya mbere bya firime ya sinema mu bihugu by'Abarabu.
Nkumuproducer, yakoranye nabayobozi batsindiye ibihembo barimo: Kaouther Ben Hania, Vatche Boulghourjian, Jean Luc Godard, Alain Gomis, Joana Hadjithomas, Annemarie Jacir, Khalil Joreige, Mohammad Malas, Lucrecia Martel, Shirin Neshat, Asli Ozge, Rafi Pitts, Bill Plympton, Ghassan Salhab, Elia Suleiman na Apichatpong Weerasethakul.
Usibye Abbout Productions, Schoucair yashinze isosiyete ikora firime ya indie 'MC Distribution'. Kuva mu 2008, ni na visi-perezida wa sinema yonyine y’ubuhanzi i Beirut: 'Metropolis'. Afatwa nkumuntu washinze isosiyete ikora firime yindie 'Schortcut Films' mumwaka wa 2016 aho yakoraga nka producer muri firime nyinshi zizwi "Félicité" (2017), "Wajib" (2017), "Rafiki" (2018), "Beauty &amp; The Dogs" (2018), "It Must Be Heaven" (2019) and "A Son" (2019

Sudabeh Mortezai (yavutse 1968), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Otirishiya wavukiye muri Iran kandi aaba na producer. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane "Macondo" na "Joy" zatsindiye ibihembo mpuzamahanga mu birori bya firime.
Yavutse mu 1968 i Ludwigsburg, mu Budage ku babyeyi ba Irani. Yabayeho mu bwana bwe n'ubuto muri Vienne na Tehran.
Yimukiye i Vienne yiga ikinamico, firime n'itangazamakuru. Nyuma yize filime muri kaminuza ya Californiya, Los Angeles (UCLA) i Los Angeles. Muri kiriya gihe, yakoze firime zitandukanye kandi ngufi zirimo documentaire "Children of the Prophet" 2006. Yibanze ku mihango y'icyunamo ya Irani kuri Imamu Hossein, umwuzukuru w'Intumwa Mohammad.
Muri 2009, yakoze "Im Bazar der Gender" isobanura umuco wo gushyingirwa by'agateganyo muri Islamu y'Abashiya. Nyuma muri 2014, yakoze filime ye ya mbere ya "Macondo". Filime nigishushanyo cyumuhungu wimpunzi ya Chechen. Yatumiwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya 64 rya Berlin (amarushanwa ya Berlinale), ahatanira igihembo cya Golden Bear Award.
Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa filime, yakoze filime ye ya kabiri "yishimye" muri 2018. Irazenguruka inkuru yumugore wo muri Nigeriya murugendo rwo gushaka umudendezo. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Filime yatumiwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya 75 rya Venice mu gice cya Giornate degli Autori. Hanyuma yatsindiye Europa Cinemas Label nka Filime nziza yu Burayi mu gice cya Giornate degli Autori mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Venice. Hagati aho, yashinze isosiyete ikora firime 'FreibeuterFilm'. Iyi filime kandi yatsindiye igihembo cya mbere cya Hearst Film igihembo cyumuyobozi mwiza wumugore.
Mu Kwakira 2018, filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime Nziza muri BFI London Festival Festival. Mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Chicago rya 54, filime yatsindiye igihembo cyihariye cya Jury cya Silver Hugo. Hanyuma mu Kuboza 2018, filime yakiriye Goldeb Star ya filime nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Marrakech

Samba Gadjigo (yavutse 12 Ukwakira 1954), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Senegal kandi akaba umwanditsi wa filimi. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa firime "Sembene izwi cyane!".
Yavutse ku ya 12 Ukwakira 1954 i Kidira, muri Senegali. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Dakar na Ecole Normale Supérieure de Dakar. Hanyuma yabonye impamyabumenyi ya PhD muri kaminuza ya Illinois muri Urbana-Champaign. Kugeza ubu akora nka Porofeseri w’igifaransa muri Mount Holyoke College, Massachusetts kuva 1986.
Muri 2015, yayoboye filime "Sembene!" hamwe na Jason Silverman. Iyi filime yari ishingiye ku buzima bw'umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Senegal Ousmane Sembène bakunze kwita se wa sinema nyafurika. Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere kumugaragaro muri Sundance Film Festival muri Utah. Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi ndetse no gushimirwa mubirori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Iyi filime yabaye uwanyuma kuri Kamera d'Or mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes ndetse yegukana igihembo cya Jury mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Luxor African 2016. Yatsindiye kandi Prix de la Jeuness muri Escales Documentaires de Libreville 2017 hanyuma yegukana igihembo cya Paul Robeson mu iserukiramuco rya Filime ryabirabura rya Newark 2016. Filime yaje kubona igihembo cyinyandiko nziza muri Emerge Film Festival.
Muri 2016, Gadjigo yahawe igihembo cy'ishami rya Bourse. Usibye gukora firime, ni n'umwanditsi wamamaye kandi yagize uruhare "muri Sinema nyafurika nuburenganzira bwa muntu", "ubushakashatsi mubuvanganzo nyafurika", "nintererano mubushakashatsi bwabirabura". Muri Werurwe 2016, yahawe igihembo cya Meribeth E. Cameron Igihembo cya Bourse yo muri Mount Holyoke College.

Cecilia Zoppelletto, ni umuyobozi w'amafilime (filmmaker) ukomoka mu gihugu cya Itali (Italy). Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa dokimanteri (documentaire) yitwa '"La Belle At The Movies"'.
Yavukiye kandi akurira i Padua, mu Butaliyani. Kuva mu 1994, yabereye i Londire (London). Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga ya PhD muri kaminuza ya 'Westminster'.
Nk'ubushakashatsi bwe, yakoze 'Decolonisation' akoresheje 'Amajyambere ya Filime': Kubaka no kongera kubaka Umwuka wa 'Zairian' kuri Film. Yanakoze ubushakashatsi ku bubiko bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ndetse n’ishusho ya firime y’igihugu nyuma y’ubwigenge.
Yakoze nka producer wamakuru muri societe yigihugu yo mubutaliyani RAI. Hagati aho, yakoraga nka televiziyo akaba n'umwanditsi kuri neti yo mu Butaliyani 'Antenna Tre Nordest'. Muri 2015, yakoze documentaire "La Belle Kuri Sinema". Iyi filime yamenyekanye cyane kandi yerekanwa muri Amerika, Ububiligi, Ubwongereza na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Noneho muri 2017, yakoze firime ngufi "Falling".

Francois L. Woukoache (yavutse ku ya 16 Gashyantare 1966), ni umukinnyi wa firime wa Kameruni uba mu bubiligi akaba n'umwanditsi. Yakoze firime zigera kuri makumyabiri hamwe nuruhererekane rwinkuru zabana ndetse na gahunda za tereviziyo.
Yavutse ku ya 16 Gashyantare 1966 i Yaoundé mu muryango ufite barumuna icyenda. Nyuma y’amasomo yisumbuye, yakurikiranye amasomo yo mu rwego rwo hejuru. Yize mu kigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ubuhanzi i Buruseli (INSAS).
Mu 1991, yakoze filime ye ya mbere yitwa "Melina". Mu 1995, yakoze documentaire "Asientos" ivuga ku bucuruzi bwabacakara. Filime yerekanwe mu birori byinshi bya firime kandi irashimwa cyane. Hanyuma yakoze indi filimi ngufi "The smoke in the eyes" 1997 i Buruseli. Mu 1998, Woukoache yayoboye "Fragments de vie". Iyi filime itavugwaho rumwe yasobanuye ibyiciro bya Afurika yo mu mijyi no mu rusaku, iy'utubari na clubs z'umujyi muri Afurika ya Ekwatoriya. Muri uwo mwaka, yayoboye filime "We no longer died" yari ishingiye ku buzima nyuma ya jenoside yabaye mu Rwanda.
Kuva mu 1998, yagiye mu bikorwa byo guhugura no gutunganya amajwi n'amashusho mu Rwanda. Nyuma yaje kuba umwarimu mu Ishuri ry’itangazamakuru n’itumanaho muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda. Muri kiriya gihe, yagenzuye ikorwa rya firime ebyiri za mbere zu Rw0anda mu 1999: "Kiberinka" na "Entre deux mondes". Muri 2000, yakoze documentaire "Nous ne Sommes Plus Morts". Filime yatsindiye Jury Mention mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Zanzibar.
Hagati ya 2003 na 2005, yari umuhuzabikorwa wumushinga "Iguku n'Urumuri watangijwe nkintangiriro" ya sinema mumashuri yu Rwanda. Muri 2009, Woukoache yayoboye film ngufi "The lady of the 4 th floor." Hagati ya 2013 na 2016, yahujije umushinga "Faces of Life". Binyuze muri uwo mushinga, yahuguye abagore bo mu Rwanda gukoresha ubuhanzi bugaragara nk'uburyo bwo kuvuga no guhindura imibereho. Nyuma yaje kuyobora film, "Ntarabana".

Eric Kabongo Ilunga (yavutse ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1984), ni umukinnyi wa filimi mububiligi n’umuririmbyi ukomoka muri Kongo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime Welcome toGerany, "Sawah" and "Third Wedding"..
Yavutse ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1984 i Kinshasa, muri Zayire (muri iki gihe Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo). Afite imyaka 13, yaje mu Bubiligi bitewe nuko nyina yashakanye n’umubiligi maze atura mu mudugudu wa Flemish mu nkengero z’Ububiligi. Kuri ubu atuye i Waregem, muri West Flanders.
Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuraperi ufite izina rya stage 'Krazy-E'. Muri 2013, yabaye umukinnyi ufite uruhare rutemewe nkumugenzi wa gari ya moshi muri film ya "The Fifth Estate". Mu 2014, Kabongo yagaragaye muri "D5R" hanyuma bahabwa uruhare mu kunenga yitirirwa Bubiligi film "Black".
Mu mwaka wa 2016, yatumiwe mu Budage gukina nk'impunzi 'Diallo' muri filime isetsa welcome to Germany. Hamwe na firime, yabaye umukinnyi ukomeye mu Burayi. Muri 2019, yakinnye muri filime "Sawah" aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Golden Palm igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya film rya Queen Palm. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri seriveri "Rivallen und Rebellen".
Muri 2014, documentaire What about Eric? yarekuwe bijyanye n'ubuzima bwe. Nyuma documentaire yatsindiye ibihembo bya Best documentaire nziza. Hanyuma documentaire "Ensor" yatsindiye igihembo cya Best Flemish documentaire, nyuma yaje kwegurirwa Kabongo nabayobozi Lennart Stuyck na Ruben Vermeersch.

Aboubakr Bensaihi (wavutse 1996), ni umukinnyi wa firime mububiligi akaba n'umuririmbyi ukomoka muri Maroc. Azwi cyane nka Marwan muri filimi yasohotse 2015 film "Black".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Yavutse mu 1996 akurira muri Molenbeek. Yarangije amashuri mUbuholandi mu kigo cya Imelda.
Mu 2014, Bensaihi yahiswemo muri film "Black" na abayobozi Adil El Arbi na Bilall Fallah. Hanyuma yakinnye imbere yumugabo 'Marwan' muri film "the black". Filime yamamaye cyane kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Nyuma yaje gutorwa muri Ensor Best Debut Award muri Ostend Film Festival mu 2016 ndetse nigihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri Magritte Awards muri 2017. Iyo filime igenda neza, yinjiye mu ikinamico "yitwa Thuis" yitwa 'Junes Bakkal' muri 2017. Muri 2018, yinjiye muri televiziyo "Daidj".
Usibye gukina, Bensaihi n'umuririmbyi n'umuraperi. We ubwe yaririmbye indirimbo "Do You Hear Me". Yanditse kandi indirimbo munsi yizina rya 'Bakr'. Indirimbo ye ya mbere yari "Sac à dos" yakurikiwe "nindirimbo nziza Elle a". Hanyuma yasohoye indirimbo "Tomber dans ton love". Muri 2016, Bensaihi yabaye umwe mu bahembwa 10 ba Molenbekenaar y'umwaka.

Marita Canga Antonio (yavutse 1995), ni umukinnyi wa firime mu Bubiligi akomoka muri Angola. Azwi cyane muri film yamamaye cyane "Umukara".
Yavutse mu 1995 i Mons mu Bubiligi ku babyeyi bava Angola. Yakuriye i Liège, ubu akaba atuye i Mechelen.
Muri 2014, yize gucunga itumanaho muri Erasmushogeschool, Bruxelles. Muri icyo gihe, yari Bahiswemo gukina nka 'Mavela' mu gatsiko thriller film "Black" iyoborwa na Adil El Arbi na Bilall Fallah. Yatoranijwe kuranga mubakandida 450. Mbere ya firime, ntabwo yari afite uburambe bwo gukina. Icyakora yakinnye uruhare rwamenyekanye cyane kandi rurashimwa cyane. Filime yaje kwerekanwa iminsi mikuru mpuzamahanga ya firime. Mu Gushyingo 2015, Martha yagizwe umukinnyi wa filime mwiza mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Tallinn Black Nights. Ukuboza k'umwaka umwe, yatorewe kuba Shooting Star mu Burayi muri 7 Magritte Awards kubera film imwe.
Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi wamamaye watangiye umwuga nkumunyamuryango "witsinda" ryumuziki Soul'Art. Muri 2018, yatangiye umwuga we wo kuririmba wenyine ku izina rya 'Martha Da'ro' maze asohora indirimbo imwe ya "Summer Blues".

Mukayijore Suzanne ni umugore akaa umunyarwandakazi uba muri politike, kuri ubu Suzanne ni Umudepite watowe kuba mu nteko ishinga amategeko mu Umutwe w’Abadepite ndetse aza no gutorwa n'abadepite bagenzibe guhagararira u Rwanda mu nteko Ishinga Amategeko Nyafurika (PAP).Suzanne akaba yari na Visi Perezida w' Ishyaka ry’Ukwishyira Ukizana (PL) mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda.
Suzanne yabonye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu icyungamari n'icungamutungo. Mukayijore Suzanne mbere yo kuza mu inteko inshinga amategeko yari asanzwe akora muri banki aho yari umuyobizi mukuru.
Suzanne yatorewe kuba Umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko Nyafurika (PAP) tariki ya 23 Nyakanga 2020, yasimbuye Nyirarukundo Ignatienne wahinduriwe imirimo akaba ari Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe imibereho mwiza y’abaturage muri Minisitere y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu. Inteko Ishinga Amategeko Nyafurika (PAP) ikaba yarashyizweho mu kugira ngo igire uruhare mu iterambere ry’ubukungu n’imibanire y’abatuye ku mugabane wa Afurika. ikaba ifite icyicaro i Midrand muri Afurika y’Epfo, ikaba igizwe n’abadepite batorwa mu Nteko zishinga amatego mu bihugu bigize umugabane wa Afurika.

Ndangiza Madina ni umugore akaba Umunyarwandakazi uba muri politike, yahoze ari umunyamabanga mukuru w'ishyaka Ideal Democratic Party (P.D.I) rikaba riri no mu bumwe bw'amashaka mu Rwanda, ndetse akaba abarizwa mu inteko ishinga amategeko yu Rwanda mu mutwe w'abadepite, Ndangiza Madina ahagarariye abagore mu inteko.
Ndangiza Madina yabonye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza yakuye muri Kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda mu mategeko. Ndangiza Madina kandi yatorewe kuba Visi Perezida wa Komisiyo y'abadepite bagize komisiyo y’uburezi, ikoranabuhanga, umuco n’urubyikruko mu inteko inshinga amategeko.

Napomuceno's Will ni filime yerekana ikinamico ya Cape Verdean yasohotse 2017 iyobowe na Francisco Manso, ishingiye ku gitabo cyitwa "The Last Will and Testament of Senhor da Silva Araújo" cyanditswe na Germano Almeida.
Napumoceno da Silva Araújo, umucuruzi ukize wa Cape Verde, yarapfuye kandi atunguranye ategura mwishywa we, asiga umutungo we ku mukobwa utemewe. Amusigira kandi icyegeranyo cya kaseti aho amubwira amateka y'ubuzima bwe, uko yavuye mubukene agera ku ntsinzi no mu rwego, ndetse n'abagore benshi yakundaga mu nzira.
"Napomuceno's Will bwerekanwe bwa" mbere muri Festival de Gramado, Burezili muri Kanama 1997.
Yakiriye ibitekerezo byiza, "Variety" ishima Chico Díaz byumwihariko. Kuri "Chronicle ya San Francisco", Mick LaSalle yanditse ko "[Araujo ya Xavier] ari clown, ariko imwe ifite imbaraga kandi ifite igitekerezo kimwe kuburyo byumvikana impamvu akurura abagore kandi agatsinda mubucuruzi. Hamwe nubwitonzi bwibutsa Roberto Benigni, akoresha ijwi rye nkigikoresho gisetsa gitangaje, akazamuka akagera kumatwi mugihe cyo kwiyemera no gukabya. Muri icyo gihe, Xavier aduha ibihe byo kwambika ubusa umutima, igihe Araujo yiyitiriye, kandi tubona mu bubabare bwe. "
Muri "Filime Nyafurika Yitwa Lusophone", Paulo de Medeiros yinubiye ko iyi filime yirengagije ibivugwa mu bukoloni mu gitabo cy’umwimerere, yerekana ko hamwe n’umuyobozi w’Abanyaportigale hamwe n’abayireba, iyi filime ikubiyemo ibitekerezo bya "Lusotropicaliste" cyangwa igamije kwibagirwa ubukoloni.

La Negrada izwi mpuzamahanga nka Black Mexicans, yasohotse 2018 ni filime yo muri Mexique iyoborwa na Jorge Pérez Solano afatanyije na César Gutiérrez Miranda na Tirisia Cine. Niyo filime ya mbere yo muri Mexique yimpimbano hamwe hagati ya Africa na Mexico bose bakinnye muri Mexico. Filime yafatiwe mu mijyi mito no muri Costa Chica, Oaxaca.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 18 Kanama 2018 muri Amerika. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma iza gutsindira igihembo cyiza cya Sinema mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Guadalajara 2018.

Bukky Abaniwonda, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Bukky Wonder, ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Kanada na Nigeriya. Azwi cyane muri firime "Bridges","Awkward Things About Losing Weight" and "The Carperdian".
Yavukiye muri Kanada nkuwa kabiri mu muryango. Yabayeho mu bwana bwe i Abuja. Afite barumuna be na bashiki be babiri. Yize Command Day Secondary School, Abuja kugirango yige amashuri yisumbuye. Hanyuma yarangije icyiciro cya comptabilite muri kaminuza ya Bowen.
Muri 2017, yakinnye cyane muri film "Bridges" iyobowe na Rogers Ofime. Hanyuma yakinnye muri film "The End".
Mu 2020, Abaniwonda yayoboye filimi ya mbere hagati ya Africa na Canada "African Family" yakorewe muri black production. yafatiwe amashusho i Calgary. Muri aba bakinnyi harimo abakinnyi b'Abanyafrika baturutse muri Nijeriya, Congo na Angola.

Germaine Mukabalisa yavutse 1988,ni umudepite uhagarariye abagore mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda yatowe muntara yamajyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Germaine yari umujyanama mu byamategeko muri World vision guhera 2018 kugeza atorewe kuba umudepite. yabaye umujyanama mu byamategeko muri Miisiteri y'ubucuruzi n'Inganda, yahoze anigisha amategeko muri, akaba nanone yari umwe mu bagize inama y'ubutegetsi y'ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi n'iterambere ry'inganda (NIRDA). Germaine asimbuye Nyirarukundo Ignatienne wagizwe Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y Ubutegetsi bw Igihugu, ushinzwe Imibereho Myiza y Abaturage.

Fumani N Shilubana (yavutse 22 Werurwe 1980), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Afrika yepfo umuyobozi na producer. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime zizwi cyane Zama Zama, Father`s War na "Kalushi: Inkuru ya Salomo Mahlangu". Uwashinze PadiriFigureZA, Fondasiyo ishaka kwinjiza umuntu mu muryango na Chairman wa Midrand Heat Basketball Club.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Yavutse ku ya 22 Werurwe 1980 mu mudugudu muto Shiluvana, Tzaneen, Limpopo, Afurika y'Epfo. Se Clifford Shilubana yari umuyobozi w'ishuri mu ishuri ribanza rya Mlungisi na nyina Nsatimuni Mundhlovu akaba umunya Mozambike / Afurika y'Epfo yari umuforomo mu Ibitaro bya Shiluvana. Afite bashiki be babiri: Labani Mgimeti na Kumani Shilubana na musaza we Tebogo Maake.
Ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2016 mu Mudugudu wa Joppie yishyuye lovola ku mugore we ubu naho muri 2017 Ukuboza 22 we na Nomathemba Olivia Ngobeni bakoze ibirori byihariye kuri African Pride Mount Grace i Magaliesburg. Ni se w'umuhungu umwe, Vulani n'umukobwa umwe Nganakati-Nsuku.
Shilubana yize mu 1998 muri Mathews Phosa College Mpumalanga, yiyandikisha muri kaminuza ya Venda mu 1999 yiga Impamyabumenyi ya siyansi (BSc) mu buhinzi atarangije maze mu 2000 yiyandikisha mu by'inganda muri kaminuza ya Tekinoroji ya Tshwane. ntibyakunze kandi igihe yashakaga gukurikirana imideli mu Butaliyani, na we ntiyagiye nyuma yo kwiyandikisha muri gahunda yo kuvuga no gukina amakinamico muri Leta ya Afurika y'Epfo abifashijwemo n'umwanditsi Mpumelelo Paul Grootboom.
Yatangiye gukina Basketball afite imyaka 15, yamenye iby'umukino nyuma yuko nyina amuguriye igitabo cy’amategeko ya Basketball, ku myaka 19 yitabira ibizamini bya Basketball muri kaminuza ya Limpopo maze atoranyirizwa guhagararira Intara ya Limpopo mu ikipe nkuru y’abagabo muri SASSU imikino mu marushanwa ngarukamwaka muri Cape Town.
Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe nka producer numukinnyi muri telenovela "Giyani: Igihugu cyamaraso". Muri uruhererekane, yakinnye 'Vukosi Moyo'. Nyuma yo gusoza urukurikirane, yagaragaye muri serie "Mafanato yakoze" kandi ayobora.
Yakinnye kandi muri serivise zizwi cyane: "Soul City", "Generations" and "Isidingo". Mubisanzwe avuga muri Xitsonga kuri tereviziyo, arirwo rurimi rwe kavukire. Yakinnye uruhare ruzwi cyane 'Detective Dabula' ku isabune ya SABC3 "Isidingo".
Shilubana yerekanwe bwa mbere na Khomelela, film yakoze kandi bafatanya kwandika nayo yakoze. Uyu mushinga wari mubutumwa bwe bwo kubona film za Xitsonga kumurongo munini. Yakusanyije amafaranga 40 000 ya firime kandi yarashe 95% ya firime ahitwa Hlovani River Lodge naho ayandi mumujyi wa Nkowankowa. Filime yerekanwe kuri Hall Hall ya Nkowankowa.
Shitshembiso Mabasa, Fumani N. Shilubana, hamwe naTeleti Khosa, batunze Xiculu Multimedia, isosiyete ikora itangazamakuru ryirabura 100% yashinzwe mu Kuboza 2019. Igikorwa cyibanze cya Xiculu nugukora no gukwirakwiza ibirimo Xitsonga kandi basohoye urukurikirane rwa Mafanato kuri Showmax, KubaTsongaInSA. doccie seriveri yerekana ibyasangiwe na Vatsonga muri republika ya afurika yepfo, Minkoka Mimbirhi,Umunsi hamwe na Tsonga Legend kuvuga show, Nyambondzwani filimi ngufi, Sivara series na COVID-19 Xitsonga rushinge mu bufatanyeXitsonga.org bose mu 2020.
Shilubana yatowe mu 2005 mu bihembo bya Naledi Theatre Awards kubera uruhare rwiza rushyigikirana "Inkuru zo mu mujyi". Ku cyumweru tariki ya 19 Gashyantare 2006, umuhango wuzuye inyenyeri wabereye muri kaminuza ya Johannesburg.
Mu mwaka wa 2010 yahawe Igihembo cya Mama Beka kubera kuzamura ubwoko bwe n’ururimi Xitsonga ku bitangazamakuru bisanzwe.
Yatorewe igihembo cye cya mbere cyo gukina igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza wumuhanga wurukundo muri Ibihembo bya FAME 2016.

Majdi Smiri (wavutse 1983), akunze kwitwa Maguy, ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Tuniziya. Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuraperi, bidatinze Smiri yabaye umuyobozi ukunzwe wa filimi zizwi cyane za televiziyo "Talaa Wala Habet", "Lilet Chak" na "Case 460".
Yavutse mu 1983 i Tuniziya, muri Tuniziya.
Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuraperi ku izina rya Maguy. Yanditse, arahimba nyuma akora Njoum Ellil muri duet hamwe numuririmbyi Ines Chkimi. Mu 2006, yagaragaye bwa mbere muri sinema hamwe na firime "Making of" iyobowe na Nouri Bouzid. Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi mu Ishuri ry'Ubuhanzi na Sinema muri Tuniziya. Hanyuma yimukiye mu Bufaransa maze akora umwaka umwe mu ruganda rukora ibicuruzwa. Amaze gusubira muri Tuniziya, yashinze uruganda rwe rukora amajwi n'amashusho, 'Underground Skills', mu 2007. Binyuze muri sosiyete, yayoboye amashusho yindirimbo nyinshi hamwe niyamamaza. Hanyuma yayoboye ibiganiro bya tereviziyo nka "Koujinitna" kuri tereviziyo y'igihugu, "Urban Fen" kuri TV ya Hannibal na "Ser El" Benna kuri TV ya Coujina.
Muri 2009, yakinnye nka 'Farid', umukanishi n'umuraperi, muri ikinamico "Njoum Ellil" iyobowe na Madih Belaïd. Muri 2012, yakoze filime ye yambere "yumukobwa, Fausse Note" aho yari umwanditsi akaba na producer. Muri 2015, Smiri yahawe igihembo cyerekezo cyiza cy'ikinamico "Lilet Chak" muri Romdhane Awards, yatanzwe na Mosaïque FM. Muri 2015, yanditse amagambo ya Lilet Chak, yahimbwe na Yacine Azaiez kandi yaririmbwe na Chkimi. Muri 2016, yayoboye urukurikirane rwa tereviziyo "Bolice" yatsindiye igihembo cyurukurikirane rwiza muri Romdhane Awards.

Ismahane Lahmar (yavutse 25 Ukwakira 1982), ni umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka muri Tunisiya akaba aba mu Bufaransa. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filimi ngufi zizwi cyane "Rainbow", "WOH!" and "Breaking News".
Yavutse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1982 i Paris mu Bufaransa, avukira ku babyeyi bo muri Tuniziya. Icyakora, yimukiye muri Tuniziya amaze kuvuka, abana na sekuru kugeza afite imyaka umunani. Hanyuma asubira mu Bufaransa.
Amaze gusubira mu Bufaransa, yiyandikishije muri kaminuza ya Paris XII yiga ibijyanye n'ubukungu. Amaze kurangiza icyiciro cya Economics and Management, yimukiye kwiga indimi z'amahanga hamwe na mushiki we. Hagati y'umwaka wa kaminuza, yagiye mu rugendo muri Kanada maze yifatanya n'inshuti y'umuririmbyi mu ruzinduko rwa Quebec. Muri kiriya gihe, yatangiye kuyobora film.
Yahuguye gukina mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Audiovisual Production (ESRA) i Paris. Nyuma yaje kwimukira muri kaminuza ya New York abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu kuyobora. Muri 2008, yerekanwe bwa mbere muri firime ngufi ya "Red Hope" muri 2008. Yanditse yerekana amashusho ya "Al Yasmine" abifashijwemo namahugurwa ya Dubai Film Connection.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yahisemo kujya muri Tuniziya, hamwe na filime iri "Under the Elbow". Icyakora, yakuyeho icyemezo kubera imvururu za politiki mu gihugu. Mu 2014, we filimi ya kabiri ngufi "Rainbow." Yatanzwe muri Nyakanga 2014 kuri Rares &amp; Tunisiens Cycle. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yanditse kandi ayobora filime "Woh", urwenya rwo muri Tuniziya rwatewe inkunga n'abaturage ba Tuniziya. Muri 2019 yashinze isosiyete ikora 'Madame Prod' aho ateza imbere akanashyigikira imishinga y'abagore na sinema.

Gakuba Jeanne d'Arc ni umunyarwandakazi uba muri politike akaba mu ishyaka rya RPF inkotanyi, yabaye kandi umuyobozi wungirije mubuyobozi bwimari muri manda ya kabiri ya sena y'u Rwanda.
Jeanne d' Arc yabonye Impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza mubumenyi bwisi ayikuye muri Kaminuza nkuru y'u burundi.
Jeanne d'Arc yavukiye i kamonyi mu Rwanda, akaba ari n'umubyeyi wa bana bane.
Muri 2011 Jeanne d' Arc yastindiye umwanya muri sena y'u Rwanda kumajwi 80.78 kwijana,akaba yarayivuyemo muri 2019. yahoze ari umwarimu mumashuri yisumbuye, yabaye umuyobozi ucunga ikigo cy'imari. yatorewe kandi kuba umuyobozi wungirije wumujyi wa kigali muri 2001 akaba yarahakozemo imyaka icumi.. yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa Pro Fermmes Twese Hamwe mugihe cyimyaka itatu, yabaye na none umuyobozi mubijyanye nubumenyi bwikirere muri minisitere yibikorwa remezo.

Madih Belaïd (yavutse 1 Mutarama 1974), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Tuniziya. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa "serivise za tereviziyo zizwi cyane na firime zirimo Naouret El Hawa", "Al Akaber" na "Allo".
Yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1974 i Sousse, muri Tuniziya. Yashakanye n'umukinnyi w'amafirime ukomoka muri Tuniziya Rim Riahi aho abashakanye bafite abana batatu.
Yize ibijyanye no gukina amafilime mu kigo cya Maghrebian Institute of Cinema muri Tunis kuva 1994 kugeza 1997. Nyuma yo kwimenyereza umwuga mu majwi no kuyobora, yabaye umuyobozi wungirije ku mashusho menshi muri Tuniziya no mu mahanga kandi yitabira amahugurwa yo kwandika mu Bufaransa, Ubudage na Maroc. Muri 1996, yanditse kandi ayobora firime ngufi: "Tout bouille rien ne bouge". Yayoboye filime ye yo gutanga impamyabumenyi, "Croix X" muri 2006, yakoze "L'Ascenseur ya" gatatu muri 2007 nyuma Allô muri 2008.
Muri 2014, yahawe igihembo cyo gukora neza ikinamico ya "Naouret El Hawa" muri Romdhane Awards yahawe na Mosaïque FM. Muri uwo mwaka, yagizwe umunyamuryango w’abacamanza ku nshuro ya kabiri iserukiramuco rya Les Nuits du court métrage Tunisien i Paris. Muri 2016, yatsindiye igihembo "cyumuyobozi mwiza w'ikinamico Al Akaber" muri Romdhane Awards.

Rim Riahi (yavutse 17 Gashyantare 1977), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Tuniziya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare 'Hanène Lahmar' muri televiziyo ya "Naouret El Hawa".
Yavutse ku ya 17 Gashyantare 1977 muri Tuniziya. Yashakanye n'umuyobozi wa filimi muri Tuniziya Madih Belaïd aho abashakanye bafite abana batatu.
Mu 1997 yatangiye umwuga wo gukina na filimi "El Khottab Al Bab" yakinagamo 'Raoudha'. Intsinzi yuruhererekane, yatoranijwe muri film ya "Moon Wedding" yo mu 1998 iyobowe na Taïeb Louhichi. Hanyuma mu 1999, yagaragaye muri filimi "Ghalia" iyobowe na Moncef El Kateb.
Mu ntangiriro z'ikinyagihumbi gishya, yahawe umwanya wa mbere muri filimi, aho yakinnye nka 'Lilia Mardoum-Srairi' muri filimi izwi cyane ya "Gamret Sidi Mahrous" iyobowe na Slaheddine Essid mu 2002. Mu 2006, yakinnye nka 'Zohra' muri serivise ya Hayet "Wa Amani ya" Mohamed Ghodhbane.
Muri 2014, yakinnye muri filimi "Naouret El Hawa", iyobowe n'umugabo we Belaïd. Uruhererekane rwamenyekanye cyane maze ahabwa igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza kubera uruhare rwe nka 'Hanène Lahmar' muri serial "Naouret El Hawa" muri uwo mwaka. Yatsindiye igihembo cya Ramadhan Award muri Romdhane Awards yahawe na Mosaïque FM.

Hon Sen. Perrine Mukankusi ni umunyapolitike akaba n'umunyamategeko mu Inteko Ishinga amategeko mu Rwanda.
Hon Sen Perrine Mukankusi yasuye urwibutso rwa abazize Jenoside ya korewe abatutsi muri 1994 rwa Mubuga kuko yasanze rundakoze neza, abizeza ko leta ibifite mu nshinga zayo kurwubaka. Yateguye amahugurwa aho yatanganga ibiganiro kuri gahunda ya "Ndi ununyarwanda" yavuzeko abanyarwanda ari ubwoko bukomeye.
Senateri Perrine Mukankusi yasuye Akarere ka karongi aho yaganiriye na baturage bakamubwira ko bafite ikibazo cya makimbirane y'ubutaka, Senateri Perrine Mukankusi we asanga icyo atariho hari ikibazo ahubwo we asanga igihangayikishije ari ihohoterwa riri mungo ahenshi batanga barivuga.
Hon Sen Perrine Mukankusi arubatse afite abana babiri umuhungu n'umukobwa.
