Djafar Gacem (yavutse 18 Nzeri 1966), rimwe na rimwe nka Djaâfar Gacem, ni umuyobozi wa firime muri Alijeriya. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa serivise zizwi cyane kuri tereviziyo na firime "Nass Mlah City", "Family" "Djemai, Sultan Achour 10" na "Bouzid Days".
Yavutse ku ya 18 Nzeri 1966 i Algiers, Alijeriya.
Mu 2001, yayoboye televiziyo ya sitasiyo ya "Nass Mlah City" yerekanwe bwa mbere kuri Télévision Algérienne, Canal Algérie na A3 ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2002. Sitcoms yishimiye cyane muri Alijeriya mu myaka ya za 2000. Urukurikirane rwasojwe muri Werurwe 2006 nyuma y'ibice 119 mu bihe bitatu. Mu mwaka wa 2006, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi mwiza mu birori bya Fennec d'or y'uruhererekane.
Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa "Nass Mlah City", yayoboye urukurikirane rwa tereviziyo "Djemai Family" mu 2008 rwahawe igihembo cyiza mu iserukiramuco rya Fennec d'or. Hanyuma muri 2013, yakoze urukurikirane rwa "Dar El Bahdja" hanyuma "Sultan Achour 10" muri 2015. Muri 2019, yayoboye filime ye ya mbere yerekana amateka ya "Héliopolis". Kwerekana firime byagombaga gutinda kubera ingaruka zanduye COVID-19 ku nganda za firime muri Alijeriya. Iyi filimi yasohotse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 2020, amaherezo isuzumwa bikomeye ku ya 4 Ugushyingo 2020. Yatoranijwe nkuwinjira muri Alijeriya muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga Yerekana ibihembo bya 93.

IMANIRIHO Clarisse (wavutse 27 Ugushyingo 1995) ni umukoba aho ku myaka 23 yatorewe kuba umudepite mu Rwanda kandi niwe mudepite muto mu mateka y'u Rwanda mu nteko Inshinga Amategeko y'u Rwanda.
Yatorewe Kuba umudepite ubwo yarangizaga Kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda, Yinjiye mu Nteko agiye guhagararira Urubyuruko, ubwo amatora yabaga muri 2018 agatsinda n'amajwi 52.9. Ubwo yaganiraga n'ibinyamakuru yavuze ukuntu yitinyutse Yavuzeko Umwana w'umukobwa afite amahirwe ndetse avuga ko urubyuko rufite amahirwe rutango kubyaza umusaruro kuko Perezida Poul Kagame arwitayeho cyane.
Hon IMANIRIHO Clarisse yitabiriye Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wa Mahoro wahuje Urubyuriko Rwo hirya no hino na bagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko wari wateguwe na Never Again Rwanda Aho yasabye urubyuruko kwigira kungaruka zatewe na Covid 19 rukiyungura ubumenyi buzarufasha mu guhangana ni cyorezo nko kwiteganiriza nibindi.
Impamyabumenyi afite(amashuri).
Hon. IMANIRIHO yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza yakuye mu kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda ubwo yarangizaga muri 2017, kandi afite Impamyabumenyi cy'iciro cya kabiri ya Kaminuza.
Hon. IMANIRIHO Clarisse aracyari ingaragu Yavukiwe Mu Murenge wa Bwishyura wo mu Karere ka Karongi niwe umu hererezi mu bana bane, babanaga na Nyina wa pfakaye.

Brighton Ngoma (yavutse 1985), ni umukinnyi wa firime Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serivise za tereviziyo "Invictus","Who Am I?" na "Master Harold...,na The Boys".
Yavutse mu 1985 i Bushbuckridge, Mpumalanga, Afurika y'Epfo kandi afite umurage wa Xhosa n'Ubusuwisi. Se yari umuganga mugihe nyina ari umuforomo. Ngoma afite murumuna we. Se yamusize afite imyaka 5, aho yakuriye hamwe na nyina. Mu 2002, igihe yari afite imyaka 17, nyina yarapfuye. Nyuma yaho, undi muryango wareze murumuna we.
Ngoma ifite uruhu rwitwa Vitiligo, rutera uruhu gutakaza pigmentation, bikavamo ibara.
Yashakanye na mugenzi we w'amafirime Tshepi Mashego akaba se w'umuhungu umwe, Leano, wavutse muri Mutarama 2017.
Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuyobozi wigenga. Hanyuma yatangiye gukina muri tereviziyo izwi cyane ya "Scandal" nka extrait igaragara. Umuyobozi amaze kubona ubushobozi bwe bwo gukina, Ngoma yahise azamurwa mu ntera ashyigikirwa. Icyakora nyuma y'amezi make, yazamuwe mu ntera kugira uruhare runini rw'imiterere 'Quinton Nyathi'. Iki gitaramo cyabaye imwe mu masabune akurikiranwa cyane muri Afrika yepfo, kandi yanatangajwe muri Afrika yose kuri eAfrica, e.tv Botswana na e.tv Gana.

Nqobile Nunu Khumalo (yavutse 15 Mata 1992), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika y'Epfo akaba ari numu model Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri "serivise za" tereviziyo Isibaya, "Soul City" na "Scandal!".
Yavutse ku ya 15 Mata 1992 i Mpumalanga, muri Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango wa Siswati. Igihe yari afite amezi abiri, umuryango we wimukiye i Johannesburg. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yize muri St Mary's Diocesan School of Girls, Pretoria amashuri yisumbuye. Nyuma yinjiye mu kigo cya Midrand Graduate Institute arangiza impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanzi mu itangazamakuru.
Muri 2013, yagaragaye muri filimi ya mbere mu gihembwe cya mbere cya filimi izwi cyane "Isibaya". Muri uruhererekane, yakinnye nka 'Cindy'. Muri 2016, yakinnye nka 'Hlengiwe Twala', muri serivise yikinamico ya eTV "Scandal!". Nyuma yaje gutsindira igihembo mpuzamahanga nk'umukinnyi mwiza wa Afurika witwaye neza muri New Vision International Film Festival, yabereye i Amsterdam mu Buholandi, 2019 kubera uruhare.
Hanyuma yakinnye kuri filimi ya "Soul City" aho yakinnye cyane 'Relebogile “Riri”' Diholo '.

Jack Devnarain (yavutse 9 Gashyantare 1971), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serivise za tereviziyo"The Ghost and the Darkness", "Isidingo" na "Mayfair".
Yavutse ku ya 9 Gashyantare 1971 i Tongaat, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, Afurika y'Epfo. Nyina yari umwarimu w'ikinamico.
Yashakanye na Pam Devnarain kandi ni se w'abana babiri.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina i Durban abinyujije mu muziki rusange. Muri kiriya gihe, yize amategeko muri kaminuza ya KZN arangiza mu 1993. Mu 1996, yatangiye gukina filime muri "The Ghost and Darkness" afite uruhare ruto. Hanyuma mu 1998, yagaragaye muri televiziyo izwi cyane "Isidingo" afite uruhare runini 'Rajesh Kumar' yamenyekanye cyane. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yakoraga mu gipolisi imyaka icyenda kugeza mu 2003 mu ishami ryihutirwa no gukumira ibyaha aho yari azwi cyane kubera ifatwa rye n’icyaha. Icyakora, yakomeje kugaragara kuri tereviziyo, sinema ndetse n’ikinamico mu buzima bwe bwemewe n'amategeko.
Mu 2002, yimukiye i Johannesburg kuba umukinnyi wabigize umwuga. Muri 2011, yakinnye muri firime ya heist film "31 miliyoni reasons" ayiyobowe. Nyuma yaje kubona nomero ya SAFTA nkumukinnyi witwaye neza muri firime. Muri 2015, yari mu itsinda rya Trek4Mandela ryateranije Kilimanjaro ku munsi wa Mandela 2015, akaba ari umuhate wo gukusanya inkunga yo gutera inkunga Caring4Girls. Kuva icyo gihe yabaye umwe mu bagize Komite Nyobozi y’ishyirahamwe ry’abakinnyi bo muri Afurika yepfo (SAGA) kuva mu 2010.
Muri 2018, yagaragaye muri firime yo muri Afurika yepfo yibyaha byibasiye "Mayfair". Yakinnye uruhare rwa 'Jalaal' muri film, nyuma yaje gusubirwamo neza. Iyi filime kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya 62 rya BFI London na Afurika mu iserukiramuco rya Filime mu Kwakira 2018.

Shahir 'Shaz' Chundra (yavutse ku ya 27 Gicurasi 1980), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika yepfo ukomoka mu Buhinde. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serivise za tereviziyo "Stellenbosch", "Abanyamwuga" ndetse "n'isi itagaragara".
Yavutse ku ya 27 Gicurasi 1980 i Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal, Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango w'Abahinde.
Yatangiye gukina afite imyaka 5 nkumukinnyi wumwana. Afite imyaka 17, yatangiye impamyabumenyi yo gukina amafilime muri AFDA, Ishuri ryubukungu bwo guhanga i Johannesburg. Amaze kurangiza, yayoboye ibitaramo byamamaye byurubyiruko muri Afrika yepfo SABC harimo;"Street Journal" and "Kasi 101 and Noted". Muri kiriya gihe, yakoze nk'umwanditsi wa sitcoms yo muri Afrika yepfo: "My Perfect Family" and "Majakhatata Records".. Mu 2011 yimukiye muri Amerika yiga gukina muri New York Film Academy.
Yabaye umuyobozi muri"Survivor South Africa Champions" na "Masterchef Season 3". Nyuma yaje kuba Umuyobozi muri Power Couple South Africa.. Nkumuyobozi wuruhererekane, yakoze progaramu nyinshi zizwi nka "Reality Check na Bootcamp Msanzi Celebrity Edition" na "Zavion Season 1". Ni n'umucuranzi wakoraga nk'umuririmbyi ukomeye w'itsinda rya rock, 'MadLove', aho yitabiriye inshuro 3 kumurongo wa 1.
Mu 2005, yagaragaye muri filimi "Isidingo" aho yakinnye "nk'umuyobozi Brown" mu bice bibiri. Igitaramo cyamenyekanye cyane kandi kirakomeza kugeza muri 2012. Yagaragaye kandi muri serial: "7de Laan" na "Entabeni". Muri 2014, yakinnye muri Emmy yegukanye ibihembo mpuzamahanga bya "Homeland" season 4, aho yakinnye nka 'Infantry Major' mubice " Krieg Nicht Lieb ". Muri 2017, yakinnye umugome wambere, 'Raj Pillay' muri serial "Bedford Wives" yerekanwe kuri SABC 3. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri filime "Igikorwa cyo Kwanga".
Muri 2018, yagaragaye muri firime yo muri Afurika yepfo yibyaha byibasiye "Mayfair". Yakinnye uruhare rwa 'Parvez' muri film, nyuma yaje kwakirwa neza. Iyi filime kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya 62 rya BFI London na Afurika mu iserukiramuco rya Filime mu Kwakira 2018.
Muri 2019, yakinnye muminsi "3 yo kugenda" kandi akina 'Roy'. Iyi filime yasohotse mu ikinamico ku ya 25 Mutarama 2019. Muri 2019, yabaye Umuyobozi wuruhererekane kuri televiziyo "The Bachelor".

Rajesh Gopie, ni umukinnnyi wa firime muri Afurika y'Epfo uturuka muri Indian. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serivise za tereviziyo "Stellenbosch", "Professionals" and "The World Unseen"
Yavukiye i Durban, muri Afurika y'Epfo mu muryango w'Abahinde. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya BA mu Cyongereza, Ikinamico n'Amateka muri kaminuza ya Natal.
Muri Nyakanga 2020, nyirasenge Dolly Singh yapfuye afite imyaka 76 azize indwara ya COVID-19.
Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yimukiye mu Bwongereza umwaka umwe yiga ikinamico. Amaze gusubira muri Afurika y'Epfo, yakoze ikinamico "hanze ya Bound" ivuga ku buzima n'ibihe by'imiryango y'Abahinde bo muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Amaze gusubira muri Afurika y'Epfo, yinjiye mu makinamico menshi nka"Be Proud, Be Yourself", "Out of Bounds" (1999), "The Coolie Odyssey" (2002), "The Tale of the Allergist’s Wife", "The Chimp Project", "Romeo and Juliet", "Back to the Faith", "Mahatma vs Gandhi", "The Pinter Sketches", "The Wiz" and "Hamlet" (2005). Hagati aho, yakoraga nk'umwanditsi w'amakinamico ku makinamico,"Out of Bounds" (1999), "Be Proud", "Be Yourself Out of Bounds" (2001), "Mahatma-Madiba", "Marital Bliss" and "Too Close for Comfort". Mu 2001, yatsindiye igihembo cyimyandikire myiza y’abasangwabutaka muri Fleur du Cap Theatre Awards kubera ikinamico "Out of Bound". Yayoboye kandi, yandika kandi akina ikinamico izwi cyane ya "Coolie Odyssey" mu 2002.
Muri 2013 yahawe buruse ya Oppenheimer aho yagiye i Londres gukurikirana amasomo ya nyuma. Nyuma yarangije icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu mahugurwa y'abakinnyi no gutoza mu ishuri rikuru rya Royal Central Speech and Drama muri 2014. Muri 2015, yabaye umuyobozi w'ikinamico hamwe na "Yerma" ikinamico yanditswe na Federico García Lorca.
Muri 2017, yakinnye muri firime yo gusetsa yo muri Afurika yepfo "Gukomeza hamwe na Kandasamys" iyobowe na Jayan Moodley. Iyi filime ibaye filime ya mbere yo muri Afurika yepfo yerekanwe cyane mu makinamico. Irimo Jailoshini Naidoo, Maeshni Naicker, Madhushan Singh, na Mishqah Parthiephal. Iyi filime yaje kuba filime yinjije amafaranga menshi muri Afurika y'Epfo muri 2017, ndetse na filime yo muri Afurika y'Epfo yinjije amafaranga menshi ku isi muri 2017.
Muri 2018, yagaragaye muri firime yo muri Afurika yepfo yibyaha byibasiye "Mayfair". Yakinnye cyane muri 'Aziz' muri film, nyuma yaje kwakirwa neza. Iyi filime kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya 62 rya BFI London na Afurika mu iserukiramuco rya Filime mu Kwakira 2018.

Katleho Ramaphakela, ni umukinnyi wa filimi akaba na producer muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi akaba na producer wa seri zizwi cyane za tereviziyo na firime "Check Coast", "Thulani No Thuli" na "Seriously Single".
Afite murumuna we: Tshepo na mushiki we: Rethabile.
Hamwe na murumuna we na mushiki we, Rethabile yashinze isosiyete ikora firime 'Burnt Onion' mu 2010. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yakinnye nka 'Thami' mu ikinamico ya SABC1 ya "Intersexions" ndetse nyuma yaje gutorwa mu gihembo cya SAFTA mu cyiciro cy’abakinnyi beza mu rukurikirane rw’ikinamico. Yakoze sitcoms ya SABC1 "My Perfect Family", "Thuli noThulani", na Vuzu mockumentary "Check-Coast".
Usibye production, yaje kugaragara kuri sitidiyo izwi cyane muri filimi na serial nka "Scandal!","Wild at Heart", "Isidingo","Backstage" and "Kota Life Crisis". Usibye filimi, yakinnye muri firime nkeya zirimo: "Blood and Oil", "Mary and Martha", "Iron Will", "Finding Lenny" and "Journey is the Destination". Ni n'umwanditsi wamamaye, wanditse ibihangano byinshi bya 'Lokshin Bioskop' "Uyaphapha", "Reflections", "Check-Coast", "4 Hours", "Kasi Superhero" and "Naledi". Muri 2017, yakinnye nka 'Detective Dlamini' muri filime ya "Bedford Wives".
Muri Kanama 2020, yayoboye filime isetsa "Seriously Single" hamwe na mushiki we Rethabile. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Rethabile Ramaphakela (yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1987), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika yepfo, utunganya amafilime. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi akaba na producer wa serivise zizwi cyane kuri tereviziyo na firime "Seriously Single", "Bedford Wives" na "The Bang Bang Club".
Yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1987 muri Afurika y'Epfo. Afite barumuna be: Tshepo na Katleho.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gutanga ikiganiro cya KTV. Hamwe na barumuna be bombi, Rethabile yashinze isosiyete ikora firime 'Burnt Onion' mu 2010. Muri 2014, yagize uruhare runini muri film mpuzamahanga "The Bang Bang Club". Hanyuma muri sosiyete yakoze televiziyo sitcom "My Family Perfect", televiziyo kuri SABC1 muri 2015. Amaze kwerekana neza sitcom, yakoze firime ngufi nka "Goodbye" "Thokoza" ashingiye ku ntambara zabereye i Thokoza mu myaka ya za 1980. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa sitcom, yakoze seri za tereviziyo Thuli "no Thulani", "Kota Life Crisis" na "Check Coast" abinyujije mu nzu ikora filimi.
Muri Kanama 2020, yayoboye filime isetsa "Seriously Single" hamwe na murumuna we Katleho Ramaphakela. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Dominika Novak Jablonska (yavutse 20 Kanama 1985), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Polonye. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri seri zizwi cyane za tereviziyo na firime "The Runaway", "Mary na Martha" na "The Forgiven".
Yavutse ku ya 20 Kanama 1985 i Łódź, muri Polonye. Mu 1990, yimukiye muri Afurika y'Epfo nyuma arangije amashuri y’ishuri ry’ubuhanzi i Johannesburg. Hanyuma yemeye bourse yo kwiga impamyabumenyi muri siyanse yubuzima. Ariko, yavuye muri bourse nyuma yumwaka asubira mubuhanzi bukomeye. Muri 2009, yarangije impamyabumenyi ya BA muri Theatre &amp; Performance muri kaminuza ya Cape Town.
Kuva icyo gihe yakoraga cyane mu gukina ibikorwa, kuyobora no gukora muri Afrika yepfo. Mu 2006, yakinnye bwa mbere afite uruhare ruto muri "firime za televiziyo Krakatoa:Volcano of Destruction". Hanyuma mu mwaka wa 2010, yahawe umwanya wo gushyigikira 'Julia Carvalho' muri seri ya "League of Glory.".
Hanyuma yagaragaye muri firime nyinshi za tereviziyo, mini-serial hamwe nikinamico nka; "The Runaway", "Wild at Heart" and "Mary and Martha". Hagati aho, yinjiye filimi televiziyo nk'ungirije uhitamo abakinnyi, nka "The Girl," "Labyrinth" na "Flight ya Storks." Muri 2014, yakoze filime ye ya mbere akina na firime "Knysna", aho yakinnye nka'Debra'.

Mojakisane 'Mojak' Lehoko, ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Afurika yepfo, Umunyarwenya n'umwanditsi.
Yavukiye kandi akurira i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Yatangiye gusetsa akina muri Cool Runnings i Melville mu 2009, kandi ibitaramo bye byagaragaye mu iserukiramuco ry'ubuhanzi rya Ghramstown. Azwi kandi nka 'The Underground', Cool Runnings niyo club ndende yo gusetsa muri Afrika yepfo. Bitewe nuko yatsindiye kuba umunyarwenya uhagaze neza, yashoboye gukinira mu makipe menshi yo gusetsa muri Afurika yepfo nka 'Parker's Comedy &amp; Jive' (Johannesburg), 'Tings &amp; Times' (Pretoria), 'Zula' (Cape Umujyi) na 'Jou Ma Se Urwenya Club' (Cape Town).
Nyuma yatorewe igihembo cya Comic cyo guhitamo kuri televiziyo "Late Nite News hamwe na Loyiso Gola". Yanditse kandi inyandiko yerekana. Yatorewe kuba Emmy mpuzamahanga muri iki gitaramo. Yatowe kandi mu cyiciro cya Newcomer mu bihembo bya Comics Choice.
Yakoze ibiganiro bya tereviziyo bizwi cyane: "The Real Jozi A-Listers", "inkuru za Ekasi" hamwe na sitcom "Abomzala" kuri SABC. Nkumunyarwenya uhagaze, yateguye umugabo umwe yerekana "Nigute Nabonye Hano" byamenyekanye cyane muri Afrika yepfo. Nyuma yaje gukora ibiganiro bya tereviziyo "The Bantu Hour", nyuma yaje gutorwa mu bihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo bya Afurika y'Epfo (SAFTAs). Muri 2017, yabaye umukandida wa Comics Choice Awards nyinshi kandi yatsindiye igihembo cya Comics Pen igihembo cyumwanditsi mwiza. Muri tereviziyo, yakoraga porogaramu zizwi cyane "Newsish" na "Woza Kleva". Noneho yagaragaye mubiganiro byurwenya "People" aired muri Comedy Central. Hagati aho, yerekanye filime ye ya mbere "Wonderboy For President" iyobowe na John Barker.
Muri Kanama 2020, yagaragaye muri firime yo gusetsa "Seriously Single" afite uruhare ruto. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Thabo Gabriel Malema (yavutse 26 Ukuboza 1985), ni umukinnyi wa firime Afurika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime na ser za televiziyo:"The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency", "Single Guys" and "Strike Back".
Yavutse ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1985 i Mabopane, Gauteng, Johannesburg. Yarangije amashuri yakuye muri kaminuza ya Maryvale. Hanyuma yize firime muri Afrika yepfo ya Motion Picture Medium na Live Performance (AFDA). Yakurikiranye kandi impamyabumenyi n'itumanaho muri UNISA. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yagiye muri Uganda no muri Nigeriya akora muri sosiyete igendanwa ya Airtel.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina muri 2006. Yaje gukora film yamateka, "Kalushi". Iyi filime irazenguruka ku nkuru y’umuhungu ukiri muto, Salomo Mahlangu, winjiye mu mutwe wo kwibohora muri Afurika yepfo nyuma yo gukubitwa n’abapolisi ba apartheid. Mu ikinamico, yakinnye mu ikinamico nka "All Balls", "Umuzi ka Vusi" na "Woza Albert". Mu mwaka wa 2015, yatorewe igihembo cya Golden Horn igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo bya Afurika y'Epfo (SAFTAs) kubera uruhare rwe nka "Khaya" muri filime "Single Guys". Ariko, azwi cyane kugaragara kuri Agent nka Vuyo no kuri ivu kugeza ivu nka Young Selogilwe Namane.
Uretse cinema n'ikinamico, kandi yabonekeye mu Televiziyo productions nka "The Lab" na "Room 9," single"Guys," "Gold Diggers" na "Lithapo." Hagati aho, yakoranye na firime mpuzamahanga za Hollywood nka "Primeval Kill", "10 000 BC" na "A Million Colors".
Muri Kanama 2020, yakinnye muri filime yo gusetsa igitsina "Seriously Single" afatanije na Katleho Ramaphakela na Rethabile Ramaphakela. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Tiffany Jones Barbuzano, numukinnyi wamafirime muri Afurika yepfo.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya BA Dramatic Arts yakuye muri kaminuza ya Witwatersrand. Yasoje kandi impamyabumenyi muri firime mu Ishuri ry’Ubuhanzi.
Muri 2010, yakinnye nka 'Danny Gibson' muri seri ya e.tv ikinamico "4 Play: Sex Tips for Girls". Yakomeje kugira uruhare kugeza muri 2012. Muri 2013, yatsindiye igihembo cya SAFTA Golden Horn igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza wa serial "4 Play: Sex Tips for Girls". Kuva mu 2006 kugeza 2007, yakinnye nka 'Gabrielle' kuri "seri zisetsa-ikinamico Izoso Connexion yanyuze" kuri SABC1. Urukurikirane rwakozwe numugabo we Johnny Barbuzano. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yatorewe igihembo cya SAFTA Golden Horn igihembo cyiza cyagezweho mu myandikire ya "Kota Life Crisis".
Ibindi byerekana kumutera imbaraga niSober Companion (2016), Seriously Single (2020) and Still Breathing (2020). Yashinze isosiyete ikora firime 'Localala Productions'. Yagize uruhare mu bitaramo byinshi nka "Six Inches na Shakers", "Macbeth", "Othello" na "A Midsummer Night Dream".
Tiffany yahise yifatanya n’ikinamico "Impromptu Zoo", yakinirwaga kuri Sandton Theatre. "Yagaragaye kandi mubiganiro" byinshi bya TV nka "Quickies", "Snitch", "Man to Man", "Uncle Max", and "Binnelanders". Usibye gukina, yabaye umwanditsi, kuri seri nyinshi: "Izoso Connexion", "Isidingo" na "Scandal" ndetse no gufata amashusho yikinamico M-Net. Muri 2015, yagaragaye muri seri yikinamico ya BBC "Wild on Heart". Muri 2017, yatsindiye igihembo cya SAFTA Golden Horn igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza kubera uruhare rwe muri televiziyo "Sober Companion".
Mu ntangiriro za 2020, yatowe na SAFTA Zahabu Ihembe ryiza ryagezweho mu myandikire ya "Lockdown". Muri Kanama 2020, yakinnye muri filime yo gusetsa igitsina "Seriously Single" afatanije na Katleho Ramaphakela na Rethabile Ramaphakela. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Mpho Osei Tutu (yavutse ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1981), ni umukinnyi wa firime w’umufaransa wavukiye muri Afurika yepfo akaba numuhanzi wijwi ukomoka muri Gana-Mosotho. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri firime na seri za tereviziyo:Seriously single,"Mrs Right Guy" and "The Jakes Are Missing". Uretse gukora, kandi ni screenwriter, umuyobozi na producer. Tutu kandi yakinnye nk'umuntu wambere muri serie yo muri Afrika yepfo 2018 yitwa The Imposter yari iyerekwa ryumuhungu wa kabiri nyuma yicyerekezo cyumukobwa wa mbere, yakinnye nka Tebogo na Gary Mokoena.
Yavutse ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1981 i Paris mu Bufaransa kwa se o muri Gana na nyina uva muri Mosotho. Kubera inkomoko y’amahanga, yabayeho mu bihugu byinshi: Lesotho, Ubufaransa, Ubwongereza, Togo na Gana. Mu 1992, umuryango we watuye muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatangiye ikinamico afite imyaka umunani. Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi ya BA (Hons) muri Dramatic Art yakuye muri kaminuza ya Wits.
Yashakanye na Tumi Morake, umukinnyi wa filime mugenzi we, umunyarwenya n'umwanditsi. Bashakanye ku ya 28 Ugushyingo 2009. Abashakanye bafite abana batatu.
Yatangiye gukina mu ikinamico aho yakinnye inshuro nyinshi mu gukina amakinamico ya Zakes Mda ya"The Mother Of All Eating", Pieter-Dirk Uys 'MacBeki, Paul Slabolepsky "For Your Ears Only", "The Island". Hamwe naba nyuma, yazengurutse Ubwongereza, Amerika n'Ubugereki. Noneho yakoze "Getting On" Yatsindiye Igihembo Cyiza Muri rusange Gucibwa muri Multi Choice VUKA! Ibihembo muri 2006. Nyuma yakinnye abantu benshi mumashusho ye yise "Carvincing Carlos" aho yakiriye igihembo cyambere cya Bank Ovation Award muri 2010. Ku ruhare 'La Fleche' mu ikinamico ya Sylvaine Strike "The Miser" yatsindiye Umukino mwiza muri Naledi Theatre Awards 2013.
Hagati aho, yinjiye kuri tereviziyo, akina muri sitcoms nyinshi "Kota Life Crisis", "High Rollers", "Samsokolo" ; kubyo yatorewe kuba umukinnyi mwiza muri TV Comedy muri SAFTAs 2014. Hanyuma yakinnye nka 'Desmond' muri International Emmy Nominated serial "Home Home". Hanyuma yerekanye uruhare rwa 'Bomba' muri firime yamamaye ku rwego mpuzamahanga "A Million Colors". Yatowe kandi nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Filime Yerekana muri SAFTAs 2013 kuri iyi film. Ni n'umuhanzi uzwi cyane aho yavugiye amajwi kuri radiyo nyinshi.
Usibye gukina, "yanakoze nk'umwanditsi wa sinema Ses Top La", "Tempy Pushas", "My Perfect Family" aho yatoranije kwandika neza muri Comedy ya TV muri SAFTAs 2014, ndetse na "Rhythm City" yatsindiye igihembo cyiza Yandika mu ikinamico ya TV muri SAFTAs mu 2009., Mu 2010, yanditse "Hopeville" kandi atoranyirizwa igihembo mpuzamahanga cya Emmy mu 2010. Hagati aho, yanabaye umuyobozi w"'amafilime nka Zone 14", "Ga Re Dumele 4" na "Kota Life Crisis".
Nyuma yaje gukorana na firime ngufi "Joburg" yatoranijwe kumugaragaro muri Sundance Film Festival mu 2010. Yashinze isosiyete ikora firime, 'What Not Entertainment' nyuma akora ibihe 2 bya sitcom "Kota Life Crisis" ya Mzansi Magic. Kuva mu 2012 kugeza 2014, yakoraga mu buyobozi bw'Ishyirahamwe ry'Abakinnyi bo muri Afurika y'Epfo (SAGA). Hagati aho, niwe wateguye ishyirahamwe ryitwa Repertory Amateur Players Society (RAPS) One Act Plays Festival, ifatwa nkumunsi mukuru wo gukina amakinamico maremare kandi yamamaye muri Afrika yepfo.
Muri Kanama 2020, yakinnye muri filime yo gusetsa igitsina "Seriously Single" afatanije na Katleho Ramaphakela na Rethabile Ramaphakela. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Bohang Moeko (wavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1988), ni umukinnyi wumunyamideli wo muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime na serivise za televiziyo: "Byukuri Ingaragu (film)", "Zone Zishyushye" hamwe "nabakozi bo murugo".
Yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1988 i Protea y'Amajyaruguru, Soweto. Se yakoraga mu bwubatsi. Yarangije afite impamyabumenyi y'icyubahiro mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe muri Kaminuza ya Leta y'Ubuntu. arangije, yimukiye i Durban arahatura akora imyaka ibiri.
Yatangiye gukundana na Shantal Dietrich, umutoza wa fitness kuva 2018. bagera bakora Nyakanga 2020.
Yimukiye i Johannesburg kwiga gukina. Muri kiriya gihe, yakinnye bwa mbere kuri Zabalaza muri 2013 afite uruhare 'Victor'. Kuva icyo gihe, yakinnye muri firime nyinshi na serivise za televiziyo nka "Impeta" "y'ibinyoma", "Side Dish", Isithunzi, "Abakozi bo mu rugo", "Scandal", "Isidingo", "Hot Zone", na "Umwamikazi". Hagati aho, yerekeje mu mwuga wo kwerekana imideli aho yabaye finale mu marushanwa ya Mr South Africa 2013.
Yagaragaye kandi kuri "#Karektas" nka 'Umushyitsi w'icyamamare' hanyuma ku "bakozi bo" mu rugo nka 'Kabelo' muri 2018. Muri 2019, yakoze uruhare rwe rwa mbere mpuzamahanga muri serie ngufi "The Hot Zone". Muri Kanama 2020, yakinnye muri filime yo gusetsa igitsina "Seriously Single" afatanije na Katleho Ramaphakela na Rethabile Ramaphakela. Yasohotse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2020 kuri Netflix.

Yor-El Francis, ni umukinnyi wa firime ukomoka muri Liberia utuye Amerika kandi akora nka producer. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa firime yamamaye cyane Murder in the Cassava Patch.
Yavukiye i Monrovia, muri Liberiya mu muryango ukomeye wa Liberiya; ba Martins bo mu Ntara ya Bassa na Francis bo muri Marshall. Yabanje kwiga mu ishuri rya Hilton Van Ee hanyuma Ishuri rya Koperative y'Abanyamerika ryiga amashuri abanza. Nyuma yaje kwiga mu kibonezamvugo cya Siyera Lewone i Freetown, muri Siyera Lewone kugira ngo arangize amashuri yisumbuye. Se yari afite amasosiyete muri Gana, Haiti, Liberiya, Siyera Lewone, Californiya na Miami kandi hagati aho, nyina yari afite butike muri Monrovia.
Amashuri yisumbuye, yimukiye muri Amerika n'umuryango we atura mu mujyi wa New York. Nyuma yize muri Hunter College, ishuri ryubuhanzi ryigenga rya Manhattan's Upper East maze yiga firime kandi yimenyereza kuri MTV Networks. Nyuma, yabonye Master of Arts muri Diregiteri ya Filime yakuye muri kaminuza yumujyi wa New York. Muri 2003, yashyizwe muri Diregiteri yimyaka ibiri yubuyobozi bwa Amerika muri gahunda yo guhugura ba Producer.
Yabanje kwimenyereza umwuga muri MTV Networks, hanyuma yimukira kuri Televiziyo ya Black Entertainment [BET], mbere yo kubona akazi muri FOX. Yatangiye umwuga wa firime nkumuyobozi wungirije kumashusho yerekana amashusho, tereviziyo niyamamaza. Yabigizemo uruhare nkumuyobozi wungirije wa kabiri kuri serivise nyinshi za tereviziyo na firime zirimo: "The West Wing" (1999), "NCIS" (2003), "The Closer" (2005), "Crank" (2006) "Bavandimwe &amp; Mushikiwabo" (2006) "Zeke na Luther" (2009). Mu 2005, yatsindiye igihembo cya mbere cya komisiyo ishinzwe amafilime muri Afurika kubera kwandika amashusho kubera amashusho ye "Piankhi, igikomangoma cya Misiri".
Muri 2012, yakoze filime ye yambere yumukobwa, "Ubwicanyi muri Cassava Patch", ishingiye kuri Liberiya kavukire. Mu ruzinduko rwe muri Liberiya muri iyo filimi, yahuye na Peter Ballah, batangira gukorana na filime. Nyuma muri firime, abakinnyi be bose babaye abana ba Ballah.

Chad N. Walker, ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Amerika kandi akora na producing. Azwi cyane nkumuyobozi wa documentaire "Brownstones to Red Dirt", "We Must Go".
Mbere yo kuyobora documentaire, yatangiye gukora nkumuhuzabikorwa wibikorwa bigufi bya "Magic Scarf". Hanyuma yinjiye nkumufasha wa Production hamwe nuwungirije umwanditsi wa firime ya firime ya "Ice Age: The Meltdown", "Age Age: Umuseke wa Dinosaurs", "Epic" na "Rio". Noneho muri 2009, yabaye umwanditsi witoza muri firime "Horton Yumva Ninde!". Muri 2010, yerekanwe bwa mbere mubuyobozi hamwe na documentaire "Brownstones kugeza Red Dirt". Filime izenguruka abana bamwe i Brooklyn bahinduka amakaramu yimfubyi ziva muri Siyera Lewone. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa documentaire, yakoze documentaire ye ya kabiri "Kei".
Noneho muri 2014, yakoze "I Am Big Bird: The Caroll Spinney Story" hamwe na Dave LaMattina. Filime yakiriwe neza muri rusange. Muri 2014, yatsindiye igihembo cya Audience Choice igihembo cyiza muri Cinéfest Sudbury International Festival Festival ya film.
Mu 2007, yafatanyije gushinga inzu yerekana amafilime, 'Umuringa Pot Pictures' aherekejwe na Dave LaMattina na Clay Frost.

Henrietta Mbawah, ni Umukinnyi wa filime muri Siyera Lewone, akaba n'umuntu uharanira imibereho myiza. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime ngufi yamamaye cyane "Jattu" n'uruhare rw'Umunyamakuru' muri firime ngufi ya "Ebola Checkpoint".
Ku ikubitiro yatangiye gukina serivise za tereviziyo afite inshingano zoroheje kandi zitemewe. Muri 2016, yakoze film ngufi "Jattu". Iyi filime izenguruka umukobwa witwa Jattu, warokotse icyorezo cya Ebola muri Afurika. Nyuma muri uwo mwaka, yagaragaye muri filime ngufi ya "Ebola" aho yakinnye 'Umunyamakuru'. Ni n'umuyobozi mukuru wa Manor River Entertainment Company. Muri 2019, yatsindiye igihembo cya Mushikiwabo kubera uruhare yagize mu guha ubushobozi abagore muri Siyera Lewone.

Lamia Chraïbi, ni Utunganya firimewo muri maroke n'ubufaransa. Azwi cyane nka producer wa firime zizwi cyane "Mimosas", "Jahilya" na "Urgent".
Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye mu micungire y'itumanaho n'amajwi mu Bufaransa ahitwa Valenciennes, yatangiye umwuga we.
Yakomeje gukora imyaka 9 kubikorwa bitandukanye bya Paris. Mu mwaka wa 2011, yashinze isosiyete ikora 'Moon a Deal Films' i Paris, nyuma yo gushinga uruganda rukora 'La Prod' mu 2007 i Casablanca.
Muri 2016, yakoranye na firime "Mimosas" na Oliver Laxe. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma iza gutsindira igihembo kinini cyicyumweru cy’abanenga mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes mu 2016. Hanyuma yakoze firime "Tegnap" iyobowe na Balint Kenyeres. Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Festival ya Lokarno. Muri 2018, yakoze "Achoura", filime ya fantasy yo muri Maroc iyobowe na Talal Selhami. Iyi filime yabaye igihembo cyiza cya Filime muri Hardline Festival ndetse ikanahabwa umwihariko wa Jury muri Festival ya Sitges Fantastic.
In 2019, she produced the television series "Meskoun", which was initiated as a pan-Arab genre-bending series with Moroccan filmmaker Hicham Lasri.

Mohamed Hefzy (yavutse ku ya 13 Werurwe 1975), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Misiri akaba Umwanditsi. Umwe mu batunganya amafilime akomeye mu burasirazuba bwo hagati no muri Afurika, Screen International yamwise umwarabu wenyine mu bayobozi 30 bazaza mu gutunganya amafilime mu 2013. Muri 2016, Hefzy yatoranijwe na Variety hejuru yurutonde rw "Amazina icumi ugomba kumenya mu nganda zamafirime y’abarabu" maze amushyira muri Variety 500.
Yavutse ku ya 13 Werurwe 1975 i Cairo mu Misiri. Mbere yo kwinjira muri sinema, yize ibijyanye na metallurgical engineering i Londres.
Niwe washinze isosiyete ikora 'Film Clinic' iherereye mu Misiri yashinzwe mu 2005. Binyuze muri iyo sosiyete, yatanze amahugurwa na gahunda zamahugurwa kubantu ba firime yabarabu nabanyafurika bakorana nimiryango mpuzamahanga nibigo. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yabaye umwe mu bagize inteko y'abacamanza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Cairo. Hanyuma mu 2011, yabaye inteko y'abacamanza mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime Abu Dhabi hanyuma aba umunyamuryango mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Venice muri 2018. Kuva mu 2015 kugeza 2017, Hefzy yabaye umuyobozi w'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Ismailia rya Documentaire na Short, ndetse no mu nama ngishwanama ya Festival mpuzamahanga ya Cairo. Kuva mu 2013, yabaye umwe mu bagize inama y'ubutegetsi ya Sinema yo mu Misiri.
Muri 2016, yakoze firime "Clash". Nyuma iyi firime yatoranijwe nka firime itangiza igice cya ' Un Certain Regard ' igice cya Cannes International Festival Festival. Muri 2018, yakoranye na producer "Yomeddine". Filime kandi yahisemo kwerekanwa i Cannes mumarushanwa yemewe. Muri 2020, yakoze firime ya "Luxor" yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Dramatic World Festival muri Sundance Film Festival. Hagati aho, abo bakoranye, "Souad, batoranijwe ku" mugaragaro ku nshuro ya mbere yerekana iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes, ryabaye ku nshuro ya gatatu muri Cannes.
Muri Werurwe 2018, yabaye perezida muto mu mateka y'iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Cairo, igihe Hefzy yahawe na minisitiri w’umuco. Muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye Centre ya Arabiya Cinema Centre y’Abarabu Yatanzwe n’Umunyamakuru wa Hollywood kubera uruhare yagize muri sinema yisi. Nyuma muri kamena 2019, yatumiwe nkumunyamuryango wa Academy ya Motions Pictures Arts Arts na Science mu ishami rya "Producer".

Connie Temweka Gabisile Chiume (yavutse ku ya 5 Kamena 1952 apfa ku ya 6 Kanama 2024) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika yepfo Azwiho gukina film muri "Black Panther", "Black Is King" na "Blessers". Kuri tereviziyo, yagaragaye muri "Zone 14", "Umujyi wa Rhythm", na "Gomora".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Chiume yavukiye i Welkom muri Afurika y'Epfo. Se wa Wright Tadeyo Chiume (m. 1983) yakomokaga muri Usisya, Nkhata Bay, Malawi na nyina MaNdlovu (m. 2020) bakomoka i KwaZulu-Natal, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Mubyara weEfurayimu Mganda Chiume wo muri Malawi.
Chiume yamaze ubwana bwe muri Welkom. Yarangije matriche mu burasirazuba bwa Cape impamyabumenyi yo kwigisha mu 1976. Amaze imyaka mike yigisha, yaretse ingendo yimukira mu Bugereki.
Chiume yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina afite uruhare muri "Porgy na Bess", "Ipi Ntombi", na "Shop Ntoya ya Horrors". Amaze gusubira muri Afurika y'Epfo, yatowe nka Thembi mu rukurikirane rwo mu 1989 "Inkom 'Edla Yodwa" hanyuma filime yo mu 1990 yitwa "Warriors from Hell". Mu 2000, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri serivise yikinamico muri Afurika yepfo ya Filime na seri za Televiziyo.
Muri 2006, yakinnye mubikorwa bya stage "Wakubise Umugore" "nawe Ukubita Urutare". Kuva 2007 kugeza 2015, Chiume yamenyekanye cyane kubera uruhare rwe nka Stella Moloi muri SABC1 ikinamico ya "Zone 14", yamuhesheje indi SAFTA. Yabonye kandi igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri Drama mugihe cya 3 SAFTA. Muri 2015, yagaragaye muri opera yisabune "Rhythm City" nka Mamokete Khuse.
Muri 2018, Chiume yakinnye Mining Tribe Umusaza muri Marvel Cinematic Universe film "Black Panther".
Muri 2020, Chiume yinjiye mu mwanya wa Mam'Sonto Molefe mu rukurikirane "rw'ikinamico Gomora" maze agaragara muri filime "Black Is King". Mu Kwakira 2020, yabonye igihembo cya Feather Award.
Chiume yashakanye kuva 1985 kugeza 2004. Ni nyina w'abana bane, afite abahungu babiri n'abakobwa babiri.

Mohamed Habib Attia (wavutse 1983), ni producer wa firime wo muri Tuniziya. Azwi cyane nka producer wa firime zizwi cyane "Falastine Stereo","It Was Better Tomorrow" na "Le Challat de Tunis".
Yavutse mu 1983 i Tuniziya, muri Tuniziya.
Muri 2009, yakoranye na firime "Laila's Birthday" nk'umusaruro mpuzamahanga hamwe na Palesitine n'Ubuholandi. Filime yayobowe na Rashid Masharawi. Mu mwaka wa 2011, Attia yakoze "No No Fear" iyobowe na Mourad Ben Cheikh yahisemo kumugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes hanyuma nyuma ya Busan, Taormina, Sheffield, ibirori bya firime bya Dubai. Mu mwaka wa 2012, filime ye "It Was Better Tomorrow" iyobowe na Hinde Boujemaa yerekanwe bwa mbere mu gutoranya ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Venice, kandi yegukana igihembo cy’umuyobozi w’abarabu witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Dubai. Muri 2013, yakoze firime ya "Falastine Stereo ya" Rashid Masharawi. Yatoranijwe kumugaragaro muri Toronto, Dubai na Chicago ibirori bya firime.
Muri 2016, yifatanije na "Zaineb n'aime Pas la Neigh" iyobowe na Kaouther Ben Hania. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku isi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Lokarno, kandi yegukana igihembo cya Tanit d'or mu minsi ya Carthage Cinematographic ndetse n’igihembo cya Documentaire Nziza muri Cinemed Montpellier. Muri 2014, ibihangano bye "Le Challaat de Tunis" byafunguye igice cya ACID mu iserukiramuco rya Cannes maze yegukana igihembo cya Filime Nziza ya mbere mu iserukiramuco rya Namur, ku muyobozi mwiza na Filime nziza i Beirut. Iyi filime yatoranijwe ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Dubai, San Sebastian na Busan kandi ikwirakwizwa mu makinamico mu bihugu birenga 15.
Muri 2017, yakoranye nubundi bufatanye mpuzamahanga Ubwiza n'imbwa. Filime yerekanwe mu gice cya Un Certain Regard mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2017. Nyuma yaje gutoranywa nkuwinjira muri Tuniziya muri Filime Nziza Yindimi Zamahanga mu bihembo bya 91 bya Academy, ariko ntibyatoranijwe. Nyuma yaje kubona igihembo cyo guhanga amajwi meza, nyuma yegukana igihembo cya film nziza muri Jury y'abanyeshuri mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Angoulême Francophone.
Ni umuyobozi mukuru wa sosiyete ikora firime, 'Cinétéléfilms' kuva 2007. Isosiyete yashinzwe mu 1983. Muri 2018, yakoze "We Turashobora kuba Intwari" iyobowe na Hind Bensari. Filime yatsindiye igihembo kinini muri Hot Docs yo muri Kanada.

Safaa Abdallah Mohammed El Tokhi (yavutse ku ya 22 Kanama 1964), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Safaa El-Toukhi, ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Misiri. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Hunter", "Gunshot" and "Kafr Delhab".
Yavutse ku ya 22 Kanama 1964 i Cairo, mu Misiri. Se wa Abdallah Al-Toukhi yari umwanditsi w'amakinamico wavutse ku ya 18 Kanama 1926, apfa ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2001 afite imyaka 74. Nyina Fathia al-Assal yari umwanditsi w'icyamamare kandi ukina mu Misiri. Fathia yavutse ku ya 20 Gashyantare 1933 apfa ku ya 15 Kamena 2014 afite imyaka 81 nyuma y’ikibazo cy’ubuzima kitazwi.
Yarangije impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubuhanzi bwa Dramatic mu 1985. Mu ntangiriro, yakoraga nk'umwanditsi, yayobowe na nyina. Mu 1995, yatangiye gukora mu kigo cy’umuco w’igihugu.
Safaa yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina mu 1979 akoresheje televiziyo ya "El Bahitha". Yagaragaye nk'umukinnyi wa stage gusa mu "gakino kamwe El Ayyam El Makhmoura yateguwe" mu 1999. Yakomeje gukina muri firime nyinshi, nka "El Zaman El Saa'b", "El Mohagir", na "Bekhit we Adila". Hagati aho, yiganje kuri televiziyo, aho yakinnye muri serial: "Leyali El Hulmiyya", "Lan Ayesh Fi Galbab Abi", "Mahmoud El Masry". Ibikorwa bye byamamaye kuri tereviziyo byanyuze kuri serial "Qadhiya Rai " Am" hamwe na 'Yousra'.

Jorge Cohen (wavutse 1986), ni producer wa firime muri Angola. Azwi cyane nka producer wa firime "zizwi" cyane Alambamento, "Luanda 24/7" na "Air Conditioning".
Yavutse mu 1986 i Luanda, muri Angola. Muri 2009, yimukiye muri Porutugali arangiza icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bucuruzi bw’ubucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza Gatolika ya Lisbonne. Hanyuma yimukiye mu Bwongereza ahabwa impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n’umuco n’ubuhanga bwo guhanga udushya muri SOAS, kaminuza ya Londere mu 2018.
Muri 2009, Cohen yakoze "progaramu" ye ya mbere Alambamento, film ngufi. Yari umuyobozi wibikorwa byigihe gito, yakiriwe neza. Nyuma yo gutsinda muri make, yabaye umwe mu bashinze uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa 'Geração 80' mu 2010. Nyuma yaje gukora firime ngufi zirimo: "Luanda 24/7", "Havemos de Voltar" na "1999" kimwe na documentaire; "Triângulo", "Independência" iyobowe na Mário Bastos. Film documentaire "Independência" yatsindiye igihembo cyiswe Documentaire Nziza mu Iserukiramuco Mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Kameron kandi yari Yatoranijwe ku mugaragaro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Durban, Iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Afurika ryitwa Luxor ndetse n’iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Pan African.
Filime ye ya "Triângulo" 2013 yari Angola-Berezile-Porutugali. Muri 2014, yasohoye televiziyo "Afripedia Angola kuri tereviziyo ya" Suwede na Angola. MU 2017, yakoze documentaire "El Último País" iyobowe numuyobozi wa Cuba, Gretel Marín. Filime yakoze Guhitamo kumugaragaro Iserukiramuco rya Amsterdam 2017. Muri 2020, yakoze filime ye yambere yimpimbano, "Ikirere".

Steve Eboh, uzwi cyane nka Ajebo, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Nigeriya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwa firime "Igipimo Cyinshi", "Igipimo Cyinshi 2" na "Lionheart". Usibye gukina, Eboh numuproducer, umuntu wa tereviziyo numugiraneza.
Ni indigene ya Achi muri Oji River LGA yo muri leta ya Enugu. Nyuma yaje kurangiza afite impamyabumenyi y'itumanaho muri Kaminuza ya Lagos.
Muri 1996, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime yo murugo "Karishika" hamwe na "Karishika 2 yayo". Kuva icyo gihe yakomeje kwiganza muri firime nyinshi zo murugo. Yakinnye muri firime nyinshi zizwi nka Nollywood nka "Taboo", "Ikuku", "Narrow Escape", "Ibibi bibi" na "Concubines". Muri 2018, yagaragaye muri firime yo murugo "Lionheart" afite uruhare runini.
Muri kamena 2019, Eboh yatangajwe nka ambasaderi w’ikirango cya sosiyete itanga peteroli na Nigeriya yitwa 'GOVOIL'. Hagati aho, yabaye Visi Perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abakinnyi muri Nijeriya (AGN), na Perezida wa Komite y’igihugu ishinzwe kwita ku bana, AGN. Yabaye kandi umuyobozi mukuru wa Confirm Projects International Ltd mugihe gito.

Souleymane Sylla, ni umukinnyi wa firime ukomoka muri Gineya ariko utuye mubutaliyani. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri filime "Les princes de la ville", "Shiny Happy People" na "Tolo Tolo".
Yavukiye muri Gineya nyuma yimukira mu Butaliyani.
Souleymane Sylla yakuriyee muri gineya aho yamaze akiri muto. Yari afite imyaka 8 igihe umuryango wimukiye i Créteil. Ku ishuri ryisumbuye rya Simone de Beauvoir niho yavumbuye ikinamico. Nyuma yaho, yinjiye mu kigo cy’imyidagaduro cy’Abafaransa cyatoranijwe kandi kizwi cyane. Yagize uruhare mu gufungura ubudasa muri theatre, cyane cyane muri TNS i Strasbourg. Yerekanwe n'umuyobozi Blandine Savetier, yahawe akazi mu mushinga wa serial ya Odyssey, yerekanwe mu bice 13, hanze, mu iserukiramuco rya Avignon 2019. Kuva mu 2013, tumubona muri firime nyinshi ngufi, harimo Anthropologiya yumuntu ugezweho, Amabwiriza yumugani no Gukata umwenda, aho akinamo uruhare runini. Yimukiye mu buyobozi muri 2012 hamwe na Mchinda, l'invaincu, akurikirwa na 2015 na Le Costume na Les Princes de la ville muri 2016. Nk’uruhare runini, yakinnye mu Budage muri firime ya TV yitwa Penthesilea na Maximilian Villwock Mu mwaka wa 2019, yagaragaye muri filime ya Jérémie Elkaïm, Ils sont vivants, itarasohoka mu Bufaransa kugeza nyuma yimyaka ibiri kubera icyorezo cya Covid-19. Mu 2020, yakinnye muri filime yo gusetsa yo mu Butaliyani Tolo Tolo akina 'Oumar'. Iyi filime yabaye iyamamare ryinjije umunsi wa mbere miliyoni 8.7.

Dagmawi Yimer (yavutse 6 Ukuboza 1977), ni umukinnyi wa filimi uvuka muri etiyopiya ariko atuye mu Butaliyani. Niwe kandi washinze hamwe na visi perezida wa Archivio delle Memorie Migranti.
Yavutse ku ya 6 Ukuboza 1977 mu mujyi muto wa Kirkos, Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya. Mbere yo kuva mu gihugu, yize amategeko i Addis Abeba mu 2003.
Mu 2005, yavuye muri Etipoya kubera imvururu zikomeye nyuma ya politiki. Yavuye mu rugo atabimenyesheje se ariko nyina na mushiki we gusa. Yambutse ubutayu hagati ya Sudani na Libiya nyuma yambuka inyanja ya Mediterane mu mpera za Nyakanga 2006. Amaherezo yageze mu Butaliyani nyuma y'urugendo ruteye akaga. Yimukiye i Lampedusa ahatura kuva ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2006. Muri Gicurasi 2007, yitabiriye amasomo yo kuvuga amashusho yishyirahamwe rya Asinitas. Muri kiriya gihe, yakoze documentaire ye ya mbere "Ubutayu ninyanja" afatanyije na Asinitas, Zalab na Aamod.
Hagati aho, yimukiye mu bunzi bw’indimi n’umuco mu ishyirahamwe rya Asinitas Onlus, mu ishuri rimwe ry’abataliyani ry’abasaba ubuhunzi, impunzi n’abimukira. Mu myaka ye myiza kuva 2007 kugeza 2008, Yimer yakoze firime ngufi zizwi cyane: "Lo scabocchio", "Le sagome", na "Caravan". Noneho yakoze "Welcome to your home" hamwe na Marco Carsetti. Noneho yari umwe mu banditsi ba documentaire ya biografiya "Ngwino un uomo sulla terra" yibanze ku kwimuka uva muri Libiya ujya i Burayi. Filime yakozwe na Asinitas Onlus, kubufatanye bwa Zalab. Muri 2009, Yimer yakiriye Umwihariko muri BIF &amp; ST kuri documentaire.
Muri 2011, yakoze firime "Solo il mare", yibanda ku kirwa cya Lampedusa. Noneho muri 2013, Yimer yakoze "Va 'Pensiero" ashingiye ku nkuru yambukiranya ibitero bibiri by'ivanguramoko muri Milan na Florence. Muri 2015, yakoze firime ebyiri: "Asmat-Amazina" na "Benvenuti mu Butaliyani".

Ainea Ojiambo (yavutse 20 Mata 1970), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Constant Gardener", "Bullion" na "Jack Zollo: My life in crime".
Yavutse ku ya 20 Mata 1970 i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Ni se w'abana babiri, umuhungu n'umukobwa.
Mbere yo kwinjira muri ecran ikunzwe, yakoraga mumikino myinshi kandi nuburyo umwuga we wo gukina watangiye. Mu 2004, yatumiriwe gukina muri firime ya Hollywood "The Constant Gardener" iyobowe na Fernando Meirelles. Muri filime, yakinnye uruhare ruto rwa 'Umushoferi wa Polisi'. Filime yagenze neza kandi yinjiza amafaranga menshi kandi yegukana ibihembo bine bya Oscar. Hanyuma mu 2007, yakinnye muri tereviziyo ya Kenya "Makutano Junction" afite uruhare mu 'nzoka'.
Nyuma yo gutsinda k'uruhererekane, nyuma yaje gutumirwa gukina izindi televiziyo ebyiri: "Block-D" na "Noose ya Zahabu". Muri opera yisabune "Noose ya Zahabu", Ojiambo yakinnye nka 'Ole Mpisha'. Isabune yaje gutangazwa ibihe 3 muri Afrika muri Afrika Magic Channel. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakoze filime ye ya kabiri ya Hollywood "The First Grader", filime yerekana ikinamico yayobowe na Justin Chadwick. Muri filime, yagize uruhare runini nka 'Ushinzwe uburezi'.
Mu myaka yakurikiyeho, yagaragaye muri firime muri firime, "The Rugged Padiri", "Fundi-Mentals", "Nairobi Half Life", "Gukurikira Yesu", "Babuz Babies", "Kibera Kid", "Amaboko" "afunze", "Stigma", Obohoz, "Padiri Rugged", "Guerilla Boy", na "LoveDoctor". Mu mwaka wa 2014, yagaragaye muri filime y’ikinamico yo muri Uganda "Bullion yatowe" "muri Oscars" afite uruhare runini.

Hassani Shapi (yavutse 15 Nyakanga 1973), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya, ukora cyane muri sinema y'Ubutaliyani. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Star Wars: Igice cya I - The Phantom Menace", "Isi" Ntihagije na "Il maresciallo Rocca".
Yavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga 1973 i Mombasa, muri Kenya. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse i Paris, mu Bufaransa mu bumenyi bw'amatungo. Amaze kuba umuganga w'amatungo, yakoraga mu ivuriro ryigenga i Paris. Nyuma yimyaka mike, yaretse akazi no gutangira gukina.
Yabanje gukora muri societe yikinamico yicyongereza i Paris yitwa ACT. Yakinnye ikinamico kandi akina udukino twinshi nka "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest", "Animal Farm", "The Old Man and the Sea" and "Don Quixote". Mu 1992, yerekanwe kuri tereviziyo mu bice bimwe na bimwe by'uruhererekane "Runaway Bay" iyobowe na Tim Dowd. Nyuma yimyaka itandatu nyuma ya 1998, yongeye kugaragara kuri tereviziyo igice kimwe cya serial "Ambasaderi". Muri 2009, Shapi yakinnye nka 'Saddam Hussein' muri televiziyo yo mu Butaliyani "Intelligence - Servizi &amp; Amabanga".
Amaze kwimukira muri Amerika, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba "Law &amp; Order" muri 2010. Nyamara, filime yagaragaye cyane yaje binyuze mu ruhare rwa Jedi Master 'Eeth Koth' muri "Star War: Igice cya I - The Phantom Menace" yafashwe na George Lucas mu 1999. Muri iyo filime, yakinnye hamwe n'abakinnyi bazwi, Liam Neeson, Ewan McGregor na Natalie Portman.
Intsinzi ya "Star Wars", yatumiriwe kwitabira ibikorwa mpuzamahanga bikomeye nka "Agent 007", "Isi ntabwo ihagije", "Irina Palm" kandi "Ntukifuze umugore wabandi". Hagati aho, abonekera mu ishekeje nyinshi Butaliyani nka "yacu ishyingiranwa Mu Crisis," "Lezioni ya Chocolate," "Today bashatse," "Sharm el Sheikh - An kitazibagirana Summer," "Ntawe ushobora Umucamanza Me," "Abakobwa ugereranije gabo," "sans Art cyangwa Igice," "Chocolate Amasomo 2" na "The Umunsi w'inyongera hamwe na Fabio Volo".

Tony Msalame Mwashumbe (12 Ukuboza 1964-28 Gicurasi 2010), yari Umukinnyi firime muri Kenya akaba n'umunyamakuru w'itangazamakuru. Umwe mu banyamakuru bubahwa cyane mu mateka ya Kenya yo gutangaza amakuru, Msalame yanagaragaje nk'umukinnyi wa filime "The Lion of Africa" ndetse na televiziyo ya "Tushauriane".
Yavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1964 i Taita, muri Kenya nk'umuhungu wa kabiri w'umuryango. Se, Chrispas Mwashumbe yari Umugenzuzi Mukuru. Nyina, Grace Sowairina Mwashumbe yari umugore wo murugo. Yari afite barumuna be 6: Dorothy Mkakim, Sheila Kale, Arnold Magah, Lorna Mwashumbe, Jacob Mwashumbe na Surprise Mwashumbe. Mu 1967, nyina yapfuye hashize igihe gito murumunawe Surprise avutse.
Afite akazi ka se, byabaye ngombwa ko yimukira mu turere twinshi, aho yarangirije amashuri abanza mu mashuri menshi arimo; Ishuri ryibanze rya Buxton Mombasa, DEB Pumwani primaire na Kisumu Union Primary School. Amaherezo yarangije Ikizamini cya KCPE mu 1970 avuye mu ishuri ribanza rya Samburu. Nyuma yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Ruiru arangiza ikizamini cya O mu 1974. Muri kiriya gihe, yasuraga buri gihe nyirarume, nyirarureshwa Job Isaac Mwamto.
Amaze kurangiza O-urwego, yabaga kwa Upper Woodley kwa nyirarume kandi aho yabyaye ishyaka ryo gutangaza radio. Mugihe cya tereviziyo "Visa vya Safari", yahuye numugore we, Pauline Mukuhi. Bashyinguwe ku mugaragaro ku ya 3 Gicurasi 1986, nyuma baza ku ya 26 Gicurasi 1989 mu cyumba cy'Ubushinjacyaha Bukuru. Abashakanye babyaranye abakobwa babiri, Grace Sowairina, wavutse ku ya 10 Nyakanga 1986 na Natasha Waithera, wavutse ku ya 19 Ukwakira 1990.
Ku ikubitiro yagize igihe gito muri NSSF n’ishami rishinzwe abinjira n’abinjira. Nyuma yaje kwifatanya na Ogilvy &amp; Mather Advertising Agency hanyuma akora imyaka 20. Mu ntangiriro ya za 1980, yatangiye gukora kuri Ijwi rya Kenya. Muri kiriya gihe, yamenyekanye cyane muri gahunda ye "Ongeza Maarifa". Hanyuma mu 1996, yinjiye muri 'Metro FM' maze akora progaramu ya "Shekki Leggi" yatambutse muri wikendi. Mu 2004, yimukiye i Mombasa maze atangiza 'Shekki FM'.
rYatangiye umwuga wo gukina amakinamico akina muri Theatre yigihugu ya Kenya harimo na "Inspecteur wa Guverinoma" na "Mabepari wa Venisi" ndetse no kuri tereviziyo Drama "Visa vya Safari" aho yahuriye n’umugore we. Mu 1988, Msalame yakinnye nka 'dogiteri' muri firime ya HBO Intare yo muri Afrika Yakinnye kandi muri "sabune Tushauriane" anakina nka 'Mwalimu wa Walimu Dennis'.
Ku ya 28 Gicurasi 2010, Msalame yapfuye nyuma yo kugwa muri sitidiyo ye ya Shekki FM iwe i Nyali. Postmortem yemeje ko urupfu rwatewe n'indwara itunguranye y'umutima.

Christopher Odhiambo Okinda (yavutse 15 Ukuboza 1980), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Constant Gardener" na "The White Massai". Usibye gukina, ni n'umuyobozi wa firime, producer, umwanditsi hamwe n'umunyamakuru wa Radio.
Yavutse ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1980 i Mombasa, muri Kenya kuri Elizabeth Apiyo Aruwa na Alois Okinda. Se yari afite abagore benshi, bityo yarezwe na nyina babanaga. Yabanje kwiga mu ishuri ribanza rya Aga Khan (Parklands, Kenya) hanyuma Bikira Mariya w'Ishuri ribanza ryimbabazi. Nyuma, yimukiye muri St Peter's Mumias Boys primaire mu 1994 arangije ishuri rya St Mary (muri Yala) mu 1996.
Mu 2005, yatangiye gukina filime muri firime ishimishije "The Constant Gardener" iyobowe na Fernando Meirelles. Okinda yagize uruhare ruto rwo gushyigikira nka 'Muganga' muri film. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori byinshi bya firime.
Hamwe nitsinzi yumukobwa we wambere yakinnye, yahise atoranywa muri "White Massai" 2005. Hagati aho, yashinze firime yikinamico 'Something Productions'. Binyuze muri sosiyete, yakinnye amakinamico mu rurimi kavukire rwa nyina Dholuo. Usibye gukina, kuri ubu akora nka radio yerekana igitondo akaba numuyobozi uhanga 'Hot 96 FM' muri Kenya.

Benjamin Alfred Onyango Ochieng, numukinnyi wa firime ukomoka muri Kenya akaba atuye Muri Amerika, ukora cyane mubikorwa bya firime ya Hollywood. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Tears of the Sun", "God's Not Dead" and "Beautifully Broken".
Yavukiye mu gace ka Ofafa Jericho mu burasirazuba, i Nairobi, muri Kenya, nk'umwana wa kabiri mu muryango w'abavandimwe barindwi. Se yari Christopher Ochieng naho nyina yari Eudiah Achieng Ochieng. Benjamin yatangiye amashuri abanza muri Ofafa Jericho Primaire hanyuma Ofafa Jericho Secondary School. Igihe Benjamin yujuje imyaka 18, yahawe akazi na se muri British American Tobacco Kenya Ltd (BAT) nyuma yimurirwa ku mwanya w’umwanditsi mu ishami ry’imishahara aho yakoraga imyaka 4. Hanyuma yimuriwe mu ishami rya mudasobwa maze akora imyaka ibiri.
Nyuma yaje kwinjira muri kaminuza mpuzamahanga yo muri Amerika (USIU) yiga ibijyanye no gucunga amakuru (MIT). Kugira ngo akomeze kwiga, Benjamin yimukiye muri USIU, San Diego muri Amerika. Kuva aho, yimuriwe muri kaminuza ya Californiya, Stanislaus i Turlock, muri Californiya. Hanyuma mu 1992, yarangije Impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Science muri Computer Science.
Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yimukiye i Hollywood, muri Californiya aho yize ibijyanye n'umuziki no gukina. Yakoranye nitsinda rya Funk Rock 'PFO' nyuma yimyaka mike ahitamo kuba umukinnyi wabigize umwuga. Hamwe n'iki gitekerezo, yatangiye kugaragara muri firime nyinshi zerekana ndetse na tereviziyo zizwi cyane zo muri Amerika nk'ibitaro "bikuru", "The Shield" na "X-dosiye" mu 1999. Hagati aho, yakinnye muri"The God’s Not Dead" Trilogy franchise as well as "Tears of the Sun", "Heavenly Deposit", "Beautifully Broken", "Father Africa", "The Boy", "Road to Redemption", "Default", "Kwame", "Chains", "Thunder Chance", "The Disciple", "American Crude" and "The Termina".
Yabaye kandi umukinnyi wijwi kandi atanga ijwi rye kuri firime na tereviziyo zirimo; "Isura Yanyuma", "Umujinya 7", "Constantine", "Ijoro Mumurage Muzehe I &amp; III", "Imashini Yamamaza Imashini", "Intangiriro", "Umunsi Isi Yagumyeho", "Primeval", "Ligue Yabanyacyubahiro Bidasanzwe", "Inzira ya 911", "Mighty Joe Young" na "E-ring".
Usibye gukina, ni n'umwanditsi ufite inguzanyo zo kwandika zizwi zirimo"The Wives" (TV Series); "Dysfunctionally Organized" (Web Series); "Mind Tricks" and "Curse of Devil’s Mountain" (Shorts), "Cheza" and "Original Man" (Films)..

Edwin Mahinda, umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya wacyuye igihe. Gutangira umwuga we wa sinema nkumuhanzi wumwana, Mahinda azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "The Kitchen Toto", "White Mischief" and "The Lion of Africa".
Mu 1987, Mahinda yagaragaye bwa mbere muri sinema hamwe na firime yo mu Bwongereza yitwa "The Kitchen Toto". Yakinnye cyane 'Mwangi' muri iyi filime, aho yaje gutsindira igihembo cya Festival ya Paris igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza. Intsinzi ya firime, yahise atoranywa muri firime ya "White Mischief" yo mu 1987 kubera uruhare ruto rwa 'Umuhungu Wategereje kuri Wake'. Ariko, mu 1988, yongeye kugira uruhare mu gushyigikira 'Umuvandimwe wa Joko' muri filime y'Abanyamerika "The Lion of Africa". Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 28 Kamena 1987, kuri HBO.
Mu 1989, Mahinda yagaragaye bwa nyuma muri firime. Yakinnye nka 'Moja' muri "Piramiddo nta kanata ni: Intare yera densetsu".

Peter King Nzioki Mwania (yavutse 25 Gicurasi 1978), uzwi cyane nka Peter King, ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Kenya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri filime "The Constant Gardener","The Fifth Estate" and "Sense8"..
Nzioki yavutse ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1978 i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Se wa Michael David Mwania, yakoraga mu gisirikare cya Kenya naho nyina akora mu bitaro bya gisirikare. Afite imyaka itandatu, yinjiye mu rusengero mu kigo cya Lang'ata. Amashuri ye yarangije ayisumbuye muri Lang'ata i Nairobi.
Yashakanye na mugenzi we bakina filime Tess King.
Yatangiye gukina filime mu 2000 muri Theatre yigihugu ya Kenya imyaka itatu iyobowe na Joab Kanuka. Mu ikinamico, yakinnye 'Iago' muri Phoenix Players yerekana ibyago bya Shakespeare "Othello". Muri 2005, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime afite uruhare ruto muri "The Constant Gardener" iyobowe na Fernando Meirelles. Muri uwo mwaka, yagaragaye nka 'Barman' muri televiziyo ya "Transit". Muri 2016, yagaragaye muri firime ishimishije "Umuyobozi mukuru" aho yakinnye nka 'Jomo'. Iyi filime yagaragaye bwa mbere ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2016, muri Eko Hotels &amp; Suites, Ikirwa cya Victoria, Lagos nyuma iza gukundwa cyane.
Yagaragaye cyane nka 'Mkwajo' muri muzika "Mo Faya" yatsindiye ibihembo iyobowe na Eric Wainaina; umugambi "mubisha muri FaceBook" numunyapolitiki ruswa 'Mzito' muri "Ni Sisi". Nyuma yinshingano nyinshi zubugome, yahawe umwanya wo kuba papa muri "serivise ya" MTV Shuga 2, hanyuma aba umutoza wumupira wamaguru muri "The Inside Story" yerekanwe kuri Discovery Channel; n'umuvugabutumwa mu "Cyuma Cyuma Cyuma".
Mu mwaka wa 2016, yatoranijwe kugira ngo azabe umuyobozi w’icyaha cya Kenya 'Silas Kabaka' muri Netflix "Sense8". Uruhare rwamuteye kuba umukinnyi wa tereviziyo uzwi cyane muri Kenya.

= Rukera Christine =
Rukera Christine ni umunyarwandakazi wikorera.
Rukera Christine ni umubyeyi w'abana batatu, akaba atuye mu karere ka kicukiro mu murenge wa Kagarama.
Amashuri yize n'umwuga.
Rukera Christine ni Umuhinzi wabigize umwuga. aho ahinga urusenda. yatangiye ubuhinzi bw'urusenda nyuma yo gusoza icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza aho yatangiye ahinga kuri hegitari 11. yashinze kompanyi yitwa CF Premium company Ltd. yubatse uruganda mu mujyi wa Kigali mu gihe yarafite isoko ryo mu Rwanda. mu mwaka wa 2019 yitabiriye inama yahuzaga abikorera aho yamuritse urusenda yakoraga rurakundwa bivamo kubona isoko ryo mu buhinde rya toni 75 buri gihembwe cy'ihinga cyangwa se (season) mu rurimi rwa mahanga. kuri ubu ubuhinzi bwe bugirira abanyarwanda batari bake akamaro aho akoresha hagati yabakozi magana atatu(300) na magana ane(400) mu gihe kihinga ndetse agakoresha hagati y'ijana(100) n'ijana na makumyabiri(120) mu gihe cy'isarura.

Mutesi Gasana ni umunyarwandakazi yatangiye kugira uruhare mu kwandika ibitabo muri 2008 aho yatangiye kujya yandika akanasohora ibitabo by'abana kugirango bijye bibafasha gukunda igihugu cy'u Rwanda no kumenya intwari zacyo, ubu ibitabo bye umunani bikaba byaremerewe kwifashishwa mu mashuri byemewe n'ikigo gishyizwe uburezi cyitwa Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB). Akaba ariwe washinze Ubuntu Publishers and Arise Education Rwanda.
umuyobozi wa Arise Education.
umuyobozi wa arise education Mutesi Gasana avugako bahereye ku bana bagiye batorankwa mu turere dutandukanye, bakandika inkuru zashyizwe mubitabo byifashishwa mu kwiga muburyo bwo gusomandetse nokwandika.3 Avugako bityoizo nkuru zarakozwemo udutabo tuzashyirwaho ikimenyetso cy'ibitabo byemewe ku isi kandi bikitirirwa abo bana babyanditse.3

Josette komezusenge ni umunyarwandakazi ndetse yihangiye n'umurimo wo kwita kuri drede mu buryo bworoshye.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Josette komezusenge ni umwana wa cumi na rimwe mu bana cumi na babiri akaba ku myaka cumi nitanu yaragiye mu bubiligi gutangira amashuri yisumbuye
muri College St Andre de Tournai ndetse akomereza i Burundi mu mwaka wa kane gusa nyuma yaho asubira mu Bubiligi ndetse abona Bachelors Degree in Accounting.
igihe yagarukaga mu Rwanda muri 2006 yamaze igihe ategura uburyo yatangiza salon ye.
Josette komezusenge yihangiye uburyo bwo gutunganya drede(dread locks) yifashishije crochet harimo; kuzihambura, kuzigira ndende n'ibindi, ibi akaba yarabigezeho
amaze imyaka makumyabiri nibiri akora mu bijyanye no gutunganya imisatsi.

Lara Sousa kandi Lara de Sousa numukinnyi wa firime wa Mozambike. Yakoze nka porogarama muri Festival ya DOCKANEMA documentaire ya Mozambike imyaka itari mike kandi akora ibikorwa byimibereho niterambere, yibanda kubushakashatsi bwe kubibazo byuburinganire, uburenganzira bwa muntu nibindi.
Sousa afite impamyabumenyi yihariye mu bijyanye na Documentaire Direction, yakuye muri Escuela Internacional de Cine y Televiziyo(EICTV) ya San Antonio de los Baños, Cuba. Yize kandi Anthropology muri ISCTE, Porutugali na UCM, Espanye, azobereye muri Visual Anthropology.
Muri 2017, yanditse, ayobora kandi asohora inyandiko yerekana ururimi rw'icyesipanyoli ", La Finca del Miedo" (Umurima w'ubwoba), yakozwe na IECTV, muri Cuba.
Muri 2018, yayoboye filime documentaire, "Fin" (End), nayo yasohotse muri Cuba.
Filime documentaire, "The Ship and the Sea" (Igiporutugali: "O Navio eo Mar"), yakoranye na Matheus Mello, afatanya na Everlane Moraes, yatoranijwe hamwe nizindi firime zigera kuri 30 nkumushinga wimishinga yimari kuri Durban ya 11 Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime (DIFF 2020) ryabaye hagati ya 10 na 20 Nzeri, kumurongo. Iyi filime yatsindiye kandi muri Durban FilmMart ya 2020, Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime Amashusho Amsterdam (IDFA) Igihembo cy’Ubuholandi.
Yitabiriye gutoranya ibikorwa bya Indaba 2020, mu cyiciro cya mbere, "Abitabiriye 2020 bafite imishinga ni abaproducer", hamwe na Inadelso Costa umushinga wa firime witwa "Karigana".
Yitabiriye imurikagurisha rya Colab NowNow ryateguwe n’inama y’Ubwongereza, afatanya n’umunsi mukuru wa Maputo Fast Forward wa Mozambique na Fak'ugesi African Digital Innovation Festival yo muri Afurika yepfo.

Mohcine Malzi (nanone Mouhcine Malzi) ni Umukinnyi wa firime muri Maroc.
Malzi yakinnye nka "Abdelkader" muri firime ya Faouzi Bensaïdi, "Volubilis", inagaragaramo Nadia Kounda na Nezha Rahil. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Venice hagati ya 30 Kanama kugeza ku ya 9 Nzeri 2017, bivugwa ko byari biteganijwe ko izasohoka mu nzu y'imikino ya Maroc kugeza uwo mwaka urangiye. Icyakora, "amaherezo Telquel" yatangaje ko isohoka muri sinema izaba ku ya 3 Ukwakira 2018.
Muri 2018, niwe wegukanye umwanya wa "Umukinnyi mwiza" mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tangier (TNFF). Muri 2019, yakinnye muri filime isetsa-ikinamico ya Saidi Bensaïdi, "Tagisi Bied", ari kumwe na Mohamed El Khyari, Sahar Seddiki, Anas El Baz, Hassan Foulane na Saida Baâdi. Yagaragaye muri filime, "L'balisa", anagaragaramo: Ahmed Yreziz na Jalila Tlamsi. Yagaragaye no muyindi filime itarashyirwa ahagaragara na Faouzi Bensaïdi yitwa, "Summer Days".

Mohcine Besri (wavutse 1971) ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Maroc, umwanditsi, Producer n'umuyobozi wazo.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, yanditse kandi ayobora filime, "The Miscreants" (izina ry'umwimerere ry'igifaransa: "Les mécréants"), ayikora kandi hamwe na Michel Merkt, Michaël Rouzeau na Nicolas Wadimoff. Iyi filime yayikinnye na Jamila El Haouini, Maria Lalouaz, Amine Ennaji, Abdenbi El Beniwi, Rabii Benjhaile n'abandi. Bivugwa ko iyi filime yasohowe na serivise yo kuri interineti Filmatigue ahagana mu 2017.
Muri 2018, yayoboye film, "Urgent" (Umutwe wumwimerere "wigifaransa: Une urgence ordinaire"), ayikina na Cécile Vargaftig. Yakozwe na Elisa Garbar, Lamia Chraibi na Michel Merkt, ikagaragaramo abakinnyi nka Rachid Mustapha, Fatima Zahra Bennacer, Youssef Alaoui, Ayoub Layoussifi n'abandi. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Marrakech 2018 (MIFF) no mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Palm Springs na Tangier National Film Festival 2019. Mu birori bya 15 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards (AMAA) mu 2016, yatowe mu cyiciro cya "Umuyobozi mwiza" kubera filime "yihutirwa". Filime kandi yabonye izindi nomination enye.
Biracyaza muri 2018, yanditse kandi ayobora firime yerekana ikinamico yitwa "Laaziza". Muri filime hagaragayemo abakinnyi nka Fatima Zahra Benacer, Omar Lotfi, Rachid Elouali na Zakaria Atifi. Bivugwa ko iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 40 rya Cairo.

Tiécoura Traoré numukinnyi wa filimi muri Mali.
Mu 2006, yagaragaye nka "Chaka" muri filime yikinamico ya Abderrahmane Sissako ", Bamako". Abandi bakinnyi barimo: Aïssa Maïga na Hélène Diarra. Muri filime ngufi ya Daouda Coulibaly ya 2010, "Tinye So", yagaragaye nka "Man with traditional clothes". Mu mwaka wa 2012, yagaragaye muri filime ya Dominique Phillipe, "Tourbillion à Bamako", anagaragaramo Fatoumata Coulibaly, Chek Oumar Sidibé, Mama Koné, Babou Thembely.

Bokang Phelane ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Lesotho no muri Afurika y'Epfo, akaba producer n'umwanditsi wa filimi.
Phelane yavukiye i Maseru, muri Lesotho. Yize amashuri yisumbuye mu mujyi yavukiyemo, nyuma akomereza muri kaminuza ya Monash muri Afurika y'Epfo aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Arts muri Psychology.
Mu 2016, Phelane rwaravuzwe muri series comedy televiziyo,"Single Guys," gukina uruhare, "Fezeka". Yagaragaye kandi mu biganiro bya televiziyo, "Shuga", byasohotse mu 2018, aho yakinnye nk'umugore wa Andile "Fezeka".
Muri Nyakanga 2017, yakinnye nka "Pula" muri Season 1 ya telenovela yo muri Afrika yepfo,"Keeping Scores", yerekanwe kuri SABC2. Yakinnye nka "Lily" mu rurimi rw'Abazulu Sci-Fi TV-seriyeri, "Emoyeni (Netflix)", yasohotse ku ya 22 Nyakanga 2018. Yagaragaye mu mvugo y’ururimi rwa Sotho, "Isipho Sothando", yerekanwe muri Werurwe 2020 ndetse no muri "Ho Kena Ho Eona," yerekanwe muri Mata 2020 haba kuri DSTV. Niwe uyoboye urukurikirane rw'ibiganiro bya televiziyo nyafurika, "Blood Psalms", azasohoka hamwe na ba producer Showmax na Canal + International mu 2021, akina nka "Zazi", umwamikazi w'ingimbi ukabije.

Maïmouna Hélène Diarra, na Helena Diarra (yavutse 1955 - yapfuye ku ya 10 Kamena 2021) yari umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Mali uzwiho gukina inshingano z’abagore bakuze kuva akiri muto. Ni umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigega mpuzamahanga gishinzwe iterambere ry'izabukuru (FIDRA). Ni Visi Perezida w'ishyirahamwe ry'umwuga rya gahunda yo kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi bwa Côte d'Ivoire (Apsfd-CI).
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Diarra yavutse mu 1955 i Segou, muri Mali ariko aba impfubyi akiri muto kandi arerwa na nyirarume na nyirakuru. Mu 1975, yinjiye mu kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe uburezi cya Diplome y’ubushakashatsi bwibanze (DEF) mu mwuga wo kwigisha. Nyuma yo guhindura siporo, hagati ya 1975 na 1977 yakiniye ikipe ya basketball ya Bamako Reds. Mu 1981, yabonye impamyabumenyi mu buhanzi bw'ikinamico mu kigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ubuhanzi (INA).
Mu 2000, yagaragaye nka "Aminate" muri firime yikinamico ya Michael Haneke, "Code Unknown". Abandi bakinnyi barimo: Aïssa Maïga, Juliette Binoche, Thierry Neuvic, Josef Bierbichler n'abandi. Mu 2004, yagaragaye muri filime y'ururimi rwa Bambara ya Ousmane Sembène, Moolaadé, akina nka "Hadjatou". Abandi bakinnyi barimo: Fatoumata Coulibaly na Salimata Traoré. Filime yerekanwe muri Ebertfest 2007. Yatorewe igihembo cya "Filime Nziza" mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes. Mu 2006, yakinnye muri filime y’ikinamico ya Abderrahmane Sissako, Bamako (film), aho yakinnye nka "Saramba". Abandi bakinnyi bagaragaye barimo: Aïssa Maïga na Tiécoura Traoré.

Catherine Kamau Karanja (yavutse Gashyantare 3, 1987) ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Kenya, uzwi nka "Celina" (cyangwa "Selina") na ""Kate Actress"."
Yaje kumenyekana kubera uruhare rwe muri TV ya Citizen TV,"Mother In-Law" aho yakinaga nka Celina. Yagaragaye no mu zindi filime nka "Sue na Jonie" (2017-2019), "plan B", na "Disconnect".
Catherine yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Chogoria aho yinjiye mu ikinamico maze amenyekana cyane kubera impano ye, mbere yo kwimukira i Loreto Convent Msongari aho yatsindiye igihembo cya 'Miss Loreto'.
Afite Impamyabumenyi mu Itumanaho, yiga ibijyanye n'imibanire rusange na Kenya College of Communication and Technology yazamuwe muri kaminuza ya MultiMedia yo muri Kenya.
Kamau ni ambasaderi wikirango muri Harpic Kenya na Nice na peteroli nziza ya Jelly.
Kamau yakinnye nka Selina (cyangwa Celina) muka Charlie (Patrick Oketch) kuri serivise yikinamico ya "Mother In-Law" yatangiye mu 2006. Yahise ava mu gitaramo yerekeza kuri televiziyo yo mu rurimi rw'igiswahiri "Sue Na Jonnie", aho yakinnye nka Sue.
Yatsindiye Umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi mu cyiciro cya TV Drama Series mu bihe bya Kalasha Awards 2017 yongera guhabwa nomination muri 2018, kubera uruhare rwe muri " "Sue Na Jonnie" ". Yatowe mu bakinnyi bitwaye neza mu cyiciro cya Filime cya komisiyo ishinzwe amafilime ya Kenya Kalasha Awards 2018 kubera uruhare yagize muri filime "Disconnect."
Yakinnye nka Joyce muri filime yo gusetsa y’urukundo ya 2019, " "Plan B" ", yakozwe na Sarah Hassan kandi iyobowe n’umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Nijeriya, Dolapo Adeleke (Lowladee). Kubera uruhare rwe nka Joyce, yongeye gutorwa nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi mu cyiciro cya Filime ku nshuro ya 9 ya Kenya Film Commission ya Kalasha Awards 2019.
Catherine Kamau aherutse no kwerekana muri firime ebyiri The Grand Little Lie (GLL) mu rwego rwo gukina. Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2021. Iyi firime yakozwe na Phil it Production isosiyete ifitwe numugabo we Philip Karanja. Indi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ni Nafsi, iyi ikaba ari filime ya Multan Production Limited iyobowe na Reuben Odanga.
Niwe kandi ukora ibintu hamwe na YouTuber. Ku rubuga rwe rwa YouTube, avuga ku myambarire, imiterere, gukina, imibereho ndetse na nyina. Afite ishyaka ku kibazo cyo gutwita kwingimbi. Kuba yarabaye umubyeyi w'umwangavu, kandi afite interuro yiswe 'Abagabekazi bagomba gutegereza', aho ashishikariza abakobwa bato gutegereza mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo kuba ababyeyi.
Kamau yashakanye na Phillip Karanja ("uzwi ku" izina rya Phil cyangwa Melvin), umuyobozi wa firime ndetse n'uwahoze ari "umukinnyi wa filimi ya Tahidi High" kuva ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 2017. Ukwezi kwa buki kwizihirijwe muri Seychelles. Mu mibanire yabanje igihe yari muri kaminuza mpuzamahanga ya Kampala muri Uganda, afite imyaka 19, yibarutse umuhungu we wa mbere, Leon Karanja, mu 2006 Phillip yareze. Muri Nzeri 2019, ibitangazamakuru byinshi byatangaje ko we n'umugabo we bategereje umwana wabo wa mbere. Uyu mukinnyi w'amafilime kandi ngo yakiriye umwana mu Kuboza uwo mwaka kugirango yishimire inda yari yarahanuwe ko ari umwana wumukobwa. Bagiye muri babymoon muri Malidiya. Yababwiye uburyo yari hafi kureka gusama. Nyuma yaje gutangaza ku ya 15 Ukuboza 2019, ko umwana wa mbere w’umugabo we ari umwana w’umukobwa Njeri ("Baby K").

Jasmine Jamila Baroudi (yavutse ku ya 16 Nzeri) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Gana. Yize Psychology muri kaminuza ya Gana.
Yaravuzwe muri Ghana kuri TV Series, "pome Adamu" (2011 - 2012) yakoranye nabakinnyi ba Ghallywood nka Majid Michel. Nyuma yaje gutorwa mu cyiciro "cyiza cya Discovery" muri Gana Movie Awards 2011 muri uru rukurikirane rwa TV. Muri 2014, yakinnye muri filime iyobowe na Mikki Osei-Berko yise, "Broken Mirror", inagaragaramo Jackie Appiah, James Gardiner, Fred Amugi na Roselyn Ngissah, kandi yakozwe na David Owusu. Hagati ya 2014 na 2015, yagaragaye nka "Tilly Walsh" muri Shirley Frimpong-Manso -yerekanwe kuri Televiziyo, "V-Repubulika". Izindi nyenyeri zirimo: Nikki Samonas, Joselyn Dumas na Christabel Ekeh. Yatowe mu bihembo bya Filime bya Gana 2014 mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’abakinnyi ba "serivise nziza" ", kuri TV, Heart Break Hotel" kuri TV3 Gana. Niwe wegukanye igihembo "cyumukinnyi witwaye neza -" Icyiciro cya Drama cya Golden Movie Awards 2019 (GMA). Yakinnye muri filime, the Cell muri uwo mwaka. Yakinnye muri film ya 2019, "A New Flame". Abandi ba star bo muri Gana bagaragaye barimo: Richard Asante (Kalyboss) na Edinam Atatsi.
Baroudi yatanze umuburo ukaze ku bagabo atera ubwoba "izina n'ikimwaro" bamwoherereje amashusho y'ubugabo bwabo kuri interineti, babona ko ari igikorwa cyo gutoteza kuri interineti. "Graphic Showbizz" yatangaje ko yavuze ko gukoresha abakinnyi badafite umwuga ari benshi bituma inganda za firime zidatera imbere, asaba ko abaproducer bashyira abujuje ibyangombwa kuri ecran gusa.
Afite umwana wumukobwa hamwe na Williams Ofori Atta, umukunzi we akaba nri nawe umutoza fitness ubu.

Mehret Mandefro (wavutse 1977) ni Umunyetiyopiya-Umunyamerika utunganya firime / seri za televiziyo, umwanditsi, umuganga na antropropologue. Ni umuyobozi w'itsinda rya Indaba Africa, akaba yarashinze ikigo cya Realness Institute akaba ari nawe washinze Truth Aid Media akaba n'umwe mu bagize inama y'abajyanama mu Harvest Fund. Yahawe kandi igihembo cya Paul &amp;amp; Daisy Soros Fellowship kubanyamerika bashya (2001) maze muri 2007 yicara nkumwe mubantu 41 bazwi cyane muri Amerika. Muri 2016, yahawe icyubahiro na Carnegie Corporation ya New York nk'umwe mu Bimukira bakomeye bo muri Amerika.
Mandefro yavukiye i Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya mu 1977, akurira muri Alegizandiriya, muri Virijiniya, muri Amerika. Se, Ayalew Mandefro, yari Minisitiri w’ingabo muri Etiyopiya na nyina Tsedale K. Mandefro. Umuryango we wahungiye muri Amerika nyuma y’ubutegetsi bwa gikomunisiti bwa Etiyopiya bwagerageje kwica se. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga rya Thomas Jefferson arangiza icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza n’ubuvuzi muri kaminuza ya Harvard. Yakomeje impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buzima rusange bw’abaturage ku ishuri ry’i Londere ry’isuku n’ubuvuzi bwa Tropical nka Scholar ya Fulbright. Yasoje gahunda ya Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Health and Society Scholars Program muri kaminuza ya Pennsylvania yibanda ku mibereho y’ubuzima akomeza gukurikirana impamyabumenyi ya PhD muri Anthropologie y’umuco muri kaminuza ya Temple aho yarangirije igitabo cyerekeye ishingwa ry’ubuzima bw’Abanyamerika. politiki muri guverinoma ihuriweho na leta. Aragenda ku kumenyereza muri internal medicine muri Montefiore Medical Center na Albert Einstein College of Medicine aho bakurikirana ubushakashatsi ku ubusumbane SIDA mu bagore
Mandefro kandi yari Umukozi wa White House mu butegetsi bwa Obama.
Mandefro numwe mubahawe icyubahiro muri 2009 muri Black Girls Rock Awards, ahabwa igihembo cyumuganda. Muri Werurwe 2014, yari umwe mu bagore bubashywe mu birori byo kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’abagore mu mujyi wa New York, na WomenWerk. Muri 2014 kandi, yakoranye na firime "Difret", iyobowe na Zeresenay Berhane Mehari.
Yakoranye firime na Zeresenay Berhane ya 2019 yitwa,"Sweetness in the Belly", hamwe na Adrian Sturges, Laura Bickford na Fiona Druckenmiller. Muri uwo mwaka, documentaire yayoboye yise " "The Loving Generation" ", yatorewe igihembo cya Webby People Voice Award. Iyi filime yemejwe ku mugaragaro ko izerekanwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Toronto (TIFF).
Mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2019 ryabereye muri Palais Des Festivals, i Cannes, mu Bufaransa, yagiriye inama abakora amafilime yo muri Afurika kubaka ubufatanye bufatika bakorana, agaragaza ko ibindi bihugu bya Afurika bishobora kwigira kuri Nollywood kugira ngo biteze imbere mu nganda zabo.
We, hamwe n’umuyobozi wa firime, Abraham Gezahagne, muri Gashyantare 2020 yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya muri Berlinale Africa Hub, aho yerekanaga amahirwe aboneka hamwe n’ibibazo byugarije inganda za firime na televiziyo mu gihugu.
We, afatanije na Alicia Keys, Lacey Schwartz Delgado, Elliott Halpern na Elizabeth Trojian, umuyobozi mukuru bakoze documentaire,"How It Feels To Be Free", ishingiye ku gitabo cya Ruth Feldstein,"How It Feels To Be Free: Black Women Entertainers and the Civil Rights Movement," ziyobowe na Yoruba Richen kandi zigomba kwerekanwa bwa mbere mu itumba 2021 na PBS na WNET.

Dina Emam ni Umunyamisiri-American film producer. Yahawe igihembo cya 10 Variety Producers "yo muri 2018". Aba i Cairo mu misiri no mu mujyi wa New York.
Yarangije muri Kaminuza ya Columbiya na MFA mu guhanga udushya.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Emam yavukiye muri Alegizandiriya, mu Misiri akurira i Brooklyn, New York.
Emam yabanje gukora kuri MTV Networks, Umujyi wa New York, mu Isoko rya Televiziyo Ubushakashatsi no gucunga umusaruro.
Muri 2018, filime yakoze yise "Yomeddine", yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes mu Bufaransa, aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Francois Chalais. Yaba we na mugenzi we icyo gihe, umuyobozi / umwanditsi wa film, Abu Bakr (AB) Shawky bari bahari mbere yo kurisha ibirori. Nyuma iyi filime yaje gutoranywa kumugaragaro muri Egiputa mu cyiciro "cyiza cya Filimi Cyiza Cy’ururimi rw’amahanga" mu gihembo cya Academy ya 2019. Yitabiriye kandi iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya El-Gouna (GIFF) 2018.
fiYakoze mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 36 rya Cairo nk'umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ubuhanzi ndetse anayobora mu minsi mikuru y’inganda za firime za Cairo 2019 ku nsanganyamatsiko igira iti: "Hariho Ubuzima Nyuma yo Gukorana?".

Solange Yijika ni umukinnyi wa firime muri cameroon ukomeye cyane kandi agaragara cyane mu makinamico ya Nigeria ni producer wa film, ndetse aharanira uburenganzira bw'umugore n'umwana. Niwe mukinnyi w'amafirime uzwi cyane mu karere ka Afurika yo hagati akaba n'umuntu ukomeye mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Kameruni (CAMIFF).
Yijika akomoka mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Kameruni. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Yaoundé II, Soa, Kameruni.
Yijika yari isura ikomeye mubikorwa bya firime ya Kameruni kuva yagaragara bwa mbere nko mumwaka wa 2005. Mu byapa bibiri byo kurwanya malariya muri Kameruni byatewe inkunga na "Global Fund yo kurwanya Malariya, Igituntu na SIDA", yakoreshejwe nk'icyitegererezo muri ibyo byapa. Ni n'umurwanashyaka uharanira ubutabera ku isi ku bagore n'abana. Yabaye ambasaderi ku nshuro ya 1 iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Kameruni (CAMIFF) mu 2016.
Yijika yari yagaragaye mu nganda za sinema zo muri Kameruni mu bicuruzwa byinshi bigera kuri 20 kandi ni we uhabwa ibihembo byinshi birimo ibihembo bya AMAA na NAFCA.
Yakinnye muri " "Ibigeragezo Byifuzo" " 2006 bya TV byerekanwe kuri CRTV, aho yakinnye nka "Diana". Nyuma yaje muri 2008 yagaragaye muri " "Mark of the Absolute" ", filime Asaba Ferdinand yayoboye akanayikora. Hakurikiraho " "Igihugu" Cy'igicucu" 2009, filime yakozwe na Agbor Gilbert Ebot ikayoborwa na Zack Orji na Neba Lawrence. Muri filime kandi hagaragayemo Jim Iyke. Muri uwo mwaka, yongeye kandi kugaragara muri filime " Excess pain " iyobowe na Neba Lawrence, hanyuma, muri uwo mwaka agaragara muri " "Royal Destiny" ", filime yo muri Kameruni yanagaragayemo Emeka Ike na Tonto Dikeh, abakinnyi babiri ba Nollywood. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yagaragaye muri " "Troubled Kingdom" ", filime iyobowe na Neba Lawrence, ifatanije na producer wa firime ukomoka muri Amerika Mairo Sanda hamwe na Fred Keyanti ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo - bashimye ubuhanga bw'uyu mukinnyi.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, yakinnye muri filime ya Nollywood ", "Blood or wine" ", yakozwe na Henry Neba Awantoh na Jim Iyke kandi iyobowe na Neba Lawrence, yanditswe na Ruth Kadiri. Muri 2013, yatorewe ibihembo bya SONNAH.
Yagaragaye muri filime, " "Decoded" ", yakozwe na Brenda Elung - nawe umukinnyi wa filime kandi iyobowe na Akim Macaulay na Enah Johnscott mu 2013, aho yakinnye hamwe nabakinnyi ba Gana na Kameruni nka Van Vicker, Jeffery Epule na Desmond Wyte.
Yabaye umwe mu bayobozi babiri baganiriye ku nama nyunguranabitekerezo mu mwaka wa 2016 mu birori byo gutanga ibihembo bya African Achievers Awards, byabereye ku ya 8 Nyakanga mu kigo mpuzamahanga cy’inama, Abuja, muri Nijeriya hamwe na Richard Mofe Damijo, umukinnyi wa politiki akaba n'umunyapolitiki.
Muri filime yo muri 2017, " "show ability to save" ", iyobowe na Musing Derick Tening kandi yakozwe na Tessy Eseme, yakinnye nka " "Jazmine Juma" ". Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere i Londres.
Yatorewe igihembo mu nshuro ya 2 ya CAMIFF Awards, yabaye hagati ya 24-29 Mata 2017 i Buea, muri Kameruni hamwe nabandi bakinnyi ba Camerwood na Nollywood nabo batowe. Yari umwe mu baterankunga ba CAMIFF 2018 hamwe na Ramsey Nouah wa Nollywood.

Edith Pikwa Boma (yavutse ku ya 3 Mutarama) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Kameruni, utuye i Houston, muri Texas muri Amerika.
Yatowe muri "Best Actress /Most Promising Actres" - Diaspora igihembo cya filime, message to "Brian", aho yagaragaye mu bihembo bya Golden Icons Academy Movie Awards 2014 (GIAMA). Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere i Houston, muri Texas. Yakinnye muri filime, "Ndolor na Senateri", yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 31 Mutarama 2016 i Houston, muri Texas.
