Brenda Shey Elung ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri cameroon na film producer. Ni Visi Perezida w’uruganda rukora cinema zo muri Kameruni (CFI). Yitwa kandi " "Madam Brenda" ".
Brenda yagize uruhare mu nganda za firime zo muri Kameruni kuva mu 2010. Yatunganije kandi akina muri filime " "Decoded" ", iyobowe na Akim Macaulay na Enah Johnscott, yasohotse mu 2013. Iyi filime yafatiwe muri Kanama 2012 ahitwa Limbe, muri Kameruni, hagaragaramo umukinnyi wa Gana, Van Vicker hamwe n’abakinnyi ba firime muri Kameruni nka Solange Yijika, Jeffery Epule na Desmond Wyte. Yari umwe mu bakinnyi ba sinema bateraniye i Buea mu mahugurwa y'iminsi itatu (31 Kanama - 2 Nzeri 2016) kugira ngo baganire ku ivugurura ry'inganda za firime zirwaye muri Kameruni.
Muri 2017, ibiganiro bye bya TV, " "SAMBA" " yakoze, yakinnye nabakinnyi ba Camerwood nka Jeffery Epule, Kelly Ade, Nsang Dilong, Marie Nyna, Solange Yijika, ubwe, nabandi; cyanditswe na Proxy Buh Melvin; kandi iyobowe na Enah Johnscott, yarekuwe. Filime nyuma ajya imbere gutsinda gihembo "Official guhitamo" mu FESPACO ibihembo wa 2017, na "Best Series" igihembo mu Ecrans Noirs ibihembo mu 2018. I Accra, muri Gana, mu gihembo cya Golden Movie Awards Africa (GMAA) 2017, televiziyo izwi cyane yahawe ibihembo bitatu; na "Best Actress" igihembo agiye Ade Kelly, "Best Actor" igihembo Libota McDonald na film kwinjiza "Best TV Series" igihembo.
Ku nshuro ya karindwi ibihembo bya AMVCA byabereye muri Eko Hotels na Suits i Lagos, muri Nijeriya ku ya 14 Werurwe 2020, ni we wenyine wari uhagarariye Inganda za Filime Kameruni (CFI) mu bihembo aho yagaragaye yambaye neza.
Niwe washinze Omega One Entertainment, isosiyete ikora firime. Yaserukiye inyungu z’isosiyete mu kiganiro mpuzamahanga cya TV cyo muri Nijeriya cyabereye i Paris (13-14 Mata 2018).
Muri 2018, yakiriye ibitero bikaze by’abafana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nyuma yo kugaragara yambaye ikanzu nziza y’Uburusiya yakozwe ku nshuro ya gatanu ya AMVCA, amushinja ko yanze gushyigikira abashushanya imuhira bakoresheje imbuga mpuzamahanga nka AMVCA, we we birengagijwe. Icyakora, yahisemo gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo basabye mu nshuro ya karindwi yerekana ibihembo mu mwaka wa 2020 aho yagaragaye mu myambarire ya Limbe yakozwe na TAS Design.

Odile Sankara n'umuhanzi, umwanditsi ndetse n'umukinnyi wa filimi muri Burkina faso. Yagizwe Perezida wa Récréâtrales akaba mushiki muto wa nyakwigendera umuyobozi w'impinduramatwara ya Burkina Faso, Thomas Sankara.
Sankara yagaragaye muri firime ya Iara Lee ya 2018, "Burkinabè Rising: ubuhanzi bwo guhangana muri Burkinafaso".

Nta Zahabu kuri Kalsaka (Igifaransa: Pas d'or pour Kalsaka) ni film documentaire ya Burukina Faso ya 2019 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Michel K. Zongo kandi afatanije na Florian Schewe.
Gufata amashusho byakorewe mu ntara ya Yatenga muri Burukina Faso. Yakozwe na Michel K. Zongo muri Diam Production [bf] na Florian Schewe muri Film Five GmbH.
Umugambi / Icegeranyo.
Kuva kera, mu gihugu cya Afurika cya Burukina Faso, abaturage bo mu mudugudu muto wa Kalsaka bari baracukuye kandi bakoresha zahabu mu rwego rwo kubatunga. Hamwe n’ishirahamwe ry’abongereza rishinzwe ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’amahanga, ariko, ibyo byaje kurangira kuko abaturage bari barahawe akarere kavuye mu bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro mu butaka bwabo. Umuganda wumudugudu, nyamara, uyobowe na Jean-Baptiste, urwana cyane kugirango ugarure ibye.
Filime yabonye igihembo cyicyiciro "cyiza cya Documentaire" muri Awards Africa Awards Awards 2019.
Ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2019 ku bufatanye n’iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya documentaire rya Montreal (RIDM), iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere na Sinema Politica Concordia i Quebec. Iyi filime yemejwe ko ari imwe muri filime zihindura isi kandi byari biteganijwe ko izerekanwa bwa mbere muri Ceki muri Autumn 2020 na "One World".
Nk’uko IMDb ibitangaza ngo iyi filime yasohotse ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2019.

Burkinabè Rising (nanone Burkinabé Rising): "ubuhanzi bwo guhangana muri Burkinafaso" ni film ndende ya 2018 yerekanwe kandi ikorwa na Iara Lee.
Iyi documentaire yakozwe na Cultures of Resistance film, muri Burkinafaso, Buligariya na Amerika mucyongereza, Igifaransa na Mooré ikamara iminota 72.
Umugambi / Icegeranyo.
Iyi documentaire yerekana abahakanamana batagira urugomo nabenegihugu ba Burkinafaso berekana inzira basezeranye, kumunsi mushya muri politiki yigihugu cyabo. Hemce, yerekana urugero rukwiye kwiganwa kumugabane wa Afrika ndetse nisi yose. Iyi filime igaragaramo abantu bafite umwuka w’impinduramatwara umeze nkuwahoze ari umuyobozi (1983-1987), Thomas Sankara, yiciwe muri Coup d'etat n’inshuti ye yamusimbuye, Blaise Compaoré, akoresheje umuziki, film, ibidukikije, ubuhanzi bugaragara nubwubatsi. Compaoré wategetse imyaka 27 nyuma yukwakira 2014 yakuweho nubwigomeke bukomeye bwamamaye, umwuka uguma hamwe nabantu kugeza ubu.
Kuzenguruka igihugu cyose gufata amashusho ya documentaire, "BURKINABÈ RISING the art of resistance in Burkina Faso", umuyobozi wayo, Iara Lee yahuye nitsinda rishimishije ryabahanzi, abahanzi ndetse nabaharanira inyungu, bagamije guteza imbere umuco wubuhanzi binyuze mubuhanzi. igihugu kizwiho. Uyu muraperi, Joey le Soldat, avuga ku rugamba rw’urubyiruko rukennye muri Ouagadougou ndetse n’abahinzi baruhira mu gihugu; umuhanzi wa graffiti, Marto, yamaganye akarengane atanga ibishushanyo mbonera by'amabara ku nkuta z'umujyi; uharanira uburenganzira bw'umugore, Malika la Slameuse, ahereye ku gitsina gore ku buhanzi bwiganjemo abagabo akora ibisigo; umubyinnyi, Serge Aimé Coulibaly, kuva kubyina bye ashishikariza abamureba gufata ingamba za politiki.
Iyi filime kandi yerekana iserukiramuco ryubuhanzi butunganyirizwa hamwe no kubaza amatsinda y'abahinzi barwanya kwangiriza ubuhinzi bwibigo. Muri rusange, film irerekana abantu batandukanye mubyiciro bitandukanye bashakisha amahoro nubutabera hakoreshejwe imvugo.
Iyi filime yerekanwe na Suns Cinema, Washington DC ku bufatanye n’umuco ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2018. Yerekanwe kandi mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sembène ku ya 25 Werurwe 2019.
Iyi filime yahawe igihembo "cyiza cyaBest Documentary Film" kandi ihabwa igihembo cy’amanota "meza y’umwimerere" n’umuyobozi "w’umugore w’indashyikirwa" mu mujyi wa New York ku nshuro ya 7 ngarukamwaka y’imyidagaduro mpuzamahanga ya Filime (WFAIFF) mu mwaka wa 2018.

Lindiwe Chibi (1976–2007), yari umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afrika yepfo. Babona ari umwe mubakinnyi ba film kabuhariwe muri Afurika y'Epfo, azwi kuruhare 'Doobsie' muri seri yakunzwe cyane "Muvhango."
Ku ya 30 Mata 2005, umukunzi we Dan Mokoena, yamurashe mu maso igihe Chibi yari kwa nyina. Amasasu yarashwe hafi, yinjira mu itama asohoka inyuma y'umutwe. Yahise ajyanwa mu bitaro bya Garden Clinic, amara ibyumweru bitatu muri koma. Amaze guhaguruka ava muri koma, yamugaye iburyo bw'umubiri we. Igihe yari amaze gukira ibikomere byica, yapfuye azize umusonga mu bitaro bya Chris Hani-Baragwanath i Soweto mu 2007 afite imyaka 31.
Mu 1995, yatangiye umwuga wo gukina umwuga wo gukina ikinamico "Ekuseni yakinwaga" kuri Civic Theatre. Hanyuma yakinnye nka "Game wo" kuri Windybrow Theatre, aho yakiriye igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza. Hanyuma yakinnye nka 'Stella Kowalski' mumikino gakondo, "A Street Car" Yitwa Desire ndetse no muri "The Pen na Molora". Yakoze umugizi wa nabi uzwi cyane 'Doobsie' muri seri ya televiziyo "Muvhango". Nyuma y'urupfu rwe, uruhare rwe rwatangajwe ko yeguye. Ku ya 3 Kanama 2018, Isoko rya Theatre Foundation ryiswe icyubahiro cya Chibi.

Randall de Jager (4 Mata 1971 - 22 Ukuboza 2001), yari mukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika yepfo. Yamenyekanye cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri serial izwi cyane "Egoli: Place of Gold" na 7de Laan.
Yavutse ku ya 4 Mata 1971 mu nkengero za Bishop Lavis, Cape Town, Afurika y'Epfo. Afite imyaka 17, yabaye umwarimu watozaga abandi ku cyumweru kandi yegeranye cyane nitorero. Yakuranye na nyina, Jean kandi afite bashiki be babiri: Juanita, Angelique na murumuna we Roger. Yakundanye kuva kera n'inshuti ye y'umukobwa, Kim Nichols.
Mu ntangiriro za 22 Ukuboza 2001, Jager yakomerekejwe bikomeye n’ubujura bwitwaje imbunda mu nzu iri mu nkengero z'umujyi wa River Club, i Sandton, mu majyaruguru ya Johannesburg. Yapfiriye mu bitaro bya Johannesburg. Yari kumwe n'inshuti ye n'umukinnyi wa filime Helene Lombard mugihe cy'ubujura. Yarashwe mu maso hatangaza ko ubwonko bwangiritse cyane.
umubirir we wimuriwe gushyingurwa i bishop Lavis i Cape Town. Umuhango wo kwibuka wabereye mu rusengero rushya rw’Intumwa ku ya 29 Ukuboza.
Mu 1992, yakinnye mu ikinamico ikinamico "Paradise iri hafi". Mu 1998, yabaye umwanditsi, aho yanditse ikinamico "Moenie Gerageza Nie". Azwiho uruhare rwa 'Hector' muri opera yisabune ya tereviziyo "Egoli: Place of Gold". Yakinnye kandi nk'umufasha wibitabo Aubrey Rudolph muri seri izwi cyane ya televiziyo "7de Laan".

Sipho Nicholas Nkuna numukinnyi wa filimi n'umuririmbyi wo muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri seri izwi cyane 7de Laan nka Fikani no kuri "Erfsondes" nka Nkululeko "Freedom" Nkosi ". "
Yavutse ku ya 18 Kanama 1988 i Mbombela, Mpumalanga, Afurika y'Epfo aho yakuriye mu nzu ya nyirakuru. Yarangije impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buhanzi yakuye muri kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga ya Tshwane, Pretoria kabuhariwe mu ikinamico. Hanyuma yagiye muri Ball State University, Indiana muri Amerika, yiga gukina.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina mumyaka ya kaminuza, aho yakinnye mumikino myinshi yikinamico nka "Parade", "Inzozi Zabakobwa", "Shaka Zulu", "Sophiatown", "Oliver Twist", "Gukodesha", na "Assassins". Yakinnye kandi mu makinamico nka Simba mu ikinamico yitwa Yanakinnye mu ikinamico "Ntare King" aho yazengurutse Irlande n'Ubwongereza akina. Ku myaka 22, Nkuna abaye umukinnyi wa kabiri wa Afurika wakinnye mu ikinamico izwi cyane ya "Phantom ya Opera".
Muri 2015, yerekeje kuri televiziyo, "Skeem Saam", abinyujije kuri agent, biba televiziyo ye ya mbere. Muri serial, yakinnye nka 'Sakhile'. Muri 2017, yafashe ikiruhuko cy'imyaka 3, aho yongeye kwerekeza mu Kwakira 2020. Muri uwo mwaka, yitabiriye urukurikirane rw'amarushanwa yo gukina BET, "Top Actor Africa". Mu marushanwa, yagaragaye nkuwakabiri. Nyuma yaje kugaragara muri opera yisabune "Roer Jou Voete" akina nka 'Shakes Mbebe' mu mpera za 2015. Muri 2016, yagaragaye muri serial "Keeping Score", kandi yagize uruhare ruto nkumukinnyi wa congo 'Issac'. Muri uwo mwaka, yatumiriwe kugira uruhare mu bashyitsi kuri serial izwi cyane ya "Rhythm City".
Kuva muri 2017, akina uruhare ruzwi cyane 'Fikani Chauke' murukurikirane "7de Laan". Yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi muri Afurika y'Epfo Broadway Awards 2016 kubera uruhare rwe 'Mingus' mu ikinamico "Sophiatown". Hanyuma yakinnye muri serie "Erfsondes" nka 'Ubwisanzure'. Usibye televiziyo, yanakinnye muri filime, "Love by Chance" and "Meet the Radebes."
Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi wamamaye. Indirimbo ebyiri mu ndirimbo zagaragaye muri filime yakinnye na Khanyi Mbau "Icyumba gitukura" naho indirimbo ye Thando igaragara kuri Meet the RAdebes. Nicholas uzwi kandi ku izina rya Nicksoul afite igihembo cy'umuziki wo muri Afurika y'Epfo kubera alubumu ye ya mbere / r &amp; b yise Therapy yasohotse muri 2018.

Quinne Brown (yavutse ku ya 9 Kamena 1979) ni umukinnyi wa firime m muri Afurika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Ouma se Slim Kind", "Sedona's Rule" and "This Is Charlotte King"..
Brown yavukiye i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Amaze kwiga, yize geografiya na antropologiya muri kaminuza ya Johannesburg. Yagiye i San Francisco mu 2003 gushyingura se, aho yahuriye n'umugabo we Ryan Huffman. Yashakanye na 2006 kandi bombi babaga i San Francisco. Nyuma abo bashakanye bimukiye i San Diego, aho babyaranye abakobwa babo bombi, Charlotte na Lara.
Mu masomo ye, Brown yabonye amahirwe yo kwinjira mu bakinnyi bikinamico ya "7de Laan". Muri uruhererekane, yakinnye ari "Connie van der Lecq". Usibye gukina, anakora nkuwatanze ikiganiro kuri SABC2. Mu 2003, Brown yafashe ikiruhuko cy'isabato nyuma y'urupfu rwa se muri Mata 2003.
Yakoze kandi mu ikinamico, filime no kwamamaza bishingiye kuri San Francisco. Muri 2008, yatangiye kwigisha abana mwishuri ryimikino ryabana. Nyuma yimyaka icumi muri Amerika, yasubiye muri Afrika yepfo hamwe numuryango. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yongeye gukina mu bakinnyi ba '7de Laan', anagaragaza imico ye 'Connie'.

Nobuhle Mimi Mahlasela (yavutse 10 Mata 1982), ni umukinnyi wa filime numumodel muri Afurika y'Epfo na model. Azwi cyane mu gukina uruhare rwa Aggie Ngwenya-Meintjies muri serial izwi cyane "7de Laan".
Mahlasela yavutse ku ya 10 Mata 1982 mu bitaro bya Baragwanath i Soweto, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Mu 1999, yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Waverley Girls i Johannesburg. Hanyuma yize ikinamico muri Pretoria Technikon, ubu ikaba izwi nka Tshwane University of Technology (TUT).
Mbere yo kwinjira muri, yabanje kujya yamamaza kuri ABSA. Muri 2012, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime ya "Mad Buddies" kandi akina uruhare ruto rwumupolisi wumugore. Muri 2016, yakoze uruhare rwa Nthati muri filime "Data's War". Yakinnye nka Aggie Ngwenya-Meintjies muri filimi izwi cyane "7de Laan" kuva mu 2010. Imiterere yamenyekanye cyane, kandi kubwibyo yaje gutumirwa gukina filimi ibihe byinshi mubakinnyi basanzwe.

Hykie Berg (yavutse 2 Gicurasi 1978), ni umukinnyi wa filimi Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwa 'Darius du Buisson' muri televiziyo ya "Egoli: Place of Gold" n'uruhare 'Conrad Bester' mu ikinmico, "Binnelanders". Muri 2011, yatsindiye igihembwe cya kane cyamarushanwa yukuri "Survivor South Africa".
Yavutse ku ya 2 Gicurasi 1978 i Pretoria, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yize kugeza mu cyiciro cya 8 mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Die Wilgers aho yatangiye gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge. Hanyuma yize mu 1998. Afite imyaka 19, yabaye umusinzi. Nyuma yaje gukira ibiyobyabwenge mu bitaro by’indwara zo mu mutwe bya Weskoppies, Cape Town.
Kuva mu 1997 na 1999, yarangije Impamyabumenyi y’ubucuruzi mu kwamamaza - Umwaka wa kabiri, Kwamamaza / Kwamamaza ibicuruzwa muri kaminuza ya Pretoriya. Hanyuma yarangije impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor muri Dramatic Arts mu buhanzi, imyidagaduro, no gucunga itangazamakuru muri kaminuza ya Stellenbosch hagati ya 1999 na 2002.
Yashyingiranywe mbere na Melissa Jacobs mu 2013 ariko batandukana muri 2018. Hanyuma, yasabye inshuti ye yumukobwa Gerridene ku ya 23 kamena 2019 aho amaherezo bashyingiranywe muri Werurwe 2020.
Yatangiye kuri tereviziyo mu rukurikirane rw'urubyiruko ruzwi cyane "muri Res" mu 2003. Hanyuma muri 2004, yagize uruhare runini muri serial "Plek van Meats". Muri 2007, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime muri "Ouma se Slim Kind". Mu 2004, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba shampiyona 13 ya "seri ya tereviziyo Egoli: Place of Gold" kandi yakinnye nka 'Darius du Buisson' aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Crystal. Yakinnye ibihe bitatu kugeza muri saison 15 muri 2007.
Muri 2018, yabaye umwanditsi aho yasohoye igitabo "Hykie Berg: Ultimate Survivor". Igitabo kivuga ku buzima bwe bw’ibiyobyabwenge ndetse n’urupfu hafi y’umwuga we wo gukina, aho amaherezo abasha kwisubiraho no kugera ku ntsinzi nyuma.

Zeke Elakhe Lungelo Mngqolo (yavutse ku ya 9 Nzeri 1982), uzwi cyane nka Thami Mngqolo, ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuyobozi wa filimi muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri seri izwi cyane g"enerations", "State Enemy No.1" and "Greed and Desire".
Yavutse ku ya 9 Nzeri 1982 i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo nk'umwana wa kabiri w'umuryango. Afite mukuru we Uvolethwu Mngqolo, witabye Imana mu 2016.
Yagiranye igihe kirekire na mugenzi we bakinana Jo-anne Reyneke. Bashakanye mu 2008 babyarana abana babiri Uvolwethu (wavutse muri 2013) na Lungelo (wavutse 2015). Muri 2018, Mngqolo yirukanwe mu rugo rwabo na Reyneke nyuma yuko bivugwa ko yabonye videwo ibangamira kuri mobile ye. Nyuma yaje gutabarwa n'inshuti ye, Matli Mohapeloa. Batandukanye mu 2018.
Mu 2003, yagaragaye muri seri ya televiziyo yitwa "Generations" akina ari ' Senzo Dlomo ', umugabo wigitsina gabo. Muri 2016, yahagaritse gukina seri, mugihe abakinyi bayo bose birukanwe kubera ko basabye umushahara munini. Yagaragaye kandi mu bakinnyi ba "State Enemy No.1". Yakinnye kandi nka 'resepteptiste' muri ikinamico ya "Muvhango". Ugushyingo 2020, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba telenovela "Isono". Muri seri akina nka 'Maradona'.

Meshack Mavuso Magabane (yavutse ku ya 8 Mata 1977), ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuyobozi wa filimi muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri seri izwi cyane "Heist", "Isidingo", "Yizo Yizo", Isithembiso na Durban gen.
Yavutse ku ya 8 Mata 1977 i Mandagsoek Limpopo, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Arubatse, ni se w'abana bane.
Mu 1998 yakoze umwanya wa mbere 'Vusi Moletsane' mu ikinamico "Isidingo" yamenyekanye cyane. Hanyuma, yagaragaye mu ikinamico "Yizo Yizo" yerekanwe kuva 1999 kugeza 2004 afite uruhare 'Jabulani "Javas" Nyembe'.
Yamenyekanye kandi ubwo yinjiraga muri Mzansi Magic telenovela Isithembiso yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 3 Mata 2017, aho yakinnye imico ya Keromemang Mtimande, se wa Tshepo, wabitswe na se na nyina kugeza igihe yavumbuwe mu buryo butangaje. gira umwana numukunzi we Chlodea ubu bakundana numwanzi we.
Yatangiye umwuga we nka Meshack Mavuso akina 'Simiso Mtshali' mu gice cya kabiri n'icya gatatu cy'urukurikirane rw'abapolisi "Zero Tolerance" yerekanwe muri SABC2. Mbere yizo nshingano zashimwe cyane, yakinnye imico itandukanye mu gice cya mbere. Mu mwaka wa 2008, yari umwe mu babyinnyi b'ibyamamare mu Kubyina umwaka mushya, ku ya 31 Ukuboza 2008.
Muri 2009, yagaragaye ashyigikiwe nigihembwe cyambere cyuruhererekane rwerekana ibisekuruza "Who Do You Think You Are?" cyari gishingiye ku ruhererekane rw'Abongereza. Urukurikirane rwaciye kuri SABC2 muri 2009. Muri 2014, yagarutse kuri tereviziyo akina visits mu bice bibiri by'ikinamico ya Sida "City" yakinnye nka 'dogiteri'. Muri 2015, ku nshuro ya mbere, yakoresheje izina Mavuso Magabane mri seri "Zabalaza". Muri seri, yakinnye Visits mugice kimwe. Muri 2016 yakoze umwanya wa kabiri ayoboye muri e.tv ikinamico "Heist" hamwe ninshingano ya 'Chairman'.
Muri 2020 nyuma yigihe gito muri serial "The River", yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba serial "Durban Gen" aho akina imico ya Dr Thabo Dlamini ugaragara nkumugore kandi akaba yarashakanye na Dr Precious Dlamini.

Fikile Mthwalo (yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1989), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Lesotho wavukiye muri Afurika y'Epfo akaba n'umwanditsi wa firime. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri seri zizwi, "Isidingo" na "Gold Diggers".
Yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1989 Lesotho kwa se wa Mosotho na nyina wa Kenya / Tanzaniya. Afite murumunawe utuye Cape Town. Kuva mu 2001 kugeza 2005, yize muri Machabeng International College ifite icyicaro i Maseru. Nyuma yimukiye i Bloemfontein, muri Afurika yepfo arangiza Matric muri 2007, mu ishuri rya St Michael Girls. Mu 2009, yinjiye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town arangiza impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Arts Film na Video Production. Nyuma muri 2012, yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye na Filime mu ishuri ry’ubuhanzi rya Tisch muri kaminuza ya New York. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yimukiye i Johannesburg.
Yashakanye na mugenzi we wo muri Afurika yepfo Atandwa Kani kuva ku ya 24 Ukuboza 2015. Yahuye na Kani mugihe cya tereviziyo aho basezeranye barashyingirwa nyuma yumwaka. Bateguye ubukwe bwabo gakondo 'Lobolo' nyuma yubukwe bwabo. Atandwa ni umuhungu wa John Kani na Mandi Kani. Mbere yubukwe bwabo, Kani yari afitanye umubano numuntu witangazamakuru, Thembisa Mdoda. Bombi baratandukanye nyuma yimyaka itatu.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina mu ikinamico izwi cyane izwi cyane, "Isidingo". Yabaye umwe mu barangije hejuru 24 mu 'O Access Presenter Search' amakuba zicishwa kuri umuyoboro O. Mu 2015, yatumye we mbere televiziyo iya uruhare na gukina imico 'Ipeleng' mu serial "It’s Complicated." Usibye ibyo, yinjiye mu matangazo yamamaza kuri tereviziyo harimo Metropolitan, PEP, Omo, Shoprite, Etiselat Nigeria, Ibidendezi, Hi-Malt Nigeria na Nivea UK. Yagaragaye muri telenovela "Gold Diggers" aho yakinnye nka 'Hlengiwe'.
Fikile yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelors muri Film na Video Production yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town (UCT), ari naho yarangirije icyubahiro muri 2012. Muri 2015 yahawe buruse yuzuye yo kwitabira gahunda yo gukina amanota ya kaminuza ya New York (NYU). Muri 2018 yarangije Masters mu buhanzi (MFA) mu gukina.

Judith Angela Broderick (wavutse 22 Nyakanga 1963), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Judy Ditchfield, ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuririmbyi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri seri zizwi cyane "The Story of an African Farm", "Cape Town" na "Hoodlum &amp; Son". Ni n'umucuruzi ukomeye akaba yarabihuguriwe mu bwongereza
Yavutse ku ya 22 Nyakanga 1963 i Pretoria, muri Afurika y'Epfo nyuma akurira muri Irene. Afite imyaka itandatu, yimukiye i Kimberley hamwe n'ababyeyi be. Noneho afite imyaka 13, umuryango we wongeye kwimukira i Pietermaritzburg. Kuva mu 1984 kugeza 1987, yamaze i Durban hanyuma yimukira i Johannesburg. Yize amashuri menshi: Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Belgravia na Herlear Primary i Kimberley kumashuri abanza. Hanyuma yize amashuri abanza ya Pelham kuri Standard 5. Hanyuma yarangije ibizamini bya matriche muri Pietermaritzburg Girls High School, Pietermaritzburg.
Hanyuma yabonye impamyabumenyi ya BA muri Psychology na Drama muri kaminuza ya Natal, Pietermaritzburg. Kuva 1984 kugeza 1987 arangije, yakoraga muri Natal Performing Arts Council (NAPAC).
Yashakanye n'umukinnyi n'umucuranzi Paul Ditchfield. Abashakanye bafite abahungu babiri: Keaton na Tom. Keaton yavutse 1991 kandi ni umukinnyi. Tom yavutse 1996 yiga amategeko ya B.Com muri kaminuza ya Wits.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina amakinamico hamwe na Loft Theatre Company, ishami rya NAPAC. Muri kiriya gihe, yakinnye mu ikinamico "Boo To the Moon" yakozwe na Paul Slabolepszy,"Tales From The Pleasure Palace" by Janice Honeyman, "Kwamanzi", "Every Good Boy Deserves Favour", "Hambe Kahle", "Maid In South Africa", "Mistakes Of An African Night To Conquer", "En Dit Was More", "In The War" and "Kitchen Tea". Hanyuma yakinnye mu ikinamico ya "Macbeth" kuri Theatre ya Leta i Pretoriya ndetse no mu ikinamico "Ibintu Dukorera Urukundo" na "bagenzi ba Arms" byakozwe na Anthony Ackerman. Muri 2001, yabonye ibihembo bya Kwazulu-Natal Vita kuba Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bakobwa.
Usibye gukina, ni n'umuririmbyi wamamaye kandi yamenyekanye cyane kandi agaragara muri muzika: Christian; Neill Solomon Rock Concert; Bursting Out; Soundcraft; The Last Great Drive-In Movie Picture Show; It's All Fright By Me; It's Still Rock And Roll To Me; Tarts; A Touch Of Tonic; the smash hit Richard Loring production A Touch Of Webber, A Taste Of Rice; Snow White And The Seven Dwarves; Buddy: The Buddy Holly Story; Fiela's Child: The Musical; The Night They Invented Champagne; and Queen: The Concert at the Sandton Convention Centre.
Kuva mu Kwakira 2006 kugeza Werurwe 2007, yakinnye muri Menopause: The Musical for Showtime Management yaberaga kuri Theatre ya Montecasino i Johannesburg. Muri kiriya gihe, yahawe igihembo cya Naledi Theatre Award 2006 cyo kwerekana ibihembo byiza byurwenya (Umugore) kuriyi gakino. Hagati aho, yagaragaye kuri tereviziyo nyinshi zirimo "Umukino wa II", "Sonnekring II", "Suburban Bliss" na "Streaks I na II". Yakinnye kandi uruhare runini muri seri; "Hooded Angels","Hoof Of Africa", "Zeru Tolerance" na "Yizo Yizo". Muri 2012, yagaragaye muri tereviziyo ya sitcom "Ses'Top La" maze akina nka 'Madamu. Rabinowitz '.
Muri 2019, yakinnye nka 'Stella Fouche' mu isabune izwi cyane "Isidingo". Yagaragaye kandi muri firime, "Kwizera Inguni", "Icyubahiro Glory", "Cape Of Good Hope" na "Stander".

Jo da Silva, numukinyi wamafirime muri Afrika yepfo n'umunyamakuru kuri tereviziyo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri seri zizwi cyane "Gabriël", "Operation Delta Force 3: Clear Target" na "Arsenaal".
Da Silva yarangije muri kaminuza ya Wits mu 1990 afite impamyabumenyi y'icyubahiro mu buhanzi bw'ikinamico. Afite kandi impamyabumenyi ya mwarimu mu myigire yimikino.
Da Silva yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa Afurika y'Epfo Eckard Rabe kuva 1996 kugeza 2007. Abashakanye bafite umukobwa umwe, Caitlin. Muri 2010, Da Silva na Rabe bombi bagize uruhare mu isabune yo muri Afrika yepfo, "7de Laan."
Da Silva yatangiye umwuga we mu ikinamico kandi akomeza imyaka myinshi mu ikinamico. Yagaragaye muri sabune opera "Isidingo" akina nka 'Natasha Wallace'.
Hanyuma yakinnye nka 'Gita McGregor' kuri televiziyo "7de Laan". Ku mirimo ye nka Gita McGregor, Da Silva yatowe mu cyiciro cya "Umugore w’indashyikirwa" mu birori byo gutangiza ibihembo bya Royalty Soapie mu 2013. Muri 2015, yatorewe igihembo cya Royalty Soapie Award mu cyiciro cya "Umugore w’indashyikirwa" kubera uruhare rwe kuri "7de Laan." Da Silva kandi yatowe mu cyiciro cya "Umukinnyi mwiza w'isabune nziza" kubera ibikorwa yakoze kuri "7de Laan" muri 2016 "Huisgenoot" Tempo Awards. Da Silva yavuye muri 7de Laan mu 2016, yimukira i Cape Town kumarana igihe n'umukobwa we no gukora akazi k'ubuntu.
Usibye izo nshingano, Da Silva yanakinnye kuri televiziyo nyinshi zirimo "Gabriel", "Arsenaal", "Madam &amp; Eve", "Suburban Bliss" na "Egoli". Guhera mu 2007, yakinnye nka 'Olivia Fitzgerald' muri televiziyo izwi cyane ya "Erfsondes".
Nyuma yo kuruhuka igihe kirekire avuye mu ikinamico, amaherezo yagarutse kuri stage akina ibintu bibiri mu ikinamico "Present Laughter" rwanditswe na Noël Coward. Ikinamico yerekanwe kuri Theatre ku Kigobe. Hanyuma yakinnye mu ikinamico, "Fatal Attraction", yerekanwe kuri Theatre kuri Bay na Pieter Toerien's Monte Casino Theatre i Johannesburg. Usibye gukina, yanatunganije, afatanya kuyobora ndetse anerekana ikinyamakuru M-Net show 'Showbuzz'. Yabaye kandi umuyobozi wumugore mukinamico yicyongereza,"It rained last night"..

Zakeeya Patel (yavutse ku ya 6 Mutarama 1988), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Afurika yepfo akaba n'umunyamakuru. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri serial izwi cyane "Isidingo", "7de Laan" na "High Rollers".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Patel yavukiye i Durban, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Ni muryango wakomokaga mu Buhinde ku ruhande rwa se Yarangije afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ikinamico no mu bitaramo yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town.
Mu 2005, yakinnye nka 'Samantha Sharma' muri opera yisabune ya televiziyo "Isidingo". Igitaramo cyaje gukundwa cyane. Hagati aho muri 2006, yabaye nyampinga wa Season 6 muri South African competition "Dancing with the Stars". Muri 2012, yagaragaye muri firime yo gusetsa "Material" kandi akina nka 'Aisha Kaif'. Noneho muri 2013, yagaragaye muri Show "High Rollers". Muri 2014, yagaragaye akina ikinamico "Emotional Creature" aho yaboneyeho umwanya wo gukorana n’umunyamerika uzwi cyane akaba n'umwanditsi Eve Ensler.
Muri 2018, yakinnye muri filime "The Docket" Muri 2019, yagaragaye muri Netflix yumwimerere "Shadow". Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri filime ishimishije ya Showmax "The Girl from St. Agnes". Mu mpera za 2019, yagize uruhare runini muri film "3 Days to Go". Muri 2020, yakinnye mu rukurikirane rwa filime "Material" "2012 yitwa New Material".
Patel yashakanye n’umukungu w’ubukungu Rob Price mu birori by’amadini atandukanye mu Gushyingo 2017. Bimukiye i Los Angeles, muri Californiya mu Kuboza 2019.

Arno Marais (yavutse 19 Mata 1984), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri "seri" zizwi cyane Stroomop, "Die Boekklub" na "Reconnect".
Yavutse ku ya 19 Mata 1984 i Bloemfontein muri Afurika y'Epfo. Nyina ni Corrie Viviers.
Mu 2009, yakinnye nk'inzobere mu by'ikoranabuhanga 'Benjamin le Roux' muri opera izwi cyane "Isidingo" aho igice cye cyanyuze ku ya 20 Ugushyingo. Muri 2016, yagaragaye muri serivise yikinamico ya kykNET "Die Boekklub" akina nka 'Herman Mouton'. Mu mpera za 2016, yagize ikiruhuko cyimyaka ibiri kuva "Isidingo". Muri kiriya gihe, yinjiye mu bakinnyi ba televiziyo ya "Sokhulu &amp; Partners" maze akina nka 'Adv. Nick Edwards '. Hanyuma yagaragaye kuri serial "7de Laan" muburyo bugaruka. Hanyuma muri 2017, asubira muri "Isidingo".
Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2010, yagize impanuka y'imodoka yahitanye Kobus Venter, umwangavu. Marais yarakomeretse cyane aguma muri koma ibyumweru bine mu bitaro by’amasomo bya Steve Biko i Pretoria. Nk’uko amakuru aturuka mu bitaro abitangaza, ngo yabyimbye mu bwonko mu gihe cya koma ndetse no kuva amaraso imbere. Yasize ibihaha yarajanjaguwe, bityo akoresha ubuhumekero. Yamaze ibyumweru bitandatu mu bitaro. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yitabye urukiko bwa mbere muri Pretoria ku bijyanye n'impanuka.
Muri 2018, yashyizeho Tweets nyinshi yibasira Abayisilamu kandi yatanze ibitekerezo bimwe bikemangwa kuri Islam.

Sonwabise 'Soso' Rungqu (yavutse ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1983), ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuririmbyi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serial izwi cyane "Isidingo".
Yavutse ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1983 i Amalinda, mu Burasirazuba bwa Londre, Afurika y'Epfo. Mu 1991, yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Clarendon ry’abakobwa. Yarangije afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buhanzi bwa muzika muri kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga ya Tshwane, Pretoria. Se yapfuye mu 2015. Arubatse kandi ni nyina w'umuhungu.
Mu 2007, yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikinamico mu ikinamico "coin n’izindi nkuru" zakorewe kuri Civic Theatre, (ubu izwi ku izina rya Theatre Johannesburg). Soso yakoze ijwi ryamamaye hejuru yimiterere ya animasiyo 'Smartycat' kumyerekano y'abana "Cool Catz" kuva 2008 kugeza 2010. Hagati aho, yanakinnye mu ikinamico y'amashuri yisumbuye ndetse n'amashuri abanza. Hanyuma yakoranye nishami ryubuhanzi numuco imyaka mike. Uruhare rwe rwa tereviziyo ya mbere rwaje nko muri PHD Inyigo Yumwana Kubuzima bwa Mindset Network.
Ubwa mbere, yagaragaye cyane kuri tereviziyo zizwi cyane: "love of Mzansi", "Scandal!" Town "(Urukurikirane rwa TV)", "Sokhulu &amp; parteners" na "7de Laan". Hagati aho, yagaragaye muri televiziyo "HeartLaughs" mu rwego rwa DVD "Indangagaciro mu bikorwa". Muri 2014, yagaragaye muri firime ngufi "Awakening" hanyuma muri firime "Munsi yubuhanzi" muri 2015. Muri uwo mwaka, yavuze uruhare kuri radio ikinamico "uHambolwethu yanyuze" kuri TruFM.
Muri 2016, yamenyekanye cyane ku ruhare 'Kau Morongwa' kuri opera "Isidingo". Yakomeje gukina kugeza muri 2018 aho yaretse kwerekana kugira ngo arebe se urwaye.

Le guceceka de la forêt ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Central Afurika na Kameruni yo muri 2003 iyobowe na Bassek Ba Kobhio na Didier Ouenangare. mu mateka ni filime ya mbere yerekanwe muri Sinema yo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique Iyi filime kandi yakorewe hamwe muri Gabon na Kameruni. Filime yahinduwe ishingiye ku gitabo cyanditswe na Étienne Goyémidé gifite umutwe umwe "Le silence de la forêt". Iyi filime yari ishingiye ku moko mato ya Pygmies nyafurika kandi ni nayo filime ya mbere ivuga ku ivangura rishingiye ku moko ry’Abanyafurika bigezweho ku bwoko bw’abasangwabutaka bo muri Afurika (Biaka people).
Gonaba (Eriq Ebouaney), umugenzuzi w’uburezi mu karere muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique yumva acitse intege nyuma yo gukora mu butegetsi bwa gisirikare imyaka irenga icumi. Bidatinze, ashishikajwe no kunganira ubwoko bw’abasangwabutaka bwitwa Baaka muri rusange birengagizwa kandi bagafatwa nabi muri sosiyete kandi ubuzima bwabo bukaba bubangamiwe n’imijyi n’iterambere ry’ubukungu.
Iyi filime yabanje gutangazwa ko izayoborwa gusa n’umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique Didier Ouenangare nkumushinga we wa mbere. Yatangiye kuyobora bwa mbere binyuze muri uyu mushinga afite imyaka 50. Icyakora umuyobozi wa filimi muri Kameruni Bassek Ba Kobhio yinjiye mu gufata amashusho kandi ashinzwe ibijyanye na tekiniki yo kurasa. Bassek yaje kuba umuyobozi mukuru wa film mugihe Didier yamubereye umuyobozi wa film. Bombi bumvikanye gukorana kandi film yatewe inkunga cyane na Kameruni na Gabon. Iyi filime yakorewe muri CAR mu gihe igihugu cyahuye n’ibibazo by’ubukungu hamwe n’ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare mu 2003. Byagaragaye ko umukinnyi wa firime Didier yakiriye inkunga ingana na 50000 FF na Agence intergouvernmentale de la francophonie mugihe cy'ibirori bya Amiens.
Benshi mubagize itsinda hamwe nabatekinisiye mugikorwa cyo gufata amashusho bashakishijwe mubihugu bituranye birimo Kameruni na Gabon. Umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Kameruni, Eriq Ebouaney yatoranijwe kugira ngo agire uruhare runini kandi yagombaga kwiga ururimi rwa Sango rukaba ari rumwe mu ndimi zemewe za Repubulika ya Centrafrique. Umuhimbyi w’umuziki wamamaye muri Kameruni, Manu Dibango, yinjijwe mu muziki wa filime. Umuyobozi wa firime Didier nawe yakiriye opposition no kunengwa kuba adahisemo abanyafurika yo hagati ngo bakore iyo film.
Iyi filime yerekanwe mu gihugu muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique yarahungabanye kubera ko sinema yonyine mu gihugu yari ifunze icyo gihe. Filime yatoranijwe kumugaragaro kugirango yerekanwe mu minsi mikuru mike ya firime kandi ifunguye muri rusange ibitekerezo byiza byatanzwe nabanegura. Iyi filime yerekanwe ku gice cy’umubumbe wa Afurika muri 2003 Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto 2003. Yatoranijwe kandi kugirango yerekanwe mu gice cy’abayobozi ba Fortnight igice cya Festival ya Cannes 2003. Iyi filime kandi yakiriwe cyane mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime 2003 ryitwa Francophone de Namur (FIFF).

Abbas Kaijuka numu moderi wo muri Uganda, umunyamideli hamwe nuwakusanyije imideli uzwi muri "kuranga Kai's Divo". Niwe wahawe igihembo cy’umwaka w’abagabo berekana imideli y’abagabo bo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba muri 2020 East Fashion Awards ndetse na Fashion Designer of the Year igihembo cya Abryanz Style na Fashion Awards 2016 kandi yahawe ibihembo bitandukanye harimo na East African Designer of the Year. igihembo mucyumweru cyimyambarire ya Swahili 2017.

Malaika Tenshi Nnyanzi uzwi cyane mwizina rye nka Malaika numukinnyi wa filimi muri Uganda, umunyamakuru n'umunyamideli. Azwi cyane kubikorwa bya radio kuri D'Mighty Breakfast show kuri KFM na Malaika na Oulanya kuri Capital Fm ndetse nakazi yakoraga kuri Veronica's Wish, Bed of Thorns, The Honourables and Mela.
Kwerekana imiterere.
Malaika yatangiye umwuga wo kwerekana imideli i Nairobi muri Kenya. Yayoboye kandi isosiyete icunga icyitegererezo hamwe numugabo kandi yerekanaga ibikorwa byabo mubirori byinshi birimo icyumweru cyimyambarire ya Swahili. Yavuye i Nairobi yimukira muri Uganda aho yakomereje umwuga we wo kwerekana imideli hamwe n'ibikorwa by'imyidagaduro. Ni ambasaderi wikirango Nice Vine.
Radiyo na televiziyo.
Agarutse muri Uganda avuye muri Kenya, Malaika yinjiye muri Televiziyo ya Urban Group ya Vision Group nk'umufatanyabikorwa hamwe na Gaetano Kagwa mu kiganiro cya mu gitondo cyitwa Urban Today. Nyuma yaje kuva muri Urban Today yakira Fashionista mbere yuko ava muri Televiziyo ya Urban mu Gushyingo 2016. Yinjiye kandi mu muyoboro w’imyidagaduro wo muri Afurika yepfo Rockstar Group nk'isura nshya ya televiziyo yitwa SHOOOOSH! Malaika yatangiye umwuga we wo gukora kuri radio muri KFM i Kampala muri Mata 2017. Yafatanije nabandi mu ikiganiro cya mugitondo, D'Mighty Breakfast show hamwe na Brian Mulondo. Muri 2019, yavuye muri KFM yinjira muri Capital Fm atangira kwakira "Malaika na Oulanya" hamwe na Oulanya Columbus asimbuye Gaetano na Lucky mumwanya wabo wa Overdrive.
Malaika yerekanye umwuga we wo gukina filime ya Nisha Kalema yo muri 2018 yerekana ikinamico ya Veronica's Wish akina nka Bankia. Yakiriye abahatanira ibihembo bibiri mu ruhare mu cyiciro cyiza cyo gushyigikira umukinnyi wa filime muri 2018 Uganda Film Festival Awards na ZAFAA Global Awards muri 2019. Nyuma yaje gukinishwa nka Stella muri 2019 Eleanor Nabwiso yayoboye film. Kuri uru ruhare, Malaika yatowe kandi yegukana igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri 2019 Uganda Film Festival Awards. Yakinnye kandi nk'umukinnyi wa Mela Katende mu rukurikirane rw'amakinamico rwa Nana Kagga rwa Mela maze yinjira muri Honourables mu 2019 nk'umunyamuryango ukomeye.
Malaika yavukiye Malaika Nnyanzi ku babyeyi bava Uganda i Nairobi muri Kenya, aho se wahoze ari ingabo za Uganda yari yarajyanywe mu bunyage. Umuryango we wasubiye muri Uganda utura i Kampala. Yagiye ku ishuri ry’incuke rya Safari, Ishuri ry’ababyeyi rya Kampala, Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Gayaza na Makerere College mbere yo gusubira muri Kenya aho yarangirije impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bucuruzi mpuzamahanga muri kaminuza nkuru y’Amerika yo muri Amerika. Muri 2018, ubwo yaganiraga na Crystal Newman kuri show ye "Crystal 1 Ku ya 1", Malaika yaje gusohoka ameze nk'uwahohotewe na mugenzi we bakorana kubera igicuri, ikintu yari amaze imyaka irenga icumi yiherereye kandi kimutera kwiheba.

Julie Nalujya uzwi cyane nka Julie Mutesasira ni umuririmbyi wa gospel wo muri Kanada uvuka Uganda uzwi muri Uganda ndetse no muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kubera indirimbo ze nka Nkulembera, Lwana Nabo, Ekikunyumira na Bamuyita Yesu, ubufatanye na Iryn Namubiru. Julie yavuye muri Uganda yimukira muri Kanada nyuma yo gutandukana n'umugabo we Steven Mutesasira babyarana abana babiri abo bakaba ari Esther na Ezekiyeli, abatsindiye muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba Got Talent season 1 2019.
Yabonye igihembo cy’umugore muri GOSPEL song ye "Saba" muri 2014 ndetse n’indirimbo nziza y’amadini kubera indirimbo ye Mukama mu 2015 kandi yatorewe kuba Indirimbo nziza y’idini kubera indirimbo ye Kijja Kugwa mu 2016 ku nshuro ya gatatu, iya kane n'iya gatanu HiPipo Ibihembo bya Muzika. Yatsindiye igihembo cy'indirimbo y'umwaka muri Olive Gospel Music Awards mu 2012, igihembo cy'umuhanzi w'umwaka muri VIGA Awards 2016, Diva Collabo Award ya Yani, ubufatanye na Iryn Namubiru muri DIVA 2011

Ubwato n'Inyanja (Igiporutugali: O Navio eo Mar) ni Filime ya documentaire yanditswe na Lara Sousa, iyobowe na Lara Sousa na Everlane Moraes kandi yakozwe na Lara Sousa na Matheus Mello.
firime yafotowe kandi ikorerwa muri Berezile na Mozambique, namasosiyete akora: Kulunga Filmes (Mozambique), Pattaki Audiovisual na Portátil (Berezile). Imiterere ya firime iri mumabara, Digital / Digital 5.1, Imiterere ya Dolby Stereo. Umusaruro uracyatezwa imbere.
Umugambi / Icegeranyo.
Icyemezo cyafashwe na Everlane na Lara bo muri Berezile na Mozambique, bombi bakaba ari abakora amafilime y’abirabura, kugira ngo berekane indorerwamo bazenguruka igihugu cyabo mu buryo bwambukiranya imipaka, hanyuma bareba filime za buri wese kugira ngo bamenye imico yazimiye mu biranga umwirondoro wabo kumpande zombi kugirango wuzuze icyuho cyabuze.
Iyi filime yatoranijwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya 11 rya Durban (DIFF 2020) ryabaye hagati ya 10 na 20 Nzeri, kuri interineti, hamwe n’izindi filime zigera kuri 30 nka imwe mu mishinga y’Ihuriro ry’Imari.
Iyi filime yatsindiye kandi muri Durban FilmMart ya 2020, Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime Amashusho Amsterdam (IDFA) Igihembo cy’Ubuholandi.

Amarushanwa y'ubwiza.

Moore yagaragaye muri firime, " "crazy in love" ", yakinanye kandi nabakinnyi ba Nollywood nka Jim Iyke Altorro Black na Crystal Milian. Filime yerekanwe bwa mbere i Beltsville, Maryland, muri Amerika. Ibirori byari byitabiriwe nabastar benshi ba Nollywood barimo Ramsey Nouah.
Acuruza imitako bambara ; Nalu Couture na Glitz na Nalu, yitiriwe umukobwa we. Niwe kandi washinze Cosmetics ya DKM n'umurongo wimyenda ya VIXEN muri Liberiya, kandi ari no mubukorikori bwa kalendari.

Bibi Nshimba kandi Bibi Amosi (yavutse Kanama 18, 1976) ni umukinnyi wa filime uvuka Congo ariko utuye American, akaba producer n'umwanditsi.
Muri serivise za TV zakozwe na Shane Brennan, "NCIS: Los Angeles", yasohotse bwa mbere muri 2009 ikagaragara kuri CBS, yagaragaye nka "Receptiste" mu gice cya 1, 2014. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yanditse, akora kandi akina muri firime ngufi, "Ben na Becca", nka "Rebecca", umunyeshuri w’ubuvuzi ukomoka muri Afurika. Muri iyi filime kandi hagaragayemo Brian Krause nka "Ben" kandi iyobowe na Victor Alferi.
Yagaragaye mu biganiro bya televiziyo 2016 byayobowe na Neil Druckmann na Bruce Straley bise, "Uncharted 4: end of thief", nk'imwe mu "Amajwi y'inyongera". Muri 2018, yafatanije kuyobora filime ngufi yerekana ikinamico, "Ukwizera nyakuri", hamwe na Prince Steven Obeni Bottan aho yakinnye nka "Angelica". Abandi bakinnyi barimo Vanessa Bisono, Andrey Bereza na Tito Londole.

Yorodani Riber ni umukinnyi wa filimi kubijyanye no kuziyobora no kuzitunganya muri Zimbabwe yavukiye Tanzaniya,kandi akora nka Screenwriter, Producer, Editor na Sound engineer.
Riber yavukiye mu muryango w'umuhungu John na Louise Riber, bombi niba ari abakora amafilime, akurira i Harare, muri Zimbabwe. Igihe kinini yamaranye muma firime no mubikoresho byo kubyara nyuma yo gukura. Yarangije mu 2004 muri Fairhaven College, Western Washington University, Bellingham, Washington, Amerika, aho yize Filime. Kuva mu 2005, yari umukinnyi wa firime ukora umwuga wa injeniyeri na injeniyeri y'amajwi i Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, yayoboye kandi ahindura "Siri ya Mtungi", ikiganiro cya televiziyo y’ururimi rwigiswahiri cyamasaha nigice, yakinnye na Cathryn Credo, Beatrice Taisamo, Yvonne Cherrie nabandi. Yatorewe ibihembo bya "Televiziyo Nziza - Urwenya / Ikinamico", "Filime Yururimi Kavukire / Urukurikirane rw'igiswahili" hamwe na "Best Sound Editor" mu bihembo bya Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards 2014 (AMVCA).
Muri 2017, yayoboye film, "Hadithi za Kumekucha: Tunu".
Muri 2018, yayoboye, atunganya kandi ahindura filime ye ya kabiri yerekana, "Hadithi za Kumekucha: Fatuma", yakinnye kandi na Cathryn Credo, Beatrice Taisamo na Ayoub Bombwe. Muri uwo mwaka, yayoboye kandi akora "Bahasha (Ibahasha)", filime yikinamico, irimo Ayoub Bombwe, Godliver Gordian, Omary Mrisho na Cathryn Credo.
Mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Zanzibar 2018 (ZIFF) ryatoranijwe ku mugaragaro, "Bahasha ya Riber niyo filime yatangije" yerekanwe bwa mbere, hamwe na "Fatuma" bashyizwe mu cyiciro cya "Long Feature". Muri ibyo bihembo, yabonye "Umuyobozi" "mwiza na Cinematografiya nziza", mu cyiciro cyihariye cya Sinema.

Memry Savanhu (nanone Memory Savanhu) ni umukinnyi wa filime wa Nollywood wavukiye muri Zimbabwe, Umukinnyi wa firime na Rwiyemezamirimo, utuye burundu i Lagos, muri Nijeriya nyuma yo kwimurwa i Londere mu Bwongereza. Yatangiye bwa mbere muri filime, "Intera Hagati", mu 2008 kandi kuva icyo gihe, yakinnye mu bintu byinshi bya Nollywood "One Fine Day", "On Bended Knees" na "76". Niwe washinze Memkay Productions, imyambaro yo gutunganya film.
Bivugwa ko Savanhu yavukiye muri Zimbabwe "maze ahishurira ikinyamakuru Guardian" cyo muri Nijeriya ko akomoka mu bwoko bwa Zezuru. Yize ikinamico i Londres no muri New York Film Academy i Abu Dhabi, UAE yize gukora firime.
Muri 2015, yatorewe igihembo cya Zimbabwe International Women Awards (ZIWA) cyabereye i Birmingham mu Bwongereza mu Kwakira k'uwo mwaka nk'uko byatangajwe na "The Herald" of Zimbabwe. Iki gihembo ni icy'uruhare yagize muri Nollywood nk'uko "Umudugudu w'Urubyiruko ubitangaza".

Jesesi Mungoshi (nanone Jesese Mungoshi) numukinnyi wa filimi muri Zimbabwe. Yagaragaye bwa mbere mu 1989, muri filime yitwa, "African Journey".
Mu kugaragara hakiri kare, Mungoshi yagaragaye muri verisiyo yo mu 1989 ndetse no mu 1990 yakurikiyeho ibice bibiri bya filime y’umuryango wa televiziyo ya George Bloomfield, "African Journey", nayo yakinnye: Jason Blicker, Katja Blomquist, Allan Jordan, Ulla Mahaka n'abandi.
Mu 1991, yagaragaye muri filime ya Godwin Mawuru yise "Neria", aho yakinnye nka "Neria". Abandi bakinnyi ni Dominic Kanaveli na Violet Ndlovu mubandi. Yagaragaye kandi muri filime ngufi ya 1993 na Farai Sevenzo yise, "Rwendo", yakinnye na Yemi Ajibade, Ben Daniels, Eldinah Tshatedi na Frank Windsor.
Muri 2017, yagaragaye muri filime isetsa-y'urukundo, "Cook Off", iyobowe na Tomas Brickhill, aho yakinnye nka "Gogo". Iyi filime ikaba yarakozwe bwa mbere muri Zimbabwe nyuma y’ubutegetsi burebure bwa Robert Mugabe, yerekanwe bwa mbere mu Bwongereza ku ya 27 Nyakanga 2019.
Mu rwego rwo gushimira uruhare rwe mu nganda za firime Zimbabwe, yahawe igihembo cya Lifetime Achievement Award na Kaminuza Nkuru ya Zimbabwe muri Gicurasi 2017 i Masvingo. Filime ya 2020, "Shaina", aho afatanije nabandi bakinnyi ba Zimbabwe nka: Marian Kunonga, Charmaine Mujeri nabandi bagaragaye, bakiriwe neza mumahanga.
Yashakanye n'umwanditsi, umukinnyi n'umusizi wa Zimbabwe, Charles Mungoshi, nk'uko ikinyamakuru "The Zimbabwe Mail" na "Uyu ari" abanyamakuru bo muri Afurika, yapfuye ku ya 16 Gashyantare 2019 i Harare, muri Zimbabwe nyuma y'uburwayi yari amaze imyaka 10 afite imyaka 71. Ubukwe bwahiriwe n’abana batanu: Farai, Graham, Nyasha, Charles, na Tsitsi, kandi igihe yapfaga bari bafite abuzukuru barindwi. Abashakanye bari kumwe numuhungu wabo, Farai bose bari gukina film.

Leila Nakabira, na Leilah Nakabira (wavutse 1993) ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Uganda, akaba Umwanditsi wa filimi n’umugore uharanira inyungu z'igitsinagore. Ni umuyobozi mukuru wa Lepa Africa Films akaba yarashinze Leilah Nakabira For Charity Foundation.
Nakabira yize Quantitative Economics muri kaminuza ya Makerere, Kampala, Uganda, ari naho yarangirije. Nyuma yigihe runaka mubikorwa bya firime, yahisemo gusubira kwiga amashusho.
Yakiriye ibihembo bitatu byumukinnyi "mwiza wa Zahabu (Ikinamico)", "Umukinnyi wa" Zahabu wizewe cyane na "Golden Discovery Actor" ibihembo byigihembo cya Golden Movie Awards Africa 2018 (GMAA) cyabaye ku ya 2 kamena, amazina yabatowe yitwa Palaise de la culture, Treichville, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, kubera filime yakinnye yitwa, "The Forbidden", yakozwe na Nampala Claire. Mu Zulu Afurika Film Academy Awards (ZAFAA) 2018, arabyuka bahatanira mu "Best Actor Female" category kuko filime imwe. Yari bahatanira na yegukanye "Best Actress" igihembo mu Film Festival Awards UDADA y'abagore yabereye ku ya 20 Ukwakira, 2018 muri Kenya kuko filime imwe. Yari yongeye bahatanira mu "Best Actress" category ku African Film Festival (Arta'atu) Awards 2019, kuko filime imwe. Ibirori byabaye ku ya 30 Kamena muri salle ya Moody Performance, 2520 Street Street, Dallas, Texas, Amerika. Kuko hasigaye film imwe, mu kiyaga cya International Film Festival (LIPFF) Awards yabereye Ugushyingo 6-9, 2019 mu Kenya, yari ku rutonde byiciro bibiri igihembo: "Best Child bakoze" na "Best Actress."
Mu munsi w’abagore muri Afurika 2019, yagiriye inama abagore kutagira ubwoba bakurikirana intego zabo.

Godliver Gordian ni filime yo muri Tanzaniya. Ni umwe mu bagize umuryango w’ubutabazi ushingiye i New York, Global Medical Relief Fund, kandi yafashije abarangije muri albino kubona akazi bavugana n’abakoresha mu izina ryabo, hatitawe ku bwoba bujyanye na albinos muri Tanzaniya.
Gordian yari ingenzi cyane muri Jordan Riber 2012 isaha n'igice ya Swahili language TV Series, "Siri ya Mtungi", aho yagize uruhare "Cheusi". Muri iyi filime kandi hagaragayemo nka Beatrice Taisamo, Yvonne Cherrie n'abandi.
Muri 2015, yakinnye cyane muri firime yikinamico yo muri Tanzaniya ya Chande Omar yitwa, "Aisha".
Mu 2016, yari ku rutonde African Film na Arts Festival (Arta'atu) ibihembo mu "Best Actress" category, kubera uruhare yagize muri filimi, "Aisha." Kuko uruhare kimwe no film, yari ku rutonde kuko Azam Bongo Movie Awards mu "Best Actress" category ku 2016 Zanzibar International Film Festival (ZIFF), bikaba yatsindiye.
Yagaragaye kandi muri filime yo gusetsa-ikinamico ya 2016 na Seko Shamte yitwa, "Gutaha".
Yabaye umuyobozi wa casting muri 2017 yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi byamafirime yo mu bwoko bwa Tanzania y’igiswahili yakozwe na Amil Shivji yise, "T-JUNCTION", yakinnye: Magdalena Christopher, Hawa Alisa (Hawa Ally), Cojack Chilo.
Muri 2018, yakinnye muri filime y’ikinamico y’ururimi rw’igiswahili ya Jordan Riber, "Bahasha (Ibahasha)", aho yakinnye nka "Hidaya". Izindi nyenyeri zigaragara zirimo Ayoub Bombwe na Godliver Gordian.
Yagaragaye kandi muri "Binti" ya Seko Shamte, filime ikinamico yo muri Tanzaniya iteganijwe gusohoka mu 2021. Yakinnye nka "Roza".

Marwa Zein ni umunya Sudani ukora ibintu byinshi harimo umuyobozi wa firime, umwanditsi wumwanditsi hamwe nuwatunganya film. Niwe mwanditsi wa documentaire ya 2019, "Khartoum Offside", akaba n'umwunganira uburenganzira bw'umugore binyuze mu mirimo ye. Niwe washinze ORE Production, isosiyete ikora firime ya Khartoum ishingiye kuri Khartoum akaba n'umwe mu bakinnyi ba firime barindwi batoranijwe baturutse hirya no hino ku isi kugira ngo yitabe iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2019 n'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya Emerging Film Talent Association (IEFTA).
Ku mushinga we wo gutanga impamyabumenyi, Zein yanditse, ayobora kandi akora filime ngufi ya documentaire, "A Game", mu 2009, ihindurwa mu ndimi eshanu kandi itangwa nk'umuntu watoranijwe ku mugaragaro mu minsi mikuru mpuzamahanga 30. mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Dubai 2016 (DIFF), film ye ngufi, a week", two days", yakinnye na Yasmin Raies na Amro Saleh, yerekanwe bwa mbere. Yagaragaye no mu bindi birori bitandukanye bya firime.
Mu gutunganya iyi filime, yamaganye imyifatire mibi ya guverinoma ya Sudani ku ruhare rw’abagore mu gukina filime. Nubwo atigeze ahura n’umubiri ku buryo butaziguye mu gihe cyo gukora iyi filime, yakiriye iterabwoba rya kamera cyangwa ibikoresho bishoboka ko byangirika. Amaherezo ariko, yabonye uruhushya rukenewe rwo gufata iyi firime. Nyuma y’impinduka za politiki zazanywe n’impinduramatwara ya Sudani yo muri 2018/19, iyi filime yerekanwe ubwo hafungurwaga iserukiramuco rya sinema ryigenga rya Sudani i Khartoum muri Mutarama 2020.

Khartoum Offside ni filime ya documentaire ya siporo yo muri Sudani ya 2019 yibanda ku bakobwa bakiri bato muri Sudani, yakozwe, yanditswe kandi iyobowe n’umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Sudani Marwa Zein. Yerekanwe ku isi yose mu ihuriro rya Berlinale rya 2019 mu Budage kandi ni imwe muri filime eshatu zizwi cyane zo muri Sudani zo muri 2019. nkubutumwa bukuru kuri documentaire.
Byatwaye Zein imyaka ine yo gukora iyi documentaire. Bitewe n’imyumvire mibi y’uburenganzira bwa muntu bw’umugore muri Sudani mbere y’impinduramatwara ya Sudani yo muri 2018/19, Zein ntabwo yigeze ahura n’umubiri, ahubwo yakiriwe n’ubuyobozi bwa Sudani bwo gusenya kamera. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, film yafatiwe ahitwa Khartoum, muri Sudani, ikorwa na Marwa Zein muri ORE Productions na Hendrik Underbjerg kuri Stray Dog Productions, Copenhagen, Danemark na Oslo, Noruveje.
Hamwe n’icyemezo gikomeye, itsinda ry’abakobwa bakiri bato i Khartoum bagiye gukina umupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga, kubera ko leta y’abasilamu bo muri Sudani yabujijwe. N’ubwo Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira wamaguru mu gihugu ryakira amafaranga ya FIFA yagenewe amakipe y’abagore, iyi kipe ikomeje guhezwa. Ariko, hariho urumuri rwicyizere, mugihe amatora mumashyirahamwe yerekana ko bishoboka kuvugurura sisitemu yose. Nubutwari nubutwari, barwanira kumenyekana kumugaragaro nkikipe yumupira wamaguru yabategarugori ya Sudani, bahanganye cyane nintego zabo.
Kapiteni Sara (Sara Jubara), umukirisitu ukiri muto, wavukiye mu majyaruguru ya Sudani, yerekana imitekerereze ya rwiyemezamirimo, kandi ashakisha imishinga y’ubucuruzi kugira ngo inzozi zabo zibe impamo, ubwo akoranya ikipe ya Sudani mu gikombe cy’isi cy’abagore. Usibye gukenera gushaka inkunga, hari ibibazo byingenzi byabaturage bagomba guhura nabyo.
Mu kiganiro cye 'Gerageza kuba umugore ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Sudani', umunyeshuri Steve Howard yanditse kuri iyi filime ati: "Abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru ni itsinda rivanze n'Abanyasudani na Sudani y'Amajyepfo ese abagore bakorera mu mibereho nk'abakozi bashinzwe kwita ku nyubako, abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri yisumbuye, abadandaza., na Bisa. Abanyamuryango barimo abagore bo mu misozi ya Nuba, akarere gakandamijwe cyane hafi y’amajyaruguru yumupaka mushya. Kandi mu byo bahanganye harimo imbaraga z'abagize itsinda rya Sudani y'Amajyepfo imbaraga zo kuguma muri Sudani, aho ubu bakeneye uruhushya rwo gutura nyuma yo gutandukana kwa Sudani zombi mu 2011. "
Kurekura no kwakirwa neza.
"Nk’uko IMDb" ibitangaza ngo iyi filime yasohotse ku ya 13 Gashyantare 2019. Bukeye bwaho, yerekanwe muri Forum y'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Berlin, nyuma iza no muyindi minsi mikuru, nka Visions du Réel mu Busuwisi, CPH: DOX Copenhagen,Sheffield Doc / Fest na IDFA Amsterdam. Yerekanwe kandi mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya documentaire rya Hot Docs ryo ku ya 26 Mata 2019. Iyi filime yerekanwe kuri interineti ibinyujije kuri Zoom hamwe n'indi filime y'abagore b'Abanyafurika n'Abarabu yitwa "The Bleaching Syndrome" (2020), mu Cyarabu ifite insanganyamatsiko y'icyongereza, na Dardishi ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2020. I Khartoum, yerekanwe bwa mbere mu gufungura iserukiramuco rya sinema ryigenga rya Sudani muri Mutarama 2020.
Akimara kwerekanwa bwa mbere i Berlin, uwanenze amafilime Vladan Petković yise "inyandiko ishishikaje, ikora ku mutima kandi rimwe na rimwe, ibisigo byerekana ibisigo" maze Joseph Fahim yandika mu isubiramo rye kuri Berlinale 2019: "Ubushake bukomeye, bwisanzuye kandi bwisanzuye kandi bukabije. yigenga, umupira w'amaguru wa Zein urwanya imyumvire nyamukuru y'abagore bo muri Sudani. "
Mu gihe cyo kwerekanwa mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Afurika ryabereye i New York mu Kuboza 2020, ku rubuga rwa YouTube, ikiganiro kijyanye no gukora documentaire hagati ya Marwa Zein n’umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Sudani n’umunyamerika Sarra Idriss Muri iki kiganiro, Zein yasobanuye intera ndende ya documentaire ze:"I wanted to tackle many aspects about being Sudanese...Are we Arabs or not? Are we still classified based on the colour of our skin, the last name of our family? – Sexuality, the political situation, inequality of women and men, religion – all of this, I wanted to tell a story about."

Toka McBaror ni producer wa filimi n'indirimbo muri Nigeria, ndetse ajya akora nk'Umuyobozi wa filimi na music video yavutse, yazuye na ishingiye mu Kaduna, Kaduna Leta, Nigeria ariko ukomoka Delta State. Afatwa na benshi nka jack na shobuja wamayeri yose yo gukora firime nubucuruzi. Ibihembo byinshi byatsindiye, byabyaye umusaruro kandi bigamije ubuhanga bwo guhanga udushya, umutoza wo gukina amafilime akaba n'umujyanama mu bijyanye no gutunganya amafilime, McBaror avugwa cyane nka Encyclopedia of Filmmaking hamwe n'ibihembo byinshi kuri kitty ye, harimo no gutanga ibihembo kuri " Kada River " muri 2018 "Toronto International Nollywood Film Festival" mu canada, 6 igihembo imikino kuko filime, Lotanna harimo: ""Best Film"," ""Best Director"," ""Best Cinematography"," ""Best Art Director"," "Best Costume" no " "Umwanditsi mwiza w'ijwi" " muri ibihembo bya zahabu ya 2017.
Agomba kandi ibihembo bye, "Filime Nziza Nyafurika" na "Umuyobozi mwiza wa Nollywood" kuva mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime mpuzamahanga rya Nollywood 2018, TINFF, ryabereye i Toronto, muri Kanada. muri firime, Ikirwa, yongera gutorwa mu byiciro bya " "Cinematografi Nziza" " na " "Umuyobozi mwiza" " mu bihembo bya ZAFAA Global Awards, kubera filime ye ya Lotanna 2017.
Muri 2011, Mcbaror yayoboye umuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya, amashusho y'indirimbo ya J'odie, " "Kuchi Kuchi" (Oh Baby)".
Ku wa gatanu, tariki ya 10 Gashyantare 2017, yayoboye filime "Umugore wa Blogger", yasohotse muri sinema zo muri Nijeriya. Iyi filime yakozwe na Seun Oloketuyi, igaragaramo abakinnyi ba Nollywood ndetse nabakinnyi nka Segun Arinze, Adejumoke Aderounmu, Deyemi Okanlawon, Ijeoma Grace Agu na Adeniyi Johnson. Muri 2017, filime "Kada River " yakozwe na we yatorewe igihembo mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Nollywood ryabereye i Toronto, muri Kanada. Mu bihembo bya Golden Movie 2017, yatowe mu byiciro bitandatu, birimo: " "Filime Nziza" ", " "Umuyobozi mwiza" ", " "Sinema nziza" ", " "Umuyobozi w’ubuhanzi bwiza" ", ""Imyambarire myiza" ", " "Umwanditsi mwiza w’amajwi" ".
Muri Kanama 2018, filime yayoboye yise " Ikirwa " yahawe "Filime Nziza Nyafurika" na we ubwe, "Umuyobozi wa Nollywood Nziza" mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime mpuzamahanga rya Nollywood, TINFF, ryabereye i Toronto, muri Kanada. Muri Nzeri muri uwo mwaka, yayoboye filime, " Merry Men: The Real Yoruba Demons " ya Ayo Makun, umunyarwenya uzwi cyane wo muri Nijeriya. Yongeye gutorwa mu byiciro bya " "Cinematografi Nziza" " na " "Umuyobozi mwiza" " muri ZAFAA Global Awards, kubera filime ye, Lotanna 2017.
Muri 2019, yasohoye igikorwa cyicyaha cya TV cyitwa, "Paper Boat".
Mu ntangiriro za 2020, yayoboye filime ya mbere y’umwaka yitwa Lilian Afegbai "yise "Imirongo ibiri" ". Nyuma ku ya 22 Gashyantare mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru i Abuja, yatangaje ko hagiye gukorerwa filime nshya ye yise "Red Caravan", azayobora kandi afatanyirize hamwe, hamwe n’ikiguzi cya N61 miliyoni, kandi agomba kurasirwa muri Leta ya Kaduna. Filime yibanze ku gicuri kandi yashyizweho mu myaka ya 1880, mugihe ubucuruzi bwabacakara bwateye imbere kandi bugomba gukinishwa nabakinnyi nabakinnyi bagera kuri 600. Mu gihe cya Covid-19, McBaror yasohoye urubuga rwa firime ngufi zitwa, "The Chronicles", zigamije gukwirakwiza abaturage ku ndwara ya Coronavirus.
By 2021, we mbere kugerageza ku n'ikinya movie umusaruro, filimi yise "uhindishwa ubuzima Hano" yari trailer yayo mugaragaro kurekurwa mu Mutarama Star Afeez Oyetoro, Nancy Isime, Bimbo Ademoye ex Big Brother Naija (season 3) housemate Temidayo Adenibuyan bita Teddy A, Beverly Osu, na Mike Godson. Muri Gashyantare twabonye bwa mbere kuri Filime ya "Underbelly" ikinamo ibikorwa bya Nollywood nka Stan Nze, Femi Adebayo, Ali Nuhu, Maryam Booth na Kunle Coker.

Meg Otanwa (yavutse ku ya 14 Gashyantare) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Nigeriya kandi wahoze ari umunyamabanki. Yavuze ko akunda indimi kandi bivugwa ko avuga bitanu neza. Yatangiye gukinira Nollywood muri 2011 muri filime, "Nzatwara Amahirwe yanjye" kandi yari yagaragaye muri firime nka "1 Ukwakira" (2018), "Ojuju" (2014), "Kpians: Umunsi mukuru w'ubugingo" (2014) n'abandi benshi. Yabaye igicapo cyo mu Gushyingo 2006 cya Zen Magazine.
Otanwa ukomoka kuvuga karere Idoma ya Benue Leta, Nigeria, gukura igice mu Lagos. Akomoka mu muryango ufite abagore benshi kandi avuga indimi eshanu zirimo Icyongereza, Yoruba, Igifaransa, Hausa, ururimi rwe kavukire Idoma na Espagne. Yahawe impamyabumenyi muri kaminuza ya Ahmadu Bello, muri Zariya aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu rurimi rw'icyongereza, hanyuma akomeza kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no gucunga abakozi muri kaminuza ya TIME, Tuniziya, Tuniziya, nyuma yaho, aba Master of Business Administration impamyabumenyi muri kaminuza ya Jean Moulin, Lyon, mu Bufaransa.
Nyuma yakoze mu kiringo kirekire ku Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere, Tunis, Tunisia, Otanwa yeguye kandi atora umwuga mu gukora, gufata we Nollywood gukinira mu 2011, featuring mu kubyina drama film by Emem Isong, "I’ll Take My Chance". Muri 2014, yakinnye muri filime ya Kunle Afolayan, ku ya 1 Ukwakira ; mu rukurikirane rw'amakinamico ya Bodunrin Sasore, "Mbere ya 30", yakinnye nka "Aisha"; no muri firime ya Charles Novia ", Atlanta".
Yakinnye muri Afrika Magic 2016 ya mbere ya telenovela ", Hush" ya Nollywood, nka "Koko Ogunbiade". Hagaragaye kandi Richard Mofe Damijo, Thelma Okoduwa na Rotimi Adelegan.
Yahawe igihembo muri Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards 2017 kugirango abone "Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu" cyiciro cya Drama ndetse nigihembo cyo kumenyekanisha AMVCA kubera serivise y'umwimerere MNET yatsindiye, kubera uruhare yagize muri thriller telenovela, "Hush". Uyu mukinnyi w'amafilime kandi yari yitabiriye kuri tapi itukura y'ibirori bya 2018.
Muri filime ya Tosin Igho 2018 yise, "Eva", yakinnye nka "Yewande", akina nabakinnyi nabakinnyi nka Beverly Naya, Hauwa Allhabura, John Okafor nabandi.
Muri filime ya 2020, "Kuri Maria Ebun Pataki", iyobowe na Damilola Orimogunje, yakinnye nka "Derin".
Yari featured nk'uko "Angela" mu Dimeji Ajibola wa sci-fi thriller, "Ratnik", ngo kurekurwa Ukuboza 1, 2020 na featuring Osas Ighodaro, Karibi Fubara, Pawulo Utomi n'abandi.

Plan B ni filime yo gusetsa y’urukundo ya Kenya na Nigeriya yasohotse 2019 yanditswe, iyobowe kandi ikosorwa nuwakoze firime ya Nigeriya, Lowladee. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Kenya akaba na producer Sarah Hassan, Catherine Kamau Karanja, hamwe n’umukinnyi wa Nigeriya Daniel Etim Effiong bakinnye.
Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba muri Afurika ya Magic Viewers 'Choice Awards (AMVCAs).
Iyi filime yakozwe na Lowladee ku bufatanye na Alfajiri Productions, uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa muri Kenya.
Gutandukana na Ethan we (Lenana Kariba), Lisa Waweru (Sarah Hassan) yagiye kunywa mu kabari, ahahurira n'umugabo udasanzwe. Guhagarara ijoro rimwe hamwe n’umuntu utazi maze aratwita. Nyuma y'amezi atanu, umunyamurwango wacitse, Lisa, yamenye ko umugabo atwite ari umuyobozi mukuru wa Nigeriya muri Afrika yuburasirazuba akwirakwiza isosiyete ishingiye kuri Nairobi, Dele Coker (Daniel Etim Effiong). Kuruhande rwinshuti ye, Joyce (Catherine Kamau Karanja), gahunda nziza yageze kugirango Dele asabe inshingano zo gutwita. Iyi gahunda igomba rwose guhinduka ubuzima burambye kuri bose.
Filime yasohotse ku munsi w'abakundana, ku wa gatanu 14 Gashyantare 2019. Yerekanwe kuri NTV (Kenya) ijoro ryabanjirije gusohoka kwisi.

Africa Movie Academy Awards yo muri 2019. Ni ibirori byabaye ku cyumweru tariki ya 27 Ukwakira 2019 ijoro ritazibagirana kuri Event Centre muri muri Nigeria.
Ibirori byitabiriwe n'Abayobozi, Abakinnyi, n'Abanditsi ba filme. Iri joro ryo gutanga ibihembo ryayobowe na, na Funnybone, ni nyuma yo kwakira inyandiko zigera kuri 700 zatanzwe hagati y'itariki ya 21 Ukwakira 2018 na 26 Mutarama 2019.
Abateguye ibirori batangaje Abatoranijwe ku ya 19 Nzeri 2019. Filime nka na nizo zari ziyoboye izindi muri 13 zatanzwe mu cyiciro naho "The Burial Kojo" na "Redemption" byakurikiranye n'izindi 10. "" yatsindiye mu byiciro bitandukanye nka Best film, achievement in costume design no muri Achievement in makeup ndetse n'igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza. Filime ishingiye kuri politiki yitwa yatwaye ibihembo bitatu(3) muri iryo joro rimwe, harimo ibihembo by'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu nshingano zunganira (best actress in supporting role), umukinnyi wa filime mwiza, ndetse na filime nziza yo muri Nigeriya.

Iserukiramuco du Cinéma Africain de Khouribga (FCAK) cyangwa iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika i Khouribga ni iserukiramuco rya sinema nyafurika ryabereye i Khouribga muri Maroc. Ryashinzwe mu 1977, ni rimwe mu minsi mikuru ya firime ya kera kandi ikomeye muri Maroc.
Kuva mu 1967, club ya sinema yariho muri Khouribga, ifite abanyamuryango 200 bakora kandi berekanwa buri cyumweru. Mu 1977, iyobowe na Noureddine Saïl, ihuriro ry’igihugu ry’amafirime ya sinema muri Maroc (FNCCM) ryafashije gutunganya Rencontres Cinematographiques de Khouribga. Ikipe ya sinema yaho yemeje ko ikomeza kubaho. Kubera ko inganda zikomeye za Khouribga ari Ubucukuzi bwa fosifate, iyi club yabonye inkunga mu biro bya Fosifati. Iyobowe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga wa Sinema ya gatatu, club ya sinema yemeje ko iserukiramuco ryibanze kuri Afurika.
Inama ya gatatu ya Afurika ya Film ya Khouribga yabaye kuva ku ya 2–9 Mata 1988. Hateganijwe ingengo y’imari 900.000 (amafaranga 630.000), ubutumire bwahawe abenegihugu 100 n’abanyamahanga bagera kuri 30 baturutse mu bihugu by’abarabu, Uburayi na Afurika. Abaminisitiri bane ba guverinoma bitabiriye iryo funguro rikomeye, kandi abitabiriye nibura 50.000 bareba firime zo mu bihugu 14. Inama ya kane yabaye ku ya 17-24 Werurwe 1990. Inama ya gatandatu yabaye kuva ku ya 26 Werurwe kugeza ku ya 2 Mata 1994.
Kuva mu 2004 FCAK iyobowe na Fondasiyo, Nourddine Saïl aba Perezida na Lahoussaine N'douf nk'umuyobozi mukuru.

Amateka ya Sinema ya Botswana (cyangwa sinema muri Botswana) agizwe no gukora film mu gihugu cya Botswana muri Afrika yepfo, haba mbere na nyuma ya Botswana. Sinema ya Botswana ni imwe muri sinema nyinshi zo muri Afurika zirimo na sinema z'igihugu cya Bénin, Misiri, Kenya, Nijeriya na Afurika y'Epfo, n'ibindi.
Inganda za firime zaho muri Botswana ziswe "Botswood" na bamwe, bisa nuburyo uruganda rwamafirime rwitwa "Bollywood ", umunya Nigeriya " Nollywood ", naho umunyamerika " Hollywood ".
Nk’uko umuhanga mu by'amateka Neil Parsons abivuga, kopi ya mbere izwiho kurokoka ya firime yanditswe muri Botswana guhera mu 1906 na 1907. Ku bwe, isosiyete ikorera mu mujyi wa Londere mu Bwongereza ifitwe n’umugabo witwa Charlie Urban yohereje kamera kugira ngo bafate amashusho yerekeranye n’urugendo rwa gari ya moshi ya Bechuanaland i Victoria Falls, urugendo rwa gari ya moshi rwanyuze mu karere k’igihugu cya Botswana muri iki gihe. Umunyamerika witwa Rudolf Pöch ukomoka muri Otirishiya yaje kuza akora urukurikirane rwa firime ngufi mu gihugu cya Afurika, cyarimo amajwi n'amabara kandi kigaragaza umusaza w'imyaka mirongo itandatu, Kubi. Parsons yafataga Kubi "umustar wa mbere wa Botswana".
Mu 1912, Umunyamerika uzwi ku izina rya W. Butcher yabonye uruhushya rwo kujya mu burasirazuba bwa Botswana gufata amashusho y'urugendo rw'abasirikare ba Bangwato; ibi byabereye mu mujyi wa Serowe. Kuva mu Ntambara ya Mbere y'Isi Yose kugeza mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, ibihangano bya firime bya Botswana byiganjemo documentaire zivuga ku baturage bo mu karere ka Botswana y'iburengerazuba ndetse n'amakuru yerekeye ibintu bibera mu burasirazuba.
Bivugwa ko, Umukinnyi wa mbere wa Filime ukomoka muri Botswana yari umugabo witwa Molefi Pilane, umuturage waho, umutware w’amoko bivugwa ko yanditse abagore boga bakoresheje kamera ntoya. Umugore uzwi ku izina rya "Miss Muichison" yafashe amashusho yerekana amasaha agera kuri abiri, asobanura imikorere ya African Auxiliary Pioneers Corps ; ibice bibiri bizwi ko bizarokoka naho icya gatatu gikekwa ko kiriho muri Botswana.
Filime yitwa Bechuanaland Protectorate yakozwe mu gihe cy'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose kandi ikaba ifitanye isano n'abasirikare ba APC basubiye mu rugo baturutse muri Afurika y'Amajyaruguru nyuma yo gutsinda urugendo rwo gusubira muri Botswana. Muri firime hagaragaramo umutware wimiryango Bathoen II.
Umukinnyi wa firime muri Afurika y'Epfo, Bill Lewis yaje mu karere ka Botswana mu 1947 gufata amashusho y’uruzinduko rwa cyami mu murima abasirikare ba APC bari. Umunyamerika Tom Larson nawe yaje mu mpera za 1940; yafashe amashusho ya documentaire ebyiri, imwe yiswe " Abakora imvura ya Okavango " yasohotse mu 1948.
Umunyapolitiki waho, uzaba Perezida wa mbere wa Botswana Seretse Khama Umwirabura, yashakanye na Ruth Williams Khama, Umuzungu ukomoka mu Bwongereza, mu 1948, bituma Botswana yitabwaho n’amahanga kubera amategeko ya Apartheid yo mu karere; ibi byatumye amasosiyete menshi atunganya firime akora movietone reels kubashakanye. Ibigo byafashe amashusho biranga Paramount Pictures hamwe namakuru yisi yose. Filime zerekeye aba couple zakomeje gukorwa neza nyuma yo kuva muri Botswana gutura mubuhungiro.
1953 yabonye umusaruro " Remmants mu isiganwa badapfuye ", yakozwe na Molepolole utuye Louis Knobel, a White umuntu wakoraga kuko Afurika y'Epfo Serivisi z'amakuru. Iyi filime irambuye ubuzima bwabaturage ba San batuye mubutayu bwa Kalahari, burimo igice cya Botswana. Yakozwe munsi yizina rya "Kalahari Films" kandi imara iminota 17.
" Abahigi ", filime yo mu 1957 yakozwe n’umunyamerika John Marshall na yo yerekanaga ku bantu batuye i Kalahari, kimwe n’ikiganiro cya BBC, " Isi Yatakaye ya Kalahari ", cyerekanwe naLaurens van der Post wakiriye Afurika y'Epfo.
Igitaramo cyo muri Amerika " Mugenzi wa Omaha's Wild Kingdom " nacyo cyaje gukina amashusho hirya no hino muri Botswana mu myaka ya za 1960.
Botswana yabonye ubwigenge mu 1966, izana impinduka muri politiki, imibereho myiza n’umuco muri ako karere, harimo n’uburyo amafilime yakozwe ndetse akanatezwa imbere mu gihugu gishya cya Afurika.
Mu 1980, John Marshall yafashe amashusho yandi mashusho menshi ya Botswana ajyanye na Botswana, " Nǃai, Inkuru y Umugore wumugore ", kubyerekeye urugamba rwa a ! Umugore wa Kung, N! Ai, washakanye ku gahato afite imyaka umunani n'umuvuzi wimiryango.
Urwenya rwo mu 1981, "The Gods Must Be Crazy " rwashyizwe muri Botswana maze ruba icyamamare mpuzamahanga; ryakwirakwije umwe mu bakozi batatu ndetse n’ibice bitatu bitemewe: 1988 " The Gods Must Be Crazy II " nayo yakunzwe cyane, filime zombi zituma umukinnyi wa Namibiya Nǃxau ǂToma azwi cyane muri firime, naho " Crazy Safari " yo mu 1991 niyo yambere mubikurikiranye bitatu bitemewe. byakozwe na societe ya firime ikorera muri Hong Kong yitwa Orange Sky Golden Harvest, nayo yakinnye na Nǃxau ǂToma. Abandi bombi ba nyuma, "Umusazi muri Hong Kong" (1993) na "Imana igomba gusetsa mubushinwa" (1995) ntabwo bafatiwe amashusho muri Botswana.
2000 yakozwe na Disney""Whispers: An Elephant's Tale " yafatiwe amashusho muri Botswana, yakinwe na Angela Bassett wamamaye muri Hollywood. Nyuma yaho, muri 2009, muri Botswana ibice bya firime ya M. Saravanan yo mu rurimi rwa Tamil, " Ayan (film) " byafashwe amajwi.
"Ubwongereza " bwamamaye cyane, buvuga ku nkuru y'urukundo nyarwo rwa Seretse Khama na Ruth Williams, yafashwe amashusho igice hagati ya Botswana na London, Ubwongereza maze isohoka ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu 2016.
Amasosiyete ya sinema.
Botswana ifite amasosiyete menshi ya sinema na sinema, harimo na New Capitol Cinemas na Gaborone Cine Centre.

Gloria kamanzi uwizera.
Gloria kamanzi uwizera ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari we washinze Glo creations Ltd ndetse akaba n'umunyamuryango wa Women Entrepreneurship programme(AWEP Rwanda).
Gloria kamanzi uwizera yatangije Glo creations Ltd muri 2008 iherereye mu Kiyovu, aho akora imyambaro n'imitako yo mu nzu. Yifashisha batik akaba ari uburyo akoresha akora ibihangano bye akoresheje amaboko.

Motlatsi Mafatshe (wavutse 1984), ni umukinnyi wa filimi n'umucuranzi wa Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime zizwi cyane za "Leta" "yihohoterwa", Sokhulu na "Partners II" na "Zama Zama". Usibye gukina, ni n'umucuranzi uzwi cyane wakoze inshuro zirenga 400.

Yashakanye na Millicent Nkangane, umunyamideli kuva mu Gushyingo 2014. Bahuriye bwa mbere mu rusengero.
Yakinnye 'Sechaba' ku isabune izwi cyane ya SABC 3 "Isidingo" muri 2010. Amaze gukina imyaka irenga icyenda, yaje kwinjira kumugaragaro mu itsinda ryayobora iki gitaramo muri 2018. Muri 2019, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu bakinnyi ba mbere muri Royalty Soapie Awards.
Yakinnye kandi nka 'Wandile Dhlomo' mu ikinamico y'umupira w'amaguru "Shooting Stars". Hanyuma yagaragaye afite uruhare 'Casper' murukurikirane "Iyo Twari Umwirabura". Muri 2018, yafatanije gukora romcom "Love Lives Here".

Mkhulu Malusi Manqoba Skenjana (yavutse 6 Mata 1982), uzwi Khulu Skenjana, ni umukinnyi wa Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri televiziyo izwi cyane ya "Machine Gun Preacher", "Zulu" na "Zama Zama".

Yashakanye na mugenzi we bakina filime Mona Monyane. Bashakanye muri 2016 bamarana imyaka ine hamwe nabana babiri. Umwana we wa kabiri Amani-Amaza Wamazulu Skenjana yavutse ku ya 16 Ugushyingo 2017 apfa nyuma y'iminsi irindwi avutse. Umukobwa we w'imfura ni Ase-Ahadi Lesemole Mamphai Skenjana wavutse muri Kanama 2016.

Maze mu 2010, we yagize uruhare 'Dawidi Tabane' mu "biganiro yimije Game." Hagati aho, yagaragaye afite uruhare rwa 'Thomas' mu rukurikirane rwa "Hola Mpinji". Yagaragaye kandi muri "serivise nyinshi zizwi nka" "Sokhulu &amp; Partners", "Rhythm City", "Hola Mpinji", "A Place Called Home" and "Jozi-H".

Louw Venter (yavutse ku ya 16 Kanama 1975), ni Umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Afurika yepfo akaba n'umukinnyi wa firime. "Azwi cyane mubuyobozi" bwe no kwandika muri firime zizwi cyane "Igiti", Konfetti na "Swartwater".
Yavutse ku ya 16 Kanama 1975 i Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Mu 2001, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime na "Final Solution" aho yagize uruhare ruto nk 'umunyamuryango wa Paramilitary. Mu 2002, yakinnye 'Marco' muri filime yo mu Butaliyani "The Piano Player" iyobowe na Jean-Pierre Roux. Mu 2003, yakinnye muri firime ebyiri: "Adrenaline" na "Citizen Verdict".
Usibye gukina, ni n'umwanditsi w'inyandiko wanditse filime yatsindiye ibihembo bya "Konfetti" yayobowe na Zaheer Goodman-Bhyat. Usibye ibyo, yari umwanditsi wa "serivise za tereviziyo: Rugby Motors" na "Vinkel &amp; Koljander". Muri 2015, yerekanwe bwa mbere na firime ngufi "Leemte". Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa firime, yakoze televiziyo "Vinkel &amp; Koljander" muri 2016. Muri 2016, yamenyekanye cyane muri firime "Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu", yari ishingiye ku nkuru y'impamo. Muri filime, yakinnye uruhare rwa 'Van Heerden'. Filime yagenze neza kandi itangwa mubirori byinshi bya firime.
Venter yakoze kandi urwenya hamwe na mugenzi we wo gusetsa muri Afurika yepfo Rob Van Vuuren. Bombi bagaragaye nk'abantu bavugwa Corne (Venter) na Twakkie (Van Vuuren) murukurikirane rwa videwo ya YouTube na gahunda yitwa "The Amazing Show". Venter yakinnye kandi murumuna wa Van Vuuren muri comedi ya "Van der Merwe" muri 2017.
Muri 2020, yayoboye kandi yandika filime ye ya mbere yitwa "Stam" yasohotse kuri BoxOffice ya DStv mu Kwakira. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi yose mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Durban muri Nzeri 2020. Yerekanwe kandi muri 18 ya Tofifest International Film Festival 2020 muri Polonye. Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Afurika yepfo mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Durban 2020 (DIFF).

Thabo Andrew Rametsi II (yavutse 17 Nyakanga 1988), azwi nka Thabo Rametsi, ni umukinnyi wa firime na producer muri Afurika y'Epfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serial zizwi cyane"The Giver", "The Gamechangers" and "Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu"

Icyakora, yahawe ibihembo bibiri byumukinnyi witwaye neza mu Isabune ya TV yakuye muri South African Film and Television Awards (SAFTA) muri 2014 na 2015 kubera uruhare. Muri icyo gihe, yahawe igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza muri DStv Mzansi Magic Viewers Choice Award. Nyuma ya "Scandal!", yagaragaye muri saison ebyiri za "serivise za" tereviziyo ya Thola kuri televiziyo SABC2. Hanyuma yakinnye nka 'Celia' murukurikirane rwo "Gusarura". Nyuma yaho asubira biganiro hanyuma Inyuguti yarashwe bapfuye, gufata Mbangeni wa gusohoka kabiri mu kwerekana.
