Yavutse ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 1978 i Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yashakanye na Mandla Khumalo. Abashakanye bafite umukobwa umwe n'umuhungu umwe.
Muri 2019, yarwaye lymph node yabyimbye muri tiroyide. Kugira ngo avurwe, yatewe inshinge za karuboni ya dioxyde de puffness mu jisho.
Igihe yari afite imyaka ine, ababyeyi be bamwandikishije mu ishuri ryo kubyina nyuma yo kubona ko akunda kubyina kandi yitabira amarushanwa yo kubyina yo muri Amerika y'Epfo na Ballroom. Afite imyaka itanu, yatsindiye amarushanwa ye ya mbere muri shampiyona yintara kubyina Ballroom ndetse nimbyino zo muri Amerika y'Epfo. Afite imyaka umunani, yize mu ishuri ry’imbyino kandi yiga kubyina iyobowe n’umukorikori uzwi cyane witwa Debby Turner, wabaye umujyanama n’umuyobozi. Nyuma yaje kwinjira mu ishuri ry’imbyino rya North West Arts Council aho yagize amahirwe yo kuba umwarimu mu myaka yashize. Igihe yari afite imyaka 19, yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya FNB Vita.
Nyuma yaje kwifatanya numuyoboro wa SABC2 ahinduka Travel Xplorer. Muri kiriya gihe, yatumiriwe gukina 'Cindi' muri filime "Hey Boy" iyobowe na Andre Odendaal yerekanwe mu 2003. Muri 2008, yagizwe umwe mu bacamanza mu marushanwa yo kubyina, "Dans!" "Dans!" "Dans!" byerekanwe kuri ykNET. Mu mwaka wa 2008, yabaye umucuranzi wa koreografi n'umucamanza mu marushanwa nyayo, 'High School Musical: Spotlight Africa yepfo' yanyuze kuri M-Net.
Muri 2017, yakinnye muri Mzansi Magic show, "Lockdown" afite uruhare rwa 'Tyson' muri saison yayo ya kane. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye 'Marang' muri firime ya "Zulu". Muri Werurwe 2019, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi muri SAFTA ibihembo kubera uruhare rwe muri "Lockdown 2". Muri Nzeri 2020, yagaragaye mu ikinamico ya Mzansi "Abakozi bo mu rugo" afite uruhare 'Mkhonto'.

Jarrid Geduld (yavutse 13 Mutarama 1990), ni umukinnyi wa firime murim Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri filime zizwi cyane "10,000 BC", "Ellen: Die storie van Ellen Pakkies" and "Boy Called Twist"."t".
Yavutse ku ya 13 Mutarama 1990 muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Mu 2004, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime hamwe na "Boy Boy Yitwa Twist" kandi akina nk'umuhanzi wumwana. Hanyuma muri 2005, yagaragaye muri firime ebyiri: "Icyumba cya Flyer" na "Interrogation". Muri 2013, yatorewe igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi muri Afurika y'Epfo mu bihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo byo muri Afurika y'Epfo kubera uruhare yagize muri filime "Lucky Man"..
Muri 2018, yakinnye nka 'Abie Pakkies' muri film "Ellen: Die storie van Ellen Pakkies". Filime yabaye iyamamare kandi yakiriwe neza. Muri 2018, yahawe igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Silwerskerm kubera uruhare rwe. Noneho muri 2019, mu bihembo bya Filime na Televiziyo byo muri Afurika yepfo, yatsindiye igihembo cya SAFTA Golden Horn igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza muri Filime Yerekana uruhare yagize muri iyi film. Muri uwo mwaka, yatsindiye igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu nshingano zunganira muri 15th Africa Movie Academy Awards.

Colin 'Cole' Moss (yavutse 9 Gashyantare 1976), ni umukinnnyi wa firime muri Afurika y'Epfo ahanini ugaragara mu Bwongereza, Amerika na Afurika y'Epfo cinema na televiziyo.
Yavutse ku ya 9 Gashyantare 1976 i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Ise Richard Moss ni umwongereza-Afurika yepfo aho sekuru yari isake. Nyina Veronica Salt yari afite amateka ya Irilande. Kubwibyo, Colin yavutse afite imico ivanze yabongereza, Irilande, Abadage na Afrika yepfo. Yatsinze ukulele na saxofone ikina.
Yashakanye n'umuyobozi wa Afrika yepfo, Tamarin Kaplan. Ubukwe bwizihijwe muri 2014 muri Stellenbosch.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina nkumunyarwenya uhagaze kuri Afrika yepfo yihagararaho. Yakomeje gukora urwenya hagati yimyidagaduro yo gukina imyaka myinshi. Nyuma yaje kurangiza impamyabumenyi yikinamico muri kaminuza ya Kwazulu-Natal mu 1996. Yatangiye gukina binyuze mu bitaramo bimwe na bimwe nka "Fat Pig" na "My Zinc Bed". Mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 90, yakinnye buri gihe na gahunda ye ya stage nk'umunyarwenya muri Afurika y'Epfo ndetse no mu minsi mikuru itandukanye yo gusetsa. a. no mu Bwongereza na Irilande. Muyindi nzira yumwuga we, Moss yakomeje gukora nkurwenya. Kuva mu 2003 umuyobozi w'itsinda risetsa 'Comedy All Stars Cape Town' muri Cape Town. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakoze porogaramu ye yo gusetsa muri Stand Up Comedy Club mu mujyi wa New York.
Mu 1998, yerekanwe bwa mbere kuri tereviziyo na televiziyo "Isidingo" aho yakinnye nka 'Stewart Buller'. Yagaragaye muri uruhererekane kuva 1999 kugeza 2001 akunzwe cyane. Hanyuma yagiye i Cape Town, akora akazi ko gutanga ibiganiro kuri tereviziyo zitandukanye, harimo na TV "Life City" 2001. Mu 2002, yabaye umunyamakuru wa stunt show "Fear Factor". Muri 2003, 2005 na 2007 yafashe icyemezo cyo kwerekana imiziki nimpano ya 'Idols South Africa' in season 3
Mu 2005, Moss yagize ijyana gabo uruhare mu ikinamico y'Epfo "Number 10." Uyu yakinnye muri Afurika yepfo Horror "Cryptid" mu 2006 yafashe umwanya wa Mioss Dan Huevelman. Mu 2007, yinjiye muri filime yo gusetsa yo muri Afurika yepfo "Big Fellas" akina kimwe mu bintu bibiri by'ingenzi; 'umusore Jake Holmes'. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri filime "yihishe" y'Abongereza n'Afurika y'Epfo aho yakinnye nka 'Officer De Witt'. Muri 2008, yagize uruhare runini nka 'John' muri comediyo y'Ubutaliyani n'Abafaransa "Ex". Hanyuma yakinnye umukinnyi wa firime hamwe numunyamurwango 'Dexter "Dex" Simms' muri firime iteye ubwoba "Surviving Evil" muri 2009.
Bitewe nuburengerazuba bwe, yahisemo gukina amafilime mpuzamahanga nka: 'Ofisiye DeWitt' mu ikinamico "The World Unseen". Filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana ibihembo byinshi mpuzamahanga. Nyuma yaje kugira uruhare runini muri film "Surviving Evil" aho yakinnye na Billy Zane. Yakinnye kandi nka 'Max' mu guhuza BBC na DH Lawrence's "Women in Love". Moss yakinnye nka 'Kevin Fuller' muri filime "Momentum ari" kumwe na James Purefoy na Morgan Freeman.
Muri Werurwe 2014, yagaragaye muri filime ya televiziyo ya ZDF "Elly Beinhorn". Muri 2015, yimukiye mu mujyi wa New York ahita asinywa na The Talent House. Nyuma yibyo, yakinnye inshuro nyinshi 'Justin Boden' kuri Marvel yakunzwe cyane na Netflix, "Jessica Jones". Hanyuma yakinnye nka 'Anthony' muri "Black Mirror" ya Netflix ndetse no muri seriveri ya David Simon yitwa "Deuce". Hagati aho, yagize uruhare runini muri filime "Hanyuma Yaje Nawe" hamwe n 'uruhare rwa' Drew Conrad 'muri filime "Noheri mu gasozi".

Make Room ni firime yo mu rurimi rwa Hausa yo muri Nigeriya 2018 yerekana isano iri hagati yurukundo no gukurikirana inzozi imbere yiterabwoba, iyobowe na Robert Peters kandi yakozwe na Rogers Ofime. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo abakinnyi n’abakinnyi ba Kannywood nka Yakubu Muhammed, Sani Muazu, Rekiya Attah na Usman Uzee, bashyigikiwe na Adams Garba, Asabe Madake, Abba Zakky na Abubakar Maina.
Iyi filime yakozwe ishingiye ku bikorwa by'inyeshyamba mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Nijeriya yagaragayemo abakinnyi bagera ku 3.000, abakinnyi 100 hamwe n'abakozi 100 batunganya, naho aho bakorewe ni Ijebu - Miango, Agace k'ubutegetsi bwa Bassa, muri Leta ya Plateau, muri Nijeriya. Umusaruro watwaye iminsi igera kuri 50 kugirango urangire, bitwara igereranyo cya N200 kugeza kuri miliyoni 300 nkingengo yumusaruro.
Nyuma yo gushimutwa hamwe nabandi bakobwa 245 bo mwishuri rye, umusore mwiza Salma (Asabe Madaki), umwana wenyine wababyeyi be bafite imyaka 17 nabandi bakorewe kubana nabaterabwoba mukigo cyabo. Ibi byamuviriyemo guhungabanya inzozi ze ariko we, nubwo, uko ibintu bimeze ubu yagumye mubyukuri mubuzima bwe. Goni, umwe mu nyeshyamba, araza maze bombi bakundana bidatinze barashyingirwa. Mugihe ubuzima bugoye, hamwe no kwamburwa urupfu numubabaro, inyeshyamba nabakunzi babo bidatinze.

Made in Heaven ni filime yikinamico yo muri Nijeriya yo muri 2019 iyobowe na Toka McBaror ikorwa na Darlington Abuda. Ibiranga Nollywood's Richard Mofe Damijo, Jide Kosoko, and Nancy Isime, Ayo Makun, Toyin Abraham, Blossom Chukwujekwu, Lasisi Elenu, former Big Brother Naija housemate - Kemen, n'abandi. Filime yerekana abantu nyamukuru bashakisha ubufasha bwumwuka mubuzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.
Nyuma yo kubona ko umukunzi we amushuka hamwe ninshuti, isoni Richard yamusize inyuma yangwa muri club gusa ahura na Angela bahuye nkibyo. Muri iryo joro nyene, barapfuye hanyuma ku murongo uja ku Irembo ry'Urubanza, Angela asabwa gusubira ku Isi. Richard yahise ashakisha inzira aratoroka kurwanira urukundo rwa Angela, nubwo bibujijwe na malayika murinzi woherejwe nyuma ye hamwe nabadayimoni kugirango atazigera atsindira urukundo rwe muminsi irindwi, kunanirwa bikaba byaviramo ubugingo bwe gucirwaho iteka.
Filime yakozwe na Peekaboo Consulting Limited. Yakoranye na Newlink Entertainment Limited, NewOhens Limited na Corporate World Entertainment Limited.
Iyi filime yemejwe ko izasohoka mu mpeshyi ya 2019. Yerekanwe ku cyumweru, tariki ya 15 Nzeri 2019 muri IMAX Theatre, Lekki, Lagos, Nijeriya.

Kevin Chuwang Pam (wavutse 1982) niwe wegukanye igihembwe cya 4 cya Big Brother Africa muri 2009. Afite Impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor mu Cyongereza yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Jos
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Chuwang yavutse 1982 akurira i Dogon Dutse, mu nkengero za Jos, umurwa mukuru wa Leta ya Plateau muri Belt Hagati ya Nijeriya. Afite barumuna be barindwi.
Chuwang mu ntangiriro za 2006 ubwo yakoraga muri gahunda y’igihugu ishinzwe ibikorwa by’urubyiruko i Lagos, yitabiriye "The Next Movie Star", ikiganiro cya TV cyo muri Nigeriya cyatewe inkunga na Haier Thermocool aho yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri. Mu cyagombaga kumuzana ku itara ryagutse, yinjiye mu irushanwa rya Big Brother Africa (season 4) hanyuma amaze gutsinda abandi 24 bahataniraga baturutse mu bihugu 14 bya Afurika bagaragara ko batsinze, batwara igihembo cy’amadorari 200.000 ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2009. Se yari kumwe na we mu birori byo gusoza muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Muri Nyakanga 2012, "View Point Nijeriya" yatangaje ko uwatsinze Big Brother Africa (BBA) 2009 ku wa gatanu tariki ya 12 Nyakanga 2013 i Jos yatangije igitaramo gishya cya muzika cyo guhiga televiziyo munsi y’imyidagaduro, "Down to Earth Projects Ltd", ikigo cye, tagged "Jos Uzane", aho 20 batoranijwe bitabiriye ahantu hamwe mumujyi wa Jos guhatanira igihembo cya N500.000.
Ni umuyobozi mukuru wa "Down2Earth Entertainment" hamwe na "Naija Pikin", umuryango utegamiye kuri leta yashinze. Akora kandi ubujyanama bwimyidagaduro.
Chuwang yashakanye na Elizabeth "Liz" Gupta, mugenzi we babana mu rugo bahuye mu 2009 mu nzu mberabyombi ya Big Brother Africa Revolution kuva mu 2011. Akomoka muri Tanzaniya kandi se wapfuye yari Umuhinde. Ubukwe bwabaye ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2011 i Abuja, muri Nijeriya. Abashakanye bafite umukobwa witwa Malika Savannah.
Muri 2015, yasobanuriye "Encomium Weekly" umuryango we wimukiye i Jos.
Muri Gicurasi 2016, Chuwang n'umugore we hamwe n'abahoze bitabira ikiganiro nyacyo cya Big Brother Africa, Uti Nwachukwu na Nkenna Iwuagwu bitabiriye ubukwe bw'undi mugenzi we, Geraldine Iheme i Lagos.

Katung Aduwak (wavutse ku ya 21 Werurwe 1980) niwe wegukanye ibihembo bya mbere bya Big Brother Nigeriya kuri televiziyo byerekanwe hagati ya 5 Werurwe na 4 Kamena 2006. Akomoka muri Zonkwa, muri Leta ya Kaduna, muri Nijeriya kandi ni umwanditsi, umwanditsi kandi umuyobozi kimwe nuwarangije siyanse ya politiki. Yigeze kuba umunyamakuru mu ihuriro ry’ishuri ry’ubucuruzi rya Harvard kandi akora imyaka myinshi nk'umuyobozi mukuru wa MTV Base, Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe guhanga udushya muri VIACOM International akaba n’umuyobozi mukuru muri Chocolate City. Kugeza ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru wa One O Eight Media hamwe nabafatanyabikorwa ba Afrika muri Campfire Media.
"Big Brother Nigeriya".
Aduwak w'imyaka 26 y'amavuko niwe wegukanye intsinzi muri ibyo birori byakiriwe na Michelle Dede na Olisa Adibua, shampiyona yambere cyane ku ya 4 Kamena 2006 hamwe nigihembo cyamadorari 100.000. Nyuma yimyaka 11, yatangaje ko urufunguzo rwo gutsinda muri iki gitaramo ari we kuri we, mu kuba wenyine ndetse no kuba ingamba.
Nyuma ya "Big Brother Nigeriya".
Nyuma yikiganiro nyacyo kuri TV, Aduwak yerekeje i New York kugirango akomeze amashuri ye muri Digital Film Academy, arangiza impamyabumenyi yubuyobozi maze ajya gukina film.
Icyagombaga kuba filime ya mbere ya Aduwak ni"Heaven's Hell". Itariki yo gusohora nyirizina yari iteganijwe ku ya 23 Mutarama 2015. Iyi filime ariko ntiyasohotse kugeza ku ya 10 Gicurasi 2019. Amashusho ya firime yafashwe mu mwaka wa 2012 na One O Eight Media, afatanya na BGL na Hashtag Media House kandi bakinamo abakinnyi n’abakinnyi ba Nollywood ndetse n’umuhanzi Waje wo muri Nijeriya.
Muri 2020, Aduwak yayoboye film ngufi yerekana amakimbirane hagati yabanyamerika nya diaspora nyafurika, yise "Ntibikekwa ko Hano".
Aduwak yashakanye na Raven Taylor-Aduwak kandi afite umuhungu.

Kada River ni filime yikinamico yo muri Nigeriya yo muri 2017 iyobowe na Toka McBaror ari nawe wayifatanije na Forinclay Ejeh hamwe nubuyobozi bwakozwe na Olakunle Churchill. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo abakinnyi ba Nollywood n'abakinnyi nka Joke Silva, Keppy Ekpenyong, Rachel Oniga and Bayray McNwizu. Abandi barimo uwahoze ari murugo muri Big Brother Naija 2017 - TBoss (Tokunbo Badmus), Umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Gana - Fella Makafui, Chris Okagbue, James Blessing, Rakiya Attah and Oluchi Madubuko. Iyi filime ni epic yerekana ibibazo byugarije Leta ya Kaduna, inyito ikaba irindi zina ry'Umugezi wa Kaduna.
Iyi filime yafatiwe hafi ya Kafanchan na Kagoro, ahabereye ubuzima nyabwo bwabereye ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2000 nkuko byavuzwe n'umuyobozi. Umusaruro wacyo watewe inkunga na Big Church Foundation.
Iyi filime yerekana ubushyamirane bwa kera hagati ya Boduas na Shawlains, bwarangije imvururu zikaze kandi ziva amaraso, hagati aho abakunzi babiri bato, Jerome (Chris Okagbue) na Nadia (Fella Makafui), baharanira gufasha guhindura urwango rukabije. kurera hagati y'amoko yabo.
Iyi filime yerekanwe ku zindi filime icyenda mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Nollywood, ryabereye muri salle ya kaminuza ya Toronto, Toronto, Kanada. Nibwo filime yatangije ku nshuro ya mbere y'ibirori byabereye muri Imagine Cinemas no mu kigo cy’ibirori byabereye i Toronto hagati ya 12 - 16 Nzeri 2017.

Girley Charlene Jazama ni umukinnyi wa filime wa Namibiya, umwanditsi w'amafilime akaba na producer wa firime.
Umwuga wa Jazama wamafirime namakinamico watangiye kuva muri 2005. Yabaye Namibiya wa kabiri watowe muri "Sotigui Awards", nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza, nyuma ya Adriano Visagie wari watowe mbere kubera igitaramo cye muri " "Salute!" ", Aratsinda.
Yagaragaye cyane mu bakinnyi bari muri ""The Lion King" ", mu gihe yari yarize mu ishuri ryigenga rya Karibib.
Yakoranye umwete ku bufatanye na Pan-African Festival ya Sinema na Televiziyo ya Ouagadougou, mu rwego rwo kumenyekanisha impano mu gukina sinema nyafurika na diaspora.
Mu mwaka wa 2008, yari umwe mu banditsi barindwi batoranijwe na sosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa, Optimedia, kugira ngo yandike isabune nshya yise "Amasano ahuza", ku kigo cya Namibia Broadcasting Corporation. Uyu musaruro wabaye televiziyo ya mbere ya Namibiya.
Mu 2009, yakinnye nka "Schülerin" muri filime yo mu kidage ", "Liebe, Babys und der Zauber Afrikas" ".
Jazama yari umukinnyi wa mbere muri firime ya 2019, " "Umurongo Wera" " aho yakinnye nka "Sylvia". Muri Nyakanga 2019, iyi filime yerekanwe ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu iserukiramuco rya sinema mpuzamahanga rya 40 rya Durban ndetse no mu yandi maserukiramuco menshi ya firime ku isi.
Filime ye ya 2019 yiminota 29, "Baxu and the Giants" yakoranye na Andrew Botelle kandi iyobowe na Florian Schott, yizihijwe ninganda za firime za Namibiya nka firime ya mbere ya Namibiya kuri Netflix. Muri Werurwe 2020, iyi filime yatowe mu "iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi RapidLion ryabereye" i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo igihembo cya "Filime Nziza Nziza". Nyuma yerekanwe muri Amerika mu "iserukiramuco rya sinema ryigenga rya San Francisco" hanyuma nyuma muri Nzeri muri uwo mwaka muri "Namibian Theatre &amp; Film Awards 2019", aho yakiriye nomination zirindwi. Nanone, filime yakiriye izindi nomination n'ibihembo.

Daniel Etim Effiong, nawe Daniel Etim-Effiong numukinnyi wa filimi muri Nollywood wo muri Nigeriya akaba numuyobozi wa film.
Yavukiye i Jaji, muri Leta ya Kaduna, muri Nijeriya kandi yari atuye mu Benin City, Edo State; Lagos State and Abujaa. Papa we yari mu ngabo za Nigeriya. Se, wahoze ari Lt Col. Moses Effiong yahawe imbabazi ku mwanya wa perezida na perezida wa Nijeriya Muhammadu Buhari ari kumwe n'abandi batanu bakatiwe igifungo cya burundu mu 1986 nyuma y’uko bivugwa ko byatsinzwe na Vatsa Coup ku butegetsi bwa Ibrahim Babangida bakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo guhisha ubutegetsi maze bakarekurwa mu 1993 ariko nta gutangaza ku mugaragaro kandi kugarura urwego nuburenganzira.
Mu myaka ye y'ubuto, yize mu ishuri ryigenga ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Mariya, Ikirwa cya Lagos, Lagos nyuma aza gukomeza amashuri yisumbuye muri kaminuza ya Leta, Ikorodu, Lagos. Nyuma yaho, yerekeje muri Kaminuza nkuru y’ikoranabuhanga, Minna, muri Leta ya Nigeriya, aho yize kandi abona impamyabumenyi ya mbere mu bijyanye n’imashini. Nyuma yigihe gito cyakazi mu nganda za peteroli na gaze nka injeniyeri, yahisemo guhindura imyuga maze atangira kwiga ibijyanye no gutunganya amafilime, kwandika no kuyobora mu ishuri ry’amafirime rya AFDA muri Afurika yepfo nyuma akurikira amasomo muri kaminuza ya Johannesburg mu bijyanye no gukina amashusho.
Amaze kureka akazi ka peteroli na gaze, yabaye progaramu ya NdaniTV.

Yagaragaye muri 2019 na "Bland2Glam" muri gahunda ye #Powerof7 yo kwizihiza imyaka irindwi akora mu bucuruzi bw'imyambarire.
Yagaragaye ari kumwe n'abakinnyi ba filime bo muri Kenya Sarah Hassan na Catherine Kamau Karanja muri filime isetsa ya 2019, "Plan B" aho yakinnye nk'umuyobozi mukuru wa Nigeriya w'ikigo gishingiye ku mujyi wa Nairobi, Dele Coker. Yagaragaye ari kumwe na Ike Onyema na Atteh 'SirDee' Daniel muri filime ngufi, " "Umuyaga" ", yakozwe na Diane Russet kandi iyobowe na Michael 'AMA zaburi' Akinrogunde. Anita Ukah (yavutse 14 Kanama 1995) ni umukinnyi wa firime akaba n'umunyamideli muri Nigeria rwiyemezamirimo na Miss titleholder wari ikamba nk'uko wegukanye muri 2018 nk'Umukobwa mwiza cyane muri Nijeriya. Yambitse ikamba ry'umusimbura wa MBGN Umwamikazi Nyekachi Douglas muri 2019. Yaserukiye Nigeriya mu marushanwa ya Miss World 2018 yabaye ku ya 8 Ukuboza 2018 kuri Sanya City Arena i Sanya mu Bushinwa, aho yaje muri Top 30 mu marushanwa ya Miss World.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ukah akomoka muri leta ya Imo kandi akomoka mu muryango w'abantu barindwi.
Ukah ni umuhanga muri laboratoire yubuvuzi wize muri kaminuza ya Igbenedion, Okada arangiza muri 2016.
Amarushanwa ya mbere ya Anita yari muri kaminuza ye aho yatsindiye irushanwa rya Miss Igbinedion University Okada (IUO) mu 2014. Muri 2018, Ukah yaserukiye leta ya Imo kumukobwa mwiza muri Nigeriya 2018. Kuri finale ikomeye yabereye muri Okara Cultural Centre i Yenagoa, Bayelsa, Yambitswe ikamba ryumukobwa mwiza muri Nijeriya.
furikaUkah uzwiho kuzamura ibicuruzwa byakorewe mu karere muri 2019, yashyize ahagaragara ibicuruzwa bye byerekana imideli yise The Uzo Brand. Isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa bikozwe mu mpu biva mu bikoresho biva mu karere. Ikirango cyibanda cyane kumifuka. Munsi yikimenyetso, yasohoye icyegeranyo cye.

The Blessed, izwi kandi ku izina rya Les Bienheureux, ni filime yo muri Alijeriya yerekana umuryango ubayeho nyuma y'intambara ya Alijeriya izwi kandi ku izina rya 'the dirty war'.
Shyira mumasaha 24, firime yibanda kubashakanye bibaho kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 20 kandi bateganya itariki muri resitora. Abashakanye batumvikana ku bijyanye no kohereza cyangwa kohereza umuhungu wabo mu mahanga kwiga kandi bahitamo kubabaza inshuti zabo nijoro. Mugihe cyo kurya, ingingo irazanwa kandi birangira buri wese muri bo atekereza uko abona intambara n'ejo hazaza h'igihugu.
Igihembo mpuzamahanga cya mbere [Nominee]

Can You Dig This ni film ya documentaire yabanyamerika 2015 iyobowe na Delila Vallot. Intego nyamukuru yiyi firime nubuhinzi bwo mumijyi nkumuntu nyamukuru atera umurima wibiryo murugo rwe.
Iyi nkuru nigitekerezo kigamije gushishikariza abantu ahantu hose gutera nkuko abantu bayobora batera ubusitani bwumujyi murugo rwe mumajyepfo ya Los Angeles.

Redemption, izwi kandi nka Resgate, ni filimi yo muri Mozambike ya 2019 iyobowe na Mickey Fonseca. Iyi nkuru yibanda ku buzima bwubugizi bwa nabi kuko umuntu wambere ahitamo guhindura ubuzima bwe no kuba umubyeyi mwiza nyuma yimyaka ine ariko bikarangira agasubira mubuzima bwubugizi bwa nabi. Yatorewe ibihembo icyenda kandi yegukana bibiri muri byo muri Afurika Movie Academy Awards.
Umugabo wagarutse avuye muri gereza amenya ko, mbere gato yo gupfa, nyina yafashe umwenda uteje akaga. Nubwo ashaka guhindura ikibabi gishya, ahatirwa kongera gusubira mubuzima bwicyaha kuko akeneye amafaranga cyane.

Lost in Time ni film yo muri Kenya 2019 yanditswe na Edijoe Mwaniki. Ni mu mutwe thriller ryibanda ku kibazo mutwe.
Kugeza ubu, film imaze gutwara ibihembo bitanu bya Kalasha awards. Ibyiciro byo gutanga ibihembo birimo "Filime nziza cyane", "umuyobozi mwiza" (Peter Kawa), "umukinnyi mwiza muri film" (George Mo), "amashusho meza" (Edijoe Mwaniki) na "amajwi meza" (Karanja Kiarie).
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa nyina wa Sam, yagumye mu mutwe, kuko uwo munsi uba umunsi umwe yabuze umukobwa we. Ibi bimugiraho ingaruka mubitekerezo, kandi agerageza kurwanya ubwoba bwe. Yatangiye kuba mu nshuti ye ya Michael, ariko bidatinze abona ibintu bidasanzwe bibera mu nzu. Agerageza guhishura amabanga yerekeye inzu numugore udasanzwe winshuti ye, mugihe arwanya ubwoba bwe, bwaba ubwubu nubu.

Sprinter ni firime yimikino ya 2018 izenguruka umukinnyi unyura mubibazo byumuryango, iyobowe na Storm Saulter. Will Smith na Jada Pinkett Smith bari abaproducer bayobora uyu musaruro. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muIserukiramuco rya Filime y'Abanyamerika muri 2018 aho yatsindiye ibihembo bya Best Narrative Feature, Igihembo cyabaterankunga mu cyiciro cya Filime Nziza n’Umuyobozi mwiza.
Umwangavu wo muri Jamayike uremerewe na se udahungabana na musaza we udahungabana yizera ko izamuka rya meteorike mu isiganwa ry’imirima rishobora kumuhuza na nyina, wabaga muri Amerika mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko mu myaka icumi ishize.

Triangle: Going to America ni filime yo muri Etiyopiya 2014 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Theodros Teshome. Yatowe mu byiciro bitatu bitandukanye muri Afurika ya Movie Academy Awards 2015; Filime nziza mundimi nyafurika, Umuyobozi mwiza na Filime nziza.
Yatsindiye "Igihembo cy'Abashinze Iserukiramuco- Narrative" mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime nyafurika muri 2015 ndetse inegukana "Igihembo cy'abaterankunga" muIserukiramuco rya Sinema rya filimi mu Rwanda muri 2015.
Filime yazengurutse imigabane itatu kandi ivuga ku kibazo cyo kwimukira muri Amerika mu buryo butemewe. Kaleab na Jemal bafite ubushake bwo gukora ibishoboka byose kugirango bagere muri Amerika ubuzima bwiza. Mu rugendo rutoroshye, bahura na Winta nziza (Mahder Assefa), mugenzi wabo wimukira uturutse muri Eritereya. Kaleab na Winta bakundana mugihe bava muri Afrika yuburasirazuba banyuze muri Libiya, Ubutaliyani, Mexico ndetse amaherezo bakerekeza muri Amerika.

The Perfect Picture: 10 Years Later ni film yo muri Gana ya 2019 yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso na Ken Attoh. Ni kimwe na "Perfect Picture", yakozwe kandi yanditswe na Shirley Frimpong-Manso.
Filime yumwimerere yari hafi yabagore batatu basunika imyaka mirongo itatu bagerageza gushira amanga kugirango bahindure ubuzima bwabo, ariko ibyateganijwe byari bifite izindi gahunda kuri bo. Noneho murukurikirane, abadamu baragarutse, iki gihe basunika imyaka mirongo ine. Nubwo bakuze kandi bafite ubwenge, bamenye ko ubu bafite ibibazo byinshi harimo nubusabane bwabo butari bwiza.

Ibihembo bya Gana Movie 2019 byari ibirori byabereye muri Theatre ku ya 20 Ukuboza mu mwaka 2019. Muri ibyo birori, umukinnyi wa filime Salma Mumin yakoze amateka kuko yatsindiye umudari we wa mbere kuko yitwaye neza mu cyiciro cy’ibihembo. Umukinnyi Alphonse Menyo nawe yatwaye igikombe cye cya mbere cy'umukinnyi mwiza mu byiciro. Igihembo ngaruka mwaka cyerekana indashyikirwa mu nganda za sinema zo muri Gana kandi iyi yari inshuro ya cyenda(9).

Alioune Ifra Ndiaye (wavutse 1969/1970) 1969/1970
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Ndiaye ni umuhungu w'umujandarume, mukuru we ni umuyobozi wa firime Souleymane Cissé.. Ndiaye yatewe inkunga na murumuna we, Ndiaye yimukiye muri Kanada yiga ibijyanye no gukina amafilime muri Université du Québec à Montréal. Yagarutse i Bamako mu 1997 kugira ngo abone impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu mateka. Mu 1998, Ndiaye yashinze itsinda ry’ikinamico rya BlonBa ari kumwe n’inshuti ye, umufilozofe w’Abafaransa n’umwanditsi Jean-Louis Sagot-Duvauroux. Yize kandi umubano wumuco muri Kaminuza ya Sorbonne Nouvelle Paris 3. Ndiaye yafatanije kwandika no gukora ibitaramo bitanu mu muco w'ikinamico ya kotèba, kandi itsinda rya BlonBa ryatanze ibitaramo ijana muri Senegali, Bénin, Ubufaransa n'Ububiligi. Muri Mutarama 2007, BlonBa yafunguye umwanya w’umuco, inzira yonyine y’ikigo ndangamuco cy’Abafaransa (CCF). Umwanya w’umuco wahatiwe gufunga nyuma y’ihirikwa ry’ubutegetsi bwa Mali 2012, ariko ishami ry’Ubufaransa ryemerera kuguma mu bucuruzi.
Ndiaye yayoboye kandi documentaire, firime zimpimbano, na videwo yindirimbo, maze ahimba igitekerezo cya telekotèba. Yatoje porogaramu yo gutunganya amafilime i Paris, yitabira gutunganya TV kandi akora nk'umujyanama muri Tchad kugira ngo afashe kuvugurura imiyoboro isanzwe. Muri 2012, yasabye umwanya wo kuba umuyobozi mukuru wa Office de Radiodiffusion-Télévision du Mali, ariko ntiyatorwa. Muri 2013, Ndiaye yashinze umuyoboro we wa tereviziyo i Bamako, witwa Wôklôni nyuma ya elve mu migani ya Mandingo. Yatangije umuyoboro n'amafaranga ye, ariko ntiyigeze abona uruhushya rwemewe na guverinoma. Ndiaye yayoboye igitaramo cyiswe "Taynibougou, la cité des profiteurs", anenga urwego rwa ruswa mu gihugu. Yasohoye igitabo "Banyengo" mu 2016, mu rwego rwo guteza imbere umuco w’igihugu. Muri 2017, umwanya wumuco wa BlonBa wongeye gufungura. Ndiaye niwe waremye abahanzi hamwe Djinè Ton.
Ndiaye ni we washinze umutwe wa politiki Wele Wele, ushaka gukangurira urubyiruko kwiyamamariza umwanya wa politiki. Ni anististe, kandi ntavugwaho rumwe muri Mali kubera ko adakurikiza Islam. Ndiaye afite abana bane, harimo impanga kuva yashyingiranwa bwa mbere. Ahuza amahugurwa yo kwandika ikinamico ngarukamwaka.

Dennis Bots (yavutse ku ya 11 Kamena 1974) ni umuyobozi wa firime wa Zambiya-Ubuholandi.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Dennis Bots yavukiye mu mujyi wa Kitwe wa Zambiya mu 1974. Ababyeyi be b'Abaholandi babaga muri Zambiya, aho se yakoraga. Akiri uruhinja, yimukiye mu mujyi wa Gemert wo mu Buholandi. Se wa Bots yari umukinnyi wa firime ukunda cyane, kandi Bots yakoze filime ye ya mbere, "Shetani", afite imyaka 12, yerekana igishusho cyo muri Afurika cyaguzwe muri Wereldwinkel kandi kirimo umwuka. Bots ivuga nka firime kuva mubwana bwe, nka "Stand By Me", "E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial" and "The Neverending Story". Yize muri Macropedius College kandi akora kuri tereviziyo yaho imyaka itari mike. Ku myaka 18, Bots yimukiye i Amsterdam kwiga film.
Mu 1996, Bots yahawe impamyabumenyi mu ishuri rya Filimi na Televiziyo yo mu Buholandi i Amsterdam. Yatangiye umwuga we akora kuri tereviziyo, ayobora ibice bya "serivise za Goudkust", "Rozengeur &amp; Wodka Lime", "Goede tijden", "Slechte tijden" na "Trauma 24/7". Muri 2005, Bots yayoboye filime ye ya mbere yerekana, "Zoop muri Afurika". Yibanze cyane kuri firime zabana kuva yatangira. Bots yayoboye "Anubis en het Pad der 7 Zonden", ikaba yarabaye firime yarebwaga cyane mu 2008 mu Buholandi. Yayoboye Achtste Groepers Huilen Niet mu 2012, ahuza igitabo yatekereje gukora kuva mu 1999. Inkuru ivuga kubyerekeye umwana wimyaka cumi n'ibiri urwara leukemia.
Muri 2014, yayoboye "Oorlogsgeheimen" ("Amabanga y'intambara") yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Luxembourg mu 2015. Bots yakoze kandi kuri "serivise ya Celblok H" (2014) na "Orpheus Project" (2016). Muri 2017, yayoboye "Storm:Letters van Vuur", abaho mugihe cy'ivugurura ry'abaporotisanti. Iravuga amateka yumuyaga, umuhungu se yatawe muri yombi azira gucapa ibaruwa ya Martin Luther. Bots yayoboye "Circus Noel" muri 2019, kubyerekeye umukobwa winjiye muri sirusi. Byanditswe na Karen van Holst Pellekaan, Bots yakoranye na firime zabanje. Muri 2020, Bots yayoboye "Engel", ishingiye ku gitabo cyanditswe na Isa Hoes. Filime yanditswe na Ellen Barendregt ivuga amateka yumukobwa ushobora gukora ibyifuzo kubantu beza. Bots iba i Bussum.

Marcelin Bossou (yavutse ku ya 3 Gicurasi 1984) ni umuyobozi wa firime muri Togo, utunganya firime, akaba n'umwanditsi.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Bossou yavukiye i Lomé, muri Togo mu 1984. Yari umuhungu w'ababyeyi bo muri Bénin. Se wa Bossou yari umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'imikino.. Yakoraga kuri tereviziyo yigenga ya Radio Télévision Delta Santé nk'umutekinisiye nyuma aba umuyobozi.
Muri 2008, yiyandikishije muri Ecole Supérieure des Arts Visuels i Marrakesh muri Maroc nyuma yo kubona buruse. Bossou yayoboye filime ye ya mbere ngufi, "La Bourse ou la vie" na "L'inconnu" mu 2010. Yabonye uruhushya rwe muri Film Studies, Directory option, muri 2012. Filime ya Bossou yahawe impamyabumenyi, "Nuit de Noces", yinjiye mu birori byinshi bya firime nka Mediterranean Short Film Festival ya Tangier, Iserukiramuco rya Filime nyafurika rya Luxor, hamwe na Festival ya Afrika ya Poitiers. "Nuit de Noces" yakiriye Grand Prix mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Atakpamé i Togo ndetse nigihembo cyihariye cya René Monory mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican ya Ouagadougou. Irasuzuma imitwaro abagore bahura nazo iyo bashyingiranywe, harimo no kwerekana ubusugi bwabo.
Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi, Bossou yayoboye "L'anniversaire". Yashinze isosiyete ikora amajwi n'amashusho Marbos Productions i Lomé muri 2015. Intego nyamukuru yaryo ni ugutanga inkunga kubanyeshuri biga muri firime ya Togoliya kugirango bakore film zabo za mbere. Muri 2015, yayoboye "Les deux frères". Filime yahawe igihembo cyo gufotora neza mu iserukiramuco rya Clap Ivoire. Muri 2019, Bossou yakoze firime "La vie de Daniel" iyobowe na Gilbert Bararmna na "Femme" Ebène na Rachel Kpizing.
Kuri ubu Bossou arimo akora kuri firime ye ya mbere yerekana, "Broken Drums", biteganijwe ko izasohoka mu 2021. Yigisha isesengura rya firime, kwandika na tekinike mu Ishuri Rikuru rya Sinema i Lomé.

Samira Magroun (wavutse 24 Mutarama 1987) numukinnyi wa filimi muri Tuniziya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Magroun afite abavandimwe benshi. Akiri umwana, yashishikazwaga no kuba umukinnyi wa filime akanavugwa cyane ndetse akanavugwa cyane. Magroun yize icyongereza nyuma yishuri ryisumbuye. Nyuma yaje kwiga ishuri ryigisha indege Nouvel Air mbere yuko atangira umwuga we wo gukina Filimi.
Magroun yatangiriye mu bucuruzi bwe muri Tuniziya Fehri yatangajwe cyane n'imikorere ya Magroun, maze atorerwa kuba Syrine muri "Maktoub", yatangiye mu 2008. Imico ye ni umugore utagira ubwenge ukoreshwa n'umukunzi we, Elyes, na Magroun bavuze ko abakobwa nka we ari benshi muri sosiyete.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Magroun yakinnye muri sitcom "Garage Lekrik" nka Lobna, umukobwa ukunda ubutunzi ufite umubano utitiranya na Boulouna, yakinnye na Lotfi Abdelli. Amaze guhabwa inshingano, yahise abyemera kuko byari amahirwe meza kandi abakinnyi bari bafite abakinnyi beza. Muri Nzeri 2010, Magroun yakinnye muri serivise yo muri Siriya "Takht Charki" yanditswe na Yam Mach'hadi iyobowe na Racha Chabartji.
Magroun yasezeranye numupira wamaguru Adel Chedli muri Mata 2012. Yabyaye umuhungu na Chedli, Koussay. Bombi bashakanye imyaka ibiri mbere yo gutandukana. Muri Gicurasi 2020, Magroun yibarutse umwana we wa kabiri, umukobwa Zayna.

Mel Gambôa (yavutse ku ya 23 Gicurasi 1984) ni umukinnyi wa filime w’umunyaromaniya utuye muri Angola, umunyamakuru, na producer wa televiziyo.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Gambôa yavutse 1984 i Bucharest, muri Rumaniya. Umukobwa wa se wa Angola na nyina w’umuromaniya, yatangiye gutaramira mu ikinamico mu 1998, yinjira mu itsinda ry’ikinamico Horizonte Nzinga Mbandi nk'igikorwa kidasanzwe. Hagati ya 2001 na 2003, Gambôa yabaga i Madrid maze yinjira mu itsinda ry’ikinamico Los Sobrinos del Mago de Oz nk'umukinnyi wa filime akaba n’umuyobozi wungirije w’imikino y’abana "El Gnomo Jeromo" na "Los Evangelios Apócrifos" na Frank Huesca.
Mu 2004, yasubiye i Luanda yitangira ikinamico, yitabira amahugurwa menshi kandi yiga amasomo y'ubuhanzi. Gambôa yinjiye muri societe yo muri iki gihe imbyino na percussion Manésema mu 2006 nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe imibanire rusange n’umuyobozi ushinzwe imihango. Mu 2007, yatangiye umwuga we kuri tereviziyo. Mu mwaka wa 2010, Gambôa yashinze isosiyete ikorana na Multimedia Together Now, usibye gutanga serivisi zo gufotora no gufata amashusho, yashyizeho gahunda zamahugurwa kubakinnyi n’amasomo ya "Photography Angola".
Gambôa yabaye umuyobozi wa gahunda yimyidagaduro "Tchilar kumuyoboro" wa 2 wa Televiziyo rusange muri Angola. Muri 2012, yatangiye kwakira ikiganiro cya radio cyitwa "Show da Mel" kuri Rádio Despertar 91.0 FM.
Muri 2017, Gambôa yimukiye i Los Angeles kugira ngo arangize amashuri ye muri sinema. Kubera ibibazo by'amafaranga, yahatiwe gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga kugira ngo yishakire inkunga.
Gambôa ni umunyamurwango uharanira inyungu z'umugore kandi yavuze ko abaturage badashobora kumenya ibibera muri politiki ya Angola. Yimenyereza tantra yoga no gufotora. Yize ibitabo bivuga ku idini ry'Ababuda.

Stefanie Sycholt (wavutse 1963) ni umuyobozi wa firime muri Afrika yepfo, utunganya amafilime, akaba n'umwanditsi.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Sycholt yavukiye i Pretoriya mu 1963. Yize icyongereza munsi ya JM Coetzee ndetse na siyanse ya politiki na teoriya muriKaminuza ya Natal na kaminuza ya Cape Town. Sycholt yagize uruhare mu bikorwa byo kurwanya ivanguramoko kandi yabaye umuyobozi ushinzwe itangazamakuru mu ihuriro ry’abanyeshuri bo muri Afurika yepfo. Marita yashoboye umusaruro ikipe Ava bikaba amasanamu Nelson Mandela's Welcome Home Rally mu Durban mu 1990. Sycholt yaje kujya mu Budage kwiga muri Kaminuza ya Televiziyo na Filime Munich. Yakoze mu ishami rishinzwe kwandika rya kaminuza ya firime na televiziyo i Munich ndetse n'umwanditsi n'umuyobozi.
Mu 2001, Sycholt yakinnye bwa mbere muri "firime" na Malunde, ivuga amateka yumuhungu witwa Wonderboy uba inshuti nuwahoze ari umusirikare mubutegetsi bwera. Yakiriye ibihembo bitandatu bya Avanti harimo umuyobozi mwiza, kandi igice cyinyungu cyagiye mumfashanyo ya Mandela kubana bo mumuhanda. Yayoboye filime isetsa yakozwe kuri TV "Gwendolyn" mu 2007. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yanditse, ayobora, afatanya na "Themba". Ukurikije igitabo kitazwi na Lutz van Dijk, ni ikinamico yo mu muryango ivuga amateka yumuhungu ukiri muto ukunda umupira wamaguru na nyina wanduye sida. "Themba" yahawe igihembo cya UNICEF Uburenganzira bw'umwana mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Zanzibar 2010. Sycholt yayoboye ibice byinshi byurukurikirane rwa "Inga Lindström".
Sycholt yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa firime wo muri Arijantine kandi afite umuhungu umwe. Agabanya igihe cye hagati y'Ubudage, Arijantine, na Afurika y'Epfo.

Sofia Amara (yavutse ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1968) ni umunyamakuru w’umufaransa wavukiye muri Maroc akaba n'umuyobozi wa firime.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Amara yavukiye i Casablanca mu 1968. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Yorodani afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bumenyi bwa politiki no muri IEP i Paris mu 1996. Amara yatangiye umwuga we wumwuga nkumunyamakuru muburasirazuba bwo hagati kumiyoboro itandukanye na radio. Yagaragaje ibyabaye nka Intifada ya mbere y'Abanyapalestine, igitero cya Koweti na Iraki, no kugaruka kwa Yasser Arafat muri Gaza.
Amara yatanze raporo ku Isoko ry'Abarabu muri Egiputa, kandi afungwa kabiri hamwe n'abigaragambyaga i Cairo. Yakoze documentaire ku ntambara yo muri Siriya kuva yatangira mu 2011. Muri 2014, Amara yasohoye igitabo "Infiltrée dans l'enfer syrien: du Printemps de Damas à l'Etat islamique" aho yasabye ko igihugu cya kisilamu cya Iraki na Levant (ISIL) mubyukuri byari umufatanyabikorwa wa Bashar al-Assad. Mosul amaze kubohorwa muri 2017, Amara yabaye umwe mu banyamakuru ba mbere b’abagore binjiye mu mujyi hamwe n’ingabo za Iraki.
Muri 2017, yayoboye documentaire "Yabuze Abana ba Califa", yerekanaga abana bafite imyaka umunani bogejwe n'ubwonko kandi bahabwa imyitozo yintwaro. Yakiriye igihembo cya AMADE mu iserukiramuco rya TV rya Monte-Carlo. Muri 2018, Amara yasohoye igitabo "Bagdadi, Khalifa w'iterabwoba". Harimo ibiganiro bye n'uwahoze ari umugore n'umukobwa wa Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, umuyobozi wa ISIL. Igitabo cyasuzumye izamuka ry'ubutegetsi bwa al-Baghdadi n'ingaruka zaryo ku isi.
Amara ifite icyicaro i Beirut. Muri 2019, yanenze Perezida wa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika Donald Trump kuba adafite politiki yo mu burasirazuba bwo hagati kandi yirengagiza ihohoterwa rya guverinoma z'Abarabu. Amara yavuze ko umwanzuro uhangayikishije cyane mu mpeshyi y’Abarabu ari uko "hari abayobozi bashinzwe ibibazo bakora bashingiye ku nyungu zabo bwite zihinduka kandi rimwe na rimwe zikabarwa nabi."

Tezeta Abraham (yavutse 15 Gashyantare 1985) numunyamideli wumutaliyani ukomoka muri Etiyopiya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Abrahamu yavukiye i Djibouti kubabyeyi ba Etiyopiya. Yimukiye hamwe n'umuryango we mu Butaliyani afite imyaka itanu. Aburahamu yarwanije umwirondoro we akiri muto, akenshi akaba ari we mukobwa wenyine wumwirabura mwishuri rye. Mu 2002, yatsindiye irushanwa rya "Miss Italy Africa" ryamufashe ku isi yimyambarire. Nkumunyamideli, yakoraga mubirango Fendi, Gianfranco Ferre, Replay, Moschino, na Jean Paul Gaultier, nabandi. Abrahamu yakiriye impamyabumenyi ye nk'umujyanama mu bukerarugendo. Yagiye muri Miss Italy mu 2010.
Abraham yashimishijwe nisi ya sinema maze atangira kwitabira amafilime afite imyaka 18, akenshi ahabwa inshingano. Mu isuzuma yabwiwe ko ari mwiza cyane, byaramutangaje. Muri 2012, Abraham yagize uruhare ruto muri film "A Flat for Three". Ukwezi kumwe nyuma yo kugenzurwa numuyobozi Ivan Cotroneo muri 2015, Abraham yahawe umwanya "mubiganiro bya TV È arrivata la felicità". Kuva mu 2015, yakoranye na Cotroneo kuri firime nyinshi na serivise. Muri 2017, Abraham yakinnye umunyeshuri wa kaminuza ashishikajwe nubuzima bwa Lord Byron na Mary Shelley, mubutaliyani muri film ngufi "L'ultima rima". Yakinnye umubyeyi muri firime ngufi ya 2018 "La festa più bellissima". Muri 2019, Abraham yafashije gutangiza iserukiramuco rya Filime rya MiWorld.
Aburahamu afite umuhungu. Yamaganaga ivanguramoko mu Butaliyani, avuga ko abirabura baba ku nkengero za sosiyete ari umuco w’Abagatolika. Abrahamu kandi ateza imbere ingendo nkinzira yo gufungura ibitekerezo mumico mishya. Ubu atuye i Roma.

Franco Sacchi numukinnyi wa firime wumutaliyani akaba n'umwanditsi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane "Iyi Ni Nollywood", "Inkone z'Abanyamerika" no "Gutegereza Harimagedoni".
Yavukiye muri Zambiya akurira mu Butaliyani.
Mu 2003, yakoze documentaire ye ya mbere "y'Abanyamerika Inkone". Filime yerekanwe kandi itoranywa kumugaragaro muri International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam (IDFA). Muri 2005, yakoze icyerekezo "IThis Is Nollywood",documentaire ivuga ibijyanye ninganda za firime. Filime yaje gutsindira igihembo cyabaterankunga mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Abuja. Iyo filime igenda neza, Franco yafatanije kuyobora no gufata amashusho "Waiting for Armageddon", yasohotse mu 2010.
Usibye kuyobora firime, yabaye umwarimu mukuru muri Avid Technology kuva 1996 kugeza 2002.

Amin Sidi-Boumédiène (yavutse ku ya 5 Werurwe 1982), ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Alijeriya ukomoka mu bufaransa. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa "Al Djazira" ngufi na firime "Abou Leila".
Yavutse ku ya 5 Werurwe 1982 i Paris, mu Bufaransa. Ariko, nyuma yakuriye mu Alger, Algeria. Yagarutse mu Bufaransa yiga chimie nyuma ya baccalauréat.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi iyobowe na Conservatoire Libre du Cinéma Français (CLCF) i Paris mu 2005. Noneho yakoze firime ye ya mbere "Ejo, Algiers?" muri 2011. Filime yatoranijwe mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Hanyuma yakoze firime ye ya kabiri "Al Djazira", yafatiwe muri Algiers muri Nyakanga 2012. Yatsindiye Igihembo cya Filime Nziza y'Abarabu mu iserukiramuco rya filime rya Abu Dhabi.
Muri 2014, yayoboye "Serial ye ya gatatu ngufi K." Filime yerekanwe muminsi ya firime ya Bejaia. Nyuma yuruhererekane rwa firime ngufi zatsinze, yakoze filime yambere "yumukobwa, Abou Leila", film yijimye. Yarasiwe rwose mu gihugu cye cya Alijeriya. Filime yaje guhitamo kuri 58 Semaine de la Critique. Filime yasohotse mu makinamico ku ya 15 Nyakanga 2020. Yatoranijwe kandi kugirango yerekanwe mu cyumweru mpuzamahanga cy’abanenga muri Festival ya Cannes ya 2019. Mu Gushyingo 2019, iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya Filime nziza ya mbere ya Diregiteri mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime mpuzamahanga rya 50.

Mirko Dragolioub Popovich (yavutse 1948), ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Bubiligi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa film izwi cyane "Tango Ya Ba Wendo".
Yavutse mu 1948 i Buruseli mu Bubiligi kandi akomoka muri Yugosilaviya.
Niwe washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa 'Zinneke Parade' i Buruseli. Mu 1993, yakoze documentaire ngufi "Tango Ya Ba Wendo" hamwe na Roger Kwami Zinga wo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Amagambo magufi avuga ku buzima bwintangiriro yumuziki wa Zairian, Wendo, uzwi kandi nka Papa Wendo. Kuva 1966 kugeza 1980, Popovitch yakoraga nk'umucuranzi mumatsinda ya rock. Yakomeje gukora nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ikigo ndangamuco cya Watermael - Boitsfort imyaka 28. Mu 1997, yabaye komiseri ushinzwe ibikorwa bya "Na Nga Def Senegal", aho yaje gukorera "Laafi Burkina Faso" mu 1999 na "Alafia Benin" mu 2004.
Usibye sinema, ni n'umwanditsi mwinshi. Mu 2004, yanditse kandi asohora inkuru ngufi zatsindiye igihembo cya mbere cya Francité mu 2004 hanyuma yegukana igihembo cya RTBF Fureur de lire 2004. Mu mwaka wa 2008, yatorewe kuba Umuyobozi w’umuryango udaharanira inyungu Africalia, aho yakomereje imyaka 7 hanyuma asezera ku ya 1 Mutarama 2013. Hamwe n'uburambe bwose yabonye muri iyi myaka, yatangije umurongo wa documentaire yakozwe nabakinnyi ba firime nyafurika kubijyanye numuco.

Ahmed Benaissa, (1944-2022) ni umukinnyi wa firime mu Bufaransa ukomoka muri Alijeriya. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime zizwi cyane "Étoile aux dents ou Poulou le magnifique", "Amarembo yizuba" hamwe "n’abanzi ba hafi".
Yavukiye muri Alijeriya mu muryango w'abakobwa batanu n'abahungu bane. Se yari umurwanashyaka wafashwe agafungirwa muri Alijeriya. Icyakora yaje kurekurwa nyuma y'ubwigenge bwa Alijeriya. Nyuma yaje kwimukira i Paris mu Bufaransa. Yabayeho hafi imyaka 18 mu Bufaransa. Muri icyo gihe, yahawe amahugurwa mu Ishuri ry’Ikinamico.
Arubatse, ni se w'abahungu babiri.
Mu 1971, Benaïssa yatangiye umwuga we wa sinema akoresheje filime "Étoile aux dents ou Poulou le magnifique" iyobowe na Derri Berkani. Yakinnye nka 'Jibé' muri iyo film. Iyo filime igenda neza, yakiriye filime nyinshi mu myaka yakurikiyeho nka filime yo muri Alijeriya "Leïla et les autres" mu 1977 iyobowe na Sid Ali Mazif, "Buamama" mu 1985 iyobowe na Benamar Bakhti na comedi izwi cyane "Le Clandestin" mu 1989 iyobowe na Bakhti.
Yakinnye cyane muri 'Haroun', muri film L'Etranger de Camus. Yakinnye kandi anayobora kuri Theatre yigihugu ya Algiers, ndetse no muri Theatre ya Regional ya Oran. Yayoboye kandi Ikinamico y'akarere ka Sidi-Bel-Abbès. Muri 2013, yatsindiye igihembo cyerekezo cyiza cya film "Nedjma". Benaïssa yakinnye nka 'Rida' muri Ramzi Ben Sliman ya mbere yerekana filime "My Revolution". Yasohotse mu Bufaransa muri Kanama 2015. Kuri Theatre, urugendo na "Meursaults" rurakomeje mu Bufaransa muri 2017.

Abdelhamid Bouchnak (wavutse 1984), ni umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane wa filimi muri Tuniziya. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa filime "iteye" ubwoba yo muri Tuniziya Dachra.
Yavutse mu 1984 i Tunis, muri Tuniziya. Se Lotfi Bouchnak numuririmbyi uzwi cyane wo muri Tuniziya umukinnyi wa Oud uzwi cyane. Abdelhamid yize mu Ishuri Rikuru ry'Ubumenyi n'Ikoranabuhanga Ryashushanyije muri Tuniziya (ESAC) i Gammarth. Nyuma yize muri kaminuza ya Montreal arangiza afite impamyabumenyi yo kwiga film.
Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yabaye umuyobozi muri sosiyete Shkoon Production. Ariko, ubanza yakoraga nka "cinemateri" murubuga rwa Ta7ana, hamwe na tereviziyo ya "Hedhoukom". Yagiye kandi muri firime ngufi nk'umukinnyi wa sinema muri "Alliance" muri 2011 hanyuma "Le Bonbon" muri 2016. Nyuma yimyaka mike, yayoboye inyandiko zamateka, "Jadis Kerkouane".
Muri 2018, Abdelhamid yayoboye filime ye yambere "yumukobwa", Dachra, film iteye ubwoba. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma iza gutoranywa mu cyumweru mpuzamahanga cy’abanenga mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Venice. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa filime, yayoboye igihembwe cya 1 cya televiziyo "Nouba cyanyuze" kuri Nessma mu kwezi kwa Ramadhan muri 2019. Hanyuma yayoboye Season 2 "yuruhererekane rumwe, yise Ochèg Eddenia" yatangajwe muri 2020.

Paul Onsongo (yavutse 21 Nyakanga 1948), ni ni umukinnyi wakoze filimi nyinshi zikomeye muri Kenya. Azwi cyane ku ruhare muri filime "Umusozi w'ukwezi", "Küken für Kairo" na "Flame Tree of Thika".
Yavutse ku ya 21 Nyakanga 1948 i Mombasa, muri Kenya.
Mu 1974, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime na "Wilby Conspiracy". Mu 1981, yatangiriye kuri tereviziyo ya mini na "The Flame Tree of Thika". Yakinnye uruhare rwa 'Juma' mubice bine byuruhererekane rwa mini. Muri uwo mwaka, yakinnye muri filime yerekana ubuzima bwa "Rise na Fall ya Idi Amin" aho iyi filime yatsindiye ibihembo bitanu, harimo n'umukinnyi mwiza, mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Las Vegas.
Hanyuma mu 1985, yagaragaye muri firime ishimishije "Küken für Kairo" aho yakinnye cyane nka 'Umucuruzi'. Mu 1987, yakinnye cyane muri Megitew muri firime ya tereviziyo "Turi Abana", aho yamenyekanye cyane. Mu 1989, yakinnye nk'umugome wa Abdullah muri filime "Cheetah". Mu 1990, yagaragaye muri firime yerekana ubuzima bwa "Mountains of the Moon" afite uruhare 'Sidi Bombay'. Uruhare rwe rwamenyekanye cyane.

Shamira Raphaëla (yavutse 1982), ni umukinnyi wa filimi wo muri Aruba ukomoka mu buholandi. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa documentaire "Daddy and the Warlord", "Deal With It" and "Our Motherland".
Yavutse mu 1982 muri Karayibe, akurira muri Aruba kwa nyina w’Ubuholandi na se wa Curaçao.
Nyuma ya voorbereidend wetenschappelijk onderwijs (VWO), yimukiye mu Buholandi yiga ubuhanzi bwiza muri Gerrit Rietveld Academie. Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi yubuhanzi bwitangazamakuru muri kaminuza yubuhanzi ya ArtEZ. Ku ikubitiro, yatangiye gukora nk'umuyobozi wigenga aho yayoboye ibiganiro byinshi bya tereviziyo: "Expeditie Robinson" na "Spuiten en Slikken".
Muri 2006, Raphaela yakoze kandi ayobora film ye ya mbere "Yumunyu Mumaso Yanjye". Amagambo magufi avuga abakobwa batatu ba Aruban. Nyuma yo gutsinda kwikabutura nyinshi, yakoze bwa mbere documentaire "Deal With It". Iyi filime yakiriwe neza nyuma iza gutangwa mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ry’umujyi wa Los Angeles, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Belize ndetse n’iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Aruba. Iyi filime irazenguruka inkuru y’abacuruza ibiyobyabwenge n’abasinzi: se Pempy na murumuna we Andy, mubyukuri abo mu muryango we. Iyi filime yatorewe kuba umukinnyi wa mbere witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco rya Filime ry’Ubuholandi (NFF) 2015. Muri 2017, iyi filime yahawe igihembo cya Lenno na Sunfish igihembo mpuzamahanga cy'amafilime mpuzamahanga ya Amsterdam (IDFA) kubera igihembo cyiza cy'urubyiruko.
Muri 2017, yanditse filime "Yamanutse ya Superwoman" aho yatsindiye igihembo cya Karen de Bok muri IDFA, 2018. Muri uwo mwaka, yakoze "Lenno na Angelfish". Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yegukana igihembo cy’inyandiko nziza z’abana b’i Burayi mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Berlin mu 2019 hanyuma ihabwa igihembo cy’inyandiko nziza z’abana muri IDFA, 2018.
Muri 2018, yakoze documentaire yerekana ubuzima bwa "Daddy na Warlord" izenguruka ku nkuru y’umunyamakuru Clarice Gargard, wahoze ari umugabo w’iburyo bwa Charles Taylor, wahoze ari perezida wa Liberiya. Filime yagaragaye bwa mbere muri Sinema Iserukiramuco rya film muri 2019. Nyuma, film yatsindiye Inyana ya Zahabu kubwinyandiko ngufi nziza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ry’Ubuholandi 2019. Ukuboza 2019, yakoze documentaire "Ons Motherland".

Talal Selhami (yavutse ku ya 11 Werurwe 1982), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Maroke ukomoka mu bufaransa. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime zizwi cyane "Mirages", "Achoura" hamwe "nabashushanyaga Ibiremwa - The Frankenstein Complex".
yavutse ku ya 11 Werurwe 1982 i Neuilly-sur-Seine, Hauts-de-Seine mu Bufaransa nk'umuhererezi w'umuryango. Se, Mohamed Selhami ni umunyamakuru wa Maroc akaba ari nawe washinze ikinyamakuru Maroc Hebdo International. Yarangije icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu buhanzi no kwidagadura, inzobere mu gukora, muri kaminuza ya Paris 1 Pantheon-Sorbonne.
Muri 2005, yakoze umukobwa we muto "Sinistra". Nyuma yo gutsinda muri make, yakoze "Partir en umwotsi" muri 2007. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yakoze filime ye ya mbere yerekana, "Mirage". Iyi filime ihagarariwe kumugaragaro mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Marrakech mu 2010 ndetse na Tangier National Film Festival muri 2011. Filime yaje gutsindira ibihembo bibiri: Kumashusho meza no Gusobanura neza Abagore. Mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Bruxelles (BIFFF) i Buruseli, 2011 yakiriye filime idasanzwe y'abacamanza.
Ukuboza 2018, yasohoye filime ye "Achoura, La nuit des enfants" nk'umusaruro uhuriweho na Franco-Maroc. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu minsi mikuru cumi n'itanu ku isi: harimo, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime mpuzamahanga rya Paris, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime ryiza ryabereye i Buruseli, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Bucheon (BiFan) muri Koreya y'Epfo ndetse na Neuchâtel International Fantastic Film Festival (NIFFF) muri Neuchâtel. Nyuma muri 2019, Talal yahawe igihembo cyumusaruro mwiza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tangier ndetse n’abacamanza badasanzwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sitges. Hagati aho, filime yanatanze igihembo cyiza cya Filime muri HARD: LINE International Film Festival mu Budage.

Lauren Selmon Roberts ni umukinnyi wa firime ndetse akaba na producer ukomoka muri amerika. Ni umuyobozi wa "Rainbow Town", documentaire yibanze ku mfubyi muri Liberiya yatewe n'intambara.
Ni umukobwa wa Kathryn na Dewey Selmon wa Norman, Oklahoma. Yarangije impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu itangazamakuru ryamamaza muri kaminuza ya Leta ya California, Fresno muri Gicurasi 2005. Nyuma yaho, yahawe impamyabumenyi ihanitse y’ubuhanzi bwiza yakuye muri College of Mass Communication and Media Arts of Southern Illinois University Carbondale.
Igihe yari afite imyaka 14, yatangiye gukoresha kamera ya videwo. Roberts yakoze amashusho ye ya mbere, yinjira mubucuruzi bwa WNBA afite imyaka 15. Muri kiriya gihe, yatangiye gukina imirimo myinshi mwishuri nko gutanga raporo, kubyara, kurasa no gutunganya. Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yakoraga kumiyoboro yamakuru.
Hagati aho, yagiye muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba gushaka documentaire. Nyuma yimyaka ibiri akorana nimpfubyi zintambara &amp; abahoze ari abasirikari babana muri Liberiya, yahisemo gukora documentaire ye yambere yuzuye, "Umujyi wa Rainbow Town" muri 2010. Yabaye kandi umukinnyi wa sinema akaba n'umwanditsi wa documentaire. Iyi filime irazenguruka inkuru yukuri yumugore warokoye ubuzima bwimfubyi zintambara zirenga 250 mugihe cyintambara yabenegihugu. Nyuma yo gushimwa cyane, iyi filime yanahawe igihembo n’umuyobozi wa Guild of America. Nyuma yaje kwerekanwa muri New York Fashion Week, mu nzu ndangamurage ya Tolerance International Festival Festival ndetse nandi maserukiramuco ya firime mpuzamahanga.
Nyuma yo gutsinda kwa filime, yinjiye nka producer muri NBCUniversal uruganda rukora uruganda, 'Peacock Productions'. Kuva mu 2011, yakoraga nka producer wungirije, producer wungirije hamwe na producer nyobozi kuri serivise zitandukanye za tereviziyo, umwihariko wa TV hamwe na documentaire.

Ayanda Daweti (wavutse 1990), umenyerewe nka Tuckshop Bafanaz, ni umukinnyi wa muzika wo muri Afurika y'Epfo akaba n'umucuranzi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe 'Chumani Langa' muri televiziyo izwi cyane ya Scandal!.
Yavutse mu 1990 akurira i Tsolo, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Nyina Nomalizo Daweti yapfuye azize indwara z'umutima asinziriye ubwo Ayanda yari afite imyaka 13. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa nyina, yimukiye i Mhlakulo, Tsolo mu burasirazuba bwa Cape hamwe na nyirasenge Stella Sondaba na nyirakuru Nomonde Sondaba. Nyuma yimyaka mike, yimukiye i Johannesburg. Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye, yimukiye i Cape Town yiga IT ndetse yiga n'ubuhanzi muri kaminuza y'ikoranabuhanga ya Tshwane, Pretoria.
Uruhare rwe rwa tereviziyo ruzwi cyane kandi ruzwi cyane rwanyuze kuri eTv isabune opera "Scandal!", aho yakinnye 'Chumani Langa'. Muri serial, yakinnye uruhare mubyukuri muto kurenza imyaka ye. Muri 2018 yatsindiye igihembo cya Golden Horn igihembo cyiza cya Filime ya TV muri Filime na Televiziyo yo muri Afrika yepfo kubera film ye "Okae Molao". Muri 2020, yatumiriwe kugira uruhare mu biganiro bya televiziyo "Amaraso Zaburi".
Usibye gukina, ni n'umucuranzi yakoresheje izina rya stage 'Tuckshop Bafanaz'. Yatangiye umuziki kubijyanye na nyirasenge, aho yasohoye inzira itandatu ya mbere ya EP. Muri 2019, yasohoye alubumu yeguriwe nyina. Yakundanye n'umukobwa witwa Xola kuva 2007 kugeza apfuye azize impanuka ikomeye y'imodoka mu 2010. Nyuma, yeguriye indirimbo 'Xola' kugirango amwibuke.

Tshepo Maseko (yavutse 7 Werurwe 1974), ni umukinnyi wa firime muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane ku ruhare rwe muri serial izwi cyane "Isidingo","Vehicle 19" and "More Than Just a Game".
Yavutse ku ya 7 Werurwe 1974 muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yabonye Impamyabumenyi y'igihugu muri Drama yakuye muri Pretoria Technikon ubu izwi ku izina rya Tshwane University of Technology. Nyuma yimyaka mike, yabaye Radio Itangaza kuri Motsweding FM.
Yashakanye na Masego Morapedi kuva 2013. Abashakanye bafite abakobwa batatu.
Yatangiye umwuga we afite imyaka 13. Mu 1998, yatangiriye kuri tereviziyo ya "Isidingo" aho yakinnye nka 'Parsons Matabane' imyaka myinshi. Mu 2005, yagaragaye muri filime ngufi "Blow" akina 'Nick'. Hanyuma muri 2007, yakinnye bwa mbere muri firime hamwe na "Poena Is Koning". Muri 2008, yashizeho umurongo wimyenda witwa 'Phologolo Active Wear' (PAW).
Yakinnye kandi muri serial "#Karektas" nkumushyitsi wicyamamare hanyuma kuri serial "Ba Kae?" nka Nyiricyubahiro. Muri 2011, yatsindiye Igihembo cyumukinnyi witwaye neza mu isabune ya TV kuri SAFTA. Muri uwo mwaka, yarushanwe mu marushanwa ya M-Net yo "kurokoka Afurika y'Epfo Survivor: Maldives" nk'umuhanzi w'icyamamare. Muri 2013, yakinnye muri firime mpuzamahanga ya "Vehicle 19". Muri filime, yashyize ahagaragara 'Lieutenant'.
Yakiriye Igihembwe cya munani cyuburere bukuze bwerekana ukuri "Kubuzima" Bwerekanwe kuri SABC2. Hanyuma yagaragaye muri make "Impeta". Hagati aho, kuva 2012 kugeza 2013, yabaye umuyobozi wa gahunda yumuziki w’amadini "Gospel Classics yo" mu gihe cya kabiri.

Michelle Beling-Pretorius, ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afrika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri serial izwi cyane "Isidingo","Egoli: Place of Gold".
Yavukiye kandi akurira mu burasirazuba bwa Cape, Afurika y'Epfo.
Yatangiye umwuga wo gukina akiri muto cyane. Yabanje kwinjira mu ikinamico yo muri Afurika yepfo anakina udukino twinshi mu gihugu hose. Mu 1999, yimukiye i Gauteng kugira ngo akore umwuga w'umwuga. Yakinnye uruhare rwo gushyigikira 'Janine Cullanan' muri serie "High Rollers" hanyuma yinjira muri televiziyo izwi cyane kuri televiziyo "Isidingo" aho yakinnye nka 'Wendy'.

Khanya Mkangisa (wavutse ku ya 13 Werurwe 1988), ni umukinnyi wa filimi muri Afurika yepfo. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri serial izwi cyane "Isidingo","Shattered, Step Up to a Start Up" and "Harvest".. Ni n'umunyamakuru kuri tereviziyo akaba n'umuhanzi wa DJ. azwi kuri YoTv kimwe no gukundana.
Yavutse ku ya 13 Werurwe 1988 i Peddie, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yarangije muri AFDA, Ishuri ryubukungu bwo guhanga.
Yakundanye n'umuraperi, J Molley kumurusha imyaka 10 aho ibihuha byatangiriye mu Kwakira 2019.
Afite imyaka 14, yinjiye kuri tereviziyo maze aba umunyamakuru wa Yo YV. Yakomeje gukora mu musaruro imyaka itatu. Hanyuma yimutse kugirango yerekane siyanse "yubumenyi yitwa Knock Knock". Mu 2004, yerekanye televiziyo ye ya mbere "yakinnye muri serie Mthunzini." "Com". Nyuma yaje gukina muri "Lab1" nka 'Refilwe' na "Ugugu noAndile". Nkumunyamakuru, yakiriye igitaramo cyo kubyina 'Shield Teen'. Hagati aho, yagaragaye cyane mu bitaramo bizwi cyane muri "Zone 14" muri 2011 na "Intersexions" muri 2012. Muri 2012, yakinnye muri BBC "yise Mad Dogs III" afite uruhare 'Anna'. Hanyuma muri 2013, yinjiye mu bakinnyi basanzwe ba serial "Zabalaza" akina 'Mpilo'.
Muri 2019, yerekanye bwa mbere nk'umuhanzi wa DJ maze akora ibitaramo muri Jozi to Quilox weekend weekend i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Muri 2020, yagaragaye bwa mbere muri sabune izwi cyane "Muvhango" afite uruhare rwa 'Mbali'.

Keabetswe 'KB' Motsilanyane (yavutse 8 Mata 1979), uzwi cyane nka KB Mamosadi, ni umuhanzi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo ukora ibitaramo, umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w'indirimbo, producer, umukinnyi wa firime, umubyinnyi ndetse n'umugore w'ubucuruzi. KB yakuze ashishikarira umuziki nubuhanzi muri iyo ntara. Yinjiye mu itsinda ry’icyamamare muri Afurika y'Epfo, Crowded Crew, wamenyekanye cyane mu mpera za 90. Mu 2001, KB yinjiye muri e-TV isabune Backstage nka we, byahuriranye no kumurika alubumu ye ya mbere, Beautiful Vibrations (2002), yagaragayemo indirimbo yakunzwe cyane 'OA lla', imuha izina rya Mamosadi. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri serie izwi cyane "Backstage", Mthunzini.com, "Rhythm City" and "7de Laan".
Yavutse ku ya 8 Mata 1979 i Moruleng, muri Afurika y'Epfo
Yigeze gushyingiranwa na Terry Pinana mbere yuko batandukana muri 2007. Ni nyina w'umuhungu umwe.
KB ifite alubumu 6 kugeza ubu, zamugize umuhanzi uzwi cyane watsindiye ibihembo muri Afrika yepfo. Ni imyidagaduro yuzuye yasangiye stage n'abahanzi bakomeye nka: Eve, Sibongile Khumalo, Busta Rhymes, Beyonce, Prime Circle, Ashanti, Dwele na Brandy.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina mu 1999 akina amakinamico. Azwi cyane mubyerekanwa "Backstage" aho yakinnye nka 'KayBee'. Kohereza urugendo rwe kuri iki gitaramo, nyuma yakinnye nka 'Lucilla Vilakazi' muri televiziyo izwi cyane ya "Rhythm City". Yabaye umukinnyi usanzwe muri uruhererekane kugeza igihe azagenda muri 2015. Muri 2017, yinjiye muri Afrika yepfo Afrika yisabune izwi cyane yisabune "7de Laan" kandi akina nkumunyamategeko ukomeye, 'Lesedi'. Yakinnye kandi muri saison ya kabiri "yuruhererekane rwa Thola" nka 'Dibuseng Makwarela'. Yakinnye kandi murukurikirane "Mtunzini.com" nka 'Phaphama Molefe'. KB yatsindiye ibihembo bibiri byigihembo cya Golden Horn igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza mu isabune ya TV muri 2008 na 2011.
