Dyana Gaye (wavutse 1975) ni umuyobozi w'amafirime mu bufaransa ariko aturuka muri senegali.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Gaye yavukiye i Paris mu 1975, umukobwa w’abimukira bo muri Senegali, yiga muri kaminuza ya Paris 8 Vincennes-Saint-Denis yiga filime. Yakiriye inkunga ya Louis Lumière - Villa Médicis inkunga mu 1999 kubera amashusho ye "Une femme pour Souleymane". Gaye yayoboye mu 2000, kandi yahawe igihembo kinini cya Jury mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Dakar. Mu 2004, yari umwe mu bahatanira umwanya wa Rolex Mentor na Protégé Arts Initiative. Gaye yayoboye filime ngufi "J'ai deux amours", mu rwego "rw'umushinga wa Paris la métisse" mu 2005. Umwaka ukurikira, yayoboye "Ousmane", byagenze neza cyane. Yakiriye nomination ya Filime ngufi nziza muri César Awards. Muri 2009, Gaye yakoze kandi ayobora "Saint Louis Blues", yari comedi yumuziki. Yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Lokarno na Sundance Film Festival, yari umwe mu batanu ba nyuma ba Filime ngufi nziza muri César Awards. Filime yatoranijwe, iterwa inkunga kandi ikorwa mubice bigize gahunda yibanze ya Afrika.
Yabaye igihembo cya 2012 cyigihembo cya Gan Foundation. Gaye yayoboye "Munsi ya Starry Sky" muri 2013, abaye film ya mbere yerekana amashusho hagati ya Dakar, Turin, na New York City. Yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto maze ahabwa igihembo kinini cya Jury hamwe nigihembo cyabateze amatwi muri Premiers Plans Angers Festival. Gaye yavuze ko iyi filime ari ugukomeza gukina filime ngufi zabanjirije iyi, no gukora ubushakashatsi ku ndangamuntu nyinshi ndetse n’abinjira.
Gaye ni umunyamuryango wa Collectif 50/50, umuryango ufite intego yo kugira uburinganire hagati y’abagabo n’abagore mu nganda za firime, ndetse no guteza imbere ubudasa muri sinema.

Marina Niava (wavutse 1985) ni umuyobozi wa firime ya Cote d'Ivoire, utunganya firime, n'umwanditsi.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Niava ni umukobwa muto wa Pierre na Cécile Niava, bombi bigisha indimi. Yatangiye gukunda ubuhanzi nubuvanganzo kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi byubuvanganzo. Yarangije muri Lycée Sainte Marie d'Abidjan ahabwa igihembo cya Series A Excellence Award. Niava amaze kubona impamyabumenyi ye mu itangazamakuru no gutunganya amajwi n'amashusho yakuye muri Institut des Science et Techniques de la Communication, Niava yatsindiye amarushanwa ayobowe na Radio JAM i Abidjan maze atangira umwuga we nk'umutoza. Nyuma yaje kuba umunyamakuru muri Afurika 24. Niava yateje imbere sinema mugihe cyo gufata amashusho yamamaza.
Kuva mu 2009 kugeza 2010, Niava yabaye umwanditsi umwe mu gihembwe cya 1 cya "serivise Teenager", yakiriye igihembo cy’uruhererekane rwiza rwa Afurika mu iserukiramuco rya Vues d'Afrique ryabereye i Montreal. Yimukiye i Oslo, muri Noruveje mu 2010 aba umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho mu kigo ndangamuco nyafurika. Niava yagenzuye ibirori bya firime ya Kino Afrika 2010 na 2011 muri Oslo. Yabaye igihembo cya BENIANH International Foundation cyatsindiye igihembo cya buruse muri 2012.
Mu Kwakira 2012, yayoboye documentaire ye ya mbere, "Noirs au soleil levant", ivuga ku buzima bw’abanyeshuri bo muri Afurika i Tsukuba, mu Buyapani. Filime ya mbere ya Niava ngufi, "21", yarangiye mu Kuboza 2013. Yatewe inkunga n'amafaranga yatanzwe n'Umuryango mpuzamahanga de la Francophonie. "21" ivuga kubyerekeye umukobwa ukiri muto udashobora kwihanganira umukunzi wa nyina kandi niwe filime yonyine yo muri Afrika yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Oakland. Niava yarayoboye gito mahano "Worse" muri 2014. Yakoze nkumuhuzabikorwa wihariye wa firime "Advantageous" 2015.
Niava yarangije icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza cya Filime na Televiziyo muri Academy ya Art University. Muri 2017, Niava yanditse igitabo cye cya mbere, "American Dreamer". Yabaye finale ya 10 Prix Ivoire pour la Littérature Africaine d'Expression Francophone.

Sarah Magaajyia Silberfeld (yavutse 30 Kanama 1996) ni umukinnyi n'umuyobozi wa filimi muri Nijeriya ariko akomoka mu Bufaransa
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Silberfeld ni umukobwa w'umuyobozi wa firime Rahmatou Keïta n'umunyamakuru w’umufaransa Antoine Silber. Yatangiye gukina kuri theatre yaho afite imyaka 11. Silberfeld yakuriye mu Bufaransa ariko agenda kenshi mu Bugereki, Nigeriya, na Mali, aba i Los Angeles imyaka itatu. Yatangiye gukina filime muri 2011, i "La Lisière". Silberfeld yize ibijyanye no gukina mu kigo cya Lee Strasberg mu 2013, muri Playhouse West Repertory Theatre muri 2014 ndetse no muri Studio ya Susan Batson mu 2015. Afite imyaka 18, yanditse kandi ayobora film ye ya mbere ngufi, "Me Hano" kandi afatanya kuyobora "Ride cyangwa Die" irimo Piper de Palma na Roxane Depardieu.
Muri 2016, Silberfeld yagize uruhare rwe rwa mbere muri "The Wedding Ring", iyobowe na nyina kandi yatewe inkunga yose binyuze mumafaranga ya Afrika. Yakinnye na Tiyaa, umukobwa ukiri muto ujya kwiga mubufaransa agakundana numugabo ukomoka mubyubahiro. Filime ibaye film ya mbere ya Nigeriya yakinnye muri Awards Awards. Muri 2017, yayoboye filime ye ngufi "Vagabonds", yakinnye na Danny Glover. Muri uwo mwaka, Silberfeld yabonye impamyabumenyi ya filozofiya na Sorbonne. Mugihe cya kaminuza, yize icyongereza abinyujije muri firime zo muri Amerika.
Yabaye umuyobozi mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime ya Friborg 2019 kandi atera inkunga Amasezerano y’uburinganire n'ubwuzuzanye. Silberfeld yerekanye documentaire ya nyina "Al'lèèssi." "." "." "Une actrice africaine" (2004), ifoto yumukinnyi wa Nigeriya Zalika Souley.

Roukiata Ouedraogo (wavutse 1979) ni umwanditsi w'amakinamico ya Burkinabé, umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umunyarwenya muri Burkinafaso.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Yakuriye muri Fada N'Gourma, umukobwa w'umukozi wa Leta. Se yari yagiye mu ikinamico ryaho kandi yari inshuti na bagenzi be b'umupira w'amaguru hamwe n'umukinnyi uzwi cyane Sotigui Kouyaté.. Se wabo ni umutware wa Mossi wa Soumiaga. Akiri muto, Ouedraogo yimukiye Ouagadougou kugirango akomeze amashuri. Mu mashure yisumbuye, yinjiye mu mugwi w'amakinamico yaho hanyuma azenguruka igihugu. Kugira ngo abone amafaranga, yafunguye salon ntoya yo gutunganya imisatsi hafi y'urugo rwe maze ategura imyenda. Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi ye, Ouedraogo yimukiye i Paris mu 2000, aho musaza we yari atuye. Yari afite akazi kadasanzwe, kandi yirukanwe nk'umubitsi muri mini-market kubera ko yitiranyije amafaranga na CFA.
Yakoze nk'umuhanzi wo kwisiga no kwerekana imideli imyaka myinshi. Mu 2007, Ouedraogo yahisemo kwibanda ku ikinamico maze yemerwa muri Cours Florent nyuma y’isuzuma. Mu rwego rwo gukora amasomo, yanditse kandi ayobora ikinamico ye ya mbere, "Yennenga, icyamamare cya Mossé." Nyuma yo kwakirwa neza n'abamwigisha, ikinamico yabanje gukinirwa kuri teatre ya Comédie de la Passerelle mu 2008. Ishingiye kuri imwe mu migani yashinze muri Burkinafaso, kandi Ouedraogo yakinnye nk'umwamikazi wo mu kinyejana cya 11. Ku bwe, kwandika ikinamico byamufashije guhangana n'agahinda ko kubura se na murumuna we.
Muri Nzeri 2010, ikinamico ye yakorewe bwa mbere mu kigo ndangamuco cya Gambidi muri Ouagadougou, kandi cyerekanwe kuri televiziyo y'igihugu. Kubaho kwa nyirarume muri iki gitaramo byari ikimenyetso cyo kwemeza inzira yumwuga ishobora gucibwa intege numuntu ukomokamo nka Ouedraogo. Ikinamico yongeye kugarurwa nka comedi yumuziki, hamwe nababyinnyi umunani nabacuranzi babiri. Muri Mata 2011, Ouedraogo yateguye ikinamico yo gutera inkunga ONG Fitima, ifasha abana bamugaye. Yakoranye mu gitaramo "ingingo ya 13" yitiriwe Itangazo ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu, ryakozwe mu mwaka wa 2012 mu bitaramo byaberaga mu mihanda mu Bufaransa. Muri 2013, yakoze igitabo cyerekana ubuzima bw'umugore umwe yerekana "Ouagadougou pressé", ku ngingo yo kwimukira mu Bufaransa.
Ouedraogo yatangiye gukina filime muri Nzeri 2013, muri filime ngufi "Marie et les gargouilles". Yagaragaye muri filime "Samba"2014. Muri uwo mwaka, Ouedraogo yegerejwe na Dani Kouyaté kugira ngo akine mu rukurikirane "rw'inyandiko L'Amour en cage". Muri 2015, yakinnye mu ikinamico "Roukiata tombe le masque", urwenya ku gukebwa kwe. Yagaragaye mu gitaramo "Le Parlement du rire" kuri Canal +. Muri Mata 2017, Ouedraogo yatangiye kwandika inkingi kuri Inter Inter y'Ubufaransa. Muri 2018, yakinnye muri "Je demande la route", yerekanwe muri Festival Off d'Avignon.
Ouedraogo yashakanye na Stéphane Eliard, umuyobozi wa firime. Avuga Igifaransa na Bambara.

Deolinda Inês Caetano Kinzimba (yavutse ku ya 11 Gicurasi 1995) ni umukinnyi wa firime akaba aririmba ndetse ashobora kwandika indirimbo cyanwa filime Angola.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Kinzimba yavukiye i Luanda akurira muri Ingombota. Yavuze ko yagize ubuzima bwiza kandi ko ashishikajwe n'umuziki kuva akiri muto. Mubyo akora harimo Phyllis Hyman na Selena Quintanilla. Kinzimba yabaga muri Tanzaniya akiri ingimbi kuko yari afite mushiki we wakoraga kuri ambasade ya Angola. Yimukiye i Guimarães, Porutugali mu 2014 kwiga no kugira amahirwe meza. Kinzimba yize amategeko muri Porto.
Muri 2016, yatsindiye igihembwe cya gatatu cya Ijwi rya Portugal. Kinzimba yiswe " Whitney Houston mushya" ubwo yakoraga indirimbo yakunzwe cyane ya Houston " "I Have Nothing " ashimwa cyane. Yakinnye " "I Will Always Love You " ya Mariah Carey na " A Moment Like This" na Kelly Clarkson kurangiza. Kinzimba yongeye guhura na nyina, uwo yari amaze imyaka ibiri atabona. Kubera intsinzi, Kinzimba yasinyanye amasezerano na Universal. Muri Nzeri 2016, yakinnye mu gitaramo "Dentro".
Indirimbo ye ya mbere, "Primeira Vez", yasohotse mu Kwakira 2016. Ugushyingo 2017, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere yise. "Deolinda Kinzimba" yakiriye inyenyeri eshatu nigice ziva muri Sábado, ashima amarangamutima ya Kimzimba n'imikorere ye ariko anenga ibizaba byavuzwe. Nubwo bimeze bityo, iki kinyamakuru cyavuze ko ari umukino wambere hamwe nindirimbo nyinshi zikomeye. Yitabiriye Iserukiramuco RTP da Canção 2017, ku butumire bw'umwanditsi w'indirimbo Rita Redshoes, agera ku mukino wa nyuma w'ibyo birori.

Samantha Mugatsia (wavutse 1992) ni umukinnyi w'amafirime muri Kenya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Mugatsia yavutse mu 1992, umukobwa wa Grace Gitau. Yakuriye i Nairobi kandi akora nk'ingoma y'itsinda The Machine Machine. Yari yaranakoze akazi ko kwerekana imideli. Mugatsia yize amategeko muri Kaminuza Gatolika yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ariko ahagarika amasomo ye kugira ngo atangire umwuga we wo gukina. Mu Gushyingo 2016, yari yitabiriye pop-in y'abahanzi ubwo yamenyanwaga n'umuyobozi wa firime Wanuri Kahiu, amubwira ko yanditse inyandiko kandi ashaka kwerekana Mugatsia. Nubwo atigeze akora, Mugatsia yemeye uruhare.
Muri 2018, Mugatsia yakinnye na Kena Mwaura, umwe mu bantu babiri bakomeye, muri "Rafiki" ya Kahiu. Iyi nkuru ishingiye ku gitabo cyitwa "Jambula Igiti" cyanditswe n'umwanditsi wa Uganda Monica Arac de Nyeko kandi kirasobanura urukundo ruteye imbere hagati y’abakobwa babiri aho bibujijwe kuryamana kw'abahuje igitsina. Mu rwego rwo kwitegura uruhare, Mugatsia yafashe amezi menshi yamasomo yo gukina kandi yitoza gukoresha imyitozo yindorerwamo no kubaho mubitekerezo. Iyi filime yari itemewe muri Kenya, aho kuryamana kw'abahuje igitsina bitemewe. "Rafiki" abaye film ya mbere yo muri Kenya yerekanwe mu Iserukiramuco rya sinema i Cannes. Ann Hornaday wo muri Washington Post yise imikorere ya Mugatsia "yitonze." Mugatsia yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu iserukiramuco rya FESPACO rya 2019 ryabereye i Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso kubera kwerekana Kena. Ihagarikwa rya filime ryakuweho nyuma gato yuko Kahiu atanga ikirego, kugira ngo yerekane muri Kenya kugira ngo yemererwe guhabwa ibihembo bya Academy.
Mugatsia yerekana ko ari iby'umwuka. Yanze kugira icyo atangaza ku mibonano mpuzabitsina ye, ariko agirira impuhwe umuryango wa LGBT.

Lucrécia Paco (yavutse 19 Ukwakira 1969) ni umukinnyi wamafirime muri Mozambike. Afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi ba filime bazwi cyane muri Mozambike.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Paco yakuriye i Maputo. Akiri umwana, yakundaga kuririmba no kubyina imiziki gakondo, yakandamijwe cyane muri kiriya gihe mbere y’ubwigenge bwa Mozambique mu 1975. Paco yakubiswe ku ishuri azira gukoresha indimi gakondo. Nyuma y'ubwigenge, guverinoma y’abasosiyalisiti yashishikarije amatsinda y’ubuhanzi, kandi yitabira kuririmba, kubyina, no gusoma imivugo.
Mu gihe mu gihe cy'intambara yabenegihugu ya Mozambike, Paco yerekeje ibitekerezo ku ikinamico mu rwego rwa politiki. Yagaragaye muri documentaire ya "Maputo Mulher" 1984. Mu 1986, Paco yari umwe mubashinze itsinda rya Mutumbela Gogo, itsinda ryambere ryamakinamico yabigize umwuga muri Mozambike kugeza na nubu. Yayobowe na firime nyinshi z'Abasoviyeti yarebye, anakora udukino duto twerekana uko kuba Mozambike byari bimeze. Mu rwego rwo gushyigikira itsinda ryamakinamico, Paco nabandi banyamuryango bashinze imigati.
Paco yafashe ikiruhuko cyimyaka itanu kuri stage kubera umunaniro. Paco yatumiwe na Instituto Itaú Umuco muri Berezile muri 2009. Yitabiriye umushinga wa Antidote mu mahugurwa mpuzamahanga ku bikorwa by’umuco mu turere tw’amakimbirane, akoresheje ikinamico Mulher Asfalto. Muri 2010, Paco yakinnye muri film "Quero Ser uma Estrela". Nyuma yaho gato, yakinnye nyamukuru muri "Nineteens", telenovela ya mbere ya Mozambike.

Nicole Amarteifio (yavutse 1982) ni umuyobozi wa firime yo muri Gana, producer, n'umwanditsi.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Amarteifio yavukiye muri Gana ariko yimukira i Londres nk'umwana w'amezi atatu kubera guhirika ubutegetsi mu gihugu cye, aba mu Bwongereza imyaka itandatu. Sekuru, komiseri w'akarere k'abazungu, yashakanye na nyirakuru muri Gana mu 1945. Nyuma yaje kwimukana n'umuryango we i Scarsdale, New York, ariko buri mwaka aruhukira muri Gana. Igihe yigaga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Scarsdale, umunyeshuri bigana yatanze igitekerezo cyo guturika Afurika kugira ngo ikibazo cya sida gikemuke. Ababyeyi ba Amarteifio basubiye muri Gana mu 1997. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Afurika na Afro-Amerika yakuye muri kaminuza ya Brandeis mu 2004. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yabonye akazi i Washington, DC nk'umujyanama mu iterambere ry'ubukungu bwa Afurika muri The Whitaker Group, akorera Rosa Whitaker.
Mu 2006, Amarteifio yimukiye i Accra, muri Gana, kugira ngo akore mu iterambere ry'ubukungu muri Fondasiyo Nyafurika. Nyuma gato yo kwimukira muri Afrika, yagize igitekerezo cyo gukora igitaramo nka "Sex and the City" i Accra. Amarteifio yasubiye muri Amerika kwiga kaminuza ya Georgetown maze ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu itumanaho ry’ibigo mu 2010. I Georgetown, yize munsi ya Mike Long, wamushishikarizaga kwandika amashusho. Amarteifio yabonye akazi muri Bank y'isi nk'umuntu wa mbere ushinzwe imbuga nkoranyambaga muri Accra. Amezi atari make nyuma yo gusubira muri Gana, yatangiye kumenyekanisha igitekerezo cye kubanyamwuga ba tereviziyo, banga gukora umushinga ariko bamutera inkunga yo kwandika igitaramo.
Amarteifio yashyizeho bije maze amenya ko akeneye amafaranga ahagije kugirango atangire aho gutanga ibihe byuzuye. Kugira ngo yige kubyara umusaruro, yakurikiranye imirimo yabatunganya ibitangazamakuru byinshi hanyuma yiyandikisha mumasomo ya kaminuza yabaturage. Amarteifio yavumbuye inyandiko zijyanye "Sex and the City" hamwe n'ibiganiro bifitanye isano kuri interineti, maze abikoresha nk'icyitegererezo cyo kwandika, ndetse n'inkuru z'inshuti ze muri Afurika. Yabonye abakinnyi mu guhamagara, maze avugana na mugenzi we bigana, Maame Adjei, kugira ngo bakine Zainab. Adjei yagiye mwishuri muri Connecticut hamwe na Nana Mensah, Amarteifio yahisemo kumiterere ya Sadé. Yifashishije abakozi ba firime bo muri Gana, Amarteifio ahanini yarashe igitaramo cye muri wikendi nijoro kugirango atavuguruzanya nakazi ke muri Banki yisi.
Igihembwe cya mbere cyerekana, "Umujyi wa Afurika", cyasohotse kuri Youtube muri Werurwe 2014. Bikurikirana ubuzima bwinshuti eshanu zari zasubiye muri Afrika nyuma yo gutura mumahanga no kugendana urukundo, umwuga, nubuzima bwa nijoro mumurwa mukuru wa Gana, hamwe nibiganiro byukuri kubyerekeye igitsina. Amarteifio yari igamije gukora ibiganiro kubyerekeye umunya nyafurika, no gukuraho kirazira. Urukurikirane rwanenzwe guhagararira abantu batoranijwe badafite byinshi bahuriyeho nabagore benshi bo muri Afrika. Amarteifio yakuyeho kunegura, abaza igitekerezo cyumugore usanzwe wumugore. Igihembwe cya kabiri cyerekanwa cyasohotse muri 2016. Urukurikirane rwe rwa kabiri rwa televiziyo, rukora politiki yiswe "Repubulika", narwo rwasohotse mu 2016, rushingiye ku manza zabayeho muri Accra.
Amarteifio yiswe " Shonda Rhimes yo muri Gana." Yiswe umwe mu bagore 100 ba OkayAfrica muri 2018. Filime ye ya mbere yakinnye, "Mbere yimihigo", yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Seattle muri 2018. Urwenya rwurukundo, rukurikira isano iri hagati ya Afua na Nii mugihe batekereza kurushinga.

Doria Achour (wavutse ku ya 1 Werurwe 1991) ni umukinnyi ndetse n'umuyobozi wa firimi mu Bufaransa ariko akomoka muri Tuniziya
Achour ni umukobwa wumuyobozi wa firime wa tuniziya akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime Lotfi Achour na nyina w’Uburusiya akaba umwanditsi w'amakinamico. Mukuru we ni umwanditsi w'amakinamico, kandi afite murumuna we. Achour yakuriye mu cyiciro cya 12 cya Paris mu kirere cyari "icyerekezo cy'ubuhanzi, ariko ntabwo ari burugumesitiri." Akiri umwana, yaherekeje ababyeyi be mu myitozo yabo no mu bitaramo byabo.
Mu 2002, Achour yerekanye umukobwa wa Sergi López muri "Les Femmes... ou les enfants d'abord... [fr]", iyobowe na Manuel Poirier. Nyina yamufashije kubona uruhare, abona itangazo muri "Libération". Nyuma yuruhare rwe rwa mbere, Achor yafashe amasomo yo gukina umwaka umwe muri Théâtre des Déchargeurs. Yagize uruhare rwa kabiri muri firime nkeya, nka "L'enemi naturel" na "L'École pour tous". Kugira ngo yibanze ku myigire ye, Achour yahagaritse umwuga we wa firime imyaka myinshi. Achour yabonye impamyabumenyi y’ubuvanganzo yakuye muri kaminuza ya Paris-Sorbonne nyuma aza kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri sinema yakuye muri kaminuza ya Paris Diderot.
Muri 2012, Achour yakinnye umusore Yasmeen muri "La fille publique", kandi imico ye yahumekewe nubuzima bwa mbere bwa Cheyenne Carron. Mu mwaka wa 2013, Achour yayoboye filime ye ya mbere ngufi, "Laisse-moi finir", ku ngingo y'ubuzima muri Tuniziya nyuma y'Isoko ry'Abarabu igihe abayisilamu bigaruriraga. Yerekanwe mu minsi mikuru myinshi kandi ihabwa igihembo cya Audience muri Made in Med marushanwa ya firime ngufi yo muri Kamena 2014. Imyitwarire ye muri "La fille publique yakuruye" umuyobozi Sylvie Ohayon, wakinnye uyu mukinnyi ukiri muto nka Stephanie muri film ya"Papa Was Not a Rolling Ston". Muri 2016, Achour yakinnye muri filime ye ya mbere yicyarabu, "Yaka Ibyiringiro". Yayoboye filime ngufi "Le reste est l'œuvre de l'homme", yatsindiye igihembo cya Jury mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance 2017. Yakinnye na Leila, umukobwa wabuze, muri Naidra Ayadi ya film ya "Ma fille ya" 2018.
Achur ni agnostic. Ni umukunzi wibitabo byo hagati.

Maji-da Abdi (yavutse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1970) ni umuyobozi wa firime na producer ukomeye muri Etiyopiya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Abdi yavukiye Dire Dawa, yabaga i Addis Abeba kugeza afite imyaka ine. Nyuma y’impinduramatwara yo mu 1974, nyina wari warahukanye na se, ahungira hamwe na murumuna we i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Abdi yarangije amashuri abanza nayisumbuye muri Kenya. Afite imyaka 17, yimukiye muri Kanada n'umuryango we kwiga ubucuruzi. Abdi yiyandikishije muri kaminuza y’iburengerazuba bwa Ontario, Abdi amenyera imico mpuzamahanga. Yumvaga atandukanye nabenshi mubanyeshuri bigana, bifuzaga kubona akazi kuri Wall Street, arangiza gahunda mubuvanganzo bwigifaransa. Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi, Abdi yakoze imyaka itari mike mu itangazamakuru ndetse no gutunganya film.
Abdi yari mu rugendo muri Nepal mu myaka ya za 90 ubwo yahuraga na Bernardo Bertolucci, wari mu gihe cyo gufata amashusho ya "Buda". Yahisemo kuba umuntu wimenyereza umwuga. Mu 2001, Abdi yasubiye muri Etiyopiya maze ayobora filime ye ya mbere yise "“Uruzi rutandukanya",” yiga ku buzima bwa buri munsi bw'abagore b'Abanyetiyopiya mu gihe cy'intambara ya Eritereya na Etiyopiya. Filime yahawe igihembo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Kanada.
Abdi nawe yagize uruhare mugutunganya film. Mu 2001, yakoze firime ngufi ya "Data" na Ermias Woldeamlak, asuzuma umubano wumuryango nyafurika. Abdi yakoranye na Abderrahmane Sissako nk'umuproducer n'umushushanya w'imyambarire muri firime ye "Gutegereza umunezero" (2003) na "Bamako" (2006). Yakoze muri joriji ya firime ngufi na Cinéfondation muiserukiramuco rya sinema i Cannes muri 2013. Abdi ahangayikishijwe nibibazo byamazi kimwe nibidukikije muri rusange. Yashakanye na Sissako.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Abdi yakoze iserukiramuco rya firime Amashusho Yingenzi, iserukiramuco rya mbere ryahariwe firime ngufi za Etiyopiya. Yari yarateguye gukora ibirori nk'ibi mu myaka itari mike ariko amaherezo ahabwa inkunga na Minisiteri y’umuco ya Etiyopiya na Olivier Poivre d'Arvor. Mu iserukiramuco rya mbere, Abdi yakoze amahugurwa yo gufasha abakora amafilime bato kwitoza. Yavuze ko imyaka itandatu mbere y’ibirori, sinema yo muri Etiyopiya yasigaye inyuma mu bihugu byinshi ariko urwego rw’umusaruro rukiyongera. Usibye imirimo ya firime, Abdi akorera Orbs, ikinyamakuru cyibanda kuri siyanse, ubuhanzi numwuka.

Nomsa Kupi Manaka (wavutse 1962) ni umubyinnyi n'umukinnyi wa filime, umukinnyi wa koreografi wo muri Afurika yepfo
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Manaka yavutse 1962 i Orlando, mu mujyi wa Soweto muri Johannesburg, Afurika y'Epfo. Amaze gutozwa ballet ya kera, yigisha kubyina muri Funda Centre, yashinzwe numugabo we, Matsemela Manaka. Mu 1989, yakinnye mu ikinamico, "Gorée", yashyize aha hantu hateranira imbata zerekeza muri Amerika, kandi zivuga ku rugendo rwo mu mwuka rw'umukobwa ukiri muto. Uyu mugore yiga kubyina nyafurika, bimuganisha ku kwishakira ibisubizo. Azenguruka umugabane arangirira i Gorée, muri Senegali. Agezeyo, ahura n’umugore ukuze, wakinwe na Sibongile Khumalo, amufasha kumenya umurage we nyafurika.
Mu 1991, Manaka yashinze ikinyamakuru cy'imbyino, "Umukororombya w'Amizero", maze akora choreografiya, harimo n'iya opera "Umukobwa wa Nebo", mu 1993. Mu bihangano bye bya koreografiya, ahuza imigenzo nyafurika ndetse nuburyo bwo kubyina byubu. Umugabo we, Matsemela Manaka, yapfuye mu 1998 azize impanuka y'imodoka.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Manaka yagaragaye muri filime ngufi ya Tiisetso Dladla yayobowe na "Exiled", ivuga ku mugore wumvikanye mu buhungiro bwe muri politiki muri Amerika mu 1990. Mu myaka ya za 2010, yabanaga n'umucuranzi Hugh Masekela, wari urwaye kanseri ya prostate. We ubwe yari yarasuzumwe kanseri yintanga mu 2016. Yavuze ku kuntu babona iyi ndwara ati: "Byari ngombwa ko twembi twohereza ubutumwa ko tugomba kwishimira ubuzima bwacu n'abo turi bo. Ntidukwiye kureka kanseri ikatumanura. " Hugh Masekela yapfuye muri Mutarama 2018. Manaka yakize indwara nyuma y'amezi ya chimiotherapie. Mu gihe cyo gukira kwe, Manaka yazanye igitekerezo cyo kubyina kubyina "Dance Out of Kanseri", yaberaga kuri Theatre Joburg yo gukusanya amafaranga ku barwayi ba kanseri.

Cecil Moller (wavutse 1967) ni umuyobozi na producr wa firime muri Namibiya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Moller yavukiye muri Namibiya mu 1967 akaza muri Amerika kwiga ubuhanzi. Ashishikajwe no kumenya ibintu bifatika, yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu itumanaho yakuye muri Ramapo College. Moller yakoraga nka injeniyeri yijwi, cinematografi numwanditsi wibikorwa byinshi mbere yo kuyobora firime ye. Yatangiye gukina filime yerekanwe bwa mbere na "No Plot" mu 1991. Nibwo bwa mbere muri firime nyinshi zakozwe mu myaka ya za 90. Mu 2000, itegeko rya komisiyo ishinzwe amafilime ya Namibiya ryatowe kugirango rizamure abayobozi ba firime nka Moller.
Mu 2001, Moller yakoze ubushakashatsi ku mibereho yindaya muri Walvis Bay zishingiye ku bikamyo byoherezwa mu bihe byagenwe muri filime ngufi yatsindiye "Inzu y'urukundo". Yashakaga kumenya impamvu abo bagore, bamwe muri bo yari azi kuva ku ishuri, babaye abakora imibonano mpuzabitsina. Kuva 2004 kugeza 2007, yabaye umuyobozi wa komisiyo ishinzwe amafilime ya Namibiya. Moller yavuze ko Namibia yabuze 50% by’amafaranga ashobora guturuka ku bicuruzwa mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga mu gihugu nka "Generation Kill" kubera kubura ibikorwa remezo.
Moller yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no gutunganya amashusho muri kaminuza ya Chapman mu 2010. Yasohokanye na firime ngufi "Marvin na Stevie n'Imana" nyuma gato yo kurangiza amashuri. Mu 2016, Moller bareganwa umusaruro Perivi Katjavivi i 'S Ikiranga mbere film "bitaboneka," gucukumbura nsanganyamatsiko ya post-cy'ubukoloni Namibia ndangamuntu no existentialism. Yabonye igihembo cyiza cya Diregiteri wa Filime muri Namibian Film &amp; Theatre Awards 2017.

Nadine Ibrahim (wavutse 1993/1994) ni umuyobozi wa firime ya Nigeriya.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Ibrahim yavukiye i Kaduna akurira ari Umuyisilamu. Nyina, Amina J. Mohammed yahoze ari minisitiri w’ibidukikije muri Nijeriya akaba n'Umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije w’umuryango w’abibumbye. Igihe yari akiri muto, yashishikajwe no kuvuga inkuru no gukina filime aho kuba amasomo gakondo. Yavuye muri Nijeriya yerekeza mu Bwongereza afite imyaka 14 yiga itangazamakuru no gutunganya amashusho muri kaminuza ya Gloucestershire. Mubindi bintu, yakoraga imishinga yumuryango w’abibumbye na firime za Fictionless. Ibrahim yari producer wungirije wa "Hakkunde", hafi ya Nigeriya yepfo uhura numuco wamajyaruguru kunshuro yambere.
Filime ye ngufi ya documentaire "Through Her Eyes" yasohotse muri 2017. Iravuga amateka ya Azeeza, umukobwa wimyaka 12 washimuswe ahinduka umwiyahuzi. Iyi filime yari kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Los Angeles kandi yatowe mu cyiciro cya filime ngufi mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime muri Afrika. Kubitsinda ryitangazamakuru EbonyLife firime na tereviziyo yakoresheje firime avuga inkuru zamoko yo mumajyaruguru ya Nijeriya, nka Hausa, Fulani, Igbira, Igala, Tiv na Gbagyi. Ni umuyobozi mukuru wa sosiyete ikorera mu gihugu cya Nigeriya, Nailamedia, yashinzwe mu 2017. Filime ye ya documentaire ngufi yitwa "Marked", yakoranye imyaka ibiri yatewe inkunga no gushyira ikimenyetso cya nyirasenge, yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya Aké ryabereye i Lagos muri 2019. Ireba inkovu gakondo, ikwirakwizwa muri Nijeriya ariko nanone ikaba kirazira, ariko, ubwiza bwayo nibyo Ibrahim yashakaga gutsinda.
Ibrahim yanditse Tyler Perry, Alfred Hitchcock, Spike Lee and Ang Leee nk'intangarugero. Iyindi ngaruka ikomeye avuga ni nyina, binyuze mu mirimo ye muri guverinoma yamenye ubukene na ruswa muri Nijeriya. Yagizwe umwe mu basore bakomeye ba firime bo muri Nigeriya bareba. Ibrahim yashakanye na Nasir i Abuja muri 2017.

Ngardy Conteh George niUmuyobozi, umwanditsi, kandi atunganya firime ukomoka muri Siyera Lewone ariko yibera muri Kanada.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ngardy Conteh George yavukiye iFreetown, Sierra Leone kandi ni umuhererezi mu bana bane. Mu bwana bwe, umuryango we wimukiye i Toronto, muri Kanada mu 1981. Conteh George yagiye mu ishuri rya Leta rya Jesse Ketchum (1981-1992), n'Amashuri yisumbuye y'Amajyaruguru (1992-1995) mbere yo kurangiza mu kigo cya Vaughan Road Collegiate Institute (1995-1997).
Kurikirana n'umurima.
Conteh George yize muri kaminuza ya New Orleans (1997-2001) kuri bourse yo gusiganwa ku maguru aho yitabiriye amarushanwa yo gusimbuka gatatu no gusimbuka hejuru. Conteh George yegukanye umwanya wa 3 mu gusimbuka hejuru muri Shampiyona yo mu nzu ya Sunbelt 1998. Mu 2001, Ihuriro rya Sun Belt ryatangaje ko Ngardy Conteh yari mu rutonde rw’abakomiseri 2000-2001 na Academic Honor Roll. Urutonde rwabakomiseri ni icyegeranyo cyabakinnyi babanyeshuri bakomeje byibuze amanota 3,5 mugihembwe cyambere cyangwa bitatu bya gatatu.
Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi, Conteh George yibanze ku gutunganya amafilime no kuvuga amateka ya Diaspora nyafurika. Filime ye ya mbere yari "Abasirikare kumihanda" (yakozwe muri gahunda ya Momentum hamwe na NFB mu 2004) yasobanuye imbaraga za Ras King zo kwigisha no guha imbaraga urubyiruko.) mu 2005, Conteh George yari umuyobozi ushinzwe gutunganya inyandiko. urukurikirane rw'ibitabo "bizima", byakozwe na Frances Ann Solomon. Yayoboye ibice 3 kandi afatanya kuyobora kimwe muri byo.
Hamwe na sosiyete ye Mattru Media, Conteh George yakoze, ayobora kandi ahindura imishinga myinshi yo gutangaza no kugana abakiriya. Mu bicuruzwa harimo "The Rhyming Chef Barbuda," igitaramo cyo guteka gihuza ibiryo hamwe na hip hop yakinnye numugabo we Philman George. Yasohoye ibihe bibiri byikinyamakuru cyimyidagaduro yerekana ikinamico hip-hop yerekana Cypher kuri TV ya AUX, igice cyisaha yisaha ya "The Circle of Slavery" yerekanwe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Siyera Lewone, hamwe na documentaire ndende ya The Flying Stars (Yiswe ' Leone Stars ')
"Flying Stars" (muburyo bwa "Leone Stars") iyobowe kandi ikorwa na Conteh George na Allan Tong hamwe nabandi ba producer ni Katarina Soukup wo muri Catbird Productions. Umushinga wakusanyije amadolari ibihumbi 20 kuri kickstarter kandi niyo documentaire yambere yatsindiye Telefilm Canada TIFF Pitch Iyi! amarushanwa. Nyuma yo gutsinda, film yakiriye inkunga yikigega cya Sundance Institute Documentary Film Fund. Mu mpeshyi ya 2012 film yatoranijwe muri Hoteri ya Hot Docs. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi muri RIDM ikomeza gukina mu Iserukiramuco rya Filime zabirabura harimo irya Toronto na Wilson Oakville, ndetse n'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Black Star. Iri serukiramuco ryasojwe nigihembo cyiza cya documentaire mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya BronzeLens 2015 kandi ryatangajwe ku isi yose harimo Umuyoboro wa Documentaire muri Kanada, NHK mu Buyapani, DR muri Danimarike na Al Jazeera. Ubu iratemba kuri Kweli. TV ku isi hose.
Itsinda ry'itangazamakuru rya OYA.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Conteh George yayoboye kandi ahindura inyandiko ngufi ya "Dudley Avuga kuri njye" mu rwego rwo kuyobora umushinga wa Akua Benjamin Legacy Project yakozwe na Alison Duke. Yakiriye Ikiganiro Cyiza cya Kanada mu Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime ya Karayibe. Abagore bombi barema bashizeho ubufatanye bushingiye ku guhuza indangagaciro maze bashinga uruganda rukora OYA Media Group. Itsinda rya mbere rya OYA Media Group ni "Mr. Jane and Finch"bayobowe na Conteh George kandi bafatanije kwandika / bafatanije na Conteh George na Duke. Iyi documentaire yashinzwe na CBC Doc POV ikazenguruka kuri Winston Larose, umukunzi w’umukecuru w’imyaka 80 ukomoka mu gihugu cya Giyane-Kanada ujugunya ingofero muri politiki y’ibanze kandi ahura n’ivanguramoko rishingiye kuri gahunda muri politiki ya Kanada. Iyi filime yatorewe igihembo cya Golden Sheaf kandi yahawe ibihembo bibiri bya Canadian Screen Awards: Igihembo cya Donald Brittain Award Cyiza Cy’Imibereho Myiza ya Politiki no Kwandika neza kuri Documentaire.
Yashinzwe na Duke, abo bagore bombi bayobora kandi gahunda ya OYA Emerging Filmmaker (bisanzwe byitwa Black Youth Pathway to Industry) kubakiri bato barangije porogaramu za firime na tereviziyo.

Blanche Bilongo (yavutse ku ya 26 Mutarama 1974) ni umukinnyi wa filime, umwanditsi wa filimi wo muri Kameruni.
Ubuzima bwa Biografiya.
Bilongo akomoka muri Cameroni hagati Yize muri kaminuza ya Johnson muri Yaoundé akora ballet. Mu 1987, yatangiye kwitabira imyitozo yitsinda ryamakinamico ya Les Pagayeurs ya André Bang kandi yafashe mu mutwe imirongo yabigizemo uruhare. Umunsi umwe, ubwo umukinnyi wa mbere utari uhari, Bilongo yamusimbuye kandi imikorere ye yemeje abantu bose. Bilongo yaje kwinjira muri iryo tsinda.
Bilongo yatangiye gukina filime mu 2000, i "Tiga, L'Héritage". Muri 2005, Bilongo yakinnye nka Sabine kuri opera yisabune "N'taphil". Muri 2007, yakinnye Pam muri firime ya "Les Blessures Inguérissables ya" Hélène Patricia Ebah. Imico ye ivuga kubura umugabo we akamenya ko ubuzima bwe bwabaye ibinyoma. Yabaye umwanditsi wa televiziyo CRTV mu 2009.
Muri Gicurasi 2015, Bilongo yahawe izina rya Knight of the Order of Valor, nyuma y’icyifuzo cya Minisitiri w’ubuhanzi n’umuco Narcisse Mouelle Kombi. Muri 2019, Bilongo yasohoye indirimbo ye ya mbere, "Le temps de Dieu". Yaririmbwe mu rurimi rwa Beti kandi yeguriwe nyina wapfuye. Muri 2020, yakinnye nka Marie Young muri comedi y'urukundo "Coup de Foudre à Yaoundé".

Francine Munyaneza ni umucuruzikazi n'umushabitsi w'umunyarwandakazi, washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa Munyax Eco Ltd, isosiyete ikora ingufu zituruka ku mirasire y'izuba ikora kuva mu 2013 kandi ikorera i Kigali. Niwe washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa La Maison Verte, umushinga wo kubaka ubusugire bw'ibidukikije.
Munyaneza yari yarigishijwe imari n'imicungire y'ubucuruzi mu Bubiligi kaminuza yitwa Université Catholique de Louvain.
Usibye impamyabumenyi ye, Munyaneza yahisemo gusubira mu rugo (mu Rwanda) kugira ngo atangire ubucuruzi bwe bw’ingufu zishobora kuvugururwa kandi buhendutse kugira ngo akemure ibibazo by’amashanyarazi mu cyaro ndetse n’amazi ashyushye mu mijyi myinshi yo mu Rwanda. Ibyo byabaye nyuma yimyaka 20 yuburambe mu burasirazuba bwo hagati, Uburayi, Afurika, Aziya na Amerika akora ku nzego nkuru z'ubuyobozi hamwe n’amasosiyete akomeye yo muri Amerika yo mu majyaruguru, ndetse n’imiryango iharanira ubutabazi ya Komite mpuzamahanga ya Croix-Rouge (ICRC), Médecins Sans Frontières or Doctors Without Borders(MSF. Munyaneza yagaragaje ubusobanuro bw'ingufu z'izuba mu Rwanda. Rwanda ni igihugu kiri kuzamuka mubijyanye n'uburinganire, Munyaneza yaharaniye kuzamura ubushobozi bw'igitsinagore, kandi azwiho guha umwanya bagenzibe b'igitsinagore haba mu kazi ko gucuruza ndetse no mukubungabuka ihindagurika ry'ikirere. Kuva mu 2014, isosiyete ye Munyax Eco yatoranijwe na REG (Rwanda Energy Group, isosiyete ikora amashanyarazi mu gihugu) kugira ngo itange ingufu za Solar Water Heaters. Niyo mpamvu isosiyete ye yagiye ikurikirana sisitemu zirenga 800 za Solar Water Heating sisitemu kubakiriya barenga 1200 B2B &amp; B2C itanga ingufu kubantu barenga 10,000, inatanga amashanyarazi yizuba kuri sisitemu ya gride, Solar Street itara nibindi bikoresho byizuba (Solar Home Systems, Solar Cold Chain and other Solar productive use equipment). Nyuma y’imyaka itanu ikora, Munyax Eco yamenyekanye n’itsinda ry’imigabane rya Londres ko iri mu "ma business yihuta cyane muri Afurika " muri raporo iheruka gukorwa na "Companies to Inspire Africa", yashyizwe ahagaragara muri Mutarama 2019. Munyaneza na ICU basinyanye amasezerano yo gutanga ibikoresho byubwubatsi bwa sisitemu yo gufotora mu Burundi mu rwego rwo kuzamura umusaruro w’amashanyarazi hifashishijwe imirasire ishobora kongera ingufu muri Afurika. Munyaneza yigaragaje cyane akarere k'ibiyaga bigari hamwe n’ubucuruzi bwe bushya bw’ingufu zishobora kubaho binyuze mu ngorane zo kubona inguzanyo.
Ibyagezweho n'ibihembo.
Francine Munyaneza yatowe vuba aha muri AFSIA Solar Awards 2021 n’ishyirahamwe ry’imirasire y’izuba muri Afurika kandi yegukana igihembo cyitwa “The Residential Project of the year” kubera ibikorwa by’ubushyuhe bw’izuba mu gihugu hose. Yatowe nkumukinnyi wumwaka urenga 30, abahatanira Founder of The Year Awards 2020 - muri Afrika yuburasirazuba. Munyaneza yakiriye inkunga muri ARIE 2021 binyuze muri USADF (Fondasiyo ya Amerika ishinzwe iterambere).

Dominique Alonga ni umukobwa ukiri muto, rwiyemezamirimo, umwanditsi na blogger. Niwe washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa Imagine We Rwanda, ububiko bwibitabo, inzu y’ibitabo n’isomero ryashinzwe mu 2014.
Alonga yize impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu itangazamakuru kandi azobereye mu mibanire rusange no gucunga ibirori muri Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College mu Buhinde.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo ya Alonga, Dominque yasubiye i Kigali mu Rwanda maze atangira gukora mu ishami ry’itumanaho rya Never Again Rwanda. Muri 2014, yinjiye mu marushanwa ya ba rwiyemezamirimo bashinzwe imibereho myiza bakora mu kuzamura imibereho y’abana icyo gihe muri Kanama 2015, ahabwa igihembo cy’amafaranga n’umushinga udaharanira inyungu Reach for Change cyamuteye kureka akazi yakoraga maze atangira ku mugaragaro kwikorera. umuryango we utegamiye kuri Leta, Imagine We Rwanda. Bitewe no kutagira ibitabo byinjira mu ruhame hanze y’isomero rusange rya Kigali, yatangije umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta agamije kongerera ubushobozi umuco wo gusoma no guhanga mu Rwanda. Alonga yemeza ko kimwe mu bikenewe cyane u Rwanda na Afurika bifite ari ugukunda ubuvanganzo kandi akoresha igihe cye n'umutungo kugira ngo atange umusanzu muto muri ibyo bikenewe. Alonga yatangiriye ku gitabo cy’abana cyitwa "ABC's of Rwanda, igitabo" cyanditseho inkuru ngufi nka "The Burden of the Saved a" nd "The Shape of Hypocrisyand Tracing the Cracks", kimaze kumenyekana kuko gishingiye ku ihungabana ry’ibisekuruza ndetse na Jenoside yo mu 1994. Yanditse inkuru nyinshi zibabaza kandi zisusurutsa umutima zakoze kubarwanda benshi nyuma ya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda 1994. Alonga ahugura urubyiruko kubijyanye no guteza imbere imishinga no kwitwara neza binyuze mumushinga wamateka, kandi yibanda ku mpano zibitabo, guhugura abashobora kwandika, no gusohora ibitabo. Alonga atezimbere gusoma no umuco wo kwandika mubanyarwanda ndetse no mumashuri ubaha ibikoresho bifatika bashobora guhuza no kwihesha agaciro kubasomyi ba Afrika.
Dominique Alonga yahawe ibihembo byinshi nkurubyiruko rwihangira imirimo harimo Tigo na Reach for Change Digital Changemakers Award 2015, One Hundred Most Influential Young Africans, UKAID’s iAccelerator, Celebrating Young Rwandan Achievers(CYRWA) Award and Youth connect champion 2015,World Bank Blog for Development Award 2016, and Mandela washington fellow 2016 in the U.S
Dominique Alonga yavutse kuri nyina wo mu Rwanda Antoinette Nyirahuku na Christopher Alonga, se uva muri congo. Alonga yavukiye muri DRC ariko mu 1997 umuryango we wahunze Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) ujya mu Rwanda bashaka umutekano. azwiho gukunda kwandika no gutangaza. Amarana umwanya munini nabana kugirango basome hamwe nibiganiro mbwirwaruhame.

Rosette Chantal Rugamba ni umucuruzikazi washoye mu bukerarugendo, washinze kandi Umuyobozi wa Songa Africa, sosiyete ikora ibijyanye n'ubukerarugendo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba akaba na nyiri Amakoro Songa Kinigi Lodge ikorera mu Rwanda.
Rosette afite impamyabumenyi ya politiki (siyanse mbonezamubano) ya siyanse na sociologiya yakuye muri kaminuza ya Makerere, yize ibijyanye no kwamamaza mu Bwongereza kandi ni umuyobozi wa Aspen's global leadership -Ali East Africa of 2010. Niwe mwanditsi w’isoko rusange ry’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo (COMESA) m'Ubukerarugendo burambye - ishingiro ryo gushyiraho ingamba n’ubukerarugendo mu karere.
Rosette Chantal Rugamba ashishikajwe cyane n'ubukerarugendo kandi afite ubutunzi bwinshi bw'ubushishozi n'inzego za leta mu gukangurira ubufatanye bwa Leta n'abikorera guteza imbere ubukerarugendo neza. Rosette yagize uruhare runini mu nganda n’ubukerarugendo mu myaka 24 ishize atangirana na EuroStar mu Bwongereza, hanyuma aba umuyobozi ushinzwe kugurisha no kwamamaza muri British Airways muri Uganda no muri central Afurika., yagiye akora nk'Umuyobozi mu Nama Nyafurika yikorabuhanga- Afurika y'Epfo. Ni perezida w’Urugereko rw’Ubukerarugendo, akaba n'umwe mu bagize inama y’Urugereko rw’Abagore mu Ishyirahamwe ry’abikorera. Kuva mu 2003, Rosette yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru w’ibiro by’ubukerarugendo na parike y’u Rwanda (ORTPN), aho yateje imbere ububyutse n’iterambere ry’ubukerarugendo mu nyuma makimbirane y’u Rwanda no kubungabunga parike eshatu z’igihugu mu Rwanda. Kuva mu 2003 kugeza 2010, ubwo yari umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga ibidukikije mu Rwanda, umubare w’abakerarugendo wiyongereye uva ku 13.000 ugera kuri 790.000 ndetse anaba uwa mbere mu kwinjiza amadovize. U Rwanda rwatoranijwe kuba intangarugero mu gukora ubukerarugendo bwa Afurika kandi rutsindira imurikagurisha ryiza rya Afurika mu imurikagurisha ry’ubucuruzi rya ITB-tourism mu myaka 4 ikurikiranye. Rosette yamenyekanye nk'Ubunyamabanga bw'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba nk'umwe mu bashinzwe ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga ibidukikije mu karere. Yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wungirije ushinzwe ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga Ikigo cy’iterambere ry’u Rwanda (RDB). Rosette Rugamba ashyirwa muri komite ishinzwe imyitwarire y’ubukerarugendo bwa UNTWO-Global manda y’imyaka ine yatangiye ku ya 17 Nzeri 2017 kandi akora nk'umujyanama wihariye w’umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango w’abibumbye ushinzwe ubukerarugendo ku isi (UNWTO). Mu zindi nshingano za Rosette harimo gukorera mu Nama y'Ubucuruzi Mark East Africa (TMEA) na Sonarwa-Insurance Company.

Akaliza Keza Gara ni umunyarwakazi w'umuhanga mu ikoranabuhanaga n'itumanaho akaba n'umucuruzikazi. Afite uruhare runini mu guteza imbere abakobwa kandi yamenyekanye kubera ibikorwa bye n'ibihembo byatanzwe na guverinoma y'u Rwanda ndetse n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’itumanaho. Gara yashinze ubujyanama bwikoranabuhanga hamwe nisosiyete ikora urubuga hamwe na studio ya animasiyo. Yavuzweho kuba "umwe mu bagore bake bo mu Rwanda bateye intambwe igaragara mu guhindura isura y’ikoranabuhanga mu gihugu" kandi akaba umunyamuryango w’umuryango World Economic Forum’s Global Shapers Community.
Akaliza Keza Gara yavukiye muri Uganda kandi yabayeho mu bihe bitandukanye muri Afurika y'Epfo, Kenya, Amerika, Ubufaransa, Ubusuwisi, n'Ubutaliyani. Afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buhanga bwa multimediya no gushushanya yakuye muri kaminuza ya Kent, Canterbury (UK). Yatuye i Kigali, mu Rwanda nyuma yo kurangiza icyiciro cye maze atsindira akazi ke ka mbere mu 2009 akoresheje isoko ryo guhatanira urubuga rw’ubunyamabanga bwa Leta bwongerera ubushobozi abakozi ba Leta. Yari afite imyaka 23 y'amavuko kandi yagombaga kuguza mudasobwa igendanwa kugirango arangize akazi. Gara yashinze ubucuruzi bwa Multimedia Shaking Sun kugirango amwemere gutsindira imirimo myinshi mubijyanye no gushushanya, gukora imbuga na animasiyo no gutoza abana b'abanyarwanda. Isosiyete yakoze imbuga za Minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi mu Rwanda na Minisiteri y’umutungo kamere.
Kuva muri Nzeri 2012, Gara yakoraga nk'umujyanama muri kLab, umuryango utanga ubufasha bw'ikoranabuhanga no gutanga inama ku bantu bo muri Kigali ndetse anakorana n'Abakobwa bo muri ICT Rwanda, umuryango uhuza abagore bakora mu bumenyi bw'ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho kugira ngo bateze imbere ikoranabuhanaga nk'umwuga kubakobwa. Ni umunyamuryango wa Kigali hub umuryango wa World Economic Forum’s Global Shapers Community. Muri 2012 Gara yahawe igihembo cya Rwiyemezamirimo w’umugore witwaye neza muri ICT na Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko na ICT. Muri uwo mwaka, yari umwe mu bagore bane bo mu Rwanda ba rwiyemezamirimo ba ICT bamenyekanye nk'indashyikirwa mu nzego zabo n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’itumanaho. Yatangiye gukoresha "Abanyarwanda kuri Twitter" (#RwOT) hashtag.
Muri 2013, Microsoft yashyizeho Gara nk'uhagarariye urubyiruko muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ku nshuro ya mbere Umunyarwanda ashyirwaho kuri uwo mwanya, kandi yari umwe mu bane bagize akanama ngishwanama k'urubyiruko muri gahunda ya 4Afrika.
Gara yashinze kandi Studiyo Yambi Animation. Arimo guteza imbere "animasiyo ya African Tales", izaba ikinamico ya mbere ya bana yakorewe mu Rwanda. Gara yakoze umushinga wa mbere wa cartoon mumwaka wa 2014, urukurikirane rwigisha abana, kandi yizera ko azateza imbere uwo mwuga hamwe nabana babanyaRwanda.
Muri 2018, Gara yashyizweho n’umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango w’abibumbye António Guterres kuba mu kanama gashinzwe ubufatanye bwa Digital. Muri ako kanama, Umunyamabanga mukuru yagize ati: “Ikoranabuhanga rya Digital rigira uruhare runini mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iterambere rirambye kandi bagabanya umwihariko ku mipaka mpuzamahanga. Ni yo mpamvu, ubufatanye mu bihugu byose ndetse no ku mipaka ari ingenzi kugira ngo hamenyekane ubushobozi bw’imibereho n’ubukungu by’ikoranabuhanga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ndetse no kugabanya ingaruka ziterwa no kugabanya ingaruka zose zitateganijwe. ”
Gara yasobanuwe nk "umwe mu bagore bake bo mu Rwanda bateye intambwe igaragara mu guhindura isura y’ikoranabuhanga mu gihugu". Yitabiriye Amahoro Binyuze mu Bucuruzi ndetse n'Ishuri Rikuru ry'Ubuyobozi mu masomo yo guhangana no gutera imbere ndetse muri 2017 yarangije icyiciro cya kabiri cya siyansi mu bumenyi bw'ikoranabuhanga yakuye muri Kobe Institute of Computing.

Mukashyaka Lina Higiro ni umucuruzikazi wo mu Rwanda kandi yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa Banki ya NCBA mu Rwanda kuva muri Nyakanga 2018. mbere yuko ahabwa inshingano, kuva muri Nyakanga 2016, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa AB Bank Rwanda. Muri uru ruhare, yagenzuye imikorere ya banki, amabanki y’ubucuruzi, iterambere ry’ubucuruzi n’imari ya digitale. Mbere yibyo, Higiro yari umuyobozi w’ingamba, igenamigambi n’ubucuruzi muri I&amp;amp;M Banki, kandi mbere yaho yakoraga muri Guaranty Trust Bank (icyo gihe yari Fina Bank), nk'umuyobozi wa Banki, kuva muri 2007 kugeza 2011.
Mukashyaka Lina Higiro yize muri kaminuza ya North-West University, muri Afurika yepfo, arangizanya impamyabumenyi y’ubucuruzi. Nyuma, yabonye Master of Business Administration yakuye muri kaminuza ya Liverpool mu Bwongereza. Afite kandi icyemezo mu bucuruzi n’itumanaho ry’amasosiyete, cyatanzwe na kaminuza ya Ryerson, i Toronto, muri Kanada.
Lina Higiro yari mu bagore benshi bari kugira uruhare rukomeye mu guteza imbere no kuvugurura imikorere y’Urwego rw’Imari ku mugabane w' Afurika, hari abagore baturutse ku Mugabane wa Afurika mu bihugu nka kote divuwari, Kenya, Ibirwa bya Morise, Nigeriya, u Rwanda, Afurika y’Epfo, Uganda, Zambiya na Zimbabwe aho yaje ku mwanya mwiza ku mwanya wa 3 ku rutonde rugaragaraho abagore bo muri Afurika bakora mu nzego zitandukanye z’imari, zirimo ibigo by’ishoramari, amabanki n’ibigo by’ubwishingizi bizwi nka Angaza Awards.

Mireille Karera n'umucuruzi akaba na rwiyemezamirimo, washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa KORA Coaching Group Ltd, isosiyete ikora ibya Coaching &amp; Consulting ikorera mu Rwanda icyo kigo cyatangiye muri 2013 i Dubai muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu(United Arab Emirate -UAE) hanyuma muri 2015 mu Rwanda. Munyuma gihita kitangira ishuri yigisha abayobozi igatoza n'abandi kuba aba Coach mpuza mahanga nkawe. Icyo kigo cyitwa KORA Coaching &amp; Business Academy(KCA) cyantagiye muri 2018.
Karera yakurikiranye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Business &amp; Legal Translation kuri kaminuza i Cologne, mu Budage. ndetse no mu bwongereza muri kaminuza zitandukanye. Aba umutoza (Coach) guhera muri 2013.
Karera yagarutse muri Afurika nyuma yo kumara imyaka irenga 20 hanze ya Afurika ari mumahanga atandukanye. Muri iyo myaka harimo imyaka13 akora nk'uwambere mu kugurisha, ingamba zo guteza imbere ubucuruzi ku batanga serivisi z’imari ku isi nka Moody's Investor Services, EBS Dealing Resources (ubu ICAP) na Thomson Reuters i Londres, Dubai, Johannesburg na Nairobi. Yabaye Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro ry’Abagore ku Isi mu Rwanda kandi mbere yari Umuyobozi w’Urugaga rw’Abagore ruherereye i Dubai ruha imbaraga abagore mu nshingano z’Ubuyobozi no kwiteza imbere ku kazi, yagize uruhare mu gushyiraho gahunda z’ubujyanama bw’umwuga ku bagore. Afite inkuru nyinshi zishishikariza abagore kwishora mubucuruzi. Ubufatanye bwe hagati ya KORA Coaching Group na Career Women Network Kigali bukemura ikibazo cyubumenyi hagati yabategarugori kugirango bahabwe amahirwe yo guhatanira akazi. Isosiyete ye KORA Coaching and Business Academy (KCA) yakwirakwije serivisi zayo mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika. Mu by'ukuri, mu academy bituma abagore ba rwiyemezamirimo n'urubyiruko kubona uburenganzira business batoza no mentorship, ndetse ubumenyi gucunga ubucuruzi.
Muri 2017, Karera yahawe igihembo "Africa’s Top 25 Distinguished Women in Business Excellence" n'ikinyamakuru Africa Leadership Magazine &amp; Amazons Watch Magazine.
Muri 2020, Karera yahawe igihembo "101 Most Fabulous Global Coaching Leaders" na World HRD i Mumbai mubuhindi.
Muri 2022, Karera yahawe igihembo “700 African Doers” n'ikinyamakuru Tropics Magazine

Iribagiza Clarisse (yavutse 28 Mutarama 1988) ni umunyarwanda w'umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa. Ni umuyobozi mukuru akaba ari nawe washinze isosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga rya mobile HeHe Limited kandi ni umwe mubanyamuryango 7 ba UNCTAD "eTrade y’abagore bunganira abagore baturuka mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere". Yabanje kwegukana ibihembo bya ba rwiyemezamirimo bo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kuri televiziyo "Inspire Africa" Season 1.
Iribagiza yize muri kaminuza y’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga ya kaminuza y’u Rwanda kandi yitabira gahunda ya incubation ya Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
Yashinze isosiyete ye mugihe akiri muto. Isosiyete ye yakuze ifite abakiriya miliyoni ebyiri. Isosiyete ikorana nabatanga isoko kandi babona uburyo bwo kugurisha kuri Internet ibicuruzwa byabo, kubarura no kwakira ubwishyu bwa digitale kubakiriya babo ba nyuma. HeHe Labs yafatanije na GirlHub muri gahunda igamije gushishikarira abakobwa bo mu Rwanda. Ntabwo babigisha ibijyanye na ICT gusa, ahubwo ikoranabuhanga nigishushanyo muri rusange no mubitekerezo binegura.
Iribagiza yari umwe muri "20 movers and shakers of Africa" bavuzwe mu nama nkuru hanyuma umwaka ukurikira Jeannette Kagame, Madamu wa perezida w'u Rwanda amuhemba muri gahunda y'imbuto foundation yiswe "Celebrating Young Rwandan Achievers"..
Muri 2017 yatowe nk'umwe mu bagore 100 ba OkayAfrica. Irabagiza yicaye mu itsinda ry’abajyanama ba Perezida wa Banki Nyafurika.
Ku ya 24 Nzeri 2019, Inama y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe ubucuruzi n’iterambere yatangaje "eTrade y’abagore bunganira" baturutse mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Irabagiza yarari kumwe nabandi nka Nina Angelovska, Nazanin Daneshvar, Xiaofei Yao, Patricia Zoundi Yao, Claudia de Heredia na Helianti Hilman. Byatangajwe kumusozo w’Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye i New York ariko Irabagiza yari umwe muri babiri batitabiriye ibirori byo gutanga ibihembo.

Umutesi Aliane ni umukobwa w’imyaka 22 akaba ari umunyeshuri muri Kaminuza,akaba ari rwiyemezamirimo ukiri muto kandi w'umunyarwandakazi.
Aliane Umutesi, yari asanzwe afite inzozi zo kuzakora umwuga wo gucuruza,ibihe by'icyorezo cya COVID-19 byatumye mu ngamba zifatwa harimo ni uko abantu basabwaga kuguma mu rugo, nibwo Aliane yatekereje gushinga kampani "'Lush Green Groceries" ishinzwe guhahira ndetse no gushyikiriza abantu, ibiribwa byiganjemo imboga, imbuto, ibikoresho by'isuku mu ngo zabo.

Joy Murekatete ni umunyarwandakazi, akaba ari rwiyemezamirimo n'umucuruzi, yashinze isosiyete mu Rwanda yitwa Jotete Investments Ltd.
Murekatete ufite ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abashyitsi, yatangiye isosiyete y' ubucuruzi mumwaka wa 2013, ikaba yaragize uruhare mu gukwirakwiza indabyo kubakiriya bayo batandukanye barimo amahoteri (ikigo cya Radisson blue na Kigali convention centre, Hill View iri i Kigali na Gisenyi, Ubumwe grande, Chocolate), amabanki (Banki nkuru yigihugu y'u Rwanda, Ambasade y'Amerika, DFID, Presidence,Parliament, Insengero(kigali english church, kibagabaga, God is able, Kanombe, Insurance company, saham, Khazan restaurant nahandi henshi. Murekatete avuga ko binyuze mu ihuriro, we nabandi bagore benshi bafite imishinga nkiye bazashobora kugera kuri byinshi bitandukanye harimo kwiga, kubona ubufasha bw'amafaranga bakeneye kandi gushobora kuzamura ubucuruzi bwabo no gukora neza.
Banki ya Kigali ifatanije na Inkomoko Entrepreneur Development yatangaje ko Murekatete ari umwe muri ba rwiyemezamirimo batanu batsindiye kubona Inguzanyo zidafite inyungu biturutse kuri gahunda zabo zo kuzamura no guteza imbere ubucuruzi mu Rwanda binyuze muri 2020 BK Urumuri.

Jessie Kalisa Umutoni (wavutse 1973) ni rwiyemezamirimo w’umugore wo mu Rwanda, umukire akaba n’umuyobozi wa G-Mart Ltd isosiyete ikora kandi igapakira ingwa zikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda. Mbere yo gutangiza isosiyete ye bwite Kalisa yari umuyobozi ushinzwe abakozi n’ubuyobozi muri Inyange iindustries kuva mu 2008 kandi mbere yaho yari umuhuzabikorwa muri MTN-Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Kalisa yavutse 1973 nk'imfura mu muryango w'abakobwa barindwi n'abahungu babiri; ababyeyi be ni Andrew Kalisa na Violette Mukansanga wo muri Uganda ; ababyeyi be bari abarimu muri Uganda, aho yize amashuri abanza, ayisumbuye, nyuma yinjira muri Nkumba College (Nkumba University). Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yakoze imirimo itandukanye hanyuma nyuma yimyaka cumi n'ibiri asubira mwishuri aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri human resources.

Mushimiyimana Eugénie ni Umunyarwandakazi w’umucuruzi, rwiyemezamirimo akaba n'umuyobozi wa ba rwiyemezamirimo b'abagore mu Rwanda. Azwi cyane ku nyubako 3 nini z'ubucuruzi afite i Kigali harimo M&amp;M Plaza inyubako y'amagorofa 7 i Gishushu, Remera muri Kigali.
ubuzima bwo hambere.
Eugénie wavukiye mu Karere ka Ruhango, Intara y'Amajyepfo yakuriye iruhande rwa nyina byamuteye kuba umucuruzi. Nyuma yo gushyingirwa afite imyaka 27 yabuze umugabo we icyo gihe ubuzima buba bubi noneho ahitamo gukora no gutunga umuryango we. Mu ntangiriro yacuruzaga mu biribwa birimo ibishyimbo, umuceri, amavuta y'imikindo n'ibindi ubucuruzi bwe bwatangiye mu gihugu imbere nyuma bwambuka umupaka abukorera no hanze y'u Rwanda. nyuma yaje gucuruza peteroli na sima nyuma yimyaka 20 atekereza ku kiruhuko cyizabukuru nyuma yinjira mu mutungo utimukanwa kandi Eugénie yabaye umuyobozi wungirije wa kabiri w’ishyirahamwe ry’abikorera ku giti cyabo mu Rwanda (PSF).

Zulfat Mukarubega ni rwiyemezamirimo w'umunyarwandakazi. Niwe washinze bwa mbere kaminuza y'ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2006, akaba anahagarariye mu by'amategeko iryo shuri rikuru ry’ubukerarugendo rya RTUC (Rwanda Tourism University College). yashinze kandi ikigo cya Home Care Training Center(HCTC).
Mu myaka ya za 1970, Mukarubega yize ubuforomo imyaka itatu mubitaro bya Butare ari naho yabonye icyangombwa (certificat). Nyuma yaho, yahisemo gushaka akazi kugirango akomeze amashuri ariko ntiyakora umwuga w'ubuvuzi nubwo aribwo yari yarize ahubwo yabonye akazi muri garage y'abazungu i Kigali nk'umunyamabanga. Ubu ni umubyeyi wishimye ufite abana bane, umuhungu nabakobwa batatu.
Mukarubega afatwa nk'umwe muri ba rwiyemezamirimo bakomeye mu Rwanda ariko mukuzamuka kwe yaranzwe n'urugendo rwo kwihangana no kudacogora. Mu mwaka wa 1973, yashoye amafaranga 5000 yari yarazigamye ashinga resitora ntoya mu karere ka Kayonza, Intara y'Iburasirazuba. Iyo Resitora niyo yamubereye intangiro y'urugendo rumuganisha kwiterambere nkinzozi ze. Resitora imaze gukomera, yafunguye ubucuruzi muri Kigali akajya agurisha imyenda yabagabo. Muri 1979 nibwo yashyingiwe, afatanyije n’umugabo we batangiza ishuri ryigisha tekiniki i Muhazi, akaba yari yungirije umuyobozi wungirije kuri iryo shuri. Yakomeje guhuza uburezi n'ubucuruzi. Mu 2002, yatangiye gukurikirana inzozi ze zanyuma, ashyiraho ishuri rikuru ry'ubukerarugendo no kwakira abashyitsi, risa n'iryari muri Kenya no muri Afurika y'Epfo. Muri 2006, iryo shuri rikuru nibwo ryakinguye amarembo abanyeshuri. Murwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy'ubushomeri mu rubyiruko, cyane cyane mu rwego rwo kwakira abashyitsi, yasinyanye amazeserano na Quatar u Rwanda rukaba rugiye kohereza abarenga 600 barangije mu bukerarugendo no kwakira abashyitsi muri Qatar gukora mu gikombe cy'Isi cya FIFA kizabera muri Qatar giteganijwe muri ukuboza 2022. Yabaye umuyobozi wa MTN Foundation.
Mukarubega ni umwe muri batatu bahawe ibihembo na Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika mu Rwanda(U.S. Embassy in Rwanda) akaba ari ibihembo mpuzamahanga by’abagore b’ubutwari bagaragaje ibikorwa bidasanzwe mwiterambere. Muri 2011 yabaye umukozi wumwaka nka rwiyemezamirimo wumugore.

Barbara Umuhoza ni Pasiteri mu Rwanda, umuhuza wa magambo, akora muri domene zitandukanye ari umusemuzi mu ndimi zitandukanye, Umunyamakuru kandi akaba umushyushyarugamba (MC). Ni nyiri Éclat Communications Ltd, isosiyete itanga serivisi mubusemuzi, gutunganya ibintu no gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga.
Umuhoza kandi ni umwe mu bashinze umuryango wa Lucia's Scashed Candles, isosiyete IKORA buji ihumura ikorerwa mu Rwanda kandi ikwirakwizwa mu gihugu. Umuhoza ni umunyamuryango wa Rwanda Leaders Fellowship yakira gahunda zo gutanga inama ku rubyiruko mu Rwanda. Yakiriye iserukiramuco rya sinema rya gikirisitu ryo mu Rwanda 2018, maze ayobora ubwo barangizaga icyiciro cya 2019 mu kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere ubukungu bw’umugore (IEEW). Yagizwe moderator muri Alliance for Financial inclusion's 2019 Global Policy Forum. Muri 2020, yitabiriye inama y’amahoro binyuze mu bucuruzi iyobowe n’ikigo gishinzwe guteza imbere ubukungu bw’umugore aho yagejeje ibitekerezo bye ku nshingano z’ubushumba n’uburyo byagize ingaruka ku cyorezo cya COVID-19. Umuhoza asangira ibitekerezo bye abinyujije kuri podcasts yakirwa kuri IHeartRadio. Umuhoza kandi yashinze Barbara Show kuri YouTube hamwe na videwo mu Kinyarwanda hamwe na rimwe na rimwe mu Cyongereza. Yasemuriye uwari igikomangoma cy'Ubwongereza Prince Charles (King Charles) muri Chogm 2022.

Anne Marie Kantengwa ni rwiyemezamirimo w'umunyarwanda akaba ari umuyobozi mukuru wa Hotel Chez Lando.
Amaze kurokoka itsembabwoko ryakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, yacitse intege cyane atakaza icyizere cyo kubaho Nyuma yuko hafi ya bose mu muryango we bishwe harimo abayeyi be,abavandimwe be, umugabo we ndeste nabana be. Mu 1996, Kantengwa ni bwo yafashe umwanzuro wo gutangira kuvugurura Hotel Chez Lando, iyo hoteri ikaba yarashinzwe na musaza we Ndasigwa Lando wishwe muri Jenoside. Louise Mushikiwabo wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda ubu akaba ayobora Umuryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Ururimi rw’Igifaransa, La Francophonie akaba murumuna wa Anne-Marie na Lando, yafashije mukuruwe kubyutsa iyo hoteri na resitora. Muri 2001, ubucuruzi bwa Kantengwa bwatangiye gutera imbere arinako yatangie kwegera no gufasha abantu batishoboye barimo imfubyi n'abapfakazi ba Jenoside. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri kuva mu 2003 kugeza 2008, yatorewe kuyobora Inteko Ishinga Amategeko (Lower Chamber of Parliament) mbere yuko asubira kwibanda ku bucuruzi bw’amahoteri kugeza uyu munsi. Ku butegetsi bwe muri hoteri y’umujyi, Kantengwa yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere ryayo nk'uko byemejwe na Jean Marie Vianney Gatabazi, minisitiri w’ibanze.
Binyuze muri porogaramu ya Peace Through Business, Kantengwa yahawe igihembo cy’umuyobozi mwiza wa 2021 wateje imbere hotel ayoboye.Ni igihembo cyatanzwe n’Umuryango uteza imbere ba rwiyemezamirimo b’abagore ‘Institute for the Economic Empowerment of Women: IEEW’

Nathalie Mpaka, ni umucungamari akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru muri BK Group Plc (yahoze ari Banki ya Kigali), banki nini y'ubucuruzi mu Rwanda. Ni umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imari muri BK Group.
Madamu Mpaka afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse y’ubuhanzi mu icungamari yakuye muri kaminuza ya Birmingham City, i Birmingham, mu Bwongereza, mu 2006. Ni n'umucungamari wemewe, wemewe na Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), bo mu Bwongereza. Byongeye kandi, ni umunyamuryango w'Ikigo gishinzwe ibaruramari ryemewe mu Rwanda (ICPAR).
Mu gihe yari akiri umunyeshuri wa kaminuza hagati ya 2004 na 2006, Nathalie yakoraga nk'umucungamari wungirije muri Parkwood Leisure Limited, isosiyete ikorera i Worcester mu Bwongereza, nko mu 50 kilometres (31 mi), mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'umujyi wa Birmingham. Yaje guhabwa akazi nk'umucungamari wemewe, na White Stuff Clothing, ihuriro ry'amaduka arenga 115 mu Bwongereza, ahakorera imyaka itanu kuva 2007 kugeza 2012.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, yimukiye mu Rwanda maze ahabwa akazi na Banki ya Kigali nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe imari, ahakorera imyaka ibiri. Ukuboza 2014, yazamuwe kuba Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imari, uyu mwanya aracyafite guhera muri Werurwe 2019.
Madamu Nathalie Mpaka ni umwe mu bagize inama y'ubuyobozi muri Banki ya Kigali ishami ry'Ubwishingizi Rusange, ishami rya BK Group Plc. Akora kandi nk'umunyamuryango w'itsinda rikuru ry'ubuyobozi muri banki. Ni n'umwe mu bagize Inama Nyobozi mu kigo cy’abacungamari ba Leta bemewe mu Rwanda.

Binyuze mu mirimo ye i Drakkar, Lydie yahinduye kandi asohora imitwe 16 ya Kinyarwanda kandi atanga ibitabo birenga miliyoni. Ibitabo bya Drakkar byahawe amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye 3.800, agera ku bana miliyoni eshatu mu Rwanda. Yashinze kandi Happy Hearts Preschools muri 2015 kugirango itange uburezi bufite ireme kuri bose. Ubu umuyoboro wihuta cyane wigenga ryibanze ryibanze mu Rwanda,
Lydie Hakizimana ni umwe mu bashinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi wa Drakkar Limited, ucuruza kandi akanatanga ibitabo by’uburezi mu Rwanda. Kuri Lydie, byose byatangiye mu 2006 ubwo ishyaka rye ryo gusoma ryatumaga afungura iduka rito ryibitabo. Bidatinze, ibyifuzo bye byo kwihangira imirimo byatumye agirana umubano n’amasosiyete menshi yandika, amaherezo agirana amasezerano n’umubwiriza wo mu Bwongereza, Pearson Education. Drakkar yahise ahinduka umucuruzi ucuruza ibitabo byuburezi mu Rwanda, aba intangarugero mu cyerekezo cy’igihugu cye cyo kubaka ubukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi. Uyu munsi, Lydie ayobora abakozi 45 nabagabuzi b'igihe gito.
Lydia numugabo we bashakaga ishuri ryumuhungu wabo ntibashobora kubona ishuri bifuzagako umuhungu umuhungu wabo yabo yakwigamo. Bahisemo rero gufungura ishuri ryabo rya Montessori kugirango bigishe umuhungu wabo, nabandi bana kwiga kwikorera ibintu ubwabo.
Madamu Lydie Hakizimana yahawe igihembo na Meya wa Paris, Anne Hidalgo, muri Kongere ya 41 y’abayobozi b’aba Francophone yateguwe n’ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry’abayobozi b’aba Francophone (AIMF) i Kigali, mu Rwanda kuva ku ya 18 kugeza ku ya 21 Nyakanga 2021.

Agnes Mukashyaka ni Umunyarwandakazi uzwi mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere uburenganzira n'imibereho y'abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe n'imiryango yabo. Ni umwe mu bashinze kandi akaba umuhuzabikorwa wa Izere Mubyeyi Organization, umuryango nyarwanda uharanira uburenganzira bw'abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, ubukangurambaga bwo kubarengera, no kubafasha kubona serivisi zibafasha kwiteza imbere .
Agnes Mukashyaka ni umuhuzabikorwa wa Izere Mubyeyi Organization. Uyu muryango ukora ibikorwa birimo:
Mu mwaka wa 2023, Agnes Mukashyaka yatsindiye IVLP Impact Award, igihembo gitangwa ku bitabiriye gahunda ya "International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP)" ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Yakoresheje inkunga y'icyo gihembo mu mushinga wo kumenya abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe no kubahuza na serivisi zibafasha mu Mujyi wa Kigali.
Agnes Mukashyaka yagiye agaragara mu bikorwa bitandukanye byo guteza imbere uburenganzira bw'abantu bafite ubumuga, by'umwihariko abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Yagize uruhare mu bukangurambaga bwo kongera ubumenyi ku bumuga no guteza imbere ubufatanye hagati y'imiryango, ibigo by'amashuri n'inzego z'ubuzima.

Mushimiyimana Gaudence ni umutegarugori wumunyarwandakazi ufite ubumuga akaba ari nawe washinze murwanda Ishyirahamwe ry’Abagore bafite ubumuga ryitwa UNABU(Rwanda Organization of Women with Disabilities) akaba ari n'Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa.
Akorera ubuvugizi abari n'abategarugori bafite ubumuga byongeye kandi arabafasha kandi akanabashyigikira. Binyuze muri UNABU, Mushimiyimana agaragaza ko abagore n’abakobwa bafite ubumuga, bahura n’ibibazo bitandukanye kandi bibasirwa nihohoterwa bishingiye ku kuba ari abagore bari hirya no hino mu gihugu noneho hakiyongeraho n’ubumuga. Umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’umuryango nyarwanda w’abagore bafite ubumuga (UNAB), Mushimiyimana Gaudence, avuga ko hari icyuho mu mategeko ajyanye n’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe gikwiye kuvaho, kugira ngo ufite ubwo bumuga ahabwe uburenganzira busesuye nk’abandi ndetse n’ihohoterwa ribakorerwa. Ibi nanone yabigarutseho tariki ya 24 Ugushyingo 2021 mu nama yateraniye mu Mujyi wa Kigali ihuza imiryango itandukanye iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu by’umwihariko abafite ubumuga, abanyamategeko, Minisiteri y’Ubutabera (MINIJUST) ndetse n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima (RBC).Ibibazo byagarutsweho muri iyo nama byatumye abagore bafite ubumuga bavugwaho by’umwihariko bishingira ku kuba ari abagore ariko noneho hakiyongeraho kuba bafite ubumuga. Mushimiyimana abona ko igikwiye gukorwa mu gushyigikira abo bagora aruki guverinoma ikwiye gukurikiza amategeko arengera abagore kugirango yereke abakibayeho mubuzima bwu bwoba no nabakiri hasi hasi cyane ko bashyigikwe. Itegeko Nshinga, ingingo ya 21 ivuga ko buri Munyarwanda wese afite uburenganzira ku kugira ubuzima bwiza. Ingingo ya 16 mu Itegeko Nshinga ivuga ku kurinda ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose rigaragaza ko Abanyawanda bose bangana imbere y’amategeko, ukorera ivangura ufite ubumuga abihanirwa n’amategeko.
Kuva UNABU yashingwa, UNTF EVAW yashyize imbere gushyigikira amashyirahamwe y'abagore. Muri 2014, yatangije icyiciro cyihariye cy’inkunga igenera iyo miryango. Muri 2018, itanga ikindi icyiciro cyihariye cyo guhagarika ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore n’abakobwa bafite ubumuga UNABU yabonyemo inkunga. Ambasaderi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu Rwanda yahembye inashimira Mushimiyimana nkumwe mubanyarwandakazi bane b’indashyikirwa kandi bagira umurava bagakora itandukaniro muri sosiyete babamo.

Akanyana Sharon ni umunyarwanakazi, umucuruzi, rwiyemezamirimo ushyira imbere ibikikorwa bya made in rwanda. Niwe washinze akaba n'umuyobozi wa Ishyo Foods Ltd.
Amashuri n'imibereho.
Akanyana yabaye miss wa kaminuza nkuru y u Rwanda ari naho yize bachelor mu mwaka wa 2005 (Miss Campus 2005). Akanyana afite impamyabumenyi mu buhinzi yakuye muri Kaminuza nkuru yurwanda na Masters mu nyigisho ziterambere. Nyuma yo kumara kwiga yashakaga akazi ariko ntiyakabona. Ibi ariko byamuhaye umwanya uhagije wo gucukumbura ishyaka rye mubyerekeranye no guteka. Iyo yasangiraga ninshuti ze cyangwa umuryango we, bakundaga ibyo yabaga yakoze nka za yogurt hamwe nimbuto zitandukanye. Ubwo igitekerezo cyo guhindura ishyaka rye ryo guteka aka bihinduramo ubucuruzi gitangira kuvuka.Sharon yatangiye ubucuruzi ahereye ku bwiyoroshye mu gikoni cye.
Ishyo Foods ni kampani yatangijwe na Akanyana Sharon warangije muri kaminuza y’u Rwanda muri 2018. Ishyo Foods ikora imvange y’umutobe w’imbuto izwi nka komfitire (jam), igakorwa hifashishijwe imbuto zirimo inyanya, vanilla,inkeri n’inanasi. Ibikorwa na Ishyo Foods biboneka mu masoko atandukanye acuruza ibiribwa (supermarkets) muri Kigali nko muri Samba Foods no muri Simba. Akanyana Sharon yatangiriye ibikorwa bye mu gikoni cye, yifashishije ubushobozi buke yari afite, nyuma umushinga we uraguka ugera ku rwego rukomeye kubera umwihariko ufite. Sharon Akanyana, ni umunyamuryango wa SheTrade, akaba na nyir'ubucuruzi w’isosiyete itunganya ibiribwa ikorera mu mujyi wa Kigali yavuze ko binyuze muri hub yashoboye guhabwa amahugurwa ku bucuruzi butandukanye, nko kwamamaza ndetse n’uburyo bwo gukoresha imibare ye kandi akanabona uburyo bworoshye bwo kubona ubufasha bw’amafaranga nandi mahirwe menshi. Ashisikariza abantu iri huriro rizafasha mu gushyigikira no kugeza ku rubyiruko rwaba rwiyemezamirimo b'abagore no kubafasha gutera imbere no kubona amahirwe menshi yo gushora imari.
Akanyana yahinduye ingamba zimikorere yubucuruzi mugihe cya COVID-19 kugirango kugirango adakomeza kwishingikiriza ama supermarkets nkabaguzi be nyamukuru. Atangira gukorana naza hoteri na resitora nkabaguzi nyamukuru kuri we, kandi yagura imikorere igera hakurya yu Rwanda no muri Afrika yuburasirazuba.

Habyarimana Béata ni umunyarwandakazi ndetse n’umucuruzi w'umunyamwuga mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’imari akaba n’umunyapolitiki. Ni Minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda(MINICOM) muri guverinoma y’abaminisitiri, kuva ku ya 15 Werurwe 2021.
Habyarimana yavukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ariko impamvu yatumye ariho avukira byatewe n’akazi ababyeyi be bakoraga. Ababyeyi be bakoraga muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri icyo gihugu. Mumibereho ye yakoze mu bijyanye no gufasha abantu batandukanye kugera kuri serivisi z’imari hanyuma akora no mu bijyanye no kubafasha kwiga iyo mishinga yabo ku buryo yavamo ubucuruzi cyangwa ibikorwa bibyara inyungu.
Hon. Habyarimana yakurikiranye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n'imari no kuyicunga.muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda kuva 1996 kugeza 2000,nanone kandi afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya Masters mu miyoborere mu by’imari yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Maastricht mu Buholandi. Bitewe nuko we umuryango bagiye baba mu bihugu bitandukanye, igice kimwe cy’amashuri ye yakize mu Bubiligi, ikindi akigira mu Rwanda aho yizei Kanombe, mu gihe amashuri yisumbuye yayize muri Economic Rwamagana izwi kwizina rya Groupe Scolaire St Aloys Rwamagana.
Hon. Habyarimana ni umuhanga mu bukungu ufite uburambe bwimyaka irenga 16 mu bijyanye n’imari kuko mbere yuko ashyirwaho yakoraga nk'umuyobozi wungirije muri Banki ya Afurika. Yabanje kandi gukorera ikigo cya Bill &amp; Melinda Gates Foundation,mu bijyanye no gufasha abantu kugera kuri serivisi z’imari ariko ku bantu bafite ubukene bwihariye (Access to Finance for Poor). Yakoze no mu kindi kigo cy’Abanyamerika cyari gifitanye imikoranire na Banque Populaire kandi akomeza imikoranire myiza. Ni umwe kandi mu bashinze Umuryango Nyafurika wa New Faces, New voices, uhuza abari n’abategarugori ukanabafasha kugera kuri serivisi z’imari.

Marie Ange is a leading African entrepreneur and wellness advocate, best known as the Managing Director of Zima Healthy Group Ltd, a Premium Food focused brand dedicated to promoting plant-based nutrition and holistic living through locally sourced Rwandan products. With a strong commitment to Made-in-Rwanda innovation, she actively champions the development of African food systems, agro-processing industries, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
Under her leadership, Zima Healthy has become a symbol of modern African wellness, offering natural, nutrient-rich products that reflect the continent’s agricultural potential. Marie Ange’s work not only promotes healthier lifestyles but also supports sustainable economic growth by empowering local producers and food manufacturers.
She is a sought-after speaker and thought leader at summits and Continental Events, where she advocates for African self-reliance in food manufacturing, value addition, and entrepreneurship across the agro-wellness value chain.

Mariam Muganga (wavutse 1987) ni rwiyemezamirimo w' umugore mu Rwanda. Niwe washinze Academic Bridge, ikigo gitanga urubuga rukoreshwa mu mashuri amagana yo mu Rwanda ndetse kugeza ubu rukaba rwararenze imbibi rukoreshwa no mu bindi bihugu by' Afurika y' Iburasirazuba harimo Uganda, Burundi, Tanzania, na Kenya.
Mariam Muganga afite impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Science (BASc.) muri Computer Science and Information yakuye muri University of Rwanda. Ni rwiyemezamirimo ndetse n' umuyobozi mu ruganda rw' ikoranabuhanga.
Muri 2016 Academic Bridge yatsindiye igihembo cy’ itumanaho mpuzamahanga muri eEducation kubera uruhare yagize mu kuzamura uburezi binyuze muri ICT.
Mariam Muganga yateguye porogaramu ya Academic Bridge muri 2014, ayisohora muri 2015 igamije gufasha ibigo by' amashuri guhuza amakuru no koroshya itumanaho ku babyeyi binyuze mu mimaro itandukanye irimo: Kwandika abanyeshuri no kubaha kode zibaranga (Enrollment and student registration), gutegura ingenabihe (timetable), gutegura no gukurikirana uko amasomo atangwa (lesson planning), gutanga amakuru k' ubwitabire (attendance), amakuru ku myitwarire (discipline), gutanga impushya no kubimenyesha ababyeyi (permissions management), kwandika amanota (results), gukora birote (report cards and transcripts), ndetse no gushyikira ababyeyi bamenyeshwa amakuru k' umunyeshuri.
Afatanije na mugenzi we Christian bari bahuje intego, biyemeje kubaka Academic Bridge neza batanga igisubizo gikomeye kandi cyunganira ireme ry' uburezi mu mashuri y' ibyiciro byose.
Mu mwaka wa 2025, Academic Bridge yizihije imyaka icumi (10) imaze ikora, mu kirori cyahawe insanganyamatsiko "10 Years in the Making: Building, Adapting &amp; Growing" bitanga ishusho y' urugendo rw' Academic Bridge mu myaka icumi. Yaranzwe no kubaka, kuyinoza, ndetse no kuyagura. Ubu Academic Bridge yabaye ubukombe. Yarasagambye kandi yigaruriye imitima y' abayobozi b' ibigo by' amashuri, abarimo, abanyeshuri, ndetse n' ababyeyi bayikoresha kubera kugirira umumaro ibigo by' amashuri mu guhuza amakuru no kwimakaza uburezi bufite ireme.
Muri urwo rugendo rwo kubaka no kunoza Academic Bridge, Mariam Muganga yanashinze KudiBooks,urubuga rufasha ibigo by' amashuri n' abacuruzi mu bijyanye n’ibaruramari no kwishyura byoroshye, rugamije gukemura ibyuho biri mu micungire y’imari y’amashuri n’ibigo by’ubucuruzi.
Afatanije n' ikigo IST Legal, Mariam Muganga ubu arangaje imbere urubuga ruri kwimakaza ubutabera bwihuse binyuze mu guha abavugizi n' abacamanza urubuga bakoresha rwifashisha ubwenge buhangano (AI).

" 'Franz R. Friedl' ", nanone ku izina ry'irihimbano " Jacques Renée " (* 30 Gicurasi 1892 muri Oberkappel, Ositiriya; † 5 Ukuboza Essen), yari umunya Otirishiya gucuranga inanga, umuhimbyi na uwahimbye film.
Umuhungu wa Küfer yize amashuri yisumbuye hanyuma ahabwa amahugurwa yubuhanzi na Rosé, Carl Flesch na Hugo Kaun. Friedl yaciye akora akazi ko gutunganya ibitaramo muri Dortmund na Dresden. Kuva mu 1923 kugeza 1926, Franz Friedl yari umucuranzi w'inanga muri Teatro Colón i Buenos Aires Arijantine, kuva mu 1927 wo muri Otirishiya yo hejuru, akaba yaranakoresheje izina ry'irihimbano Jacques Renée inshuro nyinshi, akora nk'umuhimbyi wigenga kandi ahimba umuziki wa chambre, kurengana, no kwidagadura kuva 1933 nabyo umuziki wa firime.
Muri Gatatu ya Reich Friedl yari umwe mu bahimbyi ba sinema bakoreshwa cyane mu Budage kandi yanakoze firime nyinshi zo kwamamaza no anti-Semitike firime zitera nka pseudo-documentaire " The Umuyahudi w'iteka " irahari.. Friedl yanditse kandi amanota menshi ya firime yumuco na documentaire. Mu myaka ya mbere ya DEFA Friedl yakoraga kandi muri societe ya gikomunisiti. Mu 1951, uwahimbye ahanini yarangije imirimo ye ya firime. Ubuholandi Björn Stenvers numwuzukuru wumukobwa we wenyine.

"Björn Stenvers" (* 25 Gicurasi 1972 muri Arnhem) ni (CEO) umuyobozi mukuru wa Eye Care Foundation akaba yarashinze ishuri ndangamurage.
Mbere, yari umuyobozi wa Fonds de dotation des International Council of Museums. Kugeza mu 2016 yari umuyobozi wa Fondasiyo y'ingoro z'umurage wa Amsterdam, ari na we yashinze. Björn ni we wenyine mu bitabiriye gahunda ya perezida y’abaminisitiri ba Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubukungu n’Umurimo wa Leta uyobowe na Perezida w’Uburusiya (RANEPA, Ihuriro rya Gaidar), Uburusiya aho yigisha. Muri 2014 Stenvers yashinze ishuri rya "Rostov Kremlin Academy", muri 2015 yashinze "Ishuri Ndangamurage rya Amsterdam", 2017 " [Aruba Inzu Ndangamurage", "Altai Inzu Ndangamurage" na "Ishuri rya Zoo rya Moscou" yo guhugura abakozi ba muzehe. Afite imyanya yubuyobozi mpuzamahanga; Umuyobozi wa " Kaminuza y'Abaturage ya Amsterdam ", umuyobozi wa Inzu Ndangamurage ya Diamond i Amsterdam, Iserukiramuco ry’umucyo wa Amsterdam akaba n'umuyobozi w’umurage ndangamuco w’isi wa Igihome cya Brest, Belarusi. Björn Stenvers yashakanye numuririmbyi Tamara Hoekwater. Afite impamyabumenyi nyinshi mumateka yubuhanzi, kwamamaza no gutumanaho. Björn ni umwuzukuru wumukobwa umwe rukumbi wumuhimbyi wa Otirishiya Franz R. Friedl.
