Scholastique Mukasonga ni umwanditsi wavutse mu 1956 mu cyahoze ari intara ya Gikongoro mu Rwanda akaba atuye Mu bufaransa. Muri 2012, Yatsindiye ibihembo bya prix Renaudot na prix Ahmadou-Kourouma kubwigitabo cye "Our Lady of the Nile" "." Usibye kuba uwahataniye igihembo mpuzamahanga cy’ubuvanganzo cy’ubuvanganzo cya Dublin n’igihembo cy’ibitabo cya Los Angeles Times, Mukasonga yahembwe mu 2014 igihembo cya Seligman cyo kurwanya ivanguramoko ndetse no mu 2015 ahabwa igihembo Société des gens de lettres. Kuri ubu atuye muri Lower Normandy mu Bufaransa.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Scholastique Mukasonga yavutse mu 1956 mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, ku ruzi rwa Rukarara. Mu 1959, gahunda ya mbere yo kurwanya abatutsi yashenye igihugu ituma abatutsi bamwe bahunga. Mu 1960, umuryango we woherejwe hamwe nabandi batutsi benshi i Nyamata mu mu karere ka Bugesera kari kadatuwe, scrubland. Umuryango we wabaga mu nkambi y'impunzi nyuma yo kwirukanwa mu mudugudu wabo, aho yarokotse nubwo yatotejwe ndetse akenda no gukorerwa ubwicanyi. Nyina Stefania yitaye ku bana be, Nubwo umubare muto 10% by'abatutsi wari wemewe gukomeza mumashuri yisumbuye, yabanje kwiga Lycée Notre-Dame-de-Citeaux i Kigali, hanyuma akomereza mu ishuri ry'i Butare. Mukasonga abisobanura agira ati: "Ni ryo shuri ryonyine ry'abakobwa ryanyemereye gukoresha umwuga wanjye kugira ngo mfashe abandi badafite amahirwe yo kwiga."
Mu 1973, abanyeshuri b'Abatutsi birukanwe mu mashuri, hamwe n'abakozi ba Leta b'Abatutsi birukanwa ku mirimo yabo. Kubera iyo mpamvu, byabaye ngombwa ko agenda, ahungira mu Burundi kugira ngo ahunge iterabwoba. Yarangije amasomo ye nk'umukozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza mu Burundi atangira akazi muri UNICEF. Mukasonga yageze mu Bufaransa mu 1992 biba ngombwa ko asubiramo ikizamini cy’abakozi bashinzwe imibereho myiza, kubera ko impamyabumenyi yakiriye mu Burundi itemewe n’ubuyobozi bw’Ubufaransa. Kuva 1996-1997, yari umukozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y'abanyeshuri ba kaminuza ya Caen. Kuva mu 1998 kugeza ubu, akora imirimo yo guhagararira ubutabera (amategeko) muri Union départementale des association familiales de Calvados (Ishami ry’amashyirahamwe y’imiryango ya Calvados). Kuri ubu atuye ahitwa Normandy.
Mu 1994, abantu 37 bo mu muryango we bishwe muri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Byatwaye Mukasonga indi myaka 10 kugirango agire ubutwari bwo gusubira mu Rwanda, ibyo yabikoze mu 2004. Muri uru rugendo niho yumvise afite ubushake bwo kwandika igitabo cye cya mbere, igitabo cyandika ku buzima, "Inyenzi ou les Cafards." Inyandiko y'Icyongereza, yahinduwe na Jordan Stump, yiswe "Cockroaches," kandi yatorewe igihembo cy’ibitabo cya Los Angeles Times mu 2016 mu cyiciro cy’ubuzima bwa muntu. Yakurikijeho igitabo cya La Femme aux pieds nus muri 2008. Yabonye igihembo cya Seligmann, avuye muri, yemera imirimo irwanya ivanguramoko no kutoroherana. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yasohoye icyegeranyo cy’inkuru ngufi zitwa L'Iguifou, anegukana igihembo cya Paul Bourdari mu 2011 avuye muri l'Académie des sciences d'outre-mer ndetse no mu gihembo cya Renaissance kubera Igitabo cye "Notre-Dame du Nil", yatsindiye ibihembo bitatu: igihembo cya Ahmadou-Kourouma i Geneve, igihembo cya Oceans France, na prix Renaudot mu 2012. Ubuhinduzi bw'icyongereza bw'iki gitabo, "Our Lady of the Nile,", bwatoranijwe nk'imwe mu bitabo icumi byatsindiye igihembo cy’ubuvanganzo bwa Dublin kandi yabaye uwahawe ubufasha ku gihembo cya Emerging Voices mubijyanye n’Imari. Gukora filimi y'iki gitabo byaratangiye iyobowe na Atiq Rahimi.
Muri 2014, Mukasonga yasohoye igitabo gishya "Ce que murmurent les collines" "," yatsindiye igihembo Société des gens de lettres muri 2015 mu. Igitabo cye "Coeur Tambour" cyasohotse muri Mutarama 2016 mu cyegeranyo cyera cya Gallimard. Muri kamena 2017, yahawe igihembo kubambasaderi bavuga Igifaransa (Ambassadeurs francophones) i Copenhagen. Muri Werurwe 2018, yasohoye igitabo gishya cyandika ku buzima, "Un si beau diplomate!" Prix Bernheim wo muri Fondation du judaisme francais (Fondasiyo y'Abayahudi b'Abafaransa) yamuhaye igihrembo muri 2015 mu rwego rwo kumushimira ibikorwa bye byose. Scholastique Mukasonga ni umwe mu bagize inteko ishinga amategeko ya Prix Deauville Littérature et Musique (Igihembo cya Deauville ku buvanganzo n'umuziki). Yahawe kandi icyubahiro cya Chevalier des Arts et des Lettres, ishimira abagize uruhare runini mu muco muri ibyo bice byombi.
Mu gitabo cye cyitwa "Notre-Dame du Nil", yavuze ishuri ryisumbuye ryubatse ku musozi wa metero 8202, ritari kure y’inkomoko ya Nili. akaba ariho abakobwa bahurira, muguhiramo abanyeshuri umubare w'abatutsi ugarukira kuri 10% by'abanyeshuri. Biboneka ko iyi nkuru ishingiye kubintu byabaye mu buzima: bisa nkaho yavugaga ishuri ryisumbuye rya Notre-Dame de Citeaux i Kigali aho yari umunyeshuri, kandi gukura abanyeshuri b’abatutsi ni byo byari yiboneye mu 1973. igihe yari mu buhungiro mu Burundi.
"Ce que murmurent les collines (What the Hills Whisper)" ni ikusanyirizo ry'inkuru ngufi, zimwe muri zo zishingiye ku mateka y'u Rwanda, yagaragaje uko abandi bashushanya amashusho y'ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw'u Rwanda. Ni igitabo cye cya mbere kitari gishingiye kuri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. "Un Pygmée à l'école" ni inkuru ngufi yanditswe na Mukasonga, yanditswe mu 2017 kandi ishyirwa mu cyegeranyo cyiswe "La rencontre avec l'autre (The encounter with the Other)""."
Hamwe n'igitabo cye "Coeur Tambour" "(Pounding Heart, Drumming Heart)" Scholastique Mukasonga yaguye icyerekezo cye uko yavuye mu Rwanda kugera muri Antilles, Amerika no muri Berezile. Igitabo gikurikirana Kitami, umukobwa wabaye umuririmbyi uzwi cyane muri afurika. Tugarutse ku gitabo cya "Un si beau diplome," Mukasonga yigana uburyo se yamushyizeho igitutu kugirango abone impamyabumenyi. Mu buhungiro mu Burundi, Djibouti, hanyuma akaza kugera mu Bufaransa, "beautiful diploma" yari 'ingufu zamufashaga kwihanganira guhezwa no kwiheba. Igitabo cye aheruka gusohoka muri Werurwe 2020, igitabo cyitwa "Kibogo est monté au ciel (Kibogo Yuriye mu kirere)". Irasebya ikibazo cy'amadini, ivugabutumwa, n'ubunini bifitanye isano n'igihe cy'abakoloni.

Umutoni kuri ubu ukorana na High Media, isosiyete ikora ibijyanye no gutunganya amashusho, gufotora no gushushanya.Umutoni ni umwe mubagize itsinda riigira inama abakobwa bato mumashuri atandukanye. Icyakora, yagize isoni akiri umwana kandi ababyeyi be bahoraga bamuburira ko atazabikora nkumunyamakuru Ugira isoni Umutoni ni umwe mubagize itsinda rigira Inama abakobwa bato mumashuri atandukanye. Uwimpundu Sandrine ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi akaba umukinnyi wa filime umaze kumenyekana cyane mu Rwanda ku mazina ya Rufonsina.
Uwimpundu Sandrine ubundi amazina ye yanyayo ni ayo, aho benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga no kuri televisiyo na radiyo azwi nka Rufonsina. Umwana w'umukobwa w'umunyamahane cyane akaba umwana w'umukobwa w'umunyacyaro cyane utewe ishema ryokuvuga ikigoyi (ni ururimi rukoreshwa mu majyaruguru ashyira burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda.) Uwimpundu afite umugabo bashakanye afite n'umwana umwe w'umukobwa akaba ari Mama Gallois izina ry'ububyeyi, akaba asazwe akora akazi umwuga w'ukubudozi.Uwimpundu Sandrine uzwi nka Rufonsina ndetse akaba ubu ari umukinnyi genderwaho muri filime inyura kuri television Rwanda mu cyigo cy'igihugu cy'itangazamakuru RBA, ahoo akina ari umudozi w'imyenda, witwa cyane kukazike ndetse n'abakiriye be abitaho, afite kandi umwana w;umuhugu umwe.
Uwimpundu Sandine tuzi kumazina ya Rufonsina uri mu bagore bacye bakina filime mu Rwanda basetsa nkuko abagabo babikora,akaba ari umwe utuma filime Nyarwanda zikundwa. izina Rufonsina ryatumwe amenyekana muri filime ari gukina yatumwe amenyekana cyane, Rufonsina ukunze gukina filime ari umugoyikazi (uvuga ikigoyi). Rufonsina wabaye umukinnyi muri filime Ejo Si Cyera, byamufashije kumenyekana, kakaba ari kamwe mu kamufashije kumenyekana cyane, Ati " Akantu nkina nkubitana imigeri Seburikokoimigeri,ncanga imigeri ako kantu naragakunze cyane gafite urwego kashyizeho kuko karahererekanyijwe cyane n'abantu bo hanze barampamagaye biti usanzwe ukina karate?, ni gute ukubita umugobo agahunga, bimeze bite?". Rufonsina umaze imwaka myinshi akina filime isaga 12, gukina filime no gutebya ntabwo ari ibintu ashakisha cyangwa yaba yarize mu mashuri ahubwo ni impano Imana Yamuhaye, yagize Ati " ushobora kumbwira ngo ngwino nguhe akazi Gukina) nkacishamo ijisho umunota umwe nkahita mbikora binyoroheye.
Uwimpundu Sandrine ubu ari gukina muri filime eshanu icyarimwe, ibyo akabishobora kuko badakina babatunguye kandi abikora bucye bucye. Filime yinjiye no mu rugo rwe kuburyo ibyo akora umugabo we arabikunda ndetse aranamushyigikiye, naho umwana, we w' umukobwa y'ibyariye ntakimwita mama we ahubwo amwita Rusonsi ngwino wirebe dore uri kunyura kuti televiziyo, gusa uwo mwana nawe arabikunda. Rufonsina ucyeneye iterambere rirambye kandi rihoraho afite intego yo kuzaba umukinnyi mpuzamahanga muri filime na cinema ku isi.
Uwimpundu Sandrine (Yageze i kigali bwa mbere 2007 akaba yaratangiye gukina filime 2009) yahawe ibihembo bibiri mu Rwanda nk'umukinnyi mwiza wa filime w'umwaka wa 2020, n'umukinnyi mwiza wa byenda gusetsa w'umwaka 2020. Rufonsina amaze gukina filime nyishi zirimo Kibonke Papa Sava, Seburikoko, Ejo si kera, Umuturanyi.

Marie-Pierra Kakoma (yavutse 27 Gicurasi 1996), uzwi cyane nka Lous and the Yakuza, ni umuraperi, umwanditsi w'indirimbo n'umunyamideli ukomoka mu Rwanda na Kongo ariko utuye mu Bubiligi. Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yo gushyira ahagaragara indirimbo ye ya mbere "Dilemme" muri Nzeri 2019, ikurikirwa na "Tout est gore" mu Kuboza 2019 na "Solo" muri Werurwe 2020. Album ye ya mbere, "Gore", yakozwe na El Guincho, yasohotse ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2020.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Lous amazina bwite ni Marie-Pierra Kakoma yavukiye i Lubumbashi, muri Zayire (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo y'ubu) ku ya 27 Gicurasi 1996. Ababyeyi be bari abaganga bakomeye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo igihe yavukaga. Se w'umunyacongo yari umuganga w'abagore, naho nyina w'umunyarwanda yari umuganga w'abana. Nyina wa Kakoma yafungiwe muri Kongo amezi abiri mu ntambara ya kabiri ya congo mu 1998 azira ubwoko bwe. Se amaze kubona ko nyina arekuwe, bahungiye mu Bubiligi ari kumwe na bashiki ba Kakoma. Kakoma na barumuna be basigaye baje gusanga nyina mu Bubiligi nyuma yimyaka ibiri mu 2000, mugihe se yagumye muri congo. Uyu muryango wimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2005 mbere yo gusubira burundu i Buruseli muri 2011.
Ishyaka rya Kakoma ryo kuririmba ryatangiye akiri muto mu gihe yari akikijwe n'umuziki kubera ko se yakundaga indirimbo za kera za Mozart, Chopin, Vivaldi, na Beethoven bose babanyaburayi.
Yatangiye kwandika umuziki we afite imyaka irindwi. Umuryango we wimukiye mu Bubiligi afite imyaka 15, yatangiye kwandikira Columbia Records yizeye ko azasinyishwa muri label. Ku myaka cumi n'umunani, Kakoma yaciwe intege n'ababyeyi be bamubuza kuba umuririmbyi, ngo abe umuganga, maze afite imyaka cumi n'icyenda, yirukanwa mu rugo iwabo. Mu gihe cyo kubura aho kuba, yabaye mu mihanda amezi menshi mbere yo gutura muri sitidiyo y’umuziki, aho yararaga akandika umuziki, mu gihe yagendaga akora indirimbo zimwe na zimwe. Mu myaka itatu, Kakoma yakoze indirimbo 52, harimo EP zirindwi. Muri 2016, yagaragaye mumashusho y'indirimbo "BruxellesVie" yumuhanzi w'umubiligi Damso.
Kakoma yakiriye izina "Lous and the Yakuza arikuye" ku "bugingo(soul)", isoko y'ishyaka rye rya muzika, na "Yakuza", umutwe w'abagizi ba nabi wateguwe n'Ubuyapani, izina akoresha mu gusobanura "crew" y'abafatanyabikorwa yishingikirizaho mu guhanga umuziki we. Lous yavumbuwe bwa mbere n’ushinzwe kumureberera inyungu, Miguel Fernandez, amaze kubona ko yasohotse kuri interineti. Guhera mu 2017, yamenye ko ashishikajwe no gukora alubumu, asaba inshuti ze magara gushinga itsinda riyishyigikira, yatangiye kuririmbira ahera mu tubari no mu tubyiniro twa nijoro i Buruseli. Mu mpera za 2017, Lous yatumiriwe gukora acoustic ya "La ChillZone", nyuma asinya muri Columbia Records ibinyujije muri Sony Music yo mu Bufaransa, afite imyaka 22. Ku ya 15 Kamena 2018, hasohotse "Le Ridicule Ne Tue Pas", ku bufatanye bwa Lous na Yakuza n'itsinda rya elegitoroniki rya BSSMNT.
Nyuma y’amezi atandatu ashakisha producer uhuza ibyifuzo bye, Kakoma yahisemo producer El Guincho wo muri Espagne, nyuma yakazi ke ku ndirimbo ya " Malamente " ya Rosalía. Lous yasohoye indirimbo yabo ya mbere "Dilemme" ku ya 19 Nzeri 2019, yakozwe na El Guincho na Ponko. Iyi ndirimbo yatumye Kakoma amenyekana cyane, ikusanya miliyoni zirenga 20 kuri Spotify, miliyoni 8.9 zerekanwe kuri YouTube, ikaza ku mwanya wa mbere kuri Spotify Italia ya Viral 50. Amashusho y'indirimbo, yayobowe na Wendy Morgan, yerekana indangamuntu zitandukanye Lous afite ahantu hatandukanye, hagamijwe kwerekana ubuzima bwe kuva muri Congo yerekeza mu Bubiligi. Ku ya 1 Mata 2020, remix irimo umuraperi w’umutaliyani Tha Supreme n’umutaliyani Mara yashyizwe ahagaragara.
Muri Red Bull Elektropedia Awards 2019, Lous and The Yakuza yegukanye umudari wa feza mu cyiciro cya "Fresh on the Scene". Indirimbo ya kabiri ya Lous, "Tout est gore", nayo yakozwe na El Guincho, yasohotse ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2019. Iyi ndirimbo imaze kumenyekana nyuma yuko umukinnyi wa filime Issa Rae asakaje amashusho kuri videwo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ku ya 20 Werurwe 2020, Lous yasohoye indirimbo ye ya gatatu yise "Solo", hamwe n'amashusho y'indirimbo yakozwe na Wendy Morgan na Kevin Bago. Filime ngufi bifitanye isano, yiswe "Solo (Itangiriro)" yasohotse ku ya 14 Mata 2020. Indirimbo zose uko ari eshatu zashyizwe kuri alubumu ye ya mbere, "Gore", yakozwe na El Guincho. Ubusanzwe byari biteganijwe ko izasohoka ku ya 5 Kamena 2020, alubumu yaje gutinda kugeza mu mwaka wa 2021.
Ku ya 27 Gashyantare 2020, Kakoma yasinyiye kujya yerekana inzu yimyambariro y'umufaransa Chloé. Muri Werurwe 2020, Lous and the Yakuza yashyizwe muri gahunda ya Spotify ya RADAR, igamije kwagura abahanzi ku isi hose binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2021, yasohoye indirimbo ye "Je ne sais pas", irimo umuraperi wo mu Butaliyani Sfera Ebbasta. Ku ya 4 Werurwe, yaririmbye mu iserukiramuco rya muzika rya Sanremo 2021 muri duet hamwe na Gaia, hamwe n'indirimbo "Mi sono innamorato di te" ya Luigi Tenco. Ku ya 8 Kanama, yifatanyije na Woodkid mu birori byo gutanga ihererekanyabubasha kuva mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo 2020 yerekeza i Paris 2024. Umuziki wa Kakoma wasobanuwe nk "" silky "ihuza TRAP, R&amp;amp;B, na pop.
Kakoma azwiho isura rusange, ni ukuvuga ikimenyetso gishushanyijeho ku gahanga, cyasobanuwe nk'inyuguti 'Y' n'akadomo hagati kandi kikagereranya n'ikimenyetso cy'urukundo rwa Prince # 2. Kakoma ubwe yahimbye ikimenyetso, cyiswe "les mains levées vers le ciel (amaboko yazamuye yerekeza mu kirere)", nk'ikimenyetso kigamije kugereranya amaboko abiri ahuza isi n'ijuru. Ukwizera kwe kw'idini no kwizera Imana byamubereye intandaro yo kurema ikimenyetso. Lous yamenyekanye kandi kumyambarire ye nuburyo bwe, yakuye ku bahanzi nka FKA Twigs na Erykah Badu.
Nk'umwana, Kakoma yakundaga umukino bita 'manga' kandi yabonaga ashishikajwe ninsanganyamatsiko zijyanye namateka ya muntu, cyane cyane ubutwari n'ibikorwa by'intwari, nkibisobanuwe mu byanditswe na Cicero. Mu kubyiruka kwe, yari umukinnyi wa siporo kandi yanakinnye umupira w'amaguru w'abanyamerika imyaka irindwi kubera ko yari ashishikajwe na "Eyeshield 21". Kakoma yakoze ubushakashatsi bwo kwandika nk'uburyo bwo kwerekana kuva mu bwana, igihe ashishikajwe no kuba umwanditsi w'ibitabo byamuteye kwandika impapuro zirenga 300 z'uburebure. Usibye umuziki n'imyambarire, Lous n'umuhanga cyane, gushushanya bisanzwe,gushushanya imyenda no gukora 'manga' nibishushanyo mbonera.

Anne-Marie Goumba (wavutse ku ya 9 Ukwakira 1954), ni umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Repubulika ya Centrafrique kandi ni umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Pan-Afurika kuva muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique. Ni umupfakazi wuwahoze ari umunyapolitiki muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique Abel Goumba.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Anne-Marie Mbakondo yavutse ku ya 9 Ukwakira 1954 i Nyanza, mu Rwanda. Yabanje kwiga amashuri makuru muri École Normale Supérieure i Save, mu Rwanda, mbere yo gukomeza kwiga muri Université Catholique d'Afrique Centrale. Nyuma yaje gukora umurimo wo kwigisha nka mwarimu mu ishami ry’ubuvuzi rya Butare hagati ya 1973 na 1977. Agezeyo, yahuye na Abel Goumba, na we wari umwarimu ku bibazo by'ubuzima rusange, nyuma amugira umugore.
Umugabo we yari amaze igihe kinini avugurura ibya politiki muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique, yashinze icyaje guhinduka ishyaka rya Patriotic Front for Progress. Na we yashyigikiye imirimo ya FPP, kandi ahagarara mu matora rusange yo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique ya 2005 maze atorerwa kuba umudepite mu karere ka gatanu ka Bangui namajwi 37.32% mu matora yo ku ya 8 Gicurasi. Muri ayo matora, umugabo we ntiyabashije gutsinda. Amaze kujya munteko ishinga amategeko ya Repubulika ya Centrafrique, yatowe nk'uhagarariye Repubulika ya Centrafrique mu Nteko ishinga amategeko ya Pan-Afrika. Muri Mutarama 2015, yashimye ibikorwa byo kubungabunga amahoro bikorwa n'u Rwanda, avuga ko mu gihe amaze imyaka 30 muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique, atigera yibagirwa ko yavuye mu Rwanda. Ni umuhuzabikorwa w’umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta witwa Les Flamboyants, ushaka gukumira ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore n’abana.

Ines Mpambara ni Umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda usanzwe akora nka Minisitiri ushinzwe Imirimo y'abaminisitiri kuva muri Werurwe 2020.
Kugeza agizwe ushinzwe Imirimo y'abaminisitiri, yari amaze imyaka irenga 10 akora nk'umuyobozi wa Guverinoma mu biro bya Perezida w'u Rwanda. Yabanje kandi gukora muri Minisiteri y’ubuzima aho yakoraga imyanya itandukanye, Mbere yaho yakoraga mu cyahoze ari kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda nk'umwarimu akaba n'umuyobozi w'ishuri ry'itangazamakuru n'itumanaho.

Amashanyarazi ya skateboard numuntu utwara abantu ashingiye kuri skateboard. Umuvuduko mubisanzwe ugenzurwa nintoki zidafite intoki zifata kure cyangwa kugendana uburemere bwumubiri hagati yimbere yubuyobozi kugirango bugende imbere ninyuma kugirango feri. Kubijyanye nicyerekezo cyurugendo iburyo cyangwa ibumoso, birahindurwa muguhindura ikibaho kuruhande rumwe cyangwa kurundi. Itondekanya ryibibaho byamashanyarazi (urugero niba byujuje ibisabwa nk " imodoka ') kandi byemewe gukoreshwa mumihanda cyangwa kaburimbo biratandukanye mubihugu.
Ubwoko bwa Skatebo Yamashanyarazi
Hariho ubwoko bubiri bwibanze bwa skateboard yamashanyarazi kumasoko.
Fastest Electric Skateboard
Buri mwaka ushize utujyana mubihe bigezweho, bidukeneye guhindura imibereho yacu. Wigeze wumva bavuga ngo, "Ibibazo bigezweho bikeneye ibisubizo bigezweho" cyangwa "Ibihe bigezweho bikenera ibikoresho bigezweho?" Isi igenda yerekeza kubikoresho byikora byikora, nawe ugomba kubikora. Uyu munsi twakusanyije amakuru kuri kimwe mubintu bigezweho. Nibyo skateboard yamashanyarazi yihuta kwisi.
Ububiko busanzwe bwo gucuruza nkibyavuye muri Evolve na Boosted burashobora kugera kumuvuduko wo hejuru wa 20-25mph (32-40kph) muburyo bwihuse, mugihe imbaho ninzobere zishobora kwubakwa na moteri ikomeye cyane kumuvuduko wa 50mph (80kph) no hanze yacyo. Feri isanzwe ishyirwa mubikorwa nka Dynamic feri / Gufata feri biva mumuziga winyuma gusa kandi intera ihagarara irashobora gutandukana cyane hagati ya moteri niziga / ipine.
Habayeho impanuka nyinshi zica zirimo amashanyarazi ya skateboard hamwe na konti nyinshi zo gusura ibitaro. Ibikoresho byawe birinda harimo ingofero, ivi, inkokora hamwe nudupapuro twamaboko birasabwa kugenda byihuse.

Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice ni umubyeyi w'umunyarwandakazi umenyerewe muri filimi nyarwanda nka Kankwanzi mu runana, ukina filimi zitadukanye kandi akaba ari n'umwe mu bakinnyi b’ikinamico mu Rwanda.
Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice [wavutse 1964] ni umugore tumenyereye kumazina ya Kankwanzi, yavukiye mu uMujyi wa Kigali, mu akarere ka Nyarugenge. Ni imfura mu bana batatu bavukana nawe. Mu buzima busanzwe ni umubyeyi w’abana babiri[umuhungu n’umukobwa] gusa ntiyagize amahirwe yo gusazana n’umugabo kuko batandukanye ubu buri wese akaba y'ibana ariko by’umwihariko Marie Médiatrice akaba abana n’aba abana be bombi. Mu amashuri yisumbuye yize Sicial.
Ikinamico na filimi.
Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice avuga ko yatangiye kwiyumvamo impano akiri muto gusa akaza kugira amahirwe yo gutangira gukina ikinamico ku mugaragaro mu 1988 ubwo yari afite imyaka 24 y’amavuko.Yagize ati”Natangiye ubuhanzi bw’ikinamico mu 1988. Ni impano nari mfite kuko natangiye kuyiyumvamo nkiri umwana, nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi anjya mu itorero rya Mashirika, mu 1998 nabwo Urunana ruza gushaka abakinnyi ngiyeyo ndatsinda ninjiramo gutyo.”
Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice nka Kankwanzi akigera mu ikinamico Urunana kwitwa iri zina yabanje kubyanga kubera ukuntu yari kujya akina ari umugore ugaragaza ubujiji bwinshi.Yagize ati”Mu Urunana bari bari gushaka abakinnyi 8, babanje gutoranye 16 ndatsinda, barongera batoranya abandi 8 nabo mbazamo. Bampaye umwanya wa Kankwanzi ndawanga cyane, nkavuga nti’Ntabwo nakina ndi ikigoryi meze kuriya’ ariko umwanditsi ambwira ko ari nziza ngeze aho ndabyemera.” Yavuze ko hari amahugurwa yari amazemo iminsi bamubwira ko umuhanzi mwiza nta mwanya atakina birangira yemeye gukina ari mu ishusho ya Kankwanzi w’umunyacyaro.Kankwanzi avuga ko bitewe n'uburyo akina ari umugore w'umuturage kandi w' hari abantu benshi baba bumva ko ari nako ateye mu ubuzima busanzwe, gusa ngo iyo bamubonye birabatungura.Yagize ati “Hari umuntu wavuye mu Bufaransa w’umuzungukazi na we ukora biriya by’amakinamico, ambwira ko yumvaga ndi umunyacyaro cyane mfite ubujiji nka buriya mba ngaragaza. Na bamwe mu abanyamakuru ba BBC bigeze kuza mu Rwanda bambonye baratangara.”
Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice nka Kwankwanzi Kankwanzi yemeza ko Urunana rumaze kugira uruhare rukomeye mu iterambere ry’umuryango we, ndetse akaba yariyubakiye inzu akubaka n’izindi zo gukodesha zimwinjiriza amafaranga buri ukwezi. Akina ikinamico abikomatanya na filime ariko yemeza ko Urunana ari rwo rwamufashije cyane kuko filime yagiye akina ari nkeya kandi zikaba zitanabamo amafaranga menshi.Yagize ati”Urunana rumaze kungeza kuri byinshi nabashije kwiyubakira inzu y'iicumbi, narihiye abana amashuri nubaka n’andi mazu yo gukodesha byose kubera kurukomatanya no gukina filime ariko navuga ko uruhare runini ari Urunana kuko muri filime nta mafaranga arimo menshi.”Yakinnye muri filime yitwa ‘Haranira kubaho’, ‘Zirara zishya’ n’izindi nyinshi ndetse by’umwihariko yananyuze muri Seburikoko ariko ntabwo akigaragaramo kuko mu mwanya yakinagamo yapfuye.
Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice Avuga ko akunda cyane abahanzi bo ha mbere biganjemo Fredéric Francois, George Moustaki, Nana Mouskouri n’abandi. Ati ‘bariya bahanzi baririmba indirimbo zituje z’igifaransa zo ha mbere ndazikunda cyane.’Mu bahanzi bo mu Rwanda b’ubu avuga ko azi Amag The Black, King James, Jay Polly na Knowless.Mu abana be, Kankwanzi yemeza ko umuto umwana w’umukobwa witwa Umwali Aurore ari we ugaragaza impano yo gukina ikinamico ndetse bakaba bakinana ari umwana we mu Urunana yitwa Kereri [Claire].Ashishikariza abakuru biyumvamo impano kudatinya kuzigaragaza ndetse akanasaba abandi bamaze kugira aho bagera muri uyu mwuga gushyigikira impano z’abakiri bato nk'abana.

Eugénie Kayitesi Umunyarwandakazi, Ubu akaba atuye anakorera muri Africa Yepfo, Akaba Nimpuguke mubijyanye Nubuhinzi,ndetse Nubutubuzi bwimyaka.(Food Processing)
Eugénie Kayitesi ifite impamya bushobozi ya Professor yakuye muri kaminuza ya University of Pretoria Mubijyanye Nimitunganyireze nibikomoka mubuhinzi (Consumer and Food science).
Eugénie Kayitesi yabonye igihembo cya African Women in Agriculture Research Development (AWARD),
Eugénie Yabaye mubagize ikigo Health Equity and Right Organization, (HERO) Ikigo kitagamiye kuri Leta y'uRwanda.
Kayitesi Kandi yabaye Umujyanama wa komite yikigo cya Food Evaluation Research Laboratory (FERL).

Reta y'uRwanda ibinyujije muri minisiteri y'ibidukikije yatangije gahunda yo gutera amashyamba gusigasira ahari kubungabunga amashyamba ya kimeza ndetse ni ikengerezo za yo guhana abangiza amashya no gushyigikira abantu bafite umuhate mu gutera amashyambau Rwanda muri rusange rufite amashyamba ari ku buso bwa hegitari 724,666 ari byo bingana na 30.4%
Ibiti biteye mu Rwanda, 30% ari ibivangwa n’imyaka kandi hakaba hari gahunda yo kubyongera ku buryo muri 2024 bizaba bigeze kuri 85% no kongera ubuso buteyeho amashyamba.
Intego y'uRwanda mu kongera amashyamba.
Reta y'uRwanda ibinyujije mu kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe amashyamba kivuga ko u Rwanda rufite intego yo gusubiranya ibice byangiritse bidafite amashyamba no kongera aho yagabanutse, gusarura no gutera andi mashyamba aho atigeze hagamijwe kuyongera.
Umumaro w' amashyamba ku bidukikije n'urusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima.
Amashyamba abumbatira urusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima ndetse n'ibimera muri rusange, amashyamba afite umumaro mu guhangana n'ingaruka z'imihindagurikire y'ibihe no guhangana na amapfa nko mugihe cyi izuba cyangwa imvura nyishi muri rusanga.

Juliet Kabera ni Umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo gishinzwe gucunga ibidukikije mu Rwanda.
Juliet Kabera numuyobozi wikigo gishinzwe Kurinda Ibidukije Mu Rwanda (REMA), Akaba yarashyizweho muri Gicurasi 2020. Mbere yo gushyirwaho, yari afite umuyobozi mukuru w’ibidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe muri Minisiteri y’ibidukikije. Nyakanga. Juliet yabaye Umuyobozi wa Komite Nyobozi y'Ikigega Cyinshi cya Protokole ya Montreal mu mwaka wa 2019/2020.
Juliet KABERA yahawe impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor muri Siyanse yize ibijyanye na Biochemie yakuye muri kaminuza ya Makerere Kampala, muri Werurwe 2002, naho muri Kamena 2020 arangiza Masters muri Conservation MBA muri kaminuza Nyafurika y'Ubuyobozi.
Icyo Avuga muguca Amashashi Mu Rwanda.
Kabera yavuze ko uburambe bw’imyanda ya pulasitike bwagaragaje akamaro k’ubufatanye bw’igihugu, uturere ndetse n’amahanga mu rwego rwo kurwanya umwanda.Ati: "Nyuma y'ibiganiro bikomeye mu mezi ashize, twishimiye intambwe imaze guterwa mu rwego mpuzamahanga rwemewe n'amategeko ku bijyanye no kwanduza plastike".
Umushinga w’icyemezo uremera imiterere y’imipaka y’ikibazo cy’umwanda wa pulasitike kandi ko ari ngombwa kuwukemura aho uturuka.Yavuze ko hakenewe gushyirwaho amategeko akomeye na politiki haba ku rwego rw'igihugu ndetse no ku isi hose, agira ati: “Kubera ko umwanda wa plastike ari ikibazo cyambukiranya imipaka, dushobora kugikemura dukorera hamwe.”

Ni Umunyamategeko w’umunyarwandakazi
Mutimura Christine Wekesa yari ku rutonde rw’abakandida 35 b’abahanga mu by’amategeko bemejwe n’Inama y’abaminisitiri ba EAC (East African Community). yateranye kuwa 4-6 Mata 2022.
Mutimura yakoze mu bunyamabanga bwa (East African Community)EAC ari umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe iby’amategeko.
Mutimura Christine Wekesa yarahiriye inshingano mu gihe (East African Community Justice) EACJ idafite umwanditsi kuko Yufnalis Okubo, yagiye mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru kuwa 31 Werurwe 2022 afite imyaka 60. Bivuzeko ko azaba akora inshingano z’umwanditsi mukuru mu gihe hagishakishwa umwanditsi mukuru. Umuhango wo kurahiza Mutimura wabereye i Arusha muri Tanzaniya ku cyicaro cy’urukiko rwa (East African Community)EAC, uyoborwa na Perezida warwo Nestor Kayobera n’abandi bacamanza. Ni inshingano nshya z’umwanditsi wungirije w’Urukiko rw’Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba EAC(East African Community Justice).

N'Umushinga washizweho kugirango barebe banashire mubikorwa ikigo gishya aricyo Pariki Nyandungu.
Kuva muri Nzeri 2018, Minisiteri y’ibidukikije yabinyujije mu kigo gishinzwe imicungire y’ibidukikije mu Rwanda (REMA) yaririmo gutegura Pariki y’imyidagaduro y’igishanga i Nyandungu, kugira ngo itange ahantu ho kwidagadurira mu mijyi, igarure imikorere y’amazi y’igishanga no kongera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima.Muntangiriro, umushinga wateguwe kurangira mubice bibiri, icyiciro cya mbere cyatangiye kuva 2016 kugeza 2018 cyarimo kwiga no gutegura umushinga, mugihe icyiciro cya kabiri cyatangiye kuva 2018 kugeza 2020 cyari kigamije kwibanda kubikorwa byo kubaka.Ibikorwa byumushinga byarahagaze kubera kongera gukora neza umushinga no guhindura ikigo cyashyiraga mubikorwa byumushinga, kuko nta buhanga bwari bufite bwo gutunganya ubusitani.
Impamvu zahagaritse ibikorwa byumushinga harimo imvura idasanzwe itunguranye yateje imyuzure ikabije igira ingaruka kubikorwa byumushinga ndetse no gufunga icyorezo cya Covid-19 hamwe nakazi kashyizweho na leta kugirango ikumire ikwirakwizwa rya coronavirus.Izi mbogamizi zagize ingaruka kubikorwa byumushinga kandi ziyandikisha gutinda kumezi 8, kurugero ko bitazarangira muri 2020 nkuko byari byateganijwe.Ariko, inama hagati ya REMA, rwiyemezamirimo nu mucungezi wibikorwa byumushinga byarangiye wongereye andi mezi atandatu.

Izina ryabaye ikimenyabose ni Claire[cyangwa Kerere], umukobwa wa Kankwanzi na Bushombe bo mu Ikinamico Urunana, amazemo imyaka irenga cumi n’ibiri amazina ye nyakuri ni Umwali Aurore.
Claire cyangwa Kerere Ubusanzwe yitwa Umwali Aurore akaba yaramamaye nka Claire mu ikinamico urunana yanyuraga kuri BBC, [British Broadcasting Corporation], iri zina ni naryo abaturanyi bamuhamagara iwabo i Nyamirambo kuri 40. Yatangiye gukina Urunana yiga mu kiburamwaka mu mwaka wa 2005. Icyo gihe ajya gukina Urunana ntiyari azi ibyo arimo neza nk’umwana wari umaze igihe gito atangiye kwiga kugenda no guca akenge. Yinjiye mu ikinamico ajyanwe n’umubyeyi we Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice [uwo bakinana nka Kankwanzi [Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice] ari na we umubyeyi we mu Runana]. Umwali Aurole, ubu yiga mu umwaka wa kane mu ishuri rya Saint Philippe Gikondo riherereye mu Murenge wa Kigarama mu Karere ka Kicukiro, mu ishami ry’ibaruramari. Yavukiye mu mujyi wa Kigali, i Nyamirambo aho ni mu Karere ka Nyarugenge ari naho abana n’umubyeyi we Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice [Kankwanzi].
Umwali Aurore w’imyaka 17 avuga ko atajya agorwa no gukina ari umukobwa wo mu cyaro, icyamufashije cyane ngo ni uko yatangiye kubikina akiri muto bityo abikuriramo bikiyongeraho ko yumva akunze icyaro.Ati “Uretse ko dukina ibyanditse ariko nubwo navukiye mu mujyi wa Kigali ubuzima bw’icyaro ndabukunda, mu gukina ndabanza nkishyira mu buzima bw’icyaro nkabona gukina nk’umwana wo mu cyaro. Iyo Umwali na nyina bari mu rugo mu buzima busanzwe ntiwapfa kumenya ko bakinana mu Runana, gusa hari igihe baterura ikiganiro ukumvamo amajwi yo kwa Bushombe na Kankwanzi (Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice) i Nyamirambo. Umwali avuga ko kuba yarahawe gukina ari umwana wa Kankwanzi [Muhutukazi Marie Mediatrice] ari na we nyina w’amaraso ngo “Bimfasha kwirekura mu gukina.”
Umwali Aurore nka Kerere cyangwa Claire yibuka ko akinjira mu ikinamico Urunana, amafaranga ya mbere bamuhembye nyina yamuguriyemo igipupe, gusa amaze guca akenge ari we bacishaho amafaranga yabashije kwigurira igezweho. Hejuru y’inyungu nyinshi yakuye mu Runana, Umwali Aurore avuga ko igikomeye yungutse umuryango mushya ndetse ngo ni byo bimwishyurira ishuri.Ati “Igikomeye nungukiye mu ikinamico Urunana ni uko hari inyigisho batanga ku rubyiruko nanjye nkafataho, harimo n’inyungu z’amafaranga, mbasha kwiyishyurira ishuri kubera gukina.”Umwali avuga ko i Nyamirambo ahafite inshuti z’urungano banafitanye umubano ukomeye hanze y’ikinamico nka Petero, Mutesi, Obama musaza we n'abandi.
Umwali Aurore nka Kerere cyangwa Claire inzozi afite harimo kwagura impano ye akazavamo umuntu ukomeye mu ikinamico. Ikindi gikomeye yifuza ni ukuzaba umucuruzi uzwi mu Rwanda agakoresha ubumenyi yakuye mu ishuri. Ati “Numva nacuruza ibintu byo kurya, ngashinga nka alimentation cyangwa byazanshobokera nabonye ubushobozi nkashinga hoteli.”

Clementine Wamariya (wavutse mu mwaka 1988) ni umwanditsi w’umunyarwandakazi ariko utuye muri Amerika, akaba n’umuntu uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu cyane. Yavukiye mu muryango usanzwe i Kigali n'ababyeyi be afite imyaka itandatu kubera Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda, Yahungiye kwa nyirakuru mu majyepfo y’igihugu ariko ahatirwa kongera guhunga igihe jenoside yibasiraga umuryango wabo ikica nyirakuru. Yahunze igihugu amara imyaka itari mike azenguruka Afurika mbere yo guhabwa viza y'impunzi muri Amerika.
Yatuye hamwe n'umuryango we mu gace ka Chicago maze atangira amashuri afite imyaka cumi n'itatu. Yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu 2006 binyuze kuri "Oprah Winfrey Show ubwo yahuraga" bitunguranye n'ababyeyi be. Amaze kurangiza muri kaminuza ya Yale, yakomeje umwuga wo kuvuga mu ruhame harimo ibiganiro bya TED. Muri 2018, yasohoye igitabo kivuga ibyamubayeho, yise "The Girl Who Smiled Beads". Niwe wahawe igihembo cya Alex Awards 2019.
Ubuzima bwe muri make.
Wamariya yavukiye kandi akurira i Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda. Se yari umucuruzi mu bucuruzi bwa tagisi naho nyina yari umuhinzi ahinga imbuto n'indabyo murugo.
Itsembabwoko ryakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda ryatangiye muri Mata 1994, igihe Wamariya yari afite imyaka itandatu. Umuryango watangiye kumva urusaku rwinshi rwatewe n’amasasu, murumuna we Pudi avuga ko ari inkuba, basanga abaturanyi babo badahari. Nyina wa Wamariya amaze kumenya akaga kari kuba, yamwohereje hamwe na mushiki we, Claire, mu majyepfo y’igihugu kugira ngo babane mu isambu ya nyirakuru. Ariko ibyo nabyo ntibyari bifite umutekano, kandi umuryango wibasiwe bikomeye. Igihe abajenosideri bakomanga ku rugi, we na Claire babwiwe na nyirakuru guhunga. Mu guhunga nijoro no kwihisha ku manywa, barokotse bigoranye, bashoboye guhunga igihugu bahinduka impunzi. Benshi mubavandimwe be, harimo na nyirakuru, barishwe.
Ahantu hambere umutekano bawusanze ni mu nkambi yimpunzi mu Burundi, ariko ntibashoboye gutura ahantu hamwe igihe kirekire. ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu nkambi no gushaka ahantu hari itera imbere byatumye bakomeza kwimuka bivuze ko bamaze imyaka myinshi bakora ingendo hagati y'inkambi. Mu myaka itandatu yakurikiyeho bavuye mu Burundi bimukira muri Zayire, Tanzaniya, Malawi, Mozambike, amaherezo baza kugera muri Afurika y'Epfo. Kuva aho, mu 2000, we numuvandimwe we basabye Umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe abimukira kubaha ubufasha, bahabwa viza y'impunzi muri Amerika. Batuye hamwe n'umuryango mu nkengero za Chicago muri Kenilworth.
Kugaragara kuri "Oprah Winfrey Show".
Wamariya yamenyekanye bwa mbere kurwego mpuzamahanaga ubwo yagaragaraga kuri "Oprah Winfrey Show" mu 2006, akiri umunyeshuri muri New Trier. Hamwe na mushiki we Claire, bamusabye kuzagaragara kuri iki kiganiro kugira ngo baganire ku byamubayeho mu gihe cya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. Ariko we numuvandimwe we batabizi, Winfrey yari yateguye guhura bitunguranye n'ababyeyi babo. Se na nyina bombi barokotse jenoside,Wamariya yari yaravuganye na bo kuri telefoni, ariko yari amaze imyaka cumi n'ibiri atabonana nabo imbonankubone. Abatunganya iki kiganiro bateguye ingendo z'ababyeyi bava muri Afurika no guhura kwabo kuri tereviziyo. Wamariya yatumiwe nk'umushyitsi mu gitaramo cya "Oprah" inshuro eshatu mu myaka yakurikiyeho, kandi uko yagaragaye muri iki kiganiro byatumye yamamaye ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Wamariya yashishikajwe no kuvugira mu ruhame mu gihe cy'ishuri, kuko yabwiraga abanyeshuri ibyamubayeho. Amaze kugaragara kuri "Oprah", abategura ibirori, cyane cyane mu nzego z’ubutabazi, baramutumiraga ngo avuge uko byagenze. Mubikorwa bye harimo ikiganiro cya TED, cyiswe "War and What Comes After",
Amaze kugaragara kuri "Oprah", kandi mu gihe yari umunyeshuri i Yale, Wamariya yakoraga ibiganiro byo kuvuga muri Amerika mu nzu ndangamurage y’Urwibutso rwa Holocaust muri Amerika (USHMM). Mu rwego rwo kubimenya, ndetse n’akazi yakoranye n’imiryango y’impunzi i Yale no muri New Haven, muri leta ya Connecticut, yagizwe umuyobozi wa USHMM na Perezida Barack Obama. Yongeye gushyirwaho manda ya kabiri yimyaka itanu muri 2016.
Amaze kurangiza icyiciro cye muri Yale Wamariya yimukiye i San Francisco, yahuye n'umunyamakuru "wa New York Times" Elizabeth Weil, wari utuye mu gace kamwe. Yabwiye Weil ibyamubayeho, maze bombi batangira gutegura icyegeranyo kirekire bamaranye imyaka ibiri bagikoraho, cyasohotse muri 2018. Umutwe w'igitabo ni "The Girl Who Smiled Beads"; ibi bivuga inkuru yabwiwe na nyirasenge akiri umwana.

Jacqueline Mukangira n'umunyapolitikikazi w'u Rwanda numudipolomate. Kandi Ni Komiseri Mukuru w’u Rwanda mu Buhinde. Nanone kandi yahoze ari Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu bihugu by’Amajyaruguru.
Mukangira yagizwe Komiseri Mukuru mu gihugu cy'u Buhinde na guverinoma y’u Rwanda ku taliki ya 28 Ugushyingo mu mwaka 2019, agera mu Buhinde ku taliki ya 4 Werurwe mu mwaka wa 2020. Ku taliki ya 21 Gicurasi mu mwaka wa 2021, yashyikirije Perezida w’Ubuhinde Ram Nath Kovid ibaruwa ye y’icyizere mu muhango wakozwe n’inama hifashishijwe uburyo bwikoranabuhanga bwa videwo kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19. We na perezida biyemeje gukorera hamwe kugira ngo barusheho gushimangira umubano w’ibihugu byombi no kungurana ibitekerezo hagati y’u Rwanda na Malidiave. Yavuze ku bintu bidasanzwe bigize umuco w’ubucuruzi bw’u Rwanda ndetse na bimwe mu mishinga ibihugu byombi biteza imbere mu minsi ya vuba.
Mukangira mbere yari yarigeze gukora mu nzego zitandukanye, nk'Umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko mu mwaka wa 2004 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2007, Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri Suwede mu mwaka wa 2007 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2011), n'Umuyobozi Mukuru muri Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga n'Ubutwererane, Amahame remezo n'Ubushakashatsi muri Sena y'u Rwanda.

Mukamasabo Appolonie yabaye umuyobozi w'akarere ka Nyamasheke kuva mu mwaka wa 2019, uyu mwanya yawugiyeho asimbuye Kamali Aime Fabien wahoze ayoboye ako karere nyuma akaza kweguzwa n'inama njyanama nyuma yo kumutakariza icyizere, kubera kutuzuza inshingano, kudahuza inzego, hamwe no kutihutisha imyanzuro ifatwa n’inama njyanama.
Mukamasabo Appolonie nawe yaje kweguzwa n'inama njyanama y'akarere ka Nyamasheke, Inama y’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere Nyamasheke yafashe iki cyemezo cyo kwirukana Mukamasabo Appolonie yateranye kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 28 Kanama 2023. kubera imyitwarire n'imikorere idahwitse.
Perezida w’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere ka Nyamasheke, Hategekimana Jules Cesar, yabwiye UMUSEKE ko basanze Mukamasabo yaratezutse ku nshingano, hakaba hari ibyo atakoze ndetse n’imyitwarire mibi yatumye atuzuza ibyo yasabwaga. yasimbuwe by'agateganyo nuwari umuyobozi w'akarere wungurije ushinzwe iterambere ry'ubukungu bwana Muhayeyezu Joseph Desire.

Numbona uzanyite umusizi, nunyumva uzanyite igisigo" - icyo ni icyivugo cya Carine Maniraguha umusizi kugeza ubu ufite igihembo giheruka cy'uwahize abandi bose mu Rwanda.
Ubusizi ni ubutunzi bukomeye bw'umuco w'abantu - bwabayeho kuva cyera cyane ku imigabane yose y'isi aho abasizi bungikanya amagambo yuje ubuhanga n'injyana mu gusobanura ibiriho, umuco, ibyishimo, intambara, urukundo, amahoro, n'ibindi.
Maniraguha Carine Kimwe mu bisigo bye gitangaje ni icyo yise "Nsa nk'umusazi" aho avuga ku byo areba mu ishusho y'umuntu abandi bita umusazi, ati: "Ariko uko wasara uko ari ko kose ntabwo ibintu byawe byose biba ari ubusazi." avuga ko yahanze icyo gisigo kuko abitwa abasazi n'abiyita abazima babona ibintu ugutandukanye kandi buri wese azi ko uko abibona aribyo bizima. Ati: "Nanjye nanditse kiriya gisigo nk'umuntu utari gusobanukirwa neza ibyo ndimo kureba, atari uko ari byiza ahubwo hari aho biri kutujyana hatari heza." Carine Maniraguha aka yaragaragaye muri filimi nka Seburikoko, filimi Makuta na filimi Ejo si kera zinyura kuri RBA.
Ishamiry'umuryango w'abibumbye ryita ku uburezi, ubumenyi, n'umuco, UNESCO rivuga ko ariyo mpamvu buri mwaka tariki 21 Werurwe yahariwe kwishimira no gusigarisa ubusizi. Bigendanye n'uyu munsi wa 2022, ukuriye UNESCO yavuze ko "imbaraga z'ubusizi ntacyo wazigereranya", kandi ko nk'imvugo ifungura imiryango ku bandi ubusizi ari ubuvanganzo "bukenewe kurushaho mu bihe bikomeye".
Maniraguha Carine umukobwa w'umunyarwandakazi w'umusizi udasobecyeranya uzwi kandi nka Carine Poet [ufite imyaka 27] ubwo mu 2018 habaye irushanwa Art Rwanda-Ubuhanzi ry'ikigo Imbuto Foundation kuva ku imidugudu kugeza ku rwego rw'igihugu, abagabo n'abagore, Maniraguha Carine aza mu basizi 10 ba mbere, ndetse aza kubarusha aba uwa mbere. Nta rindi riraba kugeza ubu. Carine Poet acyeka ko inganzo ye ayikomora ku mugore wa mbere ufatwa nk'uwatangije ubusizi buriho ubu mu Rwanda - Nyiraruganzu II Nyirarumaga (wabayeho 1500 - 1550) -, nubwo na nyina umubyara afite iyo mpano ariko ngo atigeze ageza mu ruhame. Yagize ati: "Kugeza ubu igihembo cy'umusizi wa mbere mu Rwanda ni njyewe ugifite."

Somi (yavutse yitwa Laura Kabasomi Kakoma ku ya 6 Kamena 1981) ni umuririmbyi wahataniye Grammy award wavukiye muri Amerika, umwanditsi w'indirimbo, umwanditsi w'amakinamico, akaba n'umukinnyi wa filimi ukomoka mu Rwanda no muri Uganda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Somi yavukiye i Champaign, muri Illinois, mu gihe se yari arangije amasomo ya dogiteri muri kaminuza ya Illinois muri Urbana - Champaign. Igihe Somi yari afite imyaka itatu, umuryango we waje kwimukira i Ndola, muri Zambiya, naho se yakoraga mu muryango mpuzamahanga wita ku buzima. Mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 1980, ubwo se yabaga umwarimu muri kaminuza ya Illinois, basubiye muri Champaign, aho Somi yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Kaminuza ndetse na Champaign Central High School. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza muri Anthropology na African Studies yakuye muri kaminuza ya Illinois muri Urbana - Champaign. Afite kandi impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga yakuye muri kaminuza ya New York 's Tisch School of Arts in Performance Studies.
Muri 2007, yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere "Red Soil in My Eyes" muri label ya Harmonia Mundi / World Village label bakoranye amasezerano ye ya mbere yo kumufasha mu muziki. Iyi alubum yakunzwe cyane hamwe nindirimbo "Ingele" yabonye umwanya wa 10 kuri U.S. World Music Charts muri Amerika mumezi menshi.
Muri 2009, Somi yasinyanye na label yigenga ya ObliqSound. yahise asohora "If the Rains Come Firstt" yasohotse ku ya 27 Ukwakira 2009, hanyuma igatangira kuri no. 2 kuri "Billboard" ' iba iya 21 kuri ' Heatseekers chart "Billboard". Iyi alubumu igaragaramo umuhanga wo muri Afrika yepfo Hugh Masekela, umujyanama wa Somi umaze igihe kinini. Muri Werurwe 2011, Somi yashyize alubumu ye ya mbere y'ibitaramo kuri Jazz Standard izwi cyane mu mujyi wa New York. Yasohotse kuri Palmetto Records muri Kanama 2011.
Muri 2013, Somi yasinyanye amasezerano yambere ya label na Sony Music kugirango abe umwe mubahanzi ba mbere kuri jazz imprint Okeh Records. Album ye na label yambere yatangiriye "The Lagos Music Salon", igaragaramo abahanzi badasanzwe batsindiye Grammy award nka Angelique Kidjo na Common ndetse ikanagaragara kuri US Jazz Charts, yatewe inkunga n'amezi 18 yamaze i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Nyuma yo gushimwa cyane no kuba abafana bariyongereye cyane, "The Huffington Post" hamwe nibindi bitangazamakuru byise Somi " Nina Simone mushya". Muri Werurwe 2017, yasohoye "Petite Afrique" nka alubumu ye ya kabiri kuri Okeh Records. Iyi alubumu yatsindiye igihembo cy’amashusho cya NAACP 2018 kubera indirimbo idasanzwe ya Jazz, ni alubum y’umuryango munini w’abimukira bo muri Afurika batuye i Harlem, Umujyi wa New York.
Muri Nyakanga 2020, Somi yasohoye 'Holy Room - Live kuri Alte Oper' Album ya Live, inagaragaramo Radio Big Band ya Frankfurt, yatorewe igihembo cya Grammy award 2021 cya Album nziza ya Jazz Vocal kandi yegukana igihembo cya 2021 NAACP Image Award nka Album ya Jazz Yamamaye, Vocal.
Ikinamico yambere ya Somi, "Dreaming Zenzile", n'umuziki ushingiye kubuzima bwa Miriam Makeba. Yerekanwe bwa mbere muri The Repertory Theatre ya St. Louis muri Nzeri 2021 nyuma yuko igice cya mbere gihagaritswe iminsi itanu mbere kwerekanwa muri Werurwe 2020 kubera icyorezo cya Covid-19. Nkumwanditsi n'umukinnyi, akoresha izina rye ryanyuma akagenda na Somi Kakoma.Kuri ubu Somi atuye mu mujyi wa New York.

Uyu ni umwe mu bagore bacye mu Rwanda bize ubumenyi ishami ry'ubugenge (physics), ubu ari gukora PhD ku ikoreshwa ry'ikoranabuhanga mu myigishirize y'ubugenge, abwira abana b'abakobwa bakiri bato amahirwe bo ubu bafite yo kwiga amasomo y'ubumenyi, Yitwa Dr Madame Nyirahabimana Pascasie.
Dr Nyirahabimana Pascasie, ni umunyarwanda kazi akaba ari umubyeyi w'abana bane, uyu akaba ari mwarimukazi wa kaminuza Nkuru yu Rwanda mu ishami ry'ubugenge avuga ko nawe atatekerezaga ko aziga ubugenge cyangwa ngo agere aho ageze ubu. Madamu Nyirahabimana Pascasie yiga mu mashuri abanza umuntu wari aho wize amashuri menshi yari mwarimu, akumva ko yazaba mwarimu abaye abonye ayo mahirwe. yagize ati "Twebwe ntabwo twigaga dufite intumbero kuko no kwiga icyo gihe ntibyari byoroshye".
Madame Nyirahabimana Pascasie yahise ahagarika amashuri yubaka urugo mu 1995, mu 1996 arabyara umwana ariko yumvikanye n'umugabo we ko agomba gusigarana umwana ankajya kwiga. umugabo we yaramushyigikiye ajya kwiga amashuri ya kaminuza, kandi atanaretse inshingano yo kurera umwana, imirimo ubusanzwe yombi itoroshye kuko isaba umwanya uhagije. Yagize Ati: "Ibyo rero byatumaga mvuga nti 'ngomba kwiga cyane nkazarangiza amashuri bikamfasha guteza imbere ubuzima bwanjye n'ubw'umuryango wanjye'".
Madame Nyirahabimana Pascasie nawe nkabandi abana b'abakobwa bose bigaga siyansi yabwiwe amagambo yo kumuca intege, akayumva ariko ntayahe agaciro. yakomeje kubona ubusumbane ubwo hariho ishami ry'ayisumbuyei ryigisha kwita ku muryango, rizwi nka 'familiale', yari nk'umwihariko w'abakobwa, abahungu bakaba aribo biga ibindi, nubwo nyuma byaje guhinduka abana b'abakobwa bakadenda biga andi mashami. Dr nyirahabimana Pascasie ati "Ibibazo nahuye nabyo bikomeye ni imyumvire y'abantu batandukanye, ntibumvaga uburyo umugore ajya kwiga ubumenyi [sciences] kandi ntibumva uko wabifatikanya n'izindi nshingano zirimo urugo". Ariko yaragiye yaragiye yiga amashuri yisumbuye arayarangiza, yiga na kaminuza ayirangiza ari imbere y'abandi bose biganaga. Ati: "Twize turi abanyeshuri 15, ninjye gusa wabonye amanota yo hejuru, rero wakwibaza uti ni gute umuntu ashobora kubona amanota yo hejuru mu bahungu ari abakobwana cyangwa se ari umudamu?"
Docteur madame Nyirahabimana Pascasie agira inama abakobwa bakiri bato kwiremamo icyizere, kumenya ko bafite ubushobozi bungana n'ubw'abahungu ndetse ko ubu banafite amahirwe. Ati: "Njyewe nagendaga ntafite uwo ndeba, ariko bo baragenda batureba imbere, ubwoba bafite rero nibatwegere tubafashe kugira ngo ejo aho turi nituhava bazahajye".
Ishami ry'Umuryango w'abibumbye ryita ku uburezi, ubumenyi n'umuco, UNESCO, rivuga ko abagore bari mu bushakashatsi muri siyansi ku isi batagera kuri 30%. Iri shami rivuga kandi ko abagore bari munsi ya 30% ari bo bagera muri za kaminuza mu masomo ya Siyansi, Ikorabuhanga, injeniyeri n'Imibare azwi nka STEM.

Eugenie Musayidire, yavutse Ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1952, mu Rwanda,N'umunyarwandakazi uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu uba mu Budage. Yahawe igihembo mpuzamahanga cya Nuremberg mu burenganzira bwa muntu mu 2007.
Eugénie Musayidire ni Umwe mubatutsi bake mu Rwanda. Yahunze mu 1973, igihe yaburiwe ko yenda gufatwa. Yabanje guhungira mu Burundi, akomeza amasomo ye muri kaminuza y’Uburundi mu bijyanye n’ubukungu n’imibereho. Mu 1977, yasabye ubuhungiro muri politiki mu Budage, kandi yitoza kuba umufasha wa farumasi. Yareze Umuryango atura i Siegburg, aho yakoraga mw'Itorero ry'Abaluteriyani Yaje gukora i Bonn.
Yize ko umuryango we wishwe mu gihe cya Genocide yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.: abura nyina, murumuna we na bene wabo benshi kandi baziranye. Inshuti yamuzaniye ibuye, vestige yonyine murugo rw'umuryango we. Yasobanuye ibisobanuro by'aya makuba yandika igitabo cyitwa "Ma pierre qui parle", mu 1999.
Eugénie Musayidire yiyemeje mu buryo bw'intangarugero mu bwiyunge hagati y'Abahutu n'Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Mu 2001, yasuye igihugu akomokamo, ku nshuro ya mbere kuva yava mu buhungiro. Muri uwo mwaka, yashinze mu Budage ishyirahamwe " Hoffnung In Ruanda e. v.»(«Ibyiringiro mu Rwanda "). Abikesheje inkunga y'Itorero ry'Abaporotesitanti b'Abadage, yashinze, mu 2003, i Nyanza, Ikigo gishinzwe kuvura urubyiruko, "IZERE", aho abana ndetse n'urubyiruko bahura n'ingaruka za Genocide bitaweho.
Muri uku kuguma mu Rwanda mu 2001, yashoboye guhura n'umwicanyi wo mu muryango we, wahoze aturanye. Iyi nama nicyifuzo cyo kwiyunga byatumye havuka firime, "Mama wa Assassin". Iyi filime yahawe igihembo cya Adolf-Grimme.
Kuwa 30 Nzeri 2007, Eugénie Musayidire ahabwa igihembo mpuzamahanga cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu cya Nuremberg, gitangwa na Doudou Diène wahoze ari umunyamabanga w’umuryango w’abibumbye ku bibazo by’ivanguramoko, ivangura rishingiye ku moko, abanyamahanga no kutoroherana.
Muri Gicurasi 2015, documentaire yitwa "Mein Stein spricht" ("Ibuye ryanjye rivuga: inzira ndende yo kwiyunga mu Rwanda"), ku nkuru ya Eugénie Musayidire ivugwa kuri televiziyo ARD-alpha

Uwimana Jeannette wa tunguranye mu bataniraga ikamba rya Nyampinga wu Rwanda 2022, ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva no kutavuga ni umwe mu abakobwa batunguranye aho yaje no kwegukana ikamba ry’uwahize abandi kugira umushinga urimo agashya ‘Miss Innovation.
Uwimana Jeannette [yavutse mu 1996] ni umunyarwandakazi umenyekanye cyane vuba aha, nyina yitwa Mukabutera Colette, yavuze ko umwana we yavutse atavuga kandi atumva. Ni imfura mu muryango avukamo, mama yibuka ko yabonye icyo kibazo mfite amezi abiri. yajyanywe ku bitaro bitandukanye nyuma banzura ko atumva kandi atavuga. uyu umukobwa w'i myaka 26, niwe umukobwa wa mbere ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva no kutavuga wateye intambwe yo kwinjira mu irushanwa rya Nyampinga Rwanda.
Uwimana jeannette yize amashuri yisumbuye mu ikigo gifasha abafite ubumuga cya HVP-Gatagara kandi arateganya gukomeza kaminuza, Uwimana ingorane nyamukuru y'abameze nkawe ari ukumvikana n'abandi kuko ururimi rwabo ari amarenga kandi atazwi na benshi.
Uwimana Jeannette niwe mukobwa wenyine mu abana barindwi bavukana, iwabo ni mu akarere ka Nyanza mu intara y'Amajyepfo, avuga ko "nakuranye intego yo gukora cyane nkazaba umugore ushoboye, ntitaye ku bumuga bwanjye."Ati: "Nciye muri nyampinga Miss Rwanda, ndashaka guharanira uburenganzira bungana kuri bose no guteza imbere urubyiruko rufite ubumuga. Ikirenzeho, ibyo abahatana basabwa byose; ubwiza, ubwenge n'umuco, nakubwira ntashidikanya ko byose mbyujuje." Mukabutera umusemurira mu ururimi rw' amarenga yagize ati: "Yajyaga ku ishuri ugasanga abana bigana badafite ibikoresho akabaha ibye, ubundi abana badafite amaguru agakunda kubaterura no kubakarabya. Uwimana Jeannette kuva kera yifuzaga kuba Nyampinga Miss Rwanda, Nyuma yo gutera intambwe ya mbere akinjira muri iri rushanwa rya Nyampinga Miss Rwanda, Uwimana Jeannette avuga ko ubu abantu benshi bamushyigikiye, harimo abo mu muryango we, inshuti ze, n'abantu b'iwabo ku ivuko. Uwimana Jeannette avuga ko naba nyampinga muri Miss Rwanda 2022 azaharanira gusaba ko itegeko rirengera abamugaye rishyirwa mu bikorwa maze abafite ubumuga nk'ubwe bakabona ubwisanzure ahatangirwa serivisi, ku mashuri, mu ma banki, mu bitaro, n'ahandi….Ati: " Nzakomeza gukora ubukangurambaga kuri ibi ibibazo n'ingorane abafite ubumuga bahura nazo buri munsi."Uretse gufashwa gushyira mu ngiro umushinga we, umukobwa wegukanye igihembo cy’ufite uhiga iyindi agenerwa umushahara w’ibihumbi 500 amafaranga yu Rwanda ku ukwezi, ahabwa na Banki ya Kigali.

Marie Clémentine Dusabejambo (wavutse 1987) ni umukinnyi wa firime wo mu Rwanda.
Dusabejambo yavukiye i Kigali muri 1987, umwuga we ni ukuba enjeniyeri w'amashanyarazi n'itumanaho.
Filime ngufi ya "Dusabejambo, Lyiza" yatsindiye igihembo cya bronze cya Tanit mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage mu 2012. Filime ye ngufi "A Place for Myself" (2016) yavuze amateka y'umukobwa ukiri muto ukomoka mu Rwanda urwaye albinism, uhanganye n’ivangura n’agasuzuguro yakorewe mu ishuri ribanza. Dusabejambo yashimishijwe niyi ngingo nyuma yo kumva amakuru y’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abantu barwaye alibinism muri Tanzaniya. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Goethe Institut i Kigali, kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime ryabirabura rya Toronto 2017. Yabonye ibihembo bitatu, harimo igihembo cya Ousmane Sembene, mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Zanzibar (ZIFF), kandi yegukanye igihembo cya bronze cya Tanit mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Carthage mu 2016. Yatowe kandi muri Filime Nziza mu bihembo bya Afurika bya Filime 2017, kandi yegukanye igihembo cya Thomas Sankara muri FESPACO 2017.
"Icyasha" (2018) yibanze kumuhungu wimyaka 12, wifuzaga kwinjira mumakipe y'umupira w'amaguru ariko akaba atotezwa kubera effeminate. Yatowe muri Filime Nziza muri ZIFF 2018, mu cyiciro cya firime ngufi mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage, no muri Filime ngufi nziza muri Afurika muri Movie Academy Awards 2019. Yatsindiye igihembo cya Zébu muri Filime ngufi ya Panafrican muri Rencontres du Film Court Madagascar 2019.

Docteur Mukanyirigira Didacienne, ni umwe mu mubagore b'abanyarwanda b'indashyikirwa akaba ari umwe mu bahanga mu myuga w'ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda.
Docteur Didacienne Mukanyirigira ni umwarimu muri kaminuza nkuru yu Rwanda mu ishami ryikoranabuhaga, akaba n'umuyobozi w'icyiciro cy'akabiri mukigo nyafurika gishizwe interinete ikora hagati y' ibintu, uyu umugore akaba n'umubyeyi wabana 3, yagiye akora amasomo itandukanye muri urwo rwego ubu akaba afite impamyabushobozi y'icyirenga [] mu ikoranabuhanga n'itumanaho ariko mbere yibyo byose akaba atigeze arota kuzagera kuri urwo rwego.
Docteur Mukanyirigira Didacienne kuri ubu ni umuyobozi w’amasomo mu Ishuri rya ICT akaba n’umuyobozi w'icyiciro cy'akabiri m'ikigo nyafurika gishizwe interinete ikora ku bintu (ACEIoT) muri kaminuza nkuru yu Rwanda.Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya BSc muri yakuye mu Ishuri Rikuru ry'ubumenyi n'Ikoranabuhanga rya Kigali (KIST), ubu ni kaminuza nkuru ya Rwanda, Ishuri Rikuru ry'ubumenyi n'ikoranabuhanga (UR-CST).Afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya siyansi mu bijyanye n'amakuru n'itumanaho yakuye muri kaminuza ya Huazhong y’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga (HUST), mu Bushinwa, na PhD mu bijyanye n’amashanyarazi, ubushakashatsi bw’itumanaho yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town, Afurika y'Epfo. Docteru Mukanyirigira Didacienne Inyungu zubushakashatsi bwe ni ugukoresha interineti y'ibintu kugirango ibone ibisubizo by'igihugu mubibazo bitandukanye, harimo ubwikorezi, ubuhinzi, ubuzima.
Docteur Mukanyirigira Didacienne Kugeza ubu ni Umusesenguzi Mukuru muri Komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga (NCST), u Rwanda akaba na Perezida w’Inama y'ubutegetsi muri Rwanda Energy Group Limited.

Agahozo Alphonsine ni umukinnyi w'umunyarwandakazi ukina umukino wo koga. Ni umwe mu bakobwa bitabiriye imikino Olempike yabereye i Londres mu Bwongereza mu 2012 no mu 2020 yabereye i Tokyo mu Buyapani, aho yari ahagarariye u Rwanda mu cyiciro cy'abagore cyo Koga metero 50 bakoresheje uburyo bwo koga bwitwa freestyle.
Ubuzima bwe n'umwuga wo koga.
Alphonsine Agahozo yavutse tariki 18 Nyakanga mu mwaka wa 1996.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, yitabiriye imikino Olempike yabereye i Londres mu Bwongereza. Yaserukiye u Rwanda mu cyiciro cy'abagore cyo koga metero 50 hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa freestyle. Yasoje iri rushanwa ari ku mwanya wa 58, ntiyabasha kugera mu cyiciro cya kimwe cya kabiri (1/2) cy'irushanwa.
Yongeye guhagararira u Rwanda mu mikino Olempike ya 2020 yabereye i Tokyo mu Buyapani, aho yitabiriye irushanwa ry'abagore ryo koga metero 50 hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa freestyle.

Valerie Piraino n'umunyabugeni w'umunyarwanda ariko utuye muri Amerika umenyerewe cyane mu gushushanya no gutaka ibishushanyo.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Yavutse muri 1981 i Kigali, mu Rwanda akurira haba mu gihugu cye ndetse no muri Amerika. Ubuhanzi bwe bugaragaza indangamuntu y’amahanga kandi bukubiyemo insanganyamatsiko nko gusobanura ibintu byinshi biranga muri rusange, kurwanya ubukoloni (cyangwa kurwanya imperialism), diaspora ny'afurika. Yahawe ibihembo birenga icumi bimwemerera imikoranire, kandi yagiye agaragara mu imurikagurisha rirenga mirongo itatu muri leta umunani za Amerika ndetse no mubindi bihugu bitatu.
Nyina wa Valerie, yari umuhanga mu kudoda mu Rwanda, yahuye na se w'umunyamerika, igihe yakoraga mu bikorwa byo gutabara no kwiteza imbere. Nyuma yo kuva mu bwana bwe akiri muto yagiye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, no mu bindi bihugu bitatu byo muri Afurika, Valerie, kimwe n'ababyeyi be, bimukiye muri Arizona. Nyuma, umuryango we wimukiye i Baltimore, MD, aho yize muri kaminuza ya Maryland Institute of Art. Igihe Valerie yigaga i Baltimore, yasubiye mu Rwanda, aho benshi mu ruhande rwa nyina bari biciwe muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. Uru rugendo rwashishikarije umurimo we nk'umuhanzi uhuza ibihugu, harimo n'umushinga we. Mu 2005, Valerie yimukiye mu mujyi wa New York, ari naho yatangiriye MFA mu ishuri ry’ubuhanzi rya kaminuza ya Columbia. Yarangije muri MFA ye mu 2009 yahise yihutira guhanga umurimo we, kuri ubu akora nk'umwarimu w'igihe gito mu ishuri rya Parsons of Design.
Ibikorwa bigaragara n'imurikagurisha.
Ikigaragara ni uko umurimo we uzwi cyane, ni urukurikirane rw'ibishusho bigizwe namapapayi yakoze ashushanyije ibice bya polystirene, hanyuma bigahisha imiterere y'ibumba ryirabura rya epoxy, irangi, resin, ibiti, ndetse rimwe na rimwe akoresha irangi rya zahabu kugirango anogereze igishushanyo. Mu kuganira ku kamaro k’amabara, umukara na zahabu, Valerie avuga ko umukara na zahabu byibutsa ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro ndetse n’ibidukikije byabereye muri Afurika kubera ubukoloni. Amabara n'imiterere nabyo byerekana uruhu rw'abaturage bava muri Afurika bakoreshejwe mu mutungo kamere wabo.
Amapapayi ni imbuto zatoranijwe kugirango zihagararire imyumvire yo kurwanya ubukoloni kubwimpamvu ebyiri zingenzi. Iya mbere, Amapapayi yari ifunguro rya mugitondo mugihe yari umukobwa muto akiri muri Afurika. Icya kabiri, amapapayi, akomoka muri Karayibe, bagereranya nk'ubukoloni kuko "bakurikiza inzira y'ubutegetsi bwa gikoloni ". Mu imurikagurisha ryarangiye muri Mutarama, 2017 ryiswe "Dis Place" mu Nzu Ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi bwa Diasporan, amapapayi yasaga nkaho yakomeretse, byerekana ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore bo muri Afurika. Mu gihe amapapayi ari bimwe mu bikorwa bya Valerie bizwi cyane, yakoze ibindi bishushanyo byinshi kandi yagiye mu imurikagurisha mu gihugu hose, ndetse anagaragara mu imurikagurisha mu bindi bihugu ku isi.
Ibihembo yatsindiye.
Valerie yakiriye ubusabane nibihembo mu myaka ye yose yo guhanga ibihangano.

Abagore baragenda biyongera mu kazi ko kubaka mu Rwanda, ariko ni bacye cyane baboneka bakuriye za 'chantiers', Enatha Cyuzuzo ari muri abo, ni umwihariko afite mu intara y'Iburasirazuba mu Karere ka Nyagatare.
Cyuzuzo Enatha Kubakisha inzu niwo mwuga yize muri kaminuza, ariko ni n'ibintu yakunze kuva ari muto, anabishyigikirwamo n'ababyeyi be n'abavandimwe be, nk'uko yabibwiye BBC.Mu biro bya kompanyi ye Ela Poder Construction Company, no kuri chantier imwe muzo afite i Nyagatare, Cyuzuzo akoresha abagabo n'abagore barimo n'abamuruta cyane mu imyaka.Inzu imwe muzo ari kubakisha ayigeze kure, ati: "Ubu ndi gupinyura 'renton' ndashaka gusakara nyine"Yongeraho ati: "Iyo twubaka inzu tugira ibyiciro, hari icyiciro cya mberee cyo gutegura, ubundi niko kazi, ibindi ni ukubikura ku gipapuro nkabitereka ku ikibanza. "Aha bisaba kwitonda cyane kuko Akarere kaza gusuzuma niba ibintu washushanyije aribyo wubatse." Mu kazi ke ko gupatana no kubakisha inzu, uyu mukobwa w'imyaka 26 ushoboye yerekera abagabo n"abagore, akabaha amabwiriza y'ibyo bakora, akabahemba nabo bakababo.
Cyuzuzo Enatha nk'umwubatsi (civil engineer) amaze kubakisha inzu i Kigali aho akomoka no muri Nyagatare aho yahisemo gukorera kuko yabonye ari umujyi uzakomeza gutanga akazi kenshi mu bwubatsi n'ejo hazaza. Gatete Athanase wamuhaye akazi k'inzu ubu ari kubakisha mu mujyi wa Nyagatare avuga ko yakamuhaye kuko yabonye ko afite ubushobozi. Ati: "Azi kubaka, kandi inzu ni ikintu umuntu ashyira hariya kikagaraga ukavuga uti 'iyi inzu yubatse neza', ibikorwa rero yakoze [mbere] nibyo byivugiye, mbona afite ubushobozi, mbona afite udushya." Nubwo ataragira inararibonye y'imyaka myinshi muri aka akazi, Cyuzuzo avuga ko ubu amaze kwigirira icyizere, ariko ntajya yibagirwa, inzu ya mbere yubakishishe. Kubera imiterere y'aho yari iri ntibyari byoroshye, ati: "Ni ukuvuga ngo iyi nzu yarangoye pe! Nageze aho nkajya ndara ntasinziriye."Ariko imaze kurangira niyo nzu yatumye nisuzuma, mpinduka undi muntu ndabyumva ko ndi gukura, iyi nzu yari ifite ibigeragezo birenze ibya etage yubatse ahantu hazima."Nkiyuzuza nahise mvuga nti "ntacyananira."
Guhindura imyumvire.
Cyuzuzo Enatha avuga ko Kompanyi ye ipatana kubaka amazu, ubwe ashushanya imbata z'inzu akaba ari nawe uzubakisha. Gushushanya ni imwe mu mpano yabonye ko afite kuva ari muto. Aqkazi akora kiganjemo abagabo akavuga ko ibi bituma hari ingorane ahura nazo zishingiye ku myumvire ya bamwe muri bo.Ati: "Hari imitekerereze ya bamwe bumva ko umukobwa mutagirana 'deal' y'akazi gusa. "Ni ukuvuga ngo gukorana n'igitsina gabo bisaba ngo wisanishe nacyo, ubereke ko nawe uri umugabo, ko ushoboye kandi ubereke ko uri umukobwa uri 'smart' niho abura aho ahera." Enatha Cyuzuzo afite umusore bakundana kandi ngo bazashinga urugo rwabo "vuba", uyu umusore ngo akunda ibyo akora ndetse "ni imwe mu mpamvu intera ingufu zo gukora".

Uwimana Consolée (yavutse 1964 mu karere ka Ngororero),ni umukinnyi w’ikinamico uzwi nka Nyiramariza m’ Urunana na Manyobwa muri Musekeweya n'izindi zitandukanye akaba abarizwa mu itorero Indamutsa ry' ikigo cy'igihugu gishizwe itangazamakuru (RBA).
Uwimana Consolée ni umubyeyi w'abana batanu yirerana kuko umugabo we yitabye Imana mu 1990, Consolée yabyirutse ari umukobwa ushabutse ndetse abo biganye mu mashuri abanza bamufiteho urwibutso nk’umunyembaraga wahoranaga inseko n’ibyishimo ndetse akaba yari azwiho guhora akangurira bagenzi be kutigunga.
Uwimana yatangiye gukina ikinamico ari mu mashuri abanza abigiramo umwete bidasanzwe hanyuma aza kujya mu itorero Indamutsa rya RBA mu mwaka wa 1984. Uwimana yakinnye amakinamico atandukanye aho izina rye rizwi mu makinamico nka “Bazirunge zange zibe isogo”[yakinnye ari Bazirunge] ari nayo kinamico yatangiriyeho akijya mu itorero Indamutsa,mu mwaka wa 2002 yatangiye gikina ikinamico Urunana,akomereza kuri Musekeweya, Ruteruzi ndatashye n’izindi nyinshi.
Uwimana yabaye ikimenyabose mu gihugu hose nka Nyiramariza umugore wa Sitefano mu ikinamico Urunana, by’agahebuzo yubatse izina mu buryo budasanzwe muri Musekeweya aho akina yitwa Manyobwa umugore wa Kibanga.

Karekezi Uwacu Martine yabaye umwanditsi ukomeye w’ibitabo abitewe no kubura inkuru akoresha yigisha abana. Uwacu Karekezi Martine avuga ko kwandika ibitabo no gushushanya atari impano Imana iha abagabo bonyine, gusa haracyari abagore benshi babikora bakabiherana mu ngo zabo, n'abatabona uko bakoresha impano yabo, nyamara uyu ni umwuga urimo imibereho.
Uwacu Karekezi Martine, ni umwarimukazi w’indimi wabigize umwuga wigisha abana bo mu mashuri y’incuke kuri Green Hills Academy, mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Hejuru yo kuba umwarimukazi, ni umwanditsi w’ibitabo by’abana, imivugo, gushushanya n’ibindi bifite aho bihuriye n’ubugeni. Uyu mwarimu umaze imyaka isaga 15 mu uburezi, yavuze ko agitangira kwigisha yaje kujya ahura n’ikibazo cy’inkuru ziryoshye zijyanye n’amasomo yabaga asabwa kwigishaabanyeshuri be. Yarebye kujya apfa kwigisha uko abonye, abona yaba ari gutatira amahame agenga umwuga w’uburezi, ahitamo gutangira kwiyandikira inkuru zizajya zijyana n’amasomo ashaka kwigisha abana.
Karekezi Uwacu Martine avuga ko aka akazi ko kwa ndika ibitabo, yagatangiye agitangira kwigisha abana. Hari ukuntu ukenera kwigisha abana isomo, ukabona nta nkuru n’imwe iri mu igitabo ufite yagufasha kwigisha abana.”Yakomeje agira ati “Njye ntabwo inkuru nari nkeneye byari ngombwa ko ziba mu bitabo cyangwa ngo zimpe amafaranga, nta nubwo nari nzi ko hari uwazikunda ngo azishyire mu ibitabo ariko njye zari zinyuze n’abanyeshuri banjye zikabaryohera. Nkandika inkuru yarangiza ibyo nayihimbiye nkayishyira mu kabati nkayibika.”
Mu imwaka wa 2015, Uwacu yaje guhura n’abashinzwe guteza imbere ibijyanye n’ibitabo mu muryango Save the Children, bamusangana agatabo gato yari yariyandikiye n’intoki karimo imwe mu inkuru yajyaga yifashisha yigisha abanyeshuri be. Ako gatabo baragakunze, bamwizeza kumuhuza n’inzu zisohora ibitabo zikomeye zikamufasha gushyira hanze inkuru ze. Ati “Bampuje n’inzu zisohora ibitabo ndetse n’abashushanya, bakunda inkuru zanjye uyikunze akambwira ko ayigura.” Mu imyaka mike amaze atangiye gusohora ibitabo, amaze gusohora ibitabo 20 birimo inkuru z’abana ndetse n’ibindi bine birimo imivugo. Avuga ko amafaranga ava mu bwanditsi bw’ibitabo ataraba menshi nk’uko bikwiriye ariko ku muntu wakuze akunda kwandika ibyo bitamuca intege. Ati “Abantu bandika ibyishimo bya mbere ntabwo ari amafaranga. Inyungu ya mbere tugira ni ukubona ko hari abasomye ibyo twanditse cyangwa se akaguha igitekerezo gitandukanye. Uguhaye igitekerezo aba aguhaye inyungu iruta uwari kukigura akagishyira mu akabati.” Uwacu nyuma yo gushyira hanze impano ze, yashinze Sankofa Creative Ltd, inzu ihuriza hamwe abahanzi n’ abanyabugeni mu ngeri zitandukanye, bagahanga, bagakosorana bakagurisha.
Ubwanditsi bwatumye Uwacu atagihorana umutima uhangayitse, cyangwa se ngo ahore arambirije ku mushahara gusa.
Karekezi Uwacu Martine Afite inzozi zo kwagura impano ye ndetse n’ibikorwa bya sosiyete ye [Sankofa Creative Ltd, ubwanditsi n’ubugeni bukaba umwuga utunga abawukora mu Rwanda. rero Nta igihe cyashira utumvise abavuga ko AbanyaRwanda badafite umuco wo gusoma, ko aho gusoma ibitabo bamwe bihitiramo gusoma amacupa mu tubari rero tugire umuco wo gusoma ibitabo.

Rwigamba Rica ni umunyarwandakazi, inzobere mubijyanye n'ubukerarugendoyabaye umuyobozi mu ishami ry'ubukerarugendo mu ikigo k'igihugu gishinzwe iterambere RDB.
Rica Rwigamba yize amashuri yisumbuye ku ikigo cy'amashuri cya St Marys School kuva 1995 kugera 1997 mu ishami ry'ubukungu-icyongereza n'igifaransa (Economy-English literature and French), nyuma yakomereje amasomo ye muri kaminuza ya Makerere muri Uganda kuva 1998 kugera 2001 mu ishami ry'ububanyi n'amahanga. Nyuma yo gusoza kaminuza yakomerejeho ikiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza (Master of Business administration) muri Kaminuza ya Oklahoma Christian University kuva 2014 kugera 2016.
Amateka y'umuryango ahagarariye.
Rica ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru wa gateganyo wa Mastercard Foundation mu Rwanda; ikomatanya ubuyobozi, kwihangira imirimo n'imibereho myiza. Ibi byagize ingaruka nziza ku rugendo rwe ubwo yakoraga muri guverinoma, abikorera ndetse n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ishyigikira guhanga imirimo ku rubyiruko. Intandaro ya byose, ni rwiyemezamirimo kumutima. Rica yihatira kwerekana ibyiza mu bantu itanga ubuyobozi, inkunga no kubatera inkunga mu rugendo rwabo rugana ku ntsinzi.Rica usanzwe ari igihugu Umuyobozi wa Mastercard Foundation mu Rwanda; ikomatanya ishyaka ry'ubuyobozi, kwihangira imirimo n'ingaruka z'imibereho. Ibi byagize ingaruka ku rugendo rwe ubwo yakoraga muri guverinoma, abikorera ndetse n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ishyigikira guhanga imirimo ku rubyiruko. Intandaro ya byose, ni rwiyemezamirimo kumutima. Rica yihatira kwerekana ibyiza mu bantu aho atanga ubujyanama m'ubuyobozi, inkunga n'ibitekerezo bibafasha kugera ku ntsinzi.
Ugushyingo 2017 kugera Werurwe 2019 ya umuyobozi wa gahunda (Program manager) muri Mastercard foundation Rwanda, uyu mwanya yawukozeho umwaka n'amezi atanu. Muri Mata 2019 kugera Kanama 2019 yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa gahunda (Senior Program manager) muri mastercard foundation, umwanya yamazeho amezi atanu gusa. Kanama 2019 nyuma yo gusoza inshingano yari afite zo kuba umuyobozi mukuru wa gahunda muri mastercard foundation, Rica yatangiye izindi nshingano muri uyu muryango nk'umuyobozi mukuru (country director of Mastercard Foundation), amaze imyaka ibiri kuri uyu mwanya. Mu biganiro byahuje Mastercard foundation n'ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe iterambere n'ubukerarugendo RDB, Rica Rwigamba yagize ati; "Ubufatanye dufitanye na RDB ni intambwe igaragara mu cyerekezo cyiza cyo kugera ku ntsinzi ya gahunda ya Hanga Ahazaza no gufasha urubyiruko gutera imbere mu bukerarugendo no mu kwakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda"
Rica Rwigamba wamenyekanye cyane ayobora ishami ry'ubukerarugendo muri RDB, yanditse igitabo kitwa "Kibuno mpa amaguru" iki gitabo kiri mu bwoko bw'ibitabo byo gufasha abana kwidagadura hakoreshejwe ibishushanyo byinshi n'amagambo make.

Umwihariko w'iyi ngoro niyo yambere y'ubatswe mu karere kibiyaga bigari ndetse na africa muri rusange ishingiye kubidukikije no kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima n'ibimera.

Clemantine Uwitonze Yagize umuziki umwuga aho yaje gukomereza Impano yaje kwaguka ajya mu makorali atandukanye, mu mwaka wa 2004 atangira umuziki ku giti cye. Ni umwe mu bahanzi b’igitsinagore baririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana umaze kwagura umwuga we mu buryo bukomeye.

Rolande Pryce ni umuyobozi wa Banki y'Isi mu Rwanda kuva 2020 yasimbuye Yasser El Gammal wakoraga kuri uwo mwanya kuva muri Gashyantare 2016.Mbere yo kwinjira muri Banki y'Isi, Madamu Pryce yabaye umujyanama mu by'amategeko muri guverinoma ya Jamayike ku mategeko mpuzamahanga rusange n'ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga mu myaka irenga icumi; kandi nkumwarimu wungirije mumategeko mpuzamahanga muri kaminuza ya West Indies

Yagize kandi uruhare mu gutanga ubufasha mu by'amategeko mu by'imari, ibikorwa remezo ndetse n'abikorera. Nyiranyamibwa Suzana, umuririmbyi w'umunyarwandakazi w’inararibonye waboneye benshi izuba mu bahanzi nyarwanda yagarutse gutura mu Rwanda by’iteka nyuma y’imyaka irenga 40 yari amaze mu mahanga ya kure.
Nyiranyamibwa Suzana [yavutse 1943] yavuye mu Rwanda mu 1973 ahunze itoteza n’ubwicanyi bwa hato na hato bwakorerwaga abatutsi. Yabanje kuba muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ahava nyuma y’imyaka 16 yerekeza mu Bubiligi.
Uyu muhanzi n’umuryango we bahunze nyuma y’uko se yishwe aroshywe mu Rusumo mu mwaka wa 1963. Nyina, Mukanzigiye Carolina na we yazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ubwo yari avuye mu Bubiligi kwivuza no gusura umuryango we wari warahungiyeyo. yagize Ati “Data bamwishe muri 1963, ari muri baba bandi baroshywe mu Rusumo hariya i Kibungo ubu ni mu akarere ka Ngoma intara y'uburasirazuba, mu 1973 nibwo twavuye mu Rwanda twari abana icyenda buri wese yagiye ukwe dushaka ubuzima turakura bigenda uko.” Yongeraho ati “Muri Congo nahageze mu 1973, nahunganye n’umugabo wanjye, mu urugo twari abana icyenda ariko buri wese yagiye ukwe tujya gushaka ubundi buzimaNahunganye n’umugabo twabyaranye abana bane we yaguye muri Congo icyo gihe. Nahabaye imyaka 16 mpava njya kuba i Bruxelles ari naho nari ntuye iyo imyaka yose.”
Nyiranyamibwa Suzana w’imyaka 79 avuga ko mu myaka yamaze i Burayi atigeze ahakunda kurusha u Rwanda ari nacyo cyamushyizemo imbaraga arataha ngo asazire mu gihugu cye cyu Rwanda. Ni umwe mu abaririmbyi b’imena bashinze itorero Isamaza ryagize uruhare rukomeye mu gutiza umurindi ingabo ku rugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda. Icyo gihe yaririmbanaga n’abahanzi bari bakunzwe icyo igihe barimo bakomeye mu ijyana ya kinyarwanda n’abandi babyinaga cyane.Ntabwo nigeze nkunda u Burayi, nahabeshejwe n’uko nari mfite abana bagombaga kwiga kandi nkaba hafi yabo nkabitaho. Ntabwo nari gushobora kuguma hariya, mu Burayi ntabwo ari ahantu ho gusazira.” Yavuze ko nyuma yo kuza gutura mu Rwanda agiye gukomeza guhanga indirimbo nshya ndetse ngo nibimushobokera azongera ahuze abakecuru yaririmbanye na bo mu Isamaza bongere bahange.
Nyiranyamibwa Suzana ari mubashinze Itorero Isamaza ryashingiwe mu Bubiligi mu myaka igera kuri 30 ishize, ryatangiye rigizwe n’abiganjemo abagore n’inkumi zabyinaga hagamijwe gushakisha ubufasha bwo gushyigikira ingabo zarwanye urugamba rwo kwihobora mu 1990. Isamaze rigitangira ryabarizwagamo abahanzi b’abahanga barimo nka Nyiranyamibwa Suzana, Jeanne Karigirwa Ruboneka, Anonciata Gatera, Francoise Ruboneka, Anonciata Kayisire n’abandi batandukanye.
Nyiranyamibwa Suzana umwe mu bashinze Itorero Isamaza yavuze ko nyuma yo kugaruka gutura mu Rwanda ateganya kongera guhuza abakecuru bagenzi be bakiriho bakongera kuririmba nk’itsinda no gukora ibitaramo by’indirimbo ahanini zibutsa abantu ibihe iri torero ryagize mu myaka yashize. Ati “Abo twahoranye mu itorero Isamaza benshi baracyariho ariko babivuyemo, uwari umuhanga cyane mu bo twaririmbanye yaratabarutse ni Jeanne Karigirwa abandi barashatse iby’imiziki babivamo Ubwo nanjye ngiye kugerageza ndebe ko twakongera gukora ariko biragoye.”
Nyiranyamibwa avuga ko hari indirimbo yahimbye ariko zitarasohoka gusa arateganya kuzazishyira hanze kuri nshya azamurika mu gihe kiri imbere. Mu kwihuza n’abahoze bagize Isamaza ngo yifuza ko bakora ibitaramo bito no guhanga indirimbo nshya gusa ngo ni akazi gasaba imbaraga nyinshi. Ati “Abakobwa twaririmbanye hafi ya bose iby’umuziki ntibakibyiyumvamo, bari bafite amajwi meza, ni abahanga gusa ngira ngo murabazi, bamaze gushaka baba bahagaritse umuziki abandi barabiretse Nzagerageza gushaka uko nakongera kubabwira duhure twongere dukore ariko birasaba imbaraga.” Iyo umubajije urwibutso afite ku Itorero Isamaza asubiza yitsitsa cyane ku bumwe no kutiganda byarangaga abaririmbyi ndetse no guharanira iterambere rya buri wese byabarangaga.

Yabanje kuba impuguke mu by'ubukungu muri Minisiteri y’Imari aho yasimbuwe na Kalisa Thierry.
Madamu Rwakunda afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri globolization no guteza imbere ubukungu muri kaminuza ya Antwerp.
Amina Umulisa Rwakunda ni umuyobozi w'inama y'ubutegetsi mu ikigo gishinzwe Isoko ry'imigabane mu Rwanda (RSE) kuva 2012. Ubu ni Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ubukungu / Umuyobozi wa Politiki ya Macroeconomic muri Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi; n'Ubuyobozi bwa NISR (Ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda) umwanya amazeho imyaka 12 n'ukwezi kumwe kuva 2010. By'umwihariko, Umulisa afite inshingano zo guhagararira igihugu mu isuzuma ry’ikigega mpuzamahanga cy’imari (IMF), gusuzuma igihugu ndetse n’ibindi bice bimenyesha icyemezo cy’umuryango ku bijyanye n’ubufatanye n’u Rwanda.

Amina Umuhoza (wavutse 1996) niwe washinze Saye campany ltd ifite Umushinga wa dukataze ugamije kongerera ubushobozi abakobwa mubitekerezo, imibereho ndetse nubukungu kugirango barwanye inda zitifuzwa mubakobwa bato bo mu Rwanda
Umuhoza Amaze gukura Yumvaga ko umunsi umwe azatanga ubufasha ubwo aribwo bwose ku bakobwa batishoboye, cyane cyane abadashoboye kwigurira ibya ngombwa, nk'isuku. yarbaye umuyobozi wimyidagaduro yishuri, Visi perezida wa club yimiyoborere nzizana visi perezida wa club ya Never again Rwanda. Muri 2012 yabaye umunyamakuru w'inama nkuru y’abana mu Rwanda aho yatowe na bagenzi be. Amina Umuhoza yitabiriye inama nyinshi muri leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, Kenya, Uganda, Etiyopiya n'u Rwanda kandi ubumenyi bwose yabonye burimo gukoreshwa mu gushora imari mu rubyiruko rwe.
Mu 2017, afite imyaka 21, yatangije uruganda rukora dekorasiyo zomurgo arirwo Saye Ltd. Mukeshimana Béata ni umunyapolitiki w'umunyarwanda akaba n'umunyamabanga uhoraho muri minisiteri y'ubutabera (Ministry of Justice) aho yasimbuye k'umwanya madamu Isabelle Kalihangabo wagizwe umunyamabanga mukuru w'ubiro bishinzwe iperereza mu Rwanda (RIB).
Ku wa gatanu, tariki ya 11 Ugushyingo 2016, Inama y'Abaminisitiri yashyizeho Beata Mukeshimana nka Visi-Perezida wa Komisiyo ishinzwe ivugurura ry'amategeko mu Rwanda (RLRC). Madamu Mukeshimana yahoze ayobora ishami rishinzwe ubushakashatsi, ivugurura n’ivugururwa ry'amategeko muri komisiyo ishinzwe ivugurura ry’amategeko mu Rwanda.
