Karigirwa Jeanne d'Arc ni umunyarwandakazi, umuhimbyi n'umuririmbyi wagize uruhare runini mu iyandikwa ry'indirimbo nyinshi z'ifashishijwe mu gutiza umurindi ingabo zari ziri ku rugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda.
Karigirwa Jeanne d’Arc [yavutse mu mwaka wa 1942] mu Rwanda mu Karere ka Gakenke mu intara y'amajyaruguru. Akirangiza kwiga amashuri abanza yahise ajya gukomereza amashuri ye yisumbuye i Bujumbura mu Burundi. Mu 1966 yaje kugaruka mu Rwanda kubera ko ariho hari ababyeyi be. Bitewe n’ubuzima bari babayeho bwo gutotezwa, Kaligirwa yaje gufata umwanzuro wo guhungira mu Bubiligi mu 1972. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe gusa, mu 1973 yakoresheje uburyo bwose bushoboka akura umuryango we mu Rwanda umusanga mu Bubiligi.
Karigirwa Jeanne d'Arc wari ufite impano yo kwandika indirimbo no kuririmba yafashe ikaramu ye maze yandika indirimbo ayita “Rwanda turanze twanze guhera ishyanga” mu mwaka wa 1989. Icyo gihe nibwo yatangiye guhuza abiganjemo abagore n’inkumi muri abo abamenyekanye cyane ni Nyiranyamibwa Suzanne, Anonciata Gatera, umuvandimwe we Françoise Ruboneka, Anonciata Kayisire n’abandi batandukanye maze bashinga itorero Isamaza. Iyo iba imvo n’imvano y’ishingwa ry’itorero Isamaza’ ryari rigamije gutiza umurindi ingabo z’Inkotanyi no kuzishakira ubufasha bwo kuzishyigikira mu rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu.
Karigirwa Jeanne d’Arc akimenya ko Inkotanyi ziri hafi gutangiza urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda, yahise yandika indi ndirimbo ayita ‘Indege irahinda’. Iyi ni imwe mu ndirimbo n’uyu umunsi igikunzwe. Uko urugamba rwokubohora igihugu rwarushagaho gukomera ari na ko Inkotanyi zigenda zifata ibice bimwe na bimwe by’igihugu, Kaligirwa yakoze izindi ndirimbo ebyiri ari zo Turaje na Girubuntu. Abari bagize Itorero Isamaza bakomeje gukora ibitaramo byinshi mu bihugu bitandukanye mu rwego rwo gukusanya inkunga yo gufasha inkotanyi ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu. Izindi ndirimbo baririmbye zigakundwa cyane harimo ‘Nimuberwe bakobwa, Nimucyure inganji, Dore ijoro ryiza, Ntituzabibagirwa Uraho Rwanda n’izindi nyinshi zitandukanye zikaba zaranditswe na Nyiranyamibwa.
Karigirwa Jeanne d’Arc yaje kwitaba Imana muri Kamena mu mwaka wa 1998, azize uburwayi busanzwe aguye i burayi mu bubirigi. Yasize abana batatu barimo umukobwa umwe n’abahungu babiri. Abo bana baje kujya mu itorero AMAREBE N’IMENA mu Bubiligi. Iri torero na ryo rikaba ryaragize uruhare rukomeye mu gutiza umurindi ingabo z’Inkotanyi zari ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu babinyujije mu bihangano bakoraga.

Uwituze Solange ni umunyapolitiki w'umunyarwandakazi wavutse 1974 akaba n' umuyobozi mukuru wungirije ushinzwe ubushakashatsi n'ikoranabuhanga mu kigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi no gusakaza ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi (Deputy Director General in charge of animal resources research and technology transfer) RAB kuva mu 2018. Yashyizwe mu Nama y'Ubuyobozi y'Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry'u Rwanda () mu 2020.
Ni umufatanyabikorwa washinze ishuri ry'ubumenyi mu Rwanda (RAS). Afite impamyabumenyi ya PhD na MSc mu bumenyi bw'inyamaswa yakuye muri kaminuza ya Leta ya Kansas, muri Amerika. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda, mu 2002 aguma muri kaminuza ari umunyamabanga w’amasomo mu ishami ry’ubushakashatsi mu buhinzi. Uwituze azana mubuyobozi bwa KCRC (Kigali collaborative research center) imyaka 18 yumwuga mwinshi mumashuri makuru yubuhinzi, ubushakashatsi, nimiyoborere yimishinga myinshi.
Amateka n'indimi akunda.
Uwituze yavukiye mu Rwanda, yakuriye mu rugo ruvuga cyane igifaransa kandi yifuzaga kuva akiri muto kwiga icyongereza no kwiga muri Amerika, cyane cyane bitewe n'iterambere rya meritokarasi ku bagore bo muri Amerika. Mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994, abantu benshi bo mu muryango we barishwe, barimo se na barumuna be babiri, bituma yiyemeza kugira icyo akora mu buzima bwe kandi afite intego irenze ihohoterwa ryabaye.
Uwituze ni Umufatanyabikorwa washinze Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubumenyi aho ayoboye igice cy’ubuhinzi n’ibidukikije. Ni umwe mu bagize komite ishinzwe ubumenyi mu Ihuriro rikurikira rya Einstein, igikorwa cya Institute of African Science Mathematical Science (AIMS).
Kuva Gicurasi 2018 ni umuyobozi mukuru wungirije ushinzwe ubushakashatsi n'ikoranabuhanga mu kigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi no gusakaza ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi (RAB). Yabaye Umuyobozi wa Gahunda y'Ubufatanye no gucunga Ubucuruzi mu Ihuriro rya Kaminuza zo mu Karere mu kongera ubushobozi mu buhinzi (RUFORUM) kuva Mutarama 2017 kugera Mata 2018. Ukwakira 2014 kugera Ukuboza 2016 Yabanje kuba Umuyobozi wa RUFORUM ushinzwe amahugurwa no kwizeza ubuziranenge. Yabaye Umuyobozi w'ishami ry'ubuhinzi, kaminuza y'u Rwanda (UR).
Afite uburambe bwimyaka 10 mubuyobozi no gucunga imishinga itandukanye yubaka ubushobozi. Yabaye umuyobozi wumushinga wa gahunda yubuyobozi bwabagore mubuhinzi muri USAID / HED. Yakoze nk'umuyobozi wumushinga wa NICHE muri NUFFIC kugirango atezimbere Agroforestry / Amashyamba / Ikigo Cyagura Ubuhinzi muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda UR.

UWINGENEYE Joyeuse ni Umuyobozi Mukuru w’ikigo gishinzwe gutanga amasoko ya Leta mu Rwanda, Urwego rushinzwe kugenzura ibikorwa byashinzwe kugenzura imitunganyirize, isesengura n’ubugenzuzi mu bijyanye n’amasoko ya Leta no kugira inama Guverinoma n’inzego zose zitanga amasoko ya Leta kuri politiki n'ingamba mu bijyanye no gutunganya imitunganyirize y'amasoko ya Leta
Mu ijambo rye mu Ihuriro rya 13 ryo gutanga amasoko muri Afrika yuburasirazuba ryabereye mu Rwanda Madamu Joyeuse yagize ati "COVID-19 yabaye umusemburo w'amasoko yihutirwa. Uwingeneye Joyeuse yize ikiciro cya kabiri cy'amashuri makuru mu masomo y'ubukungu yabonye 2002-2007 muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda, yakomereje amasomo ye muri kaminuza ya kenya yigisha ibijyanye nimicungire n'umutungo w'amafaranga (Moi university/ Kenya school of monetary studies) aho yavanye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga muri banki n’imari, politiki y’imari 2011-2013 (Masters in banking and finance, financial sector policy).
Uwingeneye Joyeuse kuva 2008-2011 yabaye Umuyobozi w'ishami rya UMWALIMU SACCO RWANDA. Yabaye Umusesenguzi wo Kwamamaza mu ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’u Rwanda (RDB) Mutarama 2019 - Nyakanga 2019.

Kayitare Isheja Morella Ku wa 24 Mutarama 2022, ni bwo inzozi ze zabaye impamo ubwo yitabiraga Paris Fashion Week Haute Couture. Umunyana Chantal (Wavutse 1994) washinze akaba nuyobora umuyobozi wa Umubyeyi Elevate. Umubiriye Elevate Ltd.
Umunyana yavukiye mukarere ka kamonyi akaba ari pfura mubana biwabo. Munyana afite umugabo numwana wimyaka itatu.Umunyana Chantal Yasoje Amashuri ye muri kaminuza nkuru akaba ariwe washinze kandi akanayobora Umubyeyi Elevate. Umubyeyi Elevate Ltd nubucuruzi bwikoranabuhanga ryubuzima kubabyeyi bakiri bato, abagore batwite, abashaka kuba ababyeyi, nurubyiruko, bigamije kugabanya indwara nimpfu ziterwa no gutwita no kubyara kubera ubumenyi buke ninkunga ikomeye.
Chantal yize Ubuganga muri kaminuza nkuru yu Rwanda akaba yanshoje mwishuri Rikuru ry’Abagore Ba Rwiyemezamirimo (AWE),rifite gahunda yo kongerera ubushobozi abagore ikorwa na Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta ishinzwe uburezi n’umuco.
Umuntu wese agomba gufata neza ubuzima bwe. Ku bijyanye n'ababyeyi, ibi bigomba gushimangirwa, kubera ko ubuzima bwabo bugira ingaruka no ku bana babyaye. Binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga abagore bashobora kugera ku mbuga zitandukanye, harimo na Umubaye Elevate, zitanga amakuru ajyanye n'ubuzima, iyo akoreshejwe neza, bishobora gutuma ubuzima bwiza bugera ku babyeyi ndetse no ku rubyaro rwabo.
Umubyeyi Elavate:Umubyeyi Elevate 'yatangijwe ku mugaragaro mu Gushyingo 2020. Kuva icyo gihe yatsindiye ikigega cya Young Resilient Fund 2021, yashyizwe ku rutonde rwa 15 muri Afurika Young Innovators for Health 2021, kandi yari mu bagore batatu bahanga udushya twatsindiye igihembo ndetse n'ubujyanama ku buntu. Umunyana na we yagiye muri Isiraheli mubice 20 byashinzwe gutangiza.

Chantal Ujeneza Numubyeyi wabana babari

Umugwaneza Charlotte umwe mubakinnyi beza usanzwe ari kapiteni w'ikipe ya APR Basketball Club mu cyiciro cy'abagore, ndetse akaba arinawe kapiteni w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'U Rwanda.
Umugwaneza Charlotte (yavutse ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 1989) mu Murenge wa Gasaka, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, Umugwaneza ni we wenyine warokotse mu muryango w'abana bane - abakobwa batatu n'umuhungu umwe. Ababyeyi be Aaron Mazuru na Susan Mukagahima na barumuna be bose bishwe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yahitanye abantu barenga miliyoni, Umugwaneza yarezwe na nyirasenge.
Umugwaneza Charlotte yize mu rwunge rwa mashuri rwa Gasaka mu akarere avukamo amashuri abanza mbere yo kwinjira muri Groupe Scholaire Notre d'Ame de la Paix Cyanika nayo iherereye mu karere ka Nyamagabe yiga mu cyiciro rusange (tronc Common O' level) kugira ngo yige bisanzwe. Ku rwego rwa masomo y'isumbuye, yinjiye muri College Saint Emmanuel de Hanika mu Karere ka Nyanza aho yize ibaruramari arangiza muri 2009. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yinjiye muri kaminuza ya Lay Adventiste ya Kigali (INILAK) akurikirana impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya mbere mu icungamari maze arangiza muri 2014. Nyuma yo kurangiza, Umugwaneza yakoranye n'amasosiyete menshi arimo MTN Rwanda nk'umucungamari. Umugwaneza, ufite uburebure bwa 1.95mh n'uburemere bw'ibiro 80, akaba ari umwe mu bakinnyi bakina hagati basketball y'abagore bo mu Rwanda neza.
Umugwaneza Charlotte ari mu bihumbi by’abana basigaye badafite ababyeyi kandi batagira aho baba kubera jenocide yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, bivuze ko atigeze agira amahirwe yo kubona urukundo n'ubwuzu bw'ababyeyi be. Nyuma y'urupfu rw'ababyeyi be na barumuna be, Yagize ati:"narenzwe na masenge,Immaculee Mukamusonera. Mvugishije ukuri ubwana bwanjye cyari igihe kitoroshye. kuba narabuze umuryango wanjye nkiri muto cyane, nahatiwe gufata ibyo nahawe byose kandi ngomba kwiga byinshi nkiri muto", Umugwaneza yakomeje agira ati: “Umuryango wa masenge ni umuryango wegamiye ku idini nahawe uburere no gusenga nyamara nkiri muto nakundaga gukina umupira ariko masenge abyanga. nabwiye masenge kumugaragaro andeke nkurikire ibyo nkunda kuva nkiri muto, kubw'amahirwe, yanteze amatwi arabyemera. Kuva uwo munsi, natangiye gukina umupira ntatinya ingaruka.
Umugwaneza Charlotte ati: "nari umukinnyi w'ingenzi muri College Saint Emmanuel de Hanika. Urebye uburebure bwanjye no gukunda siporo, mwarimu w'imikino yacu yangiriye inama yo kugerageza basketball, anyemeza ko mfite imico yo kuzaba umukinnyi mwiza wa basketball. ni uko nahisemo gukina basketball, Yanyigishije iby'ibanze, uburyo bwo kwiruka n'umupira mpita mbimenya vuba. Nyuma y'ibyumweru bike, niswe izina mu ikipe y'ishuri."
Mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2009, yatoranijwe kuba mu ikipe ya Basketball y'abagore ya karere ka Nyanza yitabiriye “Imiyoborere Cup Cup” - iyi kipe yageze ku mukino wa nyuma w'igihugu ariko itsindwa na Nyarugenge. Muri iryo rushanwa niho Charles Mushumba, umutoza mukuru wa IPRC-Amajyepfo, icyo gihe akaba yaratozaga ikipe y’abagore yahoze ari kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda (NUR), yaramubonye maze amwemeza ko yinjira mu ikipe ye, ari yo yarushanwaga mu bagore b’igihugu. Yaje kandi kuganira na nyirasenge maze atangira kuva i Nyamagabe kugera Huye buri munsi kugira ngo yitoze, amezi atatu.
Umugwaneza Charlotte ubwo yitabiraga irishanwa rya Zone V yabereye i Kampala yashimishije umutoza mukuru wa APR, Charles Mbazumutima.Inyungu za APR zahuriranye n’uko Umugwaneza yimukiye i Kigali aho yagombaga gutangira amashuri ya kaminuza muri INILAK, bityo akajya mu ikipe ya gisirikare mu 2010. Ati: Byari bigoye kubona umwanya wo gukina muri APR icyo gihe kuko bari bafite abakinnyi benshi beza kandi b'inararibonye b'abanyamahanga kandi numvaga shaka gukina cyane, ariko umutoza yakomeje kuntera inkunga kandi namaze hafi umwaka ntinjiye mu ikipe yambere. ikipe kugeza 2011 ubwo club yatangiraga gukoresha abakinnyi ba banyarwanda. iyi ikipe nayibereye kapiteni, nyobora iyi kipe mu ibikombe bitandatu bya shampiyona isanzwe, ibikombe bitandatu bya playoff, bituma iba ikipe yatsinze cyane, yagizwe umukinnyi mwiza wo hagati wumwaka. Umugwaneza Hamwe na APR, Umugwaneza yanitabiriye amarushanwa ya Afrika Zone V Club buri mwaka, abura gusa 2016.

Irere Claudette ni umunyapolitiki akaba n' umunyamwuga mu ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda, yagizwe Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe ubumenyi n’amahugurwa y’imyuga n’ikoranabuhanga muri minisiteri y' uburezi mu Rwanda muri Gashyantare 2020. Nyakubahwa. Minisitiri Claudette yaboneye impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri ry’abakobwa rya FAWE, mu Rwanda. Yakomeje amashuri ye kandi abona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu Buhanga bwa mudasobwa na sisitemu mu 2012 yakuye muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda. Nyuma yaho, mu 2013, yabonye buruse yo kwiga Masters Program maze ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse ya siyansi n’ubuhanga mu bijyanye na Computer Engineering yakuye muri kaminuza ya gikirisitu ya Oklahoma muri Amerika.
Umwuga mbere ya politiki.
Mbere yo kwinjira muri Minisiteri, Irere Claudette yari mu bagore b’abanyarwanda bayoboye iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda kandi ayoboye KLab aho inzobere mu bumenyi bwa digitale mu murwa mukuru wa Kigali zifatanya mu guhanga udushya. Mbere yibyo, Yashinze hamwe n’umuyobozi wa Laboratoire ya mbere y’imyenda yitwa FabLab Rwanda. FabLab yari ishami rya laboratoire yubumenyi yitwa KLab. FabLab Rwanda ni laboratoire ya mbere yo guhimba digitale ya Kigali yakomotse ku gitekerezo cya FabLabs ku isi hose cya MIT's Centre for Bits na Atoms (CBA). Laboratwari za Fab zitanga uburyo bwinshi bwo gukoresha uburyo bugezweho bwo guhanga no mu Rwanda, FabLab niyambere mubwoko bwayo itanga ibikoresho bya prototyping ya 3D n'umwanya kugirango abaturage babone ubumenyi bwikoranabuhanga bugezweho. Irere, washinze FabLab Rwanda kandi yigeze kuba umuyobozi mukuru, mbere yabaye umuyobozi w’umushinga mu rugereko rwa PSF-ICT, umuyobozi mukuru muri Klab, n’umuyobozi w’umushinga wa ICT muri Transform Africa. Irere Claudette yari umunyamuryango w’abakobwa muri ICT Rwanda, umuryango w’abagore babigize umwuga mu ikoranabuhanga uharanira guha imbaraga no gushishikariza abakobwa bakiri bato kwinjira mu bumenyi bwa siyansi, ikoranabuhanga, ubwubatsi n’imibare (STEM) bakiri bato.
Ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2018, Irere yagizwe umunyamabanga uhoraho (PS) muri Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga no guhanga udushya ubwo yinjiraga muri guverinoma yavuguruwe na Perezida Paul Kagame wagabanije abagize guverinoma kuva kuri 31 ikagera kuri 26. Inama y'Abaminisitiri ni abagore 50 ku ijana; bikagira u Rwanda, na Etiyopiya, ibihugu bibiri bya Afurika byonyine byubahiriza ihame ry' uburinganire muri guverinoma zabo. Yari umwe mu bato bagize guverinoma bakoze nk' umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga no guhanga udushya kugeza mu 2020 ubwo yavanwaga ku mwanya w’umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga no guhanga udushya agashyirwa ku mwanya wa minisitiri ushinzwe Amashuri ya tekinike. n'imyuga (TVET) muri Minisiteri y'Uburezi. Irere Claudette yabaye kandi Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe guhanga udushya no guteza imbere ubucuruzi muri Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga n’itumanaho (MiTEC), muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda

MUGWANEZA Pacifique ni umunyapolitiki w'umunyarwandakazi akaba umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Ubugenzuzi bw’amakoperative (Cooperatives Inspection Division Manager).
Madamu Pacifique MUGWANEZA afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse (Masters) mu micungire ya Politiki y’ubukungu yibanda ku mahame agenga ishyirwaho n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya politiki y’ubukungu mu buryo nyabwo yavanye muri kaminuza ya Auvergne - Clermont Ferrand, mu Bufaransa, na Bachelor's Degree in Science Science: Amafaranga na Banki yavanye muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali (ULK),
Ni umuyobozi ushinzwe kugenzura no guteza imbere amakoperative mu ikigo cy’amakoperative mu Rwanda, kuva mu mwaka wa 2018: kikaba ari ikigo cya Leta gishinzwe kwandika, kugenzura no guteza imbere amakoperative: Imyaka ibiri n’amezi cumi na kumwe (Mata 2018-kugeza ubu) y'uburambe bw'umwuga mubijyanye na koperative mu Rwanda (Rwanda Cooperative Association "RCA"). Yabaye kandi umuyobozi wa komisiyo ishinzwe imari n’ubugenzuzi mu Nama y'Ubuyobozi y'Ikigo cy'Ingoro z'umurage z'u Rwanda kuva mu Gushyingo 2016 kugeza muri Nzeri 2020.
Yakoze muri MINECOFIN: Imyaka icumi (2008 -2018) y'uburambe bugenda butera imbere muri Politiki ya Macroeconomic, yibanda kuri politiki yo hanze (BOP: Balance of Payments) aho umurenge usobanura imyanya ya leta ugereranije nurwego mpuzamahanga. Kuva ku ya 10 Nzeri 2008: politiki y’imari nisesengura muri politiki y’ubukungu: ibi byari bikubiyemo isesengura ryingaruka nziza kurwego rwa macro, no kongera agaciro isoko ryimari yari igeze, Kuva ku ya 15 Nzeri 2009: Impuguke ya Macroeconomic Convergence, yibanda ku miterere y’urwego rwo hanze no guhuza ubukungu mu karere (EAC, COMESA).
Kuva muri Nzeri 2014 kugeza muri Mata 2018, Ushinzwe Politiki yo mu Bubanyi n’amahanga yibanda ku gukora amafaranga asigaye inyuma - kureba imbere no gusesengura, raporo ya buri kwezi na buri gihembwe ku buringanire bw’ubucuruzi, ingaruka z’ubukungu bw’ubufatanye bw’akarere, gusesengura uburyo bwo kwagura ibyoherezwa mu mahanga, BOP ibitekerezo n'ibitekerezo byo kunonosorwa, hanyuma isesengura ku ihindagurika ryibipimo byingenzi byubukungu.
Kuva muri Mata 2006-Kanama 2008: Ushinzwe inguzanyo muri Banki ya Agaseke (Banki ya Afurika iriho ubu), ibikorwa by'ingenzi birimo gusesengura ibyifuzo by'inguzanyo, kugenzura ibyangombwa byose bisabwa ku nguzanyo, gusuzuma ingwate zatanzwe, kugenzura imenyekanisha ry'inyandiko zose. hamwe n'umwunganizi wa guverinoma, bakora isesengura ry'inguzanyo yatanzwe, bagatanga inguzanyo.
Muri 2019, yahuzaga inama mpuzamahanga y’ubufatanye bw’amakoperative, yabereye mu Rwanda kuva ku ya 14 kugeza ku ya 17 Ukwakira 2019. Muri 2016, yari umwe mubagize itsinda ryashinzwe na MINECOFIN na BNR kugirango bimure urwego rwo hanze kuri Balance of Payment Manual Six (BPM6), kuko byasabwaga na IMF guhuza nindi mibare yubukungu nka sisitemu ya Konti yigihugu (SNA), imibare y’amafaranga n’imari (MFS), hamwe n’imibare y’imari ya Leta (GFS). Muri 2013, yari ashinzwe MTCP (Medium Term Convergence Program), nkuko bisabwa na GFS (Ibarurishamibare rya Leta muri EAC), aho yatanze ingamba zo kugera ku ngingo zijyanye no guhuza amafaranga muri EAC. Kuva muri Mutarama 2009 kugeza muri Kamena 2014: Umunyamuryango wa Task Force mu rwego rwo hejuru kugira ngo baganire ku masezerano mpuzamahanga y’isoko rusange ry’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, Ibihugu bya EAC

Mukarusine Claudine ubana n'ubumuga bw'uruhu. Byagenze gute ngo uwo mukobwa ubana n'ubumuga bwuruhu ngo agaragare mu mashusho y'indirimbo yu muhanzi King James.
Mukarusine Claudine a (yavutse mu 1991) ni imfura mu muryango w’abana batanu. Abandi bane bose bamukurikira nta n’umwe ufite ubumuga bw’uruhu. Yize muri Kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda ishami ry’Uburezi mu yahoze ari KIE ryari riherereye i Remera mu aKarere ka Gasabo, by’umwihariko Indimi n’Ubuvanganzo asoza mu 2017. Mukarusine Claudine ufite imyaka 28 wavukanye ubumuga bw'ruhu ukunda kuganira.Asanzwe ari umunyamideli ukomeye ndetse yanahagarariye u rwanda mu iserukiramuco ry'afurika ubumuga ryabereye muri Ethiyopiya 2018. ni umunyeshuri wavomye ku isoko y'umuziki, ariko aza kubiharira abandi. Mu Indirimbo ya KING JAMES.
Mukarusine Claudine mu kiganiro na IGIHE yavuze ko akimara kumenya inkuru y’uko King James ashaka umukobwa ufite ubumuga bw’uruhu ujya mu ndirimbo, yabanje kubyibazaho byinshi. Yabajije uyu muhanzi n’itsinda ry’abantu bari kumufasha impamvu yatumye bifuza gukora muri ubu buryo, amaze gusobanukirwa yemera gutangira kumufasha. Yashakishije abandi bagenzi be babana n’ubu bumuga ariko ngo uwo abonye agasanga hari ibyo atujuje bari bavuganye, uwo asanze abyujuje nawe agasanga kumukoresha bizasaba andi mabwiriza ahitamo kwitanga afasha King James ndetse n’amashusho ayagiramo ubuntu. Ati “Naje gusubira inyuma ndatekereza nsanga ibintu by’ubuhanzi narabikundaga nkiri muto kuko najyaga nandika indirimbo nkanaziririmba cyangwa se ibintu by’ubugeni. Kuko nabonaga bingoye kubona uwo bashakaga ndababwira nti ariko njye nshobora kubafasha nemera kujya muri iyo ndirimbo gutyo.”Mu bindi byagoye uyu mukobwa gufata umwanzuro, harimo ikijyanye n’imyambarire iranga abakobwa bajya mu ndirimbo z’abahanzi, rimwe na rimwe bambara bitandukanye n’imyemerere ye.
Yari umwanditsi n'umuririmbyi.
Mukarusine Claudine Ati “Mu mashuri yisumbuye aho nize cyari ikigo cy’ababyeyi b’Abadivantisiti. Abana twiganaga iyo byaga ngombwa ko hari ibyo tujya kwerekana, hari indirimbo najyaga mbigisha kuko iyo twaziririmbaga njye numvaga amarira arimo kugwa mu mutima rimwe na rimwe yaranagwaga, zari iz’agahinda”. “Hari izindi najyaga ndirimba ngo abantu bamwe baricwa, abandi bararenganwa ariko nta muntu n’umwe wajyaga abivumbura ko ariyo mpamvu”.
Mukarusine Claudine Uyu mukobwa avuga ko hari abantu bamwe bamubaza ibibazo bikamutangaza cyane, kubera kudasobanukirwa imibereho y’abafite ubumuga bw’uruhu. Yabanje gukorana n’ibigo bizwi cyane byigenga n'ibigo bya Leta birimo KT Rwanda Network, Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere m’u Rwanda (RDB), Ikigo gishinzwe ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda (Rwanda Information Technology Authority) n’Ishuri Rikuru Nderabarezi rya Kigali.
Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya kabiri muri Computer Science (kaminuza ya Bangalore) na MSc.IT, ishami rya Computer Science &amp; Software Engineering yo muri kaminuza yu Rwanda.
Rita yabaye umuyobozi wa e-guverinoma mu gihe guverinoma y’u Rwanda yashyiraga mu bikorwa ingamba zitandukanye za e-Guverinoma kandi inshingano ze zari uguhuza ibyo bikorwa byose ku rwego rw’igihugu. Kuva icyo gihe yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere ry'u Rwanda muri ICT; bikubiyemo ibice byo gucunga imishinga, gushyiraho politiki, igenamigambi rikorwa no gushyira mu bikorwa, kimwe na M&amp;E. Yakoze cyane cyane mu nzego za Leta z’u Rwanda mu bijyanye na ICT mu nzego zitandukanye kandi yiyemeje gukorera abikorera ku giti cyabo, hamwe n'uburambe n'ubumenyi afite.

Akayesu Shalon yavukiye Kibagabaga kuwa 23 Ukuboza 2002, akaba amaze kuba kimenyabose ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse no mu mashusho y'indirimbo z'abahanzi b'abanyarwanda. Dore ko uyu mukobwa yumvikanye bwa mbere mu ifungwa rya bimwe mu byamamare byo mu Rwanda birimo Davis D, ndetse yongera kutavugwaho rumwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ubwo yagiraga uruhare mu kwirukanisha umunyezamu Kwizera Olivier mu ikipe y’Igihugu Amavubi.

Mukasine Marie Claire (yavutse 1959) ni umunyamategeko w'umunyarwandakazi, umunyapolitiki n'umukozi wa Leta. Kuva mu 2011 kugeza 2019 yari umwe mu bagize Sena y'u Rwanda, kandi yabaye umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y'Ibikorwa Remezo mu Rwanda. Muri 2020 yagizwe Perezida wa Komisiyo y'igihugu ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Rwanda (NHCR). Mukasine Marie Claire kandi yakoze muri Sosiyete sivile nk'umunyamuryango uharanira uburenganzira bw’umugore n’umwana, Haguruka, yawuyoboye hagati yo mu mwaka 1994-1996, ndetse yabaye umwunganizi mu bigo bitandukanye bya leta yu Rwanda, Ku ya 8 Gicurasi 2020, Nirere yashyikirijwe inshigano nk'uwahoze ari Visi Perezida wa Komisiyo yitwa Silas Sinyigaya, amaze gukora manda ye imwe, yashizweho n' inama y'Abaminisitiri aho yari iyobowe na Perezida Paul Kagame ku ya 16 Kamena 2020.
Mukasine afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko, impamyabumenyi ebyiri z'icyiciro cya kabiri mu micungire n'imiyoborere, na PhD mu by'amategeko.
Mukasine yagiye akora mu nzego zitandukanye z'ubuyobozi nk'umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa wa Haguruka, umuryango utabara imbabare uharanira no kurengera uburenganzira bw'umugore n'abana. Yabaye umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango mu Rwanda. Yabaye kandi umuyobozi mukuru wa Rwanda Investment Group(RIG), n’umuyobozi mukuru w’isosiyete y’ubwishingizi Sonarwa. Muri 2013 yari umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'igihugu cy'ubwishingizi.
Mu 2011, Mukasine yatorewe kujya muri Sena y'u Rwanda nk'uhagarariye Intara y'Amajyepfo, aba umusenateri kugeza muri 2019. Muri 2017 yari mu basenateri basaba ko imishinga y'iterambere mu karere yakurikiranwa vuba. Yabaye umwe mu bagize komisiyo ihoraho ya Senateri ishinzwe ibibazo bya politiki n’imiyoborere myiza, maze mu 2018 yagaragaje ko ari ngombwa gutegura gahunda yo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abahoze ari imfungwa bahamwe n'ibyaha bya jenoside
Mukasine yabaye kandi perezida w’umutwe w’u Rwanda umutwe w’abadepite bo muri Afurika barwanya ruswa (APNAC).
Ku ya 29 Kamena 2020, Mukasine yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Komisiyo y'igihugu ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Rwanda (NHCR). Mu Kwakira 2020, yasabye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko kongera ingengo y’imari ya NHCR no kuyiha icyicaro gihoraho i Kigali.

Mukeshimana Assumpta umunyarwandakazi ukora ibiganiro bya siporo mu Rwanda.
Assumpta yatangiye gukora siporo muri 2011.bavugako umubare w’abagore bakora mu itangazamakuru ugereranyije n’uw’abagabo uracyari hasi. Ibi bituma usanga hari n’ibiganiro bimwe na bimwe bisa n’ibyahariwe abanyamakuru b’abagabo. Muri ibyo biganiro twavuga nk’ibijyanye na Politike, ubukungu ndetse na Siporo.
Assumpta Mukeshimana, umunyamakuru w’umugore ukora mu ishami rya Siporo kuri TV1, akaba amaze imyaka isaga itanu akora aka kazi.yafashe icyemezo cyo gukora ibyo bagenzi be bamwe batinye, inzitane yahuye nazo n’ibindi.
Mukeshimana Assumpta abavugako umukobwa ukora ibya sport aba yarananiranye, abavugako aba ari umugore w’ abakinnyi bose n’abatoza, ni byinshi ariko umuntu iyo ukora akazi ugakunze, ibyo byose biza ubirebesha amaso, ubundi ugakomeza kubaho kandi unakora cyane..Mukeshimana avugako bitaba byoroshye ariko yasanze mu buzima bwose bisaba gukora amahitamo y’ibyangombwa mu buzima. Kubihuza ntakundi ni ugukora akazi mu gihe cyako hanyuma mu mwanya karangiye akita no kurugo rwe. Nirinda kujya mu bintu byinshi byatuma mpuga kugirango umwanya mbonye nabo mu rugo bambone.Ikindi abwira igitsina gore icya mbere bakwiye kwiyumvamo ko bashoboye kandi bakirinda kugumana ibitekerezo bibabwira ko batakora neza, badafite ubuhanga. Ikindi bagakora cyane kuko ntabwo kuba umunyamakuru mwiza byizana bisaba gukora no gushirika ubute. Hanyuma byaba bibabaje U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu biha urubuga abagore, maze mu banyamakuru hakaba hakiri abacyumva ko badashoboye kandi barahawe umwanya.

Jane Uwimana Yamenyekanye cyane akora kuri Radio10,(2008-2013).
Muri Gicurasi 2013 Aho yaje guhagarika itangaza makuru kubera gutwita.
Yaje kurigarukamo muri 2014 Irangira, Agaruka akora kuri Lemigo TV, Ahava ajya kuri Royal FM, Aho yavuye 2016 Ajya kuri Kiss Fm, arinaho Akora Ubu.

Mugabo Anna ni umuyobozi w’umurimo muri Minisiteri y’abakozi ba Leta n’umurimo mu Rwanda, arangwa no gushishikariza urubyiruko rwinshi kujya mu mahugurwa y’ubuhanga kugira ngo babe abashoramari.
Gashyantare 19 /2011 Mugabo Anna yahuye na Trivets Deepak hamwe n'abakozi mirongo itatu na batatu birukanwe kugirango bumvishe Deepak ko igomba gusubiza abakozi akazi kabo muri UTEXRWA. Mugabo yasobanuye ko guhagarika imirimo y'abakozi mirongo itatu na batatu ari ukurenga ku ngingo ya 33 y'itegeko ry'umurimo. Mu mategeko agenga umurimo ingingo ya 33 ivuga ko, “urutonde rwo kwirukana rugomba gukorwa hakurikijwe imikorere, impamyabumenyi y'umwuga, igihe umara mu kigo, n'inshingano z'imibereho.” Amategeko agenga umurimo asobanura kandi ko umuyobozi yari akwiye gutanga integuza y'ukwezi mbere yo kurangiza kandi agaha abakozi inyungu zabo zanyuma, abakozi mirongo itatu na batatu ntibakire.

Nkuranga Lynder ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi wari ukuriye ubutasi mu mahanga mu rwego rw'u Rwanda rishinzwe Umutekano ubu ni umukuru w'urwego rushinzwe abinjira n'abasohoka.
Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Nkuranga Lynder [wavutse muri 1982], niwe mugore wa mbere uyobora uru rwego rushinzwe imipaka, abinjira n'abasohoka, uburenganzira bwo gukorera mu Rwanda, inyandiko z'inzira, ubwenegihugu n'ibindi.
Nkuranga Lynder, ufite imyaka 40, afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n'amahoro n'amakimbirane ndetse anitabira amasomo mu ishuri rya polisi rya Musanze. Amaze imyaka irenga icumi akora muri Polisi y'igihugu y'u Rwanda Umwuga we wabaye mwiza kandi byihuse kugeza ubu.
Nkuranga Lynder yazamutse vuba mu mapeti mu gipolisi mu myaka igera ku 10, mu 2018 we n'abandi bagore babiri Rose Muhisoni na Teddy Ruyenzi bahawe ipeti rya ACP (Assistant Commissioner of Police). Lynder Nkuranga yari amaze umwaka umwe akuriye ishami ry'ubutasi mu mahanga mu rwego rw'u Rwanda rushinzwe umutekano National Intelligence and Security Services (NISS). Icyo gihe nibo bagore ba mbere bari bageze hejuru cyane mu mapeti y'igipolisi mu Rwanda, nyuma ya Mary Gahonzire wageze ku rwego rwa komiseri. Nkuranga yakoze imirimo itandukanye muri polisi irimo:

Gahonzire Mary yavukiye mu Rwanda, 1962. Yakuriye muri Uganda.Mu 1987, Gahonzire amaze kurangiza kaminuza, yasabye kwinjira mu gipolisi muri Uganda ayishyamo. Yabaye kandi Komiseri Mukuru mu gipolisi cy'u Rwanda.
Gahongayire Mary yabaye umuyobozi mukuru w'apolisi y'igihugu mbere yuko agirwa komiseri mukuru w'ungirije b'urwego rushinzwe amagereza mu rwanda. ubu yahagaritse imirimo akaba Yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru.

Sophie Nyirabakwiye, amaze imyaka irenga 15 mu iterambere ryigihugu ndetse n’amahanga. yakoreye UNDP Niger aho yari ibidukikije ninzobere mu bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Imyaka itatu akorera muri Nigeriya no gufatanya nizindi gahunda mubihugu duturanye byamuhaye kwerekana imiterere y’ibinyabuzima n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu karere ka Sahel.
Sophie Nyirabakwiye Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu bijyanye no gucunga ibidukikije yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town.
Sophie Nyirabakwiye, afite uburambe bwimyaka irenga 13 mu kazi mu iterambere ry’igihugu ndetse n’amahanga binyuze muri gahunda z’umuryango w’abibumbye. Yakoze kandi muri UNDP u Rwanda nk'umuyobozi w'itsinda rishinzwe kurwanya ubukene na gahunda y'ibidukikije imyaka itanu. Muri kiriya gihe, Sophie yatsindiye ibihembo mpuzamahanga byo guhanga udushya kandi ashyigikira igipimo cyayo cyiza kugeza ku mugabane wa Afurika muri 2017 (YouthConnekt Africa). Iki gipimo cyari cyarakusanyije abafatanyabikorwa nka UNCTAD, AfDB, KOICA, AU, Fondasiyo ya Tony Elumelu, n'andi masosiyete. y'abikorera ku giti cyabo n'imiryango yo mu karere &amp; mpuzamahanga.
Yakoze muri Nigeria, Madagasikari, u Rwanda, Afurika y'Epfo na Senegali mu nshingano zinyuranye guhera ku nzobere mu bya tekinike kugeza ku muyobozi w'itsinda mu bice bitandukanye cyane cyane kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima, kuvugurura urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima, kurwanya ubucuruzi bw'ubuzima butemewe n'amategeko, kwangirika kw'ubutaka, imihindagurikire y'ikirere, ubukungu bw'icyatsi n'ubururu, guhangana n’amazi y’amazi, kugabanya ubukene binyuze mu mirimo y’urubyiruko, kubona imari, gukora neza, imibereho irambye, n’ibindi bice byiterambere ry’ubukungu.
Yayoboye imiyoborere yizindi gahunda zagenze neza zirimo Imari y’ibinyabuzima, gahunda yo kurwanya imihindagurikire y’imihindagurikire y’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, Iterambere ry’imidugudu iteza imbere, Ubukungu bw’ibidukikije bwagiye bukurikirana ibiganiro bya Politiki yo mu rwego rwo hejuru, Ubukene n’ibidukikije, Ikigega cy’ibidukikije, Ikigega cy’ubutaka n’ibidukikije, n'ibindi... Muri Madagasikari, akora nk'umujyanama wa tekiniki ushinzwe ibidukikije n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere. Yashyigikiye ishyirwaho rya gahunda yo kurwanya imihindagurikire y'ikirere, guteza imbere umushinga wo kwitegura (GCF), na gahunda igamije kurwanya icuruzwa ry’ibinyabuzima bitemewe, imari y’ibinyabuzima, ibinyabuzima byo mu nyanja no ku nkombe zo kubungabunga / kubungabunga ibidukikije, yashyigikiye ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya NDC, guteza imbere umutungo wa GCF., ibiganiro ku bukungu bwubururu.

Yvonne Umulisa ni inzobere mu by'ubushakashatsi, akaba n'umwalimu w’ubukungu muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda mu ishami ry’ubukungu.
Yvonne Umulisa afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubukungu mpuzamahanga n'iterambere yakuye muri Académie Universitaire Louvain, mu Bubiligi na PhD mu by'ubukungu yakuye muri kaminuza ya Jönköping, Suwede (mu cyongereza: International and Development Economics from, Belgium and a PhD in Economics from Jönköping University, Sweden)
Yvonne Umulisa yakoze muri MINECOFIN nk'umukozi ushinzwe Isesengura rya Politiki y'iterambere n'inzobere mu bushakashatsi (mu cyongereza: Development Policy Analyst and Research Expert
MINECOFIN) Oct 2012 - Oct 2014. Kanama 2016 - Kugeza ubu ni umwalimu muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda.
Ubushakashatsi bwe bwibanze ku bukungu bwo guhuza amafaranga mu Karere ka. Kubera iyo mpamvu, yatewe inkunga n’igitekerezo cy’ahantu heza h’ifaranga, ubushakashatsi bwe kugeza ubu bwibanze ku bukungu bw’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAMU), kugira ngo butange ibimenyetso bifatika byo kumenyesha abafata ibyemezo by’iterambere ry’ejo hazaza. Ubushakashatsi bwe kugeza ubu bwasohotse mu kinyamakuru cyo kwishyira hamwe mu bukungu no muri Afurika y'Iterambere. Inyinshi mu myigishirize ye ikubiyemo Microeconomic Intermediate Microeconomics, Operations Research, Advanced Macroeconomics théorie, Politiki y’ifaranga n’amafaranga na Banki haba muri kaminuza ndetse na master's program.

Mukantabana Mathilde (wavutse 1958) ni umunyapolitiki n'umudipolomate w'umunyarwandakazi wavukiye i Butare, kuri ubu akora nka ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri Amerika akaba na Ambasaderi uhagarariye Mexico, Burezili, na Arijantine. Ni Perezida akaba ari nawe washinze umuryango udaharanira inyungu Friends of Rwanda Association (F.O.R.A).
Mukantabana Mathilde yize amateka n'ubumenyi bw'isi aho yabonye impamyabushobozi mu cyiciro cya kabili cya kaminuza muri kaminuza nkuru yu Burundi, yakomeje yiga amateka abona icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza hamwe na social work muri kaminuza ya Carifornia State univerisity iri sacramento muri Carifornia muri Amerika, akaba afite imypamyabushobozi y'ikirenga mu ndimi yakuye muri Carifornia State univerisity sacramento.
Mukantabana Mathilde afatanyije na UNDP Batangije umuryango social work, umuryango utigenga muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda mu myaka 1999, aho yari n'umwarimu muri kaminuza, akomeza no kuba muri mu nama y'ubutegetsi ya Sonoma State university, aho yigishaga amasomo ajyanye na genocide.

Kantengwa Judith Heard, ni umunyarwandakazi umaze kubaka izina mu kumurika imideli yegukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga atadukanye.
Kantegwa Judith Heard Uyu mugore w’imyaka 34 y’amavuko afite inkomoko mu Rwanda ariko uri Uganda ari naho atuye. akaba ari umunyamideli ukorera muri Uganda, yegukanye igihembo cya Nyampinga bitadukanye. Judith Heard ni Umunyarwandakazi uzwi mu kwerekana imideli, yubatse izina muri Uganda. Ni umubyeyi w’abana barimo umwe yafashe akiyemeza kumurera ndetse n’impanga yabyaranye n’umugabo we, Umunyamerika Dr. Alex Heard unamwongerera imbaraga mu bikorwa bye byo kumurika no guhanga imideli. Gusa baje gutandukana mu 2019 nyuma y’imyaka 13 babana.
Kantengwa Judith Heard usanzwe abifite inkomoko mu Rwanda ndetse na Uganda, kuko afite se umubyara ari w'umunyarwanda akagira undi nyina w'umugandekazi. Ubwo yajyaga muri Nyampinga Miss Elite yavuzeko ahagarariye Afurika y’Iburasirazuba kuko ababyeyi be bavuka mu bihugu bitandukanye rero hombi baramushyigikiye.
uyu Kantegwa yitabiriye urushanwa ryo guteka rya gorolla Highland Silverchef Competition 2019 ryabereye muri Five Volcanoes Boutique Hotel iri mu akarere ka Musanze rihuze abatetsi 13 baturutse mu bihugu nku Rwanda, Uganda, na Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo.Akaba yari umwe mubagize akanama nkemurampaka katanganga amanota harimo umunyarwandakaziuba muri uganda. Uyu mubyeyi w’icyamamare muri Uganda Kantegwa Judith Heard asanzwe azwi mu kumurika imideli.

Mukabaranga Agnes ni Umunyarwandakazi w'Umunyapolitiki. ni umwe mu bagize Ishyaka Riharanira Demokarasi ya Gikristo (PDC) akaba n'umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Pan-Afurika ndetse akaba yarahoze mu Nteko Nshinga amategeko no muri Sena y'u Rwanda. Ni umunyamategeko wabigize umwuga.
Mukabaranga yagizwe umunyamuryango wa mbere mu Nteko ishinga amategeko muri Leta y’inzibacyuho nyuma ya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda mu mwaka 1994 Mu mwaka 2003, itegeko nshinga rihoraho ryemejwe mu gihugu ryashyizeho igihugu cy’amashyaka menshi gifite inteko ishinga amategeko igizwe na sena n’umutwe w’abadepite. Mukabaranga yagizwe senateri nyuma yo gutorwa kwa Perezida Paul Kagame agatorerwa kuba perezida wa mbere mu itegeko nshinga rishya. Yari umwe mu bagore 39 batowe cyangwa bashyizwe mu nteko ishinga amategeko muri uwo mwaka, ugereranije n'abagabo 41. Yarahiriye guharanira ubutabera n'ubwiyunge mu gihugu nyuma ya jenoside, yashimangiye uruhare rw'umugore muri iki gikorwa, agira ati: "Abagore biteguye kurushaho kumvikana, bakunda amahoro kandi bafasha mu bwiyunge. Mu mwaka 2013, mbere yo kuva muri sena, Mukabaranga yatorewe manda y'amezi atandatu nk'umuvugizi w'ihuriro ry’igihugu ngishwanama ku mashyaka ya politiki (National Consultative Forum), uruhare yagize ku bufatanye na Sylvie Mpongera wo mu ishyaka rya Gisosiyalisiti ry’u Rwanda (Rwanda Socialist Party, PSR).
Mukabaranga Agnes yabuze abavandimwe be muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda, kandi ni umubyeyi w'Abana bane.

Teta Gisa Rwigema Umukobwa wa Maj Gen Fred Rwigema umuyobozi w'ishami ry'umuryango wa Afrika yunze ubumwe muri Minisiteri y'ubumwe n'amahanga n'ubutwererane yu Rwanda akaba yari aherutse gukora ubukwe nu mugabo we bakundanye kuva mu bwana witwa Marvin Manzi. Ubukwe bwitabiriwe na Peresida wu rwanda Paul Kagame.

Baguma Rose ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umugore w'ubatse urugo, Akaba ari impirimbanyi ya polikite mu burezi. Baguma rose wakoze muri minisiteri y'uburezi ubwo yari Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Politiki n’Igenamigambi, ubu akaba akora mu mujyi wa kigali aho ari umunyamabanga mu nkuru w'inama y'ubutegetsi y'umujyi wa kigali.
Baguma Rose ni umwe m'ubagize urwego rw'uburezi mu Rwanda, aho guverinoma y’u Rwanda yashyizeho ingamba zitandukanye, harimo wenda no kuvugurura amwe mu mategeko, bikorwa hagamijwe gukuraho inzitizi zihari zagiye zituma abantu batagira amahirwe angana mu bijyanye n’uburezi, harimo wenda izishingiye ku gitsina, ku bumuga, agace umuntu aturukamo n’ibindi.

Mukamana Liberata ni umunyarwandakazi akaba umwarimu muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda, afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubukungu yakuye muri Kaminuza mpuzamahanga ya Kampala muri 2014 muri Uganda.
Liberata MUKAMANA afite impamyabumenyi y’ubukungu yakuye mu cyahoze ari kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda (2007), impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Microfinance yakuye muri kaminuza ya Belgamo (Ubutaliyani, 2008), Impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza (mu icyongereza: Post Graduate Diploma in Gender and Local Economic Development from Makerere University (Uganda, 2011) mu bijyanye n'uburinganire n'iterambere ry'ubukungu muri kaminuza ya Makerere (Uganda, 2011), Master mu by'ubukungu yakuye muri kaminuza mpuzamahanga ya Kampala (Uganda, 2014). Kuri ubu (2018) umukandida wa PhD mu bushakashatsi bw’uburinganire muri kaminuza ya Makerere, muri Uganda.
Amaze kurangiza icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza (Bachelor), yakoze nk'umukozi ushinzwe kegeranya ibimenyetso muri COPABU (Coperative des producteurs artisans de Butare) kuva 2006 kugeza 2007. Yari ashinzwe guhuza no kugenzura ibikorwa byose byo kohereza ibicuruzwa by'ubukorikori bya COPABU mu Butaliyani. Ibikorwa nyamukuru kwari ukugenzura ibikorwa by’umusaruro mu cyaro, guteza imbere amahame y’ubucuruzi bukwiye, gushakisha ibyangombwa byose bisabwa byoherezwa mu mahanga, gukorana n’amasosiyete atwara ibicuruzwa biva mu Rwanda mu Butaliyani.
Nyuma y’amasomo ya muri Microfinance mu Butaliyani, yinjiye muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda aho akora kugeza ubu. Yakoze kandi nk'umujyanama mu mahugurwa muri Gender Mainstreaming ku bakozi b'ikigo gishinzwe amakuru ya geografiya na Sensing ya kure (CGIS) n'ishami rya geografiya, Ishuri ry'ubumenyi n'ikoranabuhanga, kaminuza y'u Rwanda muri 2014.
Igenzura ku mikoreshereze yinguzanyo nuburyo bwo kugabana uburinganire hagati yumurimo mubikorwa biterwa inkunga ninguzanyo: Urubanza rwa Duterimbere MFI mu Rwanda, rwasohotse muri Cogent Social Science 27 Ukuboza 2017, (mu icyongereza: Control over the utilization of the loan and the pattern of the gendered division of labor in the loan-funded activity: A case of Duterimbere MFI in Rwanda, published in Cogent Social Sciences 27 December 2017)
Guteza imbere uburinganire bw’umugabo mu kubona inguzanyo ziciriritse binyuze mu buryo bworoshye bwo gutanga inguzanyo ku bagore byibasira MFIs: Ibimenyetso byatanzwe na Duterimbere MFI yo mu Rwanda, byasohotse mu kinyamakuru mpuzamahanga cy’ubucuruzi n’iterambere ry’ubukungu Vol. 4 No 3 Ugushyingo 2016 (mu icyongereza: Promoting gender equality in access to microcredit through flexible lending approaches of female targeting MFIs: Evidence from Duterimbere MFI of Rwanda, published in the International Journal of Business and Economic Development Vol. 4 No 3 of November 2016)
Microcredit yo guteza imbere ubushobozi butanga umusaruro wabakene: imyumvire yuburinganire mubakiriya ba Duterimbere MFI mu Rwanda yasohotse mu kinyamakuru mpuzamahanga cy’ubuhanzi n’ubumenyi rusange, Vol. 3 No 6 Kanama, 2015 (mu icyongereza: Microcredit for promoting the productive capacity of the poor: a gender outlook among the clients of Duterimbere MFI in Rwanda published in International Journal of Liberal Arts and Social Science, Vol. 3 No. 6 of August, 2015)
Umusanzu w’amashyirahamwe y’abagore mu kuzamura ubukungu bw’abategarugori muri Uganda, ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku ishyirahamwe ry’imiryango y’abagore muri Uganda (Nawou), bwasohotse mu kinyamakuru cy’u Rwanda Umubumbe wa 26, Urukurikirane B: 2012 Ubumenyi bw’imibereho (mu icyongereza: The Contribution of Women Organizations to the Economic Empowerment of Craftswomen in Uganda, case study of the National Association of Women Organizations in Uganda (Nawou), published in Rwanda Journal Volume 26, Series B: 2012 Social Sciences)

Nishimwe Marie Grâce ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umunyapolitikekazi ukora mu mujyi wa kigali. Ni umuyobizi w'inama njyanama wungirije w'umujyi wa Kigai, akaba yaratowe muri 2021. Nishimwe Marie Grâce ni inzobere kandi akaba ari kabuhariwe mu bijyanye n’imitunganyirize y’umujyi n'imirwa mikuru, yabyize muri Kaminuza ikomeye ku isi y’Ikoranabuhanga yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (muri Massachusetts Institute of Technology). Afite Impamyabumenyi ihanitse ya kaminuza mu by’amategeko n’ubushabitsi (Masters’s degree). Nishimwe Marie Grâce afite inararibonye mu gukemura amakimbirane ashingiye ku butaka, akaba yaragize uruhare rugaragara mu gutegura Politiki n’amategeko mu bijyanye n’ubutaka.
Nishimwe Marie Grace akora mu ishami rishinzwe imicungire y’ubutaka mu cyigo gishinzwe ubutaka, aho yageze hariho ihame ryitwa iterambere ryiyongera, aho nk'urugero, avugako niba umuntu afite gahunda yo kubaka inyubako y’amagorofa 15, atazasabwa kuyazamurira rimwe yose.

Umutesi Geraldine ni umugore w'umunyepolike w' umunyarwandakazi. uyu Umutesi Geraldine akaba akora mu umujyi wa Kigali, akaba kandi ari umuyobozi mukuru w'ungirije w'imbuto Foundation mu Rwanda.
Umutesi Geraldine ni umubyeyi ufite umugabo ndetse n'abana babili. Umutesi Geraldine yize amashuri y'isumbuye yiga amasomo ajyanye n'uburezi, ndetse azano gukomeza kwiga ibijyanye n'uburezi mu mashuri y'akaminuza. Umutesi Geraldine arangije kwiga yakoze ku bw'ibutso rwa genocide ku gisozi (Kigali Genocide Memorium).

Jeanne d'Arc Uwimanimpaye (yavutse 15 Kanama 1978) ni umunyarwandakazi w'umunyapolitiki. Yabaye umunyamuryango w'inteko ishinga amategeko Umutwe w’abadepite kuva mu 2008. Kuva mu 2013 kugeza 2018, yabaye Visi Perezida w’Umutwe w'abadepite. Uwimanimpaye Jeanne d'Arc yagiye agira ibwirwa ruhame zizi kandi zikomeye nkaho yavuzeko, igihugu cyacu cy’u Rwanda cyari gisanzwe gifite ubundi ikirere kiza ndetse ko ari na byo byatumye abantu benshi birara ntibashyireho ingamba zihamye kandi zifatika zo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, yibasira ibihugu bitandukanye mu biyaga bigari birimo n’u Rwanda hatari ikibazo cy’ inzara atari byo namba, ahubwo ko icyabaye ahubwo ari ibura ry’umusaruro w’ubuhinzi uhagije mu baturage bigatuma abantu batabona amafunguro menshi kandi meza, nk’uko byari bisanzwe, bakabifata nk’ikibazo cy'inzara ariko atari byo.
Uwimanimpaye Jeanne d'Arc yarangije muri Economics muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda. Mbere yo kwinjira mu Nteko, yakoraga nk'umwarimu w’ishuri ry'isumbuye, ndetse no mu nzego z'ibanze nk'umugenzuzi w'imbere mu karere akaba n'umukozi ushinzwe imibanire rusange.
Uwimanimpaye yinjiye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko mu matora y’abadepite yo mu Rwanda mu 2008, nk'umwe mu bahagarariye abagore batandatu mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yagiye mu Bwongereza nk'indorerezi y'amatora ya Commonwealth ku matora rusange yo mu Bwongereza 2010.
Mu matora y’abadepite 2013, Uwimanimpaye yasubijwe mu mutwe w’abadepite nk'uhagarariye abagore mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Mu Kwakira 2013, yatorewe kuba Visi Perezida wungirije ushinzwe kugenzura no gushyiraho amategeko, ahabwa amajwi 70 kuri 80. Nk’Umuvugizi wungirije, yerekanye icyifuzo cyo kwemerera Perezida Kagame kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu, nyuma y’uko icyifuzo cyari kimaze gusinywa na miliyoni 3.8
Uwimanimpaye yatoranijwe nk'umukandida wa FPR-Inkotanyi mu matora y'abadepite yo mu 2018, atorerwa guhagararira Akarere ka Gatsibo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Yeguye ku mwanya wa Perezida wungirije, asimburwa na Edda Mukabagwiza wa FPR-Inkotanyi. Muri Nzeri 2019, Uwimanimpaye yasabye ko hakorwa iperereza ku kibazo cy’amafaranga cyerekeranye n’amasoko yatanzwe n’ikigo cy’ubuhinzi cy’u Rwanda, kandi anenga amasoko yatanzwe n’ikigo gishinzwe amakoperative mu Rwanda.

Rwigamba Bella ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari y’UUmukozi wa Minisiteri burezi (MINEDUC) aho ushinzwe ikoranabuhanga, Bella RWIGAMBA ni Umuyobozi mukuru wa Digital ushinzwe uburezi muri minisiteri y'uburezi. Mbere yo kwinjira muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi, yakoranye mu rwego rw’ingufu na Bboxx isosiyete ikorera mu Bwongereza aho yakoraga nka Master Data Analys ndetse no mu rwego rw’imari aho yakuriye ishami ry’Ubucuruzi muri RSwitch National e-payment switch ishami ryu Rwanda.
Rwigamba Bella afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu iterambere rya sisitemu no gutanga amakuru yakuye muri kaminuza ya HAN yomu Buholandi na BBA impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabili cya kaminuza mu micungire y'amakuru (Information Management) yakuye muri kaminuza y'Abadiventisti bo muri Afurika yo hagati (Adventist University of Central Africa).

Akintore Alline Kabbatende ni umunyarwandakazi ufite imyaka 34 ya mavuko, ni umukunzi w'ikoranabuhanga ufite amateka mu mashanyarazi na elegitoroniki. Kugeza ubu niwe uhagarariye guverinoma yu Rwanda mu ihuriro ry’ubukungu bw’ISI, ikigo cy’impinduramatwara ya kane mu nganda aho ayoboye iterambere ry’imikorere ya tekinoloji y’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda (mu icyongereza: Representative from the Government of Rwanda at WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM) kandi agashyira ingufu mu guteza imbere ubufatanye n’ubufatanye bw’abafatanyabikorwa n’ibigo byigenga.
Yize muri kaminuza ya Pennsylvania muri Amerika.
Igihe cyose mbwiye abantu aho nkomoka, ikintu cya mbere kiza mu bitekerezo byabo ni 1994 Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Numva nifatanije cyane na hahise hanjye. Igihe nageraga muri Amerika bwa mbere, ushinzwe abinjira n'abasohoka yarebye kuri pasiporo yanjye ahita atanga ikibazo, " uri umuhutu cyangwa umututsi? Igisubizo cyanjye cyaroroshye cyane, ndamusubiza ati "Ndi Umunyarwanda".
Yabaye umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Rwanda Online Platform Ltd, itanga ibisubizo byikoranabuhanga muri PPP hamwe na leta yu Rwanda ku girango ihindure imitangire ya serivisi za leta kubanyarwanda bose, aho yubatse umubano n'abafatanyabikorwa ba leta n’abikorera; kandi yayoboye iterambere ry'ibicuruzwa no kujya kumasoko kugirango batange kandi bakoreshe serivise za leta. Ubunararibonye yakoranaga mu bijyanye n'ikoranabuhanga: mu kigo gishinzwe iterambere ry'u Rwanda (Ishami rya ICT), Samsung Electronics (HQ, Koreya y'Epfo), Ubwikorezi rusange bw'amashanyarazi (USA) ndetse nk'umwanditsi usanzwe wa NewTimes (u Rwanda).
Kuri ubu ni umuyobozi wa komite yaba IT mu nama y'ubuyobozi ya Banki ya Kigali Plc. kuva mu Gushyingo 2018. Ni n'umwe mu bagize inama y'ubuyobozi y'ikigo gishinzwe gutangaza amakuru mu Rwanda (Broadcaster Public Rwanda) | kLab Rwanda (ihuriro ry’ikoranabuhanga rya mbere mu Rwanda), Visi-Perezida w'Inama y'Ubutegetsi ya Gasabo 3D (Inzobere muri 3D CAD; Umufatanyabikorwa w'akarere ka SolidWorks), Global Shaper, ihuriro ry'ubukungu ku isi, Kigali Hub, Umuhuzabikorwa wa Mentorship, Abakobwa muri ICT Rwanda Umutwe | munsi y’ubumwe mpuzamahanga bwitumanaho (ITU) hamwe na Speaker / Panelist: Ihuriro ryubucuruzi rya Stanford Afrika (Palo Alto, 2016), ITU Telecom World (Budapest, 2015), TransformAfrica.

Therese Bishagara Kagoyire (25 Ukuboza 1952 - 8 Nyakanga 2019) yari umunyarwandakazi w'umunyapolitiki. Kuva mu 2011 kugeza 2019, yabaye umwe mu bagize Sena y'u Rwanda. Yari umunyamuryango wa Rwanda Patriotic Front (FPR).
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Bishagara yakuriye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse. Yari afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bumenyi bw’ibinyabuzima.
Bishagara yakoze ubushakashatsi muri Programme de la Lutte Contre le SIDA et les Infection Indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina,kandi yabaye n’ubunyamabanga buhoraho bwa komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe kurwanya SIDA, Yabaye Umuyobozi w'Ikigo cy'ubuvuzi cya Kigali (1996–2004). Yabaye umwarimu w'igihe gito muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda (1999–2003).
Yakoze nka Resident Advisor Feature International / Easure Evaluation / USAID kuva 2006 kugeza 2007. Yabaye umujyanama wa tekinike muri Save the Children UK mu 2006, ndetse no muri PSI - Ibiranga gukumira VIH (2005–2006). Kuva mu 2008 kugeza 2011, Bishagara yari umuyobozi wa gahunda y'igihugu ya Jhpiego / MCHIP International, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta ukorana na kaminuza ya Johns Hopkins (USAID).
Yakoze mu myanya y'abagize inama y'ubutegetsi muri White Ribbon Alliance for Motherhood Safe (2007–2011), Université Libre de Kigali (2008–2011) hamwe n'ikigega cyo gutera inkunga iterambere ry’u Rwanda, Rwanda Local Development Support Funds (2007–2011). Yari umunyamuryango wa Association d'Exécution des Travaux d'Intérêt Public (ASSETIF). Yabaye perezida wa Profemmes Twese -Hamwe na COCAFEM / Ibiyaga Bigari (2007–2011). Bishagara yinjiye mu nteko ishinga amategeko mu mutwe wa Sena y'u Rwanda muri 2011, nk'uhagarariye Intara y'Iburengerazuba.
Bishagara yararwaye muri Mata 2019. Yapfuye ku ya 8 Nyakanga 2019 mu bitaro bya Johns Hopkins, Baltimore, Maryland, muri Amerika Yashyinguwe mu irimbi rya Rusororo i Kigali.

Sonia Kubwimana n'umuyobozi w'ubucuruzi bw'u Rwanda afite umwuga mubukungu, abakozi n'Ubuyobozi Rusange bumara imyaka 25. Mu mibereho ye yose, yagiye akora mu ubuyobozi bukuru bw'imari muri Bralirwa Plc,Isosiyete ikora Heineken mu Rwanda.
Sonia afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubukungu n'ubuyobozi yakuye muri kaminuza y'i Uburundi n'uburezi bukuru (executive education) yakuye muri INSEAD, IMD, London Business School n'Ishuri ry'ubucuruzi rya Harvard (Harvard business school).
Azi neza I Kinyarwanda, Igifaransa n'Icyongereza.
Mu gihe yari umuyobozi ushinzwe abakozi muri Bralirwa (2009-2017), Sonia yatsinze yayoboye gahunda ya Rubanda na Organisation yasabwaga gutera inkunga Isosiyete ubwihindurize kuva kumwanya wambere wiganje kumasoko kugeza kurushanwa no kubakoresha guhangana na Sosiyete. Impinduka zakozwe zirimo kuvugurura Umuryango muri byose amashami, guteza imbere imikorere, imiyoborere n'ubuyobozi mu Ishirahamwe kimwe no guha abakozi imyitwarire ikenewe kugirango batsinde mu bucuruzi.
Byongeye kandi, mugihe kimwe, nubwo kwiyongera kubuhanga mu Rwanda no hanze, Bralirwa yashoboye gukomeza umwanya wa "Umukoresha wo guhitamo" no gukurura kandi ushake abanyamwuga babishoboye kurwego rwabato, hagati na bakuru mugihe nabo bakomeza ibyiza urwego rwo gusezerana mumuryango. Na none kandi umwe mubagize komite nyobozi ya Bralirwa,yagize uruhare rukomeye kandi ruha agaciro ubujyanama.
Kuri ubu Sonia ni umuyobozi w'ubucuruzi mu nzego za kawa n’ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda, umujyanama n'umutoza wigenga wabigize umwuga wo gutoza nyobozi no korohereza serivisi binyuze muri Breakfast Club Afrika, umuryango w'abanyamuryango ba Panafrican ufite intego imwe yo gufasha abayobozi b'imiryango kuba abayobozi beza, bityo bikagirira akamaro imiryango yabo n'abakozi. Breakfast Club africa (BCA) ifite abanyafurika benshi mubihugu birimo Siyera Lewone, Gana, Nijeriya, Malawi, Kenya, u Rwanda, Afurika y'Epfo, n'icyerekezo cyo kurushaho kwaguka kumugabane wa Afrika yose.
Byongeye kandi, Sonia ari mumashyirahamwe atandukanye yabanyamuryango babigize umwuga harimo Ihuriro Mpuzamahanga rya bagore Kawa Ihuriro (Umutwe wu Rwanda), Ubukerarugendo nu Ishyirahamwe mu Rwanda (RTTA), Ishyirahamwe ryakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda (RHA), Abagore b'Abanyafurika Gahunda yo kwihangira imirimo (AWEP) na Rotary International (RI). Akorera kandi ku Inteko rusange yimidugudu yabana ba SOS Rwanda kandi yahoze mubuyobozi bw' Inama y’umurimo mu Rwanda.

Mutoni Saranda Olive ni umukobwa wimyaka 19 w'umusizi n'umunyamakuru, akaba n'umurwanashyaka wa Imfura Arts For Peace, wavukiye kandi akurira mu Rwanda, Saranda yari afite imyaka 13 gusa ubwo yatangiraga kwandika ibisigo bye SUGAR DADDY ni kimwe mubisigo bye byagize ingaruka nziza mubuzima bw'abantu.
Oliva mutoni ni umunyeshuri wifuza gucunga neza kwakira abashyitsi no mu bukerarugendo kuba, akora cyane ashishikajwe no gucuruza abashyitsi ndetse n'ubukerarugendo, ashishikajwe no kwiga no kugira ubumenyi bushya. Byaragaragaye ko ari umutungo w'agaciro ufite umwuka wo gukorera hamwe no gushakisha amahirwe murwego rwo kwakira abashyitsi n'ubukerarugendo aho ubumenyi bwanjye n'ubuhanga byanjye byakoreshwa mugihe cyo kwiga. ni umukinnyi wa filime ufite urukurikirane rukomeje ruzwi nkibanga rinyura kumurongo wa interineti uzwi nka topline TV, ni umuvugizi wa rubanda muri Orators Africa akaba n'umurwanashyaka wa imfura ubuhanzi bwamahoro u Rwanda byongeye kandi ko akora ibisigo. Gukorana ubunyangamugayo ni ihame rye. Ahanini ashishikarizwa nabantu batsinze bakoze cyane kugirango bagere kuntego zabo. Kubwibyo, ntagitinya ibibazo ahubwo, yihatira kubitsinda ejo hazaza heza.
Amateka n'ibitekerezo.
Saranda agira ati: “Gutwita kw'ingimbi ni kimwe mu bibazo u Rwanda ruhura nacyo, ku gitekerezo cye yabonye ko abagabo bashakanye ari bo basenga cyane uruhare rw'izo nda zitifuzwa kubaho binyuze mu guha ibintu bihenze abakobwa bakiri bato kandi kuko na bo bumva bashimishijwe cyane no kubonana nabo bityo bigatera ibibazo byinshi.
Binyuze mu kwandika iki gisigo we nubwo gishobora byibura kugabanya ijanisha ryaba bangavu batwite aho Sugar daddy izahagarika kunyerera yiruka inyuma yingimbi zingana neza nabakobwa babyaye.
Saranda ati "Ntabwo bintangaje iyo umuntu avuze ko akazi kanjye kamufashije. Nahoraga ntekereza kwandika nkikiza ubwanjye aribyo kandi rimwe na rimwe nkavugira abandi. Ndagerageza gukuraho iyi ngeso yo gupfobya ingaruka zanjye.
Hagati aho, nubwo, ubutumwa bwose nakiriye bushima akazi kanjye bimpa umunezero kandi ibyo ntibigera bishimisha. Sinzi inshuro nakinguye inbox cyangwa ndarira. Abantu basangira ninshi mubuzima bwabo kandi ndicishijwe bugufi kandi noroheje kubwibyo.
Imibonano mpuzabitsina yambukiranya ibisekuruza yakemuye yabayeho mumateka yabantu, urugero rwabo kubijyanye nimyitwarire yimibonano mpuzabitsina ijyanye na 'Sugar daddy' cyangwa 'Sugar mummy' yakuze ihinduka inganda zitanga ibikoresho kubakobwa bato nabahungu. umukino wo gukoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina kubagabo bakuze.

Professional Background.
JEANNETTE KAWERA also known as KAJETTE is a Rwandan Professional and Passionate Journalist, Writer and Content Creator who on a special note in 2024 was invited to go to Baku, Azerbaijan for the COP29 organised by UNFCCC and reported about COP29 on various media platforms while there. She went to Europe, in The Netherland and got certified by RNW in Media Training for Advocacy and Social Change Campaign in the Netherlands and is now an RNTC Alumni. She acquired some Reuters Training Courses on Digital Journalism, she was also trained by the US Agency for Global Media/The United States Broadcasting Board of Governors and is a certified Environmental and Climate Change Journalist. Kawera has been to different training offered by FEMNET in Kenya and Tanzania for Excellent Journalists aiming to boost their skills. She went to Nairobi Summer School on climate Justice and expressed her extraordinarily skills in journalism and reporting on environment and climate crises. She later went Kenya for a Some Fine Day Pix workshop on Journalism Film Reviews as an Entertainment Journalist. She graduated from YALA Women International Journalism Academy and has worked for several big Media Houses including InyaRwanda Ltd. and she has currently been working with The NewTimes Publication, Rwanda as a Journalist/Reporter.
She is currently pursuing her Master’s Degree in Journalism, Media and Communications, and she holds a First Class Honors’ Degree in Bachelors of Arts in Mass Media and Communications from Mount Kenya University. She also majored in Hospitality Management and Leadership at Akilah Institute for Women. Kawera wrote for Dedza Films, a boutique film distributor and hybrid consulting agency dedicated to bringing nuanced films by underrepresented filmmakers to new audiences, as well as the likes of Akilah Stars Magazine amongst other international ones.
She won twice as the Female Entertainment Journalist of the Year 2022 Awards from Karisimbi Events and holds two Special Recognition Awards: The 2021 Humanitarian Award Winner in the Consumers Choice Awards due to her 'Fight Against Period Poverty Campaign' and the 2022 Excellence Service Award from B4B. Kawera is more of a Social Media Manager and Content Creator, she also works as The Communications Officer at Rwanda Climate Change and Development Network (RCCDN) and SURF/FR. She is passionate about Event Planning as well as helping in the organization and implementation of various social activities. She worked with RSW Australia-based Ministries in organizing and implementing the Gospel Talent Hunt Competition. Jeannette Kawera always fights for better changes in the community she belongs to, especially for women's empowerment.

Mu mwaka wa 2014 ubuyobozi bwa REMA mu Rwanda bwatangaje ko mu Rwanda ibishanga byabangamirwaga bikabije mumyaka yo hambere
kuko Leta yariho icyogihe yarekaga abaturage bakabituramo abandi bakabikoreramo ibyobashaka abandi bakubakamo ugasanga bibangamira cyane. Kuko bari batarasobanukirwa akamaro k'ibishanga kubaturage ndetse n'igihugu ubwacyo.
Ibishanga muri ikigihe.
Mu Rwanda ni hamwe mu bihugu bifite ibishanga byinshi kandi bitandukanye mumpande zose z'igihugu mubyaro ndetse no mumujyi wa Kigali,ubwawo harimo ibishanga.
Ibishanga nibimwe mumutungo kamere ariko akamaro kabyo gatangiye kumenyekana ubu kuko mbere bititabwagaho uko bikwiye nkuko Madamu Dr Rose Mukankomeje yabitangaje muri Kamena 2014 itariki 3, agira ati ikibabaje nuko ibishanga byo mu Rwanda
byatuwemo,ibindi bituzwamo inganda ndetse bishyirwamo nibitagomba kujyamo akaba ariyo mpamvu leta yu Rwanda yashizeho ingamba zo kubungabunga ibishanga mu Rwanda.

bigatuma twangiza amazi ava muri ibyo bishanga ndetse tukangiza numwuka uva mukirere kubera iryo twika rya hato na hato mu bishanga

ibishanga nibimwe mu mumutongo kamere w'igihugu kuko bifite akamaro kanini ku baturage ndetse n'igihugu ubwacyo
ibishanga bifite akamaro gakomeye kuko ibishanga bibika amazi noneho igihe imvura yabaye nkeya bikayohereza mu migezi
ikindi kandi ayo mazi aba ayunguruye kuburyo byorohera abayakoresha muburo bwose. sibyo gusa kuko hari ibishanga mu Rwanda
byagenewe guhingamo imyaka,ibigori,imbingo cyangwa ibiryo by'amatungo tworora mu Rwanda.ibishanga kandi byitaweho neza

Muri Rusange mu Rwanda habarirwa ibishanga bisaga 900 biri kubuso bwa 10% bw'igihugu

Amashyamba yo mu Rwanda abarirwa ku buso bwa hegitari 724,695 zingana na 30.4% by’ubuso bwose bw’igihugu nk’uko bitangazwa muri raporo ya vuba igaragaza ubutaka buriho amashyamba (Rwanda Forest Cover Mapping Report/2019) muri ayo mashyamba 53% ni ayatewe, 21 ni aya cyimeza ari mu mukenke, 19% ni amashyamba ya cyimeza yo mu misozi ibonekamo imvura nyinshi mu gihe 6.2% ari ibihuru. Bimwe mu byagezweho muri Gahunda y’Igihugu y’Ubukungu Butangiza Ibidukikije, by’umwihariko mu mushinga urambye wo gutera ibiti no kubungabunga amashyamba ni ibi bikurikira:
1.Ubuso bw'amashyamba.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, ni bwo u Rwanda rwihaye intego yo kugarura amashyamba kuri hegitari miliyoni ebyiri yahozeho akaba yarangijwe bitarenze mu 2020. Imbaraga u Rwanda rwashyize mu kubungabunga amashyamba ariho, gutera amashyamba mashya, kuvugurura amashyamba mu bice bitandukanye by’Igihugu no guharanira kugera ku ntego za Bonn Challenge ni byo byatumye u Rwanda rugera ku ntego yo kugira 30.4% by’ubuso bw’Igihugu buriho amashyamba. Izo nzego zifite akamaro gakomeye ko gushimangira uruhare rw’u Rwanda mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.
Leta y’u Rwanda yashoye akayabo mu gutera amashyamba mashya no kuyasubiza aho yari asanzwe binyuze muri gahunda ngarukamwaka yo gutera ibiti n’amashyamba. Nko mu gihembwe cy’umwaka wa 2020/2021 Abanyarwanda bateye ibiti miliyoni 25 byagize uruhare mu kuvugurura amashyamba muri gahunda yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.
Muri icyo gihembwe, hegitari 7,400 zateweho ibiti bisanzwe, izindi hegitari 900 zihingwaho ibiti mu mashyamba ya cyimeza ndetse haterwa n’ibiti byeraho imbuto 77,000. Hanavuguruwe hegitari 500 z’amashyamba ahingwamo ibiti bicanwamo amakara mu rwego rwo kongera umusaruro.
3. Abikorera n'amashyamba.
Binyuze muri gahunda y’Igihugu yo kwegurira abikorera ibikorwa bimwe, Leta y’u Rwanda yagiranye ubufatanye n’urwego rw’abikorera mu guharanira imicungire iboneye y’amashyamba ya Leta.
4. Pariki ya Gishwati.
U Rwanda ruherutse guhanga Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura, imwe muri Pariki nshya muri Afurika, mu rwego rwo kurinda amashyamba kimeza ya kera n’inguge ziyacumbitsemo.Iyo Pariki igizwe n’amashyamba abiri ari yo irinini rya Mukura n’irito rya Gishwati aherereye ku musozi ugabaya icyogogo cy imigezi ya Congo na Nili, agakurikira urwunge rw’ibibaya by’Albertine (Albertine Rift) bigizwe n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rutandukanye.
5. Pariki y’Ibirunga.
U Rwanda rwatangiye umushinga ukomeye wo kwagura Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga no guharanira ahazaza heza h’ingagi zo mu misozi zita mu rugo ishyamba ry’Ibirunga. Iyi gahunda y’imbonekarimwe igamije kwagura pariki ku kigero cya 23% ikiyongeraho kilometero kare 37.4, ubunini bwayo bukava kuri kilometero kare 160 bukagera kuri kilometero kare 197.4.

Bimwe mu byavuye "mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe na Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenganzira bwa muntu (NCHR)"", buherutse kugaragaza ko mu rwego rw’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro," 49.4% by’ibirombe biri mu gihugu byanduza imigezi n’inzuzi cyangwa andi mazi. Ni mu gihe 70.93% by’ibyo birombe ari byo bifite uburyo bwizewe bwo gucunga ibisigazwa by’imyanda iva mu bucukuzi. Kurwanya ihumana ry’umwuka wo mu kirere urimo n’uw’abantu bahumeka biri ku gipimo cya 75.82%. Ibirombe bifite ubushobozi bwo gufata amazi byakoreshejwe, ni 64.4%.
Ibi ni bimwe mu byatumye Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, isaba Leta gukaza ubugenzuzi mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro kugira ngo ibidukikije ndetse n’uburenganzira bw’abatuye mu nkengero z’ahacukurwa amabuye y’agaciro, budahonyorwa.
Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, Mukasine Marie Claire, avuga ko kugeza ubu ibyavuye mu shakashatsi bakoze, hatanzwe inama kandi zigahabwa ikigo gishinzwe ubucukuzi. Ati: “Impamvu ari bo twabihaye nuko ari bo bahagarariye Leta kandi Leta niyo ifite inshingano zo gutuma imirimo ikorwa mu rwego rw’ubucukuzi hakurikijwe amategeko n’amabwiriza aba yatanzwe. Kugira ngo yubahirizwe ni uruhare rwa Leta binyuze muri icyo kigo. Amategeko arahari ameze neza ariko twasanze hari aho bidakorwa neza. Kuba bidakorwa neza hakenewe ijisho ribikurikirana”. Uretse ibi bibazo ubushakashatsi bwa Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, bwagaragaje ko mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro hari ikibazo cy’abagore bakiri bake.
Ubushakashatsi bwa NCHR bugaragaza ko ba engeniyeri muri uru rwego rw’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro, bangana na 26.23%. Abagore bakora ubucuruzi bushingiye ku bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro ntibarenga 5.41%.Ikigo k’Igihugu gishinzwe Mine, Peteroli na Gazi kemera ko ibi bibazo mu bucukuzi bihari kikemera ko kigiye kubishakira ibisubizo.
Dushimimana Narcisse, Umuyobozi ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iyubahirizwa ry’amategeko n’ubugenzuzi bwa Mine mu kigo gishinzwe Mine, Peteroli na Gazi avuga ko iki kigo kirimo kureba izo mbogamizi zose zagaragajwe, zakwitabwaho. Urwego rw’Ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro ruza ku mwanya wa Kabiri mu nzego zinjiriza igihugu amafaranga menshi nyuma y’ubukerarugendo.Mbere y’umwaduko wa COVID-19 mu 2019, urwego rw’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro rwahaga akazi abagera ku 71,205 bavuye ku bihumbi 47,727 babonaga akazi mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro mu mwaka wa 2017.
Icyakoze kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19 abari babeshejweho n’ubucukuzi bagabanutseho 19%.
Mu mwaka 2021 Leta yagobotse urwego rw’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro, ku buryo ababoneraga amaramuko mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bari bageze ku bihumbi 100.

Mbirurume (izwi Bilirume, Biruruma, Birurume, Bitirume) ni uruzi mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda ni uruzi rw'umugezi wa Nyabarongo.
Umugezi wa Mbirurume uturuka mu gace k’amashyamba kari mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda, mu burasirazuba bw’Ikiraro cy’Amazi cya bw’igice cya Kongo-Nile. Umugezi wa Mbirurume uturuka mu majyaruguru ya kure ya Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Utemba ugana mu majyaruguru y’iburasirazuba, ukinjira mu Karere ka Karongi, ugaca mu burengerazuba bwa Mukungu. Nyuma ukomeza gutemba werekeza mu majyaruguru y’iburasirazuba ukurikira umupaka ugabanya Uturere twa Nyamagabe na Karongi. Hanyuma uhindukira ugana mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba mbere gato yo guhura n’Umugezi wa Mwogo, uwinjiramo uturutse ibumoso. Imigezi ihuriweho igize uruzi rwa Nyabarongo, rutemba mu majyaruguru ku nkengero z’iburasirazuba bw’igice cya Nili-Kongo.

Umugezi wa Mwogo ni uruzi ruri mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda, rubyara umugezi wa Nyabarongo iyo ruhuye na Mbirurume. Ruturuka m'umashyamba ya nyungwe mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda mu burasirazuba bwa Congo-Nile, aho runyura mumirenge ya ruramba wo mukarere ka Nyaruguru, rukomereza mumurenge wa Kitabi muKarere ka Nyamagabe,rugakomeza rujya kuri nyabukona aho intara y'iburasirazuba igabanira n'iyamajyepfo. Ruba rwanyuze Kandi Nyarusiza rwerekeza mu Karere ka Huye.
Rwerekeza mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba runyuze mu burengerazuba bw'aka karere, rwinjira mu karere ka Nyanza. Mu karere ka Nyanza rukanyura mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba, rukanyura Mweya aho uruzi rwa Gihimbi rwinjirira uhereye ibumoso. Munsi yiyi ngingo ihujwe nuruzi rwa Rukarara uhereye ibumoso. Hanyuma rugakora urubibi rw'iburengerazuba rw'akarere ka Ruhango kugeza ruhujwe uhereye ibumoso nuruzi rwa Mbirurume mumajyepfo ya Bikwa Umugezi uhuriweho witwa uruzi rwa Nyabarongo, rukomeza ruguru rujya I Kigali.
IMIRIMO IKORERWA MUKIBAYA CYA MWOGO
KUBUHINZI BW'UMUCERI N'IMBOGA
Iki kibaya kizwiho cyane gutunganywamo imihanda y'amazi ihingwamo umuceri, aho abaturage bishyize hamwe mu makoperative bawuhinga ku bwinshi bakawurya mungo zabo ndetse bagasagurira namasoko.
Mu bice biteramo umuceri, hahingwa ibigori, ibishyimbo, ibijumba, n'imboga zinyuranye bitandukanye nk'ubutaka bwo mu misozi.
Nanone haberamo byo kurinda igishamga no kuvomerera.Leta n'abahinzi bafatanya mu mirimo yo gukora imiringoti n'ingomero z'amazi kugira ngo ubuhinzi bukomeze mu bihe byose by'ihinga.
Kubera icyi gishanga kigira ubwatsi buhora buba bwinshi, abaturage bahororera inka n'amatungo magufi bakoresheje uburyo bwo kuhakura ubwatsi (kwahira) cyangwa ubworozi bwa kijyambere. Nanone bifashisha amwe mumazi areka hafi y'uruzi buhira amatungo.
Kubera ko uyu mugezi n'ikibaya bya Mwogo bihuza uturere twinshi, harangwa imirimo ihoraho yo kubaka no gusana ibiraro bihuza imirenge n'uturere twa Nyanza, Ruhango na Nyamagabe.
Nanone hakorerwamo imirimo y'uburobyi bw'amafi yo mubwoko bwa tilapiya. Ndetse no gucukura umucanga w'igihogo wifahishwa mubwubatsi.
INGAMBA ZAFASHWE MUKUKIBUNGABUNGA.
Zimwe mungamba zafashwe harimo Gutera amashyamba y'imigano (bamboo) ku nkombe z'umugezi wa Mwogo n'imigezi iwushora bityo bigafata ubutaka Hari ingamba zo guca kandi imirwanyasuri kumisozi.
Hashyizweho itegeko n'imipaka (buffer zone) ihagarika ubuhinzi n'ubwubatsi busatira neza inkombe z'umugezi. Tutibajyiwe ko Abahinzi bo mu kibaya no mu nkengero bafashwa gutera ibiti bivangwa n'imyaka (nk'iseti, Alnus, n'ibiti by'imbuto) kugira ngo ubutaka bukomeze kugira amahumbezi n'umuco wo gufata amazi.

Umugezi wa Rukarara (cyangwa Lukarara) ni uruzi rwo mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda. ruturuka k' Umugezi wa Mwogo, na rwo rukaba umugezi wa Nyabarongo. Namazi ava kure cyane ya Nili. Rukarara izamuka ituruka m'amashyamba mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda mu burasirazuba bwa Congo-Nili. Igishanga cya Kamiranzovu mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe ritanga ikigega gisanzwe cya Rukarara Inkomoko ya Rukarara ubu izwiho kuba isoko rusange ya Nili Ibi byashimangiwe n’urugendo rwa 2005/2006 ruzamuka uruzi rufite ibikoresho bigezweho.

Umugezi wa Akanyaru ni uruzi runini rw'umugezi wa Nyabarongo Irazamuka mu misozi miremire yo mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda n'Uburundi, itemba iburasirazuba hanyuma ikerekeza mu majyaruguru ku mupaka uhuza ibyo bihugu mbere yo kwinjira mu ruzi rwa Nyabarongo. Kurambura hepfo birimo ibishanga byingenzi ariko bidakingiwe, bibangamiwe nibikorwa byabantu.

Imigwegwe nibimwe mubyatsi cyangwa ibirabyo byimeza mu Rwanda. si ibihingwa byimeza gusa gusa bifite akamaro

Umugezi wa Rusizi (nanone rimwe na rimwe yitwa Rusizi) ni uruzi, ufite uburebure bwa kilometero 117, ruva mu kiyaga cya Kivu rugana ku kiyaga cya Tanganyika muri Afurika yo hagati, rukamanuka kuri metero 1.500 (metero 4900) rukagera kuri metero 770, hejuru y'inyanja hejuru yuburebure bwayo, Imiyoboro ihanamye cyane iboneka kuri kilometero 40 za mbere, aho hubatswe ingomero z'amashanyarazi Ahagana hepfo, ikibaya cya Rusizi, gifite imisozi yoroheje gusa, kandi uruzi rutemba mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika unyuze kuri, hamwe n'umuyoboro muto cyangwa ibiri ucitsemo umuyoboro munini.
Rusizi ni uruzi rukiri ruto, rwashinzwe hashize imyaka igera ku 10,000 igihe ikirunga giturika mu imisozi ya Virunga. Imisozi yabujije ikiyaga cya Kivu ahahoze hasohokera amazi ya Nili ahubwo ihatira ikiyaga kurenga mu majyepfo ya Rusizi no mu mazi ya Congo.

Umugezi wa Sebeya ni uruzi ruri mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, u Rwanda rusohoka mu kiyaga cya Kivu giherereye mu majyepfo y'umujyi wa Gisenyi. Umugezi wa Sebeya ukomoka mu misozi y'akarere ka Rutsiro.Ipima kilometero 110 z'uburebure bwamazi irimo kilometero kare 286 y'aturere ka Rutsiro, Ngororero na Rubavu.
Umugezi wa Sebeya iyo wuzuye usenyera amazu, igatwara imyaka twahinze bikaduteza inzara, sebeya iteje ikibazo cyane, kuko itwara ibintu n’abantu. uganiriye na abaturage bo mumurenge wa kamana rugerero na nyundo yo mukarere ka Rubavu bakkubwirako, uyumugezi wa sebeya wari warababereye ikibazo gikomeye kuko iyo wuzuraga wabateraga ibiza bitandukanye harimo; gutwara ibihingwa, amazu ndetse nibintu.

Umugezi wa Koko ni uruzi mu Karere ka Rutsiro gaherereye mu burengerazuba bwu Rwanda utemba ugana mu kiyaga cya Kivu Ni umwe mu nzuzi nini zitwara imisozi y'iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda mu kiyaga cya Kivu, uwundi ni umugezi wa Sebeya Mu gihe cyabakoloni uruzi rwasobanuye imbibi za perefegitura ya Kibuye na Gisenyi.

Umugezi wa Rubyiro ni umugezi uri mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda ukaba uherereye ibumoso bw'umugezi wa Ruzizi. Uhura na Ruzizi, bigakora umupaka utandukanya u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, mu ntera ya 2 kilometero hejuru y'aho uruzi rwa Ruhwa, rukora umupaka utandukanya u Rwanda n'u Burundi, rwinjirira muri Ruzizi. [1]

Umugezi wa Ruhwa ni uruzi ruri mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda ni uruzi rw'i bumoso rw'u mugezi wa Ruzizi. Ihurira na Ruzizi, igize umupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, nko mu kilometero 2 munsi y'aho umugezi wa Rubyiro winjira muri Ruzizi. Ruhwa igize umupaka uhuza uturere two mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda n'Uburundi. [1]

Umugezi wa Koko ni uruzi mu Karere ka Rusizi gaherereye mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda akaba ari uruzi rw'iburyo rw'umugezi wa Ruhwa, rukaba rugabanya umupaka uhuza uturere two mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda n'Uburundi. Kuburebure bwayo bwose inyura muri parike ya Nyungwe.

Ikiraro cya Ruzizi I cyangwa Pont Ruzizi I (cyangwa Ruzizi I) ni ikiraro gikora nk'imwe mu mipaka ihuza imipaka ihuza Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mujyi wa Bukavu n'u Rwanda mu umujyi wa Rusizi hejuru y'umugezi rwa Ruzizi.
Ikiraro cya Ruzizi I mukucyubaka cyatewe ininkunga n'ibihugu byubumwe bwi Burayi muri gahunda y'ubukungu y'umuryango wubukungu wibihugu byibiyaga bigari. Yafunguwe na Mayor Bilubi Ulengabo Meschac ku ya 19 Kamena 2019. Ikiraro gifite metero 57 z'uburebure, ni ikiraro cya kabiri kirekire muri Bukavu, nyuma ya Ikiraro cya Ruzizi II, nacyo kikaba nk'imwe munzira Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo ihana imbibi n'u Rwanda.Cyubatswe bwa mbere mu 1935 kandi nyuma y'igihe kinini kirasenywa kugira ngo cyongere gusanywa mu 1974 hamwe n' ibyuma nibiti bifite ubushobozi bwo gushyigikira ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere buke cyangwa imodoko zitwara toni zitarenze 3 Byari bimaze igihe kinini bikora, mbere yo kubaka iki kiraro gishya, cgifite ubushobozi bwo gushyigikira toni zigera kuri 30, gikora neza kuva muri 2012.

Icyiraro Ruzizi II ni kimwe mu biraro i Rusizi cyangwa Bukavu, ikora nk'imwe mu mipaka ihuza imipaka ihuza Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mujyi wa Bukavu n'u Rwanda mu karere ka Rusizi hejuru y'uruzi rwa Ruzizi. Iki cyiraro giherereye inyuma yumusozi ubamo inkambi ya gisirikare yitwa "Saio Military camp", yubatswe mu 1943 nyuma y’intsinzi y’ingabo za Kongo muri Etiyopiya k' ubutaliyani babaga muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba ku ya 8 Kamena 1941 mu gihe cy’Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Icyiraro cyahise cyubakwa kugira ngo habeho ubucuruzi hagati ya Rwanda-Urundi na Kongo Mbiligi, imirimo yabo yamaze imyaka 12 kuva 1908 kugeza 1920 Icyiraro gifite uburebure bwa metero 88, nicyo cyiraro cya mbere kirekire mu mujyi wa Bukavu, giherereye mu birometero 20 uvuye kuri Icyiraro cya Ruzizi I, kikaba ari n’umupaka wa gasutamo n’u Rwanda i Rusizi.

Mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ibidukikije no guharanira imirire myiza, Umuryango AEE watanze ibiti 2,080 bya avoka byo gutera muri Huye na Nyaruguru, biba bikeya kuko byifuzwaga na benshi.
Umuryango AEE wabitanze ku baturage bo mu Murenge wa Mukura mu Karere ka Huye, no mu Murenge wa Ngera ndetse n’uwa Ngoma mu Karere ka Nyaruguru. Byahawe abaturage bakeya batoranyijwe n’inzego z’ubuyobozi. Abatuye muri Mukura no muri Ngera bagiye bahabwa igiti kimwe buri wese, naho muri Ngoma bo bahabwa ibiti bitatu buri wese.

Icyayi Cya Gisovu ni icyayi gihingwa mu misozi ya Gisovu mu murenge wa Twumba, akarere ka Karongi intara y'iburengerazuba. Ahocyaciye agahigo mu Rwanda no kumasoko mpuzamahanga kuba aricyo cy'igurwa amafaranga menshi, aho cyaguzwe amadora 5.97, ikindi ni icyayi cya Kitabi.

Icyayi Kitabi ni icyayi cyahesheje igihugu cyu Rwanda ishema, aho cyaciye agahigo ko kuba cyaraguzwe amafaranga meshi ku isoko mpuzamahanga ryo muri Kenya aho cyaguze amadora asaga 6.06, hamwe ni cyayi cya Gisovu.
Agahebuzo ki icyayi cya Kitabi.
Icyayi cya Kitabi cyaciye agahigo cyo kugurwa amafaranga menshi ku isoko ry'icyayi mu gihugu cya Kenya, aho cyari gihagarariye u Rwanda. Kuva iri murikagurisha ryatangira mu 1956 ni ubwa mbere byari bibaye.

Mu Rwanda Icyayi cyatangiye guhingwa mu 1961. Mu mwaka wa 2018 cyakorwagamo n’abahinzi 42840, gihingwa kuri hegitari 26897 mu turere 12 tw’igihugu. Ingano yacyo yarazamutse iva kuri toni 14 500 mu 2000 igera kuri toni 27 824 mu 2017/2018.
Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi (NAEB), kigaragaza ko mu 2016-2017 icyayi cyoherejwe mu mahanga cyari toni 25,128 zavuyemo miliyoni $74,5 mu gihe mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2017-2018 habonetse toni 27 824 zasaruwemo miliyoni $88.
Mu 2018 mu Rwanda hari inganda 16 zitunganya icyayi. Mu bakoranaga na zo abagore bari 60% n’abagabo 40%. Icyayi cy’u Rwanda kimaze kuba ubukombe, muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize cyahawe ibihembo 11 muri 12 byatangiwe mu Nama yahuje Abahinzi b’Icyayi muri Afurika, yabereye i Nairobi.
