Muyombo Thomas umuhanzi ny'a Rwanda uzwi kwizina rya TOM CLOSE yavutse tariki ya 28 Kanama 1986, avukira ahitwa masindi muri Uganda arinaho yatangiriye kwigira amashuri y'ikiburamwaka(NURSERY SCHOOL). Nyuma yaho ababyeyi be baje kwimukira mu Rwanda arinaho yahise atangirira amashuri ye abanza muri Remera academy, hanyuma ajya kuri LA colombiere ari naho yasoreje amashuri ye abanza.
Ubuzima bwe bw'amashuri.

Nyuma yo gusoza amasomo ye yismbuye muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda muri 2013 Muyombo Thomas uzwi kw'i zina rya Tom Close muri 2014 yahise atangira gukorera mu bitaro bya Kacyiru. Muri 2015 yahise ajya gukora mu kigo cy'ubuzima cya RBC.

Umuhanzi DR Muyombo Thomas uzwi nka Tom close yazamuwe mu ntera mu kazi nyuma yaho inama y'a ba minisitiri yateranye ikamugira umuyobozi w'ishami ry'igihugu rishinzwe gutanga amaraso mu kigo cy'igihugu cy'ubuzima (RBC). Tom Close yashyizwe muri uyu mwanya nyuma yuko muri Mata 2019 inama yaba minisitiri yari yaramugize umuyobizi w'i kigo gishinzwe gutanga amaraso, ishami ry'a Kigali (RCBT-Kigali).

Sugira Ernest Umunyarwanda ukina Umupira w'Amaguru mu Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwe bw'Umupira w'Amaguru.
Sugira yamenyekanye cyane mu mwaka 2012 akinira AS Muhanga mbere y’uko ajya muri APR FC hagati yumwaka 2013 nuwa 2014.Yakiniye AS Kigali hagati yumwaka 2015 nuwa 2016 ndetse na AS Vita Club yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.Muri Nyakanga mu mwaka 2017 nibwo Sugira Ernest yasubiye muri APR FC ariko avunikira mu Ikipe y’Igihugu ‘Amavubi’ nyuma y’ukwezi kumwe. Yamaze hafi umwaka wose adakina, agaruka mu kibuga neza hagati mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2018 na 2019. Kutumvikana n’umutoza Adil Mohamed Erradi biri mu byatumye Sugira Ernest atizwa Rayon Sports mu Ukuboza 2019, nyuma yo kumara amezi abiri yaroherejwe gukorera imyitozo mu ikipe y’abato, Intare FC.

Groupe scolaire officielle de butare ni ishuri rya leta y'u Rwanda ryatangiye mu 1929 ryubatswe na leta ya ababirigi yaririho muricyo gihe mu Rwanda. Ubundi icyi kigo cyatangiye kigamije kwigisha abanyarwanda, abarundi, n'abatuye mugace ka kivu, ni ukuvuga kamwe muduce duherereye muri leta ya repubulika iharanira demokarasi ya kongo yubu.
Nkuko twabivuze ruguru iri shuri ryatangiye mu 1929,riherereye mu ntara y'amajyepfo, Akarere ka Huye, Umurenge wa Ngoma ni metero nkeya uvuye kumuhanda ugana kuri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda.
Iri shuri muri 2004 ryasuwe numukuru wigihugu cyacu nyakubahwa perezida wa lepubulika y'u Rwanda Paul kagame,aho bizihizaga isabukuri yi myaka 75th cyari cyimaze gishinzwe anabashimira imikorere myiza yacyo. irishuri kandi 2012 ryongeye kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 83th cyarikimaze gishinzwe.

Ishuri ry'a segonderi ryitwa FAWE girls' school ryatangijwe na perezida wa repubulika y'u Rwanda Paul kagame mu1999 ubwo yari visi perezida icyo gihe.
Iri shuri ryatangiye rifite inyego yo kuzamura umwana w'umukobwa muburezi ngo ajye kurwego rumwe nku rw'unuhungu.
Uko yagiye azamura urwego.
FAWE Girls' school muri 1999 yatangiranye abanyeshuri 160 b'abakobwa hamwe n'abarimu 10 gusa. Muri 20009 yarimaze kugira abanyeshuri 700 hamwe nabarimu b'abagabo 23 na b'abagore 12.

Rugangura Axel yavukiye i Bujumbura tariki 30 Gicurasi mu mwaka 1988. Ni Umunyarwanda ukora mugisata cy'Imikino,avuga amakuru yimikino, akanogeza umupira uwo mu Rwanda nahandi kw'isi akaba akorera ikigo cyigihugu cyi tangaza makurux mu Rwanda(RBA).
Ibyo wamenya kuri Rugangura Axel.
Rugangura amashuri abanza yayigiye mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku ishuri ribanza rya APAPER, icyiciro rusange acyigira kuri IPM (Institut Paroissial de Mukarange), ikindi cyiciro acyigira muri APADE.Kaminuza, Rugangura yayize mu yahoze ari NUR (National University of Rwanda) mu ishami ry’itangazamakuru n’itumanaho rizwi nka SJC (School of journalism &amp; Communication), aharangiza muri 2012.
Yakuriye Kicukiro avuga ko yakunze umupira akiri muto bitewe n’uko bari baturanye n’ahantu berekaniraga umupira bityo akura akunda kuwureba.Aho yareberaga imipira niho yahuriye na Mpamo Thierry wakundaga uko yaganiraga ibijyanye n’imipira aho bareberaga.
yamujyanye kuri Contact FM, ariko atangira ameze nk’uwimenyereza umwuga nubwo yari afite impano. Muri urwo rugendo Rugangura yanyuze kuri Radio Autentic mbere y’uko ajya mu kwimenyereza umwuga (internship) kuri KFM, radiyo yari mu zigezweho muri icyo gihe.
Uku kwimenyereza kurangiye Rugangura yaje kwerekeza kuriaho yanamenyekaniye cyane aza kuhava yerekeza kuri Radio Rwanda, agikorera kuva mu myaka ine ishize.ni umwe mu banyamakuru bakunzwe cyane kubera ubuhanga afite mu kogeza umupira w’amaguru kuri ubu akaba akora mu kigo cy’igihugu cy’itangazamakuru (RBA).

Emery Gatsinzi niwe raperi wambere ukomeye mu Rwanda ugendeye kubigwi yihariye akaba azwi kw'izina rya Riderman. Uyumuhanzi yavutse tariki ya 10 werurwe1987.
Riderman yavukiye I Bujumbura mu Burundi niwe mfura mubavandimwe, bavukana ari batanu,abahungu batatu na bakobwa babiri.
Emery Gatsinzi amashuri abanza yayize kuri ecole primaire kabusunzu maze ayisumbuye ayiga Muri groupe scolaire St Andre, kaminuza yayikomereje muri university Libre de Kigali mubijyanye n'ubukungu n'icunga mutungo kugeza muri 2008,aho yerekeje muri Rwanda Tourism University College mu ishami ry'ubukerarugendo n'icunga mutungo ariko ntiyaharangiriza.

Rayon sports fc ni ikipe ikinira mu Rwanda ikaba iri no mu makipe akomeye muri shampiyona y'u Rwanda(Rwanda premier league).Ni ukuvuga ngo igitekerezo cyo gushinga ikipe ya Rayon Sports cyatangiye kuvuka mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 1960 nyuma yo kunoza neza ishingwa mu 1964 ishingiwe mucyahoze ari komini Nyabisindu muri perefegitura ya Butare, ubu ni mu murenge wa Busasamana, akarere ka Nyanza mu ntara y'Amajyepfo. Rayon Sport yaje kubona ubuzima gatozi mu mwaka 1968.
Rayon Sports yabaye ikipe ya mbere igeze mu matsinda mu mikino nyafurika, hari mu mwaka wa 2018 ni yo kipe yo mu Rwanda yaciye agahigo ko kugera mu matsinda.
Inkomoko y' izina rayons.
Izina RAYONS ni izina iyi kipe yahawe na padiri w' umuzungu Arnot Channoire wayoboraga ishuri rya Krisitu umwami ry' i Nyanza, arikomoye ku izina yari yahawe na MUREGO Donate wari warashinze iyi kipe. Ibitaro bya Butaro ni ibitaro biherereye mu murenge wa Butaro, mu karere ka Burera mu ntara y'Amajyaruguru, Ibi bitaro byatangiye gukora 2006 bishyira 2007 bitangira bikorera mukigo ndera buzima cya Ruhondo bizanywe n'ishuti mubuzima (partner in health) ifatanyije na minisitere y'ubuzima ariko amazu ibitaro nyirizina bikoreramo akaba yaratangiye gukorerwamo muri Mutarama 2011, ni inyubako zatwaye akayabo ka miliyoni 160 za mafaranga y'u Rwanda.
Ibitaro bya Butaro nkuko twabivuze hejuru ibi bitaro byafunguwe kumugaragaro mu akarere ka Burera mu ntara y'Amajyaruguru, Ibi bitaro byikitegererezo bisuzuma bikanavura kanseri "(Butaro Ambulatory Cancer Center (BACC))."
Ibitaro bya Butaro tariki ya 9 Nyakanga 2021 ubuyobozi bw' akarere ka Burera bwa shyikirije ibitaro by'a butaro imbangukiragutabara shya, izunganira abaturage mukubagabanyiriza imvune baterwaga n'urugendo rurerure bajyaga bakora bajya gushaka serivise z'ubuvuzi.

Apostle Yoshua Ndagijimana Masasu, the founder and overseer of Evangelical Restoration Church, President and Chancellor of Bible Communication Center, author of Amazon’s Best Seller, “Delivered from All my Fears”
Apostle Yoshua Ndagijimana Masasu was born in 1960 in a village in Rusizi. In 1989, he married Senior Pastor Lydia Umulisa Masasu, and they have been together since then
Apostle Yoshua Ndagijimana Masasu, the founder and overseer of Evangelical Restoration Church, President and Chancellor of Bible Communication Center, author of Amazon’s Best Seller, “Delivered from All my Fears”, Apostle Masasu is a man who has dedicated his whole life to please Jesus at any cost. This passion began when he gave his life to Jesus Christ in 1983 and began the journey of serving him wholeheartedly.
He is also the founder of the Bible Communication Centre (BCC), an international organization that focuses on preparing an army of consecrated Disciples, from different places and backgrounds for the purpose of making Jesus Christ the Lord of this generation.
BCC operates in all 5 continents with more than 5000 members from various churches. Within the BCC program, He has written 7 manuals that are used for discipleship training.
Apostle Yoshua holds a bachelor’s degree in Electronics and telecommunication Engineering and a bachelor’s degree in Library Science.
He has an honorary doctorate degree in divinity from Logos University, Florida in 2015, and is currently pursuing a Master’s in Theology: Christian Ethics and Leadership at the Protestant Institute of Arts and Social Sciences, Rwanda.
Apostle Yoshua is happily married to his beautiful wife and partner in ministry, Pastor Lydia Umulisa Masasu, and together they have five children: Deborah, Joshua, Caleb, Esther and Yedidia.
The birth of evangelical restoration churh.
And the Lord answered me,and said,write the vision,and make it plain upon tables,that he may run that readeth it. The vision is yet for an appointed time,but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry,wait for it ;because it will surely come, it will not tarry”(Habbakuk 2,2-3)
In 1984, I visited Rwanda for the first time after decades in exile and God spoke to me about the country. In the aftermath of the 1994 Genocide against Tutsi, Rwanda was a desolate country filled with blood and bones of victims who are estimated to 1 million. God commanded me to organize a mission trip to Rwanda through the earlier created ‘Jerusalem Ministry’. The mission included among others delivering a special message of God destined to the new authorities in Kigali.
The Journey began when he founded “Jerusalem Ministry” in Democratic Republic of Congo, that aimed to help his fellow Rwandan refugees to regain hope in that foreign land.
In 1994, he was called by God to move to Rwanda and there he founded Evangelical Restoration Church. With the vision of a Church family where those who were nearly lifeless due to the horrors of the genocide against the Tutsi, would be restored into life givers. Today, Evangelical Restoration Church has over 80 parishes in Rwanda and 10+ in other African Countries.
On my way to Kigali God reminded me of the words he had told me ten years earlier through Ezekiel 37:1-10 and confirmed that the time of great work among his people and nations starting from Rwanda had come. At that time, Rwanda was looking like the valley of dry bones Ezekiel saw in the vision which became a vast army by the power of the Word and the Spirit of the Lord.
God clearly asked us to start a church that would be a Family Church where everyone would find a father, a mother, a sister, and a brother and where dried broken hearts would be restored and equipped. The ultimate vision was to bring restoration in the World where there is spiritual, emotional, and physical death and dryness.

Meddie Kagere (wavutse ku ya 10 Ukwakira 1986) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu Rwanda ukinira Singida Big Stars FC muri Shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Tanzaniya ndetse n’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda nk'imbere.
Kagere yasinyiye ikipe ye ya mbere mu Burayi mu mwaka wa 2014 hamwe na mlewa msasa namba 9 matata, ubwo yinjiraga mu ikipe ya KF Tirana yo muri Alubaniya Superliga, mu masezerano yi myaka ibiri nyuma yo kwemera kwishyura ikipe ye yahoze yitwa Rayon Sports FC ku madorari 10,000 yo gusesa amasezerano ye.
Ku ya 1 Mutarama muri 2015, Kagere yarekuwe na KF Tirana.
Mu gikombe cya SportPesa 2018, ubwo yari umukinnyi wa Gor Mahia FC, yatsinze igitego cya mbere yatsinze Simba SC, aba shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere muri Tanzaniya, maze bamusinyisha nyuma y'ibyumweru bivugwa.
Singida Big Stars FC.
Ku ya 4 Kanama 2022, mu munsi wa Singida Big Stars Day, Kagere yagaragaye mu myitozo ya mbere y'umukino na Zanaco FC yo muri Zambiya, yemeza ibihuha bivuga ko Kagere yavuye muri Simba SC bityo Kagere akaba ari umunnyi mushya, nyuma yuko Singida Big Stars FC yazamuwe muri shampiyona ya Tanzaniya ku nshuro yambere muri 2022/2023 muyi uwo mwaka.

Rutayisire Antoine wavutse 1958, ni Umushumba Mukuru wa paruwasi ya Remera mu itorero ry'Angilikani mu Rwanda, wamenyekanye cyane munyigisho zigiye zitandukanye z'iyobokamana mu Rwanda, Ni umugabo watangiye ivugabutumwa mu 1983 akimara gukizwa, Mu 1990 yaretse akazi ko kuba mwalimu umwanya we awuharira kwigisha ijambo ry'Imana, yahise ajya kuyobora umuryango w'ivugabutumwa rishingiye kuri Bibiliya w'abanyeshuri ba kaminuza, akaba ariwe wabaye umunyamabanga mukuru wawo wa mbere kugeza mu 1994. Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yayoboye umuryango w'ivugabutumwa wa (AEE) mu 2008 ayobora paruwasi ya Biryogo mu itorero ry'Angilikani mu Rwanda, ahava ajya kuyobora paruwasi ya Remera ariyo arimo kugeza ubu.
Niki avuga kunsengero zifunzwe?
Ubwo yari mu kiganiro kuri KT Radio, Pasiteri Rutayisire Antoine yagarutse ku kibazo cy’insengero zimwe zafunzwe, avuga ko hari bamwe mu bakirisito byabagizeho ingaruka zirimo gusubira inyuma mu by’ukwemera no kubura aho bahurira nk’ahantu habafasha kuruhukira no gusenga.
Yakomeje ashimangira ko inshingano nyamukuru y’itorero ari uguhindura ubuzima bw’abantu no kubigisha kubaho neza mu isi, arinda umutekano, indangagaciro nziza n’ubumwe. Yagaragaje kandi ko nubwo atishimiye ko insengero zifungwa, abona ko n’ubwo zitaba zifunguye ibikorwa byo gukomeza ukwemera bishobora gukorwa mu bundi buryo

Mu myemerere gakondo ya Kinyarwanda, abazimu ni ijambo ririmo amagambo abiri (Abazi -Umu) bisobanura imizi yacu twe turi hano. Abazimu ni abantu bo mu muryango runaka babayeho ariko batakiriho, ni ukuvuga bitabye Imana.
Mu madini ya gikirisitu, abazimu ni ijambo rikoreshwa mu gusobanura imyuka mibi igamije inabi ku bazima, iyo basenga birukana abo bazimu. Umuzimu ni ishusho y’umuntu wapfuye, bikekwa ko ashobora kugaruka cyangwa kugaragara mu isi y’abazima. Mu mico n’imigenzo itandukanye ku isi, abantu benshi bemera ko imyuka y’abapfuye ishobora gukomeza kubaho mu bundi buryo butagaragara.
Imyemerere n’Imigenzo
Mu bihugu byinshi no mu mico itandukanye, inkuru z’abazimu zabayeho kuva kera. Bamwe bemera ko umuzimu aba ari umwuka w’umuntu utabonye amahoro, wenda kubera urupfu rutunguranye cyangwa ibibazo yasize adakemuye. Hari n’abemera ko imyuka ishobora kugaruka kurinda cyangwa gutanga ubutumwa ku bantu bakiriho. Gusa abantu bakwiye kumenya ko umuzimu cyangwa abazimu atari inabi mu muryango kubera ko igihe cyose uwapfuye akomeza kwifuriza umuryango we kugira ishya n'ihirwe. Aha twavuga nk'umubyeyi witabye Imana asize abana akomeza kumenya amakuru y'abo yasize yaba mabi cyangwa meza.Mu gihe bigaragaye ko batabayeho neza nkuko yabyifuzaga, uwo mubyeyi agaragara kenshi mu isura yahoranye mu muryango akagira n'ubutumwa atanga. Ikibazo gikomeye ni uko abenshi badakunda gusobanukirwa icyo iyo sura y'umubyeyi isobanura n'igikwiye gukorwa kugirango umubyeyi atuze.
Mu muco nyarwanda, hari imyemerere ivuga ku myuka y’abakurambere, aho bamwe bemeraga ko abakurambere bakomeza kugira uruhare mu buzima bw’abariho. Ariko ibyo biterwa n’umuco n’imyemerere y’abantu ku giti cyabo.
Abazimu mu Buvanganzo n’Imyidagaduro
Abazimu bikoreshwa cyane mu nkuru, filimi n’ibitabo. Akenshi bagaragara nk’ikintu giteye ubwoba mu nkuru z’iterabwoba, ariko hari n’aho bagaragazwa nk’umwuka mwiza urinda abantu cyangwa ubayobora. Ibi bituma inkuru z’abazimu zikundwa cyane mu myidagaduro no mu buvanganzo.
Ibisobanuro bya Siyansi
Nubwo hari abantu benshi bemera ko abazimu babaho, siyansi ntiyemeza ko hari ibimenyetso bifatika byerekana ko imyuka y’abapfuye igaruka ku isi y’abazima. Abahanga benshi basobanura ko ibihe abantu babona cyangwa bumva ibintu bidasanzwe bishobora guterwa n’ubwoba, imitekerereze, inzozi cyangwa ibindi bintu by’imitekerereze.
Guterekera ntabwo ari umuhango nkezamana nk'uko benshi babivuga. Guterekera ni umuhango mbonezamubano uhuza abariho n'abakurambere babo batakiriho ari bo "Abazimu".
Guterekera ni ukwibuka Abakurambere b'Intwari babayeho mu muryango nyarwanda. Ni umurimo uhuza, abariho n'Abakurambere babo batakiriho (Abazima n'Abazimu) mu rwego rwo kubibuka. Mu guterekera, hibukwaga Intwari z'Abakurambere gusa, nta bigwari byibukwaga.
Guterekera, ni umurimo wakorwaga kenshi, nk'uko abakirisitu basenga kenshi. Nta muntu washoboraga kumara iminsi myinshi cyangwa ukwezi, adaterekereye.
Amateka y'ijambo Guterekera.
Dukurikije ibikorwa n'imiterere y'umuhango wo guterekera mu mateka y'u Rwanda, usanga ari ijambo ry'impine ryunze amagambo abiri ari yo "Guteka" no "Guterekera". Mu Ikeshamvugo rya Kinyarwanda, guteka bivuze kwicara k'umwami cyangwa undi munyacyubahiro, na ho guterekera bikavuga gushyikiriza imbaga y'abantu bateranye bahuje n'umugambi umwe, ibiribwa n'ibinyobwa ngo basangire.
Impamvu yo Guterekera Abazimu.
Guterekera Abazimu byakorwaga mu buryo bwo kwibuka no kuzirikana intwari z'Abakurambere zo mu muryango uyu n'uyu, byose bigamije guha agaciro Abakurambere bubatse ishyanga iri n'iri no kuzirikana umurage basize mu iyubakagihugu cyabo.
Uburyo bwo Guterekera Abazimu muri iki gihe.
Guterekera bikorwa mu buryo bwo kwita umwana izina ry'umukurambere w'igihangange wabayeho mu muryango uyu n'uyu. Noneho uko bamuhamagara iryo zina, bakaba banibuka uwo mukurambere w'Intwari bakomokaho, bitiriye uwo mwana. Ari nayo mpamvu mu muco w'Abanyarwanda, usanga baziririza kwita izina ridafite ibigwi, kugira ngo umwana baryita ritazamwokama.
Guterekera kandi, bikorwa mu buryo bwo gushyiraho umunsi ngaruka mwaka wo kwibuka nyakwigendera cyangwa izindi ntwari z'igihugu, hagakorwa imigenzo runaka yo kubibuka, abantu bagasangira ari na ko bavuga amateka yabaranze.

Manzi Thierry w’imyaka 24 y’amavuko, yari Kapiteni w’ikipe y’ingabo z’igihugu APR FC, akaba yarakiniye amakipe atandukanye hano mu Rwanda harimo Marrine, Rayon Sports Fc na APR FC, ku mugabane w'Africa ndetse no ku mugabane w'iburayi yakinnye mu ikipe y'igihugu cya Georigiya mu ikipe nshya ya Fc Dila Gori agiye gukinira mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri iri imbere, AS FAR yo muri Marroc.

Ni imwe mu mihango mikuru ya Kinyarwanda yahozeho na mbere mu Rwanda umu.bigizwe n'ibintu bibiri nyamukuru aribyo gusaba cyangwa gushimira.
Bikorwa mu mihango, igizwe n'imigenzo itandukanye nko kwiyeza mbere yo guterekera, gutamba igitambo (igitambo kikaba kiba ari icyo gusaba cyangwa gushima), gusangira icyo gitambo nyuma yo gucyura ubuhoro (gucyura ubuhoro ni igihe igitambo kimaze gushya), no kugisangizaho abakurambere bashyira mu muriro uduce tw'ibiribwa n'ibinyobwa birimo gusangirwa.
Nta munsi wihariye wagenwe wo kubandwa cyangwa guterekera, umuntu abikora kubera impamvu n'igihe abyifuje.
ikindi kandi umuco nyarwanda wari ufitanye isano yahafi n'imyemerere gakondo y'abanyarwanda ba kera, aho bemeraga ko nubwo Imana ariyo isumba byose, abakurambere imandwa(imandwa) n'abazimu bafite ubushobozi bwo guhuza abaziri n'Iyaremye.
Muri iyi myemerere, imihango yo GUTEREKERA no KUBANDWA yari inkingi zamwamba mumibereho yabo.
Guterekera byari umuco woguhuza abaziri n'abapfuye, wari umuhango wo kwibuka no guha icyubahiro abakurambere bapfuye(abazimu).
abanyarwanda bemeragako abazimu bashobora kurinda umuryango cyangwa bakawuteza ibyago cyangwa amakuba iyo birengagijwe.
muri uyumuhango hakoreshwaga ibikoresho byihariye birimo: Inzoga (urwagwa) yakoreshwaga mugusuka kubutaka (kumena incunda), amata yakoreshwaga cyane cyane kubazimu b'abana cyangwa abantu b'abanyacyubahiro.
Inzuy'abazimu (ikiraro) akazu gato k'ibyatsi kabaga karimu mu mbuga cyangwa mu rugo rwagati, aho bakiriraga ibyo bahaye abazimu.
Uburyo uyu muhango wakorwaga wo kubandwa.
umuhango watangiraga mugitondo umukuru w'umuryango (cyangwa umupfumu wabugenewe) yafataga urwagwa cyangwa amata, akavuga amazina y'abakurambere be, abasaba ko barinda urugo, abana n'amatungo. yavuagaga amagambo akurikira "Twaguterekeye uyumunsi, turinde amakuba, uturengere." Hanyuma agasuka inzoga k'ubutaka cyangwa akayishyira mukazu k'abazumu.
Kubandwa (Kwinjira mu muryango wa Ryangombe).
kubandwa byari igikorwa gikomeye cyane cyo gusenga Imana binyuze kuri Ryangombe umutware w'imandwa. Uwabandwaga yabaga abaye Imandwa, akakirwa mu muryango wabatoranyijwe.
Ababaga bemerewe no kwitabira kubandwa.
Uno muhango wo kubandwa ntago wari uwabose muburyo bwo kuwuyobora, ariko buri muryango wagombaga kugira abawurimo.
Imandwa 'abanyiginya barabantu banyuze mumuhango bamaze kwizera, abatware b'umuhango bari abantu Umuvunyi,Ineza na Binego
babaga ari imandwa zingenzi), abakobwa n'abagore bari bemerewe kubandwa, uretse imihango imwe n'imwe yabaga ifite amabwiriza yihariye.
Ibikoresho byakoreshwaga n'amashusho.
ibikoresho byakoreshwa muri uyumuhango wokubandwa ndetse no guterekera nibi bikurikira:
Inyabuta yari intebe y'ibiti bitatu yabaga ihagarariye ubumwe
Inkoni y'umuringa yashushanyaga ubushobozi n'ubutware.
Imyambaro(inshabure) yarikozwe mu mpu z'inyamanswa cyangwa ibyatsi.
Ibishushanyo ababandwaga biyandikagaho n'ifu yingwa y'umwura mu maso no ku mubiri bashushanya ubumwe n'isi y'umwuka.
Uburyo umuhango wagendaga kuva utangiye kugeza urangiye.
Uyumuhango wabaga muremure harigihe wamaraga iminsi myinshi ariko dore zimwe muntambwe z'ingenzi:
Kwicara kuntebe uwenda kubandwa yajyaga imbere y'imandwa nkuru.
Kugera kurukiryi ahaniho imihango nyir'izina yabaga irikubera.
Guhabwa izina rishya uwabandwaga yahgabwaga izina ry'imandwa ryamufashaga kwinjira mubumwe n'abakurambere.
Gusoza umuhango wasozwaga n'ibirorori bikomeye aho umuryango wose wishimaga ko babonye umuryango mushya murwego rw'imandwa.
Akamaro kiyimihango ubusanzwe ntiwari umuco wo kuraguza gusa ahubwo wari uburyo bwo gukomeza ubumwe bw'umuryango, kwigisha ubutwari binyuze mumateka yaryangombe na Binego, no kugera indangagaciro z'umuco nyarwanda.

Kuraguza ni umwe mu mihango mikuru mu Rwanda umu ndetse no muri Benimana bose mu Rwanda umu no mu Rwanda rw'iyo.
Kirazira kikaziririzwa, mu Kinyarwanda ntawe ujya kugira icyo akora gikomeye mu buzima atabanje kubaza (Kuraguza/ Gupfumuza) ngo amenye niba Imana yera cyangwa yirabura.
Iyo Imana yera biba bigaragaza ko ibyo yaragurizaga bizamubera byiza cyangwa se bizamuhira naho iyo Imana yirabura, icyo gihe uraguza azibukira ibyo yaragurizaga kuko bitazamuhira cyangwa se agahabwa intsinzi yo kumutsindira ako kabi k'ubwire n'ubwitabire mu nzira ze.
Umuhango wo kuraguza wabagaho na mbere yo gushaka umugeni mu Kinyarwanda ntawe ujya gushaka mu muryango atabanje kuraguriza ngo awereze ndetse n'umugeni ubwe azashaka niba atari uw'umugongo mubi cyangwa intubya mu maguru kuko uwo yazatera ubukenya n'ubugingo buke mu muryango ashatsemo ndetse agatubya abantu n'ibintu.
Mu kuraguriza urushako kandi baragurizaga n'umuranga kimwe n'umushyingira ndetse n'ahazubakwa igisharagati bagaherako bahamura imitsindo itsirika itsinda abanzi, abagome n'abagambanyi ndetse n'abarozi ngo batazarogera abageni mu gisharagati bakavaho babazinga urubyaro cyagwa n'ubugiri n'ubugwiza bakabateza inyatsi cyangwa no kubazinga ubushake ejo bakazarara ntacyo babashije kwimarira cyo kubaka urugo.
Umuhango wo kuraguza wahoze mu Rwanda kandi ari uwa agaciro kanini cyane ko n'abakuru bavugaga bati "Intabaza irira ku muziro, ukura utabaza ugasaza utamenye, kandi Umwami uraguza yatsinze ubuguza."

Ni icyamamare mu muziki gakondo nyarwanda by'umwihariko mu gucuranga inanga. Ni umucuranzi w'inanga urimo kuzamuka akaba ageze ku rwego rushimishije rutanga ikizere cya ejo hazaza muri ubu buhanzi bwa gakondo. Zimwe mu nanga ze harimo Ngwino, Urare, Ndi amahoro, Bizashira n'izindi.

Rutangarwamaboko ni umuvuzi gakondo, Umupfumu akaba n'Imandwa nkuru y'u Rwanda. ubusanzwe ni umushakashatsi, umwigisha w'ubuzima bushingiye ku muco akaba n'inzobere mu by'umuco, amateka, imbonezabitekerezo (filosofiya) n'ubuzima bwa muntu bushingiye ku myizerere, imyumvire, imitekerereze, imyitwarire ndetse n'imigirire.
Rutangarwamaboko avuka mu Bibungo bya Mukinga, i Nyamurasa, mu karere ka Kamonyi mu ntara y'Amajyepfo. Akaba avuka kuri se Munyabarame.
Ubu atuye mu murenge wa Gisozi ho mu karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali.
Akaba afite impamyabumenyi ebyiri za kaminuza ku rwego rw'ikirenga mu buvuzi bw'indwara zo mu mutwe, n'ibigendanye n'umuco, ubukerarugendo n'amateka.

Sekuruza we witwaga Rutangarwamaboko yari umugangahuzi, umuganga akaba n'umupfumu akaba n'umukuru w'Imandwa mu Nduga hose, niho nawe yabikuye nk'umurage mu buryo umubyeyi agenda abiraga abazakurikiraho, akaba ari naho izina Rutangarwamaboko rituruka. Sekuruza yamusigiye n'imiringa yambara ku maboko yise "Imiringa y'imirinda" imurinda ibintu byakototera umuntu by'amandu n'amarozi ndetse ikaba n'umurimbo.

VVOB education development ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu, washinzwe mu mwaka 1982. Washinzwe na guverinoma ya Flemande n'Ububiligi batanga umusanzu mu ireme ry'uburezi mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere.
Uburezi bufite ireme ni umusingi witerambere. VVOB igira uruhare mu isi iringaniye aho guverinoma zifite ubushobozi bwo kubaha, kurinda no kubahiriza uburenganzira bwo kwiga bufite ireme kuri buri munyeshuri, nta vangura iryo ari ryo ryose.
Intandaro ya VVOB ni ubufasha bwa tekiniki mu mishinga na gahunda bikorwa mu bufatanye mu bihugu byo muri Afurika, Aziya na Amerika y'Epfo. Ibyo babikora babifashijwemo na guverinoma y'Ububiligi na Flemande, n'abandi baterankunga benshi.
Ibiro bikuru bya VVOB biherereye i Buruseli mu Bubiligi. Mu mwaka 2020 VVOB ikora muri Kamboje, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ecuador, u Rwanda, Afurika y'Epfo, Suriname, Uganda, Vietnam, Zambiya n'Ububiligi.

VSO mu (Voluntary Service Overseas) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu, umuryango utegamiye kuri leta uteza imbere uburezi ufite icyerekezo cya "isi iboneye kuri buri wese" ninshingano yo "guteza impinduka zirambye binyuze mubushake". VSO itanga ingaruka ziterambere binyuze muburyo bwubwitange buvanze bugizwe nabakorerabushake mpuzamahanga, abenegihugu, nabaturage bakorera hamwe kugirango batezimbere sisitemu nibisabwa kugirango imibereho ihinduke neza Muri 2018–19, VSO yakoraga mu bihugu 23 byo muri Afurika no muri Aziya
VSO kuri ubu ikora mubice byingenzi byibanze:
Kandi binyuze muburyo butatu bwibanze bujyanye nibice byose:
Byongeye kandi, VSO ifite icyerekezo cyurubyiruko aho urubyiruko ari rwo rwungukirwa n’ibisubizo by’imihindagurikire y’imibereho kimwe n’abagize uruhare runini mu guteza impinduka.
VSO yashinzwe mu 1958 na Alec na Mora Dickson binyuze mu ibaruwa ya musenyeri yandikiye urupapuro rwa Londres Ikinyamakuru cya, nkuburambe bwo kwiga mumahanga kubarangije amashuri, ubanza abagabo gusa, mbere yo gutangira kaminuza. Abakorerabushake batanze ubufasha budafite ubuhanga mu gusubiza amacumbi y'ibanze n'amafaranga yo mu mufuka. Mu 1962, imyitozo yarahindutse ikoresha abakorerabushake barangije kaminuza Kugeza mu 1980, abakorerabushake badafite ubuhanga bari barangije burundu kandi igihe cya serivisi cyariyongereye kugeza ku myaka ibiri. Umubare w'abakorerabushake bakoraga ubanza waragabanutse ugera kuri 750, ariko mu 2003 wari waragarutse ugera ku 1.400. Kuva mu Kuboza 2004, gusaba abakorerabushake byemewe kuva ku myaka iri hagati ya 20 na 75, nabo bagomba kuba bafite uburambe nibura bwimyaka ibiri mubyo bakora.

Kwigisha n'ubushakashatsi.
Ibigo bya AIMS byigisha imibare y'ibanze kandi ikoreshwa, ikubiyemo ibintu byinshi bikoreshwa mu mibare muri fiziki (harimo na astrofizike na cosmologiya), ibinyabuzima byuzuye, bioinformatics, computing siyanse, imari, kwerekana ubuhinzi n'ibindi. Ko muri Senegali itanga amasomo haba mu gifaransa no mu icyongerezaUsibye gahunda zayo zamasomo, AIMS Afrika yepfo ifite ikigo cyubushakashatsi mubice bitandukanye nka cosmology, computing and finanse (reba hano hepfo). Muri 2015, AIMS Kameruni yateganyaga gutangiza ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cyakira abashyitsi ndetse no gusura abashakashatsi bo muri kaminuza zo muri Kameruni ndetse no hanze yayo.
Ibigo bya AIMS bitanga serivisi zabaturage. AIMS Senegal yashyizeho uburyo bushya bwo kwigisha bw’abarimu bigisha imibare yisumbuye kandi ifatanya n’ubucuruzi bw’ibanze gukusanya inkunga yo gushyiraho amarushanwa y’igihugu ku bijyanye na porogaramu za mudasobwa no kwerekana imibare, hibandwa ku gushakira ibisubizo bishingiye ku iterambere. Hakizimana Muhadjiri uvukana na kapiteni w’Amavubi, Haruna Niyonzima, yatowe nk’umukinnyi mwiza w’umwaka w’imikino wa 2017/18 mu Rwanda, Nyuma yo kuzamurwa n’umutoza Mungo Jitiada wiyita Vigoureux, kandi yakiniye ikipe ya Etincelles na Emirates Football Club yakiniraga muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu kuva muri Nyakanga 2019.

Mukura Victory Sports cyangwa se Mukura ni Ikipe yumupira w'amaguru yababigize umwuga ikaba ibarizwa mu karere ka Huye mu intara y’Amajyepfo, aho yambara imyenda yiganjemo amabara y'umuhondo n'umukara.
Mukura Victory Sports et Loisirs Football Club, ibarizwa mu ntara y'amajyepfo akarere ka Huye, yashinzwe mumwaka w' 1963 mukwezi kwa Gicurasi, kuri ubu ni ikipe ibarizwa muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere mumupira w'amaguru. Iyi kipe kandi yakirira imikino yayo kuri sitade mpuzamahanga y'akarere ka Huye. ni sitade ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu basaga gato ibihumbi icumi.Guhera mumwaka wa 2021 Jean Damascene MANIRAGUHA niwe muyobozi w'ikipe ya Mukura.

Kaminuza ya Cambridge ni i. Cambridge yatangijwe mu mu mwaka 1209 ihabwa amasezerano ya na mu 1231, Cambridge ni ku isi. Iyi ya kuze mu ishyirahamwe ry’intiti zakomotse muri kaminuza ya Oxford zikurikira umwanditsi wa "suspenidum" (kumanika intiti) mu matiku n’abaturage bo muri ibyo bice. zisangiye ibintu byinshi kandi bakunze kwita "".
Nk’uko ikinyamakuru, Cambridge iri ku mwanya wa kaminuza zizwi cyane ku isi kandi kuri ubu yicaye nka kaminuza ya kabiri nziza ku isi no mu Burayi. Nk’uko iyi kaminuza ibitangaza, Cambridge yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi bya kurusha ibindi bigo byose, hamwe n’abahawe igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel 121. muri kaminuza ndetse n’abarimu barimo kandi bafite imidari 11 ya, 7, 47 na 14. Muri 2016, Abanyeshuri ba kaminuza bari batsindiye.
Mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 12, agace ka Cambridge kari kamaze kugira izina ry'ubumenyi na kiliziya, kubera abihayimana bo mu itorero ry'abepiskopi rya ryegereye. Icyakora, byari byabereye muri bishoboka cyane ko ari byo byatumye hashyirwaho iyi kaminuza: intiti eshatu za Oxford zamanitswe n’ubuyobozi bw’umujyi kubera urupfu rw’umugore, batabajije abayobozi ba kiliziya, ubusanzwe bari gufata umwanya wa mbere (kandi ubabarire intiti) mu bihe nk'ibi, ariko icyo gihe zari zishyamiranye. Kubera gutinya ihohoterwa ryinshi ry’abaturage bo mu mijyi, intiti zo muri kaminuza ya Oxford zatangiye kwimukira mu mijyi nka Paris, na. Nyuma yaho, intiti zihagije zagumye i Cambridge kugira ngo zibe urufatiro rwa kaminuza nshya igihe zari zimaze kuba umutekano uhagije kugira ngo amasomo asubire muri Oxford.
Kugirango dusabe icyambere, birasanzwe ko Cambridge ikurikirana ishingwa ryayo mu masezerano 1231 yatanzwe na kuyiha uburenganzira bwo guhana abanyamuryango bayo ("ius non-trahi extra") no gusonerwa imisoro imwe n'imwe; Oxford ntabwo yahawe uburenganzira nk'ubwo kugeza mu 1248.
mu 1233 cya cyahaye abarangije muri Cambridge uburenganzira bwo kwigisha "ahantu hose mu ". Nyuma yuko Cambridge avuzwe ko ari rusange muri "" mu ibaruwa yanditswe na mu 1290, akemeza ko ari ya mu 1318, byabaye ibisanzwe ko abashakashatsi bo mu yandi yo mu Burayi basura Cambridge kwiga cyangwa gutanga amasomo yo kwigisha.

Kaminuza ya Michigan (UM, UMich, cyangwa Michigan) ni muri. Yashinzwe mu 1817 nigikorwa cyakarere ka kera ka, nka "", cyangwa "kaminuza ya Michigania", imyaka 20 mbere yuko iba leta, iyi kaminuza niyo ya kera cyane ya.Ikigo cyimuriwe muri Ann Arbor mu 1837 40 acres (16 ha). Iyi kaminuza iyobowe n’inama leta kuva mu 1850, igihe ryatangizwaga ku mugaragaro.
Iyi kaminuza igizwe na kaminuza cumi n'icyenda kandi itanga porogaramu, icyiciro cya kabiri cya ndetse cya kabiri cya kaminuza. Michigan ifite amashuri icyenda yabigize umwuga:, Ishuri,,. Ifatanya na ziherereye muri na (buri kaminuza yemerewe gutandukana) kandi ikora ikigo giherereye i. Michigan ibarizwamo n’umuryango gihugu, ndetse.
Michigan yabaye ikigo kuva 1871. Iyi kaminuza yiyandikisha ni abanyeshuri bagera ku 32,000 barangije ndetse n’abanyeshuri 16,000 barangije. Kwinjira muri kaminuza byashyizwe mu byiciro "byatoranijwe cyane." Hafi ya kimwe cya kabiri cy'abanyeshuri baturuka muri leta. Abanyeshuri mpuzamahanga baturutse mu bihugu bigera ku 130 bangana na 15 ku ijana by'abanyeshuri bose.

Kwizigira Jean Claude Umunyamakuru w’imikino mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Itangazamakuru (RBA).
Ibyo Wamenya kuri Kwizigira.
Kwizigira numunyamakuru wu munyarwanda Kandi numwe mubanyamakuru b’imikino bakunzwe mu Rwanda, akaba akorera ikigo cyitangaza makuru mu Rwanda(RBA) yasezeranye na Umubyeyi Clarisse tariki 12 Nyakanga mu Murenge wa Kimihurura, bari bashagawe n’inshuti n’abavandimwe ubukwe bwabo bwari tariki 21 Nyakanga mu mwaka 2018.Kwizigira yavuze ko imyaka 15 ari myinshi ku bantu bakundana baba baragiye banyura muri byinshi birimo no gushwana rimwe na rimwe ariko ikintu gikomeye cyatumye yumva ko ubuzima bwe agomba kubumarana na Umubyeyi ari imyitwarire ye, uburyo yihangana, amukunda kandi akanamubera umujyanama uruta abandi. Kwizigira Jean Claude usanzwe ari umunyamakuru w’imikino akaba n’umusesenguzi kuri RBA bakunzwe cyane mugihugu cy'u Rwanda.

Hagenimana Benjamin ni Umunyamakuru w'Imikino akaba Umusesenguzi mu Rwanda kuri radio B&amp;B FM Umwezi
Urugendo Mwitangazamakuru.
Benjamin Gicumbi ni umunyamakuru wakoze kuri Radio 10 mu biganiro by’imikino no kogeza imipira y’i Burayi, mbere gato y’uko agera kuri Radio 10 yabanje gukora kuri Radio Ishingiro ikorera mu mujyi wa Gicumbi ari naho yakuye izina Gicumbi unungubu akaba abarizwa kuri B&amp;B FM. Uyu mugabo wamenyekanye cyane guhera mu mwaka wa 2016 ubwo yari avuye i Gicumbi agiye gukora kuri Radio 10, akundirwa bikomeye uko yogeza imikino y’i Burayi n’uburyo ageza amakuru y’imikino ku bakurikira ikiganiro yumvikanamo.
Hagenimana yavukiye mu karere ka Nyamasheke mu ntara y’Iburengerazuba mu mwaka 1989, aba ari naho akurira. Amashuri abanza yayize ahitwa Rwabidege, aza kwiga icyiciro rusange cy’amashuri yisumbuye muri College Intwari de Mwezi hafi y’iwabo. Arangije icyiciro rusange cy’amashuri yisumbuye nibwo yagiye mu karere ka Rusizi, aho yari agiye kwiga ahitwa mu Gishoma, biba ubwa mbere yagiye mu modoka ndetse ananyura mu mujyi wa Kamembe. Nk’umwana w’imfura mu muryango wakuze adafite Se agasigarana na nyina na barumuna be batatu, yafashe icyemezo cyo kujya gushakisha ubuzima mu mujyi wa Kigali, yawugezemo muri 2010 acumbikirwa na mubyara we wari warahamutanze. Hagenimana avuga ko kuva yagera i Kigali yari umuntu ukunda umupira w’amaguru, ku buryo amafaranga make yakoreraga icyo gihe yayifashishaga ajya kureba imipira yaba iyo mu Rwanda ndetse no hanze. Kenshi iyo yabaga areba umupira yanabaga ari mu mpaka zikomeye, anabikundirwa bikomeye n’abo barebanaga umupira cyane cyane wo hanze. Byo kuganira ku mupira mu tubari byatumye hari umuntu (yagize ibanga) wamubonyemo impano, amufasha kujya kuri Radio. Hagenimana atangira itangazamakuru yahereye kuri “Radio Amazing Grace”, nuko uwari umuyede yinjira mu itangazamakuru mu mwaka 2012. Mu mwaka 2013 nibwo Hagenimana yagiye kuri radiyo Radio Ishingiro y’Igicumbi, iki gihe yari agikorera no kuri Amazing Grace. Igikombe cy’Isi cya 2014 yacyogeje ari umwe cyose arakirangiza, iki gihe nibwo izina rye ryatangiye gukomera mu matwi y’abakunzi be. Icyo gihe Radio Rwanda yari ifite Rutamu, Flash ifite Rugangura na Rugimbana, Radio10 ifite ba Fuadi, Castar, Bayingana na Jean Luc ariko byampaye imbaraga zo gukora cyane kugira ngo mbashe kwigarurira abakunzi b’imikino b’i Gicumbi.” Muri 2016 nibwo Radio 10 yaje gushima uyu musore bahita bamurambagiza, bamujyana gufatanya na Fuadi Uwihanganye mu kiganiro cy’imikino cyitwa “10 Zone” ndetse no kogeza imipira itandukanye. Fuadi ni we wamuhamagaye ambwira ko hari umuntu uri bumuhamagare ngo baganire, nyuma y’akanya Castar na we yaramuhamagaye amubwira ko amushaka, yaje kujya kumureba baremeranya atangira akazi gutyo. Mu mwaka 2019 amaze imyaka ibiri kuri Radio10, uyu wari umusore yaje kubona imwe mu nkumi zari zije mu mirimo kuri iki gitangazamakuru, Umuhoza Delphine, bemeranya kubana, bararushinga. Hagenimana Benjamin yagize ati “Nyuma y’imyaka ine ndashimira Radio/TV10, mwampaye amahirwe yo gukoresha impano yanjye no kugaragara kurushaho. Mu minsi mike iri imbere turahurira mu kindi gitangazamakuru cy’imikino nikokijya kuri B&amp;B FM.”

Kaminuza ya Oxford ni muri, mu Bwongereza. Hariho ibimenyetso byerekana ko bigisha kuva mu 1096, ikaba kaminuza ya kera cyane ku na. Yakuze vuba kuva 1167 igihe yabuzaga abanyeshuri b'icyongereza kujya muri. Nyuma y’amakimbirane hagati y’abanyeshuri n’umujyi wa Oxford mu 1209, abize bamwe bahungiye mu majyaruguru y’iburasirazuba berekeza muri aho bashinze icyahindutse. zisangiye ibintu byinshi zisanzwe kandi zitwa "". Oxford iri muri kaminuza zizwi cyane ku isi.
Iyi kaminuza igizwe na kaminuza, ibyumba bitandatu, hamwe n’amashami atandukanye y’amasomo ateguwe mu bine. Amashuri makuru yose ni ibigo byigenga muri kaminuza, buriwese ugenzura abanyamuryango bayo hamwe nimiterere yimbere nibikorwa. Abanyeshuri bose ni abanyamuryango ba kaminuza. Ntabwo ifite ikigo gikuru, kandi inyubako n'ibikoresho byanyanyagiye mu mujyi rwagati. muri Oxford agizwe ninyigisho, -matsinda mato muri za kaminuza na salle, amahugurwa, akazi ka laboratoire ndetse rimwe na rimwe andi masomo yatanzwe n'amashami n'amashami ya kaminuza nkuru. gitangwa ahanini hagati.
Oxford ikora ya kera cyane ku isi, hamwe ku isi hamwe na sisitemu nini y’ibitabo by’amasomo mu gihugu hose. Mu mwaka w'ingengo y'imari urangira ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2019, kaminuza yinjije amafaranga angana na 45 2.45miliyari, muri zo 624.8miliyoni yavuye mu nkunga y'ubushakashatsi n'amasezerano.
Oxford yigishije abanyeshuri benshi bazwi cyane, barimo ndetse n’abakuru b’ibihugu na guverinoma benshi ku isi. Kugeza mu Kwakira 2020, abatsindiye igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel 72, Abamidari 4 ba Fields, hamwe n’abatsindiye ibihembo 6 bya Turing Award barize, barakora, cyangwa bakoze ubusabane bwo gusura muri kaminuza ya Oxford, mu gihe abayirangije batsindiye imidari 160. Oxford ni inzu ya bourse nyinshi, harimo na, imwe muri gahunda za kera za bourse mpuzamahanga.
Itariki yo gushinga kaminuza ya Oxford ntiramenyekana. Birazwi ko kwigisha muri Oxford byabayeho muburyo bumwe nko mu 1096, ariko ntibisobanutse igihe kaminuza yatangiriye. Intiti yigishije Oxford mu ntangiriro ya 1100s.
Yakuze vuba kuva 1167 igihe abanyeshuri b'icyongereza bagarukaga muri. Umuhanga mu by'amateka yigishije intiti nk'izo mu 1188, maze intiti ya mbere izwi cyane mu mahanga, igera mu 1190. Umuyobozi wa kaminuza yari afite izina rya kuva byibura 1201, kandi ba shebuja bamenyekanye nka "Universitas" cyangwa isosiyete mu 1231. Iyi kaminuza yahawe amasezerano ya cyami mu 1248 ku ngoma y'Umwami.
Nyuma y’amakimbirane hagati y’abanyeshuri n’umujyi wa Oxford mu 1209, abize bamwe bahunze urugomo bajya i, nyuma bashinga kaminuza ya Cambridge.

Agakingirizo ni igikoresho kigabanya amahirwe yo kwanduzanya indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ndetse no gusama inda zitateganijwe. Habaho agakingirizo k'abagabo n'aka abagore. Hamwe n'imikoreshereze ikwiye - kandi gakoreshwa mubikorwa byose by'imibonano mpuzabitsina -.Abagore nabo bashakanye bakoresha agakingirizo k'abagabo bashobora kugira amahirwe ya 2% yo gusama. Hamwe n'imikoreshereze isanzwe, igipimo cyo gutwita kingana na 18% ku mwaka. Imikoreshereze yako igabanya cyane ibyago byo kurwara gonorrhea, chlamydia, trichomoniasis, hepatite B, na VIH / SIDA. Zirinda kandi ku rugero ruto kwirinda indwara ya herpes, papillomavirus ku muntu (HPV), ndetse na sifilis.
Agakingirizo k'umugabo kaba kazungurutse ku gitsina gihagaze mbere yo gukora imibonano kandi kigakora mu gukora inzitizi y'umubiri ibuza amasohoro kwinjira mu mubiri w'uwo muhuje igitsina. Udukingirizo twabagabo dukorwa muri latex, kandi mubisanzwe, kuva polyurethane, polyisoprene, cyangwa amara y'intama. Udukingirizo tw'abagabo dufite ibyiza byo koroshya imikoreshereze, byoroshye kubigeraho n'ingaruka nke. Abafite allergie ya latex igomba gukoreshwa polyurethane cyangwa izindi verisiyo yubukorikori. Agakingirizo k'abagore gakozwe muri polyurethane kandi karashobora gukoreshwa inshuro nyinshi.
Udukingirizo nk'uburyo bwo gukumira indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina zakoreshejwe kuva byibura 1544. Agakingirizo ka reberi kabonetse mu 1855, gakurikirwa n'udukingirizo twa latex muri 1920. Ari kurutonde rw' rw'ishami ry'umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku buzima ku isi, urutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi. Igiciro cyinshi mu gihugu cy'iterambere kiri hafi 0.03 kugeza US $ 0.08 buri umwe. Muri Leta zunzubumwe z'Amerika,ubusanzwe agakingirizo kagura amadolari y'Amerika 1.00. Kw'isi yose munsi ya 10% y'abakoresha kuringaniza imbyaro bakoresha agakingirizo. Ibiciro byo gukoresha agakingirizo biri hejuru mu bihugu byateye imbere. Mu Bwongereza agakingirizo ni uburyo bwa kabiri bukunze kugaragara mu kuboneza urubyaro (22%) mu gihe muri Amerika ari ubwa gatatu bukunze kugaragara (15%). Paracetamol, izwi kandi nka acetaminophen, ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane mu kugabanya ububabare n'umuriro. Ufatwa mu kanwa, mu kibuno cyangwa mu rushinge mu mutsi.
Wakozwe bwa mbere mu 1877, kandi uri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Paracetamol, izwi kandi nka acetaminofeni, ni imiti ikoreshwa mu kuvura ububabare n'umuriro. Ubusanzwe ikoreshwa muburyo bworoshye bwo kugabanya ububabare. Ibimenyetso bivanze kubikoresha kugirango bigabanye umuriro mubana. Bikunze kugurishwa bifatanije nindi miti, nko mumiti myinshi ikonje. Paracetamol ikoreshwa kandi mububabare bukabije, nk'ububabare bwa kanseri n'ububabare nyuma yo kubagwa, bufatanije n'imiti y'ububabare bwa opioid. Ubusanzwe ikoreshwa haba kumunwa cyangwa kugororoka, ariko iraboneka no guterwa mumitsi. Ingaruka zimara hagati yamasaha abiri nane.
Ingaruka mbi n'uko ikora.
Paracetamol muri rusange ifite umutekano mugihe gikenewe. Icyifuzo ntarengwa cya buri munsi kumuntu mukuru ni garama eshatu kugeza enye. Umubare munini urashobora gutera uburozi, harimo no kunanirwa kwumwijima. Ni gake cyane ibisebe byuruhu bishobora kubaho. Bigaragara ko bifite umutekano mugihe cyo gutwita no konsa. Ku bafite uburwayi bwumwijima, irashobora gukoreshwa, ariko mukigero cyo hasi. Byashyizwe mubikorwa byo gusesengura byoroheje. Ntabwo ifite ibikorwa byingenzi byo kurwanya inflammatory. Uburyo ikora ntabwo isobanutse neza.
Paracetamol yakozwe bwa mbere mu 1877. Niwo muti ukoreshwa cyane mu kubabara no kugira umuriro muri Amerika ndetse n'Uburayi. Ari kurutonde rwumuryango wubuzima ku isi urutonde rwimiti yingenzi. Paracetamol iraboneka nkumuti rusange, hamwe namazina yikirango arimo Tylenol na Panadol nibindi. Igiciro cyinshi mugihugu kiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri munsi ya kuri dose. Muri Amerika, igura kuri dose. Muri 2017, yari imiti ya 25 ikunze gutangwa muri Amerika, hamwe na miliyoni zirenga 24 zandikiwe.

Amahirwe yo kwandura indwara binyuze mubikorwa byimibonano mpuzabitsina aratandukanye cyane na patologi yandi kandi biterwa nubusambanyi. Imikorere imwe n'imwe itarimo guhuza igitsina cyangwa umunwa (urugero, kwikinisha, gutunga urutoki cyangwa gukubita), hamwe no gukoresha agakingirizo, ingomero z'amenyo cyangwa gants, bigabanya ibyago byo kwandura. Iyi myitozo ivugwa nkimibonano mpuzabitsina itekanye.
Bitewe n'indwara ireba, inzobere mu buzima ziragira inama imibonano mpuzabitsina ikingiwe n'udukingirizo mu gihe cyo kuryamana n'abantu bashobora kwandura. Agakingirizo kagaragaza ko ari ingirakamaro cyane mu gukumira kwanduza indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina no mu gitsina ndetse n'amasohoro, ariko ntizirinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina zigaragara ku ruhu rw'igitsina. Agakingirizo rero gakoreshwa neza mugihe cyimibonano mpuzabitsina no kwinjira, niyo yonyine yo kuboneza urubyaro irinda kwandura virusi itera sida na hepatite B. Icyakora, ntabwo irinda neza izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina itera abantu benshi bapfa, nka sifilis cyangwa papillomavirus ya muntu, ishinzwe ubwoko butandukanye bwa kanseri harimo na kanseri y'inkondo y'umura kandi ikingira gusa. Hanyuma, ntirinda kandi imyanya ndangagitsina ishinzwe ingaruka zikomeye zo mumitekerereze n’imibereho y’umuntu wanduye kandi kwanduza akayoya mu gihe cyo kubyara, bita neonatal herpes, bitera impfu zikomeye hamwe n’urukurikirane rukomeye.

Umwihariko w' ibitaro bya Muhima.
Ibitaro bya Muhima nkuko twabivuze haruguru biherereye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, ni ibitaro bifite umwihariko wo kwita ku bagore batwite n'abana ariko bitanga n'izindi serivisi z'ingenzi mu buvuzi ku bivuza bataha.
Serivisi zitangwa n'Ibitaro bya Muhima:

Ibitaro bya Masaka ni ibitaro bizwiho kwakira abarwayi bagiye batandukanye kandi barwaye indwara zitandukanye. Ibiibitaro biherereye mu Rwanda mu kagari ka Gako mu Murenge wa Masaka mu Karere ka Kicukiro.

Mu Rwanda ibipimo by' imikurire y' abana bato bigaragaza ko hari impinduka ikomeye yabaye mu mikurire hashingiwe k' ubushakashatsi bwakozwe k' ubuzima n' imibereho by' abaturage mu mwaka 2020.
Ibipimo by' imikurire y' abana bato.
Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda 13% y' abana bavuka bafite ibiro bike biri munsi ya 2.5, 33% by' abana bari munsi y' imyaka itanu bafite ikibazo cyo kugwingira, 93% by' abana bari hagati y' amezi 6 na 23 nibo bahabwa inkingo zose zagenwe.

URwanda rwafashe ingamba zinyuranye mu kurwanya no kurandura igwingira mu bana bato, gahunda z' amarerero y' abana bato,gahunda mbonezamikurire y' abana bato na gutanga inyongeramirire.

Pasiteri Ezra Mpyisi ni umugabo w'umunyarwanda wavutse mu mwaka 1922,avukira hafi y'i Nyanza ahari hari umurwa w'u Mwami. Uyumugabo yamenyekanye cyane kubera gutebya kwe, mu magambo nka " Wa Njiji we". Akaba anazwi cyane mukwigisha ijambo ry'Imana aho abarizwa mu Itorero ry'Abadivantisiti bumusi wa karindwi.
Pasiteri Ezra Mpyisi amashuri abanza yayize RWAMATA mu ishuri ry'abadivantisiti ariho hari iwabo, amashuri y'isumbuye ayiga i Gitwe mu misiyoni y'abadivantisiti. Mpyisi yarakomeje ariga kugeza ubwo yabaye mwarimu.
Ezra Mpyisi Kaminuza yayize muri Zimbabwe ajyanyweyo nabazungu kuko nibo bategekaga icyo gihe, Ezra yaje kujya mumahanga aho yasoje kwiga mu mwaka 1964. Ezra Yaje kugaruka mu Rwanda mu mwaka 1997.
Ezra Mpyisi niwe mudivantisiti wambere wabonye icyangobwa cy'icyiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza mubijyanye n'iyobokamana ("theologian") haba ari mu Rwanda, Burundi ndetse na kongo. Ezra Mpyisi yahawe ubu pasiteri mu mwaka 1951.
Amagambo akomeye pasiteri ezra mpyisi yavuze ku Rwanda.
Ezra Mpyisi avugako ubwo bahaga abanyarwanda ubwigenge mu mwaka 1962, we avugako babuhaye abatari babukeneye kubera ko nyuma yuko Umwami Rudahigwa atanze Mu mwaka (1959) Kigeli agahungira muri America abavugagako badashaka ubwigenge babwiye ababiligi ati turashakako mudutegeka nkuko byahoze ariko mudufashe kwica Abatutsi ubundi mudutegeke kugeza aho muzashakira. Uko niko Kayibanda nabe bavugaga ubundi Ezira we ahamyako ibintu byagiye gupfa ubwo ubwigenge babuhaga abongabo bataribabukeneye, ubwo ababusabye n'ababurwaniye baribarapfuye abandi barabaye impunzi.

uhereye uwo munsi yagize igitekerezo cyo gutangira iri shuri ritoza abakiri bato umupira w'amaguru, habanza gucamo igihe kinini abitekerezaho,atangira kubishyira mubikorwa mu mwaka wa 2008, icyo gihe atangirana n'abana b' abahungu 20 uhereye igihe David yatangiriye umubare wakomeje kwiyongera kugeza ku bakinnyi 300 harimo amatsinda 6 y'abahungu bitewe n'imyaka bafite ndetse n' amatsinda 2 y'abakobwa.Uhereye muri 2008 ukageza muri 2020 bakomeje kujya bakina ndetse bagatsinda amarushanwa atandundukanye.

Paul Van Haver wamenyekanye mu bikorwa bya muzika nka Stromae, yavutse ku wa 12 werurwe mu mwaka 1985, ni Umubiligi ukomoka mu Rwanda kuri Rutare Pierre na Miranda Marie Van Haver.
Amateka y'Urungendo rwa muzika.
Stromae yatangiye umuziki akora injyana ya Hip Hop, yakoreshaga izina rya Opsmaestro, ubu yibanda cyane ku muziki wa Electronic music. yavutse kuwa 12 Werurwe mu mwaka 1985.Imwe mu ndirimbo zatumye aba icyamamara ni iyo yise ‘Alors on danse’, yanabaye igihe kirekire iya mbere mu gukundwa mu bihugu by’ i Burayi cyane cyane ibivuga ururimi rw’Igifaransa. kuri se w’Umunyarwanda witwa Rutare Pierre na nyina w’Umubiligikazi Miranda Marie Van Haver wo mu bwoko bw’aba-flamands.
Yageze i Kigali nk’umwana uje kwa Se.
Stromae yageze mu Rwanda mu ijoro ryo ku itariki ya 16 Ukwakira mu mwaka 2015, yari aje kuhakorera igitaramo cy’agatangaza cyahuruje imbaga kuva ku biga kuvuga kugeza ku basaza n’abakecuru rukukuri. Hari n’amagana y’abaturutse mu mahanga nko muri Congo Kinshasa, Uganda, Burundi ndetse na Kenya ahari haturutse itsinda ry’abahanzi bagize Sauti Sol, bose bakuru n’umuziki w’uyu muhanzi.Habura iminsi mike ngo agere i Kigali, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga no mu bitangazamakuru byose ni yo nkuru yacicikanaga. Ariko hari abigaragaje nka ba ‘Thomas’ wo muri Bibiliya bavugaga ko bemera bamubonye.
Byari iyobera! Haba mu bateguraga iby’urugendo rwe, abo mu muryango we, itangazamakuru n’abari bamurangamiye, nta n’umwe wari uzi ‘umunsi n’isaha’ yagombaga kugerera i Kigali ku mpamvu zabereye benshi urujijo.
Urugendo rukomeye rw’imyaka irindwi.
Stromae ni umwe mu bahanzi bakoze ibikorwa bikomeye n’amateka mu gihe gito bamaze mu ruganda rwa muzika.Uyu muhanzi mu mwaka wa 2009 yigeze gukora ibitaramo aho yazengurutse ibihugu birenga 25 byo ku migabane itandukanye y’isi.Akandi gahigo yesheje ni uko yigeze gukora ibitaramo bigera kuri 200 mu myaka ibiri gusa, ubwo ukoze imibare wasanga mu kwezi kumwe yarakoraga ibitaramo umunani. Mu gihe cyo kuzenguruka ibihugu bitandukanye amurika alubumu ye, Byaje kumugiraho ingaruka zikomeye aza kurwara bitewe n’umunaniro ukabije. Umuvandimwe we Luc Van Haver, hamwe n’umugore we Coralie Barbier batangaje ko byabateraga ubwoba aho yashoboraga gukora igitaramo buri nyuma yiminsi 5 cyangwa 3. Mu mwaka wa 2018, Umuhanzi Stromae yatanze ikiganiro kuri televiziyo France 2 aho yasobanuraga impamvu yari yarahagaritse umuziki we.

Shadrack Kabango uzwi ku izina rya Shad, umwe mu bahanzi b’abanyarwanda bakomeye ubarizwa mu gihugu cya Canada,
Shadrach Kabango yavukiye muri Kenya ku itariki ya 18 Nyakanga 1982. Avuka ku babyeyi b’abanyarwanda. Yakuriye i Londres na Ontario kubera akazi k’ ababyeyi be.Album ze nka When This Is Over (2005), The Old Prince (2007), TSOL (2010) na Flying Colours (2013) zaraguzwe cyane. Kuri album When This Is Over, hariho indirimbo yise I will not understand igaruka kuri Jenoside, iriho n’imivugo yanditswe na nyina Bernadette Kabango. Nyinshi mu ndirimbo ze zarebwe inshuro zisaga 1,000,000.

Nkusi Arthur ni umugabo wumunyarwanda akaba ari umunyarwenya wakunzwe nabataribake hano mu Rwanda ndetse n'imahanga. Uyu mugabo yavutse tariki 22 Mutarama 1990,ni mwene Mpazimaka Jones Kennedy na Kibuuka Herriet akaba avuka mumuryango w'abana 6.kuri ubu uyu musore yamaze kurushinga na Miss Mutoni Fiona Naringwa.
Nkusi Arthur akomoka mumuryango w'ibyamamare uhereye kuri se umubyara Mpazimaka Kennedy wa menyekanye mu ikinamico na sinema ndetse no gusobanura filime mu Kinyarwanda.ndetse na mukuruwe Sintex umaze kwiyegurira imitima yabeshi mu Rwanda.

Ruhumuriza James uzwi nka King James (yavutse kuwa 1 Mata 1990), Ni Umuhanzi Nyarwanda wandika akanaririmba indirimbo mu njyana ya R&amp;B ndetse na AfroBeats. King James azwi cyane mu kuririmba indirimbo z'urukundo n'izisanamitima, aho n'izindi njyana nka zouk na Pop atabura kuzihangamo. King James ni mwene Consolatie Kazizi na Issac Murihano.
King James yavutse 1990, avukira mu bitaro bya CHUK, mu mujyi wa Kigali. Akaba ari umwana wa 6 mu bana 7 bavukana, akaba asengera mu itorero ry'Abadiventiste.
Yasoje amashuri yisumbuye muri Ecole APE Rugunga, kuva 2013 yize muri Mount Kenya University mu bijyanye n'itangazamakuru n'itumanaho (Journalism and Mass Communication). King James akiri umwana yari afite inzozi zo kuzaba Umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga, Gusa nyuma aza kumva indirimbo z'umuhanzi w'umunyamerika ukora injyana ya R&amp;B zimutera ishyaka ryo gutangira guhanga no guhimba indirimbo ze bwite.
King James yatangiye umwuga wo kuririmba muri 2006 ahera ku ndirimbo itarahise yakirwa neza, gusa ntiyacika intege akomeza kwisunga abahanzi bari bamaze kumenyekana abigiraho, nibwo mu mwaka 2009 mo hagati yasohoye indirimbo yose ""Intink"i" imuzamura kurundi rwego, mu mpera za 2010 King James yigaragaje nk'umuhanzi w'icyamamare uyoboye abandi mu njyana ya R&amp;B aho yari asigaye ahanganye n'abahanzi bakomeye bariho nka Tom Close, Meddy cyangwa The Ben.
Kwamamara no Kumenyeka.
King James asa nk'uwagize amahirwe, ubwo abahanzi Meddy na The Ben bari bagezweho mu mwaka wa 2010 bimukiraga muri Amerika. Yahise asa nk'usigaye wenyine ku isoko ry'abaririmbaga indirimbo z'urukundo bimuhesha kwamamara cyane, asinya amasezerano n'inzu itunganya umuziki ya Kina Music ahita asohora umuzingo we wa mbere (album) ayita ""Umugisha" kuwa 24 ukuboza 2010. mu mwaka wakurikiyeho mu kuboza 2011 asohora iya 2 ayita "Umuvandimwe"" yariho indirimbo zakunzwe cyane nka "Narashize, Birandenga, Ese warikiniraga" n'izindi.. ayikorera igitaramo cyo kuyimurika i Butare muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda kuwa 13 Mutarama 2012. Ku mugoroba kuwa 25/12/2014, King James ku nshuro ye ya kabiri, yongera kumurikira album ye ya 3 yise "Ntibisanzwe" mu mujyi wa Musanze, anaha Noheri abatuye muri uwo mujyi.
Mu Myaka yakurikiyemo, King James warumaze kuba izina ritoroshye mu ruganda rw'umuziki mu Rwanda ndetse n'i mahanga yakomeje gusohora indirimbo zikunzwe aha twavuga "Yantumye", "Ndagukunda" "Naramukundaga" zabaye indirimbo ziremereye mu gihugu cy'u rwanda. Muri Kanama 2016 yasohoye indirimbo "The Girl Is Mine" arikumwe n'umuhanzi w'icyamamare ukomoka muri Vincentian soca witwa Kevin Lyttle.
King James amaze gushyira hanze imizingo (Album) nyinshi zirimo, Umugisha, Umuvandimwe, Ntibisanzwe, Meze neza, Ubushobozi yasohotse kuwa 10 Ukwakira 2021 ndetse n'izindi, akaba atangaza ko arimo gutegura iya 8 yise "Gukura"
Inyungu z'umuziki no Gufasha.
King James ni umwe mu bahanzi bahiriwe cyane n'urugendo rwe rw'ubuhanzi kuko uretse gukundwa kw'ibihangano bye, kuva 2013 King James yabaye wa muhanzi utumirwa no mu bitaramo bikomeye nko gutaramira muri Rwanda day iya London, Amsterdam, Atlanta, San Francisco, Ghent and Bonn n'iyo mu bubiligi yabaye mu mwaka wa 2017 usibye n'aho akunze kwifashishwa no mu bikorwa bya politiki, agataramira n'imbere y'abayobozi bakomeye, imbere mu gihugu.
King James yagize ijwi rifatika mu mitima y'urubyiruko yaba abahanzi bato bakizamuka, ndetse n'abandi bataba mu ruganda rw'imyidagaduro nka bandebereho (influencer) ndetse n'intangarugero (role model) ko bishoboka ko inzozi zawe wihanganye ugashyiramo imbaraga zawe zose uzigeraho, nk'uko King James akunda kubitangaza yagize ati: "urubyiruko ntirukwiye kugira akazi na kamwe basuzugura kuko ikintu cyose umuntu akoze ashyizeho umutima kimubyarira umusaruro" ibi yabikomoje ubwo yari mu kiganiro n'ikinyamakuru Isimbi TV avuga ko uretse ubuhanzi yanagerageje byinshi bimwe birakunda ibindi bikanga, kuko King James yahinze umuceli, yacuruje imodoka, ndetse kur'ubu afite iduka yise Mango Super Market, yagize uruganda rukora ifu y'ibigori yise "ihaho" yafunguye mu mwaka wa 2020, ndetse King James afite inzu y'amagorofa 2 yujuje ku Kamonyi ati: ibi byose mbikesha umuziki.
Kuwa 12 ukuboza 2021 King James yamuritse urubuga yise Zana Talent ruzajya rwifashishwa n’abakora filme, indirimbo, imideli n’ibindi bijyanye n’imyidagaduro. Mu gutekereza gushinga uru rubuga yibutse imvune abahanzi bakiri bato batari bamenyekana bagira mu kwamamaza ibihangano byabo kugirango bigere kure kandi bibonwe na benshi, niko gushaka igisubizo nk'umuhanzi mukuru umaze kugira byinshi ageraho. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n'itangazamakuru kuwa 1 Ukuboza 2021 yatangaje ko Zana Talent ije nk'igisubizo ku buhanzi, ku bahanzi kandi n'abamaze kugira izina ibihangano byabo byemewe ko babishyiraho, ndetse by'umwihariko ko album ye "Ubushobozi" yabaye intangiro y'izindi azajya acishaho.
King James yahawe ibihembo byinshi mu rugendo rwe rw'umuziki, cyane cyane mu bihembo bya Salax Awards na. Mu mwaka wa 2012, King James yatsindiye umwanya wa mbere mu irushanwa rikomeye rya Primus Guma Guma Super Star (PGGSS) ryari ribaye ku nshuro yaryo ya 2, ryategurwaga na Bralirwa, akaba ari kimwe mu bihembo binini byaranze umuziki we.
Mu bihembo bikomeye byo mu Rwanda bihemba Abahanzi b'indashyikirwa mu muziki "salax Awards" nabyo yabihatanyemo ku bwinshi uretse ibyo muri 2016 nibyo yasezeyemo kubera impamvu z'akandi kazi yari afite abonako bitamukundira kubifatanya. Gusa mu bihembo yatsindiye mu myaka yayibanjirije harimo:
King James ni Umuhanzi udakunda kuvuga cyane ku buzima bwe bwite cyangwa ku mubano we wo gukundana n'undi muntu (relationship) kuko azwiho kugira ibanga rikomeye kuri ayo mabanga, akenshi akavuga ko ahugiye ku muziki we n'indi mishinga y'ubucuruzi afite. Mu biganiro bitandukanye, King James avuga ko ubuzima bwe bwite, cyane cyane ibijyanye n'umugore cyangwa umukunzi, ari ibanga rye bwite. Yemeza ko atari ngombwa ko abantu bose babimenya.
Mu mwaka wa 2019, mu bitangazamakuru bitandukanye hakwirakwiriye ibihuha bivuga ko King James agiye gukora ubukwe, cyane ko yari amaze igihe atagaragara cyane.Gusa abihakana yivuye inyuma, avuga ko nta gahunda y'ubukwe afite vuba, ariko ko bishoboka mu gihe kizaza. King James yagiye ahanahanwa n'abakobwa batandukanye, barimo n'abahanzi bagenzi be nka Knowless na Priscilla, ndetse n'umukobwa w'umunyarwandakazi uba muri Amerika witwa Meek Rowland. Gusa, King James yagiye abihakana byose, akavuga ko ari incuti zisanzwe cyangwa abafatanyabikorwa mu muziki.
King James ashimangira ko ubuzima bwe bw'umwuga n'ubucuruzi aribwo abantu bakwiye kwitaho, kuruta iby'urukundo rwe.

Madebeats w’imyaka 26, ni umuhanga mu gutunganya indirimbo. Muri iyi minsi ni umwe mu bakoranye n’abahanzi bafite amazina akomeye mu muziki w’u Rwanda no mu karere. Muri iyi minsi ni umwe mu basore bamaze kubaka izina mu mitima y’abakunzi ba muzika mu Rwanda cyane mu batunganya indirimbo ni umusore mu muziki umaze igihe gito amaze gukora indirimbo nyinshi zamamaye hano mu Rwanda kandi z’abahanzi b’ibyamamare.

Neza Da Songbird Uyu ni umunyarwandakazi wavukiye i Kinshassa. Avuga indimi enye neza zirimo Ikinyarwanda, Igifaransa, Icyongereza n’Ilingala. Neza akorera umuziki we i Toronto muri Canada ari naho abana n’abavandimwe be.
Neza Da SongBird, umunyarwandakazi ukorera umuziki muri Canada yatoranijwe mu bahatanira igihembo cy’umuhanzi mwiza utanga icyizere cy’ejo hazaza muri muzika ya Afurika mu bihembo bigiye gutangwa ku nshuro ya kane bya Afrima. Neza akora injyana zishingiye kuri R&amp;B, Pop, Afro-Dancehall n’izindi zigezweho ziganjemo izituje, yagiye muri studio bwa mbere mu mwaka 2000, ari nabwo yakoze indirimbo ye ya mbere. Uyu muhanzikazi ari mubatanga icyizere mu kuzamura umuziki nyarwanda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Si ubwa mbere Neza yitabiriye amarushanwa mpuzamahanga y’abanyamuziki kuko no mu mwaka 2012, yaje kwitabira amarushanwa ya African Entertainment Awards yabereye muri Canada. Akaza guhabwa igihembo cya “Best Female Artist”.

AMATEKA YA SENDERI HIT... Ni muntu ki?
Eric Senderi Nzaramba ni umuhanzi nyarwanda uririmba injyana ya Afro Beat, wamenyekanye cyane ku mazina ya "Eric Senderi" cyangwa "Senderi International Hit". uyu muhanzi akaba ari umwe mu bakunze kwifashishwa mu bitaramo birimo gahunda za Leta n'ibindi bitaramo.
Eric Senderi Nzaramba, yavukiye mu Ntara y’I Burasirazuba mu Karere ka Kirehe, Umurenge wa Nyarubuye, Akagari ka Nyarutunga ubu akaba atuye mu mujyi wa Kigali.
Yavutse ku itariki ya 15 Werurwe 1977. Avuka mu muryango w’abana icyenda, ubu hasigaye babiri. Se yitwa Ndikumwami Yohana, Nyina akitwa Mukaderevu Esperanse. Amashuri abanza yayigiye I Nyarubuye n’ay’imyuga atatu.
Nyuma yaje kujya mu gisirikare cy’inkotanyi gutabara, yaje kuva mu gisirikare mu 2007.
Yinjiye mu buhanzi akiri muto ari mu itorero ry’aho yari atuye hitwa Nyarutunga gusa no mu gisirikare yari utera indirimbo (Ossi Morale) ari nabyo byaje kumufasha mu buhanzi bwe. Atangira guhimba indirimbo zivuga kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi 1994.
Yakoze nk’iyitwa "Intimba y’Intore z’Imana, Humura ntibizongera, Nyarubuye Iwacu, Twigirire Icyizere" n’izindi nyinshi zigera kuri 42. Izi ndirimbo zikaba zinafite amashusho yazo.
Nyuma yaje gukora n'indirimbo zivuga ku buzima busanzwe, nk’iyitwa "Turi mu muvuduko, Cyimbagira, Abanyamujyi, Abanyarwanda Twaribohoye, Abasore Bariho Nta Cash, Reka Jarousie, Ndanyuzwe, Sofia, Umunyana, Kora, Abareyo, APR Fc, Sukura Umujyi," n’izindi nyinshi.
Senderi yagiye hegukana ibikombe harimo icyo yahawe n’Umujyi wa Kigali cy’indirimbo yitwa Sukura Umujyi. Iki gikombe cyamuhesheje itike yo gutembera muri Afurika y’Epfo na Madagascar. Yaje no gutoranywa mu bahanzi batatu muri Afurika bafite indirimbo zishobora guhoza abana bahuye n’imitingito ku isi, imyuzure, Jenoside n’ibindi biza.
Yahawe igihembo na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame cyo kujya muri America(muri Mexico) gushyigikira ikipe y’igihugu y’abatarengeje imyaka 17 aho yari iri mu gikombe cy’isi. Aha yahawe n'umwanya wo kuririmba muri icyo gikombe cy'isi.
Senderi ni umwe mu bahanzi bitabiriye irushanwa rya 'Primus Guma Guma Super Star' inshuro eshatu zikurikiranya. Yitabiriye itangwa ry'ibihembo bya 'Salax Awards' abyegukana inshuro eshatu.
Yabashije no kwegukana ibihembo nk'umuhanzi ukunzwe cyane n'abaturage muri 'Kalisimbi Awards' naho yacyegukanye inshuro eshatu.
Kugeza ubu ni umwe mu bahanzi Nyarwanda babashije kuririmba muri Stade Amahoro ivuguruye yakira abantu ibihumbi 45.
Senderi ni umuhanzi wagiye arangwa n'udushya twinshi haba mu bitaramo ndetse no mu buzima busanzwe harimo no kuba yarigeze kwitwa musaza wa Miss Rwanda 2015 Kundwa Doriane.

Nicole Musoni Ni umukobwa wa Évariste Musoni, umuhanzi nyarwanda ukorera umuziki we muri Canada ari naho umuryango wabo wose utuye.
Amateka y'urugendo rwa muzika.
Nicole Musoni, ni umuhanzikazi w’ijwi rigororotse ubasha kuririmba injyana zitujye kandi zibyinitse nka Pop na Soul. Uyu mukobwa yatangiye umuziki mu myaka irindwi ishize. Amaze gusohora indirimbo zirimo ‘Interlude’, ‘Die with me’, ‘La Panique’ n’izindi. Uyu muhanzikazi kandi anakunze gusubiramo indirimbo z’abahanzi barimo Childish Gambino, Julia Michaels, The Weekend n’abandi. Nicole Musoni amaze kwitabira amarushanwa atandukanye y’umuziki arimo nka ‘Secondaire en Spectacle’, ‘Star Académie’ n’andi.
Uyu mukobwa yavukiye mu Rwanda, ku myaka ibiri y’amavuko we n’umuryango we bajya gutura muri Canada kugeza n’ubu.
Yatojwe na nyina kubyina imbyino za Kinyarwanda ndetse na we ageze muri Canada atangira kubyigisha amatorero atandukanye. Yagiye atumirwa mu mijyi yo muri Canada kugira ngo asangize ubu bumenyi abanyamahanga n’Abanyarwanda batabashije kubyigira mu Rwanda.

Nshimiyumuremyi Eric (yavutse ku ya 24 Ukuboza 1988), uzwi ku izina rye ry'ubuhanzi Enric Sifa, ni umuririmbyi n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo wo mu Rwanda akaba n'umuvugizi mu ruhame akayobora na Filimi. Muri 2002, yatsindiye amarushanwa yo kuririmba mu Rwanda yatangije umwuga we wa muzika kandi amuha radiyo na televiziyo mu Rwanda. Muri 2006. umuryango udaharanira inyungu ukomoka mu mujyi wa Portland ; Oregon ukorera mu Rwanda w'amushyize mu itsinda ryazengurutse Amerika kugira ngo riteze imbere gutera inkunga abana. Nyuma yo kuzenguruka yagumye muri Portland kuva asohora alubumu eshatu za studio.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Sifa yavutse ku ya 24 Ukuboza 1988, avukira mu mudugudu wo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, u Rwanda mu muryango wo hagati. Se yagurishije ibicuruzwa biva mu nganda, kandi umuryango we wari ufite imodoka kandi ukoresha abakozi kugira ngo bahinge ikawa yabo. Igihe Sifa yari afite imyaka itanu, ise na mukuru we biciwe muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Sifa na murumuna we batandukanijwe na nyina na mushiki wabo w'uruhinja kandi birinda urugomo bahungira mu ishyamba bamarayo amezi atatu. Nyuma yo guhura n’inzara mu ishyamba, Sifa yahisemo gushyira mu kaga ko yicwa maze asubira mu mudugudu aho we na murumuna we bahuriye na nyina na mushiki wabo kuri sitasiyo ya Croix Rouge. Basubiye mu nzu yabo, basanga umuyobozi wamunzwe na ruswa yafashe imitungo yabo, bityo babana mu kazu gato imyaka myinshi kugeza igihe nyina wa Sifa yaboneye impapuro zikenewe na guverinoma y'u Rwanda kugira ngo yambure umutungo we. Igihe yegera umukozi wa leta ku bijyanye n'umutungo we, yahaye akazi agatsiko ko kumukubita maze apfa nyuma y'ibyumweru bibiri azize gukubitwa.
Nyirasenge wa Sifa yajyanye murumuna we na mushiki we ariko kubera ko atari afite ubushobozi bwo kumutunga, yatangiye kubana n’umuturanyi. Kuba mu mudugudu umwe aho umuryango we wishwe byari bigoye kuri Sifa ku mutima, nuko arahunga aba impfubyi yo mu muhanda. Sifa yamaze imyaka itandatu arokoka mumuhanda aririmbira abanyamahanga kumuhanda kugirango bahinduke, bafasha abacuruzi, gutwara imizigo, no gukina urusimbi kuri marble hamwe nabandi bana bo mumuhanda.
Sifa yakomeje kuririmba indirimbo za nyina kugira ngo ahumurize ndetse n'abandi bahungu, kandi yahaga agaciro umuziki cyane ku buryo yakwinjira mu tubyiniro nubwo yari muto mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko. Umunsi umwe nijoro nyuma yo kwizitira uruzitiro kugirango abone kwinjira muri club nijoro, bouncers baramukubita, Sifa yumva yumvise Imana imutegeka kujya igihe kinini cyo kubyina. Bukeye bwaho, yagiye mu rusengero ahinduka Umukristo.
Yakundaga umuziki ku rusengero, kandi umuryango w'itorero wamuretse akaguma mu rugo rwabo. Umugore ukorana na Africa New Life Ministries, umuryango udaharanira inyungu ukomoka muri Portland, Oregon, yashakaga kumushyigikira amuha gitari kuko yari azi ubushobozi bwe bwa muzika. Mu 2002, umwaka nigice nyuma yo gutura mumuhanda, Sifa yatsindiye amarushanwa yigihugu yo kuririmba kwandika indirimbo yindirimbo yise Urukundo na sida. Sifa yamenyekanye cyane mu Rwanda kuri televiziyo na radiyo maze atumirwa gukina imbere ya Perezida Paul Kagame.
Ku ya 9 Kanama 2014, Sifa yashakanye n'umugore we Whitney Ferrin, bahuriye muri Warner Pacific College. Muri Gicurasi 2015, Sifa yahawe impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bucuruzi yakuye muri Warner Pacific kandi arateganya gushinga imishinga myinshi ihuriweho na MyiBOBO LLC kugira ngo ishyigikire umwuga we wa muzika.

Nkusi Thomas wamenyekanye cyane ku izina rya Yanga yavutse mu mwaka w' 1980 yitaba Imana mu 2022
Nkusi Thomas wamenyekanye cyane ku izina rya Yanga yavutse mu 1980. Nkusi thomas yashakanye na Eriko umugore w'umuyapanikazi mu mwaka w'2011 babyarana abana 2.
Mu 1998, Yanga yatangiye gusobanura amafilime abitangirira aho bita kuri 40 i Nyamirambo kwa Mayaka. Yanga yakomeje kubikora nk'umwuga akabikorera mubice bitandukanye nka Remere, Kicukiro, Kabeza na Kanombe hari ahantu abantu bahurira bakareba izo filime yasobanuye. Yanga nubwo yatangiye mu 1998 yamenyekanye cyane kuva mu mwaka wa 2000 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2013.

RNUD mu icyongereza: (Rwanda National Union of the Deaf) ni umuryango w’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta Wanditswe (Reg No 69/05) uhuza ibyiciro byose by’abatumva kugira ngo bakemure ibibazo byabo mu mibereho, ubukungu, umuco na politiki. RNUD yashinzwe mu 1989 n’abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva hagamijwe kwishyira hamwe, kumenyekanisha ibibazo / impungenge n’uburyo byakemuka.
Abatumva bashinze RNUD nyuma yo kubona ko ibyo bakeneye hamwe n’ibibazo byabo birengagijwe n’umuryango mugari. Inshingano y'ibanze ya RNUD ni ukureba inyungu z'abatumva, kuvugana mu rurimi rw'amarenga kugira ngo babaha serivisi, bakemure ibibazo byabo kandi babe nk'inzobere mu kutumva. Icyakora, Ishyirahamwe ryarasenyutse biturutse kuri jenoside yibasiye u Rwanda, mu 1994 aho benshi mu banyamuryango bashinze biciwe.
Abatumva bo mu Rwanda bahura n’urubuga rugoye rw’ibibazo kuva ku mibereho, ubukungu, umuco n’iterambere, imyumvire mibi y’abaturage ku batumva, inzitizi z’itumanaho. Ubukene burusheho gutesha agaciro abatumva kugera ku cyubahiro n’ubumwe no kubona akazi n’uburere aho batuye kandi ibyo bikababuza kwishimira byimazeyo uburenganzira bw’ibanze bwa muntu buhabwa abantu bose. RNUD yiyemeje guharanira amahirwe angana y’Abanyatumva batumva ndetse n’uburenganzira bwabo bwa muntu nk'uko bigaragara mu mategeko mpuzamahanga ndetse n’igihugu.
RNUD ni umunyamuryango w’amashyirahamwe y’igihugu y’abafite ubumuga mu Rwanda (NUDOR) kandi yifatanije n’ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva (WFD). RNUD ikora kandi ku bufatanye na serivisi ishinzwe ubushake mu mahanga (VSO) u Rwanda, Malmo Deaf club - Suwede, Ikigega cy’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga na Fondasiyo(Foundation)ya Kentalis n’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze.

Dream Boys ni itsinda Nyarwanda rikora injyana ya R&amp;B na Afrobeat rigizwe na Nemeye Platini uzwi nka Platini P ndetse na mugenzi we Mujyanama Claude uzwi nka TMC Ni tsinda bashinze muri 2009, riza kumenyekana cyane bakora ibitaramo hirya no hino mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo cyane cyane mu bihugu bibarizwa muri East Africa Community (EAC). Dream Boys yegukanye irushanwa rya Primus Guma Guma Super Star ubwo ryabaga ku nshuro ya karindwi. Ni mu birori bikomeye byabereye kuri Petit Stade byasojwe mu ijoro ryo ku wa 24 Kamena mu mwaka 2016.
Platini na TMC bagize iri tsinda bamaze kwitabira iri rushanwa inshuro esheshatu mu nshuro indwi rimaze kuba.
Amateka kuri buri umwe.
Platini ubundi yitwa Nemeye Platini akaba yaravutse muri nzeli mu mwaka 1988 I Bukavu kuko niho ababyeyi be bari barabaye bahamaze igihe kirekire. Nyuma yaho yaje gutahuka nk’abandi banyarwanda bose atangira amashuri ye abanza abiri yayize muri Congo, akomereza kuri ecole Primaire ya Nyanza ya Kicukiro. Icyiciro rusange cy’amashuri yagikomereje kuri Ecole secondaire de Gasange I Byumba, akomereza mu rwunge rw’amashuli rwa leta i Butare. Yaje gukomereza muri Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda mu ishami ry’itangazamakuru. Platini akiri umwana yaririmbaga muri Korari aza kuhava atangira gukora muzika ye. Ubu Platini, wakoze gake kuri Radio Salus, akora rimwe na rimwe kuri Radio Isango Star mu biganiro nka Isango na Muzika.
Mujyanama Claude [TMC] ni undi musore ubarizwa mu itsinda rya Dream boys. TMC akaba yarabonye izuba taliki ya 25 Nzeli mu mwaka 1988 na we avukira Uvila muri Congo. Yaje kuza mu Rwanda nyuma yu mwaka 1994 atangira amashuli ye abanza kuri Ecole Primaire de Kicukiro akomereza ayisumbuye kuri Ecole Secondaire de Kicukiro yaje guhinduka E.T.O Kicukiro.
TMC yaje kujya kwiga muri GSOB (Group Scolaire Officiel de Butare) mu ishami ry’imibare n’ubugenge, Kaminuza ayiga muri KIST. Kimwe na Platini, TMC na we yabanje kuririmba muri korari ayivamo ajya kwiririmbira ku giti cye.
Mu mwaka wa 2007, TMC arangije amashuli yisumbuye ni bwo yakoze indirimbo ya mbere ayikorerwa na BZB The Brain ayikorera muri The Future Production ariko iki gihe yaririmbaga injyana ya Hip hop. Muri 2008, Platini akirangiza amashuli yisumbuye yahuye na TMC bari bariganye i Butare mu mashuli yisumbuye ndetse bakaba bari banaturanye ibyo bikaba byaratumye bakora itsinda baryita "Dream Boys" kugeza n’uyu munsi ni ko ryitwa.
Guhera ku gitaramo cya mbere nibo bahanzi bagarutsweho cyane ku myambarire myiza yabaranze n’uburyo bitwara kuri stage n’ababyinnyi babo. Ibi bikajyana n’uburyo bahuza amajwi yabo, banavugisha abafana babo mu gihe barimo kuririmba.
Uko Platini na TMC bahuye bashinga Dream Boyz.

Gusa bakunze guhurira cyane mu ishuri. Dream Boyz yaje gukora indirimbo yabo yitwa “Nirizingua” yo mu njyana ya bongo irakundwa, ariko iyatumye Deam boys ikundwa ikanamenyekana cyane ni “Magorwa”. Mu ndirimbo z’aba bahungu humvikanamo ubutumwa busa nkaho ari ubuzima busanzwe ndetse n’amaganya ndetse abantu akaba ari yo mpamvu babakunda kuko bavuga ibiriho.
