Patrick Kinigamazi (wavutse ku ya 2 Werurwe 1983) ni umunyarwanda wakinagaa umukino w'iteramakofe wabigize umwuga mu irushanwa kuva 2006 kugeza 2020. Yatwaye igikombe cya Afurika muri 2016 ndetse na WBF super featherweight kuva 2017 kugeza 2020.
Kinigamazi yavutse ku ya 2 Werurwe 1983 i Gisenyi, mu Rwanda, yimukira mu Busuwisi afite imyaka cumi n'itanu nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Amaze gutangira siporo yo kurwana afite imyaka cumi nirindwi, yakurikiranye na murumuna we mumukino w'iteramakofe maze yinjira muri Club pugilistique de Carouge.
Mu myaka we wa mbere nkumukinnyi wateramakofe yanarushanwe muri kickbox, yegukana ibikombe bibiri byisi ndetse n’ibihugu bine by’Uburayi. Ku ya 2 Gicurasi 2010, yegukanye igikombe cya WKN cyitiriwe isi yose cyatsinzwe na Gary Hamilton, arangiza imyaka irindwi amaze ari nyampinga. Nyuma Kinigamazi yari umukino wari ikomeye.
Kinigamazi yakinnye na basketball na Bernex Geneve Basket.
Ku ya 29 Kamena 2006, Kinigamazi yatangiye gukina umukino witeramakofe nku wabigize umwuga, atsinda Rocco Cipriano na tekinike yo mu cyiciro cya gatanu i Carouge. Yatsindiye igikombe cye cya mbere mu rugamba rwe rwa karindwi, atsinda Martino Ciano kubera igikombe cyoroheje cy’Ubusuwisi. Nyuma yo gutsinda inshuro 16 kugirango atangire umwuga we yatsinzwe umukino we wa mbere mu 2011 na Guillaume Frenois uzaba shampiyo wi burayi. Umwaka umwe, yatsinzwe bwa kabiri nundi mufaransa, Sebastien Cornu.
Ku ya 18 Ugushyingo 2016, hashize imyaka irenga icyenda nyuma y’irushanwa rye rya nyuma rya shampionat, yatsinze umurwanyi ukomoka mu gihugu cya Congo ukomoka mu gihugu cya Espagne, Clark Telamanou, kubera igikombe cy’umucyo cyoroheje cya Afurika cyatsinzwe binyuze ku cyemezo cya benshi hamwe n'amanota yanditseho 96–94, 96–94 na 95–95. Imirwano ibiri nyuma, ku ya 9 Kamena 2017, Kinigamazi w'imyaka 34 yatsinze Juan José Farias ku bwumvikane (117-106, 116-107, 116-107) kugira ngo yegukane igikombe cya WBF super featherweight. Yatsinze ibitego bine byatsinze abasore bahataniraga mbere yuko ahura n’umukinnyi w’umukinnyi w’umukinnyi w’umukinnyi w’umukinnyi w’amajyepfo Bongani Mahlangu i Geneve mu izamu rye rya gatanu, atsinda imikino Olempike yo mu 2004 ku cyemezo cya benshi ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2019. Yahawe kandi umurwanyi w’umwaka wa 2017 muri WBF Awards.

Adonis Jovon Filer (yavutse ku ya 11 Nyakanga 1993) ni umukinnyi wa basketball ukomoka mu Rwanda akagira ubwenegihugu bwa merika ukinira REG BBC ya BAL muri africa. Akinira kandi ikipe yigihugu ya basketball yu Rwanda mumarushanwa mpuzamahanga.
Filer yavukiye muri Chicago, yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Mount Carmel mbere yo kwimukira mu kigo cya Musenyeri Noll i Hammond, muri Leta ya Indiana. Nyuma yaje no kwiga mu ishuri rya Notre Dame i Fitchburg, muri Massachusetts.
Filer yiyemeje gukinara Ingwe za Clemson. Mu gihe yakinaga na rokie, yagereranije amanota 10.0 na 4.0 reba. Nyuma yimyaka ibiri, yavuye muri Clemson yerekeza muri Floride Atlantike.
Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2017, Filer yasinyanye amasezerano ya mbere nku mwuga n’ikipe ya Sipiriyani Apollon Limassol. Yarekuwe mbere yo gukina umukino uwo ari wo wose n'ikipe ye.
Filer yahise asinyana amasezerano yigihembwe cya 2018–19, na Beroe wo muri Basketball ya Buligariya (NBL).
Muri shampiyona ya 2020–21, Filer yakinnye na Patriot ya RNBL. Nyuma yigihembwe, amasezerano yararangiye. Ku ya 8 Kamena 2021, Filer yasinyanye na REG BBC. Ku ya 8 Werurwe 2022, yashyizeho agahigo muri BAL ku bafasha benshi mu mukino nyuma yo gutsinda abafasha 14 mu gutsinda AS Salé. Muri shampiyona imwe, yagiye yegukana igikombe cya kabiri cya RBL kandi yitiriwe izina rya Team ya mbere All-RBL umwaka wa kabiri yikurikiranya.
Ugushyingo 2022, Filer yakinnye n'ikipe Urunani BBC muri Elite 16 yo mu cyiciro cya 2023 cya BAL. Yagarutse muri REG muri shampiyona nkuru ya 2023.
Filer yatoranijwe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball mu Rwanda mu 2020 maze atangira bwa mbere mu majonjora ya AfroBasket 2021.

Darrius Garrett (wavutse ku ya 11 Mata 1990) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball wabigize umwuga, akaba umunyamerika n' umunyarwanda, ukinira ikipe ya Iraklis wo muri Shampiyona y’Abagereki. Yakinnye muri basketball yo muri kaminuza ya Richmond.
Garret yatangiriye mu ishuri ryisumbuye ya McEachern i Powder Springs, muri Jeworujiya aho yize imyaka ibiri ahahurira nu umutoza we Nick Chaykowsky. muri 2007–08, afite amanota 16.2, na 11.8 reba, 4.3 blok na 2.0 buri mu mukino.
Nkumunyeshuri wambere muri Richmond mu mwaka wa 2008–09, Garrett yakinnye afite amanota 1.3 na reba 1.9 mumikino 12.
Nkumunyeshuri wa kabiri muri 2009–10, Garrett yakinnye imikino 35 yose arangiza ari uwa karindwi mu nama ya Atlantike 10 mumikino yose hamwe na 1.7 (60 yose hamwe). Yagereranije kandi amanota 2.3 na 3.4 yagarutse mu minota 14.2 kuri buri mukino. Ku ya 10 Mutarama 2010, mu mukino wahuje Massachusetts, Garrett yashyizeho amateka ya Atlantike 10 na Richmond ku bitego mu mukino umwe hamwe na 14, bihuza ibice bibiri bya kabiri mu mukino wabereye mu mateka ya NCAA Icyiciro cya mbere.
Nkumuto muri 2010–11, Garrett yahagaritse amashoti 59 yose, arangiza umwaka wa karindwi kurutonde rwibihe byose bya Richmond hamwe na 124. Mu mikino 37, yagereranije amanota 1.9, reba 4.1 na blok 1,6 mu minota 12.8 kuri buri mukino.
Nkumukuze muri 2011–12, Garrett yabaye umukinnyi usanzwe kandi igice kinini cyikipe, ndetse arangiza umwuga we nkumukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Richmond hamwe na 231. Hamwe n'iki cyubahiro, yanashyizwe mu ikipe ya Atlantique 10 All-Defender Team. Mu mikino 32, yagereranije amanota 4.5, 6.5 yagaruye, 1.0 afasha na 3.3 bice mu minota 25.5 kumukino.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Irushanwa rya Basketball.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2017, Garrett yakinnye mu irushanwa rya Basketball kuri ESPN kuri Broad Street Brawlers. Yahatanira igihembo cya miliyoni 2 z'amadolari, kandi afasha Brawlers kugera mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'irushanwa, atsindirwa muri Team Colorado 111–95.
Garrett yakinnye imikino 3 mu ikipe yigihugu ya basketball yu Rwanda mu majonjora y’igikombe cyisi cya FIBA cya 2019 aho yagerageje amanota 11.7, 9.3 reba na 2.3 afasha kuri buri mukino.
Garrett ni umuhungu wa Darrick Jones na Sharllene Garrett, akaba afite mushiki we, Dayira, na murumuna we, Darrick Jr.

Idrissa Adam (wavutse 28 Ukuboza 1984) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wabigize umwuga wo muri Kameruni uhatanira metero 100 na metero 200.
Yasohotse bwa mbere ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu marushanwa nyafurika y’imikino ngororamubiri mu 2003, aho yabaye uwa gatanu muri metero 100. Yatsindiye umudari wa mbere ku mugabane afurika w’umwaka wakurikiyeho, atwara umudari wa bronze mu kwiruka metero 4 × 100, muri Shampiyona nyafurika yabereye muri 2004 mu ikipe ya rimo Joseph Batangdon. Hari hashize indi myaka ine mbere yuko yegukana undi mudari ukomeye: muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya 2008 we na Batangdon bongeye gutwara umuringa berekeza muri Kameruni. Yaje ku mwanya wa kane muri ibyo birori muri Jeux de la Francophonie 2009.
Yahagarariye Kameruni muri metro 100 na 200 muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya 2010 mu kwiruka ndetse n’imikino ya Commonwealth 2010, ariko ntiyabona ibihe byiza kurenza icyiciro cya mbere. Yigaragaje nk'umukinnyi ku giti cye mu mikino yo muri Afurika muri 2011, aho yayoboye Kameruni amasegonda 10.14 muri metero 100 kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza kandi niyo yatunguye muri metero 200 umudari wa zahabu imbere ya Ben Youssef Meité.

Delphine Bertille Atangana (yavutse ku ya 16 Kanama 1984) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wabigize umwuga uvuka i Yaoundé wo muri Kameruni kabuhariwe muri metero 100.
Mu mikino ya Commonwealth 2006 yegukanye umudari wa bronze muri metero 100 arangiriza ari kumwanya wa karindwi muri metero 200. Yitabiriye kandi imikino Olempike yo mu 2004, Shampiyona y'isi ya 2005, Shampiyona y'isi yo mu 2008, Shampiyona y'isi ya 2011, Shampiyona y'isi yo mu 2012 ndetse na Olempike yo mu mpeshyi 2012 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma. Yatsindiye zahabu muri 200 m mu mikino ya Afro-Aziya.
Ibihe byiza yagize ni amasegonda 11.24, yagezweho mu Kwakira 2003 i Abuja. Afite amasegonda 23.26 muri metero 200, yageze muri Mata 2003 i Bron, n'amasegonda 7.19 muri metero 60, yageze muri Gashyantare 2006 i Aubière. Afite kandi amateka y’igihugu mu kwiruka metero 4 x 400 n'iminota 3: 27.08, yagezeho hamwe na bagenzi be Mireille Nguimgo, Carole Kaboud Mebam na Hortense Béwouda mu marushanwa y'isi yabereye i Paris mu 2003.

Joseph Batangdon (wavutse ku ya 29 Nyakanga 1978) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga akaba yarahoze yiruka muri Kameruni kabuhariwe muri metero 200.
Batangdon yabaye shampiyo muri Afurika mu 2004, ukwezi mbere y'imikino Olempike yo mu 2004. Yarushanwe mu marushanwa ya metero 200.

Serge Bengono (wavutse ku ya 3 Kanama 1977) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Kameruni wiruka na maguru muri metero 100.
Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 2000 na Shampiyona y'isi mu 2001 na 2003 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.
Ibihe bye byiza ni amasegonda 10.25 muri metero 100, yagezeho mumikino ya 1999 yabereye muri Johannesburg; n'amasegonda 20.89 muri metero 200, byagezweho muri Mata 2002 i Knoxville. Niwe kandi ufite rekodi yigihugu mu kwiruka metero 4 x 100, yageze muri Shampiyona yisi 1999. Muri relay yanitabiriye amarushanwa yisi ya 1997.
Kuri ubu Serge Bengono ni umutoza wungirije muri kaminuza ya Norfolk.

Hortense Béwouda (yavutse 19 Ukwakira 1978) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga wo gusiganwa ku maguru wo muri Kameruni kabuhariwe muri metero 400.
Ibihe byiza yagize ni amasegonda 51.04, yayagize muri kamena 2004 muri Algiers. Kugeza ubu afite Umuhigo wi gihugu mu kwiruka metero 4 x 400 niminota 3: 27.08, yagezeho hamwe na bagenzi be Mireille Nguimgo, Carole Kaboud Mebam na Delphine Atangana muri Kanama 2003 i Paris.

Emmanuel Alobwede Eseme (wavutse 17 Kanama 1993) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ufite ubwenegihugu bwa merika uvuka muri Kameruni. Yitabiriye metero 200 mu bagabo mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri ya 2019 yabereye i Doha, muri Qatar. gusa ntabwo yujuje ibihe bicyenewe ngo yitabira kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.
Muri uwo mwaka kandi, yitabiriye kandi metero 200 z'abagabo ndetse na metero 4 × 100 z'abagabo mu marushanwa yo kwerekeza mu mikino Nyafurika ya 2019, muri ibyo bihe byombi atatsindiye umudari.
Yahagarariye Kameruni mu mikino Olempike ya 2020 yabereye i Tokiyo, mu Buyapani mu kwiruka metero 200 mu bagabo.

Carole Madeleine Kaboud Mebam (wavutse ku ya 17 Nzeri 1978) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri wa Kameruni uzobereye mu kwiruka metero 100 na 400.
Afite kandi amateka y’igihugu mu kwiruka metero 4 × 400 n'iminota 3: 27.08, yagezeho hamwe na bagenzi be Mirelle Nguimgo, Delphine Atangana na Hortense Béwouda muri Kanama 2003 i Paris.

Claudine Komgang-Fotsing cyangwa Claudine Komgang (wavutse ku ya 21 Mata 1974) ni umukinnyi wa siporo wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Kameruni, akaba yarasezeye mu mikino akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 400.
Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu muri Shampiyona nyafurika 2000. Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'isi yo mu 1999 ndetse na Olempike yo mu 2000 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.
Igihe cye cyiza ni amasegonda 50,73, yageze muri Nyakanga 2000 mumujyi wa Mexico.

Hugo Lucien Mamba-Schlick (wavutse ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1982) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga akaba ari Umunyamerikakazi wasimbutse inshuro eshatu mu marushanwa ya afurika.
Yabaye uwa gatandatu muri Shampiyona nyafurika yo mu 2006 yegukanye umudari wa feza mu mikino yabereye muri Afurika 2007 kandi yegukana umudari wa feza mu marushanwa ya Afurika yo muri 2008 yaberaga muri Athletisme. Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'isi ya 2007, 2009 na 2011 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma. Mu mwaka wa 2010 yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu mikino ya Commonwealth yabereye i Delhi, mu gusimbuka gushya kwa metero 17.14. Ubu ni inyandiko ya Kameruni.

Myriam Léonie Mani (wavutse ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1977) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Kameruni akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 100 na 200.
Mani yari ahagarariye Kameruni mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2008 yarushanwe muri metero 100. Mu bushyuhe bwe bwa mbere yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu inyuma ya Torri Edwards na Jeanette Kwakye mu gihe cya 11.64 kugirango bazamuke mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Agezeyo, yananiwe kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza kuko igihe cye cya 11,65 cyari inshuro ya gatandatu gusa yubushyuhe, bitera kurandurwa.

Sylvie Florence Mballa Éloundou (yavutse ku ya 21 Mata 1977) ni - Umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukora umukino wo gusiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Kameruni afite ubwenegihugu bwu bufaransa akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 100.
Sylvie Mballa Éloundou ukomoka mu gace ka Yaoundé, umurwa mukuru wa Kameruni, mu ntangiriro yari ahagarariye igihugu yavukiyemo, ariko ahindura ubwenegihugu ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2002 kugira ngo ahatane nk'umwe mu bagize ikipe y'Ubufaransa. Nyuma y'indi mpinduka, ku ya 1 Mata 2005, yongeye kwinjira mu marushanwa munsi y'ibendera rya Kameruni.
Igihe cye cyiza kuri metero 100 ni amasegonda 11.13, yageze muri Nyakanga 2005 muri Angers, ariko, mu marushanwa ya IAAF yaberaga mu 2006 yabereye i Moscou, yarangije kwiruka metero 60 ku mwanya wa munani.

Françoise Mbango Etone (yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1976) ni umukinnyi w’imikino ngororamubiri wabigize umwuga ukomoka i Yaoundé mu gihugu cya Kameruni. Yagiye mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga atandukanye mu Bufaransa kuva mu 2010. Mu gihe yarushanwaga afatanyije na Kameruni, Etone begukanye umudari wa zahabu inshuro 2 mu mikino Olempike yo gusimbuka ushuro eshatu mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2004 yabereye muri Atenayi, mu Bugereki no mu mikino Olempike ya 2008 yabereye i Beijing mu Bushinwa. Yatsindiye imikino Olempike mu gusimbuka gatatu yashyizehoagahigo muri metero 15.39 mu mikino Olempike yabereye i Beijing mu 2008. Muri M 15.39 m mu gusimbuka gatatu harehare mu bagore batatu basimbuka mubihe byose. Abagore 25 gusa ni bo ba simbuka metero 15, Etone yasimbutse hejuru ya metero 15 kuri 7 kugeza kuri 11 yagaragaye ku mukino wa nyuma mu mikino Olempike wenyine.
Etone kandi yari umuhanga muremure wasimbutse wabaye uwa kabiri muri Shampiyona nyafurika mu 1999. Etone niwe mukinnyi wa mbere w’abakobwa bahagarariye Kameruni wegukanye imidari mu mikino ya Commonwealth, Shampiyona yisi n’imikino Olempike. Yabaye buruse muri gahunda ya Olempike Solidarity kuva mu Gushyingo 2002.
Mu mwaka w'amashuri wa 2005–06, yabaga mu mujyi wa New York kuri bourse yo kwiga muri kaminuza ya Mutagatifu Yohani i Queens, muri New York. Bourse yashobotse ku bufatanye n’isosiyete ikora amashanyarazi muri Amerika AES Sonel hamwe na Ambasaderi w’Amerika muri Kameruni, Niels Marquardt. Yahisemo kaminuza ya Mutagatifu Yohani kugira ngo yige (hamwe na murumuna we, Berthe) kubera ko ishuri ryashyigikiraga gahunda z'umuco muri Kameruni.

Alfred Émile Moussambani (wavutse ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1974) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Kameruni akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 100. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1996 na 2000 nk'umunyamuryango w’ikipe ya metero 4x100. Abandi bagize ikipe muri 1996 bakinanye ni Benjamin Sirimou, Aimé-Issa Nthépé na Claude Toukéné-Guébogo. Abagize ikipe bakinanye muri 2000 ni Serge Bengono, II, Joseph Batangdon, na Benjamin Sirimou.
Afatanije na Serge Mbegomo, Claude Toukene na Joseph Batangdon yegukanye umwanya wa karindwi ku mukino wa nyuma wo kwiruka metero 4 x 100 mu mikino ya Commonwealth 2002 ndetse no mu mikino ya Commonwealth 2006.
Yabaye kandi umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu ye muri Shampiyona y'isi 1997, 2001 na 2003.
Yirutse kandi metero 100 muri 10.33 ariko akoresheje umuyaga +4.1.

Samuel Nchinda-Kaya (wavutse ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1967) yahoze ari umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wari wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Kameruni witabiriye amarushanwa ya metero 100 mu bagabo mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1992. akoresha amasegonda 10.41, byari bihagije kugirango abashe kujya mu cyiciro gikurikira, aho yagize amasegonda 10.58. Ibihe byiza yagize ni amasegonda 10.24, mu mwaka wa 1992. Yirutse kandi muri metero 200, akoresha amasaha 21.50. Mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1988, yarushanwe muri metero 100 na 200, azamuka muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.

Mireille Nguimgo (wavutse ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 1976) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa kumaguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Kameruni akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 400.
Ntabwo yarushanwe kurwego rwo hejuru kuva shampiyona 2004.
Afite kandi amateka y’igihugu mu kwiruka metero 4 × 400 n'iminota 3: 27.08, yagezeho hamwe na bagenzi be Carole Kaboud Mebam, Delphine Atangana na Hortense Béwouda muri Kanama 2003 i Paris.

Georgette Nkoma (wavutse ku ya 16 Kamena 1965) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga akaba akomoka muri Kameruni. Muri Shampiyona nyafurika yo mu 1996 yatsindiye imidari ya zahabu muri metero 100 na 200. Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'isi mu 1993, 1995 na 1997, ndetse no muri metero 4 × 100 mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1996 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.

Joëlle Sandrine Mbumi Nkouindjin (wavutse ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1986) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Kameruni ufite umwihariko wo gusimbuka gatatu. Yitabiriye amarushanwa y'isi ya 2015 yabereye i Beijing, gusa ntiyabashije kujya ku mukino wa nyuma. Afite ibihe byiza muri metero 14.16 mu gusimbuka gatatu ari i Yaoundé muri 2015 na metero 6.35 mu gusimbuka birebire muri Yaoundé 2014.

Umunsi mukuru w’abagore mu Buhinde wizihizwa ku ya 13 Gashyantare buri mwaka, ku isabukuru ya Sarojini Naidu wavutse ku ya 13 Gashyantare 1879 i Hyderabad, mu Buhinde. Naidu yari umuyobozi w’ishyaka ryigenga ry’Ubuhinde kandi azwiho ibikorwa by’ubuvanganzo, cyane cyane ku bisigo bye bifite insanganyamatsiko nko gukunda igihugu, gukundana n’indirimbo yise "Nightingale y' Ubuhinde" - ("Bharat Kokila") ya Mahatma Gandhi, Naidu iteka yaharaniraga kongerera ubushobozi abagore mu Buhinde.

Ikipe ya Cricket y'abagore yu Rwanda ni ikipe ya Cricket yo mu Rwanda, aho ihagararira igihugu mu marushanwa atandukanye. Ikipe y’Igihugu y’abagore mu mukino wa Cricket yegukana igikombe itsinze ikipe ya Nigeriya mu marushanwa ya Afurika, rikaba ryaritabirwe n’ibihugu 5 aribyo u Rwanda, Nigeriya, Sierra Leone, Gana na Gambiya.
Bimenyimana Marie Diane niwe kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu ya Cricket y'abagore, ni ikipe y'abakinnyi bafite ibikombe mpuzamahanga banditswe muburyo bugaragara bakuye muri nigeriya. Abakinnyi b’ikipe ya cricket y’u Rwanda nibo biganje mu batwaye ibihembo by’abakinnyi beza b’irushanwa aha twavuga:

Issa-Aimé Nthépé (wavutse ku ya 26 Kamena 1973) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ufite ubwenegihugu bwu bufaransa wiruka cyane muri metero 100. Yavukiye i Douala mu gihugu cye cya Kameruni mu 1999.
Muri Shampiyona yi Burayi 2002 yarangije umwanya wa gatanu muri metero 100 na kane muri metero 4 x 100. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane cya Shampiyona y'isi 2003. Yaje ku mwanya wa karindwi n'ikipe ya relay y'Abafaransa mu gikombe cy'isi cya IAAF 2006.
Ibihe bye byiza ni amasegonda 10.11 muri m 100 n'amasegonda 20.58 muri m 200, byombi yabigezeho mu mpeshyi ya 2002.

Suzie Tanefo (wavutse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 1969) ni umukinnyi wa siporo wabigize umwuga ukomoka mugihugu cya Kameruni wasezeye ku gukina akaba ari mukiruhuko cy'izabukuru akaba yaari kabuhariwe muri metero 400.
Mu mikino yo muri Afurika yo hagati 1987 yegukanye imidari ya feza muri metero 200 na 400. Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'isi yo mu 1991 na Olempike yo mu 1992 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.
Igihe cye cyiza ni amasegonda 52,88, yagezweho muri 1989.

Georgina Toth (wavutse ku ya 10 Werurwe 1982) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga akaba afite umbenegihugu bwa Hongiriya wavutse aru umunya Kameruni, kandi yakiniye iguhugu yavukiyemo cya Kameruni mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2008.
Toth yize muri kaminuza ya Arizona y'Amajyaruguru i flagstaff, muri Arizona, aho yarushanwe mu ikipe y'abagore basiganwa ku maguru, arangiza mu 2009 afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n'ubucuruzi-imari n'ubucuruzi.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, yaje ku mwanya wa kane mu marushanwa ya Afurika yo ku nshuro ya 16 muri 2008. Toth ifite rekodi yigihugu muri Hongiriya na Kameruni mu guta ibiro hamwe na 19.69 m (64 ft 7 muri), hamwe na rekodi yigihugu ya Kameruni mu guta inyundo hamwe na 67.42 m.

Mahmoud Saber ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukina umupira w amaguru wumunyamisiri ukinira ikipe ya Pyramide yo mu Misiri yo mu Misiri nka rutahizamu.
Mahmoud Saber yavutse ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2001. Yatangiye umwuga we muri Nogoom FC muri 2018 naho muri 2020 yimurirwa muri Pyramids FC. Ari no mu ikipe ya Olempike yo mu Misiri 2023.

Ahmed Aly Ahmed Daador ni umukinyi w'umupira wamaguru wu munyamisiri ukinira ikipe ya Pyramide yo muri Egiputa yo mu Misiri nkumuzamu.
Ahmed Daador yavutse ku ya 10 Mata 1995 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we muri 2015 hamwe na Misr lel-Maqasah SC. Muri 2017, yinjiye muri Pyramids FC naho muri 2020 yimurirwa muri Al Masry. Muri 2021, yasubijwe muri Pyramids FC.
Yari mu ikipe ya kabiri yegukanye igikombe cya EFA League 2018/2019 na 2019/2020 CAF Confederation Cup

Abdallah Magdy ni umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Egypt, akaba akina hagati mu kibuga (midfielder) aho afasha cyane mu kurinda no gutangiza ibitero; kuri ubu akinira ikipe ya Pyramids FC ikina muri Egyptian Premier League, shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere mu Misiri, kandi azwiho gukina afite imbaraga, gutanga imipira myiza no gufasha ikipe ye kugera ku ntsinzi mu mikino yo mu gihugu no ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Abdallah Magdy yavutse ku ya 22 Gashyantare 1997 mu Misiri. Yakiniye Misr Lel Makkasa kuva 2019 kugeza 2021 ubwo yimurirwaga muri Pyramide.
Yari mu ikipe ya kabiri yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona yo mu Misiri 2022.

Ghanam Mohamed ni ukuminnyi wu mupira wamaguru wu munyamisiri wa bigize umwuga ukinira ikipe ya Future FC yo muri Egiputa ho mu Misiri, muri Future FC ni nkumukinnyi wo hagati.
Ghanam Mohamed yavutse ku ya 12 Werurwe 1997 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we wumupira wamaguru muri Al Ahly. Muri 2017, yimuriwe muri El Gouna. Muri 2018, yimuriwe muri El Entag El- Harby naho mu 2021 yimurirwa muri Future FC. Muri rusange, amaze kwitabira imikino irenga ijana mu marushanwa yose harimo no kugaragara mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika U-23 2019.
Yatsindiye Igikombe cya Afurika U-23 2019 ndetse n’igikombe cya EFA 2020/2021 hamwe na Future FC.

Mahmoud Shaaban ni umukinnyi wu mupira wamaguru wu munyamisiri wabigize umwuga ukinira muri League yo muri Egiputa mu kipe ya Future FC nka myugariro.
Mahmoud Shaaban yavutse ku ya 7 Werurwe 1995 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we wumupira wamaguru Al-Ittihad muri 2015. Muri 2019 yimuriwe muri FC Masr maze muri uwo mwaka, asubizwa muri Al Ittihad. Muri 2021 yaguzwe na Ghazl El Mahalla ubu akaba ari muri Future FC.

Ali Ahmed Mohab Elfil ni umukinnyi wu mupira wamaguru wumunyamisiri ukinira muri cy'iciro cya mbere muri league yo muri Egiputa ho mu Misiri mu i kipe ya Future FC nka myugariro.
Ali Elfil yavutse ku ya 13 Ukuboza 1992 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we wumupira wamaguru muri Telephonat Beni Suef SC. Muri 2015, yimuriwe muri Haras El Hodoud SC. Muri 2018, yaguzwe na Tala'ea El Gaish SC maze mu 2022 yimurirwa muri Future FC. Muri rusange, afite inshuro zirenga ijana n'ibitego bitatu.
Yabaye igisonga mu gikombe cya EFA 2019/2020 ndetse nuwatsindiye igikombe cya Super Cup 2020/2021.

Mahmoud Marei ni umukinyi wu mupira wa maguru wa bigize umwuga wu munyamisiri ukinira mu cyiciro cya mbere muri League yo muri Egiputa mu ikipe ya Future FC nka myugariro.
Mahmoud Marei yavutse ku ya 24 Mata 1998 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we wumupira wamaguru muri club yurubyiruko ya Wadi Degla SC. Yazamuwe mu ikipe ya mbere muri shampiyona ya 2017/2018 aho yakinnye imyaka, aho yagaragaye inshuro zirenga ijana mbere yo kwerekeza muri Future FC. Yakinnye kandi mu ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 mu Misiri mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika U-20 2017 aho yakinnye imikino itatu na Mali, Gineya na Zambiya.
Muri 2019, yegukanye igikombe cy’ibihugu CAF U-23 hamwe n’ikipe ya Misiri naho muri shampiyona 2021/2022 atwara igikombe cya EFA League hamwe na Future FC.

Bay Kamara ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru ufite ubwenegihugu bw’Ubuholandi ariko ukomoka muri Senegali ukinira ikipe ya Aswan SC yo mu Egiputa ho mu Misiri nku kina ku ruhande.
Bay Kamara yavutse ku ya 15 Gashyantare 2001 muri Senegali. Yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Zeborgia mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe mpuzamahanga y’Urubyiruko mu Buholandi. Yabanje gukina muri AZ Alkmaar na FC Emmen. Yinjiye mu ikipe ya Misiri yo mu Misiri Aswan SC mu 2022, ubu ari mu nguzanyo na Ismaily SC.

Ibrahim Ayesh ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru wu munyamisiri ukinira ikipe ya Ghazl El Mahalla yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu egiputa ho mu Misiri, akina nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Ibrahim Ayesh yavutse ku ya 16 Ugushyingo 1998 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we mu kibaya cya Tigris mu 2018. Mu 2022 yimuriwe muri Aswan SC naho mu 2023 yimurirwa muri Ghazl El Mahalla.

Saber El Shimi ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru akaba umunyamisiri ukinira Aswan SC muri Egiputa nka myugariro.
Saber Ashraf El Shimi yavutse ku ya 30 Mutarama 1993. Yahoze ari capitaine wa Eastern Company SC nyuma yaje gusinyana amasezerano yimyaka ibiri nigice na Aswan SC kubusa.

Mido Mostafa ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wu munyamisiri wabigize umwuga ukinira mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Misiri ho muri Egiputa mu i kipe ya Banki nkuru yigihugu ya Misiri nka myugariro akaba yaratizwe muri Aswan SC.

Amr Hossam ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wu munyamisiri wabigize umwuga ukinira mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Misiri ho muri Egiputa mu i kipe ya Eastern Company nka myugariro ari mu ntizanyo muri Aswan SC
Amr Hossam yavutse ku ya 26 Mutarama 1991 mu Misiri. Yatangiye umwuga we mu 2015 mu ihuriro ry’abapolisi. Muri 2016, yimuriwe muri Petroject, Mbwira FC muri 2018, Isosiyete y'Iburasirazuba mu 2021, ubu akaba ari inguzanyo muri Aswan SC.

Mostafa Abdelrasoul (yavutse 14 Gashyantare 1998) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga wu mupira wamaguru wu munyamisiri ukinira ikipe ya Aswan SC yo muri Egiputa ho mu Misiri muri cyiciro cyambere akina nkumukinnyi wo hagati.

Mahmoud Namjoo (yavutse, 22 Nzeri 1918 -yapfuye 21 Mutarama 1989) yari umukinnyi uterura ibiremereye ukomoka Irani. Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 1948, 1952 na 1956 aza ku mwanya wa gatanu, uwa kabiri n'uwa gatatu. Mu marushanwa y'isi yegukanye zahabu eshatu, imwe ya feza n'imidari ibiri ya bronze hagati ya 1949 na 1957, aba uterura ibiremereye wa mbere wa Irani watsinze mu gikombe cy'isi. Namjoo kandi niwe wambere wateruye ibiremereye muri Aziya byatumye ashyiraho agahigo ki si; mugihe cye umwuga we yashyizeho uduhigo tune: kamwe muri clean and jerk muri 1949 na dutatu muri rusange, muri 1948, 1949 na 1951.
Namjoo yavukiye i Rasht mu 1918 maze mu 1937 yimukira i Tehran, aho yakoraga ahugurwa mu bubaji. Yateruye ibiremereye muri siporo. Usibye guterura ibiremereye yanarushanwe mu kubaka umubiri, kandi yegukana Igihembo cyitiriwe Bwana Universe mu kugabanya ibiro mu 1948, aba uwa gatanu mu 1955. Mu 1956 yamaze amezi abiri akora akazi ko gutoza mu biremereye muri Turukiya. Yakomeje imyitozo mu myaka mirongo ine yakurikiyeho agerageza gutsindira imikino Olempike yo mu 1960. Yapfuye azize kanseri, yandura afite imyaka 70.
Mahmoud Namjoo at Olympedia

Mohamed Atwa (wavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga 1990) ni umukinnyi w’umupira wa maguru w’umunyamisiri ukinira ikipe ya El Gouna yo mu Misiri mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Misiri nka myugariro, ubu akaba ari mu ntizanyo muri Aswan SC. Yatangiye umwuga we muri 2016 aho yakiniye muri Egiputa Clearing Club maze yinjira muri Alexandrie Union mu 2016. Yimukiye muri Pioneer mu 2018, Pyramide muri 2019, Alexandrie Union na El Gouna muri 2020 na Aswan ku ntizanyo mu 2022.

Raphael Viashima Ayagwa (wavutse ku ya 13 Gashyantare 1998) ni umukinyi wabigize umwuga ukina umupira wa maguru ukina mu cyiciro cya mbere muri Nigeriya ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati wa Aswan.

Raphael Ayagwa yakinaga muri Plateau United FC i Jos, muri leta ya Plateau, mbere yuko asinyira ikipe ya Lillestrøm yo muri Noruveje ku ya 15 Kanama 2018. Yavuye muri iyo kipe ku ya 25 Kamena 2019 nyuma yo gusesa amasezerano ye byumvikanyweho.

Ahmed Hamoudi (yavutse wavutse 30 Nyakanga 1990) ni umukinnyi umupira wamaguru wu munyamisiri wabigize umwuga ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati utera mu ikipe ya Pyramids yo muri Egiputa mu cyiciro cyambere mu Misiri.
Hamoudi yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu rubyiruko na Smouha Sporting Club maze azamuka mu ikipe yabo ya mbere mu 2010. Muri shampiyona ya mbere yakinnye buri gihe. Nyuma y'imyivumbagatanyo ya Stade ya Port Said ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2012, Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri yahagaritswe, maze ku ya 10 Werurwe 2012, Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mu Misiri ryatangaje icyemezo cyafashe cyo guhagarika shampiyona isigaye. Umikino ya shampiyona yakurikiyeho wongeye gutangira, nyuma y’ubutegetsi bwa Misiri 2013 ku ya 3 Nyakanga 2013, igihe cya Misiri cyahagaritswe kubera impamvu z’umutekano, maze hafatwa icyemezo cyo guhagarika igihe gisigaye cya shampiyona. Igihembwe cyakurikiyeho cyongeye gukinwa byuzuye kandi Hamoudi hamwe na Smouha bari mu ikipe yabaye iya kabiri muri shampiyona.
Ku ya 29 Nyakanga 2014 Basel yatangaje ko basinyanye na Hamoudi ku masezerano y’imyaka ine. Yinjiye mu ikipe ya mbere ya Basel muri shampiyona yabo ya 2014–15 iyobowe n'umutoza mukuru Paulo Sousa. Nyuma yo gukina umukino umwe wikizamini, Hamoudi yakinnye bwa mbere ikipe ye nkuru mu mukino w’igikombe cy’Ubusuwisi ku ya 23 Kanama 2014 ubwo Basel yatsinze ibitego 4–0 na CS Italien (GE). Yakinnye umukino wa mbere muri shampiyona yo mu gihugu maze atsinda igitego cye cya mbere cya shampiyona mu mukino wabereye i St. Jakob-Park ku ya 23 Nzeri 2014. Nicyo gitego cyanyuma cyumukino umupira wari uturutse kuri mugenzi we wo muri Egiputa Mohamed Elneny, kuko Basel yatsinze 3-1 na Vaduz.
Igihembwe 2014–15 cyagenze neza kuri Basel. Basel yinjiye muri Champions League mu matsinda. Bageze mu cyiciro cya knockout ku ya 9 Ukuboza 2014, ubwo bashoboye kunganya 1-1 i Anfield na Liverpool. Ariko bakuwe mu marushanwa na Porto mu cyiciro cya 16. Mu mpera za shampiyona 2014-15, Basel yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona kunshuro ya gatandatu yikurikiranya. Mu gikombe cy'Ubusuwisi 2014–15 Basel yageze ku mukino wa nyuma. Ariko, kunshuro ya gatatu yikurikiranya barangije ari abiruka.
Ku cyumweru tariki ya 5 Kanama 2015 Hamoudi yinjiye muri Zamalek ku nguzanyo kugeza shampiyona ya 2015-16 irangiye, yatangiye bwa mbere ku ya 23 Kanama 2015 maze atsinda ibitego bibiri mu mukino yatsinze CS Sfaxien ibitego 3–1 mu cyiciro cya gatanu cy’amashyirahamwe ya CAF 2015. Igikombe cyamatsinda.
Ku ya 30 Mutarama 2017, Hamoudi yinjiye muri Al Ahly wo muri Al Batin.

Mohamed Hamdy Zaky uzwi nka Mohamed Hamdy (wavutse ku ya 13 Ukuboza 1991) ni umukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga, w’umunyamisiri ukinira mu ikipe ya Ismaily yo mu Misiri muri Shampiyona yi cyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri, nka rutahizamu.
Hamdy yakinnye na Misiri U20 muri 2011 FIFA U-20 Igikombe cyisi.
Hamdy yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru mu Misiri ku ya 8 Kamena 2015, na Malawi.

Malick Evouna (wavutse 28 Ugushyingo 1992) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu mupira wa maguru ukomoka muri wa Gabon ukina nka rutahizamu mu i kipe yo muri Egiputa Aswan SC.
Nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego cumi na bibiri mu mikino 17 muri shampiyona ya 2012–13 muri CF Mounana, Evouna yinjiye mu ikipe ya Maroc Wydad Casablanca atsinda ibitego umunani muri shampiyona ye ya mbere.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2015, hatangajwe ko Evouna yinjiye muri Al Ahly wo mu Misiri.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2016, Evouna yimuriwe muri Tianjin Teda FC yo mu Bushinwa.
Ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 2020, Evouna yimuriwe muri CS Sfaxien wo muri Tuniziya.
Ku ya 4 Nyakanga 2022, Evouna yasubiye mu Misiri asinyira Aswan SC
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 2012, Evouna yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Gabon na Arabiya Sawudite. Yinjijwe mu ikipe ya Gabon mu gikombe cy’Afurika cya 2015 maze atsinda igitego mu mukino ubanza na Burkina Faso.
Kugeza muri Kamena 2016, Evouna yatsinze ibitego 12 mu ikipe yumupira wamaguru ya Gabon.

Yakiniye ikipe yi gihugu ya Misiri y'abatarengeje imyaka 23, Muri 2015, Moussa yasinyanye amasezerano yi myaka 4 na El-Entag, ava muri Wadi Degla na Al Ahly Fc mbere yuko arangira 2010-2011

Sayed Shabrawy (wavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1993) ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwugu wu munyamisiri usanzwe ukina ku ruhande rw'iburyo mu ikipe ya El-Entag El-Harby. Yakinye mu ikipe yi gihugu ya Misiri mu batarenge imyaka17, imyaka20, na imyaka 23.
Shabrawy yatangiye umwuga we muri Al Ahly mu 2000, azamurwa mu ntera azakinira ikipe ya mbere mu 2014. Nyuma yimukiye muri Al Ittihad Alegizandiriya akina shampiyona imwe, kugeza ubwo yongeye kwimuka muri shampiyona ya 2015–16 ku buntu, asinyana amasezerano n’imyaka ibiri na Aswan, aho yakinnye cyane y'umwuga we wabigize umwuga kugeza ubu. Muri 2017, yasinyanye amasezerano yimyaka itatu na El-Entag El-Harby.

Mahmoud Rizk (wavutse 1 Mutarama 1990) ni umukinyi wu mupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka mu misiri ukina nkumukinyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya Al Ittihad yo mu Misiri.
Rizk yavuye muri El Mansoura yerekeza muri Al Ahly mu 2015 afite amasezerano yimyaka 5, ariko yagurijwe muri El Entag El Harby umwaka umwe, muri saison ye ya mbere hamwe na El Entag El Harby, yabonye imvune yimbere yimbere ; icyakora iyi kipe yamusinyanye amasezerano ahoraho na Al Ahly shampiyona irangiye. Muri 2017, yongereye amasezerano na El Entag El Harby imyaka 2. Nubwo yongereye amasezerano, yarekuwe niyi kipe mu mpera za shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri 2017–18, nyuma yaje kwinjira muri Al Ittihad ku buntu.

Ibrahim Hassan Hussein (wavutse 10 Kanama 1966) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukomoka mu Misiri wahoze akina umupira wa maguru anyura iburyo. Ibrahim Hassan yahamagawe mu ikipe yi gihugu icyuro 100 yo muri Egiputa. Impanga ye yitwa Hossam nawe yakinnye umupira wa maguru wa bigize umwuga, bakinanye mu makipe yabo.
Hassan yavukiye i Cairo, yakinnye ubuhanga imyaka igera kuri makumyabiri, mu mwuga aho yasangiye amakipe na murumuna we Hossam ku bwinshi. Yahagarariye Al Ahly (kabiri), PAOK FC, Neuchâtel Xamax, Al Ain SCC, Zamalek SC na Al-Masry, ndetse yinjira mu mpanga ye mu mahanga mu mahanga mu Bugereki, Ubusuwisi na Leta zunze ubumwe z'Abarabu.
Hassan yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru afite imyaka igera kuri 40, akomeza kugira ubuhanga nk'umuyobozi wungirije mu ikipe yahoze yitwa El-Masry, aho murumuna we na we yatangiriye umwuga w'ubutoza mu 2008. Mu mwaka wa 2010, nyuma yigihe gito nk'umuyobozi wungirije hamwe na Zamalek, yabaye umuyobozi wumupira wamaguru.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Hassan yakinnye imikino 125 atsinda Misiri ibitego 12 mumyaka hafi 20, nka Hossam. Yagaragaye mu ikipe y'igihugu mu gikombe cy'isi cya 1990 FIFA, ayifasha kunganya bibiri ndetse no gutsindwa n'Ubwongereza 0–1. Murumuna we na we yari intangiriro idashidikanywaho, kuko aba bombi babaye abakinnyi ba mbere baturutse muri Afurika batoranijwe muri Century Club ya FIFA. Hassan akomeje kuba umupira wamaguru wumupira wamaguru wo muri Egiputa wahisemo amakipe yisi ya FIFA (inshuro eshatu) akina muri 1990 na 1999 na Bosiniya na Afrika yepfo.

Agostinho Cristóvão Paciência uzwi nka Mabululu, (yavutse ku ya 10 Nzeri 1989) ni umukinnyi mpuza mahanga wa bigize umwuga akaba umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Angola ukinira ikipe ya Primeiro de Agosto nka rutahizamu. Yakinnye igikombe cyisi cya FIFA 2014.

Taher Mohamed Ahmed Taher Mohamed Mahmoud (wavutse 7 Werurwe 1997) ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka mu Misiri, ukinira ikipe ya Misiri Al Ahly hamwe ni kipe yi gihugu ya Misiri nkumukinnyi wo kuruhande.
Taher yatangiye umwuga we murii Arab Contractors FC afite imyaka umunani, ubwo yinjiraga bwa mbere mu ikipe nkuru ya 96; yatsitse mu gikombe cy'abakinnyi beza muri 2009, 2010, na 2012. Muri 2008, yakiniye ni kipe y'Abarabu Contractors 1996 mu gikombe cya Danone Nations cyabereye i Paris, aho yerekanye ubuhanga bukomeye ; muri iri rushanwa, umuhanzi w'icyamamare muri Tuniziya Al Zubair Baya yatangaje kuri radiyo ya Al Jazeera ko agomba gutorwa nk'umukinnyi mwiza muri shampiyona. Umufaransa Legend Zinedine Zidane yasinyiye T-shirt igihe yaburaga igikombe.
Mu 2013 umutoza mukuru w’Abarabu Contractors FC "Mountain Wolves", Mohamed Radwan, yamutoranyirije kujya mu ikipe ya mbere nkumukinnyi ukiri muto w’umupira wamaguru w’Abanyamisiri muri shampiyona yambere ya Misiri. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere na Al Ahly FC, "African Club of the Century", maze ikipe ye iratsinda. Taher yatojwe n'umutoza wo mu Misiri Hassan Shehata.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’igihugu cya Misiri ku ya 16 Ugushyingo 2018 mu majonjora y’igikombe cya Afurika cy’igikombe cy’ibihugu yakinnye na Tuniziya, nk'umusimbura w’iminota 86 asimbuye Amr Warda. Taher yari mu rutonde rwa nyuma rw'ikipe y'imikino Olempike yo mu Misiri yatwaye igikombe cya Afurika giheruka cyabereye i Cairo mu Gushyingo 2019 ikanabasha kujya muri Tokiyo 2020
Muri Nzeri 2016, US ESPN yatoranije Taher Mohamed mu bakinnyi 10 ba mbere b’umupira wamaguru ku isi bemerewe kuzamuka hamwe n’amakipe yabo mu gikombe cyisi kizabera mu Burusiya 2018.

Mahmoud Abdel Moneim Abdel Hamid Soliman witwa Mahmoud Kahraba cyangwa Kahraba (wavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1994), ni umukinnyi w’umupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka mu Misiri ukinira ikipe ya Al Ahly SC yo mu Misiri ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Misiri.
Nyuma yo gutangira umwuga nku mukinnyi wuri ukiro muto hamwe na Al Ahly, yatangiye gukina muri shampiyona yicyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri hamwe na ENPPI muri 2011. Yinjiye mu ikipe ya FC Luzern yo mu Busuwisi mu masezerano nki ntizanyo mu gihembwe cya 2013 ariko ava muri iyi kipe muri Werurwe 2014 nyuma y’uko amasezerano ye arangiye na Luzern avugwaho imyitwarire idakwiye. Yagarutse mu Busuwisi muri gihembwe cyakurikiyeho inguzanyo y'amezi atandatu.
Kahraba yatangiye umwuga we na Al Ahly nk'umukinnyi ukiri muto, atsinda ibitego 36 mumikino 20 yakiniye iyi kipe afite imyaka cumi n'itanu nyuma yo kugirana ubufatanye na Trézéguet. Mu gihe yari muri Al Ahly ni bwo yahawe izina rya Kahraba ("Amashanyarazi") n'umutoza w'urubyiruko Badr Ragab kubera imbaraga n'umuvuduko.

Jordan Chipangama (yavutse 12 Ugushyingo 1988) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu kwiruka ukomoka muri Zambiya akaba kabuhariwe muri marato. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya marato y'abagabo mu mikino Olempike ya 2016 aho yarangije ku mwanya wa 93 n'amasaha 2:24:58. Chipangama yize kaminuza muri Amerika. Muri kaminuza, yarushanwe muishuri rya Arizona na kaminuza ya Arizona y'Amajyaruguru.

Chauness Chauzje Choosha (wavutse 31 Ukuboza 1992) ni umukinnyi wa siporo wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Zambiya. Yitabiriye amarushanwa mpuzamahanga yo kwiruka mu nzu ya IAAF 2012 aho yashyizeho agahigo mu gihugu cya Zambiya muri metero 60, maze aviramo muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza cya metero 100 muri Shampiyona nyafurika yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri. Choosha yabonye itike yo kujya mu mikino Olempike ya 2012 akoresheje ikarita ya wildcardgusa ntiyujuje ibihe bisabwa muri metero 100.
Choosha yavutse ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1992 i Monze, muri Zambiya. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Musuku.
Amarushanwa muri Afurika.
Choosha yakoze imikino mpuzamahanga yi mikino ngororamubiri muri Shampiyona yisi ya IAAF 2012 muri metero 60, anashyiraho agahigo mu yigihugu cye Zambiya, akoresheje amasegonda 8.19. Ariko, yarangije umunani (nuwa nyuma) mubushyuhe bwe ntiyakomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Nyuma yaje kujya muri Bénin kwitabira amarushanwa ya Afurika 2012 yaberaga muri Athletisme aho yitabiriye metero 100 ndetse akanitabira kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza akoresheje amasegonda 12:72, ariko akurwa mu marushanwa nyuma ya kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. kuzenguruka. Phiri kandi yitabiriye metero 200 ariko ntabwo yakoze kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza nyuma yo kurangiza bwa nyuma mubushyuhe bwe na 30 muri rusange.
Choosha yujuje ibisabwa mu mikino Olempike ya 2012 yabereye i Londres abinyujije ku ikarita yerekana ikarita nyuma yuko umukinnyi wiruka intera ndende Tonny Wamulwa yakomerekeye mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda ibyumweru bitatu mbere yuko imikino itangira. Yitabiriye metero 100 mu bagore mu cyiciro kibanza ku ya 3 Kanama maze ashushanya ubushyuhe bwa mbere, arangiza ari uwa kane mu bakinnyi umunani, akoresheje amasegonda 12:29. Kuva mu 2016, igihe ni cyiza ku giti cye. Yashyize imbere ya Afa Ismail wo muri Maldivies (amasegonda 12.52) na Rima Taha wa Yorodani (amasegonda 12.66) mu bushyuhe buyobowe na Feta Ahamada wo muri Comoros (amasegonda 11.81). Muri rusange, yarangije ku mwanya wa 57 kuri 78 bahanganye, kandi ntiyigeze yinjira mu cyiciro cya mbere kuko igihe cye cyihuta cyatinzeho amasegonda 0.05 ugereranije n’umukinnyi watinze cyane wateye imbere.

Hamdy Fathy Abdelhalim Abdelfattah (yavutse 29 Nzeri 1994) ni umukiinyi wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga uvuka mu Misiri ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya Al Ahly mu cyiciro cya mbere muri Egiputa ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Misiri.
Ku ya 14 Ukwakira 2019, Fathy yatangiye gukinira mpuzamahanga maze atsinda igitego kimwe rukumbi yatsinze Botswana igitego 1-0. Hamdy yagaragaye mu mukino wanyuma wa 2021 AFCON na Senegal.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo byerekana intego ya Misiri mbere."

Edwin Kwabla Gadayi (yavutse 14 Gashyantare 2001) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa mu kwiruka muri Gana. Muri Mata 2021, yashyizwe mu itsinda ry'abagabo batanu bitabiriye imikino ngororamubiri ku isi yabereye i Silesia, muri Polonye. Yitabiriye kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri metero 200 mu mikino nyafurika yabereye muri Maroc aho yari uwa 4 akoresheje iminota 20.92. Muri Nyakanga 2022, yashyizeho agahigo mu ikipe yi gihugu muri metero 200 muri Shampiyona ya 2023 yabereye i Cape Coast mu gihe cy'amasegonda 20.848.
Gadayi afite icyicaro mu karere ka Ashanti muri Gana. Ni umunyeshuri wa kaminuza ya Cape Coast.
Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri Shampiyona nyafurika U20.
Yagaragaye kandi nk'uwatsinze mu ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri muri Gana ryaberaga muri Shampiyona yabereye muri Paa Joe muri KNUST.

Mahmoud Naim (wavutse ku ya 9 Mata 1994) ni umukinnyi wu umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga wo mu Misiri ukinira ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'igihugu cya Misiri Aswan SC nka myugariro. Yahoze ari umukinnyi wa sosiyete ya Eastern SC, Ceramica Cleopatra.

Moses Mumba Yavukiye i Kitwe mu gihugu cya Zambiya kandi yari umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu marushanwa yo gusiganwa ku maguru muri metero 800. Yahagarariye Zambiya mu 2004 na Olempike ya 2012. Mumba yitabiriye amarushanwa atatu mu gikombe cy'isi, mu mikino ngororamubiri (IAAF). Mu myaka ya 2005, 2009 na 2011, yaserukiye igihugu cye cya Zambiya mu mikino ibiri ya Afurika. Muri 2007 na 2011, yari umutozawo'abasiganwa ku maguru mu ishuri muri Californiya. Mumba yari afite ibendera rya Zambiya mu birori byo gutangiza no gusoza imikino Olempike ya 2012..
Ku myaka 18 y'amavuko, Mumba yari yitabiriye imikino ya Commonwealth 2002 ndetse no mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 mu mikino ngororamubiri. Nyuma yaje kwinjizwa muri kaminuza ya Oral Roberts, aho yari umuntu uhagaze neza. Mumba ni umunyamuryango wa kaminuza ya Oral Roberts Hall of Fame. Nyuma ya kaminuza, yatangiye siporo yabigize umwuga hamwe na Santa Monica Track Club.
Mu mwaka wa 2016 yagaragaye mu bucuruzi bwiswe "ICYIZERE" cyo kwiyamamaza kwa Footlocker "Ubuzima Bwuzuye x Abiruka nyabo", kuri ubu hategurwa filime ku buzima bwe. Filime izerekanwa izayoborwa na Ashley Avis, ikanakorwa na Cary Granat, Michael Flaherty, na Edward Winters.

Kabang Mupopo (wavutse ku ya 21 Nzeri 1992) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Zambiya akaba wegukanye umudali wa zahabu muri metero 400 muri Shampiyona nyafurika yo muri 2015.
Mupopo yatangiye gukina umupira afite imyaka 11, Yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore ya Zambiya; Nka kapiteni, yayoboye Zambiya mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika 2014, aho baviriyemo mu matsinda.
Mupopo yatangiye siporo mu mpeshyi ya 2014, yiruka muri metero 53.44muri metero 400 bwa mbere. Yaserukiye Zambiya mu mikino ya baguva icyongereza 2014 yabereye i Glasgow, aho yakoresheje amasaha 53.09 akaza gusezererwa muri kimwe cya kabiri. Muri, yatsindiye ifeza muri 51.21 mu gikombe cya Afurika cyabereye i Marrakech, yica amateka ya Zambiya; Yatakaje zahabu Folashade Abugan wo muri Nijeriya, wirutse icyarimwe, arangije ifoto. Mupopo yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo ahagararire Afurika mu marushanwa ya Afurika IAAF 2014, no muri Marrakech, aho yegukanye umwanya wa kane maze azamura igihugu cye agera kuri 50.87. Mupopo yahawe buruse y’amezi 18 na komite olempike ya Zambiya mu 2015, imwemerera kwibanda ku mikino ngororamubiri aho kuba umupira.
Muri Gicurasi 2015, Mupopo yagaragaye bwa mbere muri IAAF Diamond League i Doha, arangiza ari uwa karindwi muri 51.88. Muri Nyakanga 2015, yirukanye 50.86 muri La Chaux-de-Fonds, atunganya amateka ye ku munsi utarenze ijana ku isegonda. Yatoranijwe mu gikombe cy'isi cya 2015 i Beijing.

Racheal Nachula (wavutse 14 Mutarama 1986) ni umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Zambiya wahoze akina siporo ukina nku mukinnyi ukina imbere muri shampiyona ya Espagne mu ikipe ya Zaragoza hamwe ni kipe yi gihugu ya bagore ya Zambiya.
Imikino ngororamubiri.
Azobereye muri metero 400, Nachula yegukanye umudari wa bronze muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya 2008, mugihe cyiza cyamasegonda 51.39. Yitabiriye imikino ya Commonwealth mu 2006, Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 2006, Shampiyona y’imbere mu 2008, ndetse n’imikino Olempike yo mu 2008 atujuje ibyiciro byanyuma. Yatsindiye umudari wa silver muri 400 m mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika yo mu 2009, yandika igihe cya 53.34 amasegonda.
Afite kandi amasegonda 23.42 muri metero 200, yagezweho muri Gicurasi 2007 muri Gaborone.

Rhoda Njobvu (yavutse 29 Mutarama 1994) ni umukinnyi uvuka muri Zambiya akaba ari kabuhariwe mu gusiganwa ku maguru akaba yarabigize umwuga.
Njobvu yungutse ubunararibonye mpuzamahanga bwa mbere mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza 2014, aho yarushijwe muri metero 400 akoresheje amasegonda 57.47 mu cyiciro cya mbere. Muri 2016, yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri Shampiyona nyafurika yabereye i Durban muri 200m. Muri Shampiyona Nyafurika ya 2018 yabereye i Asaba, muri Delta, yongeye kugera muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza, kuri iyi nshuro muri metero 100, yongeyeho, yegukanye umudari wa bronze mu kwiruka metero 4x400, ashyiraho amateka y’igihugu muri gahunda hamwe na 3.38.18s.
Muri Gicurasi 2021, yitabiriye imikino ngororamubiri ku isi yabereye i Chorzów, muri Polonye. We na bagenzi be basibye umukino wa nyuma nyuma yo kwiruka 44.81 s mu cyiciro kibanza muri Gicurasi 2021.
Mu 2021 yashyizeho ibyiza ku giti cye muri metero 100, ku isaha ya 11.12 akaba ari cyo gihe cyambere ku isi, ihuza Tiana Wilson mbere yuko ikubitwa na Nzubechi Grace Nwokocha. Yashimangiye kandi umwanya we mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yatinze 2020. Nyuma yaho gato, yongereye rekodi zirenga 200m agera kuri 22:69 azamura Kabange Mupopo amateka yambere yigihugu kuva muri 2017 hafi igice cyamasegonda, kandi yujuje metero 200 mumikino olempike ya 2020. Njobvu ntabwo yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu mikino Olempike haba muri ibyo birori. Njobvu yayoboye imikino yombi mu mikino ya Commonwealth 2022 maze agera muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu kwiruka metero 200 aho yaje ku mwanya wa kane mu isiganwa rye yiruka amasegonda 23.72 kandi afite umwanya wa cumi na kane wihuta muri rusange.

Gerald Phiri (wavutse ku ya 6 Ukwakira 1988) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru uvuka muri Zambiya wirukankaga muri metero 60, metero 100 na metero 200 mu marushanwa atandukanye. Yatangiye siporo yiga mu ma shuri mato, akomeza umwuga muri kaminuza yo muri amerika. Yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere watsizwe i rushanwa inshuro 100–200 mu marushanwa yabereye mu nzu nini ya 12 kandi yegukana igihembo muri amerika yose. ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga muri Shampiyona yi si ya 2009 yabaye yasoreje muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri metero 100. Mu mwaka wa kabiri muri kaminuza yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu birometero 60, yegukana imidari itatu muri 2010.
Nyuma yitabiriye amarushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu ya IAAF 2012, yitabira imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi 2012 yabereye i Londres. Yaviriyemo muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza akomeza kurushanwa mu mwaka wa kurikira. Phiri yabuze amahirwe yo gutwara umudari mu marushanwa ya IAAF 2014 yaberaga mu nzu ya metero 60, maze ava mu marushanwa nyafurika yaberaga muri Athletisme nyuma yimyaka ibiri kubera imvune. Ntiyashoboye kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri metero 100 mu mikino Olempike ya 2016 nyuma yo kurangiza umwanya wa kane mu bushyuhe bwe.
Phiri yavutse ku ya 6 Ukwakira 1988 mu bitaro bikuru bya Ndola, muri Zambiya. Ni umuhungu wa Huggins na Bestoria Phiri kandi afite barumuna be bavukana. Umuryango we wimukiye muri Afurika y'Epfo mu 1996, ariko nyuma wi mukira mu mujyi wa Mid Wales wa Welshpool nyuma yuko nyina abonye akazi muri icyo gihugu. Phiri yize Abbeydale Grange School i Sheffield ahugura hamwe na City of Sheffield na Dearne Athletic Club iherereye mu majyepfo ya Yorkshire. Yakinnye umupira akiri ku ishuri maze ahabwa umwanya mu ishuri rya Sheffield ku wa gatatu ariko aranga kuko yashakaga kwibanda ku mikino ngororamubiri, anakina Basketball na Badminton. Phiri yahawe impamyabumenyi muri kaminuza ya Texas A&amp;amp;M muri Gicurasi 2012, nyuma yimukira i Orlando, muri Floride. Yahisemo kaminuza kugira uburambe bwo guhindura ubuzima. Phiri mu kiganiro 2012 yavuze ko intego za siporo ari Usain Bolt, Yohan Blake na Tyson Gay. Yahoze ahagarariye Ubwongereza ariko yerekeza muri Zambiya mu 2009, kandi afite ubwenegihugu bubiri bw'ibihugu byombi.
Ishuri, icyiciro rusange nakazi.
Yirukanye umuyaga ufashwa n amasegonda 11,76 namasegonda 11,85 mumikino ya metero 100 mugihe mumwaka wa 7. Byari kuba amateka mashya yigihugu ariko ntibyamenyekanye kubera ko aherutse kugera mubwongereza. Phiri yavumbuwe n’umwarimu we wigisha ibijyanye n’umubiri mu mwaka wakurikiyeho ku munsi w’imikino ngarukamwaka w’ishuri maze amenya ko afite impano muri siporo nyuma yo gutsinda ibirori bye mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri y’ishuri ry’icyongereza mu 2003. Muri 2005 yanditse amajwi ya gatatu yihuta cyane muri metero 100 mu Bwongereza mu mateka ya siporo y'abatarengeje imyaka 17, ku masegonda 10:51. Phiri yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza metero 100 muri Shampiyona y’Ubwongereza (AAA), maze akora metero 60 mu nzu mu mukino umwe, arangiza ari uwa gatanu muri rusange. Yavuze ko ibisubizo bibi biterwa no kugira ibibazo mu mugongo nubwo imyitozo yo mu itumba. Phiri yabaye Nyampinga w’Amashuri mu Bwongereza 2006, kandi yegukana igihembo cya Harold Whitham kubera kubona ibihembo byiza ku mukinnyi wa Sheffield muri ibyo birori.
Imikino Olempike n'andi marushanwa.
Yatoranijwe guhagararira Zambiya mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu ya IAAF 2014 yabereye muri Polonye. Phiri yatsindiye ubushyuhe muri metero 60 akoresheje amasegonda 6.59 kandi abasha gukomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri mu bushyuhe bwa gatatu bwa kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza, ariko ntiyabura kubona umudari arangiza ku mwanya wa gatanu ku mukino wa nyuma hamwe n’igihe cya gatatu n’uwa kane. Phiri yazamutse ku mukino wa nyuma wa metero 100 muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya 2016 yaberaga muri Athletisme ariko aragenda kubera imvune yo mu kibuno yagize muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri ibyo birori kandi ntiyabasha kwitabira isiganwa rya metero 4 x 100. Mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro, yegukanye umwanya wa kane akoresheje amasegonda 10.27 mu bushyuhe bwe bwa metero 100 kandi ntiyitabira kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Phiri yari afite ibendera rya Zambiya mu birori byo gusoza.

Sydney Sido Siame (yavutse 7 Ukwakira 1997) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru agakora na siporo uvuka muri Zambiya. Yarushanwe muri metero 200 mu marushanwa y'isi ya 2015 yabereye i Beijing gusa ntiyakomeza mu cyiciro cyisumbuye. yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu mikino Olempike y'urubyiruko 2014.
Kwiruka amasegonda 9.88 byanditswe kuri 100 m i Lusaka muri 2017, ariko igihe cya Siame nticyakuwe kurutonde rwisi hashingiwe ku gihe giteye inkeke. Bibaye ku nshuro ya mbere umunya Zambiya arenga kuri bariyeri y'amasegonda 10 no kuzamura bidasanzwe amasegonda 0.34 ku mukinnyi.

Anthony Tonny Wamulwa (wavutse ku ya 3 Kanama 1989) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Zambiya wiruka intera ndende nka mrato akaba kabuhariwe muri metero 5000.
Nkumukinnyi muto warangije icya cumi (muri metero 3000) muri Shampiyona yisi y’urubyiruko mu 2005, icya cumi mu mikino ya Commonwealth 2006, uwa karindwi muri Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 2006 na gatanu muri Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 2008. Mu mwaka wa 2008 yegukanye umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa yo kwambukiranya imipaka y’akarere ka Afurika yepfo, bivuze ko yari yujuje ibisabwa mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo kwambukiranya imipaka yabereye i Edinburgh mu 2008, aho yarangije ari cumi na karindwi mu bakinnyi 109 bari mu isiganwa ry’abato. Yari yarangije icyenda mu 2007.
Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'isi ya 2007 ndetse n'imikino Olempike yo mu 2008 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.

Dennis Banda (wavutse ku ya 10 Ukuboza 1988) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga akaba ari myugariro w'umupira w'amaguru uvuka i Lusaka muri Zambiya mu ikipe ya Green Buffaloes muri Zambiya. Yari afite ibyifuzo byinshi byo gukina muri shampiyona ya 2010/11 i Burayi cyangwa muri Amerika yepfo aho umukozi wa FIFA Marcelo Houseman yakoraga kumasezerano. Yakiniye ikipe nkuru inshuro 29 haba mu gikombe cyisi ndetse no mu gikombe cy’Afurika.
Dennis ntaho ahuriye na perezida wa Zambiya Rupiah Banda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya anakinira igihugu cye mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA U-20 2007 cyabereye muri Kanada.

Emmanuel Banahene Osei (wavutse ku ya 16 Kanama 1988) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukina umupira wa maguru muri Gana. Banahene yakina cyane nka rutahizamu, uwo kuruhande cyangwa umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga.
Banahene yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Gana Stay Cool FC Nyuma yimukira mu bihugu mpuzamahanga, aho yari mu ikipe yatsindiye ku nshuro ya 3 irushanwa rya Mylik Classic U-19, ryakinnye hagati ya 27 na 29 Ugushyingo 2005 muri Dansoman Park, Accra, Gana. Kamena 2006, Umutima w'Intare FC yamusinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 3. Yaje kugurwa n’uruhande rwa Isiraheli Hapoel Petach Tikva mu mpeshyi ya 2008. Ariko, yabonye amahirwe make yo gukina mu gice cya mbere cya shampiyona ya 2008/2009, nyuma aza kugurizwa mu cyiciro cyo hasi Ramata Shalon. Inguzanyo ye irangiye, mu Kwakira 2009, yasubiye muri Gana gusinyana amasezerano mashya yumwaka umwe na Heart of Lions FC, atangira ku nshuro ya kabiri muri iyi kipe. Mu mwaka wa 2010, Banahene yongeye kugurishwa, noneho kuri Berekum Chelsea, hanyuma umwaka ukurikira, mu ikipe ya Orduspor yo muri Turukiya. Muri 2012, yagurijwe mu ikipe ya TFF ya mbere ya Giresunspor. Mu mpeshyi ya 2012, yasinyanye na Karşıyaka amasezerano y’umwaka umwe. Ku ya 24 Ukuboza 2012, yahagaritse amasezerano yagiranye na Orduspor. Muri Mutarama 2015 yasinyiye Ismaily SC mumasezerano yimyaka ibiri nigice.
Ku ya 26 Kamena 2022, Banahene yinjiye mu ikipe ya Al-Zulfi yo muri Arabiya Sawudite. Ku ya 5 Mutarama 2023, Banahene yarekuwe.

Kåre Becker (wavutse 27 Mutarama 1978) ni umukinnyi yahoze akina umupira wa maguru muba bigize umwuga wakinnye imbere ukomoka muri Zambiya.
Becker yavukiye muri Zambiya na se wa Malawi na nyina wa Zimbabwe, yimukiye mu Buholandi afite imyaka 5 nyuma yo kuba muri Irilande y'Amajyaruguru na Noruveje.
Mu 2000, Becker yagurijwe Heracles Almelo mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'Ubuholandi. Igihembwe cya 2000–01 kirangiye, abajijwe icyo yashakaga kubona mu mishyikirano mishya, yasabye umwanya wo gutekereza. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, ariko, ikinyamakuru cyaho cyatangaje ko kuvugurura amasezerano "byahagaritswe kubera umushahara ukabije".
Muri 2001, Becker yasinyiye urundi ruhande rwa kabiri, PEC Zwolle. Ariko, muri iki gihembwe, umuyobozi Paul Krabbe [nl] yasimbuwe na Peter Boeve, wamufashe nabi ndetse anamuha ikindi cyumba cyo gufungiramo. Kubera iyo mpamvu, yavuye mu mpera za 2001–02.
Mu 2004–05, Becker yasinyiye Eintracht Nordhorn mu cyiciro cya kane cy’Ubudage, ariko ntiyakinnye neza kuko "yasuzuguye cyane umupira w’Ubudage".

Mzansi Shadrack Biemba (4 Mutarama 1965 - 8 Gicurasi 2010) yari umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wari warabigize umwuga wavukaga muri Zambiya.
Biemba wakinnye nk'umuzamu, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika y'Epfo muri AmaZulu, mbere yakiniye Bloemfontein Celtic.
Biemba kandi yari ahagarariye uruhande rwigihugu cya Zambiya, agaragara inshuro 12 hagati ya 1990 na 1994.
Nyuma Biemba abaye umutoza wizamu hamwe n’ikipe ya Afurika yepfo Moroka Swallows, ukora muri uwo mwanya hagati ya 2006 na 2010.
Biemba yapfuye azize kanseri ku ya 8 Gicurasi 2010 afite imyaka 45.

Charles Bwale (wavutse ku ya 29 Nyakanga 1976) ni umutoza w’umupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga akomoka muri Zambiya akaba yarahoze atoza ikipe ya Konkola Blades. yari umukinnyi ukona inyuma nka myugariro, akaba yarakinnye imikino icyenda mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya kuva 2000 kugeza 2003. Yakinnya ikipe ya Zambiya mu marushanwa y’igikombe cya Afurika 2002. Bwale yagizwe umutoza wa Konkola Blades mu mpera za 2020.

Chanda Bwalya ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga wu mupira wa maguru ukomoka muri Zambiya. Yahoze akinira muri Terengganu FA muri Maleziya. Yahoze kandi akinira ikipe yu mupira wa maguru yi gihugu ya Zambiya.

Johnson Bwalya (wavutse ku ya 3 Ukuboza 1967) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Zambiya wahoze akina umupira wa maguru akaba yarakinaga mubi mbere. Umwuga we wose wo gukina yawumaze mu Busuwisi mu gihe yari ahagarariye, ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Hamwe na Zambiya, yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 1988.
Bwalya yavukiye Mufulira, yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Kantanshi maze atangira umwuga we mu ikipe yavukiyemo ya Butondo Western Tigers. Mu 1986, yinjiye muri Mufulira Wanderers, yegukana umupira w'amaguru w'umwaka muri shampiyona ye ya mbere muri iyi kipe. Shampiyona irangiye, yasinyiye ikipe yo mu Busuwisi FC Friborg.
Nyuma yaje gukinira FC Sion, FC Bulle, SC Kriens, FC Luzern, na SR Delémont.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Bwalya yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya muri Mata 1987 mu majonjora yo gukina imikino ya Afurika yose yakinnye na Malawi i Lusaka kandi yari mu ikipe ya Zambiya yujuje amajonjora mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1988 yabereye i Seoul. Yatsinze igitego muri Zambiya yatsinze Ubutaliyani 4–0 mu nzira yo kuba ikipe ya mbere ya Afurika yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza. Nyuma yo kunyura hejuru ya myugariro, Bwalya yakubise ishoti kuri metero zigera kuri 35 zinyeganyega kandi zirohama munsi yumupaka. Mu mukino wahuje Ubudage bw’iburengerazuba Zambiya yatsinzwe 4–0, yarakomeretse. Ntiyigeze agaragara muri Zambiya mu myaka ine yakurikiye.
Amaze gukira, Bwalya yagaruye imiterere maze asubira ku mwanya we mu ikipe y'igihugu kandi yagombaga gufatanya n'ikipe mu mukino wa Senegali gusa amenya ko indege yari itwaye iyi kipe yaguye mu nyanja mu mpanuka ya Gabon. Igihe ikipe nshya yari iteraniye ni Bwalya na Kalusha Bwalya bayoboye iyi kipe, bombi batsinze igitego mu mukino wahuje Maroc na Bwalya babona igitego batsinze bafite metero 25 barasa 2-1.

Larry Bwalya (wavutse 29 Gicurasi 1995) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukina umupira wa maguru ukomoka muri Zambiya ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati wa Simba muri Tanzaniya ni kipe yu mupira wa maguru yi gihugu ya Zambiya.
Bwalya yasinyanye na Simba SC ku ya 15 Kanama 2020 ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu. Umukinnyi wo hagati rwagaragaye mu mikino ibiri mu marushanwa ya CAF Champions League ya 2020–21, atangira imikino na FC Platinum ku ya 6 Mutarama 2021, no mu mukino wo mu matsinda yatangije na AS Vita Club.

Taonga Bwembya (yavutse ku ya 11 Kamena 1995) ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Zambiya ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya mashyamba ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya.
Bwembya yagize uruhare runini mu kuyobora ikipe ye ku mwanya wa kabiri mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Zambiya mu 2014, agera ku ntego muri cyiciro cya mbere nyuma y’imyaka icyenda ihagaze. ayobora iyi kipe ye ku mwanya wa gatanu ushimishije muri shampiyona ye ya mbere nka capitaine. Mbere yigihembwe cya 2016, yabaye myugariro wifunzwa, yanga ibyifuzo byamakipe menshi akomeye. Muri uwo mwaka, Inzererezi zabonye abayobozi bane batandukanye bayobora itsinda, kandi birinda cyane kumanuka. Bwembya yavuze ko gukina kwabo ari impinduka zikunze gukorwa ku ntebe ya tekiniki.
Amaze kuyobora kapiteni Wanderers imyaka ibiri, yinjiye muri Zanaco mbere yigihembwe cya 2017. Amarushanwa ye ya mbere mu ikipe yaje muri Gashyantare, mu cyiciro cya mbere cyo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Shampiyona cya CAF 2017. Bwembya yagizwe umukinnyi w’umukino w’abafana mu mukino wa Zanaco watsinze igitego cya mbere cyatsinzwe na nyampinga w’u Rwanda APR FC. Mu mukino wa kabiri, yatsinze igitego cyonyine mu gutsinda Zanaco 1-0 kugirango abone umwanya wabo mu cyiciro gikurikira. Ibi kandi byabaye intego ye yambere hamwe niyi kipe. Batsinze club yo muri Tanzaniya Young Africans nyuma yibyo kugirango babashe kujya mu matsinda. Ku munsi wanyuma wumukino wamatsinda, Zanaco ikeneye amanota imwe kugirango itere imbere, Bwembya yirukanwe mugihe bakinnye na Wydad Casablanca. Nyuma yiminota icumi, Wydad yatsinze igitego, bituma atera imbere kuko Zanaco yarangije umwanya wa gatatu maze ikurwaho kubitandukaniro. Yagizwe kapiteni w'ikipe mbere ya shampiyona ya 2019.
Imibare mpuzamahanga.
Bwembya, wakuriye i Mufulira, yashyigikiye Mufulira Wanderers FC gukura.

Emmanuel Chabula (wavutse ku ya 10 Mutarama 1998) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zambiya ukina nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere mu ikipe ya Lusaka Dynamos hamwe ni kipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Chabula yerekeje ku rwego mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga ku ya 2 Kamena 2019 atsinda penaliti 4-2 (2-2 nyuma yo gutegekwa) yatsinze Malawi, atsinda igitego cye cya mbere mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga ku munota wa 89 wuwo mukino.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo urutonde rwa Zambiya ibitego byambere."

Miguel Changa Chaiwa (wavutse ku ya 7 Mata 2004) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Zambiya ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga, ukinira ikipe ya Young Boys yo mu Busuwisi ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Zambiya.
Ibicuruzwa byurubyiruko bya Shamuel Academy, Chaiwa yinjiye muri club ya Zambiya Atletico Lusaka ku nguzanyo mu 2022. Yimukiye mu ikipe y’abasuwisi Young Boys ku ya 14 Kamena 2022, asinya amasezerano yimyaka 4.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Chaiwa ni urubyiruko mpuzamahanga muri Zambiya, akaba yaraserukiye Zambiya U17 muri 2019 na 2020. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu nkuru ya Zambiya mu mukino wa gicuti yatsinzwe na Iraki ku ya 20 Werurwe 2022.
Se wa Chaiwa, Changa na we yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga muri Zambiya.

Linos Chalwe (wavutse 17 Nzeri 1980) ni rutahizamu wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga akaba akomoka muri Zambiya.
Yabaye mu ikipe ya Zambiya 2006 y’igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika, yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu mu itsinda C mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’amarushanwa, bityo ananirwa kubona amajonjora yo kujya muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza.

James Chamanga (wavutse 2 Gashyantare 1980) ni umukinnyi w'umupira wa maguru wa bigize umwuga wo muri Zambiya ukina nka rutahizamu mu ikipe ya Red Arrows.
Igitego cya Chamanga kuri Bafana Bafana cya muhesheje kwi mukira mu mahanga mu gihe Bush Bucks ikipe ye y'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika y'Epfo icyo gihe ya musinyishije muri 2005. Nyuma yuko Bush Bucks asezerewe mu 2006 yasinyanye na Supersport United aho ari we watsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi kipe muri shampiyona ya 2006–07.
Ku ya 9 Ukuboza 2007, Chamanga yatsinze ibitego bitanu yatsinze Swallows mu mukino wa shampiyona 6-2. Harimo hat-trick hagati yiminota 20 na 24.
Muri Mata 2008, Chamanga yimukiye mu ikipe ya Dalian Shide yo mu Bushinwa Super League, nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego 14 muri Premier League ya ABSA muri Moroka Swallows muri shampiyona ishize.
Ku ya 6 Gicurasi 2012, Chamanga yagaragaye muri shampiyona ya 100 muri Dalian mu mukino yatsinze ibitego 4-1 iwayo na Tianjin Teda. Yatsinze hat-trick muri uyu mukino.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Chamanga yagaragaye bwa mbere ku rwego mpuzamahanga ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2005 na Botswana nyuma y'amezi atanu atsinda igitego cye cya mbere mpuzamahanga mu mukino wa kimwe cya kabiri cy'igikombe cya COSAFA na Afurika y'Epfo.
Yabaye mu ikipe ya Zambiya 2006 y’igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu itsinda C mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’amarushanwa, bityo ananirwa kubona amajonjora yo kujya muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza. Yatsinze igitego cya Zambiya na Sudani (Igikombe cy’Afurika 2008) mu gutsinda Chipolopolo ibitego 3-0. Chamanga kandi yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya Zambiya mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika 2006 na Tuniziya.

Beston Chambeshi (wavutse 4 Mata 1960) ni umutoza wu mupira wa maguru ukomoka muri Zambiya kandi yahoze ari umukinnyi wabigize umwuga.
Chambeshi yakinnye umupira wamaguru wa Nkana.
Yahagarariye Zambiya mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1988.
Yatoje ikipe ya Zambiya Power Dynamos kuva 2012 kugeza 2013. Yabaye umuyobozi w'ikipe y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 ya Zambiya muri 2017, anabayobora mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA U-20 2017. Yahujije uruhare rwe n’uruhande rwamakipe Nkana, kandi yatsindiye igihembo cyumutoza wumwaka wa FAZ 2017.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, nyuma yo kwegura kwa Wedson Nyirenda, yagizwe umuyobozi w'agateganyo w'ikipe nkuru ya Zambiya. Yasimbuwe n'umuyobozi w'Ububiligi Sven Vandenbroeck muri Nyakanga 2018.
Muri Nyakanga 2021, Chambeshi yagizwe umuyobozi wa Zambiya, asimbuye Milutin Sredojević.

Daniel Nathaniel (wavutse ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1992) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukina umukino wamaboko wa volleyball wo muri Nigeriya ukina muri Sunshine Spikers ya Akure ndetse n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Nijeriya ya bagabo.
Yahawe impamyabumenyi ya muri electoronike, ukina nk'umukinnyi wa Nijeriya Sunshine Spikers volley ball Team, Akure, muri Leta ya Ondo. Daniel akina kandi mu ikipe ya Men volleyball A mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Nigeriya y'abagabo.
Ni kapiteni w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Nigeriya Mens ya Volleyball. Daniel Nathaniel yari mu ikipe yatsindiye Shampiyona y’igihugu ya mbere ya Volleyball i Bauchi muri 2019.
Yabaye kandi mu ikipe yegukanye igikombe cya 2022 cy’ubumwe bw’ubumwe bw’akarere ka Kwara muri Leta ya Kwara itsinze New Waves yo muri Leta ya Ogun muri iri rushanwa. Kimwe mubyo yagezeho ni ukuyobora ikipe ya nigeriya ya mens ya volley ball mu mikino nyafurika yo muri 2019 muri Maroc.

Ezzaki Badou uzwi ku izina rya Zaki (wavutse 2 Mata 1959) ni umutoza wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga muri Maroc ndetse akaba yarahoze ari umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga wa kinnye ari nku muzamu. Ezzaki Badou ubu ayobora CS Chebba.
Zaki yavukiye muri Sidi Kacem, Zaki yari ahagarariye AS Salé, Wydad AC, RCD Mallorca na Fath Union Sport mu myaka 17 yamaze akora umwuga. Hamwe na Mallorca, yasinyiye mu 1986 nyuma yo kwitwa umupira wamaguru w’Ubufaransa nkumukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru w’umwaka muri Afurika, yatsindiye kuzamuka muri La Liga mu 1989 ubwo yatwaraga igikombe cya Ricardo Zamora.
Zaki yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Maroc mu gikombe cy'isi cya 1986 ndetse n’igikombe cy’ibihugu bine bya Afurika. Mu marushanwa yahoze, yabereye muri Mexico, yafashije igihugu cye mu cyiciro cya 16 ; byongeye kandi, uwahawe imipira 76 yuzuye yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 1984.
Mu 2006, Zaki yatoranijwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira wamaguru nyafurika nkumwe mu bakinnyi 200 b’umupira wamaguru muri Afurika mu myaka 50 ishize.
Zaki yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 1993 afite imyaka 34, ahita aba umuyobozi. Mu 2002, nyuma yo gutoza amakipe menshi, harimo n'ahahoze ari FUS na WAC, yagizwe umuyobozi wa Maroc, ava ku mwanya we nyuma y’imyaka itatu agaruka muri Gicurasi 2014. Yagiye ku bwumvikane muri Gashyantare 2016.
Zaki yaje gusubira mu mirimo ya club, akomeza kuyobora impande nyinshi.

Mustapha El-Biyaz nanone yitwa El-Biaz (yavutse ku ya 12 Gashyantare 1960) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga ukina nka myugariro avuka i Taza muri Maroc.
El Biyaz yakinnye umupira wamaguru muri KAC Marrakech muri Botola. Yagize kandi "amarozi" muri make na FC Penafiel muri Liga ya Porutugali muri shampiyona ya 1987–88.
El Biyaz yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru muri Maroc mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1984 no mu mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cy'isi cya 1986.
Mu 2006, yatoranijwe na CAF nk'umwe mu bakinnyi 200 b'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika beza mu myaka 50 ishize.

Noureddine Bouyahiaoui (yavutse 7 Mutarama 1955) ni umugabo wahoze ari umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru wakina nka myugariro wu mupira wa maguru muri wa Maroc yakiniye ikipe yigihugu ya Maroc mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1986. Yakiniye nanone KAC Kenitra.

Yakoze umwuga we wu mupira wa maguru mu Bufaransa aho yari mu ikipe ya Maroc mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1986 na 1994. Yarushanwe kandi muri Maroc mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1984.
