Abdelaziz El Idrissi Bouderbala (wavutse ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1960) yahoze ari umukinyi wu mupira wa maguru wabigize umwuga muri Maroc. Mu 2006, yatoranijwe na CAF yari mubakinnyi 200 bakina umupira w'a maguru muri Afurika mu myaka 50 ishize.
Aziz CHAR yatangiye umwuga we wabigize umwuga i Wydad Casablanca, mbere yo kwimukira muri FC Sion, Matra Racing na Olympique Lyon yo mu Bufaransa nyuma. uwahoze ari umukinnyi yakoraga nk'umuyobozi wa tekinike mu ikipe ye ya mbere Wydad Casablanca. Yakiniye kandi GD Estoril-Praia ukomoka muri Porutugali. Mu 1986, Bouderbala yegukanye umwanya wa kabiri mu gihembo cy'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika.
Bouderbala yakinnye imikino 57 mu ikipe yumupira wamaguru yigihugu ya Maroc kandi akina imikino yanyuma yigikombe cyisi cya 1986.
Muri 2015, yabaye ambasaderi w'igikombe cya SATUC, irushanwa rishya ry’abagiraneza ku isi ry’imfubyi U16, impunzi n’abana batishoboye.
Aba i Canton, muri Leta ya Michigan, hamwe n'umugore we n'abana bane.

Khalid Mustafa Khalifa al-Aruri uzwi ku izina rya Abu al-Qassam mu cyarabu, yari umukinnyi ukina umukino wo kurwana (umurwanyi) muri kisilamu,na Palesitine hamwe na Yorodani yari umuyoboke wa al-Qaeda, akaba yari umuyobozi w'abashinzwe kurinda idini.
Khalid al-Aruri yavutse ku ya 25 Nyakanga 1967, avukira i Ramallah ku nkombe y'Iburengerazuba. Yakuriye mu mujyi wa Zarqa muri Yorodani kandi yari umuturage wa Yorodani.
Igihe yari i Zarqa yahuye na Abu Musab al-Zarqawi maze mu 1989 aba bagabo bombi bajya muri Afuganisitani, bahaguma kugeza mu 1993. Mu 1991, bivugwa ko yakoreye umuryango mpuzamahanga utabara imbabare wa kisilamu. Kuva ku ya 29 Werurwe 1994 kugeza muri Werurwe 1999, bafungiye hamwe muri Yorodani maze al-Zarqawi ashinga umuryango we wa Bayt al-Imamu. Nyuma yo kurekurwa kwabo, bombi bongeye kujya muri Afuganisitani aho Al-Aruri abaye umuyobozi w'ikigo cya Al-Zarqawi imyitozo ya jihadi hafi ya Herat.
Umubano hagati y’umuyobozi mukuru wa al-Qa'ida Sayf al-Adl na Khalid al-Aruri watangiye mu 1999 igihe Abu Musab al-Zarqawi yagiraga inama n’ubuyobozi bwa al-Qa'ida i Kandahar mbere yo gufungura imyitozo ye hafi ya Herat. Ku bwa al-Adl, al-Zarqawi "yakundaga gutemberana na Khalid al-Aruri na Sulayman Darwish Abu-al-Ghadiyah."
Nyuma yuko Zarqawi n'abantu be bavuye muri Afuganisitani mu 2001, al-Aruri yari umwe mu bajyanama b'imbere ba Zarqawi bizewe maze aba umwe mu bahuza bakomeye na Ansar al-Islam mu majyaruguru ya Iraki. Al-Aruri yakoraga nk'umuyobozi wa kimwe cya kane cya al-Zarqawi kandi yari ashinzwe imyitozo mu majyaruguru ya Iraki. Abu al-Qassam yitabiriye inama ikomeye n'abantu begereye Mullah Krekar muri Kanama 2003 i Tehran.

Mohamed Timoumi (yavutse 15 Mutarama 1960) yahoze ari umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Maroc. Yahawe igihembo cyu mupira w'a maguru muri Afurika mu mwaka wa 1985, kandi ni we mukinnyi wa nyuma we gukanye iki gihembo ubwo yakinaga umupira wa maguru mu gihugu cya Afurika. Muri 2006, CAF yamutoranyirije kuba umwe mu bakinnyi 200 bakomeye bu mupira wa maguru muri Afurika mu myaka 50 ishize.
Uyu mukinnyi yitabiriye igikombe cyisi cya FIFA mu 1986 muri Mexico. Ku rwego rw'amakipe, Mohammed Timoumi yatsindiye CAF Champions League hamwe na FAR Rabat, ikipe ikomeye y'umupira w'amaguru muri Maroc mu gihe cye. Yarushanwe kandi muri Maroc mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1984
Mohamed Timoumi yakinnye akiri muto muri Union of Touarga, aho yari umukinnyi muto. Aho niho yaboneye indorerezi n'inzobere mu mupira w'amaguru muri Maroc.
Impano ye yatumye yinjira muri imwe mu makipe akomeye ya Maroc: FAR Rabat, wegukanye igikombe cya CAF mu 1985.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo byerekana ibitego byambere bya Maroc, urupapuro rwerekana amanota nyuma ya buri gitego cya Maroc".

Hassan Akesbi (wavutse 5 Ukuboza 1934 apfa ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 2024) yahoze ari umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Maroke afite ubwenegihugu bwa merika wahoze akina umupira wamaguru wakinaga mu bi mbere mu kibuga.
Mu mwaka wa 2006, Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika (CAF) ryatoranije Akesbi nk'umwe mu bakinnyi 200 b'umupira w'amaguru bakomeye bo muri Afurika mu myaka 50 ishize.

Abdelkrim Merry uzwi ku izina rya Krimau ni umukinnyi wahoze akina umupira wa maguru wari wa rabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Maroke wakinaga ku mwanya wi mbere mu kibuga.
Krimau yavukiye i Casablanca, muri Maroc, yamaze ubuzima bwe bwose mu Bufaransa, agera ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya UEFA 1978 na SC Bastia.
Krimau yari mu ikipe ya Maroc yo mu 1986 mu gikombe cyisi cya FIFA maze atsinda igitego kimwe yatsinze Portugal ibitego 3-1. Mu mikino 13 mpuzamahanga kuva 1976 kugeza 1989, Krimau yatsinze ibitego bitanu.
Umwuga wo kwigisha / gutoza.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2012, Krimau yatangiye umwuga wo gutoza hamwe na Olympique Marrakech.
Krimau agaragara buri cyumweru muri TV Yerekana Kurambura kuri TV ya Arryadia.

Hassan Nader (wavutse 8 Nyakanga 1965) ni umugabo wahoze umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Maroke afite ubwenegihigu bwa merika wahoze akina umupira wamaguru wakinaga imbere mu kibuga.
Yakoresheje igice kinini cyimyaka 21 yakinnye muri Porutugali - akusanya imikino 219 ya Primeira Liga yose hamwe n'ibitego 94 - cyane cyane hamwe na Farense, aho yarengeje ibitego 100.
Nader yavukiye i Casablanca, yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Wydad AC yaho mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe ya RC Lallor ya La Liga mu 1990–91. Igihembwe cya kabiri kirangiye, ikipe ya Balearic Islands yasubiye ku rwego rwa mbere, maze yinjira mu mutoza Lorenzo Serra Ferrer muri manda ye.
Muri Nyakanga 1992, Nader yerekeje muri SC Farense muri Primeira Liga, aba umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona mu 1994–95 n'ibitego 21 kandi yagize uruhare runini mu majonjora ya Algarve mu gikombe cya UEFA. Mu myaka umunani, yakinnye mu ikipe hamwe n’umuturage Hajry Redouane.
Nyuma Nader yinjiye muri SL Benfica, ariko agaragara nabi mu bihe bibiri maze yimukira i Farense, aho yari kuguma kugeza mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2004 afite imyaka 39, mu gihe iyi kipe yimukiye mu cyiciro cya kane Terceira Divisão yatsinze 11. shampiyona ibitego mu mwaka wa nyuma.
Umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa Maroc inshuro 15, Nader yakinnye mu gikombe cyisi cya FIFA mu 1994, atsinda Ubuholandi mu kunganya mu matsinda 1-2, no mu gikombe cy’Afurika cyo mu 1992.
Umuhungu wa Nader, Mohcine, nawe ni umupira wamaguru na rutahizamu. Yavukiye muri Porutugali, yanakoresheje ubuzima bwe bwose muri iki gihugu.

Hicham Zerouali uzwi ku izina nka Zero cyangwa Umupfumu wa Maroke (wavutse 17 Mutarama 1977 - 5 Ukuboza 2004) ni umugabo wahoze ari umukinnyi wu mupira wa maguru ukomoka muri Maroke.
Yakinaga mubi mbere mu kibuga hagati muri Maroke, muri Scotland na United Arab Emirates. Yakinnye imikino 7 muri Maroke ku isi.
Nyuma yo gukinira muri Maroc kavukire ya Yaakoub El Mansouria na Polisi ya USP, Zerouali yasinywe n’umuyobozi wa Aberdeen Ebbe Skovdahl ukomoka muri FUS de Rabat mu Gushyingo 1999 ku mafaranga 450.000, abigiriwemo inama n’umuyobozi w’umupira w’amaguru., Keith. Burkinshaw. Yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere muri Scotland wambaye ishati ya '0' mu 2000, yabujijwe muri shampiyona ya 2000 na Premier League ya Scotland n'Ubwongereza.
Muri Mutarama 2000, Zerouali yatsinze igitego cya metero mirongo itatu ku busa mu gikombe cya Scottish Cup cya kane cyatsinzwe na St Mirren kugira ngo yongere yongere. Zerouali yahise atsinda ibitego 2-0 kuri Pittodrie kugirango afashe iyi kipe mu cyiciro gikurikira cyamarushanwa. Aberdeen yageze ku mukino wanyuma w'igikombe cya Scottish 2000 ndetse na FA Cup 2000 hamwe na Zerouali bakina imikino yombi, nubwo batsinzwe na Celtic na Rangers.
Muri Kanama 2000, Zerouali yavunitse akaguru mu mukino wahuje Motherwell, nyuma aza kubura umwanya mu mikino Olempike yabereye i Sydney, amaherezo amara umwaka adakina. Muri kimwe mu bihe atazibagirana nyuma yo kugaruka, yatsinze Hat-trick na Dundee.
Al-Nassr mwene FAR Rabat.
Nyuma yuko amasezerano ye muri Aberdeen arangiye, yahise agaruka gukina umupira wamaguru muri United Arab Emirates hamwe na Al-Nassr umwaka umwe, mbere yo gusubira mu gihugu cye cya Maroc mu 2003, asinyira FAR Rabat. aho yatsindiye Coupe du Trone muri uwo mwaka.
Zerouali yakinnye imikino 7 mu ikipe yumupira wamaguru ya Maroc maze atsinda ibitego bitatu. Yakiniye Maroc mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu byabereye muri Mali mu 2002 maze atsinda ibitego bibiri yatsinze Burkina Faso ibitego 2-1. Yakinnye kandi muri Shampiyona y’urubyiruko mu 1997. Yari mu ikipe mpuzamahanga ukwezi mbere yuko apfa.

Samir Hadji (wavutse 12 Nzeri 1989, avukira i Creutzwald) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga wu mupira wa maguru ukinira ikipe ya Luxembourg club F91 Dudelange nku mukinnyi wi mbere mu kibuga. Yavukiye mu Bufaransa, ahagarariye igihugu cya mavuko cya Maroc ku rwego mu bato.
Ni umuhungu w'uwahoze akinira Maroc Mustapha Hadji. Se wabo wa Hadji yahoze ari umukinnyi wa AS Nancy Youssouf Hadji. Se wabo yamusobanuriye ko "arangiza vuba kandi siporo".
Hadji yatangiye gukina muri club yavukiyemo SR Creutzwald. Muri 2007, yinjiye mu Budage asinyana na 1. FC Saarbrücken muri Oberliga, igice cya gatanu cyumupira wamaguru wubudage. Nyuma yimyaka ibiri, Hadji yasubiye mu Bufaransa ajya mu ikipe yahoze yitwa AS Nancy. Yamaze imyaka ibiri akinira ikipe y’abakunzi ba Championnat de France, akina imikino 59 ndetse atsinda ibitego 18 mbere yo gusinyana na RC Strasbourg muri Nyakanga 2010. Hadji yatangiye umwuga we ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2010 mu mukino wa Coupe de la Ligue w'iyi kipe na Évian. Hadji yatangiye umukino akina iminota 120 yuzuye kuko Strasbourg yatsinzwe 5-4 kuri penariti.
Nyuma yo gukinira CS Fola Esch mu gice cy’igihugu cya Luxembourg, Hadji yimukiye muri Excelsior Virton muri 2019.
Hadji yakinnye umukino umwe muri Maroc U23 banganya 0-0 na Niger U23 ku ya 1 Ugushyingo 2011.

Badr El Kaddouri (wavutse ku ya 31 Mutarama 1981) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga mu mupira wa maguru uri mu kiruhuko cyi zabukuru muri Maroke, uheruka gukinira ikipe ya Dynamo Kyiv yo muri Ukraine. Yari nu munyamahanga wa Maroke. El Kaddouri yakinaga ibumoso yashoboraga no gukina hagati mu kibuga.
El Kaddouri yatangiye umwuga we muri Wydad Casablanca mu 2000. Mu 2001, yafashije iyo kipe gutwara Igikombe cya Maroc. Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yinjiye muri Dynamo Kyiv.
El Kaddouri yinjiye muri Dynamo Kyiv mu 2002, kugeza igihe inguzanyo ye yimukiye muri Celtic mu 2011, yari umwe mu bakinnyi bamaze igihe kinini muri iyi kipe. Yatangiye gukina na Dynamo ku ya 17 Kanama 2002 atsinda Volyn Lutsk ibitego 3–1. Igihe yari muri iyo kipe, yatsindiye ibikombe bine bya Shampiyona yo muri Ukraine, ibikombe bine bya Ukraine ndetse n’ibikombe bitanu bya Ukraine. Yagaragaye mumikino 123 ya shampiyona mugihe rimwe na rimwe yayoboraga ikipe.
Ku ya 31 Kanama 2011, El Kaddouri yasinyiye ikipe ya Celtic yo muri Scottish Premier League ku masezerano y'inguzanyo y'amezi atandatu ahitamo kugura. Niwe muntu wa mbere muri Maroc wakiniye Celtic. Yazanywe nk'igifuniko cya Emilio Izaguirre, wakomeretse igihe kirekire. Ku ya 10 Nzeri 2011, El Kaddouri yakinnye bwa mbere muri Celtic muri 4–0 yatsinze Motherwell. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere kuri Celtic mu mukino wa Derby Old Firm na Rangers ku ya 18 Nzeri 2011 maze agaragara inshuro 6 mu ikipe ya Ecosse mbere yo gusubira muri Dynamo Kyiv muri Mutarama 2012.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
El Kaddouri yakinnye igihugu cye cyose hamwe 45 kandi yari asanzwe mu gihugu. Yitabiriye kandi imikino Olempike yo mu 2004 hamwe n'ikipe ya Olempike ya Maroc.

Sofian Benzouien (wavutse 11 Kanama 1986) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga mu mupira wa maguru uri mu kiruhuko cyiza. Yavukiye mu Bubiligi, ariko yari umunya Marke ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w’urubyiruko rwo muri Maroc mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’urubyiruko ya FIFA mu 2005, Benzouien yari yarakinnye mu makipe y’urubyiruko n’abakinnyi ba Anderlecht, Beringen-Heusden-Zolder na Bruxelles. Muri Mutarama 2007, yavuye mu ikipe ya Espagne Racing de Santander B (ikipe yabigenewe ya Racing de Santander)
Muri Kanama 2007, yinjiye muri Perugiya ya Serie C1. Amaze gukina imikino 4 gusa muri saison ya 2007–08, na nil muri saison ya 2008–09, yahagaritse amasezerano yagiranye niyi kipe mubwumvikane.
Muri Mutarama 2009, yinjiye muri Eupen mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'Ababiligi. Muri Nyakanga 2010, yasinyiye F91 Dudelange mu gice cy’igihugu cya Luxembourg. Yakiniye Dudelange kugeza shampiyona ya 2018-19 irangiye.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Amahanga U20 yo muri Maroc, Benzouien yahamagaye muri Maroc U23 kumukino wa gicuti, kugirango yitegure irushanwa rya CAF ryabagabo ryabanjirije imikino Olempike.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2019, Benzouien yimukiye mu ikipe ya Swift Hesperange yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Luxembourger, aho yatorewe kuba umuyobozi wa siporo ndetse anaboneka muri iyi kipe ikindi gihembwe kimwe nkumukinnyi uhagaze neza. Iyi kipe yatandukanye na Benzouien muri Nzeri 2022.

Salma Khabot (yavutse ku ya 29 Kamena 2001) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga mu ikipe ya kayaker yo muri Maroc.
Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri K4 500m hamwe na Laila Bouchir, Chaymaa Guemra na Zina Aboudalal muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya 2019.

Mustafa Ahmed Bakali uzwi ku izina rya Mustapha Bakkali (wavutse 1924 kugeza ku ya 13 Nyakanga 2005) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukina umukino wa chess ukomoka muri Maroke ndetse akaba utegura ibiremereye. Yatsindiye Shampiyona ya mbere ya Chess muri Maroke mu 1965, yabaye perezida wa Federasiyo ya Chess muri Maroke (FRME) kuva 1975 kugeza 1986.
Mustafa Bakali akomoka muri Tétouan. Yatsindiye Shampiyona ya mbere ya Chess ya Maroc yabaye kuva ku ya 24 Nyakanga kugeza ku ya 1 Kanama 1965 muri club y’ubumwe mu mujyi yavukiyemo, aho yatsinze 6/7 mu cyiciro cy’abakinnyi umunani. Yatsindiye neza izina rye mu 1966, yegukana igikombe cya gatatu mu 1973 atsinda Ahmed Bennis mu mukino wabereye i Rabat.
Bakali yakiniye Maroc mu mikino Olempike ya Chess inshuro enye:
Bakali yari umunyamuryango washinze ishyirahamwe ry’imyuga rya Royal Maroc mu 1963, kandi yayoboye inama y'ubutegetsi mu buryo butemewe kuva 1965 kugeza 1969. Yabaye perezida wa federasiyo kuva 1975 kugeza 1986. Yabaye kandi umunyamuryango wa Federasiyo ya Chess.
Bakali yapfiriye i Tétouan ku ya 13 Nyakanga 2005 afite imyaka 81, nyuma y'uburwayi bumaze igihe.

Mohamed Tissir (wavutse 1976) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukina umukino wa chess Maroke.
Yatsindiye igikombe cya Afurika muri Chess muri 1999, Shampiyona ya Chess ya Maroc mu 1996, 1999 na 2005, kandi ahagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino Olempike itari mike. Yatsindiye kandi umudari wa zahabu mu mikino ya 36 ya Chess Olympique ya Palma de Mallorca (Espagne) mu 2004 ndetse anatsinda imikino y'Abarabu yabereye muri Yorodani mu 1999.
Yakinnye mu gikombe cyisi cya Chess 2000, aho yarangirije hepfo yitsinda D, ndetse na FIDE World Chess Championship 2004, aho yatsinzwe na Alexey Dreev mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Ubu ni umutoza wa chess.

Ali Sebbar ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukina umukino wa chess akaba yaragaragaye mu mikino yi si.
Sebbar yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona ya Maroc muri 2013, ahagararira igihugu cye mu mikino Olempike myinshi, harimo 2004 na 2014, anakina Shampiyona y'isi ya Chess 2013, yakiriwe na Sergey Karjakin. Yamutsinze mu cyiciro cya mbere.

Hichem Hamdouchi (yavutse ku ya 8 Ukwakira 1972) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga uvuka i Tangier muri Maroke afite umwenegihugu byu bufaransa ukina umukino wa chess.
Hamdouchi yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona cya chess muri Maroke inshuro cumi n'umwe, kuva mu 1988 afite imyaka 15, ubwo yemererwaga bwa mbere gukina amarushanwa akomeye. Muri uwo mwaka, mu marushanwa ya Casablanca, yamenyekanye kubera impano ye yujuje ibisabwa mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Maroke kwitabira imikino ya Chess muri Olympikee yo mu 1988 yabereye i Tesalonike. Afite imyaka 17 yabashije kujya mu majonjora yo muri Afurika mu gikombe cy’isi cya makipe yabaye aya mbere i Lucerne. yatsinze bidasanzwe kuri Jeroen Piket, John Fedorowicz na Ye Jiangchuan.
Mu 1990 muri Olympique ya 29 ya Chess yabereye i Novi Sad yatsinze 8/11, nyuma yaho aruhuka chess kugirango yige. Afite imyaka 20, mu 1992 yakinnye neza mumarushanwa menshi yuburayi. Muri uwo mwaka yakinnye muri 30 ya Chess Olympiade yitwaye neza 7.5 / 11. Yatsindiye muri Sitges na Ceuta mu 1992, aho yakuye amahame ya nyirakuru wa mbere. Mu 1993 yatangiye kwiga Ubukungu muri kaminuza ya Montpellier. Ukuboza 1993 yatsindiye amarushanwa ya master yabereye i Montpellier hamwe na 7/9, abona amahame ye ya kabiri. Nyuma y'amezi make yahawe izina rya nyirakuru. Icyo gihe yari umwe muri ba nyirakuru batatu bo muri Afurika, abandi babiri ni abakinnyi bo muri Tuniziya Slim Bouaziz na Slim Belkhodja.
Mu 1994 yatsindiye amarushanwa ya Masters yabereye i Casablanca maze mu 1995 aba Nyampinga w’Abarabu Chess i Dubai, igitaramo azagisubiramo mu 2002 na 2004. Mu 1996 yongeye gutsinda amarushanwa akomeye ya grandmaster yabereye i Montpellier, aho yize ubucuruzi ubu. Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye mu 1998, yatuye muri Espagne kandi atsinda amarushanwa muri Dos Hermanas, Bolzano na Djerba.
Yongeye gutsindira i Montpellier mu 2001 maze muri uwo mwaka aba Nyampinga wa Chess muri Afurika imbere ya Watu Kobese wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Mu 2002 yatsindiye kumugaragaro muri Nice, Belfort na Coria del Rio. Muri Mutarama 2003 yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 75 ku isi afite amanota 2615.
Muri FIDE World Chess Championship 2004 yabereye i Tripoli yazamutse mu cyiciro cya gatatu, aho yakuweho 0.5-1.5 na Michael Adams waje ku mwanya wa kabiri. Mu 2005 yatsindiye muri Castelldefels, mu 2006 i Salou no muri 2007 muri Saint-Affrique. Mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’i Burayi mu Kwakira 2007, yakiniye ikipe ya Basque Gros Xake Taldea.
Muri 2009 Hamdouchi yimukiye muri Federasiyo ya Chess. Muri 2013 yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona y’Ubufaransa kandi yari umwe mu bagize ikipe y’Ubufaransa yegukanye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona y’amakipe yabaye aya mbere iwayo i Warsaw.
Yashakanye na Nyiricyubahiro Nyiricyubahiro Adina-Maria Hamdouchi.

Abderrahmane Boushita (yavutse 5 Nzeri 1997) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu mukino wa jido ukomoka muri Maroke. Yahagarariye Maroke mu mikino nyafurika ya 2019 yegukana umudari wa feza mu bagabo batarengeje ibiro 66.
Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'ibiro 66 mu bagabo mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Judo ya 2017, mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Judo ya 2018 ndetse no muri Shampiyona y'isi ya Judo ya 2019.
Mu marushanwa ya Afurika 2021 yabereye i Dakar, muri Senegali, yegukanye umudari wa bronze mu bagabo 66 kg.

Zahira El Ghabi ni umugore wu muhanga wu mukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu mukino wa chess,wo muri Maroke FIDE, WFM, 2005.
Mu ntangiriro ya 2000, yari umwe mu bakinnyi ba chess bakomeye muri Maroc. Mu 2000, Zahira El Ghabi yitabiriye Shampiyona y’abagore ku isi mu mukino wa chess na knockout ndetse no mu cyiciro cya mbere yatsinzwe na Julia Demina.
Zahira El Ghabi yakiniye Maroc mu mikino Olempike y'abagore:
Kuva mu 2006 ntiyakunze kwitabira amarushanwa ya chess.

Imad Bassou (wavutse 4 Nyakanga 1993) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu mupira wa maguru ukomoka muri Maroc.
Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro, mu basiganwa 66 kg.
Murumuna we Issam Bassou nawe ni umucamanza.
Mu 2021, yarushanwe mu bagabo 66 kg mu bagabo 2021 ba Judo World Masters yabereye i Doha, muri Qatar.

Soumiya Iraoui (yavutse ku ya 19 Werurwe 1996) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga mu mikino wa Jido ukomoka muri Maroke. yabonye umudari wa feza mu mikino nyafurika yegukana imidari itatu, harimo imidari ibiri ya zahabu, muri Shampiyona nyafurika ya Jido. Yahagarariye Maroke mu mikino Olempike ya 2020 yabereye i Tokiyo, mu Buyapani.
Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa ye muri Shampiyona Nyafurika ya 2018 yabereye i Tunis, muri Tuniziya. Yitabiriye kandi isiganwa ry’ibirometero 57 mu bagore mu mikino ya Mediterane ya 2018 yabereye i Tarragona, Cataloniya, Espanye.
Muri 2019, yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu marushanwa y'abagore 52 kg mu marushanwa ya Afurika ya Judo yabereye i Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatsindiye kandi umudari wa feza mu isiganwa ry’ibiro 52 mu bagore mu mikino nyafurika ya 2019 yabereye i Rabat, muri Maroc. Muri uku kwezi, yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa y'abagore 52 kg mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Judo ya 2019 yabereye i Tokiyo, mu Buyapani. Ukwezi kumwe, yatsindiye umudari umwe wa bronze mu birori bye muri Judo Grand Prix Tashkent ya 2019 yabereye i Tashkent, muri Uzubekisitani.
Yatsindiye kandi umudari wa silver muri iri rushanwa mu marushanwa ya Afurika ya Judo ya 2020 yabereye Antananarivo, Madagasikari. Mu 2021, yarushanwe mu bagore 52 kg mu bagore muri Judo World Masters i Doha, muri Qatar aho yakuweho na Réka Pupp wo muri Hongiriya mu mukino we wa mbere. Muri Shampiyona yo muri Afurika 2021 yabereye i Dakar, muri Senegali, yegukanye umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa ye.

Rachid Rguig (wavutse 1 Nzeri 1980) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukina umukino wa Jido muri Maroke, wakinnye mu cyiciro cya kabiri cyoroheje. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu cyiciro cye mu marushanwa ya Afurika ya Jido yo mu 2009 yabereye i Port Louis muri Maurice, nu muringa mu marushanwa ya Afurika ya Jido yo mu 2008 yabereye i Agadir, muri Maroke.
Rguig yari ahagarariye Maroc mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2008 yabereye i Beijing, aho yarushanijwe mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'abagabo (66) kg). Yakiriye neza umukino wa kabiri wibanze, mbere yo gutsindwa, na ippon (point point) hamwe na juji gatame (ukuboko kwinyuma-perpendicular), kwa Benjamin Darbelet w’Ubufaransa. Kubera ko uwo bahanganye yateye imbere mu mukino wanyuma, Rguig yatanze irindi shoti ry'umudari wa bronze yinjira mu cyiciro cya repechage. Kubwamahirwe, yatsinzwe kumukino we wambere numunyakanada Sasha Mehmedovic, watsinze neza waza-ari awasete ippon (point point) hamwe na kata gatame (gufata urutugu), muminota ibiri namasegonda mirongo itatu n'atandatu.

Ikipe Hockey y'igihugu ya Maroke y'abagabo ni ikipe iyoborwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’amagare mu bwami bwa Maroke, ni umunyamuryango w’ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry’imikino ya ice (IIHF). Iyi ikipe ikinira kuri sitade iherereye mu murwa mukuru Rabat muri Maroke.
Muri Kamena 2008, Maroc yitabiriye Igikombe cya mbere cy’Abarabu cyabereye Abu Dhabi, cyanarimo amakipe yaturutse muri Alijeriya, UAE na Koweti. Umukino wa mbere wa Maroc watsinzwe na UAE 9-0 ku ya 16 Kamena 2008. Umunyamerika Yassin Ahrazem yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Koweti mu gikombe cy’abarabu 2008. Ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2010, IIHF yatangaje ko ubu Maroc ari umunyamuryango.

Ikipe y'igihugu ya basketball ya Marocke ihagararira igihugu cya Maroke mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga basketball. Iyi kipe iyoborwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Basketball muri Maroke, rizwi nka FRMBB. Iyi kipe yagaragaye igihugu muri FIBA AfroBasket inshuro 20 yegukana umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa ya 1965 no mu 1968, Marocke iya kabiri.

Ishyirahamwe Michlifen Ifrane Basket-ball, rizwi nka AMI Basket, ni ikipe ya basketball ya Maroke ifite icyicaro i Ifrane. Ikipe irushanwa muri Diviziyo, shampiyona y'igihugu yo hejuru. Cercle Municipal de Casablanca bakunze kwita CMC ni ikipe yabigize umwuga ikia imikino ya basketball, ni igice cy'ishyirahamwe ryi mikino myinshi, rifite icyicaro mu mujyi wa Casablanca, muri Maroke.
CMC yashinzwe mu 1934 ku bushake bwa bamwe mu bayobozi b'umugi, hagati ya Casablanca (Parike y’Abarabu) ikwirakwira ku buso bwa m 8000 m 2, CMC ni imwe mu makipe ya mbere ya siporo muri umujyi.
Mu 1972, CMC yegukanye umwanya wa kabiri mu gikombe cya Maroc (Coupe du Trône de basket-ball) maze ijya mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’i Burayi cya 1972–73 aho Mounier Wels (66-) yavanyweho mu cyiciro cya mbere. 99 ku ijana i Casablanca na 58-107 i Wels, Otirishiya).

AS Salé uzwi kandi nka Club Sportive Salé, ni ikipe ya bigize umwuga ya basketball ikomoka muri Maroke aho muri Salé. Iyi kipe irushanwa mu cyiciro cya Basketball ya afuruka ya babigize umwuga yitwa BAL. Abakinnyi bazwi muri iyi kipe barimo abakinnyi bakomeye ba basketball muri Maroc Abderrahim Najah, Zakaria El Masbahi na Soufiane Kourdou.
Salé yatwaye igikombe cya Maroc inshuro 9 nigikombe cya Maroc inshuro 11. Iyi kipe yegukanye igikombe kimwe cyumugabane, FIBA Champion Cup yegukanye muri 2017. Salé kandi yitabiriye imikino ibiri ibanza ya Shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball (BAL).
Igice cya basketball cyikipe yimikino myinshi AS Salé cyashinzwe mu 1928. Iyi kipe yakinnye mu cyiciro cya Excellence Division, icyiciro cya mbere cya Maroc, ariko ntago yegukanye igikombe cya mbere cya shampiyona kugeza mu 2010.
Ku ya 20 Ukuboza 2017, Salé yegukanye igikombe cya Afurika cya FIBA 2017, igikombe cya mbere mpuzamahanga cya Salé ndetse n’icyubahiro cya mbere mu ikipe ya Maroc muri ibyo birori mu myaka hafi 20. Yabikoze atsinda Étoile de Radès muri Radès, atsinda umukino wa nyuma 77–69. Umutoza mukuru w'ikipe yatsinze yavuze El Bouzidi. Nyuma yaya marushanwa, Abdelhakim Zouita wo muri Salé yahawe igihembo cy’umukinnyi ufite agaciro muri iri rushanwa mu gihe Abderrahim Najah yabonye umwanya mu bakinnyi batanu.
Ibikurikira nibikoresho bya AS Salé muri saison ya 2022 BAL.

Shampiyona yi gihugu nicyo cyagezweho cyane muri siporo cyangwa amarushanwa ayo ari yo yose mu ikipe yi gihugu cyangwa imbere mu gihugu. Umutwe wacyo akenshi ufatwa nki rushanwa, sisitemu yo ku rutonde, ingano, ubushobozi, n'ibindi. Ibi bigena ishyirahamwe ryiza, umuntu umwe (cyangwa ikindi kigo) mu gihugu kimwe no mu bindi bice. Inshuro nyinshi, gukoresha ijambo igikombe cyangwa amarushanwa ni uguhitamo amagambo uzaba uwambere.

Jon Carter Kent (wavutse ku ya 7 Gicurasi 1979) ni umukinnyi wa ruhago ukomoka muri Afurika yepfo. Yakinnye imikino ibiri umunsi umwe mu 2002. Yasezeye mu mukino wa Cricket mu mwaka wa 2011 nyuma yo gukurwa mu masezerano yi kipe ya Cricket ya Dolphins.

Gemma Acheampong (wavutse ku ya 13 Gashyantare 1993) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga uvuka muri Ganaufite ubwenegihugu bwa merika akaba ari kabuhariwe mu gusiganwa ku maguru. George Wilson Acquaah (3 Ukwakira 1925 - 18 Ukuboza 1963) yari umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wari wara bigize umwuga wa komokaga muri Gana witabiriye imikino Olempike 1952.
Mu 1952, George Acquaah yagaragaye nk'umwe mu bakinnyi barindwi bitabiriye Gold Coast mu mikino Olempike yaberaga mu murwa mukuru wa Finlande Helsinki. Mu bushyuhe bwa karindwi mu kwiruka metero 100 umusore wimyaka 26 yavanyweho akoresheje amasegonda 11.1 kumwanya wa gatanu. Mu bushyuhe bwa kabiri bwa metero 4 × 100 relay ikipe ya Gold Coast, hamwe na Acquaah nkuwiruka wa kabiri hamwe na Gabriel Laryea, John Owusu na Augustus Lawson, babonye umwanya wamasegonda 42.1 babashyira kumwanya wa kane, byongeye biganisha kuri an kurandura.

Ubuzima bwo hambere.

Janet Amponsah (yavutse ku ya 12 Mata 1993) ni umukinnyi w’umugore wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Gana. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu gikombe cyisi mu 2013 ntiyageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Yatsindiye umudari muri metero 4 × 100 muri Shampiyona ebyiri nyafurika no mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2010. Yatoranijwe nk'utwaje ibendera rya Gana mu muhango wo gutangiza imikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2014, kandi yatowe nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Gana muri 2015. Ntabwo yagize amahirwe yo kwitabira igikombe cyisi cyabereye mu Bushinwa mu 2015, biturutse ku bibazo yari afite cya viza ye. Mu mikino Olempike ya 2016, yitabiriye metero 200 na metero 100.
Yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri nyuma ya Cote d'Ivoire Marie Josee Ta Louat muri metero 100 mu bagore mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika 2018 yabereye Asaba, muri Nijeriya.

Kenneth Ekow Andam (wavutse ku ya 8 Mutarama 1976) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Gana wasezeye mu marushanwa ya metero 100 mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2000 yabereye muri Ositaraliya. Andam yarushanwaga muri amerika mu gusiganwa ku maguru mu ma rushanwaga muri kaminuza.
Kenneth Ekow Andam yavutse ku ya 8 Mutarama 1976. ni mwene Takoradi wo muri Gana. Ababyeyi be ni Kenneth na Janet Andam, bivugwa ko akomoka mu idini.
Imyitozo ngororamubiri.
Mu 1995, Andam yatsinze inshuro eshatu mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri nyafurika yabereye i Bouaké, muri Kote Divuwari muri metero 15,63 ndetse na Shampiyona yo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba asimbuka i Banjul, muri Gambiya. Yashyizeho agahigo ishuro eshatu yo gusimbuka metero eshatu muri metero 16.02, umujyi uri mu majyaruguru ya Gana mu marushanwa hagati ya zone ya 1995 maze aba umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bagabo muri iryo rushanwa.
Andam yize muri kaminuza aho yarushanwe mu gusiganwa ku maguru muri metero 100, metero 200, metero 4 × 100, no gusimbuka aharehare. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2012, afite amanota meza mbere kuri muri buri gikorwa, harimo amateka y’ishuri mu marushanwa ya 4 × 100 yashyizweho mu 1999 hamwe n’umunyakanada Lewonarido amasegonda 38.88. Andam iri ku mwanya wa gatatu kurutonde rwi bihe byose inyuma ya Frank Frederick na Myles-Mills, naho uwa gatatu inyuma ya Frederick na Oluyemi Kayode.
Yahawe Andam ni ibihembo by’Iburengerazuba, harimo n’umwaka wa mbere w’umwaka haba mu nzu ndetse no hanze, igihembo cy’imisozi y’iburengerazuba hamwe n’imikino ngororamubiri hamwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri ry’igihugu Icyubahiro cy’Abanyamerika. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2011, afite agahigo y'ibihe byose bya mumisozi muri metero 60 na metero 200, no hanze metero 100 na metero 200.
Mu 1999, Andam yabaye uwa 11 mu gihugu muri metero 100 na 7 muri metero 200 kandi yabaye u wa mbere mu gusimbuka birebire na 4 X 100. yakomeretse ubwo yamanukaga ntiyabasha kwitabira isiganwa rya metero 60 na 20. Mu marushanwa ya NCAA yo mu 1999 yaberaga hanze yaberaga i Boise, muri Idaho, yazamutse hamwe na Myles-Mills kugera muri kimwe cya kabiri cya metero 200 ndetse n’ikipe ya 4 X 100 iri ku mwanya wa mbere mu gihugu, yujuje ibisabwa ku mukino wa nyuma.. hamwe no muri kimwe cya kabili yihuta cyane. Andam yakomeretse mbere yumukino wanyuma, kandi ikipe ya yarangije iza ku mwanya wa gatatu mu gihugu.
Andam yakomeretse ukuguru kwavunitse muri Mutarama 2000, ariko akira gukina umukino wamuhesheje inshuro ebyiri umusozi wa West West Conference Abagabo Hanze Hanze Yumukino wumukinnyi wicyumweru. Muri icyo gihembwe, yabaye nyampinga wa MWC muri metero 100 na 200, kandi yujuje ibisabwa muri metero 100 na 4 X 100 mu marushanwa ya NCAA yo mu 2000 yo hanze no mu murima yabereye i Durham, muri Karoline y'Amajyaruguru.
Amarushanwa mpuzamahanga.
Mu 1999, Andam yaserukiye Gana muri metero 200 mu marushanwa y'isi yabereye i Seville muri Espanye mu 1999. Yarangije ku mwanya wa gatandatu mu bushyuhe bwe bwa mbere (amasegonda 21.31) ananirwa gukomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri. Mu mwaka wa 2000 mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu byabereye muri Alijeriya, Andam yegukanye umudari wa bronze muri metero 100 (amasegonda 10.33) n’umudari wa zahabu mu ikipe ya Gana ya 4 × 100 (amasegonda 39.90). Mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2000 yabereye i Sydney, yaserukiye Gana muri 4 X 100; ariko, ikipe ye yananiwe kurangiza ishyushye rya play off. Andam kandi yitabiriye metero 100 muri Shampiyona y'isi 2001 yabereye i Edmonton, muri Kanada. Mu bushyuhe bwe bwa mbere, yarangije umwanya wa gatatu muri 10.40 kugirango abone itike yo kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Ingaruka ku bidukikije ku buhinzi bw’inyamanswa ziratandukanye kubera ibikorwa bitandukanye by’ubuhinzi bikoreshwa ku isi. Nubwo bimeze gurtyo, ibikorwa byose byu buhinzi bya garagaye ko bifite ingaruka zitandukanye ku bidukikije. Ubuhinzi bw’inyamaswa, umusaruro w’inyama bushobora gutera umwanda, ibyuka bihumanya ikirere, gutakaza urusobe rwi binyabuzima, indwara, no gukoresha cyane ubutaka, ibiryo, n’amazi. Inyama ziboneka hakoreshejwe uburyo butandukanye, harimo ubuhinzi-mwimerere, ubuhinzi bw’ubuntu, umusaruro w’amatungo menshi hamwe n’ubuhinzi butunzwe. Urwego rw’ubworozi rurimo kandi ubwoya, n’amagi n’amata, amatungo akoreshwa mu guhinga, no korora amafi.

Amazi yo mu murima, azwi kandi nk'amazi yo mu buhinzi, ni amazi yi yemeje gukoreshwa mu gukora ibiribwa no gukusanya andi ma soko. Muri Amerika, hafi 80% by'amazi meza yakuwe mu nzuzi n'amazi yo mu butaka akoreshwa mu gutanga ibiribwa n'ibindi bicuruzwa bikomoka ku buhinzi. Amazi yo mu murima ashobora kuba arimo amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imyaka cyangwa kuvomera amatungo.

Ikiyaga cya Fuquene ni ikiyaga kimeze nk'umutima giherereye mu kibaya cya Ubaté muri Chiquinquira, igice cya Altiplano Cundiboyacense, mu majyaruguru ya Cundinamarca, muri Kolombiya, ku mupaka na Boyaca. Ikiyaga cya Andean, kiri butumburuke bwa metero 2,540, yafatwaga nk'uwera mu idini rya Muisca yari atuye muri ako gace mbere yuko Abesipanyoli bigarurira uyu mujyi wa Muisca mu myaka 1530.

Kurenza urugero ni inzira yo kuvoma amazi ku butaka uyashyira hejuru yi bihingwa ugakoresha aringaniye mu kuvomerera. Amazi yo kuvomerera ni imwe mu masoko manini y’amazi meza kandi aboneka mu nsi. Kugabanuka kw'amazi yo kuvomerera kugereranywa na konti ya banki ikuramo amafaranga menshi kuruta kubitsa. Impamvu nyamukuru itera amazi yubutaka kugabanuka ni ugupompa cyane amazi yubutaka hejuru yimigezi yo munsi.

Amavuta yi ntoki, akomoka mu mikindo ya mavuta, ni soko ry'ibanze ry'injiza abahinzi benshi bo muri Aziya yepfo, Afrika yo hagati n'uburengerazuba, na Amerika yo hagati. Ikoreshwa mu gihugu nk'amavuta yo guteka, yoherezwa hanze kugirango ikoreshwe mu biribwa byinshi by ubucuruzi n'ibicuruzwa byita ku muntu kandi bihindurwamo ibinyabuzima. Itanga amavuta agera ku inshuro 10 kukurenza soya, cyangwa kungufu cyangwa izuba.

Ubutaka bwo mu mpinga ni ubutaka bushobora gukoreshwa mu guhinga ibihingwa bitandukanye nibwo bwitwa ubutaka bw’ubuhinzi, mu karere runaka (nk'igihugu cyangwa isi yose). Abashyigikiye igitekerezo cy’imirima y’ubuhinzi bavuga ko n’ubwo umubare w’abatuye isi ugenda wiyongera, hakenerwa ubutaka bwinshi bwo guhinga, kubera ko umusaruro w’ibiribwa kuri hegitari imwe y’ubutaka bwiyongera cyane kuruta uko isi ikenera ibiribwa. Ibi bishyigikiwe nuko agace keguriwe imirima mubihugu bimwe, byombi byateye imbere (urugero Finlande) no gutera imbere (urugero Ubuhinde, Ubushinwa), byatangiye kugabanuka. Ku isi hose, mu gihe umubare rusange w'ubutaka bwo guhingwa ukomeje kwiyongera, ubuso bw'inzuri zihoraho bwaragabanutse kuva mu 1998, byibuze hegitari miliyoni 60 ntizirirwa. Bavuga ko ibindi bihugu, nka Amerika, bifite isambu yera cyane.

Uruziga rw'uburozi (COP) bivuga kohereza mu mahanga imiti yica udukoko twabujijwe mugukoreshwa mu biribwa, bimwe muri byo bigaruka mu buryo bwo kubitumiza mu mahanga. "Uruziga" rwuzuye iyo imiti yubumara yoherejwe hanze noneho ikoreshwa muguhinga imbuto, inyama, numusaruro utumizwa mu mahanga kandi ushobora gukoreshwa no murugo. Uru ruziga rwamenyekanye bwa mbere ugereranije n’Amerika bikareba umubano urebana hagati y’ibindi bihugu byo ku isi y'Amajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo.

Ijambo plasticulture risobanura imyitozo yo gukoresha ibikoresho bya pulasitike mubikorwa byubuhinzi. Ibikoresho bya plastiki ubwabyo bikunze kwitwa "ag plastike". Plasticulture cyangwa ag plastike irimo firime ya fumigasi yubutaka, kuvomerera ibitonyanga cyangwa kuvoma, umugozi uziritseho ibihingwa bya pulasitike, inkono za pepiniyeri na bale, ariko iryo jambo rikoreshwa cyane mugusobanura ubwoko bwose bw ibiti bya plastiki cyangwa ibitwikiriye ubutaka. Ibifuniko nkibi bitangirira kuri ya pulasitike, gutwikira umurongo, tuneli ndende cyangwa ntoya, kugeza muri parike ya palastike.

Soil compaction cyangwa Guhuza ubutaka, bizwi nko kwangirika kwi miterere y'ubutaka, ni ubwiyongere bwubucucike bwinshi cyangwa kugabanuka ku butaka bitewe nu buremere bw'imbere cyangwa inyuma bi kubiri hejuru. Kubihuza birashobora kugira ingaruka mbi ku miterere y'umubiri, imiti n'ubuzima hamwe nu butaka. Hamwe n’isuri y’ubutaka, ifatwa nk'ikibazo gihenze kandi gikomeye cyane ku bidukikije cyatewe n’ubuhinzi butari ubwu mwuga."
Umutekano mu biribwa

Indyo irambye ni ibiryo bifite ingaruka nke ku bidukikije zigira uruhare mu biribwa, no kwihaza mu mirire, no mu buzima buzira umuze ku bihe bya bantu bazaza. Indyo zirambye zirinda kandi zubaha urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, byemewe mu muco, bigezweho, ubukungu bwizewe kandi buhendutse, bihagije mu mirire, bafite umutekano, n’ubuzima bwiza buzira umuze, kandi bitezimbere, umutungo kamere n’abantu. " Iyi ndyo igerageza gukemura ikibazo cyintungamubiri (imirire mibi) hamwe nibyikirengan’ikirenga (umubyibuho ukabije), mu gihe harebwa ibintu by’ibidukikije nk’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, gutakaza urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no kwangirika kw’ubutaka.

Icyatsi ni igihingwa gifatwa nki cyifuzwa mu gihe runaka ku bwimpamvu, gikurira aho kidashaka. Igitekerezo cyi cyatsi gifite akamaro kanini mubuhinzi, aho ikigamijwe ari uguhinga ibihingwa cyangwa urwuri rwu bwoko bumwe, cyangwa kuvanga amoko make yifuzwa. Mu bidukikije, ubundi bwoko bwibimera bifatwa nkutifuzwa bityo rero urumamfu. Uretse ibyo, ibyatsi bimwe bifite imiterere itifuzwa bigatuma ibyonnyi byibimera ubisanga ahantu henshi hahurira na bantu.
Akamaro k'ibidukikije.
Irushanwa hamwe nibihingwa bihingwa kandi byanduye.
Mugihe ijambo "urumamfu" muri rusange rifite ubusobanuro bubi, ibimera byinshi bizwi nkibyatsi birashobora kugira akamaro. Ibyatsi bibi byinshi, nka dandelion ("Taraxacum") hamwe na kimwe cya kane cyintama biribwa, kandi amababi cyangwa imizi yabyo bishobora gukoreshwa mubiryo cyangwa imiti y'ibyatsi. Burdock isanzwe ku isi, kandi rimwe na rimwe ikoreshwa mu gukora isupu n'imiti muri Aziya y'Uburasirazuba. Ibyatsi bibi bimwe bikurura udukoko twiza, ari nako dushobora kurinda ibihingwa ibyonnyi byangiza. Ibyatsi bibi birashobora kandi gukumira udukoko twangiza udukoko kubona umusaruro, kubera ko kuboneka kwabo bihagarika ikibazo cyibimenyetso byiza udukoko dukoresha kugirango tumenye ibiryo byabo. Ibyatsi bibi birashobora kandi gukora nk "ibimera bizima", bitanga igifuniko cyubutaka kigabanya gutakaza ubushuhe kandi bikarinda isuri. Ibyatsi bibi birashobora kandi kuzamura uburumbuke bwubutaka; dandelion, kurugero, izana intungamubiri nka calcium na azote ziva mu butaka hamwe n’umuzi wazo, kandi clover yakira bagiteri itunganya azote mu mizi yayo, ifumbira ubutaka mu buryo butaziguye. Dandelion kandi ni bumwe mu moko menshi atandukanya hardpan mu mirima ihingwa cyane, ifasha ibihingwa gukura neza mu mizi. Indabyo zimwe zo mu busitani zatangiye ari urumamfu mu murima wahinzwe kandi zororerwa guhitamo indabyo zabo cyangwa amababi akwiriye. Urugero rw'icyatsi cy'ibihingwa gihingwa mu busitani ni ibigori, ("Agrostemma githago"), cyari urumamfu rusanzwe mu mirima y'ingano y'i Burayi, ariko ubu rimwe na rimwe rugahingwa nk'igihingwa cy'ubusitani.

Ihumana ry’ubuhinzi ryerekeza ku binyabuzima biva mu buhinzi bivamo kwanduza cyangwa kwangiza ibidukikije, kandi bikomeretsa abantu n’inyungu z’ubukungu. Umwanda urashobora guturuka ahantu hatandukanye, uhereye kumyanda ihumanya y’amazi ukagenda hamwe no gukwirakwira cyane, ku rwego rw’imiterere, bizwi kandi ko bitanduye bituruka ku bidukikije ndetse n’umwanda uhumanya ikirere. Iyo mwanda mu bidukikije ishobora kugira ingaruka mbi mu bidukikije, ni ukuvuga kwica inyamaswa zo muri ako gace cyangwa kwanduza amazi yo kunywa,

Imihindagurikire y’ibihe isobanurwa nku bushobozi bw’imibereho, ubukungu n’ibidukikije kugira ngo duhangane n’ibintu bishobora guteza akaga cyangwa inzara cyangwa imidugararo muri Rubanda.  Kubungabunga ikirere bifitanye isano n’ingamba zo kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ikirere, Igamije kugabanya ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere kandi ikubiyemo gutekereza ku butababazi bw’ikirere n’uburinganire. Mu bikorwa bifatika harimo ibikorwa remezo byangiza ikirere, ubuhinzi bwangiza ikirere n’iterambere ry’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Uburyo buhari bufite intego yo gupima guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere bukoresha, hari ibisobanuro bihamye kandi bisobanutse byo guhangana n’imihindagurikire yikirere, kandi bigatuma amatsinda atandukanye y’abantu agereranywa hifashishijwe ibipimo bisanzwe kandi bifatika.

Ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere ku buhinzi zishobora gutuma umusaruro w’ibihingwa ugabanuka ndetse n’ubuziranenge bw'ibihigwa n'imirire bitewe n’amapfa, imivumba, n’umwuzure ndetse no kwiyongera kw’udukoko tujya ku mwaka ndetse n’indwara z’ibimera. Ingaruka zikwirakwizwa ku isi ziterwa n’imihindagurikire y’ubushyuhe, imvura n’imiterere ya karuboni yo mu kirere bitewe n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere ku isi. Muri 2019, miliyoni zari zimaze guhura n’ibura ry’ibiribwa kubera imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Byongeye kandi, igabanuka ry’umusaruro w’ibihingwa ku isi ni 2% - 6% hafi buri myaka icumi. Muri 2019 byari byarahanuwe ko ibiciro by'ibiribwa bizamuka 80% muri 2050. Ibi birashoboka ko umutekano w’ibiribwa wiyongera, bikagira ingaruka ku baturage batishoboye. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2021 bwagaragaje ko ubukana bw’ubushyuhe n’amapfa ku musaruro w’ibihingwa byikubye inshuro eshatu mu myaka 50 ishize i Burayi - kuva ku gihombo cya 2,2% mu 1964–1990 kugeza ku gihombo cya 7.3% muri 1991 kugeza2015.

Ifumbire ni ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose gikomoka ku miterere karemano cyangwa y’ubukorikori gikoreshwa mu butaka cyangwa mu bihingwa kugira ngo bitange intungamubiri z’ibimera. Ifumbire irashobora gutandukana nu butaka butagira intungamubiri. Inkomoko nyinshi yifumbire ibaho, yaba ka remano cyangwa inganda. Kubikorwa byinshi byubuhinzi bugezweho, ifumbire yibanda ku ntungamubiri eshatu zingenzi: azote (N), fosifore (P), na potasiyumu (K) hiyongereyeho inyongeramusaruro nkifu yurutare kuri micronutrients. Abahinzi bakoresha iyi fumbire muburyo butandukanye: binyuze mumashanyarazi yumye cyangwa pelletised cyangwa yamazi, bakoresheje ibikoresho binini byubuhinzi cyangwa ibikoresho byintoki.
Ifumbire mvaruganda ni: nitrati ya amonium, fosifate ya amonium, sulfate ya amonium, urea na nitrati ya calcium amonium. Amoniya, aside sulfurike na aside fosforike ni ibintu by'ingenzi mu gukora iyi fumbire. Kugeza ubu, hydrogène ikenewe mubikorwa bya Haber-Bosch ikomoka mu bicanwa biva mu kirere (gaze gasanzwe cyangwa amakara), bikavamo imyuka ya CO2. Ammonia ishobora kuvugururwa irashobora gukorwa mugihe hydrogène ikozwe muri electrolysis y'amazi ukoresheje amashanyarazi ashobora kuvugururwa (ingufu z'izuba n'umuyaga). Bitewe n’akarere kayo, Afurika ifite amahirwe menshi yo kubyara amoniya ishobora kuvugururwa no kugabanya gushingira ku ifumbire mvaruganda.

Inguzanyo ku giti ni igitekerezo cy’ubuhinzi bushingiye ku buhinzi aho bahemba igiti cyangwa serivisi z’ikirere. gahunda yatunganijwe hakenewe inzira yoroshye yo kubona inguzanyo kumuhinzii ku giti cye byibuze, kandi byoroshya ishyirwa mubikorwa nogukurikirana imishinga nkiyi hakoreshejwe uburyo bwunguka, kimwe nikigo cy'ubwishingizi.
Ubundi buryo bwo gutanga inguzanyo burimo ibiti byemewe kugabanuka kwa mazi ashingiye ku biguzi byo kugumana ibiti kugiti cye. Mu turere tumwe na tumwe, inguzanyo nini yo kugabanya ingano itangwa ku biti byabitswe hejuru y’ibiti byatewe mu gihe mu tundi turere inguzanyo zishobora kugenwa hashingiwe ku bunini hamwe n’ibiti. Ibintu byinyongera bishobora kugira ingaruka kumubare w'inguzanyo yatanzwe nubunini bwubutaka hamwe nigiti cyibiti kugirango harebwe inyungu zamazi yimvura.
Inguzanyo y'ibiti yabazwe nk'inguzanyo y'amazi y'imvura, no gukoresha ibara rya karubone.
Sisitemu yo gutanga inguzanyo ikoresheje kode yakozwe na Ferdinand Swart.
Gutera ibiti byinshi byabaturage byateguwe cyangwa byatewe nuburyo bwo gutanga inguzanyo (OARM, PSA, GPS). yo mu Buhinde yashyizeho gahunda yo gutanga inguzanyo mu biti mu 2016.

Ubuhinzi bugira uruhare mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere binyuze mu byuka bihumanya ikirere no guhindura ubutaka butari ubuhinzi nk’amashyamba mu butaka bw’ubuhinzi. Ubuhinzi, amashyamba n’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka bitanga hagati ya 13 kugeza kuri 21 ku ijana by’ibyuka bihumanya ikirere ku isi. imyuka mibi igizwe na kimwe cya kabiri cy’ibyuka bihumanya ikirere biva mu buhinzi. Ubworozi ni soko nya mukuru yohereza ibyuka bihumanya ikirere.
Ibikorwa byubuhinzi bisohora imyuka ya parike ya gaze karuboni, aside nitide, na metani.
Ibikorwa nko guhinga imirima, gutera ibihingwa, no kohereza ibicuruzwa bitera imyuka ya karuboni. Ubuhinzi bwangiza imyuka bingana na 11% byuka bihumanya ikirere. Imirima nko kugabanya guhinga, kugabanya ubutaka bwubusa, gusubiza biyomasi ibisigazwa by ibihingwa kubutaka, no kongera ikoreshwa ryibihingwa bitwikiriye bishobora kugabanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere.

Ni Ubuhinzi-Bworozi buvanze n'amashyamba cyangwa ibiti. Bivuga uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose bwo gukoresha ubutaka aho urwuri n'ibihingwa bihujwe n'ibiti n'amashyamba.Guhuza ubuhinzi, ubworozi n’amashyamba bifite inyungu nyinshi, nko kongera umusaruro ukomoka ku bihingwa by’ibiribwa by’ibanze, kuzamura imibereho y’abahinzi kuva ku musaruro, kongera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, kuzamura ubutaka n’ubuzima, kugabanya isuri mu mirima. Ubu buryo kandi bunabungabunga ibidukikije. Mu kwifashisha ubu buryo ushobora gutera ibiti by'imbuto, n'ibindi bicuruzwa by'ingirakamaro bifite agaciro mu bukungu. Ibikorwa by'ubuhinzi bwiganje cyane mu turere dushyuha, cyane ahantu hato dufite akamaro kanini muri Afurika yo munsi y'Ubutayu bwa Sahara. Nyamara, kubera inyungu zayo nyinshi, urugero ni intungamubiri zo kugabanya amapfa, byemejwe muri Amerika no mu Uburayi.

Ubworozi bwa karubone ni zina ry'uburyo butandukanye bw'ubuhinzi bugamije kw'injiza karubone yo mu kirere mu butaka no mu mizi y’ibihingwa, ibiti n'amababi yabyo. Intego yo guhinga karubone ni ukongera umuvuduko wa karubone yinjira mu butaka n’ibiti by’ibimera hagamijwe kugabanya karuboni mu kirere. Kongera ibinyabuzima mu butaka birashobora gufasha gukura ibihingwa, kongera ibinyabuzima byose bya karubone, kongera ubushobozi bwo gufata amazi yu butaka no kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’ifumbire. Ubworozi bwa karubone ni kimwe mu bigize kubungabunga ikirere.

Aimée Classen ni umunyamerika ukora ku bidukikije wiga ku ngaruka z’imihindagurikire y’isi n'amoko atandukanye y’ibinyabuzima byo ku isi. Ibikorwa bye biramenyekana kubera kwita kubidukikije hamwe n’ibitekerezo, hamwe n’ubudasa bw’ibinyabuzima byo ku isi bikubiyemo, birimo amashyamba, urwuri, ibiti, hamwe no mu turere dushyuha kandi duhindagurika.
Kugeza ubu ni umuyobozi w'ikigo cy’ibinyabuzima cya kaminuza muri Michigani, umuryango w’abanyeshuri n’abashakashatsi muri kaminuza wahariwe kwiga ubwoko butandukanye bw’imihindagurikire y’ibidukikije. Classeni ni umwanditsi mukuru w'ikinyamakuru cy’ibidukikije muri Amerika.

Uburobyi bwibasiwe n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere mu buryo bwinshi harimo urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima byo mu mazi, nibyo mu nyanja bigira ingaruka ku kuzamuka ku bushyuhe bw’inyanja, ndetse n'aside yo mu nyanja na nu mwuka yo mu nyanja, mu gihe urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima byo mu mazi meza bigira ingaruka ku ihinduka ry’ubushyuhe bw’amazi, umuvuduko w’amazi, n’amafi akabura aho aba. Izi ngaruka ziratandukanye mu rwego rwa buri burobyi. Imihindagurikire y’ibihe ihindura ubwiyongere bw’amafi n’umusaruro w’amoko yo mu nyanja n’amazi meza. Imihindagurikire y’ibihe iteganijwe gutuma habaho impinduka zikomeye mu kuboneka no gucuruza ibikomoka ku mafi. Ingaruka z'ibihe na politike z'ubukungu zizaba ingirakamaro, cyane mu bihugu biterwa cyane nu murenge. Kugabanuka gukomeye mu bushobozi bwo gufata bishobora gutegerezwa muri mberabyombi nko mu karere ka pasifika yepfo.

Ubusitani ikirere nuburyo ubusitani bushobora kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya ikirere biva mu busitani kandi bigashishikarizwa kwinjiza carbone nu butaka n’ibimera hagamijwe kugabanya ubushyuhe bw’isi. Kuba umuhizi atangiza ikirere bisobanura gusuzuma ibibera mu busitani n'ibikoresho byazanywemo n'ingaruka bigira ku mikoreshereze y'ubutaka n'ikirere. BIrashoboraka kandi gushiramo ibiranga ubusitani cyangwa ibikorwa mu busitani bifasha kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya ikirere ahandi ku isi.
Imikoreshereze yubutaka na gaze ya parike.
Ibyinshi mu byuka bihumanya ikirere bitera imihindagurikire y’ikirere byaturutse ku gutwika amavuta n’ibimera. Ariko raporo idasanzwe y’akanama gashinzwe guverinoma ihuriweho n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe yagereranije ko mu myaka 150 ishize by’ibicanwa n’umusemburo wa sima ari byo byonyine bigera kuri bibiri bya gatatu by’imihindagurikire y’ikirere: ikindi cya gatatu cyatewe nu ko abantu bakoresha ubutaka..
Imyuka itatu yingenzi ya parike ikorwa nu butaka budashoboka ni carbone, metani, na okiside. Carbone yumukara cyangwa soti birashobora kandi guterwa no gukoresha ubutaka budashoboka, kandi, nubwo atari gaze, irashobora kwitwara nka gaze ya parike kandi ikagira uruhare mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere.

Ubuhinzi bw’ikirere (cyangwa ubuhinzi bwangiza ikirere) ni inzira ihuriweho yo gucunga ibibanza bifasha guhuza uburyo bw’ubuhinzi, amatungo n’ibihingwa n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, nkaho bishoboka, bikayirwanya hagabanywa ibyuka bihumanya ikirere biva mu buhinzi, icyarimwe hitawe ku baturage biyongera ku isi kugira ngo babashe kwihaza mu biribwa. Ntabwo hibandwa gusa ku buhinzi bwa karubone cyangwa ubuhinzi burambye, ahubwo no kongera umusaruro w’ubuhinzi. "bijyanye n'icyerekezo ku biribwa n'ubuhinzi birambye kandi ishyigikira intego yo gukora ubuhinzi, amashyamba n'uburobyi kurushaho gutanga umusaruro kandi birambye".
Ishami rishinzwe ibiribwa n’ubuhinzi ryagaragaje ko ibikoresho byinshi by’ibihugu n’abantu ku giti cyabo muburyo bwo gusuzuma, kugenzura no gusuzuma ibice bigize murigahunda ya CSA no kuyishyira mu bikorwa na FAO. Bimwe muri ibyo bikoresho birimo:

Gutema amashyamba ni uruhare runini mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere, kandi imihindagurikire y’ikirere igira ingaruka ku mashyamba.
Ihinduka ry'imikoreshereze y'ubutaka, mu buryo bwo gutema amashyamba, ni isoko rya kabiri rinini rya ya karuboni yo mu kirere, nyuma yo gutwikwa na peteroli. Imyuka ya parike isohoka mugihe cyo gutwika biyomasi yishyamba no kubora ibikoresho byi bimera bisigaye hamwe na karuboni yubutaka. Icyitegererezo cyisi yose hamwe nu bubiko bwa parike yi gihugu itanga ibisubizo bisa kubyangiza amashyamba. muri 2019, gutema amashyamba bishinzwe hafi 11 ku ijana mu byuka bihumanya ikirere. Ibyuka byangiza imyuka yo gutema amashyamba birihuta. Gukura amashyamba ni karuboni ifite ubushobozi bwo kugabanya ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Zimwe mu ngaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, nk’umuriro mwinshi, zishobora kongera amashyamba.
Gutema amashyamba biza muburyo bwinshi: umuriro w’ishyamba, gutema ubuhinzi, korora amatungo, no gutema ibiti. Umubare munini wi bikorwa byu buhinzi bivamo amashyamba biterwa inkunga n’imisoro ya leta. Amashyamba afite 31 ki ijana yubutaka bwisi kandi buri mwaka kilometero kare 75.700 (bingana na hegitari miliyoni 18.7) zishyamba ziratakara. Nk’uko ikigo gishinzwe umutungo w’isi kibitangaza, habayeho kwiyongera kwa 12 ku ijana mu gutakaza amashyamba y’ibanze yo mu turere dushyuha kuva muri 2019 kugeza 2020. Gutema amashyamba menshi bikomeje kubangamira amashyamba yo mu turere dushyuha, ibinyabuzima bitandukanye, na serivisi y'ibidukikije batanga. Igice nyamukuru gihangayikishijwe no gutema amashyamba ni mumashyamba yimvura yo mu turere dushyuha kubera ko atuwe n’ibinyabuzima byinshi ku isi.
Impamvu zitera amashyamba.
Ubworozi bw'amatungo busaba igice kinini cy'ubutaka bwo korora amashyo y'amatungo n'ibihingwa by'amatungo kubyo abaguzi bakeneye. Nk’uko ikigega cy'isi cyita ku nyamaswa kibitangaza, "Ubworozi bw'inka nini ni bwo bwa mbere mu guteza amashyamba mu bihugu hafi ya byose bya Amazone, kandi bingana na 80% by'amashyamba muri iki gihe." Ubworozi bw’amatungo bwashinzwe muri Tejas mugihe cya Misiyoni ya Espagne, hagati ya 1820 na 1865 kandi bwari butwarwa ahanini n’inka zo muri Mexico. Nyuma, ubwo ubutumwa bwari bumaze gufungwa maze abapadiri n'abasirikare bava muri ako gace ariko bagasiga inka inyuma, umurimo wafashwe n'abenegihugu ku giti cyabo. Nyuma y'intambara y'abenegihugu, Texans yatangiye gukusanya inka no kugurisha amajyaruguru muri leta nka Kansas na Illinois. Nk’uko bitangazwa na Greenpeace, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta uharanira ibidukikije ku isi, inganda z’inka nizo zifite uruhare runini mu kohereza imyuka ya metani kubera ko 60% by’inyamabere zose ku isi ari inka z’amatungo. Gusimbuza ubutaka bw’amashyamba n’inzuri bitera igihombo cy’amashyamba, ibyo bikaba biganisha ku kongera imyuka ihumanya ikirere mu gutwika uburyo bw’ubuhinzi no guhindura imikoreshereze y’ubutaka.

Fermentation ya enteric ni inzira igogora aho karubone ya igabanywa na mikorobe ikabamo molekile yoroshye kugirango yinjire mumaraso yinyamaswa. Kubera ubuhinzi bw’abantu bushingiye ku bice byinshi by’isi ku nyamaswa zonona na fermentation ya enteric, ni kimwe mu bintu byongera imyuka ihumanya ikirere.
Amatungo yinyamanswa naya afite rumen. Rumen ni igifu gifite abantu benshi kiboneka hafi yinyamabere zimwe na zimwe za artiodactyl, nk'inka, intama, n'impongo, bibafasha kurya selile ikomoka ku bimera bikomeye ndetse n'ibinyampeke bikomoka ku nyamaswa za monogastrici (ni ukuvuga, "icyumba kimwe gifunze"), nka abantu, imbwa, ninjangwe, ntibishobora gusya. Nubwo ingamiya zitekereza ko ari amatungo ntabwo ari amatungo yukuri.
ferimetatiyo ibaho mu gihe metane ikorewe muri rumeni mugihe habaye mikorobe. Amoko arenga 200 ya mikorobe aboneka muri rumeni, nubwo hafi 10 ku ijana gusa aribyo bigira uruhare runini mugusya. Ibyinshi muri ibyo bikoresho bifatanye ninyamaswa. Nyamara, ijanisha rito naryo rikorerwa mu mara manini kandi ryanyuze nko kuryama.

Ibidukikije bikomoka ku bimera ni umuco wo kurya ibikomoka ku bimera iyo biterwa no gushaka gukora indyo irambye yirinda ingaruka mbi z’ibidukikije ku musaruro w’inyama. Amatungo muri rusange ateganijwe kuba hafi 15 ku ijana y’ibyuya bihumanya ikirere ku isi.
Usibye imihindagurikire y’ikirere, inganda z’ubworozi nizo ntandaro y’ibanze mu urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no gutema amashyamba, mu gihe bifite akamaro kanini ku bijyanye n’ibidukikije nko gukoresha amazi n’ubutaka, umwanda, ndetse no kutabaho neza.
Ingaruka ku bidukikije ku bikomoka ku nyamaswa.
Ibice bine bya gatanu byangiza imyuka iva mu buhinzi biva mu bworozi.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n'ikigo cya isi ireba mu 2009 bwavuze ko raporo yasuzuguye ingaruka zijyanye na metani, imikoreshereze y'ubutaka ndetse n'ubuhumekero, bigatuma amatungo agera kuri 51 ku ijana by'ibyuka bihumanya isi

Imicungire yuzuye mu buhinzi ni uburyo bwo gucunga umutungo watunganijwe mbere na Alani mu gucunga ubwatsi. Imicungire ya Holistike yagereranijwe ko uburyo bwa perimaculiture. Imicungire ya Holistike ni ikirango cyanditse.
Ubuyobozi bwuzuye busobanura sisitemu yo gutekereza kuburyo bwo gucunga umutungo. Ubusanzwe byakozwe na Alani, ubu birahuzwa kugirango bikoreshwe mu gucunga izindi sisitemu zifite imibereho iruhanyije nk'ibidukikije n’ubukungu. Ubwatsi buteganijwe kurisha ubusa no kurisha kuzenguruka ariko buratandukanye kubera ko bumenya neza kandi butanga urwego rwo guhuza inzira enye z’ibinyabuzima: uruziga rw’amazi, [4 [5 Imicungire ya Holisitike yagereranijwe n'uburyo bwa permaculiture.

Itsinda rishinzwe amashyamba muri Uganda n’umuryango ukorera muri Uganda, mu rusobe rudasanzwe rw’abafatanyabikorwa mu mashyamba, imiryango itegamiye kuri leta, ibigo bya masomo nu bushakashatsi bigira uruhare mu iterambere rirambye ry’amashyamba muri Uganda bikaba bitandukanye mu bice bitandukanye byi gihugu iterambere. Yashinzwe mu 2001 kugira ngo igire uruhare mu iterambere ry’amashyamba no gukurikirana mu bwigenge ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Politiki y’amashyamba na gahunda y’i gihugu y’amashyamba.
ifatanya n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, Imiryango ishingiye ku baturage, Amashyirahamwe y’abakoresha amashyamba Amashuri makuru n’ibigo by’ubushakashatsi hamwe n’abanyamuryango ku giti cyabo bagize uruhare mu iterambere no kuramba by’amashyamba muri Uganda. Kuva mu 2014 kugeza 2016, Itsinda rishinzwe amashyamba muri Uganda, ibiribwa n’ubuhinzi by’umuryango w’abibumbye n’ishami rishinzwe gutera inkunga amashyamba munsi ya Minisiteri y’amazi n’ibidukikije ku nkunga y’amafaranga yatanzwe n’ishami rishinzwe iterambere mpuzamahanga, mu Bwongereza, yashyize mu bikorwa umushinga “Kongera igihe cy’amashyamba n’imiyoborere muri Uganda” kugira ngo ugerageze inzira yo kwandikisha amashyamba yigenga no gutangaza amashyamba y’abaturage muri Uganda, nkuko biteganijwe, ariko ntibyigeze bishyirwa mu bikorwa, mu itegeko ry’igihugu ry’amashyamba n’ibiti mu 2003.

Raporo idasanzwe y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe imihindagurikire yi kirere, iyi yerekana, ubutayu, iyangirika ryu butaka, imicungire yu butaka burambye, umutekano wi biribwa, na pariki. gazi itemba mu bidukikije ku isi, ni ubushakashatsi bwibanze kuva mu mwaka wa 2019 ni mpuguke 107 zaturutse mu bihugu 52. itanga ishusho rusange yimiterere yi kirere ku nshuro ya mbere kandi ifata icyemezo cyo kwandikisha ubutaka nku mutungo wingenzi. Isomo rya 50 ryemeje ku mugaragaro Incamake ku bafata ibyemezo kandi yemeza raporo ishingiyeho. hamwe ni nyandiko yuzuye ya "Raporo idasanzwe yerekeye imihindagurikire y’ibihe n’ubutaka," mu buryo butemewe, yasohotse ku ya 8 Kanama 2019. Raporo ifite impapuro zirenga 1.300 kandi ikubiyemo imirimo yinzobere 107 zaturutse mu bihugu 52.
Raporo ni iya kabiri muri Raporo eshatu zidasanzwe muri raporo y’isuzuma rya gatandatu (AR6) yatangiye muri 2015 ikazarangira mu 2022. Iya mbere yari Raporo idasanzwe ku bushyuhe bwa 1.5, naho iya gatatu ni Raporo idasanzwe ku nyanja na koroyosifera mu bihe by’i mihindagurikire y’i bihe yasohotse ku ya 25 Nzeri 2019. Inzira ya AR6 ifatwa na IPCC ko ari yo irarikira cyane kuva itsinda ryashingwa mu 1988.
Isuzuma ryambere ryizunguruka na raporo zidasanzwe.
Kuva yashingwa mu 1988, IPCC iha guverinoma z’ibihugu 195 bigize uyu muryango, incamake y’incamake y’isuzuma ry’ubumenyi ku bashoramari b’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, harimo ingaruka ziriho ndetse n’ingaruka zishobora kubaho. Raporo kandi yashyize ahagaragara ibisubizo bishoboka mubijyanye no kurwanya imihindagurikire y'ikirere. IPCC yasohoye Raporo eshanu z’isuzuma, na raporo y’isuzuma rya mbere rya IPCC mu 1990 "(" FAR), bizwi "nk’imihindagurikire y’ibihe 2007", na Raporo ya gatanu yo gusuzuma. Buri raporo ikubiyemo kandi "isuzuma ryuzuye rya siyansi na tekiniki ry’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, muri rusange mu bitabo bitatu, imwe kuri buri tsinda ry’imirimo ya IPCC, hamwe n’incamake y’abafata ibyemezo, na Raporo ya Synthesis."
Igice cya 1: Imiterere n'imiterere.
Ubuyobozi bwa siyansi bwa SRCCL bwarimo impuguke 107 zaturutse mu bihugu 52 nku guhuza abanditsi bayobora hamwe n’abanditsi bayobora mu matsinda atatu ya IPCC hamwe na Task Force ishinzwe ibarura rya parike y’igihugu ku nkunga yatanzwe n’ishami rishinzwe ubufasha bwa tekinike mu itsinda rya III. 53% by'abanditsi ba raporo bakomoka mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere naho mirongo ine ku ijana by'abanditsi bayobora ni abagore.
"The Economist" yavuze ko raporo "irasa indi miburo irasa ku miterere y'isi ndetse n'uburyo abantu bahinduka hafi ya buri mugabane wa buri mugabane. Ibikorwa by'abantu bigira ingaruka kuri bitatu bya kane by'ubutaka butagira urubura ku isi, bikagira ingaruka zikomeye ku kirere. " BBC yasohoye urukurikirane rw'ingingo zijyanye no gutangaza raporo. Roger Harrabin, umusesenguzi w’ibidukikije kuri BBC, yavuze ko iyi raporo "izaba raporo yemewe nyamara mu buryo dukoresha no gukoresha nabi ubutaka." Ingingo yo ku ya 8 Kanama 2019 yanditswe na "New York Times" (NYT) yagaragaje ukuri ko SRCCL "yateguwe n'impuguke zirenga 100 zaturutse mu bihugu 52" kandi ko yasanze "igice cya miliyari igice cy'abantu basanzwe baba ahantu hahindutse ubutayu, kandi ubutaka burimo gutakara hagati y’incuro 10 na 100 kurenza uko bumeze. " NYT yerekanye kandi ko umubare w’abimukira wiyongereyeho gatanu ku mupaka w’Amerika na Mexico uva El Salvador, Guatemala na Honduras "uhurirana n’igihe cyumye cyasize benshi badafite ibiryo bihagije." Bamwe mu bahanga "basabye ko ari ikimenyetso cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere." Ingingo yo muri "Atalantike" yari ifite umutwe ugira uti: "Iki Gihugu Nicyo gihugu cyonyine gihari". Iyo ngingo yavuze ari intambwe ikomeye kuko ivuga ko ubutaka butarangwamo urubura ubwabwo, abantu bakeneye gukura mu biribwa, "ari buke kandi bufite agaciro". Iyi ngingo yerekanye bamwe mu bahanga mu bumenyi bw’ikirere n’abashakashatsi bafite, mbere ya SRCCL, rimwe na rimwe bagaragaje ko ubutaka ari "isuku" itagira umupaka "yoza isi", mu buryo bwo kongera ibiti bihagije byagabanya cyane umutwaro wa CO. "Ikinyamakuru" ubushakashatsi bwibanze.

Cacao ivugurura isobanurwa nka cacao ikorerwa mu murima ukoresha ubuhinzi bushya nu buryo bwo guhinga amashyamba. Ifitanye isano rya bugufi na shokora yo muri ikerene, itanga ibiribwa kama umuryango wo kubungabunga amashyamba yimvura, hamwe n’umushinga w’ubuhinzi bw'umwimerere. Cacao nibikoresho fatizo bikoreshwa mu gukora shokora.
Cacao ivuguruye irangwa nu buhinzi bw'ibinyabuzima butandukanye bwi biti aho ibiti bya cakao bihingwa mu gicucu cy’ibindi biti, bigana m' urusobe rwi binyabuzima rusanzwe. Ubu buryo bwo guhinga bukoreshwa nk'uburyo bwo kugarura amashyamba ku rwuri rw’inka zatereranywe ndetse no mu tundi turere tw’ubuhinzi bw’amashyamba. Mubisanzwe bifatwa nkingamba zo gucunga neza ubutaka, aho abahinzi bashobora kubyara ibiryo ninjiza mugihe cyo kuvugurura amashyamba.
Urugendo rwa cacao rusubirwamo ni ingamba zo kurwanya imirima ya cacao, ikaba akenshi itera amashyamba mu turere dushyuha.
Agroforestry ivugurura ikoresha iri hame nkuburyo bwo gusana amashyamba. Imwe mu nyungu zubu buryo ni ugukuraho neti ya CO2 mukirere. Izindi nyungu zirimo kongera umusaruro ukomoka ku bihingwa by’ibiribwa, kuzamura imibereho y’abahinzi kuva ku musaruro winjiza, kongera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, kuzamura ubutaka n’ubuzima, no kugabanya isuri. Hamwe nimiterere yubutaka bwiza, ibihingwa biva mubuhinzi bushya burimo vitamine zimwe na zimwe, imyunyu ngugu, na phytochemiki. Imiti myinshi ya phytochemiki irashobora kongera uburyohe bwibiryo ugereranije nibikorwa bisanzwe byubuhinzi. Muri rusange, ubuhinzi bushya bwubuhinzi nuburyo bwubuhinzi bushya bukoresha ibiti cyane kuruta ibihingwa byumwaka.
Ibiti bya Cacao, bikomoka mu mashyamba y’imvura yo muri uquateur, mu bisanzwe byahinduwe kugira ngo bibeho kandi bitere imbere mu nsi y’ishyamba rishyuha. Ibi, bifatanije no kwiyongera kwisi yose kuri shokora, bituma ibiti bya cakao ari ikintu cyiza cyibiti by’amashyamba yi mbera byombi.
Kugabanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe.
umuyobozi ushinzwe amategeko n’ubukangurambaga, avuga ko igisubizo kimwe ari uko inganda za shokora zishobora guhinduka mu buhinzi bw’amashyamba no mu bwoko bwa cakao zikuze mu gicucu, kandi ko hagomba kunozwa uburyo bw’imyororokere ya cacao.

Ubuhinzi bushya ni uburyo bwo kubungabunga no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe ibiribwa hamwe nu buhinzi. Yibanze mu kuvugurura ubutaka, kongera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, kuzamura uruziga rwa mazi, kuzamura serivisi z’ibidukikije, gushyigikira ibinyabuzima, kongera imbaraga mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, no gushimangira ubuzima n’ubuzima bw’ubutaka bw’imirima.
Ubuhinzi bushya ntabwo ari imyitozo yihariye ubwayo. Ahubwo, abashyigikira ubuhinzi bushya bakoresha uburyo butandukanye bwu buhinzi burambye hamwe. Imyitozo ikubiyemo gutunganya imyanda myinshi yu murima bishoboka no kongeramo ifumbire mvaruganda ituruka hanze yu murima. Ubuhinzi bushya ku mirima mito nu busitani akenshi bushingiye kuri filozofi nka perimaculiture, Ubuhinzi, ecologiya, igishushanyo mbonera, hamwe nu buyobozi bwuzuye. Imirima minini nayo igenda ikoreshwa mu buryo nkubu, kandi akenshi ikoresha oya kugeza cyangwa kugabanuka kugeza.
Mu gihe ubuzima bwu butaka bugenda butera imbere, ibisabwa byinjira birashobora kugabanuka, kandi umusaruro wi bihingwa urashobora kwiyongera kuko ubutaka bushobora guhangana ni kirere gikabije kandi bukabamo udukoko twangiza na virusi.
Imyitozo n'amahame akoreshwa mu buhinzi bushya harimo:

Icyerekezo cy’amapfa, mu karere gikunze gukoreshwa mu gukurikirana ibiza by’amapfa no kwiga urugero nu buremere bw’ibihe by’amapfa. Ironderero rikoresha imvura nu bushyuhe bwo kwiga itangwa rya mazi ni bisabwa ukoresheje uburyo bworoshye bwo kuringaniza amazi. Yakozwe n’iteganyagihe witwa Wayine, wasohoye bwa mbere uburyo bwe mu mpapuro zo mu 1965 "z’amapfa y’ikirere" ku biro bishinzwe ikirere cy’ibiro by’ikirere muri Amerika.
Abanyamateka bavuze ko akamaro k'ibipimo bigabanuka kubera imiterere yinzira uko bishakiye, harimo n'ubuhanga bukoreshwa mu kugereranya. Indangagaciro idashobora kubara ubukonje nu butaka butose nabyo byavuzwe nkintege nke.

Mootral ni isosiyete y'Abongereza n'Ubusuwisi itegura ibiryo byinyogera bigabanya imyuka ya metani ituruka ku nyamaswa zororoka, inka n'intama, n'ihene. Methane ni intego nya mukuru ya gaze ya parike kandi muri raporo ya 4 y’akanama gashinzwe guverinoma ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe irasabwa kwiyongera kuva kuri 23 ikagera kuri 72 kubera ubunini bw’ingaruka zayo ugereranije na carbone no kuramba mu kirere cy’isi.
Ibigo bikoresha ibiryo bya Mootral bitanga inguzanyo ya karubone ishobora gukoreshwa kugirango igabanye ibyuka bihumanya ikirere cyangwa igurishwa kubandi bantu. Ukuboza 2019, Verra yatangaje ko yemeye Mootral nk'uburyo bwa mbere ku isi bwo kugabanya imyuka ihumanya metani ituruka ku matungo magufi.
Mootral yitabiriwe cyane nku wakabiri mu mpinduka zibihe na mahame yo mu Buholandi.

Inyama &amp; Ubworozi Australiya ni sosiyete yigenga igenga ibipimo ngenderwaho mu micungire y’inyama n’amatungo ku masoko ya Ositaraliya n’amahanga. Icyicaro gikuru kiri mu majyaruguru ya Sydney muri Ositaraliya ; M&amp;LA ikorana cyane na guverinoma ya Ositarariya, n’inganda z’inyama n’ubworozi. Nu buyobozi bu tandukanye, M&amp;LA ifite uruhare runini mubice by'imari, ibya leta nu bushakashatsi. Itsinda ry’ibigo M&amp;LA rikora ubushakashatsi kandi ritanga serivisi zo kwamamaza ku bakora inyama, inzego za leta n’abasesengura isoko. Ihuriro nibikorwa nabyo bikoreshwa na M&amp;LA bigamije guha abaproducer amahirwe yo kwishimana nabandi bitabiriye gutanga isoko.
Icyorezo cya Corona cya hungabanije amasoko yu bukungu nu musaruro ku isi. Icyorezo cya COVID nacyo cyagize ingaruka ku kwinjiza amatsinda ya M&amp;LA. Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2019–20, M&amp;LA yinjije muri rusange amadori miliyoni 269.7. M&amp;LA yagize igabanuka rya 0.1 ku ijana mu kwinjiza ugereranije n’umwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018–19, aho itsinda ry’ibigo ryinjije amadorari miliyoni 269.9.
Itsinda rya M&amp;LA ryashinzwe nyuma yo guhuza ikigo cy’inyama n’ubworozi cya Ositaraliya (AMLC) n’ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi ku nyama (MRC) cyemerera abikorera ku giti cyabo izo nzego za leta mu 1998. Itsinda ryi bigo bya M&amp;LA ryashinzwe imirimo yubushakashatsi niterambere rya AMLC nintego ya MRC yo gutanga inkunga yumusaruro.
Inyama n’amatungo Australiya igarukira.
Icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyatumye gukusanya amakuru n'imibare biva ku masoko yo mu karere ndetse no ku isi bigorana. Kubera COVID-19 yabujijwe no kugabanya kubona amakuru, M&amp;LA yahagaritse by'agateganyo umusaruro wa EYCI hagati ya Werurwe na Kamena 2020. Nyuma yo koroshya imipaka ya COVID-19 muri Ositaraliya, igipimo cy’isoko cyagarutse mu cyumweru gishize cya Kamena 2020. M&amp;LA igamije gukomeza guha abasesengura n’abasesengura isoko amakuru ku miterere y’isoko mpuzamahanga bashyira mu bikorwa ubushakashatsi ku masoko y’amahanga, bushimishije n’abakora ibicuruzwa muri Ositaraliya ku bijyanye n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga. Muri 2018–19, Australiya yohereje 72% by’inyama z’inka n’inyama zose, naho Ubushinwa bugira 24% by’inyama z’inka zo muri Ositaraliya mu mwaka wa 2019. M&amp;LA yakoze ubushakashatsi ku baguzi mu Bushinwa kugira ngo isesengure imyitwarire y’abaguzi n’iterambere ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19. Ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi byagaragaje ko hakomeje kwiyongera ku baguzi bakeneye inyama zitukura mu Bushinwa, hamwe n’inyama z’inka za Ositaraliya ziyongereyeho 43% ku masoko y’Ubushinwa mu gihe cy’icyorezo. Ubu bushakashatsi bugamije kunoza icyizere cya producer no gutanga
amakuru kubasesengura isoko mugihe cyorezo cya COVID-19.

Nubwo imyuka ya metani iva mu buhinzi n’andi masoko ya antropogeneque yagize uruhare runini mu gushyuha kwashize, ntabwo bifite akamaro kanini kubushyuhe bwa none na vuba. Ni ukubera ko mu myaka yashize habaye kwiyongera gake cyane mu kirere cya metani yo mu kirere methane idasanzwe ituruka mu bishanga karemano, cyane cyane mu turere dushyuha, aho kuba isoko ya antropogene.

Ibibazo by’ibidukikije n’amahitamo ni raporo y’umuryango w’abibumbye, yashyizwe ahagaragara n’umuryango w’ibiribwa n’ubuhinzi yu muryango wa bibumbye ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 2006, igamije gusuzuma ingaruka zose zu bworozi ku bidukikije ibibazo, hamwe nu buryo bwa tekiniki na politiki bushobora kugabanywa ". Umwanditsi mukuru Henning Steinfeld yavuze ko amatungo ari umwe mu bagize uruhare runini mu bibazo by’ibidukikije by’iki gihe" kandi ko hakenewe ingamba zihutirwa kugira ngo iki kibazo gikemuke.
Ingingo yo mu 2009 mu kinyamakuru Worldwatch Institute yanditswe n'abanditsi Anihangi, icyo gihe bakoreraga muri Banki y'Isi, bavuze ko raporo idahwitse kandi ko ubworozi bugira uruhare runini mu byuka bihumanya ikirere ku isi, nibura 51 ku ijana, bifata hitawe ku guhumeka kw'inyamaswa n'ubushobozi bwa fotosintetike y'ubutaka bukoreshwa mu kugaburira no gutura amatungo. Igisubizo cya 2011 kuri iki kibazo cyashyizwe ahagaragara hamwe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abahanga, batesha agaciro ingingo y’iki kinyamakuru kandi gishimangira isuzuma rya 2006. Ariko iki gisubizo cyashubijwe bongera gushimangira igereranyo ryabo mu gihe abahanga banze gukomeza impaka nubwo ubutumire bwatumiwe. Mu mwaka wa 2013, yafatanyije ku mugaragaro n’ubunyamabanga mpuzamahanga bw’inyama n’ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry’amata kandi benshi mu banditsi bamwe ba raporo ya mbere bashyize ahagaragara ubushakashatsi bwakurikiyeho (2013) bwakorewe, bavugurura igereranyo cy’imyuka ihumanya ikirere bitewe n’amatungo amanuka; kugeza 14.5 ku ijana udakemuye amakosa ayo ari yo yose avugwa yagaragaye muri raporo ya Anhangi cyangwa mu mpaka zasuzumwe n’urungano.

Gregory V. Jones ni umugabo ukomoka ku mugabane wa amerika mu bushakashatsi bwi kirere akaba ari nzobere mu bijyanye ni kirere cyu buhinzi bwi mbuto, yibanda ku kuntu imihindagurikire yi kirere igira ingaruka ku mikurire yi mizabibu, umusaruro wa divayi, ndetse nu bwiza bwa divayi ikorwa. Jones akaba ari umuyobozi mukuru wa Abacela Vineyards na Winery i Roseburg, Oregon. Mbere yahoze akora nku muyobozi wi kigo gishinzwe kwigisha divayi kandi ni umwarimu mu bushakashatsi bwi bidukikije muri kaminuza ndetse anaba umuyobozi wi shami ryu bucuruzi, itumanaho ni bidukikije muri kaminuza y’amajyepfo ya Oregon muri Oregoni kandi yari Porofeseri muri gahunda yu bumenyi ni bidukikije muri kaminuza.
Ubushakashatsi bwa Jones bwasobanuwe kandi ubuhanga bwe bwagaragaye mu bitabo by’ubucuruzi bwa divayi no ku mbuga za interineti harimo: Ikinyamakuru muri Gicurasi 2015, "cya Oregoni muri" Gicurasi 2015, ["3" "Divayi nini yo mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba" Mata 2015, (Ukuboza 2014), Nzeri 2013), Ikinyamakuru mu gushyingo 2012), n'ikinyamakuru "Mail Tribune" (Kamena 2009).
Icyubahiro n'ibihembo.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Jones yahawe igihembo cy'icyubahiro na Ranki na Conifirariya kubera akazi yakoranye n'inganda zikora divayi muri Porutugali.

Ibiribwa hamwe na lisansi ni ikibazo kijyanye n'ingaruka zo gutandukanya imirima cyangwa ibihingwa kugirango umusaruro wa biyogaze ubangamire itangwa ry'ibiribwa. Impaka za biyogizi ni biribwa zirimo ibitekerezo byinshi, kandi ni kuva kera, bitavugwaho rumwe mu bitabo. Hariho ukutumvikana ku kamaro ki kibazo, ikibitera, ni bishobora gukorwa cyangwa kugirango iki kibazo gikemuke. Ibigoye kandi bidashidikanywaho biterwa nu mubare munini wingaruka ni bisubizo bishobora kugira ingaruka nziza cyangwa mbi kuri sisitemu yi biciro. Byongeye kandi, imbaraga zigereranijwe zizi ngaruka nziza kandi mbi ziratandukanye mu gihe gito kandi kirekire, zirimo ingaruka zitinze. Uruhande rwa masomo yi mpaka narwo ruyobowe no gukoresha uburyo butandukanye bwu bukungu nu buryo bwo guhatanira gusesengura imibare.
Ifaranga ry'ibiciro by'ibiribwa.
Kuva 1974 kugeza 2005 ibiciro byibiribwa nyabyo (byahinduwe kugirango ifaranga) byagabanutseho 75%. Ibiciro byibicuruzwa byari bihagaze neza nyuma yo kugera ku ntera mu 2000 na 2001. Kubwibyo, kwiyongera kwibiciro byibiribwa vuba bifatwa nkibidasanzwe. Impapuro zikora ubushakashatsi kuri politiki ya Banki y'Isi yasohotse muri Nyakanga 2008 zagaragaje ko izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ibiribwa ryayobowe n’ibinyampeke, hamwe n’izamuka ry’ibiciro mu 2005 nubwo ibihingwa byanditswe ku isi. Kuva muri Mutarama 2005 kugeza muri Kamena 2008, ibiciro by'ibigori byikubye hafi gatatu, ingano ziyongereyeho 127 ku ijana, n'umuceri wazamutseho 170 ku ijana. Ubwiyongere bw'ibiciro by'ingano bwakurikiwe no kwiyongera kw'amavuta n'ibiciro bya peteroli hagati ya 2006. Ku rundi ruhande, ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko umusaruro w’ibisheke wiyongereye vuba, kandi wari munini bihagije kugira ngo igiciro cy’isukari cyiyongere gito usibye 2005 na mbere ya 2006. Uru rupapuro rwanzuye ko ibicanwa biva mu binyampeke byazamuye ibiciro by’ibiribwa bifatanije n’ibindi bintu bifitanye isano hagati ya 70 na 75 ku ijana, ariko Ethanol ikomoka mu bisukari ntabwo yagize uruhare runini mu izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ibiribwa biherutse.

Guhinga kwimura ni gahunda yu buhinzi aho usanga imirima ihingwa byigihe gito, hanyuma igatereranwa mugihe ibimera bitangiye guhungabana byemerewe gukura kubuntu mugihe umuhinzi yagiye guhinga ahandi. Igihe cyo guhinga gikunze kurangira iyo ubutaka bwerekana ibimenyetso by umunaniro cyangwa, iyo umurima urengerwa ni byatsi. Igihe cyigihe umurima uhingwamo ubusanzwe ni kigufi ugereranije nigihe ubutaka bwemerewe kubyara bushya kubeshya.
Ibidukikije muri politiki.
Guhinduranya guhinga ni uburyo bwu buhinzi cyangwa gahunda yo guhinga, aho, mugihe runaka, mugihe gito, umurima muto uhingwa kandi benshi bari mu byiciro bitandukanye byo kongera gukura. Igihe kirenze, imirima ihingwa mugihe gito ugereranije, kandi yemerewe gukira, cyangwa igwa, mugihe kirekire. Amaherezo umurima wahinzwe mbere uzahanagurwa ku bimera karemano hanyuma uzongere guhingwa mu bihingwa. Imirima muri sisitemu yo guhinga yashyizweho kandi ihamye ihingwa kandi igwa buri gihe. Ubu bwoko bwo guhinga bwitwa jhumming mu Buhinde.

Ibimera ku mubumbe ni umuryango ugamije gukangurira abana ndetse n’abantu bakuru ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere n’ubutabera ku isi. ni igikorwa ikora kandi mu gutera ibiti kandi ibona ko iki ari igikorwa gifatika kandi cyi kigereranyo mu rwego rwo kugabanya ingaruka z’imihindagurikire yi kirere. Muri 2011, yageze ku ntego yo gutera ibiti miliyoni.
Uyu muryango uri mu bafatanyabikorwa b’urufatiro rwa Fondasiyo f 20, umuyoboro mpuzamahanga wi mishinga ni miryango ya bagiraneza.

Ubuhinzi bwa Kamere bwa shinzwe mu 1936 na Mokichi Okada, washinze Itorero ry isi mesiyaniti, gahunda y’ubuhinzi yiswe nta feritilize farming.
Offshoots nka Sekai Kyusei Kyo, iteza imbere 'ubuhinzi bw’ibidukikije bwa Kuyuseyi', ni shyirahamwe rya Mokichi Okada rya shinzwe nyuma yu rupfu rwe kugira ngo rikomeze guteza imbere umurimo mu Buyapani no muri Aziya y'Amajyepfo-Uburasirazuba.
