Tochukwu Nnourge (wavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga 1995) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa volleyball ukomoka muri Nijeriya ukina mu ikipe ya gasutamo ya Nigeria ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya volleyball y'abagore.
Ni kapiteni w'ikipe ya gasutamo ya Nigeria.
Ikhiede yavukiyei Asaba mu 1995.
Ikhiede akina mu ikipe ya bakinira volleyball yo ku mucanga b mu ikipe y'igihugu ya volleyball y'abagore.
Mu ntangiriro za 2019 yari i Yawunde muri Kameruni aho we na Francisca Ikhiede begukanye umudari wa zahabu muri Shampiyona mpuzamahanga ya Volleyball ya Camtel.
Yari mu ikipe yari ihagarariye Afurika mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya FIVB ya Volleyball ya 2019 yabereye i Bariloche, muri Rio Negro muri Arijantine. Ari kumwe na bagenzi be batsinze Argentine yakiriye umukino ubanza 2-1 (13-15, 15–11, 15–11).
Yari mu ikipe yari ihagarariye Nijeriya mu marushanwa ya mbere y’umwaka wa 2019 wa Shampiyona y’isi ya Volleyball yaberaga i Hamburg mu Budage.
Ikipe ya Nigeriya yari iya kabiri mugihe Kenya yujuje ibisabwa kugirango imikino Olempike isubitswe 2020.
Yari mu ikipe ya gasutamo ya Nijeriya yagumanye igikombe cya Perezida Beach Volleyball mu 2021 i Kaduna ari kumwe na mugenzi we Francisca Ikhiede.

Amarachi Uchechukwu (yavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2001) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa volleyball wo muri Nijeriya ukina mu ikipe ya gasutamo ya Nijeriya ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya volley ball ya bagore.
Amarachi akina mu ikipe yo kumucanga ya volleyball muri b mu ikipe y'igihugu ya volleyball ya bagore.

Ikibaya cya Mugogo kiri ku buso bwa Hegitari 79.
Ibyo wamenya ku Igishanga cya Mugongo.
Abakorera mu gishanga cya Mugogo bakomeje kwibaza uko bazakomeza bahangana n’ibihe biri imbere mu bijyanye n’imirire, bitewe n’uko amazi y’imvura ikomeje kugwa akarengera igishanga, bikaba bitaborohera kubona uburyo bahinga.Abatuye mu ngo zegereye icyo gishanga cya Mugogo, bafite impungenge z’uko igihe nkicyi cy’itumba turimo, imvura irimo igwa ari nyinshi nabwo amazi ashobora kuzaba menshi kurushaho,bakisanga yageze mu ngo zabo.Ukurikije uburyo imvura irimo igwa muri iyi minsi, yangije kiriya kibaya, bigaragaza ko hakiri icyuho gikomeye mu kubona igisubizo cyaho kirambye mukukibungabunga.Abahanga bagiye basesengura ndetse n’inyigo zagiye zikorwa, bikagaragara ko gukemura kiriya kibazo bikiri ingorabahizi, bigomba guhera ku gukumira amazi aturuka mu misozi miremire harimo nk'imisozi yo muri Nyabihu no mu birunga; ndetse kandi na Leta ikaba hari imishinga yanatangiye gushyira mu bikorwa.Minisiteri ibifite mu nshingano, mukwita no kwiga kuri kiriya kibazo cy’ikibaya cya Mugogo cyuzura, kiri mu byihutirwa Leta irimo gushakira ingengo y’imari yo kugikemura no gushaka igisubizo kirambye.

Yabaye mu ikipe yari mu gikombe cy'isi cy’abagore cya FIFA 2003 ndetse n’igikombe cy’isi cya FIFA 2007. Ku rwego rwa ikipe akinira Robert Morris College muri Amerika.

Igishanga cya Bugugu kigabanya Umurenge wa Kigabiro na Rubona.
Ibyo Wamenya ku Igishanga cya Bugugu.
Igishanga cya Bugugu kitaratunganywa bagiraga ubwoba bwo guhinga ahantu hanini kuko nta mazi ahagije yari ahari.Abahinzi bavuga ko nyuma y’uko iki gishanga gitunganyirijwe,Igishanga cya Bugugu cyikongerwamo amazi, bongereye ubuso buhingwamo kuko babonaga ikibazo cy’amazi gikemutse.Igishanga cya Bugugu kitaratunganywa cyahingwagamo n’abahinzi 900 ariko bariyongereye bagera ku kigero cya 1 200. Umusaruro wo mu bihembwe, urugero bibiri bishize wikubye ku inshuro ebyiri kuko wavuye kuri toni 3 kuri hegitari ugera kuri toni 5.3, hakaba hari umuhigo w’uko umusaruro uzagera kuri toni 7 kuri hegitare.Ubu bari muri gahunda yo kwagura imirima ikaba migari kuko amazi ahagije.Kuri ubungubu nukuvuga ngo batangiye guhinga neza n’amazi babona ahagije kuko ibihembwe bibiri bishize, umusaruro waboneka kuri hegitare nawo wariyongereye kuko amazi yabonetse n’abatabiraga ibijumba hafi binjiye mu buhinzi bw’umuceri.

Ku rwego rwa ikipe yakiniye La Ladies muri Gana.

Nadia Medjmedj (wavutse ku ya 20 Werurwe 1974) ni umukinnyi wa Paralempike ukomoka muri Alijeriya uhatanira mu cyiciro cya F 56 cyo gutera no kujugunya umuhunda.
Yitabiriye imikino Paralempike yo mu 2008 yabereye i Beijing mu Bushinwa. Agezeyo, yatsindiye umudari wa bronze mu ishoti ry’abagore ryashyize mu majwi F 57 na F 58 ndetse na disikuru y’abagore itera F 57 na F 58.

Asmahan Boudjadar ni umukinnyi wo muri Alijeriya uhatanira gutera no kujugunya umuhunda. Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu ishoti rya F 33 ryashyizwe mu mikino Paralempike ya 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro, muri Burezili.
Asmahan Boudjadar yarushanwe mu ishoti ryashyizwe mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri ya 2015 yabereye i Doha, muri Qatar. Yataye ikimenyetso k'umukino wanyuma, arangirira k'umwanya w'anyuma. Muri Werurwe 2016, yangije ishoti nyafurika F33 yashyizeho amateka atera 5.56 metres (18.2 ft) muri IPC Abakinnyi ba Grand Prix i Dubai. Boudjadar yateye kandi muri ku muhunda, aho yashyizeho amateka mashya ya F 33.
Yitabiriye imikino Paralympike ye ya mbere mu 2016 i Rio de Janeiro, muri Burezili, nyuma yuwo mwaka. Yagize uruhare mu kurasa F33 mu bagore, yegukanye umudari wa zahabu afite amateka mashya ya Afurika afite metero 5.72, imbere ya Qatar Sara Hamdi Masoud na Sara Alesanaani wo muri Leta zunze ubumwe z'Abarabu ku mwanya wa kabiri n'uwa gatatu. Boudjadar yagize icyo avuga nyuma yibi birori, avuga ko yumva ari ukumwihorera nyuma y’ibyavuye mu marushanwa yabanjirije aya. Mu birori bya mbere bya Grand Prix yo muri 2017, yongeye kwandika amateka ya javelin ku isi, atera 12.82 metres (42.1 ft).

Yabaye kandi inshuro ebyiri yegukanye umudari wa zahabu muri decathlon mu mikino yose ya Afurika, yatsinze mu 1987 na 1991. Yatsindiye ibikombe bitatu bya decathlon mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri y’Abarabu kuva 1981 kugeza 1987 kandi yegukanye umudari wa zahabu inshuro ebyiri mu mikino ya Pan Arab Arab 1985, aza ku mwanya wa mbere muri podiyumu ya decathlon na javelin.
Bacha yagaragaye rimwe kurwego rwisi, muri Shampiyona yisi 1983 yaberaga muri siporo. Ntabwo yananiwe kwandika ikimenyetso cyemewe mumikino yo kurasa ahitamo kutarangiza amarushanwa.

Tazmin Brits (yavutse ku ya 8 Mutarama 1991) ni umukinnyi w'umugore ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatsindiye zahabu mu gutera umuhunda mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y'urubyiruko mu 2007. Yiteguye gutorwa mu mikino Olempike izabera i Londere 2012, mbere yo kugira impanuka yo mu muhanda, imusiga mu bitaro amezi abiri. Muri Gicurasi 2022, Ciriketi Afurika y'Epfo yahaye Abongereza amasezerano ye ya mbere yo hagati, mbere ya shampiyona 2022-23. Muri Nyakanga 2022, Brits yongerewe mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo mu marushanwa ya Ciriketi mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza 2022 yabereye i Birmingham, mu Bwongereza.

Yabaye umukinnyi wambere watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Shampiyona y’abagore mu Ntara ya 2010.

Azmi Mohamed Megahed (15 Mata 1950 – 12 Nzeri 2020) yari umukinnyi ukina umukino wa maboko wa volleyball wo muri Egiputa. Yitabiriye imikino y'abagabo mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1976

Ikiyaga cya Sake ni ikiyaga cyo mu Rwanda. Giherereye mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Iki kiyaga gihana imbibi n'imirenge itatu: Sake, Jarama na Rukumberi. Ni ikiyaga gito kandi kidafite ubujyakuzimu burebure. Kizwiho kugira amafi menshi n'ingona. Abaturage bagituriye barobamo amafi kandi bamwe bavomamo amazi.
Ikiyaga cya Sake kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 350. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo ntiburenza metero 4,3.
Iki kiyaga gihana imbibi n'imirenge itatu y'Akarere ka Ngoma. Ni Umurenge wa Sake, Umurenge wa Jarama n'Umurenge wa Rukumberi.
Ibimera n'inyamaswa.
Ku nkombe z'ikiyaga hamera urufunzo ("Cyperus papyrus"). Hamera kandi ubwatsi bwitwa "Echinochloa pyramidalis".
Ikiyaga cya Sake kizwiho kugira amafi menshi. Mu kiyaga haba kandi inyamaswa yitwa "Lutra maculicollis". Haba kandi ingona.
Abaturage baturiye ikiyaga barobamo amafi. Bamwe muri bo bavomamo amazi. Mu mwaka wa 2016, abaturage bavugaga ko batinya ingona ziba mu kiyaga. Ubuyobozi bw'Umurenge wa Sake bwasabaga abaturage kutavoma amazi y'iki kiyaga. Bwabasabaga kuvoma ku mavomo no ku masoko.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Ngoma bwateganyaga kugira inkengero z'ikiyaga ahantu nyaburanga. Icyo gihe ibiti byari biherutse guterwa ku nkengero zacyo kugira ngo kibungabungwe.

Mu nkengero z’Ikiyaga cya Sake mu Murenge wa Rukumberi, Akagari ka Rubago ni ho haherereye ‘Sake Beach’ hamwe mu hantu nyaburanga hatunganyirijwe gukorerwa ubukerarugendo hafunguwe muri 2019, hari ubusitani bukora ku mazi y’Ikiyaga cya Sake ku mucanga.
Uretse ubusitani buhari, kuri ubu hari kubakwa amacumbi, bikaba biteganyijwe ko hazubakwa n’inzu ziberamo inama, umwanya w’imyidagaduro, gushyiraho ikibuga cya Volley ku mucanga, gushyiraho aho abana bidagadurira, na Piscine yihariye ku batinya kujya mu mazi magari y’ikiyaga. Wongeyeho ko ubu uretse abo mu Karere ka Ngoma hari n’abo mu bindi bice baza kuhatemberera no kuhiyakirira, nubwo bakiri bake.
Akarere ka Ngoma gaherutse gutangaza ko kiteguye gukemura imbogamizi zirimo iz’umuhanda werekeza kuri Sake Beach udakoze neza no kwihutisha uburyo bwo kuhageza amashanyarazi.

Ikiyaga cya Mugesera ni ikiyaga cyo mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Kigali. Gihana imbibi kandi n'Akarere ka Rwamagana.
Ikiyaga cya Mugesera gifite ubuso bwa km² 39. Ni cyo kiyaga kinini mu biyaga n'ibishanga by'ikibaya cya Nyawarungu. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Abatutsi benshi bajugunywe muri iki kiyaga. Kubera iyo mpamvu, gifatwa nk'urwibutso rwa Jenoside.
Ikiyaga cya Mugesera kiri mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Kigali. Kiri mu Karere ka Ngoma, mu Murenge wa Mugesera, uwa Zaza n'uwa Rukumberi. Gihana imbibi kandi n'Umurenge wa Karenge wo mu Karere ka Rwamagana.
Ikiyaga cya Mugesera kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 1 360. Gifite ubuso bwa km² 39. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri m 4,5. Ubujyakuzimu buringaniye ni m 3.
Ikiyaga kiri mu kibaya gifite ubugari bwa km 35. Umugezi wa Nyawarungu unyura muri icyo kibaya ugana mu majyepfo. Uwo mugezi utera ibishanga n'ibiyaga bihoraho. Ikiyaga cya Mugesera kiri iburasirazuba bw'uwo mugezi. Ni cyo kiyaga kinini muri ibyo biyaga. Ni kimwe mu biyaga byo hejuru by'uruzi rw'Akagera.
Amazi y'ikiyaga aturuka ku migezi mito imanuka ku misozi yo mu majyaruguru, iburasirazuba no mu majyepfo. Iyo migezi izana amazi menshi mu bihe by'imvura. Ikirere cyaho gifite ubushyuhe buringaniye kubera ubutumburuke. Ibihe by'imvura ni kuva muri Werurwe kugeza muri Gicurasi, no kuva muri Nzeri kugeza mu Kuboza.
Ibinyabuzima n'uburobyi.
Ubushyuhe bw'amazi yo hejuru buri hagati ya °C 23 na 25. Mu kiyaga harimo amafi menshi n'amoko menshi y'inyoni zo mu mazi. Harimo kandi ingona, inzoka n'izindi nyamaswa.
Amafi y'ingenzi mu uburobyi ni "Oreochromis niloticus" na "Oreochromis melanopleura". Mu 1973, ku kiyaga hakoreraga abarobyi 325. Uwo mwaka, baroba toni 300 z'amafi. Ubu, ku nkengero z'ikiyaga, borora amafi mu bigega.
Ubwikorezi n'ubukerarugendo.
Mu 2023, hakozwe ubwato bunini buhuza Umurenge wa Mugesera n'Umurenge wa Karenge. Ubwo bwato bwatwaraga abantu, imodoka n'umusaruro w'ubuhinzi nk'inanasi. Mu 2025, ubwo bwato bwari bumaze umwaka urenga budakora.
Mu Murenge wa Zaza, ku nkengero z'ikiyaga, hubatswe hoteli yitwa Lakeside Recreation Resort.
Mu kinyejana cya 15, akarere gakikije Ikiyaga cya Mugesera kari gatuwe n'umuryango w'Abahondogo. Abahondogo bari aborozi b'Abatutsi bari bafite igihugu cyigenga.
Umurenge wa Rukumberi ukikijwe n'ibiyaga bitatu: Sake, Mugesera na Rweru. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Abatutsi bo muri Rukumberi babuze aho bahungira. Abenshi bishwe. Abandi bajugunywe mu Kiyaga cya Mugesera.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukumberi rushyinguyemo abazize Jenoside barenga 38 000. Buri mwaka muri Mata, abarokotse bashyira indabo kuri iki kiyaga. Ikiyaga gifatwa nk'urwibutso rwa Jenoside.

Umusozi wa Nyiragongo (/ˌ n ɪər ə ˈ ɡ ɒ ŋ ɡ oʊ, - ˈ ɡ ɔː ŋ - / neer-ə-INDIRIMBO -go) ni stratovolcano ikora ifite uburebure bwa 3,470 m (11.385) ft) mu misozi ya Virunga ifitanye isano na Albertine Rift. Iherereye muri parike y'igihugu ya Virunga, n Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, nko mu birometero 12,5 mu majyaruguru y’umujyi wa Goma n’ikiyaga cya Kivu no mu burengerazuba bw’umupaka n’u Rwanda. Ikibaya kinini gifite uburebure bwa kilometero ebyiri (1 mi) kandi ubusanzwe kirimo ikiyaga cya lava. Kugeza ubu icyo cyobo gifite intebe ebyiri zitandukanye zikonje za lava zikonje mu rukuta rw'ikiriba - imwe kuri metero 3,175 (10.417 ft) naho iyindi yo munsi ya metero 2975 (9,760 ft).
Ikiyaga cya lava cya Nyiragongo rimwe na rimwe cyabaye ikiyaga kinini kizwi cyane mu mateka ya vuba. Ubujyakuzimu bw'ikiyaga cya lava buratandukanye cyane. Uburebure ntarengwa bw'ikiyaga cya lava bwanditswe kuri metero 3,250 (metero 10,660) mbere yo guturika kwa Mutarama 1977 - ubujyakuzimu bw'ikiyaga gifite metero 600 (2000). Nyuma yo guturika muri Mutarama 2002, ikiyaga cya lava cyanditswe ku butumburuke bwa metero 2.600 (metero 8.500), cyangwa metero 900 munsi y’umugezi. Urwego rwazamutse buhoro buhoro kuva icyo gihe. Nyiragongo hamwe na Nyamuragira hafi yabo ni bo nyirabayazana wa 40 ku ijana by'iruka ry’ibirunga bya Afurika.

Umusozi wa Everest (Nepali: सगरमाथा, romanised: Sagarmāthā; Tibetan: Chomolungma ཇོ་ མོ་ གླང་ མ; Igishinwa: 珠穆朗玛峰; pinyin: Zhūmùlǎngmǎ Fēng) ni umusozi muremure w'isi hejuru y’inyanja, uherereye mu gace ka Mahalangur Himal. Himalaya. Umupaka w'Ubushinwa na Nepal unyura mu mpinga yawo. Uburebure bwacyo (uburebure bwa shelegi) bwa 8.848.86 m (29,031 ft 8 + 1⁄2 in) bwashizweho vuba aha mu 2020 n’abayobozi b’Ubushinwa na Nepali.
Umusozi wa Everest ukurura abazamuka benshi, harimo nabanyamisozi bafite uburambe. Hariho inzira ebyiri nyamukuru zo kuzamuka, imwe yegera impinga kuva mu majyepfo yuburasirazuba bwa Nepal (izwi nka "inzira isanzwe") indi iva mumajyaruguru muri Tibet. Nubwo idafite ibibazo bikomeye byo kuzamuka mu buryo bwa tekiniki mu nzira isanzwe, Everest irerekana akaga nk'indwara zo mu butumburuke, ikirere, n'umuyaga, ndetse n'ingaruka ziterwa n'inkangu hamwe na Khumbu. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2019, abantu barenga 300 bapfiriye kuri Everest, inyinshi mu mibiri yabo ikaguma ku musozi.
Imbaraga za mbere zanditse kugirango tugere mu nama ya Everest zakozwe n'abasozi b'Abongereza. Kubera ko icyo gihe Nepal itemereraga abanyamahanga kwinjira muri icyo gihugu, Abongereza bagerageje inshuro nyinshi ku nzira yo mu majyaruguru iva mu ruhande rwa Tibet. Nyuma y’urugendo rwa mbere rw’iperereza n’abongereza mu 1921 rugeze kuri m 7000 (22,970 ft) kuri Col ya ruguru, urugendo rwo mu 1922 rwasunitse inzira y’imisozi y’amajyaruguru rugera kuri m 8.320 (27.300 ft), bikaba bibaye ubwa mbere umuntu azamuka hejuru ya m 8000 (26,247 ft). Urugendo rwo mu 1924 rwavuyemo rimwe mu mayobera akomeye kuri Everest kugeza na nubu: George Mallory na Andrew Irvine bagerageje inama ya nyuma ku ya 8 Kamena ariko ntibigera bagaruka, bituma havuka impaka zo kumenya niba ari bo ba mbere bageze ku isonga. Tenzing Norgay na Edmund Hillary bakoze inyandiko ya mbere ya Everest mu 1953, bakoresheje inzira yo mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba. Norgay yari imaze kugera kuri m 8,595 (28.199 ft) umwaka ushize nkumunyamuryango w’urugendo rw’Abasuwisi 1952. Itsinda ry’abashinwa ry’imisozi rya Wang Fuzhou, Gonpo, na Qu Yinhua bakoze raporo ya mbere yazamutse ku mpinga iva mu misozi y’amajyaruguru ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1960..

Jamie Craig Webber (wavutse ku ya 21 Mutarama 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Afurika yepfo ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga, mu ikipe ya SuperSport United yo mu gihugu cya muri Afurika yepfo.
Amaze gukinira Vasco da Gama na Stellenbosch mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’igihugu, yinjiye muri SuperSport United muri Mutarama 2018.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Kamena 2017, yahamagawe mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo mu gikombe cya COSAFA, maze atangira gukinira Afurika y'Epfo muri iri rushanwa.
Yahagarariye kandi Afurika yepfo kurwego rw'abatarengeje imyaka 23.

El Arabi Hilal Soudani (wavutse 25 Ugushyingo 1987) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Alijeriya ukina nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere mu ikipe ya Damake yo mu gihugu cya Arabiya Sawudite ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Alijeriya.
Soudani yagaragaye bwa mbere ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu mwaka wa 2010, agaragara mu marushanwa ya 2013, 2015 na 2017 mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu, ndetse no mu gikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cy'abereye muri Burezili 2014. Kugeza mu Gushyingo 2019, yatsindiye imipira 54 mpuzamahanga ndetse atsinda ibitego 24, bituma aba umunyalijeriya w'atsinze ibitego bitandatu mu mateka.
Soudani wavukiye muri Chlefe, yatangiye umwuga we mu ntera ntoya y’ikipe yavukiyemo Chlef. Muri Gicurasi 2006, afite imyaka 19, yatangiye gukinira ikipe ye ya mbere muri iyi kipe asimbuye USM Annaba mu cyiciro cya 28 cya shampiyona yo muri Alijeriya 2005 kugeza 06, yaje gukinira Samir Zaoui ku munota wa 72.
Muri 2008, Soudani yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w’umwaka wa 2008 nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego 11 mu mikino 24 muri shampiyona ya 2007–08.
Muri Kamena 2011, Soudani yagiye mu igeragezwa n'ikipe y'Abafaransa shampiyona 2 muri Le Mans FC.
Vitória de Guimaraes.
Ku ya 8 Kanama 2011, Soudani yasinyanye amasezerano y’imyaka itatu n’ikipe ya Victoriya yo muri Porutugali. Amafaranga yo kwimura byavuzwe ko mu mayelo 800.000. Ku ya 25 Kanama 2011, Soudani yatangiye gukinira Vitória ku mugaragaro nk'umusimbura w’iminota 66 mu mukino wo kwishyura wa shampiyona yiburayi 2011 muri 12 na Atletico Madrid. Ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2011, Soudani yafunguye konti ye muri iyi kipe akoresheje igitego mu cyiciro cya gatatu cya Taca yo muri Poritugale 2011 kugeza 12 na Moura Atlético Clube. Nyuma yo gutsinda igitego 1-0, Soudani yatsinze igitego cyo kunganya ku munota wa 89 wumukino wohereza umukino kumwanya winyongera, mbere yo gutsinda uwatsinze kumunota wa 117. Ku ya 1 Mata 2012, yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muri Primeira Liga itsinze Pacos ya Ferreira ibitego 3-1. Ku ya 21 Mata, yatsinze igitego 3-2 yatsinze Uniayo ya Leiria.
Ku ya 26 Gicurasi 2013, Soudani yafashije Vitória gutsinda umukino wa mbere wa Taça de Portugal yatsinze Benfica ibitego 2–1 ku mukino wa nyuma, atsinda igitego cyo kunganya ku munota wa 79 mbere yuko Ricardo Pereira atsinda igitego nyuma yiminota ibiri. Bukeye, yagiye muri Korowasiya kugira ngo arangize ubuvuzi mbere yo kwimurirwa i Dinamo Zagreb.

Abdellah Haimoud (wavutse 21 Gicurasi 2001), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Marocke ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati wa mu ikipe ya Botola Wydad AC.
Amaze gutangira gukora akiri muto muri Mohammed VI Football Academy. Mu mwaka wa 2021, yabonye impinduka ikipe yo muri Wydad AC.
Ku ya 30 Gicurasi 2022, yaje ku munota wa 84 kuri Guy Mbenza na Al-Ahly SC ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Afurika cya CAF maze atsinda umukino itsinze ibitego 2-0 kuri Stade Mohammed V.
Ibikorwa mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2022, umutoza Hicham Dmii yamutumiye mu myitozo hamwe n’ikipe ya Maroc A, agaragara ku rutonde rw’abakinnyi 23 bazitabira imikino y’ubufatanye bwa kisilamu muri Kanama 2022.
Ku ya 15 Nzeri 2022, Hicham Dmii yamutumiye hamwe na Maroc mu mikino Olempike guhatana na Senegali mu rwego rwo kwitegura kwitabira imikino Olempike yo mu 2024.

Maghreb de Fès ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga muri Maroke ifite icyicaro i Fez, ikora amarushanwa muri Botola, indege y'ambere y'umupira w'amaguru wa Maroke.
Iyikipe yashinzwe mu 1946. Iyi ikipe yari isanzwe yambara ibikoresho byo murugo kuva yatangira. Maghreb de Fès ni ikipe izwi cyane kubera gutsinda igice cyayo cyumupira wamaguru, izwi cyane mugihugu ndetse no hanze yacyo. Iyi kipe yakinnye imikino yayo iwayo muri 45,000 Stade Fez iri mumujyi wa Fez kuva 2007
Maghreb de Fès yigaragaje nk'imbaraga zikomeye mu mupira w'amaguru muri Maroc ndetse no muri Afurika mu kinyejana cya 20. Mu mupira wamaguru mu gihugu, iyi kipe yatwaye ibikombe 10; 4 Amazina ya Botola, 4 Igikombe cy'intebe ya Maroke na Botola 2 (icyiciro cya kabiri cya Maroke) kabiri. Mu marushanwa yo ku mugabane no ku isi, Maghreb Fez yatwaye ibikombe 2; igikombe kimwe cya CAF Confederatiyo Igikombe kimwe na CAF.
Itsinda rishyigikiye kumugaragaro rya MAS ni Ingwe Zica. Yashinzwe mu 2006.

Abatsinze (4): 1980, 1988, 2011, 2016

Igishanga cya Rugende nigishanga giherereye mukarere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali Kandi nigishanga gikora kuturere tubiri aritwo Gasabo na Rwamagana.

Umuhuzabikorwa w'ibiro by'ubutaka n'ibikorwaremezo mu karere ka Gasabo bwahaye Igihe ntarengwa kubafite Ibikorwa byabo ndetse na magaraje mu gishanga cya Gatsata ko baba bamaze gukuramo ibikorwa byabo bitarenze Taliki 30 Ukwakira 2011

"Igishanga cya Kibumba giherereye mukarere ka Nyamagabe."
Ibyo Wamenya ku Igishanga cya Kibumba.
Iki gishanga, abahinzi bagihingamo bavuga ko imirima myinshi yatwawe n’imyuzure hagasigara udushitu, gusa bakaba bafite ikibazo cyuko umugezi wa Rukarara wicamo ibice iyo wongeye kuzura ubundi ahasigaye uhatwara kuko wari ufite inzira imwe kuri ubu ukaba ufite izigera kuri esheshatu.Ubuyobozi bwa karere buvugako igikwiye ari kubanza gukorwa kuri iki kibazo ari ubukangurambaga ku gushinganisha ibihingwa mu baturage, kugira ngo nihaba ibiza bajye byibuza babasha kubona imbuto bashoye.Bakomeje bavuga bateganya kuhasura bakareba ikibazo uko giteye no gukorana n’bahanga mu gutunganya ibishanga bakazemeza uburyo iki gishanga cyatunganywamo, n’igitera kuta inzira kw’amazi ya Rukarara atuma igishanga cyuzura.bagombaga kuzabanza kugere muri ako gace bakareba icyakorwa n’ibyangiritse uko bingana. Abaturage na bo basabwaga kujya bahinga basiga inkombe z’umugezi ntibasasereze imigezi, abahinga imusozi nabo bagasibura imirwanyasuri.gahunda yari kuzakorana n’abahanga mu gutunganya ibishanga nibo bazemeza icyo cyiriya gishanga cyizakorerwa n’amazi yataye inzira ya Rukarara.
Tumenye gahunda ya leta yo kubungabunga Ibishanga.
Ibishanga biri gutunganywa mu rwego rwo kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biba mu bishanga.u Rwanda rurushaho gufata imyanzuro yo kugabanya ibikorwa bya muntu byangiza ibishanga kugira ngo hirindwe ingaruka zatezwa n’iyangirika ryabyo.Mu mwaka 2020 u Rwanda rwavuguruye National determined contributions ni gahunda y'igihugu yo guhangana n'imyuka ihumanya ikirere harimo rero no kubungabunga ibishanga kuko bifite ubushobozi bwo kubika imyuka yangiza ikirere. Ibishanga bibungabunzwe bizagira akamaro ku baturage, Umujyi wa Kigali urakura kimwe n'indi iwegereye, abantu bakenera aho kuruhukira.Muri gahunda yo kwita no gutunganya ibishanga wiswe Kigali Wetland master plan, biteganijwe ko ibishanga 5 muri 36 biri mu Mujyi wa Kigali bigomba gutunganywa mu gihe kitari kirekire kugirango urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima birimo bizabashe gusubirana,Mu bishanga bizatunganywa mu minsi ya vuba n'ubwo hataratangazwa igihe ibikorwa bizatangirira, harimo igishanga cya Rwampara, icya Gikondo, icya Nyabugogo, Rugenge agazwi nko mu Rwintare na Kibumba. usibye kuba bizatanga imirimo ku baturage bazabitunganya, byitezweho ko bizanongera ibikorwa by'ishoramari.Ibikorwa byo gutunga ibi bishanga bizatanga imirimo ku baturage binongere ibikorwa by’ishoramari nk’ubukerarugendo.

Igishanga cya Rwangingo giherereye mukarere ka Gatsibo ndetse kikanakora kukarere ka Nyagatare.
Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Gatsibo mu mwaka wa 2016 bwavuze ko iki gishanga cya Rwangingo kijya gutunganywa hari mu rwego rwo kugira ngo ubukungu burusheho kwiyongera kandi n’imibereho y’abatuye baka karere na yo itere imbere kurushaho.Mugutangira kgukoresha igishanga cya Rwangingo byari biteganyijwe ko iki gishanga kizahingwamo igihingwa cy’umuceri, ariko ku ukubitiro abaturage bazagihingamo barashishikarizwa gutangirana n’imbuto ya soya n’ibigori, kugira ngo habanze hakorwe igeragezwa.Kuba ubuhinzi burimo gufata indi ntera mukarere ka Gatsibo,nibimwe mubimenyetse bivuze ko ubukungu bwako na bwo buri kugeda butera imbere mu buryo bushimishije, ibyo bigira uruhare mu kubyaza umusaruro iki gishanga nabwo burushaho kugenda neza.Igishanga cya Rwangingo gifite ubuso bungana na hegitari 900, Akarere ka Gatsibo kakaba kihariye ubuso buhingwamo bungana na hegitari 320.Umwe mu bahinzi batangiye guhinga muri iki gishanga, avuga ko igihingwa batangiriyeho guhinga cya soya bizeye kuzakuramo umusaruro ushimishije, kandi ngo isoko ryari rinahari kuko bari begerejwe uruganda ruyitunganya.

Godfrey Chitalu, uzwi ku izina rya Ucar (22 Ukwakira 1947 - 27 Mata 1993), yari umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zambiya wakinnye mu bi'imbere. Azwi cyane nk'umukinnyi ukomeye wa Zambiya mu bihe byose kuko afite umuhigo wo gutsinda ibitego mu ikipe y'igihugu kandi yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w’umupira w'amaguru muri Zambiya inshuro eshanu. Muri 2006, yatoranijwe na CAF nk'umwe mu bakinnyi 200 b'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika mu myaka 50 ishize.
Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru muri Zambiya ry'atangaje ko Chitalu yatsinze ibitego birenga 100 mu marushanwa yose yabaye mu 1972, akaba arenga Geradi Mulere yatsindiye mu mwaka umwe ndetse na Lioneli Mesi yose hamwe muri 2012, bombi bakaba bakunze kwita umunyamakuru amateka y'isi. Ubushakashatsi bwatanzwe mu mwaka wa 2012 nyuma yuko Liyoneli Mesi ahinduye amateka avugwa ku isi ya Geradi Mulere. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, umuvugizi wa FIFA yatangaje ko amateka ya FIFA ku isi atigeze abaho kuko batakurikiranye amarushanwa yo mu gihugu.
Nyuma y’izabukuru, Chitalu yatangiye gutoza kandi yari ayoboye ikipe y’igihugu ya Zambiya igihe ikipe yose yazize impanuka y’indege y'abereye ku nkombe za Gaboni ku ya 27 Mata 1993.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Godfrey Kangwa Chitalu yavukiye i Luanshya, mu Ntara ya Copperbelt, aho se Chitalu yakoraga akazi ko gucukura amabuye y'agaciro ndetse akanaba umucamanza w’urukiko rw’ibanze, mu gihe nyina Chitalu yari umugore wo mu rugo. Yakuriye mu gice cya 9 cy'umujyi wa Mine hamwe na barumuna be 9, Godefure ni uwa karindwi wavutse. Aha kandi niho yakinaga umupira wamaguru wurubyiruko utambaye ibirenge, mumihanda yumujyi kimwe nabantu benshi. Imikino yabera hagati yibice bitandukanye byumujyi wa kirombe. Utubuto twaba igihembo nyamukuru kubatsinze, ariko, mubihe bimwe na bimwe amafaranga yaba igiciro. Aha niho imikino imwe nimwe yarangirira mu kuboko, hagati y'amakipe ahanganye. Chitalu yakundaga gukina umupira, ariko imiterere y'imikino isobanura ko yagize imvune nyinshi. Bimwe muri ibyo bikomere byaba birimo ukuboko kuvunitse, kuzavunika inshuro nyinshi mugihe kizaza. Rimwe na rimwe, iyo yari mu bitaro, yarahunze akajya gukina umupira n'incuti ze.

Umugezi wa Luapula ni igice cy'umugezi wa kabiri muremure wa Afurika, Kongo. Ni uruzi rw'ambukiranya imipaka rugizwe hafi y'uburebure bw'umupaka uhuza Zambiya na Congo. Ihuza ikiyaga cya Bangweulu (muri Zambiya yose) kugera ku kiyaga cya Mweru (gisangiwe hagati y'ibihugu byombi) kandi giha izina Intara ya Luwapula ya Zambiya.

Umugezi wa Lubudi ni uruzi rwu mugezi wa Luwalaba muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC). Lubudi yazamutse hafi y'umupaka wa Zambiya mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bwa Kolwezi. Itemba mu majyaruguru no mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba kugira ngo ifatanye na Luwalaba uhereye ibumoso aho ikibaya cya Katanga cyo mu majyepfo kigwa mu bwonko bwa Upemba, hafi ya Bukama. [1]

Uruzi rwa Lubue ruturuka mu majyepfo rugana mu majyaruguru runyura mu karere ka Idiofa, intara ya Kwilu, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Hafi y'aho rukomoka mu majyepfo, aho uruzi rwa Musanga rwinjirira uturutse ibumoso, ni uruzi ruto rugoramye, rufite ubugari bwa metero 12 (ubunini bwa 39 ft), rufite amabuye n'imigezi y'amazi yihuta (rapids) ruhagaze. Rutangira gukoreshwa n'amato ahitwa Mulasa, kandi nyuma y'aho, runyura mu kibaya kinini cyuzuye amashyamba.Rusohokera mu ruzi rwa Kasaï hafi y'umujyi Dibaya Lubue.

Umugezi wa Luele (witwa Piyo cyangwa Liye umugezi wacyo wo hepfo) uva mu majyepfo ugana mu majyaruguru unyuze ku butaka bwa Idiyofa, intara ya Kwilu, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Uruzi rutangira nku mugezi usobanutse mu kibaya gito hafi ya Idiofa. Ikura mu bunini byihuse kubera imigezi mito mito, muri yo hakaba harimo uruzi rwa Punkulu, hanyuma ikanyura mu kibaya kinini mbere yo kwinjira mu ruzi rwa Kasai umanuka uva Mangayi.

Umugezi wa Lufuko (cyangwa Lufuku) ni uruzi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ru sohoka mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika iruhande rwu mudugudu wa Mpala mu Ntara ya Tanganyika (ahahoze ari Intara ya Katanga).
Lufuko itwara igice cy'imisozi ya Marungu. Habayeho ibyifuzo byo kubungabunga amashyamba hejuru ya 1,500 uhana imbibi nu mugezi wa Mulobozi nu mugezi wa Lufuko mu turere tubungabunga ibidukikije. [1]

Lukaya ni uruzi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Inkomoko yacyo iherereye mu misozi ya Crystal, aho iva iburasirazuba ikanyura muri Basi ya Congo, hanyuma ikanyura mu nkombe z'umugezi wa Ndijili. Umuhanda wa gari ya moshi uva Matadi ugana Kinshasa unyura mu kibaya cyu mugezi igihe runaka, unyura mu majyepfo hanyuma ugana iburasirazuba bwa Kinshasa. Igihe kimwe uruzi rwitirirwa akarere muri leta y'ubuntu ya congo.

Umugezi wa Zigi uzwi kandi ku izina rya Sigi mu giswahiri, ni uruzi ruherereye mu burasirazuba bwa Tanga mu gihugu cyaTanzaniya.
Uruzi ruzamuka mu gasozi ka Amani mu burasirazuba bwi misozi ya Usambara mu Karere ka Muheza, mu misozi ya Handei, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1130 kandi butemba kuri kilometero 100 mu masumo maremare hamwe n'impinduka nyinshi zicyerekezo kumunwa wa kilometero 40 mu majyaruguru y'umujyi wa Tanga mu nyanja yu Buhinde. Inzuzi zayo ni Kihuhui (kuva mu majyepfo) na Musi (kuva mu majyaruguru).

Umugezi wa Wembere ni uruzi ruherereye mu majyaruguru yu burengerazuba bwa Singida, muri Tanzaniya. Uruzi ni igice cy'ikibaya cy'amazi cy'ikiyaga cya Eyasi.
Munsi yumwuzure uruzi ruhinduka amajyaruguru yuburasirazuba rugasuka mu majyepfo yikiyaga cya Kitangiri. Ikiyaga cya Kitangiri gisohoka mu kiyaga cya Eyasi kinyuze mu ruzi rwa Sibiti.

Umugezi wa Wami ni uruzi ruherereye mu karere ka Puwanimuri Tanzaniya. ni amazi y’a masoko ya Wami ni nzuzi zayo akomoka mu misozi yi burasirazuba bwa Arike yo mu karere ka Morogoro. Uruzi rutemba rugana mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba unyuze mu karere ka Pwani kugira ngo rwinjire mu nyanja y'Abahinde mu burengerazuba bw'ikirwa cya Zanzibari.

Umugezi wa Umba uherereye mu majyaruguru yu burasirazuba bwa Tanzaniya mu karere ka Tanga. Irazamuka mu ishyamba rya Shagayu mu misozi ya Usambara yi burengerazuba ku butumburuke bwa metero 2000 kandi itemba mu majyaruguru y’umusozi ugana iburasirazuba. I Lelwa isiba uruzi rwa Mbalamu, ruva mu majyaruguru akabije y'imisozi ya Usambara, n'umugezi wa Mglumi ukinjira muri Umba. Mbere yuko Umba yinjira mu nyanja y'Ubuhinde, yambuka umupaka yerekeza muri Kenya. Umunwa ubwawo uranga ahantu h'iburasirazuba cyane ku mupaka uhuza Tanzaniya na Kenya, wakozwe ahanini mu murongo ugororotse ugana mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba ugana ku kiyaga cya Victoria mu kinyejana cya 19. Mu masoko yo hejuru y’uruzi rwagati mu myaka ya za 1960 rwagati, havumbuwe amabuye y'agaciro menshi, harimo safiro na spessartine. Ku ruzi kandi ni Umba River Game Reserve, ikigega cy’inyamanswa kirimo hamwe na Mkomazi Game, hafi kilometero kare 2.600.

Umugezi wa Tarangire ni uruzi ubundi ruherereye mu karere ka Manyara rwa gati mu ishami ryi burasirazuba ryi kibaya cya rifuti cyo muburasirazuba, mu majyaruguru ya Tanzaniya.
Amazi y’umugezi wa Tarangire ari mu misozi miremire no mu nkengero z’akarere ka Babati mu karere ka Manyara n’akarere ka Kondoa mu karere ka Dodoma, cyane cyane imisozi ya Irangi mu Karere ka Kondoa. Uruzi ruzamuka mu misozi ya Wasi, rugwa mu burasirazuba bwa Kondoa Escarpment. Itemba iburasirazuba igana Chubi aho ihindukirira amajyaruguru ikanyura muri parike y'igihugu ya Tarangire.
Hanyuma ihindukirira iburengerazuba hanyuma ikerekeza mu majyepfo, mbere yo kurangirira ku ruzi rwayo ku kiyaga cya Burunge.
Umugezi wa Tarangire nisoko yambere y’amazi meza y’inyamaswa zimuka n’ibindi binyabuzima byo mu bidukikije bya Tarangire mu gihe cyizuba cyumwaka.

Umugezi wa Songwe ni uruzi rugize imbibi mpu zamahanga hagati ya Malawi na karere ka Songwe muri Tanzaniya. Agace ka songwe muri Tanzaniya yitiriwe uruzi.
Amazi meza ya Songwe niho imipaka ya Malawi, Tanzaniya, na Zambiya ihurira. Itemba mu majyepfo yuburasirazuba kugirango yubake mu kiyaga cya Nyasa. Amasomo yo hagati atandukanya imisozi ya Misuku ya Malawi n'umusozi wa Umalila mu karere ka Songwe muri Tanzaniya. Inzira yo hepfo inyura mu kibaya cya Kyela, ikibaya kirumbuka giherereye mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'ikiyaga cya Malawi ikibaya cya Rifuti yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Ikibaya cya Kyela gihingwa n'umuceri n'ibindi bihingwa.

Uruzi rwa Sibiti ni umugezi w’amazi menshi ufite uburebure bwa kilometero mirongo irindwi n’eshanu uhuza ikiyaga cya Eyasi n’ikiyaga cya Kitangiri, ukagira umupaka karemano hagati y’akarere ka Singida n’akarere ka Simiyu mu majyaruguru yo hagati mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya.
Uruzi rwa Sibiti rufite undi mugezi umwe urushamikiyeho ariwo uruzi rwa Semu. Uruzi rwa Sibiti ni uruzi rw'ikibaya cyuzuyemo imigezi myinshi yinjira mu kiyaga cya Kitangiri, harimo:

Umugezi wa Ruvuma hitwa kandi uruzi rwa Rovuma, ni uruzi ruri mu karere k'ibiyaga bigari bya Afurika. M'ugice kinini cy'amasomo yacyo, ikora umupaka uhuza Tanzaniya na Mozambike (muri Mozambike uzwi nka Rio Rovuma). Uruzi rufite kilometero 800, hamwe n'ikibaya cy'amazi gifite kilometero 155,500 mu bunini. Ikigereranyo cyo gusohora buri mwaka ni metero 475 ku munwa wacyo.

Umugezi wa Rufiji uri muri Tanzaniya. Ni uruzi runini kandi ndende mu gihugu. Uruzi rugizwe no guhuza imigezi ya Kilombero na Luwegu. kilometero 600, hamwe n'inkomoko yayo mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Tanzaniya n'umunwa wacyo ku nyanja y'Ubuhinde ahateganye ni kirwa cya Mafiya hakurya ya Mafia, mu karere ka Pwani. Umugezi wacyo nyamukuru ni uruzi runini rwa Ruaha. Irashobora kugenda hafi kilometero100.
Umugezi wa Rufiji ni 200 mu majyepfo ya Dar es Salama. Delita yinzuzi irimo ishyamba rinini rya mangrove mu burasirazuba bwa Afrika.

Umugezi wa Pangani, mu masoko ya kera, kandi ushobora kuba w'arigeze kwitwa Rahaputusi) ni uruzi runini rwo mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Tanzaniya. amasoko abiri y'ingenzi, nayo yinjira mu kigega cya Nyumba ya Mungu mu Karere ka Kilimanjaro. Nyuma yo kuva mu kigega umugezi uhinduka Pangani nkuru, isohoka mu nyanja y'Abahinde mu Karere ka Tanga ku cyambu cya Tangan ku cyambu cya Pangani.

Umugezi wa Mara ni uruzi rutangirira mu Ntara ya Naroko muri Kenya rukarangirira mu Karere ka Mara muri Tanzaniya, kandi rukaba ruri hakurya y'inzira yimuka y’inyamanswa mu bidukikije bya Maasai Mara na Serengeti.

Umugezi wa Manonga, uzwi kandi ku izina rya Manyonga, ni uruzi ruherereye hagati ya karere ka Tabora na karere ka Shinyanga, muri Tanzaniya. Uruzi rutemba rugana iburasirazuba mu kiyaga cy'aKitangiri. Mu gihe cy'izuba, kuva muri Kamena kugeza Ugushyingo, uruzi rwa Manonga rwumye rwose.

Lukuledi ni uruzi ruherereye muri Repubulika yunze ubumwe ya Tanzaniya, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Afurika. rufite uburebure bwa kilometero 160, izamuka iva kumupaka uhuza uturere twa Lindi na Mtwara.

Umugezi wa Kalambo ugize umupaka uhuza Zambiya na karere ka Songwe, Tanzaniya. Ni umugezi muto ugereranije uzamuka ku kibaya cya Ufipa mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Mbala ku butumburuke bwa metero 1800 hanyuma ukamanuka muri Albertine Rifuti, ukinjira mu majyepfo yi burasirazuba bwi kiyaga cya Tanganyika ku butumburuke bwa metero 770, mu buryo bugororotse intera yu murongo wa kilometero 50 gusa. Iyi nyamukuru ivuga ko izwi cyane, isumo ryayo, Isumo rya Kalambo, akaba ari yo ya kabiri muri Afurika yaguye hejuru (nyuma y’amazi ya Tugela yo muri Afurika yepfo. Munsi yimvura, uruzi rutemba mumugezi muremure.
Ukeneye ibisobanuro birambuye reba Isumo rya Kalambo, harimo no gukwirakwiza ahahoze hubatswe kera.

Ikibaya cya Yaeda, cyangwa ikibaya cya Yaida, ni ikibaya cyi gishanga giherereye mu karere ka Mbulu, mu karere ka Manyara, muri Tanzaniya. Ikibaya giherereye mu majyepfo y'ikiyaga cya Eyasi.
Ikibaya kigize ikibaya cya endoreheyike k'idafite aho gihurira. Umusozi muto uva mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba mu majyepfo yu burengerazuba utandukanya ikibaya ni kibaya cy'ikiyaga cya Eyasi.

Ikiyaga cya Sulunga (cyitwa kandi Igishanga cya Bahi) ni ikiyaga kidashinga cyo rwagati muri Tanzaniya. Kiri ku mupaka w'intara za Dodoma na Singida.
Mu gihe cy'imvura, ni cyo kiyaga kinini muri izo ntara zombi. Mu myaka y'izuba ryinshi, gishobora gukama burundu.
Ikiyaga cya Sulunga kiri nko ku birometero 45 mu burengerazuba bw'umujyi wa Dodoma. Kiri mu kibaya cya Bahi, kidafite aho amazi asohokera. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 830.
Iyo cyuzuye, ikiyaga gifite ubuso bwa km² 974. Gifite uburebure bwa km 42 n'ubugari bwa km 26. Akarere gatanga amazi mu kiyaga gafite ubuso bwa km² 23 447. Imigezi y'ingenzi ikinjiramo ni Bubu na Mponde.
Ikiyaga gikikijwe n'imidugudu myinshi. Gifite akamaro mu burobyi no mu bworozi bw'abaturage.

Urugomero rwa Nyumba ya Mungu ni urugomero ruri muri Tanzaniya, urugomero rwa mashanyarazi ruherereye rukorera mu Karere ka Mwanga, mu Karere ka Kilimanjaro. Yubatswe mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 1960 ni amazi manini yo mu karere ka Kilimanjaro. Nyumba ya Mungu Ikigega. Ikigega gisangiwe n'akarere ka Moshi mu karere ka Kilimanjaro n'akarere ka Simanjiro mu karere ka Manyara. Nyumba ya Mungu bisobanura 'Inzu y'Imana'. Ubushobozi bwayo bw'ashyizweho ni 8.

Leta y’u Rwanda yashyize imbaraga mu gutera amashyamba no gusubiranya aho yahoze, gahunda yatangiwe mu mwaka wa 2009.
Ibyo Wamenya ku Gusubiranywa kwa Amashyamba.
Mu mwaka wa 2011 ni bwo u Rwanda rwiyemeje kuba rwasubiranyije hegitari miliyoni ebyiri zahozeho amashyamba kandi mu mwaka 2020 byagombaga kuba byaragezweho.U Rwanda ni kimwe mu bihugu bya mbere byashyize mu bikorwa gahunda yari igamije gusubiranya hegitari miliyoni 150 zahozeho amashyamba akaza kwangizwa ku Isi, zigasubiranywa bitarenze mu mwaka wa 2020.Iyo gahunda yagiye itanga umukoro wo gusubiranya hegitari miliyoni 350 z’amashyamba aho yahoze kugeza mu gihe cyo mu mwaka wa 2030.Ibice biteweho amashyamba mu Rwanda bigira uruhare rukomeye mu gufasha igihugu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, kurwanya imirire mibi n’ibindi.U Rwanda ruri muri gahunda y'icyerecyezo cy’imyaka 30 kizageza mu mwaka 2050. Muri iki gihe u Rwanda rufite gahunda yo kuzaba ruri mu bihugu bikize ku Isi ariko kikagumana umwimerere wacyo wo kubungabunga ibidukikije, mu kwirinda ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.Kimwe mu bizafasha muri iyo gahunda, harimo gukomeza gutera amashyamba no gusazura amashyamba ashaje, ari nako habaho kurengera ibidukikije bishyira mu igenamigambi ry’imijyi n’ahandi hantu hahurira abantu benshi mu Rwanda.Mu kwirinda ko haterwa ibiti bibonetse byose, hashyizweho ibigo bituburirwamo imbuto z’ibiti,Mu gishushanyombonera cy’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka,gitegeka imijyi yose y’u Rwanda n’udusantere guteganya ahantu hahariwe guterwa ibiti n’ibikorwa bitangiza ibidukikije.
Leta y’u Rwanda Nubwo intego yo gutera amashyamba n’ibiti byinshi ari ukubungabunga ibidukikije hari nagahunda yogushaka ko binabyazwa umusaruro, bikungukira ababikora.Guverinoma yashyizeho uburyo bwihariye bw’imicungire y’amashyamba, hifashishijwe abikorera.Mu mwaka wa 2019, Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije yatangije uburyo bwiswe (Private Forest Management Units). Kuri ubu hegitari 23.456,15 zingana na 38.4 % by’amashyamba ya Leta acungwa n’abikorera.Ubukerarugendo gakondo bw’u Rwanda ni za pariki kandi umutungo wazo wa mbere ni inyamaswa n’amashyamba. Ibyo byatumye higwa uburyo bwihariye bwo gukomeza kubungabunga izo pariki igihugu gifite ari nako aho bishoboka zongerwa.u Rwanda rwatangiye gahunda yo kwagura Pariki y’Ibirunga mu rwego rwo kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rubamo nk’ingagi zo mu misozi.

Ikiyaga cya Jipe ni ikiyaga kiri ku mupaka wa Kenya na Tanzaniya. Kiri hafi y'Umusozi wa Kilimanjaro.
Ikiyaga cya Jipe kizwiho amoko y'amafi ataboneka ahandi ku isi. Kizwiho kandi inyoni zo mu mazi n'ibishanga bigikikije.
Ku ruhande rwa Kenya, ikiyaga kiri mu majyepfo y'umudugudu wa Ngohonji. Ku ruhande rwa Tanzaniya, kiri mu Karere ka Mwanga, mu Ntara ya Kilimanjaro. Ikiyaga gihabwa amazi ahanini n'umugezi wa Lumi. Uwo mugezi umanuka ku Musozi wa Kilimanjaro. Gihabwa kandi amazi n'imigezi iva mu misozi ya Pare. Amazi asohoka mu kiyaga anyura mu mugezi wa Ruvu.
Ku ruhande rwa Kenya, Pariki y'Igihugu ya Tsavo y'Iburengerazuba irinda igice cy'ikiyaga. Ku ruhande rwa Tanzaniya, hafi y'ikiyaga hari ahantu harinzwe ha Mkomazi.
Ikiyaga cya Jipe kizwiho amoko y'amafi ataboneka ahandi. Kibamo kandi inyoni zo mu mazi n'inyamaswa z'inyamabere. Ibishanga byo ku nkombe zacyo bishobora kugera kuri km 2 uvuye ku kiyaga.

Umugezi wa Lumi uherereye mu Karere ka Rombo, muri Kilimanjaro mu majyaruguru y'u burasirazuba bwa Tanzaniya ndetse na gace gato mu majyepfo ya Kenya mu Ntara ya Cowasite. Ikomoka mu burasirazuba bwa mpinga ya Mawenzi ku ruhande rw'iburasirazuba bwa (Umusozi Kilimanjaro), kandi itemba cyane hafi y'Uruzi Rombo ku buryo hafi yo gukora ikibanza. Lumi, ariko, ikomeza icyerekezo cyayo cyo mu majyepfo, bityo rero twavuga ko igereranya inzira yo hejuru ya Ruvu, imwe mu masoko abiri nyamukuru y’umugezi wa Pangani. Itemba ikiyaga cya Chala n'umujyi wa Taveta mu burengerazuba hanyuma ugasuka mu kiyaga cya Jipe. Ubwoko bw'amafi Barubusi. 'Pangani' yabonetse gusa mu ruzi rwa N'joro, ruherereye mu kibaya cyo hejuru cy'uruzi rwa Pangani.

Umugezi wa Ngerengere ni uruzi rwo mu karere ka Morogoro muri Tanzaniya. Irazamuka mu misozi ya Uluguru, ikanyura iburasirazuba kugira ngo ifatanye n'u mugezi wa Ruvu hafi. Umujyi wa Morogoro uri ku ruzi rwa Ngerengere.

Umugezi munini wa Ruaha ni uruzi rwo mu majyepfo ya Tanzaniya rw'agati runyura mu bishanga bya Usangu na Parike yi gihugu ya Ruwaha, mu burasirazuba kugera mu ruzi rwa Rufiji. Iranyura kandi iranga imipaka iri hagati y'akarere ka Iringa, akarere ka Dodoma na karere ka Morogoro. Umugezi munini wa Ruaha ufite ubuso bungana na kilometero 83,970. Abaturage bo mu kibaya batunzwe ahanini no kuhira no kubaho mu mazi nko kuroba no korora amatungo.

Umugezi wa Ulanga, uzwi ku izina rya Kilombero, uzamuka mu misozi miremire yo mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bw'akarere ka Morogoro, muri Tanzaniya, mu burasirazuba bwa Rifiti yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Uruzi rutemba rugana mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bushira ubuseruko bw'akarere ka Lindi mbere yuko rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Rufiji. Amaherezo Rufiji yinjira mu nyanja y'U buhinde ku nkombe y'a majyepfo y'akarere ka Pawani.

Umugezi wa Lukenie ni uruzi ruri mu kibaya cyo hagati cya Kongo hagati muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC).
Inzuzi ziva i Kinshasa zerekeza muri Congo (Kasayi), na uruzi rwa Fimi kugera i Lukeniye kugeza aho zimukiye i Kole, urugendo rw'i byumweru 6 kugeza 12. Ibi ntibikorwa mugihe cyamazi make (Kamena - Kanama), ariko, kubera gutinya guhagarara igihe kirekire. Lukenie ntabwo ishobora kugendagenda hejuru ya Kole.
Mu bihe bya mbere y’abakoloni b’Ababiligi, uruzi rimwe na rimwe rwakoreshwaga mu gutwara reberi ku biro nka Kole na Lodja ikamanuka ku kiyaga cya Leopold II. Nyamara, ibikoresho byinshi byazanwe ku butaka bwa Bene Dibele, mu majyepfo ku nkombe y’iburyo y’umugezi wa Sankuru munsi gato y’aho bihurira n’umugezi wa Lubefu, inzira yizewe.
Bimwe mu bice nyamukuru by’ibiti bya Sodefor biri ku mpande zombi z'umugezi wa Lukenie, bishingiye kuri Oshwe. Muri Nzeri 2010, abantu babarirwa mu magana bo muri Oshwe, umuryango wo mu Ntara ya Mai-Ndombe, bigaragambije barwanya SODEFOR. Basabye ko ihagarikwa ry’ibiti by’inganda muri kariya karere, byangiza amashyamba y’imvura abaturage bashingiyeho nta nyungu ku baturage bakennye.

Umugezi wa Lukuga ni uruzi rwu mugezi wa Lualaba muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) rutwara ikiyaga cya Tanganyika. Ntibisanzwe kubera ko imigezi yayo itandukana ibihe gusa ariko nanone bitewe n'ihindagurika ry'igihe kirekire.

Umugezi wa Lukunga ni uruzi runyura mu murwa mukuru wa Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni uruzi rw'umugezi wa Kongo. Kinshasa aryamye mu kibaya k'izengurutswe n'imisozi, gitwarwa n'i nzuzi nyinshi. Muri ibyo, Lukunga ni imwe mu zikomeye, kandi kubera iyo mpamvu iha izina Akarere ka Lukunga ku mujyi. [1]

Umugezi wa Lukushi ni uruzi rw'u mugezi wa Luvua. Iva mu majyepfo igana mu majyaruguru unyura mu Ntara ya Malemba Nkulu yo mu Ntara ya Hoti Lomami no mu Ntara ya Manono yo mu Ntara ya Tanganyika, ikanyura mu mijyi icukurwamo amabati ya Kitotolo na Manono mbere gato yo kwinjira muri Luvua. [1]
Mu ntangiriro ya 1800, Umwami Kumwimbe w’Ubwami bwa Luba yashyizeho igihugu cy’abakiriya gihuza imidugudu ya Hemba yo mu kibaya cy’umugezi wa Lukushi, kandi cyagize uruhare runini mu kurinda Luba kuganza ibindi bihugu bito byo mu karere. [2]

Lulonga ni uruzi ruturuka mu ntara ya eqateri ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni kolomeortero 200 ndende kuva yatangira mu mujyi wa Basankusu. Lopori na Maringa bifatanya gushinga Lulonga hariya. Umugezi wa Lulonga utemba mu ruzi rwa Congo ku mudugudu wa Lulonga.

Uruzi rwa River ni uruzi ruri mubigize umupaka uhuza Angola na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni uruzi rw'uruzi rwa Lufu
Umugezi wa Lungezi uzamuka mu ntara yo hagati ya Kongo mu burasirazuba bwa Songololo, utemba ugana mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba kugera ku mupaka na Angola aho uhurira n'umugezi wa Lavemba, hanyuma ugatemba ugana iburengerazuba ugana ku mupaka kugeza aho uhurira n'umugezi wa Lufu, unyura mu majyaruguru unyuze muri Angola ugakomeza. iburengerazuba ku rubibe.
