Umugezi wa Luvua (cyangwa "uruzi rwa Lowa") (Swahili) ni uruzi ruri mu Ntara ya Katanga muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (RDC). Rutemba ruturutse ku mpera y'amajyaruguru y'ikiyaga cya Mweru ku mupaka wa Zambiya na Kongo mu cyerekezo cy'amajyaruguru y'uburengerazuba ku kugera aho ihurira n'uruzi rwa Lualaba ruteganye n'umujyi wa Ankoro. Lualaba ihinduka uruzi rwa Kongo ruri munsi y'amasumo ya Boyoma.
Ikiyaga cya Mweru, kiri ku burebure bwa, ni ikiyaga cyuzuye amazi cyakozwe n'isuri aho umuyaga watwaye alluvium. [1] Uruzi rwa Luvua ruva mu majyaruguru y'ikiyaga i Pweto muri RDC. [2] Uruzi rutemba mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba ugana Ankoro, aho uhurira na Lualaba. [3] Umurongo wo hagati w'uruzi ubangamiwe n'imigezi myinshi, imigezi n'amasumo mu gihe umanuka uva ku kibaya ugana mu kibaya cya Kongo. [4] I Piana Mwanga amasumo akoreshwa mu gutanga amashanyarazi yo mu birombe bya Manono na Kitotolo. Uruzi rushobora kugendwa mu bwato buto buto mu yo hasi munsi ya Kiambi. [3] Luvua ifite amazi menshi cyane hagati ya Werurwe na Gicurasi, aho amazi menshi cyane hagati ya Nzeri na Ugushyingo. [5]
Ikibaya cy'Uruzi rwa Kongo gifite ishusho y'isahani nini kandi idakomeye. Luvua inyura mu nkengero z'amajyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'iyi sahani, ikazana amazi ava mu kibaya cya Mweru-Bangweulu. [6] Luvua itwara amazi ku buso bwa, igice kinini cyabyo cyahoze ari igice cy'amazi ya Zambezi. [7] Hari ibimenyetso bikomeye by'inyamaswa bigaragaza ko ikibaya cya Luvua cyahoze ari igice cy'uburyo bwa Zambezi, aho amoko menshi y'amafi asanzwe muri ubwo buryo bwa Zambezi nayo aboneka muri Luvua. [8] Inyamaswa zo muri Kongo zinjiye muri Luvua zinjira mu kiyaga cya Mweru, ariko zafunzwe n'amasumo ya Mambatuta kugira ngo zigere mu kiyaga cya Bangweulu. Impinduka yabaye mu ntangiriro za Tertiary. [9]
Bamwe mu bahanga mu by’ubutaka babona ko Luvua ari igice cy’uruzi rwa Kongo. Bashyira inkomoko ya Kongo mu misozi miremire iri hagati ya Tanzaniya na Zambiya, aho uruzi rwa Chambeshi ruturuka, rutemba mu majyepfo y’uburengerazuba rugana ku kiyaga cya Bangweulu. Uruzi rwa Luapula ruvamo rukamanuka rugana mu majyaruguru rurenga kugera ku kiyaga cya Mweru. Uruzi rwa Luvua rusohoka mu kiyaga cya Mweru rugatemba mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba rugana ku ruzi rwa Lualaba, ruhinduka uruzi rwa Kongo rumanuka. [10] Bamwe bavuga ko Kongo itangirira aho Lualaba na Luvua bihurira. [11] Impamvu yo gufata Lualaba nk'amazi y'ingenzi, nubwo ari magufi cyane, ni uko rufite amazi akubye kabiri aho ruhurira na Luvua. [10]
Ikibaya cyo hejuru cy'uruzi rwa Luvua cyahoze gituwe n'abantu b'umuryango wa Bwile. Hashize igihe nyuma ya 1810, Kumwimbe Ngombe, umutegetsi w'Ubwami bwa Luba, yigaruriye akarere. Umumisiyonari n'umushakashatsi w'Umunyaburayi David Livingstone "yavumbuye" Ikiyaga cya Mweru mu 1867, kandi yibwiraga ko uruzi rwa Luvua rutemba rugana ku Nili y'Hejuru. Ariko nyuma y'urupfu rwa Livingstone, ni bwo Henry Morton Stanley, mu rugendo rwe rwo gushakisha rwo mu 1874-1877, yagaragaje ko mu by'ukuri uru ruzi ari umugezi w'uruzi rwa Kongo. Guhera mu 1891, Umuswahili witwa Shimba yatangiye ibitero by'inyuma byinshi byo kunyaga abantu bakabagurisha nk'abacakara, ibyo bigatuma igice kinini cy'inkombe y'iburengerazuba y'Ikiyaga cya Mweru kiba nta bantu. Shimba yifatanyije n'undi Muswahili witwa Kafindo wari ari mu gace ko hejuru y'uruzi rwa Luvua, maze batera umutegetsi w'aho w'umuryango wa Yeke. Ibyo bitero byakomeje kugeza igihe Umubiligi Braseur agezeyo, atangira "kuhanagura intambara" muri ako karere, akarere ibihangange by'Uburayi byari byumvikanyeho ko ari ak'ubutegetsi runaka.. [14]
Mu 2000, mu Ntambara ya Kabiri ya Kongo, ingabo za leta zatsinzwe bikomeye n'ingabo z'u Rwanda i Pweto, aho uruzi rwatangiriye. Ingabo za Kongo zari zazanye inyinshi mu modoka zazo zitwaje intwaro zambukijwe uruzi. Hari ubwato bumwe, kandi ntibari bafite umwanya uhagije wo kuvana izo modoka mbere yuko Abanyarwanda bahagera. Abasirikare bashyizemo tanki ya T-62 mu buryo buteye ubwoba, maze ubwato buragwa burohama. Abanyarwanda babonye ibifaru 33, hamwe n'izindi modoka, ingabo za Kongo zari zagerageje gutwika. [15]

M'pozo ni uruzi mu ntara ya Basi Congo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Inkomoko yarwo iherereye muri Angola igize igice cya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. ni uruzi rurangirira ku nkombe y'ibumoso yu mugezi wa Congo, mu birometero bike ugana Matadi.
Uruzi ruzwi cyane cyane mu gice cyo hepfo y’urugendo rwarwo no kuri kanyoni, rukoreshwa na gari ya moshi ya Matadi - Kinshasa, kandi rukaba rwaragize ikibazo gikomeye mu gihe cyo kubaka uyu murongo wa gari ya moshi mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19.

Umugezi wa Maringa ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Umugezi wa Maringa ndetse nu mugezi wa Lopori uherereye mu majyaruguru, bifatanya hafi na Basankusu bigakora uruzi rwa Lulonga, uruzi rw'u mugezi wa Kongo. Ikibaya cya Maringana Lopori gifite ubuso bungana Maringa-Lopori-Wamba, ifite akamaro gakomeye ku bidukikije. Abaturage ba Ngando batuye mu gace ka Maringa mu majyaruguru ya Ikela.

Jean-Claude Raphael (wavutse 5 Werurwe 1973) ni umukinnyi wa jido ukomoka muri Morise.
Raphael yaserukiye Morise mu mikino y'olempike ya Atlanta mu 1996 agera ku mwanya wa 9 mu mikino olempike ya Sydney mu 2000. abona umudari wa zahabu mu bihugu bivuga icyo ngereza, we gukanye umudari wa zahabu mu mikino yo mu nyanja y’Ubuhinde, watsindiye umudari wa Zahabu muri Afurika ya Jido, amaze imyaka myinshi yitabira amahanga mbere yo gusezera mu marushanwa ya bigize umwuga nyuma y’imikino Olempike ya Sydney.

Marie Hanitra Roilya Ranaivosoa akunze kwitwa Roilya Ranaivosoa (yavutse ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 1990) ni umunyamoritaniya uterura ibiremereye muri Morise ukomoka muri Malagasi, uhatanira mubafite ibiro 48, yahatanye mu cyiciro anahagararira Morise mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga.
Yitabiriye amarushanwa menshi ya Shampiyona y'isi yo guterura ibiremereye. Yitabiriye imikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2014 mu birori bya bapima ibiro 58.
Yahagarariye Morise mu mikino y'olempike ya 2020 yabereye i Tokiyo, mu Buyapani. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 11 mu bagore mu bapima ibiro 49.
Yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu bagore bapima ibiro 49 mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza yabereye i Birmingham mu Bwongereza. Mu kuboza 2022, yatorewe kuba umwe mu bagize komisiyo y'abakinnyi ba IWF.

Souleymane Anne (wavutse ku ya 5 Ukuboza 1997) ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru ukina nk'umukinnyi ukinira ikipe ya Virton yo mu Bubiligi ndetse ni kipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Moritaniya.
Anne yatangiye umwuga wu mupira w'amaguru mu cyiciro cyo hasi cyu bufaransani umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri SMOC, Saran, Angoulême, hanyuma Aurillac Arpajon.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Anne yavukiye mu Bufaransa, akomoka muri Moritaniya. Anne yatangiye gukina mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Moritaniya mu mukino wa gicuti yatsinzwe na Gana ibitego 3 kuri 1 ku ya 26 Werurwe 2019.
Yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 2019, irushanwa mpuzamahanga rya mbere ryiyi kipe

Jidou Ould Khaye El Moctar (yavutse ku ya 8 Nyakanga 1985) ni umukinnyi wiruka ukomoka muri Moritaniya w'itabiriye imikino olempike yo mu mpeshyi muri 2012 mu birometero 200. Yabaye icyitegererezo muri Moritaniya mu birori byo gutangiza irushanwa. El Moctar yavanywe mu cyiciro cya mbere ariko arangiza n'ibihe byiza afite amasegonda 22.94.
Yitabiriye isiganwa rya metero 100 mu mikino olempike ya 2016 yabereye i Rio Janeiro. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 6 mu cyiciro kibanza kandi ntiyujuje ibyiciro bya mbere byanyuma. Yabaye ibendera rya Moritaniya m'ugihe cya kwiyerekana cy'amahanga.

Aminata Kamissoko (wavutse ku ya 9 Nyakanga 1985) ni umukinnyi usiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Moritaniya.
Mu 2003, Kamissoko yitabiriye amarushanwa y'isi muri 2003 yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri yabereye mu Bufaransa, yiruka muri metero 100 aho yirutse mu gihe cya masegonda 13.70 akaza ku mwanya wa 7 ku buryo atujuje ibisabwa mu cy'iciro gikurikira, amezi 12 nyuma yaje kuba uwa kabiri mu bahatana, mu gitsina gore bahagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino olempike yo mu mpeshyi, ubwo yitabiriye imikino olempike yo mu 2004 muri metero 100, yiruka akoresha ibihe bya masegonda 13.49 akaza ku mwanya wa 8, bityo ntibujuje ibisabwa mukuhya mu cyiciro gikurikira.

Youba Mohamed Ould H'meïde akitwa Youba Hmeida (wavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1976) ni umukinnyi wo kwirukanka n'amaguru uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru ukomoka i Nouakchott muri Moritaniya, wazobereye mukwiruka metero 400. Yaserukiye Moritaniya mu mikino olempike yo mu 2004, anashyiraho agahigo mu gihugu ndetse n’umuntu ku giti cye akoresha amasegonda 47.87 ku mukino wa mbere wa siporo yakinnye mu marushanwa y’isi ya IAAF 2001 yabereye i Edmonton mu karere ka Alberta, muri Kanada.
Hmeida yujuje ibihe bisabwa mu ikipe ya Moritaniya muri metero 400 mu bagabo mu mikino olempike yo mu 2004 yabereye muri Atenayi ahabwa ikarita yinjira mu gusozi IAAF. Hmeida yiruka na bandi bakinnyi barindwi aza muri butatu, Hmeida yarenze umurongo wa nyuma ku mwanya wa nyuma na masegonda arenga atatu inyuma y'umuyobozi Anton Galkin wu burusiya akoresheje amasegonda 49.18. Hmeida yananiwe kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kuko yashyize kure avuye mu bice bibiri byikora mu cyiciro gikurikiraho hanyuma akaza ku mwanya wa. 58 muri rusange muri prelime. Hmeida yagizwe umuyobozi utwara ibendera rya Moritaniya na Komite y’igihugu olempike mu muhango wo gutangiza.

Houleye Ba (yavutse ku ya 17 Nyakanga 1992) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Moritaniya wiruka n'amaguru hagati.
Yitabiriye imikino olempike yo mu 2016 mu kwiruka muri metero 800 mu cyiciro cya bagore aza ku mwanya wa 2 akoresha amasegonda 43.52, gusa ntabwo yujuje ibihe bisabwa mu gukomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri. Mu mikino yo mu mpeshyi ya 2020 yirutse muri metero 100 kandi yiruka amasegonda 15.26 byari ibihe byiza ku giti.

Chérif Baba Aidara (wavutse ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 1967) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Moritaniya wiruka n'amaguru hagati.
Aidara yitabiriye imikino olempike ibiri yo mu mpeshyi, mu mikino olempike yo mu 1992 yinjiye muri metero 800 arangiza ari uwa 6 ku umunani bitabiriye, yiruka mu bikomeye, gusa ntabyo yujuje ibisabwa mu cyiciro gikurikira, ntabwo yongeye kwitwara neza muri metero 800 kuri imikino olempike yo mu 1996 aho iki gihe yarangije ku mwanya wa 7 mu bubasha bwe, gusai ntiyongeye kwitabira icyiciro gikurikira. Yagiye kandi mu marushanwa y’isi yo mu 1997 yaberaga mu kwiruka muri metero 800 aho yaje ku mwanya wa nyuma mu bushyuhe bwe ntiyakomeza mu cyiciro gikurikira.

Abidine Abidine (wavutse 31 Werurwe 1993) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Moritaniya, akaba yiruka intera ndende ya Marato. Yitabiriye amarushanwa muri metero 5000 mu mikino olempike yo muri 2020.
Muri Kanama 2019 mu mikino nya furika yo muri 2019, Abidine yaserukiye Moritaniya muri metero 5000 arangiza ku mwanya wa 27 agangiza afite ibihe bingana n'amasaha 15: 52.09.
Abidine yari afite ibendera rya Moritaniya mu gihe cy'imikino olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo muri 2020.

Gino Frederic Soupprayen Padiatty (wavutse 3 mutarama 1973) ni umukinnyi wu munya Moritaniya uterura ibiro biremereye, uhatanira mubatarengeje ibiro 56 wahagarariye igihugu cy cya Motitaniya m'umarushanwa mpuzamahanga. Yitabiriye imikino olempike yo muri 1996 ndetse no mu mikino olempike yo mu 2000 mu birometero 56.

Jessika Selma Rosun (wavutse ku ya 26 Mata 1991) ni umukinnyi umutera umuhunda ukomoka muri wa Morise.
Yatsindiye umudari wafeza muri Shampiyona ya furika ya batarengeje imyaka 2009, yegukana umwanya wa cumi muri shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2010, aba uwa gatanu mu mikino y'abereye muri afurika muri 2011, aba uwa gatandatu muri shampiyona ny'afurika muri 2012, yegukana umudari wa feza mumikino yo muri 2013 yo mubufaransa, yegukanye umwanya wa cumi na kabiri mu mikino ya yabavuga icyongereza muri 2014, yegukana umudari wa feza muri shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2014, y'egukana umwanya wa gatandatu mu mikino ny'afurika yo muri 2015, iya karindwi muri Shampiyona ny'afurika 2016, aba uwa kane muri 2017mu mikono yo mubufaransa, aba uwa karindwi mu mikino ybavuga icyongereza muri 2018, uwa gatanu muri shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2018 nuwa gatanu mu mikino ny'afurika yo muri 2019.
Umuntu we yitwaye neza ni metero 53,98, yagezweho muri Gicurasi 2019 i Savona.

Bernadette Perrine-Ravina (wavutse ku ya 18 Gashyantare 1975) ni umukinnyi uri mukiruhuko cy'izabukuru utera umuhunda ukomoka muri Morise.
Yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu mikino yo muri afurika yo muri 1995, umudari wa feza muri mikino yo mubufaransa muri 1997, umudari wa feza muri shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 1998, aba uwa gatandatu muri yo mubufaransa muri 2001, yegukanye umudari wa feza muri shampiyona ny'afurika 2002, yegukana umwanya wa munani mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2002, uwa gatandatu muri shampiyona ny'afurika 2006, uwa karindwi muri shampiyona ny'afurika ya 2010, uwa kane mu mikino ya Afurika yose muri 2011 na karindwi muri shampiyona ny'afurika 2012.
Yatsinze kandi imikino yo mu kirwa cyo mu nyanja ya bahinde muri 1998 na 2003. Nkumukinnyi ufite amashoti yarangije umwanya wa gatanu muri shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 1998.
Umuntu ku giti cye yataye ni metero 54.56, yagezeho muri Kamena 2002 muri Réduit. Iyi ni inyandiko ya Morise.

Gavin Kaplan (wavutse 7 Gashyantare 1998) ni umukinnyi wa ruhago mu mupira w'amaguru, ukomoka muri afurika yepfo. Yatangiye icyiciro cye cya mbere ku ya 18 Ugushyingo 2021, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba muri 2021 kugeza 22 CSA nyuma yi minsi 4. Yatangiriye bwa mbere muri Twenty20 ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2022, mu ntara yI burengerazuba muri 2021 kugeza 22 CSA T 20 mu marushanwa yaho. Yatangiye Urutonde rwe rwa mbere ku ya 16 Werurwe 2022, mu Ntara yI burengerazuba mu gikombe cyu munsi umwe 2021-22 CSA.

Gregory Nkale Mahlokwana (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1994) ni umukinnyi wa ruhago mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yabonye Urutonde rwe mbere mu majyaruguru ya CSA yo mu Ntara ya 2016 kugeza 17 ku ya 12 Gashyantare 2017. Yatangiye gukinira muri Twenty20 mu majyaruguru mu gikombe cya Afurika T20 cyo muri 2017 ku ya 1 Nzeri 2017. Yatangiye gukina mu cyiciro cya mbere mu majyaruguru mu gikombe cy’iminsi 3 cya Sunfoil 2017–18 ku ya 14 Ukuboza 2017.
Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya majyaruguru mu gikombe cya Afurika T20 muri 2018. Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Titans mu gikombe cya Abu Dhabi T20 muri 2018. Yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere watsindiye amajyaruguru muri 2018–19 Intara ya CSA Intara yumunsi umwe, aho yirukanye 18 mu mikino umunani.
Muri Nzeri 2019, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Cape Town Blitz mu marushanwa ya Mzansi muri 2019. Muri Mata 2021, Mahlokwana yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo mu ikipe idasazwe ya bagabo, aho imikino yabo itandatu yakiniwe muri Namibiya. Nyuma yaho muri uko kwezi, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Free State, mbere yi gihembwe cya 2021-22 muri Afurika yepfo.

Takudzwanashe Kaitano (yavutse 15 kamena 1993) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Zimbabwe. Yatangiye gukinira mu mikino mpuzamahanga mu ikipe ya Cricket ya Zimbabwe muri Nyakanga 2021.
Kaitano yerekeje mu cyiciro cya mbere muri Mid West Rhinos mu gikombe cya Logan muri 2016–17 ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2017. Yagaragaye ku rutonde rwe rwa mbere muri Mid West Rhinos muri shampiyona yo muri 2017–18 ya Pro50, ku ya 23 Gicurasi 2018. Ukuboza 2020, yatoranijwe gukinira muri Rhinos mu gikombe cya Logan 2020–21.
Yatangiye bwa mbere muri Twenty20 ku ya 13 Mata 2021, akinira Rhinos, mu marushanwa yo mu gihugu cya Zimbabwe 2020–21. Nyuma yaho muri uko kwezi, yatowe nk'umukinnyi uhagaze neza mu mikino y'ibizamini bya Zimbabwe na Pakisitani.
Muri Nyakanga 2021, Kaitano yashyizwe mu itsinda ry’ibizamini bya Zimbabwe kubera umukino umwe bakinnye na Bangladesh. Yatangiye Ikizamini ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2021, muri Zimbabwe na Bangaladeshi. Mu mukino ubanza, yatsinze ibitego 87, amanota menshi n’umufungura wa Zimbabwe ku ncuro ya mbere.
Muri Mutarama 2022, Kaitano yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe umunsi umwe mpuzamahanga kubera imikino yakinnye na Sri Lanka. Yatangiye gukinira ODI ku ya 16 Mutarama 2022, muri Zimbabwe na Siri Lanka.

Bryce Parsons (yavutse ku ya 13 Gashyantare 2001) ni umukinnyi umukino wa criketi ukomoka muri afurika y'Epfo.
Yatangiye gukinira Twenty20 muri Gauteng mu gikombe cya T20 CSA Provincial cy'Intara muri 2019–20 ku ya 14 Nzeri 2019. Ukuboza 2019, yagizwe kapiteni w'ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo mu gikombe cy'isi cya Cricket cy'abatarengeje imyaka 19. Yabaye umukinnyi w'ambere watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Afrika yepfo muri iri rushanwa, yatsinze 265 mu mikino itandatu.
Yatangiye icyiciro cye cya mbere ku ya 13 Gashyantare 2020, akinira Gauteng mu gikombe cy’Intara cy’iminsi 3 - 2019. Yakoze Urutonde rwe rwa mbere ku ya 16 Gashyantare 2020, kuri Gauteng muri 2019–20 Intara ya CSA Intara Umunsi umwe.
Muri Mata 2021, Parsons yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo ikipe ya bagabo, kubera imikino yabo itandatu yakinnye muri Namibiya. Nyuma yaho muri uko kwezi, yahamagawe mu ikipe ya KwaZulu-Natal, mbere y’igihembwe cya 2021-22 muri Afurika yepfo.

Johannes Jonathan Smit (wavutse ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1995) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Cricket ukomoka muri Namibiya wakinnye bwa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Namibiya muri Gashyantare 2012, afite imyaka 16.
ni umukinnyi w’ibumoso wihuta ukomoka muri Keetmanshoop. Smit yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya Namibiya y'abatarengeje imyaka 19 muri shampiyona yo muri 2011–12. Yakinnye imikino itanu muri icyo cyumweru cya Khaya Majola, cyabaye mu Kuboza 2011, Namibiya ihura n’a makipe y’abatarengeje imyaka 19 y’a makipe yo muri Afurika yepfo. Igihe shampiyona irangiye, muri Gashyantare 2012, Smit yatoranijwe kugirango atangire gukinira icyiciro cya mbere mu ikipe nkuru ya Namibiya. Yatsinze igitego kimwe ku ncuro ye ya mbere yakinnye n'Intara y'Iburengerazuba mu marushanwa yo mu Ntara y'iminsi itatu, yo muri Afurika y'Epfo, aya Mujahid Behardien. Smit yakinnye undi mukino wo mu cyiciro cya mbere gihembwe gikurikira, yongera gukina ni ntara y'uburengerazuba. Yongeye kugaragara mu batarengeje imyaka 19 mu cyumweru cya Khaya Majola, maze atwara ibitego birindwi, inyuma ya Bredell Wessels gusa muri Namibiya. Abakinnyi cumi na babiri bakinanye nawe muri iri rushanwa yatsinzwe n’abakinnyi babiri gusa - Kyle Simmonds wa KwaZulu -Natal (17) na Vincent Moore (14).
Muri Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 19 ya ICC muri Afurika, yabereye muri Uganda muri Gicurasi 2013, Smit yatsinze ibitego cumi na bibiri, inyuma ya Paramveer Singh wo muri Kenya. Yagizwe kandi umukinnyi wa Final, nyuma yo gufata 4/17 mu minota umunani, harimo na ni bitego bitatu yitsindiye, kugira ngo afashe Namibiya gutsinda Kenya ku manota 52, bityo yemererwe kujya mu gikombe cy’isi cy’abatarengeje imyaka 19 muri 2014. Smit yatangiye gukinira abatarengeje imyaka 19 Umunsi mpuzamahanga (ODI) mu gikombe cyisi, yakinnye muri leta z'unze ubumwe zabarabu muri Gashyantare 2014. Yagaragaye mu mikino itandatu yose ya Namibiya muri iri rushanwa, aho yatsindiye umunani inyuma ya Bredell Wessells (14) gusa muri Namibiya. Muri rusange gufungura umupira hamwe na Marius Delport cyangwa Kobus Brand, imibare ye myiza, 3/55, yaje guhangana na Ositaraliya.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Hanze y'abakinnyi batarengeje imyaka 19, Smit yabaye akamenyero ku ikipe nkuru ya Namibiya mu marushanwa yo mu gihugu cya Afurika y'Epfo ndetse no mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga, agaragara mu gikombe cya cya mpuzamigabane muri 2013 na Shampiyona ya WCL, mu majonjora y'isi ya 2013, ndetse nA majonjora y'Igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2014. guhangana na Kenya mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi 2014 muri Nuvele Zelande, yakuye 3/23 avuye mu minota icumi yafunguye hamwe na Louis Klazinga, bituma Kenya igera kuri 186/8 kuri 50. Yatsinze icyenda mu mikino ya Namibiya, yaje kuri wiketi n'amanota 144/7, nyuma yo kwirukanwa kwa Sarel Burger, hanyuma atsinda 33 ntabwo yavuye mu mukino 25. Namibiya yatsinze ibitego bibiri (hasigaye imipira irindwi), naho Smit agirwa umukinnyi w'umukino.

Tasmeen Granger (yavutse 12 Kanama 1994) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Zimbabwe ukina imikino ya cricket. Yaserukiye igihugu cye cya Zimbabwe mu majonjora yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina imikino ya 20 mu bagore ku isi muri 2013 na 2015.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, yari umwe mu bakinnyi bane b’abakinnyi b’abakobwa ba Zimbabwe babujijwe ni nama mpuzamahanga yu mukino wa Cricket (ICC) gukina mu ikipe y’iterambere ry’isi yose, kubera gukina na makipe ya Cricket nkuru y'abagore, nyuma yuko ICC ihagaritse Cricket ya Zimbabwe mu ntangiriro z'ukwezi.. Muri Gashyantare 2021, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe kubera imikino yakinnye na Pakisitani.
Mu Kwakira 2021, Granger yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe, muri umunsi umwe mpuzamahanga w'abagore (WODI) kubera imikino ine yakinnye na Irilande. Imikino yari umukino wa mbere WODI nyuma yuko Zimbabwe ibonye WODI muri ICC muri Mata 2021. Yatangiye bwa mbere WODI ku ya 9 Ukwakira 2021, muri Zimbabwe na Irilande.

Brian Bara Chari (wavutse 14 Gashyantare 1992) ni umukinnyi wa Zimbabwe ukina umukino wa cricket. Yatangiye gukinira imikino mpuzamahanga mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Zimbabwe mu Gushyingo 2014.
Ni umukinnyi wo mu rwego rwo hejuru kandi rimwe na rimwe akina nku mu binyuma yugara, Chari yakiniye mu gihugu imbere muri Matabeleland Tuskers kuva mu 2011. Niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi mu irushanwa rya Matabeleland Tuskers no mu marushanwa ya Shampiyona ya 2017–18 muri Pro50, yatsinze 316 mu mikino umunani. Yabaye kandi umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Matabeleland Tuskers mu gikombe cya Logan 2018–19, yatsinze 356 mu mikino itandatu.
Ukuboza 2020, yagizwe kapiteni wa Tuskers mu gikombe cya Logan 2020–21.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Chari yerekeje bwa mbere muri Zimbabwe mu Gushyingo 2014, akina muri bibiri mu bizamini bitatu by'ikipe mu ruzinduko rwabo muri Bangaladeshi. Yatangiye gukinira umunsi mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya (ODI) muri Zimbabwe na Pakisitani ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2015.
Muri kamena 2018, yashyizwe mu bakinnyi 22 babanje mu cyiciro cya mbere cya T2020 mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga (T20I) mu marushanwa ya Tri-Nation ya Zimbabwe 2018. Ukwezi kwakurikiyeho, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe umunsi umwe mpuzamahanga (ODI) kubera imikino yakinnye na Pakisitani.
Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe mu marushanwa yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika T20 2018. Muri Nzeri 2019, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Twenty20 ya mpuzamahanga muri (T20I) ya Zimbabwe mu marushanwa ya Tri-Nation ya Singapore ya 2019–20. Yatangiye gukinira T20I muri Zimbabwe, na Nepale, muri Singapore Tri-Nation ya Singapore ku ya 27 Nzeri 2019.

Richard Ngarava (wavutse 28 Ukuboza 1997) ni umukinnyi wa Zimbabwe ukina umukino wa cricket. Yatangiye gukinira Twenty 20 yo muri Zimbabwe na free state yo muri afurika yepfo mu gikombe cya Afurika cya T20 muri 2016 ku ya 9 Nzeri 2016. Mbere y’umukino wa mbere wa Twenty 20, yari mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe mu gikombe cy’isi cya Cricket cy’abatarengeje imyaka 19.
Yaje kurutonde bwa mbere muri Zimbabwe ya A na Afuganisitani A mu ruzinduko rwa Afuganisitani muri Zimbabwe ku ya 3 Gashyantare 2017. Nyuma y'imikino no kuza ku rutonde A, Ngarava yongerewe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe umunsi umwe mu mikino mpuzamahanga (ODI) mu mikino itanu yakinnye na Afuganisitani. Yatangiye gukinira ODI muri Zimbabwe na Afuganisitani muri Harare Sports Club ku ya 16 Gashyantare muri 2017. Muri Gashyantare 2017, yashyizwe mu itsinda ry’ishuri na Zimbabwe Cricket kuzenguruka u Bwongereza nyuma yuwo mwaka.
Yatangiye bwa mbere mu cyiciro cya mbere muri Rising Stars mu gikombe cya Logan 2017–18 ku ya 4 Ukwakira 2017. Muri kamena 2018, yashyizwe mu itsinda rya Board XI kubera imikino yo gususurutsa mbere y’imikino ya Tri-Nation Zimbabwe 2018.
Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe mu marushanwa yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika T20 2018. Nyuma yaho muri uko kwezi, yashyizwe mu itsinda ry’ibizamini bya Zimbabwe mu rukurikirane rwakinnye na Bangladesh. Ariko, nyuma yaje kwirukanwa mu bigeragezo kubera imvune.
Muri Nzeri 2019, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Twenty 20 International (T20I) ya Zimbabwe mu marushanwa ya Tri-Nation ya Singapore muri 2019–20. Yatangiye gukinira T20I muri Zimbabwe, na Singapore, muri Singapore muri Tri-Nation Series yo ku ya 27 Nzeri 2019. Muri Gashyantare 2021, Ngarava yashyizwe mu itsinda ry’ibizamini bya Zimbabwe kubera imikino yakinnye na Afuganisitani. Muri Mata 2021, yashyizwe mu itsinda ry’ibizamini bya Zimbabwe, kubera imikino yakinnye na Pakisitani. Yatangiye ikizamini cya mbere muri Zimbabwe, na Pakisitani, ku ya 29 Mata 2021.

Yvan Hilary Pierrot (23 Gicurasi 1996 - 31 Ukuboza 2015) yari umukinnyi uterura ibiremereye ukomoka muri Morise. Yarushanwe mu bagabo bapima ibiro biri hejuru 105 mu muhango wi birori mu mikino ny'afurika ya 2015
Pierrot yatangiye guterura muri 2010 afite imyaka 14. Yabonye umudari we wa mbere wa zahabu mu 2013 muri Shampiyona y’urubyiruko muri bihugu bivuga icyongereza. Muri 2013 yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Morise. Muri 2015 yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona yi bihugu bivuga icyongereza, anegukana umudari wa zahabu mu cyiciro cy'abato. Mu mikino nyafurika yatsindiye umudari wafeza ibiri (isuku &amp; umuhunda) mu icyicirokuri cya bapima ibiro birenga 105.
Ku gicamunsi cy'umwaka mushya, 2015, yari atwaye imodoka wenyine, maze agira impanuka y'imodoka yahitanye Midlands.

Jonathan Olivier Permal (yavutse ku ya 15 Mutarama 1994) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru uvuka mu Karere ka Flacq wo muri Morise wiruka muri metero 100 na metero 200. Muri mikino ya bafaransa muri 2013, yegukanye umudari wa feza muri 200. Yageze no muri kimwe cya kabiri cyaba metero 100 na metero 200 mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika 2014 yabereye i Marrakech, muri Maroke.
Permal kuri ubu ni iya gatatu yihuta cyane muri Maurice muri metero 200 hamwe n'ibihe cya masegonda 20,85 nyuma ya 20.06 ya Stephan Buckland na 20.66 ya Eric Milazar. Kugeza ubu niwe mugabo wihuta cyane uhatanira Morise.

Odirile Modimokoane (yavutse ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2001) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa cricket wo muri Afurika yepfo. Yatangiye bwa mbere muri Twenty 20 ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2021, muri Dolphins mu marushanwa yo kuwa 2021-22 mu Intara ya CSA ya T20 Knock-Out. Mbere y’umukino wa mbere wa Twenty 20, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Afurika yepfo mu gikombe cy’isi cya Cricket cy’abatarengeje imyaka 19. Yatangiye icyiciro cya mbere ku ya 18 Ugushyingo 2021, muri Dolphins muri 2021-22 CSA y'iminsi 4. Yaje mubakinnyi bwa mbere ku ya 27 Werurwe 2022, muri Dolphins mu gikombe cy'umunsi umwe 2021-22 cya CSA.

Alfred Mothoa (wavutse ku ya 16 Ukuboza 1989) ni umukinnyi wa cricket ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Cricket ya majyaruguru mu gikombe cya furika ya T20 muri 2015. Muri Kamena 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Titans muri shampiyona ya 2018–19.
Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Titans mu gikombe cy'abu Dhabi ya T20 muri 2018. Ukwezi kwakurikiyeho, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Jozi Stars ku nshuro ya mbere y'irushanwa rya Mzansi muri T20. Yabaye umwe mu bayobozi bayoboye Titans muri 2018–19 CSA y'iminsi 4 ya Franchise, aho muri 21 mu mikino umunani.
Muri Nzeri 2019, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Limpopo yari mu gikombe cya T20 cy'Intara muri 2019–20. Muri Mata 2021, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Free State, mbere y’igihembwe cya 2021-22 muri Afurika yepfo.

Janneman Nieuwoudt Malan (wavutse ku ya 18 Mata 1996) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Cricket ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatangiye gukinira imikino mpuzamahanga ya Cricket muri Afurika yepfo muri Gashyantare 2019.
Umwuga wo murugo na T20.
Malan yashyizwe mu ikipe y’amajyaruguru y’iburengerazuba mu gikombe cya Afurika cya T20 muri 2016. Muri Kanama 2017, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Bloem City Blazers mu gihembwe cya mbere cya shampiyona ihuruweho cya T20. Ariko, mu Kwakira 2017, Cricket yo muri afurika y'Epfo yabanje gusubika amarushanwa kugeza mu Gushyingo 2018, ubwo ihagarikwa rikuweho.
Malan niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi mu marushanwa ya CSA yo mu Ntara ya 2017–18, mu munsi umwe, yatsinze ibitego 500 mu mikino icumi. Yabaye kandi umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mu marushanwa y’igikombe cy’iminsi 3 ya Sunfoil muri 2017–18, yatsinze 1.046 mu mikino icumi.
Muri Kamena 2018, Malan yashyizwe mu ikipe mu ikipe ya Cape Cobras muri shampiyona yo muri 2018–19. Muri Nzeri 2018, yashyizwe mu ikipe y’Intara y’Iburengerazuba mu gikombe cya Afurika cya T20 muri 2018. Niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba muri iri rushanwa, yatsinze imikino 178 mu mikino ine.
Mu Kwakira 2018, Malan yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Cape Town Blitz mu marushanwa ya mbere ya shampiyona ya mbere ya Mzansi muri T20. Muri Nzeri 2019, yashyizwe mu ikipe mu ikipe ya Cape Town Blitz mu marushanwa ya Mzansi shampiyona ya mbere muri 2019. Muri Mata 2021, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Boland, mbere y’igihembwe cya 2021-22 muri Afurika yepfo.

Beyatt Lekweiry (wavutse ku ya 11 Mata 2005) ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Moritaniya ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga mu ikipe ya AS Douanes ku nguzanyo ya FC Nouadhibou, ndetse ni kipe yi gihugu ya Moritaniya.
Nku musore, Lekweiry yakiniye ikipe yiwabo avukamo ya FC Nouadhibou yo muri cyiciro cya mbere muri Morise. Muri 2021 yinjiye muri AS Douanes ku nguzanyo y'umwaka umwe. Icyo gihe yatekerezaga ko ibitangazamakuru byo muri Moritaniya ari kimwe mu byifuzo byu mupira wa maguru mu gihugu.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Lekweiry yari umukinnyi ukomeye muri Mauritania mu gikombe cy'Abarabu U-20 2020 afite imyaka 15. Umwaka ukurikira yatorewe guhagararira Mauritania mu gikombe cy’ibihugu 2021 cya Afurika U-20 ariko ntiyitabira irushanwa kubera imvune.
Muri Mutarama 2022, Lekweiry yari mu ikipe nkuru y’igihugu cye mu gikombe cy’Afurika muri 2021 kubera guhamagarwa kwe bwa mbere. Ku myaka 16, yariwe mukinnyi muto muri iri rushanwa. Yakomeje gukinira umukino we wa mbere mu mukino wa nyuma w'ikipe mu mikino itangira, yaje kuza asimbuye Mali ku ya 20 Mutarama 2022.

Yoann-Jean-Noël Langlet (yavutse 25 Ukuboza 1982) ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibiga. Yavukiye i Réunion,Iri ni ishami ryo mu mahanga hamwe na karere k'Ubufaransa kari mu nyanja y'Abahinde, ahagarariye ikipe yi gihugu ya Moritaniya ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Langlet yakiniye amakipe yo mu Bufaransa, Ubusuwisi, Libiya n'Ubugereki.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mu 2003, Langlet yemeye kuba umunyagihugu ndetse nu muturage wa Moritaniya, nyuma yu butumire bwa mugenzi we wu mufaransa Noel Tosi, wahoze ari mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Moritaniya kandi yamwifuza muri iyi kipe.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo urutonde rwa intego ya Mauritania mbere."

Adaklu Waya ni umurwa mukuru w'akarere ka Adaklu. Ni kamwe mu turere two mu karere ka Voluta, muri Gana adaklu district yashyizweho ku itariki ya 28 kamena 2012 kandi yari ikubiyemo mbere mu gice kinini cyari kitwa adaklu anyigbe district mbere yo gutandukana.
Adaklu Waya iherereye mu karere ka Volta kandi ni akarere gakomeye kugera mu mijyi ya Adaklu.

Akarere ka Achiase ni kamwe mu turere mirongo itatu na dutatu two mu karere k'iburasirazuba, muri Gana. Mu ntangiriro y'ahoze mu gice kinini kandi cya mbere cy'a karere ka Birim y'Amajyepfo mu 1988, yashinzwe kuva mu cyahoze ari Njyanama y'akarere ka Birim, kugeza igice cy'iburengerazuba cy'akarere cyacitsemo ibice kugira ngo habeho a akarere gashya ka Birim y'Amajyepfo ku ya 29 Gashyantare 2008; bityo igice gisigaye cyiswe izina rya Central District ya Birim, hamwe na Akim Oda nk'u murwa mukuru. Icyakora ku ya 15 Werurwe 2018, igice cy'iburasirazuba bw'akarere cyacitsemo ibice kugira ngo hashyizweho Akarere ka Achiase, bityo igice gisigaye cyagumishijwe nkakarere ka Birim yepfo. Inteko y'akarere iherereye mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'akarere k'iburasirazuba kandi ifite Achiase nk'umurwa mukuru.

Bertrand Ketchanke (wavutse ku ya 14 Kamena 1980) yahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira wa bigize umwuga ukina nka myugariro. Yavukiye muri Kameruni, akaba yari umusore ukina nka mpuzamahanga mu Bufaransa kandi yakinnye inshuro imwe mu ikipe nkuru ya Moritaniya.
Ketchanke yatangiye umwuga we muri Rennes yo mu Bufaransa mu cyiciro cya mbere cyitwa lige ya 1. Mu 1999, yoherejwe ku nguzanyo muri Reims mu cyiciro cya gatatu cy'Ubufaransa. Mu 2004, Ketchanke yasinyiye mu cyiciro cya gatanu mubwo ngereza muri Scarborough. Mu 2005, yasinyiye ikigo muri Irilande y'Amajyaruguru ariko avayo kubera iterabwoba. Mu 2010, yasinyiye ikipe ya Borgo yo mu Bufaransa.
Mbere yi gice cya kabiri cy'umwaka wa 2011–12, Ketchanke yasinyiye BX Bruxelles mu cyiciro cya gatatu mu bubiligi. Muri 2013, yasinyiye ikipe ya Luxembourgish yo mu cyiciro cya gatatu US Esch. Muri 2014, yasinyiye CS Pétange mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Luxemburuge. Muri 2015, Ketchanke yasinyiye ikipe yo mu Bubiligi ya FC Arlon [fr].

Dominique Da Sylva (wavutse ku ya 16 Kanama 1989) ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa Moritaniya ukina nku mukinnyi ukina imbere mu ikipe yu mujyi wa Kuala Lumpur ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Moritaniya. Yamaze igihe mu ikipe ya Académie de Football Nouakchott mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe ya CS Sfaxien yo muri Tuniziya muri 2007. Nyuma y'imyaka ine, yimuriwe mu ikipe ya Al-Ahly yo mu Misiri.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Da Silva yavukiye i Nouakchott mu gihugu cya Moritaniya ku babyeyi ba Gineya-Bissawu. akaba ari uwo mu idini rya bagatolika.
Yari muri shampiyona ya 2006–07 muri Académie de Football yo muri uyu mujyi mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe ya CS Sfaxien yo muri Tuniziya mu 2007. Muri shampiyona ye ya kabiri hamwe na Sfaxien, yatsinze ibitego bine mu mikino icumi yakinnye mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Tuniziya, shampiyona ya babigize umwuga ya 1. Yatsinze ibitego bitatumuri bya shampiyona muri 2009-10 ndetse n'ibindi bibiri muri shampiyona yakurikiyeho mbere yuko yinjira mu ikipe ya Al-Ahly yo mu Misiri ku madolari 600.000 muri Mutarama 2011. Da Silva yatsinze ibindi bitego bitatu mugihe cyo kwigaragaza muri 2010–11 kandi afasha Al-Ahly gutwara shampiyona yi cyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri muri shampiyona ya karindwi yikurikiranye. Ku ya 9 Nzeri 2012, yaje asimbuye atinze mu gutsinda Al-Ahly yatsinze ENPPI ibitego 2-1 mu gikombe cya Misiri. Muri Mutarama 2014, Da Silva yimukiye muri Zamalek SC. Yahise atangaza ako kanya, atsinda igitego muri buri mukino wa mbere.
Muri Kamena 2017, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Viyetiname yo muri Vietnam Hồ Chí Minh City FC, atsinda ibitego bibiri ku busa. Mu mpera za 2019, Da Sylva yavuye muri Viyetiname yerekeza muri Maleziya, asinyana na Terengganu FC
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe yi gihugu ya Moritaniya mu 2007 atsinda ibitego 45. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere igihugu cye na Maroke mu 2008.

Boubacar Salam Bagili (wavutse ku ya 7 Ukuboza 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Moritaniya ukinira Nouadhibou ndetse ni kipe y'igihugu ya Myritaniya.
"Nkumukino wakinnye 16 Nyakanga 2017." "Amanota ya Mauritania yanditse mbere, amanota yinkingi yerekana amanota nyuma ya buri gitego cya Bagili."

Jacob Ba (wavutse 20 Mutarama 1984) yari umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Moritaniya.
Ba yavukiye i Saint-Louis, muri Senegalie, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Senegale, Ubufaransa, Espagne, Maroke n'Ububiligi muri Linguère, Martigues, Gazélec Ajaccio, Dijon, Tours, Gueugnon, Terrassa, Kenitra, Ubumwe Royale Namur, Aurillac FCA, Angoulême CFC, Limoges FC na Cholet.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ba yari umukinnyi wabigize umwuga wakomokaga muri moritaniya mu 2008, akaba yarahamagawe mu ikipe yigihugu inshuro

El Hadji Ba (yavutse ku ya 5 Werurwe 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga ikina mu ikipe ya Sipiriyani Apollon Limassol. Yavukiye mu Bufaransa, akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Moritaniya.
Ba yatangiye gukina kuwabigize umwuga we ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2012 mu mukino wa shampiyona hamwe na Guingamp muri uwo mukino yaje kugaragaramo nku wasimbuye. Mbere yo gukinira bwa mbere muri Le Havre, yari afitanye isano no kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Tottenham Hotspur yo mu Bwongereza aho bivugwa ko yari yemeye kwinjira muri iyi kipe.
Yatangiye gukinira Sunderland na Carlisle United mu gikombe cya FA ku ya 5 Mutarama 2014, akomeza gutsinda igitego aho muri uwo mukino yatsinze igitego cya gatatu atsinda 3–1.
Ku ya 29 Kamena 2015, Ba yinjiye muri Charlton Athletic mu masezerano y’imyaka itatu, bityo arangiza imyaka ibiri yakoranye na Sunderland. Amasezerano yagiranye niyi kipe yahagaze ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2017.
Ku ya 6 Werurwe 2017, Ba yinjiye mu ikipe ya Noruveje Stabæk.
Ku ya 23 Kamena 2022, Ba yemeye gukinira mu ikipe ya Apollon Limassol muri shipure.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Bavukiye mu Bufaransa, ababyeyi ba Ba bakomoka muri Senegali na Moritaniya. Yari umufaransa akaba urubyiruko wari mpuzamahanga, akaba yarahagarariye igihugu cye kurwego rwabatarengeje imyaka 18.
Mu 2022, yakiriye ubutumire bwe bwa mbere bwo guhagararira Moritaniya. Yatangiye gukinara Moritaniya mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika 3–0 muri 2023 aho batsinze Sudani ku ya 4 Kamena 2022.

Tanaka Chivanga (yavutse 24 Nyakanga 1993) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Zimbabwe ukina umukino wa cricket. Yatangiye gukinira imikino mpuzamahanga mu ikipe ya Cricket ya Zimbabwe muri Gicurasi 2022.
Ukuboza 2020, yatoranijwe gukinira ikipe ya Eagles mu gikombe cya Logan muri 2020–21. Yatangiye icyiciro cye cya mbere ku ya 9 Ukuboza 2020, muri Eagles, mu marushanwa yi gikombe cya Logan 2020–21.
Yatangiye bwa mbere muri Twenty 20 ku ya 10 Mata 2021, no muri Eagles, mu marushanwa yo mu gihugu cya Zimbabwe muri 2020–21. Ku ya 14 Mata 2021, umukino wahuje Eagles na Rock wagiye muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere, Chivanga yita umuntu w’umukino kubera gukina kwe umukino urangiye. Nyuma y'iminsi itatu, Chivanga yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe kubera imikino yabo yari mpuzamahanga muri Twenty 20 muri T20I yakinnye na Pakisitani. Mbere yo gutorwa mu ikipe y'igihugu, Chivanga yari yanakina n'i ikipe ya Cricket ya Zimbabwe A. Ku ya 26 Mata 2021, Chivanga yashyizwe mu itsinda rigerageza rya Zimbabwe, no mu rukurikirane rwakinnye na Pakisitani.
Muri Gicurasi 2021, yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe A mu rukurikirane rwabo na Afurika y'Epfo A. Yagiye ku rutonde rwe rwa mbere ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2021, muri Zimbabwe A na Afurika yepfo A. Muri 2021, Chivanga yashyizwe mu itsinda rya Zimbabwe kubera umukino umwe bakinnye na Bangaladeshi.
Muri Gicurasi 2022, Chivanga yashyizwe mu ikipe ya T20I ya Zimbabwe kubera imikino 5 yakinnye iwayo na Namibiya. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere wa T20I ku ya 17 Gicurasi 2022, muri Zimbabwe na Namibiya. Ukwezi kwakurikiyeho, yahamagawe mu ikipe ya Zimbabwe umunsi umwe mpuzamahanga (ODI) kubera imikino yakinnye na Afuganisitani. Yatangiye gukinira ODI ku ya 4 Kamena 2022, muri Zimbabwe na Afuganisitani.
Ku ya 12 Gashyantare 2023, Chivanga yatangiye gukinira mu igeragezwa muri West Indies.

Dr. Utumatwishima Jean Nepo ABDALLAH
Minisitiri w'Urubyiruko n'Ubuhanzi, Repubulika y'u Rwanda
Dr. Utumatwishima Abdallah ni Minisitiri w'Urubyiruko n'Ubuhanzi mu Rwanda. Yahoze akora nk'umushakashatsi mu by'indwara z'ibyorezo mu Kigo cy'Igihugu cy'Ubuzima cya Amerika, aho yakoraga ubushakashatsi ku bintu bishobora gutera indwara z'umutima n'imitsi ku bimukira b'Abanyafurika mu gace ka Washington D.C.. Kuva akigera mu cyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza, Utumatwishima yagize uruhare runini muri gahunda zo guteza imbere urubyiruko mu Nama y'Igihugu y'Urubyiruko mu Rwanda kandi aracyabikora kugeza ubu.

U Rwanda rugizwe n'imisozi ubundi yari iriho amashyamba ariko hari aho usanga imisozi ihanamye. Nta gushidikanya kandi ko u Rwanda ruri mu bihugu bituwe cyane ku isi kandi kikaba ari gito.
Ibyo wamenya ku Gufata neza Amashyamba.
Kurwanya ibikorwa byangiza amashyamba ibituma amashyamba akomeje gusagarirwa n’ibikorwa bya muntu,urugero nko mu mujyi wa Kigali, aho byibura mu Cyumweru kimwe hinjira amakara imifuka irenga ibihumbi 61, ku buryo Umujyi wa Kigali wonyine mu cyumweru wangiza amashyamba ahinze kuri hegitari zirenga 300.Umujyi wa Kigali utiza umurindi itemwa ry’amashyamba, bavuga ko biteye impungenge mu gihe amashyamba yakomeza gutemwa mu gihugu kuko mu bice by’icyaro nabo benshi bicanira inkwi."Mu bushakashatsi bwakoze mu mwaka wa 2020 bwagaragaje ko mu Cyumweru kimwe gusa mu Mujyi wa Kigali hinjira imbaho ibihumbi 53,193, imifuka y’amakara ibihumbi 61,241, amasiteri y’inkwi metero cube 321m3, inkingi z’amashanyarazi ibihumbi 20 naho ibiti byo kubakisha ibihumbi birenga bitatu bihinjira mu cyumweru kimwe.Urebye mu mibare ihujwe ubona ko hegitari 485.2 zaba zagiye mu Cyumweru zijyanywe n’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi bituma ibiti bitemwa.Usesenguye ziriya mbaho zavuye kuri hegitari imwe, amakara ava kuri hegitari 398, inkwi ziva kuri hegitari 4.2, ibiti biva kuri hegitari 3, byose ni mu cyumweru kimwe gusa."
Tumenye Ubuso bw'Amashyamba.
Ubuso bw’u Rwanda 30.4% bungana na kilometero kare 8,006% buriho amashyamba, 68% aya mashyamba n’ay’abaturage naho 32% akaba aya leta agizwe n’amashyamaba y’amaterano, imigano n’amashyamba kimeza.I"mibare ya hegitari 485 zijyenda mu cyumweru kimwe mu makara n’inkwi ukubye Ukwezi, Umwaka, ukabihuza na toni miliyoni 2.7 z’amakara n’inkwi bikoreshwa ku mwaka, ubihuje n’uburyo Abanyarwanda twiyongera ndetse dukoresha amakara n’inkwi bihita bitanga umukoro wo gufata ingamba zo kongera amashyamba no kureba ubundi buryo bwo gukoresha izindi ngufu mu gucana n’imbabura zirondereza ibicanwa. Inganda zikora ibyayi, amashuri, amagereza n’abandi bakoresha inkwi n’amakara mu guteka nabo bakareba uko bareka gutema ibiti.""Ibidukikije iyo bivuyeho natwe ntitwashobora kubaho, turebe amashyamba nk’ikidukikije aho kuyabonamo inyungu mu kuyacana gusa, twongere ibiti n’amashyamba. Fata iwawe uhatere igiti kiribwa imbuto n’ibivangwa n’imyaka. Tubungabunge amashyamba niyo yaba aya leta ntukabone uwangiza amashyamba ngo uceceke, igiti kimwe gifitiye akamaro abantu benshi. Abantu bumve ko tubayeho kubera ibidukikije, urahinga ukeza kubera imvura, uwejeje aratugaburira tukarya kandi tukagira ubuzima bwiza tubona umwuka mwiza duhumeka."
Amashyamba arinda kwangirika kw'ikirere akanakurura imvura
amashyamba atuma imisozi itambara umusa ngo itwarwe n'isuri kandi akanakurura umwuka mwiza duhumeka.

U Rwanda muri gahunda yo gutera ibiti nibura bisaga miliyoni 36 umwaka washize muri 2022 mu rwego rwo kurushaho kubungabunga ibidukikije, kubera iyo mpamvu Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije yatangije gahunda yo gutera ibiti mu mashuri byiganjemo iby’imbuto ziribwa.
Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, yavuze ko gahunda yo gutera ibiti u Rwanda rwiyemeje ko igomba gukorwa ahantu hatandukanye harimo no mu mashuri mu rwego rwo gukundisha abakiri bato ibyiza byo kubungabunga ibidukikije.Yavuze ko muri Kigali hagiye guterwa ibiti bisaga ibihumbi 400 kandi no mu mashuri ubukangurambaga burakomeje mu rwego rwo gutera ibiti byiganjemo imbuto ziribwa zizanifashishwa mu kurwanya imirire mibi mu mashuri.Kuri ubu mu Karere ka Nyarugenge hateganyijwe guterwa ibiti 9685, Gasabo bazatera ibiti 7020 mu gihe Kicukiro yitegura gutera ibiti ibihumbi birenga ibihumbi bine.Hatangiye gahunda yo gutera ibiti, hashize iminsi haterwa ibiti mu Mujyi wa Kigali kandi iyogahunda bayigira buri mwaka.Basanze ari ngombwa ko guhera no mu mashuri abana bato bagakura bazi kubungabunga ibidukikije icyo ari cyo, bazi kubitera n’akamaro kabyo.Tariki ya 22 Ugushyingo mu mwaka 2022, iyi gahunda yatangirijwe mu ishuri rya Ecole Belge de Kigali, aho umujyi wa Kigali watangaje ko muri uwo mwaka hagiye guterwa ibisaga ibihumbi 21 mu bigo by’amashuri nk’uko Meya w’Umujyi wa Kigali,yabivuze.
Mubindi wamenya kuri gahunda yogutera Ibiti.
Ibyo biti bifitwe muri gahunda harimo n’ibyo ibigo by’amashuri bizatera. Buriya iyo uhaye umwana ubutumwa abugeza ku wo umutumyeho, aba rero ni intumwa za Leta ku babyeyi babo. Buriya umwana muto uteye igiti uba umuhaye ejo heza hazaza. Igiti ni ubuzima kandi ni ejo hazaza h’u Rwanda biba byiza n’abana bagize uruhare mu kugira Isi nziza.”Nubwo Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije yihaye gutera ibiti miliyoni 36 ariko ngo ibimaze kuboneka bigaragaza ko bashobora no gutera miliyoni 40 bigizwemo uruhare na buri munyarwanda.Minisitiri yasabye Abanyarwanda muri rusange kugira uruhare mu gutera ibiti bahereye mu ngo zabo, ku mihanda banyuramo, ku nsengero, mu mirima n’ahandi hatandukanye ndetse n’urubyiruko arwibutsa kugira uruhare mu gutegura ejo hazaza heza.Iyo haterwa ibiti mu mashuri bibafasha kurushaho gutekereza ku kamaro k’ibiti kandi bibafasha no kugira ikirere n’umwuka mwiza uborohereza kwiga neza.Umukozi muri Ambasade y’Ububiligi yavuze ko gahunda yo gutera ibiti u Rwanda rwihaye izafasha mu kurushaho guhangana no kubungabunga ibidikikije kandi ko kubitera mu bigo by’ishuri ari ingirakamaro.

Umugezi wa Mbomou cyangwa Bomu (nanone witwa M'bomou mu gifaransa) ni umugezi ugize umupaka uhuza ibihugu cya Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) ndetse na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC).
Mbomou ihuza uruzi rwa Uele kugira ngo ikore uruzi Ubangi. Ubangi, uruzi rwa Kongo, narwo rukora nku mupaka uhuza CAR na DRC.

ni umugei wabona kuri aya merekezo: 6°02′00″S 23°46′00″E﻿ / ﻿6.03333°S 23.76667°E﻿ / -6.03333; 23.76667,Umugezi wa Mbuji-Mayi, cyangwa bawita "Bushmaie", "Bushimaie", "Bushimay" or "Mbushimaie", ni umugezi wa muri Repubulika iharanaira Demoarasi ya Congo, ukaba ari umugezi wa Sankuru, uri mu ntara ya lualaba nanone mu ntara ya kapanga bigana muntara ya Kasayi hari n'umugezi wa Mbuji Mayi. is a river in the.
Kuva mu kinyejana cya 17 kugeza ku cya 19, ni uruzi rwari rugizwe nurubibi z'Ubwami bwa Lunda.

Umugezi wa Momboyo (mu gifaransa ni umugezi wa Momboyo) ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ihurira nu mugezi wa Busira ikora uruzi rwa Ruki, uruzi rw'umugezi wa Congo. Momboya nu mugezi wacyo mukuru Luilaka irashobora kugenda kuri kilometero 545 kuva ku isoko yawo.
Imidugudu iherereye ku ruzi itanga umuriro muri Mbandaka n'i biribwa bihari bitandukanye, icy'ingenzi bihari ni myumbati, ibigori n'amavuta y'imikindo. [5] Amazi y'inzuzi yandujwe no gusohoka mu masoko rusange k'uruhande rw'inzuzi. Ibi bivamo indwara ziterwa n'amazi nka diyare mu baturage bahaturinye. [6] Mu 2008 hagaragaye ibibazo by’inguge muri Ingende munsi y’umugezi no muri Boteka, kuri Momboya. Iyi ndwara iterwa ahanini no kurya inyama z'inguge. [7]

Umugezi wa Mulobozi ni uruzi ruri mu Ntara ya Tanganyika (ahari Intara ya Katanga) wo mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Itemba iva iburengerazuba, ikanyura mu misozi ya Marungu, mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika mu majyaruguru y'icyambu cya Moba. Amashyamba n'inzira y'inzuzi zayo ziri mu kaga gakomeye ko kurimbuka gaterwa n’isuri ku nkombe. Mollusk Tomichia guillemei ituye muri Mulobozi kandi atuye ku ruzi rw'uzuye ibyondo mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika.

Umugezi wa Ndjili ni uruzi rutemba ruva mu majyepfo runyura mu murwa mukuru wa Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, aho ruhurira n'umugezi wa Kongo. Itandukanya uturere twa Tashangu na n'umusizo w'amba. [1] Uruzi ruha izina rya komini Ndjili no ku Kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Ndjili. [2]

Umugezi wa Ngiri (cyangwa uruzi rwa giri) ni uruzi rwu umugezi wa Ubangi rutemba rugana mu majyepfo unyuze mu Karere kaUbangi ya majyepfo ko mu ntara ya eqateri, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Umugezi wa Nzoro (cyangwa Nzaro, Obi, Zoro) ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni umugezi w'iburyo w'umugezi wa Kibali. Ikoreshwa mu gutanga amashanyarazi kuri Mine ya Kibali.
Umugezi wa Nzoro ukomoka mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'igihugu, hafi y’umupaka na Sudani y'Amajyepfo uhuza umupaka na Uganda. Bikurikira inzira yo kugendagenda mubyerekezo rusange byiburengerazuba kugera aho bihurira na Kibali kumanuka uva Durba. [1] Imiterere y’ikirere ya Köppen ni karere ka kimberabyombi ka savanna aho itose. [2]

Ruki ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni umugezi uri ibumoso w'umugezi wa congo. ushobora kuwubonwa nkaho itemba igana hepfo y'umugezi wa Busira, nawo ushobora kugaragara nkaho igana hepfo y'umugezi wa Tshuapa.

Umugezi wa Rutshuru ni uruzi ruri mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ruvoma amazi yarwo mu kiyaga cya Mutanda mu misozi ya Virunga muri Uganda, rutemba rugana mu majyaruguru mu kiyaga cya Rutanzige (ahari ikiyaga cya Edward). Mu burebure bwayo bwose inyura mu ntara ya Rutshuru mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru. [1]

Umugezi wa Salonga ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni umugezi ukomokaho uruzi wa Busira.
Izina ryuyu mugezi ryaturutse ku kuvuga nabi nsao'loonga, izina ry'inyoni. Umugezi wa Salonga ugenda werekeza mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba unyuze muri parike y'igihugu ya Salongo [1] no kugera aho uhurira n'umugezi wa Busira. [2] parike yi gihugu ya Salonga ni parike nini y’amashyamba manini muri afurika, ifite ubuso bwa kilometero 33,350. [1] rwinjira muri Busira kilometero 2 hejuru yi mbere ya Lotoko. urashobora kugenda umwaka wose hamwe na toni 50 kugeza Watsi Kengo. [3]

Umugezi wa Sankuru ni uruzi runini ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Uburebure bwacyo bugera ku kilometero 1.200 ikora uruzi rurerure rw'umugezi wa Kasai.
Hejuru y’isangano n’umugezi wa Mbuji-Mayi uzwi nka Lubilash. Itemba yerekeza mu majyaruguru, hanyuma iburengerazuba ikanyura mu mijyi mike, nka Lusambo. Hanyuma yinjira mu ruzi rwa Kasai hafi ya Bena-Bendi ku bipimo.

Umugezi wa Tshilongo (mu gifaransa umugezi wa Tshilongo) ni uruzi ruri mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Muri buvumbuzi bwa Grandslam, aho ingabo z’umuryango w’abibumbye zishinzwe kubungabunga amahoro zagabye igitero muri Leta ya Katanga bitandukanye, ku ya 17 Mutarama 1963, abayoboke ba Burigade ya 99 bageze ku ruzi rwa Tshilongo aho byabasabye guhagarara. Nyuma ya saa sita, Moïse Tshombe yishyize mu maboko yabo. [6]

Umugezi wa Tshuapa cyangwa umugezi Tshwapa ni uruzi riri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, akaba uruzi runini ku mugezi wa Busira.
ni uruzi ruzamuka mu majyepfo y’icyanya gikomye cya Sankuru, ruzenguruka mu majyaruguru y’iburengerazuba kugera Elinga-Mpango no kugera i Bondo, aho ruva mu burengerazuba y'amajyaruguru rugana Bowende, hejuru y’isangano ryarwo n’umugezi wa Lomela rugakora uruzi rwa Busira. [1] ku kilometero 408, kuva aha kugera k'umugezi wa congo. [2] wa Bowende ni kilometero 29 kuva ihuriro hamwe na kilometero 444 kuva Mbandaka. ku ruzi rwa Kongo. [3]

Umugezi wa Ubangi, witwa Oubangui, ni uruzi runini rw'umugezi rwa Kongo mu karere ka afurika yo hagati. Itangirira ku masangano ya Mbomou (bivuze rusohora buri mwaka metero cube 1,350) ni uruzi rwa Uele (bivuze ko isohoka buri mwaka metero 1,550) ikanyura iburengerazuba, igakora umupaka uhuza ibihugu bya Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Repubulika Kongo. Ubangi ugana mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba ikanyura i Bangui, umurwa mukuru wa CAR, nyuma ikanyura mu majyepfo ugakora umupaka uhuza Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo na Repubulika ya Kongo. Ubangi yinjira mu ruzi rwa congo i Liranga.

Uele izwi kandi ku mvugo ya Uélé, Ouélé, cyangwa uruzi rwa Wele, ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Uele ituruka ahitwa Dungu, ikaba ihuriro ry’inzuzi za Dungu na Kibali, zombi zikomoka mu misozi yegereye ikiyaga cya Albert. Uhujije iyi migezi itemba iburengerazuba nko muri kilometero 1,210, kugeza igihe Uele ihurira n'umugezi wa Mbomou i Yakoma. Inzuzi nini ku ruzi rwa Uele ni uruzi rwa Bomokandi (ibumoso) n'umugezi wa Uere (uruhande rw'iburyo).

Umugezi wa Uere, nanone witwa umugezi wa Were, ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ikomoka hafi y'umupaka na Sudani igatemba iburengerazuba igirango y'injire mu ruzi rwa Uele.

Umugezi wa Ulindi ni uruzi rw'umugezi wa Lualaba muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC). hakaba hariho icyifuzo cyo k'ubaka urugomero rw'amashanyarazi kuri uri ruzi kugira batangize umushinga wo gucukura zahabu.

Umugezi wa Wamba ni uruzi ruri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) na Angola. Ikomoka ku butumburuke bwa metero 3,250, ari nk'isangano ry'imigezi mito nko mu Ntara ya Lunda y'amajyaruguru ya Angola, akarere k'imisozi mito n'imigezi idakabije. Muri Angola izwi ku izina rya Uamba.
Itemba yerekeza mu majyaruguru, aho igizwe n'igice cy'umupaka wa Angola / DRC, hanyuma mu burebure bwacyo ikanyura mu Ntara ya Bandundu kugera aho ihurira n'umugezi wa Kwango ku butumburuke bwa metero 1,023.

Umugezi wa Yekokora ni uruzi ruri mu ntara ya eqateri, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yekokora ni uruzi rw'umugezi wa Lopori. Umugezi wa Lopori ufatanya n'umugezi wa Maringa mu majyepfo, ugakora uruzi rwa Lulonga, uruzi rw'umugezi wa Kongo. Yekokora itembera mu kibaya cya Lopori muri Maringa, uzwi ku izina rya Maringa-Lopori-Wamba, ahantu h’icyanya gikomye bifite akamaro kanini mu bidukikije.

Iyangirika ry'imigezi ni bishanga bitera igabanuka ryamazi Mugihugu. Ubushakashatsi byagarajeko hatigize igikorwa Bimwe mubinyabuzima byacyika burundu mu Rwanda.
Iyangirika ry'imigezi ni bishanga Bigaragarako hamwe mubishanga kimwe cya kabiri hahinduwe ahacukurwa gasegereti,guhingwa,Kuvumba nibindi byangiza Ibishanga.
Ubundi Igishanga kiba kigizwe nurufunzo ugasanga Ari ubuturo bwi Nyamanswa.
ubundi mubusanzwe urufunzo rufasha gufata amazi yavuye imusozi no guhumanura ikirere,bitewe ni myotsi iba iri mukirere.
Indiri tu Nyamanswa zo mu mazi ni ziguruka ziri mubwoko bw'inyoni. Harimo imisambi.

Ibishanga by'ikigali Birigutunganywa ngo bishyirwemo ibinyabuzima bitandukanye byiganjemo ibiguruka byari bitangiye kuzimira.
Akamaro k'ibinyabuzima..
Buri mwaka kwi Taliki 05 Kanama isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima.
Ibinyabuzima biba mubishanga nsetse nahandi handi bifasha mugutuma ikirere gisa neza nsetse nugufasha isi ikomeza kuba nziza.
Ibinyabuzima biba mubishanga..
Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima biba mubishanga Harimo imisambi.
Ibicyeri,Imitubu inyoni zitandukanye.

Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga urengera ibidukikije, ARCOS, bwerekanye ko ubudahangarwa bw’ibishanga cyane cyane ibyo muri Kigali bwangiritse ku gipimo cya 65%.
Ibyo wamenya ku Ibishanga by'Umujyi wa Kigali.
Igishushanyombonera cy’imitunganyirize y’ibi bishanga kigaragaza ko Umujyi wa Kigali ufite ubuso bungana na kilometero kare 15.76 (20%) bugizwe n’ibishanga hamwe n’imibande.Ibishanga byo hepfo y’i Gikondo nka Rwandex na Rwampara kugera Nyabugogo, ndetse na Gacuriro, Mulindi na Masaka, bigomba gutunganywa mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu guhereye muri Nyakanga mu mwaka 2021.Ibishanga byitaweho cyane ku ikubitiro ni icya Rwandex, Rwampara, icya Masaka, mubindi bikorwa bizahakorerwa birenze kuhatera ibiti ni uko hazashyiirwa ibiyaga, hazashyirwa serivisi zifasha abantu gukora siporo, abakoze ubukwe baze kuhifotoreza. Hazaterwa indabo hazanwe ibinyabuzima birimo inyoni zari zaracitse i Kigali, ibinyugugu,…mbese nk’uko ubibona uko Nyandungu yakozwe.Byari biteganyijwe ko amafaranga azajya aboneka ibishanga nk’icya UTEXRWA na Nyabugogo na byo bizatunganywa, ariko icy’ingenzi ari ukubanza gukuramo ibikorwa byose birimo, kugira ngo ibyo bishanga bibashe kwakira no kubika amazi yose ava muri Kigali.Inkunga yatanzwe na Banki y’Isi kugira ngo ivugurure Kigali n’imijyi itandatu iwunganira, yaje ari icyiciro cya kabiri cy’umushinga wiswe ‘Rwanda Urban Development (RUDP)’ uzamara imyaka itanu kuva mu mwaka 2021 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2025.
Uko Umushinga waruhagaze.
MININFRA mu mwaka wa 2021 Kamena, yatangaje ko Banki y’Isi n’Ikigega cy’Isi gitera inkunga ibidukikije (GEF), ndetse n’ikigega cyitwa Nordic Development Fund (NDF), byatanze inguzanyo y’Amadolari ya Amerika ya miliyoni 170 (ahwanye n’Amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyari 170).Muri ayo mafaranga hakaba haragombaga kuvamo amadolari ya Amerika miliyoni 50 (ni miliyari 50 z’Amanyarwanda) yagenewe kubaka ibikorwaremezo, gutera ibimera bibungabunga ibishanga by’i Kigali no kuzanamo ibisimba bimwe byahacitse kugeza ubu bikiboneka muri Pariki ya Nyungwe.Uyu mushinga watangiraga mu mwaka wa 2021 muri Nyakanga, MININFRA yavugaga ko miliyoni zigera ku 120 z’Amadolari ya Amerika yasigaye nyuma yo gukuramo 50 yo gutunganya ibishanga by’i Kigali, azakoreshwa mu guteza imbere imijyi ya Huye, Muhanga, Rusizi, Rubavu, Nyagatare na Musanze.Icyiciro cya mbere cya RUDP, Banki y’Isi yari yagihaye amadolari ya Amerika agera kuri miliyoni 100, aho kuva mu mwaka wa 2016 kugera mu mwaka wa 2021 Kigali yubatswemo imihanda yo mu makaritiye ireshya na kilomero 54.

Igishanga cy’Akagera kiri mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda.
Tumenye Igishanga cy'Akagera.
Igishanga cy’Akagera kiri mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda. Kigizwe n’urufunzo rwinshi n’ibindi bimera, usanga kibamo amoko menshi y’inyoni atemberamo akanagera muri Pariki y’Akagera aho asurwa n’abakerarugendo. Iki gishanga gifite amazi yisuka mu Kagera akanatanga urugomero rwa Rusumo n’ibindi."Mu Rwanda hari amoko atatu y’ibishanga: ibishanga bikomye, ibishanga bikoreshwa habanje gufata imigambi yo kubirengera, n’ibishanga byakoreshwa nta kibazo. Muri byo harimo Kamiranzovu, Rugezi n’Akagera ntibyemerewe guhingwamo.""Ni Ibishanga bitagira ibikorerwamo na mba bikomye aribyo bitatu igishanga cya Rugezi, icya Kamiranzovu n’icy’Akagera,Bavugako atari byo byonyine ariko ibi by’umwihariko ngo bigomba kuyungurura umwuka, amazi n’ingomero bikanatanga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima bitandukanye biba bikenewe mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’umuntu."

Urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima runyuranye ruri mu byanya bikomye za pariki, n’ibishanga, rusurwa na ba Mukerarugendo aho bigira uruhare runini mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’igihugu.
Urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima runyuranye ruri mu byanya bikomye (za pariki, n’ibishanga), ko rusurwa na ba Mukerarugendo aho bigira uruhare runini mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’igihugu.Abanyarwanda bashishikarizwa gufatanyiriza hamwe mu kwiteza imbere no gufata neza umutungo kamere w’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima.U Rwanda rwihaye Icyerekezo cyo mu mwaka 2050, cyo kuba mu bihugu biteye imbere binyuze mu iterambere ritabangamira ibidukikije.Gahunda y’igihugu y’imyaka irindwi yo kwihutisha iterambere. Bityo iyangirika ry’umutungo kamere n’urusobe ry’ibinyabuzima, bigira ingaruka zikomeye kandi zidindiza kugera ku ntego z’iterambere ry’ubukungu igihugu cyiyemeje.Inzira iracyari ndende, igisabwa nuguhindura imyumvire ku ikoreshwa ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, aho kera byafatwaga nk’ahantu ho kujugunya imyanda.
Kuvugurura Imigezi n'Ibishanga byari byaratereranywe.
Bivuzeko inzira iracyari ndende, igisabwa nuguhindure imyumvire mu buryo hakoreshwa indiri z’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, cyane cyane ibishanga, imigezi n’ibiyaga, kera byafatwaga nk’aho kujugunya imyanda.Umuturarwanda agomba kuzirikana isano kamere afitanye n’ibidukikije, bityo akarushaho kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima bibumbatiye amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa n’ibimera dukesha ibidutunga, imiti twivuza n’umwuka mwiza duhumeka aho bavuze ko uwo mwuka udashobora kubonerwa ikiguzi gikwiye.tariki 05 Kamena buri mwaka, kuri iyi tariki isi yose yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ibidukikije,buri wese asabwa gukomeza guhindura imyumvire y’uburyo hakoreshwa neza urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima.

Muvumba ni uruzi ruherereye mu majyaruguru.y'uburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda no mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Uganda. Ibice byo hejuru byamazi ya Nili. Kuri Birometero 170 z'uburebure, ni rumwe mu nzuzi runini 'mu Rwanda haba mu bunini no mu bukungu. Amzi yuru Ruzi Yifashishwa mu guhinga icyayi mu butumburuke bwo mu majyaruguru yu Rwanda no mu majyepfo y’iburengerazuba bwa Uganda. Inzira yacyo yo hasi itanga amazi kubice byumye bya Nyagatare, byorohereza kuhira imirima yumuceri nibindi bihingwa kimwe no gutanga amazi y'inka muri kano gace kugirango borore inka.
Uruzi rufata isoko i Rukomo mu karere ka Gicumbi hafi y'umujyi wa Byumba mu misozi miremire yo mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Mwisoko, yitwa uruzi rwa Mulindi. Uyu mugezi ni ingenzi cyane mubukungu kuko ikibaya cyacyo n’ibibaya by’inzuzi zacyo birumbuka kandi birimo ibihingwa by’icyayi. Rumwe mu ruganda runini rw'icyayi mu Rwanda, Uruganda rwa Mulindi Factory tea ruherereye ku uru ruzi. Mulindi itemba mu majyaruguru kuri 28 km hanyuma yinjira muri Uganda.
rumaze kwinjira muri Uganda, ruhindura izina ruva mu ruzi rwa Mulindi ruhinduka uruzi rwa Rwabakazi. Rwabakazi ikomeza mu majyaruguru, hanyuma imaze kugera mu mujyi wa Kabale, uruzi ruhindura inzira kandi rutemba mu cyerekezo rusange cyo mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba yerekeza mu Rwanda. Iki gice cyumugezi wa Muvumba muri Uganda (Umugezi wa Rwabakazi) gifite uburebure bwa km 55. Uruzi rusubira mu Rwanda mu Karere ka Nyagatare rugafata izina Umugezi wa Muvumba. Ihita itemba yerekeza mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa kilometero 87 ikisuka mu ruzi rwa Akagera ahitwa Kagitumba, inyabutatu ihuza u Rwanda, Uganda na Tanzaniya. Kuri kilometero 30 yanyuma yinzira zayo, uruzi rugize umupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Uganda.
Muvumba river ifite ikibaya gihingwa cyane. Inzira yo hejuru yinzuzi mu misozi yintara yamajyaruguru mu Rwanda no mu Karere ka Kabale muri Uganda ifite ibibaya bigufi bikoreshwa cyane nko guhinga icyayi. Uruzi rutanga amazi kumigezi itabarika ifasha kuvomera imirima. Kubera iyo mpamvu, uruzi rwangiritse igice kinini ahantu henshi kugirango igenzure amazi kandi irebe ko haboneka amazi no mugihe cyizuba. Mu bice bidahingwa byicyayi, ikibaya gikoreshwa mubuhinzi butunze Benci.
Iyo uruzi rwongeye kwinjira mu Rwanda, rutemba mu turere tw’imisozi ahantu hahanamye kandi hahanamye cyane. Inzira zose z'ikibaya cy'umugezi wa Muvumba zikunda kwibasirwa n'umwuzure kubera imvura nyinshi igwa mu misozi yo mu majyaruguru yayo. Ibi bizwiho kuzana imyuzure ikabije ndetse no mu bice byo hepfo yuruzi ubusanzwe bitagira imvura nyinshi. Iyi myuzure ishobora guhagarika inzira yo hepfo yuruzi, igafunga imihanda nikiraro mugihe nayo yangiza cyane ibihingwa.
Ibinyabuzima ni Bimera.
Hanze y'ubuhinzi bunini, imigezi yo hepfo ishyigikira ishyamba rinini. Iri shyamba rifunganye rirashobora kuba ryinshi kandi ntirishobora kwambuka, kandi rikubiyemo ubwoko bwinshi bwibiti bya savanna. Ubwoko bwinshi bwinyoni buboneka muri kariya gace, ubwinshi muri bwo ni heron na egrets. Amatungo magufi y’inyamaswa n’ibikururukanda Inyamaswa nini zo mu mazi nka Invubu, ningona za Nili zishobora kandi kuboneka mubice byegeranye n’isangano ry'umugezi munini wa Akagera. Izi nyamaswa zizwiho kugenda zerekeza hejuru cyane cyane mugihe cyumwuzure utera guhitana abaturage baho batabizi batamenyereye aya matungo kuba kure cyane.

Pariki y'igihugu Ya Rusizi ni pariki y'igihugu cyu Burundi, iruhande rw'umugezi wa Rusizi. Ni 15 km mu majyaruguru yu mujyi wa Bujumbura Umugezi ubamo Invubu na sitatungas. Gustave, ingona ya Nili, bivugwa ko yahitanye abantu 300.

Muri Bibiliya havugwa inkoni Mose yakubise mu Nyanja Itukura igatandukana Abisiraheli bakayambuka.
Bisaba amasaha atandatu n’iminota 20 kuva i Kigali kugera mu murwa mukuru wa Misiri ari wo Cairo. Iyo ugeze muri uyu mujyi ufata indege ikugeza mu Mujyi wa Sharm El Sheikh ari na ho haherereye Inyanja Itukura.
Umuntu umenyereye ubuzima bwa Kigali abanza kugorwa n’ubushyuhe bwo muri aka gace cyane ko bigoye kubona umuntu wambaye yifubitse.
Ikintu cya mbere gitangaje ubona ukigera muri uyu murwa ni ibiti bitoshye ariko bavuga ko bisaba kubyitaho cyane ukabivomerera kuko utabikoze gutyo bitaramba.

Norvège iherereye mu Mudugudu wa Karama, Akagari ka Nyabugogo, Umurenge wa Kigali Akarere ka Nyarugenge. Aka gace kiswe Norvège kubera ukuntu kubatswemo inzu zigendanye n’igihe n’uburyo gakomeje kugezwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye by’iterambere.
Ubusanzwe Norvège ni igihugu kiri ku Mugabane w’u Burayi mu Majyaruguru y’Isi, kizwiho kuba abaturage bacyo ari bamwe mu babayeho neza.
Iyo utembereye muri aka gace kari mu Mudugudu wa Gakoni mu Kagari ka Nyabugogo mu Murenge wa Kigali uhana imbibi n’uwa Kimisagara n’uwa Mageragere kabatijwe akabyiniro ka Norvège, utungurwa n’ibikorwa remezo bimaze kukagezwamo.
Hari irerero rifasha mu burezi bw’abana bafite guhera ku myaka itatu kugeza kuri itanu. Hubatswe inzu zigezweho ziherutse gutahwa n’Umukuru w’Igihugu ziri mu byiciro bitandukanye ku buryo umuturage ashobora kugura ku giciro kimunogeye.
Abantu benshi bahazi neza bahamya ko ikibanza cyaho gisaba uwifite kuko gihenze. Ni mu gihe ibiciro fatizo by’ubutaka mu Rwanda 2021, byateguwe n’Urugaga rw’Abagenagaciro ku mutungo utimukanwa mu Rwanda rugena ibiciro by’ibibanza hagendewe ku bintu bitandukanye.
Ruvuga ko ikibanza cyo guturaho amafaranga make ashoboka ari 3,849 kuri metero kare mu Mudugudu wa Karama ho mu Kagari ka Nyabugogo, Umurenge wa Kigali.

Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Kirehe butangaza ko udusozi twa Nyarubuye dutatwse namabuye manini turi guteganyirizwa gushyirwa mu bice nyaburanga bizajya bisurwa na ba mukerarugendo.
Akarere ka Kirehe gafite umwihariko w’ubwiza butatse imisozi iriho amabuye manini y’ibitaro, igaragara cyane mu bice by’Imirenge ya Kigina, mpanga, Nyarabuye na Nasho. akarere ka kirehe gahana imbibi nigihugu cya tanzania kakaba gatatswe nibyiza byishi

Ahirengeye mu Murenge wa Gatsibo, aho bita Gatsibo k’imitoma, hari ahahoze ibivumu byari bigize urugo umwami yabagamo. Uhasanga kandi inzu ishaje imeze nk’iyubatswe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni. Iyo uhahagaze kandi ubasha kubona ibice byinshi by’imisozi. Iyo uhageze ubona ko koko hari amateka.

Ndego ni umwe mu mirenge 12 igize Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba.
Aka gace kahoze ari amashyamba, kadatuwe, ndetse mbere ya 1994, hahoze ari Parike y’Akagera.
Hari ibiyaga bine, ari byo: Nasho, Rwakibare, Ihema na Kagese. N’ubundi hegereye Parike y’Akagera, ndetse hagahana imbibi n’Akarere ka Kirehe, hari n’agace k’Ikiyaga cya Rwakibare kegereye Umugezi w’Akagera, n’igihugu cya Tanzania. Ibi bituma abatuye Ndego bagirana ubuhahirane n’Abanyambo bo muri iki gihugu gituranyi cya Tanzania.
Umurenge wa Ndego utuwe n’abaturage basaga ibihumbi 20, abenshi batunzwe n’ubuhinzi. Usibye ahubatse amazu n’ibindi bikorwa remezo, ahari ibiyaga na hake hari imisozi ihanamye, ubuyobozi buvuga ko ahasigaye hakorerwa ubuhinzi n’ubworozi.
Gusa n’ubwo ibiti bya kimeza cyangwa by’ishyamba byatemwe bigacanwa uko abaturage bagiye biyongera, byinshi bigatwikwamo amakara, uhageze ntuhabura ibimenyetso by’uko aha hantu hahoze ari Parike y’Akagera.

Igiti ni ijambo risanzwe rivuga, nta bisobanuro byemewe bizwi ku isi hose byerekana icyo igiti aricyo, haba mu bimera cyangwa mu rurimi rusanzwe., igiti ni igihingwa icyo aricyo cyose gifite uburyo rusange bwurwego rurerure, cyangwa igiti, gifasha amababi ya fotosintetike cyangwa amashami intera iri hejuru yubutaka. Ibiti na byo bisobanurwa n'uburebure, hamwe n'ibiti bito kuva kuri 0,5 kugeza kuri 10 (1,6 kugeza 32.8 ft) byitwa ibihuru, bityo uburebure buke bw'igiti busobanurwa neza. Ibimera binini nka papayi n'ibitoki ni ibiti muri ubu buryo bwagutse.
Ingeso yo gukura kw'ibiti ni ihindagurika ry'ihindagurikire riboneka mu matsinda atandukanye y'ibimera: mu gukura mu buremure, ibiti bishobora guhangana neza n'izuba. Ibiti bikunda kuba birebire kandi biramba, bimwe bigera ku myaka ibihumbi. Ibiti byinshi biri mu binyabuzima bya kera cyane ubu. Ibiti byahindura imiterere nkibiti binini bigizwe ningirabuzimafatizo zihariye zongerera imbaraga imiterere nigihe kirekire, bigatuma zishobora gukura muremure kuruta ibindi bimera byinshi no gukwirakwiza amababi yabyo. Bitandukanye ni ibihuru, bifite imiterere isa yo gukura, mubisanzwe bikura binini kandi bifite igiti kimwe nyamukuru; irashobora kugabanuka mubunini mugihe gikabije cyibidukikije nko kumusozi nuduce twa subarctique. Imiterere yibiti yagiye ihindagurika mu byiciro bidafitanye isano n’ibimera hasubijwe ibibazo bisa n’ibidukikije, bituma iba urugero rwiza rw’ubwihindurize. Hafi yubwoko 60.000-100.000, umubare wibiti kwisi yose ushobora kuba makumyabiri na gatanu kwijana ryibinyabuzima byose bizima.Umubare munini muribi ukura mu turere dushyuha; henshi muri utwo turere tutarasuzumwa neza n’ibimera, bigatuma ibiti bitandukanye kandi bitamenyekana neza.
Ibiti bigira akamaro kenshi: hari ibyera imbuto: nk’amacunga, amapapayi, indimu, amatunda, marakuja, za avoka, imyembe n’ibindi byinshi. Hari n’ibyubakishwa amazu n'amateme hakaba n’ibisaturwamo imbaho, zikabazwamo ibikoresho by’amoko menshi, hakaba n’ibicanwa. Hari n'ibiti bitanga igicucu kuburyo abagenzi bashobora kwikinga izuba baruhuka bamara gutora akabaraga bagakomeza urugendo.
Leta y'u Rwanda isaba abaturage abatuye mu mijyi kwitabira gahunda yo gutera ibiti by’imbuto mu rwego rwo kongera imirire myiza yo mu ngo. kandi ikogera gushishikariza abaturage Gahunda igira iti"Ntutema kimwe uge Utera bibiri".

Mu Rwanda, kimwe n’ahandi hose ibidukikije bigizwe n’ibice bibiri, ibidukikije kamere n’ibidukikije biva ku bikorwa bya muntu kandi bigengwa na politike, inzego z’ubuyobozi n’amategeko mu mikorere, mu kurindwa no mu micungire yabyo. Ibidukikije kamere bigizwe n’ubutaka n’ikuzimu, umutungo w’amazi, umwuka, urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ubwiza nyaburanga, ahantu nyaburanga n’inyubako. Ibidukikije biva ku bikorwa bya muntu birebana n’imitunganyirize y’imijyi n’icyaro n’imibereho y’abantu.
Ibidukikije karemano by’u Rwanda birangwa n’aho u Rwanda ruherereye mu burasira zuba bw’Afurika yo hagati ya 1° 04’ na 2° 51’ (mu majyepfo ya koma y’isi) na 28° 45’ na 31° 15’ (Uburasirazuba). Ibintu by’ingenzi bigize ibidukikije keremano by’u Rwanda biri ku buso bungana na km² 26338 kandi birangwa ahanini n’ubutumburuke bw’imisozi, ubutaka, imiterere y’ikirere, ibimera n’amazi.

Imiterere y’imisozi yo mu Rwanda iranyuraranye. Uvuye i burasirazuba ugana iburengerazuba ubutumburuke buri hagati ya m 1000 na 4500. Iburasirazuba burangwa n’imisozi migufi, mu gihugu hagati n’imisozi iringaniye n’aho mu burengerazuba n’imisozi miremire.
Isunzu rya Kongo Nili.
Ni uruhererekane rw’imisozi ifite ubutumburuke buri hagati ya m 2500 na 3000. Iryo sunzu ricuramiye ikiyaga cya Kivu, rigabanya amazi y’u Rwanda mu bice bibiri: amazi yisuka mu kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Kongo mu burengerazuba n’amazi yisuka mu kibaya cya Nili mu burasirazuba. Isunzu rya Kongo Nili, mu majyaruguru hashyira i burengerazuba, higanje uruhererekane rw’imisozi y’ibirunga bitanu harimo ikirunga kibisumba byose aricyo Karisimbi gifite ubutumburuke bungana na m 4507.

U Rwanda rurangwa n’ibihe by’igihugu biri munsi ya koma y’isi bidakora ku nyanja ariko imihindagurikire y’ibihe byo mu Rwanda bigengwa n’ubutuburuke bw’imisozi. Ubushyuhe ntabwo buhindagurika cyane. Mu mwaka, ubushyuhe buba buri hagati ya 16°C na 17°C mu bice by’imisozi miremire, hagati ya 18°C na 21° C mu bitwa byo mu gihugu hagati na 20°C kugeza kuri 24°C mu bice by’imisozi migufi y’iburasirazuba n’iy’iburengerazuba. Imvura igwa mu mwaka iri hagati ya mm 700 na mm 1400 mu duce tw’imisozi migufi yo mu burasirazuba n’iburengerazuba, no hagati ya mm 1200 na mm 1400 mu duce tw’ibitwa byo mu gihugu hagati no hagati ya mm 1400 na mm 2000 mu duce tw’imisozi miremire. Imvura igwa igira uruhare runini ku mazi yo mu migezi, ibiyaga n’ibishanga. Imyuzure mu gihe cy’itumba riba mu kwezi kwa Werurwe rikagera muri Gicurasi naho ikamuka rikaba mu gihe cy’impeshyi iba kuva mu kwezi kwa Kamena kugera muri Nzeri. U Rwanda rugenda ruhura n’amapfa maremare kandi agenda agaruka mu duce tw’iburasirazuba n’amajyepfo y’iburasirazuba. Iyo mihindagurikire ifitanye isano n’iyo dusanga mu rwego mpuzamahanga itewe n’ishyuha rusange ry’umubumbe w’isi.
Imihindagurikire y’ikirere ni iki?
Imihindagurikire y’ikirere irebana n’impinduka muri rusange y’ibigize ikirere n’ibihe. Irangwa n’impinduka y’ibigize ikirere kimenyerewe mu buryo n’inshuro bidasanzwe biba mu gihe kirekire, akenshi hagati y’imyaka 30 na 35. Ibigize ikirere bihinduka bikubiyemo uko imvura igwa, ubushyuhe, imiyaga, ububobere, urubura n’ibihe by’ihinga. Mu magambo yoroshye, imihindagurikire y’ikirere isobanura uguhinduka kw’igihe kirekire kw’imiterere y’ibihe n’ikirere.

U Rwanda rufite imigezi myishi igabanyijemo ibice bibiri. Hari imigezi yisuka mu kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Congo n’indi yisuka mu kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Nili. Imigezi yo mu kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Congo ni migufi irimo amazi make kandi yisuka mu kiyaga cya Kivu. Amazi y’umugezi wa Rusizi aturuka mu Kiyaga cya Kivu. Amazi menshi ajya mu kiyaga cya Kivu aturuka mu mugezi wa Ruhwa ugize umupaka w’u Rwanda n’u Burundi mu gice cy’iburengerazuba naho mu gice cy’amajyaruguru amazi ajya mu kiyaga cya Kivu ava mu mugezi wa Sebeya mu Ntara ya Gisenyi. Ikibaya cy’uruzi rwa Nili nicyo gifite igice kinini cy’amazi yo mu Rwanda. Imigezi minini yo mu Rwanda ariyo Nyabarongo n’Akanyaru ndetse n’indi myinshi iyisukamo niyo igize uruzi rw’Akagera iturutse mu kiyaga cya Rweru. Iyo migezi ihererekanya amazi hagati yayo n’ibishanga binini n’ibiyaga bitari birebire ujya ikuzimu.
mu Rwanda N°48/2018 ryo ku wa 13/08/2018 rivuga ko mu bikorwa bibujijwe harimo kumena imyanda yanduza n'itanduza, itemba cyangwa gazi ihumanya mu mugezi, mu ruzi, mu gishanga, mu kidendezi, mu kiyaga no mu nkengero zabyo; kwangiza ubwiza bw’amazi yaba ay’imusozi cyangwa ay’ikuzimu. Ubu bugenzuzi bukaba bwatangiriye mu Turere dukora ku kiyaga cya Kivu aritwo Rubavu,Rusizi,Nyamasheke,Karongi na Rutsiro. Mu rwego rwo ku kirengera birinda icyatuma cyangirika nuko hari metero.

U Rwanda rufite indiri y’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima zinyuranye: indiri z’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima kamere zigizwe n’amashyamba y’inzitane yo mu misozi miremire, amashyamba mato yo mu duhanga tw’imisozi,umukenke, ahantu hahehereye n’amashyamaba y’matereno. Ahantu hakomye ho mu Rwanda hagizwe n’Ishyamaba rya Cyimeza rya Nyungwe, Pariki Nasiyonali y’Akagera, Pariki Nasiyonali y’Ibirunga na Pariki Nasiyonali y’Akagera n’aho hantu harinzwe ho mu Rwanda hagizwe n’ishyamba rya cyimeza rya Mukura, n’amashyamba ya Cyamudongo, Busaga, Umukenke wo mu burasirazuba. Ishyamba rya cyimeza rya Gishwati ryo riri hafi kuzimangatana.
Amashyamba ni kimwe mu mutungo kamere u Rwanda rufite, ariko by’umwihariko kuba rugifite amashyamba ya kimeza bikaba akarusho kuko bifasha mu kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Amashyamba ya kimeza ari mu igihugu cy'u Rwanda harimo: Nyungwe, Kibirizi, Gishwati, Mukura ndi menshi kuko amashyamba ya kimeza agera 107 hose mu gihugu.

Parki nkuru ya Nyungwe ni ishyamba cyimeza riri mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda kandi riri hejuru y’inkombe z’ikiyaga cya Kivu. Iryo shyamba rifatanye na Pariki Nasiyonali ya Kibira yo mu gihugu cy’u Burundi kandi rishobora kuba ari ryo shyamba ry’inzitane ryo mu misozi minini kandi miremire muri Afurika yose; ryari rifite ubuso bwa km² 924 mu mwaka w’i 2000. Iryo shyamba riri mu misozi ifite m 1600 na m 2950 kandi ririmo amoko menshi y’ibimera abana n’amoko anyuranye y’inyamaswa; agizwe ahanini n’inyoni n’ingunge. Ishyamba cyimeza rya Nyungwe ni kimwe mu bigega by’amazi y’u Rwanda: ritanga hafi 60% by’amazi y’u Rwanda. Ikindi kandi isoko ry’uruzi rwa Nili iri muri iryo shyamba.

Amashyamba y’amaterano yatewe hagati ya 1920 na 1948 kandi agizwe ahanini n’intusi ariko hari ubundi bwoko bw’ibiti nka Gereveriya, Cedrella, Callianda bugenda bukwirakwizwa. ubuzima bwo kuri iyi si dutuyeho, ribonekamo ibimera bitandukanye, Ubuso bw’u Rwanda 30.4% bungana na kilometero kare 8,006% buriho amashyamba, 68% by’aya mashyamba n’ay’abaturage naho 32% akaba aya leta agizwe n’amashyamaba y’amaterano, imigano n’amashyamba kimeza. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe amashyamba (RFA), gitangaza ko mu mwaka wa 2022/2023 bateganya gutera ubuso burenga hegitari 50,000, buriho ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka.

Ikiyaga cya Nyirakigugu ni ikiyaga gito cyo mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Murenge wa Jenda, mu Akarere ka Nyabihu. Kiri hafi y'umuhanda wa kaburimbo uva i Musanze ujya i Rubavu.
Amazi y'iki kiyaga yagiye yiyongera. Yageze mu nzu z'abaturage bamwe. Abo baturage basabye kwimurwa.
Abaturiye ikiyaga bavuga ko cyavutse mu mwaka wa 1963. Cyatangiye ari amazi make. Abantu bamwe bagifataga nk'ahantu nyaburanga.
Mbere, amazi y'iki kiyaga yajyaga mu kiyaga cya Karago. Ahagana mu mwaka wa 2010, inzira y'amazi yanyuraga munsi y'umuhanda yarafunzwe. Kuva icyo gihe, amazi yatangiye kwiyongera.
Ingaruka ku baturage.
Mu mwaka wa 2013, amazi yari amaze kugera ku nzu zimwe. Abaturage batinyaga ko yangiza inzu n'umuhanda. Umuyobozi w'Akarere ka Nyabihu, Twahirwa Abdoulatif, yavuze ko aho hantu hadakwiye guturwa. Yasabye abaturage kwimuka.
Mu mwaka wa 2022, amazi yinjiraga mu nzu z'abaturage. Inzu zimwe zatangiye gusenyuka. Abaturage basabye Leta kubimura. Umuyobozi w'Akarere, Mukandayisenga Antoinette, yavuze ko ubuyobozi bushaka inzira yo gusohora amazi buhoro buhoro. Yasabye abaturage gutekereza ku kwimuka.

Ikiyaga cya Bisoke ni ikiyaga kiri ku gasongero k'Ikirunga cya Bisoke, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda. Ni ikiyaga kiri mu mwobo w'ikirunga ("crater lake").
Ikiyaga cya Bisoke ni hamwe mu hantu nyaburanga mu Rwanda. Ba mukerarugendo benshi barakizamuka kugira ngo bakirebe.
Ikiyaga cya Bisoke kiri ku gasongero k'Ikirunga cya Bisoke. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 3 711.
Ikirere cyo kuri iki kirunga gihinduka vuba. Rimwe haba ibihu, ubundi hakaba harakeye. Imvura na yo ishobora kugwa umwanya uwo ari wo wose.
Ba mukerarugendo benshi basura ikiyaga kubera ubwiza bwacyo. Urugendo rutangirira i Kinigi, ku biro bya RDB. Abazamuka bagomba kwambara imyenda irinda imbeho n'inkweto zitanyerera. Abatazifite bashobora kuzikodesha i Kinigi.

Ni ubwoko bw’ inyoni idakunze kuboneka ahantu henshi ku Isi. Iyi nyoni yakoreshejwe mu kirago cy’ igihugu cya Novelle Zelande mu kinyejana cya 19, ni inyamabere ikaba n’ imyamahoro.
Ubu bwitonzi bw’ iyi nyoni no kuba idakunda imirwano bituma inyamaswa z’ indyanyama ziyisagarira cyane zikayikoramo amafunguro.

Umujyi wa Gisenyi, uri mu Karere ka Rubavu iri mu mijyi itandatu yatoranyijwe izunganira Kigali. izwiho kuba umujyi wo kwidagaduriramo, ndetse ukanashyuha. Uretse kuba umujyi w’ubucuruzi, ufite n’ibice nyaburanga bifasha abantu kwishimisha no kuruhuka. Umusozi wa Rubavu(Gisenyi) ni umusozi w’amateka uhagararaho ukareba umujyi wa Rubavu na Goma nk’uyicayemo.
Umusozi wa Gisenyi, ubu umaze kugirwa umusozi w’ubukerarugendo ku bufatanye na Koperative Inshongore y’Inkeragutabara hamwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA) n’ikigo cy’igihugu cyimakaza iterambere (RDB).
Umusozi wa Gisenyi ubumbatiye amateka menshi, arimo ashingiye ku buvumo (abacunga uyu musozi bavuga ko batarahashyira umuhanda ku buryo abantu bahagera) ngo bwifashishijwe n’Umujenerali w’Umudage, ubwo barwana n’Ababiligi bari muri DR Congo mu ntambara ya mbere y’Isi, ndetse hagwa abasirikare benshi cyane.
Aha ngo Abadage barahakunda kuko hafite aho hahuriye n’amateka yabo nk’uko tubikesha Ndagijimana Innocent, umwe mu bagize Koperative Inshongore.
Uyu musozi kandi wakunze kujya wifashishwa n’ingabo z’u Rwanda.
Uyu musozi uzengurutswe n’agahanda k’ibilometero 11 ushobora kugendamo n’amaguru gusa, ukora Siporo cyangwa uri gutembera.
Iyo uri hejuru uba ushobora kureba neza Umujyi wa Gisenyi, ikiyaga cya Kivu n’Umujyi wa Goma muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo munsi yawe.
