Lumala Abdu (wavutse ku ya 21 Nyakanga 1997) ni umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi usatira izamu mu ikipe ya Pyramids yo mu Misiri ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Abdu yakuriye hamwe na nyirakuru mu mudugudu wa Kataba kuva nyina yapfa afite amezi make gusa ise ntazwi. Afite imyaka 10 yahawe Henrik Larsson, ishati nk'umunsi w'amavuko ye, yahawe na nyirasenge. Yizeraga kuzabona ubuzima bwiza, ubwo nyirakuru yamwohereje mu murwa mukuru Kampala afite imyaka 16. Abdu yakoze akazi kenshi, nko koza imodoka, mbere yuko ahura n'abanyaburayi b'abazungu babashije kumujyana mu ndege yerekeza ku kibuga cy'indege cya Sturup.
Yasigaye wenyine mu mihanda ya Malmö niho yavuganye na Migrationsverket. Bashoboye kubona icumbi rya Abdu mu mujyi muto wa Bromölla. Agezeyo, yatangiye imyitozo hamwe n'ikipe yaho Ifö / Bromölla akina mu cyiciro cya 5 cya Suwede, ariko nyuma yo kutabasha kubona inkweto z'umupira w'amaguru we n'inshuti bimukiye mu cyiciro cya 9 Gualövs GoIF. Yahise agirwa kapiteni hanyuma amaze gutsinda ibitego 20 m'umikino 10 ikipe nini ya Mjällby AIF yamusinyiye mu mpeshyi ya 2014. Yakinnye umwaka usigaye hamwe na bafite munsi y'imwaka 17 na 19. Mbere y'igihembwe gitaha Abdu yazamuwe muri ikipe nkuru A ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Suwede Superettan. Yarishimwe, maze atsinda ibitego 3 mu mikino 24 ari 17 gusa igihe shampiyona yatangiraga. Ibihuha by'impano ye by'akwirakwirijwe n'amakipe nka Malmö FF na Olympiacos bashaka kumusinyisha..
Abdu impano ye yaje kurangirira muri Suwede yo mu ndege muri Kalmar FF. Muri shampiyona ya mbere, yakinnye imikino 10 ya shampiyona.
Mbere y'igihembwe cya 2017 Abdu yahawe inguzanyo muri ikipe ya Superettan Varbergs BoIS. Nyuma y'igice cya shampiyona hamwe niyi kipe, yagarutse muri Kalmar FF kugirango yongere gutizwa, kuriyi nshuro ikigirwamana cye cya nyina Henrik Larsson Helsingborgs NIBA. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere mu mukino yakinnye na GAIS. nyuma yishati ya Abdu ivuga Lumalinho.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, Abdu yinjiye mu ikipe ya Pyramids FC yo mu Misiri yo mu Misiri aho yahuye n'uwahoze ari umutoza wa Uganda, Sébastien Desabre.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’igihugu cya Uganda ku ya 9 Kamena 2019 mu mukino wa gicuti na Turukimenisitani, atangira mu kibuga.

George Abege Opio (yavutse ku ya 5 Werurwe 1993) ni rutahizamu ukomoka muri Uganda kuri ubu ukinira Sri Lanka's Up Country Lions SC. Yaje gukina muri shampiyona yo muri Kenya mu ikipe ya Nairobi City Stars, anakina muri Bandari FC (Kenya) hamwe na Kariobangi Sharks, ndetse na Asante Kotoko SC yo muri Gana mu cyiciro cya mbere
George yatangiriye muri FC Luzira ya Maroon, Luweroo United yo muri Uganda mbere yo kwinjira muri kaminuza ya SC Victoria muri 2013. Nyuma yaje muri Kenya aho yamaze igihembwe cya 2014 muri Nairobi City Stars.
Muri 2015 yerekeje ku nkombe za Bandari FC muri Kenya kugeza mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2016 hanyuma yerekeza mu Burengerazuba yinjira muri SoNy Sugar FC muri shampiyona ya 2017 na 2018.
Yagarutse i Nairobi mu gice cya kabiri cya shampiyona ya 2018 nyuma yo kwinjira muri FC Kariobangi Sharks. Mu ntangiriro z'uwo mwaka, yari afite kwerekeza mu yindi kipe muri Kenya Posta Rangers FC ariko kubera impamvu zitazwi, yagumye i SoNy.
Igihembwe cya 2018/19 kirangiye, George yerekeje muri shampiyona yo muri Gana yinjira muri Asante Kotoko SC ku masezerano yimyaka itatu. Ariko, nyuma y'amezi make, yavuye muri iyo kipe hanyuma ahuzwa yerekeza mu ikipe ya Uganda yitwa URA FC. Muri Mata 2021 yimukiye muri Sri Lanka's Up Country Lions SC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2012, George yabereye ku kibuga cya Stade Juba, mu mukino wa gicuti na Sudani y'Amajyepfo. Muri 2015 yatangaje yeruye icyifuzo cye cyo kurushaho kwitabwaho mu ikipe yigihugu.

Leo Adraa ni umutoza w'umupira w'amaguru kandi wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mugihugu cya Uganda.
Yatsindira shampiyona y'imbere muri Sudani yepfo ari hamwe na Atlabara FC, Adraa yayobora iyi kipe muri marushanwa ya CAF muri 2014, ni ubwa mbere ikipe ya Sudani yepfo yitabiriye ayo amarushanwa.
Yashyizweho nk'umutoza w'agateganyo w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Sudani y'Amajyepfo mu 2016, aho yagombaga kuyobora iyi kipe mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2017 ; ariko, yeguye kuri uyu mwanya nyuma y'umukino umwe kuri uwo mwaka kubera uburangare bw’ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ku mushahara we, avuga umushahara atishyuwe. Adraa yatangaje ko atazongera gusubira muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo.

Brian Aheebwa (wavutse 1 Nyakanga 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ya KCCA FC yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda hamwe nikipe yigihugu ya Uganda (Imisambi) nka rutahizamu.
Umwuga w'urubyiruko.
Akiri muto, yari umunyamuryango w’ishuri rya Seminari ya Mutagatifu Yohani Bosco maze mu 2014 yinjira mu ishuri ry’imikino rya Mbarara kugeza 2016.
Mbarara FC (2016-2020).
Aheebwa yinjiye muri Mbarara City FC mu 2016 arangiza muri Mbarara. Yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 4 amaze kwinjira muri Mbarara City FC, Mu 2016, niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona y'akarere yatsinze ibitego umunani. Yatangiye gukinira irushanwa rikuru muri 2017 muri Mbarara City FC na Kireka Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere yatsinze Masavu FC muri Werurwe 2017. Ku ya 9 Mata 2017 yatsinze ibitego bine muri Mbarara City FC na Nyamityobora FC. Yatsinze ibitego 39 mugihe cy'imyaka ine yamaze muri Mbarara City FC.
Muri Kamena 2020 yinjiye muri KCCA FC asinya amasezerano yimyaka 3. Ku ya 3 Ukuboza 2020, yatangiye gukinira KCCA FC na Bright Stars FC. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere kuri KCCA FC muri uwo mukino, KCCA FC yatsinze ibitego 2 kuri 1.
Aheebwa yavutse ku ya 1 Nyakanga 1998 mu Karere ka Kibale. Yize amashuri abanza ya Kahunde, Ishuri ry'isumbuye rya Mutagatifu Yohani Bosco muri Hoyima mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Mutagatifu Kirigwajjo aho yakiriye UCE. Hagati ya 2014 na 2015, Aheebwa yinjiye mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi cy’Urwibutso rwa Mayanja aho yarangirije impamyabumenyi muri Nursing bityo akaba ari umuyobozi w’ubuvuzi wemewe.

Sadat Byishimo Anaku Ana (wavutse 9 Ukuboza 2000) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Dundee yo muri Ekose, nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere asatira izamu.
Anaku yakinnye i gihugu cye cya Uganda mu mujyi ya KCC, aho yatsinze ibitego 22 mu mikino 67 yakiniye iyi kipe mbere yo gusinyira imyaka ibiri mu ikipe ya Scottish Dundee muri Kanama 2022, nyuma yo kurangiza ingeragezwa akaritsinda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Nzeri 2021, yari ahagarariye itsinda ryatoranijwe rya Uganda mu akarere, naho muri Gashyantare 2022 ahagarariye itsinda ryatoranijwe rya Uganda mu murikagurisha ryabereye muri Esipanye.
Anaku yahamagawe n'ikipe nkuru y'igihugu ya Uganda, ariko guhera muri Kanama 2022 yari atarakina.

Bright Anukani (yavutse 26 kamena 2000) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga mu ikipe ya KCCA ndetse nikipe yumupira wamaguru ya Uganda.
Yinjiye muri KCCA mu mpeshyi 2020.

Khalid Aucho (wavutse 8 Kanama 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Young Africans yo muri Tanzaniya ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda nku mukinnyi ukina hagati mu kibuga.
Aucho yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu makipe atandukanye, nka Jinja Municipal Council FC kuva 2009 kugeza 2010, Water FC yo muri Uganda kuva 2010 kugeza 2012, Simba FC yo muri Uganda, Tusker ikomoka muri Kenya, Gor Mahia ikomoka muri Kenya, na Baroka ikomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yari mu ikipe ya Uganda yujuje ibisabwa mu gikombe cya Afurika ku nshuro ya mbere mu myaka 38.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Aucho yavukiye i Jinja, muri Uganda. Yize amashuri abanza ya Namagabimuri Kayunga, St Thudus mu cyiciro rusange, akomereza mu Ishuri rivanze rya Iganga mu mashuri yisumbuye.
Muri Nyakanga 2016, Aucho yagiye mu igeragezwa mu ikipe ya Aberdeen yo muri Skotishi mu cyiciro cya mbere. Kwimukira muri Aberdeen byaragiye, ariko, nyuma yo kwishyura amafaranga yo kwimura amakipe. Nyuma y’igeragezwa ritangenze neza muri otcosse, Aucho yasinye muri Baroka FC ikomoka muri Afurika yepfo ku giciro cyavuzwe ko ari Rande 200.000.
Ku ya 24 Kanama 2016, Aucho yasinyiye ikipe ya Baroka FC Yatangiye umukino we wa mbere ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2016 mu mukino w’umupira w'amaguru wa shampiyona wabereye kuri Stade ya Cape Town ku munota wa 50 asimbuye Chauke Mfundhisii.
Urubyiruko rwo muri Afurika SC.
Aucho yimukiye muri ikipe yo muri Tanzaniya ya Young Africans SC muri Kanama 2021.

Timothy Dennis Awany (wavutse 6 Kanama 1996) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira FC Ashdod ndetse nikipe yigihugu ya Uganda nka myugariro.
Awany yakiniye mu ikipe ya KCCA yi Kampala.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, yinjiye muri shampiyona ya Isiraheli yinjira mu ikipe FC Ashdod.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Awany yagaragaye bwa mbere mu ikipe mpuzamahanga y'igihugu cya Uganda mu 2016, kandi yashyizwe mu ikipe izakina mu gikombe cy'Afurika cyo muri 2017.

Ikiremwamuntu gikwiye guhindure imyumvire mu buryo bwogukoresha indiri z’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, cyane cyane ibishanga, imigezi n’ibiyaga, kera byafatwaga nka ahantu ho kujugunya imyanda.
Kubungabunga Ibiyaga n'Ibishanga.
Kurengera ibidukikije mu rugamba rw’iterambere rirambye, inzira ni ndende,abantu basabwa guhindura imyumvire ku ikoreshwa ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, aho kera byafatwaga nk’ahantu ho kujugunya imyanda.Umuturarwanda agomba kuzirikana isano kamere afitanye n’ibidukikije, bityo akarushaho kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima bibumbatiye amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa n’ibimera dukesha ibidutunga, imiti twivuza n’umwuka mwiza duhumeka uwo mwuka udashobora kubonerwa ikiguzi gikwiye.Abanyarwanda bashishikarizwa gufatanyiriza hamwe mu kwiteza imbere no gufata neza umutungo kamere w’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima.Urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima runyuranye ruri mu byanya bikomye za pariki, n’ibishanga, bifashako igihugu ko gisurwa na ba Mukerarugendo aho bigira uruhare runini mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’igihugu.Twite ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, iyo ni insanganyamatsiko ijyanye n’icyerekezo cyo mu mwaka 2050 u Rwanda rwihaye, cyo kuba mu bihugu biteye imbere binyuze mu iterambere ritabangamira ibidukikije.
Mu Rwanda, insanganyamatsiko ivuga iti Igihe kirageze twite ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ijyanye n’icyerekezo cyo mu mwaka 2050 u Rwanda rwihaye, cyo kuba mu bihugu biteye imbere, binyuze mu iterambere ritabangamiye ibidukikije kandi rifite ubudahangarwa ku ngaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.Iyo nsanganyamatsiko, ijyanye n’intego z’iterambere rirambye, na gahunda y’igihugu y’imyaka irindwi yo kwihutisha iterambere. Bityo nukuvugango iyangirika ry’umutungo kamere n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, bigira ingaruka zikomeye kandi zitubuza kugera ku ntego z’iterambere ry’ubukungu bw'igihugu cyiyemeje.Bavuga ko ibyo bigaragaza ko kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, byuzuzanya no guteza imbere ubukungu n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage.kurengera ibidukikije ni rugamba rw’iterambere rirambye.

Micheal Azira (yavutse 22 Kanama 1987) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Azira yasinyanye na Batteri ya Charleston ya USL Pro muri 2012. Yatsindiye Charleston igitego y'atsinze Wilmington Hammerheads mu mikino ya Shampiyona ya USL Pro muri 2012. Azira yatsinze ibindi bitego bitandatu muri Battery muri 2013.Ku ya 6 Werurwe 2014, Azira yimuriwe muri Seattle Sounders FC muri Shampiyona nkuru y’umupira w'amaguru. Yatangiye bwa mbere muri MLS asimbuye Montréal ku ya 23 Werurwe.
Seattle ntabwo yongeye amasezerano ya Azira nyuma y'igihembwe cyo muri 2015. Azira yinjiye mu mushinga wa MLS Waiver mu Kuboza 2015 kandi yatoranijwe ni kipe ya Colorado Rapids. Azira yagurishijwe na Rapids ku ya 8 Kanama 2018 yerekeza i Montreal Impinduka zo mu cyiciro cya kane cyatoranijwe muri MLS SuperDraft muri 2020. Azira yongeye kugurishwa muri Kanama 2019, kuri iyi nshuro kuri Chicago. Amasezerano yagiranye niyi kipe yarangiye mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2020.
Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2021, Azira yasinyanye na USL Champiyona ya Mexico.

Assani Bajope (yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1982) numupira wamaguruukomoka muri Uganda.
Bajope akina nk'umukinnyi ukina hagati mu kibuga, Bajope yakiniye umujyi wa Kampala, mu ikkipe ya City Council FC mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Saint-George SA yo muri Etiyopiya muri Nyakanga 2006.
Yabaye kandi umwe mu bagize ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’igihugu cya Uganda akaba yarahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu inshuro zirenga 20, kuva 2003 – 2008.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo byerekana igitego cya Uganda mbere."

Timothy Batabaire (yavutse ku ya 25 Kanama 1981) ni myugariro mu mupira wamaguru ukomoka i Iganga muri uganda.
Batabaire yari yatangiye gukina mu 1999 na SC Villa aho yagumye kugeza shampiyona irangiye 2003. Nyuma yimukiye i Burayi gukina umwaka umwe muri Shampiyona ya kabiri ya Seribiya na Montenegoro, hamwe n’ikipe ya Seribiya OFK Niš, hagati y’ibiruhuko byo mu itumba ryo mu 2003–04 na 2004–05. Kuva mu 2005, yakinnye muri Afurika y'Epfo na Bloemfontein Celtic aho yakinnyeimikino itanu ikomeye mbere yo kwimuka, mu mpeshyi 2009, yerekeza mu yindi kipe yo muri Afurika y'Epfo, Bidvest Wits. Ku ya 19 Kanama 2014, yimukiye mu ikipe ya Garankuwa FC yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’igihugu cya Afurika yepfo
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Batabaire yabayeumukinnyi w'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda kuva mu 2000.

Shafik Bhuchu Batambuze (wavutse 14 Kamena 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru aka ari mpuzamahangaukomoka muri Uganda ukinira Gor Mahia yo muri Kenya nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibibuga.
Batambuze yakiniye amakipe atandukanye nka Simba, Urubyiruko rwa Muhoroni, SC Villa, Western Stima, Sofapaka, Tusker na Singida United.
Yatangiye gukinira amarushanwa mpuzamahanga muri 2016, kandi yashyizwe mu ikipe yitabiriye imikino yi gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika muri 2017.

Bayo Aziz Fahad ni umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira MFK Vyškov muri shampiyona yi gihugu cya Ceki. Bayo yakinnye ku rwego mpuzamahanga akomoka muri Uganda.
Umwuga w'urubyiruko.
Bayo niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi mu marushanwa ya bibigo bya mashuri y'isumbuye muri Uganda mu marushanwa ya Copa Coca Cola muri 2014. Yatsinze ibitego 11.
Yinjiye muri Proline FC mu 2014 afite imyaka 16. Yakinnye imikino 25 atsinda ibitego 16 muri shampiyona yo muri 2015–16 ya shampiyona ya kabiri ikomeye muri Uganda.
Imikinireye ye yagize uruhare mu kuzamura Proline FC muri shampiyona ya Uganda.
Muri shampiyona ya 2016–17, yatsindiye Proline ibitego bitandatu. Yakinnye imikino 18.
Bayo yakinnye kimwe cya kabiri cya shampiyona yo muri Uganda muri 2017-18. Yatsinze ibitego bitandatu mu mikino 14 ya shampiyona. yahise ajya mu ikipe yo muri Zambiya ya Buildcon FC mu gusoza shampiyona.
Ku myaka 18, Bayo yinjiye muri ikipe ya Zambiya Buildcon FC muri Mutarama 2018. Yatsinze ibitego icyenda kandi atanga imipira yavuyemo esheshatu mu mikino 16.
Ku ya 27 Nyakanga 2020 yasinywe mu ikipe yo muri Isiraheli yitwa FC Ashdod.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Werurwe 2018, Bayo yakiriye guhamagarwa mu ikipe nkuru y'igihugu ya Uganda n'umutoza Sebastien Desabre mu kiruhuko mpuzamahanga. Bayo yakinnye mumikino yombi ya gicuti na Sao Tome na Malawi.

Alexis David Bbakka (yavutse ku ya 13 Nzeri 1995) ni umukinnyi w umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere asatira izamu mu ikipe ya Ettan Fotboll mu kipe ya Umeå ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda. Yavukiye muri Suwede, akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.

Giosue Ebong Bellagambi (yavutse ku ya 8 Ugushyingo 2001) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukina nk'umuzamu w'ikipe ya Huddersfield Town yo mu Bwongereza, ariko atizwa mu ikipe yu mujyi wa Salford. Yavukiye mu Bwongereza, akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Bellagambi ni gicuruzwa cy'urubyiruko rwa Lambeth Tigers FC na Whyteleafe, y'imukira mu ishuri ry’urubyiruko rwa Huddersfield Town muri 2018. Ku ya 6 Kanama 2020, yasinye amasezerano ye ya mbere y'umwuga na Huddersfield Town. Yatangiye umwuga we ari mu ntizanyo ya Ramsbottom United mu Gushyingo 2020, aho yakinnye imikino 4. bamutiza bwa kabiri yari kumwe na Ebbsfleet United, yarangiye muri Werurwe 2021. Yarasigarany ukwezi kumwe kwa masezerano na Stalybridge Celtic muri Kanama 2021 nyuma yo gukira imvune y'urutoki. Ku ya 27 Ukuboza 2021, yinjiye mu mujyi wa Brighouse ku ntizanyo y'iminsi 28. Mushiki we nawe ni Viola Bellaganbi
Ku ya 26 Mutarama 2022, yongereye amasezerano mu mujyi wa Huddersfield kugeza mu 2024. Ku ya 8 Kanama 2022, yimukiye muri Hyde United ku ntizanyo y'amezi atatu. Ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2022, intizanyo ye yagabanijwe na Huddersfield. Bukeye, yasinyiye intizanyo muri shampiyona y'Amajyaruguru ya Spennymoor Town ku ntizanyo yo kugeza ku ya 2 Mutarama 2023.
SIBLINGS Giosue Bellagambi afite na mushiki we witwa Viola bellagambi nawe ari mu myitozo yo kuba umukinnyi wu mupira w'amaguru nkuko murumuna we sutton yunze ubumwe kuva 2017 kandi n'ubu aracyabikora
Inguzanyo yo mu mujyi wa Salford.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2023, Bellagambi yinjiye muri EFL League Ikipe ya Salford City ku nguzanyo kugeza shampiyona irangiye 2022-23.

Herbert Bockhorn (wavutse 31 Mutarama 1995) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina iburyo kuruhande kuri 2. Bundesliga ikipe ya 1. FC Magdeburg.
Umwuga w'urubyiruko.
Bockhorn yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru muri TSV Melsdorf na FC Kilia Kiel mbere yo kwinjira mu rubyiruko rwa Werder Bremen aho yakiniye amakipe ari munsi yimwaka 17 na 19.
Werder Bremen III, II na SC Wiedenbrück 2000.
Bockhorn yinjiye mu ikipe ya Werder Bremen ya kabiri mu ikipe ya bari munsi ya 19. Yatangiye umukino we wa mbere ku ya 27 Kanama 2014 na SG Aumund-Vegesack. Ku ya 21 Nzeri 2014, Bockhorn yakinnye umukino we wa mbere na Werder Bremen bahanganye na TSV Havelse. Bockhorn yinjiye muri SC Wiedenbrück 2000 kuva Werder Bremen II. Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere ku ya 1 Kanama 2015 yakinnye na Rot-Weiss Essen.
Borussia Dortmund II.
Bockhorn yinjiye muri Borussia Dortmund II mu 2016. Yatangiye gukina bwa mbere ku ya 12 Kanama 2016 na Rot-Weiß Oberhausen. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere ku ya 27 Kanama 2017 na Borussia Mönchengladbach II. Bockhorn yakiniye ikipe nkuru ya Borussia Dortmund inshuro ebyiri: ku ya 22 Nyakanga 2018 kuri Stade ya Banki ya Amerika. Yakinnye na Liverpool mugihe cy'igikombe mpuzamahanga.
Umujyi wa Huddersfield.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, Bockhorn yimukiye mu ikipe ya Huddersfield Town yo mu Bwongereza, ahura n'umutoza Jan Siewert, wari watoje Bockhorn mu gihe cye na Borussia Dortmund. Ku ya 13 Kanama 2019, Bockhorn yerekeje bwa mbere mu mujyi wa Huddersfield, mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'igikombe cya EFL yakinnye na Lincoln City. Icyakora, ku ya 16 Kanama, Siewert yarirukanwe; Serivisi za Bockhorn ntizakunzwe n’umuyobozi mushya Danny Cowley, maze ava muri iyo kipe shampiyona irangiye, atagaragara muri shampiyona.
Muri Nyakanga 2020 Bockhorn yasinyanye amasezerano yumwaka na VfL Bochum.

Tenywa "T-Bone" Bonseu (yavutse ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1976) ni umupira w'amaguru mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru, ukomoka i Kampala muri uganda, w'akinnye imyaka icyenda y'umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga muri Amerika.
abatabigize umwuga na kaminuza.
Bonseu yatangiye umwuga we akinira Horizon FC mu gihugu cye cya Uganda, mbere yo kuza muri Amerika mu 1997 kwitabira no gukina umupira w'amaguru muri kaminuza ya Martin Methodiste College yo mu cyaro cya Tennessee nyuma yo gukora igeragezwa n'ikipe yo mu Buyapani muri shampiyona ya J.
Bonseu yinjiye muri Pittsburgh Riverhounds ya muri shampiyona ya A mu 1999 akinayo ibihe bibiri, mbere yo gusinyana na Shampiyona nkuru y'umupira w'amaguru wa Chicago Fire. Bonseu yagiye kumara ibihe byinshi muri MLS, akina na Columbus Crew mu 2001, Dallas Burn mu 2002 na 2003, na MetroStars yaguze Tenywa muri Dallas kwa Steve Jolley mbere ya shampiyona yo muri 2004. Mu bihe bitanu muri MLS, Bonseu yakinnye muri shampiyona isanzwe 87 n'imikino 11 yo gukina (gutangira byose uretse bitatu).
Nyuma yo kurekurwa na MetroStars, Bonseu yakinnye ibihe bine na Rochester Rhinos mu cyiciro cya mbere cya USL kuva 2005 kugeza 2008, mbere yo gusinyira Pittsburgh Riverhounds mu 2009.
Bonseu yari umwe mu bakinnyi bato batoranijwe kugaragara mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda. Afite imikino 21 muri Uganda.

Ivan Bukenya (wavutse 1 Ugushyingo 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda. Bukenya yahoze akinira FC Linkoping City, na Erbil FC muri Iraki, Abayobozi ba Kaizer muri Afurika y'Epfo na Bengal y'Iburasirazuba FC yo mu Buhinde.
Bukenya yatangiye urugendo rwe rw'umupira w'amaguru muri Nyakanga 2007 ubwo yasuraga Rio Ferdinand. Yakiniraga ikipe ya Coca-Cola y'ahisemo urubyiruko rwatojwe na Mike Mutebi hamwe na Ibrahim Juma, Andrew Buteera na Dennis Guma aho bakinanye n'abasore ba Proline FC. Kuba ku ruhande rwa Coca-Cola byari ukwemeza inyenyeri igenda ikura ari Bukenya kandi yaje gusinyira ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda. Ferdinand yashimishijwe cyane n'impano zerekanwa kugirango akore muri Proline y'abato, Bukenya yari mu rwego rwo kujya mu Bwongereza no gukina imikino n’impande z’ishuri rya Manchester na West Ham mu Kwakira uwo mwaka. Yatsinze ibitego burigihe muri shampiyona ya Uganda kandi yagaragajwe nk’iterabwoba mu kirere mu gihe cyo gutera imigeri no ku busa kuri Proline FC. Umukino wa Bukenya gusoma hamwe n'ubushobozi bwo kwimurira umupira hejuru cyane twavuga ko ari imwe mu mbaraga zikomeye mu ikipe ya Mujib Kasule, aho yaciye.

Ikiyaga cya Cyabayaga ni ikiyaga gihangano cyo mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Akarere ka Nyagatare. Cyashyizweho mu mwaka wa 2004.
Amazi y'Ikiyaga cya Cyabayaga yuhira umuceri. Ikiyaga kirororerwamo amafi. Kibangamiwe n'amarebe n'isuri.
Ikiyaga cya Cyabayaga kiri mu kagari ka Cyabayaga. Cyashyizweho mu mwaka wa 2004. Kibika amazi y'imirima y'umuceri. Iyo Umuvumba wuzuye, ikiyaga kigabanya amazi ajya mu mirima.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, hashinzwe koperative y'abarobyi. Iyo koperative ishinzwe kurinda ikiyaga no kukororeramo amafi. Mu mwaka wa 2014, yari ifite abanyamuryango 72.
Ikiyaga cya Cyabayaga gifite ubuso bwa hegitari zigera kuri 40. Ubwo buso bugabanuka iyo amazi ari make.
Amazi y'ikiyaga yuhira umuceri w'amakoperative atatu y'abahinzi. Uwo muceri uhingwa ku buso bwa hegitari 600.
Mbere y'umwaka wa 2014, koperative y'abarobyi yasaruraga ibiro 400 by'amafi ku kwezi. Muri Mata 2014, amarebe aturuka mu Muvumba yakwiriye hafi ikiyaga cyose. Kuva icyo gihe, umusaruro w'amafi warahagaze.
Muri Mata 2018, isuri yasibye ikiyaga. Ikiyaga nticyari kigishobora kubika amazi. Mu mwaka wa 2019, RAB yatanze imashini zo gukuramo itaka.
Mu mwaka wa 2025, ikiyaga cyari hafi gukama. Imyuzure yari yangije imiyoboro izana amazi y'Umuvumba.

Keita Buwanika (yavutse kuya 16 ukuboza 2002) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru mu buyapani, ukina kuruhande mu ikipe ya JEF Chiba. yavukiye i Tokiyo ise akomoka muri uganda nyina akaba umu yapanikazi.

Elvis Okello Bwomono (yavutse 29 Ugushyingo 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi w'inyuma wa ÍBV.
Urubyiruko na Southend.
Bwomono yavukiye muri Uganda kugeza afite imyaka itatu. Bwomomo yaje kwimukira i Londres aho yize kuri Hatch End High School. Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umukinnyi ukiri muto muri Queens Park Rangers, nyuma aza kwinjira muri Southend afite imyaka 14.
Atangiye gukinira Southend batsinze Gillingham ibitego 2–1 mu gikombe cya EFL yo mu majyepfo ya 2017 B ku ya 29 Kanama 2017. Mu Kwakira 2017, yasinye amasezerano ye yambere y'umwuga niyi kipe.
Nyuma yo gusezererwa, Bwomono yanze amasezerano mashya yanga gukinira iyi kipe, nubwo yagize uruhare rwe mu gusezerera iyi kipe. Nyuma yaje kuva muri Southend.
Muri Gicurasi 2022, Bwomono yinjiye muri Besta-deild karla sideBV.
Bwomono yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Uganda mu Gushyingo 2020 aho bakinaga na Sudani y'Amajyepfo.

Bobosi Byaruhanga (wavutse ku ya 3 Ukuboza 2001) ni umukinnyi w’umupira w'amaguru uvuka muri Uganda usanzwe ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya Austin FC II yo muri Amerika, ku nguzanyo ya Vyškov.
Byaruhanga yatangiye umwuga we muri Vipers, agenda atera imbere muri iryo shuri, aza gutwara ibikombe bibiri bya shampiyona ndetse n’umukinnyi w’umwaka wa 2021 Airtel FUFA. Muri Kamena 2022, yari afite kuva muri iyo kipe, maze muri Kanama 2022, yimukira muri Repubulika ya Ceki, yinjira mu ikipe ya Vyškov yo mu gihugu cya Ceki.
Muri Mutarama 2023, yimukiye mu ikipe ya Amerika Austin FC II ku ntizanyo yi gihembwe, aho ashobora no kugurwa.

Peter Byaruhanga (yavutse 18 Kanama 1979) ni Uganda wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru wa babigize umwuga, ukora muri Amerika, wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Byaruhanga yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda kandi afite ubwenegihugu bubiri bw'Abanyamerika na Uganda.
Byaruhanga yakiniye UAB Blazers muri shampiyona ya 1998 na 1999.
Muri Gashyantare 2000, ikipe ya Kansas City bahisemo Byaruhanga mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya 2000 MLS SuperDraft. Yigaragaje inshuro esheshatu mu bihembwe bibiri. Muri Gicurasi 2000, Kansas bohereje Byaruhanga ku ntizanyo muri Raleigh Express mu mikino itanu. Mu 2001, yagiye mu ntizanyo muri Atlanta Silverbacks. Ku ya 18 Kamena 2001, Kansas baretse Byaruhanga. Ku ya 6 Nyakanga 2001, yasinyanye na Richmond Kickers. Mu 2002, yakiniye Cincinnati Riverhawks ndetse na Carolina Dynamo yo muri USL D3-Pro muri shampiyona. Muri 2009, yakiniye Rocket City.

Igishanga cya Cyabayaga cyashyizweho mu mwaka wa 2004, gifasha mu gukamura amazi ari mu muceri no kuyagabanya mu mirima.
Ibyo wamenya kugishanga cya Cyabayaga.
Igishanga cya Cyabayaga gifite ubuso bwa hegitari zigera kuri 40 ariko zikaba zigabanuka bitewe n’amazi iyo yabaye make. Uretse amarebe ashobora gutuma kigira ikibazo ngo n’abahinga mu nkengero zacyo nabo bahinga bashyiramo ibitaka kimwe n’amatungo acyuhirwaho.Mu mwaka 2014 batewe n’amarebe aturuka mu mugezi w’umuvumba hamwe n’umucanga muri icyoguhe nta musaruro w’amafi bakibonaga kandi imbaraga zabo zari zimaze gukendera.Bavugaga ko bakeneye guterwa inkunga yo gukuramo ayo marebe bakareba ko bakongera kurya ku ifi no kwinjiza amafaranga ayikomokaho.Ubuyobozi bw’akagari ka Cyabayaga bwavugaga ko iki kibazo bwakimenye kandi bwiteguraga kugira icyo bwafasha mu kugikemura.Bavugaga ko bagiye kwifashisha umuganda w’abaturage bagakuramo aya marebe, ariko na none bakanahuza koperative y’abahinzi b’umuceri icunga amazi ajya muri iki kiyaga ndetse na koperative Cyabayaga Fishing y’aborozi b’amafi.Cooperative yakoreragamo ubworozi bw’amafi yari igizwe n’abanyamuryango 72. Mbere ngo amarebe ataraza muri icyo kiyaga bari bageze ku musaruro w’ibiro 400 by’amafi ku kwezi aho ikiro cy’ifi cyagurwaga amafaranga y’u Rwanda hagati Igihumbi magana atanu (1500) n'Iguhumbi magana abiri (1200).

Elio Capradossi (wavutse ku ya 11 Werurwe 1996) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nku mukinnyi ukina hagati muri ikipe ya Cagliari muri shampiyona ya seri B Yavukiye muri Uganda, ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga mu Butaliyani.
Capradossi ni umwe mubazamukiye mu ishuri ryurubyiruko rya roma. Yatsindiye muri Shampiyona y'Ubutaliyani yabatarengeje imyaka 19 muri 2015–2016 hamwe n'ikipe ya batarengeje imyaka 19 ya Roma nka kapiteni w'ikipe.
Mu mpeshyi 2016 yagurijwe muri Bari muri Seri B. Yatangiye shampiyona ku ya 24 Nzeri 2016 akina nk'umukinnyi wa tangiye umukino na Benevento kuri Stadio San Nicola. Muri Mutarama 2018, nyuma y'igihembwe ni gice yamaze i Bari, asubira i Roma.
Ku ya 6 Gicurasi 2018, yakinnye bwa mbere na Roma mu mukino yatsinze Cagliari 1-0 hanze aho yakinnye mu 11 bantangiye mu kibuga.
Ku ya 20 Nyakanga 2018, Capradossi yasinyiye ikipe ya Spezia yo muri Seri B ku nguzanyo kugeza ku ya 30 Kamena 2019.
Ku ya 1 Kanama 2019, Capradossi yasinyanye na Seri B ikipe ya Spezia ku masezerano y'imyaka ine.
Muri Kanama 2019, Capradossi yaguzwe na Spezia Calcio naho muri Nyakanga 2020 agira imvune ikomeye y’imitsi yimbere yabujije ibikorwa bye byo gukina mugi cya mezi icumi yakurikiye. Ku ya 23 Gicurasi 2021, umukino wa Speziana Roma kugaruka muri Seri A nyuma y'imyaka itatu.
Ku ya 1 Nzeri 2022, Capradossi yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri na Cagliari.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Hamwe n’Ubutaliyani yabatarengeje imyaka 17 yitabiriye Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 17 ya UEFA ndetse no mu gikombe cyisi cya FIFA yabatarengeje 17 muri 2013.

Abel Dhaira (9 Nzeri 1987 - 27 Werurwe 2016) yari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, akaba yari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda wakinnye nk'umuzamu. akaba yarakinnye inshuro 13 mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Dhaira yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda, Congo na Isilande muri Express, URA, AS Vita (ubwo yinjiye mu Kuboza kwa 2009 ku madolari ya Amerika 22.000) na ÍBV. Yarekuwe n'ikipe ya Simba SC yo muri Tanzaniya mu Kuboza 2013.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Dhaira yakinnye bwa mbere muri Uganda mu 2009. Yatwaye ibikombe bitatu bya CECAFA muri 2009, 2011 na 2012. Mu gikombe cya CECAFA muri 2012 yajyanywe mu bitaro nyuma yo kugongana n'umukinnyi bari bahanganye.
Mu 2015, Dhaira bamusanganye kanseri yo mu nda hanyuma abagwa muri Uganda mu Kuboza uwo mwaka. Yasubiye muri Isilande muri Mutarama 2016 aho yongeye kwivuriza. Icyakora, kanseri yari yarakwirakwiriye mu mubiri we maze ku ya 27 Werurwe 2016, apfa azize indwara mu bitaro bya kaminuza nkuru ya Isilande, afite imyaka 28.

Patrick Lechi Edema (wavutse 27 Kanama 1992) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ukomokamuri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Eléctrico.
Yatangiye umwuga wogukina muri Segunda Liga muri Beira-Mar ku ya 31 Kanama 2014 mu mukino yakinnye na Sporting B.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yaserukiye Uganda yabatarengeje imyaka 20 muri Shampiyona ya CECAFA yabatarengeje imyaka 20 muri 2010.

Impano Fred (yavutse ku ya 21 Nyakanga 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka i Masindi muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya SC Villa yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda ndetse n'ikipe yigihugu ya Uganda.
Muri Kanama 2021, gift yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka itatu na ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda yitwa SC Villa. Mbere yo gusinyira Villa, yakinnye mu cyiciro cya gatatu cya Booma FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ukuboza 2022, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic yamutumije kwinjira mu ikipe nkuru y’umupira wamaguru y’igihugu cya Uganda mu marushanwa y'ibihugu yo muri2022 yabeye muri Alijeriya. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere mu mukino wa gicuti wahuje Uganda na Mali birangira banganyije 0-0 muri Tunusiya. Yatangiye gukinira ku mugaragaro mu marushanwa ya Shampiyona y’Afurika muri 2022 ubwo Uganda yanganyaga na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ku ya 14 Mutarama 2023 kuri Stade Annaba muri Alijeriya.

Paul Edwin Hasule (20 Ugushyingo 1959 - 26 Mata 2004) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda. Yabaye kapiteni n'umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda (uzwi ku izina rya "The Cranes"). Yari amaze imyaka 25 yitabira ikipe yi gihugu nk'umukinnyi n'umutoza. Paul Edwin Hasule yavutse 1959 kuri John Haumba Kango na Petwa wa Murandu Mbale. Yashimishijwe cyane no kuba rutahizamu igihe yari muri kaminuza ya Tororo na nyuma ya kaminuza ya Makerere, umwuga we muto muri Mbale Intwari niwo w'amugize umutungo ukomeye mu mupira w'amaguru wa Uganda.
Kwinjira muri Villa.
Byahindutse ubwo yinjiraga muri SC Villa mu Gushyingo 1981. Ibyo byaje nyuma yo gusezera kw'intwari, kandi yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya Villa na Nile FC mu gikombe cya Jesse Owens cyabereye kuri Stade ya Nakivubo muri 1981.
Uyu musore w'imyaka 22 yageze muri parike ya Villa ari kumwe na basirikare bakuru nka Jimmy Kirunda, umutoza wa Cranes, Dan Lutalo, Godfrey Kisitu na Fred Serwadda. Ku ikubitiro, umutoza wa Villa, George Mukasa, yahaye Hasule gukina iburyo ariko ntiyabyemera kandi yitwaye nabi igihe yahindurwaga ku mwanya wo hagati.
Umurage wa ikipe na Cranes wari wararenganye.
Afite imyaka 44, yapfiriye mu bitaro bya Mulago muri 2004, urupfu rwateye amarira menshi akarere, abayoboke be bamuhaye icyubahiro cya nyuma mu buryo bwo gushyingura mu buryo bukwiye, binjira mu kwishyura amafaranga yo gushyingura harimo no kugura isanduku yashyinguwemo mu ibendera ry'igihugu mu cyubahiro cye akwiye.

Ikibaya cya Bugarama gifite ubuso busaga hegitari 1500 buhingwamo umuceri.
Igishanga cya Bugarama ni kimwe mu binini biri mu Rwanda bikorerwaho ubuhinzi, aho kingana na hegitari 1 500. Umusaruro w’abahinzi bo muri iki gishanga ugurwa n’inganda enye zitonora umuceri
Mu kibaya cya Bugarama ni hamwe mu hakunze gukorerwa imirimo y’ubucuruzi bunyuranye kandi bukitabirwa n’abanyamahanga barimo n’abo mu gihugu cy’u Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.

Denis Iguma ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muriUganda usanzwe ukina nka myugariro wa KCCA FC hamwe n'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ku ya 29 Werurwe 2012 ubwo bakinaga n'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Misiri. Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kuba mu ikipe y’umupira wamaguru y’igihugu cya Uganda muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke. Muri 2017, yashyizwe mu bakinnyi 23 bari kujya mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika muri 2017.

Isaac Isinde (wavutse ku ya 16 Mata 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa Uganda kuri ubu ukinira Hadiya Hossana nk'umukinnyi ukina hagati. Yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Jinja, igihangange cya siporo mu burasirazuba bwa Uganda; aho yari asanzwe akora. Yatsindiye ibikombe 4 muri shampiyona, muri Etiyopiya ndetse n’ibikombe 2 bya FA bya Etiyopiya mu myaka 5 yakoranye na Saint George.
Isaac yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu Nama Iganga Town Council, Simba, Victors yo muri Uganda, Saint George muri Etiyopiya, Buildcon FC muri Zambiya, na TRAU FC mu Buhinde.
Isaac yerekeje muri Buildcon FC nyuma yo kurangiza amasezerano yagiranye na St. George yo muri Etiyopiya, iminsi mike kugeza ku mukino w'anyuma w'igikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu aho yari muri Uganda, Isaac yatangiye gukinira Buildcon FC na TP Mazembe. Sitade Mwanawasa, Ndola, Isinde igaragara inyuma iburyo. Yatangiye bwa mbere muri shampiyona ya Zambiya ku ya 8 Mata 2017 na Real Nakonde FC maze umukino urangira banganyije 0-0.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Isinde yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mpuzamahanga n'ikipe nkuru y'igihugu ku ya 3 Werurwe 2010 muri Tanzaniya (2–3), aho yakinnye umukino wose. Ubu asanzwe mu ikipe y'igihugu yashyizweho kuva mu 2013 kandi ku myaka 25 y'amavuko yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu inshuro 55.

Katende Jerome Raymond (yavutse 29 Nzeri 1987) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muriUganda wahoze akinira ikipe ya Universiti Sains Maleziya yo muri Maleziya. Nubwo ahanini akina nk'umukinnyi w'ibumoso, ashobora gukina nka rutahizamu, umuvuduko ukaba ikimuranga nyamukuru.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina n’ikipe ya SC Villa yo muri Uganda mu 2003, arangije amashuri yisumbuye, maze agaragara muri iyi kipe 45, mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya bapolisi bo muri Uganda mu 2006. Nyuma yo kwigaragaza 27 hamwe na Polisi yatsinze ibitego 18, ikipe ya Uganda Revenue Authority SC yo muri Uganda yaramushimye maze yinjiramo muri 2007. Mu myaka 2 yakoranye na URA yakinnye imikino 25 muri iyi kipe, mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Omani yo muri shampiyona ikipeya Al Nasrin 2009. Nyuma y'umwaka mwiza muri Omani, yinjiye muri shampiyona yo muri Maleziya ya Universiti Sains Malaysia Staff FC aho akina ubu.

Ibrahim Sadam Juma (wavutse 1 Ukwakira 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga ukomoka muri Uganda uherutse gukinira hagati mu kibuga muri sahmpiyona ya Uganda mu ikipe ya KCCA FC. Azwiho guhanga, intera yo gutambutsa no kurangiza umukira mu izamu, ni n'inzobere mu kwirukana ubusa. Juma yafashwe na Uganda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Mu busore bwe, Juma yakinnye muri Kampala Kids. Yabaye umukinnyi w'ingenzi mu ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya gikombe cya Tivoli na Gothia mu 2003 yatsinze ibitego 25 mu mikino 13 mu marushanwa aheruka - ndetse na Tivoli Cup umwaka wakurikiyeho. Yafashije iyi kipe kongera gutwara igikombe cya Tivoli - igikombe cya karindwi muri rusange - mu 2008 ubwo yatsindaga ikipe ya Danemarike Hillerod 6–0 ku mukino wa nyuma.
Juma yatangiye umwuga we mukuru mu ikipe ya Isthmian League Cray Wanderers. Nyuma yimyitwarire ishimishije kubakinnyi Juma yahamagawe mu makipe y'ambere arangije atangira gukinira muri Corinthian Casuals. Umusanzu ukomeye wa Juma muri Cray Wanderers ni ugutsinda igitego kubusa cyatsinzwe na Simon Osborn bigatuma Cray Wanderers atsindara imikino ya nyuma bityo akazamurwa mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho. Juma yagiye gukina inshuro 4 gusa kuri Cray Wanderers.
Yakuriye i Luzira, mu nkengero za Kampala.

Murushid Juuko (wavutse 14 Mata 1994) ni ukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina mu kibuga hagati muri Express FC.
Juuko yavukiye Entebbe, mu Karere ka Wakiso. Yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu makipe yo muri Uganda Bunamwaya na SC Victoria University mbere yo kwerekeza muri Tanzaniya gukinira Simba.
Juuko yinjiye muri Express FC muri 2020 ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2014, Juuko yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ("Cranes") bakina n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Seychelles. aho Ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda yatsinze igitego 1-0.
Juuko yayoboye Cranes k'umukino y'ambere yokujya mu gikombe cya Afrika kuva 1978. Yari mu ikipe yatsinze Comoros 1-0 kugirango ijye mu mukino wanyuma wa 2017 muri Gaboni. Amaze kubura umukino ubanza na Gana kubera guhagarikwa mugihe cya majonjora yakinnye iminota 180 yakinnye na Misiri na Mali.
Mu gikombe cy’Afurika cya 2019 Juuko yakinnye imikino ibiri, iyambere yakinnye na Congo indi ikina na Senegali nyuma yo gukomereka. Uganda "Cranes" yagarukiye mu cyiciro cya 16.

Joseph Kabagambe (wavutse ku ya 3 Nzeri 1984) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Al-Nil Al-Hasahesa yo muri Sudani, nka rutahizamu.
Yavukiye mu gace ka Mubare, mu Karere ka Kabale, Kabagambe yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru ku mpande zaho, mbere yo kwinjira muri Horizon FC muri 2000. Kabagambe yakinnye umupira wamaguru mu Rwanda na Sudani.

Savio Kabugo (wavutse 20 Mutarama 1995) ni ukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda kuri ubu ukinira jwaneng galaxy fc yo muri botswana.
Savio yakinnye umupira we mu makipe atandukanye nka Victoria University SC, KCCA FC, URA FC kuri ubu akina muri Proline FC.
Kaminuza ya Victoriya.
Nyuma yo kwitwara neza muri shampiyona ya Fufa, mu Igikombe cya Uganda ndetse no muri Uganda, Savio yahaye amahirwe yo kugerageza muri Bidvest Wits muri Kamena 2013. Muri Nzeri 2014 ubwo yari mu ikipe y'igihugu Savio Kabugo yagize imvune mu mukino wa nyuma w'amakipe mu 2014 wari mu Kuboza na Bright Stars, yashoboye gukina nyuma yo gufata ibituma ububabare bugabanuka.
Muri Mutarama 2015, Savio yinjiye mu Kampala City Council Savio Kabugo yari mu bakinnyi ba KCCA FC bagize impanuka ubwo yerekezaga i Ntungamo mbere y’igikombe cya nyuma cya Ugandamuri 2015 na SC Villa.
Ku ya 4 Ukuboza 2015, Savio Kabugo yasinyiye URA FC ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe. Kabugo yakinnye imikino itandatu, URA yatsinzwe na Express FC ibitego 2-1 muri Werurwe 2016 niwo mukino we wa nyuma muri URA FC.
Muri Kanama 2016, Savio Kabugo yinjiye mu ikipe y’umupira wamaguru ya Proline Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2016, Savio Kabugo yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu ikipe y’umupira wamaguru ya Proline bakina na Sadolin FC kuri Stade Kyabazinga i Bugembe.
Ukuboza 2018, Savio yinjiye mu ikipe ya AS Vita avuye muri SC Villa ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu.
Ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2019, Savio yimukiye mu ikipe ya Etiyopiya Sebeta City.
Savio Kabugo yabuze ababyeyi be bombi akiri muto. Ni mubyara wa Ivan Bukenya, wakinnye umupira wamaguru muri Uganda wahoze akinira Kaizer Chiefs muri Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru muri Afrika yepfo.

Patrick Henry Kaddu (wavutse ku ya 9 Ukwakira 1995) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi ukina mu b'imbere muri RS Berkane muri shampiyona ya Botola Maroke Telecom muri Maroke, ndetse no mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda "Cranes".

Youssoufia Berrechid.

Umwuga mpuzamahanga.

Ku ya 12 Kamena 2019, Kaddu yashyizwe mu bakinnyi 23 ba Uganda mu gikombe cy’Afurika cya 2019 mu Misiri. Ku ya 22 Kamena 2019, yatsinze ibitego 2-0 itsinze umukino wa mbere yatsinze Congo.

Umwuga mpuzamahanga.

Derrick Kakooza (wavutse ku ya 23 Ukwakira 2002) upima metero imwe na sanimetero mirongo inani neshantu (1.85cm) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda kuri ubu ukina nku mukinnyi ukina mu b'imbere mu ikipe ya ENPPI yo mu Misiri.
Kakooza wavukiye i Kampala, yatangiye umwuga we mu ishuri rya Polisi rya Naguru, mbere yo kwinjira muri Polisi Kampala. Amaze kuzamurwa mu ikipe ya mbere hamwe na Polisi,yagize ibihe byiza mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2021 mu batarengeje imyaka 20 byatumye yerekeza mu ikipe yo mububiligi ya Anderlecht. Imyitwarire ye ya shampiyona nayo yari mwiza, yatsinze ibitego umunani mu mikino cumi n'umunani muri shampiyona ebyiri.
Nyuma yo kwimukira muri Anderlecht, Kakooza yarangije kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Valmiera yo muri Lativiya mu ntangiriro zo muri 2022 avuye muri Polisi FC.
Amaze gukina umukino umwe mu gikombe cya Finilande na KuPS, Kakooza yasinyiye ikipe ya ENPPI yo mu Misiri muri Mutarama 2023.

Alex Kakuba (wavutse 12 Kamena 1991)ni umukinnnyi wumupira w'amaguru ukpmoka muriUganda kuri ubu ukinira CD Cova da Piedade.
Kakuba yatangiye umwuga we muri Proline FC. Yavuye muri Proline FC mu mpeshyi ya 2012, yimukira ku buntu mu ikipe yo mu cyiciro cya kane muri Porutugali ikipe ya Esperança Lagos. Muri Mutarama 2013, yinjiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri cyitwa Covilhã, yakinnye imikino 50 ya shampiyona bibiri. Ku ya 14 Kamena 2014, Kakuba yimukiye muri Estoril Praia muri Primeira Liga, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka ine.
Kakuba yasinye imyaka 2 muri PAS Giannina muri Nyakanga 2018. Yarekuwe ku buntu ku ya 10 Ukuboza 2018.
Ku ya 27 Werurwe 2019, Kakuba yasinyiye ikipe ya Lori FC. Muri Kamena 2019, yinjiye mu ikipe ya CD Cova da Piedade yo muri Porutugali.

Kalungi Edward (wavutse ku ya Ukwakira 1977)ni umugande wasezeye gukina umupira w'amaguru wa babigize umwuga, ukina nka myugariromu ikipe y'igihugu muri 1993 kugeza 2003.
Kalungi yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Express FC ya Uganda, Shinas FC yomuri Omani, Hue FC yomuri Viyetinamu, Reba E San FC (Tayilande), Al-Wasl FC (mubarabu), na Sulut United FC yo muri Indoneziya. Yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2010.
Kalungi yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 3 Nzeri 1993 bakina na Tanzaniya. Kalungi yatsinze igitego cya mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 2000 n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Somaliya mu gikombe cya CECAFA muri 2000.
Umwuga nyuma yumupira wamaguru.
Muri 2013, Kalungi yatorewe kuba intumwa y'ishyirahamwe ry'abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda. Ukuboza 2018, Kalungi yagizwe umukozi muri FUFA, ishami rishinzwe kugenzura ibikorwa remezo by’umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda.

Henry Kalungi (wavutse ku ya 25 Ugushyingo 1987) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uvuka i Kampala muri Uganda.
Kalungi yavuye mu gihugu cya Uganda yerekeza muri Amerika mu 2006 kugira ngo yige kandi akina umupira w'amaguru muri kaminuza ya Winthrop. Yakinnye imikino 56 muri Winthrop mu myaka itatu yamaze muri yo kaminuza, yiswe ikipe ya MVP yo mu 2006, kandi ahabwa Ikipe ya Big South All-Tournament Team na NSCAA / adidas All-South Atlantic Region Team.
Kalungi yakinnye na Hampton Roads Piranhas na Fredericksburg Gunners muri USL Premier Development League, yashyizwe mu itsinda rya makipe yabaye aya mbere muri 2008.
Kalungi yatoranijwe mu cyiciro cya kane (53 muri rusange) ya MLS SuperDraft yo mu 2009 na Colorado Rapids, ariko ntabwo yahawe amasezerano niyi kipe. Nyuma yaje gusinyana na Richmond Kickers yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri muri USL, maze atangira umwuga we ku ya 18 Mata 2009 mu mukino wa Richmond wabahuje urangira ari 2-2 na Harrisburg City Island. Yagumanye na Richmond mu bihe byo uri 2009, 2010, na 2011. Iyi kipe yongeye kumusinyisha muri shampiyona yo muri 2012 ku ya 22 Nzeri 2011.
Kalungi yatijwe muri Proline FC yo muri shampiyona yaUganda ku ya 3 Ukwakira 2011. Azasubira i Richmond muri Gashyantare 2012. aho yari aherutse gusinywa na Charlotte Independence.
Kalungi yagaragaye mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda yabatarengeje imyaka 20 ndetse n'ikipe nkuru y'igihugu.

Yatangiye umwuga muri na Villa SC muri shampiyona ya Uganda, nyuma yimukira muri Polisi Jinja, mbere yuko mu 2006 ajya gukina muri Saint-George SA muri Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere muri Etiyopiya. Diaz Kambere ni umukinnyi w'umugande ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Kanada. Kugeza ubu akina muri Afurika United FC muri Multicultural Soccer League ya British Columbia. Akora nk'umutoza mukuru w abakobwa muri Delview Secondary
Kambere yavukiye muri Uganda, ariko yimukira i Surrey, muri Columbiya yu bwongereza n'umuryango we akiri umwana. Yabaye umunyeshuri mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Centennial i Coquitlam n’ishuri ribanza rya John Norquay i Vancouver, yakinnye umupira mu rubyiruko mu ishyirahamwe ry’imikino rya kanada na bataliyani ryi Vancouver (ICSF) ndetse na Eagle Ridge Rogue Selects i Coquitlam, BC, kandi yari umunyamuryango wa Columbiya yu bwongereza. itsinda ry'intara k'urwego rwa bari munsi yimwaka 15, 16, na 18. Amaze kwimuka n'umuryango we mu majyepfo ya Mainland muri 1992 yize muri Langara College no muri Trinity Western University, aho yize Kinetics na Psychology.
Kambere yasinyiye Vancouver Whitecaps yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cya USL muri 2006, nyuma akina imikino 28 mu myaka ibiri hamwe niyi kipe. Ku ya 6 Nzeri 2008, yasinye amasezerano y’umunsi umwe na Toronto FC kugira ngo abashe gukina umukino na Chivas USA, kubera ko iyo kipe yabuze abakinnyi icyenda mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga.
Kambere yahgarariye kanada muri 2008 mumarushanwa ya CONCACAF Olympic Qualifying tournament.

Lawrence Kenneth Kasadha (wavutse 14 Nyakanga 1994) ni myugariro mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Bul FC yo muri Uganda.
Yabanje gukina shampiyona imwe mu ikipe ya SC Villa, SC Victoria University, KCCA no mu cyiciro cyo hasi c ndetse no muri shampiyona ya Kenya mu ikipe ya Nairobi City Stars, Bandari FC Kenya na Tusker FC
Kasadha yatangiriye mu cyiciro cyo hasi cya Jinja Municipal Council Hippos FC muri 2011 mbere yuko yinjira muri SC Villa mu cyiciro cya mbere, mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 2012. Nyuma y'amezi atandatu, hagati ya 2012, yasinyiye gukinira kaminuza ya SC Victoria.
Nyuma yimukiye muri Kenya yinjira mu ikipe ya Nairobi City Stars muri shampiyona yo muri 2014 maze shampiyona irangiye yerekeza muri Bandari FC yo muri Kenya muri shampiyona ya 2015 hari amakuru ko afite ahandi ashaka kujya muri Ushuru FC
Yagarutse muri Uganda muri 2016 yinjira muri KCCA ariko agaruka muri Kenya muri shampiyona ya 2018 hamwe na Tusker FC
Yarekuwe na Tusker nyuma y'amezi atandatu gusa hanyuma asubira muri Uganda akomeza kujya muri Gaddafi FC batsindiye kuza mu marushanwa yisumbuyeho mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2020-21, hanyuma yari Bul. FC.

Richard Juuko Kasagga (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda ukina nka myugariromu ikipe ya Olympique Béja muri shampiyona ya Tuniziya.akaba akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.

Jamil Kasirye (wavutse 1954) ni umunyezamu mu mupira w'amaguru uri mu kiruhuko cyizabukuru wakiniye Uganda mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 1978.
Yavukiye i Kasubi mu nkengero za Kampala, Kasirye yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Lint FC, Kampala City Council FC, SC Villa na Bank of Uganda FC. Yatsindiye ibikombe bibiri bya shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere muri Uganda hamwe na Villa, yegukana igikombe cya Uganda inshuro eshatu kabiri na KCC rimwe na Villa, anayobora ikipe ya Villa yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1983.
Kasirye yagiye agaragara inshuro nyinshi mu rubyiruko rwa Uganda ndetse n'amakipe akomeye y'igihugu. Umukino we wa nyuma yatsinzwe na Zambiya ibitego 0-3 muri Nyakanga muri 1984.

Abubakar Muhammad Kasule uzwi cyane ku izina rya Abubakar Kasule ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Express FC yo muri shampiyona ya uganda.
Abubakare kasule,ni umukinyi w'umupira w'amaguru wo muri Uganda.yavukiye muri Uganda ku wa 5 Mutarama 1999. Mu mwaka wa 2022 yasubiye muri Express FC nyuma yo kuba yari yaragiye muri leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika gukomeza amasomo muri kaminuza no gukina umupira.

Noah Babadi Kasule (wavutse 15 Gicurasi 1985) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda.
Kasule yatangiye umwuga we mu ikpe ya Kampala yitwa kampala City Council mbere yo kwimukira muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC. Mu 2007, Kasule yimukiye muri Arumeniya, amara imyaka ine akina muri Banants mbere yo kumara imyaka itatu i Gandzasar Kapan n'umwaka umwe muri Ulisses.

Robert Katende ni umutoza wa chess muri Uganda, mu mupira w'amaguru, na injeniyeri. Ni n'umuyobozi mukuru wa siporo yo hanze.
Yateje imbere umukino wa chess mu cyaro hamwe n'abana bo m'umuhanda wa Kampala. Azwiho kandi kuba yarayoboye Phiona Mutesi, umukandida wa mbere w’umugore m’umukino wa chess muri Uganda ndetse n’igitabo cya 2012 cyanditswe na Tim Crothers na filime Umwamikazi wa Katwe muri 2016, yiyobowe na Nair Mira, ikandikwa na William Wheeler. David Oyelowo yakinnye nka Robert Katende muri iyi filime, inagaragaramo Lupita Nyong'o na Madina Nalwanga.
Ubuzima bw'ambere n'uburere.
Katende yavukiye mu karere ka Kiboga, na nyina w'u mwangavu, yabanaga na nyirakuru mu bwana bwe. Yakuriye i Naakulabye, m'umujyi wa Kampala. Yatangiye ubuzima bwe mu ishuri ribanze rya St Elizabeth nyuma ajya mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Lubiri aho yamenyekanye muri chess. Kuva i Lubiri, yinjiye muri kaminuza ya Kyambogo aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu by'ubwubatsi, ateza imbere imyumvire ya chess. Yatangiye umupira w'amaguru nyuma akinana ubuhanga mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Miracle, Top TV FC, hamwe na ba ambasaderi ba siporo.
Kugeza ubu Katende afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu ikoranabuhanga rya mudasobwa ndetse n’impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu iterambere ry’umuryango mpuzamahanga yakuye muri kaminuza ya Northwest muri Amerika.
Ni umukinnyi wemewe na chess FIDE umwigisha na arbiter.
Muri 2018, Katende yatoranijwe kugirango yinjire muri gahunda yo gutangiza abayobozi muri Obama Foundation.
Katende yashakanye na Sarah Ntongo. Bafitanye abakobwa batatu.
Muri 2017, mu rwego rwo kubahiriza uruhare Katende yagize mu muryango wa chess, Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya Chess (FIDE) ryamuhaye igihembo cya Tigran Petrosian.
Muri 2018, Katende yari umwe mu bayobozi 200 b'Abanyafurika bemewe na Fondasiyo ya Obama. Ibikorwa bye byagaragaye no mu nama ya Fondasiyo ya Obama muri 2018.
Muri 2019, Katende yasohoye igitabo yise Knight idafite Ikigo gisobanura ingorane zo mu bwana bwe nu buryo yahisemo gukoresha chess nk'igikoresho cyo guhindura ubuzima.

Allan Kateregga (wavutse ku ya 3 Kamena 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka mu gihugu cya Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi ukinira hagati mu kibuga, mu ikipe ya FC Saint-Éloi Lupopo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Usibye Uganda, yakiniye muri Kenya, Afurika y'Epfo, na Iraki.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, yagarutse avuye mu ntizanyo muri Maritzburg United, Kateregga yemeye gusesa amasezerano na Cape Town City.

Godfrey Kateregga (5 Gicurasi 1960 - 13 Werurwe 1999) yari rutahizamu wakinaga umupira w'amaguru wakiniye ikipe y'ihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Kateregga yavukiye i Mulago mu nkengero za Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Tobacco FC, Kampala City Council FC, SC Villa na Express FC. Yatsindiye ibikombe bine bya shampiyona muri Uganda,bibiri muri KCC na Villa, kandi yegukana igikombe cya Uganda inshuro eshanu (bibiri muri KCC n'umwe muri Villa).
Kateregga yagaragaye inshuro nyinshi mu ikipe nkuru yi gihugu ya Uganda.

Habib Kavuma (wavutse 4 Nzeri 1991)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira Amajyepfo ya Samity, nka myugariro.
Yavukiye i Makindye, Kavuma yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda no mu Rwanda muri Bunamwaya, APR, Kampala Capital City Authority na SC Villa. Muri Nyakanga 2022, byatangajwe ku mugaragaro ko Kavuma yasinyiye gukina shampiyona ya CFL yo mu majyepfo ya Samity mu Buhinde.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2009.

Hood Kaweesa (wavutse 22 Nyakanga 1982) ni umukinnyi ukina nka myugariro mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Polisi FC. Yari umwe mu bagize itsinda ry’igikombe cya CECAFA muri 2002.

Vincent Kayizzi (wavutse 6 Werurwe 1984) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe OC Bokavu Dawa.
Kayizzi yatangiye gukina muri ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda muri Kampala City Council FC. Muri shampiyona 2006/07 yagize amahirwe aza mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yo mu Rwanda yitwa APR FC. Muri Mutarama 2009, yimukiye i Burayi gukina mu gikombe cya mbere muri Seribiya (icyiciro cya kabiri cyo muri Seribiya) FK Srem, iyi kipe ikaba iyambere mu Burayi mu kuzana bakinnyi baturutse Uganda, nka Nestroy Kizito na Phillip Ssozi. Nyuma yaje kugira ikindi gihe mu Burayi, ubwo yakinaga na Motor Lublin muri Shampiyona ya kabiri ya Polonye 2012–13.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kayizzi akina mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda kuva 2004, kugeza muri 2014, afite imipira 40 n'ibitego 4 yatsinze.

Martin Kayongo-Mutumba (yavutse yitwa Martin Mutumba, ku ya 15 Kamena 1985) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga wakinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga. Yibukwa cyane kumwanya muri AIK, aho yatsindiye Allsvenskan na Svenska Cupen muri 2009. Yavukiye muri Suwede ku babyeyi bakomoka muri Uganda, yahagarariye amakipe yo muri Suwede baterengeje imyaka 17 na 19 mbere yo gukinira umukino mpuzamahanga wa mbere muri Uganda muri 2012.
Mu 2004 AIK yifuzaga ko Mutumba yakina na FC Café Opera, ikipe yakoraga nk'ikipe ntoya ya AIK. Kubwamahirwe macye, Mutumba yavunitse ukuguru mu marushanwa yo mu rugo yakinnye na bagenzi be mbere yuko shampiyona itangira kandi ntabwo yigeze ashobora gukina umukino uwo ari wo wose wa Café Opera. Yavuze ko yatakaje imbaraga zogukina umupira w'amaguru, Urukiko rw'ubucamanza rw'amuhaye amahirwe ya kabiri ahitamo gukomeza umupira.
Igihe yabanje gusinyana na AIK, akiri ingimbi, ise yaretse akazi maze Mutumba ukiri muto aha umuryango amafaranga yinjiza. Iyo kipe yamuretse aragenda, umuryango wahise wisanga m'ubibazo by'ubukungu.

Igishanga cya Gatuna gifite hegitari umunani 8 cyeguriwe abatuye hafi y’umupaka wa Gatuna kugira ngo biteze imbere babinyujije mu buhinzi bakorera muri icyo gishanga.
Umushinga wo gutunganya Igishanga cya Gatuna.
Umushinga wo kugitunganya, uzibanda ku gutunganya ubutaka buri ku buso bwa Hegitari 600, bwo mu misozi igikikije, mu rwego rwo kuburinda kwangirizwa n’isuri. Bizajyana n’ingamba zo gukangurira ababuhinga kubahiriza ibikenerwa byose mu kongera umusaruro harimo imbuto nziza, ifumbire y’imborera n’imvaruganda, imiti, ishwagara n’ibindi bituma umusaruro wiyongera.Ni igishanga kiri ku buso bwa Hegitari 220, izikunze kurengerwa n’amazi y’imvura, zikaba zibarirwa muri 20.Mu umushinga wo kugitunganya haziyongeraho Damu, izayobora amazi mu buryo bworohereza abahinzi mu mirimo ijyanye no kuhira imyaka, bityo bajye babasha no guhinga batitaye ku kurindira imvura.Ibyo bizarushaho kubakira abahinzi ubushobozi, no guca imyumvire y’abagitekereza ko umurimo w’ubuhinzi ari uwa ba “mbuze uko ngira”.Ubwo bizaba byashyizwe mu bikorwa, umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, uzarushaho kwiyongera.Igihe kirageze ngo umuhinzi yubakirwe ubushobozi bumugira rwiyemezamirimo nk’abandi bose babarizwa mu rindi shoramari rirambye. Ibi rero ntiyabigeraho mu gihe agihura n’inzitizi zirimo n’isuri, ari na yo mpamvu Leta y’u Rwanda yatekereje icyafasha umuhinzi guhangana n’izo mbogamizi akabukora kinyamwuga byisanzuye.Igice kitagerwamo n’isuri muri iki gishanga, ngo nibura mu gihe hahinzwe ibirayi, hasarurwa Toni 19 kuri Hegitari imwe. Gahunda yo kugitunganya ikubiye mu mushinga mugari wo kwita ku buhinzi n’ubworozi watangiye gukorerwa mu Turere tw’igihugu guhera mu mwaka wa 2022, ukazamara imyaka itanu.
Uko byari bimeze mu Igishanga cya Gatuna.
Mugihe kinini cyari gishize bamwe mu bahinga mugishanga cya Gatuna bataka igihombo baterwaga n’amazi y’imvura yateraga imyuzure muri icyo gishanga,Abafite imirima muri icyo gishanga, abagituriye n’abaturage biganjemo abo mu Mirenge ya Kaniga na Cyumba mu Karere ka Gicumbi iki gishanga kibarizwamo, bagaragaza ko uko kwangirizwa imyaka y’abo n’amazi yarengeraga imirima imwe n’imwe ikigize byatumaga babaga bataha ntamusaruro.Bavugako bahoraga bahangayitse bibaza amaherezo y’icyo kibazo barayobewe, kuko inzego zose bigaragara ko zakagize icyo zibikoraho, bari barazegereye barazitakambiye ngo zibarwaneho zibafashe gushaka umuti w’icyo kibazo.Nubwo ibintu byose ku masoko ya byihagazeho muri Gicumbi, naho ibirayi byageze ku mafaranga 550. Imbuto imboga n’ibindi biribwa biragurwa n’Umuntu wifite, byaratumbagiye ku kigero kirenze kure uko byahoze mbere.Ubuyobozi butekereza ko kuba kiri hafi gutunganywa, abahinzi bazarushaho kongera imbaraga n’ubushake mu buhinzi buteye imbere bityo n’abakenera umusaruro ugiturukamo babyungukiremo.

Kizito Keziron ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ZESCO United muri shampiyona ya Zambiya hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ("Cranes") nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga. Muri 2015, Keziron yari mu bahatanira kuba umukinnyi w’umwaka w’igihembo cy’abakinnyi ba FUFA Airtel.
Umwuga w'urubyiruko.
Akiri muto, yari umunyamuryango wa Kitende Mutagatifu Mariya aho yari mu ikipe yegukanye igikombe cya Copa Coca-Cola yo muri 2013 i Kabale. Nyuma yinjiye muri KJT Rweshama aho yakiniye shampiyona imwe muri 2013/14.
Yatangiye gukinira Blasters ku ya 4 Mutarama 2018 na FC Pune City aje asimbuye Dimitar Berbatov ku munota wa 46. Ntabwo yashoboye gukina shampiyona yose kuko yagize imvune hagati muri shampiyona yo muri 2017-18. Yakomeje kwitwara neza muri Blasters muri shampiyona ya 2018-19.
Muri Nzeri 2019 yinjiye muri KCCA FC asinya amasezerano y'imyaka 2. Ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2019, yatangiye gukinira KCCA FC na Tooro FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kizito yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda, ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 2014 kuri Stade y'igihugu ya Mandela bakina na Etiyopiya. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 4 Nyakanga 2015, bakina na Tanzaniya mu cyiciro kibanza cya CHAN muri 2016. Yari mu ikipe ya Uganda Cranes yatwaye igikombe cya CECAFA muri 2015 muri Etiyopiya. Yabaye kandi mu ikipe ya Uganda yakinnye muri CHAN muri 2016 yabereye mu Rwanda.

James Jimmy Kidega (wavutse 16 Kanama 1982) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri ugande wahoze akina umupira wamaguru ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga.
Yavukiye i Jinja, murumuna we ni Moses Oloya, wakinnye umupira mpuzamahanga muri Uganda.
Kidega yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri SC Villa, Express, Rayon Sports fc yo mu Rwanda, La Passe, Gulu United, Uganda Revenue Authority, Chanthaburi na Bontang. Yatsindiye imipira ibiri mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.

Hamis Diego Kiiza (yavutse ku ya 10 Ukuboza 1990) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukina muri Kagera Sugar FC, muri shampiyona yambere ya Tanzaniya.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Diego yatangiye gukinira Cranes muri Bobby Williamson muri Gicurasi 2011 ubwo yahamagarwaga mu ikipe ya batarengeje imwaka 23 ubwo bahuraga na Tanzaniya mu majonjora y'imikino yose ya Afurika. Yatsinze ibitego 3 mu mikino 2 ubwo bakinaga na Tanzaniya afasha ikipe kuzamuka mu cyiciro gikurikira guhura na Kenya. Nyuma yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya bari munsi y'imyaka 23, yazamuwe mu ikipe y’igihugu yuzuye izakina na Gineya-Bisawu mu majonjora akomeye yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 2012 ku ya 4 Kamena 2011.

Mubikorwa byo gutunganya iki gishanga yakozwe harimo kongera ingomero z’amazi zuhira umuceri.
Gahunda yo gutunganya Igishanga cya Rugeramigozi.
Mubikorwa byo gutunganya iki gishanga yakozwe harimo kongera ingomero z’amazi zuhira umuceli, kurwanya isuri mu nkengero z’igishanga, haterwa ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka kandi abahinzi bagahugurwa gufata neza imiyoboro y’amazi.Abahinzi kandi bubakiwe ubwanikiro buhagije ku buryo ngo umusaruro wabo utangirikira mu mirima, banigishwa kwikorera ifumbire y’ibirundo bitanga nibura toni zisaga 100 yunganira imvaruganda.Ibiti bisaga ibihumbi 100 bizafasha abahinzi gukomeza kongera umusaruro, kuko bizafasha kurinda imiyoboro twubatse itanga amazi mu mirima isuri iyangiza kuko ubundi aha nta mazi yahageraga.Umuhuzabikorwa wafashaga abahinzi ba Rugeramigozi yavuga ko mu bikorwa bibungabunga ibidukikije muri iki gishanga birimo no gutera ibiti ku materasi akikije igishanga.Buri wese akwiye kuba ijisho rya mugenzi we, kugira ngo bakomeze kubona umusaruro uhagije w’umuceli muwurinda isuri yawangiza.Igihembwe cyashize abahinzi bakaba barabashije kugurisha Toni 356 bavuye kuri 274 bari bagurishije mu mwaka wa 2016, hatabariwemo uwo bajya kurya iwabo.
Ibindi Wamenya kumusaruro Abahinzi babonaga.
Abahinzi b’umuceri mu gishanga cya Rugeramigozi baravuga ko umusaruro wabo ukomeje kwiyongera,bavuga ko mu gihembwe cyari gishize cy’ihinga mu mwaka wa 2016 bari biyemeje kuzamura umusaruro kugera kuri Toni 200 kuri Hegitari 57, bakaba barabashije kubona umusaruro ungana na Toni 189 bavuye kuri Toni 125.Umwe mubahinga avugako ahinga kuri hegitari eshanu ariko yajyaga yeza kg 200 ariko aho ahuguriwe gutera umuceli ku murongo no gukoresha ifumbire y’ibirundo ageze kuri kg 382.Ubuso bwose bwa Rugeramigozi ya mbere n’iya kabiri busaga Hegitari 100 zihingwaho n’amakoperative ya COCAR na KIABER.Umukozi w’Akarere ka Muhanga wari ushinzwe igenamigambi avuga ko DUHAMIC ADRI yifatanyije n’Akarere mu kwesa imihigo ine irimo no kongera umusaruro ku bihingwa by’umuceri n’ibigoli.

Ali Kimera ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umuzamu wa Busoga United.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

James C. Kirunda (1950 - 25 Gicurasi 2020) yari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda akaba n'umuyobozi w'umupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Yitabiriye imikino itanu yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika ndetse anayobora Uganda mu marushanwa atatu yanyuma.
Yabaye umuyobozi w'ikipe y'igihugu hagati yo muri 1989 na 1996.

Igishanga cya Ruterana, giherereye mu murenge wa Rongi mu karere ka Muhanga.
Ibyo wamenya ku Igishanga cya Ruterana.
Igishanga cya Ruterana, cyo mu karere ka Muhanga, k’ubufatanye n’umushinga protos bigishijwe kwita kubidukikije,ndetse banahabwa ubumenyi mu gutunganya uturima twigikoni.uyu mushinga wari usanzwe ubafasha wahagaritse ibikorwa byawo maze ubyegurira akarere ka muhanga.Ubwo abo baturage bavuga ko bageze kuri byinshi, ngo haracyari byinshi bari bizeye ko bazakora k’ubufatanye n’umushinga, akaba ariho bahera basaba akarere ka muhanga kubaba hafi muburyo bwimyumvire ndetse no mubushobozi.Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Muhanga,nabwo bwizeza aba baturage ko buzakomeza kubafasha nkuko bwari busanzwe bukorana n’uyumushinga, ariko kandi bunasaba abaturage kugira uruhare mu gusigasira ibyo bagezeho.Abaturage bavuga babihuriraho n’ubuyobozi bw’umushinga protos, aho busaba akarere, gukomeza kuba hafi abaturage mu rwego rwo kubafasha gukomeza kugira imibereho myiza.Mu ubufatanye kuva mu mwaka wa 2014, ni bwo abo baturage batangiye gufashwa muri gahunda zigamije kurengera ibidukikije, ndetse no kuzamura imibereho yabo, ubu bakaba bashyizwe mu maboko y’Akarere byumwihariko, nyuma yuko ibikorwa byumushinga bigeze kumusozo.

Ronnie Kisekka (wavutse 5 Ukuboza 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nka myugariro.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroc.

Henry Kisekka (wavutse 31 Kanama 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi wo k'uruhande w'ikipe ya Aizawl muri shampiyona ya I.
Afatwa nk'umukinnyi w'ingenzi mu bashaka ibitero muri Dong Nai muri 2012, yatsinze ibitego 11, afasha ikipe ye kugera ku ntera. Ntibyatinze, yakiriye guhamagarwa mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mbere y’amajonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi cyo muri 2014.
Binh Duong FC yahagaritse amasezerano ya Henry Kisekka muri 2016.
Ku ya 6 Mata 2022, hatangajwe ko ikipe ya shampiyona ya I mu ikipe ya Mohammedan yarangije gusinyisha Kisekka mu ikipe ya Bhawanipore ikorera mu mujyi wa Kolkata. Ku ya 30 Mata, yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri "Black Panthers" na NEROCA. Ku butegetsi bwa Nikola Stojanović, ikipe ye ku nshuro ya mbere, yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona y’igihugu cya mbere muri shampiyona ya 2021-22, ariko yarangije ari igisonga nyuma yo gutsindwa na Gokulam Kerala ibitego 2-1.
Ku ya 21 Nzeri, mbere yuko shampiyona yo muri 2022-23 shampiyona itangira, Aizawl yatangaje ko yasinyishije Kisekka. Yatangiye gukinira iyi kipe ku ya 15 Ugushyingo na TRAU banganyije 1-1.

Joel Derick Kitamirike (wavutse 5 Mata 1984) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga w'akinnye nka myugariro. Yakiniye ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya mbere ya Brentford muri shampiyona ya 2003–04 ndetse no muri Dundee yo muri shampiyona ya Sikotishi muri 2005. Ikipe ye aheruka ni Chelmsford City. Yavukiye muri Uganda, yimukira mu Bwongereza akiri umwana kandi afite ubwenegihugu bw'Ubwongereza.
Ugushyingo 2008 yakatiwe igifungo cy’amezi 20 azira gutanga ibiyobyabwenge byo mu rwego rwa A.
Kitamirike yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda, mu 1984 aza mu Bwongereza afite imyaka itandatu. Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umukinnyi mu bana ba Chelsea, aho yagaragaye inshuro imwe munsi yabafite imyaka 17, ahagarara mu gikombe cya UEFA na Hapoel Tel Aviv, ubwo abakinnyi benshi batagiye muri Isiraheli kubera guhungabanya n'umutekano. Yinjiye muri Brentford ku ntizanyo muri Nzeri 2003, yongera ngutizwa mu Gushyingo 2003 mu gihe gisigaye cya shampiyona yo muri 2003–04, aho yakinnye imikino 25 ya shampiyona ndetse n’igikombe muri Brentford. Yarekuwe na Chelsea mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2003–04, nyuma yi geragezwa n’ikipe yo mubuholandi Willem II Tilburg na Walsall, yinjira mu mujyi wa Mansfield mu Kuboza 2004 nta masezerano yagiranye. Yakiniye Mansfield inshuro ebyiri mbere yo kwinjira muri Dundee muri Mutarama 2005 ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Yatangiye gukina mukibuga muri Dundee inshuro zirindwi, muri shampiyona yo muri 2004–05 ubwo iyi kipe yasezererwaga muri shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Sikotishi ndetse ikongera kugaragara inshuro ebyiri mbere yo kuva muri iyi kipe mu Gushyingo 2005 nyuma yo kwemeranya gusesa amasezerano. Nyuma y'amezi abiri, yinjiye mu ikipe nkuru yo muri majori, mu ikipe ya Columbus Crew.
Yagaragaye rimwe muri Crew mbere yo kugwa mu mupira w'amaguru utari shampiyona yu Bwongereza no gukinira Fisher Athletic na Weymouth. Yarekuwe na Weymouth muri Gashyantare 2008 yinjira mu ikipe ya Chelmsford City, akaba yarigaragaje rimwe mbere yo kuva muri iyi kipe mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 2007–08.
Ugushyingo 2008 yakatiwe igifungo cy’amezi 20 azira gutanga ibiyobyabwenge byo mu rwego rwa A.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kitamirike yari ahagarariye Ubwongereza ku rwego rw’abatarengeje imyaka 15 muri 2004, ikipe y’umupira w'amaguru y’igihugu cya Uganda yamushyize mu ikipe yabo mu majonjora y’igikombe cy’isi ndetse n’igikombe cy’ibihugu muri 2006 yakinnye na DR Congo muri Kamena 2004, akoresha amategeko mashya ya FIFA bituma yemererwa gukinira igihugu cye cy'amavuko kurwego mpuzamahanga rwose. Nubwo Kitamirike yari ashishikajwe no gukina, amategeko y’abinjira muri Uganda ntiyemeraga ubwenegihugu bubiri. Kitamirike ntiyashakaga kureka ubwenegihugu bw'Ubwongereza kugira ngo abone pasiporo ya Uganda bityo abura umukino.

Igishanga cya Nyarububa gihuza Umurenge wa Cyungo na Rukozo mu Karere ka Rulindo.
Tumenye Igishanga cya Nyarububa.
Igishanga cya Nyarububa gikikijwe n’imisozi miremire mu kugitunganya, Leta yafatanyije n’abaturage baca amaterasi y’indinganire ku misozi ikikije icyo gishanga, amazi ntiyongera kubona aho amenera, baragikamura bakoresheje imigende y’amazi, abaturage batangira guhinga ntacyo bishisha.Abo baturage bavuga ko nta wari wigeze agerageza kugihinga ngo asarure, kubera ko imvura yagwaga amazi aturuka muri iyo misozi akakirengera.Mbere yo gutunganya iki gishanga hashyirwa amaterasi ku misozi igikikije, hashyirwa n’imiferege irinda amazi kwinjira muri icyo gishanga, nta muturage wahingaga ngo asarure. Bamaraga guhinga amazi akuzura igihingwa ushyizemo kikabora, ikibashije gushinga umuzi gitangiye gukura amazi y’imvura akava muri ya misozi byose akabirengera.Igishanga cyari cyarabahombeje, cyarabateje inzara mu buryo bukomeye, barabagobotse baragitunganya, aheraga igice cy’umufuka uraheza ibiri cyangwa itatu, ubuyobozi barabushimira cyane.Uwahingaga imigenda itanu yabonaga umusaruro w’ibiro bitarenze 15, ubu umuntu arahinga akaba yakweza nka toni y’ibigori, barashesha bakabona kawunga, barimo kurya neza, abana bameze neza nta kibazo. Ubuyobozi barabushimira cyane, icyo gishanga cyari ikibazo ariko ubu ni igisubizo.
Ibindi Wamenya ku Igishanga cya Nyarububa.
Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rulindo icyo busaba abaturage n’uko bakoresha icyo gishanga bakagihingamo ibihingwa byateganyijwe. Nk’uko babibonye mu minsi yashize, ubuyobozi bukuru bw’Igihugu bwabageneye inyongeramusaruro ya nk’unganire, ibyo byose ni bwa buyobozi bwiza buhora bwifuza ko umuturage yatera imbere.Abahinga mugishanga ubwabo barabyivugira ko mu mateka yabo icyo gishanga cyabayeho kitabafasha, ariko kubera imiyoborere myiza cyaratunganyijwe, Ubuyobozi burifuza ko bakibyaza umusaruro bagihingamo mu bihe byose by’ihinga, ntihagire igihe kibacika, ariko bahingamo ibyo bagiriwemo inama n’ubuyobozi byamaze gukorerwa ubushakashatsi, mu rwego rwo kubafasha kongera umusaruro. Ubuhinzi bube inkomoko y’ubukungu nk’uko biri mu cyerekezo Igihugu cyihaye.

Fabian Derrick Subi Kizito (yavutse 26 Nyakanga 1990) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinnyi w'imbere mu kibuga muri SV TEC.
Kizito yavukiye i Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu Buholandi muri DOTO Pernis, RKSV Leonidas, DCV Krimpen, Veensche Boys, BVCB Bergschenhoek na VV Hillegersberg. Muri Kanama 2019 yasinyiye ikipe ya Suwede ya Nyköpings BIS.
Yatsindiye ibitego bibiri muri Uganda muri 2012, atsinda igitego kimwe. Igitego cye cyaje ku ncuro ya mbere mu mukino wa gicuti na Misiri. Umukino we wa kabiri wari umukino wo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cyisi cya FIFA bakina na Angola.

Geoffrey Baba Kizito (yavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe Than Quang Ninh yo muri Vietinami, nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Yavukiye i Kampa, kuva muri 2012 na 2013 yari muri Vietinamu hamwe na Xuan Thanh Sai Gon. Mu ntangiriro za Mutarama 2014 yasinyanye amasezerano yo gukinira shampiyona ya Kenya mu ikipe ya Gor Mahia. Yagarutse muri Vietinamu muri shampiyona yo muri 2015, hamwe na Than Quang Ninh. Muri 2018 yinjiye muri Saigon. Yimukiye muri Than Quảng Ninh muri shampiyona yo muri 2020.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira mpuzamahanga muri Uganda mu 2012.
Muri 2017 yabaye umuturage ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Vietnam, ku izina rya Trần Trung Hiếu.

Joseph Nestroy Kizito (wavutse 27 Nyakanga 1982) ni umugande wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru wa babigize umwuga ukina nka myugariro.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Kizito yari ahagarariye Uganda kuva muri 2001 kugeza 2011, amaze kwinjiza inshuro 39 mu ikipey'igihugu.
Mu gihugu cye, Kizito yamaze imyaka ine muri Villa, afasha iyi kipe gutwara ibikombe bine bikurikirana (2000, 2001, 2002, na 2002–03) n'ibikombe bibiri bya Uganda (2000 na 2002). Yatsindiye igikombe cya Kagame Interclub muri 2003, mbere yo kwimukira mu mahanga.
Nyuma yo kuba uwashakira aho akina, Kizito yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri na Partizan ku ya 2 Nyakanga 2010. Yatangiye gukinira iyi kipe nyuma yiminsi 19, akina iminota 90 yuzuye, batsinda igitego 1-0 na shampiyona wa Arumeniya muri Pyunik, mu mikino ya kabiri yi cyiciro cya kabiri cya majonjora ya UEFA muri 2010–11. Mu mwaka wa 2010–11 muri Seribiya, Kizito yanzinze imikino 14, iyi kipe yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona. Yafashije kandi ikipe ye gutwara Igikombe cya Seribiya muri 2010–11, bityo ikusanya kabiri. Mu Kwakira 2011, Kizito yahagaritse amasezerano yagiranye na Partizan ku bwumvikane.
Nyuma yo gusubira mu gihugu cye, Kizito yasinyiye ikipe ya Victoriya yazamukiyemo muri kaminuza ya Victoriya muri Kanama 2012, ahakina umwaka umwe. Yaje kumarayo imyaka itatu yakurikiyeho, mbere yo kugenda muri Nyakanga 2015. Nyuma gato, Kizito yinjiye muri ikipe yo muri Uganda ya Lweza.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kizito yakinnye bwa mbere mu marushanwa ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2001. Yakomeje atsinda ibitego 39 muri Cranes mumyaka icumi yakurikiye. Muri Gashyantare 2012, Kizito yatangaje ko yeguye mu mupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga.
Kizito ukomoka mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya, yavukiye i Mutukula, muri Uganda ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya na Uganda. Ni murumuna wa Manfred Kizito, wari uhagarariye u Rwanda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Manfred Kizito (wavutse 14 Werurwe 1980) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wacyuye igihe, wakinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati. Yavukiye muri Uganda, yaserukiye u Rwanda mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga.
Kizito yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda, ubuzima bwe bwa mbere yakinnye muri Polisi hamwe na Villa, mbere yo kwimukira mu Rwanda muri 2005 gukinira APR FC na ATRACO FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
N'ubwo yavukiye muri Uganda, Kizito yahawe pasiporo y'u Rwanda, kandi ahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu cyu Rwanda, yahamagawe inshuro 19 mu ikipe y'igihugu hagati ya 2004 na 2007, harimo no mu mikino itandatu yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA.
Murumuna we Nestroy nawe ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru.

Edward Kizza (wavutse 17 Ukuboza 1998)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi w'imbere mu kibuga muri Pittsburgh Riverhounds muri Shampiyona ya USL.
Kizza yavukiye i Kampala, yimukiye muri Amerika hamwe n'ababyeyi be afite imyaka 14. Yize umwaka wa mbere w'amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rya Carlisle mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri rya Montverde Academy hafi ya Orlando, muri Floride. Hamwe na Montverde, Kizza yari muri gahunda ya SIMA kandi yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 41 mu bakinnyi ku mwanya wa 41 mu rwego rwigihugu na topdrawersoccer yavuye muri shampiyona nkuru.
Ku ya 5 Werurwe 2021, Kizza yasinyanye amasezerano y'umwuga na Revolution yo mu Bwongereza nyuma yo gushimisha abatoza muri shampiyona. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere muri Revolution ku ya 17 Mata 2021 muri shampiyona yabo yakinnye na Chicago Fire, yaje nk'umusimbura ku munota wa 83 banganya ibitego 2-2, maze akubita umupira ku mutwe.
Nyuma y'igihembwe cyo muri 2022, Kizza yarekuwe nu Bwongereza bushya.
Memphis 901 (inguzanyo).
Ku ya 30 Werurwe 2022, Ubwongereza bwatangaje ko bagurije Kizza mu ikipe ya shampiyona ya USL Championship mu ikipe ya Memphis 901 mu gihe gisigaye cya shampiyona 2022. Kizza yahamagawe ari mu ntizanyo ye muri Nyakanga 2022.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds (inguzanyo).
Ku ya 15 Nyakanga 2022, ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya USL ya Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC yatangaje ko baguze Kizza ku ntizanyo mu gihe cyari gisigaye cya shampiyona muri 2022.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds.
Ku ya 13 Mutarama 2023, Kizza yimukiye i Riverhounds guturayo.

Mustafa Kizza (wavutse ku ya 3 Ukwakira 1999) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe yigihugu ya Uganda ukina inyuma kuruhande.
Ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2017, Kizza yashyizwe mu ikipe Kampala Capital City,i Lugogo. Ku ya 3 Werurwe 2017, Kizza yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya Kampala Capital City Authority na Bright Stars FC kuri stade ya Phillip Omondi Yatsinze igitego cya mbere mu mujyi wa Kampala Capital City Authority kuri Polisi FC ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2017 kuri Stade ya Phillip Omondi Lugogo. Yagaragaye mu mikino 7 yakinnye na Kampala Capital City Authority.
Kizza yakinnye umukino wa mbere wa shampiyona bakina na Bright Stars FC kuri Stade ya Phillip Omondi StarTimes, Kampala Capital City Authority (yatsinze 2–1). Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri shampiyona yatsinze Polisi FC kuri Stade ya Phillip Omondi i Lugoggo. Yakinnye imikino 23 muri shampiyona. Ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Kampala bwatwiye shampiyona. Kizza yarangije shampiyona ya 2018–2019 muri Uganda, afite imipira yavuyemo ibitego 25 muri kiriya gihembwe; ibitego 16 muri Uganda, 6 muri Caf, 4 mu Igikombe cya Uganda maze atsinda ibitego 2 muri shampiyona.
Kizza yakinnye umukino we wa mbere muri icyo gihembwe na Maroons FC, yakinnye imikino 24 ya Uganda Premier League akora 14 bafasha; 2 afasha muri Caf, no gutsinda ibitego 6.
Kizza yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa shampiyona bakina na Wakiso Giants FC ku ya 31 Kanama 2019 maze batsinda muri uwo mukino, Ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kampala bwatsinze igitego 1-0.
Muri Nyakanga 2020, yasinye muri Impinduka ya Montreal (yaje kwitwa CF Montréal muri 2021). Nyuma y'igihembwe cya 2021, amasezerano ya Kizza yangiwe na Montréal.

Allan Kyambadde (wavutse 15 Mutarama 1996)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya El Gouna muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Misiri.
Muri Kanama 2019, Kyambadde yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Misiri ya El Gouna FC avuye muri Kampala Capital City Authority FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yatumiye Kyambadde kuba umwe mu bakinnyi b'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu marushanwa y'ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’amarushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Saidi Kyeyune (wavutse 1 Mutarama 1993)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, ya mutumiwe kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Melvyn Lorenzen (wavutse 26 Ugushyingo 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina ku ruhande bazatira izamu muri Wormatia Worms. Afite kandi ubwenegihugu bw'Ubudage.
Lorenzen yinjiye muri SV Werder Bremen muri 2013 avuye muri Holstein Kiel. Yatangiye bwa mbere Bundesliga ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2013 na VfB Stuttgart. Yasimbuye Eljero Elia nyuma y'iminota 88 banganya 1-1 i Stuttgart.
Mu mpera za Nyakanga 2017, Lorenzen yinjiye mu ikipe ya Eredivisie ADO Den Haag ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe FC Utrecht baza gutsindwa 3-0 m'urugo.
Karpaty Lviv na Persela Lamongan.
Muri Werurwe 2021, nyuma yo gutsinda AFC Wimbledon muri Nzeri 2020, Lorenzen yasinyanye amasezerano y'ukwezi kumwe n'ikipe ya Indoneziya ya Persela Lamongan yo muri Liga 1.
Ku ya 23 Kanama 2021, Lorenzen yasinyanye na Sligo Rovers yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Shampiyona yo muri Irilande mu mikino 13 yarisigaye muri shampiyona yabo muri 2021, nyuma y'ibyumweru bibiri imyitozo niyi kipe. Yavuye muri iyo kipe shampiyona irangiye.
Lorenzen yinjiye muri Wormatia Worms, wazamuwe muri Regionalliga Südwest, muri Nzeri 2022.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
