Lorenzen yavukiye i Londere mu Bwongereza kuri se uvuka Uganda na nyina w'umudage. Amazina ye akomoka kuri nyina. Se yitwa Drake Mugisa. Mu 2016, yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda, maze atangira umukino wa mbere mu mukino wa gicuti yatsinzwe na Zimbabwe ibitego 2-0 ku ya 31 Gicurasi 2016.

Edrisa Lubega (wavutse 17 Mata 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Christened 'Torres' nyuma ya Fernando Torres, yavukiye mu muryango ufite abana 4 kwa Mugisha Tumushabe na Rebecca Nakamya.
Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri shampiyona ya Uganda muri 2016-17.
Mbere yuko Proline FC yazamurwa mu ntera, ubwo bakinaga muri shampiyona ya FUFA, niwe rutahizamu wabo wa mbere, watsinze ibitego 21, bituma ashobora gutorwa mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Ishuri rye ritabizi, Dynamic SS, Lubega yavuye gukinira Proline FC atabimenyesheje umuntu numwe, afitanye isano n’ishuri cyangwa ubunyamabanga bw’amarushanwa, bityo ntiyashobora kwitabira amarushanwa y’ishuri rya Copa Coca-Cola muri 2016 akurikije amategeko.
Muri Gashyantare 2017, Lubega yatijwe muri Ositarariya, mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu ikipe ya Floridedorfer AC. Yatangiye gukinira muri shampiyona muri iyi kipe ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2017 atsinda 1-0 iwayo batsinda Autriche Lustenau. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya shampiyona muri iyi kipe ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2017, atsinda igitego ku munota wa 10 yatsinze Wiener Neustadt ibitego 3-0. Igitego cye,yarahawe umupira na George Davies, cyatsinze na Floridsdorfer igitego 1-0.
Muri Nyakanga 2018, Lubega yongeye gutizwa, kuri iyi nshuromuri SV Ried umwaka umwe, ahitamo kongera undi mwaka. Yatangiye gukina shampiyona muri iyi kipe ku ya 5 Kanama 2018, yandikisha umufasha ku izamu rya Thomas Mayer kuko Ried yatsinze WSG Wattens ibitego 2-1. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere cyo guhatanira iyi kipe ku ya 17 Kanama 2018 atsinda ibitego 3-0 iwayo bahananye na FC Liefering. Igitego cye, cyatsinzwe ku munota wa 45 kandi afashijwe na Manuel Kerhe, bituma batsinda igitego 1-0 kuri Ried.
Muri Kanama 2019, Lubega yagarutse muri Proline asinya amasezerano y'umwaka umwe gusa.
Ku ya 17 Nyakanga 2021, yinjiye muri Estrela da Amadora muri Porutugali ku nguzanyo.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Milutin Sredojević yashyize Edrisa Lubega mu ikipe ye igizwe n'abantu 30 mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda. Yatangiye gukina imikino mpuzamahanga ku ya 27 Mutarama 2016, aje asimbuye ku munota wa 79 asimbuye Erisa Ssekisambu banganya na Zimbabwe igitego 1-1 mu cyiciro cya Shampiyona y’Afurika.

Azake Luboyera (yavutse 6 Mata 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina mu b'imbere.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Hans Production Academy muri Uganda, Luboyera yaje kwinjira muri Aspire Academy yo muri Qatar muri 2012. Nyuma yo kuva muri Aspire muri 2014, Luboyera yinjiye muri gahunda ya Ottawa Fury muri 2015.
Ku ya 20 Nyakanga 2017 Luboyera yasinye amasezerano ye ya mbere y'umwuga muri Ottawa Fury. Yatangiye umwuga we muri Ottawa nyuma y'iminsi icyenda, atsinda igitego cyo gufungura itsinze rya Toronto FC II ibitego 2-0.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Luboyera yakinnye imikino ibiri mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda y'abatarengeje imyaka 20, mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika mu baterengeje imyaka 20 muri 2017.

Charles Lukwago (wavutse ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 1992) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umuzamu, mu ikipe ya Saint George yo muri Etiyopiya, ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Mu mpeshyi 2021, Lukwago yasinyiye ikipe ya Saint George yo muri Etiyopiya Premier League ku masezerano yimyaka ibiri.

Halid Lwaliwa (wavutse ku ya 22 Kanama 1996) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinyi wo hagati mu kibuga wa FK Bregalnica Štip hamwe n'ikipe yumupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Lwaliwa wavukiye Iganga, Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Mariya i Kitende, mbere yo gutangira umwuga we w’umupira w'amaguru muri Vipers SC aho yazamuwe mu ikipe nkuru muri 2014. Yasinye amasezerano yo kongera amasezerano muri Kanama 2018. Mu 2022, Halid yinjiye mu karere ka FK Bregalnica mu majyaruguru ya Makedoniya.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye ku rwego mpuzamahanga ku ya 21 Nzeri 2019 atsinda u Burundi ibitego 3-0 mu majonjora yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2020.

Taddeo Lwanga (wavutse ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina muri Arta Solar7 muri shampiyona ya Djibouti ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Akiri muto, yari umunyamuryango wa Ndejje United FC mu cyiciro cya kabiri, mbere yo kwitabira igikombe cya Buganda Masaza cya Kyadondo.
Muri Mutarama 2014, Lwanga yinjiye muri Express FC. Yatangiye gukinira Express FC ihanganye na Polisi FC ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2014. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Express FC bakina na Lweza Football Club ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 2014.
Muri 2015, yinjiye muri SC Villa atangira bakina na Bright Stars i Mwererwe ku ya 25 Kanama 2015. Yagaragaje ibihe bitazibagirana muri Sports Club Villa, igitego yatsinze Al Khartoum SC yo muri Sudani mu gikombe cya CAF Confederations Cup muri Gashyantare 2016. Taddeo yagize ibihe byiza bifasha SC Villa kurangiza umwanya wa kabiri muri shampiyona ya Uganda.
Muri 2017, Lwanga yinjiye muri Vipers SC maze asinyana amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Yatangiye gukinira Bright Stars FC ku ya 12 Nzeri 2017. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri Vipers SC na Proline FC ku ya 24 Ukuboza 2017 kuri Stade ya Mutagatifu Mariya.
Muri Kanama 2019, Lwanga yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Misiri muri Tanta SC.
Ku ya 2 Ukuboza 2020, Lwanga yinjiye muri Simba SC ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Ku ya 19 Kanama 2022, Lwanga yinjiye muri Arta Solar7 nk'umukinnyi w'igenga ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Taddeo yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda bakina n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Malawi mu mukino wa gicuti wabereye kuri sitade Kamuzu.

Brian Majwega ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina hagati mu kibuga, akaba umukinnyi wa KCCA FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Simeon Masaba (wavutse ku ya 23 Werurwe 1983) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira muri shampiyona ya Uganda, mu ikipe Uganda Revenue Authority SC, aho akina nka myugariro.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Polisi Jinja muri shampiyona ya Uganda, mbere yo kwerekeza muri Villa SC muri 2004. Yagarutse muri Polisi Jinja muri 2006 maze muri 2008 atangira gukina inshuro ebyiri na Villa SC muri 2008. Simeon Masaba ahitamo kwinjira muri Uganda Revenue Authority, kumasezerano y'umwaka umwe ku mashiringi miliyoni 10..
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Masaba yakiniye ubu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda. Yakinnye imikino 69, atsinda ibitego 7.

Tom Masiko (wavutse 17 Gashyantare 1996) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Wakiso Giants, nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere.
Yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri ikipe ya Kampala Capital City Authority, muri Vipers na Wakiso Giants.
Yatangiye gukinira imikino mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2013.

Geofrey Massa (wavutse 19 Gashyantare 1986) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira muri shampiyona ya KTFF Süper Lig k'uruhande rwa Küçük Kaymaklı muri Chiypure ya ruguru.
Yavukiye i Jinja, Massa yatangiye umwuga we muri 2004 hamwe n'ikipe ya Police FC muri shampiyona ya Uganda, mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Al-Masry Club yo mu Misiri muri 2005. Yakinnye imyaka itatu muri Egiputa mbere yo kwimukira mu 2008 mu ikipe yo muri Afurika yepfo ya Jomo Cosmos, yakinnye imikino 14 atsinda igitego kimwe. Muri 2008, yavuye muyo kipe asubira mu Misiri maze asinyana na Itesalat. Massa yinjiye ku ya 14 Nzeri 2011 muri shampiyona ya Telsim Super League, mu ikipe ya Yenicami Ağdelen SK. Ku ya 21 Kanama 2013, yasinyanye amasezerano na kaminuza yo muri Afurika y'Epfo ya Pretoria FC yo kuyikinira.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Massa yagiye agaragara mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda, akaza bwa mbere muri 2005.

Rogers Mato (wavutse ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2003) Ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina muri shampiyona ya Uganda, mu ikipe ya KCCA FC ndetse n'ikipe yi gihugu ya uganda.
Nk'umusore Mato yakiniye ikipe ya Lweza FC na Maroons FC muri ya shampiyona y'abato. Muri 2018 yinjiye mu ikipe yabato ya Proline FC muri shampiyona ya FUFA. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2019–20, Mato yazamuwe mu ikipe nkuru, ariko yaje gusezererwa n'iyi kipe muri shampiyona kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19. Yabaye umukinnyi w'ingenzi muri iyi kipe muri gihembwe cyakurikiyeho, abayobora mu majonjora yo kuzamukahe juru yo kuza igihe gito atsinze Gadaffi FC. Muri Nzeri 2021 hatangajwe ko uyu mukinnyi yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 4 na shampiyona wa Uganda ku inshuro ya 13 KCCA FC ku giciro kitaramenyekana.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Nzeri 2021, Mato yahamagawe mu ikipe nkuru y'igihugu mu mukino wo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2022 nu Rwanda. Nyuma y'amezi abiri yagaragaye mu ikipe y'igihugu mu mukino wo kwitoza n'ikipe ihagarariye yo mu karere ka Nyaruguru. Mato yafunguye amazamu m'ugihe ikipe y'igihugu yagiye gutsinda 3–1. Muri Mutarama 2022, yongeye guhamagarwa mu mikino itanu ya gicuti n’impande z’ibihugu by’Uburayi na Aziya ubwo Cranes yagendaga muri Turukiya, Iraki, na Bahirayine. Yakomeje gukina umukino wa mbere mu mukino ubanza na Isilande ku ya 12 Mutarama 2022. Yatangiye akina iminota mirongo inani amaherezo anganya 1-1.

Sula Matovu (wavutse ku ya 17 Nyakanga 1992) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nka rutahizamu akaba n'umukinnyi wo hagati muri Al-Orouba SC muri shampiyona ya Oman Professional League ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Matovu yatangiye umwuga wo gukina akiri mu ishuri mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Proline FC mu 2007. Igihe yari muri iryo shuri yerekanye ubushobozi budasanzwe n’imikorere ikomeye maze yinjira muri Nalubaale Buikwe muri shampiyona ya Uganda Super League. Nyuma y'igihembwe kimwe yinjiye muri Proline FC aho yatsindaga buri gihe muri Uganda, kubera ubuhanga bwe bukomeye, nu muvuduko mwinshi ubwo yakuyemo abo bahanganye, gutsinda neza no kwambuka umupira, kugenzura neza umupira, kugenzura no gutambuka ndetse no kwerekana neza m'umikino y'umupira w'amaguru yashimishije umutoza w'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru wa Uganda, Bobby Williamson wamuhamagaye mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda. Yagaragaye kandi mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya batarengeje imyaka 20 ya Uganda ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya 23 ya Uganda.
Mutagatifu George FC (Inguzanyo).
Muri Mutarama 2011, Matovu yimukiye mu ikipe ya Saint George FC yo muri Etiyopiya yatojwe na Giuseppe Dossena ku masezerano y'inguzanyo y'amezi 6.
Muri Kanama 2012, Matovu yarangije kwimuka umwaka umwe muri Erbil SC. Ku ya 25 Nzeri 2012, mu mukino wa kabiri wa kimwe cya kane kirangiza muri Aziya, Matovu yatsinze Erbil SC igitego cya mbere mu minota 37 ku munota wa 1 na Kelantan bituma Erbil SC ikomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 2012, yaje asimbuye ku munota wa 46 ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Aziya yakinnye na Al Kuwait maze Erbil SC ikomeza gutsindwa ibitego 4–0. Ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2012, Matovu yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya shampiyona yo muri Iraki hamwe na Kurdish ku minota wa 7 yatsinze Al Sulimaniya ibitego 3-2.
Nyuma y'igihembwe gishimishije hamwe na Erbil SC yo muri Iraki, ikipe ya BK Häcken yo muri Suwede Allsvenskan yamutumiye mu igeragezwa by'ibyumweru 3 aho yashimishije iyi kipe ya tekinike maze aba umukinnyi wihuta cyane m'umateka y'ikipe maze arasinya. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri BK Häcken itsinze FC Dallas mu mukino wa mbere wa shampiyona kuva yatangira kuba umukinnyi ucyenewe mu ikipe ya Gothenburg BK Häcken.
Abayobozi ba Kaizer.
Nyuma yo kumara 2014 mu ikipe ya BK Häcken yo muri Suwede ya Allsvenskan, yahujwe no kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Kaizer Chiefs muri shampiyona yo muri Afurika yepfo ku ya 20 Kamena 2015. Yatangiye imyitozo hamwe na Kaizer Chiefs ku ya 24 Kamena 2015 nyuma asinyana amasezerano y’amezi atandatu ku ya 8 Nyakanga 2015. Sula yatsinze igitego cya kane yatsinze 4–0 yatsinze Volcan de Moroni wa komore muri 2016 marushanwa ya CAF.

Boban Zirintusa Bogere (wavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 1992) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukomoka mu gihugu cya Uganda, ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya Mtibwa muri Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere muri Tanzaniya ndetse no mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Boban yabanje gukina muri Vipers na Simba zo muri Tanzaniya, Mtibwa Sugar yo muri Tanzaniya, Dynamos na Highfield zo muri Zimbabwe, Polokwane city yo muri Afurika y'Epfo, Buildcon yo muri Zambiya na Etiyopiya Coffee yo muri Etiyopiya.
Boban yageze muri iyo kipe mu mwaka wa 2006 rw'agati muri shampiyona. Yasinywe n'umutoza Charles Ayiekoh, kugirango akomeze ikipe mugihe cyo guhangana ni cyiciro cya mbere muri shampiyona wa Vipers muri shampiyona yambere. Yabaye muri iyo kipe y'amateka yarokotse kumanuka kumutwe nyuma yo kutsindwa ibitego 4-1 bya Kampala United ku mukino wa kabiri uheruka gukina na shampiyona yo muri 2006 mbere yo kuva muri Vipers muri 2008.
Yinjiye muri Dynamos muri Highfield FC muri Mutarama 2013. Boban Zirintusa yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Dynamos ubwo ibihangange bya Harare byatsindaga umukino wa mbere wa Champiyona mu cyiciro cya mbere cyatsinze na Lesotho Correctional Services FC kuri sitade Rufaro. Boban yaje kuza asimbuye Tichaona Mabvura ku munota wa 68.
Umujyi wa Polokwane.
Boban yinjiye mu mujyi wa Polokwane FC mu Kwakira 2014 avuye muri Dynamos. Boban wasimbuye mu gice cya kabiri, yatsinze igitego cya mbere ku mukino wa mbere yakinnye muri Polokwane nyuma y’ubufasha bwa Esau Kanyenda ku munota wa 47 kugira ngo afashe Umujyi wa Polokwane guhagarika Bidvest Wits kuri 2–0 muri shampiyona ya ligue ya ABSA.
Ku ya 24 Nyakanga 2017, Zirintusa yemeye amasezerano n’ikipe yo muri Zambiya yitwa Buildcon Football club.
Ikipi yimikino ya Kawa ya Etiyopiya.
Muri Mutarama 2018, Boban yagiye gukina muri Etiyopiya Coffee Sports Club.
Kirinya - Jinja Amashuri Yisumbuye.
Muri Nzeri 2019, yinjiye muri Kirinya - Jinja Senior Secondary School FC. atangiye gukinara Bul FC.
Muri Mutarama 2020, Boban yongeye gukinira Mtibwa.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Boban yanyuze mu ikipe y'igihugu yu mupira w'amaguru yashyizweho, ikiniye Uganda yabatarengeje imyaka 20, kugeza mu ikipe nkuru, nyamara yatangiye gukinira ikipe ye y'igihugu nkuru mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya Berezile muri 2014 Uganda na Liberiya, ku ya 24 Werurwe 2013 i Samuel K.Doe Sitade Imikino muri Monoroviya.

Ismail Watenga (yavutse 15 Gicurasi 1995) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nk'umuzamu mu ikipe ya Vipers SC
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sredojević, ya mutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’amarushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, kunganya na Zimbabwe, no gutsindwa na Maroke.

Hassan Mawanda Wasswa (yavutse ku ya 14 Gashyantare 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga, ukomoka mu gihugu cya Uganda, ukinira ikipe ya Jeddah yo muri Arabiya Sawudite ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Ku ya 4 Mutarama 2017, Wasswa yimukiye mu ikipe ya Nejmeh yo muri Libani. Ariko, kubera ibibazo by'imvune, ntabwo yagaragaye muri iyi kipe. Muri Kanama 2019, Wasswa yinjiye mu ikipe ya Jeddah Club yo muri Arabiya Sawudite.

Geofrey Wasswa Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nka myugariro muri shampiyona ya Uganda, mu ikipe ya SC Villa hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Umwuga w'urubyiruko.
Wasswa yatangiye umwuga we wu mupira w'amaguru akiri umwana muri Haka Academy, aho yateye imbere mu mupira w'amaguru, mu ishuri ubwo yinjiraga mu mashuri yisumbuye kuri St Mary's Kitende yatorewe kuba umukinnyi mwiza w'iburasirazuba muri shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru ya Airtel Raising Stars. ku ishuri kuri St Marys Kitende, Wasswa yatsinze ibikombe byinshi bya Copa Coca-Cola mu ishuri ndetse na shampiyona y'ishuri rya Afrika y'uburasirazuba.
Yinjiye muri Vipers SC mu 2015 afite imyaka 16. Yakinnye imikino 72 atsinda ibitego 8, muri 2015–16 Wasswa yari mu ikipe ya Junior ariko anakinira Ikipe nkuru. wasswa yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya Vipers SC Senior muri 2016 na Bul FC kuri stade Nakivubo umukino Vipers SC yatsinze igitego 1-0
Yatsindiye ibikombe byinshi hamwe na Vipers SC muri 2018 muri shampiyona ya Uganda.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2016–17, yatsindiye Igikombe cya Uganda kuri Vipers sc maze atorerwa kuba Uganda, umukinnyi ufite impano nziza na Azam abaterankunga ba shampiyona. Yakinnye imikino 18.
Wasswa Geoffrey yagiye agaragara muri Vipers SC ku mugabane ndetse anakina imikino myinshi haba mu gikombe cya CAF Confederations Cup, CAF Champions League na El Merrichk wo muri Sudani ndetse na CS Constantaine wo muri Alijeriya haba mu gihugu ndetse no hanze yacyo.
Wasswa yasinyiye SC Villa muri Mutarama 2021. Ku mukino wa mbere yakiniye kaminuza ya Ndejje University FC, maze yatsinze igitego afasha ikipe ye nshya kujya mu gikombe cya Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku myaka 18, Wasswa Geoffrey yatangiye gukinira amakipe y'abatarengeje imyaka, mu byiciro byinshi nko muri COSAFA, hagati Zambiya ikina Uganda abataregeje imyaka 20, Lesthoso ikina Uganda, Zimbabwe ikina Uganda, hamwe na Uganda ikina Misiri.
Muri Werurwe 2018, Wasswa Geoffrey yakiriye guhamagarwa mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda n'umutoza Sébastien Desabre mu kiruhuko kiri mpuzamahanga ariko ntiyigeze aba mu ikipe ya nyuma ariko anakurikiranwa n'ikipe ya tekinike ya Cranes.

Ivan Wani Adebo Levi (wavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1998), uzwi ku izina rya Ivan Wani, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati, mu ikipe ya Busoga United FC yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Sudani y'Amajyepfo.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Wani ya maze gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Sudani y'Amajyepfo.

Walusimbi Solomon (wavutse 19 Nzeri 1999) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nka rutahizamu mu ikipe ya Maroons FC muri shampiyona ya Uganda.
Walusimbi yatangiye gukina muri Maroons FC ku ya 15 Nzeri 2016, ku munsi wo gutangiza shampiyona nkuru yo muri 2016-17, na Paidha Black Angels kuri sitade Bar Okoro mu karere ka Zombo, maze umukino urangira banganyije ibitego 2-2. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Maroons FC ku ya 13 Ukwakira 2016 ku munota wa 82 bakina na Bright Light FC, Maroons FC yatsinze ibitego 2-0. Yatsinze igitego cyenda mu kwiyamamaza atsinda Sporting United ibitego 4-1 muri FUFA. Mu mukino wanyuma wo muri 2016/17 FUFA, Walusimbi yatsinze igitego cyatsinze Maroons FC bityo azamurwa muri Uganda muri 2017-2018. Yatsinze ibitego 9 byose muri Maroons FC mu gihe cyo kwiyamamaza Big League.
Ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2017, Walusimbi yerekanye bwa mbere muri shampiyona muri Uganda, ubwo yinjiraga nk'umusimbura ku munota wa 72 wa William Wadri maze atsinda igitego ku munota wa 78 bakina na Masavu FC, Maroons FC yatsinze igitego 1-0. Muri shampiyona ya mbere ya Uganda yatsinze ibitego bitanu mu mikino 24 ya shampiyona.

Godfrey Walusimbi (wavutse ku ya 3 Nyakanga 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi w'ibumoso mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda. Niwe mukinnyi wa mbere ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda wakinnye imikino mpuzamahanga irenga 100.
Muri Kamena 2011, Walusimbi yagiye muri Suwede mu igeragezwa, ryi byumweru bibiri hamwe n'ikipe ya Allsvenskan kuruhande rwa BK Häcken.
Muri Mutarama 2013, yavuye i Bunamwaya yerekeza muri DR Congo muri CS Don Bosco. Amaze amezi make hamwe nikipe, yahagaritse amasezerano ye bitewe n'umusaruro mucye. Yagarutse mu ikipe yahoze yitwa SC Villa.
Mu Kuboza 2013, Walusimbi yinjiye muri Shampiyona yo muri Kenya mu ikipe ya Gor Mahia aho yatozwaga na Bobby Williamson wahoze atoza ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Abayobozi ba Kaizer.
Muri Kanama 2018, Walusimbi yimukiye mu ikipe ya Kaizer Chiefs yo muri Afurika y'Epfo yo mu cyiciro cya mbere, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka itatu. Ikiguzi cyo kwimura cyari hafi miliyoni 4.4 z'amafaranga y'Afurika y'Epfo. Yatangiye gukina shampiyona muri iyi kipe ku ya 18 Nzeri 2018, akina iminota mirongo icyenda yose yatsinze ibitego 2-0 bahanganye na Free State Stars. Muri Mutarama 2019, Walusimbi yavuye muri iyo kipe, ahitamo gusubira gukina mu rugo muri Uganda.
Muri Nzeri 2019, Walusimbi yinjiye mu ikipe ya KF Vllaznia Shkodër yo muri Alubaniya Superliga ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe. Yavuye muri iyo kipe shampiyona irangiye.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 4 Nzeri 2010, Walusimbi yerekeje mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu mukino wo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika muri 2012 na Angola mu rwego rwo gusimbura Nestory Kizito wakomeretse. Ku ya 16 Mata 2011, yafashije Ikipe ya Uganda yabatarengeje imyaka 23 gutsinda ibitego 2-1 byatsinzwe na Tanzaniya mu majonjora yo gukina imikino ya Afurika yose yitwaye neza aho yatsindiye igitego cya mbere akoresheje imirimo yo guhanga ku ruhande rw'ibumoso. Ku ya 4 Kamena 2011, yatsinze Gineya-Bisawu mu mukino ukomeye wo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2012. Igitego nicyo cya mbere mu gutsinda ibitego 2-0 kuri cranes ya babonye iri mu itsinda rya mbere rya J imbere ya Stade y'igihugu ya Mandela yuzuye.

Enock Walusimbi (wavutse ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 1998) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa Uganda ukina nka myugariro muri shampiyona ya Scotthead League One mu ikipe ya Peterhead ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Walusimbi yavukiye i Kampala.
Nyuma yo gukina na Shafranto na Nansana United, Walusimbi yakiniye Bright Stars hagati muri 2016 na 2020. Walusimbi yasinyiye Express FC ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri muri Nzeri 2020, maze ahabwa kapiteni w'iyi kipe mbere ya shampiyona yo muri 2020–21. Yatsinze muri shampiyona ya Uganda Premier League muri cyiciro cya mbere hamwe na Express.
Mu mpeshyi 2022, byavuzwe ko Walusimbi yakoreye ibizamini muri ikipe ya Dundee United yo muri shampiyona ya Scottish Premiership. Walusimbi yasinye muri Scottish League One mu ikipe ya Peterhead muri Nzeri 2022.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Amaze kuyobora kapiteni wa Uganda abatarengeje imyaka 23, yakinnye bwa mbere muri Uganda ku ya 29 Kanama 2021 ubwo yatsindwaga na gicuti bakina na Etiyopiya 2–1.

Moses Waiswa Ndhondhi (wavutse ku ya 20 Mata 1997) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya SuperSport United, nk'umukinnyi wo hagati utera.
Yavukiye i Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu ikipe ya Växjö United hamwe na Vipers. Yasinyiye Vipers muri Mutarama 2017. Yatsindiye Shampiyona yo muri Uganda muri 2017–18 hamwe niyi kipe. Muri Mutarama 2020 yasinyiye ikipe ya SuperSport United yo muri Afrika yepfo. Ku ya 25 Mutarama 2020 yatangiye gukinira SuperSport United na Chippa United.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2017. Yatsinze igitegocya mbere nyuma yo guhamagarwa mu ikipe yi gihugu.

Innocent Esimu Wafula (wavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1998) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nka myugariro muri shampiyona uganda ya Premier League mu ikipe ya KCCA FC ndetse nikipe yigihugu ya Uganda.
Wafula yinjiye muri Chemelil Sugar muri 2014 maze atangira gukinira Muhoroni youth, ku ya 22 Gashyantare 2014. Chemelil Sugar yatsinze 2–0 Wafula atanga imipira yavuyemo ibitego. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere kuri Chemelil Sugar bakina na Tusker ku ya 23 Mata 2014 kuri Sitade ya Ruaraka i Nayirobi.
Wafula yinjiye muri Gor Mahia muri 2015 avuye muri Chemelil Sugar. Mu mukino wa mbere yakinnye batsinze KCB umukino urangira ari 1-0. Muri Mutarama 2017 yasinye amasezerano mashya y'imyaka ibiri muri Gor Mahia. Ku ya 17 Nzeri 2017, Wafula yatsinze igitego kitazibagirana muri Gor Mahia ikina na SoNy Sugar kuri Stade y'igihugu ya Nyayo, nibwo Gor Mahia itigeze iba ku nshuro ya 15 y'igikombe cya shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Kenya bityo itwara umwaka wa gatatu ukurikirana.
Wafula yinjiye muri Vipers SC muri Mutarama 2019 asinya amasezerano y'imyaka itatu.,
Wafula yinjiye muri Mbarara City FC muri Mutarama 2021, avuye muri Vipers SC ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe. Yatangiye bwa mbere ku ya 13 Mata 2021 na MYDA.
Ku ya 24 Kanama 2021, Wafula yasinyanye amasezerano y'umwaka na KCCA FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Wafula yatangiye gukinira mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 6 Nzeri 2021 bakina na Mali mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi muri 2022, ubwo yinjiraga nk'umusimbura wasimbuye Emmanuel Okwi ku munota wa 69. Umukino wabereye kuri Stade ya St Mary-Kitende urangira 0–0.
Wafula yabyawe na nyakwigendera Bwire Ogutu na Mary Omoding bo mu Karere ka Busia.

Minisiteri ishinzwe imicungire y'ibiza n'impunzi ("Ministry of Disaster Management and Refugee Affairs", MIDIMAR) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe gukumira no guhangana n'ibiza. Ishinzwe kandi ibibazo by'impunzi.
Ubu iyi minisiteri yitwa MINEMA ("Ministry in Charge of Emergency Management"). Kuva muri Kanama 2023, Minisitiri wayo ni Albert Murasira.
Icyerekezo cya MINEMA ni igihugu gishobora guhangana n'ibiza, kandi gicunga neza ibibazo by'impunzi.
MINEMA ishinzwe gukumira ibiza, kugabanya ingaruka zabyo, gutabara, no gusana nyuma y'ibiza. Ibyo biza birimo imyuzure, imitingito n'inkangu. Ishinzwe kandi politiki y'impunzi ihuje n'amategeko y'u Rwanda n'amasezerano mpuzamahanga.
Inshingano z'ingenzi za MINEMA ni izi:
Marcel Gatsinzi yatangiye kuyobora iyi minisiteri ku wa 12 Mata 2010.
Ku wa 22 Kanama 2023, Albert Murasira yagizwe Minisitiri ushinzwe MINEMA. Yasimbuye Solange Kayisire. Mbere yaho, Murasira yari Minisitiri w'Ingabo kugeza muri Kamena 2023. Muri Nyakanga 2026, yari akiri Minisitiri wa MINEMA.

Nicholas Wadada Wakiro (wavutse 27 Nyakanga 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nk'umukinyi w'iburyo wa Azam FC yo muri Tanzaniya ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Wadada yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru, akiri urubyiruko afite imyaka 13 mu ikipe ya Lukuli United muri 2007. Nyuma yaje kwinjira muri Kitende ya Mutagatifu Mariya muri 2010, maze muri uwo mwaka yinjira muri shampiyona ya Uganda Super League, mu ikipe ya Bunamwaya FC (ubu ni Vipers SC).
Wadada yinjiye muri Bunamwaya FC mu mwaka wa 2010, afite imyaka 16 yari umukinnyi ukina iburyo inyuma mu kibuga.
Muri shampiyona ya 2011–12 Wadada yabaye umukinnyi udasanzwe yari mu ikipe yarangije kumwanya wa kabiri muri shampiyona ya Uganda Super League 2011–12.
Muri 2012–13 Wadada yakinnye imikino 20 ya shampiyona, mu gihe Bunamwaya yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu muri shampiyona ya Uganda Premier League.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Wadada yari mu bakinnyi agera kuri 23 bageze muri AFCON yo muri 2017 i Gaboni. Yatangiye umukino umwe akaza gusimburwa mu mukino na Misiri.
Yakinnye imikino itandatu mu majonjora yimikino y'igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2018, bakina na Misiri, Gana na Repubulika ya Kongo.
Wadada yatsinze igitego mu mukino bakina na Niger ku ya 2 Kamena 2018 mu marushanwa y’ibihugu bitatu yabereye i Niamey.

Brian Umony (wavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i Jinja, muri Uganda ukinira Kampala City Council FC. Kuva mu 2009, yabaye kandi umukinyi mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Umony yavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1988 i Jinja kuri Francis Kermit na Loise Uwanchango, ni umuhererezi mu bana bane. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa nyina muri 1997, yimukiye i Kampala kubana na nyirarume. Yatangiye gukina umupira akiri muto,akora cyane no kugera mu m'akipe y’ishuri kuko yahoraga yirengagizwa kuberako yari muto.
Muri Gashyantare 2011, amaze kwitoza hamwe niyi kipe mu gihe cyabanjirije shampiyona, Umony yasinyanye amasezerano y’intizanyo y’umwaka umwe na Portland Timbers umwaka wa mbere muri Shampiyona nkuru ya Major league.
Nyuma y'igihembwe cya 2011, Ibiti byatangaje ko banze guhitamo kugura uburenganzira bwa Umony kandi ko atazagaruka muri shampiyona 2012.
Muri Mutarama 2012, Umony yasinyanye n'ikipe ya Vietiname yaje yahindutse Becamex Binh Duong.
Muri ukuboza 2012, Umony yasinye amasazerano y'imwaka ibiri muri Tanzaniya mu ikipe ya Azam F.C.
Muri Mata 2018, Umony yimukiye gukina mu Buhinde muri shampiyona ya I-League asinyana n'ikipe ya Gokulam Kerala FC ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Umony yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda muri 2009. Yatsinze mu gikombe cya CECAFA cyo muri 2008, ibitego bitanu byafashije igihugu cye gutwara igikombe cya 10 cya CECAFA.
Umony yarangije muri kaminuza ya Kyambogo. Akunda gusoma imirimo yo Shakespeare.

Basil Tenywa Tuma (yavutse ku ya 24 Mata 2005) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Maltese muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi muri shampiyona ya EFL mu ikipe ya Reading. Nubwo yavukiye muri Uganda, umuryango we w'imukiye i Berkshire akiri muto.
Umwuga wumupira wamaguru.
Tuma yerekeje bwa mbere mu mukino wa EFL Cup 2-1 batsinzwe na Stevenage ku ya 9 Kanama 2022, akina iminota 55 mbere yo gusimburwa na Jahmari Clarke.
Tuma yaserukiye Uganda muri Shampiyona ya CECAFA yabatarengeje imyaka 17 muri 2020, aho batsinze muriTanzaniya ku mukino wa nyuma. Tuma yahamagawe muri Malta yabatarengeje imyaka 19 muri Nzeri 2022.
Imikino ngororamubiri.
Tuma yize muri Eton College arangiza ari kumwanya wa 3 muri Junior y'abahungu muri metero 100, muri Shampiyona ya ESAA y'Amashuri Yisumbuye ya Track &amp; Field 2019, hamwe n'amasegonda 11.23.

Charles Tibingana Mwesigye (wavutse ku ya 28 Kanama 1994) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wakinaga nk'umukinnyi ukina kuruhande iburyo. Yavukiye muri Uganda, yaginiye u Rwanda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Tibingana yavukiye i Mbarara, muri Uganda, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu ikipe ya Proline, Victoria Unversity, APR FC, Bullets, AS Kigali na Yala United.
Yatangiye gukinira imikino mpuzamahanga mu Rwanda muri 2011, yaje twitabira igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyabatarengeje imwaka 17 muri 2011.

Abubaker Tabula (wavutse 12 kamena 1980) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda akaba ari umutoza. Yahoze ari umukinnyi mu ikipe y’umupira wamaguru ya Uganda "Uganda Cranes" ndetse anayibera kapiteni iyi kipe muri 2005.
Yari Myugariro yakinnye muri SC Villa muri 2001, Kampala City Council FC muri 2005 Proline FC yo muri 2013, Simba FC,hamwe na ikipe zo mu Rwanda nka APR FC muri 2007 ndetse vuba aha muri Suwede muri GIF Sundsvall.
Kuri ubu Tabula atoza Maroons FC yo muri Uganda. Ni umwe mu kinaga inyuma kuruhande muri Uganda beza.
Yibukako atazibagirwa uko batsinzwe nu Rwanda muri 2004, kuri stade ya Namboole, rukina Afcon bw'ambere.

Phillip Ssozi (yavutse ku ya 23 Nyakanga 1982) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru i Kampala muri Uganda.
Phillip yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Uganda ayoboye ikipe ya Villa SC, amaze gutwara Shampiyona eshanu zikurikirana. Ukuboza muri 2003 yimukiye i Burayi, gukina muri Seribiya muri Shampiyona ya mbere ya Seribiya (ubwo ni cyiciro cya 2 cya Seribiya). Iyo kipe izwiho kuzana abakinnyi benshi ba Uganda mu i Burayi, ariko nyuma yo kurangiza icyo gihembwe, Ssozi yagarutse muri Afurika, kuri iyi nshuro akinira mu ikipe ikomeye yo mu Rwanda ya APR FC kuva mu murwa mukuru w’iki gihugu Kigali. Ngaho yatsinze muri uwo mwaka wa 2005, Shampiyona yu Rwanda. Nyuma yi cyo gihembwe, yagarutse muri Uganda aho yakinnye bwa mbere muri Victor FC ya Kampala, kuva 2007 akinira mu yindi kipe y’umurwa mukuru, ya Express Red Eagles.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kuva mu 1999, Ssozi yakinnye imikino 22 mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda, atsinda ibitego 2.

Sam Ssimbwa (wavutse 1967) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Uganda, ubu akaba ari umutoza.
Yakiniye amakipe atatu: nka KK Cosmos muri 1986, KCC FC muri 1987 kugeza 1995 na Mbale Intwari FC muri 1999 kugeza 2000. Yakinnye kandi mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Yatoje amakipe nka Health FC (1998), na Mbale Intwari FC (1999-2000), na Masaka LC FC (2001), Polisi ya Gisirikare FC muri (2002), na KCC FC (kabiri 2002 &amp; 2009), Top TV FC (2003-2004), Rwanda ATRACO FC (2006), Express FC (2007), Simba SC (2008) na Kenya Sofapaka FC (2009-2010).
Kuva mu Gushyingo kugeza Ukuboza 2012 yatoje ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Somaliya. Mbere yari umutoza mukuru wa kaminuza ya SC Victoria. Nyuma yaje gutoza ikipe ya Express FC na Police FC yo mu Rwanda Ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2014 SC Villa yashyizeho Ssimbwa nk'umutoza.

Steven Sserwadda (wavutse ku ya 28 Kanama 2002) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati mukibuga, muri shampiyona ya League soccer mu ikipe nkuru y’umupira w'amaguru ya New York Red Bulls ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Sserwadda yavukiye i Kampala, yatangiye gukina mu rubyiruko rw’ikipe ya Kampala Capital City Authority FC muri 2015. Muri 2018 yazamuwe mu ikipe ya mbere ya KCCA nyuma yo kuzamuka mu ntera y'a makipe y'urubyiruko. Nyuma y'amezi make, yagaragaye bwa mbere mu makipe mpuzamahanga mu gikombe cya CAF Confederation Cup yo muri 2018–19 yabatsinze ikipe yo muri Tanzaniya,ya Mtibwa Sugar. Muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu gikombe cya Uganda, Sserwadda yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu bitego bigera 9-0 batsinze ikipe ya Synergy FC. Mu gihe yari kumwe niyi kipe yatsindiye ibikombe bitandukanye, harimo: Igikombe kimwe cya Kagame Interclub, igikombe kimwe cya Uganda Premier League, na 2 Super, n'igikombe cya Super 8.
Ku ya 30 Nzeri 2021, Sserwadda yinjiye muri Shampiyona ya USLmu ikipe ya New York Red Bulls II. Sserwadda yatangiye gukinira Red Bulls II ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2021, ubwo yanganyaga na Tampa Bay Rowdies igitego 1-1. Ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2022, Sserwadda yatsinze igitego cya mbere hamwe na New York Red Bulls II ubwo yatsirwaga na New Mexico United 1-2. Ku ya 9 Kanama 2022, Sserwadda yatsinze igitego cyo kunganya intsinzi ya Atlanta United 2-1.
New York Red Bulls (intizanyo).
Ku ya 22 Kamena 2022, New York Red Bulls yatangaje ko basinyanye na Sserwadda ku ntizanyo y'igihe gito, mbere yogukina yuko kimwe cya kane kirangiza muri Amerika ya 2022 bakina na New York City FC. Sserwadda yerekeje mu ikipe ya mbere muri Red Bulls umunsi umwe asimbuye Luquinhas ku munota wa 84.
Muri New York Red Bulls.
Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2022, Sswerwadda y'imukiye burundu kuri Red Bulls ku rutonde rw'amakipe ya mbere.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Sserwadda yagaragaye mu mikino itandatu yose yakiniye Uganda mu gikombe cy'ibihugu cyo 2021 bya Afrika abaterengeje imyaka 20. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu matsinda, agira uruhare runini mu kwiruka ku mukino wa nyuma. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu mukino wa gicuti 1–1 (5–4) yatsinze Tajikistan ku ya 25 Werurwe 2022.

Simon Peter Sserunkuma (wavutse 19 Nzeri 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipea ya Simba SC yo muri Premier League ya Tanzaniya.
Yatangiye bwa mbere muri shampiyona yo muri 2007 mu mukino yakinnye na Kampala City Council FC. Mu gihe yamaranye na Victors FC yabatsindiye Super League muri 2008, ni umukinnyi ufite agaciro n'igikombe cya Uganda mu mwaka umwe.
Yabaye umukinnyi uhenze cyane mu mateka ya Uganda ubwo SC Villa yishyuraga Victors FC miliyoni 16 z'amashiringi ($ 10,000) muri Gicurasi muri 2009.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Sserunkuma yerekeje mu ikipe y'igihugu ubwo yatozwaga na Bobby Williamson baje gutsinda Malawi ibitego 2-1. Muri Werurwe 2010, yaje gukira imvune yari yakomeretse kugira ngo abashe kujya mu majonjora yo guhatanira itike yo guhatanira kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika cya (CHAN) bakinnye n'Uburundi aho yagize uruhare rukomeye mu gutsinda iyi kipe y'igihugu.

Geoffrey Sserunkuma (ku ya 7 Kamena 1983) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri uganda wa bigize umwuga, ukina muri Wakiso FC hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya uganda nka rutahizamu.
Sserukuma akina nka rutahizamu, yakiniye ikipe ya Polisi Jinja. Yishimiye gutsinda ari muri Kampala City Council FC mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Saint-George SA yo muri Etiyopiya muri shampiyyona ya Premier League muri Nyakanga 2007. Mu mpeshyi 2008, yavuye muri ikipe ya Addis Ababa yimukira muri Bloemfontein Celtic. Muri Nyakanga 2009, yavuye muri Bloemfontein Celtic kwimukira i Vasco Da Gama, nyuma yo guterana amagambo n'umuyobozi wa Celtic, Owen da Gama.
Ku ya 6 Mata 2010, Sserunkuma yasinyiye ikipe ya Bidvest Wits yemera amasezerano y'iyi kipe imyaka ibiri.
Ariko, yagarutse muri Vasco Da Gama muri gihmbwe cya yakurikiyeho, akina mu cyiciro cya kabiri nyuma yo gusezererwa kwi kipe kuva mu isonga.
Ikipe yumupira wamaguru ya Lweza.
Muri 2015, Sserunkuma yinjiye muri Lweza FC. Sserunkuma yakinnye shampiyona yo muri Lweza FC atsinda ibitego umunani muri icyo gihembwe.
Muri Nyakanga 2017, Sserunkuma yinjiye muri Buildcon FC Ku ya 12 Kanama, Sserunkuma yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Buildcon FC na Lusaka Dynamos mu mukino wa shampiyona wa bereye kuri Stade Levy Mwanawasa.
Yakiniye NAPSA Stars FC FC igihembwe kimwe.
Ku ya 7 Kanama 2019, Sserunkuma yinjiye mu gukina muri Wakiso Giants FC.

Daniel Sserunkuma uzwi ku izina rya Muzenyi (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i Kampala muri Uganda, kuri ubu ukina nka rutahizamu muri Vipers SC n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ("Cranes").
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Sserunkuma yavukiye kandi akurira mu gice cya Lubaga cyo mu karere ka Kampala. Yize mu ishuri rya Mutagatifu Mariya i Kitende ryanabyaye abakinnyi ba Uganda nka David Obua, Eric Obua, Emmanuel Okwi na Ibrahim Juma.
Mu Gushyingo 2013, Sserunkuma yateje impagarara muri iyi kipe atanga ku mugaragaro icyifuzo cyo kwimura, agaragaza ko yifuza kujya mu ikipe ya FC Banants yo muri Arumeniya. Ariko, umukinnyi ntiyari yemerewe kuva muri iyo kipe.
Muri 2014, niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona yi cyiciro cya mbere cya Kenya muri 2014 yatsinze ibitego 16.
Ukuboza 2014, Sserunkuma yimukiye ku buntu mu bihangange byo muri Tanzaniya cya Simba. Yahagaritse amasezerano yagiranye ni yi kipe ku bwumvikane nyuma y’amezi atanu gusa muri shampiyona ya Tanzaniya Premier League.
Ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2015, hatangajwe ko Sserunkuma yinjiye mu ikipe ya Ulisses yo muri Arumeniya ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Muri Nzeri 2017, Dan yinjiye muri Express FC. Dan yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Express yakinnye na Maroons Football Club ku ya 27 Nzeri 2017
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Gashyantare 2013, Sserunkuma yakiriye ikipe ya mbere ihamagarira muri Cranes ya Uganda. Mu mukino we wa mbere yakinnye nu Rwanda, yatsinze igitego kimwe kuri penariti m ugihe yatanze umupira uvamo igitego kindi.

Michael Sserumaga (wavutse ku ya 3 Kanama 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i Kampala muri Uganda, ukinira SC Villa.
Yatangiye gukina muri Polisi Jinja mbere yo kwimukira muri Kanama 2007, mu rubyiruko uruhande rwa Helsingborgs. Yazamuwe mu ikipe nkuru muri shampiyona yo muri 2008. Icyakora mu myitozo hamwe n’ikipe ya Uganda KB Intare, y'agize imvune ikomeye y'amaguru y'amaze hafi umwaka.
Muri Nzeri 2009, Sserumagga yasinyanye amasezerano y'umwaka umwe na Uganda Revenue Authority SC, nyuma yo kugira ngo yisubireho kandi abone gusubira mu Burayi. bahagarariye muri shampiyona ya Caf Champions League muri Uganda na Bunamwaya SC basinyishije Sserumaga amasezerano y'amezi 6.
Muri Gashyantare 2011, yinjiye mu ikipe y'u Rwanda mu ikipe ya Rayon Sport fc.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ku ya 8 Kamena 2008 yakina na Benin.

Andrew Eugene Sseppuya (yavutse 1 Mata 1983) ni rutahizamu ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda. Sseppuya yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Sseppuya yarangije kwerekeza mu ikipe yu mupira w'amaguru ya Arumeniya FC Banants kumafaranga atazwi. Nyuma yi cyiciro cya shampiyona cya shampiyona ya 2007, yarekuwe atagaragara muri shampiyona. Nyuma yinjiye mu ikipe ya Seribiya FK Vojvodina. Mu gihe cy'itumba 2008–09 idirishya, yinjiye muri FK Čukarički. Mu mpera za Mata 2009, ni we watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona ya Superliga yo muri Seribiya 2008–09, akaba yarakinnye umukino umwe na Vojvodina na 11 kuri Čukarički mu gihe yatsinze ibitego birindwi, byose bikaba bivuze ko igitego kimwe kuri buri minota 114 kuri ikibuga.
Mu Kwakira 2009, yasinye amasezerano yu mwaka umwe muri FK Mladi Radnik. Ku ya 16 Werurwe 2010, Sseppuya yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yo muri Lituwaniya yitwa FK Sūduva. Ku ya 1 Kanama 2010, Sseppuya yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya A-League mu ikipe y'Amajyaruguru ya Queensland Fury bituma aba umukinnyi wa 20 w'iyi kipe wasinyiye shampiyona itaha. Sseppuya yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri Fury mumikino yabo 3, 2-2 banganya na Melbourne Victory. Yarekuwe muri Fury nyuma yuko ikipe yikubye.
Mu mpera za Werurwe 2011, ya sinyanye amasezerano n’ikipe ya Petrolul Ploiești yo muri Rumaniya muri Liga II. Yarekuwe muri iyi kipe mu mpeshyi, nyuma yuko iyi kipe imaze kuzamuka muri Liga I. Mu ntangiriro za Nzeri 2011 yasubiye muri Seribiya maze asinyana amasezerano y’imyaka 2 na FK Borac Čačak. Azaboneka muri iyi kipe mu cyiciro cya 5 cya SuperLiga ya 2011–12.
Muri Nyakanga 2012, nyuma yo gusezererwa kwa Borac muri shampiyona ya SuperLiga, Sseppuya yakoze igeragerwa muri Boyacá Chico, nubwo nyuma amaherezo yasinywe muri FK Jedinstvo Bijelo Polje muri Shampiyona yambere ya Montenegrin.
Sseppuya yatsinze ibitego 3 mu mikino 4 yakiniye FC Istiklol mbere yuko arekurwa niyi kipe muri Mutarama 2014.

Robert Ssentongo (wavutse ku ya 5 Kamena 1988) Ni umkinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Kyetume FC, nka rutahizamu.
Ssentongo yavukiye i Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu ikipe ya Simba, SC Villa, Kampala City Council, Brabrand, Lyon African, URA, Saint George, Fasil Kenema, na Kyetume FC.
Yatsinze ibitego 3 mu mukino, yo muri shampiyona ya FUFA Big League, yo kuzamura imikino yanyuma yo muri 2019 kugirango afashe Kyetume FC kubona kuzamurwa mu ntera yambere ku nshuro yambere.
Muri 2018 yasinyiye ikipe ya Kyetume FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira muri mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2004, kandi yagaragaye mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA. Niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Cecafa, mu gilombe cya Challenge muri 2012. Yabaye umwe mu bakinnyi muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2016.

Titus Ssematimba (wavutse 15 Kanama 2003) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukinira Wakiso Giants FC muri Premier League ya Uganda ndetse n'ikipe yigihugu ya Uganda nku mukinnyi wo hagati wataka i zamu. Muri Shampiyona yo muri 2022 muri CECAFA mu bataewnge imyaka 20 yabereye, muri Sudani, Ssematimba yagizwe umukinnyi w’iri rushanwa.
Muri Nzeri 2021, Ssematimba yamuritswe muri Wakiso Giants FC avuye mu karere ka Black Star FC mu karere ka Kampala. Ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 2021, yatangiye gukinira ikipe ye ya Wakiso Giants FC ubwo yoherezwaga muri SC Villa ibitego 3-1 mu kigo cy’imyidagaduro cya Kavumba aho yatsindiye umupira muri uwo mukino.
Ssematimba yakiniye Uganda yabatarengeje imyaka 20 mu gikombe cyo muri 2022 uri CECAFA yabataregeje 20 cyabereye yo muri Sudani muri 2022. Yatangiye bwa mbere ku ya 29 Ukwakira 2022, ahanganye na Tanzaniya abatarengeje 20 kuri Stade ya Al-Hilal, Omdurman.
Ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Ku ya 21 Nzeri 2022, Ssematimba yerekeje bwa mbere muri Uganda mu marushanwa ya Tri-national yakininye na Uganda.
Ssematimba yabyawe na Godfrey Kibuka Semuwemba na Bridget Nabulya Ssematimba. Amashuri abanza yatangiriye mu ishuri ry’incuke rya Golden Age, Kibuye maze yinjira mu ishuri ribanza rya Kyagwe mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri ribanza ry’Urwibutso rwa Yusuf Banaziyo, Najjanankumbi ku muhanda wa Entebbe. Amashuri yisumbuye, yize amasomo ye asanzwe na muri College ya London.

Erisa Ssekisambu (wavutse ku ya 28 Kanama 1995) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukinira mu ikipe ya Kiyovu sports muri Shampiyona y'u Rwanda ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga.
Ssekisambu yagiye agaragara mu makipe atandukanye yo muri Uganda nka SC Villa, Express FC, Uganda Revenue Authority SC, Vipers SC ndetse yakinnye muri KCCA FC.
Ssekisambu yinjiye muri Express muri Mutarama 2012. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere ku ya 22 Gashyantare 2012 na Water FC umukino urangira ari 0–0. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere yatsinze Masaka Local Council FC ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2012 naho Express yatsinze igitego 1-0.
Uganda Revenue Authority SC.
Muri Kamena 2012, Ssekisambu yinjiye muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC avuye muri Express fc.
Ssekisambu yagarutse muri SC Villa muri 2015. Yakinnye na Soana FC nku mukino w'ambere agarutse muri SC Villa. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya shampiyona na Express maze umukino urangira utsinze na SC Villa 2–1.
Muri Nyakanga 2015, Ssekisambu yimukiye muri Vipers SC muri 2015., Yakinnye umukino wa mbere na Bidco FC, Vipers SC yatsinze igitego 1-0. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri Vipers SC yatsinze Saints FC. Ssekisambu yarangije shampiyona yatsinze ibitego 16 nubwo hari abanyabwenge bavuga ko yatsinze 17 muri shampiyona ya Uganda Premier League yo muri 2015–16 Sekisambu yatsinze igitego cyamateka kuri Vipers SC na Enyimba FC ku ya 12 Gashyantare 2016 mu cyiciro kibanza. icyiciro cya CAF Champions League umukino ubanza.
Ku ya 1 Ugushyingo 2018, hatangajwe ko Ssekisambu yinjiye mu ikipe ya Gor Mahia yo muri Kenya ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Ku ya 16 Gashyantare 2019 yatsinze Hattrick ye ya mbere kuri Gor Mahia na Mount Kenya United.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 20 Kamena 2015, yakinnye bwa mbere muri Uganda na Tanzaniya maze atsinda ibitego 2 ku ncuro ya mbere. Yari umwe mu ba star bamurika muri Final ya CHAN 2016 yabereye mu Rwanda ubwo yatsindaga ibitego 2-2 na Mali.
Muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2014, Erisa niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Uganda.

Robert Ssejjemba (wavutse ku ya 5 Ukuboza 1980) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ni umutoza usanzwe muri gahunda y’umupira w'amaguru w’abagabo ya kaminuza ya Wayland Baptist.
Mu mpera zumwaka wo muri 2006, muri Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru yatangirijwe imwe muri DC United, ariko ntabwo yasinywe amasezerano y'umwuga nabo. Nyuma yakinnye muri shampiyona yo muri 2007 na Richmond Kickers mbere yo kwerekeza muri Charlotte Eagles muri shampiyona yo muri 2008. Ku mukino wa nyuma wa USL wo mu cyiciro cya kabiri cyo muri 2008 hamwe na Eagles, ariko,yagize imvune ari muri ACL yatumwe arangiza umwuga wo gukina Ssejjemba. Yagaragaye mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda inshuro nyinshi, harimo n'amajonjora yo kujya mu gikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2006.
Mu 2009, yabaye umutoza mukuru wa gahunda y'umupira w'amaguru mu bagabo yasubukuwe muri kaminuza ya Virginia Intermont College, ari mwarimu. Nyuma, yabaye umutoza mukuru w'ikipe y'abagabo ya kaminuza y’amajyepfo y’iburengerazuba kuva muri 2014 kugeza 2019. Muri 2019, yabaye umutoza mukuru wa kaminuza ya Batisita ya Wayland.

Godfrey Ssali (yavutse ku ya 6 Gashyantare 1977) ni umukinnyi ukina hagati mu kibuga mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina mu ikipe ya Express FC yo muri Uganda.
Yatangiye umwuga we na Polisi Jinja muri shampiyona ya Premier League ya Uganda, mbere yo muri 2004 y'imukira muri Express FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yakinnye kuva 2003 kugeza hagati muri 2004 mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.

Pione Sisto Ifolo Emirmija (yavutse 4 Gashyantare 1995) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri shampiyona ya Danemarike ukina nk'umukinnyi w’ibumoso, mu ikipe ya Midtjylland yo muri Danemarike.
Yatangiye umwuga we w'abigize umwuga hamwe na Midtjylland yo muri shampiyona ya Danemarike Superliga, amaze kugaragara imikino114 yose ndetse atsinda ibitego 31 muri shampiyona eshanu. Muri 2016 yimukiye muri Celta Vigo kumafaranga miliyoni 5 zama euro, aho yatsinze ibitego 18 m'umikino 135. Muri 2020, yagarutse muri Midtjylland kuri miliyoni 3 z'amayero.
Sisto yagaragaye bwa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Danemarike muri 2015, kandi yari mu bakinnyi babo mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA muri 2018.
Pione Sisto yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda, avukira mu muryango ukomoka muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo. Umuryango wa Sisto w'imukiye muri Danimarike afite amezi abiri. Yagaragaye na Tjørring NIBA muri 2002, afite imyaka irindwi, y'imukira mu rubyiruko rwa FC Midtjylland muri 2010.
Yatsindiye Midtjylland ikina na Manchester United itsinze iwayo ibitego 2-1 muri Europa League ku ya 18 Gashyantare muri 2016. Yatsinze kandi igitego cyo gufungura umukino wa kabiri kuri Old Trafford mbere yuko Midtjylland ikomeza gutsindwa 5–1 (6–3 kuri rusange) na United maze yanga kuva muri Europa League.

Muhammad Shaban (wavutse 11 Mutarama 1998) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukomka muri Uganda ukinira muri Onduparaka, nka rutahizamu.
Shaban yavukiye muri Arua, Shaban yasinye amasezerano na Vipers muri 2015, ariko biba impfabusa maze asinyira Onduparaka. Yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka itatu na Kampala Capital City Authority muri Kwakira 2017, atsinda igitego cya mbere nyuma y'ukwezi. Muri Kanama 2018, yajwe kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo ya Orlando Pirates na Raja Casablanca yo muri Maroke. Yasinyiye Raja Casablanca muri shampiyona yo muri 2018–19, akina shampiyona 5, mbere yo gusubira muri Vipers muri Kanama 2019.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira mpuzamahanga mu 2016, kandi yashyizwe mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika 2017.

Yunus Sentamu (wavutse 13 Kanama 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nkimbere..
Muri Nyakanga 2016, Sentamu yasonewe gukinira muri FC Ilves muri Veikkausliiga nyuma yo gukemura ibibazo bya visa, kuko yari yarasinyanye amasezerano muri Mutarama 2016.
Ku ya 19 Kamena 2017, Sentamu yimukiye muri Tirana mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Alubaniya. Yatangiye umukino ubanza mu mukino ubanza muri 2017–18 muri UEFA Europa League icyiciro cya mbere cyamajonjora, yakinnye na Maccabi Tel Aviv maze Tirana yatsinzwe ibitego 2-0. Yakinnye i mu mukino wagarutse kuri Stade ya Selman Stërmasi, ahabwa ikarita itukura kubera ikosa kuko Tirana yatsinzwe ibitego 3–0, maze basezererwa kuri 5–0 yose hamwe.
Sentamu yayoboye Tirana bwa mbere ku ya 25 Ugushyingo mu kunganya igitego 1-1 na Shënkolli ku mukino wa shampionat wa 9. Icyakora, icyemezo cy'ikipe cyo kumugira kapiteni w'umukino cya maganiwe cyane na bafana. Umuyobozi Zé Maria yaburanye amahitamo ye kandi anashimira Sentamu, amwita "urugero kuri bose". Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere cya shampiyona ku ya 17 Ukuboza mu mukino wa 6–0 wa Pogradeci wemewe ku munsi wa 11. Mu mukino uheruka wa 2017, Sentamu yatsinze penariti yatsinzwe na Karabeci kandi we ubwe yatsinze igitego cya gatatu mu gutsinda 0-4 kuri Naftëtari Kuçovë abaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa Tirana wageze ku mibare ibiri muri shampiyona ya 2017–18.
Sentamu yashoje shampiyona ye ya mbere muri Alubaniya atsinze ibitego 12 m'umikino 19 yakinnye shampiyona kuko Tirana yatwaye shampiyona w’icyiciro cya mbere muri Alubaniya nyuma yo gutsinda Kastrioti Krujë ku ya 16 Gicurasi 2018.

Nelson Senkatuka (yavutse ku ya 10 Nzeri 1997) Ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri uganda ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Bright stars FC muri shampiyona ya uganda no mu ikipe y'igihugu the Cranes, akina nka rutahizamu.
Senkatuka yatangiye umwuga muri Hope Doves FC i Kampala aho yamaze shampiyona bibiri akinira Erith na Belvedere FC, Cranes United FC, Kampala, Proline Football Club ndetse ubu akaba ari muri Bright Stars FC.
Ibyiringiro Inuma FC.
Mugihe muri Byiringiro Inuma yayoboye asubira inyuma kuzamurwa mu ntera kuva muri Kampala Regional League yatsinze ibitego byinshi yatsinze ibitego 23 mumikino 24 n'ibitego 27 mumikino 31.
Erith &amp; Belvedere.
Mugihe yari mu bushakashatsi mu Bwongereza, Senkatuka yakiniye Erith &amp; Belvedere FC muri Shampiyona yumupira wamaguru ya Ryman akina imikino itanu atsinda igitego kimwe.
Senkatuka yanagaragaye muri Cranes United FC muri Essex Alliance Football League aho yakinnye imikino 34 atsinda ibitego 45.
Njyanama y'Umujyi wa Kampala.
Mugihe yari Njyanama yumujyi wa Kampala, Senkatuka yakinnye imikino 16 atsinda ibitego 4.
Proline y'umupira w'amaguru.
Yashyizwe ahagaragara muri Proline Football Club ku wa gatandatu 12 Kanama 2016. Yabaye m'ubatsinze ibitego bitanu by'ambere muri shampiyona ya Uganda Super League muri 2016/2017 yatsinze ibitego 11 ndetse anatanga imipira 7 ivamo ibitego.
Ku ya 13 Nzeri 2019 Nelson yinjiye muri Moghreb Tétouan ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu.
Bright Stars Umupira wamaguru.
Ku ya 22 Nzeri 2021, yongeye gusinyira ikipe ya Bright Stars Football Club maze atsinda igitego cya mbere ku munsi wafunguwe wa 2021-2022 muri Uganda Premier League yari ihanganye na Mbarara City FC. Ku ya 5 Ukuboza 2021 na UPDF SC, Senkatuka yarangije ibitego 50 muri Uganda Premier League.
Senkatuka ni Muganda k'ubwoko bugwa munsi yu muryango wa Mbogo.

Ibra Sekajja (yavutse 31 Ukwakira 1992)Ni umukinnyi ukinaumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nka rutahizamu.
Yavukiye muri Uganda, yize amashuri yisumbuye ku ishuri ry’abaturage rya Ashburton kuva muri 2004 kugeza 2009.
Sekajja yatangiye umwuga muri Crystal Palace ku ya 30 Mata 2011, mu birori byabereye mu mujyi wa Hull. Yatsinze igitego cyo ku munota wa 88 kunganya igitego cya mbere. Sekajja yari yiganje mu kibuga mu minota mike yanyuma yu mukino, yemeza ko banganya na Hull byatumye umutekano w’ingoro muri Shampiyona. Yizihije akoresheje inshuro eshatu.
Nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu wa mujyi wa Braintree na Hemel Hempstead Town muri shampiyona yo muri 2015-16, Sekajja yinjiye muri Dulwich Hamlet wo mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Isthmian, atangira gukina atsinda ibitego 2-2 umukino wahuje Enfield Town ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2016. Yasoje shampiyona ya mbere muri iyi kipe atsinda ibitego 17 mu marushanwa yose, harimo igice cya mbere cyatsinzwe na Enfield Town mu mukino wa kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza cya Isthmian League. Nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego 12 bya shampiyona muri Dulwich muri 2016–17, yinjiye mu mujyi wa Bognor Regis muri 2017–18. Muri 2018-19 Sekajja yakiniye Havant &amp;amp; Waterlooville mbere yo kwinjira muri Gosport Borough muri Werurwe.
Sekajja yinjiye muri Maidenhead United mu Gushyingo 2019. Muri Mutarama 2020, yagiye kugeragezwa mu mujyi wa Grimsby.
Sekajja yongeye kwinjira muri Dulwich Hamlet muri Mutarama 2021.
Ku ya 15 Kanama 2022, yasinyiye muri AC Oulu muri Finilande kugeza shampiyona irangiye.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Sekajja yafashije u Bwongereza kurwego rwa bafite munsi y'imyaka 16. Muri Kanama 2013, yahamagawe mu ikipe ya Uganda mu mukino wa gicuti na Misiri. Ntiyakinnye kuko yari atarabona pasiporo ye ya Uganda.

Ibrahim Sekagya (wavutse ku ya 19 Ukuboza 1980) ni Uganda wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru wakinnye hagati mu kibuga. Kugeza ubu ni umutoza mukuru wa New York Red Bulls II yo muri MLS Next Pro.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2013, Sekagya yinjiye mu ikipe ya MLS New York Red Bulls ku buntu, nyuma yo kuva mu ikipe ya mushiki we ya Red Bull Salzburg. Ku ya 4 Kanama 2013, Sekagya yerekeje bwa mbere i New York atangira ari umukinnyi wo hagati arinda izamu, intsinzi kuri Sporting Kansas City ibitego 3-2. Ku ya 27 Ukwakira 2013, Sekagya yatsinze igitego cyatsinzwe mu mukino uheruka wa shampiyona yakinnye na Chicago Fire kuri Red Bull Arena kugira ngo afashe ikipe ye gutsinda 5-2 kandi ibe shampiyona isanzwe. Nicyo gikombe cyambere cy'ikipe mumateka yimyaka igera 17. Ariko, gutanga kwa Sekagya byatumye habaho kunganya igitego cyatsinzwe na Houston yatsinze ibitego 2-1 byatsindiye New York mu mukino wo kwishyura wa MLS 2013. Muri shampiyona 2014 Sekagya yabaye umukinnyi usanzwe utangira i New York ufasha iyi kipe kugera ku mukino wo kwishyura wa MLS. Sekagya yasezeye mu mupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga mu ntangiriro yo muri 2015.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Sekagya yakinnye mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda aho yari kapiteni w'iyi kipe. Yagaragaye inshuro 8 anatsindira igitego kimwe mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi cya FIFA cyo muri 2006, ndetse n’imikino 3 ndetse n’igitego mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi cya FIFA cyo muri 2010.

Lawrence Segawa (wavutse ku ya 10 Nzeri 1984) ni umugande ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga uvuka i Jinja muri Uganda uheruka gukinira Uganda Revenue Authority SC.
Yakiniye Police FC mbere yo kwimukira mu mahanga, Muri 2006, yimukiye muri Sudani aho yasinye ikipe ylgihangange muri iki gihugu yitwa Al-Merreikh. Ubukurikira y'imukiye muri Seribiya, maze asinya, mu kiruhuko cy’itumba cya shampiyona yo muri 2009-10, hamwe na FK Srem ukomoka muri Sremska Mitrovica, ikipe ifite umuco umaze kumenyekana wo gutumiza abakinnyi b'umupira w’amaguru muri Uganda, kandi aho azahurira na mugenzi we bakinira ikipe y’igihugu Vincent. Kayizi.

Omar Jamal Salim Magoola (yavutse ku ya 27 Gicurasi 1995), uzwi ku izina rya Jamal Salim, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukinira ikipe ya Richards bay fc.
Salim yakinye umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda no muri Express FC na Kampala Capital City Authority FC.
Yasinye muri Express FC nyuma y’irushanwa ry’akarere ka muri 2011, ryatsinzwe n'ikipe yo hagati, Mu mwaka wo muri 2012, yize muri kaminuza ya Kampala nk'umunyeshuri wiga mu mwaka wa mbere akorera impamyabumenyi mu micungire y’abakozi kandi yari umwe mu bahatanira izamu rya Bell Super League. Yatangiye gukina imikino mpuzamahanga muri Uganda ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2012 na Sudani y'Amajyepfo. Yabaye umwe mu bagize Ikipe ya Cranes ya Uganda mu mikino ibiri yanyuma ya Afurika y’ibihugu muri AFCON muri 2017 i Gabon na 2019 muri Egiputa.

Denis Rukundo (yavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1996) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu Rwanda ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati wa Police FC ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda.
Umwuga wa bigize umwuga.
Rukundo yatangiye umwuga mu gihugu cya Uganda hamwe na Maroons FC na KCCA FC, mbere yo kuva muri Ugandaajya muri APR FC muri 2017. Ku ya 20 Kanama 2019, yasubiye muri Uganda asinyana amasezerano na Police FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Rukundo yavukiye muri Uganda kuri se w'u Rwanda na nyina wa Uganda. Yahamagariwe guhagararira ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda mu mukino wa gicuti muri Kamena 2021. Yatangiye gukinira u Rwanda mu mukino wa gicuti yatsinze Repubulika ya Centarafurike 2-0 ku ya 3 Kamena 2021.

Kasule Owen (wavutse ku ya 3 Werurwe 1989 i Kampala) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda, ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda super league muri URA SC.
Owen yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina muri Nakawa United, mbere yo kwinjira muri Kampala City Council FC
Muri 2008, Owen yinjiye muri Bunamwaya SC, aho yatsindiye igikombe cya Shampiyona hamwe nabo muri 2009–10, atsinda ibitego 12 avuye mu gikombe cyo muri Afurika.
Hoang Anh Gia Lai FC.
Muri 2012, Owen yinjiye mu ikipe yo muri Vietiname yitwa Hoang Anh Gia Lai FC aho yayikiniye shampiyona imwe atsinda ibitego 1 mu mikino 6 ya shampiyona.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2012 , Owen yinjiye muri Uganda mu ikipe ya URA SC.

David Otti Ni umwe mubari abatoza bubahwa cyane muri Uganda, akaba n'umwe mu bantu bambaye neza mu mupira w'amaguru wa Uganda. Yavukiye i Gulu, mu majyaruguru ya Uganda kandi yapfuye afite imyaka 71 ku ya 3 Werurwe 2011 mu bitaro bya Case MedCare i Kampala. Raporo y’ubuvuzi yabanje kwerekana ko yatewe na embolisme y’ibihaha mbere yuko umurambo we w'imurirwa mu bitaro by’igihugu bya Referral Mulago kugira ngobapime uko wapfuye. Ibihe byari bikomeye m'ugihe cyitangazamakuru. Yarwaye na diyabete, mu gihe yari akiri umutoza wa Express FC, n'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Ukwezi kwa Otti kwaciwe muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize nyuma y’intambara yari imaze imyaka ine irwaye diyabete. Mu gihe cye, yatoje amakipe atatu ya mbere ya Uganda - Express, KCC na SC Villa.
Yarambuye amaboko atoza hirya no hino mu karere nko akore ku mpande za Kenya, Volcano United na Gor Mahia 1981–83), Siporo (NCS) umunyamabanga mukuru.
Ni muri Express FC, aho Otti yubahwa cyane kuba yarazanye iyi kipe igikombe cya mbere cya shampiyona mu myaka hafi makumyabiri ishize muri 1993. Yatsindiye kandi ibikombe bitatu bya Uganda mu gihe yari ahari.
Otti yibukwa cyane nkumwe m'ubatoza batsinze neza umupira w'amaguru wa Uganda kandi yayoboye amakipe yose akomeye mumupira w'amaguru wa Uganda arimo Express, SC Villa na KCC FC ku mazina menshi, kandi yatsinze haba mu buryo bwo gutera no kwirwanaho. Umwuga we watangiye mu myaka ya za 1960, akinira Bitumastic na Uganda Cranes (ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda), harimo n'igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1968. Yatangiye umwuga w'ubutoza mu 1973.
Yatoje kandi Uganda Cranes, ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda yaje amajonjora mu gikombe cy'Afurika i Cairo (1974) na Etiyopiya (1976).
Muri make kandi y'agize igihe gito cyo gutoza muri Somaliya no mu Rwanda.
David Otti yashakanye na Kwizera, babyarana abana batanu, Richard Otti, Juddy Akello Olunga, Leonard Odong, David Ochan, na Jackie Otti. Yashyinguwe i Pece.

Ibrahim Orit (wavutse 28 Nyakanga 1998)Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nkumukinyi wa Vipers SC hamwe n'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Orit yavukiye mu bitaro bya Soroti, muri Uganda, nk'uwa kabiri wavutse mu muryango w'abantu batandatu, nubwo ababyeyi be bombi bapfuye bakiri bato ba Orit. Yize mu ishuri ribanza rya Aloet, ariko byabaye ngombwa ko areka amashuri nyuma y'urupfu rw'ababyeyi be kuko nta mafaranga yo kwishyura amafaranga y'ishuri.
Orit yatangiye umwuga we muri Odudwi FC mu cyiciro cya kane cyo muri Uganda mu 2013, yagiye yitwara neza muri Soroti Garage, Junior Eagles na Future Stars mbere yo gusinyisha ikipe ya Mbarara City yo muri Uganda mu mpeshyi 2017. Ku ya 2 Nyakanga 2020, byatangajwe ko Orit yinjiye muri shampiyona na Uganda Vipers SC ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu, bibaye ku nshuro yabo ya kabiri muri iyo mpeshyi.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Orit yatangiye gukinira Uganda ku ya 22 Mutarama 2021 itsinzwe na Togo ibitego 2-1 muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2020. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muri Uganda mu mukino wakurikiyeho akoresheje ishoti riva kuri metero 16 atsinzwe na Maroke 5-2 ku ya 26 Mutarama.
Orit ikina nka winger. Nyuma yo gusinyira muri iyi kipe, umuyobozi wa Vipers SC, Fred Kajoba, yatangaje ko yakinnye nk "umukinnyi wagutse ukunze guca ibumoso ariko akaba yarakinnye iburyo ndetse na rutahizamu mukuru".

Moses Opondo (yavutse 28 Ukwakira 1997) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira muri AC Horsens n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Opondo yavukiye muri Uganda, yimukira muri Danimarike ari kumwe na nyina afite imyaka ine.
Muri Nyakanga 2016, Opondo yatijwe muri gahunda y'urubyiruko muri AaB kuri Vendsyssel FF. Yatangiye gukinira icyiciro cya mbere cya Danemarike ku ya 24 Nyakanga 2016, aje asimbuye ku munota wa 61 asimbuye Washington Brandão itsinzwe na HB Køge igitego 1-0. Muri Mutarama 2017, inguzanyo ya Opondo yahinduwe amasezerano ahoraho. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere cyo guhatanira iyi kipe ku ya 14 Gicurasi 2017 atsindwa na 1-0 muri shampiyona na FC Helsingør. Igitego cye, cyatsinzwe ku munota wa 64, nicyo gitego cyonyine cyyu mukino. Muri Nyakanga 2017, amasezerano ya Opondo yongerewe kugeza mu mpeshyi ya 2019. Vendsyssel yasezerewe muri Danemarike Superliga nyuma ya shampiyona ya 2019–20.
Muri Kamena 2019, hatangajwe ko Opondo yasinyanye amasezerano n’imyaka ine na Odense Boldklub (OB). Nk’uko "Tipsbladet" ibitangaza, OB yari yaramuhaye ingingo yo kugura hafi miliyoni 1 DKK.
Yagize amahirwe yo gukinira OB muri Superliga ku ya 14 Nyakanga 2019, ariko ku munsi wa kane ni bwo yaje mu kibuga nk'umusimbura nyuma y'iminota 71 kuri Jens Thomasen atsinze 0-1. hejuru ya Esbjerg fB.
Ku ya 24 Mutarama 2022, Opondo yagurijwe mu ikipe ya Danemark yo mu cyiciro cya mbere AC Horsens muri shampiyona isigaye. Kurangiza shampiyona igitego kimwe mumikino 10, hemejwe ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2022, ko Opondo yasinyiye burundu muri AC Horsens, yandika amasezerano kugeza muri Kamena 2026.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, Opondo yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu mukino wa gicuti na Nigeri na Repubulika ya Centarafurike. Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga ku ya 2 Kamena 2018 yatsinzwe na Nigeri ibitego 2-1.

Denis Masinde Onyango (yavutse ku ya 15 Gicurasi 1985) ni umuganda ukina umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga ukina mu izamu, wakinaga muri afurika yepfo.
Amaze gutangira umwuga we mu gihugu cye kavukire, Onyango yagiye gukina muri Shampiyona y’umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika yepfo muri ikipe ya Supersport United, Mpumalanga Black Aces, na Mamelodi Sundowns. Hamwe na Mamelodi Sundowns, ye gukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona cya CAF muri 2016 kandi yitabira igikombe cyisi cya FIFA cya makipe muri 2016. Yatowe nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Afurika ukomoka muri Afurika muri 2016. Yashyizwe kandi ku izamu rya cumi ryiza ku isi ku rutonde rw’umwaka wo muri 2016, ryakozwe n'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry'amateka y'umupira w'amaguru &amp;amp; Ibarurishamibare.
Yaserukiye Uganda mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2017, anabatwara kugeza igihe yegiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2021.
Onyango yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda, yatangiye umwuga we na SC Villa i Kampala nyuma yinjira muri St. George SA muri Etiyopiya.
SuperSport United na Mpumalanga Umukara Aces.
Mu 2006, Onyango yinjiye mu ikipe ya Supersport United yo muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Ku ya 8 Nyakanga 2010, yarekuwe na SuperSport United.
Ku ya 26 Nyakanga, Mpumalanga Black Aces yasinyishije Onyango k'ubuntu.
Muri 2011, Onyango yinjiye mu ikipe ya Mamelodi Sundowns yo muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Ku ya 2 Kanama 2013, yatanze inguzanyo ku bahanganye muri shampiyona Bidvest Wits.
Muri Nyakanga 2014, Mamelodi Sundowns yakoresheje uburyo bwo kongera amasezerano ya Onyango umwaka.
Onyango yatsindiye umunyezamu wa PSL igihembo cya shampiyona (umukinnyi mwiza mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Afurika yepfo) muri shampiyona yo muri 2015–16 kandi agumana impapuro 14 zisukuye kuko Sundowns yabonye amanota 71.

Phillip Omondi (1957 - 21 Mata 1999) yari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda.
Ni umukinnyi ukina imbere, Omondi yakiniye ikipe ya Kampala City Council FC kuva 1973 kugeza 1979, ubwo yimukiraga mu gihugu cya leta zunze ubumwe z'abaabu kugirango yinjire muri Sharjah.
Omondi yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu gikombe cy'Afurika cyo muri 1974, 1976 na 1978, aho ari we watsinze ibitego byinshi kuko Uganda yarangije ku mwanya wa kabiri. Yafashije kandi ikipe gutwara ibikombe bya CECAFA cyo muri 1973 na 1977.
Umwuga nk'umuyobozi.
Nyuma yogusoza umwuga gukina, Omondi yabaye umuyobozi wa Banki ya Uganda FC na KCC mbere y’izabukuru muri 1992.

Moses Oloya (wavutse 22 Ukwakira 1992) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya Hải Phòng yo muri Vietiname.
Ubuzima bwambere kandi bwihariye.
Murumuna wa Oloya ni Jimmy Kidega, wanakinnye umupira mpuzamahanga muri Uganda.
Oloya yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda, Vietiname na Burusiya mu buyobozi bwa Kampala Capital City, Xuan Thanh Sai Gon, Becamex Binh Duong, Kuban Krasnodar na Hanoi FC.
Yasinyiye Haiphong muri shampiyona yo mui 2022.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira mpuzamahanga muri Uganda mu 2011, kandi yagaragaye mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA. Yari umwe mu bagize ikipe ya Uganda yari mu gikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2017.

Francis Ronald Olaki Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wumupira ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nka rutahizamu cyangwa umukinnyi w’ibumoso muri Buildcon FC muri Zambiya.
Ni murumuna wa Emmanuel Okwi, umwe mu bagize ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda, ubu akaba akinira ikipe ya Simba Sports ikipe yo muri Tanzaniya.

Simon Okwi Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi w'imbere muri kaminuza ya Victoria ya SC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Emmanuel Arnold Okwi (yavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1992) ni umukinnyi ukina w’umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukina nku mukinnyi w’ibumoso mu ikipe ya Al Ittihad Alexandrie Club yo mu Misiri ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Okwi yakiniye ikipe ya SC Villa yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda Super League mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe ya Simba SC yo muri Tanzaniya ku madolari 40.000.
Muri Mutarama 2013, ikipe yo muri Tuniziya ya Étoile Sportive du Sahel yasinyiye Okwi amafaranga yo kohereza muri Tanzaniya amafaranga agera kuri madorari 300.000. Iyi kipe ariko yananiwe kwishyura amafaranga Simba SC Nyuma yaje guhanagurwa na komite ishinzwe imikino y’abakinnyi ba FIFA mu Kuboza 2013 kugira ngo asubire muri SC Villa nubwo icyemezo cyahinduwe nyuma y’amezi abiri kugira ngo ashobore gukinira Youth Africans S.C, nubwo Simba SC yigaragambije.
Okwi yongeye kwiyunga na Simba SC muri Kanama 2014 mu masezerano y'amezi atandatu, asobanura ko Youth Africans S.C bahagaritse amasezerano ye bananiwe kwishyura amadorari ibihumbi 50 by'Amerika yari amurimo. Okwi yanze gukina imikino itanu yanyuma ya shampiyona muri 2013–14 ku bakiri bato bo muri Afrika kubera impaka zo kwishyura. Youth Africans S.C yamaganye cyane iyimurwa ya Simba SC bavuga ko amasezerano agikurikizwa. Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru muri Tanzaniya ryanze icyo kirego muri Nzeri 2014.
Muri Nyakanga 2015, SønderjyskE Fodbold yasinyiye Okwi ku masezerano y'imyaka itanu, byemejwe na Simba SC, azakomeza kugeza muri 2020. Muri Mutarama 2017, Okwi yemeye gusesa amasezerano. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu mikino itandatu.
Agarutse avuye muri Danemarike Okwi yongeye kwinjira mu ikipe yahoze yitwa SC Villa asinya amasezerano y'amezi atandatu. Yatsinze ibitego 10 mu mikino 13 ya Uganda Premier League.
Muri Kamena 2017, Okwi yasinyanye na Simba SC ku nshuro ya gatatu mu mwuga we yemeye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2019, Okwi yinjiye mu ikipe ya Al Ittihad yo mu Misiri yo mu Misiri mu masezerano y'imyaka ibiri.

Dennis Okot Oola (yavutse 1 Ukuboza 1990)Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira BIDCO Bul, nka myugariro.
Yavukiye i Gulu, yakinnye umupira wa maguru muri kaminuza ya Victoria na Kampala Capital City Authority.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2015.

Caesar Okhuti (yavutse 7 Ukwakira 1990) ni umutoza ukomoka muri Uganda akaba nu mukinnyi wakinaga umupira w'amaguru uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru. Yayoboye ikipe ya Arua Hill Sports Club kuva muri shampiyona ya FUFA Big League kugeza muri shampiyona ya Uganda Premier League muri 2021. Okhuti yari mu ikipe ya Onduparaka FC yazamuwe muri 2016. Yigeze gukinira Express na KCCA FC ariko atizwa muri Onduparaka FC muri shampiyona yo muri 2016/17. Yatsinze muri shampiyona na Bunamwaya SC yo muri 2010 na KCCA FC muri 2016. Yasezeye mu mupira wamaguru wa bigize umwuga ku ya 17 Kanama 2021, nyuma yo gutsinda umukino wa nyuma wa StarTimes FUFA Big League hamwe na Arua Hill SC.
Okhuti yatangiye umwuga muri 2007 akoresha Arua ukomoka muri Uganda muri shampiyona ya Super League Ediofe Hills FC na URA FC. Yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda n'umutoza Laszlo Csaba nyuma y'uwo mwaka. Umwaka ukurikira, Bunamwaya SC y'amuguze agahigo ki gihugu miriyoni 12. Imvune yo mu mugongo muri Nzeri 2008 yamuhagaritse amezi abiri ariko agaruka kurangiza shampiyona nk'umukinnyi wa gatatu watsinze ibitego byinshi n'ibitego 18. Yamenyekanye mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu cya Uganda mu 2009. Muri 2010, Okhuti yafashije Bunamwaya gutwara igikombe cya USL.
Ku ya 20 Gicurasi 2011, Okhuti yasinye amasezerano na Vissai Ninh Bình muri Viyetinamu muri V.League 1 aho yatsinze ibitego bine mu mezi atatu. Yagarutse muri Mutarama 2012 gukinira Bunamwaya.
Muri 2014, Okhuti yinjiye muri El Nasir yo muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo, ariko shampiyona yakurikiyeho yasubiye mu rugo kugira ngo afashe Onduparaka FC ikora muri Arua kuzamuka muri shampiyona ya Uganda.
Ku wa gatandatu, 5 Ukuboza 2015 kuri Stade Addis Ababa muri Etiyopiya, Okhuti yabonye i gitego cyonyine ya tsindiye u Rwanda mutwara igikombe cya 14 cya CECAFA Senior Challenge Cup muri Uganda. Bibaye ku nshuro ya kane Uganda itsinze u Rwanda ku mukino wa nyuma (2003, 2009, 1011, 2015) kandi ni bwo bwa mbere umutoza wa Seribiya wo muri Seribiya Milutin "Micho" Sredojevic yari ayitsinze, kuko yatsinzwe imyaka ine inyuma ya Uganda mu gihe yatozaga u Rwanda. Caesar yatsinze ibitego bitatu muri iryo rushanwa nka kapitane we n'umuhungu wa kera, wa Kitende Mutagatifu Mariya Farouk Miya. Okhuti avuga ko kugaruka kwe "guhindura imyumvire". Nibwo yegukanye igikombe cya kabiri CECAFA.
Okhuti yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Uganda muri CHAN muri 2016.

Tito Okello (wavutse 7 Mutarama 1996) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Sudani yepfo ukina nkumukinnyi ukinira ikipe yo muri Irani ya Paykan FC ndetse nikipe y'igihugu ya Sudani yepfo.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Okello yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Sudani y'Amajyepfo ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2020 bakina na Kameruni B.

Allan Okello (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 2000) Yabaye umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru muri KCCA FC, ku ntizanyo ya paradou AC hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya ugandanka rutahizamu, ni umukinnyi wa Fufa Airtel w'umwaka wa 2019.
Ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2017, Okello yashyizwe ahagaragara mu ikipe ya Kampala Capital City, i Lugogo. Okello yinjije igitego bitatu maze atanga umupira wavuyemo igitego kimwe ku ncuro ya mbere ubwo ubuyobozi bwa Kampala Capital City City bwatsindaga Onduparaka FC 7–0 kuri stade ya Phillip Omondi ku ya 27 Gashyantare 2017, bityo aba umukinnyi wa mbere watsinze ibitego muri shampiyona ya Premier League ya Uganda muri 2016–2017. Muri Nyakanga 2017, amakipe menshi y'abigize umwuga ku isi nka Mamelodi Sundowns, Amsterdamsche Football Club Ajax hamwe n’ikipe ya Al Ahly Sporting Club yo muri Egiputa yerekanye ko ishishikajwe na Okello. Icyakora, intumwa ye, Isaac Mwesigwa yemeje ko "atazava mu gihugu atarangije amashuri ye yo mu rwego rwa A."
2018–19 Uganda Premier League.
Okello yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa shampiyona ku ya 28 Nzeri, ahanganye na Soana FC kuri Stade ya Phillip Omondi StarTimes, Kampala Capital City Authority (yatsinze 2–1). Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri shampiyona yakinnye na Onduparaka ku ya 19 Ukwakira kuri Green Light Stadium, muir Arua. OKello yakinnye umukino wa nyuma wa shampiyona na Maroons FC ku ya 4 Gicurasi 2019, kuri Stade ya Phillip Omondi. Yakinnye imikino irenga 24 muri shampiyona. Ubuyobozi bukuru bwa Kampala bwabaye shampiyona. OKello yarangije shampiyona ya 2018–2019 ya Uganda Premier League n'ibitego bitandatu.
Ku ya 21 Mutarama 2020, Okello yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 3 na Paradou AC.
Ku ya 20 Nzeri 2022, Okello yasinyanye amasezerano y'inguzanyo y'umwaka na KCCA FC.

Tony Odur (wavutse 7 Ukuboza 1984) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda uheruka gukinira Katwe United yo muri Uganda. Odur kandi yagiye agaragara mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda. Muri Werurwe 2010, Odur yatsinze ibitego bitazibagirana yakinnye n'Uburundi mu majonjora ya CHAN.
muri 2014 muri CAF muri Champion League.
Mu marushanwa ya CAF Champions League muri 2014, KCCA FC vs El Merriekih Tony Odur yari ku rupapuro, rw'amanota rw'abatsinze igitego kimwe n'ikindi cyatsinzwe na mugenzi we Herman Wasswa kugira ngo batsindiye hanze muri sudani, ishingiye kuri El Merriekih mu mukino wa 1, yatsinze igitego mu mikino ya 2 aho KCAA FC yatsinzwe na El Merriekih mu rugo, kampala, igiteranyo cya 3-2 bishyigikira KCCA FC gukomeza. Murin shampiyona ya CAF champions league yo muri 2014 na Nkana bakina na KCCA FC, Odur yatsinze igitego kumunsi wa 26 mu mukino urangira banganyije 2-2, kandi ibi byatumye aba umukinnyi wenyine wa KCCA watsinze ibitego mu mikino itatu mu mikino ya CAF Champions league muri 2014.
Odur yagaragaye muri 2003 nku musore ushimishije muri Express FC. Hamwe nu muto witwa Mark Mwambo, kuva aho yaretse umukino, wo hagati, bari abana bashya kuri bariyeri yavuye ku ntebe muri Shampiyona ya makipe ya CECAFA muri uwo mwaka kugirango bahindure umukino. Bombi ni bo bavuganaga muri kiriya gihe kandi birashimishije cyane iyo shampiyona irangiye, bafashije Express gutwara igikombe cya Kakungulu. Ariko gukomera cyane ni byiza gutinda kunganya, Odur yatsinze ku mukino wanyuma wa Kakungulu muri 2004 na KCC.
Ariko, ibibazo bya Odur byabaye iikinyabupfura gicye. Faruuk Ssimbwa, wahoze ari umuyobozi muri Express hagati ya 2005 na 2007 yatangarije [ikinyamakuru Uganda] ko Odur yari umuhanga nuko atumvira. Ati: "Yari umukinnyi wifuzwaga gushaka gufata ikipe, ariko ntashobonte niba adahawe icyo ashaka."
Nimwe mumpamvu yarange kureka ikipe akajya muri Bunamwaya. Yagize kandi ibizamini by'igeragezwa muri Danimarike nubwo atatsinze, kandi Tony yagize ati: "Nkeneye kongera kurasa amahirwe nk'aya niyo mpamvu nkora cyane."
Muri Mata 2014, Tony yagiye muri Viyetinamu gukomeza akazi ki nzozi ze, zo gukinira ahandi hanze ya Shampiyona, bityo yerekeza mu ikipe ikorera muri Viyetinamu, Sai Gon FC kugira nakore igeragezwa muri Mata 2014. Muri 2014 Tony yabuze umukino ukomeye mu gikombe cya Uganda, kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza na kaminuza ya Sc victoria kuri stade ya phillip omondi, kubera imvune yo mu ivi ariko KCCF yatsinze uyu umukino ibitego 2-1

Robert Odongkara (wavutse ku ya 2 Nzeri 1989) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Horeya AC ya Gineya, nk'umuzamu.
Odongkara yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Villa, Uganda Revenue Authority na Saint George.
Mu Kwakira 2018, Odongkara yimukiye mu mujyi wa Adama muri Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Etiyopiya nyuma y'imyaka irindwi ari kumwe na Saint George. Muri Kanama 2019, Odongkara yarangije kwimukira muri Horoya AC ku masezerano yi myaka ibiri.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2010, yagaragaye mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA. Yagaragaye inshuro imwe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2017, akina iminota mirongo icyenda yose yo kunganya 1-1 mu matsinda hamwe na Mali.

Joseph Benson Ochaya (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1993) Ni umugande ukina nkuwabigize umyuga mu mukino w'umupira w'amaguru, ukina mu misiri mu ikipe ya Al Mokawloon Al Arab no mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Ochaya yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mu Kampala city Council / Ubuyobozi bw'Umujyi wa Kampala, Navibank Sài Gòn, Asante Kotoko, na Lusaka Dynamos, TP Mazembe na Al Mokawloon Al Arab.
Ochaya yavukiye i Kampala, yatangiye umwuga we mu Kampala city Council.
Mu Gushyingo 2012, yavuye mu Kampala city Council yimukira mu ikipe ya Asante Kotoko yo muri Gana ku giciro cy’amadorari 30.000. Muri Kanama 2013, yagiye mu igeragezwa mu ikipe yo mu Budage SpVgg Greuther Fürth Yabaye Umukinnyi w’icyiciro cya mbere muri Uganda, Umukinnyi ufite agaciro cyane' muri shampiyona yo muri 2015-16, ubwo yakinaga na Kampala Capital City Authority. Kwimukira muri yo ikipe yo muri Afrika yepfo Bidvest Wits muri Kanama 2016 byaguye.
Muri Werurwe 2017, Ochaya yarangije kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Zusiya Lusaka Dynamos. Mu Kwakira 2018, yasinyanye n'ikipe ya Kongo TP Mazembe. Muri Nzeri 2022, yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Misiri Al Mokawloon Al Arab.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Nzeri 2012, Ochaya yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda, atangira bwa mbere muri uwo mwaka. Yagaragaye mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cyisi cya FIFA. Yabaye umwe mu bakinnyi muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2016.
