Patrick Ochan (wavutse ku 10 Ukuboza 1990) Ni umugande ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina hagati mu kibuga muri Kyetume FC no mu ikipe y'iguhugu ya uganda,
Patrick yabanje gukina muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC, no muri Saint George FC muri Etiyopiya, Simba SC muri Tanzaniya, na TP Mazembe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ndetse no muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC.: Lapasse Football Club yo muri shampiyona ya Seyishele Premier League. aGaruka muri URA Uganda Revenue Authority SC muri 2015-2017, nyuma yaho yagiye muri Bukavu Dawa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 2017. Muri Nzeri 2018, yinjiye muri Kyetume FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
"Ibarurishamibare neza nkumukino wakinnye 10 Nzeri 2017"

Benjamin Ochan Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira muri KCCA FC muri shampiyona ya Premier League ya Uganda nkumuzamu. Ni umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda. Kuva mu Kwakira 2021, afata nka kapiteni wa KCCA FC.
Ochan yakiniye amakipe atandukanye nka KCCA FC, Bloemfontein Celtic, Villa SC, Victoria University SC, Kabwe Warriors, AFC Leopards kuri ubu muri KCCA FC
Muri 2015, yinjiye muri KCCA FC muri kaminuza ya Victoria ya SC, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka 2. Yatangiye bwa mbere bakina na Uganda Revenue Authority. Ni umwe mu bakinnyi bake muri shampiyona bakinnye imikino 15 yose mu cyiciro cya mbere cya 2016/17 ya Uganda Premier League, Ochan yagumanye impapuro 8 zisukuye hamwe 4 baza mu cyiciro cya mbere mu gihe abandi 4 baza muri icyiciro cya kabiri. Ukuboza 2016, Ochan yasinye andi masezerano yu mwaka 1 ya mugumanye muri KCCA FC kugeza muri Mutarama 2018. Mu gihe muri KCCA FC Ochan yari kapiteni wungirije wa kabiri. Mu minsi ye yera kandi nziza i Lugogo niho KCCA FC yujuje ibisabwa mu mupira wa maguru ku mugabane wa Afurika nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe ya Al-Masry yo mu Misiri muri penaliti binyuze mu guhindura umwanzuro mu Misiri.,
Muri Mutarama 2018, Ochan yinjiye muri Kabwe Warriors nyuma ya Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2018 yabereye muri Maroke anasinya amasezerano yi myaka 3. Ku ya 14 Nyakanga 2019 Ochan yavuye muri Kabwe Warriors FC ku masezerano yo kumvikana.
Ku ya 16 Nyakanga 2019 yinjiye muri AFC Leopards ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe.
Ochan yongeye kwinjira muri KCCA FC ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri ku ya 13 Nzeri 2021. Yabaye kapiteni wa KCCA FC kuva mu Kwakira 2021.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ochan yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ku ya 30 Nzeri 2013 akina n'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Misiri mu mukino wa gicuti. Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’amarushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroc.

Denis Obua (13 Kamena 1947 - 4 Gicurasi 2010) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba umuyobozi w’ishyirahamwe rya Uganda, akaba yarakinnye ibumoso muri Uganda hagati yo muri 1968 na 1977 nyuma akaza kuba perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’amashyirahamwe y’umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda (FUFA) n'umuyobozi w'Inama ishinzwe amashyirahamwe y'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba no Hagati (CECAFA).
Denis Otim Obua yavutse ku ya 13 Kamena 1947 mu mudugudu wa Akol mu Karere ka Amolatar muri Uganda. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Boroboro na Manjasi High School, Tororo, aho, muri 1967, impano ye yamenyekanye maze asinywa muri Coffee United FC. Umwaka wakurikiyeho yinjiye muri Police FC, bakorana umwuga umwe nk'umupira w'amaguru n'umupolisi. Muri 1977, Obua niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona, afite ibitego 24, ariko nyuma yuko Polisi isezerewe mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 1978 yinjiye muri Maroons FC ya Luzira.
Obua yakiniye Maroons gusa igihembwe kimwe. Muri Mata 1979, umunyagitugu wa Uganda, Idi Amin, yirukanwe maze, mu gihe kihungabana cy'akurikiyeho, abakinnyi benshi bo muri Simba FC - ikipe, icyo gihe, bakuwe mu bakozi bakuru b'ingabo - batawe muri yombi. Kugira ngo wirinde ibintu nk'ibyo, Obua n'abandi bakinnyi benshi b'umupira w'amaguru bahungiye muri Kenya, aho yakiniye Luo Union. Yagarutse muri Uganda mu 1980 maze asubira muri Polisi FC, ariko ntiyasubirana imiterere maze arasezera. Muri 1983, yavuye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru yinjira muri Villa SC, wari yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere muri Uganda umwaka ushize.
Obua yakiniye Villa mu mikino yombi yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy’igikombe cya Afurika cy’igikombe cyo muri 1983, ariko, mbere gato yuko umukino ubanza wa kimwe cya kane kirangiza, yakomerekeye mu kibazo cyatumye umwuga we wo gukina urangira. Yari muwa kabari i Kamwokya ubwo yagabweho igitero n’abantu bitwaje imbunda, batangira kurasa ku bakiriya batabishaka. Obua yarashwe mu nda, nubwo yajyanywe mu Budage bw'Iburengerazuba kwivuza, ntiyashoboye gukomeza gukina.
Denis Obua yabyaye abana 18. Umuhungu we David yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa Uganda kandi yakinishaga Umutima muri shampiyona ya Premier League ya sikotishi. Undi muhungu, Eric, akinira SC Villa yari muri Uganda Super League, naho uwa gatatu, Kevin, akinira ishuri rye, Ishuri ryisumbuye rya St Mary, Kitende. Umukobwa, Sarah Desire Birungi, ayoboye ikipe y’igihugu y’ubwishingizi ya netball muri Netball League ya Uganda.

David Obua (wavutse 10 Mata 1984) ni umutoza wumupira wamaguru wa Uganda, wahoze ari umukinnyi. Ni umutoza w'ungirije wa Maroons FC yo muri Uganda Premier League. Mu mwuga we wo gukina, Obua yakiniye Polisi FC, Raleigh Capital Express, Wilmington Hammerheads, Kaizer Chiefs na Heart of Midlothian muri Scottish Premier League. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, yari ahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda kandi afite agahigo ko kuba yaratsinze ibitego byinshi muri iki gihugu mu gikombe cya Afurika ndetse no mu majonjora y'igikombe cy'isi.
Obua yavukiye i Kampala, muri Uganda, yakiniye amakipe menshi mu gihugu cya Uganda harimo na Police FC. Yamaze kandi igihe muri Morice no muri Amerika, aho yakiniye Raleigh Capital Express na Wilmington Hammerheads igihe yigaga muri kaminuza.
Obua yagaragaye na Kaizer Chiefs ubwo yakinaga mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda na Afurika yepfo maze ahabwa amasezerano y'imyaka 3. Yatangiye bwa mbere ku ya 11 Kanama 2005 atsinda Dynamos ibitego 2-0. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya Chiefs muri derby ya Soweto ku ya 29 Ukwakira 2005. Obua yatangajwe cyane igihe yari muri Afurika yepfo, yegukana igikombe cya shampiyona ndetse n’umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Afurika yepfo muri shampiyona 2006–07.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amasezerano ya Kaizer Chiefs yabonetse k'ubuntu mu mpeshyi ya 2008. Yatangiye igeragezwa mu ikipe ya West Ham United yo mu cyiciro cya mbere, mbere yo kwemeranya n’ikipe ya Scottish Premier League yo mu gihugu cya Scottish Premier League. Ku ya 6 Kanama, byagaragaye ko Obua yahawe uruhushya rwo gukora kandi yasinyiye imitima.

Ivan Ntege (wavutse 8 Nzeri 1994) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira muri KF Tirana muri Alubaniya ndetse nikipe yigihugu ya Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sredojević, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cyo muri Afurika muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Julius Ntambi Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikibuga mu ikipe yo muri Kiira Young.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Derrick Nsibambi (yavutse ku ya 19 Kamena 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Uganda uherutse gukinira ikipe ya Smouha yo mu Misiri ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ukina imbere.
Yakinnye umupira wamaguru muri Kampala Capital City Authority na Smouha.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2017.

Stephen Nsereko (yavutse ku ya 20 Nyakanga 1986) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda.
Nsereko yize muri kaminuza ya Buganda mu gihugu cye kavukire cya Uganda, anagira umwuga wo gukina muri Villa Kampala yo muri Uganda Super League, mbere yo kwimukira muri Amerika muri 2006, yaje kwitabira no gukina umupira w'amaguru muma shuri makuru no muri kaminuza ya Winthrop. Yatoranijwe nk'inama nkuru y’umwaka wa 2006 mu majyepfo y’umwaka, yashyizwe mu itsinda rya Big South Conference All-Freshmen Team, atoranywa na College Soccer News nk'umwe mu ba mbere 100 muri 2006, akomeza kubawe inshuro eshatu zose -Inama Nkuru y'Amajyepfo n'akarere ka Atalantika y'Amajyepfo yose.
Nsereko yakinnye kandi na Hampton Roads Piranhas na Fredericksburg Gunners muri USL Premier League League.
Nsereko yabaye umunyamwuga muri 2010 ubwo yasinyaga na Richmond Kickers wo mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya USL. Yatangiye gukinira iyi kipe ku ya 16 Gicurasi 2010 mu mukino yakinnye na Real Maryland Monarchs.
Nsereko ni umunyamuryango wuzuye w'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ; yagaragaye mu mikino itatu y'igihugu cye mu marushanwa yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA 2006, yakinnye na Burkina Faso, Gana na Cape Veride.

Moses Nsereko (yapfuye ku ya 15 Nzeri 1991) yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wo muri Uganda, ari nu umuyobozi, Mu mwuga we wo gukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati, yakiniye ikipe yigihugu ya Uganda mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika cyo muri 1976 na 1978.
Nsereko yinjiye mu Kampala city council (KCC) nk'umuhungu w'umupira mu mpera zo muri 1960, ariko buri gihe yagiye agaragara mu ikipe ya kabiri y'iyi kipe. Mu 1970 ni bwo yashoboye kwambara umwenda w'umuhondo "uzwi" wa KCC. Kugeza 1971, yatangiye mu ikipe ya KCC. yabanje koherezwa nk'umukinnyi w’iburyo n'umutoza Jaberi Bidandi Ssali, Nsereko yahinduye umwanya wo hagati mu kibuga. Nku mukinnyi muri KCC, yafashije iyi kipe gutwara shampiyona y'igihugu ya Uganda muri 1976 na 1977, ndetse n'igikombe cya CECAFA ya makipe muri 1978.
Mu 1979, Nsereko yagizwe umukinnyi n'umutoza muri KCC nyuma yo kugenda kwa Bidandi Ssali. Nkumukinnyi-umutoza mukuru muri KCC, Nsereko yatsindiye Uganda Super League muri 1981, 1983, na 1985, ndetse ni gikombe cya Uganda muri 1979, 1980, 1982, na 1984. Nyuma yi gihembwe kidashimishije muri 1986, yeguye muri 1987.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Nsereko yari umusore mpuzamahanga mbere yo gukinira ikipe yigihugu ya Uganda. Yakinnye imikino umunani atsinda igitego kimwe muri Uganda mu gikombe cy’ibihugu cy’Afurika cyo muri 1976 na 1978, maze atoranywa mu itsinda ry’irushanwa rya nyuma. Nsereko yegukanye igikombe cya CECAFA muri 1973, 1976, na 1977 ; yawushije penalti ya nyuma mu gutsindwa kurasa na Tanzaniya mu marushanwa yo muri 1974.
Muri Mata 1989, Nsereko yatorewe kuba umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’amashyirahamwe y’umupira wamaguru muri Uganda (FUFA). Ku buyobozi bwa Perezida John Semanobe, yakoze mu gushinga inzego z'umupira w'amaguru. Bitewe no kuvugurura iterambere ry’umupira wa maguru mu rubyiruko, ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda yegukanye ibikombe byigikombe cya CECAFA mu 1989 na 1990. Nsereko yari afite umwanya muri FUFA kugeza apfuye muri 1991.
Ku ya 15 Nzeri 1991, Nsereko yiciwe bunyamaswa hanze y'urugo rwe mu nzu ya Wampewo i Kololo, Kampala. Abantu bitwaje imbunda batamenyekanye ntibigeze bashyikirizwa ubutabera. Nsereko yasize abapfakazi babiri n'abana barenga barindwi.
Urupfu rwa Nsereko rwateje akaga umupira w'amaguru wa Uganda abashyigikiye KCC.

Andrew Mwesigwa (wavutse ku ya 24 Mata 1984) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Uganda wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa kinnye nka myugariro.
Mwesigwa yatangiye umwuga we muri 2002 akinira ikipe ya Villa SC yo muri Uganda, mbere yo kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Islande ya ÍBV muri 2006.
Nyuma yo kumara shampiyona yo muri 2010 hamwe n’ikipe ya Chongqing Lifan yo mu Bushinwa, muri Gashyantare 2011 yasinyanye amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri n’ikipe yo muri Kazakisitani Premier League yo muri FC Ordabasy.
Muri Gashyantare 2013, Mwesigwa yongereye amasezerano na Ordabasy, nyuma yo gutwara igikombe cya Super cup cya Qazaqistan muri 2012. Mwesigwa yavuye muri Ordabasy mu Kuboza 2014.
Muri Gicurasi 2015, bivugwa ko Mwesigwa yasinyanye amasezerano y’imyaka itatu na Bidvest Wits yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’umupira wa maguru, ariko imishyikirano ya masezerano irahagarara maze Mwesigwa ntabwo asinyira Bidvest Wits.
Nyuma muri 2015, Mwesigwa yakiniye Yenicami Ağdelen muri KTFF Süper Lig, mbere yo kugenda muri Mutarama 2016.
Nyuma yo kuva muri Yenicami Ağdelen, Mwesigwa yagiye mu rubanza hamwe no muri V.League uruhande rwa 1 Hà Nội, mu 2016 rwimurirwa mu mujyi wa Ho Chi Minh maze rwitwa Sài Gòn FC Yamaranye shampiyona yo muri 2016 na Sài Gòn, akora 23 imikino ya shampiyona.
Muri Mutarama 2017, Mwesigwa yagiye mu igeragezwa n'ikipe yahoze yitwa FC Ordabasy.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mwesigwa yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Uganda muri 2003.

Hamza Mulindwa Muwonge (yavutse ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 1982) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira Bright Stars, nk'umuzamu.
Muwonge wavukiye i Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Ggaba United, Kampala United, Simba, Bunamwaya ariyo Vipers, Thika United na Bright Stars.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2007, kandi yagaragaye mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA.

Martin Muwanga (wavutse ku ya 20 Ukwakira 1983) ni umukinnyi wari rutahizamu w'umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda. Kugeza ubu akinira ikipe ya Uganda Premier League mu ikipe ya Uganda Revenue Authority SC.
Muwanga yatangiye umwuga we na Polisi Jinja muri shampiyina ya Premier League ya Uganda, mbere yo kwerekeza muri ATRACO FC muri 2006 hanyuma yerekeza muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC muri 2008.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yakinnye kuva muri 2004 kugeza muri 2005 imikino ibiri mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.

Bernard Muwanga (yavutse ku ya 25 Kanama 1993) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Proline FC, nka myugariro akaba n'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Yavukiye i Kampala, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Bright Stars, SC Villa na Kampala Capital City Authority.

Travis Mutyaba (yavutse ku ya 7 Kanama 2005) ni umukinniy ukina umupira w'amaguru uvuka i Nansana Uganda ukinira ikipe ya SC Villa yo muri shampiyona ya Uganda Premier League ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Muri Kanama 2021 Mutyaba yasinye amasezerano yi myaka itatu na ikipe ya Uganda Premier League yitwa SC Villa. Mbere yo gusinyira Villa, yakiniye ikipe y'abato ya Vipers SC na Synergy FC yo muri Futsal Super League, aho yari umwe mu batsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona. Ukuboza 2021, bivugwa ko yari amaze gukurura amakipe yo mu Butaliyani n'Ubufaransa.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri 2019 Mutyaba yari mu ikipe ya Uganda y'abatarengeje imyaka 15 yatsindiye Shampiyona ya CECAFA yabatarengeje imyaka 15 muri 2019 muri Eritereya. Mu mukino wa kabiri w'ikipe yo mu matsinda, yatsinze ibitego bibiri gusa ikipe ye yatsinze na Tanzaniya. Yongeye gutsinda igitego yatsinze 4-0 kuri Kenya ku mukino wanyuma kugirango afashe gutwara igikombe. Umwaka ukurikira yagizwe umukinnyi ufite agaciro cyane kuko Uganda yatsindiye muri Shampiyona ya CECAFA yabaterengeje imyaka 17 yo muri 2020 yabereye mu Rwanda.
Mutyaba yahamagawe mu ikipe nkuru y'igihugu mu mukino wa gicuti na Tanzaniya afite imyaka 16. Yakomeje atangira gukinira umukino wa nyuma intsinzi ya 2-0. Muri Mutarama 2022 yongeye guhamagarwa mu mikino itanu ya gicuti n’impande z’ibihugu by’Uburayi na Aziya ubwo Cranes yagendaga muri Turukiya, Iraki, na Bahirayini.

Muzamir Mutyaba (yavutse 10 Ukwakira 1993) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Uganda ukinira ikipe ya Express, nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Maroons, kaminuza ya Victoria na Kampala Capital City Authority. Nyuma yo kuva muri KCCA mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 2019–20, muri Mutarama 2021 yasinyiye muri Express.
Yatangiye gukinira ari mpuzamahanga muri Uganda muri 2014.

Mike Mutyaba nanone yiswe Sulaiman Mutyaba (yavutse ku ya 23 Werurwe 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukomoka mu gihugu cya Uganda wakinnye nk'umukinnyi w'imbere mu kibuga. Ubusanzwe y'akinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati unyura ibumoso nyamara yari afite ubushobozi bwo gukina neza iburyo cyangwa imbere.
Mike Mutyaba yinjiye mu kipe kuva akiri mu ishuri kubera ko mbere yari umukinnyi w’ishuri mu ikipe y’iwabo ya Express FC maze aza gutangira umukino wa mbere.
Mutyaba yiagiye muri El Merreikh, Mu mubano mwiza bafitanye, Mike Mutyaba yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri, mu gibihangange cyo muri Sudani aricyo El-Merreikh, nyuma y'iminsi ibiri ikipe ya Bunamwaya SC yohereje Owen Kasule yinjiye mu ikipe yo muri Viyetinamu ya Hoang Ahn Gia Lai asinya amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri.
Umunyamakuru wa FUFA, Rogers Mulindwa, yatangarije abanyamakuru ati: "Turemeza ko Mike Mutyaba yinjiye muri El-Merreikh kandi tumaze gusohora icyemezo mpuzamahanga cyo kwimura umuntu cya (ITC)."
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yari mu ikipe ya Uganda ya batarengeje imyak 23. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe nkuru ya Uganda muri 2011.

Allan Musoke (wavutse 1980) ni umukinnyi ukina rugby m ubumwe bwa Uganda. Akina ku ruhande. Mubuhanga, akaba akora nk'umukozi ushinzwe abakozi muri Uganda Telecom Ltd.
Musoke yakoze siporo nyinshi kuva akiri muto. Yakinnye umukino wa basketball muri DMark Power muri Ligue ya FUBA, kuva 1996 kugeza 1999, yari umuzamu, hamwe n'umupira w'amaguru muri Nsibirwa Hall, muri kaminuza ya Makerere, kuva mu 2000 kugeza 2002, yari nka rutahizamu, kugeza ubwo yiyemeje gukina gusa rugby.
Musoke ni umwe m'ubakinnyi beza ba ruhago ba Uganda muri iki gihe, nubwo atigeze akina mu mahanga. Ikipe ye kuri ubu ni UTL Kobs. Yabaye inshuro ebyiri MVP ya ruganda ya rugby.
Akina ku rwego mpuzamahanga muri Uganda, kuri ubu akaba ari we watsinze ibitego byinshi muri "Cranes". Yabaye umukinnyi w'ingenzi mu ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya CAR Africa Cup ku ya 29 Nzeri 2007, batsinze Madagasikari 42–11, mu mukino yatsinze igerageza.
Musoke kandi yakiniye ikipe mpuzamahanga african Leopards, ku ya 23 Nyakanga 2005, mu gutsindwa muri 15-30 n’abanyeshuri bo muri Afurika yepfo, muri Ellis Park, Johannesburg.

Majid Musisi (yiswe Magid Musisi) (yavutse 15 Nzeri 1967 - 13 Ukuboza 2005) yari umukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Uganda wavuzwe kuba ari we mukinnyi wa mbere w’umupira wamaguru wa Uganda wasinyiye ikipe y’i Burayi.
Musisi yabyawe na Siraje Katende na Deborah Namutebi. Yize mu ishuri ribanza rya New Mulago nyuma yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Bashir, ariko nyuma areka ishuri kugira ngo akore umwuga w'umupira w'amaguru
Majid Musisi, kimwe n'abandi bakinnyi benshi b'umupira w'amaguru kuva muri mirongo inani, yakuze mu mwuga we w'umupira w'amaguru ku kibuga kizwi cyane cya Mulago, kizwi cyane ku izina rya 'Maracana' yerekeza kuri sitade izwi cyane yo muri Berezile. Kuruhande nka Adam Semugabi na Rajab Sekalye, yari umwe mubyifuzo bya mbere mu mashuri abanza ya New Mulago.
Stocky, yari afite imbaraga kandi afite umuvuduko, Musisi yarengeje imyaka ye maze agaragara muri bagenzi be ku buryo muri 1983 - ku myaka 16 gusa - uruhande rwa kabiri rwa Pepsi FC rwaramufashe. Muri icyo gikorwa, Majid Musisi yaretse kwiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Bashir i Wandegeya. Nyuma yi gihembwe gishimishije, umutekinisiye wa SC Villa, David Otti yabonye uyu musore maze ahita amwandikisha mu ikipe ya Villa yiteguraga Shampiyona ya Cecafa muri Mutarama 1985.
Icyakora, Majid Musisi yabuze urugendo igihe pasiporo ye yarangiraga, ikipe ya Villa yerekeje muri Sudani guhura na El-Hilal muri Shampiyona y’Afurika ya ikipe nyuma y'ibyumweru bitatu. Muri kiriya gihe, SC Villa yarafite imbaraga zavutse zifite ibikombe bibiri bya shampiyona zimaze gukenyera. Rogers Nsubuga niwe wabaye umukinnyi wa mbere muri iyi kipe hamwe na Ronald Vubya na Shaban Mwinda utari kure.
Nyuma yo kumarana ibihe bibiri na Rennes mu Bufaransa aho yakinnye imikino igera 64 yose yatsinze ibitego 18 (Shampiyona 2 nigikombe cy'ubufaransa), yagurishijwe mu ikipe yo muri Turukiya ya Bursaspor, nyuma yaje kugurishwa muri Çanakkale Dardanelspor kuri miliyari y'amafaranga 1.8 yohereza ari amashiringi ya Uganda, gukora amateka ku isoko ryo kwimura ibicuruzwa bihenze cyane muri Uganda. Muri shampiyona ya 1996, yatowe nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi mu mahanga muri shampiyona ya Turukiya. Amaze gukina muri Turukiya yagize amarozi akinira Đà Nẵng muri Viyetinamu. Yashinze "icyamamare" muri Bursaspor ingona yo kwizihiza ibitego mu mukino wa UEFA, Intertoto Igikombe cyahuje ikipe y'Ubudage Karlsruher SC ku ya 2 Kanama 1995.
Yakinnye kandi mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Magid Musisi yashakanye na Suzan Nantongo bari baratandukanye mbere gato y'urupfu rwe. Musisi yabyaye abana barindwi
Yapfuye nyuma y’uburwayi bwari bumaze igihe ku ya 13 Ukuboza 2005 mu rugo rwa nyina i Bwaise, mu nkengero z’umujyi wa Kampala, aho yari acumbitse nyuma y’uko ubuzima bwe bari bumeze nabi. Umurambo we wimuriwe mu rugo rwe rwa Muyenga, aho ajyanwa mu baturanyi ba Bukasa kugira ngo ushyingurwe saa yine z'ijoro ku ya 14 Ukuboza 2005.

Paul Musamali (yavutse ku ya 20 Ukwakira 1994) ni umukinnyi wabigize umwuga ukina umupira w'amaguru i bumoso, muri buildcom FC yo muri zambiya premier league no mu kipe y'igihugu ya uganda.
Musamali yinjiye muri SC Villa muri 2012. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya Express FC maze atsinda igitego cya mbere muri SC Villa bakina na Ndejje University FC mu gikombe cya Uganda.
Yinjiye muri Western Stima muri 2014, atangira gukinira Nakumatt FC maze atsinda igitego cye cya mbere yatsinze bakina na Kakamega Homeboyz
Mu mwaka wo muri 2016, Musamali yinjiye mu Kampala city council atangira gukinira bahanganye na Vipers ndetse atsinda igitego cye cya mbere mu Nama Njyanama y'Umujyi wa Kampala bakina na Onduparaka.
Musamali yinjiye muri Buildcon FC kumasezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Yatangiye gukinira bahanganye na Kabwe Warriors.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Musamali yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 14 Nyakanga 2017 n'a majonjora yahanganye na Sudani y'Amajyepfo yo muri Chan muri 2018.

Allan Tarsis Munaaba (Yavutse ku ya 19 Mata 1989 ni umugande wakinnye umupira w'amaguru, uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru, wakinaga muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC, akaba akora muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC nku muyobozi mukuru, kuva muri Nzeri 2021.
Munaaba yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru muri Jinja Municipal Council FC muri 2005, SC Villa kandi aheruka gukina muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC. Yinjiye muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC muri 2008 maze atangira gukinira ikipe ya Young Africans FC mu gikombe cya Cecafa cyo muri 2008, Uganda Revenue Authority SC yatsinze ibitego 2-0 aho Allan yatanze umupira ku gitego cya kabiri. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Uganda Revenue Authority SC bakina na Sharing FC i Nakivubo muri 2009. Allan yari umwe mu bakinnyi bakinnye mu gikombe cya CAF Confederation muri 2015 kandi bagaragara mu mikino yose. Allan kandi ni kapiteni wa Uganda Revenue Authority SC. Muri Kamena 2020, yasezeye mu mupira w'amaguru. Muri Nzeri 2021, yagizwe umuyobozi mushya wa Uganda Revenue Authority Umuyobozi mukuru wa SC asimbuye Henry Mayeku.
Muri 2012, Munaaba yabonye impamyabumenyi yo muri Bachelor of Business mu kwamamaza muri kaminuza ya Makerere.

Isaac Muleme (wavutse 10 Ukwakira 1992) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nkumukinyi w'ibumoso kuva muri Viktoria Žižkov.
Muri Gashyantare 2019, Isaka yinjiye mu ikipe yo muri Tchèke muri Viktoria Žižkov avuye mu ikipe ya Haras El Hodoud yo mu Misiri.
Muri Gashyantare 2020, Muleme yinjiye mu ikipe ya Fortuna Liga FC Nitra ku ntizanyo ya kimwe cya kabiri. Yatangiye shampiyona mu gihe cya mbere abonye amahirwe, mu rugo i pod Zoborom, ku ya 15 Gashyantare 2020 bakina na Pohronie. Pohronie na Nitra bari mu ntambara itaziguye yo kwirinda aho bamanuka, Nitra irusha amanota Žiar nad Hronom yari ishingiye ku bashya. Muleme yatangiye ku munota wa 81, ubwo yinjiraga asimbuye Duje Javorčić. Umukino washojwe banganya igitego.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sredojević, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’amarushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Steven Mukwala (Yavutse 15 Nyakanga 1999) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nka rutahizamu muri Asante Kotoko SC yo muri Gana. Yakiniye Vipers SC atizwa muri Maroons FC yo muri Uganda Premier League.
Muri Mutarama 2017, byatangajwe ko Mukwala azinjira mu ikipe nkuru ya Vipers SC yo muri Uganda, Vipers SC mu byavuzwe ko hari ikintu cy'ambere cyatangiye kumuvana mu mupira w'amaguru wa Masaza kugeza kuri w’umupira wamaguru wa Uganda.
Muri 2018, Mukwala yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ya batarengeje imwaka 23 gukina na Gana na Kameruni aho yatsinze igitego kimwe ndetse akaba yari no mu ikipe ya Uganda yitabiriye amarushanwa ya COSAFA yabereye muri Lesotho maze abasha gufasha Uganda kurangiza ku mwanya wa 3 inyuma Misiri imaze gutsinda ibitego 3.
Muri Gashyantare 2017, Mukwala yari mu itsinda rya Vipers Team ryatsinze Azam muri Uganda Premier League kandi yari muri gahunda za Miguel Da Costa umutoza wa Vipers icyo gihe wari wamugiriye ikizere nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego bikomeye ikipe mu gushaka ku mugikombe muri 2017.
Muri 2019, Mukwala yatijwe muri Maroons FC muri shampiyona nshya yo muri 2019-2020 aho yatsinze ibitego 13 ndetse numwe mubatsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona n'imikino itanu yo kujya muri Uganda Premier League. Umuvuduko n'imbaraga zo kurangiza umupira byashimishije andi makipe menshi ariko ashyira imbere ikipe yo mu bwana ya Vipers SC.

Ronald Mukiibi (wavutse ku ya 16 Nzeri 1991) ni umukinnyi ukomoka mu gihugu cya Uganda, ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Suwede ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina nka myugariro mu ikipe ya Degerfors. yagaragaye mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ku rwego mpuzamahanga kandi afite pasiporo ya Suwede.
Ikipe ye ya mbere yakiniye ya Allsvenskan yari BK Häcken. Nyuma yaje kumara imyaka myinshi muri upstarts Östersunds FK. Mu mpeshyi yo muri 2021 yararekuwe, gusa agaruka muri Nzeri, uwo mwaka nyuma yo kunanirwa kubona indi kipe. Nyuma yi gihembwe cyo muri 2021 yongeye kurekurwa.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2022, Mukiibi yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri na Degerfors.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mukiibi yahamagawe mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cy'Afurika cyo muri 2017, ariko yanga kwitabira.
Icyakora, yemeye guhamagarwa muri 2019 ubwo yongeye guhamagarwa mu ikipe ibanza y’igikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2019, nyuma akaza guhamagarwa mu bakinnyi 23 ba nyuma ku ya 11 Kamena. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere yatsinze kote Divuwari igitego 1-0 ku ya 15 Kamena 2019.

Ashe Mukasa (Yavutse Mata 1952) yahoze ari umukinnyi wo hagati wumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda wakiniye Uganda mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 1978.
Mukasa yavukiye mu gace ka Lungujja ko muri Kampala, yatangiye umwuga we akina n’urubyiruko rwaho Nateete Young Stars na Nakivubo Boys. Muri 1969, yinjiye muri Coffee FC yo mu cyiciro cya mbere muri shampiyona. Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yimukiye muri NIC FC mu cyiciro cya kabiri.
Mu 1972, Mukasa yagarutse mu cyiciro cya mbere hamwe na Express FC, iyi kipe yari gutwara ibikombe bibiri bya shampiyona mu bihe bitanu.
Mukasa yakiniye Uganda ku mukino wa nyuma wo muri 1974, 1976 na 1978.

Mugisha Godfrey (Yavutse ku ya 23 Ukwakira 1978) yahoze ari umukinnyi w’umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda wakinnye nkumukinnyi ukina hagati kandi ari rutahizamu. Godfrey yakinnye cyane nko kina kuruhande. Yahagarariye Uganda mu batarengeje imyaka 17, abatarengeje imyaka 19 na 21, abatarengeje imyaka 23, n'ikipe nkuru y'igihugu ya Cranes. Yagombaga gukinira ikipe y'abatarengeje imyaka 23 (Imikino yose yo muri Afurika) muri Afurika y'Epfo ariko yaje kuvayo kubera imvune. Yagize uruhare runini mu kuyobora KCC FC muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri shampiyona ya Afrika.
Yimukiye muri Reta zunzubumwe z'Amerika muri 2000 kugira ngo yige kaminuza, arangiza afite impamyabumenyi muri sisitemu yo gutanga amakuru no gushushanya. Yabaye itsinda rya mbere mu nama zose muri 2002, 2003, na MVP mukarere ka XII 2003, naho Abanyamerika bose bubahwa muri 2003. Mu mwaka wa mukuru 2004/05 yatumiwe muri Chicago Storm, ikipe yumupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga. Icyo gihe yari hafi kurangiza kugirango ashobore gusinya.

Yassar Mugerwa Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya KCCA FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’amarushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.

Bevis Kristofer Kizito Mugabi (Yavutse ku ya 1 Gicurasi 1995) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nka myugariro mu shampiyona ya sikotishi mu ikipe ya Motherwell. Yabanje gukina shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru yo mu Bwongereza muri Yeovil Town. Yavukiye mu Bwongereza, ahagarariye Uganda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Ubuzima bwambere kandi bwihariye.
Mugabi yavukiye i Harrow, Londere, ku babyeyi baturutse i Kampala, muri Uganda.
Mugabi yatangiye umwuga muri Fulham mbere yo kwinjira muri gahunda y’urubyiruko ya Southampton muri Nyakanga 2011, anasinyana amasezerano n’imyaka ibiri ni gice n’ikipe muri Gashyantare 2015.
Yasinyiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Yeovil Town ku ya 5 Kanama 2016 ku masezerano y'umwaka. Yatangiye gukinira ikipe ye ya mbere ku ya 9 Kanama 2016, asimbuye ku munota wa 54 mu mukino wa shampiyona ya EFL Cup na Walsall. Mugabi yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere kuri Yeovil mu gikombe cya EFL wabahuje na Portsmouth ku ya 30 Kanama 2016. Muri Gicurasi 2017, yasinyanye amasezerano n’imyaka ibiri n’iyi kipe
Mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 2018–19, Mugabi yarekuwe na Yeovil nyuma yo gusezererwa muri shampiyona ya kabiri.
Ku ya 12 Nzeri 2019, Mugabi yasinyiye Motherwell ku masezerano kugeza muri Mutarama 2020. Nyuma yuko mugenzi wo muri Motherwell Charles Dunne akomeretse, Mugabi yari yiteguye gutangira bwa mbere vuba nkuko byari byitezwe. Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2019, Motherwell yatangaje ko bongereye amasezerano na Mugabi kugeza mu mpeshyi ya 2021.
Ku ya 18 Gashyantare 2022, Mugabi yasinyanye amasezerano na Motherwell, kugeza mu mpeshyi ya 2024.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mugabi yari yemerewe guhagararira Ubwongereza cyangwa Uganda ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Musa Mudde (Yavutse ku ya 23 Gicurasi 1990) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muriUganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga.
Musa Mudde yagaragaye bwa mbere mu gukina mu Buhinde, akinira ikipe ya Gokulam Kerala muri sahmpiyona ya I-League.

Hassan Mubiru (yavutse ku ya 16 Ukuboza 1978) ni umukinnyi akaba rutahizamu w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i Lukuli, mu gice cya Makindye, mu karere ka Kampala muri Uganda wakiniye Express FC.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Hassan Mubiru wavukiye i Lukuli, mu nkengero z'akarere ka Kampala mu gice cya Makindye, ni umwe mu bakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru bafite ubuhanga, Uganda yigeze itunga. Yavutse ku ya 16/12/1988, Mubiru yatangiye umwuga we w'umupira w'amaguru mu ishuri kimwe n'abandi bakinnyi benshi b'umupira w'amaguru mu gihugu. Ariko, inzozi ze akiri umwana ntizari kuba umupira wamaguru nkuko yahoraga arota umwuga mubyamategeko cyangwa ubuvuzi. Ntabwo byari bikwiye kuba yarangije ishuri murwego rwa O. Yize amashuri abanza ya Katwe Noor mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Makindye amashuri yisumbuye.
Nyuma yo kuva mu ishuri mu 1994, Mubiru yahisemo kwibanda ku mupira w'amaguru maze umwuga we ushingiwwa ahitwa Lukuli United, igice cya mbere mu mudugudu yavukiyemo. Umutoza Walakira Siraje wakoraga uruhande icyo gihe yahamagaye Mubiru amusaba kwitoza hamwe niyi kipe. Imbere yahindutse intangiriro ako kanya. Mu 1995/6 Amarushanwa ya shampiyona yicyiciro cya mbere Kampala, Lukuli United yagaragaye hamwe namakipe menshi ko mu yandi harimo Police FC. Ibikorwa bya Mubiru ku ruhande rw'iburyo rwagati rwagati muri iri rushanwa byashimishije benshi barimo umutoza wa Polisi FC, Denis Obua (wahoze ari perezida wa FUFA) washukishije umuzamu abapolisi ba Nakawa kugira ngo yinjire mu bapolisi nyuma yo kwinjira mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’icyiciro cya mbere mu gihugu.. Muri iki gihe, Mubiru yari ashishikajwe no kujya mu ikipe kuko yashakaga kuba umukinnyi wa shampiyona.
Mubiru yayoboye muri shampiyona ya Premier League yo muri Kenya mu gutsinda ibitego ibihe bitatu bikurikiranye (2001, 2002 na 2003) ubwo yari muri Express FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mu gihe Majid Musisi wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Turukiya atari adahari, Mubiru yahamagariwe kuzuza mu mwanya mu Musisi, mu itsinda ry’amajonjora yo gushaka umwanya hamwe na Musisi mu itsinda ry’amajonjora yo guhatanira itike yo guhatanira nini za Musiri mu matsinda ane yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika. Yatangiye agahigo ka dasanzwe muri uyu mukino, atsinda ibitego bibiri, harimo imyigaragambyo itazibagirana ku munota wa nyuma yahaye Uganda intsinzi y'ibitego 2-1. Kuva icyo gihe, yagize uruhare runini mu ikipe y'igihugu.

Daniel Mubiru (wavutse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1976) ni umukinnyi ukina wo hagati mu kibuga ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina mu ikipe ya Polisi ya Jinja muri shampiyona ya Premier League.
Yatangiye umwuga we na Villa SC muri Premier League ya Uganda, mbere yo muri 2003 yimukira muri Polisi Jinja.
Mubiru yakinnye kuva 2002 kugeza 2004 mu ikipe yumupira w'amaguru ya Uganda.

Umwuga mpuzamahanga.

Joseph Mpande (wavutse 12 Werurwe 1994) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina muri Viyetinamu nku mukinnyi wa Hải Phòng muri shampiyona ya V.League 1.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2014, umutoza Milutin Sedrojevic, yamutumiriye kujya mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda mu gikombe cya Afurika 2014. Iyi kipe yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu matsinda y’irushanwa nyuma yo gutsinda Burkina Faso, inganya na Zimbabwe itsindwa na Maroke.
Amaze kuva muri Miyanimari, yimukiye muri Viyetinamu akinira i Hai Phong.

Farouk Miya (wavutse 26 Ugushyingo 1997)Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w' amaguru ukomoka muri Uganda ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga, ukinira mu ikipe ya TFF Yambere Ya makipe ya Çaykur Rizespor hamwe n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Muri Mutarama 2016, hatangajwe ko Miya azinjira mu ikipe nkuru y’Ububiligi,ya Standard Liège mu byavuzwe ko ari amasezerano y’intizanyo yabanje kumuvana mu ikipe ya Vipers yo muri Uganda. Standard Liège yabonye serivisi zayo ku giciro cya 400.000 US $.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2017, Miya yagurijwe muri Royal Excel Mouscron kugeza shampiyona irangiye.
Muri Gashyantare 2018, Miya yagurijwe muri Səbail FK, agaruka mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2017–18.
Ku ya 20 Kanama 2019, Miya yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka itatu na Süper Lig kuruhande rwa Konyaspor. Yatangiye umukino we nyuma yiminsi itanu ahanganye na Galatasaray kuri Stade Türk Telekom.
Yinjiye mu ikipe ya TFF Yambere Yambere Çaykur Rizespor mu masezerano y'imyaka ibiri muri Nyakanga 2022.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Miya yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2014 na Seychelles.

Charles Livingstone Mbabazi (Yavutse ku ya 18 Ukwakira 1980) ni umutoza w’umupira wamaguru wa Uganda akaba yarahoze akinira ikipe ya Athletic St Patrick muri Shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere muri Irlande ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda. Yari umukinnyi ufite ubushobozi bwo gukina haba mu m'ababa cyangwa imbere. Mu gihe y'amaze muri ikipe yakoresheje izina rya Mbabazi inyuma mu myenda ye.
Mbabazi yamenyekanijwe na St Patrick n'umukozi icyo gihe yari John Fashanu. Yabanje gukinira ikipe ya Al Ahly SC muri shampiyona ya Premier League yo mu Misiri. Nyuma y'imishyikirano y'amaze igihe kinini arekurwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga na Federasiyo y’amashyirahamwe y’umupira w’amaguru ya Uganda, yatangiye ku munsi wa St Stephen ku munsi wo muri 1999 yakinnye na Athlone Town mu gikombe cya Leinster. Mbabazi yabaye umufana ukomeye, atsinda igitego cya mbere bakinnye na Longford Town mu mikino ya Ligue y'abereye muri Richmond Park. yatsinze igitego mu rugo kwa Bray Wanderers, nyuma y'iminsi ine gusa na murumuna we bapfuye muri Uganda.
Muri Kamena 2002, Mbabzai yatsinze igitego bakinnye na HNK Rijeka mu gikombe cya Intertoto UEFA 2002. Uyu mukino wanditswe mu mateka k'ubatagatifu nkubwa mbere batsinze mu marushanwa ya makipe yi Burayi. Nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego hanze, Charles yongeyekuzuguza inshundura mu cyiciro gikurikira mu mukino wo mu rugo na KAA Gent.
Mu 2003, byabaye ngombwa ko asezera kubera ikibazo cy'umutima nyuma yo kugwa mu kibuga mu mukino wa shampiyona na Bohemians. Ubuhamya yatanze ku guhitamo Brian Kerr bwabaye mu Gushyingo 2004 mbere yo gusubira muri Uganda. Mbabazi yatsindiye Uganda inshuro 36.

Anthony Mawejje Jr. (Yavutse ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1986) Ni umugande wakinnye umupira w'amaguru arkina hagati muri police FC, ndetse no mu ikipe y'igihugu ya ya Uganda.
Mawejje mbere yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri mu ikipe ya Tippeligaen yo muri Noruveje Haugesund mbere ya shampiyona yo muri 2014. Muri Nyakanga 2014, nyuma yo kwitaba Haugesund inshuro eshatu gusa, Mawejje yimukiye i Valur ku ntizanyo. Ku ya 27 Mutarama 2015, Mawejje yabaye umukinnyi ku buntu.
Muri Nyakanga Mawejje yinjiye muri Tirana muri Alubaniya maze atangira umukino wa mbere ku ya 6 Nzeri 2017 atsinda FK Kukësi aho yakinnye umukino wose. Tony yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri Tirana ku ya 16 Nzeri 2017 bakina na KS Iliria ; Tirana yatsinze 1-0.

Haruna Mawa ni umutoza wumupira wamaguru ukina muri Uganda kandi yahoze ari umupira w'amaguru. Nkumukinnyi, yakiniye Rayon Sports fc mu Rwanda. Mu Gushyingo 2016, yagizwe umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Somaliya.

Benjaloud Youssouf (wavutse 11 Gashyantare 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati, mu ikipe yu bufaransa ya LB Châteauroux. Yavukiye mu Bufaransa, ahagarariye Comore ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Yavukiye i Marseille, Youssouf yari mu ikipe ya FC Nantes ya batarengeje imyaka 19 yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza cya Coupe ya Gambardella. Yinjiye muri Orléans muri 2013 ahindura umwuga arikumwe nabo.
Muri Kamena 2017 yimukiye muri AJ Auxerre, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka itatu.
Amasezerano ye ya Auxerre arangiye, ntiyabashije kugaragara mu ikipe ya mbere muri shampiyona yose ya 2019–20, Youssouf yasinyiye muri Le Mans.
Ku ya 23 Kamena 2021, yasinyanye na Châteauroux imyaka ibiri.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Youssouf yerekanye bwa mbere muri komore muri 2015.

Ikibaya kinini cya Rift ni izina ryatanzwe muri 1894 n'umushakashatsi ukomoka muri ekosi witwa John Walter Gregory, nyuma y'urugendo rwe muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, mu itsinda ryari irya geologiya rigizwe n'uruhererekane rw'ibishanga n'ibirunga, biherereye muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
ryitwa irya furika y'Iburasirazuba cyangwa "Irikora kuri afurika y'Iburasirazuba", iri rigizwe n'amashami menshi agabanijwemo ibice by'ibibaya, nayo ubwayo agabanijwemo uduce duto, ikibaya cy'amasoko. Ibi byinjira mu imiterere yose izina rya "sisitemu yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba". Ihuriro hamwe n’’inyanja Itukura, Ikigobe cya Suez Ikosa na Levant Fault bigize Sisitemu ya Afro-Arabiya.
Mubyukuri, amakosa yose ya tectonic yerekeje muri Afrika no muri Aziya Ntoya nko mu kilometero cya 7 000, uva mu majyaruguru ugana mu majyepfo, na kilometero 30 Kuri kimometero 100 z'ubugari, kuva muri Libani kugera muri Mozambike, unyura ku nyanja Itukura n'ibiyaga binini byo muri Afurika. Igabanya Ihembe rya Afurika mo kabiri: isahani ya Somaliya, iburasirazuba, iragenda iva ku isahani ya Afurika, y'iburengerazuba. Igabanyijemo, igana mu majyepfo ya Etiyopiya, ku mpande zombi za Uganda. igashamika iry’iburengerazuba (Albertine rift) rinyura mu biyaga binini byo muri Afurika, ryakozwe no kwegeranya amazi mu kwiheba, mu gihe ishami ry’iburasirazuba (Gregory rift) ryambukiranya Kenya na Tanzaniya mu burasirazuba bw’ikiyaga cya Victoriya, aho rigizwe n'umugozi muto.
Ni ahantu hameze nk'umwobo.
Ubumenyi bwa geologiya.
Kuva mu majyaruguru ugana mu majyepfo, tectonike agizwe no yo kwa Afar (harimo Ikigobe cya Tadjoura na Block ya Danakil), ikibaya cya Awash, ikibaya cya Omo, ikiyaga cya Turkana, nyuma y’ikosa rya Afurika ryigabanyijemo amashami abiri, rigira Ikomeye Ibiyaga bya Afurika mu burengerazuba n'ibiyaga bito mu burasirazuba bw'ikiyaga cya Victoria, kugira ngo bihure mu majyepfo mu kiyaga cya Malawi no mu kibaya cya Shire, mu majyepfo ya Malawi.

Igishanga cya Bishenyi giherereye mu Murenge wa Rugalika mu Karere ka Kamonyi, cyuzuye biturutse ku mvura nyinshi yahaguye none ubu abaturage ntibari kubona uko bagenda, Ni igishanga kiri ku umuhanda uhuza Bishenyi, Kigese na Rugalika, kucyambuka bifashishaga amateme atatu ariho na yo imvura yayatwaye. Imvura yatangiye kugwa kare, ikagwa mu buryo budasanzwe ku buryo abaturage bahatuye bakorera mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’abanyeshuri bavaga ku mashuri batari kubona uko bataha. Ni igishanga gisanzwe cyuzura iyo habayeho ikibazo cy’imvura nyinshi igwa igihe kirekire.

Ikibaya cya Mukunguri, ni igishana kiri mu mirenge ya Mugina na Nyamiyaga ho mu karere ka Kamonyi hamwe no mu Murenge wa Kinazi wo mu Karere ka Ruhango, ahakorerwa ubuhibw'umuceri muri iki gishanga, aho hamaze imyaka isaga 40 hari ubu buhinzi muri iki gishanga cya Mukunguri. Abahinzi bibumbiye mu ma Zone 13 mu gishanga gifite ubuso bwose bugera kuri Hegitali 700 ariko wakuramo imigezi n’ahanyuzwa imiyoboro n’ibindi bikorwa by’ahadahingwa ugasanga gisigarana nka Hegitali 500 zirenga. Gusa na none kubera ibibazo by’ibiza byakuze kwibasira iki gishanga, ubuso bubyazwa umusaruro bubarirwa muri Hegitali 400 zirenga. muri iki gishanga harimo abahinzi bibumbiye muri koperative zitandukaNYE nka COPRORIZ
Umushinga wo kugitunganya, uzibanda ku gutunganya ubutaka buri ku buso bwa Hegitari 700, bwo mu misozi igikikije, mu rwego rwo kuburinda kwangirizwa n’isuri. Bizajyana n’ingamba zo gukangurira ababuhinga kubahiriza ibikenerwa byose mu kongera umusaruro harimo imbuto nziza, ifumbire y’imborera n’imvaruganda, imiti, ishwagara n’ibindi bituma umusaruro wiyongera.Ni igishanga kiri ku buso bwa Hegitari 700, izikunze kurengerwa n’amazi y’imvura, zikaba zibarirwa muri 20.Mu umushinga wo kugitunganya haziyongeraho Damu, izayobora amazi mu buryo bworohereza abahinzi mu mirimo ijyanye no kuhira imyaka, bityo bajye babasha no guhinga batitaye ku kurindira imvura.Ibyo bizarushaho kubakira abahinzi ubushobozi, no guca imyumvire y’abagitekereza ko umurimo w’ubuhinzi ari uwa ba “mbuze uko ngira”.Ubwo bizaba byashyizwe mu bikorwa, umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, uzarushaho kwiyongera.Igihe kirageze ngo umuhinzi yubakirwe ubushobozi bumugira rwiyemezamirimo nk’abandi bose babarizwa mu rindi shoramari rirambye.

Igishanga cyangwa Ikidendezi cya Cyoganyoni, kiri hagati y'akagari ka Ruyenzi ho mu murenge wa Runda n'aka Kigese ho mu murenge wa Rugarika. Abaturage bagituriye, niho bavoma amazi kuko amariba avamo amazi meza aherereye kure yabo.
Ku nkuka z'igishanga cya Cyoganyoni, hari ibiraro by'ingurube n'iby'inka, muri iki gihe cy'imvura, imyanda isohokamo ikaba iruhukira muri icyo kidendezi, abaturage bakaba bavuga ko ibyo byiyongera ku myanda ituruka mu mugezi wa Bishenyi wisuka muri Cyoganyoni, uba wazanye imyanda itandukanye irimo ifumbire mvaruganda bafumbiza imyaka bahinga muri icyo gishanga.
Mugihe kinini cyari gishize bamwe mu bahinga mu gishanga cya Cyoganyoni bataka igihombo baterwaga n’amazi y’imvura yateraga imyuzure muri icyo gishanga,Abafite imirima muri icyo gishanga, abagituriye n’abaturage biganjemo abo mu Mirenge ya Kaniga na Cyumba mu Karere ka ngoma iki gishanga kibarizwamo, bagaragaza ko uko kwangirizwa imyaka y’abo n’amazi yarengeraga imirima imwe n’imwe ikigize byatumaga babaga bataha ntamusaruro.Bavugako bahoraga bahangayitse bibaza amaherezo y’icyo kibazo barayobewe, kuko inzego zose bigaragara ko zakagize icyo zibikoraho, bari barazegereye barazitakambiye ngo zibarwaneho zibafashe gushaka umuti w’icyo kibazo.Nubwo ibintu byose ku masoko ya byihagazeho muri Ngoma, naho ibirayi byageze ku mafaranga 550. Imbuto imboga n’ibindi biribwa biragurwa n’Umuntu wifite, byaratumbagiye ku kigero kirenze kure uko byahoze mbere.Ubuyobozi butekereza ko kuba kiri hafi gutunganywa, abahinzi bazarushaho kongera imbaraga n’ubushake mu buhinzi buteye imbere bityo n’abakenera umusaruro ugiturukamo babyungukiremo.

Ni igishanga kiri mu Mudugudu wa Gatyazo, Akagari ka Rugali mu Murenge wa Macuba mu Karere ka Nyamasheke, aha niho hatangijwe igihembwe cya kabiri cy’ihinga cy’umwaka wa 2012-2013 batangira batera ibigori mu materasi ari ku misozi ikikije umugezi wa Kilimbi. Aya materasi ari guterwaho ibigori yaciwe mu mirima y’abaturage ku nkunga y’umushinga wa Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi ushinzwe gutunganya ibishanga no kubibungabunga. Uyu mushinga ukorera mu Mirenge ya Macuba na Kilimbi hagamijwe gutunganya.Muri iki gihembwe ahatoranyijwe hazahingwa ibigori muri aka karere hangana na hegitari 2500, bikaba biteganyijwe ko kubiba bizarangirana.
Mu rwego rwo kubungabunga neza iki gishanga babanje gukora amaterasi ku misozi imenera amazi muri iki gishanga, ibi bikaba byarafashije abaturage gutunganya imirima yabo bityo bikazabafasha no kongera umusaruro. Abakorewe aya materasi kuyitaho bakayabyaza umusaruro kandi bakayafata neza kugira ngo atangirika, kuko ari ku misozi ihanamye bagateraho urubingo. Muri 2023 mu Karere ka Nyamasheke hazatangira ibikorwa byo kubungabunga inkengero z’umugezi wa Nyagahembe. Bizakorwa ku buso bwa Kilometero 36 buterweho imigano, urubingo n’ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka. bizaba ari igisubizo k’ugukumira amazi y’uyu mugezi yangizaga hegitari nyinshi z’umuceri bahahingaga.
Abahinzi b’iki gihingwa ngangurarugo kikaba na ngengabukungu iyo cyeze ari kinshi kikagemurirwa amahanga bari baherutse kubwira itangazamakuru ko Minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi yababeshye kuzagitunganya bagategereza bagaheba.
Koperative yabo igizwe n’abanyamuryango 179, Bavuga ko iyo habaye umwuzure, igishanga kikuzura, imyaka yabo ikangirika bahomba kandi na Leta ntigire icyo ibamarira mu kubashumbusha. Ikibabaje kurushaho ni uko basanzwe bishyura ubwishingizi, Tuzatangira kurwanya isuri mu mabanga y’imisozi yose ikikije igishanga cya Nyagahembe ku buso bwa hegitari 80. Hazakorwaho amaterasi y’indinganire hacukurweho imirwanyasuri ndetse haterwe n’ibiti ndumburabutaka bivangwa n’imyaka ndetse n’urubingo. Politiki y’ubuhinzi ya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda kuri paji yayo ya 231 ivuga ko mu gutunganya ibishanga no kuhira hari gahunda yo gufasha abahinzi kubona ibikoresho byo kwifashisha bakabyishyura buhoro buhoro ku mafaranga make kuzageza babyegukanye.

Umusozi Mabu ni umusozi uri mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike, uzwi cyane kubera ishyamba rigwamo imvura cyane ryakuze. Umusozi Mabu ufite uburebure bwa metero1700 kandi ni ishyamba rifite hegitari 7000. Nubwo bizwi cyane mu karere, ishyamba ry'umusozi Mabu hamwe n’ibinyabuzima bitandukanye cyane ntibyari bizwi nk' bimera n’inyamaswa kugeza mu 2005. ubwo wasuwe nyuma kuri Google Earth mu 2005 n'itsinda ry'abahanga bo mu kigo cyita ku kubungabunga imisozi ya Mulanje (MMCT) hamwe n'abashakashatsi mu by'imiterere ya ornithologue, nyuma mu 2008 n'abahanga bo mu busitani bwa Kew Royal Botanic ; mugushakisha icyogajuru cya Google Earth kugirango ushakishe ahantu nyaburanga hatamenyekana muri Afrika. Bikunze kwitwa " Ishyamba rya Google ".
Ibituye ku musozi Mabu.
Hariho abaturage baturiye umusozi wa Mabu, hafi yabo ni Nangaze, Nvava, na Limbue. Uyu musozi ugira uruhare runini mubuzima bw'abaturage, kandi muri cosmologiya y'umuyobozi wa Nangaze. Inkuru zaho zivuga ko abayobozi ba mbere ba Nvava cyangwa umuryango wa Nangaze nyuma yo gupfa umwuka wabo wagurutse kumusozi. Ni n'impamvu ituma buri umwe muri aba baturage avuga ko byemewe ko ari umusozi wa Mabu. Abaturage bitabaza umusozi kugirango bakingire, nanone poroteyine zituruka ku nyamaswa, kurisha kw'amatungo, n’imihango gakondo. Ibi bikorwa byabyaye ubumenyi bwinshi bwaho kubyerekeye uyu musozi utaracukumburwa bijyanye n'inyungu ziyongera kuri Mabu. Muri cosmology yabo Umusozi Mabu ni ingingo y'umuco igomba kubahwa.
Kugeza ubu, hari imiryango ibiri itegamiye kuri Leta ya Mozambike ikorana n’abaturage guhindura umusozi wa Mabu ahantu ho kubungabunga ibidukikije, ari bo Justica Ambiental na RADEZA. Iyi miryango itegamiye kuri leta yashizeho amashyirahamwe yo kurinda umusozi wa Mabu mu baturage batandukanye. Justica Ambiental yashinze amashyirahamwe muri Nangaze, Nvava, Namadoe na Limbue. RADEZA yashyizeho komite zishinzwe gucunga umutungo kamere mu miryango ine yavuzwe n'izindi esheshatu. RADEZA ifatanije na ITC (Iniciativa de Terras Privadas) yemeje guverinoma gutanga ibyemezo by'ubutaka bw'abaturage - DUAT. Kugeza, ubungubu nta kubungabunga Mabu byemewe. Ariko, amashyirahamwe agenzura uko umusozi nishyamba byajya bisurwa.
Mu moko 126 y’inyoni yamenyekanye, hari abwoko burindwi bushya bw'amoko y’inyoni zibangamiwe ku isi mu ishyamba, harimo na Thyolo alethe, abandi baturage bose bakaba babangamiwe no kwangiza amashyamba no gutema amashyamba.
Habonetse amoko menshi mashya mu ishyamba ry'umusozi Mabu. Gutandukanya ishyamba ry'imvura, bikikijwe na savannah, bituma bishoboka ko ryakira amoko menshi mbere atavumbuwe. Amazina y' ubwoko kugeza ubu burimo:
Muri iryo shyamba hashobora kuba hari andi moko menshi mashya, hamwe n’abakandida kugeza ubu barimo umunyabwenge, pseudo-sikorupiyo, ibikeri, udusimba, udusimba, injangwe, nudukoko dutandukanye.
Muri Kamena 2009, guverinoma ya Mozambike yatangaje ko bazashyiraho ingamba zo kubungabunga ibidukikije kugira ngo ibicuruzwa bitinjira mu bucuruzi. Ishyamba rya Mabu ngo niryo shyamba rinini rinini ryo hagati muri Afurika. Amashyamba yo muri Afrika adahumanye no gutema ibiti nibindi bikorwa byabantu ntibisanzwe. Ishyamba ry'umusozi Mabu rikikijwe n'uturere twangijwe n'intambara y'abenegihugu ya Mozambike (1977–1992). Kubona umuhanda mubi, no kuyikoresha nkubuhungiro kubaturage baho mugihe cyintambara byose byagize uruhare mukurinda. Nta nyandiko zerekana ingendo zabanjirije cyangwa gukusanya ingendo zavumbuwe.

Igishanga cya Mulindi cyangwa Ikibaya cya Mulindi kiri mu karere ka Gicumbi,gifite ubuso bwa hegitare 1200, cyose cyari gisanzwe kirimo icyayi, ariko imwe mu mirima yacyo yari iri ku buso bwa hegitare 150 yatembeyemo imyuzure n’isuri biva ku misozi, bigiteza kuma.
Umushinga w’Ikigega cy’Ibidukikije, ushinzwe kubaka ubudahangwa bw’abaturage b’Akarere ka Gicumbi mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, harimo kubafasha kurwanya isuri n’imyuzure, ndetse no kongera umusaruro w’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi. rero umushinga ’Green Gicumbi’ ukorera muri ako Karere uvuga ko Leta n’abaturage batakomeza guhomba icyayi cyahingwaga mu kibaya cya Mulindi kubera imyuzure, ukaba urimo gufasha abagihinga ku misozi.
Ubundi icyayi kigira imizi miremire, iyo igeze ku mazi yo mu butaka biteza igiti cyose guhita cyuma. nubwo icyayi gikunda ahantu hahora imvura, icyo ku misozi ari cyo gikura neza kandi kikaryoha bitewe n’uko ibibabi bisoromwa biba bitarigeze birengerwa n’imyuzure yo mu gishanga. wari ufite umurima w’icyayi ungana na 1/2 cya hegitare mu kibaya cya Mulindi, avuga ko bataraterwa n’imyuzure yasoromaga ibiro birenga 150 buri byumweru bibiri, ariko ubu ngo nta na 70kg abasha kubona. icyayi yahinze imusozi yatangiye kubona ko kizamuha umusaruro ungana cyangwa urenga uwo yabonaga mu kibaya cya Mulindi ubwo yari atarangirizwa n’imyuzure hamwe n’isuri imanuka ku misozi.

Igishanga cya Cyohoha - Rukeri giherereye mu karere ka Rulindo, aha abaturage bavuga nta nyungu bagikuramo kuko bishyurwa amafaranga make ku kilo bakanakatwa amafaranga menshi y’ifumbire. Abo bahinzi kandi bavuga ko banakatwa amafaranga y’abatunganya bityo ngo bakaba basanga ubuhinzi bwabo nta kamaro bubafitiye uretse kubakamuramo imbaraga.
Uhinga icyayi muri iki gishanga, avuga ko ubu buhinzi bugirira akamaro abatari abahinzi ngo kuko ababagurira icyayi bakanabaterera imiti babaca amafaranga menshi. abasoromyi bo bahabwa amafaranga 21 ku kilo basoromye, twe twagiteye tukagikorera tukakitaho bakaduha 45 ku kilo, bagahindukira bagakuramo amafaranga y’amafumbire hakaba ubwo usanga mu kwezi umuntu asigarana ubusa agataha uko yaje.

Igishanga cya Cyohoha kiri mu karere ka Bugesera mu murenge wa Mayange, bamwe mu baturage bavuga ko babuze icyo bakora nyuma yo kubuzwa guhinga mu gishanga cya Cyohoha ahateye ibiti, mu gishanga cya Cyohoka hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Burundi.
mu myaka ya za 2000 ikiyaga cyaCyohoha, cyarakamye amazi ashiramo tukajya duhingamo urutoki, ibishyimbo, amateke n’imyumbati. Ariko mu mwaka muri 2016 REMA yatangiye kutwigisha uko twahinga imusozi tukareka guhinga mu kiyaga,batangira gutera imigano ku nkengero z’ikiyaga. itsinda ribungabunga ikiyaga cya Cyohoha. Avuga ko imyumvire yabo yahindutse ubu bakaba babungabunga ikiyaga babishyizeho umwete. kubungabunga ikiyaga cya Cyohoha dufashwa kujya tubyaza umusaruro urufunzo bakuramo ari narwo rugira uruhare mu gukamyamo amazi. Umwe Ati: “Batwigishije gukora pipinyeri no gutubura imbuto z’ibiti byo gutera. Urufunzo dukura mu kiyaga turubohamo isakaro ryo gutwikiriza ingemwe kugirango ziticwa n’izuba zikuma.
Imigano iteye mu gishanga cya Murago iteye ku nkengero za Cyohoha, umushinga wa bamboo uzabafasha kuyibyaza umusaruro kuburyo bazatera imbere kandi bagakomeza no kubungabunga iki kiyaga n’ibidukikije muri rusange badafite imbogamizi z’ubushobozi.

igishanga cya Mugonero gifite hegitare 50, kiri mu murenge wa Mahembe mu karere ka Nyamasheke, bivugwa ko nta musaruro w’umuceri bafite biturutse ku kuba amazi atakigera mu miyoboro y’igishanga.
Aba baturage bavuga ko mbere bezaga umuceri mwinshi ariko aho sosiyete y’Abashinwa itunganyirije ikiraro kiri hejuru y’umugezi wa Kiboga amazi atakinjira mu miyoboro, mbere amazi yarazaga neza nta kibazo ariko aho abashinwa baziye ntitwongeye kuyabona, ubu turahinga ntidusarure. nta musaruro tuzabona kubera kubura amazi kuko imvura ntacyo itumariye, ubu umuceri wagomba kuba uzanye uruyange.” Akomeza avuga ko mbere yezaga imfuka 100 y’umuceri utonoye ariko ko ubu abona nta na 50 azabona.

Igishanga cya Rusuri, kiri gutunganywa n'umushinga Welthungerhilfe kuva ku wa 26 Kamena 2015 urimo gutunganya iki gishanga cya Rusuri cyo mu Murenge wa Rwaniro mu Karere ka Huye, kugira ngo kizajye gihingwamo umuceri. iki gishanga, ngo uretse kuba bagiye kubona akazi kabinjiriza amafaranga mu gihe cy’amezi 20, ngo na nyuma yaho bazabasha kujya bahinga beze kurusha uko byari bisanzwe, nta n’uboneshereje nk’uko byari byarabaye akamenyero.
Igishanga bagiye gutunganya gifite ubuso bwa ha 120, ariko ngo nibamara kugitunganya, umuceri uzajya uhingwa kuri ha 70 gusa. Hegitari zisigaye, zimwe ni izizasigwa ku butaka bwegereye umugezi unyura muri iki gishanga, izindi ziri ku butaka bwo mu nkengero z’igishanga buzasigwa bugaterwaho ibiti hibanzwe ku byagirira akamaro abaturage, urugero nka avoka. Hari n’ibice bizagenda bisigara hagati mu gishanga bitazajya bihingwa, kugira ngo bizajye bisukura amazi yo mu gishanga. Kuri buri rugomero rw’amazi hazasigwa umwanya utazahingwamo, waretswe ku buryo bwa kamere, bya byatsi bisanzwemo bikagumamo. Turi no gutekereza ku byatsi twakongeramo, byifitemo ubushobozi bwo gufata amafumbire aba yashyizwe mu muceri, amazi akazajya avamo yamaze kuyungururwa.
Iki gishanga nikimara gutunganywa, imiryango 700 igituriye, haherewe ku yari isanzwe igihingamo, ndetse no ku ikennye kurusha iyindi, izabasha kujya ihinga umuceri. Ngo kizaba kinabereye ijisho, ku buryo ba mukerarugendo bashobora kuzagisura.

Igishanga cya Ngiryi kiri mu karere ka Huye, aho gikorerarmo na Koperative ya COPRORIZ Ngiryi, ihinga umuceri mu gishanga cya Ngiryi gihuza imirenge 3 ya: Musha, Ndora na Gishubi. harimo ikibazo cy'amazi make n'inyubako z'igishanga zishaje.
Taliki ya 3 Gashyantare Isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wo kwita ku bishanga n’ahantu hahehereye, akarere ka Huye kakaba gashyize imbaraga mu gutunganya ibishanga ngo karusheho kugira isura nziza itoshye kuko ibi bikorwa binahindurira abaturage ubuzima. Mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ibishanga kimwe n’ibindi bice bihehereye, Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Huye buvuga ko bwamaze guha umurongo gahunda yo gutunganya ibishanga.
Mu gihugu cyu Rwanda.
Ibishanga bigizwe na 10, 6% by’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda hamwe n’ibishanga bigera ku 915 byavumbuwe mu gihugu hose. Muri ibyo, ibishanga 38 bingana na 20% y’ubuso bwose birarinzwe.

Igishanga cya Jeredi, Igishanga cya Jeredi cyaratunganyijwe kugira ngo kirusheho kubyazwa umusaruro.
Igishanga gito cyitiriwe Jeredi gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 5 giherereye hagati y'Utugari twa Cubi na Nyamiramba mu Murenge wa Kayenzi, kuri uyu wa kane tariki ya 27 Nzeri 2018 nibwo hakiriwe by'agateganyo imirimo yo kugitunganya, kugira ngo kizabyazwe umusaruro mu buryo bufatika.
Kwakira imirimo yakozwe muri iki gishanga, byakozwe ku bufatanye n'Urwego rw'Inkeragutabara (Reserve Force) ari nabo batunganyije igishanga, muri iki gikorwa cyo kwakira imirimo yakozwe hari kandi tsinda ry'abakozi baturutse ku cyicaro cy'Akarere riyobowe n'Umuyobozi w'Agateganyo w'Ishami ry'ubuhinzi n'umutungo kamere bwana Mukiza Justin, itsinda ryaturutse ku Murenge ndetse n'Umufatanyabikorwa w'Umushinga RWAARI. Bimwe mu byakozwe mu gutunganya igishanga harimo ku gukora inziza(imiyoboro) z'amazi kugira ngo birinde ko isuri ya hato na hato, ikindi kandi imirima nayo yaratunganyijwe.
Muri iki gishanga ubusanzwe hari hasanzwe hakoreramo amatsinda mato mato y'abahinzi agera kuri 3, ngo ariko nkuko umukozi ushinzwe ubuhinzi mu Murenge abitangaza, biteganyijwe ko ayo matsinda yazakorwamo itsinda rimwe kugira ngo bifashe muri gahunda ya "smart Nkunganire. Nubwo n'ibindi bihingwa nk'ibigori n'ibishyimbo bigomba kwibandwaho kuko iki gishanga ari cyiza, u wari ukuriye itsinda rya mu gikorwa cyo kwakira iyi mirimo yakozwe mu gutunganya igishanga, yasabye abahinzi ko bashishikarira guhingamo n'imboga kugira ngo bashobora kubona amafaranga kuko imboga zitanga umusaruro mu buryo bwihuse.

Igishanga cya Mirayi gikora ku mirenge ya Muganza na Gishubi abagihingamo umuceri ubu bari gusarura ariko umusaruro wabo wagabanutse ku rwego rwa kimwe cya kabiri. Impamvu ngo ni imirimo yo gutunganya urundi ruhande rw’iki gishanga yatumye ahahinze hakama. Abahinzi muri aka gace ubuzima bwabo bushingiye ku gihingwa cy’umuceri ariko bavuga ko kubera iki kibazo ubu aho basaruraga 250Kg z’umuceri hari abari kuvanamo 100Kg gusa. Igishanga cya Mirayi n'Igishanga cya Nkunamo bihuza Gishubi na Mamba usanga umusaruro ari mukeya kuko ni Ibishanga byakamye, hasabwa ko byubakwaho ingomero zigezweho zigafasha kubyuhira bigahingwa hakabaho kuboneka k'umusaruro kuko ibishanga ni bimwe mu bifasha abaturage benshi kubona imirimo bakabona uko bahinga bakiteza imbere bakabona ibyo kudya bivuye mubuhinzi cyane ko mubishanga akenshi hakorwamo ubuhinzi bw'imiceri cyangwa se hagakorwa ubuhinzi bw'ibigori.

Igishanga cya Base,ni Igishanga cya Base cyose kiri mu karere ka Ruhango, hamwe gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 110. Imibare itangwa n'akarere ivuga ko 40 muri zo ari zo zangiritse. aho amazi y’imvura menshi abangiriza aturuka ku bisenge by’inyubako zo mu Mujyi wa Ruhango n’uwa Nyanza akamanukana umuvuduko agana mu mirima yabo, hari Hegitari nyinshi z’umuceri zarengewe n’isuri ahari hahinze umuceri hagaragara umucanga.

Igishanga cya Bahimba ni igishanga gihingwamo n'abaturage b'imirenge ya Bushoki, Tumba,Mbogo na Base na Rusiga yose yo mu karere ka rulindo mu intara y'ajyaruguru. Igishanga cya Bahimba kiri mu karere ka Rulindo, kuwa mbere tariki 08/10/2012, Minisitiri w’Intebe, yasuye ibikorwa bitandukanye bijyanye n’ubuhinzi bikorerwa mu gishanga cya Bahimba asanga icyo gishanga kitabyazwa umusaruro nk’uko bikwiye.
abayobozi b’akarere ka Rulindo yasabye gukoresha ingufu zose, bafatanyije n’abaturage, bagashaka imbuto ikwiranye n’icyo gishanga maze kigahingwa bakakibyaza umusaruro ku buryo bugaragara. Kimwe muri ibyo bibazo ni amazi yireka ahantu hamwe ntagere mu mirima y’abaturage yose. Ngo hari imiyoboro y’amazi yagombaga gutunganywa itaratunganywa ariko barimo gushaka uburyo yatunganywa bafatanije na MINAGRI.

Rafidine Abdullah (wavutse 15 Mutarama 1994) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati. Akunda gukina haba kwirwanaho cyangwa kubabaza. Yavukiye mu Bufaransa, ahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu ya komore ku isi.
Nyuma yo kwitoza hamwe n’ikipe nkuru muri shampiyona yo muri 2011–12 iyobowe n uwahoze ari umutoza Didier Deschamps, mbere yi gihembwe kiyobowe n'umuyobozi mushya Élie Baup, Abdullah yasubijwe mu ikipe nkuru burundu kandi yambaye nimero ya nimero 13. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa bigize umwuga ku ya 9 Kanama 2012 mu mukino wa kabiri w’amajonjora yo gushaka itike yo gukina na Eskişehirspor yo muri Turukiya.
Ku ya 3 Kanama 2016, Abdullah yagiye mu mahanga ku nshuro ya mbere mu mwuga we, asinyana amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri n’ikipe ya Espagne Segunda División Cádiz CF.
Ku ya 17 Nyakanga 2018, Waasland-Beveren yatangaje ko basinyanye na Abdullah ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Nyuma yo gukina iminota 644 gusa mu mikino icumi, Abdullah n'iyi kipe bahisemo gusesa amasezerano babyumvikanyeho ku ya 28 Mutarama 2019. "Amasezerano ya Abdullah yarangiye nyuma yuko Waasland-Bveren yanze kongererwa igihe shampiyona irangiye mu Busuwisi 2021-22."
Ibikorwa mpuzamahanga.
Abdullah yavukiye mu Bufaransa ku babyeyi b'Abasetsa. Umusore w’Ubufaransa wari uhagarariye igihugu cye kurwego rwabatarengeje imyaka 18. Yagarutse mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Comoros atangira kubakinira mu mukino wa gicuti na Togo n'amanota 2-2.

Benik Tunani Afobe (yavutse 12 Gashyantare 1993) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nka rutahizamu wa Hatta. Yavukiye mu Bwongereza, yaserukiye ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo inshuro esheshatu hagati yo muri 2017 na 2018.
Afobe yasinyanye amasezerano y’umwuga na Arsenal muri Gashyantare muri 2010, maze atizwa mu makipe atandukanye arimo Huddersfield Town, Reading, Bolton Wanderers, Millwall, Sheffield ku wa gatatu na Milton Keynes Dons mbere yo gusinyisha ikipe ya Wolverhampton Wanderers muri Mutarama 2015. Umwaka umwe, yasinyiye Bournemouth ku mayelo miliyoni 10. Nyuma y'igihembwe, yagarutse ku ntizanyo yahoze mu ikipe y’wolves muri shampiyona yakurikiyeho aho yabonye amayelo miliyoni 10 yoherejwe muri Molineux. Icyakora bidatinze, yinjiye muri Stoke City mu ntangiriro ku nguzanyo mbere yo guhinduka burundu muri Mutarama 2019.
Afobe yari mu ikipe y'Ubwongereza yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona yo mu Burayi munsi yabafite imyaka 17 -FA y'abatarengeje imyaka 17 muri Gicurasi 2010.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Afobe yavukiye i Leyton, muri Londere, akurira i Dagenham aho yize amashuri abanza ya Monteagle ndetse n’ishuri ry’abaturage rya Jo Richardson. Yinjiye muri Arsenal Academy afite imyaka itandatu; yakinaga mu cyumweru cya shampiyona Eclipse FC i Dagenham ubwo yabonwaga numuskuti wa Arsenal - Gary Nott. Yinjiye muri Arsenal ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2001. Yatsinze ibitego 40 muri U-16 muri 2007–08, ibitego 11 mumikino 13 yakinnye muri 2008–09, n'ibitego 21 mumikino 24 yakinnye muri Arsenal U-18 muri 2009–10. Yatorewe kuba umukinnyi U-18 wa Arsenal muri shampiyona.
Afobe yahise atsinda ibitego bibiri batsinda Manchester United ibitego 4-0 mu mikino yi cyiciro cya kabiri nyuma yo kuza kumusimbura. Mu cyiciro cya gatatu, yatsinze ibindi bitego bibiri kugirango afashe ikipe ye gutsinda Bradford City no kugera mu cyiciro cya kane. Ku ya 29 Ugushyingo, Afobe yatsinze Hat trick itsinze Colchester United 6–0.

Chadrac Akolo (wavutse ku ya 1 Mata 1995) ni umukinnyi w’umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ufite ubwengehiguhu bwa kanada ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe y’abasuwisi ya St. Gallen ndetse n’ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo.
Akolo wavukiye muri DR Congo, yavuye mu gihugu cye n'umuryango we kubera imvururu za politiki zaho maze agenda yambuka inyanja ya Mediterane, agera mu Busuwisi afite imyaka 14. Aho niho yakuye ijisho akinira FC Sion yo muri shampiyona yo Busuwisi Super League.
Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2016, Akolo wavutse i Kinshasa yinjiye muri Neuchâtel Xamax ku ntizanyo kugeza shampiyona irangiye muri 2015-16.
Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2017, Akolo yasinyanye amasezerano y’imyaka ine na VfB Stuttgart.
Muri Nyakanga 2019, yimukiye muri Amiens SC.
Yinjiye muri SC Paderborn ku ntizanyo kugeza shampiyona irangiye muri Gashyantare 2021.
Ku ya 3 Nyakanga 2022, Akolo yimukiye i St. Gallen mu Busuwisi ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Akolo yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya DR Congo mu mukino wo gushaka itike yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA kuya 2 gashyantare 2018 na Tuniziya ku ya 5 Nzeri 2017.

Dieumerci Mukoko Amale (wavutse 17 Ukwakira 1998) Ni umukinnyi ukina umukinnyi w'umupira ukomoka muri Congo ukina nk'umukinnyi wi nyuma wa DHJ. Ahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo.
Amale yamaze ubuzima bwe bwa mbere akinira ikipe ya DCMP mu gihugu cye cykaavukire cya DR Congo. Yimukiye mu ikipe ya DHJ yo muri Maroke ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 2020.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 18 Nzeri 2019. Amale yatangiriye muri DR Congo mu mukina wa gicuti cyatsinzwe n'u Rwanda ibitego 3-2
