Britt Curtis Assombalonga (yavutse kuya 6 ukuboza Ku 1992) Ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru wa congo ukina nka rutahizamu muri Watford FC.
Assambalonga yavukiye muri Zayire (izina ryitiriwe Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuya 1971 kugeza 1997) ariko umuryango we wimukiye i Londres afite amezi umunani. Yakuriye mu kazu k'Ubusuwisi, mu gace ka Londere ka Kamden. Yagiye mu ishuri rya Whitefield kandi ni umuhungu wa Fedor Assombalonga, wahoze akina umupira mpuzamahanga wa Zayire.
Peterborough United.
Ku ya 6 Kanama 2014, Assombalonga yinjiye mu Nottingham Forest, ku masezerano y’imyaka itanu ku giciro cy’amafaranga miliyoni 5 zishobora kuzamuka kugera kuri miliyoni 8 zishingiye ku bigaragara (muri zo Watford izahabwa 50% kubera kugurisha ku ngingo). Ibi byatumye ishyamba rya Assombalonga Nottingham ryashyirwa umukono ku masezerano, hiyongeraho miliyoni 4.5 zama pound yahawe Celtic kuri rutahizamu Pierre van Hooijdonk mu 1997. Assombalonga yatsinze ibitego bye byambere mu mashyamba nyuma yiminsi cumi n'ibiri nyuma yo gusinyana na Bolton Wanderers kuri Stade Macron. Nyuma yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu mikino ibiri yakurikiyeho na Bournemouth na Reading. Yatsinze igitego muri East Midlands Derby, afungura amazamu na Derby County. Assombalonga yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere ku ishyamba ku ya 17 Nzeri itsinze iwayo ibitego 5-3 na Fulham iherutse gusezererwa. Nyuma yongeye gutsinda igitego gikurikiraho yakinnye na East Midlands Derby, anganya na Pride Pariki amaherezo atsinda ibitego 2-1. Ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2015 batsinze Wigan Athletic ibitego 3-0, Assombalonga yagize imvune ikomeye yo mu ivi bikekwa ko itazakomeza kumara amezi cumi n'abiri. Assombalonga iragaruka mukibuga cya Shampiyona nyuma y'amezi cumi n'ane adahari, mugihe cya 43 umunsi wa shampionat na Blackburn Rovers isimbuye Robert Tesche kuminota 84 (1-1).
Ku ya 6 Kanama 2016, iyobowe n'umutoza mushya Philippe Montanier, yatsindiye Burton umukino wo gufungura shampiyona.
Ku ya 29 Mutarama 2022, yinjiye muri Watford FC.
Ku ya 27 Werurwe 2018, Britt Assombalonga yishimiye guhitamo kwe kwa mbere na Tanzaniya, mu mukino wa gicuti.
Yatoranijwe na Florent Ibenge kugirango azitabira igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2019. Ku munsi wa 3 yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muguhangana na Zimbabwe.

Ikiyaga Nasser ni ikiyaga kinini cyakozwe n'abantu. Kiri mu majyepfo ya Misiri no mu majyaruguru ya Sudani. Cyabayeho kubera urugomero runini rwa Aswan rwubatswe ku mugezi wa Nili.
Ikiyaga Nasser ni kimwe mu biyaga binini ku isi byakozwe n'abantu. Amazi yacyo atanga amashanyarazi muri Misiri.
Ikiyaga Nasser ni kimwe mu biyaga binini ku isi byakozwe n'abantu. Gifite uburebure bwa km 479. Ahagutse cyane, gifite km 16. Gifite ubuso bwa km² 5 250. Gishobora kubika amazi agera kuri km³ 132.
Ikiyaga cyabayeho kubera iyubakwa ry'urugomero runini rwa Aswan ku mugezi wa Nili. Urwo rugomero rwubatswe hagati ya 1958 na 1970.
Amashanyarazi n'amazi.
Amazi y'Ikiyaga Nasser akoreshwa n'urugomero rwa Aswan mu gutanga amashanyarazi. Misiri ifite impungenge ko urugomero rushya rwa Etiyopiya ruzagabanya amazi ya Nili yinjira mu kiyaga. Ibyo byagabanya amashanyarazi atangwa n'urugomero rwa Aswan.

Ikiyaga cya Manzala ni ikiyaga cy'amazi y'umunyu cyo mu majyaruguru y'iburasirazuba bwa Misiri. Kiri ku nkombe y'Inyanja ya Mediterane, mu Delta ya Nili, hafi ya Port Said.
Ni cyo kiyaga kinini mu biyaga byo mu majyaruguru ya Delta ya Nili. Kuva mu kinyejana cya 20, ubuso bwacyo bwaragabanutse cyane.
Ikiyaga cya Manzala kiri mu majyaruguru y'iburasirazuba bwa Misiri, hafi ya Port Said. Kiri ku birometero bike uvuye ku matongo ya kera ya Tanis. Ni cyo kiyaga kinini mu biyaga byo mu majyaruguru ya Delta. Mu 2008, cyari gifite uburebure bwa km 47 n'ubugari bwa km 30.
Ikiyaga ntikigira ubujyakuzimu bunini. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo buri hagati ya m 4 na m 5. Hasi y'ikiyaga hari ibumba ryoroshye.
Port Said yashinzwe hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Manzala mu kinyejana cya 19, igihe hubakwaga Umuyoboro wa Suez. Ikiyaga kiri mu majyepfo y'ikibuga cy'indege cya Port Said. Kibuza umujyi kwaguka.
Ikiyaga cya Manzala cyahoze ari isoko y'amafi ahendutse muri Misiri. Ariko umwanda mu mazi wagabanyije umusaruro. Mu 1985, uburobyi bwakorerwaga ku buso bwa hegitari 89 000. Bwakoreshaga abantu bagera ku 17 000.
Leta ya Misiri yumukije igice kinini cy'ikiyaga kugira ngo gihingwe. Ariko ibihingwa ntibyakuze neza mu butaka bw'umunyu. Kugeza mu 2001, ikiyaga cyari cyatakaje hafi 80 % by'ubuso bwacyo.

Serge Dikilu Bageta (yavutse ku ya 24 Werurwe 1978 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri congo wahoze akina umupira wamaguru aheruka gukinira Free State Stars FC.
Yinjiye muri Ajax CT muri 2003, mbere yakinnye muri DC Motema Pembe na Tout Puissant Mazembe. Kuva yinjira muri iyi kipe, Bageta yagize uruhare runini hagati nka myugariro wa Ajax. Aherutse guhuzwa no kwerekeza mu makipe menshi yo mu Burayi. Yavuye muri Ajax muri 2008 yinjira muri Afurika yepfo muri Maritzburg United.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
ni Myugariro nu munyamahanga ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo.

Cédric Bakambu (yavutse ku ya 11 Mata 1991) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukina nk'umukinnyi ukina imbere mu ikipe ya Olympiacos yo muri shampiyona yo Bugereki ya Super League ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo.
Yatangiye gukinira by'umwuga muri Sochaux mu mwaka wa 2010, anabakinira imikino 107 yemewe mu bihe bitanu, atsinda ibitego 21. Nyuma yi mukiye i Bursaspor kuri miliyoni 1.8 zamayelo, arangiza ari we watsinze ibitego byinshi kuko ikipe ye yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri mu gikombe cya Turukiya, mbere yo gusinyira Villarreal nyuma yumwaka.
Yavukiye mu Bufaransa, yabahagarariye ku rwego mpuzamahanga ubyiruko kugeza ku batarengeje imyaka 20, atsinda ibitego umunani mu mikino 38 anatsindira Shampiyona y’Uburayi yo muri 2010 mu batarengeje imyaka 19. Muri 2015, yatangiye gukinira ikipe ye y'igihugu ya Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo.
Bakambu yavukiye i Vitry-sur-Seine, yatangiye umwuga we muri Ivry waho afite imyaka 10 mbere yo kwimukira i Sochaux nyuma yimyaka ine.
Ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2010, Bakambu yakinnye umukino wa nyuma wa Coupe Gambardella muri 2010 maze atsindira ikipe ye igitego kuri Stade ya France. Sochaux ariko, yatsinzwe umukino 4–3 kuri penariti. Yabanje gutsinda ibitego bibiri muri kimwe cya kane yatsinze kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza yatsinze Metz.
Bakambu yatangiye umwuga we ku ya 7 Kanama 2010 mu mukino wafunguye wa Sochaux wo muri shampiyona ya Ligue 1 na Arles-Avignon, agaragara nk'umusimbura ku munota wa 83 wasimbuye Modibo Maïga ku ntsinzi y'ibitego 2–1 kuri Stade Auguste Bonal. Ukwezi kwakurikiyeho, yasinyanye amasezerano ye yambere yumwuga yemera amasezerano y'imyaka itatu niyi kipe kugeza muri Kamena 2013.

Esele Bakasu (yavutse Ku ya 13 Werurwe 1975) muri Zaire, ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru wa congo (DRC), wakinnye nka myugariro.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire cyangwa DRC, yakinnye hagati muri 1997 na 2002.
Ari mu itsinda ryatoranijwe mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 1998, 2000 na 2002. Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa muri 1998.
Yakinnye kandi imikino ibiri, ibara icyiciro kibanza cy'igikombe cy'isi.

Jean-Bertrand Baleckita (Ku ya 6 Mutarama 1948) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo wavukiye i Brazzaville muri Afurika ekwatoriyare. Akina nka rutahizamu.
Abavandimwe be Serge-Simon Balekita-Nzaba na Ferdinand nabo ni abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru.
Jean-Bertrand Balekita yegukanye igikombe cya Afurika muri 1972. Yarushanwe nyuma y'imyaka ibiri mu marushanwa yo muri 1974 yasohotse.
Amaze gukura nk'umupira w'amaguru, yinjiye mu gisirikare maze aba umukoloneli kandi akora ku mwanya wa attaché wa gisirikare kuri ambasade ya Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo muri kuba.

Musemestre Bamba yavutse Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1971 i Kinshasa ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Icyo gihe yari umutoza wungirije wa SC Roland Beckum.
Yakinnye nk'umukinnyi ukina hagati. Musemestre Bamba yakiniye US Kintambo na AS Vita Club yi Kinshasa muri Kongo atangiye umwuga we mbere yinjira muri shampiyona ya Turukiya i Denizlispor muri shampiyona yo muri 1994-1995. Nyuma yimukiye mu Budage aho yakiniye SpVg Marl na VfB Hüls.
Mu 1996, Abanyekongo basinyanye na LR Ahlen. Hamwe niyi kipe, yitabiriye kuzamuka kugera mu cyiciro cya2 muri Bundesliga mu mpera za shampiyona ya 1999–00 Regionalliga, mu cyiciro cya kane cyumupira w'amaguru w’Ubudage, aho iyi kipe yagumye imyaka itandatu. Yatsinze imikino 314 yose (harimo 173 ) muri iyi kipe (niya nyuma yiswe Rot Weiss Ahlen muri 2006), atsinda ibitego 54 harimo 24 muri Bundesliga ya kabiri. Uyu mukinnyi wibasiye impande zose yakoreshejwe nkikarita kubera imyaka afite kubakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru kuva ikipe ye yamanuka muri Regionalliga Nord muri 2006. Bitewe n'ubudahemuka bwe muri iyi kipe, Musemestre Bamba ni umwe mu bakinnyi bakunzwe cyane muri iyi kipe. Ariko, amasezerano ye ntiyongeye kongerwa nyuma yi gihembwe cyo muri 2006-2007.
Mu gice cya mbere cya shampiyona yo muri 2007–08, Musemestre Bamba yagiranye amasezerano na SV Lippstadt 08 muri Oberliga Westfalen, ariko agaruka muri Regionalliga Nord muri SC Verl mu kiruhuko cy’itumba, aho yakuye amasezerano kugeza mu mpera za 2008 Igihembwe -2009. Ariko, aya masezerano araseswa muri kuboza 2008 kubwu mvikane ningirakamaro mu mpera zumwaka. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, Musemestre Bamba yakiniye irushanwa y'igihugu cya shampiyona SG Telgte. Kuva muri shampiyona ya 2010–11 yakiniye SC Roland Beckum, bazamuwe mu ntera bava muri Landesliga bajya muri Verbandsliga muri 2011 na Oberliga Westfalen muri 2012. Kuva mu 2012 yabaye umutoza wungirije w'ikipe ya Beckum Oberliga.
Bamba akina imikino itatu mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, atatsinze igitego.

Yannick Bangala Litomba,(yavutse taliki ya 14 Mata 1994) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru waRepuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo. Akina nka myugariro cyangwa umukinnyi wo hagati urinda izamu, kuri ubu akinira Young Africans.
Hamwe no gutoranya Abanyekongo batarengeje imyaka 20, yitabiriye igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Africa cyo muri 2013 cyateguwe muri Alijeriya. Hamwe n’abatoranijwe nyamukuru, yaje kwitabira amarushanwa y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2014 na 2016. Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo yatsindiye ku nshuro ya 2016 yabereye mu Rwanda, itsinze Mali ku mukino wa nyuma n'amanota 3-0.

Jean-Kasongo Banza (yavutseKu ya 26 Kamena 1974 apfa ku ya 7 Kamena 2024) i Kinshasa, icyo gihe hitwaya muri Zaire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Yiswe abashyigikiye ikipe ya AS Vita Club " "Korando" ".
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire hanyuma ikitwa DRC, yakinnye imikino 25 (nta gitego yatsinze) hagati muri 1996 na 2001.
Ari mu ikipe mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1996, 1998 na 2000. Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa muri 1998.

Ngabu Yannick Bapupa (yavutse Ku ya 21 Mutarama 1982) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo i Kinshasa (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ahahoze ari Zayire). Yakinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Yatojwe mu ikipe ya AS Vita, Bapupa yari afite imyaka makumyabiri(20) ubwo yimukiye muri Suwede.
Ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 2009, yiyandikishije muri shampiyona eshatu hamwe na Kalmar FF, batwaye shampiyona y'igihugu muri 2008 nu mwanya 4 m'umwaka ushize. Umubare w'amafaranga yimuwe noneho abarirwa kuri miliyoni 4 SEK, hiyongereyeho igihembo cyo gusinya kingana na miliyoni 1.3 mu SEK. Nyuma yiminsi icumi ageze i Småland (5Ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2009), uyu mukinnyi yatawe muri yombi azira gufata ku ngufu umukobwa w’imyaka 18 i Gävle mu birori byihariye byateguwe ejo bundi. Bimaze kumenyekana kuri polisi (muri 2007, yakatiwe amasaha 90 yo gukora umuganda n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 40 000 mu SEK kubera gukubita mugenzi we), Bapupa yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka ibiri. Ku ya 12 Werurwe 2010, kimwe no kwishyura indishyi zingana na 85 000 muSEK ku wahohotewe, ariko aratoroka yirukanwa.
Yarekuwe Ku ya 7 Kamena 2011, Kalmar ntashaka kugarura kY masezerano yasheshwe Ku ya 14 Mata 2010, amasaha make nyuma y'ubujurire bwe bwanzwe n'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rwa Suwede. Mu masezerano yagiranye na SFF, iyi kipe ntabwo isabwa kwishyura umushahara wumukinnyi utarigeze akina ku mugaragaro amabara ye. Ku rundi ruhande, Bapupa agumana igihembo cye cyo gusinya. Ubu nta masezerano, asa naho yiyemeje gukomeza umwuga we nk'uko byatangajwe n'umukozi we Innocent Okeke. Uwahoze ari perezida muri Gefle IF, Leif Lindstrand, aratangaza ku ruhande rwe ko adateganya kugaruka ku Banyekongo muri iyi kipe aho yamaze ibihe bine.

Jérémie Basilua ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo..
Yatsinze igitego muri Seyishele Ku ya 29 Gashyantare 2012, mugihe cy'ambere cyatoranijwe (nicya nyuma).
Yaje gutorwa mu ikipe y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 y’Abanyekongo mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2013. Hamwe n'imikino yo kunganya no gutsindwa kabiri, Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo ntiyashoboye kurenga icyiciro cya mbere.

Basilua Jérémie ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo..
Yatsinze igitego muri Seyishele Ku ya 29 Gashyantare 2012, mugihe cy'ambere cyatoranijwe (nicya nyuma).
Yaje gutorwa mu ikipe y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 y’Abanyekongo mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2013. Hamwe n'imikino yo kunganya no gutsindwa kabiri, Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo ntiyashoboye kurenga icyiciro cya mbere.

Samuel Bastien, wavutse Ku ya 26 Nzeri 1996 i Meux mu Bubiligi, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati muri Burnley FC.
Urubyiruko n'amahugurwa.
Samuel Bastien wavutse ku babyeyi b'Abanyekongo, yarezwe na Patrick na Monique Bastien akiri muto. Yatojwe muri RFC Meux na UR Namur, Samuel Bastien yahise amara ibihe bitatu mu makipe y'urubyiruko ya Standard de Liège mbere yo kwinjira mu ishuri rya RSC Anderlecht.
Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2014, ubwo yatsindwaga na RSC Anderlecht kuri Royal Mouscron Peruwelz (4-2), Samuel Bastien yakinnye iminota ye ya mbere y'umwuga afite imyaka 18.
Amerika Avellino (intizanyo).
Bitewe no kutagira ibyiringiro kuri Anderlecht, yagurijwe muri Amerika Avellino umwaka umwe muri Serie ya B.
Kanama 2016, agurishwa muri Chievo Verona na Anderlecht. aHasigaye imyaka bibiri.
Ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2018, Samuel Bastien yasubiye mu Bubiligi asinyana muri Standard de Liège. Ku ya 22 Nyakanga 2018, yakinnye iminota ye ya mbere hamwe na Standard de Liège gusa baza gutsindwa mu gikombe cy’Ububiligi cyatsinzwe na FC Bruges (2-1). Ku ya 7 Kanama 2018, yakinnye umukino we wambere w'iburayi mu mikino ya gatatu yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira igikombe cya Shampiyona iwayo na Ajax Amsterdam (2-2). Ku ya 18 Kanama 2018, yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere kuri Rouches itsinze na KSC Lokeren (0-3). Ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2019, Samuel Bastien yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muri shampiyona ya Europa League mu mukino wanganyije na Arsenal (2-2). Ku ya 15 Ukuboza 2019, mugihe cy'umukino wahuje Standard na Anderlecht, Bastien yavuy mu kibuga afite imvune. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, nyuma yo gukora ibizamini byo kwa muganga, hamenyekanye imvune y'ukuguru kw'ibumoso. Iyi mvune imuhagarika kugeza mu mpera zo muri 2019. Muri shampiyona ya 2020–21, Samuel Bastien yazamuwe kuba visi kapiteni na Philippe Montanier. Yatangiye shampiyona atsinda igitego mu mikino yambere yo mu rugo yakinnye na Cercle Brugge Ku ya 8 Kanama 2020 (1-0). Ku ya 17 Kanama 2020, mu mukino wa kabiri wa shampiyona yakinnye na Waasland-Beveren, yongeye gutsinda igitego ariko arakomereka atinze umukino. Samuel Bastien arwaye myotendinous disinsertion ya kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibumoso (hamstring). Imvune yamusize ukwezi kurenga bituma abura imikino icyenda.

Mukoko Batezadio, (yavutse Ku ya 24 Ukwakira 1992) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo, ukina nka rutahizamu kuri Ittihad ya Tangier.
Yitabira na AS Vita Club muri marushanwa ya Afrika Champions League ndetse n'igikombe cya Confederation. Yageze ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Confederation Cup muri 2018, batsindwa na Raja de Casablanca. Batezadio yatsinze igitego ku mukino wa nyuma w'icyiciro cya kabiri, ariko bikaba byagaragaye ko bidahagije kugirango batsinda irushanwa.
Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mu ikipe ya Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo, Ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2015, mu mukino wa gicuti na Zambiya (intsinzi 0-3). Nyuma yakinnye bukeye na Angola (gutsindwa 1-0). Ariko, iyi mikino yombi ntabwo yemewe na FIFA.
Nyuma, muri 2016, yitabiriye igikombe cya COSAFA. Akina imikino itatu muri iri rushanwa, ahanganye na Mozambike, Botswana na Swaziland. Congo yaje ku mwanya wa kane mu marushanwa.

Patrick Batshi uzwi nka "Anelka" (yavutse Ku ya 20 Ukwakira 1984) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo.
Patrick Batshi yatangiye umwuga wo gukina muri 2004 hamwe na AS Vita Club yi Kinshasa, aho yakinnye imyaka itatu mbere yo kwinjira muri AS Vita Kabasha mu Gushyingo 2006. Nyuma y'amezi atatu, yavuye mu gihugu cye cya Kongo maze atura muri Shipure y'Amajyaruguru aho yasinye muri Gashyantare 2007 n'ikipe ya Telsim Süper Lig club muri shampiyona ya Ozanköy SK. Nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego 23 mu mikino 38 mu myaka itatu nigice, Batshi yimuye mu Gushyingo 2010 ku mukinnyi wa shampiyona Çetinkaya TSK.
Yakinnye guhitamo kwe kugeza ubu muri 2005 mu mukino wa gicuti wabereye muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo.

Epotele Bazamba (yavutse Ku ya 13 Gicurasi 1976 icyo gihe ari muri Zaire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa congo (DRC), wakinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire nyuma yabaye DRC Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo, yakinnye hagati yo muri 1997 na 2001.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 1998 na 2000. Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa yo muri 1998.
Yakinnye imikino itandatu abara icyiciro cya mbere cy'igikombe cy'isi, mu gihe cyo muri 1998 na 2002

Eddy Bembuana-Keve, yavutse Ku ya 24 Ukuboza 1972 mucyari Zaire, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga wumupira wamaguru ukomoka muri congo wavukiye mu bubiligi mu mwaka wa 2001 wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Akina umwuga we wose mu bubiligi usibye igihembwe yari mu butaliyani.
Yitabiriye CAN muri 1998, aho yakinnye imikino itatu atsinda igitego muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Yahagaritse umwuga we wu mwuga muri 2003.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Muri 1998, Eddy Bembuana-Keve yahamagawe inshuro nyinshi mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Kongo kandi yakinnye cyane mu mikino itatu ya CAN muri 1998, atsinda igitego kimwe.

Ben Malango, uzwi ku izina ryuzuye rya Ben Malango Ngita, (wavutse10 Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1993) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i Kinshasa muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo. Akina nka rutahizamu muri Qatar SC no ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Urubyiruko n'amahugurwa.
Ben Malango Ngita yavutse ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1993 i Masina, muri komini mu burasirazuba bwa Kinshasa, umurwa mukuru n'umujyi munini wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yatangiye gukina umupira wamaguru mu ikipe yoroheje ya Jack Trésor Kinshasa, bamarana imyaka ye ya mbere yo kwitoza.
Gutangira muri Don Bosco (2013-2016).
Muri 2013, ubwo yari afite imyaka 20, Malango yagiye i Lumumbashi, agamije kwinjira muri Cercle Sportif Don Bosco, yazamuwe mu ntera mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Kongo. Yavumbuwe mu ba bigize umwuga akina imikino ya shampiyona ya DRC muri 2013-2014, aho iyi kipe yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri mu itsinda ryayo, ihuza na nyampinga uzaza, ya muri TP Mazembe. Ibi bimufasha kugera kuri play-off, azayirangiza kumwanya wa kane.
Ibyahishuwe kuri TP Mazembe (2016-2019).
Ben Malango amaze gutsinda ibitego umunani ndetse na bane bamufasha mu cyiciro cya mbere cya shampiyona, Ben Malango ntiyigeze ahunga y’ikipe yitwaye neza muri iki gihugu, TP Mazembe, yatangaje ko izinjira mu Gushyingo 2016.
Ku ya 19 Ugushyingo 2017, yegukanye igikombe cya Confederation Cup muri 2017, yatsinze ikipe ya Supersport United yo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Byagaragaye ko yatsinze igitego muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza umukino wa mbere yakinnye n'ikipe ya Maroc FUS Rabat.
Akina kandi umukino wanyuma wa Afurika muri Super Cup muri 2017 na 2018. Muri 2017, ikipe ye yatsinzwe na Mamelodi Sundowns. Muri 2018, ikipe ye yongeye gutsindwa, kuri iyi nshuro na Wydad AC.
Yageze no muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza muri Champions League muri 2018 hamwe ni yi kipe, hanyuma kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri 2019. Yatsinze ibitego birindwi muri iri rushanwa yo muri 2018. Yatsinze igitego cyatsinzwe n'ikipe ya yo muri Mozambike, nyuma yikubye kabiri ikipe ya ES Sétif yo muri Alijeriya.
Mu Gushyingo 2018, ubwo CAF yashyize ahagaragara urutonde rwa batoranijwe mu byiciro bitandukanye by’imihango itandukanye ya CAF muri 2018, Ben Malango yashyizwe mu cyiciro cy’umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Afurika w’umwaka hamwe n’abandi bakinnyi bagera 33.

Mutarama Besala Bokungu (yavutse ku ya 30 Mutarama 1989) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, ukina mu binyuma-iburyo.
Muri Nyakanga 2007, yimuriwe muri Esperance Sportive de Tunis. Amasezerano ye y'agombaga kurangira muri Kamena 2011. Janvier Besala yagarutse muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo avuye mu kwakira 2010. Yashoboye, muburyo bubi, gusubiza mu ikipe ya TP Mazembe atanyuze ku miyoboro yemewe. CAF ishinja ikipe ya TP Mazembe kuba yaratanze umukinnyi utujuje ibyangombwa mu mukino wahuje ikipe ya Simba FC yo muri Tanzaniya, ndetse na Wydad wo muri Casablanca ubara, ku mukino wa nyuma wa 16 na 8 wa nyuma wa Champions League muri 2011. Ku ya 14 Gicurasi 2011, CAF yahisemo kutemera ikipe ya congo.

Joel Beya Tumetuka, (yavutse Ku ya 8 Ukuboza 1999) i Lubumbashi, muri congo, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akina ari mpuzamahanga ukina nka rutahizamu muri TP Mazembe.
Joël Beya yatoje muri ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Ecofoot Katumbi. Akina muri shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru mu ntara afite ibitego 11 mu mikino 8, bityo ikipe ikazamuka ikagera kuri linafoot yo muri congo, aho yaje kurangira yatsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi kipe ibitego 5, kandi afite pasiporo ye kubacuruzi ba Don Bosco. Beya yarangije gutsinda ibitego byinshi kuri Don Bosco ibitego 7 maze ubuyobozi bufata icyemezo cyo kumuzana muri Tout Puissant Mazembe. Yazamutse neza aho yakinnye igikombe cye cya mbere cya Afrika, akurwaho na Raja de Casablanca, yaje gukina k' umunota wa 78.

Gerard Biena Mukunku, (wavutse Ku ya 5 Werurwe 1977) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muricongo, ukina nka myugariro, ubu ni umutoza w'umupira w'amaguru. Ni umwe mu bagize itsinda ry’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira wamaguru i Kinshasa, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Mukunku yakinnye mu gihugu mu makipe nka Desembe na Vita, babaye na shampiyo w’igihugu inshuro enye. Nubwo myugariro yari ku mwanya wamyugariro, Mukunku niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi kipe, akaba ari we watsinze penaliti. Muri icyo gihe, Mukunku yanakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo. Mu 2000, umukozi w'umupira w'amaguru yatangiye gushakira, Mukunka ibintu byinjiza amafaranga. Abanyekongo barebaga mu Bubiligi Lokeren na Tuniziya Étoile du Sahel, ariko nta makipe n'imwe yaje asubira i Vita. Mu 2001, Mukunku yakinnye umukino wa mbere w'ikipe y'igihugu mu marushanwa yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi muri 2002 na Tuniziya
Mu 2000, umuyobozi wa Spartak Moscou, Yury Zavarzin, wagize uruhare mu bucuruzi bwa diyama, yahawe uburenganzira na Vita Club. Nyiri Spartak, Andrei Chervichenko, yakuye umukinnyi mwiza w'iyi kipe Gerard Mukunka muri iyo kipe, asinyisha umukinnyi amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri.
Mukunku yasubiye mu gihugu cye kavukire yimukira muri club TP Mazembe. Umwaka umwe, Fakel yasubiye mu cyiciro cya mbere maze atumira Mukunku kongera gukinira ikipe ya Voronezh, ariko aranga. Mukunku yaje kwinjira mu ikipe ya Maniema Union, aba kapiteni w'ikipe kandi yitabira imikino ya CAF Confederations Cup muri 2008.
Mu mwaka wa 2014, Mukunku yahatiwe guhagarika umwuga we nyuma yo gutsinda umucamanza mu mukino w’igikombe cya DR Congo, kuko atemerewe imyaka icumi.
Mukunku afite umugore Bongueli n'abana babiri, umuhungu Jordan hamwe n'umukobwa Prisilla, ndetse n'abana yareze. Uyu mugore kandi yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru, akinira ikipe ya Milinga yo muri Kongo ndetse n'ikipe y'abagore ya Kongo Ni umuyoboke wa Kimbanguism.

Eric Bokanga Musau,(wavutse Ku ya 9 Ukwakira 1988) i Kinshasa muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa congo. Akina nka rutahizamu mu ikipe ya AS Vita Club.
Yakinnye kugeza icyo gihe muri JAC Trésor na Benfica de Luanda hanyuma muri AS Vita Club, yinjiye muri Standard de Liège mu kwimura impeshyi muri shampiyona ya 2010/2011.
Nyuma yo guturuka mu gihugu cye agakurikirwa n’amakipe akomeye yo mu Burayi, Standard de Liège yahisemo kumugura mu ikipe ye, AS Vita Club. Nyuma yo gutsinda ibizamini byuzuye, yakurikiwe na AJ Auxerre. Mugihe umukinnyi yari akwiye gukodeshwa muri AS Vita Club, yimurwa rero burundu kumafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 60.000 za madorali. Umukinnyi wa congo yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri hariya muri Liège club nu mwaka winyongera. Kubwamahirwe make, uku gutangaza kurangira kunanirwa, umukinnyi kuba soyvent yakomeretse kandi adashobora kumenyera imiterere yuburayi bwo gukina, igihe cye cyo gukina kiragabanuka kandi ntagihamagariwe guhitamo. Yahagaritse amasezerano muri Mutarama 2011 akanasinyana na TP Mazembe mu rwego rwo kubyutsa impano ye.
