Gladys Bokese (yavutse Ku ya 10 Nzeri 1983) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wumupira wamaguru ukomoaka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo(DRC) i Kinshasa. Akina nka myugariro wo hagati.
Umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa congo, yitabiriye igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yakiriye ikarita itukura mu mukino wahuje Kameruni kubera gukubita cyane Achille Webo mu gihe CAN muri 2006. Yatsindiye igikombe cya mbere cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2009 hamwe n’abakinnyi baho muri Kote Divawari.
Bokese ari mu ba kapiteni b'ibyamamare b'ikipe y'icyatsi n'umweru y'umurwa mukuru wa DRC, Daring Club Motema Pembe (DMCP).
Yayoboye ikipe ye inshuro nyinshi mu marushanwa y'igihugu, Igikombe cya Congo na Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru yabatijwe VSL-Vodacom Super League, ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga igikombe cya CAF, C2 ndetse rimwe muri CAF Champions League.

Jérémy Bokila (yavutse Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 1988) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo ukina nka rutahizamu muri Willem II Tilburg.
Jérémy Bokila yimukiye akiri muto hamwe n'ababyeyi be mu Buholandi. Aho niho yatangiriye umupira we wa mbere, muri ZSV Zelos, ikipe yakiniraga. Amaze imyaka icumi mu m'akipe atandukanye yabato y'imyaka, yinjiye muri nucleus y'urubyiruko rwi kipe ya kabiri ya AGOVV Apeldoorn. Ku ya 10 Kanama 2007, yakinnye umukino we wambere kumugaragaro na FC Den Bosch. Ufite ibihe bitatu, yahisemo kugerageza amahirwe ye mu mahanga mu mwaka wo muri 2010 asinyana na SV Zulte Waregem, mu bubiligi.
Mu ikipe ye nshya, Jérémy Bokila akunze kuba umusimbura. Nyuma y'umwaka, yemeye gutizwa muri Sparta Rotterdam, aho yatsinze ibitego byinshi. Agaruka i Waregem muri Kamena 2012, yongeye gutizwa, kuri iyi nshuro muri FC Petrolul Ploiești, muri Rumaniya. Imyitwarire ye myiza imwemerera gushyirwa mu ikipe y'igihugu ku mukino wa gicuti na Burkina Faso. Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 2012.

N'Dingi Bokila Mandjombolo ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zaire (muri iki gihe DR Congo), wavukiye Ku ya 27 Ugushyingo 1954.
Mu bindi bintu, yatsinze ibitego bitatu mu cyiciro cya 2 mu Bubiligi, munsi yi jacketi yra K. RC Harelbeke, wamuhesheje izina rya "Isaro rya Harelbeke".
Benshi mu bana be nabo babaye abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru. Uzwi cyane ni Jérémy nawe wabaye umukinnyi ukina mumahanga ukomoka muri congo.

Yannick Bolasie, (wavutse Ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1989 i Lyon mu Bufaransa) ni umukinnyi w' umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya,ukina ku rwego mpuzamahanga.Akina nka rutahizamu.
Bolasie yatangiye umwuga we muri Rushden na Diamonds afite imyaka 16. Yamaranye amezi ane niyi kipe mbere yo kwerekeza muri ikipe ya Maltese Floriana FC.
Yagarutse mu Bwongereza muri 2008 nyuma y’icyifuzo cyatanzwe na Plymouth Argyle, ahakura amasezerano y'imyaka 2. Yinjiye muri Dagenham na Redbridge mu rubanza ariko asubira i Plymouth nyuma y’urubanza rutarangiye. Muri Ugushyingo 2008, yagurishijwe muri Rushden na Diamonds maze atangira gukinira Eastbourne Borough kuri 29 ugushyingo kandi yagaragaye inshuro zirindwi muri Conference National mbere yo gusubira i Plymouth muri Mutarama 2009. Bolasie ari ku ntizanyo ebyiri zikurikiranye kuri Barnet FC.
Yannick Bolasie yinjiye mu mujyi wa Bristol mu mpeshyi ya 2011. Yakinnye imikino makumyabiri n'itanu mu marushanwa yose mu gihe cye cyonyine muri ikipe D 2 yo mubwongereza.
Muri Kanama 2012, yemeye gusinya imyaka itatu hamwe na Crystal Palace.
Mu gihembwe cya 2014-2015, mu Ugushyingo 2014, yihesheje izina yitwara neza mu mukino wahuje Liverpool warangiye ari 3-1 ashyigikira Crystal Palace. Bolasie yakuyeho Dejan Lovren akoresheje urutonde rwa tekinike kandi aha izamu igihe kitoroshye mu mukino wose. Mu kwezi k'Ukuboza, umukinnyi wa Kongo yageze ku bikorwa bikomeye na Tottenham (intsinzi 2-1). Mugihe asa nkaho ameze nabi hafi yinguni, arahindukira atunguranye, azamura umupira ahita asiga Christian Eriksen na Roberto Soldado kumwanya mbere yo kwambuka. Ku ya 4 Werurwe 2015, yatanze infashanyo ebyiri zagize uruhare mu gutsinda 3-1 na Queens Park Rangers. Muri Mata, yatsinze ibitego bitatu mu minota 11 yakinnye na Sunderland yahaye intsinzi ikipe ye.
Ku ya 15 Kanama 2016, Yannick Bolasie yinjiye mu ikipe ya Everton mu bihe bitanu. Yatangiye gukinira ubwo yinjiraga ku isaha mu mukino ubara umunsi wa kabiri wa Premier League na West Bromwich Albion (intsinzi 1-2). 22 Ukwakira ubukurikiyeho, yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere hamwe na Everton na Burnley (gutsindwa 2-1). Ku ya 4 Ukuboza 2016, umukinnyi wo hagati wa congo yirukanwe kubera imvune yakinnye na Manchester United (1-1). Imitsi yo mu ivi yagize ingaruka kandi Bolasie yagombaga kubagwa. Mutarama 4 Ubukurikira, umutoza wa Everton, Ronald Koeman, yatangaje ko bizatwara hagati y'amezi cumi n'umwe na cumi n'abiri mbere yuko Yannick Bolasie agaruka.
Ku ya 26 Ukuboza 2017, umukinnyi wo hagati wa congo yagarutse mu kibuga cya Premier League nyuma y'umwaka urenga imvune yo mu ivi ubwo yatangiraga na West Bromwich Albion. Yatsinze igitego kimwe mu mikino cumi n'irindwi mu gice cya kabiri cya shampiyona cyo muri 2017-2018.
Inguzanyo kuri Aston Villa.
Ku ya 25 Kanama 2018, Bolasie yatijwe igihembwe muri Aston Villa. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu mikino makumyabiri nimwe ya shampiyona mbere yo gusubira mu ikipe ya Everton hakiri kare nkuko byari byitezwe Mutarama 2019.
Inguzanyo kuri Anderlecht.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2019, Bolasie yatijwe muri RSC Anderlecht kugeza shampiyona irangiye. Yatsinze ibitego bitandatu mu mikino cumi n'irindwi ya shampiyona yakiniye ikipe y'Ububiligi.
Intizanyo kuri Sport CP.
Ku ya 2 Nzeri 2019, Bolasie yongeye gutizwa, iki gihe cy'igihe muri Sporting CP.

Jonathan Bolingi Mpangi Merikani, (yavutse Ku ya 30 Kamena 1994) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Repuburika Iharanaira Demokarasi ya congo (DRC). Akina nka rutahizamu muri Buriram United. Ni umuhungu wa Mpangi Merikani, wahoze ari umunyezamu wa DCMP.
Jonathan Bolingi yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona cy’umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika muri 2016 hamwe n’igihugu cye ndetse na CAF Champions League muri 2015 hamwe n’ikipe ya Tout Puissant Mazembe yo muri Kongo.
Ageze i Lubumbashi mu mwaka wo muri 2010 nyuma y’igihe gito yamaze muri Kimbangu Sport, yatijwe mu ikipe ya Don Bosco aho yatwaye igikombe cya Congo kandi agaragaza ko ari umuntu watanze rutahizamu w’umucuruzi Chico Ushindi. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu cyiciro kibanza cy'igikombe cya Congo na Tshipepele mu mukino wo kugaruka afite intsinzi nini (7-0), nyuma atsinda igitego muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza na AS Dauphins Noirs de Goma kugira ngo atsinde (4- 1). Yatsinze kabiri, Ku ya 30 Werurwe 2013 kurwanya Amerika Tshinkunku m'ugihe cya 3rd Umunsi wa "Linafoot", kubwi ntsinzi ya Don Bosco (3-0).
Muri mwambaro ya Jomo Cosmos (yo muri Afurika y'Epfo), mu mikino icyenda ya mbere ya shampiyona, yahiye ubwoba kuri konti, yandikisha ibitego 23 byose cyangwa bisi zose hamwe 2.5 kuri buri mukino. Ikipe yo muri Afurika yepfo, yakoresheje se Mpangi Merikani w'imyaka 25, yifuza kubona serivisi zayo, ariko ntabashe kubona amasezerano ya Don Bosco. Kugaruka kwe i Lubumbashi byanze bikunze, nubwo uru ruzinduko rudasanzwe muri Afrika yepfo, kuko uyu mukinnyi rwose yari uwa TP Mazembe.
Kuva hejuru ya metero 85, Jonathan Bolingi (ku bilo 74) arashobora gukina kumurongo wose w'ibitero. Umwirondoro we ushukisha vuba Patrice Carteron udatezuka kumwinjiza mubakozi be.
Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muri CAF Champions League Ku ya 9 Werurwe 2014 ahanganye na Astres FC ya Douala (Kameruni), agarutse nyuma yo kungukirwa n'ikosa ryakozwe n'umuzamu wa Kameruni. Yatsinze Supercup ya Congo na MK Etanchéité atsinda igitego cya kabiri kuri TP Mazembe ariko ikibabaje kuri we, yarakomeretse kandi byabaye ngombwa aha abandi. Yatsinze ibitego bi tatu na AS Bantou Ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2014, kumunsi 1 wa Linafoot, harimo ibitego bibiri by'umutwe, kugirango batsinde cyane (7-0). Ku ya 9 Ukuboza 2014, yatsinze igitego kimwe rukumbi cya Mazembe yatsinze AS Dauphins Noirs muri Goma ayoboye umupira wa Kabaso Chongo muri 93 iminota.
Yakurikiranwe n'amakipe menshi yo mu bubiligi, amaherezo yasinyiye Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2017 kuri Standard de Liège ku nguzanyo ihitamo kugura.
Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere hamwe na Standard de Liège yatsinze KV Kortrijk reuge agaruka gukina.
Yasinyanye by'imazeyo na Standard de Liège kuri1 Ku ya 18 Gicurasi 2017.

Theo Bongonda Mbul'Ofeko Batombo, bakunze kwita Theo Bongonda, (yavutse Ku ya 20 Ugushyingo 1995) i Charleroi mu Bubiligi, ni ukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Kuri ubu akinira Cádiz CF nk'umukinnyi w'ibumoso.

Marvel Bope Bokadi, (yavutse Ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1996) i Kinshasa, muri congo, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi ukina hagati cyangwa myugariro kuri Standard de Liège.
Hamwe n'ikipe TP Mazembe, yatsindiye igikombe cya Afurika Champions League muri 2015, yatsinze ikipe ya USM Algeria ku mukino wa nyuma. Uku kwimikwa kumwemerera kwitabira igikombe cyisi cya ma kipe muri 2015 cyateguwe mu Buyapani. Mu gihugu cye kavukire, ubuhanga bwe bwa tekinike bwamuhesheje izina rya Zidane.
7Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2017, yasinyiye kuri Standard de Liège ku ntizanyo ahitamo kugurwa. Merveille arimo gukina umukino we wa mbere wo gukina na Rouches na Union Saint-Gilloise (2-2). Ku ya 18 Gicurasi 2017, Standard yashyizeho uburyo bwo kwimura bwa nyuma Jonathan Bolingi, Christian Luyindama na Merveille Bope Bokadi, bose babanje kugurizwa na Ikipe ya Tout Puissant.
Ufite imikino umunani mu mikino icyenda ya mbere ya shampiyona yo muri 2017-2018, yagize ikibazo cyo gucika imbere mu rugendo yerekeza muri Anderlecht ku 1 Ukwakira. Abanyekongo ntibasubiye mu kibuga kugeza ku ya 3 Gashyantare 2019 igihe Anderlecht yamwakiriye, asimbuye mu izamu hagati mugenzi we Christian Luyindama wari wavuye i Galatasaray.
Ku ya 19 Nzeri, yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa Europa League na Vitória Guimarães (intsinzi 2-0), bituma ahuza hagati na Konstantinos Laifis. Muri 2019, yarekuwe azize imvune mu cyiciro cya mbere cya shampiyona y’Ububiligi yakinnye na Lommel ku ya 26 Nzeri. Yasuzumwe ikindi cyacitse cy'imbere y'imbere, iki gihe mu ivi ry'iburyo. Hatarashira imyaka ibiri, Merveille na we yararwaye imitsi ya Achilles yongeye kumukomeza kumara amezi menshi. Nubwo ibyo byose byahindutse, buri gihe abonye umwanya we muri Liège cumi n'umwe.
Hamwe no gutoranya Abanyekongo, yitabiriye irushanwa rya Toulon muri 2013 nyuma rishyirwaho bwa mbere kuri Stade des Martyrs na Angola kuri Ku ya 26 Werurwe 2016 (Gutsinda 2-1). Merveille yahise yitabira Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2016 yabereye mu Rwanda, atsinda igitego yatsinze Angola. DR Congo yatsinze irushanwa itsinze Mali kumukino wanyuma.

Jordan Botaka, (wavutse Ku ya 24 Kamena 1993) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo, ukina nk'umukinnyi ukinira iburyo i Hapoel Jerusalem, ku ntizanyo ya La Gantoise.
Botaka ukomoka mu gace ka Kinshasa k’ababyeyi b’Abanyekongo, yatangiye umwuga we mu Buholandi muri mwambaro ya RKVV Westlandia hanyuma kuva muri ADO La Haye, mbere yuko ababyeyi be bimukira muri Antwerp. Botaka yahise yinjira mu mashuri ya RSC Anderlecht, KSK Beveren hanyuma ajya KSC Lokeren.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Club Brugge.
Muri shampiyona 2 yakinnye muri ikipe ya ruguru ya Venise, ntiyakina umukino numwe.
Excelsior Rotterdam.
Nyuma y'ibihe bibiri muri iyi kipe adakinnye umukino numwe n'ikipe ya mbere, n'intizanyo yahawe CF Belenenses, yinjiye muri Excelsior Rotterdam aho yabonye aho atangirira. Hamwe niyi kipe, yabaye kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu gikombe cy’Ubuholandi muri 2015.
Muri 2016, yinjiye mu ikipe Leeds United ikina Shampiyona.
Umukino wa Charlton F.C..
Ku ya 11 Kanama 2016, yatijwe muri Charlton Athletic igihembwe kimwe.
Ku ya 26 Kamena 2017, Jordan Botaka yasinyanye amasezerano y'ibihemwe 3 muri K Saint-Trond VV.
Yahise yigaragaza nk'intangiriro idashidikanywaho ndetse aba kapiteni w'ikipe.
Ku ya 19 Gicurasi 2020, yiyemeje ibihembwe bine ashyigikira KAA La Gantoise, kurwanya amafaranga angana na 600.000 euro.
Kunanirwa kwishyira muri Ghent, Jordan Botaka yatijwe ku ya 23 Mutarama 2021 amezi 6 ahitamo kuguma muri Sporting de Charleroi.
Yageze mu cyiciro cya kabiri gishimishije hamwe na "Zebras" ariko ananirwa kumvisha ubuyobozi bw'ikipe gukoresha uburyo bwo kugura bukubiye mu ntizanyo.
Tugarutse i Ghent, Jordan Botaka ashyirwa muri B nucleus ku ya 22 Kamena 2021 n'umutoza Hein Vanhaezebrouck.
Umukinnyi arimo gushakisha byi mazeyo ikibazo gishya.
Ku ya 28 Mutarama 2022, Jordan Botaka yagurijwe kugeza shampiyona irangiye Fortuna Sittard, muri Eredivisie.
Hamwe n’Abaholandi batarengeje imyaka 19, yitabiriye amajonjora yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka 19.

Pierre Botayi Bomato (wavutse Ku ya 11 Werurwe 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa congo i Kinshasa muri congo. Akina nka rutahizamu kuri Panthère du Ndé.
Pierre Botayi yakira ibihe bibiri mu ikipe ya DR Congo. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu Ku ya 27 Kanama 2011, mu wagicuti na Angola (intsinzi 1-2). Akina umukino we wa kabiri Ku ya 23 Gashyantare 2012, mu mukino wa gicuti na Tanzaniya (0-0).
Muri ikipe, akinira Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Angola, na Kameruni.

André Watshini Bukia, mu magambo ahinnye André Bukia(yavutse3 marsKu ya 3 Werurwe 1995), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka i Kinshasa muriwa congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati utera muri Al-Batin FC.
André Bukia yavuye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo afite imyaka cumi n'icyenda yinjira muri FC Penafiel yo muri Porutugali.
Yahamagariwe bwa mbere mu gutoranya shampiyona irangiye yo muri 2015-2016, umukino wa gicuti na Romaniya. Yubaha guhitamo kwe kwambere Ku ya 25 Kamena 2016 bakina na Suwazilande, mu gikombe cya COSAFA muri 2016 (gutsindwa 1-0).

Tshimen Bwanga (wavutse Ku ya 5 Mutarama 1949) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zaire. Yakinnye mu buzima bwe bwose muri Tout Puissant Mazembe, aho yitabiriye imikino irenga 300 n'ikipe ye.
Yatangiye icyiciro cye muri shampiyona yo muri1963-1964 nkumuto wa Tout Puissant Englebert, mbere yuko yinjira mu ikipe yabigenewe y'ikipe ye yi myitozo igihembwe yakurikiyeho, nyuma yinjira mu matsinda ya bigize umwuga mu gihe cya 1965-1966 aho yatsindiye gukurikira icyiciro cya mbere, hamwe n'abatsinze inshuro eshanu muri Afurika Champions League.
Azamenya guhitamo kwe bwa mbere hamwe n'ingwe ya Zayire muri 1968 abitegetswe na André Mori, mbere yuko Blagoja Vidinić atangira kuyobora iryo hitamo muri 1970. Vidinić yashyizeho visi-kapiteni Tshimen Bwanga akihagera. Yaje kuba kapiteni muri 1972.
Kugeza ubu atuye mu Bufaransa, muri Les Ulis muri Essonne, umujyi utari muto cyane mu buryo bwa siporo, aho abantu bamwe na bamwe nka Thierry Henry, Patrice Évra, cyangwa Anthony Martial bakuriye.

Francis Chansa (wavutse10 septembreKu ya 10 Nzeri 1974) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) i Lubumbashi.
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika mu 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Yves Diba Ilunga (yavutse Ku ya 12 Kanama 1987) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga no muri congo i Lubumbashi. Akina nka rutahizamu w'ikipe yo muri Qatari ya Al Kharitiyath n'ikipe y'igihugu ya congo.
Yatoranijwe bwa mbere Ku ya 11 Kanama 2010 hamwe n'ikipe ya A ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mukino wa gicuti na Misiri aho yanatsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu ya A. Mbere, yari yarahamagawe mu ikipe ya A mu mukino wo kwishyura ndetse no mu cyiciro cya nyuma cya CHAN muri 2009 (Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika). Umukino we wa mbere na A 'yakiniwe i Lubumbashi na Repubulika ya Kongo mu cyiciro cyo gukuraho. Kuriyi nshuro, azafungura amazamu yu mukino uzarangira itsinze 3-0.

Guelor Dibulana, (yavutse Ku ya 13 Gicurasi 1989 apfa Ku ya 28 Werurwe 2013) yavukiye i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina mu izamu.
Yatangiye umwuga we wumwuga afite imyaka 22 hamwe na FC Nzakimuena muri (2011-2012), nyuma akina shampiyona hamwe na FC Les Stars muri (2012-2013).
Nyuma yaje gusinyana na DC Motema Pembe, ikipe yakinnye kugeza apfuye Werurwe 2013, byabaye mu gihe cy'impanuka yo mu muhanda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yatoranijwe mu ikipe y'igihugu mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2014, ariko ntabwo yaje gukina.
Kugaragara kwe gusa muri mwambaro w'igihugu bibaho Ku ya 15 Mutarama 2012, mu gice cya kabiri cyu mukino wa gicuti na Oman (2-2).

Rodrigue Dikaba (Yavutse ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1985) Ni umukinnyi nku mufaransa, ukomoka muri Congo, Umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka i congo wavukiye Toulouse.
Umwanya akunda ni kuruhande. Ni umunyamahanga wa congo.
Yatojwe muri Arras Football, yabonywe na AS Beauvais, umuturage w'igihugu, wa muzanye muri 2006. Hamwe na ASBO, yatsinze vuba ananirwa gutsinda mu kuzamuka muri Ligue ya 2, yahembwe mu ikipe y'igihugu.
Muri Mutarama 2008, guhitamo Congo igahamagarira serivisi za gukina umukino n'ikipe y' Ubufaransa ya A.
AS Beauvais Oise ikora nk'isoko: abaye intandaro yo kwirwanaho kwa Beauvais, abikesha gukomera kwe no gucuranga. Mu riryo muri 2009, yahisemo kutaguma muri Picardy ariko ntiyabona ikipe. Amaherezo, yageze mu itumba ryo muri 2009, mu ikipe ya FC Ceahlăul Piatra Neamţ, icyo gihe yari itara ritukura rya Rumaniya muri D1.
Yinjiye Nyakanga 2010 mu ikipe ya Oldham Athletic ariko nyuma yo kugaragara inshuro 2 n’imvune mu ikipe y' igihugu, yarekuwe niyi kipe Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2010. Muri Mutarama 2011 yongeye kwinjira muri Beauvais.

Patrick Dimbala Mawongo (yavutse Ku ya 20 Nzeri 1982 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba umubiligi ukomoka muri congo usanzwe ari umutoza wungirije muri ROCC (Royal Olympic Club ya Charleroi yashinzwe mu 1912) mu bubiligi mu gice cya 2 cy'abatabigize umwuga.
Dimbala yahuguye muri SV Asse kuva 1991 kugeza 1996, hanyuma no muri Eendracht Aalst kuva 1996 kugeza 1999.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Muri Ukuboza 1999, imyitozo ye, Eendracht Aalst yamuhaye amahirwe mu makipe yambere. Azakinira harimo igitunguru mu ikino 37, ku bitego 7 yatsinze. Imyitwarire ye ireba ikipe ya Jupiler League: KAA La Gantoise yinjiye mu gihe cyi imbeho muri 2001-2002.
Kuri Gent, yakinnye imikino 38 ku bitego 5 yatsinze mbere yo kwimurirwa muri KV Kortrijk, yongera mu cyiciro cya kabiri, aho yagumye amezi 6 gusa.
Na none, ni igice cya 1 umuturage wamuhamagariye: umuturanyi, Royal Excelsior Mouscron. Mubindi bihe bibiri, Dimbala yambaraga umwenda wa Hurlus inshuro 57, atsinda ibitego 7. Impinga yiki gihe ikomeje umukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cyababiligi yatsinzwe Gicurasi 2006 kurwanya muri SV Zulte Waregem.
Ariko ikipe y'umupaka ihura n ibibazo by'amafaranga Dimbala yimukira mu bugereki. Ubwa mbere muri APO Levadiakos kuva 2007 kugeza 2009, no kuva 2009 muri PAS Giannina.
Agarutse muri Nzeri 2014 mu Bubiligi anasinyana amasezerano y'igihembwe muri Royal Football Club Tournai.

Ava Dongo Luete (wavutse Ku ya 27 Mutarama 1996) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru uvuka congo i Kinshasa ukina nka myugariro wo hagati muri Royal Antwerp FC yo mu Bubiligi.
Ku ya 18 Nzeri 2019, yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, mu mukino wa gicuti yakinnye n'u Rwanda. Yahise agaragara atsinda igitego. Ariko, DRC yatsinzwe 2-3.

Elos Elonga-Ekakia (yavutse Ku ya 2 Gicurasi 1974) ni umukinnyi ukinaumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, ubu yahinduwe umutoza w'urubyiruko. Amaze umwuga we wose mu mwuga mu Bubiligi, akina mu ma kipe abiri akomeye yo muri iki gihugu, FC Bruges na Anderlecht, kandi yambaraga umwenda w’ikipe y’igihugu cya Kongo inshuro mirongo itatu.
Nyuma yo gutwara igikombe cyo w’Ububiligi hamwe na Anderlecht muri 2000, yaguye mu mpanuka ikomeye yo mu muhanda ituma ataba mu murima imyaka hafi 3. Ekakia yahise akina ibihe bitarenze bibiri bya Francs Borains, ariko ingaruka zimpanuka zagaragaye mu mukino we. Urubyiruko rw'ikipe rwa bigaragaje, Lokeren.
Elonga-Ekakia yatangiye gukinira ikipe ya AS Vita Club, imwe mu makipe akomeye i Kinshasa, umurwa mukuru wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 1993. Byihuse cyane, yabonywe na bashakishwa abakinnyi muri Beveren, ikipe yo m'ububiligi, ariko ntabwo yigeze abona amahirwe ahari. Nyuma yu mwaka ku ntebe, yimukiye i Lokeren, waje gukina mu cyiciro cya 2. Yatsindiye igikombe muri 1995-1996, hamwe n'ibitego 14, yagize uruhare runini mu kuzamuka kw'iyi kipe muri D1. Igihe abantu bashya bateraga i Lokeren muri 1998, Jan Koller na Jean-Paul Boeka-Lisasi, Ekakia yabonye igihe cye cyo gukina kigabanuka, kandi ageze mu kibuga wasangaga akenshi bifata uruhande. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, yerekeje muri FC Brugge, shampiyo urinda izamu, hamwe na mugenzi we Koen Schockaert.
Ekakia amara igihe muri Bruges, abujijwe na bakinnyi nka Gert Verheyen cyangwa Edgaras Jankauskas. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri gusa, maze ava muri iyo kipe yerekeza kuri Anderlecht bahanganye, aho yasanze Jan Koller. Muri icyo gihembwe, mauve yiganjemo shampiyona, kandi Ekakia ya gombaga guhangana n’amarushanwa akomeye cyane na Koller, ariko na Tomasz Radzinski, Oleg Iachtchouk, Edrissa Sonko cyangwa Yánnis Anastasíou. Nyamara yakinnye imikino igera kuri mirongo itatu, kandi afite ibitego icumi, yagize uruhare mu gutwara igikombe cya shampiyona w’Ububiligi ndetse n’igikombe cya Pro League muri 2000.
Kubwamahirwe, nyuma gato yo gutsindira igihugu, Ekakia yaguye mu mpanuka ikomeye yo mu muhanda. Yatanyaguje imitsi ye ikomeye, maze ihungabana ritera kuva amaraso mu bwonko. Ufatwa nk'uwatsinzwe mu mupira w'amaguru, bimutwara hafi imyaka itatu kugirango agaruke mu kibuga. Yagarutse mu cyiciro cya 3, ahitwa Francs Borains, aho yakinnye kugeza muri 2004 mbere yo kumanika burundu.
Muri Kanama 2010, yagizwe umutoza wihariye w'amakipe y'urubyiruko ya Lokeren

Meschack Elia, (yavutse Ku ya 6 Kanama 1992) i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru muri Kongo (DRC). Akina nka rutahizamu w'ikipe yo mu Busuwisi ya BSC Young Boys.
Meschack Elia akomoka muri komini ya N'Sele i Kinshasa. Yatangiye gukina umupira hakiri kare, nka benshi mu rubyiruko rwo mu gace atuyemo mbere yo kuvumburwa na Alain le Jeune, perezida w'ikigo cyo gutangiza abana b'Abanyekongo mu mupira w'amaguru.CIECF".
Muri 2012, yitabiriye irushanwa rya Airtel Young Talent Tournament aho ikipe ye yitabiriye icyiciro cya nyuma muri Kenya. Akina akurikirana hamwe na Green Angels na Jogarry.
Muri Nzeri 2014, yinjiye muri CS Don Bosco kandi yiboneye iterambere ritangaje.
Meschack Elia ntaramenyekana muri rusange, muri CHAN yo Rwanda muri 2016, aho yabaye ikintu gikomeye cyo gutoranya kandi agaragaza impano ye yose.
Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2022, yongereye amasezerano muri BSC Young Boys, kugeza muri 2024.
Ku mukino wa nyuma w'irushanwa rya Mali, yafunguye amazamu ku gutandukana n'umutwe wa Jonathan Bolingi. Yatsinze igitego cya kabiri ku mupira wa Yannick Bangala: yataye umunyezamu wo muri Mali Dyigui Diarra mbere yo gutsinda igitego cyubusa. Umukino urangira intsinzi isobanutse (3-0) ishyigikira abakinnyi ba congo. Yongeye gutorwa umuntu wumukino. Kim's Mavuangu
Yarangije nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri aya marushanwa n'ibitego bine ndetse anatorwa nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri iri rushanwa.

Doris Fuakumputu (wavutse Ku ya 18 Mata 1984) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomomka muri congo i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Uyu ni rutahizamu akaba ari mpuzamahanga wa congo, akaba yarakinnye umukino muri ekipe y'igihugu bw'ambere muri 2008).

Roger Hitoto, (Yavutse Ku ya 24 Gashyantare 1969) i Mbandaka (muri Zayire, ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo), ni umukinnyi ukina arimpuzamahanga mu umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Umukinnyi hagati mu kibuga hamwe n'uwatwitse, Hitoto yamaze igihe kinini cyu mwuga we mubufaransa.
Yatojwe ari muri FC Melun, Hitoto yahiswemo afite imyaka 15 na FC Rouen. Ku myaka 19, muri 1988, yatangiye bwa mbere mu cyiciro cya 2. Muri shampiyona esheshatu yakinnye imikino 147 muri D2 (igitego 1) na 10 muri gikombe cya bafaransa. Nyuma yaje kwinjizwa muri Lille OSC, ikipe ikomeye. Buhoro yigaragaza nk'intangiriro, akurikira Jakob Friis-Hansen. Yakinnye shampiyona bitatu muri D1 (imikino 66 n'ibitego 3) hanyuma bibiri muri D2 (imikino 43).
Yatoranijwe mu ikipe ya Zaire (yiswe iya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 1997), yitabira igikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 1996 (yakinnye imikino 2) hamwe na 1998 (imikino 3). Yakinnye kandi imikino itatu yujuje ibisabwa mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1998.
Yakomeretse cyane muri 1998, Hitoto yavuye i Lille muri 1999 yerekeza mu Bushinwa hanyuma muri katari. Mu 2001, yagarutse muri shampiyona muri FC Rouen, asubira muri katari, nyuma arangiza umwuga we mu ma kipe yakiniraga harimo FC Mantes, CMS Oissel, ni zindi.
Nyuma yuko atangiye izabukuru muri siporo, Hitoto yongeye kuba umujyanama ku isi mu umupira w'amaguru maze afata inshingano muri federasiyo y'umupira w'amaguru ya Kongo, nk'umuyobozi ureberera mu Burayi.

Jean-Florent Ikwange Ibenge (yavutse Ku ya 4 Ukuboza 1961) yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, wahindutse umutoza, yavukiye i Mbandaka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
izina ba muhimba ni Coach Endroit, uzwi ku izina rya Florent Ibenge, amazina ye nyakuri ni Jean Florent Ibenge Ikwange, ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo, wavukiye i Mbandaka mu cyahoze ari intara ya Ekateri yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ku ya 4 Ukuboza 1961, afite abavandimwe na bashiki bacu. akaba Umukunzi umupira w'amaguru kuva akiri muto, yikubita ku rutugu hamwe n'umupira w'amaguru wahoze muri Zairian (ingwe ya Zaire) maze ava muri Zaire yerekeza i Burayi mu myaka 12 kubera impamvu zo kwiga, mu gihe yakinaga umupira. muri 2004, yatoje nk'umutoza, muri 2008 aba umutoza wungirije mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Kongo, nyuma gato yo kwitwara neza ku mugabane wa Aziya, muri 2012 asinyana amasezerano na AS Vita Club maze yibutswa nk'umutoza w'igihugu muri 2015 muri CAN gukinisha kuva aho yakinnye uruhare rwabatoza kabiri.
ni muri 2020 nibwo umutoza Ibenge yavuye muri AS Vita Club kubera ibikorwa yaramaze kugeraho byo muri Afurika.
Ibengé yavuye muri AS Vita Club.
Umutoza wa AS V. Club, Jean Florent Ibenge, ubwo yatandukanaga n'ikipe ya Kinshasa, amaze imyaka myinshi atoza. Ibi byatangajwe ku wa gatatu tariki ya 30 Kamena 2021 ku mbuga na Perezida wa AS Vita Club, Bestine Kazadi.
Ati: “Nshuti nshyigikiye, ndatangaza kugenda ku mutoza wacu Jean-Florent Ibenge. Mu izina rya AS V. Club, turamushimira serivisi yatanzwe kandi tumwifurije gutsinda” ibi bikaba byavuzwe na Madamu Kazadi, nta yandi makuru arambuye.
Jean Florent Ibenge yabanye na AS Vita Club kuva muri 2013
Mu gihe cya Ibenge, Les léopards ya DRC yashoboye kwinjira mu myaka itatu kuva muri 2016 kugeza 2018 muri 50 ba mbere ku isi ku rutonde rwa FIFA.
Ariko, iyi kipe yabuze igikombe cyisi cya 2018 ihuza 2-2 na Tuniziya iwayo mugihe amanota yari 2-0 hasigaye iminota 15. Nubwo intsinzi yatsinze Libiya na Gineya muminsi yanyuma, Ingwe izabura isi. Ibenge asa nkaho yatakaje flair.
Itandukaniro ryumuntu.
Urubuga rwihariye Four FourTwo ruhuza Florent Ibenge 50 umutoza ku isi muri 2015.

Jordan Ikoko, (yavutse Ku ya 3 Gashyantare 1994) yari muri Montereau-Fault-Yonne, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC) ukina nka myugariro muri Paphos FC.
Paris Saint Germain.
Jordan Ikoko yavukiye i Montereau muri 1994 afite ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo. Yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru muri 2002 muri Mitry Mory Football, umujyi yakuriyemo mbere yo kwinjira muri Villeparisis US Municipale nyuma yimyaka ibiri. Mu 2007, yinjiye mu kigo cy’amahugurwa cya Paris Saint-Germain. Muri Kamena 2009, yabaye uwa rangije mu gikombe cy’igihugu ku bana bafite imyaka 14 ahitamo Paris-Île-de-France League. Mu ikipe ya Paris, yakinnye imikino itanu ya CFA mu ikipe ya B muri shampiyona yo muri 2010-2011 hanyuma yigaragaza nk'intangiriro mu ikipe yabigenewe mu bihe bya kurikiyeho, akina imikino 20 muri 2011-2012 hanyuma 18 muri 2012 -2013.
Urukurikirane rw'inguzanyo.
Ku ya 7 Kanama 2013, Jordan Ikoko yasinyanye amasezerano yu mwuga n’ikipe ya Paris mu gihe cyi myaka itatu ahita agurizwa muri Amerika Créteil-Lusitanos. Yakinnye umukino wa mbere wa bigize umwuga kuri Ku ya 16 Kanama 2013, kumunsi wa gatatu wa Ligue 2, na SM Caen wa simbuye Augusto Pereira Loureiro kumwanya wa 63 umunota w'umukino (gutsindwa 3-0). Icyumweru cyakurikiyeho, yashinzwe bwa mbere ahanganye na FC Istres (kunganya 2-2).
Muri shampiyona 2014-2015, PSG ya mugurije ubugira kabiri, kuriyi nshuro Le Havre, ikipe ya Ligue 2 aho yakinnye imikino igera kuri 20 ya shampiyona.
Umwaka umwe, Ku ya 24 Nyakanga 2015, yongeye gutizwa maze atwara RC Lens.
Ku ya 23 Kamena 2016, yinjiye muri En avant Guingamp ku masezerano yi myaka itatu kugirango asubize Lars Jacobsen. Byu mwihariko yatsinze igitego we nyine, ku ya 13 Kanama 2017 ubwo yakiniraga Paris Saint-Germain Football Club, ikipe ye yitoreza, kumunsi wa kabiri wa Ligue ya 1 muri 2017-2018.
Muri Kamena 2019, yasinye amasezerano na Ludogorets Razgrad muri Bulugariya.
Jordan Ikoko yatoranijwe bwa mbere hamwe nu bufaransa batarengeje imyaka igera 16 Ku ya 29 Nzeri 2009, mugushirwaho na Wales mu mikino ya gicuti (intsinzi 6-0). Yatsinze igitego cya mbere hamwe n'iri hitamo Ku ya 1 Ukuboza 2009 mu mukino wa gicuti n'Ububiligi (intsinzi 4-1).
Ku ya 3 Nyakanga 2013, yatoranijwe na Francis Smerecki kwitabira muri Euro yo 2013 bari munsi yimyaka 19. Nyuma yo gutangira amarushanwa bitoroshye, yakuye Espayne muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza maze yinjira mu mukino wa nyuma yakinnye na Seribiya bitewe n'ibitego bya Yassine Benzia na Antoine Conte. Les Bleuets yatsinzwe igitego 1-0 kumukino wanyuma. Yegereye iri rushanwa nka bafite kandi yitabira imikino yose yi kipe yu bufaransa.
Hamwe no guhitamo DRC.
Ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2016, yatoranijwe rero n'umutoza w'ikipe umupira w'amaguru ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo amezi make mbere yuko CAN muri 2017 yujuje ibyangombwa byo gutoranya Abanyekongo.
Yatoranijwe muri CAN muri 2017, yakinnye umukino wa mbere na Kote Divuwari (2-2).
Hamwe n’Ubufaransa bwabatarengeje imyaka 19, yabaye uwanyuma wa Euro muri 2013.

Herita N'Kongolo Ilunga, (yavutse Ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1982) i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nka myugariro.
Ilunga yavuye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo akiri muto cyane, yaje mu Bufaransa atangira umupira w'amaguru muri Sarceles.
Mu 1995, yinjiye mu kigo cya mahugurwa cya Amiens SC. Nyuma yi mikino myiza n'urubyiruko rwa Amiens, yavuye kuri Stade Rennes nyuma yi myaka ine. Nubwo bikiri ibyiringiro nki bisanzwe, ibibazo ntabwo bihinduka kumushyigikira kandi amahirwe yogukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga asa nkaho agabanuka.
Muri Kamena 2002, iki gihe mu mahanga na Barcelona, mu byukuri aho asinyira Espanyole.
Frédéric Antonetti, icyo gihe yari umutoza wa ASSE, ashaka igisubizo ku ruhande rw'ibumoso. Afite amafaranga make kandi ubushakashatsi bwi mbitse (yavumbuye Michael Essien byu mwihariko) bi zamutera kubona intizanyo ahitamo kugura umusore wi myaka 21. Ako kanya, yishyizemo nta mpungenge kuko uruhande rwi bumoso rwitiriwe maze Greens isubira muri Ligue 1 mu mpera ziki gihembwe cyo muri 2003-2004. Antonetti, utaremezwa mu nshingano ze, Elie Baup asimbuye. Ikipe ikoresha uburyo bwo kugura.

Giannelli Imbula Wanga, (yavutse Ku ya 12 Nzeri 1992) i Vilvoorde mu Bubiligi, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga wumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati muri Tuzlaspor.
Yanyuze mu rubyiruko rwo muri Amerika Argentineuil na Racing Club de France, yageze muri 2004, mu kigo cy’imyitozo cya Paris Saint-Germain mbere yi gihembwe mbere yo gusubira mu Isiganwa. Muri 2007, yinjiye mu kigo cyigisha En avant Guingamp.
Ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2009, yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa bigize umwuga yakinnye niyi kipe Dijon FCO icyarimwe abaye umukinnyi muto wa bayeho muri Ligue 2, afite imyaka 17, ukwezi kumwe n'iminsi 4. Yitabiriye umukino wa kabiri mbere yuko iyi kipe isubira mu cyiciro cya gatatu. Ariko iyi kipe ikomeza shampiyona imwe gusa kubururu, mu rwego mbere yo kuzamuka dukesha umwanya wa gatatu. Yahawe umupira mwiza cyane, yakiriwe neza nabatoza bahanganye, nka Philippe Hinschberger wa muhamagaye "umunyamahanga», cyangwa na Erick Mombaerts amubonamo«umukinnyi w'indashyikirwa». Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri Ligue 2, Ku ya 11 Mutarama 2013, kuri Stade Océane, mu gutsinda kuri Le Havre igitego. Gukurikira avant Guingamp kuzamuka muri Ligue 1 muri Gicurasi 2013, ni cyera ”Umukinnyi mwiza muri Ligue 2 na bagenzi be mu gihe cy'ibikombe bya UNFP.
Imikino ya Olempike.
Ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2013, yasinyanye amasezerano yi myaka 5 na Oleympike ya Marseille. Iherere kanyabubasha rigera kuri miliyoni 7.5 zama yero hiyongereyeho + miliyoni 2 za bonusi. Nyuma yo gutangira ibyiringiro na OM, mu mikino ye ya mbere muri L ya1 yakinnye n'ikipe yahoze yitwa EA Guingamp, Ku ya 11 Nzeri 2013 noneho umukino wa mbere wa Champions League wu mwuga we na Arsenal kuri Stade Vélodrome, Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2013, yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere hamwe na Phocaeans, Ku ya 24 Nzeri 2013 kurwanya AS Saint-Étienne mu gutsinda ibitego bibiri kuri OM. Muri iki gihembwe cya mbere kandi nubwo amarushanwa yari mu mwanya we, yakinnye buri gihe kandi yitabira imikino mirongo itatu ni rindwi mu marushanwa yose.
FC Porto noneho Stoke City.
Ku ya 31 Kanama 2017, yasinyiye igihembwe cy'intizanyo muri Toulouse FC nta mahitamo yo kugura muri Stoke City.

Arnold Isako, uzwi kandi ku izina rya Arnold Issoko, (yavutse Ku ya 6 Mata 1992), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri kongo. Akina iburyo hagana inyuma, ariko kandi nku mukinnyi w'iburyo.
Amaze gukora byinshi mu mwuga we muri Porutugali (amaze kugaragara inshuro zirenga 80 muri shampiyona ya Porutugali mu bihe bitatu yakinnye na Vitória Setúbal FC) hanyuma mu Buhinde na Mumbai City FC, yasinye muri 2019 na SM Caen, ikipe ya Ligue 2 yo mu Bufaransa.
Yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo mu mukino wa gicuti na Romaniya muri Gicurasi 2016.

Musasa Kabamba (yavutse ku ya 30 Gicurasi 1982) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri (DRC) i Kinshasa.
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Nicodème Kabamba Wa Kabengu, uzwi ku izina rya "Serpent de Rail" cyangwa "Umushakashatsi" (yavutse Ku ya 29 Nyakanga 1936), yahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) yahindutswe nyuma umutoza.
Kapiteni w'ikipe ya congo yatsindiye CAN muri 1968, Nicodème Kabamba yatsinze ibitego bibiri yatsinze Congo-Brazzaville. Yabaye mpuzamahanga kuva muri 1956 kugeza 1969 akinira Amerika Panda, DC Motema Pembe na Standard de Liège muri 1959 - 1963).
Yaje kuba umutoza hagati muri 1973 na 2003: ni umutoza wungirije w'ikipe y'igihugu muri CAN muri 1974, yatsinze irushanwa. Ayobora amakipe ya SCOM Mikishi, FC Saint Éloi Lupopo, DC Motema Pembe (kuva muri 2003) na TP Mazembe. Muri 2013, yahawe igikombe cyi cyubahiro cyo muri UFC.
Yapfuye ku ya 29 Gashyantare 2020 mu ivuriro ya Ngalima i Gombe maze, ahambwa ku ya 10 Gicurasi 2020 mu irimbi rya Necropolis.

Junior Kabananga (yavutse ku ya 4 Mata 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ukina nka rutahizamu.
Yiswe Uhoraho Ku ya 25 Nzeri 2014 na Florent Ibenge ku mukino ukomeye mu mikino ya CAN muri 2015 na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2014, yatsinze igitego muri Abidjan, igitego kiva mu kugenzura igituza mu mukino wa kabiri na Kote Divuwari.
Umunota wanyuma wumushyitsi wa CAN muri 2017 kubwinyungu za Hervé Kage, niwe ugaragaza ikipe mu gihe cya marushanwa. Mu byukuri, yatsinze ibitego cyihuse mu matsinda yakinnye na Maroke (1-0), na kote divuwari (2-2), ndetse no gutsinda Togo (3-1). Mu gihe ikipe ye yasezerewe muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza yakinnye na Gana (2-1), ibitego bitatu yabanje gutsinda bya muhaye umwanya wa mbere muri CAN, kurutonde rwabatsinze.

Kadima Kabangu, izina ryuzuye ni Dark Johns Kadima Kabangu, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nka rutahizamu.
Kabangu yakiniye ikipe ya Lupopo yo muri Kongo, mbere yo kwimukira muri 2016 yerekeza i Budapest Honvéd FC muri Hongiriya.
Hamwe na Budapest Honvéd, yakinnye imikino 12 mu cyiciro cya mbere, atsinda ibitego bibiri. Nubwo yakinnye bike, yatsindiye kuba shampiyona wa Hongiriya muri 2017. Uku kwimikwa kumwemerera gukina mu cyiciro kibanza cya Champions League mu mpeshyi yo muri 2017.
Nyuma yimukiye muri Arumeniya muri 2018.
Muri 2019, yasubiye mu rugo, asinya muri na DC Motema Pembe. Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yamenyekanye muri DR Congo abikesheje "inyundo yo mu mutwe" [].
Ku ya 21 Mutarama 2022, yageze muri Maroke kugira ngo asinyane amasezerano yi bihe bitatu n'igice na Raja Club Athletic.
Ku ya 22 Gashyantare, yatsinze igitego cya mbere hamwe na "Greens" mu mutwe wumunsi wa 18 wa shampionat na JS Soualem (intsinzi 0-1).
Ku ya 10 Nzeri 2014, Kadima Kabangu yakiriye umwe rukumbi mu ikipe ya Congo, na Siyera Lewone. DRC yatsinze 0-2 muriyi nama yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika muri 2015.

Mulota Patou Kabangu (yavutse Ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1985) ni umukinnyi ukina wumupira wamaguru ukomoka (DRC) i Kinshasa. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati cyangwa rutahizamu. Kuri ubu akinira ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Saint Eloi Lupopo i Lubumbashi.
Yaje kumenyekana cyane muri CAF Champions League muri 2010, yatsindiye n'ikipe ye, ndetse no mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya ikipe muri 2010, aho TP Mazembe yageze ku mukino wa nyuma na Inter Milan. Yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Bubiligi RSC Anderlecht ku ya 1 Mutarama 2012. Intizanyo ye ntiyongerewe asubira muri TP Mazembe muri Kamena 2012. Muri 2017 yinjiye muri Daring Club Motema Pembe. Muri 2021, asinyina na FC Saint Eloi Lupopo
Kabangu yavukiye i Kinshasa. Yatangiye bwa mbere muri club yaho, umujyi wa Kin. Muri 2009, yinjiye muri TP Mazembe. Uyu mwaka, yatsindiye igikombe cya shampiyona ya Congo. Mu mwaka wa 2010, TP Mazembe yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona, yujuje ibisabwa mu gikombe cy'isi cya ikipe.
Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 2010, yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza mu gikombe cyisi cya ikipe. Ikipe ya mutoje, TP Mazembe, yatsinze 2–0 na SC Internacional yo muri Burezile. TP Mazembe niyo kipe yambere yaba Abanyaburayi cyangwa Abanyamerika yepfo bakinnye umukino wanyuma w'igikombe cyisi cya FIFA.
Muri Mutarama 2012, yasinyiye ikipe y'Ububiligi RSC Anderlecht. Arakina bike. Akenshi ku ntebe, ahitamo kuva mu ikipe y'Ububiligi.
Ku ya 30 Kamena 2013, Kabangu yinjiye muri Qatar Stars League, muri ikipe ya Al Ahli SC.
Muri 2017, yinjiye muri Tout Puissant Mazembe, ikipe ye yitoreza.

Dominique Babo Kabasu (yavutse Ku ya 4 Werurwe 1950) noneho muri Kongo Mbiligi ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi wari mpuzamahanga wumupira wamaguru wa congo (DRC), wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire, yakinnye imikino 3, ku gitego kimwe yatsinze, hagati yo muri 1974 na 1976.
Yatsindiye Igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1974 hanyuma atoranywa muri, uwo mwaka kugira ngo yitabire Igikombe cy'isi mu Budage.

Eugène Kabongo Ngoy (yavutse Ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 1960) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC), i Léopoldville muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yakinaga nka rutahizamu.
Akinira ikipe ya RFC Seraing, RC Paris, RSC Anderlecht, Olympique Lyonnais na SC Bastia.
Yatsinze ibitego 29 mu cyiciro cya 2 muri shampiyona yo muri 1985–86 hanyuma atsinda ibitego 22 muri shampiyona yo muri 1988–89.
Yitabiriye igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1988 hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire ubu ni congo.
Umwuga we warangiye ubwo Shampiyona yi gihugu yatangazaga ko adakwiriye ku mubiri Ku ya 1 Werurwe 1992.

Mutamba Kabongo (yavutse Ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1970) noneho ubu ni muri Zaire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muriwa congo (DRC), wakinnye nka myugariro.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zaire hanyuma yitwa DRC, yakinnye imikino 7 (nta gitego yatsinze) hagati yo muri 1996 na 2001.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika cyo muri1996 na 1998. Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa yo muri 1998.
Yakinnye kandi imikino itatu ibara imikino ibanza y'Igikombe cy'isi, muri 1998 na 2002

Mu Rwanda muri rusange hari ubuvumo burenga 50, i Musanze honyine hari 12 bufitanye isano n’uruhererekane rw’ibisozi binini cyane byitwa Ibirunga. Aha hamaze kuba agace k’ubukerarugendo bunogeye ijisho ku banyamahanga ndetse n’abanyarwanda bagenda batahura ibyiza bitatse igihugu cyabo.
Ubu buvumo bufite uburebure hafi kilometero ebyiri,ubujyakuzimu bwa metero10 na 40, n’ubugari bwa metero 3 kugeza kuri metero 10.
Ubumenyi bw’isi ariko bugaragaza ko ubu buvumo bukomoka ku iruka ry’ibirunga biri hejuru yabwo ryabayeho mu myaka ibihumbi byinshi ishize, aho ibikoma (magma) biva mu birunga aribyo byagiye byuma bigasigaramo ibyanya munsi ari nabyo byavuyemo ubu buvumo.
Mu mateka ya vuba aha hantu habaye ubwihisho bw’abateraga u Rwanda bavuye muri Congo Kinshasa bita abacengezi, gusa intambara yo kubarwanya irangira bayitsinzwe ndetse benshi babugwamo.
Ubu buvumo buratangaje cyane kuko hari n’ibice byabwo bikomeza bikagera no muri Congo Kinshasa, igihande cy’i Musanze na Kinigi kiratunganyije cyane, harimo urumuri ruhagije n’umutekano usesuye, ni ahantu heza ho gusura kuri buri munyarwanda wifuza kubona ibyiza by’igihugu cye kuri kiriya giciro.

Ubuvumo bwa Samatare buherereye mu karere ka Rwamagana Umurenge wa Gahengeri, Akagari ka Kagezi, Ni ubuvumo burebure kuburyo n’ahabatuye batazi uko bureshya cyangea uko bwabayeho. Buri mu musozi w’amabuye menshi, buteye ubwoba n’amatsiko cyane.
Ubuvumo bwa Samatare ni ubuvumo nyabagendwa ku ntangiriro zabwo kugera kuri za metero nke ugenda, harimo ibyumba (inzira zibushamikiyeho) kandi ni ubuvumo benshi baza gusengeramo nubwo bitemewe kubera impamvu z’umutekano w’abajyamo.
Muri ubu buvumo harimo udupapuro twanditseho ibyifuzo abasengaga banditse batura Imana, abaza kuhasengera abenshi ni abaturuka kure baza bagafata amajoro atari make.
Iyo ubonye ubu buvumo usanga buteye amatsiko cyane ku buryo buramutse bukozweho ubushakashatsi bugatunganywa bukitabwaho bwahinduka ahantu nyaburanga hakurura amatsiko y’abantu ari nako hinjiza imari n’iterambere hafi yabwo.

Ubu buvumo bwa Nyankokoma bwitirirwa Ruganzu buri mu karere ka Gicumbi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru mu murenge wa Ruvune mu mudugudu wa Nyankokoma. Buri ku musozi muremure uhanamye, ahantu hateye ubwoba bukabije kuko uramutse uguye ibyawe byaba bisa nk'aho birangiye, kubona icyaguhagarika biragoye bitewe n'uburyo hacuramye.
Muri ubu buvumo harimo icyumba kinini cyane bita Kambere ahagana hejuru imbere hari uwundi mwenge urimo ikindi cyumba ho, bisa n’ibigoye kuhinjira kuko byagusaba kurira kandi kanyerera.
Munsi yawo, hari uwundi mwenge muto kwinjiramo bisaba gukambakamba. Iki cyumba bakita Kagondo. Hari umwijima uteye ubwoba ntushobora kubona ikintu na kimwe n’amaso utifashishije urumuri.
Ni icyumba ubona gisa n'aho ari kigari. Ku nkuta zo muri ubu buvumo hari aho ubona udupapuro twashyizwe hagati y’amabuye turimo ibyifuzo by'abagenda baza kuhasengera. Izi nkuta kandi ziranyerera, ziriho amazi ameze nk’amavuta.

Ubuvumo bwa Nyakavumu buherereye mu Mudugudu wa Kigarama, Akagari ka Bisesero, Umurenge wa Mubuga, Akarere ka Karongi, Intara y’Iburengerazuba.
Ubu buvumo bukekwa ko bwaguyemo abantu bagera kuri 200 bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994, buracyabitse imibiri y’aba bantu, nubwo bwose hakomeje igikorwa cyo kuyikuramo.
Ubuvumo bwa Nyakavumu ni burebure kandi bufite amakona imbere, bityo gutaburura imibiri ari igikorwa kigomba ubuhanga n’ubushobozi.

Hang Son Doong ni ubuvumo bw'amayobera buherereye muri pariki ya Phong Nha Ke, ku mupaka wa Vietnam na Laos. Nyuma y’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ihuriro ry’abashakashatsi ku by’ubuvumo b’Abongereza muri 2009-2010, Hang Son Doong yafunguwe nk’icyanya nyaburanga kuva muri 2013.
Ubu buvumo bufite metero zirenga 200 z’ubugari, metero 150 z’ubujyejuru na metero 6,500 z’uburebure; nubwo abashakashatsi bavuze ko mu gihe kingana n’umwaka bamaze muri ubwo buvumo batabashije kubuzenguruka bwose. Abashakashatsi bemeje ko ubuvumo bwa Hang Son Doong buruta ubwari buzwi ko ari bwo bunini bwa Deer buri muri
Malaysia bufite metero 90 z’ubugari, metero 100 z’ubujyejuru na kilometero 2 z’uburebure.
Ubu buvumo bumaze imyaka isaga miliyoni 5. Bitewe na calcium carbonate iba muri ubu buvumo hashobora kuboneka ibicu bitanga imvura ndetse ikaba ijya inahagwa, cyangwa se ikabura ubutaka bwaho bukuma. Muri 2013 ni bwo abakerarugendo ba mbere basuye ubu buvumo aho kuhasura byari ukwishyura $3000.

Hariho ubwoko bw’inyoni zimuka imigabane cyangwa se ahandi hantu ziba zisanzwe zituye kubera impamvu zitandukanye, mu ngendo zazo ariko zigenda zihagararara kugira ngo ziruhuke, nyamara inyoni zitwa bécasses (mu Gifaransa) cyangwa woodcock (mu Cyongereza) ziruka ahantu hangana kuriya nta kuruhuka ndetse zinagendera ku butumburuke buri hejuru cyane, ahantu hataba umuyaga.
Iyi nyoni ya woodcock ibasha kuguruka ahantu hareshya n’ibilometero ibihumbi 4 na metero 620 mu gihe kingana n’iminsi ibiri gusa, mu gihe zagurutse ahantu hareshya n’ibilometero 7153 mu minsi itatu n’igice.
Izi nyoni zitura muri Afurika y’Epfo mu gihe umugabane w’u Burayi uri mu bihe by’ubukonje, zikongera kwimuka zihagaruka mu gihe impeshyi igeze, zigatura mu Burayi bw’Uburasirazuba.

Inyoni yitwa Inganji ni imwe mu nyoni zikunzwe muri Pariki y’igihugu ya Nyungwe. Ubwoko bw’iyi nyoni bukunze kuba mu mashyamba y’inzitane akenshi usanga arimo aya kimeza yo muri Afurika yo hagati.
Iyi nyoni ikunze muri Pariki ya Nyungwe, ifite ijwi ryiza cyane usanga ba mukerarugendo bishimiye, kubera kuririmba neza bigasa n’amajwi meza ashimisha abayumva.
Si izi nyoni gusa usanga zikunzwe kuko bamwe usanga bakunda ubwoko bwazo, uko zisa, amajwi yazo azitandukanya aho zimwe ziririmba zisakuza, izindi zituje, izindi zikavuga nk’ingoma, imyirongi, bigaha Pariki ubwiza bw’amajwi agenda anyuranamo.

Ni kenshi abantu bagiye bagaragaza ko inyoni ya Autruche, kubera ubwenge buke ihisha umutwe mu mucanga igihe yihisha abantu cyangwa inyamaswa zishobora kuyisagarira.
ubushakashatsi buvuga ko Autruche ifite ubwenge buke kubera ko ifite ubwonko buto (bupima amagarama 26.3) ugereranyije n’ijisho ryayo kuko ryo rifite umurambararo wa sentimetero eshanu, aho ryenda kungana n’umupira wa Biallard.
Kuba iyi nyoni yihuta cyane iyo igendera ku maguru kurusha uko izindi nyamaswa zabikora. Umuvuduko wayo ushobora kugera kuri kilometero 64.3 ku isaha, nicyo abahanga mu by’inyamaswa bavuga ko idakoresha ubu buryo bwo gushyira umutwe mu mucanga yihisha kuko ifite ubushobozi bwo guhunga ndetse igasiga icyaba kiyisagariye.
Iyi nyoni kubera igihagararo cyayo gishobora kugera kuri metero ebyiri ndetse ikagira n’ibiro 150 biyiha umugeri uremereye ikoresha mu kwirinda, bityo ikaba idakeneye guhisha umutwe gusa.
Impamvu Autruche ikunze kugaragara yashyize umutwe mu mucanga, abahanga mu by’inyamaswa bavuga ko biterwa n’uko iyi nyoni iyo igeze cyo gutera amagi no kuyararira icukura umwobo ushobora kugera kuri santimetero 91 z’ubujyakuzimu kugira ngo iyarinde izindi nyamaswa zishobora kuyarya.
Ibi Autruche zikomeza kubikora kugeza igihe amagi yazo aturazwe, abahanga bakaba bavuga ko ari ho haturutse imyumvire y’uko mu buryo bwo kwihisha zishyira umutwe mu mucanga.
Mu rwego rwo kurinda aya magi, Autruche y’ingabo n’iy’ingore zisimburana mu kuyacunga rimwe na rimwe zikajya zinyuzamo zigashyira umutwe mu mucanga mu rwego rwo kuyahindura zikoreresheje umunwa wazo kugeza igihe zumvise ko ari mu cyerekezo zifuza.

Inyoni ya Barge rousse ishobora kwiha umwanya wo kuruhuka ariko bitayisabye kugwa mu giti cyangwa ku butaka. Ibi ngo ikaba ibikora iruhura igice kimwe cy’ubwonko bwayo kikamera nk’igisinziriye mu gihe ikindi gice kiyifasha gukomeza gukubita amababa iguruka.
Inyoni ikiri nto yo mu bwoko bwa “Barge rousse” yaciye agahigo ko kuguruka ibirometero 13 560 aho yakoze urwo rugendo ikarusoza idahagaze ngo igire icyo kurya cyangwa icyo kunywa ifata.
Iyi nyoni ifite imyaka ibiri yabashije kumara iminsi 11 n’amajoro 11 hiyongereyeho isaha imwe, iguruka ku buryo byayibashishije guhagurukira muri Alasika ho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikagwa ku Kirwa cya Tasmanie kiri mu Majyepfo ya Australie.

Ikiyaga cy'Ihema ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Akarere ka Kayonza, mu majyepfo ya Pariki y'Akagera. Inkombe yacyo y'iburasirazuba ni umupaka w'u Rwanda na Tanzaniya.
Ikiyaga cy'Ihema ni cyo kiyaga kinini muri Pariki y'Akagera. Kibamo imvubu n'ingona. Abakerarugendo bagitemberamo mu bwato.
Ikiyaga cy'Ihema kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 1 292. Gifite ubuso bwa km² 90. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo buri hagati ya m 5 na m 7. Buhinduka bitewe n'ahantu n'igihe cy'umwaka.
Ikiyaga gikikijwe n'ibishanga binini by'urufunzo. Umugezi wa Akagera ugaburira ibiyaga bigera kuri cumi na bibiri. Ikiyaga cy'Ihema ni kimwe muri byo. Amazi y'Ikiyaga cy'Ihema yisuka mu Mugezi wa Akagera.
Ubushyuhe bwo muri ako karere buri hagati ya dogere 21 na 26. Imvura igwa ku mwaka ni nka mm 1 100.
Ikiyaga cy'Ihema kibamo imvubu nyinshi n'ingona. Intare n'ingwe ziza kunywa amazi ku nkombe zacyo.
Ibishanga bikikije ikiyaga ni ingenzi ku inyamaswa za pariki. Biziha amazi yo kunywa igihe cyose. Ni n'ahantu h'ingenzi h'inyoni zo mu mazi. Muri izo nyoni harimo shoebill ("Balaeniceps rex") na papyrus gonolek ("Laniarius mufumbiri").
Mu 1934, itegeko ryashyizeho pariki ryabujije uburobyi mu biyaga byayo. Nyuma, politiki nshya yo gucunga pariki yemeye uburobyi.
Gutembera mu bwato ku Kiyaga cy'Ihema ni kimwe mu bikorwa by'ingenzi by'abasura Pariki y'Akagera. Abakerarugendo babona imvubu, ingona n'inyoni nyinshi zo mu mazi.
Ikibazo gikomeye cy'Ikiyaga cy'Ihema ni amarebe. Amarebe ni ikimera cyo mu mazi. Atwikira amazi y'ikiyaga. Agabanya umwuka wa ogisijeni uri mu mazi. Ibyo byangiza ibinyabuzima.
Ikiyaga gihujwe n'Umugezi wa Akagera binyuze mu bishanga. Kubera iyo mpamvu, amarebe ashobora gukwira no mu zindi nzuzi n'ibiyaga.

Félicien Kabundi Tshiamalenga (yavutse Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 1980) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) i Kananga. Akina nka myugariro wi nyuma. Yahindutse igihangange cyo muri Sudani muri ikipe ya Al Hilal Omdurman.
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Elias Kachunga, (wavutse Ku ya 22 Mata 1992) i Haan mu Budage, Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri wa congo. Ni rutahizamu w'ikipe yo mubwongereza yitwa Bolton Wanderers.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-15, yatsinze ibitego bitandatu bya Bundesliga.
Ku ya 26 Kamena 2015, yinjiye muri FC Ingolstadt.
Ku ya 24 Kamena 2016, Elias Kachunga yatijwe mu gihembwe kimwe ahitamo kuguma mu ikipe y’Ubwongereza ya Huddersfield Town, muri iyo Shampiyona yitwa championship. Imvune yo mu kaguru mu mukino yakinnye na Newcastle yarangije shampiyona ye ya 2017–18.
Nyuma yo gukina n'amakipe y'urubyiruko yo mu Budage, yubashye ihamagarwa rye rya mbere muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ku ya 26 Werurwe 2017 aje gukina umukino wa gicuti na Kenya.
Ku ya 2 Nzeri 2020, yinjiye muri Sheffield ku ya gatatu.
Ku ya 6 Kanama 2021, yinjiye muri Bolton Wanderers.
Elias Kachunga yabyawe na nyina w’umudage na se w’umunyekongo, Innocent Kachunga, wavukiye mu mujyi wa Goma maze yerekeza mu Budage muri 1987.

Hervé Kage, (Yavute ku ya 10 Mata 1989 i kinshasa) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, ukomoka muri Congo, aka yarabigize umwuga, akina hagati mu kibuga, muri RE Virton.
RSC Anderlecht (2006-2009).
Kage yasinye amasezerano ye yu mwuga muri gihembwe cyo muri 2006-2007 na RSC Anderlecht. Muri 2007, yatijwe muri RKC Waalwijk amezi 6, aho yakinnye imikino ine. Muri shampiyona yakurikiyeho, yongeye gutizwa na Anderlecht mu ikipe ya Royale Union Saint-Gilloise. Yakinnye imikino 14 kandi atsinda igitego cya mbere cyu mwuga we
Royal Charleroi SC (2009-2012).
Mu 2009, Hervé Kage yimuriwe muri Royal Charleroi SC, aho atakinnye umukino n'umwe muri Anderlecht. Akina umukino we wambere hamwe n'ikipe ye nshya muri Kanama 2009, bakina na FC Brugge. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, yakinnye imikino 23 atatsinze igitego na kimwe. Muri 2011, yatijwe i Betar Yeruzalemu, aho yakinnye imikino 6 gusa. Muri 2011-2012, yakinnye imikino 29 atsinda ibitego 5, amateka ye muri shampiyona imwe.
KAA La Gantoise (2013-2014).
Murijanvier 2013Mutarama 2013, asinyana amasezerano na La Gantoise, azayinjiramo muri shampiyona itaha. Nyuma y'iminsi icumi, nyuma yo gukurwa muri nucleus yikipe yambere, ubuyobozi bwa Charleroi bwemeye kuyimurira muri club ya Ghent ako kanya kubera indishyi zamafaranga.
KRC Genk (kuva 2014).
Hervé Kagé yinjiye muri Nyakanga 2014 kuri KRC Genk amasezerano y'imyaka 3 hamwe n'imyaka 2 yinyongera. Yahagurutse rero muri La Gantoise aho atigeze yinjira muri gahunda z'umutoza mushya, Hein Vanhaezebrouck.
Guhamagarwa kwe kwa mbere mu ikipe ya Congo kwabaye Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 2012 bakina na Burkina Faso. Muri Mutarama 2015, yatoranijwe gukina mu gikombe cya Afurika.

Emmanuel Kakoko Etepé, (yavutse Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 1950) avukira i Léopoldville, ni umupira wamaguru akaba umu Zayirwa wo mu myaka ya za 1970 na 1980.
Nka rutahizamu, Emmanuel Kakoko Etepé yari umukinnyi ukina nkumunyamahanga ukomoka wu Zayirwa. Yatsinze muri AFCON muri 1974 kandi yitabira igikombe cyisi cya FIFA muri 1974, aho yakinnye atangira gukina na Scotland, na Yugosilaviya (ariko yasimbuwe mu gice cya kabiri) ntiyakina na Burezile. Zaire yaviriyemo mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Imana Kinshasa, atwara shampiyona ya Zayire inshuro ebyiri n'igikombe. Yasinye muri 1981 na VfB Stuttgart, akina umukino umwe gusa muri Bundesliga (na Werder Bremen, Ku ya 19 Ukuboza 1981 (2-2)), udatsinze igitego. Nyuma y imuriwe kuri 1. FC Saarbrücken, mu bihe bibiri, yatsindiye Oberliga Sud-Ouest (Ikidage D3) mu 1983. Yarangije umwuga we muri Borussia Neunkirchen.
Umuhungu we, Yannick Kakoko, kuri ubu akina mu Budage, muri SpVgg Greuther Fürth.

Gael Kakuta,(yavutse Ku ya 21 Kamena 1991) yavukiye i Lille, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri wa congo ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati utera muri Amiens SC.
Kakuta yatojwe muri RC Lens ariko atangira umwuga we muri Chelsea FC aho afatwa nk'impano mu gukora. Guharanira kwemeza, azi amakipe menshi, akenshi muburyo bwi nguzanyo, atabashije kwemeza ibyiringiro amuha.
Amahugurwa kuri RC Lens.
Gaël Kakuta yatangiye gukina umupira afite imyaka irindwi nyuma yo kubona nyirarume akinira ikipe yikiniraga i Lille. Yakinnye imikino ye ya mbere muri US Lille-Moulins maze atsindwa umukino we wa mbere cumi na barindwi kuri umwe. Muri 1999, yinjiye muri Racing Club de Lens hanyuma ikigo cya Liévin kibanziriza imyitozo nyuma y'imyaka itanu. Yahamaze imyaka ibiri, imyitozo mu cyumweru kandi akina imikino ye muri wikendi. Yatojwe cyane na Joachim Marx, wahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa Polonye.
Inzira mu Bwongereza.
Muri Nyakanga 2007, yinjiye mu Bwongereza no mu ikipe ya Chelsea, yemeza ko afite impano n'umukoresha w'iyi kipe Guy Hillion. Yinjiye mu izamu, yahise aba umwe mu bakinnyi bakomeye mu ikipe ye maze agirwa umukinnyi witwaye neza mu mwaka wa shampiyona irangiye, amaze gutsinda ibitego cumi na bibiri mu mikino makumyabiri nine. Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yakomeje imyitozo mu ikipe imwe hanyuma asinya amasezerano yumwuga muri 2009.
Ku ya 17 Mutarama 2009, Luiz Felipe Scolari amuhamagara mu banyamwuga, kumukino wa shampiyona na Stoke City. Mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare 2009, uyu mu kinnyi yaravunitse cyane ukuguru mu myitozo, bityo biba ngombwa ko ataboneka mu gihe cy'amezi umunani gusa yakurikiyeho. Ku ya 3 Nzeri 2009, Kakuta yahagaritswe mu marushanwa yose mu gihe cy’amezi ane nyuma ya makimbirane hagati y’ikipe ye yitoreza, Lens, na Chelsea. Amaherezo, ihagarikwa ryavanyweho, Chelsea irabyemera "kugurisha hafi miliyoni eshatu z'amayero kuri Lens. Ku ya 21 Ugushyingo, Carlo Ancelotti yatangiye umwuga we wa mbere amuzana mu kibuga cya Wolverhampton ku munota wa mirongo itanu n'umunani. Igihembwe kirangiye, uku gukina kumwemerera kubona izina rya shampyona mu Ubwongereza. Ku ya 8 Ukuboza 2009, Gaël Kakuta yinjiye mu mateka y'iyi kipe, abaye umukinnyi muto washyizweho muri Champions League, ahanganye n'ikipe ya APOEL Nicosia. Yari afite imyaka cumi n'umunani, amezi atanu n'iminsi cumi n'irindwi.
Ku ya 26 Mutarama 2011, kubera kubura umwanya wo gukina, yagurijwe muri Fulham kugeza shampiyona irangiye, nta buryo bwo kugura. Agarutse i Londres, umutoza we mushya André Villas-Boas ntabwo yamwizeye kandi yagurijwe na Bolton Ku ya 31 Kanama 2011 Kuri1Ku ya 1 Mutarama 2012.

Paul-Mohamed Kalambay Otepa (yavutse Ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 1948 apfa ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 2024) muri Kongo Mbiligi ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa congo (DRC), wakinnye nkumuzamu.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye umukino umwe, atatsinze igitego, muri 1974.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974. Mu isi yateguwe mu Budage, nta mukino numwe akina.

Pascal Kalemba (yavutse Ku ya 26 Gashyantare 1979 i Kinshasa apfa Ku ya 27 Ugushyingo 2012) mu mujyi yavukiyemo, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru, akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC). Akina nk'umuzamu.
Yagiye mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 2002 asimbuye no mu gikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo nk'intangiriro aho yagaragaye nk'umuzamu mwiza ariko kubera imyitwarire ye. Nyuma yo kugenda kwa Claude Le Roy ku buyobozi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ntazongera gutorwa mu ikipe y'igihugu kubera kutitwara neza.
Pascal Kalemba Lukoki yapfuye Ku ya 27 Ugushyingo 2012 i Kinshasa, afite imyaka 33.

Dieudonné Kalulika, (wavukiye Kinshasa Ku ya 10 Mutarama 1981), ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa congo, ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati utera. Yakiniye ikipe ya CD Primeiro de Agosto yo muri Angola kuva muri Mutarama 2013, nyuma yo kumara igihe kinini mu buzima bwe mu Bubiligi.
yakinnye inshuro 12 n'ibitego 4 yatsindiye mu ikipe y'igihugu ya congo, yakinnye mu gikombe cy'Afurika muri 2004.
Intambwe yambere muri congo.
Dieudonné Kalulika yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri 1997 muri AS Maïka, mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Kongo. Yakiniyeyo ibihe bibiri, yibeshya ko yatsinze ibitego, nyuma aragenda agerageza amahirwe ye mu mahanga muri 1999. Yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Burundi ya Atlético OFC, nubwo yatsinze ibitego byinshi, yahuye n’ivanguramoko na bagenzi be, bituma ava muri iyo kipe asubira mu gihugu cye kavukire nyuma ya shampiyona. Nyuma yinjiye muri US Safari, no mu cyiciro cya kabiri, ubwo yatangiraga kwiga amategeko. Muri 2001, yinjijwe muri Tout Puissant Mazembe, ikipe nini ya Lubumbashi, ikina mu cyiciro cya mbere. Muri shampiyona ye ya mbere muri iyi kipe, yatsindiye igikombe cyigihugu. Imyitwarire ye myiza ya makipe yafunguye amarembo ikipe y'igihugu muri 2004, aho yakinnye muri CAN muri 2004, aho igihugu cye cyasezerewe mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Dieudonné Kalulika yahise agaragara n’uwahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wu bubiligi, Luc Nilis, wamusinyishije na Beringen Heusden-Zolder, ikipe ikina mu cyiciro cya 2 aho yari umuyobozi wa tekiniki. Yakinnye umukino wa mbere ku ya 31 Kanama 2005 hanze ya Oud-Heverlee Louvain maze yishimira itangira rya mbere afite igitego cya mbere nyuma yiminsi itatu ahanganye na Red Star Waasland. Ni umukinnyi usanzwe mu ikipe kandi yatsinze ibitego bitandatu bya shampiyona. Kubwamahirwe, iyi kipe ifite ibibazo bikomeye bya mafaranga kandi ihatirwa gusaba guhomba muri Werurwe 2006. Uyu mukinnyi yaje kurangiza shampiyona muri KVSK United, bakinana mu cyiciro cya nyuma cyi cyiciro cya 2. Yatsinze ibitego bitanu mu mikino itandatu, nyamara byagaragaye ko bidahagije kwinjira mu ntore.

Alain Dioko Kaluyituka, (yavutse Ku ya 2 Mutarama 1987), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa Kino-congo wakinnye nkimbere-imbere.
Yatojwe muri Vita Club i Kinshasa, yagize ibihe byiza bya kabiri hamwe na dolphine y'umukara, wa mugurishije kuri TP Mazembe. Yigaragaza vuba muri iyi ikipe, hamwe no kwihuta gukubita no gutondeka neza. Ni intwari ya CAF Champions League muri 2009, na CAF Champions League 2010 yatsinzwe n'ikipe ye. Ariko mugihe cy'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA muri 2010, aho Amavubi yageze bidasanzwe kumukino wanyuma na Inter Milan (gutsindwa 0-3). Muri iri rushanwa, Kaluyituka yagize ubwoba bwo kurinda Amerika yepfo amakipe yo muri Mexico yo muri Pachuca na Sport yo muri Berezile Internacional. Yatowe nk'umukinnyi wa kabiri witwaye neza muri iri rushanwa nyuma ya Andrés D'Alessandro.
Yasinyanye na Al Ahli SC muri katari muri 2011, ahita yigaragaza nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi kipe akaba n'umwe mu batsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona (nubwo yahageze muri shampiyona). Ariko, ntashobora kubuza gusezererwa kw'ikipe ye shampiyona irangiye. Yagurijwe rero muri ikipe, ya Al Kharitiyath, kugirango agume muri cyiciro cya mbere. Asanga ikipe ya Al Ahli nyuma yo kuzamuka kwe byihuse mu ntore za katari.
Yasoje shampiyona yo muri 2013-2014 nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona ya katari n'ibitego 22, imbere y'abakinnyi nka Saez, Dagano, Youssef Msakni, Adriano, na Nene.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-2015, nubwo hari ba rutahizamu benshi nka Hamdi Harbaoui, Issam Jemâa, Imoh Ezekiyeli, Romarinho, Sebastián Quintana, Paulinho, cyangwa Younis Mahmoud, yarangije gutsinda ibitego byinshi ku nshuro ya kabiri yikurikiranya, atsinda ibitego 25. Yatowe kandi umukinnyi mwiza wa shampiyona.
Muri 2015, yavuye mu ikipe ya Al Ahli SC yinjira mu ikipe ya Al-Gharafa. Muri 2016, yagurijwe umwaka umwe muri Lekhwiya SC, imwe mu makipe meza muri katari.

Pedro Kamata (yavutse Ku ya 6 Nzeri 1981) yahoze ari umukinnyi ukomoko muri Congo, ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo i Luanda (Angola). Yakinaga nka rutahizamu.
Yatojwe muri AJ Auxerre (1993-2001).
yaje mu mupira w'amaguru hamwe n'amakipe ya Auvergne ya Neuvy na Moulins (Allier). Muri 1994, yinjiye mu kigo cy'amahugurwa cya Association de la jeunesse auxerroise.
FC Groningen (2002-2003).
Muri 2002 yagiye mu Buholandi muri FC Groningen.
Tugarutse muri Auvergne no mu karere ka Berry (2003-2005).
Muri 2003, yinjiye muri Clermont Foot 63. Yakinnye imikino 18 ya shampiyona 2 atsinda ibitego bibiri.
Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yagiye muri La Berrichonne de Châteauroux, akiri muri L2. Yakinnye imikino 14 atsinda ibitego bibiri yatsinze maze ikipe ye ibasha kugera ku mukino w'anyuma wa mu gikombe cy'ubufaransa, na Paris Saint-Germain itsinzwe (1-0).
Mu 2004, yagarutse muri Clermont Foot 63. Yakinnye imikino 10 atsinda igitego, mbere yo gusubira muri La Berrichonne de Châteauroux muri shampiyona yo muri 2004-2005, iyi kipe yaje ku mwanya wa gatanu muri shampiyona ya shampiyona 2.
Icyerekezo Ubutaliyani (2005-2011).
Mu mpeshyi ya 2005, Pedro Kamata yageze mu Butaliyani gukina mu ikipe ya AC Legnano, akina muri Serie C2. Yakinnye imikino 82 atsinda ibitego 5. umwaka wa 2 bivamo kuzamuka muri Serie C1 hamwe ni cyubahiro cya shampiyona yo muri Serie C2 muri 2007. Ku ya 22 Mutarama 2008, yasinye amasezerano na AS Bari (Serie B) kugeza mu mwaka wo muri 2011 shampiyona irangiye, iyi kipe yazamuwe muri Serie A, yakinnye imikino 60 atsinda igitego 1.
Kamata yarahamaga we mu Ukuboza 2005 n'umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Angola. Ariko, amaherezo yahisemo gukina n'igihugu cya se,cya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
AS Yzeure (2011-2012).
Ku ya 27 Nzeri 2011, yagarutse muri Allier aho asinyana amasezerano na AS Yzeure ukinira mu itsinda B rya CFA. Yakinnye imikino 23 atsinda ibitego 3.

Wilson Kamavuaka, (yavutse Ku ya 29 Werurwe 1990) i Düren mu Budage, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga mumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati urinda.
Wilson yavukiye mu Budage, i Düren mu majyaruguru ya Rhine-Westphalie, yatangiye umupira w'amaguru mu ikipe ya Sportfreunde Düren kuva muri 1999 kugeza 2007, ubwo yinjiraga mu makipe y'urubyiruko ya Alemannia Aachen. Muri 2009, yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri nitsinda ryabigenewe rya TSG 1899 Hoffenheim.
Nyuma yi bihe bibiri, amasezerano ye ntabwo yongerewe kandi Wilson akorana na reji ya 1. FC Nuremberg, ariko yahise yinjira mu ikipe y'ambere. Ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2011, yatangiye umwuga we muminota irindwi ishize yakinnye na FSV Mainz 05 (3-3).
Yabonye umupinnyi ngenderwaho bwa mbere muri Bundesliga ku ya 10 umunsi i Munich na Bayern, ariko ikipe ye yatsinzwe cyane (0-4), Wilson akina umukino wose. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yagurijwe mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'Ubudage muri SSV Jahn Regensburg.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Nubwo Wilson yari umunyamwuga kandi ukina nk'umukunzi wi kibuga cya Hoffenheim, Wilson yatangiye gukinira ikipe yi gihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo Ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2010 i Innsbruck muri Otirishiya, mu mukino wa gicuti na Arabiya Sawudite (0-2).

Albert Kanta Kambala, Ni umukinnyi ukina numupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa Zayire, wakinnye nkumukinnyi wo hagati.
Yavukiye i Élisabethville, Kambala yatangiye umwuga we muri TP Mazembe. Nyuma yi mukiye mu Bugereki hamwe na Alpha Ethniki afite imyaka 23, asinyana na Rodos FC mu bihembwe bibiri. Yarangije umwuga we wo gukina mu Bubiligi ahabwa uruhushya rwa UEFA Pro ku ishuri rya Heysel.
Ayobora amakipe menshi yumupira w'amaguru muri DR Congo, harimo DCMP, AS Vita Club, AS Dragons, SC Cilu, AS Kabasha, OC Bukavu Dawa na FC Makila Mabe.
Kanta Kambala yapfiriye mu bitaro i Kikwit afite imyaka 50 .

Jean-Paul Kamudimba, (yavutse amakuru kuri Gashyantare 1982) i Lubumbashi, n'umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri wa congo.
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Kuri ubu atuye hagati y'Ubwongereza n'Ubufaransa, aho umuryango we uba.

Déo Gracia Kanda Mukoko (yavutse Ku ya 11 Kanama 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Congo (DRC) i Matad.
Akina nku wo hagati ibumoso muri sukari ya Mtibwa
Umukinnyi wihuta cyane kandi ni umu tekinike nubwo afite metero 1,71, nu mwe mu byiringiro bikomeye bya congo byigihe cye.
Daring Club Motema Pembe.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Daring Club Motema Pembe mbere yo kwinjira muri TP Mazembe.
Ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 2010, yatsinze igitego cyo kunganya na Esipagne Espérance de Tunis yo muri Tuniziya mu kugaruka kwa nyuma kwa CAF Champions League (amanota ya nyuma 1-1).
Yitabira ikipe ya batarengeje imyaka 23 mu majonjora ya CAF mu marushanwa y'umupira w'amaguru yaberaga i Londres ndetse no mu majonjora yo gukina imikino ya Afurika muri 2011.
Muri 2013, yavuye muri Tout Puissant Mazembe yerekeza muri Raja Casablanca.
I Raja Casablanca, yitabiriye igikombe cyisi cya FIFA muri 2013.
Muri 2014, yasinyanye muri AS Vita Club.
Subira kuri TP Mazembe.
Muri 2015 yagarutse muri Tout Puissant Mazembe.Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere na FC Saint Eloi Lupopo.

Thierry Kasereka ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Kasereka yavukiye i Goma mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru kandi amarana igihe n'ababyeyi be i Crișcior, Hunedoara, muri Rumaniya, muri Transylvania, mbere yo gusubira muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 2003.
Kasereka yatangiye umwuga we mu kigo cyigisha umupira w'amaguru i Kinshasa, Yaje kwimukira muri DC Virunga mu mpeshyi yo muri 2005 mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe y'urubyiruko ya AS Vita Club muri 2007. mu mpeshyi ya 2010, Kasereka yasinyanye n'ikipe nkuru AS Vita Club Kinshasa, muri Ligue 1. Muri shampiyona ye yambere yambere (2010), yahise atwara shampiyona yi gihugu.
Kasereka yari mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo yatoranijwe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2014 kizabera muri Afurika yepfo, mbere yo kuvanwa mu ikipe nyuma yuko umutoza w’i gihugu Claude Le Roy mbere gato yuko irushanwa ritangira. Kasereka yakinnye imikino itandatu kugeza uryo yashyirwaho bwa mbere muri 2011. Yabanje gukina muri DR Congo ya batarengeje imyaka 23 mu gushaka itike yo kuzitabira imikino ya Olempike izabera i Londres muri 2012 Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa akomeye ya Toulon muri 2013.
