Kabwe Kasongo (yavutse Ku ya 31 Nyakanga 1970) Ni umukinnyi ukina wumupira wamaguru ukomoka muri (DRC) i Kinshasa. Yakinnye nka myugariro.
Kabwe Kasongo yitabiriye Igikombe cy’Afurika muri 1992, Igikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 1994, Igikombe cy’Afurika muri 1996 ndetse n’igikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 2000 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Muri ikipe, akina cyane ashyigikiye Vitoriya Guimarães na Deportivo Chaves. Yakinnye imikino 39 yose mu cyiciro 1 cya Porutugali naho imikino 211 muri 2&amp;nbsp;Igabana ry'igiportigale.
Ku ya 19 Gashyantare 2020, yabaye umutoza wa Sabroso Sport Clube, ikipe yo mu karere ka Vila Real.

Pierre Mwana Kasongo nanone yitwa Muana) yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga wavutse Ku ya 10 Ukwakira 1938 kandi yapfuye Ku ya 13 Mutarama 1986. Yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu Les Léopards, atoza andi n'amakipe yaho kandi akinira amakipe abiri yo mu Bubiligi. Yari azwi cyane kubera ubuhanga, impano n'imiterere. Yari umwe mu bakinnyi bake b'Abanyekongo batoranijwe gukina umupira w'amaguru mu Burayi muri 1963. Yagumye i Ghent, umujyi w’icyambu na komine mu karere ka Flemande mu Bubiligi. Igihe y'amaze mu Bubiligi, yakiniye amakipe ya Gantoise (1965-1967) na Verviétois (1961-1965).
Urubyiruko n'umwuga.
Pierre Mwana Kasongo yari umupira w'amaguru w'umuhanga kandi ufite ubuhanga bwo gukina umupira w'amaguru aho yagaragaye mu bwana bwe. Nyina yavuze ko yanze gukina n'ibindi bikinisho kandi yishimira gukina n'umupira we w'amaguru. Amaze gukura, yari azwi cyane kubera kuba umuntu ufite uburakari buke kandi yari azwiho kurwana iyo arakaye cyane, ariko ibyo ntibyigeze bimubuza umwuga we w'umupira w'amaguru. Imico nk'iyi yamuhesheje amazina yamwiziritseho kugeza apfuye nka "Bomber»,«Volvo»n'abandi menshi nka«Mwadia Nvita». Igihe kimwe, Kasongo yarwanye na Bakekole Lumumba hanze y'urubyiniro. Muri 1960, Kasongo yakiniye FC St. Eloi muri Elisabethville, ubu yitwa Lubumbashi, kugeza muri 1961. Mbere yo kwimukira mu Bubiligi, we n'umugore we babyaranye abana batatu kandi babiri muri bo bimukana na we n'umugore we mu Bubiligi. Mu gihe ya maze mu Bubiligi ni bwo we n'umugore we babyaranye umwana wabo wa kane n'uwa gatanu. Nku musore ufite impano; yatorewe gukinira i Burayi yimurirwa mu Bubiligi muri 1961 mu rwego rwo gushimangira amakipe y'Ububiligi. Hamwe na Patrice Kimoni na Stanislas Kalamba, Kasongo yashoboye kwinjiza muri RCS Verviers, izwi kandi nka CS Vervietois. Yakiniye RCS Verviers kuva 1965 kugeza 1966 hanyuma bidatinze yinjira muri ARA Gent, uzwi nka KAA Gent muri Nyakanga 1967, asigaye kugeza 1968. Mu 1968, Igikombe cya Afurika cyabereye muri Etiyopiya naho Congo ikina na Gana ku mukino wa nyuma kuri Stade Addis Ababa ku ngoma ya Haile Selassie. Leon Mungamuni yatsinze iminota icumi m]ugihe cyinyongera m'ugihe Congo-Kinshasa yatsinze ibitego 3-2 kugirango igere kumukino wanyuma ihure na Gana. Pierre Kalala Mukendi yatsinze igitego cy'umukino mu gice cya kabiri cyafashijwe n'umupaka winyuma wa Kasongo. Kubera iyi ntsinzi yatsinze Gana niho Ingwe yegukanye igikombe cya mbere cya AFCON. Baba shampiyo basubiye mu gihugu cyabo, bakiriwe na Mobutu na ba minisitiri be, barimo Etienne Tshisekedi wahoze ari Minisitiri w’intebe wa Kongo. Bakiriwe neza kandi batumirwa gufata amafoto yemewe na Mobutu. Bose bari bambaye imyenda imwe kandi bose bari bambaye ingofero y’ingwe ya Mobutu. Nyuma yo gutsinda CAN 1968, Perezida Mobutu Sese Seko yatumiye ikipe ya Pelé na Burezile FC Santos mu mikino ya gicuti i Zayire. Mwana Kasongo yari umwe mu bakinnyi bari mu ikipe ya Kongo yakinnye n'umukinnyi uzwi cyane wo muri Burezile ndetse n'ikipe ye yose.

Jean Kasusula Kilitsho, (yavutse Ku ya 5 Kanama 1982) i Kisangani, ni umukinnyi wumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC). Akina nka myugariro.
Jean Kasusula yatangiye umwuga we muri Kisangani ikipe yaho ya AS Makiso muri 2002. Nyuma yinjiye muri Kabasha Goma FC.
Mu 2003, yinjiye muri Tout Puissant Mazembe, imwe mu makipe akomeye mu gihugu.
Muri 2009, mugihe cy'igikombe cyisi cyatsinze igitego yatsinze Auckland City FC.
Kasusula azwiho umusaraba mwiza no gutera imigeri kubusa.

Ikiyaga cya Bosumtwi n icyo kiyaga cyonyine kiba muri Gana. Giherereye mu mwobo wa kera muri kilometero Ni 30 mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba bwa Kumasi, umurwa wa Ashanti, kandi ni ahantu hakunze gukorerwa imyidagaduro. Hari imidugudu igera kuri 30 hafi y'ikiyaga cya Bosumtwi,iyo midugudu ituwe n’abaturage bagera ku bihumbi 70. umudugudu wamamaye cyane aho ba mukerarugendo bakunze gutura ni Abono.
Ashanti ifata Bosumtwi nk' ikiyaga cyera. Dukurikije imyizerere gakondo, roho z'abapfuye ziza aho ku kiyaga gusezera ku mana Asase Ya. Kubera iyo mpamvu, bifatwa nk'ibyemewe kuroba mu kiyaga gusa hakoreshejwe mbaho. Mu bwoko bw'amafi yo mu kiyaga harimo "Hemichromis frempongi", hamwe na "Tilapia busumana" na "T. discolor".
Mbere y’ingaruka za asteroide, ako gace kari ishyamba rikunda kugwamo imvura cyane ryuzuye inyamanswa. Nyuma y'ingaruka, icyobo cyavuyemo cyuzuye amazi agize ikiyaga cya Bosumtwi.
Ibihe by'imvura nyinshi byuzuje cya cyobo amazi, bituma urwego rwikiyaga ruzamuka hejuru y'ibice byo hasi. Ibihe nkibi bigaragazwa n’ibisigazwa by’amafi biboneka ku misozi. Amazi ni yo yatemba ava mu kibaya anyuze mu muyoboro wuzuye., ariko hari igihe usanga amazi ari make ku buryo ishyamba ryinjira mu kibaya bigatuma ikiyaga kiba gito gusa.

Edo Kayembe, (yavutse Ku ya 3 Kamena 1998) i Kananga muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati urinda Watford FC.
Edo Kayembe ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yatangiye umupira w'amaguru mu mujyi yavukiyemo (kananga) mbere yo guhaguruka yerekeza i Kinshasa aho yatangiriye umwuga we w'umwuga n'ikipe ya Sharks XI FC. Yageze mu Bubiligi yinjira muri RSC Anderlecht muri 2017 imyaka ine n'igice. Ku ya 22 Ukuboza 2017, yakinnye umukino we wa mbere wa bigize umwuga na Anderlecht, mu mukino wa Jupiler Pro League na KAS Eupen. Uwo munsi yaje gukina mu mwanya wa Adrien Trebel, maze ikipe ye itsindira igitego cyatsinzwe nil.
Mu mpera z'umwaka wo muri 2018, yakinnye imikino ibiri mu rwego rw'amatsinda yo mu gikombe cya Europa League, ubwo yakiraga Spartak Trnava, hanyuma ku cyatsi cya Dinamo Zagreb.
Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2020, Kayembe yemeye imyaka itatu n'indi kipe yo muri Bubiligi, KAS Eupen.
Ku ya 7 Mutarama 2022, Kayembe yinjiye muri Watford FC, aho yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ine nigice.
Ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2019, Edo Kayembe yishimiye itorwa rye rya mbere hamwe n'ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, mu mukino wa gicuti na Alijeriya. Yaje gukina mumikino uwo munsi maze amakipe yombi anganya (1-1).

Mwamba Kazadi (Yavutse Ku ya 6 Werurwe 1947 - 1996). ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo Yakinnye nk'umuzamu, cyane muri Tout Puissant Mazembe.
Yavutse Ku ya 6 Werurwe 1947, Kongo Mbiligi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Mwamba Kazadi yitabiriye igikombe cy'isi muri 1974 hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire.

Francis Kazadi (yavutse Ku ya 20 Nyakanga 1992) i Kinshasa, ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nka rutahizamu wa Tala'ea El Geish, ku ntizanyo yatanzwe na Al-Masry Club.

Neeskens Kebano, (yavutse Ku ya 10 Werurwe 1992) muri Montereau-Fault-Yonne (muri Seine-et-Marne), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati utera Fulham.
Yatoranijwe mu ikipe y'Ubufaransa kuva ku batarengeje imyaka 17 kugeza ku myaka 20, yahisemo muri 2014 gukinira ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo yitabiriye igikombe cya Afurika muri 2015.
Neeskens Kebano yatangiye umupira w'amaguru afite imyaka 6 muri ikipe ya Montereau-Fault-Yonne. Se yamuhaye izina rye rya mbere yerekeza kuri Johan Neeskens, umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru mu Buholandi wo mu myaka ya za 70. Yamenyekanye na Paris Saint-Germain mu gihe cyo gushakisha kwinjira muri INF Clairefontaine. Nyuma y'amezi make yi bigeragezo, y'asinyiye kandi yinjira mu ikipe ya PSG y'imyaka 13 muri 2005.
Paris Saint Germain.
Yatojwe muri PSG, yazamutse mu ntera yinjira mu ikipe yabigenewe, muri CFA, muri 2010. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere n'ikipe ya mbere ya PSG Ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2011, ku myaka 18, na FC Martigues muri gikombe cya bafaransa. ya 2 Werurwe, yatsinze igitego cya mbere cyumwuga muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza amarushanwa. Ufite CFA kandi yitabiriye imikino irindwi muri shampiyona yo muri 2010-2011, yasinyanye amasezerano yambere yu mwuga, m'ugihe cy'imyaka 3, hamwe na Paris SG.
Mu ntangiriro za shampiyona yo muri 2012–13, yongereye amasezerano na PSG indi myaka ibiri, mbere yo kujya mu ntizanyo kuri Stade Malherbe de Caen, muri Ligue 2 kugirango abone umwanya wo gukina. Abamugaye kubera imvune yo mu ivi byatumye ataba mu kibuga amezi 3, yitabira imikino 12 ya shampiyona.

Ikiyaga cya Logipi ni ikiyaga cy'amazi y'umunyu cyo mu majyaruguru ya Kenya. Kiri mu majyaruguru y'ikibaya cya Suguta. Gitandukanyijwe n'Ikiyaga cya Turkana n'urukurikirane rw'ibirunga bito.
Ikiyaga cya Logipi ntikigira ubujyakuzimu bunini. Amazi yacyo agaburira inyoni nyinshi za flamingo.
Ikiyaga cya Logipi gifite ubujyakuzimu bwa m 3 kugeza kuri m 5. Gifite uburebure bwa km 6 n'ubugari bwa km 3. Amazi yacyo arimo umunyu mwinshi wa "sodium bicarbonate". Igipimo cy'ubusharire bwayo (pH) kiri hagati ya 9,5 na 10,5. Umunyu wayo uri hagati ya g 20 na g 50 kuri litiro.
Mu 2020, imvura nyinshi yatumye Ikiyaga cya Turkana cyuzura. Amazi yacyo yarengeye Ikiyaga cya Logipi.
Inyoni za flamingo zikunze kuba ku Kiyaga cya Logipi. Zirya udukoko two mu mazi twitwa "Arthrospira" (Spirulina) n'ibindi binyabuzima bito byo mu mazi.

Jean Kembo uba Kembo (Yavutse Ku ya 27 Ukuboza 1947 i Leopoldville, Ku ya 26 Werurwe 2007) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wo muri Zayire.
Yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga, yitabiriye kwimikwa ku mugabane w’ikipe y’igihugu ya Zayire, mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 1968 muri Etiyopiya, na 1974 muri Egiputa.
Yiswe "Bwana Goal", yafashije cyane Zayire, umukino urangiye, abaye umukinnyi wa mbere wo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara kugira ngo abashe kujya mu cyiciro cya nyuma cy’igikombe cyisi cya FIFA, atsinda ibitego bibiri kuri Maroke Ukuboza 1973.
Ni se wa Jirès Kembo Ekoko, nawe ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga.

Julien Kialunda, (yavutse Ku ya 24 Mata 1940 i Matadi muri Kongo, apfa Ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1987 i Antwerp) mu Bubiligi, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa congo, wakinnye nka myugariro wo hagati. Yakiniye amakipe atatu yo mu Bubiligi hagati ya 1960 na 1980, ntabwo byari bisanzwe ku mukinnyi nya furika icyo gihe. Nyuma yumwuga we, yabaye umutoza wa Zayire amezi make. Yapfuye azize SIDA Ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1987.
Hano haribiganiro kumazina ye, bamwe babyandika "Kialunda", abandi "Kaliunda". Nkuko umukinnyi ubwe atazi neza uko izina rye ryanditswe, imyandikire ikunze kugaragara, "Kialunda", ifatwa nku kuri.
Julien Kialunda yavutse Ku ya 24 Mata 1940 i Matadi, muri kiriya gihe haracyari Kongo y'Ububiligi, apfa ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1987 i Antwerp mu Bubiligi. Yatangiriye umupira i "Daring Léopoldville", umurwa mukuru w’abakoloni b’Ababiligi, nyuma uza kuba Kinshasa. Mu 1960, yasimbukiye i Burayi, ariko icyo gihe kikaba cyari gake cyane. Yatangiriye muri Union Saint-Gilloise, ikipe yaturutse i Buruseli, nyuma ikina mu cyiciro cya mbere. Nyuma y'imyaka itatu, iyi kipe isubiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Yatsindiye igikombe maze asubira mu ndege ya mbere muri shampiyona ya mbere, ariko kugaruka ntibyatinze, aho "Abanyamurwango" barangije ku mwanya wa kabiri kugeza ku mwanya wa nyuma, bisobanura kimwe no kumanuka.

Mafu Kibonge (yavutse ku ya 12 Gashyantare 1945) noneho muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nkumukinnyi wo hagati.

Muscal Mvuezolo-Musumbu (yavutse Ku ya 30 Werurwe 1979 i Kinshasa) ni umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.

Chadrack Muzungu Lukombe, (yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1997 i Kinshasa), ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo ukina nka kuruhande hamwe na RS Berkane.
Yatojwe afite imyaka 9 muri ATHLETIC CLUB UJANA Training Center i Kinshasa. Yatangiye umwuga we muri AS Vita Club, ikipe ya turutse mu gihugu akomokamo.
Muri Mutarama 2019, Lukombe yagiye mu mahanga asinyana n'ikipe yo mu Misiri ENPPI SC.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama umwaka ukurikira, yinjiye mu Burayi na Espagne UD Almería. Yahawe ikipe ya B ikina muri Tercera División (icyiciro cya kane). Noneho yi muriwe muri Boulogne mu buryo bw'intizanyo nta mahitamo yo kugura.
Ku ya 20 Gicurasi 2022, yegukanye igikombe cya Confederation nyuma yo gutsinda umukino wa nyuma kuri penaliti yakinnye na Orlando Pirates FC (banganya, 1-1). Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2022, yatsinze Wydad Casablanca kuri penariti mu mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Maroke kuri Stade Mohammed-V (banganya, 0-0). Ku ya 10 Nzeri 2022, yatangiye ayobowe n'umutoza we mushya Abdelhak Benchikha ku mukino wa nyuma wa CAF Super Cup na Wydad Athletic Club. Umukino warangiye itsinze 0-2 ku kigo cyimikino cya Moulay-Abdallah.

Glody Ngonda Muzinga, (yavutse Ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1994),Ni ukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomo ka muri wa congo ukina nkumukinnyi winyuma muri Riga FC.
Yagiye gukina muri Afurika Champions League ndetse n’igikombe cya Confederation inshuro nyinshi. Yageze ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Confederation hamwe na AS Vita Club muri 2018, batsindwa na Raja de Casablanca.
Uburambe bwa mbere iburayi muri Dijon.
Yinjiye muri Dijon FCO muri Kanama 2019, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka 2 (undi 1 bishoboka) kugirango asubize urugendo rwa Oussama Haddadi na Arnold Bouka Moutou. Byabaye ngombwa ko akina irushanwa n’umusore ukomoka mu gihugu cya Maroke na Hamza Mendyl kandi yakinnye imikino 8 gusa mu marushanwa yose (harimo 6 muri Ligue 1) muri shampiyona ya mbere.
Umwanditsi w'imyiteguro ibanziriza shampiyona, yatangiye kumunsi wambere wa Ligue 1 muri 2020-2021, ku ya 22 Kanama 2020. Kubwamahirwe, yakomerekejwe m'ugihe cy'umukino hanyuma kubura kwe byagereranijwe mu byumweru byinshi. Mu guhatana na Aníbal Chalá, yagurijwe mu gihembwe, yigaragaje nk'intangiriro ku ruhande rw'ibumoso rwa myugariro wa Dijon.
Yatsinze igitego cya mbere hamwe na Dijon FCO ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 2020, na OGC Nice, mu izina ry'umunsi wa 12 wa Ligue 1. Nyuma yitabiriye intsinzi ya mbere ya Dijon ya shampiyona (amanota ya nyuma 1-3).
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo Ku ya 11 Kanama 2017, kurwanya Kongo. Uku kunganya ibitego biri mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika muri 2018.

Ikiyaga cya Retba, kizwi kandi ku izina rya ikiyaga cya roza (bisobanura " ikiyaga cy'umutuku werurutse "), giherereye mu majyaruguru ya Cap Vert muri Senegali, muri kilometero 35 z' amajyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'umurwa mukuru Dakar mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Afurka. Yiswe amazi ya roza bitewe n'icyatsi cyo mu nyanja "Dunaliella salina" kizwiho kuba kirimo umunyu mwinshi. Ibara ryacyo ryiganza cyane cyane guhera mu mpera za Mutarama kugeza mu ntangiriro za Werurwe mu gihe cyizuba; icyakora, Mu gihe cy'imvura nyinshi yo muri Nzeri 2022 ntihahungabanijwe ibikorwa byo gusarura umunyu ku kiyaga gusa, ahubwo kubera ko watumye ikiyaga gitakaza ibara, byagize ingaruka mbi ku bukerarugendo.
Ikiyaga giherereye muri kilometero 35 mu majyaruguru-y'uburasirazuba bwa Dakar, gitandukanijwe n'inyanja ya Atalantika gusa na koridoro ifunganye y'imisozi, kandi yitirirwa amazi yiroza, aterwa n'icyatsi cyo mu nyanja "Dunaliella salina". Icyo cyatsi gitanga ibara ritukura kugirango ribafashe kwinjiza urumuri rw'izuba, rubiha imbaraga zo gukora ATP. Ibara rigaragara cyane mu gihe cy'izuba (kuva Ugushyingo kugeza Gicurasi) kandi ntigaragara cyane mu gihe cy'imvura (Kamena kugeza Ukwakira).
Ikiyaga kizwiho umunyu mwinshi (kugeza 40% mu turere tumwe na tumwe), ibyo bikaba ahanini biterwa no kwinjira mu mazi yo mu nyanja no guhumeka nyuma. Kimwe n'Inyanja y'Umunyu, ikiyaga kirahagije kuburyo abantu bashobora kureremba byoroshye.
Umunyu woherezwa mu karere kose hamwe n’abaterankunga bagera ku 3.000, abagabo n’abagore baturutse muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba, bakora amasaha 6-7 ku munsi. Umunyu ukoreshwa n’abarobyi bo muri Senegali mu kubungabunga amafi, akaba ari kimwe mu bintu gakondo, harimo n’ibiryo by’igihugu, ari amafi n’umuceri witwa thieboudienne. Toni zigera ku 38.000 z'umunyu zisarurwa muri iki kiyaga buri mwaka, ibyo bikaba bigira uruhare mu nganda zitanga umunyu muri Senegali. Senegali iri k’umwanya wa mbere utanga umunyu muri Afurika.
Urutonde rw'umurage wisi.
Ikiyaga cya Retba cyasuzumwe na UNESCO nk'Umurage w'isi kuva mu Kwakira 2005, kandi kiracyabarwa gutyo mu mwaka wa 2023.
Akamaro muri siporo.
Ikiyaga cyakunze kuba iherezo ry'isiganwa ry'imodoka mu murwa wa Dakar mbere y'uko imyigaragambyo yimukira muri Amerika y'Epfo mu 2009.

Inganda zikora ibinyobwa nizo zitungwa agatoki cyanecyane.
Nyuma yo kubona ko inganda zikora ibinyobwa muri Afurika zikoresha amazi menshi, ba nyiri izo nganda bararakangurirwa gukoresha amazi make mu binyobwa bakora kuko biri muri gahunda yo kurengera umutungo kamere w’Amazi n’ibidukikije muri rusange.
Ibi byasabwe kuri uyu wa 25 Mata 2013 mu nama yaberaga i Kigali ihuje ibihugu 7 byo muri Afurika byibumbiye mu ihuriro ABIWSI rigamije gukangurira inganda nyafurika z’ibinyobwa gukoresha amazi make mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije.
"Nyuma yo kubona ko inganda zikora ibinyobwa muri Afurika zikoresha amazi menshi, ba nyiri izo nganda bararakangurirwa gukoresha amazi make mu binyobwa bakora kuko biri muri gahunda yo kurengera umutungo kamere w’Amazi n’ibidukikije muri rusange."
Ibi byasabwe kuri uyu wa 25 Mata 2013 mu nama yaberaga i Kigali ihuje ibihugu 7 byo muri Afurika byibumbiye mu ihuriro ABIWSI rigamije gukangurira inganda nyafurika z’ibinyobwa gukoresha amazi make mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije.
Ibyo bihugu ni Misiri, Ethiopie, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzanie, Ouganda na Zimbabwe
Abari mu nama basanze inganda zo muri Afurika zikoresha amazi arenze urugero ugereranyi n’igipimo kiba gisabwa gukorehswa muri litiro y’ikinyobwa gisembuye n’ikidasembuye.
Ikigereranyo fatizo cy’amazi kigomba kujya muri litiro imwe y’ikinyobwa ni Litiro enye z’amazi.
Alexis Ruzibukira, ushinzwe inganda nini,into n’iziciriritse muri Minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda (MINICOM), yavuze ko iyi nama ari ingirakamaro bitewe nuko ibyavugiwemo bizafasha Inganda z’ibinyobwa muri Afurika gukoresha neza amazi igihe ashyirwa mu binyobwa.
Ngarukiye Deric, ushinzwe ibya tekiniki mu ruganda rw’ Inyange, yatanze urugero rugaragaza ko mu mwaka w’ 2010 bakoreshaga amazi angana na litiro 4,5 muri litiro imwe y’ ikinyobwa mu gihe bari barihaye. Kuri ubu uruganda rw’Inyange rukaba rukoresha litiro 4 z’amazi muri ilitiro imwe y’ ikinyobwa.
Ku ruhande rw’uruganda rukora ibinyobwa rwa BRALIRWA, Jules Kalitanyi ushinzwe gukurikirana uro ruganda avuga ko kuva mu myaka icumi bakorana n’umushinga ABIWSI bagabanije amazi bakoresha baka bageze kuri litiro enye muri litiro imwe y’ikinyobwa.

Kuri ubu isi yose ihangayikishijwe n’ingaruka ziterwa cyangwa zizaterwa n’imyuka ihumanya ikirere igenda yiyongera uko bukeye n’uko bwije. Nyamara twiyibagiza ko uko guhumana kw’ikirere ari twe n’ibikorwa byacu dutuma bibaho.
Imyuka ihumanya ikirere iterwa ahanini kuri ubu n’ubwiyongere bw’inganda ndetse n’ibinyabiziga.
Imyuka ituruka mu nganda, imyotsi iterwa no gutwika amashyamba, imyuka iva mu binyabiziga biri kugenda, ibyo byose birazamuka bikagera kure mu kirere aho bitera impinduka nyinshi.
Ibi hamwe n’ibindi tutarondora hano, ni byo bigira ingaruka ku kiremwamuntu no ku byaremwe muri rusange.
Ingaruka z’imyuka ihumanya ikirere.
Ingaruka z’imyuka ihumanya ikirere ziteye guhangayika cyane. Iyi myuka itera ibibazo mu guhumeka, bityo indwara zinyuranye z’ibihaha n’umutima zikiyongera. Kanseri na zo zikaziraho yaba kanseri y’ibihaha, iy’uruhu n’izindi zinyuranye. By’umwihariko abana bavukira ahantu hakabije kuba umwuka uhumanye bakunze kurwara umusonga na asima.
2. Ubushyuhe budasanzwe
Indi ngaruka y’iyi myuka ni ukwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku isi bizwi nka Global warming. Uko ubushyuhe bwiyongera ku isi bigira ingaruka ku mazi yo mu nyanja kuko ahahoze ari balafu zirashonga, bigatuma aho amazi yageraga aharenga. Ingaruka zikaba imyuzure no kwimuka kw’abantu bahunga aho amazi yuzuye.
3. Imvura zirimo aside
Imyuka mibi nka NO (nitric oxide) na SO2 (sulfur oxide) igenda yiyongera mu kirere uko ibintu bitwitswe haba mu nganda, gutwika ibishingwe n’ibisigazwa by’inyamaswa. Iyo imvura iguye, ibitonyanga byayo byivanga nay a myuka nuko imvura ikagwa yabaye aside. Ibi bigira ingaruka ku bimera, inyamaswa n’abantu.
Iyo umwuka wa azote (nitrogen) ubaye mwinshi muri ya myuka ihumanya ikirere ugeze ku mazi yo ku Nyanja birivanga nuko bikabyara ibimera byo mu mazi bizwi nka algae. Nibyo byitwa eutrophication. Ibi bihita bigira ingaruka ku mafi n’ibindi biremwa byose biba mu Nyanja. Kuri ubu algae zisa n’icyatsi ziboneka mu biyaga n’ibizenga by’amazi zose ni ingaruka za nitrogen nyinshi.
5. Kwangirika kwa Ozone
Nkuko twabibonye ozone twakita nk’akayunguruzo, iturinda imirasire mibi y’izuba izwi nka ultraviolet (UV). Imyuka mibi yangiza aka kayunguruzo ni izwi nka chlorofluorocarbons na hydro chlorofluorocarbons. Uko aka kayunguruzo kagenda kangirika niko iyi mirasire igenda yiyongera ku isi ikaba itera ibibaso ku ruhu no ku maso.
Ni gute twacyemura iki kibazo.
Nubwo tubivuze mu magambo Atari menshi nyamara guhumana kw’ikirere bifite ingaruka kandi zizakomeza kwiyongera nihatagira igikorwa ngo imyuka ihumanya ikirere igabanyuke.
Reka turebere hamwe ibyo twakora ngo duhangane n’iki kibazo gihangayikishije isi
Kuri ubu imodoka bwite ziri kugenda ziyongera. Uretse no guteza ikibazo cyo kuba nyinshi mu muhanda, ariko binongera imyuka ijya mu kirere mibi. Nyamara abantu baramutse bakoresheje itwara rya rusange, mwaba mujya mu cyerekezo kimwe aho kugirango buri wese agende mu modoka imwe mukajya muri imwe muri benshi, byagabanya ya myuka ijya mu kirere (aho kugirango usange imodoka 5 zishoreranye buri yose irimo umuntu umwe n’indi myanya 4 itarimo abantu, bajya muri imwe izindi 4 bakaziparika)
Kuri ubu hari uburyo bwinshi bukoreshwa nyamara butaritabirwa na benshi. Imirasire y’izuba itanga amashanyarazi, amashanyarazi ava ku mmuyaga, byose birekura ingufu zingana n’izindi kandi byo ntabwo bihumanya ikirere. Ubu buryo bukoreshejwe neza byagabanya ikoreshwa ry’amashanyarazi akomoka mu gutwika ibisigazwa by’inyamaswa, ingufu ziva mu ikoreshwa ry’amakara kimwe no gutwika amashyamba
Hari ibintu byinshi tujugunya cyangwa dutwika nyamara byakongera gukoreshwa. Amacupa avamo amazi n’imitobe, aho kuyajugunya cyangwa kuyatwika, ashobora gutunganywa akongera agakoreshwa. Ibase ishaje ushyizemo ibitaka wateramo imboga zikamera kandi ukaba wungutse kabiri
Kuri ubu abahanga Bari bakwiye kureba uburyo bwo gutwara ikibanyiziga hadakenewe risansi cyangwa mazutu. Hashobora gukoreshwa imirasire y’izuba (ubu buryo bwatangiye gukoreshwa) kimwe no gukoresha amashanyarazi. Ibi byatuma ya myuka izamuka mu kirere igabanyuka.

Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo ni ikiyaga cyo mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru, hafi y'umujyi wa Musanze. Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo n'Ikiyaga cya Burera byitwa «ibiyaga by'impanga».
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 2 800. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 764. Amazi yacyo akoreshwa mu gutanga amashanyarazi. Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo kiri mu gace ka Ramsar kitwa Rugezi-Burera-Ruhondo.
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo kiri hafi y'umujyi wa Musanze. Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo n'Ikiyaga cya Burera byitwa «ibiyaga by'impanga».
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo gifite uburebure bwa kilometero 9. Ubugari bwacyo ni kilometero 3. Gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 2 800. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 764. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri metero 65. Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo gifite ibirwa 10.
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo cyaremwe n'ibikorwa by'Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo. Amahindure yafunze ikibaya, nuko amazi araretama. Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo gitandukanywa n'Ikiyaga cya Burera n'agace k'ubutaka. Ako gace gafite ubugari bwa kilometero imwe.
Imigezi mito yisuka mu Kiyaga cya Ruhondo. Amazi y'ikiyaga asohokera mu mugezi wa Mukungwa, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba. Umugezi wa Mukungwa wisuka mu mugezi wa Nyabarongo. Amazi y'umugezi wa Mukungwa akoreshwa ku rugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa Mukungwa II.
Ikiyaga cya Burera kiri hejuru y'Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo ho metero 98. Iryo tandukaniro rikoreshwa mu gutanga amashanyarazi ku rugomero rwa Ntaruka. Umuyoboro uri munsi y'ubutaka uhuza ibiyaga byombi i Ntaruka. Uwo muyoboro wubatswe n'Ababiligi muri 1959.
Uburobyi n'ubuhinzi.
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo kibonekamo amafi. Abaturage baturiye ikiyaga basaba ko hakongerwa amafi ashyirwamo. Abahinzi kandi bakoresha amazi y'ikiyaga mu kuhira imyaka.
Kurengera ibidukikije.
Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo kiri mu gace ka Ramsar kitwa Rugezi-Burera-Ruhondo. Ako gace kashyizweho muri 2005. Igishanga cya Rugezi cyongera amazi y'Ikiyaga cya Burera n'Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo.
Ntaruka ni ho hantu nyamukuru ho kwinjira ku biyaga byombi. Abasura ibiyaga bahakorera ingendo mu bwato. Kuva ku kiyaga, babona ibirunga bya Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga. Muri 2024, abashoramari bashakaga kubaka ibikorwa by'ubukerarugendo ku nkengero z'Ikiyaga cya Ruhondo.

Jean N'diela Muntubile bakunze kwita "Santos Muntubile"(yavutse Ku ya 20 Ukuboza 1958) yavukiye i Léopoldville, akina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari umutoza wa congo.
Akina nku mukinnyi ukina hagati mu kibuga na rutahizamu, cyane cyane muri FC Sochaux.
Jean N'diela Muntubile uzwi ku izina rya " Santos ", yagaragaje nkushaka akazi muri FC Sochaux muri 1980. Ni umukinnyi ukina kuruhande wihuta, byihuse kandi byiza Nyuma y'igihembwe cya mbere muri ikipe ya Franche-Comté, yagurijwe muri 1981 - 1982 muri Olympique de Marseille, icyo gihe yakinnye mu cyiciro cya 2. Nyuma asubira i Sochaux, agumaho kugeza muri 1984. Afite imikino 50 n'ibitego 2 yatsinze mu cyiciro cya 1 hamwe na Sochaux. Yakomeje umwuga we mu Budage no mu Bufaransa. Yabaye umukinnyi wa congo hagati ya 1985 na 1990.
Mu myaka ya za 2000, yatangiye umwuga wo gutoza. Yakoze muri Tout Puissant Mazembe kuva 2005 kugeza 2007 ndetse no muri Daring Club Motema Pembe muri 2009. Ari ku buyobozi bw'ikipe y'igihugu yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona Nyafurika muri 2009. Ni umutoza w’igihugu cya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo inshuro nyinshi, cyane muri 2011 no muri 2013-2014.

Ishami ry’ibidukikije, amashyamba n’uburobyi ni rimwe mu mashami ya guverinoma y’Afurika yepfo. Ifite
inshingano zo kurengera, kubungabunga no guteza imbere ibidukikije n’umutungo kamere muri Afurika y'epfo.
iri shami ryashinzwe mu mwaka w'2019 rihuzwa n’ishami rishinzwe ibidukikije n’ibice by’amashyamba n’uburobyi bigize ishami ry’ubuhinzi, amashyamba n’uburobyi.
Amashami y’ishami rishinzwe ibidukikije ni:

Nelson Omba Munganga, (yavutse ku ya 27 Werurwe 1993) i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati hamwe n'ikipe yo muri Maroke ya MC Oujda.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe yo muri DR Congo, ku ya 6 Nzeri 2019, ahanganye na Kameruni. Uyu mukino watsinzwe n'amanota 0-2 ni umwe mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2015.
Muri Mutarama 2015, yakinnye mu cyiciro cya nyuma cy'igikombe cya Afurika cyabereye muri Gineya ya Ekwatoriya. Yitabiriye imikino ibiri muri iri rushanwa, na Cape Veride mu matsinda, hanyuma akina Congo muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza. DR Congo iri ku mwanya wa gatatu muri CAN, itsinze igihugu cyakiriye muri "ku mukino wa nyuma ubanza", nyuma yo kurata penariti.
Muri Mutarama 2016, yitabiriye Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika, yateguwe mu Rwanda. Akina imikino itanu muri iri rushanwa. Nyuma yaje kwitwara neza atsinda igitego cya mbere hamwe na DR Congo, na Angola mu matsinda. DR Congo yatsinze irushanwa itsinze Mali ku mukino wa nyuma, n'amanota ya nyuma ari 3-0.
Muri uwo mwaka, yitabiriye Igikombe cya COSAFA muri 2016. Yitabiriye imikino ibiri muri iri rushanwa, atsinda igitego muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza na Mozambike.

Jérémie Mumbere Mbusa ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga wa congo ukina nku mukinnyi ukina hagati muri AS Vita Club.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe yo muri DR Congo ku ya 18 Nzeri 2019, mu mukino wa gicuti yakinnye n'u Rwanda (batsindwa 2-3).
Hamwe na AS Vita Club, yitabiriye inshuro nyinshi muri Afrika Champions League.

Youssouf Mulumbu, (yavutse Ku ya 25 Mutarama 1987), yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka i Bumbu, muri komini mu mujyi wa Kinshasa muri Kongo, wahindutse umukinnyi wo hagati, kuri ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru wa FC Tanganyika akaba ari ikipe yo muri Kongo ifite icyicaro i Kalemie.
akiri muto n'umuryango we bagiye mu Bufaransa avuye muri Zayire (izina ryahoze ryitwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo), yakuriye mu mujyi wa Épinay-sous-Sénart, mu nkengero za Paris.
Yinjiye mu kigo cy’imyitozo cya PSG afite imyaka 13, yambikwa ikamba rya shampiyo w’Ubufaransa munsi y’imyaka 18 muri shampiyona yo muri 2005-2006. Ku ya 22 Ukwakira 2006, Guy Lacombe bituma akora bwa mbere muri Ligue 1, ku myaka 19 n'amezi 10, ahanganye na AJ Auxerre asinyana amasezerano ya mbere y'umwuga na PSG Ku ya 13 Ugushyingo y'umwaka umwe. Gusezerana, ni igihe gikurikirwa na Manchester United. Shampiyona irangiye, yatoranijwe mu ikipe y’Ubufaransa y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 yatsinze irushanwa rya Toulon.
Yakiriye ihitamwo rye rya mbere mu ikipe y'Ubufaransa ya Espoirs Ku ya 21 Kanama 2007 bakina na Ubutaliyani.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2007-2008, yatijwe nta mahitamo yo kugura Amiens SC muri Ligue 2 (imikino 29, igitego kimwe).
Yagarutse muri PSG muri shampiyona yo muri 2008-2009 yakinnye imikino mike ya UEFA. Ariko, akomeza kugarukira kumwanya wabasimbuye.

Landry Mulemo (wavutse ku ya 17 Nzeri 1986 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo n'ubw'Ububiligi. Yakinaga nka myugariro w'ibumoso.
Yakuriye mu ikipe ya Standard de Liège, ayitwarana shampiyona y'u Bubiligi mu 2008 no mu 2009. Yakiniye amakipe y'u Bubiligi y'abato, harimo iyitabiriye Imikino Olempike ya 2008 i Beijing, mbere yo guhitamo gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Kongo kuva mu 2011.
Mulemo yatangiriye mu bana ba Standard de Liège mu 1990, akomereza muri R Flémalle FC (1992–1995), agaruka muri Standard mu 1995. Kuva mu 2004 kugeza mu 2007, yatijwe muri K Saint-Trond VV, ahakina imikino isaga 60.
Agarutse muri Standard de Liège (2007–2010), yatwaranye na yo shampiyona y'u Bubiligi (2008, 2009) n'igikombe cya "Supercoupe" (2008, 2009). Muri Kamena 2010, yerekeje muri Bucaspor yo muri Turukiya. Nyuma yaho yakiniye KV Kortrijk (2011–2013, 2014–2015), Beitar Jerusalem muri Isirayeli (2013–2014), Kaposvári Rákóczi muri Hongiriya (2014), KF Vllaznia muri Alubaniya (2017) na Birkirkara FC muri Malita (2017–2018).
Muri Mutarama 2020, nyuma y'imyaka ibiri nta kipe afite, yasinyiye Union royale Namur Fosses-la-Ville, aba kapiteni wayo, ayivamo muri Kanama 2020.
Mulemo yakiniye ikipe y'u Bubiligi y'abatarengeje imyaka 21, yitabira Shampiyona y'u Burayi y'abatarengeje imyaka 21 yo mu 2007 mu Ubuholandi, ndetse n'Imikino Olempike yo mu 2008 i Beijing, aho u Bubiligi bwabaye ubwa kane. Ku ya 9 Ukwakira 2009, yahamagawe bwa mbere mu ikipe nkuru y'u Bubiligi ku mukino na Turukiya, ariko ntiyinjira mu kibuga.
Yifashishije amategeko mashya ya FIFA, ahitamo gukinira Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, nk'uko Joachim Mununga na Andréa Mbuyi-Mutombo babigenje. Yakiniye Kongo imikino 10 hagati ya 2011 na 2013, harimo umukino wo gushaka itike y'Igikombe cy'Isi na Swaziland ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 2011.
Mu 2021, yateguye i Kinshasa igikorwa cyo gushakisha impano z'abakiri bato ku bufatanye na Málaga CF yo muri Esipanye, naho mu 2022 abikora ku bufatanye na KV Kortrijk.

Rémi Mulumba, (yavutse Ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 1992) yavukiya i Abbeville mu Ubufaransa, Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo, ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati urinda.
Mulumba yatangiye umwuga we muri SC Abbeville. Muri Kanama 2006, yinjiye mu myaka wa 14 yatoranijwe muri Ligue de Picardie, ari kumwe na Florian Pinteaux hamwe na Birama Touré. Yinjiye muri Amiens SC muri 2008. Muri 2010, yinjiye muri FC Lorient.
Nyuma yinguzanyo ebyiri zagiye zikurikirana muriDijon, yongeye kugurizwa, kuriyi nshuro muri Auxerre muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-2015. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere ku ya 9 umunsi na AC Arles-Avignon (intsinzi 2-1).
Yahisemo gukinira Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kandi yemera guhamagarwa Kanama 2015 gukina umukino na republika ya centrefricaine ubara umunsi wa kabiri wo gushaka itike ya CAN yo muri 2017. Amaherezo ntashobora guhuzwa uwo munsi kubera ibibazo by'ubuyobozi ariko yubaha guhitamo kwe kwa mbere na Nigeriya Ku ya 8 Ukwakira 2015.
Ku ya 14 Kamena 2016, yiyandikishije mu bihe bibiri hamwe no muri Gazélec Ajaccio.
Yitabira igikombe cya mbere cy’Afurika muri Gaboni kuva Mutarama kugeza Gashyantare 2017.

Jackson Muleka, (Yavutse Ku ya 4 Ukwakira 1999) i Lubumbashi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo (DRC). Akina nka rutahizamu mu ikipe ya Beşiktaş JK. Yiswe akazina k'umuryango wa Facebook muri congo "sniper" yerekeza kuri ibi bitaramo hagati yu kwezi kwa Werurwe na Mata 2021 aho yatsinze ibitego hafi muri buri mukino wo muri Jupiler Pro League.
TP Mazembe (2017-2020).
Yatsinzwe n'ibyiciro byose by'ishuri ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Katumbi, amaherezo ni mu mpera z'umwaka wo muri 2016 nibwo umutoza Hubert Velud (icyo gihe wari umutoza wa Mazembe) yamwinjije mu bakozi b'iyi kipe.
Muleka yitoreza hamwe niyi kipe ariko atarakina, kugeza muri 2017 haje umutoza Pamphile Mihayo niho Muleka agaragara ku mpapuro z'umukino kandi akunguka mugihe cyo gukina.
Muri 2018, rutahizamu wa Mazembe mu gihe Ben Malango yakomeretse, Mihayo yizeye rutahizamu we ukiri muto nibwo impano ye yateye imbere.
Afite ibitego byinshi, haba muri Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru cyangwa muri Afurika muri Champions League.
Yarangije gutsinda ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona ya DR Congo n'ibitego 24 bityo aba abafatanya kwandika agahigo.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2019-2020, Muleka yarangije gutsinda ibitego byinshi muri Afurika muri Champions League n'ibitego 7 (ibitego 2 yatsinze Zamalek, ibitego 4 yatsinze Zesco United, igitego 1 yatsinze Primeiro do Agosto) bituma aba umwe mu bashakishwa cyane -inyuma yabakinnyi k'umugabane wicyo gihe.

Albert Mwanza Mukombo (yavutse ku ya 17 Ukuboza 1945 muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo apfa Ku ya 13 Ukwakira 2001) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nka myugariro.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Congo-Kinshasa icyo gihe yari Zayire, yakinnye imikino 21 (nta gitego yatsinze) hagati yo muri 1968 na 1976.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage, yakinnye imikino itatu: bakina na Sikotilande, Yugosilaviya na Burezile.
Yitabiriye kandi ibikombe bya Afurika muri 1968, 1972 na 1974. Yatsinze amarushanwa muri 1968 na 1974.

Pierre Kalala Mukendi, (Yavutse Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 1939 i Likasi hanyuma apfa Ku ya 30 Kamena 2015) i Johannesburg, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa congo (DRC) wahindutse umutoza.
Yari umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga muri congo (DRC), yitabiriye CAN muri 1965, atsinda ibitego bibiri. Ikipe ye isezerewe mu cyiciro cya mbere. Nyuma yakinnye CAN muri 1968, aho yatsinze igitego ku mukino wanyuma atsinda irushanwa.
Yatoje ikipe ya DR Congo muri 1992. Yayoboye abakinnyi ba congo mu gihe CAN muri 1992.
Yapfuye azize impyiko Ku ya 30 Kamena 2015 afite imyaka 75 i Johannesburg,muri Afurika y'Epfo.

Jean-Claude Mukanya (yavutse Ku ya 1 Gicurasi 1968) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga wumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DR Congo), wakinaga nka myugariro.
Yabaye akina imikino mpuzamahanga inshuro 49 muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (icyahoze ari Zaire), hagati ya 1991 na 1999.

Cyrille Mubiala Kitambala (Yavutse Ku ya 7 Nyakanga 1974 i Kinshasa)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri congo (DRC).
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo aho yatsinze igitego ku gihugu cyatsinze na Misiri, nubwo igihugu cye cyatsinzwe ibitego 4-1.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri 1998 muri CS Style du Congo, nyuma yinjira muri AS Dragons.
Mu 2000 yinjiye muri imwe mu makipe akomeye mu gihugu AS Vita Club imyaka itatu.
Muri 2003, yari afite ibyifuzo bya makipe nka Ajax Cape Town, Mamelodi Sundowns, n'izindi.
Amaherezo yaje gusinyira Ajax Cape Town aho yakinnye imikino 69 atsinda ibitego 7.
Bloemfontein Celtic FC.
Muri 2009, yasinyanye na Bloemfontein Celtic FC muri shampiyona imwe, akina imikino 13 atsinda ibitego 3.
Yitabiriye Igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2004 aho yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu mu itsinda.
Yitabiriye cyane igikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 2006 aho yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri mu itsinda inyuma ya Kameruni.
Muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza hagati ya DR Congo na Misiri. Yatsinze igitego kimwe nubwo yatsinzwe 4–1.
Nyuma ya marushanwa yarangije umwuga we mpuzamahanga yari yarakinnye mu mikino 21 yose nigitego 1.

Firmin Mubele Ndombe, (Yavutse Ku ya 17 Mata 1994), ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) ukina mu b'imbere.
Yageze ku mukino wa nyuma wa CAF Champions League muri 2014 hamwe na AS Vita Club, batsinzwe na ES Sétif yo muri Alijeriya. Mu iri rushanwa, yatsinze ibitego bitatu mu ikipe ya Kaizer Chiefs yo muri Afurika yepfo mu cyiciro cya nyuma.
Mu idirishya ryo kwimura impeshyi muri 2015 yimukiye muri Al Ahli SC.
Ku ya 30 Mutarama 2017, yimuriwe kuri Stade Rennes, basinyana amasezerano y'imyaka itatu n'igice.
Firmin yakinnye umukino wa mbere na Angers SCO, agaruka ku munota 70 mu mwanya wa Yoann Gourcuff.
Yatsinze igitego cya mbere mu mabara ye mashya yakinnye na Olympique Lyonnais kumunsi wa 31 wa Ligue 1. (1-1)
Ku ya 30 Mutarama 2018, yatijwe muri Toulouse FC kugeza shampiyona irangiye ahitamo kugurwa.
Ku ya 7 Kamena 2018, yimuriwe kumugaragaro muri Toulouse FC.
Ku ya 2 Nyakanga 2019, yatijwe muri FK Astana igihembwe 1 ahitamo kugurwa.

Trésor Mputu Mabi, uzwi ku izina "Sekibi", (yavutse Ku ya 10 Ukuboza 1985 i Kinshasa (yahoze ari Zayire)), yahoze ari umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo wakinnye nkumukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga. Afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi beza b'Abanyekongo mu bihe byose, niba atari byiza, ndetse n'umwe mu bakinnyi beza bakina ku mugabane wa Afurika.
Mu 2007, yavumbuwe na TP Mazembe, Igikombe cya CAF na CAF Champions League, aho yambitswe umudali rya mbere ry'atsinze ibitego byinshi muri iri rushanwa n'ibitego 9, kandi yatowe nk'umukinnyi witwaye neza kurusha abandi ku isi na IFFHS (Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry’umupira w'amaguru &amp; Imibare) yo gutsinda ibitego 20 muri mpuzamahanga muri 2007. Muri 2009, yatsitse muri CAF Champions League hamwe na TP Mazembe kandi yitabira igikombe cy'isi cy'amakipe muri 2009 aho ikipe ye yarangije amarushanwa 6. umwanya hamwe n'imikino 2 no gu tsindwa 2. Muri Werurwe 2010, Mputu yatorewe kuba umukinnyi mwiza wa Afurika w'umwaka wao muri 2009, akina ku mugabane.
Uwahoze ari umuyobozi w'ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Claude Le Roy, asobanura ko Mputu aruta rutahizamu wa Kameruni, Samuel Eto'o we ubwe yatoje mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA muri 1998 ubwo yari umutoza wa Kameruni.
Inyungu ziva muri Arsenal nandi makipe.
Muri Ugushyingo 2007, Ikipe ya Arsenal yo mu Bwongereza, irerekana inyungu muri Mputu. Inyungu zemejwe na perezida w'ikipe ya TP Mazembe, Moïse Katumbi Chapwe na federasiyo y'umupira w'amaguru ya congo, batangaza ko iyimurwa ryegereje. Uyu mukinnyi rwose yagiye i Londres mu igeragezwa ry'iminsi icumi, umutoza wa Gunners, Arsene Wenger, avuga ko ari umukinnyi uhanga kandi ko byamushimishije kugeza ubu, ariko nta gukurikirana byakurikiranwe. Biragaragara ko yanzwe. Muri 2009, Standard de Liège yahisemo kumwimura, yabonye amasezerano niyi kipe ikomeye yo mu Bubiligi. perezida wa TP Mazembe yamubujije kwimurwa, amutegeka kutagenda.
Andi makipe yerekanye ko ashishikajwe n’umukinnyi, amakipe y’Ubwongereza (Blackburn, Hull City, Tottenham), ubufaransa (Nantes), ubugereki (Olympiakos), Tuniziya (Club Sportif Sfaxien, Espérance Sportif de Tunis, Club Africain, Étoile Sportif du Sahel) na Ikipe ya Turukiya Galatasaray.
Trésor Mputu niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi mu mateka y'ibikombe by'amakipe yo muri Afurika, afite ibitego 41. Ari imbere yu munyamisiri Mahmoud Al-Khatib, ibitego 37.

Paul-José M'Poku Ebunge, bakunze kwita Paul-José Mpoku akitwa kandi Polo Mpoku, (yavutse Ku ya 19 Mata 1992 i Kinshasa, muri Zayire) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo, Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri Incheon United.
Atangira umupira w'amaguru abatarabigize umwuga, muri Cornesse. Hamwe na Luis Pedro Cavanda runaka mu makipe ye.
Paul-José M'Poku yatangiye imyitozo muri Standard de Liège muri 2004. Mu 2008, yavuye mu Bwongereza yinjira mu kigo cy'amahugurwa cya Tottenham Hotspur. Nyuma y'ibihe bibiri hamwe nu rubyiruko rwiyi kipe, yatijwe umwaka umwe muri Leyton Orient.
Ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2011, yasubiye muri Standard de Liège aho yasinye amasezerano 4 y'umwuga.
Ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 2012, yatsinze igitego cya mbere ku mutuku m'ugihe cya Standard de Lierse, umukino Standard yatsinze ibitego 3-0
Ku ya 26 Gicurasi 2013, yasinyiye ibitego bitatu ye yambere yatsinze 7-0 na La Gantoise kumukino wibizamini byi Burayi.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2013-2014, yaturikiye rwose mu ikipe ya Liégeois, yitabira imikino hafi ya yose yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’Ababiligi, maze aba umunyembaraga mu ikipe ye, hamwe n’abakinnyi nka Michy Batshuayi by'umwihariko. Mu mpera zuyu mwaka wuzuye amarangamutima, M'poku azatsinda 12 mu mikino 49 yitabiriye. Standard izarangiza shampiyona ukurikira wu bubiligi, gusa ibuze umutwe.
Ni musaza wa Albert Sambi Lokonga, nawe umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru wa bigize umwuga.

Djo Issama Mpeko (yavutse Ku ya 30 Mata 1989 i Kinshasa, Zaire (ubu ni DR Congo)) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina iburyo inyuma kuri TP Mazembe. Yitoje mu ikipe ya Lumières Mbandaka no muri DC Motema Pembe. Muri 2011 yimuriwe muri As Vita Club yakinnye imikino 115 mu myaka 2 atsinda igitego kimwe. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2013, yasinyanye na Kaburscorp, muri Angola. Akina imikino 17 mu myaka 2 ariko azagu komereka. Muri 2015 yasinyanye na TP Mazembe.

Samuel Moutoussamy, (yavutse Ku ya 12 Kanama 1996 i Paris) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya FC Nantes.
Kuva muri Guadeloupe binyuze kuri se, Samuel Moutoussamy na we afite inkomoko i kongo binyuze kuri nyina.
Afite imyaka 8, yabanje gutekereza gukora siporo. Yashakaga kandi kwitoza jido kugirango yige kwirwanaho.
Mu 2003, yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri ikipe ya AS Meudon. Muri 2009, yinjiye muri INF Clairefontaine, imyaka ibiri mbere yo gutozwa. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2011-2012, Samuel Moutoussamy yageze i Lyon. Kuva muri shampiyona ya mbere, yagiye agaragara inshuro nyinshi hamwe na B bakina mu cyiciro cya kane.
Yarekuwe na Olympique Lyonnais, yinjiye muri FC Nantes muri 2016, ubwo yakinaga n'ikipe yabigenewe. Umwanditsi w ibihe bibiri byiza, cyane yatsinze ibitego bitanu, yinjiye mu makipe ya mbere muri 2017. Yajugunywe na Claudio Ranieri mu mukino wo kwishyushya mu Budage na Ingolstadt. Yakinnye umukino we wambere ku mugaragaro Ku ya 12 Kanama 2017 na Marseille kuri La Beaujoire, maze atsinda igitego cya mbere nku munyamwuga n'ikipe imwe Ku ya 28 Mata 2019 kuri Velodrome..
Ku ya 16 Nyakanga 2019, Samuel Moutoussamy yongereye amasezerano indi myaka ibiri na Canaries, amuhuza n'ikipe ya Nantes kugeza muri 2024.
Yakiriye itoranywa rye rya mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ku ya 10 Ukwakira 2019 mu mukino wa gicuti na Alijeriya.

Anthony Mossi (Yavutse Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 1994 i Paris) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo Akina nk'u muzamu muri Neuchâtel Xamax FCS.
Yakinnye umukino wa mbere mpuzamahanga na DR Congo Ku ya 28 Gicurasi 2018 bakina na Nigeriya.

Cédric Mongongu (yavutse 22 kamena 1989 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nka myugariro wo hagati.
Yageze kare cyane mu Bufaransa avuye muri Zayire, Mongongu afite ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo. Ashishikaye cyane nu mupira w'amaguru, yatangiye gukinira hariya mu ikipe ya Garenne-Colombes (Hauts-de-Seine) mbere yo kwinjira mu ikipe ya Racing club de France afite imyaka 13, arangije ahakorerwa imyitozo ya AS Monaco muri 2005 hanyuma agaragara bwa mbere muri L1 muri 2007. Yamaze gutorwa mu izamu hagati, yahuye n’Ubufaransa A 'mu mukino wa gicuti wabereye muri Espagne. Muri Monaco, ntarashyirwa mu mwanya runaka. Akenshi yakoreshwaga hagati, Ricardo yatangiye kuyikoresha mu kwirwanaho kubera ubushobozi bwayo bwo ku zamura. Akoreshwa kandi nk'inyura iburyo, asimburana na François Modesto, aho atoroheye cyane kuruta muri myugariro wo hagati.
Kugira ngo yishyure ibikomere, yagaragaye gake cyane nka myugariro wo hagati. Amaherezo Mongongu yatsinze mu izamu ryo hagati, ihura na Nicolas N'Koulou imwe mu mpeta zo hagati mu Burayi.
Mu ntangiriro za shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, Cédric yagumanye icyizere cy'umutoza mushya wa ASM, wamuhuje na Sébastien Puygrenier muri myugariro wo hagati. Yasinyanye amasezerano ya mbere y'umwuga y'imyaka 3. Yakinnye imikino 33 ya Ligue 1 muri shampiyona yamubonye asohoka. Birahumuriza kandi ni byiza gutangira, yanga abamurwanya. Umukino we mwiza rwose niwo wakinnye na Olympique de Marseille kuri Vélodrome. Imyitwarire ye myiza cyane yatumye aba ku gipangu cy'amakipe akomeye harimo na AC Milan.
Amaherezo yahisemo gukomeza amarangamutima ya Monegasque. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere wa shampiyona yo muri 2010-2011 i Lyon ariko nyuma yaje gutakaza umwanya kubera imvune nimyitwarire ye.

Benjamin Mokulu (yavutse Ku ya 11 Ukwakira 1989 i Buruseli) ni umukinnyi ufite ubwenegihugu bw'umubiligi, umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo Yahindutse muri ravenna calcio.
Amaze gukina mu makipe atandukanye y'urubyiruko mu Bubiligi, amaherezo yahisemo igihugu cye, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ihitamo rya mbere ryabonetse Ku ya 9 Gashyantare 2011 gukina na Gaboni. Yatsindiye Ballon d'or muri 2012, 2013 na 2015.
Ku 1 Nzeri 2014, yinjiye muri Ligue 1 na SC Bastia ku ntizanyo mu gihembwe kimwe, ahitamo kugurwa. Yegereye Sir Alex Fergusson gukinira Manchester United nyuma yicyo gihembwe. Azagabanuka kandi azakina iminota 110 gusa muri myunda wa Bastia mbere yuko KV Mechelen amuha muri AS Avellino, ikipe ya Serie B yo mu Butaliyani, aho yiyemeje kugeza muri 2017.

Saio Ernest Mokili Yenga yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) wo mu mwaka wa 1960 na 1970.
Umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Congo-Kinshasa, yitabiriye AFCON muri 1968, atsinda igitego yatsinze Gana kandi atsinda irushanwa.
Icyo gihe ni umutoza wa DR Congo muri 1997, mu buryo budasanzwe.

Wilfred Moke Abro, (Yavutse Ku ya 12 Gashyantare 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguruukomoka muri congo i Kinshasa. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya MKE Ankaragücü.
Wilfred Moke yitabira Europa League hamwe na m'akipe Steaua Bucharest na Konyaspor.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo Ku ya 5 Nzeri 2017, kurwanya Tuniziya. Kunganya (2-2) biri mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi muri 2018.
Yatoranijwe na Florent Ibenge kugirango azitabira CAN muri 2019. Ikipe ye yakuweho na Madagasikari kuri penariti.

Gaston Mobati (Yavutse Ku ya 4 Nzeri 1961 i Léopoldville apfa Ku ya 13 Gicurasi 1995) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru Ukomoka muri Zayire wakinaga nka rutahizamu.ku kirwa cya Reunion.
Yavutse Ku ya 4 Nzeri 1961 i Kinshasa, muri Kongo, Gaston Mobati wahoze ari rutahizamu arimo kwitoreza muri iki gihugu, mu ikipe ya AS Dragons i Bilima. Yatoranijwe mu ikipe yi gihugu mu basirikare bato, yahise ashakishwa na LOSC. Yatijwe ageze muri 1986/1987 muri Montceau Les Mines muri D2, Mobati yakinnye imikino 7 gusa atsinda ibitego 2. Agaruka i Lille muri 1987, Mobati yakinnye bwa 1 D1 na LOSC, Ku ya 17 Ukwakira 1987 bakina na Stade Lavallois. Yize ubucuruzi umwaka wa mbere hafi ya Cyriaque Didaux, Guy Lacombe, Jean-Pierre Meudic, itozwa na Georges Heylens. Muri 1987/1988, yagize ibihe byiza, ibitego 10 muri D1 na 3 muri Coupe de France, bizakomeza kuba umwaka mwiza w'umwuga we. Yahujije ibihe bikurikira hafi ya Angloma, Boli, Pelé, ntagitsinda amanota menshi. Ku buryo muri 89/90, LOSC iyobowe na Jacques Santini yamuretse anyerera mu myitozo. Mobati yambaraga umwenda wa Dogues inshuro 74 muri D1 (ibitego 19) na 16 muri Coupe de France (ibitego 8) kuva 1987 kugeza 1990. Yerekeje mu Bugereki muri Ethnikos Le Piraeus muri 1990, asubira mu Bufaransa muri 90/91 i Guingamp. Nyuma y'imikino 11 (ibitego 2) hamwe na En Avant de Guingamp, yarangije shampiyona muri AS Beauvais (imikino 2 yakinnye). Muri 1991/1992, yagumye muri ikipe ya Picard ariko nta mukino n'umwe yakinnye, amanika abambari be muri 1992, afite imyaka 31.
Gaston Mobati yapfuye Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 1995 ku kirwa cya Reunion. Umuhungu we Alphonse, wanyuze mu kigo cy’amahugurwa cya Toulouse, na we yagerageje umwuga w’umupira w'amaguru wahagaritswe muri 2008, kubera ko utaragera ku rwego rwo hejuru ugereranije na CFA n’igihugu.

Miché Mika, (Yavutse ku ya 16 Nzeri 1996 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri TP Mazembe.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ku ya 10 Mutarama 2016, mu mukino wa gicuti yakinnye n'u Rwanda (gutsindwa 1-0).
Yitabiriye nyuma ya Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2016 yateguwe mu Rwanda. Muri iri rushanwa, akina imikino itatu. DR Congo yatsinze irushanwa itsinze Mali ku mukino wa nyuma, 3-0.

Pamphile Mihayo Kazembe (yavutse Ku ya 17 Nzeri 1976 i Lubumbashi) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC) Akina nku mukinnyi wo hagati cyangwa myugariro wo hagati. Kugeza ubu ni umutoza wa TP Mazembe n'umutoza wungirije w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni se w'abana 4.

Christopher Nzay Mfuyi (Yavutse Ku ya 3 Nyakanga 1989)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo wavukiye i Geneve, mu Busuwisi. Yakinaga nka myugariro wo hagati hamwe na FC Stade Lausanne Ouchy.
Christophe Mfuyi yagaragaye bwa mbere mu mwuga mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy’Ubusuwisi hamwe na Servette FC muri 2007-2008. Yatijwe muriikipe ya Sportif Chênois mu cyiciro cya gatatu muri shampiyona ikurikira mbere yo gusubira i Geneve muri 2009-2010. Mu mpeshyi yo muri 2010 yasinyanye na Valenciennes Football Club aho yatangiriye bwa mbere ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2010, muri Coupe de la Ligue yakinnye na Boulogne.
Ku ya 21 Kamena 2012, yagarutse mu ikipe ye yitoreza muri Servette FC.

Mpangi Merikani (yavutse Ku ya 4 Mata 1967 i Kinshasa) icyo gihe muri Repubulika ya Kongo-Kinshasa, uyu munsi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru muri Kongo (DRC), wakinnye nk'u muzamu, mbere yo kuba umutoza. Umuhungu we, Jonathan Bolingi Mpangi, na we ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye hagati muri 1984 na 1996.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 1988, 1992 na 1996. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza aya marushanwa muri 1992 na 1996.
Yakinnye kandi imikino itatu ibara icyiciro kibanza cy'igikombe cy'isi.

Ardiles-Waku Menga, (yavutse Ku ya 28 Nzeri 1983 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ukina nka rutahizamu.
Menga yakuriye mu Budage. Yatangiye umwuga we wumwuga muri 2001 hamwe na VfL Osnabrück, aho yatsindiye ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona yo muri 2006-2007 n'ibitego 15.
Kugeza ubu afite amahitamo y gukinira Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Tueba Menayane (yavutse ku ya 13 Werurwe 1963 i Kinshasa, icyo gihe hari muri Repubulika ya Kongo-Kinshasa, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo (DRC), wakinnye nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Tueba Menayane yakinnye imikino igera kuri 169 atsinda ibitego 8 mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Porutugali hagati muri 1986 na 1993. Hamwe n'ikipe ya Benfica Lisbon, yitabiriye Igikombe cy'Uburayi cya Champion mu ikipe.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye hagati muri 1988 na 1992.
Ari mu itsinda ryatoranijwe mu gihe CAN yo muri 1988 na 1992. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza aya marushanwa muri 1992.

Andrea Mbuyi-Mutombo, (Yavutse Ku ya 6 Kamena 1990 i Buruseli) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga mu umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati mu kibuga mu ikipeya ikipe RNK Split.
Andréa Mbuyi-Mutombo yatangiye umupira w'amaguru mu makipe y'urubyiruko ya RSC Anderlecht. Muri 2006, yinjiye muri FC Bruxelles. Nyuma yu mwaka umwe, yasinyiye muri Portsmouth, ikipe yari yaramushakishije.
Hanyuma yagurijwe kuri SV Zulte Waregem Ku ya 22 Kanama 2008.
Yatsinze igitego cya mbere kuri Zulte Waregem, mu mukino na Mechelen, hashize iminota mike akandagiye mu kibuga. Yatsinze igitego cya kabiri mu mukino ukurikira na Tubize.
Nyuma y'amezi atandatu gusa i Zulte, imikino 14 no gutsinda ibitego bitatu, asubira muri Portsmouth mu gihe ya gombaga kuguma kugeza muri Kamena. Mu byukuri, ikipe ntiyigeze ishima imyifatire ye.
Ku ya 19 Kamena 2009, yasi nye amasezerano y'imyaka 2 na Standard de Liège. Muri 2011, ntabwo yinjiye muri gahunda z'umutoza José Riga, yavuye mu ikipe ya Liège yinjira muri Cercle de Bruges muri shampiyona. Byakoreshejwe cyane mu gihe cya shampiona, amasezerano ye ntabwo yongerewe. Yahise yerekeza muri Korowasiya, aho yinjiye mu ikipe ya HNK Rijeka.
Muri 2015, yakoreye urubanza muri AJ Auxerre ariko ntiyagumaho nyuma yuru.
Nyuma yigihe cyiza mu ikipe ya Scottish club Inverness, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Korowasiya RNK Split.
Yavukiye mu Bubiligi, yahisemo guhitamo Abanyekongo mu ntangiriro zo muri 2010 agamije kwambara umwenda "w'ingwe". Yanze rero ubwenegihugu bw'Ububiligi kuko nk'uko ingingo ya 10 y'Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ibivuga, “Ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo ni bumwe kandi bwihariye. Ntishobora gufatirwa hamwe nizindi zose ” de la famille/LIVRE I DE LA NATIONALITE.htm 1.

Mbala Mbuta (yavutse Ku ya 7 Mata 1985) ni umutoza muri wa congo (DRC) uvuka i Kinshasa, muri Kongo (DRC).
Muri FC Les Star de Kinshasa niho yavumbuwe. Bidatinze yinjiye muri DC Motema Pembe. Ikipe ye yegukanye igikombe cya congo muri 2002 ndetse na shampiona ya Kinshasa, ibikombe byinshi bya shampiyona ya Kinshasa. Yatsindiye ibikombe 2 bya muri wa Kongo mu myaka ibiri yakurikiyeho ndetse n'indi shampiyona ya Kinshasa mbere yo kuva muri iyi kipe. Amaze gutsinda byinshi muri DC Motema Pembe (DCMP), yageze muri Isiraheli muri 2004 mu gihe kitari gito ku nguzanyo. Yinjiye mu ikipe ya Hapoel Tel-Aviv, yamazeyo amezi atandatu mbere yo kugwa mu Burayi aho azakinira mu Busuwisi muri Yverdon-Sport FC, iyi kipe yazamutse mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’Ubusuwisi. Ntabwo azwi n’abanyaburayi, ariko asanzwe ari inyenyeri mu gihugu cye. Muri 2006, ikipe ye, Yverdon-Sport FC, yamanuwe mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy’Ubusuwisi (Challenge League). Zurich Grasshopper noneho ihitamo kugura uyu mukinnyi utanga ikizere cyane. Ku ya 20 Kanama 2014, SO Cholet iratangaza ko yashakishije umukinnyi muri shampiyona itaha.

Ekofa Mbungu (yavutse ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 1948 icyo gihe muri Kongo y'Ububiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa Kongo (DRC), wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
