Ilombe “Pele»Mboyo, (yavutse Ku ya 27 Mata 1987 i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wumubiligi uri mpuzamahanga ukina muri Royal Excelsior Virton nka rutahizamu. Ni urubanza rw’Ababiligi rwo gusubira mu buzima busanzwe kuva yongeye gukina umupira w'amaguru nyuma atoranyirizwa mu ikipe y'igihugu nyuma yo gukatirwa igihano cy'igifungo. Icyakora, kugerageza kwimukira mu Bwongereza byavanyweho kubera ibyifuzo by’abanyamigabane.
Ilombe Mboyo yavukiye i Kinshasa ageze mu Bubiligi akiri umwana, yavumbuye umupira w'amaguru muri Zellik Sport (1993-1997), nyuma yimukira muri Sporting d'Anderlecht afite imyaka igera ku 10 (1997-2001). Nyuma y'imukiye muri SC Eendracht Aalst (2001-2002) hanyuma yerekeza muri FC Bruges (2002-2005). Nyuma yinjiye muri Sporting de Charleroi aho yatangiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya mbere muri Ukuboza 2008.
Nyuma yimukiye muri KV Kortrijk muri 2010-2011 hanyuma asinyana na La Gantoise muri 2011. Biteganijwe ko azinjira mu ikipe y’Ubwongereza Norwich City Football Club mu ntangiriro zo muri 2013, cyangwa akazasubira muri Anderlecht. Ku ya 7 Kanama 2013, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka 4 na KRC Genk. Igiciro cyo kwimurwa kingana na miliyoni 4.7 z'amayero, amateka ya club ya Limburg!
Ku ya 8 Ukwakira 2012, nyuma y'imvune ya Romelu Lukaku, yahamagawe kugeza kuri shitani itukura na Marc Wilmots ku mikino yo muri 12 na16 ; Ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2012 muri Seribiya no kurwanya Scotland. Iyi mikino ikinwa mu rwego rwo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi cya FIFA muri 2014. Arazi guhitamo kwe kwa mbere kurwanya Scotland kuri16 octobreKu ya 16 Ukwakira.
Ilombe Mboyo yakinnye umukino wo guhitamo " Ingwe ”ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mukino wa gicuti wahuzaga Gambiya na DRC (3-0) i Banjul Ku ya 10 Kanama 2011, iyobowe na Robert Nouzaret. Kuva icyo gihe ntabwo yahamagawe mu ikipe ya Kongo.
Ilombe Mboyo yageze mu Bubiligi akiri umwana. Ni umuhungu wa Ilombe Mboyo, wahoze ari perezida uhuza na AS Vita Club.

N'Dinga Philippe Mbote Amily (yavutse Ku ya 11 Nzeri 1966 i Kinshasa, icyo gihe muri Repubulika ya Kongo-Kinshasa, uyu munsi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru muri Kongo, wakinnye nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Vitória Guimarães, yakinnye imikino 285 atsinda ibitego bigera 16 mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Porutugali hagati ya 1986 na 1996. Yitabira iyi kipe mu gikombe cya UEFA.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye hagati ya 1988 na 1998.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika cyo muri1992, 1994 na 1996. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza amarushanwa buri gihe.

Ishyamba rya Kakamega ni ishyamba rikunda kugwamo imvura nyinshi riherereye mu ntara ya Kakamega na Nandi mu gihugu cya Kenya, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'umurwa mukuru Nairobi, rikaba kandi hafi y'umupaka wa Kenya na Uganda.
Ishyamba rya Kakamega riri ku butaka bufite hagati ya metero 1500 na 1600 z'ubutumburuke. Riri mazi y'uruzi rwa Isiukhu na Yala, izo nzuzi zombi zinyura mu ishyamba ry Kakamega mbere yo kwisuka mu kiyaga cya Victoria.
Ishyamba ririmo ibigega bifite kilometero kare 238, munsi ya kimwe cya kabiri cyacyo rikaba risigaye ari ishyamba kavukire. Mu majyaruguru y’ishyamba ni hegitari 4,468 habaye Ikigo cy’igihugu cy 'ishyamba rya Kakamega, gihabwa imiterere y’amashyamba y’igihugu mu 1985. Mu majyaruguru gusa ni ishyamba rya Kisere. Mu mashyamba yose harimo uruhererekane rw'ibyatsi, rufite ubunini kuva ku rugero rwa 1 kugeza kuri 50.
Ishyamba rya Kakamega riratohagiye kandi rigwamo imvura cyane, ugereranije rigira 1200 mm - 1700 mm y'imvura ku mwaka. Imvura ni nyinshi cyane muri Mata na Gicurasi, hamwe na Kamena irimo izuba gato. Mutarama na Gashyantare ni amezi abamo izuba. Ubushyuhe burahoraho mugihe cyumwaka, hagati ya dogere selesiyusi 20 na 30.
Ibinyabuzima bitandukanye.
Ishyamba riri mu kibaya cya Victoria-savanna mosaic ecoregion. Ibimera n’ibinyabuzima byo muri iryo shyamba birimo amoko menshi ajyanye n’amashyamba agwamo imvura kenshi yo mu karere ka Gineya-Congoliya, aherereye mu burengerazuba mu kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Kongo.
Ibimera biboneka muri parike harimo amwe mu mashyamba akomeye kandi yoroheje yo muri Afurika: icyayi cya Elgon "(Olea welwitschii)", inkwi zitukura "(Prunus africana)", umunuko wera, ubwoko bwinshi bwa croton, na "Pouteria altissima". Hariho ubwoko 380 bwanditse bw'ibimera. Ibi birimo amoko 150 y'ibiti n'ibihuru, n'ubwoko 170 bw'ibimera by'indabyo harimo amoko 60 ya orchide ifite amoko 9 aboneka muri iri shyamba gusa.
Ishyamba rizwi cyane ku nyoni zaryo, amoko y’inyoni 367 Nibura inyoni 9 ntizisangwa ahandi.
Inyamaswa z’inyamabere ziboneka muri parike zirimo ingurube yo mu gihuru, duikers, igihuru, otter yo muri Afurika itagira clawless, mongoose, igiti kinini cy’amazi yo muri Afurika, ibisimba, pangoline, pcoline, amababi na primates zitandukanye zirimo inkende y'ubururu, inkende itukura, inkende ya De Brazza, baboon, potto na rimwe na rimwe inguge. Ingwe yagiye ivugwa rimwe na rimwe, ariko yagaragaye bwanyuma mu 1991.
Ibimera n’ibinyabuzima byo mu ishyamba rya Kakamega ntabwo byigeze byigwa cyane.
Igice cyo mu majyepfo y’ishyamba rya Kakamega, sitasiyo y’ishyamba ya Isecheno iyobowe n’ishami ry’amashyamba rya Kenya nicyo gikorerwamo cyane mu ubukerarugendo. Hari igiti kizwi cyane kitwa Mama Mtere, igiti cy'amateka ni igiti gifotorwa cyane mu ishyamba rya Kakamega, hari n' ibindi biti by'imitini.
Ubukerarugendo rw iryo shyamba rwashimishije abantu bakomeye barimo Ambasaderi w’Amerika ucyuye igihe muri Kenya Robert Godec warisuye muri Mata 2018 atangazwa n'ubwiza bwaryo.

Igishanga cya Rurambi kiri mu karere ka Bugesera kiri ku buso bwa hegitari 1000 kikaba gihingwamo umuceri n’ibigori, biteganyijwe ko kizongera ubukungu muri ako karere kuko kizajya gitanga umusaruro ugera kuri Toni 9600 z’umuceri.
Ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi n’umushinga ugamije guteza imbere ubuhinzi mu karere ka Bugesera (PADAB) bamaze gutunganya iki gishanga kikaba kizatangira gutanga umusaruro yuri mwaka. iki gishanga cyari cyuzuyemo urufunzo, mu gihe cy’itumba kikuzura amazi aturutse muri Nyabarongo. Hakaba hatangiye kubakwa imiyoboro n’urugomero ruzajya rwifashishwa mu gukamura igishanga igihe amazi ya Nyabarongo yabaye menshi no kuhira igihe yabaye make.Umushinga wose wo gutunganya igishanga watwaye miliyari 13 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ku mushinga wose, ariko ku buso bw’igishanga buhingwaho kubutunganya byatwaye miliyari 7.5.
mu minsi mike iki gishanga kizaba cyatangiye gutanga umusaruro ugaragara. Duteganya ko nibura hegitari imwe izajya itanga umusaruro uri hagati ya toni esheshatu n’umunani kandi kigahingwa kabiri mu mwaka. Dufite icyizere ko mu mwaka igishanga cya Rurambi kizajya gitanga umusaruro wa toni 9600 by’umuceri.” Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ibivuye mu buhinzi kandi, mu karere ka Bugesera huzuye uruganda rwa “Mayange Rice Mill” rufite ubushobozi bwo gutonora toni 50 z’umuceri ku munsi.
Iki gishanga kimaze kuduteza imbere ku buryo butandukanye, twatangiye gukoreramo amafaranga mu mwaka wa 2010 none tumaze no kubonamo imirima yo guhingamo umuceri.Igishanga cya Rurambi ubuso bumaze guhingwa bugera kuri hegitari zisaga 300, abaturage bagihingamo bakaba bibumbiye mu makoperative ane.

Igishanga cya Nyabarongo Ubutaka Ni igishanga cya Leta, ni Ubutaka bwo mu gishanga cya Nyabarongo kimwe n’ubw’ibindi bishanga ni ubwa Leta. Ntibushobora kwegurirwa burundu abantu ku giti cyabo kandi nta wushobora kwitwaza ko abumaranye igihe kirekire ngo abwegukane.
Ibibazo byugarije igishanga cya Nyabarongo.
Nubwo igishanga cya Nyabarongo gifite akamaro cyugarijwe n’ibibazo binyuranye bishingiye cyane cyane ku mikoreshereze yacyo icyangiza, ikanduza amazi, ikanahungabanya urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ibyo bibazo bishingiye ahanini ku bikorwa by’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, ubucukuzi bwa kariyeri, ubwubatsi, imiturire, gutwika igishanga n’inkengero zacyo n’ibindi. Nyamara ibyinshi muri ibyo bikorwa birabujijwe cyangwa ababikora basabwa kubikorana ubwitonzi n’ubushishozi buteganywa n’amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga ibishanga mu Rwanda. Bamwe mu baturiye igishanga cya Nyabarongo barahinga bagasenya inkombe z’umugezi bakanatwika urufunzo ngo birukana inkende zibonera.

igishanga cy'Agatare mu Mirenge ya Ruhango na Bweramana mu karere ka Ruhango, bongeye guhabwa iki gishanga nyuma y'uko hari hashize imyaka 12 gihawe rwiyemezamirimo ariko akananirwa kukibyaza umusaruro.
Iki gishanga cy’Agatare kibarirwa mu byanya bikomye, mu rwego rwo kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Gikorwaho n’imirenge ya Butaro,Kivuye, Gatebe,Ruserabuye, Ruhunde na Ruhunde yo muri Ruhango na Nyankenke na Miyove yo muri Gicumbi Iki gishanga gifitiye igihugu akamaro kanini kuko aricyo soko y’amazi y’urugomero rw’amashanyarazi.

Mu guteza imbere ubuhinzi kuko butunze benshi mu Karere ka Gisagara hatoranyijwe ibihingwa bine byitabwaho kugira ngo abahinzi babashe kwihaza no gusagurira inganda n’amasoko.
Tumenye Ibihingwa byagombaga guhingwa.
Mu Karere ka Gisagara haboneka ibishanga bifite ubuso bugera kuri hegitali 5000. Muri byo hamaze gutunganywa hegitali 2500 harimo izigera ku 1500 zatunganyijwe mu myaka itandatu ishize.Mu guteza imbere ubuhinzi kuko butunze benshi mu Karere ka Gisagara hatoranyijwe ibihingwa bine byitabwaho kugira ngo abahinzi babashe kwihaza no gusagurira inganda n’amasoko.Ibyo bihingwa ni ibigori, umuceri, urutoki n’ibishyimbo.Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere bwashyize ingufu mu gutunganya ibishanga bituma umusaruro w’umuceri wiyongera.Muri gahunda yo kwigisha abahinzi guhinga kijyambere, gukoresha ifumbire mvaruganda n’imborera no gutera imbuto y’indobanure ndetse no gutunganya ibishanga ni byo byatumye umusaruro mu buhinzi wiyongera.ndetse no gukoresha neza amazi cyane mu bishanga ndetse no kuhira imusozi.Gutunganya ibishanga ni uburyo bwo gufata neza amazi, aho amazi ari make hakorwa uburyo bwo kuyongera, aho ari menshi akayoborerwa ahandi.Hari ibice bikibamo amazi menshi ku buryo ibigori n’ibishyimbo bitahera, no mu gihe cy’imvura hari ibice bitwarwa. Abahinzi bifuza uwabatunganyiriza igishanga neza.Umuyobozi w'Intara yamajyepfo mumwaka ushize yashishikarizaga abaturage bafite ibishanga kubikoresha neza, ariko bakanitabira kuhira kuko n’ubwo mu bishanga haba harimo amazi ntaba ari mu mirima imbere.
Gutunganya ibishanga byagize umusaruro.
Umusaruro wagiye uzamuka, mu mwaka 2015 abahinzi bezaga toni 4000 z’umuceri ariko ubu bageze kuri toni hafi ibihumbi 10. Icyo bifuza ni uko bageze kuri toni ibihumbi 20 kandi bifuza kuzabigeraho nibamara gutunganya ibishanga bisigaye.Mu bigori naho umusaruro wariyongereye kuko kuri ubu abahinzi beza toni 4 kuri hegitari imwe; naho ku bishyimbo bakeza toni 1,48.Mu bishanga biteganyijwe ko bizatunganywa harimo icyitwa Nyiramageni gihuza Imirenge ya Gikonko, Mamba na Ntyazo gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 600. Ikindi ni icya Ngiryi nacyo kiri gushakirwa ubushobozi kugira ngo gitunganywe.Gutunganya ibyo bishanga bizajyana no gushyiraho uburyo bwo kuhira imyaka ku misozi ibikikije.Mu bijyanye no kuhira imisozi hegitali 625 zuhiwe hakoreshejwe imashini muri iyi myaka itandatu ishize, naho hegitali hafi 2800 zishyirwaho amaterasi y’indinganire.Hubatswe ubwanikiro bw’ibigori 42 n'ubw’umuceri 28.Hubatswe uruganda rutunganya urwagwa n’umutobe mu bitoki rufite ubushobozi bwo kwakira toni zisaga 900 mu kwezi kumwe. Rugemura inzoga mu Turere twa Gisagara, Huye, Nyaruguru na Nyamagabe ku buryo ku kwezi rwinjiza amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 90Frw ajya mu baturage baruha ibitoki.Mu kwita ku musaruro hubatswe inganda zirimo urw’umuceri ruri mu Murenge wa Gikonko rutunganya toni zigera ku 7800; hubakwa n’urutunganya ibigori mo ifu.

Igishanga cya Gasuma, Abahinga mu bishanga bya Gasuma na Ruhoboba mu Murenge wa Simbi mu Karere ka Huye, barifuza gutunganyirizwa ibi bishanga ku buryo bajya babasha kubona amazi yo kuhira mu buryo bworoshye, bityo babashe kubibyaza umusaruro no mu gihe cy’impeshyi.
Dufite igishanga cya Gasuma tujya duhingamo imboga n’imbuto, ariko urebye ahanini mu mpeshyi nta mazi tuba dufite. Anyura hepfo, kuyifashisha ni ukujya kuyadaha.”Akomeza agira ati “Uwadushyiriraho umuyoboro uca hejuru y’imirima twabasha kubona amazi, tukajya duhinga no mu mpeshyi.

igishanga cy’Agatorove Ubundi kiri ku buso bwa hegitari 80, cyatunganyijwe mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari yashize. Uyu ni umwaka wa kabiri gihingwa. Igishanga cya gatorove, Ni igishanga abahinzi baturiye igishanga cy’Agatorove giherereye mu Murenge wa Mata mu Karere ka Nyaruguru, barishimira kuba cyaratunganyijwe bakanahabwamo imirima, ariko ubwanikiro bumwe bamaze kubakirwa ngo ntibuhagije.
Abagihingamo bavuga ko kugitunganya byatumye basigaye bahinga bakeza bakanasarura, by’umwihariko abatarakigiragamo imirima bakishimira ko na bo bahawemo aho guhinga. Iki gishanga cyari kibi cyane mbere y’uko gitunganywa. Twahingagamo bwa yisi, ibijumba, ibishyimbo n’ibindi. Nabwo kandi twahingaga mu gahande kamwe, ahandi ntihahingwe.
Ubwanikiro kandi ngo si ubw’ibigori gusa kuko bushobora kwanikwamo n’ibishyimbo, ndetse n’ibyumba bibwubakwamo bigashobora kubikwamo ifumbire y’imvaruganda, mu gihe abanyamuryango batarabasha kubyifashisha.

Dieudonné Mbokani Bezua, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Dieumerci Mbokani, (Yavutse Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 1985 i Kinshasa muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo)), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nka rutahizamu muri SK Beveren.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Iherezo ryu muryango wabana barindwi (bashiki bacu 2 nabavandimwe 5), abikesha izina rye rya mbere kubera ko nyina yategereje imyaka 8 kugirango amubone nyuma yo kuvuka kwa mukuru we.
Muri TP Mazembe niho Dieumerci Mbokani yaje mu bye. Mubyukuri, guhera ku ya 1 gihembwe, asanzwe ari mu bayobozi b'iyi kipe. Bidatinze, yari umwe mu bagize ikip y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu gihe cyo kwitegura CAN yo mu Misiri kugeza umukino uzahuza Tuniziya. Kubwamahirwe macye, ntiyatoranywa muri 23 bazitabira iri rushanwa. Mbokani arasigaye, hagati aho, yari ntagereranywa arangije azakomeza gtanga akazi keza kandi nini kuri TP Mazembe.
Mu idirishya ryo kwimura impeshyi yi gihembwe cyo muri 2006-2007, yerekeje i Burayi, muri Anderlecht ku ntizanyo. Iyi kipe yamuhaye amahirwe make yo kwigaragaza kuko Franky Vercauteren yahisemo gukina Nicolás Frutos na Mohammed Tchité. Shampiyona irangiye, yakinnye byinshi kubera kubera imiterere mibi ya Mbo Mpenza n'imvune ya Mémé Tchite.
Muri kamena 2007, yinjiye muri Standard de Liège yambara numero 9 (numero yabataka). Muri shampiyona ye yambere yuzuye, yatsinze ibitego 15 maze ashyiraho bombi buzuzanya kandi bakorana neza na Seribiya Milan Jovanović (ibitego 31 hagati yabo muri 2007/08). Yabaye shampiyo w’Ububiligi kandi yamamaye ku bwumvikane kubera uburyo bwe butangaje ndetse n’igihe cyo mu kirere.
Igihe cyakurikiyeho, yakomeje gutsinda ibitego byingenzi, cyane na Everton kumwanya wa 1 UEFA (2-2), cyangwa na Sevilla FC (1-0). Muri shampiyona, Mbokani yatsinze ibitego 4 (ahanganye na Dender, Westerlo, Germinal Beerschot na Cercle Bruges), atsinda ibitego 16, arangiza uwatsinze ibitego byinshi aza ari uwa kabiri (inyuma ya Joseph Akpala) na gatandatu ku rutonde rwa Golden Boot 2008. Mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 2008-09, Stuttgart yatanze miliyoni 15 z'amayero mu ikipe ya Liège. Umukinnyi yifuza gusubiza neza kuri iki cyifuzo ariko ikipe irashaka gukomeza rutahizamu wayo. Yemera ko “yashinje inkoni. Ntabwo nari meze neza mu mutwe ".
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, yatangiye shampiyona neza atsinda ibitego bitatu mu mikino umunani ariko nyuma yaje gusinzira nabi ariko akomeza gushyigikirwa na László Bölöni arangiza shampiyona atsinda ibitego 4 bito ku isaha, bidakwiriye ibihe byashize.

Kapela Mbiyavanga, (yavutseKu ya 12 Gashyantare 1976 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukina umupira wamaguru wa congo, ubu ni umutoza wa União SC do Uíge yo muri Angola, ukina muri Girabola
Mu 1994, icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 18, yinjijwe muri DC Motema Pembe, ikipe iri mu gihugu cye kavukire. Yakinnye ibihe bitanu byose hamwe niyi kipe, atwara Linafoot eshatu, n'igikombe cyabatwaye igikombe muri 1994.
Amaze kuva muri iyo kipe mu idirishya ryo kwimura imbeho 2000, yinjiye muri Atlético Pétroles Luanda yo muri Angola. Mu mwaka wa mbere, yatsindiye Girabola n'i gikombe cya Angola. Yasubiyemo iyi mikorere shampiyona ikurikira. Mu 2002, yongeyeho Supercopa ya Angola.
Yageze kandi muri iyi kipe muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri CAF Champions League muri 2001. Yagaragaye cyane muri iri rushanwa, atsinda igitego mu matsinda yakinnye n'ikipe yo mu Misiri ya Al Ahly, nyuma inshuro ebyiri muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza n'ikipe yo muri Afurika y'Epfo ya Mamelodi Sundowns.
Muri 2005, yatrijwe igihembwe mu ikipe ya Maritzburg yo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yagurijwe kandi muri 1 ° de Agosto muri 2007. Mu 2008, yimuriwe muri Kabuscorp SC, club aho yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru nk'umukinnyi muri 2010.
Muri uwo mwaka, yabaye umutoza wungirije wa Kabuscorp SC, umwanya yari afite umwaka umwe. Yaje kuba umutoza wa União SC do Uíge muri shampiyona ya 2011/2012. Yongeye kuba umutoza w'iyi kipe muri Gicurasi 2014.

Hugues Bedi Mbenza (Yavutse ku ya 11 Nzeri 1984 i Kinshasa) numupira wamaguru mpuzamahanga wa congo Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Hugues yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri 2006, muri AC Mosi. Muri 2007, yinjiye muri TP Mazembe. Muri 2009, yatsindiye CAF Champions League na CAF Supercup. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2009, yatsinze igitego batsinzwe Pohang Steelers ku mupira yari ahawe na Trésor Mputu. Mu mwaka wo muri 2010, yatsindiye igikombe cya Shampiyona na Espérance de Tunis. Mu gikombe cyisi cya ikipe 2010 yongeye gutsinda na CF Pachuca.
Mu 2011, yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Bubiligi ya RSC Anderlecht aho yakinnye imikino 14.
Muri 2013, yinjiye muri Club Africain de Tunisiya yakinnye imikino 36 atsinda ibitego 2.
Muri Kamena 2015, nta masezerano, yinjiye muri FC Renaissance du Congo.

Chancel Mbemba (yavutse ku ya 8 Kanama 1994 i Kinshasa, muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo))ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Yakinnye kuva muri Nyakanga 2022 muri Olympique de Marseille nka myugariro wo hagati.
Inkomoko y'umuryango.
Chancel Mbemba yakuriye i Kinshasa mu muryango w'abana 9. Nyina Antoinette ni umukinnyi wa basketball warinze amabara ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mbemba yize ibyamashanayarazi, nyuma yumwuga we, bishoboka ko yakwitoza muri uru rwego.
RSC Anderlecht (2013-2015).
Yerekanwe na RSC Anderlecht, yageze i Buruseli muri 2011 aho yakinnye bwa mbere n'ikipe yizeye ya Sporting Anderlecht.
Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2013, ku munsi wa mbere wa shampiyona yo muri 2013–14, Mbemba yatangiye gukinira Anderlecht na Lokeren, kimwe na mugenzi we Youri Tielemans. Nubwo baje gutsindwa, buriwese yashoboraga kubonako Chancel afite impano. Yakomeje guhuza imikino mu izamu hamwe na Cheikhou Kouyaté, asubiza Bram Nuytinck ku ntebe icyarimwe.
Ku ya 17 Nzeri 2013, yerekanye bwa mbere mu Burayi mu mukino wa Champions League wabereye i Lisbonne na Benfica.
Ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2013, yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu mabara ya Anderlecht ku kibuga cya RAEC Mons, nubwo ya shinzwe bwa mbere nku mukinnyi w'inyuma.
Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2013, yatsinze igitego kimwe rukumbi cy'umukino mu kibuga cya Racing Genk yemerera ikipe ye gutsinda intsinzi ikomeye mu guhatanira igikombe gikomeye.
Ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 2014 muri Champions League, yatsinze ibitego bibiri kuri Galatasaray bituma Anderlecht irangiza ku 3 mu itsinda ryabo kandi ikamara igihe cy'itumba ry’Uburayi.
Newcastle United (2015-2018).
Ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2015, Newcastle yemeje ko Chancel Mbemba ari umukinnyi wayo.
FC Porto (2018-2022).
Ku ya 23 Nyakanga 2018, yasinyanye amasezerano kugeza mu 2022 na FC Porto.
Muri 2020, yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona ya Porutugali ndetse n’igikombe cya Porutugali, cyane yatsinze ibitego bibiri ku mukino wa nyuma.

Blaise Lelo Mbele, (Yavutse Ku ya 10 Kanama 1987 i Kalemie) avukira muri DR Congo, ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru wa congo ukina nka rutahizamu muri ikipe ya Al-Ahli Manama.
Nyuma yo kwinjira muri CS Sfaxien muri 2007, yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 3 muri Arabiya Sawudite na Al-Hilal FC mu Ukuboza 2007. hari Ihererekanyabubasha rye rigera kuri miliyoni 1 yama yero. Lelo yinjiye mu ikipe yo muri Sudani ya Al Hilal Omdurman muri 2009; ikiguzi cyo kwimurwa kibarirwa ku ma yero 500 000 . Nyuma yakinnye muri Libiya (Al Nasr Benghazi), Maleziya (Selangor FA) na Turukiya (Şanlıurfaspor). Muri 2012, yasinyanye n’ikipe ya Alijeriya yitwa Mouloudia Club d'Alger yamugurije shampiyona irangiye muri CA Batna. Mu 2014, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Angola, Petro Atlético.

Igishanga cya Rwasave kiri hagati y’akarere ka Gisagara n'akarere Huye.
Tumenye Igishanga cya Rwasave.
Abahinzi bahinga muri icyi gishanga kizwi ku izina rya Rwasave gihuriweho n’uturere twa Gisagara na Huye mu mwaka 2013 bavugaga ko nyuma y’uko ubuyobozi bwayoboraga koperative ihinga umuceri buvuyeho bunyereje amafaranga angana na miliyoni 29 byatumye batangira gukorera mu gihombo. Basabaga ko inzego zibishinzwe zabakurikirana vuba icyo kibazo ibikorwa byabo by’ubuhinzi bikongera kugenda neza nk’uko byahoze mbere.Ubuyobozi bw’iyi koperative bwavugaga ko nubwo iki kibazo kimaze igihe cy’umwaka n’amezi 6, cyashyikirijwe inkiko.Iyo koperative yakorera ibikorwa byayo by’ubuhinzi k’ubutaka bufite hegitali 103 buri mu gishanga cya Rwasave; Iki gishanga kikaba gihuriweho n’imirenge 2 yo mu karere ka Gisagara ariyo Save na Kibirizi n’ ibiri yo mu karere ka Huye, Mbazi na Ngoma.
Umutekano munzira zambukiranya utwo turere.
Igishanga cya Rwasave kigira inzira zikinyuramo zambukiranya utu turere twombi.Abaturage mu mwaka 2016 bavugaga ko mu masaha ya nimugoroba muri iyi nzira habaga hari insoresore zihabategera zikabambura ibyo bavuye guhaha,ndetse ngo rimwe na rimwe zikanahabakubitira.Abaturage kandi bavuga ko mu myaka ishize muri iyi nzira bahiciye umuntu avuye mu mujyi wa Huye,kuburyo mwicyogihe ngo nta muntu wari ugipfa kuhanyura ari wenyine mu masaha ya nimugoroba.Ubuyobozi bwahumurizaga kandi abaturage, bababwira ko n’ingabo z’igihugu zirimo zihakora uburinzi, bityo bakaba bakwiye gushyira umutima hamwe.Bavugaga ko nta muntu uzongera kugirira ikibazo aho hantu rwose ko ubuyobozi bwabihagurukiye,bufatanyije n’abaturage ubwabo,bati nibahumure ntacyabananira.

Junior Mbele, (Yavutse ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1995 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyiuri mpuzamahanga akaba ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo ukina nkuwo hagati mu kibuga, hamwe na HUS Agadir.
Junior Mbele atangira umupira w'amaguru mu myitozo ya Daring Club Motema Pembe. Muri Werurwe 2020, yageragejwe muri club ya KAA La Gantoise ariko ananirwa gusinya amasezerano.
Ku ya 3 Ukuboza 2020, yiyandikishije mu gihembwe muri US Monastir. Ku ya 10 Ukuboza 2020, yakinnye umukino we wa mbere n'iyi kipe na CS Sfaxien (gutsindwa, 2-1).
Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2021, yiyandikishije muri shampiyona muri Al Nasr Benghazi.
Ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2022, yinjiye mu bwi sanzure muri Hassania d'Agadir.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Ku ya 18 Nzeri 2019, yakiriye bwa mbere mu mukino wa gicuti n'ikipe y'u Rwanda kuri Stade des Martyrs (batsindwa, 2-3).

Marcel Mbayo (yavutse Ku ya 23 Mata 1978 i Lubumbashi) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC)
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Emmanuel Nsumbu Mazuwa (yavutse Ku ya 24 Nzeri 1982 i Kisangani) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati. Yitabiriye umupira w'amaguru mu gikombe cy'Afurika muri 2004 hamwe na DR Congo. yahizwemo mu ikipe y'igihugu inshuro 31 kuva 2002.

Michél Sinda Mazingu-Dinzey (yavutse Ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1972 i Berlin, mu Budage) ni umukinnyi w'Umudage, Umukinnyi w’umupira w'amaguru, wabaye umutoza. Kugeza ubu ni umuyobozi wa Antigua na Barbuda Ku ya 7 Werurwe 2019.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire ubu ni DRC, yakinnye imikino 33 (ku bitego 3 yatsinze) hagati yo muri 1996 na 2004.
Ari mu itsinda ryatoranijwe mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu muri 1996, 2000 na 2004. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza aya marushanwa muri 1996.
Yakinnye kandi imikino ibiri ibara, imikino ibanza y'igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 1998, n'imikino ibiri ibara imikino ibanza y'igikombe cy'isi muri 2002.

Jason Mayele (wavutse Ku ya 4 Mutarama 1976 i Kinshasa, Zayire hanyuma apfa Ku ya 2 Werurwe 2002 mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Yakina nka rutahizamu.
Yashyinguwe mu irimbi ryu mudugudu wu mujyi wa Épinay-sous-Sénart.

Jean Adelard Mayanga Maku (yavutse Ku ya 31 Ukwakira 1948 muri Mbandaka) yari umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru kuva muri za 1970 muri Zaire. Yakinaga nka rutahizamu.
Yakinnye kuva muri 1968 kugeza 1982 muri AS Vita Club, aho yiganjemo amarushanwa yi gihugu ndetse atwara igikombe cya Afrika cya Champion ikipe muri 1973.
yari Umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa Zayire kuva muri 1970 kugeza 1979, yarushanwe muri CAN muri 1972 (4, atsinda ibitego 3), CAN muri 1974 (yatsinze, n'ibitego 3), ni gikombe cyisi muri 1974 (1 kuzenguruka, imikino 3 yakinnye, ibitego 0).
Yatoje muri make ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 2001.
Amaze gukinira mu Bubiligi, cyane mu mikino Olempike de Charleroi, yarahatuye. Umuhungu we Albert "Alba" Pemba Mayanga na we yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru mu rukurikirane rw'igihugu cy'Ububiligi. Abishywa be Michaël na Jordan Mayanga nabo bakinnye mu cyiciro cy’igihugu cy’Ububiligi.

Ricky Mavuba Mafuila Ku Mbundu, witwa Ricky Mavuba, (yavukiye Ku ya 15 Ukuboza 1949 yapfuye Ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 1996) yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo). Ni se wa Rio Mavuba.
Ku myaka 15-17, Ricky Mavuba yakinnye mu byiciro bya komini kuri stade rusange ya Komine Matete (uyumunsi Stade Jean Kembo). Muri kiriya gihe (1964-1968), imbaga yi yi mikino yo hanze b'amwitaga Larousse, nkaho twavuga umuntu w'ibitabo, intiti cyangwa umuntu ukomeye w'umupira w'amaguru.
Mu 1968, afite imyaka 19, yatangiriye bwa mbere muri Vita Club mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’Umujyi wa Kinshasa, nku mukinnyi wo hagati wa gabye igitero muri sisitemu 4-2-4. Hagati mu kibuga, Mavuba aha sanga Kibonge Gento, inyenyeri ikomeye ya Kinshasa, na Diantela, umukinnyi mpuzamahanga hafi yo kurangiza umwuga we.
Inzobere mu kurasa ku izamu na virtuoso yo kurwanya ibitero, Ricky Mavuba agaragazwa no kurutondeka neza kwe, pasiporo ye yogejwe hamwe nu mfu ruka ye rimwe, bikarangirira mu rushundura. Ibi amaherezo bizamuhesha izina rya Ndoki ya Ndombe (Umupfumu w'umwirabura) na bakunzi ba Green na Black Club.
Mu 1970, igihe Kibonge yigaragaje nk'umukinnyi mwiza ku 10, ukina umukino wa Diantela hanyuma Diantela asubira inyuma, Ricky Mavuba na Maufranc Ma mbwene bahise batangira kwishyira mu kibuga hagati ya V Club.

Chris Mavinga, (Yavutse Ku ya 26 Gicurasi 1991 muri Meaux) ni umupira w'amaguru wumupira w'amaguru Ukomoka muri congo. Akina nka myugariro wo hagati muri Los Angeles Galaxy muri MLS.
Ni Mpuzamahanga mu makipe akiri muto y'ubufaransa, yatoje m'ukigo cyamahugurwa cya PSG. Chris Mavinga yifuzwa n'amakipe menshi, ariko amaherezo ni Liverpool ni yo ibasha kwinjizamo myugariro ukiri muto, mu mpeshyi ya 2009, ibangamira ikipe ye y'imyitozo ikomeje guhabwa indishyi z'a mahugurwa.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, yakinnye mu ikipe ya Liverpool ya bigenewe kandi ntiyigeze agaragara rimwe n'ikipe ya mbere. Yakomeje gutsindira muri Shampiyona yu Burayi yabatarengeje imyaka 19 hamwe n’Ubufaransa, afite umwanya wa myugariro w’ibumoso.
Inguzanyo mu Bubiligi.
Ntabwo yabonye umwanya wo gukina shampiyona yakurikiyeho, kandi muri Kuboza 2010, yatijwe mu igice cya kabiri cya shampiyona muri KRC Genk mu Bubiligi kugira ngo abone umwanya wo gukina.
Mu mukino uheruka wa Play-offs ya 1 ya Shampiyona y’Ababiligi muri 2010–2011 na Standard de Liège, yakomeretse atabishaka ariko akomeretsa bikomeye Mehdi Carcela mu maso, avurwa izuru, amenyo menshi kandi avunika urwasaya, umusifuzi Frank De Bleeckere amuhana ikarita y'umuhondo. Iyi mvune yateje impagarara mu Bubiligi. Mehdi Carcela yamaze mu bitaro amezi icumi.
Garuka mu Bufaransa unyure mu Burusiya.
Ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2011, yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ine na Stade Rennes.
Yimuriwe i Rubin Kazan mu mpeshyi yo muri 2013, asubira mu Bufaransa nyuma y'u mwaka. Intizanyo hamwe nu buryo bwo kugura kuri Stade de Reims Ku ya 30 Kanama 2014, afite intego yo kugarura ubuzima nyuma yo kudakina igice cya shampiyona mu Burusiya. Nubwo shampiyona itoroshye, yarangiye zirindwi gusa itangira muri shampiyona, yagarutse muri Ligue 1 muri shampiyona yo muri 2015-2016, kuriyi nshuro kuri ESTAC. Yirukanwe ku ya 32 umunota ukurikira amakarita abiri yu muhondo ku mukino wa mbere na Troyes, ku ya 15 Kanama 2015, na OGC Nice (3-3). afite igihe agarutse ahagaritswe mugihe cya 4, umunsi wa shampionat, y'agize umukino mushya utoroshye icyumweru cyakurikiyeho, ahanganye na SM Caen (batsindwa 1-3), asimburwa kuri munota 40 na Quentin Othon.

Zola Matumona Pitshu (Yavutse Ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 1981 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri FC Renaissance.
Yageze muri AS Vita Club Kinshasa (imwe mu ma kipe akomeye ya DR Congo) nyuma yo kumara igihe muri ikipe yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri Styles du Congo. Yahise aba umukunzi w'abashyigikiye ikipe y'icyatsi n'umukara bamwitaga "Icyumba" yerekeza ku mukino, ugereranije n'umukinnyi w'umudage, Karl-Heinz Rummenigge. Yahamaze ibihembwe bitanu, yegukana igikombe cya shampiyo wa congo, ibikombe byinshi bya Kinshasa, yitabira CAF Champions League ndetse na CAF Cup hamwe ni kipe ye. Yatsindiye kandi igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza muri Kongo inshuro nyinshi mbere yo kuva mu ikipe ye. Yageze muri FC Bruxelles muri 2007 amafaranga bya mayero 60 000 .
Yahagaritse ku bushake amasezerano yagiranye niyi kipe nyuma y’amagambo y’ivangura yavuzwe na perezida waryo. Nk’uko uwunganira uyu mukinnyi yabitangaza, Johan Vermeersch yari yatutse Matumona amusobanurira ko "ntiyari akiri mu gihugu cye kandi yagombaga kwibagirwa ibiti n'i bitoki imbere y'abakozi n'a bandi bakinnyi. Uyu muyobozi yemeza ibyo yavuze ariko asobanura ko ari "urwenya".
Uyu mukinnyi yaje gusubukura amasezerano ye amuhuza niyi kipe kugeza muri 2009 nyuma yikiganiro na perezida wasabye imbabazi kumugaragaro kubyo yavuze.

Vumi Ley Matampi (Yavutse Ku ya 18 Mata 1989 i Kinshasa) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukin ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umuzamu muri Football Club Renaissance du Congo.
Vumi Ley Matampi yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri AS Vita Club nyuma yinjirayo, muri 2005, DC Motema Pembe. Yakinnye imikino 200 ya shampiyona niyi kipe mu myaka itandatu kandi yegukana igikombe cya shampiyona muri 2005 na 2008 ndetse ni gikombe muri 2006, 2009 na 2010. Imyitwarire myiza muri ikipe yatumye atoranya ikipe y'igihugu ya mbere, kumukino wa gicuti na Misiri. Ku ya 11 Kanama 2010. Yaje gukina ku munota 57 w'umukino, yatsinzwe ku manota y'ibitego bitandatu kuri bitatu, asimbuye Mulopo Kudimbana. Muri Gashyantare 2011, ari mu itsinda ryahamagajwe n'umutoza wa Kongo Santos Muntubile kwitabira amarushanwa ya Afurika y'ibihugu muri 2011. Nta mukino n'umwe yakinnye mu cyiciro cya nyuma yakinnye muri Sudani, aho DR Congo yatsinzwe muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza na Tuniziya n'igitego kimwe ku busa. Ukwezi kumwe, yahamagawe mu ikipe yigihugu ku nshuro ya kabiri, n’umutoza w’Ubufaransa Robert Nouzaret, ku mukino ubara imikino y’amajonjora y’igikombe cy'isi muri 2014, yakinnye na Maurice. Ntabwo ikina mugihe cy'inama yatsindiye ku bitego bitatu kuri nil.
Yinjiye Ukuboza 2011,muri Tout Puissant Mazembe basi nye amasezerano y'imyaka itandatu. Asanga muri iyi kipe afite ikipe yi gihugu Robert Kidiaba maze aba, nkuko byatoranijwe, umusimbura. Muri Mutarama 2012, yubashye guhitamo kwe kwa kane mu ikipe yi gihugu mu mukino wa gicuti na Oman birangira banganyije ibitego bibiri ahantu hose ariko nyuma akabura umwanya, kubera umwanya afite wo gusimbura ikipe. Yakinnye imikino cumi nine gusa muri TPM ye gukanye igikombe cya shampiyona muri 2012 na 2013. Yatijwe Ugushyingo 2013 kuri ikipe ya Angola yo Kabuscorp, iganje muri shampiyona wa Girabola.

Alain Ekakanga Masudi, (Yavutse ku ya 12 Gashyantare 1978 i Kinshasa, muri Zayire ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuva mu 1997), yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru muri Kongo.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri SC Bastia muri 1997, mbere yo kwinjira muri Nîmes Olympique, icyo gihe yakinnye muri Ligue ya 2. Nyuma yaje gusinyana na AS Saint-Étienne mbere yo kuva muri shampiyona y'ubufaransa burundu.
Yakiniye mu Busuwisi ahitwa Lausanne-Sports, hanyuma muri Otirishiya na Libiya.
Mu 2004, yageze muri Isiraheli akina mu ma kipe menshi yi cyiciro cya mbere cya Isiraheli. Muri 2008, yasinyanye na Maccabi Herzliya, ikipe yo mu cyiciro cya Isiraheli.
Ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wa congo, yitabiriye cyane igikombe cya Afrika muri 2004 aho yatsinze igitego kimwe gusa, na Gineya. Kubera ko iyi CAN imwe, atagihamagarwa mu ikipe yigihugu.
Hagati ya 2000 na 2003 ya banaga n’umunyamakuru wa televiziyo Francesca Antoniotti, babyarana umuhungu witwa Enzo, wavutse muri 2002.

Arthur Masuaku (Yavutse ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 1993 i Lille) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Ni umukinnyi w'inyuma mu kibuga kuri Besiktas JK, ku nguzanyo ya West Ham United.
Yateye intambwe ya mbere atangirira muri ikipe ya L'OS Fives i Lille. Muri 2006, yinjiye mu kigo cya banjirije imyitozo cya Liévin, hamwe na Raphaël Varane. Yatangiye umukino wa mbere muri Ligue 1 mu ikipe y'ababyeyi ku ya 10 Kanama 2013 na Toulouse. Yakomeje akomeza kwitwara neza nubwo ibihe bitoroshye ikipe ye yarimo, iguma muri zone yabamanuka. Hamwe n’umutoza w’Ububiligi Ariël Jacobs ku buyobozi bw'ikipe, byemejwe ko afite umwanya wo gutangira nta gushidikanya ibumoso.
Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere muri Ligue 1 ku ya 29 Mutarama 2014, mu mukino wahuje Olympique de Marseille kuri Stade Vélodrome.
Mu mabara ya Olympiakos, yabaye shampiyo w’Ubugereki kabiri muri 2015 na 2016 kandi ye gukana igikombe cy’Ubugereki muri 2015.

Kilasu Massamba, (yavutse Ku ya 22 Ukuboza 1950 muri Kongo Mbiligi, apfa Ku ya 25 Kamena 2020),ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga wa congo.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yegukanye umwanya wa kane mu gikombe cy'Afurika cyo muri 1972 ndetse anakina igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1976. Yagize kandi uruhare mu gutoranya impaka z’igikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974.
Muriikipe, yambara amabara ya CS Imana na AS Bilima.

Amédée Masasi Obenza, (yavutse Ku ya 11 Nzeri 1991 muri DR Congo) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina nka myugariro wo hagati muri AS Vita Club Kinshasa. Yatoranijwe bwa mbere mu ikipe yi gihugu kwitabira CAN muri Kameruni. Hamwe na DRC, yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza, aho bakuweho ni gihugu cyakiriye Kameruni. Ibitego bye yatsinze mu gihe cyo guhagarara byamuhesheje izina "Zombie ni mugoroba". Mu 2021, yabaye shampiyo w'umupira w'amaguru muri DRC hamwe na AS Vita Club. Muri 2022, yasinyanye na TP Mazembe.
yje muri AS Vita Club, muri 2020, muri igihembwe cyo muri 2020 kugeza 2021..
Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu kuri Ku ya 12 Mutarama 2021, mu mukino wa gicuti na Tanzaniya (1-1).
Nyuma yaho, muri Shampiyona y’umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika yo 2020 yateguwe muri Kameruni, yitabiriye imikino ine yakinnye n’ingwe maze atsinda ibitego bibiri birimo kimwe na Libiya na Nigeri.
Urebye uko yitwaye mu gikombe cy’umupira w'amaguru cya Afurika giheruka muri 2020, azahamagarwa mu ikipe nkuru ya DR Congo n'umutoza w’igihugu Christian N'Sengi mu mikino izakina na Gabon na Gambiya mu izina ry’igikombe cya Afurika muri 2021 cya Amajonjora y’i bihugu.

Budge Manzia, (yavutse Ku ya 24 Nzeri 1994) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC) ukina nka rutahizamu i Dukla Prague.
Budge Manzia yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Sharks XI yo muri Kongo. Muri Mutarama 2013, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Tuniziya yitwa Étoile Sportive du Sahel. Muri Mutarama 2014, yi mukiye mu Burayi no mu gihugu cya Ceki muri Dukla Prague.
Budge Manzia yitabiriye irushanwa rya Toulon muri 2013, Igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2013 ndetse n’umupira w'amaguru wa Afurika muri 2013 hamwe n’ikipe ya Congo.

Mandanda itunganye, (yavutse Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1989 muri Nevers mu Ubufaransa), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga wa congo ukina nkumuzamu.
Ni uwa kabiri mu bavandimwe b'abazamu b'abigize umwuga hamwe na Steve Mandanda (wavutse mu 1985, mpuzamahanga w’Abafaransa), Riffi Mandanda (wavutse mu 1992, Umunyamahanga wa Kongo) na Over Mandanda (yavutse mu 1998).
Mandanda yatojwe muri SM Caen, yinjiye mu kigo cy’umwuga cya Girondins de Bordeaux (CFA) muri 2007. Mu gushaka igihe cyo gukina shampiyona ihanitse, yagerageje inshuro nyinshi ashyigikira muri Paris FC, Entente Sannois Saint-Gratien bombi mu ikipe y'iGihugu, no ku kigo cy'amahugurwa cya RC Lens, kigaragaza ko kidashoboka.
Muri Mutarama 2009, yanze amasezerano avuye mu mujyi wa Ipswich mu Bwongereza, amaherezo kugirana amasezerano na AS Beauvais, mu Gihugu. Ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2009, akina umukino we wa mbere k'umugaragaro muri Aviron bayonnais, usibye umukino w'onyine wemewe y'itabira. Yamanuwe muri cyiciro cyakurikiyeho nk'umuzamu wa gatatu mu ikipe ya Picard kandi amaherezo nti yagumishijwe mu mpera za shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010.
Muri Nyakanga 2010, Parfait Mandanda asinyana na Altay İzmir, ikipe ya kabiri yo muri Turukiya. Yahujwe inshuro 12 mu minsi 36, yungutse uburambe muri shampionat nto. Kubwamahirwe, kurwego rusange, kwihanganira biragoye kuva ikipe idahunga kumanuka m'ucyiciro cya gatatu. Umukinnyi noneho ahagarika uburambe bwe muri Turukiya agerageza gusubira i Burayi.
Yabaye shampiyo wa D2 mu Bubiligi muri 2012 hamwe na Sporting de Charleroi.
Hamwe na DR Congo, yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2015.

Mambwene Mana (yavutse Ku ya 10 Ukwakira 1947 hari muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga wumupira wamaguru wa congo (DRC), wakinnye nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye imikino 10 mu marushanwa yateguwe na FIFA, nta gitego yatsinze, muri 1974.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage, yakinnye imikino itatu: kurwanya Sikotilande, Yugosilaviya na Burezile.
Yitabiriye kandi igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1974 cyatsinzwe n'ikipe ye.

Emeka Esanga Mamale (yavutse Ku ya 21 Ukwakira 1977 muri Zayire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo arapfa Ku ya 25 Kamena 2020 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi wari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinaga nka rutahizamu.

Jean-Marc Mundele Makusu, (Yavutse Ku ya 27 Werurwe 1992 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Yakinnye nka rutahizamu hamwe n'itsinda rya Orlando Pirates muri Afrika yepfo muri 2019. Kuri ubu akinira AS Vita Club yi Kinshasa.
Yatangiye umwuga we muri Ceforbel Club, nanone yitwa Bel'Or Training Center yi Kinshasa, iyobowe na Perezida Lolo Mosango Ebisa wabashije kwitoza no kuzamura umukinnyi.

Jean-Marc Mundele Makusu yitabira Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2014 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yakinnye imikino 3 atsinda ibitego 2 muri iri rushanwa.

Yves Makabu-Makalambay, (yavutse Ku ya 31 Mutarama 1986 i Buruseli) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umuzamu.

Muri Sikotilande, yabaye umunyezamu wambere wiyi kipe mu myaka ibiri, akina imikino igera kuri mirongo itandatu. Yaje gutakaza umwanya we asanga ari umunyezamu wa gatatu mu nzego, cyane nyuma y’umubano mwiza n'umutoza John Hughes.

usubirwamo hamwe na ""Amashitani atukura" mu m'ukino wa gicuti utemewe na Standard de Liège muri Gashyantare 2008, aho yakinnye kimwe cya kabiri.

Ishyamba rya Achimota ni ishyamba rinini riherereye muri Achimota mu karere ka Okaikwei mu majyaruguru ya Accra; riherereye nko muri kilometero 7,6 uvuye Accra mu gihugu cya Gana. NI ishyamba ririnzwe kandi ribungabunzwe kugirango hadakorerwamo ibyangiza ibinyabuzima biririmo nko guhiga, kubakamo amazu. iryo shyamba kandi ryifashishwa mu kugenzura ibyuka bihumanya ikirere aho muri Accra.
Ishyamba ryashyizwe mu igazeti mu 1930 kandi rifite ubuso bungana na hegitari 494.95. Kugeza ubu, ingano y’amashyamba agera kuri hegitari 360. Ishyamba rya Achmota ryashyizweho kugirango habeho umupaka hagati y'umujyi wa Accra n'ishuri rya Achimota. Inyinshi mu nyamaswa zo muri Zoo ya Accra zimuriwe mu gasozi igihe hubakwaga ingoro ya Perezida. Kugeza ubu, icungwa nka arboretum hamwe n’ikigo cyita ku nyamaswa. Inyamaswa nka python, ingamiya, imbuni, impyisi, inkende nizindi zishobora kuboneka mu mashyamba.
Komisiyo ishinzwe amashyamba ya Gana yateganyaga guhindura amashyamba ikaba ikigo cy’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku bidukikije cyiswe "Parike ya Accra Eco". Biteganijwe ko hazaba hari amazi, amazi y'umunyu, ahantu nyaburanga, ubusitani, ubuvuzi bw'amatungo, kumenyekanisha ibinyabuzima, ahantu hakambikwa, umuhanda hakanzitirwa.
Muri Gicurasi 2022, byavuzwe ko ibice by'ishyamba byashyizwe ahagaragara nk'ishyamba. Samuel Abu Jinapor yahakanye ko Guverinoma yashyize mu kinyamakuru inyandiko nyobozi (EI) kugira ngo yemeze kongera kugenwa, kugurisha cyangwa guteza imbere ishyamba. Umuryango witwa umuryango wa Owoo wavuze ko ari ba nyir'ubutaka bwa mbere bufite amashyamba. Hagati ya 1921 na 1927, isambu yahawe na guverinoma y'abakoloni ku ishuri rya Achimota. Mu itangazo, uyu muryango wavuze ko batabonye indishyi z’ibyo baguze mu 1927. Uyu muryango kandi wavuze ko bababaye, 'akarengane gakabije k’amateka' kubera ko batigeze bigarurira igihugu.

Imisozi ya Ngong ni impinga iherereye mu kibaya kinini cya Rift, giherereye mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba hafi ya Nairobi, mu majyepfo ya Kenya. Ijambo "Ngong" ni ijambo ryaturutse mu rurimi rw'abamasayi mu nteruro yabo igira iti "enkong'u emuny" bisobanura isoko y'imvubu, kandi iri zina rikomoka ku masoko aherereye hafi y'umujyi wa Ngong.
Imisozi ya Ngong, iva ahahanamye h'iburasirazuba yerekeza parike y'igihugu ya Nairobi, no mu majyaruguru, umujyi wa Nairobi. Impinga y'imisozi ya Ngong ni metero 2,460 hejuru y'inyanja.
Mu myaka y'ubutegetsi bw'abakoloni b'Abongereza, agace gakikije imisozi ya Ngong kari agace gakomeye ko guhinga, kandi amazu menshi ya gikoroni aracyagaragara muri ako gace. Muri filime "yitwa Hanze ya Afurika yakinnywe mu mwaka wa" 1985, impinga enye z’imisozi ya Ngong zigaragara inyuma y’amashusho menshi hafi y’inzu ya Karen Blixen. Abaturage baho baracyavuga ko babonye intare k'umusozi mu myaka ya za 90. Imva yonyine ya Denys Finch Hatton, iherereye mu burasirazuba bw'imisozi ya Ngong, yitegeye parike y'igihugu ya Nairobi.
Hari inzira igenda hejuru y'imisozi ya Ngong. Serivisi ishinzwe amashyamba ya Kenya ifite ibiro munsi ya parike..Abaturage baho rimwe na rimwe bagiye bakora ibikorwa byo guteranira hamwe basenga ku cyumweru ku mpinga y’amajyepfo y'iyo misozi, bareba ikibaya kinini cya Rift.
Hafi y'imisozi ni umujyi wa Ngong. Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi ya Ngong Hills yarangiye kubakwa mu mwaka wa 2015.
Serivisi ishinzwe amashyamba muri Kenya itanga abayobora bakanarinda umutekano wa bamukerarugendo bakishyura amafaranga y'inyongera.

Umugezi wa Yala ni umugezi rwo mu burengerazuba bwa Kenya, uruzi rw'ikiyaga cya Victoria. Ubusanzwe itemba vuba hejuru y'urutare inyuze mu kibaya kinini mbere yo kwinjira mu mugezi wa Nzoia gukora igishanga cya Yala k'umupaka w'ikiyaga cya Victoria. Ubutaka bukikije umugezi wa Yala ahanini burahingwa cyangwa bugakoreshwa mu kuragira, hamwe n’ibisigisigi bike by’ishyamba rya kimeza. Isuri y'ubutaka irahagaragara mu kibaya cy'uwo mugezi, cyane cyane mu bice byo hepfo yawo. Imishinga irakomeje yo gukoresha uruzi amashanyarazi.
Imiterere y'Umugezi wa Yala.
Umugezi wa Yala uzamuka muri Nandi mu Ntara y'ikibaya cya Rift, muri Kenya. Itemba iburengerazuba kuri 219 kilometres ku munwa wacyo ku kiyaga cya Victoria mu Ntara ya Kisumu, mu gihugu cya Kenya. [1] umwe mu nzuzi nini zo muri Kenya zigaburira ikiyaga cya Victoria, ikigereranyo cya meterokibe 27.4 mu isegonda. [2] rutanga hafi 5% byinjira mu kiyaga cya Victoria buri mwaka. [3]
Igishanga cya Yala ku nkombe z'umugezi gifite kirometerokare 175 ku nkombe y'amajyaruguru y'Ikiyaga cya Victoria. [1] Igishanga kirimo hegitari 1,500. Ikiyaga cya Kanyaboli, igishanga cy’amazi meza ya deltaic gifite ubujyakuzimu bwa metero 3 metres, igaburirwa n’amazi y’inzuzi za Nzoia na Yala hamwe n’amazi atemba ava mu kiyaga cya Victoria. Ikiyaga gitanga ubuhungiro bw' amoko menshi y’amafi atakiboneka mu kiyaga cya Victoria. [6]
Ikibaya cy'amazi ya Yala gifite kilometerokare 3,351. [1] Ubushakashatsi ku micungire y’ibidukikije ku kibaya cy’uruzi rwa Yala na Nzoia bwasohoye raporo y'ibanze mu 2008. inyiigo yakorewe ku bantu batatu bahagarariye 10 kuri 10 kiromrterokare z'uduce tw'ubutaka mu kibaya cya Yala. Muri [11] uko ari bitatu igice kinini cy'ubutaka bwahinzwe. Ibihingwa ngandurarugo birimo ibigori, ibishyimbo, amasaka, igitoki, imyumbati n'ibijumba, mu gihe ibihingwa ngengabukungu birimo icyayi, ingano n'imyembe. [12]
Imishinga y'amashanyarazi.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2016, ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bushoboka bwo guteza imbere urugomero rwa Nandi rwo gushyigikira kuhira imyaka, gutanga amazi no kubyaza amashanyarazi. Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwaba rufite tiribine ebyiri za MW 25 Pelton kandi rutanga 185 GWh buri mwaka. [22] Muri Mata 2020 hatangajwe ko Tembo Power ya Maurice, hamwe na Metier na WK Construction yo muri Afurika y'Epfo basinyanye amasezerano yo guteza imbere urugomero rw'amashanyarazi ruva mu ruzi rwa Yala. Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi ya Kaptis yagombaga kugira ubushobozi [23] 15MW kandi izatangira gukora mu 2022. Umushinga uzatwara miliyoni 30 z'amadolari. Amashanyarazi yagaburirwa umuyoboro ukorwa na leta ya Kenya Power and Lighting Company (KPLC). [24] Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwagombaga kuba hafi y'umujyi wa Kakamega. [25]

Cedrick Mabwati (Yavutse ku ya 8 Werurwe 1992 i Kinshasa) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati ukina muri CD Tudelano.
Umuryango we wavukiye i Kinshasa, umurwa mukuru wa DR Congo, umuryango we wimukiye muri Esipanye mu mujyi wa Salamanca afite imyaka 12, ahunga amakimbirane igihugu cyabo ba komokamo Yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru ku ishuri nyuma yinjira mu ikipe UD Santa Marta. Yahise abonwa na Atlético de Madrid maze yi njira mu kigo cy’imyitozo cy’iyi kipe mu murwa mukuru wa Espagne afite imyaka 14.
Nyuma yo gukora bwa mbere hamwe na "Colchoneros" muri Mutarama 2010, muri Copa del Rey na Recreativo de Huelva mu gihe wi njiye mu mikino. Nyuma yaje kugurizwa mu ikipe ya Numancia yo muri cyiciro cya kabiri, irangiza iyimurwa ry’umusore ukomoka mu gihugu cya Kongo umwaka ukurikira. Nyuma y'ibihe bibiri byemeza muri Liga Adelante, yasinyiye muri Betis Sevilla, azamurwa mu cyiciro cya mbere, yaguze umusore ukomoka mu gihugu cya Kongo ku ngingo yo kurekura ku mayero 1,21! Amaze gukina imikino 24 muri La Liga, no kumanuka gushya kwi kipe ya Andalusiya, yatijwe muri Kanama 2014 muri ikipe Osasuna, nayo yamanutse.
Ku ya 30 Mutarama 2015, yimuriwe muri Crew SC ya Columbus yo muri MLS.
Amaze gukina na munsi yabafite imyaka 20 ya Congo, yarahamagawe muri Nzeri 2014, n'umutoza mushya w'ingwe, Florent Ibenge, mu majonjora ya CAN muri 2015. Niba gutsindwa na Kameruni biza kwanduza umupira we wa mbere, uwa kabiri azanezezwa cyane n'umusore ku ruhande, ukiri muto, kuko atanga umufasha wa Jérémy Bokila, ibyo bikaba byerekana ko Abanye kongo batsinze Siyera Lewone ibitego 2-0.

Lema Mabidi, uzwi ku izina rya Chikito, (yavutse Ku ya 11 Kamena 1993 i Kinshasa ahari Zayire), ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati hagati muri AS Vita Club.
Intangiriro muri DRC.
Yavutse Ku ya 11 Kamena 1993 i Kinshasa, Lema yatangiye gukinira ikipe yo mujyi yavukiyemo, ni Sharks XI FC kandi Mabidi yamenyanye n'isi yu mwuga ubwo yakinaga muri Shampiyona y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo afite imyaka cumi n'itandatu, Lema yatsindiye muri 2009 Amarushanwa ya karito ya Malebo.
Lema Mabidi yitiriwe "Chikito" akomeza kuguma mu ikipe ya Sharks FC mu bihembwe bine kugeza muri 2013 ubwo AS Vita Club yamwimuriye afite imyaka 20, Lema yakomeje iterambere rye maze agera mu ikipe y'igihugu muri uwo mwaka muri DRC. Nyuma y'umwuga mwiza, yageze ku mukino wa nyuma wa CAF Champions League muri 2014 hamwe na AS Vita Club. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu mukino ubanza yakinnye n'ikipe ya Alijeriya muri ES Sétif. Ku mukino wa nyuma w'icyiciro cya kabiri, yongeye gutsinda igitego akoresheje amashoti maremare rikomeye. Muri iki gihembwe, Mabidi yahise akurura amakipe yo hanze hanze ya DR Congo.
Ubunyamwuga muri Tuniziya.
Nyuma ya CAN yo muri 2015 no mu gihe cyo kwimura imbeho, amakipe menshi yo muri Afurika yepfo yashimishijwe nu mwirondoro we, ariko yasinyiye muri Club Sportif Sfaxien, shampiyona ye ya mbere hamwe niyi kipe yo muri Tuniziya izatangira nabi, Mabidi ntago yatangiye, nta gitego atsinda. ariko akomeza gutanga ubufasha kandi, nyuma y'ikibazo cyimishahara, afata FIFA kandi yiyemeje Nzeri 2015 Ikipe ya Maroke muri Raja Casablanca.

Umusozi wa Meru uzwi kandi ku izina rya Sumeru, Sineru cyangwa Mahāmeru, ni umusozi ufite impinga eshanu z'imisozi miremire y'Abahindu, Jain, na Budisti. Uyu musozi uvugwa kandi mu byanditswe bimwe na bimwe by'amadini adashingiye ku Buhinde nka Taoism byatewe no kuza kw'abasenga Buda mu Bushinwa.
Aho izina Meru rya Komotse.
Insengero nyinshi zizwi cyane z'abasenga Buda, Jain, n'Abahindu zubatswe nk'ikigereranyo cy'uyu musozi.
Izina nyaryo ry'umusozi ni Meru, hiyongeraho imbanzirizazina yemewe ya su-, bivamo ibisobanuro "Meru ihebuje" cyangwa "Meru nziza". "Meru" ni izina ry'amasaro yo hagati muri mālā.
Ibipimo byitiriwe umusozi wa Meru - byose bivugako ari igice cy'inyanja ya Cosmic, hamwe n'andi magambo menshi abisobanura mu magambo adasobanutse neza (urugero, "izuba hamwe n'imibumbe yose bizenguruka umusozi") - kumenya aho biherereye biragoye cyane, nkuko abahanga benshi babivuga.
Abashakashatsi benshi bagaragaza umusozi wa Meru cyangwa Sumeru hamwe na Pamirs, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Kashmir.
Suryasiddhanta avuga ko umusozi wa Meru uri hagati "y'isi" ("bhuva-madhya") ku butaka bwa Jambunad, inyandiko yo mu kinyejana cya cyenda, ishingiye ahanini ku nyandiko zitashyizwe ahagaragara za Yāmal Tantr, avuga:
" Sumeruḥ Prithvī-madhye shrūyate drishyate na tu"
(Sumeru yunvikana kuba hagati yisi, ariko ntiboneka aho).
Inyandiko nyinshi za cosimologiya zisangwa mu myandiko z'abahindu. Muri imwe muri zo, mu isanzure ry'ikirere, umusozi wa Meru nawo wasobanuwe ko uzengurutswe n'umusozi wa Mandrachala mu burasirazuba, umusozi wa Suparshva mu burengerazuba, umusozi wa Kumuda mu majyaruguru na Kailasa mu majyepfo.

Larrys Mabiala, (Yavutse Ku ya 8 Ukwakira 1987 muri Montfermeil) ni Umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nka myugariro wo hagati hamwe na Portland Timbers, muri MLS.
Paris Saint Germain.
Yanyuze mu kigo cy’amahugurwa cya PSG, yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'umwuga mu gihe cy'umukino wa nyuma wa cumi na gatandatu wa Coupe de la Ligue na Lorient kuri Parc des Princes on20Ku ya 20 Kamena 2006. Yasinyanye amasezerano ye yu mwuga hafi ako kanya mu Gushyingo 2006 ubwo yakomeretse mu gihe kitazwi (abaganga b'iyi kipe ntibari bazi neza imvune ye. Amaherezo yaje kugaruka avuye mu mvune muri Gashyantare 2007 abitegetswe na Paul Le Guen, ubwo yasinyaga amasezerano ye y'umwuga mu gihe cya Guy Lacombe.
Nyuma y'ibyumweru bike gusa by'imyitozo, umutoza ya hisemo ku mujyana mu cyiciro cya 16 cy'igikombe cya mbere cya UEFA i Lisbonne na Benfica. Kubura amarushanwa nyuma y'amezi ane adahuguwe, birumvikana ko afite ikibazo cyo kugaragara muri Simão.
Yahamagawe mu ikipe y'Ubufaransa munsi y'imwaka 23 ku nshuro ya mbere na René Girard ku mikino yakinnye na Danemarike na Noruveje ku ya 23 na Ku ya 27 Werurwe 2007. Muri uyu mukino wa kabiri, yabonye cape ya mbere ya tricolor a kina mu mwanya akunda wa myugariro wo hagati (gutsindwa 1-0).
Kugira ngo yungukire ku gihe kinini cyo gukina, yatijwe muri shampiyona yo muri 2007-2008 muri Plymouth (Shampiyona), ariko uburambe bwo mu Bwongereza bwa ragabanutse kuko yakomeretse ivi umunsi umwe mbere y’umukino wa mbere wa shampiyona ya gombaga kwitabira. Abakozi b'ubuvuzi bahise bifuza ko yabazwe ariko abigishije inama na muganga wa PSG, yahisemo k ubyanga akurikiza ubuvuzi no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe mu Bufaransa. Mu gihe yakiriye i Paris, umuyobozi wa Plymouth Ian Holloway yimukiye mu mujyi wa Leicester. Yasimbuwe na Paul Sturrock, maze ahitamo kubanza guhagarika inguzanyo ye. Mabiala yahise yi njira mu bakozi mu myitozo maze akina imikino ibiri n'ikipe yabigenewe bituma umuyobozi ahindura ibitekerezo, amaherezo ashaka kumugumana. Bibabaje Mabiala ariko ahitamo gusubira i Paris. Yarekuwe mu masezerano ye Ku ya 20 Ukuboza 2007 kandi ntazakina umukino uwo ariwo wose n'ikipe ya mbere.
Ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2008, yemeye gukina n'igihugu akomokamo, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, n'ikipe y'Ubufaransa A '.

Tristan M'Bongo (yavutse Ku ya 27 Ukuboza 1982 i Kinshasa) niumukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo.
Yavukiye i Kinshasa, Tristan M'Bongo yageze mu Bufaransa afite imyaka 5. Yakoze umwuga we ari muto mu m'akipe yi kinira mbere yo kwinjira muri Albi, ikipe ya CFA, aho yigaragaje nki ntangiriro ikomeye. Muri 2007, yahisemo kujya gukinira Luzenac, wari ugikina muri CFA. Hamwe na Luzenac, yarangije shampiyona nku mukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi ibitego 8. Uwa nyuma yarangije shampyona witsinda rye muri CFA igijemwe gikurikira hanyuma agera muri ikipe k'unshuro ya mbere mu mateka yayo. Igihembwe cya 2009-2010 kizaba icya M'Bongo: Arangiza shampiyona n'i bitego 17 kandi niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi kipe. Imyitwarire ye yashimishije abashaka akazi muri RC Strasbourg, bamwiyandikishije muri Nyakanga muri 2010 nyuma yuko iyi kipe imanuka mu Gihugu. Nyuma yi gihembwe cyiza muri ikipe ya Strasbourg, yahisemo gusubira i Luzenac.
Yubaha cape ye yonyine hamwe na congo, Ku ya 21 Gicurasi 2010 kurwanya Arabiya Sawudite. Umukino warangiye batsinzwe ibitego 2-0.

Robert Kidiaba Muteba (yavutse Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1976) i Lubumbashi ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, kuva 2002, yakiniraga TP Mazembe nkumuzamu. Yari Mpuzamahanga, yahamagawe inshuro 61 mu ikipe y'igihugu hagati ya 2002 na 2015.
Yagize uruhare mu gutoranya Abanyekongo mu gikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2004, cyarangije ku mwanya wa nyuma mu itsinda ryo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’irushanwa, bityo ntabura amahirwe yo kujya muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza. Ikora parade idasanzwe kandi azwiho "kubyina" iyo Mazembe itsinze.
Muri Ukwakira 2011, Kidiaba yakomerekeje ku rutugu rw'iburyo kandi igihe cye kirangiye, yashoboraga gusubira mu kibuga gusa muri 2012 kandi byabaye ngombwa ko atakaza umukino wanyuma w'a majonjora yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika muri 2012 na Kameruni.

Raoul Albert Kidumu Mantantu witwa "Kidumu Mantantu", (yavutse Ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 1946 i Thysville, ubu ni Mbanza Ngungu) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wari Zayire muri za 1960 na 1970. Yakinaga nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu kibigs. Yatangiye umwuga we mu mashitani atukura ya Mbanza Ngungu wa muzamuye, mbere yo kwiyandikisha muri CS Imana FC Matiti Mabe. Inkunga yo gutera imbere, yatoranijwe mu ngwe y'ikipe ya Zayire. Muri 1974, yari kapiteni w'iyi kipe, guhitamo bwa mbere muri Afurika yepfo, Sahara yitabiriye igikombe cy'isi cy'umupira w'amagura; hari mu 1974 i Gelsenkirchen..
Ni umukinnyi uri umunyamahanga wa Zayire. Yakinnye ibikombe 3 by'Afurika: muri 1968 (uwatsinze, ibitego 2), 1972 (4) na 1974 (uwatsinze, igitego 1). Yakinnye kandi mu gikombe cyisi cyo mu 1974 (mu cyiciro cy'ambere, imikino 3, ibitego 0, ikarita 1 y'umuhondo).
Muri ikipe, yakiniye na CS Imana.

Sogokuru Okitankoyi Kimoto (yavutse Ku ya 22 Nyakanga 1976 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina w'umupira w'amaguru wa congo, wavukiye mu Bubiligi muri 2008, wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Yageze mu Bubiligi muri 1999, Kimoto yerekana imico igaragara munsi y'amabara ya Sporting de Lokeren. Nyuma y'imyaka ine, azimurirwa kandi muri Standard de Liège icyarimwe nuwahoze ari mugenzi we, Sambegou Bangoura. Ariko, ntazashobora kwishyira mu mwanya wa Liège.
Nyuma y'igihe gito muri Saint-Trond, Sogo kuru Kimoto azakoresha impano ye muri Isiraheli, aha azamenya ama kipe ane muri shampyina eshatu.
Papy Kimoto kandi yari umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu ya Kongo inshuro 54.
Nyuma yo gukukuruka, Kimoto yabaye umuyobozi w'umupira w'amaguru ufite uruhushya rwa CAF "A". Kimoto yayoboye AS Dragons / Bilima na JS Kinshasa mbere yo kugirwa umuyobozi wa FC Renaissance du Congo muri Ukuboza 2018.
Kugenda neza, birashobora no gukoreshwa nkikintu cyo hagati.

Christian Kinkela Fuanda, (Yavutse Ku ya 25 Gicurasi 1982 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Mu rubyiruko, yambaraga cyane amabara ya Red Star 93 kuva muri 1994 kugeza 1995 m'ugihe kitarenze imyaka 13. Yavuye muri 2001 yinjira muri Stade Lavallois aho yakinnye n'ikipe yabigenewe muri CFA2.
Yabaye umunyamerika mpuzamahanga kuva muri 2005. Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2010-2011, yagize uruhare mu kuzamuka kwa AC Ajaccio muri Ligue ya 1 abona umwanya wa 3 ku rutonde. Yatsinze ibitego icyenda bya shampiyona anatanga imipira umunani. Ikinyamakuru cy’umupira w'amaguru mu Bufaransa cya mwitiriye mu ikipe isanzwe ya Ligue 2 mu mpera za shampiyona.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2011-2012 muri L1, Christian Kinkela yi tabiriye imikino 29 ya shampiyona, atsinda ibitego 3 abonwa n'ikipe ya Corsican iguma mu ntore z’umupira w’amaguru mu Bufaransa.

Bijou Kisombe Mundaba (yavutse Ku ya 29 Nzeri 1976 ho muri Zayire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nka myugariro.

Ari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika muri1998, 2002 na 2004. Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu muri iri rushanwa muri 1998.
Yakinnye kandi imikino itandatu ibara mu kibanza cy'igikombe cy'isi, mu gihe cyo muri 1998 na 2002.

Alain Kizamba ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo wa kinnye nku muzamu.

Andre Ngole Kona cyangwa Andre N'Gole Kona (Yavutse Ku ya 16 Kamena 1970 i Lubumbashi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu cyahoze ari muri Zayire. Yakinaga nka rutahizamu.
Yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru mu gihugu cye kavukire kandi akurikirana amakipe ya Lubumbashi (FC Lubumbashi Sport) na Barumbu (SM Bibicha). Hanyuma yagiye mu kigo cyigisha imyitozo cya Jomo Cosmos muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 1993–94, Andre Kona yakiniyeikipe ya Gençlerbirliği.
Mu gutsinda ibitego 74 harimo penariti 12 kuri Gençlerbirliği, yabaye umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri 1958.
Hagati yo muri 1993 (Ku ya 23 Kanama 1993) na 2001 (iKu ya 26 Gicurasi 2001), yakinnye imikino 147 yose hamwe iminota 12 458 kuriyi kipe.
Imyitwarire ye myiza yaje muri shampiyona ya 1993–94, ubwo yatsindaga ibitego 21 byose mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Turukiya
akinira ikipe ya Antalyaspor, hanyuma yongera gukinira Gençlerbirliği, hanyuma akinira Diyarbakirspor hanyuma asoreza muri İstanbulspor A. Ş..
Ni umwe mu bakinnyi bonyine muri Turukiya batsinze ibitego birenga 100 muri Shampiyona ya Turukiya.

Ntishobora gufatirwa hamwe nizindi zose ” de la famille/LIVRE I DE LA NATIONALITE.htm 1.

Restituta Joseph Kemi (yavutse 30 Nyakanga 1971 i Singida) ni uwiruka wa ukomoka muri Tanzaniya. Yatwaye ibendera inshuro ebyiri rya Tanzaniya mu birori byo gutangiza imikino Olempike yo muri 2000 na 2004.
Yatsinze muri 1997 na 1999 yatsinze isiganwa rya Corrida de Langueux.

Sara Ramadhani Makera (yavutse 30 Ukuboza 1987) ni umunyatanzaniya wiruka muri marato. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya marato y'abagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016 aho yarangije ku mwanya wa 121 akoresheje isaha ya 3:00:03.
Muri 2019, yaserukiye Tanzaniya mu mikino nyafurika yo muri 2019 yabereye i Rabat, muri Maroke. Yarushanwe muri kimwe cya kabiri cya marato y'abagore gusa ntabwo yarangije isiganwa rye.

Magdalena Crispin Shauri (yavutse ku ya 25 Gashyantare 1996) ni umukinnyi wiruka intera ndende ukomoka muri Tanzaniya. Yitabiriye marato y'abagore muri Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2017 mu biruka. Muri 2019, yitabiriye irushanwa ry'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IAAF yo muri 2019. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 49.

Angelina Daniel Tsere (yavutse ku ya 23 Kanama 1999) ni umukinnyi wiruka intera ndende muri Tanzaniya. Yitabiriye amarushanwa y'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IAAF yo muri 2019 yabereye i Aarhus, muri Danimarike. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 78.
Muri 2017, yitabiriye amarushanwa y'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa ya IAAF mu marushanwa yisi muri 2017 yabereye i Kampala, muri Uganda. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 37.

Nataliya Elisante Sulle (yavutse ku ya 19 Nyakanga 1988) ni umunya Tanzaniya wiruka intera ndende. Yitabiriye amarushanwa y'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IAAF yo muri 2019 yabereye i Aarhus, muri Danimarike. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 68.
Muri 2019, yaserukiye muri Tanzaniya mu mikino nyafurika yabereye i Rabat, muri Maroke. Yarushanwe muri kimwe cya kabiri cya marato y'abagore arangiza ku mwanya wa 7 akoresheje amasaha 1:14:33.

Zakia Mrisho Mohamed (yavutse ku ya 19 Gashyantare 1984) ni umunya Tanzaniya wiruka intera ndende yari kabuhariwe mu kwiruka m'u muhanda. Yahagarariye igihugu cye muri metero 5000 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 no mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2012.
Yavukiye i Singida, Yitabiriye irushanwa rye rya mbere mpuzamahanga ry’imikino ngororamubiri muri 2003, yiruka muri metero 3000 aho yarangije ari uwa gatandatu. Yatsinze muri Cinque Mulini mu kuzenguruka ibihugu muri 2004, abaye umugore wa mbere wo muri Tanzaniya wa bikoze. Yatoranijwe mu marushanwa ya IAAF muri 2005, kandi abasha kurangiza ku mwanya wa makumyabiri mu isiganwa rirerire. Yaje ku mwanya wa gatandatu muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona yisi yo muri 2005 mu isiganwa, na gatatu ku mukino wanyuma wisimuri metero 3000 nyuma yu kwezi. Yahagarariye Tanzaniya mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2006, arangiza ari uwamunani muri metero 5000 ari kuri finale.
Mu marushanwa ya IAAF yo muri 2007 yari ku mwanya wa 23 muri rusange ariko ntiyatsinze neza inzira, ananirwa kugera muri metero 5000, ashyushye muri Shampiyona yisi yo muri 2007 mu isiganwa. Amahirwe nk'ayo yamutegereje mu mikino Olempike ya mbere yabereye i Beijing umwaka ukurikira, nu bwo yashoboye kurangiza umwanya wa kane muri metero 3000, ku mukino wa nyuma wa IAAF ku Isi yo muri 2008 kimwe no guhatanira metero 5000. Yageze ku mukino wa nyuma ukomeye ku isi muri shampiyona itaha muri Shampiyona y’isi yo muri 2009 yaberaga mu isiganwa, afata umwanya wa 15 muri metero 5000.

Amina Mohamed Mgoo (yavutse ku ya 22 Nyakanga 1998) ni umunya Tanzaniya Witabiriye amarushanwa y'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IAAF yo muri 2019 yabereye i Aarhus, muri Danimarike. Yarangije ku mwanya wo kuri 99.
Muri 2017, yitabiriye irushanwa ry'abagore bato mu marushanwa ya IAAF mu kuzenguruka isi muri 2017 yabereye i Kampala, muri Uganda. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 68.

Failuna Abdi Matanga (yavutse 28 Ukwakira 1992) ni umunya Tanzaniyakazi wiruka birebire. Yarushanwe muri metero 10,000 mu bagore muri Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2017 mu isiganwa. Muri 2019, yitabiriye irushanwa ry'abagore bakuru mu marushanwa ya IAAF ya kuzenguruka isi, yabereye muri Aarhus, Danimarike. Yarangije ku mwanya wa 16.
Muri Kamena 2021, yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo ahagararire Tanzaniya mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2020.

Anna Ndege (yavutse ku ya 5 Werurwe 1982 i Shinyanga) ni umukinnyi wiruka hagati ukomoka muri Tanzaniya. Ibihe byiza bye ni iminota 4: 09.71 kuri metero 1500 ni agahigo ko muri Tanzaniya mu intera ndende.
Ibisubizo bye byiza ni umwanya wa cumi n'icyenda mu isiganwa rigufi muri Shampiyona yisi ya muri 2001. Yigeze guhagararira Tanzaniya inshuro ebyiri mu marushanwa ku rwego rwo hejuru, yiruka mu isiganwa rigufi muri 2001 na 2002. Yitabiriye imikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2002, yiruka muri metero 800 na metero 1500. Yatsindiye umudari muto muri izo ntera zombi mu mikino ya gisirikare ya Afurika.

Nzaeli Kyomo (yavutse ku ya 2 Kamena 1957) ni Umunyatanzaniya wahoze yiruka mu marushanwa yitabiriye imikino ya Olempike ya Moscou muri 1980 mu burusiya no muri 1984 muri Amerika. Niwe washinze Kyomo.org itanga uburezi bw'ibanze, imyambaro n'ibiryo ku bana ba Tanzaniya. Ni umubyinnyi kandi akaba umunyamuryango wu buhanzi bwaba Olempike.

Adriana Alves (yavutse ku ya 13 Nzeri 1995) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru muri Angola. Yarushanwe muri metero zigera ku 100 mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2015 yabereye i Beijing, mu bushinwa, gusa ntiyakomeje imbere mu cyiciro cya mbere.
ni Umunyatanzaniya wahoze yiruka mu marushanwa yitabiriye imikino ya Olempike ya Moscou muri 1980 mu burusiya no muri 1984 muri Amerika. Niwe washinze Kyomo.org itanga uburezi bw'ibanze, imyambaro n'ibiryo ku bana ba Tanzaniya. Ni umubyinnyi kandi akaba umunyamuryango wu buhanzi bwaba Olempike.

Esperança Gicaso (yavutse 2 Nyakanga 1992) ni umukinnnyi ukina imikino ngororamubiri ukomoka muri Angola. Yabaye nk'ibendera rya Angola mu mikino Paralympike yo muri 2016. Gicaso yari mu irushanwa mu byiciro bya T11 kubakinnyi batabona.
Ibintu byingenzi byerekana umwuga.
Gicaso yatangiye imyitozo ya siporo muri 2008. Muri 2011, yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu birometero bigera 100 kuri T11 mu mikino nya furika yabereye i Maputo, muri Mozambike. Yitabiriye imikino Paralympike yo muri 2012 muri metero 100, T11 na metero 200 muri T11, na metero 400 muri T12. gusa Ntabwo yazamutse ku mukino w'anyuma w'ibi birori.
Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri yo muri IPC 2013 yabereye i Lyon mu Bufaransa, Gicaso yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 200 muri T11. Mu mikino nya furika yo muri 2015 yabereye i Brazzaville, muri Repubulika ya Kongo, yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 100 T11.
Gicaso yari afite ibendera rya Angola mu birori byo gutangiza imikino Paralympike yo muri 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro. Yarushanwe muri metero 100, metero 200, na metero 400 T11.
Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri ya Para muri 2017 yabereye i Londres, Gicaso yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 100 muri T11 n'umudari wa feza muri metero 200 T11. Yatowe nk'umukinnyi ufite agaciro kurusha abandi muri 2017 n'ishyirahamwe ry'abakinnyi b'imikino Olempike muri Angola.
Gicaso aba i Maianga, muri Angola. Yigisha Igiporutugali ku ishuri rya Luanda.

Neide Dias (yavutse ku ya 11 Kanama 1987) ni umukinnyikazi ukomoka muri Angola wiruka muri metero 800 na 1500.
Yabaye uwa munani mu marushanwa ya bereye Ibero-Amerika yo muri 2004 muri metero 400, uwa gatandatu mu mikino ya Lusophony yo muri 2009 muri metero 800, icyenda mu mikino ny'afurika yo muri 2015 metero 1500 na munani mu mikino nyafurika ya 2019 muri metero 1500.
Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa ya Ibero-Amerika yo muri 2010 metero 800, Imikino Nyafurika yo muri 2015 muri metero 800, na Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2019 muri metero 1500 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.
Ibihe byiza yagize ni iminota 2: 07.01 muri metero 800, yagezweho muri kamena 2014 i Bilbao; n'iminota 4: 17.35 muri metero 1500, byagezweho muri kamena 2019 i Braga. Iheruka ni yandikwa rya Angola.

Ana Isabel Elias (yavutse ku ya 17 Nzeri 1965) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Angola, akaba yiruka hagati. Yitabiriye metero 1500 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1992.
ni Umunyangola wahoze yiruka mu marushanwa yitabiriye imikino ya Olempike ya Moscou muri 1980 mu burusiya no muri 1984 muri Amerika. Niwe washinze Kyomo.org itanga uburezi bw'ibanze, imyambaro n'ibiryo ku bana ba Tanzaniya. Ni umubyinnyi kandi akaba umunyamuryango wu buhanzi bwaba Olempike.

Teresa Nzola Meso Ba (yavutse 30 Ugushyingo 1983, i Luanda) ni umunyaAngola ufite ubwene gihugu bw'Ubufaransa usimbuka gatatu.
Yahoze ahagarariye Angola, ariko nyuma yerekeza mu Bufaransa muri 2003. Mbere yibi yashyizeho agahigo yo gusimbuka inshuro eshatu muri Angola ya metero 13.49, n'ubu niwe ukigafite.
Nzola Meso Ba yarangije ari uwa cyenda muri Shampiyona yo mu Burayi 2006. Mu marushanwa yo mu nzu, yo mu Burayi yo muri 2007, yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu gahigo mu bafaransa ndetse no gusimbuka metero 14.49. Yasimbutse neza mbere yibi birori yari metero 14.07, yagezweho muri 2006.
Yaje kwitabira amarushanwa yisi yo muri 2007, Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2008 ndetse n'imikino Olempike yo muri 2008 atageze ku mukino wa nyuma. Yateje imbere ubuzima bwe kugera kuri metero 14,69 muri Kamena 2007 i Munich.

Christine Ayanda Botlogetswe (yavutse 1 Ukwakira 1995) ni usiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Botswana uhatanira cyane muri metero 400. Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 2016, yiruka iminota igera 52.37 yujuje ibyangombwa mu cyiciro cya mbere. Yirukanka muri Orapa Athletics Club kandi atozwa na Justice Dipeba, unatoza na Isaac Makwala, Umugabo wari muri barindwi wihuta cyane mu mateka.
Yujuje ibisabwa kugirango ahagararire Botswana mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2020.

Lydia Casey Jele (yavukiye i Mashila; yavutse ku ya 22 Kamena 1990) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Botswana, wiruka muri metero 400. Yitabiriye mu kwerekanwa muri Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2013, ntago yari yujuje ibisabwa kuirango ajye ku mukino wa nyuma. Yirutse metero 400 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016. yaje kuzuza ibisabwa atsindira Amarushanwa y’ishyirahamwe ryimikino ngororamubiri muri Botswana.
Ibihe byiza yagize ni amasegonda 11.51 muri metero 100, 24.55 muri metero 200 (-0.1, Shenzhen 2011) niminota 52,65 muri metero 400 (Porto Novo 2012). Jele ni Uwera.

Loungo Matlhaku (yavutse ku ya 24 Werurwe 1995) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Botswana uhatanira muri metero 200. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza mu kwiruka metero 4 × 400 mu mikino ya bavuga icyongereza muri 2018. Byongeye kandi, yatsindiye imidari myinshi kurwego rwa karere.

Amantle Montsho (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1983) ni umukinyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Botswana kabuhariwe muri metero 400. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2004 na 2008, agera ku mukino wa nyuma ku nshuro ye ya nyuma. Niwe mugore wa mbere wahagarariye Botswana mu mikino Olempike. Yagiye kandi mu marushanwa y'isi yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri ndetse na Shampiyona y'isi ya IAAF, kandi yahoze arishampiyo w'isi hejuru ya metero 400, yatsinze mu bihe byiza bya 49.56 i Daegu.
Montsho yahagaritswe imyaka ibiri azira kutubahiriza amategeko yo kurwanya ibyongera imbaraga, nyuma yo gupimisha mu mikino ya bavuga ivyongereza muri 2014.
Mu Amarushanwa ya Afurika, inshuro ebyiri yegukanye umudari wa zahabu hejuru muri metero 400, yatsindiye kandi ibikombe muri ibyo birori mu mikino yaberaga muri Afurika muri 2007, Igikombe cy’umugabane wa IAAF muri 2010 ndetse n’imikino yabavua icyongereza muri 2010. Intsinzi ya yabavua icyongereza yatumye Botswana ye gukana umudari wa zahabu wa mbere muri iyo mikino.
Ibihe bye byiza ni amasegonda 11,60 muri metero 100, amasegonda 22.89 muri metero 200, n'amasegonda 49.33 muri metero 400. Yitoje mu kigo cyigisha imyitozo i Dakar, muri Senegali, kandi afite agahigo k’igihugu muri metero 400 haba mu nzu no hanze.
Montsho yavukiye i Maun, muri Ngamilande. Yitabiriye imikino Olempikeyo muri 2004, Imikino ya yabavua icyongereza muri 2006 na Shampiyona y'isi muri 2005 na 2007 gusa atageze ku mukino wa nyuma.
Yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona nyafurika muri 2006 ndetse n'umudari wa zahabu mu mikino yo muri Afurika muri 2007. Mu mikino ya Afurika yose, yarangije kandi umwanya wa gatanu muri metero 200. Mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 2006 ya IAAF yarangije ku mwanya wa gatandatu hamwe n'ikipe ny'afurika ya metero 4x400. Yayoboye ibyiza ku giti cye na Botswana ya amasegonda 49.83 yo gutsinda muri Shampiyona nyafurika yo muri 2008 muri isiganwa. Iracyari amateka ya Shampiyona k'ubirori.
Amantle Montsho yize mu ishuri ribanza rya Bonatla i Maun.

Tsaone Sebele (yavutse 27 Ukwakira 1993) ni umukinnyi usiganwa ukomoka muri Botswanan kabuhariwe muri metero 100 na 200.
Muri metero 100 yarangije kuwa munani mu mikino nyafurika yo muri 2015 nuwa karindwi muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2018. Yageze mu cyiciro cya 2 muri kaminuza yo muri 2017. Goitseone Seleka (yavutse ku ya 10 Kanama 1988) ni umukinnyi Ukomoka muri Botswana uhatanira muri metero 400. Yitabiriye metero 4 × 400 mu marushanwa ya Shampiyona y'isi muri 2013 atujuje ibisabwa ku mukino wa nyuma. Goitseone yavukiye kandi akurira mu mudugudu witwa Nkange.

Umusozi wa Satima, uzwi kandi nk' umusozi wa Lesatima ukunze kwitwa Satima cyangwa Lesatima, niwo musozi wa gatatu muremure muri Kenya kandi muremure muri Aberdare Range. Izina rya Maasai ni Oldoinyo Lesatima, rifite ubundi buryo butandukanye, nka Ol Donyo Le Satima, kandi risobanura "umusozi w'inyana y'inka".
Impinga iri mu majyaruguru ya Aberdares, nayo ubwayo iri mu burasirazuba bw'ikibaya kinini cya Rift, kandi niho hantu harehare. Hafi yacyo hari umubare munini w'ibirunga bikarishye byitwa "Amenyo y'ikiyoka". Hano hari moraine iri hagati ya metero 3,600 na metero 3,800 mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'umusozi. Igitabo kimwe kivuga kuri Kenya cyise umusozi ubwawo"urutare runini rw'ibyatsi n'ibyatsi bya tussock bizenguruka ibicu".

Magali Franka (yavutse ku ya 24 Mutarama 1990 i Lyon, mu Bufaransa) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru uhatanira ku rwego ruri mpuzamahanga muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, uhatana mu bagore

Safi Nyembo (yavutse ku ya 23 Nzeri 1984) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'umudage wavukiye muri congo ukina nku mukinnyi ukina imbere mu kibuga.
Safi Nyembo yavutse ku ya 23 Nzeri 1984 i Kinshasa, muri Zayire.
Nyembo yatangiye umwuga we muri FSV Schierstein maze ava mu gihe afite munsi yimwaka 16 mu mpeshyi ya 2001 muri Oberliga yerekeza muri SG Germania Wiesbaden. Muri shampiyona ya 2004/2005, yimukiyekwai mukeba wabo FFC Frankfurt maze atangaza ku ya 5 Ukuboza 2004. umukino we wa mbere muri Bundesliga. Amaze gukina umukino umwe, yimukiye mu mujyi wa FSV Frankfurt aho yabonye amahirwe yo gukina imikino 22. Muri 2006, yagarutse muri FFC Frankfurt akina mu ikipe yabo ya kabiri. Nyuma yi gihembwe muri Bundesliga ya 2, yagumye mu bubiko bw'ikipe ya 1 ya FFC Frankfurt. Nyembo yahisemo kwimukira muri 1 FC Lokomotive Leipzig. Yahise aba umukinnyi uzwi cyane hamwe niyi kipe, atsinda ibitego 35 mu mikino 79 mu myaka itanu. Muri Werurwe 2012, Nyembo yahagaritswe nyuma yo kunengwa n'inama, kandi kuva icyo gihe akina mu ikipe ya kabiri gusa. Nyuma yi myaka itanu i Leipzig yakinnye kugeza muri kamena 2012 mbere yuko ahinduka muri Bundesliga aherutse kuzamurwa mu ikipe ya VfL Sindelfingen. Nyuma yi kigeragezo cyatsinze yahisemo kwimurirwa muri FF USV Jena, aho yasinye amasezerano yi myaka ibiri. Mu mpeshyi yo muri 2013 yishe amasezerano ye, yari gutangira kugeza ku ya 30 Kamena 2014, i Jena maze yinjira mu muryango FFV Leipzig wari umaze gushingwa, umuryango uzasimbura amakipe y’abagore ya FC Lokomotive Leipzig. Nyuma yo kuva muri FFV Leipzig muri Regionalliga muri 2016/2017, yinjiye mu ikipe yashinzwe FC Phoenix.

Beatrice Kamuchanga Alice (yavutse ku ya 20 Ugushyingo 1997) ni umukinnyi wiruka intera ndende kuva muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 2016 mu kwiruka metero 5000 mu bagore ; umwanya we wabaye amasaha 19: 29.47 mu bushuhe ntabwo w'ujuje ibyangombwa bya nyuma.

Fathia Ali Bouraleh (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukwakira 1987) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru uhatanira ku rwego mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Djibouti.
Ali Bouraleh yavuze ko yabonye kwiruka byihuse kuko akiri muto, yari umujura. Ali Bouraleh yatangiye imyitozo ya siporo muri 2004 mu mashuri yisumbuye. Yatsinze mu birori mu ishuri ryisumbuye, kandi ashimisha umutoza bihagije ku buryo yamutumiriye gusubira mu myitozo kabiri mu cyumweru. Yamuhaye kandi inkweto zo kwiruka, amusezeranya ko azamwigisha mu ishuri rye. Yitoje kuri sitade, kuko iyo yirukaga mu muhanda abantu bamuteraga amabuye bakamutuka, nubwo yari yambaye ipantaro ndende nigitambara cyo mu mutwe. Amazina ye ni "Mama," kandi niba abayirebaga batutse Ali Bouraleh biruka, bagenzi be barabasakuza bati "Ntutuke Mama wacu!"
Ali Bouraleh yaserukiye Djibouti mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 yabereye i Beijing nk'umukinnyi wa kabiri wa Olempike wa Djibouti. Yarushanwe muri metero 100 yiruka ashyira umunani mubushuhe bwe atarazamuka mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Yatangiye ibinyoma mu gerageza kwe kwa mbere. Mugerageza kwa kabiri, yirutse afite amasegonda 14.29, umwe mubatinze umwaka. Yarangije bwa nyuma mu bushyuhe bwe hamwe nigihe cya kabiri cyatinze muri rusange. Bouraleh yarushanijwe n'igitambaro cyo mu mutwe, ku bwe we ntibyagize ingaruka ku gihe cye cyo kurangiza.
Ubu arimo gutoza Abakobwa kwiruka 2, hamwe na Cintia Guzman. Yibera kandi atoza mumurwa mukuru, Djibouti, niho kimwe cya kabiri cyabakobwa biruka hari ikipe 2. Usibye gutoza abakinnyi, Bouraleh anatanga ibikoresho n'inkunga y'amafaranga kubakinnyi aho imyitozo yombi.

Zourah Ali uzwi kandi ku izina rya Souhra Ali Mohamed (yavutse ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 1994) ni umwirutsiukomoka muri jibuti. Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 2012 na 2020.
Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 2012 mu birometero 400, ayirangiza mu isaha 1: 05.37. Ntabwo yashyize hejuru bihagije mu bushyuhe bwe kugirango abashe kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kuko yarangije kumwanya wa 44 ndetse n'igihe cya kabiri cyatinze muri iri siganwa. Nyuma y'imikino Olempike, Zourah yatewe inkunga n'abasirikare barinda Repubulika, akaba ari ishami rya gisirikare ririnda perezida. Zourah niwe mukinnyi we nyine w’umukobwa mu barinzi ba republika mu gihe runaka, ariko hiyongereyeho abakinnyi nka Kadra Mohamed Dembil, bagura ikipe yabo y’abagore. Yabaye ibendera rya Djibouti mu birori byo gutangiza.
Yitabiriye imikino ya Afurika Yose yo muri 2011 yabereye i Maputo, na 2011 Pan Arab Games yabereye i Doha, 2017 Pan Arab Games yabereye i Baku, Shampiyona y’Abarabu muri Cayiro, na 2019 muri Afurika i Rabat.
Yongeye kwitabira imikino Olempike yo muri 2020, mu birometero 1500.

Kadra Mohamed Dembil (yavutse ku ya 22 Mata 1997) ni uwo muri Somaliya na jibuti wiruka mu ntera yo hagati utuye Ali Sabieh. Kadra yaretse amashuri yisumbuye. Avuga ko Abanyasomaliya kandi azi Igifaransa.
Kadra yinjiye mu ikipe, y'Abakobwa Run 2, mu mwaka wo muri 2012, yishyuye ibikoresho byo gukora, gutwara abantu mu murwa mukuru kugira ngo bahatane mu marushanwa, ndetse n'amafaranga y'ishuri. Muri iyo kipe, niwe wihuta cyane mu kwiruka metero 3000, ku buryo bigoye kwitoza kubera ko nta bahanganye nawe bafasha gukomeza umuvuduko. Imikino ngororamubiri yatoje irimo inzira, imbogamizi, hamwe n'uburemere bukozwe mu mata y'ifu yuzuye ifu yuzuye sima. Kadra yatangiye shampiyona muri 2013–14 hamwe n'abakobwa biruka 2, ariko ahabwa akazi nabashinzwe kurinda repubulika (abasirikari bashinzwe kurinda perezida), arangiza igihe cye nabo.
Amarushanwa ya Olempike.
Iri yerekanwa ryiyongereye ryatumye amenyekana bihagije ko yoherejwe mu mikino Olempike y’abato muri 2014 yabereye i Nanjing mu kwiruka metero 2000, asiganwa atigeze yiruka mbere. Kumenyereza, urwobo rwabanje kuzuzwa umusego, kuko amazi nigicuruzwa cyiza muri Djibouti. Kadra amaze kubimenyera, urwobo rwuzuyemo amazi kugirango ashobore kwitoza imikino Olempike.
