Nubwo Kadra yinjiye mu mikino Olempike yabato afite amateka mabi ku giti cye, yarangije afite amasaha 7:07, yica agahigo ye ku masegonda 50 arangiza ari uwa 11 mu bushyuhe bwa mbere. Mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe bwa kabiri, Kadra yaguye ku isimbuka ry'amazi ya gatatu, amusubiza inyuma ku mwanya wa 5; iyo uhujwe nubushyuhe bwa mbere, umwanya we wanyuma wari umwanya wa 14.
Yitabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 2016 mu kwiruka metero 1500 mu bagore; umwanya we ni amasaha 4: 42.67 mu bushuhe ntabwo wujuje ibisabwa muri kimwe cya kabiri.

Roda Ali Wais ni umukinnyi wo hagati mu kwiruka uhatana muri Djibouti mbere yo kwerekeza muri Ositaraliya.
Ali Wais yari afite imyaka cumi n'itandatu gusa kandi ni umugore wambere wo muri jibuti uhagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino olempike ubwo yitabiriye imikino olempike yo muri 2000 yabereye i Sydney, yinjiye muri metero 800 yaje nyuma yu bushyuhe ku buryo atujuje ibisabwa kugirango akomeze mu cyiciro gikurikira. Nyuma yo gusiganwa, Ali Wais yerekeje muri Ositaraliya abifashijwemo n’umunya ositaraliya wo muri Somaliya, aho yashakanye n’umunya ositaraliya kandi afite abana. Ntabwo yongeye guhatanira muri jibuti.

Adanech Anbesa Feyisa (yavutse ku ya 23 Mutarama 1998) ni umunyetiyopiya wiruka muri metero 1500.
Umwuga wa Biografiya n'umwuga wo gusiganwa.
Yatsindiye umudari wa umuringa muri metero 1500 muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2016 yabereye i Durban, avunika ibyiza bye muri minota 4 amasegonda 5 s 22.

Yengus Dese Azenaw (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1992) ni umukinnyikazi ukina paralempike wo muri Etiyopiya. Yahagarariye Etiyopiya muri 2012 ndetse no mu mikino Paralympike yo muri 2016. yitabiriye ibirori bya muri metero 100, 200 na 400. Yengus Azenaw yashishikarijwe kuba umukinnyi w'abigize umwuga na mwarimu w’ishuri ribanza.

Worknesh Musele Handeno (yavutse ku ya 10 Kamena 2001) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Etiyopiya, wegukanye ibikombe bya shampiyona y'igihugu ya Etiyopiya muri metero zirenga 400 na metero 800.
Musele yirutse ku nshuro ya 11 yihuta ku isi muri 2021 muri metero 800 z'abagore ubwo yarangizaga Ikigeragezo cya Olempike. Yabanje kwitabira imikino Nyafurika yo muri 2019 yabereye i Kabat muri metero 400 na metero 4x400.
Yirutse ku giti cye 1:58:71 muri metero 800 mu isiganwa ry’imikino Olempike ya Etiyopiya arangiza ku mwanya wa gatatu nyuma ya Werkwuha Getachew na Habitam Alemu muri Kamena 2021 kugira ngo abone umwanya we mu mikino Olempike yatinze ya Tokiyo yo muri 2020. Ibyiza bye byambere byari byiza 2:02:20. Yamenyekanye mu ikipe ya Etiyopiya mu mikino, ariko nti yigeze ahatana. Ku ya 30 Kamena 2021, yatsindiye metero 800 mu nama yo kwibuka Urwibutso rwa Irena Szewińska yabereye i Bydgoszcz mu ruzinduko rw’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi uri 2021, yarushije mugenzi we Diribe Welteji amasegonda.07.
Muri Werurwe 2022 Mesele yegukanye umwanya wa kabiri mu gihugu ye gukana metero 800 muri Hawassa. Yabaye uwa kane muri Shampiyona yo muri 2022 ny'afurika mu kwiruka - Isiganwa rya metero 800 mu bagore.

Medina Eisa (yavutse 3 Mutarama 2005) ni umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende. Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu muri metero 5000 mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri y’abatarengeje imyaka 2022 na feza mu isiganwa ry’abato muri Shampiyona y’isi yo muri 2023.
Muri Kamena 2021, afite imyaka 16, Medina Eisa yegukanye umwanya wa cumi mu kwiruka metero 5000 mu bigeragezo by'imikino Olempike ya Etiyopiya mbere y’imikino Olempike yatinze yabereye i Tokiyo.
Muri Mata 2022, yaje ku mwanya wa kane mu birori mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri ya Etiyopiya yabereye Hawassa, akoresha igihe cya 15: 50.3. Yatwaye umudari wa zahabu ku bagore muri metero 5000 mu marushanwa y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 yabereye i Cali, muri Kolombiya muri Kanama, isaha 15: 29.71 imbere ya mugenzi we Melknat Wudu hamwe na Prisca Chesang wa Uganda uri ku mwanya wa gatatu. Mu Kwakira, Eisa yatsindiye Irilande y'Amajyaruguru Mpuzamahanga kilometero 6 kwiruka byabereye i Dundoland, Belfast m'ugihe cya 21:07.
Muri Gashyantare 2023, yegukanye umudari wa feza mu marushanwa y'abagore bato mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yakuzenguruka isi, yiruka amasaha 21:00 arangiza amasegonda arindwi inyuma ya mugenzi we Senayet Getachew. Hamwe na kimwe cya kabiri Etiyopiya yatwaye zahabu kurutonde rw'amakipe.

Mekides Abebe Demewoz (yavutse 29 Nyakanga 2001) ni umukinnyi ukomka muri Etiyopiya. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya metero 3000 y'abagore mu gusiganwa ku maguru mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri yo muri 2019.
Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu kwiruka metero 3000 mu bagore mu mikino ny'afurika yo muri 2019 ndetse n'umudari wa feza mu kwiruka metero 2000 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike y'urubyiruko 2018.
Yarushanwe mu kwiruka metero 3000 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2020.

Elvan Abeylegesse, (nanone yahoze ari Hewan Abeye na Elvan Can umunyaTurukiya wavutse ku ya 11 Nzeri 1982) ni Umunyetiyopiya ukomoka muri Turukiya ukomoka mu gihugu cya Turukiya wo hagati kandi ufite intera ndende yiruka mu ntera kuva kuri metero 1500 kugeza kuri marato, kandi no mu irushanwa rya mbukiranya igihugu. Niwe wahoze afite agahigo ku isi- afite metero 5000, ku minota 14: 24.68.
Muri Kanama 2015, Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri muri Turukiya ryemeje ko ikizamini cyo kurwanya ibyo ngera imbaraga cyakozwe mu marushanwa y’isi ya 2007 yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri cyagarutsweho kandi ugasanga ari cyiza ku kintu cyagenzuwe, kandi ko uyu mukinnyi yahagaritswe by'agateganyo mu gihe hagitegerejwe ko bamusuzuma 'B' -Urugero '. Niba byemejwe, Abeylegesse yahagaritse gutakaza umudari we muri 2007, ndetse n'ibindi bihembo guhera kuri iyo tariki. Ku ya 29 Werurwe 2017, IAAF yemeje ikizamini cyiza, ihagarika ibisubizo bye kuva ku ya 25 Kanama 2007 kugeza ku ya 25 Kanama 2009 (bityo imwambura imidari ibiri ya feza yari yatsindiye mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008), imubuza imikino ngororamubiri imyaka ibiri.
Ubuzima bwambere nakazi.
Ibintu byingenzi byerekana umwuga.
Ku ya 3 Kamena 2006, igihe cye cyo kwandika yakubiswe n'umunyetiyopiya Meseret Defar, wirutse muri 14: 24.53 mu mujyi wa New York.
Yirutse mu irushanwa rya mbere ry’isi 10K Bangalore muri 2008 arangiza ashyushye hamwe na Grace Momanyi, abasiganwa bombi amaherezo batangazwa ko batsinze.
Yahawe igikombe cya Pierre de Coubertin mu mwaka wo muri 2010, igihembo ngarukamwaka gitangwa na komite mpuzamahanga yo gukina imurikagurisha. Yagurije inkweto zo kwiruka umunywanyi Meselech Melkamu mbere gato yuko itangira rya metero 10,000 ry'anyuma muri Shampiyona yisi yaberaga mu isiganwa 2009. Melkamu amaze kwibagirwa kuzana inkweto ze kumurongo, yagiye gufata ifeza.
Abeylegesse yatsindiye irushanwa rya Ras Al Khaimah Half Marathon muri 2010 mu gihe cya 1:07:07. Iki nicyo gihe cyihuta cyane k'umugore mu marushanwa ya kimwe cya kabiri cya marato kandi amugira umugore wa gatandatu wihuta muri rusange. Yakinnye ibyifuzo byo guhindurwa burundu mu masiganwa maremare yo mu muhanda, ariko, avuga ko umukino wa mbere wa marato ugomba gutegereza kugeza nyuma yimikino Olempike izabera i Londres 2012.

Habitam Alemu Bayih (yavutse ku ya 9 Nyakanga 1997) ni Umunyetiyopiyakazi wiruka intera yo hagati, wazobereye muri metero 800.
Alemu wavukiye i Merawi, muri Etiyopiya, yashishikarijwe kugerageza kwiruka n'umwarimu w'ishuri w'amwinjiye mu marushanwa ye ya mbere, yatsinze. Yakomeje gushishikarizwa na murumuna we, atangira imyitozo ikomeye, nyuma yo kwiruka muri shampiyona y’igihugu, yatumiriwe kujya mu ikipe i Addis Abeba.
Alemu yaserukiye igihugu ciwe mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2015, kandi yarabaye mu barangihe mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2016. Mu mikino Olempike ya Rio 2016, yakoresheje uko ashoboye kugira ngo atere imbere binyuze mu bushyuhe, ariko asezererwa muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.
Yashyize ku mwanya wa gatandatu muri metero 800 mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yo 2020.
Alemu yinjije inshuro ebyiri zose muri metero 800 World indoor Tour, yatsinze muri 2019 no muri 2021.

Abeba Aregawi Gebretsadik (yavutse ku ya 5 Nyakanga 1990) ni Umunyetiyopiya na Suwede wirukanye intera ndende yiruka muri metero 1500. Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 1500 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2012 ndetse n'umudari wa zahabu muri Shampiyona y'isi muri 2013. Yahagarariye Etiyopiya na Suwede ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Aregawi yavukiye i Adigrat, muri Etiyopiya mu karere ka Tigray. Yahagarariye Etiyopiya ku rwego mpuzamahanga kugeza mu Kuboza 2012, amaze kuba umwenegihugu wa Suwede. Yahagarariye ikipe ya Hammarby ikorera i Stockholm NIBA kugeza Mutarama 2016.
Aregawi yashakanye n'umugabo wo muri Etiyopiya ufite ubwenegihugu bwa Suwede kandi aba i Stockholm kuva muri 2009 kugeza 2012. Yemane Tsegay akaba atuye i Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya.
Aregawi yagaragaye nk'iruka metero 800 mu 2009 yegukana igikombe cya Etiyopiya muri iri rushanwa mbere ya shampiyona ya Mestawet Tadesse inshuro eshatu. Yarushanwe m'ubihugu byinshi byabanyaburayi nyuma yibi hanyuma ashyiraho ibyiza by'iminota 2: 01.98 muri Tangiers. Igihe cye cyarangiye muri metero 800 umudari wa bronze mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika yo muri 2009, aho yarangirije inyuma ya Caster Semenya.
Yahinduye metero 1500 muri cyiciro ya 2010 kandi yishimira gutsinda yatsinze muri Sollentuna Grand Prix na KBC Ijoro ry'imikino ng ororamubiri, ashyiraho ibyiza by'iminota 4: 01.96 mu marushanwa yanyuma. Yirutse kandi ku muzunguruko wa Diamond League 2010 ku nshuro ya mbere, aza ku mwanya wa kane muri DN Galan na karindwi muri Weltklasse Zurich.

Meskerem Assefa Legesse Wondimagegn (yavutse ku ya 20 Nzeri 1985 i Robe, muri Arsi) ni Umunyetiyopiya wo hagati - kandi wiruka intera ndende. Yahagarariye Etiyopiya mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 na 2012. Afite ibihembo bye bwite harimo iminota 4: 02.12 kuri metero 1500, iminota 8: 46.37 kuri metero 3000 n'amasaha 2:25:11 kuri marato.
Meskerem irushanwa cyane muri 1500. Yitabiriye inshuro ebyiri mu marushanwa y'isi yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri kandi yatwaye umudari wa feza mu marushanwa ya Afurika yo muri 2008 yaberaga muri irushanwa.
Meskerem yatangiye kwiruka amasiganwa yo hagati muri 2001 naho mugihe muri Oregon muri 2003 yirutse metero 800 nziza cyane m'uminota 2: 01.11 na metero 1500 nziza m'uminota 4: 03.96. Yashingiye ahanini muri Amerika kugeza muri 2007. Intsinzi mu mikino yose yabereye muri Etiyopiya yabereye i Addis Abeba ndetse no ku mwanya wa kabiri mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri ya Etiyopiya ya muzaniye umwanya mu mikino yaberaga muri Afurika muri 2007, aho yashyize ku mwanya wa kane yiruka 4: Iminota 09.83.
Umwaka ukurikira yazanye umudari wa mbere ukomeye - niwe wegukanye umudari wa feza inyuma ya Gelete Burka muri metero 1500 muri Shampiyona nyafurika yo muri 2008 muri isiganwa. Kumikino ngororamubiri yo muri Burezile yatsindiye inshuro eshatu zirimo ibyiza by'umuntu w'iminota 2: 02.12 muri metero 800 i Rio de Janeiro. Yirutse neza muri 1500 icyo gihembwe cyari iminota 4: 05.67, cyaje mu nama yabereye i Jerez de la Frontera. Yatorewe guhagararira Etiyopiya mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008, ariko yaje gusezererwa mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'ubushyuhe.

Tigist Assefa Tessema (yavutse ku ya 28 Werurwe 1994) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka n'amaguru mu marato, wahoze ari inzobere mu metero 800. Nyuma yo gutangira umukino wa marato muri Mata 2022, yateye imbere mu minota irenga 18 nyuma ashyiraho ku mwanya wa gatatu mu biihuta cyane ku rutonde rw’ibihe byose ku isi (kuri ubu ni uwa gatanu) muri Marato ya Berlin muri 2022.
Muri 2013, Assefa niwe we gukanye umudari wa metero 800 muri Shampiyona ny'afurika. Hamwe n’umwaka wa 2014 witwaye neza muri ibyo birori, yabaye muri 2022 i Berlin umugore wa mbere mu mateka watsinze iminota ibiri kuri metero 800 na 2:20 kuri marato.
Muri Kanama 2014, Tigist Assefa ye gukanye umwanya wa kane muri metero 800 mu bagore mu marushanwa ny'afurika yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri yabereye muri Marrakesh, muri Maroke. Muri uko kwezi, yatsinze isiganwa mu nama ya ISTAF Berlin y'abereye mu Budage. Muri Nzeri, yarangije ku mwanya wa kane hejuru y'intera mu gikombe cya IAAF Continental Cup, nacyo cyabereye i Marrakesh.
Yakuweho muri metero 800 icyiciro cya mbere cyamarushanwa yisi yo muri 2016 yabereye Portland, Oregon. Uyu musore w'imyaka 22 yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya muri metero 800 ibirori byabereye mu mikino Olempike ya Rio muri 2016, aho atujuje ibyangombwa ashyushye hamwe na shampiyona nziza ya 2: 00.21.
Yahinduye umuhanda ukora muri 2018.
Muri Werurwe 2022, Assefa yerekeje mu ntera ya marato mu marushanwa ya mbere ya Riyadh Marathon muri Arabiya Sawudite, arangiza ku mwanya wa karindwi n'amasaha 2:34:01. Muri Marato y'i Berlin muri Nzeri, umusore w'imyaka 28 yahagaritse isaha mu masaha abiri iminota 15 amasegonda 37, iterambere rirenga iminota 18 ndetse n’umwanya wa gatatu wihuta cyane mu bagore icyo gihe, bitinda gusa 2:14:04 ya ufite agahigo ku isi Brigid Kosgei na 2:15:25 z'uwahoze afite agahio muri Paula Radcliffe. Gutyo yatsinze iminota irenga ibiri, atezi mbere amasomo m'uminota irenga ibiri nigice, anashyiraho amateka ya Etiyopiya. Mu irushanwa ryo gutandukana nabi, igice cye cya kabiri cyirutse mu gihe cya 67:24 cy'arihuse kurusha icyo gihe kimwe cya kabiri cya marathon ku giti cye iminota 67:28, yashyizeho muri Mata uwo mwaka ubwo yatsindaga ibirori agahigo muri Herzogenaurach, no mu Budage.
Ibisobanuro byose biva kumwirondoro w'imikino ngororamubiri.

Umusozi wa Kulal ni ikirunga cyazimye giherereye mu majyaruguru ya Kenya, mu burasirazuba bw'ikiyaga cya Turkana. Umusozi wa Kulal ufite uburebure bwa metero 2,285. Umujyi wa Loiyangalani uri ku kiyaga giherereye muri kilometero 50 i burengerazuba bw'umusozi wa Kulal.
Umusozi Kulal wabungabunzwe kuva mu mwaka wa 1978.
Umusozi Kulal niho honyine habonetse Kulal yera-ijisho ("Zosterops kulalensis").

Mimi Belete Gebregeiorges (yavutse ku ya 9 Kamena 1988) wavukiye muri Umunyetiyopiya yiruka hagati kandi akiruka intera ndende uhatanira ku rwego mpuzamahanga muri Bahirayini. Yatsinze muri metero 5000 mu mikino ya Aziya yo muri 2010.
Yimukiye mu Bubiligi ari impunzi ya politiki ari kumwe na murumuna we, Almensh Belete, na we wiruka. Mu Bubiligi niho yatangiye guhatana: yirutse mu rwibutso rwo muri 2007 Dam Damme i Buruseli kandi ni we wegukanye irushanwa rya Eurocross muri 2009. Yahisemo kwimukira muri Bahrein mu ntangiriro za 2009 kandi yasohotse bwa mbere mu gihugu cye gishya yari mu marushanwa ya Aziya yo muri Cross Cross Country, aho yatwaye umudari wa feza inyuma ya mugenzi we Maryam Yusuf Jamal wahindutse. Yirutse muri Shampiyona y'isi ya IAAF mu mwaka wa 2009 muri Werurwe arangiza ku mwanya wo kuri 28. Yatsindiye kandi metero 1500 muri Shampiyona yisi yo muri 2009 yaberaga muri isiganwa maze agera muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Umwaka urangiye yashyizeho ibihembo byiza mu nzu mu mikino yo muri Aziya yo muri 2009, afata umwanya wa kane muri metero 800 ndetse afata umwanya wa kabiri muri metero 1500 inyuma ya Liu Qing.
Yatangiye mu mwaka wo muri 2010 arengera izina rye muri Eurocross mbere yo kujya ku mwanya wa 16 mu marushanwa ya IAAF yo muri World Cross Country yabereye i Bydgoszcz muri 2010. Yatagije imbere muri metero 3000 neza arangiza umwanya wa kane muri 8: 32.18 mu nama ya Herculis IAAF Diamond League yabaye muri Nyakanga, nyuma y'ukwezi kumwe yiruka ku giti cye cya 4: 00.25 kuri metero 1500, gufata umwanya wa kabiri inyuma ya Jamal mu nama ya Rieti. Yatoranijwe guhagararira ikipe ya Aziya na Pasifika mu gikombe cy’umugabane wo muri 2010 IAAF akaza ku mwanya wa kane muri metero 1500. Belete yatsindiye imidari ibiri mu mikino ya Aziya yo muri 2010 mu Gushyingo. Yashyizeho ingufu hamwe na Jamal muri metero 1500 kandi yarangije afite umudari wa bronze mugihe Truong Thanh Hang yamugose hafi kurangiza. Kwiruka muri metero 5000, yashoboye gukemura ikibazo cyu Buhinde muburyo bwa Preeja Sreedharan na Kavita Raut kugirango abone umudari wa zahabu mu minota 15: 15.59, arangiza ye gukanye igikombe cya mbere gikomeye.
Ku ya 12 Ukwakira 2018, yatsinze isiganwa rya Marato rya Toronto Waterfront, hamwe na masomo y'amasomo n'ibyiza bya 2:22:28.

Gelete Burka Bati (rimwe yandika nabi "Burika", Oromo: Galate Burqaa Baati, yavutse ku ya 23 Mutarama 1986) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende. Yavukiye i Kofele muri Arsi Zone yo mu Karere ka Oromia, akarere kamwe na shampiyona w’imikino Olempike ya Haile Gebrselassie.
Gelete niwe wabaye shampiyona wa masomo magufi muri 2006 IAAF yo muri World Cross Country Championship. Ni inshuro eshatu ye gukanye umudari wa Shampiyona yisi IAAF, Imikorere ye myiza ni umudari wa zahabu muri metero 1500 muri 2008. Yitabiriye inshuro enye mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororamubiri muri 2005 kugeza 2011, kandi ahagarariye Etiyopiya mu mikino Olempike haba muri 2008 na 2012.
Yatsindiye kandi umudari ku rwego rw'a karere, kuba yarabaye igisonga cya Shampiyona nya furika muri 2010 mu mikino ngororamubiri ndetse abona n'u mudari wa zahabu mu mikino yo muri Afurika muri 2007. Yari umunyafurica ufite agahigo ko kwiruka ibirometero 1500 mu nzu.
Burka ya mbere ya gezeho cyane muri 2003 muri IAAF World Cross Country Championship, aho yatsindiye umudari w'umuringa mu marushanwa y'abato. Yatangiye kwigaragaza cyane mu mikino ngororamubiri mu mpera z'uwo mwaka, nyuma y’uko federasiyo ya Etiyopiya yanze ko Merima Denboba yitabira amarushanwa, Burka yafashe isiganwa ry’ abagore mu gikombe cya Lotto Cross Cup Bruxelles. Umwaka ukurikira yasubiye mu Bubiligi maze asubiramo ibikorwa. Nyuma yo kuba shampiyo w'isi muto muri cross country yiruka muri Shampiyona yisi ya XC muri 2005, yitabiriye amarushanwa yisi yo muri 2005 yaberaga muri isiganwa, arangiza umunani mu kwiruka metero 1500. Ukwezi kumwe y'egukanye umudari wa bronze muri metero 3000 ku mukino w'anyuma w'imikino ngororamubiri. Yasoje shampiyona itsinze Espagne Cross Internacional de Venta de Baños.

Dawit Seyaum Biratu (yavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 1996) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati hamwe n' intera ndende akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 1500. Yegukanye umwanya wa kane muri Shampiyona y'isi muri 2015 kandi y'egukana umudari wa feza mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu yo muri 2016. Dawit yatwaye umudari w'umuringa muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona y'isi muri 2022.
Yari mu birori by’inzobere byegukanye umudari wa feza mu gikombe cy’isi cyo muri 2013, na shampiyona w’ingimbi muri 2014.
Dawit Seyaum y'agize uruhare runini ku rwego rw'igihugu muri 2013, yegukana metero 1500 irushanwarya mutomuri Etiyopiya. Yatangiye gukinira ku rwego mpuzamahanga ku mu zunguruko wa IAAF Diamond League aho yakurikiranye nyuma gato, maze ashyira ku mwanya wa mbere iminota 4: 14.95 mu birori bya bereye mu nama ya Doha Diamond League. Yatoranijwe guhatanira muri metero 1500 mu marushanwa y’urubyiruko ku isi yo muri 2013 ya beraga mu mikino ngororamubiri yabereye i Donetsk, muri Ukerene kandi yari igisonga cya Tigist Gashaw - ku nshuro ye ya mbere Etiyopiya, ifata imyanya ibiri ya mbere muri ibyo birori. Yahinduye iyi myanya mu marushanwa yo muri Afurika mu ngimbi muri 2013, atwara igikombe n'iminota 4: 09.00 amasegonda menshi imbere ya Tigist.
Dawit yatsindiye irushanwa rye rya mbere rya bereye i Prague muri Gashyantare 2014, yiruka metero 1500 hamwe nigihe cy'iminota 4: 09.08. Mu nama ya Rabat, yigaragaje mu bantu 1500 ba mbere ku isi abiruka bafite intsinzi m'uminota 3: 59.53 - agahigo yabato ya Etiyopiya hamwe n'inama y'inama yashyizwe ku mwanya wa karindwi kurutonde rwisi muri uwo mwaka. Yongeye hafi iminota ine muri New York Diamond League, aho yarangije ari uwambere. Dawit yinjiye muri Shampiyona yisi yabato muri Eugene nkuko akunda kandi abitangaho ye gukana umudari wa zahabu, nta nkomyi mu mikino ya nyuma. Umudari we wa mbere mukuru yakurikiranye muri Shampiyona nya furika yaberaga muri isiganwa, aho yari umudari wa feza inyuma ya Hellen Obiri w'inararibonye. Dawit yatoranijwe mu ikipe ya Afurika mu gikombe cya IAAF muri 2014 ndetse arangiza afite umudari wa bronze inyuma ya Sifan Hassan na Shannon Rowbury.

Yihunlish Delelecha (uzwi kandi ku izina rya Yihunelish Bekele Deleleneh, yavutse ku ya 22 Ukwakira 1981) ni Umunyetiyopiya n' Umunyamerika wiruka mu ntera ndende ndese yari nu munyamuryango w’ikipe ya Shampiyona y’imikino ngororamubiri muri 1998 yatsinze umudari wa feza muri Etiyopiya.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Delelecha yitabiriye amasiganwa mu cyakabiri cya marato muri Etiyopiya. no muri, Moroke, akurayo umudari wa feza.
nyuma yaje kujya muri america.
Muri Kamena 2011, iminsi 38 nyuma yo gutsinda i Pittsburgh, Delelecha yegukanye umwanya wa mbere muri Marato ya nyirakuru aba 35 hamwe na 02:30:39. Umugore m'ugenzi we wo mu gihugu, Buzunesh Deba yari yamumenyesheje iryo siganwa kandi amutera inkunga yo kugerageza. Umunsi wa 2011 watangijwe n'imvura, ihagarara nyuma yi siganwa ritangiye. Hariho umurizo muto hamwe n'ikirere gikonje bihagije kugirango ubone umwuka wa biruka ku nkombe yikiyaga cya Superior. Delelecha yi rukanye na Everlyne Lagat kugeza kilometero cya 19. Lagat yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri, naho Dot McMahan yaje avuye inyuma arangiza uwa gatatu.
Ugushyingo ya muzanye mu mujyi w'urukundo rwa kivandimwe kuri Philadelphia Half Marathon. Yatsinze, atsinda Bekelech Bedada w'i myaka 19 na Amanda Marino, umwe mu bagize ikipe ya shampiyona yo muri NCAA Cross Country yo mu 2009 ya Villanova. Igihe cya Delelecha cyiza ku giti cye ni isaha 1:12:42.
Yabaye uwa gatatu muri Marato ya Houston muri 2012, ubwo Benita Willis yamusohokaga hafi yo kurangiza na Alemitu Abera [fr] yahunze ayoboye, ashyiraho inyandiko.
Muri 2012, Delelecha ya yoboye isiganwa rya Cherry Blossom 10 Mile i Washington DC. Igihe cye cyari 54:33 yashyize ku mwanya wa gatatu, inyuma y'u watsinze Julliah Kerubo Tinega na Malika Mejdoub uri ku mwanya wa kabiri.
Muri uwo mwaka, yabaye uwa kane muri Pittsburgh Half Marathon (mu gihe Fatuma Sado yanditse agahigo mu masomo), uwa gatatu agaruka muri Marato ya nyi rakuru (kuri iyi nshuro inyuma ya Everlyne Lagat na Mulu Seboka), uwa gatanu mu Mijyi ya Twin Marato (inyuma ya Jeannette Faber) nuwa kane muri Philadelphia Half Marathon.
Delelecha yabaga i Waldorf, muri Maryland muri 2011. Rimwe na rimwe yakoraga imyitozo i Albuquerque, muri New Mexico, hamwe n'i tsinda ry'abakinnyi b'Abanya furika mu gihe bitegura gusiganwa.

Betlhem Desalegn Belayneh (yavutse ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 1991 i Addis Abeba) ni umunyetiyopiya wavukiye muri Etiyopiya Emirati wiruka hagati. Mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2012, yitabiriye metero 1500 mu bagore.
Muri 2017, Betlhem ya bujijwe imyaka ibiri kubera amakosa muri pasiporo y’ibinyabuzima. Usibye kubuzwa, ibisubizo bye byose buaje hagati ya 6 Werurwe 2014 na 22 Nyakanga 2016 byateshejwe agaciro.

Imihindagurikire y’ikirere ni ikibazo giteye impungenge kwisi yose kandi gikomeje kugira ingaruka nyinshi, akaba ari yo mpamvu abafatanyabikorwa ba leta basabwa kongera ingengo y’imari ishyirwa mu guhangana n’iki kibazo.
Imihindagurikire y’ibihe igira ingaruka zirimo imyuzure, inkangu, isuri itwara ubutaka, amapfa, inzara, gutwara ubuzima bw’abantu, gusenya ibikorwaremezo n’ibindi.
U Rwanda rukeneye arenga miliyari 11$ azifashishwa mu bikorwa byo kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe muri gahunda ya "Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC)", gahunda igihugu cyiyemeje mu kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe hagendewe ku biteganywa n’amasezerano ya Paris yerekeye imihindagurikire y’ibihe.
Muri miliyari 11 z’amadolari zizakenewa mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo u Rwanda rwiyemeje, miliyari 5.7 $ azakoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kugabanya ibishobora guteza imihindagurikire y’ibihe, naho miliyari 5.3 $ zijye mu byo guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.
Aya mafaranga akenewe yose biteganijwe ko azaturuka mu bushobozi igihugu gisanganywe andi akava mu nkunga zo hanze.
Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 22 Werurwe 2023, Minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi yahurije hamwe abafatanyabikorwa ba leta baganira ku kuzamura amafaranga yongerwa mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere no kureba uko byakwinjizwa mu ngengo y’imari.
Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi ushinzwe Imari ya Leta, Richard Tusabe, yavuze ko iyi nama igamije gushaka amafaranga yafasha mu guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire.
Ati “Ni ukureba ese ayo mafaranga yava he, twayabona gute, twayakoresha gute, na raporo twatanga zatangwa gute kugira ngo tugire ibipimo bidufasha kureba niba ibyo twiyemeje koko tubigeraho”.
Leta y’u Rwanda ifite ingamba zikomeye zerekeye ibikorwa byo kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihezikaba ziteganya ko mu mwaka wa 2030 imyuka itera ukwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku isi izagabanukaho 38%, ibi bikaba bizagabanya toni miliyoni 4.6 z’ibyuka bya carbone.
U Rwanda rukeneye ingengo y’imari ingana na miliyari 11 z’amadolari kugira ngo izi ngamba zo guhashya imihindagurikire y’ibihe zishyirwe mu bikorwa.
Ibikorwa bijyanye no guhashya imihindagurkire y’ibihe bizatwara Miliyari 5.7, mu gihe ibijyanye no guhangana n’ingaruka bizatwara Miliyali 5.3 z’amadolari.
Tusabe avuga ko ibi biganiro ari andi mahirwe yo kureba uko hakubakwa igihugu cyashobora guhangana n’impinduka z’ikirere ku buryo ibibazo byose byashoboraga guterwa n’imihindukire y’ikirere bikumirwa, ibyabayeho bigakemurwa.
Jean Michel Swalens ukora muri Ambasade y’Ababiligi ushinzwe imikoranire hagati y’u Bubiligi n’u Rwanda, yavuze ko nk’abafatanyabikorwa ba leta bareba uko bakongera ingengo y’imari ishyirwa mu bikorwa byo gukumira no guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.
Ati “Dushobora gushyira amafaranga muri izi ntego, tukamenya ibyo bikorwa ndetse tukanagenzura umusaruro wagezweho mu gukumira no guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ikirere”.
Yavuze ko nk’u Bubiligi, hari ibiganiro by’ubufatanye n’u Rwanda mu bijyanye no guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, hari gahunda nshya y’ubutwererane bw’ibihugu byombi izatangira mu 2024 izitsa cyane ku gushyira imbaraga mu gukumira no guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Ubu butwererane buzibanda cyane ku bikorwa by’ubuhinzi.
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigega cy’u Rwanda cyita ku bidukikije (FONERWA), Teddy Mugabo, yavuze ko ibikorwa by’iterambere n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe bidasigana bityo imihindagurikire y’ibihe ikwiye gushyirwa mu by’ibanze.
Ati “Gushyira ingengo y’imari mu guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, dukwiye kubibona nk’icy’ibanze aho kubifata nk’inyongera”.
U Rwanda rufite imishinga yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe irimo gutunganya ibishanga bitanu mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Abikorera barashishikarizwa gushora imari muri uru rwego.
Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’imari (IMF), giherutse kwemeza inkunga ya miliyoni 319 z’amadolari ni ukuvuga miliyari zirenga 340 Frw, zo gukoresha muri gahunda zo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe no kubaka ubukungu buhamye.

Mu myaka ishize ubwo ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bwakorwaga mu kajagari mu Rwanda, byari bibangamiye ibidukikije kuko ababukoraga mu buryo butemewe batitaga ku gusiga batunganyije aho bacukuye.
Ibi biri mu byagiraga ingaruka zo guteza isuri n’inkangu mu gihe imvura iguye, ndetse bigateza n’ibindi bibazo bibangamira ibidukikije.
Umuyobozi wa sosiyete DEMICO ikorera ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro mu Karere ka Kamonyi, Emmanuel Kinyogote, yabwiye IGIHE ko umwuga wabo utacyangiza ibidukikije. Ati ‘‘Uko tugenda ducukura bya kinyamwuga, niko tugenda dukora akazi kacu tubungabunga ibidukikije. Nk’amazi dukoresha ntabwo tugomba kuyareka ngo amanuke ku misozi, aho ashobora guteza isuri’’.
Kinyogote avuga ko banatera ingemwe z’ibiti, ku buryo aho batagikorera ubucukuzi bw'amabuye yagaciro basiga bahateye ibiti, ndetse bagasiga basubiranyije ahacukuwe hadashobora guterwa ibyo biti.
Ushinzwe ibikorwa byo kubungabunga ibidukikije muri sosiyete IMC ikorera ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro mu Karere ka Muhanga, Afazaria Adelphine, na we avuga ko abari mu bucukuzi bw'amabuye yagaciro bahagurukiye kubungabunga ibidukikije. Ati “Hazamo gutera ibiti, gucukura imirwanyasuri kuko mwabonye kuri uyu musozi dukoreraho, ni umusozi uhanamye cyane’’.
Afazaria avuga ko ubucukuzi bw'amabuye yagaciro bwa none atari bwo bwangiza imigezi igaragara hirya no hino yuzuyemo isuri, ahubwo ko ibyo byagizwemo uruhare n’ubucukuzi bw'amabuye yagaciro bwa kera, ku buryo ababukora ubu bari kuziba icyuho ngo bahanagure iyo sura mbi uyu mwuga wahoranye.
Nubwo bimeze gutyo, haracyagaragara bake bakibikora mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko, bagacukura amabuye nabi ku buryo bwangiza imirima y’abaturage cyangwa n’imisozi bukorerwaho.
Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe Iyubahirizategeko ry’ibidukikije mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cyo Kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA), Akimpaye Beata, aherutse gusaba ubufatanye bw’inzego zose mu kurwanya umuntu wese ukora ubucukuzi butemewe n’amategeko.
Yavuze ko ubucukuzi nk’ubwo bwangiza ibidukikije, bitewe n’uko ababukora muri ubwo buryo basiga badasubiranyije aho bacukuye, cyangwa ngo bafate izindi ngamba zo kurengera ibidukikije zirimo no gutera ibiti mu rwego rwo gufata ubutaka ngo budatwarwa n’imvura.
Ingabire Diane, Ushinzwe ibidukikije mu karere ka Nyanza, avuga ko gukora ingendo shuri mu kwiga uko isuri irwanywa ari kime mu byafasha ababishinzwe kwirebera uburyo kutita ku bidukikije byangiza amasoko y'amazi. Akomeza avugako nyuma yo guhugurwa n'umushinga wa LVEMP II ukorera mu kigo cy'igihugu cyita ku bidukikije,REMA,yabashije kunguka ubumenyi azifashisha mu guhwitura abacukuzi bamabuye yagaciro.

Genzebe Dibaba Keneni (yavutse ku ya 8 Gashyantare 1991) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati kandi ntera ndende. Muri metero 1500 muri 2016 y'egukanye umudari wa feza muri olempike, y'egukanye umudari wa zahabu muri iri rushanwa n'umuringa wo muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2015. Genzebe n'iyubu ifite agahigo kisi kuri metero 1500, hamwe n'ibyabaye m'urugo imbere ya kilometero imwe, muri metero 3000 na metero 5000. Afite umwihariko wo gutunga agahigo menshi kisi n'umugore umwe mu mateka y'umurongo, hamwe nubu atwaye bane, hiyongereyeho ibyiza bibiri byisi.
Amaze kwitabira amarushanwa yose y’i mikino ngororamubiri ku isi hagati ya 2009 na 2017, Genzebe yashyizwe ku mukino wa nyuma w'i byabaye byose y'itabiriye. Ni inshuro eshanu ari shampiyona w’imbere mu nzu, yegukanye metero 1500 muri 2012, na metero 3000 muri 2014 na 2016, kandi y'egukana metero 1500 / 3000m muri 2018. Yatsinze cyane nk'umukinnyi muto. Mu mwaka wa 2008, afite imyaka 17, ye gukanye igikombe cya mbere cy’isi mu marushanwa y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 maze atwara umudari wa feza muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona y’isi mu bari munsi yimyaka 20. Umwaka ukurikira, Genzebe yongeyeho igikombe cya kabiri cya Cross Country muri 2008 Amarushanwa Yabato Yisi Yimikino ngororamubiri 2008 Amarushanwa Yabato Yisi Yimikino ngororamubiri mu bari munsi y'imyaka 20, naho mu 2010, Shampiyona y'isi muri 2008 Amarushanwa Yabato Yisi Yimikino ngororamubiri" Amarushanwa Yabato Yisi Yimikino ngororamubirimu bari munsi yimyaka 20 muri metero 5000 ya zahabu. Yatsindiye igikombe cya Diamond League muri 2015 muri ibyo birori. Yahawe igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri Laureus wari 2014, na IAAF Umukinnyi w’umwaka ku isi muri 2015.
Genzebe akomoka mu muryango wa siporo w’abatsindiye imidari myinshi mu mikino Olempike, barimo bashiki be Tirunesh na Ejegayehu, na nyirasenge Derartu Tulu.
Genzebe Dibaba ni umwe mu bagize ubwoko bwa Oromo ukomoka mu butumburuke bwa Arsi Zone yo mu karere ka Oromiya kandi akomoka mu muryango w'a bakinnyi. Mukuru we Tirunesh ni umukinnyi wamamaye we gukanye imidari myinshi ikomeye. Undi mushiki wye mukuru, Ejegayehu, yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 10,000 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2004, murumuna we Dejene na we ni umukinnyi. Nyirasenge ni Derartu Tulu, 1992 na 2000 yari shampiyo muri olempike muri metero 10,000.
Mu marushanwa y'isi yabereye i Beijing, yatwaye metero 1500, kandi yatwaye umudari wa bronze muri metero 5000 ibyabaye.
Yahawe igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza ku isi muri IAAF mu mwaka wo muri 2015.

Ambasade ya Islael mu Rwanda yifatanije nisi kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga ngarukamwaka w’isi (International Mother Earth Day).
Kwizihiza uwo munsi byaranzwe no gutangiza amahugurwa agamije kongera umubare w’abanyeshuri ba Kaminuza bakora ubushakashatsi ku bimera.
Ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’abanyeshuri ba Kaminuza bagera kuri 30, yatewe inkunga na Ambasade ya Israel mu Rwanda, akaba agamije gutanga umusanzu ku iterambere rya gahunda y’Igihugu yo gukora ubushakashatsi ku bimera no gukusanya amakuru ajyanye n’umurage w’ibimera bitandukanye biboneka mu gihugu.
Umurima ukorerwamo ubushakashatsi ku bimera mu Rwanda (Rwanda’s National Herbarium) uherereye muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, ukaba ubonemo ubwoko bw’ibimera bigera ku bihumbi 17.
Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ubushakashatsi no gufasha abanyeshuri barangiza Kaminuza ndetse n’abarimu babo kumva neza urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, abo banyeshuri n’abarimu babo bafashijwe gusura Pariki ya Nyungwe kugira ngo bahakure ubumenyi bw’ibanze.
Iryo tsinda ryakusanyije ubwoko bw’ibimera 30, bizaherwaho mu gukora ubushakashatsi bwimbitse ndetse n’inyigo ku ruhare rw’ibimera mu rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije muri rusange.
Muri uwo muhango, Ambasaderi wa Israel mu Rwanda, Ron Adam yavuze ko kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima byagombye kuba mu byihutirwa igihugu cyitaho kurusha ibindi.
Ambasaderi Dr Adam yagize ati “Kimwe mu bintu byagombye kwitabwaho ni ukubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no kwita ku bidukikije muri rusange. Abatuye Isi basabwa kwita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, kuko kwangirika k’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima bikomeje kuba ikibazo gihangayikishije muri iyi myaka ya vuba aha, n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere ijyana n’ubushyuhe bukabije ”.
Kabera Juliet, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyita ku bidukikije (REMA), wari waherekeje abo banyeshuri bahugurwa, yavuze ko u Rwanda rwiyemeje kubungabunga ibidukikije, bityo ko ubwo bumenyi abo banyeshuri bahabwa bukenewe cyane mu rubyiruko, kugira ngo rushobore guteza imbere gahunda za Leta zijyanye no kwita ku bidukikije.
Umwe mu bahuguwe yavuze ko ubumenyi bahawe bwabafashije kuko bwabahaye amahirwe yo kumva neza ibyo biga, kandi babyigiye hanze y’ishuri.
Uwase Aimée Sandrine, Umuhuzabikorwa wa gahunda y’igihugu yo gukora ubushakashatsi ku bimera (National Herbarium of Rwanda), ndetse wanarangije kwiga mu ishami ry’Ibinyabuzima muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda na we yari muri urwo rugendoshuri rwo muri Pariki ya Nyungwe.
Yagize ati “Nishimiye uru rugendo, nize ibintu byinshi bishya, niboneye n’amaso yanjye bimwe mu bimera twari twarize mu ishuri. Turashimira Ambasade ya Israel mu Rwanda kuri aya mahirwe yaduhaye.”
Prof. Elias Bizuru, Umwarimu wa Kaminuuza mu ishami ry’ibimera n’andi masomo ashamikiyeho, mu Ishami rya Kaminuza ryigisha Siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga (UR College of Science and Technology), yavuze ko ayo mahugurwa n’urugendo bizafasha abanyeshuri kumenya kugenzura uko ubwoko bw’ibimera bugenda buhinduka bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.
Bizuru ati “Nize byinshi njye n’abanyeshuri banjye, twabonye ubwoko bwinshi bw’ibimera, kandi hari n’ibyo twashoboye kuzana ubundi bitabaga mu murima wa Kaminuza ukorerwamo ubushakashatsi ku bimera”.

Mu rwego rwo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, ku bufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa bako, Akarere ka Rulindo karateganya gutera ibiti birenze Miliyoni eshanu mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri.
Kuri ubu muri ako Karere hatewe ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka, biri kuri hegitari zirenga ibihumbi 40, naho ubundi buso bugera kuri hegitari zirenga ibihumbi 14, buteyeho ibiti bivangwa n’ishyamba.
Emmanuel Hategekimana, umuyobozi w’ishami ry’ubuhinzi, ubworozi n’umutungo kamere, avuga ko urugendo rwo gutera ibiti muri ako Karere rugikomeza, n’ubwo bahagaze neza iyo urebye ku gipimo cyo ku rwego rwIigihugu, ku biti bigomba kuba bitewe ku mashyamba.
Ati “Iyo urebye ku gipimo cy’uko ubuso buteweho amashyamba, turi ku kigero cya 26%, mu gihe ku rwego rw’Igihugu dufite ko ubuso bugomba kuba buteyeho amashyamba, bugomba kuba buri ku kigero cya 30%, urumva ko ari igikorwa gikomeza, kuko turimo gushyira imbaraga mu gutera ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka, no kuvugurura amashyamba ashaje, kugira ngo tugerageze guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere”.
Iyo agereranyije n’ibipimo bagezeho, ndetse n’umuhigo bagomba kwesa, Hategekimana asanga akurikije abafatanyabikorwa bafite, nta kabuza ko bazabigeraho.
Ati “Iyo turebye ibipimo bafite, n’ibyo bateganya kuzakora, umuhigo tuzawesa nta kabuza, ni umufatanyabikorwa waziye igihe, kuko bafite umushinga wo gutera ibiti mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu, kandi umaze igihe cy’imyaka ibiri irenga. Urumva mu gihe gisigaye dutera ibiti, twumva tugereranyije n’ibipimo tugenda tugira buri mwaka, uwo muhigo tuzawesa”.
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’umuryango uharanira kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima mu muhora wa Albert (ARCOS), ukorera mu turere twa Bugesera na Rulindo, Dr. Sam Kanyamibwa, avuga ko bateganya gutera ibiti birenga miliyoni eshanu mu Karere ka Rulindo, mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri.
Ati “Muri Rulindo tuzatera ibiti bigera hafi kuri Miliyoni eshatu zijyanye na gahunda yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, ariko hazaterwa ibindi birenga miliyoni ebyiri, twavuga ko ari ibiti bisarurwa vuba, kandi bizajya bigenda bisimburwa, ari byo bijyamo iby’imbuto zoroheje, abaturage bashobora gusarura kugira ngo bibateze imbere”.
Umunyamabanga Nshingabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Burega, Rodrigue Mbera, avuga ko uretse kuba ARCOS bakorana muri gahunda zijyanye no gutera ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka, imikoranire yabo ngo yahinduye ubuzima bw’abaturage.
Ati “Uyu munsi amatsinda bagiye badukorera mu buryo bwiza, nubwo ahuriye ku byo gutera ibiti, ariko na none hari ibindi duhuriramo, kuko iyo abantu bahuye ari 30, bicaye hamwe no kungurana ibitekerezo mu buryo bw’imihingire, kwizigamira n’ibindi, ibyo twe tubona ari imbaraga zo kugira ngo umuturage atere intambwe, ave aho yari ari agere ku rundi rwego rwiza”.
Zimwe mu mpamvu zituma ibiti bishobora kwangirika ntibikure nk’uko byari biteganyijwe mu Karere ka Rulindo, zirimo izuba ryinshi, cyangwa kudaterwa neza, ariko ngo ibipfuye birasimbuzwa, kugeza igihe umusaruro wateganyijwe ugezweho 100%.
Ibiti bigomba guterwa bigeze mu bwoko 15, harimo ubugera kuri 20% bw’ibiti bya gakondo.

Kutre Dulecha (yavutse ku ya 22 Kanama 1978 i Sidamo) ni umukinnyi wiruka hagati mu kibuga muri Etiyopiya. Arushanwa muri metero 1500, aho yashyizeho agahigo kisi muri 1997. Yabaye shampiyona w’imbere muri 2004, Etiyopiya ya mbere yegukanye umudari wa metero 1500 mu bagore. Yatsinze amasomo magufi y'abagore muri Shampiyona yisi ya IAAF muri 2000.

Abayobozi n’abakozi ba Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, ku itariki ya 26 Ugushyingo 2022 bifatanyije n’abayobozi ndetse n’abaturage b’Akarere ka Gicumbi hamwe na Guverineri w’Amajyaruguru mu gikorwa cy’umuganda rusange wibanze ku gutera ibiti mu Murenge wa Cyumba.
Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu yaboneyeho no kuhatangiriza icyumweru cyahariwe uburenganzira bwa Muntu kizasozwa ku itariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2022 hizihizwa isabukuru y’imyaka 74 ishize hashyizweho Itangazo Mpuzamahanga ryerekeye Uburenganzira bwa Muntu (The Universal Declaration of Human Rights).
Muri uwo muganda rusange, Akarere ka Gicumbi na Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenzira bwa Muntu, bafatanyije n’umushinga wa Green Gicumbi watangijwe muri 2019 na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, ibinyujije muri Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije n’Ikigega cy’Ibidukikije mu Rwanda (FONERWA), ukaba ugamije kongera ubudahangarwa ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Umuganda wabereye mu Murenge wa Cyumba ku musozi wa Kivuruga mu Kagari ka Nyaruka, ahatewe ibiti bibarirwa mu bihumbi 12 ku buso busaga Hegitari eshatu, mu rwego rwo kuvugurura amashyamba ashaje.
Mu butumwa yagejeje ku bitabiriye uyu muganda, Guverineri Nyirarugero Dancille, yasabye abatuye ako gace kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe babonye, cyane cyane bakesha umushinga Green Gicumbi, bityo bakiteza imbere, abasaba kandi gukumira no kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge na magendu, kurwanya isuri no gukumira Ibiza, bita ku biti byatewe.
Ati “Twese nk’abanya-Gicumbi turusheho kubifata neza no kubibyaza umusaruro mu rwego rwo kurushaho guhangana n’ingaruka zikomoka ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe.”
Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, Mukasine Marie Claire, yagarutse ku kamaro ko kubungabunga ibidukikije, kurwanya isuri no kubahiriza uburenganzira bwa muntu, asobanura ko kubyitaho bifite uruhare runini mu mu mibereho myiza ya muntu.
Aha ni ho yahereye ashishishikariza abafatanyabikorwa ba Komisiyo kurushaho kongera uruhare rwabo mu guteza imbere ibidukikije no kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Mukasine ati “Ingaruka zikomoka ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe zihungabanya bikomeye uburenganzira. Ni inshingano zacu twese kubungabunga ibidukikije hagamijwe kurushaho guharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu.”
Mukasine Marie Claire na we yashimye ibikorwa by’umushinga Green Gicumbi kuko bigamije gufasha umuturage kugira ahazaza heza.

Axumawit Alem Embaye (yavutse ku ya 18 Ukwakira 1994) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende, akaba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 1500. Ni inshuro ebyiri yegukanye umudari wa feza muri gikombe cy’imbere kuva muri 2014 na 2022.
Axumawit Embaye yagaragaye bwa mbere muri 2012. Yabaye igisonga cya metero 800 muri Shampiyona y'abato ya Etiyopiya kandi yarangije ari uwa karindwi muri Shampiyona y'isi yabato y'abato muri 2012 muri isiganwa, yagize ibihe byiza by'umuntu ku giti cye ni iminota 4: 12.92. Yarahinduye ajya muri metero 1500 muri shampiyona muri 2013 kandi yitwara neza kumuzunguruko. Yirutse neza mu minota 4: 09.11 mu nzu ya XL Galan kugira ngo ashyire ku mwanya wa kabiri kandi afite umurongo wa kabiri washyizwe hanze mu mikino ya Bislett, Folksam Grand Prix na KBC Ijoro ry'imikino ngororamubiri (yashyizeho ibihe byiza byari 4: hari Iminota 05.16 mu birori by'anyuma).
Imyanya itatu ya mbere yagizwe mu nama ya Banki ya PSD na Weltklasse i Karlsruhe mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wakurikiyeho y'amuzaniye umwanya muri iyi kipe mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu yo muri 2014 mu birori bya metero 1500. Yabaye uwa kabiri kuri Abebe Aregawi mu bushyuhe kandi asubiramo iyo mi korere ku mukino wa nyuma; nubwo Abebe yatsinze neza isiganwa, Axumawit yagumye imbere ya bandi b'apakira gutwara umudari wa feza.
Yashyize ku mwanya wa kane mu birori by’i nzobere mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu ya IAAF muri 2016 yabereye Portland, Oregon. Sifan Hassan niwe we gukanye igihe Dawit Seyaum na Gudaf Tsegay barangije ku mwanya wa kabiri n'uwa gatatu.
Mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2019 yabereye i Doha, Axumawit yavanyweho mu bushyuhe bwo kwiruka metero 1500 mu bagore.
Mu 2022, Axumawit yasubiyemo ibyo yagezeho kuva mu mwaka wo muri 2014 yegukana umudari wa feza ya metero 1500 muri Shampiyona y’imbere mu nzu yabereye i Belgrade, isaha 4: 02.29. Mugenzi we Tsegay yayoboye imidari ya Etiyopiya muri 3: 57.19 mugihe Hirut Meshesha yarangije umwanya wa gatatu (4: 03.39).

Emebt Etea Bedada (yavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1990 i Waliso) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende uhatanira mu marushanwa yo kwiruka mu muhanda. Yagaragaye nk'umwiruka vuba mubto (abatarengeje imyaka 19) hamwe na Shampiyona ny'afurika y'abato kabiri muri metero 1500 na metero 3000. Yabanye umudari mubato wa bronze mu m'arushanwa ya IAAF World Cross Country Championship muri 2008.
Yimukiye kure cyane hagati yo muri 2009 atangira kwitabira igice cya marato. Yatsinze marato muri Brescia na Venice muri 2012. Yatsindiye kandi ikipe umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa ya IAAF World Half Marathon 2012 hamwe n'ikipe y'abagore ya Etiyopiya. Marato ye nziza ni amasaha 2:25:53.
Mushiki we muto Korahubsh Itaa niwe wabaye shampiyo w’urubyiruko ku isi muri 2009 muri stelechase kandi yavunnye urubyiruko ku isi neza mu metero 2000 intera.
Amarushanwa ya mbere ya Emebt muri Etiyopiya yaje afite imyaka cumi n'itanu. Yabaye igisonga muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kandi yari metero1500, yegukanye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona ny'afurika y'imikino ngororamubiri muri 2005. Yashyizwe ku mwanya wa karindwi mu marushanwa y'abato mu marushanwa ya IAAF World Cross Country muri 2006, arangiza ari uwa kane muri Shampiyona y’ingimbi imyaka 2006. Yaje kandi ku mwanya wa gatandatu muri uwo mwaka ukomeye wo muri Etiyopiya.

Birtukan Fente Alemu (yavutse ku ya 18 Kamena 1989) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka cyane muri metero 3000. Yahagarariye igihugu cye muri Shampiyona yisi muri 2011 na 2015 agera k'umukino wanyuma kunshuro y'ambere.
1 Ntabwo yatangiriye k 'umukino wa nyuma

Tigist Gashaw Belay (yavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1996) ni Umunyetiyopiya wavukiye mu ntera yo hagati yiruka mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Bahirayini. Yaserukiye cye icyo gihugu mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016 gusa ntiyakomeje imbere mu cyiciro cya mbere. Mbere yegukanye umudari wa zahabu mu ma rushanwa mpuzamahanga y’urubyiruko muri 2013 atangirira muri Etiyopiya.

Genet Gebregioris (yavutse muri 1975 i Addis Abeba) ni umunyetiyopiya w'umugore wiruka hagati y'irukankaga mu mpera ya za 1990 no muntangiriro yo muri 2000.
Yatsindiye umudari muri bronze muri metero 1500 mu mikino yo muri Afurika yose yabereye i Harare muri 1995 muir zimbabwe. Nyuma y'imyaka itatu i Dakar muri senegali, muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 1998 yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 3000.
Yabaye kandi mu m'akipe atanu ye gukanye umudari wa feza mu birori bigufi mu marushanwa ya IAAF World Cross Country Championship, arangiza ku mwanya wo muri 11 muri 1998, ku ya 16 muri 1999, ku ya 17 muri 2000, ku ya 16 muri 2001 na 16 muri 2002

Werkwuha Getachew (yavutse 7 Ukuboza 1995) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Etiyopiya kabuhariwe mu kwiruka metero 3000. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri ibyo birori mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo muri 2022 na zahabu muri Shampiyona ny'afurika muri 2022.
Getachew ni umunyetiyopiya ufite agahigo ko muri metero 800 na metero 3000. Kuva muri Nzeri 2022, yashyize ku mwanya wa kane mu birori bya nyuma ku rutonde rw'ibihe byose ku isi. Yari mu birori bye bidasanzwe muri 2022 shampyina ya Diamond League.
Muri Kamena 2021 kuri Stade ya Fanny Blankers-Koen i Hengelo mu birori byo kugerageza imikino Olempike ya Etiyopiya, Werkwuha Getachew yateje impungenge muri metero 800 z'abagore ubwo yamanukaga ho amasaha 2: 00.20 PB ku mwanya wa mbere ku isi ku mwanya wa isaha 1: 56.67 maze ashyiraho amateka mashya y'igihugu.. Yabaye umugore wa mbere ku isi wacitse 1:57 muri 2021 kandi abona umwanya we mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yatinze muri 2020. N'ubwo yavuzwe mu nyandiko zemewe kandi yerekeza i Tokiyo, Getachew yakuweho umunsi wo gushyushya metero 800 z'abagore ntiyitabira.

Frehiwat Goshu (yavutse 28 kamena 1990) ni umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende ya marato, aba ari kabuhariwe muri metero 3000.
Yatangiye ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ubwo yari yaje mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika yo mu 2007, aho yaje ku mwanya wa kane muri metero zirenga 1500. Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 3000 muri Shampiyona y’ingimbi muri 2008 arangiza kuwa icyenda ku mukino wa nyuma w’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi muri 2009. Yatsindiye kandi umwanya wa kane mu marushanwa y'abato muri Shampiyona y'isi ya Cross Cross muri 2009. Yatsindiye Cross Internacional muri 2010 Juan Muguerza naho muri 2011 niwe wegukanye irushanwa rya Half Marathon yo muri Madrid naho igisonga cya Madrid 10K. Yafashe umwanya wa kabiri inyuma ya Priscah Cherono muri Cross Internacional de la Constitución muri Kuboza 2011.
Ibihe bye byiza yagize ni iminota 4: 13.54 muri metero 1500, yageze muri Nyakanga 2009 muri Barcelona ; Iminota 8: 50.38 muri metero 3000, yagezweho muri Nzeri 2009 muri Rieti ; n'iminota 15: 21.44 muri metero 5000, byagezweho muri kamena 2009 i Málaga.

Kalkidan Gezahegne (yavutse ku ya 8 Gicurasi 1991) Ni umunyatiyopiya ufite ubwengihugu bwa Baharayini, wuruka metero 10,000 muri 2020 i tokiyo, Yegukanye umudari wa silver olempike. Imyaka 11 mbere yaho, afite imyaka 18, Gezahegne yabaye shampiyo ukiri muto wabaye, imbere mu nzu igihe yatsindaga muri metero 1500.
Gezahegne w'imyaka 17 yegukanye umudari wa feza hejuru ya metero 1500 muri Shampiyona yisi y'abato muri 2008. Yahagarariye Etiyopiya mbere yo kubona ubwe negihugu bwa Bahirayini muri 2013.
Kalkidan Gezahegne yavukiye Addis Abeba. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri metero 1500 muri Shampiyona y’isi y’abangavu muri 2008 kandi yegukana undi wa feza y’abato mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika yo muri 2009, arangiza inyuma ya Caster Semenya. Kuzamuka kurwego rwo hejuru, Kalkidan yarangije k'umunani muri metero 1500 kwiruka muri Shampiyona yisi muri 2009 na gatanu muri metero 3000 k'umukino wa nyuma wi mikino ngororamubiri muri 2009.
Yarushanwe mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu ya IAAF yo muri 2010, yagarutse bitangaje kugira ngo yemererwe ku mukino wa nyuma. Hagati y’ubushyuhe, ya gonganye n'umurusiya Yevgeniya Zolotova agwa mu nzira. Yagarutse kugira ngo akomeze isiganwa, ariko, kandi ntiyafashe gusa abo bahanganye, ahubwo yatsinze iryo siganwa hamwe n’igihe cyihuta cy’abiruka uwo munsi. Ku mukino wa nyuma yarushije igihugu cye ndetse na nyampinga uganje Gelete Burka gutwara umudari wa zahabu. Ibi byatumye umusore w'imyaka 18 yatsindiye kuba muto mu birori byabereye mu marushanwa ya IAAF y’isi yaberaga mu nzu, yatsinze amateka yabanje gushyirwaho na Gabriela Szabo mu myaka 15 ishize. Yabuze igihe cyo hanze muri uwo mwaka kubera imvune.
Ku ya 3 Ukwakira 2021, Gezahegne yanditse agahigo ku isimuri kilometero 10 kumuhanda wo kwiruka mu birori bya Giants Geneve, biruka iminota 29:38 no kurenza ikimenyetso cyabanjirije amasegonda 5.

Zewde Hailemariam (yavutse ku ya 22 Nzeri 1962) yahoze yiruka hagati muri Etiyopiya yiruka mu burebure bwa metero 800, no kwiruka metero 400. Yatsindiye imidari ine mu marushanwa atatu atandukanye ya Afurika yaberaga muri isiganwa, kuva muri 1989 na 1992, harimo zahabu imwe muri metero 800 ku nshuro yo muri 1992 muri Kamena muri uwo mwaka. Nyuma y'ukwezi kumwe gusa yitabiriye Etiyopiya mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1992 mu birori bimwe, ariko yiruka amasaha 2: 11.60, astinda amasegonda arenga atanu ugereranije na shampiyona yo ku mugabane wa Afurika, arangiza ku mwanya wa gatandatu mu bushyuhe bwe bwujuje ibisabwa, ananirwa gukomeza muri kimwe cya kabiri. ku mukino wanyuma. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2016, Hailemariam aracyafite agahigo ka metero 400 yo kwiruka muri Etiyopiya mu minota(57.60) yirukanye mu mikino yaberaga muri Afurika muri 1987 yabereye i Nairobi.

Freweyni Hailu (yavutse 12 Gashyantare 2001) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati. Yashyize ku mwanya wa kane muri metero 1500 mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yo muri 2020. Mu 2022, Hailu yabonye umudari wa feza ku isi muri metero 800 i Belgrade.
Freweyni Hailu yungutse ubunararibonye mpuzamahanga bwa mbere muri 2018 mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’abato yabereye i Tampere, muri Finilande, aho yegukanye umwanya wa gatanu mu kwiruka metero 800 mu bagore.
Umwaka ukurikira, yabaye uwa kane mu kwiruka abatarengeje imyaka 20 muri meteo 800 mu marushanwa ny'afurika y'abatarengeje imyaka 18 - abatarengeje imyaka 20 yabereye i Abidjan, muri kote divuwari.
Hailu yitabiriye metero 800 mu bagore mu mikino Nyafurika yo muri 2019, aho yakuwe muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.
Muri Kamena 2021, mu bigeragezo by'imikino Olempike yo muri Etiyopiya, yirutse ku giti cye muri metero 1500 mu bagore kugira ngo igihe cy’imikino Olempike kibe cyujuje ibisabwa mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yatinze muri 2020. We, Lemlem Hailu, na Diribe Welteji ba shyizwe mu ikipe ya Etiyopiya. Muri iyo mikino, yarangije ku mwanya wa kane mu gihe cya 3: 57.60 inyuma gusa, 1-3, Kwizera Kipyegon, Laura Muir na Sifan Hassan.
Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2021, ku rwibutso rwa Hanžeković i Zagreb, Hailu yashyizeho agahigo muri Etiyopiya muri metero 2000 akoresheje umwanya wa metero 5 25.86s, arangiza inyuma ya Francine Niyonsaba we nyine washyize muri iri siganwa agahigo ya 5: 21.56. Ikimenyetso cya Hailu nicyo cya gatatu cyihuta cyane mu mateka.
Muri Werurwe 2022, Hailu yegukanye umudari wa feza muri metero 800 muri Shampiyona y’imbere mu nzu yabereye i Beligrade hamwe n'igihe cyiza cya 2: 00.54. Ajeé Wilson yaje ku mwanya wa mbere muri isaha 1: 59.09, naho Halimah Nakaayi aba uwa gatatu (2: 00.66). Wari umudari wa mbere kw'isi yose muri metero 800 mu rugo kubagore ba Etiyopiya mu mateka.

Lemlem Hailu (yavutse ku ya 21 Gicurasi 2001) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati kandi n'intera ndende. Niweshampiyona w’imbere muri 2022 muri metero 3000 uvuye i Beligrade 22. Hailu yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya muri metero 1500 mu umugore mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2019 na Olempike ya Tokiyo yo muri 2020.
Ku myaka 16, niwe wabaye shampiyo w’isi ku isi muri metero 1500 muri 2017 gutwara umuringa mu mikino Olempike y’urubyiruko nyuma y'umwaka, na bronze mu mikino nya furika muri 2019. Hailu afite umudari w'isi wabari munsi yabatarengeje imyaka 20 kuri metero 1500 m'urugo.
Ku myaka 16, Lemlem Hailu yungutse ubunararibonye mpuzamahanga mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’urubyiruko muri 2017 yabereye i Nairobi, aho yatsindiye metero 1500. Umwaka umwe, yatwaye umudari wa zahabu mu ntera mu mikino ny'afurika y’urubyiruko yabereye muri Algiers maze ajya muri Arijantine mu mikino Olempike y’urubyiruko yabereye i Buenos Aires, aho yegukanye umudari w'umuringa mu kwiruka metero 1500.
Muri 2019, yatwaye umudari wa bronze muri metero 1500 mu mikino ny'afurika. Hailu yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya muri ibyo birori mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2019 yabereye i Doha, agera muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.
Muri Gashyantare 2020, yashyizeho agahigo k’abatarengeje imyaka 20 kuri metero 1500 mu nzu hamwe n'igihe cya 4: 01.79, avunika ku isegonda 0.02, ikimenyetso cy'ambere cyashyizweho na mugenzi we Gudaf Tsegay muri 2016. Muri uko kwezi, Hailu yazamuye agahigo ke agera kuri metero 4 ku isegonda 1.57, iyi ikaba yari inshuro ya kane ku giti cye yagezeho mu byumweru bitatu. Mu Kwakira, yatsinze isiganwa rya metero 1500 muri Kip Keino Classic.

Fantu Worku Taye (yavutse ku ya 29 Werurwe 1999) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati ya metero 1500. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona yisi yabatarengeje imwaka 20 muri 2016. Yahagarariye igihugu cye muri Shampiyona yisi 2017 yabuze gato muri kimwe cya kabiri.
Mu mikino yo Kwizihiza Isabukuru yo muri 2018 yabereye i Londres, yahagaritse kwiruka igice cya lap kare, hakiri kare nyuma yo kwiruka ku mwanya wa mbere, yibeshya umurongo wa kilometero nk'umurongo wa nyuma hanyuma akomeza guhagarika kwiruka amaze kurenga.

Diribe Welteji Kejelcha (yavutse ku ya 13 Gicurasi 2002) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati. Yashyize ku mwanya wa kane muri metero 800 muri Shampiyona y’i mikino ngororamubiri muri 2022.
Ku myaka 16, Welteji yatsindiye muri metero 800 muri Shampiyona yisi yabatarengeje imyaka 20 muri 2018, guca agahigo ya shampionat mubikorwa. Yatwaye ifeza kuri metero 1500 muri Shampiyona yisi muri 2020.
Diribe Welteji w'imyaka 16 y'amavuko yegukanye umudari wa zahabu kuri metero 800 mu ibirori muri Shampiyona yisi yabatarengeje imyaka 20 yabereye i Tampere, aho yanitabiriye amarushanwa y'abagore muri metero 4 × 400 m kwerekanwa atageze ku mukino w'anyuma, ariko abasha kugera kubanya Etiyopiya bato.
Muri 2019, yatsindiye zahabu muri metero 1500 muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yabatarengeje imyaka 20, yarangije ku mwanya wa gatandatu muri metero 800 ibirori mu mikino ny'afurika yabereye i Rabat, kandi byavanyweho muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri metero 800 ibirori muri Shampiyona y'isi ya Doha.

Getenesh Urge (yavutse 30 Kanama 1970) ni umunyetiyopiya wasezeye mu kwiruka hagati yirukaga hagati yarushanwe muri 1980 kugeza 2000. Yitabiriye metero 1500 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1992.
Yatsindiye imidari itatu ya bronze mu marushanwa atatu atandukanye ya Afurika muri isiganwa. Muri Annaba muri Shampiyona yo muri 1988 yatsindiye umudari w'umuringa muri metero 1500, asubiramo iyi mikorere nyuma y'imyaka itanu i Durban muri Shampiyona yo muri 1993. Ibi nyuma ya Shampiyona yo muri 1992 yabereye muri Maurice aho yatsindiye umudari w'umuringa muri metero 3000. Yatsindiye kandi umudari wa bronze i Cairo mu mikino yo muri Afurika yo muri 1991, yongera muri metero 1500. Yarangije cumi na gatatu muri metero 5000 muri Shampiyona yisi muri 1999.
Yabaye kandi mu makipe atandatu yegukanye umudari mu marushanwa ya IAAF World Cross Country Championship yarangije ku mwanya wa 31 muri 1990 mu gutsindira ifeza y'amakipe, ku ya 28 muri 1992 mu gutwara umuringa w'amakipe, ku mwanya wa 14 muri 1994 gutsindira ifeza y'amakipe, 29 muri 1996 muri gutsindira ifeza y'ikipe, 21 muri 1998 mu gutwara feza y'ikipe na 17 muri 2000 mugutwara feza y'amakipe, byose muri bar 2000 mu mikino ndende.

Gudaf Tsegay Desta (yavutse ku ya 23 Kamena 1997) ni Umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati kandi no mutera ndende. Niwe w'egukanye umudari wa bronze wa Tokiyo muri 2020 muri metero 5000 mu bagore. Mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi, yatsindiye umuringa muri metero 1500 muri 2019 na feza muri ibi birori na zahabu kuri metero 5000 muri 2022. Tsegay ni inshuro ebyiri metero 1500 Uwatsindiye umudari wa Shampiyona y'imbere mu nzu, yegukana zahabu muri 2022 na bronze muri 2016. Nubu ufite ragahigo kwisi mu mazu muri metero 1500, ibirori aho yashyizeho kandi isi munsi yi myaka 18 (iriho) na bataarengeje imwaka 20.
Afite imyaka 17, yabaye Shampiyona yisi yabato 2014 muri metero 1500, umudari wa feza. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu ntera mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu yo muri 2014. Tsegay azi kwiruka cyane. Kugeza muri Gashyantare 2023, yari umugore wa 10 ku isi wihuta cyane muri metero 800, kandi uwa gatandatu kuri metero 5000 na metero 10,000.
Muri Gashyantare 2014, Gudaf Tsegay w'imyaka 17 y'amavuko yashyize ku mwanya wa mbere ku isi munsi y’abatarengeje imyaka 18 kuri metero 1500 mu nzu hamwe na metero 4, 8.47s i Stockholm. Muri Nyakanga, yabonye umudari wa zahabu mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye i Eugene, muri Oregon ku mwanya wa 4: 10.83, inyuma ya mugenzi we Dawit Seyaum muri 4: 09.86.
Nyuma yi myaka ibiri, Tsegay yegukanye umudari w’abatarengeje imyaka 20 muri ibi birori byabereye mu nzu mu gihe cya metero 4 1.81s i Glasgow, yatsinze ibitego byiza byashyizweho na mugenzi we Kalkidan Gezahegne mu mwaka wo muri 2010 n'amasegonda arenga. Amateka ya Tsegay yazamuwe neza muri 2020 nundi mugenzi we Lemlem Hailu. Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu yabereye i Portland, Oregon, yegukanye umudari wa bronze muri 4: 05.71 inyuma ya Sifan Hassan we nyine uhagarariye Ubuholandi (4: 04.96) na Dawit (4: 05.30). Icyo gihe umusore wi myaka 19 yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya muri metero 800 mu mikino olempike ya Rio 2016, aho yakuyeho ubushyuhe 3, isaha 2: 00.13.

Senbere Teferi (yavutse ku ya 3 Gicurasi 1995) ni Umunyetiyopiya wa bigize umwuga wiruka hagati na intera ndende wiruka cyane muri metero 1500 no kwambukiranya igihugu. Yabonye umudari wa feza muri Shampiyona yisi ya IAAF muri 2015. Yaserukiye igihugu cye mu marushanwa y’isi yo muri 2013 kandi yegukana imidari, ari ku murongo ndetse n’abato ku isi ndetse n’urwego rw’abato ku isi.
Yavutse Senbere Teferi Sora, yegukanye umudari we wa mbere mpuzamahanga mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’urubyiruko muri 2011 yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri, akaza ku mwanya wa kabiri muri metero 1500, kuri Kwizera kwa Kipyegon. Yazamutse hejuru y'igihugu cyose hamwe na metero 1500 gutsinda muri Shampiyona y imikino ngororamubiri ya Etiyopiya. Yafashe igihanga gikomeye mu buryo bwa Tiki Gelana muri Women First 5K, i Addis Abeba muri Werurwe muri 2012. Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’ingimbi muri 2012 muri irushanwa, yageze ku byiza bye ku minota 4: 08.28 muri metero 1500 ku mukino wa nyuma, ariko yongeye gutsindwa na Kipyegon ndetse na Amela Terzić, amusigira umuringa muto.
irushanwa rya Cross country niyo y'ibandaga nyuma yi gihembwe cyo gukurikirana. Yatsindiye Cross de l'Acier mu Bufaransa muri Gushyingo 2014. Yatoranijwe mu ikipe nkuru ya Etiyopiya mu marushanwa ya IAAF muri 2015 kandi, nubwo yagize ikibazo cy’imvune mu cyumweru cyabanjirije iki gikorwa, yajyanye mu gikombe cy’imbere hamwe na Agnes Jebet Tirop maze bombi baba aba ubwoko, hamwe na Tirop yaje gutsinda Senbere muri metero 200 z'anyuma, gusiga Umunyetiyopiya n'umudari wa feza. Umukinnyi wa mbere wa Senbere kandi yabonye umutwe we w’abagore bo muri Etiyopiya ku gikombe cy’ikipe, afashijwe na mugenzi we (ndetse n’umudari wa bronze) Netsanet Gudeta.

Yimenashu Taye (yavutse 1979) ni umunyetiyopiya wiruka intera ndende muri marato.
Mu 1998 yatsindiye isiganwa ryabato muri Shampiyona yisi ya Cross Cross Country kandi yegukana imidari ya feza muri metero 1500 na metero 3000 muri Shampiyona yisi yabato. Muri Shampiyona ny'afurika muri uwo mwaka yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 3000.
Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’o kuzenguruka w’isi muri 2000 yarangije ku mwanya wa gatandatu mu isiganwa rigufi, mu gihe ikipe ya Etiyopiya Taye ya bigizemo uruhare yegukanye umudari wa feza mu marushanwa y'amakipe.

Genzeb Shumi Regasa (yavutse ku ya 29 Mutarama 1991) ni Umunyetiyopiya wavukiye mu ntera yo hagati wiruka mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga muri Bahirayini. Yatsindiye umudari wa zahabu muri metero 1500 muri mu marushanwa ya Athletisme yo muri Aziya muri 2011 ndetse na Shampiyona yo muri Aziya yabaye mu mwaka wo muri 2012. Ibihe byiza bye ni amasaha 2: 01.18 kuri metero 800 na 4: 05.16 kuri 1500.
Yavukiye muri Etiyopiya, yatangiye kwiruka muri Bahirayini mu mwaka wa muri 2010, atangira gukinira irushanwa ry’abato mu marushanwa ya IAAF World Cross Country muri 2010 ndetse arangiza ari cumi na karindwi. Yatsinze agahigo k'igihugu kabato muri metero 800 na metero 1500 muri uwo mwaka. Yatsinze metero 1500 mu irushanwa yi'mikino ngororamubiri yo muri Aziya yo muri 2010 kandi yabaye igisonga cya metero 3000. Yirutse ku rwego rw'isi mu marushanwa y’ingimbi 2010 ya beraga muri irushanwa nyuma y'ibyumweru bike hanyuma amaze gukora amateka y’abato bo muri Bahrein iminota 4: 14.05 mu bushyuhe, yatinze muri metero 1500, yanyuma kandi yarangije icya cumi. Yashizeho metero 800 mubato akoresha amasaha 2: 04.09 muminota ashyushye mumikino ya Aziya 2010, ariko yongeye gutinda ku mukino wa nyuma, afata umwanya wa munani.
Yakusanyije indi midari mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri yo muri Aziya 2012, atwara 1500 umutwe no kurangiza icya kabiri kuri Zhao Jing muri metero 800. Nyuma yibi yegukanye umudari we wa mbere wa mbukiranya igihugu mu marushanwa ya Shampiyona yo muri Aziya, afata umwanya wa gatatu muri podium ya Bahrein hamwe na Shitaye Eshete na Tejitu Daba. Yirutse muri metero 800 na m 1500 mu mikino Olempike ya 2012, agera muri kimwe cya kabiri cya metero 800.

Besu Sado Beko (yavutse ku ya 12 Mutarama 1996) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Etiyopiya witabira imikino yo kwiruka hagati. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu marushanwa y'isi yo muri 2015 yabereye i Beijing mu bushinwa, agera muri kimwe cya kabiri. Byongeye kandi, yegukanye umudari wa feza mu mikino ny'afurika ya muri 2015.

Abebech Negussie (yavutse ku ya 2 Mutarama 1983 muri Arsi) ni Umunyetiyopiya wasezeye mu kwiruka aharehare ndetse no hagati, kabuhariwe muri metero 1500. Yaserukiye Etiyopiya muri ibyo birori mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2000 ndetse na Shampiyona y'isi muri 2001 yaberaga muri irushanwa.

Hirut Meshesha (yavutse ku ya 20 Mutarama 2001) ni umunyetiyopiya wiruka hagati. Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 1500 mu bagore mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu muri 2022 yabereye i Beligrade. Meshesha yatwaye umudari wa zahabu muri metero 800 mu mikino ny'afurika ya muri 2019.
Hirut Meshesha yungutse ubunararibonye mpuzamahanga bwa mbere mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IAAF muri 2017 munsi y'abafite imyaka 18 yabereye i Nairobi muri Kenya, aho yegukanye umudari wa bronze muri metero 800 mu bakobwa. Nyuma yagiye muri Arijantine mu mikino Olempike y’urubyiruko yo mu mpeshyi ya muri 2018 yabereye i Buenos Aires maze atwara umuringa mu birometero 800 by’abakobwa
Muri Mata 2019, yitabiriye amarushanwa ny'afurika munsi ya'abifte imyaka 18 na munsi ya'abifte imyaka 20 yaberaga i Abidjan, muri kote divuwari, kandi yegukana umudari wa feza kuri metero 800 mu bagore bari munsi y’i myaka 20. Ukwezi kumwe, yatsindiye umudari muri metero 800 mu bagore muri Shampiyona ya Etiyopiya. Muri Kanama, Meshesha yari ahagarariye Etiyopiya mu mikino Ny'afurika yo muri 2019 yabereye i Rabat, muri Maroke kandi yegukana umudari wa zahabu mu kwiruka metero 800.
Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 1500 mu bagore mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yabereye mu nzu yabereye i Beligrade, muri Seribiya. Mugenzi we Gudaf Tsegay ya yoboye imidari ya Etiyopiya iratwara kuko Axumawit Embaye yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri.

Tigist Gezahagn Mengistu (yavutse ku ya 12 Werurwe 2000) ni umukinnyi wa Paralempikee wo muri Etiyopiya. Yagaragaje bwa mbere abamugaye bahagarariye Etiyopiya mu mikino Paralempike yo muri 2020. Mu gihe cy'imikino Paralympike yo muri 2020, yakoze agahigo abaye umudari wa mbere wa zahabu muri Etiyopiya mu mateka y'abamugaye.
Yatsindiye umudari wazahabu mu bagore muri T13 1500m mu mikino Paralympike ya Tokiyo yo muri 2020. Wari kandi umudari wa zahabu wa mbere muri Etiyopiya muri Paralempike kandi wari umudari we y'atsindiye ni umudari wa gatatu w’abamugaye muri Etiyopiya hamwe nindi midari ibiri izana ifeza.

Meskerem Legesse (Yavutse ku ya 28 Nzeri 1986 - 15 Nyakanga 2013) yari umunyetiyopiya wiruka. Yitabiriye metero 1.500 mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2004 yabereye muri Atenayi. Legesse yahindutse umunyamwuga kandi yitabira ibikorwa byinshi byo muri Amerika ahantu hatandukanye.
Yashyize ku rutonde rw'abato ku isi muri metero 800 mu nzu hamwe na masaha 2: 01.03 i Fayetteville, muri Amerika ku ya 14 Gashyantare 2004. Mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2004, yirukanye umwanya wa 4:18:03 (umwanya wa cumi na kabiri mu bushyuhe bwo mu cyiciro cya mbere), ntiyakomeza kujya mu cyiciro cy'abatsindira umudari.
Legesse yabaga i Westport, muri leta ya Connecticut kandi yari amaze imyaka icyenda muri Etiyopiya, kuva muri 2004. Yasezeye kwiruka kubera ikibazo cy'umutima.
Legesse yapfuye mu buryo butunguranye ibyumweru bitatu mbere yuko abyara. Yari kumwe n'umuhungu we w'imyaka ibiri ubwo yagwaga ku ya 15 Nyakanga 2013 muri resitora i Hamden, muri leta ya Connecticut. Abaganga baratsinze m'ugukiza umwana we wari utaravuka.

Maryam Yusuf Jamal (yavutse yitwa Zenebech Tola yavutse ku ya 16 Nzeri 1984) ni Umunyetiyopiya wavukiye muri Bahirayini yiruka intera ndende. Niwe mukinnyi wa mbere wo muri Bahirayini wegukanye umudari wa Olempike, zahabu (umuringa, ariko nyuma yaje kuzamurwa nyuma yo kurenga ibyongera imbarag ebyiri) mu isiganwa ry’abagore ya metero 1500, mu mikino Olempike yabereye i Londres muri 2012. Uyu kandi wari umudari wa mbere wa olempike wegukanywe n'umugore uhagarariye leta yi kigobe. Yavukiye muri Etiyopiya, 2005 nicyo gihe cye cyambere cyuzuye. Yatsindiye umudari w'igihugu kandi yiruka metero 3000 byihuse y'umwaka, hamwe ni gihe cya 8: 28.87 mu marushanwa yabereye Oslo. Jamal ni shampiyo wisi inshuro ebyiri muri 1500, amaze gutsinda muri Shampiyona yisi ya 2007 na 2009 muri Athletisme.
Yahagarariye Bahirayini mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 yabereye i Beijing, arangiza ari uwa gatanu muri metero 1500 ku mukino wnguma. Jamal kandi yatsindiye byinshi mu marushanwa yo mu karere: yegukanye imidari ibiri ya zahabu mu mikino ya Aziya ya 2006 hiyongereyeho na Shampiyona yo muri Aziya yambukiranya igihugu muri 2007 na 2009.
Jamal yavukiye muri Zone ya Arsi muri karere ka Oromia muri Etiyopiya, agace kazwi cyane mu kwiruka intera, barimo Haile Gebrselassie, Kenenisa Bekele na Tirunesh Dibaba. Ni Umuyisilamu, kandi akomoka muri Oromo.

Sultan Haydar (Yavutse ku ya 23 Gicurasi 1985 i Golerogi, muri Etiyopiya) ni Umunyetiyopiya wavukiye muri Turukiya wiruka intera ndende muri marato. ni umukinnyi muremure kuri 55 kg, hamwe nuburebure bwa metero 170, umunyamuryango wa Enkaspor, aho atozwa na Nikola Borić.
Yavukiye i Chaltu Girma Meshesha muri Etiyopiya, yatangiye umwuga we wo kwiruka intera yo hagati kandi yaboye umudari wa bronze muri metero 800 mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika yo muri 2005. Yagaragaye ku rwego mpuzamahanga rwa nyuma muri Etiyopiya yaje mu marushanwa ya Afurika yo muri 2006 yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri, aho yerekanye impano yo gusiganwa ku magare kuko yaje ku mwanya wa gatandatu mu bagore kuri kilometero 20. Yimuriye Turukiya muri 2008.
Amarushanwa ya mbere ya Haydar muri Turukiya ni Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’i Burayi yo muri 2008. Yatangiye isiganwa ry’abatarengeje imyaka 23 mu bagore, vuba ariko atanga umwanya wa mbere maze arekera aho bigeze. Yatsindiye umudari wa metero 1500 muri zahabu, mu marushanwa ya Athletisme yu Burayi yo muri 2009, nyuma atsindira isiganwa ry’abatarengeje imyaka 23 mu marushanwa y’ibihugu by’i Burayi yaberaga muri 2009 nyuma yu wo mwaka. Mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 2011 yatangiye bwa mbere muri kimwe cya kabiri cya marato maze yandika isaha 1:10:02 ku mwanya wa karindwi kuri Calibre ndende RAK Half Marathon. Yirutse muri metero 1500 mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri yo mu Burayi muri 2010, ariko ananirwa kurangiza ubushyuhe bwe. Yerekeje kuri metero 3000 mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri yo mu Burayi ya muri 2011, aho yashyize ku mwanya wa mbere iminota 9: 03.50 kugira ngo atsinde ubushyuhe, ariko atinda ku mukino wa nyuma, aza ku mwanya wa cyenda. Hanze, yarushanwe muri Turukiya kubutaka bw'iwabo muri Shampiyona ya mbere ya Shampiyona ya makipe yu Burayi muri 2011 kandi yatsindiye muri metero 3000 mu mwanya muremure wohanagura hamwe na Alemitu Bekele Degfa na Binnaz Uslu. Haydar yatsindiye kandi umuringa muri metero 1500.

Sifan Hassan (Yavutse 1 Mutarama 1993 Yasoje inshuro eshatu zitigeze zibaho mu mikino Olempike ya Tokiyo yo muri 2020 y egukana imidari ya zahabu muri metero 5000 na metero 10,000, n'umudari wa bronze muri metero 1500. Hassan niwe mukinnyi w'enyine mu mateka ya Olempike wegukanye imidari mu birometero bigera hagati ndetse no gusiganwa kure cyane mu mikino imwe. Ni umugore wa kabiri gusa wujuje intera ya olempike kabiri.
Mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi, Hassan yatwaye ibikombe bya metero 1500 na 10,000, muri 2019, abaye umukinnyi w'enyine (umugabo cyangwa umugore) mu mateka we gukanye ibyo birori byombi mu marushanwa y’isi imwe cyangwa imikino Olempike. Yatsindiye umudari w'umuringa kuri metero 1500 muri 2015, no kuri 5000 muri 2017 ubwo na we yarangije umwanya wa gatanu kuri metero 1500. Hassan ni inshuro eshatu yegukanye umudari wa Shampiyona y’imbere mu nzu, yegukana umudari wa zahabu kuri metero 1500 muri 2016 ndetse nafeza, kuri metero 3000 na bronze kuri 1500 muri 2018. Yabonye imidari itandatu yo mu Burayi (harimo imitwe ibiri yambukiranya igihugu), n'umudari umwe wo mu Burayi. Yatsindiye kandi inshuro eshatu Diamond League, amaze kubona metero 1500 / 5000 muri 2019.
Hassan ni we ufite agahigo ku isi mu gusiganwa ku birometero kimwe na kilometero 5, byombi byashyizweho muri 2019, ndetse no gukora isaha imwe, byashyizweho muri 2020. Yatwaye amateka ku isi ku 10,000 iminsi ibiri muri kamena 2021. Afite inyandiko eshanu zi Burayi (metero 1500, 3000, 5000, 10,000, igice cya marato) hamwe n’uwubuholandi butatu.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Sifan Hassan yavukiye i Adama, Oromia, Etiyopiya akurira mu cyaro cya Kersa mu karere ka Munesa muri Zone ya Arsi ya Oromia. Yari kwiruka mu myidagaduro. Yavuye muri Etiyopiya ari impunzi agera mu Buholandi muri 2008 afite imyaka cumi n'itanu. Yatangiye kwiruka akora amasomo yo kuba umuforomo. Hassan yabaye umwenegihugu w’Ubuholandi muri 2013.

Yehualeye Beletew Mitiku (Yavutse ku ya 31 Nyakanga 1998) ni umunyetiyopiya ugenda asiganwa n'amaguru. Yitabiriye ibirori byo kugenda ibirometero 20 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016. Muri 2019, yitabiriye isiganwa ry’ibirometero 20 mu bagore mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi yabereye i Doha, muri katari.
Yarangije ku mwanya wa 16. Yitabiriye amarushanwa yo kugenda ibirometero 20 mu bagore mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2020.

Aynalem Eshetu Shefrawe (yavutse 5 Gashyantare 1992) ni umunyetiyopiya ugenda n'amaguru. Yatsindiye imidari myinshi kurwego rw'umugabane.
Kugeza ubu afite inyandiko nyinshi zi gihugu mu ntera zitandukanye.

Perennes Paulette Ruddy Zang-Milama (yavutse ku ya 6 Kamena 1987 i Port-Gentil) ni umukinnyi wa siporo ukomoka muri Gabon.
Zang Milama yari ahagarariye Gabon mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 yabereye i Beijing. Yarushanwe muri metero 100 yiruka ashyira umwanya wa gatatu m'ubushyuhe bwe bwa mbere nyuma ya Shelly-Ann Fraser na Vida Anim m'ugihe cy'amasegonda 11.62. Yatsindiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri aho yananiwe kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kuko igihe cye cya masegonda 11.59 cyari inshuro ya karindwi mu isiganwa rye.
Mu mwaka wo muri 2010, yegukanye umudari wa bronze i Doha mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga yo mu nzu ya IAAF muri 2010. Nyuma yuwo mwaka yatsindiye muri metero 100 abona feza na metero 200 bronze muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2010 y'aberaga muri Nairobi. Muri 2012, yatsindiye agahigo y'igihugu cya Gabon inshuro ebyiri, arangiza afite amasegonda 11.03 arenga metero 100 kugirango atware umudari wa zahabu muri Shampiyona ny'afurika ya bereye muri isiganwa muri 2012. Mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2012, yujuje amajonjora muri metero 100 mu bagore. Muri 2013, yakoze agahigo k'igihugu amasegonda agera 7,12 muri metero 60 i Moscou.
Ku ya 21 Gicurasi 2014, Zang Milama yipimishije ibintu bibujijwe mu kizamini cyo mu marushanwa. Nyuma yaje guhagarikwa amezi arindwi muri siporo.

Gina Bass (yavutse ku ya 3 Gicurasi 1995) ni umukinnyi wa Gambiya uhatanira gusiganwa ku maguru. Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze muri metero 200 muri Shampiyona ny'afurika muri 2016. Bass yujuje ibisabwa mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016 kandi yari afite ibendera rya Gambiya.
Mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2016, yashyize ku mwanya wa 52 mu bushyuhe bwa metero 200 kandi ntiyujuje ibisabwa muri kimwe cya kabiri.
Niwe w'ambere wujuje amajonjora ya Gambiya ku mukino wa nyuma mu mikino y'isi y'imikino ngororamubiri.
Kugeza ubu afite agahigo kigihugu muri metero 100 na 200.
Yujuje ibisabwa kugirango ahagararire Gambiya mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2020 mu bagore muri metero 100 na metero 200. Mu kwiruka metero 100, yashyizeho amateka mashya y'igihugu amasegonda agera 11.12.

Saruba Colley (yavutse ku ya 5 Gashyantare 1989, avukira i Sibanor) ni umukinnyi wa siporo wo muri Gambiya. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya metero 100 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2012 ; yirukanka abanziriza akora amasegonda 12.21, amushoboza kujya mu cyiciro cya 1, no mu cyiciro cya 1 mu masegonda 12.06, ibyo bikaba byashyize ahagaragara agahigo k’igihugu cya Gambiya ariko ntibyamujuje ibisabwa muri kimwe cya kabiri.

Irmgard Bensusan (yavutse ku ya 24 Mutarama 1991) ni umunyafurika yepfo wavutse akina umukino wa Paralempike yiruka ubu uhatanira mu Ubudage, cyane mu mikino ya T44. Bensusan yitabiriye imikino Paralympike yo muri 2016 aho yatsindiye imidari itatu ya feza mu kwiruka metero 100, 200 na 400.
Bensusan yavutse ku ya 24 Mutarama 1991 i Pretoria, Afurika y'Epfo. Yize ibaruramari muri kaminuza ya Johannesburg.
Bensusan yabanje gukara siporo nku munywanyi ushoboye mu gihe aba muri Afrika yepfo. Muri 2009 mu gihe yarushanwaga yahuye ni mbogamizi, maze acika imitsi mu ivi ry'iburyo. Imvune yamuviriyemo ku mugara ukuguru kw'iburyo munsi yivi. Bensusan yarebye kuba umukinnyi wa para-siporo ariko ntiyabasha kubona ibyiciro muri komite y'abamugaye muri Afrika yepfo. Kubera ko nyina yari Umudage yari yemerewe guhagararira Ubudage, bityo akajya mu Burayi gufata icyicaro i Leverkusen, nyuma aza gushyirwa mu bakinnyi ba T44 basiganwa ku maguru.
Muri 2014, yaserukiye Ubudage mu birori bye bya mbere mpuzamahanga, yerekeje muri Swansea muri Wales kwitabira amarushanwa ya IPC irushanwa ry’i Burayi muri 2014. Ngaho yatsindiye imidari itatu ya feza, muri metero 100, 200 na 400. Mu birori bibiri bigufi yakubiswe n’umuholandi 'Blade Babe' Marlou van Rhijn, naho muri metero 400 yakubiswe n’igihe gishya cy’isi na Marie-Amélie Le Fur w’Umufaransa. Umwaka umwe, Bensusan yitabiriye amarushanwa yisi ya IPC ya muri 2015 yabereye i Doha.
2016 Imikino Paralympike.
Mu rwego rwo kwitegura imikino Paralympike yo mu 2016 yabereye i Rio, Bensusan yitabiriye Shampiyona ya kabiri y’Uburayi, kuri iyi nshuro i Grosseto, mu Butaliyani. Bensusan yashoboye gutwara umudari wa zahabu haba muri metero 100 na 200. Ibihe bye byerekeje i Rio yabonye Bensusan yujuje ibisabwa byose mu gusiganwa ku maguru mu mikino Paralympike: metero 100, metero 200 na metero 400. Yatwaye ifeza muri ibyo birori uko ari bitatu, atakaza imidari ya zahabu na van Rhijn (metero 100 na metero 200) na Le Fur (metero 400).

Marjorie Rees Clark (yavutse ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 1909 – 15 Kamena 1993) yari umukinnyi w’imikino ngororamubiri wo muri Afurika yepfo, witabiriye imikino Olempike yo muri 1928 ndetse no mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1932. Yavukiye i Bulwer, KwaZulu-Natal kandi yarushanwe mu ikipe ya Albion Ladies Athletic Club.
Mu 1928 Clark yarangije kumwanya wa gatanu mu birori byo gusimbuka hejuru mu mikino Olempike. Yitabiriye kandi amarushanwa ya metero zigera ku 100, ariko asezererwa muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza. Nyuma y'imyaka ine yegukanye umudari wa bronze mu marushanwa ya metero 80 yiruka mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1932. Mu isiganwa ryo hejuru ryo muri 1932 yongeye kurangiza ku mwanya wa gatanu no mu marushanwa ya metero zigera 100, ariko asezererwa mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Muri 1928 Amarushanwa y'abategarugori batabigize umwuga, Association Miss Clark yatsindiye inzitizi 100 yds inzitizi &amp; no gusimbuka hejuru.
Mu mikino yo mu Bwongereza muri 1934 yegukanye umudari wa zahabu mu marushanwa ya metero 80 ndetse no mu birori byo gusimbuka. Nk'umunyamuryango w'ikipe ya relay ya Afrika yepfo yarangije umwanya wa kane mu marushanwa ya metero 110-220-110. Mu marushanwa ya metero 100 no mu birori bya metero ya 220 yakuweho mu cyiciro cya mbere.

Ilse Hayes (yavutse 30 Kanama 1985), uzwi kandi ku izina rya Ilse Carstens, ni umukinnyi wamugaye ukomoka muri Afurika yepfo uhatanira cyane mu marushanwa yo muri T13. Hayes yagiye guhatanira igihugu cye mu mikino ine y'abamugaye mu mpeshyi guhera mu mikino Paralempike yo muri 2004 yabereye muri Atenayi, mu Bugereki. Yatsindiye imidari kuri buri mukino, mu mikino ine harimo imidari ibiri ya zahabu, haba mu gusimbuka birebire, i Beijing muri2008) na London muri 2012). Nkuko yatsindiye Paralempikee, Hayes niwe wegukanye imidari myinshi kurwego rwa Shampiyona y'isi.
Hayes yavukiye i Johannesburg, muri Afurika y'Epfo muri 1985. Afite imyaka cumi n'umwe bamusanganye indwara ya Stargardt, ubwoko bwarazwe bwo kwangirika kwu bwonko, bitera kubura icyerekezo buhoro. Yize muri kaminuza ya Stellenbosch, aho yize ubumenyi bwa siporo n’ubuvuzi bw’abana. Yashakanye na Cassie Carstens kandi batuye muri Stellenbosch.
Hayes yinjiye ku rwego mpuzamahanga rwa siporo ubwo yinjiraga mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya IPC Athletisme muri 2002 y'abereye i Lille mu Bufaransa. Yinjiye mu byiciro bitatu, mu cyiciro cya T13, y'egukana umudari wa zahabu muri metero 400 yiruka n'umuringa muri metero 100. Yinjiye kandi mu gusimbuka birebire, ariko intera nziza yari 4.93 ya mubonye agwa hanze yu mudari wa kane. Ibi bya mujyanye mu mikino ya Paralempike yo muri 2004 yabereye muri Atenayi aho yatwaye umudari we wa mbere w’abamugaye, umuringa mu kwiruka metero 400 mu bagore T13. Yatsindiye kandi umwanya wa gatanu mu bagore metero 100 muri T13.
Muri 2006 Hayes yinjiye mu marushanwa ye ya kabiri y'isi, iki gihe ni Assen mu Buholandi. Yatwaye indi midari ibiri ya bronze, ku nshuro ya metero 200 na 400. Yateje imbere ibisubizo birebire kuva mu myaka ine yabanjirije kohereza intera ya 5.19, ariko ntiyabasha gubona agatuti. Intsinzi ye ikomeye kugeza ubu izaza nyuma y'imyaka ibiri mu mikino Paralympike yo muri 2008 yabereye i Beijing, ubwo yatsindaga umudari wa mbere wa zahabu. Agezeyo, ye gukanye umwanya wa mbere mu gusimbuka birebire, yandika intsinzi ya 5.68 ubwo ya geragezaga k'unshuro ya kane gutsinda Anthi Karagianni w’Ubugereki ku mwanya wa kabiri na santimetero zigera kuri 5. Hayes yatwaye kandi umudari wa feza avuye i Beijing avuye muri metero 100.
