Carina Ihembe (yavutse 9 Werurwe 1989) ni umukinnyi wiruka wo muri Afrika yepfo. Yarushanwe muri metero 60 muri Shampiyona y'isi muri IAAF 2014 Yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri.
Ku ya 13 Nzeri 2019 yahagaritswe by'agateganyo mu marushanwa azira kurenga ku mategeko yo kurwanya doping. Amatangazo y'ibirego yatanzwe yerekanaga ko Ibutamoren na Ligandrol (LGD-4033).

Evette de Klerk (yavutse ku ya 21 Kanama 1965) ni umunya Afurika yepfo wahoze asiganwa ku maguru. Yabaye umukinnyi wiganje mu bakobwa basiganwa ku maguru muri Afurika yepfo mu myaka ya za 1980, yatsindiye metero 100/200, metero ebyiri muri shampiyona y'igihugu mu myaka icumi yatangiye kuva 1982 kugeza 1991. Yatwaye kandi ibikombe bitatu bya Afrika yepfo muri metero 400. Harimo amarushanwa ya shampiona yamasegonda 11.06 (ubuzima bwe bwiza) kuri metero 100 n'amasegonda 22.36 kuri 200.
Ibyiza bye ku mikino ngufi byombi bikomeza kuba Afrika yepfo ku birometero 200, igihe cy'amasegonda 22.06 nicyo cyihuta cyanditswe nu mukinnyi ny'afurica, ariko ntabwo aricyo gitabo cya Afrika kuko kitari cyemejwe n'inzego nyo bozi z'umugabane. Icyo gihe cyashyize ku mwanya wa kabiri ku isi hejuru ya metero 200 mu 1989, inyuma ya Dawn Sowell. Usibye aya manota, yashyizeho ibyiza byamasegonda 50.57 kuri metero 400.
De Klerk ntabwo ya rushanwe ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu gihe yari ku rwego rwo hejuru mu mwuga we biturutse ku kwamagana siporo yo muri Afurika y'Epfo mu gihe cy'apartheid. Yagaragaye mu ruhando mpuzamahanga muri Afurika yepfo yaje muri shampiyona ye heruka ku rwego rwo hejuru muri 1993). Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze inshuro ebyiri muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 1993 yaberaga muri isiganrwa agera kuri podium muri metero 200 na metero 4 × 100. Yakomeje guhagararira Afurika y'Epfo mu marushanwa y'isi yaberaga mu mikino ngororamubiri muri 1993 kandi yabaye kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza muri metero 200. Yanze icyifuzo cyo guhatanira u Bwongereza mu gihe ibihano byari bihari, nkuko mugenzi we wo muri Afurika y'Epfo, Zola Budd yabigenje.
Yarushanwe muri make ku izina ryubatse nka Evette Armstrong muri 1986 na 1987.
Carina Ihembe ryangana na metero 100 ya de Klerk amateka yi gihugu muri 2015, nyuma y'imyaka 25 yashizweho. De Klerk akomeza kuba afite umuvuduko wihuse m'ubihe byose, abikesheje umuyaga we wifashishije umuyaga masegonda 10.94 muri 1990.

Amanda Kotze (Yavutse ku ya 26 Gashyantare 1986) ni umukinnyi wa siporo wo muri Afurika y'Epfo wasezeye ka buhariwe muri metero 400.
Ku giti cye yitabiriye amarushanwa y’isi y’urubyiruko muri 2003 ndetse na Shampiyona y’abatarengeje imyaka muri 2004, nyuma yaje ku mwanya wa gatandatu muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2006 kandi yitabira imikino ya Afurika Yose muri 2007 atagera ku mukino wa nyuma.
Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga y’abatarengeje imyaka muri 2004 ya nitabiriye metero 4 × 100 na metero 4 × 400. Iyi kipe hamwe na Kotze nk'umunyamuryango nayo yitabiriye metero 4 × 400 mu marushanwa ya Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 2005 ndetse n'imikino ya yabavuga icyo ngereza muri 2006, yegukana umudari wa zahabu muri marushanwa ya Afurika yo muri 2006 ndetse n'umudari wa silver mu mikino yo muri Afurika muri 2007.
Igihe cye cyiza ni amasegonda 52,76, yagezeho mu mikino ya Afrika Yose muri 2007.

Isabel Le Roux (yavutse ku ya 23 Mutarama 1987) ni u mukinnyi wo gu siganwa ku maguru wo muri Afurika y'Epfo u zobereye muri metero zigera 200.
Muri Shampiyona ny'afurika muri 2008 yatsindiye kwiruka muri metero 200 m'ugihe cyiza cy'amasegonda 22.69. Yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri metero 4x100.
Muri metero 100 igihe cye cyiza ni amasegonda 1, yagezweho muri Mata 2004 i Bloemfontein.

Anrune Weyers (yavutse ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 1992), ni umukinnyi ukina paralempike na siporo wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yatangiye imikino ngororamubiri muri 2010. Weyers yavutse afite inenge ivuka mu kuboko kwe kw'ibumoso kandi arushanwa mu cyiciro cy'abafite ubumuga muri T47. Muri Shampiyona yisi ya IPC yo muri 2011 yegukanye umwanya wa kabiri muri metero 400 na gatandatu muri metero 200. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yatsindiye imidari ibiri mu mikino Paralympike y'i Londres, ari yo silver muri metero 400 n'umuringa muri metero 200. Nyuma y'uwo mwaka, iyo midari yibwe ubwo yavaga ku kibuga cy'indege cya George mu burengerazuba bwa Cape. Muri Shampiyona yisi ya IPC muri 2013 yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri muri metero 200 na metero 400.
Muri Shampiyona y'isi ya IPC 2015, yatsindiye metero 400, no muri Paralympike ya Rio muri 2016 yatsindiye silver muri metero 200 na 400. Weyers yatsindiye zahabu muri metero 400, ifeza muri metero 200 n'umuringa muri metero 100 muri Shampiyona yisi ya Para ya Athletisme yo muri 2019 yabereye i Dubai, ikanashyiraho amateka yisi ya amasegonda 55.60 kuri metero 400 mu gikombe cya Flanders i Huizengin, mu Bubiligi muri Kanama 2019.
Weyers yatsindiye zahabu muri metero 400 muri T47 muri Tokiyo muri 2021 (Paralympikee ye ya gatatu) mugihe cyiza cya 56.05.
Weyers ni umukristo. Weyers yashakanye na Stefan Weyers.

Elinda Vorster (Yavutse Rademeyer, yavutse ku ya 8 Nzeri 1965 i Cape Town) ni umukinnyi ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru wazobereye mu gusiganwa ku maguru. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu mikino Olempike yo muri 1992 na Shampiyona y'isi yo muri 1993.
Ibyiza bye ni amasegonda 11.22 muri metero 100 (1.4, Germiston 1990) n'amasegonda agera 22.58 muri metero 200 (+1.2, Germiston 1990).

Zenéy van der Walt (yavutse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2000) ni umukinnyi wo muri Afurika yepfo, akaba ari kabuhariwe mu kwiruka metero 400. Yatsindiye imidari ya zahabu muri Shampiyona y'isi munsi y'abarengeje imyaka 18 muri 2017 na Shampiyona yisi 2017 IAAF World abatarengeje imyaka 18 muri shampiyona ya 2017, Amarushanwa ya IAAF yisi 18 munsi y'abarengeje imyaka 20 muri 2018. Muri 2019, yatsindiye umudari wa feza muri kaminuza.

Tamzin Thomas (Yavutse 6 Ukwakira 1997) ni umukinnyi wo muri Afrika yepfo wiruka. Yatsindiye imidari ibiri muri Shampiyona ny'afurika mu ngimbi muri 2015.
Amarushanwa mpuzamahanga.
1 Ntabwo yatangiriye muri kimwe cya kabiri

Tsholofelo Thipe (yavutse ari Selemela) (yavutse ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1986) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wo muri Afurika y'Epfo, kabuhariwe muri metero 400. Yashyizeho igihe cyiza cya masegonda 51.15 atsinda muri metero 400 mu mikino ya Afrika yepfo yo muri 2009 yabereye i Stellenbosch. Yavukiye i Rustenburg, Intara y'Amajyaruguru.
Umwuga n'amahugurwa.
Thipe yari umwe mu bagore ba mbere b'abirabura bahagarariye Afurika y'Epfo mu nzira ubwo yarushanwaga muri metero 400 mu mikino Olempike yo muri 2008 yabereye i Beijing. Yirutse mu bushyuhe bwa gatandatu ahanganye n'abandi bakinnyi barindwi, barimo Novlene Williams wo muri Jamayica na Nicola Sanders wo mu Bwongereza, bombi bakaba bakunzwe cyane muri ibi birori. Yarangije isiganwa ku mwanya wa gatandatu, mirongo irindwi na magana atatu (0,73) by'isegonda imbere ya Klodiana Shala wo muri Alubaniya, akoresheje amasegonda agera kuri 54.11. Thipe yananiwe kujya muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza, kuko yashyize mirongo ine na gatatu muri rusange, arangiza munsi yi bice bitatu byikora by'imbere by'icyiciro gikurikira.
Thipe yashakaga kandi kujya mu mikino Olempike ye ya kabiri yabereye i Londres. Yabaye uwa gatanu ku mukino wanyuma wa metero 400 mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Afurika muri 2012 yabereye i Porto Novo, muri Bénin ; ariko, igihe cye cya masegonda agera 52.26 nticyari gihagije kugirango abone umwanya we mu mikino olempike. Ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2012, Thipe yari mu bakinnyi icumi bo muri Afurika y'Epfo batsinzwe ikizamini cy’i biyobyabwenge ku bintu by abujijwe, harimo na norandrosterone, muri Shampiyona ny'afurika. Yagaya umuganga w'ikipe kuba yaramwandikiye ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro byitwa "Norlevo" birimo ibintu bya bujijwe ku bitangazamakuru mbere yo gutumiza iburanisha ashobora kwirwanaho.
Thipe ni umukinnyi utuye muri Royal Bafokeng Athletics Club i Rustenburg. Yatojwe n’umugabo we, Eugene Thipe, unatoza gusiganwa ku maguru n’umunyamabanga w’igihugu Simon Magakwe, watsinze inshuro eshatu mu marushanwa y’imikino ngororamubiri muri furika.

Dikeledi Moropane (yavutse ku ya 12 Werurwe 1976) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru ukomoka muri Afurika y'Epfo wasezeye muri metero 400.
Yagaragaye cyane muri Shampiyona yisi yo muri 2001, aho yarushanwe muri metero 100 atageze ku mukino wanyuma.
Mu mikino yo muri Afurika yo muri 1999 yarushanwe muri metero 100, naho ikipe ya Afurika yepfo irangiza ku mwanya wa kane muri metero 4 × 100. Mu mikino yo muri Afurika Yose yo mri 2003, yarushanwe muri metero 100 maze yegukana umudari wa feza muri metero 4 × 100. Muri Shampiyona ny'afurika yo muri 2004 yarushanwe muri metero 100 kandi yegukana umudari wa feza muri metero 4 × 100.
Ibihe byiza bye yagize ni amasegonda 11.38, yageze muri Gashyantare 2000 muri Pretoriya.

Justine Palframan (Yavutse ku ya 4 Ugushyingo 1993) ni umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku maguru wo muri Afurika y'Epfo uzobereye mu kwiruka muri metero 200 na 400. Yatsinze metero 400 muri Université ya Summer muri 2015. Yahagarariye igihugu cya Afurika y'Epfo mu marushanwa y'isi ya IAAF yo muri 2013 na Olempike yo muri 2016.
Se wa Palframan Steve na nyina Trevlyn bahoze ari abakinnyi bakurikirana, mu gihe mushiki we Katelyn na murumuna we David barushanwaga mu mikino ngororamubiri hamwe no koga. Palframan yabanje kwitoza koga, umupira w'amaguru, na siporo, kandi afite imyaka 16 yi banze ku gusiganwa.

Wendy Seegers (yavutse yitwa Hartman ; yavutse ku ya 28 Gashyantare 1976) ni umukinnyi wo muri Afurika yepfo witwaye neza mu gusiganwa ku maguru. Yahagarariye igihugu cye muri Shampiyona yo muri 1999 no muri 1999. Abashakisha ubu ni abiruka muri Ositaraliya, bashiraho amateka menshi yo muri W35 yo gusiganwa. Iruka 55.72, kuya 17/12/15 kuri metero 400, kugirango ushireho igihugu 35-39 muri Australiya. Ibi byiyongera kubyo yanditse kuri metero 60 ya 7.61, metero 100 ya 12.01 na metero 200 ya 24.42. Ku ya 3 Werurwe 2016 Abashakisha amateka ya W40 yo muri Ositaraliya ya 24.52 kuri metero 200. Yakurikiranye ibi hamwe nandi ma shusho yo muri Ositaraliya ya 12.18 kuri W40 muri metero 100. Iri ni isegonda 1 gusa hanze yubuzima bwe bwiza.
Mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Masters 2016 yabereye i Perth, Seegers yiganjemo amarushanwa ya W40 y'imyaka, gutsinda metero 100 na 200, nubwo yagize imvune ikomeye. Igihe cye metero 100 cya 11.88 (+3.4) nicyo gihe cyihuta cyane cy'abagore muri rusange kandi niwe mugore wenyine wirutse munsi y'amasegonda 12. Abashakisha bayoboye ibice byombi ku ntsinzi kugirango bakomeze badatsindwa muri shampiyona.
Wendy Seegers yashimangiye izina rye nk'abakinnyi ba mbere ba W40 basiganwa ku maguru ku isi hamwe n'ibi bitaramo. Ni umunyamuryango ukundwa cyane kandi ufite agaciro muri WAMA n'ubwitonzi bw'akazi, ubunyangamugayo no gufasha abandi bakinnyi. Akenshi yishimiwe n'umugabo we, Gys hamwe nabana Jundro, Jeanae na Janko.

Heide Seyerling (Yavutse ku ya 19 Kanama 1976) yahoze ari umukinnyi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo, wavukiye i Port Elizabeth, yari kabuhariwe muri metero 200 na 400. Yakinnye kabiri mu mikino Olempike, mu 2000 na 2004. Mu mikino yo muri 2000 yageze kuri metero 400 ya nyuma arangiza ari uwa 6 afite amateka mashya (kandi n'ubu aracyahagarariye) igihugu ku gahigo k'amasegonda 50.05. Yashakanye n'uwahoze ari umukinnyi wa siporo Mathew Quinn.

Basaula Lemba (yavutse ku ya 3 Werurwe 1965) ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo wakinnye nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Umwuga we wose w'abigize umwuga yamaze muri Porutugali, cyane na Vitória de Guimarães.
Lemba yavukiye i Kinshasa, muri Zayire, yageze muri Porutugali afite imyaka 21, asinyana na Vitória SC wo muri AS Vita Club ariko ntacyo yakoze rwose yagize muri shampiyona ye ya mbere - imikino irindwi. Yakoresheje ubukangurambaga butatu bukurikira no muri Primeira Liga, ahagarariye O Elvas CAD na CF Estrela da Amadora.
Basaula - yitiriwe izina rye mu gihe muri Porutugali - yongeye kwinjira muri Vitória mu 1990, aba umukinnyi ukomeye wo hagati mu ikipe ya Minho ndetse anasanga ikipe n’umuturage N'Dinga Mbote mu gihe cye. Muri Mutarama 1995 yavuye mu rundi ruhande mu gihugu, CF Os Belenenses, yerekeza muri FC Tirsense nyuma gato. Nyuma y'umwaka umwe mu cyiciro cya kabiri hamwe na Moreirense FC yi mukiye muri shampiyona yo hasi, ahagarariye ikipe abiri kurwego rwa kane kugeza asezeye afite imyaka 35.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Lemba yakiniye Zayire mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu cyo muri 1992 na 1994, amarushanwa yombi arangira asohotse muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza.

Makabi Lilepo (Yavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 1997) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukinira ikipe ya Al-Hilal Club (Omdurman) yo muri Premier League ya Sudani, na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo
Lilepo yavuye mu rubyiruko rwa AS Vita Club ariko ntabwo yigeze yinjira mu ikipe ya mbere cyangwa ngo ibone umwanya wo gukina Linafoot. Mu mpera zo muri 2018 yatumiwe mu bigeragezo muri Zamalek SC ya Premier League yo muri Misiri. Muri Mutarama 2019, nyuma y'amezi abiri ategereje ko impapuro zirangira, yagurijwe Mbabane Swallows muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Eswatini 2018–19. Hagati y'igihe cya 2019–20 Linafoot, Lilepo yinjiye muri FC Renaissance du Congo. Yahise agira icyo akora atsinda ibitego bine mu mikino irindwi y'ambere yakinnye niyi kipe. Kugeza muri 2021 Lilepo yari yagarutse muri AS Vita maze agaragara muri iyi kipe muri 2020–21 CAF Champions League.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Lilepo yerekeje ku rwego mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga ku ya 17 Mutarama 2021 muri mukino wa Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 2020 na Congo. Nyuma y'iminsi 13 yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga yakinnye na Kameruni mu mikino ya kimwe cya kane kirangiza amarushanwa amwe.

Botomotoito Skito Litimba (Yavutse ku ya 7 Nyakanga 1977) ni Umunyekongo wahoze ari umukinnyi w’umupira w'abigize umwuga wakiniye nka AS Vita Club, yegukana igikombe cya Linafoot muri 1997. Mu Budage, yakiniye LR Ahlen, SC Paderborn 07, 1. FC Bocholt na SV Straelen.
Yari mu ikipe y’igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika Igikombe cyo muri 1998, yarangije ku mwanya wa gatatu.

Florian Lobilo Boba (Yavutse ku ya 10 Mata 1950) ni umukinnyi akaba myugariro w'umupira w'amaguru wa congo wakiniye Zayire mu gikombe cyisi cyo FIFA muri 1974.
Lobilo yakiniye AS Vita Club, aho yatwara igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1973 cya Champions Club.
Yari mu ikipe ya Zayire yegukanye igikombe cya nyuma cy’igikombe cy’Afurika muri 1974.
Yakinnye inshuro nyinshi muri Zayire muri 1974 yujuje amajonjora y’igikombe cy'isi kandi agaragara mu mukino umwe wo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi muri 1982 ; baza gutsinda Mozambike 5-2 ku ya 13 Nyakanga 1980.
Mu 2006, yatoranijwe na CAF nk'umwe mu bakinnyi 200 b'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika beza mu myaka 50 ishize.

Hervé Nguemba Lomboto (Yavutse ku ya 27 Ukwakira 1989) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Kongo ukina nk'umuzamu wa Motema Pembe ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Lomboto yatangiye umwuga we muri Amazone Kimbanseke yo muri DR Congo, maze muri 2012 y'imukira muri Vita Club. Yahamaze igihe gito na AC Léopards yo muri Repubulika ya Kongo muri 2013, mbere yo gusubira muri Vita Club. Yakurikiranye ibyo muri CS Don Bosco na Dauphins Noirs, mbere yo gusinyana na Motema Pembe ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2021.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2013, Lomboto yatangiye gukinira ikipe y'igihugu ya DR Congo mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cya Afurika muri 2–1 mu 2014

Serge Lofo Bongeli Senge (Yavutse ku ya 13 Ukwakira 1983)ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri wa DR Congo ukina nka Rutahizamu.
Lofo yavukiye i Kinshasa, Yatangiye umwuga we ku rubyiruko hamwe na AS Paulino Kinshasa kandi muri 1999 ya zamuwe mu ikipe nkuru. Nyuma y'imyaka itatu yakoranye na AS Paulino, yinjiye mu itumba 2002 muri TP Mazembe akinayo hari shampiyona ebyiri mbere muri Mutarama 2004 yashakishijwe n’ikipe ikomeye ya Angola Atlético Sport Aviação. Yagize ibihe bitatu byiza cyane muri AS Aviação maze asinyana muri Gashyantare 2007 muri Sagrada Esperança, ariko nyuma y'igihembwe kimwe niyi kipe ni myaka ine muri Angola asubira mu mujyi yavukiyemo wa Kinshasa, wasinyanye na AS Vita Club. Ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2010, yavuye muri AS Vita Club afatanije na Tychique Ntela Kalema gusinyira n'ikipe yo mu Budage Rot Weiss Ahlen, ariko ntabwo byari intambwe ikomeye kuri Serge. Ku ya 6 Nzeri 2010, yasinyiye amasezerano y'umwaka n'ikipe yo mu Bubiligi FC Bruxelles.
Mu 2013, yafatiwe muri Isiraheli akekwaho ubwicanyi, ariko arekurwa nyuma yuko inshuti ye yemeye ko ari we wakoze ubwo bwicanyi.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Lofo yafashwe inshuro icyenda n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Congo DR, maze atsinda ibitego 2.

Trésor Lomana LuaLua (yavutse ku ya 28 Ukuboza 1980) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga ukomoka muri congo uheruka gukina nka rutahizamu. Kuri ubu ni umutoza utoza Spalding United.
LuaLua yavukiye i Kinshasa, ariko yi mukira mu Bwongereza akiri muto. Nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru muri kaminuza, yasinyiye muri Colchester United. Ngaho yatsinze ibitego 21 byose mu mikino 68 byatumye Newcastle United imusinyisha. Ariko, guhatanira umwanya byasobanuraga ko atari muto mu bisanzwe mu ikipe y'ambere, kandi nyuma y'igihembwe bine n’imikino 88, yimukiye i Portsmouth, iyi kipe yari yaramutije amezi atatu igihe yari i Newcastle. Yagumyeyo ibihe bitatu, ariko yaranzwe n'ibibazo bya disipulini na malariya. Amaze kuva muri Portsmouth, yimuye amakipe kenshi, ahagarariye impande mu Bugereki, Qatar, Kupuro na Turukiya, usibye kugaruka gato mu mu pira w'amaguru mu Bwongereza i Blackpool. LuaLua yakiriye bwa mbere imipira 31 mpuzamahanga muri 2002, atsinda ibitego birindwi mu mwuga mpuzamahanga w'imyaka cumi n'umwe. Yahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu cye mu marushanwa ane y’igikombe cya Afurika.
LuaLua azwiho kandi gushinga "Fondasiyo ya LuaLua", yita ku mfubyi zo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, no kuba umurinzi w'itsinda ry'abasuye Haslar. Murumuna we Kazenga, na mubyara we Trésor Kandol na Yannick Bolasie, bose bakina umupira w'amaguru.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
LuaLua yavutse ari Trésor Lua Lua Lomana - na Lua Lua, ni izina rya sekuru, yarihawe na murumuna we Kazenga Umuryango we wabaga mu Irembo ry’Amashyamba i Londres ; niho, yize mu ishuri rya Community Gate Community School atangira gukina umupira afite imyaka 16, ari nako yitabira imikino ngororamubiri. Ibikorwa bye muri gimunasitike nibyo byashingiweho kwizihiza intego y'ibirango bye, ibicuruzwa birindwi by'inyuma hamwe na somersault inyuma. LuaLua yari ahagarariye ishuri rye mu mupira w'amaguru nyuma yo kugaragara atera umupira wa tennisi hirya no hino ku kibuga. Yakiniraga muri Leyton Sixth Form College, aho yize ibijyanye n'ubuhanzi, ubwo yagaragaye afite imyaka 17 kuruhande rwa kabiri, Colchester United. Geoff Harrop, umuskuti mu ikipe y’umupira w'amaguru ya Colchester College, yashimishijwe n’imikorere ya LuaLua, "Umukino urangiye yatwaye ikipe yose kandi ntibyari bigoye kumutoranya mu basore bagera 22 bafite imyaka 17. " Harrop yatumiye rutahizamu mu rubanza muri Colchester United maze asinywana niyi kipe.
Murumuna we, Kazenga LuaLua, nawe ni umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga, na babyara be babiri nabo bakina ubuhanga; Yannick Bolasie, na Trésor Kandol.

Nono Lubanzadio Mayasisilua (Yavutse Ku ya 27 Mutarama 1980 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Congo (DRC)
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe nkuru ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Roger Lukaku, (Yavutse Ku ya 6 Kamena 1967 i Léopoldville (ubu ni Kinshasa) apfa ku ya 28 Nzeri 2025), ni umukinnyi w' Umubiligi ukina Umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga. Yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru kuva muri 1999. Roger ni papa w'ababiligi mpuzamahanga bo mu Bubiligi Jordan na Romelu Lukaku.
Mu 1990, icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 23, Roger Lukaku yatangiye umwuga we umupira w'amaguru w'abigize umwuga. Yinjiye mu ikipe ya FC Boom muri cyiciro cya kabiri cya shampiyona y'Ububiligi. Ikipe iza kura muri 1 kugabana muri 1992 mbere yo kongera ku manuka muri 2 kugabana igihe gikurikira. Nyuma yo kumanuka, Roger Lukaku yimukiye muRFC Seraing.
Hamwe na RFC Seraing, yarangije ari 3 muri shampiyona y'Ububiligi. Nyuma y'igihembwe 2, yakoze guhinduranye mu ikipe nshya muri Germinal Ekeren aho yanabonye icya 3 umwanya muri shampiyona y'Ububiligi.
Muri 1996 yavuye mu Bubiligi yinjira muri Gençlerbirliği SK yo muri Turukiya. Yamaranye shampiyona imwe gusa muriyi kipe mbere yo gusubira mu Bubiligi muri FC Mechelen.
Roger Lukaku nawe uri inyuma yo gushinga Ishyirahamwe Sportif Rojolu. Umuryango ukomoka muri Kintambo aho iyi club iherereye. Izina ry'iyi kipe rikomoka ku nyuguti za mbere z'amazina Romelu, Yorodani na Lukaku.
Roger Lukaku yapfuye ku ya 29 Nzeri 2025, afite imyaka 58, i Kinshasa. Nyuma gato y'urupfu rwe, umuhungu we Romelu Lukaku yamwunamiye, agira ati: “Urakoze kunyigisha ibyo nzi byose. Ubuzima ntibuzongera kubaho ukundi. Warandinze kandi unyobora nk'uko ntawundi wabishobora”.

Dodi Lukebakio, Yavutse Ku ya 24 Nzeri 1997 i Asse, mu Bubiligi,) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga w’umubiligi ukina nka winger i Hertha Berlin.
Nyuma yo gutoranyirizwa muri ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mukino wa gicuti muri 2016, amaherezo y'ahisemo muri Bubiligi umwaka ukurikira.
Dodi Lukebakio yatangiye umwuga we muri Sporting Anderlecht. Kubera kubura umwanya wo gukina, yinjiye muri Toulouse FC ku nguzanyo mu mpeshyi yo muri 2016. Kuba adafite indangamuntu cyangwa uruhushya rwo gutura, ntashobora ariko gukina niyi kipe, yewe ndetse ni tsinda ry'abigenewe. Bigaragara ko atabonye indangamuntu y'Ububiligi kuko adashobora kwerekana ko yavukiye mu Bubiligi. Mu byukuri, nta cyemezo cy'amavuko afite. Kubura icyemezo cy'amavuko ntibibuza gukorera mu Burayi (ikibazo cya shampiyona w’uburayi Renato Sanches), ariko kugira ngo abone uruhushya rwo gutura mu Bufaransa, Lukebakio agomba kuba ari mpuzamahanga, haba mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo cyangwa mu ikipe y’Ububiligi. Umutoza wa Kongo, Florent Ibenge, yemeye atazuyaje, muri Nzeri 2016, ariko federasiyo y’Ababiligi, na yo yasabye ko yamuhitamo, iramwanga muri iyi shampiyona. Nyuma yakinnye umukino wa gicuti kuri Ku ya 4 Ukwakira 2016 kurwanya na Kenya, idafunga imiryango yo gutoranya Ababiligi.

Assani Lukimya-Mulongoti (Yavutse ku ya 25 Mutarama 1986 i Uvira muri Congo) ni umunyekongo ukina umupira w'amaguru ufite ubwenegihugu bw'umudage.
Uyu myugariro ufite igihagararo cya siporo yubaka cyane metero 1.89, n'ibiro 93) akinira KFC Uerdingen.
Akomoka mu karere ka Kivu y'Amajyepfo mu burasirazuba bwa DR Congo, yitoreje i Hertha Berlin, aho afatwa nk'umusore w'umuhanga cyane. Nyuma yi gihembwe cya 3 hamwe n'ikipe y'ikipe, yasinyiye Hansa Rostock, aho yaje kuba intangiriro idashidikanywaho.
Ariko nyuma yo gusezererwa kw'ikipe ye kandi kubera imvune ya tumye atakaza umwanya, nyuma yinjira mu ikipe ya gatatu, Igice cy'Ubudage cya FC Carl Zeiss Iéna muri gihembwe, aho yatsinze vuba cyane. Amasezerano arangiye nyuma yi gihembwe cyose, yasinyiye muri Gashyantare 2010 i Fortuna Düsseldorf, ku mwanya wa 2 kugabana kuriyi nshuro, aho umukino wa mbere w'agoye cyane kubera amakosa make yo kwirwanaho ariko yagiye buhoro arawuzuza muri shampiyona ku girango abe igice cy'ingenzi cy'izamu rya Düsseldorf kandi ashimwa cyane na bakunzi biyi kipe.
Yemeje impano ye muri shampiyona yo muri 2011-2012 agera ku bihe byiza cyagaragaje neza ubushobozi bwe. Fortuna yazamutse muri Bundesliga nyuma yo gutsinda umukino wo kwishyura wa Hertha Berlin na shampiyona ya Lukimya byakuruye ama kipe menshi yo muri Bundesliga.
Nyuma yo gusinyisha FC Cologne, yaje gusinyira Werder Bremen muri Kamena 2012. Asanze uwa 1 kugabana yari azi muri make na Hansa Rostock.

Jody Lukoki (Yavutse Ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 1992 i Kindu hanyuma apfa Ku ya 9 Gicurasi 2022 mu Buholandi) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru, ukomoka mu budage wavukiye muri congo. Akina nku mukinnyi w'iburyo muri FC Twente.
Jody Lukoki yavukiye muri Zayire ariko yimukira mu Buholandi hamwe n'ababyeyi be na murumuna we Madjer Lukoki kubera intambara, igihe yari akiri uruhinja.
Afite imyaka icumi, yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru muri ikipe ya VVA/Spartaan.
Uwahoze ari umukinnyi wa VVA / Spartan na Young Boys, yinjiye muri Ajax.
Yatangiye bwa mbere hamwe n'itsinda rya mbere muri Ku ya 19 Mutarama 2011, mu ntsinzi 2-0 na m'ukeba we Feyenoord wa simbuye Lorenzo Ebecilio ku munota wa 80. Yongeye kugaragara bwa kabiri muri Ku ya 20 Werurwe 2011, mu gutsindwa 3-2 na ADO La Haye.
Yatsinze igitego cya mbere muri shampiyona yo muri 2011-2012 na Roda JC mu ntangiriro za shampiyona.
Ku ya 2 Kanama 2013, yagurijwe na SC Cambuur na Ajax.
Ku ya 4 Kanama 2013, yakinnye bwa mbere muri SC Cambuur asimbuye Oliver Feldballe ku munota wa 46 (0-0). Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere hamwe na SC Cambuur muri Ku ya 20 Nzeri 2013 na SC Heerenveen gutsindwa 2-1.

Guy Lusadisu ni umunyekongo wahoze akina umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga. Aheruka gukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri AS Vita Club.
Muri Gashyantare 2019, yagizwe umutoza mukuru wa AS Maniema Union.

Jean-Paul Eale Lutula, (Yavutse Ku ya 4 Ukwakira 1984 i Kinshasa, umurwa mukuru wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri Kongo, akaba ari mpuzamahanga ukinira u Rwanda.
Jean-Paul Eale Lutula w'imyaka 36 y'umupira w'amaguru wa bigize umwuga.
Yakiriye imipira ibiri mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri 2005. Ikina kubwiyi ntego imikino ibiri ya gicuti, ya Tuniziya na Zambiya. Yatsinze igitego ku bakinnyi ba Tuniziya.
Nyuma yaje kubona amahitamo atatu mu ikipe yu Rwanda muri 2009, mu mikino yari mu rwego rwo gushaka itike yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy’isi cyo muri 2010. Nyuma yakinnye na Misiri, Alijeriya, na Zambiya.
Hamwe n'ikipe yo mu Bubiligi FCM Bruxelles, yakinnye imikino 23 mu cyiciro cya mbere, atsinda igitego kimwe, mu mikino 66 mu cyiciro cya kabiri, ku bitego 21. Yatsinze ibitego 12 mu cyiciro cya kabiri muri shampiyona ya.

Heir Luvumbu Nzinga, (Yavutse Ku ya 23 Nyakanga 1992 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru muri congo (DRC) ukina nka rutahizamu muri DC Motema Pembe. Afite imbaraga zo gukubita cyane mu bitego bya kure.
Héritier yatangiye umwuga we muri AS Rojolu muri 2011. Kubera imikorere myiza, yagaragaye hamwe na Florent Ibenge umutoza wa AS Vita Club.
Muri 2013, yasinyiye muri AS Vita Club. Yakinnye muri Shampiyona ebyiri, harimo umukino wa nyuma muri 2014 yakinnye na ES Setif.
Yasinyiye mu ikipe ya Royale Union Saint-Gilloise mu idirishya ryo kwimura impeshyi muri 2017 nyuma y'ukwezi kumwe kwintizanyo y'igihembwe kimwe ahitamo kugurwa.
Ku ya 28 Gashyantare 2024, Héritier Luvumbu yasinyanye amasezerano mbere yigihembwe cya 2024-2025, hamwe na AS Vita club.
Yitabira igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2013 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Yakinnye kandi n’ikipe ya Kongo muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2014, aho ikipe ye yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza.
Amaherezo yaje gukina umukino na Libiya ubara mu cyiciro kibanza cy'igikombe cy'isi muri 2014.
Yitabiriye kandi CHAN muri 2016 hamwe n'ikipe ya DR Congo, yatsinze igitego yatsinze Etiyopiya kuri pasiporo ya Guy Lusadisu. Yabaye inshuro eshatu ukinnyi w'umukino, cyane yakinnye na Etiyopiya, Angola na cyane u Rwanda muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza. Byongeye kandi, kwimikwa kwa DRC byamweguriwe kuko umukino n'u Rwanda wari umukino we wa nyuma muri iki gikombe kuko yari afite imvune. Ni undi mukinnyi rero w’ibumoso w’ingwe, Umusore Meschack Elia watorewe kuba umugabo w’iri rushanwa, ni ukuvuga umukinnyi mwiza w’irushanwa ndetse watsinze ibitego byinshi n'ibitego bine. Hagati aho Mechack yatsinze kabiri ku mukino wa nyuma, ahanganye na Akaichi wo muri Tuniziya na Shikatara wo muri Nijeriya, abanditsi b'ibitego bine, basigaye mbere ya aces enye.

Christian Luyindama Nekadio, Yavutse Ku ya 8 Mutarama 1994 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC). Akina nka myugariro wo hagati muri Antalyaspor, ku ntizanyo ya Galatasaray SK.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Sanga Balende, yitabiriye Shampiyona ny'afurika muri 2015. Muri iryo rushanwa, yatsinze igitego cyatsinze ikipe ya Libolo yo muri Angola.
Muri 2015, yinjiye muri Tout Puissant Mazembe maze umutoza we amushyimira nka rutahizamu. Yatsinze ibitego kandi azamura imiterere y'umubiri.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2017, yasinyiye muri Standard de Liège ku ntizanyo ahitamo kugura. Yatsinze igitego cya mbere ku ya 28 Mata 2017 na Royale Union Saint-Gilloise ku gikoni ku munota wa 29 w'umukino. Yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w'umukino kubera ibikorwa byinshi byo kwirwanaho.
Yasinyanye by'imazeyo na Standard de Liège ku ya 18 Gicurasi 2017 amafaranga agera ku 500 000 by'amayero. Ku ya 28 Mutarama 2018, yatsinze ibitego bibiri muri shampiyona yakinnye na Royal Sporting Club Anderlecht ashimirwa by'imazeyo kugaruka kwa acrobatike nziza m'ugihe cy'ambere. Yatwaye igikombe cy'umukinnyi mwiza wa congo muri 2018.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2019, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Galatasaray ku nguzanyo ahitamo kugura. Ku ya 29 Nyakanga 2019, Galatasaray yatangaje ko uburyo bwo kugura myugariro bwakoreshejwe.
Hamwe no gutoranya Abanyekongo, yitabiriye Igikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2013 cyateguwe muri Alijeriya.
Yakinnye umukino wa mbere n’igihugu cye ku ya 5 Mutarama 2017 mu mukino wa gicuti na Kameruni birangira batsinzwe ibitego 2-0.
Yatoranijwe bwa mbere muri A mu mukino wahuzaga na Gineya ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 2016 kandi yari mu bahatanira Can muri 2017 ariko ntiyatorwa.

Ghislain Luyeye Mvete, Yavutse Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 1979 i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Yakoresheje umwuga we hafi ya TP Mazembe.
Yitabiriye hamwe na TP Mazembe mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA Club muri 2009. Yakinnye imikino ibiri muri iri rushanwa.
Mvete yakiriye amatora ane mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mwaka muri 2011. Yakinnye umukino wa mbere ku ya 8 Mutarama 2011, mu mukino wa gicuti na Kenya (intsinzi 1-0).

Joseph Ilunga Mwepu (yavutse ku Ku ya 22 Kanama 1949 muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, arapfa Ku ya 8 Gicurasi 2015 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nka myugariro.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye imikino 9 mu marushanwa yateguwe na FIFA, nta gitego yatsinze, muri 1974.
Bigaragara ko mu itsinda ryatoranijwe m'ugihe cyigikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage, yakinnye imikino itatu: bakina na Sikotilande (0-2), Yugosilaviya (0-9) na Burezile (0-3). Mwepu "ariyerekana" n'ibintu bibiri bidasanzwe:gukina na Yugosilaviya iyo bayoboye 4 kuri 0, y'ibasiye umusifuzi wo muri Kolombiya wu mukino Omar Delgado amukubita imigeri mu kibuno, ikimenyetso kitazahanwa kuko umusifuzi atabashaga kubona uwa muteye ny'irizina yirukanwe Matambula N'Daye mu mwanya we mu gihe guhitamo Yugosilaviya yatsinze umukino n'amanota 9-0. Yatoranijwe ku mukino wa gatatu w'ingwe yakinnye na Berezile kandi ibi m'ubihe bigoye (Mobutu yaba yarateye ubwoba abayobozi ba federasiyo ya Zayire ndetse na bakinnyi m'ugihe habaye irukozasoni) ajyana ifirimbi y'umusifuzi mu gihe cy'ikiruhuko, gutera imigeri neza ashyigikirwa na Seleção asohoka ku rukuta kugirango akubite umupira kandi awusukure n'i mbaraga zose munsi y'amaso y'abakinnyi ba Burezile bataye umutwe n'umusifuzi bahita bamuhana ikarita y'umuhondo.
Yitabiriye kandi igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1974 cyatsinzwe n'ikipe ye.
Ilunga yapfuye muri Gicurasi 2015 nyuma y’uburwayi bwamaze igihe mu bitaro bya Saint-Joseph i Limete (Kinshasa).

Pierre Ndaye Mulamba (Yavutse ku ya 4 Ugushyingo 1948 - 26 Mutarama 2019) yari umukinnyi wo hagati mu mupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ahahoze ari Zayire. Yiswe "Mutumbula" ("umwicanyi") na "Volvo".
Umwuga wumupira wamaguru.
Mulamba yavukiye i Luluabourg (ubu ni Kananga) muri 1948. Mu 1973, yakinnye muri AS Vita Club ya Kinshasa, wegukanye igikombe cya Afurika cya Champions Club. Yabaye igice cya kabiri cyasimbuye ikipe yigihugu ya Zayire na Maroke mu mikino itajenjetse yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi muri 1974. Muri 1974, Mulamba yakiniye Zayire mu gikombe cy’Afurika cy’ibihugu byombi mu Misiri ndetse n’igikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage bw’Uburengerazuba. Muri Egiputa yatsinze ibitego icyenda, biracyari agahigo, ubwo Zayire yatsindaga irushanwa. Mulamba yagizwe umukinnyi w’irushanwa kandi yahawe igihembo cy’igihugu cy’ingwe na Perezida Mobutu Sese Seko. Mu Budage, yayoboye iyo kipe, akina gutsindwa na Sicotilande ibitego 2-0, ariko yirukanwa nyuma yi minota 22 yakinnye na Yugosilaviya. Icyo gihe Zayire yari imaze gutsindwa 4–0, amaherezo itsindwa 9–0. Mulamba yaje kuvuga ko iyi kipe ititwaye neza, haba mu myigaragambyo cyangwa kubera gutakaza morale, nyuma yo kutabona igihembo cy’amadorari 45,000 yasezeranijwe.

Bunene Ngaduane (yavutse Ku ya 30 Nyakanga 1972 i Kinshasa, icyo gihe hari muri Zayire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo (DRC), wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yari mu itsinda ryatoranijwe mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1994 na 1996, aho ikipe ye yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza buri icyo gihe.

Hervé Ndonga (Yavutse iKu ya 2 Gicurasi 1992 i Kinshasa) Kuva icyo gihe yakinnye kuva muri Gashyantare 2015) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru (DRC), kuri Progresso da Lunda Sul nkumukinnyi wo hagati.
Hervé Ndonga yitabiriye TP Mazembe mu gikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2010 cyateguwe muri Leta zunze ubumwe z'Abarabu. Ku mukino wanyuma w'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo muri 2010 wahuje TP Mazembe na Inter Milan (gutsindwa 3-0), yinjiye mu kibuga ku munota wa 89 mu mwanya wa Dioko Kaluyituka.
Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Toulon muri 2013 atoranya abatarengeje imyaka 20.
Hervé Ndonga yahamagawe kabiri mu ikipe ya DR Congo muri 2013. Iyi ni imikino ibiri yakinnye na Libiya na Togo, mu rwego rwo gushaka itike yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi muri 2014.

John Buana N'Galula, (Yavutse Ku ya 23 Kamena 1968 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Zayire, wakinnye nka myugariro. Umwuga we wose yabigize umwuga mu Bubiligi, aho yagumye kuba kandi abona ubwenegihugu bw'Ububiligi. Hamwe na Zayire, yitabiriye ibikombe bibiri bya Afurika.
John Buana N'Galula yageze mu Bubiligi muri 1988, amezi make nyuma yo kwitabira CAN yo muri 1988, ari naho yavuye mu ikipe isanzwe y'iryo rushanwa. Yahawe akazi na K Boom FC, ikipe ikomeye yo mu cyiciro cya 2. Afite imyaka makumyabiri gusa, yigaragaje muri cumi na rimwe akimara kugera muri club. Iyi kipe ikina ku meza buri mwaka ariko ikananirwa gutwara igikombe cya shampiyona, ikananirwa mu cyiciro cya nyuma inshuro eshatu zikurikiranye hagati ya 1989 na 1991. Amaherezo, iyi kipe yashoboye kuyitsinda muri 1992 hanyuma isubira mu cyiciro cya mbere nyuma yimyaka irenga mirongo itatu itegereje, nubwo ukwezi kwa Mutarama kwa myugariro kutabonetse, yajyanye muri CAN muri 1992 aho yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza.

Isaac Ngandu Kasongo, (Yavutse Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 1979 i Kinshasa (Zayire)), ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Yakinnye henshi mu mwuga we muri TP Mazembe.
Kasongo yatangiye umwuga we mu mupira w'amaguru muri 1997 muri ikipe ya kabiri ya SC Cilu. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2001, hamwe niyi kipe, yabaye shampiyo wa LIFBACO kandi yi tabira icyiciro cya nyuma cya shampiyona y'igihugu muri 2002, aho ikipe ya Lukala yarangije ku mwanya wa kane.
Muri 2002, yaburaniye TP Mazembe. Mu gihe cye cya mbere hamwe'ibikona“, Yageze ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cy'igihugu kandi yari umuyobozi w'irushanwa rya Lubumbashi kugeza rihagaritswe. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2004, Kasongo yabaye visi-kapiteni w’igihugu kandi yitwara neza i Lumbumbashi. Nyuma yaho, Kasongo na Mazembe begukanye igikombe cya shampiyona inshuro enye (2006, 2007, 2009 na 2011) ndetse batwara inshuro ebyiri igikombe cya Shampiyona ny'afurika (2009, 2010). Yakinnye muri CAF Supercup muri 2010 na 2011. Hagati aho, Kasongo yatsinze igitego mu mukino wa mbere wa Champions League 2010 na Espérance.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Kasongo Ngandu yari mu ikipe ya DR Congo kuva 2004. Yari umwe mu bagize ikipe ya Kongo mu gikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2006, cyaje kugera muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza, aho yakuwemo na Misiri, yaje gutsinda irushanwa. Muri CHAN yo muri 2011 no mu marushanwa ya gicuti ya Nil Basin, yabereye i Cayiro muri Mutarama 2011. Mu mukino wo guhatanira umwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa ya Cayiro, Abanyekongo batsinze Abanyakenya ku manota make. Kasongo yabaye umwanditsi w'igitego cy'onyine, bityo afungura amazamu y'ibitego bye kurwego rw'ikipe y'igihugu.
Arubatse, afite abahungu babiri n'umukobwa.

Ilongo Ngansania, uzwi ku izina rya Saddam, (Yavutse Ku ya 8 Kanama 1984 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru muri Kongo (DRC) Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri Forest Rangers Football Club ya Zambiya.
Yitabiriye igikombe cya Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yiswe izina kubera uburyo bwe bwo gukina. Afite icyerekezo cyiza cy'umukino, tekiniki nziza nu buhanga bw'umubiri hamwe n'ikirenge cy'ibumoso kidasanzwe. Nyuma yo guhungira muri katari, yasubiye mu gihugu cye, muri DC Motema Pembe agamije gushaka abatoranijwe. Nyuma yo kwitwara neza, yibutswe bwa mbere kuva muri 2008 na Robert Nouzaret na Morice muri Werurwe 2011.

Yeni Atito Ngbakoto, (yavutse Ku ya 23 Mutarama 1992 à Croix) ni umufaransa ukina umupira w'amaguru, ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo kuri ubu ukinira Western Wanderers ya Western Sydney nku mukinnyi wo hagati utera.
Yabaye mpuzamahanga hamwe na basore b'Abafaransa (afunzwe na munsi ya 17 na munsi ya 18). Ngbakoto akina cyane nku mukinnyi wo hagati utera, ariko arashobora gufasha nka rutahizamu. Azwiho umuvuduko nu buhanga.
Yéni Ngbakoto yatangiye umwuga we umupira w'amaguru muri ikipe ya SC Clemenceau i Besançon. Yitwaye neza mu itsinda ry’urubyiruko rw’iyi kipe, aho bamubonye hanyuma akayoborwa na FC Metz, ariko na Tottenham, Chelsea na Barcelona. Amaherezo yasinye amasezerano y'urubyiruko na FC Metz muri 2007. Bitewe nuko yitwaye n’urubyiruko rwo muri Metz, Yeni yahamagawe mu ikipe y’Ubufaransa y’abatarengeje imyaka muri 17 na Philippe Bergeroo. Ku ya 25 Kamena 2009, yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka 5 yu mwuga na Garnets.
Umukino wa mbere muri Ligue 2.
Yéni Ngbakoto yazamuwe mu ikipe ya mbere muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-10, ariko atangira shampiyona hamwe n’ikipe yikinira muri CFA 2, atsinda igitego ku ncuro ya mbere yakiniye iyi kipe yakinnye na CA Pontarlier, Ku ya 15 Kanama 2009. Azakina amezi ane ari imbere mu ikipe yikinira, yongere atsinde muri mu kino na Thionville (intsinzi 1-0). Yahamagawe na Yvon Pouliquen ku mukino wi cyiciro cya 16 cya Coupe de la Ligue na Olempikee Lyonnais, Ku ya 13 Mutarama 2010 akaza gukina muri munota 83, mu mwanya wa Julien Cardy (umukino batsinzwe 3-0). Yagarutse mu ikipe yikinira shampiyona irangiye, arangiza shampiyona (CFA 2) atsinda ibitego 8 mu mikino 16, ikigega cyo muri FC Metz cyarangije kuba shampiyona n'amanota agera 107, umubare munini mu matsinda yose muri iyi shampiyona.

Kafula Ngoie (yavutse Ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1945 noneho muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nku mukinnyi wo hagati.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye imikino 8 (nta gitego yatsinze) hagati yo muri 1972 na 1974. Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974.
Yagiye kandi muri CANs yo muri 1972 na 1974.

Fabrice Ngoma, ku izina rye ryuzuye ni Fabrice Luamba Ngoma, (Yavutse ku ya 22 Mutarama 1994 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati muri Al Hilal Club.
Intangiriro muri DRC.
Yavutse ku ya 22 Mutarama 1994 i Kinshasa, Fabrice yatangiye gukinira ikipe yabo mu mujyi ya vukiyemo, FC Arc-en-ciel, bakinnye muri shampiyona muri 2013-2014. Yinjiye mu mwaka wakurikiyeho muri Sharks XI FC, yavumbuwe mu isi y'ababigize umwuga akina muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-2015 ya shampiyona yo muri DRC aho iyi kipe yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu mu itsinda ryayo inyuma ya DC Motema Pembe na AS Vita Club, kugira ngo igere ku mukino, imikino ku mwanya wa gatandatu.
Indi kipe ya Kinshasa, ni FC Max Mokey Etanchéité, ishishikajwe nuyu musore Ngoma wa muhereye ku gikombe cya shampiyona nshya yo muri 2015-2016, akazarangiza ku mwanya wa gatanu, bivuze ko gukuraho imikino yo kwishyura.
Inararibonye muri Nijeriya.
Muri 2016-2017, Fabrice Ngoma yakinnye gusa n'ikipe muri kimwe cya kabiri cya shampiyona kuva yimurirwa mu idirishya ryo kwimura imbeho, muri Ifeanyi Ubah FC ikina muri Premier League yo muri Nigeriya (itangira muri Mutarama ikazarangiza muri Nzeri). Imyitwarire ye myiza ntiyagaragaye kandi amakipe benshi ku mugabane wa Afurika baramushaka.

Danny Mansoni Ngombo, (yavutse Ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1963) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo (DRC). Akina nka myugariro.
Umwuga we wose yawumaze mu Bubiligi. Akinira ikipe ya K Beerschot VAC, Germinal Ekeren, RFC Seraing, Sporting Charleroi, na RCS Visé. Yakinnye kandi shampiyona yo mu Budage hamwe n'ikipe ya Wuppertal.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Seraing, yakinnye umukino muri gikombe cya UEFA.
Yitabiriye ikipe ya Zayire mu gikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika bigera kuri bitatu muri 1988, 1992 na 1994. Yakinnye kimwe cya kane kirangiza muri iri rushanwa muri 1992 na 1994. Yakinnye imikino icyenda yose mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu.

Michel Ngonge akinira mu Bubiligi, Turukiya, Ubwongereza na Sikotilande.
Yakinnye imikino 239 muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere n'icyakabiri, atsinda ibitego 53. Yatsindiye kwitwara neza muri shampiyona yo muri 1995-1996, aho yatsinze ibitego 14 muri shampiyona y'Ububiligi hamwe n'ikipe ya KRC Harelbeke.
Mu marushanwa y’i Burayi, yitabiriye imikino itatu mu gikombe cya UEFA.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire ubu ni DRC, yakinnye hagati ya 1996 na 2000.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 1996 na 2000. Muri CAN muri 1996, yakinnye umukino na Gabon. Muri CAN muri 2000, yakinnye imikino ibiri, na Alijeriya na Afurika y'Epfo. Yageze muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza CAN muri 1996.
Yakinnye kandi imikino ibiri ibara icyiciro kibanza cy'igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 1998.

Mbomboko Fiston Ngoy yahoze ari umukinnyi w' umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yabaye muri TP Mazembe kuva muri 2003. Bomboko yapfuye mu ijoro ryo ku ya 4 Kamena 2024, afite imyaka 47, nyuma y’umuriro wibasiye mu kabari i Lubumbashi.

Emmanuel Christian Ngudikama Kila (Yavutse Ku ya 7 Nzeri 1987 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo.
Ngudikama yatangiye umwuga we mukuru muri FC Les Stars i Kinshasa, mbere yo kwinjira muri AS Vita Club mu mpera muri 2009.
Muri shampiyona ye ya mbere muri AS Vita Club, Ngudikama yatsindiye shampiyona y'igihugu. Yamenyekanye kandi ari muri Shampiyona ny'afurika. Muri 2014, yageze ku mukino wa nyuma wa Champions League, atsindwa n'ikipe ya Alijeriya yitwa ES Sétif. Nyuma, muri 2018, yageze ku mukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cya Confederation Cup, atsindwa n'ikipe yo muri Maroke ya Raja de Casablanca. Yagaragaye cyane mu matsinda, atsinda ibitego bibiri mu ikipe ya kote divuwari ya ASEC Mimosas.
Ku ya 3 Werurwe 2010, Ngudikama yakiriwe bwa mbere mu ikipe ya DR Congo, mu mukino wa gicuti na Nigeriya (gutsindwa 5-2).
Mu ntangiriro za 2016, yitabiriye icyiciro cya nyuma cya Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika yateguriwe mu Rwanda. Muri iri rushanwa, yakinnye imikino itatu, harimo na kimwe cya kabiri yatsinze kuri penaliti yakina na Gineya. Icyakora, ntabwo yakinnye umukino wa nyuma yatsinzwe na DR Congo kuri Mali.
Muri rusange, yakiriye batanu hamwe na DR Congo.

Granddi Ngoyi Majundu (yavutse Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru wu mufaransa ukomoka muri congo.
Granddi yinjiye muri PSG mbere y'imyitozo yo kuri 13. Ufite amasezerano y'indobanure, yinjiye muri Kanama 2007, amasezerano y'imyaka 3 y'umwuga hamwe na ikipe ye.
Yagaragaye bwa mbere muri Ligue 1 kuri Ku ya 4 Kanama 2007 na FC Sochaux-Montbéliard, ku myaka 19. Yishimiye manda ye ya mbere muri Ligue 1 Ku ya 20 Ukwakira 2007 ku butaka bwa Valenciennes.
Mu gice cya mbere cya shampiyona ya 2008–09, yagaragaye rimwe gusa hamwe na PSG mu gutsindwa na Schalke 04 mu gikombe cya UEFA. Yatijwe rero Mutarama 2009 kuri Clermont Foot, hanyuma ukine muri Ligue 2 kugirango ubone umwanya wo gukina.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2009-2010, agaruka muri PSG, yitabiriye imikino 16 ya shampiyona hamwe na PSG.
Muri Nyakanga 2010 yongeye gutizwa igihembwe hanyuma yerekeza muri Stade Brestois 29, ikipe yari imaze kuzamurwa muri Ligue 1. Nyuma yo gutangira shampiyona ya bangamiwe n’imvune, yigaragaje nk'uwatangiye muri iyi kipe kandi abohesha iminyururu 16 hagati yitariki ya 21 nu munsi wa nyuma yagize uruhare mu kubungabunga Stade Brestois 29 mu ntore.

aggio Siadi Ngusia (yavutse Ku ya 21 Nyakanga 1997 muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga ukinaumupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri Kongo. Akina muri TP Mazembe nk'umuzamu.
Kugeza ubu ni umukinnyi wa TP Mazembe wo mu itsinda "ry'imikino ry'urubyiruko Bazano", kuva Ku ya 22 Nyakanga 2021 kumasezerano y'imyaka 5, Baggio nawe yaje guhinduka nku muzamu w'ikipe DCMP.

Michaël Jordan Nkololo, (Yavutse Ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 1992 i Créteil mu Bufaransa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru arimpuzamahangaukomoka muri congo.
Jordan Nkololo yanyuze mu kigo cyo muri Stade Rennes. Muri Mata 2006, igikombe cy'isi U15 cyabereye i Saint-Pierre muri Nantes hamwe n'a basore ba Rennes, yatsinze Olympique de Marseille ku mukino wa nyuma. Jordan Nkololo ntabwo ari muri Stade Rennes. Agaruka gukina muri Île-de-France muri AC Boulogne-Billancourt, La Berrichonne de Châteauroux yamubonye muri 2011, ubwo yari afite imyaka 19.
Yatangiye umwuga we hano muri shampiyona yo muri 2012–13, muri Ligue 2. Umwaka ukurikira, yasinyanye na Clermont Foot aho yakinnye ibihe bibiri muri Ligue 2. Yakiniye imikino 50 ya shampiyona, atsinda ibitego bibiri. Amasezerano arangiye mu mpeshyi yo muri 2015, yatangajwe muri Ligue 1. Ku ya 9 Kamena 2015, umukono we muri SM Caen yashyizwe ku mugaragaro, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka itatu. Muri Mutarama 2017, ugasanga adafite umwanya wo gukina, yatijwe muri kuri Stade Lavallois kugeza shampiyona irangiye.
Amasezerano arangiye muri Normandy, yinjiye muri FC Hermannstadt, azamurwa mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’Abanyarumaniya.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2015, yatoranijwe mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mikino myinshi ya gicuti. Yamenyekanye ku ncuro ya mbere yakinnye na Kameruni (1-1) maze yinjira mu mukino na Madagasikari (2-1).

Marcel Nkueni (yavutse Ku ya 4 Mata 1978) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Akina nkumuzamu hamwe na DC Motema pembe.
Nkueni yari umwe mu bagize itsinda rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo muri mwaka wo muri 1998 na 2000 mu gikombe cya Afurika.

Eric Miala Nkulukuta, (yavutse Ku ya 6 Nzeri 1982 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. kuri ubu akina muri CS Don Bosco i Lubumbashi.
Nkulukuta yinjiye muri DCMP muri 2002 mu bihe bibiri (imikino 56 n'ibitego 0)
Yinjiye muri TP Mazembe muri 2007 kandi yitabira CAF Champions League muri 2007,2009,2010, 2011,2012, ebyiri muri zo zatsinzwe na TP Mazembe muri (2009,2010).
Yatsinze igitego kuri AS Veti Club hamwe n'umupira uturutse kure kuri metero 35.
Yatsinze igitego batsinze Saint Eloi Lupopo ku mupira yari ahawe na Guy Lusadisu.
Nkulukuta akina gake na ikipe ye bizamutera kuva muri iyi kipe.
Ku ya 30 Kanama 2014, Nkulukuta yinjiye muri CS Don Bosco.

Shabani Nonda (yavutse Ku ya 6 Werurwe 1977 i Bujumbura mu Burundi), yahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru muri congo wakinnye nka rutahizamu.
Ubwana, ubuhunzi n'intangiriro.
Shabani Nonda yavukiye mu Burundi ku babyeyi ba Zayirwa, yagaragaye hakiri kare cyane kubera ubuziranenge bwe bwo gutsinda ibitego: afite imyaka cumi n'itanu, yamaze gukina n'abakuze maze yigaragaza nki nyenyeri y'ikipe ya mbere ya Atlético Olympic ikipe nto ya D2 i Bujumbura. Amatike make anyerera mu mufuka kugirango atezimbere ubuzima bwa buri munsi bwu muryango we. Ikipe nini yo mu mujyi irashaka ku musinyisha. Urubanza rukemurwa vuba, amasezerano yasinywe n'amafaranga yakusanyijwe. Ariko mu ntangiriro zuyu mwaka wo muri 1994, umurwa mukuru w’Uburundi hari kumena amaraso. Kimwe n'indi miryango myinshi, Nondas yagiye mu buhungiro. Se akomoka muri Zayire yahisemo kugarura umuryango we mu gihugu cye kavukire. Ariko Shabani, ufite imyaka 17, afata inzira yo mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba hamwe na mukuru we muri Tanzaniya.
Nyuma yo kugenda mu mihanda y'umurwa mukuru wa Tanzaniya no kwitegereza imyitozo ya D1, Nonda yimenyekanisha ku bayobozi b'Abasore b'Abanyafurika, ba shampiyona. Byabanjirijwe n'izina rikomeye nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego, bigurishwa n'abari mu buhungiro, kandi byasabwe n'inshuti ze, babyumvikanyweho vuba. Mu buhungiro bwe muri Tanzaniya, yakiniye Young africans kandi atwara igikombe cya Kagame Inter-Club muri shampiyona ya mbere. Muri 1994, yatwaye igikombe cye cya kabiri, Igikombe cya Tanzaniya maze ahitamo guhindura amakipe mu mpera zo muri 1994. Yiyandikishije rero muri shampiyona ya 1995 hamwe na Vaal Professionals, ikipe yo muri Afrika yepfo imaze kumubura. Amahirwe amara amezi icumi, igihe cyo kwambikwa ikamba rya shampiyona nuwatsinze ibitego byinshi hanyuma atsinda ibitego bine mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cya Afurika na Vaal Professionals. (2-2 na 2-1). Amezi atatu nyuma yiki gikorwa, yageze muri Afrika yepfo, muri aba Vaal Professionals. Amaherezo ahinduka umunyamwuga. Nubwo kwishyira hamwe byari bigoye, yatsinze ibitego cumi na bibiri mu mezi atandatu y'ambere. Umukozi wo muri Arijantine wasuye yamuhaye urugendo mu Burayi.

Yageze mu kigo cy'imyitozo cya ESTAC afite imyaka 14, muri 2004, avuye mu ikipe ya AS Bondy, Fabrice yakinnye umukino we wa mbere n'ikipe ya mbere ya Trojan, ku ya 9 Nzeri 2008 mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'igikombe cya Shampiyona na SCO Angers. Ku ikubitiro yatojwe nk'umukinnyi ukina ibumoso ukina hagati, yasimbuwe ibumoso n'umutoza we mushya Jean-Marc Furlan.
Ku ya 20 Kanama 2013, ikipe yo mu Bubiligi RSC Anderlecht yatangaje ko imaze kubona serivisi za Fabrice N'Sakala mu bihembwe bitatu.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Nyuma yo kugaragara gake mu ikipe y’Ubufaransa y’abatarengeje imyaka 17, yatoranijwe na Erick Mombaerts mu ikipe y’Ubufaransa Ikipe_yumupira_wamaguru_yabatarengeje_imyaka_17;ikipe y'abafaransa batarengeje imyaka 17, Ikipe yumupira wamaguru yabatarengeje imyaka batarengeje imyaka 23 ku ya 25 Kanama 2011, mu mukino wo kwishyura muri Ero yo muri 2013 uteganijwe ku ya 2 Nzeri na Lativiya. Fabrice ntaho yitabiriye uyu mukino ariko yemenya guhitamo kwe bwa mbere yizeye ku ya 6 Nzeri 2011 mu mukino wa gicuti na Portugal (kwinjira muri 71 iminota).
N'Sakala wavukiye mu Bufaransa, yahisemo ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo hagati mu myaka ya za 2010 agamije kwambara umwenda "w'ingwe". Yanze rero ubwenegihugu bw'Ubufaransa kuko nk'uko ingingo ya 10 y'Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ibivuga, “Ubwenegihugu bwa Kongo ni bumwe kandi bwihariye. Ntishobora gufatirwa hamwe n'izindi zose ” de la famille/LIVRE I DE LA NATIONALITE.htm 1.
Ku ya 10 Werurwe 2015, Florent Ibenge, umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yamuhamagaye bwa mbere kugira ngo yinjire kandi akine umukino wa gicuti na Iraki i Dubayi.
Ku ya 12 Kanama 2020 yasinyanye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri na Beşiktaş JK.

Vital Manuel Nsimba, (yavutse Ku ya 8 Nyakanga 1993 muri Cacuaco muri Angola) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo ukina nka myugariro w'ibumoso kuri Girondins de Bordeaux.
Vital Manuel Nsimba yavukiye muri Angola aho babaga, kugeza afite imyaka itandatu. Umuryango we uzaa guhungira muri Angola nyuma yuko se aregwa ubujura mu gisirikare. Bahaguruka berekeza mu Bufaransa na Toulouse aho nyirarume yari atuye, ku ruhande rwa se mbere yo kwimukira i Bordeaux mbere i Villenave-d'Ornon hanyuma atura i La Bastide ku nkombe iburyo bw'icyambu cya port de la Lune. Mu Bufaransa, yakinnye umupira w'amaguru muri Sporting Club de la Bastidienne nyuma mu ikipe ya Villenave-d'Ornon aho yagaragaye muri Girondins de Bordeaux. Yinjiye mu kigo cyamahugurwa cyaho afite imyaka 16.
Yatojwe muri Girondins de Bordeaux, yerekeza muri EA Guingamp muri 2013. Yabaye umukinnyi mukuru wa bigize umwuga, akina muri CFA 2. Yagurijwe muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-2015 na Luçon, akina muri National.
Nyuma yasinyanye amasezerano ye yambere y'umwuga na Bourg-en-Bresse 01 muri 2015 avumbura Ligue 2.
Ku ya 8 Kamena 2018, yinjiye muri Auvergne na Clermont Foot aho yagize ibihe byiza muri Ligue 2 ndetse yegera no kuzamuka muri shampiyona yo muri 2019-2020. Ibi birahagarikwa kubera icyorezo cya Covid-19 mu gihe Clermont Foot ari 5 muri Ligue 2. Amaherezo yaje kuvumbura Ligue 1 mu gihe cy'ingengo yimari yo muri 2021-2022 m'ugihe cya mbere mu mateka ya CF63 mu byamamare.

Belmond Nsumbu Dituabanza (yavutse Ku ya 31 Mutarama 1982 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muru congo (DRC).
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Manunu Jacky N'Tazambi (yavutse Ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1969 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru uri mpuzamahanga ukmoka muri Zayire, ubu ni congo wakinnye nka myugariro wo hagati.
Ku ya 25 Kamena 1989 yakinnye n'ikipe ya Zayire, umukino bakina na Tuniziya uza mu rwego rwo gushaka itike yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi muri 1990 (batsindwa 1-0).

Tychique Ntela Kalema ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) ukinira CSMD Diables Noirs muri Repubulika ituranye ya Kongo.
Kalema yatangiye umwuga we muri SC Cilu, asinyana nayo muri 2008 na AS Vita Club.
Yitabiriye na AS Vita Club mu gikombe cya CAF Orange Confederations Cup muri 2010.
Ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2010, avuye hamwe na Serge Lofo Bongeli ikipe ye ya AS Vita Club, basinyana n’ikipe yo mu Budage ya Rot Weiss Ahlen.
Kalema yatoranijwe rimwe gusa Ingwe ya DR Congo. Uyu ni umukino wakinnye na Togo, Ku ya 8 Nzeri 2013. Uyu mukino bawutsinzwe 2-1, uri mukino wari mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi muri 2014.
Ahagarariye igihugu inshuro cumi n'ibiri zose, ubaze imikino yakinnye n'ikipe ya A '. Mu bindi, yari mu ikipe muri Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika yo muri 2009.

Jean Kalala Tumba (yavutse Ku ya 7 Mutarama 1949 apfa ku ya 11 Mutarama 2021), yari umukinnyiukina umupira w'amaguru uvuka muri Zayire wo mu myaka ya za miro 70.
Justin Tumba Pus yabanaga n'umuryango we i Kinshasa kugeza mu myaka ya za 1960. Umuryango we wasubiye i Kananga nyuma y'imvururu zaberaga muri Kongo muri iki gihe. muri kiriya gihe umuryango we wabaga muri komini ya Kinshasa.
Muri icyo gihe, André Guillaume Lubaya yabanaga na bo, umunyapolitiki wo muri Kongo wishwe na Joseph Désiré Mobutu.
Mu gihe Pus n'umuryango we bari i Kinshasa, mukuru we yatangiye umwuga we w'umupira w'amaguru nku muzamu muri AC Mikado. Kugenda i Kananga bizahagarika uyu mwuga wa shampionat ya Leo. Uku n'uburyo Malumba Cobra, mukuru wa Pus,yisanze ari umunyezamu muri Union Tshioto St Gilloise. Umwuga we watangiye ari "umugongo" muri Renaissance de Luluabourg. Azahinduka hagati-imbere nyuma. Muri derby hagati ya Union Tshioto na Ranaissance, Ntumba Tshintula-ntula yakuye mukuru we Cobra mu myigaragambyo ikomeye.
Pus yari hagati-hagati kuruhande rwa Renaissance n'umuzamu wa Cobra muri Union Tshioto, ahanganye na murumuna we muto. uyu mukino ya Luluabourgeois yabereye imbere ya Pus na Cobra. Kuri se, kubona murumunawe gutya abamba mukuru we ntibyari byoroshye. Gukurikira iyi ntego ya Pus, Cobra yagombaga kubyutswa. Kandi icyemezo cya kibyeyi cyaraguye, cyumye kandi ntigishobora kumvikana: yaba abahungu be bose bakinnye mu makipe amwe cyangwa umupira w'amaguru, bahagarara bombi. Se yari umufana wa Tshinkunku wo muri Amerika. Nuburyo "Pus qui tue" yarangirije muri Amerika Tshinkunku.
Kinshasa yavumbuye uyu musore udasanzwe ari Tumba Pus mu 1971 mugihe cyanyuma cy'igikombe cya congo yatsindiye bwa mbere na Vita Club i Luluabourg.

Hervé Nzelo-Lembi, wavutse ku ya 25 Kanama 1975 i Kinshasa, ni umukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru wa congo kuri GB Antwerp. Akina nka myugariro.
Afite kandi ubwenegihugu bw'Ububiligi. Yatsinze mugihe cye muri FC Bruges, Umubiligi Ebony Shoe.

Christopher Oualembo, (yavutse Ku ya 31 Mutarama 1987 muri Saint-Germain-en-Laye) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Akina nku mukinnyi winyuma muri Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru muri Porutugali mu mabara ya Académica Coimbra.
Christopher Oualembo yavukiye kuri se ukomoka muri Repubulika ya Kongo na nyina ukomoka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yatangiye umwuga we muri ikipe Sportif d'Achères afite imyaka 10. Nyuma y'imyaka ibiri, yinjiye mu kigo cyigisha PSG. Mu bihe bitandatu, yarinze amabara ya ikpe nkuru. Muri shampiyona iheruka i Paris, y'egukanye igikombe cya shampiyona w’Ubufaransa munsi y'abafite imyaka 18 na AS Monaco. Yibanze cyane ku myigire kuruta umwuga we w'umupira w'amaguru, yananiwe guhindura kuba umunyamwuga.
Muri shampiyona yakurikiyeho, Christopher yinjiye muri iyo kipe avuye muri us Quevilly. kumvikana nti bwamaze kabili, kuko nyuma y'amezi atandatu yinjiye muri Levante muri Espanye.
Icyo gihe turi muri Mutarama 2007, Oualembo asinya amasezerano y'umwaka n'igice n'ikipe ya Valencian. Amasezerano arangiye yasanze nta kipe ya mwakira, nubwo yagerageje inshuro nyinshi mu m'akipe atandukanye yo mu Bufaransa (FC Lorient, Toulouse FC). Umwaka umwe, yinjiye muri AC Monza. Yatsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu Butaliyani mu Kwakira muri 2009.

Kosi Saka, (Yavutse Ku ya 4 Gashyantare 1986 i Kinshasa,) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa congo. Akina nku mukinnyi wo hagati, kuri ubu akina na KFC Uerdingen 05.

Pelly Ruddock Mpanzu, (Yavutse Ku ya 22 Werurwe 1994 muri Hendon,) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa congo ukina nku mukinnyi wo hagati urinda Luton Town.
Ku ya 28 Ugushyingo 2013, yagurijwe mu mujyi wa Luton
Ku ya 28 Mutarama 2014, yinjiye mu mujyi wa Luton burundu.

André Joël Sami (Yavutse Ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 1984 i Montfermeil) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru wumufaransa na congo. Kuri ubu arimo gukina nka myugariro wo hagati muri Ratchaburi FC.
Ingano ye ikomeye cyane ya muteye guhabwa agaciro kuri Amiens SC. Muri shampiyona yo muri 2006-2007, yagereye cyane kwinjira muri Ligue 1. Amasezerano yagiranye na ikipe ya Picard arangira shampiyona irangiye muri 2007-2008, yasinyiye kubusa muri Mutarama 2008 amasezerano na AS Nancy-Lorraine, atangira gukurikizwa muri Nyakanga 2008. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mu mabara ye mashya muri Coupe de la Ligue na Grenoble. Yatsinze kandi igitego cye cya mbere hamwe na ikipe ya thistle, ku mupira ya Julien Féret. Nyuma yaje kureba igihe kirekire adakia kubera imvune ikomeye yatewe mu mukino wahuje Nancy na Motherwell mu gikombe cya UEFA. Iyi niyo mpamvu agaragara bwa mbere cyane muri Ligue 1 m'ugihe cy'umunsi wa 30 kurwanya Girondins de Bordeaux. Azahita asiba umukino umwe mbere yuko shampiyona yo muri 2008-2009 irangira. Yatsinze kandi igitego cye cya mbere muri Ligue 1 yatsinze Lorient.
Nyuma y'ibihe birindwi bimara i Lorraine. Ku ya 5 Nyakanga 2015 Ikipe yo mu Bubiligi ya Zulte Waregem iratangaza ko Joël Sami yahagaze imyaka ibiri hiyongereyeho umwaka umwe atabishaka.
hari umwaka yamaze akina muri jupiler Muri Pro League.
Nubwo yavukiye mu Bufaransa, Sami yahisemo guhagararira igihugu cy’ababyeyi be, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yabonye ihitamo rye rya mbere Ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2008 n'Ubufaransa A 'mu mukino wa gicuti (0-0).

Djuma Shabani, wavutse16 marsKu ya 16 Werurwe 1993 i Kindu, numukinnyi mpuzamahanga wumupira wamaguru wa congo ukina nkumukinyi wiburyo ku rubyiruko rwabanyafurika.
Yagiye muri Afurika Champions League ndetse n’igikombe cya Confederation inshuro nyinshi. Yageze muri AS Vita Club umukino wanyuma wigikombe cya Confederation Cup muri 2018, atsindwa na Raja de Casablanca.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo,Ku ya 24 Werurwe 2019, bakina na Liberiya. Uyu mukino batsinzwe 1-0, wari mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika muri 2019.

Djuma Shabani, (wavutse Ku ya 16 Werurwe 1993 i Kindu,) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga wumupira w'amaguru muri congo ukina nku mukinyi w'iburyo ku rubyiruko rw'abanyafurika.
Yagiye muri Afurika Champions League ndetse n’igikombe cya Confederation inshuro nyinshi. Yageze muri AS Vita Club umukino wanyuma w'igikombe cya Confederation Cup muri 2018, atsindwa na Raja de Casablanca.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo,Ku ya 24 Werurwe 2019, bakina na Liberiya. Uyu mukino batsinzwe 1-0, wari mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo guhatanira igikombe cya Afurika muri 2019.

Raoul Jean-Pierre Shungu (wavutse3 janvierKu ya 3 Mutarama 1958 i Bukavu) ni umunyamupira wakinnye umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo noneho ubu ni umutoza.
Yaje kuba rutahizamu wa Zayire ndetse aza nokuba mu mahanga, aza kuba umutoza. Biragaragara ko yari umutoza wa Seychelles hamwe nu Rwanda.
Kuva mu 1997 kugeza 2004, yabaye umutoza wa Rayon Sports fc kandi yemerera iyi kipe gutwara igikombe cya shampiyona y'u Rwanda muri 1997, 1998 na 2002 ndetse n'igikombe cya CECAFA ndetse n'igikombe cy'amahoro muri 1998. Yaje kuba umuyobozi wa tekinike mu gihugu n’umutoza wa Seychelles hanyuma agaruka, muri 2008, muri Rayon Sports. Uku kuguma kwa kabiri kugenda neza ariko nyuma yakuwe ku mirimo ye. Nyuma yatoje u Rwanda mu gihe cyo guhitamo abakinnyi.
Kuva mu 2009 kugeza 2010, yayoboye Club ya Vita nyuma atwara FC Saint Éloi Lupopo amezi make mbere yuko yerekeza muri Vita Club Mokanda.
Yaje kuba umutoza mu Ukuboza 2013, atozaAmashitani yirabura ya Brazzaville hamwe n'undi mutekinisiye wa congo Fanfan Epoma. Muri Mutarama, yinjiye muri CARA Brazzaville hamwe na bakinnyi benshi bo mu ikipe ye.

imisozi ya Mafinga ni ikibaya gitwikiriwe n'imisozi, giherereye ku mupaka wa Zambiya na Malawi, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Iyi misozi igizwe na quartzite, phyllite hamwe n'umusenyi wa feldspathic ukomoka mu butaka.
Iki kibaya gifite umwanya muremure muri Zambiya kuri metero 2339 kuri Mafinga Hagati. Yigeze gukora inzitizi ikomeye hagati y'intara y'amajyaruguru n'uburasirazuba. Gusa ibinyabiziga bifite ibiziga 4 bishobora kwambuka kariya gace, cyane cyane mugihe cy'imvura.
Umuhanda mugufi uhuza intara zombi ubu worohewe no gusana umuhanda Isoka-Muyombe, unyura mu misozi yabo yo hepfo. Kubera ko Muyombe ari umurwa mukuru w'akarere ka Mafinga gashya, ingendo zose zerekeza ku misozi ya Mafinga biba byiza hakoresheje Muyombe nk'intangiriro (amazu abiri y'abashyitsi arahari). Usibye kunyura Isoka, Muyombe ashobora no kugerwaho uva mu majyepfo unyuze kuri Chama, n'ubwo uyu muhanda unyuramo inyamaswa zo mu gasozi za Vwasa zo mu burengerazuba bwa Malawi, cyangwa uva iburasirazuba unyuze mu mujyi wa Bolero wo muri Malawi ku nzira ya nomero104. Nkuko nta sitasiyo ya lisansi iri hafi ya Muyombe, usibye muri Lundazi, Nakonde, cyangwa Rhumpi (Malawi). Umugezi wa Luangwa, uruzi runini rwo mu burasirazuba bwa Zambiya, ufite isoko mu misozi ya Mafinga.

Didier Simba-Ekanza, (yavutse Ku ya 9 Kanama 1969), ni umukinnyi umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, wakinnye nka rutahizamu. Usibye ibihe bibiri muri Isiraheli, kuri Maccabi Petach-Tikva, ubuzima bwe bwose yabukoresheje mu Bubiligi. Yafashwe inshuro 35 mu ikipe y'igihugu kugeza 1999. Didier Simba-Ekanza yarangije umwuga we muri 2004.

Ebunga Simbi (yavutse Ku ya 6 Kanama 1983) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri (DRC).
Akina nka myugariro muri AS Vita Club, ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Kino-Congo ikorera mu mujyi wa Kinshasa.
Muri 2014, yabaye uwa kabiri muri shampiyona muri caf champions league, nyuma y'umukino w'anyuma batsinzwe ES Sétif yo muri Alijeriya, mugihe yari kapiteni wikipe ye, binjiye muri 2010.
Muri 2020, nyuma y'urugendo rurerure mu mahanga, yagarutse muri AS Vita Club aba kapiteni wacyo.

Ibrahim Lamine Mokabi Somé-Salombo uzwi cyane nka Ibrahim Somé (Yavutse Ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1988 i Kinshasa) ni umupira ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo. Kuri ubu arimo gukina muri club Sint-Truiden VV ku ntizanyo yatanzwe na RWDM Bruxelles FC. Uyu rutahizamu ushishikaye kandi ufite impano imbere yizamu ni kimwe mu byiringiro bikomeye bya congo by'igihe cyizaza. Kugeza ubu yatoranijwe mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kandi afite imipira itatu. Afite uburebure bwa metero 1.82. Asigaye ari akinisha i moso.

Abel Tezzy Tamata (Yavutse Ku ya 5 Ukuboza 1990 i Berg-op-Zoom mu Ubuholandi)Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo. Akina nka myugariro.
Tamata yavukiye i Bergen op Zoom kwa se ukomoka muri congo na nyina w’Ubuholandi. Se akora akazi ko gukora tagisi, afite mushiki we basangiye nyina na barumuna be babiri. Mushiki we basangiye nyina yashakanye n'umuraperi Ali B wabaye umukozi we.
Tamata y'amaze imyaka ine mu ishuri rya Rijks muri Bergen op Zoom maze muri 2009 yigai shuri ribanza muri kaminuza muri Saint Gorge College muri Eindhoven. Yabanye na nyirarume na nyirasenge muri Eindhoven aho yinjiye mu kipe y'urubyiruko yo muri PSV.
Yatangiye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ku ya 28 Werurwe 2015 i Dubai mu mukino wa gicuti na Iraki, yagaragaye nk'umukinnyi w’ibumoso kandi akina amukino wose, ariko ikipe ye itsindwa igitego kimwe. (1-0).

Patiyo Tambwe, (yavutse Ku ya 2 Mutarama 1986 i Beni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) mu birometero bike uvuye mu mujyi wa Goma, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru muri congo ukina nka rutahizamu.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Patiyo Tambwe yari afite amahitamo 4 hamwe nitsinda rya DR Congo hagati yo muri 2004 na 2008.

Marcel Tisserand, (Yavutse Ku ya 10 Mutarama 1993 i Meaux, mu Bufaransa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomaka muri congo, ukina nka myugariro wo hagati muri Ettifaq FC.
Muri 2006, yinjiye muri INF Clairefontaine, ahamara imyaka itatu yo gutangira imyitozo.
Yatorejwe muri AS Monaco aho yatwaye igikombe cya Gambardella muri 2011, yasinye amasezerano ye ya mbere ya bigize umwuga muri Kamena 2013. Nyuma yo kwitabira shampiyona hamwe nitsinda rya Claudio Ranieri, yatangiye umwuga we wa mbere tKu ya 10 Kanama kwinjira mu bihe bya nyuma by'intsinzi i Bordeaux.

Paulin Tokala Kombe (yavutse Ku ya 26 Werurwe 1977 i Kinshasa, icyo gihe hari muri Zayire, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoaka muri Kongo (DRC), ukina nk'umuzamu.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire ubu ni DRC, yakinnye hagati yo muri 1996 na 2004. yari mu ikipe yakinnye imikino nya furika muri 1988, no muri 2002 ndetse no muri 2004.
Yakinnye kandi imikino itatu ibara, n'imikino ibanza y'igikombe cy'isi.

Jerry Tondelua Mbuilua, yavutse27 févrierKu ya 27 Gashyantare 1975, ni umukinnyi wumupira wamaguru wa congo (DRC).

Isaac Tshikuna Tshibangu, (yavutse Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 2003 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC). Akina nka rutahizamu muri RSC Anderlecht. Yatorejwe mu ikipe yo muri FC Lokolo Moto, nyuma atizwa muri AS Dragons Bilima, amezi make hanyuma yi murirwa by'imazeyo muri kamena 2019 muri TP Mazembe.

Aaron Tshibola(wavutse taliki ya 2 Mutarama 1995) ni umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru wabigize umwuga ukina hagati mu kibuga nk’umukinnyi wo hagati. Akinira ikipe ya Kilmarnock. Yavukiye mu Bwongereza ariko ahagararira ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Yavukiye i London, yanyuze mu ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Reading mbere yo kwerekeza muri mu 2016. Yatijwe mu makipe arimo Hartlepool United, Nottingham Forest na Milton Keynes Dons, ndetse no muri Kilmarnock yo muri Ecosse. Yanakiniye mu Bubiligi muri Waasland Beveren no muri Portugal muri Aves.
Tshibola yavukiye mu Karere ka London Borough of Newham mu Bwongereza.
Umwuga we muma kipe.
Tshibola yinjiye mu ishuri rya Reading afite imyaka 13 asinya amasezerano ya mbere nk’umukinnyi wabigize umwuga muri Werurwe 2011.
Taliki ya 10 Nyakanga 2016, yimukiye muri Aston Villa ku masezerano y’imyaka ine(4).
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Tshibola yakiniye mu 2013.
Nyuma yemerewe guhagararira DR Congo kubera inkomoko ye.

John Lungeny Tshibumbu, (Yavutse Ku ya 6 Mutarama 1989 i Kinshasa muri Zayire) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukina ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nka rutahizamu.
John Tshibumbu yatorejwe muri AS Cannes aho yakinnye n'ikipe ya mbere hagati yo muri 2007 na 2010 muri Shampiyona y'igihugu.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yasi nye na Royal Charleroi Sporting Club, ni ukipe ikina muri shampiyona yi cyiciro cya mbere mu Bubiligi. Yakinnye imikino 4 hariya hamwe n'itsinda rya mbere maze agurizwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri AFC Tubize muri Mutarama 2011. Yakinnye neza buri gihe, yongeye ku gutizwa muri ikipe, imwe mugihe cy'inyongera muri 2011-2012. Yagize ibihe byuzuye afite ibitego 8 mumikino 29 ya shampiyona.
Icyakora, yasanze adafite ikipe mu gihembwe, cyane nubwo yageragejwe muri FC Rouen muri Nyakanga 2012.
Muri Nyakanga 2013, yasinye muri Gazélec Ajaccio. Yitabira ibihe byiza byi kipe yazamuwe kuva muri gihugu akagera muri Ligue 2. Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 2015, yatsinze ibitego bibiri kuri Niort maze atanga ku bazamuka neza muri Ligue 1, kuri Gazélec yatsinze ibitego 3 kuri 2 kuri stade Ange-Casanova.

Elias Tshimanga yari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC) mu mwaka o muri 1960, watsindiye CAN muri 1968.
Umwuga we nturamenyekana, ariko tuzi ko yakinnye umukino wo gutoranya mu Kuboza muri 1967, na Romaniya, kandi ko yari ku rutonde rwabakinnyi 22 batoranijwe na Congo-Kinshasa muri CAN muri 1968, nku mukinnyi wa Amerika Kipushi, cyangwa FC Kipushi.
Mu gihe yari muri CAN, yakinnye imikino wose atangira, atsinda igitego kuri penariti yakinnye na Senegali, kugirango atsinde ibitego bibiri kuri kimwe. Niwe kandi watsinze igitego mu izamu yatsinze ku mukino wa nyuma na Gana. Congo yatsinze irushanwa, niyo nyandiko yonyine ya Tshimanga uzi kugeza ubu.
Intego mpuzamahanga.

Martin Kamunda Tshinabu (yavutse Ku ya 8 Gicurasi 1946 noneho muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ni umukinnyi uri mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nkumukinnyi wo hagati.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye imikino 7 (nta gitego yatsinze) hagati yo muri 1970 na 1974.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cy'isi cyo muri 1974. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage, yakinnye umukino na Burezile.
Yitabiriye kandi igikombe cy’ibihugu bya Afurika muri 1972 na 1974. Yatsinze amarushanwa muri 1974.

Mukandi Tsimaya (Yavukiye muri 1967 abapfuye Ku ya 30 Mata 1995) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo, mu mukino na Panelefsiniakosi.
Mukandi Tsimaya yapfuye afite imyaka 28 muri mukino wahuje ikipe ye Atoromitosi na Panelefsiniakosi ku ya 30 Mata 1995. Yakebanye ijosi, amaze kugwa, apfa mu nzira yerekeza ku bitaro.

Tiko Tshinyama Tshiolola (Yavutse Ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1980 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w' amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC).
Yitabiriye igikombe cy’Afurika cyo muri 2006 hamwe n’ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Dimbi Tubilandu (yavutse ku ya 15 Werurwe 1948 muri Kongo Mbiligi, ubu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo arapfa Ku ya 17 Kamena 2021 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi wari mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo (DRC), wakinnye nkumuzamu.
Hamwe n'ikipe ya Zayire, yakinnye imikino 2 muri 1974.
Yari mu ikipe mu gikombe cyisi cyo muri 1974. Mu gikombe cy'isi cyabereye mu Budage, yakinnye na Yugosilaviya ubwo yasimbuzaga umunyezamu watangiye nyuma y'iminota 21 kandi amanota yari amaze kuba 3-0 ku ikipe ya Balkan. Gutsindira igitego kuva yatabaye bwa mbere, ntashobora kwirinda kurohama rwose ("9-0").
Yitabiriye kandi igikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 1974 cya tsinzwe n'ikipe ye.

Ricky Tulenge Sindani ni umukinnyi ukina umupira wamaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa congo ukina nkumukinnyi wo hagati.
Muri shampiyona yo muri 2014-2015, yatsinze ibitego 17 mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Kongo hamwe n'ikipe ya Arc-en-Ciel Kinshasa.
Nyuma, hamwe n'ikipe DCMP Imana, yatsinze ibitego birenga 30 muri cyiciro cya mbere cya Kongo, mu bihe bine.
Muri Kamena 2019, yasinyishije ibihe bitatu muri ikipe ya Maroke ya Difaâ El Jadida. Ariko nyuma gato, agarutse avuye kwimenyereza umwuga muri Turukiya, umukinnyi abura muri radari. Yifuza rwose kutazongera gukina n'ikipe ya Maroke, yifuzaga kwinjira muri AS Vita Club.
Hanyuma, nyuma y'imishyikirano myinshi, yiyemeje kugaraga muri AS Vita Club. Ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2020, ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu. Amafaranga yo kwimurwa agera ku 100.000 by'amadolari. Yambara numero 11 mu ikipe ye mashya.
Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mu ikipe ya DR Congo Ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2015, mu mukino wa gicuti na Zambiya.
Nyuma yitabiriye Shampiyona y’ibihugu by’Afurika muri 2016 yabereye mu Rwanda. Muri iri rushanwa, akina imikino itanu. DR Congo yatsinze irushanwa itsinze Mali ku mukino wa nyuma 3-0.

Gemi Tutuana, uzwi ku izina rya Jeff Tutuana, ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga wa congo ukina nka nkuwo kuruhande, cyangwa rutahizamu. Umwuga we wose yawumaze muri Isiraheli na Kupuro. Hagati yo muri 2002 na 2004, yakinnye imikino itatu mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Tutuana yatangira gukina umupira w'amaguru mu ikipe yitwa Japatra muri Kongo. Yakiniyeyo kuva muri 1997 kugeza 1999, nyuma ava muri AS Vita Club, aho yakinnye kuva muri 2000 kugeza 2002.
Nyuma yibyo, yagerageje amahirwe mu Bubiligi hamwe n'inshuti ye yo muri Vita Club yitwa Nsumbu Mazuwa, ariko bombi ntibagumye nyuma yikizamini cy'amakipe. kandi basinyiye ikipe ya Isiraheli Hapoel Haifa muri 2003. Bakina hamwe babyina iyi ikipe kuva muri 2003 kugeza 2005; muri kiriya gihe, batsinze Icyiciro cya kabiri kandi bafasha ikipe kugera muri Premier League ya Isiraheli. Ariko, nyuma y'igihembwe kimwe, ikipe isubira mu cyiciro cya kabiri nyuma yo kurangiza kumwanya wanyuma.
Nyuma, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Beitar Yerusalemu, yamushakaga kuva mu mpera za shampiyona ishize. Yatsinze ibitego 4 mu mikino 19 . Yagize imvune ikomeye mu mugongo arekurwa nyuma yi gihembwe kimwe, asimburwa na rutahizamu wa Espanye, David Aganzo.
Arimo gusubira mu miterere mu Bufaransa, imyitozo hamwe n'ikipe ya AS Saint-Étienne. Ni gihe cyo kuganira ni kipe yu bufaransa ya AS Cannes, umutoza we Luis Fernandez yari umutoza we wa Beitar. Nyuma asubira muri Isiraheli aho yasinye na FC Ashdod. Akinira nanone Maccabi Netanya.
Tutuana yahise yi mukira muri Chypre muri 2006 akinira Enose Neon Paralimni mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Sipiriyate mu bihe bibiri. Muri 2009, yinjiye muri Ayia Napa FC mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Sipiriyate, hanyuma Olympiakos Nikosiya.
Tutuana akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, akina imikino itatu hagati yo muri 2002 na 2004.

Bobó Ungenda, (yavutse Ku ya 19 Ugushyingo 1989 i Kasa-Vubu,) Ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ari mpuzamahanga ukomoka muri congo ukina nka myugariro wo hagati hamwe na ikipe ya Angola 1 ° de Agosto.
Hamwe na ikipe yo muri Angola ya 1 ° de Agosto, yitabiriye inshuro nyinshi muri Afrika Champions League. Yageze muri kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza aya marushanwa muri 2018.
Yakiriye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ku ya 2 Kamena 2012, kurwanya Kameruni. Uyu mukino batsinzwe 1-0 ni umwe mu majonjora yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi muri 2014.
Muri Mutarama 2014, yitabira Shampiyona y’ibihugu bya Afurika yateguwe muri Afurika yepfo. Muri iri rushanwa, akina imikino igera kuri ine. DR Congo yatsinzwe muri kimwe cya kane kirangiza na Gana.
Nyuma, muri Kamena 2016, yitabira Igikombe cya COSAFA. Muri iri rushanwa, akina imikino itatu. DR Congo ye gukanye umwanya wa gatatu mu marushanwa.

Nzuzi Bundebele Toko, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Nzuzi Toko, (Yavutse Ku ya 20 Ukuboza 1990 i Kinshasa) ni umukinnyi ukina umupira w'amaguru ukomoka muri congo.
