Qatar Airways (Arabic:) n'indege y'igihugu ya Emirate ya Qatar. Qatar Airways ni imwe mu ndege ziyongera cyane mu nganda z’indege ku isi, kuri ubu umuyoboro uhuza abantu barenga 100 mu Burayi, Amerika y'Amajyaruguru, Amerika y'Epfo, Uburasirazuba bwo hagati, Afurika, Aziya y'Epfo, Uburasirazuba bwa Ositaraliya, cyane cyane ku kibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Doha.
Qatar Airways ikora buri munsi kuva i Roma Fiumicino, Milan Malpensa na Venice kugera ku Kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Doha, itanga umurongo wa buri cyumweru 25 (indege 29, bitewe n’indege 4 ziyongereye ziva i Roma ziteganijwe mu gihe cya 01 Nyakanga - 30 Nzeri 2011). Kuva ku Kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Doha hari ingendo zerekeza Dubai hafi buri saha: igihe cyo guhaguruka ni isaha 1.
Kuva mu 2009, Qatar Airways yakoze impamyabumenyi y’inyenyeri 5 yatanzwe na World Airline Awards 2011 (isosiyete ikora ubushakashatsi mu Bwongereza, imwe mu mashyirahamwe azwi cyane mu nzego z’indege za gisivili kubera ko yahawe ibihembo by’umwaka ku masosiyete atandukanye y’indege, harimo ibihembo byisi byindege - Igihembo cyindege yumwaka) kandi yahawe igihembo cyiswe "Airline of the Yearby kubera ibikorwa byindashyikirwa mu bwato no kuba indashyikirwa mu bikorwa.
Abakozi ba Qatar Airways bahawe igihembo cya "Crew nziza mu burasirazuba bwo hagati". Byongeye kandi, Qatar Airways yatorewe kuba “indege nziza mu burasirazuba bwo hagati” mu bushakashatsi bwakorewe abagenzi mpuzamahanga barenga miliyoni 15 muri Skytrax World Airline Awards 2011.

RwandAir ni sosiyete y'indege y'igihugu cy'u Rwanda. Ni iya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ifite icyicaro i Kigali. Ikorera ku Kibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, i Kanombe.
Yashinzwe mu 2002 yitwa Rwandair Express. Yafashe izina rya RwandAir mu 2009. Ijya cyane cyane mu bihugu bya Afurika. Ijya kandi mu Burayi.
Kuva kuri Air Rwanda kugeza kuri Rwandair Express.
Air Rwanda yari sosiyete y'indege y'igihugu. Yahagaritse ingendo mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Nyuma yaho, Leta yashatse kongera kuyibyutsa. Sosiyete SA Alliance Air yo muri Uganda yayiyoboye kuva mu 1997 kugeza mu 2000.
Leta yahise yisubiza ibikorwa byayo. Rwandair Express yashinzwe ku wa 1 Ukuboza 2002. Yatangiye ingendo mu 2003.
RwandAir (kuva mu 2009).
Mu 2009, isosiyete yatangiye kwagura ingendo mu karere: Dar es Salaam, Nairobi na Gisenyi. Muri Kamena 2009, yahinduye izina iba RwandAir.
Mu Kwakira 2010, John Mirenge yabaye umuyobozi mukuru. Muri uwo mwaka, yakiriye indege ebyiri za Boeing 737-500. Mu 2011, yaguze indege ya mbere nshya ivuye mu ruganda, Boeing 737-800.
Mu 2015, RwandAir yinjiye mu Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry'Ubwikorezi bwo mu Kirere (IATA). Mu 2016, yahawe icyemezo cy'umutekano ku bikorwa byo ku butaka (ISAGO). Mu 2017, Bene yayihaye uburenganzira bwo gukorera i Cotonou.
Muri Mata 2018, Yvonne Makolo yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa RwandAir.
Mu 2020, Qatar Airways yatangaje ko ishaka kugura imigabane 49% ya RwandAir. Kugeza mu 2023, ayo masezerano yari ataranozwa. Muri Nzeri 2022, RwandAir yatangaje ko ishaka kwinjira mu ihuriro ry'indege Oneworld.
RwandAir ni iya Leta y'u Rwanda 100%. Umuyobozi mukuru wayo ni Yvonne Makolo kuva mu 2018.
Mu 2025, RwandAir yari ifite indege 14. Zirimo Airbus A330, Boeing 737-800, Bombardier CRJ900 na Dash 8. Muri uwo mwaka, umuyobozi wayo yatangaje intego yo gukuba kabiri umubare w'indege mu myaka itanu.
Mu 2018, RwandAir yajyaga ahantu 23. Ahenshi ni muri Afurika. Yajyaga kandi i Londres n'i Bruxelles. Mu 2025, yatangaje ingendo nshya zijya i Mombasa no muri Zanzibar.

Rwanda Civil Aviation Authority Ikigo gishinzwe iby'indege za gisivili mu Rwanda (RCAA, Kinyarwanda) ni ubuyobozi bwindege za gisivili zo mu Rwanda. Icyicaro cyayo kiri ku Kibuga cy'Indege Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali. Ni Ububasha bwashyizweho nk'ikigo gishinzwe indege za gisivili n'Itegeko No 21/2004 ryo ku wa 10/08/2004, risimbuza ikigo cy'indege cy'u Rwanda, cyari cyashinzwe muri 1986. Itegeko ryakurikiyeho No 44/2006 ryo kuwa 05/10/2006 ryongeye guhindura m'umuryango nka RCAA.

Rwanda Civil Aviation Authority Ikigo gishinzwe iby'indege za gisivili mu Rwanda (RCAA, Kinyarwanda) ni ubuyobozi bw'indege za gisivili zo mu Rwanda. Icyicaro cyayo kiri ku Kibuga cy'Indege Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali. Ni Ububasha bwashyizweho nk'ikigo gishinzwe indege za gisivili n'Itegeko No 21/2004 ryo ku wa 10/08/2004, risimbuza ikigo cy'indege cy'u Rwanda, cyari cyashinzwe muri 1986. Kandt House Museum ni Inzu Ndangamurage ya Kandt, yahoze yitwa Inzu Ndangamurage y’Amateka Kamere, iherereye mu cyahoze ari umujyi wa Kigali, Akarere ka Nyarugenge, mu burengerazuba bwawo. Aha hantu hatoranijwe nk'umurwa mukuru w’abakoloni mu Rwanda mu Budage muri 1907 n’umuturage w’Umudage (Administrator) Richard Kandt ku izina rya Nyarugenge. Izina ryahinduwe Kigali muri 1908 kuko byari bigoye cyane ko abakoloni bavuga. Ariko izina Kigali ryitiriwe Umwami Cyirima I Rugwe mu kinyejana cya cu 14 mu kwita izina ubu musozi wa Kigali.
Hanyuma, igitekerezo cya Richard Kandt, hamwe n’abandi bayobozi b’igisirikare cy’abakoloni, Abanyarwanda batangiye kubaka inyubako z’ubuyobozi, harimo n’iyi nyubako ndangamurage muri 1908. Iyi niyo nyubako yonyine isigaye kuva mu mwaka wo muri 1908. Kubera iyo mpamvu, iyi nyubako yavuguruwe muri 2004 ihinduka nk'inzu ndangamurage y’amateka karemano yerekana umutungo kamere w’u Rwanda. Byongeye kandi, ku ya 17 Ukuboza 2017, inzu ndangamurage yahinduye izina yitwa Inzu Ndangamurage ya Kandt hamwe n’imurikagurisha rishya ryerekana amateka y’u Rwanda mbere ndetse no mu bukoloni bw’Abadage ku izina rishya ry’ingoro ndangamurage ya Kandt. Hariho kandi iyerekanwa ry’ibikururuka bizima nka ingona za Nili, inzoka nka mamba yirabura, python, cobra, nizindi ziboneka mu cyaro cyu Rwanda.
Iyi ngoro ndangamurage iri munsi y’ishuri ry’umurage ndangamuco mu Rwanda.

Uganda Airlines ni indege ya Uganda iri mu yahoze izwi nka Flag Carrier, Iyi sosiyete ni ubukombe kuko yakoze kuva 1977 kugeza 2001 mbere yo kwitwa Uganda Airlines. yakomeje Ubwikorezi muri Kanama 2019. Iyi sosiyete y'indege yanditswe yigenga yanditswe mu gihugu itwara abantu, kandi ifite uburenganzira butangwa na leta mu bikorwa mpuzamahanga.
Icyicaro gikuru giherereye mu kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya, mu Karere ka Wakiso, nko mu bilometero 34 (21 mi), ku muhanda, mu majyepfo y’akarere ka bucuruzi hagati ya, umurwa mukuru n’umujyi muri Uganda
Nyuma y’ubushakashatsi n’inama nyinshi, y’Abaminisitiri ya Uganda yahisemo kongera gutangiza indege ya Uganda Airlines, [19] ifite indege nshya esheshatu, ebyiri muri zo zikaba ari umubiri mugari, intera ndende A330-800 naho izindi enye zikaba indege CRJ900. 20] Ubushakashatsi bwasabye leta gushora imari ingana na miliyoni 70 z’amadolari y’Amerika n’inguzanyo ingana na miliyoni 330 z’amadolari y’Amerika, yatijwe n’abatanga inguzanyo mu karere nka Banki y’ubucuruzi n’iterambere, kugira ngo barangize.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, yatangaje ko guverinoma ya Uganda yashyize amafaranga make kuri buri ndege esheshatu, mu gihe isoza gahunda yo gutera inkunga. Icyiciro cya mbere cy’indege CRJ900 cyari giteganijwe mu Gushyingo 2018, mu gihe hateganijwe ko hatangwa indege mu Kuboza 2020

Agace kahariwe bose k'ubucuruzi ni akarere kagizwe n'umuryango w’ubucuruzi ukubiyemo ibihugu byashyize umukono ku masezerano y’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose (FTA). Amasezerano nkaya akubiyemo ubufatanye hagati y’ibihugu byibuze bibiri agamije kugabanya inzitizi z’ubucuruzi, igipimo cy’ibicuruzwa bitumizwa mu mahanga n’amahoro, no kongera ubucuruzi bw’ibicuruzwa na serivisi hagati y'ibyo bihugu. Niba abantu basanzwe nabo bafite umudendezo wo kugendanirana hagati y’ibihugu, iyo hiyongereyeho amasezerano y’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose, bifatwa nk’umupaka ufunguye. Bishobora gufatwa nk'icyiciro cya kabiri cyo kwishyira hamwe mu bukungu.
Ihuriro ry’amahoro ni ubwoko bwihariye bw'ubucuruzi buhariwe bose. Aho uturere twose dufite gahunda z'amasezerano y'imbere, aho amashyaka ashyira mu ngiro kugirango habeho ubwisanzure kandi horoshywe ubucuruzi hagati yabo. Itandukaniro rikomeye hagati y’amashyirahamwe ya gasutamo n’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose ni uburyo bwabo ku bandi bantu bihariye. Mu gihe ihuriro rya gasutamo risaba impande zose gushyiraho no gukomeza imisoro imwe yo hanze ku bijyanye n’ubucuruzi n’abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi, impande z’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose ntizubahirizwa. Ahubwo, bashobora gushyiraho no gukomeza uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose bw'amahoro bukoreshwa mu bitumizwa mu mashyaka nkuko bibaye ngombwa. Mu karere k’ubucuruzi bwisanzuye nta guhuza ibiciro byo hanze, kugira ngo bikureho ingaruka z’ibiciro by’ubucuruzi, amashyaka azashyiraho uburyo bw’amategeko agenga inkomoko.
Ijambo "agace k'ubucuruzi buhariwe bose" ryasobanuwe mbere n'amasezerano rusange yerekeye amahoro n'ubucuruzi (GATT 1994) akubiyemo ubucuruzi bw'ibicuruzwa gusa. Amasezerano afite intego imwe, ni ukuvuga kuzamura ubwisanzure mu bucuruzi muri serivisi, yiswe ingingo ya V y’amasezerano rusange yerekeye ubucuruzi muri serivisi (GATS) nk "amasezerano yo guhuza ubukungu". Ariko, mu bikorwa, iryo jambo ubu rikoreshwa cyane mu kwerekeza ku masezerano atareba ibicuruzwa gusa ahubwo anareba serivisi ndetse n’ishoramari.
Ibice byemewe by'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose.
Ishyirwaho ry’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose rifatwa nk'umwihariko ku ihame ry’igihugu cyashyigikiwe cyane (MFN) n’umuryango w’ubucuruzi ku isi (WTO) kubera ko ibyifuzo by’amashyaka y’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose biha abayemeje ibirenze ibyo biyemeje. Nubwo ingingo ya XXIV ya GATT yemerera abanyamuryango ba WTO gushinga uduce tw’ubucuruzi tugenewe bose cyangwa kwemeza amasezerano y’agateganyo akenewe kugira ngo ashyirwe mu bikorwa, hari ibintu byinshi byerekeranye n’ubucuruzi bw’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose, cyangwa amasezerano y’agateganyo aganisha ku bucuruzi bugenewe bose.
Ubwa mbere, imisoro nandi mabwiriza yubahirizwa muri buri gihugu cyashyize umukono ku masezerano y'ubucuruzi bwisanzuye, bikurikizwa mu gihe ubwo bucuruzi bugenewe bose bwashinzwe, ngo habeho ubuhahirane hagati yabadafite aho bahurira n'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose ntibushobora kuba hejuru cyangwa burenze kubuza kurenza imirimo ijyanye n'andi mabwiriza ariho mu mashyaka amwe asinya mbere yo gushinga agace k'ubucuruzi bwisanzuye. Mu yandi magambo, gushyiraho agace k’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose kugira ngo gatange ubuvuzi bw’ibanze mu banyamuryango bacyo biremewe n’amategeko ya WTO, ariko impande z’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose ntizemerewe gufata nabi amashyaka atari make mbere y’uko ako karere gashyirwaho. Ikintu cya kabiri gisabwa giteganywa n'ingingo ya XXIV ni uko amahoro n’izindi nzitizi z’ubucuruzi bigomba kuvaho kugira ngo horoherezwe ubucuruzi bwose buri mu bucuruzi bugenewe bose.
Amasezerano y'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose agizwe n'agace ku bucuruzi buhariwe bose muri rusange aboneka hanze y'ubucuruzi bwa sisitemu nyinshi. Icyakora, abanyamuryango ba WTO bagomba kumenyesha Ubunyamabanga igihe bagiranye amasezerano mashya y’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose kandi ahanini inyandiko z’amasezerano y’ubucuruzi buhariwe bose zigomba gusuzumwa na komite ishinzwe amasezerano y’ubucuruzi mu karere. N’ubwo amakimbirane avuka mu duce tw'ubucuruzi buhariwe bose adashobora kuburanishwa n’urwego rushinzwe gukemura amakimbirane ya WTO, "nta cyemeza ko inteko za WTO zizubahiriza kandi zikanga gukoresha ububasha mu rubanza runaka".
Inkingi z'ubukungu bw'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose.
Gutandukanya ubucuruzi no guhanga ubucuruzi
Muri rusange, "gutandukanya ubucuruzi" bivuze ko agace kahariwe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose kazayobora ubucuruzi kure yabatanga ibicuruzwa neza hanze y'akarere bakerekeza kubidakorwa neza mu karere. Mu gihe, "guhanga ubucuruzi" bivuze ko agace kahariwe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose gahanga ubucuruzi bushobora kuba butari busanzweho. Muri byose, ubucuruzi buzamura imibereho n'ubukungu bw'igihugu.
Kurema ubucuruzi no gutandukanya ubucuruzi n'ingaruka z'ingenzi ziboneka mu gushyiraho akarere k'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose. Guhanga ubucuruzi bizatuma ibicuruzwa biva mu bicuruzwa bihendutse bikajya ku giciro gito, kandi ubucuruzi buzaguka. Ibinyuranye, gutandukana mu bucuruzi bizatuma ubucuruzi buva mu bicuruzwa bidahenze hanze y'akarere bikajya mu bindi bihenze imbere y'akarere. Ihinduka nkiryo ntirizagirira akamaro abakiriya mu bucuruzi bugenewe bose kuko babuze amahirwe yo kugura ibicuruzwa bihendutse bitumizwa mu mahanga. Icyakora, abahanga mu bukungu basanga gutandukana mu bucuruzi bitajya byangiza imibereho rusange y’igihugu: bishobora no guteza imbere imibereho rusange y’igihugu niba ingano y’ubucuruzi butandukanye ari nto.
Agace kahariwe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose nk'ibicuruzwa rusange
Abashinzwe ubukungu bagerageje gusuzuma urugero aho ubucuruzi bw’ubuntu bushobora gufatwa nkibicuruzwa rusange. Babanje gukemura ikintu kimwe cyingenzi cy’ubucuruzi bw’ubuntu, aribwo buryo bw’inkiko zashyizweho zikora nk’abakemurampaka mu makimbirane y’ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga. Ubu buryo nk'imbaraga zo gusobanura amategeko ariho na politiki mpuzamahanga y’ubukungu byemejwe mu masezerano y’ubucuruzi.
Uburyo bwa kabiri aho ubucuruzi bugenewe bose bufatwa nk'ibicuruzwa rusange bifitanye isano n'iterambere ryabo rihinduka "byimbitse". Ubutumburuke bw'ubucuruzi bwisanzuye bivuga ubwoko bwongeyeho bwa politiki y'imiterere ikubiyemo. Mu gihe amasezerano y'ubucuruzi ashaje afatwa nk '“ubushake buke” kuko akubiyemo uduce duke (nk'ibiciro n'amahoro), amasezerano aheruka gusinywa yerekeye izindi nzego nyinshi, kuva kuri serivisi kugeza ku ubucuruzi bukorewe ku ikoranabuhanga no kumenyekanisha amakuru. Kubera ko ubucuruzi hagati y’amashyaka y’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose buhendutse ugereranije n’abafite amashyaka, ahantu hagenewe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose usanga bidashoboka. Noneho ko amasezerano y’ubucuruzi yimbitse azamura ihuzwa ry’amabwiriza kandi yongera urujya n’uruza mu bucuruzi n’abatari mu mashyaka, bityo bigabanye inyungu za FTA, uduce dushya twahariwe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose tubona ibintu by'ingenzi biranga ibicuruzwa rusange.
Kuzuza ibyifuzo bigendanye n'uduce tw'ubucuruzi tugenewe bose.
Bitandukanye n’amashyirahamwe ya gasutamo, impande z’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose ntizigumana amahoro asanzwe yo hanze, bivuze ko bakoresha imisoro itandukanye, kimwe n'izindi politiki zerekeye abatari abanyamuryango. Iyi mikorere itanga amahirwe yabatari abanyamashyaka bashobora kugendera ku buntu mu bucuruzi bugenewe bose bwinjira mu masoko hamwe n’ibiciro byo hasi byo hanze. Izi ngaruka zisaba ko hashyirwaho amategeko kugirango hamenyekane ibicuruzwa biva mu mahanga byemerewe byemerewe ahantu h’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose, icyifuzo kidaturuka ku ishingwa ry’amashyirahamwe ya gasutamo. Ahanini, haribisabwa ku rwego ntarengwa rwo gutunganya ibivamo "guhinduka gukomeye" ku bicuruzwa kugirango bibonwe ko byaturutse. Mu gusobanura ibicuruzwa bikomoka muri PTA, amategeko y'ingenzi agenga inkomoko atandukanya ibicuruzwa bituruka n'ibidakomoka: gusa abambere nibo bazahabwa uburenganzira bw'amahoro yagenwe n'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose, aba nyuma bagomba kwishyura amahoro ya MFN ku byinjiye.
Twijeje ko mu kwemererwa gukurikiza inkomoko, hariho uburyo butandukanye bwo gutandukanya inyongeramusaruro zikomoka mu bucuruzi bugenewe bose no hanze yako gace. Mu bisanzwe inyongeramusaruro ikomoka mu mashyaka imwe ya FTA izafatwa nk'inkomoko kurundi ruhande niba zinjijwe mu bikorwa byo gukora murindi shyaka. Rimwe na rimwe, ibiciro by'umusaruro bivuka mu mashyaka imwe nabyo bifatwa nk'ibikomoka mu rindi shyaka. Mu mategeko agena inkomoko, ubwo buryo bwo kuvura butandukanye butangwa mu buryo bwo gukusanya cyangwa kwakira. Iyi ngingo isobanura kandi uburyo bwo guhanga ibicuruzwa no gutandukanya ubucuruzi bw’akarere kahariwe ubucuruzi bugenewe bose twavuze haruguru, kubera ko umuburanyi w’akarere k’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose afite ubushake bwo gukoresha inyongeramusaruro zikomoka mu rindi shyaka kugira ngo ibicuruzwa byabo byujuje ibisabwa bitangire.
Ububikoshingiro ku duce tw'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose.
Kubera ko muri iki gihe hari uduce twinshi tw’ubucuruzi twisanzuye kandi tugirana ibiganiro (abagera kuri 800 bakurikije ITC Amabwiriza agena Inkomoko, kubara kandi n’ubucuruzi budasubirwaho), ni ngombwa ko abashoramari n’abafata ibyemezo bakurikirana uko bahagaze. Hano hari umubare wabikijwe n'amasezerano y'ubucuruzi bugenewe bose aboneka haba kurwego rw'igihugu, uturere cyangwa mpuzamahanga. Bimwe birimo ububiko bw'ububiko shingiro bw'amasezerano y'ubucuruzi yo muri Amerika y'Epfo y'aguye yubatswe n’ishyirahamwe ryunze ubumwe ry’Amerika (ALADI), urubuga ku masezerano y'ubucuruzi n’ubucuruzi mu bihugu bigize ubumwe bw’Uburayi.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, hari ububikoshingiro bubiri bw'ingenzi bw'ubuntu bwateguwe n'imiryango mpuzamahanga kubafata ibyemezo n'ubucuruzi:
Sisitemu y'amakuru y'amasezerano y'ubucuruzi mu karere
Nkuko abanyamuryango ba WTO bategekwa kumenyesha Ubunyamabanga amasezerano y’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose, ubu bubikoshingiro bwubatswe bushingiye ku masoko yemewe y’amakuru ku masezerano y’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose (byitwa amasezerano y’ubucuruzi mu karere mu mvugo ya WTO). Ububikoshingiro butuma abakoresha bashaka amakuru ku masezerano y’ubucuruzi yatangajwe na WTO mu gihugu cyangwa ku ngingo (ibicuruzwa, serivisi cyangwa ibicuruzwa na serivisi). Ububikoshingiro butanga abakoresha urutonde ruvuguruwe rw'amasezerano yose akurikizwa, icyakora, abatamenyeshejwe WTO bashobora kubura. Yerekana kandi raporo, imbonerahamwe n'ibishushanyo bikubiyemo imibare kuri aya masezerano, na byumwihariko isesengura ry'ibiciro.
Ikarita y'imbibi z'isoko rya ITC
Ikarita igaragaza imibibi z'isoko yateguwe n’ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’ubucuruzi (ITC) hagamijwe koroherezwa ubucuruzi kuri, guverinoma n’abashakashatsi mu bibazo byo kubona isoko. Ububikoshingiro, bugaragara hifashishijwe igikoresho cyo kumurongo w'ikoranabuhanga Ikarita yo Kwinjira ku Isoko, ikubiyemo amakuru yerekeye imisoro n’inzitizi zidasoreshwa mu masezerano yose y’ubucuruzi akora, ntagarukira gusa ku bamenyeshejwe ku mugaragaro WTO. Yandika kandi amakuru ku masezerano y'ubucuruzi adakunzwe (urugero, Sisitemu Rusange ya Gahunda Y'ibyifuzo). Kugeza muri 2019, Ikarita yo Kwinjira ku Isoko yatanze amahuza ashobora gukururwa n'amasezerano y'amasomo n'amategeko agenga inkomoko. Ubusobanuro bushya bw'ikarita yinjira ku masoko azaza muri uyu mwaka bizatanga ku miyoboro itaziguye ku rupapuro rw'amasezerano kandi bihuze n'ibindi bikoresho bya ITC, byumwihariko Amategeko agena Inkomoko. Biteganijwe ko kizaba igikoresho kinini gifasha ibigo gusobanukirwa n’amasezerano y’ubucuruzi bugenewe bose no kuzuza ibisabwa ku nkomoko y'amasezerano.

Inganda z’ubukerarugendo muri Angola zishingiye ku bidukikije by’igihugu, harimo imigezi, amasumo n’inkombe. Inganda z’ubukerarugendo za Angola ni shyashya, kubera ko igice kinini cy’igihugu cyashegeshwe mu ntambara y’abenegihugu nyuma y’abakoloni yarangiye mu mwaka wa 2002. Bitandukanye n’ibihugu byinshi byo mu karere, muri rusange biha Amerika, n'Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi, n’abandi baturage benshi viza yo kuhagera cyangwa idasaba viza na gato, Angola ifite ibibazo bya viza bigoye (ibaruwa yemewe y'ubutumire, inyandiko zerekeye intego y'urugendo, kopi y'urugendo rw'ingendo, gihamya y'amafaranga, n'ibindi, byose byoherezwa i Luanda kugira ngo byemezwe). Ubu buryo bugenewe abashyitsi bushyira igihugu ku mbogamizi ku isoko mpuzamahanga ry’ubukerarugendo.
Ibikurura abashyitsi.
Parike y'igihugu ya Cameia.
Parike y'igihugu ya Cameia ni ibikurura abashyitsi muri Angola. Ni parike y'igihugu mu ntara ya Moxico ya Angola, iherereye kuri metero 1100 hejuru y’inyanja. Iragabana izina ryayo hamwe na komine yegeranye ya Cameia. Umuhanda wa Cameia - Luacano ugize umupaka w'amajyaruguru wa parike n'umugezi wa Chifumage ugize igice cy'amajyepfo y'umupaka w'iburasirazuba n'inzuzi za Lumege na Luena umupaka w'amajyepfo-uburengerazuba. Igice kinini cya parike kigizwe n’ibibaya byuzuyemo ibihe bigize igice cy’umugezi wa Zambezi, igice cy’amajyaruguru cya parike kinjira mu ruzi rwa Chifumage. Hariho kandi amashyamba manini ya miombo, asa n'ayari mu kibaya cya Zambezi cyo mu burengerazuba bwa Zambiya. Parike n'icyitegererezo cy'ibidukikije bitagaragara ahandi muri Angola. Ibiyaga bibiri, Lago Cameia na Lago Dilolo (nibyo biyaga binini muri Angola) biri hanze y'imbibi za parike kandi byombi bifite urubingo runini n’ibishanga byatsi bikungahaye ku nyoni zo mu mazi.
Parike y'igihugu ya Cangandala.
Parike y'igihugu ya Cangandala ni ikindi kintu gikurura abashyitsi muri Angola. Ni Parike ntoya mu gihugu kandi iherereye mu ntara ya Malanje. Iherereye hagati y'umugezi wa Cuije n'ubutaka 2 butavuzwe izina bw'umugezi wa Cuanza, hamwe n'umujyi wa Culamagia na Techongolola kumpande za parike. Iyi parike yashinzwe mu 1963 mugihe Angola yari ikiri munsi ya koloni ya Porutugali.
Parike y'igihugu ya Iona.
Parike y'igihugu ya Iona, iherereye mu Ntara ya Namibe, ni ahandi hantu nyaburanga hasurwa. Nibirometero 200 (Mayiro 120) uvuye mu mujyi wa Moçâmedes kandi, kuri kilometero kare 15,200 (Mayiro kare 5.850), nini mu gihugu. Mbere y'intambara y'abenegihugu ya Angola, Iona yari "paradizo y'inyamaswa, ikungahaye ku mukino ukomeye". Nyamara, nkuko bimeze kuri parike nyinshi zo muri Angola, guhiga mu buryo butemewe no gusenya ibikorwa remezo byangije byinshi muri parike yahoze ikize. Iyi parike izwi kandi ku bimera bidasanzwe n'ibitare bitangaje.
Parike y'igihugu ya Mupa.
Parike y'igihugu ya Mupa mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'intara ya Cunene yatangajwe ko ari Parike y'igihugu ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1964 mu gihe iki gihugu cyari cyikiri mubukoloni bwa Porutugali. Parike ifite akamaro kanini kubiteganijwe (nubwo muri rusange itize) avifauna. Abanya Angola benshi baba muri parike, hamwe n'abashumba b'inzererezi ndetse n'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro bibangamira inyamaswa zo muri parike. Nk’uko ingingo imwe ibivuga, "N'ubwo parike yabanje gutangazwa kugira ngo irinde amoko yo mu bwoko bwa giraffe, "Giraffa camelopardalis angolensis", mu 1974 nta n'umwe wasigaye kubera ko morfologiya ya Giraffe yera ituma ishobora kwibasirwa cyane na mine yasigaye mu ntambara y'abenegihugu ya Angola ugereranije ku yandi moko ya giraffe. Izindi nyamabere zabayeho, zirimo intare, ingwe, imbwa yo mu gasozi n'impyisi ziboneka ".
Angola ihana imbibi n'inyanja ya Atalantika kandi ifite kilometero 1.650 z'inkombe.

Ubukerarugendo muri Bénin ni inganda ntoya. Mu 1996, Benin yari ifite ba mukerarugendo bagera ku 150.000. Kugeza 2014 umubare wazamutse ugera ku 242.000. Igihugu gito gifite ibyiza nyaburanga bikurura ba mukerarugendo, parike y'igihugu ya Benin ndetse n'umuco biri mu bikurura ba mukerarugendo. Abomey ni kamwe mu turere dukurura ba mukerarugendo ba Benin, hamwe n'ingoro zahindutse Umurage w'isi mu 1982. Umurwa mukuru Porto Novo ibyiza nyaburanga birimo ingoro ndangamurage n’ubwubatsi.
Cotonou n'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cyonyine muri Bénin. Hariho indege zerekeza muri Bénin ziva mu Bubiligi, mu Bufaransa, no mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika. Muri iki gihugu hari kilometero 578 za gari ya moshi, zakozwe ku bufatanye na Repubulika ya Niger.
Guverinoma ya Benin ibona ubukerarugendo nk'uburyo bwo gutandukanya ubukungu bwabwo, gukurura ishoramari ryinshi mu mahanga, no kugabanya ubwishingizi bwa Benin ku nganda z’ubuhinzi. N'ubwo guverinoma ifite Politiki y’igihugu ishinzwe iterambere ry’ubukerarugendo, ntabwo yashyizeho ingufu nyinshi mu kuzamura ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo cyangwa gucuruza Benin nk'ahantu nyaburanga.
Bimwe mu bice byiza by’inyamanswa muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba biboneka mu majyaruguru ya Bénin, aho Parike y'igihugu ya Pendjari na Parike y'igihugu ya W biherereye. Igihe cyiza cyo kubona inyamanswa ya Parike ya Pendjari iri hafi kurangira igihe cy'izuba. Parike irashobora kugera kubagenzi kandi amacumbi arahari. Parike y'igihugu ya W iherereye mu majyaruguru ya Benin, kandi ikambukiranya Burkina Faso na Niger. Iyi parike ifite inyamanswa nyinshi, ariko biragoye kuyigeraho muri Bénin.

Osama Daoud Abdellatif ni umuherwe ukomeye w’umucuruzi wo muri Sudani akaba n’umuyobozi w'ikigo cyitwa DAL Group, n'amasosiyete menshi afite icyicaro i Khartoum, muri Sudani.
Ikigo cya DAL Group.
Osama Daoud ni umuyobozi akaba n'uwashinze ikigo cya DAL Group, kigizwe n'umubare munini w'amasosiyete afite icyicaro i Khartoum, muri Sudani. Itsinda rya DAL ribarizwa mu nzego zinyuranye z’ubukungu, nko mu kongera umusaruro w’ibiribwa, ubwubatsi, cyangwa ubucuruzi, binyuze mu masosiyete nka DAL Motors, DAL Engineering, ibiryo bya DAL (birimo ifu ya Sayga, Dairy Blue Nile Dairy, Nobo Pasta,), Sutrac na Sudani Liquid Air, kimwe n'andi masosiyete menshi.
DAL Group yashinze ishuri ry’umuryango mpuzamahanga wa Khartoum (KICS) kandi, mu rwego rwo gushyigikira inshingano z’imibereho myiza y’abaturage, ikora mu bikorwa binyuranye by’umuco, nk’ibirori by’ibiribwa gakondo bya Sudani cyangwa iminsi mikuru yizihiza imigenzo y'umuziki wa Sudani.
Daoud amaze kuragwa sosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’ubwubatsi n’imashini zikora ubuhinzi mu myaka ya za 1960, Daoud yahise ayagura kugeza ku rwego iriho muri iki gihe nk’umuryango munini wa Sudani. Nubwo Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika yafatiye ibihano byerekeranye n'ubucuruzi hagati ya Sudani, DAL Food Industries yabaye kompanyi ikora amacupa ikanayacuruza kuri Sosiyete ya Coca-Cola muri Sudani.
Osama Daoud arubatse kandi afite abana batandatu.

Bukonla Adebakin ni umuvugizi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru w'ubucuruzi wa Nigeriya. Ni umugore ndetse ni umuyobozi mukuru w'ibikorwa bya RED muri Afrika. Niwe kandi uyobora itsinda rya Future Project ritegura ibihembo byitwa Future Awards Afrika.
Adebakin yize ubumenyi, ikoranabuhanga n'uburezi muri Kaminuza ya Lagos, yo muri Nigeria.

Nonkululeko Gobodo (wavutse ku ya 10 Ukwakira 1960, avukira i Mthatha, mu burasirazuba bwa Cape) niwe wabaye umucungamari wa mbere w’umugore w’umwirabura muri Afurika yepfo mu 1987. Mu 2023 yabaye umuyobozi wa kaminuza ya Walter Sisulu.
Amaze kwiga, Nonkululeko yavugiye muri KPMG, maze ahabwa ubufatanye mu mikoranire arabyanga. Yaje gukora mu kigo cyitwa Transkei Development Corporation, nyuma y'igihe yaje kuzamuka aba umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imari. Nyuma yibyo, yashinze ikigo cye giciriritse cyitwa Gobodo Incorporated. Yagize uruhare runini mu kuyobora ihuriro rya Gobodo Incorporated na SizweNtsaluba VSP mu mwaka wa 2011 yaje gushinga ikigo cyitwa SizweNtsalubaGobodo, ikigo kinini cy’ibaruramari gifite Afurika y'Epfo. Muri 2014 yeguye ku mirimo y'umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, yashinze ikigo cya Nkululeko Leadership Consulting (NLC), ni ikigo cy’ubujyanama cy’abayobozi kandi gifite giherereye i Sandton, Johannesburg. Kugeza ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru akaba n'umuyobozi ushinzwe ubujyanama muri NLC. Ni umuyobozi mukuru utari mu nama ngishwanama mu kigo cya PPC Ltd na Clicks Group Limited. Yagizwe umuyobozi wa kaminuza ya Walter Sisulu kuva ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2023, azatangira inshingano ku mugaragaro ku ya 29 Kamena 2023.

Pam Golding (12 Nzeri 1928 - 3 Mata 2018) yari umunya-Afurika y'epfo utunganya imitungo itimukanwa yo muri Afurika yepfo. Binyuze mu kigo cyitwa Pam Golding Properties yashinze mu 1976, ni rimwe mu matsinda manini y’imitungo itimukanwa muri Afurika yepfo, ifite ibiro birenga 300 muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara ndetse no mu mahanga. Umuhungu wa Golding, Andrew Golding, ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo. Golding yapfuye ku ya 3 Mata 2018, afite imyaka 89, yapfiriye iwe mu rugo muri Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo.

Kubi Chaza Indi ni umurwanashyaka w'iterambere wo muri Zimbabwe ni rwiyemezamirimo w'umugore. Akunze gukoresha izina rye rya mbere, Kubi Chaza, yari umukinnyi wa filime mu Bwongereza, agaragara muri "Live and Let Die" mu 1973 ari umwanditsi w’igurisha ukorera James Bond. Amaze gusubira muri Zimbabwe, we n'umugabo we w'umukinnyi wa filime witwaJohn Indi batangije uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa by'ubwiza.
Indi afite uruhare runini mu iterambere ry'imiryango, byumwihariko ku bijyanye n’ibibazo byugarije abagore, kandi ni umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango w’abagore bakora ubucuruzi b’abasangwabutaka bo muri Zimbabwe.
Umuryango wa Indi wakomeje gukora mu mitunganyirize ya film, John nk'umukinnyi, ariko Kubi kumpande zombi za kamera. Mu 1989, yakoze "I am the Future", filime ivuga ku mukobwa ukiri muto (wakinwe na Stella Chiweshe) ujya mu mujyi munini ahunze intambara y'ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe mu cyaro. Mu 1993, yakinnye eponymous heroine's modern neighbour muri "Neria", inyandiko ya Tsitsi Dangarembga ivuga ku bapfakazi muri Zimbabwe. Filime zombi zayobowe na Godwin Mawuru, naho "Neria" yagaragayemo amajwi ya Oliver Mtukudzi.
Indi ni umunyamuryango w'abakora amafilime b'abagore bo muri Zimbabwe.
Yakinnye ari umukobwa wakoraga agurisha mu iduka rya Oh Cult Voodoo yaje igihe yari mu Bwongereza, maze abigiramo uruhare. Yakinnye nk'umukobwa ucuruza akorera James Bond (yakinnye na Roger Moore), amupfunyikira ikintu hanyuma avuza Mister Big igihe Bond avuye mu iduka.
Zimbabwe imaze kwigenga, Indi n'umugabo we John basubiye mu gihugu. Ari naho batangiriye uruganda rw'ibicuruzwa by'ubwiza rwitwa Kubi Cosmetics. Ubu ni iduka rizwi cyane muri Afrika yepfo. Ikora ibicuruzwa byumwihariko ku ruhu n'umusatsi wa Afrika.

Tshepo Motsepe (yavutse ku ya 17 Kamena 1953) ni umuganga wo muri Afurika yepfo akaba na rwiyemezamirimo. Ni Madamu wa Perezida wa Afurika y'Epfo, ni umugore wa Cyril Ramaphosa, Perezida wa Afurika y'Epfo. Ni mukuru wa Bridgette Radebe na musaza we ni Patrice Motsepe.
Tshepo Motsepe yize nk'umuganga uvura muri kaminuza ya KwaZulu-Natal arangiza icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu buzima rusange mu ishuri ry’ubuzima rusange rya Harvard. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yarangije amasomo y'impamyabushobozi muri gahunda yo kwihangira imirimo (SECP) mu kigo cya Gordon Institute of Business Science. Ubu ni umuyobozi wa African Self Help Trust (ASHA Trust), yibanda ku iterambere ry’abana bato ndetse n’uburezi.
Yakoze mu bikorwa rusange ndetse n'abikorera ku giti cyabo i Mmakau, Mahikeng, Johannesburg, Pretoria, no muri Zimbabwe. Yahoze ari Umuyobozi wungirije w'ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi ku buzima bw'imyororokere.
Motsepe yashakanye na Cyril Ramaphosa, Perezida wa Repubulika ya Afurika y'Epfo, bafitanye abana bane. Motsepe ni umugore wa gatatu wa Ramaphosa. Se ni nyakwigendera Chief Augustin Butana Chaane Motsepe, murumuna we ni Patrice Motsepe ukomeye mu bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, na mushiki we Bridgette Radebe, umugore w'umunyapolitiki w'ishyaka ryitwa Kongere y'igihugu (ANC) akaba n'uwahoze ari Minisitiri w'ingufu, Jeff Radebe.

Rebecca Naa Dedei Aryeetey (1923 - 22 Kamena 1961) uzwi kandi ku izina rya Dedei Ashikishan, yari umudamu ukora umwuga w'ubucuruzi muri Gana, yari umunyapolitiki. Yari azwi cyane ku bucuruzi bw'ifu muri Accra. Niwe mugore kandi ugaragara ku giceri cya 50 cy'amaPesewas.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Rebeca Naa Dedei yavutse mu mwaka wa1923, avukira ahitwa Osu akurira mu mujyi wa James, wo muri Accra. Nyina na se bakomoka muri Ga Asere na Osu.
Nyuma yo kwiga amashuri abanza, Naa Dei yahise akora ubucuruzi bw'ifu. Byatumye aba umukire kandi ukomeye cyane mu bucuruzi yakoraga bw'ifu bwamuhesheje izina ry'akabyiniririo rya 'Ashikishan', rikaba ijambo ryo mu rurimi rwitwa Ga rifite igisobanuro cy'ifu. Yari azwiho kuba umunyemari mukuru w'ishyaka rya CPP icyo gihe kandi yayoboye ibikorwa by'abagore ba CPP iwe i Kokomlemle - Accra. Nk'umunyapolitiki uharanira inyungu za CPP, yiyamamaje kandi atera inkunga Nkrumah n’ishyaka rya CPP kandi yagize uruhare runini mu gihe cyo guharanira ubwigenge bwa Gana. Yateye inkunga Nkrumah kugira ngo atsindire intebe y’inteko ishinga amategeko ya Ashiedu Keteke bituma aba Minisitiri w’intebe wa mbere wa Gana.
Kuba yari umuntu wa hafi ya Nkrumah byatumye aba umwanzi w’ishyaka rya politiki ryari ihanganye bivugwa ko aribyo byamugejeje no kugupfa hakiri kare. Yapfuye urupfu rubabaje mu gikorwa cya CPP i Ho ku ya 22 Kamena 1961 afite imyaka 38. Byaravuzwe ko abarwanashyaka ba politiki n’abagore bahawe uburozi muri icyo gikorwa nyuma yo gufata icyayi gishyushye ubwo yinubira ububabare bwo mu gifu.
Bisi zifite amagorofa abiri zazanywe mu mujyi wa Accra zizanywe na Harry Sawyer zahise zitiriwa 'Auntie Dedei', yari afite kandi ishusho ye kuri kashe y'igihugu ndetse no ku giceri cya 50 cya pesewa cya Gana, byose mu rwego rwo kumwibuka no kumuha icyubahiro.

Sylvia Nduka (yavutse 14 Ukwakira 1992) ni umunyanijeriya wigeze gutsinda mu irushanwa ry'ubwiza ndetse ni rwiyemezamirimo.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Sylvia Nduka akomoka mu gace kitwa Isuofia ni muri Leta ya Anambra. Ni umuhererezi muri bavandimwe be batanu. Yize ibaruramari muri kaminuza ya Lagos.
Umukobwa mwiza cyane muri Nigeriya 2011.
Yahataniye ikamba rya Nyampinga Miss Taraba mu marushanwa. aratsinda, yahawe imodoka ya Hyundai na miliyoni 3 naira.
Intego z'ibanze mu mushinga we, 'Sylvia Educational Foundation', ni ugushinga umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta wahaye imbaraga abantu binyuze mu burezi kandi ukita ku bana badafite amahirwe.
Sylvia Nduka yashinze kandi anayobora ikigo cyita k'umusatsi wa Sylvia, ubucuruzi bwo kwita k'umusatsi.

Botswana y'ibyingenzi bikurura ba mukerarugendo n'ububiko bw'imikino, hamwe no guhiga hamwe na safari yo gufotora irahari. Ibindi bikurura ibyiza harimo akarere ka Okavango Delta, mu gihe cy'imvura ni akajagari k'inzira z'amazi, ibirwa, n'ibiyaga. Inganda z’ubukerarugendo nazo zafashije mu gutandukanya ubukungu bwa Botswana buturuka ahantu gakondo nka diyama n’inka ndetse bihanga imirimo 23.000 mu 2005.
Iterambere ry'inganda m'ubukerarugendo.
Inganda z’ubukerarugendo za Botswana zatangiye gutera imbere mu rwego rwa politiki y'imiterere nziza mu myaka ya za 90. Afurika y'amajyepfo yagize umutekano mu bya politiki nyuma y'ivangura ndetse no kurekurwa kwa Nelson Mandela mu 1990. Iterambere ry’isi mu buryo bwo gutwara abantu n’itumanaho ry'icyo gihe ryarushijeho kugira uruhare mu bukerarugendo muri Botswana. Mu 1990 Botswana yashyize mu bikorwa Politiki y'Ubukerarugendo igamije kongera umubare w'ubukerarugendo, amafaranga yinjira muri leta, n'amahirwe yo kubona akazi. Politiki yibanze ku gukurura ba mukerarugendo mpuzamahanga ku isoko baturutse mu Burayi, Amerika y'Amajyaruguru, Ositaraliya, na Nouvelle-Zélande kugira ngo bongere amafaranga. Mu gihe igipimo cy’akazi cyazamutse neza hamwe n’inganda z’ubukerarugendo zingana na 4.5% by’imirimo isanzwe yemewe muri Botswana, imyanya myinshi y’imicungire y’imishahara myinshi mu nganda yagenewe abakozi bo mu mahanga.
Ubukerarugendo bwa Ongera uhindure Botswana bwabaye mu 2020 hagamijwe kongera ubukerarugendo bwo mu gihugu.
Ingaruka mbonezamubano n’ibidukikije.
Botswana yishingikiriza ku mutungo kamere haba mu mibereho rusange n'ubukerarugendo. Umutungo kamere muke kandi woroshye w'igihugu ni ingenzi cyane mu buzima bw'icyaro, bukoresha amazi, amashyamba, nubutaka. Agace ka Okavango Delta ni ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa na ba mukerarugendo ndetse ni n'umurage w'isi nka kimwe muri delta nini zo mu gihugu imbere ku isi. Kuba harakunzwe na ba mukerarugendo byatumye iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo ryaguka, ndetse n'ibikoresho, na serivisi mu karere birimo amabanki, amahoteri, n’indege. Icyakora, abaturage bo mu midugudu ya Khwai, Mababe na Sankoyo muri Okavango binubira ko badafite umutungo kamere w’imikino ngororamubiri ya Moremi kuko yiganjemo ba mukerarugendo mpuzamahanga ndetse n’amasosiyete y’ubukerarugendo yo mu mahanga. Ibikorwa byubukerarugendo bwa Botswanan byasobanuwe nka ahantu hateganijwe ibikorwa by'ubukerarugendo kandi bigateranirizwa mu karere gato, ibikoresho byonyine bidatanga ibikorwa byinshi by'ubukungu mu turere tuyikikije.
Nubwo igice kinini gikurura abantu gishingiye ku mutungo kamere w’igihugu, inganda zubukerarugendo ubwazo zitanga umutungo nyirizina wahinduye ibicuruzwa byangiritse. Amatsinda manini y'abantu mumatsinda y'ubukerarugendo ashobora guhungabanya inyamanswa akaziyobora ku kwimukira ahandi hantu ziashobora kuba zitamenyera. Imyanda isigwa nabamukerarugendo ishobora kandi guhindura imiterere y'ubutaka no kumenyekanisha amoko yangiza mu karere. Ibindi bikorwa by'ubukerarugendo bizwi cyane nk'ubwato bwihuta bishobora kurushaho guhungabanya inyamaswa zo mu mazi mugihe inyamanswa n’ifoto z’inyoni bishobora kugoreka imyitwarire y'ubwoko runaka harimo kugaburira no korora.
Botswana yagerageje uburyo butandukanye bwo kubungabunga umutungo kamere harimo n’imicungire y’umutungo kamere w’abaturage (CBNRM), ikaba ishingiye ku kwibwira ko abaturage baho bafite ubushake bwinshi kandi biyemeje kurushaho gukoresha umutungo kamere aho batuye ugereranije na guverinoma yakuweho. Nyamara, kubura amikoro n'ubuhanga mu baturage bikunze kubatera kwishingikiriza kumfashanyo yabafatanyabikorwa mpuzamahanga kugirango bagere ku ntego zabo ebyiri zo kuzamura iterambere ry'ubukungu no kubungabunga umutungo kamere.
Kwagura ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco muri Botswana bifite ubushobozi bwo kurushaho guteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu kugabanya umuvuduko mu mihanda ahantu nyaburanga hakurura inyamaswa mu gihe hashyirwaho uburyo bunoze bwo gukwirakwiza iterambere ry’ubukerarugendo mu guha amahirwe menshi abaturage baho kugira uruhare mu bukungu bw’ubukerarugendo. Ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco butanga amahirwe kuri ba mukerarugendo mu kwiga ibijyanye n'ubuhanzi, umurage, n'imigenzo yaho. Bamwe bavuga ko bishobora kuzamura ubukungu bw’abaturage, guhanga imirimo, kuzamura ubumwe n’ishema ry’umuco, no kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku midugudu bwibanda kandi ku kwereka ba mukerarugendo ubukorikori gakondo ndetse n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi, ibyo bikaba byiza cyane cyane ku bagore, bakunze gusigara mu nyungu z'ubukerarugendo. Amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo bushingiye ku midugudu atanga amahirwe yo kwihugura mu imyuga no kwihangira imirimo ku bagore baho. Akazi mu mudugudu wabo kavukire gatuma abagore basohoza inshingano zo mu miryango mu gihe babonye ubwigenge bw'amafaranga.
Ibikurura abashyitsi.
Amahoteri, amacumbi hamwe n’ahantu hakambitse.
Botswana iha abagenzi guhitamo amacumbi kuva muri hoteri z'ubukerarugendo zo mu rwego rwo hejuru, amacumbi meza ndetse n’inkambi za safari, guteganya amazu yabatumirwa hamwe n'inkambi. Ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa hafite amacumbi yigenga, inkambi za safari, hamwe n’ahantu hakambika abantu.
Ibyokurya bitandukanye bitangwa mu mahoteri na resitora kuva aho ukunda n'inyama zimikino, kugeza kumugabane wa Aziya no muri Aziya. Hano hari ibicuruzwa byinshi byihuse hamwe na resitora ntoya / gufata ibyokurya byaho. Kumurongo wuzuye wamacumbi, urashobora gushakisha mubukerarugendo muri Botswana - Urubuga rwubukerarugendo rwa Afrika.
Icyanya cyo hagati cya Kalahari.
Icyanya cyo hagati cya Kalahari ni parike nini yigihugu mu butayu bwa Kalahari ya Botswana. Yashinzwe mu 1961 ifite ubuso bungana na 52.800 km 2, ikabikigira icyanya cya kabiri kinini ku isi. Iyi pariki irimo inyamanswa nka giraffe, impyisi yijimye, warthog, impyisi, imbwa yo mu gasozi, ingwe, intare, inyamanswa yubururu, itamu, gemsbok, kudu na hartebeest itukura.
Parike y'igihugu ya Chobe.
Parike y'igihugu ya Chobe, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Botswana, ifite imwe mu cyanya kinini kibanda ku mugabane wa Afurika. Ku bunini, iyi ni parike ya gatatu nini mu gihugu, nyuma y'Icyanya cyo hagati cya Kalahari Hagati na Parike y’igihugu ya Gemsbok, kandi iratandukanye cyane. Iyi nayo ni parike yambere y'igihugu.
Parike ya Kgalagadi Transfrontier.
Pariki ya Kgalagadi Transfrontier ni agace kanini ko kubungabunga ubuzima bw'inyamanswa no kubungabunga ibidukikije mu majyepfo ya Afurika. Iyi parike ihuza umupaka uhuza Afurika y'Epfo na Botswana kandi igizwe na parike ebyiri zegeranye: Parike y'igihugu ya Kalahari Gemsbok muri Afurika y'Epfo na Parike y'igihugu ya Gemsbok muri Botswana. Ubuso bwa parike ni kilometero kare 38000 (milimetero kare 14,668). Hafi ya bitatu bya kane bya parike biri muri Botswana na kimwe cya kane muri Afrika yepfo.
Amakuru y'ubukerarugendo.
Politiki y’igihugu yo kubungabunga ibidukikije n’ubukerarugendo bwa guverinoma ya Botswana yashyizweho hagamijwe guteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu gihe harinzwe ibice by’ibinyabuzima. Abaturage bo muri Amerika, Afurika y'Epfo, ibihugu bigize Umuryango w'ibihugu bikoresha ururimi r'icyongereza, ndetse n'ibihugu byinshi byo mu Burayi bw'i Burengerazuba ntibakenera viza yo kumara iminsi itarenze 91. Icyangobwa cy'inzira cyirakenerwa kugirango habeho ingendo mu gihugu. Icyemezo cyumuriro wumuhondo hamwe n'inkingo za kolera birasabwa ba mukerarugendo baturutse ahantu banduye.
Raporo y’ihuriro ry’ubukungu ku isi ku bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo n’ubukerarugendo ku isi byashyize urwego Botswana rwa 88 mu bihugu 141 mu rutonde rw’irushanwa ry’ubukerarugendo n’ubukerarugendo mu mwaka wa 2015. Raporo imwe yashimye ibyiza bikurura bya Botswana, kandi igipimo cyo hasi cyatewe n’ibibazo byugarije ba mukerarugendo, harimo kutabona ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, imihanda mibi n’itumanaho.
Mu 1999, hari ibyumba bya hoteri 2100 bifite ibitanda 3,720 nigipimo cya 53%. Abashyitsi 843.314 bageze muri Botswana muri uwo mwaka hamwe n’abasaga 720.000 baturutse mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika. Amafaranga yinjira mu bukerarugendo mu mwaka wa 2000 yose hamwe angana na miliyoni 313 z'amadolari. Mu 2003, Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika yavuze ko impuzandengo ya buri munsi yo kuguma muri Gaborone ari amadorari 129, ugereranije na Kasane ku madolari 125. Ibiciro birashobora kuba munsi y'amadorari 50 mu tundi turere tw'igihugu. Botswana ifatwa nk'igihugu gifite umutekano mu gusurwa muri Afurika.
Abashyitsi benshi bageze muri Botswana bavuze ko ibiruhuko ari intego yabo yo kwinjira mu 2014 baturutse mu bihugu bikurikira by’ubwenegihugu:

Guverinoma ya Burkina Faso ivuga ko mu mwaka wa 2011 ba mukerarugendo 433,778 basuye iki gihugu
Ahantu hagaciro mu bukerarugendo muri Ouagadougou harimo: Pariki ya Bangr Weogo Urban Park, Ingoro Ndangamurage ya Burkina Faso, Imurikagurisha mpuzamahanga ry’ubugeni n’ubukorikori, hamwe n’ibirori bya Filime na Televiziyo bya Panafrican bya Ouagadougou.
Ahantu nyaburanga muri Ziniaré harimo: Pariki y’inyamanswa ya Ziniare, inama nyunguranabitekerezo ya granite, iba buri myaka ibiri, hamwe n’inzu ndangamurage ya Manega.
Imbuga nyaburanga muri Koudougou zirimo ingona ntagatifu za Sabou.
Ahantu nyaburanga muri Bobo-Dioulasso harimo: Umusigiti Mukuru, imva ya Guimbi Ouattara, Inzu Ndangamurage y’Intara ya Houet, na Guinguette.
Ahantu hashimishije muri Banfora harimo: Isumo Kamere rya Banfora, Ikiyaga cya Tengrela, na Peaks ya Sindou.
Ahantu hashimishije muri Diapaga harimo: Pariki yigihugu ya Arli, Parike y'igihugu ya W, n’imisozi ya Gobnangou.
Ahantu hashimishije muri Djibo harimo inzu ndangamurage ya kera ya Pobé Mengao hamwe n’ibishushanyo mbonera bya Pobé Mengao.
Ahantu hashimishijwe muri Gorom Gorom harimo Centre Feminine Artisan Centre ya Gorom hamwe n'ingando y'ubukerarugendo ya Gorom Gorom.

Ndi Okereke-Onyiuke (wavutse ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 1950) yahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo cy'imari n'imigabane muri Nijeriya akaba ari nawe wabaye umucuruzi w'imigabane wa mbere w'umugore muri Nijeriya.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Amashuri yisumbuye yayize mu kigo cyitwa ishuri ry’umwamikazi, giherereye Enugu, muri Nijeriya. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ishami ry'ubucuruzi n'imiyoborere aho yari yize ubumenyi mu by'imari n'ubumenyi bwa mudasobwa abyiga muri kaminuza yo mu mujyi wa New York, muri Leta zunze ubumwe z'Amerika. N'ubwo Okereke-Onyiuke yavugaga ko yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (Dogiteri murir Filozofiya) ndetse na Dogiteri w’imiyobore n'umutekano w'Isoko ry’Imari n’imigabane yakuye mu Ishuri Rikuru rya kaminuza imwe, nta nyandiko ivuga ko kaminuza yavuze ko yitabiriyemo iyo gahunda kandi ko yahawe impamyabumenyi. Ndi Okereke-Onyiuke yatangiye gukorana n’isoko ry'imari n'imigabane rya Nijeriya muri Mutarama 1983 nk'umuyobozi mukuru akaba n’umuyobozi ushinzwe ubushakashatsi n’amakuru.
Yazamutse ku mwanya wo hejuru w’Umuyobozi Mukuru n’Umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’isoko ry'imari n'imigabane ya Nijeriya (NSE). Ndi Okereke Onyiuke ni umwe mu bagore bazwi cyane muri Nijeriya bahawe inshingano ku myanya ikomeye kandi y'ingirakamaro mu buyobozi na politiki. Niwe mugore wambere wigeze gufata umwanya wa Diregiteri wa NSE.
Ndi Okereke-Onyiuke ni umwe mu bandi bahawe igihembo na Professional Excellence Foundation yo muri Nijeriya (PEFON) kubera ibikorwa by'indashyikirwa no kuyobora neza mu mwuga wabo
Ndi Okereke-Onyiuke wari umunyamigabane wu mugore ntacyo atakoze gitandukanye nkiri DG kuko kuva umunsi wambere nashizeho, natoje abantu benshi. Naje gufasha Nijeriya kugira ivunjisha rya mbere ku isi, kandi nakomeje kubikora. Sisitemu ikora ishyirahamwe. Twari twarashyizeho imiterere ikwiye kugirango tumenye neza ko sisitemu ikora, yaba umuyobozi mukuru cyangwa adahari. Ni nako bigenda ku bayobozi b'amashami. Twabonye abakozi bafite impano ikomeye, tubashora mubikorwa kandi tubahemba uko bikwiye. Ntamwanya numwe wabaye mubi.

Yavukiye mu bitaro bya Mater, i Nairobi, Yize mu ishuri ribanza rya Fort Hall Road mu mujyi yavukiyemo hanyuma yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye ry’abakobwa rya Pangani mu cyiciro rusange nyuma asoza amashuri y'icyiciro cyisumbuye mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Alliance Girls. Nyuma yagiye muri kaminuza ya "Université de Haute Bretagne" mu Bufaransa, aho yize "Lettres Modernes" mbere yo kwimuka ngo ajye mu rurimi rw'icyongereza. Yigishije mu kigo cya Mukumu Girls igihe gito hanyuma ahabwa buruse yo gukorera impamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ishami ry'igifaransa yakuye muri kaminuza ya Kenya. Afite kandi impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri muri kaminuza mu ishami ry'imiyoborere mpuzamahanga y’ubucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza mpuzamahanga yo muri Amerika (USIU).

Ubukerarugendo mu Burundi bushingira ku mujyi wa Bujumbura, ukaba ari nawo mujyi munini kandi wahoze ari umurwa mukuru w’Uburundi,ukurura bamukerarugendo mu igihugu. Usibye ibi, ikiyaga cya Tanganyika nacyo kizwi mugukurura ba mukerarugendo.
Uburundi bufite umutungo kamere ndetse n’ibinyabuzima, ariko inganda z’ubukerarugendo z’Uburundi ntabwo ziteye imbere. Ubukerarugendo bufite umugabane muto mu bicuruzwa byinjira mu gihugu (GDP). Umusanzu utaziguye w’ingendo ndetse n’ubukerarugendo mu bicuruzwa byinjira mu gihugu wari 2,1% muri 2013 na 2% muri 2014. Dukurikije imibare ya Banki y'Isi, umubare wa ba mukerarugendo mpuzamahanga wiyongereye mu myaka ya za 2000. Mu mwaka wa 2000, ba mukerarugendo mpuzamahanga bagera ku 29,000 basuye u Burundi, umubare wariyongereye ugera ku 148,000 mu mwaka wa 2005. Umubare wa ba mukerarugendo wageze ku 214,000 mu mwaka wa 2006; kugeza mu mwaka wa 2010, ba mukerarugendo 142,000 gusa ni bo bari basuye igihugu. Mu gihe urwego rw’ubukerarugendo ari ruto ariko rugenda rwiyongera, imidugararo ikomeje kwangiza ubukerarugendo mu gihugu.
Mu Burundi Ibikorwa remezo by'ubukerarugendo biri hasi cyane. Ubushobozi bwo gutwara no gucumbikira ba mukerarugendo ni ngerere. Mu mwaka wa 2010, guverinoma y’Uburundi yateguye gahunda y’imyaka 20 yo guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo ku bufatanye na Banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere hagamijwe kunoza ibikorwa remezo by’ubukerarugendo muri iki gihugu. Inkunga kandi nanone zituruka mu bindi bihugu na mashyirahamwe.
Mbere yo gusura u Burundi hakenerwa icyemezo cyerekana ko wakingiwe irwara yo mubwoko bw'ibicurane yiswe yellow fever. Malariya ni icyorezo mu Burundi, mu gihe kandi urukingo rwa kolera narwo rushobora gukenerwa igihe usuye u Burundi.
Ubukerarugendo bw'ibidukikije kamere ni bumwe mu bice by’ubukerarugendo mu Burundi. Pariki ya Kibira, Umugezi wa Rurubu n'ikiyaga cya Tanganyika bifatwa nk'ahantu nyaburanga ku nyamaswa. Hariho kandi ibiyaga byinshi by'inyoni zo mu gasozi, nk'ikiyaga nyaburanga cya Rwihinda.
Abarundi bavuza ingoma, bazwi ku izina rya "Abatimbo", ni bamwe mu bakurura ubukerarugendo bw'umuco. Ingoma z'imbaho ziri mu muco wa kera w'Uburundi. Amajwi yabo azwi nkamajwi ya "kera" ndetse "yera" yo mu Burundi kandi akaba ikimenyetso cy’ubumwe. Mu mwaka wa 2014, imbyino y’ingoma y’Abarundi yashyizwe ku rutonde rw’umurage ndangamuco w'Umuryango w’abibumbye ushinzwe uburezi, ubumenyi ndetse n’umuco uzwi nka UNESCO. Muri mwaka wa 2017, Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza yongeye kubyutsa imihango yo kuvuza ingoma mu birori ndetse abuza n'abagore kuvuza ingoma.
Nta murage w’isi uzwi n'Umuryango w’abibumbye ushinzwe uburezi, ubumenyi ndetse n’umuco uzwi nka UNESCO mu Burundi ariko hari ibibanza 10 biri ku rutonde rw’agateganyo rw'Umuryango w’abibumbye ushinzwe uburezi, ubumenyi ndetse n’umuco uzwi kuzina rya UNESCO. Izi mbuga 10 zirimo Gishora, Mugamba, Muramvya, Gasumo (isoko y’amajyepfo ya Nili), Ikibaya Kamere cya Rwihinda, Ikiyaga cya Tanganyika, Parike y’igihugu ya Rusizi, Parike y’igihugu ya Kibira, Parike y’igihugu ya Ruvubu n’isumo rya Kagera.

Zeb Tsikira ni umunyazimbabwe akaba rwiyemezamirimo ubarizwa mu bikorwa byo gutunganya imitungo itimukanwa, aba muri Kanada. Ndetse n'umwanditsi w'ibitabo.
Zeb Tsikira yavukiye mu gace kitwa "Bulawayo" akaba ari naho yakuriye mu nkengero za Nketa. Yize amashuri abanza mu ishuri ribanza rya Manondwane n'ayisumbuye mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Hamilton. Yaje kwimukira muri Kanada mu mwaka wa 2001 n'umuryango we.
Mu mwaka wa 2010 Tsikira yavuye muri kaminuza atayirangije aho yigaga mu ishami ry'intekerezo za muntu muri "kaminuza ya Ottawa". Yahise ashinga ikigo cyitwa Canvestus Group na Nyon Communications mu mwaka wa 2013 byakoraga by'umwihariko ibyerekeranye n'imitungo itimukanwa no gutunganya inyubako. Tsikira yahawe igihembo mu bihembo byahariwe abanyazimbabwe besheje imihigo byitwa "Zimbabwe Achievers Awards" mu mwaka wa 2019 aho yahembwe nka rwiyemezamirimo w'umugabo w'umwaka wa 2019.
Ni umuterankunga utanga umusanzu muri L'Arche Zimbabwe kandi agira uruhare mu bikorwa byo gutunganya umuziki mu gihugu cya Zimbabwe.

Anita Queen Uwagbale ni umudamu ukomoka mu gihugu cya Nijeriya akaba ari rwiyemezamirimo ndetse akaba yarigeze kuba umwamikazi w'ubwiza.
Uwagbale yamaze hafi imyaka ye yose yo mu buto muri Lagos kugeza igihe yaboneye urwandiko rumwemerera kwinjira muri kaminuza ya Madonna, i Port Harcourt agiye kwiga ibaruramari. Nk'umunyeshuri wigaga mu cyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza, Uwagbale yambitswe ikamba ry'umukobwa mwiza (Nyampinga) muri Nigeriya mu mwaka wa 2004, bituma ashobora kwitabira irushanwa ry'ubwiza ku Isi yose ryitwa "Miss Universe" nyuma yaje kwitabira Miss World mu mwaka wa 2004. Mu irushanwa rya Miss World 2004 Uwagbale yashyizwe muri banyampinga 15 ba mbere ku rwego rwa kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza maze agirwa "umwamikazi w’ubwiza w’umugabane" "wa" "Afurika". Nka MBGN, urubuga rwa Uwagbale rwari rufite intego zo kwita ku bihumanya Ibidukikije.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2008 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2018, Uwagbale yashakanye na rwiyemezamirimo witwa Tom Iseghohi, baje guhura hagati mu gihe yegukanaga ikamba nka MBGN. Nyuma y’imihango yo kwiyandikisha nk'abasezeranye muri Amerika, abashakanye bakoreye ubukwe bw'imbere y'amategeo i Lagos mu mwaka wa 2008, ubu bakaba ari ababyeyi bafite abahungu babiri n’umukobwa umwe. Mu mwaka wa 2009, yashinjwaga kunyereza abanyamigabane ba NITEL, ariko ibirego biraseswa.
Uwagbale yakomeje amasomo ye ajya kwiga muri Amerika mu gihe nanone yakoraga ubucuruzi bwe burimo gutunganya uruhuri rw'ibicuruzwa bikenerwa n'ababyeyi bigizwe na "Ububiko bw'abana". Muri Gicurasi 2011, ububiko bw'abana bwa Uwagbale bwafunguye mu isoko rya Chase Mall, hafi y'umuhanda wa Ademola Adetokunbo, ku kirwa cya Victoria, i Lagos, muri Nijeriya.

Umudugudu wa Umusambi, washinzwe n’ishyirahamwe ryita ku kubungabunga inyamaswa zo mu Rwanda uyobowe n’umuvuzi w’amatungo ariwe Olivier Nsengimana, ni igishanga giherereye i Kigali, mu Rwanda kikaba icumbi ry’imisozi irenga 50 itagira ingano y’imikara ("Balearica regulorum") yakuwe mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko. ubucuruzi bw'amatungo.
Izi nyoni zagaruwe nubunyage kandi ntizishobora kurekurwa mu gasozi. Umudugudu wa Umusambi utanga izo nyoni ahantu hateye imbaraga zishobora guhura na kamere yazo.
Nsengimana yatangiye umushinga w'Umudugudu wa Umusambi muri 2014. Icyari kigamijwe kwari uguhagarika ubucuruzi butemewe bwa umusambi mu buryo butemewe, guteza imbere imyumvire, no kurekura umusambi nyinshi zajyanywe bunyago zisubira mu gasozi, muri parike y’igihugu ya Akagera.

Ubukerarugendo muri Cape Verde, ku nkombe za Senegali hari itsinda ry’ibirwa, byatangiye mu myaka ya za 70 ku kirwa cya Sal kandi byiyongera buhoro buhoro mu myaka ya za 1980 na 1990 muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba.
Ubukerarugendo bwatanze miliyoni 41 z'amadolari y'Amerika mu bukungu bw'igihugu mu mwaka wa 2000. Inganda z’amahoteri zatanze 2.0% by'umusaruro rusange mu mwaka wa 1997, wiyongera ku kigero cya 6.8% mu mwaka wa 2001. Biro y'ibarurishamibare ya Cape Verdean ivuga ko umubare w’abakerarugendo wiyongereye uva ku 45,000 mu mwaka wa 1997 ugera ku barenga 115,000 mu mwaka wa 2001 ndetse urenga 765,000 mu mwaka wa 2018. Abenshi muri aba binjira baturutse mu Bwongereza bangana na (23,6%), naho Ubudage bangana na (11.2%), Ibihugu byo hasi (ni ukuvuga Ubuholandi n'Ububiligi), Ubufaransa, Porutugali, Ubutaliyani, n'ibindi bihugu. Ba mukerarugendo batageze kuri umwe kw'ijana baturutse muri Amerika. Umubare munini wa ba mukerarugendo basura ibirwa biringaniye ndetse n'ibirwa bidatuwe cyane nka Sal, Boa Vista, na Maio hamwe n'inyanja y'umusenyi wera.
Ibirwa bya Cape Verde bigira imiterere y'ikirere myiza ahanini mu gihe kingana n'iminsi 350 y'igihe cy'izuba mu mwaka, kandi ibirwa bimwe muribi bitanga imisozi ishimishije cyane. Imikino yo gusimbuka mu mazi, imikino yo kugendera k'umuvumba, ubwato hamwe n'ingendo z'amaguru zirahari kubakerarugendo. Ubukerarugendo rw'ibidukikije rimwe na rimwe bugenda butera imbere ku birwa bya São Nicolau, Santiago na Boa Vista. Ku bakerarugendo bashishikajwe n'insanganyamatsiko z'umuco, umujyi wa Cidade Velha ku kirwa cya Santiago watangajwe na UNESCO mu 1997, ariko ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco ntabwo bwatezwa imbere cyane kugeza ubu.
Politiki ya viza ya Cape Verde isaba viza kubakerarugendo baturutse ku isi yose. Vuba aha ariko, gusonerwa viza ku baturage b’Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi, abenegihugu b’Amerika na Kanada, hamwe n’abaturage b’ibihugu by’Uburayi hanze y’akarere ka Schengen, byashyizwe mu bikorwa kandi bitangira gukurikizwa ku ya 1 Mutarama 2019.

Inzu Ndangamurage ya Rwesero cyangwa Ingoro y’Ubugeni n’Ubuhanzi yo ku Rwesero, ni inzu ndangamurage iherereye i Nyanza, mu Rwanda. Yashinzwe n'Ikigo cy'ingoro z'umurage w'u Rwanda.

Ikigega mpuzamahanga cya Dian Fossey Gorilla (mu ntangiriro cyari Ikigega cya Digit) n’ishirahamwe ryita ku kurinda ingagi zo mu misozi ziri m'ukaga. Ikigega cya Digit cyashinzwe na Dr. Dian Fossey muri 1978 hagamijwe gutera inkunga mu kurwanya guhiga no gukumira inyamaswa z’ingagi zo mu misozi. Fossey yakoze ubushakashatsi mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya Karisoke kiri mu imisozi ya Virunga byo mu Rwanda. Ikigega kidaharanira inyungu cyiswe icyo kwita ku ingagi yakundaga cyane yitwa Fossey. Waciwe umutwe na ba rushimusi kugira ngo atange amadorari 20 y’amadolari y’umucuruzi w’umuhutu w’inzobere mu kugurisha imitwe y’ingagi, nk'ibikombe ndetse n'amaboko y'ingagi zikurura ba mukerarugendo.
Fossey yaje gushiraho ikigega cya Digit cyo gukusanya amafaranga yo gukora amarondo arwanya guhiga no gushimita ingagi. Yiswe "Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund International" mu 1992.
Fossey ahanini yarwanyije imbaraga z’imiryango mpuzamahanga, yumvaga idakoresheje neza amafaranga yabo mu bikoresho byinshi ku bayobozi ba parike y’u Rwanda, bamwe muri bo bakaba baravugaga ko batumije zimwe mu ngagi. Yatanze ibisobanuro ku ngaruka zikomeye z'urupfu rwa Digit, rwagize mu buryo bwo kubungabunga ibidukikije:"Nagerageje kutareka ngo ntekereze ububabare bwa Digit, ububabare ndetse no gusobanukirwa rwose agomba kuba yarabonye mu kumenya icyo abantu bamukorera. Kuva uwo mwanya, naje gutura mu gice cyanjye cyitaruye. "
Binyuze mu kigega cya Digit, Fossey yateye inkunga amarondo yo gusenya imitego ya ba rushimusi mu misozi ya Virunga. Mu mezi ane mu 1979, irondo rya Fossey rigizwe n’abakozi bane bo muri Afurika ryasenye imitego y’abahigi 987 mu gace k’ubushakashatsi. Abashinzwe kurinda parike y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, igizwe n’abakozi 24, ntibigeze bafata imitego ya ba rushimusi muri icyo gihe kimwe.
Ikigega mpuzamahanga cya Dian Fossey Gorilla gikomeje gukora ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya Karisoke, Fossey yashinze mu 1967, gikurikirana ingagi za buri munsi n’irondo.

Hôtel des Mille Collines
(Hotel y’imisozi igihumbi) ni hoteri nini iri mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda. Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yuko abantu 1.268 bahungiye muri iyi nyubako mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Inkuru ya hoteri n’umuyobozi wayo muri kiriya gihe yari, Paul Rusesabagina, yaje gukoreshwa nk'ishingiro rya filime ya Terry George ya "Hotel Rwanda" muri 2004.
Iyi hoteli y'inyenyeri 4 itanga ikigo cy'ubucuruzi na Wi-Fi y'ubuntu. Ibikoresho byo kwidagadura birimo pisine yo hanze ifite akabari, spa n'ibigo by'imyitozo ngororamubiri, n'ibibuga bya tenisi. Ahantu nyaburanga hafi harimo Sitade Amahoro n'Ikigo cy'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside cya Kigali.
Isosiyete y'indege y'Ababiligi Sabena niyo yubatse Hôtel des Mille Collines muri 1973 kandi yari iyifite mu gihe cya Jenoside yo mu Rwanda muri 1994.
Yari hoteri Y'inyenyeri enye ifite ibyumba 112, akabari, ibyumba bitatu by'inama, resitora, pisine, hamwe na tennis.
Ku ya 10 Kanama 2005, Hoteli Sabena yagurishije Hotel des Mille Collines kuri Hotel MIKCOR Hotel Holding kuri miliyoni 3.2 z'amadolari y'Amerika (hafi miliyari 1.8 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda). Umuyobozi mukuru w'itsinda rya MIKCOR, Miko Rwayitare, yavuze ko mu ihererekanyabubasha ryabereye muri iyo hoteri ku wa kane tariki ya 16, yavuze ko ubu iryo tsinda rifite 89% bya hoteri byose, ifite 8.5% na 2.5% ifitwe na Banki ishinzwe iterambere ry’u Rwanda (BRD) na guverinoma yu Rwanda. Rwayitare kandi yari umuyobozi mukuru wa Telecel International, yari isosiyete y'itumanaho. Muri Mata 2014, Mickor Investment Holdings Ltd yahinduye imicungire ya hoteri ayishyikiriza Hoteli Kempinski maze Kôinski yitwa Hôtel des Mille Collines. Hoteri yavuye mu munyururu wa Kempinski nyuma y'imyaka ibiri, kw'itariki 1 Mata 2016, isubira ku izina ryayo rya mbere.
Hoteri niho hategurirwaga filime "Hotel Rwanda", ariko ntabwo igaragara muri iyi filime, ariko ahanini yafatiwe muri Afurika yepfo. Iyi hoteri ariko igaragara muri firime ya HBO 2005, Rimwe na rimwe muri Mata, na firime yo muri Kanada muri 2007, "Shake Hands hamwe na Sekibi", nayo yafatiwe ahantu mu Rwanda.

Chez Lando ni hoteri na resitora biherereye mu murwa mukuru w'igihugu cyu Rwanda, Kigali. Iyi hoteri yashinzwe mu myaka wo muri 1980 n’umucuruzi ukomeye w’abanyarwanda n’umunyapolitiki witwa Lando Ndasingwa, n’umugore we w’umunyakanada Hélène, bombi bishwe muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda muri 1994. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Ndasingwa, hoteri yigaruriwe na mushiki we Anne-Marie Kantengwa, wari umunyeshuri mu 2013 muri gahunda y'amahoro ya IEEW binyuze muri gahunda y'ubucuruzi mu Rwanda. hotel chez lando yatangiye mugihe cyo hambere

Repubulika ya Centrafrique yagiyge hasi mu bukerarugendo kubera amateka ya vuba y’amakimbirane n’imvururu, ndetse n’umutekano muke mu turere tumwe na tumwe tw’igihugu, cyane cyane amajyaruguru n’amajyaruguru ashyira uburengerazuba.
Ubukerarugendo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) bwahuye n'ingaruka kubera intambara y'abenegihugu n'amakimbirane mu bihugu bihakikije.
Repubulika ya Centrafrique CAR ni igihugu kidakora ku inkombe muri Afurika yo hagati gifite abaturage 6,100,000 mu buso bwa kilometero kare 623,000.
Repubulika ya Centrafrique CAR ikikijwe na Tchad mu majyaruguru, Sudani mu majyaruguru, Sudani y'Amajyepfo mu burasirazuba, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo na Repubulika ya Kongo mu majyepfo, na Kameruni mu burengerazuba.
Kuva mu ntangiriro yo mu myaka yaza 2000, intambara y'abenegihugu n'imidugararo mu karere byateje ihungabana ndetse n'umutekano mucye, bituma ubukerarugendo butagira umutekano.
Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika ifite ubujyanama bw’ingendo mu rwego rwo guca intege ingendo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) ku benegihugu ba Amerika kubera ibyago by’imvururu z’abaturage n’ibyaha by’urugomo. Muri Mata mu mwaka wa 2007, ibirori byo guhiga byabereye hafi y'umujyi wa Ndele byarateye maze umuhigi w'umufaransa aricwa abandi batatu barakomereka.
Mu mwaka wa 2019, igihugu cyanditsweho ba mukerarugendo bagera ku 87,000 bari ku mwanya wa 174 ku isi.
Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) kandi yibasiwe n’amakimbirane yo mu karere, harimo nk’intambara yo muri Sudani yepfo ndetse n’imirwano mu bihugu byabaturanyi. Umutekano mu gihugu ntushikamye, cyane cyane mu majyaruguru no mu majyaruguru ahana imbibi n'uburengerazuba.
Mu myaka yashize, guverinoma yafashe ingamba zo gukaza umutekano mu gihugu kandi hamaze guterwa intambwe mu inganda z’ubukerarugendo. Nubwo, mu gihe intambara y'abenegihugu yarikomeje ndetse n'amakimbirane yo mu karere, ubukerarugendo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique (CAR) bwakomeje guhabwa imbibi.
"Ubukerarugendo muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique" bwagize ingaruka mbi ku mateka ndetse n'imirwano ibera mu bihugu byabaturanyi. Umutekano mu gihugu ntumeze neza, cyane cyane mu majyaruguru no mumbibi za majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba.
Repubulika ya Centrafrique igira ibibazo byo kubura ikirere bigatuma aho ahantu hahenda. Ikibuga mpuzamahanga gihari ni Bangui M'poko. Ahantu mu gihugu hakurura abagenzi harimo Chutes De Boali, amasoko y'uburebure bwa m 50 (164 ft).
Parike y'igihugu ya Dzanga-Sangha mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'igihugu ifite ingagi n'inzovu. Abaturage ba Baka batuye muri kariya gace. Bayanga iruhande rw'umugezi wa Sangha mu mudugudu munini hafi ya parike y'igihugu. Uwo mudugudu ufite amazu mato mato hamwe naho kuryama. Igihe cyiza cyo gusura igice kinini cy'igihugu ni guhera mu Gushyingo kugeza Mata.

Ubukerarugendo muri Tchad ni inganda ntoya. Abagenzi benshi bakururwa nubushobozi bwa Chad bwo guhiga hamwe na parike yigihugu ya Zakouma.
Ba mukerarugendo bagomba kuba bafite pasiporo na viza byemewe, hamwe n'ibimenyetso byo gukingira irwara yibicurani yiswe (yellow fever). Kuva mu mwaka wa 2000, mu gihugu haje abakerarugendo bagera ku 43,000. Tchad yari ifite ibyumba 677 bya hoteri ifite ibitanda 1,250 muri uwo mwaka. Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika yavuze ko impuzandengo ya buri munsi yo kuguma muri N'Djamena ari amadorari 239 mu mwaka wa 2002, ugereranije n’amadorari 50 mu tundi turere tw’igihugu.

Comoros ntabwo ifite inganda zikomeye z'ubukerarugendo.
Umubare w'abakerarugendo.
Nubwo Comoros ifite umutungo kamere w'ubukerarugendo, nk'inyanja n’ibidukikije byo mu nyanja, ntabwo ifite inganda zikomeye z’ubukerarugendo nk’abanywanyi bayo bo mu karere nka Réunion, Maurice, na Seychelles. Inganda z’ubukerarugendo zifite intege nke ahanini ziterwa n’imiterere ya politiki idafite umutekano, hamwe n’imivurungano ya politiki mu myaka mirongo itatu ishize.
Ba mukerarugendo muri Comoros ahanini ni abatunzi b'Abanyamerika n'Abanyaburayi, mu gihe ubushoramari muri hoteri bwaturutse muri Afurika y'Epfo.
Ibikurura ba mukerarugendo.
Ubukerarugendo bukurura ba mukerarugendo muri Comoros ni inkombe zabwo, uburobyi, hamwe n’imisozi. Mohéli ikurura ba mukerarugendo beza. Grand Comore ifite ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga hamwe na hoteri nyinshi za Comoros.

Ubukerarugendo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ntibusanzwe. Ba mukerarugendo bashobora kubona inyamanswa, imico kavukire, nibintu bya geologiya bidashobora kuboneka cyangwa n'ahandi hose muri Afrika.
Mu murwa mukuru, Kinshasa, amahirwe make y'ubukerarugendo arahari. Mu mujyi wa Kinshasa isoko ry'inzovu rirahari aho usibye ibihangano bigaragara bya congo, masike y'imiryango, nibindi bicuruzwa byiza bishobora kugurwa. Hanze ya Kinshasa kubungabunga bonobo bita Lola Ya Bonobo. I Kinshasa gusura uruzi rwa congo cyangwa amasomo ya golf yo mu mujyi cyangwa resitora zo mu mujyi birashobora kuba byiza.
Ba mukerarugendo bashobora gukora ingendo kugira ngo babone ingagi zo mu misozi no mu bibaya byo mu gasozi, wanahura n'abantu bagufi cyane bakora imyitozo gakondo yabo mu mashyamba, bonobos na okapi ni amoko abiri adasanzwe ataboneka ahandi ku isi, hanyuma uzamuke mu mpinga y'ibirunga maze urebe ikiyaga cya lava gitetse mu mwobo w'umusozi wa Nyiragongo. Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) yahuye n’imvururu zikunze kugaragara mu burasirazuba bw’igihugu.
Ingendo zigenga zihendutse muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) kuruta mu Rwanda cyangwa Uganda.
Parike y'igihugu ya Virunga.
Pariki y'igihugu ya Virunga nicyo kimenyetso cya mbere cy'igihugu muri Afrika, cyashinzweho mu mwaka wa 1925. Parike n'ingenzi mu bukerarugendo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC). Ni ikibanza ndangamurage cy'umuryango w’abibumbye ushinzwe uburezi, ubumenyi n’umuco (UNESCO) giherereye mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC).
Ku ya 11 Gicurasi 2018, muri parike y'igihugu ya Virunga hashimuswe ba mukerarugendo babiri b'Abongereza, abashinzwe parike, n'umushoferi wa Kongo. Umurinzi yarishwe ariko abandi batatu bararekurwa. Parike y'igihugu ya Virunga yafunzwe by'agateganyo kugira ngo ikemure ibibazo by'umutekano. Parike yongeye gufungura muri Gashyantare 2019. Ba mukerarugendo bashobora gusura Virunga cyangwa gutembera ku kiyaga kinini cya lava ku isi, umusozi wa Nyiragongo.

Equity Bank Rwanda Limited (EBRL), ni banki yubucuruzi ikorera mu Rwanda. Banki yahawe uruhushya na Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda, ariyo banki nkuru ikaba ari umugenzuzi w’amabanki.
EBRL ni ikigo cy’imari iciriritse gitanga serivisi z’imari mu Rwanda, bikaba bivugwa ko umutungo rusange ungana na miliyoni 363.39 y'amadorali y'America (miliyari y'amafaranga yu Rwanda 366.39), guhera ku ya 31 Werurwe 2021. Umugabane w’abanyamigabane ni miliyoni 52.42 y'amadorali y'America (miliyari y'amafaranga yu Rwanda angana 52.86).
Banki yahawe uruhushya rwa banki na Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda, muri 2011 itangira serivisi z’amabanki mu gihembwe cya kane cyo muri 2011. U Rwanda nicyo gihugu cya kane muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba aho Itsinda rya banki za Equity ryafunguye ishami. Naho Ibikorwa byo muri Tanzaniya byatangiye mu gihembwe cya mbere cya 2012. Ifite irindi tsinda rya mabanki, aho ifite amashami y’imari muri Kenya, Rwanda, Sudani yepfo, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo Uganda na Tanzaniya. Biteganijwe ko ibikorwa byayo mu Burundi bizatangira mu myaka itanu iri imbere.
Nk’uko ikinyamakuru New Times Rwanda kibitangaza ngo banki ya Equity yu Rwanda rwabonye igihembo cya Banki y'umwaka mu Rwanda muri 2020 na Banki mu gihembo cya Banki y'umwaka.
Muri 2020 banki ya Equity yu Rwanda yafunguye ishami ryu bwishingizi.
Equity Bank Rwanda Limited ikomeza amashami akurikira, guhera mu Kuboza 2014
Ibigo bigize Equity Group Holdings Limited birimo ariko ntibigarukira kuri ibi bikurikira:
Ububiko bwa Equity Group Holdings Limited iri ku Isoko ryimigabane rya Nairobi, ifite ikimenyetso cya EQTY. Ku wa kane tariki ya 18 Kamena 2009, itsinda ry’imigabane ry’itsinda ryanditswe ku isoko ry’imigabane rya Uganda (USE), maze ritangira gucuruza uwo munsi, ku kimenyetso cya: EBL. banki ya Equity yu Rwanda rwatangiye gucururiza mu Isoko ry’imigabane mu Rwanda muri 2015 ku kimenyetso EQTY.

Chez Lando ni hoteri na resitora biherereye mu murwa mukuru w'igihugu cyu Rwanda, umujyi wa Kigali.Iyi hoteri yashinzwe mu myaka wo muri 1980 n’umucuruzi ukomeye w’abanyarwanda n’umunyapolitiki witwa Lando Ndasingwa, n’umugore we w’umunyakanada Hélène, bombi bishwe muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda muri 1994. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Ndasingwa, hoteri yigaruriwe na mushiki we Anne-Marie Kantengwa, wari umunyeshuri mu 2013 muri gahunda y'amahoro yitwa IEEW binyuze muri gahunda y'ubucuruzi mu Rwanda.

Kigali Logistics Platform ni icyambu cy'imbere mu gihugu kidakora ku mazi ("dry port") giherereye i Masaka, mu Akarere ka Kicukiro, mu mujyi wa Kigali. Cyubatswe kandi gicungwa na DP World ku bufatanye na Leta y'u Rwanda. Iki cyambu gifasha mu kwakira, kubika no gutwara ibicuruzwa hagati y'u Rwanda, ibihugu byo mu karere ndetse n'ibyambu bya Mombasa muri Kenya na Dar es Salaam muri Tanzaniya.
Aho kiri n'imiterere.
Kigali Logistics Platform iherereye i Masaka, mu Karere ka Kicukiro. Iki cyambu cyubatse ku buso bwa metero kare 130.000, burimo ikibuga cya kontineri kingana na metero kare 12.000 n'ububiko bw'ibicuruzwa bungana na metero kare 19.600.
Gifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira kontineri zigera ku 50.000 za TEU ku mwaka no kubika ibicuruzwa bigera kuri toni 640.000 ku mwaka. Icyambu kandi gifite uburyo bwo kubika ibicuruzwa mu bukonje no gukurikirana ibicuruzwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga.
Mu 2016, Leta y'u Rwanda yagiranye na DP World amasezerano y'imyaka 25 yo kubaka no gucunga Kigali Logistics Platform. Iki cyambu cyatangiye gukora mu buryo bw'igerageza muri Nzeri 2018, mbere yo gutahwa ku mugaragaro na Perezida Paul Kagame ku wa 21 Ukwakira 2019.
Igice cya mbere cy'umushinga cyatwaye miliyoni 35 z'amadolari ya Amerika. Mu gihe cy'itahwa ryacyo, iki cyambu cyari kimaze gutanga imirimo 667 itaziguye n'iziguye, aho 98% by'abakozi bari Abanyarwanda.
Kigali Logistics Platform yashyiriweho korohereza ubwikorezi bw'ibicuruzwa no kugabanya igihe n'ikiguzi byatwaraga kugira ngo ibicuruzwa bigere mu Rwanda cyangwa bive mu Rwanda bijya ku masoko mpuzamahanga.
Nyuma y'uko icyambu gitangiye gukora, igihe amakamyo yamaraga mu bikorwa byo kwakira no gutanga ibicuruzwa cyagabanutse kiva hagati y'iminsi 10 na 14 kigera ku minsi itatu. DP World yavuze ko, mu gihe icyambu gikora ku bushobozi bwacyo bwose, gishobora gutuma abacuruzi bo mu Rwanda bazigama amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 50 z'amadolari ya Amerika buri mwaka.
Iki cyambu kandi gihuza u Rwanda n'ibyambu bya Mombasa na Dar es Salaam, ndetse kigafasha ubucuruzi hagati y'u Rwanda n'ibihugu birukikije birimo Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Burundi, Uganda, Tanzaniya na Kenya.
Mu muhango wo gutaha iki cyambu, Perezida Paul Kagame yasabye abacuruzi n'abashoramari kukibyaza umusaruro kugira ngo barusheho kugera ku masoko yo muri Afurika no hanze yayo.

Umuhanda wo kwamakuza inyubako yo makuza arinayo ibamo ibiro bya AIM Global Rwanda
Alliance In Motion Global izwi kandi nka AIM Global ni sosiyete mpuzamahanga igurisha ibicuruzwa byayo kwisi no muri Afurika. Iyi sosiyete imaze imyaka irenga icumi itanga serivisi ku isi. AIM Global Rwanda irashaka abaterankunga binyuze mu gukwirakwiza ubutumwa mu rubyiruko ndetse n'abakuru bushishikariza abantu gukora online business ku mugabane shingiro w'amafaranga 228000 y'u Rwanda.
Ibicuruzwa bya AIM ku isi byose ni ibyokurya bisanzwe birimo intungamubiri zifasha umubiri kugera kubuzima bwiza, kuramba, ubwiza no kurwanya indwara. Ibyinshi mu bicuruzwa bikorerwa muri Amerika n’amasosiyete atandukanye hamwe n’inzobere mu buzima bushingiye ku imirire myiza, bifashishije ibyatsi.
Aim Global itanga amahugurwa y'ubuntu ku abakiriya bayo ku biro byayo mu Rwanda. Ushobora kandi kwitabira amahugurwa y'ubungu ku biro byose bya AIM Global mubindi bihugu.

Mary Wambui ni umunyakenya uzwi mu mwuga w'ubucuruzi ndetse akaba ari n'umunyapolitiki. Yasimbuye uwahoze ari perezida Mwai Kibaki nk'umudepite mu Nteko ishinga amategeko kubwa Othaya kandi akora izo nshingano mu gihe cya manda imwe gusa yabaye guhera mu mwaka wa 2013 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2017.
Wambui yagirizwa kuba yari umugore wa kabiri wa Kibaki nubwo nta gihamya ihari. Umuryango wa Wambui wemezako Mwai yashakanye na Mary mu mwaka 1972 imbere y'amategeko yo mu migenzo ya Kikuyu ndetse ngo bombi banafitanye umwana w'umukobwa, witwa Wangui Mwai. Mu mwaka wa 2004 itangazamakuru ryatangaje ko bivugwako Kibaki afite umugore wa kabiri bashyingiranywe mu mategeko, Mary Wambui, n'umwana wabo w'umukobwa, witwa Wangui Mwai. Nyuma yuko ayo makuru yasakaye hanze, Ibiro bya perezida byasohoye itangazo ridasinyeho rivuga ko umuryango wa Kibaki ugizwe gusa n'umugore we, Lucy n'abana babo bane. Mu mwaka wa 2009, Kibaki, aherekejwe n'umugore we Lucy Kibaki, batumije ikiganiro bari kumwe n'itangazamakuru bagirango bahamirize isi ko afite umugore umwe rukumbi.
Mu kiganiro hamwe n'igitangazamakuru cyitwa "The Standard" cyanditswe ku ya 5 Mata 2007, Winnie yavuze ko we na Artur Margaryan, ukekwaho kuba ari umucuruzi ukomoka muri Arumeniya, bagamije kuzashyingiranwa mu gihe cy'ahazaza.
Mu kiganiro aherutse kugirana n’itangazamakuru ryo muri Kenya, Wambui yavuze ko afite abana batanu ariko yanze gutangaza amazina yabo bana.
Mary Wambui Mungai yari umuyobozi w'ikigo gishinzwe itumanaho muri Kenya, aho yorohewe cyane mu rubanza yarafite ubwo u rukiko nyuma yuko umucamanza yemereye abashinjacyaha gukuraho urubanza rwa miliyari 2 nigice. Ibi byabaye nyuma y ukwezi nyuma y’ubushinjacyaha (nka DPP) ahagaritse kandi urundi rubanza ruregwamo Madamu Mungai rurimo gutunga intwaro ndetse n’amasasu mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko. Ndetse Kwamamaza Yinjiye mu rutonde rwagutse rw’ibikorwa bya guverinoma, ndetse imanza zari inshinjabyaha zaje gusenyutse mu bihe byari byashize.

Rwanda Stock Exchange Limited yashinzwe ku ya 7 Ukwakira 2005 hagamijwe gukora ibikorwa by’isoko ryimigabane n'imigabane. Isoko ry'imigabane ryatandukanijwe kuva ryatangira kuko ryanditswe nka sosiyete igarukira ku migabane. Iyi sosiyete yatangijwe ku mugaragaro ku ya 31 Mutarama 2011.
Imiryango y'ivunjisha yafunguye ubucuruzi ku ya 31 Mutarama 2011. Uwo munsi wahuriranye n’umunsi wa mbere w’ubucuruzi mu bubiko bw’uruganda rukora inzoga rukumbi mu Rwanda, Bralirwa, rucuruza munsi y’ikimenyetso cya BLR. Isoko ry’imigabane mu Rwanda ryasimbuye Rwanda Over The Counter Exchange kuva muri Mutarama 2008, hamwe n’amasosiyete abiri yashyizwe ku rutonde, ari yo Itsinda iry’Ubucuruzi rya Kenya (KCB) ryashyizwe ku ya 18 Kamena 2009 n’itsinda ry’itangazamakuru (NMG) ryashyizwe muri 2 Ugushyingo 2010.
"Amarembo y'iri soko yafunguwe ku itariki ya 31 Mutarama 2011, igihe hasozwaga ibikorwa by'Isoko ry'Imigabane mu Rwanda, ryari rimaze gukora kuva muri Mutarama 2008. Iryo soko ryasimbuye isoko ryari risanzweho, aho amasosiyete abiri, ariyo Kenya Commercial Bank Group (KCB) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 18 Kamena 2009, na National Media Group (NMG) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 2010. Iri soko ry'imigabane ryatangiriye ku isosiyete ya Bralirwa, ububiko bukomeye bw'inzoga mu Rwanda, ikaba yari isosiyete ya mbere gukoresha umugabane ku isoko ry'imigabane ry'u Rwanda. Ubu buryo bwateje imbere ubucuruzi bw'imigabane mu gihugu, bigira uruhare mu kwagura ishoramari no kuzamura umuco wo gukoresha isoko ry'imigabane."
"Amarembo y'iri soko yafunguwe ku itariki ya 31 Mutarama 2011, igihe hasozwaga ibikorwa by'Isoko ry'Imigabane mu Rwanda, ryari rimaze gukora kuva muri Mutarama 2008. Iryo soko ryasimbuye isoko ryari risanzweho, aho amasosiyete abiri, ariyo Kenya Commercial Bank Group (KCB) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 18 Kamena 2009, na National Media Group (NMG) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 2010. Iri soko ry'imigabane ryatangiriye ku isosiyete ya Bralirwa, ububiko bukomeye bw'inzoga mu Rwanda, ikaba yari isosiyete ya mbere gukoresha umugabane ku isoko ry'imigabane ry'u Rwanda. Ubu buryo bwateje imbere ubucuruzi bw'imigabane mu gihugu, bigira uruhare mu kwagura ishoramari no kuzamura umuco wo gukoresha isoko ry'imigabane."
Nyuma yo gutangiza neza Bralirwa nk'ikigo cya mbere cy'ubucuruzi rusange (IPO), ikigo cya kabiri cy'ubucuruzi rusange ku isoko ry'imigabane mu Rwanda (RSE) cyari Banki ya Kigali, yatanijwe ku itariki ya 31 Kamena 2011. Ku ya 14 Mata 2015, Crystal Ventures yatangaje ko ifite umugambi wo kugira ikigo cya mbere cy'ubucuruzi rusange (IPO) ku isoko ry'imigabane ry'u Rwanda, mu kigo cyayo cy'ubucuruzi bwite, Crystal Telecom. Crystal Telecom ifite imigabane ingana na 20% muri MTN Rwanda, ikigo kinini cy'itumanaho mu gihugu.
Mu kwezi kwa Mata 2014, Isoko ry’Imigabane ry’u Rwanda (RSE) ryacuruzaga amasosiyete atanu yo mu Rwanda n’ayo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, kandi rikaba ryarakoraga ubucuruzi bw'ibikoresho bitatu bya leta n'ikigo kimwe cy'ibikoresho bifite inyungu (fixed income). Iri soko rikora iminsi itanu mu cyumweru kandi ni umunyamuryango w’Ihuriro ry’Isoko ry’Imigabane muri Afurika. RSE ifitanye umubano wihariye n’Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Nairobi (NSE) muri Kenya, Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Dar es Salaam (DSE) muri Tanzania, n’Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Uganda (USE) muri Uganda. Hari gahunda yo guhuza izi masoko ane agahinduka isoko rimwe rusange ryo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Mu kwa Mbere 2016, "The EastAfrican" yatangaje ko hari IPO eshatu zari muri gahunda.
Amaze gutangiza Bralirwa nk'intangarugero yatangiriye kumugaragaro (IPO), ya kabiri ya RSE ni Banki ya Kigali, yatangijwe ku ya 31 Kamena 2011. Ku ya 14 Mata 2015, haje Crystal Ventures yatangaje ko ifite umugambi wo gutanga ku mugaragaro (IPO) ku Isoko ry’imigabane mu Rwanda ry’ishami ryayo ryuzuye, Crystal Telecom. Crystal Telecom yari ifite imigabane 20% muri MTN Rwanda, yari isosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’itumanaho mu gihugu.
Muri Gashyantare 2011, Banki Nkuru y’igihugu cy’u Rwanda, yagiranye amasezerano n’ikigo gishinzwe kubitsa no gutuza (CDSC), kizana isosiyete yo muri Kenya, kugira ngo ikorere isoko ry’imigabane mu Rwanda umwaka umwe no guhugura abakozi b’u Rwanda kugeza igihe u Rwanda rushobora gutangira no gukora igitabo cyihariye. Ku ya 7 Ukuboza 2012, RSE yashyize ahagaragara "urutonde rw’imigabane y’imigabane mu Rwanda" (RSESI), ibarwa mu giye yigenga, ishingiye ku mategeko, imari shingiro y’isoko iremereye ibipimo ngenderwaho by’imigabane y’imigabane mu Rwanda.
Nyuma yo gutangiza neza Bralirwa nk'ikigo cya mbere cy'ubucuruzi rusange (IPO), ikigo cya kabiri cy'ubucuruzi rusange ku isoko ry'imigabane mu Rwanda (RSE) cyari Banki ya Kigali, yatanijwe ku itariki ya 31 Kamena 2011. Ku ya 14 Mata 2015, Crystal Ventures yatangaje ko ifite umugambi wo kugira ikigo cya mbere cy'ubucuruzi rusange (IPO) ku isoko ry'imigabane ry'u Rwanda, mu kigo cyayo cy'ubucuruzi bwite, Crystal Telecom. Crystal Telecom ifite imigabane ingana na 20% muri MTN Rwanda, ikigo kinini cy'itumanaho mu gihugu.
"Amarembo y'iri soko yafunguwe ku itariki ya 31 Mutarama 2011, igihe hasozwaga ibikorwa by'Isoko ry'Imigabane mu Rwanda, ryari rimaze gukora kuva muri Mutarama 2008. Iryo soko ryasimbuye isoko ryari risanzweho, aho amasosiyete abiri, ariyo Kenya Commercial Bank Group (KCB) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 18 Kamena 2009, na National Media Group (NMG) yashyizwe ku rutonde ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 2010. Iri soko ry'imigabane ryatangiriye ku isosiyete ya Bralirwa, ububiko bukomeye bw'inzoga mu Rwanda, ikaba yari isosiyete ya mbere gukoresha umugabane ku isoko ry'imigabane ry'u Rwanda. Ubu buryo bwateje imbere ubucuruzi bw'imigabane mu gihugu, bigira uruhare mu kwagura ishoramari no kuzamura umuco wo gukoresha isoko ry'imigabane."

Mu kwezi kwa Mata 2014, Isoko ry’Imigabane ry’u Rwanda (RSE) ryacuruzaga amasosiyete atanu yo mu Rwanda n’ayo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, kandi rikaba ryarakoraga ubucuruzi bw'ibikoresho bitatu bya leta n'ikigo kimwe cy'ibikoresho bifite inyungu (fixed income). Iri soko rikora iminsi itanu mu cyumweru kandi ni umunyamuryango w’Ihuriro ry’Isoko ry’Imigabane muri Afurika. RSE ifitanye umubano wihariye n’Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Nairobi (NSE) muri Kenya, Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Dar es Salaam (DSE) muri Tanzania, n’Isoko ry’Imigabane rya Uganda (USE) muri Uganda. Hari gahunda yo guhuza izi masoko ane agahinduka isoko rimwe rusange ryo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Mu kwa Mbere 2016, "The EastAfrican" yatangaje ko hari IPO eshatu zari muri gahunda.
