Masaka Creamery Limited n'Isosiyete y'ubucuruzi bukomeye bwo gutunganya amata i Kigali, mu Rwanda ndetse igatanga amahirwe k'urubyiruko yo kubona akazi kubatumva.
Iyi sosiyete yatangiye imikorere 2016 iherereye muri Kigali mu cyanya cy'inganda i Masoro. Igenda ikora ibicuruzwa bitandukanye birimo ibikoze mu mata nka yogurt, amata asembuye, cream nshya, amavuta, ghee nibindi bicuruzwa kubana na bakuze.
Intego ya Masaka Creamery nugushimisha abakiriya bacu mugukora ibicuruzwa bakunda, hamwe no kwitangira bidasubirwaho indangagaciro zacu. gukora ibicuruzwa byiza by'amata munsi yikirango cya Masaka Farms kuva ku cyicaro cyacu giherereye muri Kigali idasanzwe yubukungu.
Masaka Creamery Ltd ikoresha abakozi 40, abenshi n'urubyiruko rufite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Igiraneza agira ati: "Twiyemeje gukomeza gutanga ibicuruzwa byiza mu gihe dushiraho imirimo ku Rwanda cyane cyane urubyiruko rufite ubumuga bwo kutumva."
Iyi sosiyete ikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa byayo ku baguzi mu turere twa Nyagatare, Rwamagana na Kayonza mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, akarere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, Rulindo na Musanza mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru ndetse na Muhanga, Ruhango na Huye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo.

Inge Zaamwani-Kamwi (yavutse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1958 i Grootfontein, mu karere ka Otjozondjupa) ni rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka mu gihugu cya Namibiya akaba ari n'umujyanama wa perezida.
Yahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru w'umushinga Namdeb, ukaba wari umushinga uhuriweho w'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro hagati ya guverinoma ya Namibia na sosiyete yitwa De Beers, kuva yahabwa izo nshingano mu mwaka wa 1999. Mbere yizo nshingano muri uwo mushinga wa Namdeb, Zaamwani yari umuyobozi muri Minisiteri y’amabuye y’agaciro n’ingufu yo muri Namibiya kuva mu mwaka wa 1995 kugeza mu mwaka wa1998. Icyakora, yahagaritse izo nshingano muri Mata 2015.
Zaamwani yize mu kigo cy’umuryango w’abibumbye gishinzwe Namibia (UNIN) giherereye muri Zambiya kuva mu mwaka wa 1977 kug1za mu mwaka wa 981, ubwo yarangizaga impamyabumenyi mu "masomo y’iterambere". Yabonye kandi amahugurwa y’abayobozi yahawe na INSEAD, muBufaransa, muri kaminuza ya Cape Town hamwe na Ishuri ry’Ubucuruzi rya Harvard (ku bufatanye na kaminuza ya Witwatersrand). Zaamwani ni umunyamategeko wiguye mu mategeko y'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, amaze kubona Impamyabumenyi y'amategeko y'Icyubahiro muri "kaminuza ya Thames Valley" iherereye i Londres, ndetse n'impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri mu mategeko (LLM) yakuye muri kaminuza ya Dundee, mu gihugu cya Scotland.
Zaamwani yatangiye umwuga we mu mwaka wa 1984 nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe umushinga w'inama y'abagore ya SWAPO i Lusaka, muri Zambiya. Afite ashishikajwe na Air Namibia hamwe na Banki nkuru yigihugu ya Namibia.
Zaamwani-Kamwi ubu akora nk'umuyobozi mukuru wa Namdeb muri sosiyete ya De Beers Anonyme.
Kugeza muri Kamena 2008, yari afite inshingano zo kuba Perezida w'Urugaga rw'Ubucuruzi n'inganda rwo mu gihugu cya Namibiya. Yabaye Umuyobozi wigenga utari umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa mur muryango witwa FNB Namibia Holdings Limited guhera muri Mutarama 2000. Yari afite inshingano zo kuba umuyobozi ushinzwe umutungo muri (Namibia) (Proprietary) Ltd. Zaamwani-Kamwi yabaye Umuyobozi wa Extract Resources Ltd kuva ku ya 3 Mata 2009. Akora nk'umuyobozi wa Banki nkuru yigihugu ya Namibiya, Namdeb Property (Pty) Ltd, NamGem Diamond Manufacturing (Pty) Ltd, Diamond Board Namibia, Fishcor na Seaflower Lobster, NOSA Namibia, Zantang Investments (Pty) Ltd. na NABCOA, Ikigega cya XNET. Akora kandi nk'umwe mu bagize Inama y’amasosiyete akomeye ya Namibiya, n'ibigo hamwe n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta. Akora kandi nk'umuyobozi w'Inama Njyanama ya UNAM, Umuryango wita ku mutungo Kamere wo muri Namibiya, Ikigo cya Namibiya gishinzwe ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro n'ikoranabuhanga, Inama y'Urugaga rw'amabuye y'agaciro, Junior Achievement Namibia, Ikigo cy'imyuga n'amahugurwa, Urugaga rw'ubucuruzi n'inganda rwa Namibiya. Ni Umunyamuryango w’umuryango w'icyubahiro wa Lincolns Inn, London kandi ni umwe mu bagize ikigo gishinzwe ubuyobozi n’indangagaciro rusange z’ishuri ry’ubucuruzi rya UCT.
Ku ya 14 Kanama 2020, Zaamwani-Kamwi yaje kwipimisha asanga yaranduye icyorezo cya COVID-19.

KFC (mu icyongereza Kentucky Fried Chicken) ni Sosiyeti ikomoka muri America ifite icyicaro i Louisville, Kentucky, ni kabuhariwe mugutunganya amafunguro arimo inkoko zikaranze. Muri Afurika, Iyi resitora igurisha ibiribwa mu ibihugu 22 birimo Kenya, Uganda, na Tanzaniya mu karere ka Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.Mu Rwanda yafunguye imiryango mu mwaka wa 2020 mu Murenge wa Remera mu akarere ka Gasabo mu mujyi wa Kigali.

Banki y'ishoramari ya Angola (Banco Angolano de Investimentos) (yahoze yitwa "Banco Africano de Investimentos"), mu mpine ni "BAI", yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1996 nka banki ya mbere yigenga muri Angola. BAI ni banki itanga serivisi zose yuzuye ikorera muri Angola ifite umuyoboro mu gihugu hose (hagati ya 2012) ifite amashami 89 mu ntara zose uko ari 18, hamwe n’amashami 41 muri yo aherereye mu ntara ya Luanda. Muri buri ntara 18 hariyo amashami 9, BAI ikorera ibiro byishami rimwe gusa.
Abanyamigabane mukuru ni Sonangol, aho afite 8.5% by'imari shingiro ya banki. Arcinella Assets na Sforza Properties bafite 7% na 6.5% by'imigabane, abandi batandatu bafite 5% buri umwe; 48% isigaye ikwirakwizwa mu migabane mito.
BAI ifite icyerekezo kimwe muri Porutugali, Banco BAI Europa S.A ifite amashami abiri, Lisbonne na Porto. Mu mwaka wa 2008 BAI yafunguye Banco BAI Cabo Verde muri Cape Verde hamwe nandi mashami menshi. Mu mwaka ushize, BAI yaguze Banco BAI Microfinanças (BMF), banki nto yo mu gihugu cya Angola itanga serivisi nyinshi zirimo no kwishyuza Western Union.
BAI kandi ni umunyamigabane mu yandi masosiyete, nka Banco Sul Atlantico (BSA), IFI muri Cape Verde, Brasil Banco Múltiplo muri Berezile, Banco Internacional de S. Tomé e Príncipe (BISTP) muri São Tomé na Principe n'andi masosiyete.

Banki y'ubucuruzi n'inganda (Banco de Comércio e Indústria) ni banki iherereye mu gihugu cya Angola. Iyi banki yashinzwe ku ya 11 Nyakanga 1991 yemezwa n'itegeko rya guverinoma rifite No 08-A / 91. Umuyobozi wayo mukuru ni Filomeno Costa Alegre Alves de Ceita.
Umunyamigabane wibanze ni leta ifite 91% byimigabane. Abandi banyamigabane bagizwe n'ibigo icyenda bya leta aribyo, Ikigo gishinzwe itumanaho cya Angola cyitwa "Angola Telecom", ENSA - Seguros de Angola, CERVAL, Sonangol, Endiama, TCUL, Porto de Luanda na TAAG bifite 1.1% by'imigabane kuri buri kigo, hamwe na Bolama ifite 0.2%

Mu Rwanda rwashyize mu bikorwa ivugurura ry’ubukungu n’imiterere kandi rukomeza umuvuduko w’ubukungu mu myaka icumi ishize. Iterambere ry’inzego za Leta ryerekana ko rigarukira mugufata ibyemezo mu iterambere ry'igihugu, abikorera bazagira uruhare runini mu gufasha kuzamura ubukungu burambye.
Ubukungu bwu Rwanda bwagize inganda zihuse kubera politiki ya leta igenda neza. Ifite ubukungu buvanze. Kuva mu ntangiriro ya 2000, u Rwanda rwabonye ubukungu bwifashe neza, buteza imbere imibereho y'abanyarwanda benshi. Icyerekezo cya Guverinoma cyateye imbere cyabaye umusemburo w'ubukungu bwihuta. Perezida w'u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, yavuze ko yifuza guhindura u Rwanda "Singapore ya Afurika".
Ku bufatanye na Guverinoma y'u Rwanda, USAID ishyigikiye iterambere ry'ubukungu n'iterambere binyuze muri gahunda zongera umusaruro w'ubuhinzi, kwagura imibereho, kongera amafaranga, no kuzamura imirire, bityo bigafasha u Rwanda kwigirira icyizere no guhangana n'ikirere.
Mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe tutsi muri 1994.
Mu myaka ya za 1960 na 1970, politiki y’imari y’ubukungu y’u Rwanda, hamwe n’imfashanyo zituruka hanze ndetse n’ubucuruzi bugereranywa n’ubucuruzi, byatumye ubwiyongere bukabije bw’umuturage n’igipimo gito cy’ifaranga. Ariko, mugihe ibiciro bya kawa kwisi byagabanutse cyane mumyaka ya za 1980, iterambere ryabaye ribi.
Ugereranije n'ubwiyongere bwa GDP buri mwaka bwa 6.5% kuva 1973 kugeza 1980, ubwiyongere bwaragabanutse kugera ku kigereranyo cya 2,9% ku mwaka kuva 1980 kugeza 1985 kandi bwahagaze kuva 1986 kugeza 1990. Ikibazo cyageze mu 1990 igihe ingamba za mbere z’imiterere ya IMF gahunda yo guhindura. Mu gihe gahunda itashyizwe mu bikorwa mbere y’intambara,
hashyizweho ingamba z’ingenzi nko guta agaciro kabiri no gukuraho ibiciro byemewe. Ingaruka ku mishahara n'imbaraga zo kugura byarihuse kandi bitangaje. Iki kibazo cyibasiye cyane cyane intore zize, abenshi muri bo bakaba barahawe akazi mu bakozi ba Leta cyangwa mu bigo bya Leta.
Mu myaka 5 y’intambara y’abenegihugu yarangiye muri Jenoside yo mu 1994, GDP yagabanutse mu myaka 3 kuri 5, bituma igabanuka ryihuse rirenga 40% mu 1994, umwaka wa Jenoside. Ubwiyongere bwa 9% muri GDP nyayo mu 1995, umwaka wambere nyuma yintambara, byerekana ko ibikorwa byubukungu byongeye kubaho.
Nyuma ya Jenocide yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994.
Itsembabwoko ryo mu 1994 ryasenye ishingiro ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda, rikennye cyane abaturage, cyane cyane abagore, kandi ryangiza ubushobozi bw’igihugu mu gukurura ishoramari ry’abikorera ndetse n’amahanga. Icyakora, u Rwanda rwateye intambwe igaragara mu guhungabanya no kuvugurura ubukungu bwarwo. Muri Kamena 1998, u Rwanda rwasinyanye n'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari gishinzwe Kuringaniza Imiterere. U Rwanda rwatangiye kandi gahunda yo kwegurira abikorera ku giti cyabo na Banki y'Isi.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, guverinoma yatangiye gahunda ikomeye yo kuzamura ubukungu bw’igihugu no kugabanya gushingira ku buhinzi gusa ahubwo yongeramo ingamba nshya mubucuruzi bwa serivisi zitandukanye. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yashyize ahagaragara umuvuduko wa 13% muri GDP mu 1996 binyuze mu kunoza imisoro yinjira kubyinjira mu igihugu, kwihutisha abikorera ku giti cyabo, ibigo bya Leta kugira ngo bongere imiyoboro y'umutungo wa Leta, kandi bikomeza kunoza umusaruro woherezwa mu mahanga n'umusaruro w'ibiribwa. Igihingwa cy’icyayi n’inganda byakomeje kuvugururwa, ndetse ikawa iravugururwa yitabwaho n’uko abahinzi bumva umutekano wabo ugarutse.

Yego Innovations Limited ni isosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga rishya rikoreshwa mugutanga serivisi ku abagenzi tagisi yitwa "YEGO cab" aho serivisi za cab zitangwa gusa guhamagara nimero itishyurwa no kubona serivisi zihuse kubiciro bidahenze.
Ukurikije ikoranabuhanga rishya, abakiriya bakenera guhamagara 9191 gusa kandi tagisi iba iri ku muryango wabo n'iminota 5 gusa. Mbere tagisi-cab yatangwaga nintoki - aho abakiriya bitotombera amafaranga menshi batangaga ku bashoferi ba cab.

Isoko rya Kimisagara riherereye mu Murenge wa Kimisagara, Akagali ka Kamuhoza, Umudugudu wa Ntaraga ho mu karere ka Nyarugenge, Umujyi wa Kigali. Riherereye kumuhanda uva Nyabugogo werekeza Kuryanyuma, iri isoko rikaba rimaze igihe kitari gito ryubatswe.
Ibyo wahahira muri iri isoko.
Imbuto zitandukanye.
Kandi Imbuto ni bimwe mu biribwa by’ingenzi bifite umumaro ukomeye ku buzima bw’ikiremwa muntu. Imbuto ni isoko nziza y’intungamubiri zitandukanye nka vitamine, imyunyungugu, ibitera imbaraga, inyubakamubiri, ibivumbikisho, uturemangingondodo n’bindi.

Strive Masiyiwa (yavutse ku ya 29 Mutarama 1961) ni umucuruzi w’umukungu ufite inkomoko muri Zimbabwe ubu akorera ubucuruzi i Londere mubwongereza. Niwe washinze akaba n’umuyobozi mukuru w’amatsinda mpuzamahanga y’ikoranabuhanga na Cassava Technologies
Masiyiwa yatanze buruse ku rubyiruko rusaga 250.000 rwo muri Afurika mu myaka 20 ishize binyuze mu muryango we. Yateye inkunga imfubyi zirenga 40.000 hamwe na gahunda z’uburezi ndetse anatera inkunga abanyeshuri bo muri kaminuza zo muri Amerika, Ubwongereza, n'Ubushinwa.
Strive Masiyiwa yavukiye muri Zimbabwe, ku ya 29 Mutarama 1961. Igihe yari afite imyaka irindwi, umuryango we wavuye mu gihugu nyuma yuko guverinoma ya Minisitiri w’intebe Ian Smith itangarije itangazo ry’ubwigenge bumwe mu Bwongereza. Uyu muryango watuye i, umujyi uri mu majyaruguru ya Zambiya uzwiho gucukura amabuye y'agaciro y'umuringa. Hano niho yize amashuri abanza, mbere yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye muri Scotland. Nyina wa Masiyiwa yari rwiyemezamirimo. Mugihe Masiyiwa yari afite imyaka 12, ababyeyi be bashoboye kumuha amashuri yuburayi.
Bamwohereje mu ishuri ryigenga i Edinburgh, muri otcosse. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi mu 1978, yasubiye muri Rodeziya, agambiriye kwifatanya na Robert Mugabe na Joshua Nkomo ingabo z’inyeshyamba zirwanya guverinoma. Icyakora, yasubiye mu ishuri mu Bwongereza, ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n'amashanyarazi yakuye muri kaminuza ya Wales mu 1983. Yakoze igihe gito mu nganda za mudasobwa i Cambridge, mu Bwongereza, ariko asubira muri Zimbabwe mu 1984, yizeye ko azafasha igihugu gukira nyuma iherezo ry’intambara ya Rhodesian Bush n’amatora ya francise ku isi hose mu 1980.

Isoko Inkundamahoro riherereye i Nyabugogo Mu Karere ka Nyarugenge Mu Munjyi wa Kigali. Ni isoko ringezweho (isoko rya cyingambere) riba mu nyubaho ingeretse icuro zirindwi 7, Muri iri soko wasangamo imyambaro(imyenda, cyagwa inkweto) n'Ibiribwa bitadukanda harimo imbuto ni imboga. Kurya imbuto zihagije kandi zitandukanye bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara indwara zitandukanye ndetse zikomeye nka kanseri, Diyabete, stroke, ndetse n’izindi ndwara zitandukanye zifata umutima. Sibyo gusa kuko ishobora no kuharangurira ukanga kwicururiza.

Bethlehem Tilahun Alemu (yavutse 1980) ni umucuruzi wo muri Etiyopiya, washinze akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa soleRebels, "isosiyete ikora inkweto zikoreshwa cyane muri Afurika". Bethlehem yahawe icyubahiro n’ishimwe kubera ubucuruzi bwe, ndetse n’ingamba yashyizeho zo guhindura disikuru kuri Afurika ikava mu bukene ikajya mu mwuka wo kwihangira imirimo ku mugabane, imari shingiro, ndetse n’ubukungu. Bethlehem yatangije "Repubulika y’uruhu", yerekana ibicuruzwa biramba by’uruhu birambye, [2] hamwe n’ubucuruzi bwa "Garden of Kawa" kugira ngo biteze imbere ikawa ya Etiyopiya.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Bethlehem yavukiye mu gace ka Zenebework ka Addis Abeba. Ababyeyi be bakoraga mu bitaro byaho. Alemu yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye ya Leta, hanyuma akomeza kwiga ibaruramari muri kaminuza y’ubumwe, arangiza mu 2004. Bethlehem ni we rwiyemezamirimo wa mbere w’umugore wo muri Afurika waganiriye na Clinton Global Initiative kandi yahawe igihembo cy’umugore w’umugore w’umudage w’indashyikirwa na African Business Awards mu 2011

Mosunmola Abudu azwi kandi ku izina rya Mo Abudu, (yavutse ku ya 11 Nzeri 1964), ni umuhanga mu muri Nijeriya, akaba n'umujyanama mu micungire y'abakozi. yavuze ko ari "Umugore Watsinze kurusha abandi muri Afurika"
Mo Abudu yavukiye Hammersmith, mu Burengerazuba bwa London. Se yari injeniyeri na nyina yari umugabuzi. Inkomoko y'umuryango we iri mu mujyi wa Ondo, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Nijeriya. Ni imfura muri bashiki bacu batatu mu muryango. Mosunmola Abudu yimukiye muri Nijeriya afite imyaka 7 yo kubana na sekuru, asubira mu Bwongereza afite imyaka 11.
Ku myaka 19, Mo Abudu yatorewe kuba ambasaderi w’ikirango cya AVON Cosmetics ku isoko rya Afurika. Abudu yatangiye umwuga we nk'umujyanama mu gushaka abakozi mu 1987 mu kigo cya Atlas Recruitment Consultancy mu Bwongereza, aho yimukiye muri Starform Group mu 1990. Yagarutse muri Nijeriya mu 1993, ahigwa bukware na Arthur Andersen kugira ngo ayobore abakozi. n'amahugurwa ku gihangange cya peteroli, ExxonMobil. Niwe washinze Vic Lawrence &amp; Associates Limited.Yakomeje gukora, gukora no kwerekana ibihe hamwe na Mo, nyuma ashinga televiziyo (Ebony Life Televiziyo) kandi kugeza ubu akora ibintu by'imyidagaduro.

Richard Bbaale ni rwiyemezamirimo w’imibereho ukomoka muri Uganda washinze BanaPads mu mwaka wa 2010, isosiyete ikoresha imyanda ya pseudostem y’igitoki, ubusanzwe isigara ibora nyuma yo gusarura, ikora igitambaro cy’isuku. BanaPads ni igihembo cyatsindiye ikigo cy’imibereho cyanditswe muri Uganda na Tanzaniya hagamijwe gukora ibikoresho by’isuku bihendutse kandi bitangiza ibidukikije (100% biodegradable) kugira ngo abakobwa bo mu mudugudu bige ku ishuri kandi bihangire imirimo ku bagore baho. Amapaki nayo yegeranijwe kugirango akoreshwe nkifumbire kandi bivuze ko imyanda ijya mumyanda yaho izagabanuka kuva igitoki pseudo-stem nigicuruzwa gishobora gukoreshwa.
Afite Master mu bucuruzi bw’ubucuruzi kandi ni na we washinze SOVHEN UGANDA - umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta utera inkunga Imfubyi n’abana bafite intege nke ku buzima bwiza, uburezi n’imirire. Mu mwuga we yibanze ku gushushanya, gukora no gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa byita ku buzima bihendutse binyuze mu bikoresho bikomoka mu karere.

Amafaranga yu Rwanda (Afite ikimenyetso cya FRw, cyangwa se RF) ni ifaranga ryu Rwanda. rikaba r'igabanyijemo ibice 100.
Amafaranga yabaye ifaranga ry’u Rwanda kuva muri 1916, mu gihe Ububiligi bwari bwigaruriraga ubukoloni bwahoze bufitwe n'Abadage, naho amafaranga y’Ababiligi ya Kongo asimbura rupie yo mu Budage bw’Uburasirazuba. U Rwanda rwakoreshaga ifaranga rya Kongo Bubiligi kugeza mu 1960, igihe hatangizwaga amafaranga y'u Rwanda n'Uburundi. U Rwanda rwatangiye gutanga amafaranga yarwo muri 1964, nyuma y'imyaka ibiri ibonye ubwigenge.
Icyifuzo cyari icyo kumenyekanisha ifaranga rimwe, nki shitingi rishya ryo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ku bihugu bitanu bigize Umuryango w’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Mu gihe byari biteganijwe ko bizaba mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2012, gusa guhera muri Werurwe 2023, rizaba ari ifaranga rusange gusa ntiriratangizwa.
Muri 1964, ibiceri byatangijwe kumafaranga ni 1, 5 na 10, mu muringa. Mu 1969, hamenyekanye ibiceri bya aluminiyumu ku ifaranga 1, bikurikirwa na 1970 na n'amafaranga 2 nayo muri aluminiyumu. Kugabanuka k'umuringa-nikel igiceri 10 cy'amafaranga yatanzwe muri 1974.
Igice cy'umuringa cyari 20 na 50 yatangijwe muri 1977. Urukurikirane rushya rw'ibiceri 1 kugeza kuri 50 rwasohotse muri 2004 (byatangiye muri 2003) kandi igiceri gishya cya bimetalike cy’amafaranga 100 cyatangijwe muri 2008 (byatangiye muri 2007)
Muri 1964, inoti z'agateganyo zashyizweho kugira ngo zikoreshwe mu Rwanda (20 kugeza 100) Ibyo byakurikiranwe n'ibibazo bisanzwe kumafaranga angana kuva muri 1964 kugeza 1976.
Ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2019, Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko hazashyirwaho inoti nshya ya 500 n’inoti 1.000. Inoti zizaba zifite umutekano mushya hamwe nu bwiza bwo kugabanya Igishushanyo mbonera cy'inoti ya mafaranga 500 ni shyashya rwose, gusa ibara rusange ryahinduwe rihinduka umukara kugirango rifashe gutandukanya inoti 1.000.
Igipimo cyi vunjisha cya mateka.

Amafaranga y'u Burundi, afite code ya ISO 4217, hamwe na code ni BIF) nifaranga ryu Burundi. Igabanijwe ku izina mu "bice" 100, nubwo ibiceri bitigeze bisohoka mu binyejana kuva u Burundi bwatangira gutanga ifaranga ryabwo. Gusa m'ugihe Uburundi bwakoreshaga amafaranga ry'ububiligi bwa congo ni biceri byatanzwe.
Amafaranga yabaye ifaranga ry’Uburundi kuva muri 1916, igihe Ububiligi bwigarurira icyahoze ari ubukoloni bw’Ubudage bugasimbuza iryo bakoreshaga rya rupie y’Abadage yi burasirazuba ndetse ni faranga bwa Kongo. Uburundi bwakoresheje ifaranga rya Kongo mu Bubiligi kugeza muri 1960, igihe hatangizwaga amafaranga y'u Rwanda n'Uburundi. U Burundi yatangiye gutanga amafaranga yayo muri 1964.
Hariho gahunda yo kwinjiza ifaranga rimwe, i shitingi rishya ryo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, mu bihugu bitanu bigize Umuryango w’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba guhera mu mpera zo muri 2015. Kuva muri Werurwe 2023, gusa iyi gahunda ntirasohora.
Muri 1965, "Banki" y'Ubwami bw'Uburundi yatanze ibiceri 1 by'umuringa. Mu 1968, Banki ya Repubulika y’Uburundi yafashe itangwa ry’ibiceri maze itangiza, ifaranga rya aluminiyumu 1 na 5 na cupro-nikele ryi 10. Amafaranga 5 na 10 afite impande zombi zisa. Ubwoko bwa kabiri bwi biceri 1 na 5 by'amafaranga yatangijwe muri 1976, hagaragaramo ikirango. Muri 2011 hashyizweho ibiceri bishya 10 na 50.
Kuva muri Gashyantare 1964 kugeza ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1965, inoti za Banki yu Rwanda nu Burundi (Gutanga Banki y'u Rwanda n'Uburundi), mu madini ya 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500 na 1.000, zacapishijwe hejuru umwobo wa diagonali "BURUNDI" kugirango ukoreshwe mu gihugu. Ibyo byakurikiranwe muri 1964 na 1965 n’ibibazo bisanzwe mu madini amwe na Banki yu bwami yu Burundi (Banki y'Ubwami bw'Uburundi).
Muri 1966, inoti y’amafaranga 20 no hejuru yayo yacapishije na Banki ya Repubulika y’Uburundi, maze isimbuza ijambo "Ubwami" na "Repubulika". Ibibazo bisanzwe by'iyi banki byatangiriye mu madorari nka10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1.000 na 5.000. Amafaranga 10 yasimbuwe n’ibiceri muri 1968. Inoti 2000 zashyizweho muri 2001, zikurikirwa n’amafaranga 10,000 muri 2004. Umufotozi Kelly Fajack ishusho yabana b’ishuri mu Burundi yakoreshejwe inyuma y’inoti y’amafaranga 10,000. Muri 2015 u Burundi bwatangije urukurikirane rushya rw'inoti. Inoti ya 10, 20, na 50 franc yatakaje ubuzima gatozi kandi inoti ya mafaranga 100 niyo nyandiko yonyine yavuye murukurikirane rwa kera.

Ku ya 3 Mutarama 2006, amafaranga yari afite agaciro ka 925 ku idorali 1. Ku 2008, amafaranga yari afite agaciro ka 1,129.40 ku madorari y'Abanyamerika. Ku 2009, amafaranga yari afite agaciro ka 1.234.33 ku madorari y'Abanyamerika. Ku ya 10 Nyakanga, amafaranga yari afite 1.587.60 ku madorari y'Abanyamerika.

Amashiringi yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba yari mu ishami rya konti mu turere twagenzuwe n'Ubwongereza muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kuva muri 1921 kugeza muri 1969. Yatanzwe n'Inama ishinzwe ifaranga rya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Niryo zina ryateganijwe ku mafaranga asanzwe Umuryango wiburasirazuba bwa Afrika uteganya ahari imbere kumenyekanisha.
Amashiringi yagabanijwemo "amafaranga" 100, naho amashiringi makumyabiri yari mu ipawundi 1.
Amashiringi ya mbere yo muri Afrika y'iburasirazuba.
Bitandukanye n'ahandi mu mutungo w'Ingoma y'Ubwongereza yakoreshaga na siterilingi, muri Afurika y'Uburasirazuba bw'Ubwongereza, i shilingi aho kuba I pawundi cyari igice cy'ibanze cya konti, hamwe na pawundi yari ahanini yakoreshwaga mu kwandika amafaranga menshi cyane ntibyaba byoroshye iyo byavuzwe gusa muri shilingi.
Iyi miterere idasanzwe yavutse kubera ko ifaranga rya mbere ryakoreshejwe n’abategetsi b’abakoloni b’Ubwongereza muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba bw’Ubwongereza ryari amafaranga, ntabwo ari siterilingi. Amashiringi yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba yamenyekanye muri Kenya, Tanzaniya, na Uganda muri 1921, asimbuza folorine yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba igihe gito ku gipimo cya shilingi 2 na folorine 1. Folorine yari yazanywe kubera izamuka ry’ibiciro bya feza nyuma y’Intambara ya Mbere y'Isi Yose. Muri kiriya gihe, amafaranga yu Buhinde yari ifaranga ry’ibihugu by’Ubwongereza by’Uburasirazuba. Ifaranga, kubera ko ari igiceri cya feza, ryazamutse mu gaciro kirwanya siterilingi. Iyo igeze ku gaciro ka shilingi ebyiri, abayobozi bahisemo kuyisimbuza folorine. Kuva muri folorine niho havuye shilingi yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba. Ifaranga ryagumye gushirwa kuri siterlingi imwe kandi ryagabanijwemo amafaranga 100. muri 1936, Zanzibar yinjiye mu nama y’ifaranga, maze ifaranga rya Zanzibari risimburwa ku gipimo cya 1 kugeza kuri 1 Zanzibari. Yasimbuwe n’ifaranga ryaho (shilingi yo muri Kenya, shilingi ya Uganda, na shiringi ya Tanzaniya) nyuma yubwigenge bwintara.
Muri 1951, shilingi yo muri Afrika y'iburasirazuba yasimbuye amafaranga yu Buhinde muri koloni ya Adeni na protekate, ihinduka na Federasiyo y’abarabu yepfo muri 1963. Muri 1965, Ikigo cy’ifaranga ry’Afurika y’iburasirazuba cyarasenyutse, maze dinari y’Abarabu yepfo isimbuza shilingi muri Federasiyo y’Abarabu yepfo ku gipimo cya 20 kugeza kuri dinari 1.
Amashiringi ya kabiri yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba.
Impapuro zasubukuwe n’ifaranga ryasabwe n’umuryango w’Afurika y’iburasirazuba, ugizwe na Kenya, Tanzaniya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Sudani yepfo, na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Byari byavuzwe ko shilingi ya kabiri yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba izashyirwa ahagaragara mu mwaka wa 2012, ariko intego ntiyagerwaho. Itariki ya kabiri yagenewe umwaka wo muri 2015 yashyizweho, ariko nayo ntiyujujwe. Itariki ya gatatu igenewe ni muri 2024.
Muri 1921, inoti zatanzwe n’ikigo cy’ifaranga ry’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba mu migeci cya 5, 10, 20, 100, 200, 1,000 na 10,000, hamwe n'inoti za shilingi za 20 na hejuru kandi ifite amadini agaragara muri pawundi (1, 5, 10, 50 na 500). Muri 1943, hasohotse inoti 1, inshuro imwe gusa izo nyandiko zakozwe. 1,000 inoti zatanzwe gusa kugeza muri 1933, hamwe 10,000 inoti iheruka gutangwa muri 1947. Asigaye yatanzwe kugeza muri 1964.
Amashilingi yanditswe ku inoti mu Cyongereza, Icyarabu, na Gujarati, mu gihe indangagaciro za pawundi zanditswe mu Cyongereza gusa.
Iheruka gusohoka 10,000 / = inoti yanditswe ku ya 1 Kanama 1951 ariko inoti nkuru yakoreshejwe mugusiba imbere mu myaka myinshi nyuma yo muri 1951.

Florin yari ifaranga ry'abakoloni b'Abongereza ndetse hamwe n'abashinzwe kurinda Afurika y'Iburasirazuba hagati yo muri 1920 na 1921. Yagabanijwemo amafaranga 100. Yasimbuye ifaranga rya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kuringaniza, riza risimburwa na Amashiringi yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ku gipimo cya shilingi 2 = folorine 1. Folorine yari ihwanye na shilingi 2 muri siterilingi.
Kubera igihe gito cyabayeho, bike mu biceri byacapwe byatanzwe kandi ni bike muri iki gihe. Ibiceri byacapishijwe mu madorari ari 1, 5, 10, 25 na 50 na folorine 1 ariko, ukurikije " y’ibiceri by’isi" ibiceri 50 by'amafaranga ntibyarekuwe yo kuzenguruka kandi 30% gusa by'ibiceri 1, 5 na 10 ku ijana byakozwe byatanzwe kugirango bizenguruke.
Ikigo cy’ifaranga ry’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba cyasohoye inoti mu madini ya 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 na 500, inoti zifite agaciro ka florine 10 no hejuru nazo zitwara amapound (1, 2, 5, 10 na 50)).

Ifaranga rya rupee ryari ifaranga ry’abakoloni b’Uburasirazuba bw’Ubwongereza hamwe n’uburinzi hagati yo muri 1906 no muri 1920. Yagabanijwemo amafaranga 100.
Ifaranga ryasimbuye amafaranga yu Buhinde, yari yarazengurutse mbere. Muri 1920, ifaranga ryongeye kuvugururwa kurwanya siterilingi kugeza ku gipimo cy'ifaranga 1 = amashiringi 2 (folorine 1). Muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ibyo byakurikijwe muri uwo mwaka no gusimbuza ifaranga na folorine amafaranga yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ku buryo bungana hanyuma muri 1921 na Amashiringi yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ku mashiringi 2 kuri folorine cyangwa amafaranga.
Ifaranga rirazwi cyane gushiramo igiceri cya mbere cya aluminiyumy ku isi, igiceri cyo muri 1907 ku giceri 1.
Ibiceri bya feza byatangijwe ku mafaranga ya 25 na 50 mu mwaka wo muri 1906, bikurikirwa na aluminiyumu 1 na cupro-nikel ibiceri bigera 10 muri 1907, aluminiyumu Igiceri muri 1908 na cupro-nikel igiceri 5 muri 1913. Cupro-nikel yasimbuye aluminiyumu muri 1909.
Muri 1906, inoti (iya mbere yo muri 1905) yatangijwe na guverinoma ishinzwe kurinda Afurika y'Iburasirazuba mu nka 5, 10, 20, 40, 100 na 500. Muri 1920, Ikigo cy’ifaranga ry’iburasirazuba bwa Afurika cyasohoye inoti 1 mbere gato yuko ifaranga risimburwa.

Amashiringi ya Tanzaniya (mu magambo ahinnye: TSh cyangwa code TZS) ni ifaranga rya Tanzaniya. Ikaba Igabanijwemo amafaranga 100. Amashiringi ya Tanzaniya yasimbuye amashiringi yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba ku ya 14 Kamena 1966.
Ibiciro cyama shilingi ya Tanzaniya byanditswe muburyo bwa x/y, aho x ari amafaranga ari hejuru ya shilingi 1, mugihe y ari amafaranga. Ikimenyetso kingana na hyphen byerekana umubare wa zero. urugero amafaranga 50 yanditswe angana na shilingi 100. Rimwe na rimwe, impine ya mashilingi ni TSh ishyirwa imbere kugirango bitandukane. Niba umubare wanditse ukoresheje amagambo kimwe numubare, gusa (urugero bandika TSh 10 miliyoni).
Iki gishushanyo cyagereranijwe kuri siterilingi, aho amafaranga yanditswe muburyo bumwe bwa amapawundi (£), amashilingi (s), na amapence (d). Muri iyo nyandiko, amafaranga ari munsi yama pawundi yanditswe gusa muri shilingi na pence.
Muri 1966, ibiceri byatangijwe bi menyekana nka -/, -/, -/ na -/ na 1/, hamwe na -/ biri mu muringa, -/ muri nikel-umuringa (umuringa-nikel -zinke) hamwe na - / 50 na 1 / = muri kupro-nikel. Igikombe-nikel 5/ ibiceri byatangijwe muri 1972, bikurikirwa na nikel-y'umuringa -/ muri 1977. Ibi biceri byambere byashyizweho, bikwirakwizwa kuva muri 1966 kugeza muri 1984, ibyo byose byakozwe na Christopher Ironside OBE.
Muri 1987, icyuma gikozwe muri nikel cyasimbuye igikombe-nikel muri -/ na 1/, maze hashyirwaho igikombe-nikel 5/ na 10/ iyi biceri, bifite 5/ dekagonale. Muri 1990, hashyizweho nikel yambaye ibyuma 5/, 10/ na 20/, hakurikiraho ibiceri bikozwe mu muringa 100/ muri 1993, 50/ muri 1996 na misiri-nikel-zinc 200/ muri 1998.
Ibiceri bikunze kuzenguruka ni 50/, 100/, 200/, na 500/. Igiceri 500/ cyatanzwe ku ya 8 Nzeri 2014.
Ku ya 14 Kamena 1966, Benki Ya Tanzaniya (Banki ya Tanzaniya) yazanye inoti ya 5/, 10/, 20/ na 100/. Inoti 5/ yasimbuwe nigiceri mu 1972. Inoti 50/ zatangijwe mu 1985, zikurikirwa na 200/ muri 1986, 500/ muri 1989 na 1,000/ muri 1990. Inoti 10/, 20/, 50/ na 100/ zasimbuwe n'ibiceri mu 1987, 1990, 1996 na 1994. 5,000/ na 10,000/ inoti zatangijwe mu 1995, zikurikirwa na 2000 / = muri 2003. Urukurikirane rushya rw'inoti rwasohotse muri 2011. Izi nyandiko nshya zirimo ibintu byinshi byumutekano birinda impimbano.

Ubukerarugendo muri Djibouti ni bumwe mu nzego z’ubukungu zigenda ziyongera mu gihugu ndetse ni inganda zitanga abantu bagera ku 53,000 na 73,000 ku mwaka, hamwe n’inyanja n’ikirere cyiza ndetse hakaba harimo n'ibirwa n’inyanja mu kigobe cya Tadjoura na Bab al-Mandab. Ibikorwa nyamukuru by'ubukerarugendo harimo ni umukino wo kwibira mu mazi, kuroba, gutembera urugendo rw'amaguru ahantu kure no gutembera muzamuka imisozi, kuvumbura inzira y'imuka, kureba inyoni, n'izuba, inyanja n'umucanga.
I Goubbet-al-Kharab, hafi y’impera y’iburengerazuba y’ikigobe cya Tadjoura, hari imisozi ihanamye hamwe n'inyanja yahindutse icyatsi kibisi ndetse na lava yirabura. Umubare w'ibirunga bikora biherereye imbere mu gihugu kuva hano. Ikindi gikurura ba mukerarugendo ni Parike y’umunsi y’amashyamba yo kubungabunga ibiti bidasanzwe ku musozi wa Goda. Hafi y'umujyi wa Ali Sabieh hari imisozi itukura izwi cyane na parike y'igihugu yuzuye gazel nyinshi. Ibibaya byo ku nkombe, imisozi miremire, n'ibibaya by'ibirunga byo mu gihugu bikora bigaragaza ahantu neza. Bimwe mu bikurura ahantu nyaburanga harimo Ingoro ya Perezida, Isoko ryo hagati, Ibirwa bya Maskali, Ikirwa cya Moucha, Ikiyaga cya Abbe n'Ikiyaga cya Assal. Inkombe za Djibouti zifite inkombe nyinshi z'inyanja zikunze gukaraba izuba hamwe n'abandi bashyitsi.
Guverinoma ya Djiboutian, imaze kubona ubushobozi bw'iterambere mu ubukerarugendo bw’igihugu, yafashe ingamba zitandukanye kuribyo urugero, uburyo ntarengwa bworohereza ishoramari ry’amahanga mu bikorwa remezo by’ubukerarugendo. Batanze uburenganzi ku bubaka amahoteri no ku bubaka imihanda yujuje ubuziranenge mpuzamahanga.
Inganda z’ubukerarugendo muri Djibouti zigengwa na Minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’ubukerarugendo. Umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe ubukerarugendo (UNWTO) uvuga ko buri mwaka ba mukerarugendo basura iki gihugu batazwi. Icyakora, ubukerarugendo mpuzamahanga bwinjije miliyoni 21 z'amadorari mu mwaka wa 2012.
Nk’uko imibare y'Ibiro by'igihugu bishinzwe ubukerarugendo muri Djibouti (ONTD) ibigaragaza, hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’abashyitsi, cyangwa 48%, baturutse mu Bufaransa, 21% bakaba baraturutse mu bindi bihugu by’Uburayi. Itsinda rya gatatu rinini ryaturutse mu bihugu byegereye inkombe. Abashyitsi baturutse muri Afurika bangana na 6% gusa, benshi muribo bakomoka muri Etiyopiya. Hanyuma, abashyitsi baturutse muri Aziya no muri Amerika ya ruguru bangana n'ijanisha rito riri kuri 5% na 3%.
Djibouti ifite ibyiza nyaburanga byinshi bikurura abantu, bigizwe n’ahantu h'amateka, Parike y’igihugu, inyanja n’imisozi.
Umunsi wa Pariki y'igihugu y'ishyamba.
Umunsi wa Pariki y'igihugu y'ishyamba washyizweho mu mwaka wi 1939, urinda imisozi ya Goda. kandi nk'ishyamba rinini muri Djibouti.
Djibouti ifite resitora nyinshi zizwi zitanga ibiryo gakondo kuri ba mukerarugendo.

Ubukerarugendo muri Eritereya bwari bugizwe na 2% by'ubukungu bwa Eritereya mu mwaka wa 1997. Nyuma y'umwaka wa 1998, amafaranga yavuye mu bukerarugendo yagabanutse ku kigero cya kimwe cya kane mu mwaka wa 1997. Mu mwaka wa 2006 yari munsi ya 1% by'umusaruro rusange w'igihugu. Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku bukerarugendo ryabaze ko amafaranga yinjira mu bukerarugendo mpuzamahanga mu gihugu mu mwaka wa 2002 yari miliyoni 73 z'amadolari y'Amerika. Amakuru aturuka mu mwaka wa 2015 avuga ko ba mukerarugendo nyamukuru ari abanya Eritereya baba mu bihugu byamahanga. Hariho kandi abubatsi bake bafite amatsiko basura igihugu. Icyakora, sosiyete y'indege ya Eritereya yitwa, ntiyemerewe gutwara indege mpuzamahanga kubera guhungabanya umutekano kimwe n’ibihano byatumye abashyitsi mpuzamahanga bashingira ku ndege nka Ethiopian Airlines na Turkish Airlines kugira ngo bagere muri iki gihugu.
Guverinoma yatangije gahunda y’imyaka makumyabiri yo guteza imbere inganda z’ubukerarugendo mu gihugu. Icyakora, iterambere ry’ubukerarugendo ribangamiwe n’amapfa, igitugu cya politiki, ndetse n’intambara.

muri Africa muri rusange ikoranabuhanga riri muri bimwe birimo kwitabwaho kuko ikoranabuhanga
ni kimwe mu byihuisha iterambere haba kugihugu ubwacyo cyanga ku baturage bagituye
Inama ya Transform Africa ihuriza hamwe nibura abageraa ku bihumbi bibiri (2000) ikaba kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye ku mugabane w'Afurika gihuza abayobozi mu rwego rw’Isi n’akarere, baba abaturutse muri za guverinoma, imiryango mpuzamahanga, abakora ubucuruzi bigira hamwe uko abaturage bagendana n’impinduka zizanwa n’ikoranabuhanga no kuriteza Imbere.
Kugeza ubu abarenga 15000 bamaze kwitabira Transform Africa kuva 2013 yatangira, baturutse mu bihugu birenga 1122 bose barajwe inshinga no kugira Afurika igicumbi cy’ikoranabuhanga.
iyi nama ifite intego yo guhindura ikoranabuhanga ishingiro ry'iterambere n'imibereho myiza,
kugeza abantu ku ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga cyane cyane hakoreshejwe umuyoboro mugari w'itumanaho (broadband), gushyira imbere urwego rw’abikorera mu ikoranabuhanga, no kubakira iterambere rirambye ku ikoranabuhanga.
Ingamba nshya za Transform Africa 2023.
iyi nama kuri ino ncuro izibanda kungingo nyamukuru zijyanye no kureba umuhate ibihugu bya Africa mu kwihutisha
gahunda yo kwimakaza ikoranabuhanga, umwaka wa 2023 ni umwaka wo kugaragazamo ko Africa agize impinduka
mubijyanye no gukoresha ikoranabuhanga,Izasuzumirwamo politiki n’ingamba z’ibihugu bya Afurika mu bijyanye n’ikoreshwa rya internet mu bindi bikoresho (Internet of Things: IoT) guteza imbere ubwenge bw’ubukorano (AI) no kwimakaza ikoreshwa rya za drones n’izindi robots mu mirimo itandukanye.
iyi nama kandi izigirwamo uburyo ibihugu by'Africa byateza imbere gahunda zo gutanga service z'imari hifashishijwe
Ikoranabuhanga, guha imbaraga ubwikorezi bwibanda ku ngufu zitangiza ibidukikije n’izindi serivisi zishyira ku ntego yo kugira Afurika isoko rimwe mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga bitarenze mu 2030.
Transform Africa mu Rwanda.
mu mwaka wa 2019 iyi nama igamije iterambere ry'africa binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga yabereye mu Rwanda aho ari nabwo hagaragayemo kunshuro yambere Robot ya Sophia igeze mu Rwanda aho agaragaje udushya twinci dutandukanyye nko kumwenyura, kwitegereza ikamenya abantu, nibindi.
Imbogamizi ku ikoranabuhanga muri Africa.
Inama yiga ku guteza ikoranabuhanga imbere muri Africa agaragaje ko hakiri imbogamizi zitari nkeya bagaragaje ko
hari ibihugu byateye imbere muri Africa ariko hakaba hari nibindi bikiri inyyuma, aho bavugako hari nkibikorwa bikiddindiye nko guhererekenya amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga kuko bihenze cyane,bahamagarira ibihugu by'Africa mu kwigiranaho no gufatanya mugushyiraho Politike zifasha kwihutisha ikoranabuhanga rifite akamaro kanini muguhererekanyya amafaranga na kimwe mubyakoroshya ubucuruzi muri Africa

Café Riche ni resitora iherereye mu gihugu cya Misiri, yafunguwe mu mwaka wa 1908 ku muhanda wa 17 wa Talaat Harb, ni kimwe mu bimenyetso by'umwimerere bizwi cyane mu mujyi wa Cairo. Mu bihe bitandukanye yari izwi nk'ahantu hateranira abanyabwenge n’impinduramatwara mu makoraniro atandukanye, Iyii resitora ni igihamya cyane ko yiboneye ibintu byinshi byabayeho mu mateka mu gihe cy'ikinyejana cya 20. Bivugwa ko muri iyi resitora ariho Umwami Farouk yabonye umugore we wa kabiri, Nariman Sadek ; aho uwakoze icyaha cyo kugerageza kwica minisitiri w’intebe wa nyuma wa Misiri, Youssef Wahba Pacha niho yari ari ategereje igipimo cye; kandi muri iyi resitora niho hantu abantu benshi bari bagize imyigaragambyo cyangwa impinduramatwara muri icho gihe cya "revolisiyo yo mu 1919" bahuriye munsi kugirango bategure ibikorwa byabo babonereho no gucapa ibyapa byabo. Ababitabiriye barimo umwanditsi w'ibitabo bya politiki witwa Naguib Mahfouz ndetse n'uwabaye perezida w'icyo gihe Gamal Abdel Nasser.
Café ifite inkomoko mu mwaka wa 1908, ariko ntiyitwaga Café Riche kugeza igihe yaguzwe mu 1914 ikagurwa n’umufaransa witwa Henry Recine. Nyuma gato yo guhabwa izina café nibwo, Recine yayigurishije na Michael Nicoapolits ukomoka mu gihugu cy'ubugereki maze asubira mu Bufaransa. Nicoapolits yongeyeho umwanya wo gukiniramo ikinamico muri café, azana abahanzi nka Monira il-Mahdiyya na Umm Kulthum. Ku ya 4 Ugushyingo 1942, Nicoapolits yagurishije iyi resitora umugabo witwa George Basile Avayianos, wibanze cyane ku kwagura iyi resitora ikava ku rwego rwa café. Mu mwaka wa 1962, Avayianos yahaye iyi café Abdel Malek Michael Salib, wanabaye Umunyamisiri kavukire wa mbere utunze kafe. Iyi mpinduka mu ihererekanya ry’imitungo ryaranze impinduka nanone mu rwego rw'igihugu, kubera ko Abanyamisiri bari batangiye kwigarurira ubukungu bw’igihugu cyabo babukuye ku banyamahanga bakomeye bahoze bagenzura imishinga myinshi yari iteye imbere mu gihugu cyabo
Ibintu by'ingenzi byahabereye.
Abakundaga kujya muri café ahanini bari bafite imibereho myiza kubyerekeranye n'ubukungu. Kugeza ku gihe cy'intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, abakiriya benshi bakiraga bari abanyamahanga baba muri icyo gihugu cya Misiri. Nkuko uburenganzira bugena nyirubwite kumutungo bwahindutse bukegurirwa abanyamisiri kavukire, ni nako byagenze ku bakiriya nabo batangiyekwisanga mu bikorwa bikorerwa mu gihugu cyabo. Cairo habaye iwabo w'inzu z'ibinyamakuru byinshi, ibinyamakuru byandika, n'ibiro by'amategeko ibi byafashije mu kubaka abakiriya mu buryo burambye bagana iyi café. Kuba yari iherereye hafi ya Soliman-Pasha Square (Talaat Harb Square ya none) na Tahrir Square byatumye café iba ahantu heza ho guhurira. Abaharanira impinduramatwara bakundaga guhurira kuri iyi café kugirango bategure ingamba mu gihe cya revolisiyo yo mu mwaka wa 1919 barwanya ubutegetsi bwabongereza bwagenzuraga Misiri. Café niho habereye umugambi wo kwica Minisitiri w’intebe wa Misiri ku ya 19 Ukuboza 1919. Gamal Abdel Nasser yari azwiho kujya muri café mu gihe yateganyaga guhirika Umwami Farouk 1952.
Naguib Mahfouz yari umwe mu banyabwenge bazwi cyane kukuba barakunze kujya baza muri iyi café inshuro nyinshi, ku buryo bizwiko Malak yafungaga iyi café ku munsi wo kuwa gatanu kugira ngo ahe Mahfouz ahantu ho guteranira mu makoraniro ye. Umwanditsi w'ibitabo bya politiki ndetse avuga iyi café inshuro nyinshi mu bitabo bye.
Café Riche yafunzwe hafi imyaka icumi mu myaka ya za 1990. Urubanza rwaciwe na leta ya Misiri rwagiriza iyi café ku byerekeye no kuba yari yarigaruriye inzira rusange nyabagendwa iyo café yari irimo, bituma ifungwa by'agateganyo. Umutingito wo mu Kwakira mu mwaka wa 1992 wangije byinshi kandi ibi byatumye iyi café ihura n'imbogamizi mu gihe yari iri kurwana no kwiyubaka. Igabanuka ry'urwego rwo kwamamara kwaranze iyi café byatewe no kuzamuka kw'itangazamakuru rikoresha ikoranabuhanga. Ahantu hari hasanzwe hateranirwa bisanzwe nko muri za cafés byafashe umwanya w'inyuma aho abantu benshi bayobotse amakoraniro yo ku mbuga za interineti hamwe n'amatsinda atandukanye ya murandasi. Café Riche yari ahantu hihuriro ry’amatsinda manini y’ubuvanganzo n’ubwenge bakundaga guhurira, ariko kandi nanone n’urubyiruko muri rusange rwarahahuriraga. Mu gihe hagaragaye umwaduko w'amaduka manini manini, ubucuruzi buciriritse ntibukiri hamwe mu hantu hateranira abakiri bato, nkuko byahoze. Nyamara, mu mpinduramatwara yo mu mwaka wa 2011 yabaye ubuhungiro ku bantu bari mu myigaragambyo myinshi yo muri uyu mujyi.

Amadolari ya Amerika (Afite ikimenyetso cya $ n'ikimenyetso cya USD, cyangwa US $ kugirango ayitandukanye n’andi mafranga y’amadolari; yitwa amadolari, amadolari y’Amerika, cyangwa amafaranga y’amadolari) ni ifaranga ryemewe muri leta zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'ibindi bihugu byinshi. Itegeko ry’ibiceri ryo muri 1792 ryinjije amadorari y’Amerika ugereranije n’idolari rya feza rya Esipanye, ayigabanyamo igiceri 100, kandi yemerera gucukura ibiceri bivugwa mu madorari n’amafaranga. Inoti zo muri Amerika zitangwa muburyo bwi Notes, zizwi cyane ku cyatsi kibisi bitewe ahanini n’ibara ryatsi.
Politiki y’ifaranga muri Amerika ikorwa na Federal Reserve System, ikora nka banki nkuru y’igihugu.
Amadolari y'Abanyamerika yabanje gusobanurwa muburyo bwa bimetalike ingano na garama 24.057 ikaba ari ifeza nziza cyangwa, kuva 1837, yari garama 1.505 ya zahabu nziza, cyangwa amadorali 20.67 kuri troy imwe. Itegeko rya Gold Standard ryo muri 1900 ryahujije amadorari na zahabu gusa. Kuva muri 1934, ihwanye na zahabu ryavuguruwe kugeza kuri madorali 35 kuri troy imwe. Kuva muri 1971, isano yose ya zahabu yavuyeho.
Kugeza ku ya 10 Gashyantare 2021, ifaranga ryakwirakwijwe hirya no hino ryageze kuri madorali y'Amerika 2.10, naho triyoni y'amadorali y'Amerika 2.05 yari muri Notes ya Banki nkuru y’igihugu (biliyoni z'amadorali y'Amerika 50 zisigaye zari mu biceri hamwe na Noteri zo muri Amerika zishaje).
Ingingo ya I, Igice 8 y'Itegeko Nshinga rya Amerika riteganya ko Kongere ifite imbaraga " amafaranga y'ibiceri." Amategeko ashyira mu bikorwa ubwo bubasha muri iki gihe yanditswe mu mutwe wa 31 w'igitabo cya Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, hakurikijwe ingingo ya 5112, igena impapuro zigomba gutangwaho amadorari y'Amerika. Ibi biceri byombi byagenwe mu gice nk 'isoko ryemewe mu kwishyura imyenda. Amadolari ya Sacagaweyya ni urugero rumwe rw'amadolari y'umuringa, bitandukanye na Silive y'Abanyamerika ari ifeza nziza. Igice cya 5112 giteganya kandi gucukura no gutanga ibindi biceri, bifite agaciro kuva ku ijana kugeza ku madolari 100. Ibindi biceri bisobanuwe neza mubiceri byamadorari y'Amerika.
Ingigo ya I, Agace ka 9 y’Itegeko Nshinga iteganya ko Itangazo risanzwe na Konti y’ibyinjira n’amafaranga yose ya Leta bizajya bitangazwa buri gihe, Umubare w'amafaranga avugwa mu"Amatangazo" kuri ubu agaragara mu madorari y'Abanyamerika, bityo amadolari y'Abanyamerika ashobora kuvugwa nk'igice cya konti ya Amerika. "Amadolari" ni rimwe mu magambo ya mbere yo mu gice cya 9, aho iryo jambo ryerekeza ku madorari ya Esipanye, cyangwa igiceri gifite agaciro ka munani ka Esipanye.
Muri 1792, Kongere y’Amerika yemeje itegeko ry’ibiceri, muri ryo Igice cya 9 cyemerera gukora ibiceri bitandukanye, harimo:: 248 gice cya 20 cy'iryo tegeko cyerekana amadorari y'Amerika nk'igice cy'ifaranga rya Amerika:: 250–1
Bitandukanye n’idolari rya Esipanye ryasya, Kongere y’umugabane n’Itegeko ry’ibiceri byateganije na sisitemu icumi y’ibice bigendana n’idolari rimwe, ku buryo bukurikira: urusyo, cyangwa igihumbi cy’idolari; ijana, cyangwa ijana ku ijana by'idolari; igiceri, cyangwa kimwe cya cumi cy'idolari; kagoma, cyangwa amadorari icumi. Akamaro k'ibi bice:
Esipanye peso cyangwa idorari byagabanijwe mu mateka umunani - bityo "ibice umunani". Abanyamerika nabo bize kubara mubice "bitari" icumi bya cente mbere yo muri 1857 mugihe "bits" yo muri Mexike yakunze gukura kuruta amafaranga yabanyamerika; mu byukuri iyi myitozo yarokotse muri New York Stock Exchange yaguzwe kugeza muri 2001.
Muri 1854, umunyamabanga wa Leta, James Guthrie, yasabye ko hashyirwaho ibiceri by' amadorali y'Amerika 100 bya 100, 50, na 25, byitwa "ubumwe", igice cy’ubumwe, n’ubumwe "bw’igihembwe", bityo bivuze ko ari ihuriro ry’Ubumwe = n'amadorali y'Amerika100. Ariko, nta biceri nk'ibi byigeze bigurishwa, kandi ibishushanyo mbonera by'amadorari 50 birahari.
Iyo muri iki gihe gitanzwe muburyo bwo kuzenguruka, amafaranga atarenze cyangwa angana n’idolari asohoka nkibiceri by’Amerika, mu gihe amadosiye arenze cyangwa angana n’idolari asohoka nka Notes ya Banki nkuru y’igihugu, yirengagije izo manza zidasanzwe:
Mu kinyejana cya 16, Count Hieronymus Schlick wo muri Bohemia yatangiye gucapa ibiceri bizwi ku izina rya "joachimstalers", byitiriwe Joachimstal, n'ikibaya cyacukurwamo ifeza., izina ry'ikibaya ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Joachim, aho thal cyangwa tal, bihuza ijambo ry'icyongereza dale, ni Ikidage cyitwa 'ikibaya.' "Joachimstaler" yaje kugabanywa kugeza ku "kidage cyo" mu kidage, ijambo ryaje kubona inzira mu ndimi nyinshi, harimo: "tolari" (Ceki, Slowakiya na Siloveniya); "daleri" (Danemarike na Suwede); (Noruveje); (Ikidage); "talari" (Umunyetiyopiya); "muremure" (Hongiriya); "tallero" (Umutaliyani);(Icyarabu); "n'amadorari" (Icyongereza).
Nubwo Abadage babaye abapayiniya muri New York ya none mu kinyejana cyo muri 17 gukoresha no kubara amafaranga mu madorari y’ifeza mu buryo bwa "reichsthalers" yo mu Budage n’Ubuholandi hamwe na "leeuwendaalders" yo mu Buholandi (amadolari y’intare), ni yo muri Esipanye y'Abanyamerika umunani hose. -igiceri nyacyo cyamenyekanye gusa "nk'idolari" kuva mu kinyejana cya 18.
Imvugo (S) yo kuvuga (cyane nka "cid" yo mu Bwongereza kuri ipawundi ni siterlingi) ikoreshwa kenshi yerekeza ku madorari y'ibihugu bitandukanye, harimo n'amadorari y'Amerika. Iri jambo, ryatangiye mu kinyejana cya 18, rishobora kuba ryarakomotse ku bucuruzi bw’uruhu rwabakoloni, cyangwa rishobora no guturuka ku ijambo rya pokeri.
Green back ni irindi zina, ryabanje gukoreshwa cyane cyane ku cyifuzo cyo gusaba mu kinyejana cya 19, cyacapishijwe umukara n'icyatsi inyuma, cyakozwe na Abraham Lincoln mu gutera inkunga Amajyaruguru mu ntambara y'abenegihugu. Iracyakoreshwa mu kwerekana amadorari y'Amerika (ariko ntabwo ikoreshwa ku madorari y'ibindi bihugu). Ijambo "green back" rikoreshwa kandi n’itangazamakuru ry’imari mu bindi bihugu, nka Ositaraliya, Nouvelle-Zélande, Afurika y'Epfo, n'Ubuhinde.
Amazina yihariye yihariye:
Ikimenyetso cy'idolari.
Ikimenyetso $, mubisanzwe cyanditswe mbere yu mubare, gikoreshwa ku madolari ya Amerika (kimwe nandi mafaranga menshi). iki kimenyetso cyari igisubizo cy'ubwihindurize bwikinyejana cya 18 cyubwihindurize bwanditse bwanditse kuri peso, izina risanzwe ryamadorari ya Esipanye ryakwirakwijwe cyane mu Isi Nshya kuva mu kinyejana cya 16 kugeza mu cya 19. P na s amaherezo yaje kwandikirwa hejuru atanga $.
Ikindi gisobanuro kizwi cyane ni uko gikomoka ku Nkingi za Hercules kuri Ikoti rya Esipanye y'idolari rya Esipanye. Izi Nkingi za Hercules ku biceri by'amadolari ya Espanye ifata ifaranga y'utubari tubiri duhagaritse (||) hamwe n'igitambara kizunguruka mu buryo bwa S.
Kugaragara nkifaranga ryabigenewe.
Itegeko Nshinga rya Amerika riteganya ko Congere ifite ububasha bwo "kuguza amafaranga ku nguzanyo z’Amerika." Congere yakoresheje ubwo bubasha yemerera Banki nkuru y’imari ya Leta gutanga Inyandiko za Banki nkuru y’igihugu. Izo nyandiko "ni inshingano za Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika" kandi "zizacungurwa mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko bisabwe mu ishami ry’imari ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika, mu mujyi wa Washington, Akarere ka Columbiya, cyangwa muri banki iyo ari yo yose". Inyandiko za Banki nkuru y’igihugu zashyizweho n’amategeko nk'isoko ryemewe " ryo kwishyura imyenda. Congere yemereye kandi gutanga andi moko arenga 10 y’inoti, harimo inoti ya Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika hamwe n’inoti ya Banki nkuru y’igihugu. Icyitonderwa cya Federal Reserve ni bwo bwoko bwonyine busigaye buzenguruka kuva mu myaka ya za 70 ku isi.
Inyandiko za Banki nkuru y’igihugu zacapiwe na Biro ishinzwe gushushanya no gucapa kandi bikozwe mu mpapuro za fibure (bitandukanye na fibure y'imbaho ikoreshwa mu gukora impapuro rusange). Inoti nini zatanzwe mbere yo muri 1928 zapimye, mu gihe inoti ntoya watangije muri uwo mwaka w'igipimo bigezweho. Ibipimo by'ifaranga rigezweho (rito-rito) by'Amerika birasa n'ubunini bw'inoti za peso mzo muri philippine, inoti zatanzwe ku buyobozi bwa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika nyuma yo muri 1903, byagaragaye ko zatsinze cyane. Amafagitire manini y'Abanyamerika yamenyekanye nka ibiringiti by'ifarashi cyangwa ibiringiti byo ku ndogobe.
Politiki y'ifaranga.
Itegeko rya Banki nkuru y’igihugu yashyizeho uburyo bwa Banki nkuru y’igihugu muri 1913 nka banki nkuru y’Amerika. Inshingano yacyo y'ibanze ni ugukora politiki y’ifaranga mu gihugu hagamijwe guteza imbere umurimo, ibiciro bihamye, hamwe n’inyungu ndende mu bukungu bw’Amerika. Ishinzwe kandi guteza imbere gahunda yimari ihamye no kugenzura ibigo byimari, no gukora inguzanyo yanyuma.
Iyo Banki nkuru yi gihugu iguze, itanga konti y'abaguzi (hamwe na Banki nkuru yigihugu). Aya mafranga ntabwo yimurwa mu mafaranga ayo ari yo yose - niho bigeze muri iki gihe Banki nkuru y’igihugu yashyizeho amafaranga mashya akomeye. Amabanki yu bucuruzi noneho ahitamo umubare wamafaranga yo kubitsa muri Banki nkuru yi gihugu n’amafaranga yo gufata nkifaranga ry'umubiri. Mu bwa nyuma, Banki nkuru y’igihugu ishyiraho itegeko ry’amafaranga yanditse mu ishami ry’imari ya Amerika. Ishami ry’imari, naryo ryohereza ibyo byifuzo muri Biro ishinzwe gushushanya no gucapa (gucapa amadolari mashya) hamwe na Biro y’Imari (gushyira kashe ku biceri).
Gukoresha mpuzamahanga nkifaranga ryabigenewe.
Muri 1979, Perezida Carter yashyizeho Paul Volcker Umuyobozi wa Banki nkuru y’igihugu. Banki nkuru y’igihugu yashimangiye itangwa ry’amafaranga kandi iki gihe ifaranga ryaragabanutse cyane mu myaka ya za 1980, bityo agaciro k’idolari ry’Amerika karagabanuka.
Hariho impaka zikomeje kwibazwa niba banki nkuru zigomba kwibasira ifaranga rya zero (bivuze agaciro gahoraho kumadolari ya Amerika mugihe) cyangwa ifaranga rito, rihamye (bivuze ko agaciro k’idolari gahoraho ariko gahoro, nkuko biri m'urubanza ubu). Nubwo bamwe mu bahanga mu by'ubukungu bashyigikiye politiki y’ifaranga rya zero bityo bikaba agaciro gahoraho ku madorari y’Amerika, abandi bavuga ko iyo politiki igabanya ubushobozi bwa banki nkuru yo kugenzura igipimo cy’inyungu no kuzamura ubukungu igihe byaba bibaye ngombwa.

Chop bar ni resitora itunganya ibiryo gakondo iherereye mu gihugu cya Gana ahanini iherereye mu gace k'amajyepfo y'igihugu. Muri gakondo yaba-pidgin bo muri Gana, Ijambo "Chop", rihabanye kure n'ubusobanuro busanzwe bivuga gukata, ahubwo barikoresha bashaka gusobanura kurya. Rishobora kandi kugira ikindi gisobanuro, ku bijyanye n'amafaranga, bishatse gusobanura gukoresha cyangwa gusesagura. Mu y'andi magambo, Chop bifite igisobanuro cyuko ari ahantu dushobora kurira �chop� [ni ukuvuga kurya]. Kandi rero uhereye kuri ibi byahindutse icyo ntekereza ko aha hantu ari ahantu nyaburanga hakomeye ku muco hakaba ingenzi cyane muri iki gihugu mu kubambatira umuco, kimwe nkuko utubari twa burger ari umwihariko w'Abanyamerika naho amaduka y'amafi na chip ari amaduka y'umwihariko w'Abongereza. Nijeriya niyo ifite inyama zizwi cyane zitwa �suya�, zuzuyemo ubunyobwa bwaho. Amafunguro agaburwa ari mu bikombe by'ibumba byaho kandi ibyo ibiryo nibyo bikunze kuribwa cyane muri ako gacecyangwa ibyo bibanza. Ahenshi muri utwo tubari haba habitsemo ibinyobwa bisindisha byengewe aho hamwe n’ibinyobwa bike by’amahanga bihari. Ni igishushanyo ndangamuco cya Gana, kandi gikundwa nabenegihugu.
Ijambo 'chop' rikomoka ku nshinga isobanura 'kurya' mu rurimi kavukire rwa pidjin yo muri Gana cyangwa bikagira igisobanuro cyo gukatwamo ibice mu gisobanuro gakondo. Utubari twa Chop ahanini tugurisha ibiryo kavukire bya Gana nka fufu, banku, konkonte, na omotuo (imiceri izinze) hamwe n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'isupu.

Ubukerarugendo muri Eswatini n'inganda zabuhiriye ziraguka. Benshi mu bakerarugendo basura Eswatini bahagera bakoresheje umuhanda uva muri Afurika y'Epfo. Inganda z’ubukerarugendo muri Eswatini zateye imbere mugihe cya apartheid (muri Afurika y'Epfo aho abirabura ndetse n'abantu bo mu yandi moko batari bafite uburenganzira bwa politiki n'ubukungu nk'abazungu ndetse bahatirwa kubaho mu buryo butandukanye nubw'abazungu.) muri Afrika yepfo kandi ibyo byagize uruhare runini mugukurura abamukerarugendo. Kuva ivanguramoko rirangira, Eswatini yashimangiye umuco gakondo nk'ubukerarugendo.
Mu igihe cy'ivanguramoko.
Iyemezwa ry'ivanguramoko muri Afurika y'Epfo ndetse n'intambara y'abenegihugu muri Mozambike byagize uruhare mu kwiyambaza Eswatini nk'ahantu hashobora kubera ubukerarugendo mu majyepfo y'Afurika. Ibi byatumye ubukerarugendo butera imbere muri Eswatini kuva mu myaka ya za 1960 kugeza 1990. Mugihe cya apartheid muri Afrika yepfo, Eswatini yakuruye abashyitsi benshi kubera gufata politiki zitandukanye kurusha Afrika yepfo. Ba mukerarugendo benshi basuye Eswatini muri kiriya gihe bari bafite uburyo bwo gukurikirana porogaramu za televiziyo cyangwa imikino ya siporo batashoboraga kubona muri Afurika y'Epfo. Mu gihe cy'ivanguramoko muri Afurika y'Epfo, Eswatini yemeye umukino w'urusimbi muburyo bwemewe bwo gukurura ba mukerarugendo ibyobituma ubukungu bwiyongera cyane.
Umubare wa ba mukerarugendo basuye Eswatini wavuye kuri 89,015 mu mwaka wa 1972 ugera kuri 257,997 mu mwaka wa 1989. Mu mwaka wa 1988 ubukerarugendo bwari 3 ku ijana by'Umusaruro rusange (GDP) bya Eswatini ndetse binjya hejuru ya 4 ku ijana ku ibyoherezwa mu mahanga. Nubwo ingofero gakondo ya Eswatini yakunze kuvugwa nkikintu gikurura ba mukerarugendo, ubukerarugendo nabwo bwashimiwe ko bwatumye muri Eswatini hatera imbere. Nubwo ubukerarugendo bugaragara ko bwiyongera muri Eswatini bivugwa ko ari byo byatumye uburaya bwiyongera, nubwo nta kimenyetso cyerekana ko uburaya bwagize uruhare mu kuzamura inganda z’ubukerarugendo muri Eswatini. Ubwiyongere bw'ubukerarugendo bwatumye mubuce bwaberagamo uburaya muri Eswatini buva mu bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro bujya mu ma hoteri.
Nyuma y’ivanguramoko.
Nyuma y’ivanguramoko muri Afurika yepfo no gusoza intambara y’abenegihugu ya Mozambike byatumye abaturanyi bayo bashimishwa n’ubukerarugendo, bituma ubwiyongere bw’inganda z’ubukerarugendo muri Eswatini bugabanuka.Benshi mu bakerarugendo basura Eswatini batembera hagati ya Mozambike na Afurika y'Epfo. Ba mukerarugendo benshi barara ijoro rimwe gusa kandi abashyitsi benshi bafata ingendo z'umunsi gusa mu gihugu.
Bitewe no kubura izindi nganda zikomeye, ubukerarugendo bubonwa na benshi muri Eswatini nk'isoko rishobora kuzamuka mu bukungu. Kuva yashingwa mu mwaka wa 2003, Ikigo cy’ubukerarugendo cya Eswatini cyashimangiye ko Eswatini ari ubwami bwa nyuma bwa Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara. Ibirori nk'umunsi mukuru w'ibwami wa Incwala ufatwa nkibibanza bishobora guteza imbere ubukerarugendo. Bagerageje kandi gukurura ba mukerarugendo muri parike yimikino ya Swaziland. Mu mwaka wa 2006 Eswatini yasinyanye amasezerano ya Route ya Lubombo hamwe na Afrika yepfo na Mozambike. Amasezerano yemereye ba mukerarugendo gutembera mu bihugu bitatu bafite visa imwe.

Ibigo by'ubucuruzi muri Africa.
Inama ngarukamwaka ihuje abayobozi b'ibigo bikomeye by'ubucurizi iriga uko Afurika yarushaho kuba isoko rimwe ku bayituye kandi igakuraho n'inzitizi zikibangamiye ubucuruzi bwayo.

Amashiringi (amagambo ahinnye ni USh cyangwa se UGX) nifaranga rya Uganda. Kugabanwa kumugaragaro kugeza k'umafaranga kugeza muri 2013, kubera amafaranga menshi i shilingi ubu ntiragabanuka.
Ibiciro muri shilingi ya Uganda byanditswe muburyo bwa x/y, aho x ari amafaranga muri shilingi, mugihe y ari amafaranga. Ikimenyetso kingana cyangwa hypheni byerekana umubare wa zero. Ku rugero, amafaranga 50 yanditswe nka " -/ " na shilingi 100 nka " 100/ " cyangwa "100 / -". Rimwe na rimwe, impfunyapfunyo "USh" ibanzirizwa gutandukanya. Niba umubare wanditse ukoresheje amagambo kimwe n'umubare, gusa iribazwa rikoreshwa (urugero miliyoni USh 10).
Iki gishushanyo cyagereranijwe kuri siterling aho amafaranga yanditswe muburyo bumwe bwa mapawundi (£), shilingi (s), na pence (d). Muri iyo nyandiko, amafaranga ari munsi ya mapawundi yanditswe gusa muri shilingi na pence.
Amashiringi ya mbere ya Uganda (UGS) yasimbuye amashiringi yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba muri 1966. Nyuma y’ifaranga ryinshi, i shilingi rinshya rya (UGX) yatangijwe muri 1987 ifite agaciro ka shilingi 100.
Ubusanzwe i shilingi ni ifaranga rihamye kandi ryiganje mubikorwa byinshi byimari muri Uganda, bifite isoko ryivunjisha ryiza cyane hamwe no gukwirakwizwa gake. Amadolari ya Amerika nayo aremewe cyane. Sterling no kwiyongera amayero nayo arakoreshwa.
Banki nkuru ya Uganda yagabanije igipimo cyayo cya 22% ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2012 nyuma yo kugabanuka kw'ifaranga mu mezi 3 yikurikiranya.
Muri 1966, ibiceri byatangijwe mu madini ya -/, -/, -/ na -/ na 1/ na 2/. Ibiceri -/, -/ na -/ byakubiswe mu muringa, hamwe n’amadini yo hejuru yakozwe muri cupro-nikel. Amashiringi 2 yatanzwe muri uwo mwaka gusa. Muri 1972, hasohotse ibiceri bya cupro-nikel, 5-shilingi ariko bivanwa mu kuzenguruka none ni gake cyane. Muri 1976, icyuma gikozwe mu muringa cyasimbuye umuringa muri 5- na 10-cent naho icyuma-nikel gikozwe mu cyuma cyasimbuye cupro-nikel muri 50-cent ku 1-shilingi. Muri 1986, hasohotse igiceri cya nikel-icyuma cya 50-cent na 1-shilingi, ibiceri by'anyuma bya shilingi ya mbere.
Amashiringi ya kabiri.
Muri 1987, hashyizweho ibiceri bikozwe mu muringa 1/ na 2/ hamwe n’ibyuma bitagira umuyonga 5/ na 10/ ibiceri, hamwe na 5/ na 10/ bigoramye-bingana na hepatagonale muri ubwo buryo. Muri 1998, hatangijwe ibiceri bya 50/, 100/, 200/ na 500/. Amadini azenguruka ubu ni 50/, 100/, 200/, 500/, na 1,000/.
Muri 1966, Banki nkuru ya Uganda yazanye inoti mu nkiya: 5/, 10/, 20/ na 100/. Muri 1973, inoti 50/ zatangijwe, zikurikirwa na 500/ na 1,000/ muri 1983 na 5,000/ muri 1985.
Amashiringi ya kabiri.
Muri 1987, inoti zatangijwe mu ifaranga rishya mu kuyerekana nka: ya 5/, 10/, 20/, 50/, 100/ na 200/. Muri 1991, hiyongereyeho inoti 500/ na 1,000/, zikurikirwa na 5,000/ muri 1993, 10,000/ mu 1995, 20,000/ muri 1999, 50,000/ muri hari 2003 na 2,000/ muri 2010. Inoti ziriho ubu ni 1.000 /, 2000 /, 5,000/, 10,000/, 20,000/ na 50,000/. Muri 2005, Banki nkuru ya Uganda yatekerezaga niba gusimbuza inoti zifite agaciro gake nka 1,000/ n'ibiceri. Inyandiko zo hasi zifata inkoni mu mikoreshereze ya buri munsi, akenshi iba yanduye cyane kandi wenda ikangirika.
Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 2010, Banki ya Uganda yasohoye umuryango mushya w'inoti zerekana igishushanyo mbonera kugirango cyerekana inoti zerekana umurage gakondo wa Uganda, amateka, kamere, n'umuco wabo. Bifite kandi umutekano unoze, hari Amashusho atanu agaragara ku note yose uko ari atandatu: imiterere ya mateli ya Uganda, agaseke ka Uganda, ikarita ya Uganda (yuzuye n'umurongo wa ekwateri), Urwibutso rw'Ubwigenge, hamwe n'umwirondoro w'umugabo wambaye igitambaro cya Karimojongo. Guverineri wa Banki ya Uganda, Emmanuel Tumusiime Mutebile, yavuze ko inoti nshya zitagize ivugurura ry'ifaranga, cyangwa ngo zitegekwa na politikimu Kuvugurura bundi bushya, byatewe no gukenera gukurikiza imikorere mpuzamahanga no gutsinda impimbano. Uganda nicyo gihugu cya mbere cya Afrika cyatangije uburyo bwumutekano bugezweho bwa SPARK kumurongo usanzwe w'inoti. SPARK ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurinda umutekano bwemewe na banki nkuru ku isi kandi bukoreshwa ku inoti nyinshi zo kurinda impimbano.

Igipimo cy'ivunjisha.
Kugeza ku ya 22 Kanama 2011, amadorari y'Amerika (USD) yari afite agaciro ka USh 2,800/. Igipimo cy'ivunjisha cyamanutse kuri USh2,901/ kugeza madorali y'amerika 1 muri Nzeri 2011, maze isubira muri USh 2,303/ kugeza madorali y'amerika 1 ku ya 13 Gashyantare 2012..

Amashiringi ya Kenya (amagambo ahinnye KSh cyangwa KES) ni ifaranga rya Kenya. byagabanijwemo amafaranga 100.
Ibiciro byama shilingi yo muri Kenya byanditswe muburyo bwa x/y, aho x ari amafaranga muri shilingi, mugihe y ari amafaranga. Ikimenyetso kingana cyangwa hyphen byerekana umubare wa zero. K'urugero, amafaranga 50 yanditswe nka " -/ " na shilingi 100 nka " 100/ " cyangwa "100 / -". Rimwe na rimwe, impine ni "KSh" ibanzirizwa no gutandukanya. Niba umubare wanditse ukoresheje amagambo kimwe nu mubare, gusa prefix irakoreshwa (urugero miliyoni 10 KSh).
Iki gishushanyo cyagereranijwe kuri sterling, aho amafaranga yanditswe muburyo bumwe bwa mapawundi (£), shilingi (s), na pence (d). Muri iyo nyandiko, amafaranga ari munsi ya mapawundi yanditswe gusa muri shilingi na pence.
Amashiringi yo muri Kenya yasimbuye amashiringi yo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba muri 1966.
Ibiceri bya mbere byatanzwe muri 1966 mu kumurika ya -/, -/, -/ na -/, na 1 / = na 2 / =; -/ Ibiceri ntabwo byacapwe nyuma yo muri 1969 (usibye muri seti ya 1973); 2 / = ibiceri byacuzwe bwa nyuma ni 1971 (usibye muri 1973). Muri 1973 na 1985, hatangijwe ibiceri 5 / =, bikurikirwa na 10 / = muri 1994 na 20 / = no muri 1998.
Hagati yo muri 1967 na 1978, ifoto ya Jomo Kenyatta, perezida wa mbere wa Kenya, yabanje kugaragara hejuru y’ibiceri byose byigenga bya Kenya. Muri 1980, ifoto ya Daniel arap Moi yasimbuye iya Kenyatta kugeza muri 2005, igihe banki nkuru ya kenya, yatangije ibiceri bishya byagaruye ishusho ya Kenyatta. Ibiceri ni -/ na 1 / = mu byuma bidafite ingese na bi-metalike ibiceri bya 5 / =, 10 / = na 20 / =. Igiceri cya metalike 40 / = igicapo cyerekana ifoto ya Perezida wahoze ari Perezida ariwe Mwai Kibaki cyatanzwe muri 2003 mu rwego rwo kwibuka isabukuru y'imyaka mirongo ine mu ubwigenge bwa Kenya muri 1963.
Ibiceri bishya bifite ishusho ya Kenyatta byatanzwe muri 2005. Mu mwaka wo muri 2010, ingingo ya 231 (4) y’Itegeko Nshinga rya Kenya ryo muri 2010 ryagize riti "Inyandiko n’ibiceri byatanzwe na Banki Nkuru ya Kenya bishobora kuba bifite amashusho agaragaza cyangwa agereranya Kenya cyangwa igice cya Kenya ariko ntashobora kwifotoza ku muntu uwo ari we wese." Inoti nshya n'ibiceri byari biteganijwe ko bisohoka muri 2018 kugira ngo byuzuze iri tegeko rishya. Urukurikirane rushya rw'ibiceri rwasohotse ku ya 11 Ukuboza 2018, mu kwigaragaza nka 1/, 5/, 10/ na 20/. Ibiceri byose byerekanaga Ikirango cy'igihugu cya Kenya ku ruhande no kumashusho y'inyamaswa zizwi muri Afurika k'uruhande. Uru rukurikirane rushya rw'ibiceri rwashizweho kugirango rumenyekane kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.
Ku ya 14 Nzeri 1966, ishilingi ryo muri Kenya yasimbuye amashiringi yo muri Afurika y'iburasirazuba ku buryo bungana, nubwo aya atigeze agaragazwa kugeza muri 1969. Banki Nkuru ya Kenya yatanze inoti mu kuyerekana ni 5 / =, 10 / =, 20 / =, 50 / = na 100 / =. Inyandiko zose zigaragaza ishusho ya minisitiri w’intebe wa mbere wa Kenya na perezida, Jomo Kenyatta, imbere n’ibikorwa bitandukanye by’ubukungu biri inyuma.
5 / = inoti zasimbuye ibiceri muri 1985, hamwe niko byagenze kuri 10 / = na 20 / = muri 1994 na 1998. Muri 1986, inoti 200 / = zatangijwe, zikurikirwa na 500 / = muri 1988 na 1.000 / = muri 1994.
Kimwe n'ibiceri, Kenyatta yagaragaye ku inoti yatanzwe kugeza muri 1978, ifoto ya Daniel arap Moi yamusimbuye muri 1980. Muri 2003, nyuma yuko Mwai Kibaki asimbuye Moi kuba perezida, inoti 5 / =, 10 / =, na 20 / = kuva mu rukurikirane rwo muri 1978 hamwe n’ifoto ya Kenyatta yari yabitswe yarasohotse, ikwirakwizwa hose. Urukurikirane rushya rw'inoti rwatangijwe kuri Kenyatta, yongeye kugaragara mu imurika ya 50 / =, 100 / =, 200 / =, 500 / = na 1.000 / =. Ikibazo cy'inoti ya 200 / = yo ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2003 cyibuka "imyaka 40 y'ubwigenge 1963–2003". Inoti zacapwe i Nairobi n'icapiro ry'umutekano rya De La Rue.
Ku ya 31 Gicurasi 2019, Banki Nkuru ya Kenya yasohoye umuryango mushya w'inoti udafite amashusho y'abantu bazwi bo muri Kenya, nk'uko biteganywa n'Itegeko Nshinga rya Kenya ryo mu 2010. Muri icyo gihe, Banki Nkuru ya Kenya yakuyeho impapuro zose zabanjirije inoti 1.000 / = inoti. Ibi byakomeje gutanga isoko kugeza ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2019. Inoti zose z'uruhererekane zisangiye igishushanyo rusange cy'ikigo mpuzamahanga cya Kenyatta mpuzamahanga ku mpande z'imbere, kandi uruhande rw'inyuma rw'inoti rugaragaza amashusho yerekana ubukire bw'abaturage na kamere ya Kenya: "Green Energy" (50 / =), "Ubuhinzi" (100 / =), "Serivisi ishinzwe imibereho myiza" (200 / =), "Ubukerarugendo" (500 / =) na "Imiyoborere" (1.000 / =). Amadini yose uko ari atanu kandi agaragaza buri nyamaswa nini eshanu zo muri Afurika: inyana (50 / =), ingwe (100 / =), imvubu (200 / =), intare (500 / =) n'inzovu (1.000 / =).
Igipimo cy'ivunjisha.
Igipimo cy’ivunjisha kiriho byoroshye kuboneka muri serivisi nkizo ziri mu mbonerahamwe ikurikira.

Ubukerarugendo muri Etiyopiya bwagize 5.5% by'umusaruro rusange w'igihugu (GDP) mu mwaka wa 2006, wiyongereyeho 2% ugereranije n'umwaka ushize. Guverinoma yerekana umuhigo yahize wo guteza imbere ubukerarugendo binyuze mu bikorwa byinshi. Ubukerarugendo ni kimwe mu bigize gahunda yo kugabanya ubukene bwa Etiyopiya (PRSP), igamije kurwanya ubukene no guteza imbere ubukungu.
Ahantu nyaburanga hashobora kuba harimo Icyegeranyo cya Etiyopiya cya parike yigihugu (harimo na Parike y’igihugu ya Semien), hamwe n’ahantu h’amateka, nko mu mijyi ya Axum, Lalibela na Gondar, umujyi wa Harar Jugol ukikijwe n'inkike, Umusigiti wa Negash, muri Negash na Sof Omar.
Iterambere mu myaka ya za 1960, ubukerarugendo bwaragabanutse cyane mu myaka ya za 1970 na 1980 munsi ya Derg.Isubiranamo ryatangiye mu myaka ya za 90, ariko iterambere ryabujijwe no kubura amahoteri akwiye ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa remezo, nubwo hagenda hagaragara iyubakwa ry’amahoteri mato mato, amahoteri yisumbuyeho na resitora, ndetse n’ingaruka z’amapfa n’ihungabana rya politiki.
Kimwe mu bintu bitera imbaraga n'ubwiyongera bw'ubucyerarugendo bw’ibidukikije, hamwe nubushobozi bukomeye bwo kwaguka muri Etiyopiya. Biteganijwe ko kugurisha ibicuruzwa byingendo bizakomeza kwiyongera, byerekana ko byiyongereyeho 7% muri mwaka wa 2006 kandi byari byarateganijwe ko mu mwaka wa 2007 biziyongeraho 5%. Igurishwa riterwa ahanini no kwagura inyungu mubikoresho by'ubucyerarugendo bw’ibidukikije, harimo ingendo zo kwidagadura, gukora ingendo zakure namaguru hamwe na safari ugenda winjiza amafaranga menshi mubakoresha ingendo.

Ubukerarugendo muri Gabon ntabwo bwateye imbere. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, ibyiza nyaburanga birimo inyanja, ibiyaga hamwe n’uburobyi bw’imbere mu gihugu, kugwa ku ruzi rwa Ogooué, n’imisozi ya Crystal. Ba mukerarugendo baza kandi baje kureba ibitaro bizwi byashinzwe na Dr. Albert Schweitzer i Lambaréné. Guhiga biremewe mu bice byihariye mu gihe cy'ukuboza kugeza Nzeri.
Kugeza uba, ubukerarugendo bwarirengagijwe, busimburwa no kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze nk'amavuta n'ibiti. Mu mwaka wa 2000, guverinoma ya Gabon yakoze ibishoboka byose ngo iteze imbere urwego rutezimbere ubukerarugendo buhebuje kandi bwiza, nk'urugendo rw’ibihuru cyangwa ingendo za safari. Ukwezi k'ukuboza gushize, impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bukerarugendo yatangijwe muri kaminuza ya Libreville. Gusa ikintu kibuza Gabon gutsinda ni ruswa. Igitabo cyitwa Guardian Book of Statistics cyerekana Gabon nka kimwe mu bihugu byangiritse ku isi.
Ku ya 4 Nzeri 2002, perezida wa Gabon, Omar Bongo, yatangaje ko igihugu cye kizashyira ku ruhande 10% by'ubutaka bwa gahunda ya parike y'igihugu. Mbere, ntabwo yari ifite gahunda ya parike yigihugu, ikorana na societe yo kubungabunga inyamanswa kubibazo byo kubungabunga ibidukikije. Kugeza ubu, sisitemu igizwe na mayiro kare 10,000 (kilometero 26,000), yarengewe na Costa Rica gusa ku ijanisha ry'ubutaka, nubwo kubwa nyuma ubuso bwo kubungabunga ari buto cyane. Izi pariki nshya zirimo gutegurwa hagamijwe kubungabunga ibidukikije, nkuburyo bwubukungu bwo gukoresha amashyamba ya Gabon. Uyu mushinga washimiwe na Dr. Steven Sanderson, perezida akaba n’umuyobozi mukuru w’umuryango w’ibungabunga ry’ibinyabuzima, nka kimwe mu bikorwa by’ubutwari mu myaka 20 ishize."
Parike 13 za Gabon ziva mu turere two ku nkombe z’inyanja, aho imvubu z'ikinira ku nkombe zidakorwaho, kugeza aho amashyamba atuwe n’ingagi za "naive".
Mu mwaka wa 2000, bari bafite ibyumba bya hoteri bigera ku 2,450. Muri uwo mwaka, ba mukerarugendo bagera ku 155,000 nibo bahageze, kandi amafaranga yinjiye aturutse mubakerarugendo agera kuri miliyoni 7 z'amadorari y'amanyamerika. Umwaka wabanjije, abanyamahanga 120,000 nibo bageze mu igihugu, aho 1% aribo bonyine baje mu bukerarugendo, kandi byari hagati ya kimwe na bitatu ku ijana bya GDP (Umusaruro rusange w’imbere mu Gihugu). Umushyitsi asabwa kugira pasiporo na viza, mugihe baturuka mubufaransa, Ubudage, cyangwa ibihugu byinshi bya Afrika. Bagomba kandi gutanga ibimenyetso byerekana urukingo rw'irwara yo mubwoko bw'ibicurani bwitwa (Yellow fever). Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika yavuze ko impuzandengo ya buri munsi yo kuguma mu murwa mukuru wa Gabon wa Libreville ari madolari 182 y'amanyamerika ku munsi guhera mu mwaka wa 2002, amafaranga yakoreshejwe ahandi mu gihugu akaba ari amadorari 70 y'amanyamerika ku munsi.

Ku ya 19 Werurwe 2022, indege za gisivili za Comorian zambuye icyemezo cy’umukoresha w’indege wa AB Aviation, gihagarika ibikorwa byose.
