Imboga, imbuto n’indabo zoherezwa mu mahanga mu cyumweru zingana na toni 410.2, zinjiza 676.057 y’amadolari.
Tumenye Imboga zoherezwa mu mahanga.
Imboga,imbuto n'indabo zoherezwa mu mahanga mu cyumweru zingana na toni 410.2, zinjiza angana na 676.057 y'amadolari, ni ukuvuga koi kilo kimwe cyagurwaga amadolari 1.6 mu bihugu bya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), Leta zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu, u Buholandi, u Bufaransa n’u Budage.Ibinyampeke n’ibinyamisogwe byagurishijwe mu mahanga byinjije 1.365.943$ naho ibinyabijumba byinjiza 81.854$. Ibindi bihingwa nka pulse byinjije 45.005$ mu gihe ibinyamavuta byinjije 30.690$. Imibare yatangajwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, NAEB, kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 29 Gicurasi 2023.
Icyo imibare igaragaza.
Mu mwaka wa 2021 imboga, imbuto n’indabo byoherejwe nabyo byarazamutse, kuko mu hoherejwe ibilo 351.895 byavuyemo $1.031.579 mu gihe cyabanje hoherejwe ibilo 271.329 byavuyemo $889.256, ingano y’ibyoherejwe n’inyungu yavuyemo byazamutse 29.6% na 16% nk’uko bikurikirana, ugereranyije n’icyumweru cyabanje. Ibihugu byoherejwemo cyane ni u Bubiligi, u Buholandi, Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, u Burusiya n’u Bwongereza.

Theo Baloyi ni rwiyemezamirimo wo muri Afurika yepfo, akaba yarashinze akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa kompanyi ya Bathu Shoes. Yatangije iyi kompanyi ye y'inkweto mu mwaka wa 2015, mbere akaba yarabaye umunyamabanga mukuru muri PwC i Dubai. Yagaragaye ku rutonde "rwa Forbes" 30 Abatarengeje imyaka 30 muri 2019. Muri 2021, yatsindiye igihembo cya GQ nk'umuyobozi w'ubucuruzi wumwaka.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Baloyi yavukiye kandi anakurira i Hammanskraal, Gauteng ari naho yamaze ubuzima bwe. Se, Solly Baloyi, yaretse akazi k'ubuforomo kugira ngo abe rwiyemezamirimo mu bijyanye n'umutungo utimukanwa kandi yapfuye mu 2014 Nyina, Tshidi Baloyi, akomoka mu bazulu. Afite mushiki we witwa Goitsimang Baloyi. Baloyi yize amashuri akiri muto mu ishuri ribanza rya Shalom, nyuma yiyandikisha mu mashuri yisumbuye. Mu 2009, Baloyi yimukiye i Johannesburg maze yiga ibaruramari rya BCom muri kaminuza ya Afurika y'Epfo.
Mbere yo kuva muri kaminuza ya Afurika y'Epfo, Baloyi yatangiye urugendo rwo kwihangira imirimo ashora mu kugurisha imibavu yo guhumuza umubiri inzu ku nzu. Baloyi yahise atoranyirizwa gukorera muri PwC Afrika yepfo muri gahunda yabo barangije amaherezo arenza urugero bituma isosiyete imuha akazi igihe cyose maze yimurirwa muri PwC Middle East i Dubai.
Muri 2015 Baloyi yashinze Bathu, isosiyete ikora inkweto. Isosiyete ifite kandi ikora amaduka arenga 30 muri Afrika yepfo no mukarere ka SADC. Yagizwe umwe mu bagize inama y’inama y’ubucuruzi y’ubucuruzi muri Afurika yepfo (SACSC) muri Nyakanga 2022
Baloyi atuye mu Ijisho rya Afurika, I Johannesburg.

Sisitemu yo gutwara abantu mu Rwanda yibanda cyane k'umuhanda. Imihanda ya kaburimbo iri hagati y'umurwa mukuru wa Kigali, n'indi mijyi minini yo mu gihugu. U Rwanda kandi ruhuza umuhanda n’ibindi bihugu byo mu biyaga bigari bya Afurika, binyuzwamo ibicuruzwa byinshi bitumizwa muri mahanga n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga.
Iki gihugu gifite ikibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cyiri i Kigali, gikorera mu gihugu kimwe ndetse no mu bihugu byinshi, kandi gifite ubwikorezi buke hagati y’imijyi y’i cyambu ku kiyaga cya Kivu. Muri iki gihe nta gari ya moshi ihari mu Rwanda.
Ishoramari ryinshi mu bikorwa remezo byo gutwara abantu ryakozwe na guverinoma kuva muri jenoside yo muri 1994, ifashijwe n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi, Ubushinwa, Ubuyapani n’abandi.
U Rwanda rufite i kilometero bigera ku bihumbi 12,000 y'imihanda, muri yo kilometero 1,000 y'akaburimbo. Ibisigaye ni umuhanda wa kaburimbo ufite ubuziranenge buratandukanye kuva ahantu hakeye hafite imiyoboro itwara amazi kugeza kumurongo, utaringaniye cyane unyura mu modoka ifite ibiziga bine.
Ibinyabiziga biri mu gihugu bigenda iburyo bwu muhanda. Icyakora, abanyamuryango batatu bakomeye bagize Umuryango w’Afurika y’iburasirazuba (EAC) u Rwanda rugize, harimo abaturanyi ba Tanzaniya na Uganda, batwara ibumoso. Birahendutse cyane gutumiza ibinyabiziga byagenewe gutwara ibumoso kuruta iburyo, bishoboka ko biterwa n’isoko rya kabiri ryaturutse mu Buhinde n’Ubuyapani bihendutse ugereranije n’Uburayi, bityo amamodoka menshi yatumijwe mu mahanga kugeza igihe leta yabujije kwinjiza mu mahanga 2005 kubera impungenge z'umutekano. Kubera itandukaniro ry’ibiciro by’imodoka, hamwe n’ubushobozi bwo kurushaho guhuza ubukungu n’ibindi bihugu bya EAC n’isoko rusange ry’ibihugu bya Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo, guverinoma yatekereje guhindura igihugu gutwara ibinyabiziga ibumoso.
Umuhanda wa kaburimbo.
Benshi mu mijyi minini yo mu gihugu ubu ihujwe n'umuhanda wa kaburimbo. Imiterere yiyi mihanda yari imaze igihe gito ikennye cyane, hamwe n’ibyobo byinshi n’imodoka akenshi bigenda ku nkombe z'umwanda kubera ko byafatwaga nk'ibyoroshye kurusha umuhanda ubwawo. Gahunda ya leta iherutse yo kuzamura no kuvugurura bivuze ko inzira nyinshi zikomeye ubu zimeze neza.
Imiyoboro minini yo mu mijyi ya Kigali, kimwe n’imihanda minini ya Ruhengeri, Kibuye, na Gisenyi ni inzira nyabagendwa ebyiri, ariko imihanda minini y’igihugu yose ni inzira imwe. Nta nzira nyabagendwa i Rwanda.
Inzira nyamukuru ni (reba ikarita yerekana umubare):
Hariho kandi umuhanda umwe usanzwe ari umuhanda wa kaburimbo utameze neza, ariko birashobora kuzamurwa vuba kugirango ube kaburimbo:
Hariho serivisi nyinshi zabatoza burimunsi kuva mu Rwanda kugera aho zerekeza mu biyaga bigari bya Afrika:
Byongeye kandi, serivisi z’imodoka zitwara abagenzi (reba hano hepfo) zerekeza Gisenyi na Cyangugu akenshi zambuka umupaka wa DRC kugira ngo zitware abagenzi i Goma na Bukavu.
Uburyo nyamukuru bwo gutwara abantu mu Rwanda ni bisi yihuta, yasimbuye tagisi y'imigabane kumihanda minini.
Sangira tagisi ikora hagati ya termini ebyiri (izwi nka parike ya tagisi), ariko uhagarare kenshi munzira yo gufata no guta abagenzi. Bazwi cyane nka "tagisi" cyangwa, mu mvugo, "twegerane", bisobanura ngo 'reka twicare hamwe' mu rurimi rwa Kinyarwanda (tagisi isanzwe yigenga ikoreshwa nk'umushahara "udasanzwe" cyangwa "tagisi").
Hafi kandi buri gihe bategereza kugeza byuzuye mbere yo kugenda, kandi barashobora no gutegereza umwanya muremure ahantu hamwe kumuhanda niba abantu badahagije bahari.
Ubusanzwe ibinyabiziga ni minibus ya Toyota ifitwe numuntu ku giti cye ukoresha umushoferi (Fr: "chauffeur") hamwe nuyobora (Fr: "convoyeur") kugirango akore kandi abungabunge imodoka umunsi ku munsi. Benshi bafite imirongo ine yintebe, buri imwe ikaba yicara abantu bakuru bane (impinja nabana batabaruwe nkuko biteganijwe ko bicara ku bibero byumuntu mukuru). Byongeye kandi, hari imyanya ibiri yabagenzi imbere, kuburyo imodoka ishobora gutwara abagenzi bagera kuri cumi n'umunani, usibye umushoferi nuyobora.
Kuyobora abashinzwe gufungura no gufunga umuryango munini unyerera no gukusanya amafaranga kubagenzi, kandi azahagarara mumwanya wumuryango niba imyanya yose yongeye kuba. Nta tike yatanzwe kuri ubu buryo bwa tagisi.
Igice kinini cyimodoka kumihanda yo mu Rwanda, cyane Kigali, ni tagisi ya moto. Moto cyangwa ibimoteri biratwarwa kandi umugenzi umwe arashobora guhagarara inyuma no kwishyura hanyuma akishyura amafaranga asabwa.
Ibi biruka mugihe cyagenwe (mubisanzwe buri minota 30) hagati yimijyi minini, gusa guhagarara ahagarara hafi yicyerekezo. Nubwo byagenda mbere, igiciro gikurikira gihagarara kigomba kwishyurwa. Inzira hafi ya zose zinyura Nyabugogo muri Kigali.
Bisi ziyobowe na masosiyete yigenga kandi zitanga amatike mbere ni giciro cyashyizweho na leta. Nkuko amatike yishyuwe kandi agacapirwa ku biro (guhagarara gukomeye) cyangwa numukozi kumuhanda (guhagarara gato), ntabwo hakenewe umuyobozi uyobora amafaranga muri bisi. Amatike arashobora gutangwa mbere, bityo arashobora kugurishwa vuba mugihe cyakazi (cyane kuwa gatanu, ku cyumweru no gutangira ndetse kurangiza hamwe n'ibiruhuko by'ishuri).
Bitandukanye na Tagisi yarusange, ubu buryo bwo gutwara bubaha, gahunda aho gutegereza kuzura. Na none, usanga hafi ya bose batuzuzwa ahubwo bagenda kare.
Ingano iva kuri Toyota Coaster kugeza kumodoka nini. Abagenzi benshi bayoborwa na Ritco, leta ifitemo uruhare. Niyo sosiyete yonyine ifite aho ihagarara mu gihugu hose, mu gihe abandi batwara imodoka bo bigenga, bagarukira mu turere tumwe na tumwe. Igihe yashingwa yasimbuye Onatracom, yari indi sosiyete rusange.
Kuva muri 2018, tagisi zasaranganya ziracyari uburyo nyamukuru bwo gutwara abantu mu turere twa kure, mugihe bisi za Express zikoreshwa aho zihari. Ibi biterwa ni giciro kingana kandi cyongerewe ihumure n'umuvuduko wa bisi ya Express.
Ubwikorezi rusange muri Kigali bufata uburyo bwo guhagarika tagisi yi migabane yavuzwe haruguru, ariko ikora cyane kubera ibisabwa byinshi. Mugihe ubusanzwe ubwenegihugu butamenyekanye, amatagisi muri Kigali ifite umurongo w'umuhondo uzenguruka ikinyabiziga, kikaba cyanditseho aho itangirira n’iherezo ryayo. Serivisi nyinshi zitangira cyangwa zirangirira haba mu mujyi rwagati cyangwa kuri Nyabugogo, bisi nkuru yu mujyi.
Ubushakashatsi buherutse gukorwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’amasosiyete atwara abantu i Kigali buduha imibare ikurikira: Hri amasosiyete 19 ya bisi akoresha bisi zigera ku 1633 zose zakozwe, moderi n'ubunini mu bice bitandukanye byu Rwanda. Mu mujyi wa Kigali hari bisi 622 zikora. Muri izi 622, 90,6% muri zo ni imodoka ntoya ya Toyota Hiace, ahanini irengeje imyaka 10, kandi myinshi ishaje cyane. Mu binyabiziga binini bitwara abagenzi bagera kuri 30 cyangwa se hari ibice 58 muri byo 34.4% n'imodoka nshya zifite kandi zikoreshwa na Kigali Bus Services Ltd
Ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere.
Ihuriro rikuru ry’indege muri iki gihugu ni ikibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, giherereye i Kanombe, mu nkengero zigera kuri kilometero 10, kuva mu mujyi wa Kigali. Ikibuga cy’indege gifite ingendo mpuzamahanga zerekeza i: Lagos, Brazzaville, Dubai, Nairobi, Entebbe, Addis Ababa, Bujumbura, Johannesburg, Amsterdam, Bruxelles na Doha kandi ni ikibuga kinini cy’indege zitwara igihugu RwandAir.
Muri iki gihe nta gari ya moshi ihari mu Rwanda.

Inzu Ndangamurage ya Mauritania, izwi kandi ku Nzu Ndangamurage ya Nouakchott, ni inzu ndangamurage y'igihugu i Nouakchott, muri Mauritania. Iherereye mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bwa Hotel Mercure Marhaba, mu burengerazuba bwa Hotel de Ville, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Parc Deydouh, no mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'umusigiti Ould Abas.
Inzu ndangamurage ifite ibyegeranyo by’ubucukuzi bw'amoko n'amoko. Irimo galeri ebyiri zerekana ibyegeranyo bya ibice byibisate by'ubutaka, imyambi, hamwe n'imyambarire yaho.
Inyubako ndangamurage.
Inzu Ndangamurage y’igihugu yubatswe mu nyubako y'amagorofa abiri yubatswe mu mwaka wa1972 n'Abashinwa. Iyi nyubako irimo kandi "Ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya siyansi cya Mauritania", "ikigo cyita ku nyandiko zandikishijwe intoki za Mauritania" n’isomero ry’igihugu cya Mauritania. Inzu ndangamurage igizwe n'ibyumba bibiri bihoraho byerekana imurikagurisha n'ibyumba by'imurikagurisha by'imukanwa.

Umuhanda wa Kagitumba - Kayonza - Rusumo ni umuhanda uri mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, uhuza ibigo by'ubucuruzi byo mu mijyi ya Kagitumba, ku mupaka na Uganda na Kayonza, icyicaro cy'akarere ka Kayonza mu Rwanda na Rusumo, ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya. Umuhanda uhuza Koridoro y'ubucuruzi y'Amajyaruguru muri Uganda na Koridoro y'ubucuruzi yo hagati muri Tanzaniya.
Umuhanda utangirira i Kagitumba k'umupaka mpuzamahanga na Uganda. Irakurikira icyerekezo rusange cyerekeza mu majyepfo, ikanyura Kayonza, ikarangirira i Rusumo, k'umupaka mpuzamahanga na Tanzaniya, intera yi kilometero 208. Umujyi wa Kayonza ni hafi yo hagati mu muhanda, uherereye kuri kilometero 123 mu majyepfo ya Kagitumba na kilometero 85 amajyaruguru ya Rusumo.
Mbere yo muri 2018 iyi koridoro yo gutwara abantu, yari mu Rwanda rwose, yagaragayeho amabuye mu byiciro bitandukanye byo gusenyuka. Hifashishijwe amafaranga yatanzwe na guverinoma yu Rwanda, hamwe n’inguzanyo n’impano zatanzwe n’abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere, umuhanda wagutse kandi utezwa imbere kugeza ku cyiciro cya kabiri cya bitumen, hamwe n’ibitugu, imiyoboro y’amazi n’amazi.
Muri 2018, kuzamura umuhanda ujya mucyiciro cya kabiri cya bitumen, hamwe na ruhurura, ibitugu n'inzira zitwara amazi. Umwaka wo muri 2018 urangiye, abagera kuri 75 ku ijana by'imirimo yarangiye, biteganijwe ko barangiza mu gihembwe cya kane cya 2019. Muri kiriya gihe, ibiciro byiterambere byavuzwe nka miliyoni 187.210.000 z'amapawundi (hafi miliyoni 212.000.000 z'amadolari y'amerika).
Kwagura umuhanda no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe inyungu zatewe inkunga n’inzego zikurikira (a) Guverinoma y’u Rwanda (b) Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere (c) Ikigega cy’ibikorwa Remezo cy’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi na (d) Ikigo cy’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga cy’Ubuyapani.

Umuyoboro w’ibikomoka kuri peteroli wa Kenya - Uganda - u Rwanda ni umuyoboro utwara ibikomoka kuri peteroli bitunganijwe kuva mu mujyi wa Mombasa ku cyambu cya Kenya kugera ku murwa mukuru w’iki gihugu wa Nairobi ugakomeza kugera mu mujyi wa Eldoret ku kibaya cya Rift. Hariho gahunda yo kwagura umuyoboro mu murwa mukuru wa Uganda, wa Kampala, ukomereza ku murwa mukuru w'u Rwanda, Kigali.
Uyu muyoboro ukomoka ku cyambu cya Mombasa cyo mu nyanja y'Abahinde ugenda ugana i Nairobi, ukomeza kuri Eldoret. Icyo gice cy'umuyoboro kirahari guhera muri Gicurasi 2014.
Hasabwe ko umuyoboro wagera i Kigali, mu Rwanda, unyuze i Kampala, muri Uganda. Inzira y'umuyoboro, nkuko byasabwe, ireshya na kilometero 1,800.
Kwagura umuyoboro bizahuza ahari Eldoret muri Kenya na Kampala muri Uganda, unyuze muri Malaba. Uyu muyoboro uzagera i Kigali mu Rwanda kandi birashoboka ko uzagera i Bujumbura, mu Burundi. Buri gihugu kizaba gifite inshingano zo guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo mu mbibi zacyo; icyakora, hazatoranywa "umujyanama w'ubucuruzi" kugirango habeho kugenzura ubuziranenge.
Ubushakashatsi bushoboka bwo kwagura umuyoboro wari Eldoret kugera Kampala bwahawe ikigo mpuzamahanga muri 1997. Ubushakashatsi bwarangiye muri 1998, raporo itangwa umwaka ukurikira. Ubushakashatsi bwatewe inkunga na Banki y’ishoramari y’i Burayi. Raporo yerekanye ko kubaka umuyoboro bishoboka. Inyigo ishoboka yo kwagura Kampala kugeza Kigali yahawe Umuryango w’Afurika y'Iburasirazuba muri Nzeri 2011, iterwa inkunga ingana na miliyoni 600,000 z'amadolari y'amerika na Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere. Guverinoma za Kenya, Uganda, n'u Rwanda zemeye ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi bwombi.
Amasezerano yo kubaka yatangijwe bwa mbere, muri 2007, Tamoil, isosiyete ifitwe na guverinoma ya Libiya. Ayo masezerano yateshejwe agaciro mu 2012 nyuma yuko sosiyete yananiwe gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga. Muri Mata 2014, ibigo cumi na bine byatanze amasoko yo kubaka umuyoboro uva muri Kenya ujya mu Rwanda. Biteganijwe ko imirimo yo kubaka izatangira muri 2014, hamwe n’amezi 32 yo kubaka. Komisiyo iteganijwe mu 2016.
Amafaranga yo kubaka.
Amafaranga yose yo kubaka igice cya Eldoret Kampala Kigali yuwo muyoboro agera kuri miliyari 5 z’amadolari y’Amerika. Mu Gushyingo 2014, Ishami mpuzamahanga ry’imari, ishami rya Banki y’isi, ryiyemeje gutanga miliyoni 600 z’amadolari y’Amerika mu iyubakwa ryi gice cya Eldoret Kampala.

Ibikorwa by'Ingufu za Gaze methani ni uruganda ruteganijwe gukuramo gaz metani no gutunganya Gaz mu Rwanda.
Uru ruganda ruherereye mu mazi y’ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu karere ka mazi yu Rwanda, hafi y’umujyi wa Gisenyi,mu bilometero 165, ku muhanda ujya mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda.
Ikiyaga cya Kivu kirimo gaze metani nyinshi na gaze karuboni, iyo ibyimbye hejuru, ikora ibicu byuburozi byica. Nyamara, iyo imyuka ikuweho ikanabikwa mu icupa, ikora amavuta yingenzi yo guteka asimbuza inkwi namakara, bityo bikabungabunga ibidukikije. Imishinga yabanjirije iyerekeje gaze kubyara amashanyarazi.
Muri Mutarama 2019, Inama y'Abaminisitiri y’u Rwanda yemereye akanama gashinzwe iterambere ry’u Rwanda kugirana amasezerano na Gasmeth Energy Limited, gukuramo gaze metani yo gukoresha mu nganda no mu nganda nk'amavuta yo guteka. Ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2019, hasinywe amasezerano, hagati y’ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’u Rwanda (RDB), mu Rwanda Mines, peteroli na gaze (RMB) na Gasmeth Energy Limited (GEL), biyemeza GEL kubaka ikigo ku kiyaga cya Kivu cyo kuvoma, gutunganya no guhagarika gaze metani ku isoko ryimbere mu gihugu no kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze. Uyu niwo mushinga wambere wingenzi mukarere ka Afrika yibiyaga bigari byo gukuramo gaze metani yo guteka, kurwego rw'inganda.
Ba nyir'iterambere umushinga ni Gasmeth Energy Limited, isosiyete yanditswe ku Rwanda, abanyamigabane bayo bakaba bigaragara mu mbonerahamwe ikurikira.
Kubaka no gutera inkunga.
Gasmeth yiyemeje kwandika gushora miliyoni 400 z'amadolari y'Amerika mu kubaka uruganda rwa gaze metani. Biteganijwe ko ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi by’uruganda rushya bizatangira muri Gashyantare 2021.

Ikibuga cy'indege cya Butare ni ikibuga cy'indege giherereye i Butare, mu Rwanda.
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Butare, giherereye mu mujyi wa Butare, mu Karere ka Huye, Intara y'Amajyepfo. Aho giherereye nko muri kilometero 80, mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bw'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, ikibuga kinini cy'abasivili mu gihugu. Imiterere y'ubumenyi bw'isi yikibuga cy'indege ni: 2 ° 35 '42.00 "S, 29 ° 44' 24.00" E (Ubunini: -2.59500; Uburebure: 29.74000).
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Butare ni ikibuga gito cya gisivili gikorera mu mujyi wa Butare. Ni kimwe mubibuga by'indege umunani (8) biyoborwa n'ubuyobozi bw'indege za gisivili. Ikibuga cy'indege cya Butare giherereye muri metero 1,768 hejuru y'inyanja. Ikibuga cy’indege gifite inzira imwe ya kaburimbo, ipima metero 860 mu burebure.

African Alliance Investment Bank (AAIB) ni "ikigo cya banki gishinzwe ishoramari" gikorera ku mugabane w'Afurika.
Icyicaro gikuru cy’iryo tsinda giherereye mu gace kitwa Melrose, mu mujyi wa Johannesburg, muri Afurika yepfo, ugereranyije kiri nko muri, mu majyaruguru y'umujyi rwagati. Igipimo ndangamerekezo kigaragaza icyicaro gikuru aho giherereye ni: 26 ° 07'47.0 "S, 28 ° 04'12.0" E (Ubunini: -26.129737; Uburebure: 28.070007).
Kuva muri Werurwe 2016, AAIB ikorera mu mashami atandukanye aho ifite amasoko mu bihugu bikurikira:
Muri buri soko iyi banki ikoreramo, haba hari ishami ryanditswe ryo muri icyo gihugu rikaba riba riyobowe n'umuyobozi mukuru utari umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa, komite nyobozi, komite ishinzwe ibyago, komite y'ubugenzuzi, umugenzuzi w'imbere mu kigo, komite ishinzwe imishahara, komite ishinzwe amasezerano na komite ngishwanama tekinike.

Gati Meddy ni umunyarwanda akaba ari rwiyemezamirimo watangije ubucuruzi ariko bw’ibikorwa ahanini byo muri Amerika noneho akabigemura mu Rwanda, abicishije mu isosiyete yashinze ikorera kuri murandasi.
Gati Meddy Ni umusore ukiri muto ufite imigambi mu kuzamura ubucuruzi bukorerwa kuri murandasi, mugufasha abakiri bato ndetse bashaka kwinjira mu bucuruzi bukoresheje ikoranabuhanga. Gati Meddy yize ibijyanye n’amashanyarazi.
Meddy Yatangiye ubu bucuruzi muri 2012 ahereye ku iduka rizwi ku Isi rya eBay na Amazon,yabanje gucuruza amadarubindi arinda izuba n’amasaha, avaho kurirwo rwego ahita atangiza iduka ryakoreraga ku rubuga rwe bwite yashinze rwitwa www.gatishop.com muri 2015.
Gati Shop yatangiriye ku Mugabane wa Amerika, ositraliya, u Burayi na Aziya nyuma yo muri 2017 afata umwanzuro wo gutangiza nanone Mall for Africa, isosiyete igemura ibicuruzwa biva muri Amerika abyohereza ababikeneye mu Rwanda. Gati ubu afite amaduka 180 yo muri Amerika ndetse Bwongereza bakora.

Mall for Africa ikompanyi cyangwa sosiyete igemura cyangwa izana ibicuruzwa biva muri Amerika hamwe n'Ubwongereza abyoherereza abakiriya mu Rwanda.
Mall for Arica Ubusanzwe yatangijwe na Gati Meddy uyu yize ibijyanye n’amashanyarazi muri KIST nyuma yagiye muri Amerika aho utuye, ubu aba muri Leta ya California ahamaze imyaka igera kuri irindwi. Mu Rwanda yahuguwe mu bijyanye n’amashanyarazi ndetse n’ubucuruzi bwo kuri murandasi [e-commerce]. Natangiye gucuruza kuri murandasi muri 2012 atangirira kuri eBay aho yacuruzaga amataratara n’amasaha muri 2013 atangirira gucuruza kuri Amazon ibintu bitandukanye, nyuma muri 2015 atangiza urubuga rwa www.gatishop.com uru rucururiza ku mugabane wa Amerika, ositaraliya, u Burayi na Aziya. Muri 2017 nibwo yatangije urubuga Mallforafrica.com mu Rwanda.
Mall for Arica ubu afite amaduka agera ku 180 yo muri Amerika n’u Bwongereza bafitanye amasezerano yo kugemura ibicuruzwa byabo nibindi babyohereza mu Rwanda. Ayo maduka yose ushobora kuyasanga ku rubuga rwacu rwa murandasi www.mallforafrica.com.
Mall for Arica yafunguye ibirobikuru mu Mujyi wa Kigali kuri Centenary House, aha afite abakozi babiri bakora bahoraho. kandi batanze akazi ku bantu bamamaza, ndetse bahaye akazi amaradiyo na bagemura ibintu byabo.”Ibicuruzwa bigemurwa biza mu Rwanda akabisakaza mu bihugu birimo Nigeriya, Kenya, Gana, na Dubayi.

Ikibuga cy'indege cya Gisenyi ni ikibuga cy'indege cyo mu Rwanda. Ifite ikibuga cy'indege cya IATA GYI (tutitiranya ikibuga cy'indege cya Texas y'Amajyaruguru hamwe na FAA iranga GYI).
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Gisenyi, giherereye mu Ntara y'Uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu Karere ka Rubavu, mu mujyi wa Gisenyi, ku mupaka mpuzamahanga na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Aha hantu hareshya na kilometero 94, mu kirere, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, kuri ubu, cyikaba aricyo kibuga kinini cy'abasivili mu gihugu. Imiterere y'ubumenyi bw'isi bwiki kibuga ni: 1 ° 40 '48.00 "S, 29 ° 15' 30.00" E (Ubunini: -1.680000; Uburebure: 29.258334).
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Gisenyi ni ikibuga cy'indege giciriritse gikorera mu mujyi wa Gisenyi n'umujyi bituranye wa Goma, hakurya y'umupaka wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Imijyi yombi ituranye nayo ikoresha i Kibuga cy'indege cya Goma, cyegereye cyane umupaka w'u Rwanda neza neza n'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Tijuana n'ikibuga cy'indege cya Brown Field gitandukanijwe na Amerika - Umupaka wa Mexico. Ikibuga cy'indege cya Gisenyi ni kimwe mu bibuga by'indege bya gisivili umunani (8) biyobowe n'ikigo gishinzwe indege za gisivili mu Rwanda. Ikibuga cy'indege cya Gisenyi giherereye ku butumburuke bwa metero 1,549 hejuru y'inyanja. Ikibuga cy’indege gifite umuhanda umwe wa asfalt upima metero 1,010 mu burebure na metero 23 mu bugari.
Sosiyete z'ubwikorezi bw'abantu n'ibintu z'indege hamwe nibyerekezo by'ingendo.
RwandAir, itwara igihugu, yakoraga serivisi eshatu buri cyumweru hagati y'ikibuga cy’indege cya Gisenyi n’ikibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali. Icyakora, guhera muri Kamena mu mwaka wa 2013 ntibongeye gukora.

Ikibuga cy'indege cya Nemba ni ikibuga cy'indege cyo mu Rwanda.
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Nemba giherereye mu Ntara y'Uburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu Karere ka Bugesera, mu mujyi wa Nemba, ku mupaka mpuzamahanga na Repubulika y'Uburundi. Aha hantu hareshya na kilometero 50, mu kirere, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, kuri ubu, ikikibuga nicyo kinini cy'abasivili mu gihugu.
Imiterere y'ubumenyi bw'isi bw'ikibuga cy'indege ni 2 ° 19 '48.00 "S, 30 ° 12' 0.00" E (Ubunini: -2.33000; Uburebure: 30.20000). Ikibuga cy'indege cya Nemba giherereye ku butumburuke bwa metero 1,495 hejuru y'inyanja. Iki kibuga cy’indege gifite umuhanda umwe udasakaye ufite metero 1,100 mu burebure.
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Nemba ni ikibuga gito giciriritse gikorera mu mujyi wa Nemba kikanafasha abaturage bahaturiye. Nikimwe mu bibuga by'indege umunani bya gisivili bigengwa n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo cy'indege za gisivili.

Ikibuga cy'indege cya Ruhengeri ni ikibuga cy'indege giherereye muri Ruhengeri, mu Rwanda.
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Ruhengeri giherereye mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda, mu Karere ka Musanze, mu mujyi wa Ruhengeri. Aha hantu hareshya na kilometero 227, mu kirere, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, kuri ubu, iki kibuga nicyo kinini cy'abasivili mu gihugu. Imiterere y'ubumenyi bw'isi bwiki kibuga ni: 1 ° 30 '0.00 "S, 29 ° 38' 1.00" E (Ubunini: -1.50000; Uburebure: 29.63361).
Ikibuga cy'indege cya Ruhengeri ni ikibuga cy'indege kiringaniye gifasha umujyi wa Ruhengeri ndetse n'abaturage bahaturiye. Ni kimwe mu bibuga by'indege umunani bya gisivili bigengwa n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo cy'indege za gisivili. Ikibuga cy'indege cya Ruhengeri giherereye ku butumburuke bwa metero 1,860 hejuru y'inyanja. Iki kibuga cy'indege gifite inzira imwe ya asfalt ipima metero 1,480 mu burebure.

Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR) ni umuryango wa leta mu igihugu cy'u Rwanda.
Yatangiye ari inzu ndangamurage y’amoko mu kwezi kwa Nzeri mu mwaka wa 1989, igizwe gusa n’ingoro ndangamurage y’u Rwanda i Butare, ariko ubu irimo:

Parike nkuru z'u Rwanda ni ahantu harinzwe n'amategeko hagamijwe kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima n'inyamaswa zo mu gasozi zo mu Rwanda. Igihugu gifite pariki z'igihugu enye: Pariki y'Igihugu y'Ibirunga, Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera, Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nyungwe na Pariki y'Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura.
Buri pariki irinda urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rwihariye: imisozi miremire y'ibirunga n'ingagi mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba, savane n'ibiyaga by'Akagera mu burasirazuba, n'amashyamba y'imisozi miremire ya Nyungwe na Gishwati-Mukura mu burengerazuba. Pariki zicungwa n'Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere mu Rwanda (RDB), rimwe na rimwe ku bufatanye n'umuryango African Parks.
Pariki y'Igihugu y'Ibirunga.
Pariki y'Igihugu y'Ibirunga iherereye mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, ku mupaka wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo n'Ubugande. Irinda igice cy'urunigi rw'ibirunga rwa Virunga, harimo ibirunga bitanu bitakiruka: Karisimbi (m 4 507, ari cyo kirekire), Bisoke (gifite ikiyaga mu rwobo rwacyo), Sabyinyo, Gahinga na Muhabura.
Yashinzwe mu 1925, ikaba imwe muri pariki za mbere zashinzwe muri Afurika. Mu 1929 yaraguwe ihinduka Pariki ya Albert, yari ifite kilometero kare zigera ku 8 090 mu Rwanda no muri Kongo y'Ababiligi; nyuma y'ubwigenge bwa Kongo (1960) n'ubw'u Rwanda (1962), igabanywamo ibice bibiri. Mu 1967, umushakashatsi w'Umunyamerika Dian Fossey yashinze ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi cya Karisoke hagati ya Karisimbi na Bisoke, agira uruhare runini mu kurinda ingagi.
Pariki izwi cyane ku isi kubera ingagi zo mu misozi ziri mu kaga ko kuzimira, ikaba ibamo kandi inkima n'amoko y'inyoni arenga 200. Umubare w'abasura ingagi ni ntarengwa kandi uruhushya rugurwa muri RDB.
Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera.
Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera iherereye mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'umupaka wa Tanzaniya. Igizwe na savane, amashyamba make, ibishanga n'ibiyaga bigera kuri cumi na bibiri, birimo ikiyaga cya Ihema. Yashinzwe mu 1934, ikaba ari cyo gishanga kinini kirinzwe muri Afurika yo hagati n'ubuhungiro bwa nyuma bw'inyamaswa zo muri savane mu Rwanda.
Ibamo inyamaswa zitandukanye zo muri Afurika nka twiga, inzovu, imbogo n'imparage, ndetse n'amoko y'inyoni agera kuri 500. Intare zahabaga zatsembwe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi na nyuma yayo, ariko zongeye kuhagezwa mu 2015; inkura z'umukara zigezwayo mu 2017 no mu 2019, naho inkura z'umweru zigezwayo guhera mu 2021. Kuva mu 2010, pariki icungwa ku bufatanye bwa RDB na African Parks.
Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nyungwe.
Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nyungwe iherereye mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu turere twa Rusizi, Nyamasheke, Nyamagabe na Nyaruguru. Ni ishyamba ry'imisozi miremire ririnzwe kuva mu 1933, ryagizwe pariki y'igihugu mu 2005.
Ibamo amoko 13 y'inkende arimo impundu, amoko y'inyoni 317 n'amoko y'ibimera 1 468. Itanga hafi 70% by'amazi y'u Rwanda. Ku wa 19 Nzeri 2023, yabaye ahantu ha mbere mu Rwanda hashyizwe ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Pariki y'Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura.
Pariki y'Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura iherereye mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, ku murongo ugabanya amazi y'ikibaya cya Kongo n'icya Nili. Yagizwe pariki y'igihugu mu 2015 hagamijwe guhagarika iyangirika ry'amashyamba ryatewe n'imiturire, ubucukuzi butemewe n'ubworozi.
Igizwe n'amashyamba abiri atandukanye: irya Gishwati (rinini) n'irya Mukura (rito), afite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 34 hatabariwemo agace kayakikije. Ibamo impundu zigera kuri 20, inkima, inkende ya L'Hoest n'amoko y'inyoni 232 muri Gishwati na 163 muri Mukura.

Adebimpe Oni ni we washinze D'Rose recycling, sosiyete irwanya abangiza ibidukikije izamura imyanda ikomeye nk'amapine ashaje, amacupa, plasitike mu bikoresho bitunganyirizwa mu nzu, ibiro, ibibuga by'imikino, sitidiyo.
Isosiyete ya Adebimpe Oni irashaka gukemura ikibazo cyatewe na toni za plastiki n'amapine birangirira mu nyanja buri mwaka bitera umwanda w'amazi kandi bigatuma ubuzima bw'inyanja bubaho.

Folorunsho Alakija (yavutse ku taliki ya 15 Nyakanga mu mwaka 1951) ni umuherwe wo muri Nigeriya umucuruzi akaba n'umugiraneza. Yisanga mu myambarire y'imideri, amavuta, imitungo itimukanwa n’inganda zicapa. Ni Umuyobozi uyobora Itsinda rya Rose wo mu itsinda rya Sharon rigizwe na Rose ya Sharon Prints &amp; Promotions Limited, Digital Reality Prints Limited hamwe na visi-perezida mukuru wa Famfa Oil Limited.
Alakija afite kandi imigabane myinshi muri sosiyete ishinzwe iterambere ry'umutungo wa DaySpring. Folorunsho Alakija yashyizwe ku rutonde na "Forbes" nk'umugore ukize cyane muri Nijeriya ufite umutungo wa miliyari imwe y'amadolari mu mwaka 2020. Kugeza mu mwaka 2015, Alakija yashyizwe ku rutonde rw’umugore wa kabiri ukomeye muri Afurika nyuma ya Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala n’umugore wa 87 ukomeye ku isi na "Forbes".
Ubuzima bwambere n'ubuzima bw'imyigire.
Alakija yavutse ku taliki ya 15 Nyakanga mu mwaka 1951 mu muryango wo mu rwego rwo hejuru ; ise yari Chief LA Ogbara wa Ikorodu, muri Leta ya Lagosi. Se yashakanye n'abagore 8 babyarana abana 52 naho nyina wa Folorunso niwe mugore wambere. Alakija yize amashuri y'incuke muri Ladies of Apostles, Lagosi kuva mu mwaka wa 1955 kugeza mu mwaka wa 1958. Ku myaka yiwe irindwi(7), Alakija yagiye mu Bwongereza gukomeza amashuri abanza mu ishuri rya Dinorben ry’abakobwa muri Hall ya Hafodunos i Llangernyw, muri Wales hagati yu mwaka wa 1959 nu mwaka wa 1963. Arangiza amashuri abanza mu mwaka wa 1963, Alakija yagiye kwiga amashuriye yisumbuye y’abayisilamu i Sagamu, muri Leta ya Ogun, muri Nijeriya. Nyuma yaho arinabwo yaje gusubira mu Bwongereza kwiga amasomo yiwe y’ubunyamabanga muri kaminuza nkuru ya Pitman, Londoni.
Alakija yatangiye umwuga we w’imyaka 12 mu mwaka 1974 ari umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa muri Sijuade Enterprises, Lagos, muri Nijeriya nyuma gato yo kurangiza amasomo y’ubunyamabanga muri kaminuza nkuru ya Pitman London. Yimukiye mu cyahoze ari Banki nkuru y’igihugu ya Chicago, nyuma yaje kuba FinBank ubu yaguzwe na FCMB (Banki ya mbere y’Urwibutso rwa City) nk'umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w'umuyobozi mukuru. Yabaye Umuyobozi mushya w’ishami rishinzwe ibibazo bya Banki mpuzamahanga y’abacuruzi bo muri Nijeriya (yahoze ari Banki nkuru y’igihugu ya Chicago), nyuma aza kuba umufasha w’ibiro mu ishami ry’imari.
Alakija yahise yiga ibijyanye no kwerekana imideli muri Koleji y'Abanyamerika i Londire no mu Ishuri Rikuru ry'imyambarire. Yatangije ikirango cyerekana imideli kizwi ku izina rya Supreme Stitches, nyuma yaje kwitwa The Rose Of Sharon House of Fashion mu 1996. Yabaye perezida n’umucungamutungo ubuzima bwe bwose bwishyirahamwe ryabashinzwe kwerekana imideli muri Nijeriya (FADAN).
Muri Gicurasi mu mwaka 1993, Alakija yasabye itangwa ry'uruhushya rwo gushakisha peteroli (OPL). Uruhushya rwo gushakisha peteroli kuri hegitari 617.000 - ubu rwitwa OPL 216 - rwahawe isosiyete ya Alakija, Famfa Limited. Ihuriro rifite mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bwa Lagos na nkombe za Nijeriya mu murima wa Agbami wo muri Delta yo hagati ya Nigeriya. Muri Nzeri mu mwaka 1996, Alakija yagiranye amasezerano n’umushinga uhuriweho na Star Deep Water Petroleum Limited (ishami rya Texaco rifite imigabane yose) yohereza imigabane 40% muri Star Deep.
Nyuma yo gukugomera peteroli, guverinoma ya Nigeriya yasabye imigabane 40%, ikurikirwa n’inyongera 10%. Guverinoma yavuze ko niba Alakija n'umuryango wemerewe gukomeza umuryango wabo, bahagararaga binjiza miliyoni 10 ku munsi. Alakija yavuguruje iki kirego aratsinda.
Uburyo yaje Kumenyekana.
Kugeza mu mwaka 2014, Alakija yashyizwe ku rutonde rw’umugore wa 96 ukomeye ku isi na "Forbes". Muri Gicurasi 2015, abagore babiri bo muri Nijeriya, Minisitiri w’imari Ngozi okonjo-Iweala na Alakija bashyizwe ku rutonde rw’abagore 100 bakomeye ku isi nk'uko "Forbes" ibitangaza. Yari ku mwanya wa 86 kuri urwo rutonde.
Alakija ni umwe muri 20 mu mwaka wa 2020 Urutonde rwabaherwe bo muri Afurika rwahagaritswe muri 2021, mu mwaka wa 1941 Umuherwe wo mu mwaka 2019 Yahagaritswe muri 2020 naho # 80 Abagore bafite ingufu 2016 bahagarikwa muri 2017.
Ku taliki ya 17 Nyakanga mu mwaka 2021, kaminuza ya Benson Idahosa iniveresite, yomu mujyi wa Benin yamuhaye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'icyubahiro mu buyobozi bw'ubucuruzi. Ibi byari mu rwego rwo gushimira uruhare rwe mu bucuruzi.
Ibikorwa by'ubugiraneza.
Alakija yashinze Rose of Sharon Foundation ifasha abapfakazi nimpfubyi binyuze muri bourse ninkunga zubucuruzi. Alakija yatanze ikigo cyo gushaka ubumenyi muri Yaba College of Technology (Yabatech), ikigo cyisumbuye giherereye i Lagos.
Alakija yashakanye n'umunyamategeko Modupe Alakija wo mu muryango wa Adeyemo Alakija, mu Gushyingo mu mwaka 1976. Batuye i Lagos, muri Nijeriya, hamwe n'abahungu babo bane n'abuzukuru babo. &lt;ref&gt; Bella Naija. 29 Kanama 2014. Muri Kamena mu mwaka 2017, umuhungu wa Folorunso, Folarin Alakija, yashakanye n'umunyamideli wo muri Irani Nazanin Jafarian Ghaissarifar mu bukwe bwa miliyoni 6.4 z'amadolari mu ngoro ya Blenheim mu Bwongereza.

Lorna Rutto ni Rwiyemezairimo w' umunyakenya mubijyanye no kwita ku ibidukikije, kandi ni we washinze ikigo cya EcoPost, ikigo cy’imibereho yashinzwe hagamijwe gushaka ubundi buryo bwo gucunga imyanda ku kibazo kinini cy’imyanda ya Kenya. Mu 2009 yashinze isosiyete ye, ikusanya imyanda ya pulasitike kandi ikora ibicuruzwa bifatika, biramba cyane, kandi byangiza ibidukikije byangiza ibidukikije, bikoreshwa cyane muri Kenya. Mu mwaka wa 2011, Lorna yahawe igihembo n’icyubahiro cya Cartier Women Initiative Awards nk'igihembo cyabo muri Afurika yo munsi y'Ubutayu bwa Sahara.

Saran Kaba Jones (wavutse ku ya 21 Kamena 1982) ni umuvugizi wunganira amazi meza na rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka muri Liberiya.Niwe washinze FACE Africa, umuryango uharanira gushimangira ibikorwa remezo na serivisi z’amazi, isuku n’isuku (WASH) mu baturage bo mu cyaro muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara.Ari mu komite y' Ihuriro ry’Ubukungu ku Isi (mu icyongereza: World Economic Forum Young Global Leader) akaba n' Umuyobozi w’Ikinyamakuru IGIHE 2016 (Mu icyongereza:TIME Magazine Next Generation Leader)

Dambisa Moyo (yavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 1969) ni impuguke mu by'ubukungu akaba n'umwanditsi wa Zambiya, uzwiho gusesengura ubukungu bw’isi. N'umuntu udasanzwe ufite amateka ashimishije kandi yumwuga. Dambisa afite impamyabumenyi ya PhD mu by'ubukungu muri kaminuza ya Oxford kandi afite impamyabumenyi ya Masters yakuye muri kaminuza ya Harvard. Byongeye kandi, umuvugizi wacu Dambisa Mayo yagiye mu bihugu birenga 70 kandi akora muri Goldman Sachs, Banki y'Isi, ndetse no mu bukungu buzwi ku rwego mpuzamahanga, umwanditsi, n'umuvugizi.

Ory Okolloh ni umunyakenya uharanira inyungu, umunyamategeko, na. Ni umuyobozi ushinzwe ishoramari muri. Yahoze ari Umuyobozi wa Politiki muri Afurika hamwe na Google. Muri 2007, Okolloh yafatanije na
Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bumenyi bwa politiki yakuye muri kaminuza ya arangiza mu ishuri ry'amategeko rya mu 2005

Isis Nyong’o Madison ni rwiyemezamirimo w’itangazamakuru n’umunyakenya-Amerika. Kugeza ubu umuyobozi mu kigo ngishwanama ngishwanama Asphalt &amp; Ink, mbere yakoranye na InMobi, Google na MTV Africa. Umujyanama Mukuru mu itsinda rya. ni nawe washinze Mum's Village, urubuga rwa interineti ruhindura uburambe bwa nyina-umwana muri Kenya.

Juliet Ehimuan n'umuyobozi wubucuruzi wa Nigeriya, umuyobozi ushinzwe ikoranabuhanga, na rwiyemezamirimo. Ubu ni Umuyobozi muri Google West Africa,
Ehimuan amaze imyaka isaga makumyabiri akora mu ikoranabuhanga kandi ni umuvugizi wa rubanda, umujyanama, umwanditsi akaba n'umuvugizi w’abagore mu ikoranabuhanga no kwihangira imirimo. Niwe washinze Beyond Limits Africa akaba n'umwanditsi wa 'Iminsi 30 y'indashyikirwa'.

Allan Gray ni sosiyete ikora ibikorwa byo gukurikirana ishoramari ikaba ikomoka muri Afurika yepfo. Iyi sosiyete ifite kandi ibiro biherereye mu bihugu bitandukanye nka Botswana, Namibiya na Eswatini, kandi ikomeza gushimangira umubano wa hafi n’amasosiyete ya "Orbis Investment Management" na Allan Gray yo muri Ositaraliya. Abakiriya bayo barimo ibigo bikora ishoramari, abashoramari ku giti cyabo, amasosiyete y'ubwishingizi, ibigo bitanga umutungo ukabyazwa umusaruro mu buryo bw'ikizere, fondasiyo n'ibigo by'amahanga.
Umujyanama mu ishoramari Allan Gray yashinzwe mu kwezi kwa Ukwakira mu mwaka wa 1973 ishingwa na Allan WB Gray. Ikigo cyabashije kubona umukiriya wacyo wa mbere mu mwaka wa 1974. Mu mwaka wa 1989, Gray yashyizeho Orbis Investment Management, ikaba ari sosiyete mpuzamahanga ishinzwe ishoramari.
Ikigo cyashinzwe kandi gihindura izina cyitwa Allan Gray Limited mu mwaka wa 1992. Mu mwaka wa 1996, iki kigo cyafunguye ibiro mu mujyi wa Windhoek, mu gihugu cya Namibiya. Mu mwaka wa 1998, ikigo cyatangiye gutanga ibicuruzwa byerekeranye no kuranguza ibikorwa by'ishoramari. Ibindi biro byashinzwe mu mujyi wa Gaborone, mu gihugu cya Botswana mu mwaka wa 2004.
Allan Gray ikora ishoramari mu bihugu bigize umugabane w'Afurika kandi ikaba ikoresha abakozi barenga 1.000. Icyicaro gikuru cyayo giherereye i Cape Town, mu Karere ka Silo V&amp;A Waterfront. Silo One, icyicaro gikuru, niyo yambere muri Afrika yepfo yahawe amanota yo mu cyiciro cy'inyenyeri esheshatu mu kurengera ibidukikije, yagihawe n'ikigo gishinzwe inyubako zirengera ibidukikije cyo muri Afrika y'epfo.
Abashoramari bacuruza bashobora gushora imari mu mahitamo atandukanye atangwa na Allan Gray aho abashoramari bahitamo ibice byizerwa binyuze mu bicuruzwa bitandukanye byishoramari. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishoramari muri iki gihe atanga ishoramari ryibanze, ishoramari ridasoreshwa, ishoramari ryo hanze, amafaranga yizabukuru, amafaranga yo mu kigega cyo kubungabunga, amafaranga yo kubaho hamwe n'impano.
Abashoramari b'ibigo bashobora guhitamo gushora imari mu cyiciro cy'ishoramari ryo kwizerana aho batanga imitungo bakayibabyariza inyungu, ubuzima bwahujwe n'ubuzima butandukanye hamwe n'inshingano zitandukanye, bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ikigo n'ubunini bw'ishoramari ryabo.
Allan Gray igira uburyo itanga kandi ibisubizo cyangwa uburyo bwo kuzigama mu matsinda kubakoresha binyuze mu kigega cy’izabukuru cya Allan Gray Umbrella hamwe n’umwaka wa pansiyo ya Allan Gray.
Imbaraga z’ishoramari rya Allan Gray rigenewe kugira uruhare muri sosiyete izerekeza kuri Fondasiyo ya Allan Gray Orbis na E Squared, aho iba ifite intego yo kwigisha ba rwiyemezamirimo ndetse no kubaha inkunga. Fondasiyo iterwa inkunga n’impano ngarukamwaka ihoraho ya 5% y’inyungu ya Allan Gray Proprietary Limited itanga mbere y’imisoro hamwe na miliyoni 150 z'amadorali yatanzwe na Allan WB Gray. E Squared ifite 20% byímigabane muri Allan Gray Limited.
Inyungu igenzurwa muri Allan Gray ifitwe ubuziraherezo na Allan &amp; Gill Gray Foundation. Abandi banyamigabane barimo abakozi bahoze bayikoramo ndetse n'abagikoramo kuri ubu ndetse na E Squared. Fondasiyo ya Allan &amp; Gill Gray yashyizweho kugirango ibeho ubuziraherezo kugira ngo inyungu zigabanywa byumwihariko zigenerwa gusa abagiraneza no guteza imbere ubucuruzi, gukomeza no kwigenga mu bucuruzi bwa Allan Gray.

Kanyana Shalon ni umunyarwandakazi akaba muri ba Rwiyemezamirimo bashinze uruganda rwitwa Ishyo Food Ltd, rutunganya Konfiture ndetse akaba anitegura gukora za Yawurute. Ndetse akora ibiryo bya Yummy mu Rwanda, bikozwe mubiribwa byiza byu Rwanda.
Sharon afite impamyabumenyi iyicyiciro cya kabili cya kaminuza mu buhinzi hamwe n' impamyabumenyi ihanitse yi cyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bushakashatsi bwiterambere. Shalon afite ubumenyi, Ishyaka mugucukumbura ibyo guteka.

Chancellor House ni isosiyete iherereye muri Afurika yepfo ikora ishoramari mu bisata bitandukanye harimo ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, ubwubatsi, ingufu n’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho. Yiswe Chancellor House, bashingiye ku nyubako ikigo cy’amategeko cya Nelson Mandela na Oliver Tambo cyari giherereye.
Nyuma yo kuba cyarashyizwe ahagaragara nk’umuterankunga w'imena w'shyaka ryitwa Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika (ANC) yaje kwemerwa nk'ikigo cy’ishoramari mu gihugu kubera iryo shyaka. Birazwi cyane kubera impaka zijyanye no guhabwa igihembo cyo kungura ubukungu bw'abirabura bw'unguka hamwe n'amasezerano ya parastatal.
Kuba iyi sosiyete yaramenyekanye bwa mbere mu mwaka wa 2006. Ikinyamakuru "Mail &amp; Guardian" kivuga ko iyi sosiyete yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2003 kubushake bwa Mendi Msimang, akaba ariwe wahoze ari umubitsi mukuru wa ANC, icyo gihe yari agamije gukusanya inkunga y'ishyaka.
Mbere y'amakuru yatangajwe n'ikinyamakuru iyi sosiyete ntago yari izwi; Kgalema Motlanthe, icyo gihe wari umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyaka, ngo yabanje kubimenya ubwo yavuganaga n’ikinyamakuru kugira ngo agire icyo abivugaho.
Muri Nzeri mu mwaka wa 2021, iyi sosiyete ubwayo yemeye ko yabaye icyambu cyo gutera inkunga ishyaka rya ANC.
Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 2021, Mamatho Netsianda na Zwelibanzi Nzama, umuyobozi mukuru nshingwabikorwa, bagize uruhare mu mushinga wo guteza imbere politiki y'ibikorwa by'imitungo itimukanwa guhera mu mwaka wa 2008. Isambu iri hejuru ya sitasiyo ya Sandton yari yarahinduwe n'Umujyi wa Johannesburg, ariko ntabwo bigeze bakira ubyishyu bwabyo.
Amasezerano ya Eskom.
Mu Gushyingo mu mwaka wa 2007, ikigo gisakaza amashanyarazi ya parastatal cyitwa Eskom cyahawe imashini esheshatu zitunganya amashanyarazi zifite agaciro ka miliyari 20 yamarandi ifaranga rikoreshwa mu gihugu cya Afurika y'epfo, mu ihuriro harimo na Hitachi Power Africa. Mugihe cyo gutanga ibihembo iyo sosiyete yari ifite imigabane ingana nka 25% yose ikaba yari ifitwe na Chancellor House.
Muri Gashyantare mu mwaka wa 2008, ishyaka rya ANC ryavuze ko rizashyiraho abajyanama hagamijwe gusohoka mu mucyo kubera ibibazo by'imiyoborere. Muri Werurwe mu mwaka wa 2008, ibiro by’Umurinzi rusange byavuze ko iperereza kuri ubwo bucuruzi ririmo gukorwa.
Nyuma y’ibirego bikubiye mu itegeko rigenga ruswa mu mahanga ryashyizweho na komisiyo ishinzwe umutekano no kugurizanya, Hitachi yemeye kwishyurwa miliyoni 19 z’amadolari muri Nzeri mu mwaka wa 2015. Iyi myumvire mibi yo kutabazwa inshingano bashinzwe, gukorera mu mucyo no gucunga umutungo bifitanye isano na ishyaka rya ANC yanashamikiyeho kunengwa na Ishyaka riharanira demokarasi, ishyaka ritavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi.

Ishyo Foods Ltd ni kampani yashinzwe na rwiyemezamirimo witwa Akanyana Shalon akaba nawe umuyobozi wayo. Shalon yatangiye ubu bucuruzi ahereye ku nkomoko yoroheje akunda guteka aho yari mugikoni akabyitekera.
Uko igitekerezo cyaje.
Ishyo Foods Ltd, Ibona u Rwanda nki igihugu gifite ubutaka byiza bukungahaye ku ntungamubiri ndetse hamwe n’ikirere cyiza, hamwe no guhinga, imbuto nziza, kandi hari mashyo atandukanye atanga amata akungahaye ku ntungamubiri.
Ishyo Foods Ltd ifasha gukemura ikibazo cyibiribwa, aho itanga imbuto zirimbwa ndetse na yahurute zifite ubuziranenge kandi zihendutse. Kuko, imiryango imwe ni mwe yomu Rwanda itunzwe nibiribwa bihendutse, kandi usanga bitumizwa mu mahanga. Ibyo biryo byose bakabikoresha bikiri bibisi cyangwa bikiri bizima.

Ubuhinzi n'iterambere mu Rwanda.
Ubuhinzi bufite akamaro kanini mu bukungu bw’u Rwanda kuko bwinjiza kimwe cya gatattu cy'umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu. uru rwego ruha akazi abarenga bibiri bya gatatu by’abakozi bose mugihugu kandi iterambere rishingiye kubuhinzi ryitezweho kugira uruhare runini mu kurwanya ubukene no guca ubukene bukabije. ahubwo rukaba urwego rutanga umusaruro mwinci kandi mwiza ku isoko ry'Africa Guverinema yu Rwanda yiyemeje guhindura urwgo rw'ubuhinzi rukava kuguhinga ibitunga imiryango gusa. rukaba urwego rutanga umussruro mwinci kandi mwiza rukabasha kugemurira isoko kandi rufasha mukuzamura izindi nzego z'ubukungu mu Rwanda. Ibi bizagerwaho binyuze muri gahunda zitandukanye zishyirwa mubikorwa na Minisitteri y'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi (MINAGRI) n’ibigo biyishamikiyeho, ariko ikabifashwamo n’Urwego rw’Abikorera, abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere ndetse n’abandi bireba bose.
Intego n'iterambere.
Kugirango iterambere rirambye rigerweho, abahinzi n'aborozi bakwiriye kureka guhinga no korora ibitunga imiryango yabo gusa bagakorera guhaza isoko ry'Africa no hanze yayo. ibi kandi bizabasaba kubona service z'imari. mu Rwanda Imari irakenewe mubyiciro byose by'ubuhinzi nko kugura imbuto z'indobanure ndetse no mumirimo yo gutunganya no guhunika umusaruro.
Ikoranabuhanga mu buhinzi mu Rwanda.
u Rwanda ni kimwe mubihugu by'Africa bikora uko bishoboye mu guteza imbere abahinzi naborozi muburyo bwose
kugirango umusaruro wiyongere ndetse n'itumanaho rizamurwe mu rwego rwo guhanahana amakuru mu bahinzi ndetse nama koperative bakoreramo. mu rwego rwo guteza imbere umugore no kumushyigikira mu mirimo ye ya burimunsi leta yu Rwanda yahaye Telefone zigezweho (SMART PHONE) abagore bakora umwuga w'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi mu Turere dutandukanye harimo, Akarere Burera, Kirehe, na Nyamasheke. aba bagore bashyikirijwe izi Telefone zigezweho ni abafashamyumvire bibumbie mu ma koperative y'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda bahawe izi telefone kunkunga ya #connectRwanda

Peace Masozera Uwase, uzwi nka Peace Uwase, ni umucungamari w’u Rwanda akaba n’umuyobozi wa banki, akora nk'umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami rishinzwe imari muri Banki nkuru y’igihugu y’u Rwanda ya BNR, kuva muri Mata 2016.
Mbere yibyo Uwase yari umufatanyabikorwa ucunga PAM Business Advisory, hagati yo muri Mutarama 2013 kugeza Mata 2016. Muri urwo ruhare, yabaye umujyanama mu by'imari n’imicungire, inzobere mu bijyanye na banki, ibaruramari, ubugenzuzi, imicungire y’ibyago, imiyoborere n’igenamigambi.
Peace Uwase yize muri Mount Saint Mary's College Namagunga, aho avuka, abakobwa bose bo mu mashuri yisumbuye, mu Karere ka Mukono aho bigaga, muri Uganda, yize amasomo rusange kuva hagati ya 1992 na 1998. Yize muri kaminuza ya Makerere, no muri Uganda, arangiza impamyabumenyi mu bucuruzi muri 2001. Nyuma, yabonye impamyabushobozi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu bucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza ya gikirisitu ya Oklahoma muri Amerika. Ni umucungamari wemewe n'ishyirahamwe ry'abacungamari bemewe bo mu Bwongereza.
Akazi ka mbere yari nka Audit Associate muri Price Waterhouse Coopers, mu biro byabo i Kampala, muri Uganda, aho yakoreze imyaka irenga itatu. Yimukiye mu Rwanda muri Mutarama 2005, atangira akazi nk'umuyobozi w’imari n’imiyoborere muri "Banki y’Ubucuruzi, Iterambere n’inganda ya" BCDI, uwabanjirije Ecobanque mu Rwanda, aho yakoreye imyaka ibiri ni gice.
Ecobank imaze kubona BCDI muri Nyakanga 2007, yagumye ku mwanya mushya w'umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imari muri Ecobank Rwanda. Hanyuma umwaka umwe, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imari muri Ecobank Gineya Bissau, ifite icyicaro i Bissau.
Yaje kuba umujyanama wigenga mu gihe cy'umwaka nigice, mbere yuko ahabwa akazi na Kivu Watt Limited, nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe imari, ahakorera umwaka urenga. Yaje gusubira mu bujyanama bwite mu gihe cy'imyaka itatu n'igice, mbere yo kwinjira muri Banki Nkuru y'u Rwanda, muri Mata 2016.
Peace Uwase ni umwe mu bagize inama y’ubuyobozi y’ikigo cy’imisoro m’u Rwanda.

Epiphanie Mukashyaka (wavutse muri 1959-1960) ni umucuruzi wo mu Rwanda. Niwe washinze Buf coffee nku mugore wa mbere, ukora ikawa idasanzwe mu Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Mukashyaka yavutse 1959 cyangwa 1960 mu Rwanda. Yize imyaka 6 arongorwa afite imyaka 17. Ari afite abana 8.
Muri icyo gihe mu Rwanda mbere ya jenoside, abagore ntibari bemerewe kuragwa ubutaka, kandi wasangaga bidashoboka gukora ubucuruzi. Itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda rirangiye, abaturage bagera kuri 70% bari abagore naho abagabo bagera kuri 30%.
Itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda no gushiraho Bufcoffee.
Muri 1994, ubwo Itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda ryabaye, bituma hapfa abantu ibihumbi magana, barimo benshi mu bagize umuryango wa Mukashyaka, nk'umugabo we ndetse n'umwe mu bana be. Ibi byatumye Mukashyaka adafite akazi kandi nta nkunga y'amafaranga. Yabanje kutabasha kuzungura isambu y'umugabo we ariko bidatinze arayigarurira. Yabonye kandi inkunga y'abapfakazi bagenzi be bo m'ubaturage, barimo Ngara Nyarusiza, waje kuba umufatanyabikorwa mu bucuruzi bwa Bufcoffee.
Nyuma ya jenoside, Mukashyaka yafashe inguzanyo ya miliyoni 54 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda maze y'ubaka ikigo cyo koza ikawa i Gikongoro cyitwa Nyarusiza, icya mbere cyari gifitwe umugore mu Rwanda,: 79  aho yakoresheje abahinzi guhinga ibishyimbo. Mu gihe cyo kongera kubaka ikawa ye, yahawe ubufasha na USAID na PEARL. Muri 2004 ikawa ye yaciwe neza na Kenneth Davids. maze muri 2007, afungura ikigo cya kabiri cyo koza ikawa cyitwa Remera., Muri uwo mwaka yatsindiye igihembo cya Kawa y’igikombe cy’u Rwanda muri 2007, n’igihembo cy’igikombe cy’indashyikirwa cy’ikawa muri 2008, 2010, 2011, 2013, na 2014.
Muri 2016, isosiyete yari ifite abanyamigabane barenga ibihumbi 4000, kandi ikawa yoherezwa muri Amerika.
Muri 2019, Mukashyaka yatorewe kuba rwiyemezamirimo w’umugore w’u Rwanda, yatsindiye miliyoni 2 z’amafaranga yu Rwanda. Yabonye kandi ubufatanye muri Trademark Afurika y'Uburasirazuba.
Icyorezo cya Covid-19.
Igihe kimwe hagati yo muri 2016 na 2020 isosiyete yari ifite ibikoresho bine byo gukaraba. Igihe icyorezo cya COVID-19 mu Rwanda cyibasiye, ubucuruzi bwaragabanutseho cyane. Muri 2020, isosiyete yari ifite abakozi bagera ku bihumbi 12.000, igabanuka kuva mu mwaka ushize. Bamwe bagombaga kureka gukora nk'abahinzi ba kawa kubera icyorezo, bigatuma umusaruro muke, nubwo ubucuruzi bwari bugifite umutekano muke. Uburyo bwo kwishyura bwagombaga guhindurwa kumurongo kubera amategeko yimibereho.
Abana ba Mukashyaka bakorera ikigo. Umwe ni umuyobozi ucunga Bufcoffee. Mukashyaka yubatse ubusitani bw'umuganda iruhande rw'ishuri ry'incuke ry' umumvumu kugira ngo akomeze kwihaza mu biribwa mu gihe cy'icyorezo.

Betelehemu Tilahun Alemu (yavutse mu mwaka wa 1980) ni umucuruzi wo muri Etiyopiya, washinze akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa soleRebels, "nisosiyete ikora inkweto ubucuruzi bukura bwambukiranya vuba muri Afurika". Betelehemu yahawe icyubahiro n’ishimwe kubera ubucuruzi bwe, ndetse yashizeho n’ingamba yashyizeho zo guhindura imbwirwa ruhame kuri Afurika ikava mu bukene ikajya mu mwuka wo kwihangira imirimo ku mugabane w'isi, ishoramari shingiro, ndetse n’ubukungu. Betelehemu yatangije "Repubulika y’uruhu", ishushanya ibicuruzwa by’uruhu birambye bikozwe mu buryo bwiza, hamwe n’ubucuruzi bwa "Garden of Kawa" mu rwego rwo kumenyekanisha ikawa ya Etiyopiya.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Betelehemu yavukiye mu gace ka Zenebework ka Addis Abeba. Ababyeyi be bakoraga mu bitaro byaho hafi. Alemu yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye ya Leta, hanyuma ajya gukomeza kwiga ibaruramari muri kaminuza y’ubumwe, arangiza amashuri mu mwaka wa 2004.
Bethlehem ni we rwiyemezamirimo wo muba mbere w’umugore wo muri Afurika waganiriye na sosiyete Clinton Global Initiative kandi yahawe igihembo cy’umugore, nk’umugore w’umudage w’indashyikirwa na African Business Awards mu mwaka wa 2011.
Imishinga y'ubucuruzi.
Mu ntangiriro zu mwaka wa 2005, Betelehemu yashinze soleRebels kugira ngo itange imirimo irambye mu ibidukikije no mu bukungu. yabonye abanyabukorikori benshi bafite ubuhanga mu gace ke gato ka Zenebework babanaga n'ubushomeri budashira, yashakaga kwerekana ubuhanga bwabo no guha akazi abo mu gace atuyemo aturukamo.
Ubucuruzi bw'inkweto zakozwe mumapine yimodoka. kuruyu munsi, iyososiyete ifite amaduka ku isi yose, harimo muri Etiyopiya, Singapore, Ubusuwisi na Tayiwani.
Betelehemu yishimiye cyane kuba yarashoboye gukora ibirango kurwego rw'isi yose nka soleRebels no gukora ubusitani bwa Kawa.
Iyososiyete yatangiriye mu mahugurwa yogupima ubutaka bwa nyirakuru wa Betelehemu muri Zenebework.
SoleRebels yateye imbere, izagukura igera ku bakozi 300 muri Etiyopiya, izagukwirakwizwa mu bihugu mirongo itatu ku isi hose, igurisha abayobozi b'isoko ibyo kurya byuzuye, Ibisagara byo mu mijyi na Amazone. Amaduka ya francised hamwe n’amasosiyete byari biteganijwe gufungura muri Otirishiya, Ubusuwisi, Tayiwani, n’Ubwongereza. Betelehemu yashakaga guhanga imirimo ihembwa neza ishobora guteza imbere kubakozi bakoresheje impano yubukorikori n'umutungo kamere wa Etiyopiya. Guhitamo inkweto nk'ibicuruzwa byo gutangiza uruganda byaje nyuma. Betelehemu yatewe inkunga na seleate cyangwa barabasso, inkweto gakondo zisubirwamo z'ipine zonyine zakozwe muri Etiyopiya, kandi inkweto zahindutse inzige yahisemo kubaka uruganda.
Muri mwaka wa 2016 iyososiyete yagurishije inkweto 125.000 kandi yari imaze guhanga imirimo 1200.
Mu mwaka 2014, Betelehemu yatangaje umushinga mushya w’ubucuruzi, Repubulika y’uruhu, abinyujije ku rubugarwe rwa interineti arirwo rubuga rwa soleRebels. Betelehemu yavuze ko inganda zihenze cyane z’uruhu "zakuze kugira ngo zongere zitekerezeho," muburyo bwokubishyira ku murongo usa n’ibyo yari yararangije gukora wenyine afatanyije hamwe n’inganda z’inkweto. Usibye gushyigikira ibitekerezo bimwe by’ibidukikije n’ubukungu burambye nka soleRebels, Repubulika y’uruhu ishingiye ku mahame yo guhitamo abakiriya guhitamo abakiriya guhitamo, gukora no kwakira inkunga ya 5% yikiguzi batanga cyangwa bishyura.
Mu mwaka 2017, "Ubusitani bwa Kawa" bwongerewe mubigo bye bimwitirirwa. Bitangirira ku bicuruzwa i Addis Abeba.
Uburyo sisitemu yari yubatse.
Betelehemu yarashaka kurwanya inkuru gakondo zerekeye Afurika na cyane cyane Etiyopiya, "kurwanya shibboleth ko Abanyafurika n'Abanyafurikazi batazi icyo bakora cyangwa uburyo bwo kwiteza imbere." Betelehemu yizeraga ko Abanyetiyopiya bagomba kugenzura inkuru zabo bwite bahereye kuburyo"bantu n'intore bafite inyungu zo kwerekana ko Etiyopiya atari uko" bakeneye ubufasha "kandi bakeneye cyane cyane" ubufasha "batanga." Nkuko Betelehemu yabisobanuye mu kiganiro na "The Umugore Ukurikira". Intsinzi kwisi yose y'amasosiyete nka soleRebels ifashwa gukuraho izi nkuru zishaje kandi ituma Abanyetiyopiya bashiraho hagaragara k'usura yabo mpuzamahanga.

Diane Shima Rwigara ni umucuruzi, akaba rwiyemezamirimo n’umucungamari wabaye umukandida wigenga mu matora y’umukuru w’i gihugu ya Rwanda 2017. Rwigara yashinjwaga ku ya 23 Nzeri 2017, ari kumwe na nyina ndetse n'abandi baregwana bane, kuba yarateje imvururu mu bindi birego, ariko agirwa umwere hamwe na nyina ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2018.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Diane Rwigara yavukiye i Kigali muri 1982 avukira mu muryango w'abatutsi kandi afite barumuna be batatu. Se, ni Assinapol Rwigara, umunyenganda akaba n’umunyemari ukomeye w’umuryango w’igihugu ukunda igihugu cya Rwanda, yaguye mu mpanuka y’imodoka ku ya 4 Gashyantare 2015 i Gacuriro, muri Kigali. Umuryango wemeza ko impanuka yatewe na politiki. Polisi yavuze ko yahise yicwa ubwo imodoka y'aMercedez-Benz yari atwaye yari igonganye n'ikamyo iremereye.
Rwigara ni umucungamari watojwe. Yakunze kuvuga nabi imiyoborere y’igihugu iyoborwa na Perezida Paul Kagame hamwe ndetse n’akarengane n’agahato.
Ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2017, Rwigara yatangaje ko yifuza kwitabira amatora ya perezida. Nyuma y'amasaha 72, amafoto ye yambaye ubusa yashyizwe ahagaragara m'uburyo bugaragara bwo kumukoza isoni no kumutera ubwoba. Yashimangiye ko afite intego yo kwiyamamaza, yiyemeza kwiyamamaza mu rwego rwo guca burundu ubukene, gushyiraho ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima ku isi hose no guharanira ubwisanzure.
Ku 7 Nyakanga 2017, Komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe amatora yabwiye ko ataziyamamaza Rwigara mu matora ku mpamvu za tekiniki, avuga ko yakoresheje imikono mpimbano mu ipiganwa rye rya perezida kandi ko yatanze imikono 572 yemewe aho kuba 600 isabwa. Rwigara yavuze ko yatanze imikono y'abamusinyiye bagera 958, hiyongeraho 120 nyuma yuko bamwe batemerewe. Abandi bakandida babiri na bo ntibemerewe, bituma Amnesty International ivuga ko ayo matora azabera mu bihe by'ubwoba no gukandamizwa. Iki cyemezo kandi cyanenzwe na Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga y'Amerika n’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi. Kagame yatsinze amatora yo ku ya 4 Kanama n'amajwi 98%. Rwigara yatangije umutwe w'abaharanira inyungu witwa Agakiza ka Rubanda kugira ngo uhangane n'ubutegetsi ku gitabo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu, avuga ko inteko ishinga amategeko y'igihugu itarenze kashe. Umuryango uharanira agakiza ka rubanda nk'uko Rwigara abitangaza, ngo azakomeza imirimo ye yo gukangurira Abanyarwanda uburenganzira bwabo no kunenga politiki n'ibikorwa by'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi rishinzwe gukunda igihugu (FPR).
Ku ya 7 Kamena 2024, Komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe amatora (NEC) yanze kandidatire ya Diane Rwigara mu matora y’umukuru w’igihugu ya 2024.
Ku ya 30 Kanama 2017, inzu ya Rwigara yagabweho igitero, abapolisi bavuga ko arimo gukorwaho iperereza ku mpimbano no kunyereza imisoro. Umuryango wa Rwigara wavuze ko yabuze, bavuga ko abantu bitwaje imbunda bitazwi bambaye imyenda ya gisivili bamufatanye imbunda mu gihe inzu yashakishwaga, ariko abapolisi bahakana ko yatawe muri yombi.
Ibinyamakuru byinshi byatangaje muri Nzeri 2017 ko Rwigara atarashobora kuboneka kandi umuryango we wakomeje kuvuga ko yabuze. Leon Orsmond, umuhanzi wo mugihugu cya Afurika y'Epfo w'amamaza udushya, wafashije Rwigara mu gikorwa cyo kwamamaza imbuga nkoranyambaga na we yabuze mu Rwanda kuva mu Gashyantare 2018. Mbere yo kubura, Orsmond ntiyigeze ahisha ko adakunda leta ya Kagame.
Muri Kamena 2018, ikigo cy’imisoro n’u Rwanda cyagurishije imashini ziba mu bucuruzi bw’itabi ry’umuryango ku madolari agera kuri miliyoni 2 mu rwego rwo kugaruza ibyo bavugaga ko ari miliyoni 7 z’ibirarane by’imisoro. Cyamunara yabanje kugurisha umutungo w'ubucuruzi bwumuryango wa Rwigara, itabi ryatunganijwe, ryinjije amafaranga arenga miliyoni 500 yu Rwanda. ikigo Amnesty International yahamagariye ubucamanza bwu Rwanda kureba niba urubanza rutabaye ubundi buryo bwo gutoteza abanenga guverinoma.
Muri Kanama 2018, habayeho #FreeDianeRwigara yakoreshwaga nabanya kenya kurubuga rwa Twitter bahamagarira Kagame kurekura Rwigara. Ibi bibaye nyuma y'iminsi mike abakoresha Twitter muri Kenya babigiriye nk’umudepite wa Uganda,nyuma Robert Kyagulanyi, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Bobby Wine.
Ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2018, urukiko rwategetse ko Rwigara na nyina Adeline Rwigara barekurwa by'agateganyo; ibi bibaye nyuma y'ibyumweru bike nyuma yo gufungurwa hakiri kare abakatiwe 2140, barimo Victoire Ingabire na Kizito Mihigo. Nyuma y’umwaka urenga muri gereza, Urukiko Rukuru rw’u Rwanda rwarekuye Rwigara na nyina Adeline ingwate. Basabwe kutava mu murwa mukuru, Kigali, nta ruhushya, kandi urubanza rwabo ruzakomeza.
Abasenateri benshi bo muri Amerika barimo Dick Durbin, Ann Wagner, Patrick Leahy na Barbara Lee, ndetse n'abagize komisiyo ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu muri kongere ya Tom Lantos bahamagariye guverinoma y'u Rwanda kureka ibyo birego kuko ari ukurenga ku bwisanzure mu gutanga ibitekerezo. Abayobozi b'u Rwanda bashinje abanyapolitiki bo muri Amerika kwivanga mu manza zabo.
Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2018, inteko y'abacamanza batatu b'urukiko rukuru rw'u Rwanda yagizwe umwere Rwigara hamwe na nyina, basanga ibyo baregwa byose bidafite ishingiro. Urukiko rwasanze Rwigara yarakoresheje uburenganzira bwe bwo kuvuga mu kunegura Perezida kandi ko atateje urugomo. Nyina yagizwe umwere kubera guteza imbere amacakubiri, amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko no gukurura urugomo. Rwigara yagejeje ijambo ku bitangazamakuru biri mu cyumba cy'urukiko, agira ati: Nizeye ko ibi bivuze ko ibitotezo njye n'umuryango wanjye twahuye nabyo byarangiye kandi ko mfite umudendezo wo kuvuga icyo ntekereza. Nicyo nzakomeza kurwanira mu gihugu hose. Icyemezo cy'urukiko cyakiriwe neza na Amnesty International, yahamagariye guverinoma y'u Rwanda gukora "hagamijwe guteza imbere ubworoherane no kwemera ibindi bitekerezo kandi binenga."
Ubujurire bw'Ubushinjacyaha ku rwego rw'igihugu bwatanze ubujurire bwo ku ya 27 Ukuboza. Ku ya 9 Mutarama 2019, urwego rw’ubushinjacyaha rwa Kagame, rumaze guhabwa amabwiriza na minisiteri y’ubutabera, rwanze ubujurire bwarwo bwo kuba abere. Rwigara yishimiye iki cyemezo, avuga ko "azakomeza guharanira ubwisanzure mu gutanga ibitekerezo n'uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Rwanda."

Ikibuga k'indege cya Bugesera.
mu bikorwa bishimishije by'iterambere n'ubukungu u Rwanda rumaze kugeraho harimo n'iyubakwa ry'ikibuga k'indegegiherereye mu karere ka Bugesera.
Biteganyijweko iki kibuga kizaba gifite ubuso bwa metero kare ibihumbi 130, kizajya cyakira abagenzi miliyoni 8 ku mwaka, bazarushaho kugenda biyongera bakagera kuri miliyoni 14, ndetse kikazajya kinyuraho toni ibihumbi 150 by’ibicuruzwa bizajya bitwarwa n'indege zitwara imizigo.
Ubukungu n'iterambere.
Jules Ndenga, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo Aviation Travel and Logistics Holding (ATL) gikurikirana imyubakire y’iki kibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera, avuga ko nicyuzura bizagira uruhare rukomeye mu kuzamura ubukungu bw’u Rwanda.
Aho ikibuga k'indege giherereye.
iki kibuga k'Indege giherereye mu karere ka Bugesera mu birometero 40 mu majyyepfo yy'umujyi wa Kigali
Imirimo n'ubufatanye.
Ibikorwa byo kubaka ikibuga k'indege mpuzamahanga cya Bugesera byatangijwe na Perezida wa Repubulika yu Rwanda Paul Kagame muri Kanama 2017 nyuma yuko amasezerano ajyanye no kucyubaka yari yasinywe muri nzeri 2016 hagati ya Guverinoma yu Rwanda na sosiyete yy'ubwubatsi ikomoka mugihugu cya Portugal yitwa MOTAL ENGIL ENGENHARIA e CONSTRUCAO AFRICA kugirango izubake icyo kibuga.

Patrick Epaphra Ngowi ni rwiyemezamirimo wo muri Tanzaniya, umucuruzi, ushinzwe ibidukikije, umuyobozi w’imihindagurikire y’ikirere ya Al Gore akaba na SDG 7 Pioneer. Patrick yashinze kandi ayobora imishinga myinshi mugihe cy'umwuga we.
Ngowi yatangiye ubucuruzi bwe bwa mbere afite imyaka 15 ubwo yatangiraga kugurisha inyemezabuguzi zo kurwego rwo hejuru kuri terefone zigendanwa mu mashuri yisumbuye. Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabumenyi, Ngowi yakoze ingendo hagati mubihugu by'Ubushinwa naza Tanzaniya agarura amwe muriza terefone zigezweho kandi zihenze, atangira kugura terefone zidahenze ku bakorera inganda zihenze no muburyo bwo kuzigurisha ku isoko rya Tanzaniya. Yaje kwiyandikishije muri kaminuza ya Denzhou mu Bushinwa, yiga ingufu zishobora kubaho.
Patrick Ngowi yashinze Helvetic Solar mu mwaka wa 2007 kugirango itange kandi itange ishyireho yesitara ibikoresho by'izuba mugihugu cya Tanzaniya no mugihugu cya Amerika. Iyososiyete yanahawe igihembo cya mbere cya KPMG nk'imwe mu masosiyete 100 ya mbere akomeye yo mugihugu cya Tanzaniya mu mwaka wa 2012. Kuva icyo gihe ikigo cyahindutse itsinda ryubucuruzi butandukanye,kiba mubigo ayoboye.
"Forbes" yashyize Ngowi ku rutonde rw’abantu bambere 30 babaherwe bari munsi ya 30 ba rwiyemezamirimo bato bato bo muri Afurika na Forbes ku rutonde rw’abasore b’abaherwe bo muri Afurika barebwa mu mwaka wa 2013. Yongeye gushyirwa ku rutonde mu mwaka wa 2014 rwa barwiyemezamirimo bato bato muri Afurika binyuze muri Helvetic Group. Yatowe kandi nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba mu mwaka wa 2014 na Forbes na CNBC.
Ngowi yagize uruhare runini mu kuvuga mu birori mpuzamahanga kuko bari mubahawe ijambo maze mu mwaka 2015 atorerwa kuba umuyobozi w’umuryango w’abibumbye ku isi muri Tanzaniya. Umwaka umwe, nibwo yagombaga kuyobora byatangajwe n’umunyamabanga mukuru w’umuryango w’abibumbye avuga ko Ngowi yari umwe mu ntego zagaragaye z’iterambere mu iterambere ry’iterambere ry’umuryango w’abibumbye (SGDs) ku isi 10, yabaye intangarugero mu gutanga ingufu zisukuye, SDG 7.
Ibikorwa by'ubugiraneza.
Ngowi ni we washinzeho Light for Life Foundation, ikigo kidaharanira kitita kunyungu kikaba cyibanda ku gutanga amashanyarazi akomoka cyabgwa ava ku mirasire y'izuba ndetse n’umuyaga muto ku rubyiruko n’abagore babarizwa mu cyaro ndetse no hanze y'igihugu cya Tanzaniya.

Nkulikiyinka Christine (Yavutse ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1965) Muri 2022 yabaye umuyobozi mukuru w’isosiyete igurisha n'ubucuruzi bw’u Rwanda mu mahanga cyane mu guteza imbere ubufatanye bw’Amajyepfo yisi. Yabari ambasaderi w'u Rwanda, wabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa gahunda y'u Rwanda. Yabaye kandi ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu bihugu byinshi birimo Ubudage, Suwede n'Uburusiya.
Nkulikiyinka yavukiye i Kigali muri 1965. Yakuriye mu murwa mukuru w'u Rwanda kandi yiga mu mashuri yisumbuye. Kuva muri 1985 yize Ikidage nk'ururimi rw'amahanga i Mainz, hanyuma yiga ubuyobozi bw'ubucuruzi muri kaminuza ya Ludwigshafen y’ubumenyi. Avuga indimi nki Igifaransa, Icyongereza, Ikidage na Kinyarwanda.
Yakoraga muri Ambasade y'u Rwanda i Berlin kuva muri 1991 kugeza 2005 aho yazamuwe kuba umujyanama wa kabiri wa ambasade. Yagarutse mu Rwanda aho yakoraga muri Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga y'u Rwanda i Kigali.
Kuva mu 2009 kugeza 2015 Christine Nkulikiyinka yari ambasaderi w’igihugu cye i Berlin, aho yari ashinzwe Ubudage ariko nanone Polonye, Rumaniya, Liechtenstein, Repubulika ya Ceki, Slowakiya na Ukraine. Ku ya 14 Nyakanga 2011, yashyikirije Minisitiri w’intebe w’Uburusiya icyo gihe Dmitry Medvedev kandi kuva icyo gihe kandi yari ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Burusiya kugeza igihe ambasade y’u Rwanda i Moscou yongeye nanone gufungurwa muri Kanama 2013 maze Jeanne d'Arc Mujawamariya amusimbuye.
Muri Nzeri 2015, Nkulikiyinka yabaye ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri Suwede kandi akorana na Noruveje, Danimarike, Finilande na Isilande. Isilande yagize uruhare mu gushyiraho imyitozo mu Rwanda kugira ngo hashyizweho ingufu za geothermale.
Muri 2022 yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa gahunda y’ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda iterwa inkunga na guverinoma mu rwego rwo kunoza no gukoresha ubufatanye bw’amajyepfo.

Josephine Uwineza uzwi nka Fina, ni rwiyemezamirimo wumunyaRwandakazi, kandi uharanira imibereho myiza. Muri 2018, yateganyaga gufungura uruganda rwa mbere rwenga inzoga mu Rwanda, ruzagaragaramo abakozi benshi bagizwe n’abagore.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Josephine yavutse muri 1964 mu muryango ufite abandi bavandimwe batanu. Muri 1974, ise yiciwe mu gihe cyo guhirika ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda mu 1973 bituma nyina wa Fina yirukanwa n Rwanda hamwe n’abana be bose. Umuryango wa Uwineza wagiye mu bihugu bituranye n’aho abandi bagize umuryango we bari mu buhungiro babayo ariko amaherezo bikagera muri Kanada. Nyuma Josephine yasubiye mu Rwanda muri 1998 kugira ngo atange inkunga mu gihugu nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yatumye umubare munini w'abaturage bapfa ndetse n'igihugu cyarangiritse.
Amaze gusubira mu Rwanda ari kumwe n'umugabo we n'u mwana, Josephine yayoboye resitora y'Abashinwa, Flamingo, mu mujyi wa Kigali. Yayiyoboye iyo resitora imyaka imyaka 13 mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo kuyifunga muri 2015 nyuma yo gufata umwanzuro ko atanyuzwe n'ubucuruzi kandi kuko yashakaga kumarana umwanya n'umuryango we. Nyuma yo gufunga Flamingo, Josephine yabaye umunyamuryango wa gahunda y’amahoro binyuze mu bucuruzi yakozwe n’ikigo gishinzwe guteza imbere ubukungu bw’umugore cyibasira abagore bo mu bihugu by’u Rwanda na Afuganisitani batangiye ubucuruzi bwabo. Binyuze muri gahunda y’amahoro binyuze no mu bucuruzi, Josephine yahuye na Nancy Coldham, umujyanama ufasha mu bijyanye n’imari y’a bagore mu bihugu bikennye. Josephine yagize intangiriro yigitekerezo cyo gufungura ubucuruzi bushya muri Kigali Coldham yashishikarijwe ndetse anafashwa kubitera, anafasha Josephine kubona isoko yo gufasha muri uku gutangiza.
Coldham yabonye ubufasha m'uburyo bwa Beau's All Natural Brewing Company, uruganda rukora inzoga muri Ontario, mugihugu cya Kanada. Beau yari ashishikajwe no gutanga ibikoresho n'amahugurwa kumuntu ushaka gutangiza inzoga zabo bwite, Josephine yashoboye kubyungukiramo. Itsinda ry’abayobozi ba Beau basuye u Rwanda muri 2016 kugira ngo basuzume uko ibintu bimeze, amaherezo bituma bemera gufasha Josephine mu gutangira kwe. Nyuma y’uruzinduko rwa Beau, Josephine n'inshuti ze nshya muri Beau batangije gahunda ya Kickstarter yo gukusanya inkunga yo kunywa inzoga, bavuga akamaro k’inzoga ziri muri Rwanda ndetse na gahunda y’ubucuruzi y’u ruganda rukora kandi rukaba rufite abagore bose. Iyamamaza rya Kickstarter ryakusanyije miliyoni 95,000 z'amadolari ya kanada hamwe nabaterankunga barenga 1.000.
Uruganda rwenga inzoga.
Uruganda rwa Josephine, rwari ruteganijwe gufungura muri 2018, rugaragaramo abakozi bagizwe n’abagore bose baturutse mu turere dukikije Kigali. Uru ruganda rwenga inzoga rwari kuzakoresha ibikoresho biva mu Rwanda. Ibyingenzi binzoga nyinshi zakorwa harimo izi bitoki n'amasaka, aribintu bizwi cyane byo gukoresha mu nzoga ny'afurika. Josephine yizera ko ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imiti iciriritse y’u Rwanda rizaba intambwe nziza ku gihugu muri rusange kuva u Rwanda rwishimira kunywa byeri kandi kuba rushobora kugira iyo mikorore ikorerwa mu karere bizaba isoko y’ingufu zihuza ibihugu.

Turatsinze Théogène (yavukiye mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda muri 1970, yicishwe hagati ya 11 na 15 Ukwakira 2012 muri Mozambike) aho yari umucuruzi na rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka mu Rwanda.
Amaze kwiga icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza mu gihugu cye, yimukiye muri Mozambike, aho yakoraga imyaka itari mike, nyuma yaho arangiza amasomo ye afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu micungire muri kaminuza Gatolika ya Ositaraliya i Sydney. Yasubiye mu Rwanda, aba umuyobozi mukuru wa Banki ishinzwe iterambere ry’u Rwanda ya BRD muri 2005. Yirukanywe kuri uwo mwanya muri 2007. Yongeye kwimukira muri Mozambike, aho yabaye umuyobozi wungirije wa kaminuza Gatolika ya São Tomãs de Moçambique kugeza apfuye.
Yaburiwe irengero kuva ku ya 11 cyangwa 12 Ukwakira 2012, i Maputo. Umurambo we wabonetse ku ya 15, uboshye ndetse ureremba mu nyanja. Polisi yo muri Mozambike yabanje kwerekana uruhare rwa guverinoma y'u Rwanda mu bwicanyi, hanyuma isubiza inyuma icyo kirego. Turatsinze yatekerezaga ko yari afite amakuru y’ishoramari ya politiki yerekeranye na bamwe mu bayobozi ba guverinoma y’u Rwanda, yerekeranye n’amafaranga ya Banki y’iterambere. Iyicwa rye ritamenyekanye, ryasobanuwe nk'amateka y’urupfu rw’amayoberane rw’abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi cyangwa abumva ko barwanya leta ya Paul Kagame mu Rwanda. Ikinyamakuru kizwi cya The Zimbabwean kivuga ku rupfu rwa Seth Sendashonga (umunywanyi wo mu rwego rwo hejuru wo mu rwego rwa politiki wishwe muri Kenya muri 1998), Jean-Léonard Rugambage (umunyamakuru wishwe i Kigali mu 2010), na Charles Ingabire (umunyamakuru wishwe muri Uganda muri 2011); yavuze nanone kandi kuri Kayumba Nyamwasa, wahoze mu bagize iperereza ry'u Rwanda warokotse umugambi wo kumwica muri 2010. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, Umuyoboro wa 4 w’Ubwongereza wahuzaga urupfu rwa Turatsinze n’a bavuzwe, ndetse nk’urupfu rw’umunyapolitiki André Kagwa Rwisereka wishwe muri 2010, avuga kandi ibirego by’uruhare rwa guverinoma y’u Rwanda.

Ashish J. Thakkar ni rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka mu Rwanda. Niwe washinze Mara Group na Mara Foundation, akaba ari nawe washinze Atlas Mara Limited. Thakkar akaba yavukiye mu Bwongereza, ariko yimukira muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba akiri ingimbi mbere yo gushinga Mara Group, ihuriro ry’Abanyafurika, afite imyaka 15. Ibikorwa bya Mara Group nishoramari bikorera m'ubihugu bigera 22 by'Afurika. Ni umwanditsi w'Intare Ikanguka, Ibyabaye mu gitangaza cyu bukungu bwa Afurika.
Thakkar ni umwe mu bagize ihuriro ry’ubukungu bw’isi ku bayobozi bato ku isi, kandi yashyizwe ku rutonde rw’ikinyamakuru Fortune ku rutonde rwa mbere imunsi 40 y’imyaka 40 muri 2013. Yahawe igihembo cya Base Leadership Award mu birori bya MTV Africa Music Awards 2014. ikinyamakuru Esquire y'amwise umuntu w’umwaka wo mu burasirazuba bwo hagati muri 2016.
Muri 2015, Thakkar yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Inama y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe kwihangira imirimo ku isi naho muri 2017, agirwa umuyobozi w’itsinda ngishwanama ry’urubyiruko rwa Perezida muri Banki nyafurika ishinzwe iterambere;
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Umuryango wa Thakkar wimukiye muri leta ya Gujarat yo mu Buhinde muri Afurika mu 1890. Thakkar yavukiye i Leicester muri 1981. Yabayeho mu bwana bwe mu ishuri rya Rushey Mead mu itsinda rya Belvoir S. Ababyeyi be bari barimukiye mu Bwongereza mu 1972 igihe Idi Amin yashyiraga mu bikorwa kwirukana Abanyaziya muri Uganda. Thakkar n'umuryango we basubiye muri Afurika gutura mu Rwanda mbere yuko bongera guhatirwa kugenda kubera jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994. Umuryango wa Thakkar wahungiye mu Burundi mbere yo gutura muri Uganda nk'impunzi. Ku myaka 15, Thakkar yaretse ishuri kugira ngo atangire ubucuruzi bwe ku nguzanyo y'amadorari 5,000.
Thakkar yashinze isosiyete ye bwite, yitwa Mara Group, muri 1996 afite imyaka 15. Yatangiye atumiza ibice bya mudasobwa birimo ahanini claviers, mouses, na desktops kuva m'urugendo rwa buri cyumweru i Dubai. Thakkar amaze kubona inguzanyo y'amadorari 5,000 yo gutangiza isosiyete ye, yafunguye ubucuruzi buciriritse bwa IT m'isoko ry’ubucuruzi hakurya y'umuhanda uva mu iduka rya se i Kampala.
Mu myaka icumi yakurikiyeho, Thakkar yaguye Mara Group mu inganda, imitungo itimukanwa, ubuhinzi na serivisi za IT. Nyuma Thakkar yimuye icyicaro gikuru i Dubai, ariko akomereza ubucuruzi muri Afurika.
Muri 2013, Thakkar yatangaje kubufatanye na Bob Diamond gutangiza Atlas Mara, isosiyete ishora imari mu bigo by’a mabanki y’ubucuruzi mur'afurika. Diamond wahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru wa Barclays, na Thakkar bahuriye mu nama babinyujije ku ruhande rwabo, hari Mara Foundation na Fondasiyo ya Diamond. Thakkar na Diamond bakusanyije inkunga ingana na miliyoni 325 z'amadolari y'amerika mu Kuboza 2013, mbere yo gushyira ku rutonde iyi sosiyete ku isoko ry'imigabane rya London. Igiciro cy'imigabane cyakomeje kugabanuka gahoro gahoro kandi kigera cyatakaje 95% byigiciro cya IPO. Ikimenyetso cya ticker i Londres ni ATMA. LN, m'ugihe muri Amerika, amatike yari AAMAF.
Thakkar yashinze ikigo Mara Foundation, isosiyete idaharanira inyungu itanga inama kandi igatera inkunga ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato bo mu Afurika, muri 2009. Mara Mentor, yari porogaramu igendanwa ihuza ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato n’inzobere mu bucuruzi, yatangijwe binyuze muri Mara Foundations.
Muri Kamena 2014, Thakkar yitabiriye ibirori bya Global Accelerator yakiriwe na Fondasiyo y’umuryango w’a bibumbye hamwe ibiro by’umuryango w’abibumbye bishinzwe ubufatanye kugira ngo baganire ku kwihangira imirimo mu ntego za Loni. Thakkar yerekanye kandi akora mu birori bya ba rwiyemezamirimo barenga 100 n'abayobozi ba Loni barimo Michael Dell, Barbara Bush na Arianna Huffington. Muri Kanama 2014, Thakkar yitabiriye inama y’Amerika n'afurika, yakiriwe ndetse na White House, ari kumwe na Bill Clinton wahoze ari Perezida w'amerika. Yagiye kandi mu ishyirahamwe ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku bagore, kandi yari umushyitsi mukuru mu nama y’urubyiruko y’a bagiraneza ya Emirates Foundation muri Gushyingo 2014.

Eisha Stephen Atieno Odhiambo (1945 - 25 Gashyantare 2009 Yari Umwarimu wavukiye ahitwa i Muhoroni, akaba yaramenyekanye cyane cyane kubera umusanzu yagiye atanga mu kumvikanisha akaga/ibyago karangwa muri politiki yubumenyi na sociologie y'imbaraga. Dr Odhiambo yari kandi umwarimu w’amateka muri kaminuza ya Rice muri Amerika, aho yari umuyobozi mu bijyanye no mu kwiga imico. Yize muri kaminuza ya Makerere muri gihugu cya Uganda na kaminuza ya Nairobi muri Kenya.
Odhiambo yasezeye muri kaminuza ya Rice kubera uburwayi maze we n'umufasha we basubira mu rugo rwabo i Ndere, Siaya, muri Kenya, mbere y'urupfu rwe mu 2009 mu bitaro bya Aga Khan i Kisumu.

Porofeseri Chacha Nyaigotti-Chacha (wavutse ku ya 22 Kanama 1952 mu Karere ka Kuria, Intara ya Nyanza, muri Kenya) ni umwanditsi w'amakinamico wo muri Kenya kandi wize cyane. Yabaye umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’inama nkuru ya kaminuza muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba (2000 – 2010), kandi yabaye umuyobozi wa mbere w’ikigo cy’inguzanyo cy’amashuri makuru (Higher Education Loans Board) cyo mu gihugu cya Kenya (1995 – 2000). Kuri ubu akora nk'umuyobozi wa komisiyo ishinzwe uburezi muri kaminuza ya Kenya (CUE).
Yize muri Kenyatta College, ahabwa BEd (y'Icyubahiro) (Ururimi rw'igiswahiri), nyuma yiga muri kaminuza ya Yale, ahabwa impamyabumenyi yisumbuyeho (MA) mu bijyanye n'indimi za Anthropologique n'impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (Ph.D.) mu rurimi rw'igiswahili. Yabaye Umwarimu w'umunyeshuri n’Umwarimu mu rurimi rw’igiswahili n’indimi muri kaminuza ya Kenyatta nyuma akaza no kwigisha muri kaminuza ya Egerton muri Kenya. Yabaye Umwarimu w’ubushakashatsi mu kigo cy’ubufatanye bw’akarere n’iterambere rya kaminuza gatolika yo muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba.
