KCB Group Limited, (KCB), ni serivisi y’imari ifite isosiyete ikora mari ikorera mu karere ka Afurika y'Ibiyaga Bigari. Icyicaro cy’iryo tsinda kiri i Nairobi, muri Kenya, amashami yayo akaba ari KCB Bank Kenya Limited, KCB Bank Burundi Limited, KCB Bank Rwanda Limited, KCB Bank y'Amajyepfo Sudani Limited, KCB Bank Tanzania Limited, KCB TMB Congo na KCB Bank Uganda Limited.
Kugeza muri Kuboza 2017, Itsinda ryari rifite umutungo wa Miliyari 6.47 z'amadolari ya Amerika (nka KSh: Miliyari 646.7) hamwe n’abanyamigabane bangana na Miliyari 1.06 z'amadolari (KSh: miliyari 105.97 z'amadolari). Muri Nyakanga 2015, ibitangazamakuru by'amakuru byatangaje ko iryo tsinda rikurikirana gahunda yo kwagura muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Etiyopiya, na Mozambike.
Amateka ya Banki y’ubucuruzi ya Kenya Limited yatangiye guhera muri Nyakanga 1896, igihe uwayibanjirije, Banki nkuru y’Ubuhinde (NBI), yafunguye ishami i Mombasa kugira ngo akore ubucuruzi icyo cyambu cyari gikurura icyo gihe.
Muri 1958, Banki ya Grindlays yifatanije na NBI ishinga Banki nkuru y’igihugu na Grindlays (NGB). Nyuma y'ubwigenge, guverinoma ya Kenya yaguze imigabane 60% muri NGB mu rwego rwo kurushaho kwegera amabanki hafi ya benshi mu Banyakenya. Mu 1970, guverinoma yaguze 100 ku ijana by'imigabane muri NGB kugira ngo igenzure neza banki nini y'ubucuruzi muri Kenya. NGB yaje kwitwa Banki y'Ubucuruzi ya Kenya, (KCB). Mu 1972, KCB yaguze Savings &amp; Loan Kenya Limited, izobereye mu bijyanye n’imari y’inguzanyo.
Muri 1988, 20 ku ijana bya mbere by’imigabane ya guverinoma muri iyo sosiyete byagurishijwe binyuze mu Isoko rya mbere ryatangiwe ku isoko ry’imigabane rya Nairobi. Guverinoma mu myaka yashize yagabanije imigabane yayo igera kuri 23,6 ku ijana. Mu kibazo cy’uburenganzira bw’umwaka wa 2010, guverinoma yakomeje kugabanya imigabane yayo igera kuri 17.31 ku ijana.
Umugabane witsinda rya KCB urutonde kurutonde rwimigabane ya Nairobi munsi yikimenyetso KCB. Imigabane yitsinda ry'ambukiranya urutonde rwimigabane ya Dar es Salaam, Isoko ry’imigabane mu Rwanda, n’ivunjisha rya Uganda.
Kugeza ku ya 31 Ukuboza 2017, abanyamigabane icumi bakomeye mu itsinda rya KCB bari ku rutonde rukurikira:
Umuyobozi w'inama y'ubutegetsi ya banki ni Andrew Wambari Kairu. Paul Russo ni umuyobozi mukuru akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru w'itsinda rya banki.
Banki y’ubucuruzi ya Kenya Burundi Limited ni banki y’ubucuruzi n’ishami ry’itsinda rya KCB muri Burundi, byemewe na Banki ya Repubulika y’U burundi, umugenzuzi w’amabanki mu gihugu. KCB Burundi igizwe 0,6 ku ijana by'u mutungo wose wa KCB. Biteganijwe ko umutungo wa banki wose wari hafi miliyoni 33.6 z'amadolari ya Amerika (KSh 3.34), guhera muri Kuboza 2015.
Muri Gashyantare 2012, Itsinda rya KCB ryemerewe amabwiriza yo gushinga ishami mu Burundi. Ku ya 8 Gicurasi 2012, KCB Burundi yatangiye gutanga serivisi z’amabanki, imaze guhabwa uruhushya rw’amabanki y’ubucuruzi ku ya 18 Mata 2012. Ishinzwe, KCB ibaye itsinda rya mbere rya serivisi zimari yashinze amashami mubihugu byose byumuryango wibihugu bya Afrika yuburasirazuba.

Repubulika y'inkoko ni urusobe ry'ibiryo byihuta by'abanijeriya baherewe ubushobozi mubyerekeranye n'ubunararibonye mu guteka inkoko, cyane cyane inkoko zikaranze. Yashinzwe na Deji Akinyanju, naho resitora ya mbere yashinzwe i Apapa, i Lagos mu mwaka wa 2004. Resitora ya mbere y’inkoko yafunguwe i Lagos mu mwaka wa 2004, ubu ikaba icuruza ahantu hasaga 150 muri Nijeriya na Gana.
Repubulika y'inkoko ifite icyicaro i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Sosiyete ikora ibiryo muri Nigeriya.
Iyi sosiyete twavuga ko muri Nijeriya ariyo nini cyane muri resitora y’inkoko ifite ibyicaro bisaga 40 i Lagos hamwe n’ibindi byicaro bisaga 190 mu gihugu hose. Repubulika y'inkoko kandi yaguye serivisi mu bindi bihugu byo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba harimo na Gana.

Kassim Basma (wavutse mu 1960 mu mujyi wa Koidu, muri Siyera Lewone) ni umuherwe w’umucuruzi wo muri Siyera Lewone kandi akaba uwa kabiri mu bihugu byohereza ibicuruzwa bya diyama hanze y'igihugu muri Siyera Lewone, bingana na 38% by’ibicuruzwa byoherezwa na diyama byo muri Siyera Lewone. Basma yavukiye mu Karere ka Kono mu burasirazuba bwa Siyera Lewone. Yavukiye mu muryango ukomoka mu gihugu cya Libani ukomoka mu mudugudu wa Ain Baal wo mu majyepfo ya Libani. Ni umwe mu bagize umuryango wa Basma, umwe mu miryango ya cyera cyane ikomoka muri Libani mu gihugu cya Siyera Lewone.

Hajia Jumai Bello ni umuyobozi mukuru w'itangazamakuru mu gihugu cya Nijeriya. Niwe mugore wa mbere wabaye umuyobozi wa radiyo muri radiyo ya Bauchi. Yabaye umuyobozi wa mbere w’umugore uyobora Bauchi Radio Corporation. Yemejwe n'uwahoze ari guverineri Mohammed Abubakar wo muri Leta ya Bauchi. Mbere yo kugirwa MD (umuyobozi mukuru) w'ikigo, yakoraga nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe amakuru n'ibikorwa bigezweho. Mu 1982, yarangije muri kaminuza ya Bayero, i Kano aho yize itumanaho rusange.

Kilimanjaro ni umuyoboro wihuta wa resitora muri Nigeriya wafunguwe mu mwaka wa 2004 ukaba ufite icyicaro i Port Harcourt. Iyi resitora ni imwe mu ziri kuzamuka vuba muri Nijeriya. Uyu munsi ifite ibyicaro bisaga 51 muri Nijeriya, harimo umurwa mukuru wa Abuja, Lagos, ndetse no mu bindi bice bya federasiyo.
Kilimanjaro ifitwe na marike ya resitora ya Sundry Foods, kandi bakorera mu murenge w'ihuse wa Resitora (QSR). Kilimanjaro kuva yatangira kwigaragaza nk'imbaraga zo gutumbagira mu kirere, kandi izwi nk'imwe mu murikagurisha rya resitora ryihuta cyane muri Nijeriya, rifite amaduka arenga 48 akorera ahantu hatandukanye.

"Mama Cass Resitora" ni imwe mu masosiyete ashingiye ku biribwa muri Nijeriya.
Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 1983, Charis Grace Onabowale yafunguye ahantu ha mbere kuri Allen Avenue, Ikeja, muri Leta ya Lagos. Isoko rya mbere ryatwaye bwa mbere ikirango cya "Mama Cass Cafeteria". Muri iki gihe Mama Cass Resitora ifite urusobe rw’amaresitora agera kuri 14 yihuta mu kunoza serivisi za resitora ndetse inagura aho ikorera mu tundi turere tw’igihugu. Usibye Lagos, andi mashami aherereye mu zindi ntara za Nigeriya harimo Ogun, Edo, FCT, ndetse no mu Bwongereza. Mama Cass n'inzobere mu mafunguro gakondo (afurika) yo mu rugo hamwe no guteka ibiryo mpuzamahanga nibindi bintu nka Oven Fresh pasties, Jaydens Sliced Bread. Usibye urusobe rwa resitora, banakora imigati ndetse n'inganda nazo zirakora. Yagutse kandi mu micungire ya kantine y'inganda, ibikorwa byigenga byokurya no gutanga imigati myinshi.

Mr Bigg's ni imwe muri resitora zigira ibiryo byihuta byo muri Nigeriya. Ifitwe na sosiyete Nyafurika Yunze ubumwe ya Nijeriya PLC, kuri ubu hari ahantu hafi 170 muri Nijeriya, harimo na resitora ya mbere yakirira abakiriya mu modoka batavuye mu binyabiziga byabo muri iki gihugu, hamwe n’ibindi bine muri Gana. Mu mwaka wa 2013, Itsinda ry'Ibyamamare byo muri Afurika yepfo, byaguze imigabane 49% muri rwarusobe rw'amaduka.
Resitora izwiho ibara ry'umutuku n'umuhondo hamwe n'ibiryo by'inyama. Amateka ya Mr Bigg yatangirana n'amaduka ya kawa imbere y'ububiko bwa Kingsway mu myaka ya za 1960. Mu mwaka wa 1973, ayo maduka yiswe Kingsway Rendezvous, aba Mr Bigg mu mwaka wa 1986. Urwo rusobe rw'amaduka rwagutse vuba nyuma yo kuba rumwe mu masosiyete ya mbere yo muri Nigeriya yagurishije impushya ku bashoramari.

Tantalizers ni umuyoboro wambere wihuta kandi ukagira ibiryo bimeze neza bya abanijeriya. Yafunguye aho gukorera ha mbere ahagana mu mwaka wa 1997 mumujyi wa Festac, Lagos. Aha hantu bwa mbere habanje resitora ntoya y'abaturanyi yakoraga hamburg. Intsinzi ya mbere babonye aha hantu yabagejeje ku kwaguka kwatumye habaho sosiyete ndetse banaboneraho impushya zo gufungura andi ma resitora mumijyi nka Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja, na Port Harcourt. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2015, iyi resitora yari ifite andi mashami agera kuri 50 muri Nijeriya. Tantalizers itanga ibiryo byihuta byo muri Nigeriya nk'ibinyama, umugati urimo amagi, inkoko, umuceri wa jollof, umuceri ukaranze, keke, na hamburg.

Ifashabayo Dejoie Sylvain (yavutse ku ya 30 Mata 1994) ni rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka mu Rwanda. Yashinze umuryango Hope initiative muri 2016. Ni umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Anidaso.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Dejoie yavukiye mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda, ku Kamonyi akurira mu mujyi wa Kigali. Muri 2015, yimukiye muri Gana mu gukurikirana amashuri makuru muri kaminuza ya Ashesi nk'umuhanga wa MasterCard.
Dejoie yize muri Lycée de Kigali mu mashuri yisumbuye. Kuri ubu ari muri kaminuza ya Ashesi atanga Ubuyobozi n'Ubuyobozi
Ibihembo no kumenyekana.
Yakiriye ibihembo byinshi nka MasterCard bourse Award. Kuri ubu ni mugenzi wa Dalai Lama. Afite kandi ibihembo muri kaminuza ya Ashesi nka, yatsindiye ikibuga kinini.

Ishoramari muri Afurika ni ibikorwa byo gushyira imari mu bikorwa by’ubukungu, imishinga cyangwa imitungo bigamije kubona inyungu mu gihe kizaza. Rikorwa n’abashoramari bo ku mugabane wa Afurika ndetse n’abaturuka mu mahanga, kandi rikorwa mu nzego zirimo ibikorwa remezo, ubuhinzi, ingufu, ikoranabuhanga, ubucuruzi n’inganda
Umugabane wa Afurika ukomeje kwakira igice gito cy’ishoramari mpuzamahanga ugereranyije n’indi migabane, ariko ukagaragaza amahirwe menshi yo kubona inyungu ku bashoramari. Ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, umutungo kamere, amasoko agenda yaguka ndetse n’ivugurura ry’amategeko agamije koroshya ubucuruzi biri mu bituma inyota yo gushora imari muri Afurika ikomeza kwiyongera
Mugihe mu mwaka wa 2050 ahandi kw'isi abaturage bazaba bagabanuka muri Afurika ho bazaba barikubye aho bazaba bangana na 25̥% by'abaturage batuye isi bose bavuye kuri 17%.
Nubwo Afurika ifite amahirwe menshi y’ishoramari, hari imbogamizi zikomeje kugabanya umuvuduko w’ishoramari kuri uyu mugabane. Muri zo harimo imiyoborere idahagije, ruswa, amakimbirane ya politiki, umutekano muke, ibibazo by’ibikorwa remezo ndetse n’amabwiriza y’ubucuruzi adahoraho mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe. Izi nzitizi zishobora gutuma bamwe mu bashoramari bagira impungenge zo gushora imari yabo muri Afurika cyangwa bagasaba ingamba zihariye zo kugabanya ibyago by’ishoramari.
Ingamba zo koroshya ishoramari muri Afurika.
Umugabane w'Afurika witeze imbaraga mu ishoramari riturutse hanze y'umugabane w'afurika aho rizatiza imbaraga ishoramari mu bikorwa remezo ribariwa muyagera kuri Miliyari 108̯$ ku mwaka.
Raporo ya W orld Bank Doinng Busoness ya 2017 yari ibaye ku nshuro ya 14, aho iba isuzuma amabwiriza n'ibisabwa kugirango mu gihugu runaka umuntu atangire bizinesi.
Muri ibyo harimo kureba uko umuntu yoroherezwa gutangira businesi, guhabwa ibyangombwa byo kubaka, kugezwaho amashanyarazi, kwandikisha umutungo, kubona inguzanyo, kurinda abashoramari baciriritse n'ibindi birimo kwishyura imisoro.

Great Lakes Energy yashinzwe na Sam Dargan muri 2005. Ni Isosiyete ifite icyicaro mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda kandi ikorera cyane isoko rya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Isosiyete ifite ubuhanga bwo gukoresha ingufu zituruka ku mirasire y'izuba. Mu myaka icumi ishize, isosiyete yibanda cyane mu gusobanukirwa no gukemura ibibazo by’ingufu by’abo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Uyu munsi dukoresha ubwo bumenyi nuburambe mugushushanya, kubaka, no kubungabunga sisitemu yizuba yizewe, irambye, kandi ihendutse. Isosiyete itanga imiryango itegamiye kuri leta, ibitaro, n’ishuri hamwe na sisitemu nziza y’amafoto. Isosiyete ifite ubuhanga bwo kuvugurura ibishushanyo mbonera bya PV bituruka kuri grid hamwe na verisiyo nziza. Mubihe byashize iyi sosiyete yatanze akazi ko guhugura abanyarwanda baho uburyo bwo gukora injeniyeri no gushyiraho sisitemu. Isosiyete kandi yatanze amahugurwa kubandi ba rwiyemezamirimo bashinzwe imibereho biga gukorera muri Afurika.
Ingufu nini zo mu biyaga bigari zikwirakwiza amatara ya sun King lamps nka Green Light Energy muri 2013 zemerera gutanga igisubizo cyu mucyo urambye ingo zo mucyaro mu Rwanda.
Mu mwaka wo muri 2014, ingufu z’ibiyaga bigari zafatanije na Global Bright Light Foundation gukwirakwiza amatara y’umwami w’izuba ku mpunzi ziri mu nkambi y’impunzi ya UNHCR Kiziba muri Rwanda.

Rwamagana Solar Power Station ni urugomero rw'amashanyarazi aho akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba rukora wate 8.5MW mu Rwanda,kandi ruri m'ubukungu bwa kane mu bunini muri muryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Rwamagana Solar Power Station ni urugomero rw'amashanyarazi aho akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba rukora wate 8.5MW mu Rwanda, ruri m'ubukungu bwa kane mu bunini muri muryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi yiherereye ku butaka budakodeshwa, mu kigo cy;umudugudu w'urubyiruko rwa Agahozo shallom, mu karere ka
Rwamagana mu ntara y;iburasirazuba nko mu birometero 58 ku muhanda, mu majyepfo y;uburasirazuba bwa kigali.
(-2.026111:uburebure:30.37722
Muri Nyakanga 2013, guverinoma y'u Rwanda yagiranye amasezerano na GigaWatt Global, isosiyete yo mu Buholandi, guteza imbere urugomero rw'amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba ya Megawatt 8.5 mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, ku giciro cy'amadorari miliyoni 23 z'amadolari y'Amerika (miliyari 15 z'amafaranga). Giga Watt Global yatera inkunga, kubaka, gutunga no gukoresha icyo kigo imyaka 25, hamwe n’ingufu zakozwe zagurishijwe mu Rwanda Energy, ikigo cy’amashanyarazi mu gihugu.kandi uyu mushinga ukaba utanga ingufu zikomoka ku izuba.
Muri Gashyantare 2014, GigaWatt Global yashoboye kugera ku ihagarikwa ry’amafaranga, bituma kubaka bitangira. Guhuza imiyoboro y'amashanyarazi y'igihugu byagezweho muri Nyakanga 2014, kandi muri Nzeri 2014, urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwakoraga ku bushobozi buhebuje. Sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi igizwe na 28.360 panele yamashanyarazi ikwirakwizwa kuri muri 50 z' umurima. Igiciro cya nyuma cyubwubatsi, harimo nigiciro cyo kugera kuri gride yigihugu cyageze kuri miliyoni 23.7 z'amafaranga y'uRwanda. Inkunga yaturutse ahantu henshi, harimo (a) Isosiyete ishinzwe imari y’iterambere ry’Ubuholandi (b) Ikigega cy’ibikorwa Remezo cya Afurika kivuka na (c) Norfund. Ishyirahamwe ry’ishoramari ryigenga muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika hamwe n’ubufatanye bwa ingufu n’ibidukikije muri Finilande byatanze inkunga.
Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi iherereye ku butaka bukodeshwa, mu kigo cy’umudugudu w’urubyiruko rwa Agahozo Shalom, mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Rwanda rw’iburasirazuba, nko mu kilometero 58 kumuhanda, mu majyepfo yuburasirazuba bwa Kigali. sitasiyo yamashanyarazi iherereye kuri: 2 ° 01'34.0 "S, 30 ° 22'38.0" E (Ubunini: -2.026111; Uburebure: 30.377222).
Muri Nyakanga 2013, guverinoma y'u Rwanda yagiranye amasezerano na GigaWatt Global, isosiyete yo mu Buholandi, guteza imbere urugomero rw'amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba ya Megawatt 8.5 mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, ku giciro cy'amadorari miliyoni 23 z'amadolari y'Amerika (miliyari 15 z'amafaranga). Giga Watt Global yatera inkunga, kubaka, gutunga no gukoresha icyo kigo imyaka 25, hamwe n’ingufu zakozwe zagurishijwe mu Rwanda Energy, ikigo cy’amashanyarazi mu gihugu.

Uru rugomero rukora imyirasire hifashishijwe Silicon. Imyirasire aho iba iteretse igenda yerekeza aho izuba ryerekeza,mu gitondo yerekeza iburasirazuba nimugoroba ikerekeza iburengerazuba saa Sitaiba ireba hejuruI. Uko iyo myirasire yubakiye biratangaje kuba ibasha kugana aha izuba rigana.

Kawanda–Birembo High Voltage Power Line ni uruganda rukora amashanyarazi, rurimo kubakwa hagati y'u Rwanda na Uganda.
Umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi wa kilovolt zigera kuri 220 utangirira kuri sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi ya Uganda ahitwa Kawanda, mu Karere ka Wakiso, mu karere ko hagati ya Uganda, nko muri kilometero 15.5, mumajyaruguru ya Kampala, umurwa mukuru nu mujyi munini wa Uganda. Kuva aha, umurongo ujya mu majyepfo y’iburengerazuba bwa Uganda umujyi wa Masaka, intera igororotse igera kuri kilometero 121. Kuva i Masaka, umurongo w'amashanyarazi ukomeza iburengerazuba ugana mu mujyi wa Mbarara, intera igororotse igera kuri kilometeero 1310. Kuva Mbarara umurongo w'amashanyarazi ugenda werekeza mu majyepfo ugana mu mujyi wa Mirama Hills, intera ya kilometero 66. Uhereye kuri sitasiyo yo mu gace ka Mirama Hills / Kagitumba, umurongo w'amashanyarazi urakomeza werekeza mu majyepfo y'iburengerazuba kugira ngo urangire kuri sitasiyo i Birembo, Umurenge wa Kinyinya, Akarere ka Gasabo, u Rwanda, mu nkengero z'amajyaruguru ya Kigali, umurwa mukuru n'umujyi munini. y'u Rwanda, intera igororotse igera kuri kolometero 110.
Uyu murongo w'amashanyarazi uhuza umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi wa Uganda n'u Rwanda ruturanye. Ijyanye na gahunda y'ibikorwa byo mu biyaga bya Nil Ekwatoriya, Guhuza umushinga w'amashanyarazi, iyobowe n'umuyobozi w'akarere, Grania Rubomboras. Uyu murongo w'amashanyarazi urimo gutezwa imbere hamwe na Karuma y’amashanyarazi ya Karuma, biteganijwe ko umusaruro wa 600 MW uzakoreshwa mu karere ndetse n’amafaranga asigaye akagurishwa mu karere, u Rwanda, u Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo bikaba bishoboka ko ari abakiriya.
Ubwubatsi muri Uganda.
Umushinga kuruhande rwa Uganda ugabanyijemo ibice bitatu: (a) igice cya Kawanda - Masaka, gipima kilometero 137 (b) igice cya Masaka - Mbarara, gipima kilometero130 na (c) igice cya Mbarara - Mirama Hills, gipima kilometero 66.
Igice cya Kawanda ugana Masaka cyubatswe ku ngengo y’imari ingana na miliyoni 153.20 z’amadolari y’Amerika, muri yo Banki y’isi ikaba yagurije miliyoni 120 z'amadolare. Kurangiza byari biteganijwe muri Mutarama 2019. Icyakora, muri Nyakanga 2018, Daily Monitor yatangaje ko umurongo wa 220 kV watangijwe.
Igice cya Masaka kugeza Mbarara cyateganijwe miliyoni 50 z'amayero, kugurizwa mu kigega cy’ibikorwa remezo cy’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi. Biteganijwe ko imirimo izatangira mu gihembwe cya kane cya 2017 bikaba biteganijwe ko izarangira muri 2019. Muri Werurwe 2018, Ikinyamakuru Uganda Independent cyatangaje ko guverinoma ya Uganda yagurije miliyoni 37.1 z'amayero mu kigo cy’iterambere ry’Ubufaransa n’indi miliyoni 35 z’amayero muri Banki y’iterambere ry’Ubudage kugira ngo itere inkunga igice cya Masaka-Mbarara cy’uyu murongo.
Igice cya Mbarara Mirama Hills cyarangiye mu 2015.
Ubwubatsi mu Rwanda.
Igice cya Mirama / Kagitumba - Birembo gipima hafi kilometero 100. Igice cya Mbarara - Birembo gipima kilometero 166. Nkuko byatangajwe na EastAfrican muri Gicurasi 2015, uyu muyoboro wa 220 kV umaze kubaho. U Rwanda narwo ruri mu nzira yo kubaka sitasiyo ya 220 kV i Birembo.
Amajyambere ya vuba.
Ku munsi ukurikiraho, biteganijwe ko umurongo wa Kawanda Birembo Umuyoboro mwinshi w'amashanyarazi uzamurwa kuri 400kV. Muri Gicurasi 2018, guverinoma ya Uganda yagujije miliyoni 37.1 z'amayero (hafi miliyoni 44.2 z'amadolari y'Amerika), mu kigo gishinzwe iterambere ry'Ubufaransa, kugira ngo izamure kilometero 135, hagati yimijyi ya Masaka na Mbarara kugeza 400 kV. Mu Gushyingo 2020, ikinyamakuru New Vision cyatangaje ko Banki ishinzwe iterambere ry’Ubudage (KfW) yateye inkunga igice cyo kuzamura igice cya Masaka - Masaka kigera kuri 400kV.

Kigoma–Butare–Ngozi–Gitega High Voltage Power Line, ni umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi uhuza u Rwanda - Burundi, U ni umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi munini, urimo kubakwa, uhuza amashanyarazi menshi i Kigoma mu Rwanda n'undi muyoboro munini wa Gitega mu Burundi.
Umurongo w'amashanyarazi wa kilovolt 220 utangirira mu itsinda ry’ingufu z’u Rwanda (REG) 220kV mu mujyi wa Kigoma Rwanda, hafi kilometero 76.5, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda. Kuva aha, umurongo w'amashanyarazi ujya mu majyepfo ya Rwanda mu mujyi wa Butare (Huye), umuhanda uri hagati y'ibirometero muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 51. Kuva i Butare, umurongo w'amashanyarazi ukomeza mu majyepfo kugera ku mupaka mpuzamahanga n'Uburundi. Yambuka umupaka ikomeza igana mu mujyi wa Ngozi, intera y'ibirometero bigera kuri muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 75
Kuva i Ngozi, umurongo w'amashanyarazi ugenda werekeza mu majyepfo ugana mu mujyi wa Gitega, umurwa mukuru w'u Burundi, umuhanda uri hagati y'ibirometero muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 83, bikarangirira ku zindi 220 kV, iyi ifitwe na REGIDESO Burundi. Uburebure bw'uyu murongo w'amashanyarazi ngo ni muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 140.7, kuva ku mpera kugeza ku iherezo, hamwe na muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 61.5 mu Rwanda na muyoboro w'amashanyarazi 79.2 mu Burundi.
Uyu muyoboro w'amashanyarazi uhuza umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi w'u Rwanda n'uw'abaturanyi b'Uburundi. Ijyanye na gahunda y'ibikorwa byo mu biyaga bya Nil Ekwatoriya, Guhuza umushinga w'amashanyarazi, iyobowe n'umuyobozi w'akarere, Grania Rubomboras. Umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi urimo gutegurwa mu rwego rwo koroshya guhanahana amashanyarazi hagati y'ibihugu byombi bituranye no kwitegura kugura amashanyarazi mu bindi bihugu byo muri afurika y'Iburasirazuba Power Pool (EAPP), ifite ingufu zisumbuye zo kugurisha. Ibihugu bifite ingufu zisagutse muri EAPP birimo Etiyopiya, Kenya na Uganda.
Ubwubatsi mu Burundi.
Ubwubatsi mu Burundi bwatangiye muri Kanama 2020. Amasezerano y'ubwubatsi, amasoko nu bwubatsi (EPC) yahawe ihuriro rigizwe na "Transrail Lighting" yo mu buhinde na "Hanbaek" ukomoka muri Koreya yepfo. Igice cy'Uburundi cy'uyu muyoboro w'amashanyarazi giterwa inkunga n'inguzanyo zahawe leta y'Uburundi, gitangwa na Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere ndetse n'Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi.
Ubwubatsi mu Rwanda.
Muri 2018, byavuzwe ko KfW igiye gutera inkunga igice cy'u Rwanda kuri uyu murongo w'amashanyarazi. Mu 2022, ibitangazamakuru byo kuri interineti byatangaje ko umurongo wose mu bihugu byombi uzaterwa inkunga na Banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere ndetse n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi.
Umurongo w'amashanyarazi wakozwe muburyo butuma ikora kuri 110 kV cyangwa 220 kV, niba nibikenewe. Akazi karimo kubaka insimburangingo nshya kuri Kigoma na Gitega, ndetse no guhuza impande zombi z'umurongo w'amashanyarazi ugana ibigo bigenzura i Kigali, u Rwanda mu majyaruguru na Bujumbura, u Burundi mu majyepfo.

Ikoreshwa ry'ingufu mu Rwanda ririmo guhinduka vuba mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cyo muri 21.
Ingano y'amashanyarazi ni nke cyane kandi yibanze cyane hafi ya Kigali. Benshi mu gihugu bakoresha inkwi nk’isoko nya mukuru y’ingufu. U Rwanda ruteganya kwaguka kuva kuri MW 276 z'amashanyarazi muri 2022 rukagera kuri MW 556 muri 2024 kandi rushobora gutumiza amashanyarazi y’inyongera mu bihugu duturanye. Byongeye kandi, irimo gushyiraho imirasire y'izuba ntoya mu gihugu hose kugira ngo ingo ziherereye mu turere twa gride zitabona amashanyarazi, cyangwa zifashe guhangana n’umuriro w'amashanyarazi. Kugeza ubu, guverinoma irateganya kugeza amashanyarazi ku baturage 100% mu 2024, bitandukanye na 74.5% muri 2022.
Hamwe n’ibikorwa remezo by’amashanyarazi bigarukira, u Rwanda rufite urwego rwo hejuru rwo gukoresha ingufu zishobora kongera ingufu. Amashanyarazi menshi mu gihugu aturuka ku mashanyarazi. Umusaruro w'amashanyarazi wagize 4% by'ingufu zikoreshwa mu gihugu muri 2014,
53% by'amashanyarazi bitangwa niganda nto z'amashanyarazi. Mu mpera za 2018, uruganda rw’amashanyarazi ruhuza u Rwanda rwatanze nka 221.1 MW.
Umushinga wa KivuWatt ni umushinga w'ingufu zo gukuramo gaze karemano yashonze mu kiyaga cya Kivu no gukoresha gaze yakuwe mu kubyara amashanyarazi. Muri 2016, urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa MW 25 rushobora gutanga ingufu zihagije ku bantu 45.000 mu Rwanda. Biteganijwe ko umushinga wo kwagura ibikorwa uzongerwaho MW 26 z'a mashanyarazi mu cyiciro cyayo cya mbere, kandi amaherezo uzagera kuri MW 100 mu myaka iri imbere.
Ikigereranyo cyizuba.
Umurima wa mbere ufite ingufu zikomoka ku mirasire y'izuba muri Afurika yo munsi y'Ubutayu bwa Sahara hanze y'afurika y'Epfo ni uruganda rwa MW 8.5 ku Mudugudu w'Urubyiruko rwa Agahozo Shalom, mu Karere ka Rwamagana, Intara y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Yakodesheje hectare zigera 20 z'ubutaka mu mudugudu akaba ari umugiraneza wo kubakira no kwigisha abahohotewe na jenoside mu Rwanda. Uruganda rukoresha amashanyarazi 28,360 kandi rutanga 6% yu muriro w'amashanyarazi mu gihugu. Uyu mushinga wubatswe n’abahanga muri Amerika, Isiraheli, Ubuholandi, Noruveje, Finilande n’Ubwongereza.
Imikoreshereze y'amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba yariyongereye kuko ibiciro by'izuba byagabanutse kandi uduce twinshi ntitwiteze guhuza imiyoboro ya vuba. Imirasire y'izuba itanga amashanyarazi arenga 2% mu gihugu. Igihugu kiri mu kwaguka byihuse umuyoboro w’amashanyarazi kandi hashyizweho ibihingwa byinshi bishya cyangwa byubakwa.
Biomass ni isoko yingenzi y'ingufu zikoreshwa hifashishijwe inkwi n'imyanda yu buhinzi mu guteka. Muri 2014, ibyo byagaragaje 85% by'ingufu zikoreshwa mu Rwanda. Peat iva mu bishanga byo mu majyepfo y’iburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda bizatanga amashanyarazi abiri. Uruganda rwa MW 15 rwa mbere ruteganijwe kumurongo muri 2015 hamwe nuwa kabiri, uruganda rwa MW 80, ruteganijwe muri 2017.
Andi masoko y'ingufu.
Ibikomoka kuri peteroli, cyane mu bwikorezi, byagaragaje 11% by’ingufu z’u Rwanda muri 2014. N’ubwo bivugwa ko u Rwanda rufite peteroli na gaze gasanzwe hafi y’ikiyaga cya Kivu, guhera muri 2014, nta musaruro w’umutungo wabonetse kandi ibyifuzo byatumijwe mu mahanga. Umuyoboro wa peteroli wa Kenya - Uganda - Rwanda watwara peteroli hagati yibi bihugu niyubakwa.

Sitasiyo ya KivuWatt ni uruganda rukora amashanyarazi aho rutanga EgaWate 26 za gaze metani hamwe n'ingufu zamashanyarazi mu Rwanda.
Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi ruherereye ku Kibuye, mu Karere ka Karongi, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu bilometero 130, iburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda
Umushinga wa KivuWatt uzakuramo metani m'umazi y'ikiyaga cya Kivu kandi ukoreshe gaze kubyara amashanyarazi. Amashanyarazi azagurwa na Rwanda Electricity Corporation (RECO), ishinzwe amashanyarazi yo mu Rwanda.
Uyu mushinga wa miliyoni 200 z'amadorali, ufitwe na Contour Global ukanashyirwa mu bikorwa ku bufatanye na Wärtsilä, biteganijwe ko uzongerera 26MW ubushobozi bwo gutanga ingufu mu cyiciro cyayo cya mbere kandi amaherezo uzagera kuri 100 MW mu myaka iri imbere. Mu gihugu cyateye imbere, 25 MW y'ubu yatanga ingufu zihagije ku bantu 45.000.
Icyiciro cya 1 cy'umushinga, gifite ubushobozi bwa 25 MW, byari biteganijwe ko kizatangira ibikorwa byubucuruzi muri 2012. Icyiciro cya 2 cyu mushinga, gifite ingufu zingana na MW 75, biteganijwe ko kizatangira kubakwa nyuma y’amezi atandatu itangiye icyiciro cya 1. Uyu mushinga urimo gutegurwa na KivuWatt Limited, ishami rya Contour Global, hashingiwe ku masezerano y’inyungu yagiranye na guverinoma y’u Rwanda muri 2009. KivuWatt Limited irateganya gukuramo zimwe muri metero kibe zigera kuri miliyari 60 za gaze metani yafatiwe munsi y’ikiyaga cya Kivu no guhindura iyo gazi amashanyarazi, ikintu kikaba kitarakozwe ku bucuruzi bunini mbere. Ubwubatsi bwarangiye muri Gushyingo 2015 kandi sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi yari irimo kugeragezwa no gukurikizwa guhera mu Gushyingo 2015 kugeza itangiye gukoreshwa muri Kamena 2016.
Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa KivuWatt rwafunguwe na perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame ku ya 16 Gicurasi 2016.

Airtel Rwanda ni sosiyete y'itumanaho ikorera mu Rwanda. Itanga serivisi za telefone igendanwa na interineti. Ni ishami rya Airtel Africa. Airtel Africa iri mu itsinda rya sosiyete y'Abahinde Bharti Airtel.
Airtel yatangiye gukorera mu Rwanda mu 2012. Mu 2018, Airtel Rwanda yaguze Tigo Rwanda. Ubu ni sosiyete ya kabiri y'itumanaho mu gihugu, nyuma ya MTN Rwanda.
Mu 2011, Urwego Ngenzuramikorere (RURA) rwahaye Airtel uruhushya. Urwo ruhushya rwari urwo gukoresha imiyoboro ya telefone igendanwa ya 2G na 3G. Airtel yatangije ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda muri Mata 2012. U Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cya 17 Airtel ikoreramo muri Afurika. Airtel yateganyaga gushora miliyoni zirenga 100 z'amadolari mu myaka itatu.
Mu Ukuboza 2017, Airtel Rwanda yasinye amasezerano yo kugura Tigo Rwanda yose. Tigo Rwanda yari iya sosiyete Millicom. Icyo gihe, Tigo yari ifite abafatabuguzi bagera kuri miliyoni 3,4. Airtel yari ifite abafatabuguzi bagera kuri miliyoni 1,6. Inzego zishinzwe kugenzura zemeje ubwo bugure muri Mutarama 2018.
Nyuma yo kwihuza, sosiyete yitwaga Airtel-Tigo. Muri Mutarama 2020, yafashe izina rya Airtel Rwanda. Icyo gihe, yari ifite uruhushya rw'imyaka 12.
Emmanuel Hamez yayoboye Airtel Rwanda imyaka ine. Mu Ukwakira 2025, Sujay Chakrabarti yamusimbuye ku mwanya w'umuyobozi mukuru.
Airtel Rwanda itanga serivisi za telefone igendanwa na interineti. Ahantu hose Airtel ifite iminara hari 4G. Airtel ni yo sosiyete ya mbere mu Rwanda yatangije VoLTE na eSIM.
Airtel yatangije gahunda yitwa «Airtel Imagine» ifatanyije na Minisiteri y'Ikoranabuhanga n'Inovasiyo (MINICT). Iyo gahunda yafashije abakiriya barenga miliyoni 1,2 kubona telefone zigezweho ("smartphone").
Mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya 2025, Airtel Rwanda yari ifite 36 % by'abafatabuguzi ba telefone igendanwa mu Rwanda. MTN Rwanda yari ifite 64 %.

SORAS Group Limited isanzwe izwi nka SORAS, ni itsinda rya serivisi z'ubwishingizi. Itsinda ritanga ibicuruzwa byinshi na serivisi z'ubwishingizi, umutungo na banki mu Rwanda.
Icyicaro gikuru cya SORAS giherereye i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Iri tsinda rifite amashami mu Rwanda hamwe n’undi mufatanyabikorwa mu Burundi. SORAS niyo sosiyete yambere y'ubwishingizi bw'igenga yiyandikishije kandi ikorera mu Rwanda.
Itsinda rya SORAS ni isosiyete nini y’ubwishingizi mu Rwanda ifite isoko rya 35%.
Itsinda rya SORAS ryatangiye imirimo yaryo ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 1984 nka Société Rwandaise d'Assurances, nk'ishami ry'a Union des Assurances De Paris (UAP) International, kugira ngo ritange serivisi z'u bwishingizi mu Rwanda.
Ku ya 27 Nzeri 2010, ikigo cyahinduwe isosiyete ikora ifite amashami abiri ni ukuvuga SORAS Yizeza Generales Limited na SORAS VIE Limited. Kuriyo yimuye ibikorwa byayo bigufi kandi birebire murwego rumwe. Ibi byari mu rwego rwo kubahiriza Itegeko ry’u Rwanda nomero 52/2008 ryo ku wa 10/09/2008 ryategekaga ibigo by’u bwishingizi kugabanya ibikorwa by’igihe gito n’igihe kirekire.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, mu rwego rwo kwagura akarere, Itsinda rya SORAS ryabonye 33% by'imigabane ya sosiyete y'ubwishingizi mu Burundi, SOCAR SA. Uku kugura gushya kwatumye guhindura ibisobanuro byikigo, SORAS, biva muri Société Rwandaise d'Assurances bihinduka Société Régionale d'Assurances. Guhindura izina kwari ukugaragaza uko Itsinda rihagaze nka sosiyete yo mukarere.
Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2013, Itsinda rya SORAS nubwo amashami yaryo ya SORAS Assurances Generales Limited na SORAS VIE Limited yatakaje imigabane yagenzuraga muri Banki ya Agaseke nyuma y’i mpinduka nini zagize mu miterere y’imigabane ya banki. Ibi byatumye igabanuka rya SORAS Group muri banki riva kuri 75% rigera kuri 25%. Kuvana muri banki ya Agaseke byari mu ngamba z'itsinda ryo kongera ingufu mu bucuruzi bw'ubwishingizi.
Ku ya 3 Werurwe 2014, Sanlam Emerging Markets Itsinda ry’imari y’imari muri Afurika yepfo, yatangaje ko ryagiranye amasezerano yo kubona inyungu za 63% muri Soras Group mu masezerano afite agaciro ka miliyoni 24.3 z'amdrale. Uku kugura kwarangiye muri kamena 2014 bituma SORAS igize itsinda rinini ku isi.

Ibigo bigize SORAS Group Limited birimo ibi bikurikira:
Umugabane witsinda ufunzwe wenyine. Guhera ku ya 30 Kamena 2014, imigabane mu itsinda rya SORAS nkuko bigaragara mu mbonerahamwe ikurikira:
Itsinda rya SORAS riyobowe n'Inama y'Ubuyobozi igizwe n'abantu batanu hamwe na Moranyi Charles nk'umuyobozi w'iryo tsinda.

Sanlam ni itsinda ry’ibikorwa by’imari ryo muri Afurika yepfo rifite icyicaro i Bellville, muri Cape, muri Afurika yepfo. Sanlam ni isosiyete nini y'ubwishingizi muri Afurika. Urutonde rwimigabane ya Johannesburg, Isoko ry'imigabane rya Namibiya na A2X. Yashinzwe muri 1918 nk'isosiyete y'ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima, Sanlam Group yateye imbere mu bucuruzi butandukanye bwimari. Ibice bitanu by'ubucuruzi bigizwe na Sanlam Imari Yumuntu, Isoko rya Sanlam Emerging, Ishoramari rya Sanlam, Sanlam Corporate na Santam.
Itsinda ry'inzobere mu matsinda harimo ubwishingizi (ubuzima na rusange), igenamigambi ry’imari, amafaranga y’izabukuru, ikizere, ubushake, ubwishingizi bw'igihe gito, gucunga umutungo, gucunga ibyago n'ibikorwa by'isoko ry'imari, ishoramari n'ubutunzi. Iri tsinda rikorera muri Afurika, Namibiya, Botswana, Swazilande, Zimbabwe, Ubuhinde_ Malesiya_ Ubwongereza_ Amerika, Ositaraliya, Uburundi, Lesotho na Philippines. Ifite imigabane yinzobere mu bwishingizi, Naho Micro-Ensure Holdings Limited ikorera mu Bwongereza, ifite icyicaro muri Afurika no mu Buhinde ikorera abakiriya barenga miliyoni 10.
Kugura mu kwa 2018 kwa SAHAM Finance byatumye iba umukinnyi ukomeye muri Afurika muri serivisi z’imari itari iy'amabanki kandi iha imurikagurisha Maroke, Angola, Alijeriya, Tuniziya, Niger, Mali, Senegali, Gineya, Burkina Faso, kote Divuwari, Togo, Benini, Kameruni, Gabon, Repubulika ya Kongo, Madagasikari, Libani na Arabiya Sawudite.
Muri Gashyantare 2023, umuyobozi w’umurage n’umutungo wa Afurika yepfo na Sanlam batangaje ko bazahuriza hamwe bashiraho ubucuruzi, isambu hamwe n’icyizere hamwe. Ubucuruzi bugomba kwemezwa n’amabwiriza, buzabona Sanlam Life Insurance Limited (Sanlam Life) igurisha ubucuruzi bwayo bwizewe, Sanlam Trust, muri Capital Legacy na Sanlam Life ibona hafi inyungu zigera kuri 26% mu itsinda ryagutse ry’umurage mukuru ririmo Sanlam Trust, ubucuruzi nyuma yo kurangiza ibikorwa. Ikigo cyahujwe kizacungwa nu Murage Murage.
Kongera imbaraga mu bukungu.
Sanlam kuva muri 1993 yagize uruhare mu kuzamura ubukungu bw’abirabura (B-BBEE) binyuze mu bufatanye n’iryo tsinda n’Ubuntu-Botho Investments.
Ubufatanye bwa Ubuntu-Botho B-BBEE bwatumye ihuriro rinini ry’ingufu z’abirabura zigura imigabane 10% muri Sanlam mu cyagombaga kuba kimwe mu bikorwa bigera kure cyane muri Afurika yepfo kugeza ubu.
Mu Ukuboza 2013, igihe cya mbere cy'amasezerano y'imyaka 10 yu bucuruzi na Ubuntu-Botho cyarangiye, hamwe na miliyoni 66.5 yatinze imigabane yujuje ibisabwa kugirango ihindurwe imigabane isanzwe. Amasezerano yashyizeho agaciro kangana na miliyoni 15, bigatuma twavuga ko ari kimwe mubikorwa byatsinzwe muburyo bwayo mumateka ya Afrika yepfo. Muri 2014, habaye amasezerano yo kongera ubufatanye na Ubuntu-Botho mu bihe biri imbere.
Sanlam ifite inyungu 60% muri Santam, nayo ikora binyuze mubucuruzi bukurikira:
Sanlam yatangaje ko kwiyongera kwa 22% mu bucuruzi bushya bugera kuri miliyari 100 mu mezi atandatu kugeza muri Kamena 2015, ugereranije n’icyo gihe cyo muri 2014. Umusaruro uva muri serivisi zimari wazamutseho 5% mugice cya mbere cyumwaka wa 2014, naho 11% mugihe ibintu bimwe byigihe kimwe. Buri mwaka RoGEV kumugabane wa 13% yarenze intego ya 12.1%. Itsinda ryibanze ryibikorwa byo gupima agaciro kinyamigabane ni RoGEV.
Muri Gashyantare 2023 Umurage Umurage na Sanlam batangaje ko bagiye guhuriza hamwe imbaraga mu gushyiraho ubushake bukomeye, imitungo ndetse n’ubucuruzi hamwe.

Ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro mu Rwanda bugizwe ahanini no gucukura amabuye y'agaciro harimo nka tin, tantalum, na tungsten, Muri 2020, u Rwanda rwinjije amadolari ya Amerika 733 avuye mu bicuruzwa byoherezwa mu mahanga, bituma ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro aribwo bwinjira cyane mu Rwand bijya mu mahanga nyuma y’ubukerarugendo.
Mu mwaka wa 2019, iki gihugu cyari icya 7 mu bihugu bitanga tungsten kandi kikaba icya 12 mu bihugu bitanga tin.
* Cassiterite (amabati) yari afite umusaruro mwinshi n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga kuri toni zigera ku 3.874 zifite agaciro k'a miliyoni za madolari 42.2m muri 2010 (ukamanuka kuri toni 4.269 muri 2009).
* Yakurikiwe na coltan ifite toni 749 muri 2010 ifite agaciro ka amadolari ya Amerika 18.48 (toni 949 muri 2009), na wolfram (ubutare bwa tungsten) hamwe na toni 843 muri 2010 zifite agaciro k'amiliyoni amadolari ya Amerika 7.1m, zikamanuka kuri toni 874 muri 2009.
* U Rwanda rutanga hafi 9% ya tantalum ku isi, ikoreshwa mu gukora ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki, hamwe na 4% bya tungsten ku isi.
Amabuye y'agaciro yakuwe.
Muri Kwakira 2012, Minisiteri y’Umutungo Kamere w’u Rwanda yahagaritse ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y'agaciro mu ntara y’iburengerazuba bw’igihugu hashingiwe ko babangamiye uruzi rwa Sebeya. Iki cyemezo cyakemuwe nabi bitewe n’amasosiyete yibucukuzi y’amabuye y'agaciro yatakaje umusaruro ndetse no gutakaza akazi ibihumbi n’ibihumbi ku bakozi bakora mu birombe.

East Africa Exchange (EAX), n'Isoko ry’ibicuruzwa byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ni isoko ry’abikorera ku giti cyabo, harimo guhana ibicuruzwa mu buhinzi muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. ryatangijwe i Kigali, mu Rwanda, muri Nyakanga 2014. EAX ni iya gatatu mu bucuruzi bw’ibicuruzwa by’ubuhinzi muri Afurika, nyuma y’ivunjisha ry’ejo hazaza muri Afurika yepfo no kuvunja ibicuruzwa muri Etiyopiya.
Icyicaro gikuru cya EAX giherereye mu igorofa rya 12, ku munara wa Kigali City, Avenue du Commerce, mu mujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda. Umuhuzabikorwa w'icyicaro gikuru cya EAX kiri ni: 1 ° 56'37.0 "S, 30 ° 03'34.0" E (Ubunini: -1.943601; Uburebure: 30.059431).
Intego y'ibanze yo kungurana ibitekerezo ni korohereza abahinzi n’abakora umusaruro w’ubuhinzi kubona ibiciro byiza ku bicuruzwa byabo n’ibicuruzwa ndetse no kubona inkunga ikwiye ku bucuruzi bwabo. Guhera ku bigori n'ibishyimbo, guhana birateganya kwaguka mu ikawa, icyayi, n'umuceri. Kuva muri Werurwe 2016, EAX ikorera mu Rwanda na Kenya ifite gahunda yo kwinjira muri Uganda mu 2016.

Amabati ya Karuruma ni uruganda rukora amabati mu murwa mukuru w’u Rwanda, Kigali, kuri ubu rukoreshwa na sosiyete ya LuNa Smelter Ltd. Uru ruganda rwakoranaga mbere na Phoenix Metal Ltd.
Amabati ya Karuruma yubatswe mu ntangiriro zo muri 1980 kugira ngo atange amabati avuye muri concentéte yaturutse muri Société des Mines du Rwanda (SOMIRWA). SOMIRWA yayoboye urugamda kugeza muri 1985 igihe yahombye. Uruganda rwongeye gufungura mu mpera zo muri 1990 n’isosiyete yitwa ALICOM ariko yongera gufungwa muri Mata 1994 ubwo itsembabwoko ry’u Rwanda ryatangiraga ryokwica abatutsi. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yari ifite uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa, yarayigurishije muri gahunda yo kwegurira abikorera ku giti cyabo. Uruganda ruherereye hafi ya Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda.
Amateka yisosiyete munsi ya NMC Metallurgie.
Muri 2002 Tin Smelter yaguzwe na NMC Metallurgie. Kugeza mu mpera z'umwaka wo muri 2003 amatsinda ya tekiniki yakoraga ku ishoramari no kuyitaho mu rwego rwo gusana uruganda, gutumiza no gushyira imashini zabuze, gutangira ibikorwa byo gushonga hamwe no kunoza imikorere. Muri Kamena na Ukuboza 2003 ibizamini byakozwe neza kandi umusaruro w’inganda wari witeguye gutangira mu mpera za 2003. Muri 2005 isosiyete yafashe icyemezo cyo guhindura izina ryisosiyete ikitwa Phoenix Metal no guhindura n’amasezerano y’ishyirahamwe. Igiciro cy'amashanyarazi, kugabanuka kwamashanyarazi nikibazo cyibintu byinshi by'umurongo byari byategetse guhagarika ibikorwa byo gushonga.
Muri 2006, isosiyete yagerageje inzira nshya ishingiye kubikorwa bidasanzwe. Ibyo bizamini byagenze neza mu buhanga ariko izamuka rya kabiri ry’igiciro cy’amashanyarazi mu Kuboza 2005 n’ikibazo gisigaye cy’ibikoresho fatizo nticyagaragajwe n’ibintu byiza byakozwe muri gahunda nshya. Nyuma y'imyaka itanu abikorera ku giti cyabo, ubugenzuzi bwuzuye bwa tekiniki n’imari bwakozwe na Privateatisation kugira ngo harebwe niba amasezerano yubahirijwe n’impande zombi. Hafashwe umwanzuro hagati y’ababuranyi, ko Phoenix Metal itagifite inshingano. Phoenix Metal yasezeranije kuzirikana gushonga kandi izakora ibishoboka bidasanzwe kugirango utangire gushonga mumahirwe y'ambere.
Muri 2017, isosiyete yinjiye mu kwakira abantu kandi yaguzwe na guverinoma y'u Rwanda kuri miliyari 1.2 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda.
Amabati yubatswe muri 1980 n’Ababiligi. Intego yuyu mushinga kwari ugushonga cassiterite yose kuva kariya gace. Ubushobozi busanzwe bwa mabati bwari toni 10 za cassiterite ku munsi kandi bwiyongereye kugera kuri toni 15 ku munsi.
Uruganda rufite ibyuma 2 by'amashanyarazi. Ubushobozi bw'itanura buri hagati ya toni 10 na 15 zo kuvanga kumunsi. Amatanura atatu yo gutunganya ni ayo kugenzura umwanda. Amatanura abiri yo gutandukanya akoreshwa mugutunganya ibisigazwa.
Bamwe mu bakora ibicuruzwa byo mu Rwanda ntibafite ibikoresho cyangwa ubumenyi bwo gusukura amabuye y'agaciro. Phoenix Metal ibasaba koza no gutegura amabuye y'agaciro yoherezwa hanze harebwa ibisobanuro byamasezerano yohereza ibicuruzwa hanze. Kubwibyo, Phoenix Metal ifite nka Crusher, Mills, Spirals, Shacking Table yumye kandi itose, Magnetique separation.
Hamwe nibikorwa byo gushonga bidakora, Phoenix Metal yatangiye igikorwa cyubucuruzi. Ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro na Phoenix Metal ni:
Phoenix Metal yakoranye numukiriya umwe witwa Sideral Development. Sideral yabanje guterwa inkunga Phoenix Metal yo kugura amabuye y'agaciro.

Trade Union Centre of Workers of Rwanda ni ikigo cy’igihugu cy’abakozi mu Rwanda. Yashinzwe muri 1985 nk'ikigo cyonyine cy'igihugu.
Kuva muri 1991 hashyirwaho gahunda ya politiki y'amashyaka menshi CESTRAR yatangaje ubwigenge bwa politiki.
CESTRAR ifatanije n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abakozi.

Ubukerarugendo bw'ibimera.
Mu Rwanda kimwe nahandi hose ibidukikije bigizwe n'ibice bibiri, ibidukikije karemano, ibidukikije kamere,n'ibidukikije biva kubikorwa bya muntu kandi bigengwa na Poliike, inzego z'ubuobozi n'amategeko mumikorere,mu kurindwa no mumicungire yabyo, Ibidukikije kamere bigizwe n'ubutaka, n'ikuzimu, umwuka, urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ubwiza nyaburanga, ahantu nyaburanga n’inyubako. Ibidukikije biva ku bikorwa bya muntu birebana n’imitunganyirize y’imijyi n’icyaro n’imibereho y’abantu.
ibimera mu Rwanda nibimwe mubintu byitaweho cyane kuko byagaragaye ko bigira uruhare runini mu iterambere ry'igihugu mu Rwanda ndettse no hanze yyarwo hariho ingamba zo kubungabunga umusaruro ukomoka ku bimera

Rwanda Over The Counter Market (ROTCE), ryari isoko ry'imari n'imigabane mu Rwanda. Yashinzwe ku ya 31 Mutarama 2008 ikorera mu mujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda. Isoko ryayoborwaga na guverinoma yu Rwanda, rifite intego yo kwigenga. Ku ikubitiro kuvunja byagurishijwe gusa rimwe yatanzwe na banki nkuru y'igihugu; Banki nkuru y'u Rwanda n'indi Banki y'Ubucuruzi y'u Rwanda. Nyuma muri 2009, imigabane yatangiye gushyirwa ku rutonde.Mu Ukubuza 2010 imigabane ihwanye no kuvunja nkuko byavuzwe mu mbonerahamwe ikurikira.
Guhagarika ibikorwa no kubisimbuza.
Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2011, ibikorwa by'u Rwanda hejuru y’ivunjisha byafashwe n’ivunjisha ry’u Rwanda, ibikorwa byacyo bigenzurwa n’inama ngishwanama y’imari y’imari (CMAC).

Imibare igaragaza ko igice kinini cy’ishoramari rishya kiri kukigero cya 77.3% by’ishoramari ryose, ni ukuvuga ngo nibura miliyari 1,2 yamadolari yashyizwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Hakurikiraho Intara y’Amajyaruguru yihariye 11.7%, bingana na miliyoni 192.09 z'amadolari. Igereranya ryerekana ko iri shoramari rishya ryitezweho guhanga imirimo 57.000.Muri iyo mishinga, urwego rw’ibikorerwa mu nganda, serivisi z’imari n’ubwishingizi byihariye 45.6% by’ishoramari rishya ryanditswe, izi nzego zikazahanga 38.5% by’imirimo mishya yose. U Rwanda rufite isoko rinini kuko ruri mu miryango irimo uwa Afurika y'Iburasirazuba kandi iryosoko rika rimaze kwaguka cyane kuko na Congo yamaze kwiyongeraho.
Mu masezerano y’ishoramari rihuriweho u Rwanda rwemeranyije n’ibindi bigo mu mwaka ushize, harimo amasezerano ya Arise IIP yo kuvugurura icyanya cyahariwe inganda cya Bugesera, amasezerano ya ENI, ikigo gishinzwe ingufu cyo mu Butaliyani, amasezerano agamije ubufatanye mu buhinzi, kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ikoranabuhanga n’ubuzima. Kandi hari amasezerano u Rwanda rwasinyanye na TRW Investment Limited, amasezerano azatuma murwanda hashirwa ishuri ry'icyitegererezo ry'umupira w'amaguru, binyuze muri gahunda yiswe Tony Football Exellence Program(TFEP). Hari kandi amasezerano ya Startstone DMCC na Ecole Hôteliére azafasha mu kubaka mu Rwanda Ishuri ry’icyitegererezo mu bijyanye no kwakira abantu ku rwego mpuzamahanga Umushinga wa KOKO networks ufite agaciro ka miliyoni 25 z'amadolari witezweho gufasha u Rwanda murugendo rwo kugeza kubanyarwanda bose ibicanwa bitangiza ibidukikije, ni umushinga uzageza mu mwaka wa 2030.

Ububiko bwa Masaka Imbere mu Gihugu (MICD), ni icyambu cyumye kiri mu mujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda.
Ikigo giherereye mu gace ka Masaka, mu mujyi wa Kigali, nko mu kilometero 17.5 y'iburasirazuba bw'umujyi rwagati rw'ubucuruzi.
Muri Mutarama 2016, guverinoma y'u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano na Dubai Ports World (DPW) yo kubaka icyitwa Kigali Logistics Platform (KLP). DPW noneho yacunga kandi igakoresha depo yumye ku myaka igera kuri 25 uhereye igihe yarangirije.
Iterambere ryicaye kuri hectare 30 z'umutungo utimukanwa. Serivise zirimo serivisi za gasutamo no kugenzura ibicuruzwa, serivisi zinjira, kubungabunga no gusana, ibikoresho bya banki nibikoresho bya IT.
Icyambu cyumye kizatanga uburyo bwo gupakurura no gupakurura amakamyo atwara abantu, ububiko, bukonje. Ibicuruzwa biva mu mahanga birashobora kandi gutangwa binyuze mu bikoresho byoherejwe mu mijyi ituranye, Goma na Bukavu mu ntara ya DR Congo y'Amajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo ya Kivu. Ikigo gihujwe n’icyambu cya Dar es Salaam aho abantu binjirira umuhanda wa koridori rwagati.
Icyiciro cya mbere cyicyambu cyimbere cyubatswe hagati ya 2016 na 2018, kuri kuri hectare 13 ku giciro cyateganijwe miliyoni 35 z'amadolari.
Icyiciro cya kabiri, biteganijwe ko kizakurikira icya mbere, gikubiyemo kubaka ibikoresho bigezweho bikonje bikonje kuri hecitare 7. Igiciro cy'ibyiciro byombi giteganijwe kuri miliyoni 80 z'amadolari.
MICD irimo gutezwa imbere na Dubai Ports World, umushinga mpuzamahanga ushinzwe iterambere ry’inyanja n’umuyobozi, ufite ama terminal arenga 70 ku isi, afite abakozi barenga 35.000. DPW izatunga kandi icunge ikigo mu myaka 25 uhereye igihe yatangiriye.

Umuhanda wo hagati (Central Corridor) ni inzira yo gutwara no gucuruza iherereye muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba no Hagati. Iherezo ryayo ni umujyi wa Dar es Salaam uri ku cyambu cya Tanzaniya, aho uhurira n’isi yose ukoresheje ubwikorezi. Kuva i Dar es Salaam, koridoro ikorera mu gihugu imbere, ikorera imbere muri Tanzaniya harimo umurwa mukuru wa Dodoma n'umujyi wa kabiri wa Mwanza, ndetse n'u Rwanda n'Uburundi bidafite inkombe z'amazi, ndetse no mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Iyi nzira igizwe ikoresha umurongo wo hagati wa Tanzaniya kimwe no guhuza imiyoboro.
Umuhanda wo hagati utanga ubundi buryo bwerekeza ku nyanja kuva mu Rwanda, mu Burundi no muri DRC uva mu muhanda munini wa koridori y'Amajyaruguru, unyura muri Uganda na Kenya kugera ku cyambu cya Mombasa.

Umuhanda wa ruguru (Northern Corridor)ni inzira ihuze kandi ikomeye y'ogutwara abantu n'ibinyu mu bihugu byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba no Hagati nko mu Burundi, Uburasirazuba bwa DR Congo, Kenya, u Rwanda, Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Uganda.
Umuyoboro munini wo gutwara abantu mu majyaruguru uhuza icyambu cya Mombasa kandi harimo n' umuhanda wa gari ya moshi za Kenya Railways Corporation na Uganda Railways Corporation; ubwikorezi bwa gari ya moshi; inzira y'amazi yo mu gihugu imbere; kontineri isanzwe ifatwa nkaho ari ICD (Inland Container Depots); Icyambu cya Tororo Imbere - amasezerano yahawe na Great Lakes Ports Limited yo muri Kenya mu gihe abatavuga rumwe n’ibigo bitwara ibicuruzwa n’abatwara amakamyo; bongeyeho umuyoboro wa peteroli.
Ubundi buryo bwo gutwara abantu bukorera mu karere k'ibiyaga bigari bidafite inkombe binyuze muri Tanzaniya, bwitwa Umuhanda wo hagati uhuza Dar es Salaam. Ibi bifashisha umurongo wo hagati wa Tanzaniya.

Urwibutso rwa Livingstone - Stanley i Mugere rugaragaza ahantu umushakashatsi ndetse n’umumisiyonari Dr David Livingstone hamwe n’umunyamakuru n’umushakashatsi Henry Morton Stanley basuye kandi barara amajoro abiri ku ya 25-27 Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 1871 mu gihugu cya Burundi. Ni kilometero 12 mu majyepfo y'umujyi munini ndetse ukaba n'umurwa mukuru witwa Bujumbura, ureba ikiyaga cya Tanganyika. Mu gifaransa, yitwa "La Pierre de Livingstone et Stanley". Bamwe mu barundi bavuga ko aho ariho habereye inama ya mbere izwi cyane ya Livingstone na Stanley, aho aba nyuma bavuze amagambo azwi cyane "Dr Livingstone, ndakeka?".
Icyakora, iyo nama yabereye i Ujiji muri Tanzaniya kuri tariki ya 10 Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 1871 nk'uko bisobanurwa neza mu gitabo cya Stanley cyitwa, "Nigute Nabonye Livingstone". Ikinyamakuru cya David Livingstone nacyo cyemeza ko Ujiji ariho hantu, nkubwinjiriro bwa mbere y'umunsi w’inama witiriwe ngo "Umuseke, uzimye ujye Ujiji", umujyi yari azi neza. Livingstone yahise asobanura inama n’abantu benshi b’abarabu batuye Ujiji harimo n’uwagombaga kubika ibicuruzwa bye muruzinduko ruzakurikira, mbere yo kwandika ko Stanley yahageze.
Duhereye ku nyandiko zabo, uruzinduko rw'i Mugere rujya gusa nk'urwo ku ya 25-27 Ugushyingo ubwo Livingstone na Stanley bavuze ko ari bamwe mu bakiriwe neza. Iyo tariki ya 25 Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 1871 iragaragara kuko yashushanyije ku rutare. hanyuma buhagurukira mu ubwato berekeza mu majyaruguru y’iburasirazuba bw'ikiyaga kugira ngo babashe kumenya amakuru n'ubumenyi bw'imigezi ishobora kuva mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika. Ku mugezi wa Mugere bahabonye umudugudu wa Chief Mukamba wabakiriye abaha akazu baruhukiramo. Baraye amajoro abiri, Stanley yanditse ko umugaragu wa Livingstone Susi yasinze cyane kubera ubwakiranyi bw'Umukuru. Nk’abanyaburayi ba mbere basuye kariya gace, ukuhagera kwabo ntikwibagiranye, kandi bigomba kuba nyuma y'igihe runaka ibirori byabaye urujijo mubitekerezo by'abantu bamwe nk'inama yambere yahuje Livingstone na Stanley. Imbuga nyinshi zitanga iki kirego kitari cyo.

Ikigo (Northern Corridor Transit and Transport Coordination Authority) cyangwa umuhora uhuza no gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu majyaruguru (NCTTCA) ni urwego rwa guverinoma, rukubiyemo ibihugu bitandatu byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, rufite inshingano zo guhuza ibikorwa remezo byo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.
Umuhanda wa ruguru harimo icyambu cya Mombasa, umuyoboro mpuzamahanga w’imihanda, imiyoboro ya gari ya moshi, inzira z’amazi yo mu gihugu hamwe n’ubwikorezi bwo mu miyoboro. Ikintu cy'ibanze cya Koridori y'Amajyaruguru ni icyambu cya Mombasa, icyambu kinini muri Kenya, gihuza Kenya n'ibindi bihugu bitanu bidafite inkombe ku nyanja ndetse n'ubukungu bw'isi. Ibihugu bitandatu bikubiye muri NCTTCA ni Kenya, Uganda, u Rwanda, u Burundi, Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Koridor y'Amajyaruguru nayo ikorera mu majyaruguru ya Tanzaniya no mu bice bya Etiyopiya.
Icyicaro gikuru cya NCTTCA n'Ubunyamabanga buhoraho bw'uyu muryango biherereye ku nzu ya 1196, Umuhanda uhuza, i Nyali, umuturanyi wa Mombasa, icyambu kinini n'umujyi wa kabiri munini wa Kenya. Imiterere ya geografiya y' icyicaro gikuru ni: 04 ° 02'59.0 "S, 39 ° 41'30.0" E (Ubunini: -4.049722; Uburebure: 39.691667).
Imwe mu ntego nyamukuru zayo ni ukubaka gari ya moshi zisanzwe zihuza Uganda, u Rwanda, Sudani y'Amajyepfo ndetse n'iburasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, n'umujyi wa Mombasa uri ku cyambu cya Kenya.
Umuyoboro w’ibikomoka kuri peteroli utunganijwe, utwara lisansi yindege, peteroli na kerosene nabyo biri gutezwa imbere. Umuyoboro, upima nka umurambararo 20, irashyirwa ku nkombe za Kenya kugera muri Uganda no mu Rwanda. na kilometero 450, umuyoboro uzasimbuza amakamyo agera kuri 700 y’amavuta atwara peteroli atwara lisansi mu muhanda uhuza Mombasa na Nairobi, buri munsi nkuko byatangajwe n’isosiyete ikora imiyoboro ya Kenya.

Umuhanda wa gari ya moshi wu Rwanda ni gahunda ya gari ya moshi, irimo gutezwa imbere, ihuza igihugu n'ibihugu bituranye nka Tanzaniya na Uganda. Biteganijwe ko ubwo buryo buzahuzwa, mu gihe kiri imbere, n’abandi baturanyi b’u Rwanda, u Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, mu rwego rwo gutegura neza igishushanyo mbonera cya gari ya moshi yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Binyuze muri Uganda, SGR izemerera kugera ku cyambu cya Mombasa cya Kenya, u Rwanda rwinjira mu nyanja. Kubera ko nta muyoboro wa gari ya moshi wari usanzweho, u Rwanda rutezimbere gahunda ya gari ya moshi kuva kera.
Sisitemu ya gari ya moshi izaba igizwe n'ibice byinshi by'ingenzi:
Iki gice, gipima kilometero 150, ni igice cya gari ya moshi Isaka - Kigali Standard Gauge, gari ya moshi ihuriweho na guverinoma y'u Rwanda na Tanzaniya. Biteganijwe ko kubaka bizatangira mu Kwakira 2018, [bikeneye kuvugururwa] igice cya Rusumo - Kigali giteganijwe gutwara miliyoni 847 z'amadolari.
SGR imaze kugera i Kigali, biteganijwe ko guverinoma y'u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo izakora uburyo bwo kwagura iyi gari ya moshi kugera ku butaka bwa DR Congo. Igice kuva Kigali kugera Rubavu ni kilometero 150. Muri Kamena 2019, guverinoma ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo yerekanye ubushake bwo kugira uruhare mu nyigo ishoboka SGR igera i Rubavu na Goma.
Iki gice, gipima kilometero 60, kuva i Masaka, mu mujyi wa Kigali, unyuze ku Kibuga cy'Indege Mpuzamahanga cya Bugesera kugera i Nemba, ku mupaka mpuzamahanga n'Uburundi, ntikirahabwa umushoramari, guhera muri Nzeri 2018. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yiyemeje kugeza SGR ku Kibuga cy'Indege Mpuzamahanga cya Bugesera, ku ngengo y’imari ingana na miliyoni 85 z'amadolari.
Iyo gari ya moshi ya Uganda Standard Gauge yubatswe, SGR yo muri Uganda iteganijwe guhuza u Rwanda SGR kuri Mirama Hills / Kagitumba. Kuva aho, umurongo wanyuraga Nyagatare, Gatsibo, Gicumbi, Rwamagana, Gasabo ukarangirira i Masaka kubera imizigo na Ndera kubagenzi. Iki gice gipima hafi.
Iyi milimetero 1435 umurongo wa gari ya moshi ugamije koroshya koherezana hagati y’ibyambu bya Dar es Salaam na Mombasa, i Kigali mu Rwanda hanyuma i Bujumbura mu Burundi, na Goma, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mu rwego rwo guhuza abaturanyi bayo Uganda na Tanzaniya, u Rwanda ruzakoresha amashanyarazi mu guha ingufu za lokomoteri. Ibi bizafasha umuvuduko wa gari ya moshi zitwara abagenzi kwiyongera kugera kuri ku isaha hamwe na moteri yimizigo kugera kuri kilometero 120 ku isaha. Mu Kwakira 2018, ikinyamakuru cya East African cyatangaje ko kubaka bizatangira mu Kuboza 2018.

Cascades de Karfiguéla cyangwa Cascades ya Banfora (nanone Isumo rya Karfiguela, Isumo rya Tagbaladougou, cyangwa Isumo rya Banfora) ni uruhererekane rw'amasoko aturuka hejuru ku ruzi rwa Komoé mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Burkina Faso. Ziherereye nko mu birometero 12 mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Banfora kandi ni kimwe mu bibanza by'ubukerarugendo muri Burkinafaso. Intara ya Cascades ibona izina ryayo kumasoko. Urujya n'uruza rw'amazi asuma rubaho mu gihe cy'imvura kuva muri Kamena kugeza muri Nzeri.

Inema Arts Centre ni ikigo cyubuhanzi n'ubukorikori giherereye mu mujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda.
Iki kigo cyashinzwe muri 2012 n’abashushanyo babiri: Innocent Nkurunziza na Emmanuel Nkuranga. Abashushanya bombi n'abavandimwe batangije Inema Arts Centre bafite intego yo kwerekana ubuhanga bwubuhanzi bwu Rwanda rwihishwa, bakoresheje imvugo yo guhanga kugirango ubuzima n’igihugu kibeho, kandi batange urubuga kubahanzi bo mu Rwanda.
Inema Arts Centre yahindutse urubuga rwabahanzi batandukanye bavugana binyuze mumagambo yo guhanga. Abahanzi benshi bahanga mu Rwanda bagize Centre yu buhanzi. Inema Arts Centre kuri ubu ifite ibibanza byabahanzi icumi batuye kugirango bamenye ubushobozi bwabo bwo guhanga. Umwihariko muri Inema ni umuziki, imbyino, ubuhanzi bwa none bwo muri Afurika n'ubukorikori.
Ubugeni bwa Inema bugaragaza amashusho, ibishusho, nibindi bintu byubuhanzi byakozwe kandi byerekanwe nabahanzi ba Inema. Iki kigo kandi gikora imishinga n'ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije guteza imbere ibihangano byo guhanga u Rwanda no gutanga ihuriro ryo kwerekana ibitekerezo
binyuze mu mahugurwa, amahugurwa, ndetse n’inyigisho zifatika.
