Inzu ndangamurage ya Manega ni inzu ndangamurage iherereye mu birometero 55 mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'umujyi wa Ouagadougou, mu mudugudu wa Manega, mu gihugu cya Burkina Faso. Yashinzwe na Frédéric Pacéré Titinga.
Inzu ndangamurage zirimo "imyironge ya Boura," ibice 40 byo gushyingura, imiyoboro, amajerekani ya terracota, ibikomo hamwe n’ibikoresho byakoreshwaga mu mihango yo mu kibaya cya Niger, guhera mu kinyejana cya 2 kugeza mu cya 11. Hazwiho kandi imbunda ya Mossi imaze imyaka 200.

Sitade ya Kigali Pelé, yitiriwe Sitade y'akarere ka Nyamirambo, ni stade ikorerwamo ibintu byinshi, iherereye mu gace ka Nyamirambo mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda. Kugeza ubu ikoreshwa cyane mu mikino y'umupira wamaguru kandi yakira amakipe menshi muri shampiyona yu Rwanda, harimo APR FC na Rayon Sports.
Ifite ubwatsi bw'ubukorikori ndetse ifite imyanya 22,000 abantu bicaye neza. Iyi stade yabonaga idakwiriye kwakira imikino mpuzamahanga muri 2021 n’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru nyafurika kandi ikorerwa ivugurura ryatangiye muri Mutarama 2023 mbere ya Kongere ya 73 ya FIFA, yakiriwe na Kigali. Yongeye gufungura ku ya 15 Werurwe 2023, ahindurirwa izina mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Pelé wahoze ari umupira w'amaguru muri Berezile na perezida w’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame na perezida wa FIFA, Gianni Infantino.
Muri 1998, sitade yakoreshejwe mu kwicisha mu ruhame abantu 21 bahamwe n'icyaha cyo kugira uruhare muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda, barimo Froduald Karamira.

Iyi ni ingingo y'inzu ndangamurage muri Burkinafaso. Kubireba inzu ndangamurage muri Amerika, reba inzu ndangamurage y'umuziki "."
Inzu Ndangamurage y’umuziki iri muri Ouagadougou, mu gihugu cya (Burkina Faso) mu nyubako y’amagorofa abiri ku Muhanda wa Oubritenga mu majyepfo y’ishuri rya Phillipe Zinda Kabore.
Inyubako yahoze irimo Ishyirahamwe rishinzwe iterambere ry’imyubakire nyafurika n’imyubakire y’imijyi (ADAUA) yaravuguruwe kugira ngo yakire inzu ndangamurage. Iyi nyubako iri muburyo bw'inyubako za abasudani baba Sahelian ifite ibisenge bimeze nk'ububiko. Iri hagati mu mujyi kandi biroroshye kugera kubaturage muri rusange.
Icyegeranyo cya mbere, cyashyizwe hamwe hagati ya Nzeri mu mwaka wa 1998 na Werurwe mu mwaka wa 1999, gihora gikura. Ibikoresho byo mumiryango yose bigaragazwa harimo aerofone, membranofone, idiophone na chordophone. Buri kintu nicyo cyonyine cy'ubwoko bwacyo kandi kiratandukanye kuva kumyaka 5 kugeza ku myaka 200.
Inzu ndangamurage iyobowe n'umurinzi witwa, Parfait Z. Bambara
Ishami ry'umurage ndangamuco wa Burkina Faso

Urwibutso rwo kurwanya ruswa mu Rwanda (Anti-corruption monument of Rwanda) ni urwibutso ruherereye mu kigo cy’amasezerano ya Kigali (KCC) Kigali convention Center, mu Rwanda, ni ukwemeranya politiki y’u Rwanda yo kurwanya ruswa hamwe na guverinoma ya Qatari muri 2019, cyahashyizwe ari mu gihembo cyari mpuzamahanga cy’indashyikirwa mu kurwanya ruswa. Igishushanyo gitangaje cyuru rwibutso rw'amaboko kiri inyuma y'umuhanzi wo muri Iraki witwa Ahmed Al Bahrani.
Ibyanditswe byera byerekana imikindo yagutse, bivuze ko u Rwanda ntacyo rufite cyo guhisha isi yose. Ifite imikindo ifunguye, igereranya gukorera mu mucyo no gufungura. Urwibutso rufite uburebure bwa metero 12 rugizwe na pivot hamwe n’ibihuza byerekana akamaro k’ubufatanye n’isi yose mu kurwanya ruswa.
Ihuriro rya mpandeshatu 186 rigize urwibutso ryerekana abashyize umukono ku masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye arwanya ruswa. Intego yacyo ni ugushishikariza abantu kurwanya ruswa bafite imyifatire itigera ivuga-gupfa.

Integrated Polytechnic Regional College Ground ni ikibuga cya Cricket, kiri mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mu Kwakira 2021, iki kibuga ni cyo cyabereyeho imikino mu itsinda A mu majonjora yo guhatanira itike yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy’isi cya 2021 cya ICC mu bagabo mu gikombe cy’isi cya Afurika cyitabiriwe n’amakipe yabaye aya mbere mu gikombe cy’isi cya Afurika cya Eswatini, Gana, Lesotho, Malawi, Seychelles, Uganda ndetse n’u Rwanda rwakira. Mbere yo gutangira amarushanwa ikibanza cyaravuguruwe cyane kugirango kibe ku rwego rwo kwemerera ICC.

Les Afriques n'ikinyamakuru cyo muri Afurika cy'ubukungu n'imari gisohoka buri cyumweru. Mu mwaka wa 2007, kivuga ko aricyo kinyamakuru cya mbere cy’imari Pan-African. Gitangazwa buri cyumweru kandi kiboneka hafi mubihugu byose bivuga igifaransa.
Iki kinyamakuru cyatangiye gusohoka mu kwezi kwa Nyakanga mu mwaka wa 2007. Itangizwa ryayo ryatangajwe ku "kinyamakuru TV cyo mu Gifaransa de Léman bleu" no ku mbuga nyinshi za Afurika zihariye.
Nyuma y'ikinyamakuru cya mbere nigihe gikenewe cyo guhuza imihindagurikire gikoresha sisitemu ya francise, ikinyamakuru "Les Afriques" cyatangije inyandiko zacyo mu gihugu cya Maroc, Senegali na Kameruni.
Mu rwego rwo guhuza ibitekerezo "by'umugabane wa kera", abanyamakuru bafite icyicaro mu bihugu bya Afurika aribyo (Maroc, Senegali na Alijeriya) kandi bubahwa cyane mu muryango w’imari nyafurika.
Adama Wade, muri Maroc.
Adama Wade, umunyamorutania, yashinzwe i Casablanca byibuze mu imyaka cumi n'itatu. Yateye imbere nkumunyamakuru mubice by'ubukungu n’imari mubinyamakuru bya Maroc.
Chérif Elvalide Seye, Senegali.
Yabaye umujyanama wihariye mu itumanaho rya perezida Abdoulaye Wade mu mwaka wa 2000 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2002 kandi yashinze cyangwa acunga ibitangazamakuru byinshi mu gihugu cye. Chérif Seye yapfuye ku ya 18 Kamena 2012 i Nairobi muri Kenya

Amashanyarazi ya Rukarara ni uruganda rutanga amashanyarazi angana na megawate 9.5 ikaba ari mu Rwanda.
Sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi iherereye ku mugezi wa Rukarara, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda, kuri kilometero 182 mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda.
Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa 9,6 MW rw'ubatswe mu byiciro byinshi. Icyiciro cya mbere, gifite ubushobozi bwa MW 6.9, cyarangiye muri 2011. Icyiciro cya kabiri, gifite ubushobozi bwa MW 2,2 cyarangiye muri 2014. Amafaranga yo kubaka sitasiyo yose y’amashanyarazi yari miliyoni 13.12 z'amadolari, inkunga yatanzwe na guverinoma yu Rwanda, Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi n’ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’Ababiligi.
Amashanyarazi yatanzwe yimurwa binyuze muri sitasiyo nshya i Rukarara no kunyura ku murongo mushya w'amashanyarazi mwinshi kuva Rukarara kugera Kirinda.

Urugomero rwa Akanyaru rufite intego nyinshi, ni urugomero ruteganijwe kwambuka uruzi rwa Akanyaru, ku mupaka mpuzamahanga uhuza u Rwanda n'Uburundi. Urugomero ruzakora ikigega gifite ubushobozi bwo kubika nibura na meterokube 333,000,000. Biteganijwe ko ayo mazi azatanga nibura amazi yo kunywa ku bantu bagera kuri 614.200 mu bihugu byombi. Biteganijwe kandi ko iki kigega kizatanga amazi yo kuhira hafi hegitare nibura 12,474 z’ubutaka bw’ubuhinzi mu Burundi no mu Rwanda, bikagirira akamaro abahinzi bagera nibura ku 24.948. Urugomero ruzakira kandi amashanyarazi ya Akanyaru, afite ingufu za wate 14.5.
Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi izaba ku ruzi rwa Akanyaru, ku mupaka w’u Rwanda n’Uburundi, mu Karere ka Gisagara muri iki gihe mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo, u Rwanda ndetse no muri Komini ya Ntega mu Ntara ya Kirundo, mu Burundi.
Urugomero rufite, kumuhanda, mu majyepfo yuburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda. Ubu ni kuri kilometero 150, mu majyaruguru ya Gitega, umurwa mukuru wu Burundi.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, ibihugu byombi byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba hamwe na gahunda y'ibikorwa byo mu biyaga bya Nili Ekwatoriya (NELSAP), byagaragaje "umushinga wo guteza imbere umutungo w'amazi Akanyaru". Muri uwo mwaka, NELSAP yakoze ubushakashatsi bwibanze.
Muri 2015, Inama y'abaminisitiri ya Nili yemeje umushinga wa Akanyaru. Intumwa zaturutse mu Rwanda no mu Burundi zapimye ikibanza cy’umushinga muri Gicurasi 2016. Muri Werurwe 2018, NELSAP yateguye inkunga yuzuye muri Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere (AfDB). Mu mwaka wa 2020, hatanzwe amasoko kugira ngo hasuzumwe ubushakashatsi ku ngaruka z’ibidukikije n’imibereho (ESIA), Gahunda y’ibikorwa byo Gutuza (RAP), ubushakashatsi bwuzuye bushoboka, igishushanyo mbonera no gutegura inyandiko z’ipiganwa ku mushinga. Biteganijwe ko ubushakashatsi bwumushinga buzarangira muri Werurwe 2022.
Muri Gashyantare 2021, ikiguzi cy'umushinga cyabazwe miliyoni 190 z'amadolari y'amerika. Gusaba inguzanyo byakorewe muri AfDB, munsi y’umushinga w’ibikorwa remezo bya NEPAD (NEPAD-IPPF).
Icyifuzo cya megawate 14.5, Amashanyarazi ya Akanyaru, biteganijwe ko azatanga amashanyarazi kumazu nibura 141.111 yo mu bihugu byombi, akorera abantu bagera kuri 846.000. Uyu mushinga urimo no gusana amasoko yangiritse hejuru y’urugomero rwa Akanyaru.

Nyanza, izwi kandi ku izina rya Nyabisindu, ni umujyi uherereye mu Karere ka Nyanza mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Nyanza n'umurwa mukuru w'Intara y'Amajyepfo.
Nyanza yari umurwa mukuru w'Ubwami bw'u Rwanda, kuva 1958 kugeza 1962.
Muri 1994, mu bihe by’intambara y’abaturage yo mu Rwanda, Front Patriotic Front yo mu Rwanda yarwanye n’ingabo z’u Rwanda i Nyanza iminsi myinshi, isenya umujyi. Abatutsi benshi bishwe n'ingabo za leta hariya muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Nyanza azwi cyane mu mateka ya yogurute na kefir (gakondo bita ikivuguto muri Ikarwanda, ururimi rwu Rwanda). Ikivuguto, kuba ikinyobwa gisembuye, yari, kandi n'ubu iracyakunzwe kubera imico myiza. Umujyi urimo amata abiri. Laiterie de Nyabasindu ni imwe mu isiyete manini yo mu Rwanda akora amata na yogurute. Amaresitora mato menshi n'amaduka mumujyi bigurisha ikivuguto kubikombe cyangwa mubikoresho binini bya plastiki kugirango bikuremo. Amaduka menshi yo mumujyi agurisha amacupa cyangwa apakiye kugiti cya ikivuguto cyangwa yogurt wongeyeho isukari cyangwa uburyohe, nka vanilla cyangwa strawberry.
Ikaba kandi ibamo inyubako nini, igezweho, ifite amagorofa menshi yubatswe kugira ngo ibe Urukiko mpuzamahanga rw’umuryango w’abibumbye rw’u Rwanda (ICTR), urukiko rukomeje kuburanisha imanza zerekeye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994 mu Rwanda. Iyi nyubako kandi irimo Urukiko Rukuru.
Amakuru kubakerarugendo.
Umujyi wa Nyanza urasaba kuzimya umuhanda munini uhuza Kigali na Butare. Nyanza ni urugendo rwa bisi kuva Kigali, Gariyamoshi iri hagati mu mujyi wa Nyanza, iruhande rw'isoko ryo hanze. Amasosiyete akomeye ya bisi akorera Nyanza ni Ibirunga na Horizon, bigenda buri saha nigice bikicara abagenzi bagera kuri 28. Hariho kandi amamodoka mato azwi nka bisi ya Twegerane ihuza abantu benshi bashoboka kandi igenda iyo yuzuye. Gutwara abantu mu mujyi binyuze muri tagisi ya moto cyangwa tagisi yamagare, cyangwa n'amaguru.
Ingoro yum "umwami" wanyuma (umwami gakondo) wu Rwanda iherereye hagati yumujyi rwagati kandi niwo mukerarugendo ukurura umujyi. Ngaho, umuntu arashobora kubona ingoro gakondo yuwahoze ari umwami akayigereranya ningoro ya kijyambere yubatswe kure nabakoloni b'Ababiligi kubwami. Mu gihe ibyinshi mu ngoro y'umwami bikomeje kuba uko byari bimeze igihe umwami yabayemo mu myaka ya za 1950 na 60, ibikoresho bimwe na bimwe byibwe cyangwa birasenywa mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu 1994. Rimwe na rimwe, hashyizweho kopi yibikoresho byumwimerere. Nta mafoto yemerewe imbere ibwami. Umugore wu Rwanda wambaye "umushanana" (imyenda yubudozi yu Rwanda, itemba gakondo) ayobora abashyitsi mu ngoro.
Umujyi wa Nyanza ufite nibura amashuri abiri yisumbuye: Kaminuza y'Abadiventisti b'Abalayiki ba Kigali (UNILAK), ku muhanda ujya i Nyanza, n'Ikigo gishinzwe imyitozo ngororamubiri n'iterambere (ILPD), giherereye ku muhanda ugana ku ngoro y'Umwami kuri ihuriro rya Avenue des Siporo. ILPD yakiriye amasomo y’impamyabumenyi y’amezi atandatu nyuma y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza, itanga inyigisho zifatika mu by'amategeko ku barangije amashuri y’amategeko. Ifite kandi amasomo magufi (ubusanzwe icyumweru kimwe cyangwa munsi yayo) amasomo yo gukomeza gutura mumashuri cyangwa amasomo ajyanye namategeko kubacamanza, abanyamategeko, abahesha b'inkiko n'abandi. Abanyeshuri bo muri ILPD baturuka mu bihugu byinshi, birimo u Rwanda, Uganda, Gana, Gambiya, Kameruni, Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Kenya. Kuruhande rw'umuhanda uva Ikigo ni isoko rito rifite resitora ntoya (zitanga ibiryo n'ibinyobwa), ishuri ritwara ibinyabiziga hamwe nububiko buto bwo mu biro.
Nyanza afite amatorero menshi, arimo abagatolika, abadiventiste b'umunsi wa karindwi, ADEPR (Pentekote) n'andi, ndetse n'imisigiti myinshi.

Uburundi, ku mugaragaro ni Repubulika y’Uburundi, ni igihugu kidafite inkombe mu karere ka Afurika y’ibiyaga bigari byo mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bwa Afurika, gihana imbibi n’u Rwanda mu majyaruguru, Tanzaniya mu burasirazuba no mu majyepfo na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu burengerazuba. Inganda nini mu Burundi n’ubuhinzi, bungana na 30% by'Umusaruro mbumbe w'igihugu. Uturima tw'ikikoni ni 90% by'ubuhinzi. Igice kinini cy'injiza amafaranga menshi ni ikawa, kurugero rwa 93% by’ibyoherezwa mu Burundi. U Burundi ni kimwe mu bihugu bikennye cyane ku isi, bitewe na geografiya yayo idafite inkombe, amategeko mabi, kutagira ubwisanzure mu bukungu, kutabona amashuri, no gukwirakwiza virusi itera SIDA. Abagera ku 80% by'abatuye u Burundi babaho mu bukene.
Uru rutonde rurimo ibigo bizwi bifite icyicaro gikuru giherereye mu gihugu. Inganda n'umurenge bikurikiza inganda zerekana ibyiciro by'imisoro. Amashyirahamwe yahagaritse ibikorwa arimo kandi agaragara nkayacitse.

Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa Kibuye 1, cyangwa nanone Amashanyarazi ya Kibuye 1 (KP1), ni urugomero rutanga megawate 3.6 za gaze metani yakongejwe n'ingufu zamashanyarazi mu Rwanda.
Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi ruherereye i Kibuye, mu Karere ka Karongi, mu Ntara y'Uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi kilometero 135, iburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda.
Guhera mu 2006, ku nkunga yatanzwe n’ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe imari (IFC), guverinoma y’u Rwanda yatangiye gushakisha amasosiyete y’ubuhanga yujuje ibyangombwa byo gushushanya, kubaka no gukoresha amashanyarazi akomoka kuri gaze metani y’amashanyarazi, akoresheje gaze yakuwe mu nyanja y’ikiyaga. Kivu. Imwe mu ntego z'uyu mushinga, kwari ukugaragaza ko bishoboka kubyara amashanyarazi muri gaze metani mu kiyaga ku buryo bwunguka. Umushinga watwaye hafi miliyoni 20 z'amadolari yo gushiraho.
Uyu mushinga ni uw'ubutegetsi bwa Rwanda. Ubufatanye na Dane Associates, uruganda rukorera mu mujyi wa Edinburgh rwaciwe kubera kutumvikana mu bijyanye n'amafaranga. Mu mwaka wa 2015, kubera ko umushinga udashoboye kwishyura imyenda yawo, Urukiko Rukuru rw’Ubucuruzi mu Rwanda rwashegeshe Isosiyete ya Kibuye Power 1, bisabwe na guverinoma y’u Rwanda. Guverinoma yatangiye kwakira amasoko yatanzwe n'abashoramari bashya kugira ngo batangire umushinga.
Muri Kwakira 2016, Symbion Power, uruganda rukora amashanyarazi muri Amerika, rwaguze uruganda rukora amashanyarazi rwa Kibuye 1 ku mafaranga ataramenyekana. Symbion irateganya kuzamura buhoro buhoro, icyiciro cya mbere kugeza kuri MW 25 muri 2018, na MW 50 muri 2019.
Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa Kibuye 1 ni umushinga wa kabiri w'amashanyarazi Symbion yiyemeje guteza imbere ku kiyaga cya Kivu. Yemeye kandi guteza imbere sitasiyo ya Kivu 56, na megawatte 56, uruganda rukora amashanyarazi rukoreshwa na metani. Muri ayo masezerano, hari megawatte 14 biteganijwe muri 2018.

Symbion Thermal Power Station niurugomero rw'amashnyarazi rutanga megawatts 56 ya gazi ya metani, rutanga umuriro w'amashanyarazi iherereye kuri Cape ya Busororo hafi y'umujyi wa "Nyamyumba" mu Karere ka Rubavu, mu Ntara y'Uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda.
Sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi iherereye i Cape Busororo, hafi ya Nyamyumba mu Burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, nko muri kilometero 163, mu majyaruguru yuburengerazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru wu Rwanda. Aha hantu hareshya na kilometero 20, mumajyepfo ya Gisenyi, umurwa mukuru wintara.
Kivu 56 Amashanyarazi afite kandi akoreshwa Symbion Power LLC, ikigo cyigenga gitanga ingufu gifite icyicaro muri Amerika. Uruganda rugizwe nibikoresho bibiri: (a) kwishyiriraho hanze yinkombe ikuramo, itandukanya kandi itunganya gaze ya metani, ishonga mumazi maremare yikiyaga cya Kivu, hanyuma ikayigeza kuri (b) ikigo gitanga ku nkombe giherereye. kuri Cape ya Busororo, aho gaze ikoreshwa muguhindura gaz turubine kubyara amashanyarazi.
Sitasiyo ya Kivu 56 ni sitasiyo ya gatatu ikoreshwa na gaze metani mu Rwanda, nyuma y’amashanyarazi ya KivuWatt, itanga MW 25 kandi ikaba iri mu rwego rwo kwagura ingufu kugera kuri MW 100, na megawate 3.6, Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa Kibuye 1, narwo rukaba rufite Symbion kandi rugenda rwiyongera kugeza kuri megawate50.
Symbion Power yiyandikishije mu isosiyete ifasha u Rwanda ko ifite 100 ku ijana ku izina rya "Shema Power Lake Kivu Methane Limited", gushushanya, gutera inkunga, kubaka, gutunga, gukora no kubungabunga sitasiyo ya Kivu 56. Turbine enye, buri gipimo cya megawatt 16, giha uruganda kubyara megawatt 56 z'ingufu zisukuye.
Dukurikije amasezerano yo kugura amashanyarazi yasinywe n’impande bireba, megawate 14, kuva kuri iyi sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi, biteganijwe muri 2018. Muri Nzeri 2017, Symbion yagurishije miliyoni 100 z’amadolari y’Amerika mu mishinga yayo ibiri yo mu Rwanda; aribyo Kibuye Amashanyarazi 1 na Kivu 56 Sitasiyo. Amafaranga azakoreshwa mugutezimbere amashanyarazi yombi kubyara megawate 106. Miliyoni 370 z'amadorali y'Amerika ziteganijwe gutegurwa kugira ngo zigere kuri iyo ntego.

Maison St Benoit ni inzu y'umubikira muto wo mu Benedigito i Kigufi, mu Rwanda.
Kigufi ni umudugudu wo mu Rwanda, muri Afurika yo hagati, yegeranye n'ikiyaga cya Kivu, kimwe mu biyaga binini bya Rift Valley. Kigufi iherereye mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu Karere ka Rubavu, mu gice cya Nyamyumba, mu Kagari ka Kiraga. Iherereye mu majyaruguru y’ikiyaga cya Kivu kuri kamwe mu duce duto duto two mu majyepfo ya Rubavu, umujyi ukomeye cyane. Ibi bishyira umudugudu hafi ya Goma, ku mupaka na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Mu gihe cyabakoloni umugabo w’umwongereza witwa Jack Mat Wilson Poelaert yashinze ibibanza yubaka inyubako igizwe n’ikigo kinini cy’ababikira. Yashyizeho ubusitani burimo ibiti byinshi byiza kandi bituma abantu bavuga ko ubu Umubikira ari ikibuga cy’icyatsi kibisi cya paradizo gishyigikira inyoni nyinshi zifite amabara kandi zitanga no koga neza". Poelaert yahaye umutungo itegeko rya Benedigito muri Kuboza 1970.
Umubikira uyu munsi.
Muri iki gihe, Ababikira ba Mutagatifu Benedigito babayo basenga kandi bakora nk'uko babigiriwemo inama na Mutagatifu Benedigito, wagize ati: Ora et Labora. Bakorera inzu yabatumirwa ifite ibyumba 30 bituma iba kamwe mu hantu heza-heza kandi heza cyane kuguma mu gace ka Rubavu. Mushikiwabo Beata, umwe mu babikira batanu bayobora inzu y'abashyitsi, asobanura agira ati: Ababikira bakunda kugira abashyitsi, kubakira ntabwo ari ubucuruzi ni kimwe mu bigize ubutumwa. Bashaka ko wumva uri mu rugo.
Abashyitsi berekana ko izuba rirenze ari umunezero kubona kandi umuntu akumva afite amahoro umaze kugera i Kagufi.

Kigali Solaire ni urugomero rw'amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba mu Rwanda kandi mu gihe cyo kubaka ni cyo gihugu cya Afurika kinini cyashyizeho amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y'izuba. Yubatswe mu 2006 kuri Mont Jali hafi y'umurwa mukuru Kigali. Uruganda rukoresha amafoto yerekana amashanyarazi kandi rufite umusaruro mwinshi wa 250 kilo hamwe nibisohoka buri mwaka biva kuri kilowate 325.000. Yatewe inkunga n’umujyi w’Ubudage isosiyete ikora ibikorwa by’ingirakamaro ya Stadtwerke Mainz AG (ubu ni: Mainzer Stadtwerke AG), Mainz ikaba umurwa mukuru wa Rhineland-Palatinate, ifitanye ubufatanye n’u Rwanda.
Uruganda rugizwe gusa na gahunda, rugizwe no gukwirakwiza panne 30 yifoto ya 1 kilo imwe mu midugudu yo hanze y'igihugu amashanyarazi, agera kuri 5% yi gihugu gusa. Sitasiyo ntoya isanzwe ishyirwa hejuru yinzu yi bitaro cyangwa amashuri. Iyi gahunda kandi ni gutera inkunga no guhugura abatekinisiye baho kugirango babungabunge ibyashizweho byose.

Ihuriro ry’ubucuruzi muri Kongo n’umuryango w’abakoresha nyamukuru muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1997, yari ifite abanyamuryango bangana 2, 700 mu mwaka wa 2010. Yabonye inkunga y'amafaranga n'ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry'Ubufaransa mu mwaka wa 2010. Perezida wacyo ni Albert Yuma.

Christopher Ebhodaghe Abebe (Yavutse mu mwaka wa 1919 - Apfa tariki 22 zu kwezi kwa Werurwe mu mwaka wa 2018) OFR, KSM, KSS, uzwi ku izina rya "Pa Abebe", yari umuyobozi mukuru w’abakozi bo muri Nijeriya, nyuma aza kuba umuyobozi wa sosiyete yunze ubumwe bwa Afurika (UAC) muri Nijeriya. Yari intwari isumba izindi mu Itorero Gatolika rya ba Knight ba Mutagatifu Mulumba.
Ubuzima bwambere n'umuryango.
Christopher Abebe yavutse mu mwaka wa 1919. Umukobwa we w'imfura, Stella Obasanjo, yari umugore w'uwahoze ari perezida wa Nijeriya, Olusegun Obasanjo.
Abebe ubuzima bwe bwose yabukoresheje muri sosiyete yunze ubumwe ya Afurika, atangira kuba umwanditsi wa konti muri Uromi mu mwaka wa 1935. Mu mwaka wa 1951 yabaye umuyobozi ushinzwe umurimo i Warri, Umunyafurika wa mbere kavukire muri UAC washyizweho kuri uwo mwanya. Mu mwaka wa 1958 yagizwe umuyobozi ushinzwe iterambere n’amahugurwa y’abakozi bo muri Afurika muri Nijeriya maze umwaka ukurikira aba umunyafurika wa mbere w’abasangwabutaka washyizweho mu nama y’ubuyobozi ya UAC Nigeria. Yabaye umuyobozi wungirije mu mwaka wa 1972, aba umuyobozi ndetse na MD mu mwaka wa 1975.
Yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu mwaka wa 1980, agirwa umuyobozi w'Iteka rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Nijeriya mu mwaka wa 1981.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 1996 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2000, yari intwari ikomeye mu Iteka rya ba Knight ba Mutagatifu Mulumba. Yabaye umuyobozi wungirije akaba n’umuyobozi w’inama ya kaminuza eshatu zo muri Nijeriya (Benin, Nsukka na Calabar).
Abebe yapfuye ku ya 22 Werurwe 2018.

Hisham Mackie (yavutse mu mwaka wa 1969) ni umucuruzi wo mu gihugu cya Siyera Lewone. Kugeza ubu ni we mu Siyera Lewone w'umucuruzi ukora akazi ko kohereza diyama mu mahanga, ku kigero cya 51% by'ibicuruzwa byoherejwe mu mahanga bya diyama zituruka mu gihugu cya Siyera Lewone Mackie ayobora HM Diamond, sosiyete ikaba yari ifite 40% by'ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bya diyama mu mwaka wa 2005.
Hisham Mackie yavukiye i Freetown, muri Siyera Lewone tariki ya 6 ukwezi kwa Mata mu mwaka wa 1969 avukira mu muryango wa Siyera Lewone-Abanyalibani ukora ubucuruzi bwa diyama kuva mu mwaka wa 1952. Se we, igisekuru cya kabiri cya Siyera Lewone-Abanyalibani, yari mu bacuruzi ba mbere ba diyama babiherewe uburenganzira na guverinoma ya Siyera Lewone mu ntangiriro ya mirongo itandatu. Mackie yize amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rya Bo ryamamaye kandi rikomeye muri Bo arangiza mu mwaka wa 1986. Amaze kurangiza amashuri kuricyo kigo cya Bo, yagiye mu Bwongereza aho yize muri kaminuza ya London mu mwaka wa 1987. Mackie yinjiye mu bucuruzi bwa diyama mu mwaka wa 2002 nk'umuntu ufite uruhushya rwo kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze.

Rajan Mahtani (wavutse tariki 14 z'ukwezi kwa Gashyantare mu mwaka wa 1948) ni umucuruzi ukomeye muri Zambiya akaba umuyobozi wa Banki y’imari Zambia, ishami ry’amabanki aciriritse mu gihugu cya Zambiya. Yakurikiranye umwuga mu by'imari n'amategeko. Ni Umufatanyabikorwa w’ishyirahamwe ryemewe ry’abacungamari bemewe kandi afite impamyabumenyi ya PhD mu mategeko y’ubucuruzi yakuye mu kigo cy’ubucuruzi cy’i Londere.
Tariki ya 13 mu kwezi kwa Mata mu mwaka wa 2015, Mahtani yemeye gutanga ikirego cye ku ruganda rwa sima rwa Zambezi Portland, aho abanyamigabane bayo bake 'Ventriglias' bari barigaruriye ku tariki ya 7 ukwezi kwa Mata mu mwaka wa 2015. Kwitanga hagamijwe kurengera inyungu z'abakozi bakora ku ruganda rwa sima rwa Zambezi Portland.
Gutsindira mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Malawi mu mwaka wa 2015.
Tariki ya 28 ukwezi kwa Nyakanga mu mwaka wa 2015, Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Malawi rwemeje icyemezo cyo gushyigikira Dr. Rajan Mahtani aho byagaragaye ko Nyasa Times, yasohoye ibintu bisebanya mu izina rya Dr. Mahtani. Kubera ko nta kimenyetso cyihariye n’impaka zidafite ishingiro zivuye ku ruhande rwa Nyasa Times, Urukiko Rukuru rwahaye icyubahiro Dr. Rajan Mahtani intsinzi kandi Nyasa Times yasabwe gukuraho ibintu byose bisebanya ku rubuga rwayo hamwe no kwishyura amafaranga nk’indishyi ku gikomere cyatewe.
Gutsindira mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Lusaka mu mwaka wa 2015.
Nk’uko ikinyamakuru The Post kibitangaza ngo ku tariki ya 19 ukwezi kw'Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 2015, umucamanza w'Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Lusaka, Mwiinde Siavwapa yaciriye urubanza aho byahamijwe ko gufunga burundu bidashobora gusubirwamo kugira ngo habeho urubanza rushya. Iki kibazo kijyanye no gusaranganya amafaranga y’impimbano umuryango wa Ventriglia washyize Dr. Rajan Mahtani ku bijyanye n’uruganda rwa sima rwa Zambezi Portland. Hanzuwe ko mu izina ry’umuyobozi w’agateganyo w’ubushinjacyaha n’umwunganira mukuru ko byaba ari amakosa gushyigikira ifatwa ry’uwahoze ari umuyobozi wa banki y’imari, Dr. Rajan Mahtani.
Icyemezo cyafashwe mbere mu mwaka wa 2012, kizahagarara bityo rero, Mahtani ntashobora kubazwa ikibazo cy’inyandiko mpimbano ukundi.

Nkosana Makate (wavutse mu mwaka wa 1977), ni umunyafurika yepfo wasabye Vodacom igitekerezo cyitwa "Ndakwinginze umpamagare". Igitekerezo cye cyari kigizwe no kohereza ubutumwa kubuntu kubandi bakoresha Vodacom kugirango bagusabe ko baguhamagara, nubwo waba udafite inguzanyo ihagije yo kubikora. Nkosana Makate yasangiye igitekerezo n'umukoresha we, ariko ntabwo yigeze abona ubwishyu. Yashinjeje Vodacom kandi yatsinze urwo rubanza nyuma y'intambara y'imyaka 8.
Vodacom yatangiye serivisi yiswe Ndakwinginze umpamagare mu mwaka wa 2001. Urubanza rwaciwe mu mwaka wa 2014 mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Gauteng rwo mu majyepfo rwashyigikiye ikirego cya Makate ko ariwe nyiri gitekerezo cyaturutseho cya Ndakwinginze umpamagare. Yanze kandi icyifuzo cy'uwahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru, Alan Knott-Craig, avuga ko yazanye igitekerezo cya serivisi y'ubutumwa. Nyamara Urukiko Rukuru rwasanze Makate, ruvuga ko Geissler atari afite ububasha bwo gusezeranya Makate izo ndishyi kandi ko umwenda wari kurangira (mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko, byateganijwe) mu myaka itatu.
Makate yajuririye urwo rubanza, nyuma aza kurujyana mu Rukiko Rushinzwe Kurinda Iremezo ry'Itegeko Nshinga. Muri Mata mu mwaka wa 2016, umutabera Chris Jafta yasanze kuruhande rwa Makate no kurwanya Vodacom.

Tariki ya 29 ukwezi kwa Kamena mu mwaka wa 2005, Samuel Ndashyikirwa, wahoze ari umucuruzi muto i Kirwa, mu Rwanda, yakatiwe mu Bubiligi kubera uruhare yagize muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu mwaka wa 1994. Ababyiboneye bavuga ko yari yitabiriye ubwicanyi bwabereye i Kirwa kandi ko yagize uruhare rutaziguye muri ubwo bwicanyi, abashinjacyaha bavuga ko we na murumuna we, Etienne Nzabonimana, batanze imodoka, intwaro, n'inzoga ku basirikare b'u Rwanda bakora itsembabwoko mu karere ka ngoma.. Bombi bahamwe n'icyaha cyo gufasha imitwe ya gisirikare y'Abahutu mu kwica Abatutsi 50.000. Ndashyikirwa azamara imyaka icumi muri gereza, naho murumuna we azamara imyaka cumi n'ibiri.

Takealot ni sosiyeti yo muri Afrika y'epfo igurisha kumurongo kubaguzi bashaka uburyo bworoshye kugura kumurongo hamwe nuburambe bwabakoresha. Uru rubuga rumaze imyaka irenga icumi, rushyizweho mu mwaka wa 2002. Urutonde rwarwo rwagutse hamwe n’ibicuruzwa bitandukanye mu myidagaduro bitanga urwego rushimishije. Abakiriya barashobora kugura ikintu cyose kuva mubitabo kugeza kumikino, mudasobwa na TV.
Bimwe mubituma Takealot yerekana intsinzi ya e-ubucuruzi nuko umucuruzi wo kumurongo yihatira guha abakiriya bayo ibicuruzwa bigezweho kumasoko, hamwe nibisobanuro bigezweho.
Muri Mata 2017, Takealot yatsindiye ishoramari rikomeye rya miliyoni zisaga 69 z'amadolari ya Amerika muri Naspers, imwe mu masosiyete akomeye ya Afurika. Ibi bibaye nyuma y’uko umucuruzi wo kuri interineti yakiriye miliyoni 100 z’amadolari y’Amerika mu kigo cy’ishoramari Tiger Global Management mu 2014. Naspers ifite imigabane 53,5% muri Takealot, naho Tiger Global ifite 34%.

Amashanyarazi ya Nyabarongo Yambere (I) ni uruganda rutanga umuriro ugera kubushobozi bupimwa mumbaraga ibizwi nka megawate, aho zisaga 28 (28MW).
Urugomero rwa Nyabarongo I ni urugomero rw'amashanyarazi ruri mu Rwanda, rwuzuye mu Kwakira 2014, rukaba rwaratangiye gukoreshwa mu Gushyingo 2014. Biteganijwe ko kizatwara miliyoni 110 zamafaranga yu Rwanda hateganijwe kwishyiriraho ubushobozi ni MW 28. Uyu mushinga urimo urugomero, rufite igishushanyo mbonera cy’umugezi, hakurya y'Uruzi Mwogo, umwe mu masoko y'uruzi rwa Nyabarongo. Uyu mushinga wakozwe na Angelique International Limited na Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited yo mu Buhinde, niwo mushinga munini w'amashanyarazi mu Rwanda, kugeza ubu. Naresh Kapoor Sr., Umuyobozi mukuru ni Umuyobozi mukuru w’umushinga washyizweho na Angelique International Limited yo mu Buhinde. Bimwe mubikorwa byubwubatsi byanasezeranye nisosiyete yo muri Ositaraliya Snowy Mountains Engineering Corporation (SMEC). Ibyo bice byombi byahujwe na gride yo mu Rwanda ku ya 27 Ukwakira 2014 na 30 Ukwakira 2014. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yahaye rwiyemezamirimo igihe ntarengwa mu Kwakira 2014. Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi yararangiye ishyikirizwa umukiriya ku ya 28 Ugushyingo 2014. Yafunguwe ku mugaragaro na perezida wa Repubulika y'u Rwanda ku ya 5 Werurwe 2015.

Urugomero rw'amashanyarazi ya Rusumo, ruzwi ku izina rya Rusumo, ni urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe, hakaba hari hateganijwe gushyirwaho megawate zigera 80. Uyu mushinga wari urimo kubaka urugomero, hifashishijwe igishushanyo mbonera. megawate igishushanyo mbonera cy’ibigega cyatekerejweho mbere yo gutereranwa hashyirwaho umushinga wa MW 80 ufite ingaruka nkeya ku bidukikije ndetse bikaba bivugwa ko byatwaye miliyoni 300 amadolari ugereranije na miliyoni 400 z'amadolari ku mushinga munini. Banki y'isi yatangaje ku wa 6 Kanama 2013 ko yemeye inguzanyo ingana na miliyoni 340 z'amadolari y'Amerika yerekeza kuri miliyoni 468.60 z'amadolari y'Amerika yarakenewe muri uyu mushinga. Muri Gushyingo 2013, Banki Nyafurika itsura amajyambere yemeje inguzanyo ingana na miliyoni 113 z'amadolari y'Amerika kugira ngo umushinga urangire.
Sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi iri ku mugezi wa Kagera, hafi y’umupaka w’u Rwanda na Tanzaniya hamwe na kilometero 2 hepfo na ruguru aho ibihugu byombi bisangiye umupaka uhuriweho nu Burundi. Uyu mushinga wubatswe ku isoko ya Rusumo, hafi yumujyi wa Rusumo, hafi ya kilometero 164.5 mu majyepfo yuburasirazuba bwa Kigali, umurwa mukuru numujyi munini wu Rwanda. Isumo rya Rusumo ni, mu majyepfo yuburasirazuba bwicyicaro cyintara i Kibungo, mukarere ka Ngoma. Iyi sitasiyo yamashanyarazi iri ni: 02 ° 22'47.0 "S, 30 ° 47'09.0" E (Ubunini: -2.379722; Uburebure: 30.785833).
Imbaraga zitangwa zigabanywa bimwe mu bihugu nk'Uburundi, u Rwanda, na Tanzaniya. Amashanyarazi azavanwa mu ruganda rw’amashanyarazi akoresheje imirongo ya kilovolt 220 yohereza kuri sitasiyo zoherejwe muri: Gitega, u Burundi, intera ya kilometero 158 ; Kigali, u Rwanda, intera kilometero 115 na, Nyakanazi, Tanzaniya, intera ya kilometero 98.
Amajyambere ya vuba.
Mu Gushyingo 2016, hasinywe amasezerano abiri yo kubaka inzira y’amashanyarazi yasinyiwe i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Amasezerano ya mbere yari hagati ya Rusumo Power Company Limited hamwe n’ihuriro ry’abashoramari barimo umushinga uhuriweho na CGCOC Group Limited na Jiangxi Water and Hydropower Construction Company Limited. Aya masezerano ateganya imikorere yimirimo ya leta, harimo gutanga no gushyiramo ibikoresho bya hydro-mashini.
Amasezerano ya kabiri yasinywe hagati ya Rusumo Power Company Limited n’urugaga rw’a masosiyete, harimo Rusumo Falls Andritz Hydro GmbH yo mu Budage na Andritz Hydro PVT Limited yo mu Buhinde, kugira ngo ikore amashanyarazi yo kubyaza ingufu amashanyarazi.
Kugeza mu Gushyingo 2016, amafaranga ateganijwe muri uyu mushinga ni miliyoni 340 z'amadolari, azaterwa inkunga na Banki y'isi. Imirongo itatu y’amashanyarazi ihanitse izavana ingufu ziteganijwe biteganijwe ko izatwara miliyoni 121 z'amadolari, iterwa inkunga na Banki nyafurika ishinzwe iterambere. Biteganijwe ko imirimo yo kubaka izatangira muri Mutarama 2017.

Ingufu nini zo mu biyaga bigari, ni umuriro w'amashanyarazi ya pano soleye akorwa na EPC yashinzwe na Sam Dargan muri 2005. Isosiyete ifite icyicaro mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda kandi ikorera cyane cyane isoko rya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Isosiyete ifite ubuhanga bwo gukoresha ingufu zituruka ku mirasire y'izuba. Mu myaka icumi ishize, isosiyete yibanda cyane mu gusobanukirwa no gukemura ibibazo by’ingufu by’abo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Uyu munsi dukoresha ubwo bumenyi nuburambe mugushushanya, kubaka, no kubungabunga sisitemu yizuba yizewe, irambye, kandi ihendutse. Isosiyete itanga imiryango itegamiye kuri leta, ibitaro, n’ishuri hamwe na sisitemu nziza y’amafoto. Isosiyete ifite ubuhanga bwo kuvugurura ibishushanyo mbonera bya PV bituruka kuri grid hamwe na verisiyo nziza. Mubihe byashize iyi sosiyete yatanze akazi ko guhugura abanyarwanda baho uburyo bwo gukora injeniyeri no gushyiraho sisitemu. Isosiyete kandi yatanze amahugurwa kubandi ba rwiyemezamirimo bashinzwe imibereho biga gukorera muri Afurika.
Ingufu nini zo mu biyaga bigari zikwirakwiza amatara yizuba rya King King na Green Light Energy muri 2013 zemerera gutanga igisubizo cyu mucyo urambye ingo zo mucyaro mu Rwanda.
Muri mwaka wa 2014, ingufu z’ibiyaga bigari zafatanije na Global Bright Light Foundation gukwirakwiza amatara y’umwami w’izuba ku mpunzi ziri mu nkambi y’impunzi ya UNHCR Kiziba mu Rwanda.

Ikigo cya Akilah ni ishuri ridaharanira inyungu ku bagore i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Ni kaminuza ya mbere y’abagore mu gihugu. Ikigo gitanga impamyabumenyi y'imyaka itatu mu kwihangira imirimo nka rwiyemezamirimo, gucunga neza abashyitsi, hamwe na sisitemu yamakuru. Akilah yemerewe binyuze muri Minisiteri y'Uburezi mu Rwanda.
Ikigo cya Akilah cyashinzwe muri 2008 na Elizabeth Dearborn Hughes na Dave Hughes. Elizabeth Hughes yimukiye mu Rwanda nyuma yo kurangiza muri kaminuza ya Vanderbilt muri 2006. Amaze kwitanga hamwe n’ibikorwa byinshi byo mu nzego z'ibanze, yashinze Amani Afurika gutanga buruse ku bana bo mu muhanda.
Dave Hughes yinjiye muri gahunda nk'umukorerabushake. Bombi bafashe ingamba zo guhuza abagore mu Rwanda amahirwe yo kubona akazi igihe kirekire. Muri 2008, bateguye icyitegererezo cya Akilah Institute.
Ikigo cyafunguwe ku mugaragaro i Kigali, mu Rwanda, muri Mutarama 2010 gifite impamyabumenyi ijyanye no gucunga abashyitsi. Abanyeshuri 50 biyandikishije mu cyiciro cya mbere. Muri 2012, ikigo cyatangije impamyabumenyi yo kwihangira imirimo. Nyuma yimyaka ibiri, yatangije impamyabumenyi ya sisitemu.
Inshingano ya Akilah ni gutanga uburezi bujyanye n’isoko butuma abakobwa bakiri bato bagera ku bwigenge mu bukungu no kubona inshingano z’ubuyobozi mu kazi ndetse no muri sosiyete. Inyigisho zateguwe ku bufatanye n’abakoresha baho na guverinoma yu Rwanda. Ibyiciro byamasomo byatoranijwe ukurikije isoko ryakarere.
Ikigo cya Akilah ubu gifite abanyeshuri 1100 n’abanyeshuri 990 barangije. Ikigo gifite igipimo cyo kugumana 93 %, naho 88 % by'abanyeshuri barangije babona akazi mu mezi atandatu barangije.
Muri Mutarama 2014, Akilah yaguye mu Burundi maze afungura ishuri rya mbere ry'abagore mu gihugu. Muri Mata 2015, ikigo cyafunzwe kubera ihungabana rya politiki mu gihugu. Abanyeshuri 44 bo mu Burundi bimuriwe mu kigo cya Kigali cya Akilah.
Akilah iterwa inkunga cyane cyane binyuze mu guhuza imisanzu n'impano. Andi masoko yatanzwe harimo amafaranga yishuri ryabanyeshuri, impano yubwoko, nibikorwa bidasanzwe.
Ubufatanye bwa Marriott.
Muri 2012, Akilah yafatanije na Marriott International gutangiza gahunda yo guhugura abashyitsi barangije muri hoteri ya Marriott muri Dubai na Doha. Kuva gahunda yatangira, abize muri Akilah benshi bimukiye mu burasirazuba bwo hagati kugira ngo bitabira iyo gahunda. Marriott yahaye akazi 23 barangije Akilah mu bakozi bayo Hotel ya Kigali Marriott, yafunguwe muri 2016.
Muri 2015, Akilah yashinze u Rwanda itsinda ryambere ry’abagore biga impaka muri kaminuza. Ikipe yatsinze amarushanwa mu gihugu cyose muri uwo mwaka. Mu Kwakira 2015, Akilah yakiriye Shampiyona yambere y’igihugu ihuza amakipe y'abagore.
Muri Mutarama 2015, Elizabeth Dear born Hughe s washinze Akilah yatangije Mind Sky hamwe n’uwashinze Anastasia Uglova mu rwego rw’itsinda rya Akilah, icyegeranyo cy’ibigo by’imibereho byibanda ku burezi, ikoranabuhanga, ndetse n’akazi. Mind Sky ni urubuga rw'impano ku murongo ruhuza abakoresha nabashaka akazi muri Afurika yuburasirazuba.

Urumogi mu Rwanda rwemewe kubera ruvamo imiti, ariko nanone rutemewe mu rwego rwo kwidagadura.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe muri 1959 – 1960 bwerekanye ko kunywa urumogi mu Rwanda muri kiriya gihe byagarukiraga ku baturage bake ba Twa. Amashyirahamwe mabi y’urumogi n’urugomo, hamwe n’imibereho mike ya Twa, byatumye imikoreshereze yacyo igarukira muri ubwo bwoko.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Minisitiri w’ubuzima yasabye itegeko ryemerera urumogi gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu gihugu. Muri 2021, u Rwanda rwemeje itegeko ryo gukora urumogi hagamijwe imiti.

Ihererekanya ry'amafaranga ry'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, n'Isoko ry’ibicuruzwa byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ni isoko ry’abikorera ku giti cyabo, guhana ibicuruzwa mu buhinzi muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, yatangijwe i Kigali, mu Rwanda, muri Nyakanga 2014. ivunjisha ni iya gatatu mu bucuruzi bw’ibicuruzwa by’ubuhinzi muri Afurika, nyuma y’ivunjisha ry’ejo hazaza muri Afurika yepfo no kuvunja ibicuruzwa muri Etiyopiya.
Icyicaro gikuru cya EAX giherereye mu igorofa rya 12, ku munara wa Kigali City, Avenue du Commerce, mu mujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda. icyicaro gikuru cyiri ni: 1 ° 56'37.0 "S, 30 ° 03'34.0" E (Ubunini: -1.943601; Uburebure: 30.059431).
Intego y'ibanze yo kungurana ibitekerezo ni korohereza abahinzi n’abakora umusaruro w’ubuhinzi kubona ibiciro byiza ku bicuruzwa byabo n’ibicuruzwa ndetse no kubona inkunga ikwiye ku bucuruzi bwabo. Guhera ku bigori n'ibishyimbo, guhana birateganya kwaguka mu ikawa, icyayi, n'umuceri. Kuva muri Werurwe 2016,ivunjisha ikorera mu Rwanda na Kenya ifite gahunda yo kwinjira muri Uganda mu 2016.

Sitasiyo y'amashanyarazi, cyangwa uruganda rw'amashanyarazi rimwe na rimwe ni uruganda rutanga amashanyarazi, ni uruganda rukora amashanyarazi. Amashanyarazi muri rusange ahujwe na giride y'amashanyarazi.
Amashanyarazi menshi arimo ahari moteri imwe cyangwa nyinshi, imashini izunguruka ihindura ingufu za mashini mu mashanyarazi atatu. Icyerekezo kigereranije hagati yu murongo wa manyeti n'uyobora ikora amashanyarazi.
Inkomoko yingufu zikoreshwa muguhindura generator ziratandukanye cyane. Amashanyarazi menshi ku isi atwika ibicanwa nka amakara, peteroli, na gaze karemano kugirango bitange amashanyarazi. Amashanyarazi make ya karubone arimo ingufu za kirimbuzi, no gukoresha ibishobora kuvugururwa nk'izuba, umuyaga, geothermal, na hydroelectirike.
Muri ntangiriro za 1871, uwahimbye umubiligi Zénobe Gramme yahimbye generator ifite imbaraga zihagije zitanga ingufu ku rwego rw’ubucuruzi ku nganda.
Muri 1878, sitasiyo y’amashanyarazi yateguwe kandi yubatswe na William, Lord Armstrong ahitwa Cragside, mu Bwongereza. Yakoresheje amazi ava mu biyaga kumurima we kugirango ingufu za Siemensi. Amashanyarazi yatangaga amashanyarazi ku matara, gushyushya, kubyara amazi ashyushye, gukora lift hamwe nibikoresho bizigama abakozi ninyubako zu buhinzi.
Muri Mutarama 1882, sitasiyo ya mbere y’amashanyarazi rusange y’amakara ku isi, Edison y’amashanyarazi ya Edison, yubatswe i Londres, umushinga wa Thomas Edison wateguwe na Edward Johnson. Imashini ya Babcock &amp;amp; Wilcox yakoresheje kilowate 93 moteri yatwaraga moteri zigera 27. Ibi byatanze amashanyarazi muri bibanza byo muri ako gace byashoboraga kugerwaho binyuze mu miyoboro ya gari ya moshi utabanje gucukura umuhanda, wari wiharira amasosiyete ya gaze. Abakiriya barimo Urusengero rw'umujyi na Bailey ishaje. Undi mukiriya w'ingenzi yari Ibiro bya Telegraph by'Ibiro Bikuru by'Amaposita, ariko ntibyashobokaga kugerwaho binyuze mu mwobo. Johnson yateguye umugozi wo gutanga kugirango ukoreshwe hejuru, unyuze kuri Holborn Tavern na Newugate.
Muri 2018, Inter RAO UES na Grid ya Leta, hateganijwe kubaka urugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa wate 8 GW, akaba ariwo mushinga munini wo kubaka urugomero rw'amashanyarazi muri Burusiya.
Imbaraga zituruka ku mbaraga zishobora kubaho.
Amashanyarazi arashobora kubyara ingufu z'amashanyarazi ziva mu rugomero rwa mashanyarazi.
Amashanyarazi manini akoreshwa n’a makara, nucleaire, n’amashanyarazi arashobora kubyara megawate amagana kuri gigawate nyinshi. Ingero zimwe:

Umuriro wa Gaze isanzwe (nanone yitwa gaze ya fosile cyangwa gaze gusa) ni ibisanzwe bivangwa na hydro karibone ya gaze igizwe ahanini na metani hiyongereyeho umubare muto wa alikane ndende. Urwego rwo hasi rwa gaze nka gaze karuboni, azote, hydrogen sulfide, na helium nabyo birahari. Methane idafite ibara kandi nta mpumuro nziza, bityo impumuro nziza nka mercaptan (ihumura nka sulfuru cyangwa amagi yaboze) ikunze kongerwa mu bikoresho bya gaze karemano kugirango umutekano ube byoroshye.
Gaze isanzwe ni lisansi y’ibinyabuzima n’umutungo udashobora kuvugururwa ukorwa iyo ibice by’ibinyabuzima (cyane ibinyabuzima byo mu nyanja) byangirika mu bihe bya anaerobike kandi bigashyirwa n’ubushyuhe bukabije n’umuvuduko mwinshi mu myaka miriyoni. Ingufu ibinyabuzima byangirika byabonetse ku zuba hakoreshejwe fotosenteze za bibikwa nkingufu za chimique muri molekile ya metani nizindi hydro karbone.
Gaze isanzwe irashobora gutwikwa kugirango ishyushye, guteka, no kubyara amashanyarazi. Ikoreshwa kandi nk'ibiryo bya chimique mugukora plastike nindi miti mvaruganda ikomeye mubucuruzi kandi ntibikoreshwa cyane nka lisansi yimodoka.
Gukuramo no gukoresha gaze karemano n’ingenzi kandi bigenda byiyongera mu mihindagurikire y’ikirere. Gazi ubwayo (cyane metani) na karuboni ya dioxyde, isohoka iyo gaze naturel yatwitse, ni gaze ya parike. Iyo itwitswe kubera ubushyuhe cyangwa amashanyarazi, gaze karemano isohora imyuka ihumanya ikirere nkeya, dioxyde de carbone nkeya, kandi hafi ya byose nta kintu na kimwe kigereranije ugereranije n’ibindi bicanwa n’ibinyabuzima. Nyamara, guhumeka gaze hamwe n’imyuka itabigenewe itangwa mu ruhererekane rw’ibicuruzwa birashobora gutuma gaze karemano igira ikirenge cya karuboni kimwe n’ibindi bicanwa muri rusange.
Gaze isanzwe irashobora kuva mubutaka igatera umuriro muremure. Mu Bugereki bwa kera, umuriro wa gaze ku musozi wa Chimaera wagize uruhare mu mugani w'ikinyabuzima gihumeka umuriro Chimera. Mu Bushinwa bwa kera, gaze yavuye mu gucukura brine yakoreshejwe bwa mbere na 400 mbere ya Yesu. Abashinwa batwaye gaze yinjira mu butaka mu miyoboro itavanze imigano aho yakoreshwaga mu guteka amazi y'umunyu kugira ngo bakuremo umunyu mu Karere ka Ziliujing muri Sichuan.

Inkomoko Business Developmen Ni ikigo cyashinzwe muri 2012 mu Rwanda bikozwe nka Julienne Oyler hamwe na Sara Leedom. Mu byo gikora harimo gutanga igishoro, amasomo ajyanye no gucuruza, guhuza ba rwiyemezemirimo bato n’ibigo bikomeye. ni kimwe mu bigo muri Afurika mu kuzamura ba rwiyemezamirimo mu bihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, cyibanda ku rubyiruko rukizamuka n’impunzi.
Inkomoko Business Development ni kompanyi ikorana na ba rwiyemezamirimo bato ndetse baciriritse, harimo nki impunzi, guhanga imirimo, kuzamura imibereho kuri bose, no guteza imbere imiryango itera imbere muri Afurika, aho cyakoranye na ba rwiyemezamirimo bagera kuri 40.000.
Inkomoko Entrepreneur Development igira gahunda zitandukanye zizamura urubyiruko, urugero nka BK Urumuri Initiative gahunda ifatanya na Banki ya Kigali, yahinduriye benshi ubuzima.

BK Urumuri Initiative ni amahugurwa n'amarushanwa, yagenewe ba rwiyemezamirimo bato, kugaragaza uburyo barengera ibidukikije, hatoranywa ibigo bigera kuri 25, ba nyirabyo bahabwe amahugurwa n’ubujyanama bugezweho mu gihe kigera ku mezi atandatu, nyuma hatoranywemo ba rwiyemezamirimo habwa inguzanyo yishyurwa nta nyungu nimwe yongeweho.
BK Urumuri Initiative itanga Amahugurwa kuri ba rwiyemezamirimo bahabwa ajyanye ni micungire inoze y’imishinga yabo, uburyo bashobora guteza imbere ubucuruzi ndetse no guhanga imirimo. muri ibi bihe bazita ku mishinga ifasha abaturage guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, mu rwego rwo gutegura ejo hazaza harangwa n’Isi itoshye kandi inogeye buri wese. Ni mu gihe inkomoko business development yo itanga ubujyanama n’amahugurwa ku bakora ubucuruzi.

iImyenda ny'afurika ni imyenda ituruka ahantu hatandukanye k'umugabane wa Afrika. Hirya no hino muri Afurika, hariho uburyo bwinshi butandukanye, tekinike, uburyo bwo gusiga amarangi, n'intego zo gushushanya no gukora. Iyi myenda ifite umuco kandi ifite akamaro nk'inyandiko za mateka y'ubushakashatsi bwa Afurika.
Zimwe mu myenda ya kera ya Afurika yarokotse yavumbuwe ahahoze aruheologiya ya Kissi mu majyaruguru ya Burkina Faso. Bikozwe mu bwoya cyangwa umusatsi mwiza mugufi w'inyamanswa harimo uruhu rwumye kugirango ube inyangamugayo. Ibice bimwe na bimwe byarokotse kuva mu kinyejana cya cumi na gatatu Umujyi wa Benine muri Nijeriya. Amateka imyenda yakoreshejwe nk'uburyo bw'ifaranga kuva mu kinyejana cya cumi na kane muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba no muri Afurika yo hagati. Hano hepfo ni incamake ya tekinoroji isanzwe hamwe nibikoresho byimyenda ikoreshwa mukarere ka Afrika ndetse nibihugu bitandukanye.
Stripweaving, imaze ibinyejana byinshi ikora imyenda yo gukora imyenda yo kuboha imyenda hamwe, iranga kuboha muri Afrika yuburengerazuba, bashimira abadozi ba Mande cyane cyane abanya Tellem nkabambere mu buhanga bwo kuboha imyenda igoye yo kuboha. 4 Ibyavuye mu buvumo bwa Escarpment ya Bandiagara muri Mali byerekana ko byakoreshwa kuva mu kinyejana cya 11. Imyenda ya stripwoven igizwe nimirongo migufi yaciwe muburebure bwifuzwa kandi idoda hamwe. Kuva muri Mali, tekinike yakwirakwiriye muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba kugera kuri Coryte d'Ivoire, Gana, na Nijeriya. Raphia fibre yavuye mumababi yumye yimikindo ya raphia yakunze gukoreshwa muri Afrika yuburengerazuba no muri Afrika yo hagati kuko iboneka cyane mubihugu bifite ibyatsi nka Kameruni, Gana, na Nijeriya. Ipamba y'ipamba iva ku giti cya kapok yakoreshejwe cyane na Da gomba kugirango itange imirongo miremire ya fibre kugirango Gana itere. Ibindi bikoresho bya fibre harimo ubudodo bwo mu gasozi budasize bwakoreshejwe muri Nijeriya mu kudoda no kuboha, ndetse n'igitambaro cyo mu biti by'imitini byakoreshwaga mu gukora imyenda y'ibirori muri Uganda, Kameruni, na Kongo. Nyuma yigihe kinini, fibre nyinshi zasimbuwe nipamba. Imyenda yaboshywe kumurongo utambitse cyangwa uhagaritse bitandukanye bitewe n'akarere.
Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Ipamba rya Etiyopiya: Usibye Etiyopiya, kuboha imyenda ntibikunze kugaragara muri Afrika y'uburasirazuba. Mu kinyejana cya 1, ipamba yatumizwaga muri Etiyopiya n'Abarabu. Etiyopiya ifite ibihe byiza byo guhinga ipamba bityo ipamba noneho ikahingwa m'ugace hanyuma ikaboshywa mu myenda y'ipamba k'umurongo utambitse 20 ikoreshwa cyane n'abafite imibereho myiza.
Abanyafurika y’iburengerazuba bakeneye imyenda y’ipamba byongereye ingufu mu majyepfomu gihe cy'abakoloni.
Ingero zimwe z'imyenda nyafurika ni izi zikurikira:

Skol Lager ni yatunganijwe mbere n’inzoga zikorwa na Ind Coope breweries i Alloa, muri ekosse yo hagati. Muri 1958, Continental Graham yatangije (ishingiye ku nzoga yaho yitwa Graham's Gorden) ihita ihinduka Skol ya Graham kugirango itange igitekerezo cyo muri Scandinaviya (uruganda rwose rwatumijwe muri Suwede). Izina ryaje kuvugururwa ubu ni Skol gusa.
Allied Breweries (UK), Labatt (Kanada), Pripps-Bryggerierna (Suwede), na Unibra (Ububiligi) bashinze isosiyete nshya yitwa Skol International muri 1964. Intego yacyo kwari ugushiraho ikirango cy’inzoga kuri isi, Skol, gishobora gutangwa, gukora no gucuruzwa ku isi hose. Mu mpera z'imyaka ya z 1960, ryamamajwe cyane kuri Radiyo pirate yo mu Buholandi yitwa Veronica nka Skol International, hamwe n'ijwi ryamamaza ryaririmbwe na Patrica Paay, waje kuba umuririmbyi wa pop mu Buholandi akaba n'umunyamakuru wa TV. Kuva icyo gihe kwitabira isosiyete byahindutse ku buryo bugaragara.
Kuva muri 1973 kugeza 1982, byeri munsi yikirango cya Skol yatekwaga n’inzoga yo mu Buholandi Oranjeboom, ariko ntibyagenze neza ku isoko ry’Ubuholandi.
Muri 1980, Skol yari umuterankunga mukuru wa Automotive ya Fittipaldi, nyuma yuko inkunga ya Copersucar irangiye shampiyona irangiye. Ikirango kandi cyateye inkunga marushanwa y’igikombe cya Scottish League kuva 1984 - 1992, igikombe cya kabiri Skol Cup gihabwa abatsinze hamwe n'igikombe gisanzwe cya shampiyona muri iki gihe.
Muri 1992, ihuriro hagati ya Allied Breweries na Carlsberg ryateje Carlsberg Tetley's, yimuye umusaruro wa Skol uva Alloa ujya mu ruganda rwabo i Leeds kugeza ubwo inzoga zafunzwe muri 2011. Ikomeje gukwirakwizwa mu Bwongereza, hamwe na ABV yagabanutse kugera kuri 2.8%.
Carlsberg afite uruhushya rwo guteka no gucuruza inzoga ku isi hose, usibye Afurika na Amerika y'Epfo. Unibra ifite uruhushya rwa Afurika. Mu Burayi, byeri nayo ikorerwa kandi igacuruzwa muri Rumaniya na Turukiya. Muri Aziya, ikwirakwizwa muri Maleziya, Ubushinwa, Hong Kong, na Singapore. Muri Afurika, iri muri Angola, u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Gineya, Madagasikari, n'u Rwanda. Izina ni ururimi rw'icyongereza ruhindura ibinyobwa bya Scandinaviya skål. Mu gihe runaka, Hägar the cartrible cartoon character yakoreshejwe mu kuzamurwa.
Ku isoko rya Berezile Skol yongeyeho ibinyobwa bishya ku kirango cyabo cyitwa Skol Beats gifite uburyohe bwa citrus hamwe nuburyohe bwinshi, harimo ubururu, umutuku, n'icyatsi, hiyongereyeho umurongo mushya wa gin ya Skol Beats n'ibinyobwa bya tonike byose birimo hafi 7.9% inzoga.
Ikirango cyahawe igihembo cya Zahabu mu guhitamo ubuziranenge bw’isi 2012, cyateguwe na Monde Selection. Iki cyari igihembo cya kabiri mpuzamahanga Skol yatsindiye. Inzoga yahawe kandi umudari wa zahabu wo gupakira ndetse n’umudari wa feza mu cyiciro cy uburyohe mu bihembo mpuzamahanga by’inzoga bya Ositaraliya 2005.

Isoko rimwe ryo gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu kirere (Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM)) ni umushinga w’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika yo gushyiraho isoko rimwe ryo gutwara indege muri Afurika. Iyo isoko rimwe imaze gukurikizwa, isoko rimwe rigomba kwemerera ubwisanzure bukomeye bwo gutwara abantu n'ibintu muri Afurika, igateza imbere gahunda ya AU 2063.
Icyambere, intego ya SAATM ni ugushyira m'ubikorwa by'imazeyo Icyemezo cya Yamoussoukro muri 1999. Ibi bivuze ko abitabiriye amahugurwa bose bemeye gukuraho imipaka y’isoko ry’indege, kuvanaho imipaka ku nyungu zabo, guha buri wese uburenganzira bwo kugenda mu kirere (mbere y’ubwisanzure bwa gatanu, ntibibangamira uburenganzira bwa cabotage), no guha uburenganzira bwo kuguruka no kugabanya ubushobozi. Indege zombi zitwara abagenzi n'imizigo zirimo. Irashaka kandi guhuza amabwiriza y’umutekano n’umutekano mu ndege, ishingiye ku bisabwa na ICAO. Kugenzura SAATM bikorwa n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika, Umuryango w’ubukungu w’akarere, na komisiyo nyafurika ishinzwe indege za gisivili (AFCAC).
Inyungu yo kwishyira ukizana mu kirere, cyane cyane umudendezo wa gatanu, yemejwe bwa mbere mu itangazo rya Yamoussoukro ryo mu 1988. Iri tangazo ryongeye gushimangirwa mu 1999, igihe Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika watoye icyemezo cya Yamoussoukuro. Icyakora, ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'icyemezo ryahuye n'inzitizi, kubera ko inzego zishinzwe kugenzura ibikorwa zitatangiye gukora nk'uko biteganijwe mu masezerano. Ibihugu byinshi bigize uyu muryango ntabwo byahaye uburenganzira bwa gatanu ubwisanzure ku ndege zituruka mu bindi bihugu.
Mu mwaka wo muri 2015, Declaration for the Establishment of a Single African Air Transport Market ryashyizeho urwego rwi soko rimwe rishyira mu bikorwa icyemezo cya Yamoussoukro kizashyirwaho muri 2017. Iki gihe ntarengwa cyongerewe gahunda yo gutangiza isoko rimwe mu nama ya 30 y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Afurika yabereye i Addis Abeba. Aho, itangizwa rya SAATM ryashyizwe ku mugaragaro ku ya 28 Mutarama 2018 na Perezida w’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, nk'umuyobozi mushya w’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika. Uyu muryango washatse kugira abanyamuryango 40 mu mpera za 2019.
Ibihugu 23 bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika byabanje kwemera kwinjira muri SAATM nkabitabira gutangira. Nyakanga 2022 hari ibihugu 34 byitabiriye:
Bamwe muri guverinoma n’indege za Afurika banenze umushinga. By'umwihariko indege ntoya, kimwe na guverinoma ya Uganda, bavuga ko ayo masezerano yatuma indege nke nini ziganje ku isoko, bityo bikazimya amarushanwa.
Banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere, hamwe n’abandi basesenguzi, yahanuye ko SAATM izageza ku ndege zihendutse, ubwinshi bw’abagenzi n’inyungu z’ubukungu.
Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryo gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu kirere ryashimye Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika gutangiza isoko rimwe, ariko uraburira ko hazakenerwa byinshi kugira ngo iyi politiki ishyirwe mu bikorwa neza.
Abdérahmane Berthé, umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’indege ny'afurika, yavuze ko icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyafashije ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya SAATM.

Komisiyo Nyafurika ishinzwe iby'indege za gisivili (African Civil Aviation Commission, AFCAC) ni ikigo cy’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika gifite icyicaro i Dakar, muri senegal. Intego yacyo ni uguteza imbere no kugenzura indege za gisivili muri Afurika.
AFCAC yashinzwe nk'ikigo cyihariye cy’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika ku ya 17 Mutarama 1969. Icyemezo cya Yamoussoukro cyanditswe muri 1999 gitangira gukurikizwa muri 2002. Ubu AFCAC ni ikigo gikora isoko rimwe ryo gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu kirere, rishyira mu bikorwa Icyemezo cya Yamoussoukro. Ubufatanye bwayo n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’indege za gisivili burimo guteza imbere ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ubuziranenge bwa ICAO hamwe n’ibikorwa byasabwe.
Ikigo cyakira ubufasha bw’ubuyobozi n’imari na ICAO kandi cyabonye inkunga na Banki ny'afurika itsura amajyambere. Muri 2015 leta nyinshi ntabwo zishyuye umusanzu wabanyamuryango na 90 % by'amafaranga AFCAC yinjiza yakoreshejwe ku mushahara n'amafaranga y'ubuyobozi.

Ishyirahamwe nyafurika ry’indege (African Airlines Association) (AFRAA), ni ishyirahamwe ry’ubucuruzi ry’indege ny'afurika. AFRAA yashinzwe i Accra, muri Gana, muri 1968, ikaba ifite guhera muri Gashyantare 2021, ifite icyicaro i Nairobi muri Kenya. Intego y'ibanze ya AFRAA ni ugushiraho no koroshya ubufatanye hagati yindege za Afrika.
Ishyirwaho ry’ishyirahamwe ry’indege nyafurika ryaturutse ku iterambere ry’amateka ndetse n’ubukungu budasanzwe. Mu ntangiriro ya za 1960, ibihugu byinshi by'Afurika byinjiye mu bwigenge kandi bishyiraho indege zabo bwite. Inyinshi muri izo ndege zabaye abanyamuryango b'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.
AFRAA yatangije igitekerezo cyayo muri 1963, ubwo indege nyinshi z’indege nyafurika, zafataga umwanya zitangwa n’inama rusange ngarukamwaka ya IATA (AGM) zatangiye gukora inama nyunguranabitekerezo mbere ya AGMs za IATA kugira ngo baganire ku bibazo bifuza indege za Afurika no gufata imyanya imwe.. Iyi yari intambwe yambere iganisha ku ishyirwaho rya AFRAA. Kuva kuri iyo ntambwe yambere yabereye i Roma mu 1963, hashyizweho mu 1968 i Accra, umuryango w’akarere ushinzwe kuvuga ibitekerezo by’akarere no guteza imbere ubufatanye byakozwe n’abanyamuryango 14 bashinze.
AFRAA nkishyirahamwe ifite intego zingenzi zikurikira:
Guteza imbere inganda uburyo bwiza bwo gushyigikira ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere butekanye, butekanye kandi bwizewe muri Afurika
Kunganira kugabanya ibiciro bya serivisi zitwara indege muri Afurika ugabanya imisoro, imisoro n'amahoro
Duharanire gushyira mubikorwa iterambere rihendutse ry'abakozi
Lobby yo kubona isoko kugirango yongere amafaranga kandi yongere umurongo windege muri Afrika
Kora ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryibikorwa bigamije kugabanya ibiciro byindege zindege, kongera amafaranga n imigabane ku isoko
Korohereza no gushishikariza ubufatanye hagati y'indege ny'afurika
Ba ihuriro ry'amakuru, ubwenge nubuhanga ku nganda ny'afurika zindege
Urwego rwo hejuru rushyiraho politiki y’ishyirahamwe ni Inteko rusange ngarukamwaka igizwe n'abayobozi bakuru b'indege z'abanyamuryango. Inteko rusange ngarukamwaka iyobowe na Perezida w’ishyirahamwe. Perezida w'ishyirahamwe azunguruka buri mwaka.
Abanyamuryango ba AFRAA.
Isosiyete y'indege iyo ari yo yose ikora ibikorwa by'indege mu gutwara abagenzi cyangwa imizigo kandi yujuje ibyangombwa byujuje ibisabwa irashobora gusaba kuba umunyamuryango nk'umunyamuryango ukora cyangwa Associate. Ibikurikira nurutonde rwabanyamuryango ba AFRAA bariho.

Ibihembo by'ikoranabuhanga bya Afurika ni ibirori ngarukamwaka byizihizwa, kugira ngo bamenye ndetse banahembe abakinyi b'ikoranabuhanga muri Afrika. Ibihembo birashimira abashinzwe iterambere hamwe nabateza imbere mugihe bishimira abakoresha imari y'ikoranabuhanga, imbuga nkoranyambaga, Mobile, Agritech, Itangazamakuru, Itumanaho, esports n'ibindi.

Agace k'Ubucuruzi Bw’Ubutatu (Tripartite Free Trade Area, TFTA) ni amasezerano y’ubucuruzi ny'afurika ateganijwe hagati y’isoko rusange ry’Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo (COMESA), Umuryango w’iterambere ry’Afurika yepfo (SADC) n’umuryango w’Afurika y’iburasirazuba (EAC).
Ku ya 10 Kamena 2015, amasezerano yasinyiwe mu Misiri n'ibihugu byerekanwe hepfo (mu gihe hagitegerejwe kwemezwa n'inteko ishinga amategeko).
Ku ya 15 Kamena 2015, mu nama ya 25 y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Afurika Yabereye i Johannesburg, muri Afurika yepfo, hatangijwe imishyikirano yo gushyiraho akarere k’ubucuruzi n’ubucuruzi bw’umugabane wa Afurika (CFTA) bitarenze muri 2017, twizeraga ko ibihugu 54 bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Afurika nk’abanyamuryango b’ubucuruzi bwisanzuye mu akarere.

Africa Online Holding Ltd, rimwe na rimwe mu magambo ahinnye ni AFOL, ni yo itanga serivisi nini kuri interineti (ISP) muri Afurika. Iherereye i Nairobi, muri Kenya, itanga umurongo wa interineti kandi ikorera mu bihugu icumi bya Afurika, harimo Cote d'Ivoire, Gana, Namibiya, Eswatini, Tanzaniya, Uganda na Zimbabwe. Serivisi zitangwa na Africa Online zirimo guhamagara kuri interineti, serivisi zikodeshwa kumurongo, konte ya imeri, guhuza VSAT, DSL, WAN na VPN kubakiriya bigenga n'abacuruzi. Mu mwaka wa 2007 yahindutse ishami rya.
Sosiyete yatangijwe mu mwaka wa 1994 na Ayisi Makatiani, Karanja Gakio na Amolo Ng'weno, Abanyakenya batatu bahuye ari abanyeshuri bo muri Cambridge, Massachusetts. Makatiani na Gakio bari muri MIT mugihe Ng'weno yari Harvard. Igitekerezo cyibanze cya serivise y'amakuru yo kumurongo kubanyakenya yatejwe imbere n'umuryango wa interineti wakiriwe muri MIT witwa KenyaNet. KenyaNet yari imwe mu tumanaho abaturage benshi bibanda muri Afrika (abandi ni Okyeame muri Gana, Naijanet muri Nijeriya, na Salonet muri Siyera Lewone) yashinzwe kandi ikorwa nabanyeshuri ba MIT ikanakirwa kuri seriveri ya MIT.
Hamwe no kwamamaza kuri interineti, Africa Online yarebye kure igira igitekerezo cyo kugeza amakuru kubandi banyafurika bo ku mugabane hifashishijwe interineti. Mu mwaka wa 1995, sosiyete yaguzwe na International Wireless ya Boston, bituma irangira amaherezo yitwa Prodigy. Muri icyo gihe, Africa Online yatangiye gukora nka ISP ya mbere yo muri Kenya, nyuma yaje kwaguka muri Cote d'Ivoire mu mwaka wa (1995) igera muri Gana, Tanzaniya, Uganda, Zambiya, Zimbabwe na Swaziland, Abanyakenya batatu bakomeje kuyobora icyo gikorwa. Muri icyo gikorwa, Africa Online yaguze ISP nyinshi, nka Pipex Internet Solution (Swaziland), Net2000 (Kenya), UUNET (Namibia) na Swift Global (Uganda).
Mu mwaka wa 1998, Prodigy yagurishije sosiyete muri Afurika y'Ibiyaga Bigari. Ibiyaga by'Afurika byari byashyizwe ku isoko ry’imigabane ry'i londere kuva mu mwaka wa 1877, bikaba byarimo byaguka mu muco gakondo w'ubuhinzi no mu bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Mu gihe gito iyi sosiyete yishimiwe n’abashoramari, yandikwa ku isoko ry’imigabane rya Nairobi mu mwaka wa 2001, ariko imigabane yayo yaje gutakaza ubutaka maze ishyirwa ku rutonde i Londere na Nairobi mu mwaka wa 2003. Icyo gihe, abashinze iyi sosiyete uko ari 3 bari baravuye muri Africa Online.
Africa Online yaguzwe na Telkom Africa y'epfo mu mwaka wa 2007.

Agace k'Ubucuruzi Nyafurika ku Buntu (African Continental Free Trade Area(AfCFTA)) ni agace k'ubucuruzi ku buntu gakubiyemo igice kinini cy'Afurika. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wo muri 2018 n’amasezerano ny'afurika y’ubucuruzi ku mugabane wa Afurika, afite amashami 43 n’abandi 11 bashyize umukono ku masezerano, akaba ari yo gace k’ubucuruzi n’ibihugu byinshi, nyuma y’umuryango w’ubucuruzi ku isi, kandi kikaba kinini mu baturage ingano yaho hose, igera kuri miliyari 1,3 ku mugabane wa kabiri munini ku isi.
Amasezerano yashinze AfCFTA yashyizweho n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika Yunze ubumwe (AU) ashyirwaho umukono n’ibihugu 44 mu bihugu 55 bigize uyu muryango i Kigali, mu Rwanda ku ya 21 Werurwe 2018. Iki cyifuzo cyashyizwe mu bikorwa nyuma yiminsi 30 yemejwe n’ibihugu 22 byashyize umukono ku masezerano. Ku ya 29 Mata 2019, Repubulika ya Saharawi yashyize ku nshuro ya 22 ibikoresho byemeza, bituma amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku ya 30 Gicurasi; yinjiye mu cyiciro cyayo gikurikira nyuma y’inama yo ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2019, itangira ku mugaragaro ku ya 1 Mutarama 2021. Imishyikirano ya AfCFTA no kuyishyira mu bikorwa bigenzurwa n’ubunyamabanga buhoraho bufite icyicaro i Accra, muri Gana.
Muri 1963, Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika washinzwe n’ibihugu byigenga by'Afurika. OAU yari igamije guteza imbere ubufatanye hagati y’ibihugu by'Afurika. Gahunda y'ibikorwa ya Lagos yo muri 1980 yemejwe n'umuryango. Umugambi wasabye ko Afurika igomba kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku Burengerazuba mu guteza imbere ubucuruzi hagati y’Afurika. Ibi byatangiye hashyirwaho imiryango myinshi y’ubufatanye mu karere mu turere dutandukanye twa Afurika, nk’inama yo guhuza iterambere ry’Afurika yepfo. Amaherezo, ibyo byatumye Amasezerano ya Abuja muri 1991, ashyiraho Umuryango w’ubukungu w’Afurika, umuryango wateje imbere iterambere ry’ubucuruzi bw’ubucuruzi, ihuriro ry’imisoro, Banki nkuru y’Afurika, n’ubumwe bw’Afurika rusange.
Muri 2002, OAU yasimbuwe n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika Yunze ubumwe (AU), yari ifite imwe mu ntego zayo zo kwihutisha ubukungu bw’umugabane. Intego ya kabiri yari guhuza no guhuza politiki hagati y’umuryango w’ubukungu w’akarere uhari n’ejo hazaza kugira ngo intego z’Ubumwe zigerweho buhoro buhoro.
2018 Inama ya Kigali.
Muri Werurwe 2018, mu nama ya 10 idasanzwe y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Afurika Yunze ubumwe kuri AfCFTA, hasinywe amasezerano atatu atandukanye: Amasezerano y’ubucuruzi y’ubucuruzi ku mugabane wa Afurika ku mugabane wa Afurika, Itangazo rya Kigali na Porotokole ku Kwimuka kwabantu. Amasezerano agenga urujya n'uruza rw'abantu arashaka gushyiraho akarere katarangwamo viza mu bihugu bya AfCFTA, no gushyigikira ishyirwaho rya Passe porti y’ubumwe bw’afurika. Mu nama yabereye i Kigali ku ya 21 Werurwe 2018, ibihugu 44 byashyize umukono kuri AfCFTA, 47 bishyira umukono ku Itangazo rya Kigali, naho 30 bishyira umukono ku masezerano yerekeye kugenda kw’abantu. Nubwo byagenze neza, hari abantu babiri bazwi: Nijeriya na Afurika y'Epfo, ubukungu bubiri bukomeye muri Afurika.
Kimwe mu bintu bigoye mu mishyikirano ni uko Afurika yari imaze kwigabanyamo ibice umunani bitandukanye by’ubucuruzi bwigenga na cyangwa ihuriro ry’amashyirahamwe ya gasutamo, buri gihugu gifite amabwiriza atandukanye. Izi nzego zo mu karere zizakomeza kubaho, Amasezerano y’ubucuruzi y’umugabane wa Afurika ku mugabane wa mbere arashaka kugabanya inzitizi z’ubucuruzi hagati y’inkingi zinyuranye z’umuryango w’ubukungu bw’Afurika, hanyuma amaherezo agakoresha iyo miryango yo mu karere nk’inzitizi z’intego nya mukuru y’ubumwe bwa gasutamo muri Afurika.
Inzego zikurikira zashyizweho kugirango zorohereze ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ubucuruzi bwisanzuye. Kubera imishyikirano y'icyiciro cya kabiri hashobora gushyirwaho komite nyinshi binyuze mu masezerano.
Hashyizweho komite nyinshi, z’ubucuruzi bw’ibicuruzwa, ubucuruzi muri serivisi, ku mategeko akomokaho, imiti y’ubucuruzi, inzitizi zidasoreshwa, inzitizi za tekinike zibangamira ubucuruzi ndetse n’ingamba z’isuku na phytosanitarite. Amategeko nuburyo bwo gukemura amakimbirane biracyaganirwaho, ariko birashoboka ko bizaba birimo gushyiraho urwego rushinzwe gukemura amakimbirane. Komite y'abayobozi bakuru mu bucuruzi ishyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo by'Inama Njyanama. Komite ishinzwe guteza imbere gahunda na gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano y'AfCFTA.
Ibindi bihugu bigize AU.
Eritereya ntiyasinye kubera amakimbirane na Etiyopiya, ariko guhera muri 2019, nyuma y’inama ya Eritereya na Etiyopiya 2018, Komiseri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda muri AU yari yiteze ko amaherezo Eritereya izasinya ayo masezerano.
Isuzuma ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Muri Nyakanga 2017, raporo y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe ubukungu muri afurika, ivuga ko CFTA ishobora kugira uruhare mu guhangana n’ubukene n’ubusumbane kuko ubwinshi bwayo buzafasha impinduka zishingiye ku miterere y’ubukungu bwa Afurika. Bibonwa ko ari intambwe iganisha kuri Gahunda yo muri 2063 y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika hamwe n’intego zirambye z’iterambere. Inyandiko yari igamije kureba niba uburenganzira bwa muntu bwasuzumwe mu biganiro.

Gahunda ya 2063 ni urutonde rwibikorwa byasabwe kandi bishyirwa mu bikorwa n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika. Yemejwe ku ya 31 Mutarama 2015 mu Nteko rusange ya 24 y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma z’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika i Addis Abeba. Guhamagarira gahunda nk'iyi byakozwe bwa mbere n'Inteko ishinga amategeko ya 21 ku ya 26 Gicurasi 2013, nyuma y'imyaka 50 umuryango w’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika washinzwe, nka gahunda y’imyaka 50 iri imbere. Intego zavuzwe muri Gahunda ni iterambere ry’ubukungu (harimo no kurandura ubukene mu gisekuru kimwe), kwishyira hamwe kwa politiki (cyane binyuze mu ishyirwaho rya Afurika ihuriweho na Leta zunze ubumwe), guteza imbere demokarasi n’ubutabera, gushyiraho umutekano n’amahoro kuri umugabane wa Afurika wose, gushimangira indangagaciro z'umuco binyuze muri Afurika yubuzima bushya hamwe n'ibitekerezo bya Afurika, uburinganire n'ubwuzuzanye bwa politiki ku bihugu by'amahanga.
Raporo ya mbere yo ku mugabane wa Afurika ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Gahunda ya 2063 yatanzwe na Perezida Alassane Ouattara wa Kote divuwari ku ya 10 Gashyantare 2020, ibyo bikaba byatangiye ukwezi kwa kabiri. Ipima iterambere rirwanya intego zasobanuwe kuri gahunda yambere yimyaka icumi yo gushyira mu bikorwa kandi yatangijwe hamwe nu rubuga rwa interineti rwerekana interineti rwerekana iterambere mu bice bitandukanye bya Gahunda ndetse n’uturere.
Imishinga yibendera.
Gahunda ikubiyemo imishinga 15 yibendera, byagaragaye ko ari urufunguzo rwo gufasha no kwihutisha iterambere mu nzego zose ziterambere. Aba ni:
Gushyira mu bikorwa.
Agace k'ubucuruzi ku mugabane w' Afurika ku mugabane wa Afurika (ACFTA) kashyizweho n'amasezerano yemejwe muri Werurwe 2018 kandi azatangira gukora guhera ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2020. Banki nyafurika ishoramari n’ikigega cy’imari nyafurika byashyizweho ku izina, icyicaro gikuru kikaba cyubatswe i Tripoli, Libiya na Yaoundé, Kameruni. Igihugu cya Misiri kigiye kwakira Ikigo Nyafurika gishinzwe icyogajuru. Pan African Virtual na E-University (PAVEU) yashizweho nkimbaraga za digitale ya kaminuza ya Pan-African kandi itanga icyiciro cyambere cyamasomo atatu.
Imishinga myinshi irahagarikwa kubera kubura inkunga, nkumuyoboro wa gari ya moshi wihuta, ikigo cy’ikirere, n’urugomero rwa Inga.
Gahunda 2063 itera imbere kurubuga rwa NEPAD

African IXP Association, cyangwa AFIX, ni ihuriro ry’ingurane za interineti zikorera mu karere ka Afurika. Ni umuryango uyobowe n'abaturage ugamije guteza imbere inyungu z'abanyamuryango no kunoza imikoranire ku mugabane.
AFIX ni umunyamuryango wa federasiyo yo guhanahana amakuru kuri interineti (IX-F). Kuba umunyamuryango muri AFIX ni ubuntu kandi amarembo aruguruye ku bantu bose bakoresha enterineti ya Exchange Points in Africa.
Ishyirahamwe nyafurika rya IXP risanzwe riterana buri mwaka mu ihuriro nyafurika ry’urungano n’umuhuza (AfPIF) kandi rimwe na rimwe riterana kabiri-buri mwaka mu nama nyafurika (AIS).

Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’imari nyafurika (African Monetary Union, AMU) ni icyifuzo cyo gushyiraho ihuriro ry’ubukungu n’ifaranga ku bihugu bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika, riyobowe na Banki nkuru y’Afurika. Ihuriro nk'iryo ryasaba ko hashyirwaho ifaranga rishya rihuriweho, risa na Amayero, ifaranga rya hyipothetike rimwe na rimwe ryitwa afro cyangwa afriq. Ifaranga rimwe ry’Afurika rigomba kuba rigizwe n’ibice by’ifaranga bigizwe n’amabanki y’ubumwe bw’akarere agizwe n’ifaranga ryihariye ry’igihugu (Arab Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) Afurika y'Amajyaruguru, Umuryango w’iterambere ry’Afurika yepfo (SADC) afurika y'Amajyepfo, Umuryango w’ubukungu w’ibihugu bya Afurika y’iburengerazuba (ECOWAS) Afurika y’iburengerazuba cyangwa ECO, Umuryango w’Afurika y’iburasirazuba (EAC), Afurika y’iburasirazuba - Isoko rusange rya Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo (COMESA) - Afurika yo hagati n'ibindi.).
Amasezerano ya Abuja, amasezerano mpuzamahanga yashyizweho umukono ku ya 3 Kamena 1991, i Abuja, muri Nijeriya, yashyizeho Umuryango w’ubukungu w’Afurika, anasaba Banki nkuru y’Afurika gukurikiza mu 2028. muri 2019, gahunda ni ugushiraho Umuryango w’ubukungu nyafurika ufite ifaranga rimwe mu 2023.
Ihuriro ry’amashyirahamwe y’ifaranga.
Muri Afurika hari amashyirahamwe abiri y’amashyirahamwe y’ifaranga muri Afurika, akoresheje amafaranga yo muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba CFA, hamwe n’amafaranga yo muri Afurika yo hagati CFA. Byongeye kandi, Igice rusange cy’ifaranga gihuza ibihugu byinshi byo muri Afrika yepfo bishingiye ku mafaranga yo muri Afrika yepfo.
Gahunda y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afrika yo kurushaho kwishyira hamwe ishishikariza iterambere ry’amashyirahamwe menshi yo mu karere nkintambwe yo hagati y’ubumwe bwuzuye bw’amafaranga. Ihuriro rimwe ryasabwe ni eco, ifaranga ryateganijwe kubanyamuryango b’ubukungu bw’ibihugu bya Afurika y’iburengerazuba (ECOWAS).
Banki Nkuru ya Afurika.
Banki Nkuru Nyafurika (ACB) ni kimwe mu bigo bitatu by'imari bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bwa Afurika. Bizatwara igihe, bizatwara inshingano z'ikigega cy'imari ny'afurika.
Ishirwaho rya ACB, rizarangira mu 2028, ryumvikanyweho bwa mbere mu masezerano ya Abuja yo mu 1991. Itangazo rya Sirte ryo muri 1999 ryasabye ko iki gikorwa cyihuta, hashyirwaho 2020.
Iyo bishyizwe mu bikorwa byuzuye binyuze mu mategeko y’Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Pan-Afurika, ACB niyo izatanga amafaranga yonyine y’ifaranga nyafurika (African Monetary Union / Afro), izahinduka umunyamabanki wa Guverinoma nyafurika, izabe banki muri banki yigenga na Leta ya Afurika. bigo, bizagenzura kandi bigenzure inganda z’amabanki nyafurika, kandi bizashyiraho inyungu n’ivunjisha byemewe ku bufatanye n’ubuyobozi bwa guverinoma nyafurika.
Abashyizeho umukono.
Abashyize umukono kuri ayo masezerano bose bari bagize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika (uwabanjirije AU) icyo gihe (Eritereya, Afurika y'Epfo, Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Maroc kuva binjira):

Ihuriro ry’ubukungu n’ifaranga (economic and monetary union, EMU) ni ubwoko bw’ubucuruzi bugizwe n’isoko rusange, ihuriro rya gasutamo, n’ubumwe bw’amafaranga. EMU yashyizweho binyuze mu masezerano y’ubucuruzi, EMU igizwe na gatandatu mu byiciro birindwi mu nzira yo kwishyira hamwe mu bukungu. Amasezerano ya EMU m'ubisanzwe ahuza ubumwe bwa gasutamo nisoko rusange. Ubusanzwe EMU ishyiraho ubucuruzi bw'ubuntu n'igiciro rusange cyo hanze mububasha bwacyo. Yagenewe kandi kurengera ubwisanzure mu kugenda kw'ibicuruzwa, serivisi, n'abantu. Iyi gahunda itandukanye n’ubumwe bw’amafaranga (urugero, Ubumwe bw’amafaranga y’ikilatini), ubusanzwe ntabwo bukubiyemo isoko rusange. Kimwe n’ubumwe bw’ubukungu n’amafaranga bwashyizweho mu bihugu 27 bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi (EU), EMU irashobora kugira ingaruka ku bice bitandukanye by’ububasha bwayo mu buryo butandukanye. Uturere tumwe na tumwe tugengwa n’amabwiriza ya gasutamo n’utundi turere tugengwa na EMU. Izi gahunda zitandukanye zirashobora gushirwaho mumasezerano yemewe, cyangwa zirashobora kubaho m'ubyukuri. Kurugero, ntabwo ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi bikoresha amayero yashyizweho n’ubumwe bw’ifaranga, kandi ntabwo ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi biri mu gace ka Schengen. Bamwe mu bagize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi bitabira ihuriro ry’amashyirahamwe yombi, ndetse na bamwe muri bo.
Ibihugu byinshi byabanje kugerageza gushinga EMU mu nama y'i La Haye muri 1969. Nyuma, hatangajwe umushinga wa gahunda. Muri icyo gihe, umunyamuryango nyamukuru wayoboye iki cyemezo ni Pierre Werner, Minisitiri w’intebe wa Luxembourg. Icyemezo cyo gushinga Umuryango w’ubukungu n’ifaranga ry’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi (EMU) cyakiriwe mu December 1991, nyuma kiza kuba kimwe mu masezerano ya Maastricht (Amasezerano y’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi).

Banki Nkuru Nyafurika (ACB) ni kimwe mu bigo bitanu by'ambere by’imari ndetse n’ikigo cyihariye cy’Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika. Igihe kizaza nicyo kizaba gifite inshingano z'ikigega ny'afurika.
Nibimara gushyirwa mubikorwa byuzuye, ACB niyo izaba yonyine itanga ifaranga rimwe ny'afurika (" Afro " cyangwa " Ariq ") cyangwa se ikorana na banki zo muri Afurika nizo m'ukarere, bizaba ari banki ya leta ya Afurika cyangwa ihuriro ry’amashyirahamwe yo mu karere, izaba ari banki mu bigo by’amabanki byigenga bya Leta bya Afurika, iri hafi ya z’amabanki zo muri Afurika no mu karere, bizagenga, bigisha inama kandi bigenzure inganda z’amabanki ny'afurika zifatanije n’inganda z’amabanki n’amashyirahamwe, kandi bizashyiraho inyungu n’ivunjisha ku mugaragaro. ibiciro bishobora cyangwa bidashobora guhuzwa na banki nkuru yakarere; byose bifatanije n'ubuyobozi bwa Guverinoma ya Afurika.
Ifaranga rimwe ry’Afurika rigomba kuba rigizwe n’ibice by’ifaranga bigizwe n’amabanki yo mu karere yo hagati y’amafaranga agizwe n’ifaranga ry’igihugu (Umuryango w’Abarabu Maghreb (AMU) - Afurika y'amajyaruguru, Umuryango w’iterambere ry’Afurika yepfo (SADC) - Afurika y'amajyepfo, Umuryango w’ubukungu w’ibihugu bya Afurika y’iburengerazuba (ECOWAS) - Afurika y’iburengerazuba cyangwa ECO, Umuryango w’Afurika y’iburasirazuba (EAC), Afurika y’iburasirazuba - Isoko rusange rya Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo (COMESA) - Afurika yo hagati n'ibindi.).

Pont Ruzizi I ni ikiraro giherereye i Bukavu ni kimwe mu birindiro bya gasutamo hejuru y'uruzi rwa Ruzizi hagati ya Bukavu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo na Cyangungu mu igihugu cy'u Rwanda.
Iki kiraro cyubatswe bwa mbere mu mwaka wa 1935 nyuma kirasenywa kugira ngo cyongere cyubakwa mu byuma n’ibiti bifite ubushobozi bwo gushyigikira ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere buringaniye cyangwa buri munsi ya toni eshatu (3t) ahagana mu mwaka wa 1974. Cyakomeje kubaho kidatunganywa bituma kiba kibi kugeza igihe iki kiraro gishya cyongeye kubakirwa, kigira ubushobozi bwisumbuyeho bwo guterura toni zigera 30, mu mwaka wa 2012, ku nkunga yatanzwe n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi muri gahunda y’ubukungu bw’ibihugu by’ibiyaga bigari. Yatangijwe n’umuyobozi wa Bukavu, Bilubi Ulengabo Meschac,tariki ya 19 ukwezi kwa Kamena mu mwaka wa 2019.
Kuri metero 57, ni ikiraro cya kabiri kirekire muri Bukavu, nyuma ya Pont Ruzizi II, ari nacyo cyambukiranya u Rwanda.

Ikiraro cya Ruzizi II ni kimwe mu biraro i Bukavu bikora ku imipaka ihuza Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu mujyi wa Bukavu n'u Rwanda mu mudugudu wa Cyimbogo hejuru y'uruzi rwa Ruzizi.
Iki kiraro giherereye inyuma y'umusozi utuye mu nkambi ya gisirikare ya Saio, yubatswe mu mwaka wa 1943 nyuma y’intsinzi y’ingabo za Kongo muri Etiyopiya kuri Afurika y’iburasirazuba bw’Ubutaliyani tariki ya 8 ukwezi kwa Kamena mu mwaka wa 1941 mu gihe cy’Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Ikiraro cyahise cyubakwa kugira ngo ubucuruzi hagati y’ingoma y’Ubudage Ruanda-Urundi na Kongo y’Ababiligi, ibikorwa byayo bimara imyaka 12 kuva mu mwaka wa 1908 kugeza mu mwaka wa 1920.
Ikiraro gifite uburebure bwa metero 88, nicyo kiraro cya mbere kirekire mu mujyi wa Bukavu, giherereye mu birometero 20 uvuye kuri Ikiraro cya Ruzizi I, kikaba ari n’umupaka wa gasutamo n’u Rwanda i Cyangungu.

Umuryango w’ubukungu nyafurika (AEC) ni umuryango w’ibihugu bigize Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’Afurika ashyiraho ishingiro ry’iterambere ry’ubukungu hagati y’ibihugu byinshi bya Afurika. Intego zavuzwe n’uyu muryango zirimo gushyiraho uduce tw’ubucuruzi bwisanzuye, ihuriro ry’amahoro, isoko rimwe, banki nkuru, n’ifaranga rimwe (reba ubumwe bw’imari ny'afurika) bityo hashyirwaho ihuriro ry’ubukungu n’amafaranga.
Kugeza ubu muri Afurika hari imiryango myinshi yo mu karere, izwi kandi ku izina ry’ubukungu bw’akarere (REC), inyinshi muri zo zikaba zifite abanyamuryango benshi. RECs igizwe ahanini n’amashyirahamwe y’ubucuruzi, ndetse rimwe na rimwe, ubufatanye bwa politiki na gisirikare. Inyinshi muri izi REC zigize inkingi za AEC, inyinshi muri zo zikaba zifite aho zihurira na bimwe mu bihugu bigize uyu muryango. Bitewe niki kigero kinini cyo guhuzagurika birashoboka ko leta zimwe zifite abanyamuryango benshi amaherezo zizava muri REC imwe cyangwa nyinshi.
