Thora Nielsen Fiedler (15 Werurwe 1854 i - 13 Werurwe 1941 i Lynge) yari umuforomokazi wo muri Danemarike, prostateiste n'umuyobozi w'ikigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru. Yafashaga kwagura inzu yita ku bageze mu za bukuru ku bamugaye, nyuma mu buzima bwe aba umuyobozi w'uru rugo rw'abaforomo. Yashizeho amahugurwa ya prostate kandi ahimba ubwoko bushya bwa prostate.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Fiedler yavukiye i Nyborg ku muhinzi, umugenzuzi w’umuhanda n’ Harald Valdemar Fiedler (1808–87) na Marie Sophie Kirstine Jensen (1830-1905). Ababyeyi ba Fiedler ntibashyingiwe kugeza hashize imyaka itandatu avutse. Fiedler yari umwe mu bakobwa batatu, bashiki be bitwaga Thora na Elisif. Bose uko ari batatu batangiye kwiga kuba abaforomo mu 1886–87, Fiedler yiga mu bitaro bya komini munsi ya ya Danemark (Danemark: Dansk Røde Kors). Bashiki ba Fiedler bombi bagiye mu bitaro bya kwiga. Kurangiza amashuri muri Croix-Rouge byatwaye amezi 15.
Fiedler yagumanye na Croix-Rouge. Mu 1888 yabaye umuforomo wigenga wa Croix-Rouge naho mu 1893 umwe mu barwayi be yari Johanne Petersen. Petersen kuva mu 1874 yayoboraga ishuri ryabakobwa bamugaye. Yashinze kandi urugo rwa Cripple (Danemark: Hjemmet for Vanføre), ikigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru cy’abafite ubumuga n’abafite ubumuga, cyakoreshaga kwimura bashiki ba Croix Rouge nkabaforomo. Johanne Petersen yakundaga cyane Fiedler, wakoraga akazi ko kuba umuforomo w'igihe cyose mu rugo rwa Cripple mu 1894. Inzu yari nto, kandi Fiedler yafashaga kuyagura. Amahugurwa ya prostothique yo murugo yaguwe cyane, munsi ya Fiedler, kuburyo yashoboye gukemura ibibazo byurugo ubwabyo kimwe nibindi bitaro.
Nubwo imirimo ye nyamukuru yari ku buriri bwibitaro, Fiedler yatangiye kubaka bande na prostate wenyine. Yagumye nyuma yakazi, yubaka prothètique avuye mu bishaje, akorana n’uruhu, ibyuma n’ibyuma. Amaze kurangiza prototype, yategetse abarwayi bo murugo kubaka prostateque nkubuvuzi bwakazi. Nyuma yigihe, amahugurwa yariyongereye, Fiedler ayobora aya mahugurwa hamwe nakazi ke ko kuba umuforomo, kandi umubare w’abarwayi bafite ubumuga bakoraga muri bo wariyongereye. Abarwayi barahawe akazi kandi bahembwa, babaha akazi. Gukora prothètike yabo nayo yazigamye amafaranga yo murugo.
Fiedler yahimbye prostothique nyinshi, ihuza n'umuntu ku giti cye, yemerera abarwayi kwikemurira ibintu byinshi ubwabo, baba bakeneye umuforomo ukundi. Mu 1908 Fiedler yabaye umuyobozi w'ikigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru. Mu gihe cy' Yose impuguke zaturutse mu bihugu byagize uruhare mu ntambara zaje mu kigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru cya Fiedler kugira ngo bige uburyo bwo gukora bande na prostothique bivuye ku cyitegererezo cya Fiedler. Fiedler yavuye ku mirimo ye mu 1921.
Yahawe umudari w'ishimwe mu 1913. Ku isabukuru yimyaka 25 mu 1919 yarizihijwe kandi ahabwa impano y'amafaranga. Yakoresheje aya mafaranga kugirango abone, Frk. Fiedlers Legat.
Nyuma yo kuva ku kazi mu 1921 Fiedler yimukiye i Lynge hafi ya Sorø, aho ababyeyi be bari batuye. Yapfiriye hano ku ya 13 Werurwe 1941. Yashyinguwe hamwe n'ababyeyi be ku irimbi rya Holsteinborg n'ikigo cya Holsteinborg.

Intebe y’abamugaye ni umukino wo gukinisha abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bigira ingaruka ku maguru yo hepfo cyangwa kugenda. Intebe y’abamugaye igengwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri ku isi, kandi ni umwe mu mikino mu mikino Paralempike hakonjea.
Amarushanwa y'igihugu ndetse n’amahanga akinishwa hakurikijwe amategeko yashyizweho na federasiyo yisi yose. Aya mategeko ategeka ko amakipe yaba afite uburinganire buvanze, kandi ko imikino iba umunani irangiye. Igihe ntarengwa cy'iminota 38 yo gutekereza kuri buri kipe hamwe nigihe kimwe cya kabiri cya kabiri kizashyirwa mubikorwa nisaha. Kwemererwa kugarukira kubantu bafite ubumuga kuburyo igare ry’abamugaye rikoreshwa mu kugenda kwa buri munsi cyane abadafite ambilansi cyangwa bashobora kugenda urugendo rurerure cyane.

Ubusemuzi bwa braille ni porogaramu y'ikoranabuhanga isobanura inyandiko ya elegitoronike (nka dosiye ya MS-World fille) muri braille ikayohereza kuri periferi ya braille, nk'ibishushanyo mbonera (bitanga kopi ikomeye ya braille nshya). Mubusanzwe, buri rurimi rukenera umusemuzi warwo. Nubwo hakoreshejwe ijambo "ubusemuzi", nta busobanuro bw'uru rurimi. Ndetse no mu bihe byoroshye, nka braille y'u Buholandi, ifite amategeko akomeye yo gushyira mu nyuguti nkuru, gushimangira, utumenyetso, ibimenyetso byandika, no gutunganya page.
Ku ntego z'iki kiganiro cyangwa iyi nkuru, ijambo "inkprint" risobanura inyandiko yateguwe gusomwa n'ijisho, yaba yacapishijwe, yerekanwe kuri igaragaze amashusho, cyangwa ibe ibitswe muri mudasobwa; "braille" bivuga inyandiko yateguwe kugira ngo usome ukoresheje urutoki, rwaba rwanditseho, rwerekanwe ku gikoresho cya elegitoroniki, cyangwa kibitswe muri mudasobwa.
Porogaramu y'ubusobanuro bwa Braille cyangwa ibyuma byinjizwamo bigahindura inkprint muri braille cyangwa braille igahindurwa muri inkprint. Mubisanzwe, umuntu afite inkprint muri dosiye itunganya ijambo cyangwa kuri URL kandi ashaka braille. Braille ishobora koherezwa mubudodo bwa braille kugira ngo ikore braille y'umubiri cyangwa kuri irimuburyo bufata bukanabika. Indi mpamvu nuko umuntu afite braille ifata ikabika ya elegitoroniki yerekana ko ashaka gukora muri inkprint kugira ngo asangire n'umuntu udasoma braille.
Porogaramu y'ubusobanuro bwa Braille isanzwe ishyirwa mubikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga bifasha kuva ibikorwa bya tekinoroji bitanga ubufasha kubafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Abakenera ubusemuzi bwa Braille bushobora gukoreshwa nabantu bafite kuba babona cyangwa batabona.
Ubusemuzi bwa braille bushobora gukora kuri terefone, mudasobwa y'umuntu ku giti cye, seriveri y'urusobe, cyangwa (mu mateka) mini-mudasobwa nini cyangwa ibikorerwa mu bigo binini.
Indimi zimwe zikoresha braille idasezeranye cyangwa itaremerwa, aho buri nyuguti ikoresha inyuguti yihariye. Braille idasezeranye isaba gukoresha inyuguti nkuru, gushimangira, imibare, no kuruhuka. Indimi zimwe zikoresha braille yagiranye amasezerano, aho amategeko ahinnye y'inyandiko aragoye. Kurugero, mu masezerano y'icyongereza yamasezerano, ijambo "tekereza" (inyuguti 5) ryahinduwe nkinyuguti 3: (th) (in) k. Gukoresha cyangwa kudakoresha ibyo kugabanuka bifitanye isano no kuvuga. Kurugero, ikimenyetso "th" gikoreshwa "mubitekerezo", ariko ntabwo ari "ibinogo". Keretse niba byateguwe neza, mudasobwa ishobora gukora ikosa ntamuntu numwe wakora, nko gukoresha igabanuka rya "nyina" mw'ijambo "chimiotherapie". Igice kigoye cyane cyo gukora braille nugufata icyemezo cy'igihe cyo kudakoresha mukwishurwa. Iyo abantu bafashe ibi byemezo, ni "transcript ya braille" ; iyo mudasobwa ifashe ibyemezo, ni "ubusobanuro bwa braille".
Ikoreshwa rya mbere ryo guhindura mudasobwa no gukora braille yakoresheje mudasobwa y'ibanze muri American Printing House for the Blind rya Louisville, Kentucky.
Mu myaka yo muri 1960, habayeho umushinga MIT wo gutangiza umusaruro wa braille. Robert Mann yanditse kandi akurikirana porogaramu yo guhindura inyandiko y'ubusemuzi bwa braille yiswe DOTSYS, mu gihe irindi tsinda ryakoze igikoresho cyo gushushanya cyamenyekanye nka "MIT Braillemboss." Amaherezo, MIT yatanze akazi mu ikoranabuhanga muri Miter Corporation. Itsinda rya Miter Corporation rigizwe na Robert Gildea, Jonathan Millen, Reid Gerhart na Joseph Sullivan kuri ubu ni perezida wa Duxbury Systems bakoze DOTSYS III, ubusemuzi bwa mbere bw’inyandiko yanditswe mu rurimi rw'imikorere. DOTSYS III yatunganijwe kumashuri ya leta yo muri Atlanta nko muri gahunda rusange y'amashuri.
Mu mahugurwa mpuzamahanga ya mbere yerekeranye no gukora mudasobwa ya Braille yakozwe, yabereye i Muenster mugihugu cy'u Budage, muri werurwe mu mwaka 1973, hasobanuwe imishinga myinshi y’ubuhinduzi bwa braille yaturutse hirya no hino ku isi isobanurwa.
Ububiko bw'inyandiko ku mateka y'ubusemuzi bwa braille, ibisobanuro bya braille, hamwe n'ibikoresho bimwe bya braille bikomezwa na Duxbury Systems.

Move United ni umuryango w’abanyamerika udaharanira inyungu ugamije guteza imbere parasiporo mu rubyiruko ndetse n’abantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bw’umubiri. Uyu muryango ukora gahunda ya parasporti yabaturage ukoresheje ibice birenga 150 byaho mu gihugu hose. Move Unitedi yashinzwe muri 2020 nk'uguhuza imiryango ibiri; Abamugaye muri Amerika, yashinzwe bwa mbere muri 1956 ikaba ifite icyicaro i Rockville, muri Mayilandi, umuryango wa kabiri washinzwe muri 1967. Himura ni umwe mu bagize komite ishinzwe imikino Olempike muri Amerika. Kugeza muri 2020, uyu muryango ukora gahunda zikorera abaturage 100.000 muri leta 43. Muri 2020, iyo miryango yombi yahujwe nka Move, itangiza indangamuntu nshya na Super union. Intego yatangajwe ko uyu muryango uzakorera 90% by'abatuye Amerika hamwe na gahunda zaho mu 2028, mu gihe cy'imikino Paralympike yo muri 2028 yabereye i Los Angeles muri amerika.

Imikino ya Adaptive Sports USA (yahoze ari Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri ry’imikino y’abamugaye, Imikino y’ibimuga muri Amerika, na intebe y'abamugaye, muri Amerika) yashinzwe muri 1956, nk’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri ry’abamugaye, n’abasirikare bahoze mu gisirikare bamugaye kugira ngo bafashe mu gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abakomeretse mu ntambara bavuye muri Koreya.
Abamugaye muri USA yashinzwe muri 1967 nkishyirahamwe ry'igihugu ry'imikino ngororamubiri; mubayishinze harimo Jim Winthers, umusirikare waciwe wabaye inararibonye mu gice cya 10 cy’imisozi.
Igihembo cy'Ubuyobozi bwa Dr. Robert Harney.
Igihembo cya Dr. Robert Harney Leadership Award ni igihembo ngarukamwaka cyo guha sosiyete, umuryango cyangwa umuntu ku giti cye wagaragaje kandi utanga ubuyobozi budasanzwe mu myitozo ngororamubiri ihuza n'imikino. "Dr. Bob" yari umupayiniya wa siporo umenyereye kandi akaba umuyobozi udacogora muri siporo y'abamugaye mu nzego z'ibanze, iz'igihugu ndetse n’amahanga. Yari indashyikirwa mu rwego rw’igihugu ndetse n’amahanga mu rwego rw’abakinnyi bafite ubumuga.
Nkumukorerabushake, Harney yari mu ikipe mpuzamahanga y’ubuvuzi bw’abamugaye mu mikino yo gusiganwa ku maguru no gusiganwa ku magare kandi yitabira imikino yose y’imbeho n’izuba kuva mu 1998. Dr. Bob kandi yari umwarimu w’umwuga wabigize umwuga akaba n’igihe cyose akora umwuga wo kubaga amagufwa y’amagufwa i Boston, akaba n'umuganga w’itsinda ryabigenewe mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Winthrop na Melrose mu mujyi yavukiyemo wa Winthrop, Massachusetts mu myaka irenga 20.

Mert Lawwill (Yavutse ku ya 25 Nzeri 1940) ni wabigize umwuga, nyir'ikipe y'isiganwa ndetse n'umushinga. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya kuva 1962 kugeza 1977. Lawwill azwiho kuba yaratsinze Shampiyona y’igihugu ya 1969 AMA nkumunyamuryango witsinda ryabasiganwa ku ruganda rwa. Nyuma yumwuga we wo gusiganwa ku ipikipiki, Lawwill yabaye umwe mu bambere bashushanya amapikipiki yo gusiganwa n'abubatsi. Lawwill yahise akoresha ubunararibonye bwe nka moto yubaka moto kugirango abashe gukora igare ryimisozi mishya, atezimbere imwe ya mbere. Yateje imbere amaguru kuri amputees. Lawwill yinjijwe mu mu 1997 no mu mu 1998.
Umwuga wo gusiganwa kuri moto.
Lawwill yavukiye i. Yatangiye umwuga we wo gusiganwa nkumukinnyi wikinira ku murongo wa TT waho muri Boise, hanyuma, nyuma yo gusiganwa (nyuma uzwi nka) hirya no hino muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru. Mu 1961, yimukiye i Los Angeles, muri Kaliforuniya kugira ngo ashobore gusiganwa ku isiganwa ry’isiganwa rya, icyo gihe kikaba ari cyo cyabaye intandaro yo gusiganwa. Yabonye inkunga na, umucuruzi wa Harley-Davidson i San Francisco. Muri icyo gihe nibwo Lawwill yatangiye kwiga ibijyanye no guhindura amakarita ya moto kumarushanwa yo gusiganwa. Kugeza mu 1963, yari amaze gutwara umukinnyi wabigize umwuga maze mu 1964 asinyana amasezerano yo guhatanira ikipe yo gusiganwa ku ruganda rwa Harley-Davidson azabana na we mu buzima bwe bwose bwo gusiganwa.
Lawwill yatsinze isiganwa rye rya mbere ry’igihugu cya AMA kuri ku ya 19 Nzeri 1965. Mu 1969, Lawwill yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona y’igihugu ya AMA kandi, yatowe nk'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane muri AMA. Ukwirwanaho kwe muri Shampiyona nkuru y’igihugu mu gihembwe cya 1970 byabaye ingingo ya filime yerekana amapikipiki ya yo mu 1971, "" yakinnye n’umukinnyi wa filime hamwe n’umukinnyi. Lawwill yakomeje guhatanira igikombe cya Shampiyona y’igihugu ya AMA kugeza mu 1977 ubwo, yasezeye afite imyaka 37 kubera ikibazo cy’amatwi y’imbere cyagize ingaruka ku buringanire bwe. Yakusanyije umwuga 161 AMA Grand National arangiza kandi yatsindiye amasiganwa 15 ya Grand National mugihe cyimyaka 15 yo gusiganwa.
Umwuga wo gushushanya.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 70, Lawwill yagize uruhare mu gushushanya igenda yiyongera yo gutwara. Yari umwe mu bapayiniya ba mbere ku isi ku magare yo hanze, amaze kumenyekanisha igare rya mbere ry’umusozi. Yateje imbere kandi ubucuruzi bwa mbere bwubucuruzi guhagarika amagare yo kumusozi kandi atanga patenti. Muri kiriya gihe, yakomeje kugira uruhare mu gusiganwa ku ipikipiki nka nyir'ikipe yo gusiganwa muri Shampiyona y’igihugu ya AMA kugeza mu 1990 ubwo, yababazwaga n’uburyo AMA yayoboraga shampiyona. Nyuma yayoboye itsinda ryisiganwa irushanwa ryo gusiganwa maze ateza imbere igare ryatsinze Lawwill DH-9 ryuzuye yamanuka. Amagare yo gusiganwa ku magare ya Lawwill yahawe agaciro cyane n’abasiganwa ku isonga ku isi kandi ibishushanyo bye byatsindiye ibikombe byinshi by’igihugu ndetse n’isi.
Muri iki gihe Lawwill agira uruhare mu kubaka no kwamamaza ibicuruzwa byemewe n’umuhanda wa gare ya yasiganwe muri Shampiyona nkuru y’igihugu. Ayobora kandi sosiyete idaharanira inyungu itanga amaboko ya prostate kugirango amputees ashobore gutwara amagare cyangwa moto. Hafi ya kimwe cya gatatu cyamaboko ya prostate yose akora ajya, kugirango akoreshwe nabasirikare bahoze mu ntambara yo muri Iraki na Afuganisitani.

Intebe ni itandukaniro rya netball yahujwe no gukinira mu ma magare. Ishobora gukinwa n'abantu bombi bafite ubumuga cyangwa kandi badafite ubumuga.
Imvange ya basketball na netball yatangijwe mu iserukiramuco rikuru rya siporo ya Paraplegike muri 1949. Amakipe atandatu agizwe na bakinnyi 37 yarushanwe muri ibyo birori. Iyi verisiyo ya netball yakinwe m'ubirori byu mwaka kugeza muri 1954; yasimbuwe na basketball y'abamugaye muri 1956.
Ubwoko bugezweho bw'ibimuga bya bamugaye bisa na netball isanzwe, ariko hamwe n'amategeko yahinduwe yerekeye guhuza, kubuza no gutembera.

Dasher n'uburyo bwinjiza n'igikoresho kandi kigera kuri mudasobwa gifasha abakoresha guhimba inyandiko badakoresheje igikoresho cyandika muri mudasobwa, winjiza inyandiko kuri hamwe hagaragara amashusho hamwe n'igikoresho cyerekana kuri mudasobwa cyitiranwa n'imbeba, ahagaragara amashusho ikoraho, cyangwa imbeba ikoreshwa n'ikirenge cyangwa umutwe. Ibikoresho nk'ibi bishobora kuba ibikoresho bya prosthetic k'ubantu bafite ubumuga badashobora gukoresha igikoresho cyandika kuri mudasobwa isanzwe, cyangwa aho gukoresha imwe bigoye cyangwa bidashoboka.
Dasher ni ubuntu kandi ifungura isoko y'ikoranabuhanga, ingingo yabayeho hubahirijwe ibisabwa na GNU (General Public License)GPL, verisiyo ya 2. Dasher iboneka kuri sisitemu y'imikorere hamwe na GTK +, ni ukuvuga Linux, BSDs hamwe na Unix isa na macOS, Microsoft Windows, Pocket PC, iOS na Android.
Dasher yahimbwe na David JC MacKay kandi yatejwe imbere na David Ward hamwe n'abandi bagize itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bwa MacKay rya Cambridge research group. Umushinga Dasher ushyigikiwe cyangwa uterwa inkunga na Fondasiyo ya Gatsby Charitable hamwe na EU aegis-project.
Igishushanyo cy'umushinga.
Kubintu byose umwanditsi ashaka kwandika, bahitamo ibaruwa yanditswe yerekanwe ku habugenewe kugaragaza amashusho muri mudasobwa bakoresheje icyerekezo, aho sisitemu ikoresha uburyo bwo guhanura ibintu kugira ngo hamenyekane ibishobora guhuzwa n'ibice bikurikira, hanyuma bihuze ibyo byihutirwa byo kubigaragaza cyane kuruta inyuguti zishoboka. Ibi bizigama umukoresha imbaraga n'igihe mu gihe bagiye guhitamo ibaruwa ikurikira kubatanzwe. Inzira yo guhimba inyandiko murubu buryo yagereranijwe nu mukino wa arcade, mu gihe abakoresha bahinduranya inyuguti ziguruka hejuru ya ahabugenewe kugaragaza amashusho hanyuma bagahitamo kugira ngo bahimbe inyandiko. Sisitemu yigira kuburambe inyuguti zikomatanya nizo zizwi cyane, kandi igahindura protocole yayo mu gihe cyo kwerekana ibi.

Pickleball ni umukino wa racketi cyangwa padile aho abakinnyi babiri (abaseribateri) cyangwa abakinnyi bane (inshuro ebyiri) bakubise umupira wa pulasitike usobekeranye, wuzuye umwuka hamwe na padi m 0.86 z'inshundura kugeza uruhande rumwe rudashoboye gusubiza umupira cyangwa gukora amakosa. Pickleball ikinirwa mu nzu no hanze. Yavumbuwe muri 1965 nk'u mukino w'inyuma w'abana muri Amerika, ku kirwa cya Bainbridge muri leta ya Washington. Muri 2022, pickleball yiswe siporo ya leta ya Washington muri amerika.
Nk’uko byatangajwe na Joan Pritchard, umugore wa Joel Pritchard, ati: " Izina ry'umukino ryabaye Pickle Ball nyuma yo kuvuga ko bibyibukije ubwato bwa pickle mu bakozi aho hatoraguwe abasare mu yandi mato. " Andi makuru avuga ko izina "pickleball " ryakomotse ku izina ry’imbwa yo mu muryango wa Pritchards. Pritchards yavuze ko imbwa yaje nyuma yuko umukino umaze kwitwa, kandi imbwa ni yo yitiriwe umukino wa pickleball. Bavuze ko urujijo rwadutse ubwo umunyamakuru yabazaga Pritchards mu ntangiriro ya 70 yemeje ko bizoroha abasomyi guhuza imbwa aho kuba ubwato bworoshye. Abahagarariye Amerika Pickleball bavuga ko ubushakashatsi bwabo bwemeje ko imbwa Pickles yavutse nyuma yuko umukino wari umaze kwitwa.
Igihe Pritchard na Bell bagarukaga muri golufi ku wa gatandatu nyuma ya saa sita muri 1965, basanze imiryango yabo irambiwe. Bagerageje gushyiraho badaminton, ariko nta muntu numwe washoboraga kubona shutlecock. Pritchard na Bell bahamagariye abana babo gutegura umukino wabo. Abakuze n'abana barangije mu rukiko rwa badiminton batangira kugerageza imipira itandukanye hamwe na racket, harimo na tennis ya sitade. Urushundura rwa badminton 1.5 metero amaherezo rwa manuwe kugeza kurwego rwo mu kibuno kugirango rwemere gutwara umupira.
Amarushanwa yo muri 1976 yabereye muri Southcenter Athletic Club i Tukwila, Washington, ashimirwa ko ariryo rushanwa rya mbere rya pickleball. Yiswe " Shampiyona ya mbere ya Pickleball ku Isi na Joel Pritchard kandi yakiriwe mu kinyamakuru "Tennis" cyo muri Nyakanga 1976. Ishyirahamwe ry’Abanyamerika Amateur Pickleball (USAPA) ryashinzwe muri 1984, ni bwo basohoye igitabo cya mbere cyemewe cy’imikino kandi bakora amarushanwa ya mbere y’igihugu cya kabiri yabereye i Tacoma, i Washington. Kugeza 1990, siporo yakinwaga muri leta zose uko ari 50. Muri 2001, pickle ball yashyizwe muri siporo yo kwerekana mu mikino Olempike nkuru ya Arizona yitabiriye 100. Irushanwa rya pickle ball ryabereye muri Happy Trails RV Resort i Surprise, Arizona, kandi mu myaka itanu harimo 275 bitabiriye. Kwinjiza pickleball muri aso byagaragaye nku musanzu wagize uruhare mukuzamura amarushanwa muri Amerika.
Iyo umupira wa pickle ball ukubise umupira ukomeye, utanga amajwi atyaye. Ijwi rihoraho mu gihe cyo gukina ryateje amakimbirane hagati ya nyiri ikibuga cya pickle ball hamwe n'abafite imitungo iri hafi. Urusaku, hamwe n’izamuka ryihuse ry'amamare rya pickle ball, ryateje ikibazo gikomeye muri siporo mu baturage bo muri Amerika.

Umupira w'amaguru w'abamugaye ni itandukaniro ry'umupira w'amaguru w'ishyirahamwe, aho abitabiriye bose ari abakoresha amagare kubera ubumuga bw'umubiri. Ubumuga bwo mu mutwe nabwo bushobora kuba ikintu cyingenzi, ariko ntabwo buri gihe aribyo. Intebe y’abaimugaye irashobora kuba moteri, cyangwa intoki.
Mugihe amashanyarazi yose hamwe n'intebe y'imuga y'intoki, umukinnyi arigenda aho bishoboka. Niba ibi bidashoboka ku mubiri, umukinnyi yemerewe gukoresha pusheri kugirango azenguruke mu rukino. Ariko, gusunika ni pasiporo mu buryo badashobora kwishora mu mikino. Umupira wa maguru w’abamugaye urasa cyane nu buryo bushoboye bw'imikino y'umukino ukurikije amategeko n'imiterere - itandukaniro nyaryo ni uko umukinnyi ukoresha igare ry’abamugaye kugira ngo azenguruke mu rukino kandi anazunguruka umupira iyo arenganye, kugira ngo akemure undi mukinnyi n, no gutsinda ibitego. Niba umukinnyi ashoboye gutera umupira, noneho baremerewe kubikora. Nanone, niba umunyezamu ashoboye guhagarika umupira n'amaboko yabo, baremerewe kubikora.
Imikino ikinirwa mu nzu (mu bisanzwe ku kibuga cya basketball cyahinduwe). Umupira nawo munini cyane kuruta umupira wa maguru umupira wamaguru.
Umupira w’ibimuga wavumbuwe muri Victoriya, Ositaraliya, aho utezwa imbere nkubufatanye hagati ya Scope y na Federasiyo yumupira wa maguru Victoriya. Umupira wa maguru w’abamugaye ugabanijwemo uturere tubiri, Amajyepfo n’Amajyaruguru, hamwe n’ibigega ndetse n’ibice bikomeye. Ikipe ya mbere muri buri cyiciro cy'akarere ihurira kuri Final ya Leta.

accessaphone, yatangijwe bwa mbere mu mwaka 2005 ni CTI (Computer Telephony Integration) ifasha software itanga uburyo bwiza bwo gukoresha abantu bakoresha kumeza nka terefone yoroshye ukoresheje uburyo bwabugenewe bwokwandika muri mudasobwa,imbeba ikoreshwa kuri mudasobwa cyangwa amategeko y'ijwi. Nk'urugero, mu gihe ukoresheje terefone y'umushinga muri Cisco, NEC cyangwa Tadiran Telecom, imirimo nka Dial, Hold na Transfer ishobora gukorwa hakoreshejwe urufunguzo rushyushye D, H na T (ibanzirizwa n'urufunguzo rwa ALT). accessaphone ikoresha Microsoft Windows Terefone Porogaramu (TAPI) kugira ngo ivugane na sisitemu ya terefone y'umushinga.

Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’abamugaye muri Bangladesh (WCWAB) ni umuryango w’igihugu utegamiye kuri Leta kandi udaharanira inyungu washyizweho hagamijwe iterambere ry’abaturage bafite ibibazo by’ubumuga bo muri Bangladesh. Uyu muryango washinzwe n’umukinnyi w’abamugaye Mohammad Mohasin. Uyu muryango ukorera abamugaye kuva mu mwaka wa 2010 ugamije kwinjiza ababana n'ubumuga no gushimangira umuryango rusange. Muri 2016, umuryango wiyandikishije mu ishami rishinzwe imibereho myiza ya Bangladesh. WCWAB yatoye inama y'ubuyobozi. Intwali ku ntebe ziziga zatangiye urugendo rwo gukina umupira wamaguru muri 2010. Kuva icyo gihe, abakinyi ba Cricket bo muri Bangladeshi bitabiriye amarushanwa akomeye nkaya marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Cricket ya ICRC yabereye muri Bangladesh ndetse nigikombe cya Aziya mubuhinde.
WCWAB yari umwe mu mashyirahamwe 30 ayobowe n’urubyiruko yahawe igihembo cy’urubyiruko cya Joy Bangla na Young Bangla mu 2017, kubera ibikorwa byabo byo guteza imbere siporo.
Intebe y’ibimuga yatangijwe muri Bangladesh.
Irushanwa ry'ambere ry' abamugaye muri Bangladesh ryatangijwe mu mwaka wa 2016 nu buyobozi bwa Imago Sports bufatanije n'ishyirahamwe ry'imibereho y'imikino ya Cricket ya Bangladesh. Abakinnyi mirongo itatu na batandatu (36) b'abamugaye b'amagare (makumyabiri na batanu (25) baturutse hanze ya Dhaka) bitabiriye iri rushanwa ry'umunsi wose. Kubenshi mubakoresha igare ryibimuga bwari ubwambere bitabiriye umukino wa siporo uhatanira.
WCWAB iyobowe n'inama yatowe. Mohammad Mohsin ni Perezida wa WCWAB.

Intebe y'imikino yabamugaye ni uburyo bwagenewe kwemerera irushanwa ryiza hagati y’abafite ubumuga butandukanye, no kugabanya ingaruka z’ubumuga bwihariye bw’umuntu ku byavuye mu marushanwa. Imikino y’ibimuga ifitanye isano n’imvune y’umugongo, kandi ikubiyemo ubwoko butandukanye bw’ubumuga burimo paraplegiya, quadriplegiya, dystrofiya yimitsi, syndrome ya polio na spina bifida. Ubumuga bugomba kuba bwujuje ibyangombwa byibura by'imikorere y'umubiri. Intebe y'imuga y'imikino na siporo kubantu bafite ibikomere byumugongo akenshi bishingiye kumyanya y'ibisebe by'umugongo hamwe n'ubumuga bwabo n'ubumuga.
Intebe y'imikino y'abamugaye imwe itandukanye muri siporo mu buryo bwihariye. Mu ruzitiro rw'abamugaye, intego yo gushyira mu byiciro ni ukwemeza ko abaterankunga bashyirwa mu byiciro hashingiwe ku kugenda neza kugira ngo imyitozo yabo, urwego rw’ubuhanga, impano n'uburambe bigena ibizava mu mukino, ntabwo ari ubwoko bwabo bw'ubumuga. Ibi byishingira uburinganire muri siporo. Muri ruhago y’ibimuga, intego yo gushyira mu byiciro ni uguha imiterere siporo hagabanywa ingaruka z’ubumuga butandukanye bw’imikorere ku rukiko kuko bijyanye n’ibyavuye mu mukino.
Ubusanzwe, amasomo yakoreshejwe kuri WASI yashingiye ku mikino ngororamubiri hamwe nibisabwa mubindi siporo. Hano hari ibyiciro bine byo gukurikiranwa na munani kubirometero. Impinduka zaya masomo zishingiye ku mikorere yu mugongo zikoreshwa muyindi siporo. Aya masomo yatangiriye kumunsi wa mbere wa siporo yimuga ya bamugaye, mugihe sisitemu yo gutondekanya yari 1A, 1B, 1C, 2, 3, 4, 5 na 6. Habayeho guhinduka kuva icyo gihe mubijyanye nu busobanuro bukora nubwo ibisobanuro by'ubuvuzi byaho biherereye aho igikomere cyo mugongo cyagumye bisa.
Gutondekanya akenshi siporo yihariye.
Ibyiciro by'ubuvuzi by'imikino y'abamugaye birashobora kuba bigizwe n'ubuvuzi bwoherejwe m'ubyiciro byubuvuzi muri federasiyo ya siporo. Umuganga w'umukinnyi wa siporo arashobora gusabwa gutanga amakuru menshi yubuvuzi harimo gupima ubuvuzi no gutakaza imikorere yose ijyanye nubuzima bwabo. Ibi birimo niba imiterere igenda itera imbere cyangwa ihamye, niba ari ibintu byavutse cyangwa byavutse. Irashobora kubamo gusaba amakuru kubijyanye n'ubuvuzi buteganijwe. Irashobora kandi kubamo gusaba imiti iyo ari yo yose umuntu afata. Inyandiko zishobora gusabwa harimo x imirasire, ibisubizo bya ASAI ibisubizo, cyangwa amanota ya Ashworth yahinduwe.

Guttmann yatangiye gukoresha siporo mu rwego rwo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abahoze mu ntambara ya kabiri y'isi yose maze mu 1948 ashyiraho amarushanwa hagati y'amakipi y'imikino n'ibindi bitaro kugira ngo ahure n'imikino Olempike yabereye i Londres.

Icyarabu Icyarabu (Icyarabu: بِرَيْل الْعَرَبِيَّة, "birayl alʿarabīyah") ni inyuguti ya y'ururimi rw'icyarabu. Bikomoka ku nyuguti z'impumyi zazanywe mu Misiri n'umumisiyonari w'Ubwongereza mbere ya 1878, bityo rero ibaruwa yandikiwe muri rusange ihuye n ndetse no kimwe no mu zindi gahunda za braille. Ariko, harigeze kubaho amahame menshi, amwe murimwe (nka) ntaho yari ahuriye na Coptic Braille. Icyarabu cyarabu cyunze ubumwe cyemejwe mu myaka ya za 1950 mu rwego rwo kwerekeza, kandi ni cyo gipimo mu bihugu by'Abarabu. Izindi zifite sisitemu ya braille isa na Braille yicyarabu, nka na Braille, ariko itandukanye mu nyuguti zimwe na zimwe za diacritic.
Bitandukanye n’icyarabu, icyarabu Braille gisomwa uhereye ibumoso ugana iburyo, nyuma y’amasezerano mpuzamahanga. Imibare nayo isigaye iburyo, nko mucyarabu cyacapwe.
Imbonerahamwe braille y'icyarabu.
Icyarabu Braille kirimo amagambo ahinnye, amwe yaranzwe nudomo 4 cyangwa akadomo 5 (koma), bidasobanuwe hano. Inama yabereye muri Arabiya Sawudite mu 2002 yashyizeho amahame ahuriweho n’icyarabu, ariko guhera mu 2013 ntabwo ibihugu byose byari byiyandikishije; abadakurikiza amahame barimo ibihugu bimwe byabarabu ariko nibindi bihugu byabayisilamu batari abarabu nka Irani, Maleziya, na Indoneziya.
Nubwo inyuguti ngufi-inyajwi atari diacritics mu cyarabu cy'icyarabu, zirahitamo kandi muri rusange zirekuwe, kimwe no mucyarabu cyanditse.

Alijeriya Braille yari yakoreshwaga mu kwandika ururimi rwicyarabu muri Alijeriya. Biragaragara ko bishaje.
Muri Braille yo muri Alijeriya, inyuguti z'inyuguti zashyizweho zikurikirana mu nyuguti z'icyarabu ; kurupapuro rwicyarabu rusanzwe kurundi ruhande rukoresha umukoro utandukanye rwose, ukurikiza ukurikije gahunda yinyuguti yigifaransa. Kurugero, inyuguti ya gatanu ya braille, ⠑, ikoreshwa muri Braille yo muri Alijeriya kuri ج "j", inyuguti ya gatanu yinyuguti ya Alijeriya / Icyarabu. Mu nyuguti nyinshi za braille muri iki gihe, ⠑ ikoreshwa kuri "e", inyuguti ya gatanu y’inyuguti y’igifaransa / Ikilatini, cyangwa ku nyuguti isa na "e", aho yaba ari hose muri izo nyuguti.
Gusubiramo ubwoko bwa Alijeriya byari bisanzwe mu guhuza imiterere ya braille hakiri kare, ariko ahanini byaratereranywe hashyirwaho amahame yumvikana guhera mu guhuza Braille y’igifaransa, Icyongereza, Ikidage, n’icyarabu ku rutonde rwambere mu 1878.

Greek Braille ninyuguti ya braille yururimi rw'ikigereki. Ishingiye kumasezerano mpuzamahanga ya braille, mubisanzwe bihuye no guhindura ikilatini. Mu kigereki, izwi nka Κώδικας Μπράιγ Kôdikas Brég "Kode ya Braille".
Mu byukuri hariho inyuguti ebyiri z'ikigereki z'inyuguti z'ikigereki, zitandukanye mu itangwa ry'inyuguti nke: Braille y'Abagereki ya none ikoreshwa mu Bugereki, na Braille mpuzamahanga y'Abagereki ku nyuguti z'ikigereki cyangwa amagambo yakoreshejwe mu mibare cyangwa ubundi yashyizwe mu Cyongereza no mu zindi ndimi.
Braille y'ikigereki mpuzamahanga.
Inshingano mpuzamahanga zinyuranye ziratandukanye nimwe hejuru. Mu Bugereki bwa none bw'Ikigereki, urugero, inyuguti ya omega (ω) yanditswe kimwe n'ikilatini "j", mu gihe mu nyandiko y'Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa cyanditswe mu nyandiko y’igifaransa cyanditswe nka "w", gisa n'icapiro. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, Ikigereki cya none upsilon cyanditswe nk'ikilatini "y", ariko mu kigereki mpuzamahanga cyanditswe nka "u", kandi inyuguti ya eta ihindagurika.
Iyi nyuguti ikoreshwa, kurugero, mumibare yanditswe mubindi bitabo byikilatini-braille. Ikora kandi ishingiro ryinyuguti z'ikigereki muri kode ya na. Ntabwo ikoreshwa mu Bugereki cyangwa Kupuro. Imbonerahamwe ikurikira, inyuguti zitandukanye na Braille ya none yubugereki iragaragara.

Kode ya Gardner - Salinas nuburyo bwo gushushanya imibare nubumenyi bwa siyanse ukoresheje kugirango usome neza nababana nubumuga bwo kutabona. Uburyo bukunze kugaragara bwa Gardner - Salinas braille nubwoko 8-selile, bakunze kwita GS8. Hariho kandi ifishi 6 ihuye yitwa GS6.
Kode yatunganijwe mu rwego rwo gusimbura na John A. Gardner, umuhanga mu bya fiziki muri, na Norberto Salinas, umunyamibare wo muri Arijantine.
Kode ya Gardner - Salinas ni urugero rwururimi rworoshye rwabantu. Syntax ishingiye kuri sisitemu ya yo kwandika siyanse.

Nemeth Braille Code for Mathematics ni code ya yo gushushanya imibare na siyansi umurongo ukoresheje zisanzwe zitandatu-Utudomo two mu bwoko bwa Braille kugirango dusome neza nabafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Kode yatunganijwe na. Kode ya Nemeth yanditswe bwa mbere mu 1952. Yavuguruwe mu 1956, 1965, na 1972. Nintangarugero yimvugo isomeka yumuntu isomeka
Nemeth Braille ni code imwe gusa ikoreshwa mukwandika imibare muri braille. Hariho uburyo bwinshi bukoreshwa kwisi yose.
Amahame ya Code ya Nemeth.
Igitabo cya Nemeth Code Book (1972) gifungura n'amagambo akurikira:
Iyi kode ya Braille kubiharuro na siyansi yateguwe kugirango itange sisitemu yibimenyetso bizemerera ibitabo bya tekiniki kwerekana no gusomwa mu nyandiko. Kode igamije gutanga ibisobanuro nyabyo bishobotse kubasoma braille yumwandiko wanditse, kandi iki nikimwe mubintu byingenzi biranga. Iyo umusomyi wa braille afite imyumvire isobanutse yumwandiko wanditse, aho itumanaho riri hagati ye na mwarimu we, abo bakorana, abo bakorana, ndetse nisi muri rusange ryagutse cyane. Ikizamini cyukuri kode itanga amakuru kuva icapiro kugeza umwandiko wa braille ni ugukora inyandiko mvugo yerekeza. Ingano yamasezerano hagati yumwimerere wacapwe nuwandukuwe muri braille ni igipimo cyukuri kode.
Ingaruka imwe nuko uwandukura braille adakeneye kumenya imibare ishingiye. Umwanditsi wa braille agomba kumenya ibimenyetso byanditse kandi akamenya kubitanga muri Nemeth Code braille. Kurugero, niba ikimenyetso kimwe cyimibare gishobora kugira ibisobanuro bibiri bitandukanye, ibi ntacyo bitwaye; ingero zombi zashyirwa ahagaragara kimwe. Ibi bitandukanye na Code yumuziki mpuzamahanga ya Braille, aho braille iterwa nubusobanuro bwumuziki wino. Rero ubumenyi bwumuziki burasabwa kubyara umuziki wa braille.

Abraham Nemeth (16 Ukwakira 1918 - 2 Ukwakira 2013) yari umunyamerika. Yabaye umwarimu w’imibare muri kaminuza ya Detroit Impuhwe i Detroit, muri Leta ya Michigan. Nemeth yari afite ubumuga bwo kutabona kandi azwiho guteza imbere Nemeth Braille, sisiteme y'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona yo gusoma no kwandika imibare.
Ubuzima bwe bwo hambere.
Nemeth yavukiye mu mujyi wa mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bwa Manhattan mu Muryango mugari w’abimukira b’Abayahudi b’abayahudi bavugaga Yiddish. Yabaye impumyi kuva akivuka avanze na macula degeneration na retinitis pigmentosa.
Yabanje kwiga amashuri ya leta ariko amashuri menshi abanza nayisumbuye muri Guild yAbayahudi y’ishuri ry’abatabona i, muri New York. Amashuri yisumbuye yari muri College aho yize psychologue. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse y’ubuhanzi muri psychologiya yakuye muri.
Nemeth yize imibare na fiziki muri. Ntabwo yize imibare kuko abajyanama be mu masomo bamuca intege. Icyakora, arambiwe ibyo yumvaga ari imirimo ituzuye mu bigo by'impumyi, kandi abifashijwemo n'umugore we wa mbere Florence, yahisemo gukomeza amashuri ye mu mibare. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga. mu mibare yakuye muri.
Nemeth yigishije amasaha make muri kaminuza zitandukanye i New York. Nubwo abakoresha be rimwe na rimwe batashakaga kumuha akazi azi ko ari impumyi, izina rye ryarushijeho kwiyongera kuko byagaragaye ko yari umuhanga mu mibare n’umwarimu. Nemeth yitandukanije nabandi bantu benshi bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona abasha kwandika inyuguti zanditse zerekana amashusho nibimenyetso by'imibare ku mpapuro no ku kibaho kimwe n'abantu babibona, ubuhanga yize akiri umwana. Nemeth avuga ko ubwo buhanga bwamwemereye gutsinda mu mibare, mu gihe kidafite ikoranabuhanga ryinshi, ubwo na Braille byari bigoye gukoresha mu mibare. Mu myaka ya za 1950, yimukiye i muri Leta ya Michigan kugira ngo yemere umwanya muri kaminuza ya Detroit ukorana na Keith Rosenberg. Yagumyeyo imyaka 30, asezera mu 1985. Mu mpera za 1960 yize siyanse ya maze atangira gahunda ya kaminuza muri iryo somo.
Akamaro ku imibare n'ubuhumyi.
Mugihe amasomo yarushagaho gutera imbere, yasanze akeneye kode ya braille yakoresha neza ubwoko bwimibare nubumenyi yakoreshaga. Amaherezo, yashyizeho amategeko ya Nemeth Braille Code for Mathematics and Science Notation, yasohotse mu 1952. Kode ya Nemeth yanyuze mu 4 ivugurura kuva yatangira iterambere, kandi ikomeje gukoreshwa cyane muri iki gihe.
Nemeth ashinzwe kandi amategeko ya MathSpeak, sisitemu yo kuvuga kumvugo inyandiko. Mu masomo ye, Nemeth yasanze akeneye gukoresha abasomyi bareba kugirango basome ubundi imibare yimibare itagerwaho nibindi bikoresho. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, yari akeneye uburyo bwo gutegeka imirimo ye y'imibare n'ibindi bikoresho byo kwandukura. Amasezerano Nemeth yateje imbere gusoma neza imibare yimibare n'ijwi rirenga ihinduka MathSpeak.
Nemeth yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere ry’Ubwongereza Bumwe (UEB) kuva mu 1991 kugeza nibura mu 2001, nubwo yaje gutandukana n’abandi batezimbere iyo code, ahubwo akora ku mbaraga zisa nazo zitwa Universal Braille System (rimwe na rimwe mu magambo ahinnye yitwa NUBS hamwe na we izina ryongewe imbere). Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2012, UEB yemejwe na BANA nk'urwego rusanzwe rw'imyandikire y’ubuvanganzo, ariko Code ya Nemeth nayo yagumishijwe mu buryo bwuzuye nka sisitemu yo kwandika ku bushake. Imirimo kuri NUBS irashobora gukomeza, cyangwa irashobora guhuzwa mumategeko azaza-kuvugurura amategeko yemewe ya Nemeth (amategeko aheruka-kuvugurura amategeko ya Nemeth yari muri 2013).
Nemeth yari agikora kuri code ya Nemeth igihe yapfaga. Nemeth yari umunyamwete mu muryango w'Abayahudi kuva mu bwana, kandi kuva mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru avuye mu mibare y’amasomo, yandikaga igitabo cy'amasengesho cy'igiheburayo muri Braille.
Nemeth yari umunyamwete mu ishyirahamwe ry’abatabona. Yanditse inkuru ngufi kandi atanga disikuru kuri NFB kubyerekeye ubuzima bwe nkumubare wimpumyi. Ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2006, Nemeth yagize ikibazo gikomeye cy'umutima, ariko arakira kandi yari ahagije kugira ngo yitabe ikoraniro rya NFB muri Nyakanga 2006 kandi yemera igihembo cya Louis Braille 2006 uyu muryango wamuhaye. Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2009, yahawe icyubahiro na NFB nk'umufatanyabikorwa wahawe igihembo cya Dr. Jacob Bolotin.
Igitekerezo cya Nemeth cyasohowe imburagihe mu binyamakuru by’Abayahudi n’ubuhumyi, igihe abakozi bo muri ibyo binyamakuru bemezaga ko yapfuye mu gihe musaza we n’umugore we bapfuye.
Nemeth yari umwe mu bari bagize ishyaka riharanira demokarasi muri Amerika ariko yashyizweho na guverineri wa republika ya Michigan nka perezida wa komisiyo ya leta ishinzwe impumyi, umwanya yakoreyemo imyaka ibiri, nubwo yavuze ko adakunda politiki.
Yari umuhanga mu gucuranga piyano wakundaga gushimisha abandi, akagira kwibuka bitangaje kumatariki namakuru kandi akishimira kuvuga urwenya ninkuru yashoboraga guhuza nibintu byose cyangwa ibihe.

Ni inyuguti ya ikoreshwa ku. Hano hari inyuguti ebyiri zisanzwe za braille zikoreshwa muri Urdu, imwe muri Pakisitani indi mu Buhinde. Inyuguti zo muri Pakisitani zishingiye ku nyuguti z'Ubuperesi kandi zikoreshwa mu gihugu hose, mu gihe inyuguti z'Ubuhinde zishingiye kuri y'igihugu.
Itandukaniro nu Buperesi na Bharati Braille.
Usibye kongeramo inyuguti zihariye za Urdu zisa n’inyuguti ziyongereye mu nyuguti zanditse zitwa ugereranije n’inyuguti z’, Urdu braille yo muri Pakisitani itandukanye na Udru y’Abaperesi mu iyandikwa ry’inyuguti yacapishijwe ž, yanditswe nk'igishushanyo mu rurimi rwa Udru. kuruta nk'Igifarisi ⠬, mu Urdu rikoreshwa kuri ڈ ḍ..
Umuhinde Urdu Braille itandukanye nizindi nyuguti za Bharati braille mu kugira inyuguti nyinshi yatijwe mu Giperesi,such as ⠟ for ق "q" (Bharati "kṣ"), ⠱ for ح "ḥ" (Bharati "jñ"), and ⠷ for ع "‘" (Bharati "ḻ"). Another such letter, ⠭ for خ "x", is shared with ਖ਼ "x" but with no other Bharati alphabet, where ⠭ is otherwise the vowel "o".

Ikoranabuhanga rya Braille ni ifasha ituma abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona gusoma, kwandika, cyangwa gukoresha hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga. Iri koranabuhanga ryemerera abakoresha gukora imirimo isanzwe nko kwandika, kureba kuri interineti, kwandika mu nyandiko ya Braille no gucapa mu nyandiko, kwishora mu biganiro, gukuramo dosiye n'umuziki, gukoresha imeri ya elegitoronike, gutwika umuziki, no gusoma inyandiko. Iyemerera kandi abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa ubumuga bwo kutabona kurangiza imirimo yose mwishuri nkabandi banyeshuri bigana kandi ibemerera kwiga kumurongo. Ifasha abanyamwuga gukora akazi kabo nabarimu gutanga ibiganiro bakoresheje ibyuma na software. Iterambere mu ikoranabuhanga rya rifite ireme kuko impumyi zishobora kubona inyandiko nyinshi, ibitabo, n'amasomero, kandi bikanorohereza gucapa inyandiko za Braille.
"N'ubwo gahunda ya Braille igera ku isi hose, Ihuriro ry’igihugu ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona rivuga ko 10 ku ijana gusa by’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona bashobora gusoma Braille".

Kurzweil Education (yahoze yitwa Kurzweil Educational Systems) ni isosiyete ikorera muri Amerika itanga ikoranabuhanga mu.
Kurzweil Uburezi butanga ibisubizo byo gusoma no kwandika, ibikoresho n'amahugurwa kubafite imyigire itandukanye nibibazo, cyangwa abantu bafite cyangwa
Isosiyete yashinzwe mu 1996, yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere rya ifasha Icyicaro cyayo kiri i, muri Texas.
Isosiyete itanga ibicuruzwa bibiri byingenzi bya software kubakiriya bayo-Kurzweil 1000 na Kurzweil 3000. Kurzweil 1000 ni porogaramu ituma uyikoresha ubumuga bwo kutabona ashobora kubona ibikoresho byifashishwa ku rubuga, ibyuma bya digitale cyangwa bisikana binyuze mu OCR hamwe n’inyandiko ku mvugo. ; Porogaramu ya Kurzweil 1000 itanga uburyo bworoshye bwo kubona impapuro nyinshi kandi ikayerekana hamwe nimirima, ibirango, agasanduku, hamwe n’ahantu handitse kugirango ubone uburyo bwo gusoma kugirango ushobore kuzuza impapuro ukoresheje mudasobwa.
Kurzweil 3000 ni tekinoroji yuburezi, cyangwa tekinoroji ifasha, itanga urubuga rwo gusoma, kwandika no kwiga rugamije ababana nubumuga bwo kwiga cyangwa ubundi bumuga butuma gusoma cyangwa kwandika bigorana. Kurzweil 3000 ikoreshwa mugushigikira abafite dyslexia, dysgraphia, abiga ururimi rwicyongereza mwishuri, amashuri makuru, murugo no mukazi. Kurzweil 3000 irashobora gusoma mu ijwi riranguruye ishingiye ku mbuga za interineti, ibikoresho bya digitale cyangwa bisikanye, bigahindura urubuga rushingiye ku mbuga za interineti, ibikoresho bya digitale cyangwa bisikana muri mp3 kugira ngo bitange dosiye zumvikana kugira ngo wumve kugenda cyangwa binyuze muri porogaramu y’urubuga rwa firefly urashobora gusoma kuri iPad.
Nubwo iyi sosiyete yashinzwe mu 1996, inyandiko yayo kuri porogaramu yo kuvuga mu by'ukuri ni ikintu cyatangiye mu myaka ya za 70, igihe yatunganyaga imashini ye ya mbere ya Kurzweil yo gusoma, igikoresho gishobora gusikana no kuvuga inyandiko.
Muri 2005, Educational Systems yaguzwe na. Cambium ifite andi masosiyete menshi ajyanye n'uburezi.

JAWS (" Akazi Kubona Akajambo ") ni porogaramu ya mudasobwa ya yemerera abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona gusoma ecran haba mu cyangwa mu. JAWS ikorwa nitsinda ryimpumyi nicyerekezo gito.
Gicurasi - Kamena 2021 ubushakashatsi bwakoreshejwe nabasomyi ba ecran bwakozwe na, isosiyete ikora urubuga, yasanze JAWS ariwe musomyi wa ecran uzwi cyane kwisi yose; 53.7% by'abitabiriye ubushakashatsi babikoresheje nk'umusomyi wibanze wa ecran, mugihe 70.0% byabitabiriye babikoresheje kenshi.
JAWS ishyigikira na hamwe na verisiyo zose za Windows Server yasohotse kuva. Hano hari verisiyo ebyiri za porogaramu: "Urugo" rwibanze rwo gukoresha ubucuruzi nubucuruzi bwumwuga "kubidukikije". Mbere ya JAWS 16, "Urugo" rwiswe "Standard", kandi rwakoraga gusa muri sisitemu y'imikorere ya Windows. Verisiyo ya, rimwe na rimwe izwi nka "JDOS", ni ubuntu.
uyikoresha gukoresha porogaramu zidafite igenzura rya Windows risanzwe, na porogaramu zitagenewe kuboneka.
JAWS yarekuwe bwa mbere mu 1989 na, wahoze asiganwa ku ipikipiki wabuze amaso mu mpanuka y'imodoka yo mu 1978. Mu 1985, Henter, hamwe n’ishoramari US$ 180.000 yatanzwe na Bill Joyce, bashinze "ikigo cya Henter-Joyce" i. Joyce yagurishije inyungu ze muri sosiyete asubira muri Henter mu 1990. Muri Mata 2000, Henter-Joyce, Blazie Engineering, na Arkenstone, Inc. bahujwe no gukora.
JAWS yabanje gukorwa kuri. Wari umwe mubasomyi benshi ba ecran baha abakoresha impumyi kubona inyandiko-yuburyo bwa MS-DOS. Ikintu cyihariye cya JAWS muri kiriya gihe kwari ugukoresha menus zishimishije, muburyo bwa porogaramu izwi cyane ya Lotus 1-2-3. Icyatandukanije JAWS usibye nabandi basomyi ba ecran yiki gihe ni ugukoresha yemerera abakoresha guhitamo imikoreshereze yimikoreshereze kandi bagakora neza hamwe nibikorwa bitandukanye.
Ted Henter na Rex Skipper banditse kode ya JAWS y'umwimerere hagati ya za 1980, basohora verisiyo ya 2.0 hagati ya 1990. Skipper yavuye muri sosiyete nyuma yo gusohora verisiyo ya 2.0, hanyuma amaze kugenda, Charles Oppermann yahawe akazi ko kubungabunga no kuzamura ibicuruzwa. Oppermann na Henter bahoraga bongeramo ibintu bito kandi byingenzi kandi bakarekura verisiyo nshya. Freedom Scientific ubu itanga JAWS kuri MS-DOS nkikururwa kurubuga rwabo.
Mu 1993, Henter-Joyce yasohoye verisiyo yahinduwe cyane ya JAWS kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kwiga. Iki gicuruzwa, cyitwa WordScholar, ntikiboneka.
Mu 1992, uko yamenyekanye cyane, Oppermann yatangiye gukora kuri verisiyo nshya ya JAWS. Intego nyamukuru yo gushushanya ntiyari ukubangamira imiterere isanzwe yukoresha ya Windows no gukomeza gutanga ibikoresho bikomeye bya macro. Ikizamini na beta verisiyo ya JAWS kuri Windows (JFW) yerekanwe mu nama mu 1993 na 1994. Muri kiriya gihe, uwatezimbere Glen Gordon yatangiye gukora kuri kode, amaherezo atangira iterambere ryayo igihe Oppermann yahawe akazi na Microsoft mu Gushyingo 1994. Nyuma yaho gato, muri Mutarama 1995, JAWS ya Windows 1.0 yasohotse.
Isubiramo rishya rya JAWS kuri Windows risohoka hafi rimwe mu mwaka, hamwe nudushya duto hagati.
JAWS yemerera ibikorwa byose byingenzi bya sisitemu y'imikorere ya kugenzurwa na hamwe n'ibitekerezo byavuzwe. Izi shortcuts zibikwa zihoraho zishoboka muri gahunda nyinshi, ariko umubare munini cyane wimirimo ikenewe kugirango ukoreshe neza software ya mudasobwa igezweho bisaba neza ko umukoresha wa nyuma gufata mu mutwe ibintu byinshi byingenzi. Mubyukuri buri kintu cyose cya JAWS gishobora gutegurwa numukoresha, harimo urufunguzo rwose nibintu nkumuvuduko wo gusoma, ubunini bwakoreshejwe mugusoma utumenyetso, nibitekerezo. JAWS ikubiyemo kandi ururimi rwimyandikire kugirango ihindure imirimo kandi ihindure byinshi bigoye kumyitwarire ya gahunda.
Porogaramu ikubiyemo uburyo butandukanye bwagenewe umwihariko wa, ikora iyo mushakisha iri imbere. Iyo ushakisha urubuga, JAWS ibanza gutangaza umutwe numubare wibihuza. Imvugo irashobora guhagarikwa hamwe, imirongo igendana nurufunguzo rwo hejuru / hepfo umwambi, kandi rugenda hagati yibihuza nubugenzuzi. Urufunguzo rwinyuguti rwihariye kuri clavier rushobora gukanda kugirango ruyobore ibikurikira cyangwa ibanziriza ubwoko bwubwoko runaka, nkibisanduku byanditse cyangwa agasanduku. JAWS irashobora kubona imitwe muri na PDF inyandiko zisa.
Ikiranga JAWS cyashyizweho hamwe nuburinganire bwacyo byasobanuwe nk "bigoye", hamwe namahugurwa asabwa kubakoresha nkabashushanya urubuga bakora ibizamini byoroshye, kugirango birinde gufata imyanzuro itari yo muri ibyo bizamini.

WebAIM (Urubuga rwa interineti mu bitekerezo) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu ukorera muri i. WebAIM yatanze ibisubizo kuva 1999. Intego ya WebAIM nukwagura ubushobozi kubantu bafite ubumuga batanga ubumenyi, ubumenyi bwa tekinike, ibikoresho, ingamba zo kuyobora imitegekere, hamwe nicyerekezo giha imbaraga amashyirahamwe kugirango ibikubiyemo bigere kubantu bafite ubumuga.
Ibicuruzwa na serivisi.
WebAIM itanga ibicuruzwa byinshi na serivisi byinjira kurubuga. Igikoresho cyo gusuzuma WAVE igenzurwa na WebAIM. Iki gikoresho cyubuntu, kumurongo gitanga ibitekerezo byerekana page. WAVE Toolbar nayo iraboneka nkiyagurwa kuri mushakisha zombi za Firefox &amp; Chrome.
Serivise zo kurubuga rwa WebAIM zirimo amahugurwa yo kugerwaho, gukurikirana urubuga no kugenzura, gutanga ibyemezo, kugisha inama, gushushanya urubuga, no gusana ibiboneka.
WebAIM iyobora kumurongo wurubuga. Umutungo wabaturage urimo akanyamakuru, urutonde rwibiganiro kuri imeri, kurubuga rwiminsi 2, hamwe na.

Paraplegia, cyangwa paraparesis, ni ukubangamira imikorere ya moteri cyangwa ibyumviro byimpera zo hepfo. Ijambo ryaturutse mu kigereki cya Ionic (παραπληγίη) "gukubitwa kabiri". Agace k'umuyoboro w wibasiwe na paraplegia ni thoracic, lumbar, cyangwa. Niba ingingo enye zatewe nubumuga, tetraplegia cyangwa quadriplegia nijambo ryukuri. Niba ingingo imwe gusa ifite ingaruka, ijambo ryukuri ni monoplegia. Paraplegia ya spastique nuburyo bwa paraplegia isobanurwa nubwinshi bwimitsi yanduye, aho kuba paralike ya flaccid.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imvune z’ ryashyize mu majwi ubukana bw’umugongo mu buryo bukurikira. ASIA A nugutakaza rwose imikorere yimyumvire nubuhanga bwa moteri munsi yimvune. ASIA B ifite imikorere yunvikana munsi yimvune, ariko ntamikorere ya moteri. Muri ASIA C, hari imikorere ya moteri iri munsi yurwego rwimvune, ariko kimwe cya kabiri cyimitsi ntishobora kugenda irwanya imbaraga. Muri ASIA D, kimwe cya kabiri cyimitsi iri munsi yurwego rwimvune irashobora kugenda irwanya imbaraga. ASIA E nugusubiza ibikorwa byose byubwonko
Abantu bafite ubumuga barashobora gutandukana murwego rwubumuga bwabo, bisaba ko imiti itandukana bitewe nibibazo. Gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe bigamije gufasha umurwayi kugarura imikorere n'ubwigenge bushoboka bwose. Physiotherapie irashobora gufasha kunoza imbaraga, urwego rwo kugenda, kurambura no kwimura ubuhanga. Abamugaye benshi bazashingira ku kagare k'abamugaye nk'uburyo bwo gutwara abantu.Ibikorwa by'ubuzima bwa buri (ADLs) birashobora kuba ingorabahizi kubantu bafite ikibazo cyumugongo (SCI). Hifashishijwe abavuzi ba physiotherapiste hamwe nabavuzi babigize umwuga, abantu bafite SCI barashobora kwiga ubumenyi bushya kandi bagahuza nubwa mbere kugirango barusheho kwigenga, akenshi babaho mu bwigenge mu baturage.
Kuvugurura uruti rw'umugongo.
Reba kandi: Gukomeretsa umugongo direction Icyerekezo cyubushakashatsi
Olfactory ensheathing selile (OEC) yatewe mu ntsinzi y’umugongo w’umugabo wo muri Polonye witwa Darek Fidyka, warokotse igitero cy’icyuma cyamuteye ubumuga mu 2010.
Mu mwaka wa 2014, Fidyka yabazwe ubupayiniya bw'umugongo bwakoresheje imitsi y’imitsi, kuva ku kaguru, kugira ngo 'akureho icyuho' mu ruti rw'umugongo yaciwe ndetse na OEC kugira ngo akangure ingirangingo z'umugongo. Kubaga byakorewe muri Polonye ku bufatanye na Prof. Geoff Raisman, umuyobozi w’ubuzima bushya bw’imyororokere mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubuvuzi rya Neurologiya rya kaminuza ya Londere, hamwe n’itsinda rye ry’ubushakashatsi. Uturemangingo twa olfactory twakuwe mu matara y’umurwayi mu bwonko bwe hanyuma akurira muri laboratoire, izo selile zatewe inshinge hejuru no munsi y’umugongo wangiritse.
Fidyka yagaruye ibyiyumvo na moteri mumaguru yo hepfo, cyane cyane kuruhande rwa OEC yatewe. Fidyka yabanje kubona intsinzi nyuma y'amezi atatu abikora, mugihe ikibero cye cy'ibumoso cyatangiye kwiyongera. MRIs zerekana ko icyuho cyo mu ruti rw'umugongo cyafunzwe. Yizera ko ari we muntu wa mbere ku isi wagaruye imikorere y’imyumvire kuva yaciwe burundu imitsi yumugongo.

Guceceka k'umubiri (mu icyongereza: The Body Silent)
Ni inkuru yanditswe na, umwarimu muri. Iki gice kivuga ku rugamba rwa muntu ku giti cye binyuze mu ruti rw'umugongo, rwasohowe mu 1987 na Henry Holt na Company, Inc. Yasuzumwe ikibyimba kiva mu rubavu rwe rwa kabiri rw'inkondo y'umura kugeza ku munani wa thoracic vertebra mu 1972. Binyuze mu nkuru ye avuga amateka ye y'ubuvuzi ndetse n'uburyo isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi bwa kera (mu mpera za 1920) ryari rizi bike cyane ku bijyanye na neurologiya, kandi agasiga ibibazo bitamenyekanye aribyo yashyizeho ikibazo gishya mu myaka 50. Nkumwarimu wa antropropologiya muri kaminuza ya Columbia, akoresha umurima we murugendo rwe rwubuvuzi. "Iki gitabo cyatekerejweho no kumenya ko uburwayi bwanjye bumaze igihe kirekire ndwaye indwara y'uruti rw'umugongo bwabaye nk'urugendo rwagutse rwo mu murima wa antropropologique, kuko binyuze muri bwo natuye mu isi mbonezamubano ntarintangaje kuri njye mbere kuruta iy'Uwiteka Amashyamba ya Amazone. Kandi kubera ko ari inshingano za antropropologiste bose gutanga raporo ku ngendo zabo... iyi ni yo mibare yanjye. " Bitewe nubushakashatsi bwatewe inkunga mubyamubayeho nubuvuzi, aha abasomyi ibisobanuro nibisobanuro kubyo akora, hiyongereyeho kuganira buri gihe kubishobora kubaho hamwe nibitekerezo bye muri rusange.
Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubumenyi cyateye inkunga umusaruro w’igitabo, kandi cyanditswe na Holt.
Ibice bya Metapathographie ntabwo arinkuru ninkuru zindwara, ahubwo ni umwuga wo kwisuzuma wabigize umwuga no kwandika byimbitse kubyo leta yihariye. Nubwo metapathography atari ubwoko bwihariye, abandi banditsi ninzobere basuzumye ibikoresho bye basobanuye ko bitandukanijwe n’ibitekerezo bwite, kubera isesengura ryimbitse ry’imitekerereze n’umubiri.
Ingingo nyamukuru: Robert Francis Murphy (antropropologue)
Robert Murphy yavutse ku ya 3 Werurwe 1924, avukira i Far Rockaway, muri New York. Yize cyane kandi aba intangarugero ya antropropologue akaba n'umwarimu wa antropropologiya muri kaminuza ya Columbia mu mujyi wa New York, kuva mu ntangiriro ya za 1960 kugeza 1990. Yize imico myinshi itandukanye ku isi, nka Mundurucu wa Amazone n'imiryango yo muri Sahara. Afite imyaka 66, yapfiriye iwe i Leonia, muri Leta ya New Jersey.
Mu 1928, Murphy yabuze gukoresha ukuguru. Umuganga wo mu rugo yamusuzumye "gukoraho " byamutwaye ibyumweru bibiri kugirango akire. Murphy yatangiye kurwara imitsi mu kibero, no mu nda yo mu 1972, bidatinze agira ikibazo cyo kwihagarika. Yaje gusuzumwa afite ibice byo mu mutwe, bivuze ko gucika gato imitsi. Nyuma yimyaka mike yibimenyetso, yasuye inzobere mu bumenyi bw maze bamusuzumisha ikibyimba cyiza ariko gikura buhoro buhoro mu gice cyo hejuru cy. Mu myaka ibiri, bwarangiritse cyane, kandi yatakaje imikorere myinshi y'umubiri.
Mu 1987, igitabo cyahawe igihembo cya Lionel Trilling University cyo muri kaminuza ya Columbia.

Freedom Scientific nisosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa byoroshye kubakoresha mudasobwa bafite. Porogaramu bakora ituma, hamwe no gukoresha hamwe na mudasobwa zigezweho. Isosiyete ni ishami rya Vispero ikaba ifite icyicaro i.
wahoze asiganwa ku ipikipiki yateje imbere umusomyi wa JAWS nyuma yo kuba impumyi biturutse ku mpanuka y'imodoka. Henter na Bill Joyce bashinze Henter-Joyce mu 1987 i, muri Floride, bakora ya JAWS nyuma baza kuba. Henter-Joyce yahujwe na Arkenstone na Blazie Engineering mu 2000 bakora Freedom Scientific.

Ted Henter (wavutse 1950 muri) numunyamerika akaba uzwiho kuba yarahimbye abasoma ecran ya JAWS kubatabona. Yize ibijyanye n’ubuhanga, ariko yiga porogaramu za mudasobwa maze atangira ubucuruzi bwe nyuma yo kugira ikibazo mu mpanuka y’imodoka mu 1978, ibyo bikaba byarangije umwuga utanga ikizere cyo gusiganwa ku ipikipiki mpuzamahanga.
Mu 1987, yifatanyije n’umucuruzi, bafatanya gushinga Henter-Joyce i St. Petersburg, muri Floride. Henter yari perezida kandi ayoboye icyo gikorwa kandi atanga icyerekezo cyikoranabuhanga mugihe Joyce yakoraga nkumufatanyabikorwa ucecetse. Henter-Joyce yakoze JAWS, kuri mudasobwa bwite ukoresheje, hanyuma.
Nyuma yo guhumuka, Henter yongeye kuvumbura amazi yo mu mazi, atangira kwitabira amarushanwa yo gusiganwa ku mazi. Yatsinze inshuro esheshatu mu marushanwa arindwi yabereye muri Amerika ndetse kabiri mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga. Yagiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 1991 nyuma yo kwegukana umudari wa Zahabu muri Amerika ndetse na Shampiyona y'isi ku bamugaye.
Henter-Joyce yahujwe na Arkenstone na Blazie Engineering mu 2000 bakora Freedom Scientific. Kugeza ubu Henter asigaye mu nama y'ubuyobozi ya Freedom Scientific, maze mu 2002 ashinga Henter Math, kugira ngo akore porogaramu ifasha "abadafite ikaramu" n'imibare.

Igishushanyo cya Braille nigicapiro zitanga inyandiko ngengabuzima. Ukoresheje porogaramu yo guhindura inyandiko ya braille, inyandiko cyangwa inyandiko ya digitale irashobora gushushanywa muburyo bworoshye. Ibi bituma umusaruro wa braille ukora neza kandi uhendutse. Porogaramu yubusobanuro bwa Braille irashobora kuba ubuntu kandi cyangwa yishyuwe.
Abakoresha impumyi bakunda kwita izindi "printer ya wino," kugirango babatandukanye na bagenzi babo. Ibi bikunze kugaragara utitaye kubwoko bwa printer iganirwaho (urugero, yitwa "printer ya wino" nubwo badakoresha wino)
Kimwe na printer na wino, ibishushanyo biva mubigenewe abaguzi kugeza kubikoreshwa nabamamaji binini. Igiciro cyibishushanyo byiyongera hamwe nubunini bwa braille itanga.
Ibishushanyo mbonera by’inganda byihuta cyane ni amadolari 92.000 yakozwe n’Ububiligi yakozwe na NV Interpoint 55, yakozwe bwa mbere mu 1991, ikoresha itandukanye kugira ngo itware umutwe wanditseho kandi ishobora gusohora inyuguti zigera kuri 800 ku isegonda. Kurera umwana byatangiye mbere; mu 2000 ryatangaje ko muri Amerika hari batatu gusa muri bo, imwe ifitwe na NFB ubwayo indi ibiri na sosiyete ya. Kugeza mu 2008, ku isi hose harenga 60.
Ibishushanyo bito bya desktop ya braille biramenyerewe cyane kandi urashobora kubisanga mumasomero, kaminuza, hamwe n’ibigo by’uburezi by’inzobere, ndetse no kuba ari ibya nyir'impumyi. Birashobora kuba nkenerwa gukoresha akabati ya acoustic cyangwa hood kugirango.
Ubudodo bwa Braille mubusanzwe bukenera impapuro zidasanzwe za braille zifite umubyimba kandi zihenze kuruta impapuro zisanzwe. Bimwe mubirangirire-byohejuru birashobora gucapura kumpapuro zisanzwe. Abashushanya barashobora kuba uruhande rumwe cyangwa uruhande rumwe. Gushushanya impande zombi bisaba gutondekanya utudomo kugirango bidahuzagurika (bita "interpoint" kuko ingingo kurundi ruhande zishyirwa hagati yingingo kuruhande). Gushushanya impande zombi bikoresha impapuro nke kandi bigabanya ubunini bwibisohoka.
Iyo kopi imwe yinyandiko imaze gukorwa, gucapa izindi kopi akenshi byihuta hakoreshejwe igikoresho cyitwa, gitanga kopi kuri plastiki yoroshye. Nyamara, braille yavuyemo ntabwo isomeka byoroshye nka braille yashizwemo vuba, muburyo bumwe na idafite ubuziranenge idasomeka nkumwimerere. Kubwibyo, abamamaji binini ntibakoresha ubusanzwe.
Ibishushanyo bimwe bishobora kubyara "Ukwezi kwadomo", ni ukuvuga, bwakorewe nududomo.

Mountbatten Brailler ni imashini ya elegitoronike ikoreshwa mu kwandika ku mpapuro za braille. Ikoresha "clavier yandika ya braille" gakondo ya Perkins Brailler hamwe n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, ikayiha ibintu byinshi byongeweho nko gutunganya ijambo, ibitekerezo by'amajwi no gushushanya. Imashini yabanjirijwe kandi itunganyirizwa mu Ubwongereza Royal National College for Blind i Hanoford na Ernest Bate.
Ku ikubitiro Mountbatten yakorewe itunganywa muri Ositaraliya. Ku taliki ya 1 Mutarama mu mwaka 2010, uruganda rwa Mountbatten rwafashwe na sosiyete yo muri Polonye Harpo Sp. z o.o.
Mountbatten yatunganijwe nyuma yuko Lord Mountbatten asize irage m'ubushake bwe bwo guteza imbere ibikorwa by'iterambere, igiciro gito, cyoroshye. cyabonetse kuva mu mwaka 1991.
Kimwe na Perkins, Mountbatten ifite urufunguzo ruhuye na buri tudomo dutandatu kode ya braille. Mu gihe kimwe ukanda icyarimwe guhuza ku ufunguzo rwa gatandatu, abakoresha bashobora gukora inyuguti iyo ari yo yose muri kode ya braille. Usibye izi mfunguzo esheshatu, Mountbatten ifite urufunguzo rw'umwanya, ufungura inyuma, n'urufunguzo rushya. Kimwe n'imyandikire y'intoki, ifite ipfundo ryo guteza imbere impapuro ukoresheje imashini, nubwo bitandukanye na Perkins umurongo ntigenda. Hano hari urufunguzo rwo kugaruka rumera nk'urwo gutwara ibinyabiziga. Ibizingo bifata kandi bigateza imbere impapuro bifite ibinono byabugenewe kugira ngo birinde guhonyora utudomo twazamuye brailler twaremwe.
Usibye clavier gakondo, Mountbatten ifite ibindi bintu byinshi biyiranga. Ibi birimo kwibuka byemerera dosiye y'inyandiko ya braille kubikwa mu buryo bumwe nk'uko bikorwa hamwe n'ijambo ritunganya na processor, ibitekerezo byatanzwe byemerera umukoresha kumva inyandiko banditse cyangwa kwandika muri dosiye, hamwe no guhindura imbere n'inyuma hagati y'inyandiko na braille. Mountbatten ishobora guhuzwa n'icapiro ryemerera dosiye gucapurwa nk'inyandiko, mu gihe clavier isanzwe ya PC ishobora guhuzwa na Mountbatten ituma inyandiko ishobora gukorwa nk'uko byasezeranijwe cyangwa bidafite amasezerano.
Hari moderi nyinshi za Mountbatten, shingiro ry'umwanditsi wa Mountbatten. Umwanditsi wa Mountbatten Yongeyeho, Pro ya Mountbatten, na Sisitemu yo Kwiga ya Mountbatten.

Perkins Brailler ni imashini yandika ya braille ifite urufunguzo ruhuye na buri kadomo dutandatu kode ya, urufunguzo rwumwanya, urufunguzo rwinyuma, nurufunguzo rwumurongo. Kimwe yintoki, ifite impande ebyiri kugirango utere imbere impapuro ukoresheje imashini hamwe nigikoresho cyo kugaruka hejuru yimfunguzo. Ibizingo bifata kandi bigateza imbere impapuro bifite ibinono byabugenewe kugirango birinde guhonyora utudomo twazamuye brailler akora.
Nubwo inyandiko ya braille yagenewe abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona gusoma, mbere yo kumenyekanisha Perkins Brailler, kwandika braille byari inzira itoroshye. Abanditsi ba Braille bakoze inyuguti za braille hamwe na (nkuko byakozwe na) cyangwa bakoresheje imwe mumashini yandika ya brille igoye, ihenze, kandi yoroshye yaboneka muricyo gihe.
Imashini yambere yandika Braille yatanzwe na mu 1892.
Umwimerere wa Perkins Brailler yakozwe mu 1951 na David Abraham (1896–1978), umwarimu ukora ibiti mu utanyuzwe n’ibibazo by’ikoranabuhanga risanzweho. Umuyobozi w'ishuri rya Perkins ry’abatabona, Gabriel Farrell, yasabye Abraham gukora imashini ihendutse kandi yizewe kugira ngo abanyeshuri bandike byoroshye. Farrell na Abraham bakoranye na Edward Waterhouse, wari umwarimu w’imibare muri Perkins, kugirango bakore igishushanyo cya Brailler.
Muri 2008, hashyizweho verisiyo yoroshye kandi ituje. Harimo kandi gusiba urufunguzo hamwe nigikoresho cyo gutwara. Umunyamideli mushya yatsindiye igihembo cya silver muri International Design Excellence Awards 2009.
Gushyira impapuro bigerwaho no kuzunguza impapuro kurugoma rwimbere, kurikingura mugihe umukoresha akanze urufunguzo rwo kugaburira umurongo, no gukoresha guhunga nkisaha kugirango yimure igare ryanditseho impapuro. Sisitemu ya cam esheshatu zigizwe ninkoni hamwe na kare kwambukiranya igice cyohereza urufunguzo kuri stili isa na wire iri muri gare. Ubworoherane buri hafi, kandi kubaka umwanda wamavuta hamwe no gukoresha bisanzwe bisaba koza buri gihe kandi bigahinduka.
Imiterere mishya ya Perkins Brailler, SMART Brailler, yahimbwe na David S. Morgan isohoka mu 2011. SMART Brailler ishingiye kubikorwa byubukanishi bwa kera bwa Perkins Brailler, kandi, iyo bidafite imbaraga, birakorwa nka Brailler isanzwe. SMART Brailler ikubiyemo ibyuma bifata ibyuma bifata imashini ishushanya, kandi, iyo ikoreshejwe imbaraga, ikongeramo ibitekerezo-by-amajwi byerekana amajwi hamwe na sisitemu ya digitale kugirango ikoreshwe nabafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Porogaramu ya SMART Brailler ikubiyemo imvugo y’indimi nyinshi hamwe n’inkunga ya Braille, harimo Icyongereza, Ubwongereza Icyongereza, Icyarabu, Igifaransa, Ikidage, Ubutaliyani, Igiporutugali, Igipolonye, Ikirusiya, na Turukiya.
Hamwe na mudasobwa ziza, abakoresha benshi bakora ibisohoka mu nyandiko bakoresheje mudasobwa hamwe duhujwe na mudasobwa. Abakoresha ubumuga bwo kutabona barashobora gusoma ecran ya ukoresheje porogaramu ya mudasobwa ya mudasobwa na / cyangwa. Abakoresha sisitemu nkiyi barashobora gukoresha clavier ya mudasobwa muburyo busanzwe bwo kwandika cyangwa barashobora gukoresha umushoferi udasanzwe wa clavier yemerera urufunguzo rutandatu "sdf-jkl" gukoreshwa nkigikoresho cyinjira muri braille gisa na Perkins Brailler.

Notetakers ikubiyemo ibiranga PDA nkigitabo cya aderesi na calculatrice. Kuberako ibice byinshi byimuka hamwe nuburyo bworoshye bwa braille yerekana ibidukikije, notetakers mubisanzwe bihenze cyane. Byangiritse byoroshye kandi bigomba gusubizwa mugihugu bakomokamo kugirango bisukure buri gihe.

Muri 2011, David S. Morgan yakoze imashini ya mbere ya SMART Brailler, yongeweho inyandiko kumikorere yo kuvuga kandi yemerera gufata imibare yamakuru yinjiye.
Mu 1960, Robert Mann, umwarimu muri MIT, yanditse DOTSYS, porogaramu yemerera guhinduranya mu buryo bwikora, kandi irindi tsinda ryakoze igikoresho cyo gushushanya cyitwa "MIT Braillemboss." Ibisobanuro birambuye.
Urufatiro rwerekana impapuro zisubirwamo akenshi zihuza clavier nziza. Bisa na Perkins Brailler, iyinjizwa rikorwa namaseti abiri yimfunguzo enye kuruhande, mugihe ibisohoka binyuze mumyandikire ya braille igarurwa igizwe ya selile-mashini, buri kimwe gishobora kuzamura cyangwa kumanura guhuza umunani uruziga. Izindi variants zirahari zikoresha clavier isanzwe yo kwinjiza na pine ya braille kugirango isohore, kimwe ninjiza-gusa nibikoresho bisohoka gusa.
Uburyo buzamura utudomo bukoresha za kristu zimwe, aho zaguka iyo voltage ikoreshwa kuri bo. Nka kristu ihujwe na lever, nayo izamura akadomo. Hagomba kubaho kristu kuri buri kadomo kerekana ("ni ukuvuga" umunani kuri buri nyuguti).
Kuberako bigoye kubyara ibyerekanwa byizewe bizahangana no kwambara burimunsi, ibi byerekanwe bihenze. Mubisanzwe, cells 40 cyangwa 80 gusa. Moderi ifite selile ziri hagati ya 18 na 40 zibaho mubikoresho bimwe byandika.
Kuri moderi zimwe imyanya ya igaragazwa no kunyeganyeza utudomo, kandi moderi zimwe zifite icyerekezo gifitanye isano na buri selile kugirango yimure indanga kuri selile.
Porogaramu ikusanya ibiri muri ecran kuva muri, ikayihindura inyuguti za braille ikohereza kuri disikuru.
Abasomyi ba ecran kuri sisitemu y'imikorere ishushanya cyane cyane, kubera ko ibishushanyo nka Windows cyangwa slidebars bigomba gusobanurwa no gusobanurwa muburyo bw'inyandiko. Sisitemu y'imikorere igezweho isanzwe ifite ifasha abasomyi ba ecran kubona aya makuru, nka (UIA) kuri, kuri na, na kuri.
Braille y'uruziga yerekana.
Icyerekezo kizunguruka cya Braille cyerekanwe mu 2000 n'Ikigo (NIST) n'indi muri mu Bubiligi. Muri ibi bice, utudomo twa braille dushyirwa kumpera, ituma uyikoresha asoma ubudahwema urutoki ruhagaze mugihe uruziga ruzunguruka kumuvuduko watoranijwe. Utudomo twa braille dushyizweho muburyo bworoshye bwo gusikana-uburyo utudomo ku ruziga ruzunguruka inyuma ya ihagaze ishyiraho inyuguti. Nkigisubizo, inganda zikora ziragabanuka cyane kandi zizunguruka-zizunguruka za braille zerekana, mugihe mubikorwa nyirizina, bigomba kuba bihenze kuruta ibyerekanwa bisanzwe.

Braille Note ni mudasobwa yakozwe na HumanWare kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Ifite cyangwa Mwandikisho, hamwe na 32- cyangwa 18-inkingi 18 ishobora kuvugururwa Braille, bitewe nurugero. "IjwiNote" nigikoresho kimwe kiterekanwa na braille. GPS ya BrailleNote ni selile 18 cyangwa 32 ya BrailleNote ifite module yo hanze ya GPS.
BrailleNote irashobora gukoresha gusa software yatanzwe nuwabikoze, nubwo ibi bishobora kuzamurwa.
Gukoresha BrailleNote birasabwa na Centre ishinzwe ubufasha bwikoranabuhanga kandi rimwe na rimwe igurwa na kaminuza kugirango ikoreshwe nabanyeshuri bamugaye. Ibicuruzwa bya BrailleNote byatangijwe mu 2000, bifatwa nkubwa mbere.

Gukora kuri BrailleNote.
Hano hari moderi ebyiri za BrailleNote Touch, ubwayo niyo moderi nshya mumurongo wa BrailleNote. Umwimerere, BrailleNote Touch, yasohotse mu mpeshyi ya 2016. Inyandiko yakurikiyeho, BrailleNote Touch Plus, niyo isimbuye cyane, siporo yibuka byinshi ndetse no kunoza ibintu bitandukanye muburyo bwa tekiniki. Bitandukanye na verisiyo yambere ya BrailleNote, ubu buryo bubiri bushigikira "gukoraho braille", sisitemu ishobora gukoreshwa muguhindura imyanya yintoki kuri ecran yo gukoraho, hanyuma ukandika braille mubisanzwe. Ifite kandi clavier ya clavier ishobora kwomekwa kumurongo wambere-winjiza. Irindi tandukaniro rikomeye hagati ya BrailleNote Touch na Touch Plus hamwe na verisiyo zabanjirije iyi ni uko Touch na Touch Plus ikora android, mu gihe verisiyo zabanje zikoresha Windows CE. KeySoft yongeye gusubirwamo kandi ikora nka serivisi igerwaho munsi ya android, ariko irashobora kuzimya no gukora kuri BrailleNote nkaho ari tablet ikoresha Android, haba ukanze inshuro eshatu kanda buto yo murugo cyangwa ufashe hasi urufunguzo rwijwi. ukurikije icyitegererezo. BrailleNote Touch na Touch Plus nayo irimo Umusomyi wa KNFB kubuntu hamwe no kugura. Kamera irimo ikoreshwa muburyo bwo kumenya imiterere ya optique, itanga gusoma byoroshye inyandiko zanditse nabafite ubuhumyi bukabije.

Umukino w’abamugaye w'amagare nimwe muburyo bwa tenisi bwahujwe n’abakoresha igare ry’abamugaye. Ubunini bw'ikibuga, uburebure bwa net na racketi birasa, ariko hariho itandukaniro i rikomeye na tennis y'abanyamaguru: abakinnyi bakoresha intebe y'abamugaye yabugenewe, kandi umupira ushobora guhagarara inshuro zigera kuri ebyiri, aho guterana kwa kabiri nabyo bishobora kugaragara hanze y'ikibuga.
Umukino w'amagare w'abamugaye wiyongereye kwamamara muri 1976 bitewe n'imbaraga za Brad Parks, ufatwa nk'uwashizeho umukino wa Tenisi w’abaamugaye. Muri 1982, Ubufaransa bwabaye igihugu cya mbere mu Burayi cyashyizeho gahunda ya tenis y’abamugaye. Kuva icyo gihe, hashyizweho ingufu nyinshi mu guteza imbere siporo kurwego rwindobanure.
Bane nka Grand Slams - Australian Open, Wimbledon, Roland Garros, na US Gufungura harimo umukino wa tenisi w'abamugaye. Kugeza muri 2018, US Gufungura na Australiya Gufungura gusa ni kimwe cya kane. Abakinnyi bane ba Quad bonyine nibo batumiwe (bitandukanye n'umunani ku bagabo n'abagore). Muri 2018, umukino wa Quad Wheelchair Doubles Exhibition yakiniwe i Wimbledoni. Nyuma y'uwo mwaka, hatangajwe ko Wimbledoni izatanga inshuro enye mu buseribateri ndetse no mu nshuro ebyiri, guhera muri 2019. Mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare 2019, Roland Garros yatangaje ko muri uwo mwaka, amarushanwa yayo azatangira harimo n'amakipi y’abamugaye.

Tactile nigikoresho nyacyo cyo guhindura inyandiko-kuri- ubu irimo gutezwa imbere mu. Yatekerejwe nitsinda ryabanyeshuri barangije icyiciro cya mbere, bahatana nka "Team 100% Enthusiasm", mugihe cyamasaha 15 MIT "hackathon". Igikoresho kiranyerera hejuru yinyandiko yanditse kandi kamera ifata amashusho yamagambo ikayohereza kuri microcontroller. Amakuru yimura pin hejuru no hepfo, ahindura inyandiko muri Braille. Iyo bigeze ku isoko twizeye ko bihendutse cyane kuruta ibikoresho bihari.
Itsinda ry’iterambere ry’abantu batandatu rigizwe na Chandani Doshi, Grace Li, Jialin Shi, Bonnie Wang, Charlene Xia, na Tania Yu, abanyeshuri bose biga muri MIT igihe Tactile yasama. Ubufatanye bufatika mu, hamwe, Tactile yakunzwe cyane n’itangazamakuru kubera umuvuduko wihuse w’iterambere, ndetse n’abayihimbye bose bakaba ari abagore bo mu bice bafite umubare muto w’abagore bahagarariye.
Tactile itanga ibisobanuro byumwandiko wicyongereza, byafashwe na kamera ihuriweho, muri braille ihindagurika kuburyo. Igicuruzwa cyanyuma nukwerekana inyuguti 36 za braille icyarimwe kuri Imigaragarire [note 1] hamwe nigiciro cyagenewe kugurishwa hafi US $ 100. Hamwe nibikoresho bisanzwe byerekana braille bigurwa hagati y $ 1.500 kugeza $ 2,500, Tactile yaranzwe nk "" kwaduka kwaduka imbere kumpumyi. "
Itsinda rya Tactile ryahawe inkunga y'amadorari 10,000 $ muri MIT IDEAS Global Challenge kandi yemerwa muri Porogaramu ya Microsoft Patent, ahabwa inkunga n'abajyanama mu by'amategeko baturutse muri kugira ngo basabe kurinda patenti muri Amerika. Gusaba kwatanzwe ku ya 16 Nzeri 2016, kuri ubu bikaba bifite.

imikino ya Tenisi ni uburyo bwo gutondekanya tennis y'abamugaye igenewe kuzana umukino mwiza urimo guhangana hagati yabo bose. Ibyiciro bigenzurwa na komite mpuzamahanga y'abamugaye (IPC) kandi bigakorwa na federasiyo mpuzamahanga ya tenisi (ITF).
Ibyiciro bya tenisi by'abamugaye mu mikino Paralympike niyo shingiro ryo kumenya abashobora kwitabira siporo, no mu byiciro. niyo Ikoreshwa mugushiraho amarushanwa akwiye. Kwinjira ni ubuntu kubakinnyi ba bagabo n'abagore bafite ubumuga bw'umubiri bubabuza guhatana neza n'abakinnyi babishoboye.
Imiyoborere yiyi siporo igenzurwa na komite mpuzamahanga y'abamugaye (IPC) kandi ifatanya na federasiyo mpuzamahanga ya tennis (ITF) niyo ikora amategeko n'amabwiriza buri mwaka. Iyi Siporo niyo ya mbere yagize ishyirahamwe ry'abakozi rishobora gukora ibyiciro bitandukanye mugihe ITF yatangiraga kuyobora siporo muri 1998.
Mu mikino y'abamugaye.
Umukino wa Tenisi imikino y'abamugaye yakinwe bwa mbere muri Paralympikee muri 1992. Mu mikino Paralympike yo muri 1992, ubwoko bw’abafite ubumuga bw’abamugaye bari bemerewe kwitabira, ibyiciro bigakorwa binyuze mu by'iciro byigenga. Amarushanwa mu mikino Paralympike ya 2012 azabera kuri Eton Manor (Parike ya Olempike), kuva ku ya 1 Nzeri kugeza 8 Nzeri. Biteganijwe ko abagabo bari hagati ya 64 na 80 n'abagore 32 kugeza 48 bazahatanira imidari itandatu. Umubare ntarengwa w'abanywanyi ku gihugu cyemewe ni ibi bikurikira:
Urwego rukuru rw’imikino y’abamugaye, Komite mpuzamahanga y’abamugaye, gukora ibishoboka ngo rutezimbere ibyiciro byose kugira ngo bibe uburyo bushingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye na sisitemu ishingiye ku mikorere kugira ngo idahana abakinnyi b’indashyikirwa imikorere yabo ituma bagaragara muri a urwego rwo hejuru hamwe na banywanyi bitoza bike.

the Free Wheelchair Mission ni umuryango mpuzamahanga ushingiye wo kwizerwa udaharanira inyungu, ni umuryango utabara imbabare utanga amagare y’ibimugaye ku bafite ubumuga mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere badafite amikoro yo kubona narimwe, uyu Umuryango wita k’ubuzima ku isi ugereranya ko ufute abanyamuryango barenga miliyoni 70.
Uyu w'ahaye abantu barenga miliyoni 1.3 amagare y’abmugaye ku bantu bakeneye ubufasha mu bihugu birenga 94.
Icyicaro gikuru kiri Irvine, muri Californiya, uyu muryango washinzwe na Dr. Don Schoendorfer, ufite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga ya PhD muri buhanga bw’ibinyabuzima yakuye muri MIT kandi afite patenti zirenga 60.. Mu mwaka wa 2008, Schoendorfer yahawe umusivile umudari w'icyubahiro na Jenerali Colin Powell wahoze mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu birori byabereye ku irimbi rya Arlington..
Igitabo "Cyibitangaza" Igitabo.
Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2022, Fondateri ariwe, Dr. Don Schoendorfer yasohoye igitabo yise "Miracle Wheels: Inkuru y’ubutumwa bwo kuzana ingendo ku isi." Muri yo, Schoendorfer asangiza inkuru yitwa "amagare y'ibitangaza" yahinduye ubuzima bw'abantu barenga miliyoni 1.3 babana n'ubumugaye mu bihugu 94 bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere.
Muri Kanama 2019, uyu muryango wagaragajwe na Harry na Meghan, Duke na Duchess wa Sussex, ku mbuga zabo za Instagram hamwe n'indi miryango irimo umuyoboro w'isi ndetse na BlinkNow Foundation.

GlobalVision nisosiyete ikora software ya kabuhariwe mu gupakira no kuranga.
GlobalVision Inc. (GlobalVision) yashinzwe na Reuben Malz mu 1990. Ifite icyicaro i, muri Kanada, kandi ifite ibiro by'akarere mu Bwongereza no mu Budage.
Muri 2013, yagiranye amasezerano na GlobalVision yo gupakira ibicuruzwa byiza.
GlobalVision yerekanye urubuga rwayo rwa mbere rushingiye ku kugenzura ubuziranenge mu 2013. Ibyo byakurikiwe no gushyiraho verisiyo igezweho ya platform, Proofware, muri 2014.
Muri 2017, GlobalVision yasohoye urubuga rwo kugenzura ubuziranenge bwa desktop.
Muri 2018, GlobalVision yafatanije na na gutangiza gahunda ya mbere yo kugenzura amabara ya digitale ku isi yo gucapa no gupakira.

Hope Haven International ni umuryango w’abatabazi wa 501 (c) (3) ufite icyicaro i Rock Valley, muri Iowa, uzwi cyane muri Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika nko gukwirakwiza amagare y’abamugaye byavuguruwe ku bantu bakuru n’abana. Uyu muryango washinzwe muri 1964 nk’urukundo rwa gikirisitu kugira ngo utange serivisi ku bamugaye aho batuye. Byiringiro Haven ikusanya, igasana, ikanagabanya amagare y’abamugaye imbere mu gihugu ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga, usibye gutanga imyitozo ngororamubiri n’imyuga. Uyu muryango wishingikirije ku bakorerabushake n'abagororwa bafunzwe mu gutwara no kuvugurura amagare y'abamugaye.
Byiringiro Haven yagiye ivugurura, kandi itanga ibyoherezwa hamwe n’abakozi bahuguwe kugira ngo bafashe intebe z’abamugaye, ku bana b’impunzi z’umubiri n’abakene b’Abanyapalestine kuva muri 1998, babifashijwemo na politiki n’ibikoresho by’ikigega cy’abatabazi cya Palesitine. Ibiciro by'abamugaye birenze ubushobozi bw'imiryango myinshi, kandi amafaranga ya leta nayo ntaboneka, mu bihugu byinshi, nka Rumaniya, akoreshwa na Hope Haven hamwe n'impano z'abamugaye n'abakozi kugira ngo abamugaye babone neza.

Mobility Worldwide ni umuryango ushingiye ku kwizera, abakorerabushake ba 501 (c) (3) umuryango udaharanira inyungu.
PET ni amagambo ahinnye y'umuryango w"utwara abantu ku giti cyabo", imodoka itsinda ryubaka kandi rigakwirakwiza nta kiguzi cyo gutanga impano yo kugenda kubana bamugaye ndetse nabakuze kwisi yose. PET International, Inc. yatangiye gukora ubucuruzi nka Mobility Worldwide muri Kanama 2016, batangira gukoresha izina rya Mobility Cart kuri iyo modoka. Kuva muri 1994, amakarita arenga 80.000 ya Mobility yubatswe kandi agakwirakwizwa n'abafatanyabikorwa barenga 70.
PET yakuze mu rugendo rwo muri 1994 n’umumisiyonari w’Abametodisite Reverend Larry Hills yerekeza i Zayirecongo, aho yamenyeye bwa mbere ko iki gikoresho gikenewe igihe yahuraga n’abacitse ku icumu rya polio na mines badashobora kugenda ariko badashobora gukoresha intebe z’abamugaye aho batuye mu cyaro. Hills n'umugore we Laura bavuganye na Reverend Mel West ku ntebe y’abamugaye yahinduwe ishobora gukorera, ifatishijwe intoki n'inziga eshatu. Muri 1995, Uburengerazuba bwagize uruhare mu gukora ibicuruzwa Earl Miner mu gukora prototype yubatswe hagamijwe kunangira, ubworoherane no gukora neza. Muri 1996, enye zashyizwe mu kizamini muri congo. Ukurikije imikorere yabo, PET yagiye mubikorwa kandi yoherezwa gukwirakwizwa muri congo.
Umwaka ukurikira, umusaruro wa PET watangiye kwaguka mu bindi bihugu, guhera kuri Mozambike. Muri 2000, kugira ngo ibyifuzo byiyongera, Uburengerazuba bwafunguye ikigo muri Columbiya, Misuri, muri Amerika, gikora kwakira ibice byatanzwe, guteranya PET no kubyohereza ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ikigo cya kabiri cyo muri Amerika cyafunguwe muri Penney Farms, muri Floride (hafi ya Jacksonville, Foloride), na Hills muri uwo mwaka. Muri 2003, ikigo cya gatatu cyashinzwe i Luling, muri Texas muri amerika.
Muri 2004, kugirango bafashe gucunga iterambere n’umusaruro wa PET, Pet International yashizwemo, hamwe n'inama y’abashinzwe abakozi n’abakozi kugira ngo bafashe gucunga ibibazo byose bijyanye no guteranya no gukwirakwiza PET. Igiciro cyibigize PET ni amadolare 300.
Amagare ya PET yoherejwe muri Afuganisitani, Afuganisitani, Arijantine, Arumeniya, Angola, Bahamas, Bangladesh, Belize, Benin, Boliviya, Bosiniya, Botswana, Brasil, Buligariya, Burkina Faso, u Burundi, Kamboje, Kameruni, Tchad, Ubushinwa, Kolombiya, Kosta Rica, Cuba, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya São Tomé na Príncipe, Djibouti, Repubulika ya Dominikani, Ecuador, El Salvador, Eritereya, Etiyopiya, Fiji, Gabon, Gambiya, Gaza, Jeworujiya, Gana, Guatemala, Gineya, Gineya-Bisawu. Mozambike, Miyanimari, Namibiya, Nepali, Nikaragwa, Niger, Nijeriya, Koreya y'Amajyaruguru, Pakisitani, Panama, Papuwasiye Nouvelle Gune, Paragwaya, Peru, Filipine, Repubulika ya Kongo, Rumaniya, Uburusiya, u Rwanda, Samowa, Senegali, Siyera Lewone, Somaliya, Sri Lanka, Repubulika ya Sudani y'Amajyepfo, Suwazilanda, Siriya, Tajikistan, Tanzaniya, Tayilande, Togo, Tonga, Tirinidada, Turukiya, Uzubekisitani, Uganda, Ukerene, Uruguya, Vanuatu, Viyetinami, Banki y'Iburengerazuba, Sahara y'Uburengerazuba, Zambiya, na Zimbabwe.
