Spinal Cord Injuries Australia (SCIA) ni umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta utanga ubuvugizi na serivisi ku bantu bafite ibikomere by'umugongo (parapelegiya, qadiripelegiya) n'ibindi bisa.
SCIA yashinzwe muri 1967 nk'ishyirahamwe rya Quadripelegike rya Ositaraliya n'itsinda ry'abarwayi bo mu bitaro bya Prince Henry i Sydney, Ositaraliya. Ntibashoboye kuva mu bitaro kubera ko nta macumbi cyangwa serivisi byabateraga inkunga mu baturage. AQA yahinduye izina muri 2003.
Mu itegeko nshinga rya SCIA byibuze 50% by'inama y'ubuyobozi igomba kugira imvune y'umugongo cyangwa imiterere isa.
Abanyamuryango bashinze ni Trevor Annetts, Tom Clarke, Graeme Dunne, David Fox, Peter Harris, George Mamo, Jim McGrath, Robert McKenzie, Alan Moore, John Munday, Cecil Murr, Brian Shirt, Paul Sorgo, Stan Wanless, na Warren Mowbray. David Fox niwe wabaye perezida wa mbere. Bashishikarijwe gushinga umuryango n’umukozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage Gary Garrison, ushyigikiwe na Dr George Burniston.
Serivisi zitangwa na SCIA uyu munsi n'amakuru, ubuvugizi, amacumbi aboneka, Guhuza gahunda ya NDIS no guhuza ibikorwa, akazi, urungano nimiryango ifasha hamwe na NeuroMoves serivise idasanzwe, yuzuye, ishingiye kubimenyetso hamwe n'ubuvuzi k'ubantu ba bana n'uburwayi bw'imitsi cyangwa ubumuga bwu mubiri.
Itsinda ry’abakiriya ba SCIA ryitaba telefoni zirenga 850 ku mwaka ziva mu Banyaustraliya ba mugaye n’imiryango yabo, kandi rikomeza isomero ry’abamugaye ku biro bya SCIA i Sydney, muri Leta ya New South Wales. Isomero ry'ibitabo bya SCIA ku murongo ritanga ibikoresho bitandukanye ku bantu bafite ibikomere byu mugongo n'imiryango yabo, bikubiyemo ingingo n'ibisobanuro birambuye byu buvuzi, ubufasha na serivisi zu bujyanama. Itsinda rya makuru yo mukarere kandi ritanga ubufasha ninama kugiti cya bantu bafite ikibazo cyu mugongo mugace ka NSW.

Wheelchair Foundation (WF) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu wa shinzwe muri Kamena 2000 n’umushinga w’imitungo utimukanwa Ken Behring, ukaba ufite icyicaro i Danville, muri Californiya. Fondasiyo ifatanya n’abaterankunga (abantu ku giti cyabo, amatsinda n’amasosiyete) gutanga amagare y’abamugaye k'ubantu bakeneye ariko badashobora kubigura, cyane mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Kugeza muri Nzeri 2008, umuyoboro wa WF umaze kugeza ibihugu birenga 750.000 by’abamugaye.
Fondasiyo ifatanya n'imiryango itandukanye ya serivise, harimo Rotary Clubs, Knight of Columbus na Sister City International.
Inama mpuzamahanga y’abajyanama ya WF irimo abatari bake ndetse n’abahoze ari abakuru b’ibihugu n’ibyamamare, barimo abayobozi bafatanije Juan Carlos na Sophia wo muri Esipayne, ndetse na Mikhail Gorbachev na Nelson Mandela.
Imiryango yigenga igizwe n'intebe y'abamugaye ni Fondasiyo Yabamugaye yo muri Kanada na Fondasiyo y'abamugaye UK. WF Australiya nayo yabayeho nk'ikigo cy'igenga kugeza muri 2008 ariko ubu ni umushinga wa Rotary Club ya Gosford West (NSW).
Behring yagize icyo avuga ku kamaro k'imiryango y'itegamiye kuri Leta mu igabana ry'abamugaye:
Imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta ni ingenzi muri buri gihugu. Ndatekereza ko ubu dukorana n'imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta. Igihe twari muri Afuganisitani, twakoresheje abantu bamwe bo mu muryango w'abafite ubumuga, kandi ingabo z'Amerika nazo zaradufashaga. Buri gihe dutanga intebe nke mu Bushinwa, zikorana n’ishyirahamwe ry’abafite ubumuga. Muri Amerika yo Hagati, urugero, dukorana n’abadamu ba mbere. Abagore ba perezida ubusanzwe bafite umusingi kandi bafite aho bahurira n’ibitaro byita ku buzima busanzwe. Babaye rero cyane, cyane ifasha muri Amerika yo Hagati no mu majyepfo mu rwego rwo kudufasha kubona abahawe intebe zibereye.

World Braille Day umunsi international day ukaba uba taliki ya 4 Mutarama awareness gukangurira abantu kumenya ururimi rwa braille mu buryo rw'itumanaho bigamije kubahiriza uburenganzira bwa muntu visually impaired people. bwanagite ubumuga bwo kutabona United Nations General Assembly itariki y'uyu munsi yatoranijwe ni inteko rusange n'inteko rusange y'umuryango w'abibumbye mu itangazo ryasohotse mu gushyingo 2018,kandi ihurirana nisabukuru ya Louis Braille,Wavumbuye ubu buryo bwo kwandika.
Umunsi wa mbere w’isi ya Braille wizihijwe ku ya 4 Mutarama 2019.

Bertha Gyndykes Dkhar n'umwarimu wigisha wo mubuhinde ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona, uzwi cyane nkuwahimbye muri. Mu mwaka wa 2010, Guverinoma y'Ubuhinde yamuhaye, igihembo cya kane cy’abasivili mu Buhinde.
Bertha Gyndykes Dkhar yavukiye i Shillong, muri Meghalaya nk'umwana ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona ufite, indwara itera kwangirika kwa retina, maze atabona neza igihe yari muri kaminuza kubera ko yagombaga kureka kwiga.. Nta buryo bwo kwibeshaho, yagurishije imbuto ku isoko kugirango abeho. Mu gukomeza imbaraga zo gutsinda ubumuga, Dkhar yakoze ubushakashatsi muri code ya Braille maze ategura kode muri, ururimi rwaho muri Meghalaya.
Bertha Dkhar ni umuyobozi "w'ishuri rya Jyoti Sroat", ishuri riyobowe na Bethany Society kubana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Yabonye igihembo cya kane cy’abasivili mu Buhinde cya, ubwo yagaragaraga ku rutonde rw’icyubahiro rw’umunsi wa Repubulika y’Ubuhinde mu 2010. Yahawe kandi igihembo cy'igihugu gishinzwe imibereho myiza y'abana na Guverinoma y'Ubuhinde mu 2000.

Kunwar Singh Negi (1927 - 20 Werurwe 2014) yari umwanditsi w'ikinyamakuru cyo mu Buhinde akaba n'umukozi ushinzwe. Yahinduye ibitabo 300 muri braille. Ibikorwa bye bikomeye birimo Bhagwan Buddh Ka Updesh na Hazrat Mohammed Ki Vani, byombi bijyanye n'inyigisho za Gautam Buddha na Muhammad. Yahawe ibihembo by'abasivili b'Abahinde Padma Shri mu 1981 nyuma aza guhabwa Bhushan mu 1990.
Negi yavukiye i Pauri, umujyi ubu uri mu majyaruguru y’Ubuhinde bwa Uttarakhand mu 1927. Yarwanye muri Birmaniya mu rwego rw'ingabo z'Ubuhinde mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Yashimiye abapolisi b'Abongereza kuba baramushizemo impuhwe na disipulini. Mu 1954, nyuma y’Ubuhinde bwigenga ku butegetsi bw’Abongereza, yinjiye mu kigo cy’igihugu cy’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona i Dehradun aho yatangiye gushishikarira braille. Negi yatangiye kwandukura ibitabo mu ndimi zitandukanye z'Ubuhinde nka Punjabi, Bengali, Urdu, Gujarati, Oriya, Marathi ndetse no mu Burusiya. Yakoze ku bitabo 300 birimo ibyanditswe bya Sikh nka Sukhmani Sahib hamwe n’ibitabo byanditswe na Gautam Buddha na Muhammad.
Negi kandi yagize uruhare mu mibereho myiza y’abatabona kandi yifatanyaga na Bharat Netrahin Samaj muri Punjab ndetse n’ishyirahamwe ry’abatabona i Delhi. Ibikorwa bye bitandukanye by’amadini byatanzwe ku buntu binyuze mu butumwa mpuzamahanga bwa Maharaja Ranjit Singh ku buvanganzo bwa Gurbani Braille. Yahinduye kandi igitabo cy’umunyapolitiki Surjit Singh Barnala cyitwa My Other Abakobwa Babiri.
Negi yahawe igihembo na Padma Shri, igihembo cya kane cy’abasivili mu Buhinde mu 1981 kubera ibikorwa bye. Mu 1990, yashyikirijwe Padma Bhushan, igihembo cya gatatu mu bihembo byinshi kubera uruhare yagize mu bijyanye n'ubuvanganzo n'uburezi. Yashyikirijwe kandi igihembo cya Sikh Gaurav na komite ya Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak.
Mu 2003, Negi yabazwe glande ya prostate n'amafaranga yakiriwe na guverinoma y'icyo gihe ya Uttarakhand iyobowe na N. D. Tiwari nka Minisitiri w’intebe. Mu mwaka wa 2009, Negi yagaragaje ibibazo afite mu bijyanye n'amafaranga mu bitangazamakuru igihe adashobora kwigurira umutima utera indwara z'umutima kandi akaba nta leta yahawe. Yari yaravuwe bituzuye kubera kubura amafaranga mu bitaro bya GB Pant i New Delhi. Yapfuye ku ya 20 Werurwe 2014 i Dehradun.

Thakur Vishva Narain Singh (30 Nyakanga 1928 - 29 Nzeri 2009) ni we mwanditsi wa mbere z’Ubuhinde akaba n’umunyamakuru uzwi. Yabaye umwanditsi mukuru wa braille mu gice cyo gutangaza Ikigo cy’igihugu cy’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona i. Nyuma yizabukuru, yakomeje kwandika no gukorana n’ibinyamakuru byaho mu mujyi.
Singh yari umwubatsi mukuru inyuma yo gushiraho isomero rinini kubafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Yari ashinzwe kubona ibitabo by'idini by'Abahindu bihindurwa mu nyandiko.
Thakur Vishva Narain Singh yapfiriye i Amsterdam ubwo yari mu biruhuko by'umuryango ku ya 29 Nzeri 2009.

Harris Mowbray (/ˈhæ.ɹɪs ˈmoʊ.breɪ /; yavutse 1999) ni umuhanga mu by'indimi akaba na programu ukomoka muri Amerika. Azwiho gushyiraho ibyifuzo byinshi byo guhuza indimi nke ku isi muri.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Harris yavukiye mu mujyi wa New York kwa Michele Madansky, umujyanama w’ubushakashatsi mu kwamamaza, icyo gihe akaba yarabaye umuyobozi mukuru kuri Yahoo na Travis Mowbray, umuyobozi w’ibizamini by’amavuriro. Yakuriye mu kibaya cya Silicon. Sekuru ubyara yari umunyamibare Albert Madansky. Akomoka muri Ashkenazi akomoka mu Bayahudi.
Harris yatangiye gukora Braille kururimi rwa Gagauz nururimi rwa Sorbian. Yagaragaye cyane mu binyamakuru byo muri Polonye kubera icyifuzo cye cya Kashubian Braille. Ibyifuzo bye byanditse mu nyuguti z'impumyi byemewe ku rurimi rwa Livoniya, ururimi rwa Fulani, n'ururimi rwa Lakota. Yakoze kandi inyuguti y'intoki (inyuguti y'ururimi rw'amarenga) ku rurimi rwa Fulani, ashingiye ku nyandiko ya Adlam. Muri Werurwe 2021, Harris Mowbray yateguye icyifuzo cya Braille ku ndimi ebyiri zemewe zo mu birwa bya Amerika y'Amajyaruguru ya Mariana, Chamorro na Caroliniya Hagati ya 2021, umuryango wa Udi wo muri Azaribayijan wemeye icyifuzo cye cyo kuba Braille mu rurimi rwabo. Mowbray yanafashaga kubara Braille ya Jeworujiya.
Mu mpera za 2021, Harris yateje imbere Braille ku rurimi rw’ibihugu bya mbere Smalgyax ivugwa mu majyaruguru ya Columbiya y’Ubwongereza, ururimi rwa Elfdaliya, n’ururimi rwa Rusyn.
Mu ntangiriro za 2022, Harris yari yarafatanyije na Kongere y’abatutsi ku isi gukora braille y’ururimi rw’igitutu abifashijwemo n’abandi bashakashatsi. Yakoranye kandi n’umuryango uvuga Khoekhoegowab wo muri Namibiya kugira ngo bateze imbere Braille ku mvugo y’ururimi rwabo.
Harris yakoranye neza n’umuryango uvuga ururimi rw’Abasamogite bo muri Lituwaniya mu rwego rwo gushyiraho urwego rwerekana ururimi rwabo mu mpera za 2022. Mu 2023 yakoranye n’Abatutsi ba Crimée muri Ukraine guteza imbere Braille ku nyuguti zabo z'ikilatini.

wheelchair tennis ni umukino wa Tenisi yabigenewe bwa mbere mu mikino Paralympike ya siporo nk'imikino yo kwerekana muri 1988, hakaba harabaye ibirori bibiri (abaseribateri n’abagore). Yabaye siporo itanga imidari kumugaragaro muri 1992 kandi yagiye yitabira imikino Paralympike yose kuva icyo gihe. Ibirori bine byakozwe kuva 1992 kugeza 2000, hiyongereyeho ibintu bine (uburinganire buvanze) mu buryo bumwe no gukuba kabiri muri 2004.
Ibirori bigera kuri bitandatu birahatanwa kuri buri Paralympike. Gusa abagabo n'abagore bonyine babereye mu mikino ya Paralympike yo muri 1988, ubwo yari siporo yo kwerekana. Ibi byahujwe n’ibihe bibiri by’abagabo n’abagore nyuma y'imyaka ine ubwo siporo yahinduraga ibirori. Muri 2004, ibintu bibiri bishya byongeweho hamwe na quadriplegiya (nkibyo bizwi kandi nka ibyabaye) kandi bitandukanye nibindi bintu bavanze. Ariko kugeza mu mikino ya 2020, abagore babiri gusa ni bo bitabiriye ibyo birori, Umuholandi witwa Monique de Beer n'Umunyakanada Sarah Hunter, bombi barushanwe muri 2004 na 2008. Nyamara, Abadage baracyari abagore bonyine begukanye umudari muri Paralympike, umuringa mu marushanwa ya kabiri mu 2004.

Vinux yari ikwirakwizwa rya Linux ryakozwe muburyo bwihariye kubakoreshwa na abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, impumyi kandi batabona igice. [​​ Sisitemu kandi yashyigikiye USB Braille yerekana.
Vinux yabanje gutunganywa mu mwaka wa 2008 bikozwe na Tony Sales, Inkunga ya Tekinike muri Royal National College for Blind i Hanoford, mu Bwongereza. Yashyizwe ku rutonde rwa mbere kuri DistroWatch ku ya 1 Kamena 2010 nka Vinux 3.0.
Vinux yemereye abakoresha mudasobwa bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona no kwinjizamo verisiyo ya Ubuntu mu bwigenge. Harimo Orca (umusomyi wa ecran na magnifier), Speakup (umusomyi wa ecran ya console), Compiz (magnifier ishingiye kuri tekinoroji ya 3d), hamwe n'inkunga yo kwerekana Braille. yerekana ikora mu buryo bwikora iyo ihujwe kandi ishyigikira icyiciro cya 1 nicya 2 Braille. handicap mental ni ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (rimwe na rimwe bwitwa kudindira mu mutwe mu mvugo isanzwe) ni indwara rusange igaragara mbere yo gukura, irangwa no kubura no kutamenya neza imikorere byibuze ikora. Ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bwagiye busobanurwa nk'amanota y'ubwenge (IQ) amanota 70. Hafi ya byose bishingiye ku kumenya, ubusobanuro burimo imikorere y'imitekerereze y'umuntu nu bushobozi bw'imikorere ijyanye nibidukikije. Uyu munsi rero, umuntu ntashobora gufatwa nkufite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe gusa kubera ko afite igipimo cy'ubwenge kiri munsi ya 70.
Ishami ry'umuryango w'abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS), mu rwego mpuzamahanga rw’indwara (en) ICD-10), risobanura ko ubumuga "" ari yataye muri yombi iterambere ryo mu mutwe cyangwa iterambere ryo mu mutwe rituzuye, ryaranzwe no kudahagije kw'amashami n'urwego rusange rw'ubwenge, cyane mu bijyanye n'imikorere yo kumenya, ururimi, ubumenyi bwa moteri n'imikorere myiza .
Imvururu zijyanye n'ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (ID).
Izindi mvururu nyinshi n'ibibazo by'ubuzima birashobora kuba bifitanye isano nindangamuntu; neurodevelopmentali, psycho patologike by'umwihariko. Inshuro zibi by'iyongera hamwe nuburemere bw'indangamuntu kandi biratandukana ukurikije etiologiya y'indangamuntu: syndromes zimwe zirangwa nibibazo byihariye byubuvuzi, bisaba gukurikirana ubuvuzi buhagije.
Ibimenyetso n'ibimenyetso.
Ibimenyetso n'ibimenyetso byose biri ku rwego rw'imyitwarire. Umubare munini wa bantu bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe ntibagaragaza m'uburyo bw'ubwenge bwabo, cyane iyo gutinda guterwa n ibidukikije nk'imirire mibi cyangwa uburozi bwangiza.
Abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bashobora kwiga guhagarara, gukurura, kugenda cyangwa kuvuga, no kurusha abandi bana. Abana ndetse n'abantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bashobora kwerekana byinshi mu bintu bikurikira bikurikira:
Human rights and legal status.
Amategeko afata abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (intellectual disabilities) mu buryo butandukanye n’abatabufite. Uburenganzira bwa muntu n’ubwisanzure bwabo harimo uburenganzira bwo gutora, gukora ubucuruzi, gusinya amasezerano, gushyingirwa, no kubona uburezi akenshi buragabanyirizwa cyangwa bukagenerwa imipaka.
Inkiko zimwe zemeje zimwe muri izo mbogamizi, ariko zanasanze hari izindi ziganisha ku ivangura.
Amasezerano y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku burenganzira bw’abantu bafite ubumuga (UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities) ashyiraho amategeko fatizo agenga uburenganzira bwabo, kandi amaze kwemezwa n’ibihugu birenga 180.
Mu bihugu bimwe byo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ndetse no muri bimwe mu bihugu by’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe babuzwa gutora.
Urukiko rw’Uburayi rw’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu (European Court of Human Rights) mu rubanza Alajos Kiss v. Hungary (2010) rwafashe umwanzuro uvuga ko Hongiriya itemerewe kubuza abantu gutora ishingiye gusa ku kuba barashyizwe mu murage w’ubwishingizi (guardianship) kubera ubumuga bwo mu mitekerereze.

Silvert's Holdings Ltd, ikora nka Silvert's Adaptive Clothing &amp; Footwear, ni umucuruzi wo muri Amerika na Kanada ucuruza kandi akanakwirakwiza y'abagabo n'abagore. Isosiyete ikora ubwoko butandukanye bwimyambarire imenyereye, harimo imyenda y’ibimuga, imyenda yoroshye yo kubona kimwe ninkweto za diyabete, amasogisi n'inkweto, zagenewe gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga bwumubiri mu myambarire yabo ya buri munsi no kwambara.
Mu 1929, ID Ed Alter yashinze Ububiko bw’ishami rya Jack i Ingersoll, Ontario, muri Kanada. Ububiko bwa Jack's Ubusanzwe bwari iduka rito ryumujyi rigurisha ibicuruzwa bitandukanye. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa ID Alter, mu 1978, umwuzukuru we, Jeffrey Alter yinjiye muri icyo kigo. Mu 1980, isosiyete yahinduye izina ayita imyenda ya Silvert ya Seniors maze itangira kuba inzobere mu myambarire imenyereye hamwe na Jeffrey Alter nk'umuyobozi mukuru.
Silvert's yafunguye ibiro byayo, ububiko n’ububiko i Concord, Ontario, muri Kanada. Silvert's yari ifite ububiko bwayo bwa mbere bugendanwa kumuhanda mu 1981 naho mu 1987, hashyirwaho urutonde rwambere rwimyenda ihuza n'imiterere. Silvert yagurishije ibicuruzwa byayo binyuze mubigo byubuzima bwo mu mutwe mbere yo kugurisha abakiriya.
Silvert yatangiye kwagura ibicuruzwa mu gihugu imyaka ibiri kandi itangira kugurisha ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu 1993. Mu 1995, Silvert's yari ifite abakozi 41 b'igihe cyose n'abakozi 15 b'igihe gito. Kuva Silvert imaze kwiyongera mumyaka yashize hamwe na 9.01 kuri 10 ku rutonde rwa ku ya 15 Kamena 2018.
Silvert yaguzwe na Careismatic Brands muri Kanama 2018. Muri Mutarama 2024, Ibicuruzwa bya Careismatic byatanze.
Silvert igurisha imyenda itandukanye yo guhuza n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere kuva ku ipantaro y'abamugaye, ikabutura, hejuru hejuru, imyenda, imyenda ya nijoro, imyenda ya siporo, n'inkweto, hiyongereyeho ibikoresho byihariye bikenerwa. Gufunga Snap, ikibuno cya elastike, gufunga Velcro nibimwe mubiranga Silvert ihuza mugihe cyo gushushanya imyambarire yayo.
Silvert's ikora igishushanyo cyayo muri Kanada ariko imyenda yayo ikorerwa muri Kanada no mubushinwa.
Kuberako imyenda myinshi ya Silvert yambarwa nabantu mubigo byita kumurugo, imyenda ya Silvert ndetse ninyerera zimwe zagenewe gufata abamesa inganda.
Kugurisha no kwamamaza.
Silvert igurisha cyane cyane ibicuruzwa byayo kumurongo no mubitabo isosiyete ikwirakwiza kabiri mumwaka. Urubuga rwa Silvert kumurongo rwemerera uyikoresha guhaha akurikije ubumuga bwihariye nibikenewe.
Silvert ikoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga nka Facebook aho abarezi n'abagize umuryango bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo, ubunararibonye no gusuzuma ibicuruzwa na serivisi bya Silvert. Silvert's nayo ifite amanota-ibihembo sisitemu yashyizweho kubakiriya bayo basanzwe banyuzamo bashobora gucungura amanota yabo.
Amarushanwa yo guhangana.
Muri 2016, Silvert yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Business Business Challenge yatewe inkunga na "The Globe na Mail" na Telus Corp. kandi yari mubantu 50 ba mbere batsindiye icyubahiro.

Handicape International ni umuryango mpuzamahanga utegamiye kuri Leta ukorera mu bihugu bigera kuri mirongo itandatu.
Ni ihuriro rigira uruhare mu bihe by'ubukene no guhezwa, amakimbirane n'ibiza hamwe n'abamugaye ndetse n'abaturage batishoboye kugira ngo:
Umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta washinzwe muri 1982 i Lyon n'abaganga babiri b'Abafaransa, Jean Baptiste Richardier na Claude Simonnot, hamwe n'u mutekinisiye, Yves Gaumeton, babanje gufasha abantu bahungira mu nkambi muri Kamboje na Tayilande, tubikesha amahugurwa yahawe na Pierre na Raymond Jaccard bateje imbere prothèse muri afurika.
Muri 1992, Handicape International yari umwe mu mashyirahamwe atandatu yashinze umuryango mpuzamahanga uharanira gukumira amabuye y'agaciro ya Antipersonnel (ICBL), wahawe igihembo cy’amahoro cyitiriwe Nobel muri 1997.
Ishyirahamwe ryatsindiye igihembo cya Conrad N. muri 2011. Hilton, angana na miliyoni z'amadorale 1.5, kubera ubwitange bwe ku bafite ubumuga baba mu bihe by'ubukene, guhezwa, amakimbirane cyangwa ibiza.
Handicap International ikora ibikorwa bitandukanye byo gukumira ubumuga bugaragara, binyuze mubikorwa byo gukangurira. Ibikorwa byo gukumira bikorwa ku nsanganyamatsiko zitandukanye.
Gukumira impanuka zo mu muhanda.
Iri shyirahamwe rikora ubukangurambaga bwo gukumira no gukumira impanuka zo mu muhanda mu bihugu byinshi hagamijwe gushimangira impinduka mu myitwarire no kugabanya impanuka. Ibi bikorwa akenshi bikorwa kubufatanye ninzego zibanze.

Imyenda ifunze (mu Icyongereza: Locking clothing) ni imyenda ibuza umuntu wambaye imyenda gukuramo imyenda. Urugero rumwe rwaba imyenda yagenewe kubuza umuntu ufite ikibazo cyo guta umutwe kwambara bidakwiye. Rimwe na rimwe, gufunga imyenda bikoreshwa mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, nko ku.
Mubisanzwe, ikorwa niyi macumbi ni imwe isimbuka igaragara. Mubihe byinshi, bikozwe na zifite kimwe cyangwa byinshi bidasanzwe murwego rwo kubikora bitandukanye nimyenda isanzwe, bityo rero kuyikuramo biragoye. Akenshi, byashizweho kugirango bigaragare imbere hamwe n'ibishushanyo mbonera bya kera, nka buto ya faux na paki, amakariso, cyangwa T-shati imeze nk'ibicapo, mugihe inyuma ifite gufunga bigomba gufungura kugirango bakureho imyenda. Ubundi buryo bwo gufunga kuribi bisimbuka harimo zipers zip kuva hejuru kugeza hasi (zitandukanya zipper zisa nizisangwa ku) hanyuma zinjizwa mu mufuka muto uboneka munsi yurwego rwikibuno. Izindi zipper zishobora kuba zitari hagati kugirango zibe ahantu umurwayi atamenyereye kububona.
Rimwe na rimwe, nk'uburyo bw'imyenda idasanzwe, ishobora kubahenze, ibikoresho ku giciro gito birashobora kwomekwa kumyenda isanzwe kugirango birinde umuntu gukuramo imyenda. Nubwo amazina menshi akoreshwa kuri ibyo bintu, rimwe na rimwe bita "mousetraps." Impapuro nyinshi zirahari, zimwe murizo nazo zagenewe kugira imiterere.
"Igifuniko cya buto" nigitambara gikoreshwa hejuru ya buto kugirango kibe kinini cyane kugirango gisubire muri buto. Abarwayi barashobora gukuramo buto, ariko. Utubuto tumwe na tumwe, cyane cyane twometse ku ijosi-urwego rwa buto, byashizweho kugirango bisa nkaho bigezweho.
Guhagarika buto ifata umwenda kumpande zombi za buto hamwe, bityo bigatuma buto ntoya cyane kugirango buto inyure. Mugihe umutekano urenze buto, ariko biragoye cyane kubishyira mubikorwa, kandi ntabwo ufite isura nkiyi.
Inzitizi ya zipper ibuza zipper kunyerera munsi yacyo. Imiterere imwe nugufunga umutekano pin aho igice cyicyuma gihagaze gusa hejuru yumutwe, bityo bikabuza kugenda kumuyoboro wa zipper muricyo cyerekezo. Ubundi buryo, budoda ku mwenda, burimo ibice bibiri byuma bifatanyiriza hamwe, kandi bikabuza kugenda kwa zipper. Izindi verisiyo zarafashwe zifata gukurura kuri zipper mu mwanya. Mu bigo bimwe na bimwe byita ku buzima, arakoreshwa aho kugura ibikoresho byihariye.
"Igikoresho gisanzwe ni impeta y'ibibero", ikingira amaguru munsi. Ibi bituma ikururwa kure bihagije kugirango, ariko ikabuza kuvanwaho, kandi ntibigabanya ihumure.
Hashyizweho umukandara udasanzwe ufata ishati n'ipantaro hamwe. Ibi birinda abarwayi gukuramo ishati cyangwa gukuramo ipantaro.

Ubumuga butagaragara ni ubumuga butagaragara, ku muntu ku giti cye, bingana no kugira imbogamizi zirambye mu bishoboka by'imikoranire hatabayeho abo hafi yabo badashobora kumva byoroshye ko mu by'ukuri ari ubumuga. Niba kutagaragara bifitanye isano no kumva ubumuga bwe bwite, ni anosognosiya.
Kugaragara k'Ubumuga.
Nigitekerezo cya masomo gikemura intera iri hagati yibyo bamwe babona n'abandi babonwa n'abandi m'urwego rw'ubumuga. Biganisha kubibazo bya antropropologike y'umubano n'abandi mu gihe umuntu yibasiwe n'ubumuga, kandi mu bisanzwe muburyo bwo kwinjiza cyangwa guhezwa mumatsinda y'abantu bijyanye n'ibiranga bigaragara.
Muri sociologiya, Erving Goffman arahamagara "gupfobya Gutandukana n'ibiteganijwe bisanzwe kubandi kubyerekeye umwirondoro we, kandi bitandukanya ibitutsi bigaragara kandi bitagaragara.
Kaminuza ya Massachusetts, ku bufatanye n’urubuga rwabamugaye kwisi, rwatandukanije ubwoko butandukanye bw’ubumuga butagaragara, hamwe n'urutonde rw'ibintu bifatwa nk'ubumuga butagaragara.
Uru rutonde rurimo indwara zidakira nka diyabete, kunanirwa kw'impyiko, no kubura ibitotsi, igihe cyose bigira ingaruka zikomeye mubikorwa bya buri munsi.

Lyric Hearing ni yakozwe na InSound Medical, yashinzwe na rwiyemezamirimo wavumbuye ibikoresho byubuvuzi Adnan Shennib na Thar Casey. Igikoresho gishyirwa kandi gikoresha amatwi anatomy kugirango ingoma y'amatwi yumve amajwi. Igikoresho gishyirwa mumatwi yamatwi numunyamwuga wemewe kandi nta cyangwa bisabwa mugihe winjije igikoresho. Nubwo ibyifuzo byabasimbuye kugiti cyabo bishobora gutandukana, Lyric yashizweho kugirango yambare amezi agera kuri 4 icyarimwe idakeneye kuyakuraho cyangwa gusimbuza bateri.
Igishushanyo nogushyira ibikoresho bya Lyric Hearing bigabanya urusaku rwinyuma nibitekerezo byubwiza bwamajwi asanzwe. Abambara igikoresho barashobora kugikoresha mugihe bavugana kuri terefone, siporo, cyangwa basinziriye kandi ntibakeneye gutinya igikoresho kigwa. Lyric Hearing nayo irwanya amazi, abambara rero barashobora kwiyuhagira hamwe nigikoresho cyangwa gukora ibindi bikorwa bishingiye kumazi, nubwo isosiyete idashaka koga cyangwa kwibira.
Igikoresho cyo Kumva Lyric ntabwo ari. Igikoresho gikurwaho buri mezi make kigasimbuzwa ikindi gishya. Abambara barashobora guhindura ingano yigikoresho bakoresheje magnet kandi igikoresho cyo gukuraho nacyo gitangwa. "Icyumweru cy’ubucuruzi" kivuga ko iyi mfashanyo yo kumva yakiriye igihembo cy’ubuvuzi cya 2009.
Lyric yagurishijwe mu 2010 na Sonova, isosiyete ikuru ya Phonak, imfashanyo yo kumva (kwambara buri munsi). Phonak yashyize ahagaragara verisiyo nshya ya Lyric (Lyric 2) muri 2012 ari ntoya kugirango ihuze imiyoboro myinshi yamatwi.

Matelas ya vacuum, cyangwa vacmata, nigikoresho cy'ubuvuzi gikoreshwa muguhagarika abarwayi, cyane mugihe habaye ikibazo cy'umugogo, pelivisi, abamugaye cyangwa ihahamuka (cyane cyane ihahamuka ry'igitsina gore). Irakoreshwa kandi mu gutwara intoki y'abarwayi mu intera ngufi. Yahimbwe na Loed na Haederlé, bise matelas shell.
Immobilisation yuzuye y'umugongo (splinti) ikorwa hamwe nk'umukondo w'inkondo y'umura, matelasi ya vacuum hamwe n'igitambambuga munsi yacyo (gukomera kwa matelasi yo nyine ntabwo bihagije).
Hariho uburyo butatu bwo gushira abapfuye kuri matelas ya vacum:
Matelas ya vacuum nubundi buryo bwo gukoresha ikibaho kirekire. Ibyiza byayo ni:
Matelas ya vacum igizwe n'umufuka ufunze ikirere (mubisanzwe polymer) urimo amashapure mato (mubisanzwe imipira ya polystirene) kandi ushyizemo valive imwe cyangwa nyinshi. Mugihe cy'umuvuduko ukabije w'ikirere, amasaro y'ubusa kugenda, ariko iyo matelas imaze kubumbabumbwa umwuka, umwuka wikirere wo hanze ufunga amasaro ahantu (jamming) hanyuma matelas ikaba ikomeye.

Steve Saylor ni Umunyakanada ukina umukino n’umusesenguzi w'itangazamakuru, uwakiriye Blind Gamer hamwe na Steve Saylor, hamwe n’umujyanama ureba uburyo bworoshye mu mikino. Azwi cyane ku mbuga za YouTube na Twitch, hamwe no kuba yarakoze ku buryo bworoshye bwo kugera ku mikino nka The Last of Us Igice cya II, Imyizerere ya na Watch.
Steve Saylor yagaragaye mu bitabo byinshi, birimo Kinda Funny, kandi yagiye avugwa muri Visi Media, CG Magazine, MobileSyrup, na CNN, [1] kandi yanditse inyandiko kuri IGN. Ni n'umuvugizi wa Accessibility wavugiye muri GAconf, akaba yarahataniraga ibihembo 2021 by'imikino yo muri Kanada.

Icyerekezo na Mobilisitiya, (Orientation and Mobility), ni umwuga w'ibanda ku kwigisha abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona babasha kugenda hirya no hino. Inzobere za O&amp;M ku giti cyabo zirashobora gukoresha amashuri, ibigo bya leta cyangwa gukora nkaba rwiyemezamirimo bigenga. Ishuri Rikuru ry'emeza ibyerekezo byo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abashinzwe uburezi (ACVREP) ritanga impamyabumenyi ku bakora umwuga wo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe muri Amerika.
Ubuhanga n'amahugurwa.
Amahugurwa ya O&amp;M yibanda ku bimenyetso bishobora kugaragazwa n'impumyi cyangwa ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona kugirango abashe kumva aho baherereye nu buryo bwo kugendagenda ahantu hamenyerewe. Amahugurwa ya O&amp;M aragoye mumiterere kandi yagutse mu rwego rwayo. Inzobere zose za O&amp;M muri Amerika zikoresha ni nzego za leta zisabwa kubona ibyemezo bya ACVREP. Gahunda yo gutegura ibyemezo bya O&amp;M ni mbarwa mu mubare muri Amerika yose no muri rusange. Ubuhanga bwamenyeshejwe abahugurwa buratandukanye bitewe nubuzima bwabatoza. Kurugero, tekinike yo kugendagenda mumihanda yo mumujyi ntaho ihuriye numutoza uba mucyaro, kandi wasimbuka.
Isubiramo rifatika rigerageza kumenya ubwoko bwiza bw'amahugurwa ya O&amp;M k'ubantu bafite icyerekezo gito ntabwo yabonye itandukaniro rigaragara mugihe ugereranije amahugurwa ya O&amp;M yatanzwe n'abakorerabushake bahuguwe hamwe n'imyitozo ngororamubiri, ariko ntibari bafite imbaraga nke zo kubikora kubera urugero ruto ruto n'u buziranenge bwu buryo bwiza.

Linux Screen Reader (LSR) ni imbaraga zahagaritswe isoko yo guteza imbere kubidukikije bya ntego yuwo mushinga kwari ugushiraho urubuga rwiterambere rusubirwamo rwo kubaka ubundi buryo bwiyongera bwabakoresha mugushigikira ababana nubumuga butandukanye.
Ikoreshwa ryambere rya platform ya LSR kwari uguha abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kugera kuri desktop ya GNOME hamwe nubucuruzi bwayo (urugero: Firefox, OpenOffice, Eclipse) ukoresheje imvugo, Braille, hamwe no gukuza ecran. Kwagura bipakiye hamwe na LSR yibanze byari bigamije guhura niyi mpera.
LSR yari iyindi nzira ya, ariko hariho impamvu nyinshi zidahiganwa zo kugira tekinoroji ebyiri zagutse zifasha kuri desktop ya GNOME.
Linux Screen Reader (LSR) yatangijwe muri 2006 na. Ku ikubitiro, LSR yarekuwe ifite ariko ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 2006, verisiyo 0.3.2 yahinduwe kuri. Yahagaritswe mu 2007 ubwo IBM yerekanaga umutungo wabo muyindi mishinga.

Abandi baterankunga bagize uruhare runini muri uyu mushinga ni Pete Brunet, Eirikur Hallgrimsson, Scott Haeger, Eitan Isaacson, Andy Shi, Critóbal Palmer na Joel Feiner.

Weevac 6 ni ikirago cyo kurambura cyakozwe mu buryo bwihariye bwo gutwara abana b'afite cyangwa abana muri rusange, nko mu bitaro cyangwa mu kwimura abarwayi. Weevac 6 yahimbwe na Wendy Murphy, wavukiye muri Kanada muri 1985. Yabonye igitekerezo cyo kubikora akirebera amakuru y’umutingito wo mu mujyi wa Mexico, y'ibaza impamvu nta gikoresho cyo kwimura cyagenewe abana.
Inkomoko y'izina "Weevac 6" ituruka ku kuba igikoresho cyagenewe gutwara " abana nka 6 ".
Weevac 6 yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 35 kuri minisiteri ya CBC "Ikintu gikomeye cya Kanada".

Gnopernicus yari porogaramu itanga (AT) kubakoresha kandi bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Gnopernic ntikiri imbere cyane kandi yasimbuwe na muri GNOME.
Gnopernicus numusomyi wa "ecran-imwe-imwe" itanga imvugo, Braille, no gukuza kubakoresha bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Gnopernicus yatanzwe kubakoresha interineti yihariye - harimo guhitamo imvugo isohoka nijwi, guhitamo amabwiriza ya urufunguzo rwo kuyitwara, guhitamo Braille yerekana urufunguzo rwinjiza, no guhitamo uburyo gukuza gutangwa. Byarashobokaga kandi guhindura dosiye ya XML isobanura imvugo hamwe na Braille yasohotse.
Gnopernicus yahujwe nkumusomyi wa ecran isanzwe kuri GNOME 2.4 ku ya 10 Nzeri 2003; ariko, iterambere rya Gnopernicus ryatangiye mu 2001., hamwe nuburyo butandukanye bwo gukoresha code kugirango itume porogaramu igerwaho, yari ifite imiterere ihindagurika kuruta igishushanyo mbonera cya Gnopernicus maze ayisimbuza nk'umusomyi wa ecran isanzwe muri GNOME 2.16 muri Nzeri 2006.
Iterambere rya Gnopernicus ryayobowe na BAUM Engineering, isosiyete ikorana na Baum Retec AG.

Abandi baterankunga bagize uruhare runini muri uyu mushinga ni Adriana Iobb, Pal Csongor Sprencz, Iuliu Szijjarto na Adi Dascal

Kurambura, gurney, imyanda, cyangwa pram ni ibikoresho gikoreshwa mu kwimura abarwayi bakeneye ubuvuzi. Ubwoko bwibanze bigomba gutwarwa n'abantu babiri cyangwa benshi. Ikiziga kizunguruka (kizwi nka gurney, trolleyi, uburiri cyangwa igare) gikunze kuba gifite uburebure buringaniye, ibiziga, inzira, cyangwa sikide.
Stretchers ikoreshwai cyane mubihe bikomeye byo hanze y'ubuvuzi na serivisi z'ubuvuzi bwihutirwa (EMS), abasirikari, n'abashinzwe ubutabazi. Muri forensike y'ubuvuzi ukuboko kw'iburyo gusigara kumanitse kurambuye kugirango inkeragutabara zimenye ko atari umurwayi wakomeretse. Bakoreshwa kandi mu gufata imfungwa mugihe cyo gutera inshinge muri Amerika.
Kurambura kare, birashoboka ko bikozwe muri wicker hejuru y'ikadiri, bigaragara mu nyandiko yandikishijwe intoki kuva c. 1380. Kurambura byoroshye byari bisanzwe hamwe na basirikare hagati yikinyejana cya 20.
Mubisanzwe byanditseho "gurney", ariko na "guerney" cyangwa "girney". Imikoreshereze y'ambere y'ijambo birambuye bizunguruka ntibisobanutse, ariko bikekwa ko byakomotse ku murongo wa pasifika. Imikoreshereze yayo mubitaro yashizweho muri 1930.
Kurambura byoroshye.
Kurambura byoroshye, bizwi kandi n'izina ngirango Reeves amaboko cyangwa SKED, n'igitambambuga gikunze gushyigikirwa igihe kirekire n'imbaho z'imbaho cyangwa pulastike. Mu busanzwe gifite imikufi, gikoreshwa cyane kwimura umurwayi ahantu hafunzwe, urugero, koridoro ifunganye, cyangwa kuzamura abarwayi bafite umubyibuho ukabije. Kurambura Reeves bifite intoki esheshatu, bituma abatabazi benshi bafasha gukuramo.

Virtual Magnifying Glass ikora kumasoko atandukanye (Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, Mac OS) kubera gutezwa imbere hamwe na compiler. Nta kwishura software.

ZoomText ni ya yakozwe na Ai Squared yaguzwe na mu 2016. Inyandiko ya mbere yasohotse kuri mu 1988, naho verisiyo ya mbere ya Windows yasohotse mu 1991. ZoomText iraboneka mubice bibiri: ZoomText Magnifier na ZoomText Magnifier / Umusomyi, ikubiyemo.
Inyandiko iheruka ya ZoomText ni ZoomText 2023 yasohowe na Freedom Scientific mu Gushyingo 2022.
ZoomText nigice cyonyine cya software yagenewe abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Iraboneka kuri verisiyo yasohotse kandi ishyigikiwe na sisitemu y'imikorere ya Microsoft Windows. Porogaramu yemerera uyikoresha kubona no kumva ibintu byose kuri ecran ya mudasobwa kandi itanga uburyo bwo gusaba, inyandiko, imeri na interineti. Porogaramu igamije gufasha abantu bafite "gutakaza hakiri kare, syndrome ya mudasobwa, hamwe nubumuga bwo kutabona nka macula degeneration na glaucoma". ZoomText ifite ubufasha bubiri bwa monitor kandi irashobora gukuza ecran inshuro 60; yemerera kandi uyikoresha guhitamo igice cya ecran kinini. Ibisobanuro byanditse bigumaho kugirango bibungabunge byemewe. Igenzura ryamabara rifasha kunoza ubusobanuro bwa ecran kandi imbeba yerekana irashobora guhinduka. Itanga kandi ubushobozi bwokugenda neza kugirango ifashe uyikoresha gutangiza gahunda no kubona inyandiko kuri desktop no kubona hypertext ihuza hamwe nubugenzuzi, gushaka amagambo cyangwa interuro. Muri Windows Vista, gukuza no gufasha abasomyi ba ecran birashoboka kuri logi kuri stage.
ZoomText yakozwe kandi itunganywa na AiSquared, ifite icyicaro i Vermont, muri Amerika, kugeza mu 2016. Kuva icyo gihe iterambere no kwipimisha byahujwe nitsinda rya Freedom Scientific ryatanze kuva 1990. Igicuruzwa cyatunganijwe mu myaka irenga 25 kandi kiraboneka muri verisiyo zirenga 20.

Version 2020 was released in late 2019.
Version 2021 was released in late 2020.
Version 2022 was released in late 2021.
Version 2023 was released in late 2022.
Updates on current release versions are now published between 4 and 6 weeks apart.

Automatik Text Reader yari isoko yubuntu kandi ifunguye yongeweho kuri Firefox itanga inyandiko-y-imvugo iboneka mu cyegeranyo cya Mozilla Add-ons. Ifasha indimi nyinshi hamwe nibisobanuro kandi ishobora kwigenga kumenya ururimi rwinyandiko yanditse kandiikagira moteri ya synthesis. Mubintu byihariye, umuvuduko wijwi ushobora guhinduka kandi guhitamo inyandiko byikora. Usibye ibintu byihariye abakoresha bazabona ko interineti yoroshye gukoresha; kugira buto 4 gusa zo kuyikora.
Indimi zishyigikiwe.
Automatik Text Reader ifite ubufashe bw'ururimi yicyongereza, icyesipanyoli, igifaransa, ikidage, umutaliyani nu kirusiya. Ubwiza bwa synthesis buratandukanye cyane hagati yindimi, hamwe nicyongereza nijwi ryoroshye, ryumvikana cyane.
Kuba Firefox yongeyeho, Automatik Text Reader isaba Firefox gukora kandi ntishobora gushyirwaho standalone. Na none, kumyandiko migufi cyane igizwe namagambo atatu cyangwa munsi yayo, ibiganiro mbwirwa ruhame rwerekana ururimi irashobora kunanirwa kumenya ururimi rwukuri.

Festival speech Synthesis System ni uburyo rusange bwo guhuza imvugo mu ndimi nyinshi bwakozwe na Alan W. Black, Paul Taylor na Richard Caley mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi ku ikoranabuhanga (CSTR) muri kaminuza ya Edinburgh. Intererano zikomeye nazo zatanzwe na kaminuza ya Carnegie Mellon nizindi mbuga. Itangwa munsi yuburenganzira bwa software busa nuburenganzira bwa BSD.
Festival speech synthesis system Itanga inyandiko yuzuye kuri sisitemu yo kuvuga hamwe na API zitandukanye, hamwe nibidukikije byiterambere nubushakashatsi bwubuhanga bwo guhuza imvugo. Byanditswe muri C ++ hamwe na Scheme -isa na commande umusobanuzi kubisanzwe no kwagura.
Ibirori byateguwe kugirango bishyigikire ishyirwa muri Festival speech synthesis indimi nyinshi, kandi biza hamwe no gushyigikira icyongereza (icyongereza n’Amerika), Welsh, na Espagne. Ipaki y'amajwi ibaho mu zindi ndimi nyinshi, nk'Icyesipanyoli cya Castiliyani, Igiceki, Igifinilande, Umuhindi, Igitaliyani, Marathi, Igipolonye, Ikirusiya na Telugu.
Umushinga wa Festvox ugamije gutuma inyubako ya festival speech synthesis na amajwi mashya yubukorikori irushaho kuba gahunda kandi neza, bigatuma bishoboka ko umuntu wese yubaka ijwi rishya. Itangwa munsi yuburenganzira bwa software busa nuburenganzira bwa MIT.
Festvox nigikoresho cyibikoresho by Alan W. Black na Kevin Lenzo mukubaka amajwi yubukorikori kubirori. Harimo intambwe ku yindi inyigisho hamwe n'ingero ziri mu nyandiko yitwa "Kubaka Amajwi ya Sintetike".
Hano hari ibirori byacometse kuri GStreamer. Ibirori byateguwe mbere yo gukwirakwiza Linux.

Umurenge wa Rukira ni umwe mu mirenge 14 igize Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Rukira wari utuwe n'abaturage 29 893. Muri uyu murenge hari Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukira.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Rukira ni umwe mu mirenge 14 y'Akarere ka Ngoma.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Rukira wari utuwe n'abaturage 25 250. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 29 893. Muri bo, abagabo bari 14 301, abagore bari 15 592. Abaturage 2 828 bari batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 27 065 bari batuye mu cyaro.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside.
Mu Murenge wa Rukira hari Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukira. Urwo rwibutso rwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

Accurx ni isosiyete ikora software mu Bwongereza ikora mu rwego rw'ubuzima.
Isosiyete yashinzwe na Jacob Haddad na Laurence Bargery, bahuye nyuma baza gushinga sosiyete muri mu 2016.
Igicuruzwa nyamukuru cya Accurx ni Chain SMS, gahunda yo kohereza ubutumwa bukoreshwa no kubaga abaganga kugirango bavugane n’abarwayi. Porogaramu ikorera kuri mudasobwa ya desktop kandi ikohereza ubutumwa. Irashobora guhuza na software zimwe na zimwe zikoreshwa mu kubaga GP - Ubuzima bwa na. Iminyururu ya SMS yatangijwe muri Gashyantare 2018 kandi guhera muri Gashyantare 2019, yakoreshejwe mu kubaga GP zirenga 1.400 mu Bwongereza. Kubera ko mu Bwongereza, Accurx yinjije sisitemu muri SMS ya Chain, ikoresheje aho, hanyuma nyuma yaho "ibice birenga 90 ku ijana by'amavuriro y'ibanze yo mu Bwongereza ubu arayakoresha" kugira ngo abone akazi kuri interineti.
Ubutumwa bugufi buturuka kumurongo wa SMS bugaragara kuri "GPS Kubaga" muburyo budasanzwe.
byakoresheje uburyo bwo kohereza abarwayi ba Accurx mu 2022 kugira ngo bavugane n’abarwayi bakoresheje SMS kugira ngo bababaze niba bagikeneye gahunda yabo ya mbere yarengeje igihe cyangwa gahunda yo gukurikirana. 10% bavuze ko batagikeneye serivisi.
Sisitemu yo kureba abarwayi, Record View, yatangijwe muri Gicurasi 2022. Iremera abaganga kureba incamake yasomwe gusa yubuvuzi bwa GP bwumurwayi babiherewe uburenganzira.

Alberta Netcare (yahoze yitwa Wellnet) nintara ya rusange bukoreshwa mu kubika amakuru y’abarwayi ku buryo byoroshye kugera ku.
Hariho ibyiciro bitatu byingenzi byabakoresha Netcare:
Netcare yemerera abaganga bemerewe kureba inyandiko z'ubuvuzi z'abarwayi. Farumasi irashobora gukoresha serivise kugirango igenzure amakuru yandikiwe, no kohereza imiti.
Amakuru abitswe kandi aragerwaho.
Ubuzima bwumurwayi bubitswe kuri Netcare. Amakuru, ibisubizo bya, amashusho yo gusuzuma na raporo, raporo yubuvuzi yanditse (urugero:, kugisha inama,), ibisubizo byo gupima laboratoire (urugero nko, amakuru ya banki yamaraso), allergie no kutoroherana (ibiyobyabwenge nibiryo) allergie, kutoroherana kw'ibiribwa), umugenzuzi w'ibiyobyabwenge (agenzura imiti yandikiwe na dose kugirango arebe niba ikorana nindi miti cyangwa idakwiriye kubantu bafite allergie zimwe), amateka yandikiwe, hamwe namakuru rusange y’abarwayi (urugero: izina, itariki, umubare w’ubuzima bwite, aderesi, nimero ya terefone).
Gushyira mu bikorwa.
Ubutumwa bwa Netcare bukorwa hamwe na -kode ya ubutumwa. Ubutumwa bwoherejwe kandi bwakiriwe hejuru ya.
Netcare ikoresha protocole ikubiyemo izina ryumukoresha / ijambo ryibanga, hamwe na rwo kwemeza. Abakoresha bari mumiyoboro yizewe ya guverinoma ya Alberta (urugero ibitaro) ntibasaba urufunguzo rwa RSA rwo kwinjira.
Icyemezo cya kumurongo winjira wa kure ni TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA, urufunguzo rwa biti 112, TLS 1.2.
Kuva ku ya 15-29 Gicurasi 2009, virusi ya Trojan yagaragaye kuri sisitemu nyinshi z’ubuzima bwa Alberta na Netcare, bibangamira ubuzima bwite bw’abarwayi bo mu gace ka Edmonton 11.582.

BetterHelp ni urubuga rw' ubuzima bwo mumutwe rutanga serivisi zubuzima bwo mumutwe kumurongo kubakiriya. Serivisi zitangwa binyuze mubikorwa byurubuga kimwe na terefone n'itumanaho. BetterHelp yashinzwe mu 2013 na Alon Matas na Danny Bragonier, ikagurwa na mu 2015. BetterHelp yagumanye izina ryayo nyuma yo kugura kandi ikomeza gutanga serivisi zubujyanama kumurongo kubakoresha.
BetterHelp yashinzwe na Alon Matas mu 2013, nyuma yo guhura n’ibibazo ku giti cye kubona serivisi z’ bw’umwuga zijyanye na gahunda ye. Hamwe ninshingano yo gufasha abantu bose bahura nibibazo nkibyo kugirango babone ubujyanama bwumwuga, Matas yafatanije nuwashinze Danny Bragonier washinze urubuga rwiza rwa BetterHelp rushingiye kumurongo hamwe nubuyobozi bwa therapiste. Amafaranga yatanzwe agera kuri miliyoni 60 z'amadorari ateganijwe muri 2018.
Kuva mu 2020 kugeza 2023, BetterHelp niyo yaguze amatangazo yamamaza kuri podcast, kandi yakoresheje hafi miliyoni 8 z'amadolari yo kwamamaza podcast mu Kuboza 2023.
"Icyumba" kirakinguye 24/7 kandi urashobora kugerwaho mubikoresho byose bihujwe na interineti aho ariho hose.
Muri 2015, BetterHelp yaguzwe na, isosiyete ya ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya terefone na videwo kugira ngo itange imiti ikenewe. Teladoc yaguze BetterHelp kuri miliyoni 3.5 z'amadolari y'amanyamerika hamwe ya miliyoni 1.0, hamwe n'amasezerano yo kwishyura buri mwaka ku bagurisha angana na 15% by'amafaranga yose yinjiza yinjijwe n'ubucuruzi bwa BetterHelp muri buri myaka itatu iri imbere.
Mu Kwakira 2018, BetterHelp yitabiriwe n’abanyamakuru nyuma y’impungenge zerekeranye no gukoresha, uburambe bubi kuri porogaramu, isuzuma ryishyuwe n’abakinnyi, ndetse n’amasezerano ya serivisi bivugwa ko adahuye n’iyamamaza ryamamajwe na YouTubers yabigize umwuga. Umwe mu bashinze (akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru muri kiriya gihe) Alon Matas yasohoye itangazo asubiza ibyo aregwa. Abakora ibiri nka na bagize icyo bavuga kuri iki kibazo.
BetterHelp yakiriye igitekerezo cyo gusangira amakuru yihariye nabakiriya bayo na Facebook. Mu ivugurura rya politiki y’ibanga iheruka, BetterHelp yagize ati: "Turashobora gusangira amakuru yawe ajyanye no kugurisha umutungo, guhuza, guhomba, cyangwa ubundi bucuruzi." Isosiyete yasubije ibyo birego ivuga ko amategeko asaba BetterHelp gukurikiza amakuru y’ubuzima kandi ko atagengwa.
Ku ya 2 Werurwe 2023, FTC yatanze itegeko risaba kubuza BetterHelp gusangira amakuru y’ubuzima bw’abaguzi n’abandi bantu. Iri teka risaba kandi BetterHelp kwishyura miliyoni 7.8 z'amadolari y'abaguzi kugira ngo bakemure ibirego byo kwerekana amakuru yihariye y'abaguzi hamwe na Facebook, Snapchat, n'abandi. Ikirego cya FTC kijyanye n'itegeko ryateganijwe kivuga ko BetterHelp yakusanyije ubuzima ndetse n'amateka, aderesi ya IP, hamwe na aderesi ya imeri ku baguzi mu gihe basezerana inshuro nyinshi kubika aya makuru. Ikirego kigira kiti: "Icyakora, kuva mu 2013 kugeza Ukuboza 2020, [BetterHelp] yakomeje kurenga ku masezerano yerekeye ubuzima bwite, ikoresha amafaranga y’ubuzima bw’abaguzi kugira ngo babagereho ndetse n’abandi bamamaza serivisi."
Mu, BetterHelp yatanze amezi atandatu yo kuvura "nta kiguzi ku bahuye n’intambara yo muri Isiraheli". Ibi byamenyekanye bwa mbere binyuze mu itangazo ku rubuga rwa Twitter rwa guverinoma ya Isiraheli. Umuvugizi w'isosiyete y'ababyeyi ya BetterHelp yabwiye ko iyi ari "gahunda yigenga" kandi ko guverinoma ya Isiraheli itabigizemo uruhare.

Curex ni isosiyete y'Abanyamerika izobereye mu, cyane cyane gusuzuma no kuvura, harimo kwandika no gutanga immunotherapie ya allergie. Isosiyete yashinzwe na Gene Kakaulin na Charles Jacoby mu 2020 ikaba ifite icyicaro mu mujyi wa New York. Curex itanga urubuga rusanzwe ruhuza abarwayi n'abaganga kugirango bita allergie.
Igitekerezo cya Curex cyashinzwe mu 2020 na Gene Kakaulin na Charles Jacoby, cyatewe nubunararibonye n’abashinze na allergie. Ubunararibonye bwabo butuma bashiraho Curex, urubuga rwa telemedisine rwagenewe kwita kuri allergie.
Ibikorwa bya Curex bikubiyemo umuyoboro mugihugu hose wabaganga ba allergie nabaforomo. Curex ikubiyemo kandi serivisi ya farumasi itumiza imeri itanga allergie immunotherapie hamwe nindi miti yandikiwe murugo rwabarwayi.
Isosiyete yibanze cyane ni kuvura, harimo ibiti, ibyatsi, na allergie y’ibyatsi; imbwa, injangwe, nizindi allergie; na allergie yo murugo nkiziterwa na mite na mite. Curex kandi ivura abarwayi bafite asima na (), ibintu bibiri bijyanye na allergie.
Curex itanga serivisi zo gusuzuma allergie kandi yorohereza gupima allergie hamwe na ImmunoCAP, tekinoroji ya FDA, isaba gukuramo amaraso murugo na phlebotomiste cyangwa muri laboratoire. Byongeye kandi, Curex itanga igipimo cyamaraso IgE ukoresheje wenyine, ibikoresho byemewe bya CLIA.

The Distance Learning and Telemedicine Grant and Loan Program (DLT) ni gahunda yemejwe n'itegeko rya Farm bill rya 1990 (PL 101-624) igamije gutanga inkunga (Grants) ku mashuri n'ibigo by'ubuvuzi byo mu cyaro, kugira ngo bifashwe gushora imari mu bikoresho n'ibikorwaremezo bya telekominikasiyo, bigamije kugeza uburezi n'ubuvuzi mu bice by'icyaro aho izo serivisi ziba zidahari cyangwa ziboneka gacye. E-patient ni ugira uruhare runini mubuvuzi bwabo, cyane cyane mukusanya amakuru ajyanye bubagiraho ingaruka nimiryango yabo, bakoresheje nibindi bikoresho bya digitale. Iri jambo rikubiyemo abashaka ubuyobozi ku ndwara zabo bwite, n'incuti n'abagize umuryango bakora ubushakashatsi mu izina ryabo. E-abarwayi batangaza ingaruka ebyiri zubushakashatsi bwubuzima bwabo: "amakuru meza yubuzima na serivisi nziza, kandi bitandukanye, ariko ntabwo buri gihe ari byiza, umubano nabaganga babo."
E-abarwayi bafite uruhare mukubitaho no kwerekana imbaraga cyangwa / Ubuvuzi 2.0. icyitegererezo cyo kwita. "E" irashobora guhagararaho " "elegitoroniki" " ariko yanakoreshejwe mu kwerekeza ku yandi magambo, nka "ibikoresho", "bishobotse", "imbaraga" na "umuhanga".
Ubumenyi bugezweho ku ngaruka za e-abarwayi kuri ndetse n’ubuvuzi bwahawe bwerekana:
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu mwaka wa 2011 ku barwayi ba e-abarwayi bo mu Burayi bwerekanye ko bakunda "gushishoza no kwigenga" kandi ko bagaragaje ko umubare w’abarwayi ba e-e mu Burayi wasaga nkuwiyongera. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu mwaka wa 2012 bwerekanye ko e-abarwayi bashyira ahagaragara amashusho yerekeye ubuzima bwabo bagize ikibazo cyo gutakaza ubuzima bwite, ariko kandi bakanabona inyungu nziza ziva. Ubushakashatsi bwakurikiyeho 2017 bwifashishije bwerekanye ko iyo e-abarwayi binjijwe mu nama zita ku buzima, bongera amakuru, bakagura ikwirakwizwa, ndetse bakanagira uruhare runini mu biganiro bya ugereranije n’abashakashatsi mu gihe bangana na 1.4% gusa. y'abafatanyabikorwa bavanze.
Ubusobanuro butari Icyongereza no guhuza "e-umurwayi".
Nk’uko Maho Isono, PhD, muri i, mu Buyapani, ngo ijambo ryegereye "e-umurwayi" mu kiyapani ni "tojisha-kenkyu", aho " "kenkyu" bisobanura kwiga, iperereza n’ubushakashatsi" na " "tojisha" bivuga abashimishijwe abantu, abafite ubumuga ubwabo cyangwa abarwayi ubwabo. "
Ahumekewe nakazi ka seminari kuri e-abarwayi na hamwe na e-Patients Scholars Group Group, Umurwayi wa Suwede na injeniyeri Sara Riggare [sv] yahimbye ijambo rishya rya Suwede, " ", risobanura "kuyobora umurwayi" cyangwa "umurwayi uyobora", muri Gashyantare 2016.

Igihembo cya Jenerali Maxwell R. Thurman gitangwa mu izina ry’umuyobozi mukuru mu nama ngarukamwaka (ATA) mu rwego rwo gushimira umuntu ugaragaza kandi agaragaza imico n’ibiranga bikurikira: a umuyobozi wavutse kavukire, udushya, umuntu utera impinduka nziza, nyampinga wumusirikare, nintangarugero yiterambere ryikoranabuhanga kugirango azamure ubuzima bwabakozi bacu. Iki gihembo cyitiriwe inyenyeri enye Jenerali, wabaye nyampinga w’umusirikare akaba intangarugero mu iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga. Icyivugo cye kizwi cyane cyanditswe kuri iki gihembo ni iki gikurikira: "Inshingano y’ishami ry’ubuvuzi ry’ingabo ni ugutanga ubuvuzi bw’impanuka zo ku rwego rw’isi ku mutungo w’agaciro muri Amerika - Ni Abahungu n’abakobwa - Mu mahoro n’intambara!" Iki gihembo cyatanzwe bwa mbere muri DoD "Ihuriro ryambere" n’uwashizeho, BG Russ Zajtchuk mu 1995, ubu ni umuco ngarukamwaka muri buri nama ya ATA.

Ubuvuzi CRM, buzwi kandi ku micungire y’ubuzima, ni ijambo rikoreshwa cyane kuri sisitemu, cyangwa, ikoreshwa mu.
Hariho uburyo butatu (3) busanzwe buzwi bwa CRM: Kugurisha, Kwamamaza, na Serivisi
Ubuvuzi CRM nitandukaniro n'izindi CRM.
Ubuvuzi CRM busangiza ibice byimiterere nuburyo bwa CRMs Ibi bikubiyemo gukoresha itumanaho no gusesengura hakoreshejwe imeri, terefone, hamwe n’imibereho / interineti. Ihuza imeri, inyandiko, akazi, fax, na gahunda. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, abinjira muri CRM bashya batanga porogaramu-nka-serivisi-kandi ikirwa mu gicu (reba n'Ubuzima bwa Keona).
Itandukaniro rya CRMs gakondo rishingiye ku guhuza ishyirahamwe ryita ku buzima ibisabwa byihariye n'imiterere:
Serivise yubuzima CRM itanga serivisi yibanda ku gutanga no gutanga serivisi kubarwayi. Binyuze muri serivisi zitangirwa serivisi, abarwayi bafashwa mumihanda myinshi yo kwishyiriraho gahunda, itumanaho, koroshya gufata no kwiyandikisha, kugendagenda, guhuza ibikorwa hamwe no gukurikirana kure, hamwe nubundi buryo bwo guhuza serivisi n’abarwayi.
Menyesha Ikigo Cyikora.
Intego yikigo nderabuzima ku buzima ni ukongera ubuziranenge, kugabanya ibiciro, no gukurikirana (KPI). Ibi bigerwaho nintambwe ku yindi inyandiko-mvugo hamwe no guhamagarira guhamagarira kuyobora hamwe na EHR kwishyira hamwe no (PM) byerekana amateka yumuhamagaye n'amateka byuzuye kubakoresha. KPI yakusanyirijwe hamwe ni imikorere yabakoresha nuburambe bwabakiriya binganda.
Umutekano na Escalation Automation.
Kubera ko ibibazo byinshi byubuzima bifite amahirwe yo gutanga ubuzima n’umutekano, hakenewe ibikoresho bitandukanye (CDS) kugirango bifashe kubungabunga umutekano. Mbere yuko gahunda iteganijwe cyangwa serivisi yo kuzuza itangwa, hakenewe isuzuma ryibimenyetso by’abarwayi kugira ngo hemezwe ko ibikorwa bikorwa bishoboka ko bifite umutekano ku murwayi cyangwa ku babakikije (urugero nko gusuzuma COVID). Ku iherezo ryoroshye, "urutonde rwibendera rutukura" ni igenzura ryoroshye abarwayi n’abaganga badafite amavuriro bashobora gukoresha kugirango berekane ibintu bishobora kuvuka cyangwa byihutirwa. Abagenzuzi b'indimi karemano basanzwe bashiramo uburyo bwo gutunganya ururimi karemano hamwe nubuyobozi buvura abarwayi cyangwa imiti itari iy'ubuvuzi bateganya. Amabwiriza y’abaforomo afasha abaforomo kurangiza isuzuma ryubuvuzi no kugera kuri disikuru.
Intego yo guteganya automatike ni ukugabanya amakosa yo guteganya no kunoza utanga nuburambe bwabarwayi hamwe no gusurwa neza, mugihe kugabanya ibiciro. Guteganya kwikora mubisanzwe bikora mugushira ibipimo byo gusura muri software no kuvanaho ibintu bitoroshye uhereye kumukoresha wa nyuma. Iyikora ryemerera guhuza ibikorwa byateganijwe nta guhatira ibipimo ngenderwaho (ni ukuvuga gukuraho ibyifuzo byumuntu ku giti cye) kuva kuri gahunda.
Intego yo byikora ni ugukora kwiyandikisha kubitanga numurwayi byoroshye kandi byoroshye. Kwakira abarwayi no kwiyandikisha ni inzira zerekana imibare y’abarwayi, amateka y’ubuzima, ibyemezo byemewe n'amategeko, hamwe n’uburyo bwo kwishyura kugira ngo umurwayi ashobore “kwiyandikisha” ku kigo nderabuzima.
Serivisi zishingiye ku kibanza.
zifasha mugushakisha utanga hafi, kugendana na gahunda, kandi birashobora no korohereza ibikorwa byihutirwa kubakiriya. Intego yo kubishyira muri CRM nukworohereza itangwa rya serivisi no kongera umutekano wabarwayi.
Intego yo kohereza ubutumwa ni ugukomeza ibipimo byumwuga, gukoresha intambwe ikurikira nibutsa, no gushimangira inama zita kubuzima hamwe nubuzima bwubuzima mugihe hagabanijwe umutwaro witumanaho kubakoresha. Ubutumwa bwikora muri Healthcare CRM burimo HIPAA yubahiriza ubutumwa bwizewe kuri imeri, fax, SMS, no kuganira kurubuga.
Intego yo ni ukuzuza ubuvuzi bwa kure hamwe no gukusanya amakuru kure kandi no gushyiramo integuza zo kwita kubuzima bwiza, ubuzima, n'umutekano w'abarwayi. Gukurikirana kure ni ikusanyamakuru.

Wireless health ni uburyo bwo kwinjiza ikoranabuhanga ridakoresha insinga mu buvuzi bwa gakondo, nk'ugupima indwara, gukurikirana no kuvura abarwayi, ndetse no gukoresha ibindi bikoresho bfasa umuntu kunoza ubuzima bwe no kugira imibereho myiza. Wireless health butandukanye nubuzima bwiza kuberako ibisubizo by'ubuzima butagira umugozi bitazahora bigendanwa kandi ibisubizo by'ubuzima bugendanwa ntibizahora bikoreshwa muburyo butemewe. Umuyoboro mugari wa terefone igendanwa ni ingirakamaro mu kugera ku barwayi bashya mu turere twa kure mu gihe tuzamura umusaruro kandi woroshye binyuze mu kohereza amakuru.

Telecare nubuvuzi bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga nko gukurikirana kugira ngo zishobore kuguma zifite umutekano kandi zigenga mu ngo zabo. Ibikoresho birashobora gushiramo porogaramu zubuzima nubuzima bwiza, nkibikoresho byo gukurikirana imyitozo hamwe na porogaramu yibutsa imiti ya digitale, cyangwa tekinoroji itanga umuburo hakiri kare. Gukoresha bishobora kuba bimwe mubice bishobora gutanga ubufasha kubantu bafite uburwayi nko, cyangwa abantu bafite ibyago byo kugwa.
Itumanaho ryinshi rigabanya ingaruka ziterwa no kutitabira ibintu no gutanga ubufasha bwihuse. Bimwe mubitumanaho, nko no gukurikirana imibereho bifite ibikorwa byo gukumira kuberako iyangirika ryimibereho yabakoresha itumanaho rishobora kugaragara hakiri kare.
Telecare itandukanye cyane na na. Telecare bivuga igitekerezo cyo gufasha abantu gukomeza kwigenga mumazu yabo batanga ikoranabuhanga rishingiye kumuntu kugirango bafashe umuntu cyangwa babo.
Itumanaho rya terefone igendanwa ni serivisi igaragara aho imiterere yubuhanzi bugendanwa hamwe na SIM igenda ikoresha kugirango umukiriya asohoke hanze yiwabo ariko aracyafite serivisi ya 24/7 itumanaho iboneka kugirango ibashyigikire. Ibikoresho bisanzwe bikora ibi nibintu nka Pebbell mobile GPS ikurikirana.
Ibisobanuro n'imikoreshereze yijambo 'telecare' ntabwo byakemuwe muburyo buhoraho. Mu Bwongereza hashingiwe ku rwego rwo kwita ku mibereho kandi yibanda ku bisobanuro byasobanuwe haruguru. Mu bindi bihugu 'telecare' irashobora gukoreshwa mubikorwa byubuvuzi kure.
Imikoreshereze ya Telecare.
Muburyo bworoshye cyane, irashobora kwerekeza kuri terefone ihamye cyangwa igendanwa ifite aho ihurira nikigo gikurikirana aho uyikoresha ashobora gutabaza. Tekinoroji yateye imbere sisitemu ikoresha sensor, aho hashobora gukurikiranwa ingaruka zishobora kubaho. Ibi bishobora kubamo kugwa, kimwe nimpinduka zibidukikije murugo nkumwuzure, umuriro na gaze. Abarezi b'abantu bafite ikibazo cyo guta umutwe barashobora kuburirwa mugihe umuntu avuye munzu cyangwa ahandi hantu hasobanuwe. Iyo sensor ikora ikohereza ikimenyetso cya radio mubice bikuru murugo rwumukoresha, hanyuma igahita ihamagarira ikigo gikurikirana amasaha 24 aho abashoramari bahuguwe bashobora gufata ingamba zikwiye, haba kuvugana nabafite urufunguzo rwibanze, umuganga cyangwa byihutirwa serivisi.
Itumanaho kandi rigizwe na tereviziyo yihariye itohereza ibimenyetso mu kigo gisubiza ariko igafasha abarezi binyuze mu gutanga amakuru yo mu rugo (mu rugo) mu rugo rw'umuntu kugira ngo amenyeshe umurezi igihe umuntu akeneye kwitabwaho.
Ni ngombwa kumenya ko 'telecare' atari uburyo bwo kuburira gusa niba umuntu avuye mu rugo ahubwo ni ingamba zo gukumira abantu bagarurwa kandi bakabikwa mu baturage binyuze mu itumanaho risanzwe. Hano hari serivisi nini za serivise zitumanaho ziboneka hamwe na bimwe bizwi cyane ni impuruza ya pendant, sisitemu ya terefone igendanwa, serivisi yihuta ya terefone igenzura ibikorwa, kugenzura kugwa n'ibindi. Serivisi zitumanaho zikoresha indimi nyinshi ubu zatangijwe zifungura serivisi kubantu benshi. Bose bafite uruhare mukubungabunga ubwigenge bwabantu no kwemerera abantu kuguma mumazu yabo.
Iterambere ry'ikoranabuhanga ritera amahirwe yo guteza imbere ubwigenge no gutanga ubufasha buva mu nzego zita ku mibereho, ubu butekereza kuri eCare, hamwe na sisitemu yo kugendana / imyanya, nka kubantu bafite ikibazo cyo guta umutwe cyangwa ubundi bumuga bwo kutamenya.
Telecare mu Bwongereza.
Mu 2005, ishami ry’ubuzima ry’Ubwongereza ryasohoye "inyubako ya Telecare mu Bwongereza" kugira ngo rihuriranye n’itangazwa ry’inkunga yo gufasha gushishikarizwa gufata inama z’ibanze zifite inshingano zo kwita ku mibereho.
Ishami ry’ubuzima mu Bwongereza Sisitemu Yuzuye (WSD) ryatangiye muri Gicurasi 2008. Nibigeragezo binini byateganijwe byo kugenzura na tereviziyo ku isi, birimo abarwayi 6191 hamwe na 238 GP ku mbuga eshatu, na. Ibigeragezo byasuzumwe na:, University of Oxford,, na.
Ibyavuye mu mutwe wa WSD nyuma y’igeragezwa rya telehealth, birimo abarwayi 3154, harimo ibi bisubizo:
Ibyavuye mu itumanaho byateganijwe gutangazwa mugihe runaka kizaza. Mubyukuri ntabwo bigeze bagaragara. Bamwe mu barwayi baracyafite ikizere ko itumanaho rizatuma habaho iterambere ryinshi muri serivisi nziza. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko uburyo bwo gutumanaho bwitwaye neza, hamwe n’igiciro cyiyongera kuri iyo hiyongereyeho ubuvuzi busanzwe bwa 92.000.
Minisitiri wa serivisi ishinzwe kwita kuri leta, Paul Burstow, yatangaje mu mwaka wa 2012 ko n’itumanaho bizongerwa mu myaka itanu iri imbere (2012-2017) kugira ngo bigere ku bantu miliyoni eshatu. Iki cyifuzo cyarahebwe mu Gushyingo 2013. Muri Nzeri 2014 bwatangaje ko buzasimburwa, ariko bugaragara cyane, gahunda nshya "ikoranabuhanga ryatumye serivisi zita ku barwayi".

Ikigaragara ni uko cyahoze cyitwa Opternative, ni isosiyete ikorera ikorera mu mujyi wa Chicago itanga ibizamini byo ku murongo kandi ikabyara indorerwamo z'amaso hamwe n'ibisobanuro byandikirwa.
Biboneka ko itanga umurongo wibizamini byerekanwe kandi ikabyara indorerwamo z'amaso hamwe na lens lens ya progaramu kubasura urubuga, gutanga ibisubizo ukoresheje imeri mugihe cyumunsi umwe urangije ikizamini. Ibisubizo by'ikizamini bisubirwamo na optometriste, bifatwa nk'ibicuruzwa byemewe, kandi birashobora gukoreshwa mugutumiza ibirahuri cyangwa imibonano kuri interineti cyangwa imbonankubone ku mucuruzi w'amaso. Isosiyete ubwayo ntabwo igurisha imfashanyigisho iyo ari yo yose, kandi ikura amafaranga yinjira mu mafaranga yishyuza ibizamini.
Isosiyete yashinzwe nka Opternative mu 2012 n’ikizamini cyayo cyo kuri interineti yatangijwe mu 2015. Mu Gushyingo 2018, isosiyete yakusanyije miliyoni 9 z'amadolari ihindura izina iva Opternative ihinduka Biboneka mu kwezi gukurikira.
Kugeza muri 2019, leta 39 zo muri Amerika zemerera optometriste gutanga imiti kuri enterineti. Ibihugu bimwe na bimwe ariko byagerageje kubuza isosiyete gukora ubucuruzi. Urugero, mu mwaka wa 2016, leta ya Indiana yemeje itegeko ribuza gukoresha ibizamini by’amaso ku murongo kugira ngo hatangwe imiti y’amaso kugira ngo hakorwe "igikoresho cy’amaso". Ikigaragara ni uko yatanze ikirego kuri Leta muri Mata 2019, avuga ko kwinjiza ibikoresho by'amaso mu itegeko rya telehealth - ryarimo ibiyobyabwenge byo gukuramo inda na opioide - byatewe n'igitutu cy’abaganga ba optometriste n'inganda z'amaso aho kwita ku buzima rusange, kandi yakoreshwaga mu karengane, ashyira ahagaragara akanama gashinzwe gutanga impushya zo kwa muganga muri Indiana, umushinjacyaha mukuru wa, hamwe n’umuyobozi wa Leta mu ishami rishinzwe kurengera umuguzi, Betsy Dinardi, nk’abaregwa.
Muri Gicurasi 2019, nyuma y’igitutu kinini cy’ishyirahamwe (AOA), ikizamini cyo kureba ku murongo cyari cyaributswe n’uru ruganda, nkuko byatangajwe n’ishyirahamwe muri Amerika (FDA).
Muri Mata 2020, mu rwego rwo guhangana n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, FDA yatanze amabwiriza yo kwagura ubushobozi bwo gusuzuma indwara z’amaso ya kure, no korohereza ubuvuzi bw’abarwayi mu gihe cy’icyorezo. Ikigaragara ni uko kizatanga ku isi hose kizatanga optometriste, abaganga b’amaso, n’abatanga serivisi za optique kubona ubuntu ku buhanga bwa tekinoroji yo gupima iyerekwa, kugira ngo bafashe abarwayi guhaza ubuzima bwabo bw’amaso mu gihe.
Muri Kanama 2022, Biboneka ko yakiriye 510 (k) kugirango ikoreshwe ikizamini gishingiye kuri terefone igendanwa byaba byiza itanze imiti ivugurura abantu bari hagati ya 22 na 40. Biboneka ko yabaye ikizamini cya mbere cyerekanwe kuri FDA muri Amerika.

Uru rutonde rwabatanga serivise za telemedisine ni urwa telemedisine izwi cyane, hamwe nabatanga ubuzima na mobile. Ibi birimo ibikoresho byita kubuvuzi bwa kure, serivisi cyangwa urubuga rukoreshwa mu ntambwe zihariye mu nganda zita ku buzima, no kuvura kwa muganga.
- Yashinzwe muri 2014. Isosiyete ikora itumanaho itanga serivisi zo kugorora amenyo.

TeleMAT ni ihuriro rya serivisi za hamwe (MAT) na kubarwayi ba (OUD).
Nk’uko bitangazwa (SAMHSA), ijambo “MAT” ryerekeza ku “gukoresha imiti, hamwe n’ubujyanama hamwe n’ubuvuzi bw’imyitwarire, kugira ngo hatangwe uburyo bw’umurwayi wose mu kuvura ibiyobyabwenge. imvururu. ”Ubuyobozi bugaragaza kandi akamaro ko gukemura ibindi bibazo by'ubuzima mu gihe cyo kwivuza.
(HHS) isobanura Telehealth, cyangwa telemedisine, nk'inzira yo kwita ku “kureka umuganga wawe akaguha ubuvuzi utagusuye ku biro byawe. Telehealth ikorwa cyane cyane kumurongo hamwe na enterineti kuri mudasobwa yawe, tablet, cyangwa terefone. "
Muri 2019, ijambo "TeleMAT" ryahimbwe nitsinda rya QuickMD ryerekeza kuri serivisi yo guha MAT abarwayi binyuze kuri telehealth.

Telehomecare (THC) ni subfield muri. Harimo no gutanga serivisi zita ku buzima ku barwayi hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho, rituma imikoranire y’ijwi, amashusho, hamwe n’amakuru ajyanye n’ubuzima. Imicungire yubuvuzi ikorerwa kurubuga rwo hanze ninzobere mubuzima.
Nubwo akenshi ikoreshwa muburyo bumwe hamwe no, telehomecare ikubiyemo ibirenze gukurikirana gusa, kuko ikubiyemo uburezi, inkunga y'amarangamutima n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage, gukwirakwiza amakuru, no kuyobora wenyine. THC yakoreshejwe mu kunoza imicungire yubuzima budakira nkindwara, na, bishobora kugabanya umubare wabasura serivisi zubuvuzi bwibanze. Umubare w'abaturage bageze mu za bukuru ukenera ubuvuzi bwo mu rugo ushimangira ko hakenewe serivisi zita ku buzima, THC ishobora gukemura. Byongeye kandi, THC yorohereza amasano hagati yibitaro n’abatanga ubuvuzi bwibanze, kunoza serivisi z’abarwayi no kugabanya amafaranga y’ubuzima.
Ikoranabuhanga rya THC ryita ku barwayi banyuranye bakeneye, kuva kuri bike kugeza kubikurikirana. Sisitemu isanzwe igizwe nigice cyo hagati gihujwe nigikoresho kimwe cyangwa byinshi bya periferiya, umunzani wibiro, glucometero, impiswi ya oxyde, metero zitemba, cyangwa stethoskopi. Abarwayi binjiza ibimenyetso byingenzi namakuru yubuzima mubice bya THC haba mu ntoki cyangwa binyuze kuri peripheri. Aya makuru yoherezwa binyuze kumurongo wa terefone kuri seriveri itekanye ku kigo cyabigenewe mbere yo koherezwa kuri porogaramu ishingiye ku rubuga rwizewe. Inzobere mu buvuzi zirashobora noneho kubona no gusuzuma amakuru yumurwayi aho ariho hose hamwe na enterineti.
Hashingiwe ku bushakashatsi bwakorewe muri Amerika na Capital Area Consortium ku Gusaza n'Ubumuga, umurongo wa kb 128 wagize akamaro mu buryo butandukanye bwo kuvura no gufata neza THC. Ibi birimo:
Imwe muma porogaramu ya THC ni ugutanga ubuforomo ukoresheje terefone, televiziyo, mudasobwa, hamwe na videwo. THC irashobora kuzamura umusaruro wumurwayi, kongera umusaruro wabatanga ubuvuzi, no kugabanya ibiciro byubuzima. Iyi porogaramu irashobora kwerekanwa nka.
THC yerekanye ingaruka zikomeye ku kwinjira mu bitaro no gusura ibyumba byihutirwa, ndetse no gusura amavuriro. Umuyoboro wa Ontario Telemedicine (OTN) wakoze gahunda yo kugerageza yarimo abarwayi barenga 800 bafite imwe mu ndwara zidakira - Congestive Heart Failure cyangwa COPD. Ibisubizo byari:
THC itanga amahirwe yo kwimura itangwa rya serivisi nyinshi zita ku buzima ziva mu bitaro n’ibindi bigo nderabuzima mu ngo z’abarwayi, bityo bikagabanya umutwaro kuri gahunda y’ubuzima ndetse no kubika ibitaro ku bibazo bikomeye. Ubushakashatsi buherutse gukorwa mu bwerekanye ko ubushakashatsi buke cyane bwasuzumye imikorere ya THC, bityo rero, hakenewe ubushakashatsi bwinshi kugira ngo hamenyekane agaciro ka THC mu kugabanya amafaranga ajyanye no gucunga indwara zidakira.

Ubuvuzi bwa kure, rimwe rimwe bwitwa porogaramu z'ubuzima bwa telemental uburyo bwo kuvura imitekerereze ya interineti bushingiye kuri interineti, itangazamakuru rya elegitoronike mu mwanya cyangwa hiyongereyeho imitekerereze isanzwe.
Ku ikubitiro, byari bigamije mbere na mbere gusimbuza imiti isanzwe, imbonankubone aho umukiriya cyangwa umurwayi asabwa gusura ibiro by’abavura indwara zo mu mutwe. Kwiyongera ariko, abize biga gukoresha itangazamakuru rya elegitoronike mukuvura kugirango bashakishe uburyo bwo gutanga imiti kandi ishobora kuvura neza.
Nyuma yo gusuzuma ubushakashatsi cumi na butatu bufite akamaro, abanditsi ba meta-gusesengura isuzuma rya psychotherapi bahujwe n’ikoranabuhanga rya kure ry’itumanaho banzuye ko:
Ubuvuzi bwa kure bufite ubushobozi bwo gutsinda zimwe mu mbogamizi kuri serivisi zisanzwe zo kuvura imitekerereze. Ibikorwa bishingiye kuri terefone nibyo byibandwaho cyane mubushakashatsi kandi nkuburyo bwo gutumanaho buvura bushobora gutanga inyungu zihariye mubijyanye no kuboneka kwinshi no koroshya imikorere. Ariko, ibimenyetso bihari bigarukira mubwinshi no mubwiza. Ibigeragezo bikaze birasabwa kwemeza ibigereranyo byambere byingirakamaro.
Nubwo hatabayeho ubushakashatsi bwuzuye, ubuvuzi bwa kure bwagiye bukundwa cyane nkumusimbura wubuvuzi gakondo hamwe nuburyo bushya bushoboka hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa elegitoroniki. Ingero zirimo:
Igisirikare cy’Amerika cyatangije gahunda aho abasirikare ku rugamba bitabira bushingiye kuri videwo hamwe n’abafatanyabikorwa babo mu rugo.
AbleTo ikoresha ubuvuzi bwa kure kugirango yongere kandi itangire uburyo bushya bwo guhanga udushya, urugero, uburyo bushingiye ku matsinda yo gukoresha bwifashishwa mu kuvura no gutoza uruhushya.
Ivuriro rya Mayo, ritanga amasomo ya kure yo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abarwayi bafite ikibazo cy’ubwonko. Ukoresheje urubuga rwa interineti rwizewe, rwihuta rwohereza ubutumwa, umuvuzi ukorera mu biro akora gahunda yo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe umurwayi, uguma mu rugo rwe cyangwa hafi ye.
(NIHR) cyasohoye isuzuma ry’ubushakashatsi bwerekana uburyo ubuvuzi bwa kure hamwe n’ikoranabuhanga rishobora gufasha gucunga ubuzima.

Kwigisha abarwayi kumurongo, bizwi kandi kwizina ryabarwayi kumurongo, nuburyo bwo gutanga amakuru yubuvuzi nuburere ku barwayi ukoresheje yatanzwe binyuze kuri interineti. Nubwoko bwinyigisho zishingiye kuri mudasobwa kandi zirimo amahugurwa y'urubuga, ibikoresho bikururwa, amasomo yo kwigira, hamwe n'amajwi / amashusho. Mubisanzwe, kwigisha abarwayi kumurongo byunganirwa ninama zumuntu ku giti cye zijyanye na buri muntu.
Inzobere mu buzima zikoresha inyigisho z’abarwayi kuri interineti kugirango zitegure abarwayi uburyo bwo kwivuza, gutanga ibyangombwa no kumenyesha impapuro zemeza uruhushya, kwigisha abarwayi ibijyanye n’ubuzima, gutanga amakuru ajyanye no kwita ku kwirinda, gushishikariza imyitwarire myiza n’imihindagurikire y’imibereho, n'ibindi. abarwayi kubyerekeye politiki yo gukwirakwiza.
Kwigisha abarwayi kumurongo bigenda byamamara mugihe interineti yo murugo igenda iba rusange kandi ibikorwa byubuvuzi bigenda bikoresha ikoranabuhanga. Abarwayi bareba porogaramu zo kwigisha abarwayi kumurongo hamwe nibikoresho mubiro byubuvuzi cyangwa kuva mu ngo zabo cyangwa ahandi hantu hitaruye bafite interineti. Ibirimo birashobora gushiramo ibintu byimikorere nkibibazo, ibibazo bizima nibisubizo (mumahugurwa y'urubuga ruciriritse), hamwe nubushobozi bwo kuzuza no gutanga impapuro.
Uburezi hashingiwe ku bwoko bw'abarwayi.
Inyigisho iyo ari yo yose yatanzwe mu magambo n’ubuvuzi ku murwayi umwe cyangwa itsinda ry’abarwayi irashobora gufatwa nk’ahantu h’uburere bw’abarwayi. Nubwo ubu aribwo buryo bukoreshwa cyane muburyo bwo kwigisha abarwayi butwara igihe, burashobora kugira ibibazo bihoraho, kandi bushingiye cyane kubushobozi bwumurwayi ku giti cye bwo kwakira, kumva, no kugumana amakuru kumvugo.
Impapuro zishingiye.
Uburyo bwa kabiri busanzwe. Igitabo cyose cyamakuru ku biro byita ku buzima kiri munsi yiki cyiciro. Ibyiza byibikoresho byacapwe nuko abarwayi bashobora gusubira kumakuru.
Inyigisho z'abarwayi zitangwa n'abashinzwe ubuzima babinyujije kurubuga rwe, portal yihariye, cyangwa EHR. Urubuga rushingiye kumurongo rushobora gutangwa muburyo bwa na.
Kwigisha abarwayi bafite ikoranabuhanga rya interineti birashobora kuba byiza haba mubikorwa byubuvuzi ndetse n’abarwayi kuko biha abashinzwe ubuzima amahirwe yo gukora ibikoresho byuburezi byuzuye bitangwa buri gihe, aho gushingira ku nama imbonankubone aho amakuru atangirwa n'umukozi. Abarwayi ntibakeneye ubumenyi bwa mudasobwa / urubuga rwo gukoresha ubu buryo bwo kwiga. Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe ku barwayi 3200 bwerekanye ko n’abarwayi batazi gukoresha mudasobwa banyuzwe n’uburezi bw’abarwayi kuri interineti mu rwego rwo kwiga ibijyanye n’ubuvuzi.

Monument Inc. ni isosiyete ikora itanga ubuvuzi kumurongo kubibazo. Itanga ubuvuzi hamwe nabaganga hamwe nitsinda ryamatsinda binyuze. Urwibutso rwashinzwe mu mu 2020 na Mike Russell. Kugeza 2023, yari ifite nibura abakoresha 100.000.
Rwiyemezamirimo Mike Russell yatangiye Urwibutso nyuma yo kugurisha ku nshuro ye ya gatatu, Paintzen, ubwo yamenyaga ko yari kandi ko arwana no. Urwibutso rwakiriye miliyoni 7.5 z'amadolari mu 2019 mbere yo gutangira ku mugaragaro mu ntangiriro za 2020.
Urwibutso rwabonye Tempest, urubuga rwa interineti rwo kwita ku kugarura inzoga, mu 2020.
Muri Werurwe 2023, Urwibutso rwatangaje ko rwashyize ahagaragara amakuru y’abakoresha ku masosiyete nka,, na binyuze mu gukoresha rwabo. Muri iryo tangazo rimwe, Urwibutso rwavuze ko bakuyeho imikoreshereze yose y’abakurikirana urubuga.

Lark Health nisosiyete i. Itanga urubuga rwa 24/7 rwubuforomo mubihe byigihe kirekire, rukoreshwa (AI) kandi rufite. Lark itanga kandi abaforomo ba AI kuvura diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 2, kwita ku hypertension, guhagarika itabi, gucunga ibibazo, umubyibuho ukabije, n'ibindi byinshi ku barwayi miliyoni 1.5.
Lark irazwi cyane ko yashyizwe kuri terefone zose muri 2014.
Lark yashinzwe na na Jeff Zira. Yabanje gukora monitor yubuzima bwibitotsi yambarwa kumaboko yumuntu. Yakozwe kugirango ikangure umuntu wambaye igikoresho atabangamiye undi muntu wese ushobora kuryama hafi. Ibicuruzwa ntibyatinze kugurishwa mububiko bwa ku isi yose.
Lark yaje kwibanda cyane kubwenge bwa artile kandi bike kubikoresho. Kugeza 2014, Lark yabanjirijwe kuri terefone zose.
Porogaramu ya Lark yibanda ku bihe bisanzwe bisanzwe nk'umubyibuho ukabije, kwirinda diyabete, diyabete, na hypertension. Gahunda yo Kurinda Diyabete (DPP) yemewe ku mugaragaro (CDC) nka DPP kuri interineti.
Ingaruka za Lark zasuzumwe n’ubushakashatsi bwasohotse mu "kinyamakuru cy’ubuvuzi bwa interineti bw’ubuvuzi bwa Diyabete",
Lark ifite gahunda zubuzima zihariye zibanda ku barwayi barwaye, prediabete cyangwa bafite ibyago byinshi byo kurwara, n'ubuzima muri rusange. Serivisi za Lark zitangwa kandi zihita zihuza hamwe na ishoboye kugenzura ibikoresho byubuzima nka murugo, abakurikirana ibikorwa, nubunini. Porogaramu zimwe zemerera porogaramu hamwe nibikoresho kimwe cyangwa byinshi byahujwe gukoreshwa.

COTTRARU ni coperative y'abantu bafite ubumuga bo mu karere ka Rubavu bibumbiye hamwe bagamije kwiteza imbere no kwikura mu bwigunge.
Abibumbuye muri koperative COTTRARU bakorera mu karere ka Rubavu.
Iyi koperative imaze hafi imyaka 15 abanyamuryango ifasha abanyamuryango bayo guhindura imibereho yabo nyuma yo guhuza imbaraga nk'abafite ubumuga.
Mu mujyi wa Rubavu, ku mupaka muto wa Petite Barrière, hari koperative y’abafite ubumuga yitwa COTTRARU, ibumbiyeho abagabo n’abagore bafite ubumuga
butandukanye batwara imizigo ku magare. Yashinzwe mu 2011 n’abantu 28, ubu ikaba ifite abanyamuryango 94, n’imigabane irenga miliyoni 2 Frw,
ndetse bari kubaka inzu ya koperative imaze gutwara asaga miliyoni 110 Frw.
Abanyamuryango bayo bavuga ko kwishyira hamwe byabahaye icyizere cy’ubuzima, bikabavana mu bwigunge n’ubusabirizi, ubu bakabasha kwitunga, kwishyurira abana amashuri, no kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’imiryango yabo.
Hari batangaje ko mbere bari mu buzima bwo kwiheba, ariko koperative yabahaye icyizere n’ubushobozi bwo gukora, kwihangira imirimo no gutunga imiryango yabo.
Ubuyobozi bwa COTTRARU.
Perezida wa koperative Niyonzima Vedaste, avuga ko iyi koperative yahinduye ubuzima bw’abanyamuryango bayo, ikabafasha kubona inguzanyo no kwiteza imbere.
Imibare ya NISR (2022) igaragaza ko 3.4% by’Abanyarwanda bafite ubumuga, kandi ko abafite akazi ari 30% gusa, ibyo bigaragaza icyuho mu kubona akazi, ariko COTTRARU ikaba urugero rw’uko bishoboka kwiteza imbere n’ubwo umuntu afite ubumuga.
Abayobozi b’amashyirahamwe y’abafite ubumuga na bo basaba abanyamakuru n’abafite ubumuga kwandika no kugaragaza ubushobozi bwabo kugira ngo bibere abandi icyitegererezo.
Mu magambo ya Perezida wa koperative, “Ubumuga si iherezo ry’ubuzima; iyo duhuriye hamwe tugahuza imbaraga, buri wese ashobora kubaka ejo hazaza heza.”

Invoke Image Display (Mu ikinyarwanda: Saba Ishusho Yerekana) (IID) ni Umwirondoro wa IHE woroshya umurimo wo guhuza sisitemu itazi amashusho nka EHRs, EMRs, PHRs, RIS nizindi sisitemu yamakuru hamwe na sisitemu izi amashusho nka, hamwe nogusangiza amashusho, by gutanga uburyo busanzwe bwo gusaba ko amashusho yerekana.
Gushyira mu bikorwa.
IID isobanura icyifuzo cyoroshye cya HTTP KUBONA gikubiyemo muri URL haba ikiranga umurwayi cyangwa urutonde rwibiranga ubushakashatsi, hamwe nuruhererekane ruto rwibipimo byerekana amabwiriza yo kwerekana imyitwarire.
Umwirondoro werekana ibisabwa kugirango werekane kugirango utange interineti yerekana amashusho yuzuye yo gusuzuma, niba ubisabwe. Imikoranire isabwa ikubiyemo guhinduranya, guhinduranya no gutekesha kimwe no kugendana amashusho.
Umutekano ukemurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo busanzwe bwa HTTP.
Iyerekana irashobora gufata ishusho ya mushakisha ishingiye kubireba, pome itandukanye, plugin cyangwa umukiriya mwinshi ushingiye kubireba cyangwa imashini itandukanye; gutabaza bikomeza kuba bimwe kandi ni agnostic kuburyo bwo kureba abareba.
Umwirondoro usobanuwe nkigice cya IHE Radiologiya Tekiniki ya Tekinike.

Amategeko yashyizwe muri Twine arashobora kugerageza imiterere ya sensor kandi, ashingiye kuri logique, kohereza ubutumwa ukoresheje cyangwa, gukora, cyangwa gucana. Irashobora gukora.
Igikoresho cyakozwe na Supermechanical muri Amerika giturutse ku nkunga yakusanyijwe kuri. Intego yabo yambere yari $ 35,000 nyamara bakusanyije $ 556.541 kubaterankunga 3.966 ku ya 3 Mutarama 2012.
