Akenshi, mucyumba gisakuza cyangwa cyuzuye abantu ntibishoboka ko umuntu ku giti cye gutandukanya ijwi rimwe muri benshi. Ibi bikunze kwiyongera n'ingaruka za acoustique yo mucyumba kumiterere yimvugo igaragara. Imfashanyigisho zumva zishobora kwagura no gutunganya aya majwi, no kunoza. Ariko, niba ijwi cyane mugihe rigeze kubateze amatwi, ndetse n'ibikoresho byiza byumvikana bizarwanira gukuraho ibimenyetso. Ibikoresho bifasha gutega amatwi bitanga ubundi buryo bwo guhuza n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere, ariko birashobora kuba bigoye kandi bitoroshye.
Ikoreshwa rusange mu gufasha abantu bigoye kumva (HOH) mukongera imbaraga no gutanga ibimenyetso byiza kubigereranyo by'urusaku (SNR). ALD irashobora gukoreshwa mu gufasha abantu HOH kumva televiziyo n'ibindi ikoresho by'amajwi, cyangwa gufasha abantu kumva imvugo binyuze muri cyangwa sisitemu, nko ahantu ho gusengera cyangwa gutanga ibiganiro.
Gukoresha mikoro idafite umugozi ishyizwe iruhande rw'umuntu uvuga ikuraho amajwi hagati yabo n'uwumva, ibyo bikaba bigabanya ingaruka zo kwisubiramo biturutse kuri acoustics yo mucyumba kibi, urusaku rw'inyuma ruzenguruka abumva, hamwe n'urusaku rw'inyuma ruzenguruka umuvugizi (ukoresheje mikoro yerekeza).
Igikoresho gifasha kumva gikunze gukoresha kugirango ifate isoko y'amajwi hafi y'inkomoko yayo kandi ikayitambutsa mu buryo butemewe hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo (FM), (IR), cyangwa ubundi buryo. Umuntu uri gutega amatwi arashobora gukoresha idafite umugozi kugirango ahuze ibimenyetso kandi yumve amajwi akunda. Hariiho kandi n'abandi baguzi ALDs nk'amasaha yo gutabaza hamwe no kunyeganyeza uburiri, stethoscopes yongerewe imbaraga, monitor y'abana, hamwe n'ibimenyetso byerekana inzogera z'umuryango. Ibikoresho byinshi bifasha kumva neza FM bikorera kumirongo cumi n'irindwi hagati ya 72.1000 na 75.800MHz.

Auto-text ni igice cyinyandiko ibanziriza, iboneka nkinyongera ku nshya yahimbwe, kandi igasabwa umwanditsi winyandiko na. Guhagarika auto-text irashobora kuba irimo, cyangwa. Irashobora guhitamo umwanditsi winyandiko ikoresheje menu cyangwa igatangwa mu buryo bwikora nyuma yo amagambo cyangwa inyuguti zihariye (cyangwa guhanura inyandiko), cyangwa ukongerwaho inyandiko mu buryo bwikora nyuma yo kwandika amagambo cyangwa inyuguti zihariye (ijambo / inyandiko irangiye).
Auto-text ibika umwanya wimyandikire yandika inyandiko nyinshi zisa, cyangwa ikora rifasha abafite ubumuga. Ubu bumuga bushobora kuba ubumuga butinda kugenda, cyangwa bigatera cyangwa, hamwe nindwara (urugero). Abantu bafite ubumuga bwo bandika kubikoresho bashobora kandi kungukirwa na Auto-text, kubera ko ishobora kwihutisha.
Ingero za software zitanga auto-text:

Assistive Technology Acts itanga inkunga ihuriweho na Minisiteri y’uburezi muri Amerika muri buri ntara n’intara kugira ngo ishyigikire "Imbaraga za Leta zo kunoza itangwa ry’ikoranabuhanga rifasha abantu bafite ubumuga bw’ingeri zose binyuze muri gahunda rusange z’ubufasha bujyanye n’ikoranabuhanga." Ifashayobora Technologies ni ibikoresho, ibintu cyangwa ibikoresho bikoreshwa mugutezimbere cyangwa kugumana imikorere yumuntu ufite ubumuga. Ibi bizafasha umuntu ufite ubumuga kwigenga mubuzima, ibi birimo: uburezi, imyidagaduro, nibikorwa byose bya buri munsi. Serivisi zitangwa kubufasha bwa tekinoroji zirimo kuba ushobora gukoresha ibikoresho bya AT, gusuzuma ibikoresho, hamwe no kubungabunga byose birimo, nko kubitunganya, gusana, n'amahugurwa. Mu mategeko agenga ikoranabuhanga, inkunga ya leta ihabwa buri gihugu gutera inkunga umushinga w’ikoranabuhanga (ATAP) utanga serivisi kubantu bafite ubumuga, imiryango yabo, abarezi nibindi byinshi mubuzima bwabo. Igikorwa, cyatowe bwa mbere mu 1988, kirangira buri mwaka kandi kigomba guhora kivugururwa kugirango serivisi zishobore gukoreshwa.
Kugeza ubu, hari gahunda 56 za Leta AT. Hariho gahunda kuri leta zose uko ari 50, intara 4 zo muri Amerika, hamwe na Porto Rico n'akarere ka Columbiya. Ku bantu bagera ku 50.000.000 bafite ubumuga muri Amerika, izi gahunda zirahari kugira ngo zibafashe mu guhitamo no kubona "", risobanurwa nk'igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose cyabafasha gukora imirimo bitoroshye cyangwa bidashoboka. Abahawe inkunga 56 basabwa gukora ibikorwa byabo byubahwa kurwego rwa leta nibikorwa byubuyobozi bwa leta. Abahawe inkunga bagomba kumenyesha abantu bafite ubumuga kuri Technologies Technologies, aho bayakira, nuburyo bwo kubona Technologies Technologies.
Imfashanyo ijyanye n'ikoranabuhanga ku bantu bafite ubumuga (. 100–407), ryatowe bwa mbere mu 1988, ryemewe mu 1994 (. 103–218) na none muri 1998 (. 105–394 (text)). Yashyizweho nka sisitemu yo guhindura inkunga kandi bakunze kwita "Tech Act" mugihe gito. Kongere yemeje iri tegeko hagamijwe kongera uburyo bwo kugera, kuboneka, n’inkunga y’ikoranabuhanga rifasha binyuze mu mbaraga za Leta na gahunda z’igihugu. Itegeko ryo mu 1998 ryongeye gushimangira ko ikoranabuhanga ari igikoresho cy'ingirakamaro gishobora gukoreshwa mu kuzamura imibereho y'Abanyamerika bafite ubumuga. Hifashishijwe guverinoma abantu benshi bari kwemererwa kubona ibikoresho nibikoresho batigeze batekereza ko bazabona amahirwe yo gutunga.
Intara zose n’intara za Amerika byahawe umushinga wa Tech Act. Itsinda rya mbere ryimishinga ryatangiye mu 1989. Buri mushinga wa leta wari ufite imyaka itanu yinkunga nkuko amategeko ya 1989 abiteganya. Gusaba inkunga irushanwa byasabwaga kubona andi myaka itanu y'amafaranga. Imishinga yijejwe imyaka umunani inkunga yuzuye; umwaka wa cyenda kuri 75% yinkunga yuzuye; n'umwaka wa cumi nkumushinga wa Tech Act kuri 50% yinkunga yuzuye.
Amategeko ashyigikira imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga ifasha leta yari ateganijwe kurenga ku ya 30 Nzeri 2004. Itegeko rigenga ikoranabuhanga ryo mu 2004 (.Tooltip Amategeko rusange (Amerika) 108–364 (inyandiko) (PDF)) yemereye porogaramu y’ikoranabuhanga ifasha muri leta zose n’intara mu gihe cyimyaka itanu nka gahunda ishingiye kuri formula, kandi ikuraho amategeko.
Itegeko ry'ikoranabuhanga rifasha mu 2004.
Itegeko rigenga ikoranabuhanga ryo mu 2004, ryashyizweho umukono na Perezida George W. Bush, ryemeje ko inkunga ikomeye y’ikoranabuhanga rifasha ikomeza. Gukomeza icyo gikorwa byatumye abantu benshi bafite ubumuga bakomeza kwitabira ibikorwa bya buri munsi. Mugihe iki gikorwa cyakozwe mu 1988, impinduka nyinshi zabaye igihe byakomezaga muri 2004. Imwe mu mpinduka zikomeye zazanywe na Active Technology Act yo mu 2004 ni uguhindura intego. Ibikorwa byabanje byibanze ku gufasha ibihugu kubaka "sisitemu zo kunoza uburyo bwo kubona ibikoresho byikoranabuhanga bifasha ababana nubumuga." Itegeko ry’ikoranabuhanga rya Assistive ryo mu 2004 rihindura amategeko abanziriza itegeko rya Assistive Technology ryo mu 1998 kugira ngo rivugurure kandi ryemererwe porogaramu ya Active Technology Act. Impinduka mu itegeko rigenga ikoranabuhanga ryemerera umunyamabanga w’uburezi gutanga inkunga y’ikoranabuhanga ifasha kujya muri Leta gukomeza gahunda z’igihugu cyose. Porogaramu izafasha ababana n'ubumuga, abagize umuryango, abarezi, abahagarariye uburenganzira, n'abunganira kubona Technologies Technologies '. Byongeye kandi, impinduka mu 2004 ku nkunga ya Assistive Technology isaba leta gukoresha amafaranga mu bikorwa bya leta. Ibikorwa byo ku rwego rwa Leta birimo gahunda yo gutera inkunga, ikubiyemo gahunda y'inguzanyo yo gufasha mu kubona no gutera inkunga serivisi zifasha ikoranabuhanga n'ibikoresho. Inguzanyo y'Ikoreshwa rya Tekinoroji Yemerera abantu kuguza Ikoranabuhanga rya Assistive mugihe gito cyo gukoresha no kumenya niba igikoresho cyujuje ibyo bakeneye mbere yo kugura ibicuruzwa bya tekinoroji. Na none, Serivisi ishinzwe gutera inkunga Tekinoroji ya Leta yemerera ababana nubumuga kugura / kubona inguzanyo zamafaranga zitanga ubufasha bwa Technologie kubaguzi ku giciro gito binyuze mumasoko y’ikoranabuhanga ridafasha cyangwa bivuye mu mufuka. Mubyongeyeho, porogaramu izafasha mugukoresha ibikoresho bifasha abaguzi gusana ibicuruzwa byabo, gusanwa, no guhindurwa. Serivise ifasha ikorana buhanga ryemerera abandi bantu bafite ubumuga kongera gukoresha Technologies Technologies itagikoreshwa cyangwa ikenewe na nyirayo wambere. Ibi bituma ababana nubumuga bakira Ikoranabuhanga rifasha hamwe no kuzigama amafaranga menshi. Na none, iyi gahunda izafasha kubona inguzanyo kubikoresho bifite imyiyerekano izafasha mubikorwa byo gutanga amakuru.
Ibikorwa bya gahunda ya tekinoroji ya leta.
Bitewe n'imbaraga za gahunda ya Leta ishinzwe ikoranabuhanga, miliyoni z'abanyamerika bafite ubumuga barashobora kujya ku kazi, kujya ku ishuri, kwitabira ibikorwa by'imyidagaduro, kandi bakagira uruhare mu baturage babo. Ibikorwa bya Leta byagezweho muri make buri mwaka murwego rwo gutanga raporo ya tekinoroji. Incamake y'ibyo byagezweho yateguwe n'ishyirahamwe rya porogaramu ifasha ikoranabuhanga; kopi yuzuye ya buri gahunda ya Leta urashobora kuyisanga muri sisitemu yigihugu yamakuru yo gufasha ikoranabuhanga.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imishinga ifasha ikorana buhanga (ATAP) n’umuryango w’igihugu udaharanira inyungu washinzwe mu 1997 kandi uterwa inkunga n’itegeko rya federasiyo ifasha mu kugenzura gahunda za Leta AT. ATAP yashyizeho umuyoboro w’ikoranabuhanga ufasha ibihugu gusangira umutungo, kuganira ku bibazo, gutanga inkunga, gukora ubushakashatsi, kunganira gahunda n’amategeko, no gutanga uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga rifasha. ATAP irareba, "kubungabunga no guteza imbere urusobe rukomeye, rukora neza, kandi rukora neza muri gahunda y’igihugu ikoranabuhanga rya Leta..." urwego. Izi gahunda zigomba kumenyekana kandi mugihe hashyizweho amategeko menshi hazitabwaho cyane tekinoloji yose ifasha yakoze kugirango ifashe ababana nubumuga.
Buri Leta ifite gahunda zayo bwite zishobora kuboneka muri sisitemu yigihugu yamakuru yo gufasha ikoranabuhanga. Intara imaze gutorwa uzasanga iryo zina ryihariye rya leta ifasha ikorana buhanga hamwe na aderesi hamwe n’aho ushobora kubasanga. Muri ayo makuru uzahasanga ibisobanuro byubuhanga bwa leta bufasha bwashyizweho, uburyo bwujuje ibisabwa na leta, hamwe nubusobanuro bugufi bwikoranabuhanga ryatanzwe. Mubisobanuro, uyikoresha azabona noneho Umwirondoro wa Porogaramu ugabanijwemo ibice bitandatu:
Amategeko yo guhanga udushya n'abakozi.
Ku ya 22 Nyakanga 2014, Perezida Barack Obama yashyizweho umukono n'itegeko (WIOA) ryashyizweho n'abakozi (WIOA WIOA itanga abantu bashaka akazi bafite amahirwe yo kubona akazi, akazi keza cyane, uburezi, amahugurwa, serivisi zifasha ababana n'ubumuga kandi igahuza abakozi bafite ubumenyi n’abakoresha kugirango bateze imbere abakozi ba Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika. WIOA yagize ingaruka ku itegeko rigenga ikoranabuhanga ryo mu 2004 yimura ubuyobozi bwa AT Act mu buyobozi bwa serivisi zita ku buzima busanzwe mu ishami ry’uburezi ku buyobozi bw’umuryango utuye mu ishami ry’ubuzima na serivisi z’abantu. Ubuyobozi bw'Imibereho Myiza y'Abaturage buyobora Igice cya 4, 5 n'icya 6 bya gahunda n'ibikorwa bya AT Act. WIOA yimuye Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubumuga, ubuzima bwigenga, n’ubushakashatsi bwo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe kuva mu ishami ry’uburezi kwimurira mu buyobozi bw’umuryango utuye (ACL). Gushyira hamwe gahunda zose zita kubumuga bituma ACL "yongerera ubwigenge, imibereho myiza, nubuzima bwabantu bakuru ndetse nabafite ubumuga, nimiryango nabarezi bombi" kandi bagasohoza inshingano zabo zo guha ababana nubumuga a ubuzima bwiza.

The curb cut effect ni ibiryo ibintu byateganyijwe gufasha abafite ubumuga bikunda gukoreshwa no gushimwa n'abantu benshi kurusha abo byari byagenewe. Ikintu cyitiriwe curb cuts – miniature ramps igizwe nibice byumuhanda zabanje gukorwa kugirango intebe y’ibimuga igere ahantu runaka, ariko kandi yakiriwe nabantu basunika amagare, amagare cyangwa imizigo. Curb cuts ubu aboneka hose kandi ntakigaragara cyane nk'ikintu-cyagenewe gufasha abafite ubumuga kubona aho banyura. Urundi rugero ni ukumva abantu bakoresha televiziyo ifunze.
The curb cut effect ni igice cy'ibishushanyo mbonera rusange, ari cyo gishushanya no gutegura ibidukikije ku bushake kugirango bibashe gukoreshwa n'abantu bose, hatitawe ku bushobozi cyangwa ubumuga bafite. The curb effect gato n'igishushanyo mbonera rusange kuko curb cut phenomenon akenshi iba itabigambiriye aho kuba intego, ariko bivamo ibisubizo bisa.
Hano hari ingero zimwe zo kugabanya ingaruka.
The curb effect zabaye ibintu bigaragara mugihe societe igenda ishyira mu bikorwa ibidukikije bigerwaho kandi byuzuye. The curb effect harimo ingaruka zirimo kongera ubumenyi kubijyanye nigishushanyo mbonera rusange mubaturage muri rusange. Kuba ibintu byinshi byaragenewe mbere kugabanya inzitizi z’abafite ubumuga byakoreshejwe kandi bishimwa n’abantu bo hanze y’abaturage bateganijwe mbere byashishikarije abantu bose gushushanya. Kugabanya kugabanya ingaruka byongera inyungu zubukungu harimo gushyiramo amazu menshi yinjira mubucuruzi.

Chairiot solo ni igare ry'abafite ubumuga rishobora kugerwaho na microcar yakozwe na Chairiot Mobility Inc. Nimwe mumamodoka make kubakoresha amagare yabugenewe y'abafite ubumuga kubw'ibyo, kandi ntabwo ahinduka.
Yatangijwe mu mwaka 2014, ni imodoka imwe, ifite amashanyarazi yemerera umuntu ufite ubumuga ugenda mu kagare k’abamuga kuzunguruka mu modoka akoresheje icyuma cy’inyuma n’igitambambuga, kandi agakingira intebe y’abafite ubumuga aho atwara. Chairiot solo igenewe gutwara ibinyabiziga mu mijyi, ntabwo ikoreshwa mu nzira nyabagendwa, kandi yujuje ubuziranenge bw’umutekano w’ibinyabiziga bya Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika DOT nk’imodoka yihuta cyangwa ituranye n’amashanyarazi (NEV) munsi ya FMVSS 571.500. Yemerera abashoferi bari mu magare y’abafite ubumuga gukoresha imodoka badasize abafite ubumuga babo, kandi bikekwa ko ari yo modoka ya mbere nk'iyi yagiye kugurishwa ku isoko ry’Amerika.
Chairiot solo ntabwo ihinduka, yateguwe kuva yatangira gutwarwa n'umuntu ufite ubumuga ukoresheje igare ry'abafite ubumuga. Ikinyabiziga cyinjira mu muryango munini w'inyuma hamwe n'igitambambuga cyuzuye igorofa yo hasi irinda intebe y'imuga kumodoka. Igenzurwa na ruline ifite ipikipiki, hamwe no guhuza impinduramatwara hamwe na feri yo gufata feri. Igenzura ryose rirakoreshwa hamwe nimbaraga zo hejuru zo m'umubiri. Nta modoka y'ibirenge iri mu modoka.
Chairiot solo igaragaramo umubiri uhuriweho hamwe kuri chassis y'icyuma, umuryango w'inyuma nawo uhujwe, hamwe n'icyuma cyuzuye. Ihagarikwa ry'imbere ni ibyifuzo bibiri hamwe na rack-na-pinion. Ihagarikwa ry'inyuma n'igishushanyo cy'amaboko gikurikiranye hamwe na torsion tube yigenga igenzura ibiziga by'inyuma. Ifite feri y'ibiziga bine.
Chairiot solo ikoreshwa na moteri ya twin hub ifite amanota 3kilo imwe yubatswe mubiziga by'inyuma. Amapaki ya batiri ya volt 48 ya AGM ifite ubushobozi bwa nomero 7.5 kW itanga imbaraga zo gusunika, bateri y'ingoboka ya volt 12 ibikwa n'ububiko bukuru kandi igatanga ingufu kubikoresho by'amashanyarazi. Mu gihe habaye ikibazo cya moteri, Chairiot ishobora gukomeza gutwarwa na moteri imwe gusa. Igishushanyo gikoresha ingufu zitanga intera ya kilometero 40 kugeza kuri 50 k'umurongo wuzuye. Mu gihe cyo gupima imijyi ya EPA, Chairiot solo yageze kuri peteroli igera kuri 157 MPGe.
Chairiot solo yemejwe n’ikigo gishinzwe umutungo w’ikirere cya Californiya (CARB) nk’imodoka zangiza. Ishyirahamwe ry’abacuruzi b’ibikoresho by’imodoka (NMEDA) ryatangaje muri Werurwe mu mwaka 2015 ko Chairiot solo yatsinze gahunda yayo yo gusuzuma (CRP); niyo modoka ya mbere yihuta cyane, igare ry’abafite ubumuga ryagerwaho ku isi ryemejwe n’ubuyobozi bwigenga kugira ngo ryubahirize ibipimo ngenderwaho by’umutekano w’ibinyabiziga muri Amerika (FMVSS) 571.500.

Imyandikire y'Amarenga y'Abanyamerika (AMA) ni inyuguti y'intoki yongerera amagambo y'ururimi rw'amarenga y'abafite ubumuga b'Abanyamerika.
Inzandiko n'imibare.
Inyuguti n'imibare byashyizweho umukono k'uburyo bukurikira. Mu buryo butemewe, ibiganza by'intoki ntabwo bikozwe neza nkuko biri mu buryo busanzwe.Imyandikire y'intoki ishobora gukoreshwa ku maboko yombi, mubusanzwe ikiganza cyiganje ni ukuvuga ukuboko kw'iburyo kuburyo bw'iburyo, ukuboko kwi bumoso k'ubumoso. Kenshi na kenshi, inyuguti z'intoki zashyizweho umukono munsi y'igitugu cyiganjemo umukono. Iyo ikoreshejwe mu bindi bimenyetso cyangwa m'urwego ibyo bidashoboka, iri tegeko rusange rirashobora kwirengagizwa.
J na Z birimo kugenda. J ninjye ufite impinduramatwara y'intoki, ku buryo urutoki ruto rukurikirana umurongo w'uburyo bwanditse bw'inyuguti, Z ni urutoki rwerekanwe inyuma n'inyuma, ku buryo urutoki rukurikirana imiterere ya zig-zag y'inyuguti Z. Izi "tracings" zombi zakozwe nkuko bigaragara kubasinyiye niba ari ukuboko kw'iburyo, nkuko bigaragazwa n'amashusho ari muri ibi ingingo. Iyo wasinywe n'ikiganza cy'ibumoso, icyerekezo kiri mu mashusho y'indorerwamo, kubw'ibyo ntibisubizwa kubareba. Ariko, abasinya neza ntibakeneye "gusoma" imiterere yibi bikorwa.
Mu bishushanyo byinshi cyangwa amashusho yerekana Inyuguti mfashanyigisho y'Abanyamerika, zimwe mu nyuguti zerekanwa kuva kuruhande kugira ngo zerekane neza imiterere y'intoki. Kurugero, inyuguti "G" na "H" zerekanwa kenshi k'uruhande kugira ngo zerekane umwanya w'intoki. Ariko, basinyishije ukuboko mumwanya udafite aho ubogamiye, ikiganza cyerekeje k'uruhande n'intoki zerekeza imbere.
Inyuguti nyinshi zifite imiterere y'intoki imwe, kandi itandukanijwe n'icyerekezo. Izi ni "h" na "u", "k" na "p" igikumwe ku rutoki rwo hagati, "g" na "q" kandi, mu buryo butemewe, "d" na "g / q". Mu gusinya byihuse, "n" itandukanijwe na "h / u" icyerekezo. Inyuguti "a" na "s" zifite icyerekezo kimwe, kandi zirasa cyane mu buryo. Igikumwe kiri k'uruhande rw'ikiganza mu nyuguti "a", imbere ya "s". Iyo ikoreshejwe mu magambo y'icyongereza yanditseho n'urutoki, inyuguti z'intoki zishobora kwerekanwa ukundi kuruta niba zihagarara zonyine.
Injyana, umuvuduko no kugenda.
Iyo urutoki, n'ikiganza kiri m'urwego rwo hejuru, ntabwo isunika hamwe na buri baruwa. Inyuguti ebyiri mu ijambo zashyizweho umukono mu buryo butandukanye, binyuze m'ukuboko kw'amaboko, kunyerera kw'amaboko, cyangwa gusubiramo ikimenyetso cy'urwandiko. Inzandiko zashyizweho umukono ku muvuduko uhoraho, kuruhuka imikorere nk'ijambo rigabanya. Ibaruwa ya mbere ishobora gufatwa kuburebure bw'inyuguti y'inyongera nk'ibisobanuro uwasinye ari hafi gutangira gutunga urutoki.
Urutoki rukoreshwa cyane cyane mu gutiza amagambo mu cyongereza. Ubusanzwe ikoreshwa gusa mu bihe byihariye. Ibikurikira ni amagambo ashobora gukenera kwandikwa n'urutoki, amazina akwiye, amazina y'ikirango, amazina y'ikibanza, nandi magambo yose adafite ikimenyetso gisanzwe. Mu bindi bihe, koresha urutoki gake.
Guhinduka no gutandukana mu bitabo by'intoki.
Kimwe n'izindi ndimi, Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abanyamerika ruhora rutera imbere. Mu gihe impinduka z'intoki zidashoboka, impinduka nke ziracyagaragara mu gihe. Imyandikire y'intoki irasa uyumunsi kuruta uko byari bimeze mumyaka mirongo ishize. Urugero rw'ibanze rw'ubu buryo bwo guhinduka ruboneka muri "gutaka 'E'". Ibisekuru byakera by'abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva baracyashimangira ko ishusho ya "E" isaba ko igikumwe gikora inama y'intoki nintoki zo hagati. Hagati aho, ibisekuru bikiri bito bitangiye kubyara ishusho itandukanya igikumwe n'izindi ntoki k'uruhande rwo hasi rw'ikigazi.
Icyongereza n'inyuguti z'intoki.
Kubera ko urutoki rwatunganijwe mbere m'urwego rwo kwinjiza ururimi rw'icyongereza mururimi rw'amarenga, bifitanye isano rya bugufi n'icyongereza. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko abatumva batunganya uburyo bwo gusoma no gutunga urutoki kimwe. Kubera iyo mpamvu, gutunga urutoki byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku gusoma no kutumva abana. Uyu mwanzuro waremewe cyane, ariko habayeho impaka zishingiye ku buryo bwo kwigisha bukoresha neza iyo sano.
Ururimi rw'amarenga na Fonetika yarwo.
Fonetika ntabwo igomba guhagarikwa kumvugo gusa ariko ishobora no gukoreshwa mu gihe wasinyiye abandi. Iyo usinya, imvugo y'umuntu ishobora kumenya cyane ibizava mubyo bagerageza kuvugana n'undi muntu. K'urugero, niba uwasinye yagerageje gusinyira ko basaze, bakoreshaga mu maso hamwe n'ururimi rw'umubiri kugira ngo bamenye neza uko bamerewe. N'ubwo imvugo ivugwa nayo ikoresha ubu buryo bwo kwerekana, ntabwo bashingirwaho cyane nk'ururimi rw'amarenga. Imvugo y'imvugo mvugo n'ururimi rw'amarenga birasa kuko imvugo ivugwa ikoresha ijwi ry'ijwi kugira ngo umenye uko umuntu ameze kandi ururimi rw'amarenga rukoresha isura yo mu maso kugira ngo umenye uko umuntu ameze. Fonetika byanze bikunze bifitanye isano n'ururimi ruvugwa gusa ariko irashobora no gukoreshwa m'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abanyamerika (ASL). Iyo winjiye muri ASL, abantu ntibasinya amagambo nkuko yavuzwe. Isano iri hagati y'imvugo ivugwa na ASL iratandukanye kuko hariho isano hagati y'ibimenyetso bimwe n'amagambo yabo kandi bigasinywa ukundi kuko ASL itashyizweho umukono nkuko bivugwa.

ElevenLabs ni sosiyete ikora software kabuhariwe mu gutezimbere imvugo yumvikanisha imvugo hamwe na software y'imvugo, ikoresheje ubwenge bw'ubukorikori hamwe no kwiga byimbitse.
Yamenyekanye nka imwe mu ma sosiyete akomeye inyuma ya AI Spring igikomeje.
ElevenLabs yashinzwe mu mwaka 2022 na Piotr Dąbkowski, wahoze ari injeniyeri wiga imashini kubijyanye na Google hamwe na Mateusz Staniszewski, ushinzwe ingamba z'ibijyanye no kohereza Palantir. Bombi bakuriye mu gihugu cya Polonye, kandi imbaraga zabo zo gushinga ElevenLabs bivugwa ko zaturutse mu kureba filime zitwa izidahagije filime zo muri America.
Dąbkowski na Staniszewski babanje gusuzuma uburyo butandukanye bwo gutera inkunga, harimo amahirwe yo gukorana nokwihuta gutangira. Muri Mutarama mu mwaka 2023 bagaragaje ko babonye inkunga zingana na miliyoni 2 z'amadolari yo muri Amerika. Umwihariko wo gutangiza ubwenge bw'ijwi rya AI, ururwego rukomeje kugaragara mu bihugu by'Iburayi, yagize uruhare runini mu gukurura abashoramari. Inkunga yabanjirije imbuto yari iyobowe cyane na Credo Ventures, kandi ifatanya na Concept Ventures.
Muri Mutarama mu mwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yashyize ahagaragara k'umugaragaro beta yayo.
Muri kamena mu mwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yakusanyije miliyoni 19 z'amadorali y’uruhererekane A inkunga ingana na miliyoni 100 z'amadolari, nubwo isosiyete idafite ibiro ndetse n’abakozi 15 gusa. Inkunga yatanzwe yari iyobowe n’ikigo cy’imari ni shoramari Andreessen Horowitz, Nat Friedman wahoze ari umuyobozi wa GitHub, na rwiyemezamirimo Daniel Gross. Yagaragaje kandi uruhare rw’abantu bakomeye nka SV Angel, Mike Krieger (washinze Instagram), Brendan Iribe (washinze Oculus), Mustafa Suleyman (washinze Deepmind), na Tim O'Reilly (washinze O'Reilly Media). Byatangajwe kandi ko Andreessen Horowitz azinjira mu buyobozi bwa ElevenLabs.
Ku ya 22 Mutarama mu mwaka 2024, ElevenLabs yakusanyije miliyoni 80 z’amadolari y’Amerika mu nkunga B yazamuye igiciro cya sosiyete igera kuri miliyari 1.1. Kubijyanye n'inkunga yatanzwe yari iyobowe na Andreessen Horowitz, Friedman, Gross, na Sequoia Capital. Byongeye kandi kuribyo, sosiyete yatangaje urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa bishya, nk'isoko ryabo ry'ijwi, Studio ya AI Dubbing, hamwe na porogaramu igendanwa.
ElevenLabs izwi cyane cyane kuri mushakisha ishingiye kuri AI, ifashwa na AI n'inyandiko y'imvugo, Speech Synthesis, ishobora kubyara imvugo ubuzima bwose muguhuza amarangamutima n'ijwi. Isosiyete ivuga ko porogaramu zayo zubatswe mu rwego rwo guhindura intonasiyo n'umuvuduko wo gutanga hashingiwe ku bijyanye no kwinjiza ururimi rukoreshwa. Ikoresha algorithms yateye imbere kugira ngo isesengure ibintu bijyanye n'inyandiko, igamije kumenya amarangamutima nk'umujinya, umubabaro, umunezero, cyangwa gutabaza, ituma sisitemu yumva imyumvire y'umukoresha, bikavamo kugera kubintu bifatika kandi bisa nk'abantu.. Gutangira biri mubikorwa byo gutanga ipatanti. Binyuze kurubuga rwa beta, abayikoresha bashobora gutanga inyandiko no kubyara dosiye z'amajwi uhereye kumajwi asanzwe. Abakoresha bishyura bahabwa ubushobozi bwo kohereza amajwi yihariye kugira ngo bakore uburyo bushya bw'ijwi bakoresheje igikoresho cyogukoresha amajwi y'ikigo.
Isomero ry'Ijwi ni ikintu kiranga sosiyete mu buryo bwo gusangira imyirondoro idasanzwe y'ijwi ryakozwe hakoreshejwe cyangwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ryabo. Ijwi ryateguwe mbere y'ijwi ryemerera abakoresha mu guhitamo ijwi rihuye neza n'ibyifuzo byabo, aho kurema imwe. Ikindi gikoresho cyitwa VoiceLab cyemerera abakoresha clone amajwi avuye mu bice bike by'amajwi kandi bishobora gukora amajwi mashya.
Ku taliki ya 20 Kamena mu mwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yasohoye igikoresho cyo kumenyekanisha AI cyitwa AI Speech Classifier, ivuga ko ari cyo cya mbere cyacyo. Igikoresho kiragerwaho binyuze muri API kandi cyashizweho kugira ngo hamenyekane niba icyitegererezo cy'amajwi yoherejwe gikomoka kuri tekinoroji ya AI ya ElevenLabs. Isosiyete yagaragaje ubushake bwo gufatanya n’abandi bateza imbere AI mu gushyiraho sisitemu yo kumenya isi yose ishobora kwakirwa mu nganda zose.
Muri Nyakanga mu kwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yatangaje Imishinga irimo, igikoresho cyo gukora ibintu birebire byavuzwe nk'ibitabo by'amajwi n'ibice by'ibiganiro hamwe n'amajwi akoreshwa neza. Igikoresho cyasohotse muri Nzeri. Muri Kanama, ElevenLabs yagize ubushobozi bwo gutanga amajwi mu ndimi 28. Ukoresheje icyitegererezo cya AI, yahise itahura indimi zirimo nkiza Abanyakoreya, Abadage, na Viyetinamu, bigatuma habaho abakire mu marangamutima bakomoka mu ndimi nyinshi zitandukanye. Isosiyete yatangaje kandi ko ikoranabuhanga ryayo ryasohotse ku mugaragaro icyiciro cya beta.
Mu Kwakira mu mwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yerekanye "AI Dubbing," igikoresho gishobora guhindura imvugo mu ndimi zirenga 20. Ibiranga ubushobozi bwo kurinda ijwi ry'umwimerere w'umuvugizi, amarangamutima, hamwe nintonasiyo, ukoresheje uburyo bwihariye kugira ngo ukemure imirimo nko kuvanaho urusaku, gutandukanya abavuga, kwandukura, no guhuza imvugo yahinduwe hamwe n'ijwi ry'umwimerere ryanyaryo.
Imikoreshereze ya cumi na rimwe ikoreshwa mu rwego rw'imirenge.
Abakora imirimo bakoresheje ElevenLabs kuri podcasts, kuvuga, no kwerekana urwenya. Muri Werurwe mu mwaka 2023, umunyarwenya Drew Carey yakoresheje igikoresho cyo gukoresha amajwi ya ElevenLabs kugira ngo yongere ijwi rye mu gice cya radiyo ye, "ku wa gatanu nijoro Freakout". Muri Mata mu mwaka 2023, umunyamakuru wa televiziyo na radiyo yo muri Polonye, Jaroslaw Kuzniar, yakoresheje na verisiyo y’ijwi rye kugira ngo atange urukurikirane rwa podcast ku ntambara yo muri Ukraine. Seth Godin yakoresheje kandi ElevenLabs kugira ngo avuge podcast ye yibanze kuri AI.
Muri Werurwe mu mwaka 2023, Super-Hi-Fi, serivise yo gutangiza amakuru, yafatanyije na ElevenLabs gutanga serivise yuzuye ya radiyo yiswe "AI Radio", ikoresheje porogaramu ya ElevenLabs kugira ngo ivuze uburyo bwo kuvanga imiziki mu buryo busanzwe ivuye mu bisobanuro byatanzwe na ChatGPT. ElevenLabs yakoreshejwe kandi mu kuvuga imikino no kuvuga amajwi y'imikino ku bufatanye n’umushinga w’imikino wo mu gihugu cya Suwede witwa Paradox Interactive hamwe na Magicave ikorera mu gihugu cy'Ubwongereza.
Abanyamaji n'abanditsi bakoresheje ElevenLabs mu kuvuga ibitabo n'amajwi. Ku ya 13 Kamena 2023, Storytel yatangaje ubufatanye bwihariye na sosiyete. Muri ubwo bufatanye, ElevenLabs ikora amajwi ajyanye n’amasoko yibanze ya Storytel no gukora ibitabo by'amajwi byavuzwe na AI. Imiterere ihindura amajwi yitwa VoiceSwitcher yashyizwe mubikorwa kugirango itezimbere abakoresha, itanga ubunararibonye bwo gutegera bwihariye kuri buri muntu.
ElevenLabs yakoreshejwe mugukora amajwi yo gukina amashusho mu ndimi zitandukanye, harimo nabashinzwe gukora ibintu. Ihuriro rifite ubushobozi bwo kwigana neza imvugo iyo ari yo yose mu rurimi urwo arirwo rwose. Abafana b'ibyamamare bakoresheje ElevenLabs mugukora ubutumwa butera inkunga bakoresheje amajwi y'ibyamamare bakunda.
Muri Gashyantare, umunyamakuru wa VICE, Joseph Cox, yatangaje ibyagaragaye ko yanditse iminota itanu yivugiye hanyuma akoresha ElevenLabs mu gukora amajwi yimbitse yatsinze sisitemu yo kwemeza amajwi ya banki.
ElevenLabs ishyiraho amabwiriza asobanutse yerekeranye no gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ryayo, ibuza gutondekanya amajwi hagamijwe gutukana nko kuriganya, ivangura, imvugo yangwa, cyangwa guhohotera k'umurongo, nubwo ishyigikira ikoreshwa ry'urubuga rwayo kuri karikatire, parody na satire kandi Imvugo y'ubuhanzi na politiki igira uruhare mu biganiro mbwirwaruhame. Isosiyete yemeza ko ifite uburenganzira bwo guhagarika konti n'ibirimo by'abakoresha basanze binyuranyije n'aya mabwiriza, kandi inagaragaza ko yiyemeje gufatanya n'abayobozi no gutanga raporo ku bikorwa binyuranyije n'amategeko hakurikijwe ibisabwa.
Nyuma yo gushyirwa ahagaragara muri Mutarama mu mwaka 2023, ElevenLabs yongerewe imbaraga kandi ishimirwa ubwiza bw’ijwi ryayo, ibihe byihuta, ndetse n urwego rw'ubuntu. Yashimiwe kandi k'ubushobozi ifite bwo kuvuga neza amazina afite imvugo idasanzwe, ikemura ikibazo gikunze kugaragara mubikoresho bisa n'ibikunze guhuza cyane cyane amazina y'uburengerazuba. Sosiyete yageze ku bakoresha barenga miliyoni biyandikishije hagati yo kuyitangiza muri Kamena mu mwaka 2023.
ElevenLabs yanenzwe nyuma y’uko abayikoresha bashoboye gukoresha porogaramu zayo kugira ngo batange amagambo atavugwaho rumwe mu buryo bw’ijwi ry’ibyamamare, abayobozi ba Leta, ndetse n’abandi bantu bazwi, bikurura abantu cyane nyuma y’abakoresha kuri 4chan yakoresheje igikoresho cyo gusangira ubutumwa. Ubushobozi bwa software bwo gukoporora hafi amajwi nyayo byazamuye impungenge zimyitwarire, abayinenga babifata nk'uburyo bwimbitse. Mu gusubiza, isosiyete yavuze ko izakora ku kugabanya ihohoterwa rishobora gukoreshwa binyuze mu kurinda no kugenzura indangamuntu. Sosiyete yaje kubona uburyo bwo gukoresha amajwi y’abafatabuguzi bahembwa, ivuga ko hasabwa gutanga amakuru y’ubwishyu mu rwego rwo kunoza ibyo babazwa, kandi ishyira mu bikorwa ibihano ku bakoresha barenze ku masezerano ya serivisi.
Impungenge zagaragaye z’inyongera zagarutsweho ku bijyanye n’imyitwarire y’isoko ku mahugurwa ya ElevenLabs, hamwe n’abakinnyi benshi batandukanye bavuga ko ElevenLabs habayeho kuba yakoresheje ingero z’amajwi yabo batabanje kubiherwa uruhushya cyangwa uburenganzira. ElevenLabs, hamwe nandi masosiyete yo mucyiciro cyayo, byagaragaye rero ko ari ikibazo gishobora gutera urwego rukora amajwi.

Gnome Subtitles ni umwanditsi wa ya, ishingiye kuri. Ifasha inyandiko zisanzwe zishingiye kumyandikire, kureba amashusho, igihe cyo guhuza hamwe no guhindura ibisobanuro.
Gnome Subtitles ni yasohotse munsi ya.
Gnome Subtitles ishyigikira imiterere ya subtitle izwi cyane, nka (kandi na), na.
Ifite interineti, ishyigikira (gushira amanga, italike no gushushanya imiterere) hamwe ninzego nyinshi gusubiramo / gusubiramo. Gnome subtitles irashobora kandi gukora ibikorwa byigihe, guhindura imitwe ya subtitle no gukorana na kodegisi ya subtitle mu buryo bwikora.
Amashusho yerekana amashusho, umwanya uhindagurika, guhitamo kodegisi hamwe na subtitle guhuza / gutandukana byongewe muburyo bushya.

Aegisub ni yo guhindura porogaramu. Nigikoresho nyamukuru, imyitozo yo gukora cyangwa guhindura insanganyamatsiko zidasanzwe kubitangazamakuru biboneka. Numusimbura wumwimerere na Sabbu.
Igishushanyo cya Aegisub cyibanda ku, imiterere ya subtitles, no kurema. Iremera amashusho menshi yo gutunganya amashusho gutunganya igihe, nka na. Irashobora kandi kwagurwa hamwe nindimi za na MoonScript.
Imiterere kavukire ya porogaramu ni, ishyigikira imyanya ihagaze hamwe na styling. Aegisub irashobora kohereza subtitles mubindi bikoresho bisanzwe, nka format ya ".srt", ariko kubiciro gutakaza ibintu byose bizigama inyandiko mbisi nigihe cyibanze.
Mu bafanaubbing, Aegisub ikoreshwa muguhindura, kugihe, gutunganya, kwandika, kugenzura ubuziranenge, igihe cya no gukora karaoke. Amatsinda menshi akoresha ibikoresho bitandukanye kuri zimwe murizo ntambwe, ariko, nka zo kwandika, cyangwa ubwanditsi bworoshye guhindura.

Kunyuranya n’ibimenyetso (CROS) imfashanyo yo kumva kw'abafite ubumuga ni ubwoko bwimfashanyo yo kwumva ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara umurwayi adafite kumva mu gutwi kumwe no kutumva neza cyangwa kumva bisanzwe mu kundi gutwi. Ibi byitwa abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kuruhande rumwe cyangwa urundi.
Imfashanyo y'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva CROS ifata amajwi mu matwi hamwe no gufasha kubantu batumva neza kandi ikohereza mumatwi. Intego yiki gikoresho ni uguha umurwayi kumva impande zombi mu gihe kumva byukuri byombi bidashoboka. Sisitemu ya CROS nubundi buryo busanzwe bwo gufata ibyuma bifasha kumva aho umurwayi atabona amakuru aturutse kuruhande hamwe no kutumva.
Sisitemu nyinshi ubu ntizifite umuyoboro w'ikirokabuhanga uri inyuma y'ugutwi cyangwa ibicuruzwa byubatswe mu matwi. Izi sisitemu zidafite insimburangingo zasimbuye ibice byabugenewe mbere byari binini kandi byoroshye. Abantu bake basanze ari ingirakamaro, kandi mu buryo butandukanye umugozi woroshye gukoresha no kwambara. Hariho na sisitemu zinjijwe mumadarubindi. Niba kunanirwa kwumva bibaho mu matwi neza noneho sisitemu mu matwi meza ahuza imikorere y'imfashanyo isanzwe yunvikana niy'imfashanyo ya CROS irasabwa. Iboneza ryitwa sisitemu ya BiCROS.
Ibikoresho bya CROS by'ubu bifasha imiyoboro idafite insinga kugira ngo yohereze ibimenyetso kuva mu matwi mabi kugeza ku matwi meza. Ibi bigerwaho hafi y'inganda cyangwa indunduro ya radio.
Kuruhande rw'abafite ubumuga, ni mikoro ifunze inyuma y'ugutwi (BTE) ikozwe mu buryo cyangwa umugenzo, mu matwi (ITE). Umwakirizi akaba ari kumva neza.
Sisitemu ikoreshwa mu barwayi bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kugira bumwe nabo bafite ikibazo cyo kutumva mu matwi yabo neza. Usibye iboneza ryashyizwe muri sisitemu ya CROS, BiCROS ikubiyemo mikoro kuruhande kugirango bumve mu rwego rwo kumva kandi mikoro zombi zongerewe kandi zerekanwa ku matwi neza hakabaho kumva. &lt;/link&gt;["kutabogama ni impaka"]
Sisitemu ya CROS (Transcranial).
Muri iyi miterere y'imikorere, ikimenyetso kinyuzwa mu gihanga binyuze mu gutwara amagufwa. Hariho uburyo bubiri kuri ibi,
Igufwa rishyirwa kuri mastoid yo mugihanga kumatwi afite ikibazo, hakaba hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kubaga bwashyizwemo hamwe na progaramu itunganya amajwi yo hanze ifashwe na perutaneous percutaneous cyangwa magnet yatewe munsi y'uruhu cyangwa ifashwe k'umutwe. Ijwi ritunganywa binyuze mu gihanga ku matwi bigafasha kumva neza.
Ikimenyetso cyerekanwe ku matwi akennye mu kumva neza kurwego rwinshi bihagije kugira ngo yambuke ugutwi kwumva neza binyuze mu magufwa. Imfashanyo ikomeye yo kwumva ikwiriye cyane mu matwi kugira ngo itange amajwi ahagije. Ihitamo rishobora kuba ryiza bitewe n'igice kimwe gikoreshwa, hasigara ugutwi kumeze neza mu kumva bitagabanijwe. &lt;/link&gt;["kutabogama ni impaka"]

Thomas Rhodes Armitage (2 Mata 1824 - 23 Ukwakira 1890) yari m’Ubwongereza, akaba yarashinze.
Yavukiye i Tilgate muri Sussex mu muryango w'abaherwe bo mu nganda za Yorkshire, umuhungu wa James Armitage (1793–1872) na Anne Elizabeth Armitage née Rhodes (1788–1833), wa, mu majyepfo ya. Sekuru James (1730–1803) yaguze Farnley Hall kwa Sir Thomas Danby (wo mu muryango wa, umuyobozi wa mbere wa Leeds) mu 1799, naho mu 1844 abavandimwe bane ba Armitage (harimo na se) bashinze Farnley Ironworks, bakoresheje amakara, ibyuma n'umuriro ku isambu yabo. Murumuna we yari umunyamuryango wa.
Armitage yari nyirarume wa, nyirarume wa, na mubyara we wa mbere yakuweho kabiri na.
Yakuriye i Avranches mu Bufaransa, no i Frankfurt na Offenbach mu Budage. Yize muri na. Yabaye umuganga, akora imyitozo muri Dispanseri ya Marylebone, mu ntambara ya Crimée, ndetse anaba umujyanama wihariye i Londres. Yahatiwe kureka umwuga we w'ubuvuzi kubera kutabona neza, amaherezo aba impumyi.
Armitage yahisemo gufasha ibitabo kubuhumyi binyuze muburyo bwanditseho: mubwongereza ibi byari bigoye kubera ikwirakwizwa ryibipimo bitandukanye. Yashinze "Umuryango w’Abongereza n’amahanga mu guteza imbere ubuvanganzo bw’impumyi", nyuma "Ishyirahamwe ry’abatabona n’abongereza n’amahanga rishinzwe guteza imbere uburezi n’akazi k’abatabona" na (nyuma y'urupfu rwe) "Ikigo cy’igihugu cy’abatabona".. Iri tsinda ryiyemeje gukoresha sisitemu ya, kandi Armitage yakoranye umwete kugirango yemerwe.
Mu 1871, yafashije gushinga Royal Normal College for Blind (nyuma yaje kuba) i.
Umukobwa we yakomeje imirimo ye mu Nama y’igihugu y’abatabona anategura itegeko nshinga ryayo rya mbere.
Yashakanye na Harriett Black, apfa ku ya 23 Ukwakira 1890 ahitwa, muri Irilande, nyuma y'impanuka yo gutwara. Yashyinguwe i Magorban, Intara ya Tipperary.

Impanda yo gutwi n'igikoresho cyangwa itiyo rimeze nka feri gikusanya imiraba y'ijwi ikabayobora mu matwi. Zikoreshwa nk'imfashanyigisho zifasha mu kumva, bikavamo gushimangira imbaraga z'ijwi bityo bigatuma habaho kunoza kumva ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva cyangwa batumva neza. Impanda zo mu matwi zikozwe mu cyuma, ifeza, ibiti, ibishishwa by'amahwa cyangwa amahembe y'inyamaswa. Byasimbuwe ahanini mu bice bikize ku isi hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga rigezweho ryo kwumva kw'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva cyane kandi ridahwitse, nubwo rihenze cyane.
Impanda y'ijwi ntabwo yongerera ijwi. Ifata amajwi yakiriwe ahantu hanini kandi ikayashyira mugace gato. Ijwi ryakiriwe riranguruye, ariko nta mbaraga zakozwe mubikorwa.
Gukoresha impanda zo mugutwi kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva igice cyatangiye mu kinyejana cya 17. Ibisobanuro bya mbere byerekana impanda y'amatwi byatanzwe n'umupadiri w'Abayezuwiti n’umunyamibare Jean Leurechon mu gitabo cye "Recreations mathématiques" (1634). Polymath Athanasius Kircher nawe yasobanuye igikoresho gisa nacyo mu mwaka 1650.
Mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 18, imikoreshereze yabo yarushagaho kuba rusange. Impanda z'ugutwi zishobora gukorwa n'abakora ibikoresho k'umurongo umwe kubakiriya runaka. Abanyamideli bazwi cyane muri kiriya gihe bakoze Impanda ya Townsend yakozwe n'umwarimu ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva John Townshend, Impanda ya Reynolds yubatswe cyane cyane ku marangi Joshua Reynolds n'Impanda ya Daubeney.
Uruganda rwa mbere rwatangiye gukora ubucuruzi bw'impanda y'amatwi rwashinzwe na Frederick C. Rein i Londres mu mwaka 1800. Usibye gukora impanda zo m'ugutwi, Rein yanagurishije abafana bumva no kuvuza amajwi. Ibi bikoresho byafashaga kwibanda ku mbaraga z'ijwi, mu gihe byari bitakiri byoroshye. Nyamara, ibyo bikoresho muri rusange byari binini kandi byagombaga gushyigikirwa k'umubiri uhereye hepfo. Nyuma, y'impanda ntoya, ifata intoki n'amatwi yakoreshejwe nk'imfashanyigisho ikoreshwa kubafite ubumuga bwo kutumva.
Johann Nepomuk Mälzel yatangiye gukora impanda zo m'ugutwi mu mwaka 1810. Yagaragaje cyangwa yibanda cyane ku impanda zo gutwi kwa Ludwig van Beethoven, wari utangiye kutumva icyo gihe. Kuri ubu bibitswe mu nzu ndangamurage ya Beethoven i Bonn.
Ahagana mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19, ibyuma byumva byihishe byarushijeho gukundwa. Rein yakoze ibintu n'ubuhanga bwinshi bugaragara, harimo n'igitambaro cyo mu mutwe cyitwa acoustic ', aho ibikoresho bifasha kumva byari bihishe mu buhanga mu musatsi cyangwa mu mutwe. "Terefone ya Aurolese" ya Reins yari igitambaro cyo m'umutwe, gikozwe mu buryo butandukanye, cyarimo ibyuma bikusanya amajwi hafi y'ugutwi bigateza imbere acoustics. Imfashanyigisho z'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva nazo zari zihishe mu bindi bintu, imyenda, n'ibikoresho. Iyi gahunda iganisha ku kutagaragara kwinshi wasangaga akenshi ihisha rubanda ubumuga bw'umuntu kuruta gufasha umuntu gukemura ikibazo cyo kumuvura.
FC Rein n'Umuhungu wo m'ubwongereza barangije ibikorwa byo gukora impanda yo mu matwi mu mwaka 1963, nk'isosiyete ya mbere n'iya nyuma y'ubwoko bwayo. &lt;/link&gt;["citation ikenewe"]
Ihembe rya Pinard ni ubwoko bwa stethoscope ikoreshwa n'ababyaza ibikozwe bimeze kimwe niby'impanda y'ugutwi. N'ibiti bikozwe mu giti bigera kuri santimetero 8. Umubyaza akanda ku iherezo ry'ihembe ku nda y'umugore utwite kugira ngo akurikirane uko umutima umeze yumva. Amahembe ya Pinard yavumbuwe mu gihugu cy'Ubufaransa mu kinyejana cya 19, kandi n'ubu aracyakoreshwa ahantu henshi ku isi.

Avaz (n'ijwi' mu Giperesi) nigikoresho (AAC), kizwiho kuba aribwo bwa mbere bwatsinze AAC mu Buhinde. Nuburyo bwa elegitoronike yamakarita yo, akoreshwa cyane cyane kubana bafite ikibazo cyubwonko,, nubundi bumuga butavuga. Avaz yahimbwe na, igihangano yari kuri liste ya ya MIT ya 2011.

Umuryango mpuz'amahanga w'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kandi uzwi ku izina rya National Hearing Aid Society ni umuryango w’abanyamuryango babigize umwuga washinzwe mu mwaka 1951 uhagarariye abashinzwe ubuvuzi bumva. IHS ifite icyicaro i Livoniya, muri Leta ya Michigan, itanga serivisi ku isi hose, ifasha abavuzi kumenya inzobere mu buhanga bwo kumva kugira ngo zipime ibibazo byo kumva, guhitamo no guhuza ibikoresho byo kumva, no gutanga inkunga no gusana. IHS itera inkunga mu masomo muri audioprosthology. Ikora kandi operasiyo ya "Helpline Aid Helpline" y'igihugu itanga ibikoresho byamakuru kubijyanye n'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva no gufasha kumenya inzobere mu gufasha kumva. Sosiyete kandi itanga umurongo ngenderwaho w’inyigisho ku mpushya mpuzamahanga z’inzobere mu buvuzi.

Gutezimbere no Guhindura Itumanaho (Mu icyongereza":"Augmentative and Alternative Communication) ni buri gihembwe gikubiyemo. Yashinzwe mu 1985 ikaba yasohowe na mu izina ry’umuryango, akaba ari cyo kinyamakuru cyemewe. ni Ralf Schlosser (). Nk’uko kibitangaza, iki kinyamakuru gifite za 2018 zingana na 2.706.

Oticon ni uruganda rukora ibyuma by'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva rufite icyicaro i Copenhagen, Danimarike. Iyo sosiyete ni ishami ry'itsinda Demant. Yashinzwe mu mwaka 1904 na Hans Demant, umugore we akaba yari afite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Iyo sosiyete ivuga ko ikora ku mwanya wa kabiri ku isi mu gukora ibyuma bifasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, kandi ikoresha uburyo bwo kuyobora buzwi ku izina rya "spaghetti organisation" bwatangijwe na Lars Kolind iyobowe hagati ya 1988 na 1998.
Oticon ifite amashami mu bihugu byinshi, harimo uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa muri Polonye, rufite abakozi barenga 3.000 ku isi.
Ubuvuzi bwa Oticon ni mushiki wa kampani ya Oticon, byombi bikaba ari amashami ya Demant Group. Mu gihe Oticon kabuhariwe mu byuma by'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, Ubuvuzi bwa Oticon kabuhariwe byatangiye mu gutera no gusohora ibicuruzwa byabwo bwa mbere mu mwaka 2009. Iyo sosiyete ya Ponto yo gutwara amagufwa ubu iri mu gisekuru cyayo cya gatanu.
Mu mwaka 2013, Oticon Medical yaguze Neurelec, w'umufaransa gukora progaramu ya cochlear. Yifashishijwe mu ikoranabuhanga ryabonye, sosiyete yashyizeho uburyo bwayo bwa Neuro cochlear implant sisitemu, yemerwa na FDA mu mwaka 2021.
Muri Mata mu mwaka 2022, Demant yatangaje ko yemeye kugurisha Oticon Medical muri sosiyete yo mugihugu cya Ositaraliya Cochlear Limited kuri miliyoni DKK850 kandi ko azava mu bucuruzi bw’iburanisha kubitera ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Ibimenyetso by'amaboko n'amaboko yo gukoresha byashyizweho bwa mbere mu 21-60. Bahinduwe mu mahugurwa azenguruka 3-21.60.
Ibimenyetso by'intoki n'intoki ni bumwe mu buryo bwo gutumanaho bukoreshwa n'abasirikare cyangwa itsinda ry'abasirikare iyo gukurikizwa cyangwa niba abasirikare bakeneye kuguma batamenyekanye.
Binyuze mu gukoresha ibyo bimenyetso abayobozi b'ingabo, nk'abayobozi b'amakipe, abayobozi b'amakipe n'abayobozi ba platato, barashobora gukomeza (C2) kubintu byabo byihariye. Abashya bose bashya bigishwa gukoresha ibimenyetso byamaboko hamwe nintoki biboneka muri FM. Ariko, ntibisanzwe ko ibice byemera kandi / cyangwa gukora ibimenyetso byabo. Ibi bimenyetso amaherezo bizwi nka SOP cyangwa.
Ibimenyetso biboneka nuburyo ubwo aribwo bwose bwitumanaho busaba kureba kandi burashobora gukoreshwa mugutanga ubutumwa bwateguwe vuba mumwanya muto. Ibi birimo ibikoresho nuburyo bukoreshwa mukumenya no kumenya imbaraga zinshuti.
Ubwoko bwibimenyetso bigaragara.
Hariho inzira zitari nke rishobora gukorwa. Ubwoko bukunze kugaragara ni: ibimenyetso byamaboko namaboko, ibendera, amatara yimiti nibimenyetso byubutaka. Tugomba kumenya ko abasirikari nibice bitagarukira kururu rutonde.
Kimwe nubundi bwoko bwibimenyetso, ibimenyetso biboneka bifite aho bigarukira kandi bigarukira. Intambamyi ya mbere umuntu ashobora kubona ni intera kandi yizewe. Muri iyi mbogamizi, itumanaho ryerekanwa rirashobora guhungabana cyane mugihe cyo neza cyangwa mugihe ubutaka bubuza neza. Intambamyi ya kabiri ni ukutumva nabi. Imitwe myinshi ntabwo ikurikiza inyigisho yihariye yingabo (FM), ahubwo ikurikiza SOP yabo. Hamwe nibihumbi n'ibihumbi bitandukanye, birashoboka cyane ko buri gice cya SOP kizatangira guhuzagurika no kwambukirana. Imbogamizi ya gatatu ni uko ibimenyetso biboneka byoroshye kwibasirwa n’umwanzi; zishobora kwemerera umwanzi gukoresha ibimenyetso bigamije.
Ibimenyetso byo gushinga imirwano.
Abayobozi b'imitwe yamanutse bakoresha ibimenyetso byamaboko n'amaboko kugirango bagenzure urujya n'uruza rw'abantu, amakipe, hamwe n'amakipe. Ibi bimenyetso bikoreshwa nabanyamaguru hamwe ninkunga yo kurwana hamwe nibikoresho byo gufasha kurugamba byateguwe mubutumwa bwabasirikare.
Abayobozi b'imitwe yashizwemo bakoresha ibimenyetso byamaboko n'amaboko kugirango bagenzure ibinyabiziga kugiti cyabo hamwe na platato. Iyo intera iri hagati yimodoka yiyongereye, amabendera (apfunyitse kandi aboshye) arashobora gukoreshwa nko kwagura ukuboko gutanga ibimenyetso. Uhereye ku binyabiziga bimwe (urugero, Bradley, M2), ibimenyetso byamaboko nintoki bizagoreka.

AlterEgo nigikoresho cyambara cyicecekeye gisohoka-cyinjijwe cyakozwe na. Igikoresho gifatanye n'umutwe, ijosi, na jawline kandi gihindura ubwonko bwawe bwo kuvuga ubwonko bwinjiza amagambo mumagambo kuri mudasobwa, nta majwi.
Igikoresho kigizwe na electrode 7 ntoya ifata ahantu hatandukanye ikikije urwasaya n'umunwa kugirango yakire amashanyarazi mumitsi ikoreshwa mukuvuga. Irasa n'umugozi ku mutwe, ijosi no mu rwasaya.
Abahanga Arnav Kapur wo mu itsinda rya Fluid Interfaces muri MIT Media Lab hamwe na Shreyas Kapur na bateguye prototype maze berekana imirimo mu nama y’Imikoreshereze y’abakoresha muri Werurwe 2018, i Tokiyo. Batangaje ko, igihe bageragezaga kumenya neza ibyiciro byashyizwe ahagaragara ku makuru aho abakoresha amabwiriza basabwe "gusoma umubare wabo ubwabo, nta majwi batanze kandi bagahindura iminwa," bashoboye gushyira imibare (hagati ya 0 na 9, ni ukuvuga, ibyiciro icumi), hamwe na 92 ku ijana igipimo cyukuri.

(/ /, kuva muri ; [l̪], lit. ' ukuboko ') ni uburyo buryo bwo zikoreshwa muri Irilande n’abana na abana ndetse nabakuze. Ibyinshi mu bimenyetso byahinduwe bivuye mu (ISL), bikoreshwa n'umuryango muri Irilande.
Lámh yakozwe mu ntangiriro ya za 1980. Byaganiriweho muri Kongere ya kabiri y’uburayi ku bushakashatsi bw’ururimi rw’amarenga i mu 1985.
Lámh ntabwo ari ururimi rwamarenga rwukuri, kuko umubare muto wimvugo urashoboka. Hano hari ibimenyetso birenga 500; imvugo ikoreshwa buri gihe nibimenyetso kandi amagambo yingenzi gusa mu nteruro yashyizweho umukono.
Lámh igamije gushishikariza guhuza, guteza imbere, guteza imbere kwitondera kugenda, no kugabanya.

Data sonification ni kwerekana amakuru nkamajwi ukoresheje. Nukwumva bihwanye nuburyo bwashizweho bwo.
Inzira isanzwe yo gutondekanya amakuru ni kuyobora itangazamakuru rya digitale ya dataset binyuze muri no kugirango itange amajwi abantu babone.
Gushyira mu bikorwa data sonification harimo ubushakashatsi bw’inyenyeri bwo kurema inyenyeri, gusobanura, na geoscience.
Imishinga itandukanye isobanura umusaruro wa sonification nkubufatanye hagati yabahanga nabacuranzi.
Intego ya demokarasi yo gukoresha data sonification ni umuryango wimpumyi kubera kutaboneka kwamakuru.

Telepresence yigenga nuburyo bwo gutanga ubuvuzi bwa kure murugo rwumurwayi ukoresheje na sisitemu kugirango itange urubuga rushingiye ku baguzi. Kugeza ubu sisitemu zihari zifite ubwigenge buke cyangwa ntizifite kandi zishingiye kubakora kure.

Beltone ni sosiyete ifasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yashinzwe mu mwaka 1940, ifite icyicaro i Chicago, Illinois, muri Amerika. Ibicuruzwa bya Beltone bigurishwa mubihugu by'Amerika, Kanada, no mu bihugu birenga 40 ku isi.
Muri Amerika ya Ruguru, Beltone ifite ibigo byita kubafite ubumuga bwo kutumva birenga 1500 byigenga. Beltone itanga ibizamini byo kumva, ibikoresho bifasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva no gukurikirana abarwayi. Byongeye kandi, Beltone itanga gahunda y'ubuvuzi ikubiyemo ibyuma byo kumva bya Beltone mu buryo butandukanye mugihe abarwayi babo babifite.
Fondasiyo ya Beltone Hearing Care Foundation, umuryango 501 (c) (3) w’abagiraneza, yashinzwe mu mwaka 2014 hagamijwe gutanga ibikoresho byo kumva kubafite ubmuga bwo kutumva ku bakeneye ubwo bufasha bwo kumva bashobora kuba badashobora kubyishura cyangwa kubigeraho. Umuntu ku giti cye ndetse n’imiryango yemerewe kubona ubufasha butangwa na Fondasiyo binyuze mu gutorwa ku buryo butaziguye n'abakozi ba Beltone cyangwa abanyamuryango.
Ubwoko bw'imfashanyo y'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva.
Imfashanyigisho za Beltone ziboneka mu buryo bwinshi. Imfashanyigisho ntoya ya Beltone, microInvisa ya Beltone, ingana na raspberry. Izwi nka Invisible-in-Canal (IIC) imfashanyo yo kwumva kubafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, microInvisa ya Beltone yakozwe mu buryo bwihariye kugira ngo ihuze n'umuyoboro w'amatwi w'umurwayi. Ibyo bituma ibyuma byumva byicara neza mu matwi, bitagaragara.
Izindi moderi zigwa mu rwego rworoheje Inyuma y'ugutwi (BTE). Agace gato cyane kihishe mu gicucu inyuma y'ugutwi, kandi gahuza umuyoboro w'ugutwi ukoresheje umuyoboro muto, usobanutse. Imfashanyo z'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva za BTE bareka umurwayi akagire isuzuma ryo kumva kandi akakira ibyuma byumva umunsi umwe. Ibikoresho byo kwumva bya Beltone byateguwe kugira ngo bikemure ikibazo cyihariye cy'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Ikoranabuhanga rya Telepresence ni ijambo rikoreshwa n’ikigo (NOAA) mu kwerekana guhuza ikoranabuhanga rya satellite na interineti kugira ngo ritange amakuru, harimo na videwo mu gihe nyacyo kiva kuri kamera zikoreshwa ku modoka yacyo ikorera kure (ROV) kuri "". ROV yayo izaba ikorera mubidukikije byinyanja. Amakuru ava muri ROV yoherezwa ahitwa hub hashingiwe kubutaka, hanyuma bukohereza abahanga no mubaturage.
Iyi mbaraga ya "Okeanos Explorer" yagereranijwe no.

Okeanos Explorer yateguwe nkigikoresho cyuburezi gishobora gukurikizwa kuri.

Serivisi yo gusoma kuri radio (mu cyongereza: Radio reading service) cyangwa serivisi yo gusoma ku batabona ni serivisi rusange ya kaminuza nyinshi, amatsinda y'abaturage hamwe na, aho uwatanze inkuru asoma ibitabo, ibinyamakuru mu ijwi riranguruye bikaba inyungu z'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Ubusanzwe isakara kuri, hamwe na radio yakira burundu kuri sitasiyo runaka muri kariya gace, cyangwa iyo sitasiyo itanga. Serivisi zimwe zo gusoma zikoresha ubundi buryo bwo kugeza ubutumwa ku babumva, harimo gutangaza kuri, gutambutsa radiyo ya interineti, televiziyo ya kabiri, cyangwa na televiziyo yo ku isi.
Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya serivisi z'amakuru y’amajwi (IAAIS) niryo shyirahamwe ry'ibanze ry'abanyamuryango batanga serivise zo gusoma hifashishijwe amaradiyo, kandi rifite serivisi z'abanyamuryango cyangwa yagishije inama kandi afasha imiryango y’ibanze muri Kanada, Kosta Rika, Repubulika ya Dominikani, Guatemala, Jamaica, Ubuyapani, Mexico, Panama, Nouvelle-Zélande, Ubuholandi, Ubwongereza na Amerika.
Serivisi ya mbere yo gusoma amaradiyo muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika ni, rwatangiye mu 1969 na C. Stanley Potter na Robert Watson. Nyuma y'imyaka itandatu akora ubushakashatsi kuri iki gitekerezo, umugiraneza wa Kansas yamenye serivisi ya Minnesota, maze babifashijwemo na 1971 Petey Cerf yashinze, serivisi ya kabiri yo gusoma mu gihugu, i. Mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 70, umuyobozi w’umusomyi w’amajwi Rosie Hurwitz na Stan Potter babaye abaperezida babiri ba mbere b’ishyirahamwe ry’ibikorwa byo gusoma kuri radiyo, byaje kwitwa Ishyirahamwe ry’igihugu rishinzwe serivisi zo gusoma kuri radiyo, hanyuma, IAAIS.
Serivisi ya mbere yo gusoma amaradiyo muri Kanada yashinzwe na Richard Moses na Gordon Norman i, mu nsi yo munsi y’ishami rya Woodside ishami ry’isomero rusange rya Oakville hagati ya za 70.
Muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, amaradiyo menshi ya leta atwara serivise yo gusoma yo mu karere ku murongo wa FM. Mu bisanzwe bifatanya na kaminuza, amasomero n'ibindi bigo bidaharanira inyungu. Kwakira iyi sitasiyo bisaba kwakirwa bidasanzwe, kuboneka nta kiguzi kubumva, nubwo amashyirahamwe menshi asaba icyemezo cy'uko abashobora kuyumva badashobora gukoresha ibikoresho bisanzwe byanditse. Sitasiyo mu bindi bihugu nayo itwara serivisi nk'iyi. Serivisi zimwe zo gusoma radio zitambuka kuri sitasiyo isanzwe ya FM. muri ni yo ya mbere yuzuye yo gufungura umurongo wa radiyo yo gusoma kuri radiyo, nubwo i yagiye itangaza amasaha abiri ku munsi, kuva mu 1974. i, iyobowe n’abakorerabushake b’isomero rusange rya Memphis, itanga umunsi wose wo gutangaza ku ruvange rw’ibisomwa bya Live ndetse n’isomwa ryateganijwe mbere y'ijoro.
Radiyo yo muri Ositaraliya ifite sitasiyo mu mijyi mikuru yose no mu tundi turere.
Serivisi ya mbere yo gusoma ishingiye kuri interineti ni, yashinzwe mu 1996 na David Erdody i. Hafi ya serivise zirenga 100 z'amajwi muri Amerika zitangaza amakuru kuri interineti, kandi zimwe zitanga ububiko bwa interineti bwa porogaramu zamamaza mbere. Amashyirahamwe amwe aha abayumva amaradiyo ya enterineti yateguwe kugirango byoroshye kubona umurongo wa interineti.

Canal M n'ikinyamakuru cyo muri kanada gikoresha ururimi rwigifaransa amasaha 24 kidaharanira inyungu. Canal M ni serivisi yerekana amajwi gusa yerekana gusoma amakuru yamakuru yo mu binyamakuru n'ibinyamakuru. Ifitwe na Vues &amp; Voix. Canal M ni serivisi ishingiye ku bushake, aho abantu bakora amajwi mu bigo bifata amajwi muri Québec.
Uyu muyoboro watangijwe mu 1985 nka Radio de la Magnétothèque (bakunze kwita La Magnétothèque, izina rya sosiyete nkuru). Uyu muyoboro wakoraga mbere nta (CRTC) itanga uruhushya rwo gutangaza. Ariko, mu Kwakira 1990, CRTC yemeye ku mugaragaro uruhushya rwa serivisi.
Nyuma, muri Kanama 2009, CRTC yemeje ikindi cyifuzo cyatanzwe na La Magnétothèque cyemerera gutwara serivisi ku gikoresho fatizo cya sisitemu zitanga serivise za televiziyo muri Québec.
Muri Werurwe 2011, Radio de la Magnétothèque yiswe Canal M kugira ngo ihuze no kuvugurura isosiyete ikomokaho, kuva La Magnétothèque kugeza Vues &amp; Voix.
, serivisi isa nabumva anglophone, ikorwa nishyirahamwe ridafitanye isano na Canal M.

SNAPI ni sisitemu yemerera uyikoresha ubumuga bwo kutabona kwandika ibyo akunda ku cyangwa ikindi.
Iyo ikarita, urufunguzo rwa fob token cyangwa ikintu gisa nacyo kigendanwa gikubiyemo amakuru ya SNAPI gishyizwe mubikoresho rusange cyangwa bisangiwe na IT, cyangwa byimuriwe mu murima wa sensor y'ibikoresho, biramenyesha kubyerekeye. Terminal ishobora kuba, rusange, cyangwa (ATM). Ibi birashobora gutuma uburyo butandukanye nko itandukaniro rinini cyane cyangwa kwerekana ingano, ibisobanuro byumvikana, cyangwa igihe cyiyongereye kubisubizo mugihe cyibikorwa. Iyo ibikorwa birangiye, itumanaho risubira muburyo.
Kode yasobanuwe neza muburayi EN 1332–4. Ubuyobozi bwibanze bwa Smart Card Ikarita e-Organisatio (LASSeO) yashyigikiye kwinjiza code ya SNAPI muri gahunda zitandukanye zamakarita yubwenge yubuyobozi bw’Ubwongereza.

EyeWriter ni sisitemu ihendutse ijisho ryambere ryagenewe umuhanzi wamugaye. Sisitemu ya EyeWriter ikoresha kamera zidahenze na software igaragara kugirango ikurikirane imikorere y'amaso.
EyeWriter yakozwe na maze atezwa imbere mu rugo rwa Ebeling muri Venise Beach n'abahanzi n'abashakashatsi bo muri, n'itsinda, barimo,, na Chris Sugrue.
Uyu mushinga wamenyekanye n'ibihembo byinshi harimo no guhabwa "" na kimwe mu bintu 50 byavumbuwe mu mwaka wa 2010, ya 2010, Igihembo cya FutureEverything 2010 kandi kigaragara kuri na.
EyeWriter yagaragaye mu 2009 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya CREAM ryubuhanzi &amp; Itangazamakuru muri Yokohama. Tempt1 yagaragaye kandi muri 2009 iteganijwe kuri City Hall. EyeWriter yari mu imurikagurisha kuri ryerekanwe kuva ku ya 24 Nyakanga kugeza ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 2011.
Icyiciro cya mbere cyumushinga cyatewe inkunga na Ebeling Group bituma Tempt1 ibasha gushushanya neza kunshuro yambere mumyaka irindwi ikoresheje amaso ye gusa. Icyiciro cya mbere kirangiye, itsinda ryiterambere ryatangije icyiciro cya kabiri kandi ryakira hafi 18,000 $ nkumushinga wa, warenze intego ya $ 15,000. Yakiriye kandi inkunga yatanzwe na Ebeling Group ndetse na.
Porogaramu n'iterambere.
Porogaramu ya EyeWriter igizwe na software ikurikirana amaso, hamwe na software ishushanya ituma uyikoresha ashushanya hamwe nijisho ryijisho ryabo. Inkomoko yinkomoko ya software ya EyeWriter nisoko ifungura isoko ifite uruhushya rwubuhanzi / GPL. Porogaramu y'ibice byombi yatejwe imbere ikoresheje gufungura ibikorwa, isomero ryambukiranya C ++ isomero ryiterambere. Eyewriter 2.0 yatumye iterambere rya Livewriter rizakoreshwa mu iserukiramuco rya Cinekid 2010. Usibye ibipimo byumwimerere bya Eyewriter, ukuboko kwa robo kwarahujwe kwemerera gufata amajwi yibintu byakozwe muburyo bugaragara.

Amadarubindi ya elegitoronike akorehswa mukurinda, akubiyemo kandi akozwe n'ibikoresho bike bitandukanye.
Amadarubindi afasha kureba.
Ijambo "Amadarubindi ya elegitoroniki" rikoreshwa kenshi mu kwerekeza ku kirahure cyo kureba kure, gishobora, mu rwego rwo kunoza ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.
Ingero z'ikirahure cyo hasi zirimo ibikoresho byakozwe n'ibigo bikurikira:
"Ikirahuri cya elegitoroniki" gishobora kandi kwerekeza ku kirahure cyongerewe ingufu za elegitoronike, rimwe na rimwe cyitwa e-ibirahure, cyagenewe abakoresha badafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Ibi bikoresho byambara bifashisha ikoranabuhanga rya elegitoronike kugirango mu buryo bwihuse, rihindure, rukurikirane kandi rwandike, kwakira no kwerekana amakuru, kandi / cyangwa koroshya kugenzura.
Bimwe mubirahuri bya e-ibirahuri birimo ikora kuri ibonerana kugirango yigane.
, ubwoko bwibikoresho, bishobora gufatwa nkubwoko bwa e-ibirahure.

Igikoresho cyo kugenzura ibidukikije (Mu icyongereza: Environmental control device) nuburyo bwa ifasha abafite ubumuga bukomeye kubona ibikoresho byigenga mubidukikije nko murugo cyangwa ku ibitaro.
Igenzura ryibidukikije nigikoresho kigenzura ibikoresho - nkigenzura rya kure. Urashobora gukoresha umugenzuzi kugirango uhitemo urutonde rwamahitamo atandukanye. Buri cyiciro kizagenzura igikoresho muburyo runaka - urugero: gukina kumashusho.
Kugenzura ibidukikije ni ijambo rusange kuri sisitemu yo kugenzura ibidukikije no kugenzura ibidukikije kandi rimwe na rimwe bigufi muri EC.
Ibikoresho byo kugenzura ibidukikije birashobora gusuzumwa no gutangwa na. Itsinda ryagize uruhare mu isuzuma ryikoranabuhanga rishobora kuba rigizwe.

Robotron Pty. Ltd. ni isosiyete ikora ubushakashatsi niterambere rya Australiya hamwe ninganda zikora ibikoresho bitandukanye byubuhanga buhanitse. Isosiyete yashinzwe mu 1983 na injeniyeri wavukiye muri Ceki, Milan Hudecek. Ibicuruzwa byayo birimo ibikoresho byikoranabuhanga bifasha abatabona, nkimashini zo gusoma, kugendana nibikoresho byo gutunganya ijambo.
Inama ya Hudecek itera inkunga n'abayobozi b'imiryango itandukanye itera inkunga itabona ndetse n'imiryango y'abaguzi, baganira ku iterambere ry'ibikoresho bya Robotron, urugero, mudasobwa za Eureka A4 zisobanurwa ahantu hatandukanye nka The Braille Monitor. Isosiyete kandi yateje imbere iterambere ryibicuruzwa mu ndimi zitari Uburayi, urugero mudasobwa 'Aria'.
Umukororombya wa Robotron na TR320 ni imashini zisoma impumyi.
Mu 1989, isosiyete yatsindiye igihembo cyohereza ibicuruzwa muri Ositaraliya.
Mu 1990, isosiyete yahawe igihembo ngarukamwaka cy’umunyakanada "Winston Gordon igihembo cy’indashyikirwa mu ikoranabuhanga ryoroshye" mu rwego rwo gufasha abafite Ubumuga bwo kutabona ku bikoresho byabo bya Eureka A4. Iki gihembo "gishimangira umuntu cyangwa itsinda ryateye imbere mu ikoranabuhanga rigirira akamaro abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona." Eureka A4 yometse ku ntangiriro ya za 90 PC "kugira ngo ikoreshe porogaramu iganisha kuri ecran. Yari ifite socket y'imirongo ya terefone, clavier ya Braille, disiki ya disiki itubatswe, umuvuduko n'amajwi ndetse n'ibisohoka ku byambu ndetse na terefone."

Inteko nyarwanda y'ururimi n'umuco.
Inteko nyarwanda y'ururimi n'umuco ni inteko yashyizweho n'igihugu kubufatanye n'abaturage mu rwego
rwo gusigasira umuco nyarwanda nyuma yo kugaragara ko umuco ukomeje gukendera mu Rwanda.
Inteko Nyarwanda y'umuco n'ururimi (Rwanda Culture Heritage Autority, RCHA) Iratangaza ko harimo kwigwa uko umuganura wahuzwa n'imihogo ya burimwaka, kugirango umuganura urusheho kwaguka, kudakendera ndetse no guhuza abanyarwanda nkuko byahoze kera na mbere.
Ubusanzwe umuganura n' Inzira yatangiraga muri kanama, umwami na rubanda rwe bishimira ibyagezweho akabaha imbuto, zo kubiba, abajya ku mirimo bakayitangira kandi bameze nk'abahiganwa kuzabona umusaruro mwiza bazongera kumurikira umwami muwundi mwaka.
Uwiringiyimana atangazako kuri ubu abayobozi n'abaturage basigaye bagira imihigo, imurikirwa umukuru w'igihugu, kandi umusaruro wose babonye mugihe cyose kinga n'umwaka, bakawishimira, abakoze neza bagashimwa, ndetse n'abakoze nabi bakagawa, ndetse bakagirwa n'inama zibyo bashyiramo imbaraga mu mwaka utaha.

Mu Rwanda haba umuco wo korora amatungo atandukanye muri ayo amatumgo harimo amatungo yafatwaga nk'ingenzi cyane kuruta ayandi kuko bayubahaga muri ayo matungo twavugamo Inka.
kuko abanyarwanda bubahaga inka kuburyo batashoboraga kuvuga bimwe mubikomoka ku nka uko biboneye.
Gucunda ni umuhango wakorwaga n'abari nabategarugori mu Rwanda bafataga amata bakayatereka mu Gisabobakazunguza kugeza amata avuze (kuvura) ubundi bakayacunda amata barayacunda kugeza avuyemo amavuta. ibi kandi byakorwaga mu Rwanda gusa nkumuco nyarwanda.

Kubera agaciro abanyarwanda duha ibintu bimwe na bimwe mu muco nyarwanda nk'inka, amata, ingoma yafatwaga nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubutegetsi bwa kera, ndetse n' ubwami, hari amagambo agendanye n'ibyo bintu afite uburyo yavugwaga akagaragaza ako gaciro ibyo bintu byahabwaga mu muco nyarwanda.

Imihango n'umuco mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda.
Ubukwe ni umwe mu mihango ikomeye ndetse no mu muco wa kinyarwanda ufatwa nk'umuhango ukomeye kubera ko uhuza imiryango, ugatuma umuntu ashinga urugo rwe, akabyara abana ndetse n'igihugu kikunguka amaboko, imihango y'ubukwe mu Rwanda yagendaga itandukana k'umuco idini,n' akarere abantu bakoze ubukwe bavukamo cyangwa baturukamo.
Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, ubukwe bwari ubw'umuryango, Imiryango iyo yabonaga ko umusore cyangwa inkumi bakuze kandi ko bagejeje igihe cyo kuba bashinga urugo ubwabo, Imiryango yatangiraga gutera intambwe zabaga zikubiyemo ibyo umuco uteganya bagamije guhuza umusore n'Inkumi, ngo bashinge urwabo rugo.
Umwe mumihango yakorwaga kw'ikubitiro mumuco wa kinyarwanda
Kurambagiza ni ukureba uburanga bw'umukobwa cyangwa umuhungu, ubwiza, imico, imyifatire,bye. mu kurambagiza kandi hanabagaho kumenya no kugenzura imyitwarire, imibereho, imikorere, isuku, ndetse n'umuryango umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa akomokamo, Kugirango bamenye neza koko ko yahawe uburere.
Umuranga niwe wafashaga imiryango y'abateganya gushyingiranwa kumenyana ndetse no gutunganya neza imihango ijyanye no kurambagizanya kwayo. Umuranga yabaga ari inshuti y'imiryango yombi, ishaka guhana abageni, cyangwa akaba inshuti y'umuryango umwe muri yombi, kuburyo yabaga aziranye n'abantu bo mu muryango bashakamo amaboko.
iyo umuranga Yamenyeshaga imiryango uwo yatoranyije, umusore n'inkumi bashoboraga guhura bakamenyana cyangwa bakaganira mu buryo busanzwe ibyo ubu twita guteretana.
Gufata Irembo no Gusaba.
umuhango wakurikiragaho nyuma yo kurambagiza no kurambagizwa
Gufata irembo no gusaba byakurikiraga kurambagiza, bikabera iwabo w'umukobw. isango yo gufata irembo no gusaba, yarihutaga kuko ubusanzwe abanyarwanda bavuga ko kwimana irembo kizira, iyo umuryango w'umusore wabaga wemerewe irembo, hakurikiraghao umuhango wo kurifata aribyo bitaga gufata irembo nubu kandi bigikorwa mu mihango y'ubukwe bwa kinyarwanda.
Mu gihe abo mu muryango w'umusore bagiye kumufatira irembo babaga bageze iwabo w'umukobwa, bakakirwa, bakazimanirwa, maze uhagarariye umuryango w'umukobwa akababaza ikibagenza.
Umuranga, se w'umusore, cyangwa se undi umuryango w'umusore watoranyije nibo bajyaga gusaba no gufata irembo, iwabo w'umukobwa. Umuryango usaba watangaga inka y'ifata rembo, kubifite naho abaciye bugufi cyangwa abo twakwita abakene bakitwaza isuka, wasangaga akenshi aribwo bwambere imiryango yombi ihuye, baganira kubukwe bw'abana babo, maze bakicara bakajya inama kubizakorwa n'ibizakenerwa kumpande zombi.
Gusaba no gukwa ni umuhango wakurikiragaho ariwo wafatwaga nk'ubukwe nyirizina
Gusaba umugeni ni umuhango wakurikiraga uwo gufata irembo, ukabera iwabo w'umukobwa. mumuhango wo gusaba umuryango w'umusore watoranyaga abakwe bajya kuwusabira abo bakagenda barongowe (Bayobowe) n'umukwe mukuru, kandi bitwaje inzoga yo gusabisha.
Wari umuhango wo guhana agaciro ku miryango kuko umusore ntiyashoboraga gutwara umukobwa atamuhawe, ibyo bigafatwa nk'ikimenyetso umuryango w'umusore uha agaciro umuryango w'umukobwa kuko ariwo wamureze.
Mu gihe cyo gusaba umuryango w'umukobwa ntago wahitaga wemerera umuryango w'umusore umugeni, ibyo byafatwaga nko kwihesha agaciro nk'umuryango ndetse no guhesha agaciro abawukomokamo.
Nyuma yo gusa hakurikiragaho umuhango wo gukwa,ugakorwa n'umuryango w'umusore,kandi nawo ukabera iwabo w'umukobwa. Umusore yakwaga Inka,Isuka, cyangwa andi matungo nubwo hose bavugaga ko bakoye Inka.
Inkwano yabaga ari ikimenyetso hagati y’imiryango yombi, ko ibaye inshuti. Inkwano yari ipfundo ry’ubumwe hagati y’imiryango yombi..
Mu muco nyarwanda Inkwano yashoboraga kuba inzitizi, yaba yabonetse cyangwa itabonetse ntibyabuzaga ubukwe gutaha, mugihe inkwano yabaga yabuze, umusore yashoboraga Gutenda, ni ukuvuga ngo yashoboraga kumara igihe runaka bumvikanyeho aba kwa sebukwe akora akazi gasimbura inkwano cyangwa agahabwa umugeni ku buntu maze ubukwe bugataha.
Gutebutsa ni umuhango wabaga nyuma y'indi mihango ugamije gucyura umukobwa mu muryango wa mukoye
Ni umuhango wakurikiraga gukwa. umuryango w'umusore wajyaga iwabo w'umukobwa hagamijwe kuganira igihe umukobwa bakoye bazamubazaniza (Bazamubahekera),
Habaga hari uduce dutandukanye imiryango ikomokamo, Gutebutsa byakorwaga inshuro irenze imwe, maze umuryango w'umukobwa ugakomeza kwi hagararaho. kugirango umuryango w'umusore ubone agaciro k'umukobwa wabo.
Kurongora no kurongorwa.
Igihe iyo cyabaga kigeze umuryango w'umukobwa waramuhekaga maze ukamushyira umuryango w'umusore, iyo yabaga ageze kwa Sebukwe hari imihango y'umuco yabanzaga gukorwa ikagenda itandukana bitewe n'agace bakomokamo.
Hari nkaho iyo yabaga ageze mubikingi by'amarembo yabanzaga guhagarara hejuru yaho batabye urusyo, maze Nyirabukwe akamukoza umwuko kumpanga. Hari naho umugeni yinjiraga agasanga Sebukwe yicaye ikambere maze akamwicara ku bibero maze akanamuha Inka y'ibibero maze umugeni akabona kujyanwa mu mbere.

Mu kurongora hakoreshwaga umwishywa, umusore akawambika umugeni maze akivuga ati, Ndakurongoye ngewe kanaka, Mwene kanaka maze ababyeyi bakavuza impundu. ibirori bigakomeza kugeza bukeye maze abaje baherekeje umugeni bagasezera bagataha.

Mu rwanda ubukwe ni ikimenyetso cy'umuco w'abanyarwanda ndetse ni igihango imiryango igirana,kuko iba ihanye abageni muyandi magambo bashyingiranye, bigatuma imiryango yombi ikora imihango itandukanye ibanziriza ubukwe bw'abana babo ariko igendanye n'umuco nyarwanda.

U Rwnda rwo hambere.
Muri rusange iyo wajyaga kuraguza wagombaga kujya kureba umupfumu, wafatwaga nk'umuhanuzi. ukamugezaho gahunda zawe zose utegenya gukora, ubundi akakuragurira akoresheje Inzuzi. Zakwera ukaba ufite amahirwe muri gahunda zawe cyangwa ibindi wagiye kuraguriza. zakwirabura ukaba rwose ntamahirwe ufite muri izo gahunda, kuburyo washoboraga no kuzireka. cyangwa se akagushakira insinzi, kugirango izo gahunda zawe zizagende neza nkuko ubishaka.

Inzu ya Kinyarwanda ni inyubako iranga umuco w'akinyarwanda, aho yabaga ifite imirimo y’ubwubatsi aho by'abaga ari nka bibiri: ari byo gusiza no kwegeranya ibikoresho. Inzu ya Kinyarwanda y'ubakishwaga ibikoresho bitandukanye nk' imiganda igizwe n’umusave, umubirizi n’umuvumu. Harimo imbariro zigizwe n’imisekere, imbingo, imbabaza, imisororo, iminaba, imitiritiri, imicundura, imikindo, hamwe n' imishurushuru.
Inzu y'akinyarwanda ubundi abakurambere bakoresha ibipimo bya kijyambere, kandi abakurambere bari abantu bazi gukora umurongo w’uruziga nk'ikigonyi ugaragaza umuzenguruko w’inzu izubakwa. Ubundi bashingaga urumambo mu kibanza rw'ahagati, bakarushumikaho impera imwe y’umugozi ureshya n’umurambararo w’inzu bifuza kubaka, ku yindi mpera y’umugozi bagashumikaho isuka, umugozi uko wakareze bagacisha ya suka uruziga rwerekana umugero.
inzu y'akinyarwanda yabagaisakajwe igisenge cyangwa ugitunga. Bigaragara ko cyera, iyo abantu bamwe babaga basiza ikibanza, abandi babaga batangiye gutungacyangwa kuboha igisenge cy’iyo nzu. Iyo igisenge cy'amaraga kuzura bakirambikaga hagati mu mugero, bakakizamura ku nkingi, bakakigeza ku nzu bifuza. Mu mugero bakahashinga imiganda, bakayigonda ikinjira muri cya gisenge, bakayikomerezaho baboha kugeza ku butaka. Hari rero uruhande rw’igisenge imbere ku nzu, barubohaga banogereza, dore ko iy’inzu ya Kinyarwanda igisenge cyagaragazaga ubwiza bwayo.

Inzoga y’ihenero ni inzoga iba mu gacuma kabaga ku musego, umugabo yabaga aryamye icyaka cyamwica akabyuka agasomaho. ariko ubundi yabaga ari inzoga umugabo n’umugore banywera mu cyumba cyabo bararamo biganirira hagati yabo.Iyi nzoga yabaga ifite akamaro gakomeye, kuko yafashaga abashakanye gusabana no kubongerera ibyishimo mu gihe cyo gutera akabariro hagati yabo.
Inzoga y’ihenero ikunzwe kwitirannya n'abantu batandukanye, bazi ko iyi nzoga ari urwagwa gusa kandi ataribyo. Ibinyobwa byose by’Abanyarwanda byitwaga inzoga, gusa byatandukaniraga mu buremere, bakavuga ngo iyi nzoga ni iy’abana, iyi ni iy’abantu bakuru, ni iy’abagore, ni iy’abagabo, ariko byose byitwaga inzoga.
Iyo abantu bavuga ngo n'agacuma k'ihenero byaterwaga nibyo benze, habagamo inzoga y'urwagwa,habagamo inturire, amarwa cyangwa inkangaza.

Gusuguhuzanya mu muco nyarwanda ni kimwe mu bintu biranga umuco nyarwanda, aho bamwe babifata nk'ibigaragaza urukundo ndetse n’umubano mwiza waranze kandi ukiranga abantu. Umuco nyarwanda urangwa n'ibintu byinshi bitandukanye nk’indangagaciro,ndetse na zakirazira bifasha abanyagihugu kubana neza, no kugira irangamuntu y’ubunyarwanda. Hari amagambo yaherekezaga iyo ndamukanyo. Amwe muri ayo magambo ni amashyo, gira so, gira inka cyangwa gira abana n’ibindi. Ibi byose byagaragaza urukundo.
gusuhuzanya umuntu aha mugenzi we ukuboka ni bimwe mu byagaragazaga urukundo mu banyarwanda bo hambere, kuko mwakoranaga mu intoki, iyo waherezaga umuntu ukuboko wamubazaga amakuru ye nawe akakubwira uko ameze, ibi byagaragazaga ko ushaka kumenya uko mugenzi wawe amerewe.
Guhoberana biri mubigize umuco nyarwanda, wahuraga n’umuntu kubera urukumbuzi wabaga umufitiye ukamusuhuza cyane, bikagaragazwa nuko wamuhoberaga. iyo wasuhuzaga umuntu byaterwaga nuko wabaga utamuheruka, hanyuma muguhura nawe ukamugwa mu byano.
Gukoma amashyi no gupfukama.
Gukoma amshyi no gupfukama bwari mu buryo bwakoreshwaga mu gusuhuzanya, kuko byakorwaga iyo wabaga uhuye n’abantu babanyacyubahiro bakuru. Iyo wahuraga n’umuntu mukuru nk’Umwami, ntabwo byashobokaga ko umukora mu kiganza cyangwa ngo umuhobere, ariko kumusuhuza byo wabikoraga ukoma amashyi kandi wapfukamye.
Kuzunguza ibiganza (Gupepera).
Kuzunguza ibiganza nabyo byageze mu umuco nyarwanda aho abantu batangiye gusuhuzanya bazunguza ibiganza. umuco nyarwanda muri iki gihe wahinduye isura mu gusuhuzanya. ubona umuntu agiye gusuguza undi bagahuza imisaya ukumva arimyoje, cyangwa ukabona barahuza ibipfunsi.

mugukora imyambaro mu mpu z'inyamanswa mu birere ndetse n'imigwegwe.

wambarwa nabari cyangwa abategarugore ni umwambaro wambarwaga cyane cyane mu birori
kuko wari umwambaro uhenze mugihe cyo hambere mu Rwanda.
