Nyirandabaruta Agnes ni umunyarwandakazi akaba umucamanza wu munyarwandakazi akaba na visi perezida w’urukiko rw’ubujurire mu Rwanda kuva muri 2020.
Nyirandabaruta Agnes yabonye impamyabumenyi ya mbere muri kaminuza ya Lubumbashi, muri DR Congo muri 1996 n'impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu mategeko mpuzamahanga. Yize amategeko mu ishyirahamwe ry'abavoka rya Kigali ryarangiye kuva muri 1997 kugeza 2001. Yatangiye umwuga w'ubucamanza nk'umucamanza w'Urukiko Rukuru muri 2004 maze azamuka mu ntera aba umugenzuzi w'inkiko kandi akora kuri uyu mwanya imyaka umunani. yazamuwe mu Rukiko rw'Ikirenga mu Rwanda muri 2015 nk'ubutabera. Nyuma y’ishyirwaho ry’urukiko rw’ubujurire mu Rwanda muri 2018, Nyirandabaruta n’abandi bacamanza 12 bashyizwe mu rukiko. Muri 2020, yagizwe visi perezida w'urukiko rw'ubujurire. Yashimiwe ubwo yari umwe mu bacamanza bavuguruye inzego z’ubutabera mu Rwanda kuva hagati ya 2003 na 2004.

Mukamurera Clotilde ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umucamanza wumunyarwandakazi, aho usanzwe akora nka perezida w’urukiko rukuru rw’ubucuruzi mu Rwanda. Yashyizweho na perezida wa repubulika yu Rwanda Paul Kagame kandi yemejwe na Sena ku ya 28 Mata 2021, aho yasimbuye Kamere Emanuel.
Mukamurera Clotilde afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu n'amategeko y’ubucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town, muri Afurika yepfo kandi yize ibijyanye n’ubukemurampaka, amabanki, amasoko, ubukode n’umutungo mu by’ubwenge. Mukamurera yatangiye umwuga we w'ubucamanza nk'umucamanza mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Gisenyi muri 2000, nyuma agirwa visi perezida w'urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Rusizi. Yabaye umwe mu bagize Inama Nkuru y’Ubucamanza mu Rwanda kuva mu 2008 kugeza 2015 ubwo yatorewe kuba umucamanza mu Rukiko rw’Ubutabera rw’isoko rusange ry’Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo (Comesa). Yabonye amajwi 13 kuri 15 yatanzwe mu matora.

Immaculée Nyirinkwaya (wavutse 1958) yari umucamanza wumunyarwanda kandi akaba umugore wa mbere warushyiwze ubutabera mu rukiko rw’ikirenga mu Rwanda muri 1996. Yabaye umuyobozi wungirije wa kaminuza nkuru ishinzwe imyitozo n’iterambere (ILPD).
Nyirinkwaya muri 1982, yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko muri kaminuza ya Paris II-Assas n'indi mpamyabumenyi mu mategeko y'ubwishingizi. Yatangiye umwuga w'ubucamanza mu Bufaransa aho yakoranye n’amasosiyete atandukanye arimo Ikigo cy’indege cy’Ubufaransa, Isosiyete y’ubwishingizi y’igihugu ya Zurich ndetse na SONARWA nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe imanza. Agarutse mu Rwanda, yagizwe mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’amategeko n’iterambere (ILPD) nk'umuyobozi wungirije wa mbere. Yakoze kuri uwo mwanya kugeza muri 1996 igihe yagirwa ubutabera bw'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rw'u Rwanda. Niwe mugore wa mbere wicaye mu rukiko rw’ikirenga rw’u Rwanda utanga ubutabera ahakora imyaka 27 mbere yokujya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru muri 2023.

Mugeni Anita (wavutse 1970) ni umucamanza w’umunyawandakazi akaba na perezida w’urukiko rw’ubutabera muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba (EACJ) yari kandi perezida w’agateganyo w’Urugaga rw’Abavoka mu Rwanda.
Mugeni Anita afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse ya kaminuza yakuye muri kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda muri 1996 naho impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko yakuye muri FUSL-UC Louvain, mu Bubiligi muri 2005. Yatangiye umwuga mu by'amategeko mu 1998 nk'umuburanira mu by'amategeko nu bucuruzi. Ni umufatanyabikorwa kandi washinze urugaga rw'abavoka ba MRB. Yari umwe mu bagize akanama k’umuryango w’abanyamategeko b’Afurika y’iburasirazuba, kandi yabaye komiseri wa komisiyo ishinzwe abakozi ba Leta na komite nyunguranabitekerezo ku rwego rwa politiki ya EAC. Yashyizwe mu ishami ry’ubujurire mu rukiko rw’ubutabera muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba mu 2021, agirwa perezida w’urukiko muri Gicurasi 2023 asimbuye umucamanza ukomoka muri Tanzaniya, Sauda Mjasiri nyuma yokujya mukiruhuko cy’izabukuru.

Kalihangabo Isabelle (yavutse 1972) ni umunyamategeko w’umunyarwanda akaba yarabaye n'umunyapolitiki wabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w’ibiro bishinzwe iperereza mu Rwanda (RIB) kuva mu 2018.
Kalihangabo ni yari umunyeshuri urangije amategeko muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko mpuzamahanga y’ubucuruzi yakuye muri kaminuza ya Mwamikazi Mary y'i Londere. Hagati yo 2000 na 2004 yakoraga mu Rukiko rw'Ikirenga rw'u Rwanda mu ishami ry’inkiko za Gacaca. Muri 2004 yagizwe umucamanza mu Rukiko Rukuru rw'u Rwanda, yahakoraga kugeza muri 2007. Mu 2007 yagizwe umufasha wungirije muri minisiteri y’ubutabera ashinzwe serivisi z’ubujyanama mu by'amategeko. Aza Kuzamurwa mu ntera muri Werurwe 2014 byatumye agirwa Umunyamabanga uhoraho akaba n'Umucamanza Mukuru muri Minisiteri y'Ubutabera Yagumye kuri urwo mwanya kugeza ku ya 9 Mata 2018, ubwo yagenwaga na Perezida wa repubulika nk'umunyamabanga mukuru w’ibiro bishinzwe iperereza mu Rwanda.

Janet Nkubana ni umunyarwandakazi uboha ibiseke. Azwiho akazi ko guhuza imbaraga z’abagore mu Rwanda mu gukora ibiseke bigurishwa muri Amerika.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Nkubana yakuriye mu nkambi y'impunzi muri Uganda kubera itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda. Yabanje guhura no kuboha uduseke mu nkambi y'impunzi, yitegereza nyina n'abandi bagore bakora ibiseke. Amaze gukura, Nkubana na mushiki we Joy Ndungutse bayoboye resitora mu murwa mukuru wa Uganda, Kampala. Nkubana yahise ayobora hoteri mu murwa mukuru w'u Rwanda, Kigali. Nkubana yari afite amateka mu buhanzi kandi yibuka kubona nyina n'abandi bagore bo mu gace atuyemo akiri muto.
Nkubana Janet ni we washinze isosiyete yitwa " Gahaya Links " hamwe na mushiki we Ndungutse Joy. Isosiyete yashinzwe mu 2003 kandi yashinzwe mu 2004. Bakoresheje abagore bari abapfakazi mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994. Yatangiye kugurisha ibyo biseke ku masoko ya fla maze atangira kubyohereza muri Uganda, Kenya, Tanzaniya, na Amerika. Gahaya Links yafatanije na EDImports gukora ibitebo kumasoko ya USA. Mu 2004 Gahaya Links yakoze ibitebo 12,000 kumasoko yo muri Amerika kandi igurishwa ryarenze 50.000 by'amadorale. Muri 2005 " Gahaya Links " yahujwe na Willa Shalit kugirango habe ubufatanye nububiko bwa Macy's. Kohereza ibicuruzwa bya mbere byagurishijwe mugihe kitarenze ukwezi mububiko bwa Macy.
Kugeza mu 2012, Nkubana yakoresheje abagore barenga 4000 bakora mu gukora ibiseke. Bamwe bita ibiseke byakozwe nisosiyete ya Nkubana 'ibitebo byamahoro' kubera ko abagore bakora ibiseke bakomoka mumiryango yarwanaga muri jenoside yo mu 1994.

Yize amashuri abanza muri Ecole Primaire St. Famile kuva mu mwaka wa 2008 kugeza 2013. Nyuma yaje gukomereza amashuri yisumbuye muri Nyamyumba Secondary School kuva mu mwaka wa 2014 kugeza 2016. Yasoje icyiciro cya kabiri cy'amashuri yisumbuye (Advanced Level) mu mwaka wa 2019, aho yize Software Development muri Ecole Secondaire St. Joseph le Travailleur. Mu mwaka wa 2025 akaba yarabashije kubona certificate ya ALX muri program ya Virtual Assistant.

Kayibanda Alice n'umunyarwandakazi w'umufotozi ukomoka muri Kigali
Kayibanda akora ku mishinga itandukanye mu Rwanda ndetse no mu mahanga, hamwe n'abakiriya kuva ku miryango itegamiye kuri Leta kugeza ku miryango ya Leta ndetse n'abashoramari bato n'abantu ku giti cyabo.

Ineza Umuhoza Grace, (wavutse 1996) ni impirimbanyi y'ibidukikije, n' ikirere, akomoka i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Ni umuyobozi mukuru wa Green Protector, umuhuzabikorwa w’urubyiruko akaba n’umufasha w’ubushakashatsi mu mushinga wa CCLAD. Yatsindiye igihembo cya mu 2023.
Grace afite impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor's Degree in Water &amp; Environmental Engineering yabonye 2018 muri kaminuza yu Rwanda. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi, yize dipolomasi y’imihindagurikire y’ikirere n’ikigo cy’umuryango w’abibumbye gishinzwe amahugurwa n’ubushakashatsi () n’imicungire y’ubucuruzi hamwe n’ubufatanye n’umugore nyafurika w’ubucuruzi.

Glucose, cyangwa umutobe, nisoko nyamukuru yingufu muri anabolism. Iraboneka hamwe no gusya isukari na karubone-hydrata mugihe cya glycolysis. Iyi molekile ni monosaccharide ikenewe muburyo bukomeye bwo guhinduranya ibintu mubinyabuzima byabantu ninyamaswa.
Akamaro ka glucose kubantu
Glucose nisoko nyamukuru yingufu zingenzi kubuzima bwabantu. Mu binyabuzima bikora, selile metabolize glucose ivuye mubiryo byingufu. Muri iki gikorwa, hashyizweho molekile yingufu yitwa ATP. ATP ni isoko yingufu zingirakamaro mumikorere isanzwe yimitsi, ubwonko nizindi ngingo. Byongeye kandi, glucose itanga ububiko bwingufu nigikorwa cyingirabuzimafatizo zitukura binyuze mumisemburo igenga imikorere yubwonko hamwe nisukari yamaraso. Inkomoko nimwe muri molekile zifite akamaro mubuzima kandi zingirakamaro kubuzima bwabantu.
Agaciro gasanzwe ka glucose mumaraso yabantu kari hagati ya 70 na 100 mg / dL.[1]
Urwego rwa glucose rugomba gupimwa mugitondo mugihe rufunguye. Abantu barengeje imyaka 40 basabwa kwipimisha glucose buri myaka 3.
Inkunga ya glucose, nuburyo butandukanye nuburyo butandukanye bwo kongera ibiryo bya glucose cyangwa gufata isukari mu maraso. Inzira zimwe zisanzwe zirimo ibi bikurikira (ugomba guhora uganira kubufasha bwa glucose na muganga wawe):

Umutozo ni kimwe mugikoresho cyifashishwaga mu gukubita amata yabaga agiye kunyobwa cyangwa gucundwa bashaka kuyabuganiza musabo bitewe nuko umutozo ukoreshwa mugukubita amata yavuze yabaye ikivuguto. Umutozo ni agati gato kabazwaga mugiti bita umutozo cyara cibwaga kigashyirwa ahantu kikuma nyuma kikabazwa neza bakagisiga ugatora(ukamenyera) hanyuma ugakoreshwa ukubita(uvuruga)amata (Kuvuruga).
Ni kimwe mu bikoresho bya kera byifashishwaga mu ngo z'Abanyarwanda. Umutozo ni igikoresho cy'ingenzi cyagaragazaga uburyo amata yabungabungwaga mu muco Nyarwanda.

Dame Magdalene Anyango Namakhiya Odundo DBE (wavutse 1950) ni umubumbyi wa studio ukomoka muri Kenya, ubu uba i Farnham, muri Surrey. Ibikorwa bye biri mu byegeranyo by’ingoro ndangamurage zizwi zirimo Ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya Chicago, Inzu Ndangamurage y’Abongereza, Inzu Ndangamurage y’Ubuhanzi ya Metropolitan, n’Ingoro y’igihugu y’ubuhanzi nyafurika.
Yabaye umuyobozi wa kaminuza ishinzwe ubuhanzi bwo guhanga kuva 2018.
Ubuzima bwambere n' Amashuri.
Magdalene Odundo yavukiye i Nairobi muri Kenya, kandi yize amashuri abanza mu Buhinde no muri Kenya. Yize muri Kabete National Polytechnic muri Kenya yiga ibijyanye n’ubugeni n’ubucuruzi nyuma aza kwimukira mu Bwongereza mu 1971 kugira ngo akurikire umuhamagaro yahisemo mu bugeni bw' ibishushanyo mbonera. Amaze guhugura i Farnham, muri Surrey, yarangije impamyabumenyi ye mu buhanzi bwa fondasiyo n’ubushushanyo mu ishuri ry’ubukorikori rya Cambridge, aho yatangiye kwimenyereza umwuga w’ububumbyi.
Nyuma yigihe gito mubwongereza yavumbuye ububumbyi, maze mu 1974–75 asura Nijeriya, asura ikigo cyigisha ububumbyi i Abuja, na Kenya yiga tekiniki gakondo zo kubaka hakoreshejwe intoki. Yagiye kandi i San Ildefonso Pueblo, muri New Mexico, kugira ngo yitegereze uko hajyaho amato yatwitse umukara. Mu 1976, Odundo yabonye impamyabumenyi ya BA yakuye muri West Surrey College of Art &amp;amp; Design (ubu ni kaminuza ishinzwe ubuhanzi). Nyuma yaje kubona impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Royal College of Art i Londres. Yigishije mu Ishuri Rikuru rya Commonwealth i Londres kuva 1976 kugeza 1979 no muri Royal College of Art i Londres kuva 1979 kugeza 1982, mbere yo gusubira kwigisha muri Surrey Institute of Art &amp;amp; Design (ubu ni kaminuza y’ubuhanzi bwo guhanga) mu 1997, aba umwarimu w'ububumbyi mu 2001. Muri Werurwe 2016, yatangajwe ku mugaragaro nka Porofeseri Emerita wa kaminuza ishinzwe ubuhanzi bwo guhanga, hamwe n’ibirori byo kwizihiza byabereye mu kigo cya Farnham bitewe n’akazi ke gakomeye mu kirahure, "Inzibacyuho II". Yibera kandi akora muri Surrey.
Ubukorikori buzwi cyane bwa Odundo bwubatswe n'intoki, hakoreshejwe tekinike yo kwizinga. Igice cyose kirashya, kigatwikirwa nigifuniko kinyerera, hanyuma kikongera gutwikwa. Ibi bice bishyirwa mukumba kabyongerera ogisijeni, bigahinduka umutuku-orange. Bishyirwamo bwa kabiri, bikajya mukumba gakennye ogisijeni, bigatuma iryo bumba gihinduka umukara; ibi bizwi nko kugabanya-kurasa. Akoresha ubwoko bumwe bwa tekinike yakoreshejwe n'Abagereki n'Abaroma ba kera kandi akunda gukura ibitekerezo bishya mu bihugu nk'Ubushinwa na Mexico. Ubuhanga bwe bwo gushushanya buracyagumana na we kuko akenshi ashushanya ko ashishikajwe nimiterere karemano ndetse nigishushanyo mbonera kugirango bimufashe mu kubumba kwe. Ibyinshi mu bikoresho Odundo akora biributsa imiterere yumuntu, akenshi bikurikiza umurongo wumugongo, igifu, cyangwa umusatsi. Byongeye kandi, imiterere yo kwerekana imiyoboro y'ibibumbano bye igereranya umubiri wumugore; kimwe mu bice bye bizwi cyane ni icyombo cy'umukara na ocher gifite umusingi uhetamye kandi ijosi rirerire risa n'imiterere y'umugore utwite. Ibikorwa bye ubu biri mubice byegeranijwe bihoraho byingoro ndangamurage zigera kuri 50 harimo:
Mu 2006, ibikorwa bye byerekanwe mu imurikagurisha ryiswe "Resonance and Inspiration" mu nzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi ya Samuel P. Harn ya kaminuza ya Floride. Iyi yari imurikagurisha rye rya mbere muri Amerika kuva mu 1997 ndetse anagaragara bwa mbere muri Floride. Iri murika kandi riba, bwari ubwambere ibishushanyo bye byerekanwe ku bikoresho bye. Uburyo bwe bwo gushushanya bwigana imiterere n'imikorere y'ibikoresho bye, bikora nk'incamake y'uburyo Odundo abona imirimo ye y'ibice bitatu mubice bibiri.
Muri 2019 habaye imurikagurisha rikomeye ryibanze ku itsinda ry’ibikorwa bye birenga 50, hamwe n’ibindi bihangano Odundo yabonaga bifitanye isano cyangwa bigira ingaruka ku mirimo ye; imurikagurisha ryiswe 'The Journey of Things (Urugendo rw'ibintu)'. Igitaramo cyerekanwe ahantu habiri: Hepworth Wakefield, i West Yorkshire hanyuma ikigo cya Sainsbury gishinzwe ubuhanzi bugaragara, i Angliya y'Uburasirazuba.
Kumenyekana n'Ibyubahiro.
Odundo yahawe igihembo cya Afurika cyo Kumenyekanisha Ubuhanzi n’Ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya Detroit mu 2008, n’igihembo cy’umurage nyafurika cyagezweho mu buhanzi mu mwaka wa 2012, hamwe na dogitora z’icyubahiro zaturutse muri kaminuza ya Florida (2014) na kaminuza y’ubuhanzi London (2016). Yagizwe Umuyobozi ushinzwe Iteka ry’Ingoma y’Ubwongereza (OBE) kubera serivisi z’ubuhanzi mu cyubahiro cy’amavuko ya 2008 na Dame Commander of the Order of the Empire Empire (DBE) mu cyubahiro cy’umwaka mushya wa 2020 kubera serivisi z’ubuhanzi n'iyiga ry'ubuhanzi.
Odundo yamenyekanye nk'umukinnyi ukomeye mu bubumbyi bwa none, bituma izina rye rigira uruhare runini mu buhanzi bwa Afurika muri Amerika mu myaka ya za 90. Nkuko byagaragajwe na Augustus Casely-Hayford, "" Yifashishije ikintu runaka cyubwenge nubunararibonye bwa Leach, cyangwa umurongo watijwe kuva kera cyane muburayi, kugirango ashyireho uburyo bwo kureba amashusho ku isi yose, yigihe gito;, nyamara icyarimwe gishaje, umunyafurika nyamara ushikamye muburayi... "
Muri 2017 hatangajwe ko Odundo azatangira imirimo ya Chancellor wa kaminuza ishinzwe ubuhanzi bwo guhanga guhera muri Kamena 2018.
Odundo, mu 2008 yagizwe Umuyobozi ushinzwe Iteka ry’Ingoma y’Ubwongereza (OBE) kugira ngo akorere Ubuhanzi, yagizwe Dame (DBE) mu cyubahiro cy’umwaka mushya wa Umwamikazi 2020. Mu 2022 ni umuhanzi uzwi cyane ku isi akaba na Chancellor wa kaminuza yubuhanzi bwo guhanga. Mu mwaka wa 2008 yahawe igihembo cy’ubuhanzi nyafurika n’ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya Detroit naho muri 2012 igihembo cy’imyaka 40 y’umurage nyafurika. Muri 2019 yahawe igihembo cya "Lifetime Achievement Award" mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’ubukorikori maze mu 2020 agirwa DBE ku rutonde rw’icyubahiro cy’umwamikazi w’umwaka mushya wa Serivisi ishinzwe uburezi n’ubuhanzi. Mu 2022 yahawe impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'icyubahiro na kaminuza ya Anglia Ruskin.

Mo Abbaro (17 Ukwakira 1933 - 12 Werurwe 2016), [1 uzwi kandi nka Mo Abdalla cyangwa Mohammed Ahmed Abdalla Abbaro, yari umuhanzi ubumba wo muri Sudani warutuye i London wasobanuwe na Oliver Bloom nk "umwe mu ba bumbyi beza ku isi".
Mohammed Ahmed Abdalla Abbaro yavukiye Abu Jibayha, muri Sudani. Yarangije mu buhanzi n’ubukorikori yakuye mu kigo cya tekiniki cya Khartoum mu 1958, umwaka wakurikiyeho atsindira buruse i Londres yiga ububumbyi mu ishuri rikuru ry’ubukorikori n'ubuhanzi. Yize impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye no kubumba mu Ishuri Rikuru rya Staffordshire College of Ceramics, nyuma yaho afata igihe cyo kwihugura mu gusesengura imiti y’ibikoresho by’ubutaka mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’abakozi bo mu majyaruguru y’ikoranabuhanga ry'ubu bumbyi. Yasubiye muri Sudani kwigisha ubukorikori imyaka runaka, ariko ahitamo gusubira mu Bwongereza mu 1966 kugira ngo akomeze umwuga we mu Bwongereza.
Yigishije ububumbyi mu kigo cy’ubukorikori cya Camden mu myaka irenga makumyabiri, kandi agira amamurikagurisha menshi i Londres - harimo no muri Centre ya Barbican, Gallery ya Whitechapel (mu gice cya Afurika '95), Mall Galleries, na Ikigo ndangamuco cya Iraki - n'ahandi mu Bwongereza, ndetse no muri Amerika na Suwede. Studio ye n’icyumba cye cyo kwerekana byari mu Muhanda wa King Henry, hafi y’umusozi wa Primrose.
Yaje gukunda kwandika mubuzima bwanyuma, asohora ibitabo byubuhanga bw'ububumbyi, nka Modern Ceramics (Ububumbyi "bwa Kijyambere) - Ku mikoranire yimiterere nubuso" (2000), ndetse no mumateka yumuryango we, harimo "The History of the Abbaros of Sudan since the 15th Century (Amateka ya Abbaros ya Sudani. kuva mu kinyejana cya 15)" (1997).
Ubukorikori bwe buri mu byegeranyo by’ingoro ndangamurage y’Ubwongereza ya Londres, Institut du Monde Arabe i Paris, n’inzu ndangamurage ya Smithsonian, Washington. Ibikorwa bye byerekanwe mu imurikagurisha rya 2017 rya Frederique Cifuentes": Kuba havutse ubudahangarwa" muri P21 Gallery, London.
Yashakanye na Rose (wavutse yitwa Glennie), kuva mu 1964, umukobwa w'uwahimbye Elisabeth Lutyens akaba n'umwuzukuru wa Sir Edwin Lutyens.
Abbaro yapfuye afite imyaka 80 i Londres ku ya 12 Werurwe 2016, apfa afite umugore, n'umuhungu wabo n'abakobwa babiri.

Godson Ominibie Epelle (wavutse 27 Kamena 1994), uzwi ku izina ry'umwuga nka 1da Banton, ni umuririmbyi wo muri Nigeriya, umwanditsi w'indirimbo ndetse nutunganya amajwi. Yamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo ye " No Wahala ", yagiye hanze bwa mbere mu 2021, yongera gusohora mu 2022 nk'iyasubiwemo irimo Kizz Daniel na Tiwa Savage.
AMATEKA YA 1da Banton.
1da Banton yavukiye kandi akurira i Port Harcourt, muri Leta ya Rivers muri Nijeriya, afite impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye n'ubwubatsi mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo kureka ishuri rye agakurikira umwuga w'ubuhanzi. Yimukiye i Lagos mu 2014 nyuma yo gusinyana amasezerano na Squareball Entertainment hamwe na Adasa Cooke.
Mbere yo gushyira ahagaragara indirimbo ye ya mbere mu 2015, 1da Banton yavuze ko yaririmbaga mu bitaramo ndetse akanahimba umuziki nka producer nyuma yuko nyina apfuye mu 2008, bikamuvana mu mupira w'amaguru bikamwerekeza mu muziki.
Muri Nyakanga 2018,yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere yagutse (EP) yise "The Banton EP". Imwe mu ndirimbo z'iyo alubumu, "Way Up", yakoreshejwe nk'indirimbo yibanze mu gice cya gatatu cya Big Brother Naija. Yamenyekanye ku isi yose nyuma yo gusohora " No Wahala ", imwe mu ndirimbo ziri kuri alubumu ye "Original Vibe Machine", yasohotse mu 2021. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Leta Zunze ubumwe za Amerika, Antony Blinken yashyize iyi ndirimbo ku rutonde rw'indirimbo za Spotify yakunzwe cyane n'abatari bacye muri 2021.
Muri 2022, 1da Banton yasohoye remix ya "No Wahala" yagaragayemo Kizz Daniel na Tiwa Savage. Yakoranye kandi n'umuririmbyi wo muri Jamayike Kranium, umucuranzi wa Dancehall wo muri Gana Stonebwoy, n'abahanzi bo muri Nijeriya Zlatan, Seyi Shay na Blaqbonez.
Mu 2023, "No Wahala" yagaragaye mugice cya gatatu cyurukurikirane rw'amakinamico yo muri Amerika "Ted Lasso".
Ku ya 10 Mata 2023, "No Wahala" yumviswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 100 kuri Spotify, bituma iba imwe mu ndirimbo za Afrobeat zikunzwe cyane kuri urwo rubuga.

Amazina ya Igbo yubatswe gakondo n'amateka. Muri aya masezerano nta mazina yumuryango, ahubwo umuntu azwi binyuze kubisekuru by'abagabo.
Mubihe byashize, aba Igbo - abagabo n'abagore - bitirirwaga iminsi ine yisoko (eke, orie, afor, na nkwo) muri Igboland. Ingero: Mgbọafọ, Mgborie, Nwanyinkwọ, Mgbeeke, Nkwọja, na Ugweke ku bagore, mu gihe abagabo bitwaga Okonkwọ, Okorie, Okoeke, Okoafọ, Okoroafọ.
Mu masezerano yo kwita izina rya Igbo, umwana ahabwa izina akivuka rivuga ibyabaye bijyanye no kuvuka, umukurambere wapfuye, cyangwa igihe na / cyangwa aho yavukiye. Iri niryo zina bazamenyekanaho cyane. Kugirango habemo itandukaniro hagati y'umuntu n'undi mu gisekuru kimwe bafite izina rimwe, umuntu yatangaga izina rya mbere rya se. Abanyaburengerazuba ba mbere bavugana na aba nya Igbo bakunze kwitiranya iri zina nk'izina ry'umuryango, ariko, aho bitandukaniye naryo n'uko ryo ryo ridahererekanwa nk'izina rya kabiri kubisekuruza bikurikiraho.
Iyi sisiteme yo kwita izina yaragutse igera no mu bashakanye. Aho bitandukanye no mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe by’iburengerazuba, umugore ntabwo buri gihe ahindura izina. Mugihe abikoze, byaba izina ryumugabo we.
Murugero ruvuzwe haruguru, ababyara, "Onodugo" na "Nkechi", bashobora gutandukanywa nabandi mubisekuru byabo nizina rya se. Urugero, "Onodugo" na "Nkechi" bafite ba se bafite amazina yambere "Okonkwo" na "Agu" nk'uko urutonde ruri. Nibo se na nyina wumukobwa numuhungu, bombi bubatse. Umuhungu n'umukobwa buri wese yabyaye umwana. Uwa mbere wari ufite umwana yita umwana wabo Ezenwa. Umuvandimwe ukurikiraho kubyara yahaga umwana wabo irindi zina ritandukanye, kubera ko binyuranyije n'muco kwita umwana izina ry'umunyamuryango uriho, cyane cyane umwe mubisekuruza bimwe cyangwa byabanjirije. Ezenwa na mubyara we buri wese yabona izina rya se ryambere rikababera iryanyuma. Nyuma yo gushyingirwa, Nkechi, Adanna na Oluchi bazwi ku izina rya ba se cyangwa abagabo babo.
Mu ntangiriro no hagati mu kinyejana cya 20, nyuma yo gukwirakwiza Ubukristo ubu buryo bwendaga gukurwaho burundu kugira ngo izina rya sekuru (ari naryo zina rya se "rya nyuma") ribe ariryo zina. Mubihe byinshi, izina ry'icyongereza cyangwa izina rya se rihinduka izina rya kabiri ry'umwana.

Something to live for ni alubumu ya kane ya studio yumuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya Phyno. Yasohotse ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 2021.
Iyi alubumu y'indirimbo 16 imara iminota mirongo itanu n'itanu, kandi igaragaramo Flavour, Cavemen, Olamide, D Smoke, Peruzzi, Jay Teazer, J Dess, Bee Pee, Pappy Kojo na Anjulite. Ubusesenguzi bw'amajwi bwakozwe na Chillz, Rexxie, Masterkraft, Ransombeatz, Blaq Jerzee, TYMG, Eli, Runcheck, Marvie, Soularge na Flengy. Swaps, STG, MixMonster, Exraordinaire na Jaysynths bakoze ibyerekeranye kuvanga amajwi no gukora kuburyo bifite injyana.

Motolani Alake wo muri "Pulse Nijeriya" yavuze ko iyi alubumu ari nk'imyitozo ya Phyno mu ngingo zikuze zijyanye no gushimira, urugendo rwe, urukundo, ibihombo, ubwirasi n'ibindi. Twabonye kandi ko alubumu ari ndende cyane kubera ifite indirmbo 16 n'iminota 55, kandi ko "Paracetamol", "Love Me Right" na "Bia" bitari bikenewe. Album byarangiye ihawe amanota ya 6.1/10.
Joy Dennis wo muri "Naijaloaded" yayihayeamanota 7/10, yongeraho ko iyi alubumu ari ikintu muzika yari yarabuze kandi ko ari nko "Guhumeka umwuka mwiza".

Salvador Dalí (Salvador Dalí i Domenèchnote 1), Marquis wa Dalí de Púbol, wavukiye i Figueras ku ya 11 Gicurasi 1904, apfira mu mujyi umwe ku ya 23 Mutarama 1989, ni umunyamerika wo muri Esipanye, umunyabugeni, umwanditsi, n'umwanditsi. Afatwa nk'umwe mu bahagarariye abandi ba surrealism, akaba n'umwe mu bashushanya ibyamamare mu kinyejana cya 20.
Yatewe na Impressionism akiri muto cyane, yavuye muri Figueras kugira ngo yige amasomo y’ubuhanzi i Madrid aho yaje kuba inshuti na Federico García Lorca na Luis Buñuel maze ashakisha uburyo bwe hagati y’ubuhanzi butandukanye. Abigiriwemo inama na Joan Miró, yasubiye i Paris nyuma y’amasomo maze yinjira mu itsinda ry’aba realiste, aho yahuriye n’umugore we Gala. Yabonye uburyo bwe bwite kuva mu 1929, igihe abaye surrealiste yuzuye kandi ahimba uburyo bwa paranoid-critique. Ukuye muri iri tsinda nyuma yimyaka mike, yabayeho mu ntambara y’abenegihugu ya Espagne mu buhungiro mu Burayi, mbere yo kuva mu Bufaransa ku rugamba yerekeza i New York, aho yabaga imyaka umunani n’aho yungutse. Agarutse muri Cataloniya mu 1949, yahindukiriye abagatolika, yegera ishusho ya Renaissance kandi ahumekewe n’iterambere rya siyansi yo mu gihe cye kugira ngo ahindure uburyo bwe yerekeza ku cyo yise “mysticism corpuscular”.
Insanganyamatsiko yakunze kuvuga cyane ni inzozi, igitsina, ibiryo, umugore we Gala n'idini. Gukomeza Kwibuka ni kimwe mu bishushanyo bye bizwi cyane bya surrealiste, Kristo wa Mutagatifu Yohani w’umusaraba ni kimwe mu bikorwa bye by'ingenzi afite intego z’idini. Umuhanzi utekereza cyane, yerekanye imyumvire igaragara kuri narcissism na megalomania imwemerera gukomeza kwitabwaho na rubanda, ariko yarakaje igice cyisi yubuhanzi, yabonaga muri iyi myitwarire uburyo bwo kumenyekanisha rimwe na rimwe burenze akazi ke. Inzu ndangamurage ebyiri zamwiyeguriye akiriho, inzu ndangamurage ya Salvador Dali na Dalí theatre-muzehe. Dalí ubwe yaremye icya kabiri, nkigikorwa cya surrealiste muburyo bwacyo.
Impuhwe za Dalí kuri Francisco Franco, ubuhanga bwe ndetse nakazi ke yatinze bituma isesengura rya opus ye ndetse numuntu we insanganyamatsiko zitoroshye zikemurwa nimpaka.

Ku isi yose, abagore ahanini ntibahagarariwe mubice bijyanye n' ubumenyi n' ikoranabuhanga; uku kudahagararirwa kugaragara cyane muri Afrika aho abagore bahagarariwe munsi ya 20% byabakozi muri izi nzego. Abagore b'Abanyafurika mu bijyanye na injeniyeringi n' ikoransbuhanga n' ibijyana nabyo, bakunze kwibasirwa n'ivangura no guteshwa agaciro mu bihugu bya Afurika. Tutitaye kubyo kubura guhagararirwa mubikorwa bijyanye na STEM, hariho abashakashatsi benshi b'abagore baturutse kumugabane. Byongeye kandi, imiryango itari mike muri Afurika no hanze yayo irakora ibishoboka ngo hagabanuke itandukaniro riri hagati y’abakozi.
Abagore bazwi cyane bo muri Afrika mubuhanga.
Afurika y'Amajyaruguru.
Tyseer Aboulnasr ni umunjeniyeri wamashanyarazi ukomoka muri Egiputa. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri kaminuza ya Cairo na master na Ph.D. wo muri kaminuza ya Mwamikazi, Kingston, Kanada. Yahoze ari Umuyobozi w'ishami ry'ubumenyi ngiro muri kaminuza ya British Columbia School of Engineering, ndetse n'umuyobozi w'ishami ry'ubwubatsi muri kaminuza ya Ottawa.
Akissa Bahri ni injeniyeri w’ubuhinzi uvuka muri Tuniziya kandi yahoze ari umwarimu mu kigo cy’ubuhinzi n’igihugu cya Tuniziya. Yize mu kigo cy’igihugu cya Polytechnic Institute of Toulouse kugira ngo abone impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga ya kaminuza, nyuma abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga. wo muri kaminuza ya Lund muri Suwede mu bijyanye n’amazi y’amazi.
Najla Bouden ni umuhanga mu bumenyi bw' isi wo muri Tuniziya kugezubu ni Minisitiri w’intebe wa Tuniziya. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga. mubuhanga bwa geologiya kuva "École des Mines de Paris". Perezida yise minisitiri w’intebe, maze atangira imirimo ye ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2021, yabaye umugore wa mbere wabaye minisitiri w’intebe mu bihugu by’abarabu.
Zeinab Elobeid Yousif yari enjeniyeri windege muri Sudani. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubwubatsi bw'indege yakuye muri kaminuza ya Kingston mu 1995. Niwe mugore wa mbere wabonye iyi mpamyabumenyi.
Awatef Hamed numu Enjeniyeri wo mu byerekeye ikirere wo muri Egiputa. Kugeza ubu ni umushakashatsi muri kaminuza ya Cincinnati, yiga ikoranabuhanga rya moteri. Dr. Hamed ni umugore wambere uyoboye ishami ryindege rya kaminuza. Yatangiye kuba umuyobozi w'ishuri rya kaminuza ya Cincinnati's Aerospace Systems School muri 2001 nyuma yo kuyigayo ubwe mu 1968. Yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga kubera ubushakashatsi yakoze asuzuma ibyuma bifata umuyaga wa turbine ndetse n'isuri yabyo bitewe n'uduce duto two mu kirere. Yabonye inkunga irenga miliyoni 25 z'amadolari iturutse muri Ohio Research Scholar awards mu 2008.
Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Nasra Agil ni umu Enjeniyeri m'ubwubatsi wa Somaliya-Kanada. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubwubatsi yakuye muri kaminuza ya Ryerson, ibi bikaba ari bimwe mu byanditswe mbere byerekana ko umugore ukomoka muri Somaliya yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Kanada.
Dr. Gertrude Mwangala Akapelwa ni umu Enjeniyeri wa sisitemu ukomoka muri Zambiya. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu mibare n’uburezi yakuye muri kaminuza ya Zambiya, impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu buyobozi bwa Leta yakuye muri kaminuza ya Harvard, na dogitora mu burezi buhanitse yakuye muri kaminuza ya Liverpool. Yafashije gushinga kandi ubu akora nka Visi-Perezida wa kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga ya Victoria Falls.
Winnie Byanyima numu injeniyeri windege ya Uganda. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubwubatsi bw'indege yakuye muri kaminuza ya Manchester. Yavukiye kandi akurira muri Afurika y'Epfo ariko yimukira i Newcastle, mu Bwongereza kugira ngo atangire amashuri makuru ya kaminuza, mu ntangiriro ya kera ariko arangiza 1965 muri computing, yakuye muri kaminuza ya Newcastle. Yize gukorana na mudasobwa ya KDF 9 na ALGOL nyuma aza gukorera muri kaminuza ya Manchester kuri COBOL hamwe na mudasobwa ifashwa na mudasobwa ndetse n’ubuhanga bwa software, ibyo akaba yarakomeje kubikora mu buzima bwe bwose, bituma agira uruhare mu gushushanya Manchester Sisitemu ya mudasobwa MU5., Kahn yayoboye imishinga myinshi yubushakashatsi ku gishushanyo mbonera cya mudasobwa no kwerekana amakuru, apfa mu 2007.
Naadiya Moosajee yavukiye muri Afurika y'Epfo mu 1984, ahabwa impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'ubwubatsi ndetse n'impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye no gutwara abantu n'ibintu yakuye muri kaminuza ya Cape Town. Nyuma yaje kwiga muri kaminuza ya Edinburgh, abona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n'ubucuruzi. Mu ntangiriro z'umwuga we, yahawe akazi ko guhuza ubwikorezi bw'abanyamuryango ba VIP n'Itangazamakuru mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA 2010. Yagizwe umuyobozi w’ubuyobozi ku isi n’urubyiruko Action Network kandi amara imyaka mike yakurikiyeho ari umujyanama wa Pegasys Strategy and Development. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yashinze WomHub, isosiyete ikora udushya ishyigikira abategarugori bakura cyane muri STEM binyuze muri laboratoire zabo zibitekerezaho, aho bakorera, ndetse n’ikigega. WomHub igira uruhare mugihe kizaza cyikoranabuhanga ritezimbere AI na Cyber Umutekano. Muri uwo mwaka, yateye inkunga ubutunzi bwa Turukiya, bufite resitora nyinshi zo mu rwego rwo hejuru zo muri Turukiya i Cape Town. Nanone, mu 2016, yatangiye uruhare rwe mu Ihuriro ry’Ubukungu ku Isi nka Global Shaper.
Donna Auguste ni rwiyemezamirimo wo muri Afurika, umugiraneza, akaba n'umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa. kumusuhuza atyo kuko Rukara yavugaga ko yambu ari ukwamburwa abana.
Ibi Loupias yabifashe nk’agasuzuguro, aba amukubise urushyi maze Rukara azabiranywa n’uburakari aba yadukiye Padiri amuta ku munigo kugeza aheze umwuka.
Rukara Rwa Bishingwe utarajyaga imbizi n’abazungu yahise ashyirirwaho igihano na Rezida w’umudage witwa Gudovius abifashijwemo n’abayobozi bo mu Nduga bari abatoni ba Musinga bemeza guca Rukara mu gihugu bagamije kwigarurira akarere kose nk’ikiguzi cy’ibyo Rukara yakoze nkuko inyandiko ya Viret Emanuel igaruka cyane ku ruhererekane rw’amateka y’u Rwanda kuva 1867 kugeza 1994 ibigaragaza.
Mu nanga ya Sebatunzi yanasubiwemo n’umukirigitananga Munyakazi Déo, bagaruka ku buryo Rukara akimara kumenya ko atumijweho n’umuzungu bo bitaga Rugigana yakenze ko ishyamba atari ryeru maze ahamagara umuhungu we Nyirinkwaya amutumaho imitwe y’ingabo ze zose zarimo abakemba, Uruyenzi, Abemeranzigwe n’Urukandagira abatereka intango maze arabibatekerereza anabihanangiriza kutazamuterekera nagera i Burayi.
Imitwe y’ingabo yose yarataratse irivuga isezeranya Rukara kutamutaba mu nama ariko ubwo Rukara yatangiraga gushyamirana na Loupias bapfa ko amubwiye Yambu kandi yarayifataga nk’igitutsi maze na Loupias agashinja Rukara kumusuzugura bahise batana mu mitwe maze umuzungu asumira Rukara amukubita ikirato amutera n’ikofe, ya mitwe y’ingabo yose ikwira imishwaro.
Umwe muri izo ngabo witwa Manuka ngo yahise ahindukira akubita icondo ry’ingabo uwo muzungu amuhirika kuri Rukara maze Rukara aramwigaranzura amuta ku munigo kugeza ubwo aheze umwuka ni ko kwivuga agira ati “Ndakwishe Intahanabatatu ya Rutamu Nyir’urugi ruvuga nk’indamutsa, ndakwishe ndi se wa Nyirinkwaya.”
Rukara rwa Bishingwe wakundaga kwiyita Urwigikundiro, urwa Semukanyi, Intahanabatatu yahise ahunganan’ingabo ze zose bahungira i Bufumbira.
Rukara yishwe agambaniwe na Ndungutse
Hadaciye kabiri bahungiye Bufumbira, umwe mu bagaragu ba Rukara yaramusuye amutura inzoga mu kibindi maze amutekerereza ko mu gihugu himye umwami mushya maze Rukara amusubiza ko n’ubundi nta maramuko y’iw’abandi hamunaniye. Abaza uwo mugaragu ati” Uwo mwami yimye yitwa nde ?” Ni ko kumusubiza ko himye Ndungutse kuri Rutangira.
Rukara yahisemo kuva ishyanga akagana Ndungutse yishyingikirije ko se na sekuru bahatswe n’umwami. Rukara yasabye Ndungutse kumurinda abazungu kuko yanganye na bo. Ndungutse yasubije Rukara ati “Narabimenye ga Rukara humura ndabakurinda.”
Bukeye Ndungutse yohererejwe urwandiko n’abazungu bamusaba kuzabafatira Rukara. Nubwo Nyirinkwaya yaburiye Rukara ko yaguzwe agiye kwicwa, Rukara yamusubije ko atagiye kugwa mu gihuru, ko yemeye kwicwa agahorwa umuzungu yahotoye.
Ubwo Ndungutse yatumyeho Rukara ngo babuguze, bakibuguza Rukara yubuye amaso abona mu ntanzi z’urugo uwitwa Pawulo arahingutse. Rukara ati “Yampayinka Bishingwe, ese Ndungutse nawe koko? Ng’ibiriya ibyo nanganye na byo biraje.” Ndungutse ni ko kumusubiza ati “humura ndabikurinda”. Rukara ati “ Ntabwo ukibindinze ahubwo wantanze mba ndoga umwami!”.
Uwo Pawulo yaje bwangu agize ngo arasuhuza Rukara muri ya ndamukanyo ngo ‘Yambu’ maze Rukara ati “Yambu nayanganiye na sobuja”. Igitero simusiga cyari kizanye na Pawulo cyataye Rukara muri yombi ariko asiga avumye Ndungutse ati “Ntukime i Rwanda ndi Umucyaba, ndagiye Urw’igikundiro rwa Semukanya, ngiye kwishyura icyo nakoze ariko wowe uzishyura icyo utakoze.”
Rukara ageze mu Ruhengeri aho yagombaga kunyongerwa yongeye kubwirwa yambu maze asubiza ko adashaka kwamburwa abana be. Abajijwe uwishe umuzungu ati “Nawe banza umwibwire numvise ngo muzi kwandika kandi ibyo ubimbariza iki?”. Abari aho bose bahamije Rukara ko ari we wishe umuzungu maze ababwira ko n’ubundi bamubarizaga ubusa ko ari we wamwishe kandi atabiguraho.
Yasezeye abana be n’ingabo ze ariko asaba umuzungu kutazamukorera ku bana kuko agiye gupfa ari umwe nk’uko na we yishe umwe. Yakikijwe n’abasirikare imbere n’inyuma maze ajya kunyongwa ariko mbere yo kumugezayo bivugwa ko yabanje kwisasira babiri.
Amateka avuga ko Rukara yaremeye yanyonzwe mu mugozi agapfa ariko abazungu bakabanza kugira ubwoba ko atapfuye, niko kuzana muganga aramupima aba ari we wemeza ko yapfuye.

Amalon ni umwe mu bahanzi b'abanyarwanda mu matwi ya benshi mu bakunzi ba muzika ariko na none ukomeje kuzamura urwego rwe muri muzika yu Rwanda uyu muhanzi yaherukaga gusubiramo indirimbo na Ally Soudy indirimbo yitwa Derila yamamaye cyane mu minsi micye nyuma y'igihe gito iyi ndirimbo ikozwe na Amalon yamaze gushyira hanze indirimbo nshya yise Byakubaho.

Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga Umutare akoresha nka Facebook na Instagram umunsi ku wundi arasakaza amafoto n’ubutumwa bitandukanye arata umukunzi we basezeranye kubana nk’umugabo n’umugore mu bibi no mu byiza.
Yavuze iby’urukundo rwe n’umukunzi we asingiza ndetse n’andi avuga icyo (...)
Nyuma y’igihe gito umuririmbyi Umutare Gaby ashinze urugo n’umukunzi we, Joyce Nzere bagahita bajya gutura muri Australia,arakomeza gushimangira urwo yakunze uyu mufasha we bivugwa ko amurusha imyaka icyenda y’amavuko.
Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga Umutare akoresha nka Facebook na Instagram umunsi ku wundi arasakaza amafoto n’ubutumwa bitandukanye arata umukunzi we basezeranye kubana nk’umugabo n’umugore mu bibi no mu byiza.
Yavuze iby’urukundo rwe n’umukunzi we asingiza ndetse n’andi avuga icyo umukunzi we avuze kuri we.Gaby yagize ati ":“Buri nkuru y’urukundo iba ari nziza, ariko Iy’urukundo rwanjye nawe yandutiye izindi zose mwamikazi wanjye.”"
Benshi mu babonye ubu butumwa bwa Gaby bakomeje kugenda babugarukaho bikomeye,bamwe bamwifuriza ishya n’ihirwe, abandi bamwereka ko bishimiye uburyo abanyemo n’umukunzi we.
Hari uwavuze ko bitewe n’ukuntu Gaby abanye n’umukunzi we bishobora gutuma n’abasaza bakwifuza gusubira mu busore bakongera gushaka.Yagize ati:"“Ryoherwa n’uwo muteteri umutendeza ngohe, abasaza bagashya mu nda ngo icyabasubiza ubusore bakongera bagashaka”."
Aba bombi bakunze gushyira hanze amafoto basohakanye, bari ku igare cyangwa se batembereye mu misozi miremire.
Umutare yamenyekanye mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Nkwegukane’, ‘Ntunkangure’, ‘Urangora’, ‘Ayo Bavuga’, ‘Mesa Kamwe’, ‘Ukunda nde’ n’izindi. Ni umwe mu bahanzi bane bashya binjiye bwa mbere mu irushanwa rya Primus Guma Guma Super Star 6 iherutse gusorezwa i Kigali muri 2016.
Uyu muhanzi yarushinganye n’Umunyarwandakazi witwa Joyce Nzere [Yiga ibijyanye n’icungamutungomuri Kaminuza ya Canberra] usanzwe utuye muri Australia.
Umutare Gaby yavutse kuwa wa 5 Gicurasi 1990, ni umwe mu baririmbyi bamenyekanye mu myaka itatu ishize [kuko yatangiye kuririmba ku giti cye muri 2014] bakagaragaza imbaraga mu buryo bwihariye.
Kuwa 26 Gashyantare 2017, UMURYANGO wasohoye inkuru ivuga ku bukwe bw’Umutare na Joyce ndetse ko bagomba kujya gutura muri Australia.Icyo gihe Umutare yabihakanye yivuye inyuma kugeza ubwo umunsi wageze w’ubukwe anafata icyemezo cyo kujya gutura by’iteka muri Australia.

Nyagakecuru uzwi ku izina rya BENGINZAGE wo mu bisi bya HUYE yatwaye igihugu cy’u Bungwe mu kinyejana cya 16. Benshi bamuzi nk’igishegabo akaba n’umunyabwenge wabaga mu bushorishori bw’umusozi muremure w’ibisi bya Huye.
Ijambo ‘Ibisi’ risobanuye uruhererekane rw’imisozi. Umusozi muremure Nyagakecuru yari atuyeho, ureshya na Metero 2.400.Kuwuterera n’amaguru uhagurukiye ahitwa i Sovu bisaba iminota iri hagati ya 50 na 90.
Nyagakecuru[Izina yari yarahimbwe], yarindwaga n’ingabo ze ndetse n’inzoka karundura y’uruziramire, yahoraga ku bikingi by’amarembo ku buryo kumutera bitari byoroshye.
Nyuma y’urupfu rw’umugabo we SAMUKENDE waje kuzungurwa na RUBUGA nibwo RUGANZU II NDORI mwene NDAHIRO II CYAMATARE yigaruriye agahugu ka BUNGWE ariko nabwo bimusabye ubwenge bwinshi cyane.
Mu Bisi bya Huye hejuru hari ikizenga [kimeze nk’akayaga gato] gihora kiretsemo amazi atajya akama, bivugwa ko ariho Nyagakecuru yogeraga. Nubu iyo ugiyeyo ayo mazi urayabona.
Nyagakecuru yatsinzwe na Ruganzu ate?
RUGANZU II NDOLI na we amateka agaragaza ko yari umwami uzi ubwenge cyane kandi akagira n’ingabo zitwaga IBISUMIZI zari inkazi cyyane.
Ku ngoma ya Ruganzu Ndoli, yageze ubwo yigarurira uduce turimo Ruhashya na Mara ho mu Busanza bw’epfo[Ubu ni mu karere ka Huye mu murenge wa Ruhashya].
Icyo gihe Uriya muhinzakazi witwaga Benginzage wari ukomeye cyane ari we bita Nyagakecuru muka Samukende, yari atuye ku gasongero k’Ibisi bya Huye, akaba yari atwaye ubwami bw’Abenengwe mu gihugu cy’u Bungwe cyari gikomeye cyane kuko cyageraga no k’u Burundi.
Ngo Nyagakecuru yari yarigometse cyane ku buryo yari yaranze guhakwa k’u Rwanda no gutura amaturo umwami Ruganzu.
Ruganzu yagerageje kohereza udutero shuma kwa Nyagakecuru ariko ingabo ze zigakubitwa inshuro zigasubira inyuma.
Ibirirari by’amateka byerekana ko u Bungwe bwaba bwarashinzwe mu mwaka wa 300 nyuma ya Yezu, aho hari undi muntu wamenyekanye mu mateka y’ubu bwami akaba yaritwaga Rwamba. U Bungwe cyari igihugu kitisukirwa.
Bamwe mu bami batwaye icyo gihugu harimo: Mungwe,Karama,Rwamba,Samukende na Rubuga. Ingoma ngabe ya kiriya gihugu yari ‘Nyamibande.’’
Dukomeze,Ruganzu yaje kuzimya ingoma ya Nyagakecuru ate ?
Umunsi umwe umwami Ruganzu II Ndoli yashatse kwigarurira u Bungwe hagati y’i 1510-1543 mu rugamba rwo kwagura u Rwanda, yoherezayo abatasi kugira ngo bamwige neza azabone uko amutera, amurimbure nk’abandi bahinza, byari intego ye.
Nyagakecuru yari afite urugo rw’inzitane hejuru mu Bisi bya Huye, rukikijwe n’amatovu menshi, ariko hakaba n’inzoka y’inkazi yabaga ku bikingi by’amarembo ku buryo ntawapfaga kuharenga.
Abatasi ba Ruganzu, Nyagakecuru kugirango bazamucakire bitagoranye cyane, Ruganzu yamushukishije kumugabira ihene nyinshi, maze zihageze ya Matovu yari akikije urugo rwe n’ibisura, zirayarya zirayararika, zicamo ibyanzu, na ya nzoka karundura yakundaga kuba ku bikingi by’amarembo irahunga iragenda.
Ingabo za Ruganzu[Ibisumizi] zaje gutegura ibitero bigamije guhitana uwo muhinzakazi Nyagakecuru, birazorohera, kuko zaciye muri bya byanzu byaciwe na za hene yari yaragabiwe.
Ibisumizi, byaraseseye, bihinguka kuri Nyagakecuru biramwica. Ibirari by’amateka byerekana ko ibi byabaye
hagati y’umwaka w’1510 n’I 1543.
Nyuma y’urupfu rw’mugabo we SAMUKENDE waje kuzungurwa na RUBUGA nibwo RUGANZU II NDORI mwene NDAHIRO II CYAMATARE yigaruriye agahugu ka BUNGWE. NYAGAKECURU na RUBUGA wa SAMUKENDE baguye muri icyo gitero ndetse n’ingoma ngabe NYAMIBANDE ijyanwa ibwami kwa NDOLI.
Benshi mu basigaranye ibisigisigi by’aya mateka, bemeza ko RUGANZU NDOLI kugira ngo atsinde
BENGINZAGE byamusabye ubwenge bwinshi, kuko yagombye kugabisha ibitero bibiri, kimwe cyoherejwe kwa Nyagakecuru, ikindi cyoherezwa ku ngabo zakundaga kunganira iza Nyagakecuru zitwaga Imparabanyi, izi zari zituye mu rusobe rw’imisozi hafi aho mu bisi bya Kigasari [ubu hari uruganda rw’abacuzi b’i Gishamvu], bakabamo uwitwaga Mba wari intore cyane mu kumasha no kwizibukira.
Uyu Mba na we yaje kwicwa icyo gihe, mu ihirikwa rya Nyagakecuru, asiga n’insigamigani igira iti:’’Habe na Mba.’’
Kuri ubu iyo uri mu bushorishori bw’ibisi bya Huye, ubona itaba ryari ryubatsemo amazu ya Nyagakecuru, ubona kandi ibisigisigi by’ibimera byerekana ko hahoze hatuwe birimo amatovu make n’utundi twatsi dukunze
kumera ahantu hahoze ifumbire y’urugo.
Ubona kandi Ikizenga gito kiretsemo amazi kandi kitajya kikama. Rwagati ku musozi, ubona agace kitwa ‘Ku
Kabakobwa’, aho abakobwa bahuriraga cyera bavuye guca imyeyo [Iminyereri iva mu ishinge], no gutashya inkwi, bakaganira amabanga yabo.
Aha hagaragara agataba bakundaga kwicaramo. Kuri ubu kandi Itaba ryari ryubatsemo amazu ya Nyagakecuru, n’ubu ubonamo imyobo yerekana ko koko hashobora kuba hari urugo.
Kuki Nyagakecuru yari yaragiye gutura ku gasongero k’umusozi hejuru cyane ?
Inzobere mu by’amateka, Karangwa Jerome ivuga ko abatware n’abategetsi bo hambere baturaga ku misozi hejuru mu rwego rwo kugirango biborohore kwitegera ibihugu[uduce] byabo ariko kandi hari no mu rwego rwo kugenzura umwanzi kuko umwanzi washakaga gutera, yajyaga guterera umusozi, yatahuwe kare.
Ku itongo rya Nyagakecuru hashinze icyapa gisobanura amateka y’uyu muhinzakazi na Ndoli mu kinyejana cya 16.
Nshuti basomyi bacu reka amateka ya Nyagakecuru tuyacumbikire aha tuzakomeza kubagezaho n’andi mateka y’abandi bantu.

Umuraperi ukunzwe cyane n'abatari bake mu Rwanda uzwi kw'izina rya Logan joe akomeje kwigarurira imitama yabanyarwanda kandi akabazwi nkaho abarizwa mwitsinda rya Trapish kubera gukorana na Ish kevin byahafi.

Umunyamakuru w’imyidagaduro kuri Flash FM na Flash TV witwa Sengabo Jean Bosco benshi bazi nka Bosqizo cyangwa Fatakumavuta nk’uko akunze kwiyita, uherutse gukwirakwiza inkuru avuga ko MC Buryohe ngo yamubwiye ko Phil Peter na M.Irene bamurogesheje, Mc Buryohe yamunyomoje ashyira ukuri kose hanze asabonanura intandaro y’iki kinyoma ari ubusesenguzi bwakozwe na Fatakumavuta ku gitaramo cya Omah Lay. Kuri uyu wa 12 Mutarama 2024 ni bwo Bushali yahawe ikaze mu biro bya Minisitiri Dr Abdallah Utuma twishima, bakaba baganiriye byinshi ku muziki w’uyu muhanzi, ndetse yemererwa ubufasha muri gahunda arimo zo kumurika album ye ‘Full Moon’, izajya hanze mu minsi iri imbere.
Minisitiri Utuma twishima yabwiye uyu muhanzi ko nka Minisiteri ayoboye, biteguye gukora ibishoboka byose bagafasha abahanzi.
Bushali waririmbye mu gitaramo cyo kumurika album ya Yago mu kwezi gushize, ubwo yari avuye ku rubyiniro, yabajijwe niba yari azi ko mu bo yaririmbiye harimo na Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko, asubiza ko ntabyo yari azi ndetse avuga ko yifuza ko bazahura.

Ayodeji Ibrahim Balogun (wavutse ku wa 16 Nyakanga 1990), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Wizkid, ni umuhanzi n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo wo muri Nijeriya. Yavukiye mu gace ka Ojuelegba ko muri Surulere, Lagos, kandi abarwa mu majwi akomeye y’itsinda riri kuzamuka rya Afrobeats. Umuziki we uvanga injyana za Afrobeats, afropop, R&amp;B, afrobeat, reggae, dancehall na pop. Yatangiye gufata umuziki afite imyaka 11, asohora album yakoranye n’itsinda ry’umuziki rya Glorious Five, yashinze we n’inshuti ze zo mu rusengero.
Mu 2009, Wizkid yasinyanye amasezerano na Empire Mates Entertainment (E.M.E) ya Banky W. Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yo gusohora indirimbo "Holla at Your Boy", yari indirimbo iyoboye album ye ya mbere ya studio "Superstar" (2011), yakurikiwe n’izindi ndirimbo zakunzwe nka "Tease Me/Bad Guys" na "Don’t Dull"
Life and music career.
1990–2010:Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ayodeji Ibrahim Balogun yavutse ku ya 16 Nyakanga 1990, avukira Ojuelegba, Surulere, Lagos. Yarerewe mu rugo rwo kwemera mu madini atandukanye, akurana na bashiki be cumi na babiri. Nyina yari Umukristo w'Umupentekote naho se yari umusiramu. Wizkid yize Ijebu Ode Grammar School. Yakuze yumva King Sunny Ade, Fela Kuti na Bob Marley. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na radiyo na Tim Westwood mu 2012, yavuze ko "se afite abagore batatu". Mu kindi kiganiro twagiranye na Adesope wo muri Factor 78 TV, Wizkid yavuze ko yashinze itsinda ryitwa Glorious Five hamwe n’inshuti ze Basenganaga. Bashoboye gusohora alubumu mbere yo guseswa. Wizkid yaitwaga Lil Prinz muriryo Tsinda kugeza mu2006 yaje Gahura [./Https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OJB_Jezreel OJB Jezreel] Utunganya imiziki Amubuza gukora indirimbo muburyo bwo gufata amajwi mugihe kingana n'umwaka wose Muricyo gihe Nibwo yasuraga Studiyo ya Point Beat ya OJB kenshi, yitengereza indirimbo za 2 Face Idibia yandika indirimbo kuri alubumu ye "Grass 2 Grace".Yari ahari kandi mu gihe hafatwaga amajwi y’album ya mbere ya yitwa "Jagbajantis". Yavuze ko Naeto C ari umwe mu bantu Bamugiriye Inama ubwo yarafite imyaka 15. Wizkid yasinyanye amasezerano na Empire Mates Entertainment mu 2009. Yafatanije kwandika "Omoge You Too Much", indirimbo ya Album ya "W Experience" ya Banky W. Yakoranye kandi na Naeto C, Ikechukwu na M.I Ari nako yatezaga imbere ibihangano bye. Hagati muri 2009, yavuye mu Ishuri kaminuza ya Leta ya Lagos (LASU). Nyuma yaje kwiga muri kaminuza ya Lead City, ariko avamo amaze kwiga amasona a yo abiri.
2010–2011: "Ubwamamare".
Wizkid yatangiye gufata amajwi y’album ye ya mbere ya studio yise ' mu 2009 Yasohoye indirimbo ' nk’indirimbo ya mbere y’album ku itariki ya 2 Mutarama 2010 Iyo ndirimbo yahataniye igihembo cy’Indirimbo Nziza ya Pop, kandi yatumye atsindira igihembo cya mu birori bya The Headies 2011. Uretse gutsindira igihembo, yahawe imodoka ya yo mu 2012 yatanzwe n’abategura iryo rushanwa. Amashusho y’iyo ndirimbo yatorewe igihembo cy’"Umuhanzi Mushya Ushoboye" (Most Gifted Newcomer Video) mu birori bya byo mu 2011.
Ku ya 2 Mata 2010, Wizkid yasohoye " Tease Me / Bad Guys " nk'indirimbo ya kabiri ya alubumu. Yabanje gusohoka nka Freestyle rap. " Don't Dull ", indirimbo ya gatatu ya alubumu, yasohotse ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2010. "Superstar" yanditswe mu Cyongereza na Yoruba. Yasohowe ku ya 12 Kamena 2011 na Empire Mates Entertainment. Album ikubiyemo ijyana ya Afrobeats, R&amp;B, Dancehall, na reggae. Mugihe yakoraga kuri "Superstar", Wizkid yakoranye n'abatunganya amajwi nka E-Kelly, Jay Sleek, Shizzi, DJ Klem, Masterkraft, Q-Beats na Samklef.Iyo album ikubiyemo kwifatanya n’abahanzi nka Banky W., Skales, D’Prince na Wande Coal. Yari iteganyijwe gusohoka ku itariki ya 14 Gashyantare 2011, ariko nyuma yaje gusubikwa. Ku ya 12 Kamena 2011, Wizkid yakiriye ibirori byo kumurika alubumu muri Expo Hall ya Eko Hotel na Suites. Ibirori byo kumurika byagaragaye ibitaramo bya Banky W, Skales, 2face Idibia, Samklef, Wande Coal, D'Prince, Olamide, eLDee, Jesse Jagz, Ice Prince, Lynxxx na Seyi Shay. "Superstar" yatsindiye igihembo cya Album nziza y'umwaka muri Nigeria Entertainment Award 2012, kandi yatowe muri Album of the Year muri The Headies 2012.
2012–2014: Urugendo rwa E.M.E, "Ayo" N'izind.
A 15-second sample of "Jaiye Jaiye". The song is a fusion of Afrobeat and Afrobeats, Wizkid_-_Jaiye_Jaiye_(feat_Femi_Kuti).ogg,"Jaiye Jaiye" (2013)
Wizkid yazengurutse London mu mwaka wa 2012 anakorera ahitwa Hammersmith Apollo ku "ya" 4 Kamena 2012. Yakoranye na Banky W.,Skales,Shaydee and Niyola Nyuma yo kumurika alubumu, ibikorwa bya E.M.E byazengurutse Amerika. Urugendo rwatangiye muri Nyakanga rurangira muri Nzeri 2012. Ibikorwa bya E.M.E byakorewe mu mijyi myinshi, nka Houston, Dallas, Toronto, Vancouver, Umujyi wa New York, Providence, Calgary, Atlanta, Washington, DC, na Chicago.] ​​​​​
Ku itariki ya 12 Ugushyingo 2012, Wizkid yaririmbye mu gitaramo cya BBC Radio 1Xtra Live ku kigo cya O2 Academy i Brixton, ahurira n’abahanzi nka Trey Songz, Tulisa, Kendrick Lamar na Angel.
Hagati ya 2012 na 2014, Wizkid yafashe alubumu ye ya kabiri ya studio "Ayo". Yafatanyije nabarimo Femi Kuti, Banky W., Seyi Shay, Phyno, Tyga, Akon na Wale. Iyi alubumu yatunganijwe na Sarz, Shizzi, Uhuru, Del B, Dokta Frabz, Maleek Berry, Legendury Beatz na Spellz. Yabanje kwitwa "Choosen". Nk’uko MTV Base ibivuga, iyo album yahuye n’ikibazo cyo gusubikwa ku Itariki Yaragusokeraho.. Byatangajwe mbere ko alubumu izaba irimo Don Jazzy, Efya na Olamide. Ku ya 6 Nzeri 2014, Wizkid yagaragaje ishusho y’album hamwe n’urutonde rw’indirimbo zayo. Mbere y’uko atangaza gahunda yo gusohora album ye ya kabiri ya studio, yari yarateguye gusohora Uruvange muri Mata 2013. Mu kiganiro na Ok! Yavuze kandi ko hazagaragaramo Wale na Tinie Tempah. Wizkid yaje gutangaza ko azashyira ahagaragara alubumu ye ya kabiri ya studio ku ya 12 Kamena 2013. Mu kiganiro na HipTV, Banky W yagaragaje izina ry’iyo album anavuga ku gusubikwa kwayo. Yanatanze n’igihe cy’agateganyo cyo Kumurikiraho album..
Ku itariki ya 2 Gicurasi 2013, Wizkid yasohoye indirimbo ya mbere y’iyo album yise "Jaiye Jaiye". Iyi ndirimbo ikubiyemo ubufatanye n’umuhanzi w’Umunyanigeria wari watorewe igihembo cya Grammy Award, Femi Kuti. Wizkid yabwiye Showtime Celebrity ko yakoranye na Femi Kuti kugira ngo abantu batamufata nk’umuhanzi wibanda gusa ku ndirimbo z’inkundura, imodoka n’ibintu by’ubukungu.i. Ku ya 17 Ukwakira 2013, yaririmbye muri Felabration ya 2013, igitaramo ngarukamwaka cyeguriwe Fela Kuti. -yakozwe "On top your Matter" yasohotse nk'indirimbo ya kabiri ya alubumu ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2013. Ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 2013, Wizkid yaririmbye muri Guinness Colorful World of More igitaramo hamwe na D'banj, Tiwa Savage, P-Square, Davido, Ice Prince, Burna Boy, Olamide na Phyno. Igitaramo cyabereye ahitwa Eko Convention Centre muri Eko Hotels na Suites. Ugushyingo 2013, yakoreye igitaramo mu gitaramo cya Guinness Big Eruption cyabereye i Accra, muri Gana.
Muri Gashyantare 2014, Wizkid abaye umucuranzi wa mbere wo muri Nijeriya ufite abayoboke barenga miliyoni kuri Twitter. Muri Nyakanga 2014, Wizkid yasuye studio ya Beat 99.9 FM i Lagos maze abwira Toolz ko yakoranye n'umuririmbyi wo muri Barubade Rihanna. Wizkid yatumiwe nk'umushyitsi udasanzwe mu bitaramo bimwe na bimwe byagaragaye mu ruzinduko rwa Tinie Tempah mu Bwongereza mu 2014.
2015–2018: "Byumvikane kurundi ruhande" nk'itsinzi mpuzamahanga hamwe na "One Dance".
Ku ya 5 Mutarama 2015, Wizkid yashyize ahagaragara amashusho y'indirimbo " Ojuelegba ", indirimbo igaragaza urugamba yahuye narwo mu myaka ya mbere y'umwuga we wo gufata amajwi. yemewe nk'indirimbo igaragaramo amajwi ya Drake na Skepta ; Yerekanye kuri OVO Sound Radio muri Nyakanga 2015. Muri, Wizkid na Chris Brown bombi bakoze "African Bad Gyal" mu gitaramo cya ChrisBrown cyabereye i Durban, muri Afurika y'Epfo. Wizkid yasohoye "Expensive Shit", indirimbo ya Afrobeats Igizwe Light Guitar, saxofone na percussion acoustic muri Gicurasi 2015; indirimbo yavuzwe nkaho ishobora kuba yashyizwe kuri alubumu. Muri, Wizkid yatangaje ku rubuga rwa Twitter ko Angélique Kidjo azagaragara kuri alubumu. Muri, Mu Kwakira 2015, yavuze ko azasohora EP ye kandi akazongera gusubika itariki yo gusohorerwa album ye ya gatatu ya studio. Ibi yabitangaje kuri Instagram akimara kurangiza igitaramo cyo guha icyubahiro 2Face Idibia "Fortified".
Ku ya 5 Mata 2016, Wizkid abaye umuhanzi wa mbere wo muri Nijeriya washyizwe ku rutonde rwa Billboard s Twitter Imbonerahamwe y’amasaha 24 ashize, nyuma y’ubutanyei bwe Na drake ku ndirimbo yise “ One Dance ” yanditswe na Afrobeats ya Drake, yashyizwe ku mwanya wa "One Dance" Yakomeje Kwamamara ku rwego mpuzamahanga, iza ku mwanya wa mbere mu bihugu 15, birimo Ubwongereza, Kanada, Ositaraliya, Ubufaransa n'Ubudage. Indirimbo yabaye Wizkid yambere ya mbere nkumuhanzi wagaragaye muri utwo turere.
Umwanditsi wa Pitchfork, Sheldon Pearce, yavuze ko iyo ndirimbo ari ‘indirimbo yishimisha, y’umwimerere w’ibihe by’ihungabana, yishimira umurimo wose Wizkid yakoze.’ Mu Gicurasi 2015, Wizkid yifatanyije na Chris Brown mu rugendo rw’isi yose rwitwa "One Hell of a Nite".".
Muri Werurwe 2017, yasinyanye amasezerano na RCA Records. Ku Nyakanga 2017, Wizkid yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya gatatu ya studio "Ijwi ryavuye ku rundi ruhande.Byambere" byanditswe na Karayibe, "SFTOS" ikubiyemo izindi njyana zitandukanye, zirimo afrobeats, EDM, R&amp;amp;B, n'inzu. igaragaramo abashyitsi bagaragaye muri Drake, Major Lazer, Chris Brown, Ty Dolla Sign, Efya, Bucie na Trey Songz. wakozwe na Sarz, Del B, Spellz, Dre Skull, DJ Mustard, Major Lazer, na Picard Brothers. Iyi alubumu yabonetse kugirango igure kandi ikoreshwe kumurongo kumurongo wa muzika myinshi, harimo Apple Music, Amazone Music, Spotify, Deezer na Google Play. Wizkid abaye umuhanzi wa mbere wa afrobeats wagaragaye muri "Guinness World Records" 2018 kubera uruhare yagize muri "Imbyino imwe". Indirimbo ye " Soco " ibaye indirimbo ye ya mbere ya afrobeats yemerewe zahabu muri Kanada. Nyuma yuwo mwaka, yagaragaye kuri EP "Normani x" ya Normani na Calvin Harris, Calvin Harris, ku ndirimbo "Kugenzura Urutonde", yaje ku mwanya wa mbere ku mbonerahamwe yo kugurisha indirimbo ya "Billboard" World Digital.
2019: "Brown Skin Girl", "Umuhanzi Vol." "1" na Yakorewe "i Lagos".
Mu ntangiriro z’umwaka wa 2019, Wizkid yafatanyijwe n’umuhanzikazi Beyoncé ku ndirimbo "Brown Skin Girl", ikaba iri ku "soundtrack" ya filime "The Lion King: The Gift", yaje gushimwa cyane n’abakunzi b’umuziki n’abasesenguzi.. Yavuzweho ko ari kimwe mu bihe bye "bimurika" byo muri 2019, mu bihembo yahataniye mpuzamahanga, akamuhesha ibihembo bibiri bya Soul Train Music Awards, Nyuma yuwo mwaka, yasohoye kandi indirimbo "Joro" na "Ghetto Love".
Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2019, label ya Wizkid Starboy Entertainment yasohoye EP "Soundman Vol." "1", yibanze cyane kuri Wizkid, kandi ikubiyemo ibintu biva muri Chronixx, nabandi bahanzi batandukanye.
Muri 2020, Wizkid yagaragaye ku ndirimbo zitandukanye, harimo "Escape" ya Akon, "Gbese 2.0" hamwe na DJ Tunes na Spax, "Eve Bounce" na Yung L, na "Consider II" hamwe na Walshy Fire. Yasohoye kandi afatanyije n'umuririmbyi w'umunyamerika, H.E.R, bise " Smile ". Ku ya 17 Nzeri, Wizkid yasohoye indirimbo yise Stress ", atangaza ko azamurika alubumu ye ya kane, "Made i Lagos", ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2020.
Ku nshuro ya 27 ngarukamwaka South African Music Award, "Made i Lagos" yakiriye igihembo cya Afurika isigaye.
Ku ya 13 Kanama 2021, yasohoye remix ya " Essence ", irimo umuhanzi wo muri Kanada Justin Bieber. Indirimbo yabaye indirimbo yagaragaye cyane kuri "Billboard" Hot 100 yakozwe nigikorwa nyafurika, igera ku mwanya wa 11 ku ya 4 Ukwakira 2021.
Ugushyingo 2021, muri Grammy Award ya 64 ngarukamwaka, alubumu ye, Made "in Lagos" n'indirimbo ye "Essence" yamuhesheje ibihembo bibiri bya Grammy. Mu Kwezi kumwe, yakiriye kandi ibihembo bine bya Soul Train Awards, yatsindiye imwe muri "Essence" Best Collaboration.
Ku isabukuru ya mbere ya "Made i Lagos", Wizkid yatangaje alubumu ya 5 More Love", Less Ego", mu ntangiriro yashyizwe ahagaragara umunsi wa nyuma wa Made i Lagos, ku ya 22 Mutarama 2022. Album ye ya gatanu ya studio "More Love,Less Ego" yasohotse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 2022
Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2024, Wizkid yasohoye indirimbo " Piece of My Heart " irimo umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika Brent Faiyaz nk'umuhanzi wambere muri alubumu ye ya gatandatu ya studio "Morayo".
Mu Ugushyingo 2024, indirimbo "MMS" ya Asake yafatanijemo na Wizkid yatorewe igihembo cya Best African Music Performance mu bihembo bya 67th Annual Grammy Awards Wizkid ahabwa icyubahiro cyifuzwa mu mwuga we.
Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2024, Wizkid yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya gatandatu ya studio "Morayo" y'indirimbo cumi n'esheshatu zirimo Asake, Anaïs Cardot, Brent Faiyaz, Jazmine Sullivan, na Tiakola.

Mugisha Prince uzwi kw'izina rya the Nature, numuhanzi winjiye mu muziki nyuma yo kubona abamufasha asohora extended play(EP) ye yambere. uyu muhanzi yavutse tariki 2 ukuboza 1999, akaba avuka mumuryango wabana babiri akaba yarasoje amashuri yisumbuye.
Uyu muhanzi numwe mubahanzi bafite abavandimwe mu muziki barimo umuraperi ish kevin, logan joe. The nature avugako yakuze ashaka kuzaba umukinnyi wumupira ariko impano yumuziki niyo yabashije gukunda akayikurikirana.avugako ku myaka 15 aribwo yatangiye kwiyumvamo impano y'umuziki n'ababyeyi be bamubwirako bazamushyigikira.
The nature yavuze murwego rwo rwo kwinjira mu muziki neza, yahisemo gufata umwanya uhagije kugirango atunganye EP ye yambere yise "umva vibe". Irimo indirimbo nka:' waitress' yakoranye na gabiro guitar, 'mfatirana','slay', ndetse na chance. The nature avugako gukorana EP ye yambere na gabiro guitar byaturutse kubushuti bari basanzwe bafitanye. Uyu muhanzi The nature akaba asaba aba nyarwanda gukomeza kumushyigikira murugendo rwe rw'umuziki.

MUHIRE Kevin n' umusore ukina umupira w'amaguru nk'uwabigize umwuga mu ikipe ya rayon sport akaba akina inyuma yaba rutahizamu ahazwi nko kuri no 10 ikindi akaba afite inshingano zo kuba kapiteni w' ikipe akinamo ya Rayon Sport.
Kapiteni wa Rayon Sports, Kevin Muhire, yemeje ko umukino wa nyuma w’umunsi wa 30 bazakina na Kiyovu Sports ku wa gatandatu, tariki ya 11 Gicurasi uzaba umukino we wa nyuma muri iyi kipe.
Uyu mukinnyi mpuzamahanga w’u Rwanda winjiye muri Murera mu Kwakira 2023 ku masezerano y’igihe gito, yatangaje ko yamaze kugirana amasezerano n’ikipe yo hanze y’u Rwanda kandi ko yiteguye kuva muri iyi kipe ubwo shampiyona iraba irangiye.
Aganira na Radio&amp;TV 10, Kevin Muhire yemeje ko agiye kuva muri Rayon Sports, aho yagize ati: "Sinzagumana na Rayon Sports; Nzakina umukino wanjye wa nyuma muri iyi kipe kuri uyu wa gatandatu.
"Muhire kevin yongereye amasezerano mu ikipe ya rayon sport".

niba azakomeza gukinira iyikipe nyumayo gustindwa na APR FC ibitego2-0 bakabatwara igikombe cyamahoro ariko biravugwako
yaragije kumvikana ni kipe ya rayon-sport ko azaguma mwikipe akabayasinye amasezerano azamara imyaka ibiri kandi uyumusore mwimyaka 26 y'amavuko akaba yarivugiye ko nayindikipe azakinira mu Rwanda cyereste ayjiyehanze y'u Rwanda.

Umwuko ni cyimwe mu nigikoresho gikozwe mugiti Kenshi ukaba wifashishwa mugikoni barimo guteka ibiryo bitandukanye. Umwuko ukorwa mu biti bitandukanye ariko biba byiza iyo ubajwe mu giti cyinturusu kuko nibwo uba ukomeye.
umwuko ushobora gukoreshwa uteka akawunga,ubugari,igikoma,isosi.

Divine Ikubor (yavutse ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2000), uzwi ku izina rya Rema, ni umuririmbyi n’umuraperi wo muri Nijeriya. Yamenyekanye bwa mbere mu 2019 kubera indirimbo ye "Dumebi", muri uwo mwaka kandi ubwo yasinyaga mu itsinda rya D’Prince, Jonzing World. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, yamenyekanye cyane muri 2022 n’indirimbo ye "Calm Down", ndetse isubirwamo n’umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika Selena Gomez, igera ku mwanya wa gatatu ku rutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100. Rema kandi yayoboye urutonde rwa Billboard Afrobeats amaraho ibyumweru 58.
Muri uwo mwaka, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye, "Rave &amp; Roses" (2022), igera ku mwanya wa 81 kuri Billboard 200. Alubumu ye ya kabiri yitwa Heis yayisohoye muri 2024 yafashijwemo na Benin Boys. Knadi anahamagarwa muri kuri Alubumu nziza ku isi mu birori bya 67 bya
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Divine Ikubor yavutse ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2000 mu muryango wa gikirisitu mu mujyi wa Benin, muri Leta ya Edo, muri Nijeriya. Akomoka muri Igbanke muri Orhionmwon LGA yo muri leta ya Edo. Yavumbuye umuhamagaro we wo muri muzika mu mashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rya Ighile Group of School muri Leta ya Edo, ari naho yatangiye kuririmba no gucuranga. Nyuma yo kubura se na mukuru we, Rema yarezwe na nyina, wagize uruhare runini mu guhindura ubuzima bwe.
2019–2021: Gutangira umwuga no kwandika inyandiko.
Rema yatangiye umwuga we wa muzika akora ibitaramo mu nsengero hamwe na mugenzi we Alpha P mu mwaka wa 2019. Yamenyekanye nyuma yo gushyira hanze agace gato ari kuririmba kuri Instagram ku ndirimbo ya 'Gucci Gang' ya D'Prince. D'Prince yatangajwe n'ubuhanga bwe, amujyana i Lagos maze amuha amasezerano yo gukorana na Jonzing World, ishami rya Mavin Records ifitwe n'umuyobozi wa muzika akaba na producer Don Jazzy. Muri 2019, Rema yasohoye izina umuzingo we mbere witwa "Rema", uza ku isonga rya Apple Music muri Nigeriya.] Nyuma yi mpeshyi, indi ndirimbo izwi cyane kuri uwo muzingo yagaragaye ku rutonde rw’indirimbo zuwahoze ari Perezida wa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, Barack Obama. 2020, indirimbo za Rema zashyizwe ku majwi ya "FIFA 21". Muri Nzeri 2021, yashyizwe ahagaragara nka ambasaderi w’ikirango wa Pepsi, ari kumwe na mugenzi we wumuhanzikazi witwa Ayra Starr.
Toya Delazy, umuhanzi utunganya umuziki akaba n’umuhanzi wo muri Afurika yepfo, yatangije injyana ya "Afrorave" mu 2019, ahuza ibintu bya garage, amagambo y’Abazulu, n’ubundi buryo bwa Afurika. Muri Gicurasi 2021, Rema yakoresheje ijambo "Afrorave" kugira ngo asobanure umuziki we bwite, uhuza Afrobeats n’Abarabu n’Abahinde. Iri jwi ritandukanye ryumvikanye nabafana, rimuhesha umufana wihariye uzwi nka Ravers.
2022 – 23: "Rave &amp; Roses" na "Ravage" EP.
Nyuma yo gusohora Iimizingo itatu, Rema yerekanye alubumu ye ya mbere, "Rave &amp; Roses", ku ya 25 Werurwe 2022, munsi ya Jonzing World. Iyi alubumu irimo indirimbo 16, zirimo ubufatanye na 6lack, Chris Brown, AJ Tracey, na Yseult. Yaririho indirimbo 10 ku mbonerahamwe "ya Billboard" Afrobeats yo muri Amerika mu cyumweru cyayo cya mbere. " Gutuza " yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga, igera ku mwanya wa 3 kuri Billboard Hot 100 nyuma yo gusubiramo hamwe na Selena Gomez, ikuraho amateka menshi. 5 Muri Gashyantare 2023, yatsindiye igihembo cy’umuhanzi w’umwaka wa Digital mu bihembo bya Soundcity MVP byabereye mu kigo cya Eko Convention Centre i Lagos. Muri Mata 2023, yasohoye "Rave &amp; Roses Ultra", ibaye alubumu ya mbere nyafurika yambutse miliyari ebyiri kuri Spotify. Ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2023, Rema yasohoye "Ravage" EP, maze ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2023, akora ibitaramo mu muhango wa Ballon d'or wabereye Theatre du Châtelet i Paris mu Bufaransa.
2024: Album ya kabiri ya Studio; HEIS.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2024, Rema yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya kabiri ya studio yitwa HEIS. Umutwe wa alubumu wakomotse ku ijambo ry'Ikigereki rivuga "numero 1". Yerekana Rema ufite izina rye, "Igikomangoma cya Afrobeats". Iyi alubumu igizwe n'indirimbo 11 igaragaramo ijwi ryijimye, ritwarwa n'ingoma ugereranije na alubumu ye ya mbere, Rave &amp; Roses. Rema avuga ko ubu buryo bushya muri muzika ye ari " afro-rave " asobanura ko "[we ubwe yiyumvisha Afrobeats," mu kiganiro yagiranye na HOT 97 mu 2022. Ijwi ni uruvange rw'ubwoko butandukanye kuva Afrobeats, inzu, hip-hop, n'imbyino. HEIS ifite byinshi yerekana kumico kavukire ya Edo kandi yerekana ubushakashatsi ku nsanganyamatsiko yo gushimira umuco no kwiyemeza gushimisha abateze amatwi bituma bayifata nkirimo abadayimoni. Nubwo yanenzwe hakiri kare, HEIS yagaragaye ku mwanya wa 2 ku mbonerahamwe ya Top 100 ya Album, nyuma igera ku mwanya wa mbere, kandi imaze ibyumweru 29 iri ku mbonerahamwe hamwe no gcurangwa isnhuro miliyoni 104. Byongeye kandi, alubumu ya kabiri yakiriye Grammy nomination ya Rema kuri Album nziza yumuziki wisi yose yaranze nomero ya mbere ya Grammy ya Rema.
2025: "Uruhinja (Nicyaha)" na "Bout U.".
Ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2025, Rema yasohoye indirimbo ' Uruhinja (Ni Icyaha) ' yerekana icyitegererezo cya Sade cyo mu 1985 ' Ni Icyaha '. yaramenyekanye cyane, ihinduka imwe mu ndirimbo zo muri Nigeriya zikunzwe cyane mu 2025.
Ku ya 11 Mata 2025, Rema yasohoye indi ndirimbo yitwa ' Bout U '.
Ku ya 28 Nzeri 2020, Rema yanditse ku rubuga rwa Twitter ashinja Ishyaka Riharanira Demokarasi no Kurengera Ibidukikije (PDP) ku ruhare bagize mu rupfu rwa se, Justice Ikubor, wahoze ari umuyobozi w'iryo shyaka. Nubwo Rema yemerewe kwiga muri kaminuza ya Lagos mu 2022, byabaye ngombwa ko ava muri icyo kigo mu 2023 kubera imyigaragambyo y’abakozi ba ASUU ikomeje.
"Rolling Stone" yagize ati "Rema nta gushidikanya kandi yishimye kuba ikimenyetso cy’izamuka rya Afrobeats ku isi." Kwandika ku "munsi w’ubucuruzi" Anthony Udugba yavuze ko Rema "yaguye icyerekezo" cy’umuziki nyafurika ku isi yose. "Guardian yo muri Nijeriya" yagize iti "Mu gihe imiterere ya Afrobeats ikomeje gutera imbere, izamuka rya Rema ryashyizeho urwego rwo hejuru, ryerekana umuziki wa Nijeriya ukunzwe ku isi hose ikunze ndetse ku rwego mpuzamahanga." "Kavukire" yagize ati "Ntibishoboka gusiba ikimenyetso yasize ku mateka ya Afrobeats." Victor Okpala yagize ati "Ijwi rya Rema ryashimangiye umwanya we nk'inzira nyabagendwa." Abamunenga benshi bamushimye kuba yararenze inzitizi kandi akangurira abandi bahanzi bo muri Afurika. “Rema arashimangira umwanya we nk'umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye ba Afrobeat bo mu gisekuru cye, hamwe n'umurage uzibukwa mu myaka iri imbere.”

MUTUYEMUNGU Ignace, yavukiye mu Karere ka Nyanza mu umurenge wa Busasamana mu Intara y'amajyepfo
ahasaga mu umwaka 1988.Amashuri abanza nayize muri Primaire Mubuga akomereza mu amashuri yisumbuye muri E s st Sprit de Nyanza akomereza kaminuza mu ishami ry'uburezi. ubu akorera mu karere ka Rwamagana umurenge wa Gishari Akagali ka Bwinsanga Umudugudu wa Shaburondo.

Intandaro yo guterwa inda ku bangavu.
Ababyeyi bataganiriza abana babo ku buzima bw'imyororokere, ni imwe mu mpamvu zituma abangavu batwara inda zitateganyijwe. Izindi mpamvu zigwarukwaho cyane mubitera gusambanya abana batarageza imyaka y'ubukure harimo ubusinzi buri mu miryango, kutagira umwanya wo gukurikirana no kuganira mu muryango, ubuharike, gucana inyuma kw'abashakanye, kudasobanukirwa ihame ry'uburinganire, ababyeyi batita ku nshingano ndetse n'amakimbirane hagati y'abashakanye aterwa n'impamvu zitandukanye.
Imibare yagaragaye mu bushakatsi bwakozwe na komisiyo y'igihugu y'uburenganzira bwa muntu bwagaragaje ko abakobwa baterwa inda batarageza ku myaka y'ubukure 57.1% bazitewe n'abo basanzwe ari inshuti, 7% bakaziterwa n'abaturanyi babo mugihe 2% bazitewe n'abo bafitanye isano.

Nize amashuri abanza kuri GS Juru,amashuri yisumbuye nyakomereza kuri ES Nyamirama. Nakomeje icyiciro cya mbere cya kamizuza muri kaminuza y'Urwanda isha ry'uburezi rya Rukara. Ubu nkaba ndi umwarimu w'igifaransa n'icyongereza ku ishuri ryisumbuye rya Gishari mu karere ka RWamagana. Nkunda gucuranga piano no kumva slow music.

Akamaro k'igishanga cy'urugezi.
Igishanga cy'urugezi ni kimwe mu bishanga bifitiye igihugu akamaro kanini, iki gishanga giherereye mu karere ka Burera kikaba gikora ku mirenge ya Butaro, Ruhunde, Kivuye, Gatebe, Rwerere na Miyove yo muri Gicumbi mu ntara y'amajyaruguru.
iki gishanga gifite akamaro gatandukanye kubagituriye ndetse nigihugu muri rusange aha twavuga nko kuba aricyo gitanga amashanyarazi akoreshwa cyane mu gihugu, intaho y'inyamaswa, gitanga amazi, gikurura ba mukerarugendo...

GS Gishari ni ikigo giherereye mu ntara y'uburasirazuba, akarere ka Rwamagana, umurenge wa Gishari, akagari ka bwinsanga umudugudu wa shaburondo.
Cyatangiye mu mwaka w' 1967 cyitwa ecole primary Gishari mu mwaka wa 2013 nibwo ikigo cyaje kwaguka kigira na ikiciro cyambere cya mashuri yisumbuye, mu mwaka wa 2020 nibwo cyakomeje kwiyongera kigira ikiciro cya kabiri cya mashuri yisumbuye ishami ry' Imibare, ubukungu n'ubumenyi bwisi(Mathematics Economics and Geography)..
Icyo kigo gihereye kandi haruguru y'ikiyaga cya muhazi mu birometero 3km uvuye kuri icyo kiyaga. icyo kigo kiyobowe n'umuyobozi wit nawa KARANGWA Olivier(head teacher) na UWIMANA Gertulde. kigizwe kandi n'abarimu basaga 20 b'icyiciro kibanza,20 b'ikiciro cya mbere kisumbuye ndetse n'abarimu 5 b'icyiciro cya kabiri kisumbuye.

Ibitaro by' akarere ka rwamagana nibimwe mubitaro bikuru biri mugihugu bikababi herereye mumurengewa kigabiro akagari kanyagasenyi bigizwe nibindi bito bibyungirije harimo Ruhunda na nkomangwa ikaba Ari(Post du sante) na rubona mumwaka wa 2015 byabonye umuyobozi mushya ariwe Dr MUCYESHIMANA Adeline asimbuye Dr NKURANGA John ugiye gukomeza kwiga.
Mu ihererekanyabubasha hagati y’aba bayobozi bombi Kanama 2015, Dr. Nkuranga yashimiye abakozi bose ku bufatanye n’ubwitange bakoranye bwatumye Ibitaro bya Rwamagana biva ku rwego rw’Akarere bigashyirwa ku rwego rw’Intara. bivuze ngo ibitaro bya rwamagana nibikuru kurwego rw' intara Dr. Mukeshimana Madeleine wari usanzwe akuriye abaganga, nyuma yo guhabwa ububasha nk’Umuyobozi w’Agateganyo w’Ibitaro bya Rwamagana, yasabye abakozi bose b’ibitaro gukomeza ubufatanye kugira ngo intambwe bigezeho itazasubira inyuma.muri make aba ni abantu bakora ntamushahara bahabwa keretse ishimwe bitewe n'ibyo bakoze.

ADEPR yagejejwe mu Rwanda n’Abamisiyoneri bo muri Suède. Nyuma y’imyaka itatu bahageze ni bwo mu 1943 babatije Umunyarwanda wa mbere, Sagatwa Rudoviko, wabaye umukirisitu wa mbere mu itorero. Ubutumwa bwashibutse mu myaka 83 ishize bumaze gukwira ku isi yose ndetse by’umwihariko mu Rwanda ADEPR ifite abayoboke barenga miliyoni ebyiri.
Imibanire y'abakristo.
Urwo rusengero abakirisito bafite gahunda nziza yo kugemurira abarwayi kwa muganga, ibyo babikora bakusanya imfashanyo muri bo. Mu Rwanda insengero zifasha Leta y'u Rwanda mu kugabanya ibyaha bitandukanye nk'ubujura, abigisha bashishikariza abantu kwirinda ibyaha kuko ari inzira ijyana abantu mu muriro w'iteka.Abakristu i Gishari baharanira kubaho bakurikiza inyigisho za Yesu Kristo. Bagaragaza urukundo, gufashanya, gusenga no kugira imyitwarire myiza mu miryango no mu muryango mugari. Bitabira ibikorwa by'itorero, bafasha abatishoboye kandi bagaharanira amahoro n'ubumwe. Imibereho yabo igamije kuba urugero rwiza mu mico no mu bikorwa bya buri munsi.

Umuco w’ubukorerabushake wabanje kuba mu bigo bikora imirimo itandukanye byakoreshaga abantu bize ibintu runaka bashaka kwiyongerera ubunararibonye.
Mu mwaka wa 2020 ubwo icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyadukaga mu Rwanda no ku isi, urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake nibwo rwumvikanye cyane rufasha inzego za Leta mu iyubahirizwa ry’amabwiriza yo kwirinda icyo cyorezo cyari cyahagaritse ubuzima bw’abantu.
Nyuma kandi haje kuza n’amasezerano yasinywe hagati y’abahagarariye uru rubyiruko na Porogaramu y’Igihugu Mbonezamikurire y’abana bato, aho buri mukorerabushake, mu mudugudu atuyemo yiyemeje kujya aganira n’ababyeyi bafite abana, akabigisha gutegura indyo yuzuye no kwita ku bana.
, Umuyobozi Mukuru muri Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu ushinzwe Ubukangurambaga nIbikorwa by’Urubyiruko rw’Abakorerabushake, Richard Kubana yavuze ko bifuza ko urubyiruko ruba rwinshi mu bikorwa by’ubukorerabushake, hibandwa ku buryo buri wese yakwitanga mu bijyanye n’ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bwe.
avuga ko urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake ruhari uyu munsi rubarirwa mu bihumbi 600, bakaba bifuza ko rugera kuri miliyoni imwe n’igice [1.500.000].
Ati “Nibura nitugira abangana na miliyoni n’igice bakora neza, bafite uwo muco wo kwitangira igihugu byaba ari byiza.”
Kubana avuga ko kuri iyi nshuro buri wese ushaka kuba umukorerabushake azajya ahitamo urwego ashaka gutangamo umusanzu we, bitewe n’ibyo afitemo ubushobozi.
yavuzeko Dufite urubyiruko rwinshi rwize ibintu byinshi bitandukanye, barimo abaganga, abize ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, abanyamategeko n’abandi. bivuze ngo buriwese yakora ibyo yisangamo.
ibibangamira urubyiruko.
