Kayitesi Sonia bakunze kwita Dj Sonia yavutse 31 Ukwakira 1998 mu Karere ka Huye, mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda, ise ni Pio Nkubito na mama we yitwa Mathlide Mukarutesi ni umukinnyi wa jockey w'umunyarwanda baba mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda, ni umudamu w’umucuruzi, utegura ibirori, umunyamideli na moderi akaba umukinnyi wa filime.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'akazi.
Yinjiye mu mwuga wa deejaying kuva muri 2019. Azwi cyane kubikorwa bye muri Muzika yu Rwanda abinyujije mu marushanwa yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina igikombe cyisi. Yagize uruhare mu birori byo mu Rwanda byo guha izina ingagi yavutse, izwi cyane ku izina rya Kwita Izina.
Sonia yakinnye mu bitaramo byinshi bitandukanye, birimo Silent Disco, Imyidagaduro myiza, Ibihangange byo muri Afurika, Iserukiramuco rya Hill, kandi yakinnye mu mahoteri atandukanye ndetse n'imikino myinshi, harimo na Afrobasket y'Abagore mu Rwanda 2023, FIBA Igikombe cyisi, nahandi henshi. DJ Sonia uri mu ba DJ benshi b'abagore mu kuvanga umuziki i Kigali, yatumiwe mu gitaramo aho yahuye na Darassa akaba ari umwe mu mazina akomeye muri muzika ya Tanzaniya na Masauti akaba ari umwe mu bahanzi bazwi cyane i Nairobi. Kugeza ubu ni umwe mu bavanga imiziki y'ibitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda, Radio Rwanda, TV y'u Rwanda, n'ishami ryayo rya kabiri, ariryo KC2.
Yakinnye nka Dj igihe abaririmbyi bo muri Nijeriya bombi Davido na Tiwa Savage bagiye mu Rwanda.

Umuringa KAremera Carole (yavutse 1975) ni umukinnyi akaba ari umunyarwandakazi w’u Rwanda wavukiye mu Bubiligi, umukinnyi w'afilimi wa saxofhone umuyobozi w’ikinamico, umuhanzi utegura ibirori ndetse n’inzobere muri politiki y’umuco.
Yavutse mu 1975 i Buruseli, umukobwa w’abanyarwanda bari mu buhungiro. Nkumwana, Carole Karemera yari indashyikirwa mu mibare kandi arota gufungura imigati. Carole Karemera yize muri Royal Conservatory of Theatre na Muzika mu Bubiligi Muri 1994, ise, umunyamakuru, yasubiye mu Bubiligi biturutse kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Carole Karemera yavumbuye u Rwanda mu 1995.
Yakinnye mu makinamico menshi, nka Battlefield ya Peter Brook na Marie-Hélène Estienne, Twise urukundo na Felwine Sarr, Jaz na Koffi Kwahulé, Scratchin 'imbere imbere" na Wim Vandekeybus Umugore wa Bogus' na Kay Adshead, na Anathema na Jacques Delcuvellerie, kandi icyarimwe batangira umwuga we wa sinema Hagati ya 2000 na 2004, yagize uruhare runini mu ikinamico ya Groupov Rwanda 94. Se wabo, Jean-Marie Muyango, umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye bo mu Rwanda gakondo, yahimbye amanota kuri iki gitaramo.
Mu 2005, Carole Karemera yagize uruhare runini hamwe na Idris Elba muri filime ya Raoul Peck "Rimwe na rimwe muri Mata", hafi ya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994. Muri uwo mwaka, yahisemo gutura i Kigali. Carole Karemera amaze kwimukira mu gihugu, yagize uruhare mu mishinga y’umuco, harimo isomero rya mbere rigendanwa ry’u Rwanda, ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya mbere cy’u Rwanda i Kigali ISHYO, Espace Madiba isomero ryeguriwe ubuvanganzo nyafurika na Karayibe ryateguye udukino twifashisha mu tubari no mumihanda yimijyi yu Rwanda, murwego rwo guteza imbere abumva bashya hamwe nabaturage mubuhanzi. Mu 2007, Carole Karemera n'abandi bagore barindwi bashinze ikigo cy’ubuhanzi cya Ishyo i Kigali kugira ngo bashyigikire iterambere ry’ubuhanzi n’umuco mu Rwanda.
Karemera yabaye Umuyobozi w'Inama y'Ubutegetsi mu Kigega Nyafurika cy'Umurage Nyafurika, nk'umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije wa Arterial Network, ndetse n'uhagarariye igihugu cya Arterial Network mu Rwanda. Yakinnye mu mukino "wa Battlefield" wa 2016 wa Peter Brook, ashingiye kuri "Mahabharata". Muri 2018, yahawe igihembo muri Les Journées théâtrales de Carthage, yishimira ibikorwa bye mu ikinamico mu Rwanda no muri Afurika.

Kamatari Thierry izina ry'ubuhanzi nka Racine Rwanda yavukiye i Kigali, mu Rwanda ni umuraperi wu munyaRwanda, umusizi ndetse umwanditsi w'afilimi.
Yakoze filimi y'urukurikirane rwu Rwanda rwitwa Impanga. Yatorewe kuba umukinnyi wu mugabo mwiza muri "Impanga Series Awards". Indirimbo ye"Crush" yarangije umwanya wa kabiri wumuziki mwiza wu Rwanda kuri RFI. Mu ndirimbo yanditse harimo "nka Umwamikazi" wa Lil G feat Christopher Muneza na "Katapilla" ya Bruce Melodie.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ni umuhungu wa Rutajoga Innocent, na Gahongayire Genevieve, abaye uwa kabiri mu bana batanu. Ni se wa Inganzo Aiden Lyric wavutse muri 2023.
Racine ni umuraperi wo mu Rwanda kandi ufatwa nk'umwe mu baraperi bafite impano yo mu mutwe u Rwanda yagize mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 2010, wamenyekanye cyane mu 2017 nyuma yo gushyira ahagaragara indirimbo ye ya mbere yise Agahugu.
Rap ye ahanini yashinze imizi mubisigo kuko yahoze ari umusizi mbere yo kuba umuraperi asubira mumashuri yisumbuye. Nyuma, yaje kuba umuraperi ku izina rya stage G-Intwari aho azaririmbira ku ishuri.
Mbere yo kugira alubumu ya mbere, Racine yakoranye imishinga ibiri, imwe ikaba megahit WAKIWAKI irimo inyenyeri zose zifitwe na Ish Kevin. Racine yagize uruhare runini mugushinga ibyuma byumuziki bitari ibintu mu Rwanda kera. Yakoze umwe mu basifuzi badasanzwe witwa Imizi cypher muri 2018 yerekanaga abaraperi benshi bafite impano. Bavuga ko yohereje amafoto ya subliminal kuri bagenzi be baraperi mu ndirimbo ye ya KAREZI Yagaragaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu 2021 kubera umurongo wa rap yihuta cyane wagaragaye kuri GANG-LA ft WAWA. Numwanditsi w'ibizima kubahanzi benshi.
Racine yakoze alubumu ye ya mbere muri 2022, RWAHIPHOP, mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo bisobanura Ripande Hip Hop ifite ingaragu 13, hamwe n’ubufatanye butavugwaho rumwe bwiswe IKANZU bwavugaga umujyi kubera umwihariko wabwo udasanzwe kuko byari biteye ubwoba. Iyi niyo alubumu yonyine yabonye kugeza ubu. Muri 2023, yasohoye umukino wagutse EP witwa 2023AD. Album ye ya mbere 2022 "RwaHiphop".
Racine yakinnye muri serie ya Impanga muri 2020 aho yatangiriye ku gice cya 3, igihembwe cya 1, kandi yatorewe kuba umukinnyi wumugabo mwiza wigitaramo. Muri iki gitaramo, bigaragara ko ari umuhungu ukennye ukomoka mu cyaro agerageza kwibeshaho mu mujyi wa Kigali akora umuziki wa rap.

Bizimana Amani Bizimana (yavutse 1996), uzwi ku izina rya Amalon ni umuririmbyi akaba n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo na Filimi. Kuva mu Karere ka Rubavu, yabanje kumenyekana asohora amashusho yindirimbo Yambi muri 2018.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Amalon yavutse muri 1996 mu karere ka Rubavu mu ntara y’iburengerazuba y’u Rwanda, avukira Amran na Uwamahoro Habiba. Amalon yize amashuri yisumbuye ya Kagarama kurwego rusanzwe hanyuma nyuma ahuriweho na Integrated Polytechnic Regional Centre IPRC Kicukiro.
Yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuraperi nyuma yinjira muri Afrobeat na R&amp;B ayobowe na 1 K Entertainment, isosiyete yashinzwe na Pius Rukabuza, uzwi ku izina rya DJ Pius, umuririmbyi wo mu Rwanda akaba na DJ uzwi kugeza mu 2021.
Indirimbo ye ya mbere "yambi" yamushizeho kugirango yamamare mu ndirimbo zitandukanye yakurikiranye nka "Byakubaho" na "Delilah" arimo Ally Soudy.
Muri 2019, yari mu bahanzi, barimo Sheebah Karungi ukomoka muri Uganda, Bruce Melodie, nyirarume Austin, Riderman, Social Mulah, Active, Safi Madiba, Marina, Umwamikazi cha na Jay Polly, bakoreye ibitaramo muri Camp Kigali.
Muri uwo mwaka, Amalon niwe muhanzi wu Rwanda wenyine wakinnye kuri stage hamwe na Burna Boy mu gitaramo cya BurnaBoyExperience cyabereye muri Intare Conference Arena.

Mazimpaka Jones Kennedy ni muntu ki?
Mazimpaka Jones Kennedy ni umunyarwanda ukurikije ubwenegihugu akaba afite imyaka 64 y'amavuko. ni umukinnyi wa film haba mu karere ndetse no mu mahanga. yagaragaye muri video nyinshi zikora advert z'ubucuruzi kandi yagiye agaragara muri film mpuza mahanga kurubu kandi Mazimpaka akaba ri umwe mu bashumba bakorera ivuga butumwa mu Itorero rya Authentic Word Ministry Zion temple Celebration Center
Mazimpaka jones Kennedy amazina yiswe n'ababyeyi akaba yaravukiye mu gihugu cy'uburundi kuya gashyantare mu 1960 akurira mu gihugu cya Uganda. Amashuri ye yisumbuye yayize mu gihugu cy'Ubugande muri Kololo Senior Secondary School mu mwaka wa 1977 kugeza 1978, yashoreje amashuri yisumbuye Kampala High school mu mwaka wa 1979 kugeza mu 1980 kurubu akaba ari umugabo utuye Ahitwa Ntarama muri bugesera,
Mazimpaka Jones Kennedy afite uburebure bwa metero imwe na mirongo itandatu na karindwi (1.67) z'uburebure akaba kandi yarashakanye na Kibuuka Harriet akaba yarabyaye abana barindwi aribo Musoni Allan, Kabera Arnold, Nkusi Arthur, Ndahiro Alban,Utamuriza Bridget, Nshuti Bella harimo nuwitabye Imana Mpfizi Asley.

Itahiwacu Bruce (yavutse ku ya 3 Werurwe 1992), bakunze kwita Bruce Melodie uzwi ku izina rya Munyakazi ni umuririmbyi wo mu Rwanda yatsindiye Primus Guma Guma Super Star inshuro 8 PGGSS.
Niwe washinze Ig бар umuziki wanditseho Label. Bruce kandi ni ambasaderi w'ikirango cya BK Arena na Primus. Akora umuziki we muri 1:55 AM label yari iyobowe n'umutoza Gael. Mu Kwakira 2023, Bruce melody yasohoye indirimbo ya mbere. Iyo ari hafi irimo Jamaica ikora ibitaramo mpuzamahanga Shaggy.
Bruce Itahiwacu yavukiye mu Karere ka Kicukiro. Ni umwana wa kabiri mu muryango w'abana bane uhagarariwe na Gervain Ntibihangana (se) na Velene Muteteri wapfuye mu 2013. Bruce yize amashuri abanza ya Camp Kanombe i Kanombe, amashuri yisumbuye ayiga mu ishuri rya kisilamu rya Rwamagana.
Bruce afatwa nk'umuyobozi w'umucuranzi wu Rwanda. Yatangiye kuririmba akiri muto muri korari y'itorero maze asohora indirimbo ye ya mbere ya alubumu Tubivemo munsi yitwa, "Ndumiwe", muri Kanama 2013. Album ye ya kabiri, "Ntundize", yasohotse mu 2014. Muri kiriya gihe, Bruce yabarizwaga muri Super Level Music Label. Muri Gashyantare 2021, Bruce yatangaje ko yasinyanye na Cloud 9 Entertainment kugira ngo akurikirane umwuga we wa muzika, ariko muri 2022 asesa amasezerano na Lee maze yinjira mu buyobozi bushya, 1:55 AM Imyidagaduro, iyobowe n'umutoza wa Gael Karomba AKA Gael.
Yakinnye ibitaramo mu Rwanda no mu bihugu duturanye, harimo na Uganda kandi akorana n'abahanzi benshi, barimo Urban Boyz, Umwamikazi Cha, JayC, Sheebah Karungi, Pallaso, B2C, Fik fameica na Khaligraph Jones. Yise Craig David nk'intumwa ye. Niwe muhanzi wambere wu Rwanda waririmbye muri Coke Studio (Afrika) | Coke Studio Afrika.. Muri 2020 Bruce melodie yareze Kenny Sol na Juno kizigenza. Mu 2023 yagaragaye mu ndirimbo ya Harmonize yitwa Zanzibar.
Bruce Melodie, muri 2021, yatoranijwe nk'umwe mu bahanzi bo mu Rwanda bafite ubukungu buhamye. Bruce Melodie n'itsinda rye batangije TV TV ISIBO TV (2020) Yasinyanye kandi amasezerano akomeye yo kwemeza na sosiyete ya BROK ya miliyoni 50 z'amafaranga y'u Rwf. Yakoranye n’amasosiyete y'itumanaho yaho (MTN, Airtel) abinyujije mu kwamamaza kandi yasinyanye na infinix mobile nka ambasaderi wayo. Yasinyanye kandi amasezerano na Tecno mobile muri 2021. Yasinyanye amasezerano mashya na Kigali Arena yari ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 150 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda maze mu 2021 aba umuherwe mu mafranga y'u Rwanda asinyana amasezerano na miliyoni y'amadorali y'Amerika na Food Bundles. Ari mubacuranzi 20 ba mbere baturutse muri Afrika yuburasirazuba kurutonde rwabaherwe muri USD. &lt;/link&gt;["citation ikenewe"]

Nduwimana Jean Paul, bakunze kwita amazi ya Noopja yavutse muri 07 Kanama 1983) i Nyarugenge, mu Rwanda, kuri Daniel Baranzira na Therese Mukamazimpaka, ni umuhanzi ufata amajwi mu Rwanda, rwiyemezamirimo, umwanditsi akaba n'u washinze label yanditse yitwa Country Records. Noopja ni we washinze sitidiyo yamamaye muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba Country Records, washinze radiyo yo mu Rwanda 105.7 FM Country FM akaba n'umuyobozi wa Necessary Generation, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta ufasha urubyiruko rutishoboye ruva mu mpande zitandukanye. Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwambere nakazi.
Nduwimana Jean Paul, wavutse ku ya 7 Kanama 1983, avukira mu murenge wa Gitambi wo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, uherereye mu murwa mukuru wa Kigali mu Rwanda. Ni umwana wa gatatu mu muryango w'abantu barindwi, umuhungu wa Mukamazimpaka Therese na Baranzira Daniel. Abavandimwe be barimo KOZZE, uzwi cyane mu gutunganya umuziki wo mu Rwanda. Noopja yakundaga umuziki yakongejwe na nyina, wabaye ingoma y'itorero kandi yari azwiho kwitangira gusenga no kuririmba buri gitondo mu rugo. Uku kumenyekanisha hakiri kare umuziki ninjyana byashizeho urufatiro rwumwuga wejo hazaza mu muziki. Guhura n’ibibazo na sitidiyo zafashwe amajwi yabanje gukorana, Yahisemo gushinga sitidiyo ye yo gufata amajwi, Country Records. Intego ye kwari ugushiraho ibidukikije byunganira kandi byubaha abahanzi, bakemeza ko bahabwa icyubahiro nubufasha babikwiye.
Usibye gushinga Country Records, Noopja yatangije "Country FM". Icyerekezo cye kuri radiyo kwari ugutanga urubuga rwibanda ku rubyiruko, ruteza imbere impano zabo, rukanabaha amahirwe yo kwerekana ubushobozi bwabo. Binyuze muri izo gahunda, yagize uruhare runini mu muziki w’u Rwanda kandi akomeza gushishikariza no gutera inkunga abahanzi bakiri bato mu gace atuyemo.

Muhoranimana Eloi (yavutse ku ya 27 Gicurasi 1999), uzwi cyane ku izina ry'ubuhanzi Eloi El ni umuhanzi w'umuziki w'umunyarwanda, umwanditsi w'indirimbo ndetse na producer utungana amashusho.
Eloi kabuhariwe mu muziki wo munzu wimbitse akaba ari sub-genre y'umuziki wimbyino za elegitoronike (EDM). Eloi yasohoye ingaragu zirenga 10 ubufatanye nka: "Magical", "Amajwi," "Utari kumwe, Inzira Unkunda".
Eloi yasohoye Umukino wagutse EP witwa "Afurika ku Isi", wagaragaye nkuwambere wagaragaye muri EP yasohoye.

Kasirye Martin bakunze kwita Mc Tino azwi ku izina rya Tino Berbatov) wavutse kuya 2 ugushyingo 1984 i Jinja, muri Uganda kubabyeyi bitwa Baramaze John na Veronique Tebasurwa, ni umunyamakuru w’umunyarwanda, akaba ari munyamakuru ukorera kuri Radio, ari umuhanzi, MC na Deejay. Yakundaga kwerekana ibirori bitandukanye by'umuziki harimo Primus Guma Guma Super Star. Yabaye MC mu bitaramo byose bikomeye byabereye mu Rwanda, muri byo hateguwe na MTN u Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
yize muri kaminuza yu Rwanda mu ishami ry’imicungire y’ubucuruzi Marketing muri 2010. Yakomereje amasomo ye mu Buhinde, mu kigo cy’Ubuhinde gishinzwe itumanaho, aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu itumanaho rusange.
Mc Tino yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere, "Umurima", muri 2018 ifite indirimbo zizwi cyane nka Umurima, Niwe Nawe, MULA.
Mc Tino yari umuririmbyi wambere wa TBB trio yumuziki yari igizwe nabanyamuryango batatu: Tino, Bob na Benja. Batandukanye nyuma ya Primus Guma Guma Superstar saison 6 atangira umwuga wenyine.
Kuri ubu akora ikiganiro cyitwa DUNDA Show kuri KT Radio. Yakiriye Sonia Kayitesi, Jean Paul Bujyacyera, DJ Ira, Auddy Kelly, Confy, Racine Kamatari, Kataleya na Kandle, Marc Uwizeye na Emmanuel Sibomana kuri radio ye yitwa Dunda kuri KT Radio.
Yakundaga kwerekana ibirori bitandukanye byumuziki harimo Primus Guma Guma Super Star. Yabaye MC mu bitaramo byose bikomeye byabereye mu Rwanda, muri byo hateguwe na MTN u Rwanda. Mc Tino afatwa nkumuyobozi wu Rwanda Mc Rwanda yatangiye mcee kuva 2007.
Yakoze nka mc igihe Jason Derulo yagiye mu Rwanda.

Tuyishime Joshua yavutse ku ya 5 Nyakanga 1988 kugeza 2 Nzeri 2021 uzwi ku izina rya Jay Polly, yari umucuranzi w'u Rwanda.
Jay Polly niwe wegukanye Primus Guma Guma Super Star ibihe 4 (PGGSS4). Yari umwe mu bahanzi batsinze injyana ya hip - hop mu Rwanda kandi yahoze mu itsinda ry’itsinda rya hip - hop ryitwa Tuff Gang hamwe n’abandi baraperi nka "Fireman", "BullDogg", "P Fla", na "Green P."
Muri 2014, Jay Poly yari ambasaderi w’ikirango wa MTN u Rwanda. Mbere y'urupfu rwe, Jay Polly yari yarasangiye ibyiciro n'abahanzi bazwi ku isi barimo Lucky Dube, Koffi Olomide, Sean Kingston, Jason Derulo, Kevin Lyttle, na Davido.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Jay Polly yavutse ku ya 5 Nyakanga 1988, avukira i Gikondo, mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda. Yabaye umwana wa kabiri mu muryango w'abantu batatu barimo mukuru we, "Uwera Jean Maurice" uzwi ku izina rya "Uncle Morris," umunyamakuru w'u Rwanda. Jay Polly yize amashuri abanza ya Kinunga n'icyahoze ari ETO Kicukiro ubu Integrated Polytechnic Regional College (IPRC) Kigali.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Jay Polly yatangiye kwandika no gufata amajwi muri 2003, ubwo yari mu mashuri yisumbuye ari kumwe n'incuti ye icyo gihe none akaba umuraperi, "Green P." Hamwe n'izindi nshuti, bashinze itsinda ry'umuziki ryitwa G5. Mu 2004, itsinda ryaratandukanye maze Jay atangira gufata umuziki wenyine. Yasohoye "Amafaranga" ye yindirimbo yakurikiwe nindirimbo zakunzwe "Nda Khoho", "ubona", nizindi nyinshi.
Muri 2007, Jay Polly na Green P bagiye gufata amajwi muri studio ya ONB aho producer "Lick Lick" yakoraga. Lick Lick yafataga amajwi abahanzi batandukanye bo mu Rwanda icyo gihe bazaza ubu barimo abastar barimo "King James", Meddy, na The Ben hamwe n’abandi baraperi 3 bato "BullDogg", "Fireman", na "P Fla." Lick Lick, amaze kubona ko abaraperi batanu bafite icyerekezo kimwe n’ubushobozi, bahisemo kubahuza no gukora itsinda ryumuziki witwa TuffGang.
Muri 2011 na 2013, Jay Polly yatowe muri Primus Guma Guma Super Star (PGGSS) ariko ntiyayitsinda. Muri 2013, yasinyanye amasezerano yimyaka 3 na Touch Records aho yasohoye indirimbo zitandukanye zamamaye zirimo "Deux fois Deux", "Nda kuho Ndahumeka", "Malaika", na "Siribateri" ft Bruce Melodie kuvuga bake. Muri 2014, yatowe muri PGGSS saison 4 yatsinze ku ya 30 Kanama uwo mwaka.

Munyangango Audace yavutse ku ya 9 Mata 1989, wamenyekanye ku izina rya Auddy Kelly, ni umuririmbyi w'umunya Rwanda, umwanditsi w'indirimbo na rwiyemezamirimo.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Auddy yavukiye mu Rwanda ari umwana wa kabiri mu bana batatu. Yatangiye kuririmba akiri muto atangirana na "Azaph Music International", itsinda rya korari ku rusengero rwa Siyoni.
Yashyizeho itsinda ry'abaririmbyi bitwaga "Abasizwe 6" hanyuma nyuma, atangira gutwara wenyine.
Muri 2014, Kelly yari afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda. Muri 2018, yerekeje muri kaminuza ya Mount Kenya aho yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu micungire y’imari.
Kelly yatangiye umwuga we wo kuririmba muri 2012. Muri 2016, Yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuhanzi mwiza wa Afro fusion numuhanzi mwiza w'imyambarire. Bivugwa ko ari we muntu wa mbere wateguye "ishakisha rya Karaoke Talent", rigamije gufasha no gutera inkunga abaririmbyi babonaga ko bafite impano binyuze muri Karaoke. Nk’uko KT Press ibitangaza, yanavuguruye Amasunzu mu kuri.
Yasohoye kandi alubumu yagaragayemo Jody Phibi Album za studio.

Benjamin Mugisha yavutse ku ya 9 Mutarama 1987 yamenyekanye ku izina rya The Ben, ni umuririmbyi akaba n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yimukiye muri Amerika aho yakoranye n'umuhanzi Mike E Ellison ukomoka mu mujyi wa Detroit. Nyuma, yatumiriwe gutaramira ku cyicaro cya Loni. Indirimbo ya Ben yitwa " I'm in love", yasohotse mu Kwakira 2012, yatumye hashyirwaho icyiciro gishya cy'umuziki mu birori byo gutanga ibihembo bya Salax Music 2012 mu Rwanda bituma aba umuntu wa mbere wahawe igihembo cy'umuhanzi w’umuziki mwiza muri Diaspora.
Mu 2021, Julien Bmjizzo; Uzwi mukuyobora videwo z’umuziki wo mu Rwanda yafashe amashusho anayobora indirimbo yise "Why" ya The Ben na Diamond Platnumz.
Yavutse ku ya 9 Mutarama 1987, avukira i Kampala, muri Uganda.
Ben yashakanye na Uwicyeza Pamella wamenyekanye nka Miss Rwanda 2019. bafitanye umwana umwe w’imfura witwa Icyeza Luna Mugisha Ora.
Ben yamenyekanye nk'umuhanzi witwaye neza muri Afro R&amp;B muri Salax Awards, ibihembo by’umuziki ku rwego rw’igihugu mu Rwanda mu 2008-2009. Muri 2009-2010 yongeye kwakira igihembo "Umuhanzi witwaye neza muri Afro R&amp;B ndetse n'umuhanzi mwiza w'umugabo. Muri 2010-11, yatsindiye indirimbo nziza, Ben yahawe indirimbo ya Salas Award y'umwaka wa 2010- 2011.

Nabonibo Albert yavutse 1983 cyangwa 1984 ni umuririmbyi z'ihimbaza Imana akaba n'umucungamari ukomoka i Gicumbi mu nkengero za Kigali, mu Rwanda. Amakuru ya Thomson Reutersna Foundation asobanura Nabonibo nk'umuririmbyi uzwi kandi uzwi cyane, kandi avuga ko yasohoye indirimbo umunani z'Imana kuva mu 2012. Muri Kanama 2019, yaje kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga ubwo yavaga ari abaryamana bahuje ibitsina, ibyo bikaba bifitanye isano n’ibitekerezo bya Afurika byo kurwanya abaryamana bahuje ibitsina. Byongeye kandi, amatorero yo mu gihugu cya gikirisitu avuga ko kuba LGBTQ ari icyaha. Mu gusohoka abaye uwa mbere mu Rwanda umuririmbyi w'Imana kumugaragaro. "Pink News" yamwise izina rya munani inkuru zikomeye kandi zigenda zisohoka zo muri 2019, avuga ko byanze bikunze yahura nabyo.
Albert Nabonibo yavutse 1984 muri Kacyiru na Grew muri Gicumbi, kamwe mu turere dutanu two mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru, u Rwanda. Nabonibo yagize uruhare mu matorero yo muri Afurika y’Abapentekote harimo n’umwe mu bagize korari y’iryo torero. Yagize icyo ageraho kuva 2014, harimo "Umenipenda" na "Sogongera." Kugeza muri Kanama 2019, byabaye ngombwa ko ahuza ibitsina kandi akabaho ubuzima bubiri. Nkuko yabikekaga, Nabonibo yahuye n'ikibazo cyo kuva ku kazi, mu muryango, no gutotezwa ku rusengero bituma avuye muri batatu.
Umugabane ufite amategeko akomeye ku isi arwanya abaryamana bahuje ibitsina, n'abantu ba LGBTQ ; guhuza ibitsina ni icyaha mu bihugu byinshi, ibihano kuva igihe cyo gufungwa kugeza gupfa.

wavutse Patrick Bibarwa yavutse muri mutarama 2010 ni umuririmbyi wo Rwanda. Yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere, "Ifaranga", muri Mutarama 2010. Mbere yo gutangira umwuga we wa muzika, Bibarwa yaririmbaga muri korari y'itorero ryaho.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, Kitoko yatumiriwe gutanga igitaramo ku giti cye ku isabukuru y'amavuko ya Ange Kagame, umukobwa wa perezida w'u Rwanda, Paul Kagame. Muri Gashyantare 2013, Kitoko yaririmbye mu iserukiramuco ry'umuco w'u Rwanda ryabereye i Jylland Fyn, muri Danimarike. yitabiriye kandi u Muryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba no muri Amerika, Ubufaransa n'Ububiligi. Kagabo Richards Rwamunono, ni Umuyobozi w'akarere ka Rwamagana wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry'ubukungu. Yabanje kuba umujyanama wa Guverineri w’Intara y’Iburasirazuba.
Kagabo, ku wa Kane tariki 07 Ukuboza 2023, yatorewe kuba umuyobozi w'akarere wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza ku majwi 170, asimbura Nyirabihogo Jeanne d’Arc, weguye kuri izi nshingano. Kagabo yari amaze imyaka 11 ari Umujyanama wa Guverineri w’Intara.

Umutoni Jeanne, ni Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rwamagana wungirije ushinzwe Imibereho myiza.
Umutoni, yagiye agira uruhari mu bikorwa b'itandukanye byo gufasha abaturage b'akarere ka Rwamagana kuva mu bukene, kurwanya icyorezo cya Sida, binyuze mu mishinga itandukanye y'abafatanyabikorwa bako karere.
Mu nshingano ze, yagaragaye mu bikorwa byinshi by'iterambere birimo:

Akarere ka Rwamagana ni kamwe mu turere turindwi tugize intare y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 2023, mu nteko rusange, Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere bwiyemeje gufatanya n’Ihuriro ry’Abafatanyabikorwa, JADF mu gukura mu bukene imiryango 4000 mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri.
Akarere ka Rwamagana kagizwe n’Imirenge 14, Utugali 82 n’Imidugudu 474. Gafite ubuso bungana na 682 km2 n’abaturage 484,953, bari ku bucucike bwa 740/Km2.
Mu nama yo ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 2023, Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rwamagana wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Umutoni Jeanne yagaragaje ko Akarere ka Rwamagana gafite ingo zisaga ibihumbi 26 zikennye kandi ko kihaye intego ko nibura ingo 4000 zigomba kuba zavuye mu bukene myaka ibiri2024 na 2025, akaba ari naho ubuyobozi bwasabye aba bafatanyabikorwa kubafasha mu gukurikirana aba baturage bakava mu bukene binyuze mu bikorwa bitandukanye bizakorerwa abaturage.
Visi Meya Umutoni yavuze ko bimwe mu byo abaturage bazakorerwa ngo bikure mu bukene harimo guhabwa ifumbire, amatungo, ibikoresho ku bana babo biga, abatiga basubizwe mu ishuri abandi bashyirwe mu myuga.
Bazahabwa kandi akazi muri VUP, batangirwe mituweli n’ibindi byinshi harimo ibyo bazakorerwa n’Akarere n’ibindi bazakorerwa n’abafatanyabikorwa.
Umuhuzabikorwa w’Abafatanyabikorwa b’Akarere ka Rwamagana, Uwayezu Valens, yavuze ko bari basanzwe bafasha abaturage ku giti cyabo ariko ko ubu bagiye guhuza imbaraga mu kugabana abaturage 4000 ku buryo buri wese agira uruhare rwe mu kubafasha.

Mu Karere ka Rwamagana, ku wa 6 Mutarama 2023, habaye umuhango wo gusinya amasezerano y’ubufatanye hagati y’akarere n’Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda (FERWACY), agamije guteza imbere uyu mukino no gutegura isiganwa ry'umukino w'amagare rya Rwamagana Race. Ni amasezerano azamara imyaka itatu, aho byitezwe ko azafasha kuzamura impano z'abakinnyi basiganwa ku magare bashya no guha imyitozo abasanzwe bakina.
Inshingano z'akarere.
Akarere ka Rwamagana kiyemeje;
Inshingano za FERWACY.
FERWACY yo yiyemeje;

Mu Akarere ka Rwamagana, ku wa 25 Kamena 2024, abanyamuryango ba FPR- Inkotanyi bateraniye ku kibuga cy’umupira cya Kigabiro bitabiriye igikorwa cyo gutangiza gahunda yo kwamamaza umukandida wa RPF ku mwanya wa Perezida wa Repubulika ndetse n’abakandida b’Abadepite.
Abaturage ba Karere ka Rwamagana bishimiye ibikorwa by’iterambere n’ibihindura imibereho bagejejweho mu myaka irindwi ishize n’umukandida wa RPF-Inkotanyi Paul Kagame muri gahunda ya Guverinoma ya 2017-2024. Bavuze ko ibikorwa remezo Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame akaba n’umukandida w’Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi yari yemereye abaturage muri manda ishize, byose yabibagejejeho ndetse hiyongeraho n’ibindi.

Gikuriro kuri bose, ni umushinga ugamije kurwanya imirire mibi, guteza imbere ingo mbonezamikurire z’abana bato(ECDs), kwita ku bafite ubumuga no kwimakaza uburezi budaheza.
Mu Karere ka Rwamagana, ku wa 11/02/2022, mu cyumba cy’inama cyo mu kigo cy’urubyiruko cya “YEGO Center Rwamagana” hatangirijwe ibikorwa by’umushinga “Gikuriro kuri bose” kugirango abaturage ba Karere babashe guhabwa izi serivisi. Umushinga “Gikuriro kuri bose” ukaba uzashyirwa mu mirenge irindwi(7) yo mu karere ka Rwamagana ariyo: Muyumbu, Fumbwe, Kigabiro, Gishari, Karenge, Munyaga na Munyiginya.
Iki gikorwa cyitabiriwena Meya Mbonyumuvunyi Radjab ndetse na Visi Meya Umutoni Jeanne ushinzwe iterambere ry’imibereho myiza y’abaturage mu Akarere ka Rwamagana, Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Mu Rwanda, Uyu mushinga uzageragerezwa mu mirenge ya Kigabiro na Muhazi yo mu karere ka Rwamagana mu gihe cy’amezi cumi n’atanu(15) uhereye mu kwezi kwa Mutarama 2022; ukaba ubusanzwe TEARFUND yawukoreraga mu bihugu bya Repubulika iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo na Sudani y’epfo.

Umurenge SACCO Kigabiro, ni koperative y'abaturage b'Umurenge wa Kigabiro mu Akarere ka Rwamagana mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Iyi koperative yahawe ubuzima gatozi n'Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere Amakoperative RCA ashingiye ku ibaruwa ya perezida wa koperative yo kuwa 09 Werurwe 2010.
Icyemezo No RCA /467/2010 cyo kuwa 29/03/2010 giha ubuzimagatozi «Imboni Kigabiro Savings and Credit cooperative» (IMBONI KIGABIRO SACCO)
Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere Amakoperative; Ashingiye ku Itegeko no 50/2007 ryo kuwa 18 Nzeri 2007 rigena ishyirwaho, imiterere n’imikorere y’Amakoperative mu Rwanda, cyane cyane mu ngingo yaryo ya 23, igika cya 3; Ashingiye ku Itegeko no 16/2008 ryo kuwa 11/06/2008 rishyiraho Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza Imbere Amakoperative, cyane cyane mu ngingo yaryo ya 3, igika cya 2;
Ingingo ya mbere: IMBONI KIGABIRO SACCO ifite icyicaro i Cyanya, Umurenge wa Kigabiro, Akarere ka Rwamagana, Intara y’Iburasirazuba, ihawe ubuzimagatozi.
IMBONI KIGABIRO SACCO igamije guteza imbere abanyamuryango ibafasha kwizigamira no kubona inguzanyo. Ntiyemerewe gukora indi mirimo inyuranye n’iyo iherewe ubuzimagatozi, keretse ibanje kubisaba ikanabiherwa uburenganzira.
Iki cyemezo kigira agaciro guhera umunsi cyatangarijweho mu Igazeti ya Leta ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

Tearfund, ni umushinga wa gikirisitu ukorera mu Rwanda kuva mu 1968. Ubu ukorera mu turere 12 two mu ntara y'Amajyepfo n'Uburasirazuba mu karere ka Rwamagana ndetse na Kigali, binyuze mu matorero.
Bakorana n'abayobozi b'amatorero n'abayobozi bo munzego zibanze kugirango basubize ibibazo by'abaturage. Byinshi muribi bigerwaho binyuze mumatsinda yo kwifasha - inama zisanzwe mubaturage kubantu bashaka kuzigama amafaranga no kongera amafaranga yabo.
Amatorero arenga 1.000 hirya no hino mu Rwanda yifatanije nakazi ka CCT, kandi, kugeza ubu, abanyamuryango b’itsinda barenga 26.000 bafite ibikoresho byo gutangiza imishinga yabo. Amatsinda nayo yatojwe kwihangira imirimo kandi ahujwe nabatanga serivise yimari kugirango bateze imbere ubucuruzi bwabo.

Twagirayezu Daniel ni umuturage akaba n'umuyobozi wo mudugudu wa Kinteko mu Kagari ka Rweru, Umurenge wa Gahengeri mu Akarere ka Rwamagana.
Twagirayezu, yahoze ari umwana wo mu muhanda utagira epfo na ruguru akaza gufashwa n’ubuyobozi bwiza kuva mu muhanda ndetse na we ubwe ashingiye ku mpanuro ahabwa yiyubakamo imbaraga zatumye buri wese ubu amubonamo ubushobozi kurusha uko yari umwana wo mu muhanda.
Twagirayezu Daniel amaze gutorerwa kuyobora uyu mudugudu inshuro eshatu kandi abaturage bemeza ko bayobowe neza nk’uko byemezwa na Karemera IgnaceAti “Umudugudu wacu ni intangarugero kandi natwe turabyishimira, iyo umuyobozi wacu ahawe igihembo bidutera ishema.
Twagirayezu ahamya ko gahunda ya Girinka munyarwanda y’umukuru w’Igihugu Kagame Paul yo koroza Abanyarwanda na we yamugezeho kugeza ubu akaba afite inka 13 kandi na we yaroroje abandi.

Igishanga cya ruhogo ni igishanga gihingwamo umuceri mu karere ka Rwamagana. Ni igishanga gikora ku Mirenge itatu ariyo Kigabiro,Rubona na Mwulire, gihingwamo umuceri aho abahinzi bahoze bagihingamo kuri hegitari 270 maze Leta y'u Rwanda niy'u Buyapani ibinyujije mu kigega gishinzwe ubutwererane Mpuzamahanga (JICA) bakacyivugurura kuri ubu gihingwamo kuri hegitari 348. Kukivugurura byatwaye miliyari makumyabiri n'imwe y'amafaranga y'u Rwanda (21Million Frw) zashowe mu bikorwa byo kuvugurura ibyuzi bibiri birimo icya cyimpima na Gashara ndetse hakaba haranubatswe ikindi cyuzi gishya cya Bugugu, Hanubatswe umuyoboro ugeza amazi mu mirima. Uwo muyoboro ureshya na kilometero 23,5. Abahinzi barenga 1200 bagihingamo bavugako umusaruro wabo wikubye hafi kabiri kuko babonaga Toni eshatu kuri hegitari none ubu babona toni hafi esheshatu.
Icyi gishanga cya ruhogo mbere cyitaravugururwa cyatangaga umusaruro mucye ugereranije nubu cyamaze kuvugurwa. Icyo bita igishanga cya Cyaruhogo ni uk ari izina rimenyerewe, ariko ubusanzwe ni ibishanga bitandukanye, hari icyitwa Gashara, Cyimpima,Bugugu na Cyaruhogo; Ibi byose bihingwamo n'abahinzi 1,174 bibumbiye mu makoperative ane, bafite ibyuzi bihangano 3 ubu byamaze kuguvururwa byitezweho kuzabafasha kuhira ubuso bungana na hegitari 170. Icyifuzo cya minisiteri ifite ubuhinzi mu nshingano ni uko kuri hegitari imwe y'ubutaka havamo toni umunani z'umuceri, ibi ngo bizatuma n'amafaranga umuhinzi azabona aziyongera kuko azaba afite umusaruro mwinshi.

One Cup of Milk per Child, ni gahunda yatangijwe mu Karere ka Rwamagana yo guha amata abana bari munsi y’imyaka 5, aho bayafatira mu ngo mbonezamikurire y’abana bato (ECD) hagamijwe kurwanya imirire mibi mu bana.
Iyi gahunda yatangijwe kuwa 06 Gashyantare 2024 mu Murenge wa Kigabiro no mu yindi mirenge itandatu hatangirijwe gahunda yo guha abana amata babasanze mu ma ECDs barererwamo, mu gihe iyi gahunda biteganyijwe kuri uyu wa 07 Gashyantare iratangizwa mu mirenge 14 yose igize Akarere ka Rwamagana. Buri mwana agenewe litiro 2.5 mu minsi 5. Ababyeyi bakaba basabwa kuyunganira bategurira abana indyo yuzuye no gushyigikira gahunda mbonezamikurire y’abana bato; harwanywa imirire mibi n’igwingira mu bana. Mu Karere ka Rwamagana habarurwa ingo mbonezamikurire 627 zirererwamo abana 32,235.
Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rwamagana wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza Umutoni Jeanne yasabye ababyeyi gishyigikira iyi gahunda kandi nabo bakagira uruhare mu kurwanya imirire mibi baha abana babo n’ ibiribwa byunganira aya amata bahabwa na leta.

Urugerero rw’Inkomezabigwi icyiciro cya 11 mu akarere ka Rwamagana, urubyiruko rwasabwe kwigira ku muco w’abanyarwanda bo hambere w’ubukorerabushake.
Kuwa 19 Ukuboza mu murenge wa Muhazi mu kagari ka Kabare niho hashorejwe urugero rw’Intore z’Inkomezabigwi ku rwego rw’Akarere, muri uwo muhango waranzwe no kumurika bimwe mu bikorwa byakozwe n’izi ntore, ni umunsi kandi wahujwe n’uw’ubukorerabushake usanzwe wizihizwa ku wa 05 Ukuboza.
Umuyobozi w’Imirimo rusange mu Karere ka Rwamagana Hagenimana Jean Damascène ubwo yafataga ijambo ryo gusoza urugerero rw’Inkomezabigwi Icyiciro cya 11/2023 yagize ati:”Tubakeneye nk’abakorerabushake ariko bafite disipline kuko tuzi ko mwayitojwe, mu kinyarwanda baravuga ngo ubuze imfura ata ibiheko, niyo mpamvu tubakeneye kugira ngo mubere icyitegererezo barumuna banyu, nubwo musoje Urugerero ntabwo birangiye turabakeneye mu bukorerabushake.

Abarimu bo mu Murenge wa Kigabiro bagiranye igihango n’ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rwamagana cyo kurwanya ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo ryose rituma abana bata ishuri.
Mu kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wa Mwarimu, kuwa 14 Ukuboza 2023, mu Murenge wa Kigabiro, abarimu, abayobozi b’ibigo by’amashuri n’ubuyobozi bw’Akarere bizihije uyu munsi mu birori byaranzwe n’imbyino z’abana bato, indirimbo za bamwe mu barezi ndetse n’ibiganiro byashojwe n’ubusabane.
Abarimu bo mu Murenge wa Kigabiro biyemeje kurwanya ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo ryose rikorerwa abana, guzafatanya n’izindi nzego kurwanya inda z’imburagihe mu bangavu n’izitateganyijwe ku bakuru, gufatanya kandi n’inzego z’ibanze mu kugarura abana bataye ishuri no gutangira amakuru ku gihe aho twabonye babonye hohoterwa”

Tujyanemo Tugumanemo,ni gahunda yihariye ishishikariza abaturage kwita ku mihigo mu Akarere ka Rwamagana.
Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rwamagana wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage Umutoni Jeanne yasobanuye ko iyi gahunda yatangijwe hagamijwe kwihutisha imihigo na bimwe mu bikorwa byari bitangiye kugenda buhoro.
Agira ati: “Niba dushoje imihigo y’uyu mwaka tuyigumanemo, ariko tunajyane mu yo tugiye gutangira, iyi gahunda turimo kuyishyiramo imbaraga cyane kugira ngo buri muntu wese abigire ibye ariko ntagire naho atakarira ahubwo ajyemo kandi agumemo.”
Mu karere ka Rwamagana muri uyu mwaka w’imihigo wa 2022/2023 bafite imihigo 107 iri mu byiciro bitatu by’ingenzi ari byo ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’imiyoborere.

Ishuri ry’umuryango, ni gahunda yatangijwe mu akarere ka Rwamagana igamije guca amakimbirane mu miryango ku buryo burambye, imiryango ibana nayo ifashwa kumenya ikiyatera ikigishwa ndetse ikanaherekezwa mu rugendo rwo kuyasohokamo.
Kuwa 10 Werurwe 2023 ku biro by’Umurenge wa Karenge, imiryango irindwi imaze amezi atandatu yiga mu ishuri ry’umuryango yahawe icyemezo cy’ishimwe ko yasoje amasomo yahawe, iyi miryango ikaba yizewe kutazasubira mu makimbirane.
Ku rwego rw’Akarere hari imiryango 522 yari ifitanye amakimbirane, muri aba umurenge wa Karenge wari ufite imiryango 138 ni ukuvuga ko ari 36% ibi twabibonyemo ikibazo gikomeye kandi ubuyobozi bugomba gushakamo igisubizo.”
Ishuri ry’umuryango ni uburyo bwihariye bwo guhuza imiryango ifite amakimbirane, ikabanza kuganirizwa by’umwihariko nyuma buri munsi wa Gatanu bagahurira ku buyobozi bakigishwa amasomo atandukanye.
Umuryango ufite amakimbirane ushakirwa undi muryango w’inyagamugayo ubakurikirana umunsi ku wundi mu kubahiriza ibyo bize mu ishuri, uru rugendo rwose rugomba kumara amezi atandatu umuryango bigaragaye ko nta kangononwa na gato ugifite kabasubiza mu makimbirane, bagahabwa icyemezo cy’ishimwe ko barangije kwiga, aba kandi bagirana amasezerano n’ubuyobozi ko batazasubira mu makimbirane.
Ishuri ry’umuryango rifite ibyiciro bibiri by’ingenzi, icya mbere ni amasomo ane bahabwa mu gihe cy’ukwezi, buri wa gatanu ugenerwa isomo rimwe biga mu masaha atatu kuva saa munani z’amanywa kugeza saa kumi.
Isomo rya mbere ni irigaragaza isano iri hagati y’igihugu n’umuryango “umuryango utekanye uteye imbere ni igihugu gihamye” isomo rya kabiri ni impamvu y’amakimbirane mu miryango, irya gatatu ni ingaruka ziba mu makimbirane naho irya kane ni ugukemura amakimbirane mu miryango.
Icyiciro cya kabiri ni ugutangira kwigishwa no guherekezwa mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibyari mu masomo ya mbere, aha niho imiryango ubwayo ifashwa kumenya ikibazo gitera amakimbirane, uyu muryango ushakirwa umuryango w’inyangamugayo uzawuherekeza muri ya masomo, buri munsi wa gatanu bagakomeza kujya hahandi bahurira haba ku biro by’akagari, ku Murenge cyangwa se ku biro by’umudugudu ibi bikorwa mu gihe cy’amezi atanu

Ishuri ry’Imyuga rya Rubona, ryatashywe ku mugaragaro kuwa mbere tariki 31/03/2014, ryitezweho kuzamura ubumenyingiro mu rubyiruko rw’akarere ka Rwamagana ku buryo rizabafungurira inzira yo kwihangira imirimo aho gutegereza kujya gusa akazi. Iri shuri riherereye mu murenge wa Rubona mu karere ka Rwamagana ryeguriwe akarere kakazajya karicunga ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Uburezi.
Iri shuri ryuzuye ritwaye ibihumbi 290 by’amadolari ya Amerika (amanyarwanda agera kuri 196.521.502) yatanzwe ku nkunga ya Sosiyete y’Abanyakoreya y’Epfo “HYUNDAI” yamamaye cyane mu gukora imodoka ku bufatanye n’Umuryango mpuzamahanga “Plan International Rwanda.
Iri shuri kugeza ubu ririmo abanyeshuri 145 biganjemo abakobwa rizakomeza gufashwa na Hyundai ndetse na Plan International Rwanda mu gihe cy’imyaka 2 iri imbere mu rwego rwo rwo gukomeza kwiyubaka.

Kiliziya Gatolika ya orotodogisi, ni torero rya kabiri rinini rya gikirisitu, rifite abayoboke bagera kuri miliyoni 220 ku isi. Mu rwego rwo kwagura iri dini kuwa 27 Ukwakira 2022,hatashye urusengero rushya rwubatse mu Karere ka Rwamagana.
Kiliziya ya Orthodox, yemerewe bwa mbere gukorera ku butaka bw’u Rwanda mu 2013. Yatangiriye mu karere ka Kirehe ahitwa mu Kaziba. Kugeza ubu ifite abayoboke babarirwa hagati y’ibihumbi birindwi n’umunani.
Musenyeri wa Kiliziya ya Orthodox mu Rwanda, mu Burundi no mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo, Innocentios Byakatonda avuga ko Kiriziya y'aba Orthodox ifite imishinga iteganya gufatanyamo na Leta y'u Rwanda, bahereye ku kigo nderabuzima bagiye kubaka mu karere ka Rwamagana.

Impamba y'Umwana ku Ishuri, ni gahunda y'ubukangurambaga yatangijwe mu akarere ka Rwamagana, igamije kunganira gahunda y’ifunguro ku ishuri (School Feeding) yashyizweho na Minisiteri y'uburezi mu Rwanda.
Mu karere ka Rwamagana, iki gikorwa cyakorwe n’abaturage mu mirenge yose k'ubufatanye n'abayobozi bo munzego zibanze hagamijwe ko nta mwana uzongera guta ishuri bitewe n’uko iwabo babuze amafaranga yo kwishyura ifunguro ku ishuri.
Kuwa 13 Ukwakira 2022, ku kigo cy’amashuri cya GS Rusisiro giherereye mu murenge wa Musha niho hashorejwe ubukangurambaga bwiswe Impamba y’Umwana ku ishuri, iyi gahunda yateguwe mu mirenge yose.
Ni nyuma y’aho Minisiteri y’Uburezi yashyizeho amabwiriza agena amafaranga agomba gutangwa n’umubyeyi ku ishuri aya akaba ari ayo kunganira ‘School Feeding mu mashuri y’incuke, abanza n’ayisumbuye.
Muri iyi gahunda umuturage asabwa gutanga ikiro kimwe cy’ibinyampeke ku musaruro yabonye, hari abadahinga ariko bafite ubushobozi nabo basabwa gutanga byibuze amafaranga y’ikiro kimwe cy’ibinyampeke(ibigori, amasaka n’umuceri).
Muri ubu bukangurambaga hakusanyijwe ibiro 818 by’ibishyimbo, amasaka hakusanyijwe toni eshatu zirenga n’aho ibigori ni toni eshatu n’ibiro 599 hakusanyijwe kandi amafaranga ibihumbi 150.
Ubu bwunganizi buzatangwa mu bigo hakurikijwe imibare y’abana bahari bakomoka mu miryango itishoboye, amasaka azavamo igikoma cy’abana bari mu marerero ya Leta ndetse n’amashuri y’incuke.
Muri 2021/2022 abana bari barataye ishuri ni 716, hagarutse 657 nk’uko bitangazwa n’ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rwamagana.

Abarinzi b'igihango.
Ni abantu bagizwe n’abagize uruhare mu guhisha no kurengera abahigwaga muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, n’abandi bakoze ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa mu guteza imbere ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda no guhuza Abanyarwanda.,Abarinzi b’igihango bo mu Karere ka Rwamagana bashishikarizwa kwitwara neza bakirinda kwishora mu byaha bikomeye byatuma bakwa iryo shimwe nkuko bigarukwaho n'Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Rwamagana mu butumwa bwatanzwe ubwo hatangizwaga ukwezi k’ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa bw’abanyarwanda, n’igikorwa cyabereye ku biro by’umurenge wa Muhazi kuri uyu wa 04 Ukwakira 2022.,
Ishimwe rihabwa Abarinzi b'igihango.
Abarinzi b’igihango bahabwa imidari y’ishimwe ku bakiriho, naho abatakiriho bahabwa ibyemezo by'ishimwe mu imiryango yabo.
Mu murenge wa Muhazi, umwe mu abarinzi b'igihangao Mukabaranga Patricie ufite imyaka 52, muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 afatanyije n’umubyeyi we bahishe abantu bane barabarinda kugeza ubwo ingabo z’Inkotanyi zibatabaye.

Muryamo y’ingurube, ni indwara iterwa na virus ya (African Swine Fever Virus) ikaba ifata ingurube zorowe ndetse n’ingurube zo mu gasozi. Iyi ndwara ya muryango yagaragaye mu bworozi bw'ingurube mu murenge wa Muyumbu mu Karere ka Rwamagana nkuko bitangazwa muri raporo y'ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, RAB mu itangazo yashyize hanze kuwa Kane tariki ya 16 Nzeri 2021.
Ibimenyetso biyiranga ni umuriro mwinshi uri hejuru ya degré Celcius mirongo ine (40oC), kunanirwa kurya, kunanirwa kugenda, gutitira, gutukura ku bice by’umutwe, ku nda no ku maboko n’amaguru uhereye ku bice by’imyanya myibarukiro.
RAB yavuze ko mu rwego rwo guhashya ubwo burwayi bwamaze kugaragara mu Rwanda, aborozi b’ingurube, Inzego z’Ibanze n’Abaturarwanda muri rusange bamenyeshwa ko indwara ya muryamo y’ingurube ari indwara y’icyorezo, kandi nta muti nta n’urukingo igira.
Aborozi bose basabwe guhagarika kuzerereza ingurube ku gasozi, ingurube zikaguma mu biraro, umworozi wese ushaka kujyana cyangwa kugurisha ingurube ye azajya abihererwa icyangombwa n’umuganga w’amatungo k’Umurenge cyemeza ko itungo rye nta burwayi rifite kandi yubahirize amabwiriza yo gukumira icyorezo cya Muryamo y’ingurube
