Lillian Mbabazi ni umunyarwanda akaba ari umuhanzi ufata amajwi ukorera ibikorwa bye muri umuganda. Yavukiye muri Uganda ku babyeyi b'u Rwanda. Nk’uko byatangajwe na Uganda wamamaza muri Bryan Morel Publications, mu injyana ya muzika ya Lilian ni neo-roho ifitanye isano na R&amp;B Band. akaba Yari umunyamuryango wa Blu ya 3. Muri 2014, yari umwe mu bahanzi bagaragaye mu gihembwe cya kabiri cya Coke Studio Africa, yaje kandi kugaragara muri Filimi.
Mbabazi yatangiye kwitwara neza mu 2003, nyuma y’amarushanwa ya Coca-Cola Pop Star yatumye hashyirwaho Blu ya 3. Yabonye intsinzi muri muzika hamwe nitsinda, yatsindiye Umuhanzi / Itsinda ryiza muri Uganda &amp; Video yumuziki mwiza wo muri Uganda muri 2005 Kisima Music Awards, ndetse na filimi ikaba Video y'umwaka (Hitaji) muri Pearl of Africa Music Awards muri 2005
Yatsindiye kandi Video yumwaka (Burrn) muri 2007 Pearl of Africa Music Awards 2007 kandi yatorewe kuba Itsinda ryiza rya Afrika yuburasirazuba bwiza muri 2005 muri Kora Awards. Yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Album ya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ("Hitaji") mu bihembo bya muzika bya Tanzaniya 2005 ndetse na filimi, Video nziza yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba (Frisky) mu 2006 muri Channel O Music Video Awards.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yatowe mu ndirimbo nziza yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ("Aho uri" kumwe na Radio &amp; Weasel) mu bihembo bya muzika bya Tanzaniya 2010 naho mu 2009, yatowe mu itsinda ryiza &amp; Umuhanzi witwaye neza mu 2009 muri MTV Africa Music Awards 2009.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, yatangiye umwuga wenyine kandi afite indirimbo nziza nka "Vitamine" hamwe na Weasel wo muri bombi Goodlyfe Crew, Kawa na Akaga Yakoranye na Goodlyfe Crew, Navio, AY, P-Unit na Kitoko.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Mbabazi yatsindiye igihembo cye cya mbere mu bihembo bya HiPipo Music Awards kubera ibihembo bye byo kwibuka hamwe na A Pass.
Mbabazi yatangiye gukora kuri 91.3 Capital FM, imwe mu maradiyo akomeye ya FM muri Uganda, nyuma yo kugenda kwa mugenzi wabo mukuru wa Big Breakfast Karitas Karisimbi mu myaka ya za 2000. Icyakora, yavuye kuri sitasiyo kugira ngo yibande ku mwuga we wa muzika mbere gato yuko Blu ya 3 isenyuka maze asimburwa kuri sitasiyo na Jackie Lumbasi. Nyuma yaje kwinjira kuri Radiyo yo mu mujyi
Mbabazi yari afitanye umubano na nyakwigendera umucuranzi wa Radio Mowzey (25 Mutarama 1985 - 1 Gashyantare 2018), babyarana abana babiri (Asante Manzi na Izuba). Bivugwa ko abo bashakanye babanye kuva igihe bari muri kaminuza ya Makerere, mbere yo gutandukana kwabo amezi make kugeza mu 2015. Abashakanye bamaze kubona umwana wabo wa mbere, bahuye nibibazo byinshi amaherezo biganisha ku gutandukana.

Mbanda John, uzwi cyane ku izina rye ry'ubuhanzi Calvin Mbanda (yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1998) avukira i Kinyinya, mu Karere ka Gasabo, mu Rwanda ni umuririmbyi akaba ari umukinnyi wa Filimi wo mu Rwanda, umwanditsi w'indirimbo akaba n'umuhanzi. Yatangiye umwuga we wa muzika mu 2019. Yavuze ko gutsinda kwe kuri label ye yari ifitwe na BadRam, wagenzuye Mbanda afite imyaka 21. Muri 2019, yatangiye gukorana na The Mane Music House irimo abahanzi barimo Jay Polly atangira gukora indirimbo nka Aye, Tiktak, Aba Abantu. Yasohoye indirimbo zirimo Ariel Wayz, Marina, Tuyishime Joshua, Safi Madiba, Victor Rukotana, Mbanda azwi cyane mu ndirimbo ze za mbere. Indirimbo ze zose zatoranijwe mu bihembo bitatu birimo "Kiss summer awards", "Ibihembo byatoranijwe", "ibihembo bya Isangonamuzika", nyuma Mbanda avuga ko atazongera gukorana na Mane Music House.

Gaël Faye (Yavutse ku ya 6 Kanama 1982) ni Umunyarwanda akaba ari umuririmbyi w’umufaransa, umuraperi, n'umwanditsi w'ibitabo indirimbo n'afilimi zitandukanye.
Faye yavukiye i Bujumbura, mu Burundi, kwa se w'umufaransa na nyina w'u Rwanda. Yimukiye mu Bufaransa afite imyaka 13, ahunga intambara yo mu Burundi. Yize ubukungu n’imari.
Arubatse, afite abakobwa babiri.
Faye yanditse igitabo yatewe inkunga n'uburambe bwe mu myaka y'ubwangavu ku ntambara yo mu Burundi. "Igihugu gito" ("Petit Pays") cyasohowe bwa mbere mu Bufaransa muri Kanama 2016 na Grasset. Yatsindiye ibihembo bitanu byubuvanganzo. Yahinduwe mu ndimi 36 ikorerwa muri firime, yasohotse muri 2020.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Faye na Edgar Sekloka basohoye alubumu ya rap na hip-hop yitwa "Amata Kawa n'Isukari" (n'izina ry'itsinda ryabo).
Faye yahise asohora alubumu eshatu wenyine na EP imwe: "Pili Pili sur un Croissant au Beurre" (2013), Des fleurs EP (2014) "Lundi Méchant" (2020) na "Mauve Jacaranda" (2022). "Lundi Méchant" yagiye zahabu muri 2022.

Simon Bikindi (Yavutse 28 Nzeri 1954 apfa 15 Ukuboza 2018) yari umucuranzi n'umuririmbyi wo mu Rwanda wahoze azwi cyane mu Rwanda. Indirimbo ze zo gukunda igihugu ni zo zakinnye kuri radiyo y'igihugu Radiyo y'u Rwanda mu gihe cy'intambara na genocide yakorewe abatutsi muri 194 mu Rwanda. Kubera ibikorwa yakoze mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda, yaburanishijwe ahamwa n'icyaha cyo gushishikariza jenoside n'Urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rw’u Rwanda (ICTR) muri 2008. Yapfuye azize diyabete mu bitaro bya Benini mu Kuboza 2018.
Amavu n'amavuko mugihe cya jenoside.
Bikindi, yavukiye i Rwerere muri perefegitura y’amajyaruguru ubu ni mu intara y'amajyaruguru akarere ka Munsaze mu y’iburengerazuba bwa Gisenyi, ako karere kavamo Perezida Habyarimana na benshi mu bantu bakomeye mu butegetsi bwe bwa MRND.
Mu gihe cya jenoside, yari umuhimbyi uzwi akaba n'umuririmbyi wa muzika uzwi cyane akaba n'umuyobozi w'itsinda ryitwa "Irindiro Ballet". Indirimbo ze zasobanuwe ko zifite amagambo ya elliptique n'indirimbo zishimishije, haba mu icyongereza, igifaransa na Kinyarwanda no guhuza inyandiko za rap style hamwe nindirimbo gakondo za rubanda. Filimi ya mbere, yasohotse muri 1990, yari iy'indirimbo z'ubukwe gakondo. Yongeyeho kandi ko yari umukozi wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko na Siporo akaba n'umwe mu bagize ishyaka rya MRND.
Zimwe mu ndirimbo ze zerekeje ku batutsi zacuranzwe kuri Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines kugira ngo zishishikarize ubwicanyi. Yavuye mu gihugu hasigaye iminsi mike ngo itsembabwoko ritangire ariko agaruka nyuma muri Kamena. Ni ikibazo cyo kujya impaka niba yaragize uruhare muri jenoside ndetse n’urwego ki, ariko nk'uko byemejwe n’urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rw’u Rwanda (ICTR), bigaragazwa nta gushidikanya na gato ko yaba yarifatanije n’interahamwe z’intagondwa z’intagondwa. kandi yasabye ku mugaragaro Abahutu gutsemba Abatutsi bose muri Kamena 1994. Nyuma yo kwigarurira FPR, yahunze igihugu. Indirimbo ze zirabujijwe mu Rwanda kuva mu 1994.
Inyandiko y'ibirego no gufatwa.
Bikindi yashinjwaga n’urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rw’u Rwanda (ICTR). Yashinjwaga ibi bikurikira: umugambi wo gukora genocide ; itsembabwoko, cyangwa ubundi bufatanye muri jenoside ; gushishikariza no gukangurira rubanda gukora jenoside, n'ubwicanyi no gutotezwa, nk'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Inyandiko y'ibirego yavugaga ko Bikindi "yahimbye, aririmba, yandika cyangwa akwirakwiza ibikorwa bya muzika bishimangira ubufatanye bw'Abahutu no gushinja abatutsi kuba imbata y'Abahutu ". Ubushinjacyaha bwatanze indirimbo yise The Awakening ariko bakunze kwita Nanga aba bahutu (Nanga Abahutu), yibasiye Abahutu bashyigikiye abatutsi cyane cyane abo bahutu bakoranye n’inyeshyamba zo mu gihugu cy’abatutsi bo mu Rwanda barwanya guverinoma.
Byongeye kandi, havuzwe ko mu mezi yabanjirije itsembabwoko, Bikindi "yagishije inama na Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko na Siporo, Callixte Nzabonimana n’ubuyobozi bwa gisirikare bwahujwe na MRND ku magambo y’indirimbo" mbere yo kubarekura ngo bakinwe ku bahutu. Amashanyarazi ya radiyo RTLM. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze kandi ko mu minsi 100 ya jenoside kuva ku ya 7 Mata kugeza ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1994, Bikindi yagize uruhare mu bwicanyi, haba muri perefegitura ya Kigali na Gisenyi, kandi ko yafashije mu gushaka no gutegura imitwe yitwara gisirikare "ya Interahamwe".
Nyuma yo gufatwa i Leiden mu Buholandi ku ya 12 Nyakanga 2001, Bikindi yarwanyije koherezwa mu mahanga maze asaba ubuhungiro. Icyakora, nyuma y'amezi umunani, ku ya 27 Werurwe 2002, yashyizwe mu maboko ya ICTR. Nyuma yaje kwirega ku byaha byose aregwa maze afungirwa muri gereza y’umuryango w’abibumbye (UNDF) i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya. Nyuma y’ubukererwe, urubanza rwe rw’ibyaha by’intambara rwatangiye ku ya 15 Gicurasi 2006. Yari ahagarariwe n’umuyobozi w’igice cya Kenya cya komisiyo mpuzamahanga y’abahanga mu mategeko (ICJ), Wilfred Ngunjiri Nderitu.
Usibye ibindi bimenyetso, ubushinjacyaha bwatanze indirimbo yishimira ikurwaho ry'ubwami no kugarura ubwigenge kuva 1959 kugeza 1961: impuguke y'u Rwanda mu rubanza yaje gusobanura ko indirimbo ya nyuma idashobora kwandikirwa igihugu cy'u Rwanda muri rusange, kubera ko Abatutsi bari bafitanye isano n’ubwami bw’u Rwanda n’ubutegetsi bwa gikoloni, kandi ko bidashoboka kwanga ingoma ya cyami utabanje kwanga abatutsi. Ubwunganizi bwavuze ko mu buhamya bw’abatangabuhamya harimo kwivuguruza, bahakana ko izo ndirimbo zivuga ku batutsi no guhamagarira abatangabuhamya b’abatutsi Bikindi ngo bafashije kurokora ubuzima bwabo.
Ku bijyanye n'indirimbo, impande zombi zari zifite impuguke ku ruhande rwazo, ariko ntawahakana ko amagambo yari agoye kuyasobanura kandi ko demokarasi n'amahoro byavuzwe. Umwunganizi wa Bikindi yavuze kandi ko gushinja Bikindi ari "kumwima uburenganzira bwe bwo kuvuga". Umwe mu bunganira uregwa yashinjwaga kuba yarahaye ruswa umutangabuhamya. Umwunganira mukuru wunganira abaregwa yemeye ikirego cy’ubushinjacyaha, bituma Bikindi yanga gukomeza kumuhagararira ukundi. Nyuma ICTR yakuyeho avoka icyo kirego.
Itsinda ry'ubushinjacyaha mu rubanza rwa Bikindi ryasabye igihano cy'igifungo cya burundu, igihano gikomeye urukiko rutanga. Ubwunganizi bwasabye umwere.
Ukuboza 2008, Bikindi yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’inguzanyo y’imyaka 7 yari amaze akora, kubera gushishikariza jenoside. Iki gihano cyaturutse ku kuba urukiko rwasanze byagaragaye nta gushidikanya na gato ko mu mpera za Kamena 1994 yari yavuze ijambo ry’imodoka ya Interahamwe ifite sisitemu yo kubarizamo rubanda, asaba kandi yibutsa abaturage b'Abahutu gutsemba abatutsi bose, uwo yise "inzoka". Ibindi birego byose byavanyweho; by'umwihariko, urukiko rwasanze mu gihe indirimbo zimwe na zimwe zifite imiterere ishishikaje, zose zanditswe mbere ya 1994, bityo mbere ya jenoside, kandi ko nta bimenyetso bihagije byerekana ko Bikindi yagize uruhare mu gukwirakwiza indirimbo ze kuri radio mugihe cya jenoside, cyangwa ko we ubwe yagize uruhare mubwicanyi cyangwa gutegura imitwe yitwara gisirikare.
Urubanza rwari rwarafashwe nkikibazo kubera ikibazo giteye impungenge cyuko umuhanzi akurikiranwa ku bushake kubera ibikorwa bye, ubuhanzi bukaba bushobora gusobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye. Urubanza ariko rwirinze iki kibazo kitavugwaho rumwe, kubera ko rutari rushingiye ku ndirimbo za Bikindi.
Ubuzima bwa muntu n'imiterere.
Mu gihe cya jenoside, Bikindi yari afitanye umubano na Angeline Mukabanana, umututsi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n'ikinyamakuru New York Times muri 2008, yagaragaje igitekerezo cye ko Bikindi nta muntu yangaga kandi ko yari umuntu ufite amahirwe, ashishikajwe no gushimisha. Yavuze ko Bikindi yareze umuhungu we, wari ufite se w’abatutsi, kandi akaba yarafashije abaturanyi babo b'Abatutsi kurwanya abicanyi b'Abahutu. Mukabanana yavuze ko Bikindi amaze kwandika "Nanze aba bahutu", amubaza impamvu yanditse ibyo kandi yerekana ko bishoboka ko FPR yatsinze intambara. Yavuze ko yashubije ati: Guverinoma itegeka kwandika izi ndirimbo. Nunva FPR izaza i Kigali ukwezi gutaha, nzabandikira indirimbo.

Cornelius Nyungura (yavutse ku ya 24 Werurwe 1977), uzwi ku izina rya stage Corneille, ni umuririmbyi wa R and B wo muri Kanada. Yavukiye mu Budage bw'Iburengerazuba ku babyeyi b'a Rwanda. Igihe kinini cy'ubwana bwe yamaze mu Rwanda, amaherezo yimukira i Quebec, muri Kanada, muri 1997. Aririmba mu Gifaransa n'Icyongereza. Ibikorwa bye byamenyekanye cyane muzike y'abanyamerika numuziki w'ubugingo ; ndetse na Prince, Marvin Gaye.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Corneille yavukiye i Freiburg im Breisgau, mu Budage, nubwo ubuzima bwe bwose yabukoresheje mu Rwanda. Yavumbuye ishyaka rye muri muzika muri 1993, nuko yinjira mu itsinda rya R B, ryatsinze amarushanwa ya Découverte 1993. Ibi kandi byamumenyesheje kwandika indirimbo no guhimba umuziki. Icyakora, ubuzima bwe bwarahindutse nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994. Se, Emile Nyungura, yari umuyobozi w’ishyaka rya politiki PSD yatekerezaga ko arwanya leta bityo akaba ari igitero; Corneille yiboneye iyicwa ry'ababyeyi be na barumuna be na bashiki be batatu afite imyaka 17. Yahungiye mu Budage, aho nshuti z'ababyeyi be bamujyanye.
Muri Nyakanga 1997, Corneille yahisemo kuva mu Budage kugira ngo akomeze amasomo mu itumanaho, maze yimukira i Montreal, muri Kanada, kugira ngo yige muri kaminuza ya Concordia. Muri kiriya gihe, yashinze one, itsinda R and B, hamwe na Pierre Gage na Gardy Martin, abo bahuye nyuma gato yo kugera i Québec. "Zoukin", imwe mu ndirimbo z'itsinda ryanditswe na Corneille, yazamutse ku mwanya wa mbere mu gukina indege za Kanada. Hanyuma, mu ntangiriro za 2001, Corneille yavuye muri iryo tsinda, yifuza gukomeza umwuga wenyine. Yatangiye kwibanda ku ndirimbo ze kahise. Muri 2002, Corneille yakoze imishinga itandukanye. Yanditse kandi ahimba indirimbo Ce soir yo gukusanya "Cocktail R and B 2" (Ghetto R&amp;B, Sony Music) na Si seulement on s'aimait ya "Hip Hop Folies" (Sony Music). Yatumiwe na Dave Stewart, yaririmbye mu imurikagurisha rye rya mbere ryabereye i Réservoir i Paris, maze agira amahirwe yo kuririmbana na Jimmy Cliff. Muri Mutarama 2003, yatumiriwe kuzitabira nk'igikorwa cyo gufungura Cunnie Williams muri Olympia.
Album ya mbere ya Corneille, verisiyo yo muri Kanada ya "Parce qu'on vient de loin", yasohotse ku ya 10 Nzeri 2002. Inyandiko y’igifaransa yarimo ibihembo byinshi kuri disiki ya kabiri, yasohotse ku ya 20 Ukwakira 2003, ihita igenda neza. Muri Mata 2003, Corneille yaririmbanye na Craig David, asubiramo umurongo mu gifaransa mu ndirimbo "Rise and Fall". Yakoze urugendo rwe rwa mbere muri Gicurasi 2003, akinira amazu yuzuye i Paris, Marseille, Lyon na Bordeaux. Muri Werurwe 2005, uyu muhanzikazi yitabiriye igitaramo "Africa Live", cyateguwe mu rwego rwo kurwanya (malariya). Bwari bwo bwa mbere agaruka ku mugabane w'iwabo kuva jenoside. Album ya kabiri ya Corneille ya "Les marchands de rêves", yasohotse mu Gushyingo 2005. Corneille yakoranye na Croix Rouge yo muri Kanada mu rwego rwo gukangurira abana bazize intambara. Yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere yo mu Cyongereza, "Ivuka rya Koruneliyo", muri Nyakanga 2007. Mu mpera za 2014 yabaye umunywanyi mu gihembwe cya gatanu cya tereviziyo y’Ubufaransa TF1 ' "Danse avec les Stars".
Mu 2022 yatorewe kuba muri Manie Musicale maze atsinda irushanwa.
Corneille yanditse indirimbo Il était temps kuri Virginie Pouchain nyuma yo kwemererwa guhagararira Ubufaransa mu marushanwa y'indirimbo za Eurovision 2006. Indirimbo yarangije umwanya wa 22 kuri 24 barangije.
Muri 2014, yitabiriye igihembwe cya gatanu cya "Danse avec les star" - Igifaransa cyo "kubyina hamwe na Stars". Yafatanije n'umubyinnyi wabigize umwuga Candice Pascal. Ku ya 8 Ugushyingo 2014, bakuweho barangiza ku mwanya wa 6 kuri 11 bahatanira.
Corneille yashakanye n'umunyamideli ukomoka muri Kanada akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime Sofia de Medeiros mu 2006; bafite umwana umwe.

Jean-Paul Samputu (yavutse ku ya 15 Werurwe 1962) ni umuririmbyi wo mu Rwanda, umwanditsi w'indirimbo, n'umucuranzi. Uwatsindiye igihembo cya Kora muri 2003, Samputu azenguruka isi nka ambasaderi w’umuco mu Rwanda.
Yavukiye mu Rwanda muri 1962, Samputu yatangiye kuririmba muri 1977 muri korari y'itorero, kandi yayobowe n'umuziki gakondo ndetse n'uw'iki gihe, nka Stevie Wonder, Bob Marley, Jimmy Cliff, na Lionel Richie. Yageze muri Amerika muri 2004 mu myaka icumi Yibuka, igikorwa cyo kwibuka imyaka 10 jenoside yabaye mu Rwanda.
Samputu aririmba mu ndimi esheshatu (Kinyarwanda, Igiswahiri, Lingala, Ganda, Igifaransa n'Icyongereza) ndetse no mu buryo butandukanye kuva soukous, rhumba na reggae, kugeza mu Rwanda gakondo 5/8, Afrobeat, pygmy, na gospel. Ahuza imigenzo idasanzwe ya muzika ituruka mu turere twose two mu Rwanda, muri zo, Intwatwa, Umushayayo, Imparamba, na Ikinimba.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Jean Paul Samputu yavutse ku ya 15 Werurwe 1962 i Butare, mu Rwanda.

Muneza Christophe (Yavutse ku ya 30 Mutarama 1994), bakunze kwita Christopher Muneza uyu ni umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w'indirimbo ndetse n'umuhanzi.
Yabaye uwabonye umwanya wa kabiri muri Primus Guma Guma Superstar (PGGSS ibihe 6 na 7. Intsinzi ye ayitirira we n'umujyanama we Clement Ishimwe, wagenzuye Muneza afite imyaka 15. Mu mwaka wa 2010, yatangiye gukorana na Kina Music House irimo abahanzi benshi barimo Butera Knowless atangira gukora indirimbo nka " Sigaho ", " mi casa ", " Ishema ", agaragara muri "Like nk'umwamikazi" na Lil G yanditswe na Umuraperi Racine. Muri 2017, uyu muhanzi yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Primus Guma Guma Super Star aho yavuze ko nyuma ya " PGGSS ", atazongera gukorana na Kina Music. Muri uwo mwaka ninabwo yamuritse album ye "ijuru rito" ubwo hizihizwaga umunsi w'abakundanye. Mu mwaka w'2019 yongeye kumurika indi Album kumunsi nkuwo, byatumye bamwe mubakunzi be bamubaza impamvu akunda kumurika ibihangano bye kuri uwo munsi, ababwira ko impvu ari uko uwo munsi ujyanye n'ibihangano akora

Alpha Rwirangira (Yavutse 25 Gicurasi 1986) ni umuririmbyi ndetse n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo. Aririmba umuziki w'isi, reggae, R B, n'umuziki wo kubyina byose mu Cyongereza, Igiswahiri na Kinyarwanda.
Nyuma yuko Rwirangira atsindiye East East Tusker Project Fame nibwo umwuga we wumuziki wabigize umwuga watangiye. Ibi bimutera gufata amajwi no gukorana na AY yo muri Tanzaniya ku ndirimbo yitwa "Songa Mbele", na Bebe Cool, ku ndirimbo "Ngwino".
Nyuma yo gusohora iyi ndirimbo, ibihuha byatangiye gukwirakwira ko Rwirangira " atari Umunyarwanda nyawe ", kubera ko ari mubyara wa AY Nyuma yo gutsindira Tusker Project Fame, Alpha yatangiye kuzenguruka Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, Rwirangira yarangije asohora alubumu ye ya mbere yise "One Africa," alubumu iteza imbere ubumwe n'ubwiyunge mu Banyafurika. Yaje kuyitangiza mu Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzaniya, n'Uburundi.
Mu 2012, Rwirangira, yimukiye muri Amerika kwiga kaminuza ya Campbellsville, muri Kentucky kugira ngo akomeze amasomo ye ya muzika.
Mu mwaka wa 2012 mu biruhuko bya Noheri mu Rwanda, Rwirangira yafashe amajwi abiri, imwe hamwe na King James "Uhuza", " Bwiza " hamwe n’amahoro na " African Swagga irimo Rah P. Mu 2013 yakoranye na La'Myia Nziza mu ndirimbo Ijuru".
Alpha Rwirangira yegukanye ibihembo bya Pearl of Africa Music Awards 2011 nk'umuhanzi mwiza w’umugabo w’u Rwanda, ariko yanga kwitabira ibirori byo gutanga ibihembo, kuko yumvaga bitateguwe nabi.
Alpha Rwirangira yanze gusinyana na Afrika yepfo Record Label Gallo Record Company murwego rwo gutsindira Tusker Project Fame Season 3. Yashinje kandi Tusker Project Fame kuba idafasha abatsinze kera kandi bari muri ibi kubera gushaka amafaranga.
Muri 2015, Alpha Rwirangira yatangaje ko yatandukanye n'umukunzi we umaze igihe kinini witwa Esther UWINGABIRE wari mu bahatanira Miss Rwanda 2012 ndetse n'abamuteza imbere Ernesto Ugeziwe na Tijara KABENDERA ariko impande zombi ntizemeza aya makuru. ]

Neza Patricia Masozera, [​​ Yavutse 23 ukuboza 1984) azwi nka Neza, ni umunyarwanda ubarizwa muri Canada ukora afropop. Muri 2017, yahawe igihembo nk'umuhanzi "utanga icyizere muri Afurika" na All Africa Music Awards.
Neza Yabuze se akiri muto arerwa na nyina wapfakaye. Kubera inzara mu gihugu cyabo, Zayire, umuryango wimukiye mu Rwanda mu 1995. Nyuma yimyaka itatu, umuryango wimukiye i Toronto, muri Kanada biturutse ku cyifuzo cya mushiki we yifuza kumuha ubuzima bwiza kandi butekanye.
Neza yatangiye umuziki mu ntangiriro ya 2000, kandi kuva icyo gihe yatangiye kwiteza imbere mu buhanga bwa elektiki. Mu itumba 2010, Neza yasohoye inzira 7 ya EP yitwa 'Brand New', yagaragayemo indirimbo 'Go Gettaz'. Iyi nzira yagaragaye no kuri mixtape ya DJ Charlie Brown 'Brown Billz - R&amp;B Edition'. Amashusho ye remix ya 'Pop That' y’igifaransa Montana yasohotse muri Nzeri 2012, yatanze ibitekerezo 2000+ mu byumweru 3 bya mbere kandi byanyuze kuri televiziyo y'igihugu mu Rwanda. Muri 2016 yasohoye imwe ifite amashusho: Tambola yashimiwe cyane, ariko ntahantu na hamwe ushobora kuboneka kuri enterineti. Muri 2017, Neza yimukiye i Lagos, muri Nijeriya, maze asinywa n'umuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya, Mc Galaxy kuri label ye, MCG Empire. Neza yasohoye inshuro eshatu (Uranyica, Shaba &amp; Vibe) munsi ya label. Yagaragaye kandi kuri Album ya Skales umuhanzi wo muri Nigeriya indirimbo ebyiri "Gbe" na "Ubuzima bwiza"

Rwanda defences forces army band ni Umutwe wa Gisirikare w’ingabo z’u Rwanda ufite mushingano zawo kuririmba aho wagiye ukora filimi zitandukanye, ni itsinda rinini rikorera Leta na Gisirikare. Nubwo ihagarariye ingabo ndetse ugengwa n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ingabo. Kuva mu 2009 Itsinda rya Gisirikare rya RDF riyobowe na Liyetona Koloneli Gilbert Ndayisabye. Itsinda rya RDF rigizwe n'abayobozi bakuru hamwe na bane:
Iri tsinda rikora muri Repubulika yu Rwanda no ku mugabane munini wa Afurika. Benshi mu baririmbyi bayo boherejwe mu myaka yashize mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga amahoro muri Rwanda.
Itsinda rya gisirikare rya RDF ryashinzwe muri 1992 mu gihe cy’intambara yo Kwibohoza mu 1990 kugeza 1994 kandi ryatangiye gukora ku ya 8 Werurwe 1992 ahitwa Mulindi FPR na RPA HQ ubwo ryari rifite abanyamuryango 40 gusa. Nyuma y’intambara yo muri 1994, yongeye gushyirwaho n’abanyamuryango 120 bahuguwe n’umutwe wa gisirikare wa Gana wari mu ngabo z’amahoro ziyobowe na UNAMIR (United Nation Mission mu Rwanda). Muri 2005, Liyetona Koloneli Lemuel Kayumba yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru w'itsinda ryashyizweho na Major Gilbert Ndayisabye. Ku buyobozi bwe, iryo tsinda ryatangije imyitozo n’ubusabane n’andi mashuri y’umuziki ya gisirikare y’amahanga. Mu mwaka wa 2008, ingabo za RDF zohereje itsinda rya mbere ry’abacuranzi 20 bitabiriye amasomo y’umuziki wa Gisirikare ya Afurika yepfo, yatanzwe n’ingabo za Afurika yepfo Band Cape Town babifashijwemo na kaminuza ya Stellenbosch. Umwaka umwe, abanyamuryango 29 bagize iryo tsinda bitabiriye amahugurwa yakozwe nitsinda ry’ingabo z’ingabo z’igihugu cya Uganda mu ishuri rya gisirikare ry’u Rwanda i Nyakinama.
Ibirori byo Kwibohoza.
Iri tsinda riririmbira parade ngarukamwaka kuri Stade Amahoro mugihe cyo kwizihiza umunsi wo kwibohora. Bambaye imyenda isanzwe itukura nicyatsi, bakora indirimbo yubahiriza igihugu, "u Rwanda Nziza" kimwe no kwerekana ibyerekanwa. Bakora kandi ingendo za gisirikare gakondo numuziki kavukire nkindirimbo yigiswahiri "Sisi Wenyewe". Iri tsinda ryasohoye alubumu nshya yitwa "Ubudasa" mu rwego rwo kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 25 yo kwibohora muri 2019.
Itsinda ryayo rya jazz ryitabiriye ibitaramo hamwe nabasivili ba jazz. Yakoranye n’amatsinda menshi y’amahanga, icyamenyekanye cyane muri zo ni Ingabo z’Amerika zirwanira mu kirere mu Burayi. Yabanje kwitabira Tattoo ya Gisirikare ya Cape Town muri 2010. Abagize Urban Boyz (itsinda rya Afropop muri Rwanda) hamwe nitsinda rya jazz ryitwaye neza mu birori byo gutangiza ku mugaragaro imikino ya gisirikare mu 2017.
Itsinda rya Gisirikare Amasomo Yumuziki Yibanze.
Uyu mutwe uyobora amasomo ya muzika ya Gisirikare Yibanze Yumuziki mu kigo cya Gisirikare cya Kanombe. Amasomo arimo ibi bikurikira:

Cynthia Butare ni umunyarwanda akaba ari umukinnyi wa firime uba m'uBusuwisi kimwe naba videwo. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi wa firime w'umunyarwanda, "Kickin, it With The Kinks".
Yavukiye i Geneve mu Busuwisi. Yabaye i Geneve kugeza arangije amashuri yisumbuye hanyuma yimukira mu Bwongereza kwiga amashuri makuru.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Digital Media and Communication nyuma arangiza Master's in Documentary Practice muri kaminuza ya Manchester Metropolitan. Muri 2011, yakoze firime ngufi "Kickin It With The Kinks" kumushinga we wa kaminuza. Filime yahawe igihembo cya documentaire nziza mu ishami rye. Nyuma mu 2016, Cynthia ari kumwe n'inshuti ye Mundia, bahisemo gukora verisiyo ndende ya firime. Iyi filime yakiriwe neza kandi yerekanwa mu birori mpuzamahanga bya firime. Muri uwo mwaka, yatangije isosiyete ye bwite, ' CB Production.
Akiri ingimbi, yatangiye kwandika mu 2003. Nubwo yahagaritse blog nyuma yimyaka itatu, yongeye kuyitangiza muri 2012. Muri 2013, Butare yahawe igihembo cya Blog nziza yumwaka na BEFFTA. Icyakora, yimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2014. Igihe yari mu Rwanda, yakoze filime ye ya kabiri ya documentaire, "Ishimwa: Kuva Amaraso Yera Kuri Grace". Yerekanwe mu rwego rwo kwerekana iserukiramuco rya sinema mu Rwanda. Kuri ubu arimo gukora umushinga witwa "Garuka".

Sharangabo Mbabazi Philbert Aimé (yavutse muri 1990), ni umukinnyi wa firimi ukomoka mu Rwanda. Yakoze firimi ngufi zamamaye cyane zirimo, "Abibohoza", "Imirongo" na "Nabonye Ibintu Byanjye Ibumoso".
Philbert Aimé Mbabazi yavutse 1990 mu Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mbabazi yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ishami rya sinema yakuye muri kaminuza y’ubuhanzi n’ubushakashatsi i Geneve (UMUTWE - Genève, Haute école d'art et de design) i Geneve. Mugihe cyishuri, yakoze firime ebyiri "The Liberators" na "Versus". Filime zombi zerekanwe mu birori byinshi bya firime harimo Vision du Réel Nyon, Internationale Kurzfilmtage Winterthur, Tampere, Oberhausen na Uppsala Festival Festival. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi muri 2017, yasubiye mu Rwanda.
Muri 2019, yayoboye filime ngufi "Nabonye Ibintu byanjye n'ibumoso" yatsindiye igihembo kinini mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Oberhausen. Iyi filime yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya firime rirenga 20 nk'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Rotterdam, International Kurzfilmtage Winterthur, Go Short Nijmegen, Indie Lisboa na ISFF Hamburg, FIFF Namur n'ibindi
Yatangije isosiyete ikora firime yitwa 'Imitana Productions' ifite icyicaro i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Nyuma yaje gukora filime ye yambere yumukobwa "Republika" (Spectrum).

Bounty cyangwa se Impano ni filime isetsa y'ibikorwa ya 2012 yanditse n'umunyarwanda witwa Kagame Shyaka yerekana bwa mbere bwa Fung Chi Keung ikinwamo Chapman To, Fiona Sit na Alex Man. Mu Gushyingo, iyi filime yakiriye Ikigega cyo Guteza Imbere Amafilime ya Hong Kong " Umushinga wo Guteza Imbere Amafilime Umushinga wo Gutunganya Amafilime " kugira ngo utange HK $ 2,605.711. Iyi ni film ya 13 yatewe inkunga n'ikigega cyo guteza imbere amafilime ya Hong Kong.
Hamwe n'imyizerere yubuzima, Cho Sai Fung (Chapman To) numuntu wubwonko ufite ubuhanga budasanzwe, wishingikiriza kumuhiga wubuntu kugirango abeho. Kuri iyi nshuro yaje ku kirwa, hoteri nto yitwa LAZY Inn, guhiga umujura Lee Kin Fai wahunze, hamwe na HK $ 4000,000. Suen Long Ching (Fiona Sit) numukobwa wincumbi (Alex Man). Afite ibitekerezo byinshi n'amatsiko, kandi ni hyperactive. Nosy se numukobwa bakurikiranye abakiriya badasanzwe Cho, hamwe no gukorakora nabi no kutumvikana, bikurura urwenya rutandukanye.

Jacqueline Kalimunda (yavutse muri 1974) ni umuproduce ukomoka mu Rwanda, ukora inkuru mbarankuru zizwi nka documentaire, umuyobozi n'umwanditsi wa filimi.
Jaqueline Kalimunda yavukiye i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Yabaye muri Kenya, Madagasikari n'Ubwongereza mbere yo kwimukira mu Bufaransa. Kalimunda akiri mwishuri, yize imiyoborere hamwe namateka ya Afrika. Yinzobere mu gutunganya firime no kuyikwirakwiza. Kalimunda yatojwe nk'umwanditsi kandi akoresha ubwo buhanga mu gukora documentaire na firime za televiziyo. Yitangiye kuvuga inkuru zumwimerere ninsanganyamatsiko mubikorwa bye.
Mu 2002, yanditse, ayobora kandi afatanya gukora filime ye ya mbere, iminota 23 "ya Histoire de tresses" ("About Braids"), yatowe nka filime ngufi nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Zanzibar 2003. Filime ngufi kandi yatanzwe mu Bwongereza n'Ikigo cy'Ubwongereza gishinzwe amafilime na Amerika mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya New York. Filime yerekana inkuru hagati yumukobwa ukiri muto numuhanga wogosha umusatsi wo muri Afrika. Umugore arasaba umusatsi-kogosha kugirango yongere gukora uburyo budasanzwe bwo kogosha umusatsi.
Inyandiko "ya Homeland" ni umwanzuro wumushinga muremure watangiye ubwo yakoraga ubushakashatsi ku mashusho yu Rwanda hamwe n’amateka Jean-Pierre Chrétien na Hélène d'Almeida-Topor. Kuri iki gikorwa, Jacqueline Kalimunda yashyize ahagaragara imyaka 80 yububiko bwa firime butarasohoka mu Rwanda. Filime yerekanwe muri Fespaco 2007 muri Ouagadougou.
Mu 2007 na 2008, Jacqueline Kalimunda yafatanije kuyobora igihembwe cya mbere n'icya kabiri cy'uruhererekane rwa televiziyo "Imagine Afrika", cyanyuze mu bihugu 35 by'Afurika ku mbuga za televiziyo rusange mu Cyongereza, Igifaransa, Igiswahiri, Zulu, Igiporutugali n'izindi ndimi. Hanyuma yayoboye muri koproduction hamwe na Canal Plus Horizon filime yamenyekanye "cyane mubuzima" bwa 2011.
Umunyeshuri wiga muri Berlinale Talent Campus, Jacqueline Kalimunda yakoze kandi ayobora muri 2012 "Burning Down", yibanze kuri Afurika Filime ngufi ya mbere hamwe na Eriq Ebouaney (Femme fatale ya Brian de Palma, Lumumba ya Raoul Peck) na Cyril Guei.
Muri 2016 Kalimunda yanditse kandi ayobora "Floris", documentaire mu rurimi rwa Kinyarwanda.

Zanzibar International Film Festival cyangwa se Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firimi i Zanzibar (ZIFF), rizwi kandi nk'Iserukiramuco ry'ibihugu bya Dhow, ni iserukiramuco rya filime ngarukamwaka ribera muri Zanzibar, muri Tanzaniya kandi ni kimwe mu birori ndangamuco binini muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. ZIFF ni umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta washinzwe muri 1997 hagamijwe guteza imbere no guteza imbere amafilimi n’inganda z’umuco nk’umusemburo w’iterambere ry’imibereho n’ubukungu mu karere.

Ikigo cy’Ubwongereza gishinzwe amafilim (BFI) n’umuryango utabara imbabare wa firimi na televiziyo uteza imbere kandi ukabungabunga amashusho na televiziyo mu Bwongereza wagiye werekana amafilimi akomoka mu Rwanda aha twavuga nka filimi yanditse na Kalimunda Jacqueline yitwa le 23 minutes. BFI ikoresha amafaranga yatanzwe na tombora yigihugu kugirango ishishikarize gukora firimi, gukwirakwiza, nuburezi. Yatewe inkunga n’ishami ry’umuco, itangazamakuru na siporo, kandi iterwa inkunga igice kimwe n’amategeko agenga ikigo cy’amafirime mu Bwongereza 1949.
BFI yashinzwe muri 1933 mu rwego rwo gushishikariza iterambere ry’ubuhanzi bwa firime, televiziyo ndetse n’ishusho igenda ikora mu Bwongereza, kugira ngo bamenyekanishe imikoreshereze yabo nk'inyandiko z'ubuzima bw'iki gihe n'imico, guteza imbere uburezi bujyanye na filime, televiziyo ndetse n'ishusho ikora. muri rusange, n'ingaruka zabyo muri societe, guteza imbere kugera no gushimira uburyo bwagutse bushoboka bwa sinema yo mu Bwongereza no ku isi no gushiraho, kwita no guteza imbere ibyegeranyo byerekana amateka n'amashusho bigenda byerekanwa mu Bwongereza.
BFI ikomeza ububiko bwa firime nini ku isi, BFI National Archive, yahoze yitwa Isomero ry’amafirime y’igihugu (1935–1955), Ububiko bw’amafirime y’igihugu (1955–1992), hamwe n’ububiko bw’amafirime na televiziyo by’igihugu (1993–2006). Ububiko burimo firime zirenga 50.000, amazina arenga 100.000 adahimbano, hamwe na tereviziyo zigera kuri 625.000. Ibyinshi mu byegeranyo ni ibikoresho byabongereza ariko binagaragaza ibintu bifite akamaro mpuzamahanga ku isi yose. Ububiko bukusanya kandi filime zigaragaramo abakinnyi bakomeye b’abongereza nakazi k’abayobozi b’abongereza. &lt;/link&gt;["citation ikenewe"]
BFI iyobora BFI Southbank (ahahoze hitwa Theatre National Film (NFT) na cinema ya BFI IMAX, byombi biherereye ku nkombe y’amajyepfo yuruzi rwa Thames i Londres. IMAX ifite ecran nini ya sinema nini mubwongereza kandi yerekana ibyamamare biheruka gusohoka hamwe na firime ngufi zerekana ikoranabuhanga ryayo, ikubiyemo kwerekana IMAX 70mm, kwerekana IMAX 3D na 11,600 watt yijwi rya digitale. BFI Southbank (ecran ya firime yigihugu ya firime na Studio) yerekana firime zo kwisi yose, cyane cyane firime yamateka kandi yihariye izwi cyane idashobora kubona sinema yerekana. BFI ikwirakwiza kandi ububiko bwa sinema n’ububiko bw’umuco ahandi hantu - buri mwaka ahantu hasaga 800 hirya no hino mu Bwongereza, ndetse no ku bibuga byinshi byo mu mahanga.
BFI itanga gahunda zitandukanye zuburezi, cyane cyane mu gushyigikira imyigishirize y’amafilime n’itangazamakuru mu mashuri. Mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2012, BFI yakiriye amafaranga mu ishami rishinzwe uburezi kugira ngo hashyizweho ihuriro rya BFI Film Academy Network ku rubyiruko ruri hagati y’imyaka 16 na 25. Gahunda yo gutura ikorwa muri NFTS buri mwaka.
BFI ikora iserukiramuco rya sinema ngarukamwaka rya Londres hamwe na BFI Flare: Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya LGBT LGBT hamwe n’urubyiruko ruzaba rwerekanwe na Future Film Festival.

Joël Karekezi (yavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1985) ni umwanditsi w’u Rwanda, umuyobozi wa firime akaba na produce wa firime. afite Filime ngufi "Yitwa Pardon", ivuga ku bwiyunge nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, yatsindiye igihembo cya Zahabu Impala mu iserukiramuco rya Filime Amakula ryabereye muri Uganda. Imiterere yihariye yakozwe mu 2011, kandi yerekanwa mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Göteborg, nyuma no mu yandi maserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ya firime harimo iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Seattle (2013), iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Chicago na FESPACO.
Karekezi yavukiye i Rubavu, mu Rwanda. Se yapfuye mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, nyuma y'iki gikorwa yahungiye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (DRC) aho yasanze umwe mubyara be. Yize gufata amashusho muri Maisha Film Lab muri 2009; Afite impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye na filime iva mu ishuri ryo muri Kanada CineCours.
Karekezi amaze kwitabira Laboratwari ya Maisha, yayoboye filime ye ngufi "yitwa Pardon", yatsindiye igihembo cya Zahabu Impala mu iserukiramuco rya Filime Amakula muri Uganda. Mu mwaka wa 2010 herekanywe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Durban, Amashusho Yerekana Iserukiramuco rya Filime ngufi muri Etiyopiya, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Kenya, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Zanzibar ndetse n’iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Afurika rya Silicon Valley muri Californiya, aho ryatsindiye Filime ngufi nziza igihembo.
Karekezi yakoze verisiyo iranga, "Imbabazi", zishingiye ku nyuguti zimwe. Yakozwe ku ngengo yimari iciriritse muri Uganda.
Muri 2013 Karekezi yakoraga kuri " Impuhwe z'ishyamba ", yerekanwe muri Fabrique des cinemas du Monde mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes muri 2013. Inyandiko ya " Impuhwe z'ishyamba " yatsindiye igihembo cya CFI cyiza cya Audiovisual Award kubera umushinga w'amajwi wizewe cyane muri Durban FilmMart muri 2012.
Izindi filime ze zirimo: "Les jeunes à la poursuite du travail", 2009; "Abacitse ku icumu", 2010; "na Ntukazime Nararokotse", 2010.
Karekezi azi neza igifaransa.

Yves Montand Niyongabo ni umuyobozi wa firime mu Rwanda.
Yves yavukiye kandi akurira mu Burundi. Nyuma yaje kwimukira mu Rwanda aho yaretse gukora filimi. Yakoze nk'umuhuzabikorwa wa firime Munyurangabo muri 2017. Muri 2010 Yves yatoranijwe mu mahugurwa ya firime yateguwe na CPH: Dox muri Danimarike.

Denis Nsanzamahoro, wamenyekanye ku izina rya Rwasa, yari umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Yari kandi umuyobozi n'umutunganyi wa filime. Yapfuye ku ya 5 Nzeri 2019.
Yakinnye muri filime nyarwanda no muri filime mpuzamahanga, nka "100 Days" na "Sometimes in April". Mu 2023, yahawe igihembo cya "Legend Award" muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Denis Nsanzamahoro yatangiye umwuga wa filime mu 1999. Yakinnye muri filime nyarwanda nka "Rwasa" na "Ay'Urukundo". Izina rya Rwasa ryaturutse kuri iyo filime. Yakinnye kandi mu matangazo yamamaza.
Yakinnye muri filime mpuzamahanga "100 Days" na "Sometimes in April". Mu 2006, yakinnye muri "The Last King of Scotland". Yakinnye kandi muri "Sakabaka" na "Operation Turquoise". Yagize uruhare mu ikorwa rya "Sakabaka".
Filime ya nyuma yakinnyemo ni "Petit Pays" ya Gaël Faye, mu 2019.
Denis Nsanzamahoro yapfiriye mu Ibitaro bya Kaminuza by’i Kigali (CHUK) ku ya 5 Nzeri 2019. Yari amazeyo iminsi ine. Yazize diyabete.
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, yahawe igihembo cya "Legend Award" muri Rwanda International Movie Awards. Murumuna we n'imfura ye ni bo bakiriye icyo gihembo.

Kivu Ruhorahoza ni umuyobozi wa firime w'umunyarwanda, umwanditsi akaba na produce. Azwi ku rwego mpuzamahanga kubera filime yakinnye yitwa Gray Matter yatsindiye Jury idasanzwe ku bakinnyi ba Filime beza bakizamuka mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tribeca 2011 ndetse na Jury Ecumenical Jury yavuzwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Warsaw 2011. Yatsindiye kandi igihembo kinini cy'Iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Tübingen mu Bufaransa, Umuyobozi mwiza na Signis Igihembo cy'Iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Afurika rya Cordoba ndetse na Jury Igihembo cyihariye cy'Iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Khouribga muri Maroke.
Kivu yavukiye i Kigali ku ya 6 Ukuboza 1982, yinjiye mu mwuga wa filime akora mu 2004 ari umufasha w’ibikorwa bya Eric Kabera, umuproducer w’u Rwanda. Yaje kuzamurwa mu ntera agirwa umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro, aho yajyaga afasha abakozi b'amakuru baza mu Rwanda kuva kuri BBC cyangwa CNN. Icyakora ishyaka rye ryari firime.
Kivu Ruhorahoza yageze ku rubuga mpuzamahanga rwa firime muri 2007 hamwe na filime ye ya mbere ngufi "Yiyemereye" yatsindiye igihembo cy’Umujyi wa Venice mu iserukiramuco rya Filimi ry’Afurika, Aziya na Amerika y'Epfo kandi ryerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Venice. Filime ye ya kabiri "Yatakaye mu majyepfo" (2008) yatsindiye Filime ngufi ya Afurika nziza mu iserukiramuco rya Vues D'Afrique i Montreal kandi yerekanwe mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Rotterdam.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, Kivu Ruhorahoza yazamuye umwuga we nyuma yo gushyira ahagaragara filime ye ya mbere "yerekana imvi", filime ivuga ku ihahamuka n’ubusazi nyuma ya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo muri 1994. Iyi filime yakorewe mu Rwanda mu bihe by’amafaranga adahungabana, ariko byagenze neza cyane maze ikomeza gukina mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rizwi cyane nka Tribeca, Melbourne, Warsaw, Rotterdam, Dubai, Durban, Göteborg na Festival do Rio.
"Ikintu cya Aimless Wanderer".
Mu mwaka wa 2014, Kivu yatangiye gukora amashusho ye ya kabiri "Ibintu bya Aimless Wanderer", filime ivuga ku ngingo ikomeye y’imibanire hagati y " abenegihugu " n’abanyaburengerazuba. Filime ivuga kuri paranoia, kutizerana no kutumvikana, film yafotowe rwose kuri Kamera ya Sinema ya BlackMagic, hamwe na bije ntoya hamwe nabakozi bose baho. Yatoranijwe kumugaragaro kugirango yerekanwe bwa mbere muri Sundance Film Festival muri gahunda nshya yumupaka.

Uwizeyimana Anisziya waje kwitwa Anisia Uzeyman (yavutse Anisziya Uwizeyimana, Gashyantare 1975) ni umukinnyi w'amafirime ukomoka mu Rwanda akaba n'umwanditsi w'amakinamico. Azwi cyane nk'umuyobozi hamwe na Saul Williams wo muri filime ya "Neptune Frost" muri 2021. Yavukiye i Gihindamuyaga i Mbazi, mu Rwanda.

Belle Oceanne Iradukunda (yavutse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1996) ni umukinnyi w'amafirime w'umunyarwanda ndetse n'Umunyamerika, umuyobozi wa filime, n'umwanditsi. Yavukiye kandi akurira mu Rwanda, ubu akaba atuye i Los Angeles, muri Californiya. "Belle", yakiriwe na we muri filime nka "Kubana n'abapfuye", "Kugeza ku rupfu Tuzatandukana", na "Shifty Business".
Iradukunda yagaragaye muri televiziyo ya Hollywood isetsa-ikinamico ya Tyler Perry yitwa, "Sistas", kuri televiziyo kuri BET kuva ku ya 23 Ukwakira 2019, akina nk'umutegarugori. Muri 2020, yanditse kandi ayobora film, "Urakoze kunsuzugura".
Muri Werurwe 2018, "Ikinyamakuru New Times" cyo mu Rwanda cyatangaje uyu mukinnyi w'amafilime ashinja uwateguye gahunda y’icyumweru cy’imyambarire mpuzamahanga ya Kigali, John Bunyeshuli, icyaha cyo kwiba igitekerezo cye cy’umwimerere.

Kantarama Gahigiri (yavutse ku ya 13 Ukuboza 1976) ni umukinnyi wa filime w'umunyarwanda uba mu Busuwisi. Azwi cyane muri firime "Tapis rouge", "Me and U", "Umumarayika Yatakaye nibindi" byinshi. Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga yakuye mu ishuri rya Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies hamwe na kaminuza ya New York Institute of Technology.
Filime ya mbere ya Gahigiri "Tapis Rouge" yahawe igihembo cyiza cya Filime nziza mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema ryabereye i Geneve no kuyobora neza mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Chelsea. Ubu arimo ateza imbere Tanzanite, afro pulp dystopian thriller binyuze muri Realness - Residency of African Screenwriter.

Filimi Ishaba ni filimi yasohotse muri 2005, ikaya barabaye filimi ya nditse na Yuli Amuli, Filimi Ishaba ikaba yarakimye n'abakinnyi bagiye batandukanye ariko bose babarizwe muri Maisha Film Lab.
Yuhi Amuli ni umuyobozi wa firime nyafurika, Producer n'umwanditsi wavukiye mu Rwanda. Filime ebyiri za mbere ngufi ISHABA na AKARWA zerekanwe kandi zegukana ibihembo mu birori bitandukanye bya firime ku isi; mu Bufaransa, Misiri, Afurika y'Epfo na Kanada.

Filimi Akarwa ni filimi ngufi yasohotse ndetse itangira kugaragara muri 2005, Akarwa ikaya barabaye filimi ya Yuli Amuli, Filimi Akarwa ikaba yarakimye n'abakinnyi bagiye batandukanye ariko bose babarizwe muri Maisha Film Lab, iyi ikaba ari itsinda rimenyerewe muri filime mu Rwanda.
Yuhi Amuli ni umuyobozi wa firime mu Rwanda no muri afurika, akaba ari Produce n'umwanditsi wavukiye mu Rwanda. Filime ebyiri za mbere ngufi ISHABA na AKARWA zerekanwe kandi zegukana ibihembo mu birori bitandukanye bya firime ku isi; mu Bufaransa, Misiri, Afurika y'Epfo na Kanada.

Irankunda Julien, uzwi ku izina rya Julien Bmjizzo (yavutse ku ya 27 Gashyantare 1994 Kimihurura, Gasabo kwa Kwibeshya Sébastien na Kasine Marie Grace) ni umuyobozi w’amashusho na filimi zo mu Rwanda, bizwi nka Cinematography akaba ari nawe washinze label yanditse yitwa Bproud Music.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Bmjizzo yavukiye i Kigali, mu Rwanda, yagiye mu ishuri rizwi ku izina rya ESAPAG Gitwe mu Rwanda ariko arangije amashuri yisumbuye mu 2011 kubera umuryango we wimukiye mu Bubiligi. Yakomeje amashuri ye mu Bubiligi ku ishuri ryitwa Virgo Plus aho yarangirije amashuri yisumbuye mu bijyanye na Computer Science Management na Accounting. Nyuma yaje kwiga kaminuza yo mu Bubiligi aho yize Itumanaho n’itangazamakuru ryinshi.
Muri uwo mwaka wa 2015, Bmjizzo yashinze "BproudMusic", urubuga rukora umuziki rukorera mu Bubiligi rwibanda ku gutunganya amashusho. Muri 2021 nyine, Bmjizzo yasohoye indirimbo ye yise "Kamwe" yagaragayemo abahanzi 11 ba Hip hop na RnB Rwanda.
Amashusho na Filimi.
Kuva muri 2015, Bmjizzo yakoranye n'abacuranzi bo mu Rwanda na Tanzaniya nka Diamond Platnumz, The Ben na Bruce Melodie. Julien Bmjizzo yakoze ku mushinga we wa mbere w’umuziki, "Gusa wowe" na The Ben ft Ben Kayiranga, nk'umuyobozi wa videwo mu 2015. Muri 2021 Bmjizzo yarashe anayobora indirimbo yitwa "Impamvu" ya The Ben na Diamond Platnumz. Uyu mushinga wumuziki wagiye ahagaragara cyane wazanye Bmjizzo kumurongo munini wumuziki wisi. Uyu mushinga wambere wumuziki wamugejeje kumurongo mubikorwa byumuziki wu Rwanda ndetse no mubindi bihugu ubwo yatangiraga gukora imirimo yindirimbo nyinshi akora nkumuyobozi. Bmjizzo yakoze amashusho yindirimbo zirenga 500.

Ruzindana Lionel (yavutse muri 1987), ni umukinnyi wa filimi ubarizwa mu mubiligi ariko ukomoka mu Rwanda. Azwi cyane kubera uruhare muri firime "Earth and Blood", "Third Wedding" hamwe na "Red Soil".
Yavutse muri 1987 i Kigali, mu Rwanda nk'imfura mu muryango, akurira i Gikondo kugeza 1994. Yarangije amashuri abanza mu Rwanda mu mujyi wa Kigali, kugeza ku myaka 7. Yimukiye mu Bubiligi hanyuma aba mu Bufaransa hafi umwaka.
Yatangiye gukina ubwo yimukira mu Bubiligi. Yabanje kurangiza mu kigo cya Sainte Marie mu Bubiligi. Hagati aho, yinjiye mu matsinda abiri yikinamico kandi yiga gukina birambuye. Yatangiye gukina sinema nyamukuru muri 2015. Muri 2018, yakinnye muri filime "Troisièmes Noces" iyobowe na David Lambert. Nyuma yinjiye mu ikinamico muri "Plein La Vue" muri 2019 abifashijwemo na Philippe Lyon. Yakinnye kandi muri filime "Rouge" iyobowe na Farid Bentoumi nk 'umurinzi'.
Muri 2020 yakinnye muri filime "Isi n'amaraso" afite uruhare 'Süleyman'. Muri 2020, yakinnye muri filime "La Terre et Le Sang" umukinnyi wa firime Julien Leclerq ubu iri kuri Netflix.

Earth and Blood cyangwa se mu kinyarwanda yitwa Isi n'amaraso ni filime y’ibikorwa by’igifaransa yo muri 2020 iyobowe na Julien Leclercq ikinwamo na Sami Bouajila, Eriq Ebouaney na Samy Seghir. Iyi filime ivuga kubyerekeranye nubugizi bwa nabi bwakorewe mu ruganda rwitaruye ruba iyo umukozi ukiri muto ahishe kilo umunani za kokayine yibwe mu gatsiko. Iyo abayoboke b'agatsiko kitwaje imbunda nini baza kugarura ibiyobyabwenge, nyir'uruganda akora urwego rwa nyuma rwo kurinda umukobwa we w'umwangavu.
Yashyizwe ahagaragara ku ya 18 Mata 2020, kuri Netflix.

Eliane Umuhire ni umukinnyi w'afilimi w'umunyarwanda arko ubarizwa m'ubufaransa. Umwuga we w'ubuhanzi ufite insanganyamatsiko ibiranga, kwibuka no kwihangana. Ibikorwa bye byagaragaye muri filime zatanzwe mu minsi mikuru mpuzamahanga izwi, aho yatsindiye ibihembo kubera ibikorwa bye ndetse n’ubwitange mu mibereho. Yamamaye cyane kubera uruhare yagize muri filime yo muri Polonye "Inyoni ziririmba i Kigali" na Krzystof Krauze na Joanna Kos, Eliane yahawe igihembo cy’abakinnyi bitwaye neza mu birori nko mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Chicago, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Karlovy Vary, ibihangano bya Gdynia Polonye Ibirori, Iserukiramuco rya Polonye i New York, Reka CEE Festival i Vienne, ndetse n'igihembo cya Mastercard Rising Star muri iserukiramuco rya firime ryigenga rya Netia Off Kamera.
Mu mishinga iheruka harimo "Omen" ya Baloji, yahawe muri Un Certain Regard i Cannes mu 2023, filime ya "Neptune Frost" ya Saul Williams yerekanwe muri Fortnight ya Diregiteri mu 2021, filime ya Netflix "Ibiti by'amahoro" by Alanna Brown, na BAFTA filime ngufi yitwa "Bazigaga" iyobowe na Jo Igabire Moys, yatsindiye ibihembo bye byo gukina mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Clermont-Ferrand ndetse na Festival International du Film Francophone de Namur. Eliane akora cyane kuri tereviziyo, cyane cyane murukurikirane "Haven of Grace", yatambutse kuri Arte. Vuba aha azakina muri "Planète B", iyobowe na Aude Léa Rapin, hamwe na Adele Exarchopoulus, na Souheila Yacoub. Yagaragaye kandi muri "Ahantu hatuje: Umunsi wa mbere" hamwe na Lupita Nyong'o, Joseph Quinn na Djimon Hounsou.

Mizero Ncuti Gatwa (yavutse kamera 1992) yavukiye mu rwanda gusa ubu atuye mu byongereza akaba ri umukinnyi wa filimi. Yatangiye umyuga wa filimi mu mashuri ya Dundee repertory theatre aho yaje kubona umudari wa Lan chrleson muri 2014.
Icyerekezo cya Gatwa cyagezweho ubwo yakina ari umwangavu w’abahuje ibitsina witwa Eric Effiong muri televiziyo ya Netflix, yerekana ibiganiro "byerekeranye n’igitsina" (2019–2023), byamuhesheje igihembo cya BAFTA Scotland ndetse n’abahatanira ibihembo bitatu bya Televiziyo ya BAFTA. Yagize uruhare runini muri filime "Barbie" (2023) hamwe na televiziyo "Masters of the Air" (2024), maze arazamuka cyane agaragaza kwigira umuntu wa cumi na gatanu kwa Muganga mu kiganiro cya siyanse ya siyanse ya BBC baza "Muganga" (2023 - ubungubu).
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Gatwa yavukiye i Nyarugenge, Kigali, mu Rwanda, ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1992. i Se, ni Gatwa Tharcisse, ukomoka mu karere ka Karongi mu Rwanda, ubu ni umunyamakuru.
Uyu muryango wahunze u Rwanda mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994 maze batura muri otcosse. Babaga i Oxgangs muri Edinburgh, bimukira i Dunfermline afite imyaka 15. Gatwa yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Boroughmuir na Dunfermline High School mbere yo kwimukira i Glasgow kwiga muri Royal Conservatoire ya Scotland, arangiza afite impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanzi mu gukina mu 2013. Mugihe yiga, yakoraga muri club The Polo Lounge, atanga ibyuma hanyuma nyuma aba umubyinnyi. Conservatoire yamuhaye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'icyubahiro mu cyiciro cyo gutanga impamyabumenyi 2022.
2013–2021: Akazi kambere kare niterambere hamwe nuburere "bwimibonano mpuzabitsina".
Amaze kurangiza amashuri, Gatwa yahawe umwanya muri Dundee Repertory Theatre gahunda yo gutanga impamyabumenyi aho yakinnye mu bitaramo byinshi harimo na "Victoria" wa David Greig. Muri iki gihe, Gatwa yagabweho igitero n'abantu batatu batazi mu muhanda bavunika urwasaya; ibi byakosowe hamwe na titanium. Yagize uruhare rugufi muri sitcom "ya Bob Servant" 2014, nayo yashyizweho kandi ikorerwa amashusho muri Dundee. Muri 2014, Gatwa yahawe igihembo muri Ian Charleson Awards kubera ibikorwa bye bya Mercutio 2014 i "Romeo na Juliet" i Home, Manchester.

Kayije Kagame (yavutse muri 1987) ni umuhanzi akaba ari umukinnyi wa filimi zitandunye ukomoka mu Rwanda ariko ubarizwa mu busuwisi.
Kagame yavukiye mu muryango w'u Rwanda i Geneve mu 1987. Se, Faustin, ni umunyamakuru ukomeye wa politiki akaba n'umujyanama wa Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame (nta sano bafitanye); nyina ni umwarimu wamateka nigifaransa. Umwe muri barumuna be ni umukinnyi wa firime Shyaka Kagame. Kayije yashishikajwe no gukina afite imyaka 19 ubwo yirukanaga umuyobozi Raffaele Curi [i] i Roma kandi yamuhaye uruhare mu ikinamico. Yize ikinamico muri Conservatoire de Musique de Genève umwaka umwe, hanyuma mu 2010 yiyandikisha muri Ecole Nationale Supérieure des Arts et Techniques du Théâtre [fr] (ENSATT) i Lyon. Muri 2014, yitabiriye gahunda yo guhugura mu mpeshyi i New York yakiriwe n’umuyobozi w’ikinamico Robert Wilson, wamutaye muri uwo mwaka mu kubyutsa "Les Nègres" i Odéon i Paris.
Mubuhanzi, Kagame yakoranye firime ngufi, kwishyiriraho amajwi, nibindi bikoresho hamwe nibice. Muri 2019, hamwe nabandi bahanzi, Kagame yateguye "Ubuzima Burebure Ibi, kandi Ibi biguha ubuzima", igice cyafashe igice cyose cyinyubako ya Théâtre de l'Usine [fr] i Geneve. Muri uwo mwaka, Kagame n'umukinnyi wa filime Grace Seri bazengurutse "Sans Grace Avec Grace", ibice bibiri. Mu 2022, we n'umukinnyi wa firime Hugo Radi batangiye kuzenguruka "Intérieur Vie / Intérieur Nuit", umurimo nk'uwo ukaba wateguwe kimwe cya kabiri naho igice cyafashwe amashusho.
Muri "Saint Omer" ya Alice Diop (2022), Kagame yerekanye bwa mbere muri firime yakinnye na Rama, umwanditsi utwite yitegereza umugore (wakinnye na Guslagie Malanda) mu rubanza azira kwica umukobwa we w’umwaka umwe. Imiterere ya Kagame ifite analogue yubuzima busanzwe muri Diop, witabiriye urubanza film ishingiyeho. AO Scott wo mu "kinyamakuru The New York Times" yashimye "imikorere, ituje" ya Kagame, maze "IndieWire" imushimira "elegance idafite imbaraga". Kagame yatorewe kuba umwe muri Révélations mu birori bya 48 bya César, naho Iterambere ry’amafirime y’iburayi (EFP) amwita umwe mu ba Shooting Stars 2023.

Ndahiro Gilbert ni umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka mu gihugu cyu Rwanda ariko akaba atuye muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, Gilbert akaba akurikirana impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu ishuri rikomeye rya kaminuza rikuru rya Columbia i New York. Ndahayo akaba yarashinze sociyete ya sinema muri 2006 ubwo yabonaga umwanya wo gukora filime ya mbere yitwa Inkovu zo mu minsi yanjye ', ku bufatanye n'Ikigo cya Suwede yabereye mu Rwanda.
Ndahiro kandi arimo ashyira hamwe izindi filime ebyiri muri firimi zerekana ikinamico rya kera, nka HBO y'Abanyamerika kugirango bakore filimi zishingiye ku nkuru zo muri Afurika.

Michel Mpambara yavutse 1973 ni umunyarwanda akaba ari umukinnyi wa filimi ukorera mu Rwanda no hanze kumugabane wa afurika.
Michel Mpambara akaba yarakinnye muri filimi zigiye zitandukanye aha twavuga nka Comment conquérir l'Amérique (2004), iyitwa Faro, iyindi ya la reine des eaux (2007) ndetse na Pour toujours, hamwe na les Canadiens! (2009).

Nsengiyumva Jean Roger ni umukinnyi w'umunyarwanda, uzwi cyane mu kugaragara muri filimi nka "Africa United" na "cumi na gatandatu" hamwe na televiziyo Informer ndetse nindi yitwa "Ntuzi".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Nsengiyumva yakuriye i Norfolk mu Bwongereza nyuma yo guhunga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994. Nsengiyumva yavukiye i Kigali, abura se mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994.

Mahoro Olivier smith niyo mazina yiswe n'ababyeyi be ariko nyuma aza kwitwa Trezzo Mahoro yavutse ku ya 18 Nyakanga 1996 mu Rwanda nka Oliver Mahoro Smith. Ubu atuye i Vancouver, muri Columbiya y’Ubwongereza,muri america. Trezzo yashishikajwe no gukina muri filimi mu mwaka wa nyuma w'amashuri yisumbuye ku ishuri ryisumbuye rya Templeton.

Cedrick Mughisha Banzi (yavutse ku ya 14 Gicurasi 1997 i Kigali, mu Rwanda) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amguru akaba n'umukinnyi wa televiziyo akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime, uzwi cyane mu bitaramo yakinnye muri televiziyo yo muri Esipanye "Smiley" muri 2022 ari kumwe n'umukinnyi wa Katolika Carlos Cuevas.
Yakinnye muri 1. SC Znojmo FK muri Repubulika ya Ceki, hanyuma muri club yumupira wamaguru ya Rayo Vallecano i Madrid kuva 2021.
Muri 2019, yagaragaye muri firime ya Pedro Almodóvar "Ububabare n'icyubahiro".
Yakinnye kandi kuri serivise ya Espagne "Cuéntame cómo pasó" na sitcom "La que se avecina".

Ishimwe Chrispin uzwi ku izina rya Chrrispin, yavutse ku ya 18 Mata 2005, akaba ari nyir’ikinyamakuru kizwi nka New Time Africa. Akaba n'umuhanzi ufite impano nyinshi ukomoka Kigali, Rwanda Chrispin akomoka mu muryango w'abana 4. Umuhanzi Chrispin yatangiye akiri muto, akunda injyana ya R&amp;B (Rhythm na blues) injyana, kuririmba, kwandika indirimbo, kubyina, no gukina, aho yatangiriye muri firime nke
Chrispin arusha ibyo akora. Chrispin yatangiye kumva umuziki na firime nziza igihe yari mu kiciro cya 4 mu mashuri abanza. Yakundaga kumva indirimbo no kureba firime z'abandi bantu kuko niyo soko y'amagambo meza yo gukoresha mu ndirimbo ze, kandi kubyina byari bikurikira nyuma y'umuziki.
Impano ye yo kubyina no gukina yari ikintu kimukorera kubera ubumenyi yakuye muri Club Rafiki muri Nyamirambo.

Sibomana Emmanuel yavutse 1 mutarama 1988 mu karere ka Nyanza mu Rwanda, I se ni SIBOMANA Enias na nyina ni MUKANDANGA Marita, ni umukinnyi wa filimi n'ikinamico ya radio yu Rwanda kandi ni umunyamakuru. Muri 2014 Sibomana yatangiye umwuga we mu bitangazamakuru byamamaza, akina ikinamico ku Isano kuri Radio Rwanda. Yakoze nka radiotv10 ari (Kameramani, Muhinduzi wa Video editor, na News Reporter), no kuri Hot FM 103.6 (News Presenter &amp; Reporter) Umunyamakuru wa TV (mutima w'Urugo).
Sibomana Emmanuel amenyekana kubikorwa bye, maze atumirwa kwinjira kuri Radio BBC Urunana Ikipe ya Drama aho yakinnye nka Patrick. Yakoze kandi nk'umukinnyi mu itsinda rya Drama rya Rwanda rya Indamutsa. Mu mwuga we w'itangazamakuru, Sibomana akubiyemo ingingo zitandukanye, uhereye ku mibereho kugeza ku muco, kandi yari azwiho ubushobozi bwo kuzana inkuru mu buzima akoresheje uburyo bwe bushishikaje kandi bushishikaje.

Dallila Hermans yavutse muri 1986 mu gihugu cyu Rwanda. Dallila Hermans ni umukinnyi wa filimi zitandukanye, filimi izwi yakinnye ni De bal (1999), na De slimste mens ter wereld (2003) hamwe na Buitenhof (1995).

ISHYAMBA RYA NYUNGWE
Iri ni ishyamba ni rimwe mumashyamba ya kimeza ataratewe n'abantu. Riherereye muntara yamajyepfo mubice bya Nyamagabe, Rusizi, Nyamasheke ndetse na Nyaruguru.Iri shyamba riri ku buso bwa km² 1,019. Nihamwe muhantu habera ubukerarugendo mpuza mahanga.
Akaba ari ishyamba ricumbikiye amoko menshi y'inyoni,hari amoko ashingiye kuri 300 y'inyoni, aho amoko 29 muri yo aboneka gusa mu karere k'Imisozi ya Albertine (Albertine Rift) gusa ki isi yose. Hatibagiwe n'izindi nyamaswa ziba mu muryango w'ingagi n' inkende, harimo aho hari amoko 13 y'izihagaragara, zirimo inkende (Chimpanzees), ibimanuka (Colobus monkeys), ibitera ndetse n' inkima.
Iri shyamba kandi ribamo ni ibikorwa remezo nki imihanda.Nti twakwirengagiza ikiraro giherereye mwishyamba rwagati, uru ni urwego rw'ikiraro ruri mu kirere ruremye neza (mitero 70 hejuru y'ubutaka) rufasha abasura kureba ishyamba baturutse hejuru.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe nikigo kigihugu gishinzwe amazi, WASAC bwemeje ko 60% byamazi yose akoreshwa mu Rwanda akomoka muri Nyungwe,mumigezi nka Rubyiro, Kamiranzovu, Rukarana na mbirurume bitanga Nyabarongo, karundura, Ndambarare n'iyindi.
Inteko yiga ku murage w'isi y’Ishami rya ONU ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi n'Umuco (UNESCO) iteraniye i Riyadh muri Arabia Saoudite muri Nzeri 2023 yemeje Parike ya Nyungwe nk’ahandi hantu hashya ku rutonde rw’ahantu hagize umurage w’isi.

Ibitaro bya Nyabikenke ni ibitaro bya Akarere ka Muhanga mu intara ya majyepho yu Rwanda, mu karere ka Muhanga, Ubusanzwe ibitaro bya Nyabikenke baykagize abakozi bagera kuri 127, ariko kugeza ubu birakoresha gusa 39, bivuze ko hari serivisi zitaratangwa, kubera kubura abakozi n’ibikoresho bihagije.

Umuganda muri Muhanga ni ibikorwa bokorerwa mu karere ka Muhanga mu intara y'amajyepho yu Rwanda. Gutanga umuganda ni inkunga nkeya ariko ifasha abayikeneye, kuko nabo baheraho biga kwifasha, ni ngombwa ko abantu twese twitabira umuganda kugira ngo n’abanyantege nkeya babashe kuzamuka bagire ubuzima bwiza.

Ikoranabuhanga muri Muhanga ni ikoranabunaga rikorerwa mu akarere ka Muhanga mu intara y'amajyepho yu Rwanda, ni ikoranabuhanga ni ugukoresha ubumenyi kugirango ugere ku ntego zifatika muburyo bwororoka. Ijambo ikoranabuhanga rishobora kandi gusobanura ibicuruzwa biva muri izo mbaraga, harimo ibikoresho bifatika nkibikoresho cyangwa imashini, nibindi bitagaragara nka za sofutiweya ziri ku ma cd cyangwa furashe. Ikoranabuhanga rifite uruhare runini muri siyansi, mu buhanga, no mu buzima bwa buri munsi.

Groupe.Scolaire de Muhanga ni ikicyo cy'amashuri y'sumbuye kibarizwa muri mu karere ka Muhanga mi intara y'amajyepho yu Rwanda, aho gihereyeye muri murenge wa Kamabuye aha hahoze ari muri Gitarama. GGroupe.Scolaire de Muhanga ifite ibyiciro bitandukanye by'abanyeyshuri, aha twavuga abiga mu mashuri y'ishuke azwi nka nusery, hagakurikiraho amashuri abanza nka primeri, ndetse hari n'icyiciro rusange ndetse na boading.

Centre de sante rutonde ni ivuriro rito riri munsi y'ibitaro, aho iri vuriro riri mu murenge wa muhanga, mu karere ka Muahanga, mu intara y'amajyepho yu Rwanda. Centre de sante rutonde ni ivuroro riifasha mu kuvura abanyarwanda ndetse n'abanyamahanga bagiye tandukanye muntara y'amajyepho y'igihugu.

Dusabimana Israel ni umunyarwanda ukora umwuga wo gukina, kwandika, gutunganya amajwi no kuyobora filime. Yatangiye ubuhanzi bwe ahereye ku kuririmba no kwandika indirimbo. indirimbo ya mbere yashyize hanze yitwaga Umuvumo, ubu akaba yandika indirimbo za korali abarizwamo.
yakomereje umuwuga we w'ubuhanzi mu kwandika no gukina filime, yandika zimwe muri fiime zamenyekanye mu Rwanda zirimo My Insight, Ishusho ya Papa, Agahinda ka LIza, Sacred Love n'Indoto yamenyekanye cyane kubera kunyura kuri televiziyo Rwanda.

Bright school i Muhanga ni ikigo cy'aazaza ni ishuri ririmo amashuri y' inshuke ndetse n'amashuri abanza, rikaba riherereye mu Rwanda, Akarere ka Muhanga umurenge wa Nyamabuye mu mugi wako karere mu intara y'amajyepho y'igihugu, rikaba ari ishuri mpuzamahanga rifite imikoranire n'ibindi bihugu.

Chadai school I Muhanga ni shuri ryatangijwe n' umuyobozi waryo Madamu Raina Luff, mu mwaka wa 2006 ritangira rifite abarimu babiri(2) ndetse n'abanyeshuri 14 bafite icyumba kimwe cy'ishuri gusa, ariko kugeza ubu ishuri ryagiye ryaguka cyane kugeza kubanyeshuri basaga 450 abarezi basaga 19, ibyumba by'amashuri birenga 15, inzu y'imyidagaduro,isomero ry' ibitabo, ibibuga by' imikino itandukanye, nibindi byinshi, riherereye i mu karere ka Muhanga.

Ecole Secondaire Scientifique de Fille de Hamdam B ni ikigo cya mashuri, kirimo igeri zigiye zitandukanye giherere mu karere ka Muhanga, mu murenge wa mushishiro, mu intara y'amajyepho, Ecole Secondaire Scientifique de Fille de Hamdam B ikaba yigamo abantushuri kuva ku ishuke, amashuri abanza, hakaza ama somo y'icyiciro rusanye mu yisumbuye, gusa yose akaba yigenga.

King Salomon Academy Muhanga ni riherere mu karere ka Muhanga, intara y'amajyepho yu Rwanda, ni shuri riracyakomeza kwaguka uko bwije nuko bukeye kandi ryitwaye neza mu burezi bw' amashuri abanza aho burimwaka riza mumashari atanu ya mbere mugihugu mugutsindisha abana neza mubizamini bya leta bisoza amashuri abanza, ikindi nuko bafite imyigishirize myiza ugereranije nibindi bigo by'amashuri aho bo badashobora kurenza abana 25 mu ishuri rimwe.

Ecole secondaire adventiste Muhanga ni ishuri ryigenga Ahazaza ritoza abana kuvuga indimi ebyiri z'amahanga, icyongereza n' igifaransa ibyo bita Belangue mu rurimi rw'amahanga. ibyo bituma abana bahiga bavuga izo ndimi zose neza, ndetse nubundi bumenyi n' uburere ni indashyikirwa, riri i mu karere ka Muhanga.

U Rwanda ni igihugu cy'ishyaka rimwe cyayobowe na Front Patriotique y'u Rwanda n'umuyobozi wayo Paul Kagame kuva jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 irangiye. N'ubwo u Rwanda ruvugwaho kuba rufite demokarasi, amatora ahindurwa mu buryo butandukanye, harimo guhagarika amashyaka atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, gufunga cyangwa kwica abanenga amatora, n'uburiganya mu matora.
Amategeko y'u Rwanda yakuwe ku mategeko y'ubucamanza bw'u Bubiligi n'u Budage n'amategeko gakondo abera mu rwego rwa repubulika ya perezida, aho Perezida w'u Rwanda ari umukuru w'igihugu ufite ububasha bukomeye bwo gukora, Minisitiri w'Intebe w'u Rwanda akaba ari umuyobozi w'ubutegetsi.
Ububasha bwo gushyiraho amategeko bufitwe na guverinoma n'ibyumba bibiri by'inteko ishinga amategeko, Sena n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Ku ya 5 Gicurasi 1995, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Igihugu y'Igihe cyahise yemeje Itegeko Nshinga rishya ryarimo ingingo z'Itegeko Nshinga ryo ku ya 18 Kamena 1991, kimwe n'ibikubiye mu masezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha yo mu 1993 na porogaramu y'ubwumvikane y'amashyaka menshi yo mu Ugushyingo 1994.
Inteko ishinga amategeko y'igihugu.
Mu Rwanda Inteko Ishinga Amategeko igizwe n'abadepite mirongo inani. Muri bo, Abadepite mirongo itanu na batatu batoranywa mu matora rusange mu ibanga, batoranyijwe ku rutonde rwihariye rw'amazina y'abakandida batorwa n'amashyirahamwe ya politiki cyangwa abakandida bigenga; abagore makumyabiri na bane batoranyijwe na za kaminuza zihariye z'amatora mu buryo buhuje n'inzego z'ubuyobozi bw'igihugu; Abadepite babiri batowe n'Inama y'Igihugu y'Urubyiruko; Depite umwe watowe n'Inama y'Igihugu y'Abantu bafite Ubumuga.
Sena igizwe n'abantu makumyabiri na batandatu. Muri abo, harimo abasenateri cumi na babiri batowe n'inama zihariye hakurikijwe inzego z'ubuyobozi; Abasenateri umunani bashyizweho na Perezida wa Repubulika; Abasenateri bane batowe n'Inama y'Igihugu y'amashyirahamwe ya politiki; Umusenateri umwe watowe mu bigisha n'abashakashatsi ba Kaminuza za Leta n'ibigo by'amashuri makuru; n'Umusenateri umwe watowe mu bigisha n'abashakashatsi ba Kaminuza z'abikorera n'ibigo by'amashuri makuru.
Nyuma y'intsinzi ya gisirikare muri Nyakanga 1994, Front Patriotique y'u Rwanda yateguye guverinoma y'ishyaka isa n'iyo yashyizweho na Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana mu 1992. Yiswe Guverinoma y'Ubumwe bw'Igihugu Ifite Urufatiro Rwagutse, amategeko yayo y'ibanze ashingiye ku ihuje ry'itegeko nshinga, amasezerano ya Arusha, n'amasezerano ya politiki y'amashyaka. Ishyaka rya MRND ryashyizwe mu kato.
Gutegura politiki byari bibujijwe kugeza mu 2003. Amatora ya mbere ya nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, amatora y'umukuru w'igihugu n'amatora y'abadepite yabaye muri Kanama na Nzeri 2003, buri wese ku giti cye.
Ibibazo bikomeye leta yari ihanganye nabyo ni ugusubiza mu buzima busanzwe impunzi zirenga miliyoni 2 zagarutse kuva kera nka 1959; iherezo ry'ubugarariji no kurwanya ubugarariji mu bahoze ari abasirikare n'interahamwe n'igisirikare cy'u Rwanda cy'igihugu, cyibumbiye mu majyaruguru no mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba; no kuva mu bibazo byo gutegura iterambere ry'igihe gito n'igihe kirekire. Imfungwa zizakomeza kuba ikibazo cyihutirwa mu gihe kiri imbere, kuko zariyongereye zirenga 100.000 mu myaka 3 yakurikiye intambara.
Guverinoma ibuza ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose rishingiye ku gitsina, ubwoko, ubwoko cyangwa idini. Guverinoma yashyizeho amategeko abuza gushimangira umwirondoro w'Abahutu cyangwa Abatutsi mu bikorwa byinshi bya politiki.
Politiki-ubukungu bwibanze.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2005 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2010, umubare w'abari mu bukene bw'intica ntikize ku rwego rw'igihugu wagabanutseho hejuru ya 10 ku ijana, kandi icyizere cyo kubaho cy'imyaka igera kuri 64 kiruta icy'ibihugu nk'ibyo byo muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara ndetse n'ibindi bihugu bikennye.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, umusaruro w'ibyuka byangiza ikirere w'u Rwanda wari toni 0.1 ku muntu, ukaba wari hasi cyane ugereranyije n'ibindi bihugu byo muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara ndetse n'ibindi bihugu bifite umusaruro muke. U Rwanda rufite umubare munini w'abanyeshuri biga kurusha ibindi bihugu byo muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara, ndetse no mu bindi bihugu bikennye.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2014, u Rwanda rwari rukigaragara nk'igihugu cyinjiza amafaranga make, gifite umusaruro mbumbe w'igihugu ungana na miliyari 7.890 z'amadolari, ugereranyije n'amadolari y'Amerika, n'abaturage bangana na miliyoni 11.34.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2015 u Rwanda rwahinduye icyerekezo mu iterambere ry'ubukungu, rushyira imbere ifaranga ry'amahanga mu buhinzi bw'ikawa n'icyayi, "bifasha kugabanya ubukene n'ubusumbane". Banki y'Isi yashimye imihati y'u Rwanda. Kagame yagiranye ibiganiro n'ibigo bikomeye nka Costco na Starbucks, byahoze ari byo bigura kawa nyinshi mu Rwanda kuva mu 2015.
Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryitabiriye.
U Rwanda ni umunyamuryango wa ACCT, ACP, AfDB, WTrO.

"Jihadi" (جهاد) ni ijambo ry'icyarabu risobanura "urugamba" cyangwa "guharanira." Mu rwego rwa kisilamu, rifite ibisobanuro byinshi nubusobanuro, akenshi butavugwaho rumwe. tugiye kureba muburyo bwimbitse icyo jihadi ari cyo:
1. Ubwoko bwa Jihadi:.
Jihadi Nkuru (Jihad al-Akbar): Ibi bivuga urugamba rwimbere rwo kurwanya icyaha nimbaraga zo kubaho ubuzima ukurikije amahame ya kisilamu. Ishimangira kwiteza imbere, ubunyangamugayo, niterambere ryumuntu.
Jihadi Ntoya (Jihad al-Asghar): iyi ishobora kwerekeza ku ntambara y'umubiri, ishobora kuba ikubiyemo no kwitwaza intwaro murwego rwokurengera idini ya Islam. gusa, ni ngombwa kumenya ko ibyo bigengwa nubuyobozi bukomeye bushingiye kumahame agenga imyitwarire myiza ya kisilamu.
2. Urugamba rwo mu mwuka no mu myifatire:.
Jihadi akenshi ikubiyemo urugamba rwo kwiteza imbere muburyo bw'umwuka, gukurikiza inyigisho za Islamu, no guteza imbere ubutabera n'urukundo muri sosiyete.nanone isobanura gushyira imbaraga muguteza imbere burezi, gufasha abatishoboye, ndetse n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage muri rusange.
3. amateka yaranze jihad:.
Mu mateka ya kisilamu, jihadi yasobanuwe muburyo butandukanye. Mu bihe bya mbere bya kisilamu, akenshi yasobanuraga kurengera umuryango w’abayisilamu hagamijwe kuwurinda iterabwoba ryabarwanyaga idini ya isilamu.Igitekerezo cyaje guhinduka bitewe ningaruka za politiki, imibereho, namateka, arinabyo byaje gutuma isobanurwa ikanakorwa muburyo butaribwo.
4. Amabwiriza agenga imyitwarire muri jihad ntoya:.
Iyo uganira kuri jihadi ntoya, hariho amategeko akomeye: agomba gukurikizwa hagamijwe kurengera imyemerere y’umuryango w'abasilamu, ntabwo ari ugutera abandi ubwoba cyangwa kubakandamiza.naho Abatari abarwanyi, nk'abagore, abana, n'abasaza, bagomba kurindwa ibyago byurugamba, kandi amahame y'ubutabera n'imbabazi agomba kubahirizwa.
5. uko yasobanuwe nabi:.
Jihadi ikunze kumvikana nabi mubiganiro byiki gihe, cyane cyane kubera imitwe y'intagondwa ikoresha nabi irijambo kugirango ishyigikire urugomo n'iterabwoba ikora. abamenyi benshi mubijyanye n'idini ya isilamu bashimangira ko ibikorwa byurugomo nkibi bivuguruza ishingiro ryukuri ry'ijambo jihadi.
Jihadi nigitekerezo gifite ibisobanuro byinshi mubuyisilamu gusa icyo benshi bahurizaho cyane cyane nuko jihad ar'igitekerezo cyo guharanira icyiza, cyaba icy'umuntu ku giti cye, muburyo bw'umwuka, cyangwa, ubufatika n'ubundi buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose. kuyisobanukirwa bisaba, kumenya amahame mbwirizamuco y'ukuri ayigenga, kugirango ubashe gutandukanya ibinyoma ivugwaho bitandukanye nukuri kwayo.

ubwenge ni ijambo risobanura ubushobozi bwo guca imanza muburyo bufatika hashingiwe kugufata ibyemezo bishingiye kubumenyi, uburambe, no gusobanukirwa.kandi Ntabwo ubwenge bukubiyemo kumenya icyo gukora gusa, ahubwo no kumenya igihe nuburyo bwo kubikora neza.
Dore ibintu bimwe byingenzi biranga ubwenge:
1. guca urubanza muburyo bwumvikana:Ubwenge burimo ubushobozi bwo gusuzuma ibintu neza no gukora amahitamo ashingiye kugusobanukirwa ibintu neza muburyo bwimbitse.
2. Uburambe:ububwenge Bukunze gukomoka mubuzima bwaburimunsi,aho abantu biga binyuze mugutsindwa cyangwa gutsinda, bikabafasha gukoresha ubwo bumenyi mubihe bizaza.
3. Ubushishozi bwo gusobanukirwa:Ubwenge bukubiyemo ubushobozi bwo kubona ibirenze ibyo umuntu wese yabona no gusobanukirwa ukuri gushingiye kubihamya bifatika, biganisha kugusobanukirwa byimbitse ikintu cyangwa umuntu runaka.
4. Ubwenge bw'amarangamutima:Umuntu w'umunyabwenge akenshi aba afite ubwenge bwamarangamutima buhambaye, bumwemerera kwishyira mu mwanya w'abandi no kumva ibitekerezo bitandukanye nibye.
5. Kuringaniza ubuzima:Ubwenge bukubiyemo uburyo bwo gushaka uko waringaniza ibice bitandukanye by'ubuzima, birimo nkamarangamutima,imitekerereze,akazi,nibindi..., intego z'igihe gito nintego zigihe kirekire.
6. Gutekereza ku myitwarire:Ubwenge bujyanye kenshi no gutekereza kundangagaciro, ziyobora umuntu guhitamo ibifite akamaro kuriwe ndetse na societe muri rusange.
Muri make, ubwenge ni ibice bitandukanye bikubiyemo ubumenyi, uburambe, nubushobozi bwo kubishyira mubikorwa muburyo bwimitekerereze n'imyitwarire bihabwa agaciro cyane mumico itandukanye kandi bukunze guhabwa agaciro nabantu bashaka kwitezimbere kugiti cyabo ndetse no guteza abandi imbere.

Nizeyimana Alphonse, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Ndanda Alphonse yavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1990, avukira mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda, yatangiye umwuga we nk'umuzamu, akinira amakipe menshi akomeye yo mu Rwanda, harimo Rayon Sports FC, Mukura, na AS Kigali hamwe ni kipe nkuru y'igihugu. Atuye mu Bwongereza, aho yagiye mu mwuga w'ubutoza, agaragaza ko ari ambasaderi w'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda kuri kimwe mu byiciro byo guhangana ku isi.
Ubu, nk'umutoza, yakoresheje ubwo bwitange mu nshingano ze nshya, atoza abakinnyi bakiri bato kandi yemeza ko bafite ibikoresho n'ubuyobozi kugira ngo batsinde. Umusanzu we ntiwazamuye gusa umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda ahubwo wanakinguye amarembo y'abakinnyi b'u Rwanda gushakisha amahirwe mu makipe yo mu Burayi, cyane cyane mu Bwongereza.
Abakinnyi b’u Rwanda barashobora gukomeza kungukirwa n’amasosiyete mpuzamahanga ndetse n’urubuga yashyizeho, bigatanga inzira yo kwinjiza benshi mu bakinnyi b’umupira w’amaguru bo mu Rwanda mu makipe akomeye yo mu Burayi.
Ubwitange bwa Alphonse mu guteza imbere umupira w'u Rwanda ni ntagereranywa, kandi imbaraga ze zimubera urumuri rw'ibisekuruza bizaza bifuza kugera ku rwego rwo hejuru muri siporo.
Ndanda avuka mu Rwanda ku Gisozi, Akarere ka Gasabo mu mujyi wa Kigali.

Kororera mu kiraro nuburyo bwo korora amatungo ari hamwe, ibyo bigafasha uworoye ayo matungo kuyakurikirana, kuyagaburira, kuyavura, kuyarinda indwara no mu buryo bwo gutanga ifumbire nyinshi mugihe gito, nibindi.
Ibyatumaga umusaruro w'inka zororewe mukiraro zitagira umusaruro.
Reka twivugire kubworozi bw'inka bukorewe mu kiraro, mu Rwanda abantu barimo bagenda bamenyera kororera mu kiraro kubera ko basanze kororera mugasozi ntanyungu byabagiraga nko kororera mubiraro, aho wasanganga inka zirwa ziruka imusozi, rimwe narimwe zigakurayo indwara nkuburondwe, uburenge, ikibagarira nizindi, ikindi kibazo inka zirisha mugasozi zahuraga nazo nukubyarana ni bimasa badashaka, ugasanga umuntu araragiye inka ze zihuye nikimasa mugasozo kirakibanguriye, ukazasanga abyaje inka yincenzi, ikindi kibazo wasangaga abarozi batabona ifumbire kuko izo nka zabaga zataye amase mugasozi aho baziragiye, rimwe na rimwe umusaruro w' amata ugasanga wabaye mucye.
Icy kororera mukiraro byafashije.
kororera mukiraro byafashije ababikora kubasha kwihaza ku mukamo, kubasha gurwanya indwara zandurira mugasozi, kurwanya icyororo umuntu atahisemo kuko iyo bibaye ngobwa umuntu ashobora no kwifashisha intanga avugurura icyororo ke, kandi nanone bifasha kwihaza kwifumbire kubera ko inka ziba zita amase ahantu hamwe.

Abahanga mu by' ubuzima bavuga ko ibi bijumba bikungahaye kuri Vitamini A, ikaba vitamini y' ingenzi cyane ku bagore batwite, abana ndetse n' abantu bose muri rusange. ikihumba kimwe cya orange gipima garama 100 kirimo vitamini A yose umubiri w' umuntu ikenera kumunsi.
kandi abahanga bavuga ko ibijumba bya orange bibamo ibinyabutabire bya Alpha_carotene na Beta_Carotene bikaba iby' ingenzi cyane mu kurwanya canseri.

Ijambo “ikaramu” ni ijambo rikoreshwa cyane mu buzima bwa buri munsi, cyane cyane mu burezi, itumanaho no mu miryango muri rusange. Dore amakuru arambuye kuri iryo jambo:
----ikaramu ni igikoresho kifashishwa twandika; ikaba igizwe n' kirahure n'agatima kaba karimo umuti wifashishwa
Abantu benshi bavuze ku karamu ko ari ingirakamaro kuko uwayikoresheje atajya abura ikimurengera. Ikaramu ni ingirakamaro uwakoresheje ikaramu arayirata iti "uwagukoresheje ntajya aburara".Ikaramu ni ingenzi ku buzima bwacu buri gihe tugomba kuyiha agaciro kuko ifite byinshi imara mu buzima.

Mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi duhura n'ibibazo bigiye bitandukanye by'ubuzima. Haba ku mubiri ndetse no mu mutwe.Indwara zo mu mutwe zishobora kwibasira buri zititaye kuwo ari we, akazi akora, cyangwa ubuzima abayemo.Tugiye kugaruka kuri byinshi utari uzi ku ndwara zo mu mutwe ndetse n'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe
Indwara zo mu mutwe ni iki?
Indwara zo mu mutwe ni imyitwarire idasanzwe umuntu ashobora kugaragaza akaba yata umurongo agatangira no kubangamira abandi.
Akenshi izi ndwara, inyinshi muri zo zishobora kuba zidakomeye cg ngo zibe ari indwara zimara igihe kirekire ahubwo rimwe na rimwe zishobora kuba ari izoroheje cyangwa zimwe zishira vuba.Ishami ry'umuryango w'abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) ryasobanuye ko ubuzima bwo mu mutwe ari kumenya ubushobozi bwawe ndetse ukagira ubuzima bwiza.Hari indwara zo mu mutwe zibasira abantu benshi ku isi,aha twavuga nk'indwara y'agahinda gakabije aho (OMS) yagaragaje ko yibasiye abantu bangana na miliyoni 300 ku isi yose na ho abangana na 4% bafite indwara y'ubwoba bukabije.
Ni ibiki bitera inwara zo mu mutwe?
Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko inwara nka schizophrenia zibasira abagore cyane na ho ibibazo by'ikoreshwa by'ibiyobyabwenge bikibasira abagabo cyane kurusha abagore
2.IMBUGA NKORANYA MBAGA
Imbuga nkoranyambaga zishobora gusunikira abantu bazikoresha mu bwigunge bigatuma bagira ibibazo byo mu mutwe. ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko 10% mu bazikoresha bavuze ko zituma bashobora kwigunga na ho 10% bakavuga ko bazigiriraho ibihe.
3.UBUZIMA UMUNTU ABAYEMO
Ubuzima umuntu abayemo bushobora kuba bwamutera ibibazo byo mu mutwe. mu gihe umuntu abaye mu buzima bubi bishobora kumutera ibibazo byo mu mutwe.

Umuziki ugezweho ni umuziki wifashisha tekiniki n'ubumenyi bw'igihe tugezemo, kandi ukurikiza imimerere n'ibyifuzo by'abantu b'iki gihe. Ni umuziki uba ukurikije ibigezweho, akaba akenshi ukora mu buryo butandukanye n'umuziki wa kera, wifashisha ibikoresho n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Ubundi, umuziki ugezweho ushobora kugera ku bantu benshi, cyane cyane binyuze mu mbuga nkoranyambaga, uburyo bwo gutunganya umuziki mu buryo bwa digitale, ndetse no gukoresha imvugo n'umuziki bihuye n'umuco n'ibikorwa bya none.
Umuziki ugezweho ni umuziki uhuza uburyo bw’imyidagaduro, ubuhanzi, n’icyerekezo cy’imico ya none. Bahanzi bashobora gukoresha ikoranabuhanga, kumenya ibyifuzo by’abafana, no gukoresha imico n’ibihangano bihuje amahitamo y’abantu, byose bifasha gukora umuziki mwiza ugezweho kandi ukundwa. Gukora umuziki mwiza bisaba no guhanga udushya, kumenya uko umuziki ugenda uhinduka, ndetse no guhora ugerageza kuzakira ibisubizo bishya mu bikorwa byose byo gukora indirimbo.

Igisenge ni ubwoko bwinzu abantu bubaka,hari ubwoko bubiri igisenge cy'inzu yibyatsi,igisenge cy;inzu yamabati mu Rwanda hambere habaga ubwoko bw;inzu zubakishijwe ibyatsi ariko zaje gucika.Haza izubakishije amabati ndetse namatafari.
Igisenge nanone hari ubundi bwoko bw'inzu zihishe igisenge arizo zitwa (konoshi) mundimi zamahanga,murimake igisenge ni amoko atata mu Rwanda.

Abakonyine ni abantu ki?
Muntara y'iburasirazuba haba ubwoko bw'abantu butandukanye harimo nubu bw'abakonyine,abobantu bakunze kuba barebare,abatesi,ndetse batunga inka nyinshi cyane ugereranyije nabandi mu gihugu cyu Rwanda..
Abo bantu ntibakunda kurya ahubwo bakunda amata cyane, gukunda amata bifitanye isano n'umuco w'ubworozi kuruta kuba ari ikimenyetso cy'abo.

Inzara ni igice cy'umubiri w'umuntu gisangwa ku ntoki no kubirenge, kifashishwa mu kwishima ku mubiri igihe hari uburibwe umuntu agize.
Inzara zifashishwa mukugaraga ubwiza bw'igitsinagore cyane cyane abakobwa, iyo umuntu afite inzara ndende bivugwako ariwe ufite inzara nziza.
Abenshi bakunda kuzisiga amabara menshi kugirango bazongerere ubwiza.
