Amahunge cyangwa se amahungire ni umurima bahingamo ibijumba muburyo bw'ihariye, cyangwa se byabugenewe, aho habaga ari mu gisambu cynagwa se mu rwiri kuki amahungu akorwa ahantu hakomeye.
Amahunge y'ibijumba cyangwa se amayogi ni intabire cyangwa se ubuhinge aho buba bwege hejuru, akaka ariho batera ibijumba, amateke cyangwa imyumbati cyangwase urutoki, akaba ariho babyitanga ibinyamayogi.

Umugara w'intore ni umwambaro intore z'abagabo zambara ku mutwe yabo, ukaba ukoze mu migwegwe, ukaba ari umwe mu mitako mwiza iranga uranga intore nyarwanda, ukiwubona uhita ubonaka ari intore.
Ubundi inyamaswa y'intare igira umugara, ariko nanone intore zimbyina imbyino z'erekeranye n'umuco nyarwanda nazo zingira ibikoresho byitwa umugara.

Ingabo z'intore ni igikoresho gikoze mu giti cy'umuko kigaraga mu muco Nyarwanda, ingabo ikaba ari igikoresho gikunzwe gukoresha n'intore iyo ziri guhamiriza, Ingabo ikaba ifatwa mu ntoki, ikaba ari ikoreshwa mu kwikingira imyambi cyanngwa se icumu mu gihe uyifite ari kurungamba cyangwa se mu guhamiriza.

Umuhamirizo ni imbyino zigaragara mu muco nyarwanda, ikaba yaradutse ku ngoma y'umwami Kigeli IV Rwabugili, ni mu mwaka 1880, wari utangijwe n'umutwe w'ingabo witwa Inyaruguru, aho zawubyinaga nk'umudiho.
Umuhamirizo ni urukomatane cyangwa se uruhurirane cyangwa urusobekerane rw'intore aho ziba ziyerekana mu mwiyereko zateguye, aho ziba zakenyeye, zitwaje amacumu, imiheto ingabo zambaye bidasanzwe nkuko bigaragaza umuco nyarwanda.

Ruharage ni ubundi ingoma zikoreshwa mu muhamirizo w'intore, aho iri zina rikomoka ku mparage, aho urwo ruhu rwabaga rukoze izo ngoma zo mu muco nyarwanda, gusa zabaga ubundi bibambishije uruhu rw'ihene.
Ubundi ingoma zikoreshwa n'intore, ariho hakomoka inyito y'amagambo atandukanye arimo gutoza, gutora n'itorero, mu muco nyarwanda.

Umurishyo ni igiti gito kiba kibaje kimeze nkagati gato aho gikoreshwa kugenda bagikubita ku ngoma, umurishyo akaba ari uduti tubiri tuba tureshya.
Umurishyo urimo amako menshi bitewe n'ingoma uba uraza gukoreshwa.

Kwizera charles yavutse 2007 yamenyekanye ku izina rya stage Drizzy charle, ni umusofitiweya developa w'umunyarwanda.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
drizzy yavutse mu 2007 i nyagatare, Intara y'Iburasirazuba nk'umwana wa gatandatu mu muryango w'abantu barindwi.

Itorero ni kimwe mu biranga umuco nyarwanda, rikaba ariryo ry'igirwagamo umuco nyarwanda, amateka y'ahatise. Mu itorero niho abakurambee bigishirizaga abato uko bakunda igihugu, kumasha, gukirana ndetse no nindi mikino cyarugamba.
Mu itorero niho bigiraga kugukita ingoma, kuba intore hakazamo ndetse nizindi ndagagaciro zirimo Gutora, Gutoza, Itorero. kandi bahigiraga guhamiriza n'ibindi byinshi byerekeye igihugu.

Umukenyero ni umwambaro wakera ugaragaza umuco nyarwanda ndetse no mukarere ugigaye ukoresha cyane, ubundi umukenyero wari mwambaro wa mbarwa n'abagore nkukko biri mu muco nyarwanda, gusa n'abagabo basigaye bayicyenyera.
Umukenyero watangiye gukoreshwa kera cyane mu Rwanda, cyane cyane ukambarwa n'abantu bakuze b'abacyecuru aho babaga bitabiriye ubukwe cyangwa se ibirori bigiye bitandukanye, ibirori by'umuco, kurya ubunnyano, kubatirisha abana. Umukenyero ukaba w'ambarwa ujyanye n'ikindi gitambaro cy'itwa umwitero.

Umwitero ni umwe mu myambaro igize umushanana cyangwa se umukenyero, umwitero ukaba igitambaro umugore cyangwa umukobwa cyangwa se abana uretseko nabo n'abagabo basigaye bayambara bitera kigice cy'ohejuru nko mu gatuza cyangwa ku mabere, uturuka ku rutugu rumwe ugana hasi mu rucyenyerero kurundi ruhande.
Umwitero ugendana n'umushanana, ukaba wambarwa hari ibiroro byabaye. umwitero ushobora kuba usa n'umukenyero gusa nano bishoboara kuba bidasa.

Inigi cyangwa se urunigi ni umutako abagore cyangwa se abakobwa bambara mu ijosi rukaba ryaragiye rukoresha kuva kera mu muco nyarwanda rwerekana ubwiza bw'urwambaye.
Urunigi abakobwa cyangwa umugore bayambara muburyo bw'inshi ahantu henshi byose bikaba bifite n'ibisibanuro bitandukanye aha twavuga:

Icyansi ni kimwe mu bikoresho byakera bakoreshawa n'abakurambere bu Rwanda, ndetse cyarangaga umuco nyarwanda, aho icyansi cyari kimwe mu byakoreshwaga mu gukama cyangwa se mu gufata neza amata. icyansi cyabaga ari inkongoro yabazwaga mugiti cy'umusave cyangwa umukerenke n'isabo byakurwaga mu nzuzi zirega ibicuma zigaterekwa zikamara igihe zikabyazwamo icyansi cyo kubungabunga amata mumuco nyarwanda.
Mu muco nyarwanda, icyansi ni igikoresho cy’umwimerere gikoreshwaga mu gukama amata avuye ku nka. By’umwihariko, cyari kimwe mu bikoresho by’ingenzi mu kubungabunga amata, kuzirinda umwanda, no kugaragaza agaciro k’inka mu muryango.
Icyansi kiraziririzwa ndetse niyo cya'menetse hari umvugo bakoresha, icyansi nti kimeneka ahubwo kirabyara, cyangwa kiraseka.

Igicuma ni igikoresho cya kera mu kinyrwanda ndetse cyerekana uko abanyarwanda bajyaga basangira bakagakoresha, haba umutobe cyangwa urwagwa cyangwa ikigage, agacuma baragahinga ka kera maze bakagasarura bakagatunganya ubundi bagatangira kugakoresha mu bikoresho bisazwe, bakogeshe amazi yonyine.
Igucuma kugirango ubashe kuba wannya ikigage, umutobe cyangwa urwagwa rurimo bisabako ugomba gukoresha umuheha mutoya wabugenewe.

Umuhini ni igiti cyakoreshwa n'ubu gikoreshwa kuva kera mu bakurambere ubwo babaga bamaze gukora isekuru mu muvure mu giti cy'umuvure,nyuma bakoraga umuhini wabafashaga mugusekura ibintu bitandukanye bashyize mu isekuru.
Umuhini ni igiti gifite uburerebure bungana burenga metero, ntabwo uba uremera uba woroshye, ahanini umuhini ukunze kuba ukoze mu giti cy'indakatsi, bidakuyeho ko n'ibindi biti wawukoramo.

Umutemeri ni kimwe mubice bugize agaseke, ukaba ari igice gipfundikira agaseke, sibyo gusa umutemeri ufasha muri byinshi byagiye bugaragara mu muco nyarwanda.
Mubihe by'akera umutemeri wanjya ufasha mukubifashmo ibintu bitandukanye harimo nka rukacarara.

Kagambage Alexandre wamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo z’ibirori by’ubukwe, ni umwe mu bahanzi bafite ibigwi byihagazeho muri muzika nyarwanda, akaba yaracuranze mu matsinda atandukanye yo hambere arimo Les Unis, Super Alouette na Uruyanjye ariko nyuma yaje kwicurangira wenyine (solo).
Usibye kuba yari umuhanzi, umucaranzi n’umuririmbyi, Kagambage Alexandre yize amashuri y’imyuga akaba yari azi gushushanya no kubaza.
Mbere yo gutangira gucuranga, Kagambage Alexandre n’abavandimwe be barimo impanga ye Kagame Alexis na we wacurangaga na Ntaganira Fabien, baririmbaga muri korali ya paruwase y’iwabo ku ivuko mu Murenge wa Runda mu Karere ka Kamonyi (Gitarama).
Ntaganira Fabien avuga ko murumuna we yari umuntu utuje cyane ku buryo ngo n’iyo wamukoserezaga yakubazaga mu ijwi rituje cyane ati “ese ubitewe ni iki ?”
yitabye imana mu 2005.

Urwabya ni igikoresho gakondo cya kera kigaragara mu muco nyarwanda, urwabya rukaba rukoze mu ibumba aho ruba rufite umunwa mu nini rumeze nki kibindi ariko bitandukanye mu mikoreshereze aho urwabya barutekamo gusa imboga. urwabya rutandukanye n'uruho, igikebano, urucyo n'ikibindi.
Urwabya rukunze kuba ari rutoya ugereranije n'ikibindi kandi rwose ruba rufite umunwa mu nini cyane kugirango ibyatekewemo babashe kubyarura.

Ingasire ni ibiye rigendana n'urusyo, Ingasire ni ibuye umusyi afata mu ntoki ari gusya rikaba ari ubwoko bw'ibuye ryitwa isarabyayi, Ingasire ikaba ryaragiye rigaragara mu muco nyarwanda nkirifasha abanyarwanda mu mugusya ibinyameke bigiye bitandukanye harimo amasaka, amamera, ibigori n'ibindi bitandukanye.

Umuce ni kimwe mu bikoresho by'umuco nyarwanda bya kera kuva mu bakurambere bu Rwanda, umuce ubundi bawita umusambi cyangwa se ikirago. Umuce ubundi ukoze mu rukaganga bumishije ubundi bakagenda bahambiriza umugwegwe nayo babanje gutunganya neza bayikubita, bakayumutsa ubindi ikoroha.
Umuce ubundi utandukanye n'umusambi ndetse nanone byobi bitandukanye ndetse n'ikirago, ariko nanone bigatandukana bigendanye naho bikoresha ndetse n'imikoreshereze.

Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu ni umugabo w'umunyarwanda akaba ari inzobere mu muco nyarwanda, amateka yu Rwanda, umusizi w'umusaza, inzobere kabuhariwe, umurage n'ubuvanganzo nya Rwanda.
Nsanzabera jean de Dieu ni umwe mubanditsi bagiye bandika ubitandunaye ku muco wa kera w'abanyarwanda, harimo ibitabo yanditse nk'icyitwa Umuco mu Buvanganzo, ndetse ubu akaba asigaye ari umunyamukuri kuri TV1 aho ayobora ikiganiro cyitwa muzehe quiz.
Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu yanditse ibitabo bitandukaye amaza kwandika ibitabo bigera kuri 56, ndetse harimo imivugo 250 n'ibindi bitandukanye.

Umurage ndangamuco w'isi ni gahunda y'isi yokumenyekanisha ibintu biyiriho ariko bikonzwe na unesco. umurage ndangamuco w'isi ubundi uginzwe n'ibintu bigiye bitandukanye bigize umuco w'ibigaragara, ibifatika n'ibidafatika mu buhanzi, ubugeni, umuco, imibereyo y'abantu mu bihugu bigiye bitandukanye mu myaka uko yagiye ikurikirana mu biragano by'abantu.
Mu murange ndangamuco w'isi harimo ibintu byinshi bigiye bitandunaye bikomoka mu Rwanda aha twavuga:

Intara ni kimwe mu bikoresho gakondo kuva kera mu muco Nyarwanda, aho cyabaga gikoze mu biti byitwa urubatura cyangwa se imigano, cyangwa se imikumbuguru.
Intara ubundi ikoreshwa mu kazi kagiye gatandukanye aha twavuga nko mu kugosora imyaka igiye itandukanye cyangwa se gutunganya ibintu bigiye bitandukanye.

Umujishi cyangwa se tujye mu mujishi ni igiti gikoreshwa mu ngobyi ya kinyarwanda,kikaba ari igiti gikunze kuvugwa cyangwa gukoresha mu muco nyarwanda bashaka kuvuga guheka umuntu urwaye.
Umujishi mu ngombyi ubundi iba ari ibiri (2) igafata mu mpande ebyiri z'ingombyi, mu mujishi hajyamo abantu 4, babiri imbere n'ababiri inyuma.

Amakoma ni amasaka yose yeze akaba ariko akaba atinitse atari amakoma, Amakoma ashobora kubari amasaka y'umweru cynagwa se amasaka y'umutuku.
Amakoma akoreshwa cyane mu muco nyarwanda, iyo bari gukora ishisho.

Umurage ni ibintu byose birimo indirimbo, ibikoresho bitandukanye twasigiwe n'abakurambere mu muco nyarwanda tukajya tubigenderaho mu buzima bw'aminsi yose, twavuga ubuvanganzo, imwemerere, imitekerereza ndetse n'ibindi nki mikorere.

Umuzinga ni igikoresho cya kinyarwanda kuva kera aho kiba kiboshye nkimeze nk'igitebo ariko gifunze hose, nkikaba gifite gifite utwenge tubiri twitwa amaso, aho inzuki zisohokera cyangwa zikinjira.
Umuzinga ubundi bawumanika mu biti kugirango inzuki zize zinjyemo, ariko cyane cyane mu giti cy'umuvumu. umuzinga ukaba ukoze mu mu biti bitandukanye harimo umbatura, imbingo, imigano, umuhurura n'ibindi.

Umutiba w'imyaka ni igikoresho cyo kuva kera mu muco nyarwanda banjyaga babikamo imyaka ku mwero wayo. Umutiba ukaba warabaga ukoze mu biti bitandukanye, harimo imbingo ndetse n'imbariro nyuma bakubaka bagashyiramo icyondo gusa bagasiga umwanya wokunyzamo imyaka bashaka guhunika no kuba bayikuramo.

Ingata ni igikoresho cya kera aho kiba gikoze mu byatsi cyangwa mu makoma yumwe cyangwa imihurura n'ibindi byatsi.
Ingata ni igikoresho kuva kera mu muco nyarwanda, ikaba ifasha cyangwa yarafashaga mu kwikorera ibitu ku mutwe, kurutugu ndetse no gushyigikira ikibindi, Umutiba w'imyaka.

Manzi Josbert (azwi muri muzika, Gutunganya no kuyobora amashusho y'indirimbo na filime, ni umu content creator azwi ku mazina nka Manzi Wijos) ni umuhanzi numu video Director w'umunyarwanda wavukiye mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y 'Amajyepfo, akaba ari umwana wa mbere mu muryango w'abantu batatu. Manzi Wijos ntakidasanzwe kubona yarakuze akunda umuziki no ku wutunganya no gukora imirimo ifite aho ihuriye nawo nibisanzwe kuri we kuko yakuze akunda kubyina, kuririmba no kureba TV cyane. Mu gihe abandi banyeshuri bibandaga mugukurikirana ayandi masomo asanzwe, we yakungaga gushushanya no kwandika indirimbo, kubyina, ndetse no kuririmba agakunda no gukoresha machine cyane
yibanze m'umuziki kuwukora, kuwutunganya mu buryo bw'amashusho, gu creating ama contents, gukora ibiganiro nama filime aba aribyo akurikirana nku mwuga kuko nizo zari inzozi ze.

bizabagiraho ingaruka zitari nziza.

AKAMARO KI INGANDA MU RWANDA
inganda ni kimwe mu bikorwa remezo abantu batuye isi bakenera mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.
ibyo twauga ku nganda ni byinshi harimo nko gukora imyambaro,gukora ibyob kurya biri nkumutsima,zidukorera
amasabune dukoresha iyo dusukura aho tuba,ibyob dukoresha nibindi byinshi.
Muburyo bwo guteza imbere imibereho ya muntu dukwiye kuzamura inganda nyinshi duharanira kubaho neza,
nkabanyarwanda ndetse nisi muri rusange,tuzamura ubukungu bwigihugu na baturarwanda bose.

Mubuzima bwacu bwaburimunsi kugirango umuntu abeho nuko agomba gufata intungamubiri zose zuzuye umubiri wacu ukenera arizo dusanga mundyo yuzuye,none wakibaza ngo:ese indyo yuzuye iba imeze ite,ese yaba igizwe n'ayhe mafunguro nibyo tugiye kureba.
Abantu benshi rero usanga batekerezako indyo yuzuye bisaba kuba ufite amafunguro menshi cyangwase bisaba igishoro kinini akaba arinayo mpamvu usanga bamwe nabamwe bavugako indyo yuzuye ariya bantu bakize gusa ariko nagirango mvuge ko uko ari ukwibeshya impamvu ni uko indyo yuzuye idasaba ibintu bihenze cyane cyangwa ngo ibe igenewe bamwe gusa ngo kubera aribo bafite ubushobozi.Bimwe mubigize indyo yuzuye twasangamo ibyiciro bitatu byingenzi aribyo ibi bikurikira,
Mundyo yuzuye tugiramo ibyubaka umubiri aho dusangamo intunga mubiri zubaka umubiri tukaba tuzisanga mumafunguro agiye atandukanye kandi yoroshye kubonnwa naburiwese urugero;amagi,soya,ibishyimbo,inyama,amafi ndetse nibindi bitandukanye.Mubyubaka umubiri dusangamo intungamubiri zikungahaye cyane kuri(protein) none wakibaza akamaro ka protein kumubiri wacu?
Izi ntungamubiri (proteins) ziri mubif
asha umubiri wacu mimikorere yawo yaburimunsi.Buri gice cy'umubiri wacu gikora proteyine ngo gikore neza,urugero;mu igogora(digestion), guhumeka(respiration) ni bindi ikora nka enzyme.Proteyine zongera ingufu n'ubushyuhe mumubiri mugihe ibinyamasukari byashize zikaba zifasha imikaya yacu mukongera kwisana nyuma yo gukomereka.
Mubitera imbaraga dusangamo amafunguro akungahaye cyane kubinyamasukari ndetse navitamineB,C, Dna E.I biribwa dusangamo izi vitamine ni ibijumba,imyumbati,umuceri,ibirayi n'imbuto nynshi.Izi vitamine zose zifasha umubiri wacu gukora neza zigafasha no mwikoreshwa neza ry'ubwonko.
M,undyo yuzuye kandi dusangamo ibirinda indwara aho dusangamo vitamine nyinshi zigiye zitandukanye harimo vitamineA,B1,B2,B3,B4,B5,B6,B7,B9,B12,C,D,K,naE.Izi vitamine tuzisanga mumboga nka dodo,amashu,karoti,n'imbuto zirimo avoka,inanasi,amtunda,imineke nibindi.Imboga n'imbuto ahanini tuzisangamo vitamineC,A,E,na K.Naho vitamine B ahanini tuzisanga mubikomoka kumatungo.Ibibyose biturinda indwara ziterwa no kubura vitamin.
Ningombwa rero ko buri muntu wese yita kumirire ye ndetse akagerageza gufata izi ntungamubiri zose kuko zose ari ingirakamaro kubuzima bwacu.
Akamaro k'indyo yuzuye kubuzima bwacu.
-Indyo yuzuye ituma umubiri wacu uhorana imbaraga kandi ukomeye.
-Kongera ubudahangarwaa bw'umubiri wacu ndetse no guhashya indwara.
-Kongera imikaya no gusana ingingo.
-kuryanya indwara ahanini ziterwa n'imirire miboi.
Ibi byose nitura muka tubikurikije tugafata intunga mubiri zose uko bikwiye ntakabuza yuzagira ubuzima bwiza.
Umwandutsi:IFASHUWACU Kevine

Amapantaro ni imyambaro y'ibibero. ni imyenda yambarwa ku birenge, ikaba ifite ingufi cyangwa indende bitewe n'uko imeze.kandi ikaba yambarwa nabantu bose yaba abakobwa ndetse n'abahungu.
Amapantaro y'ibitenge agezweho wadodesha.
-Imyenda idoze mu bitenge,cyane cyane iy’abakobwa n’abadamu ntabwo ijya ipfa guhararukwa kuko uko iminsi ishira usanga hari moderi ziza zigezweho, ari nayo mpamvu tugiye kugaruka ku mapantaro adoze mu bitenge agezweho y’abakobwa n’abadamu.
-Kuri ubu ugiye kudodesha ipantaro mu gitenge,wadodesha ipantaro ikwegereye kandi yicupa kuburyo iba iri kuri taye kandi ifite imifuka ibiri mu mpande.
-Indi pantaro igezweho nayo iba ari icupa kandi iri kuri taye ariko hasi ikaba iteyeho akandi gatambaro k’umupira gatuma iba ifunganye hasi.
-Hari kandi moderi y’ipantaro y’injurugutu ariko itarekuye cyane,ahubwo ikaba ifashe uyambaye maze hasi ikaba irekuye buhoro kandi irimo rasitike.
-Amapantaro adoze muri izi moderi niyo agezweho muri iyi minsi kuruta ayandi,nawe ubaye ukeneye kudodesha ntuzagire indi moderi ukoresha itari muri izi.
Impamvu ari byiza kwambara amapantaro.
Bitewe n'imyemerere ya buri muntu, ahari ushobora kuba udakunda amapantaro niba uri igitsina gore. Bamwe bavugako umukobwa cyagwa umugore wambaye ipantaro aba ameze nk'umugabo. gusa tugiye kurebera hamwe ibyiza byo kuyambara ku bagore.
Abakobwa cyangwa abagore bambara amapantaro kubera impamvu zabo bwite zihariye ariko zifite aho zihuriye n'ubuzima. Abandi bakambara amapantaro kubera kwigana no kureberanaho.Abakobwa batambara amapantaro abenshi bahura n'ingaruka zimwe na zimwe, dore ko hari aho bagera bakagirwa inama yo kwambara n'utwenda tw'imbere tubafashe. kwambara ipantaro ku gitsina gore ni byiza kubera ko bamwe mu bagabo n'abasore bubu nta muco bafite.
Kwambara ipantaro bishobora kukurinda ibisambo cyangwa bikakurinda gukoreshwa ingeso mbi mu gihe uri ahantu utizeye. Bamwe mu bagabo cyangwa abasore bakoresha ingano y'ikanzu cyangwa ijipo wambaye bagashimisha imitima yabo byakanya gato.
Amafoto mabi ushobora gufatwa ashobora gukoreshwa nabi ku by'inyungu z'amafaranga bahabwa nyamara wowe ntaruhare wabigizemo. nubwo bimeze bityo, abagore cyangwa abakobwa bagirwa inama yo kutajya bambara amapantaro abaziritse cyane ku by'impamvu z'ubuzima nanone.
Ese wajya mu mikino ngorora mubiri cyangwa indi myitozo wambaye ikanzu? ntabwo byakunda, ni byiza gushaka ipantaro yabigenewe, ukajya ugorora umubiri wawe. Bamwe mu bagore batambara amapantaro ntanubwo bakora imyitozo ngororamubiri nyamara nayo ikenewe cyane.

INKONO ni ikintu gikoresha muguteka,kandi ni igikoresho cyo mugikoni. inkono ni isafuriya cyangwa igikoresho gikomeye gifite ubushobozi bwo gushyushya amazi cyangwa ibyo guteka..
inkono n'igikoresho cya kera cyakoreshwaga mu guteka cyangwa mugushyushya amazi.inkono kandi n'igikoresho gitekwamo ibiryo byingeri zose harimo nk' ibitoki,isombe,ibirayi,ibishyimbo,ibijumba nibindi...,kandi ikindi inkono n'igikoresho gikozwe mu ibumba cyane cyane ikoreshwa m'ugikoni

Joshua Ishimwe is a Rwandan student leader and public speaker serving as the Student Representative Council (SRC) President at the African Leadership College of Higher Education (ALCHE) in Mauritius. He is known for his work in student governance, youth leadership, and advocacy for student engagement and innovation.

Rukara Rwa Bishingwe ni Muntu Ki?
Rukara rwa Bishingwe ni mwene Bishingwe na Nyirakavumbi,yavukiye i Gahunga mu Ngoma y'u Burera,kuri ubu ni mu Murenge wa Gahunga mu Karere ka Burera aho bakunze kwita "Gahunga k'Abarashi".
Rukara yabayeho ku ngoma ya Yuhi V Musinga, umwami waba yarategetse u Rwanda hagati y'umwaka wa 1895 na 1931 hakurikijwe igenekereza ry'urutonde rw'Abami bategetse u Rwanda. Uyu Rukara rwa Bishingwe bivugwa ko atigeze ajya imbizi n'abazungu nkuko amateka abigaragaza. Abenshi bumva inkuru ya Rukara bakagirango ni umugani cyangwa igitekerezo, ariko ni inkuru mpamo kuko n'ubu Rukara afite benshi bamukomokaho bari bafite igisingizo cy'Ubutwari cy'Umuryango w'Abarashi, mu nzu y'Abarashi. Benshi muri aba ubu bakaba batuye mu Karere ka Burera mu murenge wa Gahunga ho mu ntara y'Amajyaruguru, aho bakunze kwita mu Gahunga k'Abarashi.
Ese koko Rukara rwa Bishingwe yishe umuzungu?
Imyaka ijana na cumi n'itanu (115) irashije Rukara rwa Bishingwe yishe umuzungu bapfa ko umuzungu w'umupadiri yari yivanze mubya Politiki n'imibereho y' Abanyarwanda nubwo bivugwa ko amwica atari yabigambiriye ahubwo byatewe n'umujinya umuzungu yari amuteye. Bivugwa ko Rukara yakundaga guhinyuza cyane kuko ni nabyo yapfaga n'umugabekazi Kanjogera nyina wa Musinga, kuko yigeze kumubwira ngo nta rubanza rwaciwe n'umugore. Uku guhinyura rero ni nabyo yapfuye na Padiri Loupias kuko uyu mu padiri bivugwa ko yateye imbago mu isambu y'Abarashi umuryango Rukara yakomokagamo ngo Kiliziya izahubake nuko Rukara arazirambura
Rukara rero yishe uyu Mupadiri yari agiye kumusobanurira impamvu yarimbuye imbago z'Abapadiri. Bamaze guhura umuzungu yasuhuje Rukara ngo ‘Yambu’ undi amwihanangiriza kutazongera kumusuhuza atyo kuko Rukara yavugaga ko yambu ari ukwamburwa abana.
Ibi Loupias yabifashe nk’agasuzuguro, aba amukubise urushyi maze Rukara azabiranywa n’uburakari aba yadukiye Padiri amuta ku munigo kugeza aheze umwuka.

Umugabekazi Nyiratunga.
Nyiratunga yabanje gushakwa na Gihana Nyamihana umwana wa Cyilima Rujugira akaba umugabo bakaba bari batuye ku Muyange wera ibisabo mu Ruhango rwa Mutakara na Nangingare ubu niho hubatse ishuri rya Muyange!.
Ndabarasa rero umuvandimwe wa Gihana Nyamihana yimye ingoma ya se Cyilima Rujugira yimana irya Kigeli aba Kigeli Ndabarasa atanze nawe Sentabyo ahabwa uruharo ngo arwigize imbere yimana irya Mibambwe gusa ntiyatinda ku ngoma ku bw’ubwiko bwa Gatarabuhura umuvandimwe we washakaga kumwaka ingoma.
Gatarabuhura umwe mu bazwiho mu mateka y’u Rwanda kuba bararwaniye ubutegetsi.
Izina rya Gatarabuhura riza mu mateka bwa mbere igihe cy’iyimikwa ry’umwami Mibambwe III Sentabyo, umwami wimikiwe hafi ya Muhazi ahitwa i Gasange (mu cyahoze ari Komini Giti ya (…)
Muri icyo gihe rero nibwo abiru bateguriye umuhiigo Mibambwe Sentabyo baca iraro kwa Nyiratunga bukeye Nyiratunga asama Gahindiro umwana rukumbi wa Mibambwe Sentabyo!
Ugenekereje isano, Mibambwe Sentabyo yari nk’umwana wa Nyiratunga kuko Sentabyo ni uwa Kigeli Ndabarasa umuvandimwe wa Gihana Nyamihana umugabo wa Nyiratunga bakaba bene Cyilima Rujugira.
Nyuma y’itanga rya Mibambwe Sentabyo azize ubushita himye uruhinja rwe na Nyiratunga arirwo Gahindiro ka Mibambwe rwimana irya Yuhi, ruba Yuhi Gahindiro.

Ni umwami wambere w'Urwanda wahanze ingoma y'urwanda wavukiye mu umubari (Ubu ni mukarere ka kayonza) Mu ntangiriro z’ubutegetsi bwe, Gihanga nta ngoma yimanye, ahubwo yategekeshaga ibindi birango bibiri aribyo inyundo n’ikindi gikoresho cy’umuziki bita urusengo.Ibyo gushyiraho ingoma nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubwami ngo yaba yarabizaniwe n’uwitwa Rubunga nawe abikopeye mu bucurabwenge bwakoreshwaga n’abitwa Abarenge. Abarenge bari Abasinga, aribo bitwaga Abasangwabutaka(bivuga abo Abanyiginya basanze bategeka) ngo akaba ari bo bari mu gihugu mbere y’uko iriya ngoma Nyiginya iza kurutegeka.Ingoma ya mbere yakoreshejwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Gihanga yahawe izina rya Rwoga bituruka ku ijambo ’kwogera’ cyangwa se ’kwamamara’.
Abagore Gihanga Yashakanye nabo.
Ikindi amateka garagaza, avuga ko Gihanga yagiye abyara abana batandukanye badahuje ba nyina kuko nawe yari afite abagore benshi nk'uko byari bisanzwe bimenyerewe mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere.
Umugore wa mbere wa Gihanga ari uwitwa Nyamususa akaba umukobwa wa Jeni uturuka mu bwoko bw'Abarenge akaba yarabyaranye n'uyu mugore Kanyarwanda Gahima (Wamusimbuye ku Ngoma),
Kanyandorwa Sabugabo se wa Mushambo ukomokwaho n'ubwoko bw' Abashambo (Wabaye Umwami wo mu Ndorwa),
Ndetse n'uwitwa Kanyabugesera Mugondo se wa Muhondogo sekuruza w'ubwoko Abahondogo (Bategetse u Bugesera),
Ndetse na Nyirarucyaba umukuramberekazi w'ubwoko bw'Abacyaba (Bategekaga Ingoma y'u Bugara).
Gihanga yarongoye kandi Nyangobero ukomoka mu Bunyabungo (Intara ya Kivu y'Amajyepfo) barabyarana Kanyabungo Ngabo waje gutegeka mu Bunyabungo ndetse arongora na Nyirampirangwe babyarana Gashubi se wa Gashingo ukomokwaho n'abitwa Abashingo ndetse ngo babyarana n'undi mwana witwa Gafomo.
Gihanga yari afite undi mugore w'inshoreke witwaga Nyirarutsobe babyarana Rutsobe umukurambere w'abo mu bwoko bw'Abatsobe.

Nyamulagira (Nyamuragira).
Nyamulagira ni ikirunga kinini giherereye mu gihugu cya DRC mu muri kivu y'amajyaruguru Hafi y'umujyi wa Goma kikaba kikibarirwa mu birunga bikiruka (ibyo bita Active Volcanoes) kikaba gifite Metero ibihumbi bitatu na mirongo itanu n'umunani z'ubutumburuke (3058 m)
Igihe Giherukira Kuruka.
Mu birometero cumi na bitanu mu burengerazuba bw'ikiyaga cya Kivu (15Km) hafi y'umujyi wa Goma Uherereye Muntara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru,Mu Gihugu cya DRC

Umugore w'umwirabura uzwiho kuyobora ingabo ari Umugore zitwa Marone zigatsinda ingabo z'Abongereza Umukecuru wa(c.1686-c.1760) bivugwa ko Nanny yavutse ahagana mu 1686, yayoboye ingabo z'abirabura bari barajyanywe mubucakara bitwaga Windward Maroons agatsida ingabo z'abongereza baba kolonizaga mu misoz ya Jamaica mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 18. Ku buyobozi bwa Nanny, Windward Maroons yarwanye intambara y'inyeshyamba irwanya nAbongereza, izwi ku izina rya mbere rya Maroon, yamaze imyaka myinshi. Umwamikazi Nanny' yavukiye muri Gana y'ubu, izwi ku izina rya Gold Coast. Inkuru zimwe zishimangira ko Nanny atigeze aba Umucakara, ariko birashoboka ko yahunze uburetwa nyuma gato yo kugera muri Jamayike.
Ibindi bizwi kuri Queen Nanny.
Ni ukuba yari afite imbaraga zidasanzwe, n'imitekerereze iri hejuru byamufashaga gutsinda Ingabo z'Abongereze Mu birwa bya Jamayica,
Kuba yaratsitse abongereza kugeza aho abasinyisha amasezerano y'amahoro mu
ubu Ifoto ya Queen nany igaragara ku inote (Amafranga) ya Jamaica Nk'Intwari yabo.

kururwo rutare kandi hariho ikirenge cyuwo mwami,amajanja y'imbwa ye ndetse nahandi hantu hadasanze ufata ibuye wakomangaho hakavuga nkingoma.

Group Scolaire Gaseke.
GS Gaseke ni ikigo kimwe mubigo bigize igihugu cy'u Rwanda giherereye mu karere ka Gicumbi, mu murenge wa Mutete, Akagari ka Gaseke,Umudugudu w'Irasaniro.Iki kigo kiri k'umuhanda Kigali -Gatuna mu gihe cy'iminota 30 uturutse muri gare ya Nyabugogo uba ugeze kuri iki kigo. Gs Gaseke ni ikigo kigisha neza kandi mungeri zose, gifite amashuri y'inshuke, amashuri abanza, na mashuri yisumbuye. mu amashuri yisumbuye gifite ishami rya MCE:(Mathematics, Computer science and Economics).
IBINDI TWAMENYA KURI GS GASEKE
GS Gaseke ni ikigo gikunda kwitabira amarushanwa nka, school business club competition, school business plan pitch competition and First Legal League competion(FLL) atangwa na REB n'abafatanyabikorwa bayo. GS Gaseke ni ikigo cyambere cyahawe murandasi(Internet) yihuta yo mu bwoko bwa starlink kiyihawe na TONY BLAIR, kandi bya cyongereye ubushobozi ubu kiri k'urwego rwo kwakira amahugurwa atandukanye abera mu akarere, gufasha abaturage n'ibindi bigo by'amashuri bigituriye gukoresha internet.ibi bikaba bituma cyarabaye ishuri ry'indashyikirwa(SCHOOL OF EXCELLENT).

Urwunge rw'amashuri rwa Nyinawimana ni ikigo giherereye mu ntara y'Amajyaruguru mu Karere ka Gicumbi Umurenge wa Nyamiyaga mu Kagari ka Kiziba. Kikaba gifite abanyeshuri bose hamwe barenga 2800 kikaba cyarashizwe mu 1960. Kilizi ya Nyinawimana)abanyeshuri basengeramo kikaba ari ikigo gitanga uburere bunoze kikaba gitsindisha k'urwego rwo hejuru kandi kikaba gifite n'ibyumba cy'abakobwa abagize ikibazo bafashirizwamo, ikindi gifite igikone batekeramo gifite isuku kandi kitegereye abanyeshuri ku buryo kitababangamira bigatuma biga neza bakanatsinda neza k'urwego rushimishije.
Groupe Scolaire Nyinawimana.
Groupe Scolaire Nyinawimana ni ikigo cy'amashuri giherereye mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Iyo bavuze Nyinawinana wumva Bikiramariya;ariko mu karere ka Gicumbi mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru hari umusozi witwa Nyinawimana hakaba ariho habarizwa iki kigo. Ariko padiri NDAYAMBAJE Ildophonse akavuga ko uyu musozi bakunda kuwita " Mugisaninzu" kubera ibicu bikunda kuba bihabuditse. Nyuma haje gushingwa paruwasi Nyinawimana tariki ya mbere ugushyingo 1960.Ubu rero iki kigo gifite ibyumba by'amashuri birenga mirongo itatu harererwamo abahungu n'abakobwa;Abanyehuri barenga ibihumbi bitatu ndetse n'abarimu barenga mirongo inani.Iki kigo gifite ibyiciro bitatu byamashuri aribyo amashuri y'inshuke (nursery),abanza primary ndetse n'ayisumbuye agabanyijemo ibyiciro bitatu aribyo indimi,amateka n'ubumenyi bw'isi. Cyashinzwe mu mwaka w'igihumbi kimwe magana kenda mirongo itandatu(1960).
Ni ishuri rya kiliziya Gatolika, rikaba ryararagijwe mutagatifu Fransisiko Xaverikikaba gifite umuyobozi witwa SEBAHIRE Deogratius ariwe deregiteri. Nyinawimana ni ikigo kinini cyane. Gihuriraho abayeshuri benshi, ikindi kandi iki kigo gikorana n'imishinga myinshi. Ari avs, cartas ndetse n'iyindi myinshi.Ikindi Kandi iyi mishinga ifasha abanyeshuri benshi bagatsinda bishimishije. Amakuru mashya ahari ubu nuko iki kigo kitakiyoborwa na SEBAHIRE ahubwo biravurwa ko derigiteri yahinduwe

IMODOKA ZIKORESHA AMASHANYARAZI MU RWANDA
Murwego rwo kugabanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere, mu Rwanda hasigaye hakoreshwa imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi, nubwo bitaraba 100%.
Imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi zirimo ubwoko bwinshi ariko harimo iyitwa CADILLAC LYRQ, iyi modoka ikoresha amashanyarazi 100%.
Imwe mumodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi.

Umurenge wa Byumba ni umwe mu mirenge 21 igize Akarere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Muri uyu murenge harimo igice kinini cy'umujyi wa Byumba.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Byumba wari utuwe n'abaturage 43 134. Abaturage 19 270 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 23 864 batuye mu cyaro.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Byumba wari utuwe n'abaturage 36 401. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 43 134. Abagabo bari 20 372. Abagore bari 22 762.
Abaturage 19 270 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 23 864 batuye mu cyaro. Imirenge myinshi y'Akarere ka Gicumbi ituwe n'abaturage bo mu cyaro gusa. Byumba, Kageyo na Rukomo ni yo mirenge ifite abaturage batuye mu mujyi.
Umujyi wa Byumba witwa kandi umujyi wa Gicumbi. Igice kinini cyawo kiri mu Murenge wa Byumba. Ikindi gice kiri mu Murenge wa Kaniga. Byumba ni icyicaro cya Diyosezi Gatolika ya Byumba.

Urwibutso rwa Gisozi ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali. Ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abasaga ibihumbi 250 y'abazize jenocide yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. ruherereye ku musozi wa Gisozi,urwibutso rwa Kigali ni rumwe mu zubatswe ku ikubitiro nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kuko mu 1994 aribwo umusozi wa Gisozi watoranyijwe ngo imibiri y’abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi iharuhukire. Uru rwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Gisozi, Akarere ka Gasabo. Uru rwibutso rwubatse mu rwego rwo gufasha abarokotse Jenoside n'abandi bantu bose kuzirikana ku mateka y'icyo gihe,no gukomeza kwigisha isi yose ku ngaruka zayo.
Nyuma y'ivugururwa ry'urwibutso rwo ku Gisozi Abanyarwanda barasabwa kurushaho kurusura.
Ubuyobozi bw’urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ruri ku Gisozi bufatanyije n’inshuti zarwo, basabye abanyarwanda kutirara bareka gusura inzibutso za Jenoside, kubera urwitwazo ko baba barazisuye cyangwa ko ntaho babona ho kwibukira ku Gisozi.
Umuryango mpuzamahanga wa Aegis Trust wita ku rwibutso rwo ku Gisozi, watangaje ko ibyumba byo kwigiramo ububi bwa Jenoside, ndetse n’ikibanza cyo kwicaramo, kumva no kureba ibikorwa bijyanye no kwibuka (Amphitheatre), byamaze kubakwa.
“Uru rwibutso ntirugomba guhagararira gusa ku kwerekana amateka, ahubwo twashatse ko ayo mateka [agomba kuba amateka y’isi], yaba umusingi w’ibihe byiza bizaza; niyo mpamvu hubatswe iyi ‘amphitheatre’, kuko iyo hazaga abantu barenze 1,000 baburaga aho bicara, bikaba ngombwa ko basimburana”, nk’uko umuyobozi wa Aegis Trust, Freddy Mutanguha yabitangaje.
‘Amphitheatre’ yo ku Gisozi (ikibanza kigizwe n’intebe zubatswe n’amabuye) ngo ishobora kwakira abantu bagera kuri 5,000 icyarimwe, bakareba, bakumva inyigisho, imikino n’ibindi bagezwaho n’abantu bari imbere yabo, mu gikono gikozwe mu byuma kihateretse.
Urwibutso rwo ku Gisozi ngo rugiye kubakirwa kandi ikigo mpuzamahanga kibikwamo inyandiko zivuga kuri Jenoside zagiye ziba ku isi; ku buryo ngo abavuye mu bihugu bitandukanye bajya baza kuhigira amasomo yo gukumira Jenoside n’ubundi bugome bukorerwa ikiremwamuntu, nk’uko Mutangana yabisobanuye.
Muri iki gihe abanyarwanda basura urwibutso rwo ku Gisozi ngo baragabanutse basigara batarenga 50% bavuye kuri 70% y’abazaga mu myaka ibiri ishize; ibyo bigaterwa n’uko benshi ngo biyumvisha ko basuye urwo rwibutso inshuro nyinshi, n’ubwo Mutangana ngo atirengagiza ikibazo cy’amikoro make kuri bamwe.
Abadepite Mutesi Anita na Jean Marie Vianney Gatabazi bo mu ihuriro rigize inshuti z’u rwibutso mu Nteko ishinga amategeko y’u Rwanda, bamenyesha ko kwibuka bitazigera bireka gukorwa, bagasaba abanyarwanda kutirara no kutumva ko gusura urwibutso rimwe bihagije.
“Abanyarwanda bagomba guhora baza hano gusura urwibutso, bakumva impamvu Jenoside yabaye kugirango itazongera kubaho; uretse ko hari benshi bataranasobanukirwa uko Jenoside yabaye”, Depite Mutesi.
Nyuma yo kubaka Amphitheatre ku Gisozi, abakozi ba banki za COGEBANKI na ACCESS baje kuhibukira, banatera inkunga izo nyubako zitararangira neza, aho Cogebanki yatanze ibihumbi 20 by’amadolari, Acces itanga ibihumbi 10 by’amadolari, yiyongera ku zindi nkunga izo banki zivuga ko zagiye zifashisha urwibutso rwo ku Gisozi.

DIYOSEZE GATORIKA YA BYUMBA.
diyose gatolika ya byumba(mu kilatin: dioecesis byumbanus) ni agace ka kiliziya cyangwa diyoseze ya kiliziya gatorika ya roma mu rwnda. yashinzwe kuwa 5 ugushyingo 1981 na papa yohani pawulo wa II. iyi diyosezi ni imwe mu zigize akarere k' ubutumwa ka arrikidiyosezi ya kigali.
urutonde rw' abasenyeri ba diyosezi gatolika ya byumba.
Diyosezi gaturika ya byumba igizwe n' ibice byomowe kuri diyosezi ya ruhengeri na kibungo, ifite ubuso bugera kuri kilometero kare 5100, ikaba igizwe ahanini n' igice cy' amajyaruguru y' uburasirazuba bw' u rwanda.
imbibi za diyosezi gatolika ya byumba.
diyosezi gatolika ya byumba ihana imbibi na tanzaniya mu burasirazuba n' u buganda mu majyaruguru, mu majyepfo y' uburengerazuba ihana imbibi na arikidiyosezi ya kigali naho mu burengerazuba igahana imbibi na diyosezi ya ruhengeri.
paruwasi za diyosezi gaturika ya byumba.

Dore amateka ya Shampiyona y’u Rwanda (Rwanda Premier League):
----Shampiyona y’u Rwanda n’amateka yayo
Shampiyona y’u Rwanda, izwi nka "Rwanda Premier League", yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1975. Igenzurwa n’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda (FERWAFA). Mu myaka yashize, iyi shampiyona yagize iterambere rikomeye, igaragaza impano nyinshi z’abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda ndetse ikanagira uruhare mu guteza imbere umuco w’umupira w’amaguru mu gihugu.
Amakipe yabaye ibigwi.
Hari amakipe yagaragaje ubudahangarwa muri iyi shampiyona:
Abakinnyi b’ibihe byose muri Shampiyona y’u Rwanda.
Shampiyona y’u Rwanda yakiniwe n’abakinnyi bakomeye bagaragaje ubuhanga budasanzwe:
Mu mwaka wa shampiyona wa 2023–24, APR FC yongereye ibigwi byayo yegukana igikombe cya 5 yikurikiranya, mbere y’imikino itatu ngo shampiyona irangire. Ikipe yatsinze Kiyovu SC igitego 1-0, igitego cyatsinzwe na Gilbert Mugisha.
Nanone, ikipe ya Vision FC yakoze amateka yo kuzamuka muri shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere nyuma y’imyaka 13 iri mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Ibi bigaragaza iterambere n’ubukana shampiyona y’u Rwanda igenda igira.
Shampiyona y’u Rwanda ikomeje kuba urubuga rw’ingenzi rwo kugaragaza impano z’abakinnyi no guteza imbere umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, ndetse n’icyubahiro cy’igihugu ku rwego rwa Afurika.

Arnold Kabera (yavutse mu 1989), uzwi ku izina ry'umuziki Sintex, ni umuririmbyi w'umuziki wa afro-dancehall ukomoka mu Rwanda, uzwi cyane kubera umusanzu we mu iterambere ry’umuziki w’igihugu. Ubuhanga bwe mu njyana ya dancehall bwamuhaye umwihariko mu muziki usanzwe wiganjemo hip hop, Afrobeat, na R&amp;B
Ubuzima Bwambere n’Impamvu Yamuteye Gukunda Umuziki.
Sintex yatangiye gukunda umuziki akiri muto, akurikiza abahanzi bakomeye barimo Mowzey Radio, Chris Brown, Lucky Dube, na Christopher Martin. Yatangiye umwuga w’umuziki mu buryo bw'umwuga mu 2012 nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye muri Uganda, aho yari azwi kandi nk’umubyinnyi.
Intangiriro n’Iterambere.
Mu 2012, Sintex yakoze indirimbo ye ya mbere yise "Akabazo" muri Unlimited Records. Igihe cy’ingenzi mu mwuga we cyabaye ubwo yahuraga n’umutunganyirizamusiki w’Umunya-Kenya Castello, wamuhuje n’Ikigo cy’Ubudage Goethe Institute. Bamaze kubona impano ye, umuryango w’Abadage wamuhaye ibikoresho byo muri studio, bimufasha gutangiza studio ye bwite. Ariko kuyicunga ntibyamukundiye, maze ayigurisha mu 2015.
Mu 2017, umwuga wa Sintex warushijeho gutera imbere ubwo yinjiraga muri Arthur Nation, ikigo gishinzwe gucunga abahanzi cyashinzwe na Umuvandimwe we, Arthur Nkusi, umunyarwenya akaba n’umunyamakuru. Muri iyi sosiyete, yasohoye indirimbo zakunzwe zirimo "You and I," "Icyoroshye," "Superstar," na "Twifunze." Izi ndirimbo zamufashije kwagura abafana be no kubona ibitaramo bikomeye nka Iwacu Muzika na Kigali Jazz Junction.
Mu kwa gatatu 2020, Sintex yasohoye EP (Extended Play) yitwa "My Vibes," igizwe n’indirimbo esheshatu: "Calculator," "Jangolo," "Love Story," "Friday," "Gahunda," na "Midnight Call." Yakoranye n’abatunganyirizamusiki batandukanye barimo Knox Beat, Papito, Ibalab, Bob Pro, Holybeat, na Danny Beats. Mu Ukwakira 2023, Sintex yasohoye album ye ya mbere yise "Dedication," yayituye umugore we Shadia Keza barushinze muri Kanama 2023. Iyi album irimo indirimbo esheshatu: "Dedication," "Gladiator," "Keza," "Te Quiero," "Cease Fire," na "Street," zigaragaza urukundo n’ukwizihirwa kwe.
Impinduka mu Mwuga we.
Nyuma yo gushyingiranwa, Sintex yasezeye muri Arthur Nation Ltd maze ashinga inzu ye y’umuziki yitwa "Ak High Class." Yatangaje ko iyi mpinduka yakozwe mu bwumvikane kandi igamije iterambere rye bwite no kugera ku mahirwe mashya mu ruganda rw’umuziki.
Muri Kanama 2023, Sintex yashakanye na Shadia Keza, umuhango wagize uruhare runini mu ndirimbo ze.
Umusanzu n’Icyo Avuze mu Muziki.
Urugendo rwa Sintex kuva ku mwanyenga w’imbyino kugera ku rwego rwo hejuru nk’umuririmbyi wa afro-dancehall rugaragaza ubwitange, umuhate, n’urukundo afitiye umuziki. Uburyo ahuza ubuzima bwe bwite n'ibihangano bye bikomeza gukundwa n'abakunzi b’umuziki, bimufasha kugira umwanya ukomeye mu muziki w’u Rwanda.

Ikigo cyitwa RCHC cyangwa se mu kinyarwanda ni ikigo nyarwanda cy'ubuzima bushingiye ku muco kizwi nka RCHC mu mpine, aho cyatangiye kumugaragaro muri 2011.
Ikigo nyarwanda cy'ubuzima bushingiye ku muco ni ikigo cy'ashinzwe na Rutangarwamaboko, akaba ari umugabo ukunda kuvuga ndetse no kwita ku muco nyarwanda.

Umuziki gakondo ni uruhurirane rw'ibikoresho nyarwanda bibyara umuziki urwehoheye amatwi, hakaba hari ibikoresho bigiye bitandunkanye mu rwanda byakoreshwaga mu muziki gakodo wu Rwanda wa kera.
Umuziki wagiye ukoreshwa n'ibikoresho bimwe na bimwe twavuga wenda: icyembe, iningiri, umuduri, ingoma.

"Umucyeka" ni ijambo ry'ikinyarwanda rikoreshwa mu gusobanura umwotsi cyangwa igipimo cy'umwotsi gituruka ku bintu byaka cyangwa byaka umuriro.
Akenshi, umucyeka ugaragara cyane igihe ibintu bitangiye gushya cyangwa gucana, urugero nka mu gihe bateka ku ziko cyangwa mu gihe hakoreshejwe ibikoresho byaka umuriro.
Muri rusange, "umucyeka" usobanura ibirere byuzuye umwotsi wavuye mu bintu bitarashya neza cyangwa bifite ubushyuhe butari bwiza, akaba ari na bwo buryo bwo kugaragaza ahantu hari umwotsi cyangwa aho ibintu bitangiye gucana.

Ubworozi mu Rwanda ni imwe mu mirimo y'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi igira uruhare runini mu bukungu bw'igihugu. Mu Rwanda, ubworozi bw'amatungo ni ingirakamaro mu gutanga ibiribwa, ndetse no guteza imbere ubukungu binyuze mu gukora imirimo itandukanye y'ubworozi. Ubworozi bw'amatungo mu Rwanda bukorwa ku rwego rwo hejuru, cyane cyane mu bworozi bw'inka, intama, ingurube, ndetse n'inkoko.
Ubworozi buboneka mu Rwanda.
Mu Rwanda, ubworozi buboneka butandukanye, kandi buri bworozi bufite umusaruro wihariye mu kuzamura ubukungu bw'igihugu. Dore ubworozi bukunze kuboneka mu Rwanda:
Akamaro k'ubworozi mu Rwanda.
Ubworozi bufite akamaro kanini mu buzima bw'abantu, ubukungu bw'igihugu, ndetse n'iterambere ry'imiryango. Dore bimwe mu by'akamaro bworozi bufite:
6. Iterambere Ryinganda Zikora ibikomoka ku Matungo:.
Ubworozi ni igice cy’ingenzi mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’igihugu, kandi bufasha mu guteza imbere imibereho y’abaturage mu buryo butandukanye.

Umuco gakondo w’u Rwanda ushingiye ku bumwe bw’abaturage, icyubahiro, n’imigenzo y’ubuvanganzo nyemvugo.
Abanyarwanda bafite umurage ukomeye ushingiye ku mahoro, imbyino, umuziki, ubuvanganzo, n’ubukorikori.
Dore bimwe mu bigize umuco gakondo w’u Rwanda:

Leta y'u Rwanda ikomeje gushyira imbaraga mu guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga mumashuri yose mu gihugu,aho iri gukora ibishoboka byose ngo ibigo byose byo murwanda ibigezemo interinete.Kugeza ubu mumashuri yo mucyaro ikorana buhanga riracyari ku ikigero cyohasi.Gusa ntitwakirengagizako bimwe mu ibigo byo murwanda byamaze gutangira gukoresha ikoranabuhanga.ubu murwanda iyigahunda ikorera mu bigo byo muturere twa Kirehe,Gicumbi,Gisagara,Gatsibo,karongi ndetse na Nyamagabe.

ifumbire ikomoka ahantu henshi hatandukanye aho twavuga nko kubinyabuzima,nkimibiri yaboze iragenda ikavamo ifumbire kubimera,iklindi ifumbire ishora guturuka munganda ariyo bita ifumbire mvaruganda,aho niho inganda zikora amafumbire atandukanye muburyo bwo kongera imyinyu kubimera nu budahangarwa mu butaka.

Ubusobanuro bw'umuco.
Umuco ni ibyo abantu bahuriraho kandi bemeranywaho; ni uburyo bwo gutekereza no gukora biha umuyoboro cyangwa umurongo imyitwarire y'umuntu cyangwa itsinda ry'abantu runaka;
-Umuco ugenga inzego z'imibereho y'abantu, ubuhanzi n'ubukorikori,ukwemera n'ubwenge bwabo.
-Umuco ukomatanya kandi ubumenyi bwose n'inyigisho umuntu agenda yunguka mu buzima bwe bwa muntu.
-Umuco utandukanye na kamere muntu, umuco ntuvukanwa, umuco ni imyitwarire,imitekerereze,ubumenyi,imyemerere umuntu agenda ahererekanya n'abandi bitewe n'ahantu batuye, amateka yabo n'ibibakikije.
Umuco niwo shingiro remezo ry'ubumwe bw'abenegihugu kuko bawusangiye, ukabaranga. Imibereho n'imibanire y'abantu igizwe n'ingingo nyinshi kandi zishobora gusobanurwa mmu buryo bwagutse; Abantu mumiryango yabo itandukanye babaho kandi bakabana ku buryo butandukanye bitewe n'imyemerere ndetse n'anategeko agenga umuryango wabo.
Umuryango nyarwanda ufite indangagaciro na kirazira bigenga imibereho y'abawugize, bityo gusesengura umuco mu mibereho n'imibanire yabo, bikaba byibanda kuri izo ngingo ebyiri;
Indangagaciro ni Imyitwarire ihebuje igaragaza cyangwa se iranga abantu batuye igihugu iki n'iki kandi bakayifatiraho urugero. Ni ibikorwa bishingiye ku muco byemeranijweho n'abenegihugu, bifuza ko byahora bibaranga, bikanabitirirwa uko ibihe bigenda biha ibindi.
Kirazira z'umuco w'u Rwanda ni imico cyangwa imyitwarire mibi umunyarwanda wese agomba kwirinda kandi akayirinda n'abandi, imiziririzo umunyarwanda yagendera kure kugira ngo akomeze kuba umuntu mu bandi. Kirazira ziyobora ubuzima bw'abantu, bagashishikarira iteka gukora icyiza, bikabafasha kutabangamirana.
ubutwari ni indangagaciro igaraga mu muco w'imiryango y'abantu itandukanye ituye ku isi. Mu myimvire yabatuye kwisi.Abantu benshi bafasheko risobanura risobanura Ubwitage n'ubutwari ku rugamba. Nta tandukaniro rinini n'imyumvire mu bihugu binyuranye aho ubutwari bwajyanaga no kwitanga rusha abandi ku rugamba.
Ubutwari ntibwafataga ibitsina byombi kimwe, Akenshi abagore ntibavugwaga kandi nabo hari ababaga barabaye intwari ndetse no ku rugamba. Mu Rwanda akenshi ubutwari bwagaragariraga cyanecyane mu bikorwa by'urugamba rwo kwagura no kurinda ubusugire bw'igihugu.
Mu mateka yavuba y'isi ubutwari bufatwa nko kwiyemeza gukora ikintu ugamije ineza y'abantu benshi, byaba ngombwa ukaba wabizira. Intwari ntizitinya gutanga ubuzima bwazo bitewe n'uko ziba zemera ukuri kandi zikaba ziteguye kugupfira bibaye ngombwa. Uwagaragaje ubutwari yitwa intwari, akaba umuntu ufasha abandi, akitanga by'ikirenga, atagamije inyungu cyangwa icyubahiro kivuye mu bikorwa bye.
Niba umuco usobanura nk'ibyo abantu bahuriraho kandi bemeranywaho, uburyo bwo gutekereza no gukora biha umuyoboro cyanga umurongo imyitwarire y'umuntu cyanga istinda ry'abantu, Umuco w'ubutwari wasobanurwa nk'uburyo bwo gucukumbura ibikorwa bifitiye abntu benshi akamaro, bityo buri wese agaharanira gushyira imbere inyungu rusange aho kwikunda no kwireba ubwe gusa.
Umucyo w'wubutwari ni amatwara meza abantu bumvikanaho, akabaranga mu buzima bwabo bwaburimunsi, akabaha icerekezo gihamye bagamije iterambererusange risigasiwe no gukunda igihugu bahuriyeho, kukirinda, kukirwanirira no kurenger ubuzugire bw'agagituye.
Mu Rwanda umuco w'ubutwari ugaragara mu bihe bitandukanye by'amateka y'igihugu. Amateka ya kera atwereka ko abanyarwanda bumvaga ko 'u Rwanda rutera rudaterwa' ibi biakaba byaragaragazaga icyizere bagirirana n'imbaraga n'ubutwari by'ingabo zabo.
Umuco w'ubutwari ukwiye gufatwa nko kugira icyerekezo kimwe, buri wese agatanga umusanzu we atizigama ngo icyo cyerekezo kigerweho, nta gusigana, ugize intege nke agafashwa, intego abantu bihaye bakayigereraho kugihe kandi umurimo abantu berekejeho amaboko bakawunoza uko bishoboka kose. kwanga kurwanirira igihugu kubera gutinya urupfu byari igisebo kuwabikoze, ndetse bakanamucira umugani bagiea bati;'Wanga guha amaraso igihugu, imbwa zikayanywera ubusa'.
Indangagaciro z'umuco w'ubutwari mu Rwanda.
-Umuco w'ubutwari, iyo umutu abishyizeho umwete ashobora kuwitoza. Ubutwari buturuka muri ako kamenyero ko guhitamo icyiza ukanga ikibi, ukageraho wemera guhara amagara yawe aho gutwarwa n'ikibi. Intwari iba igamije burigihe guhindura imibereho y'umuryango w'abantu iwuganisha aheza.

Umurenge wa Mutete ni umwe mu mirenge 21 igize Akarere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Mutete wari utuwe n'abaturage 27 517. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Gicumbi kagizwe n'imirenge 21. Umurenge wa Mutete ni umwe muri yo.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Mutete wari utuwe n'abaturage 23 053. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 27 517. Abagabo bari 12 960. Abagore bari 14 557.
Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.

Amaraso ni amazi yo mu mubiri atembera mu mitsi, akagira uruhare rukomeye mu mikorere y’umubiri. Akenshi agaragara afite ibara ritukura bitewe na hemoglobine iba mu uturemangingo dutukura tw'amaraso.
Amaraso afite imirimo myinshi mu mubiri, harimo:
Amatsinda y'amaraso.
Amaraso ashyirwa mu matsinda hakurikijwe ibimenyetso biboneka ku turemangingo dutukura tw’amaraso. Muri sisitemu ya ABO, hari amatsinda ane y’ingenzi:
Hari kandi sisitemu ya Rh, igaragaza niba amaraso ari Rh positif cyangwa Rh négatif.

Rutsiro ni akarere kashyizwe mu ntara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda. Ni akarere gatuwe n'abaturage benshi b'ingeri zitandukanye, kakaba gafite amateka akomeye ndetse n'ubuzima busanzwe bukomeje gutera imbere. Rutsiro ifite ibyiza by'ubutaka birimo imisozi n'ibiyaga byiza, bituma ari ahantu heza ho gusura. Uretse ibyiza by'ubutaka, Rutsiro izwi kandi ku kuba igice gikomeye mu buhinzi, aho abaturage bayo bakora ubuhinzi bw'ibinyomoro, ibirayi, imyumbati, n'ibindi.
Rutsiro ifite ibikorwa byinshi by'iterambere, harimo imishinga y'ubuhinzi no kongera umusaruro, ndetse n'uburezi butanga amahirwe ku bana b'aho. Hariho kandi ibikorwa bya leta n'abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ubuzima, ibikorwa remezo, n'ubucuruzi mu karere.
Kugeza ubu, Rutsiro irimo kugenda iterambere ryihuse, kandi igira uruhare mu buryo bwagutse mu kwigisha abaturage uburyo bwo guhangana n'ibibazo by'ubuzima, kurwanya ubukene no guharanira impinduka mu buzima bwabo.
Ibiranga Ibidukikije n'Ubukungu bwa Rutsiro
Rutsiro ni akarere kagaragara mu ntara y'Iburengerazuba y'u Rwanda, kakaba gafite ibyiza by'ubutaka n'ibikorwa by'ubukungu bitandukanye. Bimwe mu biranga ibidukikije n'ubukungu bwa Rutsiro ni ibi bikurikira:
Mu ncamake, Rutsiro ni akarere gashyigikira iterambere ry'ubukungu, abakozi b'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi, ndetse n'ubukerarugendo. Ibi byose bigira uruhare mu iterambere rihamye rya Rutsiro, kakaba ari ahantu heza ho gutura no gukora ibikorwa bitandukanye by'ubukungu
Imiterere n'Ubushobozi bw'Ubuzima bwo mu Baturage.
Mu ncamake, ubuyobozi bwa Rutsiro bugaragaza imbaraga mu kubaka umutekano, gukemura ibibazo by'iterambere, ndetse no guteza imbere imibereho myiza y'abaturage. Ubuyobozi bukomeza kubakira ku miyoborere myiza no gushyira imbere gahunda z'iterambere mu buryo bwuzuzanya na politiki za Leta.
Akarere ka Rutsiro ni ahantu heza hifitemo ibyiza byinshi by'ubutaka, ibidukikije, n'ubukungu butandukanye. Ifite imisozi ihanamye, ibiyaga bitangaje nka Kivu, ndetse n'ahantu nyaburanga hatanga amahirwe menshi y'ubukerarugendo. Abaturage ba Rutsiro bakora cyane ubuhinzi n'ubworozi, aho ibikorwa byo guhinga ibinyampeke, kawa, n'ibindi bihingwa bifite uruhare runini mu iterambere ry'akarere.
Ubuyobozi bwa Rutsiro bukora kugira ngo bubyaze umusaruro ibikorerwa mu karere, kandi bwita ku iterambere ry'imibereho myiza y'abaturage. Gahunda za Leta zijyanye n'uburezi, ubuzima, n'ibikorwaremezo zishyirwa mu bikorwa neza, bigatuma Rutsiro ikomeza gutera imbere mu buryo buhamye.
Mu buryo bw'imiyoborere, Rutsiro itanga icyerekezo cyo kugera ku ntego z'iterambere rirambye, aho ubuyobozi buharanira imiyoborere myiza, uburenganzira bw'abaturage, no guteza imbere imishinga y'iterambere. Ibi byose bituma Rutsiro iba ahantu heza ho gutura no gukora ibikorwa bitandukanye by'ubukungu, ikaba ari akarere kigaragara nk'ahazaza heza h'iterambere mu Rwanda.

AMATEKA Y'UMUPIRA MU RWANDA NO KU ISI
Amateka y'umupira w'amaguru (soccer cyangwa football mu ndimi z'amahanga) aratangaje kandi afite ibice byinshi by'ingenzi mu mateka y'uyu mukino. Uyu mukino wakurikiye undi mukino witwa "cuju" wakinwaga mu Bushinwa, ndetse hari ibindi bimenyetso byerekana ko wari warakiniwe no mu bindi bihugu. Dore amwe mu mateka akomeye:
Uyu mukino umaze gukundwa mu bihugu bitandukanye, kugeza aho umuntu wese ashobora gukurikirana imikino kuri televiziyo, ndetse ibikombe by'isi na shampiyona bituma abantu bibanda ku mupira w’amaguru mu buryo bwagutse.
UMUPIRA WA MAGURU MU RWANDA
Amateka y'umupira w'amaguru (football) mu Rwanda ni urugendo rw'ubuzima bwo gukura no guhinduka, kuva ku mukino w'abana n'ibikorwa by'abaturage kugeza ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Dore amwe mu mateka y'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda:
Uyu munsi, umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda umaze gukomera, ugaragaza impano, n'ubushake bwo gukomeza ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ndetse amakipe akomeye yo mu gihugu yitabira imikino yo ku rwego rw’akarere n’isi yose.
Akamaro ku mupira wa maguru muRwanda
Umupira w’amaguru ufite akamaro kanini ku gihugu cy’u Rwanda mu nzego zitandukanye. Ku rwego rw’igihugu, umupira w’amaguru si gusa umukino, ahubwo ni igikoresho cy’imiyoborere, ubumwe, iterambere ry’ubukungu, ndetse n’ishoramari mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Dore bimwe mu byiza by’umupira w’amaguru ku Rwanda:
Mu by'ukuri, umupira w’amaguru ni umukino ufite uruhare runini mu kubaka u Rwanda, mu guteza imbere abantu no kwereka isi ko igihugu cyacu gishoboye kandi cyashyize imbere ibikorwa by'ubufatanye, ubumwe, ndetse n’iterambere.
umupira wa maguru mu muco nyarwanda
Umupira w'amaguru ufite akamaro gakomeye mu muco Nyarwanda, aho ushyigikira ubumwe, ubufatanye, no kuganira mu buryo bworoshye. Mu Rwanda, umupira w'amaguru ntabwo ari umukino gusa, ahubwo ni igikoresho gikomeye cyo gukomeza kwimakaza umuco wo guhuriza hamwe abantu, no gushyira imbere ibyiza by'umuryango nyarwanda. Dore bimwe mu buryo umupira w’amaguru ugaragara mu muco Nyarwanda:
8. Gukora n’abafatanyabikorwa.
Mu ncamake, umupira w’amaguru mu muco nyarwanda ni urufunguzo mu guhuza abantu, kubaka igihugu gifite ubumwe, no guteza imbere imibereho myiza. Uyu mukino ugira uruhare mu gusigasira ibyiza byo mu muco w’ubufatanye, kwihesha agaciro, no kugera ku ntego y’ubuzima bwiza muri rusange.

Ubukerarugendo mukarere ka nyagatare.
Akarere ka Nyagatare kari mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, kakaba gafite amahirwe menshi mu bukerarugendo kubera ibyiza nyaburanga n'amateka bifite. Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ubukerarugendo, hatangijwe ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo gusura ahantu nyaburanga.
Mu mwaka wa 2019, habaye inama nyunguranabitekerezo ku iterambere ry'ubukerarugendo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, aho Nyagatare yagaragaje ko ifite ahantu henshi ho kwitabwaho hakabyazwa umusaruro mu rwego rw'ubukerarugendo.
Nyagatare kandi ni umwe mu mijyi yunganira Kigali, aho mu myaka yashize hatashywe ibikorwa by'iterambere birimo imihanda ya kaburimbo n'ahandi hantu nyaburanga, bigamije guteza imbere ubukerarugendo.
Muri rusange, Akarere ka Nyagatare gafite byinshi byiza byo gutemberera, harimo ahantu nyaburanga, ibikorwa by'ubukerarugendo, ndetse n'umuco w'abaturage, byose bigamije gukurura ba mukerarugendo no guteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu karere.

Umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda ni umwe mu mikino ikundwa cyane, ndetse ukaba ufite amateka n'iterambere byihariye. Uyu mukino ugaragaza uruhare runini mu muryango nyarwanda, ndetse ugira ingaruka nziza ku muco, imibereho, n'ubukungu bw'igihugu. Dore amakuru arambuye kuri umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda:
10. Ibikorwa byo Kwiga no Kuzamura Abakinnyi:.
U Rwanda rufite gahunda nyinshi zo gufasha abakinnyi bato gukomeza kwiga, ariko no kugera ku nzozi zabo zo gukina ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

URUGERERO ni ijambo mu Kinyarwanda risobanura "umuhango" cyangwa "igikorwa cy'imyitozo" gikunze gukorwa mu gihe cy'amahugurwa, imyitozo ngororamubiri, cyangwa ibikorwa by'imyifatire muri rusange. Akenshi, urugerero rukoreshwa mu gihe cyo kwigisha cyangwa kwimenyereza ibikorwa runaka mu muryango cyangwa mu itsinda..
Urugerero kandi rishobora gukoreshwa mu bisobanuro by’ibikorwa byo kwitegura, nko mu ngabo cyangwa mu mashuri, aho abanyeshuri cyangwa abasirikare bakora imyitozo yo kongera ubumenyi cyangwa gukora neza mu gihe cy'akazi katoranyijwe.
Muri rusange, "urugerero" ni igikorwa cyo kwimenyereza ibintu bishya cyangwa gukorana na bagenzi bawe kugira ngo ubyige cyangwa witegure gukora neza.
Mu Kinyarwanda, "urugerero" rikoreshwa cyane mu bikorwa byo kwitegura, cyane cyane mu mashuri cyangwa mu ngabo. Ibikorwa bikorwa mu rugerero birimo:
Mu ncamake, urugerero ni igihe cyo kwimenyereza cyangwa gukora imyitozo kugira ngo umuntu cyangwa itsinda rizabashe gukora neza no kugera ku ntego zashyizweho.

UBUMWE BWABANYARWANDA.
Ubwumvikane n'Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda: Inzira yo Gukira Amateka no Kubaka Ejo Hazaza.
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda ni ikintu cy’ingenzi cyane mu mibereho y’abaturage b’u Rwanda. U Rwanda rwanyuze mu bihe bikomeye, ariko nyuma y’ibyo bihe by'amateka, ubumwe bw'abanyarwanda bwabaye urufunguzo rwo kubaka igihugu gishya cyiza, gikomeje gutera imbere. Ibi byose byatangiriye ku kwimakaza imiyoborere myiza, kurwanya amacakubiri, no guha agaciro umuco w’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge.
Amateka y'Ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda bwatangiriye mu gihe cy’amateka yagiye agira ingaruka zikomeye ku gihugu, zirimo urugomo, intambara, n'amacakubiri. Jenoside yo mu 1994 niyo yateye ishyano rikomeye mu gihugu, aho Abanyarwanda benshi bagiye bahura n’ibibazo bikomeye byo gutakaza ababo no gusiga ibyiza byabo. Nyuma ya Jenoside, igihugu cyahuye n'ikibazo gikomeye cyo kongera guhuza abanyarwanda, gusana imitima yangiritse, no kubaka umubano w’abaturage nyuma y’ubwiyunge.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, leta y'u Rwanda yagiye ikora ibishoboka byose mu gushakira abanyarwanda uburyo bwo gusana ibikomere, gushyira imbere ubumwe, ndetse no kubaka igihugu gifite indangagaciro zikomeye zo guharanira amahoro n’ubumwe. Gahunda ya "Ubwiyunge" yashyizweho hagamijwe gusubiza agaciro abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside, ndetse no guhindura uburyo abantu batekerezaga ku byaha byakozwe. Ikintu cy’ingenzi muri ubu buryo ni ugushyira imbere imyumvire ya “u Rwanda ni igihugu kimwe” aho abantu basabwe kubana mu mahoro no gushyira imbere ibyiza by’ubumwe.
Ibikorwa by'Ubwiyunge
Ubwiyunge bwasaga nk’inzira y’agahinda n’amarangamutima menshi. Ibi byashoboraga kuzamura ibibazo mu baturage, ariko leta y’u Rwanda n’amashyirahamwe akomeye yashyizeho gahunda z’ubwiyunge, zigasaba abanyarwanda ko bemera ibibazo byashize, ko bagomba gukora ibikorwa byo gusana ubuzima bwabo no kubana mu buryo bufite icyerekezo cyiza. Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali na Ibiro by’Umuryango w’Abibumbye byagize uruhare runini mu guhuza abantu, kuganira ku byahise, no gufasha abanyarwanda gukira imitima yabo.
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda buturuka mu mico gakondo y’igihugu, aho abantu basangiraga ibyiza n’ibikorwa by’umuco. Urugero, Imbyino za Kinyarwanda, Amateka y'imiyoborere ndetse n’Imikino gakondo bigaragaza imbaraga zo guhuza abantu n’ibyo bakunda byabo. Ibi byose bifasha abanyarwanda gukomeza kubaka igihugu gitera imbere, aho abantu bita ku mico yabo, ariko banaharanira ubumwe n'amahoro.
Inshingano ya buri Munyarwanda
Buri munyarwanda afite inshingano yo kurwanya ivangura, gukomeza guharanira ubumwe, no gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba z’iterambere rirambye. Ibi bituma ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda bukomeza kuba imbaraga nyamukuru z’igihugu. Ibikorwa byo kubaka ibikorwa remezo, guteza imbere uburezi, ubuzima, n'ubukungu byose bigamije guhuza abanyarwanda no kubasubiza icyizere cy’ejo hazaza heza.
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda ku Isi
Ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda ntibwibanda gusa ku gihugu imbere, ahubwo no ku rwego mpuzamahanga, abanyarwanda babaye urufunguzo rw'ubumwe mu bihugu byinshi. Kuri uyu munsi, u Rwanda ni igihugu gikomeye ku rwego rw'isi, gifite ijambo mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga amahoro no gufasha ibihugu biri mu ntambara gukemura amakimbirane. Imyitwarire y'abanyarwanda, aho bashyira imbere ubumwe, guharanira amahoro, n’ubufatanye, byabaye isomo rikomeye ku isi yose.
Icyerekezo cy’Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda bugomba gukomeza kugira uruhare mu kubaka igihugu gitekanye, cyubahiriza uburenganzira bwa muntu, kandi kigamije iterambere rirambye. Buri munyarwanda agomba kugira uruhare mu gukomeza kubaka ubumwe, kurwanya icyatuma igihugu gikomeza kubona ibibazo, no guharanira iterambere ku nyungu z’abaturage bose.
Ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda si ikintu gishobora kugerwaho mu gihe gito, ahubwo ni urugendo rukomeje, rufite intego yo gukira no gusana ibyahise. Iyo abantu bagize uruhare mu kubaka ubumwe, igihugu kiba cyiza, kizewe, kandi kigatera imbere. Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda ni ishingiro ry’amahoro, kandi ni igikoresho gikomeye mu kubaka ejo hazaza heza mu gihugu.
Icyerekezo cy'Ubwiyunge mu Muryango Nyarwanda.
Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda ni imbaraga zikomeye zishobora kubaka igihugu kiza. U Rwanda rwagiye rugira ibihe bikomeye, ariko ubu ni igihugu gikomeye mu karere no ku isi kubera guharanira ubumwe, amahoro, n'ubwiyunge. Mu bihe by'ahazaza, ubumwe bukomeza kuba ishingiro ry’ubwiyunge ndetse n’iterambere rirambye.
Byose biri ku murongo w’ubufatanye, kwihanganirana, n’iterambere rirambye, aho abantu bose bafite umutima wo kubaka igihugu kibereye buri wese, kikaba giteye imbere.

5. Inyandiko y'Ishusho.
"Abanyarwanda ni abanyamahoro, abanyarwanda ni abanyacyubahiro. Turi abanyarwanda, dusobanura ishema ryacu mu mico"", mu bumwe, no mu kwihangana."

"Uburakari" ni ijambo ry'ikinyarwanda risobanura "anger" cyangwa "uburakari" mu Cyongereza. Ni uburyo umuntu yumva afite umujinya cyangwa atishimiye ikintu runaka. Uburakari bushobora kuvuka bitewe n'ibintu bitandukanye, nk'ibyakomerekeje umutima cyangwa ibitagenda neza.
Uburakari ni imwe mu myitwarire igomba kwitonderwa, kuko bushobora gutera ingaruka mbi mu mibanire n'abandi, bityo ni byiza kubufata neza no kubumenya kugira ngo umuntu abubashe kugenzura.

Amateka y’ururimi rw'Ikinyarwanda ni umwihariko w’ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda, kuko urwo rurimi rwagiye rukoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi kandi rufite agaciro gakomeye mu muco n’amateka y’igihugu. Ikinyarwanda ni ururimi rw'Abanyarwanda rwemewe n'amateka, kikaba kimwe mu ndimi z'ibanze mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda.
1. Ikinyarwanda n'uburyo bw'ikivugwa:.
Ikinyarwanda ni ururimi rw’umuryango w’indimi z’I-Bantu, bityo kikaba gifitanye isano n’izindi ndimi zo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba nka Kiswahili, Kirundi, n'izindi. Ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda rufite ibintu bibiri by'ingenzi byihariye:
2. Imiterere y’Ururimi rw'Ikinyarwanda:.
Ikinyarwanda kigizwe n'inyito, imvugo n’amagambo ashingiye ku migenzo ya kera. Hari ibintu byinshi bitandukanye bigize ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda harimo:
3. Amahame y’imvugo:.
Ururimi rw'Ikinyarwanda rugira imiterere y'inyito, aho amagambo agira inkomoko mu kinyarwanda gisanzwe. Ururimi rw’ikinyarwanda ni ururimi rutanga umuco ndetse rukubiyemo ubumenyi bw’ikirere n’aho u Rwanda rwavuye.
4. Ikinyarwanda n’amateka ya Politiki:.
Mu gihe cy’amateka y'igihugu cy’u Rwanda, ururimi rw’ikinyarwanda rwagiye rukoreshwa nk'uburyo bwo gusakaza ubutumwa, cyane mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Nyuma ya Jenoside, gukoresha ikinyarwanda byahindutse ikimenyetso cyo kongera kubaka ubumwe bw'abanyarwanda. Ikinyarwanda cyahindutse ururimi rw'umwimerere rwerekana icyizere mu muryango.
5. Ikinyarwanda mu Mico n'Imigenzo:.
Ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda rukoreshwa cyane mu mico n'imigenzo y’Abanyarwanda. Ni ururimi rukoresha ibimenyetso, ibitwenge, ibivugo, ndetse n'imigani ya kera kugira ngo umuco wabo wiyongere kandi urusheho gusakara. Indirimbo, imihango y'ubukwe, n'ubundi busabane byose bikunze kugenda bibumbatiye ururimi rw’ikinyarwanda nk'igikoresho cy’imvugo.
6. Ikibazo cy'ururimi mu bihugu bituranyi:.
Nubwo ururimi rw’Ikirarwanda ari rufite imvugo yihariye, rufite isano kandi n’ururimi rw'Ikinyarwanda. Gukoresha ikinyarwanda mu gihugu cy’u Rwanda, Kirundi mu Burundi ndetse no mu mashuri byagize ingaruka nziza ku buryo bwo kumva ibijyanye n’ibisobanuro n’amateka.
7. Inzira zo Kubungabunga Ikinyarwanda:.
Mu Rwanda, harimo gahunda yo kubungabunga ururimi rw'Ikinyarwanda. Ubu ururimi rw’Ikinyarwanda rwigishwa mu mashuri ndetse rukaba rukoreshwa mu buryo bwemewe mu itangazamakuru ndetse n'ibikorwa bya leta. Gusa, hari ikibazo cy'ihinduka ry’ururimi mu gihe cyagiye kigaragara cyane mu bihugu bitandukanye.
Ikinyarwanda ni ururimi rw’agaciro gakomeye mu muco, mu mibanire ndetse no mu bigo by'amashuri muri Rwanda.

Amateka y’ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda ni umwihariko w’ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda, kuko urwo rurimi rwagiye rukoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi kandi rufite agaciro gakomeye mu muco n’amateka y’igihugu. Akarere ka Nyagatare mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba kagiye kagaragaza iterambere mu bikorwa remezo mu myaka yashize. Muri byo, hatashywe Stade y'Akarere ka Nyagatare ifite agaciro ka miliyari hafi 10 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda, ikaba ifite ibibuga bitandukanye birimo umupira w'amaguru, volleyball, basketball, tennis, n'ahabera imikino ngororamubiri.
Mu rwego rw'imihanda, hubatswe umuhanda wa Rukomo-Nyagatare ureshya na kilometero 73, watwaye miliyoni 73.5 z'amadorali ya Amerika.
Byongeye kandi, ibikorwa byo kubaka ibiraro birimo icya Mirama-Rurenge, cyatwaye miliyoni 360 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda, bigamije koroshya ubuhahirane mu karere.
Mu rwego rw'uburezi, hubatswe ibiro bishya by'Akagari ka Bwera bifite ibyumba bitanu byo gukoreramo n'ibyumba bibiri binini bya salle z'inama, bigamije kunoza serivisi z'ubuyobozi no korohereza abaturage.
Ubuyobozi bw'Akarere buvuga ko ibikorwa remezo byabaye imbarutso y'iterambere, kandi busaba abaturage kubyaza umusaruro ibyo bikorwa no kubungabunga ibyagezweho.
Mu rwego rwo gukomeza guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo, umuyobozi w'Akarere yasabye abaturage kugira uruhare mu kubungabunga ibi bikorwa no kubibyaza umusaruro, kugira ngo bifashe mu kwihutisha iterambere ry'akarere.

Pariki ya Nyungwe ni imwe muri pariki zikomeye kandi z'ingenzi mu Rwanda, ikaba izwi cyane cyane kubera ubwiza bw'urusobe bw'ibinyabuzima(inyamaswa n'ibimera) biyibonekamo.
Amakuru arambuye kuri pariki y'igihugu ya Nyungwe:
Pariki y'igihugu ya Nyungwe iherereye mu ntara y Uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda,mu turere twa Rusizi,Nyamasheke, Karongi, no mu ntara y'amajyepfo mu turere twa Nyaruguru na Nyamagabe. Iyi pariki kandi ihana urubibi na pariki ya Kibira yo mu gihugu cy'Uburundi. Pariki y'igihugu ya Nyungwe ifite ubuso bugera kuri kirometero kare igihumbi na makumyabiri (1,020 km²)

Umurenge wa Kageyo ni umwe mu mirenge 21 igize Akarere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru, mu Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Kageyo wari utuwe n'abaturage 20 888.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Kageyo ni umwe mu mirenge 21 y'Akarere ka Gicumbi. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Kageyo wari utuwe n'abaturage 30 270. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 20 888. Abagabo bari 9 887. Abagore bari 11 001. Abaturage 6 646 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 14 242 batuye mu cyaro.

Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Kabare wari utuwe n'abaturage 40 228.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Kabare ni umwe mu mirenge 12 y'Akarere ka Kayonza. Ufite ubuso bwa km² 110,7.
