IBIKORWA REMEZO MU KARERE KA RULINDO
Rulindo: Hatashywe ibikorwa remezo byatwaye miliyoni zirenga 730 Frw mu kwishimira Kwibohora.
Yanditswe na ISHIMWEngabo victory
Kuya 4 July 2022 saa 08:07
Mu bikorwa remezo bishimira harimo Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Cyinzuzi kiri mu Murenge wa Cyinzuzi wari usigaye mu Karere utagira ikigo nderabuzima. Cyatwaye 495 802 359 Frw, kikazajya cyakira abaturage barenga 24900 bo mu Mirenge ya Cyinzuzi, Ntarabana na Masoro.
Hari n’ibiraro bibiri byo mu kirere birimo ikiri ku mugezi wa Rusine gihuza Imirenge ya Ntarabana na Masoro, n’ikiri ku Mugezi wa Gisagayandi gihuza Imirenge ya Rukozo muri Rulindo na Miyove muri Gicumbi. Byatwaye agera kuri miliyoni 240 Frw.
Ibi biraro bije gukemura ibibazo by’uko mu gihe cy’imvura iyo migezi yuzuraga igatuma abanyeshuri basiba amasomo, abandi bakarara badatashye kubera kubura aho banyura cyangwa bagataha bakerewe, n’ibibazo by’imigenderanire y’iyo mirenge.
Bamwe mu batuye miri iyo mirenge yahawe ibikorwa remezo, bavuga ko bari babinyotewe kandi bigiye kubafasha mu kwihutisha iterambere ry’imibereho yabo.
Mutuyimana Marie Chantal, Umujyanama w’Ubuzima mu Mudugudu wa Kavumu yagize ati "Ubundi mbere igihe twakeneraga kwivuza byadusabaga gutega moto ya 3000 Frw ijya i Remera, urumva no kugaruka byasabaga 6000 Frw."
"Byagiye bitugiraho ingaruka kuko wasangaga hari ababyeyi babyarira mu nzira, ndetse mbere hari n’ababyaraga abana bapfuye. Hari n’abantu biganyiraga kujya kwa muganga ugasanga barembeye mu ngo. Ubu hano ni hafi, na nijoro umuntu yakwizana n’amaguru. Turashimira Leta n’abayobozi bacu batwitayeho, kuko ubu tugiye kwibohora tumeze neza nta kibazo cy’ubuzima dufite."
Nshimyumuremyi Christophe we yagize ati "Turabatumye mudutumikire mutubwirire Umubyeyi wacu Perezida Paul Kagame muti ’Kisaro waratubohoye, uduha umutekano, uduha iterambere turagushimiye n’ingabo uyoboye n’abayobozi mukorana. Tukuri inyuma ntituzatenguka ubu twambariye urugamba rwo kwiteza imbere dufatanyije’."
Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rulindo, Mukanyirigira Judith, yasabye abaturage gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo bahawe no gukunda umurimo.
Yagize ati "Ibi byose mwahawe ni urukundo Umukuru w’Igihugu abakunda kandi ahora abifuriza ubuzima bwiza n’iterambere. Ni ahanyu rero kubifata neza no kubibyaza umusaruro kugira ngo tumushimire ibyaza yaduhaye."
Yanabashishikarije gutanga umusanzu mu kwivuza ku gihe, gukora bakiteza imbere no gukomeza ubufatanye mu kubungabunga umutekano kuko ari byo nzira yo kwibohora nyakuri.
Buri mwaka u Rwanda rwizihiza umunsi mukuru wo Kwibohora kuwa 4 Nyakanga, Abanyarwanda bakishimira ibyo bamaze kugeraho mu ngeri zitandukanye zirimo ubukungu, imibereho myiza, umutekano, iterambere n’ibindi.
IBYO WAMENYA KU BIKORWA REMEZO
Ibyo wamenya ku bikorwa remezo Miss Muheto yagonze.
Yanditswe na Nsengiyumva Emmy
Kuya 30 October 2024 saa 10:32
Kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 29 Ukwakira 2024, ni bwo Polisi y’u Rwanda yanyujije ubutumwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo igaragaza ko dosiye ya Miss Muheto yamaze gushyikirizwa ubushinjacyaha.
Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze Polisi yagize iti “Polisi iramenyesha ko Miss Muheto Divine yafashwe kubera gutwara ikinyabiziga yanyoye ibisindisha birengeje igipimo, kandi nta ruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga agira, kugonga no kwangiza ibikorwa remezo, hamwe no guhunga nyuma yo kugonga.”
Nyuma y’uko Polisi isohoye iri tangazo, benshi basakaje amafoto agaragaza ubwo Miss Muheto yakoraga impanuka mu gihe cyashize akagonga inzu, nyamara kuri iyi nshuro ntabwo ari yo yari yagonze.
Mu gushaka kumenya amakuru yimbitse kuri iyi mpanuka, IGIHE yamenye ko Miss Nshuti Muheto Divine yakoze ibi byaha hagati yo ku wa 18-20 Ukwakira 2024.
Uyu mukobwa wambitswe ikamba rya Miss Rwanda mu 2022, amakuru yizewe ahamya ko yakoreye impanuka ku muhanda uva Kicukiro ugana i Remera ahahoze Alpha Palace, kuri sitasiyo ya lisansi.
Mu gukora impanuka, uyu mukobwa wari wasomye kuri ka manyinya yisanze yagonze umukindo ndetse n’ipoto y’amashanyarazi, ibivuze ko yagonze ibikorwa remezo bibiri. Nyuma yo kugonga, uyu mukobwa ukiri muto yagerageje guhunga ngo atabazwa kuri aya mahano.
Gusa nyuma yo guta imodoka ye, Miss Nshuti Muheto Divine yaje gutega indi agaruka kureba uko ikibazo kimeze ari na bwo yahise atabwa muri yombi, aza gukorerwa dosiye ikaba yamaze kugezwa mu Bushinjacyaha.

Umurenge wa Gahini ni umwe mu mirenge igize Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Uri hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Muhazi.
Mu 2022, uyu murenge wari utuwe n'abaturage 46 009. Gahini ifite ibitaro binini. Ni n'icyicaro cya Diyosezi ya Gahini y'Itorero Angilikani ry'u Rwanda.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Gahini ufite ubuso bwa km² 201,7. Agace ka Gahini kari ku musozi, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 520. Kari hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Muhazi.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Gahini wari utuwe n'abaturage 32 650. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 46 009. Abagabo bari 22 449. Abagore bari 23 560. Abaturage 38 092 batuye mu cyaro. Abaturage 7 917 batuye mu mujyi.
Umuryango w'abamisiyoneri Church Missionary Society (CMS) wahisemo Gahini. Wahubatse ivugabutumwa, ibitaro n'amashuri. Muganga Joe Church yatangiye imirimo y'ubuvuzi i Gahini nyuma ya 1927. Ububyutse bwo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ("East African Revival") bwagaragaye bwa mbere i Gahini.
Uyu munsi, Gahini ni icyicaro cya Diyosezi ya Gahini y'Itorero Angilikani ry'u Rwanda.
Ibitaro bya Gahini byashinzwe na CMS. Ni bimwe mu bitaro binini by'Intara y'Iburasirazuba. Bitanga serivisi zo kubyaza no kubaga amagufa. Bivura kandi virusi itera SIDA n'indwara z'amaso. Bifite ikigo cyita ku bafite ubumuga.
Inkombe y'Ikiyaga cya Muhazi ni ahantu nyaburanga h'ingenzi. Seeds of Peace Centre na Jambo Beach bisurwa n'abakerarugendo. Benshi bahahagarara bajya cyangwa bava muri Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera. Bakora ingendo mu bwato, uburobyi no kureba inyoni.

"UMUCO" ni ijambo ryo mu Kinyarwanda risobanura "culture" mu Cyongereza. Mu buryo rusange, umuco ureshya n'uburyo abantu babana, ibyo bemera, imigenzo yabo, imyemerere, ibiribwa, imyambarire, indirimbo, imivugo, n'ibindi bikorwa bigize ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw'umuryango cyangwa igihugu. Mu Kinyarwanda, "umuco" ugira uruhare runini mu kubaka ubumwe bw'abenegihugu n'ubusabane bwabo..
Hari ibice byinshi by'umuco, birimo:
Muri make, umuco ni uburyo abantu bagira isano n'ubuzima, urwego rwabo rwa sosiyete, ndetse n'imiryango yabo.
Ibyino ni ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro cyangwa umuco w’imvugo n’imibyinire, aho abantu bibyina mu buryo bwihariye, bishimisha kandi bigaragaza ibitekerezo, amarangamutima, cyangwa amateka. Ibyino ni kimwe mu bigize umuco w’abantu kandi byaba mu bice bitandukanye by’isi, buri gace k'isi kigira uburyo bwabwo bwo kubyina, hagendewe ku migenzo, amateka, cyangwa ibihe byihariye by'aho..
Mu muco Nyarwanda, hari ibyino byihariye, harimo:
Ibyino ni kimwe mu buryo bwiza bwo kugaragaza no gusigasira umuco w’igihugu cyangwa sosiyete, bikanatuma abantu barushaho kumva umuco wabo, bakanawusangiza abandi.

Inkwano ni kimwe mu bintu umuryango w'umuhungu ubasaba umugeni utanga kugirango bamuhe umugeni mu muco w'abanyrwanda. Inkwano zabaga zirimo amako atandukanye, nubwo habagaho umugeni w'ubuntu ariko inka nicyo kintu cy'apimirwagaho inkwano zitangwa.
Inka zitegura kwima.
ni inkwano yatangwaga ku muryango w'umukobwa aho zabaga ari inyana z'inka za majigija ariko zitegura kwima noneho ikabyarira rimwe n'umugeni b'azikoye.
inka b'ankwagamo umugeni ariko w'abyari iwabo cy'angwa watandukanye n'umugabo gusa yarabyaye bitanyuze mu muco nyarwanda.
Inka umunani cyangwa ijana n'izazo.
Inka mu nani cyangwa ijana n'izazo zabaga ari inka bakoye umugore wari utuzwe n'undi mugabo bakamukurayo maze agasabwa mu rundi rugo, kuko yishimiwe kandi akuzwe bakamwita umugore wasumbakaje.
Isuka nayo yari inkwano yazaga mbere kugirango izage guhingira ubwatsi inka zizarya, mu muco n'amateka yu Rwanda Isuka yafatwaga nk'inkwano aho yatanganga amasuka 10 angana n'inka.
Gutenda byakorwaga n'umusore washakaga gukwa umukobwa ariko akaba nta kwano afite, rero akajya kwa sebukwe akabakorera akazi mugihe bumvikanye maze yakarangiza bakamuha umukobwa wabo.

Itabi ni kimwe mu bintu bigaragara mu bintu biza mu muco nyarwanda, ndetse bifite umumaro cyane kuko ry'afashaga abantu benshi mu kazi kabo kaburi munsi, harimo arinnyaga bagiye ku rugambo, itabi barikoreshaga bagiye kuragira, itabi kandi barikoreshaga bashaka nkiyongeramo akanyabugabo.

Incyamuro ni igikoresho cyakoreshaga cyane mu muco nyarwandaikaba ari igikoresho cy'ifashishwaga mugukora ibikorwa bitandukanye harimo umuvure cyngwa se isekuru mu giti cyitwa umuko cyangwa se umuvumu, ndetse incyamuro bafashaga mu gukora inkongoro cyangwa se imbehe.

Urunana ni kimwe mubikoresho by'akera bigaragara mu umuco nyarwanda, rukaba rwari rumwe mu bikoresho byakoreshaga mu buhinzi cyangwa se ubuhinzi, ubundi Urunani ni umuhoro wu bungubu. Urunani rwabaga rwihese ku mutwe warwo,ahagana hagati hakaba ariho hari ubugi hatyaye.

Muri buri stinda ry'abantu, Imiryango ndetse n'ibihugu usanga bagira ibintu bibahuza ndetse bikaba umwihariko wabo,ibyo bikabatandukanya n'abandi ndetse ugasanga aribyo bibagira abo baribo.
Aha ushobora gusanga mo byinshi birimo nk'ururimi rubahuza, imico itandukanye nimirire ndetse n'imyambarire. Kumugabane w'afurika ndetse no m'u Rwanda by'umwihariko, ibyo uranihasanga bikaba birimo Imigani migufi, aho ikoreshwa ushaka kuvuga ikintu ariko muburyo butumvwa n'umuntu uwariwe wese keretse imenyereye ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda. Ubu tugiye kurebera hamwe imigani migufi 10 itangaje cyane;
1.Shotora ingagi uzabona ubwitonzi bwayo!
Uyumugani bawuca bashaka kuvuga ko atari byiza kwendereza, kwiyenza kumuntu kugeza aho akwereka uburakari cyangwa kamere ye.
2.Nta sugi iba munzu y'ibyariro (Maternite).
Nkuko byumvikana, munzu y'ibyariro habamo ababyeyi baje kubyara, ntiwasangamo amasugi! bakaba bawucira umuntu wagaragaweho nokubeshya nyamara umuntu wese yibonera ukuri kubiriho.
3.Umugore uhora atekereza aho umugabo we ari ni umupfakazi gusa..
Uyu ni umugani ushobora guca ushaka kumvisha rubanda ko hari ibibazo byawe ugomba kwimenyera wowe ubwawe gusa.
4.Umwana yakina n'amabere ya nyina ariko ntiyakina n'ubugabo bwa se!
Uyu mugani bawuca bashaka kwerekana ko ntamikino! Niyo wakwisanzura ariko haraho utakagombye kurenga, mbese ko utagomba kurengera.
5.Ujya koga mumaso ntahera kubirenge!
Uyumugani bawuca bashaka kuvugako buri kintu kigira kigihe cyacyo, mbese ko utakorera ibintu byose rimwe ko ahubwo ugomba guhera ku vyingenzi kuruta ibindi.
6.Intebe niyo imenya uwasuze!
Iyo intebe ziba zivuga, nizo zavugisha ukuri umuntu wasuze mubantu!!
Uyu mugani ucibwa hagamijwe kwerekana ko ukuri nyako kubyabaye kuba gufitwe n'uwo byabayeho.
7.Uwaraye aribwa munnyo, abyukana intoki zinuka!!
Uyu mugani usekeje, ucibwa hashaka gusobanurwako ataribyiza guhisha ikibazo ufite kuko umunsi umwe kizagaragara wabishaka utabishaka.
8.Iyo umubu ukurumye kubugabo nibwo umenyako ubuhubutsi budakemura ibibazo byose!
cyangwa bati; Iyo imashini y'ipantalo igufashe kubugabo, nibwo umenyako guhubuka kudakemura ibibazo byose!
Iyi migani yombi yerekanako hari ibibazo bikemurwa n'ubwitonzi ndetse bikabije kuko uhubutse wakwagiza byinshi kurushaho.
9.Agahwa kari kuwundi karahandurika!
Uyu mugani bawucaga bashaka kumvikanisha ko nubwo umuntu yakubwira ibibazo bye utabifata cyangwa se bitakuremerera nkuko we bimuremereye akenshi bamwe unasanga uba ubwira ibyo bibazo byawe babifata nkaho byoroshye bitakabaye bikubabaza.
10.Igiti uzatema ushaje ugitera ukirimuto!
uyu mugani bawuca badasobanura igiti ahubwo bavuga kwizigamira, iyo wizigamiye ukurimuto bigufasha no mubusaza bwawe ntago usaza wanduranya kuko uba warizigamiye.
Imigani migufi ariyo bakunze kwita Imigani y'imigenurano nubwo ivugitse mu buryo bunyarutse, irusha ibindi byose kuranga umuco rusange w'abanyarwanda. Ushaka kumenya uburezi n'uburere cyangwa imibanire y'abantu bya Kinyarwanda wabisangamo. Nkuko Amateka y'ubuvanganzo nyarwanda abigaragaza, umugani n'ipfundory'amagambo atonze neza, gacamigani yakagiriyemo ihame ridutoza gukora iki cyangwa se kudakora kiriya. Mbese muri make umugani ni umwanzuro w'amarenga y'intekerezo. Umugani uvuga ukuri ariko muri kamere yawo ntabwo wo uba ari ukuri.
ingero ziyo migani harimo;
-Inyama utazarya ntuzirinda ibisiga.
-Uruyuzi rujya kwera ibihaza rubanza ubututu.
-Ntwe ukandagira ibijanju by'amacupa ngo ananirwe ibijanju by'ibicuma
-Nyakamwe ntavumba mu Bakara
-Agaharawe gahabwa agahari, agahararutswe kagahabwa agahini
-Aho ingenzi ziri ingegera ntizigurumbya
-Aho ingenzi zitari ingegera zirigurumbya
-Nta nyanya zera imitobotobo
-Icumu rizagucungura ntumenya aho ryacuriwe
-Nyokorome akuruma akurora
-Utagira nyirasenge arisenga
-Umwana uko umureze niko akunera nindi migani myinshi...

Ubuhiri ni igiti cya cyera cya koreshwaga mu muco Nyarwanda, cyabaga gifite amabango gikomeye cyane, cyikaba baragikoreshaga mu mu kwasa inkwi, nicyo bategaga igiti bagiye kwasa bigafasha uwasa korohorwa nnicyo yasa, gusa aha bagkoreshaga Imangu.

Imangu ni igiti cya baga gisongoye, cyoakoreshwaga cyane mu kwasa inkwi, zabaga zifite amabango menshi cyangwa ibiti bikomeye, abasokuruza bacu bakoresha imangu cyane mu ishyamba cyangwa mu rugo.
Hari ibiti bitandukanye byakorwagamo imangu kuko byari bizwiho gukomera aha twavuga indakatsi.

Nyirabunyagwa ni isuka y'agafuni yakoreshwaga kera ndetse nu bu mugutera imyaka itandukanye twavuaga ibishyimbo, ibigori, amasaka ndetse no ku bagara ibintu bigiye bitandukanye kuva kera mu muco nyarwanda.

Intabire ni umurima uhinze neza ibyatsi babitabye mu butaka ikaba ariyo bateragamo inyaka itandukanye mu gihe cyo kuyiteramo ndetse no kuyibagara. Intabire bateramo nki bishyimbo, amashaza, amasaka nibindi bitandukanye.

Urutare rwa Bigogwe ruherereye mu karere ka Nyabihu mu ntara y'iBurengerazuba bw'U Rwanda.
urutare rwahawe izina ibere rya Bigogwe bishingiye ku nkuru ivugwa mu mateka y'U Rwanda y'uwitwa Bere, wari umer mu basigajwe inyuma n'amateka wabonye ubuki ari kumwe na bagenzi be biyemeza kujya kubuhakura. Bere niwe wagiye aho ubwo buki bwari brui atangira kubuhakura aburya adasanyiye na Bagenzi be yirengagije ko ari bo bari bafasha imigoze imukomeza ngo atagwa mu rutare. Bagenzi ba bere babonye ko atari buze kuzana ubuki ngo basangire bahizemo kumjurekura, agwa mu rutare, ahasiga ubuzima. nibwo hatangiye kwitirirwa uwo Bere kuva ubwo kugeza n'ubu. Nyuma ariko haje guhindurwa ahakorerwa imyitozo y'igisirikare. kandi aka gace kakomeje kumenyekana kubera ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nka.
Andi mateka y’uruhererekane nyemvugo avuga ko kwita ako gasozi ‘Ibere rya Bigogwe’ byaba byaraturutse ku mukobwa witwaga ‘Nyirabigogwe’ wari ufite ibere rinini cyane, akaza kugwa kuri uwo musozi bakahamwitirira.

Igicugutu ni ikinyabiziga gikoreshwa amaboko kigahabwa amapine abiri ebyiri kikaba gikoreshwa mu bihugu bya Afurika y'iburasirazuba mu gurwara imizigo.
Ubusanzwe igicugutu kiba gifite ikadiri yinguni, amapine abiri mato (akenshi bikozwe mu biti, rimwe na rimwe agafunikishwa ibisigazwa b'amapine y'ibinyabiziga akorerwa mu nganda), imikandara, hamwe na padi kugirango umukoresha ashyire ivi mugihe atwara icyo kinyabiziga. Kumanuka, ucyigenderaho ahagarara kumurongo nk'utwaye moto yo mu bwoko bwa skooter ari nayo kadere. Ku butaka buringaniye, uyigenderaho ashobora gushyira ivi rimwe ku ikadere hanyuma agasunikisha hasi ukundi kuguru nk'igare.
Akenshi hongrwamo ibisigazwa by'amapine akorerwa mu nganda kugirango birinde ubunyerere
Igicugutu cyagaragaye bwa mbere mu myaka ya za 70 muri Kivu y'Amajyaruguru, mu bihe bitoroshye by'ubukungu ku butegetsi bwa Mobutu Sese Seko.
Muri 2008, ibicugutu byari bifite agaciro k'amadorari 100 ya Amerika. mu gihe kumunsi, mukarere karere ka Afurika y'Iburasirazuba abantu abantu benshi babaho babaho binjiza ari munsi y'amadorari ya amerika abiri munsi kumunsi. muri 2014 byagaragajwe ko hari abatwara ibicuguti bakaba bamara amezi atandatu binjiza amadorari hagati y'10 na 20 ku munsi.

Yigize Kabushungwe ni umugani w'Ikinyarwanda baca iyo babona umuntu yigize indakoreka, bakagoragoza akanga, nibwo bavuga bati "Knaka uriya yigize Kabushungwe". uyu mugani wakomotse kuri Bushungwe w'i Kageyo mu Cyingogo (Gisenyi); ku ngoma ya Mutara Rwogera.
Ubwo Umwami Rwogera yajyaga ku butegetsi yari akiri muto, ni uko nyina witwaga Nyiramavugo Nyiramongi aba ari we uyobora mu mwanya, nk'uko byajyaga bikorwa ibwami iyo umwami yimikwaga akiri muto. muri icyo gihe nibwo uwitwa Bushungwe wari utuye i Kageyo, akaba umukungu w'imyaka n'amatungo, yatangiye kutavuga rumwe n'abajyanaga amaturo i Bwami, afata abo babyemeranywaho abasaba kujya bazana amaturo iwe aho kuyajyana ibwami.
Umugabekazi abimenye atuma ingabo z'ibwami zijya kumufata ziramuzana, zimwereka umugabekazi. ni uko Bushungwe ahabwa igihano cyo gucibwa amatwi, kuko yari amaze kubeshya umugabekazi ko aho akomoka ubusembwa bubi burutwa no gupfa ari ukubaho udafite amatwi. birangira Bushungwe atishwe.

Nyabingi ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi wakuye benshi umutima kugeza aho hari bamwe banamwita sekibi N’ubwo izina ryamamaye cyane ari Nyabingi ariko izina rye ry’Ikinyarwanda ni Nyabyinshi, bivuze umuntu ufite ubutunzi bwinshi, ni izina ryahawe umukobwa uvugwa ko we na Ruganzu ll Ndoli, bavutse ari impanga babyawe na Ndahiro ll Cyamatare.
Nyabingi yavutse yitwa Nyabyinshi, nyuma izina rye riza kumenyekana nka Nyabingi bitewe n'uko abantu bavugaga ururimi rw'urukiga, iyo bumvaga izina Nyabyinshi bo bumvaga Nyabingi.
Umwaka yavutsemo ntuzwi neza, ariko Bikekwako yavutse hagati y'umwaka w1600 n'umwaka w'1800.
Uyu Nyabingi yagize ubutunzi bwinshi, Nyuma y'uko se yamuganiye agace k'u Rwanda kitwa mu ndorwa
Ikindi nyabingi avugwaho inkuru zitandukanye mumateka y'u, Rwanda, hari abumva iryo zina bagasesa urumeza, abandi bakamufata nk'igikomerezwa, Imana, Sekibi n'ibindi byinshi. yaru umwana w'umukobwa wa Ruganzu II ndori wayoboye urwanda mu ntangiro z'ikinyejana cya 16. Yamubyaye ubwo yari yarahungiye Ikaragwe kwa Nyirasenge Nyabunyana
Aho Nyabingi ahurira n'imyemerere.
Nyabingi ntiyigeze ashaka umugabo, ubwo yari agiye gupfa, yahamagaye abaja be n’abagaragu abihera bwa butunzi bwe bwose ngo bazabugabane.
Nk’ikimenyetso cyo kuzahora bamwibuka, bamushyiriraho imigenzo yo kujya bamuterekera. Baje no kwishyira hamwe biyita ‘Abagirwa’, nk’abantu bagizwe na Nyabingi bagatunga bagatunganirwa.
Uwo muco wo guterekera Nyabingi wahereye aho, ukwira mu Banyarwanda bose aho uwabagiriye neza na nyuma yo gupfa bahoraga bamwibuka, Na n’ubu Mu Rwanda, by’umwihariko mu duce tw’Amajyaruguru, hari ahakigaragara ibimenyetso biranga imibereho ya Nyabingi, ku gicumbi cy’uwo muco ni mu Murenge wa Butaro mu Karere ka Burera.
Muri ako gace hari abakiriho mu bahose ari Abagirwa ba Nyabingi, aho bagiye basimburana mu buryo bw’uruhererekane bamwe basimbura ababyeyi babo, hakaba hakigaragara inzu za Nyabingi (Indaro/ingoro) aho baterekereraga.

Itorero Inkindi n'Amariza n'itsinda ry'abasore n'inkumi ryashiznwe kandi riyoborwa na Carine Karambizi rigamije gukundisha abakuru n'abato by'umwihariko urubyiruko gukunda imbyino n'umuco gakondo by'abanyarwanda.
Iri torero ryanshinzwe mu mwaka w'2021, rikaba rikora ibikorwa byo gusigasira umuco, babifatanyije n'ibikorwa bya Siporo nabyo bibiungabunga bikanasigasira umuco nyarwanda

Shariya ni amategeko y'Imana yagenwe mu idini ya Islam, kandi ashingiye ku mabwiriza agenga imibereho y'abayisilamu. Iyo tuvuga "kwambara shariya," bivuze kwambara mu buryo bukurikiza amategeko ya shariya, by'umwihariko ku bagore, aho kwambara bisaba imyambaro ishyira mu gaciro, ikubahiriza ubwiyoroshye, ubusugi, no kwirinda kugaragaza ibice by'umubiri byemerewe gusa mu ruhame.
Muri rusange, ibi ni bimwe mu byo kwambara shariya bivuze:
Kwambara shariya rero ni igikorwa kigamije kugendera ku mahame ya Islam no kubaha amategeko y'Imana, mu gihe kigamije
kurinda isura, umutima, n'ubwiza bw'umuntu. Naho ku bagabo, nubwo imyambarire yabo itandukanye gato, isaba kugira isuku n'icyubahiro mu kubaha amategeko ya shariya.

Umurenge wa Runda ni umwe mu mirenge 12 igize Akarere ka Kamonyi, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Runda wari utuwe n'abaturage 72 778. Mu 2012, wari utuwe n'abaturage 34 839. Abaturage benshi b'uyu murenge batuye mu mujyi.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Runda ni umwe mu mirenge 12 y'Akarere ka Kamonyi.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Runda wari utuwe n'abaturage 34 839. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 72 778. Abagabo bari 35 695. Abagore bari 37 083.
Mu 2022, abari hagati y'imyaka 0 na 14 bari 25 627. Abari hagati y'imyaka 15 na 64 bari 45 028. Abari bafite imyaka 65 cyangwa irenga bari 1 980.
Abaturage 66 151 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 6 627 batuye mu cyaro.

"Ikiraro bambukiraho ni iki?" mu Kinyarwanda bisobanuye "Ni iki kiguhuza cyangwa kikuyobora mu yindi nzira?" cyangwa "Ni iki gikora nk'urugendo umuntu anyuramo?".
Iyi mvugo ishobora kuba ikoreshejwe mu buryo bw'ubuvanganzo cyangwa mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo, aho ikiraro cyaba gisobanura inzira cyangwa icyerekezo umuntu akoreramo urugendo rw'ubuzima, aho arimo gukemura ibibazo cyangwa kugera ku ntego.
Hari ubwo iyo mvugo ikoreshwa mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo, aho ikiraro kivuga uburyo umuntu ashobora guhindura cyangwa kugera ku bintu runaka mu buzima bwe.
kandi nanone mu rwanda dufite ibindi biraro:

Abanyabugeni n'abanyabukorikori.
Abanyabugeni n'abanyabukorikori bakora ibihangano bijyanye n'umuco gakondo mu Rwanda.
Ibikoresho by'ubukorikori by'abanyarwanda byoherejwe n'abamisiyoneri i Vatikani mu 1925,
birimo kumurikwa mu ngoro ndanga murage ya Anima Mundi Ethonological Museum.
Abayobozi mu ihuriro mpuzamahanga ry’abanyabugeni n’abanyabukorikori bo muri Burkina Faso basuye abanyabugeni bo mu Rwanda mu rwego rwo kubakangurira kujya bitabira imurikagurisha ribera muri icyo gihugu kuko iyo abantu baje muri iryo murikagurisha baba bashaka ibintu byo mu Rwanda cyane.
Amakoperative y’abanyabukorikori n’abanyabugeni atandukanye akorera hirya no hino mu mujyi wa Kigali abo bashyitsi basuye tariki 27/01/2014 bakanayakangurira kuzitabira imurikagurisha ryo muri Burkina Faso babyishimiye ariko bagaragaza ikibazo cy’ubushobozi bucye basaba ko MNICOM na PSF byazabafasha.
Uwera Maryse wari uhagarariye MINICOM yavuze ko ibi ari ibintu byo kuzaganiraho hagati y’inzego bireba hakarebwa icyakorwa ariko kandi anibutsa aba banyabukorikori ko bakwiye gushyiraho akabo maze n’uwabafasha akagira aho ahera atari ukuvuga ngo bazategereza gukorerwa byose.Musanze.

Yanditswe na Ishimwe ngabo victory
Kuya 17 March 2025 saa 08:05
Icyakora twasuye bike cyane kuko mu mpushya zisaga 100 u Rwanda rumaze gutanga ku bacukura, nasuye ibigo bitanu bitunganganya amabuye ya Wolfram, gasegereti na coltan atunganywamo ibyuma ya tungsten, tin na tantalum.
Ni amabuye akenewe muri iyi minsi cyane, kuko atunganywamo ibyuma bikomeye bikoreshwa mu bwubatsi, mu ndege, mu bifaru, mu byogajuru, mu gukora imbunda, amasasu, ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga nk’ibitanda bya telefone, mudasobwa n’ibindi bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga, gusudira n’ibindi.
Ni amabuye u Rwanda rukungahayeho cyane kuko rucukura toni ziri hagati ya 8000-10000 buri mwaka, igiciro mu mafaranga kigahinduka bijyanye n’uko amasoko ahagaze.
Mu bigo bigera ku 100 bicukura amabuye y’agaciro bibarirwa mu Rwanda, twasuyemo bine, birimo ikirombe cya Nyakabingo kiri mu Karere ka Rulindo, icya Rukaragata kiri mu Ngororero, ibya Mwurire, Nzige na Rubona (bicukurwa n’ikigo kimwe) mu Karere ka Rwamagana, n’icya Bashyamba cyo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge.
Ukoze imibare ubona ko ibyo birombe bicukura amabuye abarirwa muri toni 2000 buri mwaka, bikagira abakozi hafi ibihumbi 5000 batunze imiryango yabo mu Rwanda.
Ni imirimo yashowemo akayabo kuko nka Trinity Metals igenzura ikirombe cya Nyakabingo imaze gushora arenga miliyoni 40$, bikaba n’uko ku kigo cya Power M kigenzura ibirombe bya Rukaragata mu Karere ka Ngororero na cyane ko ho abakozi ari bake cyane ugereranyije n’imashini zikorera ibintu.
Ni ubucukuzi bukorwa imusozi no mu nda y’imisozi. Nituvuga imusozi wumve bya bindi byo kubanza guharura umusozi nka metero mirongo ingahe ubundi ugatangira kuyora uwo mucanga uba wuzuyemo amabuye y’agaciro ukawutunganya amabuye ushaka ukayabona.
Ubundi buryo ni ubwo kujya mu nda y’umusozi, ugacukura indani zitandukanye haba mu bitare no mu butaka bworoshye, aho nko mu birombe bya Bashyamba bamaze kucukura indani zireshya na kilometero 15 mu bitare 300.
Mu bushakashatsi ibyo bigo byakoze, bigaragaza ko ayo mabuye yose aramutse acukuwe neza byakorwa mu myaka igera kuri 50 iri imbere.
Ubwo bucukuzi ni nako bwungura haba abashoramari, abakozi n’igihugu muri rusange kuko batanga nk’imisoro.
Nka Twizerimana Jean Claude, ukorera mu kirombe cya Bashyamba IGIHE yamusanze mu ndani hafi muri metero 600 z’ubutambike imbere mu musozi.
Yavuze ko amaze imyaka itatu akorera iki kigo kandi ngo abona iterambere ryacyo na we rimugeraho uko bwije n’uko bukeye, kuko amaze kwigurira ikibanza mu mujyi wa Kigali.
Ati “Nagezemo ku cyumweru cya mbere bampemba ibihumbi 94 Frw, igikurikiyeho bampemba ibihumbi 114 Frw. Mu byumweru bibiri iyo nahembwe make bampa ibihumbi 190 Frw. Hari n’ubwo bigenda neza gasegereti ikaboneka ibihumbi 800 Frw mu minsi 15 akinjira.”
Mugenzi we wo mu Ngororero witwa Yankurije Betty umaze imyaka irindwi akora mu birombe bya Rukaragata ati “Mu myaka irindwi nageze kuri byinshi. Mbere nta mafaranga nagiraga. Ubu nishyurira abana ishuri, nubatse inzu, naguze inka ebyiri, isambu y’ibihumbi 600 Frw n’ibindi byinshi.”
Iryo shimwe ni na ryo wumvana abashoye imari muri iyi mirimo barimo na Kwizera Jean Bosco usanzwe ari Umuyobozi Mukuru wa DUMAC Ltd, ikigo cya mbere gicukura gasegereti na Coltan nyinshi mu Rwanda bivanze, mu kirombe giherereye mu Karere ka Rwamagana mu mirenge ya Mwurire Nzige na Rubona.
Uyu mugabo watangiye ari umucukuzi usanzwe ubu ageze ku ishoramari rya miliyari 5 Frw ati “Twatangiye dushora nka miliyoni 80 Frw ariko ubu tugeze kuri miliyari 5 Frw.”
“Twatangiranye abakozi 120 ubu barenze 1000. Aha hari amabuye menshi cyane kuko niba twaratangiriye ku bilo 200 mu cyumweru uyu munsi nkaba ngeze kuri toni zirenga 20 kandi hafi yanjye hakaba ibindi birombe by’ibindi bigo. Urumva ko aya mabuye ari menshi. Ntabwo washora uko utunguka.”
Umushoramari mugenzi we wo mu Bwongereza washoye muri Power M yo mu Ngororero witwa Ray Power unayoboye n’Uruganda rwa Power Resources International rutunganyiriza Coltan mu Karere ka Bugesera, yagaragaje ko ahantu hangana na metero 600 yabonyemo amabuye y’agaciro atandukanye ashobora gucukurwa kugeza mu myaka 16 iri imbere, iramutse icukuwe mu buryo bugezweho.
Ati “Ubu dufite amabuye twacukura mu myaka 16 ndatse turi gukora ubushakashatsi ku buryo igera ku myaka 20. Urumva ko aha hari amabuye. Inyungu iraboneka.”
Uretse abo n’igihugu ni ko cyunguka binyuze mu misoro. Kumva uburyo imisoro yiyongera ubyumvira mu musaruro wiyongera umunsi ku wundi.
Imibare y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Mine, Peteroli na Gaz (Rwanda Mining Board- RMB) igaragaza ko garagaza ko amabuye y’agaciro yoherejwe mu mahanga mu 2023 yinjirije u Rwanda asaga miliyari 1,1$, avuye kuri miliyoni 772$ bigaragaza izamuka rya 43.0%.
Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare (NISR) cyatangaje ko muri Mutarama 2025, umusaruro w’amabuye y’agaciro mu Rwanda, wiyongereyeho 4.3% ugereranyije na Mutarama 2024.
Amabuye ntabwo agaruka ku mipaka…
Rimwe na rimwe uzumva ibirego bigaragaza ko u Rwanda nta mabuye y’agaciro rugira, icyakora abavuga ukumva baravuze ngo nko muri metero 500 cyangwa ikilometero kimwe hakurya y’umupaka wayo ngo ni ho ayo mabuye abarizwa.
Ni ibintu Ray Power yumva agaseka, ashingiye ku bushakashatsi yakoze n’akayabo yashoye mu bijyanye no guteza ubucukuzi bugezweho bwibanda ku mubare w’imashini nyinshi kurusha abantu.
Ati “Ntabwo amabuye agira imipaka. Ntabwo akenera pasiporo ngo abe yava mu gice kimwe ajya mu kindi. Ubwanjye nishoreye imari mu bijyanye n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro no gushakisha aho aherereye. Imitereye y’aka karere ni imwe ku bijyanye n’uwo mutungo kamere.”
Ako gace Power avuga ni ako igice kibarizwamo amabuye y’agaciro kizwi nka Kibaran-Angolan Belt. Uretse u Rwanda ruherereye rwagati muri cyo, kibarizwamo n’ibice byo mu bihugu nka RDC, Angola, Repubulika ya Centrafrique, Zambia, Tanzania n’ahandi.
Umuyobozi w’Ishami rya RMB rishinzwe ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’ubugenzuzi bwayo, Nsengumuremyi Donat, yunze mu rya Ray Power agaragaza ko rwihagije ku mabuye ku bwinshi no ku bwiza, akavuga ko hafi igihugu cyose, ni ukuvuga mu turere 28 hagaragaye ibimenyetso by’amabuye y’agaciro atandukanye, ndetse muri utwo turere turimo ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi.
Yavuze ko nubwo u Rwanda rukataje mu gucukura, ntaho ruragera kuko mu gihe ibindi bihugu bigeze ku bilometero nka bibiri munda y’Isi, u Rwanda rutaragera no ku kilometero kimwe.
Ati “U Rwanda rufite amabuye y’agaciro, kuko ruherereye mu gice abarizwamo (Kibara Belt), ndetse rukaba hagati yacyo. Niba turi hagati bivuze turi mu izingiro ryayo. Haracyari imyaka myinshi yo gucukura.”
Uyu muyobozi agaragaza ko ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bwakomeje kwitabirwa cyane nko mu myaka icumi ishize aho u Rwanda rwabihaye umurongo. Ni urwego rubarurwamo abakozi barenga ibihumbi 70.
Agaragaza ko kugeza ubu u Rwanda rumaze gutanga impushya 136 ku bigo by’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro 99, impushya 18 z’ibigo bikora ubushakashatsi ku mabuye y’agaciro zahawe ibigo 17, impushya 76 ku bigo bicuruza ayo mabuye n’izindi eshatu ku biyongerera agaciro. Akagaragaza ko utashora muri ibyo byose nta mabuye ufite.
Ubucukuzi mu Rwanda bwatangiye gukorwa mu myaka 95 irashize mu Rwanda hatangijwe ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro nyuma y’imyaka hafi 10 yari ishize hakorwa ubushakashatsi, bwagaragaje ko rukungahaye ku mabuye atandukanye.
Agaragara cyane ni Gasegereti, Coltan na Wolfram. Urugendo rwo kwiyubaka rujyana no kongera inganda zitunganya ayo mabuye mu Rwanda zirimo urwa Gasabo Gold Refinery, rufite ubushobozi bwo gutunganya toni 96 ku mwaka, urwa LuNa Smelter rutanganya gasegereti ubushobozi bwo gushongesha toni 360 za gasegereti buri kwezi, n’urwa Power Resources International Ltd rufite ubushobozi bwo gutunganya toni 120 za coltan mu kwezi.
Nsengumuremyi avuga ko ubu bari mu mushinga wa leta uzamara imyaka itatu buzakorerwa mu duce twagaragaye ko dukungahaye ku mabuye y’agaciro cyane, bagacukura mu ntera ndende ugana hasi, kugira ngo hamenywe ingano y’amabuye u Rwanda rufite.
Ati “Turi gukora ubwa zahabu, ubwa Lithium kuko isigaye ikenewe ku rwego mpuzamahanga n’ubwa gasegereti coltan na wolfram.”
U Rwanda kandi rwanashoye mu burezi bugamije kurema inzobere muri iyo mirimo, uyu munsi bikaba ari itegeko ko ikirombe kigira inzobere mu ibijyanye n’ubucukuzi n’ushinzwe kurengera ibidukikije bose babyize.
Kuva Kaminuza y’u Rwanda yashyiraho ishuri ryigisha ibijyanye n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro mu 2015, ubu igihugu gifite abanyamwuga 260 bavuye kuri 40 rwabaruraga mu 1995.
Uretse 3Ts u Rwanda rufite na zahabu iboneka mu turere twa Gicumbi, Musanze, Burera, Nyamasheke, Rusizi na Nyarugenge, amabengeza akoreshwa mu mitako aboneka mu turere twa Ngororero, Muhango Ruhango, Muhanga, Sapphire aboneka mu Burengerazuba, Lithium n’andi ndetse ubushakashatsi burakomeje.
U Rwanda rufite intego y’uko mu 2029 ruzaba rubarura umusaruro mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro ungana na 2,2$. Gukusanya amabuye yose yacukuwe bikava kuri 40% bikagera kuri 80%.

Kwiga ni ingenzi mu mikurire y'umuntu n'umuryango,bituma abantu bunguka ubumenyi,bakiteza imbere, kandi bagafata ibyemezo byuzuye amaherezo bikagira uruhare mu ejo hazaza heza kuri bo no ku isi.
Dore ibisobanuro birambuye kumpamvu kwiga ari ngombwa:
Inyungu z'umuntu ku giti cye:.
Ubumenyi no gusobanukirwa:.
Kwiga bituma abantu bamenya ibyisi,bakumva neza ibintu bitandukanye,kandi bagatezimbere ubuhanga bwo gutekereza.
Guteza imbere ubuhanga:.
Binyuze mu kwiga,abantu barashobora kubona ubumenyi bwingirakamro,bwaba amasomo,tekiniki,cyangwa ubuhanga bworoshye bukenewe kugira ngo umuntu atsinde mubice bitandukanye byubuzima.
Kwiga bitera amatsiko y'ubwenge,bigatera inkunga yo kwivumbura,kandi bigira uruhare mu mikurire no kwiteza imbere.
Itanga umutekano w'amafaranga:.
Hejuru y'umutekano,uburezi nabwo butanga umutekanowamafaranga,cyane cyane muri sosiyete yubu.Uburezi bwiza bukunda kuganisha kumurimo uhembwa menshi,kimwe no kuguha ubumenyi bukenewe kugira ngo ugereyo
Birakenewe kuburinganire:.
Kugira ngo isi yose ibe ingana rwose,igomba guhera ku burezi.Niba buri wese yarahawe amahirwe amwe yo kwiga,noneho habaho itandukaniro rito hagati yimibereho

= Nyabihu: Inganda zikamura amababi y’inturusu zirashinjwa kwangiza amashyamba y’abaturage =
01-04-2025 - 18:31 |
Abaturage barebwa n’icyo kibazo, cyane cyane ni abo mu Mirenge ine izo nganda zikoreramo, ariyo Rurembo, Rambura, Jomba na Mulinga, aho bemeza ko kuva izo nganda zigeze muri ako gace bari kwangirizwa amashyamba, dore ko amababi y’inturusu yahindutse imari ikomeye muri ako gace.
Nk’uko babitangarije Kigali Today, ngo amashyamba akomeje kwangizwa ari ku buso burenga hegitari eshanu, bakaba bibaza uko bazabaho mu minsi iri imbere.
Umuturage wo mu Murenge wa Jomba, yavuze ko izo nganda zigurira abaturage amababi y’inturusu, bigatera bamwe biganjemo abana kubigira ubucuruzi, kugeza ubwo birara mu mashyamba yabo bakayonona.
Ati "Tukimara kubona ko abiganjemo abana bakomeje kujya birara mu mashyamba yacu bakayangiza, twegereye ba nyiri inganda tubabwira icyo kibazo, batubwira ko nta kintu babikoraho, badusaba gushyiraho abarinzi barinda amashyamba yacu, tukavuga tuti, ese turashyira abarinzi mu mashyamba bishoboke, bahembwe nande?".
Arongera ati "Njye nasanze umwana mu giti hejuru mu bushorishori agikonga, ambonye antera ubwoba ati, niba utagiye ngiye gusimbuka, ukagenda kugira ngo amahoro ahinde kuko ashobora gupfa bakagufunga. Twigeze gufata bamwe tubajyana kuri Polisi, komanda aravuga ngo ntabwo aburanisha ibishagari (amababi y’inturusu), twararize turihanagura".
Uwo muturage avuga ko uburyo ayo mashyamba ari kwangiza, bigira ingaruka zo kuma kw’ibiti bimwe na bimwe bavuna imitwe.
Ati "Igiti barakigonda kikagera hasi bakagica umutwe, urumva nta gikurikiraho uretse kuma, ishyamba ryanjye bararikokoye bararirangiza, nigeze kubwira abantu nti, ni muze murebe uburyo ishyamba ryanjye ryangijwe barumirwa, ubu byarandenze, amababi aba akenewe mu ruganda ngo ni ayo ku mitwe y’igiti".
Mugenzi we wo mu Murenge wa Rurembo ati "Twakoze imishinga dutera ibiti, mu gihe bitangiye gukura ngo bitubyarire inyungu, bazana inganda ziteka amababi y’inturusu zikayakamura, nta giti cyongeye gukura muri aka gace, baraza bakurira bakabikonda barangiza bakabica n’imitwe igiti kikuma".
Arongera ati "Ntaho tutabigejeje, ariko twabuze kivugira, abana bamwe batiga nibo bakokora ibiti byacu bakajya kugurisha abo banyenganda, rwose turasaba ko ibyo bihagarara, ubu abana bari mu biruhuko ho birarenze".
Akomeza agira ati "Ishyamba ryanjye ni igice cya hegitari, nta giti kizima wabonamo, biraduhombya cyane kuko niba narakoze umushinga wo gutera ishyamba abantu bakaryangiza ku nyungu zabo, urumva ni ikibazo".
Undi muturage ati "Abo banyenganda baratuzonze, mu Murenge wa Jomba aho ntuye, inganda zatumazeho amashyamba, baraza bakarikokora wageramo ukibaza niba ari ishyamba bikakuyobera, ariko ikibazo gihari n’uko ubuyobozi usanga busa naho bitabureba, kuko iyo utatse ntabwo bakumva".
Arongera ati "Nasanze banyangirije ishyamba mbigeza ku mukozi ushinzwe amashyamba mu Murenge, ati, muzadufatire umwe mumutuzanire tumuhane by’intangarugero, mu minsi ibiri dufata umusore tumujyanyeyo, bati, tugiye gukora raporo, bahita bamurekura arataha".
Abo baturage baravuga ko batagambiriye gufungisha izo nganda, gusa bakavuga ko uburenganzira bwabo ku mashyamba yabo nabwo bukwiye kubahirizwa, inganda zigakora ariko n’amashyamba yabo akabungabungwa, dore ko n’ayo mavuta bavuga ko nta kintu abamariye, kuko batamenya icyo akora n’aho agurishirizwa.
Ba nyiri inganda babivugaho iki?
Nyuma y’uko abaturage bagaragaje ikibazo cyabo, Kigali Today yaganiriye n’umwe mu bahagarariye izo nganda witwa Manizabayo Innocent, avuga ko ayo makuru abaturage bavuga atari ukuri.
Ati "Ibyo abo baturage bavuga ntabwo aribyo, twe tugura amashagari y’abantu batemye ibiti, tukagura n’amashyamba ayo dusaruye amababi akaba ariyo dukoresha, ubwo rero hari abantu bigize abantu utamenya, bakora ibintu by’imitwe".
Abajijwe ku bimenyetso abaturage bagaragaza byerekana ko amashyamba yabo yangizwa, yagize ati "Ubwiwe n’iki ko ataribo babyikorera bakiyangiriza, hari umuntu bafashe baramugaragaza bati, ng’uyu akavuga ko twamwohereje?, wabwirwa n’iki ko abantu bo muri iki gihe bakora ibintu utamenya, ko ashobora kugenda akiyangiriza ngo akunde aguharabike, urumva umuntu yatinyuka agakora bizinesi yo kwangiriza abaturage?".
Manizabayo yavuze ko bamwe mu baturage bari gukoreshwa kugira ngo bahagarikishe iyo bizinesi, asaba abo baturage kunyura mu nzego z’ubuyobozi.
Ati "Bamwe mu baturage barakoreshwa ngo basebye ibyo abantu bakora, twe tugurira abantu bakuru ntabwo tugurira abana, n’ubu ngiye gupakurura imodoka y’ahantu twaguze amashagara, naho ibyo ni ababiri inyuma bagenda bagafata abantu bakabagurira inzagwa, barangiza bakagenda baharabika bizinesi z’abantu".
Icyo ubuyobozi bw’Akarere buvuga kuri icyo kibazo
Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Nyabihu buremeza ko buzi izo nganda zikora umushongi mu mababi y’inturusu, gusa ngo ntabwo bwari buzi iyo mikorere mibi yo kwangiza amashyamba y’abaturage.
Ubuyobozi buvuga ko bugiye gukurikirana icyo kibazo, nibusanga ibyo abaturage bavuga ari ukuri, izo nganda zifatirwe ibyemezo, nk’uko Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyabihu wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu, Habanabakize Jean Claude yabitangarije Kigali Today.
Ati "Iki kibazo cy’imikorere imeze ityo, cyo ntabwo tukizi ariko icyo tuzi n’uko izo nganda zikamura inturusu zigakoramo umushongi ziriho, harabaho gukurikirana ibijyanye n’imikorere byabo".
Arongera ati "Turumva ko iyo mikorere niba koko ari ukuri, ntabwo ihwitse nta n’ubwo byemewe na gato, tugiye kubikurikirana kugira ngo mu by’ukuri ababirimo ababikora gutyo bahanwe nk’uko amategeko abiteganya, turabikurikirana kandi biraza gukemuka niba biriho koko".
ISHEMA Christian/rw.wipedia.org

Umurenge wa Kisaro ni umwe mu mirenge 17 igize Akarere ka Rulindo, mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Kisaro wari utuwe n'abaturage 23 113. Ugizwe n'utugari 6.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Rulindo kagizwe n'imirenge 17, utugari 71 n'imidugudu 494. Umurenge wa Kisaro ugizwe n'utugari 6:
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Kisaro wari utuwe n'abaturage 19 868. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 23 113. Abagabo bari 11 054. Abagore bari 12 059. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.

LeBron James yashimye imyambaro ya Moshions Sudani y’Epfo yaserukanye.
Yanditswe na ISHEMA Christian
Kuya 02 march 2025 saa 10:12
Yabivuze nyuma y’ubutumwa bwatambukijwe ku rubuga rwa ‘LeagueFits’, bugaragaza ko Ikipe y’Igihugu ya Sudani y’Epfo yitabiriye imikino Olempike 2024 yambaye neza.
Mu bitekerezo byatanzwe kuri aya amafoto yashyizwe kuri uru rubuga aherekejwe n’ubutumwa, LeBron James, yanditse agaragaza ko aba basore bari bambaye neza.
Ati “Abahungu basa neza.’’
Ubwo imikino ya Olempike yatangiraga abinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ze, Turahirwa Moses yagaragaje ko yishimiye kuba ari we wambitse Ikipe y’Igihugu ya Basketball ya Sudani y’Epfo.
Ati “Dutewe ishema no kugera i Paris aho twambitse Ikipe y’Igihugu ya Sudani y’Epfo yitabiriye Imikino Olempike, imyenda yose yahanzwe inakorwa na Moshions.”
Ikipe y’Igihugu ya Sudani y’Epfo iherutse guca igikuba nyuma yo gutsindwa bigoranye na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika amanota 101 kuri 100 mu mukino wa gicuti bakinnye bitegura imikino Olempike.
Imikino Olempike yatangijwe ku mugaragaro mu muhango wabaye ku wa Gatanu, tariki 26 Nyakanga 2024 i Paris mu Bufaransa ku mugezi wa Seine.
Ni ku nshuro ya 33 iyi mikino igiye gukinwa mu mpeshyi kuva habaye iya mbere i Athènes mu Bugereki mu 1896.
LeBron James yishimiye imyambaro Moshions yambitse Ikipe y’Igihugu ya Sudani y’Epfo
Abakinnyi ba Sudani y'Epfo mu myambaro ya Moshions
Basketball: Lebron James yujuje amanota ibihumbi 40
Ibi Lebron James yabikoze mu ijoro ryo Ku wa Gatandatu rishyira iryo Ku Cyumeru, tariki 3 Gashyatare 2024 ubwo ikipe ya Los Angeles Lakers akinira yatsindwaga iwa yo kuri Crypto Arena na Denver Nuggets amanota 124-114.
Muri uyu mukino Lebron James yitwaye neza kuko yatsinze amanota 26 amugira uwa kabiri watsinze menshi nyuma ya Nikol Jokic ukinira Denver Nuggets watsinze 29 aho uyu mugabo w’imyaka 39 kandi yanabaye umukinnyi mwiza (MVP) bitewe n’amateka yari akoze ndetse binamugira mwiza kuko ayo manota yatsinze yose yaje ava inyuma dore ko ikipe ye yari yarushijwe.
Byamusabye gutsinda amanota ari hejuru 9 kugirango yuzuze amanota ibihumbi 40 kuko yagiye mu mukino ariyo abura ngo akore aka gahigo ndetse akomeze kuyobora uru rutomde rwa’abakinnyi batsinze amanota menshi muri rusange barimo Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Stephen Curry ndetse na Kobe Bryant.
Lebron James ubwo yari amaze guca kuri Kareem Abdul-Jabbar ina we wahoze akinira Los Angeles Lakers wari afite amanota ibihumbi 38 338 nibwo yatangajeko yifuza kuzuza amanota ibihumbi 40 ndetse byaba byiza akayarenza.
Usibye kandi kuzuza amanota ibihumbi 40, Lebron James yabaye umukinnyi wa kane watanze imipira myinshi ivamo amanota (Assists) nyuma yo kuzuza ibihumbi 10,akaba aza inyuma ya John Stock wa mbere ufite ibihumbi 15, Jason Kid ufite ibihumbi 12, Paul Chris ufite ibihumbi 11.
Lebron James kandi yujuje gukina imipira ya kabiri ibihumbi 10 (Rebounds) ikinwa iyo umukinnyi yugarira cyangwa asatira atsinda byahise bimushyira byibuze mu bakinnyi 25 bakoze ako gahigo.Mu manota ibihumbi 40, yatsinze 23,119 muri Cleverland Cavaliers, atsinda 7,919 muri Miami Heat ahatsindira ibihumbi 8,979.
Utu duhigo turaza twiyongera ku mateka amwe n’amwe yagira kora arimo; gutwara ibikombe 4 bya shampiyona (NBA), ndeste aba umukinnyi wa shampiyona inshuro 3 (MVP).

Igishanga ni ahantu hasanzwe hari ubutaka bw'ibirunga cyangwa ibishanga, bukunze kuba hafi y'imigezi, aho amazi menshi yagiye akusanyirizwa cyangwa atembera mu buryo bwa gakondo. Aho hantu, ubutaka buba bwarahumye cyangwa bufite ubushyuhe, kandi amazi yaho ashyira mu bikorwa ibikorwa byo guhinga cyangwa gukoresha ibyo bikorwaremezo mu buryo bw'ubuhinzi.
Mu Rwanda, igishanga kenshi kijyanye n'ubuhinzi bw'imbuto, imyaka cyangwa ibindi byihariye. Igishanga gikunze kuba ahantu habonetse ibintu byinshi bihuza ubutaka n'amazi, bigatuma abantu babikoresha mu guhinga no kongera umusaruro w'ubuhinzi.
Ministeri y'Ibidukikije irashimangira ko hari ibindi bishanga 5 bigiye gutunganywa kugira ngo Umujyi wa Kigali ukomeze kugira isura nziza ariko irengera ibidukikije ari na ko abantu barushaho kugira ahantu henshi ho kuruhukira.
Ni mu gihe abatuye mu murwa w’u Rwanda n’abawugenda ndetse n'abarengera ibidukikije, bashima intambwe yatewe hashyirwaho icyanya gifasha abantu kuruhuka no kwidagadura cya Nyandungu.
Mu masaha y'agasusuruko, icyanya cya Nyandungu kimaze icyumweru gifunguwe abantu barimo kugisura. Mu magana y'abarimo kuhatemberera harimo n'itsinda ry'abana biga mu ishuri ribanza rya Source du Savoirs bavuga ko ari bwo bwa mbere basuye pariki ndetse akaba ari inyungu ikomeye mu bijyanye no kwiyungura ubumenyi n'amateka ubusanzwe basoma mu bitabo gusa.
Ingeri nyinshi z'abasura iyi pariki baba baje kuruhuka, kuganira, gusura ibyiza bitatse iyi pariki birimo ubwoko bw'inyoni n'ibiti; ibi bikaba ari inyungu ikomeye ku batabasha kujya gusura pariki zisanzwe kuko zitaruye Umujyi wa Kigali.
Abanyamahanga basura u Rwanda bavuga ko kongera ibyanya bitunganije ndetse byanasurwa bifite inyungu ikomeye ku bikorwa by'ubukerarugendo by'umwihariko ku batuye mu mujyi.”

Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
UMURENGE WA KIGARAMA ni imwe mu mirenge igize Akarere ka Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Kigarama iri mu bice by'iburasirazuba bwa Kigali, ikaba igizwe n'imidugudu itandukanye. Ni ahantu haturanye n'imirenge nka Niboye, Gikondo, na Kabuye.
Kigarama ni umurenge wateye imbere mu bijyanye n'ubucuruzi, ibikorwa by'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi, ndetse n'ibikorwa remezo nka amazi, amashanyarazi n'ibikorwa by'uburezi. Uyu murenge kandi urafite ibikorwa byinshi by'iterambere ku rwego rw'umujyi wa Kigali.
Hari byinshi byagiye bikorwa muri Kigarama, harimo imihanda mishya, amahugurwa atandukanye ku baturage ndetse n'ibikorwa by'ubwuzuzanye mu bice bitandukanye by'ubuzima.
Mu Murenge wa Kigarama, hari ibikorwa remezo byinshi byateye imbere mu myaka yashize, bigamije guteza imbere imibereho myiza y'abaturage ndetse no kubafasha kugira ubuzima bwiza. Bimwe muri ibyo bikorwa remezo birimo:

Umurenge wa Rwinkwavu ni umwe mu mirenge igize Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda.
Mu 2022, uyu murenge wari utuwe n'abaturage 36 774. Uzwiho ubucukuzi bwa gasegereti. Ibitaro by'Akarere bya Rwinkwavu biri muri uyu murenge.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Rwinkwavu ufite ubuso bwa km² 92,32. Uri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 425 ugereranyije.
Umurenge ugizwe n'utugari tune: Gihinga, Mbarara, Mukoyoyo na Nkondo.
Uhana imbibi n'Umurenge wa Mwiri mu majyaruguru. Uhana imbibi n'Umurenge wa Kabare mu burasirazuba. Uhana imbibi n'Umurenge wa Murama mu majyepfo. Uhana imbibi n'Umurenge wa Kabarondo mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba. Uhana imbibi n'Umurenge wa Nyamirama mu burengerazuba.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Rwinkwavu wari ufite abaturage 36 774. Abagabo bari 17 822. Abagore bari 18 952. Mu 2012, abaturage bari 28 225. Hagati ya 2012 na 2022, abaturage biyongereye ku kigero cya 2,7 % buri mwaka. Mu 2022, ubucucike bwari abantu 398 kuri km². Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Umurenge wa Rwinkwavu uzwiho ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Hacukurwa gasegereti. Ibirombe bya gasegereti biri ku buso bwa hegitari zirenga 2 000. Ibyo birombe biri mu mirenge ya Rwinkwavu, Rukara na Mwiri. Bikoresha abakozi barenga 800. Ubucukuzi butemewe n'amategeko ni ikibazo muri aka gace.
Ibitaro by'Akarere bya Rwinkwavu biri muri uyu murenge. Umuryango Partners In Health ukorera mu Rwanda kuva mu 2005. Mu Rwanda, uwo muryango witwa Inshuti Mu Buzima. Ufasha Ibitaro by'Akarere bya Rwinkwavu. Mu 2005, aka gace kari gafite ikigo nderabuzima kimwe gusa. Nta muganga wari uhari.
Umuhanda w'igihugu NR25 unyura mu gice cy'iburasirazuba cy'umurenge. Umuhanda w'akarere uwuvaho ugana mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba.

Tyla Laura Seethal (wavutse 30 Mutarama 2002), uzwi ku izina rya Tyla, ni umuririmbyi akaba n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo. Imiterere ye ya muzika irangwa no guhuza injyana ya pop na amapiano, ibitangazamakuru bimwandikaho kenshi bikunze kumwita " Umwamikazi wa Popiano ".
Tyla yavukiye kandi akurira i Johannesburg, nyuma yo gushyira hanze indirimbo ye ya mbere yise " Getting Late " igakundwa ahagana mu 2021 yagiranye amasezerano na Epic Records agamije ubufatanye mu bikorwa bye bya muzika. Yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga nyuma yo gusohora indirimbo ye 2023 yise " Water ", yinjiye mu ndirimbo icumi zabaye iza mbere mu bihugu byinshi birimo Afurika y'Epfo akomokamo, Ubwongereza na Amerika. Indirimbo ye "Water" niyo ndirimbo yambere y'umuhanzikazi wo muri Afrika yepfo yinjiye kurutonde rwitwa ""Billboard" Hot 100" yo muri Amerika mumyaka 55 byanamuhesheje igihembo cyambere cya 'Grammy Award' kitwa mu rurimi rwicyongereza 'Best African Music Performance'. Iyi ndirimbo yabanjirije alubumu ye ya mbere yise [2024], yasohotse mu rwego rwo gushimwa no gutsinda mu bucuruzi buciriritse, yinjiye no mu mizingo 25 igezweho mu bihugu byinshi bitandukanye biirimo na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika.
Tyla ni we muhanzi muto kurusha abandi bo muri Afurika wabayeho wegukanye igihembo cya Grammy Award. Ibindi bihembo yahawe birimo MTV Video Music Award, BET Awards ebyiri, MTV Europe Music Awards eshatu, ndetse n'igihembo cy'icyubahiro cya Global Force Award mu muhango wa mbere wa Billboard R&amp;B's No. 1's. Yanatorewe ibihembo bitandukanye harimo Brit Award, Ivor Novello Award, Soul Train Music Award, ndetse n'ibihembo icyenda bya South African Music Awards.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Tyla Laura Seethal yavutse ku wa 30 Mutarama 2002 i Edenvale, muri Gauteng, mu muryango mugari w'Abahindi Indo-Mauritian, Zulu, n'umuryango w'abakomoka muri Irilande. Yakuriye i Johannesburg, muri Gauteng, arangiza amashuri yisumbuye muri Edenglen mu wa 2019, aho yari umuyobozi w’umuco. Tyla afite abavandimwe 3, mukuru we, Whitney, na murumunawe na mushiki we muto, Tyrese na Sydney.
Mu mwaka wa nyuma w'amashuri yisumbuye, yatangiye gukora umwuga wa muzika, agashyira indirimbo z'umwimerere n'izisubiwemo kuri rukuta rwe rwa Instagram ari nako ashakisha cyane amahirwe ashoboka ngo agere ku iterambere rirambye mu muziki. Yaje kubonywa n'umuntu wa mbere wagombaga kureberera inyungu ze mu bya muzika, Garth von Glehn, wateguye amasomo ye ya mbere yo gufata amajwi. Tyla yavuze ko buri weekend m'umwaka wa nyuma w'amashuri ye yisumbuye yayimaraga muri studio afata amajwi y'indirimbo.
2019–2022: 'Getting Late' n'ibyo yagezeho k'urwego rw’igihugu..
Mu mpera za 2019, nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye, Tyla yasohoye indirimbo ye ya mbere "Getting Late" mu buryo bwigenga, ifite umusaruro wa Kooldrink, maze imuha kumenyekana mu gihugu. Video yayo yashowemo imari na manaja we mu bihe bya gumamurugo by'icyorezo cya COVID-19, ikaza gusohoka muri Mutarama 2021. Iyo video yarebwe na za miliyoni z'abantu nyinshi kuri YouTube, kandi yaje gutoranywa mu bihembo bya South African Music Award muri 2022 mu cyiciro cya Video nziza y’umwaka.
Icyo gihe kandi, yari arimo kwiga ibijyanye n'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro (Mining), ariko nyuma yo kumvisha ababyeyi be no kurira cyane, bemeye kumwemerera gusubika amasomo ye ya kaminuza kugira ngo agerageze kuzamura umwuga we w’umuziki. Nyuma yaho, muri Gicurasi 2021, yasinyanye amasezerano na Epic Records binyuze mu bufatanye na Fax Records yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Nyuma y’iyo ndirimbo ye ya mbere, yasohoye indirimbo "Overdue" mu Ukwakira 2021 na "To Last" mu Ugushyingo 2022.
2023 - kugeza ubu: Iterambere mpuzamahanga hamwe na "Water".
Muri 2023, Tyla yakoze igitaramo cye cya mbere ku mugaragaro mu birori bya Dolce &amp; Gabbana byabaye nyuma ya Milan Fashion Week, nyuma yo gusohora indirimbo ye "Been Thinking", yahaye Tyla imyanya ye ya mbere ku manota ya "Billboard Mainstream R&amp;B/Hip-Hop Airplay" na "Rhythmic Airplay charts". Heven Haile wa Pitchfork yayisobanuye nk'indirimbo y’uburanga yo mu birori, ifite umwuka w’indirimbo z'urukundo za pop-R&amp;B z’imyaka ya 2000 nka Ciara na Rihanna. Nyuma yaho, Tyla yifatanyije na Chris Brown nk’umuhanzi ufungura urugendo rwe rw'ibitaramo "Under the Influence Tour". Muri Gicurasi 2023, yasohoye indirimbo "Girl Next Door" afatanyije na Ayra Starr wo muri Nijeriya. Muri Nyakanga 2023, yasohoye indirimbo "Water" nk’indirimbo iyoboye album ye ya mbere yitwa Tyla. Nyuma yo kuzamura akarasisi k'imbyino kuri TikTok, "Water" yabaye iyambere mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Afurika y’Epfo, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, n’Ubwongereza. Tyla yabaye umuhanzi wa mbere ukiri muto wo muri Afurika y’Epfo winjiye ku rutonde rwa US Billboard Hot 100 nyuma y’imyaka 55, nyuma y’indirimbo "Grazing in the Grass" ya Hugh Masekela mu 1968.
Tyla yaririmbye "Water" muri The Bianca Show muri Suwede no muri "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" muri Amerika. Video yayo yasohotse ku wa 6 Ukwakira 2023, irebwa n'abarenga miliyoni 3 kuri YouTube mu minsi itatu gusa. Tyla yaje gukora kuri remix y’indirimbo "Girls Need Love" ya Summer Walker, yasohotse muri Girls Mix extended play muri Ukwakira 2023. Mu mpera za Ukuboza 2023, yatangaje ko album ye ya mbere yitwa Tyla (2024) igiye gusohoka, anasohora indirimbo eshatu: "Truth or Dare", "On and On", na "Butterflies" nk’indirimbo z’ibanze zo kwamamaza iyi album. Tyla yaririmbye indirimbo nka "Water" na "Truth or Dare" mu musozo wa Season 24 ya The Voice ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2023. Muri Gashyantare 2024, yatsindiye igihembo cya mbere cya Grammy Award mu cyiciro cya Best African Music Performance bigizwemo uruhare n'indirimbo ye "Water", aba n’umuhanzi ukiri muto wa mbere w’Afurika wegukanye Grammy Award.
Album ye yitwa Tyla yasohotse ku wa 22 Werurwe 2024 binyuze kuri Fax na Epic Records. Video y’indirimbo "Art" yasohokeye icyarimwe n’iyi album. Tyla yakiriwe neza n’abasesenguzi b’umuziki, maze album ye iba mu 25 za mbere mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Ubwongereza, u Buholandi, Noruveji, Nouvelle-Zélande, n’Ubusuwisi. Tyla yabonye amahirwe menshi yo gutoranywa mu bihembo bya Metro FM Music Awards muri Afurika y’Epfo, aho yahawe amahirwe atandatu. Nyuma yaho, yegukanye ibihembo byinshi mu 2024 BET Awards, anganya na Usher na Victoria Monét i Los Angeles, aho yagaragaye mu imbyino ya "Jump" bwa mbere hamwe na Gunna na Skillibeng. Ku wa 11 Ukwakira 2024, Tyla yasohoye album ye ya mbere mu buryo bwa deluxe edition, irimo indirimbo eshatu nshya, harimo "Push 2 Start". Mu buryo bw’umuziki, "Push 2 Start" ni indirimbo ya reggae yifitemo injyana ya amapiano pop-R&amp;B, yakiriwe neza n’abakunzi b’umuziki, video yayo ikaza gusohoka kuri YouTube ku wa 8 Ugushyingo 2024. Tyla yatanze ibitaramo muri Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2024. Ku wa 11 Ugushyingo 2024, yagaragaye bwa mbere muri MTV Europe Music Awards (EMAs), aho yaririmbye indirimbo "Push 2 Start" na "Water". Icyi gihe, yatsindiye ibihembo 3 bya EMAs mu byiciro bya ‘Best African Act’, ‘Best Afrobeats Artist’ na ‘Best R&amp;B Artist’. Ku wa 28 Gashyantare, Tyla yagaragaye mu ndirimbo "When I'm With You" iri kuri album "Alter Ego" ya Lisa, umuraperi wo muri Tayilande.
Tyla akura ikitegererezo k'ubahanzi barimo Michael Jackson, Rihanna, Britney Spears, Drake, Wizkid, Freshlyground, Aaliyah na Cassie. Yavuze ko inzozi ze ari ukuba icyamamare cya mbere ku isi kiririmba injyana ya "Pop" kiva muri Afurika. Kuva icyo gihe yatangiye gufatwaga nk'"Umwamikazi wa Popiano", guhuza injyana ya pop na amapiano, yashizwemo bimwe mubifitanye isano n'injyana zirimo R&amp;B na Afrobeats.

Sarah Oyinkansola Aderibigbe Sarah Oyinkansola Aderibigbe (wavutse ku ya 14 Kamena 2002), uzwi cyane nka Ayra Starr, ni umuririmbyi akaba n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo wo muri Nijeriya. Yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu mwaka wa 2022 ubwo yasohoraga indirimbo “Rush”. Iyo ndirimbo yagiye ku rutonde rw’indirimbo zikunzwe mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Ubusuwisi, Irilande n’Ubwongereza, aho yageze ku mwanya wa 24. Yanamuhesheje kandi guhabwa nominasiyo mu bihembo bya Grammy ku nshuro ya 66 nk’umunyafurika witwaye neza.
Mu ntangiriro za 2021, Starr yatangiye umwuga we asohora umuzingo wambere windirimbo wiswe Ayra Starr ndetse nindirimbo yambere yari iriho yise " Away ", yamaze ibyumweru bibiri bikurikiranye kuri numero ya kane kurutonde rwa TurnTable Top 50 ya Nijeriya; iyi indirimbo kandi yageze ku mwanya wa 17 kuri Billboard Top Triller Global chart. Yakurikiwe no kumurika alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio, 19 &amp; Dangerous (2021). yashyizwe mu byiciro nka Afropop na R&amp;B, yakiriwe neza kandi itanga ibyiciro bibiri bya mbere muri Nijeriya. Indirimbo ya mbere yise " Umusamariya uva amaraso " yageze ku mbonerahamwe ya Top 50, iba indirimbo ya mbere y’umuhanzi w’umugore igeze ku mwanya wa mbere. Muri Kanama muri uwo mwaka, Starr yashyizwe ku mwanya wa gatatu ku bahanzi bitezwe muri Billboard.
Muri 2024, Starr yasohoye alubumu ye ya kabiri, "Umwaka nujuje imyaka 21".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Oyinkansola Sarah Aderibigbe yavutse ku ya 14 Kamena 2002 i Cotonou muri Bénin, akurira aho no muri i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Ni Umunyanijeriyakazi wo mumuco waba Yoruba, hamwe n'ababyeyi bombi bo muri Leta ya Kwara. Yakuriye mu ndimi nyinshi, yiga Yoruba kandi yiga n'Igifaransa mu myaka ye ya mbere i Bénin, azi kandi neza icyongereza nururimi rwa Nigeriya Pidgin akoresha kenshi mu mirimo ye no mu mikoranire y'abanyamakuru. Umuryango we wimutse kenshi bitewe nubucuruzi bwa se, byatumye bigorana kurema ubucuti burambye nabandi bana mumashuri yisumbuye. Aderibigbe ni uwa kabiri mu bana batanu. Mukuru we Dami (wavutse 2000) yabaye umucuranzi wa gitari na nutunganya umuziki; barumuna be barimo Ade, Tolulope, na Jesutunmise. Umuziki wari ingenzi mubuzima bwumuryango. Nyina, wahoze ari umuririmbyi, na Dami bagize uruhare rukomeye mukubagenderaho. Afite imyaka icumi, yinjiye muri korari y'ishuri atangira kwandika indirimbo hamwe na Dami, bayobowe na nyina na nyirasenge. Abavandimwe be nabo bashinze itsinda kandi bahoraga binjira mumarushanwa yumuziki waho bari batuye.
Nubwo Aderibigbe yakundaga ubuhanzi akiri ingimbi, ise yari yaramusabye gushyira imbere amasomo mbere yuko apfa. Yize muri kaminuza Cours Sonou muri Cotonou ahabwa impamyabumenyi ya BA mu mibanire mpuzamahanga na siyanse ya politiki. Mu myaka ya kaminuza, yakunze gutotezwa nabanyeshuri bigana kubera imyaka ye ndetse nisura. Kugira ngo ahangane n'ibyiyumvo yagize byo gutukwa, yitabaje umuziki. "Numvaga Nicki Minaj ngiye ku ishuri maze nkumva meze nka Nicki Minaj wa kabiri." Nyina wa Aderibigbe yashyigikiraga cyane ibyifuzo bye bya muzika kandi buri gihe yamushishikarizaga gukora umwuga wo kuririmba.
2018–2020: Intangiriro yumwuga.
Ubunararibonye bwa Starr bwarimo guhatana akiri umwana kuri televiziyo ya Nigeriya yerekana impano ya "Maltina Dance All", aho yarangije ku mwanya wa kabiri kandi yatsindiye televiziyo nk'igihembo, ibyo umuryango we wabonaga ari ikimenyetso cyerekana impano ye hakiri kare. Mu myaka y’ishuri, yakoze mashup ibyitwa nko kuvanga indirimbo ebyiri arizo One Direction '" Inkuru y'Ubuzima Bwanjye " na " Sade " ya Adekunle Gold mu gitaramo cy'ishuri. Nk’uko Starr abitangaza ngo iki gitaramo cyateye ababyeyi n'abarimu amarira, maze ashishikarizwa gufatana uburemere umuziki, ibyo bikaba byararanze ibyo yaje kuvuga ko ari "itangiriro". Muri 2018, Starr yasinyanye na Quove Models, ikigo gishinzwe kwerekana imideli i Lagos. Nyuma yaje kwigana ibigo nka Studio ya Mazelle, Ikinyamakuru cyuzuye cyimyambarire, na Esperanza Woman. Nyuma yaje kuvuga ko umuziki n’imyambarire ari inyungu zuzuzanya byaje bisanzwe kuri we.
Muri icyo gihe kimwe, yatangiye no guteza imbere umwuga we wo kuririmba binyuze kuri murandasi. Muri 2019, yatangiye gushyira hanze indirimbo zisubiyemo b zabahanzi nka Andra Day na 2Face Idibia kumbuga nkoranyambaga. Muri uwo mwaka, Starr yanakinnye mu gitaramo cy’imivugo aho yerekanaga amashusho ya Jorja Smith " Ntunyitegereze ndira ", yibutsa ko bamwe mu bari bateraniye aho barize mu gihe cye. Yahisemo izina rya stage "Ayra Starr" kubera ko ryasobanuraga "gukanguka no guhumura amaso," kandi agaragara mu mashusho y’indirimbo ya Eri Ife yise" Umugore w'ejo hazaza.Nubwo yakomeje kwamamara kuri murandasi ntiyakomeje gushidikanya ku bijyanye no gukurikirana umuziki ndetse anatekereza ku micungire y’umuziki kugira ngo ashyigikire amashusho y’umuvandimwe we Dami. Nkumuntu warukiri kwiga, yashimwe, byatumye abarimu bamutangarira kubona amashusho ye muri telephone zabo yakozwe nikigo cyumuziki gikorera abahanzi bazwi nka Di'Ja na Korede Bello.
Sarah Oyinkansola Aderibigbe Sarah Oyinkansola Aderibigbe (wavutse ku ya 14 Kamena 2002), uzwi cyane nka Ayra Starr, ni umuririmbyi n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo wo muri Nijeriya. Yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu 2022 ubwo yasohoraga indirimbo “Rush”. Ukuboza 2019, Starr yashyize ahagaragara indirimbo yumwimerere yitwa "Ibyangiritse" kurupapuro rwe rwa Instagram. Mu masaha atatu, uwashinze Mavin Don Jazzy yamwoherereje ubutumwa butaziguye bugaragaza ko ashimishijwe n'umuziki we kandi amutumira guhura. Nyuma Starr yabibonye yari kurya ibinyampeke maze abonye ubutumwa avuza induru yishimye, nuko nyirasenge amufasha gutanga igisubizo. Don Jazzy yavumbuye page ye abinyujije kumuntu wamukurikinaga kumbuga nkoranyambaga wakundaga gusangiza abandi ibihangano byabahanzi bakiri bato. Abonye ubutumwa bwe bwa mbere butabonye igisubizo, yamuvugishije abinyujije kuri musaza we. Isomo rya mbere rya Starr kuri Studiyo ya Mavin kwari ukumenyekanisha amajwi yabigize umwuga. Yiyemereye ko yari afite ubwoba bwinshi muri ibyo bihe; we na murumuna we bizihizaga bucece igihe cyose Don Jazzy yabaga avuye mucyumba, hanyuma akongera guhimba agarutse. Nyuma yaje gutekereza ku miterere ya Mavin nkumuryango aho gushingira ku bucuruzi., muri 2020 yafatiye amajwi muri Studiyo ya Mavin i Lagos hamwe na ba producer Louddaaa, Don Jazzy, na Dayogrey.
Umuzingo wambere yikoreye yise umukino wa wagutse wasohotse ku ya 22 Mutarama 2021 abinyujije kuri Mavin Records. yasobanuwe nk "amateka y’urukundo cyangwa ibihe bishingiye ku rukundo" kandi "ahuza ibintu bya R&amp;amp;B / neo-roho na Afropop percussion." Starr yavuze ko icyifuzo cye muri aya majwi ari ugukora umuziki uzumvikana n'abumva ndetse n'abakuru. Kuvanga no kumenya neza umuzingo wizo ndirimbo byakozwe na Ikon, Louddaaa na Johnny Drille. Starr yanditse imwe mu ndirimbo kuri uwo muzingo wenyine kandi afatanya kwandika eyne zisigaye hamwe na murumuna we Dami. Nyuma gato yo gusohoka, uwo muzingo wabaye alubumu ya mbere kuri Nigeriya iTunes na Apple Music. Kugeza muri Werurwe 2021, wageze ku mwanya umwe kuri Apple Music mu bindi bihugu 4, yumvwa munshuro zirenga miliyoni 15 muri Spotify, YouTube na Audio Mack. Uyu mushinga wabyaye inzira " Away " wageze ku mwanya wa kane kuri TurnTable Top 50 yo muri Nijeriya na 17 muri Amerika Billboard Top Triller Global. Amashusho y'indirimbo ayiherekeza kandi yerekanwe ku rubuga rwa MTV Base rwa "Naija" Top 10 "." Starr yasohoye verisiyo ya remix ya "Ija" na " Away " irimo Tokimonsta na Lilo hagati ya Werurwe na Mata. Muri kiriya gihe kimwe, Umuzingo "Twelve AM" ya Crayon wasohotse hamwe nijwi rye mundirimbo "Muri Sync." Yakinnye muri " UC Berkeley " Ishyirahamwe ry’abanyeshuri bo muri Nijeriya ryerekana umuco wiswe Olori Awards. Muri Mata 2021, amashusho y’indirimbo ye "DITR" yasohotse kuri YouTube abinyujije kuri Mavin. Muri Kamena 2021, hasohotse amashusho yindirimbo yindi ndirimbo yitwa "Sare". Amashusho yindirimbo yombi yayobowe na Afolabi Olalekan.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2021, Starr yaririmbye shampiyona yanyuma ya "Nigeriya Idol". Ku ya 6 Kanama 2021, Album ye ya mbere ya studio, yise "19 &amp;amp; Dangerous" yashyizwe ahagaragara. Kuri iyi alubumu, yakoranye na bagenzi be bahoze bakorana Louddaaa na Don Jazzy, bombi bakaba baragize uruhare mu gutanga umusaruro kuri EP "Ayra Starr", ndetse n'abafatanyabikorwa bashya, London na Andre Vibez. Iyi alubumu yerekanye bwa mbere gufatanwa amajwi hamwe nabahanzi babatumirwa nka Fousheé na CKay. Yahuye niyakirwa ryiza hamwe nabashima benshi amajwi yayo nkayambere muri Afropop na R&amp;B. Yabyaye ibitego bibiri bya mbere mirongo ine kuri "TurnTable" Top 50, isumba izindi ni " Umusamariya Wamaraso ", iyo indirimbo yonyine, yabaye iya Starr ya mbere ya mbere ku mbonerahamwe. Indirimbo yazamutse muri Top 50 mu byumweru byinshi, kandi, ku mbonerahamwe yo ku ya 27 Nzeri 2021, yageze ku mwanya wa mbere, bituma Starr aba umuhanzi w'umugore wa mbere ubikora ufite indirimbo wenyine. ' ["4" ​ Muri Nzeri 2021, yagizwe ambasaderi w’ikirango muri Pepsi Nigeriya. Bukeye, Starr yaririmbye mugihe cyo kwerekana imbonankubone ya "Big Brother Naija". Yakoranye na Check kuri "Akaga", indirimbo ya kabiri kuri alubumu ye "Bravo". Mu bihembo bya 8 bya Afurika Muzik Magazine Awards, yatorewe igihembo cyiza cy'umuhanzi mushya. Muri Werurwe 2022, Starr yiswe "Up Now" na serivise yo gutunganya umuziki Audiomack.
Ku ya 16 Nzeri 2022, Starr yasohoye " Rush " nkimwe mundirimbo zigize album ya "19 &amp;amp; Dangerous". mu turere twinshi, harimo Ubusuwisi, Irilande n'Ubwongereza, aho yageze ku mwanya wa 24. Yabaye indirimbo yambere icuranzwe cyane kuri spotify yakozwe numugore wenyine wumunyanijeriya kandi yanatumye aba umunyafurika wambere wumugore urenze miliyoni ijana kundirimbo imwe yarebwe kuri yutube kandi yanatumye Starr ahamagarwa bwambere muri Grammy Awards ya 66 ngarukamwaka mu bihembo byiza bya muzika nyafurika. ​"​" Kuya 10 Ugushyingo2022 yagaragaye mu ndirimbo ya Wizkid ya gatanu kuri alubumu yitwa urukundo rwinshi kwiyemera gucye. Indirimbo yageze ku mwanya wa 1 mu ndirimbo zigezweho kuri Billboard, kandi yerekanwe ku mwanya wa 5 ku mbonerahamwe y’indirimbo za Billboard US Afrobeats. Ku ya 4 Werurwe 2023, Starr yerekeje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga atangaza ko umuziki we wakoreshejwe mu rwego rwo gufata amajwi ya filime "Creed III". Ku ya 13 Nyakanga 2023, Starr yatangaje ko azayobora urugendo rwe rwa mbere ruzenguruka isi rwiswe 21: The World Tour. Muri urwo ruzinduko harimo guhagarara Amerika ya Ruguru, Afurika, Uburayi na Ositaraliya. Ku ya 27 Ukwakira 2023, yagaragaye ku ndirimbo ya David Guetta yitwa " Big FU ", hamwe n'umuraperi Lil Durk. Yageze ku mwanya wa 23 ku ndirimbo za Afrobeats zo muri Amerika na No 18 kuri Nouvelle-Zélande Top 40 yambere.
2024 - ubungubu: "Umwaka nujuje imyaka 21".
Mu mpera za 2023, Starr yatangiye gukora kuri alubumu ye ya kabiri yo muri studio, "Umwaka nujuje imyaka 21". Umushinga wagaragaje ubwihindurize bukomeye mubukorikori bwe, bugaragaza insanganyamatsiko yo kwishakisha, urukundo, intimba no guha imbaraga. Starr yasobanuye ko umutwe wa alubumu watewe inkunga no kuba yarakuze, asobanura ko "atari imyaka gusa, ahubwo ko ari imikurire, kwivumbura, n'amasomo nize mu nzira." Amahugurwa yo gufata amajwi yabereye kuri Studiyo ya Mavin i Lagos akomeza mu 2024, hamwe n’umusanzu watanzwe na Louddaaa, London, na Johnny Drille, ndetse na producer Rvssian watowe na Grammy. Starr yavuze ko gufata amajwi ari "urugendo rwo kugerageza no kwigaragaza, aho nemereye kuba umunyantege nke." Mugihe cyo gutunganya alubumu, Starr yatangiye kubaka imbaraga n'amahirwe akomeye n'abafatanyabikorwa. Ku ya 5 Werurwe 2024, umuhanzi w’umunyamerika uririmba injyana ya R&amp;B, Chris Brown, yatangaje ko mu 2024 Starr azaba kimwe mu bikorwa byo gutangiza uruzinduko rwe rwa 11:11 muri Amerika ya Ruguru, bishimangira kuba mpuzamahanga ahari ku ya 8 Mata 2024, producer Rvssian wo muri Jamayike yasohoye indirimbo " Santa ", ku bufatanye n’umuhanzi Starr hamwe n’umuhanzi Rauw Alejandro wa reggaeton. Inzira yahindutse yamenyekanye cyane, ihuza Afropop, reggaeton, na Dancehall. Byatumye kandi Starr aba umuhanzi wambere wigitsina gore wo muri Nigeriya wageze kuri miliyoni 20 zabantu bamwumva kuri Spotify. Muri uko kwezi, Starr yitabiriye ibirori bya Fenty i Londres, aho yahuriye na Rihanna. Imikoranire yabo, yafashwe muri videwo ikwirakwizwa cyane, yateje kwibaza ku bufatanye bushoboka. Rihanna, wavumbuye umuziki wa Starr abinyujije kuri mubyara we, yagaragaje ko yishimiye Starr anabaza ibijyanye no gukorana na Starr na Tems. Nyuma Starr yagize icyo avuga ku mikoranire, agaragaza ko yishimiye ko Rihanna ashimishijwe kandi ko yiteguye gukorana n'abahanzi bombi mu bihe biri imbere.
Mbere yo gusohora TYIT21, Starr yabanje gusohora izindi ndirimbo nyinshi ari wenyine. "Rhythm &amp; Blues" yasohotse ku ya 13 Nzeri 2023, yinjiye mu nsanganyamatsiko z’urukundo na karahanyuze, mu gihe "Commas" yasohotse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2024, yagaragaje icyizere n'ubwigenge mu bijyanye n'amafaranga. "Santa", yasohotse ku ya 8 Mata 2024, yabaye inzira ihagaze neza, ishimirwa injyana yayo ishimishije ndetse n'amagambo akinisha. Buri ndirimbo yari iherekejwe n'amashusho yindirimbo zigaragara ziyobowe nabayobozi bakomeye bo muri Afrika, byubaka gutegereza alubumu yuzuye. "Umwaka nujuje imyaka 21" wasohotse kumugaragaro ku ya 31 Gicurasi 2024, binyuze muri Mavin Records. Iyi alubumu igaragaramo ubufatanye n'abahanzi nka Seyi Vibez, Coco Jones, Giveon, Asake, Anitta na Rauw Alejandro. Indirimbo nka "Umugore w'umukomando," zirimo Coco Jones na Anitta, zigaragaza ubushobozi bwa Starr bwo guhuza injyana ya Afrobeat nuburyo bwa pop bwiburengerazuba. Avuga kuri ubwo ku bufatanye, yagize ati: "Buri muhanzi yazanye ikintu kidasanzwe, ansunika gushakisha impande nshya z'ubuhanzi bwanjye." Imaze gusohoka, alubumu yatangiriye ku mwanya wa mbere ku mbonerahamwe ya Album ya Nijeriya maze yinjira muri Billboard 200 kuri No 195, bituma Starr aba umuhanzi w’umugore wa mbere wo muri Nijeriya wageze kuri iyi ntambwe. Abakenguzamateka bashimye umusaruro wayo udasanzwe hamwe no kuvuga inkuru hamwe. "Pitchfork" yavuze ko iyo alubumu ari "umurimo utinyitse kandi werekana neza unasobanura Afropop igezweho." Inndirimbo nka "21" zashimiwe cyane kubwimbaraga zamarangamutima, mugihe "Abana Bameze neza" yagaragazaga amajwi yumuryango wa Starr, bigatuma abamwumva bamenya neza ubuzima bwe bwite. Nyuma yo kumurika alubumu, Starr yakoze ibitaramo mpuzamahanga bikomeye kandi ashyigikira abahanzi bamenyekanye mu ngendo zikomeye. Yabashije kuba nk'igikorwa cyo gutangiza urugendo rwa Chris Brown mu 2024 11:11 Yerekeje mu mijyi 26 yo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru kuva muri Kamena kugeza Kanama, aho yerekanaga inndirimbo nshya kuva kuri "mu mwaka nujuje imyaka 21". Muri kamena 2024, Starr yakoze amateka nkumuhanzi wambere wumugore wumunyafurika witwaye neza kuri Glastonbury Festival ya Pyramid Stage. Yayoboye kandi Afro Nation Detroit muri Kanama. Abakenguzamateka berekanye "umwaka nujuje imyaka 21" nkisobanura ubuzima bwa Starr, aho "Billboard" yayishimye "nk'insanganyamatsiko yerekana gukura no nintumbero zihura n'imico yose." Starr yakoranye na Coldplay ku ndirimbo "Ibyiyumvo byiza" yo muri alubumu ya "Moon Music" ya Coldplay kandi yari igikorwa cyo gushyigikira itsinda rya Muzika rya Spheres World Tour muri Ositaraliya na Nouvelle-Zélande.
Muri Gashyantare 2025, Starr yatangije umwaka n'indirimbo ye ya mbere yise "Urukundo Rwose", ashyiraho urwego ruzaba umwe mu myaka ye yihinduka rye. uko kwezi, yakoze amateka muri MOBO Awards yabereye muri Utilita Arena ya Newcastle ku ya 18 Gashyantare, aba umugore wa mbere mu myaka 16 wegukanye igihembo cyitwa amategeko meza ya muzika nyafurika. Yatsindiye kandi amategeko mpuzamahanga meza. Muri Mata yabaye umuhanzi wa mbere w’umugore wo muri Nijeriya wabonye icyemezo cya Diamond cyo mu kilatini cyatanzwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’inganda zandika amajwi muri Amerika kubera ubufatanye bwe 2024 na "Santa" na Rvssian na Rauw Alejandro, binjije miliyoni zirenga 35 mukurebwa. Ku ya 25 Mata, yasohoye " Gimme Dat " irimo Wizkid, yerekana "911" ya Wyclef Jean na Mary J. Blige. Muri Kamena, Starr yatsindiye igihembo cye cya mbere cya BET kubera igihembo mpuzamahanga cyiza mu birori byabereye mu nzu mberabyombi ya Peacock i Los Angeles ku ya 9 Kamena, atoranya abatoranijwe barimo Black Sherif wo muri Gana, mugenzi we wo muri Nijeriya witwa Rema, na Tyla na Uncle Waffles wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Urugendo rwe rwo mu mpeshyi 2025 rwatangiye ku ya 20 Kamena hamwe n’igitaramo cyabereye mu iserukiramuco rya Summerjam New Jersey, hakurikiraho kugaragara mu iserukiramuco ry’umuziki ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Kitts ku ya 28 Kamena na Montreal International Jazz Festival ku ya 1 Nyakanga. Kuva ku ya 7 Nyakanga, yinjiye mu itsinda ry’abongereza Coldplay ku matariki menshi ya sitade kuri Muzika yabo ya Spheres World Tour, atangirana nabo murugendo rw’amajoro atatu kuri Stade ya Downsview, muri Toronto ku ya 7, 8, na 12 Kanama kuri Stade ya Downsview. Izebguruka ryakomereje kuri sitade ya Wembley muri London kuya 22 na 23 Kanama, aho Coldplay yakinnye amateka yerekana amateka ikuraho iminsi icumi icuranga kuri stade yigihugu cyUbwongereza.
Hagati muri Nyakanga, Starr yasinyanye amasezerano n’ubuyobozi mpuzamahanga na Roc Nation ya Jay-Z mu gihe asigaye yasinywe na Mavin Records kugira ngo asohore umuziki. Ubufatanye bufatika bwateguwe kugirango akoreshe imbaraga zo kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga, cyane cyane ku isoko ry’Amerika. Iri tangazo ryagaragaye ku ya 16 Nyakanga, ryemeje ko Roc Nation izagenzura imurikagurisha rye ku isi, kuzenguruka, gutumaho, ndetse n'amasezerano yemeza, cyane cyane muri Amerika n'Uburayi. Ku ya 25 Nyakanga, yasohoye " Umubiri ushyushye ", indirimbo yinjizwamo imbyino yakozwe na Ragee na The Elements, yashimiwe n'basesenguzi, hamwe na "Billboard" yayise "igikonjo cyihuta cya divayi". Iyi ndirimbo yaranze isohoka rye rya mbere munsi yubuyobozi bwa Roc Nation kandi ihinduka ihatanira igihembo cy'impeshyi. Ku ya 27 Nzeri, Starr yaririmbye mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’abenegihugu muri Parike Nkuru ya New York ari kumwe kuruhembe na Cardi B na Shakira, ndetse na Tyla, Mariah Umuhanga, na Camilo. Iri serukiramuco ryakiriwe na Ambasaderi w’umuturage w’isi Hugh Jackman hamwe na Bill Nye, Adam Lambert, Danai Gurira, na Liza Koshy, ryanyuze ku isi hose ku bantu barenga 60.000 bari bitabiriye ibyatsi binini. Mu gitaramo cye, Starr yazanye mugenzi we wo muri Nijeriya Rema nk'umushyitsi utunguranye, maze bakorera hamwe "Rush", bakurikirwa na Rema yise " Calm down " na " Uruhinja (Ni Icyaha) ". Icyi ggihe cyabaye kimwe mubintu byavuzwe cyane mu birori. Nyuma yiyi mikoranire yakataraboneka, Starr na Rema bashyize ahagaragara ubufatanye bwabo bwa mbere nkabahanzi bafatanije kuyobora bise "Ninde uriya mukobwa" ku ya 17 Ukwakira. Iyi ndirimbo yakozwe na Ragee hamwe n’ubundi bufasha bwaturutse muri The Elements, yahujije imbyino, R&amp;B, n’iburasirazuba bwo hagati mu bunararibonye bwa Afro-Dance.
Muri Nzeri 2021, Starr yagizwe ambasaderi w’ikirango cya Pepsi Nigeria. Mu Kwakira 2021, yagaragaye mu rukurikirane rwa televiziyo The Cover. Yongeye kugaragara muri Fall/Winter 2021 issue of "ODDA" Muri uwo mwaka kandi, yagaragaye mu nyandiko ya Notion. Nyuma yaho, muri Gashyantare 2025 yasinyiye amasezerano yo kwamamaza ikirango New Balance hamwe n’umuhanzi n’umukinnyi Jaden Smith, aba umwe mubagaragaza urukurikirane rushya rw’imyambaro ya siporo. Ubundi bufatanye bwe bwatangiriye kuri Maybelline New York, aho ahagarariye uruganda rw’ibirungo byo kwisiga muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara hamwe na Darling Nigeria.

Mugesera ni umwe mu mirenge 14 igize Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda. Uyu murenge uri ku nkombe y’Ikiyaga cya Mugesera.
Mu 2022, Umurenge wa Mugesera wari utuwe n’abaturage 28 637. Abaturage bose babaga mu cyaro. Muri uyu murenge hahingwa inanasi nyinshi. Mu 2021, hubakwaga uruganda rutunganya inanasi.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Mugesera uri mu Karere ka Ngoma. Akarere ka Ngoma gafite imirenge 14. Umurenge wa Mugesera uri ku nkombe y’Ikiyaga cya Mugesera. Ni agace kagira imvura nke.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Mugesera wari utuwe n’abaturage 25 716. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, abaturage bari 28 637. Muri bo, abagabo bari 13 624. Abagore bari 15 013. Abana bari munsi y’imyaka 15 bari 10 725. Abaturage bose babaga mu cyaro.
Mu Karere ka Ngoma, inanasi zihingwa ku buso burenga hegitari 4 000. Zihingwa cyane mu mirenge ya Zaza, Sake na Mugesera. Mu Murenge wa Mugesera, inanasi zihingwa ku buso burenga hegitari 2 500. Koperative y’abahinzi b’inanasi ya Mugesera (KOABANAMU) yari ifite abanyamuryango barenga 90.
Mu 2021, ikigo 1000 Hills Products Rwanda cyubakaga uruganda rutunganya inanasi mu Murenge wa Mugesera. Ku itariki ya 10 Mutarama 2021, imvura nyinshi yasenye igice cy’urwo ruganda. Uruganda rwari ruteganyijwe gutangira kwakira inanasi muri Kanama 2021.
Umurenge wa Mugesera washimiwe uko wakoze umuganda mu mwaka wa 2015–2016. Wanashimiwe kubaka inyubako izakoreramo polisi.
Mu ntangiriro za 2018, abaturage batangiye kubakira imidugudu yabo ibiro. Muri Kamena 2018, imidugudu irindwi yari yararangije kubaka ibiro byayo. Ibindi biro 28 byari bikiri kubakwa. Ibiro bimwe byatwaraga hagati ya miliyoni 3 na miliyoni 5 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

"IBYIGOJURU BIKORA GUTE?"
Amoko y’Ibikoresho Bikoreshwa Mu Byogajuru
Ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu byogajuru ni ibice by’ikoranabuhanga bishyirwa ku byogajuru (satellites) kugira ngo bifashe mu mirimo itandukanye harimo itumanaho, kugenzura isi, ubushakashatsi mu kirere, imiyoborere y’ubwirinzi n’ibindi. Ibyogajuru ubwabyo bikora nk’icyicaro cyangwa icyuma cy’ikoranabuhanga gishobora kugenda mu isanzure, kikohereza cyangwa kikakira amakuru.
Ibikoresho bikoreshwa kuri ibi byogajuru bigira amoko atandukanye, bitewe n’akazi byagenewe gukora. Uko ikoranabuhanga rigenda ritera imbere, ni ko n’ibi bikoresho bigenda bitera imbere mu bunini, ubushobozi no mu gukoresha ingufu nke.
1. Ibyogajuru by’Itumanaho (Communication Satellites).
Ibi ni byo byogajuru bikunze gukoreshwa cyane ku isi. Bifasha mu gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho nka televiziyo, telefoni, internet, n’itumanaho rya gisirikare. Bikoreshwa mu guhuza ibice bitandukanye by’isi hakoreshejwe sinyali za radiyo cyangwa microwave.
Ibyo bikoresho bikubiyemo:
2. Ibyogajuru byo Kugenzura Isi (Earth Observation Satellites).
Ibi byogajuru bigamije gutanga amakuru ajyanye n’imiterere y’ubutaka, ibidukikije, n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Bikoreshwa mu buhinzi, igenamigambi ry’imijyi, kugenzura ibiza n’ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi.
Ibikoresho bikubiyemo:
3. Ibyogajuru bya Gisirikare (Military Satellites).
Ibi ni ibyogajuru bikoreshwa n’ingabo mu rwego rwo kwicungira umutekano, gutahura ibikorwa by’abanzi, cyangwa gutanga amakuru ku bijyanye n’ikirere n’aho ibikoresho bya gisirikare biri. Bimwe bikora akazi k’ubutasi, gufata amajwi n’amashusho, n’ibindi.
Ibikoresho bikubiyemo:
4. Ibyogajuru by’Imyidagaduro n’Itumanaho rusange.
Ibi byogajuru bitanga serivisi zijyanye n’imyidagaduro, harimo gukwirakwiza amajwi n’amashusho, radio, GPS, n’ibindi. Bikoreshwa n’abantu ku giti cyabo cyangwa ibigo bikora ubucuruzi.
Ibikoresho bikubiyemo:
5. Ibyogajuru bito: CubeSats, NanoSats, na MicroSats.
Ni ibyogajuru bifite ubunini buto cyane, bikaba bikoreshwa cyane mu bushakashatsi mu mashuri makuru, mu bucuruzi buto, no mu kwiga ikoranabuhanga rishya. Kubera igiciro gito cyo kubitunganya no kubohereza mu isanzure, byatumye bihinduka ibikoresho by’ingenzi mu iterambere ry’itumanaho ryihariye n’ubumenyi.
6. Ibyogajuru by’Ubushakashatsi bw’Isanzure (Space Science Satellites).
Bikoreshwa mu bushakashatsi mu by’ikirere n’isanzure, nko kugenzura inyenyeri, inyuguti z’ikirere (galaxies), umwimerere w’umwuka, n’ubushakashatsi ku mibumbe nka Mars cyangwa Venus.
Ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu byogajuru bigira uruhare rukomeye mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Bifasha mu itumanaho, mu kurengera ibidukikije, mu kwita ku buzima bw’abantu, no mu kurinda umutekano w’ibihugu. Iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga rizakomeza kwagura ubushobozi bw’ibi bikoresho no gutuma byorohera ibihugu n’abantu ku giti cyabo kubikoresha.
