UMUBUMBE WA MARISI..
Marisi ni umubumbe wa kane uva ku zuba, ukaba uzwi cyane ku izina rya "Umubumbe Utukura"bitewe n'ibara ryawo ritukura ku butaka burimo umuringa wa feri (iron oxide). Dore ibintu bimwe na bimwe by'ingenzi ku bijyanye na Marisi:
Imiterere ya Marisi..
Ingano: Ufite ubunini buri hafi ya kimwe cya kabiri cy'ubw'Isi, n'uburemere bungana na 10.7% bw'ubw'Isi.
Ibidukikije: Marisi ifite ikirere cyoroshye cyane kigizwee ahanini na dioxyde de carbone (CO₂) ku kigero cya 95%, hamwe n'ubushyuhe buri hagati ya -153°C na +20°C.
Imiterere y'ubutaka: Ifite imisozi miremire, ibiyaga byumye, n'ibice byahoze ari ibiyaga, harimo n'ahantu h'ubusitani bw'ubutaka.
Imisozi n'ibibaya: Harimo umusozi muremure cyane witwa Olympus Mons, ndetse n'ikibaya kinini cya Valles Marineris.
Imibumbe y'ikuzimu: Ifite udukombe tubiri duto twitwa Phobos na Deimos.
Amazi n'Ubuzima bushoboka..
Amazi: Ubushakashatsi bushya bwerekanye ko Marisi ishobora kugira amazi menshi kurusha uko byatekerezwaga mbere, ashobora kuba afungiye mu myobo ya vulukano iri hagati ya 11.5 na 20 km munsi y'ubutaka.
Ibimenyetso by'ubuzima: Ikigo cya NASA cyabonye ibimenyetso byerekana ko Marisi ishobora kuba yarigeze kuba habayeho ubuzima, harimo n'ibimenyetso bya carbonate minerals byerekana ko habayeho amazi n'ikirere cyiza mu bihe byashize.

1.UMUTI MUBIJYANYE NUBUZIMA
Umuti ni ikintu (kiba igikoze mu bimera, imiti y’iwacu cyangwa se ikorwa mu nganda) gikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara cyangwa kurwanya uburibwe.
Ijambo "umuti" rifite igisobanuro nyamukuru cyo ikintu gikiza cyangwa gikemura ikibazo – yaba indwara, amakimbirane, cyangwa ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose.

Umurenge wa Kivuye ni umwe mu mirenge 17 igize Akarere ka Burera, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.

Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Burera kagizwe n'imirenge 17. Umurenge wa Kivuye ni umwe muri yo.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Kivuye wari utuwe n'abaturage 15 448. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 18 057. Abagabo bari 8 609. Abagore bari 9 448.

Umurenge wa Gatunda ni umwe mu mirenge 14 igize Akarere ka Nyagatare, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Gatunda wari utuwe n'abaturage 35 310. Ibitaro bya Gatunda byagenewe abaturage b'uyu murenge n'abo mu yindi mirenge ine.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Gatunda ni umwe mu mirenge 14 y'Akarere ka Nyagatare. Umurenge wa Gatunda wose ni icyaro.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Gatunda wari utuwe n'abaturage 27 776. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 35 310. Muri bo, abagabo bari 16 767, abagore bari 18 543.
Ibitaro bya Gatunda biri mu Karere ka Nyagatare. Kubaka ibi bitaro byatwaye amafaranga y'u Rwanda agera kuri miliyari 4. Ibitaro bya Gatunda byagenewe guha serivisi abaturage bagera ku 400 000. Abo baturage ni abo mu mirenge ya Gatunda, Kiyombe, Karama, Mimuri na Mukama.

Izina Nema ni izina rifite ubusobanuro butandukanye bitewe n’imico cyangwa ururimi rikomokamo. Rikoreshwa cyane cyane mu bihugu byo muri Afurika, ariko rishobora no kuba rikoreshwa mu zindi ndimi. Dore amakuru make kuri iryo zina:

Umudugudu wa Kabuga – Kinishya, Nyankenke, Gicumbi.
Kabuga ni umudugudu uherereye mu kagari ka Kinishya, umurenge wa Nyankenke, mu karere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Ni umwe mu midugudu yegereye imisozi ihanamye igaragaramo icyizere cy’uburumbuke, bitewe n’ubutaka bwera buhwanye n’ikirere cy’ako gace. Akarere ka Gicumbi gashyira Kabuga mu midugudu ifite amahirwe yo gutera imbere binyuze muri gahunda z’ubufatanye hagati y’abaturage n’inzego z’ibanze.
Amateka ya Kabuga yanditse kuva mu myaka ya za 2000, ubwo Leta yatangizaga gahunda y’imiturire mu midugudu igamije guteza imbere imibereho myiza n’iterambere rirambye. Abaturage batuye Kabuga biganjemo abaturutse mu bice bitandukanye bya Nyankenke, bagahurizwa hamwe n’inzego z’ubuyobozi mu rwego rwo guhuriza hamwe serivisi no koroshya igenamigambi.
Ubukungu bw’abaturage bishingiye ku buhinzi n’ubworozi. Ibigori, ibishyimbo, n’urutoki ni byo bihingwa biganje, mu gihe ubworozi burimo amatungo magufi nka ihene, inkwavu n’inkoko. Abaturage bamaze kugira ubumenyi ku buryo bwo kubyaza umusaruro ubutaka n’amatungo, hakaba harashinzwe amakoperative y’abahinzi n’aborozi, ndetse n’amatsinda y’imishinga y’ubucuruzi.
Mu bijyanye n’imibereho rusange, Kabuga ifite amahirwe yo kwegerezwa ibikorwaremezo nko kubona amazi meza avomwa ku mariba rusange, amashanyarazi atangwa na REG, n’imihanda iciriritse yegeranya ingo zigize umudugudu. Uyu muhanda uhuza Kabuga n’ahandi hatandukanye mu murenge wa Nyankenke. Harimo n’umushinga ugezweho wo gukwirakwiza imirasire y’izuba mu ngo zitaragerwaho n’umuriro w’amashanyarazi rusange.
Mu bijyanye n’uburezi n’ubuzima, Kabuga yegereye ibigo by’amashuri abanza ndetse n’ivuriro rya Kinishya, bituma abaturage babona serivisi z’ingenzi hafi. Hari kandi n’abaganga b’abajyanama b’ubuzima batuye umudugudu, bafasha mu gukurikirana isuku, ubuzima bw’abana, n’inkingo. Abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri yegereye barakomeza kubona amahirwe yo kwiga ku buryo buhoraho.
Umuco n’imyidagaduro biragaragara cyane muri Kabuga. Abaturage bishimira kwitabira amarushanwa y’imikino, inama rusange, ibitaramo byo kwidagadura, n’imihango gakondo y’ubukwe cyangwa ubukerarugendo bw’imbere mu gihugu. Kabuga irangwa n’ubufatanye hagati y’ingo, aho ibimina n’amatsinda y’ubwizigame y’abagore n’urubyiruko bikomeje kugira uruhare mu gutuma ubukungu bw’umuturage bugenda buzamuka.
Kabuga igira uruhare mu bikorwa byo kurwanya ubushomeri n’ubukene biciye muri gahunda nka “Huguka Dukore,” aho urubyiruko rurenga 30 ruri kwihugura mu myuga no kwihangira imirimo. Hari kandi amatsinda y’abagore arimo gukora imishinga y’ububoshyi, ubwogero bw’inkoko, no kubyaza umusaruro ibikomoka ku buhinzi. Inzego z’ibanze zifatanya n’abafatanyabikorwa b’iterambere (nk’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta) mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo bikorwa.
Imibare yegereye ukuri yerekana ko Kabuga igizwe n’ingo zirenga 120 n’abaturage basaga 600. Ubuyobozi bw’umudugudu bufatanya n’inama y’abaturage buri kwezi mu gukemura ibibazo, gutanga ibitekerezo no guteza imbere gahunda z’iterambere nk’imihigo. Kabuga ifite icyerekezo cyo kuba umudugudu w’icyitegererezo ku rwego rw’umurenge wa Nyankenke.
Kabuga ni umudugudu uherereye mu kagari ka Kinishya, umurenge wa Nyankenke, mu karere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Ni umwe mu midugudu igize Kinishya, ukaba uzwi mu bikorwa by’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi ndetse no mu bufatanye bw’abaturage mu rwego rw’iterambere ry’imibereho myiza.
Imiterere n’Ubuhinzi.
Kabuga iherereye ahantu h’ikirere gikonje, ku misozi ihanamye, ahakunze kuboneka imvura ihagije. Ubutaka bwaho bubyara cyane, bigatuma ubuhinzi n’ubworozi biba indashyikirwa. Abaturage baho bahinga ibigori, ibishyimbo, ibirayi, urutoki ndetse n’imboga. Hari kandi ubworozi bw’ihene, inkoko n’inka.
Kabuga yegereye ivuriro rya Kinishya ndetse n’ibigo by’amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye. Hari abajyanama b’ubuzima baba mu mudugudu, bifasha mu gukurikirana isuku, imirire, n’ubuzima rusange bw’abaturage. Abana biga mu bigo byegereye bitabira amashuri ku buryo buhoraho.
Imibereho n’Iterambere.
Abaturage ba Kabuga bafite imyumvire y’ubufatanye, bagashyira hamwe mu matsinda y’ubwizigame n’inguzanyo (ibimina), amatsinda y’abagore n’urubyiruko, ndetse n’amakoperative y’ubuhinzi n’imishinga iciriritse. Kabuga kandi ikomeje kwitabira gahunda ya Huguka Dukore aho urubyiruko rwigishwa imyuga n'ikoranabuhanga.
Kabuga ifite imihanda iciriritse iyihuza n’indi midugudu, amashanyarazi atangwa na REG, amazi meza avomwa ku masoko rusange, ndetse hari n’umushinga wo gukwirakwiza imirasire y’izuba mu ngo zitaragezwaho umuriro.
Umuco w’abaturage ba Kabuga ugaragarira mu mbyino gakondo, indirimbo, amarushanwa y’imikino n’imihango y’ubukwe bwa kinyarwanda. Umutekano urinzwe n’abaturage ubwabo binyuze mu irondo ry’umwuga n’irya kinyamwuga, bakorana n’inzego z’ibanze.
Kabuga ifite gahunda yo kubungabunga ibidukikije irimo gutera ibiti, gukusanya imyanda neza, no kurengera amasoko y’amazi. Hari ubukangurambaga bwo gukoresha ubwiherero bwa kijyambere no kwirinda isuri.
umwanditsi:Ndatimana Dodoce

Faustin Ntezilyayo yavukiye mu Karere ka Kamonyi, mu Rwanda, ku wa 20 Kanama 1962. Ni Umunyamategeko w'umunyarwanda w'inararibonye, wabaye Umucamanza Mukuru w'Urwanda kuva ku wa 6 Ukuboza 2019 kugeza ku wa 3 Ukuboza 2024.
Yize amategeko muri Kaminuza zitandukanye, harimo University of Antwerp aho yakuye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (PhD), ndetse na Free University of Brussels aho yakuye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri mu Mategeko y’imisoro.
Mu mwuga we, Nteziryayo yakoze mu nzego zitandukanye za Leta, harimo kuba Minisitiri w'Ubutabera hagati ya 1996 na 1999, ndetse akaba yarabaye Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (Vice Governor) hagati ya 2000 na 2003. Yabaye kandi Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Agency (RURA) ndetse yabaye umujyanama mu by’Amategeko muri Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda.
Uretse imirimo ya Leta, Dr. Nteziryayo yabaye Umuyobozi wa Banki y’Imari iciriritse (AGASEKE BANK) hagati ya 2011 na 2013, ndetse akaba ari umunyamuryango wa Chartered Institute of Arbitrators (FCIArb). Yabaye kandi Umucamanza mu Rukiko rw’Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (East African Court of Justice) kuva mu 2013 kugeza mu 2020.
Ni umwe mu bantu bafite ubunararibonye mu Mategeko no mu miyoborere, akaba yaragize uruhare runini mu mavugurura y’Ubutabera mu Rwanda.
Nyiricyubahiro afite Dogitora mu Mategeko (PhD in Law) yakuye muri Kaminuza ya mu Bubiligi mu 1994, Master mu Mategeko y’Imisoro (LLM in Fiscal Law) yakuye muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Bruxelles mu Bubiligi mu 1996, ndetse na Master mu by’Imibanire mpuzamahanga yihariye mu Bucuruzi mpuzamahanga (M.A in International Affairs - International Trade Policy) yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Carleton muri Kanada mu 2009.

Amasiganwa y'amagare mu Rwanda.
Irushanwa rya 17 rya Tour du Rwanda, irushanwa rya UCI Africa Tour, ryabaye kuva ku ya 23 Gashyantare kugeza ku ya 2 Werurwe 2025. Iri siganwa ryabereye mu Rwanda, ryari rigizwe n'ibyiciro 7, harimo na prologue. Eurosport itanga ikirangantego kirambuye nibisubizo kubyabaye.

Counter-Terrorism Unit (CTU).
Counter-Terrorism Unit (CTU) mu Rwanda ni ishami ryihariye rya Rwanda National Police (RNP) cyangwa Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF), rigizwe n’abantu batoranyijwe neza kandi bahuguriwe kurwanya iterabwoba no gukora ibikorwa byihuse cyane (special operations).

Umurenge wa Butaro ni umwe mu mirenge 17 igize Akarere ka Burera, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Butaro wari utuwe n'abaturage 38 013. Muri uyu murenge hari Ibitaro bya Butaro, birimo ikigo cyo kuvura kanseri.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Burera kagizwe n'imirenge 17. Umurenge wa Butaro ni umwe muri yo.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Butaro wari utuwe n'abaturage 31 520. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 38 013. Abagabo bari 18 352. Abagore bari 19 661.
Abaturage 5 880 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 32 133 batuye mu cyaro.
Ibitaro bya Butaro biri i Butaro, mu Karere ka Burera. Byafunguwe ku wa 24 Mutarama 2011. Bifite ibitanda 150.
Ku wa 18 Nyakanga 2012, ikigo cyo kuvura kanseri cyafunguwe muri ibi bitaro. Cyitwa "Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence".

Ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK) ni ibitaro byigisha bifite ibitanda 519, biherereye muMujyi wa Kigali,mu Rwanda. Byashinzwe mu 1918 n'abakoloni b'ababiligi. CHUK ni cyo kigo nderabuzima cya mbere cyashinzwe kandi kinini kurusha ibindi mu Rwanda. Cyagize uruhare rukomeye mu kongera kubaka urwego rw'ubuvuzi mu Rwanda nyuma ya Jenocide Cyagize uruhare rukomeye mu kongera kubaka urwego rw’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Inkomoko y'ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya (CHUK) yatangiye mu 1918, ubwo byashingwaga kunshuro ya mbere n'ubuyobozi bw'ingabo z'ababiligi. Icyo gihe, ikigo nderabuzima cyatangiranye n'inyubako yari yarasizwe n'abadage. Gustave Latinne, umuganga w'ingabo z'ababiligi, niwe wagizwe umuyobozi wa mbere w'iki kigo..
CHUK nibitaro bya leta bizwiho gutanga serivisi kubanyarwanda basanzwe bafite ubwishingizi bwabaturage. CHUK ni ibitaro bya Leta bizwiho gutanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi ku banyarwanda benshi, cyane cyane abafite ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima. Ibitaro byunganira n'inkunga itangwa na Guverinoma y'U Rwanda ndetse n'abaterankunga mpuzamahanga.
CHUK yimuriwe ahahoze ibitaro bya kera i Nyarugengeijya ku bitaro bya Masak, mu karere ka Kicukiro. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko impamvu nyamukuru y’iyi kwimurwa ari imiterere y’ibikoresho n’aho ibitaro byari bisanzwe biherereye, hatari hakwiriye ku rwego rw’ibitaro bya kaminuza.
Ibitaro bishya byubatswe ku nkunga y’igihugu cy’u Bushinwa, bikazagira ubushobozi burenze ubwo byari bifite, kuko bizaba bifite ibitanda birenga 800, ugereranyije n’ibitanda 519 byari bihari mbere.

Paniel Meat Processing Ltd (PMP) ni izina ry’ubucuruzi rya Elite Meat Processors, kompanyi ikorera mu birwa bya morise (Mauritius) ikaba ifite ibikorwa byibanda ku musaruro no gukwirakwiza inyama ku mugabane w’ Afurika. Elite Meat Processors yashyizweho kugira ngo igenzure kandi iyobore ibikorwa bya Paniel Meat Processing, ikaba ikorera mu birwa bya morise kandi kuva muri Ukuboza 2024 yashyizwe ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ryibirwa bya morise.
Paniel Meat Processing (PMP) yashinzwe muri 2012 na Hervé Tuyishime mu Rwanda, nyuma yo gutsinda irushanwa rya Guverinoma y'u Rwanda ryahurizaga hamwe ba rwiyemezamirimo.
Muri 2013, Tuyishime hamwe na PMP batsindiye igihembo cy’ubushabitsi cya REAL Fina Bank mu Rwanda. Mu ntangiriro, PMP yakoreraga mu murwa mukuru Kigali. Muri 2014, kompanyi yahinduye icyerekezo yibanda ku kohereza inyama zitunganyije hanze y’igihugu, maze yimurira ibikorwa byayo i Rubavu, hafi y’umupaka wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Muri 2015, Tuyishime hamwe na PMP begukanye igihembo cya mbere mu irushanwa rya SPARK ryabereye mu Rwanda. Muri 2016, Tuyishime yatangije Livestock Bank, kompanyi igamije guha abahinzi n’aborozi amatungo hamwe n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi. Iyo kompanyi yaje kwihuza na PMP muri 2022.
Muri 2019, PMP yari yaragutse ishyiramo ibicuruzwa bitandukanye birimo inyama z’inka, intama, ihene, n’inkoko, byose biboneka byihuse cyangwa bikonjeshejwe. Kompanyi yanashinze "PMP Transport and Logistics", igura amakamyo akonjesha n’ibikoresho byo kubika mu bukonje. Kuva icyorezo cya COVID-19, PMP Transport and Logistics yabaye kompanyi yigenga yitwa TRUK Rwanda, ikora ibikorwa by’ubwikorezi n’itangwa ry’ibicuruzwa, ikorera andi masosiyete y’ibiribwa n’ubuhinzi mu karere k’Iburasirazuba bwa Afurika.

Parfait Yongabo n'umunyarwanda akaba n'impuguke mu miyoborere y' ubushakashatsi n'udushya (innovation systems) akaba n'umwarimu w' ibijyanye n'ubushakashatsi muri IPRC Rwanda, akaba umuyobozi mu rwego rw'uburezi n'ubushakashatsi. yagize uruhare rukomeye muguteza imbere politiki y'ubushakashatsi n'udushya mu Rwanda, by'umwihariko murwego rw'ubuhinzi n'iterambere ry'ubumenyi.
Yongabo yakuye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (PhD) Muri Lund University yo muri Suwede aho yibanze kumiyoborere y'ubushakashatsi n'udushya.Yabanje kwiga muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda, ahakuye impamyabumenyi y'ikiciri cya gatatu Master's mu kubungabunga ibinyabuzima n'imicungire y'umutungo kamere.
Parfait Yongabo ni Umuyobozi ushinzwe iterambere ry'ibigo, ubushakashatsi bushingiye kubikorwa n'ubujyanama IDARC muri Rwanda Polytechnic. Mbere y'aho, yabaye umwarimu n'umushakashatsi muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda ishuri ry'ubuhinzi n'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo CAVM, ndetse anayobora gahunda ya Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program.
Yongabo n'umugabo arubatse afite umwana umwe w'umuhungu n'umugore, kandi n'abanyarwanda batuye ikigali mu karere ka Kicukiro nyuma yuko basoje amashuli yabo mugihugu cya Suwede. Amashuri abanza yayize mumajyepfo aho bita Muruhango Mukarere ka Nyanza, yarezwe n'umubyeyi umwe nawe waje kwitaba Imana mumwaka wa 2022.
Ubushakashatsi bwa Yongabo bugaruka ku miyoborere y'ubumenyi, iterambere ry'udushya, n'imikoranire hagati ya leta, amashuri makuru n'abikorera. Yanditse inyandiko zinyuranye,zirimo
"Constructing the national innovation system in Rwanda, efforts and challenges.
"Emergence of an agricultural innovation systems in Rwanda, Stakeholders and policies as point of departure
"Technology and innovation trajectories in the Rwandan agricultural sector, Are value chain an option?"
Ubushakashatsi bwe bwerekana uburyo u Rwanda rushyiraho politiki n'imiyoborere y'ubushakashatsi n'udushya, n'uruhare rwabyo mu iterambere ry'igihugu.
Ibihembo n'Imikoranire.
Yongabo yahawe ibihembo bitandukanye, birimo,
Yakoze imikoranire n'ibigo mpuzamahanga nka FAO, Sida, Belspo, Nuffic, IDRC, EU-JRC, University College London, na University of Johannesburg.

PAPA LEO XIV:UMUNYAMERIKA WATOREWE KUBA UMUSHUMBA MUKURU WA KILIZYA
Inteko y'Abacardinal 133 bateraniye muri chapel ya sistinei vatican kuri uyu mugoroba wa taliki 8 gicurasi 2025 yatoye umushumba mushya wa kiliziya catholic,Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost.
itorwa rya papa mushya ryemejwe n'umwotsi w'umweru wazamutse kuri chapel ya sistine,ahaberaga iri tora kuva taliki 7 Gicurasi. Bisobanuye ko mu itora,umukandida kuri uyu mwanya yabonye yabonye amajwi ari hejuru ya 89 muri 133 y'Abacardinal bitabiriye iri tora.
Cardinal Robert Prevost ukomoka muri leta zunze ubumwe z'Amerika yatowe nyuma yuko habaye ibyiciro bitanu by'itora birimo kimwe cyabaye taliki ya 7 Gicurasi n'ibindi bine byabaye kuya 8 Gicurasi 2025.Yafashe izina ry'ubutungane rya "leo XIV"
Papa leo XIV yavukiye mu mujyi wa chicago muri leta lllinois taliki ya 14 nzeri 1955.Yagizwe umucardinal na Papa Francis taliki ya 15 mata 2023,amuragiza diyoseze ya callao muri peru.
Niwe cardinal wa mbere ukomoka muri leta zunze ubumwe z'Amerika utorewe kuyobora kiliziya.Ibi byashimishije president Donald Trump wagaragazako yifuza kubona papa mushya aturuka mu gihugu cye.
Mu 2023,papa leo XIV yagaragajeko kiliziya idakwiye kwigisha amahame yayo gusa ahubwo ko ikwiye kwereka isi yose igisobanuro cyo kumenya yezu kristu.
Ati"kenshi tuganzwa no kwigisha amahame... arik tukibagirwako umurimo wacu wi banze ari ukwigisha icyo kumenya kristu bisobanuye umurimo wacu ni ukwagura ihema tukareka buri wese akinjira muri kiliziya."
Ubu butumwa buca amarenga ko Papa leo XIV yiteguye kugendera mu murongo Papa francis yasimbuye kuri iyi nshingano,urimo kudaheza uwo ariwe wese ushaka kumugisha w'Imana,uko yabateye nimibereho yaba abyeho yose.
Cyakoze ntabwo avugwaho rumwe kuko,nkuko byatangajwe n'ikinyamakuru THE PILLAR muri nzeri 2024,Papa leo XIV ntiyigeze akurikirana ikirego cy'abagore bashinjaga abapadiri babiri kubahohotera mu 2007.Ibyo byabereye muri diyoseze ya callao muri peru, Yayobowe na Papa leo XIV kuva 2014 kugeza 2023 ubwo yahabwaga inshingano i roma.

Ibihugu 3 bikize kurusha ibindi muri Afurika.
Afurika y’Epfo iza ku mwanya wa mbere ku rutonde rw’ibihugu bikize muri Afurika hashingiwe ku musaruro mbumbe.
Iki gihugu gifite umusaruro mbumbe wa miliyari 595.7 z’amadorali. Ubukungu bushingiye cyane ku mabuye y’agacuro nka diyama na Zahabu.
Egypt ni igihugu cya kabiri gikize muri Afurika, gifite umusaruro mbumbe wa miliyari 551.4 z’amadorali.
Ubukungu bwa Egypt bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga, ubukerarugendo bitewe n’ibirango by’amateka ifite nka za Pyramide...abaturage benshi bitungiwe n’ibikorwa bakorera ku nkengero z’uruzi rwa Nil.
Ku mugabane w’Afurika yose Nigeria ni igihugu cya gatatu gikize, gifite umusaruro mbumbe wa miliyari 478.5 z’amadorali. Ni igihugu cya mbere gituwe cyane muri Afurika, inganda zacyo zituma kiza ku mwanya wa gatatu mu bihugu bizifite nyinshi muri Afurika.

Umugaba mukuru wa Carabinieri ni muntu ki??
Jenerali Salvatore LUONGO, yavukiye i Naples ku ya 6 Kamena 1962, yatangiye umwuga we wa gisirikare mu 1977, yiga mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya (Nunziatella) i Naples, mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Modena na Carabinieri Application School i Roma. Afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n'amategeko, ubumenyi bwa politiki n'umutekano w'imbere mu gihugu, afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n'ubumuntu yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Gregorian i Roma. Yize icyiciro cya 2 mu kigo cy'amashuri yisumbuye. Ni umuhanga mu rurimi rw'Icyongereza. Yakoranye na Kaminuza ya Roma IV mu nshingano zo kwigisha, guhangana n'ibyaha by'ubuvuzi bwa forensic ndetse by'umwihariko kurwanya ikoreshwa ry'ibiyobyabwenge. Yari umwarimu n'umugenzuzi w'icyiciro cya kabiri cya Masters "Open Innovation and Entrepreunership" muri Kaminuza ya Campus Biomedico University of Rome.

"ISHURI RYABOFISIYE RYA CARABINIERI"
Corps ya kera ya Royal Carabinieri yashinzwe muri Turin n'Umwami wa Sardinia Vittorio Emanuele wa I, na Warrant Royal ku ya 13 Nyakanga 1814.CC_Salvo_D'Acquisto.
Ni ishuri rya ba ofisiye ba Carabinieri riherereye mu Butaliyani / Roma unyuze kuri Aurelia. Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 1976, hiyongereyeho amasomo n'umubare wa ba ofisiye, cyitiriwe Major Ugo De Carolis, umudari wa Zahabu wa Carabinieri ku bw'intwari za gisirikare (muri memoriam) na Martyr wa Fosse Ardeatine.
Iri shuri ni ishuri rinini kandi ryiza rifite ubuso bungana na metero kare 82.000, Isomero, agace ka intranet yemerera abitabiriye bose guhuza umurongo wa interineti, laboratoire y'ururimi, ibyumba by'amashuri makuru, ibikoresho by'imikino yo mu nzu no hanze, hamwe no kurasa.Iri shuri kandi rifite ibyiciro byinshi byabanyeshuri nkabanyeshuri baba barabanje gukora umwana umwe i Modena bakaza bagakora indi myaka 3 y'amasomo muri kino kigo, uruhare rwamashyamba, tekiniki ninshingano zo gusaba.
irishuri kandi ryagiye rinyura mubihe bitandukanya kandi bikomeye hagiye hakoreshwa uburyo bwinshi bwo kwinjira muri iri shuri ku buryo bubiri bwa mbere bwo kwinjiza mu gisirikare, byasabwaga kandi kwitabira amasomo yo gusaba igihe cyagenwe n’amabwiriza yihariye agenewe abapolisi bo mu Ishuri rya Gisirikare.Ubutaliyani bwinjiye mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose bwazanye izindi nteko zishinga amategeko ku bijyanye no gushaka abapolisi.
Indahiro ya Ofisiye Cadets wo mu mutwe wa Carabinieri byabaye mu 1943 na byo byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku ishuri rikuru rya Royal Carabinieri, riherereye mu mujyi wa Florence, ryinjijwe mu ngabo z’igihugu cya Repubulika, umutwe witwaje intwaro wasimbuye burundu Corps ya Royal Carabinieri mu ifasi iyobowe na Repubulika y’Ubutaliyani. Muri ubwo buryo, Ishuri ryiboneye ibyabaye mu ngabo za guverinoma ya Salò, riva i Florence ryerekeza Lodi, kugeza Ubutaliyani bubohoye.
Nubwo Ishuri Rikuru ryari ryaretse kubaho, Carabinieri ntishobora kureka ibikorwa byamahugurwa make, ikoresheje ubuhanga busanzwe bwo kwigisha bwa ba Komanda, burigihe bwagiye bugengwa mumabwiriza rusange. Hamwe no kubohora Ubutaliyani, byashobokaga gukomeza gahunda yo kuvugurura Corps ku rwego rw’igihugu, bityo, no mu mashami y’amahugurwa: gusa mu 1949 ni bwo amasomo y’abofisiye yakomereje kuri iryo shuri, yakira amasomo yo gusaba abaliyetona ba kabiri muri s.p.e. guturuka mu Ishuri rya Gisirikare rya Modena, icyakora hamwe n'umwe gusa.
Mu 1952 Ishuri rikuru rya Carabinieri ryaretse kubaho, kugira ngo risubire kuba ishuri rya ba ofisiye ba Carabinieri. Mu 1951, hamwe n’ivugururwa ry’Ingabo nyuma y’Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, byongeye kumva ko hakenewe urugero rw’amahugurwa y’abasirikare ba Carabinieri mu nyubako nshya yagaragaye i Roma, mu kigo cya Vanvitellian cyanyuze kuri Garibaldi, ubu kikaba ari icyicaro gikuru cy’ubuyobozi bw’akarere "Podgora", aho amasomo asanzwe yatangiriye ku ya 1 Ugushyingo 1952.Mu 1975, izina rya Carabinieri Officers School ryagaruwe.

Akagari ka birembo ni kamwe mutugari tugize umurenge wa sovu. Gaherereye mu murenge wa Sovu Akarere ka Ngororero Intara y'Uburengerazuba. n'akagari kagizwe n'imidugudu ine ariyo Birembo, Kanyana, Musenyi na Kagano. Gakorerwamo imirimo itandukanye cyane cyane iyubuhinzi, n'ubworezi urugero koperative Terimbere yo mubirembo yorora ingurube.
Abaturage bagatuyemo bakaba bishimira iterambere bamaze kugezwaho harimo imihanda nibindi.

Umurenge wa Ngororero ni umwe mu mirenge 13 igize Akarere ka Ngororero, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Ugizwe n’utugari dutandatu.
Mu 2022, Umurenge wa Ngororero wari utuwe n’abaturage 38.823. Ni wo murenge ufite abaturage benshi mu Karere ka Ngororero.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Ngororero uherereye mu burasirazuba bw’Akarere ka Ngororero. Ufite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 58,50.
Mu majyaruguru, Umurenge wa Ngororero uhana imbibi n’Umurenge wa Matyazo. Mu burengerazuba, uhana imbibi n’Umurenge wa Hindiro n’Umurenge wa Kageyo. Mu majyepfo, uhana imbibi n’Umurenge wa Muhororo.
Imiterere y’ubuyobozi.
Umurenge wa Ngororero ugizwe n’utugari dutandatu:
Akarere ka Ngororero kagizwe n’imirenge 13, utugari 73 n’imidugudu 419.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Ngororero wari utuwe n’abaturage 34.559. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, abaturage bari 38.823. Muri bo, abagore bari 20.569, abagabo bari 18.254.
Mu 2022, abaturage 9.106 babaga mu mujyi. Abandi 29.717 babaga mu cyaro. Ubucucike bwari abaturage 663,6 kuri kilometero kare.
Mu mirenge 13 y’Akarere ka Ngororero, Umurenge wa Ngororero ni wo wari ufite abaturage benshi mu 2022.
Umuhanda Muhanga–Ngororero–Mukamira unyura mu Murenge wa Ngororero. Icyicaro cy’Akarere ka Ngororero kiri kuri uwo muhanda. Kiri ku birometero 46,6 uvuye i Muhanga. Kiri no ku birometero 60 uvuye i Mukamira.

Ingoma y'U Rweya, bakunze kwita u Rweya rw'u Mubali, ni kimwe mu bihugu bya mbere byaranzwe kuri ubu butaka bw'u Rwanda, kikaba n'igihugu cya mbere Abazigaba bahanze bakigera my by'ino, ahasaga mu wa 400. Ni ingoma yari iherereye kuri ubu mu Karere ka Kayonza y'Amajyaruguru n'Akarere ka Gatsibo.
Gakondo nkuru yabo ari nayo yabaye intebe y'ingoma y'Abazigaba, ni mu Mirenge ya Mwiri na Murundi yo mu karere ka Kayonza, wongereho Umurenge wa Rwimbogo wo mu Akarere ka Gatsibo. Ako karere, ni ko bororokeyemo mbere y'uko bakwira mu gihugu cyose no mu bihugu dutandukanye nka Tanzania, Uganda n'u Burundi.
Umukurambere w'Abazigaba ari nawe wahanze ingoma y'u Rweya rw'u Mubali, ni Kazigaba, ingoma Ngabe yabo nk'ikirango cy'igihugu yari "sera'.Umwami wagengaga ingoma y'u Rweya rw'u Mubali mu iyaduka ry'Abanyiginya muri aka karere, ni Kabeja, ari na we se wa Nyamigezi wabaye sekuru wa Gihanga, kuko se Kazi yashatse Nyirarukangaga rwa Nyamigezi, babyarana Gihanga n;abandi bana.
Ingoma y'u Rweya rw'u Mubali, yigaruriwe na Kigeli Ndabarasa ahasaga mu wa 1740. Icyogihe yica Biyoro umwami w'icyo gihugu, ingoma yabo izima ityo. Ubutaka bwayo babwomeka ku Rwanda.

Iyo umuntu avuze izina Kanyarira buri wese ahita yumva umusozi muremure uherereye mu ntara y’Amajyepfo mu karere ka RUHANGO umurenge wa Byimana akagari ka Mpanda ukunze guhurirwaho n’abakirisitu batandukanye bajya kuwusengeraho ngo basubizwe bimwe mu bibazo bafite.
bamwe mu basaza bahabyirukiye kuva kera bavuga ko izina Kanyarira rikomoka ku mazi yaturukaga mu biti biteye kuri uyu musozi agahora atonyanga kubera ikime cyahahoraga muri ibyo biti mu bihe byo hambere.
Bitewe n’imyizerere y’abantu uyu musozi waje guhinduka ahantu twakwita hatagatifu abantu baza kuhayoboka bakajya bahasengera.
Kubera ko haje kugwa abantu bari mu masengesho inzego z’ubuyobozi zabujije abantu kujya kuhasengera ariko byanga gucika burundu kuko nubu hari abajya kuhasengera bizeye ko ibibazo bafite biri bukemuke bizeye ko Imana iri bubafashe kubikemura.

Ikiyaga cya Cyambwe ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Giherereye mu Akarere ka Kirehe, mu Murenge wa Nasho.
Ikiyaga cya Cyambwe kiri hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Nasho. Kibamo amafi, imvubu n'ingona. Amazi yacyo akoreshwa mu kuhira imyaka.
Ikiyaga cya Cyambwe kiri mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Giherereye mu Murenge wa Nasho, mu Karere ka Kirehe. Kiri ku ntera ya kilometero 2,7 mu burasirazuba bw'Ikiyaga cya Nasho.
Ibinyabuzima n'akamaro.
Mu Kiyaga cya Cyambwe haba amafi, imvubu n'ingona. Ikiyaga gitanga umusaruro munini w'amafi. Amazi yacyo akoreshwa mu kuhira imyaka, mu mushinga wo kuhira wa Nasho. Akarere ka Kirehe gashishikariza abaturage kurinda ikiyaga no kwirinda uburobyi butemewe.

Igishanga cya rwabuye ni igishanga gihereye mu ntara y'amajyepfo mu karere ka Huye ni kumuhanda uva mu mugi wa Kigali werekeza mu mugi wa Huye.
Iki gishanga gikunzwe kwibasirwa n'ibiza ndetse n'umwuzure mugihe cy'imvura nyinshi.
Iki gishanga ahanini hacyo gihingwamo igihingwa cy'umuceri, nawo wangiza n'amazi menshi akunze guterwa n'imvura nyinshi. abaturage batuye muri iki gishanga bavugako iyo imvura y'u kwa kane itangiye kugwa baba bareba neza neza uko amazi atangira kuza nabo bagahita bafata utwangushye bagahungira kumuhanda bakaza kugaruka ari uko imvura ihise.

Ni ingufu z'ikinyabutabire kiboneka mu mazi (H20) cyangwa kigacukurwa mu misozi ikindi nuko ikinyabutabire hydrogen(H2) gishobora gucanywa ndetse cyikifashishwa mu gukora amabuye (fuelcells) mu gutanga amashanyarazi
Ejo hazaza hi ngufu za Hydrogen y' Icyatsi.
Tumenye hydrogen y'icyatsi ni Hadrogen itangiza ibidukikije (Eco-hydrogen) ni hydrodero y'amararankuba yakozwe hakoreshejwe ingufu zishya mu gutandukanya amazi. Ubu buryo ngombwa bukoresha mashini itandukanya amazi (electrolyzer) ifite imishinga y'anode na cathode, ikoresha amashanyarazi (akenshi aturuka kumwimerere) kugirango itandukanye amazi. Hydrodero y'amararankuba isohoka ikoreshwa, ituma turwanya impinduka z'ikirere kandi ituma dushobora kugera ku ntego yo kugabanya umwuka mubi hasi cyane mu mwaka wa 2050. Hakoreshejwe hydrodero y'amararankuba mu bikorwa byo gutwika amazi (boiler) aho gukoresha amavuta aturuka mu byasigaye mu butaka, byagabanya cyane kwangirika kw' ikirere, bigatuma turi hafi y'aho tutazongera kugira inyongera z'ikirere.

Ubuzima bw'abana baba ku mihanda bugenda buba bubi uko iminsi ishira.
abana bo ku muhanda bagenda by'ubuzima biterwa no kwicwa n'inzara ndetse no kubura ubuvuzi mugihe baba barwaye, ndetse n'umwanda mwinshi bahura nawo ushobora kuba intandaro y'ubwo burwayi. Centre Cyprien et Daphrose Rugamba (CECYDAR), ni kimwe mu bigo bifasha abana bo mu muhanda gusubira mu buzima busanzwe, aho baganirizwa kugira ngo harebwe impamvu bari mu muhanda, ndetse bagafashwa gusubira mu muryango.
Kuva mu 1992 CECYDAR imaze kugorora abana bo mu muhanda barenga 5215, kongerera ubushobozi ingo 870 no kubaka inzu 28 z’imiryango itishoboye. Uhereye muri 2018 kugera ubu, abana 676 baragorowe ndetse banasubizwa mu miryango yabo, muri bo abagera kuri 332 bafashwa mu bijyanye n’uburezi.
abana b'abakobwa kandi nabo bagaragara ku muhanda, ariko bo haba hari ibyago byinshi by'uko bahohoterwa na bagenzi babo babahungu cyangwa abandi bagabo. bityo bo bakaba bagerwaho n'ingaruka nyinshi z'ubwo buzima bwo ku muhanda kurusha basaza babo, aho baterwa inda z;indahekana, bagakoerwa n'ihohotererwa ryo ku mubiri.

Umurenge wa Nyakiriba ni umwe mu mirenge 12 y'Akarere ka Rubavu. Ufite ubuso bwa km² 21,90.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye ni urwibutso rwibuka Abatutsi bishwe ku bwinshi muri Mata 1994 i Nyarubuye, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'umupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Tanzaniya, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye ruherereye i Nyarubuye, mu Akarere ka Kirehe, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'umupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Tanzaniya.
Nyarubuye iri mu gice cy'iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'umupaka wa Tanzaniya. Aka gace kari mu duce twibasiwe n'ubwicanyi bukomeye mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Nyarubuye ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye rwashyizwe ahari kiliziya Gatolika ya Nyarubuye. Ku wa 15 Mata 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi bari bahahungiye bizeye ko bahabona umutekano barishwe.
Ubwicanyi bwabereye i Nyarubuye bwari bumwe mu bwicanyi bukomeye bwakozwe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abantu barenga 51.000 bazize Jenoside.
Abarokotse Jenoside bo muri Nyarubuye bavuga ko ubwicanyi bwahabereye bwakoranywe ubugome bukabije.
Urwibutso rwa Nyarubuye ruzwiho kuba rwarabungabunze bimwe mu bice bya kiliziya yangijwe mu gihe cy'ubwicanyi. Muri uru rwibutso herekanwa imyambaro, amagufwa n'ibikoresho by'abazize Jenoside, kugira ngo bibere abarusura ibimenyetso by'ibyabereye aho.
Abasura urwibutso banerekwa bimwe mu bimenyetso by'ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi i Nyarubuye. Harimo ibikoresho n'ahantu bifitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe abari bahungiye muri Paruwasi ya Nyarubuye.
Urwibutso rusurwa n'abantu ku giti cyabo, amatsinda ndetse n'intumwa zo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga. Runaberamo ibikorwa byo kwibuka no kunamira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Ubukungu n'ubukerarugendo.
Mu Murenge wa Nyamyumba hari icyambu cya Nyamyumba. Icyo cyambu gihuza Akarere ka Rubavu n'utundi turere dukora ku Ikiyaga cya Kivu. Gihuza kandi Akarere ka Rubavu na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Muri uwo murenge hari n'amashyuza. Ayo mashyuza akurura ba mukerarugendo.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kabuye ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri i Kabuye, mu Murenge wa Ndora, mu Akarere ka Gisagara, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Uru rwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri irenga 50 000 y'abazize Jenoside. Myinshi muri iyo mibiri yahimuriwe mu 2018, ivanywe mu mva rusange zo mu karere.
Urwibutso ruri i Kabuye, mu Murenge wa Ndora, mu Karere ka Gisagara.
Uru rwibutso ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri mu gihugu hose. Izi nzibutso ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kwibuka no kuzirikana abazize Jenoside.
Urwibutso rwa Kabuye ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu 1994, Ndora yari mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare. Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) ivuga ko abayobozi b'igihugu n'ab'inzego z'ibanze bagize uruhare mu bwicanyi muri iyi perefegitura. Abayobozi, abasirikare n'Interahamwe barabigizemo uruhare.
Nk'uko KT Press ibivuga, urwibutso rw'agateganyo rw'i Kabuye rwari ahantu Perezida w'agateganyo Théodore Sindikubwabo yavugiye ijambo rikangurira abantu kwica. Sindikubwabo yavukiye muri ako gace.
Muri Gashyantare 2018, Akarere ka Gisagara katangaje ko kazimurira imibiri irenga 50 000 mu rwibutso rushya rw'i Kabuye. Uwo mushinga wari kuzatwara amafaranga y'u Rwanda miliyoni 500. Intego yari ugushyingura abazize Jenoside mu cyubahiro.
Muri Kamena 2018, imibiri irenga 43 000 yimuriwe mu rwibutso rushya. Iyo mibiri yari ishyinguye mu mva rusange nyinshi zo mu Murenge wa Ndora.
Buri mwaka, urwibutso rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko. Ibigo bya Leta na byo byitabira iyi mihango. Urugero, abakozi b'Ikigo cy'Imisoro n'Amahoro (RRA) basuye urwibutso mu 2024. Batanze kandi amafaranga yo kugurira inka abarokotse Jenoside bo mu Karere ka Gisagara.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibuye, ubu ruzwi nk'urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi rwa Gatwaro, rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Kibuye, umujyi muto uherereye mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwubatswe ahahoze urusengero rya kera, iruhande rwa sitade ishaje ya Gatwaro ahiciwe Abatutsi bari bakusanyirijwe kandi bafungiwe n’inzego z’ibanze. Ku kibanza cyahoze ari sitade, ubu hubatswe ishuri ryegeranye n'urwibutso.
Urwibutso rwubatswe aho abatutsi benshi, bari bagotewe aho, biciwe.
Ikibanza cyubatswe aho paruwasi yitiriwe Mutagatifu Petero ya Kibuye yahoze, hafi y’ahahoze sitade ya Gatwaro, ubu yasimbuwe n’ishuri ribanza.
Uru rwibutso ni rumwe mu nzibutso z'igihugu cy'u Rwanda zibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Izindi ni Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ntarama, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye.
Hari inzibutso nyinshi n'imva rusange mu nkengero z'urwibutso rwa Kibuye; zimwe mu mva rusange zaratunganyijwe, naho imibiri yari ahandi yimurirwa i Kibuye. Hirya no hino mu Rwanda hari n'izindi nzibutso nyinshi zibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Urwibutso rwa Kibuye ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Amateka y'ubwicanyi.
Umubare munini w'abategetsi b'u Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside waturukaga mu majyaruguru no mu burengerazuba bw'igihugu. Kubera ko FPR Inkotanyi yinjiye mu Rwanda iturutse mu majyaruguru, mu duce two mu majyaruguru y'igihugu no mu mijyi nka Gisenyi na Kibuye, abayobozi ba Leta batanze disikuru zikangurira abantu Jenoside.
Dukurikije ibarura rusange ry’abaturage ryo mu 1991, Abatutsi bo mu cyahoze ari perefegitura ya Kibuye bari 71 225, ni ukuvuga 15% by'abaturage.
Léon Mugesera, umurwanashyaka wa MRND, yavugiye i Gisenyi ku wa 22 Ugushyingo 1992:
Kuva ku wa 20 kugeza ku wa 22 Gashyantare 1993, i Kibuye habaye ubundi bwicanyi bw’Abatutsi bwakozwe n’abarwanashyaka ba MRND na CDR; ubwo bwicanyi bwabaye no muri perefegitura za Byumba, Gisenyi na Ruhengeri.
Ku wa 4 Kanama 1993, hasinywe amasezerano y’amahoro ya Arusha.
Ku wa 17 Mata 1994, hagabwe igitero gihuriweho kuri sitade ya Gatwaro, ku kigo cya paruwasi yitiriwe Mutagatifu Mikayeli ya Kibuye no ku ishuri ry’ubuhinzi rya Nyamishaba.
Perefe Clément Kayishema ni we watanze ikimenyetso cy'ubwicanyi, yica Umututsi wa mbere, Ezekiyeli Munyakaragwe.
Umuganga w’Umudage wari i Kibuye igihe ubwicanyi bwatangiraga avuga ko ku munsi ubanziriza ubwicanyi i Kibuye hari impunzi z’Abatutsi zigera ku 10 000: izigera ku 5 000 zari muri sitade ya Gatwaro, izindi ibihumbi byinshi zari mu kigo cya paruwasi ya Mutagatifu Mikayeli.
Nk’uko Koloneli Patrick Sartre, wakoze iperereza ku ngabo z’Ubufaransa zari mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside, abivuga, Abatutsi 12 000 biciwe ku wa 16 no ku wa 17 Mata kuri sitade ya Gatwaro, mu kigo cya paruwasi ya Kibuye no mu nkengero zaho. Liyetona Koloneli Éric de Stabenrath yasobanuye ko yasanze imirambo 4 300 igerekeranye kuri paruwasi, kandi avuga ko muri sitade habonetse imirambo iri hagati ya 7 000 na 9 000.
Mu 2020, abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bari bagishakisha imibiri y'ababo ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro ku rwibutso. Mu 2017, Claude Muhayimana, Umunyarwanda wari impunzi mu Ubufaransa akaba yarakoraga i Rouen, yarezwe mu Bufaransa ubufatanyacyaha mu bwicanyi bwabereye i Kibuye, ashinjwa kuba yaratwaye interahamwe mu modoka azijyana aho Abatutsi bicirwaga mu 1994.

Icyunngo ni kimwe mu bikoresho bya ahambere byakoreshwaga mu guteka kandi nanubu bigikoreshwa, iterambere ritaraza mu Rwanda ndetse no muri afrika beshyi nicyo gikoresho bifashishaga mugutegura amafunguro yabo, uko iminsi ishira indi igataha, abanyarwanda barazizibukira bagategurira mu bikoresho bizwi nka amasafuriya, akanyungo ni kimwe mu bikoresho byahambere aho bamwe mu rubyiruko rwubu bavugako batakizi.
icyo ni imwe mu nkono gakondo gikozwe mw'ibumba akaba ari igikoresho bifashishaga kurubu wagereranya n'isafuriya kikaba cyarakoreshwaga mugutegura amafunguro ndetse no mubihugu bimwe na bimwe byo muri africa cyane cyane mu Rwanda rwo hambere
Bavugako imboga zitekewe mu kungo ziryoha kurusha izatekewe mucyo twakzita amasafuriya ya kijyambere, ikindi hari ababumbyi batunzwe no kubumba, iyo babaga babumbye ibyungo ndetse n'ibindi bikoresho biva mwibumba byatumaga babona imibereho bakabasha kwiteza imberer mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi

Abardare Range ni umusozi muremure uherereye mu majyaruguro yo mu murwa mukuru wa kenya ukaba upima kilometero zisaga 160km hamwe n'uburebure bwa metero 3,500 na fiti 11,480 ft. uzenguruka intara za Nyandurua, Nyeri, Murang'ra na Kiambu na Laikipia.
Ikibanza cyangwase umusozi wa Aderdare ugizwe nigice cy'uruhande rw'iburasirazuba bw'ikibaya kinini cy RIFT kinyura mu majyaruguru ugana mu majyepfo. Mu burengerazuba, intara igwa hasi cyane mu kibaya cya Kinangop hanyuma ikagera mu kibaya kinini cya rift iburasirazuba, intara ihanamye cyane ikiyaga cya naivasha hamwe na Mau Escarpment ya kure bishobora kugaragara uhereye kumpinga ndende bufite uburebure bwa 3,999 metero na ft 13,120. Aberdares ni umusozi kandi ufite agace k'amazi y'urubogobogo rwa Sasumua n'urugomero rwa Ndakaini, rutanga amazi menshi i Nairobi. Amashyamba yo mu misozi ni agace kegereye Umugezi wa Tana, uruzi runini muri Kenya rutanga amazi ku rugomero rw'amashanyarazi rwa seven forks rutanga hejuru ya 55 ku ijana by'amashanyarazi yose kenya.
Ishyamba rya Aderdare.
Ishyamba rya Aderdare Ranges niryo ryakira ishyamba rya Escarpments ya kikiyu ikora mu majyaruguru kuva muri Nairobi,Aderdare itandukanye cyane mu burebure bwa metero 2000 na ft 6,600 ku mupaka wa mashyamba kuruhande rwiburasirazuba na 4,001 metero na ft 13.127 werekeza ku nkombe yo mumajyaruguru kun mupaka ya oldonyo lesatima. Ranges imanuka iva ku minga yerekeza I nyaruhuhu uherereye mu majyaruguru aho bigaragara ko ibibata byinzuzi byangiritse hamwe n'imiyoboro y'ibiyaga. ku ruhande rw'amajyepfo.

Amashyamba ni kimwe mu mutungo kamere u Rwanda rufite ariko by'umwihariko kuba rugifite amashyamba ya kimeza bikaba akarusho kuko bifasha mu kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima. Ishyamba rya kimeza rya Kibirizi riherereye mu karere ka Nyanza ni rimwe mu mashyamba agifite amoko y'ibiti atandukanye, harimo ibyo bita "Umushikiri" bikaba byifashishwa mu gukora imibavu.
Kubungabunga amashyamba ya kimeza.
Minisiteri ishinzwe Ubutaka n'Amashyamba (MINILAF) yatangiye gahunda yo kubungabunga amashyamba agera kuri 107 ya kimeza u Rwanda rusigaranye, kugira ngo adacika.
Kubera ubukana bw'iyangirika ry'amashyamba cyane cyane aya kimeza, hanashyizweho itegeko rya Minisiteri w'intebe rirengera bene ayo mashyamba adafite kirengera. Iri tegeko ryaje gushyigikira itegeko ryagenga ibidukikije rigaragaza ubwoko bw'ibiti bigomba kurindwa kandi rikanatunga agatoki aho biherereye, ku buryo n'umuntu wafatwa abitema ahita akurikiranwa.
Rumwe muri izo ngero ni ibiti byitwa " Umushikiri" byari byibasiwe mu minsi ishije, aho byavugwaga ko bitanga imibavu ariko nyuma yo gukaza iryo tegeko; abafashwe bagakurikiranwa n'ubutabera byaracitse.
Igisigaye ni amashyamba mato aherereye hirya no hino mu gihuhu ariko atitaweho nk'uko bikwiye. Ayo amashyamba abarirwa muri 107 ko ari yo asigaye mu Rwanda ariko MINILAF ikaba yarahagurukiye kuyarinda ngo atazimira.
Ishyamba rya Kibirizi riteye kuri hegitare 183 ni rimwe muri aya mashyamba arinzwe n'iteka rya Minisitiri. Iri shyamba riherereye mu karere ka Nyanza mu Ntara y' Amajyepfo na ryo riri mu ryakunze kwibasirwa kubera ibiti by'imishikiri bihateye. Ariko kuva Guverinoma yahagurukira iki kibazo ba rushimusi b'ibiti baragabanutse, kandi n'ingamba zo kurinda amashyamba nk'aya zarakajijwe.
Igice gishinzwe kubungabunga amashyamba muri MINILAF cyatangije gahunda y'uko hari ibiti byavangwa n'imyaka cyane cyane ahegereye ya mashyamba ariko umwihariko uzashyirwa ahantu hegereye amashyamba akeneye kurindwa. Gahunda nk'iyi yo kurengera amashyamba karemano bakoresheje umukandara w'andi mashyamba agirira abaturage akamaro, isa niyagize akamaro ku baturiye ishyamba rya Nyungwe riherereye mu gice cya Kitabi mu Karere ka Nyamagabe.
Mu mwaka wa 2018 ubuso bwari buhinzeho amashyamba mu Rwanda, bwanganaga 29.6% ubariyemo n'aya kimeza yose.Gahunda ya leta yagaragaza ko bugomba kwiyongera bukagera kuri 30% muri 2020.

Pariki y'igihungu ya nyungwe ni ishyamba cyimeza ribarizwa mu burengerazuba bwamajyepfo bw'u Rwanda, rifatanye na pariki y'igihugu ya kibira yomujyihugu cy'u Burundi kandi rishobora kuba ariryo shyamba ry'inzitane ryo mumisozi minini kandi miremire muri afirika yose.
iryo shyamba riri mu misozi ifite ubutumburuke buri hagati ya m 1600 na m2950 kandi ririmo amoko menshi yibimera ndetse namoko menshi yinyamanswa ajyizwe ahanini n'inyoni ndetse n'inguge.

Imisozi ya Cherang'any ni imisozi miremire yo mu burengerazuba bwa Kenya. uyu musozi mu umwe mu mashyamba atanu ya kenya ifatwa nk'ubukerarugendo, n'umusozi muremure ukaba wegeranye ni ikibaye kinini cyo hagati, igabanijwe na Mau Escarpment izamuka ku mupaka wa Tanzaniya kugera misozi ya Cherang'any, Escarpment ihuza ikibaya kizamuka kumusozi wa Elgon. Umusozi wa Cherangany uzenguruka intara eshatu arizo Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo marakwet no Pokot y'iburengerazuba.
Umusozi wa Cherang'any urebererwa n'umuryango w'abibumbye ishinzwe ibidukikije nka kamwe mu turere dutanu tw'ingenzi two gufata amazi muri kenya. () umuryango wa bibumbye ukurikirana impinduka z'amashyamba hagati ya 2000 na 2003, Umusozi wa Charang'any niyo yibasiwe cyane n'amashyamba yakurikiranwe, aho hagati 174.3 zatewe n'amashyamba, iki gihombo kikaba kiboneka mu karere ka marakwet no mu karere ka pokot. kubera ko iki gipande cy'amashyamba kavukire, umuryango wabibumbye urasaba ko ako gace gakurikiranywa hafi kugirango hatabaho irimbuka ry'uwo musozi.

kivu belt nizina ry'umuhanda unyura kunyengero zikiyaga cya kivu muburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda woroheje ingendo muturere two muri iyo ntara, mubihugu byinshi bicyiri munzira yamajyambere, imihanda yubakwaga mujyihe cyashize wasangaga ari imihanda igana kukibuga cy'indege cyangwase igana kucyambu,ariko namihanda ihuza ibice by'igihugu bitandukanye. umuhanda wa kivu belt watangiye gukoreshwa kuwa gatandatu tariki 19 Mata 2019, ukaba waroroheje ingendo.

Umusozi wa Taita, ni umusozi uherereye mu Ntara ya Taita-Taveta mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Kenya. Imisozi igizwe n'ibice bitatu mu majyepfo yumujyi wa Kasigau mu majyepfo hafi y'umupaka wa Tanzaniya. Massif ya Dawida ninini kandi nindende ifite uburebure bwa hejuru yinyanja kurwego rwo hejuru, Vuria. Dawida afite izindi mpinga eshatu zingenzi: Iyale, Wesu, na Susu.
Ubumenyi bwa geologiya.
Umusozi wa Taita, umaze imyaka irenga miriyoni ijana. Ubu hashize imyaka miriyoni mirongo itatu, ako gace kari gatwikiriwe n'ishyamba rinini. Mugihe hashize imyaka miriyoni icumi, amashyamba yo mubutayu yahinduwe savanna, hasigara imisozi nk "ibirwa" aho amashyamba yo mu turere dushyuha yakomeje gutera imbere. Umusozi wa Taita uzamuka cyane uva muri parike yigihugu ya Tsavo.
Imisozi izwiho amashyamba atose hamwe n’ibinyabuzima bidasanzwe n’ibimera. Amoko arenga 20 y’icyorezo cya violet yo muri Afurika aboneka muri ako karere gusa. Ubwoko bw'inyoni zizwi cyane ni Taita thrush na Taita apalis. Falita ya Taita hamwe n’imari ya Taita yavumbuwe bwa mbere ku misozi ariko ibera ahandi, na ho. Ampibian mu bwoko bwa "Boulengerula" iboneka gusa ku misozi ya Taita.
Abaturage ba Taita kavukire batuye mumashyamba kandi bahinga ubutaka, butanga umusaruro mwinshi. Mirongo itanu y’amashyamba kavukire yasimbuwe n’ibiti bidasanzwe hagati ya 1955 na 2004. Ku bibaya no mu misozi ikikije, ubutaka bukoreshwa cyane mu guhinga no kurisha. Ibice binini byamashyamba biherereye ahantu.hangijywe no gutema amashyamba. Umusozi ya Udzungwa ni imisozi iri mu majyepfo ya Tanzaniya.N'umisozi ahanini uri mu karere ka Iringa, mu majyepfo y'umurwa mukuru wa Tanzaniya Dodoma. umisozi wa Udzungwa uri mu misozi y’iburasirazuba bwa Arc, kandi ukaba utuwe n’ibinyabuzima bitandukanye by’ibimera n’ibinyabuzima bifite amoko menshi y’ibyorezo.
ni umusozi utuweho n'abaturage, izina Udzungwa rikomoka ku ijambo rya Kihehe “Wadzungwa”, risobanura abantu batuye ku musozi. Iringa nigice kinini mumisozi, nicyicaro cyakarere.

Ubu hashize imyaka miriyoni mirongo itatu, ako gace kari gatwikiriwe n’amashyamba manini. hashize imyaka miriyoni icumi, amashyamba yo mubutayu ahinduwe savanna, hasigara imisozi nk "ibirwa" aho amashyamba yo mu turere dushyuha yakomeje gutera imbere. Imisozi ya Uluguru ni imisozi iri mu burasirazuba bwa Tanzaniya, yitiriwe ubwoko bwa Luguru. Igice kinini cyimisozi ni umusozi unyura hafi y'amajyaruguru n'amajyepfo kandi ifite uburebure bwa Kuruhande runini rwa Uluguru,rufite imidugudu 50 ikora kumupaka wamashyamba kandi abantu barenga 151.000 baboneka mumisozi, akenshi bakiyongera mubucucike k'umusozi muremure kugera kumupaka wamashyamba.
Ulugurus ifite ubutumburuke bwa 200 km imbere y'inyanja yu Buhinde. Biri mu ruhererekane rw'imisozi yo mu burasirazuba bwa Afurika hamwe bita mu misozi ya Arc irimo imisozi ya Taita, imisozi ya Pare, imisozi ya Usambara, imisozi ya Nguru, Rubeho, Ukaguru, imisozi ya Udzungwa n'imisozi ya Mahenge.
Amashyamba yimisozi atanga ahantu ho gufata amazi kumigezi ninzuzi. Aya mazi atemba cyane cyane mu mpinga z’amashyamba ya Ulugurus mu migezi ihuza guhuza uruzi rwa Ruvu, rutanga amazi mu mujyi wa Dar es Salaam. Benshi mu baturage baturanye, bagera kuri miliyoni 3, n’inganda zikomeye muri Tanzaniya bashingira kuri aya mazi kugira ngo bakomeze kubaho. Gutakaza amashyamba no kugabanuka kw’amazi yo gutanga amazi yimisozi rero bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye kumibereho yabantu nubushobozi bwinganda za Tanzaniya.

Bagabanijwemo ibice bibiri; Uburengerazuba bwa Usambaras burenze Uburasirazuba bwa Usambara, bwegereye inkombe kandi bugwa imvura nyinshi.

Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2006 bwerekanye ko ishyamba rinini cyane ari ishyamba rya Iyunji (bita Chonwe) hafi y’imidugudu ya Vidunda, Chonwe, na Udunghu. Hashingiwe ku byogajuru n’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku butaka, byagereranijwe ko ishyamba ryagabanutse kuva kuri ha 471.3 mu 1975 rikagera kuri ha 356 mu 2006, rikagabanuka hafi 25%. Pariki y'igihugu ya Kitulo ni Pariki y'igihugu ya Tanzaniya, igizwe n'akarere karinzwe n'ibyatsi bya montane n'ishyamba ku kibaya cya kitulo mu misozi miremire cyane ya Tanzaniya. Parike iri ku butumburuke bwa hagati yimisozi ya Kipengere na Poroto kandi ifite ubuso bwa, uherereye mu Karere ka Mbeya no mu Karere ka Njombe. Iyi parike iyobowe na parike y’igihugu ya Tanzaniya (TANAPA) kandi ni parike ya mbere y’igihugu muri Afurika yo mu turere dushyuha yashinzwe cyane cyane mu kurinda Ibimera byayo.
Abenegihugu bavuga ko ikibaya cya Kitulo ari "Bustani ya Mungu (Ubusitani bw'Imana), mu gihe abahanga mu bimera bavuga ko ari "Serengeti y’indabyo".
Iyemezwa ry'iyi parike.
Kurinda ibimera bidasanzwe bya Kitulo Plateau byasabwe bwa mbere n’umuryango w'ibinyabuzima bitandukanye (WCS), mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga bugenda bwiyongera mu birayi Bya orchide ndetse no kongera ibikorwa byo guhiga no gutema amashyamba akikije. Mu 2002, nibwo Perezida Benjamin Mkapa yatangaje ko hashyizweho parike. Iyi parike yashyizwe mu kinyamakuru mu 2005, ihinduka parike y'igihugu ya cumi na kane ya Tanzaniya. TANAPA yatangaje ko iyi parike ishobora kwagurwa mu gihe kiri imbere kugira ngo ishyiremo ishyamba rituranye n'umusozi wa Rungwe.

Umusozi Rungwe ni umusozi wibirunga mu karere ka mbaya mu misozi miremire ya Tanzaniya. n'umusozi ufite utumburuke bwa, ni impinga ya kabiri yo hejuru ya Tanzaniya. Ikirunga cya Rungwe kuri ubu ntigikora.
Icyo wamenya k'umusozi wa Rungwe.
Rungwe ni ihuriro ry'uburasirazuba nuburengerazuba bwa bwa Africa. Yiganjemo igihugu cyimisozi mumajyaruguru uburengerazuba bw'urugero rwikiyaga kirimo ikiyaga cya Malawi.Urugero na kipengere ruri mu burasirazuba, Imisozi ya poroto kandi iherereye mu majyaruguru. yi Ikirunga cya Kyejo (m 2176 m) kiri mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba. Ikibaya cya Kyela, gifata ikibaya cya Rift yo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, kiri mu majyepfo, kigera ku kiyaga cya Malawi.
Ibibaya bikikije ishyamba rya Maimbo. Amashyamba yo hejuru ya montane aboneka kugera kuri metero 2600 z'uburebure, harimo ibiti byikozemo ikiraro bireshya na metero 10-25. Ibiti bisanzwe birimo "Albizia gummifera, Aphloia theiformis, Bersama abyssinica, Bridelia micrantha, Diospyros whyteana, Hagenia abyssinica, Macaranga kilimandscharica, Maesa lanceolata, Maytenus acuminata, Myrianthus holstii", na "Neoboutonia macrocalyx". "Astropanax goetzenii" n'umuzabibu usanzwe.

Umusozi Hanang ni umusozi uri wo mu majyaruguru ya Tanzaniya.ukaba uherereye mu karere ka Manyara na Hanang.Ni umusozi wa kane muremure muri Tanzaniya, ufite impinga eshatu za Kilimanjaro zibarwa nkumusozi umwe.
Inzira nyamukuru igana mu mpinga itangirira mu mujyi wa wa Katesh. Kuzamuka uwo musozi mugisate cy'ubukerarugendo bisaba amasaha 10 batara wurangiza bagakambika kugirango bagere kuwundi musozi wundi bifatante bakawugeraho kumunsi wa kabiri.
Ishyamba rya Hanang.
Ishamba rya Hanang rifite ubuso bwa 58.66 km², kumusozi muremure. Hagati ya metero 2000 na 2700 z'uburebure, amashyamba ya montane yicyatsi kibisi atwikiriye umusozi utose wiburasirazuba bwumusozi nuburasirazuba bwamajyepfo, mugihe ahantu humye h’iburengerazuba n’amajyaruguru humye amashyamba yumye ya montane yumye yicyatsi kibisi nicyatsi kibisi. Hejuru ya metero 2700, amashyamba yimukira mubutaka bwatsi ndetse nubwatsi bwo hejuru.

Ifite uburebure bwa ni umusozi wa gatatu muremure muri Tanzaniya ufite impinga eshatu za Kilimanjaro zifatwa nkumusozi umwe. Ol Doinyo Lengai ni ikirunga gikora mu majyaruguru ya Tanzaniya. kIgizwe na cone yibirunga hamwe na crater ebyiri, amajyaruguru yaturitse mugihe cyamateka. Mu buryo budasanzwe ku isi birunga, ibirunga byadutse natrocarbonatite, ubushyuhe buke budasanzwe n'ubwoko bwa magma. Kuruka muri 2007–2008 byagize ingaruka ku karere kagikikije
Abantu bo mu bwoko bw'aba Maasai na Sonjo bavuga ko ikirunga ari "Umusozi w 'Imana", gifitanye isano n’umugani w’imana y’imana Engai, wavuyeyo nyuma yo gukubitwa n’umuhigi akoresheje umwambi. Andi mazina nka Basanjo, Donjo Ngai, Duenjo Ngai, Mongogogura, Mungogo wa Bogwe, na Oldonyo L'Engai.
Ol Doinyo Lengai ni cone ihuza izamuka hejuru yikibaya gikikije. Ifite ibyobo bibiri ku mpande zombi z'umusozi, n'imisozi ipima dufite ubunini buri hagati ya kugeza kuri bibera mu mwobo kandi bigatanga umusaruro wa lava uva mu mpinga zabo kandi, iyo zisenyutse, ziva ku mpande zabo. Ikibaya cyo mu majyepfo ntigikora kandi rimwe na rimwe cyuzuyemo amazi. [14] Ikirunga gitwikiriye imisozi y’ibirunga, gifite imvumo nini ku ruhande rw’iburengerazuba. Hariho imiyoboro baciye ku mpande za Ol Doinyo Lengai, nka Craterum Crater mu burengerazuba, imiyoboro ya Nasira mu majyaruguru, ikibaya cya Dorobo mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba, na Oltatwa Crater ku ruhande rw'iburasirazuba.

Bisate Lodge ni hoteli yatangiye kandi yamamara mu mwaka 2018, yakorewe ingigo cyangwa imbata na Nicolas Plewman, aho igizwe n' amazu yo mw' ishyamba ibyo bakunze kwita Forest villas witegereje ubona ko izo nzu zubatse neza nk' inzu z' abami bo hambere mu Rwanda mbese nkizo wasanga murugo ry' umwami i Butare ho mu karere ka Huye.

Inyubako z' iyi hoteli zirihariye ndetse n' imbata yayo irihariye kuko uyitegereje usanga yubatse nk' uruziga kandi yubatswe n' ibiti cyangwa imbaho, iri mubwoko bwa lodge, ifiteibyumba 8 kandi ikagira na Villa imwe igizwe n' ibyumba 4 na pisine yihariye, iherereye ahantu heza hitegeye kandi haboneka inyamanswa nyinshi nki intare, ingwe, isha nizindi.

Royal balloon Rwanda ni companyi y' ubukerarugendo isanzwe ikorera mu bihugu binyuranye by' Afrika, ikaba yazanye agashya mu ubukerarugendo bw' uRwanda, aha yazanye imipira itwarwa numuriro hot air balloons ebyiri zigashishwa mu gusura ibiza nyaburanga bitatse pariki y' akagera wibereye mu kirere, kuburyo ushobora kwitegereza pariki y' igihugu y' akagere uyirihejuru mu metero zirihagati ya 100m na 1000m kandi hot air balloons zishobora gutwara abakerarugendo 4 cyangwa 6.
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2022 nibwo ububuryo bw' ubukerarugendo nibwa bwatangiye kwifashishya muri pariki y' Akagera kubufatanye bwa Royal balloon Rwanda n' urwego rushinzwe iterambere mu Rwanda RDB (Rwanda Development Board).
Umuyobozi w' ibikorwa bya Royal Balloon Rwanda mu Rwanda Atilla Turkmen yavuze ko Royal balloon bamaze imyaka irenga 30 bakora ibikorwa n' ubucuruzi byerekeye ubukerarugendo, rero bakaba biteguye kugernda n' icyerecyezo n' ingamba bya leta y' uRwanda muguteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda.
ububuryo bushya bwitezweho gufasha abakerarugendo bagana pariki y' akagera gusura no kwihera ijisho ibyiza bya pariki y' akagera cyane cyane inyamanswa nka; Intare, inzovu, imbogo, inkura, ingwe, impala nizindi.
Royal Balloon nkuko byagarutsweho n' umuyobozi wayo mu Rwanda bamaze imyaka irenga 30 bakora ibikorwa nkibi by' ubukerarugendo mu karere ka afrika y' iburasirazuba n' amagepfo, aho bamaze kugira inararibonye mugukoresha iyi mipira itwarwa n' umuriro.

Umisozi ya Marra (Fur, Fugo Marra; Arabic, Jebel Marrah ni impinga y'imisozi y'ibirunga iba muri massif ifite ubutumburuke bwa. Ni imisozi miremire muri Sudani.
Imisozi miremire iherereye hagati mu karere ka Darfur muri Sudani ku mupaka w’ibihugu bya Darfur yepfo na Darfur yo hagati, hamwe n’agace gato kari muri leta ya Darfur y'Amajyaruguru. Igice cyo hejuru ni Deriba Caldera. Ahagana hejuru ya massif ni agace gato ariko kagira ikirere gishyushye hamwe n’imvura nyinshi n’amasoko ahoraho y’amazi hagati ya savanna y'umye hamwe na scrub ya Sahel hepfo.
Imiterere y'umusozi wa Marrah.
Jebel Marra, n'ikirunga cya Tertiary gifite uburebure bwa, gikora mu majyaruguru n'amajyepfo nko muri, cyaguka kugera kuri, gikomeza amajyaruguru mu bindi. Imisozi ya Tagabo n'ikibaya cya Meidob, mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'urugero,abashakashatsi batekerezako aricyo ikomoka mu birunga. Ikibaya gishingiye ku rutare rwa Archean kikazamuka hagati y’ibibaya bya Tchad na Nili yo hagati kandi bigera mu burengerazuba kugera ku mupaka wa Sudani, bigakora umwobo utagira umupaka witwa Basement Complex, ufite uburebure buri hagati ya mu burasirazuba kugeza kuri mu burengerazuba. Imisozi n'udusozi twitaruye, nka Tebella Massif, birashoboka ko ibisigisigi byubuso bwakera bwisuri, akadomo.

Umusozi wa NUBA, ni agace gaherereye mu majyepfo ya Kordofan, muri Sudani. Ako gace gatuwe n'abaturage m'umoko kavukire azwi hamwe nkabaturage ba Nuba.abaturage babo Ntabwo bameze nkaba Nubian kavukire m'umajyaruguru ya Sudani. Ahubwo izina ryabo rikomoka ku izina ry'imisozi, “Nuba”. Mu Gihe Hagati, imisozi ya Nuba yari imwe mu bwami bwa Nubiya bwa Alodiya. Mu kinyejana cya 18, babaye ubwami bwa Taqali bwagenzuraga imisozi kugeza batsinzwe na Mahdi Muhammad Ahmad. Abongereza bamaze gutsinda ingabo za Mahdi, Taqali yagaruwe nk'igihugu. Kwinjira mu bwoko bwa Messiria na Muraheleen wo mu barabu ba Baggara byagize uruhare runini mu makimbirane agezweho ingeruka. Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 1.5 baba mu misozi, cyane cyane abo mu ubwoko bwa Nuba, hamwe na bake muri Baggara.
Ikindi wamenya muriri misozi yo mugace ka NUBA.
Ku rugero runini urutare rwo mu misozi ya Nuba rugize igice cyo mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bwa Shield y'Abarabu Nubian. Imisozi ya Nuba igizwe ahanini nubutare bwa metamorphic yo mu bihe bya Precambrian hiyongereyeho uduce tunyanyagiye mu rutare rwaka rwa Neoproterozoic na Paleozoic. Uzengurutse agace k'imisozi ya Nuba nk'inyanja hari ahantu hanini h'urutare rwa Cenozoic rwubatswe ruzwi ku izina rya "Rawaba". Ku misozi ya Nuba hari ububiko bwa fosifate bwakira uraniyumu, vanadium na fosifore bishobora kuba inyungu mu bukungu.
Imisozi miremire muri iki gihugu cya Sudani ni imisozi iboneka mugace rwagati k'imisozi ya Nuba, kandi iyi ni inselbergs. Izi inselbergs zigizwe ahanini nigitare cyaka, kuko urutare rwa metamorphic rwarangiritse cyane bityo rukaba rufite ubutaka bwo hasi.

I Rwanda ni agace gaherereye mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda, mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu karere ka Gasabo, mu murenge wa Rutunga, mu kagari ka Gasagara, hakaba ari mu mpinga y'umusozi wa Rutunga mu ihuriro ry'imidugudu ya Kamasasa na Gatare. Aha niho u Rwanda rugari rwa Gasabo rwahereye rwaguka.
Ibikorwa bya habaye.
I Gasabo habaye imiryango itandukanye y'abiru bo mu bwoko bw'abatege, bakaba bari bafite inshingano zo kuba abiru b'abanyamihango; Mu mihango umwiru w'umutege yarakurikiraga umwami w'u Rwanda mu cyubahiro ndetse bakaba bari banafite ingoma ngabe ebyiri ari zo: Rwagagaza na Rugeramisango, izi ngoma zikaba zimuritse mu ngoro y'umurage iri i Huye.
I Rwanda hatuye abami b'u Rwanda batandukanye barimo umwami Kigeri III Ndabarasa ndetse n'umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri.
I Rwanda hahoze urugo rw'umuterekero rw'umwami Yuhi V Musinga.

Munazi Eco Lodge ni hoteli iherereye mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda, mu ntara y'Uburengerazuba, mu karere ka Nyamasheke, umurenge wa Rangiro, akagari ka Banda, umudugudu wa Nkamba. Ikaba ibarizwa muri pariki y'igihugu ya Nyungwe.
Munazi Eco Lodge ni hoteli yatangiye kubakwa mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 2024, imirimo yo kubaka ikaba yarakozwe hifashishijwe ibikoresho bigezweho bidahumanya ikirere ndetse byose bikaba byarakorewe mu Rwanda mu rwego rwo kwimakaza ihame ryo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda.
Muri Kamena 2025 nibwo iyi hoteli yatangiye kwakira abayigana.
Munazi Eco Lodge yiswe izina "Munazi " rikomotse ku izina ry'igiti kiboneka mu ishyamba ry'igihugu rya Nyungwe cyitwa "Umunazi," kikaba ari igiti mu mikurire yacyo cyirangwa no gukura kigandarara, aho ukirebye ari munsi yacyo abona cyakoze ishusho y'umutaka.

Kigali Green Complex (KGC), ni inyubako irimo kubakwa i Kigali, aho iri kubakwa mu murwa mukuru w'u Rwanda, Kigali. Ikaba izaba igizwe n'amagorofa (etage) 29 mu bujyejuru uturutse k'ubutaka, biteganijwe ko iyi nyubako mu gihe ibikorwa byo kuyubaka bizaba birangiye izaba ariyo nyubako ndende mujyi wa Kigali ndetse no mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda muri rusange. Ndetse mu miterere yayo hagendewe ku gishushanyo mbonera cyayo izaba ifite izindi etage 6 zo munsi (zo mu bujyakuzimu).
Iyi nyubako iherereye mu gace kahariwe ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi n'amahoteli hagati mu mujyi wa Kigali, aho iherereye ku kibanza gifite ubuso bungana na. Iyi nyubako kandi iherereye hafi ya Kigali Convention Center,Inzovu mall,Kigali heights ikaba iri ahahoze inyubako yakoreragamo ibiro bya Minisiteri y’ubutabera mu Rwanda. Umuyoboro ndangamerekezo wa geografiya (GPS) waho ni: 1 ° 56'42.0 "S, 30 ° 03'44.0" E (Uburambike: -1.945000; Uburebure: 30.062222).
Inyubako y’amagorofa 29 iri mu bikorwa byo kubakwa n'ikigo cyitwa Ultimate Developers Limited (UDL), iyi nyubako ikaba ari umutungo w"’ikigo gishinzwe ubwiteganyirize bw’u Rwanda" (RSSB) ku kigero cy'ijanisha rya 100%. Iyi nyubako ya Kigali Green Complex ikaba yitezweho kuba imwe mu miyoboro ibyarira inyungu ikigo cya RSSB biturutse mu mafaranga yinjizwe avuye mu bafatanyabikorwa ba RSSB ndetse n'abagenerwabikorwa bayo, ndetse iyi nyubako izatanga umwanya uhagije wo gukodeshwa ndetse wujuje ibikenerwa byose ku bigo bitandukanye, ibikorwa bitandukanye by'ubucuruzi ndetse n’abantu ku giti cyabo.
Umujyanama mu bwubatsi by'umwihariko ku miterere y'inyubako (igishushanyo mbonera cy'inyubako) bivugwa ko ari Vavaki Architects. Amasezerano y'ubwubatsi, amasoko n'ibikorwa bigendanye n'ubwubatsi yahawe itsinda rya Shelter Group, rifite icyicaro i Doha, mu gihugu cya Qatar, akaba ari ikigo gifite ibiro mu burasirazuba bwo hagati, m'Uburayi ndetse no muri Aufrika. Ibikorwa byo gutegura ubucuruzi biteganijwe mu mwaka wa 2027.

ibyutaruzi k'intare.

Parike y'igihugu ya Serengeti ni pariki iherereye mu majyaruguru yo mugihugu cya Tanzaniya igera ku 14,763 km. Iherereye mu burasirazuba bwa Mara no mu majyaruguru y’akarere ka Simiyu kandi ikikijwe n'abaturage bagera kuri ya savanna. Iyi parike yashinzwe mu 1940.
Mu 1930, ubuso bungana na 2,286 km yagenwe nk'imikino yaberaga mu majyepfo no mu burasirazuba bwa Serengeti. Mu myaka ya za 1930, guverinoma ya Tanganyika yashyizeho gahunda ya parike y’igihugu yubahiriza ibyemezo bijyane n'amasezerano ajyanye no kubungabunga Fauna na flora muri Leta yabo.
Mu 1930, major Richard Hingdston, yasuye Tanganyika mu butumwa bwatanzwe na Sosiyete ishinzwe kubungabunga Fauna y’Ingoma (SPFE), yasabye ko ikigo cy’imikino cya Serengeti cyagenwa nka parike y’igihugu kugira ngo gikemure cg gikingire ibibazo by’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage n’iterambere ry’ubukungu.

Zanzibar [a] ni ikirwa cya Tanzaniya kiri ku nkombe za Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Iherereye mu nyanja y'Ubuhinde, kandi igizwe n'ibirwa byinshi bito n'ibinini binini, Muribyo birwa ikinini kirimo kitwa Zanzibar n'ikirwa cya Unguja n'ikirwa cya Pemba. Umurwa mukuru ni Umujyi wa Zanzibar, uherereye ku kirwa cya Unguja. Ikigo cyamateka cyacyo, Umujyi wa Kibuye, ni Umurage wisi.
Zanzibar kandi ni agace kigenga kunze ubumwe na Tanganyika mu 1964, kagashinga Repubulika yunze ubumwe ya Tanzaniya y'ubu.Inganda nyamukuru za archipelago ni ubwiza n'ubukerarugendo. Ingingo nyamukuru byakozwe. Ikirwa cya Zanzibar, hamwe n'ikirwa cya Mafia cyo muri Tanzaniya, rimwe na rimwe bakunze kwitwa "Ibirwa bya Spice". bigizwe n'ubukerarugendo bwa Zanzibar gahunda ya leta yatumye ubwiyongere bwa ba mukerarugendo 19.000 mu 1985, 376.000 muri 2016.
Imibereho n'ubuzima bwa Zanzibar.
Ubusumbane butandukanye buriho mu mibereho y'abatuye Pemba na Unguja, ndetse n'ubusumbane buri hagati y'abatuye imijyi n'icyaro. Impuzandengo y'umwaka yinjiza ni US $ 2500. Hafi ya kimwe cya kabiri cyabaturage baba munsi yumurongo wubukene.
N’ubwo urwego rwo hejuru rw’ubuvuzi n’uburezi rwibanze,impfu z'abana muri Zanzibar ni 54 kuri 1.000 bavutse ari bazima, ibyo bikaba biri munsi ya 10.0 ku ijana ugereranije n’igipimo cyo muri Tanzaniya. Umubare w'abana bapfa muri Zanzibar ni 73 kuri 1.000 bavutse ari bazima, ibyo bikaba biri munsi ya 21.5 ku ijana ugereranyije n'igipimo cyo muri Tanzaniya. Umubare w'abana bavuka muri Tanzaniya ni mwinshi, 35,64 bavuka ku baturage 1000, ariko umubare uragabanuka.

Tarangire ni parike y'igihugu iri mu karere ka Menyara muri Tanzaniya. Izina rya parike rikomoka ku ruzi rwa Tarangire rwambuka parike. Umugezi wa Tarangire nisoko yambere y’amazi meza y’inyamaswa zo mu gasozi muri Ecosystem ya Tarangire mugihe cyizuba cyumwaka. Ibinyabuzima bya Tarangire bisobanurwa no kwimuka intera ndende ya wildebeest na zebrasi. Mu gihe cyizuba inyamanswa ibihumbi n’ibihumbi byibanda muri parike ya Tarangire uhereye mu bihe bikikije ibihe byo gukwirakwiza no kubyara.
Ifite ubuso bungana nana 2,850 km. Imiterere nyaburanga igizwe n'imisozi ya granitike, ikibaya cy'umugezi, n'ibishanga. Ibimera ni uruvange rw’ishyamba Rya Acacia, ishyamba rya Combretum, ibyatsi byuzuyemo n'ibiti bya Adansonia.
Inzovu ya kera izwi kubyara impanga tuyisanga muri Tarangire. Ivuka ry'impanga ziherutse muri parike yigihugu ya Tarangire ya Tanzaniya ni urugero rwiza rw'ukuntu kuvuka kwizo mpanga zombi zifite ubuzima bwiza kandi bitera imbere bishobora gutsinda ibibazo.
Inzu ibamo amoko arenga 550, parike ni ahantu h'abakunda inyoni. Iyi parike izwi cyane kubera Imisozi miremire itondekanya imiterere. Abatereranywe usanga akenshi babamo dwarf mongoose. Muri 2015, giraffe yera kubera leucism yagaragaye muri parike. Ubushakashatsi bwibinyabuzima bwibanze ku nzovu yo muri Afurika yo mu gihuru na Masai giraffe.
Kuva mu 2005, agace karinzwe gafatwa nk'igice cyo kubungabunga intare muriyi pariki
Amerekezo ya pariki Tarangire.
Parike ya Tarangire irashobora kugerwaho unyuze kumuhanda wa kaburimbo uva Arusha mumasaha abiri.Pariki y'ikiyaga cya Manyara ni kilometero 70 uvuye Tarangire.

Imbogo ni Inyamanswa nini iteye nk' Inka iba mu ishyamba. Mu Rwanda Imbogo zikunze kuboneka muri Pariki y' igihugu y' Akagera iherereye mu ntara y' ibutasirazuba no muri pariki y' Ibirunga mu majyaruguru y' igihugu.Mu uturere Gatsibo, Kayonza na Nyagatare
Iyi inyamanswa uko iteye ni nki inka, gusa aho bitandukaniye nuko Imbogo ziba mu mashyamba kandi zikagira n' amahane nkuko akenshi bigaragaraiyo zitorotse pariki, aho usanga zitera abaturage ndetse zikanangiza imyaka yabo mu ntara y' amajyaruguru, ikindi nanone Imbogo iba nini kuruta Inka. Indi miterere ubona izi nyamanswa zombi zihuje.
ibindi wamenya ku mbogo.
Imbogo muri rusange zibamo amoko abiri manini gusa nanone bwoko nabwo bukagira andi moko mato abugize, kabaho imbogo zo muri Afrika akenshi ziganje mugice cy' Afrika y' iburasizuba n' amajyepfo, hakabaho n' imbogo zo muri Aziya bakunze kwita imbogo zo kumazi, zibonela mu Buhindi no mubice bihegereye cyane cyane. Imbogo iramba kugeza kumyaka 30, ihaka amezi 11.5 kandi iyo ibyaye ishobora kongera guhaka nyuma y' imyaka ibiri, zikunda kugenda mu matsinda gusa hari nizigenda zonyine cyangwa mu dutsinda duto cyane izo rero niza zigira amahane cyane, akenshi ziba ari imbogo z' ingabo zashaje izindi ngabo zikaziruka mu ishyo rinini, ziba zifite intege nke (zishaje) kandi zikarangwa n' amahane menshi no kwigunga.
Imbogo zo muri Afrika.
imbogo ziboneka muri Afrika n' imbogo zigabanijwemo amoko (Ibyiciro) abiri; hari imbogo zo mu mukenke (savannah) ziboneka cyane muri pariki zo muri kenya, tanzania, Botswana, Rwanda muri pariki y' igihugu y' akagera na Uganda mu bice by' imirambi ndetse hari n; ubundi bwoko bw; imbogo zo mu misozi izi rero zikunze kuba mu bice by' imisozi miremire nko mu Rwanda muri pariki y' igihugu y' Ibirunga ndetse no muri Tanzania.
Amabara y' imbogo zo muri Afrika.
Imbogo zo muri Afrika zikunze kuba zifite ibara ry' umukara muri rusange gusa habaho n' imbogo zifite ibara ry' igitare (Umweru) nkuko byagiye bigaragara muri pariki zo mu Rwanda z' akagera n' ibirunga.

Sisitemu yo Gusakaza Amazi yo Kunywa ya Karenge (KDWSS), ariyo ikunze kwitwa Sisitemu yo Gutanga Amazi ya Karenge ni uburyo bwo gukusanya cyangwa gufata amazi, agatunganywamo amazi meza, netse agakwirakwiza mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda. Iyi sisitemu itanga amazi mu bice bigize umujyi Kigali ndetse no mu Karere ka Rwamagana.
Ikigo gishinzwe gutunganya no gukwirakwiza amazi giherereye mu gace k'ibiyaga bya "Karenge", mu karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, ikaba yegerane n'inkombe z'ikiyaga cya Mugesera, nko muri, uturutse ku muhanda, mu majyepfo ashyira uburasirazuba bw'umujyi wa Kigali, umurwa mukuru w'igihugu cy'u Rwanda.
KDWSS yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1975 ifite ubushobozi bwo gutunganya amazi angana na (metero kube) buri munsi. Mu mwaka wa 1985, ubwo bushobozi bwongereweho bugera bugera kuri (metero kibe) buri munsi. Muri 2008, umusaruro wa buri munsi wongerewe kugera kuri. Kugeza mu Kwakira 2020, sisitemu yatunganyije (metero kibe) y'amazi yo kunywa yatunganywaga buri munsi, muri uwo musaruro (metero kibe) (80 ku ijana) yoherejwe i Kigali na (20 ku ijana) yatanzwe mu Karere ka Rwamagana.
Mu mwaka wa 2020, guverinoma y'u Rwanda, ibinyujije mu ishami ryayo, "Ishami rishinzwe gutunganya amazi n’isukura" (WASAC Limited), yiyemeje kongerera uru ruganda ubushobozi bwo gutunganya bwo gutunganya amazi kugera kuri (metero kibe) buri munsi. Imirimo yo kwagura ikubiyemo:
Kubaka no gutera inkunga.
Igiciro cyo kwagura giteganijwe kuzakoresha angana na miliyoni 164.3 z'amadolari y'Amerika. Inkunga yo kubaka itangwa ninzego zavuzwe hepfo:
Uruganda rwagutse ruri muri gahunda zateguwe n’ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda muri gahunda yo kugira ngo hagezwe amazi meza yo kunywa ku baturage bose mu Kuboza ku mwaka wa 2024.

Stade Umuganda ni sitade mberabyombi iherereye mu karere ka Rubavu aha hoze hitwa muri Gisenyi, mu ntara y'Uburengerazuba, mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda. Kugeza ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru, ku rwego rw'amakipe ya club nka Etincelles FC na Marines FC yose akaba akina muri Rwanda Premier League shampiyona y'amakipe yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda. Iyi sitade ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu bangana n'ibihumbi bitanu (5000). Sitade Umuganda ifite ikibuga kigizwe n'ibyatsi bihangano mu rurimi rw'icyongereza byitwa "turf artificial" ndetse ifite n'umwanya w'ikibuga cyo gukoreraho imyitozo. Hariho kandi ibyumba bine by'amakipe byo kwambariramo hamwe na VIP hamwe n'ibice byagenewe itangazamakuru. Iyi stade yakiriye imikino yo mu itsinda rya kane (Pool D) yo muri shampiyona y'ibihugu bya Afrika (CHAN) mu mwaka wa 2016.

ibyo wamenya ku impyisi imwe munyamaswa zitinyitse mu ishyamba, ibarwa munyamaswa zinkazi n'intare nizipfa kuyigondera kuko insuro nyinshi usanga zirwanira umuhigo nubwo waba wishwe n'intare, ubudahangarwa bw'impyisi buturuka kurwsaye rwayo rukomeye ku buryo bushobora guhekenya kandi rukajanjagura igufa ry'inzovu.
ibyo wamenya ku mpyisi.
ubusanzwe mumuryango w'impyisi harimo ubwoko bune butandukanye, impyisi zirangwa no kugira ibidomo binini ku ruhu rwazo kuko uko zigenda zitandukana niko nimiterere n'imigaragarire y'amabara y'uruhu igaragara itandukaniraho, kugeza ubu ku rwego rw'isi habarirwa impyisi ziri hagati 27000-47000, umuvuduko wayo ku isaha ushobora kugera kuri kilometero 60,impyisi ishobora gupima kilogarama ziri hagati ya 40-64 igihagararo cy'impyisi gishobora kubarirwa hagati ya santimetero 70-91, uburebure bwayo burihagati ya santimetero 95-166.
imibereho y'impyisi.
mubijyanye nimibanire yazo izi nyamaswa zibaho nkizindi nyamabere zitandukanye, mu jyihe cyaninjoro zireba neza cyane bigatuma zihiga ninjoro kumankwa zikaryama hafi yimyobo yazo, ziba mumiryango aho umuryango uba uyoborwa nimpyisi y'ingore, iyo zishatse kuganga zijya kure yimyobo yazo nabwo bukaba ubundi buryo bwokwerekana agace ziherereyemo, zijyira amajwi ajyera kure cyane izo bikazifasha mu buryo bwo guhanahana amakuru n'izindi zo mu bwoko zibarizwamo.
imyororokere y'impyisi.
ubu bwoko bw'impyisi icyigabo gishobora kwimya ibigore byinshi kubwagura bishobora kuba igihe icyaricyo cyose mumezi agize umwaka, iyo ikigore kimaze kubangurirwa kibwegeka amezi ane kandi kongera kwima ku yindi nshuro bikorwa hagati y'amezi 11 na 21, ikigore kibwagurira mu isenga kandi kikabwagura ibibwana hagati ya 1-3 ariko inshuro nyinshi biba aribibwana bibiri, bigacutswa hagati yamezi 12 na 18, impyisi, impyisi yingabo iva mumuryango yavukiyemo ku myaka ibiri mu gihe impyisi y'ingore ihaguma.
