Ingwe ni inyamanzwa ibarizwa mu itsinda ry' injangwe nini (Panthera) ni inyamajanja ndetse ikaba inyamanswa y' ikazi kandi ihorana umujinya ukabije, hari nizindi nyamanswa zibarizwa muri iritsinda nka; tigire, jaguari nizindi.
Ingwe n' inyamanswa yi indyanyama iboneka kandi ishobora kuba ahariho hose kwisi, ingwe ishobora kuba ahantu haba ubushyuhe bwinshi nko mu mukenke, mu bice by' ubutayu, ishobora kuba mu mashamba ahora agwamo imvura ndetse ziba nahantu haba amasimbi (Amasimbi) nko mu burussiya kanda hase ikahashobora.
muri pariki y' igihugu y' akagera nihamwe mu hantu haboneka ingwe mu Rwanda zikunda kwibera ahantu hihishe, akenshi iyo abakerarugendo bauye iyi pariki ntibazibona byoroshye, gusa muri iyi parike hari uduce dukunze kubonekamo inyamanswa y' ingwe nko mu bibaya bya; kilala, muhana, nyamashama, nyamatete na magashi biherereye ahagana mu majyaruguri y' iburasirazuba bwiyi pariki.

Ingando y’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa i Mimuri ni kimwe mu bice bikomeye byaranze amateka y’u Rwanda ikaba ibumbatiye urwibutso rw’ubuzima bw’umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Iherereye mu Mudugudu wa Rebero, Akagari ka Rugari, Umurenge wa Mimuri, mu Karere ka Nyagatare, ahahoze hitwa Umutara w’i Ndorwa.
Ingando y'i Mimuri yubatswe hagati y’imyaka ya 1940 na 1950, mu gihe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa yabaga ari kurambagiraigihugu, by'umwihariko mu gice cy’Umutara cyari kigizwe ahanini n’umukenke, ahanini ajya kureba ikiraro cy’inka ze cyari i Nyagatare (ahazwi nka "Cyarudahigwa") cyangwa agiye mu muhigo.
Kubera intera iri hagati y’i Nyanza n’i Mimuri, Umwami ntiyabashaga gusubira mu ngoro ye iherereye i Nyanza uwo munsi, bityo yategetse ko hubakwa iyo ngando kugira ngo ajye aharara.
Imiterere y’ingando.
Ingando igizwe n’amazu atanu yubatswe mu ishusho y’inzu za kinyarwanda, ariko zose zikaba zarubatswe mu mabati y’icyuma kuva hasi kugeza hejuru. Mu rwego rwo kugabanya ubushyuhe mu gihe cy’izuba n’ubukonje mu gihe cy’imbeho, hejuru y’amabati hashyirwagaho ibyatsi bizwi nk’inkorogoto.
Inkike y’ingando yabaga yubakitse neza, igakorerwaho isuku n’ivugurura, cyane cyane iyo umwami yabaga ategerejwe ko ahajya. Kugeza ubu, ibimenyetso bimwe by’iyo nkike biracyahari, birimo umunyinya umwe n’ibiti bibiri by’imishashi yo mu bwoko bw'inganzamarumbo.

Ubukomane bwa Nyakayaga ni agace gakungahaye ku mateka y’ubworozi n’ingendo mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Gaherereye mu Mudugudu wa Bukomane, Akagari ka Bukomane, Umurenge wa Gitoki, mu Karere ka Gatsibo, mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba. Aka gace kari ku nkengero z’aho Umutara wagabaniraga n’Ubuganza bwa Ruguru.
Ubukomane bwa Nyakayaga bwamenyekanye cyane mbere y'umwaduko w’abazungu ndetse no ku ngoma ya gikoroni, nk’ahantu habereye ubworozi kubera ubwatsi bwiza bwahabonekaga byumwihariko ku misozi ya Kiburara na Nyakayaga. Ubu bwatsi bwatumaga abatunzi bo mu bice by’Ubuganza n’Umutara, ndetse no mu tundi duce nka Ndorwa, Bugesera, Gisaka, na Bwanacyambwe, bahakunda cyane kuko inka zabo zahabaga neza, zikabyara vuba, kandi zigakamwa amata y’amavuta menshi.
Mu gihe amapfa yabaga yateye, aka gace kabaga ahantu hakururaga aborozi baturutse impande zose z’igihugu. Ibi byatewe n’ubwoko bw’ubwatsi bwahabonekaga burimo itete, umucaca, urukemba, inyovi, ivubwe, n’ishinge.
Iriba rya Rwarukaza.
Mu misozi ya Nyakayaga, Gikoma, na Matare, hahoraga iriba rihiye ryitwaga "Rwarukaza". Rikaba ryari iriba rizwi cyane mu bworozi kuko inka zanywaga ku mazi yaryo zahakaga cyane n’iyo ubwatsi bwabaga bwabaye buke. Bitewe n’uko ayo makera yafatwaga nk’isoko y’uburumbuke bw’inka, benshi mu batunzi bahitaga baguma i Nyakayaga, bamwe bagatura burundu.
Nubwo iriba rya Rwarukaza rikiri aho ryahoze, ubu ntirigikoreshwa mu bworozi kuko amazi yaryo agenerwa ubuhinzi bw’umuceri mu bishanga bya Rwagitima na Ntende.

Ku Cyasemakamba ni agace kari mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, mu Karere ka Ngoma, Umurenge wa Kibungo, Akagari ka Cyasemakamba, Umudugudu wa Kiruhura. Aka gace gaherereye hafi y’amasangano y’umuhanda munini uturuka Kigali werekeza Rusumo n’uwerekeza mu Mujyi wa Kibungo. Amateka y’aka gace ahanini ashingiye ku mutware Semakamba mwene Shumbusho ya Vuningoma ya Rwasa, wo mu muryango w’Abasa, wabayeho ku ngoma z’Abami Mutara II Rwogera na Kigeri IV Rwabugiri.
Amateka ya Semakamba.
Semakamba ya Shumbusho yabaye umwe mu batware b’ingabo z’u Rwanda, akaba yaravaga mu muryango w’Abasa. Yakuriye mu mutwe w’ingabo Abatsinzi, wari warashinzwe ku ngoma ya Mibambwe III Sentabyo. Uyu mutwe w’ingabo watwarwaga na Vuningoma, sekuru wa Semakamba, wanawuraze umuhungu we Bakimbagira, wageze ku butware ariko akaza gupfa ku ngoma ya Kigeri IV Rwabugiri. Nyuma ye, umutwe wategetswe na Ngabo, umuhungu wa Bakimbagira.
Semakamba ya Shumbusho yageze ku Cyasemakamba aherekeje ingabo z’u Rwanda ubwo zateraga igice cy’Igisaka, kikigarurirwa na Mutara II Rwogera mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana cya 19. Yahisemo gutura muri ako gace, aho yateye igiti cy’umuvumu cyaje kumenyekana cyane mu mateka y’ako gace.
Inkomoko y'izina Cyasemakamba.
Izina “Cyasemakamba” rikomoka ku mvugo y’abaturage bajyaga bavuga ku giti cy’umuvumu cyari mu itongo rya Semakamba. Aho bavugaga bati “Kiriya giti ni icya Semakamba”, bigenda bihinduka buhoro buhoro kugeza ryabaye “Ku Cyasemakamba”, izina rirahafata kugeza n’ubu.

Ingoro ndangamateka y' urugamba rwo guhagarika Jenoside nimwe mu ngoro z' umurage, umuco n' amateka z' uRwanda, yatangiye kumugaragaro itangijwe na nakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika y' uRwanda Paul KAGAME muri 2017.
Ibyo wamenya kuri iyi ngoro.
Iyi ngoro Ndangamateka y' urugamba rwo guhagarika jenoside ni ingoro iherereye I Kigali ahahoze hitwa muri CND ubu hakorera inteko ishinga amategeko imitwe yombi. iyo usuye iyi ngoro ubona inzira y' umusara ingabo za RPF _ Inkoyanyi zanyuzemo kugirango zihagarike jenoside yakorerwaga Abatitsi muri 1994 mu Rwanda, harimo amashusho, amakarita bikranye ubuhanga bigaragaza ayo mateka ndetse iyi ngoro irimo ibyumba 9 bigaragaza amateka y' urugamba rwo guhagarika jenoside kuva ku masezerano ya Arusha yo muri 1993 kugeza hagiyeho guverinoma y' ubumwe bw abanyarwanda muri nyakanga 1994.
Ibihe byingenzu mu rugamba rwo guhagarika jenoside.
Muri 1990 tariki ya 1 ukwakira, ingabo za RPA (RPF _ Inkotany) zagabye igitero ku umupaka wa kagitumba, ziyobowe Major General Fred Gasa RWIGEMA, bigeza ku tariki ya 2 ukwakira major general fred Gisa RWIGEMA yarasiwe Nyabwishongwezi arapfa, kuva icyogihe kugeza mu matariki ya 16 ukwakira, muri icyo gihe ingabo za RPA yatakaje morale kubera icyuho cyo kubura bamwe mubayobozi, kuko ingabo zare ya habyarimana zifatanyije n' abacancuro barabarashe cyane.
Ryabega kuwa 23 ukwakira major bayingana na bunyenyezi bararashwe kurugamba bikomeza kuba bibi, bigeze mu gushyingo 1990, habyarimana yemereye amashyaka menshi gukora, mu kuboza leta ya habyarimana ihimba ikinyoma cyuko Inkotanyi zateye Kigali kugirango babone uko batoteza abatutsi.
muri 1991, mutarama tariki 3 RPA yahinduye uburyo bwo kugaba ibitero, batera gatuna na kaniga, tariki 7 leta abantu urwogupfa babaziza ko ari ibyitso by' inkotanyi, tariki ya 23 mutarama RPA yafashe umujyi wa ruhengeri ari nabwo yafunguye abitwaga ibyitso bari bafungiye kuri gereza Ruhengeri.
Muri 1992, Werurwe leta ya Habyarimana nibwo yashinze umutwe w' abahutu babahezanguni wiswe CDR n' iyicwa y' abatutsi mu bugesera, muri Gicurasi RPA yagabye ibitero yigarurira amakomini amwe mu majyarugurun' iburasirazuba bituma abaturage benshi bava mubyabo. mumpera z' uyu mwaka abatutsi benshi barishwe ninabwo mu ugushyingo Lo Mugesera avugiye ijambo ku kabaya ashishikariza abahutu gutsemba abatutsi, ngo babanyuze muri nyabarongo basubire aho bakomoka muri Ethiopia.
muri 1993 muntangiriro PRA yari yamaze kwigarurira agace kaniki k' igihugu ndetse iza no gusubira inyuma kugirango bagaragaze ko ibirikubera mu Rwanda biteye inkeke, abatutsi baricwaga, inyigisho z' urwango kuri radiyo RTLM, gutoza abicanyi nk' interahamwe n' impuzamigambi, bigeze tariki ya 28 ukuboza ingabo 600 za RPA zigize batayo ya gatatu zageze muri CND i kigali muri gahunda yo kubahiriza amasezerano ya Arusha.
muri 1994 mata, tariki ya 6 arusha habaye inama y' akarere, muri iryo joro inde ya habyarimana irahanurwa yenda kugera ku kibuga cy' indege i kigali, tariki ya 7, hishwe uwari minisitiri w' intebe, abandi baminisitiri bataribashyigikiye umugambi wa jenoside n' abamurinda 10 bababiligi kandi Jenoside yahise itangira muri Gitarama, byumba nahandi, tarriki ya 8 PRA biyemeje gutera Kigali no guhagarika jenoside, mu nzira zitoroshye guturuka ku murindi wa byumba berekeza i kigali, kugera kuri tariki ya 30 mata RPA yari yamaze kwigarurira ibindi bice nka byumba yose ndetse n' umupaka wa rusumo, muri gicurasi ingabo za RPA zakomeje umurego kuko kuri tariki 18 barashe radiyo RTLM, tariki 22 babohoye ikibuga mpuzamaganga cy' indege cya kigali, tariki 29 babohoye umugi wa Kigali. muri kamena tariki 2, RPA yabohoye Kabyayi, tariki 28 loni itangaza umwanzuro ko mu Rwanda hari kuba Jenoside ikorerwa abatutsi, kugera muri nyakanga tariki 19 ubwo hashigwaga goverinoma y' ubumwe bw' abanyarwanda no guhagarika jenoside kumugaragaro, ibice byose by' igihugu byari byabohowe ibyanyuma byari Butare, Ruhengeri na Gisenyi.
Aho iyi ngoro ndangamateka iherere ari naho inteko ishinga amategeko ikorera, hashyizwemo icyumba cyihariye cyo kumurikiramo ibihangano bibumbatiye aya mateka yo kubohora igihigu no guhagarika jenoside, urubyiruko rwahawe icyo
cyumba ruhagarariwe na King Ngabo, ni abanyabugeni babyize mwishuri kandi bakora ibihangano byiza. ururubyiruko rubyaza inyungi ibihangano byarwo arinako bafasha igihugu kumenyekanisha no gusigasira amateka.

Misiyoni Gatolika ya Zaza ni imwe mu za mbere zashinzwe n’Abamisiyoneri b’Abapadiri bera mu Rwanda, ikaba iya kabiri mu gihugu nyuma ya Misiyoni ya Save. Yashinzwe ku italiki ya 1 Ugushyingo 1900 ishingwa na Musenyeri John Joseph Hirth, mu rwego rwo kwagura ivugabutumwa rya Kiliziya Gatolika mu bice by’i Gisaka byari bimaze igihe gito byigaruriwe n’u Rwanda.
Misiyoni ya Zaza iherereye mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, mu Karere ka Ngoma, Umurenge wa Zaza, Akagari ka Ruhembe, ku musozi wa Ruhembe mu gice cy’aho, mbere hitwaga Mirenge mu Gisaka cy’Igihunya. Iherereye hafi y’amasangano y’umuhanda munini wa Kigali–Rusumo n’uwerekeza mu mujyi wa Kibungo.
Abapadiri bashinze misiyoni.
Mu batangije misiyoni ya Zaza harimo:
Mu bandi bashinze misiyoni mu minsi ya mbere harimo Padiri Brard (Terebura), Furere Anselme, na bo bombi bari barakoreye i Save mbere yo kuza i Zaza.
Amavu n'amavuko n'inkomoko.
Abapadiri bageze i Zaza bakirwa na Karakawe, se wa Joseph Rukamba ndetse akaba na sekuru wa Musenyeri Aloys Bigirumwami, wabaye umwepisikopi wa mbere w’Umunyarwanda. Inzu yabo ya mbere yari nto, yubatswe ku musozi wa Ruhembe, ikaba yari iyo kwifashisha mu kwikinga izuba n’imbeho.
Nk’uko byari byarakozwe ahandi, abapadiri bakoreshaga impano nk’amasaro, imyenda, umunyu, n’ibindi mu rwego rwo gukurura abaturage ku idini Gatolika. Aha ni na ho Elisabeth Nyirambeba, umukirisitu wa mbere w’Umunyarwandakazi, yabatirijwe mu mwaka wa 1903, nubwo yakomokaga i Save.
Abanyarwanda ba mbere bihaye Imana.
Misiyoni ya Zaza yabereye isoko abanyarwanda ba mbere mu nzira yo kwiha Imana, muri abo banyarwanda harimo:

Isoko ry’i Rukira riherereye mu Murenge wa Murama, Akagari ka Kigabiro, Umudugudu wa Kigabiro, mu Karere ka Ngoma, mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba. Mu mateka, iri soko ryakorerwagamo ubucuruzi bw’abantu, cyane cyane abacakara babaga bafashwe bunyago cyangwa bashinjwaga ubugizi bwa nabi, rikaba ryarabayeho mu mpera z’ikinyejana cya 19.
Ubucuruzi bw'abacakara muri Rukira.
Ahagana mu myaka ya 1890, mu gice cyari kizwi nka Gisaka Migongo, hari ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bw’abantu byakozwe n’Abarabu n’Abaswayire. Abashimusi bafataga abasore n’inkumi bo mu bihugu bituranye n’u Rwanda cyangwa Abanyarwanda bashinjwaga ubugizi bwa nabi, bakabajyana kubagurisha ahitwa i Gisundwe muri Tanzaniya.
Uruhare rw’abaturage n’abatware b’Abanyarwanda.
Nubwo abacuruzi b’abanyamahanga bagerageje gukora ubucuruzi bw’abantu mu Rwanda, biragoye kuvuga ko byari byemewe. Abarabu bari bafite ingabo zigera kuri 500 bagerageje kwinjira mu Rwanda gushaka abacakara, ariko Abanyarwanda babasubije inyuma bakoresheje imyambi n’intwaro gakondo. Ibi bigaragaza ko ubutegetsi bwa cyami, cyane cyane ubwo ku ngoma y'Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri, butigeze bushyigikira ubucuruzi bw’abacakara.
Ihagarikwa ry’ubucuruzi bw’abantu.
Ubucuruzi bw’abantu muri ako gace bivugwa ko bwacitse mu mizo y’ingoma ya Yuhi V Musinga. Icyo gihe, abari basigaye bafite abacakara babahinduye abaja bo mu ngo, kugeza igihe basaziye cyangwa bakiriwe nk’abaturage basanzwe.
Aho isoko ryahoze n’ibimenyetso bisigaye.
Aho isoko rya Rukira ryari riri, ubu hubatse ibiro by’Umurenge wa Murama, biherereye nko muri metero 500 uvuye kuri Paruwasi Gatorika ya Rukira. Hegereye kandi ibiro by’Akagari ka Kigabiro hamwe nindi nzu yubatswe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni, yakorerwagamo n’umudiyakoni w’Umubiligi wayoboraga ako karere mu myaka ya za 1940.

Urwobo rwa Bayanga, cyangwa ahazwi nko Mu Rwabayanga, ni ahantu hari urwobo ruherereye mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, Akarere ka Bugesera, Umurenge wa Mayange. Ni urwobo ruri hagati mu ishyamba riri mu gice cy’ahitwa Gako, hafi y’umupaka w’u Rwanda n’u Burundi. Mu Rwabayanga hafite amateka maremare, ajyanye n'imico, imyumvire n'amateka y’u Rwanda kuva kera kugeza igihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.,,
Amateka n’inkomoko y’izina.
Hari impaka zishingiye ku nkomoko y’uru rwobo ndetse no ku muntu witwaga Bayanga aho bivugwa ko yarwubatse cyangwa yaruguyemo. Bamwe bavuga ko Bayanga yari umugaragu w'umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri wafukuye iriba riri imbere mu nzu ye mu gihe hariho izuba rikabije, maze bituma abona amazi ku giti cye(wenyine) maze bikabangamira ibwami. ibyo byaje gutuma afatwa nk’umugome, aratoroka ajyana n’amatungo ye, azimira muri rwa rwobo arurohamamo. Abandi bavuga ko yari umutasi waturutse i Burundi ku ngoma ya Yuhi III Mazimpaka, aho yategetswe gucukura umwobo kugeza abonye igihugu cye. Hari n’abavuga ko yari nyirarume wa Nsoro w’i Bugesera, akicwa azira gucika na inka.,
Umumaro n’uruhare mu muco.
Urwo rwobo rwahuriragamo imyumvire myinshi y’imigenzo gakondo. Rwavugwagaho kuba rurerure cyane ku buryo ruhinguka mu kiyaga cya Rweru cyangwa mu Cyohoha. Hari n’abavugaga ko harimo inzoka nini y’uruziramire, ndetse hakabamo n’amajanja y’imbwa za Ruganzu II Ndori.
Urwobo rwa Bayanga ryifashishwaga nk’igihano gikomeye, aho abarwanyaga ubutegetsi cyangwa abakekwagaho imyitwarire mibi barohwaga. Mu mateka, hari abakobwa batwaye inda z’indaro ndetse n’abakekwagaho imyitwarire idakwiriye bo mu muryango w’ibikomangoma barohwagamo. Abayobozi nka Rwampembwe, Nyombayire, Baryinyonza Burabyo n’abandi baroshwemo nk’igihano cy’ubugome cyangwa kwigomeka.,

Imisezero ni ahantu hatabarizwaga (hashyingurwaga) abami n' Abagabekazi b' u Rwanda, mu Rwanda Abami n' abagabekazi bagiye batabarizwa ahantu hatandukanye mu gihugu ariko habayeho imisezero rusange, urugero n' umusezero w' Abami w' i rutare ho mu murenge wa rutare mu karere ka Gicumbi kuri ubu. Aha i Rutare hatabarijwe Abami 11 n' Abagabekazi 2, kugeza ubu imisezero (Imva) zikigaragara ni 2 iy' umwami Kigeli IV Rwabugiri yatwaye u rwanda kuva muri 1853 _ 1895 nuwa Nyirayuhi V kanjogera, ahandi ntabimenyetso bigaragara ko hari imisezero kuko n' abaturage bahakoresha mumirimo yabo isanzwe yaburi munsi.

Umusozi Speke uri muri parike yigihugu ya Ruwenzori muri Uganda kandi niwo musozi wa kabiri muremure Hamwe n'umusozi Stanley n'umusozi wa Baker, ikora inyabutatu ikikije ikibaya cyo hejuru cya Bujuku. Impinga yegereye ni umusozi wa Stanley,ufite ubuso bwa 3.55 km (2.21 mi) mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba.
Imisozi yose muriki cyiciro igizwe nimpinga nyinshi. Mount Speke ni Vittorio Emanuele 4,890 m (16.040 ft) ; Ensonga ifite ubuso bwa 4,865 m (15,961) ft) ; Johnston 4,834 m (15.860 ft) ; na Trident 4,572 m (15.000) ft). Amazina yatoranijwe yubaha umuryango wibwami wUbutaliyani; icyakora, guhitamo izina byagombaga kwemezwa na Protectorate y'Ubwongereza na Uganda wayoboraga ako karere muri kiriya gihe.

Umusozi wa Moroto, ufite ubuso bwa (), ni umusozi uri mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Uganda.
Izina kavukire ryuyu musozi ryari "Moru To" (bisobanura "umusozi wiburengerazuba", rikomoka ku magambo "Moru" risobanura umusozi na "Kuri" bisobanura iburengerazuba). wiswe gutya kuko mugihe cyo kwimuka kwimiryango kavukire, yakomokaga muri Etiyopiya, yagaragaye mu burengerazuba.
Uyu musozi kandi wegeranye n'umujyi wa Moroto mu Karere ka Moroto, Karamoja, Intara y'Amajyaruguru ya Uganda. Nibirometero 3(3km), kumuhanda, iburasirazuba bwa Moroto akarere k'ubucuruzi hagati. Umusozi wa Moroto ni umwe mu ruhererekane rw'ibirunga ku mupaka mpuzamahanga wa Uganda na Kenya utangirira ku musozi wa Elgon mu majyepfo ukaba urimo umusozi wa Kadam n'umusozi wa Morungole. Agace gakikije umusozi wa Moroto ni ishyamba ry’amashyamba ririnda ahantu hatandukanye kuva savanna yamahwa yumye kugeza ishyamba ryumye.
Ibidukikije bikikije umusozi wa Moroto bipima kandi bikubiyemo amoko arenga 220 y’inyoni, inkende ninjangwe. Inzira zo kuzamuka zirahari kandi n'abantu abayobora imisozi barahari.
Amasoko karemano k'umusozi wa coesce kugirango ube amasoko ninzuzi nto Gahunda y'ibiribwa ku isi. yigisha abaturage ba Karimajong uburyo bwo gusarura no kubika ayo mazi no kuyakoresha mu kuhira umusaruro w'ubuhinzi mu biribwa byo mu rugo no kwinjiza amafaranga.

= Dr. Justin NSENGIYUMVA =
Dr. Justin NSENGIYUMVA, yari asanzwe ari visi guverineri wa bank nkuru y' igihugu kuva muri gashantare 2025, kuwa 23 nyakanga 2025 yagizwe minisitiri w' intebe na nyakubahwa perezida wa repubulika t' u Rwanda paul KAGAME, asimbuye Dr. Eduard NGIRENTE wari muri uwo mwanya kuva muri 2017.
Minisitiri w' Intebe mushya Dr. Justin NSENGIYUMVA afite inararibonye mu bukungu na politiki y' u Rwanda ndetse namahanga kuko yize anabona impamyabumenyi zinyuranye muri za kaminuza zikomeye ndetse anakora imirimo itandukanye mu gihugu no mu mahanga yerekeye ubukungu na politiki.
Dr. Justin NSENGIYUMVA yize muri catholic university of eastern Africa ahakura impamyabumenyi y' icyiciro cya kabiri mu bucuruzi, yahise yerekeza muri kaminuza ta nairobi naho ahakura icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu ngamba z' ubukungu n' imicungire yabwo, muri 2011 kugeza 2015 yize ze muri kaminuza ya Liecester ahakura Impamyabushobozi y' ikirenga mu bukungo.
Dr. Justin NSENGIYUMVA yakoze imirimo myinshi inyuranye yerekeranye n' ubukungu n' ingamba zabwo, ubucuruzi n' uburezi haba imbere mu gihugu no mu mahanga.

= Mpazi Model Village =
Umushinga wa Mpazi wo kuvugurura imiturire y' abaturage batuye ahazwi nko mu gitega ku mugezi wa Mpazi, aha abahatuye bari mubyago bikabije byo guhura n' ibiza kuko uwa mugezi wajyaga uhura n' amazi ya ruhuru yo mu mujyi amazi akuzura agateza ibibazo kuko yigeze gutwara ubuzima bw' abantu.
Ibyo wamenya kuri Mazi Model Village.
Umushinga w' imiturire ivuguruye wa Mpazi ni umwe mu mishinga itandukanye y' umugi wa Kigali yo kuvugurura imiturire mu mujyi cyane cyane mu duce dufite imiturire y' akajagari kandi ishyira umuzima bw' abaturage mu byago, uyu mushinga watangiye muri 2021 mu gice cy' igerageza aho hubatswe inzu eshanu za G+2 (Zigeretse kabiri) nyuma yiri gerageza Guverinoma y' u Rwanda binyuze mu mugi wa Kigali na minisiteri y' ingabo, bakomeje uyu mushinga bawita Mpazi rehousing project aho bari kubaka umudugudu w' amazu ageretse gatatu (G+3), uyu mudugudu biteganyijwe ko uzatuzwamo abasaga 688, harimo imihanda, ubusitani n' amazi meza.
Gasabo 3D companyi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi muri uyu mushinga ivugako imirimo yo kubaka uyu mudugudu biteganyijwe ko izarangizwa muri kamena 2025.
Indi mishinga yo kuvugurura imiturire muri kigali.
Umugi wa Kigali ufite gahunda yo kunoza imiturire y' abatuye kigali, nyuma yo gushyira mubikorwa uyu mushinga wa mpazi Model Village ubari indi mishinga muri Kigali izasiga abanyakigali batuye neza kandi batekanye.

= Nyabisindu Model Village =
Umugi wa Kigali ukomeje kuvugurura imiturire y' abawutuye, mu karere ka Gasabo mu murenge wa Remera ahazwi nka Nyabisindu hatangiye kubakwa imidugudu y' icyitegererezo mu mushinga wa leta y' u Rwanda uzwi nka Kigali formal settlement mugice cyawo cya Nyabisindu Rehousing Project, aho biteganijwe ko abarenga 1600 bazatuzwa muri iyi midugudu.
Nyabisindu Model Village watangiye muri Mata 2025 biteganyijwe ko mu mwaka umwe uzaba wageze kumusozo, uzaba wubatse kuri hegitari zirenga 38, ugizwe n' imidugudu 4 ndetse nundi uzongerwaho nyuma, amashuri, isiko, ubusitani bugezweho n' imihanda yakijyambere.
Ubuyobozi bw' umugi wa Kigali buvuga ko imishinga nkiyi izakomeza gukorwa ahantu hatandukanye mu mugi murwego rwo rwoguhangana n' ikibazo cy' imiturire kandi no kunoza itunganyirize y' umugi, byagarutsweho na meya w' umugi wa Kigali Samuel DUSENGIYUMVA mu gutangiza uyu mushinga.

Minisiteri y' Ibidukikije yabonye Minisitiri mushya kuga kuwa 24 nyakanga ubwo Nyakubahwa perezida wa repubulika y' u Rwanda Paul KAGAME ubwo yashyiragaho guverinoma nshya, Dr. Bernadette Arakwiye yasimbuye Dr. Uwamariya Valentine wayoboraga iyi minisiteri kugeza ubu.
minisitiri w' ibidukikije Dr. bernadette Arakwiye ni umunyarwandakazi wize kurwego ruhanitse mu mashuri atandukanye yo mu Rwanda no mumahanga nko mu bwongereza na Amerika, kandi yanakoze imirimo inyuranye y' ubushakashatsi mu bigo mpuza mahanga bikora ibyerekeye ibidukikije n' ubumenyi bw' isi.
Dr. bernadette Arakwiye yize muri kaminuza nkuru y' u Rwanda ahakura impamyabumenyi y' icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu binyabuzima, yongeye kubona impamyabumenyi y' icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bidukikije muri kaminuza ya Antiock University New England kandi nanone yabonye impamyabushozi y' ikirenya mu bumenyi bw' isi ayikuye muri kaminuza ya Clark university muri Massachusetts, Amerika.
Dr. bernadette Arakwiye mbere yo kuba minisitiri w' ibidukikije muri Guverinoma y' u Rwanda yari umuyobozi mukuru wa World resources Institute (WRI) ayoboye porogaramu ya Land restoration kuri afrika, kandi yanabaye umuyobozi w' inama y' ubutegetsi yarishinzwe kwiga kuri porogaramu yo kubungabunga ubutaka muri Afrika, ariko mbere yaho yari umushakashatsi ari research associate mukigo cya conservation international muri amerika, ndetse yanabaye research assistant mukigo cya Dian fossey gorilla funds international mu Rwanda.

Umubari ni agace gaherereye mu ntara y'Uburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda, kari mu gice cy’icyanya cy’Akagera (parike y'Akagera). Amateka y’iki gice yerekana ko hari hasanzwe hatuwe n’igihugu cyigenga cyayoborwaga n’Umwami Biyoro n’umugabekazi Nyirabiyoro. U Rwanda rwaje kwigarurira agace k'Umubari ku ngoma y'umwami Kigeri III Ndabarasa, nyuma y’aho se Cyirima II Rujugira yari yohereje umuhungu we kuhigarurira. Nyuma y’icyo gikorwa, Umubari wagiye ucengera buhoro buhoro mu Rwanda, n’ubwo wakomeje kugira ubwigenge kugeza mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana cya 20, nyuma y’Intambara ya Mbere y’Isi Yose.
Ku ngoma y'umwami Kigeli III Ndabarasa, Umubari wigaruriwe n’ingabo z’u Rwanda zari ziyobowe na Kamari ka Gahurira. Hari ibitekerezo bitandukanye bivuga ko Kigeli III Ndabarasa ashobora kuba yarigaruriye Umubari akiri igikomangoma, ibindi nabyo bikavuga ko ashobora kuba yarawigruriye amaze kuba umwami. Nyuma y’ifatwa ry’Umubari abaturage baho batangiye kwimuka, u Rwanda ruragenda rwibagirwa Umubari kugeza igihe cy’ubukoloni.
Ibitekerezo nyemvugo bivugwa ku Mubari.
Mu myemerere y’Abanyarwanda, bivugwa ko Gihanga Ngomijana, wahanze u Rwanda, akomoka ku bimanuka byamanutse mu ijuru bigwa mu Mubari. Ibyo bimanuka ni Sabizeze (Kigwa), Mututsi, na Nyampundu. Bitwa ibimanuka kuko bakomotse ku Mana y’ijuru (Nkuba). Bivugwa ko mu gihe ibimanuka byamanukaga aribyo byazanye amatungo, imbuto, n’imyuga ine yahoze ari ingenzi mu Rwanda ariyo ububaji, ubucuzi, ubukannyi, n'ubuhigi, bityo Umubari ukitwa inkomoko y’umuco n’ubwami bw’u Rwanda.
Nyirabiyoro yari umugabekazi wo mu Mubari. Amateka ye akunze gushingirwaho mu buhanuzi n’amateka y’ingoma ya Kigeri III Ndabarasa. Nyirabiyoro yahunze ubwo ingabo za Ndabarasa zafataga Umubari, nyuma akaza gufatirwa aho yari yarahungiye i Karagwe agasubizwa i Rwanda aho yishwe n’Ingabo za Ndabarasa. Azwi cyane mu mateka y’ubuhanuzi yagiye ahanura ku Rwanda ibikunze kwitwa indagu za Nyirabiyoro.
Nyirarucyaba yari umukobwa wa Gihanga. Yamenyekanye mu mateka y’imiryango migari y’ubwami bw’u Rwanda, by’umwihariko mu kwitirirwa inkomoko y’ubwoko bw'Abacyaba. Inkuru ye ivuga uburyo yishe mukase (Nyirampirangwe) akamumena inda yari atwite, maze agahunga akajya gutura mu Mubari, aho yabyaye abana maze batandukanwa ku nkomoko ya se maze bitirirwa nyina haba havutse ubwoko bw'Abacyaba.

Ku Cyarudahigwa ni ahahoze icyiraro cy’inka z’umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa, giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyagatare, Akarere ka Nyagatare, mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba. Iki cyiraro cyahoze cyubatse ku musozi wa Nsheke, kuri ubu hakaba hubatse ibiro by’Akagari ka Nsheke, kandi ni ho ibi biro byubatse muri iki kibanza. Iki kiraro cyarashenywe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ariko ibisigaratongo byacyo birimo ibikuta n’ibyuma byari bifashe igisenge biracyari aho cyari cyubatse.
Inkomoko y’icyiraro.
Nyuma yo kwima ingoma, Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa yagaragaje ubushake bwo guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’Abanyarwanda, ariko imigambi ye yagiye ikomwa mu nkokora n’ubutegetsi bwa gikoloni bwariho icyo gihe. Kuva mu 1946, cyane cyane nyuma ya 1950, yatangiye gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda ziganisha ku iterambere ry'ubuhinzi n’ubworozi bwa kijyambere.
Mu rwego rwo kugabanya ubukana bw’ikibazo cy’ubutaka cyaterwaga n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, Umwami yashishikarije abaturage korora inka nkeya zitanga umukamo mwinshi, aho kuba nyinshi zidatanga umusaruro.
Inyambo n’inzuri z’Umwami mu Mutara.
Mu mwaka wa 1949, Umwami Rudahigwa yategetse ko inyambo zivanwa mu nzuri zitandukanye maze zikimurirwa mu gice cy’Umutara, kuko ari ho hari hasigaye inzuri nini. Izo nyambo zaturutse mu nzuri nka Inyangamutsindo, Ingaju, Urugaga, Ingirikirwa, Ingeri, n’izindi. Mu Mutara, zaragirwaga ahitwa Nsheke, Barija, Gasinga, ndetse na Kabare.
Ibyihariye by’ikiraro cy'i Nsheke.
Mu kiraro cy'i Nsheke, Umwami Rudahigwa yashyizeyo ibikoresho byose byifashishwa mu bworozi bwa kijyambere, harimo:
Abashumba bazwi bari barimo: Kabagema, Bigaba, na Ruhanamirindi. Amata y’inka z’umwami, kimwe n’ayo abandi borozi bajyaga kugurisha, yakusanyirizwaga ku ikaragiro rya Nyagatare rizwi nko Ku Ilitiro, aho yatunganywaga agacuruzwa ari inshyushyu, ikivuguto, cyangwa amavuta.
Umushinga w’imiturire n’ubworozi bwa kijyambere.
Rudahigwa yatangije imishinga igamije gutuza abaturage neza no kubafasha korora neza. Muri iyo gahunda:
Umwami ubwe yubatse ibiraro bye bwite:

Ibigabiro bya Rwabugiri ni ahantu ndangamateka hahoze urugo rw’Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri, kuri ubu ni mu Mudugudu wa Bigabiro, Akagari ka Cyanya, Umurenge wa Kigabiro, mu Karere ka Rwamagana, Intara y’Uburasirazuba. Ibyo bigabiro biri ahazwi n’ubu nko mu Bigabiro.
Inkomoko y’izina “Ibigabiro”.
Mu muco nyarwanda, aho umwami yabaga atuye (urugo rw’umwami) hakundaga guterwa ibiti nk’imivumu n’ibihondohondo, bikaba ikimenyetso cy’uko hahoze urugo rw'umwami. Iyo umwami yatabarizwaga ahantu, aho hantu hitwaga umusezero, naho hagaterwa ibiti byitwaga ibigabiro. Icyo gikorwa cyari igice cy’umuco wo guha icyubahiro aho hantu no kukibungabunga.
Urugo rwa Rwabugiri i Rwamagana.
Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri yagize urugo mu Buganza, mu gace ka Rwamagana, ahahoze ari mu Gisaka mbere y’uko hashyirwa ku Rwanda mu kinyejana cya 18. Aho urugo rwe rwari rwubatse niho haturuka izina mu Bigabiro.
Urugo rwa Rwabugiri rwari rufite ibigabiro byinshi kandi binini, ariko byaje gutemwa nyuma y’Intambara ya Mbere y’Isi Yose, ubwo abapadiri bubakaga Misiyoni ya Rwamagana. Icyo gihe, Rwabutogo rwa Kabare ka Rwakagara, wari umutware wategekaga u Buganza bw’epfo, ni we wafashije abapadiri kubona imbaho,aho yasabye uburenganzira Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa ngo atemeshe ibigabiro bya Rwabugiri.

Amateka ya pariki ya kakum.
Mu 1931, agace kavomwe n’amazi y’amazi y'umugenzi wa kakum yatangajwe ko ari amashyamba kandi acungwa n’ishami ry’amashyamba. Muri gihe, ibikorwa byo gutema ibiti byari byiganje, cyane cyane mu bwoko bw’ibiti bya mahogany. Ibikorwa byo gutema ibiti byakomeje kugeza mu 1989 igihe ubuyobozi bw’ikigega bwimurirwa mu ishami ry’ibinyabuzima.
Inyigo ishoboka na gahunda ibanza yimyaka 5 yo gucunga iterambere rya parike yigihugu ya Kakum nkahantu nyaburanga hashyizweho mu mwaka mu 1990 hashyizweho umushinga wakozwe na gahunda y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe iterambere (Dudley 1990). Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bwarimo isuzuma ry’ibinyabuzima bitandukanye by’ibimera n’ibinyabuzima byo mu ishyamba rya Kakum hamwe n’ishyamba rya Assin-Attandanso, hamwe n’ubushakashatsi bw’abaturage ndetse n'inzovu (Dudley 1990; Dudley, Mensah-Ntiamoah, &amp; Kpelle 1992; Dudley 1995). Gahunda yo Kwiga no Kubanziriza Imyaka 5 Yateguwe yateguwe muburyo bwo gufatanya no gutanga inama zirimo umujyanama w’ibinyabuzima, abashinzwe amashyamba, abashinzwe inyamanswa, abaturage baho, kaminuza zo muri Gana, abayobozi ba leta mu karere, n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa bakomeye (Dudley 1992).

Ubusitani bwa Aburi Botanical nubusitani muri Abari mukarere k'iburasirazuba bwa Gana.
Uyu munsi, mu kinyejana cya 21, umuntu ntashobora kuvuga ibijyanye n'ubuhinzi bw'imboga muri Gana no muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba atavuze ku busitani bwa Aburi Botanical. Ubusitani bufite ubuso bwa hegitari 64.8. Yafunguwe muri kandi yashinzwe na guverineri William Brandford Griffith na Dr. John Farrell Easmon, umuganga w'ubuvuzi wa siyera Lewone Mbere yuko ubusitani bushingwa, niho hari sanatori yubatswe mu 1875 ku bayobozi ba leta ya Gold Coast. Ku butegetsi bwa William Branford Griffith, umumisiyoneri wa basel na Moroviya wo muri Jamayika, Alexandre Worth clerk bagenzuye isaranganya ry’ubutaka bukikije sanatori kugira ngo batangire ishami ry’ibimera. Mu 1890, William Crowther, umunyeshuri wo muri Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, yagizwe umuyobozi wa mbere w’ubusitani. Ubusitani bwagize uruhare runini mu gushishikariza umusaruro wa kakao muri Gana yepfo, utanga ingemwe za kakao zihenze namakuru ajyanye guhinga siyanse. "Hevea brasiliensis" imaze koherezwa i Aburi kuva Kew mu 1893, ubusitani nabwo bwashishikarizaga umusaruro wa rubber muri Gana.
Ubwoko bw'ibiti buboneka mu Busikani bwa Botanical.
umuntu ashobora gusangamo ubwoko bw'inshi bw'ibitu nka pamba y'ubudodo (ceiba pentandra) mahogany Imyerezi, igiti cya silver, n'ibindi byinshi, urebye uko imitetere y'imisozi ifite amoko atandukanye y'ibiti byo muturere dushyuha hamwe n'ubusitani bw'ibimera mumujyi,cyane cyane ubusitani buzwi ku izina Aburi Botanical Gardens, wabaye indiri yaba mukerarugendo 'abanyamahanga ndetse n'abenegihugu

Kumasi n'umurwa mukuru w'Inteko ya kumasi Metropolitan n'akarere ka Ashanti muri Gana.: 1, 3 Numujyi wa kabiri munini mu gihugu,  ifite abaturage 443.981 guhera mu ibarura rya 2021. umusozi wa Kumasi uherereye mu karere k’ishyamba ryimvura hafi yikiyaga cya Bosomtwe: 2 kandi iherereye nko mu kuva i Accra. Umujyi uhura N'ikirere gishyuha cya savanna, hamwe n'ibihe bibiri by'imvura bigenda bitandukana bito. Amoko menshi atuye Kumasi ni Asante Mole dagbon na Ewe.
Kumasi ni ihuriro ry’ubucuruzi, ubukungu, n’ubucuruzi muri Gana, rikaba rifite isoko rinini muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba: Isoko rya Kejetia. Umujyi niwo muco w’umuco wa Asante, bityo nanone bakitwa "Osei-Krom" cyangwa "Oseikrom" gusa, hamwe no gukurura abashyitsi benshi.: 9 Uyu mujyi kandi urimo amashyirahamwe menshi yubucuruzi, nk’ishyirahamwe ry’abatunganya ibicuruzwa bya Aboabo Talia. Kimwe cya kabiri cyo gutunganya ibiti mu gihugu kibera mu mujyi. Ikigo cy’umuco w’igihugu, Ishuri ry’Uburezi rya Wesley, n’ibitaro byigisha Komfo Anokye byose biherereye mu mujyi.  10 Umujyi kandi urimo uruganda rwamafirime rugenda rwiyongera, Kumawood, rwibanda cyane cyane ku kuvuga inkuru zishingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko mu rurimi rwaho rwa Twi.
Umusozi wa Kumasi ni ihuriro ry'umuco wa Asante, uyifasha kwitwa "Osei-Krom" cyangwa gusa "Oseikrom". Kumasi azwiho kandi Imyenda gakondo,Kente, mubisanzwe bikozwe hakoreshejwe imigenzo gakondo. Niho hari isoko rinini muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba,Isoko rya kejetia, rikaba rifite amaduka arenga 10,000. imico n’umuco muri uyu mujyi harimo Fort Kumasi (yubatswe mu 1896 kugirango isimbure igihome cya Asante ubu ni inzu ndangamurage) hamwe n’inzu Ndangamurage ya nurom. Ibyiza bya Royal Asante birimo Ikigo cy'umuco w'igihugu,Okomfo Anokye sword, Ingoro ya Asantehene (yubatswe mu 1972), n’ingoro ya Manhyia, guhera mu 1925, ubu ni inzu ndangamurage.

Drakensberg n'igice cy'iburasirazuba bwa Escarpment nini, ikikije ikibaya cyo muri Afrika yepfo. Escarpment nini igera ku butumburuke bukomeye - mu karere gahana imbibi na Afurika yepfo na Lesotho.
Ibirindiro bya Drakensberg bifite uburebure bwa kilometelo 1000(600 miles) uvuye mu ntara ya cape y'iburasirazuba mu majyepfo, hanyuma bigenda bikurikirana, uhereye mu majyepfo ugana mu majyaruguru, umupaka uhuza Lesotho na Cape y'iburasirazuba n'umupaka uhuza Lesotho n'Intara ya KwaZulu-Natal. Nyuma yaho ikora umupaka uhuza KwaZulu-Natal na Leta yigenga, hanyuma ukurikira nk'umupaka uhuza KwaZulu-Natal n'intara ya Mpumalanga. Umuyaga uherekeza mu majyaruguru uva aho, unyuze kuri Mpumalanga, aho urimo ibintu nka Blyde River Canyon, Rondavels eshatu, na Window y'Imana. Ihita igera mu majyaruguru kugera kuri Hoedspruit mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Limpopo aho izwi ku izina rya 'Klein Drakensberg na Afrikaner. Kuva kuri Hoedspruit igera mu burengerazuba kugera Tzaneen, no mu Ntara ya Limpopo, aho izwi ku izina ry'umusozi wa wolkberg n'umusozi wa Iron Crown. Kuri hejuru y'inyanja, Wolkberg nuburebure buri hejuru ya Limpopo. Escarpment yongeye kwerekera iburengerazuba kandi kuri Mokopane izwi ku izina rya Strydpoort.
Izina ry'Abanyafurika ryitwa "Drakensberge" rikomoka ku izina abimukira ba mbere b'abadage bahaye abamuherekeje, ari bo "Drakensbergen", cyangwa "imisozi ya Dragons". Igice kinini cya Escarpment nini kizwi muri Zulu nka "uKhahlamba" na "Maloti" muri Sotho.
Ubumenyi bwa geologiya.
Igice kinini cya Escarpment kigizwe nurukuta ruhanamye rwubatswe hafi y'ubutaka bw'umugabane mugihe cyo gutandukana kw'amajyepfo ya Gondwana kuva aho yangirika imbere mu gihugu kuva aho yari iherereye hafi y'inyanja ya Afrika yepfo, kandi igice cyayo cyose cy'iburasirazuba (reba ikarita iherekeje) bigize Drakensberg. Drakensberg irangirira mu majyaruguru hafi ya Tzaneen nka 22 °S parallel. Kubura Escarpment Nkuru hafi mu majyaruguru ya Tzaneen (kongera kugaragara ku mupaka uhuza Zimbabwe na Mozambike mu misozi ya Chimanimani biterwa n’ishami ry’iburengerazuba ryananiranye ry’imvururu zikomeye zatumye Antaragitika itangira kugenda yerekeza muri Afurika yepfo mu gihe cyo gutandukana kwa Gondwana 150miliyoni ishize. Umugezi wa Limpopo wo hepfo hamwe n'umugezi wa Save utemba mu nyanja y'ubuhinde unyuze mu bisigisigi by’iki kibaya cyimuwe, ubu kikaba kigizwe na Afurika yepfo Lowveld.
Mu myaka 20 ishize miliyoni, Afrika yepfo yahuye nizamuka ryinshi, cyane mu burasirazuba, bivamo ko igice kinini cyibibaya kiri hejuru. Ikibaya kigoramye ku buryo kiri hejuru cyane mu burasirazuba kandi kikamanuka gahoro ugana iburengerazuba n'amajyepfo. Mubisanzwe, ubutumburuke bw'uruhande rwiburasirazuba bwarenze. Igera ahantu hirengeye harenga aho escarpment igizwe n'umupaka mpuzamahanga uhuza Lesotho nintara ya Afrika yepfo ya KwaZulu-Natal.
KwaZulu-Natal - Leta yubuntu Drakensberg igizwe nubutare bworoshye bityo rero ikaba ifite uruziga ruzengurutse, rworoshye kuva hepfo. Mubisanzwe, hejuru ya escarpment ni hafi kumeza-hejuru kandi yoroshye, ndetse no muri Lesotho. "Imisozi ya Lesotho" ikozwe kure y’inyanja ya Drakensberg n’imigezi y’isuri ihinduka ikibaya kinini kirimo imigezi y’uruzi rwa Orange. Umubare munini winzuzi utanga imisozi ya Lesotho imisozi igaragara cyane k'umusozi, haba k'ubutaka ndetse no mu kirere.
Ibice byo hejuru bya Drakensberg bifite ibidukikije byoroheje. Birashoboka ko imihindagurikire y’ikirere iherutse kugabanya ubukana bwa periglaciation.
Knight na Grab bashushanyije ikwirakwizwa ry’umurabyo i Drakensburg maze bavumbura ko inkuba igenzura cyane ihindagurika ry’imisozi kuko ifasha mu turere tw’imisozi - ahantu hirengeye - hamwe n’ingaruka zo guturika. Mbere, imyanda yo mu nguni yafatwaga nk'iyakozwe n'impinduka zisanzwe zikonje, ibidukikije, nko kuvunika kubera ubukonje.
Imiterere ya geologiya ya Drakensberg (urukuta rwa escarpment) iratandukanye cyane kurenza 1000km. Limpopo na Mpumalanga Drakensberg bafashwe n’igice cya quartzite irwanya isuri igizwe na Transvaal Supergroup, nayo ikora Magaliesberg mu majyaruguru ashyira uburengerazuba bwa Pretoriya. Aya mabuye arenga 2000 imyaka miliyoni. Amajyepfo ya 26 ° S ibangikanye na esrakment ya Drakensberg igizwe na shale ya Ecca iri muri Karoo Supergroup, kandi imaze imyaka miriyoni 300.
Amatsinda ya Ecca na Beaufort agizwe nubutare bwimitsi butarwanya isuri kurusha andi mabuye agize escarpment ya Drakensberg. Kubwibyo, iki gice cya escarpment ntabwo gishimishije cyane nka Mpumalanga na Lesotho irambuye ya Drakensberg. Drakensberg igizwe n’umupaka w’amajyaruguru y’iburasirazuba n’iburasirazuba bwa Lesotho, kimwe na Cape Drakensberg y’iburasirazuba, igizwe n’urwego runini rwa basalt (lava) rwadutse mu myaka miriyoni 180 ishize. Urwo rupapuro rushingiye ku muto mu butayu bwa Karoo Supergroup, ibuye ryumusenyi rya Clarens, ryashyizwe mu butayu, hashize imyaka miliyoni 200

Cederberg n'imisozi itangaje cyane, imisozi igera kuri kilometero 200 (200km) mu majyaruguru ya Cape town.
Imisozi ya Cederberg igera kuri 50km amajyaruguru - amajyepfo na 20km iburasirazuba - iburengerazuba. Bahana imbibi n'iburengerazuba na Sandveld, amajyaruguru n'imisozi ya Pakhuis, iburasirazuba n'amasoko ya Springbok n'amajyepfo n'imisozi ya Kouebokkeveld na Skurweberge. Umuhanda munini winjira,N7, ugana iburengerazuba bwurwego. Imijyi yegeranye ni Citrusdal mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba na Clanwilliam mu majyaruguru. Agace gatuwe cyane.
Hariho imisozi myinshi izwi muriyo harimo Sneeuberg (2026m) na Tafelberg (1969m). Tafelberg (Afrikaans ya "Umusozi wameza") ntigomba kwitiranywa n'umusozi w'ameza muri Cape Town. Ahantu nyaburanga hagaragara harimo umusaraba wa Maltese, Wolfberg Arch na Wolfberg Cracks.
Ikiranga ako gace gisobanuwe neza n'amabuye y'umucanga, akenshi ritukura mu mabara. Iri tsinda ryibitare ririmo imirongo ya shale kandi mu myaka yashize havumbuwe ibintu bike by,ingenzi byavumbuwe muri ibyo byiciro. Ibisigazwa by’ibinyabuzima ni amafi ya mbere kandi byatangiye kuva miliyoni 450 kuva mugihe cya Ordovic.
Ibimera n'ibinyabuzima.
Ibimera byiganjemo ni Mediterranean fynbos mu bishanga byo mu majyepfo no mu burengerazuba, bigahinduka igice cy’ubutayu mu majyaruguru no mu burasirazuba.imyerezi ya Clanwilliam iri mu kaga("Widdringtonia wallichii") yo mu muryango Cupressaceae hamwe na protea ya shelegi("Protea cryophila") ya Proteaceae yanduye muri kariya gace, iboneka gusa mu turere twa kure cyane hejuru y’imisozi.
Inyamanswa zo muri ako gace ni feids ingwe ("Panthera pardus") na caracal("Caracal caracal"). Izindi nyamabere zirimo hyrax ("Procavia capensis") cyangwa "dassie", meerkats ("Suricata suricatta") n'izindi mongoose(Herpestidae), antelopes nini"(urugero":bontebok Damaliscus "pygargus dorcas" na gemsbok "Oryx" "gazella") Hariho kandi inyoni nyinshi, inyamaswa z’inyamabere nto, ibikururuka hasi n'udukoko.
Andi moko yugarijwe aboneka mu gace k'ubutayu bwa Cederberg harimo cyprinide Clanwilliam y'umuhondo ("Labeobarbus capensis", abatishoboye), Clanwiliam redfin("Barbus calidus",abatishoboye) na sawfin ("Barbus serra", iri mu kaga).
Mu buvumo no hejuru y’akarere kose, ibihangano bya San rock birashobora kuboneka, gihamya y'abantu ba mbere b'abantu. Gutura mu Burayi byazanye amashyamba n’ubuhinzi bumwe na bumwe, bituma hasenywa cyane ibiti by'amasederi byaho, ibihumbi n'ibihumbi bitemwa ku nkingi za telefone, ibikoresho byo mu nzu ndetse n'amazu. Kugera kwi Burayi kwanatumye abaturage ba San bakurwaho. Mu majyaruguru,sitasiyo ya kera ya Moraviya ya Wupperthal iracyahari, umutima w’umuryango muto uhinga, kandi ubamo inganda zaho zitanga "veldskoene", inkweto gakondo zoroshye.
Birashoboka ko Cederberg yari ikibuga cy'amajyepfo cy'intambara ya kabiri ya Boer. Itsinda rito ry'inyeshyamba za Boer ryinjiye muri kariya gace kuva muri repubulika ya Boer, mu bilometero amagana ugana mu majyaruguru, bizeye ko bazatera inkunga abaturage benshi mu bahinzi baho bakomoka mu Buholandi. Muri ibyo barananiwe; abahinzi bashobora kuba badafite impuhwe nke zo kubongereza ariko bari bafite imyumvire iboneye n'inde uzatsinda intambara. Bavuga ko abakomando ba Boer bahuye na Cederberg n'umwongereza wenyine, abategeka kwiyegurira. Baramusetse, kuko yari umwe kandi bari benshi kandi bagerageza kumutekerezaho, berekana ibyiringiro by'umwanya we. Yanze gusubira inyuma arangije arashwe. Aho yaguye ubu yitwa "Engelsmanskloof" ("Ikibaya cy'umwongereza").
Ubutaka bwo guhinga bugarukira ku butumburuke, ikirere cyumutse, hamwe n'ubutaka bw'amabuye, kandi imirima mike irahari. Icyayi cya Rooibos nicyo gihugu kizwi cyane cyoherezwa mu mahanga, nubwo imbuto n'itabi nabyo bisarurwa mu mirima imwe n'imwe. Agace ka Cederberg karimo divayi imwe, hejuru muri Afrika yepfo. Hafi yakarere ka Wupperthal hari imirima myinshi itunzwe. Ibihingwa bimwe na bimwe by'ubucuruzi biguma hafi ya sitasiyo y’amashyamba ya Alijeriya. Proteas n'ibindi bimera bya fynbos nabyo birahingwa. Imirima itari mike yahindutse abashyitsi benshi bigaburira isoko ry'ubukerarugendo bwaho ndetse n’amahanga.
Nka gace k'ubutayu, ibikorwa byibanze ni ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku bidukikije, harimo gukambika,kuzamuka urutare no gutembera. Inkambi nkuru, Alijeriya, ikorwa na CapeNature, mu gihe izindi nka Sanddrif, Driehoek, Jamaka na Kromrivier zikorera ku giti cyabo kandi zigashinga Cedarberg Conservancy, ishyirahamwe ku bushake bwa ba nyir'ubutaka.
Cederberg izwi cyane kubera ubwiza bw'inzira zo kuzamuka ku rutare cyane cyane izengurutse impinga ya Krakadouw na Tafelberg. Imeza Umusozi Sandstone ikora ibintu byiza byinzira zidasanzwe. Hariho urugendo rwinshi n'ijoro harimo ibyamamare kandi bitangaje bya Wolfberg Arch, Wolfberg Cracks na Maltese Cross.
Aka gace kandi karimo indorerezi y’inyenyeri yikunda, ikunze kwakira n'imugoroba ifunguye k'ubantu rusange.
Hariho inzira zitandukanye 4x4.
Agace kanini ko mu majyaruguru ya Cederberg gafite Itorero rya Moraviya. Umudugudu wuzuye wa Wuperthal ugizwe n'inzira ya misiyoni itanga abashyitsi uburyo bushimishije bw'ubuzima bwo mu cyaro. Umudugudu kandi n'ikigo kizwi cyane cyakozwe n'intoki zikozwe mu ruhu n'inkweto. Imwe muri "buite stasies" (bisobanurwa mu buryo butaziguye nka sitasiyo yo hanze) ni Heuningvlei, agace gato keza cyane kari mu nzira yo gutunganya inzira y'amagare y'indogobe kuva mu mpinga ya Pakhuis Pass kugera mu mudugudu. Uyu mushinga wo kurwanya ubukene uterwa inkunga n’ishami rishinzwe ibidukikije n’ubukerarugendo, urimo gushiraho amacumbi y’ibikapu, ubusitani bw’ibimera n’andi masoko atandukanye y’ubukerarugendo.

Mu myaka yo hambere mbere yuko abazungu baza mu Rwanda(mu kinyejana cya 19) sosiyete y'U Rwanda yari ishingiye ku muryango wa patriarkiya(ugenderaho ku butware bw'abagabo) aho Abagore bafatwaga nk'abantu bagomba kubahwa ariko batari bafite uburenganzira bwinshi ku bijyanye n'ifata-rwanzuro, Bari bashinzwe cyane imirimo yo mu rugo kurera n'ubuhinzi ariko nta bureganzira bwo kuragwa ku matungo cyangwa gufata ibyemezo bikomeye mu muryango. Abagore bake bonyine nibo bashoboraga kubona agaciro kenshi iyo bari abavuzi,abahanuzi, cyangwa ababyeyi b'abami.
Mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'abadage n'ababiligi (1890s-1959) byarushijeho kudindiza abagore (abakoloni bashyizeho ubuyobozi bushingiye ku bagabo gusa, bityo abagore barirengagizwa mu nzego zose, ishuri ryatangiriye ku bahungu abakobwa n'abagore ntibigeze bahabwa amahirwe yo kwiga, nta burenganzira bwo gutora, gutunga ubutaka cyangwa se kwiyamamaza mu nzego).
Mu gihe cya Repubuika ya mbere niya kabiri(1962-1994) habonetse intambwe ya mbere y'impinduka:
Iterambere nyuma ya 1994, iki nicyo gihe cy'ingenzi mu iterambere ry'abari n'abategarugori ubwo Guverinoma y'U Rwanda(FPR Inkotanyi) yashyizeho gahunda zikomeye:
U Rwanda rufatwa nk'ikitegererezo ku isi kuva mu mwaka wa 2005 kugeza ubu. U Rwanda rufatwa nk'igihugu cya mbere muri Afurika n'isi mu gushyigikira iterambere ry'abagore:
Kera Abagore babaga mu muryango utegekwa n'abagabo badafite ijambo ariko ubu Abari n'Abategarugori bari mu myanya y'ubuyobozi, bashyigikiwe n'amategeko n'imishinga.
Nta burenganzira bwo gutunga, kwiga cyangwa kuyobora ariko ubu iterambere ryabo ryahindutse rishingiye kuri olitiki y'uburinganire, amavugurura y'amategeko n'uruhare rwabo mu kubaka igihugu.

Magaliesberg (amateka azwi kandi ku izina rya "Macalisberg" cyangwa "imisozi ya Cashan") yo mu majyaruguru ya Afurika y'Epfo, ni imisozi yoroheje ariko isobanuwe neza igizwe ahanini na quartzite. Irazamuka igana mu majyepfo ya Pilanesberge (na Parike ya Pilanesberg) kugira ngo igaragaze icyerekezo kigoramye gihuza umujyi wa Pretoriya mbere yuko gisohora abagera kuri 50 km (31mi) iburasirazuba, mu majyepfo ya Bronkhorstspruit. Ahantu hirengeye ha Magaliesberg hagera kuri Nooitgedacht, nko muri metero 1852 (6076ft) hejuru y'inyanja. Inzira nyabagendwa igera hejuru y'umusozi iherereye ku rugomero rwa Hartbeesoort, itanga amashusho meza ya Magaliesberg ndetse n’akarere kayikikije.
Ubumenyi bwa geologiya.
Magaliesberg ifite inkomoko ya kera. Ibiyigize byitirirwa inzira ya geologiya ikurikiranye mu mateka maremare cyane. Quartzite, shale,chert na dolomite byashyizwe mu myanda mu kibaya cyo hagati hejuru y’imyaka miliyari 3 y’imyubakire ya Archaean Basement, izwi ku izina rya Kaapyaal craton. Iyi nzira yo gutembera yamaze imyaka igera kuri miliyoni 300. Hafi yimyaka miliyari 2, kuzamuka kwinshi kwa magma gushonga byavuyemo icyitwa Bushveld Igneous Complex. Uburemere bukabije bw'ubwo bwinjira bwagabanije imyanda yari munsi yacyo kandi ihengamye imyanda ku nkombe ku buryo ibice byavunitse byarebaga hanze no hejuru, kandi byoroheje bikamanuka imbere. Uko ibihe byagiye bisimburana, ubwo bwinjira bwarashize, cyane cyane ahantu hahanamye, bikora ibinure byimbitse cyangwa ibibaya bitanga ubushobozi bwo kuzamuka urutare k'ubantu ba none. Aka ubu kitwa ikibaya cya Transvaal kandi kirimo no hejuru cyane ya Transvaal Drakensberg ireba Lowveld mu burasirazuba bw'igihugu. Isoko ryinshi ryibikoresho byaka - lava y'ibirunga - ya Karoo Supergroup yari muto cyane nyuma yaje gutwikira ikibaya cya Transvaal, ariko nyuma yaje kwangirika ku buryo iguma gusa ku nkombe y’ikibaya cya Transvaal.
Izina rya mbere rizwi ku misozi ya Magaliesberg ni Dithaba Diloka. Iri ni izina rya se Tswana ryaho ryerekeranye n'ubwinshi bwa Heteropogon contortus ikurira muri kariya gace. Icyakora birasa nkiri zina ryaba ryarakoreshejwe gusa n'abaturanyi ba Sotho-Tswana abaturage baza kumusozi wa Magaliesberg. Abaturage baho bo mu bwoko bwa Tswana bavuze ko ari Dithaba "Imisozi".
Abashakashatsi ba mbere b'abanyaburayi baje muri ako gace banditse imisozi yitwa "Cashan" cyangwa "Kashan". Iyi yari ruswa yizina ryumukuru ukomeye wa BaKwena ba Mmatau witwaga Kgwasane wa Sekano "(Kgwasane, mwene Sekano)".
Hagati ya 1800s rwagati imisozi yamenyekanye nka Magaliesberg nyuma ya Kgosi Mogale. Mogale isobanura "umuntu utyaye" cyangwa "intwari", ariko kandi ni ijambo risanzwe rivuga umurwanyi cyangwa umusirikare wa Tswana, muri Sotho bogale risobanura "ityaye" naho mogale "intwari". Mu buryo nk'ubwo, imisozi iri mu majyaruguru, hafi y'Umujyi wa Sun, Pilanesberg, yitiriwe abatware ba Bakgatla baho, bitwaga Pilane.
Ku ya 17Mutarama1837, nyuma yuko bamwe mu ba voortrekkers bagabweho igitero bakicwa n'impis ya Mzilikazi, barwanyije kandi bayobowe na Hendrik Potgieter na Gerrit Maritz, kandi babifashijwemo n’abayobozi bakuru ba Sotho- Tswana, batwara Matabeles mu majyaruguru bambuka uruzi rwa Limpopo. Kubera ko kongera kwigarurira ako karere byari umushinga wa koperative ya Boers na Sotho-Tswana kurwanya Matabele, Boers na Sotho-Tswana bari bafitanye umubano wa gicuti mu ntangiriro yo gutura abazungu. Iyi mibanire ya gicuti igaragarira mu izina ry’umujyi mukuru wa Boer, Rustenburg, kubera ko babonaga ko batagomba kongera kugira indi mirwano irwanya imiryango nyafurika. Boers yabanje gutura mu majyepfo ya Magaliesberg muri Highveld, hasigara Bushveld mu majyaruguru ya Magaliesberg ahanini ku nshuti zabo na Sotho-Tswana n'inshuti zabo; nk'uko byanditswe na Sarah Heckford, "Umudamu Umucuruzi muri Transvaal", Boers bari kwimukira i Bushveld gusura abaturanyi babo ba Sotho-Tswana mu gihe cy'itumba. Dukurikije ubuhamya bwo mu magambo bwatanzwe n'abayobozi ba Tswana bwanditswe ahagana mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, Boers benshi ku giti cyabo bagiranye ubucuti bwa hafi n'abayobozi bakomeye ba Tswana n'abayobozi bakuru, cyane cyane bagamije gushinga amashyaka yo guhiga kugira ngo bakusanyirize amahembe y'inzovu n'ibindi bicuruzwa baturutse mu majyaruguru. Nyuma yaho, Boers batangiye gutura mu mibande ya Range ya Magaliesberg no mu Bushveld mu majyaruguru ya Magaliesberg, maze bahindura ako karere mu turere tumwe na tumwe tw’imirima itanga umusaruro muri Afurika y'Epfo, mu gihe bimuye abahoze ari inshuti zabo, babashyira ahantu hamwe no mu bubiko.
Muri ako gace habaye imirwano ikomeye mu gihe cy'intambara ya kabiri ya Anglo-Boer, kubera ko yari imenyereye cyane imisozi, yakoresheje inzira y'ibanga yambukiranya imisozi kugira ngo igabe ibitero ku basirikare b'abongereza. Mu gusubiza, ingabo z’Abongereza zubatse amazu hejuru y’imisozi hagamijwe kugabanya ingendo za Boer; amatongo yizi nyubako aracyagaragara k'umusozi.
Igenzura ry’imisozi ya Magaliesberg ryagize akamaro kanini ku ngabo za Boer n’Ubwongereza, cyane cyane inzira ebyiri zahuzaga Pretoria na Rustenburg, zambukaga ahitwa Silkaatsnek na Kommandonek. Kubera iyo mpamvu, muri ako karere habaye intambara nyinshi, nk'intambara za Buffelspoort, Nooitgedacht na Olifantsnek.
Nyuma y'intambara, imirima yo muri ako gace yarongeye guhindurwa neza maze ubuhinzi burakomeza,itabi na citrusi bigenda neza.
Mu 1923, urugomero rwa Hartbeespoort, ruherereye muri kimwe mu bibaya by'urwo rwego, rwuzuye. Yabaye ibiruhuko bizwi cyane no muri wikendi kubatuye Johannesburg na Pretoriya, kandi imidugudu ya Hartbeespoort na Kosmos yateye imbere kubwibyo.
Kugeza ubu, agace ka Magaliesberg karacyafite ubuhinzi, nubwo ubukerarugendo ari inganda zikura vuba muri ako karere.
Umusozi wa Kgaswane ni nyaburanga hejuru ya Rustenburg ifite 4,257ha (hegitari 10,520) za Magaliesberg.
Ibigega byinshi bito, byigenga na leta, bigomba kuboneka mu burebure bw'urwego.
Ikigega cya Magaliesberg.
Nyuma y'imyaka hafi icumi yo guharanira no gushyira ingufu hamwe na komite nto y’abashinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije, Magaliesberg yatangajwe ko ari urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima ku isi.
Ibi byatangajwe ku ya 9 Kamena 2015 I Paris n'Inama Mpuzamahanga mpuzabikorwa ya Porogaramu ku Muntu n'ibinyabuzima (MAB). Iyi ni gahunda ya UNESCO igamije kubaka umubano ushyigikiwe kandi urambye hagati y'abantu n’ibidukikije. Mu byukuri, ibi bivuze kwibanda cyane kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima binyuze muburyo bushya bwo guteza imbere ubukungu.
Ihuriro ry'isi yose y'ibinyabuzima, Magaliesberg yinjiye ubu, riharura ibinyabuzima 631 mu bihugu 119.
Umuyobozi w'ishami rishinzwe gutangiza urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rwa Magaliesberg (MBIG), Paul Fatti, yagize ati: "Twishimiye ko dushimira byimazeyo imiterere yihariye ya Magaliesberg n'umusanzu ukomeye itanga mu gihugu cyacu, muri serivisi z'ibidukikije muri Gauteng no mu Burenganzira bw'Amajyaruguru ndetse n'abaturage barera ahantu hanini."
Vincent Carruthers, wahoze ayobora MBIG akaba n'umwanditsi uzwi cyane wa "The Magaliesberg", ubushakashatsi bwemewe cyane ku misozi, yavuze ko iri tangazo ari indunduro y’ubukangurambaga bwatangiye mu 2006. Ati: "Nishimiye ko ubu hamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga iyi misozi minini yiboneye ubuzima bwose, uhereye ku nkomoko yayo". "Magaliesberg iruta inshuro 100 umusozi wa Everest ndetse n'igice cy'isi, ni ubutunzi budasanzwe kuri twe muri kariya gace ka Afurika."

Parike ya Mole, imwe muri parike nini mu gihugu cya cya Gana, ni ubuhungiro bw'ibinyabuzima bunini muri iki gihugu. Parike iherereye muri muri Gana kuri Savanna n'ibinyabuzima byo kunkombe ku butumburuke hamwe na escarpment. Parike ni 24km uvuye i Damongo, umurwa mukuru w'akarere, 146 km mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba bwa Tamale, umurwa mukuru w'akarere. Parike ni 700km uvuye i Accra na 430km Kumasi. Ubwinjiriro bwa parike bugera mu mujyi wa Larabanga. Inzuzi za Levi na Mole zinyura muri parike, hasigara ibyobo byokunywa gusa mugihe cyizuba kirekire. ka Gana kakira abarenga 10 mm ku mwaka y'imvura. Ubushakashatsi bumaze igihe kirekire bwakorewe kuri parike ya Mole kugirango bumve ingaruka abahiga abantu ku nyamaswa zibungabunga.
Pariki ya Mole ni pariki y'ubukerarugendo bwateye imbere muri Gana mu bijyanye n'ubukerarugendo. ifite amacumbi ya mbere muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba yubatswe hagati mu ishyamba rya Mole. Zaina premier ecolodge yigihugu itanga serivise zo kwakira abashyitsi ku isi no gukoraho bidasanzwe.
Ubutaka bwa parike bwashyizwe ku ruhande nkubuhungiro bw’inyamanswa mu 1958. Mu 1971, abaturage bake bo muri ako gace barimuwe maze amasambu agenerwa parike y’igihugu. Parike ntabwo yabonye iterambere rikomeye nkahantu nyaburanga kuva yagenwe mbere. Parike y'igihugu ya Mole nk'akarere karinzwe nta nkunga ihagije kandi impungenge z’igihugu ndetse n’amahanga zirahari ku bijyanye no guhiga no kuramba muri parike, ariko kurinda amoko y’ibinyabuzima bya antelope byateye imbere kuva iyi pariki yatangira gushingwa.
Kuva aho abantu bimukiye muri ako gace, parike yabaye ahantu h’ubushakashatsi bw’abahanga. Ibi byemereye ubushakashatsi bwigihe kirekire, byumwihariko, ahantu hasa nkaho hatabangamiwe ugereranije n’ibice bisa na Afurika y’iburengerazuba ituwe cyane. Ubushakashatsi bumwe ku baturage batuye inzovu 800, urugero, bwerekana ko kwangiza inzovu ku biti binini bitandukana nubwoko. Muri Mole, inzovu zifite imyumvire myinshi yo gukomeretsa bikabije amoko y’ubukungu nka Burkea africana
Vuba aha, ubuki bukozwe mu ndabyo mu pariki y’igihugu ya Molé bwabaye ibicuruzwa bya mbere mu bucuruzi. Hafi aho, abaturage basarura ubuki bakoresheje uburyo gakondo, budatera, kandi bafatanya n’isosiyete ikorera muri Utah kugurisha ubuki nk’inyongera y’ubuzima bwiza muri Amerika. Iyi gahunda yashinzwe n’umuyobozi wa Ashanti, Nana Kwasi Agyemang, wizera ko azongera gukongeza inyungu z’ubuki kandi amaherezo akazohereza mu bindi bihugu byo muri Afurika.

Isumo rya Wli ni isumo riherereye muri Gana kandi rirerire muri Afurika y'uburengerazuba..
Isumo rya Wli rifite ubuso bwa 20km uvuye Hohoe mu karere ka Volta muri Gana.
Inyamaswa zo mu gasozi.
Gutembera mu ishyamba ry’inyamanswa ya Agumatsa bitanga amahirwe yo kubona ibidukikije harimo unyamashwa ndetse n'ibindi binyabuzima harimo koloni nini y’ibibabi by'imbuto, ikinyugunyugu, inyoni, inkende n’abana. Ikoroni nini y'ibibabi irashobora kugaragara yiziritse ku bitare kandi iguruka mu kirere.
Isumo rya Wli n’amazi maremare muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba aherereye muri Gana Isumo rizwi ku izina rya Agoomatsa - bisobanura ngo " "Munyemerere." " Iherereye muri komine ya Hohoe yo mu karere ka Volta, igihugu cy’umuco wa Ewe. Nibirometero 280 uvuye mumurwa mukuru Accra. Byabonetse nitsinda ryabahigi bakeka ko amajwi yaguye ari ingoma ivuga kandi yiruka yerekeza ku rusaku basanga ari isumo.

Ada Foah ni umujyi uri ku nkombe y’amajyepfo y’iburasirazuba bwa Gana, aho uruzi rwa Volta ruhurira n'inyanja ya Atalantika. Umujyi uherereye hafi yumugezi wa Volta, hafi yumuhanda wa Accra - Aflao. Azwiho kuba ku nkombe z'ibirwa, Ada Foah ni n'umurwa mukuru w'akarere ka Ada y'Iburasirazuba (ahahoze hitwa Dangme y'Iburasirazuba) n'icyicaro cy'Inteko y'Akarere.
Ubukoloni bw’Abaholandi muri Ada mu kinyejana cya 16 bwabonye iterambere ry’ubucuruzi mu 1775. Izina "Foah" ryakomotse ku ijambo Fort, nko mu 1783, Fork Kongenstein yubatswe n’Abaholandi kandi ikoreshwa mu bucuruzi bw'abacakara ba Transatlantike n’ubucuruzi bw’abacakara bo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara. Igihome cyaguzwe n'abongereza ku ya 15 Werurwe 1850.
Gusa ibimenyetso bya Fort Kongenstein tubisanga muri Ada,mukarere ka Greater Accra. Icyambu cya Ada giherereye ku nkombe z'umugezi wa Volta. aho abantu babaga bagurishirizazwe bakoherezwa muri Amerika banyuze muri iki gihome nk'abacakara. Igihome cyazimye hafi yinyanja kandi kirasenyuka, buhoro buhoro cyoza inyubako yahoze ari gereza mu nyanja. izamuka ry’amazi rikomeje kubangamira inkombe n’abaturage baho, kubaka urukuta rwo kurinda inyanja birizera ko bizahagarika iri terambere.
Ubutegetsi bw'abakoroni bw'abongereza bwashyizweho mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19. Gucuruza n'Abanyaburayi mu bucuruzi bw'abacakara barengana, Ada yabaye isoko rikomeye ry'ubucuruzi bw'abacakara mu byoherezwa mu mahanga. Ubucuruzi bwabacakara bumaze kuvaho, Dangmes yacuruzaga ibicuruzwa byamashyamba yo muri Afrika yo mu turere dushyuha (cyane cyane amavuta yintoki, intoki za palm na rubber). ["citation ikenewe"]
Ubukerarugendo bw'Ada Foah.
Ada Foah ni ikigo cy’ubukerarugendo mu Karere ka Ada iburasirazuba hamwe n’inyanja zacyo,Inkombe n’ibikurura mukerarugendo na serivisi. Numugezi n'inyanja, Ada Foah azwiho siporo yo mazi nko koga, ubwato, kuroba hamwe n'ubwato. Inkombe z'umugezi ahanini zifunzwe na chalets z'ibiruhuko kuko abantu benshi baturutse i Accra bakoresha aho hantu nka weekend. Hariho icyambu n'ubwato ku nkombe z'umugezi aho amato ashobora gukodeshwa kugira ngo akore ingendo azenguruka ibirwa byo mu ruzi. Club ya Sailing Club, iherereye ku mugezi wa Volta, yugururiwe abanyamuryango gusa.
Ubushyuhe bwo mu turere dushyuha buri kwezi bivuze ubushyuhe buri hejuru ya 18° C (64° F) muri buri kwezi kwumwaka kandi mubisanzwe byitwa igihe cyizuba, ukwezi kwumutse kugusha imvura itageze kuri 60mm (2.36in) y'imvura.Ikirere cya Koppen cyerekana ubwoko bwikirere ni Aw, ikirere gishyuha cya savanna.

Munyaga ni umusozi w’amateka uherereye mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba y’u Rwanda. Uyu musozi uherereye ku nkengero z’aho u Rwanda rwagabaniraga na Gisaka mbere y’uko igihugu cya Gisaka cyigarurirwa n’u Rwanda mu kinyejana cya 19, ku ngoma y’umwami Mutara II Rwogera. Munyaga ni umwe mu misozi ifite amateka akomeye mu bijyanye n’umutekano n’ubusugire bw’u Rwanda, kuko ari ho hatangiriye igitekerezo cyo gugshinga "urugerero rw’ingabo z’igihugu".
Inkomoko y’urugerero rwa Munyaga.
Urugerero ni igikorwa cyakorwaga n'ingabo aho zabaga ziri ku nkiko (imbibi cyangwa imipaka) z’u Rwanda mu rwego rwo kururinda ibikorwa byo kuba rwavogerwa n’ibihugu by'amahanga. Ibyo bikorwa byatangiye ku ngoma y'umwami Cyirima II Rujugira, ubwo u Rwanda rwiteguraga guhura n’ibitero byashoboraga guturuka mu bihugu by’abaturanyi birimo nka Gisaka, Ndorwa, Bugesera, n’u Burundi, aho ibyo bihugu byashakaga kwigarurira u Rwanda.
Rujugira yafashe icyemezo cyo kohereza imitwe y’ingabo ngo ijye ihora ku nkiko z’igihugu aho ibitero cyangwa abaje gutera igihugu bashoboraga kwinjirira, aherako avuga ijambo rikwira hose maze rirushaho kwamamara kugeza magingo aya, aho yavuze ati:"U Rwanda ruratera ntiruterwa."
Abakemba n’itangira ry’urugerero i Munyaga.
Ku ikubitiro, Rujugira yohereje umutwe w’ingabo w’Abakemba, bari bayobowe n’umuhungu we Sharangabo, ngo bajye kurinda umupaka w’u Rwanda na Gisaka. Izo ngabo zashinze ibirindiro mu mpinga y’umusozi wa Munyaga, ahari hateganye na Gisaka. Aho ni ho urugerero rwatangiriye, maze abari bagize uwo mutwe bahatura burundu hamwe n’imiryango yabo.
Nyuma ya Sharangabo, Ndabarasa, na we wari igikomangoma, yakomerejeho kuri urwo rugerero, aho yari kumwe n’Abakemba. Abakomotse kuri abo basirikare b’Abakemba baracyatuye i Munyaga, nubwo uwo mutwe w’ingabo utacyiriho kuko wasenywe n’ubukoloni bw’Ababiligi, kimwe n’indi mitwe y’ingabo y’icyo gihe.
Munyaga mu gihe cya none.
Aho urugerero rwahoze, hitwa mu Nkamba, uhereye ku ngoma ya Rujugira kugeza ubu. Ni mu Mudugudu wa Kigabiro, Akagari ka Kaduha, Umurenge wa Munyaga, mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Mu gace k’itaba ryari ricumbikiye ingabo, kuri ubu habarirwa ubutaka buri hagati ya hegitari 10 na 15, hakaba harimo ibikorwa bitandukanye aribyo:
Umusozi wa Munyaga uherereye ahatuma uwuhagazeho abasha kwitegereza Kabarondo, ndetse n’imisozi itandukanye ikikije agace ka Munyaga, irimo: Nkamba, Ruramira, Bugambira, Ruyonza, na Nyamirama.
Agaciro k’amateka y’i Munyaga.
Umusozi wa Munyaga ni umwe mu hantu harindirwaga ubusugire bw’igihugu mu bihe cy'ingoma y'abami. Ni ishingiro ry’ihuriro ry’amateka y’ubutwari bw’ingabo, umuco wo kurinda igihugu, ndetse no kwibukiraho uko urugerero rwatangiye. Nubwo ubuyobozi bw’abakoloni bwaje gusenya iyo mitwe y’ingabo, urwibutso rw’ibyabaye i Munyaga ruracyariho binyuze mu mateka n’imiryango y’abakemba bacyihatuye.

Ikiyaga cya Chilwa nicyo kiyaga cya kabiri kinini muri Malawi. Ni ikiyaga giherereye mu burasirazuba bw'akarere ka Zomba, hafi y'umupaka na Mozambike. Hafi ya 60km z'uburebure na 40km z'ubugari, ikiyaga kizengurutswe n'ibishanga binini. Hano hari ikirwa hagati yikiyaga cyitwa Chisi Island. Ikiyaga, kandi urwego rw'amazi rwibasiwe cyane n'imvura yibihe hamwe no guhumeka. Mu 1968, ikiyaga cyazimiye mu gihe cyizuba kidasanzwe. Igihe David Livingstone yasuraga ikiyaga mu 1859, yatangaje ko umupaka wacyo w’amajyepfo wageze kuri Massif ya Mulanje, ikaba yari gutuma ikiyaga byibura igihe kirekire kuruta uko bimeze muri iki gihe.
Ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe iterambere muri Danemark, ku bufatanye na Guverinoma ya Malawi cyakoraga mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ikiyaga n’ibishanga byacyo. ikigo kandi kikaba gifite munshingano gahunda yo kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ikirere mu kiyaga cya Chilwa (LCBCCAP) yatangijwe mu rwego rwo kubungabunga agace gakomeye, kikaba atari igishanga gikomeye cy’ibinyabuzima byaho gusa, ahubwo kikaba n’isoko rikuru ry’ibicuruzwa by’amafi muri ako karere.
Inyamaswa zo mu gasozi.
Ubwoko bw'amafi bukunze kugaragara mu kiyaga cya Chilwa ni "Barbus paludinosus", "Oreochromis shiranus chilwae", "Clarias gariepinus", "Brycinus imberi" na "Gnathonemus". Ikiyaga kikaba gikunda kugaragaramo inyoni zo mu mazi zigera kuri zifite amoko agera kuri 160 atandukanye. Bamwe muribo bimukira muri Aziya - East African Flyway kuva muri Siberiya buri mwaka. Hamwe n'ubwoko cumi na bubiri bw'inyoni, umubare urenga 1% y'inyoni zosse ziraguruka. Umubare w'abantu ukikije ni mwinshi kandi uragenda wiyongera, kandi inyoni zo mu mazi zirahigwa ibiryo igihe amazi ari make kandi uburobyi bukaba ikibazo. Harimo gushyirwaho ingufu kugirango guhiga bikorwa muburyo burambye.
Imidugudu igera kuri 335 ituwe n’abaturage barenga 60.000 yishora mu kuroba ikiyaga, kandi ikurura toni zirenga 17.000 buri mwaka, 20% by’amafi yose yafatiwe muri Malawi.

Vwaza Marsh Wildlife Reserve ni ikibuga cy'imikino cyo muri muri Malawi.
Bitandukanye na parike y'igihugu ya Nyika iri mu kibaya cya Nyika, igice kinini cya Vwaza giherereye ku butaka buringaniye nubwo uruhande rw'iburasirazuba rwa parike rufite imisozi. Iherereye mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bw’ibibaya no mu majyaruguru y’imigezi y’uruzi rwa Rukuru y'Amajyepfo kandi ifite ubuso bwa 1.000km 2.
Iyi pariki irangwa n’ishyamba rya Mopane na Miombo hamwe n’ibishanga bikurura inyoni cyane zitari nke ku gasozi.
Ikibanza cy’inyamanswa cya Vwaza Marsh ntigikunze gusurwa na benshi, ahanini bitewe n’imiterere mibi y’imihanda hamwe n’ubutaka bugoye kandi butagerwaho.
Icyo wamenya kuri Pariki ya Vwaza Marsh.
Itandukaniro ry'umubare winyamanswa n'ubwoko bushobora gutandukana mugihe uko bambuka umupaka na parike y'igihugu ya Luangwa y'Amajyaruguru muri Zambiya. Ubusanzwe ikigega gifite amashyo manini y'inyamanswa ninzovu, hamwe nubwoko butandukanye bwa antelope harimo roan, kudu nini, hartebeest ya Lichtenstein, eland na impala. Warthogs iboneka no muri iki kigega kimwe na podiyumu nyinshi ya hippopotamus mu kiyaga cya Kazuni. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu bushakashatsi kamera bwerekanye kandi ko intare zihari, ariko bishoboka ko gito, kimwe n'ingwe n'imbwa zo mu gasozi.
Mose inzovu y'imfubyi ni nzovu ikuze muri iyi pariki ubu iri mu kigo cy'imfubyi cya Jumbo Foundation muri Lilongwe Malawi, yarokowe n'abashinzwe umutekano ku gishanga cya Vwaza mu ruzi rwa Rukuru y'Amajyepfo.
Inyoni zizwi cyane zirimo Goliath herons, ingurube zifunguye hamwe ni nyenyeri zidasanzwe zera. Ikiyaga cya Kazuni giherereye mu gace gashyigikira ubwoko bwayo bwa ba hippo.
Iyi arike ifite ubwoko butandukanye bw’ibimera kandi hari amoko 398 y’ibimera biva mu miryango 71.

Dambo ni icyiciro cy'ibishanga bigoye muri Afurika yo hagati, Amajyepfo n’Uburasirazuba,cyane muri Zambiya, Malawi na Zimbabwe. Mubisanzwe usanga ahantu h'imvura nyinshi igwa ahantu h'imisozi miremire kandi ifite amashami ameze nk'amashami ubwayo ntabwo ari manini cyane ariko ahujwe y'iyongera ahantu hanini. Bivugwa ko Dambos igizwe na 12.5% by'akarere ka Zambiya. Amagambo asa nyafurika arimo imbundo (akunze gukoreshwa muri Afrika yuburasirazuba), "matoro" (Mashonaland),viel (Afrika yepfo), "fadama" (Nijeriya), na "bolis" (Siyera Lewone) Abafaransa "bas-fond" hamwe n’Abadage "Spültal" nabo basabwe kuvuga ku bishanga bisa n’ibyatsi.
Dambos irangwa n'ibyatsi, ibihuru n'ibiti, bitandukanye n'ishyamba rikikije nk'ishyamba rya miombo. Birashobora kuba byumye cyane nyuma y'igihe cy'izuba, bikagaragaza ubutaka bw'umukara cyangwa ibumba ryirabura, ariko bitandukanye n'ubwatsi bwuzuye, bugumana imirongo itose yamazi mugihe cyizuba. Zirengewe n'amazi (zuzuye amazi) mugihe cyizuba (igihe cyizuba) ariko muri rusange ntabwo ziri hejuru yuburebure bwibimera, kandi ubuso bwamazi afunguye ubusanzwe bugarukira k'umugezi no mu bidendezi bito cyangwa lagoons (ibishanga bito) kumwanya muto muri rusange hafi y'ikigo.
Izina dambo rikoreshwa cyane mu bishanga hejuru y'ibibaya bigizwe n'amasoko y'imigezi. Igisobanuro kigamije intego za siyansi cyasabwe nk'ibihe by'amazi, ibyatsi byiganjemo ibyatsi, kwiheba bihana umurongo w'amazi yo mumazi ".
Ikibazo n'igisobanuro kibanziriza iki nuko ijambo rishobora no gukoreshwa mu bishanga bihana imbibi n'inzuzi kure y’amasoko, urugero dambo y'umugezi wa Mbereshi aho yinjira mu bishanga by'uruzi rwa Luapula muri Zambiya,
Raporo yo mu 1998 y’umuryango w'ibiribwa n'ubuhinzi itandukanya dambos 'hydromorphic / phreatic ' (ifitanye isano n’amazi) na dambos ' fluvial ' (ifitanye isano n’inzuzi), ikanavuga ku bwoko butanu bwa geomorphologique mu Ntara ya Luapula ya Zambiya: "imisozi miremire", "ikibaya", "kumanika", "umusenyi" na "dambos".
Dambos igaburirwa n'imvura itemba buhoro kugirango igaburire imigezi bityo rero n'ikintu cy'ingenzi cy'inzira z'amazi. Usibye kuba urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima bigoye, bigira uruhare mu binyabuzima bitandukanye byo mu karere.
Hariho igitekerezo kizwi cyane ko dambos ikora nka sponges kugirango yinjize imvura y'igihe cy'izuba irekura gahoro mu migezi mu gihe cy'izuba bityo bigatuma umwaka wose utemba, ariko ibi birwanya ubushakashatsi bumwe na bumwe bwerekana ko mu gihe cy'izuba hagati cyangwa cya nyuma amazi arekurwa mu mazi. Amasoko aboneka muri dambos zimwe. Rero, birashobora gufata igihe kirekire imyaka itari mike kugirango amazi ava mugihe cy'imvura nyinshi ahindurwe mu misozi hanyuma agaragare muri dambo, agashiraho lagoons cyangwa imigezi mu migezi yo hepfo idashobora gusobanurwa n'imvura y'umwaka ushize. Dambos irashobora kugira uruhare, mugusobanura itandukaniro ritangaje ku rwego rw'amazi cyangwa imigezi mu kiyaga cya Mweru Wantipa nikiyaga cya Chila muri Mbala.
Ubusanzwe, dambos zagiye zikoreshwa:
Vuba aha, zakoreshejwe mu byuzi by'amafi no guhinga umuceri wo mu misozi. Imbaraga zo gutezimbere dambos mu buhinzi zaburijwemo no kubura ubushakashatsi kuri hydrology n'ubutaka bwa dambos, byagaragaye ko bihinduka kandi bigoye.

Umusozi wa Kinyeti n'impinga ndende muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo. Iherereye mu misozi ya Imatong mu Ntara ya Ikotos yo mu Burasirazuba bwa Ekwatoriya, hafi y'umupaka wa Uganda. Kinyeti ifite uburebure bwa metero 3187(10,456ft) hejuru y'inyanja. Itsinda irimo Kinyeti, igera k'umupaka na Uganda, rimwe na rimwe yitwa imisozi ya Lomariti cyangwa Lolobai.
Ibice byo hepfo y'umusozi byari bitwikiriwe n'ishyamba ryiza. Aya ni amashyamba yo mu majyaruguru cyane ya ecoregion ya montane yo muri Afrika y'uburasirazuba. Iyi mpinga ni urutare, rufite ibyatsi bya montane kandi biranyanyagiye, subshrub yo hasi hamwe n’ibimera mu mwobo. Umwe mu Banyaburayi ba mbere basuye umusozi ni umuhanga mu bimera witwa Thomas Ford Chipp, wavumbuye "chippii ya Coreopsis" hafi y’isonga.

Abidjan ni umujyi munini kandi w'ubukungu wahoze ari umurwa mukuru wa Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast. Ibarura rusange ryakozwe mu 2021, ryagaragaje ko Abidjan yari utuwe n'abaturage miliyoni 6.3, bangana na 21.5% by'abatuye igihugu cyose. Abidjan ni umujyi wa gatandatu utuwe cyane muri Afurika: nyuma ya Logos, Cairo, Kinshasa, Dar es Salaam na Johannesburg. Uyu mujyi ni ihuriro ry’imico itandukanye muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba, urangwa n’ uruhuri rw’inganda no kwaguka k'umujyi. Abidjan ni umujyi utuwe cyane n'abakoresha ururimi rw'igifaransa muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba.
Uyu mujyi wagutse cyane nyuma yo kubaka icyambu gishya mu 1931, bikurikirwa no kuba umurwa mukuru w’abakoloni b’Abafaransa mu 1933. Kuzuza umuyoboro wa Vridi mu 1951, byatumye Abidjan iba icyambu gikomeye cyo ku nyanja. Abidjan yakomeje kuba umurwa mukuru wa Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast nyuma yo kwigenga mu 1960, ubwo yari yigobotoye Ubufaransa bwayikoronizaga. Mu 1983, umujyi wa Yamoussoukro wagizwe umurwa mukuru wa politiki wemewe wa Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast. Icyakora, ku mugaragaro, Abidjan yagizwe umurwa mukuru w’ubukungu kubera ko ari wo mujyi munini mu gihugu ndetse ukaba n'izingiro ry’ibikorwa by’ubukungu. Inzego nyinshi za politiki na za Ambasade zose z’ibihugu by'amahanga zakomeje kuba muri Abidjan.
Abidjan yari isanzwe ari umudugudu ukorerwamo ibikorwa by'uburobyi. Mu 1896, nyuma y’uruhererekane rw'ibyorezo bya Yellow Fever, abakoloni b’Abafaransa bari batuye muri Grand-Bassam bahisemo kwimukira ahantu hizewe maze mu 1898 bahitamo kujya gutura mu mudugudu wari uherutse kwitwa Abidjan. Mu 1903 yahindutse umujyi ku mugaragaro. ​​
Abidjan, iherereye ku nkombe ya "lagoon n'doupé", yagukiye ku bundi butaka bunini ndetse haba ahantu hatanga amahirwe menshi yo kwaguriraho ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi. Icyambu cya Petit Bassam giherereye mu majyepfo y’umujyi cyahise kirenga ku cyambu cya Grand-Bassam, maze gihinduka inzira nyamukuru inyuzwamo ibicuruzwa byajyaga mu bakoloni. Mu 1904, iherezo y'inzira ya gari ya moshi yari iherereye mu gace ka Port-Bouët ko muri Abidjan. Guhera muri uwo mwaka, nubwo umujyi wa Bingerville utari warangiye kubakwa neza, Abidjan yabaye ihuriro rigari ry'ubukungu bw'abakoronizaga Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast ndetse iba inzira ya mbere y'ingenzi mu bwikorezi yakoreshwaga mu gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa bikoherezwa mu bihugu byo ku mugabane w’Uburayi, cyane cyane binyuze mu muryango w'abanya Libani, urushaho kugira umumaro mu bucuruzi n'ubukungu. Mu 1934, Abidjan yabaye umujyi wa gatatu wa Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast, nyuma ya Grand-Bassam na Bingerville. Hafashwe icyemezo cyo kuyigira umurwa mukuru bitewe n'muhanda wa gari ya moshi wahuzaga Amajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo ya Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast.
Igihe Cote d'Ivoire/Yvory coast yigenga mu 1960, Umujyi wa Abidjan wabaye izingiro ry'ubuyobozi ndetse n’ubukungu mu gihugu gishya. Igice giherereye mu majyepfo ya Treichville, cyerekeza ku kibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga no ku nkombe z'inyanja, habaye indiri y'Abanyaburayi ndetse n'abafite ubushobozi buciriritse n'ubwisumbuyeho. Nyuma yo kubona ubwigenge kwa Ivory Coast, Umujyi wa Abidjan wateye imbere byihuse ndetse bituma n'umubare w'abaturage bahatuye wiyongera cyane, uva ku baturage 180.000 mu 1960 bagera kuri 1.269.000 mu 1978.
Imirimo yo kubaka Katedarali yitiriwe Mutagatifu Pawulo, yakorewe igishushanyo mbonera n’umwubatsi w’umutaliyani witwaAldo Spirito, yatangiye mu 1980 nyuma y'uko Papa Yohani Pawulo wa II ashyizeho ibuye ry'ifatizo maze mirimo irangira mu 1985. Kuva mu mwaka ya za 1980, ubukungu bwa Abidjan bwatangiye kugabanuka bitewe n’uburangare bw’abayobozi, ruswa ndetse no gusubira inyuma muri rusange. Mu 1983, ku buyobozi bwa Perezida Felix Houphouet-Boigny, umudugudu wa Yamoussoukro wabaye umurwa mukuru mushya wa politiki wa Cote d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast, kuko ariho yari yavukiye. Icyakora, Abidjan yakomeje kuba izingiro ry'ubukungu n'ubucuruzi mu gihugu.

Kirstenbosch n'ubusitani bw'ibimera bwubatswe munsi y'uburasirazuba bw'umusozi wameza muri Cape Town. Ubusitani ni bumwe mu busitani bwa Botanika 10 bukubiyemo ibinyabuzima bitanu muri Afurika y'Epfo bitandatu bitandukanye kandi bikayoborwa n’ikigocy'igihugu cy'ibinyabuzima cya Afurika y'epfo (SANBI). Mbere y'itariki ya 1 Nzeri 2004, ikigo cyari kizwi ku izina rya National Botanical Institute.
Kirstenbosch ishimangira cyane mu guhinga ibihingwa kavukire. Igihe Kirstenbosch yashingwa mu mwaka wi 1913 kugira ngo ibungabunge ibimera bikomoka ku butaka bwa Afurika y'Epfo, nibwo busitani bwa mbere bw’ibimera ku isi bufite uyu mwihariko, mu gihe amoko atera atabonaga ko ari ikibazo cy’ibidukikije n’ibidukikije

Cape Town ni umurwa mukuru muri Afurika yepfo. N'umujyi wa kera cyane w'igihugu kandi niho Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Afrika yepfo. Umujyi wa Cape Town niwo mujyi mu bunini mu gihugu ukurikije abaturage, nyuma ya Johannesburg, n'umujyi munini mu burengerazuba bwa Cape. Umujyi ugizwe n'umujyi wa Cape Town metropolitan.
Uyu mujyi uzwiho kandi icyambu, imiterere karemano mu karere ka Cape Floristic, ndetse n’ahantu nyaburanga nka Mountain na Cape Point. Cape Town yagizwe umujyi mwiza ku isi ku bagenzi, inshuro nyinshi, harimo nka The New York Times mu 2014, igihe cyashize mu 2025, na "The Telegraph" mu myaka 8 ishize(2017 kugeza 2025).
Iherereye ku nkombe za Table Bay, agace ka City Bowl ka Cape Town, karimo akarere k'ubucuruzi hagati (CBD), ni agace ka kera cyane ko mu mijyi yo mu burengerazuba bwa cape, ako gace kandi gafite umurage ndangamuco ukomeye. Agace ka metropolitani gafite inkombe ndende ku nyanja ya Atalantika, ikubiyemo igice cyo mu majyaruguru mu karere ka West Beach, ndetse n'akarere ka False Bay mu majyepfo.
Parike y'imeza iri mu mipaka y'umujyi kandi hari n'ibindi byinshi bibungabunga ibidukikije hamwe n’ahantu harinzwe n’inyanja imbere ndetse no hafi y’umujyi, birinda ibidukikije bitandukanye byo ku isi n’inyanja. Muri byo harimo ubusitani bwa Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden, bukubiyemo 5 muri biome 6 zo muri Afurika y'epfo, kandi bukerekana ibimera byinshi bikomoka mu karere ka Cape.
Cape Town yinjiza amafaranga menshi yo muri Afurika y'epfo, umubare muto w’ubushomeri, urwego rwo hejuru rw’ishoramari ry’ibikorwa remezo, zitanga serivisi zikomeye, ubukerarugendo bunini, n’isoko ry’imitungo itimukanwa.
Ibisigisigi bya mbere bizwi cyane mu bikorwa by'abantu muri kariya karere byabonetse mu buvumo bwa Peers muri Fish Hoek kandi byanditswe hagati yimyaka 15.000 na 12.000.
Bartolomeu Dias Umunyaburayi wa mbere wageze muri ako karere yahageze mu mwaka wa 1488 ayita "Cape of Storms" (). Nyuma yaje kwitwa John II wo muri Porutugali yitwa " Cape of Hope Hope " () kubera icyizere gikomeye cyatewe no gufungura inzira y'inyanja yerekeza k'umugabane wu Buhinde no mu burasirazuba bwa Indies.
Mu mwaka wi 1497, umushakashatsi w’igiporutugali Vasco da Gama yanditse amajwi yerekeranye n’umusozi w’amizero meza.
Mu mwaka wi 1510, ku rugamba rw'uruzi rw'umunyu, admiral wo muri Porutugali Francisco de Almeida na mirongo itandatu na bane mu bagabo be barishwe kandi ishyaka rye ryatsinzwe na "Goringhaiqua" mu myandikire y’Abadage) bakoresheje inka zatojwe bidasanzwe kugira ngo basubize ifirimbi n'induru. Gorinaiqua yari umwe mu miryango ya Khoikhoi yari ituye muri ako gace.
Mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 16 Abafaransa, Danemarke, Abadage, n'Abongereza, ariko cyane I giporutugali, amato yahoraga akomeza guhagarara hejuru ya Bay Bay yerekeza mu Buhinde. Bagurishaga itabi, umuringa, n'icyuma hamwe n'imiryango ya Khoikhoi yo mu karere kugirango bagurane inyama nshya n'ibindi byangombwa by'ingendo.
Igihe cy'Ubuholandi.
Gutura byakuze buhoro muri iki gihe, kuko byari bigoye kubona akazi gahagije.Uku kubura abakozi kwatumye kandi abayobozi baho batumiza mu mahanga abacakara muri Indoneziya na Madagasikari. Benshi muri aba bantu ni abakurambere b'iki gihe cya Cape Colored na Cape Malay.
Ku butegetsi bwa Van Riebeeck n'abamusimbuye, nk'abayobozi ba VOC ndetse na ba guverineri nyuma ya Cape, hashyizweho ibihingwa bitandukanye by'ubuhinzi. Bimwe muribi, birimo inzabibu, ibinyampeke, imbuto z'ubutaka, ibirayi, pomme na citrusi, byagize uruhare runini kandi birambye mu mibereho n'ubukungu bw'akarere.
Igihe cy'Ubwongereza.
Repubulika y'ubuhorandi yahinduwe muri Repubulika ya Bataviya y’impinduramatwara y’Ubufaransa, Ubwongereza bwimukiye kwigarurira ubukoloni bw’Ubuholandi, harimo n’ubukoroni bwa VOC.
U bwongereza bwigaruriye Cape Town mu mwaka wa 1795, ariko busubizwa mu Buholandi n’amasezerano mu 1803. Ingabo z’Abongereza zongeye kwigarurira Cape mu 1806 nyuma y’Intambara ya Blaauwberg igihe Repubulika ya Bataviya yifatanyaga na mukeba w’Ubwongereza, Ubufaransa, mu gihe cy’intambara ya Napoleon. Intambara irangiye Cape Town yahawe u Bwongereza burundu mu masezerano y'Abongereza n'ubuholandi yo mu mwaka 1814.
Umujyi wabaye umurwa mukuru wa Cape Colony nshya yari imaze gushingwa, akarere kayo kakaguka cyane kugeza mu myaka ya 1800, igice cyatewe n'intambara nyinshi na ama Xhosa k'umupaka w'iburasirazuba bwa koloni. Mu 1833, ubucakara bwakuweho muri koloni babohora imbata zirenga 5500 muri uwo mujyi, hafi kimwe cya gatatu cyabatuye umujyi icyo gihe. ikibazo cy'abakatiwe mu 1849, cyaranzwe n’imivurungano ikomeye y’abaturage, cyashimangiye icyifuzo cyo kwiyobora muri Cape.
Mu kwaguka haje gusabwa ubwigenge bukomeye mu Bwongereza, Cape igera ku nteko ishinga amategeko yayo mu mwaka wi 1854 na Minisitiri w’intebe ubarizwa aho (1872). Amatora yashyizweho hakurikijwe amacakubiri adafite amoko Cape yujuje ibisabwa.
Mu mwaka wi 1850 nuwa 1860, ubundi bwoko bw’ibimera bwatangijwe muri Ositaraliya n’ubuyobozi bw’Ubwongereza. By'umwihariko rooikrans yatangijwe kugirango ituze umucanga wa Cape flats kugirango yemererwe umuhanda uhuza umupaka n’igice cy’umugabane wa Afurika, kandi eucalyptus yakoreshejwe mu kuvoma ibishanga.
Mu 1859, umurongo wa gariyamoshi wa mbere wubatswe na gariyamoshi ya leta ya Cape kandi sisitemu ya gariyamoshi yagutse vuba mu 1870. Ivumburwa rya diyama muri Griqualand West mu 1867, na Witwatersrand Gold Rush mu 1886, byatumye umwuzure w’abinjira muri Afurika y'epfo. Mu 1895, hafunguwe sitasiyo ya mbere y’amashanyarazi rusange y’umujyi, Graaff Electric Lighting Works.
Amakimbirane hagati ya Repubulika ya Boer imbere na guverinoma y'ubukoroni bw’Abongereza yatumye Intambara ya kabiri ya Boer yo mu mwaka wi 1899–1902. Intsinzi y'Ubwongereza muri iyi ntambara yatumye hashyirwaho Afurika y'Epfo yunze ubumwe. Kuva mu 1891 kugeza 1901, abatuye umujyi barikubye kabiri bava kuri 67.000 bagera kuri 171.000.
Igihe cy' ikinyejana cya 19 ubwo cyarangiraga, ubukungu bwa politiki bya Cape Town mu karere ka Afurika y'epfo mu kinyejana cya 19 byatangiye guha umwanya Johannesburg na Pretoriya mu kinyejana cya 20.
Igihe cya Afrika yepfo.
Mu 1910, Ubwongereza bwashizeho ubumwe bw'Afurika y'epfo bwahuzaga Cape Colony hamwe na Repubulika ya Boer yatsinzwe na koloni y’Abongereza ya Natal. Cape Town yabaye umurwa mukuru w’amategeko w’Ubumwe, nyuma ya Repubulika ya Afurika yepfo.
Mu ibarura ryo mu 1936 Johannesburg yari Cape Town nk'umujyi munini mu gihugu.
Mu 1945 kwagura ikibanza cya Cae Town cyarangiye, hiyongeraho 194ha (hegitari 480) kuri Cape Town CBD, no mu kwagura, akarere ka Bowl.
Mugihe cya Aparthied.
