Rwenzori ni imisozi miremire yo muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba bw’uburinganire, iherereye ku mupaka uhuza Uganda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Impinga ndende ya Ruwenzori ifite uburebure bwa, ni umusozi ukunda kugaragaraho ibicu ndetse n'urubura. Inzuzi zigaburirwa ninzuzi zo mumisozi zigize imwe mumasoko ya Nili. Kubera iyo mpamvu, abashakashatsi b’i Burayi bahujije Ruwenzori n’imisozi y’imigani y’ukwezi, byavuzwe n’intiti y’Ubugereki Ptolémée nk’isoko ya Nili. Pariki y'igihugu ya Virunga mu burasirazuba bwa DR Congo na Parike ya Rwenzori yo mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Uganda iherereye muri urwo rwego.
Imisozi yashinzwe ahagana mumyaka miriyoni eshatu ishize mugihe cyanyuma cya Pliocene kandi ni ibisubizo byazamuye amabuye ya kristaline harimo gneiss, amphibolite, granite na quartzite.
Rwenzori ifite imisozi miremire itari ibirunga, idafite orogene ku isi.
Amateka ya Rwenzori.
Rimwe na rimwe imisozi igaragazwa n’imigani uyu musozi wo bawitiriye " Umusozi w'ukwezi ", ivugwa mu bihe bya kera nk'isoko y'uruzi rwa Nili. Abashakashatsi bo mu Burayi bwa none barebye intera yatangiye guhera mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya, Samuel Baker avuga icyo yise "Imisozi y'Ubururu" yegereye intera mu 1864, naho Henry M. Stanley asura intera mu 1875 na 1888, ubwo yandikaga izina nka "Ruwenzori".
Mu 1906,umushakashatsi Duke wa Abruzzi yakoze urugendo rugana i Ruwenzori, iyo nkuru ikaba yarasohowe na Filippo De Filippi. Urwo rugendo rwapimye impinga ndende cyane y’urwo rwego, inyinshi muri zo zikaba zaritiriwe umutware, naho umusozi wa Luigi di Savoia witwa izina rye. Aherekejwe na duke yari umufotozi Vittorio Sella, wari wasuye imisozi mbere. Igikorwa cyo gufotora Sella kibitswe kuri Museo Nazionale della Montagna muri Turin no kuri Istituto di Fotografia Alpina Vittorio Sella muri Biella, haba mu Butaliyani. Kaminuza ya Makerere, muri Uganda, nayo ifite guhitamo amashusho ye.

Humure ni umusozi muremure uri mu Karere ka Gatsibo, Intara y’Uburasirazuba mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda. Uherereye hagati ya Nyagisozi, Kageyo ya Gatsibo, Remera, Kirwa na Muhura, mu Mudugudu wa Kigabiro, Akagari ka Kigabiro, Umurenge wa Remera. Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, aho hantu hari mu karere k’u Buganza.
Mu mpinga ya Humure hari hubatse urugo rw’Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri, kimwe mu birindiro bye by’amateka. Indi mirwa yari afite yubatse ni Gatsibo y’Imitoma n’i Rwamagana. Hari igitekerezo kivuga ko izina "Humure" ryaturutse ku Mwami Ruganzu II Ndori waharambagiriye mu gihe yarambagiraga igihugu maze akaharuhukira. Aho Ruganzu yaruhukiye ni kurutare ruri mu ibanga ry'umusozi wa Humure, hakaba ari ahitwa Ryanjero hakaba hari n'iriba ryitwa Ryanjyero.
Mu bigabiro byahoze kuri uwo musozi, hasigaye igiti kimwe cyitwa Ruganiriro, ari cyo cyari ku rugo rw’umwami. Ni igiti cy’umuganashya cyarikagwagamo imizinga y’inzuki zatangaga ubuki bwitwa inziramvuzo. Icyo giti gifatwa nk’igisigaratongo cy’ibigabiro bya kera.
Hafi yaho kandi hari ikindi giti kinini cyitwaga Ndaruhutse, cyabaye ikimenyetso cy’uburyo umusozi wa Humure wabonwaga n’abaturutse kure, cyane cyane Abanyarwanda bajyaga guhaha i Bugande. Cyari igiti cy’icyerekezo cyabafashaga kutayoba bageze mu Mutara. Bitewe n’umuyaga wakomotse ku muriro w’abashumba, icyo giti cyaje kugwa. Hari ababivuga nk’inkuru ishingiye ku myemerere y’uko cyaba cyaratewe nk’igiti cy’intsinzi kugira ngo u Rwanda rutsinde Nyirabiyoro wari utuye mu Mubari wa Kabeja.
Ku ngoma ya Mutara III Rudahigwa, i Humure hashinzwe igikingi cy’inyambo zitwaga Intabangira, zari zishinzwe umutware Ryumugabe. Mbere yo kuhazana iryo shyo ry’inyambo, Ryumugabe yari yarahagabiye inka z’Impezamihigo zari zaraturutse i Gituza. Humure yari ifite urwuri rurerure rumeramo ubwatsi bunyuranye, burimo "inyovi", "uruhihi", n’"ivubwe", ibyo bikaba bijyanye n’amategeko agenga ubworozi bw'inyambo, kuko inyambo zitari zemerewe kurisha hamwe n’andi matungo nk’ihene cyangwa inkoko. Intabangira zaje kwagukira no mu yindi mirwa nka Murambi n’i Nduba.

Rugenge hazwi nko ku Kigabiro cya Rugenge, ni ahantu h’amateka haherereye mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, Akarere ka Bugesera, Umurenge wa Gashora, Akagari ka Ramiro, Umudugudu wa Kagasa. Aha ni ho honyine mu Bugesera hatuye umwami w’u Rwanda, ari we Kigeri IV Rwabugiri.
Urugo rwa Kigeri IV Rwabugiri rwari rwubatse i Rugenge, aho yatungiye umugore w’Umurundikazi witwaga Murerwa wa Ngwije. Murerwa yari yarahunze u Burundi hamwe na musaza we Cyoya, nyuma yo kwigomeka ku mwami w’u Burundi. Cyoya yazanye n’ingabo ze zitwaga Inyange, akimara kugera mu Rwanda, Umwami Rwabugiri yaramwakiriye amugira umutware ukomeye mu gihugu.
Nyuma y’igihe, Rwabugiri yashyingiye Murerwa umuhungu we Sharangabo.
Ahahoze urugo rwa Rwabugiri i Rugenge hasigaye igiti cy’umuvumu cyari cyaratemwe ariko cyaje kongera gushibuka. Kuri ubu ahahoze urwo rugo hubatse uruganda rukora ibyuma (fer à béton).
Hafi y’aho, mu bilometero bibiri, mu Murenge wa Rweru, Akagari ka Nemba, Umudugudu wa Rutete, hari ahitwa Ku Kavure ka Rwabugiri, ahari iriba rito ryitiriwe uwo mwami. Bivugwa ko ari Rwabugiri warifukuje, kandi n’ubu rikoreshwa n’aborozi bo muri ako gace buhira inka. Inka nkuru zashokaga ku rindi riba ryitwaga iriba rya Nyirarubomboza.
Kintambwe na Rwacyoya.
Aho Cyoya yagabiwe n’Umwami Rwabugiri akahatura, haje kwitwa "Kintambwe" rikaba ari ijambo ry’Ikirundi risobanura "Intare", kubera ko ako gace kabagamo inyamaswa nyinshi zirimo n’intare. Ubu, Kintambwe ni Akagari ko mu Murenge wa Rweru, aho kandi habarizwa iriba rya Rwacyoya, rifatwa nk’iriba ryafukujwe na Cyoya.

Akarwa k’Abakobwa ni akarwa gaherereye mu kiyaga cya Kivu, hafi y’umwaro wa Nyamasheke, mu karere ka Nyamasheke, Intara y’Iburengerazuba y’u Rwanda. Aka karwa kazwi mu mateka n’umuco nyarwanda nk’ahajyanwaga abakobwa batwaye inda z’indaro mu gihe cya cyami, mu rwego rwo kubahana no kubasiga ishyanga nk’uko byari bisanzwe mu muco wa kera.
Imiterere n’indangamerekezo.
Akarwa k’Abakobwa kari mu mudugudu wa Gikuyu, Akagari ka Ninzi, Umurenge wa Kagano, mu karere ka Nyamasheke. Ako karwa gaherereye mu bilometero bike uvuye ku nkombe za Kivu, kandi kari hafi y’undi mwaro uzwi mu mateka y’ubwikorezi n’ubucuruzi bwambukiranya ibihugu.
Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, gutwara inda y’indaro (inda y’umukobwa utarashyingiwe) byafatwaga nk’icyaha gikomeye. Iyo byamenyekanaga, umukobwa yahabwaga igihano cyo gucibwa, agakurwa mu muryango agasigwa ishyanga cyangwa ahantu hadatuwe.
Mu turere twegereye Nyamasheke, nk’uko byanditswe na Bigirumwami (1974), abakobwa batwaye inda z’indaro boherezwaga kuri aka karwa, aho babaga ari bonyine. Kubera icyo gikorwa cyo guherekezwa no gusigwa kuri aka karwa, kazwi kugeza n’uyu munsi ku izina rya “Akarwa k’Abakobwa.”
Ikoreshwa ry’aka karwa.
Abahavu bari abaturage bo ku nkengero z’ikiyaga cya Kivu bajyaga basura aka karwa, bamwe bagasanga abakobwa bagihari bataricwa n’inzara cyangwa inyamaswa. Bamwe muri abo bakobwa barashyingirwaga cyangwa bagatwarwa n’abo bagabo, bagakomereza ubuzima mu bundi buryo.
Akarwa k’Abakobwa gafite akamaro k’umuco n’amateka, kuko kerekana imyumvire y’ibihe byashize ku bijyanye n’uburere, imyifatire n’imyemerere ku bagore n’abakobwa mu Rwanda rwa kera. Ubu ni ahantu h’inyigisho z’amateka n’uburenganzira bwa muntu, hashingira ku guha agaciro ubuzima no kurwanya ihutazwa rishingiye ku gitsina.

Nampula ni umurwa mukuru w'intara ya Nampula mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike. Hatuwe abantu basaga 743.125 mw'ibarura rusange rya 2017 ni umujyi wa gatatu munini muri Mozambike nyuma ya Maputo na Matola. Uyu mujyi uherereye imbere mu Ntara ya Nampula,mu birometero 200 uvuye ku nkombe kandi ukikijwe n'ibibaya n'amasoko y'amabuye. Uyu mujyi ni ikigo kinini cy’akarere mu karere kose ko mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike, ndetse no mu bice bya Mozambike yo hagati ndetse n’umupaka wa Malawi na Tanzaniya.
Uyu mujyi uhuza umujyi wa Nacala uri ku cyambu n’ibihugu byo muri Afurika y'epfo bifunze ubutaka,cyane Malawi unyuze mu muhanda na gariyamoshi. Uyu mujyi ufite ikibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga gihuza Nairobi muri Kenya, Johannesburg muri Afurika yepfo, Dar-es-Salaam muri Tanzaniya kandi n'ihuriro ry’ubwikorezi bwaho mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike. Nampula ni ihuriro ry’ubucuruzi mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike, yungukira mu bice by’ubuhinzi bitanga umusaruro mwinshi, hafi y’umuhanda wa Nacala, ndetse n’abaturage bo mu mujyi biyongera cyane.
Nampula n'inzu ndangamurage y’igihugu ya Mozambike, amasoko menshi, katedrali, imisigiti, kaminuza, ibigo byigisha n’ishuri. Umujyi uratandukanye, abaturage ba eMakhuwa kavukire niwo mujyi munini ariko ufite abahinde, Abanyaburayi (biganjemo Abanyaporitigale), Abashinwa, Abanyalibani, Abanyasomaliya, na Nijeriya.
Izina "Nampula" bivugwa ko ryakomotse ku ijambo eMakhuwa "Whampula", nk'uko bivugwa mu migani yaho bikaba bisobanura umuyobozi w'imiryango y'ako karere mu bihe byashize.
Nampula ni umujyi mushya. washinzwe n’ingabo z’abakoloni ba Porutugali mu mwaka wi 1907 ikazamuka mu mujyi mu 1956. Mu gihe cy’intambara y’ubwigenge bwa Mozambike, Nampula yari ikigo cya gisirikare cy’ingabo z’abakoloni mu kurwanya umutwe wo kwibohora FRELIMO.
Nyuma y'ubwigenge mu mwaka wi 1975, Abanyaporitigale bataye Nampula maze abaturage bo mu cyaro bimukira muri uwo mujyi, bicara mu turere tutari duteganyijwe ku nkengero z'umujyi. Uyu mutwe w’abimukira wiyongereye cyane mu gihe cy’intambara y’abenegihugu ya Mozambike, bigira ingaruka kuri Nampula mu myaka icumi hagati ya 1982 na 1992. Igihe intambara yarangiraga guverinoma ya Mozambike yari yiteze ko impunzi zizasubira mu cyaro, ariko baguma mu mujyi. nyuma y'imyaka mike abimukira batinze kugabanuka, ubwiyongere bw'umujyi bwarakomeje, kuko iterambere ryihuse ry'ubukungu rya Mozambike ryagaragaye cyane mu mijyi. Nampula, mu gihe cy’intambara nyuma y’intambara, yateye imbere mu kigo kinini cy’iterambere cya Mozambike, gikurura umubare w’ishoramari rya Leta n’abikorera mu bice bitandukanye by’ubukungu n’imibereho.
Amadini yiganje mur'uyu mujyi wa Nampula ni abakristo,abayisilamu. hamwe n'muryango muto w'abahindu nawo urahari. Katedrali yayo ya Bikira Mariya wa Fatima ni archepiscopale reba Diyosezi Gatolika ya Roma ya Nampula.
Umujyi ubarizwamo ishami ry'ubumenyi bw'ubuzima, Universidade Lurio. muri 2009 hatangijwe amasomo muri optometrie,yambere muri Mozambike. Amasomo yatewe inkunga binyuze mu mushinga wa Eyecare Mozambique. Abandi bafatanyabikorwa barimo Ishuri Rikuru ry’ikoranabuhanga rya Dublin, Kaminuza ya Ulster na Brien Holden Vision Institute. Kugeza muri 2019, abanyeshuri 61 bo muri Mozambike barangije bafite impamyabumenyi ya optometrie muri Universidade Lurio harimo 34 b'igitsina gabo na 27 b'igitsina gore. Amasomo ya optometrie ubu yashyizwe muri sisitemu ya Universidade Lurio kandi akomeza gushaka abanyeshuri bashya buri mwaka. icy'ingenzi, optometrie ubu yanditswe nkumwuga muri Mozambike kandi izwi binyuze mu banyamuryango b’inama nyafurika ya Optometrie (AFCO). Mu barangije, 26 ubu bakora mu bitaro bya Leta. Mubyongeyeho, 10 bafite imyanya yo kwigisha muri kaminuza harimo abagabo batanu n'abagore batanu. barindwi mu barangije kwiyandikisha muri porogaramu z'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza (batanu b'igitsina gabo n'abagore barindwi).
Umujyi wa Nampula uherereye hagati mu ntara ya Nampula kandi ukikijwe n'ibibaya n'amasoko y'amabuye. Umujyi uri hagati y'imisozi miremire n'imisozi, isanzwe imbere mu majyaruguru ya Mozambike.

Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange riherereye ku Musozi wa Nyange ufite uburebure bwa metero 1,783, uherereye mu Mudugudu wa Ngobagoba, Akagari ka Gaseke, Umurenge wa Nyange, mu Karere ka Ngororero. Uyu musozi, wahoze mu cyahoze cyitwa Ubudaha, wubatseho iryo shuri rikaba ari ryo ryagabweho igitero gikomeye mu mwaka wa 1997 n’ikindi mu mwaka wa 1998.
Ubwicanyi bw’i Nyange mu 1997 no mu 1998.
Ubwicanyi bw’i Nyange ni kimwe mu bikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi byakozwe n’abacengezi mu Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ibyo bikorwa byabaye ku wa 18 Werurwe 1997 ku Ishuri Ryisumbuye rya Nyange riherereye mu Karere ka Ngororero, Intara y’Iburengerazuba, aho abanyeshuri barindwi bishwe bazira kwanga kwitandukanya hashingiwe ku moko. Iri shyano ryagize uruhare runini mu gusigasira indangagaciro z’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge mu Rwanda, ndetse abahitanywe n’icyo gitero bakaba barashyizwe mu rwego rw’Intwari z’u Rwanda mu cyiciro cy’Imena.
Igitero cya Mbere: 18 Werurwe 1997.
Ahagana saa mbiri z’ijoro, abacengezi baturukaga mu mashyamba yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo bateye ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange. Babanje kwica umuzamu Jean Baptiste Zibera, bamukubita icyuma ndetse bamutemagura ijosi. Binjiye mu ishuri ry’abanyeshuri bigaga mu mwaka wa gatandatu, babategeka kwitandukanya hashingiwe ku moko, ariko abo banyeshuri bose banga kubyemera bavuga ko ari Abanyarwanda.
Abacengezi bahise babarasa, hapfiramo abanyeshuri batatu:
Binjiye mu rindi shuri ry’umwaka wa gatanu barongera babategeka kwitandukanya, barabyanga. Babarasaho, barabatemagura, banabateramo grenade, hapfiramo abandi bane:
Abandi banyeshuri benshi barakomereka. Ingabo z’u Rwanda zahise zihagera, zirwana n’abo bacengezi, bariruka, umwe aricwa.
Igitero cya kabiri: 4 Nzeri 1998.
Mu gihe abanyeshuri bari mu biruhuko, abacengezi bongeye gutera Nyange. Bishe abarimu batatu bari batuye mu kigo:
Banateye urusisiro rwa Rubyiniro i Nyange, bahica abaturage batandatu.
Kwibukwa nk’Intwari.
Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 2001, Inama y’Abaminisitiri y’u Rwanda yemeje ko abanyeshuri 47 bigaga mu mwaka wa gatanu n’uwa gatandatu b’i Nyange baba Intwari z’u Rwanda mu cyiciro cy’Imena, harimo abapfuye n’abarokotse. Iki cyemezo cyashingiye ku ndangagaciro y’ubumwe n’ubutwari bagaragaje banze kwitandukanya hashingiwe ku moko.
Nubwo Igicumbi cy’Intwari z’Igihugu giherereye i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali, Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange na ryo ryubatse urwibutso rw’abo banyeshuri biciwemo, harimo n’amazina yabo yanditse ku kimenyetso cy’urwibutso.

Ruhimandyarya, izwi cyane ku izina ry’"Urutare rw’Abarundi", ni urutare runini kandi rurerure ruhanamiye ku mugezi wa Nyakabuye, uherereye mu Mudugudu wa Gasebeya, Akagari ka Gaseke, Umurenge wa Nyakabuye, Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba y’u Rwanda. Uru rutare ruri mu gace kari kazwi kera nka Bukunzi, kamwe mu turere tw’icyaro dufite amateka maremare y’abimukira n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro.
Izina "Urutare rw’Abarundi" rituruka ku muryango wa Mubarure, yari umugabo wari ufite inkomoko mu gihugu cy’u Burundi wageze mu Rwanda ahagana mu mwaka wa 1935. Mubarure yari umuhigi, hamwe n’abandi baje bari kumwe, bakaza guhigira mu mashyamba ya Bweyeye, Ikimena na Nyirandakunze (Cyamudongo) ariyo bahigiragamo inyamaswa. Nyuma baje gutura hejuru y’urwo rutare, bahaba igihe kirekire bituma abaturage baho barwita urw’Abarundi.
Ibisobanuro by’izina "Ruhimandyarya".
Izina Ruhimandyarya ryatanzwe na Sanduruma Faransisiko, mwene Mubarure, wari uzwi nk’umucukuzi w’amabuye y’agaciro by’umwihariko zahabu. Yacukuraga zahabu mu ishyamba rya Bweyeye akajya kuyigurisha i Bukavu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Kubera ko abamuguriraga zahabu akenshi batamwishyuraga, Sanduruma yafashe icyemezo cyo guhisha amafaranga ye mu isenga riri muri urwo rutare, nk’uburyo bwo "guhima indyarya". Aho yahishaga amafaranga hari hahanamye cyane, bikagorana kuhagera cyangwa kuyiba. Ibyo byatumye urwo rutare rutangira kwitwa "Ruhimandyarya."
Ubumenyi bw’amateka n’ubushakashatsi.
Urutare rwa Ruhimandyarya rufite agaciro gakomeye mu by’amateka kuko rwakoreweho ubushakashatsi n’umubirigikazi witwa Irene Boutakoff. Uyu muhanga mu by’amateka yibanze ku byasigaye byo hambere (Ibisigaratongo mu rurimi rw'igifaransa byitwa archéologie), aho yavumbuyemo ibikoresho by’amabuye aconze byakoreshwaga n’abakurambere b’Abanyarwanda mbere y’igihe cy’icyuma.

Port Louis ni umurwa mukuru akaba ari n'umujyi utuwe cyane wa Maurice, cyane uherereye mu Karere ka Port Louis, uyu mujyi ufite agace gato k'iburengerazuba mu Karere ka Ruzi rwa Rukara. Port Louis n'icyo kigo cy'imari na politiki by'igihugu. Iyobowe n'Inama Njyanama y'Umujyi wa Port Louis. Ibarura rusange ryo mu 2018 ryakozwe n’ibarurishamibare Maurice, abaturage baho bari 147.066.
Port Louis yakoreshejwe nk'icyambu n'abimukira b'Abaholandi kuva mu mwaka wi 1606, igihe batangiraga kuvuga ako gace nka "Harbour ya Tortoises". mu mwaka wi 1736 iyobowe na guverinoma y’Ubufaransa, yahindutse ikigo cy’ubutegetsi bwa Maurice kandi gihagarikwa cyane n’amato y’Abafaransa igihe banyuraga hagati ya Aziya n’U burayi, bazengurutse ikirwa cya Byiringiro. icyubahiro Umwami Louis XV. Muri kiriya gihe cy’abakoloni b'Abafaransa, Maurice yari azwi ku izina rya Ile de France. Guverineri w’Ubufaransa muri kiriya gihe, Bertrand-François Mahé de La Bourdonnais, yagize uruhare mu iterambere ry’umujyi. Kubera ko Port Louis yari ikingiwe neza n’umuyaga mwinshi mu gihe cy’umuyaga na Moka Mountain Range, Port Louis yatoranijwe kugira ngo ibemo icyambu kinini n’igihome cy’izinga. Agaciro k’icyambu karakomeje mu gihe Abongereza bigaruriye icyo kirwa mu gihe cy’intambara ya Napoleonique (1800-15), kandi kugenzura inyanja y’Ubuhinde. Icyakora, guhamagarira amato cyane nyuma yo gufungura umuyoboro wa Suez mu mwaka wi 1869. Ibikorwa by’icyambu byiyongereye mu gihe cy’imyaka irindwi hafunzwe umuyoboro wa Suez guhera mu 1967. Kuvugurura icyambu mu mpera z'umwaka wa 70 byamufashije gukomeza uruhare rwacyo nk'ibintu nyamukuru biva mu mahanga n'ibicuruzwa biva muri Maurice. Mu gihe Port Louis ikomeje kuba umurwa mukuru w’ubucuruzi n’ubuyobozi bwa Maurice, kwagura inganda z’ubukerarugendo yatumye habaho iterambere ryinshi muri Port Louis, hubatswe amaduka menshi, amahoteri, na resitora mu gace ka Caudan Waterfront.
Raouf Oderuth, Umuhanzi wo muri Maurice atanga amashusho yo mu 1930 yerekana inkombe y’amazi igihe ubwikorezi bwa moteri butabaho. haracyamenyekana nubwo inyubako ndende, imodoka nyinshi, hamwe n'imbaga y'abanyamaguru.
Imiyoborere y’ibanze ya Port Louis igenzurwa n'inama njyanama y'umujyi. Inama Njyanama y’Umujyi wa Port Louis yashinzwe bwa mbere mu 1830, ubu ikaba ari imwe mu nama eshanu z’amakomine zishinzwe imijyi yo muri Maurice, nkuko byateguwe n’amategeko agenga ubuyobozi bw’ibanze 2011. Inama njyanama y'umujyi wa komine ifite abanyamuryango 32. Umujyi ugabanijwemo amatora mu bice umunani buri wese asubiza abajyanama bane. Abajyanama noneho batora Umuyobozi n'uwungirije umuyobozi. Imikorere y'inama njyanama ikorwa binyuze mu mashami y'ubuyobozi, Imari, Imikoreshereze y'ubutaka n'igenamigambi, ibikorwa remezo rusange, Ubuzima rusange, imibereho myiza, parike n'ubusitani, hamwe n'isomero ry'Umujyi. Serivisi zitangwa n'inzego z'ibanze zirimo amashuri abanza, amashuri y'incuke, n'amashuri y'imyuga, kurengera ubuzima, kugenzura imiturire, serivisi z’imihanda, gukusanya imyanda, amarimbi, serivisi zimwe na zimwe zo kurengera ibidukikije n’umuguzi, n’ibikorwa byo kuzamura ubukungu. Izindi serivisi zitangwa mu mujyi na guverinoma nkuru. Harimo serivisi za polisi binyuze mu gipolisi cya Maurice, gikomeza ibice bibiri bishinzwe agace ka Port Louis (Metropolitan Diviziyo y'Amajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo). Hariho na Polisi yihariye ya Port, igizwe na Polisi ya Harbour na Polisi ya Sugar Terminal. Mu nshingano zabo harimo gutanga umutekano ku mizigo n'ibikoresho byo mu cyambu no kubahiriza amategeko ajyanye n'amabwiriza yo ku cyambu, gasutamo, akato, abinjira n'abasohoka.
Mu matora y’amakomine 2025, Alliance du Changement yatsindiye imyanya 31 kuri 32 y’inama njyanama, mu gihe uwigenga yabonye umutekano. Nyuma y’amatora, akanama katoye Aslam Hosenally w’umutwe w’abarwanyi bo muri Maurice kuba umuyobozi wa nyagasani, wahoze akora uwo mwanya kuva mu mwaka wa 2012 kugeza 2013, na Giovanni Hensley w’ishyaka ry’abakozi kuba umuyobozi wungirije.
Ubukungu bwuy'umujyi bwiganjemo ikigo cy’imari, ibikoresho by’ibyambu, ubukerarugendo, n’inganda zikora imyenda, imiti, plastiki n'imiti. Port Louis niho hari icyambu kinini mu karere k'inyanja y'Ubuhinde kandi ni kimwe mu bigo by'imari bikomeye bya Afurika.
Port-Louis ibamo amashuri yisumbuye menshi arimo Alpha College, Bhujoharry College, Labourdonnais College, Port Louis Academy, Loreto College, Madad Ul Islam Girls College, Ishuri ry’abakobwa ry’abayisilamu, Umujyi wa Koleji, Ishuri ry’umunsi, Ishuri ry’ubushakashatsi bw’ubuyisilamu n’isi, Ishuri Rikuru rya Londere, Ocep Ishuri rikuru ryisumbuye, MEDCO Trinity Secondary Secondary SSS, Goolam Mohammed Dawjee Atchia State College, Ishuri ryisumbuye rya MEDCO Cassis, Renganaden Seeneevassen SSS, Port Louis SSS na Port College Louis. Leta ikora kandi ishuri ry'imyuga ku bahungu, Immaculee Conception SSV.
Ikigo gikomeye cy’amashuri makuru muri Port Louis ni kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga, Maurice, kaminuza ya leta yibanda ku ikoranabuhanga. École de Medecine Louis Pasteur ritegura abanyeshuri kwigira ubuvuzi muri Université de Lille mu Bufaransa. Amashuri menshi ya tekiniki nayo afite ibibanza mu mujyi, harimo ishuri rya Jhurry ryari iryinzobere mu ikoranabuhanga ry'amakuru, Ishuri ryubucuruzi rya Appavoo, Ishuri ry’abaforomo rya Apollo Bramwell, Ishuri ry’icungamutungo n’imicungire ya BSP, hamwe n’ishuri rikuru ry’ibaruramari rya London.

Cyangugu (ahahoze ari Shangugu) n'umujyi mukuru w'akarere ka Rusizi mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, mu Rwanda. Uyu mujyi ukaba uherereye mu majyepfo y’ikiyaga cya Kivu, kandi ukaba uhuza Bukavu, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya congo, ariko ukitandukanya n'uwo n'umugezi wa Ruzizi. Ibiraro bibiri n'urugomero rwambuka umupaka.
ifite ibice bibiri by'ingenzi: Cyangugu ubwayo ni akarere gafite ubucucike buke ku nkombe z'ikiyaga, naho Kamembe n'ikigo kinini cy’inganda n’ubwikorezi kiri imbere imbere no mu majyaruguru. Ikibuga cy'indege cya Kamembe gikorera mu mujyi n'indege inshuro 11 mu cyumweru zerekeza Kigali, zikoreshwa na RwandAir.
Uyu mujyi uri hafi y’ishyamba rya Nyungwe, ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa n’abakerarugendo, akaba ari kamwe mu turere tw’amashyamba twa nyuma dusigaye mu Rwanda.
Mu 2022 uyu umujyi wari utuwe n'abaturage 43.866.

Izina rya crater rifite inkomoko ya onomatopoeic; yitiriwe abashumba ba Maasai nyuma yijwi ryakozwe na cowbell ("ngoro ngoro"). Hashingiwe ku bimenyetso by’ibinyabuzima OH 7 biboneka ku kibaya cya Olduvai, amoko atandukanye ya hominid yigaruriye ako gace byibuze miliyoni 1.75.
Abahiga basimbuwe n'abashumba mu myaka ibihumbi ishize. Abanyayiraki baje muri kariya gace hashize imyaka igera ku 2000 kandi bifatanya na Datooga ahagana mu mwaka wa 1700. Iyo mitwe yombi yirukanywe muri ako gace na Maasai mu myaka ya 1800.
Abanyaburayi bazwiho kuba abarakandagije ikirenge muri Ngorongoro Crater kugeza mu 1892 ubwo yasurwa na Oscar Boumann. Abavandimwe babiri b'Abadage (Adolph na Friedrich Siedentopf) bahinze muri icyo cyobo kugeza Intambara ya mbere y'isi yose nyuma yo gukodesha ubutaka ku buyobozi bwa Afurika y'uburasirazuba bw'abadage. Abavandimwe bahoraga bategura ibirori byo kurasa kugirango bashimishe inshuti zabo. Bagerageje kandi kwirukana amashyo y’inyamanswa mu mwobo.
Ubumenyi bwa geologiya.
Itsinda ry’ibirunga rya Pliocene Ngorongoro rigizwe n’ibirunga umunani byazimiye muri Eyasi igice cya graben, urubibi rw'iburasirazuba rwaranzwe na Gregory Rift Western Escarpment. Inkunga y'Ikiyaga cya Eyasi ihuza igice cya graben mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba. Muri urwo ruganda, ibirunga bitanu ni imeze nk'imigozi, mugihe bitatu bifite Calderas. Ikirunga cya Ngorongoro (2.5-1.9 Ma) ni trachyandesite ya basaltike. Caldera igaburirwa ni nzuzi za Munge na Oljoro Nyuki, mugihe amasoko ashyushye ya Ngoitokitok agaburira mu gishanga cya Goringop. Ikiyaga cya Magadi ni ikiyaga cya metero 1,7. Ibindi birunga biri muri icyo kigo birimo Olmoti (2.01–1.79 Ma), Empakaai, Loolmalasin, Sadiman (3.7 Ma), Lemagrut, na Oldeani. Igice cyo mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa NCA kigizwe n'ibibaya bya Serengeti, ikibaya cya Salei, ikibaya cya Oldupai, hamwe n'imisozi ya Gol inselbergs. Izi inselbergs zigize Quartzite ya Mozambike na schist ya mika hafi (800-500 Ma) mumyaka.

Tanzaniya irimo ibice 20 kw'ijana by'ubwoko bunini bw'inyamabere z’inyamabere z’Afurika, ziboneka hirya no hino mu mashyamba naza pariki, ahantu hagenewe kubungabunga ibidukikije, parike zo mu nyanja, na parike 17 z’igihugu, zikwirakwira ku buso bwa no gukora hafi 38 ku ijana by'ubutaka bw'igihugu. Umutungo w’ibinyabuzima wo muri Tanzaniya uvugwa ko utabangikanye muri Afurika n'igihugu cyambere kireba imikino ". Parike ya Serengeti, ubuso bwa kabiri mu gihugu muri parike y’igihugu kuri, iherereye mu majyaruguru ya Tanzaniya kandi izwi cyane kubera amashyo menshi yimuka y’inyamanswa na zebra mu gihe kandi azwiho kuba kimwe mu bintu bitangaje by’isi. Agace ko kubungabunga Ngorongoro, gashinzwe mu 1959, ni Umurage w’isi wa UNESCO kandi utuwe n’abaturage ba Maasai. Crater yayo ya Ngorongoro niyo Caldera nini cyane ku isi.
Kuva mu gihe cy'ubakoloni, kubungabunga inyamaswa muri Tanzaniya byabaye umukoro kuri guverinoma ya tanzaniya. Muri uru rwego, imikoreshereze y’umutungo w’inyamanswa n’abaturage baho yari isanzwe ibuza, bigatuma ubukene bwiyongera mu cyaro no guhiga. Mu myaka yashize, ikigo cy’igihugu cya parike ya Tanzaniya (TANAPA) cyatangije ibikorwa byo gukosora kugira ngo abaturage baho bagire uruhare mu kubungabunga ibidukikije, bigamije gutanga umusanzu mu bukungu bw’ibanze binyuze mu kugabana inyungu zingana.

Umugezi wa Rukarara (cyangwa Lukarara) ni uruzi rwo mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda rukaba uruzi rw'umugezi wa Mwogo, na rwo rukaba uruzi rw'umugezi wa Nyabarongo. Namazi ya kure cyane ya Nili.
Rukarara n'uruzi ruzamuka rukagera mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda mu burasirazuba bw’igabana rya Kongo Nili.Igishanga cya Kamiranzovu kiri mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe ritanga umugezi wa Rukarara. [1] Inkomoko ya Rukarara ubu izwiho kuba ariyo isoko rusange ya Nili. Ibi byashimangiwe n’urugendo rwo mu 2005/2006 rwerekeje ku ruzi hamwe n’ibikoresho bigezweho byo kugenda. Inkomoko ya Nili, isoko ya kure kuva mu kanwa kayo, iri ku butumburuke bwa, ku burebure n'uburebure
Rukarara ifite inkomoko mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Umugezi wa Nyirabugoyi na Rubyiro niwo mugezi wacyo mukuru, byombi bizamuka muri parike y'igihugu ya Nyungwe. Rukarara ni nzira ndende yinzuzi zitanga Mwogo. [6] Rukarara itemba mu majyepfo hanyuma iburasirazuba, isuka mu ruzi rwa Mwogo. Mwogo igatemba imena mu majyaruguru, ihuza uruzi rwa Mbirurume mu majyepfo ya Bwek kugira ngo ruhinduke uruzi rwa Nyabarongo.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside.
Mu Murenge wa Gisozi hari Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali. Mu mwaka wa 2023, UNESCO yashyize inzibutso enye za Jenoside mu murage w'isi. Urwibutso rwa Kigali ni rumwe muri izo nzibutso.

Urupapuro rukurikira rugaragaza amashanyarazi mu Rwanda.
Umurongo ngenderwaho.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, u Rwanda rwashyizwe ku mwanya 166 mu bijyanye n’ubushobozi bwashyizweho na191 na 164 ku bijyanye n’umusaruro w’umwaka hamwe na miliyoni 525 zaKilo wati(kw). Urwego rwo gukwirakwiza amashanyarazi rwari 21% muri 2013 (67% mu mijyi na 5% mu cyaro). Nk’uko Banki y'Isi ibivuga, mu 2017, 34% by'igihugu bari bafite amashanyarazi, ahanini akaba agenerwa imijyi minini. Mu cyaro, abaturage batageze kuri umwe ku icumi bafite amashanyarazi, cyangwa abantu barenga miliyoni umunani. Kugeza muri Mutarama 2019, isosiyete y'igihugu ishinzwe amashanyarazi mu Rwanda ariyo Rwanda Energy Group (REG) yari ifite ingufu za Mega wati 218. Nk’uko REG ibivuga, ubushobozi bwashyizweho bugomba kwiyongera kugera kuri mega wati 556 muri 2024 naho urugero rw'amashanyarazi rugomba kuva kuri 49,6,rukagera kuri 100%. Kugeza muri Kamena 2019, ingufu z'amashanyarazi ku rwego rw'igihugu zigeze kuri 224,6 mega wati zifite ingufu zingana na mega wati 140,6 .

Dominique Habimana ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyarwanda. Ni Minisitiri w'Ubutegetsi bw'Igihugu kuva ku wa 24 Nyakanga 2025.
Mbere yaho, Habimana yari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa RALGA. Ni n'umuhanzi w'indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana.
Mu 2006, Habimana yabonye impamyabumenyi ya "Bachelor" mu mibereho y'abaturage ("Social Sciences"). Yayikuye muri Université Libre de Kigali (ULK). Mu 2014, yabonye impamyabumenyi ya "Master" mu iterambere ("Development Studies"). Yayikuye muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda. Mu 2022, yabonye indi "Master" mu gukemura amakimbirane. Yayikuye muri Geneva Graduate Institute, mu Ubusuwisi.
Kuva mu 2013 kugeza mu 2018, Habimana yakoreye GIZ mu Rwanda. Yari impuguke mu miyoborere.
Kuva mu 2018 kugeza mu 2024, yakoreye Ikigo cy'Ubusuwisi gishinzwe iterambere n'ubutwererane (SDC). Yari ashinzwe gahunda z'imiyoborere. Yateje imbere uburyo bwo gukemura amakimbirane mu baturage, nk'Abunzi. Mu gihe cya COVID-19, yayoboye gahunda yo gufasha imishinga mito n'iciriritse. Iyo gahunda yakorerwaga mu Rwanda, mu Burundi no muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Ku wa 6 Kamena 2024, Habimana yabaye Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa RALGA. RALGA ni ihuriro ry'inzego z'ibanze mu Rwanda. Habimana yasimbuye Ladislas Ngendahimana.
Ku wa 24 Nyakanga 2025, Perezida Paul Kagame yagize Habimana Minisitiri w'Ubutegetsi bw'Igihugu. Habimana yasimbuye Dr Patrice Mugenzi. Ihererekanyabubasha ryabaye ku wa 28 Nyakanga 2025.
Habimana ni umuhanzi w'indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana. Mu 2025, yari amaze imyaka irenga 11 mu muziki. Yayoboye korali Seraphim Melodies. Yanditse indirimbo nyinshi z'iyo korali. Yandikiye n'abandi bahanzi indirimbo. Mu ndirimbo ze harimo "Njyewe na Yesu", "Ndagukunda", "Narababariwe" na "Umunyarwanda".
Habimana ni Umukirisitu wo mu itorero AEBR Kacyiru. Se ni pasiteri.

Ibuprofen ni imiti yo mu cyiciro cya nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) ikoreshwa mu kuvura ububabare, umuriro, n’ububabare. Ibi birimo imihango ibabaza, migraine, na rubagimpande ya rubagimpande. Irashobora kandi gukoreshwa mugufunga patent ductus arteriosus kumwana utagejeje igihe. Ishobora gukoreshwa biciye mukanwa cyangwa mumitsi. Mubisanzwe itangira gukora mugihe kingana n isha imwe.
Ingaruka zisanzwe zirimo gutwika no guhubuka. Ugereranije nizindi NSAIDs, irashobora kugira ingaruka nke nko kuva amaraso gastrointestinal. Yongera ibyago byo kunanirwa k'umutima, kunanirwa kw'impyiko, no kunanirwa kw'umwijima. Mugihe gito, ntabwo bigaragara ko byongera ibyago byo kurwara umutima; icyakora, kuri dosiye ndende irashobora. Ibuprofen irashobora kandi kwangiza asima. Nubwo bidasobanutse niba ari umutekano mugihe cyo gutwita hakiri kare, bigaragara ko ari bibi mugihe cyo gutwita nyuma bityo ntibisabwa. Koresha mugihe konsa ari umutekano. Kimwe nizindi NSAIDs, ikora ibuza umusaruro wa prostaglandine kugabanya ibikorwa bya enzyme cyclooxygenase. Ibuprofen nintege nke zo kurwanya inflammatory kurusha izindi NSAIDs.
Ibuprofen yavumbuwe mu 1961 na Stewart Adams muri Boots UK Limited hanyuma ibanza kugurishwa nka Brufen. Iraboneka munsi yizina ryubucuruzi, harimo Nurofen, Inama na Motrin. Yashyizwe ku isoko bwa mbere mu 1969 mu Bwongereza no muri Amerika mu 1974. Ari kurutonde rwumuryango wubuzima ku isi urutonde rwimiti yingenzi. Iraboneka nkumuti rusange. Igiciro cyinshi mugihugu kiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya 0.01 na 0.04 kuri dose. Muri Reta zunzubumwe za Amerika, igura amadolari 0.05 kuri dose. Muri 2017, yari imiti ya 28 yandikiwe cyane muri Amerika, hamwe na barenga 24miriyoni.

Indwara ya Coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) n'indwara yandura iterwa na syndrome ikabije y'ubuhumekero coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). Ibimenyetso bikunze kubamo umuriro, inkorora, ingorane zo guhumeka, umunaniro, kubabara umutwe, kubura impumuro n'uburyohe, kubabara mu muhogo, kuruka, no gucibwamo. Ubusanzwe bitangirira mu minsi ibiri na cumi nine nyuma yo kwandura virusi. kubantu bamwe; ariko, ntugire ibimenyetso.
Ikwirakwizwa ribaho cyane cyane iyo umuntu wanduye ahuye cyane nundi muntu. Ibi birashobora kubaho haba kwanduza ikirere cyangwa ibitonyanga bito birimo virusi. Ntibisanzwe, virusi irashobora gukwirakwira hifashishijwe ibintu byanduye. Abantu barashobora kwanduzanya virusi iminsi ibiri mbere yuko bagaragaza ibimenyetso, kandi muri rusange bakomeza kwandura iminsi igera ku 10, nubwo abafite uburwayi bukomeye wenda bandura igihe kirekire. Kwipimisha mubisanzwe biterwa na polymerase urunigi (PCR) cyangwa kwipimisha antigen byihuse bivuye mumazuru cyangwa umuhogo.
Ingamba zo kwirinda zirimo intera y'umubiri, gukoresha mask yo mu rwego rwohejuru, guhumeka ahantu h'imbere, na karantine. Inkingo nyinshi nazo zigabanya ibyago. Byinshi m'ubuvuzi n'ibimenyetso kandi birashyigikirwa. Mubadakeneye ibitaro, ariko bafite ibyago byinshi, nirmatrelvir / ritonavir, remdesivir, cyangwa molnupiravir irashobora gukoreshwa. Kubakeneye kuvura ogisijeni, dexamethasone na remdesivir barashobora gukoreshwa. Kubakeneye ubuvuzi bukomeye tocilizumab cyangwa sarilumab barashobora kongerwamo.
Muri abo bantu bagaragaza ibimenyetso, abagera kuri 80% bakira badakeneye ibitaro, 15% bakeneye ubuvuzi bwa ogisijeni, naho 5% bakeneye ubuvuzi bukomeye. Abantu bakuze nabafite ibindi bibazo byubuzima bafite ibyago byinshi. Mugihe benshi bakira nyuma y'ibyumweru bike, bamwe bakomeza guhura n'ingaruka zitandukanye (COVID ndende) mumezi. Kugeza ku, byibuze zimaze kwemezwa, bikaba byavuyemo abarenga zapfuye. Umubare nyawo w'impfu wari; ariko, ugereranije hafi guhera ku ya 31 Ukuboza 2021. Urubanza rwa mbere ruzwi rwamenyekanye i Wuhan mu Bushinwa, mu Kuboza 2019. Indwara imaze gukwira isi yose, itera icyorezo gikomeje.

Ubumuga bwo kumva, bizwi kandi nko kutumva. Umuntu utumva ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Kubura kumva bishobora kugaragara k'ugutwi kumwe cyangwa yombi. Mu bana, ibibazo byo kutumva bishobora kugira ingaruka kubushobozi bwo kwiga ururimi ruvugwa kandi mubantu bakuru bishobora guteza ingorane mubikorwa by'imibereho no kukazi. Kubura kumva bishobora kuba igihe gito cyangwa gihoraho. Kubura kumva bijyanye n'imyaka mu busanzwe bigira ingaruka kumatwi yombi kandi biterwa no gutakaza umusatsi wa cochlear. Mu bantu bamwe, cyane cyane abantu bakuze, kutumva bishobora kuvamo irungu.
Indwara yo kutumva ishobora guterwa n'impamvu nyinshi, zirimo: genetika, gusaza, guhura n'urusaku, indwara zimwe na zimwe, ingorane zavutse, ihahamuka ry'ugutwi, n'imiti imwe n'imwe cyangwa uburozi. Indwara isanzwe itera kutumva ni indwara zidakira. Indwara zimwe na zimwe mugihe utwite, nka cytomegalovirus, sifilis na rubella, nazo zishobora gutera umwana kutumva. Gutakaza kumva birasuzumwa mugihe ibizamini byo kumva bisanga umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva décibel 25 byibura ugutwi. Kwipimisha kutumva neza birasabwa kubana bavutse bose. Kubura kumva bishobora gushyirwa mubice byoroheje (25 kugeza 40 dB), biringaniye (41 kugeza 55 dB), biringaniye bikabije (56 kugeza 70 dB), bikomeye (71 kugeza 90 dB), cyangwa byimbitse (birenze 90 dB). Hariho ubwoko butatu bwingenzi bwo kutumva: gutakaza kwumva, kubura kumva, no kutumva neza.
Hafi ya kimwe cya kabiri cyo kutumva kw'isi yose irashobora kwirindwa hifashishijwe ingamba z'ubuzima rusange. Ibikorwa nk'ibi birimo gukingira, kwita ku gutwita neza, kwirinda urusaku rwinshi, no kwirinda imiti imwe n'imwe. Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku buzima rirasaba ko urubyiruko rugabanya amajwi menshi ndetse no gukoresha amajwi bwite ku isaaha imwe ku munsi mu rwego rwo kugabanya urusaku. Kumenyekanisha hakiri kare no gushyigikirwa ni ngombwa cyane mubana. Kubikoresho byinshi byumva, ururimi rwamarenga, cochlear yatewe hamwe na subtitles ni ingirakamaro. Gusoma iminwa n'ubundi buhanga bwingirakamaro bamwe batezimbere. Kubona ibikoresho byumva, ariko, bigarukira mubice byinshi byisi.
Kugeza mu 2013 kutumva bigira ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri miliyari 1,1 ku rugero runaka. Itera ubumuga ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni 466 (5% by'abatuye isi), n'ubumuga buciriritse kandi bukabije ku bantu miliyoni 124. Mu bafite ubumuga buciriritse kandi bukabije miliyoni 108 baba mu bihugu byinjiza amafaranga make kandi yo hagati. Mu bafite ikibazo cyo kutumva, byatangiye mu bwana miliyoni 65. Abakoresha ururimi rw'amarenga kandi bagize umuco w'abatumva babona ko bafite itandukaniro aho kuba uburwayi. Benshi mu bagize ubumuga w’amatwi barwanya kugerageza gukiza ubumuga bwo kutumva kandi bamwe muri bo muri uyu muryango babona ko hashyizweho cochlear bafite impungenge kuko bafite ubushobozi bwo gukuraho umuco wabo. Ijambo "kutumva" akenshi rifatwa nabi kuko ryibanda kubyo abantu badashobora gukora.

Indwara y'impiswi, nanone yitwa impiswi, ni uburyo bwo kugira byibura amara atatu arekuye, atemba, cyangwa y'amazi buri munsi. Bikunze kumara iminsi mike kandi bishobora kuvamo umwuma kubera kubura amazi. Ibimenyetso byo kubura umwuma akenshi bitangirana no gutakaza uburebure busanzwe bwuruhu nimyitwarire irakaze. Ibi birashobora gutera imbere kugabanuka kwinkari, gutakaza ibara ryuruhu, umuvuduko w'umutima wihuse, no kugabanuka kubyitabira uko bikabije. Intebe zidakabije ariko zidafite amazi kubana bonsa gusa, ariko, ni ibisanzwe.
Impamvu zikunze kugaragara cyane ni kwandura amara bitewe na virusi, bagiteri, cyangwa parasite - indwara izwi kandi nka gastroenteritis. Izi ndwara akenshi ziboneka mu biryo cyangwa amazi byanduye umwanda, cyangwa biturutse ku wundi muntu wanduye. Ubwoko butatu bw'impiswi ni: igihe gito impiswi y'amazi, igihe gito cyo gucibwamo amaraso, hamwe n'impiswi ikomeza (kumara ibyumweru birenga bibiri, bishobora kuba amazi cyangwa amaraso). Igihe gito impiswi y'amazi irashobora guterwa na kolera, nubwo ibi bidasanzwe mubihugu byateye imbere. Niba amaraso ahari, bizwi kandi nka dysentery. Impamvu nyinshi zitandura zirashobora gutera impiswi. Muri byo harimo kutoroherana kwa lactose, syndrome de munda, kutagira celiac gluten sensitivite, indwara ya celiac, indwara zifata amara nka colitis ulcerative colitis, hyperthyroidism, diarrhea aside aside, hamwe n'imiti myinshi. Mubihe byinshi, imico yintebe kugirango yemeze impamvu nyayo ntabwo isabwa.
Indwara y'impiswi irashobora kwirindwa no kunoza isuku, amazi meza yo kunywa, no gukaraba intoki n'isabune. Kwonsa byibuze amezi atandatu no gukingira rotavirus nabyo birasabwa. Igisubizo cyo mu kanwa (ORS) - amazi meza afite umunyu mwinshi hamwe n'isukari - nuburyo bwo guhitamo. Ibinini bya Zinc nabyo birasabwa. Iyi miti bivugwa ko yakijije abana miliyoni 50 mu myaka 25 ishize. Iyo abantu barwaye impiswi birasabwa ko bakomeza kurya ibiryo byiza kandi abana bagakomeza konsa. Niba ubucuruzi bwa ORS butaboneka, ibisubizo byakorewe murugo birashobora gukoreshwa. Kubafite umwuma mwinshi, hashobora gukenerwa amazi yimitsi. Imanza nyinshi; icyakora, irashobora gucungwa neza hamwe na flux kumunwa. Antibiyotike, nubwo idakoreshwa gake, irashobora gusabwa mugihe gito nkabafite impiswi zamaraso hamwe n'umuriro mwinshi, abafite impiswi ikabije nyuma yingendo, nabahinga bagiteri cyangwa parasite zihariye. Loperamide irashobora gufasha kugabanya umubare wamaraso ariko ntibisabwa kubafite uburwayi bukomeye.
Hafi ya 1.7 kugeza 5 miliyari zanduye zimpiswi zibaho buri mwaka. Bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, aho abana bato barwara impiswi ugereranije gatatu mu mwaka. Impfu zose zatewe n'impiswi zigera kuri 1.26 miliyoni muri 2013 - munsi ya 2.58 miliyoni mu 1990. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yari iya kabiri mu mpfu zikunze kwibasira abana bato bari munsi y’imyaka itanu (miliyoni 0,76 cyangwa 11%). Ibice bikunze kurwara impiswi nabyo ni impamvu itera imirire mibi kandi ikaba ikunze kugaragara cyane kubatarengeje imyaka itanu. Ibindi bibazo birebire bishobora kuvamo harimo gukura kudindiza no gutera imbere m'ubwenge.

Kurdistan cyangwa Kurdistan Nini, ni agace kadahagije gasobanuwe mu buryo bwa geo-kulturali muri Aziya y'Uburengerazuba aho Abakurdi bagize igice kinini cy'abaturage kandi umuco, indimi, n'indangamuntu by'Abakurdi byahoze bishingiye ku mateka.

Urukingo rwa Tetanusi, ruzwi kandi ku izina rya tetanus toxoid (TT), ni urukingo rukora rukoreshwa mu gukumira tetanusi. Ikoreshwa ifatanije ninkingo ya diphtheria. Mugihe cyubwana, inshuro eshanu zirasabwa, hamwe na gatandatu yatanzwe mugihe cyubwangavu. Nyuma yinshuro eshatu, hafi ya bose babanje gukingirwa. Ibihugu bimwe bitanga dose esheshatu gusa; mugihe abandi, nka USA, basaba kuzamura buri myaka icumi. Isasu rya booster rishobora gutangwa mugihe cyamasaha 48 yakomeretse kubantu bafite inkingo zitajyanye n'igihe. Ku bantu bafite ibikomere byinshi badakingiwe byuzuye, antitoxine ya tetanusi nayo irashobora gusabwa. Kwemeza ko abagore batwite bagezweho ku bijyanye no gukingira tetanusi muri buri gihe cyo gutwita birashobora gukumira tetanusi y’ababyeyi na babyaye.
Urukingo rufite umutekano cyane, harimo igihe utwite ndetse n'abafite virusi itera SIDA. Umutuku n'ububabare aho batewe inshinge bibaho hagati ya 25% na 85% byabantu. Umuriro, kumva unaniwe, nububabare bwimitsi bworoheje bibaho mubantu batageze ku 10%. Imyitwarire ikabije ya allergique ibaho munsi y'umuntu 100.000.
Inkingo nyinshi zahujwe zirimo urukingo rwa tetanusi, nka DTaP na Tdap, rukubiyemo urukingo rwa diphtheria, tetanusi, na pertussis, na DT na Td, rukubiyemo urukingo rwa diphtheria na tetanusi. DTaP na DT bihabwa abana bari munsi yimyaka irindwi, mugihe Tdap na Td bihabwa abo bafite imyaka irindwi nayirenga. Inyuguti nto d na p bisobanura imbaraga nke zinkingo za diphtheria na pertussis.
Tetanus antiserum yakozwe mu 1890, ingaruka zayo zo kuyirinda zimara ibyumweru bike. Urukingo rwa tetanus toxoid rwakozwe mu 1924, rutangira gukoreshwa ku basirikare mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Imikoreshereze yacyo yatumye igabanuka rya 95% igabanuka rya tetanusi. Ari kurutonde rwumuryango w'ubuzima ku isi urutonde rw'imiti yingenzi. Igiciro cyinshi mugihugu kiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya 0.17 na 0,65 USD kuri dose. Muri Amerika, amasomo y'urukingo rwa tetanusi ari hagati ya 25 na 50 USD.

Furosemide, igurishwa ku izina rya Lasix mu zindi, ni imiti ikoreshwa mu kuvura amazi bitewe no kunanirwa ku umutima, inkovu z'umutima, cyangwa indwara z'impyiko. Irashobora kandi gukoreshwa mukuvura umuvuduko ukabije wamaraso. Irashobora gufatwa no guterwa ku imitsi cyangwa mumunwa. Iyo ifashwe kumunwa, mubisanzwe itangira gukora mugihe cyisaha imwe, mugihe imitsi, itangira gukora muminota itanu.
Ingaruka zisanzwe zirimo kumva urumuri ruhagaze, kuvuza amatwi, no kumva urumuri. Ingaruka zikomeye zishobora kuba zirimo electrolyte idasanzwe, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, no kutumva neza. Kwipimisha amaraso birasabwa buri gihe kubavura. Furosemide ni ubwoko bwa loop diuretic ikora mukugabanya reabsorption ya sodium nimpyiko.
Furosemide yahawe patenti mu 1959 kandi yemererwa gukoreshwa mu 1964. Ari kurutonde rw'umuryango wubuzima ku isi urutonde rwimiti yingenzi. Igiciro cyinshi mugihugu kiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya $ 0.004 na US $ 0.02 kumunsi. Muri Amerika, iraboneka nk'imiti rusange kandi igura amadorari y'Amerika 0.15 kumunsi. Muri 2017, yari imiti ya 17 ikunze kwandikirwa muri Amerika, hamwe na miliyoni zirenga 30 zandikiwe. Ari kurutonde rw’ibiro bishinzwe kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge ku isi kubera impungenge z’uko ishobora guhisha ibiyobyabwenge. Yarakoreshejwe kandi mu mafarashi yo gusiganwa mu kuvura no gukumira amaraso ava mu bihaha.

Meropenem, igurishwa ku izina rya Merrem mu zindi, ni antibiyotike yagutse. ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zitandukanye za bagiteri. Bimwe muribi birimo meningite, kwandura munda, umusonga, na anthrax. Itangwa no gutera inshinge.
Ingaruka zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi, impiswi, impatwe, kubabara umutwe, guhubuka, no kubabara aho batewe inshinge. Ingaruka zikomeye zirimo kwandura Clostridium diffile, gufatwa, hamwe na allergique harimo na anaphylaxis. Abafite allergic kubindi β-lactam antibiotique barashobora kuba allergique kuri meropenem. Gukoresha mugutwita bigaragara ko ari umutekano. Ari mumuryango wa karbapenem yimiti. Ubusanzwe Meropenem itera urupfu rwa bagiteri binyuze mu guhagarika ubushobozi bwabo bwo gukora urukuta. Irwanya cyane gusenyuka na β-lactamase itanga bagiteri.
Meropenem yahawe patenti mu 1983. Byemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Amerika mu 1996. Ari kurutonde rwumuryango wubuzima ku isi urutonde rw'imiti yingenzi. Igiciro cyo kugurisha byinshi mubihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya 3.44 na 20.58 USD kuri garama imwe ya garama guhera muri Mu Bwongereza aya mafaranga agura NHS hafi £ 16 muri 2015.

2025 UCI Road World Championships
Shampiyona y'isi y'amagare yo mu muhanda 2025 (mu Cyongereza: "2025 UCI Road World Championships") yabaye ku nshuro ya 98 y'iri rushanwa ngarukamwaka ritegurwa n'Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry'umukino w'amagare (UCI). Yabereye i Kigali, mu Rwanda, kuva ku ya 21 kugeza ku ya 28 Nzeri 2025, ikaba ari yo ya mbere yabereye muri Afurika.
Hakinwe amarushanwa 13 ku muhanda uzenguruka umujyi wa Kigali, ufatwa nk'umwe mu mihanda igoye kurusha iyindi mu mateka y'iri rushanwa. Tadej Pogačar wo muri Siloveniya yegukanye isiganwa nyamukuru ry'abagabo, naho Magdeleine Vallières wo muri Kanada yegukana iry'abagore.
Muri Nyakanga 2018, UCI yagaragaje ubushake bwo guha bwa mbere igihugu cyo muri Afurika kwakira iri rushanwa. U Rwanda, binyuze mu ishyirahamwe ryarwo ry'amagare (FERWACY), rwasabye kuryakira i Kigali, ruhatana n'umujyi wa Tangier wo muri Maroke. Muri Nzeri 2021, UCI yemeje ku mugaragaro ko Kigali ari yo izakira Shampiyona y'isi ya 2025. U Rwanda rwari rusanzwe rutegura buri mwaka Tour du Rwanda, rimwe mu masiganwa akomeye ya UCI Africa Tour.
Ni ubwa mbere amarushanwa y'abagore batarengeje imyaka 23 yabaye ukwayo; mbere yaho, uwatsindaga muri iki cyiciro yabaga ari uwitwaye neza mu batarengeje imyaka 23 mu isiganwa ry'abagore bakuru.
Inzira y'amasiganwa yatangajwe muri Nzeri 2024, mu gihe cya Shampiyona y'isi yabereye i Zurich. Amasiganwa yo mu muhanda yakiniwe ku ruziga rw'ibilometero 15,1 ruzenguruka Kigali, rutangirira kandi rukarangirira kuri Kigali Convention Centre. Isiganwa ry'abagabo bakuru ryongerewemo agace k'ibilometero 42,5 kazamuka "Mur de Kigali". Kubera ko Kigali iri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1.850 kandi inzira ikaba yari ifite imisozi myinshi (metero zisaga 5.000 zo kuzamuka ku isiganwa ry'abagabo), ibinyamakuru by'umukino w'amagare byayise imwe mu nzira zigoye kurusha izindi mu mateka ya Shampiyona y'isi.
Amarushanwa 13 yari agizwe n'amasiganwa 6 yo mu muhanda, amasiganwa 6 yo gusiganwa n'igihe ku muntu ku giti cye, n'isiganwa rimwe ry'amakipe avanze (abagabo n'abagore).
Amasaha yose ni ay'i Kigali (UTC+02:00).
Mu gusiganwa n'igihe, Umubiligi Remco Evenepoel yegukanye umudari wa zahabu ku nshuro ya gatatu yikurikiranya, naho Umusuwisi Marlen Reusser yegukana uw'abagore. Ku ya 27 Nzeri, Magdeleine Vallières yabaye Umunyakanada wa mbere wegukanye isiganwa ry'abakuru muri Shampiyona y'isi y'amagare yo mu muhanda. Bukeye bwaho, Tadej Pogačar yisubiza umwambaro w'umukororombya w'umutsinzi.

Goerke yitabiriye imikino irindwi yose yo gusiganwa ku magare mu mikino Olempike yo mu 1904 yabereye i Missouri kandi yegukana ifeza mu kwiruka ibirometero 3.21.

Sol Solange afite imyaka 24, yiga Public Health muri Mount Kigali University. Akunda gusangiza abantu uduce duto tw’ubuzima bwe binyuze mu mafoto n’amavidewo ashyira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ze
yitabiriye umunsi w’ibirori bidasanzwe Perezida Kagame yakiriyemo abayobozi n’abandi batumirwa na we arimo
Buri mpera z’umwaka Perezida Kagame na Madamu Jeannette Kagame bakira abayobozi batandukanye n’abandi batumirwa bari mu byiciro bitandukanye bigize ubuzima bw’igihugu.

Sol Solange yagarutse ku buryo nubwo haciyeho iminsi kugeza n’ubu atariyumvisha ko byabaye avuga ko bidasanzwe.
Mu kiganiro InyaRwanda yagiranye na Sol Solange yagize ati " Ubutumire nabubonye nari nagiye gusura Nyungwe, ntakubeshye ntabwo nabyizeye na nyuma yaho ndi umuntu wakomeje kubyibazaho cyane."
Sol Solange avuga ko atiyumvisha uko byagenze ati "Nkibubona sinabyemeye naribazaga ngo gute se? Njyewe se ndi nde? Numvaga ari ibintu bidasanzwe bidashoboka? Njyewe ntabwo nari nakabyizeye kugera no ku munsi wa nyawo."
Uyu mukobwa agaruka ku buryo uwo munsi yiteguye kare nubwo igikorwa nyirizinza cyari gitegerejwe mu masaha y’umugoroba ati "Njyewe saa cyenda nari narangije kwitegura hari ukuntu nyine umuntu aba afite mu turemangingo akantu ko gushya njyewe rwose nari narangije kwitegura."
Agaruka ku buryo yigiriye inama yo kutaryama ngo adacikanwa ati "Imvura igitangira kugwa naravuze nti uwaba ryamye ariko ndavuga ngo ndamutse ngiye kuryama sinkanguke amasaha akagenda, nageze no mu buriri ariko ngeze aho ndabyuka nshyiramo."
Sol Solange yasoreje icyiciro cya Kabiri cya Kaminuza muri Nursing muri Mount Kenya ari naho ubu ari kwiga icyiciro cya Gatatu muri Public Health.
Uyu mukobwa kandi yanakuze akunda itangazamakuru nyuma ariko yo kugerageza kenshi mu binyamakuru bitandukanye ntibamuhe amahirwe yo kuba yabikora, yatangiye kubikora mu buryo bwo kubara inkuru arangira abantu ahantu hatandukanye.

ar renting, or car hire, is the process of temporarily leasing an automobile from a rental agency for a set period, offering flexibility, convenience, and the freedom to explore on your own terms. To rent a car, you typically need a valid driver's license, a credit card for payment, and a passport or ID. The process involves choosing a suitable vehicle, inspecting it upon pickup, reviewing and signing a rental agreement that outlines terms and conditions, and ensuring it includes comprehensive insurance and 24/7 support.

Afatanije na bagenzi be bashyizeho urubuga rwitwa " vugafrica.rw" rugamije gufasha abanditsi ba filime mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange kubahuza n’abaguzi no gucuruza inkuru zabo, bikabafasha kwiteza imbere.
Aaron ni umunyamakuru, umusangiza nkuru, ndetse n’umuyobozi w’ibirori uzwi cyane kubera ubuyobozi mu mishinga y’ubugeni n’umuco. Ni umwe mu bashinze Mashariki African Film Festival ndetse yigeze no kuyobora ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibirori bya Set Film Festival. Mu bikorwa bye bifite uruhare, Aaron yayoboye amarushanwa ya National Street Dance Competition, inshingano yagiye akora yitanga, bitewe n’urukundo afitiye gufasha urubyiruko kugaragaza impano zabo mu mbyino, filime, umuziki n’izindi nzira z’ubuhanzi.
Nk’umwe mu barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ubuzima bwa Aaron bwaranzwe no gukomera ku ntego no kugira uruhare mu kubaka igihugu. Ukwemera kwe mu mahoro n’ubumwe si amagambo gusa, ahubwo kugaragarira mu bikorwa bye by’ubuhanzi no guhindura imibereho y’abaturage binyuze mu nkuru z’ukuri.
Ku bwa Aaron, gusobanura inkuru si umwuga gusa ni uburyo bwo gukiza ibikomere, kwibuka, no kurinda umuco. Umwuga we wose ushingiye ku kwemera ko ubuhanzi ari kimwe mu bikoresho bifite imbaraga cyane mu kubaka amahoro n’ubumwe.

Kanyombya ni umukinnyi wa filimi nyarwanda amazina ye bwite ubusaznwe yitwa Kayitankore Ndjoli, yavutse 1962 avukira mu gihugu cya Repubulika iharanira Demokalasi ya Congo (RDC) mu mugi wa Goma. Amaze imyaka irenga 20 muri cinema nyarwanda.
Kanyomba yize amashuri abanza mu gihugu cya kongo i Goma ku mashuri rabanza yitiriwe mutagatifu Andereya, nyuma aza gukomereza amasomo mu ishuri ryisumbuye muri Tuungane, ari naho yagarukiye akajya mu gisirikare.
Kanyombya ni umunyarwenya, yatangiye gukina urwenya mu mwaka wa 2002,cinema ze nyinshi zibanda kurwenya, arbyyo byatumye atangira kugaragara ku ma television atandukanye yo mu Gihugu,yakinnye muri filimi zitandukanye hari harimo n'iziheruka gusohoka muminsi yashize nk'iyitwa "Kwivuko Series."
Uyu mukinnyi yagiye afasha bagenzi be kumenyekana no kuzamura impano zabo kandi yashyizeho gahunda yari igamije gufasha abakizamuka muri cinema.
Kanyombya atuye i Gikondo mu mugi wa Kigali,Ni umugabo ufite umugore,abana ndetse n'abuzukuru. avuka mu muryango w'abana barindwi (7), se umubyara yitwa Jean Batiste Sakumi na nyina Mukandutiye Gaudence. Yabaye mu ngabo z'igihugu z'u Rwanda,yinjiye mu gisirikare mu mwaka wa 1992 akimaramo imyaka 10, yabarizwaga muri Batayo ya Charlie Mobile,akaba ariho yahuriye n'impanuka yo gukuka amenyo.

Icyasha ni filme nto cyangwa filme ngufi (short, drama family film) yakozwe 2018 ikozwe na Marie Clementine Dusabejambo, ikaba ifite iminota 16 gusa, akaba ari filme yerekanwe muri festival zitandukanye harimo na The Panafrican Film and Television Festival of Ouagadougou (Fespaco 2019)
Film nto "Icyasha" ni inkuru mpimbano ibabaje igaruka ku nkuru y'umuhungu muto w'imyaka 12 washakaga kujya akina n'abandi bahungu baturanye umupira w'amaguru ariko aho kumwakira nk'umwana mugenzi wabo bakajya bamunnyuzura bamwita amazina amusebya nka cyabakobwa biza kurangira yiyahuye, ni film ngufi ya 4 muzo Marie Clementine yakoze akoreye muri production house IYUGI Production ndetse Iyi filime ye ‘Icyasha’ kuva yayikora 2018 yitabiriye amaserukiramuco atandukanye, yari iri mu zahataniye ibihembo bya Baobab Awards in Film Africa 2018 bitangirwa mu Bwongereza, mu ntangiro z'umwaka wa 2019 yari ihatanye muri FESPACO na Rencontres du Film Court 2019 yabereye muri Madagascar.
Icyasha mu yandi mazina yiswe ni "Etiquette" ni film ngufi y'iminota 16 igaruka ku buzima bw'umwana w'umuhungu Emmanuel Mugisha wakinnye yitwa Fils afite imyaka 12, aho yabonaga abandi bana bangana barakoze ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru mu gace k'iwabo bari batuyemo yifuza kujya akina nabo, ariko abo bana bandi bangana bakajya bamufata nabi bamunnyuzura bamuhimba amazina nka cyabakobwa bamwangira kujya mu ikipe yabo, ariko ntibyamuca intege kwikubitiro abifashjwemo na nyina wakinnye ari Vivine Uwamariye yiyemeza kubereka ko nawe ari umuhungu nkabo ibyo bashoboye abishoboye, ariko inkuru irangira umwana yiyahuye mu kagezi ko hafi y'iwabo baza kubona umurambo we nyuma.
Ni inkuru ibabaje yigisha abantu ndetse yerekana ubuzima bugoye abana bacamo iyo bahura n'ikibazo cy'ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, imiterere cyangwa imyitwarire ko birangira bibaviriyemo ingaruka atari nziza mu mikurire yabo.
Film nto "Icyasha" mu yandi mazina izwi nka "Etiquette" yanditswe ndetse iyoborwa na Marie Clementine Dusabejambo afatanyije n'inzu zitunganya film hano mu rwanda arizo Samcity Film House ihagagariwe Marie Epiphanie UWAYEZU ndetse na IYUGI Production ihagarariwe na Didacienne NIBAGWIRE
ni Film ngufi mpimbano (fiction short film) yakozwe mu mwaka 2018, ifite iminota 16, ikaba ari iya 4 ikozwe na Director Marie Clementine Dusabejambo, iyi film kandi ikaba yaragize abafatanyabikorwa (producers) ba 5 aribo Natacha MUZIRAMAKENGA, Malik Shaffy RIZINDE, Didacienne NIBAGWIRE, Richard MUGWANEZA, Marie Clémentine DUSABEJAMBO.
Amashusho y'iyi film yafashwe na Wael Gozly, Amajwi yayo afatwa na Jean Bosco NSHIMIYIMANA afatanije na Eugene Safari ihuzamashusho (editing) bikorwa na Wail Gzoly (Wael Gozly) afatanije na Richard Mugwaneza mu gihe itara (lighting) yakozwe na Jean Luc NSENGIYUMVA noneho imiyoborere ya production yose kuri set (production director) bikorwa na Liliane (Ella) MUTUYIMANA afatanije na Ciru NJOROGE na Mudjahida RIZINDE.
Ibikorwa bya nyuma (Post Production) bikorwa na AJAB PICTURE. Mu gihe amashusho yayo yose yafatiwe mu gace kamwe ko mu Rwanda.
Nyuma y'uko Marie Clementine Dasabejambo nyiru filme Icyasha, amaze kuba ikirangirire mu gukora film nto zikitabira amaserukiramuco atandukanye, agakora iyi ye ya 4 byamuhesheje ikuzo kubera amaserukiramuco atandukanye yitabiriye arimo Rotterdam International Film Festival, the Göteborg Film Festival na the Film Festival yabereye muri Afurika, Aziya n’indi migabane. Ndetse ni filme iri mu zahataniye ibihembo bya Baobab Awards in Film Africa 2018 bitangirwa mu Bwongereza, mu ntangiro za 2019 yahatanye muri FESPACO na Rencontres du Film Court 2019 yabereye muri Madagascar. Festival International des Films des Femmes de Cotonou 2019 iserukiramuco rihuza abagore baba mu mwuga wa sinema ryayitoranyije nka filme igenda ihagarariye u rwanda muri iri serukiramuco, gusa nubwo yitabiriye Amaserukiramuco menshi nta gihembo iregukana.

BUJYACYERA Jean Paul, uzwi nka Gutermann Guter, yavutse kuwa 27 ukuboza 1989. Avukira mu Rwanda, intara y'iburasirazuba, akarere ka Gatsibo, umurenge wa Ngarama, akagali ka Karambi. Mwene BARIGIRA Gilbert na UWIMANA Felecite, Avuka mu muryango w'abana batanu babakobwa babiri n'abahungu batatu.
"Imikurire n' Imyigire".
Amashuri abanza yayize kuri EP ADEPR NGARAMA kuva mu 1997 kugeza 2003 akomereza ayisumbuye ikiciro rusange kuri ES APEM NGARAMA. Asoreza GS BUSHYANGUHE mu mwaka wa 2007 ahava ajya gukomereza ikiciro kisumbye ku kigo cya SAINT ALOYZ RWAMAGANA aho yize amateka, ubumenyi bw'isi n'icungamutungo bizwi nka (HEG).
Yakomereje muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda ishami rya Huye aho yize itangazamakuru, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza, akomereza muri MOUNT KENYA ahakura impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu itangazamakuru.
Yakuriye mu buzima bugoranye aho yize amashuri ye abanza ndetse nayisumbuye bigoranye cyane ariko arahatana ku buryo bushoboka ayarangiza afite amanota meza ari byo byatumye agira amahirwe yo gukomereza muri kaminuza.

Agendeye ku buzima butari bworoshye yakuriyemo, yaje gushinga umuryango (organization) udaharanira inyungu witwa NUFASHWA YAFASHA ORGANIZATION (NYO) mu mwaka wa 2014. Uwo muryangowashinzwe ufite intego yo gufasha abana bo mu miryango itishoboye n'abana bafite ubumuga kubona uburere bwiza bukwiriye umwana w'umunyarwanda. Aho abo bana bafashwa kubona ibikoresho by'ishuri, amafaranga yishuri n'ibindi bikenerwa byibanze kugira ngo bagire ireme 'ry'uburezi riri ku rugero rukwiriye.
Uwo muryango ufasha kandi ababyeyi babo bana kubona amahirwe yo kongerera ubushobozi ubukungu kubagore cyane cyane n'abakobwa. Uyu muryango utanga amahugurwa mu bikorwa by'ubukorikori bwinjiza amafaranga, birimo nko, kudoda, kuboha ibiseke, no gutunganya imisatsi
Nyuma mu mwaka wa 2021 yaje gushinga ikigo cy'amashuri akitirira uwo muryango. Kugeza ubu hari amashuri y'incuke n'abanza biteganyijwe ko uko iminsi izagenda ishira bizaguka bakagira n'amashuri yisumbuye

Akora ibibumbano akoresheje ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo isemeti, ibyuma n’inkwi, byose abikoresha mu buryo butuma ibihangano bye bigira ishusho itangaje kandi nyayo. Karekezi ni umwe mubahanzi ba film bemera ko ari ngobwa ko tubungabunga amateka ya Genocide yakorewe abatutsi 1994 bumuryo bwa filimi.
Hari aho usanga imiryango n’abaturage barishwe bose, nta n’umwe usigaye wo kuvuga amateka y’ibyabaye. Ahandi ho, abayirokotse basigaye bafite ibikomere n’ihungabana rikomeye.
Mu gihe u Rwanda rwitegura kwibuka imyaka 30 ishize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ihitanye abantu barenga miliyoni, ikibazo cy’uko amateka ya Jenoside atanditswe neza ni kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye abahanga mu by’amateka n’abashinzwe kubika amateka bahanganye na cyo, benshi bakaba banabishyira ku ruhande rw’abashaka guhakana Jenoside.
Mu gihe Leta yagize uruhare mu kubungabunga amateka binyuze mu rwibutso n’amanyarwanda y’ibyaha bya Jenoside, ni abacitse ku icumu bake cyane babashije kuvuga amateka yabo, haba mu bitabo cyangwa muri filimi.

Kigali cine junction urubyiruko mwiterambere rya sinema mu rwanda
Itangiriro: Kigali cine function ni serukira muco ngarukamaka rya sinema mpuzamahanga ribera murwanda ritegurwa nikigo gitunganya filime murwanda kuva 2023. uretse kwerekana filimi iki kigo kigamije kuhuza abazikora kubatezimbere no no gushikikariza abanyarwanda muri rusange umuco wa sinema. no guhuza abanyempano ba sinema mu rwanda nisi yose itandukaniro nandi ma serukiramuco ya sinema kwisi kigali cine junction ntago itegura amarushwa ya filimi ahubwo ishirimbere kwerekana filimi nziza guha agaciro umwanya wokuganira no kungurana ibitekerezo bana tegura amahugurwa menchi atandukanye ajyanye na filimi na sinema muri rusange.
sinema nkiraro gihuza abantu.
abategura iriserukiramuco itengo yabo nyamukuru nuguhindura kigali umurwamukuru wa sinema muri afurika umugi uhuza abakora filimi nabakunzi bazo bagahura bakaganira bakungurana ibitekerezo muburyo bwo kugeza imbere ubuhanzi bwa sinema.abategura iri serukira muco bemeza badashidikanya ko sinema aruburyo bwiza bwo kubungabunga biriho, gusigasira ibyagezweho ndetse no gutekereza ahazaza. bizera nanone ko sinema ifite uruhari runini mu kubaka ubumwe mubantu niyo mpamvu iriserukiramucyo naryo ryerekeranira filimi ahuntu hahurira abantu benchi nko mumbuga ya car free zone cyangwa mumihanda (nyamirambo) intego niyo kwegereza filimi rubanda nyamwinchi cyane ko filimi zanagira umumaro wubukangurambaga no gushishikariza bantu kwanga ikibi bagakora icyiza (morality).
Kigali cine juction 2025 yagaragayemo ibiganiro byinchi byahuzagaga abakora filimi inzu zikora ziganacuruza filimi murwanda nka izacu entertainment ibiganiro byari bigamije kurebera hamwe iterambere ya sinema nabakora muruganda rwa sinema muri rusange.

Abakinnyi ba filime bakomeye mu Rwanda, barimo Rukundo Arnold wamamaye muri sinema nka Shaffy, bagaragara muri filime “The Dream”, igaragaramo umukobwa wakunze umuhungu, akanga kumuvaho nyamara umuhungu atakimushaka.

Mugwaneza watangiye Sinema mu 2012 yanyuze muri filime zitandukanye zirimo ‘Amarira y’Urukundo’, ‘Inzozi Mbi’ na ‘Isi Ntisakaye’
Rukundo Arnold wamamaye muri sinema y’u Rwanda nka Shaffy, we yayishoyemo imari bamwe bazwi nka ‘Producer’.

Iyi filime y’uruhererekane ifite inkuru ivuga ku mugabo washatse umugore afite undi mwana, ahageze wa mugore abyara undi mwana utari uw’uwo mugabo bashakanye.
Uwo mugabo wari umukire, yaje kwitaba Imana, asiga araze imitungo ye umwana wa mbere. Nyuma yo gupfa, hatangiye intambara hagati y’abana na nyina washakaga kwigarurira iyo mitungo yose.
Iyi filime yanditswe inayoborwa n’umusore witwa Mugwaneza Abdul ‘Cobby’. Uyu mugabo watangiye Sinema mu mwaka wa 2012, yagize uruhare muri filime zitandukanye zirimo ‘Amarira y’urukundo’, ‘Inzozi mbi’, ‘Isi Ntisakaye’ n’izindi.

Ni filime nyarwanda ifite ibice bifite ubutumwa butandukanye, kimwe kimwe gifite uburebure burenga isaha.
Muri make ntabwo ari uruhererekane rwa filimi nk’inyinshi zikinwa muri iki gihe inyuzwa ku rubuga rwa YouTube. Ifite umwihariko wo kuba ifite izina rimwe, ariko abayiteguye bakaba bagenda bakinamo ubutumwa bashaka gutambutsa mu gice kimara isaha irenga, ikindi gikurikiraho kikaza gitandukanye n’icyari cyabanje.
Iyi filime yateguwe na Nkusi Queen [La Queen] usanzwe ari murumuna wa Nkusi Lynda umaze kumenyekana mu ruganda rw’imyidagaduro kuva ubwo yitabiraga Miss Rwanda.

Dusenge Clenia wamenyekanye nka Madedeli muri sinema y’u Rwanda, atangiye gusohora filime ye bwite y’uruhererekane yise ‘Inkomoko’. Amaze gushyira hanze uduce twinshi tw’iyi filime.
Ni filime igaragaramo abandi bakinnyi bafite amazina akomeye muri sinema nyarwanda nka Emmanuel Rugaba na Kakuze Cecile.
Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Madedeli mu minsi yashize ubwo yatangiraga kuyishyira hanze, yavuze ko yari amaze iminsi mu myiteguro yo gukora filime ye bwite. Ati “Uyu ni umushinga wagutse ugizwe na filime y’uruhererekane ifite inkuru zivuga ku nkomoko y’ibibazo benshi bakunda guhura nabyo mu buzima bwa buri munsi.”
Madedeli ahamya ko iyi filime izagaragaza ingeri zitandukanye z’ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw’abantu, hibandwa ku bibazo biba mu miryango.
Uretse Papa Sava yamamayemo, Madedeli yanamenyekanye muri filime nka ‘Indoto’, ‘Kaliza wa kalisa’ na ‘The Bishop’s Family’.

Axmann, yagabye igitero ahobazajya bategera Gariyamoshi hagamijwe kwaka amafaranga y'uburinzi muri sosiyete ya gariyamoshi. Bud na Lou bagezeyo baribeshya ko ari intasi za sosiyete, maze Sheik na Axmann bohereza abarabu batatu bateye ubwoba basa nabarabu bashaka kubica. Kubera ko buri kigeragezo cyatsinzwe, urwango rw'abicanyi kuri Bud na Lou rugenda rwiyongera, cyane cyane iyo Lou atabishaka abishaka Sheik ku bakobwa batandatu b'abacakara, umwe muri bo, Nicole, mu by'ukuri akaba ari intasi y'Abafaransa yashinzwe kwinjira mu nkambi ya Sheik, bityo akaba yarifuzaga ko Sheik yatsindira cyamunara. Abahungu bahise birukanwa, gusa bahita bihisha ku cyicaro gikuru cya Legio y’amahanga, aho Axmann abashuka ngo biyandikishe muri Legio, umuhango wo kurahira ukaba uri mu gifaransa.
Inshingano zabo zambere zar'imyitozo ya bayonet mubutayu. Komanda wa Legio arakeka ko muri Legio harimo umuhemu, kubera ko Sheik ateganya neza buri kimwe mu bikorwa bya Legio (rwihishwa binyuze muri Axmann). Komanda yahise aha Bud na Lou pasiporo m'umujyi aho bavumbuye ubufatanye bwa Axmann nabarabu mbere yo guhura na Nicole. Arabamenyesha ko bagomba gusaka icyumba cya Axmann kugira ngo bagaragaze kwar'umuhemu, ariko akabafata mur'icyo gikorwa cyitararangira. Ariko, baratorotse, bahungira mu nkambi ya Legionnaire. Lou atangira kubona mirage, harimo ice cream soda ihagaze hamwe nu mucuruzi w'ikinyamakuru. Iyo Bud abonye oasisi nyayo Lou yibwira ko ari indi mirage.
Bahavuye barafatwa, hamwe na Nicole, ushyirwa muri harem ya Sheik Hamud. Algiers ni filime y’ikinamico yo muri Amerika yakinwe mu mwaka wi 1938 iyobowe na John Cromwell, yanditswe na John Howard Lawson ikinwamo na Charles Boyer, Sigrid Gurie na Hedy Lamarr. intego yayo yavugaga kum'umujura wihishe muri Algiers ahura na nukerarugendo mwiza womubufaransa. Igicuruzwa cya Walter Wanger (cyatanzwe mbere n’abahanzi bunze ubumwe) cyasubiwemo filime nziza yo mu 1937 y’Abafaransa "Pépé le Moko", yakuye umugambi wayo mu gitabo cya Henri La Barthe cyitwa izina rimwe.
"Algiers" yabaye sensation kuko aribwo bwa mbere Lamarr ya Hollywood. Iyi filime izwi cyane nk'isoko yo gutera inkunga abanditsi ba firime ya 1942 Warner Bros. "Casablanca", yanditse film nyuma akizirikana Lamarr n'umugore we wambere. Boyer yerekana Pepe le Moko iterwa imbaraga Warner Bros muburyo bwa animasiyo Pepé Le Pew. Mu 1966, iyi filime yasohocyeye muri Amerika kubera ko abayireze batigeze bongera kwiyandikisha ku burenganzira bwabo mu mwaka wa 28 nyuma yo kujyahanze
Pepe le Moko ni umujura uzwi cyane wahunze Ubufaransa akaba atuye i Casbah, cyangwa mugace ka Alijeriya imyaka ibiri. Komiseri Janvier, umupolisi w’Ubufaransa, yiyemeje gufata Pepe. Umunsi umwe nijoro, Janvier ayobora igitero kuri Casbah, aho Regis, umujura ugirira ishyari Pepe, ayobora abapolisi kuri Grandpere. Regis yagiye kwa Ines, nyirabuja wa Pepe, kugira ngo amuburire ko abapolisi bahageze. Ines ageze kwa Grandpere kuburira Pepe, ubwo yakekaga ko Regis yabibwiye abapolisi. Abapolisi bahageze, Pepe yihisha munsi muriyo nyubako kugeza igihe amasasu arangiriye. Pepe aratoroka nubwoyari yakomeretse.
Mu gihe cyo kurasa, umugenzuzi Slimane, ushinzwe iperereza muri Alijeriya, azana Gaby, umukerarugendo womubufaransa, warutuye aho Pepe nawe ageze aho ku gihe Slimane ashimira Pepe, abwira Gaby ko yanditse itariki Pepe yafatiwe kurukuta rwe. Bukeye, Regis abonana n’umugenzuzi mukuru Louvain maze ategura umugambi wo gufata inshuti ya Pepe Pierrot, yizeye gufata Pepe. Regis ashyikiriza Pierrot ibaruwa, bivugwa ko yanditswe na nyina, avuga ko arwaye. Hanyuma, Gaby yagiye atekereza kuri Pepe, nubwo yasezeranye n'umukunzi we Giraux. Mugihe arimo kurya, Slimane abwira Gaby ibijyanye nogushimira Pepe imitako, amaze iminsi ategura ko azongera kubona Pepe.
Hanyuma muriryojoro, Pepe amenyeshwa ko Pierrot yavuye muri Alijeriya. Pepe ageze i Casbah, abaza Regis kubyerekeye ibura ya Pierrot. Hanyuma Regis abira ibyuya Pepe yongeye guhura na Gaby i Casbah, aho bahuriraga mugihe cyabo bari mubufaransa. Nuko Gaby basezerana kuzabonana bukeye Pierrot yakomeretse arahagera, ashaka kwica Regis. Pierrot yikubita hasi agerageza kurasa Regis, hanyuma yicwa na Carlos, umwe mu nshuti za Pepe.
Bukeye, umuhango wo gushyingura Pierrot ubera hanze ya Casbah, birakaza Pepe bimutera agahinda Pepe yashakaga kwujya gushyingura Pepe ashaka kujyayo ariko Ines aramubuza kuberako Gaby yari amutegereje iwe. Pepe yagiye ahwatuye, nubwo yabeshye, ashimira Ines kuba yaramubujije kwugwa mumutego. Gaby arahagera bacyirikumwe, Pepe agaragaza akababaro kuko atashoboraga narimwe guhunga Casbah. Mbereyuko Gaby agenda, bemeranya guhurira muri hoteri ye bukeye. Hanyuma Slimane abwira Giraux ko Gaby yirigeze kubona Pepe. Iyo ibyo binaniwe, Slimane abeshya Gaby, avuga ko Pepe yishwe.
Mbereyuko Pepe ajya kureba Gaby muri hoteri ye yabanje kwigira kumugabo witwa L'Arbi ko Gaby na Giraux bahunga bakava muri Alijeriya bakoresheje ubwato kumugoroba nyuma ya saa sita yirengagiza ibyo Ines yariyamubwiye, Pepe ava i Casbah agura itike yo kugenda. Pepe ari mu bwato abona Gaby, afatwa na Slimane n'abashinzwe iperereza. Pepe yihutira kwerekeza ku bwato ahamagara Gaby, ariko ntiyamubona. Umwe mu bagabo ba Slimane yarashe Pepe maze Slimane atwika umubiri we, asaba imbabazi kuva uyu mugabo yizeraga ko Pepe yashakaga gutoroka. Pepe aramusubiza ati: "Nanjye rero mfite, nshuti yanjye."
Walter Wanger, yatunganyije iyi filime, yaguze uburenganzira kuri filime y’Abafaransa "Pepe le Moko", yakinanye na Jean Gabin, mu rwego rwo kuyisubiramo, maze agura ibyapa byose bya filime kugira ngo birinde guhatana na filime ye muri Amerika Wanger yakoresheje imiziki myinshi yo muri filime y’Abafaransa muri remake ndetse no mu bihe byakurikiranye.

Buji muri Alijeriya ni filime y'imirwano yabongereza yakozwe mu 1944 ihagarariwena George King abakinnyi bari James Mason, Carla Lehmann na Raymond Lovell. Iyifilime ivuga kunama y'ibanga yabaye mu Kwakira 1942 ibera i Cherchell, muri Alijeriya hagati ya jenerali w'umunyamerika Mark W. Clark n'itsinda ry'abayobozi bakuru bo mu Bufaransa Vichy. Muri iyo nama, abayobozi ba Vichy b'Abafaransa bemeye kutarwanya indege ya Operation Torch i Vichy mu Bufaransa -kugenzura Afurika y’amajyaruguru y’Ubufaransa yabaye nyuma yukwezi kumwe.
Mumwaka wi 1943, mbere y’uko Abanyamerika bagaba ibitero kuri Afurika y’amajyaruguru, Alijeriya yari ifiteguverinoma ya Vichy ndetse n’icyicaro gikuru cya komisiyo ishinzwe ibirwanisho mu Budage. Inshingano y'ibanga ya Jenerali Mark Clark ni ingenzi cyane mu gutuma inama ihuza Abongereza, Abanyamerika, n'Abafaransa, itanga inzira yo kugwa mu gisirikare gikomeye ku ntsinzi y’Ubumwe nta gutakaza ubuzima bukabije
Mugihe Abanyamuryango baribishimiye intsinzi, Susan Foster, yarafite ikibazo cyo guhungabana yagize mugisasu, akangukira mubitaro kandi ahangayikishijwe n'ibyabereye kuri Alan Thurston, atinya ko yapfuye. Abajije umuforomo aho aherereye kandi amenyeshwa intsinzi, avuga ko Thurston ashimirwa cyane kuba yarashoboye gutsinda kandi akavuga uburyo Thurston yagize uruhare mu butumwa bwe.
Muri flashback, mbereyinama, umukoziw’Ubwongereza Alan Thurston yahawe inshingano zo kujya muri Algiers kugarura kamera irim'amafoto yerekanaho inam'izabera. Thurston ntiyigeze amenya ibyiyonama cyangwa ibyihishe murayomashusho arikohamabwiriza yokubuza kamera kugera ku Badage. Afite igicucu cya maneko w’Ubudage Dr. Müller, ufite umugambi wo kwiba kamera akimara kuyibona.
Thurston yatawe muri yombi n’Abafaransa Vichy afatwa mpiri n’Abadage mugihome ariko arabacika. Akurikiranwa n'Abadage, ahungira mu nzu Susan Foster, umunyabugeni w’umunyamerik'utuye i Biskra, akodesha Susan atekerezako umucengezi arumujura, Susan yamufatiyeho imbunda kugeza igihe Thurston amwibwiye hanyuma amusaba koyamufasha nk'umuntu ukunda igihugu. Mugihabakozi ba Vichy bagishakisha uwatorotse, Susan yahishe Thurston muri cyumbacy'ibanga kugirangoyirinde gushakisha imitungo. Muganga Müller yasanze ibimenyetso bya Thurston birimu kirahure cy’amata n’itabi kandi aburira Susan kwirinda kwishoramuri politiki. Susan amwizezako azagenda bukeye yerekezamuri Algiers. munzira asubira mur'Amerika. Abashakashatsi bamazekugenda, Thurston aburira Susan ko Müller azakomeza kumukurikirana ariko akamusaba ko yamufasha mukugarura kamera yari yihishe umukozi wapfuye mu biro mu rugo rw’umukunzi w’umukozi, umuririmbyi w’ijoro rya Maritza, utazi akamaro kayo. Akeneye Susan udashaka gukunda igihugu cya tepid gukunda igihugu, amwemeza ko azakora ubutumwa nkibyingenzi kuruta gahunda ye yuzuye yo kwinjira muri WAC.

Iserukiramuco rya Filime nyafurika, Inc. Uyumuryango ufiticyicaro mumujyi wa New York, washinzwe mu 1990. Uyu muryango wiyemeje gutezimbere nokurushaho kumenyekanisha umuco w’Afurika binyuze murifirime.
AFF yashinzwe mu 1990, na Mahen Bonetti na komite idasanzwe y'abahanzi n'intiti zomuri Afurika n'Abanyamerika. Gahundaya AFF, iserukiramuco ryafirime muri New York (NYAFF) ryatangiye mu 1993 munsiy’ibendera ry'Iminsi igezweho, nijoro rya kera". Iriserukiramuco ryashyikirijwe hamwe na Sosiyete ya Filime y’ikigo cya Lincoln ifatanyije n’inzu ndangamurage ya Brooklyn. Yerekanaga ibikorwa bya kera birimo na filime nka "Udju Azul di Yonta" ya Flora Gomes, "Yeelen" na Souleymane Cissé, "Kaddu Beykat",Safi Faye na "Badou Boy" wa Djibril Diop Mambéty, n'abandi. Habayeho no gusubira inyuma kurifirime za Ousmane Sembène. Ibirori bikorwa buri mwaka hagati yukwezi kwa Mata na Gicurasi.
Iserukiramuco ngarukamwaka, rifatanyije na Sosiyete ya Filime ya Lincoln Centre, ikubiyemokwerekana amafilime, ibitaramo, ibihangano, ibiganiro nyunguranabitekerezo, ibiganirobyabahanzi, gahunda z'urubyirukozirwigisha, amasomo n'amahugurwa Mu 2004, BAMcinématek ya Brooklyn Academy of Muzika yabayumufatanyabikorwa wa NYAFF. Mumwaka wi 2011, Ishuri rya Sinema rya Maysles ryatangijwe igihecyokwerekan'ibirori no kwerekana AFF yagejeje kubateraniye ahw'Abanyamerika ibikorwa by'abakinnyi bafilime benshibomur'Afurika, barimo Abderrahmane Sissako, Lupita Nyong'o, Tunde Kelani n'abandi. Iri serukiramuco rimara iminsi 8-14 ryerekana burimwaka film zigerakuri 40 zakera. Uyumuryango watangije Urugendorw’igihugu rugizwenafirime ngufi zatoranijwe mw'iserukiramuco yaFilimi zaNew York ziheruka zerekanwe mubigo bikikij' Amerika
AFF ikoragahunday'umwaka n'uburezi bikikij'Umujyi wa New York hamwen’ibigo bikorera mumujyi nka Schomburg Centre y’ubushakashatsi mu muco w’abirabura, Electronic Arts Intermix, AFF ikoranan'iminsi mikuru y'imiryango mpuzamahanga.
Abitabiriye gahundazizwi harimo, nyakwigendera "Se wa Sinema nyafurika", Ousmane Sembène, umwanditsi w'amakinamico, wumusizi akaban'uwahawe igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel, Wole Soyinka, umuhanziwatinze akaba n'umurwanashyaka uharanir'uburenganzira bwamuntu Miriam Makeba n'umuhanzi, umusizi,umukinnyi wa filime, n'umukangurambaga, Harry Belafonte.
Mu 2003, AFF yasohoye anthologiya "Binyuze mumaso ya Afurika: Ibiganiro n’abayobozi", n’aba piyoniya ndetse n’abakinnyib'afilime bakomokamur'Afurika bakizamuka. Mu mwaka wa 2010, AFF yasohoye igitabo cyakabiri kigaragaza incamakeyasinema nyafurika mukinyejana cya 20 na 21 binyuzemunyandiko nokubaz'abayobozi ba'Afurika. Mu mwaka wa 2013, murwego rwokwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 20 iserukiramuco ryaFiliminyafurika ryabereye i New York, AFF yasohoye antologiya y’isabukuru yiswe "Kureba Inyuma, Kureba Imbere: Imyaka 20 Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya New York".

Uyu ni umukino wa filime ishingiye kunkuru wamuritswe ku itariki ya 25 Werurwe 2024 muri Century Cinema i Kigali. Ni kandi Filime yagarutse no ku nkuru y’umukobwa witwa Carine wari umwogoshikazi, wavuye mu rugo yari yashakiyemo umugabo, ariko wamubuzaga kubaho ubuzima yifuza.
Carine rero akaba yarashatse akiri muto, kandi mu ntangiriro yari anyuzwe n’icyo cyemezo, ariko hashize imyaka aza gusanga hari icyuho n’ibura ry’itumanaho mu rugo rwe, bimutera gufata icyemezo cyo kugendera ku nzozi ze wenyine nubwo byari bigoye. Yashoboye gutangira ubucuruzi bwo kogosha no gutunganya imisatsi, maze nyuma yaho ubwo bucuruzi burakomera, bituma ashobora guha abagore bagenzi be imbaraga, ijwi ndetse n’icyizere.
Indirimbo ziri muri iyi filime zirimo iz’abahanzi b’Abanyarwanda nka Mike Kayihura, Peace Jolis na Malaika Uwamahoro.

Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga riba buri mwaka rizwi kw'izina rya Eko (EKOIFF) ni iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime ryabereye i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Eko ryashinzwe kandi ryashinzwe mu 2009 na Hope Obioma Opara, umuyobozi mukuru wa Supple Communications Limited, aho ibirori bibera. Niwe kandi usohora ikinyamakuru Supple, ikinyamakuru cya sinema n’umuco nyafurika kirimo kureba filime, gusubiramo, no kubazwa. Intego y'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Eko ni uguteza imbere ubukerarugendo muri Nijeriya mu guteza imbere gushimira ubuhanzi n'umuco binyuze mu mashusho yerekana amashusho n'ubumenyi.

Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Nollywood (NTFF) ni iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ryahariwe kwerekana sinema yo muri Nijeriya, izwi kandi nka Nollywood, ku bantu bose ku isi. Yashinzwe mu 2017 i Toronto, muri Kanada, herekanwa ibirori byakozwe n’abakora amafilime yo muri Nijeriya ikorera muri Nijeriya ndetse no mu mahanga. Yashinzwe n'umukinnyi wa firime akaba n'umuyobozi wa Paruwasi Mykel, ukomeje kugenzura imikorere yayo.
NTFF ni itsinda ryahariwe kwakira, ibiganiro nyunguranabitekerezo, amahugurwa, ibirori byo guhuza imiyoboro, hamwe n’imihango yo gutanga ibihembo ku bibuga mpuzamahanga bitandukanye, igamije guteza imbere umuco n’ubuhanzi bya Nollywood. Abahawe iki gihembo barimo abakinnyi, nka Omotola Jalade (2017), Richard Mofe-Damijo (2018), Ubutunzi bwa Uche (2024).
Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Nollywood ryashinzwe mu 2017 na Paruwasi ya Mykel, ryashinzwe mu rwego rwo kwagura isi yose ya sinema yo muri Nijeriya mu kwerekana amafilime mu mijyi mpuzamahanga itandukanye no gushishikariza ubufatanye hagati ya Nigeriya n’abakora amafilime mpuzamahanga. Igitabo cyo gutangiza ku mugaragaro cyabaye muri Nzeri 2017 i Toronto, muri Kanada, mu rwego rwo kwerekana ko iri serukiramuco ryatangijwe nk'urubuga rwo kwerekana inkuru zitandukanye za Nollywood ndetse no kwerekana sinema.
Kuva yatangira, ibirori byabereye mu mijyi nka Atlanta, Hamburg, Berlin, Glasgow, Helsinki, Paris, Oslo, Amsterdam, Lima, Ubutaliyani, na Atenayi. Mu mwaka wa 2018, umukinnyi wa filime ukomoka muri Nijeriya akaba n'umunyamideli Chris Okagbue yabaye Ambasaderi w'Iserukiramuco ku mugaragaro, agaragaza ubushake bw'iri serukiramuco ryo kugira uruhare mu bantu bazwi cyane ba Nollywood mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza.
