Detty December ni filimi ivuga ibihe by'iminsi mikuru mu mpera z'umwaka muri Nijeriya ubusanzwe guhera hagati mu Kuboza kugeza mu mwaka mushya. Nigihe cyo kwizihiza no guhuza imbaraga, guterana kwabaturage, ibirori, nibirori birangwa nimbaraga nyinshi, umunezero, nicyizere. Ni igihe Abanyanijeriya benshi, haba mu gihugu ndetse no muri diaspora, basubira mu rugo kwishimana n'umuryango n'inshuti.
Imyitwarire n'imikoreshereze.
Ijambo Detty ni ruswa ndetse akaba ari "umwanda", bisobanura iminsi mikuru no kwizihiza nta nkomyi mugihe cya Noheri nibiruhuko.
Inkomoko y'iryo jambo ntirisobanutse neza. Abantu bamwe bavuga ko ari ibirori byatangiye nyuma ya Carnival ya Calabar yo mu 2004 mu majyepfo y’amajyepfo ya Nijeriya, yiswe "ishyaka rikomeye ry’umuhanda muri Afurika" na Donald Duke wahoze ari guverineri w’intara ya Cross Rivers. Nk’uko ikinyamakuru "BellaNaija" cyo muri Nijeriya na The Guardian kibitangaza ngo iri jambo ryahimbwe kandi ryamamazwa n'umuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya Bwana Eazi, wakoresheje nk'igitutu cy'igitaramo cye i Lagos mu 2016. Bwana Eazi na we yagiye akoresha iryo jambo.
Detty December ni ijambo rikoreshwa cyane nabanyamuryango baba diaspora ya Nigeriya baherutse gutaha. Aba batahutse vuba bakunze kwita IJGBs, amagambo ahinnye ya "Nsubiye inyuma". Banki y'isi ivuga ko amafaranga yoherejwe na diaspora ya Nijeriya muri iki gihe angana na by'umusaruro rusange wa Nijeriya, kandi akerekana imbaraga zikoreshwa mu gihe ababa mu mahanga bagarutse mu rugo.
Mugihe Detty Ukuboza ahanini ifitanye isano nimijyi, benshi mubatahutse nabo bakoresha aya mahirwe yo gusura imidugudu yabo. Ig "​​" Icyakora, ni ngombwa kwerekana ko Detty December ni filimi yibanda cyane cyane ku gusura imijyi yo mu mijyi na diaspora yo muri Nijeriya mu birori nka Rhythm Unplugged,bakaba barayikoreye igitaramo cyatangiye kuva 2004 kigamije kuzamura abahanzi bo muri Nijeriya ndetse n'abahanzi mpuzamahanga. Ibi bitandukanye cyane n’ibibera mu burasirazuba bwa Nijeriya, aho usanga abaturage benshi ba Igbo bakunda kuva mu mijyi myinshi yo mu mijyi. Ahubwo, basubira mu cyaro cyabo kwizihiza nko guhurira mu miryango ndetse n’ibindi birori mu cyaro, bigatuma habaho ubukene bugaragara mu mijyi myinshi yo mu burasirazuba, bitandukanye na kamere yibanda ku mujyi wa Detty Ukuboza uzwi. Lagos, umujyi ufite amateka akomeye ya Owambe hamwe n’inganda zidagadura zitera imbere (kuba ariho habereye imiziki yisi yose Afrobeats) ifatwa nkisura ya Detty December.
Muri iyi filimi kandi ya Detty December, berekanamo habaho ibirori byinshi bitandukanye, uhereye k'umunsi mukuru wamazu, karnival kumuhanda, kumanika ku mucanga kugeza mubitaramo, ubukwe, guterana nijoro, nibindi byinshi., ibitaramo byo mu Kuboza biragaragara cyane nka kimwe mu bintu by'ingenzi, bikurura abahanzi ndetse n’imiryango myinshi ya muzika kwakira ibitaramo muri iki gihe. Ikigaragara ni uko ibi bitaramo bisoza umwaka bitagenewe gusa umuziki uzwi cyane (nka Flytime Fest ubusanzwe ikaba ivuga ku bakinnyi bakomeye ba Afrobeats bo muri Nijeriya nka Burna Boy, Asake, Wizkid, Davido, Olamide, Rema, Ayra Starr); ubucuruzi butandukanye, guverinoma za leta, ndetse n’amashami ya federasiyo nayo atunganya ibitaramo. Iyi myumvire itanga umusaruro mwinshi kubahanzi bo muri Nigeriya, bisa nubunini bwa Super Bowl, nkuko byavuzwe na Davido wamamaye muri Afrobeats. ​ Ubu bukwe akenshi bumara iminsi yose, bukazarangirana nibirori nyuma yibirori.
Urutonde rwibintu byihariye mugihe cyagenwe.
Bimwe mubikorwa byihariye byateguwe muri detty Ukuboza igihe cyagenwe hano hepfo.
Bitewe no gusura igihugu cyangwa se gutaha kw'abanegihugu bazwi kw'izina ryaba diaspora yo muri Nijeriya hamwe n’ivunjisha, guverinoma yishimiye iyinjira n’ingaruka ku bukungu. Ku rundi ruhande, hamwe n’ubutunzi bwerekanwe butandukanye cyane n’ubukungu bwiganje mu babaturage, bamwe mu baturage bahangayikishijwe no gufungwa mu migi yabo kubera ibiciro byiyongereye n’imodoka.

Igihembo cy'umukinnyi nya afurika witwaye neza ni igihembo gitangwa buri mwaka na Afrika Film Academy. Yatanzwe kuva igihembo cya 1 cya Afrika Movie Academy Awards ku mukinnyi watanze umusaruro udasanzwe mu nshingano zikomeye muri film.
Umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bihembo byambere yatanzwe inshuro 21, kubakinnyi 21. Uwatsinze bwa mbere ni Richard Mofe-Damijo kubera uruhare yagaragaje rwe muri "ba Mayors" (2004). Uwatsinze vuba aha akana yarabaye Zolisa Xaluva "kubwami bwa Queenstown" (2024). yanditse kandi agira Amateka kuko yatsindiye byinshi, kuko afite na Richard Mofe-Damijo. Inyandiko zerekana kandidatire nyinshi ni ebyiri, na Damijo.

Kizazi Moto: Fire Fire ni Afrofuturist na Africanfuturist ni filimi Yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 5 Nyakanga 2023, kuri Disney +. Yakinywe muri rusange ikaba ifite ibitekerezo byiza byatanzwe nabayiteguye.
Buri filime ifite icyerekezo nyafurika, uhereye kumuyobozi umwe cyangwa benshi, kumutwe nkimbuga nkoranyambaga, uburinganire, ubumuga, kwigaragaza, ubumuntu busangiye, hamwe nizindi ngingo, hamwe ninkuru zirimo ingendo zigihe, ibinyabuzima byo hanze, hamwe nisi isimburana.
Ku ya 27 Kamena 2021, hatangajwe ko abakinnyi baturutse muri Zimbabwe, Afurika y'Epfo, Uganda, Nijeriya, Kenya, na Misiri bazakora ku bice icumi by'amafirime y'umwimerere ya animasiyo, yitwa "Kizazi Moto: Generation Fire". Peter Ramsey yatorewe kuba producer mukuru, mugihe Tendayi Nyeke na Anthony Silverston bagenzuraga abaproducer, naho Triggerfish niyo studio yambere, hamwe nandi ma studio ya animasiyo muri Afrika. "Guha Sezari" ni igeragezwa, ndetse n’inenge nyinshi, amaherezo ni intambwe nini igana imbere." ​"​" Yagaragaje ko nubwo filime ifite ubusobanuro bwiza, ariko ifite ibihe bikunze kwangizwa n’ibintu bidasanzwe byabaye, guhanura byoroshye cyangwa ibishushanyo bisekeje. Yongeyeho ati: "Ingaruka zidasanzwe ntizitangaje nkuko byari bisanzwe, gukina ntabwo ari byiza nkuko byakagombye ndetse no kwerekana amashusho, hamwe n'ibigoretse byayo ntabwo bishimishije nkuko ubishaka". Yashoje avuga ko iyi filime isa nkaho ari "igeragezwa" kuruta "umusaruro wizeye".
Wilfred Okiche yashimye iyi filime kubera kwerekana neza abapolisi ba Nigeriya. Inyandiko n' Inkuru.
Iyi filime ivuga amateka y'umwamikazi wifuza ubwiza kandi akifuza no kwamamara ariko akishyura ikiguzi cyo gutakaza amahoro numunezero yamagana umukunzi we, umuyobozi we. Akpos ni umugabo ubyutsemo afite intego yo kwidagadura no gushimisha inshuti ze. Yegukanye itike yo kujya muri Sun City aherekejwe na Bianca, umukobwa bamaze igihe bakundana. Muri ubwo buzima bushya, bahura n’ibibazo bitandukanye byo mu rukundo, gusabana n’abantu batandukanye, ndetse n’imibereho y’ahantu hatandukanye. Ubwo urugendo rwabo rukomeza, bakura amasomo ku rukundo, inshuti, n’ubuzima muri rusange.

filimi yitiriwe ininsi 30 cyangwa 30Days yanditse inerekanwa na Morgan spurlock kuri FX yerekanye buri episode. bamwe mubantu berekenye iyi film bafashe iminsi 30 kugirango batunganye iyi filimi
Iyi filimi ishingiye mu gihugu kiberamo ubwicanyi na ruswa, umusore yasanze umudamu muri mukabyiniro akunda. gusa ntiyahiriwe nurwo rukundo ahubwo yaje gusanga uyu mudamu ni umwe mu bagize itsinda ry’abicanyi bica abayobozi ba ruswa mu gihugu.

Iminsi 30 i Atlanta ni filime yo iri mu buryo bwo gusetsa cyangwa se comedi gusetsa y’urukundo yo muri Nijeriya 2014 yanditswe na Patrick "Koinage" Nnamani, yakozwe na Ayo Makun ikayoborwa na Robert Peters. Filime yafatiwe i Lagos na Atlanta, muri Amerika. Yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2014. Yamenyekanye nka filime yinjije amafaranga menshi kurusha ayandi muri sinema mu gihugu cya Nijeriya.
Akpos yatsindiye itike y'urugendo rw'ukwezi kumwe i Atlanta, Jeworujiya maze atumira mubyara we Richard ngo baze. Bahageze, birukira mu nshuti yabo ishaje Okiemute, ibajyana gusangira ibya ni mugoroba. Akpos ahura na Kimberly mwiza kandi yifuza kumubaza niba bazasohokana, ariko Okiemute amuburira ko se wa Kimberly agenzura cyane. Kimberly, Akpos, na Richard bongeye guhura hagati yabo mu nama y’ibidukikije, aho Akpos avuga amagambo make asekeje. Kimberly ariko, ashishikajwe cyane na Richard. Yahaye Richard numero ye ya terefone, baragenda mu gihe cya se, restaurateur Odiye, kwigaragaza.
Richard asubira muri resitora gutegereza uruzinduko rwa Kimberly, ariko Akpos arigaragaza. Kimberly abwira Akpos ise yishimiye ibitekerezo bye muri iyi nama kandi ashaka kumuha amasezerano yo gusetsa. Mu nzira atashye na tagisi, Richard amenya ko yasize igikapu cye. Iyo umushoferi amenye ko badashobora kwishyura ibiciro, arabirukana mu kabari. Kimberly na Odiye babaha gusubira mu rugo rwa Odiye, aho bahurira n'umuryango, ndetse n'umunyamategeko w’abinjira n'abasohoka, Olaraye, Clara. Akpos na Clara batangira umubano w'urukundo.
Bavuganiye kuri Skype hamwe n'ababyeyi be, Richard amenye ko uwahoze ari umukunzi we Ezee arimo gutegura ubukwe. Agerageza kumvisha nyina ko bahagaritse umubano wabo akavuga Kimberly. Richard amenyesha Kimberly ababyeyi be, ariko nyina ashimangira ko agomba kurongora Ezee. Ezee agerageza kumvisha Kimberly ko Richard azamutenguha gusa, Ezee yerekana Kimberly amashusho y'imbere ye na Richard. Kimberly acika intege maze yiruka asohoka mu nzu arira.
Akpos yishora mu gukina urusimbi mu buryo butemewe birangira afashwe arafungwa. Clara yamusuye muri gereza yemera ku muhagararira. Byagaragaye ko Akpos yarenze kuri viza, bigatuma urubanza rwe rukomera kandi ruhanwa n'amategeko. Mu rukiko, umucamanza yemeye ko amafaranga yose Akpos yinjije azaba ahagije nk’indishyi z’uko yarenze ku mategeko na viza mu gihe amafaranga azatangwa nk'inkunga akazakurikiranwa. Mu rwego rwo gukumira andi makosa, Clara amujyana iwe, aho bombi basangira, nyuma yaho baza gukora igikorwa cy'ishimisha mubiri(bararyamana). Nyuma, Clara yumvise Akpos kuri terefone, bivuze ko umubano we na we bizorohereza green card ndetse n'ubwenegihugu bwa Amerika. Clara ararakara cyane ko Akpos ashobora kuba yarakoresheje umwanya we ukomeye maze akirukana Akpos mu nzu ye.
Richard agerageza guhindura umubano we na Kimberly, ariko Odiye amutegeka gusiga umukobwa we wenyine, yongera gushimangira isura mbi abasore benshi bo muri Nijeriya bagaragaza mu bihugu by’Iburengerazuba. Richard atongana na Ezee kubyerekeye kwivanga mu mibanire ye na Kimberly.
Mugihe Akpos yanze gutanga amafaranga yinjiza mubikorwa by'urukundo. Ku kibuga cy'indege, mu gihe abo bagabo bitegura gufata indege basubira muri Nijeriya, batangajwe no kubona Kimberly na Clara, bombi bahisemo kubakurikira basubira muri Nijeriya no guhura na bene wabo.
Uburyo Filimi yakiriwe.
Filime yakiriwe neza n'abari aho muri rusange, ariko yatumye abantu benshi bafite ibitekerezo bihinduka ibitekerezo bibi. Abanegura benshi bavuga ko urwenya rwa filime rwuzuyemo clichés na stereotype, kandi ko iyi filime yasaga nkaho yasubiwemo "Osuofia i Londere" (2003), francise "ya Jenifa", cyangwa imvange ya bombi.
"30 Days in Atlanta" yagiye guca amateka yose muri 2014.
30 Days in Atlanta ni Filime yakiriye ibihembo 10 muri Golden Icons Academy Movie Awards 2014.

'76Film, yahoze yitwa Intare yo muri 76, ni filimi y'iserukiramuco filime yi iserukiramuco yo mu gihugu cya Nigeriya yakinwe muri 2016 iyobowe na Izu Ojukwu ikorwa na Adonaijah Owiriwa na Izu Ojukwu. Irimo Ramsey Nouah, Chidi Mokeme, Rita Dominic na Ibinabo Fiberesima.
yatekerejwe imyaka itandatu nyuma yintambara yabenegihugu, ivuga inkuru y'umusirikare mukuru ukomoka mu mukandara wo hagati aza gukundana numunyeshuri wo mu kiciko cy'ambere cy'amashuri yisumbuye ukomoka mu majyepfo y’iburasirazuba, ariko umubano wabo uhungabanywa no koherezwa buri gihe kuri misiyo nigisirikare. Uyu musirikare aza gushinjwa kuba yaragize uruhare mu guhirika ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare butatsinzwe mu 1976, no kwica Jenerali Murtala Mohammed. Iyi nkuru ivuga na none k’umugore utwite cyane wishora mu bibazo by’amarangamutima.
Izu Ojukwu yavuze ko "ari inkuru yavuzwe mu buryo bubiri - duhereye ku gukunda igihugu cy'umusirikare ndetse no ku bagore ba ofisiye." Ojukwu yasobanuye neza ko iyi filime yubashye imbaraga z'abagore b'abasirikare: "Njye uko mbibona, abagore ni abasirikare nyabo... Ni bo bababazwa n'icyemezo icyo ari cyo cyose abagabo babo bafata - haba ku rugamba cyangwa mu biro byabo."
Ibibazo bigaragara muri filime birimo ibihuha by’uruhare rw’amahanga mu guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Murtala Muhammed. Ojukwu yagize ati: "Ntushobora kubahunga... Ugomba guhangana n'ibihuha byose - nubwo tudashobora kuvuga, mu byukuri, uko byagenze ""' yashyizweho nyuma y’imyaka itandatu nyuma y’intambara yo muri Nijeriya, kandi nk'uko umuyobozi abivuga, iki cyari igihe abaturage ba Nijeriya batangiye gukina ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose kandi bakabona ko ari abavandimwe na bashiki bacu.

Killer Music ni filme nyarwanda yasohotse mu mwaka wa 2025 ya Murigande Jacques uzwi cyane mu ruganda rw'imyidagaduro cyane cyane mu muziki nka Mighty Popo.
Killer Music ni label ("inzu itunganya ikanareberera inyungu z'Abahanzi") iyobowe na Sano ("yakinnwe na Mugisha Patrick") ndetse n'Abafatanyabikorwa be Kimmy, Rumata na Nina bakaba bafite Abahanzi bayobora Sine na Mwiza ariko bisanga muri politiki ya label, bashyirwaho igitutu cyo guhanga injyana nshya n'udushya mu muziki wabo ndetse ari nako babananiza mu masezerano bagiranye.
Ariko kandi hakaba hari Umupolisi Gisa ukunda gukurikirana ibyaha akora iperereza bimugeza kuri case yaje imutunguye yagize ingaruka kuri benshi harimwo n'Umukobwa w'umuherwe Kamali. Aho byaje guhurira na business y'umuziki n'uko Ira warumaze guhungurwa yakururiwe mu iperereza ry'ubwicanyi ryagaragaje imvo n'imvano ya za ruswa zibera muri label "killer music" kandi umuntu ubiri inyuma byose ari wa muherwe Kamali.
biba ibibazo, biba akavuyo muri label, n'ibigeragezo bikomeye byabyaye kugwa kwa label kugeza aho habaye performance ikomeye ya korali yo muri gereza iyobowe na Shanon ndetse na Mwiza nk'ikimenyetso cyerekana ubushobozi bw'impano zifite mu kuzanzahura ibyari byapfuye mu gihe cy'ingorane.

Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime ya Urusaro ni iserukamuco rya filime y'umugore iserukiramuco rya filime ry’abagore mu Rwanda. Byakorewe i Kigali, mu Rwanda kandi byateguwe na CinéFEMMES Rwanda, bigamije guhuriza hamwe no guha imbaraga abakora amafilime.
Iri serukiramuco ryashinzwe na Jacqueline Murekeyisoni, washinze akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa w'ikigo Cine Femmes mu Rwanda. Floriane Kaneza yari umuyobozi wacyo kuva 2019-2021.
Kuva mu 2024, Iserukiramuco rya Urusaro ryahaye ibihembo filime nziza mu byiciro bikurikira:

Nahimana Clémence, wamamaye mu rwenya nka Feruje yamuritse filime yise ‘I Bwiza’, igaruka ku buzima abahanzi babamo nyuma yo guhanga bikarangira hungutse abandi batari bo.
I Bwiza ni filime ndende imara iminota 115 yanditswe inayoborwa ku bufatanye bwa Nahimana Clémence na Emmanuel Nturanyenabo, amashusho yayo afatwa na Sibomana Gilbert (One Hundred Pixels).Yerekanywe ku wa Gatatu, tariki 15 Ukuboza 2021, mu cyumba cya sinema kigezweho Canal Olympia giherereye ku i Rebero.
I Bwiza ni filime ivuga inkuru y’umukobwa Gatoni Maya w’imyaka 23, ubarizwa muri koperative ikora ibihangano by’ubwoko bwinshi uhangana na Myasiro, umukire ubigurisha kuko abona abaha amafaranga make.

Gasigwa Léopold Umwanditsi akaba n’umuyobozi wa Filime mpamo, yamuritse filime yise “Urantokoza” yerekana uburyo abagore n’abana bishwe urubozo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.Nk’umuntu wacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Gasigwa Leopold, muri iyi filime ye imara isaha n’iminota 20, yagerageje gukusanya ibimenyetso simusiga bigaragaza uburyo Interahamwe zagiye zifata abagore n’abakobwa ku ngufu ndetse zijungunya abana mu byobo babatemye bamwe bagihumeka.
“Urantokoza” igizwe n’ubuhamya butandukanye bwa bamwe mu barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi banyuze muri iyo nzira y’umusaraba, bamwe mu bayikoze barimo ahanini abayobozi bo nzego z’ibanze, abaturage basanzwe, na bamwe mu ngabo zabohoye igihugu. Abo bose bafite ubuhamya bufatika cyane ndetse bukora ku mutima w’umuntu uwufite kandi utakwishimira na busa Jenoside aho iva ikanagera.
Mu buhamya bw’abo bahoze ari abayobozi bibanze muri Leta y’abicanyi bavuga ko mu gihe barimo bica abantu, bumvaga bari mu murongo mwiza ngo kuko babwirwaga ko mu gihe batarwanyije Inkotanyi zizabica...
“Urantokoza” igamije kugaragaza uburyo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yibasiye cyane abana n’abagore, izamurikwa kumugaragaro bwa mbere ku itariki ya 4 Ugushyingo 2022 mu mujyi wa Kigali.
Muri iyi filime abantu batandukanye batangamo ubuhamya, bagaragaza ibihe bikomeye bagiye banyuramo, abandi bakerekana uruhare rukomeye Inkotanyi zagize mu guhagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

Mu mwaka wa 2009, Kabera yavuze ko iri serukiramuco rizava mu kwibanda gusa ku kibazo cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994, ahubwo bakongeramo n'ibindi byiciro kugira ngo harebwe filime zivuga ku bindi bibazo by'imibereho yo mu Rwanda rugezweho.

Bitewe n'icyifuzo cya Kabera cyo kwerekana amafilime ku bantu benshi bashoboka, iserukiramuco ntiryabereye mu murwa mukuru wa Kigali gusa, ahubwo filime y'ibirori, cyane cyane iyakozwe n'abakora amafilime yo mu Rwanda, yanerekanwe ku mashusho manini yaka umuriro mu cyaro mu gihugu hose.

Imbabazi: Pardon ni filime nya Rwanda yasohotse mu mwaka wa 2013, yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Joël Karekezi mu mashusho ye ya mbere.
Iyi filime ishingiye ku inshuti ebyiri zabayeho Manzi na Karemera, ubuzima bwabo buza gutandukanywa mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Manzi yinjiye muri Hutu Power, mugihe ubuzima bwa Karemara buri mukaga nkabatutsi. Nyuma yimyaka 15, Manzi yavuye muri gereza agerageza kwikosora amateka ye yubukazi.

Filime “ The Secret " ikunzwe muri filime nyarwanda ikinamo Bertin na Saranda bakunzwe cyane. Iyi filime igaruka ku buzima bw’urukundo,kwizwera cyane, gutakariza icyizere umuntu, ndetse n’inzira zo kunga abagize amakimbirane mu rukundo.
The Secret ni filime kandi ivuga ku buzima busanzwe, ariko ikibanda cyane ku rubyiruko, ibyo rucamo mu rukundo, ariko nanone ikagaragaza ko na wa wundi ucyeka ko ari intungane ko nawe yambaye umubiri bityo akaba yakosa. The Secret yandikwa, ikanategurwa n'itsinda rya CLICK IMAGE igaca kuri shene ya Youtube yitwa Topline TV.

Isi dutuye ni imwe muri filime zikunzwe mu Rwanda, ikagaragaza kwaguka mu ishusho yayo. Iyi filime ikinamo Robert Mutabazi uzwi nka Mc Nario, Sarah Kampire ndetse na Sam ukina uzwi nka Paru Rukundo.
Iyi filime igaruka ku buzima n’ibibazo biboneka mu mibanire y’abantu. Ikaba imaze kurebwa nabantu benshi kuri youtube ari naho ica.

Filime yitwa 'Ze Match' izaba ifite umwihariko kuko iri mu buryo bwa Animation.
Iyi filime y’imirwano igaragaraza uwitwa Nkuba ari na we mukinnyi w’imena, uba ushaka kurenganura abantu banyuranye baba bapfa umukobwa ariko akabanza kumenya neza uri mukuri n’uri mu makosa.
Rodrige wanditse kandi akanayobora iyi filime ati "Ni ikintu gishya twashatse kuzana ku isoko rya sinema nyarwanda, urebye ku Isi muri filime zakunzwe harimo izitwa Batman, Spiderman n’izindi zubatse izina, nahoraga nibaza impamvu twe ino aha tutakora nk’ibyo ahandi bakora ariko tukabikora mu rurimi rwacu n’umuco wacu, bityo abana b’i Rwanda ntibarangamire iby’imahanga kuruta ibya hano"
'Ze Match' yamuritswe mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatatu tariki 20 Ukwakira 2021 muri Orient Park Hotel i Nyarutarama, ni filime igaragaramo abakinnyi nka Daniel Gaga ukina yitwa Boss, Ugirumurera Claudine ukina yitwa Rita,Twizeyimana Bahati ukina yitwa Rurangiza na Rutungura Joseph ukina yitwa Nkuba.

Filimi ‘Sakabaka’ yatunganyijwe n’inzu Cinematic Productions Ltd ya Denis Nsanzamahoro bahimba Rwasa, ndetse yavugishije menshi abari bitabiriye umuhango wo kumurika igice cyayo cya mbere kubere bimwe mu biyikubiyemo byerekana imyumvire iriho muri bamwe mu barambagizanya, aho kuryamana babigize ihame.
Ikaba ivuga ku imyumvire iriho muri bamwe mu barambagizanya, aho kuryamana babigize ihame.
Mu myaka itari myinshi ishize, iyo umukobwa yatwaraga inda y’indaro yafatwaga nk’ikirara ndetse akaba n’icyimwaro ku muryango we, rimwe na rimwe akaba yanakwirukanwa iwabo akangara.
Nk’uko muri ‘Sakabaka’ babyerekana bisa nk’aho muri iki gihe ari ibisanzwe kuba umukobwa yatwara inda y’umusore bakundana mu gihe batarashakana.
Icyaje gutungura abantu cyane muri iyi filimi ni kubona Freddy yari afite n’undi mukobwa bakundana gusa uwo mukobwa yahoraga amubaza niba amukunda by’ukuri cyangwa se niba urukundo rwabo rushingiye ku mibonano mpuza bitsina gusa bitewe n’uko iyo batabaga bataryamye, umusore yabaga ameze nk’aho yibereye mu bindi atamwitayeho.
Denis benshi bamenyereye ku izina rya Rwasa, ari nawe nyiri iyi Film, nawe yagaragaye muri iyi filimi yitwa Peter avuye muri Amerika asanga mu Rwanda ibintu byose byarahindutse, gusa we icyamutunguye cyane, ni abakobwa beza bari biganje mu mujyi wa Kigali.

Bora Shingiro wavutse 1991 mu Rwanda i ni Umunyarwanda ufata amashusho ya filme akanayatunganya (Cinematographer), akayobora filme (Director) ndetse akaba n'umwanditsi.
Bora Shingiro amaze kumenyekana cyane kubera ibihembo bikomeye agenda atsindira, aho nko mu mwaka wa 2019 filme ye bwite "Luna" yanditse, akayiyobora ndetse akanayifatira amashusho yatwaye ibihembo bitandukanye harimo ko yatoranyijwe mu irushanwa rya ryaberaga mu Misiri muri 2019. Iyi filime nanone yatorejwe mu iheruka kubera muri Amerika mu 2019. Ariko kandi siyo yatangiriyeho kuko nyuma yo gusoza amashauri muri Kwetu Film Institute muri 2011, yahise akora Filme ngufi yise "Igitambo" muri 2016 akora kuri City Maid nka Director ndetse nka Cinematographer muri 2020 akora iyitwa "Breaking ground" yatoranyijwe muri Seattle nka Special Jury prize, 2022 akora ku mushinga wa filme ndende "The Bride" ya Myriam Birara nka Cinematographer, filme iri muzo akunda yakozeho kandi yanageze kure muri 2023 asohora iyo yise "igihuku" inkuru yakomotse ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yibanda ku buryo abantu bamwe bahungiye mu nsengero bizeye ko batari bwicirwe ahera nyamara bikaza kurangira bahaburiye ubuzima.
Bora shingiro yavukiye i Kanombe mu Rwanda mu 1991, ni umwana wa 2 mu bana 7 bavukana, yakuranye inzozi zo kuzaba umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ariko aza guhindura inzozi ze ajya kwiga ibijyanye no gukora filme muri Rwanda Cinema Center abyiga amezi 6 ndetse akomereza muri Kwetu Film Institute
Bora Shingiro ahamya ko urugendo rwe rutari rworoshye mu gutangira gusa yarafite umuhate kuko aribuka rimwe rigeze kujya mu iyerekanwa rya filme "Long Coat" yagaragayemo Edouard Bamporiki aramwegera amusaba ko yamufasha mu gukina filme no kuzikora ariko aza kumuhereza Email ye ariko yaje kumwandikira umwaka urinda urenga ataramusubiza
Gusa ntibyamuciye intege yakomeje gukora filme ngufi zirimo "igitambo" yo muri 2011, "Umutoma" yo muri 2014 akazohereza mu ma serukiramico atandukanye, biza gutuma izina rye rigira ireme kuko nka 2016 yahamagawe na Richard Mugwaneza mu mushinga wa City Maid kuburyo amushimira cyane ko ariwe usa nk'uwamwinjije neza mu ruganda rwa sinema nyarwanda ndetse na Misago Nelly Wilson umuyobozi wa Zacu Entertainment Mutiganda wa Nkunda, Kivu Ruhorahoza, JB Rutagarama, abo bose nk'abagabo ashimira bamufashe ukuboko kugeza k'uwo ariwe uyu munsi ndetse kugeza ageze ku nzozi ze zo kugera

Shooting Dogs, ni filimi yasohokeye muri Amerika nka Beyond the Gates, ni filime yasohotse mu 2005, iyobowe na Michael Caton-Jones ikinwamo na John Hurt, Hugh Dancy na Clare-Hope Ashitey. Ishingiye ku byabaye. kuri producer w’amakuru wa BBC, David Belton, wakoraga mu Rwanda mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Belton ni umwe mu banditsi ba filime akaba n'umwe mu bayikora.
Imikorere ya firime nq École Technique Officielle (ETO) i Kigali, mu Rwanda, mu 1994, mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Hurt akina umupadiri gatolika (ushingiye kuri Vjekoslav Ćurić) na Dancy umwarimu w’umwongereza, bombi b’abanyaburayi, bafatiwe mu byabaye muri jenoside.
Bitandukanye na "Hotel Rwanda", yafatiwe amashusho muri Afrika yepfo ikoresheje abakinnyi ba Afrika yepfo, iyi firime yafatiwe ahahoze amashusho yerekana. Nanone, abantu bamwe na bamwe bakoreshejwe muri filimi ya Shooting Dogs barokotse ubwo bwicanyi bakoreshwaga mu rwego rwo kubyaza umusaruro no mu nshingano zoroheje.
Umutwe w'iyi filime werekeye ku bikorwa by'abasirikare ba Loni ubwo bajyaga barasa imbwa zizerera zashize imirambo y'abapfuye. Kubera ko abasirikari ba Loni batemerewe kurasa intagondwa z’Abahutu zateje impfu mbere na mbere, kurasa imbwa ni ikimenyetso cy’ubusazi bwibintu filime igerageza gufata.
Joe Connor ni umwarimu muri École Technique Officielle hanze ya Kigali, yari hagarariye Padiri Christopher. Iri shuri kandi ryari ririnzwe na abasirikare b’Ababiligi bayobowe na Kapiteni Delon, mu rwego rwa manda y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe kubungabunga amahoro. Joe yegereye umukobwa, Marie, Christopher amubwirako amufitiye ibyiyumviro. Mu ntangiriro za Mata 1994, bareba ibintu byinshi bitera Christopher impungenge, harimo urutonde rwakozwe mu miryango y'Abatutsi, amakuru avuga ko agatsiko k'Abahutu bateye Abatutsi ahandi mu gihugu, ndetse n'inyungu ziteye inkeke zagaragajwe na guverinoma ya Christopher mu mubare w'ingabo za Loni ku ishuri.
Mu ijoro ryo ku ya 6 Mata 1994, nibwo humvikanye ibisasu bya kure n'amasasu, Delon yumva ko indege ya Perezida bayihanuye yarashwe. Akangurira abantu be kurinda impande zose z'ikigo bari bacumbitsemo, ahihindura ikigo cya gisirikare. ubwo Impunzi zari zije zageze ku marembo, Christopher, kubera Delon yanze, ashimangira ko barekuwe. Bukeye bwaho, Joe atwara imodoka kugirango azane Marie kugira ngo amuzane, ariko inzu iratereranwa uretse imbwa. Agaruka ku ishuri asanga yageze mu muryango w’inyuma, kubera ko ubu umuryango w’imbere urinzwe n’agatsiko k’Abahutu. Impunzi zitegura ziyobowe na Roland, se wa Marie. Impunzi zitari nke z’i Burayi nazo zirahagera, kandi, Christopher yababajwe, Delon ategura ko bahabwa icumbi ryiza. Christopher akomeje imirimo yitorero nkuko bisanzwe, naho Joe agerageza gufasha impunzi.
Mu gihe agatsiko gakikije ishuri, Joe atekereza ko byafasha impunzi mu gihe ibibazo byabo biri kuri televiziyo kandi agasaba ubufasha bwa Delon bwo kuzana umunyamakuru wa BBC Rachel akamuzana mu kigo. Delon yabanje gukorana, ariko ahita ahindura ibitekerezo maze yanga kumva ko abasirikari b'Ababiligi barinze Minisitiri w’intebe Uwilingiyimana bishwe. Joe yahisemo kugenda uko byagenda kose maze ashaka inshuti ye François, umuhutu, kumuherekeza aho, ariko François ntabwo ari murugo. Joe asanze Rachel numufotora we abemeza kuza mwishuri ababwira ko hari abanyaburayi. Mugihe basubiye mwishuri bahagarikwa kuri bariyeri hanyuma bakururwa mumodoka yabo bitwaje imbunda. Mugihe Rachel agerageza kumvikana kugirango basohoke, Joe yababajwe no kubona umugabo wumututsi akururwa akamwica akoresheje umuhoro. Yongeye guterwa ubwoba no kubona ko François ari kumwe n'agatsiko, bafashe umuhoro w'amaraso. François arategura Joe nitsinda rya BBC kurekurwa. Abanyamakuru basa nkaho batishimiye ibyabaye kurusha Joe, nyuma yaje kubiganiraho na Rachel, umunyamakuru w'inararibonye ufite uburambe ku bintu nk'ibyo muri Bosiniya.
Mu kiganiro na Delon, Rachel amubaze impamvu ingabo ze zitagize uruhare mu guhagarika ubwo bwicanyi no kubaza manda ya Loni. Delon asoza ikiganiro amubwira ko yasabye ko yahindura manda ye imwemerera kugira icyo akora, ariko nta ntsinzi. Christopher yibarutse umwana wa Edda, umwe mu mpunzi, amwita umwana. Nyuma Christopher yavuye mu ishuri gushaka imiti y’umwana no gusura ikigo cy’abihaye Imana cyari hafi aho, yumvise ko cyatewe. Kuri farumasi, atanga ruswa kugirango abone imiti kandi arakaye abeshya ko umwana ari Umuhutu. Ageze mu kigo cy'ababikira, asanga ababikira bose barishwe. Hanze, imbogamizi z'ishuri yatije nk'ubutoni zirimo gukoreshwa mu rwego rwa bariyeri, ikintu guverinoma ye yavuganye yishimye. Christopher agarutse ku ishuri, Delon amubwira ko bazatangira kurasa imbwa zishakisha imirambo hafi. Christopher abajije asebanya niba imbwa zarashe ku ngabo za Loni, bitewe na manda zabo nke.
Ingabo z’Abafaransa zageze mu kigo ariko zitangaza ko zihari gusa zo gutwara impunzi z’Abafaransa. Nyuma y’uburakari bukaze bwa Delon, bemeye gufata Abanyaburayi bose. Joe agerageza kumvikana na Marie gufata umwanya we ku makamyo ariko aranga. Rachel aragenda ajyana nabafaransa, abwira Joe ko nawe agomba kugenda. Itsinda ry’impunzi, harimo na Edda, bagerageza gutoroka inyuma y’ishuri ariko bagabwaho igitero n’agatsiko. Abenshi muribo bariciwe, ariko bake basubira mumutekano wikigo. Edda yabanje kubyirinda yihisha, ariko umwana we atangira kurira, aburira abicanyi imbere ye. Joe akireba, we n'umwana we baratewe urupfu.
Delon yaje guhabwa amabwiriza yo kuva kuricyo kigo cyamashuri. Mu gihe Ababiligi barimo kwitegura kugenda, Roland yinginze Delon kurasa izo mpunzi, kugira ngo yirinde ubwicanyi bakoresheje umuhoro, ariko Delon aranga. Joe yahisemo ko atagishoboye kubyihanganira agenda na Delon. Yahuye na Marie ubwo yurira ikamyo kandi ntacyo ashobora kuvuga uretse "Mbabarira". Christopher yahisemo kuguma inyuma, mbere yo kumenya ko ashobora kwinjiza abana inyuma yikamyo yishuri. Afata itsinda rito ry'abana, barimo Marie, agambiriye kugaruka kuri byinshi, ariko akimara kuva ku ishuri, agatsiko kateye kandi kica impunzi zisigaye.
Ubwo Christopher yahagarikwaga kuri bariyeri, iyobowe n'inshuti ye Julius. Nubwo Christopher yagerageje kuvuga inzira ye no kwiyambaza umubano wabo, Julius yanga kumugaragaro. Igihe Christopher yanze gufatanya, Julius aramurasa. Marie, yitegereza ibiganiro byabo atinya ko ikamyo izashakishwa, hagati aho abasha kunyerera atabizi hamwe nabana. Christopher abona Marie yahunze mbere yo gupfa.
Amashusho ya Marie yiruka ari gushaka amashusho yabajijwe hejuru y’uko Loni idashaka kuvuga ibyabereye mu Rwanda "itsembabwoko". Muri epilogue ngufi, Marie akurikirana Joe, ubu akaba ari umwarimu ku ishuri rya kera rya Christopher, maze baganira muri make ibyababayeho.
Iyi filime isozwa namakuru ajyanye na jenoside yabereye mu Rwanda n’ubwicanyi bukomeye bwabereye mu kigo cyo muri ETO by'umwihariko, hamwe n'ibisobanuro birambuye ku byabaye ku giti cya bamwe mu bakozi ba filime mu gihe cya jenoside.
Urubuga rusubirwamo rw'urubuga Rotten Tomatoes ruvuga ko rwemejwe rwa 84% rushingiye ku bisubizo 63, impuzandengo ya 7.2 / 10. Ubwumvikane buke bw'uru rubuga bugira buti: "Biragoye, abantu bavugwa hamwe no kurasa aho biha "Hanze ya Gatesi" impagarara kandi byihutirwa." Mu kinyamakuru "The Guardian," Rob Mackey yaranditse ati: "Niba utari uzi inkuru, ushobora kwitega ko iyi filime izatera imbere mu mateka mato mato ashingiye ku muco… "Shooting Dogs" ifite ahantu nyaburanga: ishuri rya Kigali aho inzozi mbi yakinaga." Muri "New Statesman," Victoria Segal yaranditse ati: " "Shooting dogs ni filimi yafatiwe amashusho" i Kigali kandi geografiya igira uruhare runini mu gutera ubwoba bukabije: imihanda idasanzwe y’ubutayu, imibiri iri mu gihingwa, ubushuhe n’umukungugu. Yuzuyemo ibihe bibi by’ibibi…"
insinzi yambere Iserukiramuco rya Filime ya Heartland 2006 Igihembo gikomeye kubintu bidasanzwe

Stacy Spikes ni rwiyemezamirimo wumunyamerika. Afite Ibihangano by'ikoranabuhanga byemezwa na leta. Numwemubashinze serivisi yo kwiyandikisha MoviePass akaba ari nawe washinze Urbanworld, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ryahariwe kurera abagore n'abanditsi b'inkuru za BIPOC n'abahanze. Uwahoze ari umuyobozi ushinzwe kwamamaza no gutunganya ibicuruzwa, Spikes yagize uruhare runini muri Motown Records, Sony Music Entertainment, Miramax Films, na Filime Ukwakira.
Spikes akomoka muri Houston. Se yarumuyobozi w'ishuri, Nyina yakiragibiganiro kuri televiziyo.
Amazekwiga amashuriyisumbuye, yimukiye i Los Angeles, aho yabanaga na nyirarume anakoramukazi k'ubururu mbere yokubona akazi ke kambere mubijyanye n'imyidagaduro muri Motown Records. kugeza 1995, Spikes yakoragamuri Miramax Films yariyazamuwe muntera inshuronyinshi, aba visi perezida w’ubucuruzi. guhera 1996-97, Spikes yari visi perezida mukuru ushinzwe kwamamaza m'Ukwakira Films.
Ibirori bya firime ya Urbanworld.
Spikes yashinziserukiramuco rya sinema ya Urbanworld mu 1997. Iri serukiramuco ryizihijisabukuru yimyaka 25 mu 2021; ibaburi mwaka mumujyi wa New York.
MoviPass, Twashinze.
Muri Gashyantare 2011, Spikes yashyizahagaragara MoviePass hamwe n’umushinga washinze Hamet Watt. Mu Kwakira 2012, isosiyete yashyizehuburyo bushyabw’ubucuruzi bwakoresheje uburyo bwo kwishyura bushingiye kukibanza. Robert De Niro yari ashyigikiye hakiri kare MoviePass. Nyuma yo kugurwa na Helios na Matheson Analytics, Spikes yirukanwe muri sosiyete muri Mutarama 2018. MoviePass yatanze ikirego cyo guhomba mu 2020.
FilimePass, Gusubiramo.
Mu 2021, Spikes yaguze sosiyete mugihombo mazeyongerakuyitangiza mumpeshyi ya 2022. Abantubagera ku 30.000 biyandikishije kurutonde rw’abategereje mbereyogutangira muminota itanu nyuma yo gutangazwa, byatumye ururubuga rwa MoviePass rusenyuka. Itera nshya rya MoviePass ifite ibyiciro bitatu byabakoresha: shingiro, bisanzwe, cyangwa premium. Ikinyamakuru Financial Times cyagize kiti: "Muguhamagarira ibitekerezo by’ubucuruzi biteye ubwoba, MoviePass irikumwanya wa Sinclair C5, Juicero, na Soup Tube."
Inyandiko ya Stacy Spikes "Yashinz'Umwirabura, Imbaraga Zihishe zo Kuba Hanze" yasohotse muri Gashyantare 2023; yerekana umwugawe.
Spikes yari producer mukuru wa "Punks", "Uruzinduko", "Umwami w’ishyamba", "Ed Ed" (2001), "Kuri da Gukunda Amafaranga" (2002), na firime ya TV "Urbanworld Film Festival idasanzwe" (2004).
Ibihembo &amp; Icyubahiro.
Yakiriye “Made in NY Award” yahawe na Michael Bloomberg, umuyobozi w'umujyi wa New York, mu 2011 kuberakazi yakoranye na Festival Urbanworld.

93 DAYS Ni filime ikinamico ifite inkomoko muri Nigeriya isohoka mu mwaka 2016 yayobowe kandi ikorwa na Steve Gukas. Iyi filime ivuga ibyorezo bya Ebola 2014 muri Nijeriya ndetse n’uko byarwanijwe neza n’abakozi b’ubuzima mu bitaro bya Lagos. Irimo Bimbo Akintola, Danny Glover na Bimbo Manuel hamwe na Native FilmWorks, Michel Angelo Production, na Bolanle Austen-Peters Production.
"93Days" yeguriwe na Ameyo Adadevoh, kumugaragari wo muri Nijeriya wagize uruhare runini mu kwirinda ndetse no kurwanya Ebola muri Nijeriya.
Ku ya 20 Nyakanga 2014, Patrick Sawyer, umudipolomate wa Liberiya n'Abanyamerika, yageze i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Yahise ajyanwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi cya mbere nyuma yo kugaragarwaho bimwe mu ibimenyetso bikabije. Umwe mu baganga be bitabiriye, Dr. Ameyo Adadevoh, yari afite impungenge yuko ashobora kuba afite indwara ya Ebola, nubwo Sawyer ahakana icyo cyifuzo; nyamara, yahisemo gushyira mu kato Sawyer kandi asaba abakozi be kwitonda mugihe bamwitayeho.
mumasaha ya saa sita, nibwo ibisubizo by'ibizamini byaje maze, byemeza ko Sawyer afite Ebola.ryabaye Ijambo ryihuta cyane ko i Lagos hashobora kubaho ikibazo cya mbere cy’umurwayi wa Ebola, kandi bidatinze imiryango y’amakuru ku isi yatangiye gutangaza amakuru. Nijeriya ihita itangira kwitegura icyorezo cya Ebola.
Dr. Adadevoh abonana na Dr. Wasiu Gbadamosi ukuriye ikigo cy’indwara zandura Yaba, na Dr. David Brett-Major wo mu muryango w’ubuzima ku isi. yaje gusanga icyo ikigo cya Yasu kidafite ibikoresho bihagije byo gufasha no kwita ku abarwayi ba Ebola. Ku ya 25 Nyakanga, abaganga bavumbuye ko Sawyer yapfuye. Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya mbere gitangira ingamba zo kongera ingamba kandi kigenzura abakozi bacyo ibimenyetso n’ibimenyetso bya Ebola.
Iyi nkuru yibanze cyane ku bitambo byatanzwe n'abagabo ndetse n'abagore bashyize ubuzima bwabo mu kaga kugira ngo barebe ko virusi ya Ebola irimo, mbere yuko iba icyorezo.

Abuja Connection ni firime y'imirwano ya Nollywood yasohotse mu 2003 yakozwe na Michael Ezeanyaeche ikinwamo na bakinnyi bazwi cyane nka Clarion Chukwura-Abiola. Hariho ibindi bice bibiri, "Abuja Guhuza 2" na "Abuja Guhuza 3", byombi biyobowe na Adim Williams.
Iyi filime ishingiye ku kugaragaza urugamba rwo guharanira ubutegetsi, amafaranga n’uburyo kugira amasano akomeye i Abuja, muri Nijeriya, bishobora guca umurongo hagati yubukene nubutunzi. aho kugira imibanire ikomeye bishobora kuziba icyuho kiri hagati y'ubukene n'ubutunzi. Inkuru ivuga ku bahanganye babiri, Jennifer na Sophia, bahora mu rugamba rwo gutsinda, amaherezo bituma Sophia ashaka inzira nshya. Ivugwa ko ari filime y'imirwano. Ariko, Jennifer ari imbere cyane yumukino. atsinda Sofiya. Kubera ko Sophia yarambiwe agasuzuguro, yahisemo guhagarika guhangana no gushaka amafaranga n'imbaraga ahandi. Azabigeraho? Cyangwa amaherezo Jennifer yatsinze urugamba?

Impanuka ni filime yikinamico yo muri Nigeriya 2013 yakozwe kandi ikayoborwa na Teco Benson ikinwamo abakinnyi bazwi nka Kalu Ikeagwu na Chioma Chukwuka.
Accide yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Nigeriya cya Filime mu bihembo bya 10 bya Afurika Movie Academy.yatowe kandi inshuro 3 muri Nigeriya Imyidagaduro 2014.
Ikindi gihembo mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro iyi filimi ya the Accident hatioranijwe umwe mu bakinnyi ba filime Chioma, nku mukinnyi mwiza” mu bihembo bya Afurika bya Sinema muri 2014.
Iyi nkuru yibanda ku buzima bwumunyamategeko wumugore wegerejwe numukiriya ushaka gutandukana no kutanyurwa yagize ububata nigitsina cya mugenzi we bimugira impamvu. Ibintu bitunguranye bibaho biganisha ku ngaruka nyinshi.

The Accident Spy ni filime yo gusetsa kadi irimo ibyahe yo muri Nijeriya 2017 iyobowe na Roger Russell ikorwa na Darlington Abuda hamwe na Nosa Aghayere Dag nka producer mukuru. Muri filime hagaragaramo Ayo Makun, Ramsey Nouah, Henry Morris, Agatha Ezzedine, Miguel A. Núñez Jr. Alibaba Akpobome na Daniel Eghan. Yasohotse ku ya 1 Ukuboza 2017, yerekanwe kuri Netflix ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 2019.
Insanganyamatsiko ya firime yazengurutseho inzobere mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga Emmanuel Prince, yafashe urugendo ava muri Amerika kugira ngo yongere ingufu nyuma yuko umukunzi we amutengushye. Mugihe muri Amerika, Umuyobozi, umuyobozi ukomeye wamakarito aha akazi umwicanyi wabigize umwuga kugirango yice uwahimbye isoko rishya ryingufu zigira ingaruka kumasoko ya karitsiye. Emmanuel atabishaka yishora mubikorwa byose yiyandikisha mubyerekanwe hanyuma yibeshya yibwira umwirondoro wumwicanyi, bityo bitera urujijo rukomeye kandi amaherezo arokora ubuzima bwuwabihimbye.

Ada Omo Daddy Ni kinamico yo gusetsa ni filimi yanditswe kandi inakinirwa muri Nigeriya mumwaka wa 2023 yanditswe na Yakubu Olawale, yakozwe na Mercy Aigbe, kandi iyobowe na Akay Mason na Adebayo Tijani. Iyi filime ishingiye ahanini ku buriganya bwa kibyeyi bwerekanwe mu gihe cy’ubukwe buzwi cyane ku izina rya " Owambe " muri Yoruba. Muri filime hagaragayemo bamwe mu bakinnyi ba Nollywood nka Charles Okafor, Sola Sobowale, Mercy Aigbe, Chiwetalu Agu na Uche Ndubuisi.
"Ada Omo Daddy" Ni filime ivuga kumateka ya Pero ugiye kurongorwa na Victor. Ubuzima bwa Pero burahinduka cyane mugihe Ifeanyi yagaragaye gitunguranye avuga ko ari se wamubyaye, bikurura ibibazo mumuryango wa Balogun usa nkuwuzuye. Kugaragara gutunguranye kwa Ifeanyi, gutandukana ariko noneho kwihana, guhishura amabanga adashimishije agomba gukemurwa mbere yubukwe bwa Pero na Victor.
"Ada Omo Daddy" ni filimi yakinnye kandi ishyirwe ku rutonde rwa filime icumi za mbere mu gihe cy’ibirori 2023 na "Premium Times".

----Adesuwa (A Wasted Lust) ni filime y’amateka yo muri Nijeriya yasohotse mu 2012, yakozwe kandi ikanayoborwa na Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen. Igaragaramo abakinnyi bazwi nka Olu Jacobs, Bob-Manuel Udokwu, na Kofi Adjorlolo. Filime yari iteganyijwe gusohoka mu mashusho muri Nijeriya ku ya 4 Gicurasi 2012, ariko kubera amakimbirane hagati y’umuyobozi w’iyo filime n’umuproducer mukuru, yasohotse gusa ku buryo bwa DVD. Iyi filime yafatiwe mu Mujyi wa Benin, muri Leta ya Edo.
Yahawe ibihembo 10 mu bihembo bya 8 bya Africa Movie Academy Awards, inatsindira ibihembo bya Achievement in Costume Design, Achievement in Visual effects, na Best Nigerian filime.
Nollywood Reinvented yahaye "Adesuwa" amanota 49%; yashimye uburyo yakozwe, yayoboye, kandi ifite umwihariko. Uwayisuzumye yasanze iyi filime ishimishije ariko idashimishije cyane.

Dusabimana Apollos yavutse 1977 ni umunyamabanga mukuru w'uruganda rwa cinema mu Rwanda mu rurimi rw' icyongereza (Rwanda filmi federation) ni umukozi w'amajwi n'amashusho akaba kandi yarabaye mu itangazamakuru,yabaye umwe mubayobozi bashinzwe akanama ko gushyiraho urubuga rw'ubumwe bwa cinema muri afurika y'uburasirazuba.
Apollos avukiye mu Rwanda AKarere ka Nyanza 13 mars 1977. Yatangiye gukora ibya cinema hashize imyaka 18,yatangiye gukora urugaga rwa cinema mu Rwanda(rwanda filim federation) kuwa 15 Werurwe muri 2023 afatanije na bagenzi be.
Apollos yize muri Kaminuza ya gatolika ya Kabgayi:mucyongereza (Institut catholique de Kabgayi) ndetse abona impamya bumenyi y'ikirenga mu gihugu cya Kenya muri kaminuza y'umusozi wa kenya: mucyongereza (Mount Kenya University).
Dusabimana Apollos ni umugabo arubatse afite umugore n'abana.

Drocelle Mukarubayiza ni umunarwandakazi ukina filimi akaba azwi cyane mu ikinamico yitwa Musekeweya inyura kuri radiyo Rwanda.
Drocella yamenyekanye mu ikinamico ya museke weya inyura ku ma radiyo atandukanye mu Rwanda cyane cyane kuri radiyo Rwanda kuko iyo kinamico inyuraho kabiri cyangwa gatatu mu Cyumweru. Mukarubayiza akina ku izina rya Zaninka akaba ari umwe mubakinaga musekeweya bamamaye bitewe n'ubuyo batangagamo ubutumwa doreko ahanini iyi kinamico yari igamije kunga no gukiza ibikomere abanyarwanda muri rusange nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 byagiye bibigisha kubana amahoro.

Afurika United ni filime yogusetsa-amakinamico yomu Bwongereza yakozwe mumwaka wa 2010 iyobowe n’umuyobozi wambere w’amafirime mu Bwongereza, Deborah 'Debs' Gardner-Paterson ikinwamo na Emmanuel Jal, Eriya Ndayambaje, Roger Nsengiyumva, Sanyu Joanita Kintu, Sherrie Silver na Yves Dusenge. Uyumugambi ni itsinda ry'abana babanyarwanda bakor'urugendo rw'ibirometero 3000 muri Afrika kugirango bagere mu gikombe cyisi cya Afrika yepfo.
Mu Rwanda, umufanaw'umupira w'amaguru Dudu Kayenzi yigish'itsinda ry'abana kubang'umupira w'amaguru akoresheje agakingirizo ka Loni, igikapu cya pulasitike n'umugozi. inshuti yemagara Fabrice yarafite icyifuzo cyokub'icyamamare mu mupirawamaguru w’umupira wamaguru kandi bigaragara ko yahinduy'amateka yabakinnyi bakomeje gukin'umupira wamaguru. Igihe Fabrice yahaw'amahirwe yokugeragezwa mu birori byo gutangiza igikombe cy'isi cy'umupira w'amaguru mu mwaka wa 2010 muri Afurika y'Epfo, yahimbye gahunda yo kunyura mubabyeyibe bakomeye, hamwe na mushiki wa Dudu na Beatrice. Beatrice yifuza kuba umuganga no gushak'umuti wa sida. Fabrice agerageza kubwira nyina kwa akunda umupira w'amaguru, ariko asubiza ati "Afurika ntabwo ikeneye inzozi, igomba gukanguka".
Bukeyebwaho, Fabrice yakuyeh'ubutwari bwokuva murugo hakirikare, hamwe na Dudu na Beatrice, biyerekana mu rwego rwomumuryango w'umugore kugirango binjiremuri bisi ijya Kigali. hanyuma babur'ahobahagarara kuko bagomba kwihisha mugihe cyokugenzura itike, bikarangirira muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Bose ukwari batatu bashak'ubuhungiro munkambi y’impunzi, aho bahura na Foreman George, umusirikare wahoze ari umwana, abah'amahirwe yogutoroka inkambi yibasiwe n’interahamwe nijoro, bahatir'umwana uwariwe wese ufite ubuzimabwiza ukomeye kwinjira muntambara y'abenegihugu. Bahungiye mu ijipo, arikwabasirikare bagenzi ba George babagerahobukeye. Itsindarishoboye guhung'imodoka mugihemoteri ishyushy'igaturika. Bashakish'icumbi murigare ishaje mw'ishyamba, aho Fabrice yavumbuye igikapu cyuzuyamafaranga George yibye Jenerali we, byerekana impamvu babakurikiranaga. Ariko, guhangana birahinduka kuko byongeye gushyirwaho hejuru yo kuvumbura pantaro mu musarani.
Dudu, Beatrice, Fabrice na George bagezekunkombe z'ikiyaga cya Tanganyika, ahobagura ubwato kugirango bagere mu Burundi hakurya. Hanoniho Dudu atangiye kuvug'inkuru yimpimbano yumwana na mushiki we bashinzwe n'Imana gushushanya umupira utigera usimbuka (cyane nkuwahimbye). Bazakenera reberi ku giti, plastike yo kuri "Shit Mountain" n'umugozi wo mu kiyaga kirinzwe n'amafi akaze.
Nyina wa Fabrice yandika anamuhamagara kuri terefone ye igendanwa, arikwajugunya telefoni mu kiyaga. Amaherezo bagezemuri resitora ya posh, aho Celeste, imbata yimibonano mpuzabitsina, akorera nyir'umuzungu agurisha ibinyobwa. Yafashe abobana bane ashimangira kobasubiye inyuma, ariko George amen'igikapu cy'amafaranga gwatange ruswa bityonyir'ubwite arabemerera kuguma no gukina muri pisine bagategereza. Fabrice afit'umwanya wogukina na "umupira w'amaguru Dudu. Joriji asinziriye, nyir'ubwite yibye umufuka we w'amafaranga awujugunya muri villa; ariko, bidatinze bagarura igikapu namafaranga hanyuma Celeste yifatanya nabo.
Bakoreshej'ubuhanga bwa Dudu, basang'uburyo butandukanye kandibudasanzwe bwogukurikirana urugendo rwabomuri Afrika yepfo, harimon'ikarito ikururwan'inka. Celeste avugako yahunze'umudugudu wekugira ngoyirinde gushyingiranwa, Fabrice abona George yataye imbunda, yakundaga kurasa bagenzi be mbere.
Ikipe yabuz'amafaranga, Dudu ashimangira kobashobora kubon'amafaranga batang'amaraso ku kigo nderabuzima cyaho. Umuntu wesewatsinze ikizamini cy'amaraso usibye Dudu, usanzw'uzi koyanduye virusi itera sida, nubwo atabimenyesha abandi. Nyuma yo kwambuka umupaka muri Zimbabwe, Dudu ahinduranya kwa Zambiya kwacha ku madorari ya Zimbabwe, ariko Celeste asobanura ko ifaranga ridahwitse kandi ko yashutswe. Agerageza gukusanya amafaranga nyuma yo kujugunywa mu mazi na Fabrice yarakaye, kandi nta bushobozi afite kuko yisuka hejuru y’isumo rya Victoria.

Tartarin wo muri Tarascon (Igifaransa: Tartarin de Tarascon) ni filime yogusetsa yomu Bufaransa yakozwe mu 1934 ihagarariwe na Raymond Bernard abakinnyibari Raimu, Fernand Charpin na Jean Sinoël. Kafi's Story ni film yerekanamoko y'ubuzima bwa Nuba muri Sudani, ihagarariwe na Amy Hardie na Arthur Howes.
Kurasana hagatiyi 1986 ni 1988, "Inkuru ya Kafi" yafashamashusho y'ubuzima bwabaturage ba Nuba mbereyuko bagiruruhare muntambara yakabiri yabaturage ya Sudani.
Kafi, umusore womumudugudu wa Torogi mu misozi ya Nuba muri Sudani, n'umwe mubagabo ba mbere bakoze ingendo mumajyaruguru berekeza mumurwa mukuru Khartoum bashaka amafaranga. Kugiramafaranga niyonzira yonyine yokubona umwambaro nokurongora umugore wa kabiri, Tete.
Nyuma yimyaka icumi nyumayiyi firime, Arthur Howes yasubiye muri Sudani gufatamashusho ya "Nuba Ibiganiro", ahoyashakaga kwigarurira ubuzima bwabaturage ba Nuba mugihe cy'intambara.

Nuba conversation ni film yakozwe mu 2000 documentaire na etnografiya ihagarariwe na Arthur Howes.
Nyuma yimyakicumi bafashamashusho y'inkuru ya Kafi, umukinnyiwa firime w’Ubwongereza Arthur Howes yongeyekwihisha muri Sudani kugirango amenyuko byagenze kubaturage ba Nuba batuye muri Torogi.
Yasanze ibimenyetso bya jihadi ahantuhose. nkurugero gahundaya tereviziyo izwicyane, "Fields of Sacrifice", yizihijabapfuye muricyo cyumweru muntambara yokurwanya Nuba hagaragayemo abagizumuryango bashimira Allah kubayarafashije abahungubabo na barumuna babo bahowe Imana.
Benshi mubaturage ba Nuba binjijwemu gisirikare n’inyeshyamba zomuri Sudani zishinzwe kwibohora abaturage mugihe cy’intambara ya kabiri ya Sudani. Abandi bavuye mungozabo ubu baba munkambi z'impunzi.
Arthur Howes yazanye documentaire yeyambere, Inkuru ya Kafi, yerekabantu ba Nuba babamu nkambi y'impunzi muri Kenya.
Nyuma, mu 2002, "Ibiganiro bya Nuba" byashyikirijwe icyicaro cy’umuryango w’abibumbye i Nairobi kumpande zagizuruhare muri ayomakimbirane. Bikekwa koyagize uruhare runini mukwihutisha inzira y'amahoro.

Kinshasa Makambo ni filme mbarakuri (filme documentaire) yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yayobowe na Dieudo Hamadi iza gusohoka mu mwaka wa 2018. Iyi filme igaruka ku nkuru y'ukuri y'abagabo 3 baharaniraga demokarasi mu myigaragambyo yabaye muri 2016 idashyigikiye perezida.
Iyi filme yerekanwe bwa mbere ku ya 18 Gashyantare 2018 Mu iserukiramuco rya 68 rya. Filme yatsindiye igihembo cya Tim Hetherington muri Sheffield DocFest ya 2018 na True Vision Award yakuye mu iserukiramuco rya yo mu mwaka wa 2018.

Uru ni urutonde ni rwa filme, ibihangano bishushanyije, amakinamico yakinnwe, ndetse n'inkuru mbarakuri zakozwe kuri jenoside yo mu Rwanda yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Adire ni filime yo muri Nigeriya yasohotse mu 2023 iyobowe na Adeoluwa Owu ikaba irimo abakinnyi nka Kehinde Bankole, Ishami rya Femi na Layi Wasabi. Iyi filime ifite amasaha abiri n'iminota itatu kandi yasohotse muri sinema hirya no hino muri Nijeriya ku filime yongerewe muri Netflix muri Mutarama 2024,
Incamake ya Filime ya Adire.
Filimi ya Adire yitiriwe umwana w'umukobwa witwaga Adire yakoraga umwuga w'uburaya igihe kirekire kandi akaba yarashakaga kubuvamo akagenda, ariko shebuja, Kapiteni, akamwangira. Umunsi umwe nijoro, yaje kwitwara neza ku mukiriya maze asaba Kapiteni kumureka, ariko amwemeza ko azagumaho. Umunsi umwe, Adire yatwaye amafaranga ya Kapiteni ahungira mu mujyi muto wa Oyo. Agezeyo, akora umwuga wo gushushanya kuko zarizo nzozi zo gushushanya imideri ndetse n'imyenda y'abagore. Mu mujyi yatuyemo, ijoro rimwe Adire yagiye mu kabari kamwe, abantu babonye ubwiza bwe n imyambarire ye itinyutse, bikurura abagabo bo mumujyi baza kumureba buri kanya. Ibi byababaje abakirisitu bo mumujyi. Adire ahanganye n'inzangano z'abagore b'itorero no gusurwa biteye akaga na Kapiteni, Adire yasanze ari mu kaga gashobora gusenya ibintu byose yari yarubatse kandi akora cyane.
Uko filimi ya Adire yakiriwe.
Shola-Adido Oladotun wo muri "Premium Times" yavuze ko iyi filime yashyizwemo imbaraga ku miterere yayo arc kandi inashimangira isomo ryo "gukunda mugenzi wawe nk'uko wikunda" kandi itegeko rya "ntuzacira urubanza". Yagaragaje kandi ko filime yoroshye guhanura kandi ikayiha amanota 5/10 nurangiza.

Sidonie Panache ni filime yogusetsa amateka y’Abafaransa yakozwe mu 1934 ihagarariwe na Henry Wulschleger abakinnyibari Florelle, Bach na Alexandre Mihalesco. amashushoyafatiwe muri Alijeriya. Amashusho ya firime yateguwe numuyobozi wubuhanzi Marcel Magniez. Byari bishingiye kuri operetta yumutwe umwe. Nibimwe mubisohoka cyane mubufaransa muruwo mwaka.
Mu 1842 mugihe cyokwigarurira Alijeriya, Sidonie Panache yihinduyenka Zouave kugirango aherekezumukunziwe woherejwe gukorerayo.

After 30 ni firime ikozwe muburyo bwa ikinamico yo muri Nigeriya ikaba yarasohotse mu 2025 iyobowe na Momo Spaine ikorwa na Ronke Ayeni kuri Studiyo ya Nemsia. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo abakinnyi nka Damilola Adegbite, Beverly Naya, Meg Otanwa, na Anee Icha mu bakinnyi bakomeye, hamwe na OC Ukeje na Patrick Doyle. Yasohotse ku isi yose binyuze kuri Video ya Amazone Prime ku ya 9 Gicurasi
Iyi filime inyura kuri televiziyo yo muri Nijeriya ikaba yarasohotse mu mwaka wa 2015 "Mbere ya 30", ihitana ubuzima bw'abagore bane bahuje imyaka mirongo itatu, ubu ikaba irimo gukemura ibibazo bishya nk'uburumbuke, ubutane, umunaniro ukabije, ndetse no gukura kwawe.
"After 30 iyi filimi" ikomeje urugendo rw'abagore bane bafite imbaraga - Temi, Nkem, Aisha, na Ama - ubu bafite imyaka mirongo itatu kandi batuye i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Ntabwo bigisobanurwa nubwoko bwo gushyingirwa, bahura nicyiciro gishya cyubuzima cyuzuyemo ibintu bigoye: umubano utoroshye, imyuga ihindagurika, igitutu cyabaturage hafi yuburumbuke, no gushakisha ibyasohozwa.
Binyuze mu ndimi za Temi, urukundo rutagira ibyiringiro ruhura nakazi ndetse, guhindura umwuga yakoraga, film irasobanura insanganyamatsiko yo kwisubiraho kugiti cyawe, gukira amarangamutima, hamwe nibisobanuro bigenda bihinduka byibyishimo, intsinzi, nubugore. Mugihe buri mutegarugori ahanganye numutekano muke no guhindura ibyifuzo, After "30" filimi ibaye inkuru yerekana imyaka-y-imyaka yerekana uko bigenda iyo igihe cyagenwe n'ibiteganijwe guhinduka.
"After 30" Filimi yakozwe na Nemsia Studios, uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa muri Nigeriya. Iyi studio nayo iri inyuma yicyubahiro nka "Umwuka wubuzima", "Mbere ya 30", hamwe "nImana Ihamagara". Iyi filime yerekana Momo Spaine yerekanwe bwa mbere mu buyobozi, nyuma yo gukora nka producer kuri "Banana Island Ghost" (2017) na "The Wait" (2021).
Uburyo yasohotse nu uburyo yakiriwe.
Iyi filime yerekanwe kuri Video ya Amazone Prime ku ya 9 Gicurasi 2025, ikaba yaragize agahigo ko gucuruzwa cyane, itangira ku mwanya wa mbere muri Nijeriya mu masaha 24 isohotse. Yagumanye imyanya icumi yambere kumurongo wicyumweru cyose. Abari bateraniye aho bashimye byimazeyo amarangamutima menshi, imiterere ikomeza kuva "mbere ya 30", hamwe no kwerekana ukuri kw’umugore wo muri Nijeriya.
Isano na After "30".
"After 30" ni filimi yakomeje kunyura ku ma televiziyo yo muri Nijeriya "After30", rwerekanwe mu 2015. Urukurikirane rw'umwimerere rwakurikiranye abakobwa bane b'abakobwa i Lagos ubwo begereye amateka y’imibereho y'abashakanye mbere y’imyaka 30. "Nyuma yo gusubiramo 30" bafite imico imwe nyuma yimyaka, basuzuma ubwihindurize mu mibereho yabo nyuma y’imyaka yabo, bafite ibibazo bishya by’umuntu, bifitanye isano, ndetse n’abaturage.

Ajuwaya ni Filime yo muri Nigeriya yasohotse mu mwaka wa 2017 yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Tolu Awobiyi Lord Tanner. Filime Adventure ikinamo Timini Egbuson, Lanre Hassan, Etinosa Idemudia, Kemi Lala Akindoju na Rahama Sadau.
Iyi filime irazenguruka abanyamuryango batandatu b’igihugu gishinzwe ibikorwa by’urubyiruko boherejwe kandi inagaragara muri Nijriya ahazwi nka leta ya Osun kubera ibikorwa byabo by’urubyiruko. Inkuru yabaye ingorabahizi mugihe abanyamuryango ba corp bavuzwe bongeye kubyutsa ibibi bimaze igihe kinini mubaturage.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere mu gihugu hose ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2019.

Sandman (Igifaransa: Le marchand de sable) ni filime y’ikinamico yakozwe mu 1932 y’Abafaransa ihagarariwena André Hugon abakinnyibari Jean Toulout, Kaissa Robba na Jean Worms. Yakorewe murisitudio ya Joinville ya Pathé-Natan. amashusho yafatiwe iGhardaïa muri Alijeriya y'Abafaransa. Amashusho ya firime yateguwe numuyobozi wubuhanzi Christian-Jaque. Umutwe werekana igishushanyo mbonera cya Sandman.
Mugihe yakoraga mubirindiro byomuri Alijeriya y’Abafaransa, liyetona yategetswe gukora iperereza kubyago byagwiririye abasirikare bagenzibe barwaye cyangwa baburiwirengero. Ibyo yavumbuye bimujyana munzitunzwe nu Burusiya bwera butangaje.

Iyobowe na Biodun Stephen, yari remake ya firime ya Aki na Ukwa 2002 yakozwe na Chinedu Ikedieze na Osita Iheme. S.O.S Sahara ni filime yikinamico yakozwemu 1938 yomu Budage ihagarariwena Jacques de Baroncelli abakinnyibari Charles Vanel, Jean-Pierre Aumont na Marta Labarr. Filime yakozwe mururimi rw'igifaransa, yakozwe n’ishami ry’igifaransa ryasitidiyo yomu Budage UFA. amashusho yafatiwe muri Alijeriya. Mami Wata ni filime yakozwe mu 2023 yabirabura nabazungu. filime yanditswe inayoborwa na CJ "Fiery" Obasi, ishingiye kumigenzo y'Afrika y'uburengerazuba. Ni ubufatanye hagati ya Nijeriya, Ubufaransa n'Ubwongereza.
Iyi filime yerekanwe bwambere mw'Iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance 2023, rikabarikintu cyagatatu Obasi yerekanagakuri Sundance. Mu Kwakira 2023, hatoranijwe kuba umukinnyi wo muri Nijeriya muri Filime Nziza Mpuzamahanga Yamamaye mu bihembo bya 96 bya Osama na Komite yabayobozi bomuri Nijeriya (NOSC). Yatowemucyiciro cyiza cya Filime Cyiza cya 39 cyigenga cya Spirit Independent Awards, nomucyiciro cy’indashyikirwa mpuzamahanga cyerekana amashusho ya 55 ya NAACP Image Awards.
Obasi yazanye bwambere atangira gutezimbere "Mami Wata" mu 2016. Amaze kwandika imishinga mike, yitabiriye laboratoire nyinshi zifasha gutunganya ibyanditswe. Mukiganiro na CNN, Obasi yavuzeko "yashakaga gukora filime ya hyper-stylized" ifitimiterere yashinzimizi, abifashijwemo n’abakinnyi ba firime akunda nka Akira Kurosawa na David Lynch. Inyuguti Prisca na Zinwe bahumekewe na bashiki banyakwigendera Obasi. Ibigo bitangumusaruro bifatanye na "Mami Wata" birimo Isosiyete ikora firime ya Obasi, Studiyo ya Guguru, Itangazamakuru rya Palmwine, Ikigega cy’Ubusuwisi Vision Sud Est na Ifind Ifoto y’Ubufaransa.
Ifoto nyamukuru yafatiwe mumidugudu ya Benin yomucyaro ipfunyika muri Mutarama
Mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance, umukinnyi wa sinema Lílis Soares yatsindiye igihembo kidasanzwe cy’abacamanza mumarushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Dramatike ku isi ya sinema. Yatwayibihembo bitatu muri FESPACO - Prix de la Critique Paulin S. Vieyra (Igihembo cya African Critics Award), Meilleure Image (Cinematography Award) na Meilleur Décor (Set Design Award). Yaguzwe na Dekanalog kugirangwikwirakwizwe.
Ku isuzuma ryakozwe na Rotten Tomatoes, iyi filime yemewe 97% yemewehashingiwe kubisubizo 38, abayinengaga bemejeko "Muburyo butangaje "Mami Wata" yakoresha palette kugirango yerekane isi ishimishije, imezenk'inzozi."
"Umunyamakuru wa Hollywood" abisobanura nk'inkuru ishimishije nubushakashatsi bukomeye "​"​"​" Ikinyamakuru "Los Angeles Times" cyagize kiti: "Ubwoburinganire hagati y'abazungu n'abirabura nuburyo Obasi ashimangira cyane insanganyamatsiko zezose: kwizera n'ibimenyetso, imigenzo n'ibigezweho, ku isi yose. ' "Mami Wata" gutanga nogufata." "Ikinyamakuru Wall Street Journal" cyavuzeko "Inyandiko ya Bwana Obasi yazamuye imigenzo ya rubanda mukuyishiramo muburyo bwihishe mubitekerezo bya politiki ndetse nokureba kugitsinagore n'imbaraga z'abagabo." Isuzuma ryakozwe na "New York Times" Critic's Pick ryagize riti: "Muri "Mami Wata", archetypes zitamenyerewe, zikora kugirango iyi filime yomuri Nijeriya ibigihangano cy’ubukungu." Matt Zoller Seitz womuri "RogerEbert.com" mwisubiramorye, yayihaye inyenyeri enye (isumba izindi) agira ati: "Filime itera amarozi, kandi amarozi akomeza kugeza ku mperuka." filime Sean Baker yise imwe muri filime akunda mu 2023.

Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema na Audiovisual yu Burundi (FESTICAB) ni iserukiramuco rya firime ngarukamwaka riberamu Burundi.
FESTICAB yashinzwe n’umuyobozi wa firime Léonce Ngabo mumwakawa 2009. Igizwe n’amarushanwa mubyiciro bitatu: filime zi Burundi, filime zomur'Afurika y’iburasirazuba na filime mpuzamahanga.
Muri FESTICAB 2011 yashinzwe umuyoboro wa firime wo muri Afrika yuburasirazuba (EAFN). FESTICAB 2015 yarekeyegukorwa kuber’imyigaragambyo yabaga birukanubutegetsibwa Perezida Nkurunziza yiyamamarizaga kuyobora manda ya gatatu, hagombaguhagarikwa ibintu byinshi.

Iriserukiramuco ryateguwe n’umuryango w’umuryango w'Afrique cinémas ikubiyemo ibihangano bya sinema na TV mubyiciro byose birimibihimbano, documentaire, animasiyo, hamwe n'ukuri Yatewinkunga n'abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye, nk'umujyi wa Lausanne, canton yomu Busuwisi ya Vaud, Umuryango Internationale de la Francophonie, Fondation Sandoz Family na Loterie romande [fr ; de], Ubufindo bwa Romandy. uwerekanye yari Archive Film yo mu Busuwisi (Cinémathèque suisse) kuri Casino de Montbenon i Lausanne.

Ana wa Banati (Arabic, Icyongereza: Abakobwa banjye nanjye cyangwa njye na abakobwa banjye) ni filime yabanya Misiri yo mu 1961 yakinwemo na Salah Zulfikar, Nahed Sherif hamwe na Zaki Rostom. Iyi filime yanditswe kandi ihagararirwa na Hussein Helmy El-Mohandess, ikagaragaramo itsinda rigizwe na abakinnyi barimo Amaal Farid, Fayza Ahmed na Zahret El-Ola.
Samir yari umuhehesi, ahura na Maysa aramukunda nawe aramukunda, ariko ntiygera abwira se ibijyanye umubano we. Se ni umugabo ushakisha ariko agashobora kurera abakobwa be bane neza, ariko ntiyashobora kubona amafaranga ahagije kugirango bitegure kurushinga, kandi yohererejwe pansiyo, umwe munatubuzi batwa amafaranaga. Se yoherejwe mu bitaro biturutse ku mpanuka, abakobwa be bakora kugira ngo bumve ubuzima. Umwe muribo akora nkumuririmbyi muri salle, uwa kabiri akora nkicyitegererezo, uwa gatatu yandika inkuru kandi ashima umwanditsi ukomeye akamufat nka we, naho uwa kane Maysa aguma murugo. Se yarazi imiterere yabo ahitamo kugumakure yabo. Maysa yakundaga Samir bagirana ibibazo, ahitamo kwiyahura arapfa. Ibyago bisubiza se gusubira guhuza umuryango.

Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Cambridge (CAFF) niserukiramuco rya firime ny'Afurika muri Cambridge. Iriserukiramuco ryashinzwe mu 2002, ribaburimwaka mu Kwakira cyangwa Ugushyingo. Nibirori birebire bya firime mur'Afrika mubwongereza.
Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Cambridge ryatangijwe muri 2002 nitsindarito ryabanyeshuri barangije muri kaminuza ya Cambridge, harimo na Lindiwe Dovey.
CAFF ya 11 yafunguwe kwitariki 10 Ugushyingo 2012 hamwe na filime yomuri Kenya "Nairobi Half Life". ibirori byamaze iminsi 7, banerekana film ya Senegal "La Pirogue". yakozwe muri 2013 CAFF yifatanyijenandi mwiserukiramuco ny'Afurika mu Bwongereza - Afurika muri Motion i Edinburgh / Glasgow, Afrika Eye muri Bristol na Film Africa i Londres - kugirango basangire ubumenyi mugukugukora amafilime. CAFF ya 12 yabayekuva ku ya 3 kugeza ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 2013, herekanwe filime zirimo "Ikintu cya ngombwa" cya Judy Kibinge na "Tey" ya Alain Gomis. CAFF ya 13 yafunguwe ku ya 1 Ugushyingo 2014 hamwe na "Timbuktu" ya Abderrahmane Sissako. CAFF ya 14 yabaye kuva ku kugeza ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2015. Muri filime harimo filime yo muri Afurika y'Epfo "Ayanda". CAFF ya 15 yabaye kuva ku kugeza 27 Ukwakira "2016".

Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya Cabo Verde (CVIFF) niserukiramuco rya firime muri Cape Verde ryashinzwe bwambere mu 2010.
Kuva muri Nzeri 2018 filime zirenga hafi 200 zimaze kwerekanwa muriryoserukiramuco nubwo CVIFF yakiriye filime zatanzwe nibindi bihugu nyinshimurizo zituruka muricyogihugu
Umuyobozi mukuruwa CVIFF ni Suely Neves. Yarangijemuri kaminuza ya Massachusetts Amherst, yanditsimpamyabumenyi ihanitse ya SIT Graduate Institute kuri politiki yokohereza Cape Verde. Yabayumuyobozi w'umushinga mumuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe abimukira akabanumuhuzabikorwa wa basketball 3x3.
Iserukiramuco rya firime ryerekanwe bwambere mu Kwakira 2010 i Espargos, Sal. Mugihe cyatekerejweho muri 2008, igitekerezo cyumunsimukuru wa firime cyarasubitswe kuberikibazo cy'ubukungu mumwaka wa 2008. Ibiroribyambere herekanwe firime eshanu zose Neves yavuzekwari intangiriro nziza kubirori bishya byateguwe. Murikiriya gihe, CVIFF ntiyashoboye kubona inkunga mu bucuruzi cyangwa mu mashyirahamwe y’umuco, ibyo bikaba byakomeza kuba ikibazo byibuze mu myaka itatu iri imbere.
Muri 2014, byavuzweko umukinnyiwa firime wa Hollywood Mike Costa azitabira CVIFF yuwo mwaka nkumujyanama hamwe n’abagize inteko. iserukiramuco ryafatanije n’ishyirahamwe ry’abanenga amafilime n’abanyamerika kugirangobongere abanyamerika bitabira.

A Sunday in Kigali (izwi mu gifaransa nka: "Un dimanche à Kigali") Ni filimi yo muri Canada yakozwe muri 2006 Igaruka kubyabaye mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi 1994. Yayobowe na iyi filime yakozwe ishingiye ku gitabo "" cya.
bernard Valcourt utunganya filime mbarankuru akaba n'umunyamakuru, yerekeje i Kigali gukora kuri filime mbarankuru kuri ariko ahageze. yisanga mu mivurungano y'ibihe bitari byoroshye byari hagati y'Abahutu n'Abatutsi byaganishije kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu gihe yamaze muri Hôtel des Mille Collines, Valcourt akundana n'umukobwa mwiza, wagiraga isoni wakiraga abakiriya witwa Gentille. Gentille uwo niwe wakiraga abadipolomate, abayobozi, na ba burugumesitiri bakundaga kuza kuri pisine buri cyumweru. Mu gihe urukundo Valcourt yakundaga Gentille rwiyongeraga igihugu cyari mu ntambara y'ubutita, ivukamo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi 1994 irabatanya. Amezi make ashize Bernard Valcourt agaruka mu Rwanda atitaye kubyari biri kuba gushakisha Gentille yakunze. Ibyinshi mu byerekanwe bigenda bisubira inyuma.
"A Sunday in Kigali" yinjije miliyoni 1.1 z'amadolari y'Abanyakanada muri Québec mu mpeshyi ya 2006, ku ya 23 Nzeri 2006 nibwo yerekanwe ku banya-canada bavuga Icyongereza. amashusho n'imigozi yabaye uburyo bwiza mu bindi bice.
Mu byumweru umunani igisohoka, Filime yakozwe kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda ya Robert Favreau ni yo filime ya mbere ya Québecois yo muri 2006 yatsindiye ku kigero cya Million 1 y'amadorali muri CAN.
Kuri Rotten Tomatoes, iyi filime ifite igipimo cya 88% hashingiwe ku bitekerezo 59 byayikorewe.
ku zindi mbuga bayivuzeho ko: "ari filime idasanzwe, ifite intego nziza ikora ku marangamutima ya muntu n'imitekerereze ye." yahaye iyi filime amanota 2 kuri 4, agira ati ""Dore ikintu cyagutera agahinda ukarizwa n'inkuru y'urukundo... ndetse n'abantu ibihumbi n'amagana barimo kwicwa agashinyaguro bitewe no kutita ku nshingano za bamwe"." Umwanditsi wa Robert Koehler na we yayihaye inyenyeri 2 kuri 4 maze agira ati: "Pic rwose yakoze ikintu cyagatangaza, yerekanye mu gihe cy’ubwicanyi bukabije bwo mu minsi 100 n'ibyakurikiye nyuma yayo."
Kuva yasohoka, iyi filime yahataniye mu maserukiramuco 42 n'ibihembo.

Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’amafirime y’abagore (AIWFF) ryashinzwe mumwaka wa 2017 n’umwanditsi w’umunyamisiri Mohamed Abdel Khalek. Niserukiramuco ryambere ngarukamwaka rya Egiputa ryibanzekubibazo by’abagore n’abakora amafilime, hibandwagaku Misiri nomukarere kagari ka MENA. Niwomunsi mukuru wambere mpuzamahanga wabereye mu Misiri yoharuguru.
Iriserukiramuco ryashinzwe mumwaka wa 2017rishingwana Mohamed Abdel Khalek, nikimwe mu bikorwa bya filime bya mbere bya Misiri. Ikorwa ku nkunga ya minisiteri y’umuco, ubukerarugendo, n’ubufatanye bw’Abanyamisiri, ifatanyije n’inama y’igihugu y’abagore, guverineri wa Aswan, na kaminuza ya Aswan, n’abandi.
Abdel-Khalek yavuzeko ibiroribifite inkingi enye: imurika rya firime zikemura ibibazo by’abagore; ihuriro ryibibazo byabagore riteranya abarwanashyaka baturutse kwisi yose; amahugurwa kubakiri bato batojwegukina firime; n'ibikorwa byoguhuza abatunganya firime.
Iriserukiramuco rikurura abitabiriye igihugu ndetse n’amahanga mubyamamare n’abanyapolitiki nka Nelly Karim, Yosra El Lozy, Madeleine Tabar, Randa El Behery, Danny Glover, Barbara Bouchet, na Victoria Abril.
Burigitabo cyubaha umugoreukomeye. Muriboharimo: Djamila Bouhired, umunyagihugukomoka mugihugu cya Alijeriya witwaje intagondwa warwanijubutegetsi bw'abakoloni b'Abafaransa, ku nshuro ya 2 muri 2018; Mohsena Tawfik, umukinnyi w'amafirime w'inararibonye wa filime na televiziyo byo mu Misiri, ku nshuro muri 2019;] ukomoka muri Siriya Kinda Alloush ku nshuro ya 9 mu 2025.
Kugezamu 2020, abanyeshuri barenga 250, abenshimuribo bakaba arabakobwa, bahuguwe mu mahugurwa y'ibirori.

Nyuma y'ibirori harimo firime za Arthur Jafa, Ja'Tovia Gary, Terence Nance, Jenn Nkiru, Gabourey Sidibe, Janine Sherman Barrois, Darius Clark Monroe, Shatara Michelle Ford, Garrett Bradley, na Naima Ramos-Chapman. Abagize itsinda barimo Bradford Young, Rashid Shabazz, Spike Lee, na Tarana Burke.
Yaba Blay, Akiba Solomon, Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, na Tariq “Igitekerezo Cyirabura” Trotter bose babanje gukorera mu nama ngishwanama y'ibirori.
Mu 2024, ibirori byari byitabiriwe n'abantu barenga 17.000.
Mushikiwabo uteguragahunda ya Blackstar Projects harimo Seen, ikinyamakuru gisohoka kabiri mubuhanzi nokwandika; amahugurwa y'abahanzi b'amabara; ubusabane; n'imurikagurisha.

Freaknik (/ˈ f r iː k n ɪ k / ; mu ntangiriro Freaknic) yarumunsi mukuru w'ikiruhuko ngarukamwaka wabereye i Atlanta, Jeworujiya. Yabanje kwitabirwa nabanyeshuri biyandikishije mumateka n'amashuri makuru yabirabura mumateka ya kaminuza ya Atlanta. Yatangiye mu 1983 nka picnic ntoya muri parike rusange hafiyikigo cya kaminuza ya Atlanta yatewe inkunga na DC Metro Club kubanyeshuri batabashaga gusubira murugo kuruhuka rwimpeshyi. Byakomeje nkigikorwa ngarukamwaka cyabayemuri wikendi muri Mata. Ibirori byariyongereye cyane nogukundwa cyane mumyaka ya za 90, bikubiyemamarushanwa yokubyina, ibitaramo, ibirori, amarushanwa ya basketball, amasomo ya rap, iserukiramuco rya firime n’imurikagurisha ryakazi.
Ikinyamakuru "cya Atlanta" cyiswe ibirori byomumuhanda bizwi cyane., abapolisi bomu karere ka Atlanta n'abayobozi batowe bakoranye kugirango Freaknik irangire. Impapuro zavuguruwe zagarutse umunsumwe ku ya 22 Kamena 2019, nka "FreakNik Atlanta '19 - Ibirori hamwe n’igitaramo cyabereye muri Cellairis Amphitheater i Lakewood.
Ubusanzwe "Freaknic", izinaryibirorini portmanteau ya "picnic" na "frak", ukurikije insanganyamatsiko ya DC Metro Club yo mu 1982–1983 insanganyamatsiko Kugaruka kwa Freak".
Freaknik yasamwe muri Werurwe 1982 ku kigo cya Spelman College mu nama ya DC Metro Club iyobowe na perezida icyo gihe Schuyla Goodson. Yatewe inkunga niyi club, yari igizwe n’abanyeshuri baturutse i Washington, DC, Maryland, na Virginia. Club DC Metro Club yari igamije ko itoroshye kuri Club ya California muri ibirori binini birangira-umwaka-shuri. Goodson yatanze igitekerezo cyizina Freaknik (icyo gihe cyiswe "Freaknic") nka portmanteau yubusa na picnic.
Izina Freaknik ryahumekewe na Le Freak na Chic, indirimbo n'imbyino bizwi cyane kuva mu 1978. Bwa mbere byabereye muri John A. White Park muri Atlanta muri Mata 1982, ryitabiriwe n’abanyeshuri bagera ku 150.
Mu 1988, Perezida wa College ya Spelman, Johnnetta B. Cole, yabujije DC Metro Club kugira uruhare muri Freaknic kuberimpamvu z’ishuri. Kuberako ntashyirahamwe ryabanyeshuri ryemewe riyobora ibirori, Daryl Miller wigenga yasabwe na DC Metro Club kuyitezimbere. Yakuze ibirori kuva 15.000 agera kuri 250.000 mumyaka itanu nta radio cyangwa amatangazo yamamaza.
Abandi bamamaza benshi batangiye kuzamura Freakni (k) utarumuyobozi. Kimwemuribyobirori cyabereye kuri hegitari 33 za Fairwood Fairgrounds cyari gifite abantu 60.000. Mu 1993, abanyeshuri babiri batari HBCU, abamamaza ishyaka Ronn Greene na Diya Nabawi, nibobabaye abambere mukuranga iryozina, ryanditswe kumugaragaro nka "Freaknik" (risozwa na "k"). Ikindi cyabereye muri Club XS hafi ya Moreland Ave. Ikigikorwa cyatejwe imbere nitsinda ryabanyamuryango ba Omega Psi Phi. Ryari rifite abantu bagera ku 30.000 muri parikingi hamwe n’abandi 60.000 bazengurutse Moreland ijoro ryose.
Mu 1991, Kristina Copeland, umutegarugor'ukomoka i Washington, DC, na Ronn Greene, bakoze ibirori byakabiri, byabereye mu imurikagurisha rya Lakewood. Mugihe ibirori byamenyekanye cyane mumico gakondo yabirabura, abashyitsi benshi b'Abirabura baturutse muturere twosetwa Amerika, Kanada, Karayibe n'Uburayi baza kuyitabira. Bamwe murabobashyitsi bahisemo guhindura agace ka Atlanta inzu yabo nshya ihoraho. Mumyaka ya za 90 rwagati, ibirori byitabiriwe n'abantu barenga 250.000 buri mwaka. Ikindikandi ibirori byari imbaraga zikomeye zubukungu mukarere ka Atlanta. Biteganijwe ko mu 1994 ingaruka z’ubukungu zageze kuri miliyoni 20 z'amadolari.
Uko Freaknik yagendagikura, banyir'amazu bahondetse nabanyir'ubucuruzi babibona nabi. Yamaganwe nubucuruzi bwa Atlanta, amashyirahamwe yabaturanyi, abafite ubucuruzi nabayobozi babaturage. Byongeye raporo zihohoterwa rishingiye kugitsina n’izindi mpungenge z’umutekano rusange ziyongereye igihe ibirori byakorwaga. Muri Mata 1997, umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Atlanta, Bill Campbell. kumihanda nyabagendwa yerekeza i Atlanta. Abayobozi b'umugi bamaze gufata ingamba zokugabanya Freaknik kugerwaho, gukundwa kwayo kwaragabanutse. Ibirori byimukiye iburasirazuba kuva Atlanta yerekeza muri Memorial Drive mu ntara ya DeKalb, Jeworujiya.
Kugeza mu 1999, nubwobimukiye mu Ntara ya DeKalb kugirango birinde abapolisi ba Atlanta, abitabiriye baragabanutse, bituma irangira kumugaragaro. Habayeho kugerageza nyuma ya 1999 kubyutsa Freaknik kumugaragaro, ariko ntibyatsinze, abayobozi b'Atlanta bagize bati: "nta bintu byemewe na Freaknic byemewe mumbibi z'umujyi." Umuyobozi w'akarere ka Atlanta, Kasim Reed, yavuze kandi ko "azakomera ndetse akanarega abategura ibikorwa byose bifitanye isano na Freaknic bitubahiriza amabwiriza y'umujyi."
Nyuma yimyaka 20, umuyobozi wanyuma wa Freaknik arimu 1999, isosiyete yamamaza ikorera mur'Atlanta Nyuma ya 9 Partners na Carlos Neal bagiranye amasezerano na Luther Campbell, Juvenile, Trina nabandi kugirango bayobore igitaramo cyiswe Freaknik muri kamena 2019. Freaknik ya 2019 yagaragayemo abahanzi bamuzika ya hip-hop na R&amp;amp;B bakorera muri Cellairis Amphitheater. Ibindi bikorwa byabonetse muri Atlanta, nkigikorwa rusange. Benshi mubagera ku 20.000 bitabiriye baribakuru bakuze bitabiriye Freakniks yemewe yomuri 80 na 90.
Studios ya Williams Street yakozisahimwe idasanzwe yiswe "Freaknik: thevMusical" ishingiye kumunsi mukuruzwi. Ikiganiro cyanyuze kuri tereviziyo y'abakuze Swim muri Werurwe 2010.
Igihembwe cya kabiri igice "cyamamare" kirangimiterere Mary Cherry agira ati "Nagiye i Freaknik murihotlanta mpindura nyina" ubwoyashimishijwe nibikorwa byebyokuruhuka.
Igihembwe igice kimwe "cyubuzima nyabwo" cyakurikiranyabanyeshuri bakaminuza mugihe cya Freaknik ya 1998.
Igihembwe cya gatandatu igice cya "Mushikiwabo, Mushikiwabo" yanditse amateka y'urugendo rwa Tia na Tamera kuva Michigan kugera Atlanta yerekeza Freaknik hamwenabagenzi babobomuri kaminuza.
Muri mixtape ye " STN MTN / Kauai ", Childish Gambino afunguravuga koyari afite inzozi zokuyobora Atlanta akazagarura azagarura Freaknik.
Kuri "Hair Day", igicecyacumi narimwe cyigihembwe cya gatandatu cyurukurikirane rwa ABC rwitwa "Black-ish", Dre ahishurira umuhungu we Jack ko nkumusore yakubiswe murubyiniro n’umuntu wazanye ifirimbi ye mu birori, ibyo bikaba byarakaje umujinya w’umuhungu we mukuru, Junior, wemeza ko Dre yamubwiye ati "Ibibera kuri Freaknik biguma i Freaknik."
Tom Wolfe yerekeje kuri Freaknik / Freaknic mugitabo cye "A Man in full" - muntangiriro ahagana kurupapuro rwa 17, igice "Chocolate Mecca" ariko n'ahandi.
Freaknik avugwa mundirimbo za rap kuvamumyaka ya za 90 nomuntangiriro ya 2000.
Beyoncé avugakuri Freaknik 1996 mundirimbo ye “THIQUE,” yasohotse kuri "Renaissance" mu 2022.
Hulu yasohoye documentaire yitwa "Freaknik: Ishyaka rya Wildest Never Never Told." muri Werurwe 2024.

Iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Hayti Heritage (HHFF) niserukiramuco rya firime ngarukamwaka ribera i Durham, muri NC, rikaba rigaragaz'ibikorwa by'abakora amafilime bomur'Afurika bakomoka. HHFF numwe muminsi mikuru ya filime y'Abirabura imaze igihe kinini muri Amerika. Iserukiramuco rya firime ryerekana ama documentaire, firime ndende, na.
Hayti numuryango wamateka uherereye i Durham, NC. Intambara y'abanyamerik'irangiye, Abirabura bashya babohowe bashinze imidugudu nka Hayti, mumijyi yomuri Carolina y'Amajyaruguru nomumajyepfo. Hayti yabay'umuryango wateyimbere kandi wibeshaho mumujyi wa Durham. Imwe mu nyubako za kera kandi z'umwimerere zisigaye ni Itorero ry'Abepisikopi b'Abanyafurika ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Yozefu, ubu rizwi ku izina rya Heritage Heritage. Mu gihe inkomoko nyayo itazwi, mu 1994, abahanzi n’abafatanyabikorwa baho bishyize hamwe maze bategura iserukiramuco rya mbere rya firime ryabereye mukigo ndangamurage cya Hayti kugira ngo babungabunge umurage mwiza wa Durham. Uyu munsi, intego yabo nukugumya firime yumukara wamajyepfo.
Kubericyorezo cya COVID-19, HHFF ya 27 ngarukamwaka izagaragaramo firime zimwenazimwe zizerekanwa kurimurandasi kimwe nokwerekan'ibinyabiziga.
HHFF ngarukamwaka ya 27 yatangiye kuvakwitariki 1 Werurwe kugeza kugeza 6 Werurwe.Iyo myak'insanganyamatsiko yavugaga "Urugendo rw'Intwari: Umuhamagaro wo gukora." Indwara ya COVID-19 yariyarimbuy'ibirori mw'Itorero rya AME ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Yozefu ryitiriwe AME kugira ngobibe ibintubisanzwe, hamwe n'ibice byokuri interineti Yerekanye firime 40 zohirya nohino ku isi kandi ikoribirori bibiri bya firime ya disiki n'ibiganiro byinshi. Ibintu byingenzi byagaragaye mu mwaka wa 27 wa HHFF harimo kwerekana amashusho ya MLK / FBI ya Sam Pollard na The Outside Story, ikiganiro cyiswe "Igihugu cy’urukundo gihura n’abakobwa b’abirabura bayobora kurokoka gucura," hagati ya Omisade Burney-Scott n’umwanditsi w’igihugu cya Shannon Houston. Muri iri serukiramuco ry’uyu mwaka kandi harimo no guha icyubahiro Cicely Tyson, wapfuye ku ya 28 Mutarama
HHFF ngarukamwaka ya 26 yatangiye kuvaku ya 13 Gashyantare kugezaku ya 15 Gashyantare.Yerekanye filime zirenga 30 kandi yibanda kuri afrofuturism, urupfu, indangamuntu, na politiki. Ibikurubikuru birimo kwerekanwa "the Black Chapter", "Ijwiryoguceceka", "Kurengana", no gufunga hamwe na "Subira". Muruwomwaka mukuru wahaye icyubahiro John Singleton, wapfuye muri 2019, mukwerekana "Amashuri Makuru." Byongeye kandi, MasterClass yakinnye yakozwe na Obba Babatundé naho hakorwa amahugurwa menshi ninama zabatoza.
Kwemererwa no guhitamo.
HHFF ifata firime mukuyitanga kandi ju ihitamo film nziza mubyoherejwe. Inteko y'abacamanza izenguruka hafi 60% ya porogaramu noneho ikosora.
Kugira ngo wemererwe gusuzumwa:
Nubwo bidasabwa kwemererwa, hitabwa kuri firime zakozwe mumajyepfo ya Amerika.

Gorillas Revisited ni documenteri ya BBC 2006 yakinwe numukinnyi wumunyamerika Sigourney Weaver. Uruhare ni umuhamagaro wo kwerekana Dian Fossey muri "Gorillas mu gihu" (1988).
Iyi documenteri ishingiye kubuzima bwa primatologue nu kubungabunga ibidukikije Dian Fossey, byavuzwe na Weaver.
Iyi documenteri yafatiwe amashusho mu Rwanda.

Gray Matter ni film yabanya Rwanda yomuri 2011 iyobowe na Kivu Ruhorahoza.
Filime ivuga inkuru eshatu zitandukanye ariko zifite ihuriro. Muriyambere, umukinnyi wafilime ukiri muto Balthazar arashaka amafaranga muri Kigali kugirango akore film ye ya mbere, "Le cycle du cafard", ariko leta yanze gutera inkunga film ishingiye ku ngaruka za jenoside yabaye mu Rwanda. Iya kabiri, filime ya Balthazar ifata ishusho kandi yerekana umuntu, ufungiye mubuhungiro, wari umwicanyi mu gihe cyintambara. Mu nkuru ya gatatu, Yvan na Justine, umuvandimwe nabashiki bacu, nabasore babiri barokotse bagerageza kubaka ubuzima bwabo.

Dark Tide ni filime iteye ubwoba yomuri 2012 yakozwe na John Stockwell, ishorwamo na Jeanette Buerling (uzwi ku izina rya Jeanette B. Milio) na Matthew E. Chausse kandi yanditswe na Ronnie Christensen na Amy Sorlie. Iyifilime ishingiye kunkuru ya Amy Sorlie ikinamo Halle Berry, Olivier Martinez, na Ralph Brown. Filime yari yananiwe bikomeye nabox-office bomb.
Kate ni impuguke mubucuruzi bwananiranye numbwo rimwe narimwe kuba uba impuguke ntago byijya bibura aba bihitana. Kate amaze kwitwa "shark whisperer", Kate ahigwa bukware nibuka icyo gitero kandi ntashobora gusubira mumazi. Hamwe na fagitire zuzuye kandi banki igiye kwambura ubwato bwa Kate, umugabo wa Kate, Jeff, Jeff, yamuhaye amahirwe menshi: kuyobora umucuruzi w’umukungu w’umukungu w’umuherwe n’umuhungu we w’umwangavu ku mwobo w’akaga - hanze y’akazu. Mu kurwanya amakenga ye no gutinya, Kate yemeye icyo cyifuzo kandi ashyiraho inzira y’ubutaka bwica kurusha abandi ku isi, "Shark Alley".
Gukorwa batangiye muri Nyakanga 2010 i False Bay, Cape Town, Afurika y'Epfo, maze urasa ibyumweru bitandatu mubwato buto bufite inyanja nini yera. Eraser: Reborn ni film yibikorwa yabanyamerika yomuri 2022, imeze nka reboot ya "Eraser" yomuri 1996, kandi isobanurwa nkigice gikurikira muri francise. Bayobowe na John Pogue agendeye ku nyandiko yanditswe na Michael D. Weiss, umugambi wibanze kukigo cyibanga kizobereye mu buhanga bw’ubuhanga bw’urupfu rw’impimbano zabatangabuhamya bakeneye gusiga ibimenyetso byabo. Umukinnyi wumukinnyi wumwongereza Dominic Sherwood mumwanya wambere nka Marshal Mason Pollard w’umunyamerika, abaterankunga barimo Jacky Lai, McKinley Belcher III na Eddie Ramos.
Marshal wmunyamerika Mason Pollard kabuhariwe mu "Erasing" abantu - bahimba impfu zabatangabuhamya baba bafite ibyago byinshi. Iterambere ryikoranabuhanga mu myaka 25 ishize, umukino warazamutse, wari undi munsi kubiro ubwoyahawe Rina Kimura, umugore wa shebuja w'icyaha wafashe icyemezo cyoguhindura ibimenyetso bya leta. Ubwo bombi bahungiraga i Cape Town, muri Afurika y'Epfo, hamwe nitsinda ry'abicanyi batagira impuhwe mu nzira yabo, Pollard yavumbuye ko yashinzwe. Kabiri-yambutse kandi yongerewe na adrenaline, agomba kuba ku isonga ryumukino we, cyangwa niwe uzahanagurwa. Iteka.

Weiss. Jacky Lai bafatanije gukina filime, mugihe abaterankunga barimo McKinley Belcher III na Eddie Ramos. Guhiga Lowry na Patty Reed babaye abaproducer.
