Africa Speaks! ni film ya documenteri yabanyamerika 1930 iyobowe na Walter Futter yavuzwe na Lowell Thomas. Ni firime ikoreshwa.
Paul L. Hoefler murugendo rwo mu 1928 muri Afurika gufata inyamaswa nimiryango kuri firime.
Nubwo iyi filime yafashwe mumezi cumi nane yurugendo rwabereye i Serengeti nomuri Uganda, bigaragara ko igitero cyintare kuri kavukire bigaragara ko cyakorewe muri pariki ya Selig i Los Angeles kandi kirimo intare itagira amenyo.
Hoefler yanditse igitabo yise "Africa Speaks" kurugendo rwasohowe mu 1931.
Ibyerekeye umuco ukunzwe.
Umutwe wiyi filime wasobanuwe mugikarito cya "Afurika Squeaks" yo mu 1940 naFilime ya Abbott na Costello "yo" muri 1949.
Itangazamakuru ryo murugo.
"Africa Speaks" yasohokeye kuri Region 0 DVD-R na Alpha video ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2015.

Beyond The Genocide ni filme mbarakuri () yo mu Rwanda yakozwe 2025 na Zion Sulaiman Matovu Mukasa. ni filme yerekanwe ku mugaragaro mu Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 31, u Rwanda rwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu1994, yerekenwa bwa mbere ku kuya 8 Mata 2025.
ni filme igaruka ku mateka y'u Rwanda rwo muri 1990, u Rwanda rwa 1994 aho igihugu cyari cyarabaye amatongo, n'urugendo rwo kongera kwisana, ubumwe n'ubudaheranwa by'u Rwanda rwa nyuma 1994.
Kuva iyi filme "Beyond The Genocide" yasohoka muri mata 2025, imaze kugaragarizwa abantu barenga 15.000 bo mu mashuri atandukanye yo mu Rwanda. Yanamuritswe muri sosiyete n’ibigo bitandukanye birimo nka MTN Rwanda, Access Bank, PAGE Rwanda muri Canada, ndetse no mu bihugu nka Kenya, Uganda, Israel, u Budage ndetse n'i Paris mu Bufaransa. aho imaze kugira amashimwe ndetse no kwegukana ibihembo bibiri icya ‘Impact DOCS Awards’ na ‘Accolade Global Film Competition’ byose yaherewe muri Amerika
Imitunganyirize ya filme.
iyi filme igaragaramo ubuhamya bw'abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, (survivors) Abagize uruhare mu ikorwa ryayo (perpetrators), Imbwirwa ruhame zihembera urwango z'abanyepolitiki (archived political speeches) ndetse tubonamo n'urubyiruko rwa nyuma ya Jenoside bavuga kucyo amateka mabi u Rwanda rwanyuzemo yabasigiye.
ni filme ifite iminota 100 yatunganyijwe na Zion Films company, ikigo cya Zion Sulaiman Matovu Mukasa wayanditse ndetse aranayiyobora (writer and director), ku bufatanye (producers) Ronnie Abraham, Winnie Adisa ndetse n'abajyanama kuri iyi project advisor aribo Christopher Marler co founder of the ADMA and former Senior Vice President at Pixel Corps na Ali Loukman guturuka muri Uganda na Production unite by Mark walker. kandi ni umushinga Zion Sulaiman yakoze ku bufatanye n'ibigo na za sosiyasiyo n'imiryango nka, The Umbrella Association of Genocide Survivors, CARSA (the Christian Action for Reconciliation and Social Assistance) abo bose bashyigikira uyu mushinga kugeza ugeze ku ntego yawo.
Zion Sulaiman Matovu Mukasa, ni umusore w’ wavutse 1999 muri Uganda. Yatangiye urugendo rwa sinema mu 2016. Mu 2018 nibwo yaje mu Rwanda aho yakoze kuri filme nyinshi zirenga 11 zirimo iyiswe “Dangerous Mom”, “Nailed”, “2020 Series”, “Alisa”, “Injustice” yerekanwe kuri Zacu TV na “Zamani” yagiye hanze mu 2023.
Gusohoka n'Ibihembo.
Ku bufatanye na Never Again Rwanda, AEGIS, CARSA n'abandi kuwa 8 Mata mu cyumweru cyo Kwibuka (kwibuka week) ni bwo iyi filme yamuritswe ku mugaragaro bwa 1 mu rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, byitabirwa n'abantu barenga 600, aho u Rwanda rwari rwibutse ku nshuro ya 31 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda ibaye.
Kuva iyi filme "Beyond The Genocide" yasohoka muri mata 2025, imaze kugaragarizwa abantu barenga 15.000 bo mu mashuri atandukanye yo mu Rwanda. Yanamuritswe muri sosiyete n’ibigo bitandukanye birimo nka MTN Rwanda, Access Bank, PAGE Rwanda muri Canada, ndetse no mu bihugu nka Kenya, Uganda, Israel, u Budage ndetse n'i Paris mu Bufaransa. aho imaze kugira amashimwe ndetse no kwegukana ibihembo bibiri icya ‘Impact DOCS Awards’ na ‘Accolade Global Film Competition’ byose yaherewe muri Amerika

Bala Bala Sese ni filime yomuri Uganda yayobowe na Lukyamuzi Bashir ishingiye kumashusho yakozwe na Usama Mukwaya, yakinwe na Michael Kasaija, Natasha Sinayobye, Raymond Rushabiro, Ismael Ssesanga, Fiona Birungi, Ashraf Ssemwogerere na Ddungu Jabal. Ni firime yambere, umuyobozi, abanditsi naba producer.
Filime ivuga urugamba rwumukunzi kurukundo binyuze mukwihangana. Mu nkengero zikirwa cya Sese, John (Michael Kasaija) yasaze akunda Maggie (Natasha Sinayobye), bombi bafite ubushake bwo gutera imbere urukundo rwabo. Eyimofe (Eyimofe: Iki Nicyo Cyifuzo cyanjye) ni film yikinamico yomuri Nigeriya 2020 yakozwe, yanditswe kandi iyobowe nabavandimwe bimpanga Arie Esiri na Chuko Esiri mugitaramo cyabo cya mbere. Fifty ni filime y’ikinamico y’urukundo yo muri Nijeriya 2015, yayobowe na Biyi Bandele ikaba yarasohotse kuya 18 Ukuboza 2015.
fifty ivuga ku iminsi mike yingenzi yabagore bane kurwego rwo hejuru rwumwuga wabo. Tola, Elizabeth, Maria, na Kate ninshuti enye bahatiwe mu gihe cyo hagati kugira ngobandike ubuzima bwabo bwite mugihe bakora umwuga ndetse numuryango bakurikije uturere twa Lagos.

Umugenzi (Italian) ni filime ikinamico yo mu 1975 iyobowe na Michelangelo Antonioni. Iyi filime yanditswe na Antonioni, Mark Peploe, na Peter Wollen, ivuga ku bijyanye na Anglo - umunyamakuru w’umunyamerika, David Locke (Jack Nicholson), wibwira ko ari umucuruzi wapfuye ubwo yakoraga documentaire i Tchad, ataziko yiganumucuruzi w’intwaro ufite aho ahuriye n’inyeshyamba muntambara y’abenegihugu. Munzira, aherekejwe n'umukobwa ukirimuto utaravuzwe izina (Maria Schneider).
"Umugenzi" niyo filime yanyumamumasezerano atatu ya Antonioni yagiranye na producer Carlo Ponti na Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, nyuma ya "Blowup" (1966) na "Zabriskie Point" (1970). Iyi filime yakiriweneza, abayinenga bashima icyerekezo cy'Antonioni, imikorere ya Nicholson, sinema, hamwe ninsanganyamatsiko iranga, gutenguha nokubaho. Mugihe iyi filime yasohokaga, yari mumarushanwa ya Palme d'or mwiserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes.
Iyi filime yabanje gusohoka na MGM ibinyujije mu bahanzi bunze ubumwe mur'Amerika, ariko mugukemura igice cy’amakimbirane ashingiye kumushinga utandukanye, Nicholson yahawe uburenganzira bwa filime kandi bivugwa koyabujije gukwirakwiza amashusho kugezigihe Sony Pictures yemeye kongera gukora no kongera kuyisohora. Mu 2005, byemejwe na Nicholson, Sony Pictures Classics yongeye gukora iyo filime, itangikinamico ntarengwa yo kongera gusohoka ku ya 28 Ukwakira 2005, ikanayishyira kuri DVD ku ya 25 Mata 2006.
David Locke numunyamakuru wa tereviziyo utemewe mu majyaruguru ya Tchad, ashakakubaza abarwanyi b'inyeshyamba bagizuruhare muntambara y'abenegihugu. Guharanira gushaka ababajijwe, arushaho gucikintege iyo Land Rover yiguye mumucanga nyuma yogutabwa aho n'abayobozi. Nyuma y'urugendo rurerure anyuzemuri Sahara asubira muri hoteri ye, Locke ananiwe amenya ko umushyitsi mugenzi we (Robertson), umwongereza bari bafitanye ubucuti busanzwe, yapfiriye mu cyumba cye cy'indwara y'umutima muri iryo joro. Locke yahisemo guhindura imyirondoro na Robertson, basacyane, mazavugako yapfiriye ku meza, umugambi ugenda nta nkomyi. Locke akusanya ibintu bya Robertson, birimo pistolet, igitabo cyabigenewe na pasiporo. Yahinduye pasiporo kugirango yitwaze ifoto ye.
I Londres, umugore wa Locke wahemutse Rachel ahinduka umwere iyo amenyeye "urupfu" rw'umugabo we. Yegereye inshuti ye, producer wa BBC witwa Knight, kugirango akurikirane Robertson kandamenye ibyavuzwe na Locke muminsi yashize. Locke, amazekwerekeza i Munich, ahasanga ikibuga cyindegekirimo ububiko bufite urutonde-rwibiciro hamwe nimpapuro nyinshi zafotowe zerekana intwaro. Akora ku bushake, akurikira ifarashi yera n'amagare mu bukwe muri shapeli ya baroque, aho ategereza inyuma y'itorero. Ubukwe bumaze kurangira, abagabo babiri babonye Locke ku kibuga cy'indege baramuhangana basaba "impapuro". Locke amazekubaha impapuro ziva mukabati, bamuha ibahasha y'amafaranga bamubwira kwigice cya kabiri kigomba kwishyurwa muri Barcelona. Bimaze kugaragara ko Robertson yari umucuruzi w'intwaro ku nyeshyamba zimwe Locke yagerageje kuvugana na Tchad.
Muri Barcelona, Locke ahitamo Knight, ugerageza gushaka Robertson. Locke ahura numunyeshuri wubwubatsi, uzwi nk " Umukobwa 'gusa, mugihe agerageza kwihisha mu nyubako ya Gaudi, Palau Güell. Nyuma (kuri La Pedrera, indinyubako ya Gaudi kuri Paseo de Gracia), Locke arasabumukobwa kuzana ibintubye muri hoteri kugirangwatazabonayo hariya na Knight ureba lobby. Knight aramwumva mugihe akusanya imizigo ye, akavugana nawehanze. Yemeye kumujyana guhura na Robertson, amusabako yamukurikira muri tagisi, ariko abasha kumubura. We na Locke bavamuri Barcelona, bahinduka abakunzi mugihebahunze. Koresha amafaranga avuyekwishura mbereyintwaro zitatanzwe, Locke ashushanya kugirangwinama iteganijwe mubitabo bya Robertson. Umubonano we ntugaragara; abagabo bategura amasezerano yintwaro barashimuswe, babazwa, kandi bakubitwa na hitmen bakorera leta ya Tchad.
I Londres, Rachel yakiriye ibintu bya Locke muri Afurika. Amaze kumva Knight avugako yirukanwe muri Barcelona, Rachel yatunguwe no gufungura pasiporo ya Locke asanga ifoto ya Robertson yanditsimbere. Akeka ukuri, yerekeje muri Espagne gushaka Locke, kuko abamukubise bamukurikira, bibwira ko bakurikira Robertson. Rachel ahabwa ubufasha na polisi ya Espagne mukumukurikirana, ariko Locke n'umukobwa bakomejekubahunga. Imodokayabo yangiritse, Locke yohereje umukobwa, amutegeka guhura nawe nyuma yiminsi itatu i Tangiers. Umutego rwose, Locke agenzura muri hoteri yomumujyi wa Osuna womuri Esipanye, aho yasanze uyumukobwa yagarutse maze yandikisha icyumba cya kabiri yiyita Madamu Robertson. Yongeye kugerageza kumwumvisha kugenda. Yasohotse muri hoteri maze azenguruka mukibanza cyuzuye ivumbi hanze, ashaka kumugarukira. Bidatinze, hitmen bageze muri hoteri, bahaguruka mbereyuko abapolisi bahagera hamwe na Rachel. Umukobwa yinjiye mwitsinda rya nyuma, basanga Locke yapfiriye mu cyumba cye. Abajijwe n'abapolisi niba bamuzi, Rachel avuga ko atigeze amumenya, ariko umukobwa ati: "Yego".
Mumyaka yaza 1960, Michelangelo Antonioni yariyasinyanye amasezerano y’amashusho atatu na producer Carlo Ponti na Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. Filime ebyiri zambere ni "Blowup" (1966) na "Zabriskie Point" (1970). Umushingawe wagatatu wiswe "uburyohe bwa tekiniki", yagendeye kunkuru ngufi yo mu 1958 yise "L'avventura di un fotografo" (bisobanurwa ngo "Amahirwe yumufotozi") na Italo Calvino. [9] Umutwe wari watewe inkunga n’amagambo J. Robert Oppenheimer yavuze kuribombe atomike kubera "tekiniki nziza" (ubwiza bw'imibare, imibare ya elegance) ibibazo byateje. Antonioni yabanje kwandika ubuvuzi bwa firime mu 1966, nyuma yandika inyandiko ku bufatanye na Mark Peploe, Niccolò Tucci, na Tonino Guerra. [10] Nyumayuko "Zabriskie Point" (1970) irekuwe, Antonioni yamaze imyaka ibiri mu mirimo yabanjirije umusaruro, harimo n’abaskuti bari hafi y’umugezi wa Amazone. [11]
Jack Nicholson na Maria Schneider baribahujweninyenyeri muruyumushinga. [9] Antonioni yaraziranye na Nicholson mumyaka yashize kuberako "Zabriskie Point" (1970) na "Easy Rider" (1969) byabaye gufatamashusho hafiyabo. Mugenzi wa Nicholson, Dennis Hopper, yatumiye Antonioni mukwerekana filime yeyambere kugiticye, nyuma Antonioni na Nicholson bavugana byinshi. Icyakora, Ponti yahangayikishijwe nigiciro kinini cyokurasa ahantumaze ahagarikumushinga. Muri [1975, Antonioni yatangarije "Los Angeles Times" ko kunanirwa mubucuruzi kwa "Zabriskie Point" (1970) byagize uruhare muguhagarika umushinga. Inyandiko, yahinduwe mwizina ry’Ubutaliyani yitwa "Tecnicamente dolce", nyuma yasohowe na Einaudi mu 1976. [10]
Filime yingengo yimari yiswe "Fatal Exit" yarimwiterambere rya Carlo Ponti Productions. Uyumushinga wariwanditswe na Mark Peploe, warumuvandimwe wa Antonioni wahoze akorananawe, Clare Peploe. [11] Mwikubitiro, Mark Peploe yagombaga kuyoboriyo filime, akoresheje amashusho yanditswenawe na Peter Wollen. [15] Icyakora, Ponti ahubwoyasabye Antonioni kuyobora iyi filime, cyane cyane kuberuburambe bwa Peploe nk'umuyobozi. Antonioni yemeye icyo cyifuzo, byemejwe na Peploe. Antonioni yari yabonye isano irihagati ya "Tekiniki Sweet" na Peploe kuko yariyibanze kumunyamakuru w'amafoto. Ariko, kubera ubwitange bwa Nicholson muri "Chinatown" (1974), Antonioni yari afite ibyumweru bitandatu gusa byo kwandika ibyanditswe. [15]

Mu gihe kirekire, hakiri kare muri filime, umukinnyi wa Nicholson Locke arimo ahindura amafoto, hagati ya pasiporo ya Locke na Robertson, mu cyumba cye cya hoteri, hamwe na kaseti yafashwe amajwi yakinnye ikiganiro mbere ya Locke na Robertson, ubu akaba yarapfuye. Kamera ipakira amasegonda 25, itagabanijwe, kugirango igumane isura ya Robertson kuri Live kuri bkoni, mugihe Locke agaragaye iruhande rwe maze bombi bakomeza kuvuga (ni ukuvuga muri kamera muri flash-imwe imwe).Iyicwa ry'imfungwa muri iyi film ntabwo ryateguwe. Igizwe namashusho nyayo yibikorwa nyabyo abakozi bafashe amashusho mugihe bari. Ifoto yanyuma ya firime ni iminota itandatu, isegonda 32-isegonda yo gufata amashusho atangirira mucyumba cya hoteri ya Locke, ureba hanze ku mukungugu wuzuye ivumbi, asunika mu tubari tw’idirishya rya hoteri yinjira mu kibuga, azenguruka dogere 180, arangije asubira inyuma yerekeza hafi y’imbere y’icyumba imbere. [26]
"Umugenzi" yarekuwe na Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer abinyujije ku bahanzi bunze ubumwe muri Amerika ku ya 9 Mata 1975. Nyuma yimyaka iyi filime isohotse, Nicholson yari yarateje imbere kandi ateganya kuzakina umushinga wa firime, ariko MGM yaretse umushinga. Nicholson yasabye indishyi, MGM ireka "Umugenzi" kuri Nicholson. Mu myaka hafi mirongo itatu, Nicholson yabujije filime gukwirakwizwa, nubwo yasohotse muri make na Warner Home Video kuri videwo mu myaka ya za 1980. ["2003"] Sony Pictures Classics yegereye Nicholson amusaba kugarura no kongera gusohora film. Ku ya 28 Ukwakira 2005, iyi filime yahawe igihe gito muri Amerika, aho yinjije amadorari 768.744 ku isi yose. Filime yasohotse kuri DVD ku Mata 2006.
Vincent Canby wo mu "kinyamakuru The New York Times" yanditse ko iyi filime ari "melodrama ihagarikwa, inkuru isanzwe isanzwe ku buryo bitarenze byibuze igice cya kabiri way unyuzemo urabona ko ari inzozi nziza, kandi ko uri imbere ureba hanze." Gene Siskel wo muri "Tribune ya Chicago" yahaye iyi filime isubiramo ryuzuye ry’inyenyeri enye, agira ati: " "Umugenzi" ni filime igoye igaragara gusa mu bwiza bwayo bw'umubiri. Kandi niba udafatiye kuri iyo nkuru yo mu bwonko bwo mu bwonko, birashoboka ko uzasanga umuvuduko w'inkuru yo kwiruka utinda cyane. Abareba bahuza n'urundi rwego, ariko bafite ubushishozi budasanzwe bwo kwerekana ishusho n'ibitekerezo... Nicholson. Igishushanyo cyiza cya Antonioni. " ​"​​​​"
Kevin Thomas wo mu "kinyamakuru Los Angeles Times" yise iyi filime "igihangano cy’ubwiza bugaragara ndetse n’ubuhanzi bukomeye burimo gusebanya nk’uko ari hypnotic. Ni ikintu gikomeye cyagezweho n’umwe mu bakora amafilime akomeye ku isi kandi akirata ikindi kintu cyiza cyatanzwe na Nicholson". Penelope Gilliatt wo muri "New Yorker" yise iyi filime "intsinzi yo guhanga tekinike irambuye amagambo y’ubuhanga bwa filime kuko atigeze ayirambura mbere". Hank Werba wo muri "Variety" yanditse Antonioni "akora cyane amaboko yerekana amashusho meza ya firime agaragazwa nuburyo bwe bwite ndetse nububabare bwo gutekereza kubuzima bwa none kugirango ashishikarize guhura nabo."
Roger Ebert yabanje guha iyi filime isuzuma ribi mu 1975. Mu 2005, yasubiyemo iyi filime asubiramo neza, yandika ko ari ukureba neza indangamuntu, kwitandukanya n’icyifuzo cya muntu cyo kwikuramo. Yashimye kandi imikorere ya Schneider nk "imikorere yo guhumeka neza." John Simon, mu gitabo cye cyo mu 1983 "cyitwa Something to Declare", yanditse adashidikanya ko "Ubusa buri hose: ahantu nyaburanga no mu mijyi, mu nsengero no mu byumba bya hoteri, ndetse cyane cyane mu byanditswe. Ntabwo bigeze habaho ibiganiro byitwa ko ari impfabusa, umugambi mubisha ariko utabishaka, biranga ibintu byinshi kandi bidafite ishingiro.
Muri 2012, "Umugenzi" yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 110 ku matora y’abanenga "Sight &amp;amp; Sound". Filime yashyizwemo n'ikinyamakuru "Empire" nk'imwe muri Filime "mu bihe byose". Iki kinyamakuru cyashimye amashusho ya firime (yakozwe na Luciano Tovoli) ndetse n’ibikorwa byakozwe, cyane cyane imikorere ya Nicholson ituje kandi yerekana. [Kurubuga rwumvikanyweho rugira riti: "Amateka ya Antonioni, umugani w'abantu bonyine, batandukanye mu rugendo nubwo imiterere y'amayobera y'irangamuntu, ihindagurika ifite ubwiza kandi idashidikanywaho." Kuri Metacritic, film ifite amanota 90 ishingiye kubisubiramo 20, byerekana "gushimwa kwisi yose".

Sira ni filime yikinamico yakozwe muri 2023 yanditswe kandi iyoborwa na Apolline Traoré ikinwamo na Nafissatou Cissé, Mike Danon, Lazare Minoungou, Nathalie Vairac na Ruth Werner. Iyifilime yerekana inkuru yumusore winzererezi witwa Sira, nyuma yigitero simusiga yanze kumanika atarwanye ahubwo agahagurukira kurwanya iterabwoba. Nubufatanye hagati ya Burkina Faso, Senegali, Ubufaransa n'Ubudage.
Yabaye iyambere kwisi ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2023 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya 73 rya Berlin, ahoyatsindiye igihembo cya Panorama Audience Award kubera Filime nziza. Filime yashyizwe muri Sahel ivuga amateka yumukobwa ukirimuto wa Fulani, Sira, wagiye guhura numukwe we, Jean-Sidi. Mu buryo butunguranye, wenumuryango we batewe niterabwoba. Abagabo bose bararashwe maze umuyobozi wagatsiko, Yéré, afata Sira aramusambanya. Asigaye apfira mubutayu, Sira yisanga wenyine maze ahungira mubuvumo ubwo yambaraga gahunda yo kubaho.

Vladan Petkovic asubiramo Cineuropa yashimye Nafissatou Cissé yanditse ati: "Cissé ni wefata abitabiriye igitaramo cyecyose, bigatuma iyi filime ibambi cyane kuruta uburyo bwo kwihorera kugahato." Petkovic yashimye umuyobozi Apolline Traoré hamwe numukinnyi womuri sinema Nicolas Berteyac "koreografiya igoye yabantu benshi, inyamaswa nimodoka zigaragaza amashusho menshi". Kuri iyifilime Petkovic yagize ati: "Traoré yateguye inkuru mu buryo bwubwenge kandi bw'inyangamugayo", yashyizwe ahantu nyaburanga "hamwe numugore womuri Afurika w'umunyarugomo nkintwari irwanya ibibazo byose". Yongeyeho, ibyo byose bituma iba "filime idasanzwe yo muri Afurika yorohereza abayireba kurwego mpuzamahanga."

GRunning the Sahara ni filime mbara nkuru omuri 2007 ivugaku amateka ya Ray Zahab, Charlie Engle, na Kevin Lin bagerageza kunyura mu butayu bwose bwa Sahara. Bakoze urugendo rwibirometero 6920, bageraku nyanja Itukura kuya 20 Gashyantare 2007.
Abaproducer Marc Joubert, Keith Quinn, Larry Tanz hamwe numuyobozi James Moll bafatiye amashusho ahantu muri Afurika mubihugu bitandatu: Senegali, Mauritania, Mali, Niger, Libiya, Misiri. Prepare2go.com yashyigikiye abakozi bafilime hamwe nibikoresho byose.

West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty (French) ni 1979 muri Alijeriya-Mauritanian film yikinamico yumuziki wigifaransa iyobowe na Med Hondo. firime wakuwe mu ikinamico yitwa "Les Negrier" (Abacakara), yanditswe na Daniel Boukman. Iyi filime ifatwa cyane nka filime y’ingenzi mu mateka ya sinema nyafurika kukoyakozwe ningengo yimari ingana na miliyoni 1.35 zamadolari yamerika, bityo ikaba imwe murifilime nini zateganijwe muri Afurika zigeze gukorwa. Kubera inyuma y’abakoloni b’Uburengerazuba bw’abakoloni, bwari munsi y’ubwami bw’Abafaransa, ikinamico yashyizwe mu bwato bwabacakara. Filime yasohotse mwikinamico mu 1979.

Achoura n'ifilime iteye ubwoba yabanye Marroco bakoresha igifaransa yomuri 2018 yayobowe kandi yandikwa na Talal Selhami. Abakinnyi babanye Maroc Omar Lotfi na Younes Bouab bakinana na Sofia Manousha, Ivan Gonzalez, Mohamed Choubi, na Moussa Masskri. ni firime ishingiye ku inshuti enye zo mu bwana zongera guhura mugihe umwe muribo, waburiwe irengero hashize imyaka 25 mugihe cyibiruhuko bya Ashura, yongeye kwinjira mubuzima bwabo, bituma bahura na djinn iteye ubwoba. Filime ifatwa nka film yambere ya fantasy ya Maroc.
"Achoura" niyo filime ya mbere y'inyamwanswa yafatiwe muri Maroke(morroco), Yerekanwe bwambere mu Kuboza 2018 mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime ry’i Paris. Filime yabonye intsinzi mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Tangier aho yatsindiye igihembo cya filime yakozwe neza, nomwi iserukiramuco rya Filimi rya Marrakech. Nimbe uzwi kandi ku izina rya Nimbe: Filime nifilime yi ikinamico yomuri Nigeriya yakozwe 2019 iyobowe na Tope Alake. Muriiyi filime hagaragaramo Chimezie Imo, Toyin Abraham, Rachael Okonkwo na Doyin Abiola. Uruhare rwumutwe rukinishwa numukinnyi wa Imo kandi inkuru ishingiye kubiyobyabwenge. Iyifilime yasohotse mu ikinamico muri Nijeriya kuya 29 Werurwe 2019 kandi yakiriwe neza nabayinenga. Filime yabaye ibihembo byinshi muri office kandiyari imwemuri firime zatsinzwe muri Nigeriya mu mwaka wa 2019. Kurubu filime ifite umwanya wa 59 kurutonde rusange rwamafilime yinjije menshi muri Nijeriya. Iyi filime kandi yatorewe igihembo cyibirori bya Filime Nollywood yo mu Bwongereza 2019.
Insanganyamatsiko yiyi firime ivuga ku umuhungu wumuyangavu Nimbe (Chimezie Imo) uhora asetsa bagenzi be ariko kubwamahirwe akabona ihumure, urukundo. ibintu byajeguhinduka mugihe yamenyeshejwe inzira iteje akaga yo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge biba impinduka mubuzima bwe. Yiboneye kandi ahamya ibibazo biherekeza, inzitizi ningaruka zijyanye nokunywa ibiyobyabwenge.

Oga Bolaji nifilime yikinamico yomuri Nigeriya yakozwe muri 2018 yanditswe kandi iyoborwa na Kayode Kasum. Muriyi filime hagaragaramo Ikponmwosa Gold, Omowumi Dada na Idowu Philips mu nshingano zabo. Iyifilime yasohotse ku Kanama 2018 kandi yakiriwe neza nabayinenga kandi yashimiwe cyane kubera amashusho yayo ndetse ninkuru. Iyifilime kandi yerekanwe mubirori firime nka New York African Film Festival, icyumweru cya Nollywood Paris, iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ryafirime rya Zimbabwe, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya RTF, iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cardiff na Zanzibar International Festival. Iyifilime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku buntu n’umuyobozi ubwe abinyujije kuri YouTube 2020 kubantu babaga mu rugo mugihe cyo gufunga kubera icyorezo cya coronavirus mu gihugu.
Oga Bolaji filime ishingiye ku nkuru yubuzima bushimishije-bwamahirwe yumucuranzi wacyuye igihe, ufite imyaka 40 ubuzima bwe burahinduka cyane iteka ryose iyo yambutse inzira numukobwa wimyaka 7.

Dear Affy nifilime isekeje y’urukundo yomuri Nijeriya yakozwe muri 2020 yanditswe na Temitope Bolade, Diche Enunwa, Anthony Kehinde Joseph, na Samuel Olatunji kandi iyobowe na Samuel Olatunji. Iy filime yasohotse muri Gashyantare 2020 ihura n'umunsi w'abakundana kandi yakiriwe neza n'abayinenga.

Shadow Parties ni film yinkinamico ya politiki yomuri Nigeriya 2021 yayobowe kandi yakozwe na Yemi Amodu. Muriyi filime hagaragaramo Yemi Blaq, Omotola Jalade-Ekeinde, Toyin Abraham, Jide Kosoko, Sola Sobowale, Magdalena Korpas, na Lucien Morgan. Yerekanwe kuri Netflix kuya 6 Nzeri 2021.

Imikino Abagabo Bakina ni film yinkinamico yomuri Nigeriya 2006 iyobowe na Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen.
Filime ireba kudasobanuka mubantu benshi bakize bomuri Lagos. Umukinyi nyamukuru Tara (Kate Henshaw-Nuttal) yahisemo gukora ubushakashatsi kumibanire yikiganiro kuri tereviziyo, yibanda kubushakashatsi yakoze ku bashakanye barimo ibiganiro byerekanwa kuri televiziyo Abby (Monalisa Chinda); umukunzi we Richmond (Mike Ezuruonye) numugorewe ufite umururumba kuruhanderwe (Ini Edo); umugorewo mu rugo ufite amateka ababaje (Chioma Chukwuka) n'umugabo we (Bob-Manuel Udokwu), bahigwa n'amabanga yijimye; nundi mugore wo murugo (Uche Jombo) urwana numugabo ukize, ushuka (Jim Iyke) na nyirabuja usaba (Dakore Egbuson).

Alakada: Bad And Boujee ni Film yasohotse mu mwaka wa 2024 ikaba ari filimi yo muri Nigeriya Icyongereza -ururimi rwurwenya-ikinamico ikinamico iyobowe na Adebayo Tijani kandi yanditswe na Toyin Abraham. Ikora nkibikomeza bya firime "ya Alakada". Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Toyin Abraham, Odunlade Adekola, Ini Edo, Bimbo Akintola Ronke Odusanya, na Okusanya Lolade, hamwe na Yhemolee, Ik Ogbonna, na Chimezie Imo bakina. Iyi filime ikurikira guhunga kwa Yetunde Animashaun, umukobwa ukiri muto wicisha bugufi wiyitirira kuba intore zo kuyobora ibibazo byimibereho.
Filime yakinwe kandi isohokera muri Nijeriya ku ya 20 Ukuboza 2024, ikwirakwizwa na Filmone. "Alakada: Bad and Boujee" binjije miliyoni 134 z'amapound mu cyumweru cyatangiye, byerekana imikorere ikomeye ya Boxe ya Nigeriya kandi ishishikajwe cyane n’abayitabiriye. Amafaranga yinjiye yagize uruhare mu bucuruzi ndetse no kwamamaza firime mugihe cyambere cyo kuyisohora.
Iyi filimi yerekeye ku nkuru ikurikira Yetunde, akaba yarakoraga kumbuga nkoranyambaga agakora ari umuntu mwiza kuri interineti abifashijwemo n'inshuti ze, Rebecca na Abebi. Bitewe n'icyifuzo kidahwema kuba icyamamare, kwemezwa, no kwemerwa mu nzego z'indobanure, Yetunde akurikirana icyamamare nubwo yakuze yicisha bugufi. Mugihe inkuru igenda itera imbere, ahatirwa guhangana numutekano muke kandi akamenya agaciro ko gukomeza kuba umwizerwa kuri we.
Abandi bakinnyi bifashishijwe muri filimi ya "Alakada: Bad and Boujee" barimo abakinnyi n’abacuranzi bo muri Nijeriya, baba barashinze kandi bakizamuka, nka King Sunny Ade na Portable. Imyitwarire yabo igira uruhare mubintu byurwenya bya firime.
Ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2024, Toyin Abraham yatangaje ko igice cya gatanu cyiyi filimi y’uruhererekane "ya Alakada" kizasohoka mu Kuboza 2024. Azandika kandi ayobore iyi filime izakorerwa munsi y’isosiyete ikora ibicuruzwa. Ibi bikurikira intsinzi ya firime zabanje muri francise, harimo "Alakada" (2009), "Alakada 2" (2013), "Alakada Reloaded" (2017), na "Fate of Alakada" (2020).
Mu Gushyingo 2024, Toyin Abraham yemeje ko Umwami Sunny Ade azagaragara cyane muri "Alakada: Bad and Boujee" nyuma yo gusangizwa amashusho y’umuririmbyi w’imyaka 78 wageze aho iyi filime iherereye. Yatangaje ku rubuga rwe rwa Twitter, yandika ati: ""Umuntu udasanzwe ari muri #Alakadabadandboujee." Yatumye inzozi zanjye zisohora."

Alan Poza ni filime yo gusetsa y’urukundo yo muri Nijeriya yasohotse mu mwaka wa 2013 yanditswe, yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Charles Novia ikinwamo nabakinnyi nka OC Ukeje nka Alan Poza. Yakiriye nomination 2 muri 9th Africa Movie Academy Awards. OC Ukeje yatsindiye kandi ibihembo byiza bya Nollywood ibihembo kubera uruhare rwe rukomeye nka Alan Poza.
Uyu mugambi ukurikira Alan Poza (Ukeje), label umuyobozi wumuziki label ikina umuhungu,akaba yarateguye kandi anigarurira imitima yabagore benshi mubigo byitangazamakuru ndetse no hanze yacyo akorera, kugirango abashukishe muburiri bwe. Guhunga amarangamutima atandukanye amaherezo bimutera ibibazo kubera ko umwe mu 'bahohotewe' adashoboye guhangana n’umutima wamuteye.
uburyo filimi ya Alan Poza yakiriwe.
Filime yakiriwe cyane nabayinengaga batigeze bayishimira, cyane cyane kubyanditswe no kuvuga inkuru. Nollywood Reinvented ni filimi yahawe amanota angana na 24% maze yandika ati: "Kuri comedi, Alan Poza ntabwo ari umunyamahirwe. Nkurukundo rwurukundo, ruteye urujijo. Kandi ku ikinamico, ni akajagari cyane. Amaherezo OC ntiyigeze ansanga nkubwoko bwabakinnyi. Sinari nzi neza uko ikintu cyose cyabaye."
"Alan Poza" yahawe kandi itsindira ibihembo 2 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards (AMAA) naho OC Ukeje ukina imico "Alan Poza" yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Nollywood (BON).

Alero's Symphony ni filime yikinamico yumuziki yo muri Nigeriya 2011 iyobowe na Izu Ojukwu ndetse ikinwamo na Bimbo Manuel, Ivie Okujaye na Chibuzor 'Faze' Oji. Yerekanwe muri Palms, Itangiriro Cinemas, Lagos. Filime n'amashusho yerekana Amstel Malta Box Office 5 (AMBO 5) yerekana ukuri. Filime ivuga amateka ya Alero (Okujaye), impanga yavukiye mu muryango uzwi cyane wo mu rwego rwo hejuru benshi bita abakire. Lovechild afasha Alero gukurikirana ibyo akunda nkumwuga. Baca bakundana.

All the color of the world are between Black and White ni film yikinamico yo muri Nigeriya 2023 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Babatunde Apalowo mugitangira cye cya mbere. Alter Date ni filime yo gusetsa cyangwa se comedi ndetse n’urukundo yo muri Nijeriya ikaba yarasohotse mu mwaka wa 2019 iyobowe na Marc Adebesin kandi yakozwe na Yemi Banjoko. Muri filime hagaragaramo Iyabo Ojo, Bolanle Ninalowo, na Kenneth Okolie.
Filime izenguruka inshuti eshatu zishaka urukundo. Uwa mbere akeneye umuntu wumukire kugirango agumane amahame ye, uwa kabiri ntabwo afite amahirwe kubagabo naho uwanyuma ntagishoboye gukundana kandi ahora akundana nabagabo babi.

Amazing Grace ni filime y’amakinamico y’amateka yo mu Bwongereza yo mu 2006 yanditswe na Jeta Amata na Nick Moran, Iyoborwa nabahanga nka Jeta Amata kandi yakozwe na Jeta Amata &amp; Alicia Arce. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Joke Silva, Nick Moran, Scott Cleverdon, Mbong Odungide, Fred Amata na Zack Amata. Iyi filime yahawe ibihembo 11 kandi yegukana igihembo cya Achievement in Cinematography muri Africa Movie Academy Awards mu 2007.
Iyi filime rimwe na rimwe ivugwa na Joke Silva, ivuga amateka yo kuvugurura ubukoroni bw’abongereza John Newton (Nick Moran), afata ubwato yerekeza muri Nijeriya kugira ngo ajye gushakayo umukoroni. Nyuma, amaze gutungurwa n'ubugome bw'ubucakara, areka umucakara maze aba umupadiri w'Abangilikani. Nyuma Newton yanditse indirimbo yo gucungura Amazing Grace ahinduka aboliste.

Amina ni filime yerekana ikinamico yo muri Nijeriya isohoka mu mwaka wa 2012 yanditswe, yakozwe, kandi iyobowe na Christian Ashaiku, yakinwe na Omotola Jalade Ekeinde, Van Vicker, na Alison Carroll. "Amina" yarasiwe i Londres.
"Amina" ni Filimi yakiriwe muri rusange yakirwa neza ndetse inavugwa nabi nabi; abanenga benshi banenze ikorwa rya firime. NollywoodForever yatanze amanota 45%, anatanga ibitekerezo bibi kubyerekeye gukina.

Going Bongo ni film yikinamico iseje yabanyamerika-Tanzaniya yomuri 2015 yayobowe na Dean Matthew Ronalds kandi yakozwe na Brian Ronalds. Muri iyifilime hagaragaramo Ernest Napoleon kandi hagaragaramo Emanuela Galliussi, Nyokabi Gethaiga na Ashley Olds. Yafatiwe amashusho muri Los Angeles na Tanzaniya.
Iyifilime yatorewe ibihembo bya Zuku Bongo Movies Awards muri 2015 yatangajwe mw iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime rya Zanzibar. Yatsindiye Filime Nziza yIburasirazuba bwafurika.
Umuganga mushya w’umunyamerika "kubw' impanuka" kubushake yijyana gukora muri Tanzaniya, muri Afurika ukwezi kose. iyiFilime ishingiye kunkuru yanayayo yumuganga wumufaransa wavuye i Burayi akajya muri Afrika.

West of Zanzibar (1954 film) nifilime yomu Bwongereza yomuri 1954 yayobowe na Harry Watt ikinwamo na Anthony Steel, Sheila Sim na Edric Connor.
igendeye "aho Nta Vultures Fly" (1951), yaba kuwayiyoboye numwe na producer nibamwe, kandi ugakomeza ibyabaye kumucungamutungo Bob Payton, wongeye gukinwa na Anthony Steel. Ingingo yiyifilime ni magendu yinzovu, kandi nubwo iyifilime isankaho ishyigikiye kubasagwa butaka nyafurika barwanya ikoreshwa ryubukungu, yabujijwe na guverinoma ya Kenya, yabonaga ko uburyo bwayo ari ubuvandimwe.
Umuryango womur Afurika Galana mucyaro wimukiye i Mombasa nyuma yamapfa. Inzira zamahoro zumuryango zirasenywa n’abacuruzi b’inzovu zitemewe. Ushinzwe umukino, Bob Payton ahinduka umugenzacyaha, yerekeza muri Zanzibar kuvumbura umuyobozi wihishe inyuma yinzovu. Payton akurikirana kariyeri ye binyuze mubice bimwe byahemutse byo mukarere ka Zanzibar. Nubwo hari inzitizi zirimo ingona n'imvubu, Payton amaherezo agana umugome. Umuyobozi w'agatsiko yahaye isambu y'umuryango w'Afurika isubiza amahembe yinzovu, ariko arishyurwa kubera umugambi we igihe umuryango wamuhindukiriye.
"Aho No Vultures Fly" yarimwe mu zamenyekanye cyane mu biro by’Ubwongereza muwi 1951 bityo Studios ya Ealing yahisemo gukora urukurikirane rwinyenyeri imwe, umuyobozi na producer, hanyuma yongera gufatanya numuryango wa Schlesinger. Dinah Sheridan yasimbuwe na Sheila Sim. Kuri stade imwe byari biteganijwe kofilm izakorerwa muri 3-D ariko siko byagenze.
Kimwe nafirime yambere, yafatiwe ahantu murAfrika. Umutwe wageze i Nairobi muri Mutarama 1953.
Nimwe muri firime nke ya Steel yakoze kumpinga yeaho atari ashyigikiye umukinnyi wumugabo ukuze.
Indirimbo imbyino byakonzwe cyane mugihe cyo gufata amashusho yari indirimbo yabaswahili yitwa "Jambo Sigara Baridl". Abakinnyi bafirime bakunze injyana cyane bahitamo kuyishyiramo nkumuziki wambere. Nyuma hafashwe umwanzuro wogutegura icyongereza cyindirimbo, Anthony Steel aririmba amajwi ayoboye, hamwe nitsinda, Radio Revelers. Abajijwe niba ashobora kuririmba, Steel yarashubije ati: "Usibye gutera urusaku mu bwogero, sinigeze ngerageza." Icyuma cyanditse indirimbo ukobyagenda kose kandibyagenze neza kurutonde.
Abakurikirana amafilime yomuri Kenya baciye iyi filime kubera ko yakangiza umubano wamoko muriki gihugu.
Iyifilime kandi yabujijwe muBuhinde nyuma yimyigaragambyo yabanyeshuri babanyafurika murikiriya gihugu.
Universal yakwirakwije film muri Amerika. Bafunguye kuri Theatre yisi yose muri New York, yakundaga kwerekana amafilime yo gukoresha - byari ikigeragezo kugira ngo iyi filime ifatwe nkiyikoreshwa muburyo butandukanye n'ikintu cy’ubukorikori, cyarisoko gakondo rya firime zo mu Bwongereza muramerika. Ubushakashatsi ntabwo bwagenze neza. Filime yarangije gufata amadorari 400.000 muramerika hamwe na booking zirenga 10,000.
Muwi 1957, iyifilime yashyizwe kurutonde rwa filime cumi na zirindwi zizwi cyane Rank Organisation yigeze gusohora muramerika.
"Variety" yaravuze ati "Urudodo rwatejwe imbere nkumudandaza ukomeye udasanzwe aho imigenzo gakondo hamwe no guhatana bigira uruhare runini. Hariho kugerageza gato kwerekana imyitwarire iboneye, nubwo ishobora kubari nziza, igaragara kuriferi kuri ecran."
Bosley Crowther yanditse mu "kinyamakuru The New York Times", "ni ishusho ishimishije kandimuri rusange yizewe kubijyanye niki gihe cya Afurika yIburasirazuba."
BFI Screenonline yaje kwandika:"West of Zanzibar" yashizweho kugirango bunguke intsinzi yababanjirije ariko film nyirizina, n'amateka yayohamwe nabayireba, ntishobora gutandukana cyane. Harry Watt... yashoboye gukomeza umuvuduko ushimishije, cinematografi nziza nokwibanda ku nyamaswa zatumye film ya mbere ikundwa cyane, ariko "Uburengerazuba bwa Zanzibar" bufite itandukaniro rimwe ryingenzi: ingingo yaryo. Irasimbuza impungenge zikwiye zita ku mibereho yinyamanswa Ahantu Nta Bisiga biguruka hamwe n’ikibazo kirenze impaka z’ubutabazi - kwimura amoko yo murafurika yo mu cyaro no kugira uruhare muguhiga amahembe yinzovu. Ariko bihakana rwose igisubizo... Bivugwa ko Watt yatunguwe, ariko icyemezo cyinama y’ubuyobozi bwa Kenya cyafashe icyemezo cyerekana ibibazo bya firime byerekana politiki y’amoko. Iburengerazuba bwa Zanzibar kuva yabuze abantu bose, kandi ikomeza kuba imwe mu mazina azwi cyane ya Ealing. Sky Movies yagize ati: "Anthony Steel yongeye kubamuyobozi wimikino, Bob Payton. Asangiye ubushobozi bwintwari ya Hollywood bwo gutsinda urugamba rukabije ntagitambaro kitagira inenge kiboheye kuri bicep imwe."
"TV Guide" yaranditse ati: "twishingikirije cyane kugace kezaka Afurika, iyi mitekerereze yAbongereza igenda gahoro."

Crumbs ni film yomuri Etiyopiya yakozwe muri 2015 nyuma ya apocalyptic siyanse yimpimbano. Niyofilime yambere yerekanwe numuyobozi wavukiye muri Espagne Miguel Llansó.
Amashusho yafatiwe hafiya Dallol, muri Etiyopiya kungengo yimari ingana na amadorali 225,000. "Crumbs" "ifata inzira idasanzwe kandi rimwe na rimwe itagaragara kunkuru yurukundo rworoshye, rukora ku mutima". Yerekanwe mw iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filimi rya Rotterdam, ndetse na Nightfall Jury Mention mw' iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Los Angeles 2015 ndetse nigihembo cya Filime nziza ya mbere yagaragaye mw' iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Fantasia 2015.
Mwiyerekwa riteye ubwoba rya Etiyopiya ya postapocalyptic, umunyabugeni utagira ingano atangira ibintu bitangaje birimo UFO itangaje, abarozi, Santa Santa, abatware b'Abanazi, n'ibindi. Kugereranya isanzure-isanzure ryikirere kuva mubiumuco wa pop wo mu kinyejana cya 20 (kuva Michael Jordan ukageza kuri Ninja Turtles), iyi fantasia ya psychedelic fantasia iratungurwa kandigakundwa kuko izenguruka umurongo wacyo.

Under the Southern Cross ni filime yikinamico yomu Butaliyani yomuri 1938 yayobowe na Guido Brignone ikinwamo na Antonio Centa, Doris Duranti na Enrico Glori. Filime yashyizwe muri Abyssinia yigaruriwe yintsinzi iheruka y'Ubutaliyani. muzagiye zikurikirana filime umunani zashyizwe mu Bwami bwa Afurika bw’Ubutaliyani mu gihe cy’Abafashisite zasohowe hagati yomuri 1936 na 1939.
Yafatiwe amashusho muri Stidiyo ya Tirrenia hamwe nomuri Tuscany no mu gace ka Galla mu ntara ya Etiyopiya y'Ubutaliyani.
Marco uba uri nyiri igihingwa cya kawa muri Abyssinia, aragerageza kugira uruhare mukubaka Ingoma nshya y'Ubutaliyani. Afite impungenge ariko ko abakozi bebo mubutaliyani, mugihe abagore babo ni miryango idahari, barimo gukundwa cyane numugore kavukire. Mugenzi we muto Paolo agomba kurwanya ibishuko bya Mailù, umukobwa ukiri muto womu burasirazuba bwo hagati.

Mandela: The Living Legend ni ni filime mbarankuru ya BBC yomuri 2003 ivuga kubuzima bwumukangurambaga Nelson Mandela. Ni filime mbarankuru igizwe nibice bibiri byakozwe na Dominic Allan hamwe nabakozi umwe. Yandikira "ikinyamakuru The Guardian", Kathryn Flett yavuze ko iyi documentaire "yubahwa kandi rimwe narimwe ikagaragaza" ariko yanzura avuga ko "atari filime yinjiriye kandi ifite ubushishozi bukabije yigeze gukorwa". Mu isubiramo rya "Mandela: Urugendo rurerure rugana ku bwisanzure" muri "Grantland", Wesley Morris yavuze ko "Mandela: Umugani muzima" ari "umurwayi utuje" kandi "byavuzwe neza na David Dimbleby".

Plot for Peace ni filime mbarankuru yo muri Afrika yepfo 2013 yayobowe na Carlos Agulló na Mandy Jacobson.
Iyifilime ivuga kumateka y’umucuruzi wumufaransa wavukiye muri Alijeriya Jean-Yves Ollivier muruhare rwubukonje bw’intambara -era yAbanyafurika, isinywa ryamasezerano ya Brazzaville yomu 1988 ndetse nibiganiro bijyanye nirekurwa rya Nelson Mandela. Ukoresheje amashusho ya archive ukomoka kuri apartheid -era Afurika yepfo hamwe nibazwa ryakozwe na Winnie Mandela, Thabo Mbeki, Denis Sassou-Nguesso na Mathews Phosa, Ollivier (mbere utazwi kandi witwa 'Monsieur Jacques') ryerekanwa nkumwubatsi w’ingenzi mu kuvana ingabo zabanya Cuba muri Angola muri 1987.
Iyifilime ishingiye kuruhare rwa Jean-Yves Ollivier, umucuruzi ukomeye wumufaransa, mukuganira ku iherezo ryintambara y’umupaka wa Afurika yepfo ndetse nanyuma ya demokarasi ishingiye ku moko menshi muri Afurika yepfo.

Jock the Hero Dog(izwinka Jock wa Bushveld) ni filime yo gusetsa yomur'Afurika y'Epfo ya 2011 yakozwe na Duncan MacNeillie. Irimo amajwi ya Bryan Adams, Donald Sutherland, Helen Hunt, Ted Danson na Mandy Patinkin. Ishingiye ku gitabo cya "Jock of Bushveld" cyo mu 1907 cyanditswe na Sir James Percy FitzPatrick.
Iyi filime yasohotse kuri Blu-ray na DVD muri Amerika muri 25 Nzeri 2012 na Arc Entertainment.
Common Sense Media yahaye film inyenyeri eshatu kuri eshanu.

Khumba ni filime yogusetsa ya xenofictive yomur'Afurika yepfo 2013 yayobowe kandi ikorwa na Anthony Silverston yanditswe na Silverston na Raffaella Delle Donne. Muriyi filime hagaragaramo amajwiya Jake T. Austin, Steve Buscemi, Loretta Devine, Laurence Fishburne, Richard E. Grant, AnnaSophia Robb, Anika Noni Rose, Catherine Tate, Ben Vereen, na Liam Neeson. Ni firime yakabiri yakozwe na Studios ya Triggerfish Animation ikaba ikwirakwizwa na Millennium Entertainment muri Amerika. Uburenganzira mpuzamahanga bwogukwirakwiza butanguruhushya nitsinda rishinzwe gucunga sinema. Filime ivuga kuri Khumba, zebra ufite igice kimwe cya kabiri nka quagga kandi akaryozwa kubura imvura mu gihugu cyose nubushyo bwe. Yatangiye gushaka amafaranga yokubura.
Iyi filime yeguriwe kwibuka Reinhold Rau washinze umushinga wa Quagga Ubworozi, wapfuye ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2006. Rau yarazwiho imbaraga zogukoresha ubworozi bw'indobanure kugirangoyongere agarure quagga yazimye, umuvandimwe wahafi w'ikibaya cya zebra. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwambere muri TIFF ku ya 8 Nzeri 2013, isohoka ku ya 25 Ukwakira 2013 n’ikwirakwizwa ry’abasangwabutaka. "Khumba" yakiriye ibitekerezo bitandukanye n'abamunenga kandi yatengushye mu biro, yinjije miliyoni 28.4 z'amadolari ku isi yose kungengo y'imari miliyoni 20.
Muri Great Karoo, Khumba yavutse igice cya kabiri ku bushyo bwa zebra. Yarezwe na nyina Lungisa na se Seko, umuyobozi w'ubushyo. Khumba ashinjwa amapfa kandi bamurenganyiriza n'ubushyo, usibye Tombi, zebra w'umugore akaba n'inshutiyemagara. Kimwe na Khumba, Tombi nawe yumva adafite umwanya mubushyo kubera imyifatire ya tomboyish.
Umunsi umwe, mantis itera Khumba gushushanya ikarita nini yerekana amazi. Khumba yemera itsinda rya amabuye y'agaciro mumwobo wokuvomera kandi aratukwa n'ubusho. Ingwe mbi yitwa Phango iraburira Mkhulu ko ubushyo bugomba kugenda kugira ngobabone amazi. Lungisa avuga inkuru yukuntu zebrasi yambere yariyera. Umunsi umwe, zebra akiri muto yambutse Karoo, avumbura umwobo wo kuvomera ubumaji mu buvumo. Amaze koga mu mazi, yasohotse afite imirongo. Izindi zebra zoga mumazi yubumaji kandi nazo zakira imirongo.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Lungisa, Khumba yagiyehanze ahura n'imbwa yomuri Afurika yo mu gasozi yitwa Skalk. Umugore w'inyamanswa witwa Mama V amukiza ibibazo, aherekejwe na ostrich yitwa Bradley. Mugihe batatu bashakishaga amazi, Bradley agaragaza koyari hafi kwicirwa mwibagiro. Khumba afasha ubusho bwimuka bwa springbok mugukingura umwobo muruzitiro runini kugirango ukomeze urugendo.
Itsinda rya Khumba rizerera mumuryango wa bohemian w’inyamaswa zibamuri parike y’igihugu ya Ying. Nyuma yo guhunga gato afatwa n’abashinzwe parike batuza Bradley bagatega umutego Khumba mukato, Khumba na bagenzi be bazamukumusozi urihafi kugirango bavugane na Eagle yirabura.
Khumba ahura nitsinda rya hyraxes yomurutare rusenga Eagle Yirabura kandi ikabuza iterambere rye. Kuvakuri albino Black Eagle, yiginzira igana umwobo kandi kwari mubuvumo bwa Phango. Black Eagle iragaragaza kandiko Phango yishe umuryango wemurwego rwo kwihorera kuberako yangiwe akiri umwana muto, kuberako yavutse afite impumyi imwe y'amaso, bikamuha kumva impumuro nziza yo kuba umuhigi mwiza. Khumba utabizi, impamvu Phango amuhiga kubera umugani wa ngwe wa kera wahanuye ko havutse igice kimwe cya zebra, kandi ingwe yariye zebra izaba umuhigi ukomeye. Seko aricuza kuba yararetse ubushyo bwe. Abifashijwemo na Tombi, amenya ko aramutse atayoboye ubushyo bwe ngo ashake irindi riba, bose bazapfa. Akurikira inzira ya Phango.
Mugihe Khumba azerera mubuvumo bwijimye, ubushyo bwe bugera munsiyumusozi, hamwenandi matungo menshi yahuye nazomurugendo rwe. Mubuvumo, Khumba asangamo umwobo wokuvomera maze amaze gutekereza kumagambo ya Lungisa ndetse n'imikoranire yose yagize, amenyako ubudasa ari ngombwa kugira ngo umuntu abeho byaba ari itandukaniro ry'umuntu rishobora kuba imbaraga z'umuntu. Mugihe Phango yugaye, yarangije kwirukana Khumba. Khumba yiruka ahunga ubwobuvumo butangira gusenyuka. Inyamaswa ziteranijwe zireba imirwano hagati ya Khumba na Phango, bigatuma bombi bagwa kubera ubuvumo bwaguye. Phango agwa mu rutare aho yiciwe n'amabuye manini manini amugwa hejuru, naho Khumba agwa mu mazi umubiri we wogeje ku nkombe. Mugihe imvura itangiye kugwa, abantu bose batangira kuririra Khumba kugeza akangutse gitunguranye urupfu rwe.
Hamwe na Phango yapfuye n'ubushyo bwa zebra ububufite inzunshya, Khumba yishimira hamwe n'ubushyobwe, Mama V, Bradley, Skalk, Nora, ubushyo bwa gemsbok, ubushyo bw'amasoko, inyamaswa zomuri parike ya Ying, hamwe na hyraxes zomurutare, ububose babana kandi bakora ibikorwa bitandukanye bikikije isumo.
Jon Olson atanga ingaruka zijwi ryinyamaswa ziyongera.
Iyi filime yasohotse muri sinema ya Afurika y'Epfo ku ya 25 Ukwakira 2013, isohoka kuri DVD ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2014. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere muri TIFF ku ya 8 Nzeri 2013.
Amashusho yumwimerere yerekanwe ya "Khumba" yanditswe, ahimbwa, yakozwe kandi ategurwa na Bruce Retief hamwe nizindi ndirimbo yahimbwe na Zwai Bala. Indirimbo z'amajwi zosezanditswe na Retief zikorwa n'abahanzi batandukanye, barimo Loyiso Bala, Ijuru rya Quartez, Korali y'abana ya Karoo, na Richard E. Grant. Yasohotse ku ya 1 Ukuboza 2013 binyuze kuri labelzero.com, iraboneka kuri iTunes na Amazon.
Ku Rotten Tomatoes, film ifitibyemezo bya 44% hashingiwe kubisubizo 18. Kuri Metacritic, film ifite amanota 40 kuri 100 ishingiye kubisubizo byatanzwe nabanegura 6, byerekana "isubiramo rivanze cyangwa rigereranyijwe".

Dear Mandela ni documentaire yakozwe 2012 Afurika-yepfo / Amerika yibanda kunshuti eshatu zigizumutwe wa shackdwellers zigendana Abahlali baseMjondolo. Mandela (nanone yitwa Mandela: Umuhungu wa Afurika, Se w'igihugu) ni filime documentaire yomu 1996 iyobowe na Angus Gibson na Jo Menell. Yatorewe igihembo cya Akademiki ya Best Documentary Feature.
Iyi filime ni filime yemewe ya Nelson Mandela, perezida wa mbere watowemu buryobwa demokarasi n'Afurika y'Epfo yunze ubumwe. Iyi filime ivuga ku bwana bwa Nelson Mandela, umuryango, amashuri, ndetse n’urugamba rurerure yagize rwo kubona umudendezo w’amoko yose atandukanye yomuri Afurika yepfo, harimo n’ibyamubayeho muri gereza ya Robben.
Kunegura firime Roger Ebert, wandika kuri "Chicago Sun-Times", yakunze iyi filime ariko yumva amakuru menshi yagombye kubarimo, cyane cyane kwishyaka rya FW de Klerk. Yanditse ati: "Inkuru nyayo y'ibyabaye biganisha ku matora iraruhije kandi irashimishije. Yego, Afurika y'Epfo yahuye n'ibibazo by'ubukungu. Ariko yashoboraga kubaho imyaka myinshi mbere mubuvumo; hashyizweho gahunda yo gucuruza rwihishwa n'ibihugu kuva mu Bushinwa kugeza muri Isiraheli, kandi diyama zayo ziracyabona inzira ku ntoki z'abageni ku isi yose. amategeko... Nta na kimwe muri ibyo bintu kibwirwa i "Mandela," cyoroshya ihererekanyabubasha mu mugani w'umukara urwanya abazungu byose ariko bivuze ko de Klerk atashakaga kubona imbaraga zahinduye amaboko. "
Abakenguzamateka Frederic na Mary Ann Brussat bakunze iyi filimi barandika bati: "Abayobozi Jo Menell na Angus Gibson baduha ishusho yahafi kandi yihariye y'iyi ntwari y'umwirabura... ayamashusho yerekana kandi yubaka ubuzima bwa Mandela nk'umuntu uharanira ubwisanzure n'umudendezo - se w'igihugu."

Death of Apartheid (US title: Mandela's Fight For Freedom) ni izina ry’uruhererekane rugizwe n’ibice bitatu byerekeranye n’imishyikirano yo guhagarika ivanguramoko muri Afurika yepfo n’amatora ya mbere ya demokarasi yakurikiyeho. Uruhererekane rwatangajwe bwambere muri Gicurasi 1995, kandi rwakozwe na Brian Lapping Associates kuri BBC, kandi rukaba rwarakozwe n’umuvugizi w’Ubuholandi VPRO, televiziyo yomur'Afurika yepfo SABC, n’umuyapani NHK.
Urukurikirane rwanditswe ahanininubushakashatsi na Allister Sparks, nuwabivuze. Urukurikirane rwaherekejwe nigitabo cyanditswe na Sparks, cyitwa "Ejo Nibindi Igihugu".

Gerrie &amp; Louise ni filime Mbarankuru yabanye canada yomuri 1997 yayobowe na Sturla Gunnarsson. Iyifilime yerekana iaknasobanura Afurika y'Epfo nyuma ya apartheid ikoresheje lens ya Gerrie Hugo, wahoze ari umusirikare mu ngabo z’ingabo z’Afurika yepfo wakundanye akanashyingiranwa na Louise Flanagan, umunyamakuru ukora iperereza kuruhare rwa SADF mu bihe bitandukanye bitavugwaho rumwe mugihe cya apartheid.
Iyifilime yerekanwe mw' iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto mu 1997, ariko ryatanzwe cyane cyane nka Televiziyo ya CBC.

Elegy for Revolutionary ni film ngufi yakozwe muri 2013 iyobowe kandi yanditswe na Paul van Zyl. Muriyi filime hagaragaramo Brian Ames, Martin Copping, na Michael Enright, kandi ishingiye kunkuruy'impamo y'itsinda ry'abasore b'Abazungu bomu majyepfo y'Afurika bagerageza kwigaragambya.

Finding Fela ni film mbarabkuru yakozwe nabanyamerika muri 2014 iyobowe na Alex Gibney, yerekana no gusesengura ubuzima bwumucuranzi womuri Nigeriya Fela Kuti. Iyifilime yagaragaye bwa mbere kwisi mw' iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Sundance 2014 kuya 17 Mutarama 2014.
Yerekana ubuzima mumuziki byumuririmbyi womuri Nijeriya Fela Kuti, wahujwe n'mashusho yagutse yiterambere ry'umuziki wa New York "Fela!" nibiganiro n'umuyobozi wacyo Bill T. Jones.
"Finding Fela" yatanzweho ibitekerezo bivanze nabagenzuzi. Ernest Cole: Lost and Found ni film ya documentaire 2024 yakozwe, yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Raoul Peck. Irakurikira Ernest Cole, umufotozi wigenga wo muri Afrika yepfo wagaragaje amahano ya Apartheid muri Afrika yepfo mugihe cya za 1960 na 1970. Byanditswe na LaKeith Stanfield.
Iyi documentaire yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi mu gice cyerekanwe cyerekanwe mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Cannes 2024 ku ya 20 Gicurasi 2024, aho yatsindiye "L'Œil d'or" ya Documentaire Nziza. Ku nshuro ya 50 César Awards yatowe mucyiciro cya Filime Nziza.
Yasohowe mwikinamico muri Amerika ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2024, na Magnolia Pictures, nomu Bufaransa ku ya 25 Ukuboza 2024, na Condor Distribution.
Ernest Cole yashyizwe ahagaragara amahano ya Apartheid akoresheje amafoto, bimuviramo guhungira muri Amerika kugira ngoyirinde gutotezwa kw’abanyamakuru b’abirabura muri Afurika yepfo. Byinshi mu bikorwa bye ntibyakomeje gutangazwa kugeza mu 2017, igihe habonetse ibibi 60.000 muri banki yo muri Suwede.
Muri Gicurasi 2023, byatangajwe ko Raoul Peck azayobora documentaire izenguruka Ernest Cole, hamwe na Magnolia Pictures igiye gukwirakwizwa muri Amerika. Iyi documentaire yakozwe kubufatanye n’umutungo wa Cole, aho Peck yaboneyeho kwinjira mububiko bwe.
Muri Gashyantare mumwaka wa 2024, byatangajwe ko LaKeith Stanfield izumvikana Cole.

Nollywood Babilon ni film mbarankuru yomuri 2008 yayobowe na Ben Addelman na Samir Mallal. Yakozwe nnkigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe amafilime muri Kanada, kijyanye no gukundwa guturika kwa firime zo muri Nigeriya. Ikwirakwizwa ry’Ubwongereza ni Dogwoof Pictures.

Five Roads to Freedom: From Apartheid to the World cup ni filime ya documentaire ya 2010 ifatanije na Robin Benger na Jane Thandi Lipman ireba impinduka z’impinduramatwara muri Afurika y'Epfo binyuze mumaso y'abagabo n'abagore batanu babaga mu gicucu cya apartheid.
Iyi filime yibanze kubantu batanu baturutse hiryanohino mu mibereho nomubya politiki: abantu basanzwe bafite uburambe bugaragaza impinduka zikomeye zabaye mu myaka 15 ishize kandi ubuzima bwabo mu 2010 bukaba bwerekana amasezerano ndetse n'ibidasobanutse neza muri Afurika y'Epfo.
"Five Roads to Freedom" ni umushinga wihariye ku mukinnyi wa firime Robin Benger. Nkumuyobozi w’abanyeshuri bo muri Afurika yepfo mu mpera za 1960 no mu ntangiriro ya za 70, yatawe muri yombi inshuro eshatu azira ibikorwa byo kurwanya ivanguramoko, amaherezo yirukanwa mu gihugu. Iyi filime yakozwe na Ian Ayres, Robin Benger, Eric Ellena, Jane Thandi Lipman, Joseph Oesi na Christopher Sumpton.

Between two worlds (umutwe wumwimerere: Zwischen zwei Welten) ni film mbarankuru yo muri 1999 yakozwe numuyobozi Bettina Haasen. Filime yibanze kubiganiro hagati yumuyobozi Haasen nabagize umuryango wimuka wa Woodabe muriNijeriya. Inyandiko ifite uburyo bwamoko.

Wigeze Wumva kuva Johannesburg ni urukurikirane rw'amafilime zirindwi ya 2010, akubiyemo urugamba rumaze imyaka 45 rugamije kurwanya ivanguramoko ku isi yose kurwanya gahunda ya apartheid yo muri Afurika y'Epfo ndetse n'abayishyigikiye mpuzamahanga babonaga ko bafatanije mu ntambara y'ubutita.
Filime zahujwe zifite interanini, izenguruka igice kinini cyisi hejuru yikinyejana. Guhera ku nama ya mbere y’umuryango w’abibumbye, bikarangira mu 1990, ubwo, nyuma y’imyaka 27 muri gereza, Nelson Mandela, umuyobozuzwi cyane muri Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika yazengurutse isi nkumuntu wigenga. Yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Connie Field, ikubiyemo ibindi bintu nk'ubwicanyi bwa Sharpeville, imyigaragambyo ya Soweto n'iyicwa rya Steve Biko.
Urukurikirane rw'izina rukomoka kumagambo y'indirimbo Gil Scott-Heron "Johannesburg'
Hamwe nigihe cyogukora cyamasaha 8 niminota 30, "Wigeze wumva kuva Johannesburg" yerekanwe bwa mbere mu nama ya Film yabereye i Manhattan, mu mujyi wa New York, ku ya 14 Mata
Mumyaka ya za 1950, abirabura benshi bomuri Afurika yepfo bamenye ko urugamba rwo kurwanya ivanguramoko rugomba kubakwa mu bibuga bine by’ibikorwa: ibikorwa rusange, ishyirahamwe ry’ubutaka, intambara yitwaje intwaro, hamwe n’ubukangurambaga mpuzamahanga. "Wigeze Wumva Kuva Johannesburg" ijyana abayireba imbere yikibuga cyanyuma, ihuriro ryo gukangurira abaturage kwisi yose ibikorwa byo guha akato ubutegetsi bwa apartheid. Batewe inkunga n'ubutwari n'imibabaro by'abaturage ba Afurika y'Epfo ubwo barwanaga kurwanya ihohoterwa no gukandamiza ivanguramoko, imitwe y’ubufatanye bw’amahanga, ku bufatanye n’abanyafurika yepfo bari mu buhungiro, bafashe icyemezo cyo kurwanya ivanguramoko. Mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ibibazo bikomeye, mu bihe byo kutitabira ubutumwa cyangwa gushyigikira guverinoma ya Hendrik Verwoerd, John Vorster na PW Botha, abakangurambaga bahamagariye guverinoma zabo n’amasosiyete akomeye yo mu Burengerazuba guhangana n’ubusambanyi bw’ubufatanye bwabo na apartheid.
Ntabwo yarintambara ya politiki gusa; byarubukungu, umuco, umuco, na roho. Urugamba rwaje mu bibuga byinshi bitangaje: byakorewe mu bibuga by'imikino no muri katedrali, muri ambasade no mu byumba by’inama by’amasosiyete, ku mbuto z’imbuto n’inyanja, mu bitaramo bya rock na sitasiyo ya lisansi. Ibihumbi n’ibihumbi barapfuye, ariko amaherezo, igitutu kitagira urugomo cyagize uruhare runini mu gusenyuka kwa apartheid bityo bituma intsinzi itangaje ya demokarasi muri Afurika yepfo.
1.. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: Road to Resistance
Filime yambere itangira mu 1948 igihe Umuryango w’abibumbye wemeje Itangazo Mpuzamahanga ry’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu. Muri uwo mwaka, Afurika y'Epfo yashyize mu bikorwa gahunda y'amategeko yiswe ivanguramoko kugira ngo itandukanya ubwoko bwayo mu bice byose by'ubuzima. Abirabura benshi muri Afurika y'Epfo, bayobowe na Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika, bakoze ubukangurambaga bwo Kwanga, bikurura ibitekerezo by’abarwanashyaka ahantu nk'Ubwongereza, Suwede, na Amerika - maze babiba imbuto z'umuryango mpuzamahanga urwanya ivanguramoko. Isi yakiriye ubwoba ubwo abigaragambyaga mu mahoro baraswaga mu mujyi wa Sharpeville wo muri Afurika yepfo maze abayobozi bose ba Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika bahatirwa mu nsi cyangwa bafungwa. Nelson Mandela afunzwe ubuzima bwe bwose kandi urugendo rwo muri Afurika yepfo rwahagaritswe neza kuko amagana ahungira mubuhungiro.
2. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: Hell of a Job
Filime yakabiri itangirigihe Perezida wungirije wa Kongere y’igihugu cy’Afurika Oliver Tambo yatorokaga muri Afurika yepfo akajya mu buhungiro maze atangira icyahindutse urugendo rw’imyaka 30 yo kwishora mu isi mu rugamba rwo kuzana demokarasi muri Afurika yepfo. Hamwe n’imyigaragambyo muri Afurika yepfo yajanjaguwe neza n’ubutegetsi bwa apartheid, iherezo ry’urugamba rwo kwibohora ryari mu maboko ya Tambo. Yabanje kubona abayoboke mu bihugu bishya byigenga bya Afurika, maze hamwe n'imbaraga zabo zose inyuma ye, yegera Umuryango w'Abibumbye kugira ngo amushyigikire, ashimangira ko guverinoma ya apartheid ishobora guhatirwa ku meza y'ibiganiro mu gihe akanama gashinzwe umutekano kazemera kandi kigaha akato ubutegetsi. Ariko ibihugu by’iburengerazuba byanze gukora, bihatira Tambo gushaka inkunga nshya. Yasabye byimazeyo Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abasoviyeti ubufasha mu kubaka ingabo z’inyeshyamba, icyemezo kikaba cyarafashe Tambo na Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika ku mwanya w’intambara y'ubutita kandi bikurikirana imbaraga z’isi yose mu myaka iri imbere.
Arikwabantu babiri bafashijwe gukingura imiryango ikomeye mu Burengerazuba: Olof Palme, Minisitiri w’intebe wa Suwede, na Arkiyepiskopi Trevor Huddleston, inkunga yabo ya mbere yatumye Oliver Tambo ashakisha ubufatanye n’ubuyobozi bw’amadini ku isi. Mu ntangiriro ya za 70, Tambo na ANC bari barabonye inkunga muri Suwede kandi bashyigikirwa n'Inama y'Itorero ku Isi, abayoboke bayo mu matorero yo ku isi bifatanya mu kurwanya ivanguramoko. Hamwe nabafatanyabikorwa bashya kuruhanderwe, Tambo yagize intangiriro yumuryango wisi yose.
3. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: The New Generation
Muri filime yagatatu nurubyiruko, habamuri Afurika y'Epfo ndetse nohanze yayo, bakurikiranwaho kwinjira mumutwe ugenda urwanya ivanguramoko. Tambo yatewe inkunga n'inkunga nshya mu bihugu by'iburengerazuba, yagarutse mu Muryango w'Abibumbye kugira ngo agerageze kumvisha urwego rw'isi kwemerera Afurika y'Epfo. Imbaraga ze zashyigikiwe n’abaturage mu gihe gukandamiza bikabije imyigaragambyo y’urubyiruko mu mujyi wa Soweto wo muri Afurika yepfo ndetse n’urupfu rutavugwaho rumwe na Steve Biko rwahinduye Afurika y'Epfo igihugu kiva mu gihugu, kikaba ikimenyetso cy’akarengane ku isi. Mu 1977, intsinzi ikomeye yatsindiye igihe Umuryango w’abibumbye watangaga intwaro iteganijwe: iyambere mu mateka. Ariko abafatanyabikorwa bakomeye bo muri Afurika yepfo mu bucuruzi bw’iburengerazuba ntibakomeza kubyemera mu bukungu, kandi ubwo Tambo yerekezaga muri Zambiya kugira ngo akorere minisitiri w’ingabo z’inyeshyamba za Kongere y’Afurika yiyongera, kumena amaraso byasaga naho byanze bikunze. Nubwo leta z’iburengerazuba zikomeye zanze kumvira icyifuzo cya Tambo cyo kwamagana umuco n’ubukungu, abaturage bo muri ibyo bihugu by’iburengerazuba bari gufasha guhindura inzira.
4. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: Fair Play
Muri firime yakane abakinnyi n’abaharanira inyungu ku isi, bahuye na guverinoma zanga gufata ingamba zifatika zo kurwanya ubutegetsi bwa apartheid, bwibasiye Afurika yepfo yera aho bibabaza: ku kibuga. Ibihano mpuzamahanga byamagana amakipe y'imikino ya apartheid bifasha kuzana ikibazo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Afurika yepfo ku mwanya wa mbere ku isi hose no guca umubano w’umuco w’Afurika yepfo n’umuco w’iburengerazuba. Kubera ko yari azi ko abirabura bagenzi babo bo muri Afurika yepfo bangiwe n’uburenganzira bw’ibanze bw’ikiremwamuntu - tutibagiwe n’uburenganzira bwo kwitabira amarushanwa mpuzamahanga ya siporo - ibihugu by’Afurika byanze guhatana n’amakipe y’abazungu bo muri Afurika yepfo y’abazungu, bahakana imikino Olempike ndetse banashyira ahagaragara ibitaramo ku bitangazamakuru ku isi hose bituma Komite mpuzamahanga ya Olempike ibuza amakipe ya apartheid mu mikino iri imbere. Ihuriro riyobowe na Afurika ryayoboye urugamba rwo gukumira Afurika y'Epfo mu mupira w'amaguru, umukino w'iteramakofe, umukino wo gusiganwa ku magare, gusiganwa ku magare, judo, kuzitira, imikino ngororamubiri, volley ball n'andi marushanwa menshi, kandi ibuza amakipe yo muri Afurika y'Epfo kwitabira imikino hafi ya yose mu myaka ya za 70. Gusa hasigaye ikipe ya nyampinga wa ruhago ku isi muri Afurika yepfo, kandi abaturage bo mu bihugu by’iburengerazuba bikinirwa umukino wa rugby bajyanye mu murima kugira ngo bafunge umuryango wanyuma kuri siporo ya apartheid. Iyamamaza rya siporo ryabaye intsinzi yambere y’umutwe urwanyivanguramoko kandi ryatsindiye umuco wo gutandukanya umuco w’abazungu mukibuga cy’ingirakamaro.
5. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: From Selma to Soweto
Filime yagatanu yibanze kurumwe mubafatanyabikorwa bakomeye muri Afrika yepfo Reta Zunzubumwe z'Amerika.Yabaye ikibanza gikomeye mu rugamba rwo kurwanya ivanguramoko kuko Abanyamerika-Abanyamerika bayoboye ikirego cyo guhindura politiki ya guverinoma ku butegetsi bwa apartheid. Umuryango w’ibanze wo gushaka amashuri makuru, inama z’umujyi, na leta kugira ngo bagabanye imigabane yabo mu masosiyete akora ubucuruzi muri Afurika yepfo yakwirakwiriye mu gihugu cyose bahatira Kongere y’Amerika kwemerera Afurika yepfo. Iyi ntsinzi itangaje yatsinzwe na perezida Ronald Reagan utavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi. Abanyafurika-Abanyamerika bahinduye cyane politiki y’ububanyi n’amahanga ya Amerika ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka. Ibihano by’i Burayi byakurikiranye, hamwe na bo, kwigunga kwa politiki y’ubutegetsi bwa apartheid.
6. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: The Bottom Line
Filime esheshatu ninkuru yubukangurambaga mpuzamahanga bwa mbere bwibanze bwo gukoresha igitutu cyubukungu kugirango ifashe guhirika leta. Amaze kubona ko ubutegetsi bwa apartheid bushingiye ku mikoreshereze y’imari y’iburengerazuba, abaturage ku isi yose, guhera ku bakozi ba Polaroid kugeza ku muyobozi wa Motors rusange, guhera ku bafite konti y’abanyeshuri muri Banki ya Barclays kugeza ku baguzi banga gaze ya Shell, bose banze ko ubucuruzi na Afurika yepfo bukomeza nk'uko bisanzwe. Ubukangurambaga no kwamagana ibikorwa byazanye ibikorwa byo kurwanya ivanguramoko mu mibereho no mu baturage b’abantu ku isi, bifasha abantu ba buri munsi gusobanukirwa no guhangana n’ubukungu bw’iburengerazuba bushingiye ku ivangura. Muguhangana n'ibitero byabereye murugo ndetse n'akajagari kiyongera muri Afurika y'Epfo, amasosiyete mpuzamahanga yavuyemu kwimuka kwabenshi, ateza ikibazo cy'amafaranga muri Afurika y'Epfo kandi byerekana neza kwiminsi y'ubutegetsi bwa apartheid ibaze.
7. Have You Heard from Johannesburg: Free at Last
Filime yakarindwi, kandi yanyuma, yibera muntandaro y’amakimbirane, Abanyafurika yepfo bavuga amateka y’imbaraga zikomeye mu gikorwa cyo kurwanya ivanguramoko ryo mu myaka ya za 80: ihuriro ryahuje ingabo zirwanya ivanguramoko muri Afurika yepfo nka mbere. Imbaga nyamwinshi yongerewe imbaraga zitigeze zibaho igihe ibisekuruza bitatu byabarwanyi barwanyaga hamwe nka United Democratic Front. Guhangana n’ubwigunge mpuzamahanga bugenda bwiyongera, guverinoma ya apartheid yagerageje gutsindira abayoboke nokwemeza isi kwaringombwa ko ivugurura ryayo ryihariye nubwo ryageragezaga guhashya kwigomeka ku mugaragaro, rimwe na rimwe rikoresha amayeri y’ibanga. Imyigaragambyo y’ubumwe bwa demokarasi iharanira demokarasi yageze ku ndunduro mu gikorwa gishya cyo Kwanga, kandi ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Nelson Mandela yabaye izina mu rugo kuko ubukangurambaga bwo kumurekura bwatwitse isi yose. Hafashwe hagati y’imyigaragambyo y’imbere idahagarikwa n’igitutu mpuzamahanga gikomeje, ubutegetsi bwa apartheid bwaje guhatirwa ku meza y’imishyikirano, amaherezo bukuraho ibimaze imyaka ibarirwa muri za mirongo bibuza Kongere y’igihugu nyafurika. Nyuma y’imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi muri gereza, Nelson Mandela yararekuwe, bituma habaho ibirori ku isi yose ubwo yazengurukaga isi ashimira bose. Nyuma yimyaka 30 mu buhungiro, Oliver Tambo amaherezo yashoboye gusubira muri Afrika yepfo. Ariko urugamba rwari rwamuteye ubwoba kandi azapfa umwaka umwe mbere yuko mugenzi we, Nelson Mandela, atorerwa kuba perezida wambere w’abirabura wa Afurika yepfo ishingiye kuri demokarasi.
Filime ndwi zagabanijwe kugezakubice bitanu kuri tereviziyo kandi zerekanwa kuri "Independent Lens" kuri PBS muri 2012.
Keith Uhlich wo muri "Time Out New York" yiswe Have You Heard from "Johannesburg" filime ya cumi nziza ya 2010 mu mwaka wa 2010, ayita "amashusho yagutse, afite impande nyinshi."
Uruhererekane rwatsindiye igihembo cya Primetime Emmy kubera azigukina amafilime ya documentaire bidasazwe mu 2012, kubera kobyanyuze kuri PBS.
"Have You Heard from Johannesburg" yasohotse kuri DVD irindwi ya disiki yashyizweho mu 2011 na Clarity Films, buri firime kuri disiki itandukanye. Buri disiki irimo ibikoresho byinyongera.

Saving Africa's Witch Children ni filim mbarankuru yayobowe na Mags Gavan na Joost van der Valk. Irimo Gary Foxcroft numuryango we Stepping Stones Nigeriya biyamamariza kurwanya abana nkabapfumu muriNijeriya, cyane cyane nivugabutumwa "Liberty Foundation Gospel Ministries", yayobowe na Helen Ukpabio.
Mu turere tumwe natumwe dukennye cyane twomuri Nijeriya, ishyaka ryivugabutumwa ry’ivugabutumwa rya Pentekote rihujwe nimyizerere ya kera ariko ikomeje gutsimbarara kumyizere yomurafurika nko kuroga no nubupfumu. Ibihumbi n'ibihumbi by'abana barahohotewe, barahohotewe, baratereranywe cyangwa baricwa kuko bashinjwa kuba barazanye indwara, ibyago, urupfu n'inzara kubera uburozi bwabo.

More than just a game ni film ya documentaire igice cya 2007 iyobowe na Junaid Ahmed. Iyi filime yerekana uburyo imfungwa za politiki zo ku kirwa cya Robben muri Afurika y'Epfo zashinze Makana FA mu 1966. Ibindi biganiro twagiranye na Mark Shinners, Anthony Suze, Sedick Isaacs, Lizo Sitoto na Marcus Solomon bihuza amashusho yongeye gushyirwaho.
Ikirwa cya Robben nigereza iyobowe n'ubutegetsi bwa apartheid yomuri Afurika y'Epfo. Imfungwa zose hari abantu bitandukanije nokurwanya ububutegetsi muburyo bumwe. Nubwo bimeze bityo, imico yabo, ibitekerezo byabo nuburyo butandukanye igihe kinini.
Kubw'impanuka imfungwa zamenye ko zose zikunda umupira w'amaguru. Gushakisha ikintu gishobora gutuma ubuzima bwa gereza butakwihanganirwa, bemeye gusaba uruhushya rwo gukina umupira mugihe cyabo cyakazi hanyuma batangira gutora abahagarariye. Gusaba kwambere kwangwa ariko amaherezo gukomeza imfungwa birishyura.
Byihuse bigakwitegura ubwabo. Shampiyona yumupira wamaguru numutaka abantu bafunzwe bashobora kugeraho kwiyobora neza. Icyerekezo cya gereza amaherezo gishyigikira Makana FA ibaha imyenda yumupira wamaguru ndetse ikanakinirwa ikibuga cyubahiriza amabwiriza ya FIFA.
Nubwobafite imicitandukanye abayobozi batowe n’imfungwa bagaragaza ubushobozi bwabo bwo kujya impaka no gukemura buri wese mu batavuga rumwe muburyo bwiza. Abayobozi bazi ko kandi bativanga iyo batanze ubuhamya. Basa nkaho batangiye kumva abo bantu badakeneye umuntu ubatera inkunga.
Amaherezo, abashinze Makana FA barangije ibihano kandi bavakukirwa cyagereza. Barekuwe mu gihugu kigiye guhinduka ubuziraherezo kandi kizabaha amahirwe yo kwerekana ubuhanga bwabo bwo kuyobora mu bwisanzure.

Suky nifilime irwana yomuri Nijeriya 2025 yakozwe na Bamidele Adelusi, yatanzwe binyuze muri Studiyo ya Nemsia kandi iyobowe na Ola Cardoso. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo Tobi Bakre, Bimbo Ademoye, James Damilare, Olarotimi Fakunle, Femi Adebayo, Ibrahim Yekini nabandi. Yashyizwe ahagaragara na Video ya Amazone Prime kuya 7 Werurwe 2025, "Suky" azenguruka umupira w'iteramakofe wa Dambe munsi yubutaka mazeakurikira umuntu utwarwa no kwihorera kandiko ari ngombwa guhora urupfu rwase, ugasanga yafatiwe mwisi yiteramakofe kandi agomba guharanira umudendezo we.
Umuhungu ukiri muto witwa Suky yavukiye mumurage w'iteramakofe wa Dambe, kuberako se yari shampiyoni muri siporo. Ubuzima bwe burahungabana iyo abonye se yiciwe imbere ye. Amaze kwihorera, Suky yiyemeje gushaka umwicanyi no kwihorera urupfu rwa se. Bidatinze, yateguwe kubera ubwicanyi no koherezwa muri gereza ya Aja, aho abanyapolitiki nintore bononekaye bagenzura amarushanwa yoguterana amakofe ya Dambe. Suky yazamutse hejuru, atsinda benshi bahanganye, mugihe cyamarushanwa. Amaherezo arwana numuntu wishese kandi agomba guhitamo kwihorera nicyubahiro.

My Song Goes Forth (izwi kandi ku izina rya Afurika Iririmba, Afurika Irareba, Ubwongereza, 1937), ni filime ya mbere ivuga kuri Afurika y'Epfo kuko ivangura ryashyizweho. Muri iyi filime hagaragaramo umuririmbyi, umukinnyi w’umukinnyi uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu Paul Robeson uririmba indirimbo y’umutwe kandi yongeraho prologue isaba abayireba gusobanura ibisigaye bya filime binyuranyije n’umugambi wa prodiyusa. Ubundi buryo bwiswe "Afurika Iririmba", intego yambere ya firime yari nkumukinyi wiganjemo abazungu bigufi-bigizwe n'amatangazo yerekana ivuka rya apartheid muri Afrika yepfo ariko hamwe n'ubutumwa buvuguruzanya mumajwi. Ahanini iyi documentaire yahujwe na Robeson hamwe n’ibikorwa byo kurwanya Anti-Apartheid hakiri kare kubera ko yongeye gutunganya no kwandika inkuru za firime.
Agatabo kamenyekanisha mbere kuriyi filime igihe yiswe "Afurika Iririmba", kavuze ko kerekana "icyo umuzungu yagezeho" kandi ngo "ibyo yakoreye abenegihugu." "Afurika Iririmba" nimwe muri filime za documentaire za mbere zaturutse muri Afurika y'Epfo zarebye ubuzima bw'Abanyafurika y'Epfo b'amoko yose. Hano hari amashusho yubuzima bwaho, amashuri na kaminuza, hamwe nigice cyimyuga, uhereye kubakozi bakora mu birombe kugeza ku gatsiko k’imihanda, abarimu-shuri kugeza ku bakozi bo mu rugo, abategereza kugeza ku bakata inkoni. Abasesenguzi nyamukuru batanze documentaire igisubizo cyiza; Umukozi wa London Daily Worker yatekereje ko ari bibi cyane kuburyo adashobora guharanira intego yo kwibohora.
Paul Robeson's rewritten narration and singing.
Yahawakazi n'umuyobozi Joseph Best, Robeson yakoze yitonze kugirango asubiremo prologue kandi muri verisiyo yanyuma avuga,
"Ubikirenge cyosecya Afurika cyashyizwe mumoko y'abazungu. Kuki ibi byabaye? Niki cyabateye kujyayo? Niba uteze amatwi abagabo nka Mussolini bazakubwira ko ari 'umuco' - umurimo uva ku Mana, washinzwe abantu bamurikirwa gutwara itara ry'umucyo no kwiga, no kugirira akamaro Abanyafurika kugira ngo ubone inyungu - ubwe."
Robeson kandi aririmba indirimbo ishyigikiye kwibohora muri Afurika,
"Kuva mumashyamba yo muri Afurika, kraal n'akazu Ahigicucu kigwa kumucyo mwinshi Indirimbo yanjye irasohoka kandi irasaba Mu gushaka urukundo n'uburenganzira Ndashaka iyo nyenyeri iri kure cyangwa hafi Erekana abantu bose inzira isobanutse Gukorera murumuna we Kandiwirukane urwango n'ubwoba "

Murugendo rwe muri Enugu, yahisemo inzira ihendutse yogutwara abantu bakunze kwita 'Soole,' ahoyahuye nabagenzi batandukanye nka we. Sea Point Days ni filime ya documentaire yo mu 2008 ivuga ibyerekeye Cape Town mu nkengero za Sea Point, iyobowe na François Verster.
Kuruhande rwumujyi womumajyepfo cyane muri Afrika, utandukanya umujyi ninyanja, ushyiraho agace kihariye cyane. Shyira aharindimuka nziza yinyanja ya Atalantika kuruhande rumwe na Signal Hill kurundi ruhande, Sea Point Promenade hamwe na pisine rusange yo koga hagati yayo ikora umwanya utandukanye na Cape Town. Rimwe na rimwe rishingiye ku guhezwa kwa Apartheid, ubu irihariye mu bigaragara ko byoroshye kuvanga imyaka, ubwoko, igitsina, idini, imiterere y'ubutunzi, ndetse n'imibonano mpuzabitsina. Nuburyo, uyu mwanya wabaye umwe mubanyafurika yepfo bose bumva ko bafite uburenganzira bwo kubaho, kandi amahirwe yo kwishima mwisi yacitsemo ibice asa nkaho bishoboka. Nigute abantu babona ahahise habo? Abantu babona bate amateka yabo, ibihe byabo muruyumwanya ndetse n'ejo hazazahabo murikigihugu?
Iyi filime yagaragaye bwambere ku isi mw'Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto.

Antique ni filime yikinamico yakiniwe kandi inasohokera mu gihugu cya Nigeriya mu 2014 iyobowe na Darasen Richards na DJ Tee. Irimo Olu Jacobs, Bimbo Akintola, Gabriel Afolayan, Ricardo Agbor, Seun Akindele na Funsho Adeolu.
Filime ye rekanywe hamwe numuryango wishimye kandi watsinze mugihe basangiye umugabane wabo, ariko haribintu bitunguranye mugihe ibiremwa bitatu bidasanzwe byateye mubwami bashaka ibya kera; ifite imbaraga zo kurinda abaturage bayo no gukomeza ubwami bwayo. Abarwanyi b'ubwami baratsinzwe kandi abateye bakuraho ikirango cyera, bityo bazana umuvumo ku gihugu.
Nyuma yimyaka icumi, umuhungu umwe rukumbi wa Oba yararwaye azagupfa. Nkuko byagaragajwe na muganga wabapfumu, uburwayi buterwa no kubura kera. Kubwibyo rero, kugirango uruziga rw’impfu n’inzara mu gihugu birangire, umukobwa w’inzirakarengane witwa Uki (Oge Indiana) yahisemo gushyira ubuzima bwe mu kaga yerekeza mu gihugu abantu babujijwe, mu rwego rwo gushaka no gusubiza kera.
Abarwanyi batatu bari baratoranijwe badasanzwe, bazahagarara kubusa kugeza bageze kuntego zabo, baherekeza Uki. Urugendo rugaragaza ko ari ubutumwa bisa nkibidashoboka kuko bahuye nimbaraga mbi zidapfa, zigerageza kubabuza kugera kuntego zabo. Umuganga wumupfumu hamwe numureshya witwa Isoken afite gahunda yihishe mugihe impungenge zagarutse mumudugudu zigaragaza urukurikirane rwingufu mugukoresha ubwami. Hagati aho, kugaruka kwa Uki n'abarwanyi ntibizwi.

Hoodrush ni filime ya ishingiye kumuziki yomuri Nigeriya yakizwe muri 2012 yanditswe, yakozwe, kandi yayobowe na Dimeji Ajibola, ikinwamo na OC Ukeje, Bimbo Akintola, na Gabriel Afolayan. Amashusho meza yarimeza, amashusho yimibonano mpuzabitsina yarihejuru cyane, aho imirwano yari yemerwa, ndetse ikaba nziza kurutazimwe mu mashusho yaberaga i Hollywood".

Awakening ni yakinywe kandi insohorerwa muri Nigeriya yijimye ya 2013 yayobowe na James Omokwe na Ethan Okwara ikinwamo OC Ukeje, Kehinde Bankole, Femi Brainard na Bryan Okwara. Yatowe mu cyiciro cya AMAA Awakening kuba yaragaragaye muraya matora ya AMMAA byagize Ingaruka Ziboneka mu bihembo bya 9 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards. Iyi filime niyo filime kuri Nollywood Yongeye kugaruka mugihe cyo gusohoka, n'amanota 81%.
Filime yakiriwe neza cyane kandi yashimiwe cyane kubikorwa byayo byiza kandi byemewe. Nollywood Reinvented yayihaye amanota 81%, akaba ari yo filime yagize manota menshi ku rubuga icyo gihe maze avuga ati: "Inkuru iri muri iyi filime irashimishije kandi iratangaje gusa, kandi ntabwo ari inkuru y’ibanze ubwayo ahubwo ni uduce duto twose tugize byose. Umwanditsi w'ibitabo akora umurimo utangaje wo guhuza ibintu byose ku buryo nta kintu na kimwe kivuga ko nanditse ku buryo butagaragara. firime isaba ko uyitaho kandi iyo uhumye amaso hashobora kubura ikintu gikomeye ". Yashimye kandi ubuhanga bwo gukina Kehinde Bankole, agira ati: "Kureba Kehinde Bankole kuri ecran nta kintu na kimwe kijyanye n'uburambe... agutegeka ibitekerezo byawe hose."
"Awakening" yahawe igihembo mu bihembo bya 9 bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards kubera icyiciro "yagezweho mu mashusho agaragara" (hamwe "n’indege iheruka yerekeza Abuja" na "Twin Sword"). Yatowe kandi muri "Filime yumwaka" muri Afurika Magic Viewers Choice Awards 2014.

"Dolce Vita Africana" ni filime mbarankuru ivuga kumafoto azwicyane yomuri Mali yafotora Malick Sidibé, amashusho yishusho kuva mu mpera za 1950 kugeza mumyaka yaza 70 yafashe umwuka utitaye kugisekuru cye ushimangira ubwisanzure bwabo nyuma yubwigenge ndetse kugeza igihe ubutegetsi bwa kisilamu bwatangiriye mumyaka yigitugu cya gisirikare. Ikogosi: The Last Turn on Left ni filime yinkinamico yomuri Nigeriya yakozwe muri 2015, yakozwe kandi iyoborwa na Toka McBaror. Irimo Chelsea Eze, IK Ogbonna, Lisa Omoriodon, Leo Orji, Didi Ekanem. Filime ivuga "inkuru yomubiruhuko bigenda nabi bigahinduka urugendo rubi".
Murirusange filime yashimwe nabangenzuzi ba film.
"Ikogosi" yashimwe nabangenzuzi ba film. Ada wa Nollywood Reinvented yaha iyifirime 2 kuri 5 byinyenyeri, ashima igishushanyo mbonera, umuziki nimyambarire, ariko anenga inkuru namashusho, imikorere yabakinnyi, ndetse no kuyobora. Yashoje avuga ati: "Nubwo harinkuru zihagije zerekeye umubano nubukwe byanze bikunze bigomba kubwirwa, byakozwe inshuro nyinshi. Harakenewe gukora firime hirya no hinoku ngingo zongeramo urwego kandi zivuga inkuru muburyo butandukanye kandi butunguranye. Hariho ibipimo bihagije kumugambi wa "Ikogosi" wo kwiteza imbere kandi imyanzuro yarikwiye rwose gushyirwaho. Ntabwo nakugira inama yogufata igihe cyo kureba iyi filime keretse urambiwe." Adenike Adebayo yanenze cyane intego ya film maze ayitondekanya inyenyeri 1 kuri 5.

Busola (Immaculate Oko Kasum) - umuforomokazi ukirimuto ufitese utemewe kandi akaba n'umukunziwe wiyemeje-phobic - yavumbuye imana hanze mu nzira yerekeza ku kazi ibura mu buryo butangaje ubwo yahamagaye nyina w’umwuka cyane (Tina Mba). Uwa nyuma yumva atamenyereye urugo, maze aha umukobwa we umugisha amavuta ya elayo asezeranya kujyana nawe ahantu hose. Amaze gutandukana n'umukunzi we Lanre, Busola asigaye acitse intege, cyane cyane nyuma y'itariki yakurikiyeho itameze neza, kugeza ubwo akunda Tunji (Efa Iwara), umurwayi ukize amufata urumuri. Bisola, umushumba we yari aherutse guhanura ko vuba aha azarongora umugabo ubereye muruwomwaka, aboniterambererye arikimenyetso, ariko nyinawe ntabyemera nubwo seyafashe uruhande rw'umukobwawe.
Abifashijwemo n'inshutiye Jola (Bukunmi Adeaga-Ilori), Busola - witegura umunsiwogusangira - yakiriye marike, yambaye imitako Tunji yari yamuhaye mu rwego rw'itsinda rye. Mugihe cyo kurya mu bwato bwe, Bisola ahura nibintu bidasanzwe bifitanye isano numukufi we. Nyina abonye akaga, agerageza kurinda umukobwa we binyuze mu masengesho, ariko umugabo we, abitewe n'imyuka mibi, ahagarika amasomo ye amukubita ubwenge. Yahise ajyanwa mu bitaro, maze Tunji amwemerera kwakira Busola na se mugihe akize. Nyuma y’inzozimbi zerekanibiza, yapfuye azize ibikomere nyuma yiminsi, maze Busola avunika umutima asaba ihumure Tunji, watumiye ubutumire bwoguhura n’umuryangowe.
Ibintubyahindutse umwijima iyogusura umuryango wa Busola bihindutse ibintubibi cyane birimo imihango yo gutamba n'imbaraga ndengakamere, bikamuhatira kurwanira ubuzima bwe.

Emitaï ([ɛ.mi.ta.i], izina ryimana ya Diola) ni film yinkinamico yakozwe muri 1971 yomuri Senegali iyobowe na Ousmane Sembène.
Mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, guverinoma ya Vichy yatoranyije abagabo baba koloni bo mubufaransa. Imyivumbagatanyo yatangiriye mumudugudu wa Diola aho abagore bahisha umusaruro wumuceri aho gutanga umusoro wubufaransa. Abayobozi ba Diola bungurana ibitekerezo ku gisubizo cyiza kuri politiki yabafaransa ikarishye, kandi ibintu birihutirwa iyabafaransa ningabo zabo zabakoloni barasa ku barwanyi ba Diola. Diola igerageza kugisha inama imana zabo, harimo na Emitaï, guhangana nabafaransa biriyongera. Bidatinze, ibyapa bya Charles de Gaulle bisimbuza ibyapa bya Marshal Pétain wa Vichy, byerekana impinduka zingana zubutegetsi muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba bw’Ubufaransa. Irihinduka rya politiki ritunguranye, ariko, ntabwo rihindura ukibintu bimeze kurwego rwumudugudu, kandi amaherezo ingabo zabakoloni zakoze ubwicanyi bwabagabo ba Diola.
"Emitai" yahawe izina ryayo kumana yomuri Senegal, "uhagarariye igice kiva mucyiciro kimwe cyubuzima kijya mu gishya kandi cyiza".
"Emitai" yasohotse muri Senegali muwi 1971, nmu 1972 muri Amerika. Yagenzuwe imyaka itanu muri Afrika ivuga Igifaransa. Filime yinjiye mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya 7 rya Moscou aho yatsindiye igihembo cya silver.
Mugitabo cye"cyitwa Family Guide to Film on Video", Henry Herx yanditse ko "inkuru nyinshi zivugwa gusa binyuze mumashusho yerekana, aya mashusho ni imbaraga zikomeye za filime".
