Umuyobozi ushinzwe udushya mumashusho akaba n'umwanditsi Jadesola Osiberu yubatse ikigitekerezo mugihe bakoraga uyumushinga wewa mbere, "Gidi Up", yashingiye kukureba ubuzima bwa buri munsi bwabaturage binyuze mumadirishya yinyubako zituranye. Amanota yahimbwe na Tolu Obanro, Chike yatanze umuzanzu mumagambo yindirimbo zimwe. Amafoto nyamukuru yakorewe kukirwa cya Lagos.
"Gangs of Lagos" yerekanwe kuya 4 Nzeri 2022 mw' iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya Toronto 2022. Yasohowe bidasubirwaho na Sitidiyo ya Amazone MGM ibinyujije kuri Video ya mbere kuya 7 Mata Iyifilime kandi yatsindiye ibihembo byinshi mumwaka wa 2023 Africa Movie Academy Awards.
Iyifilime yateje impaka nyuma y gusohoka inakomeza kuziteza kuva icyo gihe. Byasobanuwe kari "ugusuzugura umuco wo muri Lagos" hanyuma isabirwa guhagarikwa mu bitangazamakuru bya Nollywood na guverinoma ya Lagos. Oba ya Lagos numuryango wa Kosoko bamaganye iyifilime kubera koyerekanaga masikare ya Eyo nkudutsiko twabagizi ba nabi bagize uruhare mubwicanyi buteye ubwoba no gutera ubwoba abaturage binzirakarengane. "Agatsiko ka Lagos" gakomeje kuba umwe mu binjije amafaranga menshi muri Nigeriya muri sinema ya Nigeriya, yinjije miliyoni zisaga 230. Yamenyekanye kandi muri Prime Video mwi 10 za mbere kwisi ikurikiranwa cyane badakoresha ururirimi rw' Icyongereza, ishingiye ku mikorere yayo hanze y’igihugu yakomokamo kugeza igihe yasohoye.
Obalola,Gift, na Ify bari inshuti eshatu zavukiye zina kurira muri Ìsàlẹ̀ Èkó, umuryango wariwiganjemo ihohoterwa rikorwa na politiki, ubugizi bwa nabi, n’agatsiko, ubujura, no guharanira ubutegetsi. Obalola, akiri umwana, abona se - wahoze ari umwami w’umuryango - araswa mu buryo bubabaje na masike ya Eyo. Mugihe bari mumodoka, inshuti eshatu ziba umufuka wumugore, urimo amafaranga na pasiporo mpuzamahanga. Uyu mugore abimenyesha Alaye Bam Bam, umwami uyoboye imuhanda yo muri Ìsàlẹ̀ Èkó. kaze gufata Obalola, akabona igisubizo cye cy'ubutwari, akamushyira hamwe n'abandi mu kazi ke, kogukusanya ruswa n'ubujura.
Ubutwaribwa Obalola hamwe nabanyabwenge bomumuhanda bikurura Nino, umuyobozi w'agatsiko kiyongera kuba Eleniyan ukurikira (izina ry'umuyobozi w'agatsiko gakomeye muri Ìsàlẹ̀ Èkó). Nino, abonye ubushobozi muri Obalola, amujyana munsiy’ibaba maze abumubyeyi urera, amuha guhunga by'agateganyo ihohoterwa ryanyina w’idini ry’idini rya Obalola. Urugo rwa Nino rutanga ihumure, kandi Obalola akunda cyane Teni, umuturanyiwa Nino n'umukobwa wa Kazeem.
Urupfu rubi rwa Nino ruteza akaga gakomeye, rukanangiza ibyiringiro bya Obalola byozagira ubuzima bwiza. Nyuma y’urupfu rwe, Obalola n’inshuti ze basanga barushijwe imbaraga no gukorera Kazeem, umuyobozi w’agatsiko kabanzi b’ubuzima uzwiho inda nini n’ubunyamaswa, kandi ufite imizi ikomeye muri politiki ya Lagos. Kazeem yifata nk’aho ari se kuri Obalola, ariko ukuri ni uko uburiganya bwe n’icyo akoresha mu bikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi bisaba igiciro gikomeye.
abobatatu bamazeguze, imiterere yabo irushaho kuba mibi,inzira zabo zigatandukana. Obalola yaje kuba uwo Kazeem yubahwa cyane, abitewe no gushaka gutunga umuryango we no kwihorera urupfu rwa Nino. Impano ikubiyemo ubuzima bw'agatsiko, kubona imbaraga n'irangamuntu mu kajagari, mugihe Ify akomera ku nzozi zo kuba umucuranzi, nubwo ubudahemuka ku nshuti ze bukomeza kumusubiza mu kuzimu.
Inshingano y'ingenzi yateguwe na Kazeem iteza amakimbirane akaze mudutsiko duhanganye no kugenzura politiki. Ntabishaka, Ify yinjiye mubikorwa kugirango ashyigikire inshuti ze. Ariko, ubutumwa buragenda nabi, bikaviramo kurasa akajagari aho Ify yiciwe. Urupfu rwe rutunguranye kandi rukabije rwangiza Obalola na Gift, bituma basigara bahanganye nigihombo kidazanzwe
Urupfu rwa Ify ruteza andi maraso kumeneka muri Isale Eko, ubwo nyina, Mama Ify, yasabaga ko akwirukanwa. Mu byakurikiyeho, Obalola amenya ko ari Kazeem wagize uruhare mu kwicwa kwa Nino. Ibyo bituma ayobora urugamba rw’amaraso rwo kwihorera kuri Kazeem. Kubera agahinda n’inyota y’ubutabera, intambara y’udutsiko irarota, ikaba iy’amaraso menshi. Mu iherezo ryaranzwe n’urugamba rukaze, Obalola ahanganye na Kazeem, aramutsinda aramwica. Icyo gikorwa cy’ukwihorera kiba nk’aho cyuzuye urugendo rwa Obalola, kuko ahura n’uruhererekane rw’ubugome rwamuranze mu buzima bwe, agatangira gushaka inzira imukiza ibyo byiciro by’amaraso.
Ukoyakozwe no gufata amashusho.
Mugukora "Gangs of Lagos" byaatewe n’uko Jade Osiberu yiboneye ubuzima i Ìsàlẹ̀ Èkó, Lagos. Mu gihe cyo gukora umushinga we, "Gidi Up", yiboneye ubuzima bwa buri munsi binyuze mu madirishya y’inyubako zituranye. Umwe mu mashusho yingenzi, aho umubyeyi yari ategura ifunguro ry’abanabe, niwo watumye yibaza byinshi ku buzima bw’ihungabana ry’ubukungu nimibereho murako gace. Iryotandukaniro ryabaye ishingiro ryinkuru yerekanye ubuzima bwabantu akenshi bumvwa nabi. Ibi birori byashizeho urwego rwo kuvuga abantu abantu batumva nabi. Yasuzumye insanganyamatsiko zo kwifuza, ubukene, nokubaho muburyo butandukanye na Lagos butandukanye no kwinezeza. Iyifilime yibanda ku ngaruka zubujura na politiki mbi mu buzima bwaburi munsi, bugamije kubyutsa impuhwe mugihe zishimishije. Mukiganiro na Al Jazeera, Osiberu yavuze ingaruka nka Martin Scorsese na Spike Lee, abahoze mumatsinda yagangster bagize uruhare mu kuvuga inkuru. Yasobanuye agira ati: “Nahoraga nzi ko nshaka kuvuga inkuru ivuga kumwana ukurira kuriyi si udashobora gusohoka,” agaragaza ishingiro ry’umuntu munkuru za filime.
"Gangs of Lagos y"agaragaje intambwe ikomeye muri sinema yo muri Nijeriya kuko yabaye filime yambere ya Amazon Original yaturutse muri Afurika, igaragaza ko kwisi igenda yiyongera muri Afurika.] Iyi filime yayobowe na Jadesola Osiberu, uzwi mu bikorwa bye nka "Isoken" (2017), "Sugar Rush" (2019), na "Brotherhood" (2022). Yakozwe ku bufatanye na Kemi Lala Akindoju, ikaba yaravutse binyuze mu masezerano yimyaka itatu hagati ya Amazon Prime Video n’inzu itunganya filime ya Osiberu, Greoh Studios. Osiberu yakoranye na Kemi Lala Akindoju ndetse na K. I. Jegede mu kwandika inyandikonyamakuru (screenplay) igaragaza by’ukuri umuco w’imibereho y’abatuye muri Lagos.
Ishuho ngari ya "Gangs of Lagos" yatangiye mumwaka wa 2021 ikomeza amezi menshi. Benshi mubafata amashusho yabereye Eko, umuturanyi wo ku kirwa cya Lagos ahazwiho kubera amateka yaho ndetse n’ikirere cyiza. Abakinnyi ba firime bagamije gufata ingufu zidasanzwe za Isale Eko, bakoresheje ahantu nyaburanga kugirango bashire inkuru mubuzima bwa buri munsi mubuzima bwa Lagos. Usibye Isale Eko, ibindibice byo muri Lagos byakoreshejwe mu kurasa, harimo uduce nka Lekki na Surulere. Ibibibanza byatanze amakuru atandukanye yerekanaga itandukaniro ry’imibereho n’ubukungu muri Lagos, kuva mu turere two hejuru kugera mu duce dutuwe cyane.
Filime yakoresheje abanyempano bo muri nigeria zaho yaba imbere n' imyuma ya kamera. Abagize itsinda, barimo Tobi Bakre, Adesua Etomi-Wellington, na Chike, bazanye ibikorwa byabo mubuzima, bashyigikiwe nitsinda ryababyaye ryerekana umujyi. Muri Kamena 2021, "Pulse NG" yatangajwe kourutonde rugufi rwagutse rugashyiramo Pasuma. Mu gihe cyo gukorana na firime, Osiberu yasobanuye icyemezo yafashe cyo kongera Pasuma na Zlatan mu bakinnyi, agira ati: "Pasuma afite amateka maremare yo gukina. Kuva twarasa muri Isale Eko, ninde wundi ushobora guhura neza? Pasuma atunganye kuri iyi si."
Mukiganiro na Daily Post, Tobi yavuze ibitekerezo bijyanye nokwitegura uruhare rwenka Obalola mu "gatsiko ka Lagos". Yagaragaje ko bwari ubwa mbere akina umuntu uyobora kandi akishora mu buryo bwuzuye kugira ngo agire uruhare. Yatekereje kunzira ye mbere yogufata amashusho, yaravuze ati: "Ku gatsiko ka Lagos, byari ingorabahizi kuko, ku nshuro ya mbere, naretse ndagenda rwose. Nari numvise umuziki ubabaje cyane kugira ngahuze n'amarangamutima yumuntu. Indirimbo imwe igaragara kuri njye nindirimbo ya Celia' ya Tiwa Savage, ntabwo ari amarangamutima cyane.
Igishushanyo mbonera cy'umusaruro n'ibibazo.
Igishushanyo mbonera "cya Gang of Lagos" cyerekana ubwiza bwumujyi. Iri tsinda ryibanze cyane kumakuru arambuye nka palette palette, ubwubatsi, nimihanda yo kumuhanda kugirango habeho kwerekana neza ubuzima bwumujyi wa Lagos. Amashusho yerekana sinema, yayobowe na Olumuyiwa Oyedele, yashimangiye kokamera igenda ifata ingufu n’akajagari mu mihanda ya Lagos. Ububuryo bwakoreshejwe mugukora ubunararibonye, butuma abareba bumva ko ari bimwe mubidukikije bigenda bihindagurika byerekana ubuzima bwabantu.
Mugihe cyo gutunganya amashuho, abakora amafilime bahuye nibibazo mugihe bafataga amashusho mu duce twinshi twa Lagos, cyane cyane muma ghetto. Chioma Akpotha, umwe mubakinnyi bakomeye muri iyifilime, yatangaje kabo bakozi bagombaga kwishora mu " bahungu bo mu karere ", ijambo rikunze gukoreshwa muriNijeriya kugira ngo risobanure amatsinda y’abasore bakunze kugenzura ibikorwa mumijyi imwe nimwe, kugira ngo bafate amashusho neza.
Tolu Obanro yahimbye amanota yifilime, yasohowe na Studiyo ya Greoh. Umuziki ufungura umurongo wahawe amashimwe ni "Ikinyamakuru kavukire" kivuga ko ari "igitangaza." Obanro atekereza ku byoyaremye, yaragize ati: "Nashakaga gukora amanota yumvaga ari manini kandi manini." Amajwi nayo agaragaza indirimbo yinyongera ya Chike.
Kurekura no gukwirakwiza.
Yerekanwe bwambere "mw"' iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya sinema rya 2022 rya Toronto ku ya 11 Nzeri nkimwe muri filime Nijeriya zasohotse kurubuga rwa interineti mu wego rwo gushora Amazone muri Nollywood. Isohora ryafilime ryagaragaje intambwe igaragara mubufatanye hagati yabakora amafilime yomuri Nijeriya na serivisi zitanga amakuru kwisi, bituma Nollywood igera ku bantu mpuzamahanga.
"Gangs of Lagos" yinjije miliyoni 230 z'amapound muriNijeriya. Muminsi 20 yambere igisohoka muri 2023, film imaze kubona abantu 15.000.
Seyi Lasisi womuri "Afrocritik" yahaye iyifilime inyenyeri 3/5 maze aravuga ati: " "Gangs of Lagos", kimwe na Brotherhood, ntabwo ari ibihimbano. Ni ubushakashatsi bwa sinema kumibereho yacu nkabanyanijeriya. Irerekana ibyangiritse imiryango ya Nigeriya ndetse n'Abanyanijeriya bahatirwa guhamya igihe guverinoma ititaye ku iterambere no gukemura ibibazo by'imibereho".
Shola-Adido Oladotun wo muri "Premium Times" yashimye "Gangs of Lagos", avuga ko " ikorwa rayamashusho riri mu rwego rwo hejuru, ku buryo ibintu bitandukanye bituma burigice gisa neza kandi gikwiranye nubwoko bwacyo." Yagaragaje kobahisemo ahantu heza, agira ati: "Biratangaje kubona iyifilime yafatiwe amashusho ahantu nyaburanga muri Isale Eko." Icyakora, Oladotun yagaragaje kiyi filime ishobora kuba yarakoze neza nkuruhererekane rwa televiziyo, kuko yarigutuma habaho iterambere ryimbitse, atari kuri Obalola na Impano gusa ahubwo noku bantu bavugwa nka Kazeem. Yerekanye filime 8/10 inyenyeri. Emma Vine womuri "Ready Steady Cut" yavuze ko iyi filime ari "ikinamico, iteye ubwoba izahita ushora imari mu nkuru n'imiterere yayo." Yashimye imirimo ya kamera, sinema, ndetse n’imikorere y'abakinnyi. Vine yashimangiye ko imwe mu mitungo "itangaje" ya filime ari isano itangaje hagati yabakinnyi bakuze na bagenzi babo bato, ikintu gikunze kwirengagizwa ariko cyingenzi mugukora film byongera cyane kwizera.
Johnny Loftus umunyamakuru wa "Decider" yashimye imikorere yabakinnyi bo muri"Gangs of Lagos", cyane cyane agaragaza Tobi Bakre, Adesua Etomi-Wellington, na Chike Ezekpeazu-Osebuka. Yagaragaje uburyo Chike yerekana Ify, umuntu wavutse mubuzima bw’agatsiko nubwo yifuzaga cyane kunyura mubundi buryo, nkogukinira kuri stage nki ntumbero ye, Panama. Liam Lacey womuri "Original-Cin" yahaye iy filime amanota B, avuga ko "ariyo bihebuje cyane iyo itandukanije umuco wa Scorsese-Coppola kugira ngo itange kunegura bikabije ikigo cya politiki cyo muri Nijeriya."
"Gangs of Lagos" katsindiye ibihembo byinshi ndetse nogushimwa, harimo kumenyekana nkafilime nziza yomuri Nijeriya ndetse ningaruka nziza zerekanwa mu bihembo bya 2023 bya Afurika bya Sinema. Adesua Etomi-Wellington yegukanye igihembo cyumukinnyi mwiza witwaye neza.
Kugaragaza iyifilime no kuranga masike ya Eyo, ikintu cyingenzi mu muco womuri Lagos, byagaragaye ko bitavugwaho rumwe. Benshi mu babajijwe kumbuga nkoranyambaga bumvise kabakora amafilime bagaragaje kobatubaha ikigo gakondo ayomasikare arimo. Itsinda rimwe ry’Abanya Lagos ryateye ubwoba urubanza rusubizwa, irindi rirakurikira maze bajyana ikibazo murukiko.
Reno Omokri yanenze iyifilime "avuga ko isebanya," munyandiko yanditse ku ubuga rwa Twitter yanditse ko amashusho yayo atesha agaciro isura ya Nijeriya, aravuga ati: "Kwamamaza igihugu cyawe ukoresheje filime nkiyi ni nko gukubita umwobo mu bwato urimo nku umugenzi. Ninde utsinzwe?"
Mubanamaganye iyifilime kurizo mpamvu harimo guverinoma yaLeta ya Lagos, umuryango wibwami wa Kosoko womuri Lagos, Umuyobozi mukuru Adebola Dosunmu wo mu muryango w’ibwami wa Dosunmu, hamwe numukambwe wikirangirire wa Nollywood, Jide Kosoko ukora muburyo bwihariye. umuyobozi wacyo yasobanuye ko bidahawe ububasha bwo kugenzura amafilime na televiziyo byerekanwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, nubwo ubugororangingo bwemewe n'amategeko bwo kubuha ubwo butegetsi Inteko ishinga amategeko.
Muri Mata mumwaka wa 2023, guverinoma yaleta ya Lagos nabayobozi gakondo banenze filime "Gangs of Lagos" kubera kwerekana umurage ndangamuco wa leta. Guverinoma yamaganye umusaruro "udasanzwe uyobya," yemeza ko ugaragaza umuco wa Lagos mu buryo bwo gusebanya. Uzamat Akinbile-Yussuf, Komiseri waLeta ushinzwe ubukerarugendo, ubuhanzi, numuco womuri Lagos, yatangaje ko ahangayikishijwe nimiterere yiyi filime, avuga ko yasebeje amateka n’imigenzo ya Lagos kandi ko yarenganyije abaturage bayo ko ari ubugome. Yagaragaje imiterere yera y’umunsi mukuru wa Eyo, ashimangira ko ari umuhango udasanzwe wo gutambuka ku banyacyubahiro bo muri Lagos.
Muburyo nkubwo, Oba y'i Lagos, Rilwan Aremu Akiolu, yavuze kiyi filime isebanya kandi ko ari igitambo, anenga ivuga ko Eyo ari udutsiko twabagizi uruhare m bwicanyi nogutera ubwoba abaturage. Yasabye ko Amazon Web Services, Sitidiyo ya Greoh, hamwe n’abatunganya iyifilime bakuraho amashusho yose ya Eyo muryii firime.
Amazon Web Services yo muri Nigeriya, ishami rya Amazon Inc. akaba ari yashinze Prime Video Nigeriya, yatangaje koyasubije ihazabu ingana na miliyari 10 zamapound yaciwe kumusaruro wayo nubumwe bwabakozi ba Isale Eko. Amazon yemeje kifilime yayo, "Gangs of Lagos", ntacyo yangiza umuntu cyangwa itsinda. Isosiyete kandi yamaganye ubuyobozi bugenzura guverinoma ya Lagos muriki kibazo.

The Captain of Nakara ni filme iri mu bwoko bwa filme z'urwenya () yo muri Kenya yakozwe mu mwaka wa 2012. Ni Filme yakomotse ku mukino wo mu budage witwa "" wanditswe na, ifi filme ubwayo ishingiye ku nkuru y'ubuzima bwa, umugizi wa nabi w'igihe gito wigaragaje nka "Hauptmann (Kapiteni)" i Berlin mu 1906.
Umugizi wa nabi w'igihe gito Muntu (Bernard Safari) yarekuwe muri gereza yo mu gihugu cyahimbwe Nakara cyo muri Afurika. Nyuma y'igihe gito, akunda umukobwa w'umuvugabutumwa gusa yanga kumubwira ubuzima bubi yanyuzemo ahubwo yigira nkaho ari umucuruzi ukomeye akajya yitwara nka nyiri isoko. Kubera ruswa yiganje cyane muri kariya gace, ukuri kwe gutuma ibinyoma bye bibe impamo. Mu myambaro ya gisirikare yibye, Muntu yigira "Kapiteni wa Nakara" kandi arengera neza uburenganzira bwe n'ibyishimo, bimuganisha ku mpinduka zitari kuri we wenyine, ahubwo no ku gihugu cyose amaherezo atsindira kuba perezida wa Kwetu!
Ibihembo yahataniye.
Iyi filime yahatanye mu bihembo bya (AMAA) byo muri 2012 yari mu kiciro cya Achievement in Costume Design.
The Captain of Nakara kandi yahatanye mu marushanwa ya Free Spirit muri yo mu 2012
Nyuma y'umwaka muri 2013, iyi filime yahatanye mu iserukiramuco rya Filime na Televiziyo bya Pan African Ouagadougou (FESPACO) mu cyiciro cy’amarushanwa ya Digital Video Fiction. Icyiciro cyari gifite abantu 17 batoranijwe baturutse muri Afurika. Niyo nomination yonyine yaturutse muri Kenya muri iki cyiciro.

Ibihembo bya Afurika Movie Academy Awards ni ibirori ngarukamwaka by'imyidagaduro byo gutanga ibihembo, hagamijwe kwerekana indashyikirwa mu banyamwuga bo muri Afurika ndetse n'abatari Abanyafurika, bagize uruhare mu nyafurika. Ibi bihembo byashinzwe na gusa kuri ubu biyobowe na Africa Film Academy. Ibi birori bifatwa nka bimwe mu birori bikomeye muri Afurika byibanda kuri filme. ndetse rimwe na rimwe babjya babyitiranya nk'ibihembo bya "Oscars byo muri afurika".
Ibirori bya mbere bya Africa Movie Academy Awards byabereye i Yenagoa, muri Leta ya Bayelsa, muri Nijeriya ku ya 30 Gicurasi 2005 ndetse uko myaka yakurikiyeho byagiye biba bibereye mu gace kamwe kugeza 2012, uretse mu mwaka 2008 ubwo yaberaga muri Abuja, FCT ku mpamvu z'umutekano. Mu mwaka wa 2012, ibirori byo gutanga ibihembo byabereye muri Eko Hotels na Suites, Ikirwa cya Victoria, Lagos muri Leta ya Lagos. Ku nshuro ya 9 n'iya 10 bisubira muri Yenagoa, mu gihe muri 2015 byabereye hanze ya Nijeriya ku nshuro ya mbere.
Byakiriwe mu migi itandukanye ya Nijeriya, cyane cyane i Lagos, ndetse rimwe biba ku rwego mpuzamahanga i Kigali mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2018. Ibi birori kandi byagiye bibera ahantu hatandukanye harimo inzu ya Jewel Aeida Hall, Eko Hotels na Suites, Centre ya Balmoral, hamwe na Landmark Event Centre i Lagos. Kandi kuva AMAA yatangira yaragutse igera kure ya Nijeriya. Nubwo amakuru arambuye yabigenewe ari make, ariko ibi birori byakuruye isi yose, binyuze mu mijyi yabyakiriye neza ndetse no ku murongo wa interineti cyane cyane mugihe cya COVID-19. Ubu buryo bugaragaza ubushake bwa AMAA bwo kwishyira hamwe no kugera ku mugabane wa Afurika ndetse no hanze yawo.
Muri 2017 ibihembo bya Africa Movie Academy Awards byari bifite ibyiciro 28 by'ingenzi, Harimo:
Ibyiciro byahagaritswe.
Ibyiciro byinshi byahinduriwe izina, ibindi birahagarikwa n'ibindi birahuzwa. Hasi hari urutonde rwa bimwe mu byiciro byakozweho.
AMAA yashimangiye uruhare rwayo nk'umusemburo wa sinema nyafurika. Bituma filme zikozwe mu ndimi kavukire nazo zigaragaza, ishyigikira inkuru za diaspora, kandi iha umwanya ubuhanga buri tekinike. Ibihembo biteza imbere ubufatanye bwambukiranya imipaka, bikerekana impano nyafurika ku isi yose, kandi bigahugura n'abandi bashya bakizamuka bakora sinema.

Jennifer Eliogu (wavutse kuwa 30 Mata 1976) ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya uzwi cyane mu kuba umukinnyi wa filme. Mu mwaka wa 2016, Eliogu yahawe "igihembo cyihariye cyo kumenyekana" muri kubera uruhare yagize mu ruganda rwa sinema rwo muri Nijeriya. Eliogu mu 2014 kubera uruhare yagize mu kongerera ubushobozi abagore, yahawe "igihembo cy’indashyikirwa" mu nama nyafurika y’abayobozi bayoboye abagore yabereye muri Amerika.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Eliogu akomoka mu mudugudu wa Ụmụazụ muri muri, agace ko mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Nijeriya ariko yakuriye muri iherereye mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Nijeriya. Eliogu yabonye impamyabumenyi muri abona n'indi yakuye muri.
Eliogu mu 1997 yatangiye ku mugaragaro gukina filme ahereye ku yitwa "House on Fire". Eliogu yabaye ahagaritse ibya sinema yo muri Nijeriya igihe gito maze yinjira mu muziki mu buryo bw'umwuga mu mwaka wa 2012, maze asohora indirimbo ye ya mbere yise "Ifunanya" ndetse iza guhatanira n'igihembo cya Best R&amp;B Video muri "Nigeria Music Video Awards (NMVA) mri uwo mwaka."
Mu bandi bantu bazwi muri yakoranye nabo harimo, Rich Tanksley, Kenneth Okolie, Susan Peters, Bolanle Ninalowo, Moyo Lawal, Desmond Elliot, Rukky Sanda n'abandi. ni umukinnyi ukunda gushishikariza abakinnyi ba filime bakiri bato ko impano ariyo izabageza kure atari ubwambure.
Ibihembo no kumenyekana.

Fondasiyo ya Al-Basar (مؤ କାନة العالمية) ni umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta udaharanira inyungu ukorera muri Arabiya Sawudite. Yashinzwe mu 1989 kugira ngo ikore mu rwego rwo gukumira no kurandura / kurwanya indwara z’ubuhumyi &amp; impumyi.
Ikorana n’ikigo cyita ku buntu n’ubutabazi cya King Salman muri Yemeni, Bangladesh, Sudani, Nijeriya na Pakisitani mu kurwanya ubuhumyi n’indwara z’amaso. akanabaga muri Sudani
Mu bukangurambaga bwa 2019 bwatewe inkunga na King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre ku bufatanye na Al Basar International Foundation, abakorerabushake b’ubuvuzi baturutse muri Arabiya Sawudite bahuye n’abarwayi 8000 b’amaso ndetse banabagwa 800 kugira ngo bakure cataracte na glaucoma muri Ibadan, muri Nijeriya, ndetse no muri Lafia muri Leta ya Nasarawa, muri Nijeriya.

Ishyirahamwe ry’Abafite Ubumuga bo mu gihugu cya Irilande (IWA) n’ishyirahamwe ryita kubantu bafite ubumuga bw’umubiri. Ryashinzwe Intego za IWA nuguharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bw’umubiri binyuze muri politiki rusange, gutanga serivisi zitandukanye, no gutera inkunga abanyamuryango bayo.
Umuyobozi wambere w’ishyirahamwe ry’abafitubumuga bomugihugu cya Irilande yari Fr. Leo Close CM, umukinnyi wamugaye numukoresha wabafitubumuga.

Without Pity: A Film About Abilities ni filme mbarakuri yo muri Amerika yakozwe mu 1996 ikaba iri mu majwi ya Christopher Reeve. Iyi documentaire igaragaza uruhare n'imbaraga abafite ubumuga bagira kugirango babeho ubuzima bwiza kandi butanga umusaruro. Yerekanwe bwa mbere kuri HBO kuwa 8 Ukwakira 1996.
Abareba iyi filme bazisanga mu nkuru yavuzweho n'abanyamerika. bazabona inkuru y'Umugore ukiri muto ufite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe wita ku mwana we, babone n'inkur y'umugabo nawe ufite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe umaze imyaka 40 yibana kandi abayeho neza mu mashuri ya colorado.
Iyi filime izatwereka urugendo rw'umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka 6 utagira amaboko n'amaguru yagiriye ku ishuri aho yasuraga ibiro by'impuguke kuri mudasobwa ifite ubumuga bwo kutabona, ndetse ahahurira n’umwarimu ufite indwara y’igicuri wigisha amateka y’ivangura ryakorerwaga abantu bafite ubumuga.
Ndetse tubona n'inkuru y'umusore uherutse kugira ubumuga atuganiriza uko yahanganye n'indwara y'agahinda gakabije (depression) yagize nyuma yo kumenya ko yagize ubumuga, uko yabyitwayemo, ingamba yafashe n'uko yaje kubinesha agakomeza ubuzima bwe.
Iyi filme igaruka cyane ku gushima abantu bafite ubumuga ku buryo bitwara, ubudaheranwa bwabo, ubushobozi n'uburyo bishakamo ibisubizo.

Ntabwo bugaragara niba ururimi rw'amarenga cyangwa indimi ziri mu Rwanda. Mu mwaka wa 2006, umushinga w'inkoranyamagambo watangiye guhuza ururimi rw'amarenga nyarwanda byatangajwe mu 2009.
Icyakora, umushinga ntabwo wari wuzuye, kandi muri 2013 inkoranyamagambo yaje kongerwamo ibyaburaga, ishingiye ku marenga yarasanzwe akoreshwa mu gihugu hose. Ibisobanuro by’umushinga byerekanye ko iyi ari imvugo y’ururimi rumwe, ariko ibyo bitazwi. Gahunda yo gusemura iboneka muri Uganda; ntibizwi niba Ururimi rw'amarenga nyarwanda rufitanye isano n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Uganda.

Igipimo cy'ubumuga ni ijanisha rigamije kwerekana urwego rw'umuntu uhoraho kumubiri cyangwa mumutwe. Ku bantu bagize impanuka cyangwa uburwayi bumara igihe kirekire cyangwa buhoraho mugukoresha igice cyumubiri wabo cyangwa imikorere y'umubiri, igipimo cy'ubumuga gishobora gukoreshwa mugupima ubushobozi bw'umuntu. Ubumuga busobanurwa nko gutandukana cyane n'ubuzima busanzwe bw'imikorere. Ubumuga busobanura neza gutandukana ku imiterere ihamye y'umuntu nubushobozi bwa muntu, hamwe n'ubuvuzi bundi bushya, ingaruka kubikorwa by'umuntu mu buzima bwe buri munsi ntibishobora guhinduka. Ibyo biba byarageze ku rwego aho bashobora gupimwa urwego rw’ihungabana, kandi uwo murwayi aba ageze ku rwego rwitwa “Maximum Medical Improvement (MMI) ni ukuvuga ko nta gukira kurenze ubwo bitegerejwe zitaziguye umuntu afite. nubwo ibyo bitandukanyirizo bitandukanijwe bikunze gukoreshwa nimiryango ya leta nk'igipimo cyubumuga, cyangwa kugena indishyi zikwiye kubera impanuka cyangwa igikomere. Gukoresha ibimenyetso byubuvuzi hamwe n’impuguke zumvikanyweho murwego bizamura uburinganire nuburinganire murwego rwo guta agaciro.
Amabwiriza ya AMA (American Medical Association) agerageza gushyiraho uburyo buhamye bwo gupima urwego rw’ihungabana hashingiwe ku bipimo bifatika nk’urugero rw’ubumuga bwo kumva rugaragazwa na Decibel Sum Hearing Loss (DSHL) cyangwa ibizamini by’ubushobozi bwo kubona neza (visual acuity tests).
Nubwo hari ubwo buryo bwo kugerageza gushyiraho ihame, amanota y’ihungabana atangwa ku muntu umwe n’abaganga batandukanye rimwe na rimwe aratandukana cyane, bikaba ikibazo kuko bituma haboneka kutajyana n’uburinganire mu isuzuma ry’ihungabana

Ikinyamakuru cya Politiki y’abafite ubumuga ni buri gihembwe urungano rwasuzumwe n’ikinyamakuru cy' amasomo gikubiyemo ibyerekeranye n’ubushakashatsi bw’abafite ubumuga, harimo ibibazo bijyanye n’imyitwarire, politiki rusange, n’amategeko yerekeye ababana n’ubumuga. Abanditsi bakuru ni Mitchell Yell (Kaminuza ya Carolina yepfo) na James G. Shriner (Kaminuza ya Illinois). Yashinzwe mu 1990, ubu ikaba isohoka na SAGE Publications ifatanije n’ikigo cya Hammill gishinzwe ubumuga.

kolera ni infection y'amara mato na bagiteri "Vibrio kolera".
Ibimenyetso birashobora gutandukana ntanumwe, kugeza byoroheje, bikabije, ariko mubisanzwe harimo umubare munini w'impiswi z'amazi zimara iminsi mike.
Kuruka no kurwara imitsi nabyo birashobora kubaho.
Impiswi irashobora gukomera cyane, ku buryo itera umwuma ndetse n’ubusumbane bwa electrolyte mu masaha runaka.
Ibimenyetso byo kubura umwuma.
Umwuma ukabije ushobora guha umuntu amaso yarohamye, uruhu rukonje, kugabanuka kwuruhu, no gukuna amaboko n'amaguru. Umwuma urashobora kandi gutuma uruhu ruhinduka ubururu.
Igihe cyibimenyetso.
Ibimenyetso mubisanzwe bitangira amasaha abiri kugeza kuminsi itanu nyuma yo guhura.
Kolera irashobora guterwa n'ubwoko butandukanye bwa "kolera ya Vibrio", hamwe n'ubwoko bumwe na bumwe butera indwara zikomeye kurusha izindi, zishobora gutuma indwara zimwe na zimwe zikomera kurusha izindi.
Impamvu nyamukuru itera kolera ni ukunywa amazi adafite umutekano, yandujwe n'umwanda w'abantu urimo bagiteri, cyangwa ibiryo bidafite umutekano byandujwe n'amazi yanduye.
Ibiryo bitetse nabi.
Ibiryo byo mu nyanja bidatetse ni isoko rusange y’indwara kandi abantu ni bo nyamaswa yonyine yibasiwe.
Impamvu zishobora guteza ingaruka.
Impamvu zishobora guteza isuku nke, amazi meza yo kunywa adahagije, n'ubukene.
Ingaruka z'ubushyuhe bukabije ku isi.
Hari impungenge z'uko izamuka ry’inyanja, riterwa n'ubushyuhe bukabije ku isi, bizongera umubare w'indwara.
Kolera irashobora gupimwa mugupima amabyi.
Uburyo bwo kwirinda burimo kunoza isuku, kubona amazi meza, n'isuku nziza.
Inkingo za kolera zitangwa mu kanwa zitanga uburinzi bufatika bw’indwara mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu, kandi zifite inyungu zinyongera zo kwirinda ubundi bwoko bw'impiswi zatewe na "E coli".
Ubuvuzi bwibanze n'ubuvuzi bwo mu kanwa - gusimbuza amazi n'ibisubizo biryoshye kandi by'umunyu. Ibisubizo by'umuceri bi.
Kwiyongera kwa Zinc ni ingirakamaro mu bana.
IV amazi na antibiotike.
Mugihe gikabije, hashobora gukenerwa amazi yimitsi, nka lactate ya Ringer, kandi antibiyotike irashobora kuba ingirakamaro. Kwipimisha kugirango urebe antibiyotike ya kolera ishobora kwandura irashobora gufasha kuyobora amahitamo.
Kolera ifata igereranyo cya 1-point-3 kugeza 4 miliyoni z'abantu ku isi yose kandi itera 21000 kugeza 143000 impfu ku mwaka.
Ibihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere.
Nubwo ishyirwa mu ndwara y’icyorezo, ni gake mu bihugu byateye imbere, kandi bigira ingaruka cyane cyane ku bana mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere.
Indwara vs indwara zidakira.
Kolera ibaho nk'ibyorezo kandi bikurikirana mu bice bimwe na bimwe. Mu turere dufite ibyago byo kwandura indwara harimo Afurika na Aziya y'Amajyepfo y'Uburasirazuba aho usanga abantu hafi ya bose baboneka.
Ibyago by'urupfu mu babangamiwe ni munsi ya 1%, ariko birashobora kugera kuri 5%. Kutabona uburyo bwo kwivuza byongera cyane ibyago byo gupfa.
Ibisobanuro bya kolera tubisanga mu kinyejana cya 5 mbere ya Yesu muri Sanskrit. Ubushakashatsi bwa kolera mu Bwongereza bwakozwe na John Snow, hagati ya 1849 na 1854, bwatumye habaho iterambere rikomeye mu bijyanye na epidemiologiya. Indwara ndwi nini zabaye mu myaka 200 ishize, hapfa abantu babarirwa muri za miriyoni.

Ibitaro bitanga ubuvuzi busubiza mu buzima busanzwe abarwayi (Irish:) i Dún Laoghaire, Dublin, ni ibitaro byatewe inkunga na Leta ya Irilande bitanga ubuvuzi busubiza mu buzima busanzwe abarwayi bafite ubumuga bw'umubiri cyangwa ubwenge kubera uburwayi cyangwa ibikomere. Ibitaro byashinzwe igihe umuryango wa bashiki bacu b'Impuhwe babonaga umutungo uzwi ku izina rya "The Ceders" i Dún Laoghaire mu 1916.. Ibitaro byashinzwe kubera impamvu yo kuvura igituntu byarangiye kubakwa muri Gashyantare 1918.
Inyubako yari izwi ku izina rya " Mukobwa wacu w'ibitaro bya Lourdes" nyuma bihindurwamo ibitaro bitanga ubuvuzi busubiza abantu mubuzima busanzwe muri 1961, muri 1994 bihiduka ibitaro by'igihugu bitanga ubuvuzi busubiza abantu mu buzima busanzwe.

Ibitaro bifite ibitanda byose hamwe 110 ariko bivugwa ko bidafite ibikoresho bihagije bigendeye k'umuryango ukora ubuvugizi wa "An Soal" kimwe n’abakozi bakuru b’ibitaro.

Adam (Youssouf Djaoro), wahoze ari nyampinga wo koga muri Afurika yo hagati, ni umukozi wa pisine muri hoteri nziza. Champ. Mu rwego rw'ubukungu Madamu We, umuyobozi yamumanuye ku izamu kandi umuhungu we Abdel agirwa umukozi wa pisine. Umuyobozi Mukuru waho ahatira Adam gutanga amafaranga kugira ngo urugamba rwa Tchad rurwanya ingabo z’inyeshyamba, rumuhana ko atitabiriye inama yabiteye. Umutware abwira Adamu uburyo yohereje umuhungu we w'imyaka 17 ku rugamba. Abwira Adamu ko afite iminsi itatu yo kwishyura amafaranga kugira ngo ashyigikire. Kugira ngo agarure umwanya we Adam yatanze Abdel mu Ngabo za Chadian Ground Force, n'abasirikare baza murugo rw'umuryango bategura Abdel ku gahato. Adam yongeye akazi ko kuba umukozi wa pisine.
Umukobwa w'imyaka 17, umukunzi wa Abdel wari utwite, ageze kwa Adamu arajyanwa amwitaho. Amakimbirane arakomera maze abatuye mu music barahunga. Adam abwira umukazana we ubuhemu bwe aravunika. Adam yongeye gutekereza ku mwanya we maze afata moto ye hamwe na sidecar mu Karere k'intambara kugira ngo azane Abdel murugo. Asanga Abdel yakomeretse cyane- ijisho, ijosi, ukuboko kw'iburyo n'inda. Muri iryo joro, Adam yakuye Abdel mu bitaro, amushyira mu kayira kegereye urugo. Mu rugendo Abdel avuga ko yifuza koga mu ruzi ariko Abdel apfa bageze kuruzi. Adamu areremba umurambo muruzi, utwara umurambo.
Umubano wa Adam na Abdel niwo wibandwaho cyane mu nkuru y’iyi filime, kandi nk'uko umuyobozi abivuga bifitanye isano na Tchad yo muri iki gihe: "Hagati ya se n'umuhungu ni ugutwara kwibuka, ingirabuzima fatizo, n'umuco. Ni ngombwa cyane hano kuko abagabo bayobora intambara muri Tchad. Imvururu zabereye muri Tchad zimaze imyaka 40 kandi nisewanduje umuhungu we umuco w'intambara, kuko bitabaye ibyo nta mpamvu iboneka." Mahamat Saleh Haroun yanze nkana kujya mu magambo arambuye kubyerekeye intambara y'abenegihugu muri Tchad na politiki: "Filime ivuga uko iyi miterere imeze kandi ntabwo yabonye umwanya hamwe n'inyeshyamba cyangwa guverinoma; mu buzima bwe izo ngabo zombi ntizisobanutse bityo rero ntacyo byaba bitwaye aramutse abaye inyeshyamba cyangwa guverinoma kuko ibyo bitazahagarika intambara."
Umutwe wa film ni amagambo yavuye mucyegeranyo cy’imivugo "Garuka mu Gihugu Cyanjye kavukire" na Aimé Césaire. Interuro yuzuye ni "Umugabo utaka ntabwo ari idubu kubyina". Haroun avuga ko umuntu nyamukuru Adamu "avuza induru atuza Imana, ntabwo ari induru irwanya ingorane".
Igitekerezo cya firime cyaje mu 2006 mu gihe cyo gutunganya "Daratt". Taliki ya 13 Mata ingabo z'inyeshyamba zinjiye muri N'Djamena, umurwa Mukuru wa Tchad, aho Haroun yakoreraga amashusho, maze umusaruro uhita uhagarikwa. Abakozi ba filime, barimo umusore ukina umukinnyi wa mbere wujuje imyaka 18 kuri uwo munsi, bafatiwe mu butayu nta buryo bwo gutumanaho. Ibi byashishikarije Haroun kugerageza gufata ibyiyumviro byo gufungwa yagize muri ibyo birori.
Isosiyete y'Abafaransa Pili Films na Goï Goï Productions ya Tchad bakoze film hamwe. Inkunga y’inyongera yatanzwe n’isosiyete yo mu Bubiligi Entre Chiens et Loups. Mu ngengo y’imari ingana na miliyoni ebyiri z’ama euro harimo inkunga yatanzwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’Ubufaransa cy’Ubukorikori, n’ishoramari mbere yo kugurisha ryaturutse kuri Canal +, Canal Horizons, Ciné Cinéma na TV5Monde.
Gufata amashusho byabaye mu byumweru bitandatu aho biherereye muri Tchad, guhera 30 Ugushyingo 2009. Umuyobozi yavuze ko gufata amashusho muri N'Djamena ari nta shiti. Icyakora, igihe abo bakozi bafatiraga amashusho ahitwa Abéché, ikigo gikomeye cy’ingabo z’inyeshyamba, burigihe wasangaga ubwoba buri muntu wese wagize uruhare mu bicuruzwa. Ubusobanuro bwa Disability Anthropology(Ubumenyi bwa kinyamuntu ku bafite ubumuga).
"Disability Anthropology ni ishami ry'ubumenyi bwa kinyamuntu(anthropology) ryiga ku buryo abantu bafite ubumuga babaho, uburyo bashyikirana n'abandi, n'uko sosiyete ibabona kandi ibafata. Iri shami ntirishyira imbaraga gusa ku bushobozi cyangwa ku ndwara z'umubiri ahubwo rishishikajwe cyane n'imico, imyumvire,amateka n'imibanire y'abantu byose bifitanye isano n'ubumuga."
Urwego rwa antoropologiya y'ubumuga rwibanda ku ngingo zijyanye no kugerwaho, gukora, kwita,eugene, kwerekana indwara n'ibindi byinshi. Intiti ziteza imbere kandi zigasuzuma uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo cyangwa gufasha kuzana impinduka ku bantu bamugaye. Ingingo y'ubumuga muri antoropologiya yemeza abashakashatsi gukoresha lenzi(lens) ndangamuco hamwe n'uburyo bwa etinorogirafike(ethnolography) kugira ngo bamenye ikimenyane n'"ubundi" mu mico.

Urubanza rwiswe Omnibus Autism Proceeding rwari rugizwe n’imanza esheshatu z’igerageza zaburanishijwe n’abacamanza b’inzobere mu rukiko rwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika rushinzwe ibirego by’imari (United States Court of Federal Claims), hagamijwe gusuzuma niba hari isano ihamye hagati y’inkingo na autism. ["citation ikenewe"]
Kubera ko hari imanza nyinshi cyane zerekeye gahunda y’igihugu yo gutanga indishyi ku bahungabanyijwe n’inkingo (NVICP) zirega zemeza ko inkingo zateje autism zirenga 5000 by’ukuri abavoka b’abarega hamwe n’abacamanza b’inzobere bemeranyije gusuzuma imanza eshatu z’igerageza kugira ngo bamenye niba hari ibimenyetso bihagije bishyigikira isano iri hagati y’inkingo n'indwara y'autism. Bafashe iya mbere mu gusuzuma mu buryo butaziguye niba koko hari ibimenyetso bigaragaza impamvu n’ingaruka hagati y’inkingo na autism
Mu 2002, NVICP, abigiriwemo inama na komite nyobozi ishinzwe gusaba, yashyizeho Omnibus Autism Proceeding yo gukusanya izo manza. Bahisemo gusuzuma imanza esheshatu zipimishije zatanze kimwe cyangwa byinshi mu bikurikira bikurikira ku bijyanye n’inkingo-autism ihuza:
• Abavuga ko inkingo za MMR nizindi nkingo zirimo thimerosal zishobora guhuriza hamwe gutera autism.• Gusaba gushingira ku nkingo zirimo thimerosal zitera autism.• Kuvuga ko inkingo za MMR zonyine (tutiriwe tuvuga thimerosal) zishobora gutera autism.
Abayobozi batatu badasanzwe basuzumye ibimenyetso kuri buri kirego. Mu 2009, batanze imyanzuro yabo. Kuri buri kirego, inzobere eshatu zidasanzwe zanzuye ko nta sano riri hagati y'inkingo na autism.

Umutoza mukuru: Wael Abdelaaty

Ikaramu ikoreshwa mu kumenya impapuro mpimbano z'amafaranga ni ikaramu isiga wino irimo ayode(iodine)ku mpapuro z'amafaranga kugira ngo harebwe niba ari nyazo. Iyo wino ihuye n'ibinyabutaabire bya starch biboneka mu mpapuro zituruka ku giti, ihinduka umukara cyangwa ubururu. Ariko impapuro z'amafaranga nyazo ntizirimo ibinyamisogwe, bityo akamenyetso k'iyo wino kaguma kameze nk'uko kari gasanzwe.
Ayo makaramu akoreshwa mu kumenya impapuro z'amafaranga mpimbano akoreshwa kumenya inoti. Akoreshwa ku noti z'amafaranga y'u Busuwisi(Swiss franc),amayero(euro), n'amadolari y'America, n'izindi. Ubusanzwe impapuro zituruka ku myenda y'ipamba kandi ntizirimo ibinyabutabire by'ibinyabusogwe bihura na iyode(iodine).Iyo iyo karamu ishyizwe ku rupapuro rw'inoti nyayo, akamenyetso isiga kaba umuhondo cyangwa se ntikagaragare.
Izo karamu zikoreshwa mu kumenya inoti mpimbano zikora neza cyane ku mpapuro z'inoti z'impimbano ziba zaracapwe ku mpapuro zisanzwe zicapa cyangwa zikoreshwa na fotokopi.
Imiterere y'imiti ikoreshwa ku noti z'Amerika zacapwe mbere ya 1960 ituma izo karamu zidatanga ibisubizo nyabyo, bigateza amakosa yo kwemeza ko inoti nyazo ari impimbano.
Urugero rw'ibi rwabaye mu mwaka wa 2016, aho umunyeshuri w'imyaka 13 yafashwe na polisi nyuma yo kugerageza kwishyura ifunguro rya saa sita akoresheje inoti ya $2 yo muri "red seal Series 1953", nyuma y'uko ikaramu y'ishuri ishinzwe kumenya inoti mpimbano itabashije kugaragaza ko iyo noti ari iy'ukuri.
Abakora izo karamu bavuga ko izo karamu zibasha kumenya inoti mpimbano nyinshi kandi ko ari uburyo bworoshye bwo kumenya inoti mpimbano budasaba ibikoresho bihenze. Iyi karamu ya mbere yahimbwe n'Umunyabelijike(Belgian).
Abantu benshi bahakana ubuziranenge bw'izi karamu n'ugukora neza kwazo. Bavuga ko abahanga mu gukora inoti mpimbano badakoresha inote zifite ibinyabusogwe bityo iyi karamu ikaba ishobora kuba yakwibeshya bigatuma badashobora kumenya amafaranga nyiganano ari mu ikirakwizwa. Umutarika n'umushakashatsi ukunda gusuzuma ibintu by'ubupfumu witwa James Randi yagiye yandika kenshi ku kudakora neza kw'izo karamu kandi akagenda azikoresha mu ngero z'inyigisho yavuze ko yigeze kuvugana n’umukozi w’iperereza rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (United States Secret Service inspector) amubaza niba iyo karamu ikora nk’uko bivugwa, maze uwo mukozi amusubiza ati: “ntabwo yizewe.”
Uburyo izo karamu zikoramo bishobora kugirwaho ingaruka n'ibintu byo hanze. Urugero, iyo inoti yacishijwe mu isukura(laundry),bitewe n'isabune cyangwa umuti w'umweru(bleach)wakoreshejwe, ishobora kugaragara nk'impimbano kandi ari iya nyayo.
Byongeye kandi, byagaragaye ko iyo noti mpombano igiyeho umuti woroshye urimo vitamin C, ishobora gutanga igisubizo k'ikinyoma kiza(false negative);ni ukuvuga ko iyo karamu ifata iyo noti nk'aho ari impapuro nyazo z'inoti zemewe.
Nigute ushobora kugenzura amafaranga y'amiganano ukoresheje ikaramu?
Irimo umuti wa ayodine(iodine)uhura n'ibinyabusogwe (biboneka mu biti)byahura bikabyara akamenyetso k'umukara, ubururu bwijimye cyangwa umutuku w'umukaraIyo uwo muti ushyizwe ku mpapuro zishingiye ku nsinga/inziga(fibre) zikoreshwa ku noti nyazo,ntihabaho guhinduka kw'ibara;akamenyetso gahinduka umuhondo woroshye.

Irembo ni urubuga ruriho serivise ziboneka mu Rwanda kandi rucyingerwaho izindi zibigo byubucuruzi zari zisanzwe zitangwa mu buryo bunyuranye birimo birimo guhamagara aba agents bibyo bogo kujya ku iro bikoreraho nubundi bwinshi butatanye.

Ikipe y'u Rwanda y'abakobwa yageze ku mukino wa nyuma mu mikino y'isi y'abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mumutwe (Special Olympics world summer Game) yaberaga mu Budage muri 2023, nyuma yo gutsinda Bahrat yo mu buhinde zari zanganije ibitego 2-2, kuri penaliti 4-3..
U Rwanda rwitabiriye iyi mikino yabere Berlin kuva tariki 17kugeza 25 Kamena mu mikino itatu irimo Umupira w'amaguru, Bocce n'imikino ngorora mubiri mu gusiganwa metero 100

Ubumuga &amp; Sosiyete ni ikinyamakuru cy’ubushakashatsi gisuzumwa n’inzobere mu rwego rw’ubumenyi mubyerekeranye n'ubumuga. Cyatangijwe mu mwaka wa 1986 cyitwa Ubumuga, Uburema &amp; Sosiyete, hanyuma gihindura izina cyitwa Ubumuga "&amp; Sosiyete" mu mwaka wa 1994. Gisohorwa na Taylor &amp;amp; Francis naho umwanditsi mukuru ni Michele Moore (Kaminuza ya Essex). Nk’uko "ikinyamakuru Citation Reports kibitangaza" ngo iki kinyamakuru gifite ingaruka z’umwaka wa 2017 zingana na 1.212, kiza ku mwanya wa 42 mu binyamakuru 98 biri mu cyiciro “Ubumenyi bw’imibereho buvanga ibyiciro bitandukanye” ndetse ku mwanya wa 40 mu binyamakuru 69 byo mu cyiciro cya "“Gusubizaho ubushobozi bw’umuntu”."

Ababana n'ubumuga mu Burundi bagereranywa ku kuba bagera ku bantu bagera ku 350.000.
Kuya 26 Mata 2007, u Burundi bwashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga maze bwemeza kuya 22 Gicurasi 2014. Yatangiye gukurikizwa kuya 21 Kamena 2014.

Ubumuga muri Boliviya bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Boliviya.
Boliviya yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku ya 13 Kanama 2007 ayemeza ku ya 16 Ugushyingo 2009. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku ya 16 Ukuboza 2009.
Kugeza ubu mu gihugu hari abantu 741,382 bafite ubumuga butandukanye mu gihugu, aho bugabanyijemo ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (abantu 222,410), ubumuga bw'umubiri (abantu 222,410), ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (abantu 259,480) n'ubundi bumuga (abantu 37,070).

Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2019, abantu 4.9% bo muri Kambodiya bafite imyaka 5 kuzamura bafite ubumuga mu bipimo bitandukanye.
Kambodiya yemeje amasezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga n’amasezerano ya VIP ya Marrakesh.
Muri 2019, hari abantu 2,860 bafite ubumuga bakoreshwa na guverinoma ya Kambodiya.

Umubare w'abafite ubumuga muri Kosta Rika ni 10.5% by'abaturage. Iki gihugu kiri mu masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga kuva mu 2008.
Imibare y'abaturage.
Ibarura rusange ry’igihugu rya 2011 ryerekana ko 10.5% by’aba kosta Rica bafite ubumuga, 52% muri bo ni abagore n’abagabo 48%. Ubumuga bwo kutabona budashobora gukosorwa nindorerwamo cyangwa lens nubumuga bukunze kugaragara (56%).
Amategeko na politiki.
Ku ya 30 Werurwe 2007, Costa Rica yashyize umukono ku masezerano "y’umuryango" w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga kandi yemeza ayo masezerano ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2008. Mu rwego rw’amategeko yitwa "Itegeko ry’ama­hirwe angana" (Ley de Igualdad de Oportunidades), nta muntu ushobora kubogamirwa cyangwa guhezwa kubera ubumuga, niba bafite ubushobozi bungana n’ubw’abandi. Iri tegeko rishimangira kandi ko ahantu rusange no gutwara abantu hagomba kugira ibikoresho bifasha ababana n'ubumuga kubageraho.
Gicurasi 28 ni "Día Nacional de la Persona con Discapacidad" (Umunsi w’abafite ubumuga ku rwego rw’igihugu) hagamijwe guteza imbere kubaha abamugaye.
Iki gihugu cyitabiriye bwa mbere imikino y'abamugaye mu mikino Paralempike yo mu 1992, cyabuze ku nshuro ya 1996, kigaruka mu 2000 kandi gihagarariwe mu mikino Paralympike yose kuva icyo gihe. Kosta Rika ntabwo yigeze yitabira mikino ya Paralympike yo mu gihe cy’imbeho.
Ishyaka rya politiki Kuboneka nta guhezwa ("Partido de Acceso Sin Exclusión") rifite uburenganzira bw’ubumuga nk’imwe mu ntego zaryo zikomeye, perezida w’ishyaka, kandi guhera mu matora rusange yo mu 2014, umwe mu bagize Inteko ishinga amategeko ni Óscar López.

Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku baturage ba Eritereya n’ubuzima muri Eritereya mu mwaka wa 2010, muri Eritereya hari abantu bagera ku 149,103 bafite ubumuga.
Umubare munini w’abafite ubumuga mu gihugu ni abafite ibibazo byo kubona, ubumuga bwo mu mutwe no kutagenda.
Ingingo ya 14 (3), 41 (6) (C) na 51 (1) y’Itegeko Nshinga rya Eritereya zivuga by’umwihariko ku bibazo by’ubumuga mu gihugu, zirimo ubuhezanguni ku bantu bafite ubumuga burabujijwe. Mu itegeko nshinga, guverinoma itegetswe guharanira imibereho myiza no guha abaturage bose, harimo n’abafite ubumuga, umuco, uburezi, ubuzima n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage mu rwego rw’umutungo w’igihugu.
Ishami rishinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe no kwishyira hamwe mu ishami rishinzwe imibereho myiza ya Minisiteri y’umurimo n’imibereho myiza y’abantu ni urwego rwa leta rushinzwe ibibazo bijyanye n’ubumuga n’abafite ubumuga mu gihugu.

Ubumuga muri Gabon bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Gabon.
Mu mwaka wa 1995, Gabon yashyizeho itegeko risaba inyubako zose n'imihanda nyabagendwa bigera ku bantu bafite ubumuga. Igihugu cyemeje burundu Amasezerano y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga mu mwaka wa 2007. Muri 2014, cyemeza protokole y’inyongera ajyanye n’ayo masezerano..
Kuva mu mwaka wa 2015, 2% by’abaturage ba Gabon bari bafite ubumuga mu rugero rutandukanye, bingana n’abantu 27,100.

Ubumuga muri Gineya-Bissau bivuga ibibazo bifitanye isano n’abafite ubumuga muri Gineya-Bissau.
Gineya-Bissau yemeje Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku ya 24 Nzeri 2014.
Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2021, hari abantu 11,584 bo muri Gineya-Bissau bafite ubumuga butandukanye.

Ikigereranyo cy’ubwinshi bw’ubumuga muri Indoneziya kiratandukanye cyane ukurikije ibipimo. Ibarura rusange rya Indoneziya ryo mu 2010 rivuga ko 4.29% gusa bo muri Indoneziya bafite ubumuga, aho 3.94% mu bagabo na 4.64% mu bagore. Amakuru akomoka ku bushakashatsi bwo mu ngo bwa Riskesdas bwo mu mwaka wa 2007, hashingiwe ku bisobanuro bivuga kugira ingorane nyinshi nibura mu rwego rumwe rw’imikorere, agaragaza igipimo cy’ubumuga cya 11.05%, aho abagabo bagize 9.40% naho abagore bakagira 12.57%. Ibyiciro byombi byerekana imibare yubumuga izamuka cyane uko imyaka igenda ishira.
Indoneziya ni igihugu cyasinye ku masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga,aho yasinyiye ayo masezerano ku wa 30 Werurwe 2007 kandi iyemeza ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 2011.

Kuva mu mwaka wa 2001, hafi ya 4.2% by’abaturage ba Lesotho bafite ubumuga, mu rugero rutandukanye, kandi kimwe cya gatatu(1/3) cyabo ni abana bari munsi y’imyaka15.
Abantu bafite ubumuga benshi mu gihugu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona neza, kutumva, kutabasha kugenda neza, ibibazo byo kwibuka, kwifasha mu buzima bwa buri munsi, cyangwa mu itumanaho.
Amategeko na politiki.
Ingingo ya 33 y'Itegeko Nshinga rya Lesotho iteganya ingingo yo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe, guhugura no gutuza abantu bafite ubumuga. Lesotho yemeje Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bw’umuryango w’abibumbye ku wa 2 Ukuboza 2008. Politiki y’Igihugu yerekeye Ubumuga n’Isubiraho mu Buzima (NDRP) yo mu 2011 igamije gufasha guverinoma ya Lesotho mu gutegura gahunda n’ingamba zireba by’umwihariko abafite ubumuga.
Ihuriro ry’igihugu ry’amashyirahamwe y’abafite ubumuga rya Lesotho (LNFOD) ryashinzwe mu 1989 nkurwego rwo hejuru rw’imiryango y’abafite ubumuga. Abayigize ni; Ishyirahamwe ry’igihugu ry’abafite ubumuga bw’umubiri (LNAPD), Ishyirahamwe ry’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bwa Lesotho (IDAL), Ishyirahamwe ry’igihugu ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona (LNLVIP) n’ishyirahamwe ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva muri Lesotho (NADL).
Abamugaye barenga 65% mugihugu batunzwe n'imiryango yabo ndetse n'abaturanyi kugirango babeho buri munsi.
Lesotho yakoze imikino yayo y'abamugaye début mu mikino Paralempike yo mu 2000 yabereye i Sydney. Yagiye mu marushanwa yose ya Paralympique yo mu mpeshyi kuva icyo gihe, ariko ntabwo yigeze mu mikino Paralympike. Lesotho ntiratsindira umudari mu mikino Paralympique.

Ubumuga muri Macau bivuga ibibazo bifitanye isano nabafite ubumuga i Macau, mu Bushinwa.
Ubushinwa, harimo na Macau, bwashyize umukono ku masezerano y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga. Amategeko ya Macau avuga ko kubuza ivangura rishingiye ku bumuga mu burezi, ku kazi, mu kwivuza cyangwa kugera ku zindi serivisi rusange.
Guhuza no gutera inkunga gahunda zifasha abaturage bafite ubumuga bashinzwe na Biro ishinzwe imibereho myiza.
Ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2017, guverinoma yongereye umubare w'inkunga ebyiri z’abafite ubumuga ku baturage bahoraho hiyongereyeho 6.67% ku nkunga isanzwe y’ubumuga na 7.14% ku nkunga idasanzwe y’ubumuga.
Ikibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Macau n’ibibuga by’imodoka z’amato biragerwaho n’abantu bafite ubumuga bafashijwe n’abakozi. Ibiro bishinzwe imibereho myiza itanga kandi ingendo zitishyurwa zijya ku bitaro n’ibigo by’ubuvuzi hifashishijwe bisi ya Rehabilitation. Gutwara abantu na serivisi z'ubukerarugendo ku bamugaye nazo ziraboneka na Macau Barrier Ubukerarugendo bwubuntu. Abanyamaguru muri rusange bafite ibimenyetso byumvikana kandi bazamutse-bakandagira. Aho abantu bafite ubumuga bashobora guhagarara hateganywa ahantu hatandukanye mu bibuga by’imodoka rusange.

Ubumuga muri Mongoliya bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Mongoliya.
Itegeko rya Mongoliya ryerekeye uburenganzira bwa muntu bw’abafite ubumuga ryashyizweho mu mwaka wa 2016 na Leta nkuru ya Khural. Gahunda y'igihugu ishinzwe uburenganzira, uruhare no kurengera ababana n'ubumuga yemejwe na guverinoma mu mwaka wa 2017 ishyirwa mu bikorwa nyuma.
Isuzuma ryakozwe n’umuryango w’ubuzima ku isi mu mwaka wa 2018 ryerekanye ko, kimwe n’ibihugu byinshi bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, ababana n'ubumuga bafite ikibazo cyo gukoresha uburenganzira bwa politiki ndetse n’abaturage, ndetse no kubona uburezi n’akazi.
Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2024, muri Mongoliya hari abantu 115,000 bafite ubumuga butandukanye. Ubwoko bw’abafite ubumuga mu gihugu ni ubumuga bwo kugenda (19.9%), ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (19.0%), ubumuga bwo kutabona (10,6%), kutumva neza (8.2%), kutavuga ururimi (4.0%), guhuriza hamwe (7.5%) n’abandi (30.4%). Abagera kuri 11% muri bo ni abana.
Muri 2019 mu Ntara ya Govisümber, hari abantu 742 bafite ubumuga, bangana na 4% by'intara. Mu Ntara ya Dornogovi, hari abantu 2,642 bafite ubumuga, bangana na 3.7% by'intara.
Mu mwaka wa 2023, kaminuza nkuru ya Mongoliya yatangije isomero rifite ibitabo bifata amajwi ku banyeshuri bafite ubumuga. Isomero ryagenewe gusa abo bantu.

Nk’uko Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare cya Namibia kibivuga, hashingiwe ku bushakashatsi bwo mu mwaka wa 2016 bwiswe Inter-censal Demographic Survey, 5% by'abaturage ba Namibiya bafite ubumuga mu rugero rutandukanye.
Namibia yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku ya 25 Mata 2007 ayemeza ku ya 14 Ukuboza 2007. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2008.
Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2001, mu bantu bose bafite ubumuga, 35% bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, 27% bafite ubumuga bwo kugenda burimo amaboko n'amaguru, 21% bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, 11% bafite ubumuga bwo kutavuga, 5% bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe.

Uburenganzira bw’umwana mu Rwanda ku burezi n’imibereho busobanura ihame ry’uko buri mwana agomba kurindwa, kurindwa ihohoterwa, no kubona amahirwe angana yo kwiga no kugira imibereho myiza. Mu Rwanda, Leta, imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta ndetse n’imiryango mpuzamahanga nka UNICEF Rwanda bafatanyiriza hamwe mu gushyira mu bikorwa politiki n’amategeko agamije guteza imbere imibereho y’umwana no kumurinda.
Amategeko n’ishingiro ry’uburenganzira bw’umwana.
Uburenganzira bw’umwana mu Rwanda bushingiye ku Itegeko nshinga rya Repubulika y'u Rwanda n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga, harimo Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC) yashyiriweho umukono mu 1989.
Amategeko y’u Rwanda arimo:
Aya mategeko ashimangira ko buri mwana afite uburenganzira bwo kubaho, kurindwa ihohoterwa, kwiga, kugira ubuzima bwiza, no kugira amahirwe angana n’abandi bana bose mu gihugu.
Uburenganzira ku burezi.
Uburezi ni imwe mu nkingi z’ingenzi mu burenganzira bw’umwana mu Rwanda. Minisiteri y’Uburezi (MINEDUC) yashyizeho gahunda yo kugeza uburezi kuri bose (Education for All) aho abana bose bagomba kubona amahirwe angana yo kwiga kuva ku rwego rw’incuke kugeza ku rwego rwisumbuye.
U Rwanda rwateye imbere mu kwandikisha abana mu mashuri abanza hafi ku gipimo cya 98%, nk’uko byagaragajwe na UNICEF Rwanda mu 2023. Ariko, hari imbogamizi zikigaragara zirimo ubwinshi bw’abanyeshuri mu ishuri rimwe, ibikoresho bike n’ubuke bw’abarimu bafite ubumenyi bujyanye n’igihe.
Uburezi bw’incuke (ECD).
Gahunda za Early Childhood Development (ECD) zashyizwe imbere kugira ngo abana bato babone serivisi z’uburezi, ubuzima n’imirire myiza mbere y’uko batangira amashuri abanza. Izi gahunda zifatwa nk’urufunguzo rwo kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi ry’umwana kuva akiri muto. Leta y’u Rwanda n’abafatanyabikorwa nka UNICEF n’Imbuto Foundation bafatanya mu kubaka ibigo by’incuke no guhugura abarimu b’abana bato.
Uburezi burimo bose (Inclusive Education).
Mu rwego rwo kurengera abana bafite ubumuga, u Rwanda rwashyizeho gahunda y’uburezi burimo bose, aho abana bose biga hamwe kandi bagahabwa ubufasha bukenewe. Ibi bikorwa birimo kubaka ibyumba by’amashuri bifite uburenganzira kuri bose, gutanga ibikoresho byihariye, no guhugura abarimu mu kwigisha abana bafite ubumuga.
Imibereho myiza y’umwana mu Rwanda yibanda ku buzima, imirire, umutekano, n’uburere mu muryango.
Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho gahunda yo gutanga ku bana bose, by’umwihariko abaturuka mu miryango ikennye. Hari kandi gahunda za Isange One Stop Center zifasha abana bahohotewe kubona ubufasha bwihuse mu bijyanye n’ubuvuzi, amategeko n’ihungabana.
Uburinzi n’iterambere.
Abana barengerwa n’amategeko igihe bahura n’ihohoterwa, guta ishuri, cyangwa gukoreshwa imirimo ivunanye. Inzego z’ibanze, ababyeyi n’amashuri bifatanya mu gukurikirana abana bafite ibibazo, binyuze mu bayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze n’abajyanama b’ubuzima. National Commission for Children ikorana n’amadini, amashuri n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta mu bukangurambaga bwo kurengera abana.
Imibare n’ibigaragara mu bushakashatsi.
Nk’uko EICV7 Thematic Report: Education (2023/24) yabigaragaje, 47% by’abana barangiza amashuri abanza badafite ubumenyi bw’ibanze bukwiye mu gusoma no mu mibare. Ariko, ubwitabire mu mashuri y’incuke n’ayisumbuye bwiyongereye ku kigero cyisumbuye cyane ugereranyije n’imyaka yashize, bigaragaza intambwe ishimishije mu rwego rw’uburezi.
Ubuke bw’ibikoresho n’abarimu mu mashuri y’ibanze.
Ibibazo by’imibereho mibi bituma bamwe bata ishuri.
Abana bafite ubumuga batarabona amahirwe angana n’abandi.
Ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana rikitabirwa kugaragazwa n’amategeko.
Inama n’ingamba z’iterambere.
Gukomeza gushora imari mu burezi bw’incuke n’ireme ry’uburezi.
Guhugura abarimu ku buryo bwo kwigisha abana bafite ubumuga.
Gukomeza gahunda z’uburenganzira bw’umwana mu nzego z’ibanze no mu miryango.
Gukoresha ubushakashatsi buhoraho mu gusuzuma ireme ry’uburezi n’imibereho y’abana.

Ubumuga muri Papuwa Niyugine ni ikibazo kigihangayikishije gikomeje, aho ibikorwa remezo bidahagije bikunze kubuza abafite ubumuga kubona uburezi, serivisi z’ubuvuzi, akazi, n’izindi serivisi z’ibanze. Kugerwaho ni ikibazo gikomeye, cyane cyane ku bana cyangwa ku bagore bafite ubumuga, bahura n'inzitizi zo kubona serivisi z'ubuzima, uburezi, ubwikorezi rusange, n'ibiro bya leta.. Guverinoma yemeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, ariko kumenya ubwo burenganzira bisaba ko hashyirwaho uburyo bunoze bw’amategeko n’amabwiriza, gukusanya umutungo, hamwe n’ubufatanye bukomeye n’igihugu.
Ihame rya "Ntihagire umuntu n'umwe usiga inyuma", ingamba nka Loni ’Abagore zishyigikira guverinoma mu kuzamura uruhare rw’abaturage mu bafite ubumuga, gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, no guharanira gahunda y’umuryango w’abibumbye 2030 igamije iterambere rirambye.

Imibereho y’ababana n’ubumuga mu Rwanda igaragaza uko abana bafite ubumuga babaho, uburyo Leta n’abafatanyabikorwa babafasha, n’imbogamizi bagihura nazo mu burezi, ubuzima n’imibereho. Ubumuga bushobora kuba ubw’umubiri, ubw’ubwenge, ubw’amarangamutima cyangwa ubuvukanwa. Abana bafite ubumuga bakeneye ubufasha bwihariye kugira ngo bagere ku burenganzira bwabo nk’abandi bana bose.
Amategeko n’amabwiriza abigenga.
Itegeko n° 01/2007 ryo ku wa 21 Gicurasi 2007 rigena uburyo bwo kurengera abantu bafite ubumuga mu Rwanda. Rishyiraho uburyo bwo gutanga uburezi bukwiye no gushyigikira abantu bafite ubumuga mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.
Nanone, Itegeko No 54/2011 ryerekeye uburenganzira n’itegurwa ry’umwana rifasha mu kurengera abana bafite ubumuga. Itegeko No 54/2011 rigena uburenganzira n’itegurwa ry’umwana mu Rwanda.
Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho politiki y’uburezi burimo bose ("Inclusive Education Policy") kugira ngo abana bafite ubumuga babone amahirwe angana n’abandi mu burezi no mu buzima.
Imibereho y’abana bafite ubumuga.
Mu mashuri y’incuke n’abanza, abana bafite ubumuga bakunze guhura n’ibibazo byo kubona ibikoresho bibafasha cyangwa abarimu bafite ubumenyi mu burezi bwihariye. Leta yashyizeho gahunda y’abafasha b’amashuri ("teacher assistants") n’amashuri y’icyitegererezo yita ku burezi burimo bose.
Mu mashuri yisumbuye, hari ibigo bimwe na bimwe byashyizeho uburyo bwo gufasha abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga gukurikira amasomo, ariko ibikoresho n’imfashanyigisho ziracyari nke.
Ubuzima n’imibereho.
Abana bafite ubumuga bahura n’imbogamizi mu kubona serivisi z’ubuzima, harimo kugenzurwa hakiri kare ("screening") n’ibikoresho bibafasha mu mibereho ya buri munsi. Mu miryango itishoboye, ubukene butuma bamwe batitabwaho uko bikwiye.
Kurindwa no kwitabwaho mu muryango.
Abana bafite ubumuga bamwe bahura n’ihezwa rikomoka ku myumvire, cyangwa bagatereranwa n’imiryango. Leta n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta bakoze ubukangurambaga bwo guteza imbere imyumvire yo kwakira no kurengera abo bana.
Mu karere ka Musanze, umuryango "Ubumwe Community Center" utera inkunga abana bafite ubumuga babona ibikoresho n’ubufasha bwihariye mu mashuri.
Mu mujyi wa Kigali, ikigo "HVP Gatagara" cyakira abana bafite ubumuga bw’ingingo n’ubw’ubwenge, kikabafasha mu myigire n’ubuzima.
Abana bafite ubumuga mu karere ka Huye bafashwa ku bitaro bya Kabutare kubona ubuvuzi n’ibikoresho byo kugenda biturutse ku bufatanye n’umushinga nyarwanda Rwanda Resilience and Grounding Organization nk’uko byatangajwe mu nkuru ya Igihe.com.
Mu karere ka Rutsiro, gahunda y’uburezi burimo bose igenda ifasha abana bafite ubumuga kwinjizwa mu mashuri y’ibanze, nubwo imbogamizi z’imihanda n’ibikoresho bigihari nk'uko bigaragara kurubuga rw'akarere ka Rutsiro.
Abana bafite ubumuga mu Rwanda bafite amahirwe menshi yo guteza imbere imibereho yabo, ariko haracyari imbogamizi nyinshi. Imbaraga za Leta, imiryango n’abaturage muri rusange zigomba guhurizwa hamwe kugira ngo buri mwana abone uburenganzira bungana n’ubw’abandi.

Uburenganzira bw'Abagore mu Rwanda ni imwe mu ngingo zafashije igihugu kugera ku rwego rwo hejuru rw'uburinganire n'iterambere ry'imibereho myiza. U Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cya mbere ku isi rufite abagore benshi mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, rugera kuri 63.3% by’intebe mu mwaka wa 2024.
Mu myaka yakurikiye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Leta y’u Rwanda yashyize imbere politiki n’amategeko agamije kugarura uburenganzira bw’umugore, kumurinda ihohoterwa no kumufasha kugira uruhare mu bukungu n’imiyoborere y’igihugu.
Iyi nyandiko isuzuma amateka y’uburenganzira bw’abagore, uko byagiye byiyongera, intambwe imaze guterwa, imbogamizi zisigaye, n’uko iterambere ry’umugore rifasha igihugu mu buryo bw’imibereho, ubukungu n’imiyoborere.
Amateka y'Uburenganzira bw'Abagore mu Rwanda.
Mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abagore mu Rwanda bari bafite uruhare ruto cyane mu miyoborere n’ubukungu bw’igihugu. Imyumvire ya kera yashyiraga umugore mu rugo, ikamugabanyiriza amahirwe yo kwiga no kugira umutungo.
Nyuma ya 1994, gahunda zinyuranye zashyizweho, zirimo iyubahirizwa ry’uburinganire mu mategeko, gushyiraho Ministeri y’Uburinganire n’Iterambere ry’Umuryango (MIGEPROF), ndetse no kubaka inzego zishinzwe kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uburinganire nka Gender Monitoring Office.
Ibi byatumye umugore w’Umunyarwanda ava mu rwego rwo kuba “ufasha mu rugo” akajya mu rwego rw’umuyobozi, umushoramari, umucuruzi cyangwa umuhinzi ufite uburenganzira busesuye bwo gucunga umutungo we bwite.
Amategeko n'Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ashingiye ku Burenganzira bw'Abagore.
Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho uburyo bw’amategeko buha umugore uburenganzira bungana n’ubw’umugabo mu nzego zose. Ibi bigaragara cyane mu:
Mu rwego rw’imbere mu gihugu, hashyizweho amategeko asobanutse yerekeye:
Imibereho n’Imibare y’Uburenganzira bw’Abagore mu Rwanda.
Mu myaka ya vuba, imibare igaragaza ko abagore mu Rwanda bagenda bagira uruhare runini mu nzego zose z’ubuzima – uburezi, ubukungu, ubuzima, n’imiyoborere.
Mu rwego rw’uburezi, U Rwanda rwashyizeho gahunda yo gutuma abakobwa bagira amahirwe angana n’abahungu mu mashuri yose. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2023, abakobwa bigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye bari 59.3%, mu gihe abahungu bari 40.7%. Muri kaminuza, umubare w’abagore wiyongereye ugera kuri 46.2% mu mwaka wa 2024. Leta yashyizeho porogaramu nka “Girls’ Education Policy” n’iyitwa “STEM for Girls” igamije kongera ubwitabire bw’abakobwa mu masomo y’ubumenyi, ikoranabuhanga n’imibare.
Mu rwego rw’ubuzima, abagore bashobora kubona serivisi z’ubuzima bw’imyororokere, kuboneza urubyaro, no kuboneza gahunda y’ababyeyi. 98% by’abagore batwite bitabira nibura uruzinduko rumwe kwa muganga mbere yo kubyara. Indangamuntu y’igihugu (Mutuelle de Santé) yatumye abagore benshi bashobora kubona serivisi z’ubuzima ku giciro gito, bituma urupfu rw’ababyeyi rugabanyuka cyane kuva ku 1071 ku bana 100,000 bavuka (mu 2000) rugera kuri 210 mu 2023.
Abagore bagira uruhare rukomeye mu bukungu bw’igihugu. 68.9% by’abaturage bakora ubuhinzi, kandi 94.8% by’abagore bafite ubutaka butangwa n’amategeko. Nubwo abagore bafite uruhare mu buhinzi, abashobora kubona inguzanyo mu mabanki baracyari 35% gusa ugereranyije n’abagabo 65%. Leta yashyizeho gahunda “Women Guarantee Fund” ifasha abagore kubona inguzanyo mu bikorwa by’ubucuruzi no kwihangira imirimo.
Imiyoborere n'Ubutabera.
Abagore mu Rwanda bafite uruhare runini mu miyoborere. Mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, abagore bafite 63.3% by’intebe, mu gihe mu Nama Njyanama z’Uturere bari 49%. Mu rwego rw’ubutabera, 52% by’abacamanza ni abagore, ndetse 48% by’abashinjacyaha bakuru ni abagore.
Intambwe zimaze guterwa.
U Rwanda rufatwa nk’igihugu cy’intangarugero muri Afurika mu gushyira mu bikorwa uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umugore.
Amavugurura mu Mategeko.
Amategeko yo kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, ayo ku mitungo, n’ayo ku butaka yahawe imbaraga, bituma abagore bagira uburenganzira busesuye. Ibi byagize uruhare rukomeye mu kugabanya ihohoterwa no kongera umutekano w’umugore mu muryango.
Politiki n’Ubukangurambaga.
Porogaramu nka HeForShe Rwanda yatumye abagabo nabo baba abafatanyabikorwa mu rugamba rwo guteza imbere uburinganire. Hari kandi gahunda za Leta ziteza imbere abagore mu bucuruzi n’ubuhinzi nka “Hanga Umurimo”, “Made in Rwanda”, na “Kuremera Program”.
Uruhare rw’Imiryango Mpuzamahanga.
Imiryango nka UN Women, USAID, na ActionAid yatanze inkunga mu bikorwa by’ubukungu n’uburezi bw’abagore, ishyiraho amahugurwa n’amikoro yo guteza imbere ubushobozi bw’abagore mu cyaro.
Imbogamizi zisigaye.
Nubwo intambwe imaze guterwa ari nyinshi, haracyari imbogamizi mu nzego zimwe.
Hari ibice by’igihugu bigifite imyumvire ya kera igaragaza umugore nk’udashobora gufata ibyemezo cyangwa kuyobora. Ibi bigira ingaruka ku bwisanzure n’ubushobozi bwe mu miyoborere y’aho atuye.
Ihohoterwa rishingiye ku Gitsina.
Nubwo amategeko ahari, ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina riracyabaho cyane mu ngo. 31% by’abagore baracyavuga ko bahura n’ihohoterwa ryo mu ngo. Gahunda zo gukumira ihohoterwa, nka Isange One Stop Centre, zafashije gutanga ubufasha bwihuse ariko zikenewe mu gihugu hose.
Ubukungu n’Ikoranabuhanga.
Abagore mu cyaro bafite amahirwe make yo kubona ikoranabuhanga. 64% gusa ni bo bafite telefone ngendanwa, mu gihe 32% gusa bafite interineti. Ibi bituma bagira uruhare ruke mu bucuruzi bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga.
Ingaruka z’Iterambere ry’Umugore ku gihugu.
Iterambere ry’umugore ryagize uruhare rukomeye mu kubaka ubukungu n’imibereho myiza mu Rwanda.
Kongerera abagore ubushobozi byatumye ubukungu bw’igihugu bwiyongera. Inyigo ya World Bank igaragaza ko uburinganire mu bukungu bwongereye umusaruro w’igihugu ku gipimo cya 2% buri mwaka.
Mu Muryango n'Ubuzima.
Abagore bafite ubushobozi n’ubumenyi bafasha mu iterambere ry’imiryango yabo, bakagira uruhare mu kurera neza, kubungabunga ubuzima no guteza imbere uburezi bw’abana.
Ubwitabire bw’abagore mu miyoborere bwagize uruhare mu gukumira ruswa no kuzamura imikorere y’inzego za Leta.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu 10 bya mbere ku isi mu kigereranyo cy’uburinganire, rukaba urutonde rwa 6 ku Isi muri Global Gender Gap Report 2024.
Amayeri n’Inama z’Iterambere.
Kugira ngo iterambere ry’umugore mu Rwanda rikomeze kugenda neza kandi rirambye, hashyizweho amayeri n’inama mu nzego zitandukanye:
Imibereho y’Abagore n’Inkuru Zifatika.
Mu rwego rwo kugaragaza iterambere ry’umugore mu Rwanda, hari inkuru zifatika z’abagore bahinduye imibereho yabo n’iy’imiryango yabo. Izi nkuru zerekana uko amategeko, gahunda za Leta, n’imikoranire y’abagore mu bukungu n’uburezi bihuriza hamwe.
Iterambere ry’umugore mu Rwanda ryagaragaje ko uburinganire ari urufunguzo rwo kugera ku iterambere rirambye. Abagore bafite uruhare mu miyoborere, ubukungu, uburezi, ubuzima, n’imibereho myiza y’imiryango.
Nk’uko imibare yerekana, u Rwanda ruri mu bihugu bya mbere ku isi mu gushyira mu bikorwa uburinganire, kandi politiki z’igihugu n’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu byahindutse intangarugero muri Afurika. Gukomeza gushyira imbere uburezi, ubushobozi, uburinganire mu butabera n’ubukungu bizafasha umugore kugira uruhare rugaragara kandi rirambye mu iterambere ry’igihugu.

Itsinda ry’u Bwongereza ry’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (LD) ni imwe mu makipe umunani y’ubumuga ashyigikiwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira wamaguru. Kugira ngo umukinnyi ajye muri iri tsinda, agomba kuba afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, afite IQ iri munsi cyangwa ingana na 70–75, nk’uko bisobanurwa n’ Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS). Nanone kandi, umukinnyi agomba kuba yarahawe uburezi bwihariye, cyangwa yaritabiriye akazi cyangwa serivisi z’ituzanwa hagati y’imyaka 0 kugeza kuri 18.
Itsinda ry’u Bwongereza ry’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (England LD team) ryatsindiye igikombe cy’isi cy’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe mu mikino ya INAS mu mwaka wa 2002, ubwo ryatsindaga Ubuholandi (Netherlands) ibitego 2–1 kuri Stade Yokohama, mu Buyapani, muri Kanama 2002. Mu kwezi kwa Kanama 2003, bageze ku mukino wa nyuma w’irushanwa rya Learning Disabilities European Championships, ariko batsindirwa ibitego 2–1 n’Ubuholandi muri Portugal. Mu mwaka wa 2004, muri Kanama, babaye abanyarukiko b’isi mu mikino ya mbere yiswe Global Games, batsinda Polonye ibitego 4–1 ku mukino wa nyuma wabereye i Bollnäs, muri Suède (Sweden). Ariko, abari bafite igikombe cy’isi batsinzwe mu mikino ya ¼ cy’irushanwa (quarter finals) y’irushanwa rya INAS FID World Football Championship mu mwaka wa 2006, batsindwa ibitego 4–1 na Arabie Saoudite (Saudi Arabia) i Recklinghausen, mu Budage.

Uburenganzira bwo gutanga ibitekerezo ni kimwe mu burenganzira bwa muntu bw’ingenzi kandi bwemewe n’Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda rya 2003. Ubu burenganzira burimo ubwisanzure bwo kuvuga, gucapa ibitabo, gukora itangazamakuru, no kugaragaza ibitekerezo mu ruhame.
Nubwo iri burenganzira ryubahirizwa ku mpapuro, mu Rwanda haracyagaragara imbogamizi zimwe zishingiye ku amategeko, umutekano w’igihugu, n’imyitwarire y’abantu ku giti cyabo.
Ubwisanzure mu Itangazamakuru.
Mu Rwanda, itangazamakuru ryiyongera ku buryo bugaragara, haba mu binyamakuru byandika, amaradio, televiziyo, ndetse na internet. Ariko abanyamakuru bakunze guhura n’ibihano mu gihe bavuze ibitangaje bitemewe cyangwa bavuze ku nsanganyamatsiko zifitanye isano n’umutekano w’igihugu.
1. Ibyemezo bishingiye ku mategeko: Amategeko akumira amagambo agira icyo ahungabanya ku butegetsi cyangwa ku mutekano w’igihugu, rimwe na rimwe bikaba byangiza ubwisanzure bw’abantu ku giti cyabo.
2. Ihohoterwa ku batanga ibitekerezo: Hari abanyamakuru n’abaharanira uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu bahohoterwa cyangwa bakorerwa ibihano kubera ibitekerezo byabo.
3. Imyumvire y’abaturage: Abantu bamwe baracyafite imyumvire yo gutinya kuvuga ibitekerezo byabo, cyane cyane ku nsanganyamatsiko zishingiye kuri politike.
- Hariho gutanga amahugurwa ku bitangazamakuru n’abaturage ku burenganzira bwabo bwo gutanga ibitekerezo.
- Gahunda za Leta n’imiryango mpuzamahanga zashyigikiye ikoranabuhanga rituma abaturage bashobora gutanga ibitekerezo ku mbuga zemewe n’amategeko.

Imiryango imwe n’imwe y’ubugiraneza, nk’Ishingiro rya Scottish Rite Foundation, yafashe inshingano zo gukora ibizamini bisuzuma indwara yo kutabasha gusoma neza (dyslexia) no gutegura amasomo n’ibikoresho byo kwigisha, akenshi bitangwa ku buntu, ku barimu n’abanyeshuri.

masezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco (ICESCR) ni amasezerano y’ibihugu byinshi yemejwe n’Inteko (GA) ku ya 16 Ukuboza 1966 binyuze muri GA. Icyemezo 2200A (XXI), gitangira gukurikizwa ku Mutarama 1976. Uburenganzira bukubiyemo uburenganzira bw'umurimo, uburenganzira ku buzima, uburenganzira bwo kwiga, n'uburenganzira ku mibereho ihagije. Kuva muri Kanama 2025, Amasezerano afite amashyaka 173. Ibindi bihugu bine, harimo na Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika, byashyize umukono ku masezerano ariko ntibyemeza ayo masezerano.
Amasezerano akurikiza imiterere ya UDHR na ICCPR, hamwe nintangiriro ningingo mirongo itatu nimwe, igabanijwemo ibice bitanu.

Uburenganzira ku rukiko ruteza imbere ubutabera ni kimwe mu burenganzira bw’ibanze bwa buri muntu. Buri wese mu Rwanda afite uburenganzira bwo kubona ubutabera butabogamye, bwihuse kandi bukurikije amategeko. Iri burenganzira ryubahirizwa n’amategeko y’igihugu, Itegeko Nshinga, ndetse n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga u Rwanda rwasinye.
Uburyo Urukiko Ruteza Imbere Ubutabera Bukora.
1. Inzira z’Amategeko: Buri muntu ashobora kujya mu rukiko agashaka ubutabera igihe yahanganye n’ikibazo cy’amategeko cyangwa impapuro z’amakosa.
2. Uburenganzira bwo Guhabwa Umunyamategeko:Buri wese afite uburenganzira bwo kubona umwunganizi mu rukiko.
3. Ubutabera bwihuse: Urukiko rufite inshingano zo gutanga ubutabera mu gihe gito kandi bukurikije amategeko kugira ngo abantu batagwizwa n’akarengane.

Mu Gihugu cya Repubulika ya Irilande, abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabasha gusoma neza (dyslexia), cyane cyane abana bo mu mashuri, bashobora gufashwa n’uburyo butandukanye burimo: gufashwa kwigira ku giti cyabo n’abarimu b’inzobere mu myigishirize, gukoresha ibikoresho bya mudasobwa bifite ubushobozi bwo gusoma inyandiko (text-to-speech), gukosora inyuguti no guhanga amagambo (word prediction); ndetse no gukoresha amataratara afite amabara n’izindi ngamba nyinshi zitandukanye. Uburyo buhitamo gufasha umuntu bushingira ku mimerere ye yihariye. Abantu bo muri Irilande y'Amajyaruguru bafashwa na serivisi zitangwa n’imiryango ishinzwe gufasha abafite Dyslexia mu Bwongereza.
Ukurikije urwego rwubumuga, abanyeshuri barashobora guhabwa inkunga nubufasha bwihariye akeneye.
Gusonerwa ururimi rwa Irilande.
Ururimi rw’Igihugu rwa Irlande (Irish) ni isomo ribanza kandi risabwa ku banyeshuri bose. Ariko, abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutabasha gusoma neza (dyslexia) bashobora gusaba gusonerwa iri somo, kugira ngo bibande ku kwiga ururimi rw’Icyongereza.
Abanyeshuri bakeneye ubufasha mu gukora ibizamini bya leta (nk’abandikira ibisubizo cyangwa abakoresha poroseseur yo kwandika ku mudasobwa) bashobora gusaba uburenganzira bwo koroherezwa binyuze muri gahunda yitwa Reasonable Accommodation in the Certificate Examinations (RACE). Mu mwaka wa 2015, abanyeshuri bagera kuri 9,000 ni bo bakeneye ubu bufasha.
Abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha bwihariye ndetse n’uburyo bwo kwinjira muri kaminuza n'amashuri makuru binyuze muri gahunda yitwa Disability Access Route to Education (DARE). Mu rwego rw’iyi gahunda, dyslexia is recognized nka ubumuga bwihariye mu myigire (Specific Learning Difficulty – SLD). Amwe mu mashuri makuru na kaminuza ateganyiriza imyanya yihariye aba banyeshuri, ku buryo rimwe na rimwe ayo myanya ihabwa abatsindiye amanota make kurusha asabwa muri gahunda isanzwe ya CAO (Central Applications Office).

Uburenganzira ku mirimo ni kimwe mu burenganzira bw’ingenzi bwa muntu, bukubiye mu Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda rya 2003. Buri muntu afite uburenganzira bwo gukora, kubona akazi kagendanye n’ubushobozi bwe, ndetse no guhabwa umushahara ungana n’icyo akora.
Politiki n’Ibikorwa.
- **Gahunda yo guteza imbere urubyiruko:** Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho amahugurwa n’ubumenyi ngiro ku rubyiruko kugira ngo rube rufite ubushobozi bwo kubona akazi. - **Inkunga ku bagore n’abashoramari bato:** Porogaramu nka “Women’s Guarantee Fund” na gahunda zo gufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo bato zifasha mu kongera amahirwe yo kubona imirimo. - **Iterambere ry’imirimo y’ubwenge n’ikoranabuhanga:** Gahunda zo guteza imbere STEM na ICT mu rubyiruko zigamije kongera amahirwe yo kubona akazi mu mwuga w’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga.
1. **Ubushomeri mu rubyiruko:** Nubwo habaye intambwe, urubyiruko ruracyahura n’akazi gashobora guha imibereho myiza. 2. **Ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina:** Abakobwa n’abagore mu bice bimwe by’icyaro baracyahura n’imbogamizi mu kubona imirimo y’inyungu zingana n’iz’abagabo. 3. **Ubumenyi buke ku masoko y’umurimo:** Abantu benshi ntibafite ubumenyi buhagije ku masoko y’akazi cyangwa amahirwe yo kwihangira imirimo.

Maria Dudycz ni umunyamwuga mu by’ubuzima wo muri Ositaraliya, akaba kandi umuvugizi w’abafite ubumuga.
Dudycz azwi cyane kubera uruhare rwe mu gutegura no guteza imbere itegeko rya “Victorian Disability Act 2006.”
Mu mwuga we wose, uburambe bwa Dudycz mu by’ubuvuzi bwamuhesheje imirimo myinshi yahawe na Guverinoma y’Igihugu. Muri yo harimo kuyobora Itsinda Ngirakamaro rishinzwe kugenzura isoko ry’amata y’abana bato muri Ositaraliya kuva 2001 kugeza 2005, ndetse no kuyobora Ikigo cya National Health and Medical Research Council gishinzwe kanseri y’amatako (Breast Cancer Centre) kuva 2001 kugeza 2003.
Dudycz yayoboye kandi Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubuvuzi mu by'amategeko rya Ositaraliya kuva mu 1998 kugeza 2003.
Mu mwaka wa 2018, Dudycz yashyizwe ku rutonde rw’icyubahiro rw’abagore ba Victoria (Victorian Honour Roll of Women).

Itegeko ry’Ahaparikirwa byihariye ku Bantu Bafite Ubumuga (Scotland) rya 2009 ni itegeko ryatowe n’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Scotland rigena inshingano z’inzego z’ibanze ku bijyanye n’ahaparikirwa h’abafite ubumuga, ryemejwe n’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ku wa 26 Gashyantare 2009 kandi rikemezwa n’Umwami ku wa 1 Mata 2009.

Komite Ngirakamaro z’Abafite Ubumuga zasabweho gushyirwaho mu Bwongereza n’Itegeko ry’Abafite Ubumuga mu Kazi rya 1944 (Disabled Persons (Employment) Act 1944). Iri tegeko ryari igerageza rya mbere ryagaragaje uburyo bwo guhangana n’ikibazo cyo kubona akazi ku bantu bafite ubumuga ku rwego rusange.
Komite imwe yashyirwaga kuri buri kigo gikuru gishinzwe guhuza abashaka akazi n’akazi, zigizwe n’abakozi n’abakoresha bafite umubare ungana, hamwe n’abanyamuryango bigenga n’umuyobozi wigenga. Zagize uruhare mu kugenzura Igitabo cy’Abafite Ubumuga (Disabled Persons Register) ndetse no mu gukoresha sisitemu y’imyanya yihariye (quota system). Zari mu nshingano z’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Umurimo.
Hanashinzwe kandi Inama Nkuru Ngirakamaro y’Igihugu ishinzwe Ibikorwa by’Abafite Ubumuga mu Kazi (National Advisory Council on the Employment of the Disabled).

Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bw’Abafite Ubumuga (Disability Rights Commission – DRC) yashyirwagaho n’ubuyobozi bwa British Labour mu mwaka wa 1999. Icyo gihe, DRC yari komisiyo ya gatatu ishinzwe uburinganire mu Bwongereza, iri kumwe na komisiyo ishinzwe uburinganire bw’amoko na komisiyo ishinzwe amahirwe angana. Umuyobozi wayo kuva 2000 kugeza 2007 yari Bert Massie.
DRC yashinzwe gusuzuma Itegekory’Iribagiza Abafite Ubumuga rya 1995 gutanga inama ku byerekeye impinduka zaryo. Yagize uburenganzira bwo gukora iperereza no gushyira mu bikorwa amategeko arebana n’ubumuga, kandi yari ishinzwe kugisha inama abakoresha ku buryo bwo kwakira no guha amahirwe angana abakozi bafite ubumuga mu kazi. DRC yasimbuye ikigo cyabanje kandi cyari gifite imbaraga nke, aricyo National Disability Council, cyashinzwe n’abashinzwe politike ya Conservatives mu myaka ya 1990.
Itegeko ry’Uburenganzira Bungana rya 2006 ryatumye mu kwezi kwa cumi 2007, DRC isimburwa n’ikigo gishya cyitwa komisiyo nshya y’uburinganire n’uburenganzira bwa muntu, gifite ububasha ku mategeko yose arebana n’uburinganire, harimo ivangura ry’amoko, igitsina, ubumuga, idini n’imyemerere, uburyo bw’imibonano mpuzabitsina n’imyaka.
DRC yari ikigo cya leta kitari mu nzego za minisiteri (NDPB) cyari gishyikirizwa Ishami ry’Umurimo n’Imisanzu. Ibiro byayo bikuru byari mu mujyi wa Manchester, kandi hari n’ibindi biro i London, Cardiff, na Edinburgh.

Iri rushanwa ry’imikino y’abafite ubumuga ryatangiye kubera guhera mu mwaka wa 2009. Mu mikino ya 2009 ryari igikorwa cy’igerageza, ari cyo guhiganwa ku metero 1,500 mu kinyagihagararo (wheelchair) ku bagabo, bityo uwatsindiye iri rushanwa ntiyabarwagaho mu ishusho y’imidari ya nyuma y’iyo mikino.

Uburenganzira ku miturire ni kimwe mu burenganzira bw’ibanze bwa muntu, bukubiye mu Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda, ndetse bukubahirizwa n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga nka Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) n’icy’African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights.
Buri muntu afite uburenganzira bwo kugira aho atuye, mu buryo butangiza ubuzima, hakurikijwe amahame y’umutekano, ubuzima bwiza, n’imibereho myiza.
Inzego zishinzwe Miturire.
1. Ministeri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu (MINALOC): igenzura gahunda za Vision 2020 Umurenge n’iterambere ry’imijyi.
2. Ministeri y’Ibikorwaremezo (MININFRA): ishinzwe igenzura ry’amacumbi, inyubako n’imihanda.
3. Ibigo bya Leta n’imiryango y’abikorera ku giti cyabo: bikora ibikorwa byo kubaka amacumbi y’ubucuruzi n’amacumbi y’abaturage bafite ubushobozi buke. 4. Imiryango mpuzamahanga: nka UN-Habitat, ikora imishinga ifasha mu guteza imbere amacumbi meza n’imijyi irambye.

Deaf Bibliography(ubumuga bwo Kutumva) ni ububiko bwo kuri interineti bushobora gushakishwamo, bukubiyemo urutonde rw’ibitabo n’inyandiko zerekeye inyigisho ku bumuga bwo kutumva, bwatangijwe na kuva mu mwaka wa 1995. Ububiko bushobora gushakishwamo hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo gushakisha bwihuse, ndetse n’uburyo bwo gushakisha hashingiwe ku byiciro. Ibiri muri ubu bubiko birimo ibitabo byanditswe ku giti cyabyo, ibice byanditse mu bitabo byahurijwemo inyandiko z’abantu benshi, inyandiko zo mu binyamakuru bya siyansi, ndetse n’impapuro z’amamaza. Bukubiyemo ibyerekeye umuco w’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva ku isi yose, harimo n’igihugu cya Ubuyapani. Indimi zirimo ni Icyongereza n’Ikiyapani.
Ibyiciro bikubiyemo ni iby’imibereho n’ibidukikije, ubugeni n’ubumuntu, hamwe n’ibice bike by'ubuvuzi ubumenyi bw’ibinyabuzima, n’ubusanzwe. Buri kintu kiri muri ubu bubiko gishyirwa mu cyiciro hakurikijwe akarere, igihugu, n'insanganyamatsiko, kandi inyandiko nshya zongerwaho n’amagambo y’ingenzi yihariye
