Ubumuga muri Biyelorusiya bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Biyelorusiya.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Biyelorusiya yemeje Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga. Mu mwaka wa 2017, Guverinoma ya Biyelorusiya yashyizeho kandi yemeza gahunda y'igihugu ikwiye kugeza mu mwaka 2025
Kugeza ubu muri Biyelorusiya hari abantu 570,000 bafite ubumuga, bangana na 6% by'abaturage.

Abantu miliyoni 2.7 muri Ukraine (6%) bavuzwe ko bafite ubumuga mu 2014. Uyu mubare ntiwarim 1.5% by’abafite ubumuga bw’igihe gito. Mu mwaka wa 2014, 35% by'abantu bafite hagati yimyaka 60-70 bafite ubumuga buterwa nimyaka. Ku bantu barengeje imyaka 80, uyu mubare wiyongereye kugera kuri 50%.
Ukraine izwiho "kutita ku bantu bafite ubumuga". Urugero, mu murwa mukuru Kyiv 4% gusa by’ibikorwa remezo ni byo bifatwa nk’ibyorohereza abantu bafite ubumuga.
Mu myaka ya 1990, igipimo cy’ubushomeri mu bantu bafite ubumuga cyiyongereye cyane muri Ukraine (no mu bindi bihugu by’Uburayi bw’iburasirazuba) bitewe n’ihungabana ry’ubukungu.
Mu mwaka wa 2021, isosiyete ikora gari ya moshi yo muri Ukraine Ukrzaliznytsia yatangije gari ya moshi za mbere zorohereza abantu bafite ubumuga, zifite ahabugenewe h’abantu bicara mu tugare tw’abafite ubumuga.
Ukraine ni kimwe mu bihugu byatsinze kenshi mu mikino ya Paralympique.

Ubumuga muri Uganda bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Uganda.
Mu mwaka wa 2002, 16% by'abaturage ba Uganda bari bafite ubumuga butandukanye.
Byemewe n'amategeko.
Itegeko Nshinga rya Uganda ribuza ivangura rikorerwa ababana n'ubumuga. Igihugu kandi cyemera ururimi rw’amarenga rwa Uganda nk’igice cy’Itegeko Nshinga.

Hashingiwe ku bushakashatsi bwakozwe na Sosiyete itabara imbabare Croix-Rouge ya Tonga na Komite Ngishwanama ku bafite ubumuga, muri Tonga hari abantu 2,782 bafite ubumuga butandukanye, bangana na 2.8% by'abaturage bose.
Mu mwaka wa 2007, Tonga yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ariko akaba ataremeza kugeza ubu.
Mu mwaka wa 1996, ubumuga muri Tonga bwari bugizwe na: ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (43.8%), ubumuga bwo mu bwenge (24,6%), ubumuga bw’umubiri (14.5%), ubumuga bwo kutumva (8.9%), ubumuga bwo kutabona (5.4%) n'abandi (2.8%).

Ubumuga mu birwa bya Salomo bivuga ababana n'ubumuga mu birwa bya Salomo.
Ku wa 17 Ugushyingo 2022, Guverinoma y’ibirwa bya Salomo yemeje ku mugaragaro Politiki y’Iterambere Rihuriweho n’Abafite Ubumuga mu gihugu. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku wa 2 Ukuboza 2022.
Kugeza ubu hari 14% by'abaturage bo mu birwa bya Salomo bafite ubumuga butandukanye.

Ubumuga muri Sudani y’Epfo bureba ku rwego n’ingaruka z’ubuzima ku bantu bafite ubumuga muri icyo gihugu. Nk’uko twabitangarijwe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga wita ku bafite ubumuga "Light of the World", abantu bagera ku 250,000 bafite ubumuga baba muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo.
Muri mwaka wa 2015, Sudani y'Amajyepfo yashyizeho itegeko rigamije gushyigikira uburenganzira n'abafite ubumuga.
"Umuryango Mukuru w’Imiryango y’Abantu bafite Ubumuga (NUDPO)" washinzwe muri Nzeri 2020 nk’umuryango w’ubumwe ugamije kurengera no guteza imbere uburenganzira n’inyungu z’abantu bafite ubumuga bo muri Sudani Yepfo. NUDPO igizwe n’imiryango umunani iyigize, harimo "umuyoboro w’abagore bafite ubumuga bo muri Sudani yepfo" n’ishyirahamwe "ry’igihugu ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Sudani yepfo".

Ubumuga muri Somaliya bivuga ibibazo bifitanye isano nabafite ubumuga muri Somaliya.
Ku wa 2 Ukwakira 2018, Somaliya yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga maze iyemeza ku wa 6 Kanama 2019. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku wa 5 Nzeri 2019.
Kugeza mu 2020, abaturage ba Somaliya bagera kuri 5% bafite ubumuga butandukanye. Ubwoko bw’ubumuga buboneka muri Somaliya burimo: ubumuga bw’umubiri (26%), kubona (15%), kumva (12%), mu mutwe (12%), kuvuga (6%), ubwenge (5%) nabandi (24%).

Kugeza mu mwaka wa 1996, muri Seychelles hari abantu 1,496 bafite ubumuga butandukanye.
Seychelles yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku wa 30 Werurwe 2007 ayemeza ku wa 2 Ukwakira 2009. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2009.
Mu mwaka wa 1981, habarurwaga abantu 2,908 bafite ubumuga nyuma y’uko igihugu gikora ubushakashatsi bwo kumenya umubare w’abantu bafite ubu bumuga. Mu mwaka wa 1991, umubare wari 732.
Ubumuga muri Seychelles bugabanyijemo ibyiciro byinshi, birimo: ubumuga bw’umubiri, ubumuga bwo mu mutwe cyangwa bwo mu bwenge, ndetse n’icyiciro cy’ubumuga bw’amarangamutima y’amarangamutima, harimo ubumuga bwo kumva, kuvuga no kubona.
Ishyirahamwe ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva (APHI) ryashinzwe mu 2005 mu guhugura abarimu bigisha abantu batumva no guteza imbere imyumvire y’abaturage y’ururimi rw’amarenga rwa Seychelles.

Dukurikije amakuru yakusanyijwe mu mwaka wa 2006, abantu bagera ku 2,100 babana n'ubumuga muri Samoa. Itegeko Nshinga ry’iki gihugu ntirivuga cyangwa ngo ririnde byihariye uburenganzira bw’abantu bafite ubumuga, kandi ntiribuza ivangura ribakorerwa. Samoa, nubwo kuri ubu itashyize umukono ku masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, yagaragaje ko yifuza ko yakwinjira mu gihe kiri imbere.
Mu rwego rwo gukemura ibibazo by’abantu bafite ubumuga, Guverinoma ya Samoa yashyizeho Itsinda rishinzwe ubumuga ku rwego rw’igihugu (National Disabilities Taskforce). Iki kigo gifite inshingano zo gukora no gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda zigamije gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga. Itsinda rikora rigendeye ku mabwiriza yashyizweho n’Itegeko Nshinga n’Igitekerezo cya Gahunda y’Igihugu ku Bafite Ubumuga byashyiriweho mu mwaka wa 2009. Byongeye, umuryango uyobora ibikorwa byo kurengera uburenganzira bw’abantu bafite ubumuga mu gihugu, Nuanua O Le Alofa, washinzwe mu mwaka wa 2001. Uyu muryango wari wateguye kandi Inama ya 5 y’Akarere ka Pasifika ku Bafite Ubumuga mu mwaka wa 2017.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga rwa siporo, Samoa yagiye ihagararirwa muri buri gihe cy'imikino Paralympike yo mu mpeshyi kuva mu mikino Paralempike yo muri 2000, nubwo iki gihugu kititabira imikino y'abamugaye.

Ubumuga muri Romania bureba ku buzima bw’abantu hafi 900,000—bingana n’umwe mu 20 mu baturage bose—bafite icyemezo cyemewe cy’ubumuga, aho hafi igice cya gatatu cyabo ari abagore cyangwa abakobwa, kandi abantu bagera ku 77,000 muri bo ari abana.
Mu rwego rwemewe, muri Kamena 2023 habarurwaga abantu 898,349 bafite ubumuga bwemejwe, aho 8.6% babo baba mu bigo byita ku bantu bafite ubumuga, abandi bose bakaba mu miryango yabo. Ibarurishamibare rya Eurostat (EU-SILC) ryerekana ko muri 2023, 38.2% by’Abanya-Romania bafite ubumuga bari mu kaga k’ubukene cyangwa gukurwa mu muryango, ugereranyije na 27.5% by’abatagira ubumuga, ikaba ari intera ya gatatu nini cyane mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’Uburayi. Kubura ibyo bakeneye mu mibereho n’imibereho myiza kwagize ingaruka ku 28.4% by’Abanya-Romania bafite ubumuga—bingana inshuro ebyiri kurenza umubare w’Uburasirazuba bw’Uburayi—mugihe gusa 17% byabo bafite hagati y’imyaka 20 na 64 bari bafite akazi kishyurwa, ari ko gahigura mu Muryango.
Amategeko na politiki ya leta.
Ingingo ya 50 y’Itegeko Nshinga rya Rumaniya itanga “uburinzi budasanzwe” ku bantu bafite ubumuga, nk’uko bigaragazwa n’Itegeko Rishamikiyeho No 448/2006 ryerekeye Kurengera no Guteza Imbere Uburenganzira bw’Abantu bafite Ubumuga, ryahinduwe inshuro nyinshi kuva Romania yinjiye mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’Uburayi kandi rikaba ritaraguzwa mu mategeko y’igihugu ajyanye n’ubumuga. Romania yashyize umukono ku Masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (CRPD) mu mwaka wa 2010 maze ishyiraho "ingamba z’igihugu zita ku burenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga 2022–2027", akaba ari yo cya mbere cyashyizeho amahame ya CRPD mu ntego zishobora kugerwaho.
Ubuvugizi bwa sosiyete sivile bushingiye ku nzego nk'Inama y'igihugu ishinzwe ubumuga no mu manza zifatika. Amahugurwa ya EIN 2023 yabereye i Bucharest yerekanye ko abantu badafite ubumuga mu by'amategeko, ibiro by’itora bitagerwaho ndetse n’ubundi buryo bwo gutora butandukanye, ibibazo guverinoma yatangiye kugerageza-gukemura muri Mata 2025 gusa binyuze mu buryo bwo gutora bwifashisha gukorakora no kumva amajwi ku baturage batabona.
Inyungu z’abafite ubumuga.
Abakuze bose bafite icyemezo cyemewe cy’ubumuga bahabwa inkunga y’ukwezi ku kwezi, igabanuka cyangwa yiyongera bitewe n’uburemere bw’ubumuga. Amakuru ya Guverinoma yashyikirijwe Ibarurishamibare ry’Umuryango w’Uburayi ku Mibereho agaragaza ko inkunga yo ku rwego rwo hejuru yazamutse iva kuri 350 RON mu 2021 ikagera kuri 368 RON mu 2023, mu gihe ingengo y’imari yunganira abana bafite ubumuga bukomeye yazamutse kuva kuri 175 RON ikagera kuri 316 RON muri icyo gihe; kandi amafaranga yo ku rwego rwo hagati nayo yazamutse mu buryo bungana.

Roodepoort, hafi ya Johannesburg muri Afurika yepfo. Ryashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1939 na Arthur Blaxall, umupasiteri wa Anglican wavukiye mu Bwongereza, wakoranye n’umugore we muri Afurika y’Epfo guhera mu mwaka wa 1923.
Mu barimu b'iki kigo harimo Es'kia Mphahlele, wahakoreraga mu mwaka wa 1940. Nyina wa Desmond Tutu, Aletha, yakoraga nk’umutekinisiye w’ibiryo muri icyo gihe; ni ho Tutu yahuye na Trevor Huddleston.

Igipimo cyo Kwigenga mu Mikorere y’Umubiri (FIM) ni igikoresho cyo gusuzuma kigamije kwerekana urwego rw’imikorere y’abarwayi mu gihe cyose cy’ubuvuzi bwo kongera ubushobozi nyuma yo kugira stroke, ibikomere ku bwonko, ibikomere ku mugongo cyangwa kanseri.Igipimo gikoreshwa ahantu hatandukanye harimo ibigo byita ku barwayi bakeneye ubuvuzi bwihariye n’amavuriro ahuza ubuvuzi bwihuse (acute), ubuvuzi bw’igihe gito (sub-acute) n’ubuvuzi bwo kongera ubushobozi (rehabilitation care). Gikorwa ku gihe cyo kwakira umurwayi no kuva mu bitaro by’ubuvuzi bwo kongera ubushobozi, kikaba igikoresho gihoraho cyo gukusanya amakuru agamije kugereranya ibyavuye mu kuvura abarwayi mu rwego rw’ubuzima rusange. FIM igamije kandi gufasha abaganga gukurikirana impinduka mu mikorere y’abarwayi kuva batangiye kwakira ubuvuzi kugeza bageze ku gusohoka no gukurikirwa nyuma yaho.Igipimo cyerekana urwego rw’ubumuga bushingiye ku manota umurwayi abona mu byiciro 18, byibanda ku mikorere y’umubiri (motor function) no ku bwenge (cognitive function). Buri cyiciro gisuzumwa hakoreshejwe urwego rwa 7 aho 1 = gukenera ubufasha bwuzuye (&lt;25% kwigenga) naho 7 = kwigenga 100%. Bityo, amanota ya FIM ashobora gusobanurwa nk’igaragaza urwego rw’ubwigenga cyangwa uburemere bw’ubufasha umuntu akeneye. Uru rugero rukoreshwa gusuzuma uburyo umuntu ashobora gukora ibikorwa by’ibanze bya buri munsi, bityo hagamenyekana uko azaba akeneye ubufasha bw’abandi. Ibindi bice bisuzumwa birimo imikorere y’umubiri, nko kureba neza uburyo abarwayi bimuka kandi bagenda, ndetse n’imikorere y’ubwenge, nko kureba uko bafatanya n’abandi, uko batumanaho, kandi bakamenya gutunganya amakuru. FIM yatekerejwe ku bantu bagize stroke, ariko ikoreshwa kandi mu gusuzuma ubumuga mu bindi bihe by’uburwayi.

Piepzna-Samarasinha yatangiye kwandika igitabo “Ahazaza ni Abafite Ubumuga” mu mwaka wa 2018.

George Gallego (yavutse c. 1966) numunyamerika paratriathlete na rwiyemezamirimo. Niwe washinze kandi akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa Wheels of Progress akaba ari nawe washinze umushinga wa Axis. Binyuze kuri Access Initiatives, yafunguye siporo ebyiri zigamije gufasha ababana n'ubumuga: umwe i Brooklyn undi i Manhattan. Mu 2021, yafunguye resitora Contento muri East Harlem. Resitora yashyizweho ku buryo abantu bakoresha karekezi bashobora kuyinjiramo no kuyikoresha neza, kandi ku mafunguro ari ku menyu harimo QR codes kugira ngo abagize ubumuga bwo kutabona babashe kumva ayo mafunguro basomwe n’icyuma cyabo.
Gallego yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse ya master mu buyobozi bw'inzego yakuye muri kaminuza ya Mercy. Yize kandi muri kaminuza ya Fordham na kaminuza ya Cornell kugira ngo arangize.
Gallego yamugaye kuva mu rukenyerero nko mu mwaka wa 1990 afite imyaka 23 nyuma yo kugwa mu idirishya rya etage ya gatatu ahazubakwa. Yahungabanye mu buryo bw’umutima, yungutse ibiro byinshi nyuma y’impanuka, maze atandukana n’umugore we. Amaherezo, Gallego yatangiye imyitozo. Yinjiye mu irushanwa rye rya mbere ry’amagare mu 2005 ndetse n’umujyi wa mbere wa New York City Triathlon mu mwaka wa 2007.
Gallego yahuye n'umugore we, Julia Kahn-Gallego, muri Triathlon yo mu mujyi wa New York 2007; bashakanye mu mwaka wa 2009. Gallego afite abana batatu.

Dan Habib numuyobozi wa firime wumunyamerika, producer, n'umukinnyi wa cinemateri ufite icyicaro i Concord, muri New Hampshire. "Filime ze zatsindiye ibihembo zirebana n’ibibazo by’ubumuga zirimo “Who Cares About Kelsey?”", "Harimo Samuel", "Ubuzima Bwenge," "Kwifata no Kwihererana: Umva inkuru zacu", hamwe na documentaire ngufi. Filime ze zatoranijwe na Emmy, zihindurwa mu ndimi 17, kandi zikoreshwa ku isi hose mu gushyigikira uburezi n’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga. Habib aheruka kwerekana documentaire ngufi, "My Disability Roadmap", afatanije numuhungu we Samuel Habib. Iyi filime yerekanwe bwa mbere ku isi muri Hot Docs Iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya documentaire ryo muri canada ku wa 1 Gicurasi 2022, kandi ryerekanwe mu rwego rwa New York Times Op-Docs. Iyi filime igizwe n’ibiganiro hagati ya Samuel n’abaharanira ubumuga bakomeye bo muri Amerika, ikanagaragaza zimwe mu mbogamizi Habibs bahuye nazo mu gutemberera aho hantu. Filime ivuga kandi ku nyungu za Samuel mu gukundana nkumuntu wamugaye.
Habib yatangiye umwuga we wo gutunganya amafoto ya "Concord Monitor," mbere yo kugira uruhare mu guharanira uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga. Mu mwaka wa 2014, yagizwe umwe mu bagize komite ya Perezida w’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe n’ubuyobozi bwa Obama. Habib yahawe ibihembo n’icyubahiro bitandukanye, birimo Igihembo “Ubucamanza ku Bantu Bose” cyatanzwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’abanyamerika ry’abafite ubumuga mu mwaka wa 2013, ndetse na Igihembo “Intwari mu Burenganzira bwa Muntu n’Uburenganzira bwa Civili” cyatanzwe na Ishyirahamwe ry’Uburezi ry’Igihugu (New Hampshire) mu mwaka wa 2012.

Umuryango mpuzamahanga urwanya igicuri ("ILAE") washinzwe mu mwaka wa 1909. Intego yaryo ni ukuzamura imibereho y’abafite igicuri binyuze mu bushakashatsi. Uyu munsi ILAE ifite ibice birenga 150 byigihugu, nabanyamuryango barenga 26,000, cyane cyane inzobere mubuzima. Mu mwaka wa 1997 ILAE yifatanije n’ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe igicuri (IBE), n’umuryango w’ubuzima ku isi (OMS) gutangiza ubukangurambaga ku isi ku kurwanya igicuri (GCAE).
ILAE yasohoye "2017 ILAE Itondekanya Igicuri", n'impapuro zayo zirambuye zo gukurikirana, n'abaganga benshi b'inzobere, bose basohotse muri Epilepsia. Ibi bisimbuza ibyiciro byambere bya syndromes ya epilepsy yakozwe na ILAE.
Bakoresha ibinyamakuru byubuvuzi Epilepsia, "Epilepsia Gufungura", na "Epileptic Disorders".

Ella Harper (5 Mutarama 1870 - 19 Ukuboza 1921), uzwi ku izina ry'Umukobwa w'Ingamiya, yavutse afite uburwayi budasanzwe bw'amagufwa butuma amavi ye yunama inyuma, bita "genvital genu rehabvatum". Uko yakundaga kugenda akoresheje amaguru n’amaboko byatumye ahabwa izina ry’akabyiniriro “Camel Girl”. Mu mwaka wa 1886, yagaragaye nk'inyenyeri muri WH Harris's Nickel Plate Circus, agaragara mu binyamakuru aho sirusi yasuye. Inyuma yikarita ye yikibuga yanditseho:
Harper yakiraga amadorari 200 ku cyumweru ku buryo yagaragarizaga abantu (bingana na $7,000 muri 2024). Amafaranga yakiriye binyuze muri uru ruhare ashobora kuba yamuhaye amahirwe mu buzima atari kuba yabonye ahandi.
Harper yashakanye n'umwarimu witwa Robert Savely mu mwaka wa 1905; yapfuye mu 1921 afite imyaka mirongo itanu n'umwe. Yashyinguwe mu irimbi rya Spring Hill i Nashville, muri Tennesse.

ASL-phabet, cyangwa inyuguti ya ASL, ni uburyo bwo kwandika bwakozwe na Samuel Supalla ku rurimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika (ASL). Ishingiye kuri sisitemu yitwa SignFont, Supalla yahinduye kandi yoroheje kugirango ikoreshwe mumashuri hamwe nabana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva neza.
Kimwe na SignFont na Stokoe inyandiko, ASL-phabet ni inyandiko ya fonemique, ariko yaroroshe mu gukoreshwa ndetse no kugeza ahoamakuru kubidasobanutse neza, ni ukuvuga, ikimenyetso kimwe gishobora kugereranya ibintu byinshi birenze fonemike (ishusho y'intoki, ahantu cyangwa kugenda). Kurugero, mugihe SignFont ifite inyuguti 25 zerekana ubwoko bwimikorere, naho inyandiko ya Stokoe ifite 24, ASL-phabet ifite 5. Gusa ibi bishobora kuvamo homografi (ibimenyetso birenze kimwe byanditse muburyo bumwe).
Byose hamwe, ASL-phabet ifite inyuguti 22 zo gushushanya, 5 ndanga hantu, na 5 zo kugenda. Byanditswe murutonde, ibumoso-iburyo, hamwe nibishoboka inyuguti nyinshi za buri bwoko, nkamabaruwa abiri yintoki kubimenyetso bibiri. Kimwe na Stokoe yanditse (ariko bitandukanye na SignFont), ASL-phabet ntabwo itanga ibimenyetso byerekana isura yo mumaso, umunwa, nibindi bice byimiterere yururimi rwamarenga, bishobora kugorana gukoresha inyandiko yagutse.
