Intara: Uburasirazuba bwo hagati.
Amasezerano y'Abarabu ku burenganzira bwa muntu (ACHR) (22 Gicurasi 2004)

Itangazo ryerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ni ry’Inteko y’umuryango w’abibumbye, ryakozwe ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1975. Ni icyemezo cya 3447 cyafashwe n’Inteko.
Nkicyemezo cyInteko, ntabwo igomba kubahiriza ibihugu bigize uyu muryango, ariko ikora urwego rushobora gushirwaho hagamijwe amategeko mpuzamahanga n’imbere mu gihugu.
Igizwe nintangiriro ndende, n'amatangazo cumi na atatu ateza imbere cyane uburenganzira bwabafite ubumuga
Itangazo ritangaza amatangazo cumi n'atatu atandukanye:
1.Igisobanuro cyijambo "umuntu wamugaye" nk "" umuntu uwo ari we wese udashobora kwishingira wenyine wenyine, byuzuye cyangwa igice, ibikenerwa mubuzima busanzwe bwumuntu cyangwa / cyangwa imibereho, biturutse kubura, haba mubyavutse cyangwa atari, mubushobozi bwe bwumubiri cyangwa ubwenge ".
2.Kwemeza ko ubwo burenganzira bukoreshwa ku bamugaye bose "nta na kimwe kidasanzwe kandi nta tandukanyirizo cyangwa ivangura rishingiye ku bwoko, ibara, igitsina, ururimi, idini, politiki cyangwa ibindi bitekerezo, inkomoko y'igihugu cyangwa imibereho, imiterere y'ubutunzi, ivuka cyangwa ikindi kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose kireba abamugaye ubwe cyangwa umuryango we".
3.Uburenganzira bwo kubaha.
4.Uburenganzira ku burenganzira mbonezamubano na politiki nkabandi bantu.
5.Uburenganzira ku ngamba zagenewe
6.Uburenganzira bwo kuvurwa, imitekerereze n'imikorere nkuko bikenewe.
7.Uburenganzira ku bukungu n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage, harimo n'uburenganzira ku.
8.Uburenganzira bwo gusuzuma ibikenewe mu byiciro byose byubukungu n’imibereho.
9.Uburenganzira bwo kubana nimiryango yabo cyangwa nababyeyi barera no kwitabira ibikorwa byose byimibereho, guhanga cyangwa kwidagadura.
10.Uburenganzira bwo gukingirwa gukoreshwa, ivangura, no guhohoterwa.
11.Uburenganzira bwo gufashwa n'amategeko.
12.Uburenganzira bwo kugisha inama amashyirahamwe yabamugaye kubibazo bireba.
13.Uburenganzira bwo kumenyeshwa byimazeyo uburenganzira bwatangajwe mu Itangazo.

Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ni amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu y’umuryango w’abibumbye agamije kurengera uburenganzira n’icyubahiro by’abafite ubumuga. Abagize aya masezerano basabwa guteza imbere, kurengera, no guharanira uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu n’abafite ubumuga no guharanira ko ababana n’ubumuga bafite uburinganire bwuzuye mu mategeko. Aya masezerano ni umusemburo ukomeye mu muryango uharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku isi hose ufasha guhindura abantu bafite ubumuga nk’ibikorwa by’urukundo, kwivuza no kurengera imibereho yabo babareba nk’abanyamuryango buzuye kandi bangana, bafite uburenganzira bwa muntu. Amasezerano niyo masezerano ya mbere y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bwa muntu yo mu kinyejana cya makumyabiri na rimwe.
Iyi nyandiko yemejwe n'Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye ku ya 13 Ukuboza 2006, ku ya 30 Werurwe 2007. Nyuma yo kwemezwa n’ishyaka rya 20, yatangiye gukurikizwa ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2008. Amasezerano akurikiranwa na komite ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga aho inama ngarukamwaka z’ibihugu by’ibihugu bigize CRPD zashyizeho umurongo ngenderwaho kuva mu mwaka wa 2008.Iteraniro rya cumi na gatatu ry’ibihugu by’ibihugu byari biteganijwe guhurira i New York muri Kamena 2020, hanyuma ryimurirwa mu buryo bw'agateganyo kugira ngo rihure mu Kuboza 2020 kubera ikibazo cya COVID-19.
Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, kimwe n’andi masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bwa muntu, (nk’amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu mu bya politiki na politiki ndetse n’amasezerano yerekeye guca burundu ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose rikorerwa abagore) yavuye mu bikorwa by’imyaka myinshi aho amahame y’uburenganzira bw’amatsinda yatangiraga kuva mu cyifuzo kugeza ku masezerano ahuza.
Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye yemeje Itangazo ryo mu 1971 ryerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe hakurikiraho Itangazo ryerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1975. 1981 ni umwaka mpuzamahanga w’abafite ubumuga ; ibisubizo byumwaka ni Gahunda yisi y'ibikorwa yerekeye abamugaye. Umwaka wakurikiwe n'imyaka icumi y'abafite ubumuga, 1983–1992. Mu 1987, inama y’impuguke ku isi yose yo gusuzuma iterambere ryasabye ko Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye igomba gutegura amasezerano mpuzamahanga yerekeye guca ivangura rishingiye ku bumuga. Umushinga w’ibishushanyo mbonera byasabwe n’Ubutaliyani ndetse na Suwede nyuma, ariko nta bwumvikane bwumvikanyweho. Abahagarariye guverinoma benshi bavuze ko inyandiko z’uburenganzira bwa muntu zihagije. Umunsi mpuzamahanga w’abafite ubumuga (3 Ukuboza) watangajwe mu 1992 icyemezo cy’Inteko rusange 47/3. Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye yemeje amategeko ngenderwaho adateganijwe ku bijyanye no kunganya amahirwe ku bafite ubumuga ku ya 20 Ukuboza 1993 (umwanzuro 48/96 umugereka). Abasesenguzi benshi bavuze ko inyandiko zabanjirije CRPD ari "yoroshye", bitandukanye n’inshingano z’amasezerano ya CRPD.
Muri Werurwe 2000, abayobozi b'imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta itandatu y’abafite ubumuga, hamwe n’imiryango igera ku 20 y’abafite ubumuga bo mu karere ndetse n’igihugu, bemeje "Itangazo rya Beijing ryerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga mu kinyagihumbi gishya", bahamagarira leta zose gushyigikira Amasezerano. Mu 2001, Inteko rusange, nyuma y’igitekerezo cyatanzwe na Mexico, yashyizeho komite idasanzwe y’amasezerano mpuzamahanga yerekeye kurengera no guteza imbere uburenganzira n’icyubahiro cy’abafite ubumuga kugira ngo asuzume ibyifuzo by’amasezerano yuzuye kandi yuzuye agamije guteza imbere no kurengera uburenganzira n’icyubahiro by’abafite ubumuga, bishingiye ku buryo bwuzuye. Imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, harimo n’abafite ubumuga mpuzamahanga, ihuriro ry’abakoresha n’abacitse ku icumu bo mu mutwe, ihuriro ry’abacitse ku icumu rya Landmine (ubu ni Corps Survivor Corps), hamwe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abafite ubumuga bagize uruhare mu gutegura. Ihuriro mpuzamahanga ry’abafite ubumuga ryabaye umuhuzabikorwa w’umuryango w’ubumuga mpuzamahanga w’abafite ubumuga, wagize uruhare rugaragara mu gutegura, cyane cyane ushakisha uruhare rw’abafite ubumuga n’imiryango yabo mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa no gukurikirana icyahindutse.
Mu 2001, mu nama ya 56 y’Inteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye, Mexico yatangije imishyikirano, ku nkunga ya GRULAC (itsinda ry’akarere ka Amerika y'Epfo). Igihe inkunga y’amasezerano yatangizwaga mu 2002 kubera abatavuga rumwe na WEOG, Nouvelle-Zélande yagize uruhare runini mu kugera ku ntera y’akarere. Yabaye umuhuza kuva mu 2002 kugeza 2003, Nouvelle-Zélande yaje gufata umwanya wa Perezida wa Komite ya Ad Hoc maze ayobora imishyikirano ku masezerano y’ubwumvikane muri Kanama 2006, akorana cyane n’abandi bagize Komite Yorodani, Kosta Rika, Repubulika ya Ceki, na Afurika yepfo, ndetse na Koreya na Mexico. Ababikurikiranira hafi benshi bagize icyo bavuga ku "myitwarire yo gushaka icyubahiro" ya guverinoma, ibigo by’uburenganzira bwa muntu, n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta.
Amasezerano yabaye kimwe mu bikoresho byihutirwa by’uburenganzira bwa muntu mu mateka, ku nkunga n’imiryango yose yo mu karere. Ibihugu 160 byashyize umukono ku Masezerano amaze gufungura mu 2007 kandi ibihugu 126 byemeje ayo masezerano mu myaka itanu yambere. Mu rwego rwo gushimira uruhare yagize mu gushyiraho ayo masezerano, ndetse n’ubuziranenge bw’ingamba z’igihugu z’ubumuga bw’igihugu cya Nouvelle-Zélande, Guverineri Mukuru wa Nouvelle-Zélande Anand Satyanand yahawe igihembo cy’abafite ubumuga ku isi mu 2008 mu izina ry’igihugu.
Mu mwaka wa 2015, ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka magufi, Komisiyo ishinzwe uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga yatangije iperereza ku gihugu cyashyizeho umukono kubera kutubahiriza inshingano z’amasezerano. Iperereza ryatewe n'ingingo ya 6 ya protocole itabishaka, iteganya ko iperereza rizakorwa iyo komite imaze kubona "amakuru yizewe agaragaza ihohoterwa rikabije kandi rihamye" ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu bw'abafite ubumuga. Hakozwe iperereza kuri guverinoma y'Ubwongereza, raporo ya nyuma isohoka mu
Amerika ntiyigeze iboneka mu bihugu by’ibihugu byemeje cyangwa byinjiye muri ayo masezerano. Ku butegetsi bwa Barack Obama, Amerika yabaye umukono ku masezerano yo ku Nyakanga 2009. Mu, amajwi muri Sena ya Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika yagabanutseho amajwi atandatu ku bwiganze bwa bibiri bya gatatu bisabwa kugira ngo agirwe inama kandi yemererwe kwemezwa. Muri Nyakanga 2014, Komite ishinzwe ububanyi n'amahanga ya Sena yongeye kwemeza icyemezo cyo kugisha inama no kubyemera, cyemezo nticyagejejwe ku majwi ya Sena yuzuye.
Amasezerano akurikiza imigenzo y’amategeko mbonezamubano, abanziriza ijambo, aho havuzwe ihame rivuga ko "uburenganzira bwa muntu ari rusange, butagabanywa, bwuzuzanya kandi bufitanye isano" bw’itangazo rya Vienne na gahunda y'ibikorwa. Ijambo ry'ibanze 25 rivuga mu buryo bweruye iterambere rirambye, avuga ko "ubumuga" ari "igitekerezo kigenda gihinduka" kirimo imikoranire hagati y’ubumuga n’ibidukikije, kandi ivuga akamaro k '"imyumvire y’uburinganire". Ijambo ry'ibanze rikurikirwa n'ingingo 50. Bitandukanye n’amasezerano menshi y’umuryango w’abibumbye, ntabwo agabanijwemo ibice
Ingingo ya 1 isobanura intego y’amasezerano:
guteza imbere, kurengera no guharanira uburenganzira n’uburenganzira bwa muntu n’ubwisanzure bw’ibanze n’abafite ubumuga bose, no guteza imbere kubahiriza icyubahiro kavukire;
Ingingo ya 2 itanga ibisobanuro byijambo ryibanze mu ngingo za CRPD: itumanaho, (harimo Braille, ururimi rw amarenga, ururimi rworoshye n’itumanaho ritavuzwe), ivangura rishingiye ku bumuga, icumbi ryuzuye hamwe n’ibishushanyo mbonera.
Ingingo ya 3 isobanura CRPD umunani "amahame rusange" yasobanuwe hepfo, naho ingingo ya 4 isobanura "inshingano rusange z’ababuranyi."
Ingingo ya 5–32 isobanura uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga n’inshingano z’ibihugu by’ibihugu bibareba. Benshi muri ubwo burenganzira bw'indorerwamo bwemejwe mu yandi masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye nk’amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu mu bya politiki na politiki, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco n’amasezerano arwanya iyicarubozo, ariko afite inshingano zihariye zemeza ko zishobora kugerwaho byimazeyo n’abafite ubumuga.
Uburenganzira bwihariye muri aya masezerano burimo uburenganzira bwo kugerwaho harimo n’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho, uburenganzira bwo kubaho mu bwigenge no gushyirwa mu baturage (ingingo ya 19), kugendagenda ku giti cye (ingingo ya 20), gutura no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe (ingingo ya 26), no kugira uruhare mu buzima bwa politiki n’abaturage, ndetse n’ubuzima bw’umuco, imyidagaduro na siporo (ingingo ya 29 na 30).
Byongeye kandi, abari mu Masezerano bagomba gukangurira abantu uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (ingingo ya 8), kandi bakareba niba umuhanda, inyubako, n’amakuru (ingingo ya 9).
Ingingo ya 33–39 zigenga raporo no gukurikirana ayo masezerano n’inzego z’uburenganzira bwa muntu (ingingo ya 33) na komite ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (ingingo ya 34 kugeza 39).
Ingingo ya 40-50 igenga kwemeza, gutangira gukurikizwa, isano n "imiryango ihuza uturere", kubika, guhindura, no kwamagana ayo masezerano. Ingingo ya 49 isaba ko Amasezerano aboneka mu buryo bworoshye, kandi ingingo ya 50 iteganya ko ayo masezerano "Icyarabu, Igishinwa, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikirusiya n’Icyesipanyoli" ari "ukuri kimwe".
N'ubwo Umuryango w’abibumbye wemera "ibihimbano byemewe" nta "burenganzira bushya", ingingo za CRPD zivuga ku burenganzira butandukanye bw’uburenganzira bwa muntu, mu gihe hiyongereyeho inshingano za Leta ivuga ko ibihugu bitanga inkunga ku burenganzira bw’ubwishingizi bishobora gukurikizwa. Abanditsi batandukanye babashyira mu byiciro bitandukanye; iyi nyandiko izasobanura ibyibanze nubukanishi, hanyuma isobanure ibyiciro bitatu hafi ya byose bihwanye nigitekerezo kivuguruzanya cyibisekuru bitatu byuburenganzira bwa muntu.
Hamwe no kwiyongera kwinshi, indorerezi zagize icyo zivuga ku guhuzagurika no gufashanya mu byiciro by’uburenganzira. Mu 1993, Ihuriro ry’isi y’uburenganzira bwa muntu ' Itangazo rya Vienne ryateganyaga mu ngingo ya 5 ko kubera ko uburenganzira bwa muntu "bwari rusange, butagabanywa kandi bwuzuzanya kandi bufitanye isano. ... Ibihugu bifite inshingano zo guteza imbere no kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu n’ubwisanzure bw’ibanze. " Gerard Quinn ku kuba CRPD "ifatanya n'uburenganzira bw'abaturage na politiki n'uburenganzira mu by'ubukungu, imibereho myiza n'umuco". Ibi bigaragara cyane cyane muri CRPD aho uburenganzira bwa politiki bwabaye impfabusa nta nkunga mbonezamubano nubukungu byuburenganzira bwubukungu n’imibereho ntacyo bivuze nta ruhare.
Ibyingenzi nubukanishi.
Bimwe mu ngingo za mbere za CRPD byagaragaje intego n'ishingiro; nyuma yo gutondekanya uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (mu ncamake mu bice bikurikira), Ingingo zayo zanyuma zerekana urwego inzego zigomba guteza imbere uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga.
Amahame ngenderwaho y’amasezerano.
Hariho amahame umunani ayobora ashingiye ku masezerano, yasobanuwe mu ngingo ya 3:
Ingingo ya 2 (Ibisobanuro) ntabwo ikubiyemo ibisobanuro byubumuga. Amasezerano yerekana uburyo bwimibereho yubumuga, ariko ntabwo atanga ibisobanuro byihariye.
Ijambo ry'ibanze ry'amasezerano (igice e) risobanura ko Amasezerano yemera:
ko ubumuga ari igitekerezo kigenda gihinduka kandi ko ubumuga buturuka ku mikoranire hagati y’abafite ubumuga n’inzitizi z’ibidukikije ndetse n’ibidukikije bibangamira uruhare rwabo muri sosiyete mu buryo bungana n’abandi.
Ingingo ya mbere (Intego) irongera itanga ko:
Ababana n'ubumuga barimo abafite ubumuga bw'igihe kirekire ku mubiri, mu mutwe, mu bwenge cyangwa mu byumviro bishobora gukorana n'inzitizi zitandukanye bishobora kubabuza uruhare rwabo muri sosiyete mu buryo bungana n'abandi.
Ihame ry "icumbi ryumvikana".
Amasezerano asobanura " icumbi ryumvikana " nk "" ibikenewe kandi bikwiye guhinduka no gukosorwa bidashyizeho umutwaro utagereranywa cyangwa udakwiriye, aho bikenewe mu rubanza runaka, kugira ngo ababana n’ubumuga bishimire cyangwa bakore ku buryo bungana n’abandi bafite uburenganzira bwa muntu n’ubwisanzure bw’ibanze "mu ngingo ya 2 kandi babisaba mu bice byose by’ubuzima harimo n’uburezi burimo abantu bose.
Ingingo ya 8 y’aya Masezerano ishimangira ubushake bw’amashyaka mu gukangurira abantu kubahiriza uburenganzira n’icyubahiro mu kurwanya ivangura ry’abafite ubumuga. Amashyaka yiyemeje gukangurira abantu ubumuga muri sosiyete, harimo no ku rwego rw’umuryango, kurwanya imyumvire, urwikekwe n’imikorere mibi yerekeye ababana n’ubumuga, harimo n’iyongera ku gitsina n’ivangura rishingiye ku myaka. Biyemeje ubukangurambaga bugamije gukangurira abaturage guteza imbere imyumvire myiza ku isoko ry'umurimo, itangazamakuru, n'ahandi.
Uburenganzira bw'abaturage na politiki.
CRPD ikubiyemo "ubwisanzure buturuka", bugaragaza ibitekerezo by’ubuntu n’ubumuntu bikubiye mu itangazo ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu na politiki, ndetse no mu nyandiko nyinshi z’uburenganzira bw’ibihugu byinshi nk’amategeko y’abanyamerika bafite ubumuga. Muri CRPD, ibihugu bikunze gufata inshingano zo gutanga uburenganzira mubikorwa.
Mu ngingo ya 9, Amasezerano ashimangira ko ababana n’ubumuga bagomba kubaho mu bwigenge kandi bakagira uruhare mu mibereho yose. Kugira ngo ibyo bishoboke, ibihugu by’ibihugu bigomba gufata ingamba zikwiye kugira ngo ababana n’ubumuga babone uburyo bwo kugera, ku bidukikije, ku bwikorezi, ku ikoranabuhanga n’itumanaho, ndetse n’ibindi bigo na serivisi bifunguye cyangwa bihabwa abaturage. Kugerwaho birashobora guhurizwa mumatsinda atatu yingenzi:
Kumenyekana imbere y'amategeko n'ubushobozi bwemewe n'amategeko.
Ingingo ya 12 y’aya Masezerano yemeza ko abantu bose bafite ubumuga bemewe n'amategeko ndetse n’ubushobozi bwemewe n'amategeko. Iteganya ko Amashyaka (Ibihugu n’Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi agomba kongera kwemeza ko ababana n’ubumuga bafite uburenganzira bwo kumenyekana ahantu hose nk’umuntu imbere y’amategeko; bemera ko ababana n’ubumuga bafite uburenganzira bw’amategeko ku buryo bungana n’abandi mu nzego zose z’ubuzima; gufata ingamba zikwiye kugira ngo abantu bafite ubumuga babone ubufasha bashobora gusaba mu gukoresha uburenganzira bwabo mu rwego rwo gukumira ihohoterwa ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bwa muntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bw’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu buteganywa n’uburenganzira bwa muntu;
Iyi ngingo yabaye ingenzi cyane cyane mumiryango iharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga irwanya imikorere ya leta yo kurera no kurera.
Ingingo ya 13 y’aya Masezerano yemeza ko ubutabera bwubahirizwa bw’abafite ubumuga, buvuga ko: Impande z’ibihugu zigomba guharanira ubutabera bw’abafite ubumuga ku buryo bungana n’abandi, harimo no gutanga amacumbi ndetse n’imyaka, kugira ngo byorohereze uruhare rwabo nk'abitabira, harimo n'abatangabuhamya, mu manza zose z’amategeko, harimo no mu iperereza ndetse no mu bindi byiciro bibanza.
Mu rwego rwo gufasha guharanira ubutabera bunoze ku bafite ubumuga, ibihugu by’amashyaka bigomba guteza imbere amahugurwa akwiye ku bakora mu butabera, barimo abapolisi n’abakozi ba gereza. Iyi ngingo hamwe n’ingingo ya 12 yavuzwe na "Igitabo cyerekeye imfungwa zifite ibibazo byihariye" n’ibiro by’umuryango w’abibumbye bishinzwe kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge n’ibyaha.
Uruhare mubuzima rusange (harimo n'uburenganzira bwo gutora).
Ingingo ya 29 isaba ko ibihugu byose byagiranye amasezerano birengera "uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bwo gutora bakoresheje amajwi rwihishwa mu matora na referendumu rusange". Dukurikije iyi ngingo, buri gihugu cyagiranye amasezerano kigomba gutanga ibikoresho byo gutora byafasha abatora bamugaye gutora mu bwigenge kandi rwihishwa. Demokarasi zimwe na zimwe, urugero, Amerika, Ubuyapani, Ubuholandi, Sloweniya, Alubaniya cyangwa Ubuhinde byemerera abatora bamugaye gukoresha imashini zitora za elegitoronike cyangwa imfashanyo za elegitoronike zifasha abatora bafite ubumuga kuzuza impapuro. Mu bandi, muri bo harimo Azerubayijani, Kosovo, Kanada, Gana, Ubwongereza, ndetse n'ibihugu byinshi byo muri Afurika no muri Aziya, abatora bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona barashobora gukoresha amajwi mu nyandikomvugo cyangwa mu mpapuro. Benshi muribi kandi na demokarasi zimwe na zimwe, Chili kurugero, bakoresha ameza ashobora guhinduka kugirango abatora kumuga wibimuga babegere. Demokarasi zimwe zemerera gusa undi muntu gutora abatora batabona cyangwa bamugaye. Gahunda nk'iyi, ntabwo yemeza ibanga ry'itora
Ingingo ya 29 isaba kandi ko ibihugu byagiranye amasezerano byemeza "uburyo bwo gutora, ibikoresho n’ibikoresho bikwiye, byoroshye kandi byoroshye kubyumva no gukoresha". Muri demokarasi zimwe, ni ukuvuga Suwede na Amerika, ahantu hose batora hashobora kuboneka byimazeyo abatora bamugaye.
Uburenganzira mu bukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco.
CRPD ifite "ubwisanzure" bwinshi, yemeza ko ibihugu bizatanga amazu, ibiribwa, akazi, ubuvuzi, ndetse n’ubufasha bwite, bivugwa mu Masezerano y’umuryango w’abibumbye y’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco. Izi ninshingano nziza leta izakora, irenze amasezerano yabanyamerika bafite ubumuga.
Ingingo ya 23 y’aya Masezerano ibuza guhagarika abamugaye ku gahato kandi ikanabemerera uburenganzira bwo kurera abana
Uburenganzira bwo kwiga.
Ingingo ya 24 y’amasezerano ivuga ko ababana n’ubumuga bagomba guhabwa uburenganzira bwo kwiga mu nzego zose, hatitawe ku myaka, nta vangura kandi hashingiwe ku mahirwe angana. Irerekana ko abana bafite ubumuga bagomba kubona neza amashuri abanza nayisumbuye ku buntu kandi ku gahato; abantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bafite amahirwe yo kwiga amashuri makuru rusange, amahugurwa yimyuga, amashuri akuze no kwiga ubuzima bwabo bwose ; n'ibindi.
Amashyaka agomba gufata ingamba zikwiye, nka: kwemeza imyigire ya Braille, iyindi nyandiko, uburyo bwo kongera ubundi buryo, uburyo nuburyo bwo gutumanaho no kwerekana icyerekezo, hamwe no korohereza urungano no gutanga inama; gushyigikira kwiga ururimi rw'amarenga no guteza imbere indimi z'umuryango w'abatumva; guharanira ko uburezi bwabantu, cyane cyane abana, impumyi na / cyangwa ibipfamatwi, butangwa mu ndimi zikwiye n’uburyo bwo gutumanaho ku muntu; no gukoresha abarimu, harimo abarimu bafite ubumuga, bafite ubumenyi mu rurimi rw'amarenga na / cyangwa mu nyandiko ya Braille, no guhugura inzobere mu burezi n'abakozi ku bijyanye n'ubukangurambaga ku bumuga, gukoresha uburyo bwiyongera n'ubundi buryo bw'itumanaho, n'ubuhanga bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gufasha ababana n'ubumuga.
Komisiyo ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga 'Igitekerezo rusange cya 4, cyemejwe muri Kanama 2016, yashimangiye akamaro ko kwigisha abantu bose kandi yamagana uburezi butandukanye. Iki gitekerezo cyarwanyijwe n’imiryango irimo Umuryango w’abatabona ku isi ndetse n’ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva ku isi ryananiwe kuvuga ko "bidasanzwe" kugira ngo bamenye akamaro k’uburenganzira bw’umuco n’indimi.
Uburenganzira ku buzima.
Ingingo ya 25 isobanura ko "ababana n'ubumuga bafite uburenganzira bwo kwishimira ubuzima bwiza bugerwaho kandi nta vangura rishingiye ku bumuga".
Gutuza no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe.
o ya 26 y’aya Masezerano yemeza ko "Ibihugu by’ibihugu bizafata ingamba zifatika kandi zikwiye, harimo n’urungano rw’urungano, kugira ngo ababana n’ubumuga bagere kandi bakomeze ubwigenge buhebuje, ubushobozi bw’umubiri, ubw'ibitekerezo, imibereho myiza n’imyuga, no kwinjiza no kugira uruhare mu mibereho yose y’ubuzima. Kugira ngo ibyo bigerweho, ibihugu by’ibihugu bizategura, gushimangira no kwagura serivisi zita ku buzima busanzwe, mu buzima ndetse no mu bikorwa by’ubuzima, uburezi, uburezi ndetse n’uburezi, cyane cyane mu nzego z’ubuzima, umurimo, uburezi, uburezi, uburezi ndetse n’uburezi; icyiciro, gishingiye ku isuzuma rinyuranye ryerekana ibyo umuntu akeneye n'imbaraga bye kandi ashyigikira uruhare no kwinjizwa mu baturage no mu bice byose bigize sosiyete, ku bushake, kandi birashoboka ku bafite ubumuga hafi yabo hashoboka aho batuye, harimo no mu cyaro. "
Amashyaka yiyemeje guteza imbere iterambere ry’amahugurwa abanza kandi akomeje ku banyamwuga n’abakozi bakora muri serivisi zita ku buzima no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe kimwe no kuboneka, ubumenyi no gukoresha n’ikoranabuhanga bifasha, bigenewe ababana n’ubumuga, kuko bijyanye no gutura no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe.
Ingingo ya 27 isaba ko ibihugu by’ibihugu byemera uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga gukora, hashingiwe ku bandi; ibi bikubiyemo uburenganzira bwamahirwe yo kwibeshaho kumurimo watoranijwe kubuntu cyangwa kwemerwa kumasoko yumurimo hamwe nakazi keza kafunguye, karimo kandi korohereza ababana nubumuga. Iyi ngingo itegeka ibihugu by’ibihugu kurinda no guteza imbere ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uburenganzira, harimo n’abafite ubumuga mu gihe cy’akazi, bafata ingamba zikwiye, harimo binyuze mu mategeko, kubuza ivangura rishingiye ku bumuga ku bijyanye n’ibibazo byose bijyanye n’imirimo yose, gukomeza akazi, iterambere ry’akazi ndetse n’akazi keza kandi keza; no kurengera uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, ku buryo bungana n’abandi, ku, harimo amahirwe angana no, akazi keza kandi keza, harimo no gukorerwa, no ;
yaka yemeye kwemeza ko ababana n’ubumuga bashoboye gukoresha uburenganzira bwabo bw’abakozi ku buryo bungana n’abandi; gushoboza ababana n'ubumuga kubona neza gahunda rusange yubuyobozi bwa tekiniki n’imyuga, serivisi zita ku myanya n’amahugurwa no gukomeza; guteza imbere amahirwe yo kubona akazi no guteza imbere umwuga ku bafite ubumuga ku isoko ry'umurimo, ndetse no gufasha mu gushaka, kubona, kubungabunga no gusubira ku kazi; no guteza imbere amahirwe yo, guteza imbere amakoperative no gutangiza umushinga wawe bwite, kubona uburambe ku kazi, gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe imyuga n’umwuga, kugumana akazi na gahunda yo gusubira ku kazi ku bafite ubumuga.
Ababuranyi biyemeje ko amacumbi yuzuye ahabwa ababana n’ubumuga ku kazi kandi ko ababana n’ubumuga badafunzwe mu bucakara cyangwa mu bucakara, kandi bakarindwa, ku buryo bungana n’abandi, ku.
Imibereho ihagije yo kurengera no kurengera imibereho.
Ingingo ya 28 isaba ko ibihugu by’ibihugu byemera uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku yabo ndetse n’imiryango yabo, harimo, ndetse no kurushaho kunoza imibereho, kandi igafata ingamba zikwiye zo kurinda no guteza imbere ubwo burenganzira nta vangura rishingiye ku bumuga.
Ibihugu bigize ibihugu byemera uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bwo no kubahiriza ubwo burenganzira nta vangura rishingiye ku bumuga, kandi bugafata ingamba zikwiye zo kubungabunga no guteza imbere ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uburenganzira, harimo n’ingamba; kuri gahunda zo kurengera imibereho na gahunda (cyane cyane ku bagore n’abakobwa bafite ubumuga n’abasaza bafite ubumuga);
By'umwihariko, amashyaka agomba kwemeza ko ababana n'ubumuga bagera kuri serivisi z’amazi meza, kandi bakareba serivisi zikwiye kandi zihendutse, n’ubundi mu bijyanye n’ubumuga; kugera ku bafite ubumuga n'imiryango yabo ibaye mu bihe by'ubukene kugira ngo bafashe Leta ifite amafaranga ajyanye n'ubumuga, harimo amahugurwa ahagije, ubufasha bw'amafaranga no kwita ku buruhukiro; kubona gahunda, inyungu zizabukuru nibindi byinshi.
Kubaho byigenga, ubufatanye mpuzamahanga no gushyira mu bikorwa igihugu, ubunyangamugayo, kurinda ibiza.
Ibice bimwe bya CRPD byerekana "igisekuru cya gatatu" uburenganzira bwa muntu, rimwe na rimwe bisobanurwa nkuburenganzira bushya, "ubwisanzure hamwe", uburenganzira bw’ubufatanye, cyangwa uburenganzira bwitsinda. Bagaragaza ko uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga buzakenera kuvangwa n’abafite ubumuga, ubufatanye mpuzamahanga, no gushyira mu bikorwa igihugu.
Ibihe byugarije ibihe byihutirwa.
Ingingo ya 11 y’aya Masezerano yemeza ko ibihugu by’ibihugu bizafata, hakurikijwe inshingano zabyo mu mategeko mpuzamahanga, harimo amategeko mpuzamahanga arengera ikiremwamuntu n’amategeko mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu, ingamba zose zikenewe mu rwego rwo kurinda umutekano n’umutekano w’abafite ubumuga mu bihe by’amakimbirane yitwaje intwaro, ibibazo byihutirwa by’ikiremwamuntu ndetse n’ibiza byibasiwe n’ibiza.
Ingingo ya 19 ya CRPD, " Kubaho mu bwigenge no gushyirwa mu baturage", ifitanye isano rya bugufi n'ingingo ya 3 (Amahame rusange) n'ingingo ya 4 (Inshingano rusange). Nkuko rimwe na rimwe byagaragajwe muri Komite ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga 'Gusoza Indorerezi kuri raporo z’ababuranyi buri gihe cyangwa mu gitekerezo rusange cyatanzwe na komite, ubumuga bitewe n’imiterere yarwo burimo kwuzuzanya, ariko ibihugu birashobora gushishikariza cyangwa guca intege ubwigenge bw’abafite ubumuga n’imiryango y’abafite ubumuga.
Ubufatanye mpuzamahanga no gushyira mu bikorwa igihugu.
Ingingo ya 32 ya CRPD ivuga ku bufatanye n’amahanga, naho ingingo ya 33 ivuga ku ngorabahizi zishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’igihugu kugira ngo byoroherezwe n’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga.
By'umwihariko, ingingo ya 32 iteganya ko "Ibihugu bigize ibihugu byemera akamaro k'ubufatanye mpuzamahanga ... kandi izakora ibikwiye kandi byiza ... ku bufatanye n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ndetse n’akarere bireba ndetse n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, cyane cyane imiryango y’abafite
Uburenganzira n’ubumuga byombi biterwa nubwitabire bwa rubanda, ubufatanye mpuzamahanga, no gushyira mubikorwa igihugu. Nkuko bigaragara mu ngingo ya 33 ya CRPD, amashyaka agomba kugira uruhare muri sosiyete sivile, kandi yashyizeho " ingingo yibanze ", akenshi mubikorwa inzego zigihugu zita ku burenganzira bwa muntu.
Amashyaka menshi yagiye yanga kandi asobanura ibisobanuro cyangwa itangazo ryerekeye gushyira mu bikorwa ayo masezerano. Izi ni zimwe mu ngero:
Australiya ntishobora kubona ko ihagaritse kuvura ku gahato abiyita abarwayi bo mu mutwe igihe ifatwa nk'uburyo bwa nyuma.
El Salvador yemera ayo masezerano ku buryo ihuje n'itegeko nshinga ryayo.
Ubufaransa ntibubona ko ayo masezerano yubahirizwa n'amategeko.
Ubuyapani buratangaza ko igika cya 4 cy’ingingo ya 23 y’amasezerano cyasobanuwe kudakurikizwa mu gihe umwana yatandukanijwe n’ababyeyi be biturutse ku koherezwa hakurikijwe amategeko y’abinjira.
Malta isobanura uburenganzira ku buzima mu ngingo ya 25 y’amasezerano ko bidasobanura uburenganzira ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo gukuramo inda. Ifite kandi uburenganzira bwo gukomeza gukurikiza amategeko yayo y’amatora yerekeye kugerwaho no gufashwa.
Ibirwa bya Maurice ntibifata ko bigomba kubahirizwa n'ingingo ya 11 yo gufata ingamba zose za ngombwa zo kurinda ababana n'ubumuga mu gihe cy'impanuka kamere, amakimbirane yitwaje intwaro cyangwa ibyihutirwa by’ubutabazi, keretse byemewe n'amategeko yo mu gihugu.
Ubuholandi busobanura uburenganzira bwo kubaho mu ngingo ya 10 mu rwego rw’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu. Irasobanura kandi ingingo ya 25 (f), ibuza kwanga ivangura ivangura, nko kwemerera umuntu kwanga kwivuza, harimo ibiryo cyangwa amazi.
Polonye isobanura ingingo ya 23 n'iya 25 ko zidafite uburenganzira bwo gukuramo inda.
Ubwongereza bufite ubushake bujyanye n'uburenganzira bwo kwiga, abinjira n'abasohoka, serivisi mu gisirikare ndetse no mu mategeko agenga ubwiteganyirize.
Mu yandi mashyaka yiyemeje kubyemera, kubyumva, cyangwa gutangaza ko byemejwe cyangwa kwinjira harimo Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi, Azerubayijani, Kanada, Kupuro, Misiri, Irani, Repubulika y’Abarabu ya Siriya, Venezuwela, n’abandi benshi. Guhera ku ya 16 Kanama 2020, amashyaka 22 yari yatanze inzitizi zemewe n’andi mashyaka yanga, ibyo yumva, cyangwa imenyekanisha.
Porotokole idahitamo.
Amasezerano atemewe ku masezerano y’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ni amasezerano y’amasezerano yemerera abayagiranye kumenya ubushobozi bwa Komite ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga gusuzuma ibibazo by’abantu ku giti cyabo. Inyandiko ishingiye cyane ku masezerano atemewe y’amasezerano yerekeye guca burundu ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose rikorerwa abagore
Porotokole idahwitse yatangiye gukurikizwa n’amasezerano yo ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2008. Guhera mu Kwakira 2023, ifite abasinya 94 n’amashyaka 105.

Komisiyo irashobora kandi gutegeka itumanaho ritemewe iyo ritazwi cyangwa ridafite ishingiro bihagije. Porotokole idahwitse yatangiye gukurikizwa n’amasezerano yo ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2008. Guhera mu Kwakira 2023, ifite abasinya 94 n’amashyaka 105.
Icyiciro cya mbere ni Komite ishinzwe kwemeza ikirego. CRPD isaba "umunaniro wimiti yo murugo" (Ingingo ya 2 ya Protokole itabishaka). Komisiyo irashobora kandi gutegeka itumanaho ritemewe iyo ritazwi cyangwa ridafite ishingiro bihagije. Usaba arashobora gutanga ibimenyetso bifatika bivura imiti yo murugo byakongerwa bidafite ishingiro cyangwa bidashoboka.
Ibiro by’Umuryango w’abibumbye bya Komiseri Mukuru w’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu bikomeza kwandika ibirego byose ku giti cye byatanzwe hakurikijwe amasezerano abishaka. Benshi mu itumanaho ryemejwe ko ryemewe byavuyemo ibitekerezo byatanzwe n'ababunganira n'abasesenguzi ba leta.
Umuryango w’abafite ubumuga, Umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abafite ubumuga, uvuga muri make kandi ugasobanura buri rubanza (imanza 37 guhera ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2020). Abantu baturutse muri Ositaraliya, Tanzaniya, Ubwongereza, Mexico, Lituwaniya, Ubudage, Espagne, Suwede, Otirishiya, Ubutaliyani, Burezili, Arijantine, Hongiriya, Ubugereki, na uquateur bazanye ibirego bya mbere. Itumanaho rimwe ryasuzumwe na komite ni "X na Tanzaniya." Harimo umuntu ufite albinism yaciwe ukuboko. Kunanirwa kwa leta, kweretse komite, kwananiwe gukora iperereza cyangwa gukurikirana.
Andi makuru y’itumanaho CRPD yerekeranye n’abaturage batuye muri Ositaraliya yari yarashyizweho n’inzego, Umunyalituwaniya kugira ubutabera nyuma y’impanuka yo mu muhanda, umunya Ositaraliya utumva kubona ubutabera, umunya Otirishiya kubona amakuru akenewe kugira ngo akoreshe ubwikorezi rusange, n’akazi mu Butaliyani, Burezili, n'ahandi.
Komisiyo ishinzwe uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga.
ni urwego rw’inzobere mu bijyanye n’uburenganzira bwa muntu zishinzwe gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano. Nimwe mu nzego icumi z’amasezerano zishyigikiwe n’ibiro i Geneve. Mu ikubitiro yari igizwe n’inzobere 12 zigenga z’uburenganzira bwa muntu, kimwe cya kabiri cyatowe manda y’imyaka ibiri naho ikindi gitorwa manda y’imyaka ine. Kunegura hamwe na caveats.
Amasezerano na komite byatewe inkunga n’ibihugu n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, ariko bamwe banenga. By'umwihariko muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, abasenateri bakomeye bo muri Repubulika n’imiryango iharanira inyungu nk’ishyirahamwe ry’amategeko arengera amategeko yo mu rugo bavuga ko CRPD yangiza ubusugire. Ibyo birego bivuguruzanya n'abunganira abize n'abashakashatsi.
Ku rundi ruhande, intiti nyinshi z’ubushakashatsi bw’abafite ubumuga zavuze ko CRPD idashoboka guteza imbere ubwoko bw’impinduka zikenewe mu guteza imbere uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga hagamijwe gukemura ubusumbane. Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza kandi ko abantu bose bagize umuryango w’abafite ubumuga bumva ko CRPD yabaye igikoresho cy’ingirakamaro mu buvugizi: abavugizi n’abarwanashyaka bo mu nzego z’ibanze mu Bwongereza ndetse no muri Hongiriya bavuze ko batabonye CRPD n’andi mategeko y’uburenganzira bwa muntu agira ingaruka mu buvugizi bwa buri munsi kandi ko badakunda gukoresha ayo mategeko, kuko badakunze gukora mu bikorwa. Amatora yo mu 2016 muri komite ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga yatumye hatorwa umunyamuryango umwe w’umugore n’abagabo 17, [mu matora yo mu 2018. Ibi byabaye nubwo CRPD yahamagaye mu ngingo ya 34 kugira ngo hasuzumwe "uburinganire bw’umugabo n'umugore" muri komite.
Ubufatanye bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ku burenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga.
Ubufatanye bw’umuryango w’abibumbye ku burenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (UNPRPD) ni ubufatanye bwashinzwe mu 2011, hagati y’imiryango myinshi y’umuryango w’abibumbye n’indi miryango. Ubufatanye bugamije kongera imbaraga mu bikorwa by’akazi n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo mu kwinjiza ubumuga bijyanye na CRPD.
Inzego z'umuryango w'abibumbye zitabira UNPRPD ni ILO, ITU, OHCHR, UNDESA, UNDP, UNESCO, UNFPA, na. Abandi banyamuryango ba UNPRPD barimo n’umuryango.
Manda zose zirangira ku ya 31 Ukuboza umwaka werekanye. "Amatora 2012 (Umuryango w'Abibumbye Uburenganzira bwa Muntu)". Umuryango w’abibumbye. 14 Nzeri 2012.

Abashyizeho umukono 20
Ubunyamabanga Bukuru bw’Umuryango w’ibihugu by’Amerika
Indimi Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Igiporutugali, n'Icyesipanyoli
Amasezerano mpuzamahanga hagati y’Abanyamerika yerekeye guca burundu ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose rikorerwa ababana n’ubumuga ni mu karere, cyemejwe mu 1999 mu. Irahamagarira ibihugu koroshya kwinjiza ababana n'ubumuga muri sosiyete binyuze mu mategeko, gahunda z’imibereho na gahunda z’uburezi. Yatangiye gukurikizwa ku ya 14 Nzeri 2001.
Kugeza mu 2013, ibihugu 19 ayo masezerano.
OAS, Abashyizeho umukono no Kwemeza

Ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina (nanone ryitwa ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina [a] cyangwa ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina) ni ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina mu bukungu n’imibereho rishingiye ku gitsina ku bantu kubera igitsina cyangwa igitsina. Nuburyo bukoreshwa mugukoresha imyitozo yumubiri cyangwa amategeko kugirango yimure abantu kumyanya iyobowe. Intiti y’abagore, Phyllis Chesler, umwarimu w’imyororokere n’ubushakashatsi bw’umugore, asobanura ko iki kibazo ari "imikorere yamagana abakobwa n’abagore kubaho mu buryo butandukanye kandi butegekwa kandi bigatuma abahungu n’abagabo babarinda burundu ubudakemwa bw’abavandimwe babo". Ingero zishingiye ku ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina ntiziganisha gusa ku mibereho n’ubukungu by’ubukungu ku bantu, ariko birashobora no kuviramo ingaruka mbi ku mubiri.
Ijambo "ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina" rikomoka kuri Afurika y'Epfo ivangura rishingiye ku moko ryashyizeho gahunda yo kuba hejuru y'abazungu (Afrikaans) no gutandukanya abaturage benshi biganjemo abirabura n'abazungu. Abanyafurika bavuga "gutandukana" cyangwa "gutandukana", gukoresha ijambo "ivanguramoko" mu kwerekana uburinganire byerekana ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu rikubiyemo gutandukana no gukandamizwa. Mu gusobanura ivanguramoko, Dr. Anthony Löwstedt yaranditse ati:
Igitekerezo cyo gutandukana ubwacyo ntigisobanura byanze bikunze ko itsinda iryo ariryo ryose cyangwa rizashyigikirwa kurenza ayandi yose... Ikiranga umwihariko wa apartheid ndetse nubundi bwoko bw’amacakubiri akandamiza ni uko politiki, ubukungu, imibereho, ndetse n’imiterere y’akarere byashyizweho ku bushake kandi kuri gahunda hagamijwe gutandukanya amatsinda ku gahato, buri gihe ku nyungu, byibuze, rimwe na rimwe, cyangwa inyungu, mu gihe gito, ariko ku nyungu z’igihe gito, ariko ku nyungu z’igihe gito, ariko ku nyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito, ariko ku nyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito, ariko zikaba ari inyungu z’igihe gito.
Ivanguramoko rishingiye ku gitsina ni ibintu rusange kandi ntibigarukira mu gihugu runaka. Mu gihe raporo z’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina zagaragaye cyane mu rwego rw’umuco wa kisilamu, ziriganje ku isi. Bamwe mu baharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu bavuze ko ibihano bifatirwa ibihugu bikoresha ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, kimwe n'ibihano byafatiwe Afurika y'Epfo muri apartheid.
Ingero zishingiye ku ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina zagaragaye mu nzego binyuze mu bikorwa by’amadini n’umuco. Kurugero, ingingo zijyanye no gufata abagore mubisobanuro byibanze byubuyisilamu, ubukirisitu, idini rya kiyahudi, n’ababuda byasobanuwe ko ari ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina. Gukoresha kwizera, akenshi binyuze mu gusobanura byimazeyo amategeko y’idini, kugira ngo ushimangire ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina ntivugwaho rumwe.
Ijambo ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina n’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina ryakoreshejwe kandi mu gusobanura uburyo butandukanye bwo gufata abagore mu bigo nka Kiliziya y’Ubwongereza na Kiliziya Gatolika ya Roma. Minisitiri wa Peresibiteriyeni akaba n'umwanditsi Patricia Budd Kepler yerekana urugamba rw’abagore mu rwego rwo kwemerera abapadiri ndetse n’ubuyobozi bw’amadini nk’urugero rw’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina. By'umwihariko, Kepler aranenga imyumvire gakondo y’ubugabo n’umugore igabanya ubutware bw’umugore mu itorero, ashimangira ko ahubwo kwinjira mu bagore bidahungabanya gahunda z’Imana. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, umwanditsi Susan D. Rose asobanura imiterere y'imiryango y'abakurambere b'amatorero ya gikirisitu y'ivugabutumwa muri Amerika nko gukomeza ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina.
Kiliziya Gatolika ya Roma yagaragaye ko ikomeje ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina bitewe na Vatikani yashyize ku rutonde rwa "kugerageza kwera umugore" nka "graviora ya delicta" - mu yandi magambo, icyaha cyo guhagararirwa kimwe no gusambanya abana bato, no "gushaka, gutunga cyangwa gukwirakwiza porunogarafiya [y’umwana] n’umunyamadini". [
Idini rya kisilamu ryanenzwe kubera ivangura ry’imiterere bwite n’amategeko ahana nk’abagore. Indangagaciro z'abakurambere ba Islamu zikomeje kuba imwe mu mahame yarwanijwe cyane, ukurikije amashuri atandukanye. Mubisanzwe ariko, uburenganzira bwumugabo numugore buratandukanye cyane ukurikije amategeko yimiterere ya kisilamu. Urugero, abagabo b’abayisilamu bemerewe kwishora mu gushaka abagore benshi no kurongora abadamu b’abayisilamu mu gihe abagore b’abayisilamu babujijwe kugira abagabo benshi no kurongora abagabo batari Abayisilamu, kandi umurage w’abagore ni kimwe cya kabiri cy’abo bavukana. ["kandi"] ukwemezwa n’ubucamanza mpanabyaha bwa kisilamu kurushaho kuvangura abagore, kuko bishingiye cyane ku buhamya bw’abatangabuhamya. Ubuhamya bw'umugore bwonyine bufatwa nk'ibidahagije kugira ngo ushinje umwicanyi, bisaba ubuhamya bw'umugabo kugira ngo bwemeze.
Kwubahiriza kwiyoroshya mu mibonano mpuzabitsina no kwambara neza ku bagabo n’abagore b’abayisilamu bigenwa n’ubuvanganzo bwa "ḥadīth" na "suna" (ibikorwa n’amagambo bitirirwa umuhanuzi wa kisilamu Muhammad na bagenzi be); imyitozo yo gutwikira ku gahato igaragara mu turere tumwe na tumwe nk'uburyo bwa apartheid. Imyitozo yo gutwikira ku gahato, nk'uko Shahrzad Mojab abivuga, ntabwo biterwa n’amategeko ayo ari yo yose ya kisilamu; ahubwo, Shahrzad avuga "imyitozo yazamutse mu bihe bitandukanye". Imyambarire yashyizweho muri Afuganisitani ku butegetsi bw’abatalibani n’ishuri risaba abakobwa kwambara igitambaro cyatanzwe nkurugero rwo kwitwikira ku gahato. Mu mateka y’imyaka itanu ya Emirate ya kisilamu ya Afuganisitani, ubutegetsi bw’abatalibani bwasobanuye amategeko ya "Shariya" hakurikijwe ishuri rya Hanafi ry’ubucamanza bwa kisilamu n’amategeko y’idini ya Mullah Omar. Abagore babujijwe gukora, abakobwa babujijwe kujya mu mashuri cyangwa muri kaminuza, basabwe kubahiriza "purdah" no kujyana hanze y’ingo zabo na bene wabo b'abagabo; abarenga kuri aya mabwiriza barahanwe. Abagabo babujijwe kogosha ubwanwa kandi basabwa kubareka bagakura kandi bakagumana igihe kirekire nk'uko Abatalibani babishaka, no kwambara ibitambaro hanze y’ingo zabo.
Uharanira uburenganzira bw'umugore, Mahnaz Afkhami yanditse ko imyumvire y'isi ya kisilamu "itandukanya imiterere y'abagore n'imibanire ye na sosiyete nk'ikizamini gikomeye cyerekana ko gahunda ya kisilamu ari ukuri." Ibi bigereranywa ninzego za "purdah" (gutandukanya umubiri kubitsina) na "awrah" (guhisha umubiri imyenda). Kimwe no mu bihugu byinshi ku isi, ibigo bikandamiza abagore byagendaga bidakomera kugeza mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20. ​​​​​Yavuze ko andi madini na yo "yiboneye intambara nk'izo."
Idini rya Kiyahudi rya Haredi, rizwi kandi ku idini rya Kiyahudi ryitwa ultra-orotodogisi, ryanenzwe gushyiraho politiki n'imyizerere ishingiye ku gitsina. Igizwe n’abantu bake ariko bakomeje kwiyongera mu muco w’Abayahudi, idini rya Kiyahudi rya Haredi ryamamaye nk’umuryango w’intiti, aho umubare munini w’abagabo bakomeza amashuri yabo muri yeshiva kurusha abagore bo mu iseminari. Abakurikira idini rya Kiyahudi rya Haredi na bo baratandukanye kubera imyambarire yabo ndetse n’imiterere rusange: ubwanwa bwogosha, amakoti maremare yijimye, n'ingofero nini cyane ku bagabo; n'abagore bitwikiriye mu buryo bworoheje. Ibirego bishingiye ku ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina byerekana umuco wo gukandamiza umuco no gutandukanya igitsina, ndetse no kwerekana abadayimoni nk'igishuko. Byongeye kandi, amashusho rusange y’abagore yandujwe mu baturage ba Haredi, kandi abakobwa b’Abayahudi bakiri bato batewe amacandwe kandi bitwa indaya kubera kwambara imyenda ifatwa nk'iyiyubashye. Raporo zerekana ko ahanini abayoboke b’ibanze ba Haredi aribo bashinzwe ibikorwa by’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, kandi ko umuryango wa Haredi muri rusange udashyigikiye ibyo bikorwa.
Ibikorwa by'Abayahudi b'ibanze Haredi muri Isiraheli byiswe ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina. Mugihe abagore basanzwe bicara inyuma ya bisi mu bice bya Isiraheli, nta tegeko ryemewe ribishyira mu bikorwa. Icyakora, ikintu kimwe cyabaye mu Kuboza 2011 aho umugabo wa Haredi yasabye umugore wicaye imbere ya bisi kugenda yerekeza inyuma; nyuma yo kwangwa kwe kwateje igiterane kinini. Gutabara kwa polisi amaherezo byatandukanije guhangana. Ku bijyanye n'iki gikorwa, Minisitiri w’intebe wa Isiraheli, Benjamin Netanyahu, yatangaje ko ashyigikiye ahantu rusange hahurira abantu bose n’ubumwe mu baturage. Hari kandi amakuru avuga ko Abayahudi ba Haredi baciriye amacandwe ku bagore, bagaba igitero ku bakozi ba televiziyo, kandi bakigaragambya bafite ibyapa byigisha abagore kwambara no kwirinda kugenda mu masinagogi.
Amashuri amwe y'Ababuda bo muri Tibet bisaba abagore gutunganya mumaseminari nubundi buryo bwo gusenga nyuma yabagabo. ["citation needed"] Baratandukanijwe kandi nabagabo mugihe cyibi bihe nibindi bihe byinshi; kurugero, guterana kumugaragaro no gusangira, cyane cyane iyo ibyo bibaye imbere yumumonaki mukuru. Hariho] "ibimenyetso" [byerekana abagabo n'abagore, harimo n'abagabo n'abagore - bahatirwa gufata ubwikorezi butandukanye mu bihe bimwe na bimwe by'Ababuda. ndetse no gusabwa kuguma mubyumba bya hoteri bitandukanye iyo babitabye.
Ibihugu byinshi ku isi byerekana ibikorwa by’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, nubwo bikunze kugaragara mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Ibikurikira n’ibihugu byavuzwe ko byakoresheje urugero runaka rw’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina.
Afuganisitani, iyobowe n’amadini y’abatalibani, yaranzwe n’amatsinda y’abagore n’abandi nka gahunda y’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina aho abagore batandukanijwe n’abagabo ku karubanda kandi ntibashobora kubona ubwisanzure mu by'amategeko cyangwa amahirwe angana yo kubona akazi cyangwa amashuri. Bahagurukiye ku butegetsi mu mpera za 1996, abatalibani bashimangiye amahanga kubera gufata abagore, ashyiraho politiki yabuzaga ubwisanzure bw’abagore bwo kugenda, akazi, n’uburenganzira bwo kwiga. Ku butegetsi bw’abatalibani, abagore bari mu kaga ko gufungwa no guhohoterwa ku mubiri baramutse bahamwe n’icyaha cyo kuba barenze ku myambarire yashyizweho, hamwe n’ihohoterwa ryarimo: kwerekana amaboko, ukuboko, ibirenge, cyangwa mu maso; kutambara burka; no kwambara ibintu bigaragara ko bibabaje, urugero amasogisi yera / inkweto, imyenda ya stilish, inkweto zitera urusaku mugihe ugenda.
Muri Kamena 2023, Umunyamabanga wihariye w’umuryango w’abibumbye ku bijyanye n’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Afuganisitani, Richard Bennett, yabwiye akanama k’uburenganzira bwa muntu i Geneve ku bijyanye n’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina muri Afuganisitani.
Mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 20 no mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 21 muri Irani, uburenganzira bw'umugore bwarahagaritswe cyane, ugereranije n'ubwa mu bihugu byinshi byateye imbere. Raporo y’Ihuriro ry’Ubukungu ku Isi mu mwaka wa 2017 Raporo y’Uburinganire ku Isi yashyize Irani 140, mu bihugu 144, kubera uburinganire. Muri 2017, muri Irani, igitsina gore cyari kigizwe na 19% gusa mu bakozi bahembwa, bikiyongera ku gipimo cya karindwi guhera mu 1990. Ugereranije n’utundi turere two muri, abagore bo muri Irani bafite uburyo bwiza bwo kubona konti y’imari, uburezi, na terefone zigendanwa.: 16 Irani yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 116, mu bihugu 153, mu bijyanye n'ivangura rikorerwa abagore.: 16
Mu mwaka wa 2006, Marina Mahathir, umukobwa w’uwahoze ari Minisitiri w’intebe wa Maleziya akaba n’umukangurambaga uharanira uburenganzira bw’umugore, yavuze ko imiterere y’abagore muri Maleziya isa n’iy'Abirabura bo muri Afurika y'Epfo birabura ivangura. Amagambo ya Marina yavuzwe asubiza itegeko rishya rya kisilamu ryemerera abagabo gutandukana cyangwa gufata abagore bagera kuri bane. Amategeko kandi yahaye abagabo uburenganzira ku mutungo w'abagore babo. Amatsinda y’aba conservateurs nk’ihuriro ry’abakozi b’abayisilamu bo muri Maleziya yanenze amagambo ye yo gutuka Shariya no gutesha agaciro uruhare rukomeye rw’abagore muri Maleziya ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu by’abayisilamu n’iburasirazuba bwa Aziya.
Umuryango wa Pakisitani wasobanuwe ko ukoresha ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina bitewe n’imiterere y’abagore mu nzego za politiki, ubukungu, n’imibereho. Urugero, ribuza abagore bo muri Pakisitani bafite abagabo b’abanyamahanga kubona ubwenegihugu bwa Pakisitani. Itandukaniro rishingiye ku gitsina mu bikorwa by’ubukungu, uburezi no gusoma, no kugereranya imibonano mpuzabitsina mu baturage na byo byavuzwe nkikimenyetso cy’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina muri Pakisitani.
Ubushakashatsi bumwe bwerekana ko uruhare rw’uburinganire muri sosiyete ya Pakisitani rwanduzwa binyuze mu bitabo by’amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, wirengagije gushyira abagore b’ingenzi mu mateka n’ubushakashatsi bw’imibereho. Ivangura rishingiye rero rishyirwaho binyuze mu nyandiko n'amashusho aho abagore bakoreshwa imirimo yo mu rugo kandi ntibakunze kugaragara ko bakorera hanze y'urugo. Byongeye kandi, kubijyanye na kamere n'imiterere, igitsina gabo nigitsina gore kirangwa nkibihabanye bitandukanye: mugihe abagore "ari ubusa, ibicucu nubucucu", abagabo "bafite ubwenge, intwari kandi bakomeye". Kubera iyo mpamvu, uruhare rw’uburinganire rwashimangiye kandi rukomeza ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina.
Imbaraga zo guhagarika ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina zakozwe binyuze muri politiki nk’umushinga w’itegeko abagore, washyizweho n’Inteko mu Kuboza Mbere, Amategeko ya Hudood yari impaka zishingiye ku miterere yabo no kuvuga ko bagandukira abagore mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko. Urugero, abahohotewe n’abakobwa bashobora guhamwa n’icyaha ko gufata ku ngufu ari ubusambanyi n’ubusambanyi niba bitagaragaye ukundi.
Imikorere ya ku bijyanye n’abagore yagiye ivugwa ko ari ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina. Abagore babujijwe gutwara kandi "" [] kugirango bagende. igenzura ishyirwa ry’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina mu mibereho y’abaturage ba Arabiya Sawudite; kuvanga bitemewe hagati yimibonano mpuzabitsina bihanwa bikomeye. Gahunda y’uburezi yo muri Arabiya Sawudite kandi ishyira mu bikorwa uruhare rw’uburinganire mu kwigisha ko kugandukira abagore kuvuka ku bagore. Vuba aha, hashyizweho uburyo bushya bw’ikoranabuhanga bugabisha abarinzi b’abagabo binyuze mu nyandiko igihe abategarugori babo bava mu gihugu. Muri rusange, abagore bo muri Arabiya Sawudite bafite uburenganzira bwemewe n’abana bato kandi ntibashobora gufata ibyemezo bikomeye, urugero nko mu burezi, mu kazi, no mu buvuzi, batabanje kubiherwa uruhushya na mwene wabo w’umugabo.
Gutesha agaciro abagore muri societe yo muri Arabiya Sawudite byateje igitutu kinini haba mu gihugu ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Iterambere rya vuba ryagaragaye bitewe n’impeshyi n’imyigaragambyo, nk’umwami yahaye mu. Byongeye kandi, Arabiya Sawudite nayo yakuyeho amategeko abuza gukoresha moto n’amagare n’abagore; abategarugori barashobora noneho gutwara igare ahantu runaka niba bambaye neza muri kandi biherekejwe numurinzi wumugabo.
Intiti n’abarwanashyaka bose banenze amategeko mpuzamahanga kubera ko adafite gahunda n’ibikorwa rusange mu kumenya ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe by’ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina no kugira ngo bikumirwe. Nk’uko aba banegura babivuga, ryakunze kuba intandaro yo kurengera ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, mu rwego rwo kurinda ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore guhinduka no guhirika ubutegetsi. Imvugo ikikije ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina nayo yafashwe nabi nkuburyo bwa ikomeza imyumvire ya Islamu. Igisubizo cy’umuryango w’abibumbye ku ihohoterwa ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu bw’abatalibani ryakorewe abagore muri Afuganisitani, cyaganiriweho cyane. Bamwe bavuga ko Loni "itananiwe gukumira gusa, nyuma ikaza no kuba umuntu urwanya politiki y’uburinganire bw’ubutegetsi bw’abatalibani, ariko ko mu by'ukuri yarimo ivangura rikorerwa abagore mu nkunga z’ubutabazi no mu gushaka abakozi baho."
Mu 1997, (FMF) yatangije ubukangurambaga bwo guhagarika ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina muri Afuganisitani, ahamagarira abantu ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu rikorerwa abagore bayobowe n’abatalibani. Yamaganwe kuba yarateje imbere "feminism feminism" no kuba afite imvugo ikoreshwa yamagana Islam ko ari mbi. Nyuma y’ubutegetsi bw’abatalibani baguye, ubukangurambaga bwaragutse kandi buhindurwamo izina kugira ngo babe ubukangurambaga ku bagore n’abakobwa bo muri Afuganisitani. Iyobowe na kandi igamije gukomeza gukangurira abantu ubusumbane muri Afuganisitani.
Ubukangurambaga bwa "No Women, No Play" bwatangijwe mu 2009 na gahunda ya Hadi Al Mutif ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu mu kigo gishinzwe ibibazo by’ikigobe hagamijwe gukemura ibibazo by’umugore muri Arabiya Sawudite. Ubukangurambaga bugamije kubuza Arabiya Sawudite mu kugeza igihe izemerera abagore ["muri"] Sawudite kwitabira siporo. Mu gitabo cyayo, (IOC) itangaza ko kwitabira ibikorwa bya siporo ari uburenganzira bwa muntu. Usibye ubukangurambaga bwa "No Women, No Play", indi miryango nka yerekeje rubanda muri Arabiya Sawudite kubera ko ""] [.
Ku bijyanye n'ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina muri Gatolika y'Abaroma by'umwihariko, (RCWP) bashinze kugira ngo basuzugure imyanya y'itorero ryabuzaga ishyirwaho ry'abagore. Kuva iryo tsinda rimaze kubona ikindi cyifuzo cyo gusohora inyandiko "".

Ebert test gipima niba ijwi rishingiye kuri mudasobwa rikoresha mudasobwa rishobora kuvuga urwenya rufite ubuhanga buhagije bwo gutuma abantu baseka. Byasabwe n’abanenga amafilime Roger Ebert mu nama ya TED ya 2011 mu rwego rwo guhangana n’abatunganya porogaramu kugira ijwi rya mudasobwa rikoresha amajwi mu, gutanga, igihe, n’intangiriro z’imvugo y’abantu. Ikizamini gisa nikizamini cya Turing cyatanzwe na Alan Turing mu 1950 nkuburyo bwo gupima ubushobozi bwa mudasobwa bwo kwerekana imyitwarire yubwenge itanga umusaruro udatandukanye numuntu.
Ebert yaje kwangirika mu rwego rw'amajwi mu mwaka wa 2006 nyuma yo kubagwa bavura kanseri ya tiroyide. Yakoresheje isosiyete yo muri ottcosse yitwa CereProc, ikora porogaramu idoda inyandiko-ku-mvugo ku bakiriya bafite ubumuga rwo kutavuga ahubwo bagatangira kuba bakoresha amajwi yabo igihe kirekire mbere yo kuyatakaza, kandi yacukuye kaseti hamwe n'ibisobanuro bya DVD birimo Ebert kugira ngo akore ijwi ryumvikana nk'ijwi rye bwite. Yabanje gukoresha kumugaragaro ijwi bamutunganyirije ku ya 2 Werurwe 2010, agaragara kuri "Show ya Oprah Winfrey".
Abari bateraniye aho TED ya Ebert yo mu mwaka wa 2011 bavuga ku bijyanye no gutanga urwenya n'amajwi akomatanya yaturitse aseka ubwo ijwi ryumvikanaga ryatangaga urwenya rukurikira: "Umusore yagiye mu muganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe. Umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe ati:" Urasaze. " Umusore ati: 'Ndashaka igitekerezo cya kabiri.' Umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe ati: 'Ni byiza, nawe uri mubi.' "

Ubiquitous robot ni ijambo rikoreshwa muburyo busa na comptabilite hose. Porogaramu ifite akamaro ko "guhuza tekinoroji ya robo hamwe nikoranabuhanga riva mu bice bya mudasobwa biboneka hose kandi bikwira hose, imiyoboro ya sensor, hamwe n’ubwenge bw’ibidukikije ".
Ukurikije uburyo telefone zikemura ibibazo byihuse, mudasobwa zishobora kwambarwa hamwe na mudasobwa ziboneka hose bituma bishoboka ko abantu bazaba mu isi iboneka hose aho ibikoresho byose bihurira. Kubaho umwanya uhari hose biva mubikorwa byiterambere rya mudasobwa na tekinoroji bizatanga imbaraga zo gutanga serivisi zifuzwa nigikoresho icyo aricyo cyose cya IT ahantu hose nigihe cyose binyuze mumikoreshereze yabakoresha hamwe na porogaramu zidafite intego. Ihinduka ryihutishije impinduramatwara ikwira hose, ikaba yarigaragaje cyane mu gice gishya cy’ubushakashatsi butandukanye, robotics ahantu hose. Itangiza igisekuru cya gatatu cya robo gikurikira igisekuru cya mbere cyimashini yinganda nigisekuru cya kabiri cyimashini.
Imashini ya Ubiquitous (Ubibot) ni robot ikubiyemo ibice bitatu birimo robot software ya software cyangwa avatar, robot igendanwa kwisi yose hamwe na sisitemu ya sensor yashyizwe mubidukikije. Imashini na software mu isi isanzwe ishobora kuyobora robot nyayo nkubwonko kandi igakorana nabantu kandi muburyo bworoshye. Abashakashatsi ba KAIST, Koreya basobanura ibi bice bitatu nka Sobot (Software ya robot), Mobot (robot mobile), na Embot (Embedded robot).

Lekotek ni gahunda mpuzamahanga yo gutanga inguzanyo ya Assistive Technology, ibikinisho n'ubuhanga k'abana bamugaye. Lekotek ya mbere yafunguwe mu 1963 i Stockholm, muri Suwede. Kuva aho, igitekerezo cyakwirakwiriye mu bindi bihugu bya Scandinaviya, Uburayi ndetse no ku isi yose. Kurugero, muri Amerika hari lekoteks zirenga 50. Lekotek ya mbere y'Abanyamerika yafunguye i Evanston, muri Illinois mu 1980. Lekoteks ya mbere yo muri Amerika yashinzwe na Sally DeVencentis na Sharon Draznin.
Izina ni uruvange rwijambo ryumuzi wo muri Suwede "lek," risobanura igikinisho cyangwa imikino, hamwe n’ikigereki "tek" gihuza isomero.
Igitekerezo gishingiye.
Igitekerezo cyibanze ni uko gutabara hakiri kare binyuze mu gukina ibikinisho n’ikoranabuhanga byahujwe bishobora kwigisha abana bamugaye guhangana n'isi "isanzwe". Bimwe mubyibanzweho mubitekerezo bya lekotek biva mubikorwa byakozwe numuhanga mubya psychologue wubwongereza, Elizabeth Newson. Igitabo cye "Ibikinisho n'imikino", () ivuga ku ngaruka zo gukina ku mikurire yumwana.
Itangizwa rya AblePlay.
Mu Gushyingo 2005, Ikigo cy’igihugu cya Lekotek cyatangije urubuga rwabo rushya rwa AblePlay kuri www.AblePlay.org rutanga uburyo bworoshye bwo kubona amanota yemewe ndetse n’isuzuma rirambuye ry’inzobere mu gihugu cya Lekotek ku mizigo myinshi y’ibikinisho n’ibindi bicuruzwa. Isuzuma ryihariye rya Lekotek ritanga amakuru y'ibicuruzwa yashyizwe mu byiciro by'abafite ubumuga kugirango arusheho koroshya uburambe bwo kugura ibikinisho. Ababyeyi nabahanga bashobora kungukira mu bitekerezo byimbitse by'imikino bijyanye na buri gikinisho cy'abana, ndetse no kumahuriro yo kumurongo kugirango babemere gusangira ubunararibonye no gutanga inama kugiti cyabo. Gutangiza AblePlay byari intambwe ikomeye mu gusobanura intego ya Lekotek yo kuba isoko nyamukuru y'amakuru n'imirimo yo gufasha ijyanye n'ibikinisho n'imikino y'abana bafite ubumuga. National Lekotek ni agace ka Anixter Centre itanga serivisi kubantu barenga 5.000 bakuze n'abana bafite ubumuga binyuze muri gahunda 70 ahantu 35 buri mwaka.

Logitech Harmony ni urukurikirane rw'ibikoresho byo kugenzura kure(remote controls) n'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga ryo mu rugo (home automation) byakozwe mbere na Logitech. Umurongo urimo ibicuruzwa byitaruye bigenewe kugenzura ibice bigize sisitemu yimikino yo murugo (harimo tereviziyo, udusanduku twashyizwe hejuru, DVD na Blu-ray, imashini yimikino ya videwo) hamwe nibindi bikoresho bishobora kugenzurwa hakoreshejwe infragre, hamwe nibicuruzwa bishya byo mu rugo bya hub bishobora gukoreshwa mugucunga byongeweho interineti ishigikiwe nibintu (IoT) nibicuruzwa byo murugo bigenzura ibikoresho. Logitech yahagaritse gukora Harmony Remote mu 2021 kandi ihagarika inkunga ya moderi ishaje muri
Harmony remote control yatangiye gukorwa mu mwaka wa 2001 n'ikigo cyo muri Canada cyitwa Easy Zapper, kandi yagurishijwe bwa mbere mu Ugushyingo 2001. Nyuma yaho, icyo kigo cyaje guhindura izina cyitwa Intrigue Technologies kandi cyari giherereye mu mujyi wa Mississauga, muri Ontario, Canada.
Uruganda rukora ibikoresho bya mudasobwa rwitwa Logitech rwaguze icyo kigo mu kwezi kwa Gicurasi 2004 ku mafaranga agera kuri $29 miliyoni z'amadolari ya Amerika, bituma Harmony remotes ziba izikunzwe kw'isi yose.
Muri Mata 2021, Logitech yatangaje icyemezo cyo guhagarika gukora kure ya Harmony. As of 2025 batangaje ko gushyigikira moderi zishaje zishingiye kuri software ya Harmony Remote bizarangira ku ya 28 Gicurasi, moderi ijyanye na porogaramu nshya ya MyHarmony iracyashyigikiwe.
Byose bya Harmony byashyizwe kumurongo ukoresheje software iboneza hanze. Kuri moderi zose ibi birashobora gukorwa ukoresheje mudasobwa ikoresha Microsoft Windows cyangwa MacOS bakeneye guhuzwa hakoreshejwe USB; moderi ya Elite na Ultimate irashobora kandi gushyirwaho bidasubirwaho ukoresheje porogaramu ya terefone ya Android cyangwa iOS.
Buri kure ifite infragre (IR) ubushobozi bwo kwiga (moderi zimwe na zimwe zirimo inkunga ya RF), kandi irashobora kohereza amakuru kubyerekeranye na kure kure yububiko bwibikoresho byo kumurongo. As of 2012 5000+ ibirango byibikoresho byari bishyigikiwe.
Harmony zose za kure zishyigikira ibikorwa-byo gukoraho-bishingiye kubikorwa, byemerera kugenzura ibikoresho byinshi icyarimwe. Kurugero, inzu yimikino yo murugo ishobora kuba irimo TV, sisitemu yo hejuru yububiko hamwe na sisitemu yamajwi yo murugo. Kanda kuri bouton yibikorwa ya 'Reba TV' kuri kure bizafungura TV, ufungure sisitemu yo hejuru ya sisitemu, ufungure sisitemu yijwi, uhindure iyinjizwa rya TV kuri sisitemu yashyizweho hejuru hanyuma uhindure ibyinjijwe muri sisitemu yijwi hejuru yisanduku yo hejuru. Mubyongeyeho, ingano yama buto yashushanyirizwa kuri sisitemu yijwi, utubuto twumuyoboro twashizwe kumurongo wa sisitemu ya top top box, hamwe nubundi bugenzuzi kubintu bikwiye bya sisitemu kubikorwa. Ikirangantego cyakwibuka ibikoresho byakoreshwaga kuri cyangwa kuzimya hamwe nibikoresho byinjiza byari byarahinduwe mbere, bikemerera kwimura ibikoresho kuva mubikorwa bikajya mubindi bitohereje amategeko arenze cyangwa atari yo.
Modeli ya kera ya Harmony ya kure yakoreshejwe software ya Harmony Remote, yemerera abakoresha kuvugurura iboneza rya kure, kwiga amategeko ya IR, no kuzamura porogaramu igenzura kure.

Xandria yari umwe mubakwirakwije ibikinisho byimibonano mpuzabitsina na videwo zikuze, ibitabo nibintu bishya muri Amerika. Yatangiye nk'urutonde rw'imfashanyo zishingiye ku mibonano mpuzabitsina ku bafite ubumuga mu gihe umuryango uharanira uburenganzira bw'ababana n'ubumuga wari utangiye. Xandria kandi yari imwe mu masosiyete ya mbere yagurishije ibintu bijyanye n'imibonano mpuzabitsina kuri interineti. Ubucuruzi ["mu"]bwafunze muri 2016 ubwo Lawrence Research Group, Inc. yakoraga ubwo bucuruzi, yasabaga iseswa n’umunyamabanga wa Leta wa Nevada.
Xandria yashinzwe mu 1974 na Gaye Raymond, umwarimu w’ubuvuzi bw’umubiri wa San Francisco, n’umugabo we, Roy Raymond washinze ibanga rya Victoria. Filozofiya ya yavugaga ko ababana n'ubumuga bagomba kwishimira ubuzima bushoboka bwose, harimo n’ubuzima bwimibonano mpuzabitsina. Xandria yatangiye ari kataloge ikwirakwiza infashanyo yimibonano mpuzabitsina kubantu bafite ubumuga bwumubiri niterambere.
Icyegeranyo cyumwimerere cya Xandria cyatanze cyane cyane amashusho n'ibitabo byabantu bakuru, hamwe na viboters n'ibikinisho byimibonano mpuzabitsina byari byoroshye kubyumva no kuyobora abantu bafite ubumuga bwumubiri kubera gucibwa cyangwa kurwara.
Ingwate y’isosiyete y’ibanga, ubwiza bw’ibicuruzwa no kunyurwa ku giti cye byamufashije guteza imbere ibi bikurikira mu baturage muri rusange, cyane cyane mu batifuzaga ko binjira mu iduka ry’urukozasoni.
Ibicuruzwa bya Xandria byoherejwe mumapaki by'ubwenge bitanditse izina ryisosiyete. Abakiriya barashobora gusaba gusubizwa muminsi 60 mugihe batanyuzwe nibikinisho byabo byimibonano mpuzabitsina kubwimpamvu.
Gaye na Roy Raymond bagurishije icyegeranyo cya Xandria mu 1984 kandi ibarura ry’isosiyete ryaraguwe kugira ngo rishimishe rubanda. Usibye urutonde rw’abantu bafite ubumuga, iyi sosiyete yatangiye kugurisha agakingirizo, erotika, dildos, amavuta yo kwisiga, impeta y’inkoko, amakamba atatu, pompe yimboro, lingerie, imfashanyo zo kwikinisha, n’ibindi bicuruzwa bijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina. Muri mwaka wa 1999, cyatangiye kandi gukwirakwiza amashusho yimibonano mpuzabitsina yakwirakwizwaga n'ikindi kigo cyafatanyaga na cyo cyitwa Sister company 1st Skin.
Ba nyir'isosiyete bashya banashyizeho akanama ngishwanama k'ubuzima n'inzobere mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Abanyamuryango barimo abigisha imibonano mpuzabitsina, abaharanira inyungu n'umwanditsi Betty Dodson ; umunyamakuru n'umwanditsi Michael Castleman, wanditse Umujyanama w'ikinyamakuru Playboy kuva 1991 kugeza 1995; n'umuhanga mu by'imitekerereze ya muntu witwa Louanne Cole, ubu akaba ari impuguke ituye kuri WebMD "Ibyerekeye Igitsina."
Xandria yabanje kuba ifite icyicaro i San Francisco. Yimukiye i Brisbane, muri Californiya mu 1993 no mu mwanya wanyuma mu kibaya cya Las Vegas mu 2005.
Mu 1997, isosiyete yatangije Xandria.com, imwe mu mangazini ya mbere yo kuri interineti yagenewe kugurisha ibikinisho by’ibitsina na videwo zikuze. Urubuga hamwe nisosiyete ubwayo byatanze itangazamakuru ryiza mubitabo bizwi cyane nka Playboy, [[Hustler, na Fitness y'abagabo.
Mu cyiciro cyayo cya nyuma, abakiriya bashoboraga gutumiza ibintu binyuze mu iposita no guhamagara nimero itishyurwa, ariko ibyinshi mu byagurishijwe n’isosiyete byakozwe binyuze ku rubuga rwayo. Xandria ntabbwo yari afite iduka risanzwe. Xandria.com yatwaye urutonde rurerure rwibintu bijyanye nigitsina, hamwe ningingo zerekeye ubuzima bwimibonano mpuzabitsina zanditswe nabanditsi bazwi.
Ibikinisho byinshi byimibonano mpuzabitsina byo mu cyegeranyo cya Xandria byagaragaye muri filime "Stash" yo mu 2007, comedi yo mu Buhinde yakinnye na Tim Kazurinsky na Marilyn Chambers. Iyi filime ivuga kuri "Discreet Removals," isosiyete izakuraho abantu berekana amashusho yerekana porunogarafiya n’ibikinisho by’imibonano mpuzabitsina nyuma y’urupfu rwabo, kugira ngo abashakanye ndetse n’umuryango batabishaka bashobora "kwibanda ku gahinda". Stash yatsindiye igihembo cya Gold Remi 2007 cyo kuba indashyikirwa mu cyiciro cy’abakuze berekana inkuru " mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime rya WorldFest Houston.

UserWay ni sosiyete igera kuri digitale ifite icyicaro i Wilmington, Delaware. Isosiyete ikoresha AI na automatisation mu rwego rwo gukemura ibibazo by’amategeko ku masosiyete kugira ngo imbuga zabo zigerweho.
UserWay yashinzwe mu 2016 na Allon Mason. Mu 2021, Susan Bennett, umuntu watanze ijwi rya Siri, umufasha w'ikoranabuhanga wa Apple, yabaye umuvugizi w'iyi sosiyete kandi akaba umurwanashyaka 'uburenganzira bw'abantu bafite ubumuga mu gikorwa cyo kwamamaza cya UserWay, cyanagaragayemo Dr. Orna Guralnik. Mu Kuboza 2021, isosiyete yatanze umushinga wa mbere w'inyandiko y'amasoko (prospectus) ya IPO ku Isoko ry’imigabane rya Tel Aviv.
Muri Mutarama 2022, isosiyete yasohoye IPO yayo ku isoko ry'imigabane rya Tel Aviv ku gaciro ka miliyoni 120 NIS. Yakomeje gukusanya hafi miliyoni 30 NIS kubakiriya b'ibigo. UserWay yatangiye gucuruza ku isoko ryimigabane rya Tel Aviv ku izina rya UWAY.
Widget ya UserWay iraboneka kumurongo wingenzi wa CMS kimwe nimbuga za HTML / CSS / JS. Ikoranabuhanga rya UserWay ryujuje amategeko yubahiriza ashingiye kuri WCAG 2.1 AA kandi nkuko bisabwa na ADA.
Mu Kuboza 2023, UserWay yatangaje ko izagurwa n’ikigo cy’Abanyamerika Level Access ku giciro cya miliyoni 98.7 z’amadolari($) yo guhuza amafaranga n’impaka zikomeje kuvugwa. Ubucuruzi bwarangiye muri Werurwe 2024, guhindura isosiyete akaba iy'abigenga bonyine.
Mu 2024, ikirego cy’icyiciro cy’ikirego cyaregewe UserWay, kivuga ko ibirego byinshi byakabije, ko widgets zayo zitubahiriza kubahiriza amategeko, ndetse rimwe na rimwe bigatuma imbuga za interineti zigora gukoresha ababana n'ubumuga.. Ikinyamakuru Financial Times cyatangaje ko imbuga za interineti zikoresha UserWay hamwe n’andi masosiyete ya widget agera kuri interineti akiri kure yo kubahiriza amabwiriza yo kugerwaho, amwe muri yo akaba afite amakosa y’ibanze mu bijyanye no kugeza ku bikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga.

Radiyo 1RPH 1125 kHz Canberra (89.5FM Wagga Wagga, 99.5FM Junee) ni radiyo itanga amakuru kuri radiyo AM band kuri radiyo yo mu murwa mukuru wa Ositaraliya ikorera ACT yose hamwe n’ibice bikikije NSW birimo Queanbeyan, Yass na Michelago, hamwe nabakunda kugaragara cyane FM kuri Wagga na Junee, hamwe n’itangazamakuru ryandika kuri interineti.
Radio 1RPH ni umunyamuryango wa Radio Icapiro ry'abafite ubumuga. Amagambo yacyo ni, amakuru yawe hamwe no Guhindura icapiro mumajwi, kandi igamije gukorera abantu bose, kubwimpamvu iyo ari yo yose, bafite ubumuga bwo gusoma ibikoresho byacapwe bizwi nkibinyamakuru bigendanwa muntoki.
Ibinyamakuru, ibitabo, nibindi bikoresho byacapwe bizwi kwizina rya news letter bisomwa kumurongo. 1RPH yahoze ifite frequency hanze ya AM band kuri 1620 kHz, nuko agira ikibazo cyo kwivanga gake, kandi yumvikanye kure nka Amerika.
Muri Gashyantare 2016, ubuyobozi bwa sitasiyo bwatangaje ko bwagiriwe inama ko amadolari 38.000 atazaboneka muri ACT ya Leta ya ACT y’ubumuga guhera muri Nyakanga 2016, ubwo aya mafaranga azaba mu rwego rw’amafaranga rusange y’ubwishingizi bw’abafite ubumuga (NDIS) ayobowe na guverinoma ya Commonwealth. Aya mafaranga yagereranyaga hafi kimwe cya kane cyingengo yimikorere ya sitasiyo. Minisitiri w’abafite ubumuga Chris Bourke yanze gusezeranya inkunga y’umutungo wa ACT, ariko avuga ko azakora iperereza kuri Minisitiri y'abafite ubumuga butandukanye. nko Kuyobora bashizemo imbaraga zo kumenyekanisha ibura ry'inkunga ni: Perezida, Lorraine Litster; Visi Perezida, n'abafite ubumuga Perezida wa ACT, Robert Altamore; n’abakorerabushake batanga amakuru hamwe n’inteko ishinga amategeko umutwe wa ACT, Umudepite wa Vicki Dunne. Litster yerekanye ko, muri gahunda ya miliyari 22 z'amadolari ya Amerika / umwaka, miliyoni 132 z'amadolari yonyine niyo yagenewe serivisi zirimo umuyoboro wa radiyo wandika ubumuga. Ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ubwishingizi bw'abafite ubumuga (NDIA) cyatangaje ko kizasuzuma iki kibazo.

bInziga zimenyereza, zizwi nka stabilisateur hanze ya Amerika y'amajyaruguru ni amapine abiri yongerwa ku gice cy'inyuma cy'igare kugirango rigire amapine ane, bifasha abigira gutwara igare ubwabo. Kuva ku mpera z'imyaka ya 1990, amagare yitwa balance bikes yatangiye gusimbura ayo y'uruziga, kuko afasha cyane kwiga kubungabunga umutuzo no gutwara igare neza.
Isosiyete y'Abanyamerika Huffy yazanye ibiziga by'amahugurwa mu 1949 hamwe ni gare ryayo 'Convertible'. Igishushanyo gisanzwe cy'amahugurwa yibiziga ntabwo cyahindutse kuva iki Zigizwe n'inziga ebyiri nto, imwe kuruhande rwuruziga rwinyuma rwamagare. Bifatanije kuruhande rwicyuma cyangwa ikadiri irambuye hanze yikigare, nibyiza kugumisha ibiziga byamahugurwa hejuru yubutaka. Utwugarizo tugenewe guhindurwa kugirango habeho uburebure butandukanye n’impande z’ibiziga byamahugurwa, bituma habaho kwihitiramo ukurikije ibyo uyigenderaho akeneye, ariko ibi biragoye kubigeraho mubikorwa.
Igitekerezo cyo guhugura ibiziga gishobora kwerekanwa mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo mu Cyongereza ku nkunga iyo ari yo yose ya mashini, cyane cyane mu iterambere rya software.
Imikorere y'iziga ry'imyitozo ishingiye kumyumvire yuko umutwara wiga ashobora gutezimbere buhoro buhoro uburinganire bwabo hamwe nubuhanga bwo guhuza imbaraga ashingiye kumfashanyo yibiziga byinyongera. Mugihe uyigenderaho agira ikizere nubuhanga, the training wheels izamurwa buhoro buhoro cyangwa bikurwaho, mubyukuri byemerera uwagenderaho kwimuka kugendera nta nkunga y'inyongera.
Abashakashatsi berekanye ko ibiziga by'amahugurwa (training wheels) bidindiza iterambere ryukuri hamwe nubuhanga bwo kuyobora. Kwishingikiriza kumuziga wamahugurwa birinda abayitwara kubona byimazeyo imbaraga zo gutwara igare kandi biganisha kubibazo byo kwimuka kugendana batabifite. ​
Inziga zamahugurwa(training wheels) cyane cyane ziba inzitizi yo kwiga niba zahinduwe nabi, kuko zibuza igare kunanuka niba ziri hasi cyane, kandi bikabuza gufata feri niba uburemere bwinshi bwakuwe kumuziga winyuma ukoresheje ibiziga byimyitozo biri hasi cyane. Guhindura ibiziga byamahugurwa neza, no kubizamura hejuru uko ubuhanga bwumwana bwiyongera, bifasha kugabanya ariko ntibikuraho burundu ibyo bibazo.

Rod Michalko ni umushakashatsi w’Umunyakanada mu rwego rw’ubumenyi bw’abafite ubumuga.
Michalko yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga ya Filozofiya muri sociologiya yakuye muri kaminuza ya British Columbia. Mu mwaka wa 2007, yakoraga muri New College, Toronto, aho yateguye amasomo y’inyigisho z’ubumuga. Nyuma yaho, yagiye mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru muri kaminuza ya Toronto.
Michalko yatangiye gutakaza bushobozi bwo kubona akiri umwana none ni impumyi. Kuva Smokie apfa, Michalko yatangiye gukoresha inkoni yera.
