Mucukumbuzi y'urubuga, cyangwa se key access cyangwa enterineti yemerera umukoresha wa mudasobwa guhita asimbuka cyangwa akajya kukingi gika cyo kurupapuro runaka akoresheje clavier.
Kwinjira muri mushakisha zitandukanye.
Abantu benshi bakunda gukora ubushakashatsi kuri mudasobwa bamenya urufunguzo rwo kwinjira gusa iyo bakanze hamwe nurufunguzo rumwe cyangwa byinshi bihindura nka.
Kugaragaza urufunguzo rwo kwinjira.
Kugirango winjire mu bushakashatsi byemererwa muri HTML ukoresheje ikiranga accesskey. Agaciro ka element ya accesskey ikiranga nurufunguzo umukoresha azakanda (mubisanzwe uhujwe nurufunguzo rumwe cyangwa nyinshi, nkuko byasobanuwe na mushakisha) kugirango ubashe gukora cyangwa kwibanda kuri kiriya kintu. Nubwo ibiranga accesskey ishyiraho urufunguzo rushobora gukanda, ntabwo ihita imenyesha umukoresha urufunguzo rwinjira. Ihwaniro rimwe ni iryumwanditsi wurupapuro kugirango yerekane agaciro kingenzi koresha ukoresheje tagi &gt; &lt; kugirango ushire umurongo inyuguti mumyandiko ihuza ihuza na accesskey yashinzwe. Kumuhuza hepfo, umukoresha yakanda + kuri Internet Explorer, + kuri Mac (urufunguzo rw'itegeko rushobora gutanga ibisubizo utifuzaga) na + + kuri Opera kugirango yerekanwe kuri index.html.&lt;a href="index.html" accesskey="h"&gt;Home&lt;/a&gt;cyangwa gushimangira ‹H›:&lt;a href="index.html" accesskey="h"&gt;&lt;em&gt;H&lt;/em&gt;ome&lt;/a&gt;ubundi, CSS ikurikira irashobora gukoreshwa kugirango yerekane imiterere:
ntabwo ari ngombwa, ariko bishobora kugirira akamaro umukoresha. Irabafasha kumenya urufunguzo rwo gukanda kugirango bereke aho bashaka. Ubundi buryo bushoboka bwo kwerekana ibifasha gukora nibyo gukora page hamwe nibikoresho byose byerekanwe. Cyangwa webmaster ashobora gukora byombi. Ubundi buryo kubakoresha amaherezo ni ugushiraho inyandiko yumukoresha nka FireFox "Access Bar" ya GreaseMonkey.
Uburenganzi bwo gutangira ubushakashatsi muri HTML muri 1999 kandi byihuse bigerwaho hafi yubufasha bwa mushakisha rusange.
Amakimbirane na mushakisha hamwe na ecran yabasomyi.
Mucukumbuzi nyinshi zisobanura ama shortcuts ya clavier yabo, akoreshwa mugucunga mushakisha ubwayo: urugero, mushakisha nyinshi kuri Windows ALT + D kwibanda kuri URL umurongo. Bimwe mubikorwa byambere byakoresheje urufunguzo rumwe rwo guhindura urufunguzo rwo kwinjira: urugero, accesskey = "D" nayo yagenera ALT+D, bivamo kimwe cyangwa ikindi mubisobanuro bitaboneka.
Mu mpeshyi yo mu 2002, ubujyanama bw’Abanyakanada bwinjira ku rubuga rwa interineti bwakoze ubushakashatsi butemewe kugira ngo harebwe niba gushyira mu bikorwa ibikoresho byateje ibibazo abakoresha ikoranabuhanga ry’imihindagurikire y'ikirere, cyane cyane ikoranabuhanga ryo gusoma rya ecran rikoreshwa n'abakoresha impumyi kandi batabona neza. Aba bakoresha bakeneye ama shortcuts menshi ya clavier kugirango bagere kurubuga, nkuko "kwerekana no gukanda" imbeba ntabwo ari amahitamo kuri bo. Ubushakashatsi bwabo bwerekanye ko guhuza ibice byinshi byingenzi byerekanaga amakimbirane kuri kimwe cyangwa byinshi muri ubwo buhanga, kandi icyifuzo cyabo cya nyuma kwari ukwirinda gukoresha ibikoresho byose.
Ibikurikira, mushakisha yahinduye urufunguzo rwo guhindura kugirango birinde amakimbirane, nkuko bigaragara mumeza iri hejuru: mubisanzwe, ALT +SHIFT kuri Windows, naCTRY + OPT kuri Mac.
Muri XHTML 2, ururimi rwavuguruwe rwandika urubuga,rwa HTML rukora rwa World Wide Web Consortium rwatesheje agaciro ikiranga accesskey rushyigikira ikintu cya &lt;access&gt; cyasobanuwe muri Moderi ya XHTML. Ariko, XHTML 2 yasezeye kuruhande rwa HTML5, (guhera muri Kanama 2009) ikomeje kwemerera ibiranga accesskey, kandi ntibisobanura ubwoko bwibintu &lt;access&gt;.
Gukoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gushushanya amakarita.
Muri 2004, igipimo cyagaragaye ko ukoresheje imibare, iteza imbere guhuza abakoresha, kandi igafasha kongera guhanura kwihuta rya clavier kurubuga rutandukanye. Ibi birimo, kurugero, 1 kujya kurupapuro, 0 gushakisha, ndetse no kubonana, nabandi..
Nyuma yimyaka icumi, muri 2014, hasohotse ibipimo ngenderwaho kandi byuzuye hakoreshejwe inyuguti nimibare byombi hagamijwe guhumeka ubuzima bushya mubikorwa bya byimbitse kandi by'ingenzi.

AnySurfer ni umuryango w’Ababiligi uteza imbere uburyo bwo kugera ku mbuga za interineti, porogaramu, n’inyandiko za digitale ku bamugaye. Nizina ry'ikirango cyiza urubuga kandi ushobora kubona ndetse ukarugiraho uruhare rwuzuye. AnySurfer ni umushinga wigihugu ukorwa na Blindenzorg Licht en Liefde, umuryango udaharanira inyungu w’Ababiligi utanga ubufasha ku batabona n’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.
Kugenzura Urutonde rwa Anysurfer rukoresha mugihe rutanga ikirango icyo aricyo cyose gishingiye kumurongo wurubuga rwibanze (WCAG 2.0).
BlindSurfer yashinzwe mu 2001 na Rudi Canters, umupayiniya ushijwe kugenzura urubuga rwa interineti i. Yafashijwe mu bikorwa bye na Blindenzorg Licht en Liefde. Kubera inkunga y'amafaranga yatanzwe na Gelijke Kansen Vlaanderen, umushinga wahurijwe hamwe mu 2002. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Canters ku ya 14 Mata 2003, umushinga ndetse n'ikirangantego cyacyo byakomeje kwiyongera.
Ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2006, BlindSurfer yahinduye izina ry'uru rubuga arwita AnySurfer. Ibi byakozwe mu rwego rwo kwirinda gushimangira imyumvire ivuga ko kwinjira ku rubuga bigirira akamaro abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona gusa, aho kuba ababana n'ubumuga muri rusange.
Ukuboza 2008, hasohotse ikiciro cya kabiri cyuru rubuga rwibirimo rwo kugerwaho. AnySurfer yagize uruhare mu guhindura aya mabwiriza agezweho mu Giholande, kandi ihuza urutonde rwabo kugira ngo ihuze na WCAG 2.0.

Timothy Clarence Johnson MNZM (yavutse ku wa 4 Gashyantare 1976) ni umuyobozi wa siporo w’abafite ubumuga muri Nouvelle-Zélande akaba yarahoze akina umikino wa rugby w’abafite ubumuga bwo kugendera mu kagare. Yabaye kapiteni w’ikipe Wheel Blacks, ikipe y’igihugu ya Nouvelle-Zélande ikina rugby y’abakoresha amagare y’abafite ubumuga.
Johnson yari umunyamuryango w’amakipe ya Nouvelle-Zélande akina rugby y’abakoresha amagare kuva mu 1998 kugeza mu 2010, harimo n’ikipe yatwaye umudali wa zahabu mu mikino ya Paralympics yo mu mpeshyi ya 2004 yabereye Atenayi, ndetse n’ikipe yatwaye umudali wa feza mu mikino ya Paralympics yo mu 2000 yabereye i Sydney. Mu mikino ya Paralympics yo mu 2008, yari umukinnyi n'umutoza wungirije mu ikipe ya Nouvelle-Zélande, yaje ku mwanya wa gatanu. Yatsindiye umudali wa feza mu marushanwa y’isi yabereye i Toronto mu 1998 no muri Christchurch mu 2006, kandi yari kapiteni w’ikipe yo mu 2006.
Yabaye perezida wa New Zealand Wheelchair Rugby kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2004, ndetse nanone kuva mu 2011 kugeza mu 2014. Yanakoreye iyo nzego nk’umubitsi hagati y’umwaka wa 2005 na 2006. Yanahagarariye abakinnyi muri Komite Olempike ya Nouvelle-Zélande kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2014.
Johnson yize muri Kaminuza ya Canterbury no muri Christchurch College of Education, aho yasoje afite impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Engineering with Honours mu bijyanye n’amashanyarazi, elektroniki n’itumanaho mu 1998, Graduate Diploma mu Kwigisha no Kwiga (Secondary) mu 1999, ndetse na Master of Engineering mu 2004. Yanize kandi muri Victoria University of Technology i Melbourne ndetse no muri Auckland University of Technology. Yarangije amasomo ajyanye na Graduate Diploma mu Kwita ku Mirimo y’Abakinnyi B’abahanga mu 2005, kandi yasoje afite Graduate Certificate mu Buyobozi bw’Ubucuruzi (Part MBA) mu 2015.Yahawe impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza ya Canterbury na Nouvelle-Zélande Blues mu mukino wa rugby y’abakoresha amagare.
Kuri ubu akora nka Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe amarushanwa muri ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya rugby y’abakoresha amagare (WWR), aho yamaze kuba umunyamuryango w’ingenzi kuva mu 2007. Ni Umutoza wungirije w’Ikoranabuhanga mu mikino ya Paralympics yo mu mpeshyi ya 2024 i Paris, kandi ni Umutoza w’Ikoranabuhanga mu gikombe mpuzamahanga cya 2023 cya Rugby y'abakoresha amagare. Yanabaye Umutoza w’Ikoranabuhanga mu marushanwa akurikira: 2023 WWR Asia-Oceania Championship, 2018 IWRF World Championships, ndetse na 2013, 2015 na 2019 IWRF Asia-Oceania Championships.
Yakoze imirimo myinshi muri sosiyete ishinzwe indishyi zimpanuka kuva mu mwaka wa 2006 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2019
Mu isabukuru y’amavuko y’umwamikazi wa 2015, Johnson yagizwe Umunyamuryango w’icyubahiro cya Nouvelle-Zélande, muri serivisi z’imikino y’abafite ubumuga.

Umwimerere wa BobbySoftware yari igikoresho cyo kuri interineti gikoreshwa kubuntu, cyanditswe na Josh Krieger kandi gitangwa nikigo gishinzwe ikoranabuhanga ryihariye (CAST), ryakoreshejwe mukwemeza imbuga za WAI no kubahiriza 508. n' umushinga watangijwe mu mwakwa wa 1995, yamenyekanye cyane mugukoresha igishushanyo "cyemewe cya Bobby" abanditsi b'urubuga bashobora gukoresha kugirango berekane ko batsinze ikizamini cya Bobby kumurongo. Iterambere ryahujwe na Chuck Hitchcock, Umuyobozi mukuru wa CAST muri Politiki n’ikoranabuhanga, kandi ryatejwe imbere na David Clark na Michael Cooper.
Igikoresho CAST cyafunzwe ku mugaragaro ku ya 1 Gicurasi 2005. Icyakora, izina rya Bobby ryabayeho muri gahunda ya Watchfire Corporation ya Watchfire Bobby. Watchfire yatanze serivisi yubuntu CAST yakoranye naniri korana buhanga rya BobbySoft mubikoresho byabo bya Watchfire WebXACT. Itangwa rya Watchfire, ubu igice cya suite ya IBM yasobanuwe hepfo, igerageza paji yibirimo kurubuga kubwiza, kuboneka, nibibazo byihariye.
Iri koranabuhanga ryakoreshwaga kubuntu ryaje gafungwe ku mugaragaro na ba nyir'ubwite, IBM, ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2008. Ubu porogaramu iraboneka mu rwego rwa IBM Rational Policy Tester Accessibility Edition.
Kugeza ubu, Igikoresho cyo Gusuzuma Urubuga (WAVE) rutanga iyi serivisi yubuntu kuri wave.webaim.org.

Ihuriro ry’abafite ubumuga bw’umubiri yari ishyirahamwe ry’abaharaniraga uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga mu mujyi wa New York mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana cya 20. Ryashinzwe mu kwezi kwa Gatanu 1935 hagamijwe kwamagana ivangura ryakorewe n’ubuyobozi bushinzwe iterambere (WPA).
Biro y’Ubwunganizi bw’Abaturage yo mu Mujyi wa New York yashiragaho akamenyetso “PH” ku busabe bw’abasaba inkunga bari bafite ubumuga, aho “PH” risobanuraga “physically handicapped” (ufite ubumuga bw’umubiri). Aba bantu bashyirwaga ku rutonde rw’“abatabasha kubona akazi” (unemployable), maze bakangirwa kubona imirimo yashyiriweho n’WPA. Kugira ngo barwanye ibyo, abanyamuryango b’Ihuriro ry’Abafite Ubumuga bw’Umubiri bakoreye sit-in muri Home Relief Bureau iminsi icyenda batangiriye ku wa 29 Gicurasi 1935, ndetse banakora sit-in y’ikiruhuko cy’impera z’icyumweru ku biro bya WPA, nabyo mu Mujyi wa New York, mu kwezi kwa Kamena 1935. Izi ngamba zaje gutuma hashyirwaho imirimo 1,500 ku bakozi bafite ubumuga bw’umubiri mu Mujyi wa New York mu mwaka wa 1936. Ihuriro ryari rimaze gusenyuka mu mwaka wa 1938.

Ikoranabuhanga rifasha mu mikino ni urwego rw'iterambere ry'ikoranabuhanga riri kugenda rwaguka.. Tekinoroji yifashisha n'ibikoresho byinshi byakozwe kugira ngo bifashe abakunzi ba siporo bafite ubumuga mu mikino. Tekinoroji ifasha mu mikino ishobora gukoreshwa muri siporo y'ababana n'ubumuga, aho siporo ihari ihindurwa kugira ngo abakinnyi babana n'ubumuga bitabire; cyangwa, tekinoroji ifasha ababana n'ubumuga ishobora gukoreshwa mu guhimba siporo nshya rwose hamwe n'abakinnyi bafite ubumuga uretse mu bitekerezo.
Umubare w’abafite ubumuga bitabira siporo ugenda wiyongera, biganisha ku iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga rishya rifasha. Ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga bifasha bishobora kuba byoroheje, "tekinoroji-nto", cyangwa bishobora gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ryateye imbere cyane, ndetse bamwe bakoresha mudasobwa. Tekinoroji ifasha siporo nayo ishobora kuba yoroheje cyangwa yateye imbere. Ku bw'ibyo, tekinoroji ifasha ishobora kuboneka muri siporo kuva ku myidagaduro y'abaturage kugeza ku mikino ya Paralympique. Ibikoresho byinshi by'ikoranabuhanga byifashisha tekinoroji byatejwe imbere mu gihe, kandi ku bw'ibyo, siporo ku bantu bafite ubumuga "yahindutse kuba igikoresho cyo kuvura(ivuriro) ihinduka ibikorwa bigamije amarushanwa".
Ibikoresho bifasha bishobora gukoreshwa imyitozo n'amahugurwa, usibye no kuba bifasha kwitabira siporo. Hano hari bimwe mu bikoresho bifasha kuri ubu biboneka ku bafite ubumuga:
Imikino ikoresha tekinoroji ifasha.
Siporo ikoresha tekinoroji ifasha ikubiyemo iyi ikurikira:
Imikino myinshi yavuzwe haruguru yageze ku rwego mpuzamahanga rw'imikino ngororamubiri, ishyirwa mu mikino Paralympique.
Siporo ikenera ikoranabuhanga rifasha.
Imikino imwe n'imwe yateye imbere ifite intego yo guteza ikibazo abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bashobora kwishimira. Iyi siporo isaba tekinoroji ifasha abakinnyi bose mu gice cy'imikino. Ingero zimwe ni: Umukino (Sled) umupira w'amaguru ; igare ry'ababana n'ubumuga ; ubwato bwo guhuza n'imiterere, hamwe n'ubwato bwagenewe cyane cyane abasare bafite ubumuga; Nordic (cross-country) skiing hamwe n'indobo "sit-ski"; n'amarushanwa yo gutwara amagare.

Upasana Makati ni rwiyemezamirimo ukomoka mu mujyi wa Mumbai, washinze White Print, akaba n'umurwanashyaka w'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Mu mwaka wa 2016, yatoranyijwe nka umwe mu 30 bafite impano cyangwa ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa bari munsi y’imyaka 30.
Makati yize itumanaho muri kaminuza ya Ottawa.
Mu mwaka wa 2013, Upasana Makati yatekereje ku buryo abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona batangiriraga umunsi wabo, bityo agahitamo gusura amashuri kugira ngo amenye neza. Nyuma yo kubona ko hari amahitamo make ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona yo gusoma batagombye gufashwa n’umu-soma-ecran, yashinze White Print, ikinyamakuru cya mbere cyo mu Bwongereza cyibanda ku buzima bw’abantu mu Buhinde gisohoka mu Braille. Iki kinyamakuru gisohora impapuro 64 kandi gikubiyemo insanganyamatsiko zirimo ubugeni, siporo, politiki, n’ikinamico/filime.
Iki kinyamakuru ni icyinjiza amafaranga, kikishyurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo busanzwe nk’abasomyi biyandikishije n’amatangazo y’ibigo.

BrowseAloud ni porogaramu yikoranabuhanga ifasha yongerera inyandiko-imvugo imikorere kurubuga. Yakozwe na Texthelp Ltd, isosiyete yo muri Irilande y'Amajyaruguru ishingiye ku buhanga bwo gukora ikoranabuhanga rifasha. BrowseAloud yongeraho ibikoresho byo gusoma kubikoresho kugirango wongere imbuga za interineti kubantu bakeneye gukoresha uru rubuga mu gusoma inkuru. Igikoresho cya JavaScript gishingiye kongeramo ibikoresho bireremba kurupapuro rwurubuga rusurwa. Serivisi yishyurwa nuwamamaza urubuga; kandi ni ubuntu kubasura urubuga.
BrowseAloud yakoreshejwe mu Bwongereza n’inama zimwe na zimwe z’ibanze, hamwe n’ibice bya serivisi y’ubuzima. Porogaramu yatsindiye ibbihembo byinshi bishya by’itangazamakuru muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika
BrowseAloud yanenzwe naba technologiste ko bakeneye gukoresha Mouse kugirango bahitemo inyandiko mbere yuko BrowseAloud ayisoma. Ibi byasabye icyerekezo nubuhanga bwo gukoresha moteri, kugirango BrowseAloud itagerwaho mumatsinda ashobora gukoresha abandi basoma ecran, nka JAWS. Abatanga ibitekerezo bavuze ko BrowseAloud idasimbuye ibikoresho nkibi.
Ku ya 11 Gashyantare 2018, ku cyumweru, abakiriya ba BrowseAloud barenga 4.200 (amakuru amwe yavuze ko abantu barenga 5.000) imiyoboro yabo yanduye kode ya Coinhive nyuma yuko BrowseAloud, yakiriwe kuri Serivisi za Amazone, yibwe. Nubwo Coinhive itanga Monero, uburyo bwo gukoresha amafaranga -ifite imikoreshereze yemewe, kuyinjiza mu buryo muri icyo gitero byasobanuwe ko ari "bibi" n’umwanditsi mukuru "w’ikinyamakuru" mukuru, Chris Williams; kandi nka "malware" na Taylor Hatmaker, muri TechCrunch.
Serivisi ya BrowseAloud yahagaritswe na Texthelp, kugirango yemere abashakasshatsi babo gukora iperereza ku guhungabanya umutekano no gukuraho code mbi. Kwiyandikisha byagereranije ko code yakoraga muri BroswseAloud mugihe cyamasaha cumi nagatatu. Yakoresheje mudasobwa zabashyitsi kugirango ibare ibarwa cyane, ishobora kudindiza imikorere ya mudasobwa yabo no kugabanya ubuzima bwa bateri cyangwa gukoresha amashanyarazi. Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe umutekano wa cyber cyavuze ko ibikorwa ari "bitemewe".
Mu bakiriya bafite bagezweho n'ingaruka ku mbuga za interineti harimo Komiseri ushinzwe amakuru mu Bwongereza (wafunze urubuga rwabo mu rwego rwo kwirinda), Ibiro by’Ubuyobozi bw’Inkiko z’Amerika, na guverinoma z’ibihugu bya Ositaraliya bya Victoria na Queensland.
Iki kibazo cyagaragajw na Scott Helme, umujyanama ushinzwe umutekano mu Bwongereza. Boyd buri wese yerekanye ko intege nke zikoreshwa muri icyo gitero zashoboraga gukoreshwa mu kwiba amakuru y’abashyitsi yavugiwe muriyo nama. Helme na NCSC bombi basabye ko abategura urubuga bakoresha ubunyangamugayo bwa subresource mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibyo bitero.
Igitero cyagereranijwe ko cyinjije gusa abagabye igitero kingana n’amadolari 24 muri kode ya Monero. Bamwe mu batanze ibitekerezo, nka Chris Boyd wo muri Malwarebytes, bavuze ko icyo gitero cyari cyoroheje, kubera ko abagabye igitero bashoboraga kugerageza uburyo bwo gukoresha ejo hazaza.

Lorraine Mercer MBE ni Umwongereza wabashije kurokoka ingaruka za thalidomide, akaba umushushanyi, umudozi w’imipira y’imisumari n’umushoferi w’imodoka z’abafite ubumuga muri RDA.
Mercer yari uhagarariye umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abarokotse ingaruka za thalidomide ubwo yagendaga afata Itara rya Olympic mu mwaka wa 2012 ku bw’igihugu cye. Imodoka ye yateguwe ku buryo yatwaraga Itara rya Olympic neza hejuru y’umutwe we, itajya hafi y’umwuka wa ogisijeni akeneye.
Mu mwaka wa 2015, Mercer yahawe icyubahiro MBE kubera serivisi ze mu muryango, by’umwihariko ku bantu bonyine bo mu bitaro by’aho atuye muri Mid-Sussex.

Itegeko rishingiye ku ivangura ry’abafite ubumuga 1992 (Cth) ni itegeko ryemejwe n’Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Ositaraliya aho ribuza abakora ivangura rikorerwa ababana n’ubumuga butandukanye mu kazi, mu burezi, ahantu haboneka ku mugaragaro, gutanga ibicuruzwa na serivisi, amacumbi, clubs n’amashyirahamwe, n’ibindi bice. Ivangura risobanurwa harimo kunanirwa kugira ibyo uhindura kumuntu. Komisiyo ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Ositaraliya ihabwa kandi igasuzuma ibirego byatanzwe hakurikijwe iryo tegeko.

Mu 2004, ibyavuye mu iperereza rya komisiyo ishinzwe gutanga umusaruro ku itegeko ryashyizwe ahagaragara. Komisiyo yasanze mu gihe hakiri byinshi byo kunonosora, cyane cyane mu kugabanya ivangura mu kazi, muri rusange iryo tegeko ryagize akamaro gakomeye.

Komite ya Olempike ya Maguire na Sydney.
Uru rubanza rwazanywe na Bruce Maguire, rwerekeye urubuga rw’imikino Olempike ya Sydney 2000, ndetse n’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona byabafasha gukoresha neza urubuga.

Easy Chirp nigice cya gatatu cyurubuga rushingiye kuri Twitter rwubatswe na Dennis Lembree. Ni urubuga rushobora kugera kuri porogaramu, bivuze ko rutezimbere kubakoresha ubumuga n’abakoresha ikoranabuhanga rifasha. Chirp yoroshye nayo ifite akamaro kubafite tekinoroji yo hasi-nka Internet Explorer 9, umurongo wa interineti uhuza imbuga ndetse numurongo, no kubura inkunga ya JavaScript. Imigaragarire yoroshye nibyiza kubakoresha neza nibindi bishya kurumbuga nkoranyambaga, harimo na Twitter. Uru rubuga rwagaragaye bwa mbere mu ntangiriro za 2009, rwiswe Accessible Twitter, ruhindurwa izina ryitwa Chirp muri Kamena 2011. Hagati muri 2013, urubuga rwahagaritswe kubera amezi agera kuri atanu kubera ivugurura rikomeye ry’ubuhanga. Urubuga rwakozwe numuntu ku giti cye wateguye urubuga nawe ukora blog kubyerekeranye nurubuga rwitwa Web Ax.
Kimwe mu bishya bya Chirp yoroshye mu gukoreshywa ubushobozi bwo kohereza tweet ihuza ishusho hamwe nibindi bisobanuro byombi bigufi kandi birebire. Nibwo bwa mbere porogaramu ya Twitter (kimwe na porogaramu imbuga nkoranyambaga) itanga ubundi buryo bwo gushushanya kuko usanga aribwo buryo byateye imbere cyane muri iki gihe, kubura ubundi buryo bwo gufata amashusho byari ikibazo cyo kugera kuri Twitter no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga muri rusange.
Easy Chirp yahawe igihembo cy'umuyobozi wa FCC 2014 kubera iterambere iyi sisitemu imaze kugeraho, igihembo cya AFB cyo mu mwaka wa 2010 ndetse na 2009 IT IT @ web2.0. Urubuga rwatoranijwe "Gukoresha API Nziza" mu kinyamakuru.net cyo mu 2010 cyiza kurusha ibindi ku rubuga rwa interineti kandi gitangwa mu bihembo bya Blind Bargains Access Awards 2009 na 2010. nayo yari urubuga rwa RNIB rwagaragaye mu Kuboza 2011.
Kubera ikibazo cyimpinduka zikomeye za Twitter API muri 2018, igice cyohererezanya ubutumwa muri Chirp yoroshye gifite imikorere mike cyane.

Mobility mat (izwi kandi nka mobi-mat) ni igikoresho cy’ubufasha kigenewe abantu bakoresha amagare, kibemerera kugera ku nkengero z’inyanja zifite umucanga, imihanda y’ubutaka, cyangwa izindi nzira zishobora kugorana ku bantu bafite ubushobozi buke bwo kugenda, nko ku gitaramo cy’imbaho cyegeranye n’inyanja cyangwa ku nzira yuzuye ibice by’imbaho.
Mobi-mats zakoreshwa muri Ostraliya ziba zifite ubugari bwa metero 1.5 kandi zishobora kugera ku burebure bwa metero 50." Iyi tekinoloji yita ku bantu bose ni mat yirinda gusibangana, rimwe na rimwe ifite imirongo cyangwa ibyuzuye, itanga umudendezo ku bantu bose bakoresheje amagare cyangwa ibinyabiziga byoroheje, harimo ababyeyi bafite strollers cyangwa wagons, ndetse n’abantu bakoresha walkers. Ahanini mobility mats z’inkengero z’inyanja ntizigerera ku mazi kugira ngo zirinde kwangirika n’amariba y’inyanja, ariko zituma inkengero z’inyanja zibasha kugerwaho n’abakoresha amagare cyane kurusha uko byari bisanzwe. Bimwe mu sisteme z’imyidagaduro ku nkengero z’inyanja bishobora gutanga amagare yihariye yo ku mucanga abakoresha bashobora gukodesha umunsi umwe.
Aya mats ni yoroshye gutwara kandi ashobora kwimurirwa ahandi. Inkengero z’inyanja nyinshi muri Florida na Californiya zimaze kuyashyiraho; amakuru ku kuboneka kwazo akwiye kugaragazwa ku mbuga za interineti z’inkengero z’inyanja cyangwa akajyanwa mu makuru aboneka kuri telefoni.

Inzu Ndangamurage y’Amahirwe(Museum of Possibilities) ni inzu ndangamurage y’abafite ubumuga iherereye i Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Ni igikorwa cyashinzwe na Minisiteri ishinzwe imibereho myiza y’abantu bafite ubumuga ya Leta ya Tamil Nadu. Igaragaza ibikoresho byorohereza abantu bafite ubumuga, tekinoloji z’ubufasha, ndetse n’urugo rw’urugero rwubatswe ku buryo bworohereza abantu bose kugera ku bice byarwo.

Igihembo cy’Igihugu cyo Guteza Imbere Abantu bafite Ubumuga ni igihembo gihabwa abantu bafite ubumuga mu Buhinde, kandi gifatwa nk’igihembo cy’ingenzi cyane muri icyo cyiciro mu gihugu. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1969, kandi ikaba iyoborwa na Minisiteri y’Ubutabera n’Iterambere ry’Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage ya Leta y’Ubuhinde.

Umushinga w’Igihugu wo Kuringaniza Amahirwe mu Burezi ku Bagore bafite Ubumuga washinzwe na Corbett O'Toole i Berkeley, muri Californiya, mu mwaka wa 1980. Byari umushinga w’imyaka itatu wo gukora ubushakashatsi no kugaragaza ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi. Hashingiwe ku Ikigega cyo Kwigisha no Kurengera Uburenganzira bw’Abafite Ubumuga (DREDF), Umushinga w’Igihugu wo Kuringaniza Amahirwe mu Burezi ku Bagore bafite Ubumuga wakoze ubushakashatsi bwa mbere ku rwego rw’igihugu ku bijyanye n’ubumuga n’imibereho y’abagore. Yanakoze kandi Inama ya Mbere ku Rwego rw’Igihugu ku Kuringaniza Amahirwe mu Burezi ku Bagore bafite Ubumuga, yabereye i Bethesda, Maryland. Yateje imbere kandi ibikoresho byanditse bigenewe abarimu n’abajyanama, bijyanye n’ibikenewe by’abagore n’abakobwa bafite ubumuga. "Y"anakoze kandi igitabo kivuga ku bahangayikishije abandi (role models) ku bakobwa bakiri bato bafite ubumuga cyitwa "No More Stares."

Open Style Lab (OSL) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu watangijwe mu 2014, ku ikubitiro nk'umushinga wa serivisi rusange mu kigo cy'ikoranabuhanga cya Massachusetts. Umuyobozi mukuru n’Umuyobozi w’inama y’ubutegetsi bw’iri shyirahamwe ritagamije inyungu ni Grace Jun. Iri shyirahamwe rigena kandi rikora imyenda n’ibicuruzwa byihariye byo gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga, bikorwamo hamwe n’abantu bafite ubumuga ndetse kubagenewe. Iri tsinda ritumira abanyabugeni, abahanga mu by’ikoranabuhanga (engineers), n’abajyanama b’imirimo (occupational therapists) baturutse impande zose z’isi, kugira ngo bakorane mu gukemura ikibazo cy’ukuri hifashishijwe imyenda yihariye yo gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga. Uwo mushinga wasubiwemo muri MIT International Design Centre ndetse no mu ishuri rya Parsons School of Design ku Ishuri Rishya.
Buri mpeshyi, iri tsinda ryegeranya amakipe y’abantu bafite ubumenyi butandukanye harimo abanyabugeni, abahanga mu by’ikoranabuhanga, n’abajyanama b’imirimo, bakajyanwa hamwe n’umukiriya ufite ubumuga. Amakipe aba afite icyumweru 10 cyo gukora ubushakashatsi, gushushanya no guteza imbere igisubizo cyo gufasha uwo mukiriya. Iri tsinda ryakoranye n’abantu bafite ibikomere ku mitsi y’inyuma (spinal cord injuries) n’abafite ubumuga bwo mu bwonko (cognitive disability) mu gukora imishinga yabo, nk’ibikoresho byihariye byo kudoda.

Itegeko Nshingiro rya Paralympic ni izina ryahawe urutonde rw’amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga imikorere y'imikino y'abamugaye. Rishyiraho Itegeko Nshingiro rya Komite Mpuzamahanga ya Paralympic n’abandi bagize umuryango wa Paralympic, harimo komite za Paralympic z’ibihugu n’izindi nzego z’imikino.
Itegeko Nshingiro rya Paralympic rihuye kandi rikurikira Itegeko Nshingiro rya Olympic.
Abasesenguzi b’iby’ubumenyi bw’imikino bagaragaje ko intego z’umuryango wa Paralympic zigaragazwa mu Itegeko Nshingiro n’ibindi nyandiko z’ingenzi ari “zitomoye” kandi zidahwitse neza nk’uko byifuzwa ugereranyije n’Itegeko Nshingiro rya Olympic.

Abamugaye mu ntambara yo kurwanya amategeko y'Abanazi ni itegeko rya Isiraheli, ritanga ubufasha ku Bisirayeli barwanye mu ngabo z’ibihugu byari mu muryango w’abafatanyije cyangwa mu mashami y’abarwanyi b’abaharanira ubwigenge (partisan units) mu gihe cy’Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, kandi bafite ubumuga bw’umubiri cyangwa bwo mu mutwe bwatewe n’iyo ntambara. Byongeye, iri tegeko ritanga uburenganzira ku bashakanye basigaye ku bafashijwe, ku gihe gito cyangwa kugeza bashatse undi mugabo cyangwa umugore, bitewe n’uburemere bw’ubumuga bwemejwe ku mufashijwe wa mbere mbere y’urupfu rwe.
Iri tegeko ryaje inyuma y’akazi k’ubukangurambaga bw’amatsinda y’abasirikare b’intambara ya kabiri y’isi, rikemezwa na Knesset mu mwaka wa 1954. Ariko, iri tegeko ntiritanga abasirikare ba Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi yose inyungu zingana n’iza basirikare bamaze igihe mu ngabo z’Igihugu cya Isiraheli. Inyungu zishingiye kuri iri tegeko zitangwa n’Ikigo cy’Imari, ntizitangwa na Minisiteri y’Ingabo.

Robert Perske (1927 – 14 kanama 2016) yari umwanditsi w’Amerika, umuhanga mu by’idini (theologian), ndetse n’umurwanashyaka w’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga.
Yaharaniraga by’umwihariko abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bashinjwe ibyaha batakoze. Yatekereje kandi igitekerezo cy’agaciro ko gufata ibyago. Nk’umupasiteri w’umuryango wa Methodist, ibyo yanditse byagize uruhare rukomeye mu guhindura uburyo abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bitabwaho mu matorero n’imiryango y’idini. Igikorwa cye cyamamaye cyane, "Deadly Innocence?", gikurikirana inkuru ya Joe Arridy, "wamenyekanye nka Umuntu Ushimishwa cyane ku ntebe y’urupfu."

Ishuri rya Patiala ry'abatabona nishuri ryihariye ry'abana babana n'ubumuga bwo kutabona Patiala wa Panjab. "Sosiyete ishinzwe imibereho y’abafite ubumuga" society for welfare kubabana nubwo bumuga1967.

AMI-amajwi ni serivisi yo gusoma radio yo muri Canada ikorwa na Accessible Media Inc. (AMI). Iyi serivisi yatangijwe mu mwaka 1990 nka VoicePrint, iyi serivisi igira gahunda zirimo gusoma ingingo ziva mu binyamakuru byandika ku nyungu z'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa batazi gusoma. Serivisi kandi igira AMI yakozwe ivuga ijambo porogaramu rivuga ku ngingo zijyanye n'ubumuga no kugerwaho.
AMI-audio yemerewe na komisiyo ishinzwe amaradiyo na televiziyo yo muri Canada (CRTC) nka serivisi igomba gutangwa mu bushishozi; igomba gukoreshwa ku rwego rwo hasi rwa serivisi yemewe, televiziyo ya satelite, hamwe n'abatanga IPTV muri Canada. Serivise kandi itangwa binyuze muri serivise ya AMI +, hamwe na porogaramu imwe iboneka nka podcasts.
Iyi serivisi yatangijwe bwa mbere mu mwaka wa 1990 nka VoicePrint, nka serivisi y’ikigo kidaharanira inyungu cyo gusoma no kwandika (NBRS). CRTC yabemereye nka serivisi "igomba gutangira" mu 2001, bivuze ko insinga zose nshya zijyanye n'igihe hamwe n'abatanga ibyogajuru bagomba gutanga serivisi. Porogaramu yayo nayo itangwa na AMI ya sisitemu nshya, harimo na serivise ya AMI +.

"Nana" Technology ni akuma kikoranabuhanga kateguwe, kagenewe, cyangwa gashobora gukoreshwa mu kuzamura imibereho y'abantu bakuru.
Ijambo gukina kubijyanye na siyansi yubumenyi bwa nanotechnology, "Nana" ikoranabuhanga ryerekeza ku kwerekana ikoranabuhanga kuri nyirakuru w'umuntu, cyangwa "Nana". Carle niwe muntu wa mbere wateje imbere ikoreshwa ryiyi nteruro hamwe nubusobanuro busanzwe, kandi umwe yibanze gusa kuri tekinoroji ya kuma kikoranabuhanga, hamwe nigisubizo cyo kwita izina igice gishya kandi gitandukanye cyinganda zikoranabuhanga. Ijambo rya Carle hamwe n’ibisabwa byihariye byatangajwe bwa mbere mu gihugu mu kiganiro cyihariye muri Amerika kuri uyumunsi ku itariki ya 9 Kanama 2006. Kuva icyo gihe manda ya Carle na / cyangwa ibisobanuro byatangajwe, bisubirwamo, cyangwa byagaragaye mu bitangazamakuru byinshi ku isi harimo ariko ntibigarukira gusa: CNN, CNBC, Amakuru ya CBS, Amakuru ya Fox, PBS, NPR, Forbes, Amafaranga y’ubwenge, BBC, Agence France-Presse, KYODO amakuru ya serivisi, na ikinyamakuru cya Australian, ndetse nibindi.
Kuva yasobanura urwego, Carle yabaye umwe m'ubajyanama bibigo byinshi byifuza guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga kubantu bakuze, barimo APPLE, Nintendo, Vigorous Mind, na GTX Corporation. Hamwe na GTX, yafashije guteza imbere inkweto ya mbere ya GPS kubantu barwaye Alzheimer ndetse no guta umutwe, bashobora kuba bafite ibyago byo kuzerera no kuzimira. Mu mwaka wa 2012, iryo koranabuhanga ryamenyekanye nk'imwe mu "Ibintu 100 by'ingenzi byavumbuwe n'abantu" n'Ingoro Ndangamurage y'Ubumenyi n'Ikoranabuhanga i Stockholm, muri Suwede.
Usibye ijambo n'ibisobanuro, Carle yatangaje ibyiciro umunani kugeza ubu kubijyanye n'ikoranabuhanga rya "Nana", kandi bijyanye nibice bifitanye isano cyane nabantu barengeje imyaka 65:
Ubuzima n’ubuzima bwiza: Harimo ikoranabuhanga nkiryo gucunga imiti, gukurikirana ibimenyetso byingenzi, cyangwa kuvura indwara zisanzwe zireba abantu bakuru.
Umutekano: Harimo ikoranabuhanga ryo gukumira kugwa, gukurikirana cyangwa gusaba ubufasha bwihutirwa, cyangwa gukurikirana cyangwa gukumira inzererezi mubantu bafite ikibazo cyo guta umutwe Alzheimer.
Kumenya: Harimo ikoranabuhanga rigamije kunoza imikorere yubwenge muri rusange nkuko ryangijwe no gusaza bisanzwe, ubumuga bworoshye bwubwenge (MCI), cyangwa guta umutwe.
Itumanaho: Harimo ikoranabuhanga ryemerera abantu bakuze gutumanaho hakoreshejwe itumanaho ngendanwa, interineti, amashusho, cyangwa ubundi buryo bwitumanaho.
Ibyiyumvo: Harimo ikoranabuhanga rifasha abantu bakuze kugabanuka cyangwa gutakaza amaso, kumva, uburyohe, gukoraho, cyangwa umunuko.
Kwimuka: Harimo ikoranabuhanga rifasha abantu bakuze muri gahunda yo kwinjira no gusohoka, gutwarwa, cyangwa gutwara.

Imiyoboro ya Cartilage ninzira yerekana ibimenyetso byijwi byumvikana mumatwi yimbere. Mu 2004, Hiroshi Hosoi (Nara Medical University) yavumbuye iyi nzira ayita igikucangwa”. Kumva ukoresheje imiyoboro y'igikucangwa itandukanye ninzira zisanzwe zitwara amajwi, nk'umwuka cyangwa amagufwa, kuko bigerwaho no gukora umuyoboro ku igikucangwa no kumva kandi ntabwo birimo kunyeganyega kw'amagufwa ya gihanga. Kubwibyo, imiyoboro ya karitsiye yitwa "inzira ya gatatu yo kumva".
Kuva mu myaka igera hafi kuri 450 ishize, inzira ebyiri zemerewe kohereza amajwi mu gutwi imbere: gutwara umwuka no gutwara amagufwa. Mu 2004, Hiroshi Hosoi, icyo gihe wari umwarimu muri kaminuza y’ubuvuzi ya Nara (ubu akaba na perezida wacyo), yavumbuye ikintu cyo kumva akoresheje urusaku rw’amatwi y’inyuma. Muguhuza vibura no kumva, wasangaga ijwi ryanduzwa mumatwi yimbere. Yasabye igitekerezo cy'igitabo kivuga ko karitsiye ifite umutungo wihariye utuma ishobora kohereza amajwi. yiswe imiyoboro ya karitsiye. Kuva mu Kuboza 2022, impapuro 32 z’amasomo zasohotse kuri iyi ngingo mu binyamakuru mpuzamahanga bya siyansi. Byongeye kandi, ibyuma bifata amajwi ya karitsiye, na terefone ngendanwa hamwe nogukusanya amajwi biri ku isoko kuva 2017, 2022 na 2023.
Urwego rwo kwumva rugizwe n'ugutwi, hagati, n'imbere (cochlea). Ugutwi kwinyuma kugizwe na pinna kwumva hanze. Pinna ikozwe na karitsiye. Igice cyimbere ninyuma cyumuyoboro wunva winyuma ukorwa na karitsiye hamwe namagufwa. cya karitsiye hamwe nigice cyamagufwa bishobora gutandukanywa nigitutu cyoroheje nintoki. Iyo imiyoboro ishyizwe mugice cya karitsiye, ijwi rishobora kumvikana hifashishijwe imiyoboro ya karitsiye. Umwanya ukwiye wo guhuza neza ibyo bice kugirango ukorwe neza ni karitsiye ikikije ubwinjiriro bwumuyoboro wumva wo hanze, mugihe ibice biri kure yubwinjiriro (urugero, crus helicis) ntibishobora kugira uruhare runini mugutwara karitsiye.

iListen, yakozwe na MacSpeech, ni gahunda yo kumenyekanisha imvugo kuri Apple Macintosh. Mu mwaka wa 2006, iListen nicyo gice cya gatatu cya software yonyine- yemerewe kwinjiza inyandiko ukoresheje ijwi ryumuntu ukora kuri moderi nshya ya Macintosh. Abanywanyi bayo bari porogaramu yo kumenyekanisha imvugo ya Apple (yubatswe muri Mac OS X); Ikiyoka Mubisanzwe Tuvuze na Nuance, ikora munsi ya software ya Windows nka Parallels desktop ya Mac cyangwa VMware Fusion ; na gahunda yo guhagarika imvugo ya ViaVoice na Nuance / IBM.

Imitext ni bitmap subtitle yohereza uburyo bwihariye kuri sisitemu yo guhindura ibintu muburyo bwa mashusho cyangwa se ekara. Ikoranabuhanga ryahawe uruhushya rwa Scientific Atlanta kugirango rwinjizwe muri kodegisi ya PowerVu na decoders.

A universal remote ni igenzura rya kure rishobora gutegurwa gukora ibirango bitandukanye by'ubwoko bumwe cyangwa bwinshi bw'ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki. Hafi yisi-ya kure ya kure irashobora kugenzura gusa umubare w'ibikoresho byagenwe nuwabikoze, mugihe hagati na-yohejuru-ya kure yisi yose yemerera uyikoresha progaramu muri code nshya igenzura kure. Remote nyinshi zagurishijwe hamwe na elegitoroniki zitandukanye zirimo ubushobozi bwa kure bw'ubushobozi bw'ubundi bwoko bw'ibikoresho, butuma igenzura ya Kure igenzura ibindi bikoresho birenze igikoresho yazanye. urugero: VCR ya kure irashobora gutegurwa kugirango ikore ibirango bitandukanye bya tereviziyo.
Ku ya 30 Gicurasi 1985, Philips yerekanye icyambere cya kure (US Pat. # 4774511) ku izina rya Magnavox. Mu 1985, Robin Rumbolt, William "Russ" McIntyre, na Larry Goodson hamwe na Electronics Consumer Electronics yo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru (Magnavox, Sylvania, na Philco) bakoze uburyo bwa mbere bwo kugenzura kure.
Mu 1987, hasohotse porogaramu ya mbere ishobora gutegurwa ku isi hose. Yiswe "CORE" kandi yakozwe na CL 9, itangira ryashinzwe na Steve Wozniak, wavumbuye mudasobwa ya Apple I na Apple II.
Muri Werurwe 1987, Steve Ciarcia yasohoye inkuru mu kinyamakuru cya Byte yise "Wubake Trainable Infrared Master Controller", gusobanura remote rusange ishobora kohereza cyangwa gukoporora imyanya yayo(settings) kuri mudasobwa, iki gikoresho cyari gifite ubushobozi bwa macro (bushobora gukora ibikorwa byinshi icyarimwe).
Imiterere n'ibiranga.
Hafi ya kure y'isi yose isangira umubare wibanze shusho w'ibiyigize:
Bimwe mubigabanijwe cyane nka TV-B-Gone cyangwa urufunguzo rungana kure rurimo buto nkeya gusa, nk'imbaraga n'umuyoboro/abatoranya amajwi.
Hejuru-ya kure ya ifite ibindi bintu byinshi biranga:
Kuzamurwa no kwiga kure.
Hafi ya kure kwisi yose yemerera kode urutonde rwateguwe muri kure kugirango ivugururwe kugirango ishyigikire ibirango bishya cyangwa moderi yibikoresho bidashyigikiwe na kure. Bimwe murwego rwohejuru rwo kwiga kwisi kure bisaba mudasobwa guhuzwa. Ihuza risanzwe rikorwa binyuze muri USB kuva kuri mudasobwa kugeza mini-USB kuri kure cyangwa sitasiyo ya kure.
Mu 2000, itsinda ryabakunzi bavumbuye ko kure yisi yose yakozwe na UEI ikagurishwa munsi ya One For All, RadioShack, nibindi bicuruzwa bishobora kongera gusubirwamo hifashishijwe interineti yitwa JP1.
IR yiga kure irashobora kwiga kode ya buto iyariyo yose kuri IR igenzura kure. Iyi mikorere ituma kure yiga imikorere idashyigikiwe n'ibisanzwe k'ibikoresho runaka, bigatuma rimwe na rimwe bishoboka kugenzura ibikoresho iyo kure itari yabugenewe kugenzura. Ingaruka yubu buryo nuko kwigira kure bikenera kwigisha kure. Na none, ibikoresho bimwe by'imyidagaduro abakora ibikoresho bakoresha pulse y'umurongo urenze ibyo kwigira kure bishobora gutahura no kubika m'urwibutso.
Gukoraho-ecran ya kure.
Izi kure zigaragaza ecran ya LCD ishobora kuba monochrome cyangwa ibara ryuzuye. "Utubuto" mubyukuri ni amashusho kuri ecran, iyo, iyo akozeho, azohereza ibimenyetso bya IR kubikoresho bigenzurwa. Moderi zimwe zifite ecran nyinshi zigerwaho binyuze muri buto yububiko kuri ecran-ecran naho izindi moderi zifite ihuriro rya touch-ecran na buto yumubiri.
Moderi zimwe zo gukoraho-ecran ya kure yateguwe hifashishijwe porogaramu ishushanya kuri PC, ituma uyikoresha ashobora guhitamo ecran, imiterere, buto ndetse na "ibikorwa" buto ikora. "Umushinga" wakozwe noneho ukururwa muri kure ukoresheje umugozi wa USB cyangwa, muburyo bwa vuba, bidasubirwaho na Bluetooth cyangwa Wi-Fi.
Bimwe mubikoraho-ecran ya kure, nka Logitech Harmony 900 na 1100, harimo imiyoboro ya RF kugirango yemere ibimenyetso kugera ahantu kure cyane kurenza intera isanzwe ya IR (hafi metero 6). RF nayo ntisaba umurongo wo kureba. Moderi zimwe, nka Ray Super Remote, zitanga ibyifuzo byibirimo.
Smartphone na tablet kure ya bose.
Amaterefone na tableti nkibikoresha Maemo ya Nokia (N900), iOS ya Apple hamwe na sisitemu y'imikorere ya Google ya Google nayo irashobora gukoreshwa nkigenzura rya kure.
Ibikoresho byinshi byabacuruzi nka Samsung, LG na Nokia birimo icyambu cyubatswe muri IR gishobora gukoreshwa nka kure, mugihe ibindi bisaba kwomeka kumubiri, cyangwa 'dongle', bihuzwa na terefone mugihe bikoreshwa nka kure. Dongle isabwa guhindura ibimenyetso byo kugenzura amashanyarazi kuva kuri terefone m'ibimenyetso bitukura bya infra bisabwa n'ibikoresho byinshi byo m'urugo byerekana amashusho kugirango bigenzurwe kure. Icyakora birashoboka kandi gushyira m'ibikorwa sisitemu idasaba dongle. Sisitemu nk'iyi ikoresha ibyuma byihagararaho byonyine byitwa 'irembo', ryakira ibimenyetso byo kugenzura amashanyarazi kuva kuri terefone m'uburyo bwa Bluetooth cyangwa wi-fi hanyuma ikohereza muburyo bwa infra red itukura kugeza ibice bigomba kugenzurwa.

Ibikoresho byo kubungabunga ibikoresho bya sisitemu ya robot ya Telecontrol (MEISTeR) ni robot yakozwe na Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI). kugirango ifashe mu bikorwa byo gusana no gukora mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga. Yakozwe by'umwihariko kugirango ikorere ahangiritse cyane cyane mu ruganda rw'ingufu za nyukiliyeli rwa Fukushima Daiichi.
Yashyizwe hanze ku italiki ya 6 Ukuboza 2012.
Nyuma y’umutingito 9.0 na tsunami yakurikiyeho yibasiye Ubuyapani ku ya 11 Werurwe 2011, ndetse n’irimbuka ry’uruganda rukora ingufu za kirimbuzi Fukushima Daiichi, inganda zakomeje gushakisha guha robot zishobora gukora imirimo iteje akaga ku rugomero rw’amashanyarazi. Kimwe muri ibyo bisubizo ni HAL exoskeleton. Ariko, HAL exoskeleton yasabye umuderevu wumuntu. Ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 2012, Toshiba yerekanye Tetrapod yananiwe kwerekana.
Kugeza vuba aha, MHI yari yakoze gusa robot yo gutumanaho murugo hamwe na robot ya MARS-D. Nkumwubatsi w’inganda 20 za kirimbuzi mu Buyapani, byari ibisanzwe ko Mitsubishi Heavy Industries yakemura ikibazo hamwe na robot yabo bwite.
MEISTeR (Ikidage kuri shobuja) ni robot ifite intwaro ebyiri zikurikirana. Ishingiye kuri robot ya Rabot na robot igerageza MARS-D, yakozwe nk'umugenzuzi w'inganda za kirimbuzi. Ihagaze, ni ubugari, ndende, n'uburemere muri. Amaboko ya robo afite impamyabumenyi zirindwi (= amashoka arindwi) nkukuboko kwabantu kandi irashobora kuzamura buri umwe. Bitandukanye na robot ya MARS-D MEISTeR irakomeye bihagije kugirango ihangane nibidukikije. Imashini igenzurwa na kure irashobora kwifashisha ibikoresho bitandukanye mumaboko yayo nko gukata no gukora imyitozo, inzitizi zisobanutse, no gucengera muri beto kugirango urebe urwego rw'imirase. Hakozwe igikoresho kidasanzwe gishobora gufata ingero ziva ku nkuta no hasi ahantu hahumanye hamwe n'uburebure bugera kuri. Ishobora kwimuka gushika kuri no kuganira k'ubutaka butaringaniye, harimo nintambwe zigera kuri kuri buri bigega bine byayo byigenga. Ifite igihe giteganijwe cyo gukora amasaha abiri.

Lightwriters ni ubwoko bwibikoresho bitanga imvugo. Umwanditsi ntashobora kuvuga ubwoko bw'ubutumwa ari kwandikira kuri clavier, kandi ubu butumwa bwerekanwa kumyerekano ibiri, imwe ireba uyikoresha naho iyerekanwa rya kabiri ryerekana abafatanyabikorwa cyangwa abafatanyabikorwa. Imvugo synthesizer nayo ikoreshwa mugutanga imvugo isohoka, kandi moderi zimwe zitanga uburyo bwo guhuza printer kugirango itange ibisohoka byanditse.
kubantu badashoboye gukoresha clavier, moderi zimwe za Lightwriter zitanga kuri ecran ya ecran ishobora gukoreshwa na switch ikoresheje tekinoroji yo gusikana, hamwe no guhanura ijambo kugirango ugabanye urufunguzo.
Tekinoroji ifite Moderi ya SL40 ikubiyemo terefone igendanwa yohererezanya ubutumwa bugufi no guhamagara muburyo bw'amajwi, aho imvugo ikomatanya yoherezwa ku bahamagaye, kandi ubutumwa bwinjira buvugwa mu ijwi riranguruye binyuze mu ndangururamajwi.
Umwanditsi wa tekinoroji ya Lightwriter ikaba ihagarariye Abilia. Abanditsi b'amatara baraboneka mu ndimi zitandukanye zo mu Burayi.
Mu mwaka wa 1969, Toby Churchill yakoraga mu Bufaransa iyaje kurwara mugihe yo koga mu kiyaga cyanduye. Abaganga babanje kwizera ko afite izuba kandi ko ibimenyetso bizashira bidatinze, ariko barumirwa kuko yatangiye kwangirika vuba maze bahitamo kumusubiza mu Bwongereza vuba bishoboka kugira ngo akomeze kwivuza, maze yimurirwa mu bitaro bya Addenbrookes i Cambridge aho abaganga batashoboraga kumenya niba ikibazo ari imitsi cyangwa imitsi, kandi ibikoresho byabo byo kwisuzumisha bikaba bike cyane kuko ibyo byari mbere y’umunsi wa CT na MRI.
Abanditsi ba Lightwriter ni ibikoresho byimvugo bityo bisaba urwego runaka rwo gusoma.
Abanditsi bakoresha uburyo bwa Lightwriter bukoreshwa n'abantu benshi bafite ikibazo cyo kutavuga bakurikira laryngectomy, tracheostomy, stroke, gukomeretsa mu mutwe, cyangwa n'indwara zifata ubwonko zigenda zitera indwara nka moteri ya neurone (izwi kandi nka amyotropic lateral sclerose cyangwa ALS), indwara ya Parkinson, sclerose nyinshi (MS) cyangwa koreya ya Huntington.
Abanditsi bakoresha uburyo bwa Lightwriter bukoreshwa kandi nabantu bafite ikibazo cyo kutavuga bavukana bafite imiterere nkubumuga bwubwonko nyuma yo gusoma no kwandika.
Diane Pretty yari umwongerezakazi wasuzumwe indwara ya Motor Neurone Disease wagerageje guhindura amategeko y’Ubwongereza kugira ngo ashobore kurangiza ubuzima bwe abifashijwemo n’umugabo we atiriwe ashyirwa mu rwego rwo kwiyahura, bikaba bitemewe mu Bwongereza. Pretty yagiye mu Ngoro y’Abadepite no mu Rukiko rw’Uburayi ku burenganzira bwa muntu akoresheje umwanditsi we kugira ngo aburane ikibazo cye, ariko birananirana.

Level Access ni isosiyete igera kuri digitale ifite icyicaro i Arlington, muri Virijiniya.
Level Access ni gahunda itanga porogaramu y'ubucuruzi yo kugerageza urubuga no gukora imbuga za interineti zemewe kandi zujuje ubuzimagatozi, porogaramu zigendanwa, software, hamwe n'ubunararibonye bwa digitale.
Level Access yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1999 n'abashakashatsi bafite ubumuga. Gahunda ya mbere y'ubucuruzi kubyabaye Urwego rwo Kwinjira kwari ukubaka urubuga rw'urugendo rworoshye kugirango ababana n'ubumuga bashobore kujya kurubuga, bakabona amakuru ajyanye nibibuga byoroshye kandi bateganya ibiruhuko byoroshye.
Muri Gashyantare 2018, Level Access rwabonye Simply Accessible, Inc., isosiyete ikora ibikoresho bya digitale ifite icyicaro i Ontario, muri Kanada.
Muri Kanama 2022, Level Access rwarangije guhuza hamwe na eSSENTIAL Accessibility, intangiriro ya Accessibility-as-a-Service.
Muri Mutarama 2024, Urwego Level Access rwabonye UserWay hafi miliyoni 99 z'amadolari nubwo hari impaka zishingiye ku kugerwaho.

Ikoresha uburyo bwa synthesis ni sisitemu igufasha kandi mugusobanukirwa cyane mukunva kuko ikoranye indimi nyinshi mubunini bwa dosiye. eSpeakNG (Igisekuru kizaza) ni ugukomeza umushinga wambere wabatezimbere hamwe nibitekerezo byinshi byabavuga kavukire.
Kubera ubunini bwayo n'indimi nyinshi, eSpeakNG ishyirwa muri NVDA isomeka rya ecran ya ecran ya Windows, hamwe na Android, Ubuntu nibindi bikwirakwizwa na Linux. Ikibanjirije eSpeak cyasabwe na Microsoft mu 2016 kandi yakoreshejwe na Google Translate mu ndimi 27 mu 2010; 17 muri byo byaje gusimburwa nijwi ryihariye.
Ubwiza bw'amajwi asohoka muriyi sisitemu ya EspeakNG buratandukanye cyane. Muri eSpeakNG yabanjirije eSpeak, verisiyo yambere yindimi zimwe yari ishingiye kumakuru aboneka kuri Wikipedia. zagize akazi cyangwa ibitekerezo byatanzwe n'abavuga ururimi kavukire kurusha izindi. Vibratese ni sisitemu yo guhererekanya amakuru ikoresheje ihinda(vibration). yakozwe na FA Geldard mu 1957, igizwe n'ibice bitanu inyeganyega byashyirwaga ku gituza. Buri vibrateri yifashishwaga mu kohereza ubutumwa bwihariye, kandi ishobora gufasha abantu batumva cyangwa batabona neza.
Vibratese yatekerejwe nk'uburyo bushoboka bwo kohereza amakuru y'iperereza ku ngabo ziri ahantu habi cyangwa mu bihe bigoye. Nubwo mu nyandiko ya mbere ya Gerard bitavuzwemo cyane, byumvikanye ko iyi sisitemu ishobora no gufasha abantu batumva cyangwa abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona neza ​​
Geldard yerekanye ibipimo bitatu byoroheje bishobora gutahurwa byoroshye kandi byihuse numusemuzi: igihe bimara, ubukana, n'ahantu. Morse code ni urugero rwa sisitemu yo kwumva itanga amakuru yahinduwe n'igihe cyonyine, kandi irashobora gukoreshwa mu bikoresho by'ububiko. Geldard yasanze gukoresha ibyo bipimo byose, aho kuba kimwe gusa, byemewe ku ibiciro byohereza amakuru menshi. Ibikoresho byinshi byagenwe byagaragaye bishoboka, harimo ingingo zirindwi, ariko bitanu byafashwe nkibihagije. Geldard yemeje ko ibihe bitatu byerekana ibimenyetso (100 ms, 300 ms, 500 ms), hamwe n’uburemere butatu bwo kunyeganyega kuri vibrateri yari sisitemu ifatika, kandi yemerera ibimenyetso 45 gushyirwaho hakoreshejwe vibatori eshanu. Ibimenyetso byagiye bitandukana n'igihe cyashyizwe hagati ya ms 50 hamwe na 100 ms hagati y'amagambo. Ibi byatumaga bishoboka ko ubutumwa bwohererezwa ku muvuduko wa amagambo 67 ku munota mu buryo bw'inyigisho, ugereranyije na Morse code yo ifite hafi amagambo 30 ku munota.
Kugirango ngo hirindwe urujijo, buri nyajwi yahabwaga icyuma gihinda cyiharije. Kunoza umuvuduko, imibare yashizwe kubimenyetso birebire kandi inyuguti zisigaye zahawe ukurikije inshuro. Bimwe mu bimenyetso byagenewe amagambo asanzwe y'Icyongereza.
Ibibazo byinshi byagaragaye hamwe na sisitemu. Ingano y'igihe cy'amahugurwa isabwa yagaragaye nk'ikirenga. Byavuzwe ko amasomo 30, angana n’amasaha, yasabwaga kwiga sisitemu. Byongeye kandi, kudasobanuka ku murongo muto wigihe gito byari ikibazo. Igisubizo cyatanzwe kwari ukongeramo igihe cyigihe, mugihe ugabanya ubukana. Byongeye kandi, Geldard yasabye ko hashobora kubaho sisitemu ikoresheje vibrateri yegeranye cyane ishobora kwanduza icyerekezo, nko gutunga urutoki, kuriyi ngingo. Sisitemu nkiyi irashobora gukoreshwa nkinyuguti ya Lorm.

FreeTTS ni sisitemu ifata icyemezo cyanyuma mu gutuma ishyigikira byo kuvuga. Gnopernicus ikoresha ibi ahantu henshi: kumenya igihe inyandiko igomba kandi idakwiye guhagarikwa, kugirango imvugo ihuze neza, hamwe nijambo rikurikirana mumajwi atandukanye. Ibipimo byakozwe na Sun mu 2002 kuri Solaris byerekanaga ko FreeTTS yirutse inshuro ebyiri kugeza kuri eshatu kurusha Flite icyo gihe.
Kuva muri Kamena 2019, verisiyo nshya yuwo mushinga yatangiriye muri Mata 2017. Iterambere rikomeye ryarangiye muri Werurwe 2009 hasohoka 1.2.2.

Synthesizer ni tube resonance, cyangwa waveguide, icyitegererezo cyerekana imyitwarire yinzira nyayo yijwi ryeruye, kandi mu buryo bushyize mu gaciro, bitandukanye na synthesizeri ikora yerekana mu buryo butaziguye imvugo. Teletext ni serivisi yo gushakisha amakuru kuri tereviziyo yatejwe imbere mu Bwongereza mu ntangiriro ya za 70. Itanga urutonde rwamakuru ashingiye kumyandiko, mubisanzwe harimo amakuru yigihugu, mpuzamahanga na siporo, ikirere na gahunda za TV. Ibisobanuro (cyangwa gufunga ibisobanuro) amakuru nayo yoherezwa mubimenyetso bya teletext, mubisanzwe kurupapuro 888 cyangwa 777.
Serivisi zitari nke ziboneka kuri tereviziyo zatejwe imbere mu bindi bihugu, zimwe muri zo zagerageje gukemura imbogamizi za sisitemu yatejwe imbere n’Ubwongereza, hamwe n’ibishushanyo byoroheje hamwe n’ubunini bwa page.

Rero, mugihe "page yuzuye magnifier" ishingiye kumurongo wa fresnel irashobora kumara 625 cm (A4), mubisanzwe igera kuri 1.4x gukuza (byamamajwe nka "2x" iyo bipimye mukarere aho kuba igipimo); igice kinini cyikiganza kinini gishobora kugera kubintu birenze bibiri (agace karenze bane) ariko mubisanzwe bipima bitarenze 10 cm × 3 cm (3.9 in × 1.2 muri), kandi ibintu byinshi byo gukuza bisaba lens zisanzwe zibanda kumwanya muto cyane. Antiope yari igipimo cyitumanaho cyakoreshwaga mu gihugu cy'ubufaransa mumyaka ya za 1980. Yashizeho kandi ishingiro ryerekana ibipimo bikoreshwa muri serivisi ya videwo yubufaransa Minitel. Iri jambo ngo ryasobanuraga Acquisition Numérique et Télévisualisation d'Images Organisées en Pages d'Écriture, rishobora guhindurwa mu buryo bworoshye nka "Digital Acquisition hamwe no Kwerekana amashusho kure mu mashusho yanditse mu mpapuro zanditse".
Imirimo yo kurwanya Antiyopiya yatangiye mu 1972 muri CCETT, ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cy’igihugu cy’Ubufaransa gishya cyahujwe na televiziyo n’itumanaho yakoreraga i Rennes, hakaba harageragejwe iyi sisitemu kunshuro yayo yambere mu 1975. Sisitemu yatangijwe ku mugaragaro mu 1976 i Vidcom i Cannes, kandi icyarimwe mu imurikagurisha rya СПОРТ 76 ryaberaga Moscou. Yemejwe mu rwego mpuzamahanga CCIR 653 (ubu ni ITU-R BT.653) yo mu 1986 nka CCIR Teletext Sisitemu A.
kwamamaza ubucuruzi "bwa" Antiyopiya byatangiye kuri Antenne 2 mu TF1 na FR3 bombi batangiye no gutangaza Antiyopiya guhera mu ntangiriro ya za 1980. Kode ya Antiope yabanje gushyirwaho udusanduku twashyizwe hejuru na tereviziyo ya kabili ya SCART. Grundig ikorera mugihugu cy'ubufaransa bwatangiye kugurisha TV hamwe na decodeur ihuriweho kuva 1983, ikurikirwa nabandi bakora.
Antiope yari ishingiye kuri gride ya 40 × 25 ikoresheje ISO 646 na ISO 2022, ikaba kandi ifite uburyo bwo kwandika mu rwego rw'amajwi. Itandukaniro ryibanze muri filozofiya ya tekiniki hagati ya Antiyopiya na sisitemu ya terefegitura ya Ceefax yatunganijwe na BBC byaturutse ku kuba Antiope yatejwe imbere n’abashakashatsi mu itumanaho, naho Ceefax ikaba yarakozwe n’abashakashatsi ba televiziyo. Ba injeniyeri ba tereviziyo bakoze sisitemu yuzuza ecran amakuru ku gipimo cyagenwe, giteganijwe; bitandukanye na Antiyopiya yubatswe nka sisitemu yo guhinduranya paki, hamwe nuburebure bwimpapuro zamakuru, nkuko byakoreshwa kumurongo wa terefone.
Muri ibyo bihe byombi, amakuru ya tereviziyo yoherejwe mu gihe cyo guhagarikwa guhagaritse, igice cyagenwe kugirango urumuri rwa elegitoronike rugaruke ruva munsi ya ecran rusubira hejuru ya buri kintu cyerekana ishusho (gihuye nigihe cyo kohereza imirongo 25 muri buri gice cya PAL cyangwa SECAM), kandi buri murongo wakoresheje watangaga umubare uteganijwe wa byite buri cyiciro: 40 bytes kuri sisitemu yuburayi, 32 muri Amerika. Muri sisitemu ya BBC Ceefax buri tsinda rya 40 bytes ryahuye neza numurongo umwe winyuguti 40, buri byte igereranya imiterere numwanya wabyo kumurongo - sisitemu yo guhuza amashusho.

Yatwaye amakuru, amakuru yimari, ikirere, ibisubizo bya tombora, umuyobozi wa TV hamwe nandi makuru, hamwe no gufunga ibisobanuro kuri porogaramu.
Serivisiiboneke ku buntu kuri televiziyo iyariyo yose iyo ari yo yose, mudasobwa cyangwa ikindi gikoresho gifite televiziyo kandi ifite ubushobozi bwo kugera no kureba Umuyoboro wa karindwi, cyangwa kimwe mu bigo birindwi byo mu karere ka Prime, GWN cyangwa Cross Cross.
Abantu Barindwi batangiye kugerageza serivisi za Teletext mu mwaka wa 1979, batangira serivisi zisanzwe ku ya 4 Gashyantare 1980 amakuru yingirakamaro yatanzwe mu 1982 i Brisbane na Sydney. Austext yahagaritswe muri Nzeri
Mu myaka yambere wa Austext, hari serivisi ebyiri zitandukanye: 7-Inyandiko isohoka muri ATN muri Sydney hamwe na verisiyo itandukanye ya HSV-7 i Melbourne, no i Brisbane, SevenTel. Mu 1988, BTQ-7 yashinzwe umurimo wigihugu kandi yitwa Austext.
Amakuru aboneka akanandikwa kurupapuro rwa Austext yarimo amakuru agezweho yibanda kungingo zikurikira, ikirere, gusiganwa, inyungu rusange hamwe nuyobora televiziyo. Haraboneka kandi amakuru arambuye ya Austext hamwe namashyirahamwe yabatumva.
Ipaji yamakuru yarimo ibishya mubucuruzi, amakuru yigihugu, amakuru mpuzamahanga, siporo, siyanse n'ikoranabuhanga, na showbiz. Ipaji yikirere ikubiyemo umunsi umwe iteganya ubushyuhe bwumujyi, ubushyuhe bwumunsi umwe nubushyuhe ntarengwa / ntarengwa hamwe nubushyuhe buriho, ubushuhe, aho ikime, umuvuduko wumuyaga, icyerekezo cyumuyaga, izuba rirashe nigihe izuba rirenze, hamwe nicyerekezo cyiminsi itanu iri imbere kubigo bikomeye muri Ositaraliya byose byatanzwe na Biro yubumenyi bwikirere. Amapaji yo gusiganwa yarimo indangagaciro yo gusiganwa ku rwego rwigihugu TAB yahagaritse gukora ku ya 4 Kanama 2009.Urupapuro rusange rushimishije rwarimo ibintu nkibisubizo bya tombora, horoscopes ya buri munsi hamwe n urwenya rwumunsi. Iyi serivisi kandi yatwaye umurongo wa tereviziyo hamwe n’urutonde rw’urusobe rurindwi mu masoko atanu ya metero nkuru, ndetse no ku rutonde rw’indi miyoboro, haba mu mujyi ndetse no mu karere, kugeza mu 2007 igihe baburiwe irengero.
Muri Nyakanga 2009 abantu barindwi byatangaje ko Austext izahagarara ku Nzeri 2009. the seven bagaragaje ko haboneka ubundi buryo bwo gutanga amakuru ubu bugera kubareba nkurubuga rwa karindwi. Nubgo byafunzwe, serivise zanditse zifunze zakomeje kuboneka.

Infonet ni serivisi ikorerwa ku kicyo gisakaza akazash ya tereviziyo ya Maleziya. Yahoze yitwa Beriteks (ikomatanya ryijambo rya Malayika "Berita", risobanura "amakuru", na "Teks", ni ijambo ryatijwe mu rurimi rwicyongereza risobanura "inyandiko"). Sisitemu ya teletext yatangijwe mu ntangiriro za 1985 na TV3, mbere yo gutangira kumiyoboro ya RTM nyuma yumwaka. Serivisi yatangijwe yakoreshwaga na New Straits Times.
Mu gihe RTM1 na RTM2 bari bagikwirakwiza Teletext, ibiri mu itumanaho byari bitandukanye n'ibyatanzwe na serivisi ya TV3, na byo bikaba byaratanzwe ku izina rya "Beriteks". Ku bijyanye na RTM1 mu mwaka wa mbere, yatwaye amakuru ku biciro by'ibiribwa n'amakuru ku biryo no guhaha. Nkuko Beriteks itwarwa kuri RTM na TV3, bafatwa "nka serivisi" ntabwo ari amarushanwa, ndetse na siporo nkuko byagaragajwe hejuru kuyandi ma shene
RTM1 na RTM2 bahagaritse kohereza amashusho kuri televiziyo guhera mu 2000, kandi TV3 niyo televiziyo yonyine yo muri Maleziya yohereza Teletext. Nta sosiyete ya bashiki ba TV3, 8TV, TV9 na NTV7, itanga teletext.
Infonet yahagaritse gukora guhera ku ya 1 Mutarama 2008. Kubwibyo rero, ubu nta miyoboro ya televiziyo, icyigo gisakaza amashusho kuburyo bwa sitasiyo bitanga Teletext muri Maleziya.
Infonet ikoresha sisitemu ya televiziyo ya BBC Ceefax.

A spacer ni igikoresho gikoreshwa mu kongera ubworoherane bwo gutanga imiti ya aerosolize ivuye mu gipimo cya metero ihagije (MDI). Yongera umwanya muburyo bw'urusobe cyangwa "chambre" hagati y'akanwa n'ikigega cy'umuti. Ibyogajuru byinshi bifite valve y'inzira imwe ituma umuntu ahumeka imiti mugihe ahumeka kandi asohora bisanzwe; ibi bikunze kuvugwa amacupa afata umuti afite agasanduku kagenzura umwuka (VHC).
Amazina menshi y'ikirango arahari harimo AeroChamber, InspirEase na Volumatic. Birashobora kandi gukorwa mumacupa ya plastike 500 mL, nayo ikora neza.
Icyogajuru gifasha abadashoboye guhumeka cyane, kimwe n'abadashoboye guhuza umwuka wabo kuburyo bahumeka nkuko MDI ikora; ibi bizwi nko kudahuza neza gukoresha intoki n'umwuka w'ibihaha.
Ijambo spacer rikoreshwa kenshi kugirango ryerekane igikoresho icyo aricyo cyose kimeze nka MDI yongeyeho. Ibyogajuru bimwe (urugero, InspirEase) bifashisha igishushanyo mbonera cyaguye kugirango batange ibitekerezo byerekana ko guhumeka bigenda neza. Ubundi bwoko (urugero, Volumatike) ni plastike ibonerana mubice bibiri bisa na vase bihurira hamwe bikora ishusho ya barriel. Ibyumba bifata ibyumba (VHC) bakunze kwita "icyogajuru" kimwe.
Gukoresha akuma gafasha gufata umuti mu bihaha binyuze mu guhumeka" inhaler" kadafite spacer bisaba guhuza ibikorwa byinshi muburyo bwateganijwe (gukanda hasi kumuhumekero, guhumeka cyane imiti ikimara gusohoka, ufashe umwuka wawe, uhumeka), kandi ntabwo abantu bose bashoboye kumenya uru rutonde. Gukoresha icyogajuru, cyane cyane icyuma gifata icyumba, kirinda ibibazo nkibi. Ibyumba bifata ibyumba bifite akamaro kanini kubana, abantu bafite umwuka mucye, nabafite ubumuga bwo kutamenya, mu bwenge cyangwa mu mitekerereze. [3]
Nyuma yo gukuraho ingofero ya MDI, umunwa wa MDI winjijwe inyuma yumwanya. Igice cyimbere cyicyumba gifunzwe numunwa cyangwa mask itwikira umunwa nizuru. Gutanga imiti, MDI yihebye rimwe, bikavamo irekurwa ryimiti imwe. Imiti ivuye muri MDI noneho ihagarikwa mucyumba cya spacer mugihe umuntu ahumeka imiti ya aerosolize ahumeka no hanze. Umwuka uhumeka usohoka mugikoresho unyuze mumatara aho kwinjira mucyumba. Ibyogajuru bimwe bifite ifirimbi, byumvikana niba umuntu arimo guhumeka vuba.
Spacers itinda umuvuduko wa aerosol ituruka kumuhumekero, bivuze ko bike mubiyobyabwenge bya asima bigira ingaruka kumunwa kandi nibindi byinshi bishobora kwinjira mubihaha. Kubijyanye na corticosteroide, ibisigara bike mumunwa bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara candidiasis yo mu kanwa, kwandura umusemburo. Kwoza umunwa nyuma yo gushiramo steroide ihumeka bigira ingaruka zisa.
Mugihe abantu barwaye asima bashobora gukomeza MDI hafi igihe cyose, ubwinshi bwibyogajuru bushobora kugabanya imikoreshereze yabyo hanze yurugo. Ubushakashatsi bumwe bwerekana ko ibyogajuru byakorewe mu rugo, ukoresheje amacupa ya pulasitike, bishobora kuba byiza nkibikorwa byubucuruzi, ariko ibyakozwe murugo bishobora kugira byinshi bihinduka.

JTES, Ubuyapani bwa Teletext Ibisobanuro, ni protocole ikoreshwa mugushiraho mu guhindura urupapuro muri sisitemu ya Teletext, kimwe nubundi bwoko bwamakuru ya digitale, mugihe cyahagaritse intera (VBI) yerekana ibimenyetso byerekana amashusho mubuyapani. Yemejwe mu rwego mpuzamahanga CCIR 653 (ubu ITU-R BT.653) yo mu 1986 nka CCIR Teletext Sisitemu D.
Ifasha kwerekana imiterere ya Kanji, Katakana na Hiragana. Serivisi ishobora gukoreshwa kugirango yerekane subtitles, cyclicale page cyangwa progaramu ya pseudo. ikaba ifite n'uburyo bwo kwerekana amafoto, geometrie cyangwa amajwi.
Iterambere rya tereviziyo mu gihugu cyu Buyapani ryatangiye mu 1972, hakurikiraho itangazwa rya sisitemu ya mbere y’itumanaho ku isi (Ceefax) na BBC mu Bwongereza.
Kubera ko inyuguti z'Abayapani zitandukanye cyane n’inyuguti zo mu Burengerazuba, Ubuyapani bwakomeje gukora ubushakashatsi no gucukumbure mu buryo bwo guteza imbere uburyo bwihariye bwo kohereza bwitwa "uburyo bw'icyitegererezo", bwohereza ibimenyetso byo gusikana bisa na fax, ku kigero cyikubye inshuro 20 kurenza uburyo buriho, ariko bisaba generator y'inyuguti ifite nini (icyo gihe) 1- megabit ROM. Ubu buryo bwakoreshejwe mu 1982.
Mubimenyetso bisanzwe bya NTSC, hariho imirongo 525 yo gusikana ibimenyetso byo muburyo bw'amashusho. Ibi bigabanijwemo kabiri amashusho, azwi nka " imirima ", yoherejwe buri 60th yisegonda. Aya mashusho ahuza kuri ecran cyangwa se akaranga mashusho, no mumaso, kugirango akore ikadiri imwe ya videwo ivugururwa buri 30 ya segonda. Buri murongo wa buri murima ufata 63.5 μs kohereza; 50.3 μs za videwo na 13.2 μs zingana n "igihe cyapfuye" kuri buri mpera yakoreshejwe mu kwerekana televiziyo ko umurongo wuzuye, uzwi nka intera itambitse (HBI). Iyo gahunda yo gusikana igeze kumpera ya ecran isubira hejuru mugihe cyahagaritse intera ihagaritse (VBI), nka, HBI isaba "igihe cyapfuye" kugirango ikore neza ibimenyetso kuri ecran. Muri iki kibazo, igihe cyapfuye kigaragazwa nimirongo idakoreshwa yikimenyetso cyamashusho, mubisanzwe imirongo 22 yambere yikadiri.
JTES ikubiyemo amakuru mubimenyetso byo muburyo bw'amashusho nkurukurikirane rw'ududomo ku gipimo cyagenwe cya 5.727272 Mbit / s. Buri murongo wumurima ufite 50.3 μs yumwanya wa amashusho ushobora gukoreshwa mugukwirakwiza, bivamo 296 bits kumurongo.
Bishoboka guhindura inyuguti zashyizweho (JIS C 6226 Yinganda zubuyapani, ikubiyemo inyuguti 6879 zishushanyije zikwiye kwandika inyandiko, amazina y’ahantu, amazina bwite, nibindi mu rurimi rwikiyapani, byasobanuwe mu 1978), kugirango ugaragaze inyuguti zikwiye cyangwa uzamura uburyo bwo kohereza. Niba inyuguti itaboneka muri Teletext yakira imashini itanga imashini, irashobora gushirwaho ukoresheje "DRCS" (Dynamically Redefinable Character Sets).
Inyuguti zishobora kwanduzwa nka mozayike yibintu bya semigraphic, hamwe na buri kintu gifite imiterere ya 8 × 12 pigiseli.

IBOT ni igare rifite moteri rifasha umuntu ufite ubumuga kugenda rikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya giroskopi (gyroscopic) kugirango rigende neza ku butaka butandukanye imbere munzu no hanze.
Ubu buryo, iBOT® PMD, bwakozwe na Mobius Mobility kuva muri 2019.Iki gikoresho cyakozwe na DEKA Research &amp;amp; Development Corp. ya Dean Kamen ku bufatanye n’ishami ry’ubwigenge bwa Johnson &amp;amp; Johnson. Impapuro zambere zakozwe na Technology Technology yigenga kuva 2003 kugeza 2009.
IBOT ikoresha tekinoroji ya giroskopi hamwe ninziga enye zikoresha moteri hamwe ninziga ebyiri za caster kugirango zitange uburyo butandukanye bwo gutwara. Muburyo bwibiziga 4, ifite ibiziga bine gusa byo gutwara hasi, bikabasha gukora ahantu h'inyuma nka curbs, umucanga, na urubura. ikoreshwa mu buryobusanzwe nka kagare afite moteri, ifite ibiziga bibiri b'imodoka hiyongereyeho ibiziga bya caster hasi, kandi ikora nk'ibisanzwe bisanzwe by'imodoka y'inyuma yimodoka.
Ubundi buryo burimo kuringaniza uburyo, buzamura umukoresha kurwego rwamaso murwego rwo kuringaniza ibiziga bibiri byimodoka, hamwe nuburyo bwintambwe, bufasha umukoresha watojwe kuzamuka no kumanuka.
Iterambere rya iBOT ryatangiye mu 1990 muri DEKA Ubushakashatsi &amp; Iterambere i Manchester, NH. Prototype ya mbere ikora yaboneka mu 1992,: 21 no muri 1994, DEKA yasinyanye amasezerano na Johnson &amp;amp; Johnson yo gukora icyo gikoresho.
IBOT yahishuriwe rubanda kuri Dateline NBC mu gice na John Hockenberry ku ya 30 Kamena 1999.: 53 Kugeza ubu, Johnson &amp; Johnson yari amaze gukoresha miliyoni 50 US $ muri uyu mushinga.: 48 Ku gitaramo cya Art Bell 's Coast to Coast AM show (16 Werurwe 2001) umunyamakuru w’iperereza Robert Steensen yaganiriye ku gihangano cya Dean Kamen, "Umushinga Ginger" cyangwa "It", nyuma uza gusohoka nka iBOT na The Segway. IBOT yahanaguwe na FDA nk'igikoresho cyo mu cyiciro cya III ku ya 13 Kanama 2003.
Segway PT, igikoresho kitari ubuvuzi, yahagaritswe mugihe cyo guteza imbere ibicuruzwa bya iBOT, ikoresha ikoranabuhanga ryibanze. Mugihe cyiterambere, iBOT yitwaga Fred, mugufi kuri Fred Upstairs, igihano kuri Fred Astaire, mugihe Segway yitwaga Ginger, nyuma yumubyiniro wa Fred Astaire Ginger Rogers.: 27 Segway PT yarekuwe mu 2001.: 20-30
iBOT 3000 na iBOT 4000.
Johnson &amp; Johnson bashizeho Ikoranabuhanga ryigenga kugirango bazane iBOT ku isoko. Umwimerere wa iBOT 3000 winjiye mu 2003, usimburwa na iBOT 4000 mu 2005.
Bitewe na FDA yashyizwe mu byiciro, iBOT 3000 na iBOT 4000 ntibishobora kugira icyo bihindura ku bicaye cyangwa ku bagenzuzi, bivuze ko bidashobora guhindurwa ku bakoresha ku giti cyabo. Byongeye kandi, ubwishingizi bwari buke kuri ibyo bikoresho, byagurishijwe $ 25.000- $ 28,000. Haragurishijwe ibice 500 gusa, Johnson &amp; Johnson bahagarika umusaruro mu
Mu mpera za 2014, Kamen yatangaje ko FDA yashyize mu majwi iBOT kuva mu cyiciro cya III ikajya mu cyiciro cy’ubuvuzi cya kabiri. Uku kugabanya kugenzura kugenzura kwemerera DEKA kubyutsa iBOT isinziriye no gutangira iterambere kubicuruzwa bizaza.
Muri 2019, igisekuru kizaza iBOT PMD (Igikoresho cyumuntu ku giti cye) cyasohowe ku isoko na Mobius Mobility i Manchester, NH.
FDA yahaye iBOT PMD byombi IMK (Intebe Yabamugaye, Kuzamuka kuntambwe) hamwe na ITI (Intebe yimuga, ikora).

iansyst Ltd ni sosiyete itanga ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga bifasha abantu, itanga ibicuruzwa na serivisi bigamije gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga butandukanye nka: dyslexia, ubumuga bwo kutabona, dyscalculia, ihuzabikorwa ryiterambere ryiterambere, Gukomeretsa inshuro nyinshi.
Isosiyete yashinzwe i Londres mu ntangiriro za 1983 na Ian Litterick, byumwihariko bigamije gutanga porogaramu zo guhugura no kwigisha.
Kugeza mu 1995, ubu ubarizwa i Cambridge, Iansyst yakwirakwizaga inyandiko ya monologue kuri porogaramu ya Speech Synthesis, yabonaga ko ari ingirakamaro ku bantu barwaye dyslexia.
Mu 1996, iansyst yagize uruhare mu rwego rwa DSA-QAG (Itsinda ry’ubwishingizi bw’abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bw’abamugaye), ndetse no gutanga isoko ry’ikoranabuhanga rifasha n’amahugurwa ku banyeshuri bahawe igihembo cy’abanyeshuri bamugaye (DSA). Uwashinze, Ian Litterick yabaye umunyamuryango ukomeye mu burenganzira bwo gusoma yatangijwe mu 2002.
Muri 2009/2010 iansyst yafatanije na XMA gutanga gahunda yo kugera murugo muri leta kugirango itange abana bafite ubumuga bukomeye cyangwa ibikenewe by’uburezi bwihariye, bw’imiryango ikennye hamwe na Home Access ya mudasobwa, kwinjira kuri interineti n’ikoranabuhanga rifasha. Ubufatanye hagati ya iansyst n'inzobere mu burezi XMA bwamenyekanye ubwo batsindaga igihembo cyo Gukorera hamwe muri 2012 muri Technology4Good. Ibi bihembo bidasanzwe byateguwe na AbilityNet na BT kandi yahuza hamwe amashyirahamwe n'ibikorwa by'ubugiraneza nibigo bitandukanye by'ubucuruzi, ibikorwa byabo bigafasha abantu kunoza cyangwa kuzamura imibereho yabo binyuze mu ikoreshwa ry'ikoranabuhanga IT.
Mu ntangiriro za 2012 iansyst yahawe inkunga na Jisc TechDis binyuze mu marushanwa yo mu kibaya cyo mu kibaya cyo guteza imbere MyDocStore. Ibi byakozwe ku bufatanye n’ihuriro ry’imiryango iyobowe na iansyst: barimo Software ya Raspberry na ECS - Electronics na Computer Science yo muri kaminuza ya Southampton. Intego ya MyDocStore nugukora byihuse kandi byoroshye kohereza dosiye hagati yibikoresho mugihe icyarimwe kubihindura muburyo bworoshye kubakoresha; ni ukuvuga inyandiko kumajwi, inyandiko kumiterere nini no guhuza byombi. Muri 2013 umushinga watangijwe nka serivise y'urubuga azzapt.
Umuyobozi mukuru, Ian Litterick ni umunyamuryango washinze ishyirahamwe ry’abafasha mu ikoranabuhanga rya BATA mu Bwongereza. BATA yiyamamariza uburenganzira ninyungu zabakeneye ikoranabuhanga rifasha.
Umuyobozi mukuru, Janine King ayoboye inkunga ya iansyst nkabagize ihuriro ry’abafite ubumuga mu bucuruzi (BDF).

TrackR yari igikoresho cyo gushakisha imfunguzo cyakoreshwaga mu bucuruzi, cyafashaga mu gukurikirana ibintu n'ibikoresho byatakaye. Trackr yakorwaga na sosiyete yitwa Phone Halo kandi yatewe inkunga nabashinze gutakaza imfunguzo zabo ku mucanga mugihe cyurugendo rwo kwiruka.
Abashinze Terefone Halo batangiye gukora kuri TrackR mu 2009. Mu 2010, bashinze icyo kigo cyangwa isosiyete kandi bashyira ku isoko icyo gicuruzwa. Mu gihe cy'itumba 2018, TrackR yongeye kwisubiraho muri Adero, mu rwego rwo guhindura icyerekezo cyayo ku bindi bikoreshwa mu ikoranabuhanga ryayo ryo gukurikirana, ifata TrackR irenze fobs ya Bluetooth yari ishingiro rya serivisi zayo. serivisi zayo ikuraho porogaramu zayo muri Kanama 2021.
Igikoresho kirimo bateri ya lithium igomba guhinduka nka rimwe mu mwaka nuyikoresha. Iramenyesha aho iri ubu ikoresheje Bluetooth 4.0, kuri Android 4.4+ cyangwa iOS 8.0+ igikoresho kigendanwa porogaramu ya TrackR yashyizwemo kandi ikora. Iyi mikorere yitwa "Imbaga y'abantu", kubera ko buri gikoresho kizamenyesha aho giherereye ku bindi bikoresho byose bya TrackR biri mu ntera, harimo n'ibidafite cyangwa byanditswe n'umukoresha. Iyi mikorere ni ingirakamaro kuko porogaramu igomba gushyirwaho kandi igakorera ku gikoresho cyegereye Bluetooth cyegereye aho igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora gutangwa.
Kugeza muri Kanama 2017, ibikoresho birenga miliyoni 5 bya TrackR byari bimaze kugurishwa.
Kuva muri Kanama 2021, urubuga rwemewe rwavuze ko uruganda rwahagaritse inkunga ya App ku bikoresho bya Apple na Android.

WordQ® ni porogaramu ifasha ikoranabuhanga yateguwe na Quillsoft Ltd hamwe n’ibitaro bya Holland Bloorview Kids Rehabilitation Hospital. Intego nyamukuru ya WordQ ni ugufasha abantu bahanganye nogusoma no kwandika ndetse ikanafasha abafite ubumuga butandukanye. Akenshi urwo rugamba ruterwa n'ubumuga bw'umubiri cyangwa neurodivergence nka Dyslexia cyangwa ADHD. WordQ ikoresha ijambo ryubwenge guhanura kugirango yerekane amagambo umukoresha yandika muri buke 1.3. Ibi bifasha imyandikire, kandi bikana gabanya ingano yimikorere yumubiri umukoresha agomba gukora mugihe yandika. Ikoresha kandi ubuziranenge bwa Acapela inyandiko ndetse n'amajwi kugirango asome inyandiko yinyuma uyikoresha yinjiye, yemerera kugenzura no guhindura. Ikiranga imvugo ya WordQs, SpeakQ®, yashyizwe muri desktop ya WordQ ya Windows OS. Iyemerera abakoresha guhinduranya kuvuga no kwandika mugihe wandika. Ibiro bya WordQ biraboneka kuri Windows na Mac OS, iWordQ iraboneka kuri iPadOS, naho WordQ Chrome ya mushakisha ya Chrome iteganijwe gusohoka muri Mutarama 2022.
WordQ yatunganijwe bwa mbere mu mpera z'imyaka ya za 90 n'itsinda ry'ubushakashatsi riyobowe na Dr. Fraser Shein mu bitaro bya Holland Bloorview Kids Rehabilitation Hospital Toronto, Ontario, Kanada. Shein n'ibitaro bashinze isosiyete ifatanije, yitwa Quillsoft Ltd, kugira ngo bamenyekanishe WordQ ndetse no gushyigikira ubushakashatsi bwakorewe mu bitaro. Iterambere rya WordQ ryakurikiranye ibicuruzwa bya software byabanje kandi byatejwe imbere muri Holland Bloorview, KeyREP® na WiVox®, ibi byari ibikoresho byo gufasha abanyeshuri bafite ibibazo byo kwandika ndetse nubundi bumuga butandukanye. Porogaramu n'imikorere ya WordQ yarishyuwe kugirango bifashe abafite ikibazo cyo kwandika biturutse ku bumuga bwo kwiga kandi bagakoreshwa murwego runini mumashuri ya Ontario. Imikoreshereze yiyo sisitemu noneho yagutse cyane mumashuri yo mugihugu cya Kanada nahandi kwisi nyuma yiterambere, kuko itsinda kandi rikubiyemo SpeakQ na ThoughtQ®. Ikoranabuhanga rya SpeakQ ryakozwe ku bufatanye n’ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’uburezi (Newton, MA) ku nkunga ya Minisiteri y’uburezi muri Amerika. Muri iki gihe, WordQ ikoreshwa n’abaturage benshi b’abanyeshuri, ntabwo ari abafite ibibazo byo kwiga gusa, urugero, abiga ururimi rwa kabiri hamwe n’abanyeshuri hamwe n’abakozi.
WordQ ifite idirishya ritoya rigaragara hejuru yidirishya iryo ariryo ryose rikorwa kandi rikora hamwe na porogaramu iyo ari yo yose ukoresha. Nka tekinoroji ifasha, ibi byitwa transparent accessibility. Nkuko umukoresha wa sisitemu yandika, software igerageza kwerekana ijambo rikoreshwa, ukurikije inyuguti zambere namagambo yanditse mbere yukoresha. Nkuko bandika, uyikoresha ashobora gukoresha urufunguzo rwerekezo cyangwa urufunguzo rwumubare kugirango uhitemo ijambo wifuza. Umukoresha ashobora kandi gusaba porogaramu gusoma amajwi yabo yanditse mu ijwi riranguruye nkuko bandika, bigatuma impinduka zimyandikire nimbonezamvugo zifatwa mugihe wandika. Porogaramu irashobora gufungura no kuzimya uyikoresha nkuko bandika, kandi ikorana na progaramu zose zikoreshwa. WordQ kuri ubu irashobora gukoreshwa mucyongereza, Igifaransa, Icyesipanyoli &amp; Ikidage.
Ikoreshwa rya SpeakQ.
WordQ ikoreshwa mumashuri menshi muri Amerika na Kanada kugirango ifashe abantu bafite ubumuga butandukanye. imyaka myinshi igurishwa muri Kanada, ariko itangiye kugaragara ku isoko ry’Amerika. Muri Kanada, amashuri menshi yarayakoresheje kugirango akoreshwe muri sisitemu zabo. Mu mwaka wa 2010, OSAPAC, umuryango ushinzwe kugura software ku mashuri yo muri Ontario, yaguze uruhushya rwo gukoresha WordQ mu mashuri yose yo mu ntara yose. Porogaramu yakoreshejwe cyane cyane nkigikoresho cyabanditsi bahanganye nabafite ubumuga bwo kwiga bibabaza ubushobozi bwabo bwo kwandika. Ubushakashatsi bw’abandi bantu bwerekana ko WordQ nayo ikora, niba atari nziza, kuruta izindi software zisa nazo mu gufasha aba banditsi bahanganye. Ubundi bushakashatsi bwigenga bwerekana ko WordQ yo guhanura ijambo hamwe nubushobozi bwo kwandika-kuvuga bishobora kugira ingaruka nziza kubuhanga bwo kwandika bwabanyeshuri bo mumashuri abanza bafite ubumuga bwihariye bwo kwiga.

Harrington Hump ni modular, yoroshye-kwishyiriraho uburyo uburebure bwa gari ya moshi bushobora kwiyongera ku giciro gito. Sisitemu yakuye izina ryayo muri gari ya moshi ya Harrington i Cumbria, mu Bwongereza, akaba ari naho hambere hambere hambere. Kuva mu 2011, Harrington Humps yashyizwe buhoro buhoro ku zindi gariyamoshi zo mu Bwongereza n'ahandi.
Uburebure bwa platifomu mu Bwongereza bwa gari ya moshi ntabwo busanzwe kuko, mugihe cyo kubaka umuyoboro, amasosiyete atandukanye ya gari ya moshi yatuye ahantu hirengeye. Amahuriro yicaye hasi (ugereranije nurwego rwa gari ya moshi) yerekana ibibazo byinjira nogusohoka kubagenzi bafite ubumuga bwimodoka, harimo nabakoresha amagare. Kuzamura urwego rwuzuye rwuzuye rwa platiforme birahenze cyane kandi mu bihe byinshi birarenze ubushobozi bwa gari ya moshi (Network Nail) n'inzego z'ibanze.
Bivugwa ko icyateye iyi mpanuka,cyari umusozo w'ikiraro, bivugwa n’umuyobozi w’itsinda ry’abakoresha gari ya moshi ya Copeland rivuga ko urubuga ruto ku murongo wa Cumbrian Coast rwateje abakoresha ikibazo cyo kwinjira no kuva muri gari ya moshi, rwakorewe mu itsinda ry’abajyanama b’ubwikorezi bw’akarere ka Allerdale, komite ishinzwe komite y’akarere ka Cumbria. Icyifuzo cyo kuzamura igice cyamahuriro cyatanzwe kugirango paruwasi ya gari ya moshi ivuga ko imirimo yo gukosora izatwara "imibare itandatu" kuri sitasiyo.
Harrington Hump nigisubizo cyigice cyikibazo kimaze igihe kinini cyo kubona abakoresha gari ya moshi ziva kumurongo ugereranije.]Ishobora gushushanywa ku buryo buhuza n'ibipimo by'ubugari n'uburebure by'ikibuga runaka kandiika ikashobora gushyirwaho mu minsi mike. Gushiraho Harrington Hump bihendutse cyane kuruta kuzamura uburebure bwose bwa platifomu - kugeza kuri 1/10 cyibiciro bisanzwe £ 250.000.
Hump yateguwe na Network Rail Railway hamwe ninama Njyanama yintara ya Cumbria, ifatanije na Pipex Structural Composites, bwa mbere kuri gari ya moshi ya Harrington mu Kuboza 2008. Ubundi bizwi nka "Byoroshye Kubona Ahantu", Umuhanda wa gari ya moshi wemeje ko iyi nyubako izamenyekana guhera ubu ku izina ryayo, "Harrington Hump".
Hump ihagaze kugirango ihuze numuryango runaka muri gari ya moshi, mubisanzwe imwe yagenewe kwinjira mu kagare. Kubera iyo mpamvu, Hump ntabwo ikwiranye na platifomu ikorerwa muburyo butandukanye bwa gari ya moshi, nko kuri gari ya moshi ya Dalton, aho inzugi z’ibimuga z’ibimuga ziba ziri ahantu hatandukanye kuri gari ya moshi zitandukanye.
Hump ya kabiri yashyizwe kuri gari ya moshi ya St Albans Abbey naho iya gatatu kuri gari ya moshi ya Aberdovey. Izindi sitasiyo zakira Humps zirimo Northwich, Flixton, Bridge ya Whaley, Umubwiriza, Kents Bank na Hadfield.
Sisitemu ya Hump yatsindiye igihembo cyo gutanga serivisi kubakiriya muri 2009 "abakozi ba leta batandukanye nuburinganire".
Muri Gashyantare 2019, hashyizweho Hump kuri gari ya moshi ya Marsden i West Yorkshire, izakemura ikibazo cya 45 cm kumanuka uva muri gari ya moshi ujya kuri platifomu

Mwandikisho isanzwe ni software ikora yemerera kwinjiza inyuguti bidakenewe urufunguzo rw'umubiri. Imikoranire na clavier y'ububiko ibaho ahanini ikoresheje interineti ikoraho, ariko irashobora no kubaho muburyo butandukanye mugihe mubyukuri cyangwa byongerewe ukuri.
Kuri mudasobwa ya desktop, clavier isanzwe ishobora gutanga ubundi buryo bwo kwinjiza kubakoresha cyangwa kubabana n' ubumuga butandukanye badashobora gukoresha clavier isanzwe, kubakoresha indimi nyinshi bahinduranya kenshi hagati yinyuguti zitandukanye cyangwa inyuguti zitandukanye, zishobora kuba urujijo mugihe, cyangwa kubakoresha badafite clavier gakondo.
Mwandikisho ya Virtual irashobora gukoresha ibi bikurikira:
Ibikoresho bigendanwa.
Virtual Keyboards isanzwe ikoreshwa nkuburyo bwo kwinjiza cyangwa kwandika inyuguti zijya muri ecran mubikoresho bidafite clavier y'umubiri aho nta mwanya uhari, nka mudasobwa yo mu mufuka, umufasha wa digitale (PDA), mudasobwa ya tablet, cyangwa ecran ya terefone igendanwa. Inyandiko isanzwe yinjizwamo haba mukanda clavier ya virtual cyangwa kurutoki. Mwandikisho ya Virtual nayo igaragara muri software yigana sisitemu ifite buto nkeya ugereranije na mudasobwa yaba ifite.
Sisitemu ikora cyane igendanwa, Android na iOS, iha umuryango wabatezimbere amahirwe yo gutezimbere kugiti cyawe cyihariye.
Virtual Keyboards ishobora gukoreshwa mubihe bimwe na bimwe kugirango ugabanye ibyago byo kwinjirira urufunguzo. Kurugero, serivisi ya banki ya interineti ya Westpac ikoresha clavier yuburyo bwo kwinjiza ijambo ryibanga, kimwe na TreasuryDirect (reba ishusho). Biragoye cyane kuri malware gukurikirana ibyerekanwa nimbeba kugirango ubone amakuru yinjiye ukoresheje clavier yububiko kuruta uko ukurikirana urufunguzo nyarwo. Ariko, birashoboka, kurugero mukwandika amashusho mugihe gito cyangwa kuri buri kanda.

TecAccess ni isosiyete y'Abanyamerika iherereye i Rockville, muri Virijiniya, ishushanya ibikoresho byo kwiga kumurongo hamwe nurubuga rwabafite ubumuga. Isosiyete itanga serivisi zubujyanama, guteza imbere software, kugerageza no gusuzuma, amahugurwa, kugenzura, kwemeza, no gusuzuma politiki. Yibanze ku gice cya 508 kubahiriza no kugera kuri IT kumiryango ya leta n’abikorera.
Mu 2001, Debra Ruh yashinze ikigo cya TecAccess (izwi kandi nka Strategic Performance Solutions). Ubucuruzi bwateye imbere nyuma y’ingingo ya 508 y’ivugururwa ry’itegeko ryita ku buzima busanzwe ryo mu 1998, ryatangiye gukurikizwa ku ya 21 Kamena 2001, risaba ko ababana n’ubumuga bafite itumanaho ryoroshye, imbuga za interineti, ndetse n’ibikoresho bya mudasobwa.
TecAccess yahawe akazi muri 2003 na Canon kugirango fotokopi igere kubantu badashobora gukoresha amaboko cyangwa bafite ikibazo cy'ubumuga bwo kutabona; bahimbye uburyo bwo kumenyekanisha amajwi murukurikirane rwa ImageRunner.
