A footmouse (cyangwa imbeba y'ibirenge) ni ubwoko bw'imbeba (mouse) ya mudasobwa ibi bituma abakoresha babasha kwimura umurongo w'inkomoko (cursor) nogukanda ku ma button y'imbeba (mouse) bakoresheje amaguru yabo.
Ikoreshwa cyane cyane nabakoresha ubumuga cyangwa bafite ibibazo byinyuma-mugongo cyangwa ijosi. Itezwa imbere kandi nkuburyo bwo gukumira ibibazo nkibi mu gihe kizaza kandi nkuburyo bwo kongera umusaruro utagomba kwimura ukuboko hagati ya clavier n'imbeba.
Hariho ubwoko icumi bw'ibirenge. Ntabwo bose baboneka mubucuruzi. Ibigo bimwe byihariye bishushanya imbeba yabyo igenzura kubantu bamugaye.
Itandukaniro nyamukuru hagati yu bwoko butandukanye bw ikirenge ni pedal iringaniye iranyerera cyangwa pedal ihengamye. Hariho kandi adaptate y'imbeba ihindura imbeba isanzwe mu kirenge cyanyerera kandi gitambitse kuruhande rumwe. Ikirenge gikoresha kunyerera kirashobora kunyerera hamwe nimbeba ihujwe nayo, cyangwa ikadiri idasanzwe aho pedal ishobora kuzenguruka. Na magneti ntoya cyangwa ikindi gikoresho gishobora gukoreshwa kuri tablet. a footmouse ikoreshwa n'ikirenge ikoresha pedal, zishobora kugoreka no guhindukirira ishobora kunyeganyega cyangwa kugororoka mu cyerekezo kimwe cyangwa byinshi.Udupine dushyirwaho igitutu n’ikirenge ntidufatwa nka footmouse.
Gukoresha ibirenge byihuta kuruta imbeba isanzwe (intoki), kubera ko abantu benshi badafite ubushobozi buke bwo kugenda neza nibirenge n'amaguru kuruta kubiganza byabo..​​​
Niba ikirenge cyakoreshejwe hamwe na clavier, indanga irashobora kwimurwa mugihe wandika, ntamwanya rero wataye wo kwimura ikiganza hagati ya clavier nimbeba. Niba umuntu adashobora gukoresha clavier, clavier isanzwe kuri ecran irashobora gukoreshwa mukwandika inyandiko ukanze buri nyuguti kuri clavier ya virtual. Abantu nabo badafite ubushobozi buke kubirenge byabo no kuguru kandi badashobora gukora ibirenge birashobora rimwe na rimwe gukoresha ibintu bike kugirango bashireho indanga mu cyerekezo runaka.
Niba ikirenge cyakoreshejwe nabi igihe kirekire, kirashobora gutera imitsi amaguru, kandi gishobora kugira ingaruka mbi kubibazo byo hepfo. ["kubera iki?"]

Tactile nigikoresho nyacyo cyo guhindura inyandiko kuri braille ubu irimo gutezwa imbere mu kigo cy’ikoranabuhanga cya Massachusetts. Yatekerejwe nitsinda ryabanyeshuri bishyize hamwe barangije icyiciro cya mbere, bahatana nka "Team 100% Enthusiasm", mugihe cyamasaha 15 MIT "hackathon". Tactile ifite umubiri unyerera hejuru yinyandiko yanditse kandi kamera ifata amashusho yamagambo ikayohereza kuri microcontroller. Amakuru yimura pin hejuru no hepfo, ahindura inyandiko muri Braille. Iyo bigeze ku isoko twizeye ko bihendutse cyane kuruta ibikoresho bihari.

Ubufatanye bufatika mu bumenyi bwa siyansi, ubukanishi n’amashanyarazi, na siyanse ya mudasobwa, Tactile yakunzwe cyane n’itangazamakuru [wihuse w’iterambere, ndetse n’abayihimbye bose bakaba ari abagore bo mu mirima ya STEM bafite umubare muto w’abagore bahagarariye.
Tactile itanga ibisobanuro nyabyo byumwandiko biri mururimi r wicyongereza, byafashwe na kamera ihuriweho, muri braille ihindagurika kuburyo bugaragara. Igicuruzwa cyanyuma nukwerekana inyuguti 36 za braille icyarimwe kuri Imigaragarire [icyitonderwa 1] hamwe nigiciro cyagenewe kugurishwa hafi US $ 100. Hamwe nibikoresho bisanzwe byerekana braille bigurwa hagati y $ 1.500 kugeza $ 2,500, Tactile yaranzwe nk "" kwaduka kwinshi imbere y’abatabona. "

Serivisi ya STS ni serivisi yo kuvuga imvugo itanga serivisi kubantu bose bahamagara kuri terefone cyangwa abahamagaye bafite ubumuga bwo kutavuga ndetse nabashaka kuvugana nabo.
"STS Relay" iboneka binyuze kuri 711 muri Amerika binyuze muri Serivisi ishinzwe Itumanaho; muguhamagara kuri terefone, banza uhamagare 711, hanyuma ubaze STS. Umufasha witumanaho wamenyerejwe azakubaza numero ushaka guhamagara. uwakwakiriye azasubiramo ibyo umuhamagaye ufite ubumuga bwo kutavuga. Umuhamagaye ashobora gusubiza. Umufasha witumanaho "azasubiramo" ubutumwa bwumuhamagaye. Hamagara noneho yitaba muri ubu buryo butatu bwafashijwe kuganira kuri terefone.
Serivisi iboneka mu gihugu cya Ositaraliya, na Suwede, no mu bindi bihugu hashingiwe ku igeragezwa. STS Itanga kuri PSTN (umuyoboro wa terefone uhinduranya rubanda) irahari kubakeneye ubufasha bwo guhamagara kuri terefone kubera ubumuga bwo kutavuga.
STS Relay yabonetse bwa mbere muri Amerika muri Californiya, mu 1997; serivisi yabonetse ku rwego rw'igihugu ku ya 1 Werurwe 2001.
Ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2006, kaminuza ya Wisconsin - Madison yahaye Robert Z. Segalman, impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (UW 1972), impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'icyubahiro kubera umurimo yakoze mu guhanga Speech To Speech.

Isosiyete ifite icyicaro i Santa Fe, muri New Mexico. Yashinzwe mu 1993 na Patrick Markle, Geoff Webb, na Ron Erkman kandi ni yo sosiyete ya mbere yatanze ikoranabuhanga ryifashisha rituma abantu ku giti cyabo, icyarimwe, bavuga indimi nyinshi ndetse no gusoma- libretto -basomera abumva.
Sisitemu ya Figaro yakuze mu kiganiro mu 1992 hagati ya batatu bakorana na opera: Patrick Markle, icyo gihe Umuyobozi w’umusaruro wa Santa Fe Opera, Geoffrey Webb, Umushakashatsi w’ibishushanyo mbonera bya Metropolitan i New York, na Ronald Erkman, wari umutekinisiye wa Met. Muri kiriya gihe, amazu ya opera yari afite uburyo bubiri bwo kwerekana libretto hamwe na subtitles y'ibiganiro: projection kuri ecran nini hejuru ya stage cyangwa kuri ecran ntoya muri theatre. Ubusanzwe, ubusobanuro bwayo bwari mu rurimi rumwe.
Itegeko ry’Abanyamerika bafite ubumuga ryo mu 1990 ryari rimaze gushyirwaho; Markle yagerageje gukemura ikibazo cy'ahantu hatandukanye hatabaga hagenewe kwakira abantu bafite ubumuga, harimo nabatumva neza. Markle, Webb, na Erkman bakoze igishushanyo mbonera (prototype) cya mbere cy’icyicaro cy’umuntu ku giti cye maze John Crosby, icyo gihe wari Umuyobozi mukuru wa Santa Fe Opera,yabonye ko icyo gitekerezo cyagira akamaro kubantu bareba opera. Markle, Webb, na Erkman barushijeho gushimangirwa no gusobanukirwa uruhare rw’ikoranabuhanga mu gukemura inzitizi z’umubiri abantu bahura nazo, ku isi hose, zibabuza cyangwa zikabangmira uburyo babona ibikorwa by'ubugeni n'imyidagaduro ibonwa n'amaso. Markle, Webb, na Erkman basabye kandi bahabwa patenti kubyo bahimbye.
Umugiraneza n'umushoramari Alberto Vilar yabaze sisitemu ya Figaro mubigo yari afite abanyamigabane benshi. Yatanze sisitemu ya elegitoroniki ya libretto yikigo muburayi harimo na Royal Opera House i Londres, Teatro degli Arcimboldi ya La Scala i Milan mu Butaliyani, Gran Teatre del Liceu i Barcelona, Espanye, na Wiener Staatsoper i Wien muri Otirishiya. Kubera kunanirwa kwishyura impano yasezeranijwe, amenshi muri ayo masosiyete yatakaje amafaranga.
Mu 2005, Met yashinjaga isosiyete ya New Mexico gukoresha izina ryayo mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko mu kwamamaza "Simultext, sisitemu uregwa avuga ko ishobora kwerekana icyarimwe cya opera kuko kibera kuri stage kandi ko uregwa yari ahagarariye ko sisitemu yayo yashyizwe kuri Met."
Ibicuruzwa n'ikoranabuhanga.
Ibicuruzwa by'asosiyete bizwi muburyo butandukanye nkicyicaro cyinyuma, surtitles, sisitemu ya libretto ya elegitoronike ya opera, amazina ateganijwe, hamwe nubusobanuro bwa libretto.
Ibibuga bya Opera byakoresheje sisitemu yo kwerekana librettos mucyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikidage, Ubutaliyani, Ikiyapani, Ikimandare, Ikirusiya, n'Icyesipanyoli nubwo porogaramu ituma gusoma libretto mu rurimi urwo ari rwo rwose rwanditse. Ubusobanuro butangwa na ecran imwe na sisitemu yo gutanga kuri buri muntu.
Mubisanzwe, ariko ntabwo mubihe byose, sisitemu yashizwe burundu inyuma yumurongo wintebe. Buri ecran ihagaze kuburyo inyandiko igaragara neza kuri buri muntu uyikoresha. Iyerekanwa ryabanje kuboneka muri vacuum fluorescent yerekana (VFD) hanyuma, mu 2000, ikoreshwa rya flux-kristu (LCD). Mu 2004 ibyerekanwe byabonetse hamwe na ecran ya diode (OLED). Buri bwoko bwerekana amakuru amwe hamwe na progaramu ya annotasiyo kumirongo umunani icyarimwe, ishobora kuzimya uyikoresha, kandi ikoreshwa nabakoresha na buto imwe. Porogaramu ishoboye gushyigikira ibibuga 'sisitemu zihari kimwe na sisitemu ya Figaro' "Simultext". Porogaramu ituma umurongo wa buri murongo uko uririmbwa, kandi igaragara ako kanya kuri ecran.
Isosiyete yubaka sisitemu yuzuye harimo na ecran yayo idafite intoki kubakoresha badashobora gukoresha sisitemu yo kwicara, urugero abantu bari mu magare y’ibimuga, bashobora kuba bareba opera mu bice bidafite aho bicara, cyangwa abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.
Muri Amerika, sisitemu y’isosiyete ikoreshwa mu nzu ya Opera Caulkins [Kolorado, Opera ya Santa Fe muri Santa Fe, Des Moines Metro Opera muri Des Moines, Iowa, na Lyric Opera yo mu mujyi wa Kansas, Missouri.
Mu Bwongereza no mu Burayi, sisitemu zashyizwe mu bibuga birimo Royal Opera House i Londres, Teatro alla Scala na Teatro degli Arcimboldi ya La Scala i Milan mu Butaliyani, Gran Teatre del Liceu i Barcelona, Espanye, na Wiener Staatsoper i Wien, Otirishiya.
Mu 2001, isosiyete yatsindiye igihembo cya Los Alamos Laboratories 'Technology Commercialization Award kubera sisitemu ya Simultext.
Mu mwaka wa 2008, porogaramu y’isosiyete yari umwe mu bane bahatanira igihembo cy’indashyikirwa muri porogaramu z'ubucuruzi zatanzwe na New Mexico Technology Technology and Software Association. ["citation ikenewe"]

JP1 ya kure ni ubwoko bwa kure ya rusange, mubisanzwe hamwe na pin-esheshatu ihuza interineti yanditseho "JP1" mubice bya batiri, byakozwe na Universal Electronics Inc. Imiterere ya JP1 yemerera kure gusubiramo porogaramu, ukongeraho urutonde rushya r'wimikorere. Abakunzi b'imikino yo murugo bakoresha JP1 kugirango birinde ubusaza.
Hafi ya JP1 ishobora gukora ibikorwa byiterambere nko gusubiramo urufunguzo na macros. Moderi zimwe zishobora kuvugururwa ukoresheje terefone kugirango wongereho urutonde rushya.
JP1 Igenzura rya kure.
JP1 zose zikozwe na Universal Electronics, Inc.​​​​​​zicuruza modeli zitandukanye binyuze muri One For All izina ryubucuruzi kandi igakwirakwiza remote kuba koresha elegitoronike nka Radio Shack,Sony, na Sky hamwe na North American cables TV batanga na Comcast, Rogers, Cox, Shaw, Charter na Time Warner.
Ku mbaho zicapye zanditseho ikimenyetso "JP1" ni impfunyapfunyo ya "Jumper 1", ni ukuvuga uwambere (kandi kuri kure cyane, "wenyine") usimbuka ku kibaho. Nyuma moderi yanditseho "JP1.x", aho "x" ari 1, 2, 3 cyangwa 4 bitewe n'ubwoko bwa processor yakoreshejwe. Kubireba bishya, ikirango "JP2" cyakoreshejwe.
Mbere JP1 yumuzunguruko wibishushanyo ukoresha chip ya memoire ya EEPROM. Nyuma ibishushanyo bikoreshwa bitunganya hamwe na flash yibuka.
Umugozi wa JP1 uhuza JP1 ya kure na PC, ifasha PC gusoma no kwandika kububiko bwa kure bwabakoresha. Igishushanyo cyo guhuza icyambu kibangikanye, icyambu cyangwa USB ihuza imiyoboro itandukanye ya JP1 iboneka kubuntu, kandi abacuruzi benshi batanga insinga zubatswe mbere. JP1.x na JP2 bya kure ntibishobora gutegurwa hamwe nuburyo bwa kera bwa JP1, izi remote zishobora gutegurwa hifashishijwe insinga za FTDI ziteguye, aho hagomba gusimburwa gusa umuhuza.
Kuvugurura JP1 Remote ukoresheje interineti.
Amakuru na software muri JP1 igenzura kure bishobora kuvugururwa no kwagurwa ukoresheje umugozi wa interineti uhujwe na PC ukoresheje porogaramu ya software yitwa RemoteMaster, cyangwa RMIR. Kuvugurura no kwaguka birimo amakuru mashya ya code yamakuru, protocole nshya ya IR, kanda yambere, na macros.
Nicola Salmoria yavumbuye uburyo bwo kongeramo imirimo mishya yandika software "Abaguzi" (protocole isimbuza JP1 ya kure yo gutunganya ibintu). Abaguzi bashobora guterwa nubushobozi bwa JP1 bwa kure bwibikoresho. bisanzwe byo kwagura ibintu birimo uburebure bwa macro; kubahiriza byihuse; macros; na urufunguzo rurerure kanda (LKP) - aho urufunguzo rukora ibikorwa bitandukanye bitewe nigihe rumaze.
Hari software zitandukanye. Porogaramu yibanze muburyo bworoshye yemerera imikorere yibanze ya kure kuvugururwa hifashishijwe PC. Iremera kandi gushiraho ibikoresho bishya, protocole hamwe no kwaguka, nubwo ibi byakozwe bitandukanye kandi bigasubirwamo muri pake yibanze. Iyemerera kandi iboneza rya kure ryose kugenzurwa no kubikwa nkamadosiye kuri PC kugirango agabanye cyangwa "cloni" igenzura kure.
Porogaramu zuzuzanya na pake y'ibanze ikubiyemo imikorere nko gukora ibikoresho bishya, gukora protocole nshya, guteranya indimi ziteranirizo zabatunganya mugucunga kure, no gusesengura ibimenyetso byize kubigenzura bya kure kugirango bishoboke inkunga ya protocole yubatswe kugirango igenzure ibikoresho bishya.
Mu Kwakira 2000, mu nama ya "Rusange Yumuguzi Rusange" "ya kure", abakunzi ba elegitoroniki Dan "HW Hackr" Nelson na Rob Crowe bakoze uburyo umuhuza wa JP1 wakoreshwa mugusuzuma no guhindura icyo gice cy'ibikoresho byigenzura rya kure birimo amakuru yimiterere yabakoresha nibikoresho bigezweho. Hobbyist bashoboye guhindura injeniyeri imiterere yaka gace ko kwibuka, hanyuma bavumbura uburyo bwuko bakoresha ibishya. Ihuriro rya JP1 rya kure ryagutse kuri uwo murimo, kandi rikomeza kuba umwanya wambere wubuvumbuzi bwo gukoresha imikorere mishya ya JP1.
Kode y'imikorere yaguye (EFC).
Mbere kwisi yose igenzura yakoresheje igikoresho kode / protocole nimero hamwe nimibare itatu yaguye yimikorere ya kodegisi ya porogaramu ikoresheje kure yonyine, cyangwa binyuze muri JP1. Ibi rimwe na rimwe bifasha kugenzura kure kwisi yose bitegurwa kugirango ikoreshe imirimo yinyongera ishobora kuba itaraboneka no kubikoresho byumwimerere byakozwe nabashinzwe kugenzura kure. Mugenzuzi nyuma, iyi code yimikorere yaguwe kugeza muburebure bwimibare itanu.
Hariho igikoresho gifasha mugushakisha aya ma code yashizweho kurubuga rwa JP1, kandi kode yinyongera nayo irashobora kuboneka mubisanzwe bigenzurwa nabashinzwe kugenzura kure hamwe no kubitanga.
Kera UEI Igenzura rya kure.
Yamamoto Inc. Yatanze kandi urukurikirane rwambere rwo kugenzura kwisi yose, bigaragazwa nubugenzuzi bwiburayi bwitwa 'Big Easy'. Igenzura rishobora gukora ibikoresho bigera kuri bine byabaguzi, hamwe na protocole hamwe na code zisanzwe zigarukira kuri TV, satelite analogue na VCR. Nyamara, bamwe mubakira kwisi hamwe nabakinnyi ba DVD bakoresha protocole ishaje hamwe na code ya code, mubisanzwe iyakoreshwaga mbere muri analogue yakira. Ibi bivuze ko igenzura rya kera rishobora kuba ingirakamaro. Igenzura rya kure muri iki gicuruzwa rishobora kumenyekana mubusanzwe hariho amaso atatu yo gutangiza porogaramu muri bateri. Kode yo gusubiramo porogaramu ya kure irashobora gushyirwaho muburyo bwa algorithm, ishobora gukururwa kubuntu kandi igakoreshwa mugushakisha uburyo bwagutse bwo kugenzura.
JP1 yamenyekanishijwe ku Itangazamakuru ryigenga rya Detroit n'ikinyamakuru Nuts na Volts.

Induction cyangwa inductive loop ni itumanaho rya elegitoroniki ya magnetiki cyangwa sisitemu yo gukoresha rukuruzi cyangwa umuyagankuba uhinduranya kugirango utere amashanyarazi mumashanyarazi yegeranye. Induction izenguruka ikoreshwa mugukwirakwiza no kwakira ibimenyetso byitumanaho, cyangwa mugushakisha ibyuma muribimwe mubyuma byerekana ibinyabiziga bihari. Ikoreshwa rya kijyambere mugukoresha induction ni ugutanga ubufasha bwo kumva kubakoresha agakoresho kabafasha kumva kitwa bumva.
Kumenya ibinyabiziga.
Ibinyabiziga byerekana ibinyabiziga, byitwa "indective-loop traffic detector", birashobora kumenya ibinyabiziga byanyuze cyangwa bigera ahantu runaka, urugero nko kwegera itara cyangwa mumodoka. Ikizunguruka, gikoresha amashanyarazi gishyizwe muri kaburimbo. Igice cya elegitoroniki gikoresha imbaraga zumuriro wamashanyarazi kumurongo kuri 10 k Hz kugeza 200 kHz, bitewe nurugero. Sisitemu ya inductive-loop yitwara nkumuzunguruko w'amashanyarazi uhuza aho insinga ya loop na lead-in insinga ari ibintu byinjira. Iyo ikinyabiziga kinyuze hejuru yumuzingo cyangwa gihagaritswe mumuzingo, bimwe mubikoresho byikinyabiziga byongera ubudahangarwa bwumuzingo, nko gushyiramo icyuma murayomashanyarazi. Nyamara, icyuma cya periferique yikinyabiziga kigira ingaruka zinyuranye kuri inductance kubera imigezi ya eddy zikorwa. Kugabanuka kwa inductance kuva kumurongo wa eddy kuruta guhagarika kwiyongera kuva mubwinshi bwa moteri ya moteri, kandi net ni igabanuka rusange muri inductance ya loop wire. Kugabanuka kwa inductance bikunda kugabanya inzitizi zamashanyarazi zinsimburangingo. Kugabanuka kwa impedance ikora ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki bisohoka cyangwa ibintu bikomeye bitandukanijwe neza, byohereza kumugenzuzi wibimenyetso byumuhanda bisobanura kunyura cyangwa kutanyura bitewe nuko kuba hari ikinyabiziga.
Imiterere ya parikingi yimodoka ishobora gukoresha ibizunguruka kugirango ikurikirane urujya n'uruza (imyanya) yinjira cyangwa isohoka cyangwa ishobora gukoreshwa namarembo yinjira cyangwa sisitemu yo kugurisha kugirango umenye ibinyabiziga mugihe abandi bakoresha ubuyobozi bwa parikingi hamwe na sisitemu yamakuru. Gari ya moshi ishobora gukoresha induction kugirango imenye inzira ya gari ya moshi zanyuze ahantu runaka, nk'inzira ya elegitoroniki.
Imiterere itagaragara ya loop isobanura ko ibyuma bito bito bidashobora gukurura relay. Nibyiza kuberako umuzingo udatanga umusaruro mwinshi cyane "ibinyoma byiza" (vuga, kurugero, numunyamaguru wambukiranya umufuka wuzuye impinduka zicyuma). Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, rimwe na rimwe bisobanura kandi ko amagare, ibimoteri, na moto bihagarara aho bihurira bishobora kutamenyekana (bityo rero ibyago bikaba byirengagizwa na switch / signal). Imirongo myinshi ishobora guhindurwa nintoki kugirango ihore imenya ahari ibimoteri na moto. Ibihugu byinshi byo muri Amerika byashyizeho amategeko "yapfuye atukura" yemerera izo modoka kunyura mu "kimenyetso"] [yigihe runaka iyo loop itabimenye.
Ibyiciro by'ibinyabiziga.
Inductance loop nayo yakoreshejwe mugushira ubwoko bwimodoka. Gutoranya ikizunguruka kumurongo mwinshi bivamo umukono wihariye kuri buri kinyabiziga cyemerera gutondekanya ubwoko bwumubiri.
Ubundi bwoko bwa "induction loop" bukoreshwa mubyuma byerekana ibyuma, aho igiceri kinini, kigize igice cyumuzunguruko, gishobora "gutandukanwa" nuburyo igiceri cyegereye ikintu kiyobora. Ikintu cyamenyekanye gishobora kuba icyuma (icyuma na kabili cyerekana) cyangwa kiyobora / ubushobozi (studio / cavity detection). Ibindi bikoresho byibi bikoresho bikoresha ibiceri bibiri cyangwa byinshi byakira, kandi ikintu cyamenyekanye gihindura guhuza inductive cyangwa bigahindura inguni ya fonction ya voltage yatewe mumashanyarazi yakira ugereranije na coil oscillator.
Ikimenyetso cyerekana anti-submarine n'igikoresho cyakoreshwaga mu kumenya ubwato bw’amazi n’ubwato bwo hejuru hifashishijwe insinga zashizwe mu mazi zidasanzwe zahujwe na galvanometero.
Ijwi ryinjiza amajwi, rizwi kandi nka loop yo kumva, ritanga ubufasha kubakoresha ubufasha bwo kumva. Sisitemu ifite imirongo imwe cyangwa myinshi mukarere umukoresha wumva yaba ahari. Induction loop yakira mubisanzwe ni ntoya cyane ya inductor (telecoil). Sisitemu isanzwe ikoreshwa na analog power amplifier ihuye na impedance yo hasi yo kohereza. Ihererekanyabubasha risanzwe aho kuba hejuru cyangwa guhindurwa kubitwara, nubwo sisitemu y'imiyoboro myinshi yashyizwe mubikorwa hakoreshejwe modulation. Ibikoresho byinshi byumva birimo itumanaho ryemerera uyikoresha kwakira no kumva umurima wa magneti no gukuraho ibimenyetso bisanzwe byamajwi byatanzwe kurubuga rwa mikoro yo kumva.
Kubera ko nta "tuning" ihari, nkuko itumanaho rifata mu buryo butumvikanisha amajwi yose ya magnetiki yumurongo wa magneti, hakenewe igishushanyo mbonera cya sisitemu aho hakoreshwa inshuro zirenze imwe zikoreshwa mu nyubako kugirango bifasheb kurushaho; kurugero, inzu yimikino ya firime yegeranye cyangwa salle yigisha cyangwa ahandi hose hafunganye. Itumanaho rishobora kandi gufata urusaku ruvuye ahantu hatari amajwi nkumurongo wamashanyarazi, amatara, cyangwa monitor ya CRT.

Switch adapted toys ni ibikinisho cyangwa ibikoresho byahujwe kuburyo bahinduye umwimerere berekejwe kuri nini nini yo hanze yorohereza uyikoresha. Abana benshi n'abakuze bafite ubumenyi buke mikorere y'imikino n'ingingo, ntibashobora gukina n'udukino dukoresha amabuye y'amashanyarazi.
Ku bana cyangwa urubyiruko rufite ubumuga bukomeye kandi bubangamiye cyane mu mikorere y’umubiri no mu mitekerere, gukoresha igikinisho cyahinduriwe uburyo bwo kugenzura n' akabuto bishobora kuba ari cyo kintu cya mbere bakora ku giti cyabo. Ibi bibubakira icyizere, bibaha ibyishimo, kandi bigatuma batekereza ko bigira ubushobozi bwo kwiga ibintu bishya.
Ibiranga Guhindura Ibiranga.
Ukurikije ubushobozi bwumukoresha, ibintu bitandukanye birahari kubikorwa bitandukanye, harimo: guhinduranya urutoki, guhinduranya ibirenge no guhinduranya buto y'ubunini butandukanye. Abahindura bamwe bafite ibifuniko byihariye - imyenda yoroshye, "squishy" latex, pom pom, cyangwa "bump" ishushanyije kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Gukoresha ibintu byahinduwe biterwa n'imikoreshereze y'imitsi y'umukoresha, kwihuta, ubushobozi bwo kubona, imikorere yubwenge n'inyungu. Ibikinisho bihinduwe kugira ngo bikorwe n'udufunguzo byihariye bishobora gutanga amatara amurika cyangwa ahindagurika ndetse n'umuziki, kuvuga, kunyeganyega, urusaku, abafana, aromatherapy, massage, indirimbo zifite nimero, inyuguti cyangwa pepiniyeri injyana yinjyana ndetse no gufata amajwi no gukina.
Hindura ibikinisho byahujwe muri Amerika.
Hafi ya byose byahinduwe bikinisha ibikinisho nibikoresho ni ibintu bishobora kugurwa mububiko kandi bigahuzwa nyuma yisoko nabantu nimiryango. Abantu bamwe bagurisha ibyo bintu byahinduwe kumurongo binyuze kubacuruzi nka Etsy, Amazon, na Shopify. Ibigo bimwe binini nabyo bigurisha ibyo bikoresho kimwe nibikoresho byihariye bigenewe kuvura.
Hindura ibikinisho byahujwe muri Ositaraliya.
Abatanga ibicuruzwa benshi babaho muri Ositaraliya ariko bakoresha ibikinisho bitumizwa mu mahanga byahinduwe bivuze ko ibikinisho bihenze kugura. Amasomero y'ibikinisho nk'isanduku ya Nowa i Perth, Uburengerazuba bwa Ositaraliya ibitse ibikinisho byinshi byahinduwe kugirango imiryango ishobore kuguza kugirango ishakishe ubwoko bwiza bwa switch hamwe nibikinisho bishimishije kubana babo.
Amasomero y'ibikinisho atumiza ibintu byahinduwe bikinishwa cyangwa bifite abafasha bitangiye imirimo bashoboye gufata bateri isanzwe ikoreshwa kandi ikayihindura kugirango ihindurwe. Ibikinisho bifite imikorere imwe gusa birahagije kugirango bihindurwe ariko biragoye, ibikinisho byinshi bikora ntibishobora kuba byoroshye. Guhuza igikinisho cya batiri murugo birashobora kugerwaho ukoresheje umubare muto wibikoresho.
Urupapuro rwo gutera inkunga imbaga Ibikinisho kuri Tots binyuze muri Cerebral Palsy Alliance ibaho kugirango itange amafaranga akenewe mugutanga ibikinisho byahinduwe byahinduwe kugirango bikoreshwe mumasomero menshi yabigenewe yo muri Perth, atangiza gahunda itanga ibikinisho kubana bujuje ibisabwa ahantu hegereye amazu yabo.
Kwiga uburyo bwo guhindura imiterere.
Imfashanyigisho yo guhindura imihindagurikire y'ikirere yashyizweho na Greg Nakata, AIA yitwa "Reka duhuze na bose!". Umwanditsi ni umubyeyi wumwana ufite ubumuga kandi yize uburyo bwo kubahindura ibikinisho bya adapt. Guhindura uburyo bwo guhuza ibikorwa byerekana ibikoresho byose hamwe nibikoresho umuntu yakenera gutangira guhuza ibikinisho nibikoresho kimwe ninyigisho zirambuye kubwoko bwibikinisho kugirango ahuze. Nakata ashyira kandi amashusho ahuza amashusho yinyandiko kumurongo wa Instagram: AdaptedDesign aho intego ye ari iyo gutuma imenyekanisha ryoroha kubantu bose mugusangira ubumenyi no kwerekana inzira.
Hariho kandi umurongo wa interineti werekana uburyo bwo guhuza ibikinisho kugirango uhindure ibintu, nka TheLaserguy2 ya "Santa's Switch Adapted Toys".

Switch access scanning ni tekinike cyangwa uburyo guhitamo butaziguye bukoresha buto bwihariye, bwifashishwa n'abakoresha ikoranabuhanga ribafasha kuvuga cyangwa kuganira. (AAC), kugirango bahitemo ibintu bivuye mu rwego rwo guhitamo. Igipimo cyo gusikana kinyura mu bintu werekana buri kintu kuri ecran (ni ukuvuga, scanning visual), cyangwa mugutangaza buri kintu ukoresheje amajwi asohoka (nukuvuga, gusikana amajwi), hanyuma uyikoresha agakora switch kugirango ahitemo ikintu. Umuvuduko nuburyo bwo gusikana, kimwe nuburyo ibintu byatoranijwe, byashyizwe mubushobozi bwumubiri, amashusho nubwenge bwumukoresha. Mugihe hashobora kubaho impamvu zitandukanye zo gukoresha scanne, ibisanzwe ni ubumuga bwumubiri bigatuma igabanuka rya moteri kugirango uhitemo neza. Itumanaho mugihe cyo gusikana riratinda kandi ridakorwa neza kuruta guhitamo no gusikana bisaba ubuhanga bwo kumenya (urugero, kwitondera). Gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rishingiye ku buryo bwa "scanning" bifasha umuntu kugira ubwigenge mu gukoresha ibikoresho bimufasha, cyane cyane ku bafite gusa igice kimwe gishobora kugenda ku bushake.

Stenomask ni mikoro ifatwa muntoki ikaba yarashyizwe mugikuta mwimbere kugirango itangire amajwi, ihuza umunwa cyangwa izuru n'umunwa. Impapuro zimwe zoroheje zishobora gushyirwaho umukandara wo mu ijosi kugirango ufate umwanya mugihe urekura amaboko yumukoresha kubindi bikorwa. Intego ya stenomask nukwemerera umuntu kuvuga atumviswe nabandi bantu, no kurinda urusaku rwimbere kure ya mikoro.
Stenomask ni ingirakamaro mu kumenyekanisha imvugo, kubera ko itanga amajwi. umumaro wayo munini nuko igabanya amajwi kugirango atabangamira abantu bahegereye nkurukiko cyangwa ishuri. Umukoresha arashobora kuvuga mumvugo, kwerekana ibimenyetso nibisubizo bitavuzwe, no gusobanura ibikorwa uko bikorwa.
Ukoresha stenomask ashobora gutozwa kongera jwi ibyo bumvise byose muri stenomask ihujwe na sisitemu yo kumenyekanisha imvugo, kugirango yandike inyandiko nyayo yibintu byose byavuzwe. Ibi bituma " umwanditsi wijwi " atanga ibyokurya byihuse mukibanza cyurukiko kandi akabikwirakwiza muburyo bworoshye bwanditse nyuma yo gukomeza. Ibikoresho birashobora kandi guhuza na software yo gucunga imanza.
Stenomask yakozwe na Horace Webb na bagenzi be babiri mu ntangiriro ya 1940. Yari umuhanga mu magambo ahinnye ya Gregg, ariko yashakishije uburyo bunoze kandi bwihuse bwo kwandukura abantu, kubera amagambo make kandi azimije ashobora gucungwa n'abavuga vuba cyangwa imvugo igoye. Byongeye kandi, kugeza porogaramu yo kumenyekanisha imvugo ibaye impamo bihagije kugirango ikoreshwe buri munsi hagati ya za 90, abanyamakuru bigufi bavugaga mu magambo amagambo yanditsemo inyandiko mvugo yandikwa, bikavamo amasaha agera kuri abiri yandika kuri buri saha.
Rero, Webb yatekereje ko ashobora "kubisubiramo nijwi ryanjye aho gukoresha ikaramu". Nyuma yubushakashatsi bwinshi yari yarakoranye na bagenzi be yabanje gukoresha agasanduku k'itabi hanyuma akoresha n'umutobe w'inyanya urashobora - yageze ku gisubizo akoresheje mikoro imbere ya masikeri ya ogisijeni ya gisirikare ya rubber ya ogisijeni, ahujwe n'inkono ya kawa yuzuyemo ibintu bikurura amajwi. Igisubizo cyaje gufatwa n’ingabo z’Amerika zirwanira mu mazi ko ari bwo buryo nyabwo bwo kwandukura abantu muri "sisitemu zose zizwi zo gutanga raporo mu magambo", hanyuma zemezwa gukoreshwa muri raporo z’urukiko.

Switch access ni uburyo bwo gukoresha buto imwe cyangwa nyinshi mu gutunganya mudasobwa nibindi bikoresho, kandi bikoreshwa ahanini n'abantu bafite ubumuga bukomeye bw'umubiri cyangwa bw'imitekerereze. Guhindura ni igikoresho cyikoranabuhanga gifasha gisimbuza icyifuzo cyo gukoresha clavier ya mudasobwa cyangwa imbeba. Irashobora kwemerera abakoresha kugenzura mudasobwa, intebe y’ibimuga, umukino wimikino ya videwo, tablet, terefone, igikinisho, nibindi bikoresho bitandukanye bya elegitoroniki.
Switches tuza muburyo butandukanye bw'imiterere n'ingano, bitewe n'uburyo dukorwamo kugira ngo dukore (nka sip-puff, gusunika, gukurura, gukanda, guhumbya cyangwa gukanda). Guhindura(switches) nabyo biratandukanye mumabara yabyo hamwe nubwiza. Kubisunika cyangwa gukanda kuri switch, ingano yingufu zisabwa kugirango zikoreshe ziratandukanye cyangwa mubihe bimwe na bimwe birashobora guhinduka. Guhindura bimwe bishobora gusaba gukoraho gusa (ntanubwo ari imashini), bimwe bishobora kuba byarateguwe gukubitwa imigeri. Ihindura irashobora gukoreshwa nigice cyumubiri gishobora kubyara kugenda kandi kubushake. ["citation ikenewe"]
Ihindura ntishobora gucomeka muri mudasobwa. Ahubwo, Guhindura Interineti birasabwa gukemura icyuho kiri hagati ya switch na USB ya mudasobwa, serial, cyangwa icyambu cya PS / 2. ["citation ikenewe"]
Niki gishobora kugerwaho hamwe na switch.
Guhindura birashobora kuba byiza kubantu bafite ibibazo byubwenge, gutinda kwiterambere no kugarukira kumubiri. Muburyo bworoshye gukoresha ni inzira isobanutse kandi yoroshye yo kwerekana ibikorwa / reaction bakunze kwita nkimpamvu n'ingaruka. Mugukoresha cyane, birashobora kuba uburyo bwo kugenzura kugenda cyangwa gukorana nibidukikije. Hariho ibikorwa bitandukanye byo guhinduranya ibikorwa bishobora gukoreshwa mugusuzuma no guteza imbere imyumvire yumuntu guhitamo nigihe.
Guhindura birashobora guhuzwa nibikoresho bitandukanye, kurugero: Ibikoresho byogutumanaho nubundi buryo bwitumanaho, guhinduranya ibikinisho byahujwe, guhinduranya interineti kugirango ubone mudasobwa, iDevices, Ikoranabuhanga rya SMART, ibikoresho byibyumba byumviro nibikoresho bigenzura ibidukikije. ["citation ikenewe"]
Umubare muto wimikoranire ishobora gutangwa na switch ni binary switch yinjiza, kuko gufata hasi kumwanya mugihe runaka bishobora kuba bidashoboka kubikoresho byo guswera no guswera cyangwa kubabaza umuntu urwaye rubagimpande. Abakoresha bamwe bazahitamo gukoresha switch imwe, abandi bahitamo gukoresha bibiri rimwe na rimwe birenze. Kubakoresha bakoresha sisitemu zabo kugirango bagere kubikorwa byoroheje byongeweho bizana amahitamo yo guhitamo. Iyemerera kandi abakoresha babiri gukorera hamwe cyangwa gukina hagati yabo. ["citation ikenewe"]
Urebye uburyo bwinshi bwo guhinduranya ni ngombwa kubakoresha kugera kubikorwa byinshi byiterambere binyuze muri scan yogusuzuma. Ibi mubisanzwe bigenwa nubushobozi bwabo bwumubiri. Guhindura kimwe bisaba kugenzura bike kumubiri kandi mubisanzwe birarambiranye kubigeraho ariko bigabanya uburyo bwo gusikana kandi mubisanzwe biganisha ku gipimo cyihuta cyo kwinjiza. Gusikana inshuro imwe bisaba kandi kwibanda cyane. Ibice bibiri-bisikana bishoboza urutonde rwo gusikana, harimo umurongo-na-nkingi na overcan. Ibi birashobora kongera cyane umuvuduko wo kwinjiza amakuru kandi bigatuma gukoresha mudasobwa cyangwa ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga bifasha biba byoroshye kandi byihuse. ["citation ikenewe"]

Standing Wheelchair ni igare kandi rikaba rizwi nkintebe kuko ifasha abafite ubumuga mukuba bajya ahantu hatandukanye inafite abamni tekinoroji ifasha, isa n'ikadiri ihagaze, ituma umukoresha w’ibimuga azamura intebe kuva yicaye kugeza aho ihagaze. Intebe yimuga ihagaze ishyigikira umuntu mumwanya uhagaze kandi igafasha imikoranire nabantu nibintu kurwego rwamaso.
imiterere ni mikoreshereze ya Standing Wheelchair.
Mugihe bose bafite imikorere yibanze, hari byinshi bitandukanye kuriyi ntebe cyanga igare ryitwa Standing Wheelchair. Nibikoresho bifasha, intebe zihagaze zakozwe mbere na mbere ukurikije ibyo abakoresha baryo bakeneye. Uburyo bwo guterura bwinjizwamo bushobora gukoreshwa nintoki cyangwa gukoreshwa nibikoresho bya hydraulic bigereranya imbaraga. Ibiziga birashobora kandi gukoreshwa nimbaraga cyangwa intoki. Amavuta akoreshwa mubyuma bikoreshwa mubikorwa kugirango habeho kuringaniza kuramba, imbaraga, guhinduka no kumurika, icyakora hariho ibyuma biremereye kandi byoroshye birahari. Moderi yihariye yubatswe kugirango ikoreshwe buri gihe mugihe izindi zifasha gusa mubikorwa byihariye. z’ibimuga zihagaze zishobora no kwirukanwa aho zihagaze, icyakora hari impungenge z’ubuvuzi zerekana ko ibyago byinshi byo kuvunika amagufwa mugihe utwaye imodoka kubera amaguru ari umutwaro uremereye.
Gusuzuma no kubakoresha.
Intebe z’abafite ubumuga zigaragara zikoreshwa n’abantu bafite ubumuga bworoheje kandi bukabije harimo: gukomeretsa uruti rwumugongo, gukomeretsa ubwonko bwubwonko, ubumuga bwubwonko, spina bifida, dystrofi yimitsi, sclerose nyinshi, stroke, syndrome ya rett, syndrome ya polio nibindi byinshi.
Intebe zabafite ubumuga ziri mubyiciro bitandukanye muburyo zihagaze zikoreshwa nabantu bafite paraplegia na quadriplegia, kubera ko uburyo butandukanye bwo guhagarara burahari kugirango bakire ubumuga bworoheje bukabije.
Ubushakashatsi bwinshi bwerekana ibimenyetso byintebe zintebe zihagaze zitanga inyungu zubuzima kurenza bagenzi babo badafite imashini. Zimwe muri izo nyungu zirimo kuzenguruka neza, ubwinshi bwamagufwa, hamwe ningaruka nke zo kwikuramo no guhindura skelete. Abashakashatsi benshi n’abakoresha bavuga ko inyungu atari umubiri gusa - uburyo bwinshi bwo kugenda butangwa n’ibimuga by’ibimuga bihagaze bituma abakoresha babaho ubuzima bwigenga, bigatuma ubuzima bwo mu mutwe butera imbere ndetse n’ubuzima bwiza.
Intebe z'ababana n'ubumuga zihagaze bazishyize kubiciro abantu benshi batekerezagako bitageraho kuko kurubu kuzikoresha bihagaza, hamwe na verisiyo zikoreshwa kuva $ 10,000- $ 15,000. Uku kutagerwaho kwatumye ibigo byubwishingizi byinjiza ikoranabuhanga muri gahunda zabo zisanzwe. Mu 2020, Ubwigenge Binyuze mu Kongera Ubuvuzi na Medicaid (ITEM) bwiyambaje Ikigo gishinzwe ubuvuzi na Medicaid (CMS), busaba intebe z’ibimuga zihagaze hamwe n’ibimuga by’ibimuga bifite intebe zashyizwe hejuru zifite imbaraga zishyirwa mu nyungu z’ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi biramba. Icyo cyifuzo cyatanzwe igice muri Gicurasi 2023, kubera ko CMS yashyizemo intebe y’ibimuga ifite intebe zashyizwe hejuru n’inyungu kandi bakavuga ko mu gihe kiri imbere hazasuzumwa intebe z’ibimuga.
Kugeza ubu, ubwishingizi bushobora gufasha mu gutera inkunga igice cyintebe, mugihe inkunga ya Medicaid itandukanye bitewe na leta zitandukanye muri Amerika Amasosiyete menshi yubwishingizi, imiryango ishinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe imyuga, hamwe n’abashinzwe ibibazo by’ubuvuzi bagenda batera inkunga intebe z’ibimuga zihagaze kubera ubuzima bw’igihe kirekire n’ubuzima bwiza buturuka ku guhagarara neza.
Inkunga inkunga ya leta itanga mu bwishingizi kubikoresho bihagaze birashoboka, ariko mubisanzwe bisaba gutsindishirizwa mubuvuzi hamwe nibaruwa ikenera ubuvuzi (ibisobanuro birambuye) byanditswe numuvuzi wumubiri cyangwa inzobere mubuvuzi.

Nyamara, igiceri cyo kwibuka cyo muri Polonye gifite ibisobanuro bitandukanye bya tekiniki bitandukanye muburyo bakozemo umuzenguruko wacyo kiceri, bigatuma bidashoboka mu mikoreshereze ya buri munsi. Elly Savatia (wavutse 2001) ni rwiyemezamirimo wo muri Kenya akaba anahanga udushya mu ikoranabuhanga, uzwi cyane nk'uwashinze gutangiza ikoranabuhanga Signvrse ndetse n'umuhanzi wa Terp 360, porogaramu ikoresha ubwenge bw'ubukorano (AI) isobanura ijambo n'inyandiko mu rurimi rw'amarenga hifashishijwe avatars za 3D.Mu 2025, yatsindiye igihembo cya Royal Academy of Engineering 'Africa Africa for Engineering Innovation kubera ibikorwa yakoze kuri uwo mushinga.
Savatia yashinze ikigo cya Nairobi cyatangije Signvrse mu ntangiriro ya za 2020 kugirango igere ku buryo bwa digitale ku baturage batumva kandi batumva muri Afurika. Afite imyaka 24 yatangije Terp 360, isobanurwa ngo "Google Translate for language sign." uru rubuga rukoresha ubwenge bw'ubukorano (AI) hamwe n'amakuru afashwe mu kugenzura imyitwarire (motion- captured dat) kugira ngo atange ibisobanuro nyabyo by'ururimi rw'amarenga mu gihe nyacyo hifashishijwe avatar ya 3D zisa nizo mubuzima nyabwo.
Iyi porogaramu yakozwe ku bufatanye n’Abanyakenya batumva, yandika ibimenyetso birenga 2.300, harimo interuro n’amagambo asanzwe mu rurimi rw’amarenga rwo muri Kenya (KSL). Nk’uko Savatia abivuga, AI yatojwe hakoreshejwe ibyuma bifata ibyuma bifata umukono n'ibimenyetso mu mwanya w’ibice bitatu.
Hagati mu 2025, Terp 360 yari imaze kugera ku bakoresha barenga 2000 kandi yari igeragezwa mu mashuri, mu bitaro, no ku kazi kugira ngo ifashe itumanaho hagati y'abatumva n'abumva. Kuri ubu urubuga rushyigikira ubusobanuro bw'icyongereza n'igiswahili muri KSL, ruteganya kwaguka mu rurimi rw’amarenga mu Rwanda, Uganda, Afurika y'Epfo, Abongereza n'Abanyamerika.
Mu Kwakira 2025, Savatia yahawe igihembo cya Afurika cyo guhanga udushya mu buhanga bwa Royal Academy of Engineering mu muhango wabereye i Dakar, muri Senegali. Yakiriye amapound 50.000 yo gutsinda iri rushanwa, ryubaha ba rwiyemezamirimo bo muri Afurika bakoresheje ubwubatsi n’ikoranabuhanga mu gukemura ibibazo byaho.

Abafite ubumuga mu Rwanda nabo bafite uburenganzira nkabandi bose mwiterembere binyuze mugukora bahabwa amahirwe angana nkayandi bose.
Abafite ubumuga Mubuyobozi.
Mu Rwanda abafite ubumuga bahabwa amahirwe yo kwiyamamaza bahabwa imyanya ibiri yabahagararira mu nteko ishinga amategeko.
Amatsinda yo kuzigama no kugurizanya afasha abafite ubumuga kwiteza imbere.
Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere imibereho y'abafite ubumuga, hashyizweho amatsinda yo kuzigama no kugurizanya abafasha kubona igishoro cyo gutangira ibikorwa bibateza imbere.
Aya matsinda yabafashije kuva mu bwigunge, kwigira ku bandi no gutangiza imishinga irimo ubworozi, ubuhinzi n'ubucurizi. Binyuze muri ayo matsinda, benshi babashije kongera ubushobozi bwabo mu bukungu, bamwe ndetse bagera ku rwego rwo gutanga akazi no kugira uruhare mu iterambere ryi'gihugu. 3

SlWiki ni sisitemu ifunguye ishingiye kuri OpenCourseWare sisitemu ifasha mukwandika. Ifasha kwiga kwandika ibyanditse hamwe nubuyobozi (harimo kubahiriza SCORM 2004) nibikoresho byubufatanye / amasoko-mbonezamubano, guhindura, itumanaho, gushyigikira itangazwa ryuburezi bwuguruye
SlWiki ni Urubuga rworoshya ubufatanye ndetse no muri sisitemu yuburezi. Hamwe nabakoresha SlideWiki barashobora gukora no gufatanya kumurongo no gutondekanya amashusho mubitekerezo. Ibiganiro birashobora gutegurwa muburyo bukurikiranye, kugirango ubitondere neza ukurikije ibikubiyemo. Kugeza ubu ubufatanye bunini (nanone bwitwa imbaga-soko) hafi yuburezi (usibye inyandiko) bushyigikiwe gusa muburyo buke. Amashusho, kwerekana, igishushanyo, ibizamini byo gusuzuma nibindi byakozwe ahanini nabarezi, abarimu, abarimu nabarimu kugiti cyabo cyangwa mumatsinda mato cyane. Ibivuyemo birashobora gusangirwa kumurongo (urugero ukoresheje Slideshare, OpenStudy, Google Docs). Ariko, ubufatanye bukwiye bwabaturage, kwandika, guhindura, gushinga amashami, kongera gukoresha no kongera guteganya ibintu byuburezi nkuko tubizi kuva kumasoko afunguye-isoko ya software ntabwo ashyigikiwe.
SlWiki ni urubuga, aho bishoboka ko abaturage benshi bigisha, abarimu, abize bahabwa imbaraga zo gukora ibintu byubumenyi buhanitse muburyo bwo gufatanya. Kubushakashatsi bushya bugaragara, kurugero, ikigo cyubufatanye nka SlideWiki cyemerera gukwirakwiza ibirimo no kwigisha abanyeshuri ba PhD nabashakashatsi bangenzi byihuse, kubera ko umutwaro wo guhanga no gutunganya urwego rushya ushobora gukwirakwizwa mumuryango mugari. Inzobere mubice bitandukanye byurwego rushya zishobora kwibanda mugushiraho ibintu byuburezi mubice byabo byubuhanga kandi nyamara ibirimo birashobora guhuzwa byoroshye nibindi bikoresho, byongeye kubakwa no kongera kubigambirira. Ikintu cyihariye, cyoroherezwa na SlideWiki ni indimi nyinshi. Kubera ko ibirimo byose byahinduwe kandi byubatswe neza, biroroshye guhinduranya igice mu buryo bworoshye guhinduranya ibirimo no gukomeza gukurikirana impinduka muburyo butandukanye bwindimi nyinshi zikoreshwa mubintu bimwe.
SlWiki yibanda cyane cyane kubantu benshi bafite aho bahurira n'ubwanditsi, inkunga yo guhindura no gutunganya ibintu byuburezi hamwe nibibazo byo kwisuzuma. Ibiranga harimo:
Umushinga wa SlWiki H2020.
Iterambere rya SlideWikis ryashyizweho mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 2016 nk'umushinga uterwa inkunga nikigo cya EU. Yongeye gushyirwaho muburyo bushya bw'ikoranabuhanga kandi igaragara ku rubuga rwa interineti rwa SlWiki.org mu 2017. Ibigo 17 by’abafatanyabikorwa baturutse mu Burayi bwose ndetse na Amerika y'Epfo bifatanya mu rwego rwo kunoza SlWiki no gushyira mu bikorwa ibintu byinshi bishya no kuzamura ubunararibonye bw’abakoresha kugira ngo bibe ihuriro rikuru ry’uburezi bwuguruye, cyane cyane ibiganiro.

Electropalatography (EPG) n'ubuhanga cyangwa uburyo bwo kureba aho ururimi ruhura n'imberey'akanwa, cyane cyane mugihe umuntu avugira amagambo.
Agahimba k'akanwa kauguruye(artificial palate) gakozwe muburyo gahura neza n'imbere y'akanwa k'umuntu. Ako gahimba gafite utwuma tw'amashanyarazi (electrodes) tuzajya duhura n'ururimi. Iyo guhura bibaye hagati yururimi na electrode iyo ari yo yose, cyane cyane hagati y'uruhande rw'ururimi n'imbibi za palate ikomeye, ibimenyetso bya elegitoronike byoherezwa mubice bitunganya hanze. EPG itanga imbaraga-nyayo-nyayo yibitekerezo byerekana ahantu hamwe nigihe cyo guhuza ururimi hamwe na palate ikomeye.
Ibisobanuro birambuye byururimi mugihe cyo kuvuga byanditswe, bitanga amakuru ataziguye umuntu ashobora gukoresha mubuvuzi kugirango akurikirane kandi atezimbere uburyo bwabo bwo kuvuga. Ibitekerezo biboneka ni ngombwa cyane mugutsinda kuvura abana batumva.
Electropalatography yabanje gutekerezwa kandi itezwa imbere nkigikoresho cyubushakashatsi bwa fonetika kugirango tunononsore uburyo gakondo bwa palatografiya. Abashakashatsi mu ndimi za gisirikari n’amasomo bakoresheje ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki ya elegitoroniki kugira ngo babone amakuru nyayo yerekeye guhuza ururimi n’indimi mu ndimi nyinshi z’amahanga.
Ibikoresho bya mbere bya EPG byakoreshaga amashanyarazi ataziguye kugirango akoreshe ibyuma bifata ibyuma bifata ibyuma bifata ibyuma bifata ibyuma byifashishwa. Umunwa (electropalates) mubusanzwe wasaga cyane nicyapa cyerekana amenyo agezweho. Mouthpiece yarushijeho guhindurwa mugihe, ibyo bikaba byemerera ubushakashatsi bunoze. Igishushanyo 1 kirerekana amashanyarazi asanzwe muri sisitemu yo Gusoma.
EPG yongeyeho ubushishozi muburyo bwo gusobanukirwa amasomo ya fonetika. Mu myaka ya za 1960 na 1970 abantu benshi bigenga hamwe n’amasosiyete bamenye ubushobozi bwa EPG bwo kwigisha no kuvura. Nubwo inshuro nyinshi zagerageje guhindura ibikoresho bya injeniyeri EPG yo kuvura imvugo, ibigo byinshi byananiwe gucuruza EPG neza. Ibikoresho bya EPG bikomeje kuba ibikoresho bihenze cyane byo kuvura imvugo nubushakashatsi bwa fonetika, nubwo amakuru batanga biragoye kuyabona ukoresheje ubundi buryo bwo gutanga ibitekerezo byerekana neza.
Mu bushakashatsi bwa fonetike.
Nubwo byinshi mu iterambere rya EPG byeguriwe amavuriro, yakoreshejwe mu iperereza ryinshi rya laboratoire. Kibuye (1997) urutonde rwibice bitatu byingenzi byubushakashatsi:
Iyo electropalatografiya ikoreshwa mubushakashatsi bwijambo, amakuru avuye mururimi-palate yatoranijwe na mudasobwa igenzura kuri frame 100 kumasegonda. Mu minsi ya mbere (mugihe ibyerekanwe bya digitale bitari hose kandi bigarukira), amakuru yacapishijwe kumpapuro kugirango asesengurwe. Urugero rwo gucapura rushobora kuboneka ku gishushanyo cya 2, aho urukurikirane ruva hejuru kugeza hasi, kandi aho ikimenyetso cya 'O' cyerekana guhuza na '.' yerekana ko ntaho ahurira. Imvugo yerekanwe ni 'catkin' /kæt.kɪn/; icyitegererezo gifite nimero 344 yerekana mugihe / t / gufunga birangiye, no kumurongo wa 350 hariho gufunga byuzuye. Gufunga alveolar irekurwa kuri 351. Guhuza ingingo ya articulatory (itumvikana) birerekanwa neza. Ikivugwa (kizwi kandi nka Spoken - Kanda kuri Talk AAC AAC) ni porogaramu igendanwa kandi igikoresho cyo kongera no guhinduranya itumanaho (AAC) cyatangijwe mu mwaka wa 2019. Iyi porogaramu yakozwe kugira ngo ifashe abantu bafite ikibazo cyo kuvuga cyangwa gukoresha ururimi nk'abafite aphasia cyangwa autism adashobora kuvuga (nonverbal autism), ikoresheje ibimenyetso, inyandiko, n'ijwi.
Michael Bond yatangiye iterambere rya Spoken mu 2015, abitewe n'icyifuzo cyo kubona ibikoresho bigezweho kandi byorohereza abantu mu buvuzi bwo kuvuga, kuko uburyo gakondo butari bwarahindutse cyane mu myaka 50 ishize. Uyu mushinga wateye imbere cyane kubera uruhare muri gahunda yihuta ya Start-Up Chili, aho wafashe umwanya wa mbere mu bahatanira umwanya wa cumi n'umunani batangiye ku munsi wa 13 wa Demo Day mu Gushyingo 2015. Iyi porogaramu yatangijwe ku mugaragaro muri 2019.
Byinshi mu bimenyetso byumwimerere bya Spoken byatijwe muri The Noun Project, byatoranijwe hakoreshejwe imbaga nyamwinshi ishingiye kubantu kugirango hamenyekane amashusho meza kumagambo. ["citation ikenewe"] Nubwo amashusho menshi yizina y'umushinga aracyakoreshwa muri Spoken, hashyizweho ingufu kugirango uhindure amashusho yihariye kugirango tunonosore uburyo bwo guhuza no kumenyekanisha ijambo byihuse.
Ikoreshwa ryukuri rya tekinoroji ya Spoken ryongerewe mu buryo butunguranye mugihe cyorezo cya COVID-19, gifasha abarwayi gukira gukoresha umuyaga. Muri Werurwe 2021, porogaramu imaze kubona ibicuruzwa birenga 10,000 kandi ikavuga ko izamuka rya 20% buri kwezi. 2022, yagereranyaga izindi 1.000 zo gukuramo buri cyumweru.
Muri Gashyantare 2022, Spoken yinjiye muri AlphaLab Health, yihuta yo gutangiza na Allegheny Network Network hamwe nudushya two gukora. Ibi byahaye isosiyete uburyo bwo kubona ibikoresho by'ubuvuzi, inkunga, hamwe ni nama, bikarushaho gutera imbere. Yitabiriye kandi izindi gahunda nka Multiple Autism yihuta na AI ya Slalom Ventures ya AI yihuta.
Muri Nzeri 2025, porogaramu yerekanye guhuza na ElevenLabs, iha abakoresha ibikoresho byo gukora clone yijwi hamwe nijwi ryihuse ryihuse muri porogaramu. ["citation ikenewe"]
Spoken yiyemeje kwagura itangwa ryikoranabuhanga mu ndimi nyinshi, ishaka gukemura ibibazo by’abaturage batishoboye no kwitegura kwiyongera ku isi.
Spoken yitandukanije nizindi porogaramu za AAC binyuze mugukoresha urugero runini rwururimi rutanga ubushobozi bwimyandikire iteganijwe, bisa nibikorwa bya terefone byikora. Iyi mikorere yigira kumvugo yukoresha, itanga ibitekerezo byihariye mugihe runaka. Abakoresha barashobora kwagura amagambo ya porogaramu muburyo butatu: mu gukoresha inshuro nyinshi amagambo mashya mumirongo kugirango Spoken yige imiterere yabyo, mu kongeramo amagambo ku bwinshi binyuze mu mahitamo "Ongeramo Amagambo" kugirango uhanure shingiro, cyangwa ukoresheje uburyo bwa "Private Prediction", busaba ibibazo bigamije kwemeza ko amagambo mashya ahita ahanurwa muburyo bukwiye. Byongeye kandi, Spoken irashobora guhuza ibyo iteganya ukurikije aho uyikoresha iherereye, itanga ibitekerezo bijyanye muburyo bwihariye nka resitora cyangwa ibitaro.
Porogaramu ikubiyemo guhitamo amajwi-karemano, guhuza amajwi hamwe no guhitamo uburyo bwo guhitamo ikibanza, umuvuduko, nubunini, bigafasha abakoresha guhitamo ijwi ryerekana neza umwirondoro wabo cyangwa ibyo bakunda. Amajwi yose yashyizwe muri Spoken yitiriwe ibimera aho kuba abantu kugirango bagaragare ko badafite uburinganire cyangwa unisex. "Ingero"] [, Bottlebrush, na Dandelion. Muri 2025, Spoken yaguye kugirango yemere abakoresha kubona amajwi aturuka hanze nka Acapela. Ivugurura rimwe ryongeyeho ibikoresho byo kubyara amajwi mashya ukoresheje ElevenLabs, haba ukoresheje ibisobanuro byanditse cyangwa ijwi rya cloni.
Imvugo ishigikira uburyo butandukanye bwo kwinjiza kugirango uhuze ibyifuzo bitandukanye byabakoresha nibyifuzo byabo. Kurenga imyandikire isanzwe hamwe ninyandiko ziteganya, izi inyandiko zandikishijwe intoki ndetse nigishushanyo cyoroshye, gihindura inyongeramusaruro mumagambo yavuzwe. Amakuru yakoreshejwe mugutoza ibishushanyo mbonera bya Spoken byakomotse kumukino Byihuse, Kurura!, kubemerera kumenya ibishushanyo mbonera cyane kandi byukuri. ["citation ikenewe"]
Spoken itanga kandi interuro yabitswe iranga, yagenewe abakoresha bahora bakoresha interuro cyangwa imvugo yihariye. Iyi nteruro irashobora kugarurwa mugukanda kabiri gusa, koroshya itumanaho mubihe byihuse cyangwa byihutirwa.
Ikindi kintu kiranga Spoken ni "buto yo kwitondera." Iyi miterere yateguwe mugusimbuza amagambo nko gukuramo umuhogo. Kanda kamwe kamwe kamwe kano kantu kenshi gahanagura itara ryigikoresho kandi rigakina amajwi yihariye, akurura ibitekerezo. Abakoresha AAC barashobora gukoresha iyi mikorere kugirango bamenyeshe abandi ko bagiye kuvuga, cyangwa kugirango umuntu yitabweho byihuse mugihe cyihutirwa.
Kubindi byongeweho kuboneka, Spoken ikubiyemo ibintu nkibicapiro binini, uburyo bwijimye, hamwe nogutandukanya ijambo kugirango umenye neza ko porogaramu ikoreshwa kandi yoroheye kubantu bafite ibyo bakeneye bitandukanye.
Abakoresha barashobora kandi kwerekana interuro zabo murwego rwuzuye rwa ecran kugirango bavugane ahantu harehare cyane cyangwa mubihe badashaka gutera urusaku.
Ibindi bice birimo ubushobozi bwo gusangira byihuse ibyanditse cyangwa amashusho y amajwi avuye muri porogaramu ukoresheje inyandiko cyangwa imeri hamwe nuburyo bwo guhagarika amagambo amwe atagaragara mubyahanuwe, bitanga urwego rwihariye rwihariye.

Sip-na-puff cyangwa sip 'n' puff (SNP) nubuhanga bufasha bukoreshwa mu kohereza ibimenyetso kubikoresho ukoresheje umuvuduko wumwuka "kunyunyuza" (guhumeka) cyangwa "guhumeka" (guhumeka) kumyatsi, umuyoboro cyangwa "umugozi." Ikoreshwa cyane cyane nabantu bafite ubumuga butandukanye gukoresha amaboko yabo. Bikunze gukoreshwa mugucunga intebe yimuga ya moteri na quadriplegics ifite ibikomere byinshi cyane kumugongo cyangwa abantu bafite ALS.
Guhindura no gushiraho.
iyi sisitemu ifite tekinoroji ya SNP bisaba umubare wihariye wumuvuduko wumwuka kugirango ushire cyangwa uhindurwe numukoresha. Ingano yumuvuduko mubisanzwe igaragazwa nkibisumizi bikomeye / puff ikomeye cyangwa yoroshye sip / yoroshye puff, icyakora andi magambo ashobora kubaho. Menya ko amagambo akomeye na yoroshye ugereranije numukoresha kandi biterwa nubushobozi bwabo bwo guhumeka. Mubisanzwe, umuvuduko wumuyaga ujyanye no guswera / guswera no guswera byoroshye / puffs bishyirwaho binyuze muburyo bwa kalibrasi yambere ya sensor sensor yarangiye mbere yuko uyikoresha atangira gukoresha ibikoresho bya SNP. Hifashishijwe imfashanyo cyangwa umutekinisiye, uyikoresha azategura igikoresho cya SNP kugirango amenye ubushobozi bwumubiri wabo kubyara sip / puffs hamwe na sipi yoroshye / puffs. Iyo gahunda yo guhitamo imaze kurangira, igikoresho cya SNP kizamenya gusa umukoresha ibiryo byihariye na puffs zabitswe mubikoresho bya SNP.
Kugenzura ibimuga bifite moteri.
Porogaramu isanzwe yibikoresho bya Sip-na-Puff ni ukugenzura ibimuga bifite moteri. Igenzura mubisanzwe rigizwe ninyandiko enye zitandukanye uhereye kumukoresha. Intangiriro yambere puff izafasha igare ry'ababana n'ubumuga butandukanye gutera imbere, mugihe sipi ikomeye izahagarika igare ryibimuga. Ibinyuranye, icyambere cyokunywa kizafasha intebe yimuga gusubira inyuma, mugihe puff ikomeye izahagarika igare ryibimuga. Gukomeza guswera byoroshye cyangwa puff yoroheje bizafasha igare ryibimuga kugenda ibumoso cyangwa iburyo ukurikije igihe umukoresha akubita muri tube, ibyatsi cyangwa "umugozi".
Igikoresho cyo kwinjiza mudasobwa.
Kugenzura umwanya wunganira ububiko bwa mudasobwa abakoresha uburyo bworoshye kandi bwiza bwo kugenzura imbeba. Kwimuka nigikorwa cyiyi joystick isa niy'inkoni yo mu kanwa. Imbeba ya buto yo gukanda irangizwa hifashishijwe siporo cyangwa puffs imikorere ya joystick.
Igikoresho cya mudasobwa kitiriwe sip-na-puff cyinjijwe hamwe na software igera kuri mudasobwa bivuze ko clavier nyinshi imikorere ishobora gukoreshwa hamwe niki gikoresho.

ACM SIGACCESS ni Ishyirahamwe ry’imashini zidasanzwe zo kubara imashini zita kuri mudasobwa ziboneka, itsinda rinyuranye ry’abashakashatsi mu masomo n’inganda, abaganga n’abakozi bashinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abafite ubumuga butandukanye, abafata ibyemezo, abakoresha amaherezo, n’abanyeshuri kugira ngo bateze imbere ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa n’abafite ubumuga.
Mu 1964, Ishyirahamwe ry’imashini zibara mudasobwa ryatangije komite ishinzwe ibikorwa ku babana nu bumuga ku batabona, yasohoye akanyamakuru imyaka ine kandi itegura inama mu 1969. Intego ya komite yari iyo guteza imbere no gutera inkunga impumyi nkaba programmes babishoboye. Komite yaguye ibitekerezo byayo kugira ngo ishyiremo abandi bantu bafite ubumuga "Itsinda ry’inyungu zidasanzwe kuri mudasobwa n’abafite ubumuga bw’umubiri" (SIGCAPH) mu 1971. Mu 2003, SIG yiswe SIGACCESS.
Ihuriro rya ACM SIGACCESS ryabereye kuburyo bwa online kuri mudasobwa no kugerwaho (ASSETS) ninama ngarukamwaka. Intererano zose zinama zirasuzumwa nurungano na komite mpuzamahanga ya gahunda, kandi impapuro zemewe, ibyapa n'imyiyerekano bibitswe mububiko bwibitabo bwa ACM. Abanditsi bose b'impapuro zemewe bazatumirwa gutanga impapuro zagutse z'impapuro zabo ku kibazo cyihariye cya "Transaction ya ACM kuri Computing Computing" ("TACCESS").
SIGACCESS itera inkunga muburyo nutandukanye kandi andi mahugurwa ya ACM n'inama ku buryo busimburana.
"Ihererekanyabubasha kuri comptabilite" ni ikinyamakuru ACM buri gihembwe gisohora inyandiko zisobanuraimyitwarire zerekeye kubara byoroshye. Ikinyamakuru gishimangira imisanzu hamwe nibisubizo byubushakashatsi, ariko kandi byakira impapuro zifite ubushishozi bushya cyangwa imyanya.
ASSETS Impapuro Impinduka Igihembo.
ASSETS Paper Impact Award ihabwa abanditsi impapuro cyangwa se impamya bumenyi zabo. Impapuro zigomba kuba zifite nibura imyaka icumi kugirango zisuzumwe.
Umusanzu udasanzwe muri comptabilite na Accessibility Award.
Igihembo cyindashyikirwa gitangwa mumyaka yabanje kandi abayihawe batanga ikiganiro nyamukuru mu nama ya ASSETS ikurikira.

Screen Magnifier ni software ihuza ibishushanyo mbonera muri mudasobwa kugirango yerekane ibinini byagutse. Mugukuza igice (cyangwa byose) bya ecran, abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona barashobora kubona neza amagambo namashusho. Ubu bwoko bwa tekinoroji ifasha ni ingirakamaro kubantu bafite icyerekezo gikora; abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kandi icyerekezo gike cyangwa ntagikorwa gikunze gukoresha umusomyi wa ecran.
Uburyo bworoshye bwo gukuza bwerekana igice kinini cyibigize ecran yumwimerere, mu kwibanda, kuburyo gikubiyemo bimwe cyangwa byose byuzuye bya ecran. Igice cyagutse kigomba kubamo ibikubiyemo byinyungu kubakoresha no kwerekana cyangwa indanga, nabyo byagutse neza. Nkuko umukoresha yimura icyerekezo cyangwa indanga ya ecran ya magnifier igomba gukurikirana nayo kandi ikerekana igice kinini cyagutse. Niba uku gukurikirana ari akajagari cyangwa guhindagurika bishoboka guhungabanya umukoresha. Na none, icyerekezo cyangwa indanga ntizishobora kuba ibikubiye mu nyungu: kurugero, niba umukoresha akanze shortcut ya clavier ifungura menu, igice kinini kigomba gusimbuka kuri menu. Geciprocating gait orthose (RGO) ni amaguru orthose aho ingingo zombi zifatanije zifatanije no gusunika - gukurura umugozi cyangwa akabari ku buryo guhinduranya ikibuno kimwe bitanga kwaguka kurindi, bikabyara uburyo bwo guhinduranya icyarimwe muburyo bwo gukumira ikibuno icyarimwe. Igikoresho kigizwe n'imigozi y'amaguru ihujwe na pelvic band, ituma abayikoresha bafite amaguru yamugaye kugirango bagere ku kugenda bahindura ibiro byabo kuruhande.
Ubuvuzi, igihe gito cya buri munsi cyo guhagarara no kugenda muri RGO bishobora gufasha kurwanya ikoreshwa rya osteoporose, kugabanya ibyago byo kurwara ibisebe, kubyutsa ibikorwa byumutima ndetse no kuzamura imibereho myiza yimitekerereze yemerera imikoranire kurwego rwamaso ndetse nizindi ngingo.
Amahugurwa no kuyashyira mubikorwa.
Amahugurwa ya protocole mubisanzwe iteza imbere ahagarara muburyo bwo gusubiranamo cyangwa se busobetse tubangikanye, hanyuma akajya hejuru yubutaka hamwe na lofstrand inkoni yimbere yintoki hamwe na cuff; guhuza neza no kubungabunga ni ngombwa, nkibikwiye cyangwa uburemere bwibikoresho bikabije bizwi ko bihanura gutererana. Kubera iyo mpamvu, isuzuma ryiki gihe riratanga inama yo guhitamo neza abarwayi bafite ubumuga butandukanye, kuvura physiotherapie no kwishyiriraho intego zifatika kugirango barusheho kuvura agaciro ka RGOs mugihe bemera imikorere yabo mike nkuburyo bwo kwigenga kure.

Rear Window Captioning System (RWC) nuburyo bwo kwerekana, binyuze mumutwe, inyandiko mvugo yigice cyamajwi ya firime mumikino yabantu bafite ubumuga bwo batumva kandi batumva. Sisitemu yatunganijwe na WGBH na Rufus Butler Seder.
Mu nzira binjira mu ikinamico, abayireba bafata ikibaho cya pulasitike cyerekana cyashyizwe ku gihingwa cyoroshye. Ikibaho giteye mubikombe cyangwa hasi yegeranye nintebe. LED nini yerekana yashyizwe kurukuta rwinyuma rwerekana inyuguti zanditse mumashusho yindorerwamo. Abareba bimura panne mumwanya mubusanzwe munsi ya ecran ya firime kugirango basome ibisobanuro byanditse buzwi mundimi zamahanga nka subtitles kandi barebe firime. Rimwe na rimwe birakenerwa kwicara mukarere runaka ka theatre kugirango tubone inguni nziza yo kwerekana inyandiko yinyuma yasohotse inyuma yikinamico ku kibaho ndetse tunabasha kureba firime icyarimwe.
Rear Window Captioning yanditseho nubundi buryo bwo gufungura ibisobanuro, aho inyandiko igaragara burundu. Gufungura ibisobanuro byanditse ntibyakoreshejwe cyane kubera gutinya ko byinjiye cyane kandi bigaragara kubumva ndetse nabafite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Ariko, nta bushakashatsi bwakozwe kugirango abantu bumve ibitekerezo byukuntu bazahuza nibisobanuro byanditse kuri ecran. Inyuma ya Window yanditseho nuburyo bwo gufunga ibisobanuro kuko abareba bagomba guhitamo kureba ibisobanuro.
Kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, ibisobanuro byamajwi (Serivise yerekana amashusho, DVS) bishobora kandi mubisanzwe byoherezwa hamwe nibisobanuro. Abareba bumva ibisobanuro bakoresheje na terefone idafite umugozi.
Mu matangazo menshi ya firime na sinema runaka, incamake ya "RWC" ikoreshwa cyane, nkuko incamake ya CC ikoreshwa kugirango yerekane ko hari ibisobanuro byafunzwe kuri televiziyo. Akenshi, inyandiko ya "RWC / DVS" ikoreshwa, byerekana ko haboneka Byombi Byerekana rear window captioning system ryanditse hamwe na Serivise ya Video isobanura.

PB / 5 pedestrian crossing button cyangwa amajwi ya tactile yabanyamaguru ni uburyo bwo kwambukiranya abanyamaguru bufasha abumva no kutabona neza.
iyi sisitemu yakorewe mu gihugu cya Ositaraliya mu 1984 kandi igaragara ahantu nyabagendywa muri Ositaraliya, Irilande, Nouvelle-Zélande, Singapore na Amerika. ryari riyobowe nuwashushanyaga inganda David Wood, injeniyeri acoustique Louis Challis, n’umuhanda n’ubuyobozi bw’umuhanda (RTA) Frank Hulscher.
Bitewe no kuvuza amajwi menshi yo kuburira abantu, hamwe na majwi ya tactile yiri sisitemu yerekana amajwi, ni urugero rwingaruka zo kugabanya: igishushanyo mbonera cy’ubumuga nacyo kigirira akamaro abandi bakoresha. Muri iki gihe, beeping ituma abantu baba maso kandi bakamenya umutekano wumuhanda. PB / 5 yagaragaye mu ngoro ndangamurage za Ositaraliya [] "binyamakuru" byigisha.
PB / 5 pedestrian crossing button yagenewe gufasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona no kutumva. Isohora amajwi aranguruye kandi yinjyana ihindura amajwi n'umuvuduko byerekana uko ibimenyetso byambukiranya: amajwi atontoma atinda ngo "ntugende" (bisobanurwa muri patenti nk "ijwi rya locator") hamwe na "tick-tock-tick-tock" byihutirwa byerekana igihe cyo kwambuka. "Kapow!" menyesha abumva impinduka muri leta. hifashishijwe mikoro ikurikirana buri gihe urusaku rwumuhanda, kugirango ikomeze kumvikana hejuru yacyo.
Ifite kandi umwambi munini ushushanyijeho kumwanya wambere werekana icyerekezo cyo kwambuka. Imiterere ya tactile yo gushushanya igamije gukora ifatanije na pave ya tactile kugirango birinde urujijo. ["Ibisobanuro bikenewe"] Yateguwe kandi mu gufasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kuko umwambi ushushanyijeho ku rubaho rw'imbere uhinda umushyitsi hamwe na injyana ya injyana, bigatuma abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva berekana ibimenyetso byihuse kandi byoroheje byerekana igihe bagomba kwambuka.
Ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda byerekana amajwi ya PB / 5 byakorewe mu ndirimbo nyinshi, harimo nka " Bad Guy " ya Billie Eilish na "Gucana amatara" ya Giuseppe Ottaviani.

Kells crozier cyangwa "Ingoro Ndangamurage y'Ubwongereza Crozier" ni Crozier niyo muri Irlande yo hambere. Bizwi cyane nka "Kells Crozier", byerekana gufatanya na Abbey ba Kells, nubwo nta kimenyetso kibigaragaza kibaho, kandi abahanga mu by'amateka benshi bemeza ko ari ibimenyetso bidashidikanywaho. Crozier ntago yuzuye, nubwo bimwe mubisharizo bimeze nabi.
Inkomoko yabyo mbere yuko igaragara mu kugurishwa i Londres mu 1850 iyaje kubura ratakara, kandi iri mu bigize icyegeranyo cy’ingoro z'umurage w'u Bwongereza kuva mu 1859.
Kells Crozier yakozwe nabanyabukorikori batandukanye mu byiciro bitatu bitandukanye hagati yikinyejana cya 9 na 11 nyuma ya Yesu. Mugihe intandaro ya crozier ari igiti gikozwe mu ifeza kandi abakozi bapfundikijwe mu rupapuro ruvanze n'umuringa nyuma yaje gutwikirizwa ifeza cyangwa udusimba twuzuyemo intera y'inyamaswa zisanzwe muri kiriya gihe. mugihe umutwe wumuntu ushyirwa kumatonyanga kumpera ya crook. Aha niho crozier yaba yarigeze gufata ibisigisigi byera. Isahani yamanutse yigeze gufata igice cyigiciro cyagaciro ubu cyatakaye.
Uburebure bwuzuye bupima nka 133 cm.
Inkomoko n'ibimenyetso.
Munsi yigitereko cyanditseho handitsweho ikilatini kivanze n’ururimi rwa kera rwo muri Irilande: "ordo conduilis ocius do mel finnen", bisobanuwe hafi, isaba abasaba gusengera Cúduilig na Maelfinnén bagize uruhare runini cyane mu kuyivugurura. Intiti zerekanye aya mazina n'abantu ku giti cyabo bari bafitanye isano n’imiturire ikomeye yo muri Irilande i Kells, County Meath. Nyamara, ubushakashatsi buherutse gutera gushidikanya kuriyi sano.
Crozier yabonetse nta bisobanuro mu kabati k'ibiro by'abunganizi ba Londere mugihugu cy'ubwongereza hagati mu kinyejana cya cumi n'icyenda. Yari iy'aba nyirayo benshi, barimo Cardinal Wiseman (1802–1865), mbere yo kugurwa n'inzu ndangamurage y'Ubwongereza akaba ariyo iri kureberera Kells crozier.

Ray Super Remote nigikoresho gikora kuri ecran ya kure igenzura ibyo kureba no kugenzura urugo rwawe mu rwego rw'umutekeno. Igicuruzwa kigizwe na touchscreen ya kure na stand yo kwishyuza. Ikirangantego gishobora kugenzura TV, agasanduku k'insinga, imashini zakira, abakinyi ba Blu-ray, imashini yimikino hamwe namatara yubwenge hamwe na thermostat.
Ray Super Remote yashinzwe na Ray Enterprises iherereye mu mujyi wa New York itangira mu Kwakira 2015. Muri Gashyantare 2017, Ray Enterprises yirukanye abakozi bose ihagarika ubucuruzi bwayo.

Lightning Switch ni sisiteme ya tekinoroji idafite amashanyarazi kandi idafite amashanyarazi ikoreshwa na PulseSwitch Systems, umunyamuryango wa The Face Companies Group of Norfolk, Virginia. Irakoreshwa cyane nkumucyo utagira umugozi.
Imashanyarazi ikwirakwiza ntisaba isoko y'amashanyarazi. Igihe cyose kanda ya transmitter, imashini itanga imbaraga zi mashini zitangwa nurutoki rwumukoresha mumashanyarazi kugirango itange radiyo kubakira / kwifashisha generator ya piezoelectric (izina ryikirango: Umurabyo) yahimbwe nubuyobozi bwigihugu gishinzwe indege n’ikirere. Iri koranabuhanga ryasobanuwe mu nomero ya 2005 yikinyamakuru NASA "Spinoff".
Lightning Swith muri Concept Home 2007 i Omaha, muri Nebraska, igice cyubufatanye mu guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga mu miturire (PATH) cyahujwe n’ishami ry’Amerika rishinzwe imiturire n’iterambere ry’imijyi.
Lightning byizwe numujyanama wa HUD Newport Partners, LLC ya Davidsonville, Maryland muri Amerika.
Lightning Switch yatsindiye igihembo cya NOVA 2006, icyubahiro mpuzamahanga mpuzamahanga cyo guhanga udushya mubikorwa byubwubatsi.
Mu Kwakira 2007, NASA yavuze ko akazi ka generator y’umurabyo piezoelectric muri Lightning Switch ari bumwe mu buhanga 20 bwa mbere bwa spinoff bwakozwe mu myaka itanu ishize, bushingiye ku bintu nk’ubuzima bwiza, inyungu z’ubukungu, n’agaciro byagarutse kuri NASA.
Muri Werurwe 2008, Umurabyo wahinduwe kandi utoranijwe nkuwatsindiye igihembo cya SPIE Smart Structures Award 2008.
Muri 2012, Umurabyo wahinduwe Umwanya wemejwe na Space Foundation.

Extron, yahoze yitwa Extron Electronics, ni uruganda rukora ibikoresho byamajwi byumwuga. Ifite icyicaro i Anaheim, muri Californiya. Extron ikora ibiro birenga 30 hamwe namahugurwa yo mukarere hamwe n’ibikorwa byo kwerekana ku isi.
Ibicuruzwa bya Extron bikoreshwa muguhuza amashusho na nikorana buhanga rya mudasobwa, guhinduranya, no gukwirakwiza ibimenyetso kubigaragaza byumwuga hamwe na umushinga. Isosiyete ni ISO 9001: 2015 yemejwe
Muri 2004, Extron yinjiye muri sisitemu yo kugenzura isoko. Ubu itanga uburyo bwo kugenzura ndetse no gutunganya amajwi, buto ya buto, gukoraho, hamwe nibisubizo byinshi bya software. Muri 2010, Extron yaguze igabana ryibicuruzwa bya Electrosonic.
Muri 2012 Extron yafunguye amagorofa yo gukoreramo yayo atandatu, metero kare 200.000 icyicaro gikuru ku isi muri Anaheim; harimo ikigo cyamahugurwa, inkunga ya tekiniki n'ibiro byo kwamamaza, hamwe na resitora yitwa Ubworozi.
Muri 2014, Extron yinjiye mwisoko ryo gufata amasomo hamwe nibikoresho byuma bifata ibimenyetso bya videwo.

Universal Receivel mubisanzwe ni radiyo yakira kandi ishoboye gukorana na transmitter zitandukanye.
Mugihe habayeho Automation cyangwa uburyo bwikora, ibi byerekana imashini yakira radio ikorana nigenzura rya kure hafi yisoko mubisanzwe, ikoreshwa mugukingura amarembo, inzugi za garage, inzitizi zumuhanda, inzugi zinjira, nibindi. Muyandi magambo, uwakiriye kwisi yose arashobora kumenya code yoherejwe nubundi buryo busanzwe kandi butari busanzwe bwa kure, kandi birakwiriye gusimbuza iyakirwa ryemerera kongeramo ibishya kandi bitandukanye bigenzura kuri sisitemu yo gutangiza.
Gufungura urugi rwa mbere rwamashanyarazi rwakozwe mumwaka wa 1921 na CG Johnson. Yatahuye ko hari ikibazo cyuko inzugi za garage ziri munzira mugihe bikenewe gukingurwa agashaka igisubizo cyahindura uburyo abanyamerika bazamura inzugi za garage ubuziraherezo. Yayise "umuryango wa garage uzamura hejuru." Mugihe iki gihangano cyakozwe abantu benshi bahanahana amafarashi kandi amabisi basabiraga uburyo bunoze. Kubwibyo, CG Johnson yaremye "urugi rwo hejuru rwo kuzamura urugi rwa garage" rwazamuye kandi ruva mu nzira rwose kandi ntirwatwara umwanya kuko rwazamutse aho kuba uruhande rumwe.
Hamwe nimikoreshereze ya "Universal Receivers" irashobora gukoreshwa mubuzima bwa buri munsi ifasha nyirurugo usanzwe kuzamura inzugi za garage. Ibi bikoreshwa mugukingura gufunga cyangwa gufungura kuzimya ibikoresho cyangwa ibice binini byimashini. Naho amasosiyete manini ibi nabyo birakenewe mugihe cyo gutumiza cyangwa kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze bigiye bitandukanye. Byasaba akazi kenshi kugirango uzamure intoki inzugi nini za garage no gufungura amarembo aremereye. Urundi rugero ni abafungura amarembo y'amashanyarazi. Ibi birashobora gukoreshwa kubafungura amarembo yumuriro murwego rwabaturanyi kubwumutekano. Aho kugira ngo umuntu atware intoki imbere yabaturanyi iyo umushyitsi ageze kode irashobora gutangwa kuburyo burigihe burigihe kode yinjijwe imiryango y amarembo irakingura byikora.

Ikinyamakuru Braille nikinyamakuru cyimpapuro cyanditse muburyo bwa braille.
Ibinyamakuru byinshi bisanzwe bitanga ibipapuro zahinduwe, zacapwe muburyo rimwe na rimwe bita "Kanda Braille".

Communication access realtime translation (CART), byitwa kandi gufungura ibisobanuro cyangwa kwandikirwa igihe cyangwa kwandikirwa igihe nyacyo, ni izina rusange ry'imikorere ikoreshwa n'abandika amagambo y'ibiganiro (stenographe) n'abandi mu bahindura ijwi cyangwa amagambo yauzwe mu nyandiko. Umukoresha watojwe yandika amagambo nyayo yavuzwe akoresheje clavier idasanzwe ya fonetike, cyangwa uburyo bwa stenografiya, atanga ibisobanuro byizewe kandi by'ukuri byerekanwa kubakira kuri ecran, mudasobwa igendanwa, cyangwa ikindi gikoresho. Abanyamwuga ba CART bafite ubumenyi bwo kongerera ubumenyi (umuvuduko nukuri) ugereranije nabanyamakuru binkiko nabandi ba stenographe.
Porogaramu imvugo-y-inyandiko ikoreshwa nabanditsi bijwi kugirango batange CART.
CART ni ingirakamaro mu gutuma itumanaho rigera kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva cyangwa kutumva neza,kuko igihe cyo kuvuga-ku-gihe gikora benshi bafite ikibazo cyo kutumva no kutumva. Ibisobanuro byateganijwe n’amategeko y’abanyamerika bafite ubumuga (ADA) nkimfashanyo cyangwa serivisi zifasha. Mu ishuri rifite abanyeshuri batumva cyangwa batumva neza, CART nuburyo bwiza bwo gukoresha bufatanije cyangwa aho gusobanura ururimi rw amarenga, icyakora, icyemezo cyafashwe kijyanye nigikoresho kigomba gukoreshwa kigomba gushingira kubyo abantu bakeneye serivisi bakeneye. Igiciro cya serivisi CART kiri hagati ya $ 60 kugeza 200 $ kumasaha. Kubera iyo mpamvu, abantu bamwe bareba Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) nka serivisi ihendutse. Ariko, ASR ntabwo isobanutse neza kandi irashobora gutinda kubisubizo, bigatuma bidafite akamaro mubihe byishuri. CART ishobora kandi gufasha abantu ururimi rwabo rwa mbere rutandukanye n'ururimi rukoreshwa, kugirango basobanukirwe n'abavuga bafite amajwi n'imivugire itandukanye mu bihe byinshi by'amatsinda (mu kazi, mu mashuri, mu bikorwa by'umuryango) kugira ngo babone " inyandiko y'ibivuga" kandi ibafashe no kwiga indimi.
CART ya kure ikorwa hamwe nu mukoresha wahuguwe ahantu kure. Ihuza ry'ijwi nka terefone, terefone igendanwa, cyangwa mikoro ya mudasobwa ikoreshwa mu kohereza ijwi kubakoresha, kandi inyandiko nyayo yoherejwe inyuma kuri modem, interineti, cyangwa andi makuru ahuza.
Mu bihugu bimwe, CART irashobora kwitwa Palantype, Velotype, STTR (kuvuga-inyandiko-mvugo).

ColorADD ni uburyo bw'amarangamutima cyangwa ibimenyetso bigenewe gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kumenya amabara, ubu buryo bwashyizweho n'umunyabugeni w'umunyaPorutugali akaba n'umwarimu muri kaminuza ya Minho,witwa Miguel Neiva. Igizwe na geometrike ishushanya amabara hamwe namabara. Porogaramu yatsindiye icyiciro cya Vodafone Foundation Mobile 2013 Ibihe byiza byu Burayi.
Kode ishingiye ku bimenyetso bitanu shingiro: inyabutatu ebyiri (imwe izengurutse hejuru indi ijya hepfo), umurongo umwe wa diagonal, agasanduku kamwe kare kare hamwe nagasanduku kare kare karimo umukara, umweru n'amabara y'ibanze yerekana ibara rya RYB: umutuku, ubururu, n'umuhondo. Amabara akomoka ku yandi mabara afite ibimenyetso byamabara ahuriweho, arema amabara akomoka (orange, icyatsi, umutuku nubururu) nijwi ryijimye cyangwa ryera. Amabara y'icyuma nka feza cyangwa zahabu yerekanwa hamwe n'ibumoso ibumoso ku bimenyetso.
Gukoresha no kumenyekana.
Kuva yashingwa, ColorADD yakoreshejwe muri serivisi zitandukanye, cyane cyane muri Porutugali:
Yamenyekanye kandi na kaminuza ya Buenos Aires na TEDx Porto.
Muri Nzeri 2017, Mattel yashyize ahagaragara amabara meza ya Uno akoresha ColorADD.
Amafaranga no kugabanya imikoreshereze.
Sisitemu ifite uburenganzira ; ntabwo iri murwego rusange, ntanubwo yabiherewe uburenganzira. Imikoreshereze igomba gutangirwa uruhushya na sosiyete yigenga yunguka "Miguel Neiva &amp; Associados - igishushanyo mbonera cya gráfico, Lda." n'amafaranga ntabwo ari rusange. Ukurikije ColorADD "amafaranga yimpushya ahindurwa kumwirondoro wa mugenzi wawe". Hariho moderi ya bono gusa kumashuri makuru na kaminuza bicungwa na ONG idaharanira inyungu "ColorADD." "Imibereho".
Kimwe mu bintu nyamukuru binenga sisitemu ya ColorADD ni uko bimwe mu bimenyetso by'amabara bishobora kwitiranya iyo bihinduwe, bisa nuburyo imibare yicyarabu 6 na 9 ari amashusho yindorerwamo. Kurugero, ibimenyetso bihagarariye umutuku n'ubururu byombi bikoresha umuzenguruko (triangle) usa, ariko werekejwe mubyerekezo bitandukanye, naho ibimenyetso by'icyatsi na orange bikaba bisa nk'ishusho y'indorerwamo (mirror image) y'ubundi.
Mu mikoreshereze imwe n'imwe, iki kibazo cyakemuwe hiyongeraho umurongo ngenderwaho kugirango werekane hepfo yikimenyetso, muburyo busa nuburyo imibare itandatu nicyenda yicyarabu ishobora gusobanurwa. Ibi byongera urusaku kubishushanyo kandi birashobora kugabanya umuvuduko wo kumenya ibimenyetso bimwe na bimwe bya ColADAD. Mugihe imibare yicyarabu yabayeho hashize ibinyejana byinshi, sisitemu ya vuba ya ColADADD yashoboraga kuba yarakozwe mubitekerezo.
Amabara akoreshwa nka code.
Mubihe byinshi, amabara akoreshwa nka code yikindi kintu. Muri ibi bihe, guhitamo ibara akenshi uko bishakiye. Gukoresha ibimenyetso byamabara birashobora kongeramo urwego rutari rukenewe rwo kwerekera hamwe nibindi bimenyetso bitaziguye ni amahitamo meza.
Kurugero, amabara yashizwe kumurongo kurikarita yo gutwara abantu uko bishakiye. Nka ibara, akenshi bahabwa ibaruwa cyangwa umubare. Aho gusubiramo ibimenyetso bya ColorADD, byaba byiza usubije inyuguti cyangwa umubare kurikarita cyangwa ugahitamo ibara ryiza-palette. Urundi rugero ni amabara ya code ya [gutandukanya imyanda]. Murugero, ibimenyetso byerekana ibishobora gushyirwa muri buri bin byaba byiza cyane.

Cognitive orthotics ni sisitemu zishingiye kuri porogaramu (software) zifasha abantu bafite ubumuga bwo mumitekerereze, nk'abibagirwa,zibibutsa ibintu by'ingenzi mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
Ubumuga bwo mumitekerereze burashobora gutera ibibazo mu bushobozi bwo kwigenga, harimo n'ibikorwa by'ubuzima bwa buri munsi. Abafite ubumuga bworoheje bw’ubwenge barashobora kubona ubumenyi bwigenga buhagije, mu gihe abashyizwe mu majwi nk’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe budakunze kugera kuri urwo rwego rw'ubwigenge. Mugihe gahunda za mahugurwa zishobora kuba uburyo bwo gucengeza no gushyigikira ubuzima bwigenga, izo gahunda zerekanye intsinzi zitandukanye, bitewe n'umuntu uvugwa nimirimo ashinzwe. Umubare w'intambwe cyangwa ibintu bigoye by'imirimo isanzwe ya buri munsi birashobora gutuma bigora umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutamenya, kandi ikosa mubyiciro byose rishobora kuganisha kubisubizo bitemewe.
Ibikoresho nka mudasobwa byakoreshejwe mu gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abantu bafite ibikomere mu bwonko. Guhera kuri "prostothique memoire" no mu myaka ya za 1980 yerekeza ku gukemura ikibazo cy'ubwonko bukorwa binyuze mu myitozo isubiramo, abahanga mu by'imitekerereze ya muntu ni bo bonyine bakoraga porogaramu ku barwayi bakomeretse mu bwonko, bigatuma porogaramu zihari. Inzobere mu gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe zahisemo imikino yo kuri mudasobwa iboneka mu bucuruzi ishimishije cyane, ishishikaje, isubiramo, kandi ishimishije, yerekana ingaruka zishobora gukosorwa ku mikorere mibi ya neuropsychologue. Ibyavuye mu bikorwa bya mbere byo gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe mudasobwa byagabanijwe kandi, mu bice byinshi, ntibyari byitezwe. Mugihe imyitozo isubiramo yatezimbere imikorere mubikorwa byihariye byakorwaga, iyi ngaruka ntabwo yageze no mubindi bikorwa.
Abantu bashobora kungukira mur cognitive orthotics barimo abasaza cyangwa abakuze, abantu bagize impanuka z'ingenge(TBI), abantu bafite ibibazo byo kwibagirwa, cyangwa ufite ubundi bumuga bwo mu mitekerereze cyangwa mu mikurirre. Porogaramu irashobora kuba ikubiyemo ibintu byo kwiga imashini, ubwenge bwubukorikori, hamwe no kumenya imiterere kugirango ihuze ibyifuzo byabantu muburyo bukwiye.

Ikiranga ifaranga rya Kanada kiranga urutonde rwinoti zo muri Kanada Urugendo na Frontier inoti zo muri Kanada kugirango zifashe abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kumenya inoti. Icyo kimenyetso cyerekana agaciro k'urupapuro rw'ifaranga cyangwa inoti mu gice cyo hejuru ibumoso ku ruhande rwo imbere rw'ifaranga, hakoreshewje urukurikirane rw'utudomo twazamuwe. Byasabwe na Bruno Thériault, umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'igihugu cya Kanada gishinzwe abatabona, kandi cyateguwe na Susan Lederman, umwarimu w’imyororokere muri kaminuza ya Mwamikazi.
Nubwo bisa nkaho bigaragara kuri braille, biratandukanye kuko Braille isanzwe yabonaga ko ikabije. Butler in a Box yari igikoresho cya hambere cyo murugo cyagenzura n'amajwi, cyakozwe mu 1983 cyakozwe n'umupfumu Gus Searcy hamwe na Franz Kavan umuporogaramu. Igikoresho cyemereye abakoresha kugenzura ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki byo murugo, nk'amatara na terefoni, bakoresheje amategeko y'ijwi. Byabanjirije abavuga ubwenge bigezweho hamwe nabafasha basanzwe mumyaka mirongo.
Igitekerezo cya Butler in a Box cyatangiye mu 1983 ubwo Searcy yabazwaga n'inshuti impamvu adashobora gutegeka gusa amatara gucana no kuzimya niba ashobora gukuramo inkwavu mu ngofero, bitewe n'amateka ye nk'umupfumu wabigize umwuga. Searcy yafatanije nu wahoze ari programu wa IBM Kavan guteza imbere icyo gikoresho, prototype yabo ya mbere yiswe "Sidney". Butler in a box yahujije tekinoroji yo kugenzura kure hamwe no kumenya amajwi kugirango igenzure ibikoresho byo murugo. Nyamara, yahuye n’ibibazo bitewe n’ikoranabuhanga rigezweho muri iki gihe hamwe n’igiciro cyayo cyo hejuru cy’amadolari 1.500 (ahwanye n’amadolari 3.700 muri 2021).

Byongeye kandi, igenamigambi hamwe namabwiriza yatojwe yatakara mugihe ingufu zashize mumasaha arenga 3 kubera tekinoroji yo kwibuka ihindagurika yakoreshejwe icyo gihe.

The Rehabilitation Engineering and Assistive Technology Society of North America(RESNA) ni ihuriro ry'abantu bafite inyungu mu bijyanye n'ikoranabuhanga rifasha abantu bafite n'ubumuga. Inshingano zayo zerekana ko intego ya RESNA ari ukuzamura ubushobozi bw’abafite ubumuga kugera ku ntego zabo hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga binyuze mu guteza imbere ubushakashatsi, iterambere, uburezi, ubuvugizi no gutanga ikoranabuhanga; no mugushyigikira abatanga serivise yikoranabuhanga itanga ibikorwa.
RESNA yatangiye muri Kanama 1979. Mu 1993 RESNA yabaye umuryango wigenga. RESNA ifite abanyamuryango barenga 1.000, igice kinini cyabo kikaba cyibanze muri Amerika na Kanada.
Guhera mu 1995, RESNA yateguye gahunda yo gutanga impamyabumenyi kubanyamwuga bakora nkabatanga serivise zikoranabuhanga. Mu Kuboza 2015, Sosiyete ishinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe Rehabilitation Engineering Assistive Technology Society yo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru (RESNA) yavuguruye ibipimo bya WC18 ku bipimo by’ibimuga hamwe na sisitemu yo kubuza abayigana (WTORS) ibipimo by’ibimuga hamwe na sisitemu yo kubuza abantu (WTORS). RESNA iyobowe n'Inama y'Ubuyobozi igizwe n'abantu 14. Perezida ni Roger O. Smith, PhD, OT, FAOTA, Mugenzi wa RESNA

Smart Device nigikoresho cya elegitoronike, muri rusange gihujwe nibindi bikoresho cyangwa imiyoboro ikoresheje protocole itandukanye (nka Bluetooth, Zigbee, itumanaho hafi y’umurima, Wi-Fi, NearLink, Li-Fi, cyangwa 5G) ishobora gukora ku rugero runaka mu buryo bwikora kandi bwigenga. ndetse n'ubwoko butandukanye bwibikoresho byubwenge ni terefone zigendanwa, abavuga rikoresha ubwenge, imodoka zifite ubwenge, amakarita yubwenge, thermostat yubwenge, inzogera zumuryango, gufunga ubwenge, firigo zikoresha ubwenge, fableti na tableti, amasaha yubwenge, bande yubwenge, urufunguzo rwubwenge, ibirahuri byubwenge, TV yubwenge, nibindi byinshi. Ijambo rishobora kandi kwerekeza ku gikoresho cyerekana ibintu bimwe na bimwe byo kubara hose, harimo - nubwo atari ngombwa - kwiga imashini.
Ibikoresho byubwenge bishobora gushushanywa kugirango bishyigikire ibintu bitandukanye byuburyo butandukanye, ndetse n'ibintu bitandukanye bijyanye na comptabilite ahantu hose kandi bigakoreshwa muburyo butatu bwa sisitemu yibidukikije: isi yumubiri, ibidukikije bishingiye kubantu, hamwe nogukwirakwiza mudasobwa. Amazu yubwenge yerekana ko hari sensor hamwe nibikoresho bimwe na bimwe byerekana, ibikoresho, hamwe nububikoshingiro bwo kubigenzura.
Mu 1991, Mark Weiser yagaragaje uburyo butatu bwibanze bwibikoresho bya sisitemu ahantu hose: tabs, padi na kibaho.
Ubu buryo butatu bwagaragajwe na Weiser burangwa na macro nini, ifite formari planar hamwe no gushiramo amashusho yerekanwe. Ibi kandi byarebwaga byinshi nkibikoresho byamakuru. Niba buri kimwe muri ibyo biranga cyoroheje, uru rwego rushobora kwagurwa muburyo butandukanye kandi bushobora kuba ingirakamaro mubikoresho byo kubara hose.
Ibikoresho byubwenge mubusanzwe bigizwe nicyuma (harimo na radio itanga ibimenyetso), urwego rwumuyoboro (unyuzamo ibikoresho bivugana nka telephone n'ibindi), hamwe nurwego rusaba (abakoresha amaherezo batanga amategeko). Izi nzego akenshi zirimo ibintu bikurikira:
Ubwoko busanzwe bwibikoresho byubwenge birimo:
Ibikoresho byose bibarwa.
