ATutor ni sisitemu yo ku rubuga rwa interineti ishingiye ku bumenyi bwo kwiga (LMS) ifunguye ku bantu bose (open source).
ATutor ikoreshwa mu buryo butandukanye, harimo gucunga amasomo ku murongo, gukomeza iterambere ry'umwuga ku barimu, guteza imbere umwuga, n'ubushakashatsi bw'amasomo. Porogaramu ivugwa ko idasanzwe kubera uburyo bwo kuyigeraho, (ingirakamaro ku bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona); hamwe n'uburyo bukwiye bwo gukoresha uburezi ukurikije ibipimo ngenderwaho byo gusuzuma sofutiweya(software) byashyizweho na Sosiyete y'Abanyamerika ishinzwe Amahugurwa n'Iterambere (ASTD). ATutor ikoreshwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga kandi yahinduwe cyangwa yashyizwe mu ndimi zirenga cumi n'eshanu, ifite kandi inkunga y'izindi ndimi zirenga mirongo ine ziri mu bikorwa byo gutezwa imbere muri iki gihe.
ATutor niyo LCMS yambere yubahirije byimazeyo ibisobanuro bya W3C WCAG 1.0 kurwego rwa AA +, yemerera kugera kubintu byose bikubiye muri sisitemu murwego rwose rwabakoresha-uburenganzira, harimo na konti zabayobozi. Kuba ATutor yujuje ibisabwa na XHTML 1.0 bigamije kwemeza ko igaragarira neza kandi igakora kimwe ku ikoranabuhanga ryose ryemewe.
Abashinzwe iterambere rya ATutor bemeza ko ari yo yonyine igera kuri porogaramu ya LCMS ku isoko, harimo amafaranga yishyurwa kandi ifunze isoko. Iyi ngingo ya ATutor yemejwe byibuze muri kaminuza imwe yatangajwe na software. ATutor avugwa kandi mubisobanuro byinshi bya tekiniki hamwe nubumenyi; nibindi byinshi byiyongera mugice cya gatatu byateguwe kandi bikwirakwizwa kugirango bikoreshe hamwe na software.
ATutor yarekuwe bwa mbere mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2002.Byaje bisubiza ubushakashatsi bubiri bwakozwe na rwiyemezamirimo mu myaka yashize bwarebaga uburyo bwo kwiga kuri interineti ku bafite ubumuga. Ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi byerekanaga ko nta na kimwe muri gahunda yo Kwiga yo Kwiga ikunzwe muri kiriya gihe ndetse yatanze ibisobanuro bike hamwe n'amabwiriza yo kugerwaho. Icyo gihe impumyi urugero, ntishobora kwitabira byimazeyo amasomo yo kumurongo.
Babiri, muri benshi, ibiboneka muri sisitemu ni inyandiko isimburana kubintu byose biboneka, hamwe na clavier igera kubintu byose bya porogaramu. Hamwe nibi bintu, umuntu wimpumyi arashobora kumva ibice byose bya sisitemu abifashijwemo numusomyi wa ecran, kandi arashobora kugera kuri sisitemu adakeneye imbeba. Ibi biranga kandi byemerera ATutor guhuza tekinoloji zitandukanye zirimo terefone ngendanwa, abafasha mu makuru yihariye (PDAs), hamwe n’urubuga rushingiye ku nyandiko, kuvuga amazina make.
ATutor ikubiyemo ibikoresho byandika bikubiyemo abategura gukora ibikoresho byo kwiga byoroshye. Ibisobanuro nkibi bishishikariza abanditsi kongeramo inyandiko iyindi niba bibagiwe gushyiramo imwe mugihe wongeyeho ishusho, kurugero. Igikoresho cyo kwandika kirimo na serivisi y'urubuga rusuzuma uburyo ibintu byemewe byemewe n’ibipimo mpuzamahanga bitandukanye. Usibye gukora ibintu byoroshye, igikoresho ubwacyo kiragerwaho, cyemerera umukoresha wimpumyi gukora ibirimo ubwabo.
ATutor nayo yashizweho kugirango ihuze na kimwe mubintu byinshi byo kwigisha no kwiga. Hariho ibice bine byingenzi byerekana iri hame ryishusho: insanganyamatsiko, uburenganzira, ibikoresho byifashishwa, hamwe nitsinda.
Sisitemu y'insanganyamatsiko ya ATutor yemerera abayobozi guhitamo byoroshye isura n'imiterere ya sisitemu kubyo bakeneye byihariye. Insanganyamatsiko zikoreshwa muguha ATutor isura nshya, gutanga ibyiciro byamasomo uko basa, cyangwa gutanga verisiyo nyinshi za ATutor kuri sisitemu imwe, aho abakoresha bashobora guhitamo imwe nkigice cyo guhitamo.
Sisitemu yuburenganzira (privelage system) yemera abigisha guha abanyeshuri b'itsinda ry'ishuri uburenganzira bwo gucunga ibikoresho by'ishuri. Abigisha barashobora gukora abafasha cyangwa abarimu bigisha bari bafite ubushobozi buke kuri kimwe mubikoresho byandika cyangwa ubuyobozi.
E-kwiga impaka za patenti.
ATutor ni bumwe mu buryo butatu bwo gucunga imyigishirize y’amasoko yitiriwe ikibazo cy’ingutu ku buryo bwa e-kwiga bwatanzwe na Blackboard Inc. muri Nyakanga 2006. Ikigo cyita ku bwisanzure bwa software cyatanze icyifuzo cyo kongera gukora ibizamini mu izina rya ATutor, hamwe n’abandi bakiriya babiri mu mpera za 2006. Mu ntangiriro za 2007 icyifuzo cyo kongera gukora ikizamini cyatanzwe n’ibiro by’Amerika bishinzwe ubucuruzi n’ubucuruzi (USPTO). Niba bigenze neza, icyifuzo kizageraho gihagarike ibirego 44 byose byasabwe na patenti.
Mu rwego rwo gushyigikira imbogamizi kuri patenti ya Blackboard, abakorerabushake kurubuga rwa interineti basanze ingero za porogaramu zishaje zakoresheje ibitekerezo byavuzwe na patenti. Aba bakorerabushake bafatanije gukora inyandiko ya Wikipedia ku mateka y’ibidukikije byigamo, itanga ingero nyinshi zubuhanzi bwambere.
Byongeye kandi, Greg Gay, umuyobozi w’umushinga wa ATutor yashimangiye ko ashyigikiye icyifuzo cyo kongera gukora ibizamini: "Patenti ku gitekerezo cy’uburezi - ni isano iri hagati y’abanyeshuri, abigisha, n’abayobozi - ntabwo byumvikana. Ibitekerezo nkibi ni ibya rubanda kandi byakorwaga mu binyejana byinshi; ntabwo ari ibisubizo by’ubushakashatsi n’iterambere."

The Assistive Technology Industry (ATIA) n’umuryango udaharanira inyungu, ugizwe n'abakora, abacuruza n'abatanga serivisi cyangwa ibikoresho by'ikornabuhanga bifasha abantu bafite ubumuga. ATIA ihagarariye inyungu zabanyamuryango bayo mubucuruzi, guverinoma, uburezi, ninzego nyinshi zikorera ababana nubumuga. Intego imwe ya ATIA ni "kuvugana nijwi rusange" kubutumwa bwayo ni ugukora nk'ijwi rusange ry'inganda zita ku ikoranabuhanga (AT) kugirango ibicuruzwa na serivisi nziza bigezwa ku bafite ubumuga.
ATIA yashinzwe mu 1998, iyobowe n'Inama y'Ubuyobozi igizwe n'abantu 10. ATIA ifite abanyamuryango barenga 120 kugiti cyabo no mubigo. Ibiro byayo biherereye i Chicago, muri Illinois.
Kuva mu 1999, ATIA yakoresheje inama ngarukamwaka zitanga amahuriro y'uburezi n’itumanaho kubimenyereza umwuga bakorera ubumuga. Inama ngarukamwaka irakingurwa kandi ku bafite ubumuga, abarezi babo, abo mu muryango wabo, ndetse n’abaturage muri rusange. Muri 2009, ATIA yatangiye gutanga urubuga rwa interineti rwigisha kugirango rukorere ayo matsinda. ATIA yakoze kandi inama ku bufatanye n’umushinga uhuza akazi hamwe n’umushinga w’ubucuruzi muri Amerika (USBLN). Ibisubizo byatangajwe muri imwe muri iyo nama ni "Ikarita yo Kuzamura Akazi k'abafite ubumuga binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga ryoroshye".
ATIA itanga ikinyamakuru gifasha ikorana buhanga hamwe n'inyungu Ikinyamakuru (ATOB) m'ubufatanye bw'ubumenyi n’ikigo cyihariye gishinzwe ubufasha bw’ikoranabuhanga (Centre SEAT) muri kaminuza ya Leta ya Illinois. ATOB itangaza ingingo zijyanye n'ibisubizo n'inyungu z'ikoranabuhanga rifasha ababana n'ubumuga ubuzima bwabo bwose. ATOB ni urungano rwasuzumwe buri mwaka, rwatangajwe bwa mbere mu 2004.
ATIA igira uruhare mubikorwa bisanzwe byinganda binyuze muri Accessibility Interoperability Alliance (AIA). AIA yatangijwe mu 2007 nk’umuryango wigenga nitsinda ryambere rikoresha ikoranabuhanga (IT) hamwe n’ikoranabuhanga rifasha (AT), abatanga ibikubiyemo, n’indi miryango ikomeye y’ubuhanga. Kuva icyo bagiye bakora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo bateze imbere ibipimo ngenderwaho no gufatanya mu gushakira igisubizo ibibazo bimaze igihe bibangikanya bibangamira iterambere ry’ibisubizo by’abafite ubumuga. Muri 2010 AIA ihinduka ishami rya tekiniki n'ubuhanga muri ATIA.
ATIA ifatanya n’indi miryango mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga no mu bijyanye n’ubumuga mu rwego rwo kuzamura gukoresha no kumenya uburyo ikoranbuhanga rishobora kungura abantu babana ubumuga. Abafatanyabikorwa ba Alliance ni:

Charles Barbier de la Serre (; 18 Gicurasi 1767 - 22 Mata 1841) nibwo yaje guhimba inyandiko ya bafaransa uburyo butandukanye bwo kwandika no gukoresha ubundi buryo bwo kwandika, bumwe muri bwo bukaba bwarahumekeye Braille.
Yasabye uburyo bworoshye bwo kwandika bushingiye kuri gride kandi bwakorohera n'ababana n'ubumuga, yariho muburyo bubiri. Iya mbere ni inyuguti zisanzwe muri gride ya 5x5 (icyo gihe, inyuguti ya W yakoreshwaga gake mu rurimi rwigifaransa).
Hariho na verisiyo ya fonetike, yavugurwagaho amajwi y'ururimi rw'igifaransa. Mu gitabo cya 1815, hari amajwi 30 muri gride y'imirongo itanu n'inkingi esheshatu, ariko Barbier yaje kwagura umubare kugeza kuri 36, muri gride ifite imirongo itandatu n'inkingi esheshatu. Barbier yahisemo verisiyo ya fonetike, avuga ko kwiga amategeko yimyandikire byatanze indi mbogamizi kubatazi gusoma no kwandika.
Nyuma yimyaka, Barbier na Braille bombi bapfuye, Alexandre René Pignier yanditse ubuzima bugufi bwa Louis Braille. Muri yo, yasabye ko Braille, akiri muto cyane, yerekanye inenge za sisitemu ya Barbier. Nyuma abanditsi bashushanyije kuriyi nkuru kugirango basobanure guhura kwangwa hagati ya Barbier na Braille akiri muto cyane. Mubyukuri, bombi ntibabonanye kugeza mu 1833, igihe Braille yari mukuru kandi hashize imyaka ine asohoye sisitemu ye. Barbier na Braille babaye inshuti. Amabaruwa hagati yabo bombi yari meza. Mellor arimo imwe mu mabaruwa yanditse mu gitabo cye kivuga kuri Louis Braille.
Barbier yamaze ubuzima bwe bwose agerageza kumenyekanisha ibitekerezo bye kuburezi rusange. Yanditse ibindi bitabo byinshi kandi agerageza kwinjiza mubantu ibyubu uburyo bwe bwo kwandika kandi bworoshye bwo kwandika arinako abushira mu mumashuri y'incuke, ariko ntibyagerwaho. Ariko, Braille yahinduye sisitemu nibikoresho bya Barbier yabaye sisitemu ikoreshwa kwisi yose muri iki gihe.

Decapoint, cyangwa Raphigraphy, yari uburyo bworoshye bwimyandikire yikilatini yahimbwe na Louis Braille ni sisitemu ikoreshwa mu buryo bw'imyandikire kandi igafasha cyane abantu bafite ibibazo by'ubumuga butandukanye ishobora gukoreshwa nimpumyi nabatabona. Yasohowe mu 1839, nyuma yimyaka icumi nyuma yinyuguti esheshatu zitondetse. Inzandiko zagumanye imiterere yazo, kandi rero byasomwaga nta mahugurwa abareba, ariko imirongo yari igizwe nududomo dushushanyijeho nkayakoreshejwe muri braille. "Decapoint" bivuga sisitemu yo kwandika, mugihe "raphigraphy" ni ugukoresha imashini ya raphigraph kugirango itange inyandiko.
Buri baruwa yari ifite utudomo icumi tureture n'uduto buhinduka, niyo mpamvu izina decapoint. Byanditswe mbere byanditseho icyapa na stylus ; Kugirango inyandiko isomeke neza imbere yurupapuro, yakandagiye inyuma nkishusho yindorerwamo. Iyi nzira yari igoye kandi yatwaraga igihe, kandi inyandiko yari nini idasanzwe.
Mu rwego rwo koroshya inzira yo kwandika inyandiko ya decapoint, Pierre-François-Victor Foucault, munyandiko zakundaga gukoreshwa cyane ikifashishwa, yahimbye igishushanyo mbonera (umwanditsi w'urushinge) mu 1841.
Mugihe decapoint yari ifite inyungu zo kuba abantu basomerwa badafite imyitozo, ntabwo byari byiza cyane kandi bikora neza. Kuba umubare wimyandikire wino wamamaye mu myaka ya za 1880 no guhimba umwanditsi wa braille mu 1892 byagize uruhare mu gucika intege no gushushanya bidakoreshwa. Decapoint rimwe na rimwe yakoreshwaga uko byagenda kose muri 1930.

Moon System ikoreshwa mu Gusoma Ibishushanyo (bakunze kwita ukwezi kwandikwa, Inyuguti zukwezi, inyandiko yukwezi, ubwoko bwukwezi, cyangwa code yukwezi) nuburyo bwo kwandika bwimpumyi, ukoresheje ibimenyetso bishushanyije ahanini biva mumyandikire yikilatini (ariko byoroshe). Bivugwa n'abayishyigikiye ko byoroshye kubyumva kuruta braille, nubwo ikoreshwa cyane cyane nabantu bataye amaso nkabantu bakuru, bityo bakaba bafite ubumenyi bwimiterere yinyuguti.
Iyi nyandiko yitiriwe Moon Type yakozwe na William Moon (1818—1894), umwongereza w'impumyi uba i Brighton, mu burasirazuba bwa Sussex. Nyuma yo kugira umuriro utukura, Moon yabuze amaso afite imyaka 21 aba umwarimu wabana batabona. Yabonye ko abanyeshuri be bagize ikibazo cyo kwiga gusoma uburyo buriho bwo gusoma kodegisi yo gusoma, maze ategura sisitemu ye bwite "izakingurwa kandi isobanutse neza."
Moon type yatangijwe mu 1843 William kandi asohora gahunda muri 1845. Ukwezi ntabwo kuzwi nka braille, ariko nubundi buryo bw'agaciro. gukoraho gahunda yo gusoma kubantu batabona cyangwa batabona igice cyimyaka yose.

New York Point (Ingingo ya New York:.​​ Sisitemu yakoresheje imwe kugeza kuri ebyiri zingingo zashyizwe kumurongo, buri kimwe kirimo utudomo tumwe cyangwa tubiri. (Inyuguti imwe kugeza kuri ebyiri, buri imwe ifite utudomo tubiri, yaba ⟨: ⟩ ⟨:: ⟩ ⟨::: ⟩ ⟨::::) Inyuguti zisanzwe zanditswe hamwe ningingo nkeya ⟩ ingamba nazo zikoreshwa na Braille y'Abanyamerika ubu bwoko bw'imyandikire yashyizweho kugirango ifashe abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.
Inyuguti nkuru zari zigoye muri iyi sisitemu yitiriwe New York Point, buri imwe yari utudomo tune, kandi ntabwo yakoreshejwe muri rusange. Mu buryo nk'ubwo, muri rusange hashyizweho utudomo tune twagutse na apostrophe. Iyo, inyuguti nkuru, cyangwa intumwa byakoreshwaga, rimwe na rimwe byatezaga ibibazo byemewe, kandi ikimenyetso cyihariye ntigishobora kumvikana. Helen Keller akomeza avuga ko ibyo byateje ibibazo byo gusoma no kwandika mu bana bafite ubumuga bwo kutamenya, kandi ni imwe mu mpaka zikomeye zashinjaga New York Point ndetse no gushyigikira imwe mu nyuguti z’inyuguti.
Iyi sisitemu yitiriwe New York Point ntabwo yakorewe mu buryo bwa Unicode, nkuko verisiyo ya 14.0. Kimwe na braille, hariho kwikuramo: inyuguti imwe muri New York Point ihuye nurutonde rwinyuguti zacapwe.
Ingingo ya New York isomwa uhereye ibumoso ugana iburyo. Ikimenyetso kigizwe na selile imwe kugeza enye zikurikiranye buri ngingo ebyiri hejuru hamwe nubugari bumwe. Inyuguti nkuru zose zigizwe na selile enye, mugihe minuscules ihagarariwe numwe kugeza kuri batatu. Buri nyuguti nkuru yakomotse ku nyuguti ntoya ihuye ninyongera ingirabuzimafatizo imwe kugirango inyuguti nkuru igire ubugari bune. Utugingo ngengabuzima twose ni ingingo yo hasi niba selile yanyuma yinyuguti ntoya ifite gusa ingingo yo hejuru. Bitabaye ibyo, selile ziyongera zose ni ingingo yo hejuru gusa.
Nko muri braille, hari ikimenyetso cyumubare uhindura inyuguti kumibare. Imibare icumi ni imwe ine yerekana utudomo dusanga muri braille, ariko hamwe gusa zose ntago zinganya agaciro:
Utumenyetso twonyine twerekana utudomo dutatu twagutse ni ikimenyetso cyumubare uri hejuru hamwe nikimenyetso cyatanzwe, gifite imiterere imwe ninyuguti "q". Dash, hyphen, na apostrophe ni utudomo tune twagutse.
Inyandiko y'umuziki.
⟨:::: ⟩ is thus a whole C note, ⟨".: ⟩ a quarter D note, etc. In chords, the length is only given for the first note mentioned.
Ibi birashobora kubanzirizwa na ⟨ '⟩ ♯,b ⟨: ⟩ Or, cyangwa ⟨' ⟩ And, kandi byongeweho na ⟨ ⟩ (uburebure × 1½). Ibi birashobora gukuba kabiri, nkuko biri mu icapiro.
Inyandiko ibanzirizwa na octave yayo, yanditswe nkumubare wongeyeho akadomo ko hejuru: ⟨':' ⟩ 5 8va, ⟨ ⟩ 2 8va, nibindi
4th-8va C-whole 5th-inv'l with 5th-8va E

Night Writting ni izina ryahawe uburyo bwo kwandika bwagenewe abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kandi bunakireshywa n'abantu batandukanye bwaritondewe cyane kuko bwahimbwe na Charles Barbier de la Serre (1767–1841). Nuburyo bumwe muburyo butandukanye bwo kwandika bwatanzwe mugitabo cyasohowe mu 1815: "Essai sur divers procédés d'expéditive française, contenant douze écritures différentes, avec une planche pour chaque procédé" (Inyandiko ku nzira zitandukanye z’urugendo rw’Abafaransa, ikubiyemo inyandiko cumi na zibiri zitandukanye, hamwe n'isahani kuri buri nzira). Ijambo (mu gifaransa: "écriture nocturne") ntiriboneka mu gitabo, ariko nyuma ryakoreshejwe ku buryo bwerekanwe ku cyapa cya VII cy'icyo gitabo. Ubu buryo bwo kwandika hamwe nududomo twazamuye dushobora gusomwa no gukoraho byemejwe mu kigo Royale des Jeunes Aveugles (Ikigo cy’umwami cy’urubyiruko rutabona) i Paris mu 1821.
Ihame ryiyi sisitemu ryitiriwe Night Writing rikoreshwa mu kwandukura ukoresheje amajwi 36 atandukanye ya fonetike, buri kimwe kigereranwa nuburyo bwazamuye utudomo muri 2 × Imiyoboro 6.

Uwiteka Was Sceptre (Abanyamisiri "wꜣs" "imbaraga, ubutware") ni ikimenyetso cyagaragaye cyane cyane mubisigisigi, ubuhanzi, ndetse na hieroglyphs bifitanye isano n’idini rya kera rya Misiri. Bigaragara nkumutwe winyamanswa hejuru yumutwe muremure, ugororotse ufite impera.
"was Sceptre yaje gu"koreshwa nk'ikimenyetso cy'imbaraga cyangwa ubutware, kandi yari ifitanye isano n'imana zo mu Misiri za kera nka Set cyangwa Anubisi kimwe na farawo. "Wari" septres nayo igereranya inyamanswa cyangwa Khnum. Mugukoresha nyuma, cyari ikimenyetso cyo kugenzura imbaraga zakajagari Set ihagarariye.
Mu rwego rwo gushyingura,inkoni yitiriwe "Was Sceptre" yari ifite inshingano zo kumererwa neza kwa nyakwigendera bityo rimwe na rimwe ikaba yarashyizwe mu bikoresho byo mu mva cyangwa mu gushushanya imva cyangwa isanduku. Inkoni nayo ifatwa nk'impumyi. Abanyamisiri babonaga ikirere gishyigikiwe n'inkingi enye, zishobora kugira ishusho "ya". Iyi nkoni kandi yari ikimenyetso cya nome ya kane yo mu Misiri yo hejuru, izina rya Thebes (ryitwa "wꜣst" mu Misiri).
inkoni byaje kugaragaza ko yatwawe nimana, farawo, ndestse na bapadiri. kuko Bikunze kugaragara mubishushanyo, gushushanya, no gushushanya imana, kandi akenshi bigereranywa nibimenyetso nka "ankh" na "djed" -inkingi. Ibisigisigi byumubiri "byari" sceptres byabonetse. Zubatswe muri faience cyangwa ibiti, aho umutwe numurizo wumurizo winyamanswa ya Set bigaragara. Ingero za mbere zanditswe ku ngoma ya mbere.

Ubushobozi Scotland yashinzwe ku ya 31 Ukwakira 1946 nitsinda ryababyeyi ninzobere mu by'ubuzima. Intego yayo ya mbere yari ugufasha abana bafite.
Ishuri rya mbere ryafunguwe mu Corstorphine, Edinburgh mu 1948, muri Edinburgh. Mu ntangiriro ya z'imyaka ya 1960, umuryango utabara imbabare watangiye gutegura amahirwe ya akazi kubantu babana n'ubumuga, kandi mu 1973 hashyirwaho inzu ya mbere y’abakuze.
Mu gihe ishuri rya Westerlea rifite icyicaro cya Edinburgh ryafunzwe mu 2016, Ubushobozi bwa Scotland bukora andi mashuri abiri y’ubumenyi bw’inzobere; Inzu ya Stanmore muri Lanark na Corseford School i Kilbarchan.
Umushinga mushya washyizweho mu 2021 wo kubaka inzu nshya yita ku baturage mu iterambere rishya ry’abaturage muri Perth ryitwa Bertha Park. Abagiraneza bagamije kurangiza ibi mu 2026.
Ubushobozi Scotland ni umunyamuryango wa Scotland Afite ubumuga hamwe na Sense Scotland, ENABLE Scotland, RNIB Scotland, Igikorwa cyo Kumva Loss Scotland, hamwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe rya Ecosse.

Tanya Titchkosky (Yabonye izuba 1966) ni ni impuguke yiga ubumuga. Kuva muri Mutarama 2025, ni umwarimu w’ubushakashatsi bw’ubumuga mu kiga cya Ontario gishinzwe ubushakashatsi mu burezi(Ontario Institute for study in Education)
Titchkosky yabonye impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanzi muri sociologiya yakuye muri ikiciro cya mbere cya mubuhanzi kaminuza (master of arts) muri Kanama (1988), impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanzi muri sociologiya yakuye muri kaminuza ya York (1992), na Dogiteri wa Firozofi yakuye muri kaminuza ya York (1997).

key finders, zizwi kandi nka key locators, key locators, cyangwa electronic finders, ni udukoresho duto tw'ikoranabuhanga dushyirwaho ku bintu kugira ngo bifashe kubibona iyo byibwe cyangwa byaburiye aho nko ku imfunguzo, imizigo, isakoshi, igikapu, amatungo, mudasobwa zigendanwa, abana bato, telefoni zigendanwa, ibikoresho, cyangwa ibikoresho, no kohereza imenyesha, urugero, ko ameza ya resitora yiteguye cyangwa umuforomo akenewe. Bimwe muri ibyo bikoresho bitanga amajwi cyangwa bigatanga urumuri rw'amatara igihe ibisabwa.
Icyitegererezo cya mbere cy' ibanze cyabashakishaga cyari gishingiye kumajwi, kandi cyunvaga amashyi cyangwa ifirimbi (cyangwa urukurikirane rumwe), hanyuma bikoreshwa kugirango umukoresha abibone. Kumenya icyakubise agashyi cyangwa ifirimbi byagaragaye ko bigoye, bivamo imikorere mibi no gutabaza. Kubera ubwo bwiza buke kandi butizewe, Ibi bikoresho bya mbere byo gushakisha urufunguzo byaje gutereranywa vvuba kandi ntibyamenyekana cyane mu bikorwa bifite akamaro kenshi.
Mugihe ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki byabaye bito kandi bihendutse, kandi ubuzima bwa bateri bwateye imbere, radio yabaye ingirakamaro kugirango ibone imfunguzo, zashyizwemo imashini ntoya. Ikwirakwiza ryihariye rikoreshwa mugukora kimwe cyangwa byinshi byakira. Abashakisha urufunguzo bose badafite umugozi bagomba "gutega amatwi" kugirango bashakishe, bikavamo gusimbuza bateri intera kuva kumezi atatu kugeza kumwaka. Gukoresha ibimenyetso cya radio bikuraho ibyago byo gutanga impuruza z'ibinyoma.
Bamwe mu bakwirakwiza harimo serivisi ihendutse-igaruka rya serivise ifasha mugusubiza urufunguzo baramutse babuze muri tagisi, bisi cyangwa ahandi hantu hahurira abantu benshi, mugihe umukiriya yanditse ibikoresho byabo hamwe n'amakuru. Ikwirakwiza rishobora kandi kubamo amakuru yo gufasha kuyasubiza nyirayo.
Urungano rwurungano rwibanze ntirukeneye "ishingiro" ryihariye; byose birasa kandi bishingiye kuri sisitemu yitumanaho aho buri gikoresho gishobora kubona ibindi byose kugiti cye. Umukoresha arashobora, kurugero, gukoresha ikotomoni ya digitale kugirango abone urufunguzo rwimuwe naho ubundi, cyangwa terefone igendanwa kugirango abone televiziyo yatakaye cyangwa amadarubindi. Byongeye kandi, kubera ko urufunguzo rwibanze rufite imiyoboro yabyo, barashobora gusubiza kuri radiyo kimwe no kuvuza no gucana urumuri kugirango bakurure ibitekerezo. Igice cyo gushakisha gishobora gukurikira itara kugirango ubone nurufunguzo rwashyinguwe. Kugira transmitter muri buri gice bisobanura kandi ko, bitandukanye nibisekuru bya kabiri, gutakaza imashini imwe ntabwo bivamo gutakaza rwose ubushobozi bwo kubona ibindi bintu bikurikirana.
Bluetooth ingufu nkeya.
Amatara maremare ya Bluetooth (BLE) ningirakamaro mumikorere yabashakisha. Izi beacons, zirangwa no gukoresha ingufu zazo neza, zisohora ibimenyetso bishobora gutahurwa nibikoresho bihujwe, mubisanzwe telefone zigendanwa, kugirango bigerweho. Abashakashatsi bingenzi hamwe na tekinoroji ya BLE beacon ifasha cyane cyane mugushakisha ibintu byihariye. Itara ryometse ku kintu kimeze nk'urufunguzo rutanga ibimenyetso byerekana ko, iyo biri mu ntera, bigaragazwa na porogaramu ya terefone, byerekana aho ibintu biherereye.
BLE beacons yohereza ibimenyetso byamenyekanye nigikoresho kibangikanye, bigafasha igikoresho kumenya aho itara riherereye. Iri koranabuhanga rikoreshwa cyane mubashakisha urufunguzo, aho itara rifatanije nibintu nkurufunguzo cyangwa igikapu, byorohereza aho biherereye ukoresheje porogaramu ya terefone.
Ibikoresho byo gukurikirana byagize uruhare mubikorwa byubugizi bwa nabi, nko guhiga no kumenya igihe imitungo irimo ubusa. Umutekano wubatswe mubikoresho bimwe na bimwe byo gukurikirana kugirango umenyeshe umuntu mugihe arimo gukurikiranwa, birahungabana kubera ko ibikoresho bishobora kuzimya iyo gukurikirana bimaze gukorwa bihagije, birashobora guhindagurika cyangwa guhishwa bitagaragara, cyangwa bigasaba porogaramu yo kumenyesha gukurikirana bitemewe, bidakunze gukoreshwa nuwahohotewe.

3Play Media ni urubuga rutanga serivisi zifasha abantu kubona no kumva neza ibinyamakuru n'amashusho, rukorera i Boston, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu ntara ya Massachusetts, rutanga serivisi zo kongeraho amagambo yanditse ku mashusho, no gusobanura amajwi, hamwe na serivisI zanditse kuri tereviziyo, ibiri kuri videwo, na podcast. Icyo kigo yashinzwe na Josh Miller na Chris Antunes mu mwaka wa 2007.
3Play Media yashinzwe mu 2007, yashyizeho uburyo butandukanye bwo kugera ku nzego zirimo itangazamakuru n'imyidagaduro, uburezi, ibigo, guverinoma, na e-learning. Isosiyete yaguze Captionmax, itanga amakuru ku b'itangazamakuru, muri Gashyantare 2022 yaguye itangwa rya 3Play Media mu magambo yanditse neza na serivisi zitanga amakuru. Kugura byatumye Captionmax yisubiraho nka 3Play Media ku ya 21 Nzeri 2022.
Captionmax yashinzwe mu 1993, yatanze ibisobanuro mu mashusho ya videwo, hamwe n’inyandiko zamamaza ku bakiriya barenga 450(magana ane mirongo itanu), harimo imiyoboro minini ya televiziyo na radiyo, situdiyo, ibigo by’uburezi, ndetse n’amasosiyete. Kuba Captionmax yaguze National Captioning Canada muri Werurwe 2021 yarushijeho kwagura serivisi zayo zo kugera ku itangazamakuru.
3Play Media ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya cloud, machine Learning, n'abantu basuzuma kugira ngo itange serivisi zizewe zorohera abantu kubona no kumva ibirimo.

Hanger, Inc. Ni kompanyi iyoboyeku rwego rw'igihugu mu gutanga ibicuruzwa na serivisi bifasha mu kongera cyangwa gusubizaho ubushobozi bw'umubiri bw'abarwayi bafite ubumuga cyangwa bakomeretse,ifite icyicaro gikuru i Austin,Texas (former Bethesda, Maryland) za orthotic na prostothique (O&amp;P), ikwirakwiza ibikoresho bya O&amp;P nibigize, ikayobora imiyoboro ya O&amp;P, ikanatanga ibisubizo bivura abarwayi nubucuruzi mubihe bikomeye, nyuma yuburakari, nubuvuzi. Hanger, Inc. ikora ibice bibiri: Kwita ku barwayi n'ibicuruzwa &amp; serivisi.
Igice cyibanze cy’ishami ryita ku barwayi ba Hanger, Inc. ni Hanger Clinic (yahoze yitwa Hanger Prosthetics na Orthotics) mu gushushanya, guhimba, no gutanga ibikoresho byabigenewe O&amp;P binyuze mu mavuriro 677 yita ku barwayi, hamwe n’ibicuruzwa 109 byogajuru mu bihugu 44, ndetse n’akarere ka Columbiya ku ya 30 Nzeri 2018. Miliyari 4 z'amadorali buri mwaka. Ivuriro rya Hanger ryerekana hafi 20 ku ijana by'iri soko. Isosiyete ikoresha abantu bagera ku 4,600, harimo abakora prostate na orthotic bagera ku 1.500.
Abarwayi ba Hanger bazwi barimo:
James Edward Hanger, waciwe bwa mbere mu mpapuro z’intambara z’Abanyamerika, yashinze isosiyete muri Virginie mu 1861.
Amagambo yanditse mu nyandiko ya Ambrose Bierce nyuma y'intambara avuga ko "Twarashe ukuguru kwa Confederate i Philippi" bivuga Hanger. Ku ya 2 Kamena 1861, ku y'amavuko, Hanger yinjiye mu mafarasi y’ingabo z’Abanyamerika i Philippi, muri Virijiniya. Imvune yasabaga gucibwa ukuguru kwa Hanger hejuru y'amavi; yaciwe ku rugamba rwa mbere ku rugamba, abifashijwemo n'abaganga b’ubumwe. Hanger yasubiye mu rugo rw'ababyeyi be kugira ngo akire yambaye prothèse yari inkoni y'ibiti. Kuba atishimiye imikorere n'imikorere yo gusimbuza ingingo byatumye Hanger ashushanya kandi yubaka prothèse nshya iva mu biti byera byera, reberi n'ibiti, ifite impeta ku ivi no ku birenge. Igikoresho cyakoraga neza, kandi inteko ishinga amategeko ya leta yamusabye gukora “Hanger Limb” ku bandi basirikare bakomeretse.
Ibikorwa byo gukora JE Hanger, Inc., byashinzwe mumijyi ya Staunton na Richmond. Ku Werurwe 1863, Hanger yahawe ipatanti ye ya mbere ku gihimba cy’ubukorikori, nomero 155, avuye ku biro bishinzwe ipatanti ya Confederate Patent ku ya 23 Werurwe 1863. Mu myaka ishize, Hanger yakoze kandi ibandikisha uburenganzira ku bicuruzwa bishya bigenewe abasirikare bahoze ku rugamba n'abandi babuze ibice by'umubiri.
Mu 1906, Hanger yimuye icyicaro gikuru i Washington, DC. Mu 1915, yagiye mu Burayi gufasha abaterankunga b'Intambara ya Mbere y'Isi Yose no kwigira ku ndaya zo mu Burayi.
Abahungu batanu ba Hanger bagize uruhare mu gukora ubucuruzi bw'umuryango. Mu 1915, bagabanije JE Hanger, Inc., mu masosiyete ane atandukanye, buri wese akorera mu karere kamwe mu gihugu. Igihe Hanger yapfaga mu 1919, amasosiyete yari afite amashami i Atlanta, St. Louis, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, London na Paris.
Mu myaka yabanjirije Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, nta terambere ryagaragaye ryabaye mu nganda zo muri Amerika. Umuhengeri mushya w’abahoze mu rugamba rwasabye uburyo bwiza bwo gukora prostate, maze mu 1946, guverinoma ihuriweho na leta itangira gutanga amafaranga y’ubushakashatsi n’iterambere muri prostate. JE Hanger Inc.
Muri iki gihe, inganda za orthotics zashakaga guhuza n'inganda za prostate. Mu 1950, hashyizweho ishyirahamwe ry’imyororokere n’imyororokere y'Abanyamerika, ryibanze cyane ku burezi no gutanga ibyemezo by’abakora amavuriro. Mu myaka ya za 1950 rwagati, JEHanger, Inc., yariyongereye serivisi za orthotic mu bucuruzi bwayo, kandi yariyongereye igera ku biro 50 muri Amerika na 25 mu Burayi.
1960 na 1970 byagize iterambere rito ugereranije nubuhanga, ariko 1980 yaranze intangiriro yigihe cyiterambere ryiterambere ryiterambere rikomeza kugeza na nubu. Mu 1986, isosiyete y'itumanaho ikorera muri Colorado, Sequel Corporation, yagurishije ubucuruzi bwa terefone ngendanwa maze itangira gushora imari mu nganda za orototike na prostate. Mu 1989, Sequel yaguze JE Hanger, Inc, i Washington, DC. Mugihe cyo kugura, JE Hanger, Inc., yari ubucuruzi bwa miliyoni 8 zamadorali hamwe n’ibiro mu mijyi 11 na leta umunani. Nyuma gato, Sequel yahinduye izina ryisosiyete yitwa Hanger Orthopedic Group. Ivan Sabel, perezida akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ibikorwa, yibanze ku guhuza ibishushanyo mbonera no gukora ibikoresho bya prostate na orthotic by’isosiyete no kubikwirakwiza mu gihugu.
Mu 1996, isosiyete yaguze JE Hanger, Inc., yo muri Jeworujiya. Uku kugura gukubye kabiri ingano y’isosiyete, ubu ikaba yari ifite ibigo byita ku barwayi 175, ibibanza bitandatu byakwirakwijwe, inganda enye zikora n’abakozi 1.000 muri leta 30. Hanger yakomeje kugura ibigo bito kandi mu 1998, yakoraga ibigo byita ku barwayi 256. Mu 1999, Itsinda rya Hanger Orthopedic ryaguze umunywanyi waryo ukomeye n’umuyobozi w’inganda, ishami rya orthotics na prostothique ishami rya NovaCare. Ibi byongeyeho ibigo 369 byita ku barwayi. Nyuma yo kugura NovaCare, isosiyete yakomeje kwagura ibikorwa byayo hamwe nubucuruzi bwihariye bujyanye nayo. Mu 1999, Ikinyamakuru Fortune cyashyize Hanger Orthopedic Group ku mwanya wa 79 kurutonde rwamasosiyete ijana yihuta cyane.
Ukwakira 2022, Umurwa mukuru w’abarwayi, LP. yaguze Hanger
Hanger, Inc. ikora imirongo irindwi y'ubucuruzi mubice bibiri: Kuvura abarwayi n'ibicuruzwa &amp; serivisi.
Hanger, Inc. Igice cyo Kwita ku barwayi kigizwe na Hanger Clinic na Linkia.
Linkia ni kompanyi icunga imiyoboro ikorera by'umwihariko mu ruganda rukora ibikoresha byunganira umubiri (orthotics) n'ibisimbura ibice by'umubiri (prosthetics).
Ibicuruzwa na serivisi byacyo birimo Kwihutisha Kwitaho Byongeyeho, Umuyoboro wa Hanger (wahoze ari Laboratwari yigihugu), Neurotronics udushya, Gutanga Prosthetic yo mu majyepfo (SPS), na SureFit.
Amajyepfo ya Prosthetic Supply afite ibigo byo gukwirakwiza muri leta eshanu, bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa birenga 400.000. Binyuze mu ishami ryayo rya SureFit, SPS ikora kandi ikagurisha inkweto zo kuvura abarwayi ba diyabete ku isoko rya podiatric. Binyuze muri Hanger Fabrication Network, ni uruganda rukora ibikoresho bya O&amp;P byifashishwa n'amavuriro yita ku barwayi batishyuwe ndetse n'ayandi mavuriro y'abahanganye mu bucuruzi.
Innovative Neurotronics, Inc., izobereye mugutezimbere no gucuruza tekinoroji ya neuromuscular ikora. Neuromuscular bivuga gukoresha imbaraga zo gukurura amashanyarazi kugirango tunoze imikorere yibice byangiritse.
Abakozi b'ikigo ni abanditsi kandi batanga umusanzu w'abanditsi b'ibitabo nka "Prosthetics no gucunga abarwayi: Uburyo bwuzuye bwo kuvura", "Kugarura imikorere y'abakuze n'abana bafite ububobere bukabije", "n'ubuvuzi bw'umubiri no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe: Amahame n'ibikorwa".
Ibibazo byemewe n'amategeko.
Mu 2004, ibirego by’uburiganya bwo kwishyuza byakorewe iyi sosiyete igihe umuyobozi w’ibiro yamenyesheje abakozi ba Hanger i New York ko bahimbye imiti ku barwayi badahari. Urubanza rw’icyiciro rwashyikirijwe Hanger kubera gukekwaho gukoresha uburiganya mu kuzamura ibihimbano. N'ubwo ibiro 14 byavuzwe amazina muri uru rubanza, Hanger yavuze ko ahantu hamwe gusa hagize uruhare muri ubwo buriganya.

Canine Companions for Indepandence ni umuryango ukorera muri Amerika 501 (c) (3) udaharanira inyungu uhugura kandi utanga imbwa zifasha. Kuva, yashyize imbwa zirenga 6.000 zifasha abayihawe nta kiguzi.
Canine Companions for Independence yashinzwe ubwigenge yashinzwe i Santa Rosa, muri Californiya, muri Nyakanga 1975 na Bonnie Bergin nka gahunda ya mbere nk'iyi. Igihe yigishaga muri Aziya, yari yarabonye abamugaye bakoresha burros maze atekereza ko imbwa zishobora gukora imirimo nk'iyi muri Amerika. Kuva icyo gihe, yakuze iba umuryango wigihugu. Kugeza mu 2024, ifite ibigo birindwi by'imyitozo hamwe n'ibiro by'akazi mu murwa mukuru wa Washington, California, Texas, Ohio, New York, na Floride. Hari kandi amashami menshi, buri rimwe ryunganira abafasha mu kurera imbwa ntoya (volunteer puppy raisers) ndetse no gutegura ibikorwa byo gukusanya inkunga (fundraising).
Uwo muryango uhuza ababana n'ubumuga n'imbwa zitojwe cyane zifasha,kandi ugatanga ubufasha buhoraho ku buntu ku muntu uzibonera. akoreshwa mu bworozi, korora, no guhugura imbwa aterwa inkunga n’impano bwite zitangwa n’amasosiyete, abantu ku giti cyabo, n’indi mishinga, ndetse n’imishinga yo gukusanya inkunga. Bigereranijwe ko buri mbwa ifasha hamwe nubuzima bwose bwo gukurikirana imbwa igura $ 50.000. Umushinga w'Intare Club ku basangirangendo ba Canine ku bwigenge (LPCCI), washinzwe mu 1983 nk'umuntu utanga inkunga ikomeye mu bijyanye n'amafaranga n'ubwitange ku basangirangendo ba Canine, watanze miliyoni 3 z'amadorali. Muri 2015, Abasangirangendo ba Canine bafatanije n’ubuzima bw’amatungo ya Henry Schein, utanga ibikomoka ku buzima bw’amatungo ku baveterineri, utanga aborozi b’ibibwana ibicuruzwa byita ku buzima ku buntu.
Porogaramu idasanzwe, "The Veterans Initiative", itanga imbwa za serivise zahuguwe ku bamugaye n’abakomeretse. Porogaramu yakiriye inkunga kubufatanye bwa PetSmart na Canine Basangirangendo. Mu, uyu muryango winjiye mu ishami rishinzwe ibibazo by’abasirikare muri Leta zunze ubumwe z’Amerika mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe kugira ngo hamenyekane niba imbwa za serivisi zitezimbere imibereho y’abasirikare bafite ibibazo by’ihungabana nyuma y’ihungabana.
Mu mwaka 2017, uwo muryango wakoranye n'ikirango Chrysler ku gikorwa gishya cyo kuri interineti kigamije kongera kumenyekanisha no gushyigikira ibikorwa by'umuryango Canine Companions. Igikorwa cyiswe "Give a Dog a Job" cyemerera abantu gukurikirana imyitozo y'imbwa yitwa Foley,no kugirana ubufatanye na we hamwe n'abamutoza ku rubuga Facebook, Instagram na Twitter.
Abasangirangendo ba Canine bahugura ubwoko butandukanye bwimbwa zikora: imbwa za serivise (urugero, imbwa zifasha kugendagenda, imbwa za serivise kubarokotse bafite ikibazo cy’ihungabana nyuma y’ihungabana), abasangirangendo babahanga batojwe gukorana n’umuntu mukuru cyangwa umwana ufite ubumuga bayobowe n’umuhugura, kumva imbwa z’abatumva n’abatumva, n’imbwa z '“amatsinda y’ibigo.” Amatsinda yibikoresho agizwe nimbwa numufatanyabikorwa wumuntu, ubusanzwe ni inzobere mu gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe, umurezi, cyangwa inzobere mu buvuzi. Izi mbwa zitwara ubuhanga bwimbwa za serivise kimwe nubuhanga bwihariye kuberako serivisi zimbwa zizashyirwa muri gahunda na serivisi.
Abasangirangendo ba Canine bakoresha gahunda yo korora kugirango batange imbwa zabo. Bakoresha Retrievers na Labrador Retrievers, hamwe numusaraba wubwoko bubiri.
Ibibwana byororerwa nabakorerabushake biyemeje kubika imbwa amezi 16 kugeza 18, kugeza igihe cyo kwinjira muri gahunda y'amahugurwa. Muri aya mezi 16 kugeza 18, abakorerabushake b'imbwa bitangiye imirimo yo kwigisha ikibwana amategeko yacyo 30 yambere. Amenshi muri aya mabwiriza azakoreshwa mugihe cy'amahugurwa yo hejuru. Kurugero, ikibwana cyize kizashyira amaguru yacyo imbere kubintu bitandukanye, harimo inkuta n'inzitiro. Mugihe cyamahugurwa yambere, abahugura babigize umwuga barashobora kubaka iryo tegeko hamwe nimyitwarire ijyanye nubuhanga nko kuzimya urumuri no kuzimya. Ibibwana bikunze guherekeza ibyana byimbwa zabo ahantu hose burimunsi nkishuri cyangwa akazi kubategurira ubuzima nkimbwa ya serivisi.
Amahugurwa y’amezi ane kugeza ku icyenda atangira iyo imbwa isubijwe n’abakorerabushake b’imbwa ku bushake muri kimwe mu bigo birindwi by’amahugurwa bya Canine Companions muri Amerika. Amezi atatu yambere yimyitozo asubiramo ibyo imbwa zize. Amahugurwa yumwuga arimo gusuzuma ubuzima bwimbitse nubushakashatsi, kandi buri mbwa yiga amategeko arenga 40 yo kongera ubwigenge harimo gukurura intebe y’ibimuga, kugarura ibintu byataye, no gufungura imiryango. Imbwa zirashobora gutozwa nkimbwa zumva zimenyesha abatumva batumva amajwi yibidukikije kandi bikayobora uwabitwaye kumasoko yijwi. Muri 2018, abasangirangendo ba Canine batangiye gahunda yicyitegererezo yo guhugura imbwa za serivise zo gufasha abahoze mu rugerero bafite ikibazo cy’ihungabana nyuma yo guhahamuka batanga buffer yoroheje mu bantu, bazimya amatara kandi bahagarika inzozi n’imyitwarire yo guhangayika.
Abantu batumiwe guhuzwa nimbwa bagenda mukigo cyamahugurwa gikorera leta yabo mumasomo y'ibyumweru bibiri yigisha abahawe uburyo bwo gukorana nabagenzi babo bashya. Ibi bikubiyemo kwiga ibijyanye na psychologiya yimbwa, gutunganya imbwa no kwitaho, hamwe namategeko imbwa izi. Guhuza imbwa numuntu bikorwa neza kugirango barebe ko ibikorwa byabo bihuye. Mugusoza, abantu banyura mubizamini hanyuma bakitabira umuhango wo gutanga impamyabumenyi.
Amakipe ya Canine Basangirangendo bagaruka kubikurikirana bisanzwe mugihe cyo gushyira. Abakoresha imbwa Canine Basangirangendo nabo barashobora kugaruka mugihe cyo guhura cyangwa imyitozo yinyongera yo gukurikirana igihe icyo aricyo cyose. Igihe mu murimo ni imyaka umunani kugeza ku icumi.

Fourier (Chinese, Pinyin) ni uruganda rukora amarobo mu Bushinwa rufite icyicaro i Shanghai.
Uhereye kuri robotike zifasha abarwayi, kompanyi yagiye inagura ibikorwa ikora robo zisa n'abantu.
Fourier yashinzwe mu 2015 na Alex Gu. Gu yarangriije muri kaminuza ya Shanghai Jiao Tong kandi mbere yari umuyobozi ushinzwe kugurisha muri National Instruments. Izina ry’isosiyete ryitiriwe Joseph Fourier kandi ryashinzwe mu mujyi wa Zhangjiang hagamijwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe umubiri.
Fourier ishyigikiwe n'abashoramari nka IDG Capital na Arabiya Sawudite.
Kugeza muri 2019, Fourier yari yazanye ibikoresho byayo byubwenge nka exoskeletons mubitaro amagana n'ibigo nderabuzima byo mu bihugu birenga 10 maze aba umukinnyi ukomeye mu nganda. Gu yari asanzwe arota gukora robot imera nka muntu, kandi muri uwo mwaka, Fourier yatangije umushinga mushya wo gukora robot zisa n'abantu (humanoid).
Muri Kamena 2020, Fourier yaguze Zhuhai RHK Healthcare (RHK), itanga serivisi zita ku buzima busanzwe ikorera mu bitaro birenga 200 mu Bushinwa. Kugura RHK byaha Fourier uburyo bunini bwabakiriya n’ibitekerezo byinshi ndetse no gufasha guteza imbere urusobe rw’ibidukikije hafi y’ikoranabuhanga rya Fourier. Imwe mu mbogamizi Fourier yahuye nazo ni igiciro gihenze cyibicuruzwa byacyo. Igiciro kinini cyibicuruzwa byacyo byagabanywa igice binyuze mu kugura RHK itanga serivisi zita ku barwayi bo mu bitaro by’abaturage bagerageje guhaza icyifuzo cya tekinike yo kuvura ikorana buhanga. RHK yagi inafite uruhare mu gukodesha no gutera inkunga ibikoresho by'ubuvuzi, ibyo bikazafasha Fourier kubona ubufasha mu kwamamaza no kugera ku bitaro bifite ingengo y'imari n'abakozi bike mu mujyi mito.
Ukuboza 2023, umuyobozi w’Ubushinwa Xi Jinping yahuye n’abayobozi ba Fourier mu ruzinduko rw’ubugenzuzi i Shanghai. Xi yari yabajije niba bishoboka kuvugana na robot ebyiri kandi ikabona gukora imirimo yibanze. Ibi byafatwaga nk'ikimenyetso ko guverinoma y'ubushinwa yari ifite inyota ku ikoranabuhanga rya robot.
Amateka y'ibicuruzwa.
Fourier yibanze cyane ku gukora robot zifasha abarwayi bafite ubumuga bw'umubiri buterwa n'ibibazo by'ubwonko kugira ngo basubirane ubushobozi bwo kwimuka.
Ku ya 20 Werurwe 2017, Fourier yashyize ahagaragara Fourier X1, igenda ifasha exoskeleton.
Ku ya 21 Mutarama 2019, Fourier yatangije urubuga rwa Fourier Exoskeleton &amp; Robotics Gufungura (EXOPS) rwakozwe ku bufatanye n’ibikoresho by’igihugu. N'uburyo bwa Android busa na sisitemu ifunguye ikoreshwa mu gutezimbere exoskeletons.
Muri 2019, Fourier yatangiye imirimo yo guteza imbere imashini yambere ya robot ya kimuntu GR-1 yavukiye muri laboratoire nto ku igorofa rya mbere ry’icyicaro gikuru cya Fourier. Intambwe ikomeye yagezweho mu 2022 ubwo moderi ya GR-1 ya metero 1.65 yashoboye guhaguruka ku maguru yombi no kugenda. Fourier yasohoye videwo yayo igenda yakira ibisubizo bitandukanye kuko bamwe mubari mu mahanga batekerezaga ko iyi videwo yakozwe na mudasobwa. Muri Nyakanga 2023, GR-1 yashyizwe ahagaragara mu nama mpuzamahanga y’ubutasi y’ubukorikori yabereye i Shanghai yakunzwe cyane. Kuri ubu GR-1 yari imaze kugezwaho bike muri kaminuza zimwe na sosiyete za AI kugirango ubushakashatsi niterambere. Hateguwe gahunda yo gutangira umusaruro mwinshi mu mpera za gutanga ibihumbi n’ibihumbi mu 2024.
Mu Gushyingo 2023, Fourier yatangije MetaMotus ™ Galileo, isesengura ry’ibinyabuzima hamwe na platform ya rehab, ihuza ibintu bifatika ndetse na robo.
Mu mpera za Nzeri 2024, Fourier yashyize ahagaragara moderi ya GR-2 yari kuzamura GR-1. Yahagaze kuri metero 1.75, ipima kg 63, ifite dogere 53 z'ubwisanzure na 3 kg ubushobozi bumwe bwo gutwara ibintu. GR-2 yari ifite bateri itandukanijwe kandi yashoboraga gukora imirimo igoye. Ibikoresho byo guteza imbere software nabyo byari byatejwe imbere.

Lift chairs, zizwi kandi nka lift recliners cyangwa armchairs, ni intebe zifite mekanizime y'ikoranbuhanga izamura intebe yose iva ku nkingi zayo, bityo ikanafasha umuntu uyicanye guhagarara.
Muri Amerika, intebe zo kuzamura zujuje ibyangombwa byubuvuzi biramba munsi ya Medicare Igice B.
Muri raporo yo muri Gashyantare 1989 yashyizwe ahagaragara n'Umugenzuzi Mukuru w’ishami ry’ubuzima n’ibikorwa by’Amerika muri Amerika, byagaragaye ko: intebe zo kuzamura zidashobora kuba zujuje ibyangombwa bya Medicare ku bikoresho by’ubuvuzi biramba (DME) kandi ibyifuzo by’intebe bigomba kongera kugenzurwa. Raporo yatewe kwiyongera kw'intebe zo kuzamura intebe hagati ya 1984 na 1985 ziva kuri 200.000 zikagera ku 700.000. Ikinyamakuru "New York Times" cyavuze ko amatangazo yamamaza kuri televiziyo yatumaga abakiriya babaza ibyerekeye intebe zo kuzamura kandi, abaguzi bamaze guhamagara, bohererezwa urupapuro kugira ngo abaganga babo basinyire. Bimwe mu bigo byoherezaga intebe zizamuka (Lift Chairs) mbere yo kubona umukoro w'umuganga, bityo bigatuma abaganga basabwa gushyiraho umukono, bitabaye ibyo umurwayi akaba aryozwa intebe.
Medicare irashobora kwishyura gusa ikiguzi cya lift-mechanism aho kuba intebe yose. Mbere yuko Medicare isuzumwa kugirango yishyure ikiguzi, abarwayi bazakenera gusurwa na muganga wabo kugirango baganire kubikenewe byibi bikoresho. Utanga DME noneho azasaba urupapuro rwerekana icyemezo cyubuvuzi (CMN). Ubusanzwe CMN ikubiyemo ibibazo bitanu umuganga agomba gusubiza. Mubisanzwe, ibibazo nibibazo: Niba hari ikibazo cyashubijwe "OYA", birashobora gutuma uhakana ikirego.
Mubisanzwe, abatanga DME basaba kwishura byuzuye intebe yo kuzamura kandi bazatanga ibyishyu byemejwe na Medicare. Abatanga DME ntibashobora kwishyuza Medicare batabanje gutanga ibikoresho.
Intebe zo hejuru zirashobora kandi kuza hamwe numubare winyongera wongeyeho na addons. Harimo ubushyuhe na massage, umusego wumutwe ushobora guhindurwa, guhindagurika kwinyuma, kugarura bateri, hamwe nigitambara cyiza cyane.

CYBATHLON, umushinga wa ETH Zurich, ikora nk'urubuga rutera imbogamizi amakipe aturutse impande zose z'isi guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa buri munsi nabafite ubumuga. Imbaraga zitera CYBATHLON ni amarushanwa mpuzamahanga nibirori, aho amakipe agizwe nabateza imbere ikoranabuhanga baturutse muri za kaminuza, amasosiyete cyangwa imiryango itegamiye kuri leta zose, hamwe numuntu ufite ubumuga (umuderevu) aho bakemura imirimo ya buri munsi nikoranabuhanga rigezweho kugirango ribafashe mubijyanye no kwiteza imbere. Usibye amarushanwa nyirizina, CYBATHLON itanga urubuga ngenderwaho rwo guteza imbere ubushakashatsi kuri sisitemu zifasha mu guhangana n’ibibazo by’ubuzima bwa buri munsi ndetse nizindi mbogamizi zarizo zose bahura nazo, no guteza imbere ibiganiro n’abaturage hagamijwe kwinjiza ababana n’ubumuga muri sosiyete. Uruhare rwumuderevu rufatwa nkibyingenzi haba mumarushanwa ndetse no mubikorwa byiterambere, kugirango harebwe niba ibyifuzo byabakoresha ba nyuma bisuzumwa kandi bikemurwe.
CYBATHLON ya mbere yateguwe n’ishuri rikuru ry’ikoranabuhanga ry’Ubusuwisi mumujyi wa i Zurich (ETH Zurich) yabereye mu kibuga cy’Ubusuwisi i Kloten mu majyaruguru ya mumujyi wa Zurich mu Busuwisi ku italiki ya 8 Ukwakira 2016 kandi ni ryo rushanwa mpuzamahanga rya mbere ryabayeho ry’ubu bwoko. Abapilote(abadederevu) 66 baturutse mu bihugu 25 barushanwe imbere yabarebaga 4600.
CYBATHLON 2020 "Global Edition" yabaye ku italiki ya 13 kugeza14 Ugushyingo 2020. Nyuma yo gusubikwa bwa mbere kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyari cyateye isi yose muri rusange yongeye gushyirwaho kugira ngo ikorwe kure, amakipe ashyiraho ibikorwa remezo by'amarushanwa ku birindiro byabo ndetse n'amasiganwa, akurikiranwa n'abayobozi ba Cybathlon, abera kuri videwo.
CYBATHLON 2024 yabaye kuva ku italiki ya ya 25 kugeza ku ya 27 Ukwakira 2024. Amakipe mpuzamahanga 67 yaturutse ku isi yose harimo za kaminuza ninganda yarushanwe mumarushanwa adasanzwe.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe nabaderevu nubuhanga bwa tekiniki kuva mu mwaka wa 2020 bwerekana ko kuba abaderevu barashyizwe mu bikorwa byubushakashatsi hari byinshi byagezweho mugushyiramo abaderevu mubikorwa byubushakashatsi. Imibereho ya buri munsi ikoreshwa rya tekinoroji nshya ifasha ntiyari kenshi. Byombi imikoreshereze yubuzima bwa buri munsi hamwe nigihe kinini cyabakoresha babisanze bifitanye isano nimikorere yubwoko mumarushanwa.

Kuzamura ingazi ni ibikoresho by'i mashini yo guterura abantu, cyane ababana ubumuga, hejuru no hasi. Ku ngazi zagutse bihagije, gari ya moshi ikinyabiziga gitwara abantu ishyirwa kuntambwe. Intebe cyangwa urubuga rwo guterura bifatanye na gari ya moshi. Umuntu yicara ku ntebe cyangwa kuri platifomu hanyuma akazamurwa hejuru cyangwa hasi ku ngazi n'intebe igenda kuri gari ya moshi.
Kuzamura ingazi bizwi muburyo butandukanye nka stairlifts, glider glider, lift-lift, lift intebe (ariko itandukanye na chairlift ikoreshwa nabakinnyi) hamwe nandi mazina. Ijambo kuzamuka kuntambwe rishobora kwerekeza kuri lift, cyangwa cyane cyane mubikoresho by'imyitozo ku izina rimwe.
Bimwe mu byiciro byambere byatejwe imbere byakozwe mubucuruzi byamamajwe kandi bigurishwa muri Amerika mu mwaka w'i 1930 na Inclinator Company yo muri Amerika. Abayikoresheje benshi icyo gihe bahitanywe n’igicuri.

James Carlyle Marsters (5 Mata 1924 - 28 Nyakanga 2009) yari umu ortodontiste ufite ubumuga bwo k'utumva i Pasadena, muri Californiya, mu mwaka w'i 1964 akaba yarafashaga mubijyanye no guhimba igikoresho cya mbere cyandika gishobora gukoreshwa n'imirongo ya terefone. Igikoresho cyatumaga itumanaho kuri terefone rishoboka kubatumva. Nubwo Robert Weitbrecht yakoze byinshi mubikorwa byo gushushanya, Marsters yazamuye imikoreshereze yicyo gikoresho.
Marsters yavutse ku ya 5 Mata 1924, avukira i Norwich, mu mujyi wa New York, avukira ku umuyobozi mukuru wa farumasi Guy Marsters n'umugore we Anna Belle, umuforomo.
Igihe yari akiri muto cyane, Marsters yabuze kumva kubera umuriro utukura n'iseru. Ariko, yize kuvuga no gusoma iminwa. Yarangije mu ishuri rya Wright Oral School ry’abatumva mu mujyi wa New York mu 1943, niho yahuriye na John Tracy, umuhungu wa Spencer Tracy. Mu 1947 Marsters yabonye impamyabumenyi ya bijyanye nutabire yakuye muri Union College i Schenectady, muri New York.
Marsters yashakanye na Joan Tausik, umuhanzi na we wari ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva (nyuma baza gutandukana), ajya gukora mu ruganda rwa karuvati rwa se. Se wa Tausik ni we wasabye ko agomba kuba umuvuzi wa amenyo. Nubwo amanota y'ibizamini bya Marsters yari menshi, amashuri y amenyo yaramwanze kubera kutumva. Nyuma yimyaka ibiri nigice yo gusaba, kaminuza ya New York yemeye kumwakira by'agateganyo yumva ko nta mfashanyo yihariye yari kubona. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya New York mu 1952.Yakundaga kuvuga ko ashobora kumva bamwe, kugira ngo afashe gutuza ubwoba bwa bamwe mu barimu be b'ishuri ry'amenyo. Yatwaye kandi indege hagati y'imijyi ibiri yakoreragamo imyitozo, akavuga ko radiyo ye idakora neza agasaba abashinzwe umutekano mu kirere gukoresha amatara kugira ngo bamuyobore.
John Tracy, izina rye riri ku ivuriro rya Los Angeles ry’abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yashishikarije Marsters kuba ortodontiste, maze mu 1954, nyuma yo kwiga muri USC, atangira imyitozo ya Pasadena. Nyuma yaho gato, yashakanye na Alice Amelia Dorsey, umuyobozi w'iryo vuriro ryababana nubumuga ku ishuri ry’incuke rya John Tracy Clinic. Marsters yari afite abana batatu - James Marsters Jr., umuhanga mu by'ubutabire ndetse n'imiti; Jean Marsters, umuganga; na Guy Marsters, umucuranzi. Alice yapfuye mu 2003. Abashakanye bari bafite abuzukuru babiri. Marsters yapfuye ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2009, azize indwara y'umutima.
Igihe Marsters yakiraga terefone, yishingikirije ku bandi kwitaba telefoni no kumunwa amagambo kugira ngo asome kuminwa yabo ibyi bavuga hanyuma agenekereze, nyuma asubiza kuri telefoni. Muri kiriya gihe, hari umuyoboro wa TTY wubucuruzi, ariko byari bihenze cyane kubantu. Marsters yegereye Robert Weitbrecht umuhanga mu bya fiziki wabanaga nubumuga bwo kutumva w’ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya Stanford maze amusaba ko yareba uburyo bwo gukora igikoresho cyemerera abadafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kuvugana n’abanditsi ba televiziyo ku murongo wa telefone.

Amplifon SpA ni isosiyete yo mu Butaliyani ikorera i Milan kandi ni yo icuruza ibyuma by'amatwi by'abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kumva ku rwego rw'isi yose.
Amplifon yashinzwe mu 1950 i Milan na Algernon Charles Holland, wahoze ari umuyobozi w’ingabo zidasanzwe z’Abongereza, wagize uruhare mu mutwe w’Abataliyani barwanya Resistance. Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose irangiye, yatangije isosiyete igamije gutera inkunga abafite ikibazo cyo kutumva kubera amakimbirane, ashyiraho abantu benshi kandi yubaka umubano ukomeye n'inzobere mu kwita ku matwi.
Mu myaka ya za 1960 na 1970, Amplifon yafunguye amaduka muri buri karere ko mu Butaliyani, aba umuyobozi w’isoko mu gutanga, kugurisha, no gushyira no guhuza icyuma cy'amatwi ku buryo gikora neza ku muntu. Mu 1971, ikigo cya Amplifon gishinzwe ubushakashatsi n’ubushakashatsi (CRS) cyashinzwe: umuryango wigenga ugamije gukwirakwiza ubumenyi mu bice by’amajwi na otologiya, binyuze mu mutungo n’ubushakashatsi.
Mu myaka ya za 90, Amplifon yatangiye guhindurira serivisi abakiriya ku giti cyabo, itangira ibyuma by'amatwi bya digitale bya mbere mu Butaliyani mu mwaka 1996. Muri icyo gihe, isosiyete yungutse isoko rirenga 40%.
Mu 1992, isosiyete nshya yashinzwe muri Espagne, Amplifon Iberica, yaguka muri Porutugali nyuma yimyaka mike. 1998 na 2000, Amplifon yinjiye mu Busuwisi, Otirishiya, Ubufaransa, Ubuholandi no ku masoko yo muri Amerika binyuze mu kugura ibintu.
Umugabane watangiye gucururizwa muri Borsa Italiana muri. Mu 2002, Amplifon yaguze isosiyete ya Sonus muri Amerika, nyuma mu 2003 ifata ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kumva, isosiyete ifite amaduka aherereye cyane cyane mu masoko manini y’ubucuruzi.
Mu myaka yakurikiyeho, Amplifon yakomeje ingamba zo kugura mu Buholandi, Ubudage, Ubwongereza, Irilande n'Ububiligi. Mu mwaka wa mu byukuri, isosiyete yaguze 100% y’ubuvuzi bw’igihugu (NHC) muri Ositaraliya, Nouvelle-Zélande no mu Buhinde. ​ Burezili yakurikiranye mu 2014 Amplifon igura 51% by'imigabane muri sosiyete yo muri Berezile Direito de Ouvir. ["citation ikenewe"]
Mu 2016 isosiyete yashoye miliyoni 80 z'amayero (£) kugirango igure amaduka 170, harimo imirongo ibiri y'ubucuruzi mu Budage n'indi muri Canada. Muri 2017, Amplifon yashoye andi miriyoni 110 yo kugura amaduka 300, harimo imirongo ibiri y'ubucuruzi mu Bufaransa na Porutugali.
Umwaka umwe, Amplifon yarangije kugura byinshi, igura GAES yo muri Espagne kuri miliyoni 528. GAES ifite amaduka 600 (hafi 500 muri Espagne, naho ayandi asigaye anyanyagiye muri Porutugali no muri Amerika y'Epfo), abakozi 1.800, na miliyoni 210 zinjiza.
Kuva mu 2015, igiciro cy’imigabane ya Amplifon cyikubye gatatu, kiruta FTSE MIB, urutonde rw’amasosiyete 40 ya mbere yashyizwe ku rutonde muri Borsa Italiana. Kuva 2018, igiciro cy’imigabane cyazamutse hafi 1.000% kuva IPO yacyo.
Uyu muyobozi ni Susan Carol Holland, umukobwa wa Algernon, ufite 44.9% ya Amplifon abinyujije mu kigo cy’umuryango we.
Ubucuruzi n'ibikorwa.
Amplifon ifite imigabane ku isoko rya 11% ku isi, kandi iri mu bihugu 29, mu turere twa EMEA, Amerika, na APAC.
Isosiyete ikora binyuze mu rusobe rw’ibicuruzwa bigera ku 5.150, ibicuruzwa 4000 mu maduka no mu mfuruka hamwe n’ububiko 1.800 bufitanye isano n’uru rubuga, bukoresha abakozi 16.000 muri rusange. Ubucuruzi bwibanda cyane cyane kugurisha no guhuza ibyuma byumva.

An extende-wear hearing aid n'ubwoko bw'icyuma cy'amatwi gishyirwa cyane mu mfunzo y'amatwi cyane kandi gishobora kumererwa amezi menshi kitavanwaho. Ubu bwoko bw'imfashanyo yo kwumva irakwiriye cyane cyane kubantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bworoshye. Iki gitekerezo gishya cyo gufasha kwumva cyahimbwe na Adnan Shennib washinze InSound Medical, Inc.
Kuba ibi byuma by'amatwi bishyirwa mu mfunzo y'amatwi ubwabyo bitanga umusaruro mwiza mu kugabanya urusaku ruturutse ku kirere, kuvugana kw'imbere mu matwi, gusubiramo urusaku no gutanga amajwi mu buryo bwiza, ndetse bigatanga uburyo bwiza bwo kumva aho amajwi aturuka n'ubwiza bw'amajwi ugereranyije n'ibindi byuma by'amatwi.
Extended-wear hearing aids bikorwa mu kintu cyoroshye kigenewe gukurikira imiterere y'imfunzo y'amatwi y'umuntu, kandi zigira ubugari butandukanye bw'imfunzo kugira ngo zihuze n'ingano y'amatwi y'abantu batandukanye. Umuganga wa ENT, inzobere mu majwi cyangwa inzobere mu gufasha kumva ntabwo ari kubaga yinjiza igikoresho mu gutwi, agishyira mu gice cyamagufwa cyumuyoboro w ugutwi ~ 4 mm uhereye kuri tympanic membrane, cyangwa ugutwi. Gushyira muburyo bwihariye mumatwi yamatwi bivugwa ko bitanga ubwiyongere rusange mubyunguka nibisohoka, icyumba kinini cyumutwe, kugabanya ingaruka zifatika, kugabanya ibitekerezo no kunoza icyerekezo. Iyo bimaze kwinjizwamo, abakoresha barashobora guhindura amajwi nigenamiterere bakoresheje igikoresho cyo guhindura ibintu.
Birakurikirana ko umuganga w'inzobere mu matwi akuraho imfashanyo ndende yo kumva iyo bateri ipfuye cyangwa igihe icyuma kigoma gusimburwa, ariko abahanga benshi mu by'amatwi batanga igikoresho cyihariye cyo kugikuramo(removal loop) kugira ngo umuntu abikore wenyine igihe bibaye ngombwa.
Kimwe n'ibindi bikoresho byumva, guhuza bishingiye ku matwi y'umuntu ku giti cye, ingano y'ugutwi n'uburyo, imiterere y'ubuvuzi, n'ubuzima. Ibi birashobora kugenwa no gusura inzobere mu gufasha kumva.
Ibikoresho byunvikana byunvikana byubatswe kugirango bihangane nubushuhe na cerumen (ibishashara byamatwi) kandi birashobora kwambarwa mugihe ukora siporo, kwiyuhagira, nibindi. Kuramba kwimashini ndende yunvikana bigira ingaruka kumikoreshereze, itandukaniro ryibidukikije, nubuzima bwa buri mukoresha.

Indangantego yo Kumva-Imfashanyo Yerekana Indangagaciro (HASQI) ni igipimo cy'ubwiza bw'amajwi cyashyizweho mu rwego rwo gusuzuma ubwiza bw'ijijwi ry'abantu bafite icyuma cy'amatwi. Byerekanwe kandi ko bishobora gupima ubuziranenge bw'amajwi ku majwi atavuga ndetse n'ababumva nta kubura kumva.
Mugihe imyumvire yubwiza bwamajwi ishobora gupimwa hifashishijwe ibipimo byo gushishoza, ikizamini gitwara igihe kinini gukora. Kubera iyo mpamvu, ibipimo byinshi byateguwe kugira ngo amajwi asuzumwe bitabaye ngombwa ko abantu bumva. Ingero zisanzwe ziva kuri terefone zirimo PESQ, POLQA, PEVQ na PEAQ. HASQI yashyizweho bwa mbere na Kates na Arehart kugira ngo basuzume uburyo imyitwarire mibi yinjizwa n'ibyuma by'amatwi igabanya ubwiza bw'amajwi Basohoye kandi verisiyo nshya muri 2014.
Kressner na al. yagerageje kuvuga imvugo itandukanye na dataset yakoreshejwe mugutezimbere HASQI kandi yerekana ko indangagaciro rusange neza kubayumva nta gutakaza kumva hamwe nibikorwa bigereranywa na PESQ. Kendrick n'abandi.
HASQI hamwe nisubiramo ryayo 2014 n'uburyo bubiri bwarangiye busaba ibyerekezo bisukuye hamwe n'ibimenyetso bitesha agaciro kugirango bisuzumwe. Iki gipimo kigerageza kugaragaza ingaruka z'urusaku, kwivanga kudakwiye kw'amajwi (nonlinear distortion), kuyungura ku murongo (linear filtering) n'impinduka z'umurongo w'amajwi (spectral changes) binyuze mu kubara itandukaniro cyangwa isano hagati y'ingenzi mu biranga amajwi.Ibi bikorwa mugusuzuma ibahasha yerekana ibimenyetso byigihe gito kugirango hamenyekane iyangirika ryatewe nurusaku no kuyungurura umurongo, hamwe namabahasha yigihe kirekire kugirango agereranye ingaruka zo kuyungurura umurongo. Verisiyo ya 2 ya HASQI ikubiyemo icyitegererezo cyo gufata ibintu bimwe na bimwe bya sisitemu yo kumva ya periferique kubantu basanzwe kandi bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva.
Kendrick n'abandi. yateje imbere uburyo buhumye (bumwe-bumwe), bHASQI, ukoresheje kwiga imashini. Ibi bifasha ubwiza bwamajwi gusuzumwa uhereye kubimenyetso byangiritse gusa udakeneye ibisobanuro bisukuye.

the Sonotone 1010 hearing aid yagiye hanze taliki 29 Ukuboza 1952. Icyo cyari igicuruzwa cya mbere cy’ubucuruzi gukoresha transistor, zari zaravumbuwe imyaka itanu mbere ya 1947.
Byari igishushanyo mbonera, ukoresheje miniature ya vacuum ebyiri nkicyiciro cyo kwinjiza hamwe na tristoriste imwe nkibisohoka; ibi byasabwaga kuko tristoriste icyo gihe yabyaye urusaku rw'amashanyarazi cyane. Ndetse ukoresheje transistor imwe yongerewe cyane igihe cya bateri, kugabanya igiciro cy'imikorere y'ikigo. Mugihe transistor yateye imbere, ubu bwoko bw'icyuma cy'amatwi bwasimbujwe n'ibyuma by'amatwi byose bikoresha transistors.
Isosiyete ya Sonotone yari ifite icyicaro cyayo mu mujyi wa New York kandi yashinzwe mu 1929. Isosiyete yaguzwe n’andi masosiyete atandukanye kandi ntiyari ikiri mu bucuruzi mu 2005.

Personal Sound Amplification Products, izwi kandi ku izina rya "Ibikoresho by’amajwi bwite," cyangwa mu magambo ahinnye ya PSAP, bisobanurwa n’ubuyobozi bw’ibiribwa n’imiti muri Amerika nk’ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki byambarwa bigamije kongera amajwi ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutavuga cyangwa batumva. Ntabwo ari ibikoresho byo kumva, FDA isobanura ko bigamije gusimbura cyangwa gukosora igihombo cyo kutumva neza. Ku bwa Dr. Mann wo muri FDA, guhitamo PSAP nk'igisimbuza imfashanyo yo kumva bishobora kugutera kwangirika kwumva.
Byombi PSAP hamwe nibikoresho bifasha kumva nibikoresho bito bya elegitoronike bihuye mumatwi kandi byongera amajwi. PSAPs ahanini ni ibyuma byongera amajwi bisanzwe bigenewe abantu bumva neza, ariko bakeneye kongererwa imbaraga nkeya mu bihe bimwe na bimwe (nko guhiga no kureba inyoni). Imfashanyigisho zumva zirimo urwego rwisumbuyeho rw'ikoranabuhanga rwashyizweho kugirango ruvure ikibazo cyo kutumva neza. PSAP ntabwo igengwa n’amategeko agenga ibiryo, ibiyobyabwenge n’amavuta yo kwisiga kuko atagenewe kuvura, gusuzuma cyangwa gukiza ubumuga bwo kutumva kandi ntabwo ahindura imiterere cyangwa imikorere y'umubiri. Nk'igisubizo, nta tegeko ngenderwaho, kode y'ibicuruzwa cyangwa ibisobanuro kuri ibyo bicuruzwa. Nyamara, FDA igenga PSAP hashingiwe ku ngingo zimwe na zimwe z’amategeko agenga imirasire y’ubuzima n’umutekano yo mu 1968, akubiyemo ibicuruzwa bya elegitoronike nkibikoresho byongera amajwi asohora vibrasiya ya sonic.
Kuberako badakenera kwandikirwa kwa muganga no guhuza umwuga, PSAP zasobanurwa nk'ubwoko bwa amaso gusoma mu bijyanye n'amajwi. Nkibyo, PSAP irasabwa gukoreshwa nabahiga bumva umuhigo, kureba inyoni, ubufasha kumva ibiganiro bya kure cyangwa ibitaramo no kongera amajwi ya tereviziyo mucyumba gituje, urugero. Icyitonderwa, ndetse ibirahuri byo gusoma bigengwa na FDA.
Moderi zitandukanye za PSAP ziva mubakora inganda zitandukanye ziratandukanye kubiciro, imikorere, uburemere, uburambe bwabakoresha hamwe na software ya algorithms yo kuzamura no kudoda kumva. Mugihe moderi zimwe zongerera amajwi gusa, izindi nigishushanyo mbonera, gitanga mikoro yicyerekezo hamwe noguhuza kuringaniza ibimenyetso byamajwi kugirango bikureho urusaku rudasanzwe cyangwa rudasanzwe.
PSAP yagiye ikundwa cyane n'abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva neza, cyane cyane kubera ko zihendutse ugereranyije n'udupfapfa twabugenewe dukorwa ku giti cy'umuntu, nubwo kutitabira ubutumwa, kutagira umumaro no kugena gahunda yo kubonana nabashinzwe amajwi nabyo byavuzwe nkimpamvu zituma abafasha kumva batumva neza. Kubera ko badakenera kwisuzumisha kwa muganga kandi bikwiye, PSAPs iri hagati y’amadolari 50 kugeza ku magana menshi y’igiciro, mu gihe ibikoresho byo kwumva byatwaye amadorari 1400 ku kigereranyo kandi ntabwo bikubiye muri Medicare na gahunda nyinshi z’ubwishingizi.
Nk’uko ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ubumuga bwo kutumva n'izindi ndwara zitumanaho kibitangaza, muri miliyoni 36 z'Abanyamerika bashobora kungukirwa n'imfashanyo yo kumva, abagera kuri 20 ku ijana ni bo bonyine bakoresha imwe. Icyakora, ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu mwaka wa 2010 bwerekana ko munsi ya 18 ku ijana bya PSAP byakoreshejwe mu gusimbuza ibyuma bifata amajwi kandi bikanzura ko benshi mu bakoresha PSAP baba barabaye bafite ikibazo cyo kutumva kubera igiciro kinini cy’ibikoresho byumva.
PSAP nyinshi zigurishwa kubaguzi binyuze mububiko bwa interineti, muri farumasi no mumaduka menshi yimiti no kugurisha.
Amashanyarazi ya PSAP.
Ubushobozi bwa PSAP mu busanzwe n'ibikoresho bito byoroshye. Bongera amajwi kandi batanga ibisubizo kumatwi (s) y'umukoresha. Ibice nyamukuru ni mikoro, amplifier, disikuru, umugenzuzi w'ijwi n'inkomoko y'imbaraga.
Mikoro ifata amajwi (igitutu) imiraba ikayihindura ikimenyetso cyamashanyarazi. Amplifier (umuzunguruko wa elegitoronike) yongerera amplitude yikimenyetso cyamashanyarazi ukoresheje isoko yingufu (bateri). Umuvugizi ahindura ibimenyetso byamashanyarazi byongerewe imbaraga mumajwi. Ijwi (inyungu) igenzura rikoreshwa muguhindura ingano ya amplification ikoreshwa ku kimenyetso cyamashanyarazi bityo, mu buryo butaziguye, igenzura amajwi.
Ibikoresho biratandukanye mubunini uhereye kumasanduku mato (hamwe numutwi wometseho) wambarwa mwijosi cyangwa umanikwa kumukandara - hasi kugeza - igikoresho gito gifunze gihuye numuyoboro w ugutwi. Ibi bikoresho bito bisa nkibikoresho byumva ariko biroroshye cyane kandi ntibikosora kunanirwa kwumva.

Amazon Astro ni robot yo mu rugo yakozwe na Amazon.com, Inc. Igamije kugenzura umutekano w'urugo, kwita ku bageze mu zabukuru b'iwacu bari kure,no gukora nka mufasha w'ukuri ushobora gukurikira umuntu ava mu cyumba kimwe ajya mu kindi.
Ubuyobozi bwa Tom bwise igikoresho " Alexa ku ruziga " kandi ibintu byose biboneka kuri Amazon Echo Show 10 biri kuri iki gikoresho gishya. Astro ifite indangamuntu igaragara kandi igomba kuba ishobora kumenya abo mu miryango itandukanye kandi ikohereza integuza niba igikoresho kibonye umuntu atazi murugo.
Mu 2022, Amazon yatangaje gahunda y'icyitegererezo ihuza Astro na sisitemu y'umutekano ya Ring, yemerera abakozi bo mu kigo cya kure guhamagarira kugenzura Astro gukora iperereza ku bijyanye n'umutekano.
Mark Gurman wo mu makuru ya Bloomberg avuga ko, nyuma y'amezi atandatu asohotse, ku buryo umuntu uwo ari we wese yavugaga kuri Astro kuri interineti, kandi ko Amazon yohereje ibice magana make gusa, cyane. David Padiri wo muri CNET abona ko "Kugeza ubu, iyi robot ikomeje kuba ikintu cyiza, ku bantu bafite amafaranga menshi yo kugerageza ikoranabuhanga rigezweho kugeza na n'ubu ridafite ikibazo gikomeye cyo gukoresha." Lauren Goode wo mu kinyamakuru Wired yanditseho Astro nka "robot kubera robo" na "robot nta mpamvu, byibuze kuri ubu".
Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara muri Nzeri 2022 rivuga ko Astro izakora nka umurinzi w'umutekano ihuzwa n'ibikoresho bya Ring Security byo mu ngo no bigo bito by'ubucuruzi ryatumye Gizmodo ivuga ku buryo Astro igenda iba igitangaje kandi iteye ubwoba kurushaho.
