Alarm.com, Inc. nisosiyete yo muri Amerika ikora mu ikoranabuhanga, itanga serivisi zishingiye ku bicu (cloud-based) zo gucunga kure, gucunga ibikorwa by'amazu, no kugenzura alarme.
Serivisi zo kugenzura zishobora gukorwa hakoreshejwe amasezerano n'abakora ku giti cyabo (third-party contractors) nka ADT. Serivisi zirimo umutekano woguhuza, kugenzura amashusho, gucunga ingufu no gukoresha urugo, kandi birashoboka binyuze muri ecosystem yibikoresho byahujwe nubufatanye bwibikoresho.
Alarm.com yashinzwe mu 2000 mu rwego rw’ubushakashatsi n’iterambere rya MicroStrategy kandi itangiza gahunda y’umutekano itangiza ibikorwa byafashaga kurebera kure no guha intwaro gahunda y’umutekano wambuwe intwaro mu 2002. Isosiyete yateje imbere urubuga rwayo ikubiyemo porogaramu zikoresha ibikoresho by’urugo n’ubucuruzi bikubiyemo gukurikirana amashusho, gucunga ingufu ndetse n’ubushobozi butandukanye bwo gukoresha urugo. Muri Gashyantare 2009, Alarm.com yaguzwe n’ishoramari ry’ishoramari ABS Capital Partners kuri miliyoni 27.7. Muri 2015, Alarm.com yatanze icyifuzo cya mbere gitangirwa ku mugaragaro maze ijya ku mugaragaro muri kamena.
Alarm.com itanga igicu gishingiye kubicu kuburugo bwubwenge hamwe na sisitemu y'ubucuruzi. Ihuriro rifasha abafatabuguzi kurinda no kugenzura imitungo yabo binyuze ku mbuga za interineti na porogaramu zigendanwa, ndetse no mu guhuza na Apple TV, Amazon FireTV, Google Home na Amazon Alexa. Isosiyete yatangiye gutanga imicungire y’ingufu mu ntangiriro za 2010, yemerera abakoresha kugenzura kure ubushyuhe no gukonjesha ku mutungo wabo bakoresheje porogaramu zigendanwa cyangwa babinyujije ku rubuga rw’isosiyete.
Alarm.com yatangaje ko yinjije miliyoni 167.3 z'amadolari y’Amerika n’abakoresha b’abafatabuguzi barenga miliyoni 2.3 muri 2014. Muri 2018, isosiyete yatangaje ko yinjije miliyoni 291.1.
Muri 2015, Alarm.com yatanze IPO kumadorari 14 kumugabane. ABS Capital Partners and Technology Crossover Ventures, yashoye miliyoni 136 z'amadolari muri sosiyete, yagumye kuba abanyamigabane benshi.
Muri 2016, Alarm.com yahujije urubuga rwayo rushingiye ku bicu hamwe na Amazone ya Echo idafite ibyuma bifata amajwi hamwe n’ibikoresho byifashisha amajwi, ndetse na TV ya Apple ya HomeKit.
Muri 2020, Alarm.com yaguze Shooter Detection Sisitemu kumafaranga ataramenyekana.
Muri 2023, Alarm.com yaguze EBS. Icyicaro gikuru cya EBS kiri i Warsaw.

IAccessible2 ni API igerwaho na sisitemu ndetse na porogaramu ya Microsoft Windows. Ku ikubitiro yatunganijwe na IBM munsi ya codename Project Missouri, IAccessible2 yashyizwe munsi yitsinda ryitsinda ryubusa, ubu rikaba rigizwe na Linux Foundation. Yashyizwe mubindi bisobanuro bya Microsoft bishya UI Automation API.
Mugihe UI Automation yavuzweho nk "" ubwami butagira ubwami ", IAccessible2 ivuga ko" ifunguye ".
Mugihe UI Automation itandukanye cyane na Microsoft Active Accessibility (MSAA) Kugirango ikore API yorohereza abafite Ubumuga kandi ifite uburyo bwagutse IAccessible2 yo yuzuzamo ibyo MSAA yari ibuze kugirango ijyane n'java Assistive Technology Service Provider Interface (AT-SPI). Muburyo bwo kugura MSSA aho kuyisimbura IAccessible2 ituma abahanga mu gukora porogaramu bashobora gukomeza gukoresha ibyo bashoyemo muri MSAA, ariko kandi bagatanga uburyo bwo kugerwaho n'ikoranabuhanga rifasha abafite ubumuga (AT) mu buryo bwo kubona inyandiko zo mu buryo buhambaye
Umushainga wa Missouri watangiye ubwo State of Massachusetts, yari mu nzira yo kwemera gukoresha adopting the OpenDocument format mu nyandiko zayo za leta ariko isaba ko umurongo ugomba kuba worohereza abafite Ubumuga. kongera accessibility of dynamic web applications, urugero nk'aho bagaragaza ibikoresho byihariye nk'ikoranabuhanga rifasha abafite ubumuga butandukanye assistive technology ndetse no gutoranya amakuru mashya hashingiwe ku buryo bwayo no ku kamaro kayo byabaye intego ya kabiri ikomeye y'uwmushinga.
IAccessible yatangiye gushyigikirwa muri LibreOffice muri verisiyo ya 4.2. iri mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere umushinga wa Apache OpenOffice, Mozilla Application Suite, NonVisual Desktop Access ndetse no muri Opera web browser. Nubwo IAccessible2 yatangijwe urubuga nka API y'uburyo bwo korohereza abafite ubumuga kuri Windows accessibility API, Qt Development Frameworks ruri gufasha IAccessible2 nkuburyo bushobora gusimbura AT-SPI no kuri Linux, kandi ruri guteganya kongeramo uburyo bwo kuyishyigikira bwa mbere muri Qt 4.3.
guhera mu mwaka wa 2019, Qt ikoresha MSAA na IAccessible2 kuri Windows, kandi ikomeje gukoresha AT-SPI for Unix/X11 systems.

Panel Yoroheje Yinjiza (nayo yitwa SIP) nuburyo bwihariye kuri ecran yinjiza amagambo udakoresheje clavier cg impuzanyuguti isanzwe yibikoresho. SIP isanzwe ikoreshwa muri Microsoft Pocket PC na PC ya Tablet PC, aho nta mwanya wa clavier yibikoresho. Muri Microsoft Windows hari clavier isa na ecran ikoreshwa nka Microsoft Active Accessibility (MSAA) nayo ifite ubushobozi bwo guhindura imiterere ukurikije imvugo ya clavier iriho nimiterere yingenzi. Yahawe patenti na Microsoft mu Gushyingo 2004 munsi ya patenti nimero 6819315.

Kwerekana amajwi ni ugukoresha amajwi kugirango utangaze amakuru kuva avar muri mudasobwa bityo bikaba ari uburyo bwiza ngo kumenyekanisha kubafite ubumuga butandukanye. Ihuriro ryibanze ryo gucukumbura ni Umuryango mpuzamahanga wo kwerekana amajwi (ICAD), washinzwe na Gregory Kramer mu 1992 nk'ihuriro ry’ubushakashatsi muri urwo rwego.
Auditory display ni uburyo byerekana ubushobozi bwo gukoresha amajwi asohoka muri mudasobwa kubakoresha abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona (ukoresheje umusomyi wa ecran) kimwe nabakoresha kureba bakoresha amaso yabo kubindi bikorwa. Kumenya byihuse ibimenyetso bya acoustic hamwe nibintu byose biranga imyumvire yo kumva birashobora kugira uruhare mubikorwa byo kwerekana amajwi nubwo iyerekwa rihari. Kurundi ruhande, amajwi asohoka arashobora kubangamira ibindi bimenyetso bya acoustic, nko gutumanaho kuvuga. Ibi bigora gukoresha ikoreshwa ryerekana amajwi kuri porogaramu zimwe. Byongeye kandi, umusaruro wa acoustic urashobora kutubabaza cyangwa kurangaza.

Daniel Borel (wavutse 14 Gashyantare 1950) ni umucuruzi w’umusuwisi akaba ari nawe washinze ikigo cy’ikoranabuhanga Logitech.
Mu 1973, Daniel Borel yabonye impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanga muri Physique yakuye muri École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne mu Busuwisi, naho mu 1977 ahabwa impamyabumenyi ya Master of Science muri Computer Science yakuye muri kaminuza ya Stanford. Muri uwo mwaka yasubiye mu Busuwisi.
Borel yashinze Logitech mu isambu ya sebukwe mu 1981 na Pierluigi Zappacosta na Giacomo Marini. Umuyobozi wa Logitech 1982 kugeza 2008, anaba umuyobozi mukuru w’isosiyete kuva 1982 kugeza 1988, 1992 kugeza 1998. mu 1988, yashyize Logitech ku isoko ry'imigabane rya Suisse, ndetse no kuri Nasdaq mu 1997. ubu akora nka Perezida Emeritus mu nama y'ubuyobozi ya Logitech.
Borel yari umwe mu bagize Inama y'Ubuyobozi ya Nestlé kuva mu 2004 kugeza 2016. Anakora kandi mu nama y'ubuyobozi ya Dofitech, yashinzwe na we hamwe n'umugore we mu 2001, ari yo muryango ugera ikoranabuhanga rta IT ku bantu bafite ubumuga Byongeye kandi, yashinze akaba n'umuyobozi wa swissUP, umusingi ugamije guteza imbere uburezi mu Busuwisi.
Muri Nzeri 2010, Borel, ushyigikiye ubufatanye bwa Logitech na École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, yafunguye ikigo gishya cyo guhanga udushya cya Daniel Borel ku kigo cya kaminuza "Quartier de l'Innovation".
Muri 2019, Borel yitabiriye gahunda yo gukusanya inkunga yo gukusanya inkunga Unibuddy yakusanyije miliyoni 5 z'amadolari y'Amerika mu cyiciro cyayo cy'ishoramari. Kuva ubwo, Borel yakomeje gushora imari mu byiciro by'ishoramari bya Unibuddy, kandi isosiyete imaze gukusanya miliyoni 32 z'amadolari kugeza ubu, harimo miliyoni 20 z'amadolari y'Amerika mu cyiciro cya 2021.
Borel arubatse, afite abana batatu n'abuzukuru barindwi.

Audification nubuhanga bwo kwerekana uburyo bwo kwerekana urutonde rwagaciro nkamajwi. Mubisobanuro, bisobanurwa nk "ubusobanuro butaziguye bwo guhinduranya amakuru kuri domaine yumvikana." ibinkandi bigafasha cyane abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona amakuru akurikirana kandi mubisanzwe ibihe bikurikirana, nkamajwi yerekana amajwi aho amakuru yinjizwa yashizwe kumurongo wumuvuduko wijwi. Uburyo butandukanye bwo gutunganya ibimenyetso bikoreshwa mugusuzuma ibiranga amakuru. Tekinike ituma abumva bumva ibice byigihe nkinshuro. Ubugenzuzi busanzwe busaba amakuru manini hamwe nibice byigihe.
Igitekerezo cyo kugenzura cyatangijwe mu mwaka wa 1992 na Greg Kramer, mu ntangiriro yafashijwemo nu buhanga bwa sonification. Iyi yari intangiriro yubugenzuzi, ariko niyo mpamvu abantu benshi kugeza na nubu bagifata ubugenzuzi ubwoko bwa sonification.
Intego yubugenzuzi ni ukwemerera abumva kumva amajwi ndetse n'ibipimo bya siyansi cyangwa ibigereranyo.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2007 na Sandra Pauletto na Andy Hunt muri kaminuza ya York bwagaragaje ko abakoreshaga iyo sisitemu babashaga kumenya ibiranga urusaku, ibintu bisubiramo, guhindagurika buri gihe, guhagarika umutima, hamwe n’imbaraga zerekana ibimenyetso mu kugenzura amakuru y’ibihe ku rwego ugereranije no kugenzura amashusho ya porogaramu.
Mubisabwa harimo kugenzura amakuru yimitingito hamwe nibimenyetso bya neurofsiologiya by'abantu. Urugero ni esophageal stethoscope, yongerera ijwi risanzwe ridatanga impinduka zidasanzwe zidafite urusaku nkibisubizo byisesengura rya gaze.
Guhindura ultrasound kumajwi yumvikana nuburyo bwo kugenzura butanga uburyo bwa echolocation. Ubundi buryo bukoreshwa mubuvuzi harimo stethoscope hamwe nubugenzuzi bwa EEG.

Garageio ni igikoresho cy'ikoranabuhanga cyo kugenzura umuryango wa garaje mu rugo, cyakozwe na Alottazs Labs, LLC icyi cyumba cyayo giherereye i Columbus, Ohio. Alottazs Labs, LLC ni isosiyete ifite abikorera ku giti cyabo yashinzwe mu Kwakira 2012. Garageio ni interineti y'ibintu itanga igaraji icungwa ndetse n'irembo ryinjira binyuze kuri terefone n'ibindi bikoresho bifasha urubuga.
Garageio igizwe na WiFi ishoboye kugenzura ihuriro ryugurura urugi rwa garage kandi rigenzurwa binyuze muri Garageio mobile cyangwa porogaramu ya desktop. Igenzura rishobora guhuza inzugi zigera kuri eshatu zitandukanye nigikoresho kimwe.
Porogaramu ya Garageio iOS na Android yemerera uyikoresha gucunga kure buri rugi rwa garage rwigenga. Umukoresha arashobora kandi gutanga no kwemera kugera kumiryango yandi ya garage kubandi bakoresha Garageio.
Igitekerezo cya Garageio cyatangiye mu 2012 ubwo uwashinze umushinga Zak Dziczkowski yavumbuye urugi rwe rwa garage rwabuze. Zak yahise amenya ko igiciro cyo gusimbuza icyuma gishya cyari gihenze cyane kandi atekereza uburyo bwiza bwo kugenzura umuryango wa garage. Muri iryo joro nyene, Zak yahamagaye uwashinze Dave Reif maze batangira gukora kuri prototype ya Garageio.
Mu Kwakira 2012, Garageio yabaye ibicuruzwa bya Alottazs Labs, LLC izana abandi bashinze imishinga, rwiyemezamirimo Greg Colarich, umuhanga mu guhanga udushya Jess Boonstra, n’umucuruzi Zach Cochran.
Garageio yamaze igice cya mbere cy'umwaka yibanda ku gukora porogaramu no gushushanya ibicuruzwa. Garageio yahawe igihembo cy'igitekerezo gishya (Cool Idea) Igihembo cyatanzwe na Minnesota gikora plastike Proto Labs yatanze progaramu ya prototype yubusa hamwe nibikorwa byakurikiyeho. Mu Gushyingo 2013, Garageio yatangije gahunda yo gutera inkunga imbaga y'abantu binyuze muri Fundable ikusanya $ 30.000 yo kugurisha mbere.
Garageio yatangiye kohereza mu ntangiriro za 2014 kubaterankunga bayo baterankunga kandi akomeza gufata ibicuruzwa abinyujije kurubuga rwayo. Garageio yasohoye verisiyo ivuguruye ya porogaramu kandi itangaza ko hiyongereyeho porogaramu nka IFTTT (niba irenze iyo), ituma abayikoresha bakora resept zikurura ibintu byabigenewe. Garageio yongereye imiyoboro ikora kandi ikomeza kohereza muri Amerika ya ruguru.
Garageio yari umwe mu nshuro za mbere yakiriyeinkunga ya Alexa, umushiga wa Amazon.com ugamije gushyigikira amasosiyete atangira (starups) akora ku ikoranabuhanga ryo kugenzura amajwi.

Amaryllo Inc. ni isosiyete mpuzamahanga yashinzwe i Amsterdam, mu Buholandi. Ikora nka platform ishingiye ku bicu (cloud service platform) itanga ububiko bw'ibicu (cloud storage) ndetse na serivisi zo gutunganya amakuru mu bicu (cloud computing services) ku masosiyete n'ibigo by'ubucuruzi. Amaryllo yatangiye ubucuruzi hamwe na Skype IP kamera yiterambere mugutezimbere tekinoroji ya robotique ya biometrike, umuyoboro wa P2P uhishe, hamwe no kubika ibicu.
Amaryllo yashinzwe n’umunyamuryango wa Band of Angels, Marcus Yang kugira ngo ateze imbere patenti y’ubwoko bushya bwa kamera za robo zitwa "kuvuga, kumva, guhumurirwa, kumenya isura y’abantu, no gukurikirana abinjira". Ivuga kandi ko yakoze robot ya mbere y’umutekano ku isi ishingiye kuri protocole ya WebRTC, Icam PRO FHD, kandi yegukana igihembo cya CES Best of Innovation Award 2015 mu cyiciro cya Embedded Technology.] Ibicuruzwa bigurishwa mu bihugu birenga 100 byo ku migabane 6.
Amaryllo yerekanye ibicuruzwa byayo bya mbere by'ikoranabuhanga ryo mu rugo byo gucunga umutekano muri Internationale Funkausstellung Berlin (IFA) 2013 hamwe na kamera ya IP ya Skype yitwa iCam HD. Amaryllo yatangaje ibicuruzwa byayo bya kabiri byemewe na Skype, iBabi HD, muri CES 2014. Isosiyete yatowe nka "Cool Vendor " muri Connected Home 2014. Imashini za kamera za kamera, ATOM AR3 na ATOM AR3S, zatangijwe mu mpera za 2016. Yibanze ku ikoranabuhanga ry’insinga kandi ridafite umugozi rishingiye kuri serivisi za AI.
Amaryllo itanga mbere yo kwishyura ibicu mububiko bwa digitale no mumakarita yimpano yatanzwe na InComm Payments. Itanga serivise nziza yo kubara ibicu binyuze mubufatanye bwa Rescale. Amaryllo atanga kamera z'ubuntu ku bantu basinye ububiko bw'ibicu bw'umwaka wose (annual cloud storage subscription) ku rubuga rwayo.

Arlo Technologies ni sosiyete yo muri Amerika ikora kamera z'iperereza zidafite insinga (wireless surveillance cameras). Mbere yo gutangizwa ku mugaragaro (IPO) ku Isoko ry'imigabane rya New York muri Kanama 2018, Arlo yari ikirango cy'ibicuruzwa nk'ibyo na Netgear, byagumije kugenzura benshi nyuma ya IPO.
Nk’uko iyi, yohereje ibikoresho miliyoni 21,6, ifite konti miliyoni 5.82 ziyandikishije, kandi ifite konti 877.000 yishyuwe, guhera muri Mutarama 2022.
Ku ya 6 Gashyantare 2018, Netgear yatangaje ko inama y'ubutegetsi yemeje ko itandukanyirizo ry'ubucuruzi bwa Arlo na Netgear. Mu gihembwe cya kabiri cy'umwaka wa 2018, ishami rya Arlo rya Netgear ryabaye ikigo cya Arlo Technologies, Inc. Netgear yatanze munsi ya 20% by'imigabane rusange ya Arlo muri IPO, bituma igumana ubwiganze bwa benshi.
Umuyobozi mukuru wa Arlo ni Matthew McRae. McRae yinjiye muri Netgear mu Kwakira 2017 ubwo yahawe akazi nka visi perezida mukuru w’ingamba.
Arlo ikora ibicuruzwa nka Kamera yumutekano ya Arlo (Arlo security camera), ndetse na kamera zishobora gutwarwa n'izo gukurikirana abana. kamera za Arlo zateguwe ku buryo zigabanya ikoreshwa ry'ingufu hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo gucomeka buke (low-power standby mode).
Gukora Arlo byoherezwa muri Foxconn na Pegatron.

August, Inc. ni sosiyete yo San Francisco, ikora mu bijyanye no gucunga ibikorwa bw'amazu (home automation),yibanda ku byuma bifunga imiryango bihuzwa na WI-FI. Isosiyete yashinzwe mu Gushyingo 2012 na Yves Béhar na Jason Johnson.
Ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2017, uruganda rukora ibicuruzwa rwo muri Suwede Assa Abloy rwatangaje kugura urugo rwa Kanama. Amasezerano yarangiye mu Kuboza 2017.
Kugeza muri Nyakanga 2018, August Home yari imaze kugurisha miliyoni imwe zifunga ubwenge na kamera.
Muri Gicurasi 2013, Kanama yasohoye ubwenge bwabo bwa mbere. bifite ikariso yicyuma kandi yagenzurwaga hakoreshejwe Bluetooth 4.0 hamwe na porogaramu ya terefone. ku zindi nzugi zifunga urugi rwo muri Kanama, igikoresho gifata kuri deadbolt ihari ku gice cyimbere cyumuryango, iracyemerera gukoresha urufunguzo gakondo. Nyuma yaho, hagiye hanze igikoresho cya Wi-Fi bridge cyemerera gufungura umuryango hifashishijwe kure (remote access) no gukoresha mufasha wa Virtual (Virtual assistant) (nka Amazon Alexa).
Mu Kwakira 2015, isosiyete yatangije urutonde rwibicuruzwa bishya birimo igisekuru cya kabiri gifunga ubwenge, inzogera yo mu muryango, hamwe na kanda ya kode kubakoresha badafite terefone. Isosiyete yatangaje kandi Kanama Access, urubuga rwo kureka abatwara ubutumwa ba Postmates, Handy, nizindi serivisi babasha kugera kumugozi binyuze kode imwe. Serivisi kugirango ishyire Walmart ku masoko yatoranijwe yo muri Amerika. HomeKit verisiyo ijyanye no gufunga nayo yasohotse umwaka ukurikira.
Verisiyo ihendutse yo gufunga ubwenge yasohotse muri 2017, hamwe na Z-Wave ihuza igenewe kwishyiriraho umwuga. Ifunga rishya kandi ryongeyeho ibyuma byerekana ibyuma kugirango umenye niba umuryango ufunguye cyangwa ufunze.
Porogaramu yo muri Kanama yagutse igera ku gufunga Yale na Emtek muri Mutarama
Ibibazo by'umutekano.
Muri Kanama 2016, hacker yingofero yerekana intege nke hamwe na kode yo muri Kanama inshuro imwe yemerera umuntu kuyikoresha igihe kirangiye muri DEF CON. Isosiyete yakemuye ikibazo nyuma yuku kwezi. MIT yakoze ubundi bushakashatsi ku ntege nke zishobora kubaho mu mutekano wigikoresho. Bagerageje kugera ku gikoresho bakoresheje uburyo bwinshi, nta na kimwe cyatsinze. Uburyo bagerageje ni ubu bukurikira: igitero cyibanga, "Ntabwo ndimo ndumva" ibitero, guhindura itariki nigihe cyagenwe, gutondekanya paki ya Bluetooth, gusenya porogaramu, guhumura udupaki twa TCP, ibitero byabantu hagati, no kugarura uruhushya rwa nyirubwite urufunguzo rwa interineti. Muri ibyo bigeragezo byose, kimwe gusa cyari gifite ishingiro. Mugukata paki ya Bluetooth, abantu bafite umugambi mubisha barashobora kugerageza uburyo bwa " brute force " bakeka ciphertext ikenewe kugirango bakingure umuryango. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, amahirwe yo gukeka ko aya matsinda ari imwe muri miliyoni zirenga 18.4, kandi igihe giteganijwe byose (all sequence) cyitezweho kurenga imyaka ine.

Immedia Semiconductor LLC, ikora ubucuruzi nka Blink, nisosiyete yo muri Amerika ikora mu bijyanye no no gucunga ibikorwa by'amazu(home automation) ikaba ikora kamera zu'mutekano murugo (home security cameras). Isosiyete yashinzwe mu 2009 na Peter Besen, Don Shulsinger, Dan Grunberg, Stephen Gordon, na Doug Chin. Isosiyete yatangijwe bwa mbere nka Immedia Semiconductor Inc mu 2009, ariko yinjira mu isosiyete ikora ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki. Muri, isosiyete yagize ubukangurambaga bwa Kickstarter kuri kamera y’umutekano yo mu nzu, yakusanyije miliyoni zisaga 1 US $. Nyuma yaho, Blink yaje gutangaza kamera yumutekano wo hanze, sisitemu yumutekano murugo, hamwe ninzogera ya videwo.
Amazon yatangaje mu Kuboza 2017 ko baguze iyi sosiyete. Immedia Semiconductor, LLC ikomeje gukora nk'ishami ry'igenga. Biteganijwe ko tekinoroji ya Blink izakoreshwa muri serivisi ya Amazone.
Ukuboza 2019, Amazon yashyizeho ibikozwe byo gukosora (patches) mu rwego rwo gukemura ibibazo by'umutekano (Vulnerabilities),byagaragajwe mu sisteme za kamera z'umutekano za Blink XT2, byabonetse n'ikigo Tenable gikorera mu guhishura no gupiama ibyuho by'umutekano (vulnerability detection firm).
Ibicuruzwa byinshi bya Blink bikorerwa mubushinwa, mugihe ibindi bikozwe muri Maleziya na IoT Manufacturing Sdn Bhd.
Blink Video Doorbell.
The blink video doorbell ni igikoresho cy'ubwenge gihujwe na terefone cyemerera amashusho n'amajwi kureba hakoreshejwe ikindi gikoresho. Ikora kimwe na inzogera yo kumuryango, harimo mubushobozi bwayo bwo guhuza Amazon Alexa hamwe nogutanga "plus" abiyandikisha, itanga ubushobozi bwo kubika ibicu no guhuza ibikoresho byinshi.
The Blink Dog camera n'igikoresho cy'ubwenge cyagenewe guha ba nyiri amatungo uburyo bwo kugenzura amatungo yabo mugihe ba nyirayo bataba murugo. Kamera irimo ibisobanuro bihanitse 1080p videwo nubushobozi bwo kureba nijoro.

EARCON, yerekana ibyabaye cyangwa bitanga andi makuru. Earconi iranga sisitemu y'imikorere ya mudasobwa hamwe na porogaramu, uhereye kuri beep yoroshye kugirango werekane ikosa, kugeza kuri majwi yihariye ya sisitemu y'imikorere igezweho yerekana gutangira, guhagarika, nibindi byabaye.
Earxon ni kumagambo asanzwe amenyerewe mumashusho ya mudasobwa. Agashusho gasa nk ijisho con kandi ni amashusho, yashishikarije DA Sumikawa guhimba gutwi nk'ijwi ryumvikana mu ngingo yo mu 1985, 'Amabwiriza yo guhuza ibimenyetso byerekana amajwi mu mbuga zikoresha mudasobwa.
Iri jambo rikoreshwa cyane kuri Earcon yerekana amajwi muri interineti, ariko ingero z'igitekerezo ziboneka mu bitangazamakuru byamamaza nka radiyo na televiziyo:
Earcons muri rusange asanisha amajwi cyangwa amajwi. Ijambo risa naryo ryumva ryerekana amajwi ya buri munsi akora intego imwe.
Koresha muburyo bwa tekinoroji ifasha.
Tekinoroji ifasha kubikoresho bya mudasobwa nk'abasomyi ba ecran harimo ChromeVox ya ChromeOS, TalkBack ya Android na VoiceOver ya Apple - koresha ugutwi nk'uburyo bworoshye kandi bwihuse bwo kugeza kubakoresha impumyi cyangwa bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona amakuru ajyanye na interineti bayobora. Amatwi mu basomyi ba ecran ahanini akora nkibimenyetso byo kumva kugirango amenyeshe umukoresha ko bahisemo ubwoko bwihariye bwibintu, nka buto, hyperlink cyangwa inyandiko yinjiza. Bashobora kandi gutanga imiterere kubyerekeye inyandiko cyangwa uburyo bugezweho, nkaho urupapuro rwurubuga rurimo gupakira.
Earcons itanga ibyongerwaho mugukoresha abasomyi ba mudasibwa mugukoresha bitewe nubugufi bwabyo nubwitonzi, ibyo bikaba bizan a iterambere mugukoresha ibimenyetso birebire byavuzwe kugirango utange imiterere: gukoresha beep ngufi, itandukanye mugihe buto ya interineti yatoranijwe irashobora kwihuta cyane bityo rero byoroshye kubyumva kuruta gukoresha synthesis imvugo kugirango uvuge ijambo "buto".
Abantu bakoresha Earcon, abakoresha bagomba kwiga guhuza gutwi nibisobanuro byabo kugirango babashe kubyungukiramo byuzuye. Gufasha mukwiga amashyirahamwe nkaya, abasomyi ba ecran bamwe nabo bazavuga ibisobanuro byamatwi yabo, nubwo bigana kumpera yubusobanuro bwabo bwuzuye bwibintu. Birasabwa ko gutwi byamenyekana hakiri kare mugihe wiga gukoresha umusomyi wa ecran kugirango urebe ko bihinduka (kandi amaherezo, subconsciously) bifitanye isano no gukoresha bisanzwe.

ecobee ni sosiyete ikorera iToronto, muri Canada, ikora ibijyanye no gucunga ibikorwa by'amazu (home automation),ikora thermostats z'ikoranabuhanga (smart thermostats),sensor z'ubushyuhe n'izigaragaza ko hari umuntu mu cyumba (temperature and occupancy sensors), switch z'amatara z'ikoranabuhanga(smart light switches),kamera z'ikoranabuhanga (smart camera) ndetse na sensor z'ubwitonzi cyangwa aho ibintu bihurira (contact sensor). Baguzwe na sosiyete y'Abanyamerika Generac Holdings mu 2021.
Thermostats igenzurwa no gukoresha ibyuma byubaka, ibyuma byurubuga, cyangwa porogaramu iboneka kuri iOS, Android, na Apple Watch. Ibindi bikoresho bigenzurwa gusa binyuze muri porogaramu cyangwa urubuga.
Thermostat cyangwa kamera ikora nkurugo rwubwenge rwibikoresho byabo. Guhindura urumuri ntibisaba thermostat cyangwa kamera ariko ntibitanga imikorere ya hub (hub functionalty)
ecobee itanga urutonde rwa serivisi zo kwiyandikisha.
Ecobee yshinzwe na Stuart Lombard mu 2007, kandi Thermostat yayo ya mbere yasohotse mo 2008. Yagiye ihabwa ibihembo bitandukanye, birimo Deloitte Tecnology Green 15 Award ihabwa amasosiyete y'ikoranabuhanga ryita ku bidukikije byo muri Canada, ndetse na AHR Expo Innovation Award 2011 mu cyiciro cy building automation. ​
Muri Werurwe 2018, ecobee yakusanyije CA miliyoni 80 z'amadorari y'uruhererekane C inkunga.
Mu Gushyingo 2021, ecobee yatangaje ko izagurwa na Generac Holdings kuri miliyoni 770 z'amadolari. Igurisha ryarangiye ukwezi gukurikira.
ecobee yaremye ubwenge bwayo bwa thermostat, ecobee Smart, muri 2008.
ecobee yatangiye gusohora eco + muri 2019 kugirango yimenyekanishe thermostat kugiti cye murugo.
Guhindura urumuri rwubwenge.
Ecobee Switch + ni urumuri rwubwenge rwashyizwe ahagaragara ku ya 26 Werurwe 2018 Switch+ ifite mikoro (microphone) irimo Amazon Alexa, ndetse ikagira sensor zigaragaza ko hari umuntu (occupancy sensors) n'izipima urumuri rw'amatara y'amanywa (daylight sensors)
Ecobee SmartCamera yasohotse ku Mata 2020 Ifite amashusho ya 1080p. ubugari bwa Camera bwa dogere 180, guhindura icyerekezo no kuzamura (auto pan-tilt), gushyigikirwa na Amazon Alexa, ikiganiro cy'impande zombi (two-way talk) ndetse no kureba nijoro (night vision).
Ibyuma bifata amajwi bya ecobee SmartSensor byasohotse ku ya 15 Mata 2020 hamwe na SmartCamera.
Kamera ya ecobee Smart Doorbell yasohotse mu Kwakira 2023. Abakoresha bafite ecroste ya Ecobee barashobora kureba ibiryo bizima bivuye kuri kamera yumuryango wabo kuri thermostat.

eufy ni ikirango cy'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga byo mu rugo (smart home) cyatangijwe na Anker Innovation mu 2016. Icyicaro cyacyo kiri i Shenzhen mu Bushinwa. Ibicuruzwa byayo byingenzi birimo kamera zo kugenzura umutekano, gusukura robot vacuum, kumurika ubwenge, nibindi bicuruzwa byo murugo IoT. Ibicuruzwa bya eufy bigurishwa cyane cyane kwisi yose binyuze kumurongo wa interineti no kubicuruza kumurongo nka Amazon na Buy Buy nziza.
eufy yinjiye mu isoko ry'ubwenge mu rugo m'umwaka wa 2016. eufy yabanje gushyira ahagaragara robot vacuum isukura, cyane cyane serivise ya RoboVac, irushanwa n'ibirango bizwi nka iRobot. Kugeza muri 2020, ikirango cyariyongereye muri sisitemu yumutekano murugo, itara ryubwenge, nibikoresho byubuzima nkibipimo byubwenge. Ibicuruzwa birimo icapiro rya 3D ryihariye UV printer EufyMake E1 yatangijwe binyuze muri Kickstarter, sisitemu yumutekano ya NVR S4 Max, na eufy SpaceView.
Amabanga no Kurinda.
Mu 2022, eufy yahuye n’igenzura nyuma yuko bigaragaye ko amakuru y’amafoto y’umutekano yashyizwe kuri seriveri y’ibicu, ibyo bikaba bivuguruza ibyo sosiyete ivuga ko yabitse. Ikirango cyasabye imbabazi kandi kivugurura politiki yacyo, ariko ibibazo byo kwizerana biracyahari. Uwo murundikano w'ibibazo washyize ahagaragara imbogamizi z'umutekano w'amakuru (data security challenges) zibangamiye ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga byo mu rugo,kandi byatumye abagenzuzi b'amasoko (regulators) babikurikirana by'byimbitse. Ivugurura ryurubuga rwa eufy ryongeye gushimangira ubwitange bwibanga, ryibanda kububiko bwaho no gushishoza kugeza ku ndunduro.

Itegeko ry’Abafite Ubumuga (ryerekeye Amahirwe Angana, Kurengera Uburenganzira no Gushyira mu bikorwa byuzuye), ryo mu mwaka wa 1995 ni itegeko rigamije gushyira mu bikorwa itangazo ryerekeye uruhare rwuzuye n’uburinganire bw’abafite ubumuga mu karere ka Aziya na pasifika.
Ubuhinde bwashyize umukono ku Itangazo ryavuzwe kandi ni ngombwa gushyira mu bikorwa Itangazo ryavuzwe haruguru.

Abafite Ubumuga Bo mu karere ka Gasabo.
Taliki 03 Ukuboza n'umunsi mpuzamahanga wabafite ubumuga mukarere ka Gasabo. Abafite ubumuga kandi berekanye impano zitandukanye harimo kubyina, gukina ikinamico, imikino ngorora mubiri nka sitball, kudoda n'ibindi bitandukanye abafite ubumuga bamaze kugeraho.
Kumunsi mpuzamahanga w'abantu bafite ubumuga kurwego rw' Akarere ka Gasabo. Nu munsi urangwa nimurikabikorwa byakozwe n'abafite ubumuga bo Mukarere ka Gasabo. Hanabayeho gushyigikira cyangwa se gutera inkunga buri muntu umwe mumirenge 15 igize Akarere ka Gasabo ndetse hanatazwe amagare(wheelchairs) agera kuri 12 kubafite ubumuga bw'ingingo.

"Ntitwifuza impuhwe" ni intero y’ihuriro ikoreshwa n’abaharanira ishyirwamwo ry’abantu bafite ubumuga mu bya politiki by’isi. Akenshi ikoreshwa mu myigaragambyo y’amashyirahamwe y’ubugiraneza akusanya inkunga yifashishije kugaragaza abafite ubumuga nk’imitwaro cyangwa abatagira icyo bashobora kwikorera. Iri jambo ryatangiye kugaragara ku myenda (T-shirts), rijyanye n’andi magambo y’iterabwoba nk’“Kuhumizwa no Kudindizwa n’Indwara Iteye Agahinda.”
Inkomoko y’amagambo.
Iri jambo rishobora kuba ryarahimbwe n'umucuranzi wa rubanda, umusizi, n'umurwanashyaka uharanira uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga Alan Holdsworth (izina ry'icyiciro: Johnny Crescendo) usanzwe wishingikiriza ku bugome n'amagambo ashize amanga mu buhanzi bwe bwo kwigaragambya.
“Ihora ku mbabazi” (Piss On Pity) yakoreshejwe bwa mbere mu myigaragambyo yo mu 1990 no mu 1992 yiswe Block Telethon, yabereye imbere ya sitidiyo ya ITV mu Bwongereza, aho abaharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bageragezaga guhagarika ko icyo gikorwa cyo gukusanya inkunga gitambutswa kuri televiziyo. Iryo jambo ryasohowe ku myenda (T-shirts) maze ibihumbi byinshi biragurishwa. Iyo myigaragambyo yatanze amahirwe akomeye ku baharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga kugira ngo bagaragaze ibitekerezo byabo, birimo ukuntu abafite ubumuga batagaragazwa neza ndetse n’ukuntu bakurwaho mu biganiro birebana n’inyungu zabo. Ahubwo ku ishyirwa ry’inkunga mu mashyirahamwe y’abagiraneza, abaharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga bashakaga kugaragara no kwinjira mu muryango nyarwanda ku buryo bwabo bwihariye.
Nk’uko abashyigikiye iri jambo babivuga, icyo risobanura ni uko impuhwe, n’ubwo zisa n’amarangamutima meza kandi afasha, zishobora kuba igihombo ku ishema ry’umuntu. Nk’uko babivuga, iri jambo rishingiye ku kwanga ku bushake cyangwa kutabizi abantu bafite ubumuga, ndetse n’ubushobozi bushingiye ku kwikunda no kutita ku bafite ubumuga ubwo kwanga kugaragaza ku bushake cyangwa kutabizi. Nkuko Barbara Lisicki, umwe mu baterankunga b’imyigaragambyo ya Block Telethon, yabivuze muri gahunda ya BBC yitwa Network mu 1989, yagize ati ""Niba ukoresha umuntu ufite ubumuga nk’ikintu cyo gufashwa mu buryo bw’ubugiraneza, ntabwo uzamubona nk’umwe mu banganya nawe"."
“Ihora ku mbabazi” (Piss on Pity) yari izina ry’imurikagurisha ry’abahanzi bafite ubumuga, ryabereye i Wakefield, mu Bwongereza, mu mwaka wa 2019. Ibihangano byabo byagaragazaga ubwanga bw’urugendo rw’abantu bafite ubumuga ku bikorwa by’ubugiraneza. Iyo imurikagurisha yerekanye abahanzi bafite ubumuga bahanganye n’icyifuzo gisanzwe cyo kumva ko ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza ari byiza gusa.
“Ihora ku mbabazi” (Piss on Pity) ni izina ry’album yo mu 2013 ikubiyemo ibihangano bya Johnny Crescendo hamwe na mugenzi we Ian Stanton, bombi bakoresheje umuziki kugaragaza ibitekerezo bishingiye ku bunararibonye bwabo, kimwe n’iby’abandi baharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga.

Bashir Ramathan ni umukinnyi w’ubutaka w’umunya-Uganda umaze kuba umureba kugeza ku myaka 17.
Bashir ni umunyamurongo w’ama filime magufi abiri y’amateka nyayo: "Eveready" iyobowe na Paul Szynol na "Bashir's Vision" iyobowe na Daniel Roher.

Hagati ya 2010, hari ahantu hatandukanye hatangirwagaho inkunga mu Bwongereza no mu Wales, ishobora gutangwa ku bantu bafite ubumuga kugira ngo bahaze ibyifuzo byabo bitandukanye mu rugo no ku kazi, ariko rimwe na rimwe izi nkunga zagiranaga ikibazo cyo kutubahirana. Igitekerezo cya “Uburenganzira bwo Kugenzura” cyari ukugerageza guhuza izi nkunga no gushyira umuntu ufite ubumuga hagati mu migambi ye y’inkunga.
Ibice birindwi by'icyitegererezo.
Nk’igice cy’Itegeko ry’Isubiramo ry’Imibereho Myiza rya 2009, Amabwiriza y’Uburenganzira bwo Kugenzura ku Bantu bafite Ubumuga (Icyerekezo cy’Ibigeragezo) (Ubwongereza) 2010 yagerageje gushyiraho uburenganzira ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo gusaba guhitamo no kugenzura uburyo bw’ikoreshwa ry’amafaranga ya rubanda akenewe kugira ngo bafashwe kubaho mu bwigenge mu muryango.
Urwego rw’izi mishinga rwari harimo inkunga za Access to Work zatangwaga na JobCentre Plus, ikigo cya leta y’icyitegererezo, hamwe na ubwishyu butaziguye ku giciro cy’ubuzima bwigenga, harimo no gukoresha abafasha ku giti cy’umuntu, byishyurwaga ku bantu bafite ubumuga n’ibigo bishinzwe serivisi z’imibereho y’abaturage mu turere. Icyiciro cya mbere cy’ibi bigeragezo cyakomeje kuva Ukuboza 2010 kugeza Ukuboza 2012.
Umwe muri abo baderevu yitwaga Ubufatanye bwa Manchester Area, bwari bugizwe na batanu mu bayobozi icumi bo mu nzego z'ibanze (njyanama) muri Greater Manchester:
Haje kwemerwa kongera igihe cy’amezi 12 ku bigeragezo mu mwaka wa 2013 nyuma yo kuganira, ariko Inama y’Umujyi wa Oldham yaje kwemeza ko izakuramo uruhare rwayo maze isohoka ku 12 Ukuboza 2012.

Sosiyete y’Ubwami y’Abana Bafite Ubumuga bwo Kutabona (RSBC) yahuye na Sosiyete y’Ubwami yo mu Bwongereza y’Abafite Ubumuga bwo Kutabona (RLSB) ku 1 Mutarama 2017. Ibi byagize ishyirahamwe rimwe ry’ubugiraneza ryo mu Bwongereza no Wales. Intego y’iri shyirahamwe ry’ubugiraneza ni ukwemeza ko abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bafite ikibazo cyo kubona, kuva ku myaka 0 kugeza 25, bakura bafite ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bukenewe kugira ngo babashe kubaho ubuzima bwuzuye kandi bushimishije.

Mélanie de Salignac (1741-1763) yari umuhanga mu muziki w’umufaransa utabona, kandi ibyo yagezeho n’ubwo yari afite ubumuga byavuzwe mu nyandiko za Diderot.
Yavutse i Château de Mons (Charente-Maritime) [fr], ari umukobwa w’umushoramari Pierre Vallet de Salignac na Marie-Jeanne Élisabeth Volland, wari mushiki wa Sophie Volland. Musaza we mukuru yari umunyapolitiki Nicolas-Thérèse Vallet de Salignac [fr].
Yavukiye atabona amaso, kera cyane mbere y’uko Braille ivumburwa mu 1829, ariko yize kwiyigisha gusoma akoresheje inyuguti ziri ku makarita yatemwe, kandi yageze ku bintu byinshi akoresheje kumva no gukoraho. Yatekereje uburyo bwo gukoresha ibimenyetso by’umuziki bishobora kumvwa no gukorwaho, yakoresheje gusoma ibihangano by’umuziki no guhanahana ubutumwa n’inshuti.
Diderot yanditse ku byo yagezeho mu nyandiko ye yitwa “Addition to the Letter on the Blind”. Yagaragaje ko yize algebra, jiometri, ubumenyi bw’isi n’inyenyeri. Yandikaga akoresheje umuneke ku rupapuro rwagutse kandi yasomaga ibitabo byanditswe byihariye ku buryo byamufashaga. Yanacanaga imyenda kandi akina imikino y’amakarita. Yafashe ibyigisho n’ubuhanga bwe nk’ishyushyo kandi yemeza ko abantu batabona bagomba kwigishwa hashingiwe ku bushobozi bwabo busanzwe, aho kwibanda ku kutabona kwabo.
Valentin Haüy yatangiye kwigisha abanyeshuri batabona mu myaka ibiri gusa nyuma y’uko “Addition to the Letter on the Blind” ya Diderot yasohotse. Bifatwa nk’uko yashishikajwe n’ibyagezweho na De Salignac ndetse n’undi muhanga mu muziki utabona,Maria Theresia von Paradis.

Santos Futebol Clube (; "Ikipe yumupira wamaguru ya Santos"), izwi kandi nka Santos ndetse n’akazina ka gikundiro Peixe (bivugwa nka [ˈpejʃi]), ni ishyirahamwe ry’umwuga ry’umukino wa goalball ryo muri Bresil yabigize umwuga, ifite icyicaro i Santos, Bresile. Nk’umwe mu batangije umukino wa goalball ku rwego rw’igihugu, Santos FC yashyizeho ikipe ya goalball mu mwaka wa 1999, maze mu ntangiriro za 2006 iba ishyirahamwe rya mbere ry’umupira w’amaguru muri Bresile ryahindutse klub ya Paralympike. Kuva icyo gihe, binyuze mu bufatanye na Lar das Moças Cegas de Santos (LMC), Santos FC ifite umukino wa Goalball, hamwe n’amakipe y’abagabo n’abagore, nka kimwe mu mikino yayo. Uyu mukino uragenda urushaho gukundwa. Mu mikino iheruka, ikipe y’igihugu ya Bresile yari ifite abakinnyi baturutse muri Santos.

Salutem Healthcare ni isosiyete itanga serivisi z’imibereho myiza iikorera i
Windsor yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2016. Ikoresha abakozi barenga 3.000. John Godden, umuyobozi mukuru, yahawe igihembo cya MBE mu birori by'icyubahiro by’umwaka mushya 2021.
Salutem itanga serivisi z’ubuzima bwo gutura no kwigisha ku bantu bakuru n’abana barenga 1,350 bafite ubumuga bwo kwiga n’ibindi bibazo bifitanye isano, harimo n’abafite imyitwarire igoye gucunga. Mu Mata 2017, Salutem yafashe Pathways Care Group na Modus Care, ari bo batanga serivisi zihariye zo kwita ku bana n’abantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bwo kwiga, ibibazo by’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, autism n'imyitwarire igoye gucunga. Icyo gihe yari ifite amazu 55 akaba yarakwirwagaho n’abaturage bagera ku 400. Kugura Clearwater Care mu Ugushyingo 2017 byongeraga serivisi 20. Mu Kwishyura 2019, yari ikora serivisi 130 mu Bwongereza no Wales.
Mu Mata 2018, Salutem yaguriye serivisi 51 zavuye muri Scope, zirimo ishuri ryihariye 3, amazu yita ku bantu 38, n’ahakorerwa serivisi z’iminsi 10.Iyo mpinduranya yagize abakozi 1,598, bingana na ibice bibiri bya gatatu by’abakozi bose b’iri shyirahamwe ry’ubugiraneza, bahinduranyirijwe bava muri Scope bajya muri Ambito Care &amp; Education, ishami rya Salutem. Scope yabonye miliyoni 3 z’amapawundi kuri iyo mpinduranya.
Itanga ibirori bya buri mwaka bisaba imyambaro y’icyubahiro (black-tie), bizwi nka Kudos Ball, bibera Rainton Meadows Arena, Houghton-le-Spring aho abakoresha serivisi 300 baturutse impande zose z’igihugu bitabira.
Craig y Parc ni ishuri riri i Cardiff, ryashinzwe mu 1955, ryita ku bana bafite ubumuga bukomeye, ubwonko n’ubwiyongere bw’ubumuga bwinshi, ryari ryari riyobowe na Scope mbere. Tŷ Cwtch Residential Children Home iri hafi yaryo. Mu Mata 2020, abapolisi bo mu gace bateje imbere ikigaragaza ku isabukuru y’imyaka 14 y’umwe mu banyeshuri. Iri shuri rikoresha Dragon Dictate mu gufasha abanyeshuri.
Umuyobozi wa filime nyayo, Mei Williams, yahawe igihembo cya BAFTA mu 2019 kubera filime ye yerekeye umuturanyi wa Lewis Martin Court, aho isosiyete itanga serivisi zita ku bantu bakiri bato bafite ibyifuzo bikomeye ku masaha 24 ku munsi.
Bull Point ni ikigo cyita ku bantu batuye mu rugo i Plymouth, kigenewe abantu 5 bafite uburwayi bwo ku rwego rwa Autistic Spectrum Disorder. Mu mwaka wa 2019, cyateguye igitaramo cy’imbwa kugira ngo hizihirwe isabukuru y’imyaka 8 y’imbwa y’umuturanyi umwe.

Ishuri rya Sri Rakum ry’Abatabona ni ishuri ryita ku bantu bafite ikibazo cyo kubona riherereye i Bangalore, mu Buhinde. Ritanga uburezi bw’ubuntu ku banyeshuri batabona kuva mu mashuri y'inshuke kugeza ku rwego rwo hejuru. Amahugurwa atangwa arimo gusoma no kwandika hakoreshejwe Braille hamwe na amahugurwa yo kugenda ku bana batabona burundu. Abanyeshuri bato bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona bahugurwa hakiri kare mu mashuri y’inshuke kugira ngo bitegure kuzuza amashuri, kaminuza, n'amahugurwa y’umwuga. Iki ni Ishyirahamwe ryanditswe ritari irya Leta.
Iri shuri ryashinzwe na Acharya Sri Rakum mu Kamena 1998. Yaretse akazi ke mu mikino y’intambara (martial arts) mu Buyapani no mu Buhindi kugira ngo ateze imbere iri shuri. Ubu ni umuyobozi mukuru w’iri shuri.

Richard St. Denis ni umwunganizi mu by’amategeko ukomoka muri Colorado, umwe mu Bafashwe nk’Abakorerabushake 10 ba mbere na CNN ymu 2011, ndetse ni umushinga wa World Access Project. Uyu mushinga kuva mu 2008 watangiye gutanga amapine y'intebe ku bantu bafite ubumuga mu byaro byo muri Mexico.
Yakomeretse akina ski i Lake Tahoe, California mu 1976, kuva icyo gihe akoresha imodoka y’amaguru (wheelchair). Umushinga we wa World Access Project ukusanya amapine akoreshwa (used wheelchairs) ava mu bitaro, amazu yita ku barwayi, amasosiyete atanga ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi, ndetse n’abaterankunga ku giti cyabo baturutse mu Bwongereza bwose.

T61-64 ni ibyiciro by’ubumuga mu mikino ya paralympik, bikoreshwa mu mikino yo kwiruka no gusimbuka mu marushanwa ya mumikino Paralympique. Ibi byiciro birimo abakinnyi bafite ubumuga ku kuguru cyangwa ukuboko (biterwa n’ivuko ryihariye impanuka, cyangwa gukurwaho kw’igice cy’umubiri mu buryo bwa kirurigi) cyangwa abafite itandukaniro ry’urebure rw’amaguru rirenze santimetero 18 (inches 7 cyangwa zirenga).

T71-72 ni siporo yimikino yabamugaye kuri para-siporo, by’umwihariko ku bakinnyi bakoresha igare ryihariye ryo kwiruka. Ibi byiciro birimo abakinnyi bafite ibibazo byo guhagarika no kugenzura imyanya y’umubiri, nk’hypertonia, ataxia na athetose. Imikino y’ibi byiciro irimo metero 100 na metero 400.
Kwiruka kumurongo byasabwe kunanirwa kwinjizwa mumikino Paralympike ya 2024. Igikorwa cya T71 cyabaye ku nshuro ya mbere mu marushanwa ya 2025 World Para Athletics Championships. Imikino ya T72 Imikino ya 100 metres T72 y’abagabo n’abagore izaba ikina ku nshuro ya mbere mu marushanwa yo mikino Paralympike ya 2028.

Ishuri rya Ahmadi ry’Abafite Ubumuga bwo Kutabona ni ishuri ryigenga muri Kaminuza ya Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), i Aligarh, mu Buhindi, ryiyemeje gutanga uburezi no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Ishuri ritanga uburezi bw’amashuri n’ubw’umwuga kugira ngo ryongere ubushobozi bw’abanyeshuri, ubwigenge, n’amahirwe yo kubona akazi.
Iri shuri ryashinzwe na Nyakwigendera Sahebzada Aftab Ahmad Khan mu 1927. Kaminuza ya Aligarh Muslim yatangiriye gutanga inkunga y’imari ku ishuri mu 1947, maze mu 1949 ifata ubuyobozi bwaryo burundu. Iri shuri ryagiye ritera imbere buhoro buhoro rikaba ikigo cy’icyitegererezo ku bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, kandi ni ryonyine mu bwoko bwarwo ryubahirizwa na Kaminuza Nkuru. Ryashinzwe rigamije kwita by’umwihariko ku bana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, bikaba byaragiye rigira uruhare mu gutangiza uburezi burimo bose (inclusive education) muri AMU. Mu myaka ishize, ryagutse mu bikorwa n’ibikorwaremezo kugira ngo abanyeshuri barusheho gukura no gutera imbere mu buryo bwuzuye.
Ishuri rya Ahmadi ritanga uburezi kuva ku rwego rw’ibanze kugeza hejuru, rikurikiza amasomo ahinduwe kugira ngo ahuze n’ibyifuzo by’abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Ishuri ryemeza ko abanyeshuri babasha kugera ku masomo neza binyuze mu bitabo bya Braille, ibikoresho by’amajwi byo kwiga, n’ikoranabuhanga ry’ubufasha. Ishuri kandi rifite laboratwari zitandukanye zirimo Science Lab, Computer Lab, Mathematics Lab, Language Lab, na PHE Lab.
Laboratwari ya Siyansi yashyizweho kugira ngo abanyeshuri bige binyuze mu bikorwa bifatika bakoresheje ibimenyetso n’ibikoresho. Laboratwari ya Mudasobwa ifite porogaramu zisoma ku ishusho (screen reading software) nka JAWS ndetse na Braille Embosser, kugira ngo abanyeshuri bigishwe ubumenyi mu ikoranabuhanga. Laboratwari ya Matematiki yashyizweho hamwe na ibimenyetso bishobora gukorwaho n’ibikoresho by’imfashanyigisho, bigafasha abanyeshuri gusobanukirwa ibitekerezo bya matematiki. Ishuri kandi ritanga amasomo y’umuziki, haba mu njyana y’instrumenti no mu kuririmba, bifasha abanyeshuri kugaragaza impano zabo mu buhanzi. Hari kandi icyumba cyo kwidagadura ku bana bato, kirimo ibikoresho bitandukanye byo gukina, televiziyo n’ibindi. Inzu y’ibitabo y’ishuri itanga ibitabo byinshi bya Braille hamwe na amasomo n’ibikoresho byorohereza abanyeshuri mu myigire yabo.
Uretse amasomo asanzwe, ishuri ryibanda ku myigire ishingiye ku bumenyi bw’imyuga kugira ngo abanyeshuri bagire ubwigenge. Amasomo y’umwuga arimo: kwandika ku mpapuro n’ikoreshwa rya mudasobwa (Typing), kuboha ku bikoresho by’intoki (weaving of handlooms), gusana intebe (chair-recaning), kudoda, kudoda mu buryo bwa knitting, guteka n’ibindi. Ishuri rigamije gutanga ibikorwa by’imikino birimo cricket n’indi mikino, bigamije guteza imbere ubuzima bwiza no gukorana n’abandi. Ishuri kandi ryategura gahunda z’umuco n’uburezi kugira ngo hizihirwe iterambere ryuzuye ry’umuntu.
Iri shuri ryibanda ku gutura mu kigo (residential) ritanga icumbi, ibiribwa n’imyambaro ku buntu. Rifite amahosteli abiri, rimwe ku bakyara n’irindi ku bagabo. Serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku buntu nazo ziratangwa n’ishuri.
Iri shuri ryakira abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona nta vangura ku gitsina, ubwoko, imyemerere, ibara ry’uruhu, icyiciro cyangwa idini.
Yashinzwe na Sahibzada Aftab Ahmad Khan byumwihariko kubanyeshuri bafite ibibazo. Iri shuri ryibanda ku gutura mu kigo (residential) rifite ibikorwa byo gutanga icumbi n’ibiribwa ku buntu.

Muhammad Ahmed Akram ni umukinnyi w’umupira w’amakipe w’Umupakistani utabona, wavukiye ku wa 10 Nzeri 1974 i Islamabad, wakiniye igihugu cye mu gice cya mbere cy’amarushanwa y'igikombe cy’isi cya Blind T20 2012 aho ikipe ye yarangije ku mwanya wa kabiri. Muri iyo World Cup, yashyizeho ikibaho cy’isi ku manota menshi umuntu umwe ashobora kubona mu mukino wa T20I ndetse no mu mateka y’igikombe cyisi cya Blind T20 (264)

Ishuri rya Ideal rya Al-Nibras ni ishuri ryashinzwe muri Nzeri 2004 rigamije kwita ku bana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe buto kugeza ku rugero ruringaniye, kuva ku myaka 4 kugeza 21.
Ishuri ritanga serivisi zaryo zose mururimi rwicyarabu ukoresheje imvugo ya Koweti. Ishuri ritanga ubuvuzi, kuvura umubiri, kuvura akazi, umukozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza, umujyanama, umuforomo no kwisuzumisha kwa buri kwezi.

Igihembo cya Barbellion ni igihembo cy’ubuvanganzo cyo mu Bwongereza, "cyiyemeje guteza imbere amajwi y’abarwaye n’abantu bafite ubumuga mu mwandiko". Gitangwa buri mwaka ku mwanditsi wese, mu njyana iyo ari yo yose, ufite indwara ikomeye cyangwa utuye afite ubumuga. Iki gihembo cyashinzwe mu 2020 na Jake Goldsmith, ufite cystic fibrosis, kandi ibitaramo bye byanditswe “Neither Weak nor Obtuse” (2022: ISBN 978-1952386398) na “In Hospital Environments: Essays on Illness and Philosophy” (2024: ISBN 978-1952386930) byasohowe na Sagging Meniscus Press. Iki gihembo cyitwa ku izina rya W. N. P. Barbellion (1889–1919; izina rye nyakuri Bruce Frederick Cummings), umwanditsi w’igitabo “The Journal of a Disappointed Man”, wabaye ufite multiple sclerosis kandi apfuye afite imyaka 30. "​"Mu mwaka wa 2023, Goldsmith yatangaje ko iki gihembo “kizashyirwa ku kiruhuko kitazwi” kandi ko igihembo cya 2023 kitazatangwa, ariko “dushobora gukomeza mu 2024 mu buryo bwiza kurushaho”. Kuva muri Gicurasi 2025, urubuga rw’iki gihembo rwavuze ko “Nyuma y’ikiruhuko cyacu, Igihembo cya Barbellion kizagaruka mu mwaka ushize. Ibindi bizatangazwa muri Nzeri 2025.”
Iki gihembo ni mpuzamahanga kandi cyakira ibitabo bishya byahinduwe mu Cyongereza, ndetse n’ibyanditswe n’abanditse ubwabo (self-published), ariko ntikireba ibitabo bitarasohotse. Ubusabe bushingiye ku kuba umwanditsi agaragaza ubuzima afite indwara ikomeye cyangwa ubumuga bw’igihe kirekire... bushobora kugena ubuzima bwe ku buryo bugaragara, kandi abanditsi—nk’abari mu mwanya w’abita ku bandi—batagize ubumuga bashobora gusuzumwa niba igihangano cyabo ari cy’igitangaza mu kugaragaza ubuzima n’indwara, ariko bazahabwa umwanya muto mu guhatanira igihembo. Uwatsindiye iki gihembo ahabwa £1,000, igikombe cy’ikirahure (glass trophy), ndetse n’igitabo cya Barbellion cyitwa “The Journal of a Disappointed Man”.

Lewis (yitiriwe Meriwether Lewis) ni robot yigenga ikora akazi ko gufotora mu bukwe: ijya mu birori by'abantu, igatembera, kandi igafata amafoto y'ikoranabuhanga y'abantu. Ni umushinga w'ubushakashatsi muri Laboratwari y'Itangazamakuru n'imashini muri kaminuza ya Washington muri St.
Lewis yagaragaye kuri slashdot, kurubuga rwa CNN, no mubinyamakuru bitandukanye byo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru.
Mu 2002, Lewis yakiriye - hanyuma yanga - ubutumire mu birori byo kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 24 ya Nelly.

Looj yari robo yo murugo isukura imiyoboro y'amazi (eavestrough) yakozwe kandi igurishwa na companyi ya iRobot.
Looj ntabwo yari robot yigenga, ahubwo yari robo igenzurwa n'uyikoresha hakoreshejwe kure, ifite imiterere isa n'iy'igare ry'igikinisho,kandi ifite imashini isongora(power drill) ishyizwe imbere.
Looj yari muremure na robot yagutse ikwiranye mu myanda myinshi kugirango isukure imyanda yabayemo, nk'amababi n'inshinge za pinusi. Ryari rifite ibirenge birebire ku ruhande rwaryo ryemerera kugenda imbere mu muyoboro, hamwe na auger ifatanye imbere. Auger, izunguruka ibintu byoroshye kuri 500 RPM, yajugunye kandi ikuraho imyanda imbere mu muyoboro uyijugunya mu kirere. Igikoresho kandi cyari gifite icyuma gitandukanya / cyitaruye, cyakoreshwaga mu gutwara no gukoresha robot.
Moderi ya mbere ya Looj yakoreshejwe na bateri yimbere 7.2 V NiCad ishobora kwishyurwa, igomba gukurwaho kugirango yishyure. Nyuma moderi ikoresha bateri ya Li-ion yishyurwa aho.
Looj yahagaritswe muri 2017.
Looj yakiriwe neza n'ababisuzuma mbere yo kurekurwa. Crunch Gear yagize ati "Niba ushyize urwego rwawe mu mfuruka y'inzu - kandi imyanda yawe yagutse bihagije - urashobora guhanagura byoroshye impande ebyiri zinzu muminota mike."
Looj yatsindiye igihembo "cyiza cya CES Innovations Award: Ibikoresho byo mu rugo" muri

Imashini za Toyota Partner ni urukurikirane rwa za robo zifite ishusho imeze nk'abantu (humanoid) zakozwe na Toyota. Zatangiye kwerekanwa bwa mbere zicuranga ingoma n'impanda mu imurikagurisha mpuzamahanga ryabereye muri Aichi, mu Buyapani mu mwaka wa 2005. Hano hari robot 5, zose zifite sisitemu zitandukanye. Imashini 5 ni: verisiyo ya 1 (robot ya bipedal), verisiyo ya 2 (Segway -like wheels), verisiyo ya 3 (Segway -like wheels), verisiyo ya 4 (sisitemu y'insinga idasanzwe) na i-Foot (ishobora gushyirwaho amaguru 2). Muri Nyakanga 2009, Toyota yashyize ahagaragara amashusho y'ubuhanga bwo kwiruka no guhagarara kwa robot mugenzi wabo. Imashini igera kuri 7 km / isaha, icyakora kugenda no kwiruka birashobora kugerwaho gusa hejuru yuburinganire. Muri 2017, Toyota yasohoye igisekuru cyayo cya gatatu cyimashini za robo, T-HR3, izakoreshwa mu ngendo zo mu kirere.

WEMO, ni ishami rya kampanyi ya Belkin, akaba ri urukurikirane bw'ibicuruzwa byaBelkin bakoresha control home electronics remotely. The product suite includes electrical plugs, motion sensors, light switches, cameras, light bulbs, and a mobile app.
Wemo Switch ishobora gucomekwaho mumurongo uwo ariwo wose akayikoresha murugo kugirago arinde umutekano bwibiza byaterwa n'amashanyarazi, ushobora noneho kugenzurwa na terefone ya iOS cyangwa Android ikoresha Wemo App, ukoresheje urugo rwa Wi-Fi cyangwa umuyoboro wa terefone igendanwa.
Sensor ya Wemo Motion ishobora gushyirwa ahantu hose, mugihe ishobora kugera kumurongo umwe wa Wi-Fi nkibikoresho bya Wemo igenewe kugenzura. Ishobora kuzimya no kuzimya igikoresho icyo aricyo cyose cya Wemo gihujwe numuyoboro wa Wi - Fi mugihe abantu bahanyuze.
Porogaramu ya Wemo igenzura ibikoresho bya Wemo aho ariho hose ku isi igihe cyose umuyoboro wa Wemo cyangwa se ibikoresho bya Wemo bihujwe na interineti. Ibikoresho bya Wemo bishobora kandi kugenzurwa ukoresheje tekinoroji ya IFTTT. Ibikoresho bya Wemo birashobora kandi kugenzurwa nijwi binyuze muri Amazon Echo, Umufasha wa Google, na Siri ya Apple (binyuze mu gukoresha ikiraro cya Wemo).
Kutagira umutekano muke.
Guhindura Wemo bigenzurwa hakoreshejwe imiyoboro ya IP; bityo, kugirango uhindurwe kugenzurwa kuva kure, igomba kuba ifunguye kugirango yakire imiyoboro iva kuri enterineti. Muri Mutarama 2013, byagaragaye ko Wemo yari ifite inenge z'umutekano udahagaze neza mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya UPnP bityo bikaba bya kwemerera umukoresha utabifitiye uburenganzira kugenzura icyuma. Ibi birashobora kwemerera ibitero bibi, nko guhinduranya ibintu ku buryo bwihuse cyane, bishobora kwangiza ibikoresho bimwe ndetse bikanatera umuriro w'amashanyarazi.
Iyi ntege nke yakemuwe no gusohora porogaramu igezweho.
Ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2025, Belkin yatangaje icyemezo yafashe cyo guhagarika inkunga ya tekiniki ku bicuruzwa bya Wemo bishaje, guhera ku ya 31 Mutarama 2026. Nyuma yiyi tariki, ibicuruzwa byinshi bya Wemo ntibizongera kugenzurwa binyuze muri porogaramu ya Wemo kuko inkunga izaba yarahagaze. Ibintu byose bishingiye kubicu bihuza, harimo kugera kure hamwe nijwi ryunganira amajwi, ntibizongera gukora.

OpenWebNet ni protocole y'itumanaho yakozwe na Bticino mu mwaka wa 2000.
tekinoloji ya OpenWebNet yemerera urwego rwohejuru imikoranire hagati yikigo cya na Bus SCS ya MyHome domotic sisitemu. Ubwihindurize bwa protocole iheruka kunozwa kugirango yemere imikoranire hamwe na sisitemu izwi cyane yo gukoresha urugo nka KNX na DMX512-A, ukoresheje amarembo akwiye.
Porotokole ya OpenWebNet yashyizwe ahagaragara kumuryango wa MyOpen.
OpenWebNet Porotocol.
Abayobozi batekerezaga ko yigenga ku ikoranabuhanga ryakoreshejwe. Kurugero, bishoboka gukoresha software yubugenzuzi ihujwe na Ethernet, ukoresheje serial RS-232 cyangwa ukoresheje USB kugera kumarembo ahujwe na sisitemu ya domotic. Umuntu arashobora kwagura ubutumwa bwa protocole. Birahagije gusaba RFC yabo. Bizasuzumwa kandi bishyirwe ahagaragara niba byubaha syntax "ya OpenWebNet".
Hariho ubwoko 4 bwubutumwa bwa OpenWebNet:
"Itegeko / Ubutumwa"
* NINDE * NIKI * AHO # AHO ##
"Ubutumwa busaba ubutumwa"
"Gusaba / Soma / Andika Ikigereranyo Ubutumwa" busaba:
* # NINDE * AHO * DIMENSION ##
*#NINDE* AHO * DIMENSION * AGACIRO1 * … * AGACIRO ##
*#NINDE* AHO * # DIMENSION * AGACIRO1 * … * AGACIRO ##
Irembo GufunguraWebNet.
Bishoboka guhuza na bisi yo gutangiza urugo rwa SCS ukoresheje amarembo yihariye.
Hariho uburyo bubiri bwamarembo yemerera guhuza bisi yo kukibuza ukoresheje protocole isanzwe:
Irembo rya Ethernet.
Gushyira mubikorwa ubu buryo bwa na BTicino nayo yashyizwemo seriveri. Ikora nkumusemuzi hagati yubutumwa bwa OpenWebNet binyuze kuri TCP / IP nubutumwa bwa SCS bwatanzwe kuri bisi ya SCS.
Gateway USB cyangwa RS-232.
Gateway ni igice gikora nkumusemuzi hagati yubutumwa bwa OpenWebNet bwoherejwe kuri USB cyangwa serial hamwe nubutumwa bwa SCS bwatanzwe muri bisi ya SCS ibyo bigafasha cyane abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kuko iyi serivici ikoresha amajwi.

ASUS Zenbo ni robot yo mu rugo ikomoka muri Tayiwani yakozwe na kompanyi ya Asus, yashyizwe ikerekanwa ku nshuro ya mbere mu imurikagurisha ahagaragara rya Computex 2016. Igiciro cy’amadorari agera kuri 599 US $, ASUS Zenbo isa na mugenzi muto uzunguruka ufite ibara ryerekana amabara “isura” hamwe n’uruziga ruzengurutse rufite ibiziga. Byakozwe na Intel itunganya Intel hamwe na Intel RealSense ubujyakuzimu - kamera kamera, byatejwe imbere nka "mudasobwa ya robot kuri buri rugo". Izina ryahumetswe no guhuza " Zen ", "robot" na "umuhungu".
Zenbo yagenewe gutanga ubufasha,gususurutsa, hamwe nubusabane cyangwa umufasha w'abantu bo mu byiciro byose by'imyaka. kubantu bakuze, itanga ubutumwa bubibutsa imiti n'inama z'ibikorwa, kumenya igihe umuntu aguye, ndetse n'amatangazo y'akanya k'amage. Abagize umuryango barashobora kugenzura kure kamera ya Zenbo kugirango bagenzure. Irashimangira kandi guhuza ibisekuruza - gushoboza guhamagara kuri videwo, ijwi - gutwara imbuga za interineti, no kugenzura ibikoresho byo mu rugo bifite ubwenge nk'amatara, televiziyo, hamwe n'ubukonje.
Mu ngo zifite abana, Zenbo arashobora kuba umwanditsi w'inkuru, umufasha w'uburezi, hamwe n'imyidagaduro, afite imikino yo guhuza ibitekerezo, indirimbo, hamwe n'ibisubizo byerekana mumaso yayo.
Kurekura no kwakira.
Zenbo yatangije gahunda yo gutumiza muri Tayiwani ku ya 1 Mutarama 2017, ishyigikiwe n’ubufatanye mu nzego za guverinoma, uburezi, ndetse n’umutekano - harimo porogaramu yihutirwa ihujwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cya Polisi.
Mu gihe isuzuma ryambere ryashimye ubushobozi bwaryo, ugereranije na terefone zigendanwa zidasanzwe, hamwe n’imiterere yaryo ikomeye, abanenga bagaragaje imbogamizi mu kumenyekanisha imvugo no kugendagenda neza. ASUS yagaragaje icyizere ko Zenbo izaterwa imbere binyuze mugutanga umusanzu kwa ba developers no mu gukura k'uburyo bw'imikorere n'ibidukikije byayo.
Ukuboza 2017, ASUS yazamuye Zenbo mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi, iyishyira hamwe n’ubuvuzi kugira ngo ikoreshwe mu bitaro by’ubwenge bifite ubwenge hamwe n’isosiyete itanga amakuru yo mu Busuwisi Clinerion. Mu mpera za 2023–2024, ibitekerezo by’abaturage - harimo ibibazo bya tekiniki ndetse no guhagarika ivugurura - byavugaga ko Zenbo yaguye mu cyiciro gito cy’inkunga, ariko nyuma byemezwa ko ari ukutumvikana.

Ijisho ry'amashanyarazi ni igikoresho cyo gutahura urumuri gikoreshwa mu kumenya igihe urumuri ruvanywe cyangwa ruciye mu kintu. Urugero ni sisitemu y'umutekano y'umuryango ikoreshwa k'umuryango wa garage ikoresha umucyo woherezwa n'uwakira uri ku mpera y'irembo kugira ngo rihagarike gufunga igihe hari ikintu gihari cyacika ku rucyuruzo rw'urumuri. Igikoresho ntabwo gitanga ishusho; gusa kuba hari urumuri biragaragara. Umucyo ugaragara urashobora gukoreshwa, ariko imirasire yimirasire ihisha imikorere yigikoresho kandi mubisanzwe ikoreshwa muri sisitemu zigezweho. Ubusanzwe, sisitemu yakoreshaga amatara akoreshwa numuyoboro utaziguye cyangwa umurongo w'amashanyarazi uhinduranya inshuro zigezweho, ariko sisitemu ya kijyambere ya fotodetector ikoresha diode ya infrarafarike itanga urumuri rwahinduwe kuri kilohertz nkeya, ituma disiketi yanga urumuri rwazimiye kandi igateza imbere urwego, ibyiyumvo, numutekano wibikoresho.

Imiyoboro ya radiyo y'ubwoko bwose, harimo gufungura urugi rwa garage, terefone idafite umugozi, terefone ngendanwa, wohereje amashusho adafite umugozi, mikoro idafite umugozi, n'abandi benshi bari muri iki cyiciro.

OpenPicus yari isosiyete ikora ibyuma ikomoka yatangijwe mumwaka wa 2011 yateguye kandi ikora sisitemu ya Internet yibintu kuri module yitwa Flyport. Flyport ni ibyuma bifunguye kandi urwego rwa OpenPicus na IDE ni software ifunguye. Flyport ni sisitemu ikomeye yonyine kuri module, kuko ntamuntu uturuka hanze ukenewe kugirango agokere porogaramu za IoT. Isosiyete yahagaritse imirimo muri 2018.
OpenPicus yashinzwe na Claudio Carnevali na Gabriele Allegria mu mwaka wa 2011.Igitekerezo cyari ugushiraho ibyuma na porogaramu bifungura sisitemu kugira ngo byihutishe iterambere ry’ibikoresho na serivisi by’umwuga IoT. ["citation ikenewe"]
Umwaka wa 2018 urangiye, OpenPicus Wiki hamwe namakuru yose afitanye isano na Hardware yamakuru yabuze kuri enterineti kuko abashinze OpenPicus ubu bamenyekanisha izina rya IOmote bahindura ubumenyi bwabo mubucuruzi nyabwo. Amwe mumakuru ashaje agaragazwa na (wiki, inyigisho, nibindi) kubibaho bya OpenPicus birashobora kugarurwa ukoresheje Internet Archive Wayback Machine. ["citation ikenewe"]
Flyport ni sisitemu yubwenge kandi ihujwe kuri module ya enterineti. Flyport ikoreshwa nimbaraga zikomeye kandi zoroheje zifungura isoko (ishingiye kuri FreeRTOS) icunga porogaramu ya TCP / IP, porogaramu y'abakoresha hamwe na "seriveri" ihuriweho. Flyport iboneka muri 3 pin ihuza:
Sisitemu ya Flyport kuri module ishingiye kuri Microchip Technology PIC24 itunganya ingufu nke. Ikoreshwa muguhuza no kugenzura sisitemu kurubuga rwa murandasi binyuze muri enterineti yashyizwemo cyangwa seriveri isanzwe ya TCP / IP. Microcontroller ihuriweho ikora abakiriya, ntabwo rero umukiriya yakenewe. Pinout iroroshye cyane kuva ishobora guhindurwa na software.
Flyport ishobora guhuzwa na seriveri nyinshi yibintu nka Evrthng, Xively, ThingSpeak nibindi byinshi.

GreenPeak Technologies yari Utrecht, mu Buholandi ishingiye kuri fabless ikora ibicuruzwa na semiconductor hamwe na software ya IEEE 802.15.4 na Zigbee igice cyisoko ridafite umugozi. Ikoranabuhanga rya Zigbee rikoreshwa itumanaho ry'amakuru mu ngo zigezweho Smart Home no korohereza interineti yibintu (loT), ijambo rikaba risobanura ibikoresho byagenewe gukorerwa no gucungwa n'ibikoresho cyangwa sisitemu zigenzurwa n'itumanaho tya internet.
Porogaramu z'ibyuma by'amaradiyo bidakoresha insinga (wireless sensor applications) akenshi zishingiye ku bipimo ngenderwaho by'inganda, bishyiraho ibisabwa ku mikoranire y'ibikoresho (interoperability)kandi bigatuma ibice bitandukanye byavuye ku bacuruzi batandukanye bikora hamwe mu nzego nk'iyubakwa ry'amazu no mu bwikorezi bw'inganda (industrial automation).
Iterambere rya GreenPeak rishingiye ku nganda zifunguye hiyongereyeho IEEE 802.15.4. GreenPeak ni umunyamuryango wa Global Semiconductor Alliance kandi ishyigikira amahame afunguye yisi yose ya Zigbee.
GreenPeak ikubiyemo ibyuma bigenzura itumanaho rya Zigbee Smart Home hamwe na IoT ya IEEE 802.15.4.
Ku ya 17 Mata 2016, hatangajwe ko GreenPeak yemeye kugurwa na Qorvo. Nyuma yo kugura, GreenPeak yakomeza gukorera mu Buholandi, mu Bubiligi no muri Hong Kong nk'ishami ry’ubucuruzi rya "Low-power Wireless Systems" mu bucuruzi bw’ibikorwa Remezo n’Ingabo (IDP) bya Qorvo. Cees Links, wahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru wa GreenPeak Technologies, yatangaje ko azatangira kuba umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami ry’ubucuruzi rya Wireless Connectivity.

RoboBraille ni serivise y'urubuga ndetsa na imeri ishoboye guhindura inyandiko muburyo butandukanye kandi bworoshye nka Braille, mp3, e-ibitabo na Daisy. Serivisi ishobora kandi gukoreshwa muguhindura ubundi buryo butagerwaho nkamashusho ya skaneri na dosiye ya pdf muburyo bworoshye. RoboBraille yatangiye gukora kuva mu mwaka wa 2004 kandi kuri ubu itanga ibyifuzo byabakoresha ibihumbi buri kwezi kubakoresha ku isi. Serivise iraboneka kubuntu kubantu kugiti cyabo, badakoresha ubucuruzi. Gukoresha ibigo byamasomo birahari binyuze muri SensusAccess.
Serivisi ya RoboBraille yateguwe ku bufatanye n’ikigo cy’igihugu cya Danemark gishinzwe ubumuga bwo kutabona ku bana n’urubyiruko hamwe n’ibarura rya ApS. RoboBraille iboneka kubuntu kubantu kurubuga rwa murandasi, ndetse nabadakoresha ubucuruzi kandi ntibakeneye kwiyandikisha kugirango bakoreshe serivisi. Gukoresha ubucuruzi muburyo ubwo aribwo bwose birabujijwe. Iterambere n'imikorere bya RoboBraille byatewe inkunga na Guverinoma ya Danemark, Komisiyo y’Uburayi ndetse n’imiryango yigenga. Amashyirahamwe menshi yagize uruhare mu iterambere rya serivisi ya RoboBraille harimo na Royal National College for Blind ifite icyicaro i Hanoford, mu Bwongereza, Ishuri rya St Joseph ry’abatabona, Irilande, Inama y’igihugu y’abatabona bo muri Irilande, Repubulika ya Irilande, Associazione Nazionale Subvedenti, Ubutaliyani, CIDEF, Porutugali, Hilfsgemeinschaft der Blinden und Sehschwachen Öster. w'impumyi n'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, Lituwaniya, Ishyirahamwe Valentin Haüy, mu Bufaransa, n'Umuryango Pancyprian w'impumyi, Kupuro.
Mu Gushyingo 2012, serivisi ya RoboBraille yahawe igihembo cya WISE 2012 na Qatar Foundation mu rwego rwo gushimira uruhare rwayo mu burezi butarangwamo inzitizi. Muri Mutarama 2010, serivisi za RoboBraille zabonye igihembo cyiza cya BETT. Iyi serivisi yabanje kubona igihembo cya BETT kubera igisubizo cyiza gikenewe mu burezi bwihariye (2010), Igihembo cya IT cyo Kwiga ku gisubizo cyiza cya eL kwiga (2009), Igihembo cy’igihugu cya eWell-Kuba “Kugera kuri Digitally Exclude” (2009), Igihembo cya Komisiyo y’Uburayi eInclusion Award for e-Accessibility Award (2008), Igihembo cya Well-Tech cyo gutanga udushya (Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete Sosiyete).

RoboBraille yahimbwe mu mwaka wa 2004 na Lars Ballieu Christensen, umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa na rwiyemezamirimo ndetse na Svend Thougaard, inzobere mu itangazamakuru. Optical Braille Recognition ni tekinoroji yo gufata no gutunganya amashusho ndetse n'inyuguti ya brile karemano. Ikoreshwa muguhindura inyandiko za braille kubantu badashobora kuyisoma mumyandiko, no kubungabunga no kubyara inyandiko.
Mu mwaka wa 1984, itsinda ry’abashakashatsi bo muri kaminuza y’ikoranabuhanga ya Delft ryateguye igisate cyo gusoma cyo mu bwoko bwa braille, aho umutwe wo gusoma ufite selile zifotora zimuriwe hamwe n’abategetsi kugira ngo bafate inyandiko y’inyandiko umurongo ku murongo ubu buryo kandi bufasha cyane abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Mu 1988, itsinda ry’abashakashatsi b’Abafaransa muri kaminuza y’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga ya Lille bakoze algorithm, yitwa Lectobraille, yahinduye inyandiko za brile mu nyandiko isanzwe. Sisitemu yafotoye inyandiko ya braille hamwe na kamera ntoya ya CCD, kandi ikoresha tekinoroji yo kuyungurura umwanya, kuyungurura hagati, isuri, no kwaguka kugirango ikuremo braille. Inyuguti za braille zahinduwe mururimi karemano hakoreshejwe kumenyekanisha imiterere. Tekinike yari ifite ikosa rya 1%, kandi ifata igihe cyo gutunganya amasegonda arindwi kumurongo. Mu mwaka wa 1993, itsinda ryabashakashatsi bo muri Katholieke Universiteit Leuven ryashyizeho uburyo bwo kumenya braille yari yarabisikanye hamwe na scaneri iboneka mubucuruzi. ariko, ntabwo yashoboye gukemura ikibazo cyubumuga buri muri gride ya braille, kubwibyo byasabwaga ibyangombwa bya braille byakozwe neza. Mu 1999, itsinda ryo muri kaminuza ya Hong Kong Polytechnic ryashyize mu bikorwa tekinike yo kumenyekanisha ku bafite ibumuga bwo kutabona ikoresheje impande zombi kugira ngo ihindure braille mu nyandiko y'Icyongereza cyangwa Igishinwa. Mu 2001, Murray na Dais bakoze sisitemu yo kumenyekanisha intoki, isikana ibice bito byinyandiko icyarimwe. Kubera agace gato kasikiwe icyarimwe, guhindura gride ntabwo byari ikibazo, kandi hakoreshejwe algorithm yoroshye, ikora neza. Mu 2003, Morgavi na Morando bakoze sisitemu yo kumenya inyuguti za braille bakoresheje imiyoboro yubukorikori. Sisitemu yari izwiho ubushobozi bwo gukemura ibibazo bitesha agaciro kurusha ubundi buryo.
Byinshi mubibazo byo gutunganya neza inyandiko ya braille bituruka kumiterere yinyandiko za braille. Ubusanzwe Braille yacapishijwe kumpapuro zikomeye, ndetse na wino itanga itandukaniro hagati yinyuguti yazamuye nimpapuro zinyuma. Ariko, ubusembwa kurupapuro bushobora kugaragara muri scan cyangwa ishusho yurupapuro.
Inyandiko nyinshi zacapishijwe "inter-point", bivuze ko zifite impande ebyiri. Nkibyo, kwiheba kwa braille kuruhande rumwe bigaragara ko bifatanye hamwe na braille igaragara kurundi ruhande ibi bigafasha cyane abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kuko biborohera cyane mugusoma izini nyandiko za Braille.
Bumwe mu buryo bwa optique bwo kumenyekanisha braille bugerageza gukoresha amatara ya oblique na kamera kugirango igaragaze igicucu cya depression no gusohoka kwa braille. Abandi bakoresha ibikoresho biboneka mubucuruzi.

Invoxia ni isosiyete yo mu Bufaransa ikora ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga by'abakiriya (consumer electronics), izwi cyane mu gushushanya no guteza imbere ibikoresho by'ubwenge (smart devices) bikoresha ubwenge bw'ubukorikori (AI), nk’umuntu wa mbere wa GPS ukurikirana ku isoko wakoresheje ikoranabuhanga rya LoRa (ryatangijwe mu 2017), umuvugizi wa mbere uhuza hanze y’ibinyabuzima bya Amazone yakoresheje sisitemu y’amajwi ya Alexa n'umurongo w'abakurikirana GPS mu gukumira ubujura bw'amagare no gukurikirana ibikorwa by'amatungo. Ku isoko rya B2B, itanga serivisi zo gukurikirana no gucunga umutungo. Itanga kandi serivisi za IoT inganda zirimo gushushanya ibyuma niterambere hamwe namahugurwa no guhuza imiyoboro yimitsi.
Invoxia yashinzwe mu 2010 na rwiyemezamirimo udasanzwe w’Abafaransa Éric Careel (na Withings, Sculpteo na Zoov) na Serge Renouard.
Invoxia yashyigikiwe na Newfund kuva mu 2012. Mu mwaka 2013, Invoxia yafashe ubuyobozi bw'isosiyete ishinzwe gukora telefoni gakondo ya Swissvoice.
Mu Kwakira 2015, Amazon iratangaza Invoxia nku wahawe ikigega cya Alexa kugirango yinjize serivisi zijwi rya Alexa muri Triby.

Marata Vision yari ifite icyicaro i Watford, Herts, mu Bwongereza, hafi y'icyicaro gikuru cya Polaron ndetse mbere y'uko igice cyagurishwa kuri Palaron, byari biherereyr mu Majyaruguru ya London.
Marata Vision yaguzwe burundu na Polaron Controls muri Nyakanga 2004, mu gihe isosiyete y'ababyeyi Polaron Plc yatangizwaga ku isoko ry'imigabane. Muri Werurwe 2007, Polaron Plc yaguzwe na Cooper Controls (UK) Ltd, ishami rya Cooper Industries Ltd,
Nyuma, itsinda ryaguzwe na Eaton Igenzura no Kumenyesha.
Nyuma y’ifungwa rya Vutec muri Floride mu 2020, kubera ko Marata Vision yari umugabuzi w’Ubwongereza kuva mu myaka ya za 90, ubucuruzi bwarangiye muri Mata 2021.

Baha ubushobozi bwo guhuza ibikoresho by'abandi bakoresheje API na SDK zabo, kugira ngo abakora ibikoresho babishyiremo mu buryo butaziguye muri microcontrollers zabo.

Beijing Roborock Technology Co. Ltd, yiswe Roborock, ni isosiyete yo mu Bushinwa ikora ibkoresho by'abakiriya (consumer goods), izwi cyane ku bikoresho byayo bya robo bisukura (sweeping and mopping robots) ndetse n'amasuka y'amashanyarazi adafite insinga (handheld cordless stick vacuums) Xiaomi yagize uruhare runini mu ishingwa ry’isosiyete.
Beijing Roborock Technology Co. Ltd yashinzwe mu 2014 i Beijing mu Bushinwa. ryashyigikiwe ahanini na Xiaomi. yakusanyije miliyoni 640 z'amadolari muri IPO yayo yo muri Gashyantare 2020, kandi isosiyete yinjije buri mwaka hafi miliyari 4.5 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda guhera muri Kanama 2021.
Roborock yagiye ahagaragara ku isoko rya STAR rya Beijing mu 2020.
Umurongo wa "S" wa robot vacuum, watangijwe muri 2018, ufite gahunda ihuriweho yo kwirinda inzitizi kugira ngo tumenye ibintu kugeza kuri 5 cm ubugari kuri 3 cm z'uburebure. Mugihe abasukura bagenda hafi y'umwanya bakora ikarita ishushanya, bagaragaza ibintu bigomba kwirindwa nyuma.
Roborock ivuga ko ibikoresho byabo byoza cyangwa bisukura hasi bitabika amashusho cyangwa ngo bayashyire muri cloud, ndetse ko amashusho yose afatwa ahita asibwa ako kanya nyuma yo kuyatunganya.
ReactiveAI 2.0 yatangijwe no gusohora Roborock S7 MaxV. Ifite kamera ya RGB hamwe na 3D yubatswe yumucyo
Usibye kamera zabo zashyizwe imbere, ibikoresho bishya bikoresha LIDAR-hejuru hejuru yicyumba. Ukoresheje porogaramu, abayikoresha barashobora gushiraho imipaka kugirango barebe ko igikoresho kidasukuye aho. Abakoresha barashobora kandi gushiraho "oya-mop" aho igikoresho gishobora gukurura ariko ntigice.
Roborock Q7 Max, yasohotse mu 2022, irashobora kugenzurwa na Alexa, Siri, cyangwa Assistant Google.
Mu 2023, Roborock yasohoye S8, S8 Plus, na S8 Pro Ultra. Itandukaniro nyamukuru hagati yicyitegererezo ni docking station buri wese arimo. S8 ifite ibiciro bisanzwe byo kwishyuza mugihe S8 Plus ikubiyemo icyuma gisiba cyikora. S8 na S8 Plus zifite brushrol ebyiri ariko ntizamura. Moderi zose zibanziriza S8 zifite brushroll imwe.
Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra ikubiyemo kamera yerekana neza. Roborock S7, yatangiriye kuri CES Umukungugu wacyo upima 460 mL mubushobozi bwuzuye. Irashobora guhumeka metero hagati yishyurwa. Moderi ya S4 ntabwo ihindagurika.
Muri 2022, Roborock yasohoye Q5 isimbuza moderi S, kandi isa na S4 Max na S5. Q5 ifite imbaraga zo gukurura cyane, ariko ikabura imiterere ya mop. 2025, Roborock yerekanye moderi yayo ya Saros 10.
Mu 2023, isosiyete yazanye imashini yambere yo kumesa, Roborock Zeo One hamwe na firime yumye. Kimwe na Zeo One, moderi ikurikira irashobora kugenzurwa na porogaramu ya terefone ya Roborock.

Somfy ni itsinda ry’ibigo byo mu Bufaransa ryashinzwe mu 1969, rikaba rimwe mu bikomeye mu gukora no gutanga ibyuma bigenzura n'imashini zifungura no gufunga imiryango y'inyubako, amadirishya y'impumyi (window blinds) n'ibyuma by'izuba (awnings). Bakora kandi n'ibindi bicuruzwa byikora murugo nk'ibikoresho by'umutekano.
Somfy ni umunyamuryango w'akanama k'ubwenge bw'ingo (home automation) committees for Matter,thread ndetse n'ishyirahamwe ry'ibipimo by'itumanaho (Connectivity Standards Alliance). Somfy yatangaje ko afite intego yo gushyira mu bikorwa icyiciro cya mbere akoresheje Materi hejuru ya Zigbee binyuze mu kiraro, kandi ko "moteri ya Zigbee itazahinduka Matteri binyuze mu kuzamura porogaramu". Kuva mu nta bicuruzwa byemewe bya Somfy byatangajwe.

The Unity Home Manager yagurishijwe n'umuyoboro w'abacuruzi wari ugizwe na masosiyete mato, kandi yitanze, hamwe n'abacuruzi bagera kuri 90 muri Amerika mugihe kimwe.
