Wyze Labs, Inc.​(uwahoze ari Wyzecam) azwi nka Wyze,Ni kompanyi y'ikoranbuhanga yo muri America ikorera i Washington, yihariye mu gukora ibikoresho by'ubwenge mu ngo (smart home) n'ama kamera adakoresha insinga (wireless cameras). Ni start-up yashinzwe n'abakozi ba kera ba Amazon
Wyze yashinzwe ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2017, n’abashinze bane: Umuyobozi mukuru Yun Zhang, CPO Dongsheng Song, CMO Dave Crosby, na Elana Fishman. Ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2018, Wyze yagurishije miliyoni imwe ya Wyze Cam. Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2019, Wyze yatangaje ishoramari rya miliyoni 20 z'amadorali yatanzwe na Norwest Venture Partners. Muri Werurwe 2020, igihe icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyibasiye isi, Wyze yari hafi guhagarika, ariko isosiyete yashoboye kurokoka icyo cyorezo igabanya umubare w'amafaranga yashakaga gukusanya kuva kuri miliyoni 50 ikagera kuri miliyoni 10, ndetse no kongeraho gahunda yo kwiyandikisha ya Cam Plus, n'ibindi. Mu mpera za 2022, Wyze yatangaje ko 2023 ari “umwaka wa kamera”, maze asohora kamera nshya eshatu guhera ku ya 2 Werurwe 2023
Amakimbirane n'umutekano.
Muri 2019, Sensormatic, ishami rya Johnson Controls ryuzuye, yareze Wyze, avuga ko yarenze ku ipatanti. Wyze yatsinze mu rubanza, guhera muri Nzeri 2020.
Mu Ukuboza 2019, Kompanyi yemeye ko kwibwira ku murongo wa server byatumye amakuru y'abakiriya bagera kuri miliyoni 2.4 agaragara. Igisubizo cy'ikigo cyarimo gukuramo abakoresha bose kuri konti zabo, bisaba ko abakoresha bose babyemeza.
Mu 2021, Xiaomi yashyikirije Amazone raporo ivuga ko Wyze yarenze ku cyuma cyayo cya 2019 "Igikoresho cyogusukura cyigenga ndetse n’umuyaga w’umuyaga kimwe" ipatanti ya robot vacuum. Ku ya 15 Nyakanga 2021, Wyze yatanze ikirego arega Xiaomi mu rukiko rw’intara rwo muri Amerika mu karere k’iburengerazuba bwa Washington, avuga ko ibihangano byabanjirije kubaho ndetse anasaba urukiko ko rwatangaza ko ipatanti ya robot ya Xiaomi yo muri 2019 itemewe.
Mu 2022, ikigo cy’umutekano Bitdefender cyatangaje ko Wyze yahagaritse WyzeCam v1 kubera ikibazo cy’umutekano Bitdefender yari yamenyesheje Wyze imyaka itatu mbere, kikaba ari igihe kirekire kidasanzwe ku buryo intege nke zitamenyekana ku baturage. Wyze ntacyo yatangaje ku mugaragaro kubyerekeye intege nke.
Ku ya 8 Nzeri 2023, bamwe mu bakoresha bavuze kuri Reddit ko abareba urubuga berekana ibiryo bya kamera bitari ibyabo. Umuvugizi wa Wyze yavuze ko ibi byatewe n'ikibazo cyo gufunga urubuga.
Muri Gashyantare 2024, abakiriya bashinzwe umutekano wo mu rugo Wyze bagera ku 13.000 beretswe urugo rw’undi.

Muri Mutarama 2022, Jagdish Patel, Vaishaliben Patel, hamwe n'abana babo Vihangi na Dharmik bapfiriye i Emerson, Manitoba, muri metero cumi n'ebyiri uvuye ku mupaka wa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika. Uyu muryango wishwe n'ubukonje, bwageze kuri -35 ° C mugihe cyo gupfa kwabo, mugihe bagerageje kwimuka bava mubuhinde bajya muri Amerika, banyuze muri Kanada.
Igihe yapfaga, Jagdish Patel yari afite imyaka 39. Yashakanye na Vaishaliben wari ufite imyaka 37 yagendanaga n'umukobwa wabo Vihangi, wari ufite imyaka 11 n'umuhungu wabo Dharmik, wari ufite imyaka 3. abaturage benshi muri Dingucha bifuza kwimukira muri Amerika.
Uyu muryango wavuye werekeza i Toronto ku ya 12 Mutarama 2022. Polisi yo muri Canada yasanze nyuma yaho bagiye berekeza ku mupaka wa Leta Zunze ubumwe za Amerika banyuze mu muhanda, kubera ko nta makuru y'ingendo z'indege yari agaragara ku mazina y'umuryango, bageze i Emerson, Manitoba ku wa 18 Mutarama 2022.
Kugerageza kwambuka imipaka no gupfa.
Umuryango wa Patel hamwe n’abandi barindwi bagerageje kwambuka umupaka, muri gahunda y’abinjira. Umuryango birashoboka ko utari witeguye ubushyuhe buke, bwageze kuri -35 ° C icyo gihe. n'abapolisi mu murima wa Emerson, muri Manitoba. Uwo muryango washyizwe mu cyiciro cy'abahohotewe n'ubucuruzi bw'abantu, nk'uko byatangajwe n'inzego z'ubuyobozi za Canada.
Urupfu rw'umuryango wa Patel rwongereye abantu mu bitangazamakuru no mu bitangazamakuru kumenya abahinde ba magendu bakoresha Kanada nk'inzira yo kugera muri Amerika. Mugihe umupaka wa Mexico na Amerika urinzwe cyane, umupaka wa Kanada uroroshye ugereranije.
Polisi yo mu Buhinde yataye muri yombi abagabo babiri ku ya 16 Mutarama 2022 ikurikiranyweho ibyaha birimo gucuruza abantu no guteza urupfu. Nyuma y'iminsi itari mike, abapolisi b'Abahinde bata muri yombi undi ukekwaho icyaha.

Ibikorwa remezo mukorohereza abafite ubumuga bwingingo.
Abafite ubumuga nabo bafite uburenganzira kuri serivisi zihabwa Abantu bose.
Leta y'urwanda ifite pilitiki yo gishyigikira itangwa rya serivisi idaheza.
Hibandwa gushyira ibikorwa remezo byorohereza ibyiciro byose by'abantu.
Ahashyirwa ibikorwa remezo.
Ahashyirwa ibikorwa remezo byorohereza Abafite ubumuga ni Munyubako zitangirwamo serivisi zitanduka Biri munyarwanda wese acyenera harimo Inyubako ndende zubakwa ubu zikorerwamo: Amasoko,amavuriro,Amashuri,ibigo byubwishingizi,
Ibikorwa remezo mu mashuri.
Mu mashuri yubakwa ubu ashyirwamo ibikorwa remezo byorohereza Abafite ubumuga hagendewe kuri gahunda ya Leta y'urwanda yo gutanga serivisi idaheza buri munyarwanda mu mashuri hashyirwamo inzira zoroherereza abafite ubumuga bwingingo n'ibindi bitandukanye.
Ibikorwa remezo mu mavuriro.
Politike ya Leta y'urwanda yashyizeho gahunda yo kubaka ibikorwa remezo bitangirwamo serivisi cyane cyane ubuvuzi kugirango buri munyarwanda wese ahabwe serivisi Kandi muburyo budaheza.
Imbogamizi kubafite ubumuga.
Abafite ubumuga byo kutabona bagaragaza imbogamizi bahuranazo zibadindiza mumwigire bituma badatsinda izombogamizi bagaragaza harimo: kutabona infashanyigisho,integanyanyigisho n'ibindi.

Inzira ya Braille ni inzira yagenwe cyangwa iy’imisozi igenewe kugendwamo n’abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona kugira ngo nabo babashe kuyikoresha mu buryo bworoshye kandi bw’umutekano. By’umwihariko, izo nzira zigaragazwa n’imigozi cyangwa ibindi bigabanya inzira, kandi ibimenyetso n’ibyapa bikoreshwa bigira amajwi cyangwa byanditswe mu nyuguti za Braille.
Urugero rumwe ni Watertown Riverfront Park and Braille Trail, ruherereye mu gice cya Charles River i Watertown, muri Massachusetts, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, rwafunguwe mu mwezi wa Nyakanga 2016. Umugozi w’ubuyobozi ugenda ukurikiye urubibi rw’inzira ifite intera ya 1/4 mile (metero 400), ikikije pariki y’amasensori ifite ibintu bitandukanye birimo ubwato bw’inkwi bwo kuririmbaho ndetse n’intebe isohora amajwi (musical bench).

Isaha ya Braille ni isaha itangarizwa igihe ijyanye n’abatabona cyangwa abafite bumuga bwo kutabona neza
Isaha ya Braille ikoreshwa no gukorakora uruziga (dial) kugira ngo umuntu amenye ibimenyetso byanditse hejuru. Hariho verisiyo zayo zombi isanzwe n'iya mudasobwa. Verisiyo za analog zigira ikirahure cyangwa igikonoshwa gikingira isaha, gishobora gufungurwa igihe umuntu ashaka gusoma isaha. Iminwe y’isaha (clock-hands) ikozwe ku buryo itanyeganyezwa n’ukuyikoraho igihe umuntu utabona akoresha urutoki rwe kugira ngo amenye uko ihagaze. Mu buryo bwa digital, utudomo (nk’utwandiko twabraille) duhora duhindura imyanya uko igihe gihinduka. Muri iki gihe, ugomba kumenya inyuguti za Braille kugira ngo usome isaha.
Isaha z’amashanyarazi zivuga, zivuga igihe hakoreshejwe akabuto gato, nazo zikundwa cyane n’abantu batabona.

Mae Brown (1935–1973) yari umugore wa kabiri w'utabona kandi utumva ndetse akaba umuntu wa mbere w’Umunyakanada utabona kandi utumva wabashije kubona impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza. Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Toronto Scarborough mu 1972.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Brown yavukiye ahitwa Thunder Bay mu 1935. Ubumuga bwe bwo kubona no kumva bwakomeje gukomera mu buto bwe; mu mashuri yisumbuye, uburebure bwe bwari bwagabanutse ku buryo atashoboraga gusoma ku kibaho cy’umwarimu, maze ahagarika amashuri. Operasiyo yakorewe Brown akiri mu kigero cy’ubwana bwo hejuru yo gukuramo udusabo two mu bwonko yatumye atsindwa burundu no kumva.
Brown yiyandikishije mu kigo cy’igihugu cy’abatabona cya Kanada, aho yahawe amahugurwa ku buryo bwo gutumanaho nka Braille, ndetse n’uburyo bwo kubona akazi. CNIB kandi yatanze umwarimu wa Brown kugira ngo amufashe kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye. Iyo Brown yiyandikishije muri University of Toronto, CNIB yashakishije umusemuzi wamufashaga, Joan Mactavish, hamwe n’itsinda ry’abagiraneza 35 ryahinduraga ibitabo bya Brown mu nyuguti za Braille. Mactavish yahinduraga amasomo n’ibizamini bya Brown akoresheje uburyo bwo gukoresha intoki mu kwandika inyuguti (finger-spelling) mu ntoki za Brown. Brown yashoboraga gutanga ibisubizo bye mu magambo. Bimwe mu bizamini byafataga iminsi myinshi kurangiza ukoresheje ubu buryo, kandi impamyabumenyi ya Brown mu mateka na psychology yaje kuyibona nyuma y’imyaka 5.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri, Brown yagarutse mu kazi muri CNIB, ahinduka umuyobozi w’ibyerekeye abantu batabona kandi batumva, kandi ashyiraho imiyoboro n’imirimo y’ubufasha ku bantu batabona kandi batumva muri Canada. Ibi byari birimo amatsinda y’imibereho, ibitabo n’ibinyamakuru, ndetse no kugerageza ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga.
Brown yitabye Imana byihutirwa mu 1973 bitewe na undi tusabo two mu bwonko. Isuzuma ry’ubugenzuzi bw’umubiri (autopsy) ryagaragaje ko twasabo twose two mu mubiri we twatewe na neurofibromatose. Umwarimu we w’ishuri rya kaminuza, Joan Mactavish, yakomeje gushyira mu bikorwa ibitekerezo bya Brown byo gufasha abantu batabona kandi batumva nyuma y’urupfu rwa Brown.
Ibihembo no kumenyekana.
Mu mwaka wa 2002, akazi k’ubufatanye ka Brown na Mactavish kaheshejwe icyubahiro binyuze mu gushyirwa muri Terry Fox Hall of Fame.

Ikigo gishinzwe Iterambere ry’abafite ubumuga (Mongolian Бэрхээлт ки Хүний Хөгжлийн барв) ni ikigo cy’abafite ubumuga i Darkhan, Intara ya Darkhan-Uul, Mongoliya.
Iki kigo cyafunguwe ku mugaragaro mu muhango wabaye ku wa 14 Nzeri 2023, witabiriwe na Minisitiri w’intebe Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene. Cyafunguwe byuzuye mu kwezi kwa Mutarama 2024.
Iki kigo gitanga serivisi zitandukanye ku bantu bafite ubumuga, zirimo gukorera imyitozo ngororamubiri, gukorera imyitozo y’ijwi n’ubuvugizi imyitozo y’umwuga (occupational therapy), n’ubundi bufasha butandukanye mu by’imitekerereze.
Iki kigo cyatewe inkunga n’inguzanyo ya miliyoni 25 z’amadolari ya Amerika yatanzwe na Banki ishinzwe iterambere muri Aziya ndetse na impano ya miliyoni 2 z’amadolari ya Amerika (US$2 million) yatanzwe na Japan Fund for Prosperous and Resilient Asia and the Pacific.

James I. Charlton ni umwanditsi w’Umunyamerika, umunyagitugu mu uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, ndetse akaba Visi Perezida Mukuru wa Access Living i Chicago.
Yemera ko ubumuga bushyirwaho n’imibereho y’abantu mu muryango. Yakoze icyitegererezo cy’imikorere y’umuryango w’uburenganzira bw’abantu bafite ubumuga, gishobora gutandukanya amoko atandukanye y’imiryango.
Afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri kaminuza ya Chicago. Charlton yamaze kuba Umuyobozi w’Ibikorwa, Visi Perezida Mukuru ndetse na Perezida w’Agateganyo wa Access Living guhera mu 1985. Charlton kandi ni umufasha w’umwarimu muri Departema y’Uburemere bw’Ubumuga n’Iterambere ry’Umuntu muri kaminuza ya Illinois i Chicago. Ni umwe mu bagize akanama k’ubuyobozi ka Chicago Transit Authority.
Mu mwaka wa 2000, yasohoye igitabo cyitwa “Nothing About Us Without Us: Disability Oppression and Empowerment”.
Charlton yanditse inyandiko mu kinyamakuru cy’ubushakashatsi yitwa “Peripheral Everywhere”, ivuga ku bantu bafite ubumuga nk’“abantu babarirwa kabiri hanze y’imibereho”.

Ishuri ry'urwibutso rwa David Hill yari ishuri ry’abakobwa batabona i Hankou, mu Bushinwa. Ryari rifitanye isano na Kiliziya ya Wesleyan.
Iri shuri ryashinzwe mu 1883. Ryibwe mu 1911 ubwo Hankou yafatwaga n’ingabo z’ubwami.

(Mongolian Хөгжлийн Бэрхээлт ки Хүүхдийн Сэргээн Засах Хөгжлийн мав) ni ikigo cy’abana bafite ubumuga mu Karere ka Bayangol, Ulaanbaatar, Mongoliya.
Ukwubakwa kw’iki kigo kwatangiye ku wa 8 Nzeri 2016. Iki kigo cyashyikirijwe ku wa 24 Mutarama 2019 mu muhango witabiriwe na Ambasaderi w’u Bushinwa Xing Haiming, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Abakozi ba Leta ya Mongolia Zandaakhüügiin Enkhbold, ndetse na Minisitiri w’Abakozi n’Uburinganire bwa Sosiyete ya Mongolia Sodnom Chinzorig. Iki kigo cyahize ibindi mu gushimwa ku bw’ubwubatsi bwiza mu 2019.
Iki kigo gifite ubuso bwa hegitari 1.5, gifite igorofa eshatu hejuru y’ubutaka n’igorofa imwe munsi y’ubutaka. Kirimo uburiri 250 kandi gishobora kwakira abarwayi bahasura buri munsi bangana na 250.

Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ubumuga bw’icyitegererezo muri Afuganisitani bwakozwe na Asia Foundation mu 2019, hafi 80% by'abantu bakuru muri Afuganisitani bafite bumwe mu bwoko bw’ubumuga.
Muri bo bafite ubumuga, 24.6% bahuye n’ubumuga buto (mild disability), 40.4% bahuye n’ubumuga buri hagati (moderate disability), naho 13.9% bahuye n’ubumuga bukomeye (severe disability). Ku bantu bafite ubumuga bukomeye, ahantu henshi bibarizwa ni mu Burengerazuba (25.4%), mu misozi ya Central Highlands (25.4%) ndetse no mu Majyepfo-Maso y’Uburasirazuba (20.5%). Ikibazo kinini bahura nacyo mu bafite ubumuga buri hagati n’ubukomeye ni imbogamizi mu kugenda, mu mibanire, mu kubona akazi no mu mashuri.

Ubumuga mu gihugu cya Antigua na Barbuda bivuga abantu bafite ubumuga batuye muri Antigua na Barbuda.
Guverinoma ya Antigua na Barbuda yashyize umukono ku Masezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku wa 30 Werurwe 2007, ayemeza ku wa 7 Mutarama 2016.
Muri 2019, indwara z'umutima-damura, diyabete na kanseri nizo zabaye intandaro y'urupfu n'ubumuga mu gihugu.

Ubumuga muri Aruba bivuga ababana n'ubumuga muri Aruba.
Aruba yatangiye gukora urutonde rw’abaturage bafite ubumuga guhera mu 1981.
Mu mwaka wa 2010, hari abantu 6,955 batuye muri Aruba bafite ubumuga butandukanye, bikaba byari 6.9% by’abaturage bose.

Abantu bagera kuri 624.000 bo muri Azaribayijan bafite ubumuga butandukanye, bikaba byagize hafi 6.4% by’abaturage bose.
Muri Mutarama 2009, igihugu cyemeje Amasezerano yerekeye uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (CRPD). Mu kwezi kwa Mutarama 2011, cyatanze raporo y’igihugu ku ngamba zafashwe mu gushyira mu bikorwa inshingano zacyo ziri muri CRPD, ndetse n’iterambere ryagezweho muri icyo rwego, ku Ishami ry’Aburenganzira bw’Abantu bafite Ubumuga.
Abenshi mu bantu bafite ubumuga muri icyo gihugu ** bafite ubumuga bw’umubiri, ubumuga bwo kumva cyangwa kubona, cyangwa ubumuga bwo mu mutwe ["ibisobanuro bikenewe"]
Itegeko rya Disability Prevention and Disabled Persons (Rehabilitation and Social Protection) Act rya 1992 rirabujije ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose ku mwana ufite ubumuga. Itegeko ku Burenganzira bw’Abana (Law on Children's Rights) ririnda abana bafite ubumuga mu nzego zitandukanye.
Hari ibigo 14 by’ivuriro n’iterambere ry’abantu bafite ubumuga muri icyo gihugu, byita ku bantu bagera ku 10,000 bafite ubumuga buri mwaka.
Muri mwaka wa 2019, Baku Metro yatangije gahunda yo gutanga abakozi babiri bagomba gufasha abantu bafite ubumuga kugera aho bagiye.
Azaribayijan yatangiye imikino Paralempike mu mikino Paralempike yo mu mwaka wa 1996 yabereye i Atlanta, hamwe n’intumwa z’abantu babiri bahatanira gusiganwa ku maguru no gusiganwa ku maguru. Yagiye muri buri cyiciro cyakurikiyeho cy’imikino Paralympike, ariko ntabwo yigeze yitabira imikino Paralympike.

Ubumuga no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe ni ikinyamakuru cy’ubuvuzi gisesengurwa n’abahanga kigaruka ku mpande zose z’ubumuga n’ubuvuzi bw’iterambere ry’ubumuga, harimo n’imyitozo ndetse n’amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga uburyo bwo gusubiza abantu mu buzima busanzwe. Iki kinyamakuru cyasohorwa na Taylor na Francis Group kandi umwanditsi mukuru ni Dave Müller (Suffolk New College). Cyashinzwe mu 1978, kandi cyagize igipimo cy’ingaruka cya 2.054 mu 2018. Iki kinyamakuru gisohoka inshuro 26 mu mwaka.

Hagati y’abantu miliyoni 16 bafite ubumuga muri Bangladesh, cyangwa 10% by’abaturage b’igihugu. Mu mwaka wa 2004, ubwinshi bw’abantu bafite ubumuga bwari hafi 6% mu bafite munsi y’imyaka 18, naho mu bafite hejuru y’iyo myaka bwari hafi 14%. Abantu bafite ubumuga muri Bangaladeshi bafite uburenganzira bwo gufashwa na leta, ariko porogaramu zari zifite ubushobozi buke kandi zigakorerwa mu mijyi gusa, kandi ibijyanye n’ubumuga ntibyashyizwe mu bikorwa mu porogaramu z’iterambere rusange. Mu gusubiza iki kibazo, imiryango itari iya leta (NGOs) nka Centre for Disability in Development yagiye itanga ubufasha ku bantu bafite ubumuga.
Uburyo abantu benshi muri Bangladesh babona ubumuga bukomeje kuba bubi cyane. By’umwihariko mu bice by’icyaro, ubumuga akenshi bubonwa nk’umuvumo uvuye ku makosa y’ababyeyi, kandi akenshi bikemerwa ko bushobora kwandura. Abana bafite ubumuga n’abatagifite akenshi ntibagira ubucuti, bigatuma habaho gutandukana gukomeza no mu buzima bw’abakuze.
Bangladesh ni igihugu cyemeye Masezerano ya Loni ku Burenganzira bw’Abantu bafite Ubumuga (CRPD),cyayasinye ku wa 9 Gicurasi 2007 kandi kikayemeza vuba bidatinze ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 2007. Ku wa 9 Ukwakira 2013, Bangladesh yemeje umushinga w’itegeko witwa Persons with Disabilities' Rights and Protection Act 2013, washyize mu bikorwa inshingano zacyo ziri muri CRPD. Iri tegeko ryasimbuye Disabled Welfare Act rya 2001.

MagnaReady ni tekinoroji yimyambarire y'Abanyamerika hamwe na e-ubucuruzi ikorera i Raleigh, muri Caroline y'Amajyaruguru. Yibanze ku gukora imyenda imenyereye kubafite ibibazo by'ubumuga. MagnaReady niyo tekinoroji ya mbere yakozwe mubijyanye nimyambarire imenyereye yageze kwisoko rusange, hamwe nikoranabuhanga ryemerewe ibicuruzwa biboneka kubacuruza kumurongo.

Umugore we yashakaga kubishakira igisubizo, uwahoze akora imyenda y'abana, yahisemo kudoda magneti mumashati yumugabo we kugirango byoroshye gukoreshwa. Muri 2015, hatanzwe ipatanti ku ikoranabuhanga.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, PVH Corp., producer wa Van Heusen, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, na IZOD, yemereye ikoranabuhanga rya MagnaReady mu rwego rwo kugeza amashati ahuza abantu benshi ku isoko binyuze mu maduka no kuri interineti bityo bigafasha abantu bafite babana nubumuga kuba bahaha biboroheye binyuze kuri murandasi. Muri, umurongo uhuriweho n’ishati ya VanHeusen MagnaClick washyizwe ahagaragara kandi ugurishwa ku bagabo barwaye indwara ya Parkinson.
In September 2017, the MagnaReady technology was licensed in partnership with LF Americas, a division of Li &amp;amp; Fung, to bring the adaptive products to a larger retail audience.
Mu Kwakira mu mwaka wa 2017, ishati ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya MagnaReady ryerekanwe n’inzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi bugezweho ya New York mu "bintu: Imyambarire igezweho?" herekanwa nka verisiyo igezweho yimyenda yumugabo muri Mutarama 2017.

SmartThings Inc. ni kompanyi yo muri Amerika ikora ibyerekeye kugenzura no guhanga ingo z'ikoranabuhanga (home automation), ikaba ifite icyicaro gikuru i Mountain View, muri leta ya Californiya. Kuva muri Kanama 2014 ni ishami rya Samsung Electronics.
Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2012, yibanda ku iterambere rya porogaramu zikoresha amazina atazwi hamwe n’ibisobanuro bifitanye isano na porogaramu zabakiriya hamwe n’ibicu bigenewe amazu meza hamwe na interineti y’abaguzi. SmartThings ivuga ko urubuga rwayo rufite miliyoni 62 zikoresha abakoresha, umubare uvuga ko wiyongereyeho 70% kugeza muri 2019 na 2020.
SmartThings yatekerejwe n’umushinga washinze kandi wahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru, Alex Hawkinson mu itumba ry’umwaka wa 2011. Hawkinson avuga ko inzu y’imisozi y’umuryango we idatuwe muri Colorado yangijwe cyane n’imiyoboro y’amazi yabanje gukonja hanyuma igaturika bikaviramo kwangirika kw’amadolari 80.000. Hawkinson yavuze ko yashoboraga gukumira ibyangiritse aramutse amenye ibibera mu nzu. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2011 na 2012, Hawkinson hamwe n’abafatanyabikorwa be ba SmartThings bakoze kugira ngo bakore prototype y’ibisubizo bifuza gukemura ibibazo nkibi. [Icyo cyitegererezo cy'imbere cyaje kuba ishingiro ry'ubukangurambaga bwabereye kuri Kickstarter bwatangijwe muri Nzeri 2012 bukaza gukusanya miliyoni1.2 z'amdolari y'Amerika, biza kuba umushinga wa kabiri munini watewe inkunga n'abantu benshi (crowdfunding) ugamije guteza imbere ingo z'ikoranabuhanga kugeza ubu.
Gukusanya miliyoni 3 z'amadolari y'inkunga y'itangira y'umushiga mu ukuboza 2012 SmartThings yaje gushyira ku isoko ibicuruzwa byayo mu buryo bwa k'ubucuruzi mu kwezi kwa kanama 2013, mbere yo gukusanya miliyoni 12.5 z'inyongera mu cyiciro cy'ishoramari cya Series A mu mpera za 2013.
Muri Kanama 2014, Samsung Electronics yatangaje ko imaze kumvikana yo kugura SmartThings. Amasezerano y’imari y’amasezerano ntabwo yigeze atangazwa ku mugaragaro ariko yagereranijwe agera kuri miliyoni 200 z’amadolari y’ibitabo by’ubucuruzi icyo gihe.
Ibicuruzwa na serivisi.
Ku ikubitiro SmartThings yabyaye suite yibikoresho byabigenewe na serivisi za software, harimo inzu yo mu rugo ifite ubwenge hamwe na sensor. Muri Kamena 2020, umuyobozi ushinzwe ubwubatsi bwa SmartThings, Mark Benson, yatangaje ko SmartThings izitandukanya no gukora ibyuma byayo ahubwo ikibanda kuri software. Isosiyete irizera kwinjiza andi masosiyete gukora no gukwirakwiza ibyuma bya SmartThings. Mu, SmartThings yatangaje ko Aeotec izafata umurongo w’ibikoresho by’i Burayi. Mu Kuboza 2020, Aeotec yatangaje ko izanacunga ibikoresho bya SmartThings portfolio muri Ositaraliya, Kanada, Ubwongereza, na Amerika.
Kuva muri Gashyantare 2021, SmartThings itegura porogaramu na serivisi zicu.

Zygoma Implants (cyangwa gushiramo zygomatike) bitandukanye no gutera amenyo asanzwe kubera ko yomeka kumagufwa ya zygomatike aho kuba maxilla. Bishobora gukoreshwa mugihe ubunini bw' amagupfa cyangwa ubwinshi bidahagije mugushira amenyo asanzwe. Umubare w'amagufwa adahagije ushobora guterwa no gufata amagufwa kimwe no guhumeka kwa sinus ya maxillary cyangwa guhuza byombi. Uburebure bwamagufwa ntoya kugirango hashyirwemo igice cyimbere cyurwasaya rwo hejuru bigomba kuba nka 10mm kugirango yemeze kubaho kwimikwa. Iyo hari amagufwa adahagije aboneka, uburyo bwo guhuza amagufwa hamwe nuburyo bwo kuzamura sinus bushobora gukorwa kugirango ubwinshi bwamagufwa. Uburyo bwo gutera amagufwa mu rwasaya bufite ingaruka mbi zo kuvura igihe kirekire, kubuza kwambara amenyo, uburwayi bw’ahantu ho kubaga abaterankunga no kwangwa.
Gutera Zygoma byatangijwe bwa mbere mu mpera za 90 na Dr. Per Ingvar Brånemark, uzwi cyane nka Se wa Implantology Dental Implantology. Gutera Zygomatike byakoreshejwe mu kuvura amenyo ku barwayi bafite amagufwa adahagije mu rwasaya rwo hejuru, bitewe, urugero, gusaza, kuvura ibibyimba, ihahamuka, cyangwa atrophy. Gutera Zygoma bifata anchorage kumagufwa ya zygoma / zygomatic (igufwa ryumusaya). Amagufwa ya zygomatike ni menshi mu bwiza kandi ni cortical muri kamere kuruta amagufwa yinyuma. Kubera inanga ikomeye ishobora kugerwaho mumagufa yuzuye yo mukarere ka zygomatike, hamwe no gukwirakwiza imihangayiko yagerwaho kuri ibyo byatewe, prothèse irashobora guhita ishyirwa mugihe cyo kubagwa. Gutera zygoma biraboneka muburebure buri hagati ya 30 na 52.5mm. Umutwe watewe na zygoma wakozwe kugirango yemere prothèse kumugereka wa dogere 45 kuri dogere ndende yatewe. Gutera Zygomatic ishobora gukoreshwa kubarwayi badafite amenyo mu rwasaya rwo hejuru, abarwayi bavunitse cyane amenyo cyangwa amenyo yimukanwa cyane kubera indwara nka parontontite yibasiye. Intsinzi yo gutera mubitabo kwisi yose ni 97-98%. Ingorane zijyanye no gushyirwaho ni sinusite, paresthesia mukarere ka musaya na fistula ya oroantral.
Mubusanzwe, hariho uburyo bubiri bwo kubaga uburyo bwo gutera zygomatic. Imwe muriyo ni tekiniki ya kera yasobanuwe neza na Brånemark mu mwaka wa 1998, Sinusal, naho iyindi yo mu mwaka wa 2003, Tekinike Yongeyeho na Reginaldo Migliorança, yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu gitabo cyanditswe muri Mutarama mu mwaka wa 2003.

GlobalVision ni kompayi itanga porogaramu zikorera kuri interineti (SaaS) yihariye mu byerekeye gupakira no gushyiraho labels.
GlobalVision Inc. (GlobalVision) yashinzwe na Reuben Malz mu 1990. ifite icyicaro i Montreal, muri Kanada, kandi ifite ibiro by'akarere mu Bwongereza no mu Budage.
Muri 2013, Pfizer yagiranye amasezerano na GlobalVision yo kugenzura ubuziranenge bwo gupakira.
GlobalVision yashyizeho urubuga rwayo rwa mbere rushingiye ku kugenzura ubuziranenge mu Ibi byakurikiwe no gushyira ku isoko verisiyo igezweho y'iyo platform yitwa Proofware mu 2014.
Muri 2017, GlobalVision yasohoye urubuga rwo kugenzura ubuziranenge bwa desktop.
Muri 2018, GlobalVision yafatanije na Pantone na X-Rite gutangiza gahunda ya mbere yo kugenzura amabara ya digitale ku isi yo gucapa no gupakira.

Digital Command Centre yari igikoresho kinini cyo kugenzura kure (remote control) cyashyiriweho televisiyo zihenze za RCA; mu 1983 kuri Colortrak 2000 hamwe na SJT400 CED umukinnyi naho 1984 muri TV ya Dimensia Lyceum. Ikintu cy'ingenzi cyaranze Digital Command Centre ni uko byari rusange mubice byinshi bya RCA, harimo VCR, abakinyi ba CED, tuneri, amplifier, CD ikinisha, nibindi, hejuru yo kugenzura monite ubwayo. Digital Command Centre yatwaye bateri enye za AA kububasha, kubera ubwinshi bwayo kandi mbere yigihe cyayo.
Ikigo cya mbere cya Digital Command Centre cyasohotse mu 1984 hamwe na sisitemu ya Dimensia, CRK35A, yari ifite buto 52, ifite ububiko bw'ibikoresho, kandi ipima hafi ikiro kimwe na batiri.
Mu 1985, RCA yasohoye sisitemu ya Digital Command Component Sisitemu, sisitemu yose y amajwi yahujwe nibikoresho byose byamajwi ya Dimensia, nayo yakoresheje Digital Command Centre kure. Igitekerezo cy'iyi sisitemu kwari ukugira ubushobozi bwuzuye bw'ijwi rwa Dimensia utagombye gukoresha monitor ya Dimensia.
Sisitemu ya Dimensia.
In Dimensia television systems, the remote was called "Dimensia Intelligent Audio Video" or "Dimensia Digital Control" because all of the components were integrated so that the remote could activate the entire system with the touch of one button by communicating with the built-in computer found in the Dimensia monitor via the black control jack found on all Dimensia components. This remote had 8 device keys on it; TV, VCR, VID2 (DISC), AUX, AM/FM, PHON, TAPE, and CD. Since the CED Player intended to be released with the Dimensia system in 1984 was cancelled, the VID2 button and the ability to control the CED Players was absent from later remotes.
Video ya Audio Intelligent Audio Dimensia yasimbujwe icyuma kimeze nk'umugozi (CRK45A) mu 1987.

vertebral Fixation (izwi nka "fixeur spinal") nuburyo bwo kubaga amagufwa aho vertebrae ebyiri cyangwa nyinshi zomekeranye hagati yazo " igikoresho cyo gukosora vertebral ", hagamijwe kugabanya umuvuduko wurugingo bityo ukirinda kwangirika kwumugongo cyangwa imizi yumugongo.
Uburyo bwo gukosora urutirigongo bushobora kwerekanwa mugihe umuntu yavunitse urutirigongo, ubumuga bwurugingo, cyangwa indwara ya vertebral (nka spondylolisthesis).
Ibikoresho byo gukosora vertebral.
Igikoresho gikoreshwa kugirango ugere kuri vertebral ikosorwe mubisanzwe ni prothèse ihoraho cyangwa igice cya kabiri gikomeye gikozwe muri titanium ; ingero zirimo inkoni, amasahani, imigozi, hamwe nuburyo butandukanye. Ubusanzwe ubundi buryo busanzwe ni ugukoresha ibikoresho bisubirwamo, bigizwe na bio-resorbable material.
Andi makuru yerekeye iki gikoresho cyihariye cyo gukosora urutoki ushobora kubisanga muri Reta zunzubumwe za Amerika ku ya 13 Ugushyingo mu mwaka wa 2007 hashyizwe ahagaragara patenti nshya. Ubu ipatanti irashobora (23 Nzeri 2008) kuyisanga kurubuga rwa Amerika.

Isosiyete] [] [[​​ ​ Isosiyete ikora kandi ikanahindura inkoranyamagambo yo muri Siloveniya yitwa Termania, ikubiyemo inkoranyamagambo zirenga 135. Inkoranyamagambo ikoreshwa cyane kuri Termania ni inkoranyamagambo y'ubuvuzi ya Siloveniya. Ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2023 Amebis yahawe igihembo cya Padiri Stanislav Škrabec Foundation kubera ibikorwa bidasanzwe yagezeho mu bijyanye n'indimi za Slovene.

Wake-on-ring (WOR) cyangwa Wake-on-Modem (WOM) ni ibisobanuro byemerera mudasobwa n'ibindi bikoresho bishyigikiwe "guhaguruka" cyangwa kwatsa bikiri ku buryo bwo gusinzira, kuryama burundu by'agateganyo (hibernating) cyangwa "kuba byahagaritswe buhoro (soft off)" (urugero: ACPI state G1 cyangwa G2), hanyuma igatangira gukora.
Icyibanze shingiro nuko ikimenyetso kidasanzwe cyoherezwa kumurongo wa terefone kuri mudasobwa binyuze muri modem yayo yo guhamagara, ikabwira imbaraga zose hanyuma ugatangira gukora. Ibikoreshwa bisanzwe byari ububiko bwububiko na BBSes, nubwo gukoresha hobbyist byari bifite akamaro.
Imashini za Fax zikoresha sisitemu isa, aho usanga ziba zihagaritse ibikorwa cyane kugeza zibonye ikimenyetso cya fax kiri kuza, kikaba aricyo gituma zitangira gukora.
Ubu buryo bwo gukora bwa kure bwatanzwe ahanini na Wake-on-LAN, ni shyashya ariko ikora muburyo bumwe.

The Clapper ni amajwi akoreshwa n'amashanyarazi akoreshwa igihe yumvise urusaku, ikaba yaragurishijwe bwa mbere i San Francisco mu 1984, muri Californiya ikorera muri Joseph Enterprises, Inc. Joseph Pedott yagurishije clapper agira ati:
Clapper icomeka mu mashanyarazi yo muri Amerika yo mu mashanyarazi, kandi yemerera kugenzura ibikoresho bigera kuri bibiri byacometse muri Clapper. Moderi yazamuye, izwi nka Clapper Plus, ikubiyemo imikorere ya kure yo kugenzura hiyongereyeho amajwi ya mbere ashingiye kubikorwa.
Nubwo yagenewe gukorana n'urusaku rwo gukubita amashyi (clap), The Clapper ishobora gutangira gukora bitunguranye n'andi majwi, nko gucira kw'imbwa, k'urugero.
Umunyabwenge Clapper yahimbwe na Carlile R. Stevens na Dale E. Reamer, atanga Patent yo muri Amerika # 5493618, isaba ryatanzwe kuwa 1993-05-07 kandi ryatanzwe ku ya 20 Gashyantare 1996.

European Home Systems(EHS) Protocol yari uburyo gutumanaho (communication protocol) bugamije kugenzura no guhuza ibikoresho byo mu rugo hifashishijwe umurongo w'amashanyarazi (power line communication), byatejwe imbere, ryakozwe n'ishyirahamwe ry’ibihugu by’i Burayi (EHSA).
Nyuma yo guhuza hamwe na protocole ebyiri, ni igice cyurwego rwa KNX, rwubahiriza komite y’ibihugu by’i Burayi ishinzwe ubuziranenge bwa Electrotechnical Standard (CENELEC) EN 50090 kandi ifite amahirwe yo kuba ishingiro ryambere ryugururiwe urugo no kugenzura inyubako.

D²B (Domestic Digital Bus, IEC 61030) Ni standard ya IEC igenewe uburyo bwo gutumanaho bwa serial butari bwihuse (low-speed) kandi bushobora kugenzurwa n'abatandukanye (multi-master), ikoreshwa mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere ingo z'ikoranabuhanga (home automation).​​​​​ Yatunganijwe bwa mbere na Philips mu myaka ya za 1980. Muri 2006 yakuweho na IEC kubera ko hashyizweho urundi rwego, JTC1 SC 83 / WG1. Haracyariho ibikoresho byinshi byujuje ibyangombwa bya IEC61030, nk'ibice bimwe na bimwe byanditseho umutwe wa Philips hamwe nabahindura CD kuva kuri stereyo y'imodoka.
Umuhuza wa SCART atanga D²B ihuza itumanaho hagati yibikoresho.

Instabus, ni sisitemu yigenga kandi ifunguye ikoreeshwa mu gucunga no kugenzura ibikoresho by'amashanyarazi biri mu nyubako. Yakozwe na Berker, Gira, Jung, Merten na Siemens AG. Hano hari ibigo bigera kuri 200 byibikoresho byamashanyarazi ukoresheje protocole yitumanaho. The Europen Installation Bus (EIB) yemerera ibice byose by'amashanyarazi guhuzwa binyuze muri bisi y'amashanyarazi. Buri kintu cyose gishobora kohereza amategeko kubindi bice, aho biri hose. Umuyoboro usanzwe wa EIB ugizwe nibice byamashanyarazi nka switch, pulsers, moteri yamashanyarazi, amashanyarazi, amashanyarazi, hamwe na sensor.
Iyi bisi y'amashanyarazi ikozwe mu mashanyarazi ya 2x2x0,8mm, ihuza ibikoresho byose murusobe. Umubare ntarengwa wibintu ni 57375.
Sisitemu ya EIByatejwe imbere hagamijwe kongera kuzigama ingufu z'amashanyarazi, umutekano, ihumure n'ubwisanzure mu mikorere.
Nubwo EIB ari sisitemu yegerejwe abaturage kandi idakenera icyerekezo icyo aricyo cyose cyamashanyarazi cyangwa igenzura, birashoboka gushyira mubikorwa sisitemu yo kugenzura PC kugirango igenzure imiterere yimiterere no kohereza amabwiriza yintoki cyangwa yabanje gutegurwa kuri kimwe cyangwa byinshi bigize umuyoboro.
Guhuza nibindi bipimo.
Konnex KNX (standard) yatejwe imbere bitewe no guhuza EIB, BCi na EHSA.

Intelligent House Concepts ni sisitemu yo guteza imbere inyubako z'ikoranabuhanga (building automation system) ikoresha imiterere y'itumanaho rya "star topology" aho umugozi uba uhuza buri gikoresho cyose ku kigo nyamukuru. The IP500 Alliance, rifite icyicaro i Berlin mu Budage, ni umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abakora ibicuruzwa na sisitemu bigenewe guteza imbere inyubako z'ikoranbuhanga (building automation) no guhuza sisitemu zitandukanye (system integration). Aself-cleaning cyangwa pyrolytic oven ni itanura ikoresha ubushyuhe bwo hejuru kugira ngo (hafi) ngo itwike ibisigazwa by'ibyokeje hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa pyrolysis, butagombera imiti isukura. Iyo ifuru ishobora gukoresha amashanyarazi yo mu rugo cyangwa gaz.
Inzira ya Pyrolytike.
Amashyiga ya pirolitike yo kwisukura agabanya ibiryo byanduye ivu hamwe n'ubushyuhe bugera kuri. Inkuta z'itanura zometseho ubushyuhe- na aside irwanya feri.
A self-cleaning oven yakozwe kugirango igume ifunze kugeza igihe ubushyuhe bwo hejuru burangiye. Kugira ngo hirindwe ibikomere bishobora gutwikwa, hifashishijwe imashini ikoreshwa kugirango urugi rwa feri rufunge kandi rufunge mugihe na nyuma yigihe cyogusukura ubushyuhe bwinshi, bumara amasaha agera kuri atatu. Mubisanzwe, umuryango urashobora gukingurwa nyuma yubushyuhe bukonje bugera kuri.
Self-cleaning ovens ubusanzwe afite insulation nyinshi kuruta amashyiga asanzwe kugirango agabanye umuriro. Kwikingira bigabanya kandi ingufu zikenewe mu guteka bisanzwe.
Self-cleaning ovens afatwa nkayoroshye kandi atwara igihe, bityo rero akoresha amafaranga menshi. Nyamara, kubera ubushyuhe bwinshi, bitanga umwotsi kandi bisaba ingufu nyinshi. Ubusanzwe umunota wiminota 150 uzakenera amashanyarazi arenze 3 kWh. Nk’uko abahanga benshi babivuga, gukurura impuruza y’umwotsi birashobora kwirindwa no gukoresha buri gihe gahunda yo kwisukura.
Ubundi buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga.
Amashyiga ya catalitiki "ikomeza isukuye" yishingikiriza kumyuma yo mu cyuma kinini kugirango itume igabanuka ryamavuta ivu mubushyuhe busanzwe bwo guteka. Urukuta rw'itanura rya catalitiki yo kwisukura rwometseho ibikoresho bikora nka catisale ya okiside, mubisanzwe muburyo bwa catalizike muri materique ihuza. Cerium (IV) oxyde nimwe mubikoresho bisanzwe bikoreshwa. Ibindi bishoboka ni umuringa, vanadium, bismuth, molybdenum, manganese, fer, nikel, amabati, niobium, chromium, tungsten, rhenium, platine, cobalt, na oxyde zabo, zonyine cyangwa zivanze. Ipitingi ikora cyane mubusanzwe irimo oxyde y'umuringa, oxyde ya manganese cyangwa cobalt oxyde, na oxyde y'umuringa na manganese ikoreshwa hamwe. Binder irashobora kuba fluoropolymer cyangwa frit enamel. Mu myaka ya za 90, SRI International yakoze ubushakashatsi kuri Whirlpool Corporation, ihindura imiterere nogukoresha hejuru ya farumasi enamel iboneka mu ziko ihinduka imwe irimo ionic nkeya, na firime ikora ibinure mumazi ashonga.
Ubundi buryo bwo kwifashisha amashyiga ni amashyiga yoza. Ikoresha amazi nubushyuhe bwo hasi kugirango isukure ifuru. ["citation ikenewe"]

Universal Powerline Bus (UPB) ni porotokole ya porogaramu yihaariye yakozwe na Powerline Control Sisitemu kugira ngo ikoreshe itumanaho rinyuzwa mu miyoboro y'amashanyarazi hagati y'ibikoresho bikoreshwa ubwenge mu rugo (home automation). Amashanyarazi yo murugo akoreshwa mu kohereza amakuru ya digitale hagati yibikoresho bya UPB ukoresheje pulse-imyanya.
Itumanaho ni urungano rw'urungano, nta mugenzuzi mukuru ukenewe.
Aderesi ya UPB yemerera ibikoresho 250 mu nzu hamwe n'amazu 250 kuri transformateur, yemerera aderesi zose zirenga 62.500 kandi irashobora kubana n'izindi sisitemu zitwara amashanyarazi mu'rugo rumwe.
kuva mu mwaka wa 2018,UPB yari ifite ubwoko bwinshi cyane bw'ibikoresho ugereranyije n'izindi porotokole nyinshi, kandi ishyigikiwe n'abakora ibikoresho bakomeye mu rwegorwa home automation. muri abo bakora ibikoresho, harimo cyane cyane Leviton hamwe n'ibicuruzwa byayo byo mu murongo wa Omni series by'ihuzanzira ry'ibikoresho byo mu rugo, kimwe n'ibikoresho bya UPB basanzwe bacuruza. UPB inashyigikirwa kandi n'abakora porogaramu nyinshi zikoresha home automation, bamwe muri bo bakaba barashyizwe ku rutonde rukurikira.
UPB ni protocole yizewe cyane yo gutangiza urugo. Ntabwo byoroshye kwivanga kwa RF, guhagarika ibimenyetso kurukuta cyangwa ibibazo bigufi byo gutangaza nka protocole zimwe na zimwe. UPB yanduza insinga zisanzweho kandi ifite urusaku runini rwo kugabanya urusaku. Ibi bituma ishobora gukora urugendo rurerure nta kibazo, ndetse no mu mashanyarazi menshi, bigatuma iba nziza kumazu manini cyane. Ibikoresho bisanzwe byibasiye X10 ibikoresho, mubisanzwe ntabwo bigira ingaruka kuri UPB. Mubyukuri, ibimenyetso bya UPB birashobora kwakirwa neza nigikoresho cyabigenewe kabone niyo haba hari urusaku rwinshi rwamashanyarazi kumurongo w'amashanyarazi. Twilight switch ni igice cya elegitoronike kigena ko urumuri rwaka ku buryo bwikora igihe urumuri rusanzwe rw'akazi (nk'urwa joro cyangwa izuba) rugabanutse mu gace runaka. Mu mubare munini w'imikoreshereze, ibisanzwe ni ugushoboza gucana mu mihanda, imihanda, umuhanda munini, imihanda, ubusitani, imbuga, nibindi, mugihe urumuri rwizuba rumanutse munsi y'urwego runaka (urugero: kuva nimugoroba).
Umuzunguruko wubatswe na twilight switch, mubihe bimwe na bimwe, bisaba ibindi bice, nka relay cyangwa abahuza, mugihe ushaka kugenzura ingufu z'amashanyarazi zisumba izindi (amatara, ibikoresho byamashanyarazi, nibindi).
Hifashishijwe icyuma gikoresha urumuri (Photoresistor, Photodiode, Phototransistor, nibindi) byerekana ingano yumucyo umurikira ibidukikije, itera uruziga rw'amashanyarazi rufungura cyangwa rugafunga imikoranire yumurongo wa mashini cyangwa ya reta ikomeye. (power transistor, thyristor, triac, nibindi), ikora sisitemu yo kumurika. Turashimira iyi sisitemu, ingero nini zingero zikoreshwa zarakozwe, kuva kumurika haba ahantu rusange cyangwa abikorera ku giti cyabo kugeza kwigana kuboneka, aho twilight switch itanga imikorere yigihe gito cy'umuzunguruko. itara ryo kwigana abantu badahari kumubiri.

A sentroller, akoreshwa kuri enterineti y'ibintu ni sensor, umugenzuzi cyangwa actuator cyangwa guhuza ibi bitatu.
Abagenzuzi mubintu bya enterineti.
Interineti iriho ubu ni interineti y'abantu, ishingiye ku bantu bavugana n'abantu, bakoresheje terefone zigendanwa, tableti, mu dasobwa zigendanwa na mudasobwa, ariko ibi birahinduka: ibikoresho n'ibikoresho bihujwe na interineti (urugero: agasanduku gashyizwe hejuru, kamera, imodoka) biratangira guhindura umubare w'icyerekezo uva ku bantu ugana ku bintu. kure y'abantu. Ubuhanuzi bugera ku kintu cya 100 kugeza kuri 1 cyangwa birenga, bityo interineti yabantu izahinduka kuri enterineti. Kubwibyo, interineti yibintu izahuza kandi ivugane nizindi "bintu", aho guhura nabantu.
Byinshi mu bintu bishya bihujwe na enterineti bizaba byoherejwe, bivuze ko ari ibikorwa, sensor, kugenzura, cyangwa guhuza ibi bintu bitatu. Urugero rumwe rworoshye ni urugo rwa thermostat. Thermostat ni umugenzuzi kuko yumva ubushyuhe murugo, akareba niba urugo cyangwa icyumba thermostat ikurikirana ubushyuhe buri ku bushyuhe bwifuzwa, kandi niba atari byo, ifungura umushyushya cyangwa icyuma gikonjesha. Kubwibyo, thermostat ni sensor na mugenzuzi - umugenzuzi. Nta mikoranire y'abantu na thermostat cyangwa igicu bizakenerwa kugirango thermostat igumane ubushyuhe murugo kurwego rukwiye.
Mubimenyerezo, abashinzwe umutekano bakurura kandi / cyangwa batanga amakuru make cyane, ariko guhuza na enterineti ni ngombwa kubikorwa byabo. Bachir Zergoune, nawe uri mu cyiciro T46, wahoze atsindira umudali wa bronze mu 800m mu mwaka wa 1996, yitabiriye amarushanwa ya 800m, 1,500m na 5,000m, ariko arangiza ari uwa nyuma cyangwa uwa mbere mu nyuma muri buri marushanwa. Mohamed Allek, wahoze atsindira imidali ibiri ya zahabu mu mwaka wa 1996 (100m na 200m T36), yitabiriye amarushanwa atatu mu cyiciro cy’ubumuga T37 (cerebral palsy): 100m, 200m na 400m. Yatsindiye imidali ya zahabu yose mu marushanwa atatu, ashyiraho ikindi gishya mu mateka ya Paralimpike (11.99s) mu 100m, ndetse n’ikindi gishya ku isi (54.66s) mu 400m. Rezki Reguig, nawe uri umukinnyi wa T37, yitabiriye amarushanwa ya 800m, 1,500m na 5,000m, aho igisubizo cye cyiza ari ugusoza ari uwa gatandatu mu 1,500m. Omar Benchiheb, umukinnyi ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona, yitabiriye amarushanwa ya 1,500m, 5,000m na 10,000m mu cyiciro T11, asubiramo ibyavuye mu marushanwa atandukanye. Nubwo atabashije kurangiza isiganwa rya 5,000m, yageze ku cyiciro cya nyuma mu 1,500m, aho arangiza ari uwa gatanu n’igihe cy’iminota 4 n’amasegonda 27.33. Mu isiganwa rya 10,000m, yarangije ari uwa kane, n’igihe cy’amasaha 36 n’iminota 55.90, asigaje amasegonda make 53 Tim Willis wo muri Amerika, wafashe umudali wa bronze.
Hakim Yahiaoui, ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona, yitabiriye amarushanwa yo gutera discus no guterura shot put mu cyiciro F13, arangiza ari uwa gatandatu mu discus kandi ari uwa gatanu mu shot put.
Abanyarwanda babiri baturutse muri Alijeriya bahisemo kwitabira imikino yo guterura ibiremereye, harimo n’umukinnyi w’umugore wihariye w’igihugu muri aya mikino. Saleha Annab yitabiriye irushanwa ry’abagore riri mu cyiciro cy’ibiro 48, ariko ntiyashoboye guterura na kimwe. Djamel Meziani yakoze neza mu irushanwa ry’abagabo riri mu cyiciro cy’ibiro 60, aterura ibiro 165 kg arangiza ari uwa gatandatu muri cumi na babiri.

Erez Biton (Hebrew; wavutse 1942 i Oran, muri Alijeriya) ni umusizi wa Isiraheli wavukiye muri Alijeriya ukomoka muri Maroc. Niwe wahawe igihembo cya Isiraheli 2015 kubera ubuvanganzo n’imivugo by’igiheburayo, mu bindi bihembo by’ubuvanganzo.
Erez Biton yavukiye i Oran mu muryango w'Abayahudi bo muri Maroc. Umuryango we wihishe mu 1948, utembera muri Alijeriya maze bakora aliyah bajya muri Isirayeli. Yakurira i Lodi. Ku myaka 10, yabuze ubushobozi bwo kubona ndetse n’ukuboko kwe kw’ibumoso kubera grenade yari yabaye igikomeza yari yabonye. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya B.A. mu kazi k’imibereho muri Kaminuza ya Hebrew i Yerusalemu ndeste na MA muri psychologiya muri kaminuza ya Bar-Ilan. Biton yashakanye na Rachel Calahorra Biton, kandi bombi bafite abana babiri.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo ye, Biton yakoraga akazi k’imibereho myiza (social worker) i Ashkelon imyaka irindwi, ndetse agakora nka psikoloji (psychologist) mu mujyi uri kure. Yakoraga kandi nka mutwe w’itangazamakuru (journalist) kandi asohora inkingi y’inkuru y’icyumweru muri gazeti rikomeye rya Isirayeli, "Maariv." Igiti cye cya mbere, "Mincha Marokait" (Impano y’Abanya-Moroko), cyasohotse mu 1976, kimushyira ku mwanya w’Umubyeyi w’Abasizi ba Mizrahi muri Isirayeli.

Biotelemetrie (cyangwa telemetrie yubuvuzi) isobanura ikoreshwa rya tekinologi ya telemetrie mubijyanye n'ubumenyi bw'ibinyabuzima, ubuvuzi, n'izindi serivisi z'ubucuzi hagamijwe gukurikirana kure ibimenyetso by'ingenzi by'abarwayi bashobora ba ambulatori.
Ikoreshwa cyane kuri biotelemetrie ni mubice byabugenewe byita k'umutima cyangwa ibice byamanutse mu bitaro. byose bifatika bishobora kwanduzwa, porogaramu igarukira gusa ku kugenzura umutima na SpO2.
Biotelemetry iragenda ikorwa cyane mu kumenya inyamaswa n'ibinyabuzima byo mu ishyamba, binyuze mu gupima kure imikorere y'imibiri yabo, imyitwarire yabo, n'imikoreshereze y'ingufu. Irashobora gukoreshwa mugusobanukirwa uburyo inyamaswa zimuka, hamwe nibidukikije bahura nabyo mugupima ibinyabuzima bihindagurika, nuburyo bigira yabyo mugupima ibinyabuzima bihindagurika nkumutima nubushyuhe. ya telemetrie irashobora kwomekwa hanze yinyamaswa, cyangwa igashyirwa imbere, hamwe nubwoko bwokwirakwiza kubikoresho biterwa nibidukikije inyamaswa yimukiramo. Urugero, mu bushakashatsi ku mikorere y'inyamaswa ziba mu mazi, bakoresha uburyo bwo kohereza ubutumwa hakoreshejwe amashanyarazi y'amajwi (radio transmission) cyangwa amajwi atumvikana (ultrasonic transmission). Ariko inyamaswa ziba ku butaka cyangwa iziguruka zo, zishobora gukurikiranywa hifashishijwe GPS n'ubutumwa mu kirere (satelitte transmission)
Ibigize sisitemu ya biotelemetrie.
Sisitemu isanzwe ya biotelemetrie igizwe na:
Bumwe mu buryo bwa mbere bwakoreshejwe bwa sisitemu ya biotelemetrie bwatangiye mu isiganwa ry’ikirere hakiri kare, aho ibimenyetso bya physiologique byakuwe mu nyamaswa cyangwa abagenzi b’abantu byoherejwe ku isi kugira ngo bisesengurwe (izina ry’uruganda rukora ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi Spacelabs Healthcare ni uburyo rwerekana ko rwatangiye mu 1958 rutezimbere uburyo bwa biotelemetrike muri gahunda yo muri Amerika yo hambere).
Ibinyabuzima bikomoka ku binyabuzima byakoreshejwe kuva byibura 1980. Ibinyabuzima bikomoka ku binyabuzima byateye imbere kugira ngo bidasobanukirwe gusa n’imiterere n’imiterere y’inyamaswa zidafite ubwisanzure, ahubwo binasobanura uburyo inyamaswa zitandukanye zikorana, urugero, hagati y’inyamanswa n’inyambo.
Kubera ubwinshi bwa radiyo bitewe na televiziyo ya digitale iherutse gutangizwa muri Amerika no mu bindi bihugu byinshi, komisiyo ishinzwe itumanaho (FCC) kimwe n’ibindi bigo bisa ahandi vuba aha. yatangiye gutanga imirongo yihariye yabugenewe yo gukoresha biotelemetrie yihariye, urugero, Serivise ya Wireless Medical Telemetry Service (WMTS). FCC yashyizeho Sosiyete y'Abanyamerika ishinzwe ubuvuzi bw’ubuzima bw’ishyirahamwe ry’ibitaro by’Abanyamerika (ASHE / AHA) nkumuhuzabikorwa wa WMTS.
Mubyongeyeho, hari ibicuruzwa byinshi bikoresha ibikoresho bisanzwe bya radio bisanzwe biboneka nka Bluetooth na IEEE 802.11.

Cerebral Inc. ni isosiyete y'Abanyamerika ikorera mu rwego rwa telehealth, itanga serivisi z'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, zirimo ubujyanama, ibiganiro na muganga (therapy), ndetse no gucunga imiti ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zitandukanye zo mu mutwe.
Cerebral yashinzwe mu 2020 na Kyle Robertson na Ho Anh. Isosiyete yahise igabanya ibikorwa byayo muri Amerika yose kandi ikura urusobe rwayo irimo abaganga babarirwa mu bihumbi babifitemo uruhushya.
Kera, Cerebral yafatanije na gymnast hamwe n'uwatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu mikino Olempike Simone Biles nk'umuyobozi mukuru w’ingaruka.
Muri Kamena 2021, isosiyete yakusanyije miliyoni 127 z'amadolari, ifite agaciro ka miliyari 1.2. Mu Kuboza 2021, Cerebral yakusanyije miliyoni 300 z'amadolari mu cyiciro cy’inkunga ya Series C iyobowe na SoftBank Vision Fund 2, bituma igiciro cy’isosiyete kigera kuri miliyari 4.8. Muri iki cyiciro harimo abashoramari nka Prysm Capital, Access Industries, na WestCap Group.
Mu 2022, Ubwonko bwaragenzuwe kubera imikorere yabugenewe, cyane cyane ku bintu bigenzurwa nka Adderall. Minisiteri y'Ubutabera yo muri Amerika (DOJ) yatangiye gukora iperereza ku kurenga ku itegeko rigenga ibiyobyabwenge. Mu gusubiza, Cerebral yatangaje ko izahagarika imiti myinshi yandikiwe ibintu.
Nyuma yo gusohoka kwa Kyle Robertson, muri Gicurasi 2022, Ubwonko bwaragize ibibazo bikomeye, harimo ku gabanya abakozi no guhindura ingamba, mu gihe hagenzuwe amabwiriza ndetse n’ingutu z’amafaranga. Kyle Robertson kuva ubwo yasanze Zealthy, isosiyete ikora imiti. David Mou, yinjiye kuba umuyobozi mukuru hagati ya 2022, wahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo.
Ugushyingo 2024, Cerebral yaje kwemera kwishyura miliyoni 3.65 z'amadolari kugira ngo ikemure iperereza rya DOJ.
Mou yeguye ku mirimo ye mu Kuboza 2024. Brian Reinken wahoze mu bagize inama y'ubutegetsi, kuva yatangira kuba umuyobozi mukuru w'agateganyo.
Muri Kanama 2025, Cerebral yatangaje ko yaguze Resilience Lab, isosiyete y’ubuzima y’imyitwarire yibanda ku guhugura abaganga b’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe hakiri kare no kugabanya umuriro w’abaganga no gucuruza.
Cerebral yavuze ko iteganya kwagura urugero rw’amahugurwa ya Resilience Lab hamwe na protocole ku rubuga rwayo kugira ngo hongerwe ireme ry'ubuvuzi, ibisubizo by'abakiriya, ndetse n'ibisubizo bifatika ku bishyura ubwishingizi.
Cerebral itanga serivisi zo gufasha mu buzima bwo mu mutwe hifashishijwe internet,zirimo ubuvuzi bwo mu buryo bw'ibiganiro (therapy), issuzuma rikorwa n'abaganga b'inzobere mu mutwe (psychiatrist evaluations), gucunga imikoreshereze y'imiti (medication management), ndetse no gutanga ubufasha buhoraho (ongoing support). Ihuriro rikoresha uburyo bwo kwiyandikisha kandi rikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya telehealth kugirango rihuze abakoresha nabavuzi babifitemo uruhushya.

LifeMD, Inc. ni sosiyete ya Amerika ikorera mu rwego rwa telehealth, kandi icuruza ku isoko ry'imari rusange (publicly traded company). Iyi serivisi ituma abakiriya babona abagnga n'abaforomo b'inzobere (nurse practitioners) kugira ngo bagirirwe inama z'ubuvuzi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga (virtual medical consultations) ndetse banahabwe ubuvuzi hakoreshejwe imiti yanditswe n'umuganga (prescription medications).
Isosiyete yashinzwe nka ImmuDyne, Inc. mu 1994 kandi yakoze igurishwa ry'imigabane rya mbere ku isoko rusange (IPO) muri 2001. Mu mwaka 2018, yahinduriye izina ikitwa Convesion Labs,Inc, aho Justin Schreiber yashyizwe ku mwanya w'Umuyobozi Mukuru (Chief Executive Officer) Isosiyete yahinduye izina yitwa LifeMD muri 2020 itangira gukoresha izina rya ticker LFMD.
Mu gihembwe cya mbere cya 2025, LifeMD yatangaje ko amafaranga yinjije yiyongereyeho 49% YoY agera kuri miliyoni 65.7.
Muri Nzeri 2022, LifeMD yahaye Bobby Jindal wahoze ari guverineri wa Louisiana mu nama y'ubuyobozi.
Muri kamena 2023, LifeMD yatangaje gahunda yo gucunga ibiro kugirango yandike imiti ya GLP-1 yujuje ibisabwa mugihe cyo kubonana na muganga. Yatangiye gahunda yicyitegererezo hamwe na Medifast, nyuma itangaza ubufatanye hagati yamasosiyete kugirango ihuze abakiriya bayo. LifeMD kandi yakiriye ishoramari rya miliyoni 20 z'amadolari ya Medifast muri kiriya gihe.
Isosiyete yashyizeho ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima bwigenga mu
Muri Werurwe 2025, LifeMD yashyize umukono ku masezerano yo guha Eli Zilly imiti igabanya ibiro Zepbound ku barwayi bishyura. By'umwihariko, amasezerano yasinywe n’umufatanyabikorwa wa farumasi ya LillyDirect, aho ibicuruzwa bya Zepbound bigurishwa ku giciro ku bakiriya bishyura amafaranga. Ububiko bwa LifeMD bwazamutse mu 2025 nyuma y’amasezerano yagiranye na Novo Nordisk yo guha Wegovy binyuze kuri platform ya LifeMD ku giciro gito.
Muri Mata 2025, LifeMD yaguze ubuvuzi bw’ubuzima bw’umugore Optimal Human Health MD, kugira ngo bushinge umusingi w’ubuzima bw’imisemburo, metabolisme, n’ubucucike bw’amagufwa kuri platifomu.

Itangazo rya Cairo ryerekeye uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Islamu (CDHRI) ry’ibihugu bigize Umuryango w’umuryango w’ubufatanye bwa kisilamu (OIC) mbere i Cairo, mu Misiri, ku ya 5 Kanama 1990, Inyandiko ya 1990 yemeza ko shariya ya kisilamu ari yo soko yonyine, mu gihe verisiyo ya 2020 idasaba shariya.
CDHRI yatangaje ko intego yayo ari "ubuyobozi rusange ku bihugu bigize Umuryango [OIC] mu bijyanye n'uburenganzira bwa muntu". Iri tangazo ryemerwa cyane nk'igisubizo cya kisilamu ku itangazo ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu (UDHR), ryemejwe mu 1948. Riremeza ko bamwe, ariko atari bose, ba UDHR kandi rikaba ari inyandiko nzima y’amabwiriza y’uburenganzira bwa muntu yashyizweho n’abanyamuryango ba OIC gukurikiza, ariko akababuza ku buryo bugaragara imipaka yashyizweho na shariya. Kubera iyi mipaka, CDHRI yanenzwe nkugerageza gukingira ibihugu bigize OIC kunengwa n’amahanga kubera ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu, ndetse no kutubahiriza ubwisanzure bw’amadini, bifite ishingiro ku gihano cy’umubiri no kwemerera ivangura ridafite abayisilamu n’abagore.
Ibihugu bitandukanye by’abayisilamu byari binenze Itangazo mpuzamahanga ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu ryo mu 1948 kubera ko rititaye ku bijyanye n’umuco n’idini by’ibihugu bitari Iburengerazuba. Mu 1981, Said Rajaie-Khorassani - uhagarariye Irani nyuma y’impinduramatwara muri Loni - yavuze uko igihugu cye gihagaze ku bijyanye na UDHR, avuga ko ari "imyumvire idahwitse y’imyumvire y’umuco wa gikirisitu ya gikirisitu ", idashobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa n’abayisilamu batanyuranyije n’amategeko ya kisilamu.
CDHRI yemejwe mu 1990 n’abanyamuryango b’umuryango w’inama ya kisilamu. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2012, yari yarasinywe n'ibihugu 45. Mu 1992, CDHRI yashyikirijwe Komisiyo y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu, aho yamaganwe cyane na komisiyo mpuzamahanga y’abahanga mu mategeko.
Iri tangazo ritangira rivuga ngo "Abantu bose bagize umuryango umwe abayoboke bahujwe no kugandukira Allah no gukomoka kuri Adamu", kandi bibuza "ivangura rishingiye ku bwoko, ibara, ururimi, imyizerere, igitsina, idini, amashyaka ya politiki, imibereho cyangwa ibindi bitekerezo". Ikomeza itangaza ko ubuzima bwera, ikanatangaza ko "kubungabunga ubuzima bwa muntu" ari "inshingano yashyizweho na Shariya". CDHRI iremeza kandi abadafite intambara - nk'abasaza, abagore n'abana, inkomere n'abarwayi, n'imfungwa z'intambara - uburenganzira bwo kurya, aho kuba, no kubona umutekano no kwivuza mu gihe cy'intambara.
CDHRI iha abagore "icyubahiro cya muntu kimwe", "uburenganzira bwabo bwo kwishimira", "inshingano zo gukora", "umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta", "ubwigenge bw’amafaranga", n "" uburenganzira bwo kugumana izina rye n’umuryango ". Abagabo n'abagore bombi bahabwa "uburenganzira bwo gushyingirwa" batitaye ku bwoko bwabo, ibara ryabo, cyangwa ubwenegihugu. Iri tangazo rituma ababyeyi bombi bagomba kurinda umwana, haba mbere na nyuma yo kuvuka, mu gihe ashimangira ko umugabo afite inshingano zo kurengera imibereho n'imibereho y'umuryango we, harimo abana ndetse n'abagore.
Itangazo ryemera uburenganzira ku mutungo n’ibanga ku bantu ku giti cyabo. Ingingo ya 18 (b) ivuga ko "Umuntu wese afite uburenganzira bwo kwiherera mu bikorwa by’ibikorwa bye bwite, mu rugo rwe, mu muryango we, ku bijyanye n’umutungo we n’umubano we. Ntabwo byemewe kuneka maneko, kumukurikirana cyangwa kumutesha izina ryiza. Leta izamurinda kwivanga ku bushake". Irabuza gusenya no kwambura inzu iyo ari yo yose no kwirukana umuryango. Byongeye kandi, umuryango uramutse utandukanijwe mugihe, ni inshingano za leta "gutegura gusura cyangwa guhurira mumiryango".
Ingingo ya 10 y’iryo tangazo igira iti: "Islamu ni idini ry’imiterere idahumanye. Birabujijwe gukoresha umuntu uwo ari we wese ku gahato cyangwa gukoresha ubukene bwe cyangwa ubujiji bwe kugira ngo amuhindure mu rindi dini cyangwa kutemera Imana." Kubera ko muri societe ya kisilamu impamvu zose zituma abantu bava mubuyisilamu bafatwa nk’agahato cyangwa ubujiji, ibi birabuza rwose kuva mu idini ya Islam.
Iri tangazo ririnda buri muntu gufatwa atabishaka, iyicarubozo, gufatwa nabi, cyangwa uburakari. Byongeye kandi, ntamuntu numwe ugomba gukoreshwa mubushakashatsi bwubuvuzi cyangwa siyanse atabanje kubiherwa uruhushya cyangwa ibyago byubuzima bwe cyangwa ubuzima bwe. Irabuza kandi gufata bugwate umuntu uwo ari we wese "ku ntego iyo ari yo yose". Byongeye kandi, CDHRI yemeza ko ari umwere; icyaha kigomba kugaragazwa gusa binyuze mu rubanza "aho [uregwa] azahabwa ingwate zose zo kwiregura". Iri tangazo ribuza kandi gutangaza "amategeko yihutirwa yatanga ubuyobozi bukuru ku bikorwa nk'ibyo". Ingingo ya 19 iteganya ko nta bindi byaha cyangwa ibihano uretse ibivugwa muri shariya. Shariya yemerera igihano cyumubiri (gukubita, gutemwa) nigihano cyo kwicwa no gutera amabuye cyangwa gucibwa umutwe. Uburenganzira bwo gukora imirimo ya gukoreshwa gusa hakurikijwe shariya
Iri tangazo ryibanda kandi ku "burenganzira busesuye bwo kwishyira ukizana no kwishyira ukizana ", no kurwanya ubucakara, gukandamizwa, gukoreshwa, no gukolonizwa. CDHRI itangaza ko kugendera ku mategeko, ishyiraho "uburinganire n'ubutabera kuri bose", hamwe n'imbogamizi ziteganijwe n'amategeko ya kisilamu. CDHRI yizeza kandi abantu bose "uburenganzira bwo kugira uruhare mu buryo butaziguye cyangwa butaziguye mu micungire y’ibikorwa rusange by’igihugu cye". CDHRI irabuza kandi gukoresha nabi ububasha "bugengwa na Shariya ya Kisilamu."
Ingingo ya 22 (a) y’iri tangazo igira iti: "Umuntu wese afite uburenganzira bwo gutanga igitekerezo cye mu bwisanzure ku buryo butanyuranyije n’amahame ya Shariya." Ingingo ya 22 (b) ivuga ko "Umuntu wese afite uburenganzira bwo kunganira icyiza, no kwamamaza icyiza, no kuburira icyiza n'ikibi akurikije amahame ya Shariya ya Islamu." Ingingo ya 22 (c) igira iti: "Amakuru ni ngombwa cyane muri sosiyete. Ntishobora gukoreshwa cyangwa gukoreshwa nabi ku buryo ishobora guhungabanya ubutagatifu n’icyubahiro cy’abahanuzi, gutesha agaciro indangagaciro mbwirizamuco cyangwa imyitwarire, gusenya, kwangiza cyangwa kwangiza sosiyete, cyangwa guca intege kwizera kwayo." Iri ni ukubuza mu buryo bweruye umudendezo wo kuvuga icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora gufatwa nk'igitutsi, igihano cyo gukora gishobora kuba urupfu kandi nk'amagambo y'iyi ngingo yemerera igihano cy'urupfu cyo gutukana binyuranyije na UDHR. Ingingo ya 22 (d) ivuga ko "Ntabwo byemewe gukangura urwango rushingiye ku gukunda igihugu cyangwa ku nyigisho cyangwa gukora ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora gukangurira ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose."
CDHRI ikoresha imvugo yisi yose isa n’itangazo rusange ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu, ryakozwe mu buryo bwa kisilamu. Ijambo ryibanze ahanini ni amagambo y’amadini, kandi umwihariko wa CDHRI urimo imirongo myinshi yerekeza kuri Korowani, shariya, hamwe n’imyemerere y’ubuyisilamu igaragara ku rundi rutonde mpuzamahanga rusa. CDHRI yanzuye mu ngingo ya 24 n'iya 25 ko uburenganzira n'ubwisanzure byose bivugwa bigengwa na shariya ya kisilamu, ari nayo nkomoko y'iryo tangazo. CDHRI itangaza ko idini ry'ukuri ari "ingwate yo kuzamura icyubahiro nk'iki mu nzira igana ku butungane bwa muntu Ishyira kandi inshingano zo kurengera ubwo burenganzira kuri Umma yose.
CDHRI yanenzwe kuba yarashyizwe mu bikorwa n’ibihugu byinshi bifite politiki n’imigenzo itandukanye cyane by’amadini bari bafite "inyungu rusange mu kwambura intwaro mpuzamahanga kunenga uburenganzira bwabo mu gihugu." Ingingo ya 24 y’iri tangazo igira iti: "Uburenganzira n’ubwisanzure byose biteganijwe muri iri tangazo bigengwa na Shariya ya Kisilamu." Ingingo ya 19 nayo igira iti: "Nta cyaha cyangwa igihano kizabaho keretse ibiteganijwe muri Shariya."
CDHRI yanenzwe n’iburengerazuba kuba yarananiwe kwemerera Abayisilamu ubuhakanyi, nk "" uburenganzira bw’ibanze kandi budasuzuguritse ". Mu itangazo ryanditse ryatanzwe n’umuryango mpuzamahanga wita ku bantu n’imyitwarire (IHEU), umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta mu rwego rw’ubujyanama bwihariye, Ishyirahamwe ry’uburezi ku isi (AWE) n’ishyirahamwe ry’abaturage ku isi (AWC), hagaragaye impungenge nyinshi zerekana ko CDHRI igabanya uburenganzira bwa muntu, ubwisanzure mu idini, n’ubwisanzure mu gutanga ibitekerezo. Iri tangazo ryanzuye rivuga ko "Itangazo ry’i Cairo ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Islamu bigaragara ko ari ukugerageza kugabanya uburenganzira buvugwa muri UDHR n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga. Ntabwo bushobora kubonwa ko bwuzuzanya n’Itangazo Mpuzamahanga."

Ikirego cyabo no kunegura kwabo kwari gushingiye ku kuba barwanya kwinjiza "gusebya amadini" mu mategeko mpuzamahanga n’uburenganzira bwa muntu. Rhona Smith yanditse ko, kubera CDHRI yerekeza kuri Shariya, bisobanura urwego rwihariye rwo hejuru rwabagabo.

Planned Parenthood Direct ni porogaramu ya telephone igenewe gutanga serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere ikoresheje icyitegererezo cyangwa uburyo bwa telehealth. Itangazwa n'ishyirahamwe ryita ku buzima ry'izina rimwe.
Planned Parenthood Direct Yatangije serivisi muri 2015, ubwo yatangizaga porogaramu iteganijwe kubyara muri Californiya. Muri kiriya gihe, imikorere ya porogaramu igamije cyane gupima indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (STD). Ibikoresho byo kwipimisha byoherezwa mu mazu y'abarwayi, hanyuma umurwayi asubiza ibikoresho inyuma, kandi ibisubizo bigezwa k'umurwayi binyuze muri porogaramu.
Kugeza muri 2019, Gahunda iteganijwe kubyara yatangaga serivisi muri leta 27 na Washington DC. Serivisi yibanze ku gutanga ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro, no gutanga ubuvuzi bwanduza inkari (UTI). Muri, mu rwego rwo gusubiza gahunda za leta zo kugabanya inkunga y’ubuzima ku babyeyi bateganijwe, Gahunda yo Kubyara Directeur yashyizeho gahunda yo kwagura kugera muri leta zose uko ari mirongo itanu.
Muri 2024, Planned Parenthood Direct Yaguye serivisi yaguye kugirango ibone imiti ikuramo imiti ku barwayi bo muri leta zimwe na zimwe. Abarwayi basaba ibinini byo gukuramo inda bitangwa kugeza ibyumweru 10 batwite, kandi bisaba ubuvuzi bwateganijwe kubuvuzi (umuganga cyangwa umuforomo wimenyereza umwuga) kugirango bandike imiti. Niba byemejwe n'ushinzwe ubuvuzi, imiti yoherezwa murugo rw'umurwayi. Iyi serivisi iraboneka gusa kubarwayi baba muri leta aho gukuramo imiti byemewe.
Serivisi n'ibicuruzwa.
Ibicuruzwa byibanze byateganijwe kubabyeyi ni porogaramu za porogaramu zikoresha kuri iPhone, terefone ya Android, PC, na mudasobwa ya Mac, Porogaramu zisangiye izina rimwe na sosiyete, gahunda iteganijwe yo kubyara. ​​
Porogaramu n'urubuga rutanga serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere hakoreshejwe icyitegererezo cya telehealth, cyemerera abakoresha kubona serivisi z'ubuzima ziva mu rugo, batiriwe basura ibiro bya muganga. Serivisi zitangwa ziratandukanye bitewe na leta, bitewe n'amategeko ya leta.
Serivisi ziratandukanye bitewe na leta, ariko zirashobora kubamo uburyo bwo kuringaniza imbyaro byihutirwa, gupima indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro, no gukuramo imiti.

TiLR ni robot ya mbere ku isi yo mu rwego rw'ibigo ikora uburyo bwa telepresence, yakozwe na kompanyi yitwa RoboDynamics Corporation. Telepresence ya enterineti ihujwe na robot ihendutse (TiLR) ituma uyikoresha ahita atwara ahantu kure aho robot yaba ikubiyemo umukoresha ahantu kure. Ibyiza bya robotic telepresence bigabanya ingendo n'igihe cyo gutaha kimwe no kongera ibicuruzwa n'ubufatanye.
TiLR mu byukuri sisitemu yo guteranya amashusho kumuziga. Umukoresha ashoboye kuyobora robot mu gucunga kure, gutwara robot no kugenzura imikorere ya pan / tilt / zoom ya kamera ya robo. Nka TiLR itanga uburyo bwo guterana amagambo "ad hoc imbona nkubone" kimwe no kurebera amajwi n'amashusho.
Hariho ibice bibiri kuri sisitemu ya TiLR ya telepresence. Imashini ya TiLR ihagaze ku rubuga rwa kure. Igice cya kabiri ni software ya TiLR Command Centre (TCC) ishyira kuri PC iyariyo yose hamwe na web kamera hamwe n'umuyoboro mugari. Umukoresha atangiza gusa TiLR Command Centre hanyuma yinjira muri TiLR. Iyo winjiye, hariho amashusho-yerekana amashusho / amajwi hagati ya robo na TCC. Umukoresha noneho arashobora kuyobora robot kuva kure, gufata amashusho, ndetse no kwandika isomo kugirango turebe nyuma. Ubuyobozi bwa TiLR bushyigikiwe gusa kuri Windows XP / Vista. Kwishushanya gukurikira kwa TiLR Command Centre bizaba bishingiye ku buhanga bwa Flash aho abakoresha bazashobora kwinjira muri TiLR no kuyobora robot kuva kurubuga rwisi.
TiLR yatangijwe mu mpera za 2007 na RoboDynamics ikurikira porogaramu ya MILO ya telepresence yatangijwe mu 2004. Ibi bituma TiLR igira robot ya telepresence yakozwe na RoboDynamics. Muri Kanama 2008 RoboDynamics yatangije gahunda yabo ya Beta ishyira robot mu miryango itandukanye kugirango bungurane ibitekerezo. Abitabiriye gahunda ya mbere cyane ni itsinda rya Google Lunar X Igihembo cya X Award Foundation. RoboDynamics yateganyaga gukomeza gahunda ya TiLR Beta kugeza mu mpera za 2008.

UWA telerobot ni robo igenzurwa hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga rya kure,ibarizwa mu ishuri ry'ubuhanga mu by'imashini n'ubwubatsi (Mechanical and Civil Engineering) muri kaminuza yuburengerazuba bwa Ositaraliya.
UWA telerobot ni ikimenyetso cy'amateka kuri interineti na kaminuza yo mu burengerazuba bwa Ositaraliya. Nicyo gikoresho cya mbere cya telerobot cyabonetse kugirango gikoreshwe muri rusange muri 1994. Telerobot ya UWA yakozwe bwa mbere mu rwego rwa PhD na Kenneth Taylor kandi yaje gukorerwa impamyabumenyi ya PhD na Barney Dalton.
Imashini ya mbere kuri interineti, robot ikinisha plastike ifite ubwisanzure bwa dogere 2 gusa, yashyizwe k'umurongo ni tsinda riyobowe na Ken Goldberg muri kaminuza y'amajyepfo ya Californiya ibyumweru bitatu gusa mbere yuko ikipe ya UWA isohora urubuga rwabo. Imashini ya USC yamaze amezi arindwi gusa. Imashini ya UWA iracyari k'umurongo uyu munsi, nubwo robot y'umwimerere yasimbuwe mu mwaka wa 1996 kandi robot ntikiboneka kugirango abantu babone imbogamizi, nubwo ababishaka bashobora gusaba uruhushya.

Imashini ikora kuri ABB S4 isanzwe igenzura imashini ihujwe na seriveri ya Linux kandi nayo ikavugana na seriveri ya kabiri ikoresha porogaramu ya RobComm ya ABB hamwe na porogaramu ya National Instruments Labview yari isanzwe yandikiwe icyo gikorwa na James Trevelyan abifashijwemo na Perth ishingiye kuri Icon Technologies hamwe n’abanyeshuri. igice cyumushinga UWA telelabs.
Telerobot yagize impinduka nyinshi muburyo bwo kugenzura igihe. Ubusanzwe wagenzuwe ukoresheje paji y'urubuga ya HTML ihagaze ukoresheje CGI, umurimo wa Dalton wabonye itangizwa ryukuri ryagutse Java -ishingiye kuri interineti yahuye nubutsinzi buke. Igenzura ubu nuburyo bwo gukuramo porogaramu ya LabVIEW ishobora gukururwa ikubiyemo amashusho yigihe-gihe, hamwe nubugenzuzi butangwa na sisitemu ya Telelabs.
Imashini ikomeje kuba ishingiro ry'ubushakashatsi n'imishinga yitsinda ryakozwe n'abanyeshuri ba Mechatronics Engineering hamwe nabakozi muri UWA, Byibanze birimo kongeramo ibintu bishya cyangwa ubushobozi muri sisitemu. A cane gun n'inkoni yo kugendana irimo imbunda ihishemo. Imbunda za keni rimwe na rimwe zifatwa nk'imbunda zisa na zo zifashishwa nabahigi b'inyamaswa mu buryo bunyuranye n'amategeko.
Ubusanzwe akenshi ni verisiyo zoroshye gutwara kandi zoroshye guhisha z'imbunda zisanzwe zikoreshwa mu mikino yo kurasa, cyane cyane imbunda ifite umuyongo umwe cyangwa ibiri, ishingiye ku buryo bwa Leclercq bwakorewe mu Bubiligi butahenze cyane.
Hamwe nibi bishushanyo bisa, imbunda ndende igufi ishobora gukorwa kugirango isubire inyuma kugeza iryamye munsi y'ububiko, kugirango itwarwe munsi yikoti. Ubundi buryo ni muburyo bwa pistolet ndende cyane yashizwemo itandukanijwe, rimwe na rimwe bita "kumanura", cyangwa ububiko bwa skeleton, nubwo intwaro iyo ari yo yose ya siporo isaba guterana ifite ibibi bigaragara mu murima.
Mu magambo afatika gusa, itandukaniro ni uko imbunda y’ibiti, ihenze cyane kuyibyaza umusaruro, kandi muri rusange, ingaruka, bigaragara ko yatwawe n'abagabo bifuzaga, igihe cyose, kuba bashobora gufata "intego z'amahirwe", bari curio, aho bavugira, cyangwa intwaro yihishe, imwe ishobora guhunga bitamenyekanye keretse iyo usuzumye neza. Usibye inkoni ya nyakubahwa, imbunda nazo zagiye zihishwa mubindi bintu bisanzwe nk'umutaka n'inkoni zo kugenda.
Ibinyuranye n'ibyo, imbunda ya ba rushimusi biragaragara ko ari imbunda, nubwo imwe yahishwa mu buryo bworoshye n’abajya mu cyaro mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko, bitwaje imbunda yo guhiga inkono idasanzwe cyangwa kwirwanaho, bitandukanye n’imbunda idashobora kwerekanwa cyane, y’imikino yuzuye, nubwo aba bambuka mu cyiciro cyo kurokoka.
Cne guns ubu ni gake cyane kandi kuyibona biragoye kuyibona, kubera ko amategeko menshi arenga ku mategeko abuza gutwara intwaro zihishe, n'ingero z'igihe, aho byemewe, muri rusange, ni mu maboko y'abikorera ku giti cyabo n'inzu ndangamurage.
Imbunda ya kijyambere, ubwoko bwa karitsiye isanzwe ishyirwa mu kurasa amakarito manini y’umuvuduko ukabije cyangwa.410 yatwaye ibisasu bigera kuri 12 bipima imbunda, byombi bikwiranye neza nintwaro ifite ingunguru gusa ifite urugereko rwuzuye, gusohora intoki, uburyo bwo kurasa butandukanye, gufata ibyemezo, kandi rimwe na rimwe bikagaragara.
Ubundi bwoko bwimbunda zinkoni zakozwe nkintwaro zo mu kirere, muri rusange hakoreshejwe uburyo bumwe na bumwe bwikigega cy’ikirere gishobora gutandukana (intwaro yo mu kirere ya pneumatike) mu buryo bwa flask, cyangwa cyinjijwe mu buryo bw’inkoni igereranijwe cyane, nka shillelagh gakondo. Bimwe muburyo bwiza bwo kurasa, byoroshye cyane kwiyoberanya, kuba bike cyane kuruta umuyoboro. Iyi ntwaro yakoreshejwe mu gihe cy'ubujura bwa banki mu rubanza rwa Pizza Bomber.

Dummy, Umurozi wa Sible Hedingham (c. 1788 - 4 Nzeri 1863) ni izina ry'irihimbano ry'umusaza utazwi wari umwe mu bantu ba nyuma bashinjwaga kuroga mu Bwongereza mu kinyejana cya 19. Yapfuye nyuma yo gukubitwa akajugunywa mu ruzi n'abahigi.
Umaze igihe kinini atuye i Sible Hedingham, Essex, umudugudu muto w'ubuhinzi mu cyaro cy'Ubwongereza, yari afite ubumuga bwo kutumva-kutavuga yinjiza amaramuko nk'umupfumu waho. Muri Nzeri 1863, Dummy yashinjwaga na Emma Smith wo muri Ridgewell ko 'yamututse,yamuvumye'kugira indwara, maze akurwa mu kabari "ka Swan" n’agatsiko k’abasinzi. Yategetswe 'gukuraho umuvumo'. Igihe Dummy atabikoze, yajugunywe mu mugezi uri hafi nk '" ibigeragezo n'amazi ". Yakubiswe kandi inkoni mbere yuko ajyanwa mu kazi i Halstead ari naho yapfiriye umusonga. Nyuma y’iperereza ryakozwe n’ubuyobozi, Emma Smith na Samuel Stammers, wari umubaji w'ubuhanga ndetse akaba n'inshuti na Smith, bashinjwaga "gukubita mu buryo butemewe n’umufaransa umusaza bakunze kwita Dummy, bityo bikamuviramo urupfu." (Icyifuzo cy'uko Dummy yari Umufaransa cyari gisanzwe mu mudugudu, ariko nya bimenyetso byinshi byari bihari byerekana niba ari ukuri.) The World Association of Sign Language Interpreters (WASLI) ni umuryango mpuzamahanga ugamije guteza imbere umwuga wo gusobanura ururimi rw'amarenga.
WASLI yashinzwe ku wa 23 Nyakanga 2003 muri gihe cy'Inteko Nkuru ya 14 y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yabereye i Montreal, muri Kanada. Ibiro byayo biherereye i Geneve mu Busuwisi.

Silence (Chinese) Ni umuryango utabara imbabare wa Hong Kong, wibanda ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva no kutavuga bakoresha ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Hong Kong n'imiryango yabo n'inshuti zabo, kandi akaba n'umwe mu bagize akanama gashinzwe imibereho myiza ya Hong Kong.

Signmark ni alubumu ya mbere kuva y'umuraperi w'umunyafinilandi ubana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva witwa Signmark. Iyi Album yasohotse mu 2006, ikaba ari DVD ya mbere ya hip-hop yanditswe mu rurimi rw'amarenga.

See What I'm Saying: The Deaf Entertainers Documentary ni documentaire ya 2009 yakozwe kandi iyobowe na Hilari Scarl. [Igaruka ku buzima bw'abasusurutsa rubanda babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva nka Bob Hiltermann, TL Forseberg, CJ Jones, na Robert Demayo n'uburyo bagerageza kugera ku bantu bose muri rusange. ​Aba bafite imyidagaduro bafite impano batsinze ibibazo bikomeye munzira zabo zo gutsinda no gutsinda kwumwuga.

Pierre Pélissier (22 Nzeri 1814 - 30 Mata 1863) yari intangarugero mu burezi bw'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva mu Bufaransa hagati mu kinyejana cya 19. Yavukiye i Gourdon, muri Loti, yari umwarimu w’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kandi yandika inkoranyamagambo y’ururimi rw’amarenga rw’igifaransa mu 1856.Yize mbere i Rodez na Toulouse, iyobowe na Abbot Chazottes. Nyuma yabaye umwarimu mu Ishuri ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva rya Toulouse. Yabaye umunyamabanga wungirije wa Sosiyete Nkuru ishinzwe ubumuga bwo kutumva i Paris mu 1842. Mu 1843, afite imyaka 29, yagiye i Paris kwigisha mu ishuri rya Imperial School for Deaf Mutes, aho yigisha kugeza apfuye.
Azwiho kandi kuba yarabaye umusizi. Ibikurikira ni igice cyakuwe mu gisigo cye:
Dans l'œil tu mis tous les dons de l'oreille,
Aux mains, la voix, dans le corps, des spirits:
Et, par leur chant, couronnant ta merveille,
Les sourds-muets se proclament tes fils.

Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yo muri Afurika yepfo (SADSF) n’urwego nyobozi rwemewe rwa siporo y’abatumva muri Afurika yepfo ishinzwe kohereza, gutera inkunga, gutera inkunga amakipe ahagarariye Afurika yepfo hamwe n’abakinnyi b’ibipfamatwi mu birori by’abatumva, Shampiyona y’abatumva. SADSF yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1981 ikaba ifitanye isano na Comite International des Sports des Sourds (CISS), akaba ari urwego ruyobora isi ya siporo y’abatumva.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yo muri Afurika yepfo naryo ryifatanije n’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino muri Afurika yepfo na Komite Olempike (SASCOC), akaba ari urwego nyobozi rw’igihugu muri Afurika yepfo rushinzwe imikino Olempike na Paralympike.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino muri Afurika yepfo na komite olempike ryakusanyije inkunga ihagije mu kwemeza ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Afurika yepfo igihe ryahuye n’ibibazo by’amafaranga ryo kohereza abakinnyi b’ibipfamatwi mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2013 yabereye i Sofiya, muri Bulugariya.

Ishuri rya Newfoundland ryigisha ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva ryari ishuri ry'intara muri St. John's, Newfoundland na Labrador hamwe na gahunda yo gutura kw'ishuri ndetse no gutaha zigenewe abanyeshuri babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva neza cyangwa batanumva na gato.
Ishuri ryigishaga abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye. Umubare w'abanyeshuri wari abanyeshuri 10 mu mashuri makuru na 20 mu mashuri abanza, bose hamwe ni 30.
Abanyeshuri babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Kanada bakunze kwiga muri kaminuza ya Gallaudet i Washington, DC, n’ishuri ry’ikoranabuhanga rya Rochester i Rochester, muri New York.
Muri Kanama 2010, hatangajwe ko ishuri rizafunga kuko nta banyeshuri bazitabira umwaka w'amashuri utaha, kandi nta n'umwe wari uteganijwe mu myaka itanu iri imbere; abanyeshuri bose bo mu ntara baba n'ubumuga bwo kutumva neza cyangwa kutumva na gato bari muri sisitemu ya mashuri ya Leta.

Jean Massieu (; 1772 – 21 Nyakanga 1846) yari umurezi w'intangarugero ufite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Umwe mu bavandimwe batandatu babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva, yangiwe kwiga kugeza afite imyaka cumi n'itatu ubwo yahuraga na Abbé Sicard, wamwandikishije mu kigo cy’igihugu des jeunes sourds de Bordeaux-Gradignan, Ishuri rya Bordeaux ry’abana babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva. Agezeyo, yize gusoma no kwandika igifaransa, nyuma afasha guteza imbere ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igifaransa rwa mbere rwemewe. Uru rurimi rw'amarenga rw'igifaransa nyuma rwahinduwe mu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika. Yigishaga ku ishuri rizwi cyane ryababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva i Paris aho Laurent Clerc yari umwe mu banyeshuri be. Yatangiye akazi nyuma y'igitutsi cyabereye i Paris muri Rodez kandi yitangiye ubuzima bwe kwigisha abana batumva. Nyuma yaje gushinga ishuri ryabafite ubumuga bwo kutumva i Lille, mu Bufaransa.
Jean Massieu agaragara muri filime y'impimbano "yitwa Sign Gene", filime y'ibihangange ivuga ku bahindutse bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bafite imbaraga z’ibihangange binyuze mu gukoresha ururimi rw'amarenga, nka sekuru wa kane wa sekuru wa Kate Massieu (wakinnye na Carola Insolera) umukobwa w'inshuti y'umuntu ukomeye Tom Clerc, ukomoka kuri Laurent Clerc. Iyi filime yanditswe kandi ikorwa na Emilio Insolera kandi yerekanwe muri sinema muri Nzeri 2017.

Singing Space ni umwanya ukoreshwa nuwasinye ukoresheje ururimi rwamarenga. Numwanya wibice bitatu imbere yumukono, kuva mukibuno ukageza ku gahanga no kuva kuruhande rumwe rwumubiri kugeza kurundi, aho ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragara. Abasinya bakoresha uyu mwanya kugirango bagaragaze umwanya wumubiri no kwerekana imiterere yibitekerezo. Ibibanza mumwanya wo gusinya byashizwe ahantu mumwanya nyawo. Byakoreshejwe mugutanga amakuru adafatika nkigihe na gahunda. Uwasinye kandi akoresha uyu mwanya kugirango ashyireho ibice byavuzwe mu nteruro (urugero abantu, ibintu, inyubako n’ahantu) no kwerekana isano yabo. Ibi byitwa gushyira. Umukono arashobora kwinjiza abantu mubiganiro basinya amazina yabo, hanyuma akabashyira mumwanya wo gusinya. Arashobora noneho kubasubiza kuri 'we' cyangwa 'we' yerekana gusa aho yabashyize aho kongera gusinya izina ryabo. Ibi byitwa syntactique. Imikoreshereze yo gusinya umwanya kugirango yerekane aho ahantu cyangwa ibintu biherereye muburyo bumwe byitwa topografiya.
Indimi z'amarenga zikoresha umwanya wibice bitatu kuri byinshi zifashishwa mabafite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Uyu mwanya ukoreshwa mukwerekeza kubitabiriye ibiganiro, kwerekana uruhare rw'ikibonezamvugo cy'abitabiriye ibirori cyangwa kwerekana amakuru ajyanye n'ubwoko butandukanye bwibikorwa.
Indimi z'amarenga zifite uburyo bumwe bwo kwerekeza kubitabiriye ibiganiro (urugero: umukono, uwandikiwe, utabarizwa). Izi fomu zirimo gukoresha cyane umwanya wo gusinya. Mu kwerekeza mu gituza cye, uwasinye yivugiye ubwe. Mu mico imwe n'imwe aho abavuga ururimi bavuga berekeza ku mazuru kugirango berekane ubwabo, izuru ryerekanwa aho. Kwerekeza kuri aderesi cyangwa kubataba bikorwa bikorwa kumwereka. Urutoki rwerekana ibimenyetso bikoreshwa muribi bihe. Mugihe cyo kuvuga abitabiriye ubwinshi, indimi zimwe z amarenga zishobora gukoresha usibye urutoki.
Ingano yo yindimi z'amarenga.
Size of Singing Space uva hejuru yumutwe wuwasinye kugeza mukibuno uhagaritse kandi kuva mukibero kugera kunkokora. Ibimenyetso bivuzwe hejuru cyangwa imbere yumubiri. Umwanya urashobora kwaguka nkumubiri wose mururimi rwamarenga rusangiwe kandi ibimenyetso bishobora gushiramo ninyuma yumukono.

Byongeye kandi, amagambo menshi yerekeye ubuzima bwa buri munsi kandi amagambo yihariye ajyanye n'uburezi ntabwo ahagije.

James Platt Barrett (29 Kamena mu mwaka wa 1838-27 Ukuboza 1916) yari umwarimu wicyongereza kubatumva na lepidopteriste wikunda. Yari umwe mu banyamuryango bashinze umuryango w’amateka y’amateka ya Londere y’amajyepfo ya Londres kandi yigisha mu ishuri ry’ibwami ry’abana batumva n’ibiragi i Margate imyaka igera kuri mirongo itanu.
Platt-Barrett ashobora kuba yari ubumuga bwo kutumva mu busore bwe kuko yize mu kigo cyabafite ubumuga bw'okutumva ndetse nabafite ubumuga bwo kutavuga i Yorkshire. Nyuma yaje kumenyekana ko ashoboye gushyikirana nta kibazo. Yabaye umwarimu w'abatumva n'ibiragi. Bikekwa ko ashobora kuba yarahumekewe no kwiga ikinyugunyugu na Charles Baker wari umwarimu w’abana batumva basohoye igitabo "cyitwa Ikinyugunyugu cyo mu Bwongereza" (1828) cyerekanwe n’abanyeshuri be mu kigo cya Edgbaston. Platt-Barrett yagiye mu Butaliyani inshuro nyinshi. Ku ya 28 Ukuboza mu mwaka wa1908, yarokotse gato umutingito wabereye i Messina ariko umukazana we n'umwana we bishwe n'inzu yaguye maze ingero n'inoti kuva mu mezi yakusanyije birasenywa. Yatorewe kuba Umunyamuryango wa Sosiyete Entomologiya mu mu mwaka wa 1911. Yashyinguwe i Birchington iruhande rw’umugore we wari wamubanjirije.

Ishyirahamwe ry' abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva mu gihugu cya Noruveje (NDF ; Norwegian) ni umuryango wigihugu kubakoresha ururimi rwabatumva n’amarenga muri Noruveje.
Ifatanije n’ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva (WFD). Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1918. Icyicaro cyayo kiri Oslo. Ururimi rwemewe rw'iryo shyirahamwe ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Noruveje. NDF yifatanije n’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’i Burayi by’abatumva kuva mu 1995. Iri shyirahamwe ni umwe mu bagize akanama k’abatumva bo mu majyaruguru.

Ihuriro ry’igihugu cy’abatumva Nepal (NDFN ; Nepali (ne)) ni umuryango utegamiye kuri leta washyizweho kandi uyobora nkumuryango w’umuryango w’akarere ka Nepal n’amashyirahamwe yabafite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Mbere yari izwi nka federasiyo yigihugu yabafite ubumuga bwokutumva (NFDH). Ni umunyamuryango w’ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva ku isi (WFD) kandi akora nk'umuvugizi uharanira uburenganzira bw’abatumva, ndetse anayobora gahunda nyinshi mu gihugu hose hagamijwe kuzamura imibereho y’abatumva bo muri Nepal.
Two of core ni agace gakorerwamo ndetse ni ururimi rw'amarenga no kwigisha abatumva. NDFN yakoze ibishoboka ngo isohore "Inkoranyamagambo y'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Nepali", kandi ikomeza gukusanya no gukora ibimenyetso by'inyongera kuri iyi nkoranyamagambo. Yahuguye kandi yohereza abigisha ururimi rw'amarenga batumva kwigisha ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Nepali abatumva ubundi badafite ururimi rw'amarenga. Mu rwego rwo kwigisha abatumva, ikorana cyane na Minisiteri y’Uburezi, Ishami ry’Uburezi, Ikigo Gishinzwe Guteza Imbere Gahunda, n’Amashuri atandukanye y’abatumva mu rwego rwo kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi bw’abatumva muri Nepal.
