Ishuri rya Metropolitan Toronto ry’abafite ubumuga bwokutumva ni ishuri ahitwa igabana Davisville junior Republic rya Leta, riherereye ahitwa Metropolitan Toronto, i Toronto, muri Ontario hamwe na gahunda y’umunsi ikorera abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva no kutumva kuva mu ishuri ry’incuke kugeza mu wa munani. Muri iki gice, Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika hamwe n'Icyongereza kivugwa hifashishijwe icyongereza cyashyizweho umukono neza nk'ururimi rw'itumanaho.
Mu 1962, Ubuyobozi bw’ishuri ry’akarere ka Toronto bwimuye amashuri yombi, Ishuri rya Metropolitan Toronto ry’abatumva na Davisville Junior School, mu nyubako imwe y’ishuri. Kugeza mu mwaka wa 2002, amashuri yombi yakoraga ukwayo. Mu mwaka w’amashuri wo mu 2009-10, abanyeshuri umunani bariyandikishije muri iryo tsinda.
Ishuri rya Metro Toronto ryigisha abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva ryimukiye mu ishuri rya Faywood Arts-Curriculum School mu majyaruguru ya York. Kwimuka kwatewe kubera gahunda yo kutumva igabanuka (bitewe no gukoresha imiti ya cochlear yatewe no kutumva kwinshi mu bigo byumva) hamwe na gahunda yo kwibiza mu gifaransa. Umuyobozi wa Faywood ABC ni Elizabeth Schaeffer.

Monitoba ishuri byababana nabafite ubumuga ni ishuri ryintara i Winnipeg, muri Manitoba rifite gahunda yo gutura ndetse n’umunsi ikorera abanyeshuri batumva kandi batumva.
Ishuri ryigisha abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri abanza ndetse nayisumbuye, bakoresheje uburyo Bilingual-Bicultural method.
Umubare wabanyeshuri ni abanyeshuri bagera kuri 40 baboneka mumashuri makuru na 60 baboneka mumashuri abanza.

Ikigo cya MacKay, cyahoze ari ishuri rya MacKay ry’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva n’ikigo cya Mackay gishinzwe abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bw’abaprotestanti (Protestant Deaf Mutes) ni ishuri riherereye muntara ya Montreal, muri Québec, muri Kanada rifite gahunda y’umunsi ikorera abanyeshuri batumva kandi batumva cyane bo mu muryango wa Anglophone wo muri Québec. Yashinzwe na Thomas Widd mu 1869 kandi yitirirwa icyubahiro Joseph Mackay. Mu 1960, ikigo cyahujwe n’ishuri ry’abana bafite ubumuga kandi kikaba ari cyo cyongeye guhuzwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’abatabona rya Montreal mu 2006.
Ishuri ryigisha abanza kandi umubare wabanyeshuri batumva bagera kuri 30 mumashuri abanza.

Ko Taku Reo: Uburezi bw'abafite ubumuga bwokutumva muri Nouvelle-Zélande iherereye mu muhanda wa Archibald, New Lynn, Auckland, New Zealand. Ni ishuri ryihariye ryo guturamo ry’abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, ndetse n’ikigo cy’ibikoresho gitanga serivisi n’inkunga ku banyeshuri biga muri rusange, abanyeshuri mu byokurya, ndetse n’abarimu bo muri Nouvelle-Zélande.
Ishuri rya Kelston ry’abafite ubumuga bwokutumva ryashinzwe mu mwaka wo mu 1958, nk'ishuri rya Kelston ryita ku bafite ubumuga bwokutumva. ryasimbuye amashuri yabatumva kumusozi Wellington na Lopdell House muri Titirangi. Yahinduye izina ayita ikigo cya Kelston Deaf Education Centre mu 1991 kugirango kigaragaze neza serivisi zitandukanye zatanze. Mu ntangiriro za manda ya gatatu ya 2020 ishuri ryahujwe n’ikigo cyigisha ubumuga bwo kutumva cya Van Asch bashinga Ko Taku Reo, ishuri ry’igihugu ryigisha ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Mardin ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Turukiya. Byabanje kuvugwa mu mujyi wa Mardin, guhera mu bihe byibuze bitanu mu muryango mugari. Abavuga rikijyana bose baba muri İzmir cyangwa Istanbul, kandi abakiri bato cg urubyiruko rw'ubu rwimukiye ku rurimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Turukiya.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Maldiviya (MvSL ; Dhivehi) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwatejwe imbere, ahanini ku bushake, n’abana babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo mu mashuri menshi yo muri Malidiya mu 2000. Ibi birashimishije cyane abahanga mu by'indimi babyiga kuko bitanga uburyo budasanzwe bwo kwiga ku kintu bemera ko ari ivuka ry'ururimi rushya.
Inkoranyamagambo ikubiyemo ibimenyetso by'amagambo agera kuri 650 ashyigikiwe n'icyongereza na Dhivehi asobanura imiterere y'intoki n'igikorwa kizakoreshwa mugihe wasinyiye ijambo runaka.

( , "National Institute for Deaf Youth of Paris") is a school for the deaf founded by Charles-Michel de l'Épée, in stages, between 1750 and 1760 in Paris, France.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Père Vanin rwabaye mu mwaka wa 1759, Abbé de l'Épée yamenyeshejwe abakobwa babiri bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva bari bakeneye umwigisha mushya. Iri shuri ryatangiye mu mwaka wa 1760 hanyuma nyuma yaho gato rifungurirwa ku mugaragaro maze riba ishuri rya mbere ku isi ku batumva. Ubusanzwe yari iherereye munzu iri kuri 14 rue des Moulins, butte Saint-Roch, hafi ya Louvre i Paris. Prosper Menière yari umuganga kuva mu 1838 kugeza apfuye mu mwaka wa 1862. Inyuguti za Alphabet ni intoki zibiri zikoreshwa mu kwandika mu rurimi rw'amarenga rwa Yugosilaviya. Ibimenyetso bimwe byagereranijwe nyuma zitwa Cyrillic Seribiya, ibindi nyuma yinyuguti ya Gaj y'Ikilatini, cyangwa bituruka ahandi akaba ari inyuguti zifasha ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Amabwiriza ya Maastricht yo mu 1997 yerekeye ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco yubakiye ku mahame ya Limburg yo mu 1987 yerekeye ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco no kwerekana ingaruka zemewe n’amategeko n’ibikorwa bitubahirizwa n’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco. Amabwiriza yemejwe nitsinda ryinzobere zirenga mirongo itatu zateranye kuva 22-26 Mutarama 1997 i mugihe cyo kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 10 ya Limburg. Nyuma yimyaka itatu, Amabwiriza ya Maastricht hamwe n’amahame ya Limburg yasubiwemo nk’umuryango w’abibumbye E / C.12 / 2000/13 (CESCR).
Mu 1997, ikigo cya Urban Morgan gishinzwe uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu, n’ikigo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu cy’ishami ry’amategeko muri bateraniye mu yandi mahugurwa ku isabukuru yimyaka 10 y’amahame ya Limburg agerageza kumenya uburyo bwo gukoresha "ihohoterwa" kugira ngo rifashe gukurikirana (ICESCR). Inteko yari ifite intego eshatu: kumva neza igitekerezo cyo guhonyora uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco; gukusanya no gutondekanya ubwoko bw'ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira; no gushyiraho umurongo ngenderwaho wafasha ibigo mugukurikirana uburenganzira bwubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco.
Muri rusange, amabwiriza 32 yashyizwe mu byiciro bitanu agize Amabwiriza ya Maastricht. Aya mabwiriza yemejwe ku bwumvikane n’abari bitabiriye aya mahugurwa, kandi yumvikanye ko agaragaza iterambere ry’amategeko kuva mu 1986. Igice cya 1 gishimangira akamaro k’uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco; Igice cya 2 gisuzuma inshingano Leta ibereyemo mu guharanira uburenganzira bw’ubukungu, imibereho myiza n’umuco, ikanagaragaza urutonde rw’ibikorwa ndetse n’ibitagenda neza bikabije; Igice cya 3 gitangaza ko ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo ryose ryatewe na Leta kandi ko rigomba kureba niba abahohotewe bashobora gukemura ibibazo; Igice cya 4 cyibanda ku bahohotewe kubera ko uburenganzira bwabo butubahirijwe, kurindwa no kubahirizwa, binyuranye na ICESCR; Igice cya 5 kirimo gusa ibisubizo nibindi bisubizo bishoboka kubangamira uburenganzira.

In sign languages, ahantu, cyangwa tab, bivuga ahantu nyirizina amaboko ziba ziri igihe zikoreshwa mu gukora ibimenyetso. Muri terminologiya ya Stokoe izwi nka TAB, impfunyapfunyo ya "tabula". Ikibanza ni kimwe mu bice bitanu, cyangwa ibipimo, by'ikimenyetso, hamwe nigishusho cyamaboko (DEZ), icyerekezo (ORI), kugenda (SIG), nibintu bidasanzwe. Ibisobanuro byihariye byahantu, nk'igituza cyangwa urusengero rw'umutwe, birashobora gufatwa nka foneme. Indimi zitandukanye z'amarenga zirashobora gukoresha ahantu hatandukanye. Muyandi magambo, indimi z'amarenga zitandukanye zishobora kugira ibarura ritandukanye rya fonema.
Ibibanza mu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'abanyamerika.
Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika rukoresha ahantu 12 ukuyemo amaboko ubwayo: isura yose / umutwe; agahanga cyangwa umusatsi; amaso cyangwa izuru; umunwa cyangwa umunwa; urusengero, umusaya cyangwa ugutwi (uruhande rw'umutwe); ijosi; umutiba (ibitugu kugeza mu kibuno); ukuboko hejuru; inkokora cyangwa ukuboko, inyuma yintoki, imbere imbere. Mubyongeyeho, mu bimenyetso simusiga by'amaboko abiri, ikiganza cyiganje gikorana n'ikiganza kitiganje, hanyuma kikaba nk'ikimenyetso. Ikimenyetso gishobora kandi kuvugwa mu mwanya udafite aho ubogamiye, ufatwa nk'ahantu hatagaragara muri moderi zimwe na zimwe z'ururimi rw'amarenga.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Keresan, ruzwi kandi ku izina rya Keresan Pueblo Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abahinde (KPISL) cyangwa Keresign, ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwo mu mudugudu ruvugwa na benshi mu baturage ba pereblo ya Keresan, aho haboneka abantu benshi bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva kuva bavuka (iyo pueblo ntivugwa mu bitabo by'inkomoko, ariko abaturage bavugwa bemeza ko ari Zia pueblo yo muri New Mexico).
Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Keresan rwateye imbere mu karere, kandi ntaho ruhuriye n'ururimi rw'ubucuruzi Ibibaya Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abahinde.

Catalina Devandas Aguilar ni umunyamategeko wa Kosta Rika wabaye ku burenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga kuva mu 2014 kugeza 2020. Muri Gicurasi 2024, yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru mu biro by’ubufatanye, ubuvugizi n’itumanaho n’umuryango mpuzamahanga w’abinjira n’abinjira (IOM UN Migration). Mbere, yahoze ahagarariye Costa Rica mu Muryango w’abibumbye i Geneve. Yakoze kandi muri Banki y'Isi kandi agira uruhare mu ishyirwaho ry'amasezerano n'Ubunyamabanga. Arwaye spina bifida kandi akoresha igare ryibimuga.
Yabanje kugisha inama Banki y'isi kandi yari mu bunyamabanga bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye bwashyizeho. Mu 2009, Madamu Devandas Aguilar yatangiye gukorera mu kigega cyo guharanira uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga n'ikigega. Mu 2014, Aguilar yagizwe umunyamabanga wa mbere w’umuryango w’abibumbye ku burenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga.

DPI ni ihuriro ry’imiryango cyangwa inteko z’abafite ubumuga, ryashinzwe mu 1980–81 hagamijwe guteza imbere uburenganzira bwa muntu bw’abafite ubumuga binyuze mu ruhare rwuzuye, kunganya amahirwe n’iterambere. DPI ifasha amashyirahamwe yo mu bihugu birenga 152 ibibazo bya buri munsi byo gufasha abamugaye. Bakira kandi inteko hamwe ninama nyunguranabitekerezo kwisi yose hamwe namashami yabo atandukanye.
Abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu batangijwe na DPI mu 2011 kugira ngo bafashe ababana n'ubumuga mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Bashaka kunoza ibibazo byemewe n'amategeko, imibereho myiza, nubukungu bigira ingaruka kubantu bafite ubumuga. Kugeza mu 2013, abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu bashizeho imiyoboro ibiri y’abagore ku isi iteza imbere uburenganzira bw’abagore bafite ubumuga. Bashyizeho kandi umuryango w’urubyiruko hagamijwe guteza imbere uburenganzira bw’urubyiruko rufite ubumuga. Umushinga wafunzwe mu 2013.

DRI Wahoze ari Uburenganzira bw’ababana nubumuga bwo mu mutwe, ni Washington, DC bushingiye ku guharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu bugamije guteza imbere uburenganzira bwa muntu no kugira uruhare rugaragara muri sosiyete y’abafite ubumuga ku isi. DRI ibyangombwa bisabwa, itangaza raporo, kandi iteza imbere kugenzura mpuzamahanga uburenganzira bwabafite ubumuga.
DRI yashinzwe mu 1993 n’avoka kandi yashinzwe n’ishuri ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu n’ikigo cya Bazelon gishinzwe ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Kuva mu 1993, DRI yaguye ibiro mu bihugu bitatu birimo Seribiya, Mexico, na Ukraine.
DRI yahawe igihembo cya Charles Bronfman ishimira ibikorwa bya DRI mu gukangurira umutimanama w’isi kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu bw’abana n’abakuze bafite ubumuga; kwerekana amacakubiri no gufata nabi ababana n'ubumuga mu bihugu byinshi; amahugurwa no gutera inkunga ubumuga n'abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu; no guhamagarira guverinoma n'inzego z'isi kurinda abaturage batishoboye kandi birengagijwe.

Kailge Sign Language ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwateye imbere mu Ntara ya Western Highlands, Papouasie-Nouvelle-Guinée. Bivugwa mu karere kanini k'uduce duto dukikije umujyi wa Kailge, ndetse no muri Kailge nyine, mu gace ka Ku Waru - kavuga. Rushobora gusobanurwa nk'urusobe rw'ibimenyetso byo mu ngo aho kuba ururimi rumwe rusobanutse. Ishobora Gukoresha umwanya wo gusinya birasa cyane nu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva-ururimi rw'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'imidugudu rusangiwe n'abumva.
KSL ifite amagambo asa n'urundi rurimi rw'amarenga rw'umudugudu mu karere, ururimi rw'amarenga Sinasina.

Kafr Qasem Sign Language (لغة الإشارة الكفر قاسم (Icyarabu) Lughat il-Ishārah il-Kafr Qasim) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwo mu mudugudu muri Isiraheli.
Ururimi ruri mu nzira zo kwandikwa, cyane cyane muri kaminuza ya Haifa. Kafr Qasem irangwa n'ijanisha ryinshi ry'abantu babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva, kandi uko bigaragara, ururimi rwabo rw'amarenga rwateye imbere mu buryo bwihuse uko imyaka yagiye ihita, kabone niyo rwaba rwaratewe n’ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Isiraheli ndetse n'indimi z'amarenga zo muri ako karere.
Intangiriro y’umuryango w’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva muri Kafr Qasem yatangiye mu ntangiriro y'ikinyejana cya 20, ubwo umuturage yashakanye n’umugore ubana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva ukomoka muri Mazraa. Abashakanye babyaranye abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, na bo barashyingiranwa kandi bafite abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva benshi. Mu 1951, i Kafr Qasem hari abaturage 1800, 12 muri bo bakaba bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva. Gukenera kuvugana nabo byatumye habaho iterambere ry'ururimi rw'amarenga rusangiwe na benegihugu - bafite ubwo bumuga kandi bumva.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Inmaculada ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abatumva- ibisekuru by'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bya Lima, muri Peru. Ifitanye isano neza n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Peru (LSP), ariko iratandukanye bihagije ku buryo byafatwa nk'ururimi rutandukanye.
Ururimi rukoreshwa n’abantu biga mu ishuri ry’abatumva, CEBE La Inmaculada de Barranco, mbere y’1960, igihe LSP yashingwa nk'ururimi rw’igihugu cy’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva. Iri shuri ryari ryarafunguwe mu 1939. Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Inmaculada rufite hafi igice cy'ingaruka zituruka ku rurimi rw'ibimenyetso rw'Abanyamerika (ASL) ugereranyije n'ururimi rwa LSP, kandi inyuguti zikorwa n'intoki zarwo ziratandukanye cyane.

Imyandikire y'intoki ya Hongiriya (cyangwa magyar ujjábécé mu gihongiriya) Rukoreshwa mu kwandika amagambo hifashishijwe intoki mu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'Abahungariya. Bikunze kugaragara cyane ni inyuguti imwe y'intoki hafi yisura, ariko imiterere ya LSF -imiterere y'imyandikire rimwe na rimwe ikoreshwa.

Isesengura ry’Iterambere ry’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu mu Kinyejana cya 21 ni inyandiko isobanura uburyo uburenganzira bwa muntu bwahindutse, bwatera imbere, ndetse n’ingorane bwahurijeho muri iki gihe cy’ikoranabuhanga n’isi ihinduka buri munsi. Uburenganzira bwa muntu ni ihame ryemewe mpuzamahanga rivuga ko buri muntu afite agaciro, ubwigenge n’uburenganzira budashobora kumwamburwa.
Amavu n’amavuko y’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Inkomoko y’inyigisho z’uburenganzira bwa muntu ishobora gukururwa mu mateka y’abahanga nka Aristote na Cicero, ariko yaje kugirwa ihame mpuzamahanga mu myaka ya nyuma y’intambara ya kabiri y’isi yose. Icyo gihe, isi yari imaze kubona ingaruka z’urwango, jenosidi n’icuraburindi ry’ubuyobozi bubi. Ibi byatumye habaho itangazwa ry’itangazo mpuzamahanga ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu ku wa 10 Ukuboza 1948.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu mu kinyejana cya 21.
Mu kinyejana cya 21, iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga, imiyoborere n’ubukungu ryazanye impinduka nini mu buryo abantu babona uburenganzira bwabo. Ubu burenganzira ntibukiri gusa ijambo ryanditse mu masezerano, ahubwo buba bugomba kugaragara mu bikorwa by’ubuyobozi, uburezi, ubucuruzi n’imibanire y’abantu.
Kugeza ubu, inzego zitandukanye z’abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu (nka Amnesty International na Human Rights Watch) zakomeje kugaragaza imbogamizi zishingiye ku kurenga ku burenganzira mu bihugu bitandukanye, cyane cyane mu birebana n’ubwisanzure bwo gutanga ibitekerezo, uburenganzira bw’abagore n’ubw’abana.
Impinduka zatewe n’ikoranabuhanga.
Ikoranabuhanga ryatumye isi iba umudugudu umwe, ariko rinazana ibibazo bishya ku burenganzira bwa muntu. Urugero, gukusanya amakuru ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bishobora gukoresha nabi uburenganzira bw’abantu ku buzima bwite. Nubwo iri koranabuhanga rifasha mu guhanahana amakuru, rishobora no kuba intwaro yo kugenzura abaturage.
Abahanga bavuga ko icyuho kiri hagati y’uburenganzira bwo kubona amakuru n’uburenganzira bwo kugira ibanga gikwiye gucungirwa hafi. Kumenya uko ikoranabuhanga rikwiye gukoreshwa mu nyungu z’abantu bose ni kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye mu kinyejana cya 21.
Imbogamizi n’intambwe imaze guterwa.
Mu myaka 20 ishize, hari intambwe nyinshi zatewe mu kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu. Mu Rwanda n’ahandi muri Afurika, hashyizweho amategeko arengera abana, abagore n’abafite ubumuga. Ariko nanone, haracyari ibibazo by’ubukene, ubusumbane n’ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu ngo n’ahandi hatandukanye.
Hari kandi ikibazo cy’uko uburenganzira bwa muntu bwakomeje gufatwa nk’intwaro ya politiki aho kuba ishingiro ry’ubumuntu. Abashakashatsi bamwe bavuga ko ibihugu bimwe bikoresha ijambo "uburenganzira bwa muntu" nk’intwaro yo gushyira igitutu ku bindi bihugu.
Iki gice cya mbere kigaragaza uko uburenganzira bwa muntu bwahindutse kuva ku rwego rw’inyigisho za filozofiya bugera ku rwego rw’amategeko mpuzamahanga. Mu gice gikurikira, tuzasuzuma uko ihindagurika ry’ikirere, ubuhunzi, n’ubukungu mpuzamahanga bigira uruhare mu kurengera cyangwa kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu mu kinyejana cya 21.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu n’ubukungu.
Mu myaka ya vuba, ubusumbane mu bukungu bwabaye kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye bigira ingaruka ku burenganzira bwa muntu. Iyo abaturage batabona amahirwe angana mu burezi, ubuzima n’imibereho myiza, bibangamira ihame ry’uko buri wese afite uburenganzira bungana imbere y’amategeko.
Mu bihugu byinshi byo muri Afurika, harimo no mu Rwanda, hakomeje gushyirwaho gahunda zigamije kugabanya icyuho cy’ubukene binyuze mu guteza imbere uburezi, uburinganire n’imibereho myiza. Ariko, abahanga bavuga ko uburenganzira bwo kubona akazi kiza n’ifunguro rihagije bugikomeje kuba inzozi kuri benshi.
Uburenganzira ku kazi si uguhabwa akazi gusa, ahubwo ni no kuba ako kazi gatanga agaciro n’ubwigenge ku muntu. Gushyiraho politiki zishingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu mu rwego rw’ubukungu ni imwe mu nzira zo kurwanya ubusumbane n’ubukene.
Impinduka z’ikirere n’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Impinduka z’ikirere zigaragara cyane mu kinyejana cya 21 zifite ingaruka zikomeye ku burenganzira bwa muntu. Iyo amazi, imyaka cyangwa ubutaka bitakiboneka neza, bibangamira uburenganzira ku biribwa, ku buzima, ndetse no ku mutekano.
Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 20 buri mwaka baba bahunze kubera ibiza, imyuzure, n’amapfa. Ibyo bituma ubuhunzi butakiri ikibazo cya politiki gusa, ahubwo buba ikibazo cy’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryita ku burenganzira bwa muntu (UNHRC) ryemeza ko kurengera abahungabijwe n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere bigomba kuba igice cy’uburenganzira bw’isi yose. Abahanga bemeza ko politiki zose zijyanye n’ibidukikije zigomba gushingira ku mahame y’uburenganzira bwa muntu kugira ngo zigere ku ntego z’iterambere rirambye.
Uburenganzira bw’abagore n’urubyiruko.
Mu kinyejana cya 21, abagore n’urubyiruko bifashishije ikoranabuhanga mu guharanira uburenganzira bwabo. Uko isi irushaho kuba nyabagendwa, niko n’ubutumwa bw’uburinganire bugera ku bantu benshi.
Urugero, ubukangurambaga nka *#MeToo* bwafashije mu kugaragaza ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, bityo bukazamura ibiganiro ku burenganzira bw’abagore n’ubw’abakobwa. Mu bihugu byinshi, harimo n’u Rwanda, hashyizweho amategeko arengera abagore mu kazi, mu muryango no mu miyoborere.
Urubyiruko narwo rwagize uruhare rukomeye mu bikorwa by’ubukangurambaga bijyanye n’uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu, cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere no kurwanya ivangura. Uruhare rwabo rwerekana ko uburenganzira bwa muntu ari urusobe rw’abantu bose, aho buri wese agira uruhare mu kuburinda.
Uburenganzira mu bihe by’intambara n’umutekano.
Intambara n’ibibazo bya politiki bikomeje kuba imbogamizi ikomeye mu kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu. Aho hose habaye intambara, uburenganzira bwo kubaho, kubaho mu mahoro no kubona ubuvuzi buba bugeze ku iherezo.
Amategeko mpuzamahanga avuga ko n’igihe cy’intambara, uburenganzira bw’ibanze bugomba kubahirizwa. Ariko, hari aho ibyo bidashyirwa mu bikorwa kubera ubushobozi buke, politiki mbi cyangwa kutagira ubushake bwa politiki.
Ibi byose bigaragaza ko kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu bisaba imbaraga zifatanyije z’amahanga yose, inzego za leta, n’imiryango itari iya leta.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu mu gihe cy’ikoranabuhanga.
Iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ryahinduye uburyo abantu babaho, bakorana, banavugana. Ubu, amakuru agezweho, ubutumwa n’ubuvugizi bishobora gukwirakwira ku isi yose mu isegonda rimwe. Ariko, uko iterambere rizamuka, niko n’ibibazo bishya bijyanye n’uburenganzira byiyongera.
Urugero, uburyo bwo gukusanya amakuru ku bantu (data collection) bukomeje kuba ikibazo gikomeye mu kurengera uburenganzira ku buzima bwite. Ibigo bikomeye by’ikoranabuhanga bikusanya amakuru menshi y’abantu, bikayakoresha mu bucuruzi cyangwa politiki, rimwe na rimwe bitabanje gusaba uruhushya.
Ubumenyi bw’ubukorano (AI) n’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Ubumenyi bw’ubukorano (Artificial Intelligence – AI) buragenda bufata umwanya ukomeye mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Ikoreshwa mu butabera, ubuvuzi, uburezi n’imiyoborere, ariko nanone rifite ingaruka zishobora kurengera cyangwa kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Abashakashatsi bavuga ko AI ishobora gutuma habaho ivangura rishingiye ku buryo porogaramu zayo zitozwa. Urugero, porogaramu zimwe zishobora gukoresha amakuru atuzuye bigatera gufata ibyemezo bitaboneye, nko gufata abantu batabigizemo uruhare cyangwa kubima amahirwe mu kazi.
Ubwisanzure bwo gutanga ibitekerezo kuri murandasi.
Murandasi yabaye urubuga rw’ibitekerezo n’ubwisanzure, ariko nanone igenda iba isoko y’ivangura, urwango n’ibihuha.
Ibihugu bimwe byashyizeho amategeko abuza gukwirakwiza amakuru y’ibinyoma, ariko rimwe na rimwe ayo mategeko akoreshwa nabi mu guhagarika abavuga ibyo leta itishimiye.
Abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu bavuga ko hakenewe itandukaniro rigaragara hagati yo kurwanya urwango no gukumira ubwisanzure bw’ibitekerezo. Uburenganzira bwo gutanga ibitekerezo bugomba guharanirwa, ariko bukubahirizwa mu buryo butabangamira abandi.
Ejo hazaza h’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu bugomba gukomeza guhindukana n’isi, kuko ibibazo by’uyu munsi bitandukanye n’iby’imyaka 50 ishize.
Hari ibintu bitatu bizaba ingenzi mu kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu mu bihe biri imbere:
Mu gihe isi ihura n’ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, intambara, n’ubusumbane, uburenganzira bwa muntu bugomba gufatwa nk’umusingi w’amahoro n’iterambere rirambye.
Umusozo w’inyandiko.
Isesengura ryerekanye ko uburenganzira bwa muntu mu kinyejana cya 21 butakiri igitekerezo cy’inyandiko gusa, ahubwo ari ubuzima bwose bw’umuntu mu buryo bwagutse. Iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga, impinduka z’ikirere, ubusumbane n’ubukene byose bigira uruhare mu buryo uburenganzira bugaragara n’uko burengerwa.
Kubaka ejo hazaza heza bisaba ko buri gihugu, buri sosiyete n’umuntu ku giti cye ashyira uburenganzira bwa muntu ku isonga, kuko ari bwo bushingiyeho ubumwe, amahoro n’iterambere rirambye.
Inama n’Ibisubizo Bitangwa (Recommendations).
Mu rwego rwo gukomeza guteza imbere uburenganzira bwa muntu mu kinyejana cya 21, hari ibyemezo n’ingamba by’ingenzi byashobora gufasha isi yose kugira iterambere rirambye n’ubumwe mu burenganzira:
Izi nama zifasha mu kubaka isi igendera ku mahame y’uburinganire, amahoro, n’ubwubahane, aho uburenganzira bwa muntu buba umusingi w’ubuzima bw’abantu bose.

Uruhare rw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu Kurengera Uburenganzira bwa Muntu ni inyandiko isesengura uburyo ONU yashyizweho, intego zayo, inzego zayo zishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu, ndetse n’uko yagiye ikora ibikorwa byo kurengera uburenganzira bw’abantu ku isi yose.
Inkomoko y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
Umuryango w’Abibumbye washyizweho ku wa 24 Ukwakira 1945, nyuma y’intambara ya kabiri y’isi yose, kugira ngo habeho uburyo bw’ibanze bwo kubungabunga amahoro ku isi no gukumira intambara n’ihohoterwa rikabije ku bantu.
Ishyirwaho ry’ONU ryari rigamije guhangana n’ingorane zagiye zigaragara mu gihe cy’intambara: jenoside, ivangura, gukandamiza abaturage no kwica amategeko mpuzamahanga.
Intego z’ONU mu burenganzira bwa muntu.
Amasezerano y’ishyirwaho ry’ONU ashyira imbere ibintu bitatu by’ingenzi:
Muri aya mahame, kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu ni kimwe mu by’ingenzi byubakiyeho imiyoborere y’isi. ONU yemeje ko buri muntu afite agaciro kandi ko uburenganzira bwe butagomba kwangizwa n’umuntu cyangwa igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose.
Amasezerano n’inzego z’ONU zishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu.
ONU yashyizeho amasezerano n’inzego zigamije gukurikirana no gushyigikira uburenganzira bwa muntu ku isi yose. Inzego zikomeye z’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri ONU ni izi:
Amateka y’ingenzi y’ONU mu burenganzira bwa muntu.
ONU yagiye igira uruhare mu bikorwa byinshi byo kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu:
Aya mateka agaragaza ko ONU itari gusa ishyiraho amategeko, ahubwo inagira uruhare mu gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ayo mategeko ku isi.
Inzego z’ONU zishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu.
ONU yashyizeho inzego nyinshi zigamije gukurikirana no kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu ku isi yose. Izi nzego zifite inshingano zitandukanye: zishinzwe gukurikirana ibikorwa, gushyiraho amabwiriza, gutanga amahugurwa, no gufasha ibihugu gushyira mu bikorwa amategeko mpuzamahanga.
UN Human Rights Council (UNHRC).
UNHRC yashyizweho mu 2006 isimbura Komisiyo ya mbere y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu. Intego yayo nyamukuru ni:
UNHRC ikoresha uburyo bwo kohereza abagenzuzi ku bihugu, gukurikirana ihohoterwa, no gutanga raporo z’imikorere y’uburenganzira bwa muntu ku Nteko rusange y’ONU.
Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR).
OHCHR ifasha ibihugu gushyira mu bikorwa amategeko mpuzamahanga y’uburenganzira bwa muntu. Ibikorwa byayo birimo:
Izi nzego zombi zifasha mu gushyiraho amategeko, amahugurwa, gahunda z’uburezi, no kurwanya ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore n’abana.
Ibikorwa by’ONU ku Isi hose.
ONU ikora ibikorwa byinshi bigamije kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu:
Urugero, mu bihugu byibasiwe n’intambara cyangwa ihohoterwa rya politiki, UNHRC ikora raporo zisesengura uburenganzira bw’abaturage n’ibyemezo byo kubungabunga amahoro. OHCHR nayo igafasha mu gushyiraho amategeko n’ubuyobozi bw’imbere mu gihugu.
Imbogamizi ONU ihura nazo.
N’ubwo ONU ifite intego nyinshi, hari imbogamizi ikomeye:
Ingero z’Ubwirinzi bw’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu n’Ibikorwa by’ONU.
Umuryango w’Abibumbye ukora ibikorwa byinshi byo kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu ku isi hose. Ibikorwa by’ingenzi birimo kohereza abagenzuzi mu bihugu byugarijwe n’intambara cyangwa ihohoterwa, gutanga raporo zisesengura uko uburenganzira bushyirwa mu bikorwa, no gushyigikira gahunda z’uburezi n’ubuzima ku bana n’abagore.
Imbogamizi z’Ibikorwa.
N’ubwo hari intambwe zatewe, ONU ihura n’imbogamizi zikomeye:
Imbogamizi ku rwego rw’Imiyoborere n’Imikoranire.
Ububasha bwa ONU burangwa n’imiyoborere y’amahanga n’ubufatanye bw’ibihugu. Hari ibibazo bikurikira:
Iterambere rishya mu burenganzira bwa muntu.
Mu kinyejana cya 21, uburenganzira bwa muntu buhura n’ihindagurika ry’isi ryihuse, irimo ikoranabuhanga, imihindagurikire y’ikirere, n’ubusumbane bw’ubukungu. ONU yashyizeho gahunda nshya zo kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu no gushyigikira ibihugu mu guhangana n’izi ngorane.
koranabuhanga rihindura uburyo abantu bavugana, bakora, kandi bakora ubuvugizi. Gusa rifite ingaruka ku burenganzira bw’abantu:
Ubufatanye bw’Imiryango y’ibihugu n’iyigenga.
ONU ikorana n’imiryango y’ibihugu, imiryango itari iya leta (NGOs), n’ibigo mpuzamahanga mu kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu. Ubufatanye bukorwa mu buryo bukurikira:
Ingaruka z’izi gahunda.
Ubufatanye bw’ONU n’imiryango butanga umusaruro mu buryo bukurikira:
Imbogamizi z’Iterambere rishya.
N’ubwo hari intambwe, hari imbogamizi zikomeye:
Inama n’Recommendations ku kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Mu rwego rwo gukomeza guteza imbere uburenganzira bwa muntu ku isi, inama zikurikira zifite akamaro:

Indangagaciro y’Umuco n’Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda ni inyandiko isesengura uburyo umuco w’abantu, indangagaciro zabo, n’imiryango bifitanye isano n’uburenganzira bwo kwiyumvamo agace cyangwa itsinda, kandi igahabwa agaciro n’amategeko mpuzamahanga.
Inkomoko y’Indangagaciro y’Umuco.
Umuco ni uburyo abantu bahurira ku myemerere, imigenzo, amateka, ubuvanganzo, n’imyitwarire. Kwiyumva mu itsinda ni kimwe mu by’ingenzi byo kubaka umuryango w’abantu ndetse n’iterambere ryabo.
Abahanga mu by’ubumenyi bw’umuco bavuga ko indangagaciro y’umuco igira uruhare mu:
Agaciro k’Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda.
Uburenganzira bwo kwiyumva mu itsinda cyangwa mu muco wihariye burengera:
Amategeko Mpuzamahanga arengera Umuco.
Uburenganzira bwo kwiyumva mu itsinda bufitanye isano n’amategeko mpuzamahanga arengera indangagaciro z’umuco. Aya mategeko agenga uburenganzira bwo kubaho no kugaragaza umuco, kandi akurikirana ko abantu bose bashobora kwishyira hamwe mu matsinda y’umuco n’imiryango yabo.
Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).
Ingingo ya 27: Umuntu wese afite uburenganzira bwo kwitabira ubuzima bw’umuco w’abantu, kuryoherwa n’ubuhanzi, no kugira uruhare mu bikorwa by’ubumenyi n’ubuhanzi by’umuco.
International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR).
Ingingo ya 15: Abaturage bose bafite uburenganzira bwo kugaragaza no kubungabunga umuco wabo, gufata gahunda z’uburezi zishingiye ku muco, no gukoresha ururimi kavukire mu myigire yabo.
UNESCO Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions (2005).
- Intego nyamukuru ni ugushyigikira uburenganzira bwo kugaragaza umuco n’ubuhanzi, kurengera umwihariko w’ibihugu n’imiryango, no guteza imbere imiryango y’umuco.
Ingero z’Isi Hose ku Burenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda n’Umuco.
Uburenganzira bwo kwiyumva mu itsinda bugenda buterwa imbere mu bihugu bitandukanye, hakurikijwe amategeko mpuzamahanga, ubuyobozi bw’imbere mu gihugu, n’imiryango yigenga.
Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda muri Canada.
Canada ifite amategeko arengera indangagaciro z’abo mu bihugu byabo kavukire n’abimukira. Itegeko ry’Uburinganire n’Uburenganzira bwa muntu ryemerera buri wese kwiyumva mu itsinda ry’umuco we, kwitabira imihango, no gukoresha ururimi kavukire.
Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda muri Nouvelle-Zélande (Aotearoa).
Itegeko rya Waitangi rifasha abanya-Māori kubungabunga umuco wabo, indimi zabo, n’imigenzo y’umuco. Abaturage bose bafite uburenganzira bwo kugaragaza indangagaciro z’umuco wabo mu mashuri, ibikorwa by’ubuhanzi, n’imihango.
Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda muri Afurika y’Epfo.
Itegeko nshinga rya Afurika y’Epfo rishyiraho uburyo bwo kurengera indangagaciro z’amoko atandukanye. Abaturage bafite uburenganzira bwo kugaragaza imyemerere yabo, kwambara imyambaro y’umuco, no gutanga uburezi bushingiye ku muco wabo.
Imbogamizi n’Ihohoterwa ku Bumenyi bw’Umuco.
N’ubwo hari amategeko mpuzamahanga n’imbere mu bihugu arengera indangagaciro z’umuco, hari ibibazo byinshi bikigaragara mu isi yose. Izi mbogamizi zirimo:
Uruhare rw’Imiryango Mpuzamahanga n’Amabwiriza ya ONU.
Imiryango mpuzamahanga nka UNESCO, OHCHR, na UNDP ifite uruhare rukomeye mu kurengera indangagaciro z’umuco no gushyigikira uburenganzira bwo kwiyumva mu itsinda. Iyi miryango ishyiraho gahunda, raporo, n’ingamba zo gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uburenganzira bw’umuco ku isi yose.
Inama n’Recommendations ku Kurengera Uburenganzira bwo Kwiyumva mu Itsinda.
Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere uburenganzira bwo kwiyumva mu itsinda no kurengera indangagaciro z’umuco, inama zikurikira zirakenewe:

Uburenganzira ku Buzima bw’Iganga mu Ikoranabuhanga ni uburenganzira bw’umuntu bwo kugira amakuru ye bwite, uburyo asangirwa, n’uko akoreshwa n’abakoresha ikoranabuhanga ku isi yose.
Inkomoko y’Uburenganzira ku Buzima bw’Iganga.
Uburenganzira ku buzima bwite bw’umuntu (privacy) bufite inkomoko mu mategeko mpuzamahanga arengera uburenganzira bwa muntu, nk’UDHR Ingingo ya 12 n’ICESCR Ingingo ya 17. Mu gihe cy’ikoranabuhanga, ubu burenganzira bwiyongereye kubera:
Agaciro k’Uburenganzira ku Buzima bw’Iganga.
Uburenganzira ku buzima bwite mu ikoranabuhanga burimo:
Amategeko Mpuzamahanga arengera Uburenganzira ku Buzima bw’Iganga.
Uburenganzira ku buzima bwite (privacy) mu ikoranabuhanga burengerwa n’amategeko mpuzamahanga atandukanye, arimo:
Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).
-Ingingo ya 12: Ntihagomba guhonyorwa ubuzima bwite bw’umuntu, urugo rwe, amakuru ye bwite cyangwa ibaruwa ze. Uburenganzira bwo kurindwa gucibwa bugufi bwubahirizwa kandi bufatwa nk’ingenzi mu isi yose.
International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR).
Ingingo ya 17:Ntihagomba guhonyorwa ubuzima bwite cyangwa amakuru bwite y’umuntu. Buri gihugu gifite inshingano zo kubahiriza no kurengera ubuzima bwite bw’abaturage bacyo, harimo no mu ikoranabuhanga.
European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
- Itegeko ry’Uburayi ryo kurengera amakuru y’abaturage ku murandasi, rikubiyemo uburenganzira bwo kumenya, kugenzura, no gusaba ko amakuru yawe bwite asibwa cyangwa ahindurwe.
Ingero z’Isi Hose ku Buzima bw’Iganga mu Ikoranabuhanga.
Uburenganzira ku buzima bwite mu ikoranabuhanga burakurikiranwa mu bihugu bitandukanye, hifashishijwe amategeko n’inzego zishinzwe kurengera amakuru y’abaturage.
Uburenganzira bwa Privacy muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (USA).
Mu USA, amategeko nka California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) arengera ubuzima bwite bw’abaturage, ndetse no kugenzura amakuru y’abakoresha urubuga. Abaturage bafite uburenganzira bwo kumenya, gusaba gusibanganya cyangwa guhindura amakuru yabo bwite.
Uburenganzira bwa Privacy mu Burayi.
Itegeko rya GDPR ryo mu Burayi ritanga uburenganzira ku makuru bwite, rituma abaturage bamenya neza amakuru abacisha bugufi, uburyo akoreshwa, n’uburenganzira bwo kuyasiba cyangwa kuyahindura.
Uburenganzira bwa Privacy muri Koreya y’Epfo.
Koreya y’Epfo ifite amategeko akomeye yo kurengera amakuru y’abaturage ku murandasi (Personal Information Protection Act, PIPA). Abaturage bafite uburenganzira bwo kumenya uburyo amakuru yabo akoreshwa, kandi ibigo bigomba gukurikiza amabwiriza akomeye yo kubika amakuru.
Imbogamizi n’Inzitizi mu Kurengera Uburenganzira ku Buzima bw’Iganga.
N’ubwo hari amategeko arengera ubuzima bwite mu bihugu byinshi, hari ibibazo bikomeye bikigaragara mu isi yose:
Uruhare rw’Imiryango Mpuzamahanga mu Kurengera Uburenganzira bwa Privacy.
Imiryango mpuzamahanga nka OHCHR, UNESCO, na Internet Governance Forum (IGF) ifite uruhare rukomeye mu gukurikirana no gushyigikira uburenganzira ku buzima bwite mu ikoranabuhanga. Iyi miryango ishyiraho amategeko, raporo, n’ingamba zo kurengera amakuru y’abantu ku isi yose.

Kurwanya Ubukene Biciye mu Buryo bwo Kurengera Uburenganzira bwa Muntu ni uburyo bwo gukoresha amahame y’Uburinganire, Uburenganzira bwa Muntu, n’amategeko mpuzamahanga mu guhangana n’ubukene no guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage bose.
Inkomoko y’Uburyo Bushingiye ku Burenganzira bwa Muntu.
Uburyo bushingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu (Human Rights-Based Approach, HRBA) bufite inkomoko mu mategeko mpuzamahanga arengera uburenganzira bwa muntu, nk’ UDHR (1948), ICESCR (1966), na gahunda za UNDP zo guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage.
=== Agaciro k’Uburyo Bushingiye ku Burenganzira bwa Muntu mu Kurwanya Ubukene Uburyo bushingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu bufasha:
=== Imbonerahamwe: Ingingo Z’ingenzi za HRBA mu Kurwanya Ubukene
Amategeko Mpuzamahanga n’Uburyo Bushingiye ku Burenganzira bwa Muntu mu Kurwanya Ubukene.
Uburyo bushingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu bukurikiza amahame n’amategeko mpuzamahanga agamije guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage, kurwanya ubukene, no kurengera abagore, abana, n’abandi bantu bafite intege nke.
Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga arengera Iterambere.
- Ingingo ya 22 na 25 zerekana ko abantu bose bafite uburenganzira ku mibereho iboneye, harimo ubuzima, uburezi, ibiribwa bihagije, amazu, n’imyambaro.
- Iri tegeko ryongera kurengera uburenganzira ku buzima, uburezi, serivisi z’imibereho myiza, ndetse n’amahirwe angana ku baturage bose, bikaba intambwe ikomeye mu kurwanya ubukene.
- Ibi bigamije kugabanya ubukene ku isi yose, guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage, no kurengera uburenganzira bw’abantu bose mu buryo burambye.
Uburyo Bushingiye ku Burenganzira bwa Muntu mu Iterambere.
- UNDP na OHCHR bashyiraho HRBA aho buri wese afatwa nk’ufite uburenganzira bungana bwo kubona serivisi, amahirwe y’uburezi, ubuzima, n’ibikorwa by’iterambere. Uburyo bushingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu bugamije guhuza gahunda z’iterambere n’amategeko mpuzamahanga.
Kurwanya ubukene biciye mu buryo bwo kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu ni ngombwa kugira ngo iterambere rirambye rigerweho. Uburyo bushingiye ku burenganzira bwa muntu bufasha:
Ibihugu, imiryango mpuzamahanga, n’abikorera mu iterambere bagomba gukorana kugira ngo uburenganzira bwa muntu bugere ku bantu bose, bigafasha kugabanya ubukene ku isi yose.

Uburenganzira karemano n’uburenganzira bw’amategeko ni ibitekerezo bibiri by’ingenzi mu mategeko n’uburenganzira bwa muntu. Bamwe mu batekereza ku mategeko n’uburenganzira batangaza ko hariho ubwoko bubiri bw’uburenganzira: uburenganzira karemano (natural rights) n’ uburenganzira bw’amategeko (legal rights).
Uburenganzira Karemano.
Uburenganzira karemano ni uburenganzira umuntu afite atari ukubwe ku mategeko cyangwa imigenzo y’umuco runaka cyangwa leta. Ni uburenganzira buhoraho, bw’ingenzi, kandi budashobora guhabwa cyangwa gukurwaho n’abantu. Nubwo amategeko ashobora kutubahiriza, umuntu ashobora kubuhomba bitewe n’imyitwarire ye, urugero nko guhonyora uburenganzira bw’undi.
Uburenganzira bw’Amategeko.
Uburenganzira bw’amategeko ni uburenganzira umuntu ahabwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’amategeko runaka. Ubu burenganzira bushobora guhinduka, gukurwaho cyangwa kugenzurwa n’amategeko y’abantu. Ibi bihuza n’icyitwa amategeko yemewe (positive law).
Amateka y’Uburenganzira Karemano.
Uburenganzira karemano bufite inkomoko mu mitekerereze ya kera kandi bukomeje kugira uruhare mu mategeko n’uburenganzira bwa muntu kugeza n’ubu.
Filozofe n’Abategetsi Bagaragaje Uburenganzira Karemano.
Uburenganzira karemano bwagiye burushaho gusobanurwa no guhabwa agaciro n’abafilozofe, abategetsi, n’abanditsi b’amateka mu bihe bitandukanye.
Thomas Hobbes na Social Contract.
Thomas Hobbes (1588–1679) yatanze igitekerezo cy’uburenganzira karemano mu bitekerezo bye ku mategeko n’ubutegetsi, agashimangira ko abantu bavukana uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imbaraga zabo kugira ngo barinde ubuzima bwabo.

Uburenganzira bw'abaturage ni uburenganzira n’ubwisanzure bw'ibanze buri ku rwego rw’umuntu, aho leta yemera kutabuhungabanya, haba binyuze mu Itegeko Nshinga, amategeko asanzwe, cyangwa ibisobanuro by’imanza, kandi hatabayeho gukurikiza amategeko agenga imikorere y’ubutabera.
Buri gihugu kigira uburyo bwacyo bwo gusobanura uburenganzira bw’abaturage, ariko akenshi harimo:
Inyito Rusange n’Amateka.
Uburenganzira bw’abaturage bushobora kugaragarira mu Itegeko Nshinga, ibikubiye mu mategeko y’ibanze, cyangwa mu masezerano mpuzamahanga nka:
Igitekerezo cya civil liberties gishobora gusubizwa inyuma kugeza ku Itegeko rya Magna Carta ryashyizweho mu Bwongereza muri 1215, rikaba ryari ishingiro ry’uburenganzira bw’abaturage n’ubwisanzure bw’ibanze.
Uburenganzira bw’abaturage buracyari ikibazo mu bihugu byinshi bitewe n’ingaruka z’intambara, iterabwoba, n’icyemezo cyo gusubika uburenganzira bwihariye mu bihe byihutirwa.
Uburenganzira bw’Abaturage mu Bihugu Bitandukanye.
Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’Ubushinwa rirengera uburenganzira bw’abaturage ku rwego runaka, cyane cyane Ingingo z’Iburenganzira n’Inshingano z’Abaturage. Ariko, mu bikorwa bya politiki, leta ikoresha amategeko yiswe "subversion of state power" na "protection of state secrets" mu gufunga abagaragaje ibitekerezo bibangamiye ishyaka rya Communist Party n’abayobozi b’igihugu.
Itegeko Nshinga ry’Ubuhinde (Part III) rirengera uburenganzira bw’ibanze (Fundamental Rights) burimo uburinganire, ubwigenge, uburenganzira bwo kurengera umutungo, ubwisanzure bw’iyobokamana, n’uburenganzira ku bucuruzi n’uburezi.
Itegeko Nshinga ry’Ubuyapani rya 1947, rizwi nka "Postwar Constitution" cyangwa "Peace Constitution", rirengera uburenganzira bw’abaturage cyane mu bice 10–40, harimo n’Ingingo ya 25 ishyiraho uburenganzira bwo kugira imibereho iboneye.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Hanoi ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva- umujyi wa Hanoi muri Vietnam. Hafi ya 50% hamwe n'izindi ndimi z'amarenga zo muri Vietnam, kandi amagambo yayo yagiye agira uruhare runini mu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'igifaransa rwigeze kwigishwa mu mashuri yo muri Vietnam yo ku ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Giyane ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva rwa Guyana. Amakuru make ahari. Kubera ko Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika rukoreshwa mu burezi muri Guyana, "Ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Giyane" rushobora kuba izina ryaho rya ASL.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Gineya-Bissau (Portuguese cyangwa Língua de sinais guineense.​​Ni ururimi rw'amarenga ruri mu rugendo rwo gukura, rukomoka ku ishuri rimwe ry'abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva ryo muri Gineya-Bisawu, ryashinzwe i Bissau mu mwaka wa 2003. Mu 2005, umunyalinguist n'umwarimu w'ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Porutugali basanze GBSL (Guinea-Bissau Sign Language) ikiri ururimi rudateye imbere cyane, ariko ifite ubusugire bumwe hagati y'abnyeshuri mu ishuri no mu buryo bakoreshaga amarenga mu miryango yabo iyo basubiye mu rugo.
Ntabwo bifitanye isano itaziguye n'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igiportigale, nubwo rwatije inyuguti.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Gambiya ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igihugu rukoreshwa n'umuryango w'abatumva muri Gambiya. Ishuri ryonyine ry’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Gambiya, Ishuri rya St John ry’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva, ryashinzwe n’umupadiri gatolika ukomoka muri Irilande. Ururimi rw'amarenga rwo mu Buholandi rwinjijwe muri iryo shuri hamwe n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo mu Bwongereza rwateye imbere mu rurimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Gambiya, rurimo ibimenyetso bimwe na bimwe kavukire byakoreshwaga n'abaturage muri rusange. "Bitandukanye" [] y’iburengerazuba, Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika ntirwigeze rwinjizwa muri Gambiya kugeza nyuma yaho bityo umuryango w'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva utamenyereye ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika.

Mu ndimi z'amarenga, imvugo ni imiterere yihariye y'umubiri hamwe no mu maso bijyana n'amarenga, kandi bikenewe mu gukora amagambo neza. Imvugo ni kimwe mu bintu bitanu bigize ikimenyetso, hamwe na handhape (DEZ), icyerekezo (ORI), ahantu (TAB), no kugenda (SIG). Ikintu cy'ingenzi kigaragaza imvugo ni umunwa. Ariko kandi, si ibimenyetso byose bifite imvugo yihariye isanzwe ibiranga. ["citation ikenewe"]

Indimi nyinshi z’amarenga zo muri Etiyopiya zagiye zikoreshwa mu mashuri atandukanye ya Etiyopiya y’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva kuva mu 1971, ndetse no ku rwego rw’ibanze kuva 1956. Ururimi rw’amarenga rwo muri Etiyopiya, rushobora kuba ari urwego rw’igihugu, rukoreshwa mu mashuri abanza, ayisumbuye, ndetse no muri kaminuza ya Addis Abeba - amashuri makuru, ndetse na televiziyo y'igihugu. ["citation ikenewe"]

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Enga ni ururimi rw'amarenga rugaragara mu baturage ba Tato Enga mu ntara ya Enga, Papouasie-Nouvelle-Guinée. Byatangajwe mu 1980 mu ngingo eshatu zanditswe na Adam Kendon, zishingiye kuri filime zishingiye ku moko y’abasinyiye batatu (umwe ntiyumva, babiri bumva) mu kibaya cyo hejuru cy’umugezi wa Lagaip, ariko havugwa amakuru avuga ko akoreshwa cyane mu karere gakikije. Amakuru ajyanye n'aho ihagaze ubu ntaramenyekana, kuko nta makuru mashya ahari.

Nederland yahuye na Gebaren (NmG), cyangwa Ikimenyetso cyashyizweho umukono n’Ubuholandi, ni uburyo bwandikishijwe intoki bw’Abadage, bukoresheje ibimenyetso by’ururimi rw’amarenga rw’Ubuholandi, bukoreshwa mu kwigisha mu Buholandi izondimi kandi zigafasha cyane ababana nubumuga bwo kutumva.

Sign-Language Media ni itangazamakuru rishingiye kuri sisitemu y'itangazamakuru ry'indimi z'amarenga. Ihuriro byubatswe kumiterere yikibonezamvugo igoye ikozwe muzindi ndimi z amarenga. Mubisanzwe itangazamakuru ryubatswe mundimi cyangwa indimi zanditse, kandi akenshi ntizihuza nururimi rwamarenga.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Douentza, cyangwa ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Dogon ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abaturage ruvugwa muri Douentza ndetse n'abaturage baturanye bo mu gihugu cya Dogon muri Mali. Ntibizwi ukuntu bishobora kuba bisa n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo mu mudugudu hafi, Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Tebul, ariko rushobora kuba ntaho ruhuriye n'urundi rurimi rw'amarenga rwo mu karere ka Dogon, Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Berbey. Kugeza mu 2013, nta shuri ry’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva muri ako karere, ariko harateganijwe; itangizwa ry'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abanyamerika nk'ururimi rw'inyigisho rushobora kugira ingaruka kubimenyetso bya Douentza. Ikusanyamakuru ryakusanyirijwe hamwe n'ikigo cya Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics kugirango cyandike urupapuro rwabanjirije ururimi.

Sisitemu ry'ururimi rw'amarenga, [a] izwi kandi ku rurimi rwasinywe [b] cyangwa Igipolonye cyasinywe, ni uburyo bwandikishijwe intoki bw'igipolonye bukoresha ibimenyetso by'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igipolonye. Muri 2011, Sisitemu y'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Polonye yemerewe n'amategeko.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Ceki (Czech, ČZJ) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva muri Repubulika ya Ceki. Birashoboka ko byagaragaye mu gihe cy'ishuri rya mbere ry'abana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva muri Bohemia (1786). N'umuryango w'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igifaransa kandi urumva igice hamwe n'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'igifaransa. Nubwo imvugo yo muri Tchèque na Slovakiya isa, ntabwo yegereye cyane ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Silovakiya. ["citation ikenewe"]

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Kupuro cyangwa Sipiriyani (Greek) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rudasanzwe rwa Kupuro. Bigaragara ko ari pidgin y'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika n'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'ikigereki, rutaragera ku rurimi rwuzuye. Umuryango w'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo mu Bugereki Sipiriyani ukoresha ururimi rw'amarenga rw'ikigereki.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Chiriqui (Icyesipanyoli: "Lengua de Señas de Chiriquí", LSCH) ni rwo rurimi rw'amarenga rw'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva rwo mu ntara ya Chiriquí muri Panama. Ntabwo byumvikana niba bifitanye isano n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Panamani, rutumvikana neza na rwo; niba aribyo, byanaba bifitanye isano n'ururimi rw'amarenga rw'abanyamerika.

Imyandikire y'intoki ya Chili ikoreshwa n'umuryango w'abana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Chili gusinya amagambo y'Icyesipanyoli kandi yinjijwe mu rurimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Chili. N'inyuguti imwe kandi isa cyane n'inyuguti z'intoki z'Abanyamerika, kimwe n'Igifaransa, Berezile na Espagne.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Taurus rwagati (CTSL; Turkish) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rwo muri Turukiya. Bivugwa mu midugudu itatu yo mu misozi ya Taurus rwagati. Yamenyekanishijwe ku isi na Rabia Ergin, wagiye ayimenyeraho akura.

Sign language Glove ni igikoresho cya elegitoroniki kigerageza guhindura icyerekezo cy'ururimi rw'amarenga mu magambo yanditse cyangwa avugwa. Bamwe mu banenga ubwo buhanga bavuze ko ubushobozi bwa gants zifashishwa na sensor zo gukora ibi bikunze kuvugwa cyane cyangwa kutumva nabi, kubera ko indimi nyinshi z'amarenga zifite ikibonezamvugo kigoye gikubiyemo gukoresha ibimenyetso byerekana ibimenyetso no mu maso (ibintu bitari intoki).
iyi sisitemu ishobora kwambarwa irimo sensor zikoresha intoki enye nintoki kugirango umenye buri jambo, interuro cyangwa inyuguti nkuko bikozwe mururimi rwamarenga.
Ibyo bimenyetso noneho byoherezwa bidasubirwaho kuri terefone igendanwa, ikabihindura mumagambo yavuzwe ku kigero cyijambo rimwe kumasegonda hakoreshejwe iyo sisitemu.
Abashakashatsi bongeyeho kandi ibyuma bifata bifata mu maso abantu bakoresheje mu gupima icyo gikoresho - hagati y'ijisho ryabo no ku ruhande rumwe rw'akanwa kabo - kugira ngo bafate ibintu bitaranga ururimi.

Imyandikire y'intoki ya Catalone ikoreshwa mu rurimi rw'amarenga rw'Igikatalani ariko ntiyemerwa ku mugaragaro nk'imwe mu ndimi zemewe za Cataloniya kugeza ku ya 3 Kamena 2010 igihe itegeko ryo kuwa 17/2010 ry’ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Catalonike (LSC) ryemejwe na guverinoma. Imyandikire y'intoki ya Catalonike ni ukuboko kumwe kandi irasa cyane n'inyuguti ya Espagne. Kubera iyo mpamvu, abantu bakoresha ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Icyesipanyolio bashobora gusobanukirwa hafi 80% by'ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Cataliane.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Bouakako cyangwa LaSiBo (French) ni ururimi rw'amarenga rugaragara mu mudugudu wa Bouakako, mu burengerazuba bw'umujyi wa Hiré mu majyepfo ya Coryte d'Ivoire. LaSiBo yakoreshejwe n'ibisekuru byinshi by'ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva, benshi muri bo bakaba bafitanye isano. Benshi mu baturage bumva, bavuga Yocoboué Dida, hari icyo bazi m'ururimi, kandi bamwe bavuga neza. Amagambo aratandukanye hagati y'abavuga, byerekana ko ururimi rukiri ruto. Ukurikije imyaka y'abasinyaga babana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva cyane, birashoboka ko byibuze ifite imyaka 50 (as of 2016).
LaSiBo isa n'ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Nanabin muri Gana, ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Mardin muri Turukiya n'izindi ndimi z'amarenga zo mu mudugudu zibanze mu miryango imwe cyangwa mike.

Ururimi rw'amarenga rwa Berbey ni ururimi rw'amarenga rw'umuryango w'umudugudu wa Berbey mu karere ka Hombori muri Mali. Ururimi rwaho ni Humburi Senni. Kuri ubu ururimi ruvugwa n'abavandimwe babiri (umwe muri bo akaba abana n'ubumuga bwo kutavuga) n'imiryango yabo, barimo abana bane babana nubwo bumuga. Mu gisekuru cya benewabo, abakoresha ibimenyetso bose bari abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Ibarura rusange ryakozwe na Eswatini ryo mu 2017, ababana n'ubumuga bagera kuri 176.184, bangana na 16.1% by'abatuye igihugu. Icyorezo kiri hejuru cyane mu dore ko 82% by’abafite ubumuga baba mu cyaro mu gihe 18% basigaye ari abo. mu 2017 ku rundi ruhande, ryerekana ko 52% by’abafite ubumuga muri Eswatini nta mashuri bafite. Mu bitabira ishuri, 22,3% bahabwa impamyabumenyi y'amashuri abanza, mu gihe 9,6% bafite impamyabumenyi y'abato. Byongeye kandi, Ibarura rusange ry’umwaka wa 2019 ryerekana ko mu gihugu hari abanyeshuri 41.565 bafite ibibazo by’ubumuga n’ubumuga bwihariye mu mashuri abanza (adasanzwe kandi asanzwe), muri bo 54% ni abagabo naho 45% ni ab'igitsina gore. ​​​
Amashuri yihariye muri Eswatini.
Minisiteri y’Uburezi n’Amahugurwa Itangazo ryihariye rya y’uburezi, iteganya ko Eswatini ifite amashuri menshi yakira abantu bafite ibibazo byihariye (PSN) mu turere tune. Muri byo harimo:
Nubwo hashyizweho ingufu muri gahunda yuburezi burimo ibibazo byinshi. Ubwa mbere, gahunda yo kumenyekanisha hakiri kare abana bafite ibibazo byihariye byuburezi ntibibaho muri Eswatini, abarimu bigisha, cyane cyane kurwego, mubisanzwe bashinzwe umurimo utoroshye wo kumenya abanyeshuri bashobora gukenera Uburezi bwihariye, no kwagura SNE. Icya kabiri, hariho iterambere rito ry'abarimu kuko ababyeyi bananiwe kumenya ibimenyetso byambere abarimu bakeneye kongerera ubushobozi guhoraho mbere nakazi. Rimwe na rimwe iyo guverinoma ya Eswatini yohereje ibikoresho by’ishuri kugirango bikoreshwe mu burezi bw’abana bafite ubumuga n’abafite ubumuga, ubusanzwe ni ibikoresho bijyanye n’uburezi rusange. Abarimu n'abayobozi muri aya mashuri bakora cyane kugirango bahuze ibikoresho nibisabwa byihariye, kuburyo rimwe na rimwe bagomba kwishingikiriza ku baterankunga, badashobora guhora banyuze mubufasha.

Villaney "Lany" Remengesau (wavutse 30 Werurwe 1985) numuntu uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Palau. Azwiho ubuvugizi ku Babana nubumuga muri Palau no mu karere kagari ka Aziya-Pasifika, ibyo bikaba byaratumye agirwa umuntu ukomeye cyane muri Palau mu 2024 n'ikigo cy'itangazamakuru cya Palau.
Remengesau yavukiye i, muri Palau, mu murage wa Palauan na Aziya. Afite ubumuga bw'umubiri kandi akoresha igare ry'abamugaye. Yize imicungire yubucuruzi muri kaminuza, arubatse afite umwana.
Remengesau yagize uruhare runini mubuyobozi no gutanga inama mugutezimbere amashyirahamwe nabafite ubumuga muri Palau. Yagize uruhare mu kubyutsa OMEKESANG, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta uharanira uburenganzira bw'abafite ubumuga muri Palau, kandi wabaye umuyobozi wacyo kuva mu 2011 kugeza mu 2020. Ku buyobozi bwe, OMEKESANG yabonye ubunyamuryango bwuzuye bw’imishinga mpuzamahanga iharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga, harimo ihuriro ry’abafite ubumuga bwa pasifika, Aziya ya Pasifika DPO United, n’abafite ubumuga mpuzamahanga. Remengesau yabaye kandi perezida w’ishyirahamwe rya Belau ry’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta hagati ya 2018 na 2020.

Hamisa Zaja (c.1972 -) numunyakenya uha imbaraga ababana nubumuga. Yashinze ishyirahamwe ry’inyanja ry’abafite ubumuga. Mu 2024 yabaye uwanyuma mu (USIP) Igihembo mpuzamahanga cy’abagore bubaka amahoro.
Zaja yavutse ahagana mu 1972 mu ya Kenya. Yavuwe kugira umuriro igihe yari akiri umwana, kubera iyo mpamvu afite ukuguru kumugaye. Yagiye mu ishuri rya Port Ritz ry’abafite ubumuga nyuma y’ishuri ryisumbuye rya Mama Ngina. Yari azi ko umuryango we wateguye ubukwe bw'abana babo, ariko nta mukandida wamenyekanye. Yakomeje arangiza amashuri yubuyobozi.
Zaja yashinze ishyirahamwe ry’inyanja ry’abafite ubumuga. Yatorewe kuba muri ya.

Ola Abu Al Ghaib cyangwa Ola Abualghaib (Arabic) ni umuvugizi uharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga ku isi. Muri Kanama 2019, yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ubunyamabanga bwa Tekinike bw’ikigega cy’abafite ubumuga ku isi, ahahoze ari Umuryango w’abibumbye ku burenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga (UNPRPD).
Dr. Abualghaib yayoboye iterambere ry’uyu muryango no gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba z’ibikorwa (SOF) muri 2020–2025 na 2025-2030, avuga ko Ikigega ari umufatanyabikorwa w’isi ku isi uteza imbere ubumuga. Ku buyobozi bwe, miliyoni zisaga 100 USD zashowe mu bihugu birenga 100 byo mu turere dutanu.
Abualghaib yagaragaye muri Apolitical's Gender Equality Urutonde 100 rwabantu bakomeye muri politiki yisi yose muri 2019.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Abu Al Ghaib yavukiye i Nablus, ku nkombe y’Iburengerazuba, yari afite imyaka cumi n'ibiri ubwo yaburaga gukoresha amaguru. Kubera ibyo bihe byahinduye ubuzima, yahatiwe kuguma mu rugo imyaka itatu atize. Igihe amashuri yari hafi yanze kumwandikisha kubera ubuzima bwe, yimukiye i, ari naho yiyandikishije mu. Ku ikubitiro umunyeshuri witegereza, yemerewe kumugaragaro nyuma yo kubona amanota menshi mwishuri rye.
Abu Al Ghaib yatangiye umwuga we uharanira uburenganzira bwe ku kigo mu gihe cya kaminuza. Imbaraga zamuhesheje umwanya muri komite ishinzwe kubaka ikigo, aho yahinduye ikigo cya kaminuza n’abanyeshuri bamugaye.
Muri Palesitine, Abu Al Ghaib yashinze umuryango wa Stars of Hope Society, umuryango ugamije gukemura ibibazo by’abagore bafite ubumuga no kubashyigikira mu kubahiriza uburenganzira bwabo.

Ikigo gishinzwe ubuvugizi cy’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (MDAC) ni umuryango washinzwe muri Hongiriya mu 2002. Icyicaro cyayo i Budapest.
Ikigo gishinzwe ubuvugizi cy’abafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe (MDAC) n’umuryango mpuzamahanga uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu uteza imbere uburenganzira bw’abana n’abantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bwo kwiga, ubwenge n’ubwenge-bw’imibereho (ubuzima bwo mu mutwe).MDAC ikoresha amategeko mu guteza imbere uburinganire no binyuze mu manza zifatika, ubuvugizi, ubushakashatsi no gukurikirana no kongerera ubushobozi.MDAC ikorera ku rwego rw'isi kimwe n'akarere ndetse n'imbere mu Burayi no muri Afurika.

Yooralla (ku mugaragaro umuryango wa Yooralla wa Victoria) ni umuryango utanga serivisi Zababana nubumuga muri Ositaraliya, utera inkunga abatsinze 30.000 babana n’ubumuga.
Umuryango wa Yooralla wa Victoria washinzwe mu 1977 mu rwego rwo guhuza ishuri ry’ibitaro bya Yooralla na Sosiyete ya Victorian y’abana bafite ubumuga.

Umuryango wa Victorian kubana bamugaye (1935–1977).
Sosiyete ya Victorian y'abana bamugaye yashinzwe mu 1935 na, umugore w'umucamanza mukuru. Byari bifitanye isano rya bugufi n’ishuri ry’ibitaro bya Yooralla n’ibitaro. shuri rya Treloar n'Ishuri Rikuru ni inzu idatunganijwe ituwe kandi umunsi ku munsi ishuri rikuru na kaminuza by’abana Babana ubumuga n’urubyiruko, kuva ku myaka 2 kugeza kuri 25 i hafi ya, mu Bwongereza.
Intego n'imiyoborere.
Ishuri na kaminuza bigamije gutanga uburezi bushoboza abamugaye, hifashishijwe uburyo bwo kwigisha, kwita, kuvura akazi, no. Bayoborwa na Treloar Trust, umugiraneza wanditswe. Ishuri, kaminuza, hamwe nicyizere bakunze kwita umwe cyangwa hamwe nka "Treloar". Icivugo cyemewe ni "Treloar's: Gushoboza Uburezi".
Mu 1907, icyo gihe, yashyizeho 'Ikigega cy’abamugaye' nk'ubujurire bwe. Intego ye kwari ukubaka ibitaro n’ishuri hanze yumujyi kubana barwaye igituntu kitari ibihaha. Ku ya 13 Kamena 1907 yanditse mu gitabo cye ko Nyiricyubahiro 'yaje mu nzu ya Mansion kugira ngo afungure Fete y'umwamikazi mu rwego rwo gufasha ikigega cyanjye cy'abamugaye. Mu 1908, ishuri ry’indaro n’ibitaro byafunguwe muri Alton, nk’ibitaro na College bya Lord Mayor Treloar Cripples.
Mu 1948, Ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima cyafashe ibitaro, maze ishuri rikuru rya Lord Mayor Treloar ryimukira i Alton, ryimukira mu kibanza gishya cyaguzwe na Trust mu 1949 mu mudugudu uri hafi ya. Mu 1965, ishuri ry’abakobwa rya Florence Treloar ryafunguwe mu mudugudu wa Holybourne. Mu 1978, ayo mashuri yombi yahujwe ku izina rya Lord Mayor Treloar College, hamwe n'Ishuri Rito ryacumbikiwe muri Froyle n'Ishuri Rikuru rya Holybourne.

Ishyirahamwe ry’Abatavuga n’Abatumva mu Bwongereza (BDA) ni umuryango w’ubugiraneza uyoborwa n’abatavuga n’abatumva ubwabo, ukaba urwanya akarengane kandi uvuganira abantu batumva bakoresha ururimi rw’amarenga rwo mu Bwongereza.
Iri shyirahamwe ryabanjeho ryari Ishyirahamwe ry’Igihugu ry’Abatavuga n’Abatumva (National Association for the Deaf and Dumb, NADD), ryashinzwe n’abantu batumva mu mwaka wa 1886. Ishyirwaho rya NADD ryaturutse ku kibazo cy’uko habonekaga ibimenyetso by’ihungabanywa ry’uburenganzira bw’abatavuga n’abatumva ku bijyanye n’ururimi no ku burezi, byatewe n’ibyemezo byafashwe mu nama yabereye i Milan mu mwaka wa 1880. Iyo nama mpuzamahanga, aho abenshi mu bitabiriye bari abarimu bigishaga abana batumva uburyo bwo kumva, yafashe umwanzuro wo guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’indimi z’amaboko ku isi yose. Nyuma y’iyo nama, abitabiriye basubiye mu bihugu byabo bafite intego yo guca burundu ikoreshwa ry’abarimu batumva ndetse n’ikoreshwa ry’ururimi rw’amaboko mu mashuri. Banashakaga kandi gukomeza kugabanya ubwinshi bw’abanyeshuri mu ishuri, kugira ngo abarimu bumva babashe kubagenzura neza.
Komisiyo y’umwami ishinzwe uburezi bw’abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva yatangijwe mu mwaka wa 1889 ariko ntiyabasha kugisha inama abatumva kandi ishyigikira ishyirwaho ry’imvugo itanduye bityo guhagarika ururimi rw’amarenga; mu gusubiza ikinyamakuru "Deaf Mute" yashishikarije abatumva kwishyira hamwe kurengera inyungu zabo bwite.
Mu 1889, NADD yaretse kubaho bityo abagabo bane batumva, barimo Francis Maginn na George Healey, bategura inama muri Mutarama 1890 ku rusengero rwitiriwe Mutagatifu Saviour rw’abatumva, Umuhanda wa Oxford, London, ku buryo bise "Inama y’Igihugu y’Imiryango n’Ubukangurambaga by’Abakuze Batavuga n’Abatumva". Iyi nama yasuzumye ishingwa ry’umuryango w’igihugu kugira ngo "uzamure uburezi n’imibereho y’abatumva n’ibiragi mu Bwongereza" bituma havuka ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva n’ibiragi ry’Abongereza (BDDA) i Leeds ku ya 1890. Mu mwaka wa 1971, BDDA yakuyemo ijambo “Dumb” mu izina ryayo. Ntibyageze mu myaka ya 1970 ari bwo amashuri yatangiye kongera gusuzuma no kwakira ikoreshwa ry’ururimi rw’amaboko.
Kuza kw'ururimi rw'amarenga no kwemerwa na rubanda rusanzwe byatumye abayobozi b'ibipfamatwi bagaruka ku mwanya wa mbere guhera kuri Jock Young nk'intebe ya mbere y'abatumva mu 1983, kandi hagati mu myaka ya za 90, umuyobozi mukuru wa mbere w'abatumva, Jeff McWhinney.
Mu myaka ya za 90 BDA yabaye umuryango uyobowe n’abatumva kandi ubukangurambaga bwo kumenyekanisha ururimi rw amarenga nabwo kugeza ubu intego nyamukuru yibikorwa byabo. Intebe ni Dr. Robert Adam. Intebe zabanjirije iyi zirimo nyakwigendera Terry Riley, umwanditsi wa gahunda ya BBC ' "Reba Umva". ["citation ikenewe"]
Mu mwaka wa 2003, BDA yasohoye inyandiko isobanura intambwe zitandukanye serivisi z’abaturage zigomba gufata kugira ngo zorohereze abantu batumva n’abakoresha Ururimi rw’Amaboko rw’Abongereza (BSL), iyo nyandiko bayise ‘BSL Charter’.
Mu mwaka wa 2017, BDA yasohoye verisiyo ivuguruye y’iyo nyandiko, bayita Charter for British Sign Language.
Umuyobozi w'i Londere, Sadiq Khan, yashyize umukono masezerano mu Gushyingo 2023.

kigo cya Rosewood cyari ikigo Cyiterambere ry’ababana n' ubumuga giherereye ahitwa muri,
Muri Werurwe 1888, Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Maryland yemeje "Itegeko ryo gushyiraho no gushyiramo ishuri ry’ubuhungiro n’amahugurwa ya Feeble Minded of the State of Maryland" (Umutwe 183, Ibyakozwe na 1888) ryahaye ububasha Inama y’abashyitsi cumi na barindwi yo kuyobora ikibanza cy’ishuri "kizakira, cyita kandi cyigisha abantu bose badafite ubwenge, badafite ubwenge n’abatagira ubwenge. N'ubwo iri tegeko rikomeye, amadolari ibihumbi icumi yonyine niyo yagenewe ubutaka n’inyubako, nyuma y’amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu by’amadolari nyuma y’umwaka. Ubuhungiro bwagombaga kuba ubuntu kubana bose batishoboye bafite hagati yimyaka irindwi na cumi nirindwi, bishyuza amadorari magana abiri na mirongo itanu kubandi bana bose.
Kubera amazu adahagije hamwe n’amafaranga yatanzwe hamwe n’umubare w’abasaba kwemererwa (ugereranyije n’inama y’ubuzima ya Leta mu 1884 kuri 1,319) Inama y’abashyitsi yagombaga gushyiraho politiki ibuza kwinjira. Byashyizweho n'Inama y'Ubutegetsi mu 1899, politiki yo kwinjira yagarukiye gusa ku "bashobora guhura n'amahugurwa runaka hagamijwe ko batezwa imbere mu buryo bw'ingirakamaro no kwibeshaho, mu yandi magambo ni ishuri ryigisha kandi ntirigumane.
Gusa abana b'abazungu bari hagati yimyaka irindwi na cumi n'irindwi. Abahungu bigishijwe guhinga, guhinga no kubaza mu gihe abakobwa bize ubudozi, gukaraba, amata n'imboga, ndetse n'amahugurwa ya serivisi zo mu rugo. Hamwe nubu buhanga, twizeraga ko abagororwa bari kwibeshaho nibarekurwa bafite imyaka cumi nirindwi
Amahugurwa yagize indi ntego nayo, kubera ko Inama y'Ubutegetsi yakunze kwerekana icyifuzo giteye isoni cyo gusaba ubuhungiro kwibeshaho. Ibyinshi mu biryo byakuze cyangwa byororerwa mu murima ukikije kandi hafi imyenda yose hamwe nimyenda yo kumeza byakozwe nabakobwa. Imyenda yose hamwe nogukora isuku byakozwe nabagororwa ndetse nakazi kabo ndetse gakoreshwa mugihe cyo gucukura inyubako nshya mumwaka wa 1892 na 1900.Umurima wakomeje gukora kugeza muri za 1960.
Mu 1900, Inama y'Ubutegetsi yasabye ko hubakwa ishuri ryihariye ry '"ibara ry’ibara rifite intege nke" ndetse n’inyubako y’inyongera ku bana b'igicuri. Ibyiringiro byanyuma byagezweho mugihe Thom Cottage yubatswe mu 1896 binyuze mubuterankunga. Ikindi cyizere cyagaragaye igihe mu 1894 na 1907 Inteko ishinga amategeko ya Maryland yemeje umushinga w'itegeko ryo kwimurira abarwayi bose b'abasazi kandi bafite ibitekerezo bidafite imbaraga kuva mu nyubako z’intara mu bigo bya Leta. Mugihe ibi byateje igitutu ku gihingwa gifatika kuri Rosewood, cyanatumye inkunga ya leta ikomeza.
Kuva mu 1911 kugeza 1933, abarwayi 166, cyane cyane abagore n’abakobwa, basize Rosewood munsi yanditswe na habeas corpus; bakorewe icuruzwa ryabantu, ryaguzwe nabakire nkabakozi batewe inkunga nabakozi badahembwa, bakunze kuvurwa kandi akenshi bagatereranwa n "abarezi babo." Leo Kanner yamaganye aya mahano imbere y’ishyirahamwe ry’abanyamerika ryita ku barwayi bo mu mutwe mu 1937.
Filime ishimishije ya 2017 "Ikigo" gishingiye kubigo bya Rosewood. Filime yavuzwe nabayikora kugirango bashingire kubyabaye.

Imikino y’Igihugu y’Abatumva y’Ubushuhe ya 1989, izwi ku izina rya 16 ry’abatumva mu birori, ni imikino mpuzamahanga ya siporo myinshi yabaye kuva ku wa 7 kugeza ku wa 17 Mutarama 1989 muri Parike y’umwamikazi Elizabeth II i Christchurch, muri Nouvelle-Zélande.

Ubushakashatsi bwo kutumva mu Bwongereza (The Hearing Research Trust) bwari bumwe mu buyobozi bukomeye bw’ubushakashatsi bw’ubuvuzi bw’Abongereza bukora mu rwego rwo kutumva. Ibikorwa byayo byingenzi ni ubushakashatsi bw'ubuvuzi n'uburezi.
Yashinzwe mu Gutsinda Ubumuga bwo kutumva mu 1985 n’umudepite w’Ubwongereza witwaga Jack Ashley n’umugore we Pauline.
Yabaye igice cy'urukundo Igikorwa cyo Gutakaza Kumva muri 2013.

Walter E. Fernald giteza imbere, nicyo kigo cya kera byatewe inkunga na leta bikorera ababana. Ku buyobozi bwa gatatu, Walter Fernald, byabaye icyitegererezo ku bigo bya Leta ku bamugaye mu iterambere. Nyuma niho habaye mu kinyejana cya 20. Iperereza kuri ubu bushakashatsi ryatumye amabwiriza mashya yerekeye ubushakashatsi bwabantu mu bana.
Ishuri rifite umutungo uri kumuhanda wa Trapelo muri.
Ikigo cya Fernald, ubusanzwe cyiswe Ishuri Rikuru ryigisha kwigisha no guhugura abana ba Idiotic, ryashinzwe i Boston n’umuvugurura mu 1848 hamwe n’amadolari 2,500 yatanzwe n’inteko ishinga amategeko ya Massachusetts. Ishuri ryagiye buhoro buhoro ryimukira ahitwa Waltham hagati ya 1888 na 1891. Amaherezo ryarimo inyubako 72 kuri. Igihe cyo hejuru, ishuri ryafunze abantu bagera ku 2500, abenshi muri bo bakaba ari "abahungu batagira ubwenge ".
Ubushakashatsi bwubuvuzi bwa kirimbuzi mubana.
Ishuri rya Fernald niryo ryakorewe ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na 1946–53 bwakozwe na kaminuza ya Harvard na MIT bwerekanaga abana bato b'abahungu kwanduza dosiye ya isotopi ya radio. Inyandiko zabonetse mu 1994 n’ishami ry’ingufu muri Amerika zagaragaje ibisobanuro bikurikira:

Deafnet (cyangwa DEAFNET) yashizweho nkumushinga wo kwerekana mu 1978 na SRI International (yahoze yitwa Stanford Research Institute) muri kaminuza ya Gallaudet ya Washington kubatumva. Yatewe inkunga n’ishami ry’ubuzima, uburezi, n’imibereho myiza y’Amerika kugira ngo yerekane ibyiza bya e-mail ku batumva.
Deafnet yari yo yabayeho bwa mbere mu gukoresha koko icyuma cy’itumanaho cyabugenewe ku batumva. Deafnet yatanze uburyo ku bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, abafite imiyoboro y’itumanaho yari yaragabanijwe, bwo kuganira no kungukira mu muryango mushya w’itumanaho. Deafnet yashyizweho nka Sisitemu ya Mudasobwa, ikomatanya ibikoresho byagenewe abakoresha bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva hamwe na terminal zisanzwe za mudasobwa. DEAFNET yanashyizeho kandi uburyo bwo kuganira mu gihe nyacyo (‘real-time chat’) aho abakoresha bashoboraga kuganira ako kanya bakoresheje inyandiko.
Ibikoresho bisanzwe byakoreshwaga byari bigizwe na terminal ya Zenith ZT-1, Superphone (terminal ifite coupler yubatse imbere yemera guhuza na Baudot cyangwa ASCII ndetse ifite buffer y’inyuguti 1000), hamwe na printer ya Epson. Igikoresho cya Superphone cyagurishwaga ku $495 mu mwaka wa 1981.
DEAFNET yafatwa nk’uburyo bwiza bwo kugabanya ikiguzi mu itumanaho ku batumva, ariko itangira ry’ama-terminal akorana na ASCII ndetse na Internet nyuma yaho byasimbuje icyo gikeneye.

Florida yandika abasemuzi batumva (FRID) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu ugamije gufasha abasemuzi kubatumva kandi bafite ikibazo cyo kutumva baba muri leta ya Florida. FRID ni leta ifatanya na rejisitiri yabasobanuzi kubatumva. FRID ifite abanyamuryango barenga 950 guhera 2009.
Sisitemu yo Kugenzura Ubwiza bwa Floride.
"Sisitemu yo Kugenzura Ireme ry’Ubunyamwuga muri Florida (Florida Quality Assurance Screening System) iyoborwa na FRID igamije gukora isuzuma ry’" abasobanurira abatumva bakoresha ururimi rw’amaboko muri Florida. Isuzuma rigabanyijemo ibice bibiri: Icyanditse (Written) na Icyerekanwa mu bikorwa (Performance). Florida Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (FRID) ntikigikora isuzuma ry’ireme ry’ubunyamwuga ryo mu gihugu imbere (in-state quality assurance screenings) kubera amasezerano bagiranye na Registry of Interpreters of the Deaf (RID).
Isuzuma ryabasobanuzi ba Florida.
"Isuzuma ry’Abasobanurira mu Mashuri rya Florida (Florida Educational Interpreter Evaluation) riyoborwa na FRID rigamije gukora isuzuma ry’abasobanurira abatumva bakoresha ururimi rw’amaboko muri Florida bakorera mu mashuri y’incuke kugeza ku mwaka wa 12 (K–12). Isuzuma rigabanyijemo ibice bitatu: Icyanditse (Written), Ikiganiro (Interview), n’Icyerekanwa mu bikorwa (Performance)."
"Florida Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (FRID) ntikigikora isuzuma ry’abasobanurira mu mashuri ryo mu gihugu imbere (in-state educational interpreter screenings) kubera amasezerano bagiranye na Registry of Interpreters of the Deaf (RID)."

Isuzuma rigabanyijemo ibice bitatu: Icyanditse (Written), Ikiganiro (Interview), n’Icyerekanwa mu bikorwa (Performance)."
"Florida Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (FRID) ntikigikora isuzuma ry’abasobanurira mu mashuri ryo mu gihugu imbere (in-state educational interpreter screenings) kubera amasezerano bagiranye na Registry of Interpreters of the Deaf (RID)."

Abacuruzi batumva; ni abatumva bagurisha ku makarita manini y’inyuguti rusange, mfunguzo, imashini zometseho imisumari, kereyo n'amakaramu, ibendera ry’igihugu, cyangwa inyemezabwishyu ku buryo butandukanye, bakaba baracapuye ubwabo. Muri uku gucuruza, abagurisha bavuga ko batumva, gukoresha cyangwa gushyira igitutu ku baguzi. Bamwe mu bacuruza "] ["bahimba" ubumuga bwo kutumva kugira ngo bashuke abantu.
Muri Amerika, Ishyirahamwe ry’abatumva ryakoze ubukangurambaga ku bacuruza batumva, hagamijwe kuzamura urwego rw’abatumva nk’abanyamerika babishoboye mu mubiri no mu bitekerezo.

TASH ni ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryunganira ababana babana nubumuga, abo mu miryango yabo, abandi bunganira, n'abantu bakora mu rwego rw'abafite ubumuga. TASH ni uguteza imbere uruhare rw’abana n’abakuze bafite ubumuga bukomeye mu bice byose bigize umuryango wabo, no gukuraho akarengane k’abaturage kagabanya uburenganzira bwa muntu. TASH ikora nkumuryango udaharanira inyungu 501 (c) (3). Ifite ibice, imiterere ya komite (urugero, gutura mu baturage, hamwe na komite ishinzwe imiturire) hamwe n’abanyamuryango mu bihugu 34 n’intara kandi ifite icyicaro gikuru kuri 2013 H Street NW, Suite 715, Washington, DC 20006.
TASH yashinzwe mu 1975 ku izina rya "Ishyirahamwe ry’Abanyamerika rishinzwe uburezi bw’abafite ubumuga bukomeye / bafite ubumuga bukomeye" ("AAESPH"). Izina ryahinduwe ryitwa "Ishyirahamwe ry’abafite ubumuga bukomeye" (TASH) mu 1980, ryongera kwitwa Ishyirahamwe ry’abantu bafite ubumuga bukomeye mu 1983. Mu 1995, inama y’ubuyobozi yafashe icyemezo cyo kureka iryo zina, kubera ko ridahuye n’indangagaciro zigezweho. Izina TASH riracyakoreshwa kubera kumenyekana kwayo kwinshi.

Edward Verne Roberts (23 Mutarama 1939 - 14 Werurwe 1995) yari umunyamerika uharanira inyungu. Niwe muntu wa mbere ukoresha igare ry’ibimuga yize muri. Yari umuyobozi wambere wumuryango uharanira uburenganzira bwabafite ubumuga.
Roberts yanduye indwara y’igicuri afite imyaka cumi nine mu 1953, imyaka ibiri mbere yuko urukingo rwa Salk rurangiza iki cyorezo. Yamaze amezi mu bitaro asubira mu rugo amugaye kuva ku ijosi hasi usibye intoki ebyiri ku kuboko kumwe n'amano menshi. Yararaga mu bihaha by'icyuma nijoro kandi akenshi yaruhukiraga ku manywa. Iyo avuye mu bihaha yarokotse " guhumeka ibikeri," tekinike yo guhatira umwuka mu bihaha ukoresheje imitsi yo mu maso no mu ijosi.
Ed Roberts yashakanye na Catherine Dugan mu 1976, ariko bombi baratandukana mu 1982. Basangiye kurera umuhungu wabo Lee.

Patrisha Wright numunyamerika uharanira uburenganzira bwababana n'ubumuga. Ni impumyi byemewe n'amategeko. Yagize uruhare runini mu gushyiraho.
Yari mu cyicaro cya San Francisco kugira ngo ashyigikire ingingo ya 504 y'itegeko ryerekeye gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe muri Mata 1977, nk'umufasha bwite wa Judy Heumann. Mu 1979, yashinze ikigega cy’uburenganzira n’ubumuga bw’ubumuga (DREDF) hamwe na Mary Lou Breslin na Robert Funk. Kuva 1979 kugeza 2005 yakoraga nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ibibazo bya DREDF. Yaharaniye ko hashyirwaho itegeko rirengera abana bafite ubumuga ryo mu 1986 no guhindura itegeko rigenga imiturire ryerekeye ababana n'ubumuga. impungenge z’ubumuga mu ihuriro ry’imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu bose bakoraga kugira ngo bemeze itegeko ryo gusubiza uburenganzira bwa muntu mu 1987.
Na none mu myaka ya za 1980, ubwo ubuyobozi bwa Reagan bwatinyaga guhindura cyangwa gukuraho amabwiriza ashyira mu bikorwa ingingo ya 504 y’itegeko ryita ku buzima busanzwe (Abanyamerika) ryo mu 1973 hamwe n’amategeko agenga uburezi bw’abana bose bafite ubumuga bwo mu 1975, Wright na Evan Kemp (wo mu kigo cy’uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga) bayoboye ubukangurambaga mu nzego z’ibanze no guharanira kurwanya aya makarita arenga 40.000. Mu 1984, ubuyobozi bwahagaritse kugerageza guhindura cyangwa gukuraho ayo mabwiriza; icyakora, barangije inyungu zubwiteganyirize bwibihumbi magana nabahawe ubumuga.

Henry Viscardi Jr. (1912-2004) yari umunyamerika uharanira uburenganzira bw’abafite ubumuga baharanira inyungu z’uburinganire n’akazi k’abafite ubumuga mu bakozi. Mu 1952, abifashijwemo na Eleanor Roosevelt, yashinze Ubushobozi Kugira ngo abana bafite ubumuga bafite amahirwe angana yo kwiga, yashinze ishuri ryita ku bakozi i Albertson, mu 1952, nyuma ryitwa ishuri rya Henry Viscardi mu cyubahiro. Yabaye umujyanama wa ba perezida benshi bo muri Amerika bazana impinduka nyinshi za politiki mu rwego rw’abafite ubumuga. Ni n'umwanditsi w'igitabo "Duhe ibikoresho". Mu cyubahiro cye, ikigo cya Viscardi mu 2013 cyatangije ibihembo bya Henry Viscardi Achievement Awards kugira ngo bamenye kandi bamenye abayobozi b'intangarugero bo mu muryango w'abafite ubumuga.
