Belarus ntirarushanwa mu mikino yo kutumva.

Zaruhi Valeriani Batoyan (Armenian ; wavutse 29 Nzeri 1979), ni umunyapolitiki wo muri Arumeniya, umunyamakuru uharanira uburenganzira bwababana n'ubumuga yahoze ari Minisitiri w’umurimo n’imibereho myiza muri guverinoma ya kabiri ya Pashinyan.
Zaruhi Batoyan yavutse 1979 muri Yerevan. Mu 2008, yarangije mu ishami ry'itangazamakuru muri. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yitabiriye gahunda y’amahugurwa y’abagore bashinzwe kuyobora n’ubumuga (WILD) yatanzwe na Mobility International USA muri
Ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2016, yatorewe kuba umwe mu bagize Inama y’ishyaka rya sosiyete sivile. Muri 2017 yatorewe kuba umunyamuryango w’inama y’abasaza ya Yerevan for Way Out Alliance. Ku Kamena 2018, yagizwe Minisitiri wungirije w’umurimo n’imibereho myiza [ya 18 Mutarama 2019. Ni umukoresha w’ibimuga.

Burezili yitabiriye imikino y’abatumva ku nshuro ya mbere mu 1993. Guhera icyo gihe, Brezile yagiye itabira Deaflympics kenshi. Burezili yatsindiye igihembo cyayo cya mbere mu mikino y'abatumva mu mwaka wa 2009. Brezile kandi yitabiriye Imikino y’Abatumva y’Ubukonje bwa mbere mu mikino yo mu mwaka wa 2019 yabereye muri Sondrio Province, mu Butaliyani.

Robert Sampson (4 Werurwe 1925 - 3 Ukuboza 2006) yari visi perezida muri. Yasuzumwe indwara ya afite imyaka 5, kandi akoresha igare ubuzima bwe bwose.
Sampson, umunyamategeko, yari umwunganira abamugaye. Yakoreye Komisiyo ya Perezida ishinzwe umurimo w'abafite ubumuga iyobowe na ba perezida batanu b'Abanyamerika. Imbaraga ze zamufashije kuganisha ku myubakire mu kugera ku bamugaye, nk'ibimuga by'ibimuga.
Sampson yafatanije na gukusanya amafaranga yo kuvura indwara y'imitsi., umurizo numero N116UA, bamwitiriwe.

Muri uquateur bwa mbere yitabiriye imikino ya abatumva ku nshuro ya mbere mu 2013 ndetse akomeza no kwitabira imikino y’Abatumva y’Ubushuhe ya 2017, yegukana umudari wa silver muri 2017.
Ecuador itaritabira imikino y'ubumuga bwo kutumva.

Lauren Weibert (yavutse ku ya 17 Kamena mu 1988) ni umunyamerika utumva urubura. Yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Deaflympique ya 2015 amarushanwa ya shelegi y'abagore bafite ubumuga. wa zahabu mu birori byo gusiganwa ku maguru mu bagore ndetse na feza mu birori byo kwambuka urubura.] ​
Yemerewe kandi guhagararira Amerika mu mikino Olempike yo mu mwaka wa 2011, ariko amaherezo ibirori byaje guhagarikwa kubera ibirego bya ruswa byashinjwaga umuyobozi wa siporo w’ababana n'ubumuga bwo kutumva bo muri Silovakiya bigatuma habaho kunanirwa mu muteguro.

Uzubekisitani yitabiriye imikino yo kutumva kuva mu 1997. Uzubekisitani yatsindiye umudari wa mbere w’abatumva mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2009 yabereye i Taekwondo, ari nawo mudari wabo rukumbi mu mateka bafite mukiciro cyabafite ubumuga bwo y’abatumva.

Indorerwamo ni icyuma cyangwa igikoresho gikoreshwa mu kugaragaza ishusho y'abantu cyangwa ibintu.
Indorerwamo ya mbere yageze mu Rwanda mu 1986,uruganda rwa mbere rwazitunganyije rwitwa Anik Industries.

Treasures of Ikoro Restaurant, iherereye Kimihurura mu mujyi wa Kigali, izwi cyane kubera imiterere yayo idasanzwe ikoresha ibikoresho by’umwimerere nk’amabuye ya lava azwi mu Kinyarwanda nka amakoro. Uru rugo rw’ubucuruzi rwubakiye ku ndangagaciro zo guhuza ikoranabuhanga rigezweho n’umuco nyarwanda, binyuze mu gukoresha ibikoresho by’umutungo kamere.Amabuye ya lava aboneka cyane mu majyaruguru ya Rwanda, hafi y’imisozi y’ibirunga, akaba yarakunze gukoreshwa mu bwubatsi bwa kera kubera imbaraga n’ubwiza bwayo.Ubu, ikoreshwa ryayo rigaragara nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubwubatsi burengera ibidukikije no kubungabunga umuco.
Amateka y’Amakoro mu Muco Nyarwanda.
Mu turere tw’amajyaruguru y’igihugu, cyane cyane hafi y’Ibirunga bya Virunga, amakoro amaze imyaka myinshi akoreshwa mu bwubatsi bw’amazu, insengero, n’ibindi bikorwa by’umuco. Aya mabuye agaragazwa n’imiterere ifite utwenge twinshi n’amabara y’isi, asobanura imbaraga no guhangana n’ibihe.Mu muco wa kera, gukoresha amakoro byafatwaga nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubukorikori n’imbaraga z’abanyarwanda mu kubaka. Ubu noneho, mu bwubatsi bugezweho, akomeza gukoreshwa mu buryo bushimangira isano hagati y’ibikorwa by’abantu n’ubutaka bubatunze.
Imiterere n’Igishushanyo muri Treasures of Ikoro.
Muri Treasures of Ikoro, amakoro si ishusho gusa ni igice cy’ingenzi cy’ubuzima n’umwuka wa resitora. Imiyaga, inzira, n’ameza byubatswe cyangwa byambitswe amakoro, bitanga itoto n’ituze mu mwanya wose.Itara ryoroheje rikubita ku buso bw’amabuye, ritanga umucyo n’ubushyuhe byumvikana n’umwuka karemano w’ahantu. Ibi byose bigaragaza uburyo bwo guhanga inyubako zitajegajega ku ndangagaciro zo kubungabunga ibidukikije.
Umuco n’Imikino Igisoro mu Mugususurutsa Abashyitsi.
Treasures of Ikoro kandi ishimangira umuco w’imikino y’Abanyarwanda nka Igisoro. amwe mu meza ahari yakozwe mu buryo bushya, yifiteho ikibuga cy gukinira igisoro, aho abashyitsi bashobora gukina mu buryo bushimishije mu gihe bari ku meza baryoshywa n’amafunguro.Ibi byahinduye amafunguro si ukwiyumvamo ibyokurya gusa, ahubwo byabaye uburyo bwo gusabana no gusangira umuco n’inshuti.
Kurengera Ibidukikije n’Ikoreshwa Rirambye.
Gukoresha amabuye ya lava muri Treasures of Ikoro ni igikorwa cy’ubwubatsi burengera ibidukikije. Amabuye akurwaho mu buryo butabangamira ubutaka, hagamijwe kubungabunga aho aturuka. Ibi bihura n’icyerekezo cya Leta y’u Rwanda mu guteza imbere ubwubatsi burambye, nk’uko biteganywa muri Green Building Minimum Compliance System na Vision 2050 by’Igihugu. Uyu murongo w’ubwubatsi uhuza iterambere ry’ubukungu n’ubusugire bw’ibidukikije.
Ibituma Abashyitsi bahakunda.
Uwo winjira muri Treasures of Ikoro ahora yumva ari hafi y’ibidukikije. Ubushegeshagi bw’amabuye, itara rituje, n’ubushyuhe bitanga amarangamutima y’ituze n’ubusabane n’ubuzima kamere.Ni ahantu hatanga uburambe bwo gusabana n’umutuzo, aho ubwiza n’ubwitonzi bigaragarira mu mico no mu bidukikije.
Ubusigire n’Icyo Byungura.
Treasures of Ikoro igaragaza icyitegererezo cy’uko umuco, ibidukikije n’ubucuruzi bishobora kubana mu buryo bwuzuzanya. Ibi byahinduye uburyo bwo kureba ubukorikori nyarwanda, bituma amabuye ya lava (amakoro) aba ikimenyetso cy’ubuhanzi, uburambe, n’umuco nyarwanda w’iki gihe.

AMIS (ubuhinzi) &lt;mark&gt;ni ishyirahamwe rishinzwe amakuru ajyanye n'ubuhinzi, ni urubuga n'ikoranabuhanga rihuza amakuru atandukanye ku bijyanye n'ubuhinzi no gutangaza amakuru ku bantu bose bari mu buhinzi&lt;/mark&gt;. Iryo shyirahamwe ryihariye kurusha izindi kuko rifungura amakuru y'ubuhinzi, ariko rikanatangaza amakuru yose bifuza kumenya ku buryo burambuye.Iryo shyirahamwe ryihariye kurusha izindi kuko rifungura amakuru y'ubuhinzi, ariko rikanatangaza amakuru yose bifuza kumenya ku buryo burambuye.

Alma Woodsey Thomas (22 Nzeri 1891 - 24 Gashyantare 1978) yari umuhanzi n’umwalimu w’umunyafurika n’umunyamerika yaratuye kandi agakorera i Washington, DC, ubu akaba azwi nk’umunyamerika ukomeye w’umuhazi mubyo gusiga amarangi wo mu kinyejana cya 20. Niwe mugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika akaba n’umunyamerika winjijwe krurtonde rwi cyegeranyo cy’ubuhanzi bwo gusiga amarangi gihoraho mubiro bya reta zunze ubumwe bwa amerika buzwi nka white house. Thomas azwi cyane kubera ubuhanga bwe mugukora ibihangano by'amashusho y'amabara, ndetse yatangiye no gukora ibihangano byamashusho adasobanutse ariko arimo ubuhanga, yayakoze nyuma yo kujya mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru cy'imyaka 35 yigisha ibihangano mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Shaw Junior rya Washington.
Thomas, usanzwe ufatwa nk'umunyamuryango w’ishuri ry’ubuhanzi rya Washington Color school Art ariko ubundi agashyirwa mu majwi na bamwe nkumuhanzi wumuhanga mubyo gukurura amarangamutima y'abantu / cyangwa nkumwirabura wambere ubayeho wabayeho uzi kuvanga amarangi bikurura amarangamutima y'abantu, yabonye impamyabumenyi ye yo kwigisha yakuye muri kaminuza y’akarere ka Columbiya (izwi ku izina rya Miner Normal School icyo gihe). Yabaye uwa mberewabonye impamyabumenyi mu ishami ry’ubuhanzi rya kaminuza ya Howard, kandi akomeza umubano mwiza niyo kaminuza mu buzima bwe. Yageze ku ntsinzi nkumuhanzi wumugore wumunyafurika n’umunyamerika nubwo amacakubiri n’urwikekwe byariho icyogihe.
Thomas yamenyekanye cyane nyma y'urupfu rwe. Igishushanyo cye cyerekanwe mu ngoro ndangamurage no mu byegeranyo kandi byagiye byibandwaho mu bitabo byinshi ndetse n’imurikagurisha ry’umurage wubuhanzi bwo gushushanya. Inzu Ndangamurage y'Abanyamerika ya Smithsonian ikomeza gukusanya ibikorwa bye kwisi hose. Mu 2021, inzu ndangamurage yagurishije ishusho ya Thomas "Alma's Flower Garden" mu bucuruzi bwihariye ku madolari 2.8 miliyoni.
Ubwana, uburezi, n'imyanya yo kwigisha akiri muto..
Alma Thomas yavutse ku ya 22 Nzeri 1891, avukira i Columbus, Jeworujiya, avuka ariwe mukobwa mukuru(ari imfura) mu bakobwa bane, se yitwa John Harris Thomas, umucuruzi, na Nyina Amelia Cantey Thomas, wari umuhanzi mugushushanya no kudoda imyenda. Nyina na nyirasenge, nyuma baje kwandikwa nk'abarimu ndetse n’abanyeshuri barangije muri Tuskegee.Yagaragaje ubuhanga akiri umwana, nubwo umwuga we wubuhanzi yawutangiye nyuma amaze gukura. Igihe Tomasi yari amaze gukura, yerekanaga ubuhanga bwe mu buhanzi, kandi yishimira gukora uduce duto duto duto nk'ibipupe, ibishushanyo n'amasahani abumbye, cyane cyane mu ibumba ku mugezi wari uri inyuma y'iwabo. Nubwo yari ashishikajwe n’ubuhanzi, Thomas "ntiyari yemerewe" kujya mu nzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi akiri umwana. Yahawe amasomo yumuziki, kuko nyina yacurangaga inanga.
Mu 1907, igihe Thomas yari afite imyaka 16, umuryango we wimukiye mu gace ka Logan Circle gaherereye i Washington, DC Mu gusobanura uko umuryango wimutse, nyuma yaranditse ati: "Ndangije amashuri yisumbuye i Columbus, nta hantu na hamwe nashoboraga gukomereza amashuri yanjye, bityo ababyeyi banjye bahitamo kwimurira umuryango i Washington.": 3 Tomasi yashoboye kandi kubona uko ajya mu masomero y'i Washington, bitandukanye na Columbus. ": 3 Ababyeyi be bafashe iki cyemezo nubwo byamanuye umuryango mu mibereho no mubukungu, bituma bava mumubare wabari mucyiciro cya kabiri cy'ubukungu bari bafite bakiba muri Jeworujiya. Abandi banditsi bagaragaje ko imvururu z’amoko ya Atlanta n'ubwicanyi bushingiye ku moko bwo mu 1906 ari impamvu zishobora kuba zaratumye bava muri Jeworujiya. [3] Urundi rugero rw’ihohoterwa rishingiye ku moko umuryango we wahuye naryo muri Jeworujiya, ise wa Alma yahuye n’agatsiko ka lynch mbere gato yuko Alma avuka, umuryango we wavuze ko kutumva kwe kwatewe n'imirwano yagiranye nabari bagize ako gatsiko. Nubwo byari bitandukanye, umurwa mukuru w’igihugu wari uzwiho guha amahirwe Abirabura benshi kurusha indi mijyi myinshi. Nkuko yabyanditse mu myaka ya za 70, "Nibura amasomero ya Washington yakinguriwe nabanyafrika cyangwa abirabura bari barahawe izina rya Negro, mu gihe Columbus yo yari yarakumiriye abirabura(Negro) mu isomero ryayo." [4] I Washington, Thomas yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya tekinike rya Armstrong, aho yakuye umwanya wa mbere mu masomo y’ubuhanzi. [3] Kuri bo, yagize ati "Ninjiye mu cyumba cy'ubuhanzi, byari nko kwinjira mu ijuru... Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Armstrong ryashizeho urufatiro rw'ubuzima bwanjye." Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yari umuhanga mu mibare na siyansi, kandi ubwubatsi bwibihangano bwaramushishikazaga cyane. Ibikorwa bye by'ubuhanzi yakoreye i Armstrong byerekanwe muri Smithsonian mu 1912. ["citation ikenewe"]
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye ya Armstrong ": 4 mu 1911, yize amashuri yakaminuza mu ishuri risanzwe rya Miner (ubu rizwi nka kaminuza y'akarere ka Columbiya), ahabwa impamyabumenyi yo kwigisha mu 1913. [3]: 19 Mu 1914, yabonye umwanya wo kwigisha mu mashuri ya Princess Anne ku nkombe y'Iburasirazuba bwa Maryland, aho yigishije amezi ane. [3]: 19 Mu 1915, yatangiye kwigisha mw'ishuri ryari mu nzu ya Thomas Garrett i Wilmington, muri Delaware, kugeza mu 1921. [3]
Thomas yinjiye muri kaminuza ya Howard mu 1921, afite imyaka 30, yinjirira ku masomo yibanze kubera amahugurwa yabanjemo y'abarimu. Yatangiye ari umunyeshuri wiga ibijyanye n'ubukungu bwurugo, ateganya kuba inzobere mu gushushanya imyambarire, gusa nyuma aza guhindura ajya mu buhanzi bwubwiza. [3]: 19-20 Ubuhanzi bwe yibanze kuri Howard bwari ku gishushanyo; Romare Bearden na Henry Henderson bavuze ko amashusho yakoze mu gihe cyo kwiga kaminuza ari "amasomo kandi atamenyekanye." [13] Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Science mu buhanzi Bwiza mu 1924 yakuye muri Howard, abaye umunyeshuri wa mbere muri gahunda y’ubugeni bwa kaminuza. Hasabwe ko hashobora kuba umugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika-Umunyamerika cyangwa Umunyamerika wabonye impamyabumenyi y’ubuhanzi, [3] icyakora Mary Jane Patterson yakiriye impamyabumenyi ye, mu 1862, hashize imyaka 60 mbere.
In 1924, Thomas began teaching art at Shaw Junior High School, a Black school in the then-segregated public schools of Washington, D.C., where she worked until her retirement in 1960; she wrote, "I was there for thirty-five years and occupied the same classroom."[4]: 13  She taught alongside fellow artist Malkia Roberts.: 43  While at Shaw Junior High, she started a community arts program that encouraged student appreciation of fine art. The program supported marionette performances and the distribution of student designed holiday cards which were given to soldiers at the Tuskegee Veterans Administration Medical Center. Also, according to her reminiscences, "At Shaw, I organized the first art gallery in the D.C. public schools in 1938, securing paintings by outstanding Negro artists from the Howard Gallery of Art."[3]: 23 [4]: 4
Imyaka mirongo itatu nigice y’umwuga wa Tomasi wigisha, kuva 1924 kugeza 1960, bavuzwe na Thurlow Tibbs, umucuruzi w’ubuhanzi w’umunyafurika n’umunyamerika DC (n’umwuzukuru w’inshuti ya Tomasi Lillian Evans, umuririmbyi wa opera) nk '"igihe cyo gusembura;" [3] muri bo yakuyemo ibitekerezo byinshi ningaruka, hanyuma nyuma ya 1960 ahereye kuri ibyo bitekerezo n'ingaruka azarema ibihangano bye byihariye. Mu gihe yigishaga muri Shaw Junior High, Thomas yakomeje gukurikirana ibihangano bye, amashuri ye asanzwe kandi adasanzwe, ndetse n’ibikorwa yakoranye n’umuryango w’ubuhanzi wa Washington, DC, aba nyuma bakunze kubikora mu buryo bujyanye na kaminuza ya Howard.
Muri kiriya gihe, Thomas yashushanyije, cyane cyane mu mazi; mu gihe injyana ye mu myaka ya za 1930 yari ikiri "gakondo gakondo" kandi karemano, yiswe "amabara meza cyane." [13] Mu mpeshyi, yajyaga mu mujyi wa New York gusura ingoro ndangamurage z'ubuhanzi, harimo inzu ndangamurage ya Metropolitan, hamwe na galeries. [13]: 448
Mu mpeshyi yo mu 1930 kugeza 1934, yize muri kaminuza y’abarimu ya kaminuza ya Columbia, abona impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu bijyanye n’ubuhanzi mu 1934; ubushakashatsi bwe bwibanze ku bishushanyo, maze yandika igitabo cye ku ikoreshwa rya marionettes. [3]: 11,23  [13]
Mu ci ryo mu 1935, yize marionettes mu mujyi wa New York hamwe n’umupupe w’umudage w’umudage n’umunyamerika Tony Sarg, se w’ibikinisho bigezweho muri Amerika. [3]: 23
Mu 1936, yashinze umuryango witwa umushinga w’ishuri ry’ubuhanzi, kugira ngo uzane abana amahirwe y’ubuhanzi. [3]: 22  [4]
Mu 1943, Thomas yafashije James W. Herring, wahoze ari umwarimu muri Howard, na Alonzo J. Aden babonye ububiko bwa Barnett-Aden, ububiko bwa mbere bw’abirabura bwigenga bw’abirabura muri Amerika.: 2 Yabaye visi perezida mukuru. Kuba Thomas yarafatanije n’Ingoro ya Barnett-Aden byasobanuwe ko ari "ingenzi kuri" kandi, nk'uko byatangajwe n’umuyobozi ushinzwe amasomo, Adelyn Dohme Breeskin, iterambere rya "pivotal" mu iterambere rye nk’umuhanzi wabigize umwuga. "Byamuteye guhura n’abahanzi bakomeye bo mu gihugu cya none," byatumye arushaho kumenya ibijyanye n’ubuhanzi n’icyerekezo, "kandi bituma abahanzi [" bamurwanya kandi bamutera imbaraga. [13]
Mu myaka ya za 1940, Thomas yinjiye kandi mu muryango w’abahanzi ba Lois Mailou Jones, "Itsinda Rito rya Paris (cyangwa" Itsinda Rito rya Paris, "cyangwa" Itsinda rya Studio rya Paris ") Iri tsinda ry’abahanzi ba Black Washington ryashinzwe na Jones na Céline Marie Tabary, abahanzi ndetse n’abanyamuryango b’ishami ry’ubuhanzi rya kaminuza ya Howard (Jones kuva 1930 kugeza 1977, na Tabary guhera mu). "mu mpera za 1940," [3] 1945, 1946, cyangwa 1948. Yateranye haba buri cyumweru cyangwa kabiri mu cyumweru, [3] muri studio ya Jones, "Sitidiyo Nto ya Paris," mu rugo rwe kuri 1220 Quincy Street NE, mu gace ka Washington ka Brookland. Yabayeho. [3] Yahaye abahanzi bateye imbere amahirwe yo gushushanya kuri moderi, kunoza ubuhanga bwabo - "guteza imbere ubuhanga nuburyo," na "gutezimbere ubuhanga bwabo no kungurana ibitekerezo", kimwe na salon, cyangwa ihuriro ryibiganiro - "kuvuga kubyagezweho mubuhanzi bugezweho, cyane cyane ko byari bishingiye i Paris." Abandi bagize iryo tsinda usibye Jones na Tabary barimo Delilah Pierce na Thomas, ndetse na Bruce Brown, Ruth Brown, Richard Dempsey, Barbara Linger, Don Roberts, Desdemona Wade, Frank West, na Elizabeth Williamson. Ifoto, yo mu bubiko bwa Thomas, y’iteraniro ry’itsinda ryo mu 1948 ryerekana abahanzi cumi na batatu n’umunyamideli w’umugabo.
Mu 1958, Thomas yasuye ibigo by’ubuhanzi byo mu Burayi bw’iburengerazuba hamwe n’abanyeshuri ba kaminuza ya Temple mu ruzinduko runini rwateguwe n’iryo shuri ry’ubuhanzi rya Tyler. [3]: 25 [13]
Uruhare rwe mu itsinda rito rya Paris bivugwa ko rwashishikarije Thomas gushaka andi masomo muri kaminuza ya Amerika. Igitabo kimwe kivuga ko mu ntangiriro ya za 1950, "ishami ry’ubuhanzi rya AU ryafatwaga mu bice byinshi nk 'ishami ry’ubuhanzi rya avant-garde mu gihugu." Kubera iyo mpamvu, mu 1950, afite imyaka 59, yatangiye imyaka icumi yiga muri iyo kaminuza, yiga amasomo nijoro na wikendi, yiga ubuhanzi, harimo amateka yubuhanzi no gushushanya. [13]: 449  Muri kaminuza y'Abanyamerika yize gushushanya hamwe na Robert Franklin Gates na Ben "Joe" Summerford. Ariko Jacob Kainen yari umwarimu we ukomeye cyane, kandi yari kuba inshuti magara ubuzima bwe bwose. Igihe Thomas yigana na Kainen mu gatasi 1957, yamufata nk'umuhanzi mugenzi we aho kuba umunyeshuri. [3]: 11 Kainen yari yarahuye na Thomas mu 1934, mu nzu mberabyombi ya Barnet-Aden, maze mu 1957, yemera gutangira kwigisha icyiciro cya AU cy’umwaka wose cy’abanyeshuri batandatu batoranijwe bashushanyije, barimo na Thomas, ariko ubuyobozi bwemerera abanyeshuri 32, benshi muri bo bakaba batangiye, kwiga ishuri maze Kainen areka gucika intege nyuma ya manda imwe. [3]: 30
Igihe Thomas yatangiraga amasomo ye yisumbuye muri kaminuza y'Abanyamerika mu 1950, yari akiri amarangi y'ikigereranyo. Mu myaka ya za 1950, uburyo bwe bwahindutse muburyo butandukanye, kuva gushushanya kwishusho kugeza kubisimu no kwerekana imvugo idasobanutse, hamwe n "" urwibutso ", amashusho yijimye ahanini yambaye amajwi yubururu nubururu, atangira kwakira amabara meza yakoreshaga nyuma muburyo bwe bwo gusinya. [3]: 25, 30-31
" "Ubuhanzi bwo guhanga ni ubw'igihe cyose bityo bukaba butigenga ku gihe. Ni mu myaka yose, mu bihugu byose, kandi niba bivuze ko dushaka kuvuga umwuka wo guhanga umuntu ukora ishusho cyangwa igishusho uhuriweho n'isi yose y’umuco, utitaye ku myaka, ubwoko ndetse n'ubwenegihugu; aya magambo ashobora guhagarara nta nkomyi." " -Alma Thomas, 1970 Mu 1960, Thomas yavuye mu kwigisha maze aba umuhanzi wigihe cyose wabigize umwuga afite imyaka 68 cyangwa 69.
Mu myaka ya za 1960, yatangiye gukora amashusho y’amabara, ahumekewe nakazi k’ishuri rya New York na Abstract Expressionism.
Thomas yari azwiho gukorera muri sitidiyo y'urugo (icyumba gito cyo kubamo), akora ibishushanyo bye "asunika canvas ku bibero bye kandi abinganya na sofa." Yakoraga mu gikoni mu nzu ye, ahimba imirimo nka "Watusi (Hard Edge)" (1963), manipulation ya Cutis ya Matisse "The Snail", aho Thomas yahinduye imiterere ahindura amabara Matisse yakoresheje, maze ayita indirimbo ya Chubby Checker.
Mu buryo butandukanye n’abandi banyeshuri benshi bo mu ishuri ry’amabara rya Washington, ntabwo yakoresheje kaseti kugira ngo agaragaze imiterere y’amashusho ye. [13]: 451 Ubuhanga bwe bwarimo gushushanya imirongo yamakaramu yoroheje hejuru ya canvas kugirango akore imiterere nishusho, no kuzuza amarangi irangi nyuma. Imirongo yikaramu ye igaragara mubice byinshi yarangije, ntabwo yabisibye.
Ibikorwa bya Tomasi nyuma yizabukuru byari byibanze cyane kubitekerezo byamabara. Ibikorwa bye muri kiriya gihe byumvikanaga n’ibya Vasily Kandinsky (wari ushishikajwe n’ubushobozi bw’amarangamutima y’amabara) ndetse n’i Washington Color Field Painters, "ikintu cyamushimishije abamunenga... ariko nanone cyibajije ibibazo byerekeranye n '" umwirabura "mu gihe abahanzi bato bo muri Afurika n’Abanyamerika bakoraga ibikorwa byo kwigaragambya bishingiye ku moko." Yavuze ati: "Gukoresha ibara mu mashusho yanjye ni iby'ingenzi kuri njye. Nkoresheje ibara nagerageje kwibanda ku bwiza n'ibyishimo mu gishushanyo cyanjye aho kwibanda ku buntu bwa muntu ku muntu." [4] Yongeye kuvuga ku bijyanye no gukoresha ibara yagize ati: "Ibara ni ubuzima, kandi umucyo ni nyina w'amabara."
Imurikagurisha rye rya mbere ryasubiye mu 1966 (24 Mata - 17 Gicurasi) mu Ngoro y’ubuhanzi muri kaminuza ya Howard, ryateguwe n’amateka y’ubuhanzi James A. Porter. Harimo imirimo 34 kuva 1959 kugeza 1966. Kuri iri murika, yakoze "ibishushanyo mbonera by’isi", uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa byahumetswe na kamere, harimo "izuka" (1966), mu mwaka wa 2014 bikaba byari kugurwa mu cyegeranyo cya White House. Niwe mugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika-Umunyamerika winjijwe mu cyegeranyo cy’ubuhanzi gihoraho cya White House.
Tomasi n'umuhanzi Delilah Pierce, inshuti, bari gutwara imodoka mu cyaro aho Tomasi yashakishaga imbaraga, akuramo ibitekerezo ku ngaruka z'umucyo n'ikirere ku bidukikije. ["citation ikenewe"]
Kugira ngo duhangane n'ikibazo cyatewe na Howard show, nk'uko Romare Bearden na Henry Henderson babitangaza, uburyo bwe bwongeye guhinduka, mu buryo bw'ingenzi: "Tomasi yahinduye uburyo bwihariye ubu buzwi nk'umukono we - ukina ibara rirwanya ibara kandi hejuru y'ibara rifite ishusho ntoya, idasanzwe y'urukiramende rufite ibara ryinshi, akenshi rifite ibara ryinshi." [13] Iri murika ryakiriwe neza na Helen Hoffman mu kinyamakuru Washington Post cyo ku ya 4 Gicurasi 1966, cyiswe "ibara ryerekana amabara ryerekana umwuka we".
Ahumekewe n'ukwezi kugwa mu 1969, Alma Thomas yatangiye insanganyamatsiko ye ya kabiri y'ingenzi yo gushushanya. Urukurikirane "Umwanya, Snoopy" "nisi" byashyizwe mubikorwa pointillism. Yabyukije umwuka muburyo butandukanye cyane bwamabara nuburyo bwa mozayike, akoresha ubururu bwijimye bwijimye bwijimye kandi bwijimye bwa orange, agaragaza abstraction nubwiza butunguranye akoresheje ibara. Ibikorwa byinshi muriki ruhererekane bifite uruziga, rutambitse, na vertical verisiyo. Ibishushanyo birashobora kubyara ibyiyumvo byo kureremba. Ibishushanyo nabyo bitanga ingufu muri canvas. Itandukaniro ryamabara ritera ibara rikomeye, kandi rigumana imbaraga ziboneka.
Hagati ya 1967 na 1975, Thomas yahawe ibihembo byinshi n’ishimwe mu mashyirahamwe atandukanye y’ubuhanzi n’ingoro ndangamurage z’Abanyamerika. Mu 1967, Thomas yatsindiye icyubahiro mu imurikagurisha ry’umuryango w’abanyamerika bo muri Otirishiya hamwe n’ishusho ye "The Viennese Waltzes," nyuma mu 1972, afite imyaka 81, Thomas ni we mugore wa mbere w’umunyamerika w’umunyamerika wagize imurikagurisha wenyine mu nzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi ya Whitney. Nyuma yaho muri uwo mwaka, imurikagurisha rinini cyane ryabereye mu ngoro y’ubuhanzi ya Corcoran.: 452 Thomas yahakanye ibirango bamushyizeho nk'umuhanzi kandi ntiyemera inzitizi zose zibuza ibikorwa bye byo guhanga no gukora umwuga w'ubuhanzi, harimo n'irangamuntu ye nk'umwirabura. Yizeraga ko icy'ingenzi kuri we ari ugukomeza guhanga icyerekezo cye binyuze mu bihangano bye ndetse no mu isi y’ubuhanzi nubwo amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko. Thomas yari akivangura nkumuhanzi wigitsina gore wumwirabura kandi yanenzwe muburyo bwe budafatika butandukanye nabandi Banyamerika b'Abirabura bakoranye ibishushanyo n’ibimenyetso mu kurwanya igitugu. Ibikorwa bye byagaragaye hamwe nabandi bahanzi benshi b'Abanyafurika-Abanyamerika muri za galeries no kwerekana, nk'ububiko bwa mbere bufite abirabura mu Karere ka Columbiya.
Nyuma yo kwerekana muri Whitney, icyamamare cya Thomas mu muryango w’ubukorikori cyiza cyane. Kuba yaramenyekanye vuba aha byatewe ahanini na Robert Doty amushyigikiye mu majwi, kuko yateguye igitaramo cya Thomas's Whitney mu rwego rwo kwerekana imurikagurisha ry’abahanzi bo muri Afurika n’Abanyamerika, rigamije kwamagana ko badahagarariwe. Abanenga New York bashimishijwe nuburyo bwa kijyambere bwa Thomas, cyane cyane ko yari umukecuru wimyaka 80 mugihe yatangiraga igihugu. Ikinyamakuru New York Times cyasuzumye imurikagurisha rye inshuro enye, yita amashusho ye "gukuramo impuguke, tachiste mu buryo, nta makemwa mu gukoresha amabara Abazungu benshi bamunegura bamushimye nk "" Ikimenyetso cyabashushanyijeho amabara "kandi nk" "impano, abstractioniste ebullient". Filozofiya ya Alma Thomas yubuhanzi bwe nuko ibikorwa bye byuzuye imbaraga, kandi izo mbaraga ntizishobora gusenywa cyangwa kuremwa.
Ushinzwe gutunganya ibihangano bya New York akaba n'umwanditsi witwa Thomas B. Hess yaguze ishusho ya Tomasi yo mu 1972 ishushanya "Red Roses Sonata", maze mu 1976 umusingi w’umuryango we uha iki gitabo inzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi ya Metropolitan. [3]: 34 ]
Mary Beth Edelson ' Bamwe mu bahanzi b'Abanyamerika bazima / Ifunguro Ryera (1972) bakiriye "Ifunguro Ryera" rya Leonardo da Vinci, hamwe n'abayobozi b'abahanzi b'abagore bazwi bahurira hejuru y'imitwe ya Kristo n'intumwa ze; Alma Thomas yari muri abo bahanzi b'abagore bazwi. Iyi shusho, ivuga ku ruhare rw’amadini n’ubuhanzi amashusho y’amateka mu kugandukira abagore, yabaye "imwe mu mashusho agaragara y’ubuhanzi bw’umugore."
Thomas yabwiye "New York Times" mu 1977 ko "atigeze arongora umugabo ariko ibihangano byanjye. Ni uwuhe mugabo wigeze ashima ibyo nashakaga?" Yanditse ati: "Kera byavuzwe, ntupfe kugira" Miss "ku ibuye ryawe. Ndumva nishimiye cyane kuba narakomeje Miss wanjye. Ndavuga ko Miss uhagaze kuri Jackasses zose nabuze mu buzima." [4] Yongeyeho ati: "Umugabo mwiza ni umunezero, ariko ku bw'Imana ntukagwe na Jackass." [4] Yagize ubuzima busanzwe, hamwe ninshuti nyinshi zabahanzi. "Ntakunze kubura" inzu ndangamurage cyangwa imurikagurisha rifungura i Washington. [13]: 447
Thomas yabaga mu nzu imwe i Washington, ku muhanda wa 1530, 15, NW, ubuzima bwe bwose, kuva mu 1907 igihe umuryango we wimukiye muri Jeworujiya kugira ngo ashobore kwiga amashuri yisumbuye kugeza apfuye mu 1978 (usibye imyaka mike yari afite mu myaka 20 yakoraga ahandi). Murumuna we John Maurice Thomas, uzwi ku izina rya se kandi yari afite umwuga wo kuba isomero muri kaminuza ya Howard, yasangiye inzu na we. [4]: 7  Urwo rugo, ubu ruzwi ku izina rya Alma Thomas Inzu, rwubatswe ahagana mu 1875 kandi rushyirwa ku gitabo cy’igihugu cy’ahantu ndangamateka. Ku ya 26 Gicurasi 2025, Umuhanda hagati y’Itorero na Q wahinduwe Alma Thomas
Alma Thomas yapfuye ku ya 24 Gashyantare 1978, mu bitaro bya kaminuza ya Howard, nyuma yo kubagwa aortic.
Impapuro za Tomasi zatanzwe mu bihe byinshi hagati ya 1979 na 2004 muri Archives of Art Art y'Abanyamerika na mushiki we, J. Maurice Thomas.
Imiterere yubuhanzi.
Alma Thomas akazi ke kare kari guhagarariwe muburyo. Nkumwirabura, yibanze kumurimo we wo guhanga aho kwibanda kumoko cyangwa igitsina. Tomasi yizeraga ko guhanga bigomba kwigenga kuburinganire cyangwa ubwoko, guhanga imirimo yibanda kubwiza butunguranye no gukuramo ibara.
After further education at American University and influenced by James V. Herring and Lois Mailou Jones, her work became more abstract. Toward the end of her life, her style moved "to a color-filled, impastoed geometric abstraction of tessellated brushstroke patterns." These paintings have been compared to Byzantine mosaics and the pointillist paintings of Georges-Pierre Seurat. Thomas' style has qualities similar to West African paintings as well as Byzantine mosaics.
Ibara rye ryamazi hamwe namavuta yashizwemo no gukoresha (rimwe na rimwe kurengana) urukiramende rwamabara. Yakomeje gukoresha ubu buhanga mu mirimo ye, bwerekanaga amabara aboneka mu biti, indabyo, ubusitani, ndetse n’andi mashusho asanzwe. Igishushanyo cye "nimugoroba Glow" cyatewe ahanini n’uko Tomasi yashishikajwe n’amabara y’isi: "Igiti cyera hanze y’icyumba cye, cyashishikaje Tomasi ibishushanyo mbonera byakozwe n'amababi yacyo ku idirishya, kandi bifite ishusho y’urumuri n’igicucu hasi hasi no ku rukuta imbere mu rugo rwe." Amashusho ye yise 'Alma's Stripes', kubera ko ishusho yuzuye irangi yaremye urukiramende rurerure. Nyuma ibikorwa byahumetswe nubushakashatsi bwikirere hamwe nisi. Umutwe w'ishusho ye "ya Mars Dust" (1972) yerekanaga inkuru zamakuru yumuyaga wumukungugu kuri Mars. [4]: 33 .
Nyuma reaction, kwerekana, niterambere.
Umuhanga mu by'amateka y’ubuhanzi Richard J. Powell yanditse mu 1997 ku bijyanye n’umwanya wa Thomas na Sam Gilliam nk’abanyamuryango babiri bazwi cyane b’Abanyafurika-Abanyamerika bo mu Ishuri ry’amabara rya Washington, ati: "Mu gihe baganiraga n’ibikorwa by’abahanzi bagenzi babo bo mu Ishuri ry’amabara rya Washington (Gene Davis, Morris Louis, na Kenneth Noland), banabagejejeho, binyuze mu buryo bwa tekiniki kandi bwo mu rwego rwo hejuru bwo gusiga amarangi, ibyifuzo by’imibereho by’icyiciro rusange cya Washington DC." Yakomeje avuga ko mu myaka ya za 1960 Thomas "yateye umugongo" ku buryo yari asanzwe ahagarariye "umuryango w’ubuhanzi wa DC wabonaga ko ari ibitekerezo by’ibitekerezo," ashyigikira "uburyo budasubirwaho bwatewe n’ubuhinzi bw’imboga, inyigisho z’amabara ya siyansi, ndetse n’umuziki." Powell yavuze ko Tomasi yo mu 1976 "Azeleas Kuririmba no Kubyina Rock na Roll Music" ari "ubuhanga bwo kuganira inzira zinyerera hagati ya kamere na sosiyete," kandi "bikerekana uburyo bwo kwishyira hamwe kw'ibihe." Ikinyamakuru Washington Post cyamusobanuye ko ari "imbaraga mu ishuri ry’ibara rya Washington ".
Yanditse mu 1998, umuhanga mu by'amateka y’ubuhanzi Sharon Patton yavuze ko "Igitaramo cya Tomasi cyo mu 1973 cy’umuyaga na Crepe Myrtle" ari "kimwe mu bishushanyo mbonera bya Minimalist Color-Field byakozwe n’umuhanzi nyafurika w’umunyamerika."
Nubwo Thomas atabonye monografiya kugeza mu 1998 igihe inzu ndangamurage ya Fort Wayne yerekanaga ibyerekeranye n’umuhanzi, ubukererwe bw’abashakashatsi bwimbitse ntabwo bugaragaza umurage we n’ingaruka ku buhanzi bwa Visual. Jacob Kainen, umwarimu we muri kaminuza y'Abanyamerika mu gatasi 1957, [3] yemeza ko "Tomasi yagize uruhare runini mu iterambere ry’ibishushanyo mbonera mu kinyejana cya 20." Kainen yanditse mu gitabo cya Fort Wayne yerekana ko yahuye na Thomas mu 1943, mu birori byabereye mu nzu mberabyombi ya Barnett-Aden. [3]: 30 Kainen amwibuka muri kiriya gihe nk "" umugore muto, unanutse ufite ubwiza bwimyambarire, imyifatire ye ndetse no gushikama kudashidikanywaho byatumye ikibazo cy'ubunini bwe kidafite akamaro. " [3] Muri gahunda y’imyidagaduro y’ubuhanzi ya kaminuza ya Howard yo mu 1966 "Alma W. Thomas: Imurikagurisha ryisubiraho, 1959-1966," Kainen asobanura ko ari "Ikimenyetso cy’abashushanya amabara."
Mu mwaka wa 2009, amashusho abiri yakozwe na Thomas, harimo na "Watusi (Hard Edge)", yatowe na Madamu wa Perezida Michelle Obama, umushinga w'imbere mu nzu ya White House, Michael S. Smith (umushinga w'imbere), hamwe n'umuyobozi ushinzwe inzu ya White House, William Allman kugira ngo berekanwe muri White House mu gihe cya perezida Obama. "Watusi (Hard Edge)" yaje gukurwa muri White House kubera impungenge zatewe n'iki gice kibereye mu biro bya East Wing ya Michelle Obama. "Sky Light", yatanzwe na Hirshhorn Museum and Garden Sculpture, yamanitswe mu nzu bwite ya Obama.
Mu mwaka wa 2015, ikindi gishushanyo cye, "Izuka" (1966), cyamanitswe cyane mu cyumba cyo gusangiriramo umuryango wa Old House cyo muri White House, kikaba cyaraguzwe mu cyegeranyo cya White House mu 2014 hamwe n’amadorari 290.000 n’inkunga yatanzwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’amateka rya White House. Guhitamo mu cyegeranyo cya White House byasobanuwe nk'ikimenyetso cyiza ku butegetsi bwa Obama na Holland Cotter wanenze ibihangano "bya New York Times". Cotter yavuze ko umurimo wa Tomasi ari "kureba imbere nta gukabya; nyuma y'amoko ariko kandi ukunda amoko."
Mu mwaka wa 2016, imurikagurisha "Alma Thomas", ryasobanuwe mu bikoresho byamamaza ko ari "uburyo bwa mbere bwerekanwe ku bikorwa by’umuhanzi mu myaka igera kuri makumyabiri," kandi ko bugaragaza "ubwihindurize butandukanye bw’imirimo ya Tomasi kuva mu mpera za 1950 kugeza apfuye mu 1978" bwateguwe na The Frances Young Tang Teaching Museum and Art Gallery muri Skidmore College na Studio Museum i Harlem. Iri murika ryateguwe na Ian Berry, Umuyobozi wa Dayton w’Ingoro Ndangamurage ya Tang na Lauren Haynes, Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe amasomo, icyegeranyo gihoraho mu nzu ndangamurage ya Studio i Harlem kandi ashyigikiwe n’inshuti za Tang. Ibikoresho byamamaza imurikagurisha byagaragaje ko "ibihangano bya Tomasi, ibishushanyo mbonera by’ingufu ndetse no kwiyemeza kurangi byamuremye umurimo wihariye kandi udasanzwe." Bavuze kandi ko "ikubiyemo gake cyane amabara y’amazi n’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe hakiri kare." Iri murika ryagabanyijwemo ibice bine: Himura kuri Abstraction; Isi, Umwanya, hamwe nakazi katinze.
"Ikinyamakuru Wall Street Journal" cyamusobanuye mu mwaka wa 2016 nk'umuhanzi wahoze ari "umuhanzi udashimwa" uherutse kumenyekana kubera ibikorwa bye "exuberant", uzwi cyane ku buryo bwabo, injyana n'ibara.
Muri 2019, Tomasi yo mu 1970 yashushanyije "izuba rirenze" ryatejwe cyamunara mugurisha Christie. Yagurishijwe miliyoni 2.655.
Mu 2021, hashyizweho igiciro gishya cy’ibikorwa bya Tomasi igihe "ubusitani bw’indabyo bwa Alma", bwashushanywaga mu myaka ya 1968 kugeza mu 1970, bwateshejwe agaciro n’inzu ndangamurage y’ubuhanzi ya Greenville, yagurishije mu kugurisha ku giti cye n’umuguzi utamenyekanye ku madolari miliyoni 2.8. Inzu ndangamurage yari yaguze irangi mu 2008 ku madolari 135.000.
Ibikorwa bya Thomas byashyizwe mu imurikagurisha ryo mu 2021 "Abagore muri Abstraction" kuri Centre Pompidou.
Imurikagurisha ry’ubuhanzi bwe yise "Alma W. Thomas: Byose ni Byiza," ryateguwe n’inzu ndangamurage ya Chrysler i Norfolk, muri Virijiniya n’inzu ndangamurage ya Columbus i Columbus, Jeworujiya, yafunguwe ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2021, mu nzu ndangamurage ya Chrysler. Byari biteganijwe ko bizahakorera kugeza ku ya 3 Ukwakira 2021, nyuma yaho bikorera mu cyegeranyo cya Phillips i Washington, DC, mu mpeshyi 2021, inzu ndangamurage ya Frist i Nashville mu mpeshyi 2022, n'inzu ndangamurage ya Columbus mu mpeshyi 2022.
Inyandiko ngufi, "Miss Alma Thomas: Ubuzima mu Ibara", yashinzwe ku bufatanye n’imurikabikorwa. Iyobowe na Cheri Gaulke ikanakorwa na Jon Gann, yakinnye iserukiramuco rya firime zirenga 40 ku isi yose kandi yegukana ibihembo ndetse n'ibihembo.
Mu 2023, ibikorwa bye byashyizwe mu imurikagurisha "Igikorwa, Ibimenyetso, Irangi: Abahanzi b'Abagore na Global Abstraction 1940-1970" mu nzu mberabyombi ya Whitechapel i Londres.
Ibikorwa bigaragara mubyegeranyo rusange.
Alma Thomas Teen Umwanya muri Martin Luther King Jr. Urwibutso rwibutso rwitiriwe izina rye.

Celine Dion,ni umwana w'umuhererezi mu bana cumi na bane, yatangiye kubona ibihembo akiri muto mu ntara ye,mu gihugu kavukire cya Québec yatangiye gutsindira ibihembo byihuse ku ndirimbo ye ya mbere Ce n'était qu'un rêve muri alubumu y'indirimbo z'igifaransa yahimbye mu myaka ahagana 1980. izi ndirimbo zatumye arushaho gukundwa no kumenyekana mu gihe indirimbo yise "D'amour ou d'alliance" (1983)yarimbye bwa mbere mu gihugu cy'Ubufaransa yamuheshejekurushaho kumenyekana no kwamamara mu Bufaransa. Yakomeje kwamamara akimara gutsinda amarushanwa y'indirimbo za Eurovision mu 1988 aho yari ahagarariye igihugu cy' Ubusuwisi mu indirimbo ye yise" "Ne partez pas sans moi"."
Nyuma yize icyongereza, ahindura imyambarire maze asinyana amasezerano na Epic Records muri Amerika. MuriAlubumuye yo mu Cyongereza, "Unison", yasohotse mu 1990 maze imugaragaza nk'umuhanzi ukomeye wa pop mu masoko yo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru na Anglo-Saxon.
Mu myaka ya za 1990, yamenyekanye cyane ku isi, cyane cyane akora alubumu ebyiri ziza ku rutonde rw'izagurishijwe cyane mu mateka ya muzika:Alubumu "Falling into you" (1996) na "Let's Talk About Love" (1997), buri imwe yaycuruje kopi zirenga miliyoni 30 ku isi yose. S'il suffisait d'aimer" (1998).
Mu myaka ya za 2000, yamenyekanye cyane nk'umukinnyi w'umugore wa filimi, cyane cyane mu gitaramo "Umunsi mushya…" cyatangiwe i Las Vegas kuva 2003 kugeza 2007, kikaba ari cyo gitaramo cyinjije amafaranga menshi mu mateka hamwe na "Taking Chances World Tour" kuva 2008 kugeza 2009 cyabaye imwe mu ngendo zunguka cyane mu bihe byose.
Mu myaka ya za 2010, yongeye gutura i Las Vegas kuva mu 2011 kugeza 2019 kandi akora ibitaramo byinshi byo mu karere ku isi. Mu mwaka wa 2016, urupfu rw'umugabo we n'umuyobozi, René Angélil, wagize uruhare runini mu byiciro byose yatsindiye, byagaragaje impinduka mu mwuga we.
Umuziki wa Celine Dion ufasha abakunzi be mu ibintu bitandukanye, kuva R&amp;amp;B kugeza gospel kugeza kera kugeza pop. Yandika cyane cyane mu Gifaransa n'Icyongereza, ariko nanone rimwe na rimwe mu akandika muri Espagnol,Igitaliyani, Ikidage, Ikilatini, Ikiyapani na Mandarin, azwi cyane kandi azwi nk'umwe mu bantu bafite ijwi rikomeye muri muzika ya pop. Yakiriye ibihembo bitanu bya Grammy, harimo Album y'umwaka n'indirimbo y'umwaka, naho ibihembo bibiri bya Academy by'indirimbo y'umwimerere nziza byahawe indirimbo yakoze mu 2003, ihuriro mpuzamahanga ry’inganda za Fonografiya ryamuhesheje icyubahiro kubera kugurisha alubumu zirenga miliyoni 50 mu Burayi. Mu bihembo bya muzika ku isi 2007, yahawe "igihembo cya Legend" mu rwego rwo kumushimira « Gutsinda ku isi yose hamwe no guteza imbere ibikorwa bya muzika». Mu buryo nk'ubwo, yahawe "igihembo cya Billboard Icon Igihembo" cya Billboard Music Awards mu 2016 mu rwego rwo gushimira umwuga we wose.
Umuhanzi rukumbi wamamaye cyane mu mateka ya muzika muri Kanada mu mateka. Ni umwe mu bahanzi bagurishije Alubumu nyinshi cyane hamwe na miliyoni zirenga 200 zagurishijwe kwisi yose.

Inyamaswa ziba mu Rwanda no muri Afurika zasizwe imiti ngo zikomeze kugaragara mu mwimerere.
Muri afurika Museum harimo inyamaswa zigaraga mu isura ya nyayo aho zazizwe imiti ngo zitangirika, kuko zizanwa hashize igihe kirekire.
Muri izo Nyamaswa harimo Inzovu, Intare, Imvubu, Isatura, Agasumbashyamba, Ingugi, Imbogo, Igisamujyonjyo(Pangolin), Impala, Imparage, Inzoka, Ingona,Ingwe, Urusamagwe, Imbwebwe, Umuhari, Akanyamasyo ndetse n'izindi.
Akarusho ku muntu utarabona izo nyamaswa iyo azibonye asanga zifite umubiri wazo w'umwihariko, ubwoya ndetse n'ibindi bice bitigeze byangirika kubera zibitswe mu buryo bwa gihanga butuma zitangirika.
Izo nyamaswa zigaraga nuri iyo nzu ndangamurage harimo izakuwe mu Rwanda ndetse n'izakuwe mu bindi bice byo muri Afurika nka Tanzania, u Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Inzu ndangamurage ya Africa Museum iherereye mu nkengero z'umujyi wa Buruseli mu gace Tervuren ikaba iri mu nzu ndangamurage zikomeye ku isi, irimo ibisigaswa miliyoni 10 by'inyamaswa, amabuye y'agaciro ibihumbi 250, ibikoresho by'umuziki 8,000, ubushyinguro bw'amateka (Archives) 350, amakarita ibihumbi 20, ubwoko bunyuranye bw'ibiti ndetse n'ibikoresho bijyanye n'umuco karande.

Faith Ringgold (Faith Willi Jones ; Ku ya 8 Ukwakira 1930 - 13 Mata 2024) yari umwirabura w’umunyamerika akaba umwanditsi, umunyabugeni, umuhanzi ukora ibitaramo, akaba n'umurwanashyaka uhuza abantu, yari azwi nkumuntu uzi kuvuga neza imbwirwaruhame.
Ringgold yavukiye i Harlem, mu mujyi wa New York, kandi yabonye impamyabumenyi yicyiciro cyagatatu cya kaminuza yakuye muri City College ya New York. Yari umwarimu wubuhanzi muri sisitemu yishuri rusange rya New York City. Nkumuhanzi wa multimediya, ibihangano bye byasesenguye insanganyamatsiko yumuryango, ubwoko, icyiciro, nuburinganire. Urukurikirane rw"inkuru, byakozwe kuva mu myaka ya za 1980, byafashe ibyabaye ku Banyamerika b'Abirabura maze biba ibihangano bye byasinywe. Mu mwuga we, yazamuye ibikorwa by’abahanzi b'Abirabura maze arahaguruka arwanya guhezwa kwabo n’ingoro ndangamurage. Yanditse kandi ashushanya ibitabo birenga icumi byabana. Ubuhanzi bwa Ringgold bwerekanwe ku isi yose kandi buri mu byegeranyo bihoraho bya The Guggenheim, Inzu Ndangamurage y’Ubuhanzi ya Metropolitan, Inzu Ndangamurage y’Ubuhanzi n’ibishushanyo, inzu ndangamurage ya Philadelphia, n’ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya Schomburg mu muco w’abirabura.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Faith Willi Jones yavutse ari umuhererezi mu bana batatu ku ya 8 Ukwakira 1930, mu bitaro bya Harlem, mu mujyi wa New York.: 24 Ababyeyi be, Andrew Louis Jones na Willi Posey Jones, bakomokaga mu miryango y'abakozi bimuwe na Great Migration. Nyina wa Ringgold yari umunyamideli kandi se, ndetse no gukora imirimo itandukanye, yari umwanditsi w'inkuru. Bamurereye mubidukikije byamuteye gutangira kwiga guhanga. Nyuma ya Harlem Renaissance, inzu ya Ringgold akiri umwana i Harlem yakikijwe n’ubuhanzi butera imbere - aho abantu nka Duke Ellington na Langston Hughes babaga hafi aho.: 27 Inshuti ye yo mu bwana Sonny Rollins, wabaye umucuranzi ukomeye wa jazz, yakundaga gusura umuryango we kandi akitoza sakasofone mu birori byabo.: 28
Kubera indwara ya asima yari arwaye, Ringgold yakoze ubushakashatsi ku buhanzi bugaragara nk'imyidagaduro ikomeye abifashijwemo na nyina, akenshi yageragezaga na crayons akiri umukobwa muto.: 24 Yize kandi kudoda no gukora mu buryo bwa gihanga akoresheje imyenda ya nyina. ​: 24 Izi ngaruka zose hamwe, ibihangano bya Ringgold bizaza byatewe inkunga n'abantu cyane, imivugo, numuziki yakundaga kubikora mu bwana, nubwo ivanguramoko, ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina, n'amacakubiri byamucaga intege mubuzima bwe bwa buri munsi.: 9
Mu 1948, kubera igitutu cy’umuryango we, Ringgold yiyandikishije mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Umujyi wa New York yiga ibijyanye n’ubuhanzi, ariko ahatirwa kwiga ibijyanye n’ubuhanzi, kubera ko City College yemereraga abagore kwiyandikisha mu byiciro bimwe na bimwe.: 134 Mu 1950, yashakanye numuntu wakundaga gucuranga piano witwa Robert Earl Wallace babyarana abana babiri, Michele na Barbara Faith Wallace, mu 1952. Ringgold na Wallace batandukanye nyuma yimyaka ine kubera kunywa ibiyobyabwenge bya heroine.: 54 Hagati aho, yiganye n'abahanzi Robert Gwathmey na Yasuo Kuniyoshi. Yamenyekanye kandi n’umucapyi Robert Blackburn, bazafatanya gukurikiranya ibicapo nyuma yimyaka 30.: 29
Mu 1955, Ringgold yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri City College hanyuma bidatinze yigisha muri gahunda y’ishuri rusange rya New York City. Mu 1959, yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse yakuye muri City College yajyanye na nyina n’abakobwa be mu rugendo rwe rwa mbere mu Burayi. Igihe bari mu rugendo mu mahanga i Paris, Florence, na Roma, yasuye ingoro ndangamurage nyinshi, harimo na Louvre. Iyi ngoro ndangamurage yashishikarije urukurikirane rw'ibishushanyo bizwi ku izina "ry'Igifaransa" (1991–1997). Uru rugendo rwaciwe mu buryo butunguranye, ariko, kubera urupfu rwa murumuna we mu 1961. Ringgold, nyina n’abakobwa be bose basubiye muri Amerika kumushyingura.: 141 Yashakanye na Burdette Ringgold ku ya 19 Gicurasi 1962.
Ringgold yasuye Afurika y'Iburengerazuba inshuro ebyiri: rimwe mu 1976 na none mu 1977. Izi ngendo zagize uruhare runini mu gukora mask, gushushanya ibipupe, n'ibishusho.
Ibikorwa by'ubugeni.
Ubuhanzi bwa Ringgold bwari butandukanye cyane. Harimo gushushanya,kubihangano bikozwe mu bisigazwa bya palasitike, amabuye nibindi, gutunganya amashusho n'ibikorwa by'ubuhanzi no gutunganya ibitabo by'abana. Nkumwarimu, yigishije muri sisitemu yishuri rusange rya New York City ndetse no kurwego rwa kaminuza. Mu 1973, yaretse kwigisha ishuri rya Leta kugira ngo yitangire guhanga ibihangano igihe cyose. Mu 1995, yegerejwe na ACA Galleries kugirango abahagararire wenyine kandi yari ahagarariwe nabo ubuzima bwe bwose.

Paul Kagame arahirira kuyobora u Rwanda.
Kuri uyu wa 11 Kanama 2024 pereziida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame yarahiriye kongera kuyobora u Rwanda n'Abanyarwanda muri manda y'imyaka itanu, kongera gutorwa n'ibirori byo kurahira kwe, benshi babihuza n'ibimaze kugerwaho n'impinduka mu iterambere ry'impande zitandukanye z'Igihugu.
Uyu munsi Sitade Amahoro yakiriye ibirori byo kurahira kwe, ni gihamya cy'uko u Rwanda rumaze gutera imbere dore ko yavuguruwe ikuzuzra itwaye abarirwa muri Miliyali 200Frw.
Mu myaka 30 ishize Sitade Amahoro yari inkambi y'impunzi z'Abatutsi bari barahungiyemo, ariko uyu munsi ni ikimenyetso ntakuka cy'iterambere ry'u Rwanda, guhamya uko Igihugu cyiyubatse kandi kinatanga icyizere cyo gukomeza gutera imbere k'u Rwanda n'Abanyarwanda.
Kurahira kwa Perezida Kagame uyu munsi muri sitade Amahoro, bigaragaza indi sura nshya u Rwanda rwerekejemo mu ruhando mpuzamahanga ruyobowe na Perezida kagame. Mu ijambo yavuze nyuma yo kurahira, Perezida Kagame yatangaje ko iyi manda nshya ari iyo gukora cyane kugira ngo Abanyarwanda bagere ku bindi byinshi byiza mu myaka iri imbere.

Joseph van Vicker (yavutse ku ya 1 Kanama 1977), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Van Vicker, ni umukinnyi wa filme ukomoka muri Gana, akaba Umuyobozi wa filme akaba na Humanitarian. Niwe muyobozi mukuru (CEO) wa Sky + Orange production, inzu itunganya filme. Van Vicker yahataniye ibihembo bibiri aribyo "Umukinnyi mwiza" n' "Umukinnyi mwiza ukizamuka" mu bihembo bya yo muri 2008.
Vicker yavukiye mu mujyi wa Accra muri Gana ku mubyeyi umubyara nyina w'umunyagana na se Ise yaje gupfa afite imyaka itandatu gusa.
Vicker yize mu aho yiganye n'umukinnyi, Yarangirije muri mu mwaka wa 2021.
Vicker yashakanye na Adjoa ku wa 16 Ukwakira 2003. Igihe bizihizaga isabukuru y'imyaka 21 bamaranye bashakanye, yashimiye Imana ndetse anashimira umugore we kuba ahora amuba hafi.
Vicker yinjiye mu myidagaduro akora kuri radiyo nk'umunyamakuru yitwaga Groove yumvikanaga kuri 106.3 fm (1999-22000) n'iyitwa Vibe 91.9fm (2001–2004) ndetse aza gukora no kuri televiziyo yo muri Gana yitwa (1997–1999) &amp; Metro TV (2000–2004), Vicker yagaragaye muri televiziyo yo muri Gana "izuba" ryerekanaga ubuzima bwa kaminuza. Yakinnye imico ya LeRoy King Jr., umunyeshuri wubuhanzi Bwiza wavukiye muri Amerika ugeze muri Sun City kurangiza amashuri ye. Urukurikirane rwakoresheje ibice 10 byose.
Vicker yinjiye mu myidagaduro ahereye kuri radiyo nk'umunyamakuru yitwaga Groove yumvikanaga ku murongo wa 106.3 fm mu mwaka wa (1999 - 2000) akomereza kuri Vibe yumvikanaga kuri 91.9fm muri (2001–2004) ndetse aba n'umunyamakuru wa televiziyo yitwa muri (1997–1999) akora no kuri mu (2000–2004), Vicker yaje kugaragara muri filme y'uruhererekane yo muri Gana "yitwaga "Sun City"" yavugaga ku buzima bwo muri kaminuza. Yakinaga yitwa LeRoy King Jr umunyeshuri mwiza wiga iby'ubuhanzi wavukiye muri Amerika waje muri Sun City kurangiza amashuri ye. Iyi filme yagize ibice 10 byose.
Nyuma yaho Vicker yatorewe gukina muri filme yitwaga "Divine Love" nk'umukinnyi usanzwe. Iyi filme kandi yabaye imbarutso ku ma role y'abakinnyi bakomeye nka na bakinnyemo nk'Umuhungu n'Umukobwa bayoboye inkuru y'iyo filme.
Akenshi Vicker akunzwe gutoranywa nk'umukinnyi ukina role zo gukundana aho akinana na Jackie Appiah cyangwa ugasanga bakunze kumugereranya na mugenzi we wo muri Gana Majid Michel cyangwa wo muri Nigeriya.
Kumenyeka muri Nollywood.
Vicker yagaragaye muri filme nyinshi zakorewe muri aho yakinannye n'Abakinnyi bakomeye bo muri Nollywood, barimo nka,, ndetse na. Muri filme yakiniye muri Nollywood harimo nka "My Soul Mate", "Heart of Fire", "Popular King", "Gambling with Marriage", "Harvest of Love", "Stolen Will", "The Joy of a Prince", "Discovered", "The Kingdom" and "Against the law".
Kumenyekana ku rwego Mpuzamahanga.
Vicker yayoboye, akina kandi akora filme 5 abikoreye muri Sky + Orange Productions kuva mu 2008. Umwaka wa 2012 wabaye umwaka mwiza ku nzu ye ya production aho yatwaye ibihembo 2 kuva muri NAFCA icya Best Actor n'icya Director Awards abiheshejwe na filme ye "Joni Waka."
Vicker yahataniye ibihembo byinshi ndetse anatsindira byinshi kuva muri Africa kugeza muri. Ibihembo birimo nka, ACRAG Awards na Nollywood Academy Films Critics 'Awards.
Muri 2009 yatsindiye igihembo cya Best African Caribbean Actor na Best African American Actor naho muri 2011 yatsindiye icya the Pan African creative actor. Muri 2013 atsindira icya the Best International Actor award muri Papyrus Magazine Screen Actors Awards (PAMSAA) ya 2013 yabereye Abuja muri Nijeriya.

Umugenzo Nyarwanda wo kwitwaza Inkoni.
Mu muco n'amateka y'u Rwanda, habagamo imigenzo mikuru yabaga ari umuco karande ababakomokaho bazagenderaho ibihe byinshi. Muriyo migenzo, ntitwabura kuvuga k'umaze imyaka myinshi mu muco w'Abanyarwanda, ari wo wo kwitaza inkoni.
Kwitwaza inkoni, byari bimwe mu bigize imigenzo myinshi y'Abanyarwanda, yaba abakiri bato n,abakuru, abayobozi n'abayoborwa.
Impamvu nyamukuru zatumaga Abanyarwanda bo hambere bitwaza inkoni:
Kwirinda no Kwitabara.
Kera u Rwanda rukiri amashyamba ya cyimeza, rwari rurimo inyamaswa nyinshi z'inkazi n'ibikururuka bitagira ingano. Ibyo byatumaga Abanyarwanda, bahora bitwaje inkoni, kugira ngo mu gihe bahuye n'inyamaswa iyo ari yo yose yabasagarira babashe kwitabara. Iyo bahuraga n'inzoka, inkoni babaga bitwaje, ni yo yabibafashagamo kugira ngo babashe kuyica, itabangiza.
Inkoni nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubushumba.
Abanyarwanda bitwazaga inkoni nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubuyobozi n'ubushumba bw'abo bashumbye cyangwa se bashinzwe kubungabunga umutekano wa bo. Iteka ryose, wasangaga abami, abatware b'umwami n'abatware b'imiryango, bakunze kwitwaa inkoni.
Inkoni nk'akaguru ka gatatu.
Abanyarwanda bitwazaga inkonink'akaguru ka gatatu, iyo umuntu yaageraga mu zabukuru, akenshi yagiraga intege nke, zivanze no kurwara isusumira, bityo bikamusaba kugira inkoni yo kwicumba, kugira ngo abashe gushingura abe yagira iyo agana.
Izo akaba ari zo mpamvu nyamukuru zatumaga Abanyarwnda, baba abato n'abakuru bagira umugenzo wo kwitwaza inkoni, ukaba waramamaye na magingo aya.
Nta bwo kwitwaza inkoni byari umuco w'urugomo cyangwa se impamvu z'ubusaza nk'uko benshi babyibwira cyangwa se babibwiwe, buri wese yagiraga impamvu ze zituma yitwaza inkoni hakaba n'izo bahuriyeho.

Majid Michel (yavutse ku ya 22 Nzeri 1980) ni umukinnyi wa filme ukomoka muri Gana, akaba umunyamideli, agira ibiganiro kuri televiziyo, ni umuvugabutumwa, akora n'imirimo yo gufasha imbabare (humanitarian). Yagiye ahatanira kenshi igihembo cya "Best actor in a leading role" mu bihembo bya Africa Movie Academy Awards mu myaka ya,, na. Gusa yaje kwegukana icya 2012 nyuma yo guhatana ubugira 3 byanga
Michel yavukiye i mu nkengero z'umurwa mukuru wa Gana Accra. Ni umuhungu ukomoka kuri Se w'umuLibani na nyina umubyara w'umunyagana akaba avukana n'abavandimwe be 9. Yize amashuri abanza muri St Therese ayakomereza muri, aho yiganye na Van Vicker umukinnyi wa filme ndetse n’uwahoze ari w’umuryango w’abibumbye. Mu mashuri yisumbuye, Michel yyakundaga gukina no kugaragara mu kinamico akaba n'umwe mu bagize drama club yo ku kigo yigagaho, bimuhesha gutwara igikombe cya Best Actor Award kuva muri kimwe mu bitaramo yakinnyemo ku munsi wo kwibohora muri aho muri Gana.
Mbere yo kuba umukinnyi wabigize umwuga, Michel yamurikaga imideli. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na "Star FM Ghana muri 2017," Majid yatangaje ko bwa mbere agerageza gukina filme atahise abona amahirwe kubera yaratarabimenya ariko ntibyamuca intege ahubwo ishyaka n'umuhate n'urukundo yarafitiye umwuga wo gukina filme byamuteye guhatana kurushaho mu ruganda rwa filme.
Role ya mbere yayibonye muri filme y'uruhererekane yamamaye cyane " a"ho yakinnyemo nk'umusore ukora muri hoteri wo muri Libani.
Nyuma atoranywa nk'umukinnyi w'imena muri filme irangira ya mbere ye "Divine Love" akinana na hamwe na Van Vicker muri role yunganira. "Iyi filme bahuriyemo irakundwa cyane ibahesha kugira amazina akomeye aturuka muri Ghana."
Mu mwaka wa 2008 Michel yakinnye muri "Agony of the Christ nk'umukinnyi w'imena, filme yahataniye ibihembo 7 muri" Afurika Movie Academy Awards yo muri 2009, harimo n'igihembo cya Michel yahataniraga nk'umukinnyi mwiza w'uwo mwaka.
Mu Kwakira 2017 Michel yatangaje ko ahembwa byibuze $15.000 kandi ko yinjije amadorari agera ku 35.000 ayakuye mu gukina filme. mu kwa cumi 2017 Michel gutangaza ko atazongera gukina role zimusaba gusomana kubera impamvu z'uko ari umukristo wavutse ibwa kabiri kandi imyemerere ye ikaba itabimwemeza abitangariza mu kiganiro kuri radiyo.
Kumenyekana muri Nollywood no Kwamamara.
Michel ni umwe mu bakinnyi bo muri Ghana binjiye mu ruganda rwa filme mu gihe cya usanzwe uyobora filme muri Nijeriya ubwo yagiranaga amasezerano y'ubufatanye na Director w'umunyagana ukorera muri Venus Films. ["citation needed"] Aya masezerano yatumye Abakinnyi benshi bo muri Ghana bagaragara ku isoko rya bibahesha amahirwe cyane kuruta n'Abakinnyi bo muri Nigeria, zimwe muri filme zakorewe muri ayo masezerano Michel yagaragayemo harimo: "Crime to Christ" (2007), "Agony of Christ" (2008), ' (2009), ' (2010), and "Who Loves Me?" (2010) amongst others.
Michel yatangiriye kuri filme y'urukundo yo muri 2009 "Emerald" akina role y'imena hamwe nubwo benshi bashimye imikinire ya Michel n'umubano we na Nnaji bagaragaje muri filme, ntibyatumye filme itagira amanota mabi. Gusa filme yo muri 2009 yakiriwe neza ibona amanota meza yaba ku mikorerwe yayo (production) ndetse n'imikinire ya Michel.
Mu mwaka wa 2009 Michel yakinnye muri filme yo muri nijeriya "Guilty Pleasures" yamugaragaje nk'umukinnyi mwiza ndetse ibona n'amanota meza. Muri 2010 yari inshuro ya 3 yongeye gukinana na Genevieve Nnaji bahurira noneho muri filme filme yo muri Nollywood yakiriwe bitandukanye inavugwaho mu buryo butandukanye Aho Kuri Nnaji Michel yavuze ko yamwigishije gukina Kandi aza no gutangaza ko buriya Genevieve Nnaji ariwe mukinnyi uzi gukina neza asomana mu ruganda rwa sinema.
Michel yakunze gukemura impaka hakiri kare mu mwuga we wa Nollywood mu magambo ye mu bitangazamakuru, harimo no kuvuga ko Gana nta nganda za firime yigeze. Mu mpera za 2010, byavuzwe ko uyu mukinnyi yaruhutse gukorera muri Nollywood nyuma yo guhabwa iterabwoba ry’urupfu yahabwaga n’abakinnyi bo muri Nijeriya batekerezaga ko abatwara ama role mesnhi
Yagarutse muri Gana aho yagaragaye muri filme nka "4 Play" yo muri 2010 hamwe n'ibice byayo byayikurikiye "4 Play Reloaded" (2011).
Muri 2012, yakinnye muri filme yavugaga ku ntambara yitwa "Somewhere in Africa", akina ari umunyagitugu, nubwo iyi filme itagafashe ariko Michel yashimiwe uko yayikinnyemo atsindira igihembo cye cya mbere muri Africa Movie Academy Award Byatumye yongera kugaruka muri Nollywood muri 2014 ahita agaragara muri 30 days in Atlanta aho byamushyize ku rutonde na the Nigerian Cinema Exhibition Coalition nk'imwe muri highest box office draws yo muri 2014. izindi film zo muri 2014 yagaragayemo harimo nka: ', itarakiriwe neza na ' ndetse na "", zombi zigorwa no kuzamamaza ndetse no kumenyekana.
Majid Michel yarashatse abyara abana batatu. Ku wa 19 Ugushyingo 2015 Michel yatangaje ko Umugore we bamaranye imyaka 10 y'urushako ariwe soko y'instinzi ye Ashima Imana muri uwo mwaka aba arinabwo basubiramo isezerano bagiranye ryo kubana nk'umugabo n'umugore.
Majid ni Umukristo ukijijwe Kuwa 4 Ukwakira 2016, Yari umushyitsi w'umuvugabutumwa mu rusengero aho yajyaga abasangiza Ijambo ry'Imana rifasha abantu Ubwo yari mu kiganiro kuri Radiyo Joy FM yo muri Gana, yatangaje ko ubu afite ubuzima bushya nk'umukristo nk'uko bibiliya ivuga Kuwa 1 Mata 2017 yavuze ko kuva yatangira urugendo rwe rw'agakiza byatumye atana n'incuti ze za mbere, ariko Imana imuhesha izindi ncuti zimushyigikira mu buzima bwe bushya.
Mu 2017 mu gitaramo cya pasika Majib yavuze mu magambo make ko kubambwa kwa Kristo bishushanywa no kwanga ivanguramoko, inzangano, ishyari, ubwibone, intambara, n’ububasha bw’abadayimoni ahubwo ukabaho ubuzima bwuzuye ubuntu buturuka ku Mana"
Mu kwa cumi 2017 yatangaje ko Imana ariyo imukoresha mu gukorera abantu ibitangaza. Ku ngingo yo kwikinisha, Majid avuga ko ari icyaha ku Mana ari nta muntu ukwiye kubikora na rimwe mu buzima bwe avuga ko nawe yigeze kubatwa nabyo mu myaka ye y'ubuto ariko ashishikariza urubyiruko kubyirinda
Ubwo yari mu kiganiro na, Majid ntiyemeranije na Freeze ku bijyanye no gutanga icyacumi. Majid yavuze ko gutanga icyacumi atari inyigisho zo mu isezerano rya kera. Ahubwo, avuga ko kigomba guhabwa itorero kugira ngo rifashe abakene.

Ramsey Nouah (yavutse ari Ramsey Tokunbo Nouah Jr kuwa 19 Ukuboza 1970) ni umukinnyi wa filme ukomoka muri Nijeriya akanaziyobora. Yatsindiye igikombe muri Africa Movie Academy Award cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mu role y'ibanze agiheshejwe na filme yakinnye yatangiriye kuyobora filme kuri filme yo muri 2019"​"​"​" ahita akomereza kuri filme yakunzwe muri yitwa ikaba filme yari yongewe gusubirwamo​ yo muri 1995
Ramsey Tokunbo Nouah Jr. yavukiye i kuwa 19 Ukuboza 1970 kuri se w'umuLibani na nyina w'umunya- ukomoka muri Owo, muri Leta ya Ondo. Yakuriye i Surulere Lagos, aho yigiye amashuri abanza kuri Atara primary school akomereza kuri community grammar school. Yakuye impamyabumenyi ya mu ishuri rikuru rya Lagos (), nyuma nibwo yabonye gukomeza umwuga wo.
Nouah yinjiye mu mwuga wo gukina filme mu myaka ya za 90 kuko yari akeneye amafaranga yo kwishyura impamyabumenyi ya General Certificate Education (GCE). Ariko umwuga we wo gukina filme ufata ishusho ubwo yakinaga nka Jeff Akin-Thomas muri filme yacaga kuri televiziyo yo muri Nijeriya bise Soap Opera Fortunes Kuva icyo gihe yagaragaye muri filme nyinshi nk'umukinnyi w'imena aza kwitirirwa akabyiniriro ka Lover Boy kubera role nyinshi yakinaga muri filme z'urukundo Afatwa kandi nk'umwe mu bakinnyi bashakishwa cyane muri Nijeriya.
Muri 2015, Nouah yahawe uburenganzira bwo gusubiramo filme Living in Bondage yo muri 1992. Muri 2018, nibwo yatangaje ko iyo azasubiramo azayita Living in Bondage: Breaking Free, yaje no gusohoka kuwa 8, ugushyingo 2019, iba filme ya mbere Nouah yayoboye anayikinamo​ ndetse iza gutsindira ibihembo 7 muri.
Nouah yashakanye na Emelia Philips-Nouah, bibarutse abana 2 b'abahungu Quincy Nouah na Joshua Nouah n'umukobwa umwe witwa Desiree Nouah.

Destin Conrad (yavutse ku ya 25 Kamena 2000) ni umuhanzi w'umunyamerika.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Destin yavukiye i Tampa muri Leta ya Floride, arererwa n’umubyeyi umwe ukomoka muri Jamayika. Nyirasenge, wari umuvugabutumwa, yakundaga kumujyana mu rusengero no mu bikorwa by’itorero aho yaririmbaga. Yatangiye kumenyekana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga Vine mu mwaka wa 2014, ubwo yashyiragaho videwo ye ya mbere, maze akaza kubona abayoboke barenga miliyoni. Ni naho kandi yahuriye bwa mbere n’umuhanzi Kehlani, bafitanye ubucuti bukomeye kandi amufata nk’umuvandimwe we mukuru.
Amaze kwigaragaza nkumuntu wimbuga nkoranyambaga kuri Vine, yatangiye gusohora umuziki nkubuseribateri. Muri 2019, yasohoye indirimbo "Cautious." Mu myaka mike yakurikiyeho, yasohoye izindi ndirimbo, zirimo ubufatanye na Ambré bise "Uburiganya" na trap / R &amp; B hybrid "Closure", byombi byasohotse mu 2020. Kugeza mu 2021, yashoboye gusohora icyegeranyo cy’indirimbo 9 za "Colorway." Yarekuye "Satin" mu 2022, "Yayoboka" mu mpera za 2023, na "Submissive 2" mu 2024. Yandikiye abandi bahanzi nka Kehlani na Ambré. Yakoranye kandi n'umuririmbyi / umwanditsi w'indirimbo Alex Isley (umukobwa wa Ernie Isley) mu ndirimbo 2024 yise "Amakosa amwe." Basohoye kandi amashusho yindirimbo imwe. 2024, Destin Conrad yatangiye urugendo rwe rwa mbere. Ni urugendo rwo mu mijyi 36 yo muri Amerika rwatangiye ku cyumweru, tariki ya 4 Gashyantare 2024 i Ngwino Ufate Live muri Austin, Texas hanyuma ruzenguruke i Los Angeles kuri Echoplex ku wa gatanu, 5 Mata 2024.

Jordan Alexander Ward (wavutse ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1995), uzwi cyane nka Jordan Ward, ni umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w’indirimbo ndetse n’umubyinnyi w’umunyamerika. Yatangiye umwuga we nk’umubyinnyi mbere yo kwinjira mu muziki. Yatangiriye umuziki mu mwaka wa 2017, maze mu 2023 asohora alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio yitwa "Imbere". Mu 2024, yatorewe igihembo cya NAACP Image Award mu cyiciro cy’umuhanzi mushya w’indashyikirwa mu bihembo bya 55 bya NAACP
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Jordan Ward yavutse ku ya 1 Gashyantare 1995 kandi yakuriye i St. Louis, muri Missouri. Kuva akiri muto, yerekanye ishyaka rikomeye ry'ubuhanzi, cyane cyane imbyino n'umuziki.
Yorodani yize kubyina, harimo ballet, jazz, na hip-hop, akiri ingimbi. Mbere yo kwishora mu muziki, Jordan Ward yigaragaje nk'umubyinnyi, imyitozo ndetse anakorana n’amasosiyete atandukanye yo kubyina ndetse no mu bitaramo byinshi. Amaze kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye, yimukiye i Los Angeles, ari naho yakoraga nk'umubyinnyi winyuma, azenguruka abahanzi barimo Justin Bieber, Becky G, Janet Jackson, na Beyoncé.
Ward yatangiye kwandika no gufata amashusho y'indirimbo ze mu Muri 2017, Jordan Ward yashyize ahagaragara umushinga we wa mbere, "A Peak mu nama". Nyuma yibi, yasohoye indirimbo nyinshi, harimo "Mustard" irimo 6LACK.
Mu Kwakira 2021, yasohoye EP yitwa "Guma Gutuza." Muri Werurwe Ward yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere, "Imbere", muri Interscope Records. Iyi yakozwe na Lido, igaragaramo ubufatanye na Joyce Wrice, Ryan Trey, Gwen Bunn, na Joony. Isohora, "Imbere" yashushanyije ku mbonerahamwe ya Billboard R&amp;amp;B yo muri Amerika mu cyumweru cyayo cya mbere. "[" ["needed"] "Rolling Stone" yashyize "Imbere" kurutonde rwayo rwa Album 100 Nziza zo mu
Mu gihembwe cya kane cya 2023, yazengurutse u Burayi bwose. Ward yatorewe igihembo cy’ishusho cya NAACP kubera umuhanzi mushya w’indashyikirwa mu bihembo bya 55 bya NAACP. Ward ​ Muri Mata 2024, yasohoye indirimbo "Umukinnyi wa kabiri" mu majwi ya "Ntubwire Mama Wapfuye Umwana." Ku ya "" 2025, Ward yasohoye indirimbo imwe 'JUICY' yakozwe na Michael Uzowuru na Teo Halm.
Muburyo bwa muzika hamwe ningaruka.
Umuziki wa Ward uhumekwa na funk, ubundi rock, na hip hop.

Jackie Appiah (yavutse kuwa 5 Ukuboza 1983) ni umunyegana wavukiye muri kanada, Umukinnyi wa filme wamamaye cyane mu ruganda rwa sinema muri Afrika.
Jackie yavukiye mu mujyi wa Toronto muri Kanada, aza kwimukira muri Gana akiri muto ariho yatangiriye umwuga we wo gukina filme. Uko imyaka yagiye itambuka Jackie yerekanye ubuhanga bumuhesha kuyobora role nyinshi ahawe yaba muri Nollywood cyangwa Gallywood, biramwubahisha yaba ku rwego rw'imbere mu gihugu ndetse no mu mahanga.
Ibikorwa bye birivugira kuko byamuhesheje ibihembo byinshi ndetse anahatanira byinshi, aho yegukanye igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza muri 2010 agikuye muri Africa Movie Academy Awards(AMAA) ndetse ahabwa n'icy'umukinnyi mwiza wunganira (Best Actress in a supporting role) muri africa Movie Academy Awards yo muri 2007 aza guhatana no muri 2008 icya "Best Actress in a Leading Role" n'icya "Best Upcoming Actress" muri AMAA nubwo byo atabyegukanye"." Ibi bishimangira izina rye ku ruhando rw'amazina akomeye muri sinema. Muri 2023 Glitz Africa yamuhaye igihembo cya Excellence in Creative Art Award mu ishimwe ngarukamwaka rigenerwa Abagore. Jackie ayobora filme, akazishoramo amafaranga, ni umunyamideli yerekana imideli ndetse afasha n'ababaye (humanitarian)
Mu myaka 20 ishize, Jackie Appiah yagize igihe cyamuhiriye mu mwuga we wo gukina filme yaba muri Gana cyangwa muri Nijeriya. Mu mpera zo mu myaka ya 90 nibwo Jackie Appiah yinjiye mu mwuga wo gukina filme ahereye kuri filme zacaga kuri televiziyo na filme zirangira zo muri Gana.
Muri 2003 nibwo yabaye nkugaragara bwa mbere kubera filme "" yo muri gana yakinnyemo ikaza kwamamara imuhesha kumenyekana muri sinema yo muri Afurika y'iburengerazuba. Nyuma y'uko iyo filme yerekanye ubuhanga bwe byatumye akina muri filme zitandukanye yaba muri Gana no muri Nijeriya, ahinduka umukinnyi mwiza w'umukobwa wagaragazaga ikizere mu karere.
Usibye kuba umukinnyi wa filime, Appiah yagiye akora n'ibikorwa by'ubugiraneza, yifashishije izina rye ryamamaye, afasha mu burezi ndetse no mu buvuzi muri Gana. Ibyo bikorwa bimuhesha ibihembo byinshi n’ishimwe kubera uruhare yagize mu nganda za firime ndetse n’ibikorwa bye by’ubutabazi.
Kwitabira ubutumire bwa Edward Seddoh Junior, Jackie Appiah byamubereye inyungu kuko yakinnye role ya Enyonam Blagogee muri filme Things We Do For Love yanditswe na Edward Seddoh Junior. Nyuma nibwo yaje gukina muri filme nka"Tentacles", "Games People Play", "Sun-city". n'izindi filme nyinshi z'uruhererekane.
Jackie ajya yibuka ko yarafite ubwoba ku nshuro ya mbere ubwo yajyaga gukina filme, yagize ati: "ndabyibuka naringiye gukna muri filme Venus yaje kwitwa Divine Love, aho nakinnye nitwa Kate (), sinizeraga ko nabikora neza, naratitiraga ariko abantu benshi ntibabimenye" Gusa byarangiye yemeje abantu bose batitaye ku bwoba yarafite.
Jackie avuga ko igice yakunze muri filme ari Mummy's Daughter cyo muri film Venus, inkuru y'iyo filme igaruka ku miryango, aho yayikinnyemo ari umukobwa w'igikomangomakazi. Jackie yatangaje ko yakunze uburyo yakinnye ndetse ko yanakunze cyane iyi role yakinaga Ubu Jackie yishimira aho uruganda rwa sinema rugeze rwiyubaka ndetse ko ari vuba cyane n'abandi bakabona iterambere ryawo ritangaje.
Jackie Appiah afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi ba filme bari ku rugero rwiza kandi bakomeye, uruganda rwa sinema yaba iyo muri Gana cyangwa Nijeriya bafite mu myaka 20 ishize.
Kumenyekana muri Nollywood no Kwamamara.
Appiah yari yaramaze kumenyekana muri Nollywood kubera filme nyinshi zo muri Gana yagaragayemo zamamaye nyinshi zatsindiye muri Gana harimo: "Beyoncé - The President's Daughter", ', "Passion of the Soul", "Pretty Queen", "The Prince's Bride", "The King is Mine," hamwe na '. Muri filme zakiniye muri Nollywood zamenyekanye cyane harimo: "Black Soul" na "Bitter Blessing yakinanye" n'umukinnyi wo muri Nollywood Ramsey Nouah ndetse na "My Last Wedding ari kumwe n'umukinnyi wo muri" Nollywood.
Muri 2013 yatsindiye igihembo cy’umukinnyi mpuzamahanga witwaye neza muri "Papyrus Magazine" Screen Actors Awards (PAMSAA) cyo muri 2013 cyabereye Abuja, muri Nijeriya.
Isura ya Jackie ushobora kuyibona ku byapa byinshi byamamaza no kuri televiziyo zo muri Gana harimo na advert ya GSMF yavugaga ibyo kwirinda virusi itera SIDA.
Jackie yegukanye kuba uhagarariye U.B mu kwamamaza ibikorwa byabo, Ubu akaba ahagarariye ibikorwa byo kwamamaza IPMC ndetse no ku byapa byabo byose. "GSMF" niko kazi ke ko kwamamaza ka mbere yakoze
Kuva yaba umukinnyi wa filme, Appiah yahataniye ibihembo byinshi ndetse anatsindira byinshi. yagiye atsindira igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza muri role z'ibanze nk'icya 2010 muri Africa Movie Academy Awards (AMAA). ndetse ahabwa n'ibindi by'umukinnyi mwiza wunganira nk'icyo yatsinze muri 2007 muri AAMA Muri 2008 aba nominated gusa ntiyatsinda "Glitz Africa" yaje kumuha igihembo cy'ishimwe muri 2023 yise the Excellence in Creative Art Award muri Ghana Women of the Year Honours 2023
