Ubuzima bwe bunini akiri muto yabaga muri Kanada agize imyaka 10 we na nyina bimukira muri Gana yamamaye cyane ku izina rye Appiah, Muri 2005 yashakanye na Peter Agyemang bakaba bafitanye umwana w'umuhungu.

Ego Ella May (/ ɛg-oʊ ˈɛl.ə meɪ / eh - go eh - luh yavutse mumwaka wa 1992 ni umuririmbyi winjyana ya R na B, neo-soul hamwe na Jazzy ya contemporary. Ni umurirmbyi uturuka m'Ubwongereza, muri London yamajyepfo.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ella May yavukiye mu gace ka Croydon. Izina rye ryahumetswe n’umuco we wo muri Nijeriya ndetse no ku muririmbyikazi Ella Fitzgerald. Yatangiye kuririmba akiri muto, kandi afite imyaka 19 yigishije kwiyarangurira gucuranga gitari, gutunganya indirimbo no gukora umuziki we bwite.
Muri 2014, Ella May yasohoye umuzingo windirimbo we wambere, "Guhumeka Amazi", AFROPUNK yagize ati: "yampaye ubushagarira kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo". "Vice" yamusobanuye ko nk'ijwi ry'ejo hazaza rya neo-roho".
Muri 2015, yasohoye umuzingo windirimbo, "Zero", aho SPIN yise "guhuza imbaraga z'ubugingo, jazz na elegitoroniki".
Muri 2018, indirimbo ye "Imbonerahamwe ya Umwe", yaje kurutonde rwa "New York Times" rw'indirimbo nshya zizwi cyane. Yashyizwe mumajwi yigihembwe cya gatatu cyuburere "bwimibonano mpuzabitsina".
Muri 2019, Ella May yasohoye, "Icyayi &amp; Impuhwe". "Earmilk" yise inzira "ibirori biryoheye amatwi". Indirimbo ye "Abakobwa Ntibahora Baririmba Abahungu" yasobanuwe nkitangaje "na Onsmash"

Ogi Ifediora, uzwi cyane nka Ogi, ni umuhanzi w’Umunyamerika ufite inkomoko muri Nijeriya, uririmba injyana ya R&amp;B na blues. Yamamaye cyane ubwo yaririmbaga indirimbo "AlJ" ya PJ Morton, ndetse n’indirimbo ye yo mu 2021 "I Got It", yakozwe n’umuhanga mu gutunganya indirimbo wegukanye Grammy, No ID.
Ogi Ifediora yavutse mu 1997 hanze ya Chicago akurira i Madison, muri Wisconsin. Kuva akiri muto, yakundaga umuziki. Nyirakuru yakunze kuririmba indirimbo gakondo zo muri Nigeriya kumukangura. Yahoraga kandi mu nama zo gusengera mu muryango, zirimo n'indirimbo. Ibi byaranze intangiriro yinyungu za Ogi muburyo bukomeye kandi bugoye. Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yari umunyamuryango wa korari jazz usibye gucuranga inanga. Nyuma yize muri Northwestern University aho yize ibijyanye na siyanse ya politiki kandi yiga ibijyanye n’amategeko. Igihe yari ahari, yari umwe mubagize itsinda rya cappella, SHAKA cappella.
Mu myaka ye mikuru, yakoze konte ya Instagram aho yashyize ibifuniko byindirimbo zitandukanye, harimo nindirimbo ya "Alight" ya PJ Morton. PJ Morton amaze gusubiramo igifuniko cye, yaje kuvugana na producer No ID., wafatanije nawe gukora indirimbo ye ya mbere, "Nabonye".
Muri 2022, Ogi yasohoye Uumuzingo we wa mbere, "Monologues". Nkumuhanzi, yashyigikiye kandi afungura abahanzi nka Marias, Mahalia, Snoh Aalegra, na Paramore. [Mu 2022, Ogi yerekanye bwa mbere BET Awards yakinnye na "Nabonye", indirimbo ye ya mbere muri "Monologues" EP.
Umuziki we wasobanuwe cyane nka R&amp;amp;B, hamwe na jazz na hip hop. Avuga kandi ko umuziki nyafurika wagize ingaruka ku njyana ye.

Omar Samuel Pasley (wavutse ku ya 3 Nzeri 1986), uzwi ku izina ry’ubuhanzi Omi (/ˈoʊmiː/ OH-mee), ni umuririmbyi wo muri Jamayika. Yamenyekanye cyane muri 2012 kubera indirimbo ye "Cheerleader", verisiyo yasubiwemo ikamenyekana ku rwego rw’isi. Ubu yasinyanye na Ultra Music, igice cya Sony Music, kandi yarekuye alubumu ye ya mbere, "Me 4 U", muri 2015.
Omar Samuel Pasley yavukiye muri paruwasi ya Clarendon. Yashingiwe i Kingston, nyuma yo kuvumburwa na Dancehall impresario Clifton Dillon (uzwi ku izina rya Specialist) maze asinyana na Oufah, ifatwa nkikirango cyigenga cya Jamayika. Indirimbo ye ya mbere yafashwe amajwi ni "Guhagarara kuri Batatu" yasohokanye n'amashusho yindirimbo. OMI yari yarahimbye indirimbo ye yambere yise " Cheerleader " mu mwaka wa 2008. Amaherezo yaje kuyandika no kuyikora no kuyisohora mu mwaka wa 2012. Yasohowe muri Jamayika hamwe na videwo y’ingengo y’imari iciriritse, yerekana amashusho menshi muri Oregon mu rugendo rwa mbere OMI yagiriye muri Amerika, iba icyamamare muri Jamayika ndetse inamenyekana muri Hawaii no muri Dubai. Ntabwo yigeze asohora alubumu, OMI yashoye indirimbo zakunzwe cyane muri Jamayika nka "Fata Byoroshye", "Ibishashi byurufaya" (iherekejwe n'amashusho y'indirimbo) na "Ibara ry'iminwa yanjye", iyanyuma irimo Busy Signal, imbyino izwi cyane yo muri Jamayika, ska, n'umuhanzi wa reggae.
2014 - ubungubu: "Me 4 U.".
Mu mwaka wa 2014, "Cheerleader" yabonye ubuzima bwa kabiri ubwo Patrick Moxey, perezida wa Ultra Music, ikirango cy'imbyino igice kimwe na Sony Music yumvise iyi ndirimbo maze arayikunda maze ayisubiramo ayitangaza nkindirimbo ibyinitse. Mu ntangiriro za 2014, Ultra Music yashyizeho remix ebyiri z’indirimbo, imwe ya Ricky Blaze indi ya Felix Jaehn, bikorwa n'umuhanzi utunganya indirimbo w’imyaka 20 w’umudage. Amaherezo, Ultra Music yahisemo inzu yo mu turere dushyuha ya "Cheerleader" nkuko byasubiwemo na Jaehn. Iyo yasubiwemo yabanje gukundwa cyane muri Suwede, amaherezo yemezwa inshuro 5 na platinum. Bidatinze, indirimbo yakwirakwijwe mu zindi mbonerahamwe z’i Burayi, cyane cyane Ubufaransa, Ubutaliyani n'Ubudage. Yaje ku isonga mu bihugu byinshi by’Uburayi no muri Ositaraliya. Mu Bwongereza, OMI yakoze amateka ku ya 24 Gicurasi 2015, ubwo "Cheerleader" yaje ku mwanya wa mbere mu Bwongereza ku rutonde rw’abaseribateri mu cyumweru cya kane yikurikiranya, ibyo bikaba bibaye igihe kirekire gikurikiranye umuhanzi wo muri Jamayika wagize uwo mwanya ku mbonerahamwe. Muri Amerika, indirimbo yinjiye muri Billboard Hot 100 muri Gicurasi 2015; nyuma yaje gukora umwanya wambere wa Hot 100 nyuma yibyumweru 12 mubishushanyo mbonera. Binyuze mukwigarurira umwanya wa mbere, OMI yaje kumenyekana kwisi yose. Ku ya 27 Kanama 2015, yasohoye indirimbo " Hula Hoop ". Yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio "Me 4 U" ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2015. Iyi alubumu ikubiyemo indirimbo " Cheerleader ", " Hula Hoop ", "Kangura", na "Tera mu nyanja".
Indirimbo yasohoye wenyine.
Indirimbo "Hula Hoop" ntiyigeze yinjira kurutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100 ariko yaje kumwanya wa 16 kurutonde rwa Bubbing under Hot 100 chart

Alexandra Isley (wavutse ku ya 16 Mata 1987) ni umuririmbyi n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Yasohoye umuzingo muto we w'indirimbo wambere witwa The Love / Art Memoirs mu mwaka wa 2012. Yakoze indirimbo n'abahanzi batandukanye barimo Scarface, Terrace Martin, Masego, 9th Wonder, Rapsody, Tank and the Bangas, ndetse na Lucky Daye. Isley kandi yigeze gutoranywa mu bihembo bibiri bya Grammy Awards.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Mukuvuka kwa Alexandra Isley, ni umukobwa wa Ernie Isley wo mu itsinda ryimyororokere rya Isley Brothers. Isley yavukiye muri New Jersey, ariko igihe kinini cy'ubwana bwe yabaga i Los Angeles. Yise Stevie Wonder, Umuganwa, Ella Fitzgerald, Toni Braxton, Aaliyah, na Mariah Carey nk'abahanzi bibihe byose kuri we. Yakundaga kuririmba kuva mu bwana kandi umuryango we washyigikiraga gukurikirana umuziki nkumwuga wabigize umwuga.
Yatangiye imyitozo yo kugorora yijwi kera afite imyaka 12 nyuma arangiza amashuri yisumbuye y'ubugeni muri LA County. Isley yakuye impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri UCLA, aho yize mu ishami rya jazz.
Isley afite synesthesia, yasobanuye iryo hurizo kuri "LA Weekly": "Mu mutwe wanjye mfite ibitekerezo binyuranye, kandi ibintu byose bisa nkibishushanyije, cyangwa ni umurongo uhoraho w'amabara... Rimwe na rimwe nzatangira guhimba ikintu kandi ngomba guhindura urufunguzo kuko ayo mabara ntazanyorohera."
Isley yasohoye bwa mbere umuzingo mugufi w'indirimbo yise "The" "Love Art / Memoirs" mu mwaka wa 2012 Okayplayer yasubiyemo uwo muzingo maze itanga igisubizo cyiza: "Nyamuneka mwizere ijwi rya Alex mutagendeye kumusaruro we utuje ashoboye kubyara igisekuru cyabana bakunzwe cyane nka "Hagati y'impapuro" uko yabaye intangarugero"
Isley yavuze ko umuziki we ari r &amp; b hamwe na hip hop hamwe na jazz. Samantha Callender wa "Essence" yavuze ko ijwi rye ari "amajwi yoroshye ya silike atwara injyana ya neo-roho." Yakoranye n'abahanzi nka 9th Wonder mundirimbo "Ibicu by'imvura"; Lucky Daye na Masego muri "Nziza &amp; Byinshi (Yasubiwemo)"; Chromonicci muri "Interstellar"; na Christian Kuria muri "Toroka."
Ugushyingo 2019 yasohoye umuzingo mugufi w'indirimbo "Wilton" ihuriweho na Jack Dine utunganya umuziki. Muri 2020 Isley yakoze igitaramo cya serivise ntoya ya "NPR". Muri uwo mwaka kandi yari umuhanzi wamamaye cyane muri Cautious Clay mundirimbo "Kugera", kumajwi yigihembwe cya kane "cy'umutekano muke".
Muri 2022 yasohoye "Marigold," alubumu yakoranye na Jack Dine. Jackie B. wo muri Soul Bounce yasuzumye neza umushinga ati: "Alex Isley na Jack Dine bakomeje kuba umuhuro mwiza wakozwe mu ijuru kuko batujyana mu ruziga ruva mu bimera rukamera kugeza kuri "Marigold"." Yagaragaye ku ndirimbo ya Tank iheruka "Nta mbibi" muri alubumu ye ya 10 R&amp;amp;B Amafaranga.
Isley yasohoye alubumu "Nasize Umutima wanjye muri Ladera" hamwe na Terace Martin mu Kwakira 2023. Iyi alubumu, yabaye iye yambere yagaragaye kumbonerahamwe ya Billboard, yagaragaye ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rwa Album ya Jazz ya Jazz ya Billboard no ku mwanya wa 22 kuri Album ya Jazz.
Yatsindiye ibihembo bibiri bya mbere bya Grammy Award nk'umuhanzi wagaragaye kuri "Garuka ku Rukundo" na Robert Glasper mu birori bya 66 bya Grammy Awards. Indirimbo yatowe nk'indirimbo nziza ya R&amp;B hamwe na R&amp;B nziza.
Muri Gashyantare 2025, Isley yasinyiye ikigo cyita kwifunguro rya sasita ry/ubuntu gitangwa na Warner Records.
Isley aba i Los Angeles. Afite umukobwa numuririmbyi Kenyon Dixon (b. 2017).

Tony Kofi (wavutse kuya 10 Nyakanga 1966) ni umuririmbyi w'umwongereza munjyana ya Jazz sexaphonist n'umwirongi. Ayobora inyabutatu na quartet kandi ni umwe mu bashinze itsinda rya Monk Liberation Band. Ubutatu bwe burimo umukaraza Winston Clifford na Hammond B3 n'umuyobozi Anders Olinder. Kofi yasinye mu imitsinda ryihariye rya Jazz. Yatsindiye ibihembo bibiri bya BBC Jazz Awards: umucuranzi mwiza muri 2008 na Alubumu nziza muri 2005 muri Byose Birabizi. Tony yinjiye muri Orchestre Grand Union mu 1998, iyobowe n’umuyobozi w’ubuhanzi Tony Haynes, kandi kuva icyo gihe yabaye umuhanzi ukomeye. Muri Gicurasi 2021, Kofi yagaragaye kuri Radiyo BBC 4 kugira ngo aganire ku mibereho ye ya mbere ndetse n’ibintu byahinduye ubuzima byatumye afata sekisafone.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Kofi yavukiye i Nottingham ku babyeyi ba Gana. Nyina yari umukunzi wa jazz kandi yari afite inyandiko nyinshi.
Yavutse akoresha akaboko k'ibumoso ariko ahatirwa n'umuryango we gukoresha ukuboko kwe kw'iburyo.
Kofi yari afite inzozi zo kuba umucuranzi ariko bamubwira ko bidashoboka. Kubera ko yari umuhanga mububaji ku ishuri, ibyo bikaba byaramuteye inzira yo kuba umwuga w'ububaji.
Afite imyaka 16, yakoraga nk'uwimenyereza umwuga mugihe agace gato kurubaho kamufashe kumwenda wukuboko akagwa hejuru yinzu. Yaguye avuga ko yiboneye icyerekezo gisobanutse cyubuzima bwe burambuye imbere ye, harimo ingendo, umuryango ndetse no gucuranga. Nyuma yo kugwa yari muri koma iminsi myinshi ariko mugihe cyakurikiyeho yaje gukira neza.
Kofi yakiriye amafaranga y'indishyi zo kugwa, maze amaylo 50 ayatakaza kuri sekisafone. Yabwiye ababyeyi be ko atazasubira ku kazi kandi ko azibanda cyane ku kwiyigisha gucuranga.
Ubwa mbere umuryango we ntiwabyemeye ariko yayikinaga buri munsi, nubwo bitotombeye urusaku rwa barumuna be batandatu. Amaze gutera imbere, ababyeyi be baza kumushyigikira kandi nyina amuha inyandiko zo kwigiraho.
Nyuma Kofi yize muri Berklee College of Music.
Ubucukumbuzi k'umuziki.

David Adedeji Adeleke (wavutse ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 1992), uzwi ku izina rya Davido, ni umuririmbyi wo muri Nijeriya-Amerika, umwanditsi w'indirimbo ndetse na producer. Davido yavukiye i Atlanta, muri Amerika, akurira i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Yatangiye umuziki we nkumunyamuryango witsinda KB International. Davido yize imiyoborere yubucuruzi muri kaminuza ya Oakwood mbere yo kuva mu ishuri kugira ngo akubite kandi yandike amajwi. Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yo gusohora " Dami Duro ", indirimbo ya kabiri muri alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio "Omo Baba Olowo" (2012), aho yavuyemo izindi ndirimbo esheshatu - "Back when", "Ekuro", "Overseas", "All of you", "Gbon Gbon" na "Feel alright" - bafashwe. Muri 2012, Davido yatsindiye igihembo bikurikiraho muri The Headies Hagati ya 2013 na 2015, yasohoye indirimbo " Gobe ", "one of a kind", " Skelewu ", " Aye ", "Tchelete (Goodlife)", "Naughty", "Owo Ni Koko", "The Sound" na "The Money".
Muri Mutarama 2016, Davido yatangaje ku rubuga rwa Twitter ko yasinyanye amasezerano na Sony Music nyuma y'amezi make, ashinga inzu itunganya imiziki yitwa Davido Music Worldwide, aho abahanzi barimo Morravey na Logos Olori basinyemo amasezerano. Muri Nyakanga 2016, Davido yasinyanye amasezerano na RCA Records ya Sony maze mu Kwakira muri uwo mwaka, asohora indirimbo eshanu Yaguwe (EP) "son of Mercy", yari ishyigikiwe n’indirimbo "Gbagbe Oshi", "How long" na "Coolest Kid in Africa ". Muri Mata 2017, Davido yongeye kugirana amasezerano na Sony kubera ibibazo byo kugenzura ibihangano hanyuma nyuma yuwo mwaka, asohora indirimbo eshanu zirimo "IF" na " Fall ". "​" Mu Gushyingo 2019, Davido yasohoye alubumu(umuzingo) ye ya kabiri ya studio "A Good Time", yatewe inkunga n’indirimbo zasohotse mbere "IF", "Fall", "Assurance", "Blow My Mind" na "Risky".
Muri 2019, ikinyamakuru "New African" cyashyize ahagaragara Davido nk'umwe mu Banyafurika 100 bakomeye. Album ye ya studio, "Igihe cyiza", yasohotse ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 2020. Muri Gashyantare 2021, Davido yagaragaye ku rutonde rukurikira rwa Time 100. Yasohoye "Timeless", alubumu ye ya kane ya studio, ku ya 31 Werurwe 2023. Davido ni ambasaderi w’umuco muri Nijeriya nijwi rikomeye ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu muri Afurika. Ni umwe kandi mu bahanzi bakunzwe cyane muri Afurika kuri Instagram na Twitter.
David Adedeji Adeleke yavutse ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 1992, avukira i Atlanta, Jeworujiya, Amerika. Adeleke (wavutse 1957) ni igihangange mu bucuruzi ukomoka muri Nijeriya, naho nyina Vero Adeleke (1963–2003) yari umwarimu wa kaminuza. Davido ni umuhererezi muri barumuna batanu n'umuhungu wa gatatu wa se. Yize mu ishuri mpuzamahanga ry’Abongereza i Lagos, maze afite imyaka 16, asubira muri Amerika kwiga ibijyanye n’ubucuruzi muri kaminuza ya Oakwood.
Igihe yari i Oakwood, Davido yaguze ibikoresho bya muzika atangira gukora. Yakoze kandi umuziki KB International hamwe na babyara be B-Red na Sina Rambo. Davido yavuye muri kaminuza ya Oakwood gukurikirana umuziki igihe cyose yimukira i Londres, ari naho yakoraga mu majwi ye. Nyuma yo gusubira muri Nijeriya mu 2011, Davido yahagaritse umwuga we wa muzika maze yemera ko yubaha se yiyandikisha muri kaminuza ya Babcock, ari naho yarangije muri Nyakanga 2015, afite impamyabumenyi y’umuziki nyuma yuko se yishyuye kaminuza kugira ngo atangire ishami ry’umuziki mu ishuri ryatangije umunyeshuri umwe.
Intangiriro Y'umwuga.
Muri 2011, Davido yatangiye gukora kuri alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio "Omo Baba Olowo", ikaba ivanze na Afrobeats na hip hop. Davido yakoranye na Jay Sleek, Maleek Berry, GospelOnDeBeatz, Spellz, Dokta Frabz, Bwana Chidoo, Theory Soundz na Shizzi gukora alubumu. "Omo Baba Olowo" agaragaramo abashyitsi kuva Naeto C, Sina Rambo, B-Umutuku, Kayswitch, Ice Prince na 2 Face Idibia. Muri rusange yakiriwe nabi nabanenga umuziki, berekanaga ibiyikubiyemo ndetse n’indirimbo za Davido. Iyi alubumu yatsindiye Album nziza ya R &amp; B / Pop kandi yahawe igihembo cya Album yumwaka muri The Headies 2013, ndetse na Album nziza yumwaka muri Nigeriya Imyidagaduro 2013.
Indirimbo "Yagarutse Iyo" ya Naeto C yasohotse nk'indirimbo ya mbere ya alubumu ku ya 7 Gicurasi 2011. Yakorewe i Londres na Davido kandi yakiraga kenshi mu kirere. 9 Gicurasi 2011 2 Indirimbo yamenyekanye nyuma y'amezi atatu yohereje kuri bamwe mu nshuti ze. Amashusho y'indirimbo aherekejwe na "Dami Duro" yashyizwe ahagaragara ku Mutarama 2012, ubwo imyigaragambyo yigarurira Nigeriya.
Indirimbo ya gatatu ya Album "Ekuro" yasohotse ku ya 25 Mutarama 2012. Amashusho y’indirimbo yafashwe amajwi kandi ayobowe na Miami na Antwan Smith. Umuhanzi wo muri Nigeriya Aramide yasohoye igifuniko cyindirimbo. Indirimbo ya kane ya Album "Hanze" yasohotse ku ya 6 Gicurasi verisiyo itarangiye yindirimbo yasohotse mbere yuko isohoka kumugaragaro. Davido yavuze ko yafashe indirimbo hamwe na GospelOnDeBeatz 'bahuriye mu isoko.
2013–2016: Isohora risanzwe, "Baddest" na "Son of Mercy".
Ku ya 25 Gashyantare 2013, Davido yasohoye inzira yakozwe na Shizzi " Gobe ". umwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rwa "Premium Times" ' 10 za mbere za 2013 "." Godfather Productions yafashe amashusho y'indirimbo muri Afrika yepfo. Davido yatangaje ku rubuga rwa Twitter "one of kind" izasohoka ku ya 13 Gicurasi 2013. Shizzl nawe yakoze iyi ndirimbo. Tebza wa Godfather Productions yafashe amajwi anayobora amashusho yindirimbo muri Afrika yepfo ; yerekana Afurika yunze ubumwe ikungahaye ku muco n'umuziki.
" Skelewu " yasohotse ku ya 13 Kanama 2013. Yashyizwe ku mwanya wa gatanu ku rutonde rwa "Premium Times" ' rutonde rw’indirimbo 10 za mbere za irekurwa ryaherekejwe no gutangaza amarushanwa yo kubyina "Skelewu". "Skelewu" yashyigikiwe n'amashusho abiri y'indirimbo; iyambere yayobowe na Sesan isohoka ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2013. Yashyizwe kuri YouTube ikoresheje konte ya parody. Nyuma gato yo gusohora amashusho, Davido yavuze ko hari umuntu wamuhemukiye ayirekura kandi ko azakora indi videwo hamwe na Moe Musa, umuyobozi w’amashusho y’indirimbo mu Bwongereza. Sesan yanenze Davido n'ubuyobozi bwe kuba barasohoye amagambo atari yo. Moa Musa yafashe amajwi anayobora amashusho yindirimbo yemewe ya "Skelewu" i Londres, kandi yasohotse mu Kwakira 2013.
Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2014, Davido yasohoye " Aye ", yakozwe na T-Spize. indirimbo yayobowe na Clarence Peters asohoka ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2014. Indirimbo ya Davido yakoranye na Mafikizolo wo muri Afurika yepfo, yiswe "Tchelete (Goodlife)", yasohotse ku ya 30 Mata 2014. na Oskido na Shizzi, ikwirakwizwa na MTN ya Play na Callertunez. na Mafikizolo mu birori byabereye muri MTN Nigeriya ya Elite Night mu Kuboza 2013. Oskido na Uhuru bagaragaye muri videwo.
Muri Kamena 2014, Davido yakoranye na Mi Casa, Lola Rae, Sarkodie, Diamond Platnumz na Tiwa Savage mu ndirimbo "Africa Rising", indirimbo yakoreshejwe mu gikorwa cy'uruganda rwa DStv cyo guteza imbere ibikorwa by'ishoramari mu rwego rw'imibereho myiza. Video y'indirimbo yafashwe amajwi kandi yayobowe n'inzu yo gutunganya indirimbo yo muri Afurika y'Epfo Callback Dreams. Aba bahanzi baririmbye iyi ndirimbo mu birori byo gutangiza Africa Rising muri Mauritius. Muri Kamena 2015, Davido yashyize hanze indirimbo ya "Fans Mi" yafashije Meek Mill. Mbere yo kurekurwa, yashutse abafana akoresheje amajwi n'amafoto y'inyuma y'ibisonga bya videwo.
Album ya Davido The Baddest yari iteganyijwe gusohoka muri Kamena 2015 ariko gusohoka kwayo byasubitswe ku itariki ya 10 Ukwakira uwo mwaka. Hashize iminsi ibiri mbere y'uwo munsi, gusohoka byongeye gutangwa kuko ikigo kitamenyekanye cyatanze igitekerezo cyo kugitanga. Davido yari yarashyize hanze Igishushanyo cy'indirimbo ya album no ku rutonde rw'indirimbo mu ntangiriro z'uwo mwaka. The Baddest yari ifite gahunda yo gutunganya ibijyanye na Shizzi, Del B, Spellz, J Fem, Don Jazzy, Puffy Tee, Uhuru, Kiddominant na Young John. Nanone byari kuzitabirwa n'abahanzi nka P-Square, Don Jazzy, Runtown, Uhuru, DJ Buckz, Akon, Meek Mill, Wale na Trey Songz. Muri Mutarama 2016, Davido yatangaje kuri Twitter ko yasinye amasezerano ya disiki na Sony Music; itangazo rye rivugwaho n'abantu batandukanye. Iki kigo cy'ubuhanzi cyashyize ahagaragara itangazo ry'itangazamakuru ryo kwemeza amasezerano. amasezerano Davido yagiranye na Sony yasabye ko asohora albums ebyiri, kandi amwemerera gukomeza uburenganzira ku muziki no kuririmba mu bitaramo.
Amezi make nyuma yo gusinyana na Sony, Davido yashinze label yanditseho Davido Music Worldwide (DMW). Dremo, Mayorkun, Yonda na Peruzzi kuri ubu basinywe muri label. Muri Nyakanga 2016, Davido yasinyanye amasezerano na RCA Records. Amasezerano yanditse na yahinduye gahunda yo ' "Baddest". Nk’uko ibivuga, amasezerano Davido yagiranye na Sony yasabye ko alubumu yitabirwa n’amahanga kugira ngo yemererwe ku isi hose. Mu Kwakira 2016, yasohoye inzira eshanu EP "Umuhungu w’Impuhwe", washyigikiwe n’indirimbo "Gbagbe Oshi", "Igihe kingana iki", "Coolest Kid in Africa"; kandi ikubiyemo abashyitsi bagaragara na, na
2017–2018: "If", "Fall", "Fia" and "Assurance".
Davido yatsindiye ibihembo byiza bya Afrika muri MOBO Awards 2017. Ku ya 17 Gashyantare 2017, yasohoye "Niba", yakozwe na Tekno, wanditse umuzimu wanditse inzira ya Davido. Amashusho yindirimbo "Niba" amaze gukwirakwizwa inshuro zirenga miliyoni 172 kuri YouTube, bituma abona umwanya muri videwo ye yitwaye neza. yari diyama yemejwe n’inganda zandika amajwi muri Afurika yepfo (RISA), yerekana kohereza ibicuruzwa 200.000. "Niba" yatsindiye Indirimbo nziza ya Pop Indirimbo nziza yumwaka muri Headies 2018. Asubiramo OkayAfrica, Sabo Kpade yavuze ko iyi ndirimbo ari "gutwika buhoro" hamwe n "" urusaku rudasanzwe rwumvikana neza kandi rudafite ibikoresho ". Amashusho y'indirimbo "Niba" yafatiwe i yayobowe na Director Q ikorwa na Tunde Babalola. Davido yifatanije nuwashushanyaga imyenda yumugabo Orange Umuco wo gusohora icyegeranyo cya capsule cyahumetswe na "Niba".
Davido Yasohoye indirimbo "Fall",ikubiyemo igice cy'indirimbo Kojo Funds's track "Dun Talking", muri Kamena 2, 2017. RISA yemeje "Fall" platinum;
Iyo ndirimbo yari imwe mu ndirimbo 100 zakunzwe cyane gushakishwa kuri muri Amerika muri Mutarama 2019, kandi yari mu ndirimbo 10 zakunzwe cyane kuri Shazam muri New York muri Gashyantare 2019,Yabaye indirimbo ya pop y’Abanyanigeria imaze igihe kirekire ku rutonde rwa "" mu mateka. "Fall" yashyizwe ku mwanya 163 ku rutonde rwa Pitchfork rw'indirmbo 200 nziza za mbere mu za 2010s kugeza 2019. Umuyobozi w’amashusho wavukiye muri Nigeria akaba Umunyaburayi, Daps, ni we wayoboye gufata video y’indirimbo ya "Fall", mu Ugushyingo 2023 yari imaze kurebwa inshuro zisaga miliyoni 274, ikaba ari video imaze kurebwa cyane cyane n’umuhanzi w’Umunya-Nigeria kuri YouTube.
Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2017, Davido yasohoye "Fia" yakozwe na Fresh VDM kandi isobanurwa nk'inzira nziza. Ku murongo wa kabiri, Davido avuga ku ifatwa rye n’uruhare rwa Caroline Danjuma mu gukurura ibihuha yagize uruhare mu rupfu rwa Tagbo Umenike. Umwanditsi w'ikinyamakuru Native Magazine yashimye uburyo Davido yanditse indirimbo avuga ko "Fia" "abasha kwerekana zimwe mu ntambara aherutse kugirira ku giti cye, atiriwe yifuza mu buryo burambuye". Asubiramo umuziki muri Afurika, Kayode Faniyi yavuze ko "Fia" itanga "amakimbirane abaho" kandi ko "nta gushidikanya ko ari indirimbo y’umwuga wa Davido - nibura kugeza igihe azirenza". Daniel Orubo wo mu miyoboro ya Konbini yavuze ko "Fia" ari inzira "ihuza" ikoresha "ijwi ryijimye" rya Davido. " yatorewe kuba Indirimbo nziza ya Pop Indirimbo nziza yumwaka muri Headies 2018. Stefflon Don yatewe inkunga na "Fia " yasohotse ku ya 30 Werurwe 2018. Davido yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cya Afurika kandi yari umwe mu bahawe ibihembo byiza ku isi hose muri MTV Europe Music Awards 2017. Davido yasohoye "Icyizere" ku ya 30 Mata 2018; yeguriye inzira umukunzi we arayirekura kugira ngo ahure n’imyaka 23 amaze avutse. Asubiramo ikinyamakuru "kavukire", Toye Sokunbi yavuze ko indirimbo "ivuga byinshi ku kamaro ko gusobanuka mu gihe cya emojis, kwemezwa n'abo dukunda no gushyira urukundo imbere, mu buryo butandukanye". Davido yatsindiye amategeko mpuzamahanga meza muri BET Awards 2018, abaye umuhanzi wa mbere nyafurika wabonye igihembo cye kuri stage nkuru. Mu ijambo rye ryakiriye, yasabye abakunzi n’abahanzi bo muri Amerika gusura Afurika no kurya ibiryo.
Muri Kanama na Nzeri 2018, Davido yaririmbye mu nzu ya Blues i Boston mu rwego rwa "The Locked Up Tour", yatangiye muri Kanama ikazarangira muri Nzeri., nyuma y'uru ruzinduko, yakinnye hamwe na Meek Mill, Post Malone na Fat Joe mu iserukiramuco rya Made in America.
2019: Igitaramo cya O2 Arena, "Blow My Mind", "Risky", Good time.
Muri Mutarama 2019, Davido yagurishije The O2 Arena i Londres, abaye umuhanzi wa mbere w’umunyafurika wabikoze nyuma ya Wizkid mu mwaka wa 2018. Kwandikira "The Guardian" Caroline Sullivan yahaye igitaramo inyenyeri enye kuri eshanu, yita Davido "alfa" ati; "imyifatire ye myinshi iterwa n'abaraperi b'Abanyamerika bakoranye, barimo Young Thug na Swae Lee".
Inzira ya Chris Brown yafashijwe " Blow My Mind " yasohotse ku ya 26 Nyakanga 2019. Yakozwe na Shizzi kandi mu ntangiriro yari igamije gusohoka nk'indirimbo ya mbere ya alubumu. Amashusho yindirimbo yindirimbo yakusanyije miliyoni imwe mumasaha arenga "Fever" ya Wizkid na " Ngwino wegere " ahinduka amashusho yindirimbo yo muri Nigeriya kugirango agere kuri iki gikorwa vuba. Yabaye kandi amashusho yindirimbo yo kugirango ibone ibitekerezo byinshi mumasaha 24 yambere isohotse. "Risky" yasohotse ku ya 23 Ukwakira Amashusho y'indirimbo "Risky" yayobowe Alabi kandi yunamiye serivise ya televiziyo ya "Top Boy". Muri, umunyarwandakazi wo mu bakozi ba Davido na Popcaan abamenyesha abapolisi.
Album ya kabiri ya Davido A Good Time yasohotse ku wa 22 Ugushyingo 2019; ikubiyemo indirimbo z'indirimbo "If", "Fall", "Assurance", "Blow My Mind" na "Risky". Davido yafashe amashusho ya A Good Time i Atlanta; yabwiye ikinyamakuru Vibe ko yifuzaga gufata amashusho muburyo bushya. Davido yavuze ko album ari igitabo cyakozwe n'abantu bose, avuga ko igizwe ahanini n'abakinnyi b'ikipe ya Afrobeats ariko ko igizwe n'ibindi bintu byo mu zindi njyana. Davido yatangaje izina ry'iyi album mu birori byabereye i Lagos muri Nzeri 2019 avuga ko izasohoka mu kwezi gukurikiraho. Nanone yashyize hanze inyandiko z'indirimbo enye zo muri album mu gihe cy'iki gitaramo. Muri Nyakanga 2020, A Good Time yarenze miliyari 1 y'indirimbo zafashwe amajwi ku mbuga zitandukanye za digitale.
2020–2022: "A Better Time" and social media fundraising.
Muri Gicurasi 2020, Davido yagaragaye ari kumwe na Bwana Eazi na Tiwa Savage mu nkuru y’ikinyamakuru "Billboard" yise "Africa Now". Ikiganiro cyakozwe hifashishijwe guhamagarwa kuri videwo ; abahanzi bakemuye ingingo nyinshi, zirimo ubuzima buri muri karantine na afrobeats nkicyiciro.
Kuri Twitter, Davido yatangaje gahunda yo kumurika alubumu ye ya gatatu ya studio "A Igihe Cyiza". Yavuze ko yafashe amajwi 11 kuri iyi alubumu anatangaza ko iyi nyandiko izagaragaramo " Tiwa Savage " kandi ko we n'abantu bose bakoraga kuri iyi alubumu bateranije inzira mu minsi 14. Muri, Davido yagaragaye kuri "Tonight Show yakinnye na Jimmy Fallon" kugira ngo akore agace k'indirimbo ze "D&amp;G" na "Kugwa" kuri alubumu "Igihe Cyiza". Ku Kanama 2020, Inzu Ndangamurage ya Grammy yatangaje ko Davido ari umushyitsi wihariye mu kiganiro cyayo cyo ku wa mbere. Yitabiriye ibirori ndangamurage bya Instagram Live, byabaye nyuma yiminsi itatu. Ku ya 10 Nzeri 2020, yasohoye indirimbo yakozwe na Dammy Twitch yise "FEM", hamwe n'amashusho yayo.
"Igihe cyiza" cyasohotse ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 2020. Harimo abashyitsi bagaragaye muri Lil Baby, Nicki Minaj, Nas, Chris Brown, na Young Thug, n'abandi. Davido yafashe alubumu nyuma yo guhagarika urugendo rwe muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru 2019 biturutse ku cyorezo cya COVID-19 gikomeje. Ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 2021, Davido yasabye bagenzi be ndetse n’abafana kumwoherereza miliyoni imwe naira, maze avuga ko abatamutumyeho amafaranga batagomba kongera kwiteranya na we. Yakusanyije miliyoni 200 naira yongeraho miliyoni 50 naira y'amafaranga ye, yose ayatanga mu mazu y'imfubyi muri Nijeriya.
Muri Werurwe 2022, Davido yagaragaye ku ndirimbo " Hayya Hayya (Better together) " ari kumwe n'umuririmbyi w'umunyamerika Trinidad Cardona n'umuririmbyi wa Qatari Aisha. Indirimbo yagaragaye bwa mbere kuri alubumu yakusanyije "FIFA Igikombe cyisi Qatar 2022 Amashusho yemewe" (2022). Muri, Davido yasohoye indirimbo yakozwe na Pheelz " Hagarara ukomeye ", iyi ikaba ari yo ya mbere yasohoye wenyine muri uyu mwaka kandi ikubiyemo amajwi ya Korali yo ku cyumweru. Muri, Davido yatangaje iserukiramuco rye rya mbere ngarukamwaka ryitwa Are We African Yet (AWAY), ryabereye ahitwa Farm Farm Arena i Atlanta, Jeworujiya, ku ya 18 Ugushyingo 2022, rikaba ryarimo n'ibitaramo byakozwe na Kizz Daniel, Pheelz, Lojay na BNXN.
2023 - ubungubu: "Timiless", Nine + Records, na "5ive".
Muri Kamena 2022, Davido yabwiye ikinyamakuru "Rolling Stone" (Umuzingo)alubumu ye ya kane ya studio "Igihe" kitarangiye. 21 Werurwe 2023, yatangaje kuri Instagram iyi alubumu izasohoka ku ya 31 Werurwe. "Igihe" cyabaye alubumu ya mbere ya Davido mumyaka itatu. Yatangarije CNN umutwe wa alubumu, uwatunganije amajwi Don Jazzy yamusabye, ni ikigaragaza intego ye kugira ngo iyi alubumu yibukwe mu myaka ibarirwa muri za mirongo. Yatangarije kandi umuyoboro wamakuru alubumu yanyuze mu byiciro bitatu mbere yanyuma yayo. Album ya 17-track ikubiyemo ubufatanye na Skepta, Angelique Kidjo, Asake, Focalistic, Cavemen nabandi. wakozwe na Magicsticks, Rage, Darmie, Blaisebeatz, 1da Banton, Caltonic SA, Young Alpha n'abandi. Ahanini inyandiko ya amapiano, "Igihe kitarambiranye" cyerekana imiziki nka Dancehall, ragga, konto, highlife na Afropop. Ubuhanzi bwa Umuzingo(alubumu) yerekana igishusho cy'umutwe wa Davido, inzovu ebyiri zifunze, n'inzira iganisha ku masaha manini. Indirimbo ya kabiri yo muri ku umuzingo we " ishushanya mu Bwongereza, Ubusuwisi, Ubuholandi na Suriname, aho yageze ku mwanya wa mbere.
Davido yakiriye ibihembo bitatu mu birori bya 66 ngarukamwaka bya Grammy Awards, harimo umuzingo wa mwiza w'indirimbo wa mbere kwisi na Icyiciro cy’indirimbo cyangwa imbyino nyafurika zihiga izindi muri "Unavailable". Mu 2023, Chris Brown yerekanye Davido na Lojay ku ndirimbo ye yise " Sensational ", yasohotse nk'indirimbo ya kabiri muri alubumu ye ya cumi na rimwe muri studio "11:11". Iyi ndirimbo yerekanwe ku mwanya wa 96 kuri "Billboard Hot 100" yo muri Amerika, ikora nka Davido na Lojay ku nshuro ya mbere ku mbonerahamwe. Muri Mutarama 2024, Davido yashyizwe ku rutonde inshuro eshatu muri 55 ya NAACP Image Awards. Muri Mata 2024, Davido yashinze isosiyete ye yandika, Nine + Records, ku bufatanye na UnitedMasters. Mu, yabwiye ikinyamakuru "Rolling Stone" ko alubumu ye ya gatanu ya studio, "5ive", izashyirwa ahagaragara muri Werurwe 2025. Yatangaje kandi ko "Funds" igaragaramo umuraperi Odumodublvck n'umuririmbyi Chike, nk'indirimbo ya kabiri ya alubumu. Indirimbo ntangarugero ya Brenda Fassie yo mu 1997 "Vuli Ndlela".
Davido avuga ko ishyaka rye ry'umuziki abikesha nyina, maze akura yumva abaraperi Ja Rule na 50 Cent. Nk’uko "kibitangaza" ngo ubuhanzi bwe bugaragaza itandukaniro riri hagati ya Afrobeats, hip hop na R&amp;amp;B. Mu kiganiro na "Numéro", Davido yavuze ko yari umwe mu bagize itsinda rya hip-hop mbere yo kwerekeza muri R&amp;B hanyuma Afrobeats. Nk’uko umwanditsi Jon Pareles wanditse "ikinyamakuru New York Times" abitangaza ngo umuziki wa Davido wibanze ku ngingo zishimishije nko gukundana, kwifuza, no gutekereza neza. N'ubwo yanenzwe kuba afite "ijwi ryijimye kandi ryijimye", Emmanuel Daraloye yashimye imikorere ya Davido mu majwi kuri udakendera. By'umwihariko, Daraloye yamuhaye inguzanyo yo kujya "ku birenge" hamwe na Fave kuri "Kante" no gutanga "igitabo cyo hasi cyashyizwe hasi" ku ndirimbo "Ku Muhanda".
Ku ya 6 Mata 2012, "Imyidagaduro yo muri Nijeriya Uyu munsi" yatangaje ko Davido yasinyanye na MTN miliyoni 30 zama pound. Muri ayo masezerano, Davido yabaye isura ya MTN Pulse, ubukangurambaga bugamije kwamamaza urubyiruko rwo muri Nijeriya. Ku Ukwakira 2013, "Pulse Nigeria" yatangaje ko Guinness Nigeria yasinyanye na Davido amasezerano yo kwemeza. Mu rwego rw’amasezerano, yakoreye igitaramo muri Guinness World of More Concert ari kumwe n’abahanzi barimo P-Square, D'banj, Wizkid, Ice Prince, Burna Boy, Olamide, Phyno, Chidinma, Waje na Tiwa Savage.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, Davido yasinyanye amasezerano yo kwamamariza Infinix Mobile, uruganda rukora telefoni rukorera muri Hong Kong. Muri, yabaye ambasaderi w’ikirango ku isoko rya 1xBet. Mu Kwakira 2021, ambasaderi w'ikirango cya cognac Martell cyatangaje ko ari ambasaderi mushya. Mu, Davido yasinyanye amasezerano n’uruganda rukora inkweto Puma maze aba ambasaderi w’ibirango ku isi.
Davido yabyaye abana batandatu; abakobwa batatu n'abahungu batatu (umwe muri bo yapfuye).
Ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2022, ikinyamakuru "Peoples Gazette" cyatangaje urupfu rw'umuhungu mukuru wa Davido n'umwana wa gatatu David Ifeanyi Adeleke Jr., warohamye muri pisine yo koga mu rugo rwa se I Banana ; yari afite imyaka itatu igihe yapfaga. Polisi yakoze iperereza ku bakozi bo mu rugo rwa Davido. Abakozi umunani bo mu rugo batumiwe kuri sitasiyo ya polisi kugira ngo babazwe nyuma yuko umwe yari amaze kumenyesha polisi impanuka yo kurohama. Nyuma y’iperereza ry’abapolisi, abakozi batandatu bararekuwe abandi babiri bakomeza gufungwa.
Muri Werurwe 2023, Davido yemeje ko yashakanye n'umugore we bamaranye igihe kirekire, Chioma Rowland. Ku ya 25 Kamena 2024, yakoresheje ibirori by'ubukwe ahitwa Harbour Point mu kirwa cya Victoria, i Lagos. Ibirori byitabiriwe nabantu benshi bakomeye, barimo Olusegun Obasanjo na Babajide Sanwo-Olu. Davido yanditswe na Deangelictouchstylist, Lucky Enemuo, na Ugo Monye.

Jayson Andrew "Mick" Jenkins (yavutse ku wa 16 Mata 1991) ni umuraperi wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika uba i Chicago, kandi ukorera munsi y’inzu itunganya umuziki ya Cinematic. Yamenyekanye cyane binyuze mu mushinga we "Water" wasohotse muri 2014, hakurikiraho umuzingo mugufi w'indirimbo "Waves" muri 2015.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Jenkins yavukiye i Huntsville, muri Alabama. Nyuma yo gutandukana n'ababyeyi be, yimukiye i Chicago, muri Illinois ari kumwe na nyina na mushiki we afite imyaka icyenda. Nkumwana, Jenkins yayobowe cyane nababyeyi be bakunda umuziki. Nyina yumvaga Neo-soul, mugihe se yakundaga umuziki w'Imana wo muri iki gihe. Igihe Jenkins yari afite imyaka 17 gusa, yatangiye kujya afungura indangururamajwi muri Young Chicago Authors, ihuza abanditsi bato. Mick Jenkins yize muri Hirsch Metropolitan High, aho yatangiye kwitabira ibigeragezo by'agashinyaguro ku ishuri ryigisha amategeko muri iryo shuri mu 2008. Amahirwe aboneye, yaje kuba umunyeshuri wimenyereza umwuga mu rukiko rw'inyubako nkuru ya Dirksen i Chicago. Jenkins yarangije amasomo ye mu by'amategeko mu mwaka wa 2009, ubwo yabaga uwimenyereza umwuga muri Sir &amp; Madame, iduka ry'imyenda, maze muri make aba umuntu wifuza kwerekana imideli. Nyuma muri 2009, yasubiye i Huntsville kwiga muri kaminuza ya Oakwood, nyuma afungwa iminsi 34 ashinjwa amakosa. Oakwood ni ishuri ryigenga ryifatanije n’itorero ry’Abadiventisti bo ku munsi wa karindwi. Mu mwaka wa kabiri wa Jenkins ku ishuri, yinjiye mu marushanwa ya rap, aho igihembo cyari Udukoresho tw’amatwi tw'umuziki twa Beats By Dre. Jenkins ntabwo yatsinze iri rushanwa, ariko avuga ko byamuteye kuvumbura ishyaka ryo gukora umuziki. Jenkins yaje kuva muri Oakwood nyuma yuko se abuze akazi ku ishuri, bivuze ko amashuri ataragikomeje. Jenkins avuga ko yasohoye imvange zindirimbo eshanu akiri muri kaminuza, nubwo nyuma yaje kuzirengagiza akazikura kuri interineti. "Mickstape" hamwe na "Gukurikirana Ibyishimo: Inkuru ya MickalasCage", zo ziracyaboneka. Mu mwaka wa 2012, Jenkins yemeye icyaha aregwa cyo gutunga urumogi. Yaje gufungwa iminsi 34 muri Alabama, mbere yo gusubira i Chicago kwibanda ku muziki.
2012–2013: Intangiriro yumwuga, "Ibiti &amp; Ukuri", hamwe nuruvange.
Ku ya 13 Mutarama 2012, Jenkins yasohoye imvange ye ya mbere yemewe, "The Mickstape", ikurikirwa na "The Pursuit of HappyNess: The Story of Mickalascage" muri Kanama Muri 2012, Jenkins yasubiye i Chicago maze yinjira muri YCA (Young Chicago Authors), itsinda ry’imivugo, aho yaririmbiye umurongo wa mbere utazirwa nka akapera. ["citation needed"] Ibi byatumye abahanzi bafata amajwi baho, hamwe numuyobozi witsinda rya Pivot Gang rya Chicago, Saba bamwitondera. Bombi bahise bakorana mundirimbo, yitwa "Heaux", yari igenewe umushinga wa Mick Jenkins, ariko barangije bagaragara kuri mvanjye ya Saba "GETCOMFORTable" (2012). Jenkins yabaye kandi umwe mu bagize itsinda rya hip-hop, ryitwa Free Nation. Abandi banyamuryango barimo Prop, J-Stock, Burman, na Maine Uwera. Igihugu cyigenga ni "itsinda rya hip hop riteza imbere ibitekerezo byo guhanga utakiriye ibitekerezo bigufi byashyizweho nububasha".
Muri Mata 2013, Jenkins yasohoye imvange "ye y'ibiti &amp;amp; Ukuri". Kaseti yahise ikundwa cyane mu karere, irimo umusaruro jazz, ibivugwa muri Bibiliya, hamwe n'indirimbo ye ikabije. Nyuma y'amezi make gusa irekuwe, ubufatanye hagati ye na bagenzi be b'abaraperi ba Chicago Chance The Rapper na Vic Mensa bwaje mu ndirimbo imwe "Crossroads" imwe, iyi ndirimbo kandi yarashimwe cyane kandi yakirwa neza.
2014–2015: "Amazi" "n'imiraba".
Muri Nyakanga 2014, Jenkins yagarutsweho cyane nyuma y’isohoka ry’indirimbo ye ndetse n’amashusho yitwa "abahowe" "Imana", ibyo bikaba byaragaragazaga ubushishozi ku kuri gukabije kw’umuryango hamwe n’ifata ryiza. Indirimbo ikangura ibitekerezo yari ifite ubutumwa ku ihohoterwa rikorerwa imbunda, intambara hagati y'umutimanama we no gutsinda gushya, ndetse n'ubwana bwe bw’imivurungano i Chicago. "Abahowe Imana" yoboye abantu bakomeye mu muryango wa hip-hop nka Timbaland, kugira ngo bagere kandi bashimire Jenkins impano ye ya muzika ndetse n’amagambo akomeye. Ku ya 12 Kanama, Jenkins yashyize ahagaragara umushinga we, "Amazi," kugira ngo ashimwe. Ugereranyije indi mishinga yagiye asohora, "Amazi" yibanze ku gitekerezo cyo kugereranya amazi nukuri kwubuzima.] [4 ​ Urugendo rwe rwa mbere rwemewe rwabaye muri Gashyantare 2015 hamwe Knight, Noname na Saba. Yifatanyije kandi na Joey Bada $$ na Denzel Curry mu cyiciro cya 1 cyuruzinduko rwabo ku isi. ["citation ikenewe"]
2016: "Ibice bikiza".
Ku ya 17 Kanama 2016, Mick Jenkins yasohoye indirimbo ya mbere muri alubumu ye ya mbere yari itegerejwe cyane, "Spread Love". Ku ya 25 Kanama 2016, Jenkins yasohoye indirimbo ye ya kabiri ya alubumu yise "Kurohama", igaragaramo igikoresho cyakozwe na quartet ya jazz ikorera mu mujyi wa Toronto BADBADNOTGOOD. Indirimbo ivuga mu buryo butaziguye urupfu rwa Eric Garner, umwirabura wanizwe n'abapolisi. Iyi alubumu, "The Healing Component", yasohotse ku ya 23 Nzeri 2016. Indirimbo nyinshi ziri kuri alubumu zirimo intore na outros hamwe n'ibiganiro byerekeranye n'urukundo n'umugore uvuga inkuru, mushiki we. "Healing Component", mu magambo ahinnye ya THC, yerekana insanganyamatsiko yurukundo muri alubumu. Kuva ku kwikunda kugeza kuburambe bwurukundo, ahuza uburyo butandukanye urukundo rushobora gufata.
2017–2020: "Cyangwa" Urukurikirane rw'imizingo y'indirimbo migufi, "Ibice byumugabo" na "sirusi".
Ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 2017, Mick Jenkins yasohoye "Cyangwa Ibindi; Amaganya", imvange ya mbere mu ruhererekane rw'imishinga Jenkins asobanura ko ari "urukurikirane rw'umushinga urimo ibitekerezo n'ibitekerezo bya muzika birimo gutera inkunga alubumu." Imvange ya kabiri murukurikirane, "Cyangwa Birenzeho; Kwiheba", yasohotse ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2018. Ku ya 26 Ukwakira, alubumu ye ya kabiri ya studio, "Piece of a Man", yashyizwe ahagaragara. 2021: "Inzovu mu cyumba".
Ku ya 8 Ukwakira 2021, Mick Jenkins yatangaje alubumu ye ya gatatu yari yitezwe yise "Inzovu mu Cyumba", yasohotse ku ya 29 Ukwakira. mbere, "Truffles" yasohotse ku ya 23 Kamena 2021. Indirimbo ya nyuma ya alubumu "Scottie Pippen" yasohotse ku ya 22 Ukwakira
Ku ya 7 Nyakanga 2023, Jenkins yatangaje alubumu ye ya kane "Yihangana", asohora indirimbo yayobowe na JID "Smoke Break-Dance" kuri uwo munsi. Iyi alubumu yerekanye ko yasohotse bwa mbere nyuma yo kuva muri Groupe yumuziki ya Cinematike, ubu akaba akora kubufatanye na RBC Records na BMG. Indirimbo ya kabiri ya alubumu, "Guapanese" yasohotse ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2023
2025: "andika ubusa", "Ibiteye ubwoba" "n'ubwicanyi bw'inkongoro".
Ku ya 16 Mutarama 2025, Jenkins yasohoye "umuzingo mugufi andika umwanda", gusa kurubuga rwa muzika kumurongo. Uwo muzingo watumye rap ya Jenkins y "ubwoko bwa beats" yisanga kuri YouTube, maze asobanura inzira iri inyuma yo gusohora, avuga ko umushahara muto abahanzi bakura ku mbuga za muzika. Yagaragaje kandi ko ari intangiriro y "icyiciro gikurikira muri muzika", asezeranya umuziki n’ibirimo kuzagera mu 2025. Nyuma y’amezi arindwi, Jenkins yasohoye indirimbo ebyiri zitwa "Scarecrows", zigizwe n’ubufatanye na Smino na Ab-Soul.

Anna Saba Lykke Oehlenschlæger (; wavutse ku ya 11 Kanama 1997), uzwi cyane nka Saba (yandikwa mu nyuguti nkuru), ni umuririmbyi w’Umunyetiyopiya-Umunyadanishi, akaba anakina amafilime ya muzika ndetse anakora umwuga wo kumurika imideli. Mu mwaka wa 2024, yahagarariye Danemarke mu irushanwa rya Eurovision ahatanishijwe indirimbo ye “Umusenyi”, maze agera mu cyiciro cya nyuma cy’iryo rushanwa
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Anna Saba (amazina y’amavuko ni Saba Lykke Oehlenschlæger) n’uwasanganywe inda imwe Andrea (wavutse yitwa Sara) bavukiye i Addis Ababa ku ya 11 Kanama 1997. Baje gutoranywa bakajyanwa mu miryango ibarera bafite amezi umunani, maze bakurira i Ringkøbing muri Danemarke kuva ku ya 10 Mata 1998. Akiri umwana, Oehlenschlæger yakiniye ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ya DBU Jutland.
Nyuma yo kuva mu mashuri yisumbuye, Oehlenschlæger na mushiki we bimukiye i Copenhagen, batangira kuba umunyamideli na rwiyemezamirimo mu bicuruzwa byera amenyo, mu gihe mushiki we yakoraga umwuga wo kuririmba no gucuranga. "]", agitangira bwa mbere nkumukinnyi wa stade udasanzwe.
Ku ya 25 Mutarama 2024, Saba yatangajwe nk'umwe mu bitabiriye, umukino wanyuma wigihugu cya Danemark kumarushanwa yindirimbo za Eurovision 2024, hamwe nindirimbo "Umusenyi". Yakomeje gutsinda umukino wa nyuma ku Gashyantare 2024, abona uburenganzira bwo guhagararira Danemark mu marushanwa ari imbere. Ku ya 29 Werurwe 2024, abinjira benshi barimo Saba, basohoye itangazo rihuriweho risaba "guhagarika imirwano bidatinze kandi birambye" muri Gaza, ndetse no "gutahuka mu buryo butekanye ingwate zose". Saba yananiwe kwitabira imikino ya kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza ku ya 9 Gicurasi 2024, ashyira uwa 12 kuri 16 n'amanota 36.
Muri 2018, Oehlenschlæger bamusanganye indwara ya bipolar I maze ajyanwa mu bitaro inshuro nyinshi kugeza muri 2020, nk'uko yabisobanuye muri filime ya DR DR 2020 (transl. 'Impanga yanjye yasaze'). Yitoje kandi kwigirira nabi mu myaka ye y'ubwangavu. Ni ambasaderi w’ishyirahamwe ry’ihungabana rya Danemark.
Oehlenschlæger yari afitanye umubano na Lærke-Maria Schmidt kuva muri 2020 kugeza muri 2023

Kara Elizabeth Walker (wavutse ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 1969) ni umunyamerika wo muri iki gihe ushushanya akoresheje amarangi, gucura ibyuma, umwanditsi, gutegura urubyiniro, umukinnyi wa firime, na mwarimu ukora ubushakashatsi ku moko, igitsina, ubuzima bw'imyororokere, urugomo, n’irangamuntu mu kazi ke. Azwi cyane nkuwakoze igishushanyo kinini kizwi kw'izina tableaux yumukara ikoze mu mpapuro zishashagirana nkibyuma. Walker yahawe igihembo cy'ubusabane cya MacArthur mu 1997, afite imyaka 28, aba umwe mu bakiri bato bahawe igihembo. Yabaye iicyitegererezo mu buhanzi bugaragara mu ishuri ry’ubuhanzi rya Mason Gross kaminuza ya Rutgers kuva mu
Walker afatwa nkumwe mu bahanzi bakomeye kandi bazwi cyane mu b'Abanyamerika b'Abirabura bagikora muri iki gihe.

Nadia Buari (yavutse kuwa 21 Ugushyingo 1982) ni umukinnyi wa filme ukomoka muri Gana. Nadia Buari yahataniye ibihembo 2 (nominated) by'umukinnyi mwiza wunganira (best actress in a leading role) mu bihembo bya Africa Movie Academy Awards byo muri 2009.
Nadia Buari yavukiye mu mujyi witwa Oil City muri Gana, Abyarwa n'Ababyeyi babanyagana na wabyaye abana 5, abyara impanga inshuro 2 Nadia Buari avuka ari uwa 5. Yize mu ishuri rya Mfantsiman_Girls'_Secondary_School riherereye mu murwa hagati, muri kaminuza yiga ibijyanye n'ubuhanzi muri University_of_Ghana ahakura bachelor (impamyabumenyi) mu buhanzi (Fine Arts) Mu gihe cyose yamaze muri University_of_Ghana yabarizwaga mu mahuriro y'imbyino n'ikinamico (drama and dance clubs).
Mu mwaka wa 2005 Nadia Buari yatangiriye umwuga wo gukina filme muri filme y'uruhererekane yacaga kuri televiziyo yo muri Gana yitwa Games People Play. Filme ye ya mbere ikomeye yakinnyemo ni Mummy's Daughter abona gukina mu yitwa "Beyonce: The president's daughter" ayikinamo yitwa Beyonce ikaba ariyo filme yamumenyekanishije cyane. Augustine Miles Kelechi Okechukwu (wavutse ku wa 17 Ukuboza 1992), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Tekno, ni umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w’indirimbo ndetse n’utunganya imiziki wo muri Nijeriya. Indirimbo ye “Enjoy” niyo film yuruhererekana inyura kuri TV Winning Emmy Ted Lasso (Igice cya gatatu n'igice cya karindwi).
Kelechi akomoka mu karere ka Ivo, Intara ya Ebonyi, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Nijeriya. Yavukiye muri Leta ya Bauchi mu muryango w'abana batandatu - abahungu batanu n'umukobwa umwe.] ​​​​Yakuriye mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu birimo Nasarawa State, Kaduna (umurwa mukuru wa Kaduna State), ndetse na Abuja (umurwa mukuru w’Igihugu cya Nijeriya), kubera ko se yakoraga mu gisirikare cya Nijeriya Tekno Miles afite imyaka 8, yiyandikishije mu ishuri ry’umuziki aho yize kandi akaba n'umuhanga wo gucuranga piyano na gitari. Ni umuvandimwe mukuru wundi muhanzi muri nijeriya witwa spotless
Tekno Miles niwe wambere wasinyishijwe na K-Money Entertainment. Indirimbo ye yise "Holiday",yasohowe ku izina rya Imprint, kandi irimo ijwi ry’umuhanzi w’icyamamare Davido, "Holiday" yakiriwe neza kandi Ibona amajwi menshi.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, Tekno Miles yagaragaye n’umunyarwenya uzwi cyane wo muri Nijeriya witwa Julius Agwu mu birori byabereye i Abuja, nyuma yuko Tekno Miles yakiriye amashyi menshi nyuma yo gukora indirimbo yise "Onye Ne Kwu", remix ye yise "Oleku". Muri ibyo birori niho yahuye na Iyanya na Ubi Franklin, umuyobozi wa Made Men Music Group maze baba inshuti. Ubi na Iyanya amaherezo bashishikarije Tekno Miles kwimukira i kugirango ateze imbere umwuga we wa muzika.
Ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2013, yasinyanye amasezerano yo gufata amajwi na Made Men Music Group "(MMMG)", aho yasohoye indirimbo nka "Dance" na "Anything". Aba baseribateri bamuhesheje igihembo mu cyiciro cya "Best New act of the Year" mu birori byo kwidagadura muri Nigeria 2014. Ku ya 18 Kamena 2015, Tekno Miles yasohoye indirimbo ye yise "Duro", yakozwe na DJ Coublon. "Duro" yakiriwe neza haba muri Afurika ndetse no muri Amerika. Remix yagaragayemo na yasohotse ku ya Indirimbo yakozwe na DJ Coublon hamwe na video iyobowe na AJE Filmworks. Ku Ukuboza 2016, Tekno yagizwe umwe mu mpano icumi za mbere za hip-hop na R&amp;B kureba muri Amerika muri 2017 na Billboard. tekno izwi kandi nka Pana shobuja yahinduye izina ayita Big Tek
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Elton John yakinnye indirimbo ya Tekno yise 'Diana' kuri kimwe mu bice bye bya radiyo Isaha ya Radio kuri.
Icyakora, ku wa 13 Ukwakira 2017, Tekno yagaragaye na DJ Cuppy ku ndirimbo yise "Green Light", iyi ikaba yari indirimbo ya mbere ya DJ Cuppy.
Ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2017, Umuraperi wo muri Kanada Drake yashyize amashusho ye hamwe na Tekno ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram, yandikaho ngo "Igi fata igihe "
Ku wa 10 Kanama 2018, Umuhanzi w’umunyamerika Ciara, yifatanyije na Tekno, mu bufatanye bwiswe "Freak Me." Kuri uyu wa Tekno yatangaje ko iyi ndirimbo yasohotse kandi agaragaza ibihangano bitwikiriye kuri konte ye ya Instagram @teknoofficial.kuwa gatanu
Ku wa 15 Kanama 2019, Tekno yatangajwe nk'umwe mu batunganya 'Won't Be Late' na Swae Lee uafatanyije na Drake
Muri Kamena 2018, Tekno yasinyanye amasezerano yo gukwirakwiza na Universal Music Group Nigeriya (UMGN), ishami ry’umuziki wa Universal Music Group ishinzwe Afurika y’iburengerazuba, ndetse n’ikirwa cyitwa Records cyitwa UK. Muri, Tekno yagaragaye kuri Beyoncé ' "" y'amajwi y'indirimbo "Don't Jealous Me".
Ku wa 6 Ukuboza 2020, Tekno yashyize ahagaragara urutonde rwa alubumu ye ya mbere yari itegerejwe na benshi, "Old Romance". Mu 2022, yagaragaye muri ' ' afataniyije na Kizz Daniel, inzira yabaye injyana ya mbere ya shazamed mu mwaka umwe. Nanone, muri uwo mwaka, Davido yerekanye uburyo Tekno yagize uruhare mu kubyutsa umwuga we mu gihe gikomeye cyane ubwo yari akeneye imbaraga nshya.
Umuhanzi Tekno wo muri Afro-pop yashyize ahagaragara amashusho yindirimbo ye yise "Puttin". Inyuma ya alubumu ye yamenyekanye cyane mu 2023, The More The Better, igihembo -gutsindira umucuranzi wa producer wo muri Nigeriya akaba na producer, Tekno, yatangije ibihe bishya bya muzika n'indirimbo ye aheruka kwitwa Wayo. Iyi ndirimbo nshya niyambere itanga ubufatanye bwe bushya na emPawa Afrika ya Mr Eazi, izabona Tekno abaye umushoramari nabafatanyabikorwa muri label.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, umukunzi wa Tekno yibarutse umwana w'umukobwa. Muri 2020, Tekno yatangaje ko yimukiye muri Amerika. Iki cyari igisubizo ku makuru y’icyifuzo cyatanzwe mu Nteko ishinga amategeko ya Nijeriya yo guhindura izina ry’igihugu muri UAR, kikaba cyari amagambo ahinnye y’igihugu cya Afurika yunze ubumwe cyangwa Repubulika yunze ubumwe ya Alkebulan ku ya 2 Kamena.
Muri 2017, Tekno yamenyesheje rubanda ko afite aside irike. Ibintu byari bimaze kuba ingorabahizi kandi amaherezo byagize ingaruka ku ijwi rye. Yagombaga kubagwa kugira ngo akemure icyo kibazo.
