Basilika ya Sagrada Família yubatswe hashingiwe ku gishushanyo mbonera cya Antoni Gaudí, ikirangirire mubwubatsi. Iherereye hagati mumujyi wa Barcelona, ikaba imaze imyaka irenga ijana iri kubakwa, kandi biteganyijwe ko iyi inyubako izarangira umwaka utaha.
Basilika ya Sagrada Família ubu ifite uburebure bwa metero 162.91, ikaba iciye kunyubako y'urusengero rwo mu Budage rwitwa Ulm minster yari urusengero rurerure kuva mu 1890.
Ulm Minster, ni urusengero rwa gikiristu rwubatswe hagati y'umwaka wa 1543 na 1890, ni rwo rwari rusanzwe rufite uwomwanya, rukaba rufite uburebure bwa metero 161.5. Ubu Sagrada Família yarurengejeho metero imwe, kuko ifite metero 162.91.
Ibuye ryambere rya Sagrada Família ryashyizweho mu 1882.

Ramba Hills, ni umushinga w'ikigo Investment Africa Holdings Ltd, kibarizwa i Kigali, kikaba gifite ishami ryitwa Ramba Real Estate ari ryo rizaba ricunga ibikorwa bya Ramba Hills.
Uyu mushinga wubakwa muri Gasabo, mu Murenge wa Kacyiru, hepfo y’Ibitaro bya King Faisal, hafi y’inzira ijya muri Vision City no ku kibuga cya Golf cya Kigali. Uteganyijwe kurangirana n’imyaka ine.
Ramba Hills izaba igizwe ninyubako ndende ebyiri n'izindi zizigaragiye ziringaniye, ubusitani bugari butaga amahumbezi, ubwogero rusange, parikingi nini,imihanda myinshi n'ibindi urebeye kugishushanyo mbonera.
Mu gice cy’imbere hateganyijwe inzu 10 zigeretse rimwe zo guturamo, ziteganyijwe ku ruhande rureba ku Kibuga cya Golf cya Kigali. Zizaba zifite ubusitani bunini bwihariye ndetse n’imihanda inyuramo.
Ku rundi ruhande, hagiye kubakwa imiturirwa ibiri miremire, imwe ifite amagorofa 26 indi 24. Hegereye izo, hari izindi nyubako enye zindi z’amagorofa: imwe izaba ifite 16, indi 12, n’indi 10. Muri izo nyubako ebyiri ndende cyane, imwe izaba ikorerwamo n’ibiro, indi igenewe guturwamo.
Uyu mushinga uri mukiciro cyo kurushaho guhindura isura y'Umujyi wa Kigali, ariko n'imibereho y'abanyamujyi ikarushaho kuba myiza bigendanye no kubona ahantu hagezweho ho gutura no gukorera

Visi Perezida w’u Rwanda (Igifaransa: Visi-président rwandais, Kinyarwanda: visiperezida) yari umwanya wa politiki mu Rwanda washyiriweho Paul Kagame kuva muri Nyakanga 1994 kugeza muri Mata 2000. Uyu mwanya wakuweho mu mwaka w'2000.
Uyu mwanya wabayeho no mu itegeko nshinga ry’u Rwanda kuva 1961 kugeza 1973. Icyakora, uwo mwanya ntiwigeze ushyirwaho umuntu n'umwehagati ya 1961 na 1969.

Dwayne Michael Carter Jr. Dwayne Michael Carter Jr. (wavutse ku wa 27 Nzeri 1982), uzwi cyane nka Lil Wayne, ni umuraperi wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Akunze gufatwa nk’umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye ba hip-hop b’igihe cye, ndetse no mu baraperi bakomeye mu mateka. Yavukiye kandi akurira i New Orleans, aho yaje gutahurwa na Birdman mu 1993 maze asinya muri Cash Money Records afite imyaka 11. Yakomeje kwamamara muri iri tsinda kugeza igihe ayivamo muri 2018.
Carter yashyizwe bwa mbere mwitsinda rimwe na Cash Money labelmate BG muri 1994 - bazwi nka BG'z - maze basohora alubumu yiswe "inkuru y'ukuri" muri uwo mwaka, nubwo Carter (icyo gihe yitwaga Baby D) yagaragaye kuri eshatu gusa. Carter na BG bahise bashinga itsinda rya Hot-hop ryamajyepfo Hot Boys hamwe na bagenzi babo Juvenile na Turk muri 1997, basohora alubumu yabo ya mbere, "Get It How U Live!" uwo mwaka. Hot Boys yigaruriye abantu muri rusange nyuma yo kumurika alubumu yabo ya kabiri "Guerrilla Warfare" (1999) ndetse no kugaragara mundirimbo imwe ya BG, " Bling Bling ". Iri tsinda ryaratandukanye nyuma ya alubumu bitewe na buri munyamuryango (usibye Carter) aho buri wese yaciye inzira ze, nubwo indi alubumu imwe "'Em Burn" (2003) - yasohotse nyuma.
Alubumu ya mbere ya Carter ya studio, "Tha Block Is Hot" (1999), yari intambwe ihambaye nkumuhanzi wenyine, aho byazamuye ubucuruzi bwe. Yakurikiwe na "Light Out" (2000) na "500 Degreez" (2003). Carter ashimwa kuba yarahinduye imvange zindirimbo hamwe nuburyo bwe bushya mu myaka ya za 2000.] "[" "2" Album ye ya gatandatu, "Tha Carter III" (2008), yagize akamaro kanini mu mwuga wa Wayne, mu cyumweru cya mbere yagurishijwe miliyoni zirenga imwe mu gihugu. Yatsindiye Album nziza ya Rap muri Grammy Awards ku nshuro ya 51 kandi ishyigikirwa na Billboard Hot 100 ku ndirimbo " Lollipop " (irimo Static Major), hamwe no mu ndirimbo icumi za mbere hajemo " A Milli " na " Yabonye Amafaranga " (irimo T-Pain).
Alubumu ya karindwi ya studio ya Carter, "kuvuka bundi bushya" (2010), yagerageje rap ya rock hanyuma isohoka mubusanzwe yakiriwe nabi. Ukwezi kumwe kurekuwe, yakatiwe igifungo cy’amezi 8 azira gutunga imbunda akomoka ku byabaye muri 2007. Alubumu ye ya munani, "Ntabwo ndi Umuntu" (2010), yasohotse mu gihe yari afunzwe, mu gihe alubumu ye ya cyenda, "Tha Carter IV" (2011), yasohotse nyuma amezi avuye muri gereza. Nubwo hari ibitekerezo bitandukanye, "Tha Carter IV" yagurishijwe ibice 964,000 mucyumweru cyayo cya mbere muri Amerika Aulubumu ye ya cumi na kabiri ya studio, "Tha Carter V" (2018) - yabanjirijwe na "Ntabwo ndi Umuntu wa II" (2013) na "Alubumu ya Free Weezy" (2015) - yasohotse nyuma y’ubukererwe bw’igihe kirekire n’amakimbirane yo mu itsinda ryamuteguriraga umuziki, maze igira ibice 480,000 mu kugurishwa mucyumweru cya mbere. Alubumu ye ya cumi na gatatu, Gushyingura (2020), ibaye alubumu ye ya gatanu idakurikiranye numero ya mbere. Muri Kamena 2025, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya cuminakane, "Tha Carter VI".
Carter yagurishije inyandiko zisaga miliyoni 120 ku isi yose, harimo alubumu zisaga miliyoni 25 na miliyoni 95 zikoreshwa mu buryo bwa digitale muri Amerika, bituma aba umwe mu bahanzi ba muzika bagurishije cyane ku isi. [1 2 ​​ Muri Nzeri 27, 2012, yabaye umuhanzi wambere wumugabo anyuze kuri Elvis Presley wanditswe cyane kuri Billboard Hot 100, hamwe n'indirimbo 109. Carter yashinze itsinda ritunganya umuziki Young Money Entertainment muri 2005, yasinyishije abahanzi barimo Drake, Tyga na Nicki Minaj.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Dwayne Michael Carter Jr. yavutse muri Nzeri 27, 1982. Yamaze imyaka ye ya mbere mu gace gakennye ka Hollygrove ka Uptown New Orleans, Ward ya 17 ya Louisiana. Nyina, umutetsi, yamubyaye afite imyaka 19. Ababyeyi be baratandukanye afite imyaka ibiri, kandi se yataye burundu umuryango. Mu kiganiro 2009, umunyamakuru wa CBS News Katie Couric yabajije uyu muraperi impamvu yakoresheje izina Wayne aho gukoresha izina rye. Carter yarashubije ati: "Nzakubwira impamvu nakuyeho D hano hano kuri TV. Nakuyeho D kuko nari ndi muto. Data, ariho, kandi ntabwo ari mubuzima bwanjye kandi ntabwo yigeze aba mubuzima bwanjye. Sinshaka rero kuba Dwayne. Nahitamo kuba Wayne." Couric yabajije niba se abizi, maze Carter, aseka ati: "Ubu arabizi." Carter yavuze ko abona umugabo washatse nyina nyuma nyakwigendera Reginald "Urukwavu" McDonald ari se nyawe. Carter afite tatouage yeguriwe McDonald.
Carter yiyandikishije muri gahunda yimpano mwishuri ryibanze rya Lafayette. Nyuma yaje kwiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Eleanor McMain imyaka ibiri, aho yari umunyeshuri w’icyubahiro akaba n’umunyamuryango w’ikinamico, akina Tin Man mu ishuri ryakozwe na "The Wiz". 1 Nyina wa Carter yafashe icyemezo cyo kumukura ku ishuri kubera umutekano we. Ku myaka 15, Carter yari atangiye kwamamara mubikorwa bya muzika; nyina yemeje ko agomba kuva mu mashuri yisumbuye nyuma yo kubona imbunda yapakiye mu gikapu cye kugira ngo yirinde.
Carter yanditse indirimbo ye ya mbere ya rap afite imyaka umunani. Mu mpeshyi yo muri 1991, yahuye n’umuraperi washinze Cash Money Records Bryan "Baby" Williams (uzwi ku izina rya Birdman), wamutoje kandi amutera inkunga yo gukunda hip-hop; Birdman yashyizemo Carter mundirimbo za Cash Money, kandi (mukwitura) yakundaga gufata amajwi mato kumashini isubiza ya Williams.
Mu 1994, afite imyaka 12, Carter yakomerekejwe n’amasasu hafi y’igituza. Icyo gihe, yavuze ko gukomeretswa byabayeho ku bw'impanuka. Icyakora, muri Nzeri 2018, Carter mu biganiro yavuze ko byari ukwiyahura nyuma yo kubwirwa na nyina ko agomba guhagarika amashyirahamwe ye afitanye isano na rap. Carter ashimira umupolisi ubu utari mu kazi Robert Hoobler (1956–2022), uwo yise "Uncle Bob", ko yarokoye ubuzima bwe ashimangira ko umwana uri hafi gupfa ajyanwa mu bitaro mu modoka ya polisi aho gutegereza ko ambulance iboneka. Izindi konti zerekana ko hari abandi abapolisi benshi bagize uruhare muguhitamo no gushyira mubikorwa iyo nzira.
1994–1999: Intangiriro yumwuga nabahungu Bashyushye.
Nyuma yo gukira igikomere cy’amasasu, Carter yahujwe na Christopher Dorsey, umuraperi wo muri New Orleans uzwi ku izina rya BG, inshuti ye kuva kera, umukunzi wa Cash Money hamwe na mugenzi we Hot Boys. Nyuma baza gushinga bombi, BG'z, BG yitwa "Lil Doogie" na Carter yitwa "Baby D". Basohoye alubumu imwe gusa mwizina ryitsinda, "Inkuru Yukuri" (1995).
Mu 1997, Carter na Dorsey bahise binjira muri quartet hip-hop, Hot Boys, hamwe nabaraperi nabandi bagenzi babo, Juvenile, na Turk. Amaze kwinjira afite imyaka 14, Carter yari umunyamuryango muto muri kiriya gihe. Alubumu ya mbere ya Hot Boys, "Get It How U Live!", yasohotse muri uwo mwaka, muri uwo mwaka wa 1999 yakurikiwe na alubumu ikomeye yitsinda muri rusange ya "Guerrilla Warfare", yageze ku mwanya wa mbere ku mbonerahamwe ya Alubumu "rwa Billboard" Top R &amp; B / Hip-Hop na nimero ya gatanu kuri Billboard 200. Mugihe cyumwuga wabo, Hot Boys yari ifite indirimbo ku mbonerahamwe ebyiri, " Turi kwaka " kuva kuri "Get It How U Live!" na " Nkeneye Umukobwa ushyushye " kuva kuri Guerrilla Warfare. Itsinda ryasangiye indirimbo, " Bling Bling ", hamwe nandi matsinda ya Cash Money, itsinda rya babiri Big Tymers (bigizwe na Birdman na producer Mannie Fresh). Umurongo wa Carter muri iyo ndirimbo wumvikanye gusa ku ndirimbo yagombaga kunyura kuri radiyo, mugihe kuyariri kuri alubumu yumvikanye aririmba agace gato rusange. "Bling Bling" yagaragaye kuri Album y'abanyamuryango ba Hot BoG, "Chopper City muri Ghetto", yasohotse muri Mata 1999. Carter yitabiriye no kuririmbana na Juvenile mu gihangano “Back That Azz Up”, cyaje kugera ku mwanya wa 18 ku rutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100, kandi kigaruka ku mwanya wa 5 mu ndirimbo z’imbere muri R&amp;B na Hip-Hop.
"Bareke bashye", alubumu irimo zitashyizwe ahagaragara yanditswe na quartet mugihe cya 1998 na 2000, yasohotse muri Werurwe 2003, hashize imyaka myinshi itsinda rimaze gusenyuka. Yageze ku mwanya wa gatatu ku mbonerahamwe ya Top R &amp; B / Hip-Hop, ariko ntiyitwaye neza kuri "Billboard" 200 aho yaje kuri nimero cumi na kane.
1999–2004: "Uruhande rushyushye", z"imya amatara", na "Dogere 500".
Alubumu ya mbere ya Carter wenyine, "Uruhande rushyushye", yasohotse ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 1999, ubwo yari afite imyaka 17 kandi agaragaza imisanzu ikomeye yatanzwe na Hot Boys. Yatangiye ku mwanya wa gatatu kuri Billboard 200 nyuma iza kwemezwa na platine na RIAA mu Kuboza 1999, bitarenze ukwezi isohotse. "]" Iyo alubumu yatumye mu 1999 atoranywa na Source magazine nk'umuhanzi mushya wahize abandi iza mw'icumi zambere zigezweho Indirimbo yari iyambere ya alubumu yari ihagarariye izindi, iyo korasi yayo ikaba yarakozwe nuwahoranye na Carter muri Hot Boys, Juvenile na BG
2004–2006: "Tha Carter", "Tha Carter II", na "Nka Data, Nk'umuhungu" "we".
Ku ya 29 Kamena 2004, Album ya kane ya studio ya Carter, "Tha Carter", yashyizwe ahagaragara, ibyo bikaba byerekana icyo abanenga batekereza ko ari iterambere mu njyana ye yo kuririmba no ku nsanganyamatsiko. Byongeye kandi, ibihangano bitwikiriye alubumu byagaragaye bwa mbere kuri Wayne-umukono wa dreadlock. "Tha Carter" yamenyekanye cyane na Wayne, agurisha kopi 878,000 muri Amerika, mu gihe indirimbo " Go DJ " yabaye eshanu za mbere ku rutonde rwa "Billboard" Hot R &amp; B / Hip-Hop. Nyuma y’isohoka rya "Tha Carter", Lil Wayne yagaragaye ku ndirimbo yise “ Umusirikare ” ya Destiny's Child hamwe n’umuraperi TI wa Atlanta, wageze ku mwanya wa gatatu kuri Billboard Hot 100 hamwe n’indirimbo Zishyushye za R &amp; B / Hip-Hop.
2006–2007: Indirimbo zivanze nizo yafatanyije n'abandi.
Aho gukurikirana alubumu imwe yonyine, Carter yatangiye kugera kubamuteze amatwi abinyujije mu mvange nyinshi ndetse n'abashyitsi bagaragara kuri pop zitandukanye, R&amp;B na hip hop. Mu mvange nyinshi, "Kwiyegurira 2" na "Da Amapfa 3" byakiriye ibitangazamakuru byinshi kandi bisubirwamo. "Kwiyegurira Imana 2", byasohotse mu 2006, byahujije Carter na DJ Drama kandi bikubiyemo inzira yamenyekanye cyane mu mibereho, "Georgia Bush", remix ya Field Mob na Ludacris '" Jeworujiya ", aho Carter yanenze igisubizo cyahoze ari perezida w’Amerika George W. Bush ku ngaruka z’umuyaga Katrina wagize mu mujyi wa New Orleans. "Da Dought 3" yarekuwe umwaka ukurikira kandi yaraboneka kubuntu kubuntu. Harimo Carter kuririmba hejuru yibitaramo bitandukanye uhereye kumuririmbyi uherutse gukorwa nabandi bahanzi. Ibinyamakuru byinshi bizwi cyane bya hip hop nka "XXL" na "Vibe" byerekanaga imvange. Christian Hoard wo mu kinyamakuru "Rolling Stone" yasuzumye imvange "Da Amapfa 3" "n’amapfa ararenze 2 (Carter 3 Sessions)" "muri alubumu nziza zo mu 2007".
2007–2010: "Tha Carter III", "Turi Abanyamafaranga bakiri bato", no "kuvuka ubwa kabiri".
Muri 2007, Carter yavuze ko azongera guhura na Hot Boys, afite gahunda yo kumurika alubumu nyuma yuko Alubumu ya BG yonyine "Too Hood to Be Hollywood" irangiye. Ubusanzwe "Tha Carter III" yari iteganijwe gusohoka mu 2007, ariko yaratinze nyuma y’amajwi menshi yamenyekanye kandi akwirakwizwa hifashishijwe imvange, harimo "n’amapfa yarangiye Pt." "2" kandi "Amapfa ararangiye Pt." "4". Mu Kuboza, Lil Wayne yateguye gusohora "The Leak", alubumu itandukanye irimo indirimbo zasohotse hamwe n'inzira enye ziyongera, ku Kuboza 18, 2007, hamwe na "Tha Carter III" yatinze kugera muri Werurwe 18, 2008. Ahubwo, "The Leak" yabaye EP ifite indirimbo eshanu kandi yasohotse muburyo bwa digitale mukuboza 25, 2007.
2010–2013: "Ntabwo ndi Urukurikirane rw'umuntu" na "Tha Carter IV".
Mu kiganiro kuri Mixtape ya MTV ku wa mbere, Carter yatangaje ko hasohotse "Tha Carter IV". Nyuma yaje gutangaza ko izasohoka mu mpera za 2009 mbere y’ikiruhuko. Birdman yari yavuze mbere ko "Tha Carter IV" izasohokana na "Rebirth" nka alubumu ya disiki ebyiri. Carter yabihakanye, avuga ko " "Tha Carter IV" ikwiye "Tha Carter IV" ", yongeraho ko "Turi bato babanyamafaranga" ishobora gusohokana hamwe no "Kuvuka ubwa kabiri". Izi alubumu amaherezo zasohotse zitandukanye. ["citation ikenewe"]
Carter yasohoye alubumu ye ya munani, "Ntabwo ndi Umuntu", ku myaka 28 y'amavuko, Nzeri Iyi alubumu yasohotse mu gihe Carter yari afunzwe ashinjwa gutunga intwaro. Iyi alubumu yagurishije kopi zirenga 953000 muri Amerika havamo indirimbo yatsindiye " Right Hejuru Yayo ", yaje ku mwanya wa gatandatu kuri Billboard Hot 100. Iyi alubumu nayo yagaragaye ku mwanya wa kabiri, ariko nyuma iza ku mwanya wa mbere kuri "Billboard" 200, bituma Carter aba umuraperi wa mbere mu gihe yari afunzwe (kuva Album ya Tupac Shakur yashyizwe ku mwanya wa "mbere" kugeza mu 1995).
"Tha Carter IV" yatinze mu 2011, nyuma yuko Lil Wayne atangiye gufata amajwi kuva kera nyuma yo kuva muri gereza. Yasobanuye ko indirimbo ye ya mbere kuva yasohoka ari "verisiyo ya "A Milli" yo muri 2010 kuri steroid". Indirimbo ya mbere ya "Tha Carter IV", " 6 Foot 7 Foot " irimo Cory Gunz, yasohotse mu Kuboza 15, 2010. Ku ya Werurwe 8, Carter yasohoye indi ndirimbo, "Tugarutse vuba", nubwo itari yashyizwe kumurongo wemewe wa "Tha Carter IV". Indirimbo, " John ", irimo Rick Ross, yasohotse muri Werurwe 24. ["citation ikenewe"] Mu kiganiro cyo muri Werurwe 29, Carter yatangaje ko azasezera afite imyaka 35; kuvuga ngo "Numva ndikunda njya muri studio mugihe ari ingingo ikomeye" mubuzima bwabana be bane. Mu gihe cyimyaka ibiri hagati ya 2010 na 2012, Carter yagiye agaragara mu ndirimbo nyinshi zamenyekanye nka " Nabikoze (Cash Money Intwari) " na Kevin Rudolf, " Miss Me ", "Motto ", na " HYFR (Hell Ya Fucking Right) " na Drake, " Nta rukundo " na Eminem, "Kanda kuri Light " na Jay, " " Ndi kuri Umwe ", " Bijyana ku mutwe ", na " Nta Nshuti Nshya " by DJ Khaled, " Motivation " ya Kelly Rowland, " Ballin" "na Young Jeezy," Ibicu bidasanzwe "by BoB," Ndashobora gutekereza gusa "by David Guetta," Fade "na Tyga," Pop That "by French Montana, na" Bandz a Make J D.
Ibikorwa bya "Tha Carter IV" byashyizwe ahagaragara muri Mata 20. Ubusanzwe byari biteganijwe kurekurwa muri Gicurasi 16, yatinze inshuro nyinshi kugeza yemejwe ko izarekurwa ku ya 29 Kanama 2011. Muri Gicurasi 26, indirimbo ya gatatu ya alubumu, " Uburyo bwo Gukunda ", yasohotse. Yasohoye indi nzira, "Nshuti Anne (Stan Igice cya 2)", muri Kamena. ["citation needed"] Mu rwego rwo kwitegura "Tha Carter IV", Carter yasohoye imvange, "Ihangane 4 Tegereza", bisa na mixtape ye "No Ceilings" (2009); mixtape yongeye gusohoka kuri serivise zitangwa muri Mutarama 2022 hamwe ninzira enye ziyongera.
2014–2019: "Album ya Weezy Yubusa" na "Tha Carter V.".
Ukwakira 18, 2013, uwahoze ari visi perezida wa Cash Money Records ushinzwe kwamamaza Mel Smith, yanditse kuri Twitter ati: "Umunsi mwiza wa gatanu !! Umuziki mushya wa YMCMB uza vuba !! Carter 5." Nyuma y'amezi hafi ane, mu kiganiro na "The Griffin", yasohotse muri Gashyantare 14, 2014, Smith yagize icyo avuga kuri alubumu iri hafi: "Turi hafi cyane yo guhagarika alubumu. Bizatungura abantu bose... Sinshobora gusohora itariki kuko ashaka gutangaza abantu." 15, mu gitaramo cya Drake mu birori bya NBA All-Star Weekend muri New Orleans, Carter yagaragaye nk'umushyitsi mbere yo gutangaza ko "Tha Carter V" azasohoka muri Gicurasi 5, 2014. Muri Werurwe 2014, Carter yongeye kuvuga mu kiganiro yagiranye na SXSW ko "Tha Carter V" yaba alubumu ye ya nyuma.
Ibitekerezo bya politiki n'amoko.
Muri 2013, Carter yakiriwe nabi nyuma yuko amashusho yasohowe na TMZ amweretse bigaragara ko akandagiye ibendera rya Amerika. Carter yaje gusobanura ko "Ntabwo nigeze ngambirira gusuzugura ibendera rya Amerika", kandi ko arimo gufata amashusho y'indirimbo kuri alubumu ye yise, "Imana Ihe umugisha Amerika". Avuga ko intego y'ibendera yari iyo kwerekana ko "inyuma y'Ibendera ry'Amerika hari Hoods ya Amerika".
Mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2016, Carter yagize icyo anenga ku mutwe wa Black Lives Matter, agira ati: "Ntabwo numva mfitanye isano n'ikintu kibi ntanafite aho mpuriye nacyo. Niba ubikora, uri umusazi nk'umwanda," yongeraho ko kuba afite umwirabura w'umukire ufite abakunzi b'abazungu ari gihamya ko abirabura bahabwa agaciro muri Amerika.

Primus Guma Guma Super Star mu mpine PGGSS ni Amarushanwa yabaga buri mwaka y'Abahanzi baririmba mu Rwanda.
PGGSS yaterwaga inkunga na Primus lager ya Bralirwa, ariko aya marushanwa agategurwa na East African Promoters (EAP) akaba yarabaga mu rwego rwo gufasha Abahanzi no guteza imbere uruganda rw'umuziki mu Rwanda. Aho aya marushanwa atanira n'andi amenyerewe nka Tusker Project Fame cyangwa American Idol akunze gukoresha abahanzi baririmba batari bamenyekana, Primus Guma Guma Super Star yo itabirwaga n'Abahanzi bamaze kugira amazina akomeye mu Rwanda (nka Tom Close, Bruce Melodie, King James, Riderman, Dream Boys n'abandi.. bagahangana bagamije gutsindira amafaranga yateganyijwe nk'igihembo, bazenguruka igihugu bataramira abafana babo.
2013 ubwo yabaga ku nshuro ya 3, Aya marushanwa yaramaze gufata indi ntera akunzwe, yitezwe na benshi bakunda umuziki nyarwanda, aho abanyamakuru ndetse n’abasesengura mu myidagaduro mu Rwanda bashimiye Primus Bralirwa kuba yaranye igikorwa nk'iki kinini mu Rwanda.
2019 Mushyoma Joseph uzwi nka Boubou uyobora EAP yabwiye ikinyamakuru IGIHE ko iri rushanwa ritazongera kuba ndetse ko Bralirwa na East African Promoters (EAP) yabafashaga kuritegura bari kugirana ibiganiro byo gushaka ikindi gikorwa bafatanya gukora cyateza imbere abahanzi, nk'uko PGGSS yari imaze imyaka igera ku munani ibikora. ni nyuma y'uko Bruce Melodie ariwe muhanzi waruritsindiye muri 2018.
PGGSS yagiye igira impaka nyinshi nko mu mwaka wa 2013, havugwaga urutavugarumwe mu itangazamakuru bashinja Bralirwa ndetse na EAP babashinja kuba baribeshye bagatsindisha umuraperi Riderman atariwe warukwiriye gutsinda.

Simbiatu “Simbi” Abisola Abiola Ajikawo (wavutse ku ya 23 Gashyantare 1994), Yamenyekanye cyane ku izina rye ryambere Little Simz, ni umwongerezakazi uririmbi injyana na rap hamwe numukinnyi wa filime. Ni umuhanzikazi wamenyekanye cyane binyuze mu mizingo ye itatu ya mbere yakoze ku giti cye: Curious Tales of Trials + Persons (2015), Stillness in Wonderland (2016), na Gray Area (2019). Uyu wa nyuma washyizwe ku rutonde rw’ibihembo bya Mercury Prize, kandi utsindira ibihembo bya Ivor Novello mu cyiciro cya Alubumu Nziza, ndetse unabona intsinzi muri NME Awards.
Alubumu ye ya kane, "Rimwe na rimwe nshobora kuba intore" (2021), Yakunzwe cyane n’inzobere mu muziki, kandi ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byayigaragaje nk’iyo hejuru mu 2021. Iyi alubumu yegukanye igihembo cya Mercury Prize 2022, inatuma nyirayo ahabwa Brit Award y’Umuhanzi mushya w’umwaka 2022 ndetse na Libera Award yo muri Hip-Hop/Rap. Album ye gatanu, Oya Urakoze (2022), yasohotse kugirango ashimwe. Mu 2024, yagaragaye ku ndirimbo " Turasenga " ya Coldplay, ari kumwe na Burna Boy, Elyanna, na Tini. Alubumu ye ya gatandatu ya studio, "Lotus", yasohotse ku ya 6 Kamena 2025.
Hanze yumuziki, Ajikawo yakinnye muri Netflix yububyutse ikinamico "Top Boy". Yagaragaye kandi nka we muri filime "Venom: Reka habeho ubwicanyi" (2021).
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Ajikawo yavukiye Islington, London, ku babyeyi ba Nigeriya. Yakuriye mu isambu hamwe na bashiki be bakuru. Nyina na we yari umurezi mu bwana bwe. Ni ubwoko bwa Yoruba.
Yize mu ishuri rya Highbury Fields i Londres kandi yiga no mu rubyiruko rw’urubyiruko rwa St Mary mu Muhanda wo hejuru, Islington, ari kumwe na Leona Lewis na Alexandra Burke. Ajikawo yashimiye Club y'urubyiruko ya Mary uruhare yagize mu mwuga we, avuga ko ari "ahantu byose byatangiriye kuri njye home inzu ya kabiri".
Nyuma Ajikawo yize muri Westminster Kingsway College na kaminuza ya West London aho yakomereje umwuga we wa muzika.
Asobanura umuziki we nka rap nubushakashatsi. Mu gihe afitanye isano rya hafi n’ubwoko bwa grime, yanakuye imbaraga mu zindi njyana zirimo reggae, blues, synth-rock na jazzy R&amp;B.
Ajikawo yakuze yumva abahanzi ba rap Busta Rhymes, Nas na Biggie Smalls, byamuteye gukora umwuga wo gufata rap. yakunze kuvugwa nkimwe mubintu byamugizeho ingaruka. Ajikawo yagize ati "Ndatekereza ko "Miseducation ya Lauryn Hill" yari amashuri yanjye rwose. Lauryn Hill yari umwe mu bahanzi ba mbere batumye numva imbaraga z'umuziki." Yakuye kandi imbaraga ku bahanzi ba jazz Nina Simone, John Coltrane na Billie Holiday kuri alubumu ye "Rimwe na rimwe nshobora kuba intore". Ibindi byamuteye inkunga harimo ikigirwamana cye Kendrick Lamar, wamwitaga "umuntu mubi ubikora ubu" mu
2015–2017: Intangiriro yumwuga "nigitekerezo cyamatsiko yikigeragezo + Abantu" no "gutuza muri Wonderland".
Ajikawo yakoreye ibitaramo muri Rising Tide, iluvlive, Gufata Inganda (Iterambere ry’imijyi) Ingoma ya Hackney, Inzu ya Somerset n'inzu ya ba nyagasani. Yakinnye kandi muri BBC 1Xtra Prom 2015 muri Royal Albert Hall, ari kumwe na orchestre yuzuye iyobowe na Jules Buckley. Ajikawo arashobora kumvikana kuri "Leave to Remain" amashusho yindirimbo, akora indirimbo "Kureka Nukwo". Mu ntangiriro za 2013, yagaragaye kuri Radiyo BBC 1Xtra kugira ngo aganire ku mikorere ye muri weekend ya Hackney. Ajikawo yagiye gukora isomo rya Maida Vale kuri Huw Stephens. Yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere muri studio, "Amatsiko Y’ibigeragezo + Abantu", ku ya 18 Nzeri 2015.
2018–2021: "Agace keza", "Kamanuka 6" kandi "Rimwe na rimwe nshobora kuba intore".
Ajikawo asohora umuziki we "kumyaka ye bwite yumuziki 101" Yanditseho umuziki hamwe na AWAL Recordings. Ku ya 6 Nzeri 2018, Ajikawo na label ye AGE 101 basinyanye amasezerano n’isi yose na AWAL Recordings, nyuma yuko AWAL imaze gukwirakwiza alubumu ye ya mbere yise "Amatsiko y’amatsiko y’ibigeragezo + abantu" mu 2015. Aya masezerano yongerewe ku ya 18 Kamena 2020.
Ajikawo aba i Londres. Ni inshuti yo mu bwana bwumukinnyi Fady Elsayed numukinnyi wa filime Letitia Wright. Ajikawo na Wright bakomeje kuba inshuti nziza kandi Ajikawo yafotoye Wright kubera ibihangano by'indirimbo ye yise "Kwikunda" mu mwaka wa
Ajikawo numufana wa Arsenal FC
Muri 2018 inshuti ye, umunyamideli Harry Uzoka, yarishwe, byamuteye inkunga yo kwandika indirimbo ye "Ibikomere".
Umwuga we wo gukina wa Ajikawo watangiriye akina ari Vicky mu kiganiro cy’abana ba BBC cyitwa Spirit Warriors, cyatangajwe mu mwaka wa 2010, ndetse na Meleka muri televiziyo ya E4 "Youngers". Yavugaga kuri televiziyo "Afrofuturism", na Shelley mu isubukurwa rya Netflix rya "Top" "Boy", ryerekanwe bwa mbere mu mpeshyi ya 2019.

Tobi Adeyemi (yavutse ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 1988), uzwi cyane nka tobi lou, ni umuhanzi ufite inkomoko muri Nijeriya no muri Amerika; akaba akora umwuga wo kuririmba, kwandika indirimbo, kurapa no gutunganya umuziki.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Tobi Adeyemi yavukiye i Lagos akurira i Chicago. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Homewood-Flossmoor ndetse n’ishuri ryisumbuye rya Hinsdale, ari naho yatangiye gufata amajwi. Yize muri kaminuza ya Illinois aho yakinnye umukino wa baseball hanyuma SUNY Albany na kaminuza ya Florida A&amp;amp;M, aho yakinaga umupira wamaguru wa kaminuza mumakipe yombi. Nyuma yo kutandikwa mu mushinga wa MLB wa 2011, yakinnye imyaka 2 ya kimwe cya kabiri cya baseball ya Joliet Slammers nkumukinnyi wo hanze mbere yo kugenda muri 2012 kubera imvune. Mu 2014, yimukiye i Los Angeles kugira ngo akomeze umwuga we wa muzika. Igihe yari i Los Angeles, yakoraga nk'umushoferi wa Uber.
2015–2018: Intangiriro na "tobi lou na" Trilogy.
Ku ya 16 Nzeri 2015, Adeyemi yasohoye indirimbo ye ya mbere, "Pretty Please". Muri 2015, yasohoye indirimbo "Uruhinja rwawe" ku izina rya Wonda. Ku ya 9 Gashyantare 2018, yasohoye umuzingo w'indirimbo mugufi wa mbere, "tobi lou n'ukwezi". Ku ya 8 Werurwe 2018, yasohoye indirimbo "Troop" irimo Smino. Ku ya 9 Werurwe 2018, Ikitari Cyasohoye alubumu "Ntabwo Ibintu Byiza Byose", byari bikubiyemo indirimbo "Monsters" irimo Adeyemi na Michael Noheri. Ku ya 27 Mata 2018, yasohoye imizingo mito y'indirimbo "tobi lou na" "Loop", zari zirimo indirimbo "Buff Baby", yamamaye cyane kuri TikTok. Ku Kamena 2020, "Buff Baby" yemejwe na zahabu n’ishyirahamwe ryandika amajwi muri Amerika. Ku ya 10 Kanama 2018, yasohoye imizingo mito y'indirimbo "tobi lou n'umutobe". Ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2018, yatangiriye ku mbonerahamwe ya Billboard Next Big Sound, igera ku mwanya wa 8. Ku ya 18 Ukuboza 2018, Penomeco yasohoye umuzingo muto w'indirimbo "ubusitani" bwe, bwagaragayemo Adeyemi ku ndirimbo "Cool". Adeyemi na Marc E. Bassy bifatanije na Kyle mu ruzinduko rwe "Lightpeed" 2018.
2019–2022: "Baho ku rubura, Lingo Starr," kandi "Ntishobora Kurimbuka".
Muri 2019, Adeyemi yatangiye urugendo rwe rwa mbere, urugendo "Ibyishimo + Birenze Agahinda" hamwe na Liltrxptendo na femdot. Urugendo rwatangiye ku ya 12 Nzeri 2019 i Minneapolis, rukarangira ku ya 20 Ukwakira 2019 i Chicago. Ku ya 2 Kanama 2019, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere yuzuye ya studio yuzuye, "Live On Ice," yerekana abashyitsi bagaragaye muri Erica René, Cam O'bi, Rockie Fresh, Soundbwoy, sawa (K), Glassface, Vernon, Ryan Destiny, Djemba Djemba, na LeJKeys. Iyi alubumu yageze kuri 45 ku mbonerahamwe yigenga ya Amerika yigenga na 14 ku mbonerahamwe ya Heatseekers yo muri Amerika. Ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2019, yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 50 kuri Bandsintown x Billboard US Rising Artists Index. Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2019, Ryan Destiny yasohoye indirimbo "Kimwe" irimo Adeyemi. Adeyemi yagaragaye ku ndirimbo "Sengera Ukuri" ya Peter CottonTale, hamwe na Chance the Rapper, kuri Album ya CatchTale "yitwa Catch", yasohotse ku ya 17 Mata 2020. Indirimbo yageze kuri 24 ku mbonerahamwe ya Gospel Airplay. Adeyemi yagaragaye ku ndirimbo "Maroc" ya Kota Inshuti, kuri alubumu ye "Byose", yasohotse ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2020. Ku ya 3 Nyakanga 2020, yasohoye "EP ya Lingo Starr". Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2020, yasohoye indirimbo "Okay" hamwe na Dreezy. Ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2020, Saba yasohoye indirimbo "Areyoudown? Pt. 2", irimo Adeyemi. Ku ya 23 Mutarama 2021, yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 2 ku rutonde rwa Billboard Top Chicago Emerging R &amp; B / Hip-Hop Abahanzi 2021. Ku Werurwe 2022, hasohotse alubumu ye ya studio "Non-Perishable", igaragaramo abashyitsi ba T-Pain, Jean Deaux, na Chika. Iyi alubumu yageze ku mbonerahamwe ya Billboard yo muri Amerika Yagurishijwe, 46 ku mbonerahamwe yo kugurisha Album ya Amerika muri iki gihe, na 5 ku mbonerahamwe ya Heatseekers yo muri Amerika. Ku ya 2 Mata 2021, Rockie Fresh yashyize ahagaragara alubumu "Slid Thru Pt 2", irimo Adeyemi na Jeff Kaale ku ndirimbo "Gucci". Ku ya 25 Werurwe 2022, yashyizwe ku mwanya wa 33 ku mbonerahamwe y’abahanzi Emerging Abahanzi. Ku ya 29 Nyakanga 2022, Album ya Warren Hue "y’umuhungu w’umwaka" yasohotse, irimo Adeyemi ku ndirimbo "Mu gikapu cyanjye."
2023 - ubungubu: "Ikirere cya Baggy", "Mumbabarire Natinze", kandi "Niyubashye".
Ku ya 31 Werurwe 2023, yasohoye alubumu "Baggy Weather", igaragaramo abashyitsi ba Chief Keef na eaJ, nk'umwihariko kuri porogaramu ye ya TobiLoop. 'Mini-verisiyo' ya alubumu yasohotse umunsi umwe kuri serivise zitangwa. Ku ya 5 Gicurasi 2023, yasohoye umuzingo muto windirimbo "Mumbabarire Natinze". muri T-Pain mu ruzinduko rwe """ Guhunga Kuva Wiscansin: Igitero " mu mpeshyi ya 2023. Muri, yatangaje urugendo rwa "Perish Ubururu" hamwe na grouptherapy. Urugendo rutangira ku ya 21 Nzeri 2023 i Houston, rukarangira ku ya 29 Ukwakira 2023 i Phoenix. Ku ya 15 Nzeri 2023, yasohoye indirimbo "Cobra" irimo Young Thug. Ku Ukwakira 2023, Adeyemi yitwaye nka K'Sante muri Ligue ya Legends itsinda ryitwa Heartsteel, hamwe na Baekhyun, ØZI, na Cal Scruby, mu ndirimbo yabo ya mbere yise "Paranoia".
Tobi Lou yatangaje ko abahanzi barimo André 3000, The Notorious BIG, Will Smith, Tupac, NSYNC, Timbaland, Frank Ocean, Missy Elliott, Maroon 5, Pharrell Williams, na Kanye West bamutera inkunga.

Ama Serwah Genfi (wavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1994), uzwi cyane nka Amaarae, ni umuhanzi w’indirimbo akaba n’umwanditsi. Yamenyekanye mu buryo bwe budasanzwe buhuriza hamwe pop, R&amp;B, Afrobeats na alté, ndetse n’imyambarire iranga ubwisanzure n’igitsina. Nyuma yo gukorana n’abahanzi bo mu karere no gusohora indirimbo nto zitarimo alubumu, mu 2017 yashyize hanze umuzingo mugufi we wa mbere yise Passionfruit Summers.
Muri 2020, Amaarae yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere "Umumarayika Utazi" gushimwa. Indirimbo " Sad Girlz Luv Money " irimo Moliy yamenyekanye cyane kuri TikTok. Mu 2021 indirimbo yasubiwemo hamwe na Kali Uchis kandi ishushanyije ku isi yose. Pitchfork yanditse alubumu "Umuziki mushya mwiza" maze ayita alubumu ya 19 nziza ya 2020.
Ku ya 9 Kamena 2023, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya kabiri yari itegerejwe na benshi "Isoko Baby" kugira ngo itangwe ibitekerezo.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Amaarae yavukiye i Bronx, muri New York kwa Ama Bawuah na Kwadwo Boateng Genfi akurira hagati ya Atlanta, New Jersey na Accra, muri Gana. Ni mukuru w'abana babiri. Amaarae yanditse indirimbo ye ya mbere afite imyaka Yibutse imvugo idasanzwe ya Kelis yamubereye umwete.
Yize mu ishuri mpuzamahanga rya Gana imyaka mike. Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yatangiye gukora imvange y'umuziki. Afite imyaka 17, yimenyereje muri studio yumuziki. Mu kigo cya kaminuza, yitoje amajwi kandi yubahiriza ubuhanga bwe bwo kwandika indirimbo yiga ubuvanganzo bw'icyongereza. Yasubiye muri Gana muri Kamena 2017.
Amaarae yanditse imvange y'indirimbo ye ya mbere, "Muri Splendid Isolation", ISI muri make, afite imyaka 17 igihe yari muri Gana. Irimo indirimbo "Yaje Mbere", Amaarae yakiriye "Cassie" ya Cassie na Ryan Leslie, n'indirimbo "CrukdStr8", azunguruka kuri " A $$ " ya Big Sean.
Amaarae yashyize ahagaragara umushinga we wa mbere "Passionfruit Summers" muri 2017. Iyi alubumu irimo indirimbo "Fluid", yunganirwa n'amashusho y'indirimbo.
Amaarae yagizwe "umwe" mu bahanzi bashya bakunzwe muri Afurika muri Mata imurikagurisha ryabereye i Lagos, muri Nijeriya.
Ku ya 12 Ugushyingo 2020, Amaarae yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio, "Umumarayika Utazi". Owen Myers wo muri "Pitchfork" yanditse ko "bivuguruzanya no guhanga udushya, mu gihe abantu bakomeye bo mu nganda bakanguka ku kuri kuva kera ko Afurika ishyiraho umuvuduko w’umuziki wa pop."
Ku ya 14 Mata 2025, Amaarae yakoze amateka nk'umuhanzi wa mbere wo muri Gana wakoze wenyine ku giti cye mu iserukiramuco ry'umuziki n'ubuhanzi rya Coachella. Imyitwarire ye kuri Stage ya Gobi yagaragayemo inzira n'indirimbo zidashyizwe ahagaragara n'abahanzi bo muri Gana nka La Même Gang, Eazzy, Joey B, na Asakaa Boys. Muri iki gitaramo, yatangaje alubumu ye yise "Black Star" kandi yiyogoshesha umutwe kuri stage, iyi ikaba yarashimishije cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.
Ku ya 8 Kanama 2025, Amaarae yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya gatatu "Black Star". Amashusho yindirimbo yemewe ya "Fineshyt" nayo yasohotse kumunsi umwe.

Marian Azeb Mereba, uzwi nka Mereba, ni umuhanzi w’Umunyamerika uririmba, ucuranga hip-hop, ukandika indirimbo, akaba anakora umuziki nk’umutunganya bwite.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Mereba yavukiye i Montgomery, muri Alabama, akurira muri Pennsylvania. Se akomoka muri Etiyopiya. Nyina ni Umunyamerika kandi yavukiye kandi akurira i Milwaukee, muri Wisconsin. Umuryango we wimutse kenshi kubera akazi k'ababyeyi be nk'abarimu ba kaminuza.
Mereba yabanje gukunda umuziki afite imyaka ine. Yatangiye kwandika indirimbo mu mashuri abanza yiga gucuranga piyano na gitari. Yize amashuri yisumbuye i Greensboro, muri Karoline y'Amajyaruguru.
Mereba yize muri kaminuza ya Carnegie Mellon mbere yo kwimukira muri Spelman College. Yarangije muri Spelman mu 2011 afite impamyabumenyi y’icyongereza n’umwangavu muto.
2013–2017: "Icyumba cyo Kubamo", "Radio Flyer", n'umudugudu wa Spillage.
Nyuma yimyaka itari mike akora ibitaramo muri muzika yindie muri Atlanta, Mereba yishyize ahagaragara umushinga we wa mbere wumuzingo w'indirimbo ngufi "Icyumba cyo Kubamo", ku izina rye ryuzuye, ku ya 14 Gashyantare 2013.
2018–2019, 2021: "Ishyamba ninzira yonyine yo gusohoka" &amp; "Glock Peaceful".
Mu mwaka wa 2018, Mereba yasinyanye na Interscope Records, " ahita asohora indirimbo "Ikamyo" "Yirabura" " na "Umubumbe.
Ku ya 13 Ukuboza 2021, Mereba yasohoye "Glock Peaceful", iteganya igihugu kitarangwamo ihohoterwa rikorerwa imbunda n'ubugome bwa polisi. Indirimbo yagaragaye kuri saison 5 yikiganiro "Umutekano muke" wakozwe na Issa Rae kuri HBO Max.
2024-ubungubu: "Umuyaga watwitse umuriro".
Mu Kwakira 2024, byatangajwe ko Mereba yasinyanye amasezerano n’umunyakanada rwihishwa, asohora indirimbo "Impimbano", yabaye iyambere muri alubumu ye ya kabiri "yitwa The Breeze Grew a Fire," yasohotse ku ya 14 Gashyantare 2025.
Mereba yavuze ko Stevie Wonder nk'umujyanama ndetse n'umuziki ukomeye. Muri 2017, yakinnye hamwe na Wonder muri Malibu.

Osayaba Andrew Ize-Iyamu, uzwi cyane nka Cruel Santino, ni umuhanzi wo muri Nijeriya uririmba, yandika indirimbo, arapa kandi akanayobora amashusho. Ari mu itsinda rya Monster Boys hamwe n’abatunganya umuziki Genio Bambino na GMK. Afite amasezerano na Interscope Records mu bufatanye na Monster Boy, ndetse na Warner Chappell Music. Yatangiye kumenyekana cyane nyuma yo gusohora alubumu ye ya mbere Mandy &amp; The Jungle, yamufashije kumurika injyana ya alté no kuyamamaza, cyane cyane binyuze mu ndirimbo ye “Rapid Fire".
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Osayaba Andrew Ize-Iyamu yavukiye i Lagos ku ya 3 Kamena 1992, akurira Ikeja. Yari umuhuzabikorwa wikinamico yingimbi mumashuri yisumbuye. Amaze kurangiza amashuri, yitabiriye gahunda y'umujyi wose nk'umuririmbyi wuduce duto. Mu kiganiro na GQ yo mu Bwongereza, yagize ati "Numvise alubumu ya mbere ya Drake, Urakoze Nyuma. Kumva umuntu uririmba na rap byanyemeje ko nshobora kubikora." Se yari ashinzwe kwumwigisha umuziki we, mumikurire ye.
2011–2016: Ozzy B kuri Santi, Gushyingura Suzie, Ubwoba bwa Gangsta.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, yatangije umwuga we wa muzika nk'umuraperi kuri SoundCloud, ku izina rya stage Ozzy B. Ku ya 13 Nzeri 2011, yasohoye imvange y'imirongo 21 yiswe "Diaries of Loner", kuri SoundCloud. Mu isuzuma rya We Plug Music Nziza, Neefemi, yagize ati "umushinga ni umwe mu mvange nziza ya Nijeriya hamwe nigihe". Ku ya 29 Nzeri 2013, yasohoye ivanga rye rya kabiri "Ivuka rya Santi". Mu mwaka wa 2016, yahinduye izina ry'ubuhanzi ayita Santi, hasohotse umuzingo we wa mbere wagutse "wo gushyingura Suzie", abinyujije kuri Monster Boy ku ya 30 Kamena 2016.
Ku ya 29 Kamena 2016, "Gangsta Fear" indirimbo yahimbye, yanditswe na Odunsi Moteri, gutandukana na SoundCloud, hamwe nibintu bya afro-Dancehall. Nyuma yo gusohora amashusho yindirimbo iyobowe na Falomo na Santi ubwe. Inyandiko yabaye intsinzi mubucuruzi mubindi bice bya muzika, muri Nijeriya, no mubwongereza.
2017–2018: Ijwi rya OVO, Gukubita 1, Ibitaramo, umuriro wihuse.
Muri 2017, yafunguye Skepta mu gitaramo Cyacu cyo gutaha muri Nijeriya. [​​​ Ku ya 29 Ukuboza 2017, yafunguye Show Dem Camp muri Palmwine Music Fest, ari kumwe na Bez, Ajebutter22, Lady Donli, Odunsi, Tomi Thomas, n'abandi. Ku ya 21 Mutarama 2018, Santino, Odunsi, MAKA, na Lady Donli, kivuga ku kinyamakuru cyitwa Guardian Life Magazine, Vibes Of The New Age Edition, aho bavugaga kuri gahunda zabo z'ejo hazaza.
Ku ya 2 Ugushyingo 2018, nka Santi, yasohoye "Rapid Fire", irimo Shane Eagle, Tomi Agape, na Amaarae binyuze kuri Monster Boy, kandi yakozwe na Genio Bambino. Nyuma y’ikiganiro yagiranye na Julie Adenuga, na Ebro Darden, kuri Apple Music 1, yamenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Muri 2018, yasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye na Carolina y'Amajyaruguru - ashingiye ku buryo budasobanutse, kandi asohora "imihango yo gushyingura Suzie".
2019–2020: Mandy &amp; Ishyamba, Inyandiko zandika, Nta marira mu ishyamba ryerekana.
Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 2019, ku izina rye rya mbere ryitwa Santi, Santino yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio "Mandy &amp; The Jungle", agaragara cyane muri DRAM, GoldLink, Tay Iwar, Amaarae, Krisirie, Nonso Amadi, Bridge, Shane Eagle, Kida Kudz, Seki, na Tomi Agape. Hamwe n'inguzanyo zitangwa na Odunsi (Moteri), GMK, Higo, LeMav, DOZ, na Genio Bambino. Mandy &amp; The Jungle, yavuzwe nka imwe muri alubumu Murinzi hamwe na tracks zo muri 2019.
Ku ya 28 Kanama 2019, Santino uzwi nka Santi, yayoboye amashusho y’indirimbo "U Say" ya GoldLink, agaragaza Tyler, Umuremyi, na Jay Prince, kuri alubumu ya studio ya Diaspora. Ku ya 6 Gashyantare 2020, Santi ku murongo w’ibirori bya Lovebox, biteganijwe kubera muri Gunnersbury Park i Londres, kuva ku ya 12-14 Kamena. Nyuma y’ikwirakwizwa rya coronavirus ikomeje, ibirori byahagaritswe. Ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 2019, yakinnye mu birori bya Day n Vegas muri Las Vegas Festival Grounds, akingurira Tyler, Umuremyi, na Cat Cat.
Ku ya 10 Ugushyingo 2020, yaririmbye kuri Stage ya Gnaw, ya Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival. Ku ya 5 Ukuboza 2019, yayoboye ikiganiro cye cya mbere i Londres, yise Nta marira mu ishyamba, mu Nzu y'Amakoraniro ya Islington. Ku ya 3 Werurwe 2020, Santi yerekanye gahunda ye, yo gukora ikiganiro kuri televiziyo kivuga ku muco w'urubyiruko rwo muri Nijeriya. Abwira Crack Magazine ati: "Aho niho umutima wanjye uri ubu. Muri Nijeriya, ntabwo twigeze tugira igitaramo kijyanye n'amashuri yisumbuye, igitsina ndetse n'ibiyobyabwenge. Ndumva abana bakeneye umwanya utekanye, ikintu cyo gushakisha no guhungira."
Kuva 2021: Amasezerano yo gutangaza, Subaru Boys: IJURU RYA NYUMA.
Ku ya 17 Gashyantare 2021, nyuma y’ubufatanye bwo gutangaza hagati ya Warner Chappell Music, na Love Renaissance, itsinda rya Monster Boys (Cruel Santino, GMK, na Genio Bambino) ryasinyanye amasezerano yo gusohora na Warner Chappell Music. Ku ya 4 Werurwe 2022, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye yari yitezwe na "Subaru Boys: IJURU RYA NYUMA", binyuze muri Interscope Records, hamwe nabashyitsi bagaragaye muri Brazy, Maison2500, Bratzbih, Seo, Ebee, Kawa, Gus Dapperton, Amaarae, Chi Virgo, Solis, na Skepta. Rolling Stone yashyize alubumu kurutonde rwabo rwa Album 100 nziza zo mu 2022. Ku ya 10 Gashyantare 2023, Santino yasohoye "Showmetheway !!" irimo Poco Lee, kandi yakozwe na GMK kuri Monster Boy.
Santino azwiho kuvanga no guhuza amajwi atandukanye, kuva R&amp;B, roho na rap kugeza Afrobeats n'umuziki wa indie. Ku ya 11 Kamena 2019, Toye Sokunbi wo muri The Fader, yamwise izina nk'icyerekezo cy'ejo hazaza ha Afropop. Umugome Santino, wahoze azwi ku izina rya Ozzy B cyangwa Santi, azwiho kubyara ragga yatewe no gutanga imisatsi, imisatsi ndetse n'imyambarire. Ku ya 31 Gicurasi 2019, mu kiganiro n'ikinyamakuru Clash, Osayaba Andrew Ize-Iyamu yivugiye ko "yagize uruhare mu njyana zose, byanze bikunze umuntu ku giti cye. Yashishikarije izina rye kuva Santigold. Yatewe inkunga na Beenie Man, na Young Thug, ndetse no kuba yarakozwe n'umuhanzi w'indie na hip-hop, byamufashije kwiteza imbere nk'umuhanzi."

Temilade Openiyi (wavutse ku ya 11 Kamena 1995), uzwi nka Tems, ni umuhanzi wo muri Nijeriya uririmba, yandika indirimbo kandi akabikora no mu buryo bwo gutunganya umuziki. Yatangiye kumenyekana cyane ubwo yafatanyaga na Wizkid ku ndirimbo “Essence” yo mu 2020, yak later igera ku mwanya wa 9 kuri Billboard Hot 100 nyuma yo gusubirwamo na na Justin Bieber. Iyo ndirimbo yamuhesheje igihembo cya Grammy. Muri uwo mwaka kandi, yagaragaye ku ndirimbo “Fountains” ya Drake, umuraperi wo muri Kanada.
Muri 2020, Tems yasohoye umuzgino we wa mbere wagutse (EP), "Kumatwi yamenetse". Yasinyanye na RCA Records kugirango arekure umuzingo we wa kabiri, "Niba Orange yari Ikibanza" (2021). Mu 2022, amajwi ya Tems yo mu ndirimbo ye " Hejuru " yatoranijwe na Future ku ndirimbo ye yise " Ndagutegereje ", bituma amenyekana nk'umuhanzi w'umushyitsi hamwe na Drake. Iyi ndirimbo yatangiriye kuri "Billboard" Hot 100, bituma aba umuhanzi wa mbere nyafurika akaba numuhanzi wa kabiri wo muri Nigeriya ufite indirimbo abikora ku mbonerahamwe. Indirimbo yamuhesheje igihembo cya Grammy igihembo cyiza cya Melodic Rap. Tems yerekanaga " Nta Mugore, Nta gutaka " ya Bob Marley kuri Album ya "Black Panther: Album ya Wakanda Forever" yamajwi muri Nyakanga 2022 kandi muri uko kwezi, indirimbo ye " Free Mind " (yari iri kumuzingo we wambere) yatangiriye kuri "Billboard" Hot 100, igera ku mwanya wa 46 kandi yandika amateka y’abagore ku ndirimbo ndende ya mbere yerekana urutonde rwa R &amp;amp; B / Hip-Hop. ​​ Yanafatanyije kandi nabandi kwandika no gutunganya amajwi yinyuma mundirimbo "Nzamura hejuru" ya Rihanna byatumye itoranywa muri, ndetse na ​ ​
Mu 2024, Tems yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere ya studio "Yavukiye mu gasozi" kugirango ashimwe. Iyi alubumu yageze kuri 30 ba mbere mu Buholandi, mu Busuwisi no mu Bwongereza, aho yageze ku mwanya wa 24. Yatangiye kuvuka kwe muri Born in the Wild Tour, kuzenguruka isi.] ​​"​"​​​ Tems yabaye umuhanzi wa mbere wo muri Nigeriya ufite ibihembo byinshi bya Grammy.
Mu mibereho ye yose, Tems yahawe ibihembo byinshi, harimo ibihembo bibiri bya Grammy, ibihembo bya Billboard Women in Music Award, ibihembo bine bya NAACP Image Awards, BET Awards bine na Soul Train Music Awards eshatu.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Tems yavutse ku ya 11 Kamena 1995, i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. Izina rye rya mbere Temilade risobanura "ikamba ni ryanjye" muri Yoruba; akomoka mu bwoko bwa Yoruba. Umuryango we wimukiye mu Bwongereza akiri uruhinja, nyuma asubira muri Nijeriya nyuma yo gutandukana kw'ababyeyi be, afite imyaka itanu. Tems yabaga Ilupeju mbere yo kwimukira i Lekki nyuma Ajah. Yize muri kaminuza ya Dowen yisumbuye na Monash Afurika y'Epfo kubera amashuri makuru, aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu by'ubukungu.
Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yakundaga gutotezwa kubera ijwi rye. Afite imyaka 11, yinjiye muri korari y'ishuri maze bidatinze atangira kuririmba muri falsetto ariko abonwa numwarimu wumuziki wamutoje akamwigisha gucuranga piyano. Tems yakundaga kwitoza kuririmbana na murumuna we, wakundaga kumuherekeza kuri gitari.
2018–2021: Intangiriro yumwuga nimizingo yagutse.
Muri 2018, Tems yaretse akazi mu kwamamaza hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo akore umwuga wa muzika. Yatangiye kwiga ubuhanga bwo kwikorera kuri YouTube maze ku ya 18 Nyakanga 2018, asohora indirimbo ye ya mbere yise "Mr Rebel", indirimbo yayikoze wenyine. Ku ya 7 Kanama 2019, yasohoye indirimbo "Gerageza". Muri 2020, DJ Edu yamuhisemo kuba umwe mu "bahanzi icumi bareba" muri uwo mwaka. Ku Mata 2020, Tems yagaragaye ari kumwe n’umuririmbyi mugenzi we wo muri Nijeriya Davido kuri verisiyo yakozwe n’umuhanzi w’indirimbo w’umunyamerika witwa Khalid hamwe n’indirimbo ya elegitoroniki y’icyongereza ya Disclosure yise “ Menya agaciro kawe ”.
Ku ya 25 Nzeri 2020, Tems yasohoye umuzingo we wa mbere wagutse, "Ku matwi yamenetse". Yakozwe cyane cyane na we kandi indirimbo " Indishyi " yariri kumuzingo yabaye iyindi yakurikiranwe kuri "Gerageza", igera ku mwanya wa mbere ku mbonerahamwe ya muzika ya Apple yo muri Nijeriya na nimero ya gatandatu ku mbonerahamwe ya TurnTable Top 50 yashyizwe ahagaragara kandi imaze kubona miliyoni eshanu kuri YouTube. Ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2020, Tems yagaragaye ku ndirimbo mugenzi we wo muri Nijeriya Wizkid, " Essence ", muri alubumu ya kane ya sitidiyo, "Made i Lagos". Indirimbo yamuhesheje umwanya wa mbere kuri BBC 1Xtra Airplay Chart. kandi umwuga we wa mbere kuri Billboard Hot. Ku ya 8 Ugushyingo 2020, Tems yashyizwe muri Future Awards Africa: Icyiciro cya 2020.
Ku ya 13 Kanama 2021, hasohotse verisiyo yakozwe na "Essence", ikubiyemo ikindi kintu cy’umuririmbyi w’umunyakanada Justin Bieber, yasohotse, bituma iyi ndirimbo igera ku mwanya wa cyenda kuri Billboard Hot 100. Ku ya 3 Nzeri 2021, Tems yagaragaye ku ndirimbo y’umuraperi n’umuririmbyi wa Drake, " Isoko ", kuva kuri alubumu ya gatandatu ya sitidiyo ya nyuma, "yitwa Certificate Lover Boy", yatangiriye ku "mwanya" wa 26 kuri Hot Yakozwe mbere na mbere na GuiltyBeatz, kandi indirimbo "Crazy Tings" yasohotse hasigaye iminsi itanu ngo igere ku mwanya wa gatatu ku mbonerahamwe ya Afrobeats y’Ubwongereza. 2022–2023: Iterambere.
Ku ya 31 Werurwe 2022, Umuziki wa Apple 1 watangije ikiganiro cya Vibe Radio Yerekana hamwe na Tems. Ku ya 2 Mata, igice cyayo cya mbere kirimo isura ya Muyiwa Awoniyi, na Tunji Balogun. Ku Mata 2022, Tems yagaragaye hamwe na Drake ku ndirimbo y’umuraperi w’umunyamerika Future, " Ndagutegereje ", kuva kuri alubumu ya cyenda ya studio, "Sinigeze Nkunda". Indirimbo yatangiriye kuri Hot 100, bituma Tems umuhanzi wambere wumugore wumugore wumukobwa wambere wambere kurutonde nibindi byinshi byambere kuri chart. Indirimbo yerekana indirimbo " Hejuru " yo "Kumatwi yamenetse".
Muri Nyakanga 2022, Tems yerekanaga " Nta mugore, nta kurira " ya Bob Marley ya filime ya Marvel yitwa "Black Panther: Wakanda Forever" amajwi yakunzwe na Rihanna. Ku ya 26 Nyakanga, Tems yungutse inshuro ya kane Ashyushye 100 n'indirimbo ye " "Free Mind" " yakuye "kuri Broken Ears" yagaragaye ku mbonerahamwe igera ku mwanya wa 44 na nimero ya 1 ku mbonerahamwe y'indirimbo Afrobeats yo muri Amerika. Byamuhesheje icyemezo cya mbere cya platine na silver wenyine wenyine muri Amerika no mubwongereza. "]" ​ ​​"​"
Ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2023, Tems yasohoye indirimbo " Me &amp;amp; U ". yerekana indirimbo yambere Tems yasohoye ari wenyine kuva yasohora Iyaba Orange hari ahantu, usibye igifuniko cye cya Bob Marley yise " Nta Mugore, Nta kurira " yasohotse mu 2022. "Me &amp; U" yahawe igihembo cyindirimbo mpuzamahanga Yindashyikirwa muri 55 ya NAACP Image Awards nigihembo cyiza cya Dr. Bobby Jones Igihembo cyiza cya Gospel / Inspirational Award.
Ku ya 5 Ukuboza 2023, Tems yatangaje ko indirimbo ye ya kabiri y'umwaka " Ntabwo ari Umumarayika " izasohoka ku ya 8 Ukuboza.
2024 - ubungubu: "Kuvukira mu gasozi".
Muri Werurwe 2024, Tems abaye umuririmbyi wa mbere wo muri Afurika wahawe igihembo cya Billboard Women in Music Award aho yahawe mu cyiciro cya Breakthrough. Alubumu yambere ya studio ya Tems "yavukiye mu gasozi" yasohotse ku ya 7 Nyakanga Kamena kandi izashyigikirwa n’uruzinduko ku isi. Indirimbo " Nkunda MeJJe " kuri alubumu yaramenyekanye kandi ireba mbere ya Tems ya mbere ya Coachella yashyizwe ahagaragara isohoka ku ya 25 Mata.] ​​
Mu 2025, Tems abaye umunyarwandakazi wa mbere wagize uruhare mu ikipe yumupira wamaguru wa Shampiyona nkuru yinjira mu itsinda rya San Diego FC. Yatunguwe no gusohora umuzingo "Urukundo rwe ni Ubwami" ku ya 21 Ugushyingo
Nyina wa Tems yamwemereye gusa kumva umuziki wa gikristo akiri umwana. Mu myaka ye y'ubwangavu, yashishikajwe na R&amp;amp;B na hip hop, atangira kumva abahanzi nka Burna Boy, Lauryn Hill, Adele, Rihanna, Coldplay, Paramore, na Asa. Yateze amatwi kandi Destiny's Child, Beyoncé, Lil Wayne, na Aaliyah, kandi yigeze kuvuga indirimbo ya Alicia Keys yo mu 2004, " Niba ntakubonye " mu gitaramo cya Live. Tems yiswe Aaliyah, " Koga Nziza " ya Frank Ocean, na " I Gotta Find Peace of Mind " ya Lauryn Hill nk'ibitekerezo byubaka muri icyo gihe, avuga ko indirimbo ya Hill ari "cyane, mu mwuka cyane". Yagaragaje uburyo umuziki w'abo bahanzi wamufashije kumva uburyo indirimbo zishobora guhuza amarangamutima, gutanga isano yo mu mwuka, no kuba inzira yo kwigaragaza neza.
Ibihembo naho yatoranyijwe.
Tems yahawe ibihembo byinshi, harimo ibihembo bibiri bya Grammy, Billboard Women in Music Award, ibihembo bine bya NAACP, ibihembo bine BET na Soul Train Music Awards eshatu.

Uru ni urutonde rw'ubutumwa bwa diplomasi mu Rwanda. Umurwa mukuru Kigali kuri ubu ubarizwamo ambasade 44 na komisiyo nkuru.
Inshingano za diplomasi muri Kigali.
Ambasade na Komisiyo Nkuru.
Ibyanditswe byanditseho inyenyeri (*) ni ibihugu byibumbiye mu muryango wa Commonwealth. Ibyo bihugu nibyo ambassade zabyo zitwa komisiyo nkuru cyangwa 'High Commission' mu rurimi rw'icyongerezarimi rw'icyongereza.

Damini Ebunoluwa Ogulu (wavutse ku ya 2 Nyakanga 1991), uzwi ku izina rya Burna Boy, ni umuraperi wo muri Nijeriya, umwanditsi w'indirimbo, ndetse na producer. Yamenyekanye cyane muri 2012 nyuma yo gushyira ahagaragara "Like to Party", indirimbo ya mbere ku muzingo we wambere we yakoreye muri studio ' (2013). Muri 2017, Burna Boy yasinyanye amasezerano na hamwe n’isosiyete nkuru ya. Album ye ya gatatu ya studio ', yaje kumenyekana cyane muri label ya mbere, yasohotse muri 2018
Mu 2019, Burna Boy yatsindiye Best International Act mu bihembo bya BET Award, kandi atoranywa nka. Muri uwo mwaka nyine, yasohoye alubumu ye ya kaneya studio, "African Giant", yatsindiye Album yumwaka muri 2019 All Music Music Awards 2019 kandi yatorewe kuba Album yumuziki mwiza ku isi muri 62 ya Grammy Awards.] "​"​ Yatsindiye amategeko mpuzamahanga meza muri 2021 BET Awards kunshuro ya gatatu.
Album ya gatandatu ya studio ya Burna Boy "Love, Damini", yasohotse muri Nyakanga 2022, ibaye alubumu ya mbere yo Muri Nigeriya ku mbonerahamwe ya Billboard 200. Yabaye kandi alubumu nyafurika yagaragaye cyane mu Bufaransa, Ubuholandi, n'Ubwongereza. Mu Kwakira 2022, Burna Boy yahawe igihembo cy’umunyamuryango wa Order of the Federal Republic kubera ibyo yagezeho muri muzika. Mu 2023, "Rolling Stone" yamushyize ku mwanya wa 197 ku rutonde rw’abaririmbyi 200 bakomeye mu bihe byose. Burna Boy yatsindiye International Act mpuzamahanga muri 2023 BET Awards. Indirimbo ye " " yatsindiye Afrobeats Ingaragu yumwaka nindirimbo yumwaka kuri Headies 2023. Burna Boy yabaye umuhanzi wa mbere nyafurika ufite alubumu ebyiri zinjije miliyari irenga 1 kuri Spotify.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Damini Ebunoluwa Ogulu yavutse ku ya 2 Nyakanga 1991, avukira i Port Harcourt, muri Leta ya Rivers, muri Nijeriya. Nyina, Bose Ogulu, yakoraga nk'umusemuzi w'ururimi, naho se Samuel Ogulu, yayoboraga isosiyete yo gusudira. Sekuru ubyara Benson Idonije yigeze kuyobora Fela Kuti. Nyuma, nyina amubera umuyobozi. Ogulu yakuriye mu majyepfo ya Nijeriya maze atangira gukora wenyine akoresheje Studio ya FL. Yize amashuri yisumbuye ya Corona i Agbara, muri Leta ya Ogun, mbere yo kwimukira i Londere mu Bwongereza, kugira ngo akomeze amasomo ye. ​ ​ ​ Yatangiye umwuga we wa muzika nyuma yo gusubira i
2012–2015: L.I.F.E "(Kureka Ingaruka Ziteka)" na "SPACESHIP".
Album ya mbere ya studio ya Burna Boy, "L.I.F.E", yasohotse ku ya 12 Kanama 2013, ibera nk'ikurikirana rya mixtape ye ya kabiri "Burn Identity" (2011). Iyi alubumu yagurishije kopi 40.000 kumunsi yasohotse. Aristokrat Records yaje kugurisha uburenganzira bwayo bwo kwamamaza muri Uba Pacific kuri ₦ 10 miliyoni. Gusohora alubumu yabanjirijwe 'five: "Like to Party", "Tonight", "Always Love You", "Run my Race", na "Yawa Dey". "L,I.F.E" yakozwe na Leriq rwose kandi bugaragaramo abashyitsi kuva, MI Abaga, Timaya, Olamide, Reminisce, na Wizkid, nibindi. "Nigeriya Imyidagaduro Uyu munsi" yashyize alubumu ku mwanya wa 10 ku rutonde rwa Album ya 12 nziza ya 2013. Umuziki wa alubumu watewe inkunga na Fela Kuti, King Sunny Ade, na Bob Marley. Yakiriye neza muri rusange abanegura umuziki, bashimye umusaruro wayo. Yatowe muri Album nziza yumwaka muri 2014 Nigeriya Imyidagaduro. Muri Kanama 2013, "L.I.F.E y"ageze ku mwanya wa karindwi ku mbonerahamwe ya Album "ya Billboard" Reggae.
Muri 2014, Burna Boy yatandukanye na Aristokrat Records; yashinze label yandika "yitwa" Spaceship Entertainment "," muri Gashyantare 2015.
2018–2019: "Hanze" na "Nini Nyafurika".
Ku ya 19 Mutarama 2018, Burna Boy yagaragaye mu itsinda ry’abanyamerika ryitwa Fall Out Boy ryitwa "Sunshine Riptide", umurongo wa alubumu yabo ya karindwi "yitwa Mania". Yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya gatatu ya studio, "Outside", nyuma y'icyumweru kimwe, ku ya 26 Mutarama 2018. Uyu muhanzikazi yavuze ko ari imvange, "Outside" igizwe ahanini na afrobeats, Dancehall, reggae, na rap rap. Irimo abashyitsi bagaragaye mu baririmbyi b'Abongereza J Hus, Lily Allen, na Mabel. "Outside y"ashyigikiwe n'indirimbo esheshatu: "Rock Your Body", "Streets Africa", "Koni Baje", "Sekkle Down", "Heaven's Gate" na " Ye ". Umusaruro wayo wakozwe na Leriq, Baba Stiltz, Jae 5, Juls, Chopstix, Steel Banglez, Fred Gibson, Phantom, na FTSE. Iyi alubumu yakiriwe neza kandi yashyizwe ku rutonde na Pulse Nigeria na "Nigeriya Imyidagaduro Uyu munsi" nka alubumu nziza yo muri Nijeriya yo muri 2018. Yatsindiye Album y'umwaka muri 2018 Imyidagaduro ya Nigeria. 2018, "Hanze" yerekanwe ku mwanya wa gatatu ku mbonerahamwe ya Album "ya Billboard" Reggae. Indirimbo imwe yo muri alubumu, "Ye", yarangije ku rutonde rw’ibitabo byinshi byo muri Nijeriya umwaka urangiye nk'indirimbo nini ya 2018.
Ku ya 7 Ukwakira 2018, Burna Boy yaririmbye mbere y’imbaga yagurishijwe muri O2 Academy Brixton ya London. Umunsi umwe mbere yiki gitaramo, yakoze ibirori byamamaye kuri Red by Little Farm hanyuma agurisha udusanduku duto tw’ibinyampeke bye bya Space Puffs, hamwe n'amakaye yabigenewe, amatara, hamwe n'amashati ashushanyije. Ku Ukwakira 2018, yatangajwe nk'umwe mu bahanzi bashya ba Afro Hub ba Spotify. Iri tangazo ryamuhuriranye no kwitwa Umuhanzi wa YouTube kuri Rise mu gihe cy'amezi atatu.
Ku ya 3 Mutarama 2019, Burna Boy yatangajwe hamwe na Bwana Eazi nk'umwe mu bahanzi bitabira iserukiramuco rya muzika n'ubuhanzi rya Coachella Valley 2019. Yatsindiye ibihembo bine mu iserukiramuco rya MVP rya Soundcity MVP, harimo Umuhanzi nyafurika w’umwaka, Guhitamo abumva, na MVP nziza y'abagabo. Ku ya 21 Werurwe 2019, Burna Boy yasohoye EP-4 ikorana na EP hamwe na DJDS ikorera mu mujyi wa Los Angeles, yitwa "Steel &amp;amp; Copper". EP ihuza injyana ya Burna Boy hamwe na DJDS umutego ucuramye. "]" ​​​​
