2020–2022: "Inshuro ebyiri z'uburebure" n'urukundo ", Damini".
Muri Mata 2020, Burna Boy yaririmbye "Isi imwe: Hamwe murugo" bidasanzwe. Ku ya 19 Kamena 2020, yagaragaye kuri remix yindirimbo ya virusi ya Master KG yo muri Afrika yepfo " Jerusalema ". Burna Boy yakoresheje umukono wa afrobeat yumukono ku ndirimbo ndetse anaririmba igice mururimi rwa isiZulu. Ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2020, Burna Boy yagaragaye ku ndirimbo y’umuhanzi w’umwongereza Sam Smith, " My Oasis ", indirimbo ya mbere muri alubumu yabo ya gatatu ya studio, "Urukundo Rugenda". Album ye ya studio, "Twice as Tall", yasohotse ku ya 14 Kanama 2020. Yakozwe na Diddy na nyina, Bose Ogulu. Ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2020, "Inshuro ebyiri nka Tall" yatowe muri Album nziza ku Isi ku nshuro ya 63 ya Grammy Awards. Ni umwaka wa kabiri wikurikiranya Burna Boy yabonye nomination muri iki cyiciro. Yatsindiye igihembo cya Edison mu cyiciro cya Album ku Isi cya "Afurika Igihangange", kandi yatsindiye Itegeko mpuzamahanga ryiza muri MOBO Awards ku ya 9 Ukuboza, ahagarika amarushanwa ya Drake, Megan Thee Stallion, Lil Baby na Roddy Ricch. Mu birori ngarukamwaka bya Grammy Awards byabaye ku ya 15 Werurwe 2021, yatsindiye igihembo cya Grammy kuri Album nziza ya muzika ku isi. Indirimbo "Destiny" ya Burna Boy yashyizwe ku rutonde rw'abakinnyi mu muhango wo gutangiza Joe Biden. Yatsindiye Itegeko mpuzamahanga ryiza muri Awards, abaye umuhanzi wa mbere nyafurika wegukanye iki gihembo inshuro eshatu zikurikiranye.
Ku ya 19 Werurwe 2021, Burna Boy yagaragaye ku ndirimbo y’umuririmbyi w’umunyakanada Justin Bieber "Ukundwa nawe", umurongo wa alubumu ye ya gatandatu ya studio, "Ubutabera". Ku ya 17 Nzeri 2021, yagaragaye ku ndirimbo y’umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika Jon Bellion yise "Ndabyumva", ikaba yaranze ubufatanye bwa mbere bw’umuziki hagati yabo bombi, ariko aba nyuma bandika "Gukundwa nawe" na Justin Bieber. Ku ya 4 Kamena 2022, Burna Boy yaririmbye kuri sitade y'imikino ya Belgravia i Harare, muri Zimbabwe, aho bivugwa ko yanze amafaranga yo kwambara igitambaro cya ZANU-PF mu rwego rwo kwemeza ubuyobozi bwa Mnangagwa.
Muri 2022, yahawe igihembo cyitwa "Best Solo Act on the World" na NME.
Burna Boy yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya gatandatu ya studio, "Urukundo, Damini", ku ya 8 Nyakanga 2022. Isohoka ryayo ryabanjirijwe n’indirimbo "Kilometero" na " Iheruka ".
Burna Boy yakoze igitaramo cye cya mbere muri Jamayike ku ya 18 Ukuboza 2022, kuri Stade y'igihugu ya Jamaica.
2023–2024: "Nababwiye…".
Muri Mata 2023, Burna Boy yasohoye indirimbo yise " Mera Na " irimo Sidhu Moose Wala, aho yahaye icyubahiro Sidhu. "Mera Na" yashushanyije ku mbonerahamwe mpuzamahanga zitandukanye zirimo Billboard Global 200, Kanada Hot 100, na New Zealand Hot Singles., yasohoye indirimbo " Sittin Hejuru Yisi ", yerekana cyane umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika Brandy mu 1998 yakunzwe cyane yise " Top of the World ".
Ku ya 10 Kamena 2023, Burna Boy abaye umuhanzi wa mbere ukomoka muri Afurika witwaye neza muri UEFA Champion League Final Kick Off Show na Pepsi. Uyu muhanzikazi yerekeje kuri sitade Olempike ya Atatürk i Istanbul muri Turukiya, imbere y'abashyigikiye barenga 71.412 ndetse n'abantu barenga miliyoni 700. Muri Nyakanga, abaye umuhanzi wa mbere nyafurika wanditse kandi agurisha ibitaramo kuri stade muri Amerika, yerekeza kuri Citi Field i New York. ["Billboard" nk'umuhanzi wa mbere wa Afrobeat w’umwaka wa 2023. yatowe mu bihembo bine bya Grammy, bituma aba umuhanzi watowe kurusha abandi muri Nigeriya mu mateka ya Grammy hamwe n’abakinnyi icumi batoranijwe mu mwuga ndetse n’umunyanijeriya wa mbere wagize kandidatire mu myaka itanu yikurikiranya, kuva muri 2019 kugeza mu yashimiraga abahanzi bo muri Afurika ku bahatanira Grammy, The Recording Academy yavuze ko Burna Boy ari umuhanzi ukomeye muri Afurika. "Igihugu" cyamwise umwidagaduro wumwaka kubera kugira umwaka utagereranywa kandi udasanzwe.
"Sittin 'on Top of the world" yakiriye igihembo cyiza cya Melodic Rap Cyiza Cyiza Cyiza cya 66 cya Grammy Awards. Burna Boy yakoze indirimbo mu birori ku ya 4 Gashyantare 2024, ari kumwe na Brandy na 21 Savage.
Mu Gushyingo 2024, indirimbo ye yamenyekanye cyane "Hejuru" yatowe nk'umuziki witwaye neza muri Afurika muri Grammy Awards ya 67 ngarukamwaka, izabera muri Gashyantare 2025 kuri Crypto.com Arena i Los Angeles. Yatorewe igihembo inshuro buzima bwe bwose.
2025 - ubungubu: "No Sign of Weakness".
Ku ya 10 Nyakanga 2025, Burna Boy yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya munani ya studio "Nta kimenyetso cyerekana intege nke", irimo Travis Scott, Mick Jagger, Stromae, na Shaboozey ku ndirimbo imwe. Binyuze kuri iyi alubumu, yatunganije injyana ye kuva kuba collab-uburemere kugeza ku buke. Iyi alubumu yakozwe na label ye Spaceship, hamwe na Atlantic Records na Bad Habit. igaragaramo uburyo butandukanye bwa muzika butandukanye, harimo igihugu, '90s hiphop, inzu yikoranabuhanga, rock, na muzika ya elegitoroniki ya Nigeriya.
Burna Boy yatangaje ko "nta kimenyetso cyerekana intege nke" muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru azenguruka ibyumweru bike mbere yuko alubumu isohoka, uruzinduko rutangirira kuri Red Rocks Amphitheater muri Colorado mu Gushyingo. Ibitaramo byose byo muri Amerika ya ruguru bizagaragaramo icyiciro cya dogere 360, usibye Urutare rutukura, ruri kuri amphitheater isanzwe. Yakinnye kandi i Waldbühne i Berlin na SparkassenPark i Mönchengladbach, mu Budage, no mu iserukiramuco rya Wireless mu Bwongereza mbere y'urugendo.
Burna Boy yakundanye n'umuraperi w’Ubwongereza Stefflon Don kuva 2018 kugeza
Ukuboza 2024, ibihuha bivuga ku mubano wa Burna Boy n'umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika R&amp;B, Chloe Bailey, byagaragaye nyuma yo kumarana na we mu birori byo kwizihiza ' Detty Ukuboza '. Amashusho yabo yishimira ubuzima bwa Lagos nijoro byongereye ibitekerezo. Ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2025, "Premium Times Nijeriya" yemeje ko bakundana nyuma yo kugaragara ku munsi wo gusangira n’abakundana n’abakundana i Lagos, bakishora mu ruhame.
Muri 2025, Burna Boy yagizwe umwe mubagabo bambaye neza ba GQ.
Umuziki wa Burna Boy ni uruvange rwa Afrobeats, hip hop, reggae, na R&amp;amp;B. Umuziki we, avuga ko ari "Afro-fusion", ni ihuriro rya Afrobeat, dancehall, hip-hop, pop, R&amp;B, na reggae. "]" Umuhanzi Dancehall umuhanzi Kittitian Byron Messia yamusobanuye nkumuhanzi windirimbo zidasanzwe zidasanzwe utandika amagambo cyangwa guta igihe muri studio kugirango akore indirimbo. Mu kiganiro na "The Punch", Burna Boy yavuze uburyo ahumekwa agira ati: "Ninjiye mu kazu maze ndyama injyana kandi umuziki uraza aho ndi. Mvugishije ukuri, sinshobora kubisobanura rwose - guhumeka n'ibitekerezo binyuzamo mu mwuka iyo ndi muri studio." Yamamaye cyane mu bafana ndetse no ku banegura kubera amagambo akubiye mu ndirimbo ze, zigaragara cyane mu gace ka Afrobeats, aho usanga indirimbo ziba zitezimbere kubyina bitwaye amafaranga. Yaganiriye kandi ku ngingo za politiki mu muziki we, nko ku murongo "wa Afurika w'igihangange" "Indi nkuru". Umuhanzi wo muri Nijeriya, Omah Lay, yatangaje ko Burna Boy ari umwanditsi mwiza w'indirimbo yigeze abona kandi ko ari imbaraga mu bijyanye n'ubuhanzi bwo kwandika.
Azwiho kuba afite amajwi, ndetse n'ijwi rye rya baritone, aririmba avanze icyongereza, Yoruba, na Nigeriya Pidgin.
"Rolling Stone" yanditse Burna Boy mubaririmbyi 200 bakomeye mubihe byose.
Intsinzi ya Burna Boy yatumye bamwe batekereza ko yahimbye umwirondoro wumuntu ukomeye muri Afrobeats. Umuyobozi ushinzwe impano Kim Moore yatangarije "CNN" ko "Intsinzi ya Burna Boy (Grammy) izashishikariza abandi bahanzi bo muri Afurika gukora imishinga ishimisha abantu bose ku isi." Umunyamakuru wa radiyo BBC, Darren Joseph, yamusobanuye ko ari "igishushanyo mu gisekuru".
"Rolling Stone" yamusobanuye ko ari igihangange mu muco wo muri Nijeriya, wabaye ambasaderi wa Afrobeats nk'umuryango "w’isi" yose, ushobora kumva umeze nk'iwabo mu kuzamuka ku rutonde rw’ibihugu by’i Burayi ndetse no gukomeza umubano w’amarangamutima n’ubwoko "bwashize" nk’ubuzima bwo "hejuru" imyaka yabo ya
BOF yamwise "umwe" bagize uruganda ku isi Aniefiok Ekpoudom wo muri "The Guardian" yagize ati "Burna Boy ari mu butumwa bwo kwibutsa Abanyafurika hose ku mizi yabo ku mugabane, kandi Afrobeats ni igikoresho cye".
Ku ya 8 Kamena 2022, abaherekeza bashinzwe umutekano witwa Burna Boy bivugwa ko barashe abantu babiri mu kabyiniro ka nijoro i Lagos. Nk’uko byatangajwe n'umugore w'umwe mu bahohotewe, ibyabaye byatangiye nyuma yo kwanga ubutumire bwa Burna Boy bwo kwifatanya nawe mu gice cya VIP. Abashinzwe umutekano batanu bafitanye isano na Burna Boy batawe muri yombi bakurikiranyweho gushaka kwica. Nyuma y’uwahohotewe yashinje uyu muhanzikazi n’umuryango we gushaka gucecekesha umuryango we amafaranga y’amafaranga. Kuva ku Kamena 2022, amashusho ya CCTV y’iraswa ntabwo yari yashyizwe ahagaragara n’iyi kipe. Ku ya 1 Mutarama 2023, ubwo yagendaga i Lagos mu rukundo rwe, Damini, urugendo Burna Boy rwababajwe cyane n’uko yahakanye ibihuha byo kurasa nijoro ndetse n’ibihuha bivuga ko nyina yahoze ari umubyinnyi w’inyuma w’umupayiniya wa Afrobeat, Fela Kuti.
2019 'Abanyafurika Bunze ubumwe' guhagarika igitaramo.
Mu Gushyingo 2019, Burna Boy yatangajwe nk'umuyobozi mukuru w'igitaramo 'Africans Unite' muri Afurika y'Epfo, igikorwa kigamije guteza imbere ubumwe no gukemura ibibazo by'abanyamahanga. Icyakora, ibyo yabanje kwamagana ibitero bivugwa ko byakorewe abanyamahanga muri Afurika y'Epfo no kwerekana ko adashaka gusura iki gihugu byatumye abantu banengwa. Abahanzi bo muri Afurika yepfo n’abaturage basabye imbabazi, Burna Boy yanga gutanga. Bavuze iterabwoba ry’ihohoterwa n’umutekano, abateguye ibirori amaherezo bahagaritse igitaramo.
Burna Boy kandi yagiye mu makimbirane rusange n'umuraperi wo muri Afurika y'Epfo AKA kuri Twitter, biturutse ku biganiro ku ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina muri Afurika y'Epfo. Burna Boy yanenze ibyo bitero maze, kuri tweet kuva yasibwe, avuga ko azahura na AKA ku mubiri baramutse bahuye.
Mu gusubiza, AKA yagaragaje ko itishimiye, ishimangira ko Afurika y'Epfo yashyigikiye mbere umwuga wa Burna Boy mbere yuko atsinda ku rwego mpuzamahanga, anasaba imbabazi. Amakimbirane yarushijeho kwitabwaho ubwo igitaramo cya Burna Boy cyari giteganijwe mu gitaramo cya 'Africans Unite' cyongereye igitutu rubanda asaba imbabazi. Mu gihe impungenge zikomeje kwiyongera ku mutekano n’impaka, igitaramo cyahagaritswe. Mu 2022, AKA yerekanye ko atagifite ibibazo na Burna Boy, byerekana ko hashobora kubaho ubwiyunge hagati y'abahanzi.
Filozofiya iyobora Burna Boy ni Pan-Africanism. Yizera "kubaka ibiraro" hamwe na diaspora nyafurika, bizera Afrika nkumugabane w’ababyeyi n’aho abantu bavukiye. Yabaye umuvugizi uharanira ubutabera mbonezamubano ku isi. Umuziki wa Burna Boy ntabwo ari imyidagaduro gusa; ni umuhamagaro mubikorwa kuko akoresha urubuga rwe kugirango avugishe ukuri kubutegetsi kandi amurikire ibibazo bireba abantu muri Nijeriya ndetse no kwisi yose. Muri alubumu ye ya studio African Giant, arasesengura amateka y’imivurungano ya Nijeriya asenya inkuru zayikikuje kuva zabona ubwigenge. Indirimbo nka "Iyindi Nkuru" iramagana ingaruka mbi z’isosiyete ya Royal Niger mu gushyiraho ubutegetsi bwabakoloni muri Nijeriya, "Kwangiza ingwate" iranenga ubugwari bw’Abanyanijeriya mu kudahangana n’abakandamiza mu gihe "Wetin Man Go Do" yinubira ububabare bwa rubanda. Umunyamakuru wa radiyo BBC, DJ Target, yagize ati: "Ahagarariye impinduka, kandi avuga nabi akarengane mu gihe ahagarariye Afurika akiri muto ndetse akanamenyekana ku isi hose."
Nyuma y'imyivumbagatanyo ya Johannesburg yo muri 2019 muri Afurika y'Epfo yibasiye Abanyafurika baba muri iki gihugu, yiyemeje kutazongera gusura Afurika y'Epfo niba guverinoma itagize icyo ikora kugira ngo iki kibazo gikemuke. Muri 2020, yashyizeho ikigega cyo gutabara abahohotewe na #EndSARS imyigaragambyo yo kurwanya ubugizi bwa nabi bwa polisi. Estelle Uba wo muri "Repubulika" yavuze ko amagambo akomeye ya Burna Boy adahatira Abanyanijeriya gusa, ahubwo ko abenegihugu baturutse mu bihugu byahoze biganjemo abakoloni muri Afurika y'Epfo, Aziya, na Amerika y'Epfo kugira ngo babare, kandi bahangane n'ukuri kw'abakoloni bashya mu bihugu byabo. Binyuze mu ndirimbo ye 20-10-20, yarekuwe ku bufatanye n’iraswa rya Lekki 2020, yatanze ijwi ryamagana kurwanya iraswa ry’abigaragambyaga #EndSARS, imiyoborere mibi, ruswa, n’ubugome bwa polisi muri Nijeriya.

Itorero Garukurebe ni itorero ry'umuco rikorera mu Karere ka Rwamagana mu Buganza. Ni itorero ryatangijwe hagamijwe gukuza no kubungabunga umuco nyarwanda, cyane cyane imbyino n'indirimbo gakondo.Itorero Garukurebe ryashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1982.rikaba ryarashinzwe na MUKAMPUNGA Janviere. Itorero Garukurebe Kugeza ubu rigizwe n’ibyiciro bitatu birimo abana bakiri bato, icy’urubyiruko ndetse n’abakuze barimo abakecuru n’abasaza. Abanyamuryango baryo bose barimo n’ab’icyubahiro bagera ku 101.

Ubuyobozi bw'igitugu ni uburyo bw'imiyoborere burangwa no gukoresha imbaraga no kutumvikana n'abo uyobora, aho umuyobozi cyangwa itsinda ry'abayobozi bafata ibyemezo bonyine, kandi bakirengagiza uburenganzira n'ibyifuzo by'abaturage.

Igihugu cya Misiri yatangiye kwitabira imikino ya mu 2013. Uwo mwaka ni na wo yabonye umudari wayo wa mbere w’abafite ubumuga bwo kutumva, ubwo ikipe y’igihugu y’umupira w’amaguru yegukanaga umudari wa bronze. Egiputa ntabwo yigeze yitabira Itumba ryiryo rushanwa Deathlympics.

Innocent Ujah Idibia MON [a] (Listen ⓘ ; yavutse ku ya "18 Nzeri" 1975), uzwi ku izina rye rya 2Baba wahoze yitwa 2Face Idibia n'umuririmbyi wo muri nijeriyaa uzi mukwandika Indirimbo no kuzitunganya, umwanditsi w’indirimbo, umuhanzi w’injyana n’utunganya umuziki wo muri Nijeriya, uzwi cyane kubera album ye ya mbere yakoze ku giti cye 2004 [b] Afatwa nkumwe mu bahanzi "bakomeye"kandi bakomeye muri Afrobeats bibihe byose nyuma y’umusanzu we muri muzika ya pop ya Nigeriya mu myaka ya za 2000.
2Baba yatsindiye igihembo cya MTV Europe kubera African Act mu 2005 Mu 2019, yakoze indirimbo afatanyije na Cobhams Asuquo na Timi Dakolo bashyize hanze indirimbo igamije gukangurira abantu. "Billboard" yashyize indirimbo ye " African Queen " No 1 kurutonde rw'indirimbo nziza za Afrobeats mubihe byose.
Ubuzima bwe n'amashuri yize.
2Baba yavutse ku ya 18 Nzeri 1975, avukira i Jos, muri Leta ya Plateau, muri Nijeriya, akomoka muri Idoma ukomoka muri Leta ya Benue muri Nijeriya rwagati. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Mount Saint Gabriel i Makurdi mbere yo gukurikirana Business adminsistration mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Ubuyobozi n’ikoranabuhanga, Enugu (IMT), riherereye muri Leta ya Enugu.
Nyuma yo Kwiyegurira umuziki, 2Baba yahagaritse amashuri asanzwe akurikirana umwuga we wa muzika. 1996, yari amaze gutangira guhimba imiziki no gufata amajwi cyane cyane muri GB Fan Club muri Enugu State Broadcasting Services (ESBS). Yakoreraga ku izina rya stage "2Face", yavuze ko iryo zina ari "ugutandukanya ubuzima bwe bwite nubw’ubucuruzi" nubwo nyuma yaje guhinduka "2Baba" mu 2016.
Ubwo yari mu ishuri rikuru ry’imiyoborere n’ikoranabuhanga Enugu (IMT), Idibia yatangiye umwuga we wa muzika akorana na Blackface Naija, umunyeshuri biganaga mu mashuri yisumbuye, na Faze, bose nyuma baza gushinga itsinda ry’abantu batatu, Plantashun Boiz. Itsinda ryasohoye alubumu ebyiri, "body and soul" (2000) na "Sold Out" (2003),babifashijwemo na Dove Records, gifitwe na Nelson Brown. Abagize itsinda batandukanye mu 2004, 2Baba basubira mu muziki wenyine.
2Baba yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya mbere ku giti cye, "Face 2 Face" (2004), yasuzumwe neza n'abanegura umuziki kandi ashyirwa ku rutonde rwa "alubumu ikomeye ya mbere yo muri Nijeriya yo mu kinyejana cya 21 n'umuhanzi wenyine". Yakurikiwe na alubumu ye ya kabiri, "Grass 2 Grace" (2006). Nyuma yibyo, yavuye muri Kennis Music maze ashyiraho label ye bwite, Hypertek Digital., yasohoye alubumu y'ubushakashatsi yitwa "The Unstoppable", hamwe n’ikinyamakuru International edition mu mwaka wa 2010 Music Video.
Mu 2004, 2Baba yavuye mu itsinda "Plantashun Boiz" byatumye iryo tsinda ryicamo ibice, bituma havuka amakimbirane n'abahoze ari bagenzi be bamushinja ko yatandukanijwe. 2Baba n’umwe bari bigeze gukorana mu itsinda, Faze, basangizanyije amakosa mu ndirimbo zitandukanye zo mu ma album yabo y’umwihariko.
BlackFace yavuze ko indirimbo 2Baba yakoze zanditswe na bombi, nubwo iki kibazo cyaje gukemurwa mu rukiko. Indirimbo " African Queen " yabaye impaka hagati ya 2Baba, label ye yise Kennis Music, n'uwahoze ari umuririmbyi mugenzi we Blackface, bamushinje ku mugaragaro ko yamwibye indirimbo, avuga ko yanditse iyi ndirimbo bakiri itsinda. Umuziki wa Kennis waje kwemera guha Blackface inguzanyo zo kwandika iyi ndirimbo kandi yemera no kumwishyura amafaranga y’amafaranga yavuye mu ndirimbo.
Ku ya 25 Mutarama 2017, 2Baba yatangaje binyuze ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram ko azayobora imyigaragambyo mu gihugu hose ku ya 5 Gashyantare 2017; imyigaragambyo yarwanyaga politiki yashyizwe mu bikorwa na Perezidansi ya Muhammadu Buhari. Mu rwego rwo guhagarika imyigaragambyo, ubuyobozi, binyuze kuri komiseri w’igipolisi cya Leta ya Lagos, Fatai Owoseni, bwasohoye itangazo rivuga ko imyigaragambyo yabujijwe muri Leta, avuga ko hari impungenge z’uko amazu y’amazu azayashimuta kandi agateza akaduruvayo. Icyakora, aya magambo yaranze kandi yirengagizwa ku mugaragaro, mu gihe kumenyekanisha imyigaragambyo byakomeje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.
Muri Gashyantare 2017, 2Baba yasohoye videwo ivuga ko yahagaritse imyigaragambyo kubera impamvu z'umutekano. Ibihuha byakwirakwiriye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bivuga ko ubuyobozi, binyuze kuri DSS, bwamutoye mbere y'uwo munsi kandi bumuhatira guhagarika imyigaragambyo yavuzwe cyane, nubwo nyuma yaje gukora tweet nyinshi ku rubuga rwe rwa Twitter kugira ngo ahakana iki kirego.
2Baba yashakanye n'umukinnyi w'amafirime ukomoka muri Nijeriya, Annie Macaulay-Idibia kuva mu 2012 i Lagos, muri Nijeriya. I Dubai ku ya 23 Werurwe 2013, habaye umuhango w’imbonezamubano, kandi bafite abana babiri.
Ku ya 26 Mutarama 2025, yatangaje ko yatandukana n’umugore we bashakanye, Annie kuri Instagram. Nyuma y'iminsi mike, uyu muhanzikazi yagaragaye ari kumwe na Natasha Osawaru, umushingamategeko mu nzu mberabyombi ya Edo.
2Baba yahawe ibihembo byinshi mubuzima bwe bwose, harimo igihembo cya MTV Europe Music Award na World Music Award, ibihembo bitanu bya Headies byindirimbo yumwaka, ibihembo bine bya Channel O Music Video Awards, na BET Award. Byongeye kandi, yahawe igihembo muri MTV Africa Music Awards, Umuziki wa Black Origin Awards, Kora Awards, ndetse na 'Afrima Legend Award' 2019. Yinjijwe muri " The Headies Hall of Fame " mu 2015 no muri 'Hall Legends Hall of Fame' muri Gana mu 2022
Muri Gicurasi 2016, 2Baba yahawe impamyabumenyi y'icyubahiro mu buhanzi muri kaminuza ya Igbinedion, muri Nijeriya, naho muri Werurwe 2019, agirwa Umunyeshuri w'ishuri ry'umuziki muri kaminuza ya Obafemi Awolowo. Muri Mutarama 2017, yatangaje ubufatanye na Komisiyo y’umuryango w’abibumbye ishinzwe impunzi (UNHCR) anatanga impano ku bantu bimuwe mu byabo (IDP) n’abatahutse. Yatangije kandi ubukangurambaga "Vote Not fight" munsi ya Fondasiyo ya Youngstars n'Ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe demokarasi. yabaye ambasaderi ku bicuruzwa the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) in 2009, the Nigerian Stock Exchange (NSE), Airtel Nigeria, Globacom,bitandukanye gishinzwe imiyoborere NAFDAC ambasaderi nyafurika mu ruganda rukora inzoga mu Butaliyani, Campari mu 2016.
Igitaramo cya FORTYfied All-Star Tribute Concert, cyateguwe na 2Baba kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 40 n’uruhare muri muzika ya Nigeriya, cyabaye ku ya 20 Nzeri 2015, muri Eko Hotel na Suites Convention Centre. Yakiriwe na Basketmouth ikanaterwa inkunga na STAR Lager Beer, igitaramo cyamamaye cyane. Niwe kandi washinze urukurikirane rw'ibitaramo "Buckwyld na Breathless" na Fondasiyo ya 2Baba, yahoze yitwa "2Face Reach Out Foundation".

Austin Iornongu Iwar Jnr (wavukiye ku ya 9 Kamena 1997), uzwi nka Tay Iwar, ni umuhanzi uririmba, wandika indirimbo, ucuranga, ukora injyana z’amajwi ndetse akanatunganya amajwi. Azwi cyane mu guhuza R na B n’injyana ya Afro-fusion. Umwuga we watangiye hakiri kare cyane akiri muto yasohoraga imishinga ye ya mbere irimo Renascentia yo mu 2016. Yatangiye kumenyekana cyane kubera Gemini yo mu 2019, yasohotse ibinyujijwe kuri Soulection, itsinda rye rya muzika ryo muri Los Angeles.
Yaje mu muziki hamwe na alubumu ivanze yumuziki yamamaye cyane yitwa Passport, yamuhesheje igihembo ku mwanya wa 3 n'uwa 4 zo muri Nigeriya Teens Choice Awards mu cyiciro cya Choice Mixtape / EP mu 2014 na 2015. Ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 2021, " Wizkid 's "Made in Lagos" deluxe studio album, yatowe muri GRAMMYs kandi imuha ibihembo bidasanzwe, binyuze cyane muri
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Austin Iornongu Iwar yavutse ku ya 9 Kamena 1997 i Marina, akurira hagati ya Lagos na Abuja. Igaragara rye rya mbere muri muzika, ryaturutse kuri mukuru we Suté Iwar. Austin watangiye guhanga umuziki afite imyaka cumi nine, akoresheje sofutiware yumuziki wa digitale FL Studio.
Ku ya 22 Mata 2016, Tay Iwar yasohoye umuzingo w'indirimbo Indirimbo-zirindwi witwa Renascentia, irimo Suté Iwar. inzira "Urukundo rwo kugendera ku mafarasi," yaje kugaragara ku majwi y’igihembwe "cy’umukobwa w’uruhu muri Transit" mu 2017.
Muri 2019, Iwar yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya sitydiyo GEMINI, ikubiyemo abashyitsi bagaragaye muri Cruel Santino, Preyé, Odunsi (Moteri), na Suté Iwar. Inzira "Utero" yatumye Iwar abahatanira ibihembo byiza byijwi (Umugabo) ku nshuro ya 14 ya The Headies. Ku ya 13 Mata 2019, indirimbo ze "Diamond" na "Komeza" zo muri GEMINI zagaragaye kuri radiyo Soulection.
Muri 2020, Iwar yakoranye na Wizkid munzira "Urukundo nyarwo," hamwe na Projexx, nyuma yaje kumuha izina rya mbere rya Grammy. Yagaragaje kandi kuri Album "y’umuhungu wenyine" wa Omah Lay mu 2022. Ku ya 29 Werurwe 2022, Wizkid yashyize ahagaragara amashusho y’indirimbo "Urukundo nyarwo," arimo Tay Iwar na Projexx.
Muri 2024, Tay Iwar yagaragaye kuri Alubumu "ya nyuma" ya Headie One kumurongo "Imbunda &amp; Amafaranga". Yasohoye kandi igice cya kabiri cya Zahabu EP hamwe na Le Mav ku ya 12 Nyakanga

Samara Joy McLendon (yavutse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 1999) ni umuririmbyi w’Umunyamerika. Alubumu ye ya mbere yasohotse mu 2021 yamufashije gutorwa nk’umuhanzi mushya mwiza na JazzTimes. Alubumu ye ya kabiri, Linger Awhile (2022), yageze ku mwanya wa mbere ku rutonde rwa Jazz Albums. Yahawe ibihembo bya Grammy, birimo icy’umuhanzi mushya mwiza mu 2023, ndetse atsindira ibihembo bibiri by’Album nziza ya Jazz Vocal (mu 2023 no mu 2025) hamwe n'icya Performance nziza ya Jazz (2024 na 2025).
Ubuzima bwambere n'uburere.
Yavukiye mu gace ka Castle Hill gaherereye mu gace ka Bronx, mu mujyi wa New York, Joy yavutse mu 1999 mu muryango w’umuziki. Sekuru na sekuru, Umusaza Goldwire na Ruth McLendon, bashinze itsinda rya gospel rya Philadelphia The Savettes. Sekuru, Umusaza Goldwire McLendon nawe yarangije igihembwe cya 3 cya BET 'Gospel Talent show "Sunday Best". Se - umukinnyi w'amajwi akaba n'umucuranzi wa bass wazengurutse umucuranzi wa gospel Andraé Crouch - yamumenyesheje abakomeye ba gospel nka The Clark Sisters, n'ubugingo n'umuziki wa Motown. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Fordham ryubuhanzi kandi akora ibitaramo mu itsinda ryayo rya jazz. Muri, yatsindiye Vocalist Nziza mu iserukiramuco rya Ellington, amarushanwa yisumbuye yakiriwe na Jazz mu kigo cya Lincoln.
Yabanje guhura na jazz muburyo bufite intego ubwo yiyandikishaga muri gahunda ya jazz muri SUNY 's Purchase College nkumu majwi wijwi, maze yitwa Ella Fitzgerald Scholar. Inshuti zaho zamumenyesheje amajwi y’abahanzi bakomeye ba jazz barimo Sarah Vaughan na Fitzgerald, n’abacuranga ibikoresho nka Kenny Washington, Jon Faddis (twiganye), na Ingrid Jensen. Ashingiye ku gishushanyo cya jazz Billie Holiday, Joy yaje gukora ikiruhuko cyitwa "Ibumoso wenyine" kandi yifashishije uburyo bwe bwose kuri stade igezweho.
Muri 2019, nka Samara McLendon, yatsindiye amarushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Jazz Vocal Sarah Vaughan. Umwe mu bacamanza muri iryo rushanwa, Christian McBride uzwi cyane ku isi, yavuze ko Joy ari "impano iboneka rimwe mu gisekuru." Yakoranye na producer ndetse n’umuyobozi wa nyuma, Matt Pierson, yanditse alubumu ye yise iyambere akiri muri kaminuza, arangiza "magna cum laude" mu 2021. "Samara Joy" yasohotse ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2021, kuri Whirlwind Recordings. "Jazz Times" yise Umuhanzi mushya mwiza mu Mu kiganiro, umuyobozi wa firime Regina King yamwise "umukobwa ukiri muto usa na Sarah Vaughan na Ella Fitzgerald bombi baba mu mubiri we."
Yasohoye amashusho menshi y'amashusho, harimo imwe yari imaze kurebwa inshuro zirenga miliyoni 1.5 guhera mu Kwakira 2020. Aya mashusho yari afite guhera mu Gushyingo 2022 yungutse abayoboke be 200.000 kuri TikTok. Ahanini ku mbaraga zatsinze, yazengurutse u Burayi, harimo n'ibitaramo byagurishijwe mu Butaliyani na Otirishiya. Mu 2021 akomeza muri 2022, yazengurutse Amerika, iserukiramuco Jazz,
Ku ya 15 Gashyantare 2022, yaririmbye kuri "uyu munsi" ari kumwe n'umucuranzi wa gitari Pasquale Grasso kuri "uyu munsi" muri Nzeri 2022. agaragara mu iserukiramuco rya Newport Jazz. Yagaragaye kuri alubumu ya 2022 ya piyano piyano Julius Rodriguez "Reka amajwi abwire bose".
Ku ya 16 Nzeri 2022, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye ya kabiri, "Linger Awhile", kuri Verve Records. igaragaramo uvuza ingoma Kenny Washington, umucuranzi wa gitari Pasquale Grasso, piyano Ben Paterson, na David Wong wa bassiste. Mu byo yanditse mu gihe cy'imbeho 2022 harimo kuririmbana na Jazz muri Orchestre Lincoln Centre mu ruzinduko rwayo rwa Big Band. Mu rwego rwo kwiyamamaza kw’ibiruhuko, Joy yifatanyije na Theory maze atangira indirimbo ye nshya yise "Noneho na nyuma" gusa yamamaye mu mujyi wa New York. Yavuze ko ibiruhuko bya Billie ku buryo bwe bwiza.
Yatowe kandi yatsindiye ibihembo bibiri muri Grammy Awards mu 2023: Alubumu nziza ya Jazz Vocal Album ya "Linger Awhile" n'umuhanzi mushya mwiza. Muri Grammy Awards mu 2024, yatowe kandi yegukana igihembo cyiza cya Jazz Performance hamwe nindirimbo ye "Tight." Yatowe kandi yegukana ibindi bihembo bibiri muri Grammy Awards mu 2025: Igitaramo cyiza cya Jazz hamwe na "Twinkle Twinkle Little Me" na Album nziza ya Jazz Vocal ya "Noheri nziza".

Braxton Cook (wavukiye ku ya 27 Werurwe 1991) ni umunyamerika ucuranga saxophone yo mu majwi yo hejuru (alto) akaba n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo unaririmba. Yakoreye ingendo hamwe n’abahanzi ba jazz barimo Christian Scott, Christian McBride na Marquis Hill, kandi aririmbira hamwe n’abandi nka Jon Batiste, Mac Miller na Rihanna. "​" Mu 2017, Fader yamwise “impano idasanzwe ya jazz,” naho mu 2018, Ebony imushyira mu bahanzi batanu ba jazz bakwiye kwitabwaho cyane.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Braxton Cook yavutse ku ya 27 Werurwe 1991, avukira i Boston, muri Massachusetts. Nyuma yo kwimuka inshuro nyinshi, umuryango we watuye ahitwa Silver Spring, Maryland, mu nkengero za Washington, DC, aho yabaga hafi yuburere bwe.
Cook yize ishuri ryisumbuye rya Springbrook yiga saxofone yayobowe na Paul Carr. Igihe yari ahari, yari umwe mu banyeshuri 30 bo muri Amerika batoranijwe mu itsinda rya Grammy jazz 2009. Yize muri kaminuza ya Georgetown imyaka ibiri, aho yize icyongereza yibanda cyane muri African American Studies. Nkumunyeshuri wambere, yiswe Finalist ya YoungArts 2010.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, Cook yimukiye mu ishuri rya Juilliard, aho yize jax saxophone hamwe na Ron Blake na Steve Wilson. Mu mbere muri Juilliard, Cook yitabiriye igitaramo cya Donald Harrison, aho yahuye na mwishywa wa Harrison, umucuranzi w’inzamba Christian Scott. Nyuma yaho gato, Cook yabaye umunyamuryango muremure witsinda rya Scott.
Cook yatangije umwuga we wenyine muri 2014, yishyira ahagaragara bwa mbere EP "Sketch". Yashyize ahagaragara kandi alubumu yuzuye "Cook Yahuye na Butcher Brown" ku bufatanye n’itsinda ry’abanyamerika ryitwa "Jazz" Butcher Brown mu "2015", mbere yo gusinyana na label yigenga "ya" Fresh Selects mu 2016. Ibihembo.
Muri 2018, Cook yagaragaye muri videwo "ya Vox" yise " Indirimbo itinywa cyane muri jazz, yasobanuwe ", yakiriye uburyo bushya budasanzwe: Ubuhanzi, Ubuzima n’umuco igihembo cya 40 cya News na Documentaire Emmy Awards. Ku ruhare rwe muri videwo, Cook yahawe icyemezo cya Emmy Awards.
Muri 2019, Cook yakinnye hamwe na Jon Batiste kumajwi "yubugingo" bwa Pixar, yatsindiye igihembo cya Academy kumanota meza yumwimerere.
Muri Gicurasi 2020, Cook yagaragaye mu gitaramo cya Tiny Desk cya NPR, yakoreye mu rugo rwe muri New Jersey. Nta itsinda rimushyigikira kubera intera mbonezamubano, yakoresheje imirongo kugirango ashyigikire gitari, amajwi, na saxofone. Muri iki gitaramo, Cook yakoze amashusho ya alubumu zitandukanye zirimo "Ahantu Hagati" (2017) "n’ikimenyetso cy’umuriro" (2020), ndetse na "Indirimbo ye (ya Trayvon Martin)", yanditse yandika ku ivanguramoko n'ubugome bwa polisi. [​​​​
Uwahoze ari mugenzi we babanaga na Juilliard Jahaan Sweet yakoresheje urugero rwijwi rya Cook mu gutunganya " Lavender Haze ", inzira ifungura kuri Album ya Taylor Swift ya Album ya "Mid22". Cook yashimwe nk'umuproducer wongeyeho kuriyi nzira, ariko ntiyigeze yumva kugeza alubumu isohotse. Cook na Sweet bari barigeze gukorana mugutunganya indirimbo "Tryna Be" yo muri Album ya 2022 ya studio ya Giveon "Tanga cyangwa Ufate".
Ukuboza 2022, Cook yatangaje ko hasohotse alubumu ye ya gatanu yuzuye ya studio yuzuye "Ninde uri nde iyo ntawe ureba" ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2023, kuri Nettwerk. ahagaragara alubumu nk'imwe mu ziteganijwe "gusohoka" mu 2023.

Mageragere ni umwe mu mirenge 10 igize akarere ka Nyarugenge, ari yo: Gitega, Kanyinya, Kigali, Kimisagara, Mageragere, Muhima, Nyakabanda, Nyamirambo, Nyarugenge, Rwezamenyo.
Umurenge wa Mageragere ufite utugari 7 ari two: Kankuba, Nyarufunzo, Kavumu, Ntungamo, Runzenze, Nyarurenzi, Mataba.

Gereza ya Mageragere, kumugaragaro ikigo ngororamuco cya Nyarugenge (, French), ni igororero riherereye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Kigali, mu Rwanda. Ryashinzwe muri Nzeri 2016, Rizwi nka Mageragere ni gereza nini mu Rwanda. Kugeza muri Kanama 2023, Mageragere icumbikira abagororwa bagera ku 9000.
Ikoreshwa na serivisi ishinzwe Gukosora mu Rwanda (RCS, Kinyarwanda, French).
Gereza ya Mageragere yashinzwe mu 2016 ihuza ibigo bibiri bitandukanye byo gukosora. Gereza ebyiri zahujwe Gasabo na Nyarugenge
Abagororwa n'ibikoresho.
Gereza ya Mageragere yubatswe hamwe hateganijwe guturwa hagati yimfungwa 8000 - 10,000. Gereza ya Mageragere igizwe nibice bitatu, buri gice kigenewe guhuza ibikenewe gukosorwa:

Philippe Van Leeuw ni umuyobozi, umukinnyi ndetse n'umwanditsi wa filime. Akomoka mu gihugu cy'Ububiligi. Yakoze filime ye ya mbere mu 2009 yitwa The Day God Walked Away. Muri 2017"," yanditse kandi ayobora indi filime “”. Iyi filme yamurikimwe ku nshuro ya mbere mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya filime ryabereye i "." Mu bihembo bya Magritte Awards byabaye kunshuro ya 8, iyo filme yegukanye ibihembo byose by'icyo yari yahataniraga, bingana n'igiteranyo cy'ibyegukanywe na " Mr Nobody", birimo n'igihembo cya Filime nziza n'icy'umuyobozi mwiza wa filme cyahawe Van Leeuw.

Impuhwe z'ishyamba (Igifaransa: La Miséricorde de la Jungle) ni filime yakozwe mu mwaka wa 2018 n’umuyobozi w’amafirimi ukomoka Mu Rwanda Joël Karekezi. Ivuga amateka y’abasirikare babiri bo mu Rwanda bitandukanije n’umutwe wabo wa gisirikare mu ntangiriro y’Intambara ya Kongo ya kabiri ndetse n’urugamba rwabo rwo kubaho mu mashyamba aryana hagati y’amakimbirane y’intambara akomeye
Iserukiramuco rya filime rya mbere ryabereye mu iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya firime muri Toronto ku ya 8 Nzeri 2018 kandi rikaba ryaragize umwanya wa kabiri kuva Joël Karakezi. Filime yatoranijwe ku rutonde rwa TIFF's Discovery; Stéphane Bak, umwe muri bombi bayoboye, yatoranijwe nk'umwe mu ba star umunani bakizamuka muri ibyo birori. Filime yagaragaye muri Festival International du Film Francophone de Namur mu Bubiligi. Ku ya 20 Ugushyingo, yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Rwanda mu iserukiramuco rya sinema ry’iburayi 2018 (EFF) i Kigali. Filime yatsindiye Stallion ya Zahabu muri FESPACO.
Serija Xavier unaniwe n'intambara (Marc Zinga) hamwe n'abashyashya ba Private "Faustin" (Bak) batandukanye bituguranye kubera intambara na bataillon yabo yo mu Rwanda mu karere ka Kongo iyo ihamagarwa mu buryo butunguranye mu gitero cya n'ijoro. Bahura n’ibura ry’amazi, ibiryo, n’iterabwoba biterwa na malariya ndetse n’inyamanswa byo mu mashyamba. Bombi barashaka kongera guhura na bataillon berekeza iburengerazuba ariko bagomba gukomeza kwirinda kugirana imikoranire n’abaturage baho bitewe n’uko Abanyekongo banga kurwanya ingabo z’u Rwanda no kuba hari imitwe y’inyeshyamba idasanzwe.
Ubwa mbere, Xavier mukuru ararakara kandi asaba umusore "Faustin private" ariko umubano wimbitse amaherezo uratera imbere hagati yaba bagabo bombi, cyane cyane ko "Faustin" atanga umusanzu ukomeye mubuzima bwabo. Filime irimo ibitekerezo byinshi ku mahano yibasiye akarere n'ibibazo byinshi byinsobanuro n'imbabazi mugihe cyintambara. Xavier arahigwa bukware n’ubugizi bwa nabi yiboneye ndetse akanakora mu gihe Faustin ashishikajwe n’iyicwa ry’umuryango we n’umugore ukiri muto yifuza kongera kubona.
Amaherezo bahitamo kwigana abasirikari ba congo ubwabo, bombi bashoboye kugwa hamwe nitsinda ry'abaturage babagaragariza urukundo n'ubufasha. Amashusho atandukanye ya firime - gukurikirana inyeshyamba, kongera guhura n'intambara, n'ingendo zabo bwite zaba bagabo bombi - bahurira kumusozo wa film.
"The mercy of the Jungle yakorewe" mu Bubiligi na Aurélien Bodinaux binyuze muri Neon Rouge Productions. Bodinaux, Karekezi, na Casey Schroen bashimiwe amashusho. Amashusho y'ubukorikori yaturutse Mu bufaransa hamwe na Filime nziza yo kurasa yo mu budage yashyizwe kurutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa. Gufata amashusho byabereye muri Uganda.

Consolee Nishimwe (wavutse ku ya 11 Nzeri 1979) ni umwanditsi w’u Rwanda, Umukangurambaga, kandi warokotse jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Nishimwe yavutse ku ya 11 Nzeri 1979 i Rubengera, Kibuye (Karongi), mu Rwanda. Nyina, Marie-Jeanne Mukamwiza, na se, Andre Ngoga bombi bari abarimu bigisha mu mashuri abanza. Bahuye mu 1972 bashyingirwa muri Kanama 1977. Nishimwe ni imfura (niwe mukuru iwabo) mu bana batanu. Avuga Icyongereza na Kinyarwanda.
Jenoside Yakorewe abatutsi.
Nishimwe yari afite imyaka 14 igihe itsembabwoko ryo ryakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda ryatangiraga muri Mata 1994. Uyu muryango wahungiye mu gace k'Abayisilamu kugira ngo ukingirwe ariko se na nyirasenge bishwe ku ya 15 Mata 1994. Nyuma y'icyumweru, barumuna be batatu, Bon-Fils Abimana w'amezi 16, Pascal Muvara w'imyaka 7 na Philbert Nkusi w'imyaka 9, baricwa. Sekuru na nyirarume na bo barishwe. Nishimwe yarahunze yihisha amezi atatu, yihanganira iyicarubozo n’izindi ngorane, harimo n’ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ryanduje virusi itera SIDA. Nyina, Marie-Jeanne, na mushiki we, Jeanette Ingabire, barokotse. Jenoside irangiye, 90% by'abatutsi bo mu mujyi wabo bari barishwe.
Mu 2001, Nishimwe yimukiye muri Amerika aho yabaye umuntu uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu akaba n'umuvugizi ushishikariza abantu. Mu mwaka wa 2012, yasohoye urwibutso, "Yageragejwe Kugarukira ku mateka y'Umucikacumu wa Jenoside Kubabara, Kwihangana n'Ibyiringiro". Mu 2014, yavugiye mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo ya kaminuza ya Yale ku isabukuru yimyaka 20 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Muri 2018, yagejeje ijambo ku Nteko rusange y’umuryango w’abibumbye.
Nishimwe ubu atuye mu mujyi wa New York.

Beata Umubaye Mairesse (wavutse 1979, i Butare) ni ikimanyi cy'umunyaporonye n'umunyarwanda Akaba ari umwanditsi w'igifaransa n'ikinyarwanda akaba yararokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. Ni umwanditsi w'ibitabo bitatu, hamwe n'ibyegeranyo byinshi by'inkuru ngufi n'imivugo. Inyandiko ye yabonye ibihembo byinshi by'ubuvanganzo mu bufaransa ndetse no mu mahanga.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Beata Umubyeyi Mairesse yavukiye kandi akurira i Butare, mu Rwanda. Se yari Umunyapolonye naho nyina ni Umunyarwanda. Akiri umwana, yize ishuri mpuzamahanga i Butare, aho yize kuvuga igifaransa neza. Muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, Beata w'imyaka 15 y'amavuko yarokoye we na nyina w’umututsi agerageza kwigira umufaransa. Bombi bahunze igihugu bihisha muri convoy y'abana ya Terre des hommes. Umubyeyi Mairesse nyuma azashyirwa hamwe n'umuryango urera mu majyaruguru y'ubufaransa. Amashuri yisumbuye, yize ubuvanganzo na siyanse ya politiki muri kaminuza ya Sorbonne, ari naho yarangirije impamyabumenyi mu bikorwa by’ubutabazi n’iterambere. Nyuma yakoraga mu miryango mpuzamahanga ifasha no mu rwego rw'ubuzima. Kuva mu 2007 yabaga i Bordeaux, mu Bufaransa.
Muri 2015, Umubyeyi Mairesse yerekanye bwa mbere nk'umwanditsi ufite icyegeranyo cy'inkuru ngufi zitwa "Ejo", ijambo risobanura "ejo hashiz n'ejo Hazaza" i Kinyarwanda, ururimi rwe kavukire. Izo nkuru zashyizweho mbere na nyuma ya jenoside kandi zivugwa uhereye ku bagore. Muri 2017, yasohoye icyegeranyo cya kabiri cy'inkuru ngufi, "Lézardes".
Muri 2019, yasohoye "Après le progrès", icyegeranyo cy'imivugo. Muri uwo mwaka, Mairesse yasohoye igitabo cye cya mbere, "Tous tes enfants dispersés". Igitabo kivuga amateka y'umuryango washenywe na jenoside n’ubuhunzi. Ireba insanganyamatsiko nk'ububyeyi, uruhare rw'umugore nk'abatwara umuco, ihererekanyabubasha n'umuco hagati y'ibisekuru, ivanguramoko n'umuco. "Tous tes enfants dispersés" yakiriwe neza n’abanenga Abafaransa kandi ihabwa ibihembo byinshi by’ubuvanganzo, harimo na Prix des cinq umugabane wa 2020 de la francophonie. Icyongereza, "Abana bawe bose, batatanye" bahawe ishimwe na "Financial Times" na "The Guardian".
Umubyeyi Mairesse yasohoye igitabo cye cya kabiri yise "Consolée", mu 2022. "Consolée" avuga inkuru y’umugore w’amoko avanze yakuwe kuri nyina w’u Rwanda akiri umwana kugira ngo arerwe n’ababikira bera nyuma yoherezwa kurerwa mu Bubiligi. Inkuru ishingiye kubintu byabayeho byabana bavanze-moko barerewe muri Institut pour enfants mulâtres de Save mugihe cy'ubutegetsi bwabakoloni. Igitabo cyahawe Prix Kourouma mu imurikagurisha ry’ibitabo byabereye i Geneve mu 2023.
Mu 2024, Umubyeyi Mairesse yasohoye igitabo cyandika ku buzima bwa "Le convoi", cyerekanaga ko yahunze u Rwanda mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu 1994. Muri iki gitabo, avuga uburyo yakurikiranye abana kuva muri convoy yahunze, ikipe ya BBC yafashe amashusho ya convoy, hamwe n'abakozi bashinzwe ubutabazi bakijije ubuzima bwe. Yavanze autobiography hamwe ninyandiko, ahuza ibikorwa bye n'abandi banditsi barokotse itsembabwoko, nka Primo Levi na Imre Kertész. "Le convoi" yahawe ishimwe n’abanenga Abafaransa, kandi yitwa kimwe mu bitabo byiza byo mu 2024 na Télérama na Les Inrockuptibles. Igitabo cyakomeje gutsindira ibihembo byinshi by’ubuvanganzo, harimo Prix Essai France Télévisions na Grand prix de l'héroïne Madame Figaro. Yabaye kandi finale ya Prix du Livre Inter 2024.
Muri uwo mwaka, icyegeranyo cye cy’imivugo "Culbuter le malheur" cyasohowe n’umwamamaji w’Abafaransa-Kanada Mémoire d'encrier.
Beata Umubyeyi Mairesse yatanze ijambo ritangiza iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga ry’ubuvanganzo mpuzamahanga rya 2424. ["citation ikenewe"]

Kayitesi annick Jozan (yavutse mu 1979 u Rwanda) ni umwanditsi w’u Rwanda akaba yararokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi.
Muri Mata 1994, Annick Kayitesi-Jozan yabuze abanyamuryango bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. mu batutsi bari i Butare, kandi bari bahungiye mu kigo cy’ishuri, aho nyina yakoreraga. Interahamwe zishe nyina muriryo shuri. Murumuna we Aimé, ufite imyaka 9, mushiki we Aline, ufite imyaka 16, babyara be bombi, bajyanywe mu gikamyo bajyanwa aho batewe imipanga baricwa. Annick ntabwo yajyanywe hamwe n'abandi bagize umuryango we, kubera impamvu zidasobanutse neza, ahari kubera ko abaturanyi bashakaga kumugumana nk'umukozi.
We na mushiki we Aline, bajyanywe n’umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta Terre des Hommes. Yimukiye mu Bufaransa. Yabanje kubana nimiryango yakiriye abanyamahanga.. Yiga siyanse ya politiki, abona DEA, nyuma atangira kwiga psychologiya. yatangiye kwitwa impunzi, mu 2005,aza kubona ubwenegihugu bw'Ubufaransa.
Yashinze ishyirahamwe Études sans frontières kugira ngo ateze imbere ishuri ry’imfubyi za jenoside. Yitabiriye kwibuka Kunshuro ya 30 jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Afite umuhungu n'umukobwa Yabyaranye n'umufaransa. Kuva mu 2015 yabaga muri Uzubekisitani hamwe n'umugabo we, Raphaël Jozan uyobora ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry'Ubufaransa (AFD).

Irakoze Ariane Vanessa ni umukinnyi wa filime w'umunyarwandakazi watangiye umwuga we wo gukina muri 2020, mu ruherekane rw'urubuga rwa "Maya". Nyuma yaho gato, Irakoze yakinnye mu rundi rubuga rwa interineti, "Ibanga(The secret)", ryakozwe n'umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda Yves Mizero.
Irakoze yakinnye mu ruherekane rwa filimi ica kuri terevisiyo "iShusho ya Papa" nka Olive.

Rising From Ashes ni filime yigenga ya 2012 yigenga ivuga ku iterambere ry’ikipe y’igihugu y’amagare mu Rwanda, igihugu kigikomeje kwibasirwa na jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994 aho abagera ku 500.000-1,000,000 bishwe.
Umukinnyi w'amagare wabigize umwuga Jacques “Jock” Boyer yimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2006 kugira ngo afashe itsinda ry'abacitse ku icumu rya jenoside bahanganye n'ikibazo cyo gushinga ikipe y'igihugu y'amagare. Iri tsinda rigizwe n’abana basigaye ari impfubyi kandi bahahamuwe na jenoside mu myaka icumi ishize. Mugihe cy'inkuru, Boyer hamwe n'itsinda "Rise from Ashes" byahise babifashijwemo nibyagezweho.
"Team Rwanda" itangira nk'umuryango w'amagare ariko igenda ihinduka uko abategura bamenya abakinnyi bakeneye cyane. Abanyonzi benshi ntibazi gusoma no kwandika, bafite ubuzima budafite amazi, amashanyarazi cyangwa ubuvuzi, kandi benshi barimo gukira ingaruka z’amateka ya jenoside yo mu 1994. Amaherezo, "Ikipe y'u Rwanda" ifatwa nk'ikimenyetso kicyizere ku Rwanda, ambasaderi w'igihugu kigaruka. Mu myaka yakurikiyeho, itsinda ryagura icyerekezo kandi ritezimbere icyitegererezo cyo kwita ku bakinnyi. Mu mwaka wa 2012, iyi kipe itangira guteza imbere ikipe ya mbere y’Afurika yose ihuye na Tour de France nyuma yuko umwe mu bakinnyi yujuje ibisabwa mu mikino ya 2012 Summer Olympics.
Daphne Howland wo "muri The Village Voice" yise "Rising From Ashes" "documentaire idasanzwe. Ntabwo ireba ikipe yo gusiganwa ku magare gusa; ni gihamya y'ibyabaye iyo abantu bita kubandi."
"Umunyamakuru wa Hollywood", Frank Schneck yagize ati: "Filime irasobanutse kandi ifite ubukungu." “Filime… irinda melodramatike idasanzwe, nyuma ya byose, ntibikenewe cyane mu nkuru isanzwe irimo amateka akomeye.”
Urubuga rwo gukusanya urubuga Rotten Tomatoes ruvuga ko 79% by'abanenga bahaye filime isuzuma ryiza rishingiye ku isuzuma 19, impuzandengo ya 5.9 / 10.
"Rising From Ashes" yakozwe n'imiryango ibiri ifatanya n'imiryango idaharanira inyungu, Gratis 7 Media Group hamwe nu Project Rwanda, mugihe cy'imyaka itandatu. Forest Whitaker yavuze iyi filime yakozwe n'amadorari 800.000 yaturutse gusa ku baterankunga. Kuva yasohoka mu 2012, iyi filime yatsindiye ibihembo mu birori birenga icumi bya firime ku isi. ["citation ikenewe"]

Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana (yavutse ku ya 19 Mutarama 1991 mu Rwanda), bakunze kwita izina rya stage Isacco ni umuririmbyi w’igifaransa n’ikinyarwanda, akaba n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo.
Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana yavukiye mu Rwanda akurira cyane cyane muri Kenya. Ni bucura iwabo mu bavandimwe batatu babyawe na Béata na Callixte Nzabonimana.
Mu bwana bwe muri Kenya, yatangiye gukunda umuziki hakiri kare. Nyuma yaje kwimukira mu Bufaransa gukurikirana amasomo ya Logistics anakomeza gutezimbere umwuga we wu muzika.
Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana yatandukanye n'ababyeyi be akiri muto kubera ihungabana n'ibihe bigoye byagize ingaruka ku gihugu cye muricyo Gihe gihe. Kuva afite imyaka itatu, yarezwe na bakuru be babiri adahari ababyeyi be badahari.
Nubwo yakuze adafite urukundo rw'ababyeyi, yahawe uburere bukomeye kandi bwita kuri benewabo, we abona ko ari ababyeyi be b'ukuri. Mu kiganiro kuri televiziyo, yagize ati: “Ndi uwo ndiwe uyu munsi kubera bo.” mucyongereza "“I am who I am today because of them.”
Yongeye guhura n'ababyeyi be bamubyaye afite imyaka 21, uburambe yavuze ko butazibagirana.
Mu bwana bwe bwose, abantu benshi mu baturage - inshuti z'umuryango ndetse n'abo baziranye - bagize uruhare mu kumwitaho no kumererwa neza, nubwo ntaho bahuriye kandi nta kintu na kimwe bategereje. Iyi nkunga ititangiriye itama yatangajwe cyane na Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana kandi bituma agira impuhwe n’ubufatanye. Akenshi avuga ko kwiyemeza gufasha abandi bituruka kuri ubu bunararibonye bwawe: “Iyo ukoze ibyiza hafi yawe, umunsi umwe bikugarukira haba kuri wewe cyangwa ku muryango wawe.”
Azwiho ubuhanga nka Isacco akitwa Umwami wa Stage kubera ibikorwa bye byimbaraga n'ubushobozi bwo gukurura abantu no kubashishikariza
Isacco yatangiye urugendo rwe rwa muzika muri Kenya, aho yamenyekanye na sitidiyo zafashwe amajwi na mubyara we, Rukuz, utuganya imiziki. Yanditse indirimbo ye ya mbere, " "Maisha Ni Mpango" " ("Life is a Project"), yakiriye amashusho kuri radiyo yo muri Kenya kandi amuha amahirwe yo gukora nk'igitaramo cyo gutangiza ibitaramo byaho.
Nubwo mu ntangiriro atigeze atekereza ko umuziki ari umwuga wabigize umwuga, Isacco yagumye mu ruhando nyuma yo kwimukira mu Bufaransa. Agezeyo, yinjiye mu ruziga rw'inshuti z'umuziki maze ashinga itsinda " ' IC-KS ' ". Nyuma y'imyaka itari mike, mugihe abagize itsinda bakurikiranye izindi nzira z'umwuga, yahisemo gutangira umwuga wenyine.
Muri 2017, Isacco yasohoye indirimbo ye ya mbere ku giti cye, NONAHA ("Now "), yahise atsindira ako kanya maze atangira urugendo rwe rwa muzika wenyine. Kuva icyo gihe, yamenyekanye kubera ijwi rye ry'ukuri, imbaraga zikomeye, hamwe na stage ikomeye.
Yasohoye izindi ndirimbo nyinshi, zirimo:
"Uko Ubikora" (2020)
Muri 2020, yashinze label ye bwite, ISACCO Production, asohora zunguza afatanyije n'umuhanzi wo muri Gineya Lil Sako.
Album ye ya mbere, "On s'amuse", yasohotse muri Nzeri 2021 kandi ikubiyemo inzira umunani. Album ya kabiri iteganijwe mu mpera za 2025, hamwe nubufatanye butandukanye n'abahanzi bo muri Kenya.
Ibikorwa bye bikomeje kwitabwaho n’itangazamakuru mu Rwanda no muri Kenya, yemeza umwanya afite mu muziki wa diaspora nyafurika.
Muri uwo mwaka, Isacco yakoze ibitaramo byinshi byubahwa, hamwe n'abahanzi bazwi:
Frankfurt - Yasangiye stage na Dadju

Dock Pullman - Yakinnye na DJ Arafat, Bramsito, Passi, na Djibril Cissé, uwahoze ari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w'umupira w'amaguru mu Bufaransa aza kuba umu DJ
Dock Eiffel - Yitabiriye igitaramo cyo kwizihiza isabukuru yimyaka 25 ya Soum Bill
Foire de Paris - Yakozwe nabahanzi batandukanye ba Trace Afrika
Zénith de Paris - Yasangiye stage na Mariam Ba

2022 - Umuhanzi mwiza wa Diaspora

Ibikorwa by'ubutabazi.
Isacco yiyemeje cyane gushyigikira abatishoboye, cyane cyane abasaza n'abafite ubumuga. Yagaragaje ko yumva ari ingirakamaro rwose iyo kumarana nabo umwanya Abatega amatwi, no gusangira ibihe byo guhuza abantu.
Kuva mu 2013, Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana yitanze buri mwaka muri Diyosezi ya Pilgrimage of Oise i Lourdes, akora nk'umurezi w'ibitaro ku basaza n'abamugaye basura. Afata inararibonye nkisoko ifatika yo gukura kugiti cye no guhumeka mubuhanzi.
Uburyo bwe bwashinze imizi muri altruisme: atanga ubufasha adategereje kugaruka, atanga igihe cye nta nyungu ateganya, kandi yizera ko gukora ibikorwa byiza nta mpamvu zidasanzwe ari isoko y'ibanze yo gusohoza umuntu ku giti cye. Kuri we, ibikorwa by'ineza bikorwa muri iki gihe bishobora kugira ingaruka zirambye haba mu buzima bwe cyangwa mu buzima bw'abandi.
Iyi filozofiya ya kimuntu iramenyesha cyane uko abona isi kandi ikomeza guhindura ibyo yiyemeje n'imibereho ye.
Isaac Murwanashyaka Nzabonimana afite impamyabumenyi n'inzobere muri logistique. Yakoreye ibigo byinshi mpuzamahanga, harimo:
BMW nkibice byo kugurisha ububiko
Nestlé Purina nk'umukozi ushinzwe ibikoresho
Curieux E-fluid nk'umuyobozi wububiko
Sodexo nkumutekinisiye wibikoresho mugihe cya olempike ya Paris 2024
FM Logistic nk'umuyobozi w'itsinda
GreenTech nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikoresho
Album ya kabiri (iteganijwe mu mpera za 2025)
"Uko Ubikora" (2020)
"Zunguza" feat. Lil Sako (2021)

Marc Zinga (wavutse ku ya 21 Ukwakira 1984) ni umukinnyi wa Kongo-Umubiligi, umuririmbyi akaba n'umukinnyi wa filime. Yaririmbye bye muri "May Allah Bless France", yatorewe igihembo cya Most Promising Actor.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Zinga yavukiye i Likasi, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yimukiye mu Bubiligi n'umuryango we afite imyaka itanu. Yari umwe mu baririmbyi bayoboye itsinda rya "Peas Project" hagati ya 2003 na 2011.
Yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina agaragara mu ma firime mato na televiziyo mbere yo gutangira imirimo ikomeye muri filime "Abaskuti ba Zebrasi" na "May Allah Bless France!" muri 2014.
Uruhare rwe muri "May Allah Bless France!", Zinga yatorewe igihembo cya cesar Award for most Promising Actor. Muri 2015, yahawe igihembo cya Magritte Award for Most Promosing Actor mu bihembo bya 5 bya Magritte Award kubera uruhare yagize muri "Zebras", naho muri 2019, igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza muri African Film and Television Festival of Ouagadougou (Fespaco) kubera uruhare yagize muri filime yo mu Rwanda yatsindiye "The Mercy of the Jungle".
Mu 2024, yabonye igihembo cye cya kane cya Magritte aba nuwa kabiri mu bakinnyi bitwaye neza, kubera uruhare rwe muri "Omen", filime yo mu 2023 iyobowe n'umuraperi Baloji wo mu Bubiligi-Kongo mu mukino wa mbere yakinnye. Zinga afite uruhare runini rwa Koffi, Wagarutse i Lubumbashi nyuma yimyaka 15 adahari.

Nameless (izina ry’Igifaransa: "Les anonymes") ni filime nyarwanda yo mu 2021 yo mu bwoko bwa drama, yayobowe na Mutiganda Wa Nkunda mu kuyobora kwe bwa mbere Filime yerekanwe ku nshuro ya 27 ya FESPACO, aho yatsindiye igihembo cyiza cyane. Byatewe n’icyaha cy’urukozasoni Nkunda yibaneye i Kigalii Kigali, ndetse na film ya Ken Loach yo mu 1966 "Cathy Come Home".
Iyi filime yari ishingiye ku bintu byabayeho mu buzima bugoye bw’abakunzi bakiri bato baturuka i Kigali, ndetse no kuba barababaje mu ihohoterwa.

Kinyarwanda ni filime ya 2011 ishingiye kuri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Ushingiye ku nkuru zukuri, film igizwe n'inkuru esheshatu zahujwe n'ibintu byinshi bibaho mugihe cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi riba. ​​​
"" yavuze ko iyi filime ari "Doubly Disappointing", mu gihe African American Literature Book Club cyasobanuye ko ari "umukinnyi wa mbere w’ubuyobozi".

Gamaliel Mbonimana ni umuhanga mu by'amateka y'u Rwanda, Porofeseri Emeritus muri kaminuza nkuru y'u Rwanda. "Azwi cyane mu Rwanda kubera ibikorwa bye nk'umuhanga mu by'amateka n'umuco".
Mu 2007, yahamagawe nk'umutangabuhamya w'inzobere mu bushinjacyaha mu rubanza rwa Simon Bikindi imbere y'urukiko International Criminal Tribunal for rwanda.

Bazigaga ni filime ngufi ivuga kuri genoside yakorewe abatutsi mu rwanda iri mu rurimi rwigifaransa yo mu 2022 yanditswe kandi iyobowe na Jo Ingabire Moys. Yafatanije na Verbinski hamwe na Graham King na John B. Carls, film ikinamo Eliane Umuhire.
Iyi filime yatsindiye igihembo cya BAFTA ku bahatanira igihembo cyiza cya Filime ngufi mu bihembo bya 76 bya British Academy Film Awards.
Filime ishingiye ku kuri ku ibyabaye, ikavuga inkuru y’umupasiteri ukiri muto witwa “Karembe” (Ery Nzaramba) usabwa gushakira ubuhungiro we n’umukobwa we kugira ngo birinde imitwe y’abicaga Abatutsi ishaka kubagiraho nabi.
Mu gushaka uko barokoka, bahungira mu rugo rw’umupfumu ukomeye kandi ukiri utinyitse muri ako gace uruhare rwakinwe neza cyane na Eliane Umuhire

Benjamin Sehene (wavutse mu 1959) ni umwanditsi wo mu Rwanda umurimo we w'ibanze cyane cyane ku bibazo by’irangamuntu ndetse n’ibyabaye kuri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. yakunze kuba muri Kanada no mu Bufaransa.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Benjamin Sehene yavukiye i Kigali, mu Rwanda, mu 1959 mu muryango w'Abatutsi.
Umuryango we wahunze u Rwanda kubera amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko n'ubwicanyi bwakorerwaga abatutsi mu 1963 bajya muri Uganda. Bagize amahirwe yo gutoroka babikesheje mukuru wa Benyamini, wakoraga muri ambasade y'Amerika i Kigali icyo gihe akaba yarashoboye kwimura umuryango.
Benjamin yarakuriye mu bugande yiga no muricyo gihugu.
Yize i Paris muri kaminuza ya Sorbonne mu ntangiriro ya za 1980.
Mu 1984 Sehene yimukiye muri Kanada, atangira kwandika ku mateka ye 1988.
Nyuma yo kwimukira i Paris, mu 1994 habaye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu rwanda. Sehene yasubiye mu Rwanda guhamya no kwandika kubyo yabonye. Yavumbuye ibyiyumvo byo mu bwana byashyinguwe mu kwibuka, ndetse n'ururimi rwe kavukire, Kinyarwanda. Agaruka i Paris, byamutwaye hafi imyaka ine kugirango atezimbere ibitekerezo bye mu nyandiko. Ashingiye ku byamubayeho, Sehene yanditse inyandiko ya "Le Piège ethnique" (1999), yasohotse mu Cyongereza yitwa "The Ethnic Trap".
Mu 2005 Sehene yateguye documentaire isubiramo itatanya ry'abagize umuryango we, i Toronto, Buenos Aires, Paris, na Kigali. Urudodo rwabo bahuriyemo ni ugushakisha indangamuntu: bose bitwara muri bo itsembabwoko ryo mu Rwanda n'intangiriro yaryo. Yahangayikishijwe cyane n'ejo hazaza h’u Rwanda n'akarere Lake Region. Yashyigikiye Afurika Renaissance, yizeye ko bishoboka nyuma yo kureba urugero rwa Afurika y'Epfo.
Muri 2005 kandi yandikaga igitabo kivuga ku bimukira hamwe n’urubyiruko rwo mu gisekuru cya kabiri n'icya gatatu cy'Abanyarwanda.
Yanditse "Le Feu sous la soutane" ("Umuriro munsi ya Cassock") (2005), igitabo cy’amateka cyibanze ku nkuru y’ukuri y’umupadiri Catholic hutu Priest, Wenceslas Munyeshyaka, watanze uburinzi ku mpunzi z’abatutsi mu rusengero rwe mbere yo gusambanya abo bagore no kugira uruhare mu bwicanyi. Iki gitabo nicyo gitabo cya mbere cy’igifaransa cyitwa Rwanda cyasohowe kuva jenoside yaba yo mu 1994.
Sehene atanga kandi ingingo mu kinyamakuru cyo kuri interineti rue89, kandi ni umunyamuryango wa PEN International. ["citation ikenewe"]
Mu 2002 Sehene yari atuye muri Kanada; mu 2005 yari atuye mu La Chapelle District ka Paris, aho yari atuye mu 2008; mu Kwakira 2010 yari agarutse mu Bufaransa.

Uwamahoro Antoinette (yavutse ku ya 25 Ukuboza 1975 i Kigali) ni umukinnyi wa filrimi w'umunyarwandakazi
Uwamahoro Antoinette uzwi ku izina rya "Intare y'igore", "Siperansiya" amaze imyaka makumyabiri akina muri firime mu Rwanda. Yamenyekanye cyane muri firime zitandukanye zo mu Rwanda zirimo Serikwira, Giramata, Mukadata, Intare y'ingore n'abandi. bifata iyindi ntera muri Seburikoko kuri Televiziyo y'u Rwanda.
Yumvaga abaye umustar wa firime nka Commando.
Ni imfura mu bana barindwi Bavukana.
Arubatse, afite abana batatu. Kuri ubu, atuye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge mu Murenge wa Nyamirambo.

Fred Mfuranzima (wavutse 1997) ni umwanditsi wu Rwanda, umuhanzi, umusizi, n’umuntu uharanira amahoro. Yanditse ibitabo mu Cyongereza no mu Kinyarwanda. Muri 2018 yashinze Imfura Heritage Rwanda, urubuga rwo guteza imbere ubuhanzi n'ubuvanganzo, no Peace activism. Inyandiko ze zikunze kwerekana ibibazo n'intsinzi by'abantu mu Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside ya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Nk’umuntu uharanira amahoro, Mfuranzima yagize uruhare rugaragara muri gahunda zitandukanye n’ubukangurambaga bugamije kwimakaza amahoro n’ubwiyunge mu Rwanda no mu karere k’ibiyaga bigari.
Ubuzima bwambere nuburere.
Fred Mfuranzima yavukiye i Huye, mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda mu 1997, ariko yakuriye mu gace ka Kigali akomoka mu muryango w’abantu barokotse jenoside. Amateka yumuryango we yaje kumutera ishyaka, bituma agira uruhare mukubaka amahoro nubwiyunge akoresheje imivugo, kwandika nubuhanzi.
Yatangiye kwandika akiri umwana muto mu mashuri abanza. Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yandikaga imivugo n'inkuru abo bigana.
Mfuranzima yize anitabira amasomo menshi yo kwandika n'amahugurwa, ndetse n'ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye byo kwiga.
Mbere yo gutangira kwandika nkuwabigize umwuga nk, Mfuranzima yifuzaga kuba umikinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru, ariko Yagize imvune yahagaritse ibyiringiro byo kuba umukinnyi.
Yasohoye igitabo cye cya mbere, ""Letter From Tutsi Hill", mu 2017. Yanditse ibitabo bitandukanye mu Cyongereza na Kinyarwanda, harimo: Child, "U Rwanda is Poetry",The Broken, "Kuva ku gasozi Bututsi", "Dreams to find another World", "Sister's Left Shoes na The Lonely Soul". Byinshi mu bikorwa bye byabanda ku nsanganyamatsiko z’"identity" (kwimenya no kumenya aho ukomoka), ubwiyunge ndetse n’ubuzima bwa muntu, akenshi agaragaza ibibazo n’intsinzi abantu bahura na byo mu mibereho yabo Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside.
Mfuranzima yanditse kandi ibisigo byinshi, birimo "My Shame ", "Never Again", "Endless Music", "In low Voice", "Confession", "Three Patriots", "Umwiza", "Full of Repect", na "African Dream".
Yavuze ko ibihangano by abanditsi nkabanditsi b’u Rwanda Tharicis Gatwa, Scholastique Mukasonga, Yolande Mukagasana, n’abandi nka Oduor Jagero, Kae Tempest, na Shakespeare bya muteye imbaraga mu nyandiko ze.
Kugeza mu 2021, Mfuranzima yigisha mu bice bitandukanye, harimo kuri "American Corner Kigali" no muri "Kigali Public Library".
Muri 2018, yinjiye mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’Imibereho Myiza y'Abaturage kwiga iterambere ry'umushinga, igenamigambi n'imicungire, anasaba amasomo atandukanye yo kwihangira imirimo. ["​"]
Muri 2018 Mfuranzima yashinze ikigo cy’imibereho Imfura Heritage Rwanda Ltd, gikoresha ubuhanzi, ubuvanganzo, n’ubumenyi bw’ubwenge mu guteza imbere umuco w’amahoro n’ibyiringiro mu karere k’ibiyaga bigari bya Afurika. Itera kandi impano nshya binyuze mu kwandika, umuziki, imivugo, hamwe n’ubuhanzi bugaragara, kugira ngo ifashe kurema umuryango w’abantu bashinzwe imibereho myiza n’abaharanira amahoro. Mu 2021 Imfura yari ifite amashami i Kanombe, Kiyovu, na Huye. Yashinze kandi umuyobozi wa Imfura Arts Centre na Imfura Arts for Peace association.
yateguye iserukiramuco ngarukamwaka ry'amahoro ryiswe Imfura Heritage Festival, rigaragaramo abahanzi bato baturutse mu karere. Yateje imbere ubufatanye na ambasade ya Isiraheli n’Ubudage mu Rwanda, Isomero rusange rya Kigali, Intumwa z’Umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’Uburayi mu Rwanda, n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta itandukanye mu Rwanda, harimo na Never Again Rwanda.
Yafunguye kandi inzu yo isohora ibitabo ikanabitangaza, kugirango byorohereze abanditsi b'u Rwanda gusohora. Yishyura 75 ku ijana by'amafaranga yo gutangaza naho abanditsi bishyura 25 ku ijana.
Ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ku munsi wo kwibuka jenoside yakorewe Abatutsii ku ya 21 Mutarama 2023, ufatanije na Aegis Trust, Mfuranzima yasomye bimwe mu bisigo bye.

Lyiza ni filime ngufi yo mu Rwanda ya 2011 iyobowe na Marie-Clementine Dusabejambo.
Ibihe byashize bihora mu buzima bwa Lyiza ugomba kubana n'ihahamuka ry'ubwicanyi bw'ababyeyi be, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda. Iyo amenye se w'uwo bigana, Rwena, nyirabayazana w'ubwicanyi bwabo, abivuga ku mugaragaro, bitera impagarara nyinshi. Ariko ubwumvikane bugaruka binyuze mu butabazi bwa mwarimu ujyana abasore mu ngoro ndangamurage ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, aho bibukwa, akanayobora Lyiza kubabarirra. Tutiriwe dédactique kandi n'uburyo bw'umwimerere bwo kuvuga, film ishimangira akamaro ko gusangira ubunararibonye no kwigisha ukuri n'ubwiyunge.

Ikinyantigwa na Baribuda ni ururimi rwa kinyacroele ruvuga Icyongereza, rwavutse ku ivangamiriro ry’abavuga indimi za Kwa n’abavuga Icyongereza cyo muri Antigwa na Baribuda mu birwa bya Leeward. Ubu, ni ururimi kavukire muri Antigwa na Baribuda, Saint Kitts na Nevis, Anguilla, Montserrat, ndetse no mu miryango imwe yo muri Dominica. Ikinyantigwa na Baribuda ni rwo rurimi ruvugwa cyane mu bihugu byigenga byombi, kandi ni rumwe mu ndimi zivugwa cyane mu Burasirazuba bwa Karayibe. Ururimi rufite abantu bagera ku 150,000 baruvuga nk’ururimi kavukire.
Ikinyantigwa na Baribuda rigizwe n’amoko menshi atandukanye, kandi amwe muri yo yumvikana gusa mu buryo bugarukirijeho. Bitewe no kwiyongera kw’ihuriro hagati y’abatuye Ibirwa bya Leeward, uru rurimi rwa creole rwagize amoko menshi y’utugari yaje kuzimira nyuma y’ivangura. Ubwoko buvugwa cyane kurusha ubundi, Northern Antigwan, bwagize impinduka cyane bitewe no kugabanuka no kugengwa n’abandi bavuga Icyongereza.
Igice kinini cy’amagambo y’Ikinyantigwa na Baribuda gikomoka mu Cyongereza, kandi ururimi rufite uburyo bwihariye bw’inyajwi ndetse n’imiterere y’imvugo idasanzwe. Ikinyantigwa na Baribuda kigumye kuba ururimi rutari urwo mu nzego zemewe, bityo ntikigishwa mu mashuri cyangwa ngo gikoreshwe mu itumanaho ryemewe.

Natacha MUZIRAMAKENGA ni umunyarwandakazi wavutse: 1984(afite imyaka 41). Akaba azwi ku mazina: MIZIGURUKA. Akora umwuga wo gukina filim no gukora cyangwa guhanga filime. Ibihangano by'ingenzi Gukina filime, gukurikirana ibikorwa by'ubugeni. Urugero rwa fililme ya yoboye: "Neptune Frost", urugero rwa Filime yakinnye: Grey matter, Small country: An African childhood.
Natacha MUZIRAMAKENGA, uzwi kandi ku izina rya MIZIGURUKA (wavutse 1984), ni umuhanzi uhuza ibihugu byinshi byo mu Rwanda akaba n'umuyobozi ushinzwe guhanga. Ibikorwa bye birimo imivugo, gukina, no gutunganya. Insanganyamatsiko yakozeho zagarutsemo kenshi harimo kwihangana, ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, uburenganzira bwa muntu, feminism(uburinganire bw'abagore n'abagabo), no guhagararira abirabura.
Miziguruka yakinnye muri filime zitandukanye harimo "Neptune Frost" ; "Petit Yishyura", izwi kandi ku izina rya "Igihugu gito: Gukurira muri Afurika" ; "Grey matter" ; na "Icyumweru k'i Kigali".
Yagize uruhare mu ikinamico yitwa "Kwiga Feminism yo mu Rwanda", azenguruka Ubudage n'Ubusuwisi hagati "ya" 2020 na 2021. Yanditse igitabo cyitwa "Méandres" kandi akora ibitaramo bihuriza hamwe amashusho n’imivugo mu birori bya Frequencies Festival i Berlin.Yerekanye ibikorwa bye nk’ukurikiranira hafi ubuhanzi bw’iki gihe i Seoul mu 2023.
Ibihangano bye byanditswe mu kinyamakuru "Wasafari" no mu gitabo rusange "Au dessous des Volcans", cyasohowe na Sepia mu mwaka wa 2019. []

Dorcy Rugamba (yavutse mu 1969) ni umwanditsi, umukinnyi w'ikinamico, umubyinnyi n'umuyobozi w'ikinamico w'Umunyarwanda. Ni umuhungu wa Rugamba Cyprien na Daphrose Mukansanga. Ababyeyi be n'abavandimwe be benshi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ibikorwa bye byinshi bivuga kuri iyo Jenoside.
Mu 2012, Dorcy Rugamba yashinze Rwanda Arts Initiative. Mu 2024, yari umuyobozi w'ubuhanzi wa Kigali Triennial ya mbere. Mu 2024 kandi, yasohoye igitabo "Hewa Rwanda, une lettre aux absents". Mu 2026, yasohoye igitabo cy'inkuru "Les enfants gâtés de Butare".
Dorcy Rugamba yavutse mu 1969, mu Rwanda. Se ni Rugamba Cyprien. Rugamba Cyprien yari umwanditsi, umuhimbyi w'indirimbo n'imbyino, akaba n'umushakashatsi. Ni we winjije Dorcy mu buhanzi. Dorcy yatojwe imbyino gakondo z'Intore.
Dorcy yize ibijyanye n'imiti (farumasi) muri Kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda no muri Kaminuza Gatolika ya Louvain. Mu 1992, yashinze itorero ry'imbyino n'ikinamico «Isango» i Butare.
Ku ya 7 Mata 1994, Dorcy n'umuvandimwe we Olivier ntibari mu rugo i Kigali. Bari i Butare kwa nyirasenge. Uwo munsi, abasirikare bishe ababyeyi be n'abavandimwe be batandatu. Umuvandimwe we Cirdare ni we warokotse mu rugo.
Dorcy yize ikinamico muri Conservatoire royal de Liège, mu Ububiligi. Yahawe igihembo cya mbere mu buhanzi bw'ikinamico.
Dorcy Rugamba ni umwe mu banditsi batandatu b'ikinamico "Rwanda 94". Itsinda ry'ikinamico Groupov ryayerekanye mu iserukiramuco rya Avignon, mu Bufaransa, mu 1999. Iyi kinamico yahawe ibihembo byinshi mu Bubiligi no mu Bufaransa. Mu 2004, yerekaniwe mu Rwanda: i Butare, i Kigali n'i Bisesero.
Mu 2001, Dorcy yashinze «Ateliers Urwintore» i Kigali. Ni ahantu ho kwigisha, guhanga no gukora ubushakashatsi mu buhanzi. Mu 2005, yayoboye ikinamico "L'Instruction" ya Peter Weiss. Iyi kinamico ivuga ku rubanza rw'abakoze ibyaha muri Auschwitz. Yerekanywe mu Rwanda, mu Bufaransa, mu Bubiligi, mu Bwongereza, mu Buyapani no muri Amerika. Hagati ya 2004 na 2008, Dorcy yakinnye mu makinamico yayobowe na Peter Brook, Rosa Gasquet na Milo Rau.
Dorcy yanditse ikinamico "Bloody Niggers!". Muri Mata 2011, ikinamico ye "Gamblers, or the Last War of the Soldier Hungry" yerekanywe bwa mbere i Antwerp, mu Bubiligi.
Mu 2012, Dorcy yashinze Rwanda Arts Initiative i Kigali. Ni ikigo giteza imbere ubuhanzi. Iki kigo cyateguye imishinga ye nka "Planet Kigali" na "Umurinzi". "Umurinzi" yakozwe mu 2019, mu kwibuka ku nshuro ya 25 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Muri Werurwe 2020, Dorcy yakoze "Les restes suprêmes". Iki gihangano kivuga ku murage w'Afurika uri mu nzu ndangamurage z'i Burayi. Cyerekanywe muri Biennale ya Dakar mu 2022. Mu Ukwakira 2020, yatangiye gukorana na Abderrahmane Sissako kuri opera "Le vol du Boli", i Paris. Umuziki wayo wahimbwe na Damon Albarn.
Muri Gashyantare 2024, Dorcy yari umuyobozi w'ubuhanzi wa Kigali Triennial ya mbere. Yakinnye kandi muri filime "Neptune Frost" ya Saul Williams na Anisia Uzeyman. Dorcy aba hagati ya Buruseli na Kigali.
Muri Werurwe 2024, Dorcy yasohoye igitabo "Hewa Rwanda, une lettre aux absents" muri Éditions JC Lattès. Muri iki gitabo, yandikira ababyeyi be n'abandi bapfuye. Avuga ku bwana bwe n'ubusore bwe i Kigali. Iki gitabo cyashyizwe ku rutonde rwa mbere rw'igihembo Renaudot, mu cyiciro cy'inyandiko ("essai").
Iki gitabo cyahinduwe igitaramo giherekejwe n'umuziki. Dorcy agikorana n'umucuranzi w'Umunyasenegali Majnun. Cyerekanywe i Buruseli mu Ukwakira 2024. Muri Werurwe 2025, cyerekanywe mu iserukiramuco rya Adelaide, muri Ositaraliya. Mu 2026, cyari muri gahunda ya Biennale Teatro y'i Venise.
Muri Kanama 2026, Dorcy yasohoye igitabo cy'inkuru "Les enfants gâtés de Butare" muri JC Lattès. Iki gitabo kivuga ku mujyi wa Butare mbere ya Jenoside.

U Rwanda na Juliet ni inyandiko ya nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda yakozwe na producer Ben Proudfoot.
Iyi filime ikurikira urugendo rw’umwarimu w’ishuri rikuru rya Dartmouth, Andrew Garrod i Kigali aho agerageza kwinjiza abakomoka ku bahutu n’abatutsi kugira ngo bakore icyiciro cya Shakespearean bizeye ko gishobora kubatera kwiyunga.
Filime yongewe ku masomo ya Universite Universite Film &amp;amp; Video Council. Yerekanywe muri Meredith College, ishyirahamwe ry'abanyeshuri rya USC Shoah Foundation.
Ibirori no kwerekana.

Emamode Edosio, uzwi cyane ku izina rya Ema, ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n'umuyobozi wa filime. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya Bachelor of Science (B.SC.) muri siyanse ya mudasobwa yakuye muri kaminuza ya Leta ya Ogun. Yize gukora firime ya digitale muri New York Film Academy (NYFA) n'amashusho yerekana amashusho muri Motion Pictures Institute of Michigan, Amerika. Yakiriye Filime nziza n'umu Director w'umwaka batanga ibihembo bya bashiki bacu.
Mu 2013, yasubiye muri Nijeriya. Yakoranye na sosiyete ikora filime nka 66 Dimension ni 2007. Nyuma yaje gukorana na Hip Hop TV, Clarence Peters muri Capital Dreams Pictures, EbonyLife TV ndetse aba n'umwanditsi kuri BBC. Ema yasubiye ku ishuri i Abuja kugira ngo akomeze kwiga sinema. Yakoze filime nyinshi nka "Joy Ride", "Ochuko" anayobora Kasala.
Ubuzima bwa mbere hamwe n'akazi ko kwiga.
Edosio yavukiye mu rugo rwa gikristo. Ni umwana wa gatatu mu bana barindwi mu muryango we. Se ni umwubatsi akaba ari mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru naho nyina yari umunyamategeko. Yatangiye amashuri ye muri Loral Nursery and Primary School, umujyi wa Festac, Lagos nyuma yaho akomereza muri kaminuza nkuru ya leta, Odogbolu imyaka mike mbere y'uko arangiza amashuri yisumbuye muri S-tee Private Academy, Umujyi wa Festac.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi ya B.Sc. muri siyanse ya mudasobwa yakuye muri kaminuza ya Olabisi Onabanjo, mbere yuko ajya kwiga gukora firime ya digitale muri NYFA n'amashusho yerekana amashusho muri Motion Picture Institute of Michigan.
Umwuga wabigize umwuga.
Yagarutse muri Nijeriya mu 2013 nyuma ya gahunda ye yo kwiga muri Amerika. Muri Nijeriya, Ema yakoranye na 66 Dimension, Hip Hop TV, Clarence Peters kuri Capital Dreams Pictures, TV ya Ebonylife na BBC. Nkumuyobozi, Ema yakoranye n'abahanzi bazwi nka 2Baba, 9ice, Lord of Ajasa, Terry da Rapmanand n'abandi benshi. Akazi ke ka mbere muri TV ya Ebonylife yitwa Heaven

Yuhi Amuli (wavutse ku ya 4 Nzeri 1993) ni umuyobozi wa firime, umwanditsi Wa Firimi, Akanazituganya Akaba n'umunyamategeko, Akomoka mu Rwanda. Filime ye ya mbere yerekanywe bwa mbere ""uburyohe bw'igihugu cyacu" Ikaba izwi Nka "A Taste of our Land" (2020) yerekanywe bwa mbere muri Pan African Film Festival ryabereye i Los Angeles kandi yegukana igihembo cya Jury igihembo cya Filime nziza ya mbere yerekana inkuru. Iyi filime yagiye kwerekanwa mu yandi maserukiramuco atandukanye ya filime ku isi kandi yegukana ibihembo bya African Movie Academy Awards (2020).Filime mbere yakozwe n’umuyobozi wayo yitwaye neza kurusha izindi
Ubuzima bwa hambere nakazi.
Amuli yakuriye ku kirwa cya Nkombo, ikirwa gito kandi kitaratera imbere mu kiyaga cya Kivu, mu Rwanda, kikaba kidafite amazi n'amashanyarazi. Nyina yakoraga Mu ishuri ribanza ari umwarimu, naho se yari umucungamari. Nubwo amikoro Yari make Amuri yarezwe yihugurira cyane ku kamaro k’uburezi no ku kwihangana. Yagiye mu mahugurwa menshi yo kwandika no kuyobora Firimi ku isi; harimo na Maisha Film Lab Yitabiriye muri 2014.
Amuli yamenyekanye cyane muri filime ye ya mbere yise "“A Tasete of our Land"" (2020), Iyi filime Yakorewe mu gihugu cyo muri Afurika kitatangajwe izina, kandi ikubiyemo inkuru zabaye mu gihe abashinwa bari kwagura ibikorwa byabo kuri uyu mugabane, cyane cyane mu bikorwa by’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro. Yerekanwe bwa mbere mu Pan African Film Festival ryabereye i Los Angeles, yegukana igihembo cya Jury igihembo cya Filime nziza ya mbere yerekana inkuru nziza ndetse n’igihembo cy’Africa Movie Academy Award kubera Filime nziza ya mbere yakozwe n’umuyobozi. Yabonye cyumukinnyi mwiza kuri Michael Wawuyo Sr muri Festival du Cinéma Africain de Khouribga.
Filime ye ya kabiri, "Citizen Kwame" (2023), ikurikira Kwame, umugabo wo muri Afurika wiyemeje kuva mu nzu ye. Ariko kugira ngo abigereho, agomba kubanza kubona viza itangwa n’umugenzuzi wo mu Burengerazuba ugenga uko abantu basohoka cyangwa binjira mu nzu. Ni mu bufasha akura mu mubano mushya agiranye n’umukobwa wo mu Burengerazuba aho ashobora kugera ku ntego ye. Iyo filime yegukanye igihembo cya Filime ndende ya mbere yakozwe n’umuyobozi wayo yitwaye neza kurusha izind mu iserukiramuco rya sinema rya Afurika rya Luxor 2023. Muri 2017, yakoze "Nameless" abinyujije mu isosiyete ye yigenga yitwa, IZACU. Iyi filime yitabiriye amahugurwa nyuma y’umusaruro mu iserukiramuco rya Filime rya Carthage muri Tuniziya, nyuma aza gutorwa kugira ngo ayikwirakwize na sitidiyo ya Orange mu Bufaransa. Numunyeshuri wiga muri Berlinale Talents (2021) na Laboratwari ya Toronto (2020). Kuva, Amuli yari arimo ategura film ye itaha, "Kuva".
Amuli afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu by'amategeko yakuye muri kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali (Kigali Independent University) kandi akurikirana impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (LLMM) (icyiciro cya 2024) yibanda ku mategeko agenga imyidagaduro mu ishuri ry'amategeko rya Loyola i Los Angeles.

Jo Ingabire Moys ni umunyarwandakazi - umwanditsi, umukinnyi w’amafirime n’umuyobozi aho filime ye ngufi ya mbere "Bazigaga" yaranzwe no gutorwa mu bihembo bya BAFTA nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu maserukiramuco atandukanye.
Ubuzima bwa Hambere n'amashuri Yize.
Yavutse mu ntangiriro ya za 1990, mu ntangiriro ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi n’abaturage bo mubwoko bw’Abahutu mu 1994 Yakuriye ikigali muricyo gihe niwe wari muto mu bana batandatu. Nyina yakoraga ubucuruzi mu gihe se yakoraga ku biro bya gasutamo.
Mu 1997, igihe Moys yari afite imyaka 8, ku ikigo yigagaho batatswe n’ingabo z’interahamwe zakoze jenoside icyo gihe zashimuse abana b’abanyapolitiki., Moys n'umuryango we bimukiye muri Uganda imyaka umunani nyuma bajyaa mu Bwongereza. Yize mu ishuri rya Dulwich mu majyepfo ya London. Aha niho yasanze ubuvanganzo bw'icyongereza kandi yibanda ku bitabo. Yarangije muri kaminuza Mariya y'i Londres.

Automobili lamborghini S.p.A ni sosiyete yo mu Butaliyani ikora imodoka zihenze zizwi nka sports car n' imodoka zifite imbaraga nyinshi. iyi sosiyote ifite icyicaro i Sant'Agata Bolognese mu butaliyani kandi izwi ku isi yose kubera imodoka n'ikoranabuhanga rihanitse
Lamborghini yashinzwe mu 1963 na Ferruccio Lamborghini, umushoramari w’umutaliyani wari umaze kumenyekana mu gukora imashini n’amapikipiki. Yashakaga gukora imodoka za siporo zifite ubudasa ku isoko ry’icyo gihe kandi zihanganira urujya-n’uruza rwa buri munsi.
Imodoka ya mbere yakorewe ni 350 GT mu mwaka wa 1960, ariko izamuhaye izina rikomeye ni Miura mu 1966, izwi cyane ku isi kubera ko yari ifite moteri hagati (mid-engine), bitari bisanzwe kuri izo modoka.
Mu myaka yakurikiyeho, Lamborghini yagiye ikora izindi modoka zizwi nka Countach, Diablo, Murciélago n’izindi, zose zigaragaza umuvuduko, imbaraga n’imiterere yihariye.
Mu 1998, Automobili Lamborghini yabaye sosiyete iyobowe na Audi AG, sozi ya Volkswagen Group, bituma ishobora gukura no gukora imodoka zigezweho mu ikoranabuhanga no mu isoko mpuzamahanga.
Ibicuruzwa n’Imodoka.
Lamborghini izwi cyane ku modoka za siporo zifite imikorere myiza, harimo:
Ikoranabuhanga n’Imiterere.
Lamborghini iharanira gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rigezweho mu gukora imodoka zayo no gukora imodoka zifite imbaraga nyinshi ariko zifite n’ibikorwa byita ku bidukikije, harimo gahunda yiswe Direzione Cor Tauri igamije kwimakaza imodoka zishyira imbere ikoreshwa ry’ingufu zidahumanya ikirere kandi ziramba.
Umusaruro n’Imurikagurisha.
Kuva mu ishingwa ryayo, Lamborghini yakomeje gutera imbere. Mu mwaka wa 2023, yabashije kugeza ku bakiriya imodoka zirenze 10,000 mu mwaka umwe ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka yayo, ikaba ari ikimenyetso cy’iyongera ry’ubucuruzi no kwaguka kw’isoko.
Sosiyete Automobili Lamborghini ifite abakozi basaga 3,000, kandi ifite urutonde rw’abacuruzi mu bihugu birenga 50 ku isi yose, bituma imodoka zayo zigurishwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Lamborghini ni kimwe mu byamamare mu rwego rw’imodoka zihenze kandi zifite imbaraga, ikaba ifite umubano ukomeye n’abakunzi b’imodoka ku isi yose. Imodoka zayo zikunze kugaragara mu bitaramo by’imodoka, indirimbo, sinema n’ahandi mu muco rusange.

= Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit =
The Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit, also known as the Stealth Bomber, is an American heavy strategic bomber, featuring low-observable stealth technology designed to penetrate dense anti-aircraft defenses. A flying wing design with a crew of two, the B-2 is capable of delivering both conventional and thermonuclear weapons.
Development and History.
The B-2 originated from the "Advanced Technology Bomber" (ATB) project during the Carter administration. Its development was a significant leap in aerospace engineering, focusing on reducing the aircraft's radar, infrared, visual, and acoustic signatures.
The B-2’s most distinctive feature is its flying wing configuration, which lacks a fuselage or tail. This shape, combined with radar-absorbent materials (RAM), makes it exceptionally difficult to detect on radar.
The aircraft's stealth comes from a combination of reduced acoustic, infrared, visual, and radar signatures. This allows the B-2 to operate at high altitudes without being easily targeted by surface-to-air missiles or interceptor aircraft.
Operational History.
The B-2 was originally designed to strike high-value Soviet targets during the Cold War. However, it has seen extensive use in conventional conflicts since its debut.
Note: Due to its high maintenance requirements and sophisticated skin, the B-2 requires specialized climate-controlled hangars to protect its radar-absorbent coating.

Spiro ni ikigo cy'ubucuruzi gikorera muri Afurika, gikora kandi gicuruza moto z'amashanyarazi, kikanatanga serivisi yo guhinduranya bateri ("battery swapping") ku bamotari.
Gikorera mu bihugu bitandatu by'Afurika, harimo n'Rwanda, aho cyatangiye ibikorwa mu 2023. Kigamije kugabanya ikoreshwa ry'ibikomoka kuri peteroli mu bwikorezi no kugabanya ingaruka mbi ku bidukikije.
Spiro yatangiye ibikorwa byayo muri Togo na Bene mu 2022, maze mu 2023 igera muri Kenya, Rwanda, Ubugande na Nijeriya. Umuyobozi wayo mukuru ni Kaushik Burman. Muri Gicurasi 2024, ikinyamakuru "TIME" cyayishyize ku rutonde rw'ibigo 100 bifite ijambo rikomeye ku isi ("TIME100 Most Influential Companies"); icyo gihe yari ifite moto z'amashanyarazi zigera ku 14 000.
Mu Kwakira 2025, Spiro yabonye ishoramari rya miliyoni 100 z'amadolari y'Amerika, harimo miliyoni 75 zatanzwe n'ikigega FEDA cya Banki Nyafurika y'Ubucuruzi bw'Ibyoherezwa mu Mahanga (Afreximbank).
Mu Rwanda, ibiro bya Spiro biri i Remera–Giporoso, mu mujyi wa Kigali. Muri Nzeri 2025, Spiro yamuritse imideli mishya ya moto, Ekon 450M1 na Ekon 450M2, iteranyirizwa mu gihugu kandi ku giciro kiri hasi ugereranyije n'iyabanje. Ku wa 14 Kanama 2026, yamuritse moto nshya, EKON M1 V3, yakorewe imisozi n'imihanda igoye yo mu Rwanda, mu imurikagurisha ry'i Gikondo.
Muri Nyakanga 2026, Spiro yari ifite mu Rwanda moto z'amashanyarazi zirenga 28 000 na sitasiyo zirenga 300 zo guhinduranya bateri, harimo eshatu nini i Kigali; yari imaze no guha akazi abantu barenga 3 000.

Ubumenyi bw’Imitekerereze bushingiye ku Myitwarire (Behavioral Psychology).
Ubumenyi bw’imitekerereze bushingiye ku myitwarire, buzwi nka "Behavioral Psychology", ni ishami ry’ubumenyi bwiga kandi bugasesengura imyitwarire igaragara y’abantu n’inyamaswa, hibandwa ku buryo imyitwarire yiga, igahinduka, kandi ikagenzurwa n’ibidukikije. Iri shami ryirinda kwibanda cyane ku bitekerezo byihishe mu mutwe, ahubwo rikita ku byo umuntu akora bishobora gupimwa no kugaragara.
Behavioral Psychology ishingiye ku gitekerezo cy’uko imyitwarire myinshi yigishwa binyuze mu bunararibonye, cyane cyane hifashishijwe ibihembo (reinforcement) n’ibihano (punishment). Abahanga bagaragaje ko iyo imyitwarire ihembwe, ishobora kwiyongera, naho iyo ihaniwe, ishobora kugabanuka cyangwa igahagarara burundu.
Hari amahame y’ingenzi agenga Behavioral Psychology. Irimwe muri ryo ni kwiga binyuze mu gusubiramo (conditioning). Habaho ubwoko bubiri bw’ingenzi:
Iri shami ry’ubumenyi rifite akamaro kanini mu nzego zitandukanye z’ubuzima. Mu burezi, rifasha abarimu gutegura uburyo bwo kwigisha bushingiye ku guhemba imyitwarire myiza y’abanyeshuri, bityo bigatuma biga neza kandi bakitwara neza. Mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi bw’indwara zo mu mutwe, Behavioral Psychology ikoreshwa mu gufasha abantu guhindura imyitwarire itabafasha, nk’ubwoba bukabije, imyitwarire yo kwigunga, cyangwa ingeso mbi.
Nanone, Behavioral Psychology ifite uruhare mu mibereho ya buri munsi. Ifasha abantu gusobanukirwa impamvu bitwara mu buryo runaka no kumenya uko bahindura imyitwarire yabo bifashishije imyitozo, kwiyemeza, n’ibihembo byiza. Ibi bituma umuntu yiyubaka, akagira imyitwarire imufasha kugera ku ntego ze no gutera imbere.
Mu gusoza, ubumenyi bw’imitekerereze bushingiye ku myitwarire ni ingenzi cyane mu gusobanukirwa no kunoza imyitwarire ya muntu. Bwerekana ko imyitwarire myinshi ishobora kwigishwa no guhindurwa, bigatanga umusanzu ukomeye mu iterambere ry’umuntu ku giti cye n’iry’umuryango muri rusange.

Rolls royce izwiho kuba ikora imodoka zitari iza siporo (non-sports cars) zifashwa mu bikorwa bigiye bitandukanye nko mubirori, mubukwe ndetse nibindi bikorwa bigiye bitandukanye.
Uko rolls royce yatangijwe.
Rolls-Royce yakozwe kubera ubuhanga bwa Henry Royce mu by’imashini, ubushobozi bwa Charles Rolls mu bucuruzi, n’impamvu zabo zo gukora ibicuruzwa byiza kurusha ibindi byose—biba mu modoka cyangwa mu moteri z’indege
