Se wa Costa Titch yari Umugereki naho nyina akaba Umunyafurika y’Epfo. Yavukiye muri Afurika y’Epfo.Ku ntangiriro z’ubuzima bwe, Costa Titch yagiraga urukundo rukomeye n’imyidagaduro, atangira ari umubyinnyi. Mu mwaka wa 2014, yimukiye i Johannesburg, aho yakomeje umwuga we wo kuba umuraperi.
Mu 2020, Costa Titch yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere yise "Made In Africa", irimo ubufatanye n'abahanzi batandukanye bo muri Afurika y'Epfo nka AKA, Riky Rick, na Boity. Iyi alubumu yamamaye cyane kandi yagenze neza mu bucuruzi, ishimangira ko Costa Titch ari umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye mu muziki wo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yakomeje kwegukana ibihembo 3 byo guhatanira ibihembo bya Hip Hop Awards 2020 muri Afurika y'Epfo ndetse yegukana Igihembo Cyo gufatanya n'abandi bahanzi "Nkalakatha Remix" irimo AKA na Riky Rick mu gusubiramo Nkalakatha yakozwe na Mandoza.
Indirimbo ye "Ayeye" yakiriwe neza cyane, bitewe n'ubutumwa bwayo butera inkunga bwo kugumana icyizere nubwo ubuzima bwari bugoye. Indi ndirimbo ye, " "Big Flexa" ", yatsinze agahigo ko kuba videwo y'indirimbo Amapiano yarebwe cyane kuri YouTube mu Ukuboza 2022. Muri uwo mwaka, yabonye amanota menshi mu marushanwa ya 7 ya All Africa Music Awards 2022.
Costa Titch yanakoranye n'umuririmbyi w'umunyamerika ukomoka muri Senegali witwa Akon mu gukora remix y'indirimbo " "Big Flexa" ", irimo umusanzu wa mugenzi we w'umucuranzi wa Amapiano Alfa Kat akaba na producer Ma Gang.
Mu 2022, Titch yakoranye n'umuririmbyi w'umunya - Nigeria, OLA, mu ndirimbo yabo ya " "Data" ".
Costa Titch na Champuru Makhenzo bashyize ahagaragara umushinga wabo wa EP ' "Trapiano Vol.1" '.
Ku ya 11 Werurwe 2023, Costa Titch yaguye mu kantu ubwo yari arimo kuririmba mu iserukiramuco rya muzika rya Ultra South Africa i Johannesburg. Yahise asubirana imbaraga ze maze akomeza kuririmba, ariko yongera kugwa Ahita apfa afite ku myaka 28. Dukurikije iperereza ryakozwe n'umuryango we n'abaganga b'indwara, urupfu rw'uyu muhanzi w'icyamamare rwatewe n'ibintu byinshi bitandukanye, birimo umuvuduko utazwi ku mutima we, stress idashira, n'umunaniro ukabije.
Itangazo ryemewe ryasohowe n’umuryango we rivuga ko igitutu ku mutima we n’umunaniro uhoraho (stress chronique) bishoboka ko byateye ihindagurika ridasanzwe ry’imiterere y’imikubitire y’umutima, ari na ryo ryateye igicuri (seizure) cyamwishe ubwo yari ari ku rubyiniro aririmba.

Ikiganiro mpaka Mubuzima busanzwe iyo tuganira cyangwa iyo duhuye nabagenzi bacu turasuhuzanya tugahana ibiganza ndetse hari abagira n'akanyamuneza bagahoberana ndetse bagahana n'imisaya ibyo baganira cyangwa se amambo babwirana niyo azamura ibyiyumvo umuntu akiyumva bitandukanye nuko yarasanzwe yiyumva mubihe bisanzwe.
ni nabwo hahita habaho intangiro yokuganira kw' abantu babiri ikiganiro kinikizwa sinakubwira rimwe na rimwe ninabwo usanga harubwo umuntu aturika agaseka biturutse kukiganiro kirikuganirwa.

Michel Nkuka Mboladinga cyangwa Michel Kuka Mboladinga (yavutse ku wa 26 Nzeri 1976) ni mufana w'umupira w'amaguru wo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (RDC). Azwi ku mazina y'akabyiniriro Lumumba na Lumumba Vea kubera uko ahagarara asa n'igishushanyo cya Patrice Lumumba mu gihe ikipe y'igihugu ya RDC "Les Léopards" iri gukina. Kuva mu 2013, amara umukino wose ahagaze adahumeka, atimura umubiri, nk'igishushanyo. Yamenyekanye cyane muri rubanda no mu itangazamakuru mpuzamahanga ubwo yagaragaraga mu mikino ya Igikombe cya Afurika cya 2025 cyabereye muri Maroke.
Michel Nkuka Mboladinga yavukiye muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo) ku wa 26 Nzeri 1976. Ni umufana ukomeye w'ikipe y'igihugu ya RDC, izwi ku izina "Les Léopards", kandi avuga ko yatangiye kuyishyigikira kera mbere y'uko amenyekana nk'«mufana igishushanyo».
Mu 2013, yafashe icyemezo cyo guhindura uburyo yifata mu kibuga: kuva icyo gihe, mu mikino minini y'ikipe y'igihugu ahagaze ameze nk'igishushanyo, aticara kandi atagendagenda mu bafana. Ni umunyamuryango w'ishyirahamwe ryemewe ry'abafana n'abashishikariza ikipe y'igihugu ya RDC, kandi mu kiganiro yivuga nk'umuhanzi n'umushyushyarugamba ukoresha umupira w'amaguru ngo yibutse amateka y'igihugu cye.
Ibisobanuro ku mikorere ye.
Mu gihe cy'umukino, Michel Kuka Mboladinga ahagarara iminota 90 yose y'umukino w'ibanze, kandi iyo bibaye ngombwa akageza no ku nyongera n'imitutire y'amapenaliti, aticara na rimwe. Akenshi ahagarara hejuru y'agahanda gato kateguwe ku ruhande rw'ikibuga, akazamura ukuboko kwe kw'iburyo hejuru areba mu kirere, mu mwanya uvanze n'uwa statue ya Patrice Lumumba iri ku rwibutso ruri i Kinshasa.
Yambara imyambaro yiganjemo amabara y'ibendera rya RDC – ubururu, umuhondo n'umutuku – kandi imisatsi ye n'amaso y'amaso agashushanya uburyo bw'ibijyana n'imyambarire yo mu myaka ya 1960, kugira ngo arusheho gusa na Lumumba. Mu biganiro n'itangazamakuru asobanura ko iyo myitwarire ari ituro ryo kubaha Lumumba no kugaragaza indangagaciro z'icyubahiro, ubwigenge n'ubusugire bw'igihugu.
Uko yamenyekanye mu itangazamakuru.
Mu gihe cya Igikombe cya Afurika cya 2025, kuba ahagaze adahinduka mu kibuga byatumye amamera mu mashusho y'ibinyamakuru mpuzamahanga, kuko imyitwarire ye itandukanye cyane n'uburyo abafana benshi b'umupira w'amaguru bamenyerewe kwitwara batanga ibyishimo n'amajwi menshi.
Amafoto n'amashusho ye yakwirakwiye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, aho bamwe bamwise «mufana igishushanyo» cyangwa «umwuzukuru wa Lumumba». Mu mikino y'umuyoboro wa televiziyo, abatangaza imikino bakunda kugaragaza ifoto ye buri mukino RDC yakinnye, ku buryo aba ikimenyetso cyihariye cy'iyo kipe.
Abandi bafana bamwe na bo batangiye kugerageza kumwigana bahagarara mu mwanya nk'uwo, nk'ikimenyetso cyo kumushyigikira no kwifatanya n'ubutumwa bwe.
Intego avuga ko afite.
Michel Nkuka Mboladinga avuga ko ibikorwa bye bidahagararira ku gushimisha ikipe y'igihugu gusa, ahubwo ari «misiyo y'ubumwe n'ubutwari bw'igihugu» igamije kubaha amateka ya RDC no gutanga inkunga y'ubutwari ku bakinnyi n'abaturage.
Bamwe mu banditsi n'abanyamakuru basobanura iyi myitwarire nk'urugero rugaragaza uko siporo ishobora gukoreshwa mu kugaragaza icyangano cy'ubukoloni no gushimangira umwirikano w'igihugu mu Rwanda rwa Kongo.

Bernard Bahati ni umurezi n'umushakashatsi w'Umunyarwanda mu bijyanye n'ikoranabuhanga mu burezi. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2021 ni Umuyobozi Mukuru ("Director General") w'Ikigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Ibizamini n'Ubugenzuzi bw'Amashuri (NESA), akaba ari we muyobozi wa mbere w'icyo kigo.
Mbere yaho yari umwarimu muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda. Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (PhD) yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Stockholm muri Suwede.
Bahati yatangiye umwuga we ari umwarimu mu mashuri abanza. Yize icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza ("Master of Education" mu ikoranabuhanga mu burezi no kwiga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga) muri Kaminuza ya Witwatersrand i Johannesburg muri Afurika y’Epfo.
Mu mwaka wa 2019 yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (PhD) mu ishami ry'ubumenyi bwa mudasobwa n'imikorere y'ibigo ("Department of Computer and Systems Sciences") rya Kaminuza ya Stockholm muri Suwede. Igitabo cy'ubushakashatsi bwe, "Technology-enhanced formative assessment in higher education: An intervention design of scaffolding student self-regulated learning", kigaruka ku buryo ikoranabuhanga ryafasha mu isuzuma rihoraho ("formative assessment") ry'abanyeshuri ba kaminuza.
Bahati yabaye umwarimu muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda, nyuma aba Umuyobozi ushinzwe kunoza imyigishirize n'imyigire ("Director of Teaching and Learning Enhancement") muri iyo kaminuza. Ubushakashatsi bwe bwibanda ku ikoreshwa ry'ikoranabuhanga mu kwigisha no kwiga.
Inama y'Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 19 Gashyantare 2021 yamushyize ku mwanya w'Umuyobozi Mukuru wa NESA, ikigo gishya cyari kimaze gushyirwaho n'itegeko ryasohotse mu Igazeti ya Leta mu Ukwakira 2020. NESA yatangiye imirimo ku wa 1 Werurwe 2021; ishinzwe gutegura no gukoresha ibizamini bya Leta by'amashuri abanza, ayisumbuye n'ay'imyuga (TVET), ndetse no kugenzura ireme ry'uburezi mu mashuri. Bahati ni we wayoboye ishyirwaho ry'icyo kigo.
Nk'umuyobozi wa NESA, akurikirana imigendekere y'ibizamini bya Leta n'ishyirwa ry'abanyeshuri mu mashuri. Muri Nzeri 2023, yibukije abayobozi b'amashuri yo mu Kigali ko gushyira abanyeshuri mu mashuri ("placement and orientation") ari inshingano za NESA yonyine, abasaba kutivanga muri uwo murimo. Muri Gashyantare 2026 yari akiri Umuyobozi Mukuru wa NESA.

Rugezi Marsh ni igishanga cyo hejuru cyane hamwe nubutaka buri mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda, cyane cyane mu Turere twa Burera na Gicumbi hafi y’umupaka na Uganda. Shenseea, amazina ye nyakuri akaba Chinsea Linda Lee, ni umuhanzi w’icyamamare ukomoka muri Jamaica, uzwi cyane mu njyana ya Dancehall. Yavutse ku itariki ya 1 Ukwakira 1996, akaba yaramenyekanye cyane kubera ijwi rye rikomeye, imbyino zidasanzwe n’imyambarire ikurura abantu benshi.
Urugendo rwe mu muziki
Shenseea yatangiye kumenyekana cyane mu mwaka wa 2016 nyuma yo gusohora indirimbo "“Loodi”" yakoranye n’umuhanzi Vybz Kartel. Iyi ndirimbo yamufunguriye amarembo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, atangira gukorana n’abahanzi bakomeye nka Sean Paul, Megan Thee Stallion, Kanye West na Drake. Ubutumwa n’ingaruka ku rubyiruko
Shenseea azwiho kuba aharanira ko abagore bagira ijambo rikomeye mu muziki wa Dancehall, wari usanzwe wiganje n’abagabo. Indirimbo ze zikubiyemo ubutumwa bwigenga, kwigirira icyizere no kwihagararaho. Ibi byatumye aba icyitegererezo ku rubyiruko rwinshi, cyane cyane abakobwa bifuza kwinjira mu muziki.
Usibye umuziki, Shenseea azwiho gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga neza, bikamufasha gukomeza gukundwa n’abafana be hirya no hino ku isi. Ni umwe mu bahanzi bagaragaza ko impano, umurava n’icyerekezo bishobora kugeza umuntu ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

UMUSOZI WA HURO ni umusozi uherereye mu karere ka Gakenke,uri mu mudugudu wa Huro, akagari ka Gakenke,umurenge wa Muhondo. Kera hahoze hitwa i Bumbogo. Amateka agaragaza ko umurwa wa abanyamihango b'umuganura bitwaga abiru bo kwa myaka bari bashinzwe gutegura imbuto arizo amasaka n'uburo. Aha i Huro hahurizwaga imbuto zarobanuwe neza kandi zizira icyasha zikoherezwa ibwami gukoreshwa mu mihango y'umuganura,ari naho havuye imvugo yakwirakwiye mu Rwanda ngo " ihuriro ni i HURO ". Bashakaga kuvuga yuko abazanye imbuto n'abazijyanye bahurira i Huro.
Mudahinyuka Paulin w’imyaka 78, uri mu basaza batuye i Huro, yavuze ko mu gihe cyo gutoranya imbuto babyitagaho kandi nta mugore wari wemerewe gukora mu mbuto ngo atayanduza bitewe no gutinya ko yazakoramo ari mu gihe cy’imihango abakera bafataga nk’igihe cyanduye.
Ati “Bakoraga uko bashoboye bakarobanura imbuto nziza itarangiritse izabasha kumera bitagoranye, kandi abagore bari babujijwe gukorakora iyo mbuto ngo itazagenda yarangiritse, ndetse n’abagabo ntibakoreshagamo intoki, ahubwo bakoresha agati bitaga ‘isando’, birinda kuyangiza.”
Iyi mbuto yajyaga ibwami iherekejwe n’ingoma n’inzoga z’imitsama zateguwe, kugira ngo bimurikirwe Umwami, abiheshe umugisha.
Mudahinyuka, yakomeje avuga ko Umwami yazaga ari kumwe n’umuganuza mukuru bagashyira intoki mu gitenga (ikibo kinini), cyuzuye imbuto maze zigasesekara ku butaka, ubwo “umwami akaba atanze imbuto kuko isesekaye ku butaka bw’u Rwanda.”
Kimwe mu bimenyetso bikiranga amateka ya Huro twavugamo Ivubiro ryahashyizwe n'umuvubyi witwaga Minyaruko wa Nyamikenke.wari umutware w'ubusigi mu kinyejana cya cumi na gatandatu(16)abisabwe na Ruganzu II ndori.nan'uyu munsi hakaba hakiri ikibinsi kiri mu gihuru kirimo amazi.Iri vubiro ryifashishwaga n'Abiru b'Abahinzi bo kwa Myaka bapima imvura kugirango bamenye niba izagwa vuba cyangwa izatinda maze babona izatinda bakihutira kubimenyesha Umwami nuko nawe agashaka uburyo ayivubisha vuba.
kandi mubindi bice by'amateka biri muri Gakenke twavugamo umusozi wa Kabuye ahari iriba rya Nyirarucyaba n'Ubuvumo bw'Umwami,hari kandi i Mbirima ya Matovu mu murenge wa Coko ahari amateka y'Abami;lbuye rya Bajyejye riri muri santere ya Gakenke,n'ahandi.

Septimius Awards ni ibirori ngarukamwaka bitanga ibihembo mu byerekeye amafilime bibera mu mujyi wa Amsterdam mu Ubuholandi. Ibi bihembo byatangiye mu mwaka wa 2022, bishyira imbere gushyigikira impano nshya no guteza imbere imishinga y'indashyikirwa mu bihugu bitandukanye ku isi.
Iki gikorwa cyashinzwe na Jan-Willem Breure, umuyobozi w'amafilime ufite inkomoko muri u Rwanda, wifuje gushyiraho urubuga rugaragaza uburinganire hagati y'amafilime y'iburengerazuba n'ayandi bice by'isi.
Septimius Awards izwiho kuba igabanya ibyiciro by'abakinnyi n'amafilime hagati y'imigabane itanu y'isi: Afurika, Aziya, Amerika, Uburayi, n'Oseyaniya. Ibi bikorwa kugira ngo habeho guhagararirwa kw'impano zitandukanye zitagaragara mu bindi birori bikomeye nka Oscars.
Ibihembo bitangwa mu byiciro birenga 30, harimo amafilime maremare, amafilime mbarankuru, n'inyandiko z'amafilime (scripts).
Abatsinze n'abashyikirijwe ibihembo.

Jan-Willem Breure (yavutse ku ya 1 Nzeri 1988) ni umuyobozi wa filime, ushinzwe itunganywa rya filime (producer), akaba n'umushabitsi w'Umunyarwanda uba mu Buholandi. Ni we washinze ibihembo mpuzamahanga bya Septimius Awards na Isis Fashion Awards.
Breure yavukiye mu Rwanda, nyuma aza kururwa n'abamisiyoneri b'Abaholandi. Yakuriye mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika birimo Kenya na Namibiya mbere yo kwimukira mu Buholandi. Yize ibijyanye no gushushanya mu ishuri rikuru ry'ubugeni rya Royal Academy of Art, The Hague.
Breure ni we washinze isosiyete itunganya filime yitwa JW Productions. Azwi cyane ku itunganywa rya filime mbarankuru (documentaries) zivuga ku bibazo byugarije umuryango mugari. Breure arimo gutegura filime filime y’abana b’intambara n’umuryango w’abagore w’umuryango w’abibumbye.
Mu mwaka wa 2022, Breure yashinze Septimius Awards, ibihembo mpuzamahanga bitangirwa buri mwaka i Amsterdam. Ibi bihembo bishimwa cyane kubera uburyo biteguye, aho ibyiciro bigabanywa dushingiye ku migabane (Afurika, Aziya, Burayi, Amerika, n'Osiyaniya) kugira ngo buri gice cy'isi kibe gihagarariwe.
Isis Fashion Awards.
Yashinze kandi Isis Fashion Awards (IFA), iserukiramuco ryibanda gusa ku bashushanya imitako n'ibikoresho by'ubwiza (accessory designers). Iri serukiramuco rishaka guha agaciro abakora inkweto, amasakoshi, n'imitako.
Joburg Film Festival.
Mu mwaka wa 2026, Breure yagizwe umwe mu bagize akanama nkemurampaka (jury) mpuzamahanga mu iserukiramuco rya filime rya Joburg Film Festival muri Afurika y'Epfo.

Isis Fashion Awards (IFA) ni irushanwa mpuzamahanga ry'imideli ribera mu Ubuholandi. Iri rushanwa ryibanda gusa ku bikoresho by'imideli ("accessories"), nk'inkweto, amasakoshi n'imitako.
Isis Fashion Awards yashinzwe na Jan-Willem Breure. Ibirori bya mbere byabaye mu 2022. Ibirori bitambuka kuri televiziyo SALTO y'i Amsterdam.
Isis Fashion Awards yashinzwe na Jan-Willem Breure. Jan-Willem Breure ni we kandi washinze Septimius Awards. Breure avuga ko urugendo rwe ruva mu Rwanda rujya mu Buholandi rwamuhaye igitekerezo cy'ibi bihembo.
Abashushanya ibikoresho by'imideli ntibakunze kwitabwaho. Abantu bitaye cyane ku bashushanya imyenda. Isis Fashion Awards yashinzwe kugira ngo ibahe urubuga. Ni ryo rushanwa rya mbere mu Buholandi ryahariwe ibikoresho by'imideli gusa.
Izina Isis rikomoka ku mana Isis y'Abanyamisiri ba kera.
Imigendekere y'ibirori.
IFA ni ibirori by'umunsi umwe. Bigizwe n'ibiganiro ku itapi itukura, imyiyerekano y'imideli n'umuhango wo gutanga ibihembo.
Abashushanya berekana ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibikoresho. Muri byo harimo inkweto, amasakoshi, amadarubindi, imitako, amasaha, imikandara n'ingofero.
Aberekana imideli ntibaba bambaye imyenda. Baba bambaye ibikoresho gusa. Ibi bituma abantu bareba ibikoresho.
Imyiyerekano igabanyijemo ibice by'iminota 20. Nyuma ya buri gice, akanama nkemurampaka gatanga ibitekerezo. Abashushanya batatu ba mbere bahabwa igikombe cya zahabu gishushanya imana Isis.
Isis Fashion Awards itambuka kuri televiziyo SALTO kuva mu 2022. Ibirori bya 2026 byatambutse kuri SALTO2 ku wa 25 Kamena 2026.
Ibirori byavuzweho kandi n'ibindi bitangazamakuru. Muri byo harimo ShowNieuws, PowNed, OndaTV yo mu Butaliyani, ikinyamakuru Plitky cyo muri Ikerene na "Playboy" y'Ubuholandi.

Saul Stacey Williams (yavutse ku ya 29 Gashyantare 1972) akaba umuraperi w’umunyamerika, umuririmbyi, umwanditsi w’indirimbo, umucuranzi, umusizi, umwanditsi, n’umukinnyi wa filime. Azwiho kuvanga imivugo n'izindi hip hop, ndetse no kuba yarayoboye muri filime yigenga yiswe "ya Slam" yo mu 1998 ndetse n’umuziki wa jukebox.. Yabonye igihembo cya 2026 Grammy Awards kubera alubumu ye "Saul Williams yahuye na Carlos Niño &amp; Inshuti Kuri Treepeople" mu cyiciro cya Album Cyiza Cyivugo Cyivugo.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'uburere.
Saul Stacey Williams yavukiye i Newburgh, muri New York, ku ya 29 Gashyantare 1972, ni umuhererezi mu bana batatu. Yize muri Newburgh Free Academy, aho yanditse indirimbo ye "Black Stacey". Yarangije muri kaminuza ya Morehouse afite impamyabumenyi ya BA mu bijyanye no gukina filime na filozofiya, nyuma yimukira mu mujyi wa New York, ari naho yakuye impamyabumenyi ya MFA mu gukina porogaramu ya Graduate Acting University ya New York muri Tisch School of Arts. Igihe yari muri kaminuza ya New York, yabaye umwe mu bakinnyi bakinnye mu mivugo ya New York café. Yabaye kandi muri Burezile nk'umunyeshuri wo guhanahana amakuru kuva 1988 kugeza 1989.
Kugeza 1995, Williams yari yarabaye umusizi wa mic. Mu 1996, yatsindiye izina rya Nuyorican Poets Cafe ' Grand Slam Champion. Filime documentaire "SlamNation" ikurikira Williams hamwe n'abandi bagize itsinda rya Nuyorican Poets Slam mu 1996 (Beau Sia, muMs da Schemer, na Jessica Care Moore)ubwo bahatanira amarushanwa y’imivugo y’igihugu ya 1996 yabereye Portland, Oregon. Umwaka ukurikira, Williams yagize uruhare runini mu gukinwa kwa filime yitwa "Slam" yo mu 1998. Williams yagaragaye nk'umwanditsi n'umukinnyi muri filime, yari kuzegukana igihembo cya Sundance Festival Grand Jury Award ndetse na Cannes Kamera D'Or (Kamera ya Zahabu).
Ahagana mu 1998, Williams na we nibwo yinjiraga mu muziki. Yakinnye n'abahanzi nka Nas, The Fugees, Blackalicious, Erykah Badu, KRS-One, Zack De La Rocha, De La Soul, Buckethead, na DJ Krust, ndetse n'abasizi Allen Ginsberg na Sonia Sanchez. Amaze gusohora urutonde rwa EP, yasohoye LP "Amethyst Rock Star" hamwe na producer Rick Rubin mu 2001. Muri Nzeri 2004, yashyize ahagaragara alubumu ye yiyitiriye yakunzwe n'abantu benshi. Yakinnye ibitaramo byinshi bishyigikira Nine Inch Nail mu ruzinduko rwabo mu Burayi mu mpeshyi 2005, anashyigikira na Mars Volta. Williams yatumiwe mu iserukiramuco rya muzika rya Lollapalooza muri kiriya gihe, kandi icyiciro cya Chicago cyemereye Williams gukurura abantu benshi. Yagaragaye kuri Album ya Nine Inch Nail "Y'umwaka Zero", kandi ashyigikira iryo tsinda mu ruzinduko rwabo muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru 2006. Muri urwo ruzinduko, Williams yatangaje ko Trent Reznor bazafatanya gukorana alubumu ye yari ikurikiyeho.
Ubu bufatanye bwavuye muri 2007 "The Inevitable Rise and Liberation of NiggyTardust!". Iyi alubumu yaboneka ku rubuga rwayo gusa kugeza CD y'umubiri isohotse, irimo imirongo mishya hamwe n'ubuhanzi bwagutse. Abakiriya 100.000 ba mbere ku rubuga bari bafite uburyo bwo gukuramo verisiyo y'ubusa yo hasi y'ubusa. Ubundi buryo bwari ubwo abakoresha kwishyura $ 5 kugira ngo bashyigikire umuhanzi mu buryo butaziguye kandi bahabwe guhitamo gukuramo verisiyo yo mu rwego rwo hejuru ya MP3 cyangwa verisiyo ya FLAC itagira igihombo. Ibikoresho byakozwe na Trent Reznor bivangwa na Alan Moulder. Reznor ni we wavuze, nyuma y’uko aherutse kugirana amasezerano na label, ko bagomba kuyisohora mu bwigenge no mu buryo butaziguye ku bari bateranye.
Mu ntangiriro za 2008, ubucuruzi bwa Nike Sparq bwerekanaga indirimbo ya Williams "Urutonde rw'ibisabwa (Indishyi)". Mu kiganiro cyo mu Gushyingo 2008 yagiranye na Wired.com, Williams yavuze ku mishinga ye iri imbere: "Hariho alubumu imwe ninjiye mu rukenyerero mfite intego yo kuyirangiza mu kwezi gutaha. Trent irashaka gukora ku rukurikirane rwa "Niggy" nkeka ko rwaba rwiza, kandi mfite na alubumu n'indirimbo nshya zerekaniwe mu rugo ko niteguye kujya muri sitidiyo kandi nkaryama."
Album ya kane ya Williams, "Ikirunga cy’izuba", yasohotse ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 2011. Williams yerekanye iyo alubumu mu gikoni cya Hoxton Bar cyo mu mujyi wa Londres ku ya 26 Mutarama 2011. Livemusic yabajije Williams ku mugoroba maze akora filime yakurikiyeho, yakozwe n’umuhanzi Alex Templeton-Ward. Igihe Williams yabazwaga icyo imivugo igamije, yagize ati: "Ibi ndabihimbye, nta gitekerezo mfite ariko hano turagiye. Ndatekereza ko byaba ari ukugaragaza, gusangira, kuruhuka, gushakisha. Kuri njye, imivugo itanga bimwe mubyabaye kuri cathartique. Nshobora kunyura mu marangamutima n'ubunararibonye bw'amarangamutima cyane cyane, urabizi, gutandukana, ibibazo nk'ibintu byose nkeneye guhura nabyo, yaba ari hamwe n'inganda, ufite idirishya rifunguye hafi aho. Iyo niyo ntego y'ubusizi: iyo idirishya rifunguye, ryemerera akayaga gake, ubundi bushishozi, ibindi bishoboka ku buryo dushobora gushakisha ibyo twumva byose, ibyo dutekereza byose hamwe n'umwanya wo kubona ibirenze ibyo tuzi, kuko hari ibintu byinshi birenze ibyo tuzi, noneho naba narazimiye. "
Album ya gatanu ya Williams, "MartyrLoserKing", yasohotse ku ya 29 Mutarama 2016. Indirimbo ya mbere yasohotse muri iyi alubumu ni "Burundi", ku bufatanye na Emily Kokal wa Warpaint.
Muri Werurwe 2018, The Kills basohoye igifuniko cy' "Urutonde rw'ibisabwa (Indishyi)" Williams maze Williams afungura igitaramo cyagurishijwe cyabereye mu nzu mberabyombi ya Regent i Los Angeles ku ya 13 Kanama 2018.
Nk'umwanditsi, Williams yasohotse mu "kinyamakuru The New York Times", "Esquire", "Bomb Magazine", na "African Voices", ndetse asohora ibyegeranyo bine by’imivugo. Nk'umusizi n'umucuranzi, Williams yazengurutse kandi atanga ibiganiro ku isi yose, agaragara muri kaminuza n'amashuri makuru. Mu kiganiro cye mu gitabo "Amagambo yawe mu maso yawe: Kuzenguruka mu myaka makumyabiri", Williams agenewe kuririmba cyane gutaka, ni uko ubuzima bukora."
Muri Mutarama 2009, yasohoye "NGH WHT – Imizingo yapfuye ya Emcee hamwe na The Arditti Quartet", isoma igitabo cye cy’imivugo mu 2006. Ubu bufatanye na Thomas Kessler (wanashyizeho umurongo wa Williams uvuga ijambo, "yavuze ko imbunda ku mutwe" ku muziki) yasohotse hakoreshejwe uburyo bubiri bwo kwishyura: abayumva bashoboraga gukuramo igice cya 18 kugeza ku cya 22 cy'iminota 27 yahimbwe mu buryo bwa MP3 ku buntu, cyangwa bagashobora gukuramo ibice 33 byose bigize imiterere ya AIFF itagira igihombo ku madorari 6, hamwe n'amajwi atandukanye hamwe na quartet. Ibikururwa byose byishyuwe byose hamwe bifite 563 megabytes. Williams yagize uruhare mu mirongo ibiri kuri alubumu "Baba Urukundo" rwa 2011 na Arthur H.
Williams yakinnye muri "Slam" (1998) n'uyu "munsi" (2012). Kuri stage, yatorewe umwanya wa mbere muri "Holler Niba Ya Unyumva", umuziki wa Broadway urimo umuziki na Tupac Shakur. Nubwo igaragaramo umuziki wa Shakur, umuziki ntabwo ari ubuzima bwe. Ninyandiko yumwimerere yanditswe na Todd Kreidler. "Rolling Stone" yavuze ko umusaruro ari "umuziki wa mbere wa hip-hop jukebox mu mateka ya Broadway". Igitaramo cyabaye ku ya 19 Kamena 2014 "."
Yabonye igihembo cy’umunyakanada cyerekana igihembo cy’umukinnyi witwaye neza mu bihembo bya 9 bya Kanada byerekanwe muri 2021, kubera ibikorwa bye muri filime "Akilla's Escape".
Mu 2025 yagize uruhare mu kubwiriza muri filime iteye "ubwoba" ya Ryan Coogler.
Mu 2021, "Neptune Frost", Williams yanditse kandi afatanya na Anisia Uzeyman, yerekanwe i Cannes muri Fortnight ya Diregiteri. Filime yatewe inkunga na Kickstarter yiyamamaza neza muri 2018.
Williams ni inyamanswa. Aranenga cyane intambara yo kurwanya iterabwoba n'intambara yo muri Iraki na Afuganisitani. Mu bikorwa bye bizwi cyane harimo indirimbo zirwanya intambara "Ntabwo mu Izina ryanjye" na "Act III Scene 2 (Shakespeare)". Muri 2011, yongeyeho izina rye muri Occupy Musicians, ashyigikira umuryango wa Occupy ku isi hose kurwanya ubusumbane bw’amafaranga. Yerekana ko ari umutekamutwe.
Williams na Marcia Jones, umuhanzi w’amashusho n’umwalimu w’ubuhanzi, batangiye umubano mu 1995 nk'abahanzi bakoranye mu buhanzi bwa Brooklyn ndetse n’amagambo y’imivugo. Icyegeranyo cy’imivugo cyanditswe na Williams cyiswe "S/HE" ni uruhererekane rwo gutekereza ku iherezo ry’umubano we na Jones. Jones yakoze ibishushanyo mbonera bya "karindwi ya Octave", amashusho muri "S/HE" asubiza Williams, anashyiraho alubumu ye "Amethyst Rock Star" 2001.
Williams afite umuhungu hamwe na koreografiya Fatima Robinson.
Ku ya 29 Gashyantare 2008 (isabukuru y'imyaka 36), Williams yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa filime Persia White nyuma y’imyaka itanu. Bahuye ubwo yagaragaraga abashyitsi kuri serie "Y'umukobwa". Ku ya 17 Mutarama 2009, White yatangaje abinyujije kuri blog ye Myspace ko we na Williams batakiri kumwe.
Yashakanye n'umukinnyi wa filime Anisia Uzeyman. Yabaye i Paris imyaka ine ubu aba i Los Angeles.

Dominique Celis, wavukiye mu gihugu cyu Burundi, ni umwanditsi w’Umubiligi n’Umunyarwanda.
Dominique Celis yavukiye mu gihugu cyu u Burundi, yakuriye mu Rwanda hanyuma aza gukurira muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo). Umuryango we watuye mu gihugu cy'u Bubiligi mu 1986. Umwe mu bagize umuryango we wa nyina yapfuye muri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994. Yakomereje amasomo ye ya kaminuza i Liège, aho yabonye impamyabumenyi y'uburere mu bya filozofiya. Nyuma yo kwigisha mu mashuri yisumbuye, yakomeje umwuga we akorera Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Ububiligi. Ni we washinze ishami rya Liège rya Ni Putes Ni Soumises (Nta busambanyi cyangwa ngo abe umunyamategeko uyoboka). Yimukiye i Kigali mu 2013.
Yasohoye inyandiko nyinshi kuri jenoside yekorewe ry’Abatutsi, mu kinyamakuru "Aide-Mémoire" cy’ishyirahamwe "Territoires de la Mémoire", cyibutsa kwibuka abishwe mu Bubiligi.
Mu 2022, yasohoye igitabo "cyitwa Ainsi pleurent nos hommes (Ngaho Abagabo Bacu bararira"). Muri iki gitabo, Dominique Celis asobanura jenoside binyuze mu ijwi ry'umwanditsi ndetse n'inyandiko, Erika. Erika yahunze u Rwanda umwaka umwe mbere ya jenoside. Yagarutseyo mu 2013. Binyuze mu kwandikirana na mushiki we, no kuba inkuru y'urukundo ikomeye, avuga ku kuba bidashoboka kwibagirwa mu gihugu kirimo guhinduka cyane.

Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) yashinzwe mu 1970 nyuma yo guhuzwa kwa Paris FC na Stade Saint-Germain. Mu mwaka wayo wa mbere w’imikino, PSG yegukanye Ligue 2, bityo izamuka muri Ligue 1. Ariko umuvuduko w’iterambere ryayo wahise uhagarara, maze ikipe iratandukana mu 1972. Paris FC yagumye mu cyiciro cya mbere, mu gihe PSG yamanukaga mu cyiciro cya gatatu. Nyuma yo kuzamuka inshuro ebyiri zikurikiranye, PSG yagarutse mu cyiciro cya mbere mu 1974 kandi yimukira ku kibuga gishya cya Parc des Princes.
Ibikombe bya mbere bya Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) byageze mu myaka ya 1980. Iyobowe n’abakinnyi b’icyamamare nka Safet Sušić, Luis Fernandez na Dominique Rocheteau, PSG yegukanye Coupe de France mu 1982 na 1983, ndetse n’igikombe cyayo cya mbere cya Ligue 1 mu 1986. Nyuma y’iyo myaka y’intsinzi, ikipe yagize igabanuka rikomeye, ariko Canal+ yafashe PSG mu 1991 maze ikongera kugarura ubukire bwayo. Iyobowe n’abakinnyi nka David Ginola, George Weah na Raí, PSG yatwaye ibikombe icyenda kandi igeze mu cyiciro kimwe cya kabiri cy’ibikombe byo ku mugabane w’i Burayi mu myaka ya 1990. Ikigaragara ni uko Paris yegukanye igikombe cya kabiri cya shampiyona mu 1994 ndetse n’igikombe cya UEFA Cup Winners' Cup mu 1996. Luis Fernandez, wari umwe mu bakinnyi b’icyamamare muri icyo gihe, ubu akaba ari umutoza wamenyekanye cyane.
Mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana cya 21, Abanya-Paris bahanganye no kugaruka ku mwanya wa mbere, nubwo bari bafite abakinnyi b’inararibonye nka Ronaldinho n’umusaruro w’ibitego wa Pauleta. Muri icyo gihe, PSG yegukanye ibindi bikombe bitanu birimo bitatu bya Coupe de France, kimwe cya Coupe de la Ligue, ndetse n’igikombe cya UEFA Intertoto. Ariko ikipe yamenyekanye cyane kubera guhangana n’ibibazo bitandukanye by’imiyoborere. Mu 2006, Canal+ yagurishije PSG ku kigo cya Colony Capital, ariko ibintu byarakomeje kuba bibi, maze PSG imara imyaka ibiri ikurikiranye irwana no kwirinda kumanuka mu cyiciro cya kabiri.
Ihirwe rya Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) ryahindutse cyane ubwo Qatar Sports Investments, iyoborwa na guverinoma ya Qatar, yafataga ikipe nk’iyabo mu 2011. Guhera icyo gihe, PSG yashoye amafaranga menshi mu gusinyisha abakinnyi b’abahanga ku isi nka Zlatan Ibrahimović, Lionel Messi, Neymar na Kylian Mbappé, aba bakinnyi babiri ba nyuma bakaba ari bo bahenze cyane mu mateka y’umupira w’amaguru. Kubera iyo mpamvu, PSG yabaye ikipe ikomeye mu mupira w’amaguru w’Abafaransa, yegukana ibikombe 37 birimo 11 bya shampiyona, 8 bya Coupe de France, 6 bya Coupe de la Ligue na 11 bya Trophée des Champions.
Ku rwego rw’i Burayi, PSG yabaye abakinnyi basanzwe mu cyiciro cya 16 cya UEFA Champions League, bagera ku mukino wa nyuma ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka yabo mu 2020, ndetse begukana igikombe cyabo cya mbere ku rwego rw’umupira w’amaguru w’isi mu 2025. Ikipe y’i Burayi yatwaye kandi UEFA Super Cup ndetse na FIFA Intercontinental Cup mu 2025, ikaba yarageze ku rwego rudasanzwe rw’imyaka 20 y’intsinzi n’amateka y’ikirenga.

Nyamko Ana Sabuni (wavutse ku ya 31 Werurwe 1969) ni umunyapolitiki wo muri Suwede wari Umuyobozi w’abigenga hagati ya Kamena 2019 na Mata 2022.Yabanje kuba Minisitiri w’Ubufatanye kuva 2006 kugeza 2010 ndetse anaba Minisitiri w’Uburinganire kuva 2006 kugeza 2013 muri guverinoma ya Suwede. Sabuni umwe mu bagize Ishyaka Riharanira Ukwishyira ukizana kwa buri muntu, yatorewe kuba Umudepite mu 2002. Sabuni yakoze amateka muri Kamena 2019 abaye umuyobozi wa mbere w’ishyaka mu nteko ishinga amategeko ya Suwede ukomoka mu moko mato ndetse n’umuyobozi w’ishyaka rya mbere ukomoka mu mpunzi. Muri Mata 2022, Sabuni yeguye ku buyobozi bw'ishyaka.
Nyamko Sabuni yavukiye i Bujumbura mu Burundi, aho se, umunyapolitiki w’ibumoso ukomoka muri Zayire, yabaga mu buhungiro. Se wa Sabuni ni umukirisitu, naho nyina ni umuyisilamu. Uyu muryango wabonye ubuhungiro bwa politiki muri Suwede mu 1981 naho Sabuni akurira i Kungsängen, mu majyaruguru ya Stockholm. Yize amategeko muri kaminuza ya Uppsala, politiki y’abimukira muri kaminuza ya Mälardalen muri Eskilstuna, n’itumanaho n’itangazamakuru mu ishuri ry’itumanaho rya Berghs i Stockholm.
Yashakanye kuva 2004 kugeza 2012 kandi afite abahungu b'impanga kuva muri ubwo bukwe. Yavuze ko atari umunyamadini.
Paweł Rogaliński, Nyamko Sabuni na Mara Carfagna mu nama ya gatatu y’uburinganire yabereye i Stockholm muri Nzeri 2009.
Sabuni yari umwe mu bagize akanama k’Urubyiruko rwigenga rwa Suwede kuva mu 1996 kugeza mu 1998. Yavuze ko iyicwa ry’impunzi ya Cote d'Ivoire Gerard Gbeyo, ryakozwe n’umusuwede neo-Nazi wo muri Suwede mu mujyi wa Klippan mu 1995, nkimwe mu mpamvu zatumye yishora muri politiki.
Nyuma gato yo gutorerwa imirimo, yafashe icyemezo cyo gukuraho inkunga y’umuryango Centrum mot rasism, aho nyirarume Mkyabela Sabuni yari umuyobozi.
Mu ibaruwa y’ibitekerezo yo ku ya 17 Nyakanga 2006 yasohotse mu kinyamakuru cyo muri Suwede Expressen, Sabuni yasabye ko hasuzumwa abagore b’abagore b’abagore bose b’ishuri hagamijwe gukumira imyanya ndangagitsina. Yasabye ko hijab ihagarikwa ku bakobwa bari munsi y’imyaka 15 kandi anashyigikira ko ubwicanyi bw’icyubahiro bwashyirwa mu cyiciro cyigenga mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana cya Suwede. Muri Nyakanga 2006, hasohotse igitabo cye Flickorna vi sviker ("Abakobwa Tureka"), kivuga ku bagore bo muri Suwede babangamiwe n’ihohoterwa ry’icyubahiro.
Sabuni avuga ko kwimenyereza Abayisilamu babaho na Qor'ani "bigabanya amahirwe yabo". Yagaragaje ko imyitozo nko gusenga inshuro eshanu ku munsi cyangwa kubaza umuziki, itesha agaciro Abayisilamu.
Ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2006, guverinoma nshya ihuriweho na Suwede yavuye mu matora yatangaje ko Sabuni yagizwe Minisitiri mushya w’uburinganire n’uburinganire. Niwe muntu wa mbere ukomoka muri Afurika wagizwe Minisitiri muri guverinoma ya Suwede.
Kuba Sabuni yagizwe Minisitiri w’Uburinganire n’Uburinganire bw’Uburinganire byahuye n’imyigaragambyo ya bamwe mu Bayisilamu bo muri Suwede, bamushinje Islamophobia na populism. Icyifuzo cyo kwanga ko ashyirwaho umukono n’ishyirahamwe ry’abayisilamu bo muri Suwede, bivugwa ko ariryo shyirahamwe rinini rihagarariye abayisilamu muri Suwede.
Yeguye ku ya 21 Mutarama 2013, avuga ko uzamusimbura agomba kwitegura mbere y'amatora rusange ya 2014
Muri Kamena 2021, Sabuni yatorewe kuba umuyobozi w'ishyaka rya Liberal.
Ku ya 8 Mata 2022, Sabuni yeguye ku buyobozi bw'ishyaka nyuma y'impaka zikomoka ku magambo ye avuga ko azahunga Suwede yerekeza muri Noruveje niba Suwede yarigeze gutera. Umunsi umwe yasimbuwe na Johan Pehrson

Barack Hussein Obama wavutse Baraka Hussein Obama, ku ya 18 Kamena 1934 - 24 Ugushyingo 1982) yari umuhanga mu by'ubukungu muri Kenya akaba na se wa Barack Obama, wahoze ari Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ni umuntu ukomeye mu nkuru y'ubuzima bw'umuhungu we, Dreams from My Father (1995). Obama yashatse mu 1954 babyarana abana babiri n'umugore we wa mbere, Kezia. Yatoranyijwe muri gahunda yihariye yo kwiga kaminuza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yiga muri Kaminuza ya Hawaii aho yahuriye na Stanley Ann Dunham, bashyingiranywe mu 1961 nyuma yo gutwita umuhungu we, Barack. Obama na Dunham baratandukanye nyuma y'imyaka itatu. Hanyuma Obama yagiye muri Kaminuza ya Harvard kwiga amashuri yisumbuye, aho yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu by'ubukungu, maze asubira muri Kenya mu 1964. Yabonye umuhungu we Barack nanone, ubwo umuhungu we yari afite imyaka 10.

Abantu benshi bagira imitekerereze inyuranye kubwozi bw'inzuki ndetse bamwe bakibwira ko ari udusimba tugira amahane.Nyamara kandi ubuzima bw’inzuki buratangaje kandi burangwa n’imwe mu mico yo kubaha inzuki z’ingore kuko ingore ari zo zibyara umwamikazi.imibanire yazo ndetse n'imikoranire yazo iratangaje kuko ziha icyubahiro umwamikazi wazo kuko ariwe uzibeshaho kandi uziyoboye.Abahanga bavuga ko umwamikazi (urwiru) atandukanye n'izindi nzuki kuburyo iyo ziri kumwe uhita ubona itandukaniro.Bavuga ko kandi hagati y’inzuki icumi na makumyabiri bashobora gukuramo icyana cy’uruyuki bagatangira kugiha ibyokurya by'ibwami n’igikoma kibwami.inzuki kandi zifite umumaro k'ubuzima bwamuntu.
Ibyo benshi bita umwanda sikobiri kuko nibyo bivamo ubuki.inzuki kandi zigira ibishashara aribyo bakamuramo ubuki,bashobora kandi kubikoramo buji mu gutanga urumuri.

Babigarutseho mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yabahurije muri Lemigo Hotel kuri uyu wa 23 Ukwakira 2021, yigaga ku guteza imbere amoko y’ibiti gakondo mu kubungabunga ubutaka n’ibyogogo byangiritse. Iyi nama yateguwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Amashyamba (RFA) ku bufatanye n’Umuryango ARCOS utegamiye kuri Leta.
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RFA, Mugabo Jean Pierre, yavuze ko hakenewe kongerwa imbaraga n’ubukangurambaga mu gutera ibiti gakondo bikomeje gukendera.
Yagaragaje ko kubitera bikigoranye kuko mu mishinga itandukanye ishyirwaho igamije kongera amashyamba n’ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka usanga ibyatewe bishobora gukura neza biri ku mpuzandengo yo hasi.
Yakomeje ati “Kubera impamvu yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe itugiraho ingaruka twese, n’abaterankunga ubasabye amafaranga ushobora kubumvisha uko ibyo biti byaterwa. Bo icyo barebaho ni ingaruka byagira, n’imbogamizi zihari.”
Mugabo yanasobanuye ko hakwiye kurebwa impamvu zose zizitira kuba ibyo biti byakwiyongera zikigirwa uko zikurwaho.
Ati “Niba ari ingemwe zitujuje ubuziranenge zigakosorwa. […] Reka ibyo biti byongere bigaruke abaturage babibone. Ibijojo, imivumu, imiko, imiravumba n’ibindi.”
Isoko y’imiti n’ ibiryo by’amatungo …
Nk’uko buri gihugu kigira umuco wacyo, Abanyarwanda nabo bafite uburyo bivura bwa gakondo budakoresha imiti ya Kizungu ahubwo bwifashisha ibyatsi n’ibiti.
Ibirimo umuravumba, umubirizi, umuvumu, n’ibindi byinshi bizwiho kwifashwa mu buvuzi bw’indwara zitandukanye.
Ibiti gakondo binongera imyunyungugu mu butaka bukarumbuka, bikabufata ntihabe isuri iterwa n’imvura, bigafasha abaturage kubona inkwi ndetse bikaba ibiryo by’amatungo n’zindi nyamaswa muri rusange. Hari n’izo bibera icumbi zirimo inyoni n’inzuki kimwe n’utundi dusimba duto.
Umuyobozi wa ARCOS (Albertine Rift Conservation Society), Dr Kanyamibwa Sam, yasobanuriye abitabiriye iyo nama ko kuba ibi biti bifite akamaro haba mu mibereho y’abanyarwanda no mu kubungabunga ibidukikije, bishimangira ko ari ngombwa gukomeza kubitera no kubibungabunga.
Yakomeje agira ati “Aya yagombye kuba amahirwe yo kuganira neza tukagera ku bisubizo byakwifashishwa mu kubungabunga ibi biti.” Kanyamibwa yashimangiye kandi ko kugira ngo ibiti gakondo byatangiye guterwa bizakure neza, hakwiye kwimakaza umubona udasanzwe hagati y’abaturage ndetse n’abatanga ibi biti.
Abitabiriye inama batanze ibitekerezo bagaragaza zimwe mu mpamvu ibi biti bigenda bikendera ndetse n’icyakorwa ngo bibungabungwe. Bimwe mu bitekerezo byatanzwe nuko abaturage batagikunda ibi biti kuko bitinda gutanga umusaruro bityo bikaba byaba ngombwa ko bajya bahabwa indi mishanga yabafasha kubungabunga ibi biti.

ubuki:ni bimwe mubiribwa biryohera bikorwa ni nzuki
"Muri iki gihe" "cyubu indwara z’umutima ziri guhitana benshi kubera imibereho ya buri munsi itandukanye,hamwe usanga abantu benshi bafite ibiro byinshi badakora imyitozo ngororamubiri ndetse numubyibuho ukabije."
abashakashatsi batandukanye bagaragaje ko ubuki bwifitemo ubushobozi bwo kurinda indwara zifata umutima. muri iyi nkuru rero tugiye kureba bimwe mubigize ubuki twavugamo; isukari y'umwimerere;imyunyu ngugu n'ibindi bitandukanye. bimwe mubyiza by'ubuki twavugamo, bufasha umutima gutera neza,bwongera imbaraga z'umutima mugukora neza, butuma amaraso akomeza gutembera neza mumubiri.
Kubantu bajya barwara umutima ubuki bugabanya ububabare bw' umutima kuko bakunda kuribwa mugatuza kugice cyaho umutima uherereye. ariko nubwotwabonye ibyiza byinshi byo gukoresha ubuki ntago aribyiza gukoresha ingano nyinshi irengeje urugero nko kubana bari munsi y'umwaka umwe.

Ingaruka zamakimbirane mumiryango harimo kwishora mubiyobya bwenge, ubusambanyinyi,guta amashuri kubana,kwiyaka ubuzima,kwishora mubujura ndetse noguta umuryango.kubanu bakuru habaho kutigirira ikizere mumuryango ndetse ababyeyi habaho gutndukana cyangwa se umwe akaba yakica undi.habaho inzangano hagati yimiryango ifitanye amakimbirane.

Paruwasi ya Rwamagana yashinzwe na Nyiricyubahiro Yohani-Yozefu Hiriti, kuwa 5 Gashyanare 1919, maze ayiragiza Bikira Mariya Umwamikazi w'imitsindo.(Notre dame dese victoires). Kuri iyo tariki ni bwo Abamisiyoneri bahageze kugira ngo bahatangire ubutumwa muri Misiyoni yari imaze gushingwa.

Ubuganza ni igice cy'u Rwanda kiri mu nkengero z'ikiyaga cya Muhazi, mu burasirazuba bushyira amajyepfo y'icyo kiyaga.
Padiri Lewo Delimasi (R.P. Leon Delmas) watumwe kurambagiza ako karere gaherereye mu nkengero z'ikiyaga cya Muhazi adutekerereza amateka y'ishingwa ry'iyo Misiyoni.RWAMAGANA niryo zina ryahawe Misiyoni nshya yagiye mu ruhererekane rw'ishingwa rya za misiyoni z'icyahoze ari Vikariyati ya Kivu kuva muri Gashyantare 19199.
Muri Gashyanare 1918, Padiri Lewo Delimasi, aturutse muri Misiyoni ya Kigali yari yarashinzwe kuwa 21 ugushyingo 2013, akaba yari ayibereye umukuru, nibwo yakoze urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu Buganza, abisabwe na Musenyeri Yohani-Yozefu Hiriti wifuzaga ko yamenya neza imiterere y'ako karere gakikije ikiyaga cya Muhazi.

Ibirayi ni ikiribwa cyiza cyane ku bantu bakora siporo kuko kibarinda kuba bagira ikibazo cy’isukari nkeya mu gihe bakoresheje imbaraga muri siporo. Ikindi kandi ibirayi byongera imbaraga, bikongera ubwinshi bwa ‘potassium’ mu mubiri cyane cyane iyo bitekeshejwe umwuka (cuire à la vapeur), iyo potassium rero ituma imikaya ikomera.

muri ikigihe abantu batandukanye bakiri mu myaka yo kubyara usanga bababibazaku mata baha abana babo basubiye mu kazi, kuko ikiruhuko umubyeyi ahabwa ari amezi atatu, yaba akorera leta cyangwa abikorera.

= Amata yuzuye intungamubiri ariko hari abatinya ko yabatera ibibazo =
Ku rubuga www.lemonde.fr, bavuga ko nko mu Bufaransa, kugurisha amata byagabanutseho 20% hagati y’umwaka wa 2003-2016, bitewe n’uko hari amakuru agenda avuga ko amata yaba atera ibibazo bitandukanye mu mubiri, harimo n’ibijyanye n’igogora.
Urubuga www.lexpress.fr, rwo rugaragaza ko hari abavuga ko amata y’inka ashobora gutera indwara zitandukanye harimo nka kanseri ifata imyanya y’ibanga y’abagabo(cancer de la prostate), cyangwa kanseri ifata intanga z’abagore (ovaires).
Gusa ibyo bivuguruzwa n’inzobere mu by’ubuzima, ahubwo bakavuga ko amata akize cyane ku butare bwa “calcium” na “vitamine D”, gusa kunywa amata cyane cyane ku bantu bakuru biracyateza impaka zo kumenya niba ari bibi cyangwa ari byiza.
Kunywa amata y’inka atakuwemo na kimwe mu biyagize, byarinda umwana kubyibuha bikabije, bikanamurinda kubura vitamine D.
Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe muri Canada bwagaragaje ko abana banywa amata y’inka uko yakabaye, nta kintu cyakuwemo, baba bananutse ugereranyije n’abanywa amata agabanyijwemo amavuta(demi-écrémé), kandi abana banywa amata uko yakabaye, baba bafite vitamine D mu maraso iri ku rugero rwiza.
Ubwo bushakashatsi bwakorewe ku bana 2.745 bafite hagati y’imyaka ibiri n’itandatu, bukorerwa ku bitaro bya St Michael by’ahitwa i Toronto, butangazwa mu kinyamakuru cyitwa ‘American Journal of Clinical Nutrition’, bwagaragaje ko amata y’inka ari meza kuri bo kuko abazanira vitamine D kandi ikenewe mu mubiri wabo.
Ubwo bushakashatsi bwahinyuje ibitekerezo by’uko amata yaba ari mabi ku buzima.
Ku rubuga www.healthline.com, bavuga ibindi byiza byo kunywa amata y’inka.
Amata y’inka yifitemo intungamubiri.Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe muri Canada bwagaragaje ko abana banywa amata y’inka uko yakabaye, nta kintu cyakuwemo, baba bananutse ugereranyije n’abanywa amata agabanyijwemo amavuta(demi-écrémé), kandi abana banywa amata uko yakabaye, baba bafite vitamine D mu maraso iri ku rugero rwiza.Ubwo bushakashatsi bwakorewe ku bana 2.745 bafite hagati y’imyaka ibiri n’itandatu, bukorerwa ku bitaro bya St Michael by’ahitwa i Toronto, butangazwa mu kinyamakuru cyitwa ‘American Journal of Clinical Nutrition’, bwagaragaje ko amata y’inka ari meza kuri bo kuko abazanira vitamine D kandi ikenewe mu mubiri wabo.

umuntu wese ajya murukundo ashaka kuzarambana n'uwo yihebeye.
rero hari ibimenyetso bigera muri 2 byakwerekako uwo mukundana ko mutazarambana,bitwo bikaba byagufasha gufata umwanzuro.
1.gushira kw'amatsiko:igihe ukundanye nu muntu igihe kirekire birashobokako,wageraho ukamumenya neza.ariko ibukako umuntu agenda ahinduka.
2.Nagukorera ikintu kiza akakikwishyuza:ubundi umuntu wawe agukorera ikintu kiza adategerejeko nawe uzakimukorera cyangwa ko uzamwishyura.

William Henry Gates III (wavutse ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1955) ni umucuruzi w’umunyamerika akaba n’umugiraneza. Yabaye umuhanga mu mpinduramatwara ya mudasobwa nto mu myaka ya 1970 na 1980, afatanyije na Paul Allen mu bwana bwe, bashinze isosiyete ya mudasobwa ya Microsoft mu 1975. Gates yabaye umuherwe muto ku isi icyo gihe mu 1987, afite imyaka 31. Ibi byakurikiyeho nyuma y’uko Microsoft yatangiraga gutanga umusanzu wayo mu mwaka ushize ndetse n’izamuka ry’imigabane. Ikinyamakuru Forbes cyamushyize ku mwanya w’umuntu ukize cyane ku isi mu myaka 18 muri 24 hagati ya 1995 na 2017, harimo imyaka 13 yikurikiranya kuva mu 1995 kugeza 2007. Gates yabaye umuherwe wa mbere mu 1999, ubwo umutungo we warengaga gato miliyari 100 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Nk’uko Forbes ibivuga, kugeza muri Gicurasi 2025, umutungo we wari miliyari 115.1 z’amadolari ya Amerika, bimugira uwa cumi na gatatu mu baherwe ku isi.
Gates yavukiye i Seattle, muri leta ya Washington, yize amashuri yigenga muri Lakeside School, aho yagiranye ubucuti na Allen ndetse anateza imbere ibyo akunda mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga. Mu 1973, yiyandikishije muri Kaminuza ya Harvard, aho yize amasomo arimo Math 55 n’amasomo ya siyansi ya mudasobwa yo mu rwego rwa kaminuza, ariko yayahagaritse mu 1975 ajya gushinga no kuyobora Microsoft. Yayikoreye nk'umuyobozi mukuru mu myaka 25 yakurikiyeho, ndetse aba perezida na perezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi ubwo iyi sosiyete yashingwaga mu 1981. Yasimbuwe nk'umuyobozi mukuru na Steve Ballmer mu 2000, yahindutse umuyobozi mukuru w’ubwubatsi bwa porogaramu, umwanya yari afite kugeza mu 2008. Yavuye ku mwanya wa perezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi mu 2014 aba umujyanama mu ikoranabuhanga w’umuyobozi mukuru Satya Nadella n’abandi bayobozi ba Microsoft, umwanya agifite. Yeguye ku mwanya w’inama y’ubutegetsi mu 2020.
Uko igihe cyagiye gihita, Gates yagabanyije inshingano ze muri Microsoft kugira ngo yibande ku bikorwa bye byo gufasha afatanyije na Bill &amp; Melinda Gates Foundation, umuryango munini ku isi w’abagiraneza, we n’umugore we icyo gihe, Melinda French Gates, bayoboye kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2024. Yibanda ku nzego zirimo ubuzima, uburezi, no kurwanya ubukene, Gates yamenyekanye kubera imbaraga ze zo kurwanya indwara zandura nka igituntu, malariya na polio. Nyuma y’uko French Gates yeguye ku mwanya w’umuyobozi wungirije nyuma yo gutandukana kw’aba bombi, umuryango wahinduriwe izina witwa Gates Foundation, aho Gates ari we muyobozi wawo wenyine.
Gates ni we washinze akaba na perezida w'andi masosiyete menshi, arimo BEN, Cascade Investment, TerraPower, Gates Ventures, na Breakthrough Energy. Mu 2010, we na Warren Buffett bashinze Giving Pledge, aho bo n'abandi baherwe biyemeje gutanga nibura kimwe cya kabiri cy'umutungo wabo mu bikorwa by'ubugiraneza. Yamenyekanye nk'umwe mu n'ikinyamakuru "Time" mu 1999, yahawe andi mashimwe n'ibihembo byinshi, harimo n'umudari wa Perezida w'Ubwigenge, wahawe we na French Gates mu 2016 kubera ibikorwa byabo by'ubugiraneza. Yanditswe muri filime nyinshi za documentaire, yasohoye igitabo cya mbere mu bitabo bitatu byateguwe, "Source Code: My Beginnings", mu 2025.
William Henry Gates III yavutse ku ya 28 Ukwakira 1955, i Seattle, muri Washington, nk'umuhungu w'ikinege wa William H. Gates Sr. [a] (1925–2020) n'umugore we wa mbere, Mary Maxwell Gates (1929–1994). Inkomoko ye irimo Icyongereza, Ikidage, n'Ikinya- Irish / Ikigo cy'Abanye-Ecosse-Irish. Se yari umunyamategeko ukomeye, naho nyina yakoraga mu nama y'ubuyobozi ya First Interstate BancSystem na United Way of America. Sekuru wa Gates, JW Maxwell, yari perezida wa banki y'igihugu. Gates afite kandi mushiki we mukuru, Kristi (Kristianne), na mushiki we muto, Libby. Ni uwa kane mu izina rye mu muryango we, ariko azwi ku izina rya William Gates III cyangwa "Trey" (ni ukuvuga batatu) kuko se yari afite inyuguti "II". Uwo muryango wabaga mu gace ka Sand Point muri Seattle mu nzu yangijwe n'inkubi y'umuyaga idasanzwe ubwo Gates yari afite imyaka 7. Gates akiri muto, ababyeyi be bifuzaga ko akora umwuga w’amategeko. Mu bwana bwe, umuryango we wakundaga kujya mu itorero ry’amatorero ya gikristo ya Congregational, idini ry’abaporotesitanti bavuguruye. Gates yari muto ugereranyije n'imyaka ye kandi yatotezwaga akiri umwana. Umuryango washishikarizaga amarushanwa; umwe mu bashyitsi yavuze ko "ntacyo byari bitwaye byaba ari imitima cyangwa umupira wo mu mazi cyangwa koga ujya ku cyambu; buri gihe hariho igihembo cyo gutsinda, kandi buri gihe hariho igihano cyo gutsindwa".
Ku myaka 13, Gates yiyandikishije mu ishuri ryigenga rya Lakeside Prep School. Ubwo yari mu mwaka wa munani, itsinda ry’ababyeyi bo muri iryo shuri ryakoresheje amafaranga yavuye mu igurishwa rya Lakeside School kugira ngo bagure terminal ya Teletype Model 33 ASR n’igihe gito cya mudasobwa kuri mudasobwa ya General Electric (GE) ku banyeshuri.[17] Gates yashishikajwe no gukora porogaramu ya GE muri BASIC, maze yemererwa kuva mu masomo y’imibare kugira ngo akurikirane inyungu ze. Yanditse porogaramu ye ya mbere ya mudasobwa kuri iyi mashini, ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya tic-tac-toe ryemereraga abayikoresha gukina imikino kuri mudasobwa. Gates yashimishijwe n’iyo mashini n’uburyo yahoraga ikora neza cyane.
Nyuma y’uko impano ya Mothers Club irangiye, Gates n’abandi banyeshuri basabye umwanya kuri sisitemu, harimo na mudasobwa nto za DEC PDP. Imwe muri izi sisitemu yari PDP-10 ya Computer Center Corporation (CCC), yabujije Gates, Paul Allen, Ric Weiland, n’inshuti magara ya Gates akaba n’umufatanyabikorwa wa mbere mu bucuruzi, Kent Evans, mu mpeshyi nyuma y’uko ibafashe bakoresha udukosa muri sisitemu yo gukora kugira ngo babone umwanya wa mudasobwa ku buntu.
Abanyeshuri bane bashinze Lakeside Programmers Club kugira ngo binjize amafaranga. [8] Nyuma y’ihagarikwa ry’akazi, bitanze gushaka udukosa muri porogaramu za CCC kugira ngo babone igihe cy’inyongera kuri mudasobwa. Aho gukoresha iyi porogaramu ukoresheje Teletype, Gates yagiye ku biro bya CCC yiga kode y’isoko ya porogaramu zitandukanye zakoreshaga iyi porogaramu, harimo Fortran, Lisp, n’ururimi rw’imashini. Amasezerano na CCC yakomeje kugeza mu 1970, ubwo iyi sosiyete yavaga mu kazi.
Mu 1971, umwarimu wo muri Lakeside yasabye Gates na Evans gukoresha sisitemu yo gutegura gahunda y’amasomo y’ishuri, abaha igihe cya mudasobwa n’amafaranga y’inyongera. Aba bombi bakoze cyane kugira ngo gahunda itegure umwaka wabo wa nyuma. Mu mpera z’umwaka wabo wa gatatu, Evans yahitanywe n’impanuka yo kuzamuka imisozi, Gates yavuze ko ari umwe mu minsi ibabaje cyane mu buzima bwe. Hanyuma yiyambaje Allen, wamufashaga kurangiza gahunda yo muri Lakeside.
Ku myaka 17, Gates yakoranye na Allen yise Traf-O-Data kugira ngo akore ibyuma bipima umuhanda bishingiye kuri poroseseri ya Intel 8008. Mu 1972, yabaye umwanditsi w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko. Yari intiti mu by’ubumenyi bw’igihugu ubwo yarangizaga mu ishuri rya Lakeside mu 1973. Yabonye amanota 1590 muri 1600 mu bizamini bya Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) maze yiyandikisha muri Kaminuza ya Harvard mu gihe cy’umuhindo wa 1973.
Gates ntiyamaze igihe gihagije muri Harvard ngo ahitemo kwibanda ku byo yibandaho, ahubwo yafashe amasomo y’imibare (harimo na Math 55) n’amasomo ya siyansi ya mudasobwa yo mu rwego rwa kaminuza. Ubwo yari muri Harvard, yahuye n’umunyeshuri mugenzi we akaba n’umuyobozi mukuru wa Microsoft Steve Ballmer. Gates yavuye muri Harvard nyuma y’imyaka ibiri mu gihe Ballmer yagumyeyo maze arangiza "kaminuza". Nyuma y’imyaka myinshi, Ballmer yasimbuye Gates nk’umuyobozi mukuru wa Microsoft maze akomeza uwo mwanya kuva mu 2000 kugeza yeguye mu 2014. Gates yateguye uburyo bwo gutondeka pancake nk'igisubizo kuri kimwe mu bibazo bitarakemurwa byatanzwe mu isomo rya combinatorics rya Porofeseri Harry Lewis. Igisubizo cye cyabaye icya mbere mu myaka irenga 30, kandi icyakurikiyeho ni 2% gusa Igisubizo cye cyashyizwe ahagaragara ku bufatanye n'umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa wa Harvard Christos Papadimitriou.
Gates yakomeje kuvugana na Paul Allen maze aza kumusanga muri Honeywell mu mpeshyi yo mu 1974. [32] Mu 1975, MITS Altair 8800 yasohotse ishingiye kuri Intel 8080 CPU, maze Gates na Allen babona amahirwe yo gutangiza sosiyete yabo bwite ya porogaramu za mudasobwa. [33] Gates yavuye muri Harvard muri uwo mwaka. Ababyeyi be baramushyigikiye nyuma yo kubona ukuntu yifuzaga gutangiza sosiyete ye bwite. [34] Yasobanuye icyemezo cye cyo kuva muri Harvard ati: "Iyo ibintu bitagenda neza, nashoboraga gusubira ku ishuri buri gihe. Nari mu kiruhuko cyemewe."

Amagaju Football Club ni ikipe yumupira wamaguru yo mu karere ka Nyamagabe Intara y Amajyepfo, yu Rwanda. Kurubu iyi kipe irushanwa muri Shampiyona y’umupira wamaguru mu Rwanda, ikinira imikino yayo iwayo kuri Stade de Nyamagabe izwi ku izina rya Nyagisenyi.Nikipi yumupira wamaguru yumwuga ikorera mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Iyi kipe yashinzwe muwi 1935, ikina imikino yayo murugo kuri Stade Nyagisenyi. Ibara ryabo murugo ni umuhondo nubururu. Amagaju ni imwe mu makipe amaze igihe mu Rwanda, afite ibikombe 5. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]

Umurenge wa Nyange ni umwe mu mirenge 13 igize Akarere ka Ngororero, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Nyange wari utuwe n'abaturage 24 859.
Nyange izwi kubera amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Izwi kandi kubera abanyeshuri b'Intwari z'Imena bo mu 1997.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Nyange ni umwe mu mirenge 13 y'Akarere ka Ngororero. Ufite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 54,37.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Nyange wari utuwe n'abaturage 21 932. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 24 859. Ubucucike bwari abantu 457 kuri kilometero kare.
Akarere ka Ngororero gafite ibikorwa byinshi by'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Umurenge wa Nyange uri mu mirenge irimo ubucukuzi butemewe bwinshi.
Umurenge wa Nyange ufite ikigo cy'ikoranabuhanga ("telecenter"). Muri Nyakanga 2025, umushinga wa DOT Rwanda wahaye icyo kigo mudasobwa 10. Uwo mushinga uzahugura kandi abacuruzi bato mu ikoranabuhanga.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Abatutsi benshi bahungiye muri kiliziya Gatolika ya Nyange. Padiri Athanase Seromba yategetse ko iyo kiliziya isenywa. Abari bayirimo bose barapfuye. Uyu munsi i Nyange hari urwibutso rwa Jenoside.
Muri Werurwe 1997, Interahamwe zateye Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange. Zategetse abanyeshuri kwitandukanya hakurikijwe ubwoko. Abanyeshuri barabyanze. Bavuze ko bose ari Abanyarwanda. Bamwe muri bo barishwe. Abo banyeshuri bari mu Ntwari z'Imena.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda ya Basketball y'abatarengeje imyaka 16 nikipe ya Basketball y'igihugu cy'u Rwanda, iyoborwa na Fédération Rwandaise de Basketball Amateur. Ihagarariye igihugu mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Basketball y'abagore batarengeje imyaka 16.

Faustin Butéra (wavutse kuwa 20 Nzeri 1955) numukinnyi w'umunyarwanda usiganwa ku maguru. Yitabiriye irushanwa ryo gusiganwa kumaguru rya metero 400 na metero 400 mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1984.
Butéra yegukanye umudari wewa mbere mpuzamahanga mu irushanwa rya 1978 rya Siporo muri Afurika yo Hagati ryabereye i Libreville, muri Gabon, ahoyatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mu kwiruka metero 800 mu minota 1 n'iminota 55.5. Mu 1979, yashyizeho igihe agahigo ke cya mbere cyo kwiruka metero 400 mu buryo bw'amasegonda 53.7, nubwo yari yihuta kurusha agahigo k'u Rwanda ntikemejwe bitewe n'uburyo bwo gukoresha igihe n'intoki. Yashyizeho igihe cyecya mbere cyo kwiruka metero 400 mumasegonda 49.36 mu 1982.
Butéra yatsinze mumikino yo gusiganwa kumaguru yametero 400 ndetse no mu mikino Olempike yomuri 1984, yari iteganyijwe muminsi ikurikiranye. Ku itariki ya 3 Kanama, Butéra yarangije ari uwa 7 mu mikino yo gusiganwa kumaguru ya metero 400, yirukanye amanota 54.36 ariko ntagera muri kimwe cyakabiri cy’irushanwa. Igihe cye cyashyize umuhigo w’igihugu cy’u Rwanda kugeza uburacyariho muri 2025 Ku itariki ya 4 Kanama, yagarutse muri metero 400, yiruka amasegonda 51.41 aba uwa 8 mu gihe yarari mwirushanwa.
Nyuma y'imyaka itatu mu mikino ya Afurika yo Hagati yo mu 1987, Butéra yongeye kwitabira mu isiganwa ry'imipira yogusiganwa metero 400. Yatsindiye umudari wifeza inyuma ya Jean-Pierre Abossolo-Ze, yiruka amasegonda 54.0. Igihe cye cyongeye kwihuta kurusha agahigo ke k'igihugu, ariko ntibyemejwe bitewe n'uburyo bwogukoresha igihe nintoki bwakoreshejwe.
Muri 2012, Butéra yashimwe na Minisiteri y'Umuco n'Imikino yomu Rwanda, ahabwa uburenganzira bwo kwinjira mumikino yose yomu Rwanda kubera kuba umukinnyi mpuzamahanga ukomeye mu gihugu.

Amavunja ni indwara mbi cyane iterwa n'umwanda,ikaba ikwira kwira muburyo bwihuse iyo utabyitayeho nkiyo hari uyirwaye mumuryango.
ubushakashatsi bwakozwe kuri iyindwara bugaragaza ko hari uburyo butandukanye amavunja ashobora kwanduriramo. ahenshi cyane nimuburyo bwoguhura cyangwa kwegerana muburyo bwogukoranaho.
UBUSHAKASHATSI KUBIJYANYE NO KWANDURA AMAVUNJA MU MURYANGO:
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mubihugu bitandukanye bwerekanye ko amavunja yandura cyane mumiryango,aho umuntu umwe ashobora kuba intandaro yogukwirakwiza indwara mubandi.kuburyo bworoshye,ibiheri byinkuruka bituruka kumuryango umwe bigenda bigaragara kubagize urugo.
Ibi bigaragazwa nazaraporo zibigonderabuzima naza kaminuza aho amavunja yandura kuburyo bworoshye mumiryango cyane cyane habayeho kutita kwisuku. ubushakashatsi kandi bwerekanyeko igihe cyogukwirakwira kwamavunja gitandukana bitewe nicyiciro cyabantu.abana nabacecuru nibo bagaragaza ibyago byinshi byokwandura kuko umubiri wabo uba utabasha neza gukingira indwara nkamavunja.
urubyiruko rwari hagati yimyaka 18 na 35 rwasanganywe ibyago byinshi byogukwirakwiza amavunja kuberako hari byinshi bakora mumiryango nomumatsinda bituma bandura byoroshye.

Amata ni kimwe mubyo kurya byihagije ku ntungamubiri n'ibifitiye umubiri akamaro ku buryo ashobora gutunga yaba umwana cyangwa umuntu mukuru igihe kirekire adakeneye ikindi kintu.
Amata arimo amoko menshi. harimo amata akomoka ku nyamaswa, ku bantu, amata ya soya, ay'utubuto duto twa almond, aya coconut n'andi ava mu bindi.
Amata y'inka nk'amwe mu akundwa na benshi, usanga nayo anyobwa mu buryo butandukanye. Hari anyobwa arimo ibinure bike, anyobwa atarimo ibinure (fat-free milk), ikivuguto, n'andi.
Intungamubiri ziba mu mata.
Amata abamo intungamubiri nyinshi, harimo:
Akamaro k'amata ku buzima.
Amata afitiye umubiri w'umuntu akamaro kanini, twavugamo nk'ibinure bigize amata, ibi ni ingenzi cyane kuko bituma umubiti ugira imbaraga ukaba wabasha gukora imisemburo yo kuwurinda ibishobora kuwangiza, ndetse bikanawurinda ubukonje.
Ibinure kandi hari vitamine zibikenera kugira ngo zibashe gukora neza mu mubiri akamaro kazo.
Proteyine ziboneka mu mata, ni kimwe mu bifasha umubiri w'umuntu gusana ahangiritse, kongera ubudahangarwa by'umubiri, gukomeza imikaya n'amagufwa, ndetse n'indi mikorere myiza y'umubiri.
Izi vitamin n'izindi ntungamubiri ziba mu mata zigira akamaro gatandukanye tutarondora. Kamwe muriko ni:
Vitamin A iba mu mata, ituma amata agira akamaro cyane mu gukomeza amenyo, gukomeza imikaya y'amaso, kurwanya indwara y'amaso yo kutabona neza nijoro, kugira uruhu rwiza n'ibindi.
Umuganga w'umuhanga mu kuvura amagufwa, Frorence Piquet, atanga inama yo kwihata cyane ibikomoka ku mata kuko bikungahaye ku myunyungugu (calcium) ituma amagufwa akomera kandi bikanayarinda korohera no kumungwa ngo abe yavunika uko umuntu agenda akura.
Vitamin B1 igira akamaro cyane mu kurinda indwara y'imitsi, ifasha mu mikorere y'umutima n'imitsi y'amaraso, ituma umubiri ugira ingufu, ni vitamine zirinda ubusaza, kurinda amaso kurwara ishaza, ifasha mu mikorere myiza y'uruhu, amaso, imisatsi, umunwa ndetse n'umwijima. iyi vitamine kandi inafasha umubiri guhangana na stress.
Vitamin B2 irinda uburwayi bwo kubura amaraso (anemia) kuko ifasha umubiri kwinjiza ubutare.
Vitamin B3 ifasha umutima gukora neza ikanagabanya choresterol mbi mu mubiri
Vitamin B5 ifasha mu gukora uturemangingo dufasha mu guhanahana amakuru ku bwonko, ituma umutima ukora neza, ikanakomeza amagufwa. Iyi vitamin kandi ituma inda ibyara (uterus) ikura neza
Vitamin D ifasha mu kuringaniza umuvuduko w'amaraso, ituma umutima ukora neza, ifasha mu kurinda indwara zituma umubiri wirwanya (autoimmune diseases) ndetse inafasha umubiri kwinjiza kalisiyumu no kuringaniza imyunyungugu mu mubiri
Abahanga bahamya ko bitewe n'uko amwe mu mafunguro cyangwa ibiribwa abantu bafata biba byuzuyemo aside (acid) bigira uruhare mu gukura imyunyungugu mu magufwa bityo akaba yakwangirika byoroshye. Banavuga kandi ko kurya umunyu mwinshi nabyo biri mu byangiza amagufwa.
Kunywa amata rero n'ibiyakomokaho ni kimwe mu bisubizo bituma amagufwa atangirika. ikindi harimo no kurya nk'imboga za epinari, kwirinda kurya umunyu mwinshi cyane cyane uwakorewe mu nganda, ndetse ukanakora imyitozo ngororamubiri. ibi byose birinda amagufwa kwangirika no koroha.

Gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge byongera imbaraga (gukoresha imiti yongeri imbaraga muri siporo) birabujijwe mu mikino ya siporo. Abakinnyi bagaragaye ko bakoresheje ibiyobyabwenge nk'ibyo bibujijwe, byaba binyuze mu isuzuma ry'ibiyobyabwenge, sisitemu ya pasiporo y'ibinyabuzima, iperereza cyangwa kwemererwa mu ruhame, bashobora guhagarikwa mu irushanwa igihe kirekire. Ku byerekeranye n'ibiyobyabwenge byagaragaye ko Ibiyobyabwenge n’ibisindisha bikoreshwa mu buryo butandukanye no ku mpamvu zitandukanye mu bihugu byinshi byo ku isi. N’ubwo ahenshi mu bihugu, ibinyobwa birimo arukoru/imisemburo isindisha (alcool) byemewe n’mategeko, ibyo ntibibujije ko bigira ingaruka ku buzima kubera uburozi buba bubirimo. Iyo umuntu anyoye ibinyobwa birimo arukoru buri munsi, agera aho akaba umugaragu wabyo bikanamwokama agahora ashaka kubifata. Bimwe mu bibazo biterwa n’ibiyobyabwenge/ibisindisha harimo ibibazo bijyanye n’imyitwarire, ibibazo by’ubuzima bigaragara inyuma ku mubiri, ibibazo by’ uburwayi, imitekerereze idahwitse ibi bikaba ari bimwe mu bigaragaza bigaragaza uburemere bw'icyaha. Abakinnyi bagaragaye ko bafite ibiyobyabwenge mu mubiri bibujijwe, cyangwa byangiza cyangwa banze gupimwa ibiyobyabwenge nabo bashobora guhagarikwa muri uyu mukino. guhagarikwa mu irushanwa ashobora kandi guhabwa abakinnyi bagaragaye ko bafite ibiyobyabwenge bibujijwe cyangwa imiti itera imbaraga idafite ingaruka nyinshi ku barushanwa mu mikino. Urwego rwa siporo rushinzwe kugena ibiyobyabwenge bibujijwe muri siporo ni Ikigo Mpuzamahanga Gishinzwe Kurwanya Ibiyobyabwenge (WADA).
Ubusanzwe, umukinnyi wese upimwe ibiyobyabwenge bibujijwe nyuma yo kurangiza igihano cya mbere, acibwa burundu mu mukino wa siporo. Abantu benshi bazwi cyane bafatiwe ibihano byo gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bw'ibiyobyabwenge baturutse mu mukino wa siporo, hamwe n'imanza zikomeye zakozwe kuri Ben Johnson, Marion Jones na Tim Montgomery. Byongeye kandi, abakinnyi benshi bakorewe gahunda za leta zo gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana mu Budage bw'Iburasirazuba no mu Muryango w'Abasoviyeti hagati y'imyaka ya 1950 na 1980 bari abasiganwa mu mikino, ariko ireme ry'akazi mpuzamahanga ko kurwanya imiti yongerera umubiri imbaraga ryari ribi cyane ku buryo umukinnyi umwe gusa wo mu Budage bw'Iburasirazuba yagaragaye ko afite iyi ndwara. Nyuma y'ibirego byo gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bw'ibiyobyabwenge mu Burusiya, IAAF yahagaritse abakinnyi bo muri icyo gihugu mu marushanwa, harimo n'imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2016.

Tigers Basketball Club ni ikipe ikina umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Ifite icyicaro i Kigali. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2019, yinjira muri shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball y’u Rwanda (RBL) muri 2029.
Tigers Basketball Club yashinzwe na Francis Shyaka, uyu akaba na rwiyemezamirimo, kandi yahoze ari umukinnyi wa basketball. Umusaruro mwiza iyi kipe yagize ni umwanya wa 4 muri shampiyona ya 2021-2022 initabira imikino ya 1/2 muri iyi shampiyona. Mu Ukuboza 2024, iyi kipe yasinyishije umutoza watsinze inshura eshanu witwa Henry Mwinuka, nk'umutoza mukuru wayo mushya.
Ikipe ya Tigers yatwaye igikombe cyayo cya mbere mu mwaka wa 2025 ubwo yatwaraga igikombe Basketball cy'u Rwanda.
Kuva yashingwa, Tigers yakiniye mu bibuga byinshi byatanzwe na Rwanda Basketball League (RBL), ariko, ikipe ifite gahunda yo kubaka ikibuga cyayo mu gihe kizaza.

Rwanda Peace Cup yari izwi nka The Rwanda Cup ni cyo gikombe cya mbere cya shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda. Cyashinzwe gikorwa bwa mbere mu 1975, naho icya mbere cyegukanwa na Kiyovu Sports.
Irirushanwa rifunguye kumakipe yose yomu cyiciro cyambere n'icyakabiri mu Rwanda. Abatsinze bemerewe kujya mu gikombe cya CAF Confederation Cup nokujya muri FERWAFA Super Cup, umukino uzahuza amakipe yatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona y'u Rwanda mumwaka utaha. APR FC niyo kipe yatsinze cyane mugutwara ibikombe cumi na bitatu.

Gukirana ni umwe mu mikino gakondo y’Abanyarwanda yakundwaga cyane cyane n’abasore, aho wabafashaga gupima imbaraga z’umubiri, ubutwari n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana.Uyu mukino wari mu cyiciro cy’imikino njyarugamba, ifite uruhare rukomeye mu gutegura urubyiruko kuba abantu bafite ingufu n’umurava mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
Amateka n’aho umukino ukomoka.
Mu bihe bya kera, mbere y’uko imikino y’amahanga nk’umupira w’amaguru itangira gukwirakwira mu Rwanda hagati ya 1920 na 1930, imikino gakondo yari igize igice cy’ingenzi cy’imibereho y’Abanyarwanda. Icyakora, uko ubukoloni n’indi myidagaduro mishya byagiye byinjira, imwe muri iyo mikino yaragiye ihigikwa ndetse igera aho igenda yibagirana.
Igitabo “Imikino n’Intwaro Gakondo” cyamuritswe na Komite Olempike y’u Rwanda gifatanyije na Inteko Izirikana muri Nyakanga 2018, cyagaragaje ko imikino gakondo irimo gukirana ifite uruhare mu gusigasira umuco no kwimakaza indangagaciro zirimo ubutwari, ubufatanye n’ikinyabupfura.
Uko gukirana byakinwaga.
Gukirana byakinwaga n’abantu babiri bafatana bagamije gutsindana umwe akagusha undi hasi mu buryo bwubahiriza amabwiriza gakondo. Byasabaga:
Abasore bakuraga bamenyereye uyu mukino bakabonwa nk’abiteguye inshingano zikomeye mu muryango no mu gihugu.
Akamaro ko gukirana mu burezi n’imibereho.
Nk’uko indi mikino gakondo yar'ifite icyo itoza, gukirana byafashaga:
Byongeraga kandi icyubahiro ku musore watsindaga mu marushanwa, bikamugira icyitegererezo mu bandi.

ikipe ya bugesera ya bagore bakina volleyball yatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona 25/26 kunshuro yabo ya karindwi istinze musanze svb iyistinze amaseti 3 kuri 1 byatumye igumya iyoboye muri women sitting volleyball.

Igikombe cy'isi cy'umupira w'amaguru ni irushanwa ritegurwa n'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry'umupira w'amaguru (FIFA), rikaba buri gihe nyuma y'imyaka ine, rikabera mu gihugu cyateganyijwe, rikitabirwa n'ibihugu biba byaratsinze imikino y'amajonjora, bihatanira kwitabira iryo rushanwa.

Urukiramende ni umukino gakondo w’u Rwanda rwo hambere wari wubashywe kandi ukunzwe n’ingeri zose z’abanyarwanda. Uyu mukino ushize mu cyiciro cy’imikino yo gusimbuka, aho umukinnyi asabwa gusimbuka akarenga umugozi cyangwa igiti kigenda kizamurwa hashingiwe ku bipimo bya metero.
Amateka y’u Rwanda agaragaza ko uyu mukino wari ufite intego yo kwerekana imbaraga, ubushongore, n’ubuhanga bw’abasore b’intarumikwa. Mu mwaka wa 1907, mu Mujyi wa Nyanza, hagaragaye amafoto yafashwe n’umuhanga mu by’imibereho ya muntu (anthropologist) w’Umunyapolonye, Jan Czekanowski, yerekana abasore b’Abanyarwanda basimbuka urukiramende rurerure cyane.
Iyo foto yaje kumurikirwa i Berlin mu Budage mu mwaka wa 1909 mu rugendoshuri rwateguwe n’itsinda rya "Deutsche Zentral-Afrika-Expedition". Amakuru akubiye muri ayo mateka agaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bashoboraga gusimbuka urukiramende ruri ku burebure bwa metero 2.50, ibintu byafatwaga nko kurenga imiterere isanzwe y'umuntu.

UMUKINO WA GOLF MU Rwanda
mu Rwanda rw' imisozi igihumbi mubibaya bitatse ibyiza uhasanga icyanya cya hariwe umukino uzwi kwizina rya"GOLF" aho nahandi ni Kigali Golf Resort &amp; Villas. aho bagusanganiza ururwiro n'akanyamuneza bakwakirana urugwiro, murakaza neza mu mukino wa Golf mu rwanda ukndwa nabeshi ariko ugasaba agatubutse ugakinwa nabifite bo mubiciro bitandukanye haba abo mu Rwanda cyangwa mumahanga
umukino wa golf watangiye ahagana muri 2005 mu akarere ka Gasabo umurenge wa Nyarutarama aho watangiranye nabari bifite muri icyo gihe bakazarya batumira abaturanyi mu bindi bihugu bakaza gukina umukino uryenda ukura kuryeraho bagiye bagura ikibuga banongeramo ibicyenewe kugirango habashe kuzarya hakira abantu beshi baje gukina Golf.
Umukino wa Golf ni umwe mu mikino idakunze gukinwa na buri wese cyane ko ugaragara nk’ukinwa n’abakuze ndetse n’abifite. Gusa ni umwe mu ishingirwaho ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda bushingiye kuri siporo.
Kubera iyo mpamvu, u Rwanda ni kimwe mu bihugu biri kwihutisha iterambere rya siporo rudasize inyuma umukino wa Golf, usa n’aho wamaze kwigarurirwa n’abafite amikoro ari hejuru.
Kugeza mu 1997 hongeweho indi myobo iba 18, ariko iyo na yo ntabwo yari yuzuye neza kuko ntiyari ikoze ku rwego nk’urwo iriho ubu rushobora kwakira amarushanwa ayo ari yo yose ku Isi nk’uko byagenze mu gihe cyashize twakira Sunshine Tour. Ubu na PGA Tour twayakira.
Sunshine Tour ni irushanwa ryo muri Afurika y’Epfo riri ku rwego rw’Isi. Rijya ritumirwamo ba Tiger Woods, ba Rory McIlroy n’abandi bose. Muri uyu mwaka twarayakiriye ariko hari na European Tour ishobora kubera aha, na PGA Tour yahabera.
Ni amarushanwa nyine afite ibigwi ku rwego rw’Isi. Iryo twagiraga rikomeye ni Rwanda Open ryatumirwagamo ibyo bihugu byose. Nubwo baza gukina ariko biba byatewe n’amafaranga y’ibihembo yashyizweho.
Bo bareba amafaranga ariho. Kugira ngo utumire nka Tiger Woods aze gukina hano, bisaba amafaranga. Iki kibuga rero kiri ku rwego rwiza kandi rukomeye rwakwakira ayo marushanwa yose.

Kepler College Volleyball Club
Kepler College Volleyball Club ni ikipe ikomeye ifite ikicaro mu Rwanda ikinyinya, izwiho gukina mu cyiciro cya mbere (Serie A) mu bagabo n'abagore, ikaba yarigaragaje nk'imwe mu makipe mashya afite intego zikomeye nyuma yo gufata umwanya wa kabiri muri shampiyona y'abagabo ya 2023/24. Ikipe igizwe n'abakinnyi b'abanyeshuri ba Kepler College n'abandi b'inzobere, baharanira gukina bafatanyije n'uburezi kandi Iyi kipe ikina amarushanwa akomeye nka FRVB League ndetse n'amarushanwa yo kwibuka (Memorial Tournaments). Thierry Manzi (wavutse ku ya 12 Nyakanga 1996) Akaba afite uburebure bwa metero imwe na mirongwinani na gatanu(1,85m) n' umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukina nk'umwunganizi mwikipe ya Al Ahli Tripoli yo muri Libiya ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
