Oumar Sidibé (wavutse 25 Werurwe 1990) n'umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wa Mali ukina nk'umukinnyi wohagati mukibuga mwikipe ya Rayon Sports yomu Rwanda.
Sidibé yatangiyumupira wemuri Mali mwikipe ya Real Bamako na Stade Malien. Yerekeje muri Sudan mwikipe ya Al-Hilal Club mu 2013. Mu 2016, yerekeje muri DR Congo mu ikipe ya AS Vita Club, hanyuma akomereza aho muri Turukiya mu ikipe ya Hatayspor. Ku ya 5 Kanama 2019, yerekeje mwikipe yomu Rwanda ya Rayon Sports.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Sidibé yagaragaye arikumwe n'ikipe y'igihugu cya Mali mu mukino wagicuti batsinzemo Guinée Equatorial 3-0 ku ya 24 Mata 2009.

Laudit Mavugo (wavutse kuya 10 Ukwakira 1993) yari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umurundi. Yarumwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu y'Uburundi.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'Uburundi ku isonga."

Addax SC yahoze ari Rugende FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu marushanwa y'icyiciro cya kabiri muri shampiyona itegurwa na Ferwafa, ikaba ari ikipe y'umushoramari Mvukiyehe Juvenal.
Addax sc ikinira ku kibuga cy'i Rugende i kabuga Juvenal yahoze ari umuyobozi wa Kiyovu sport.

Motar FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda,yashinzwe kandi inakinamo abakora umwuga wo gutwara abantu kuri za Moto, ibarizwa mu marushanwa y'icyiciro cya kabiri muri shampiyona itegurwa na Ferwafa Ni ikipe itozwa na Uwimana Abdul uzwi nka Gakara wahoze akina muri Rayon Sports. Perezida w’ikipe ya Motar FC akaba ari Habiryayo Aloys Patrick.
Motar FC ifite ikipe ya Karate y’abamotari yitwa WUSHU, ikorera kuri Club Rafiki, hari ikipe y’abagore, ikindi ni hari ikipe izajya ikina imikino yo gusiganwa kuri Moto. bafite icyiciro cy’abana bato, icyiciro cy’abakanyujijeho ndetse n’icyiciro cy’abakinnyi bakina mu cyiciro cya gatatu cya shampiyona y’ u Rwanda.

City Boys FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda ikaba ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'ashampiyona y'umupira wa maguru. Ikina igikombe cy'amahoro mu Rwanda yakinnye na Rayon sport. City Boys FC ikaba ari umuvandimwe wa Gorilla FC kuko zose zashizwe na Mudaheranwa Hagdi.

Unity SC (Unity Sport Club) ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda. Unity ibarizwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri cyiciro cya kabiri cy'ashampiyona y'umupira wa maguru ategurwa na Ferwafa. Unity ikaba iyoborwa KNC, AKaba arinawe mu yobozi wa GAsogi United.

Miroplast FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda, yagaragaye mu Cyiciro cya Mbere cytwaga Azam Rwanda Premier League mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2017 kugeza 2018. ni ikipe ishingiye ku ruganda rwa Milonko. Miroplast FC ubwo yakina muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cy'ambere mu Rwanda ya tewe mpaga ndetse igatsirwa ibitego byoroshye.
Moroplast FC ikaba ifite igikombe ya rwaye cy'abatarengeje imwaka 18, mu irushanwa rya Sebamed Tournament muri 2015.

Ejoheza FC cyangwa Ejoheza football Academy (Ejoheza WFC/Academy) ni ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru y’abagore ategurwa na FERWAFA, ndetse na marushanwa y'abatarengeje imyaka 17/20. ikinira Murenge wa bugarama mu Karere ka Rusizi. Ejo heza FA ibarizwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya shampiyona mu Rwanda.

Vision Jeunesse Nouvelle FC ni ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda ikaba ari ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'ashampiyona y'umupira wa maguru. Vision Jeunesse Nouvelle FC ikaba itegamiye kuri leta cyangwa ari umuryango udaharanira inyungu washinzwe mu mwaka wa 2002.

Vision FC ni ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda, yakinaga mu mu Cyiciro cya Mbere muri shampiyona ya 2024, yakirira amakipe mu rugo ku kibuga cya Mumena, mu muyi wa Kigali.
Abakinnyi bayizamukiyemo.
Vision FC yakinnyemo abakinnyi batandukanye nka Karema Eric, Ishimwe Christian, Byiringiro Lague, Nizeyimana Djuma n'abandi

Aspor FC ni ikipe ikinira umukira w'amaguru ku kibuga cya Rugenda mu karere ka Gasabo, ikaba ibarizwa mu cyiciro cy'akabiri cya shampiyona yu Rwanda muri Ferwafa. ikaba ari ikipe ya kinnyemo abakinnyi nka Imanishimwe Emmanuel Mangwende.

Esperance FC ni ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ibarizwa mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ikinira ku kibuga cya Kimisagara ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya shampiyona mu Rwanda muri Ferwafa. Esperance de Kigali ikaba ari kipe ikoresha siporo mu guteza imbere amahoro n'uburinganire.

Sina Gerard FC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ibarizwa mu Rwanda ikaba ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'ashampiyona y'umupira wa maguru mu Rwanda.
Sina Gerard FC ikaba ifite amakipe atandukanye, hari amakipe y'abagabo ndetse hakaba hari n'amakipe n'abagore.
Sina Gerard fc Ikaba yaratwaye igikombe cy'icyiciro cya Gatatu cy'amarushanwa y'umupira wa maguru mu Rwanda ndetse n'ibindi bihembo itsinze Motar FC.

Siporo ifite uruhare runini mu Rwanda, cyane cyane murwego rw'abaturage, aho umupira w'amaguru ari ikintu gikunzwe cyane kandi abana bakinira muburyo butunguranye mu midugudu, mu mijyi no mu mashuri. Siporo kandi ishyigikiwe na Politiki ya leta yoguteza imbere siporo yomu Ukwakira 2012. Ibi bivuga ko siporo ifite inyungu nyinshi, harimo guhuza abantu, kunoza ishema ry'igihugu nbumwe, nokunoza ubuzima. Iyi politiki igaragaza imbogamizi mw'iterambere rya siporo mu gihugu, harimo ibikorwa remezo bike nubushobozi buke bw'amafaranga. Ishyiraho "intego itera imbaraga" ko, muri 2020, u Rwanda rugomba kugira "ijanisha ryinshi ry'abaturage bakina siporo kurusha mu kindi gihugu icyo ari cyo cyose cya Afurika" kandi rukaza mubihugu bitatu bya mbere bya Afurika mu mikino ya basketball, volleyball, gusiganwa kumagare, siporo n'imikino ya Paralempike, hamwe n'imikino icumi ya mbere mumupira w'amaguru. Igamije kandi "guteza imbere ukwitabira cyane kw'abantu mumikino gakondo". Dukurikije ubushakashatsi bwashyizwe ahagaragara nikigo cy'ubumenyi n'iterambere rya siporo cya Kaminuza ya Western Cape, siporo ikunzwe cyane mu Rwanda ni umupira w'amaguru, volleyball, basketball, siporo n'imikino ya Paralempike.
U Rwanda rwagaragaye bwambere mu mikino Olempike muwi 1984, ndetse rugaragara bwa mbere mu mikino Paralempike muri 2004. Iki gihugu cyohereje abakinnyi barindwi mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2012 yabereye i Londres, bayihagararira mumikino ngororamubiri, koga, gusiganwa ku magare yo mu misozi na judo, n'abandi 15 mu mikino Paralempike yo mu mpeshyi ya Londres kugira ngo bahatanire imikino ngororamubiri, guterura amashanyarazi na volleyball yo kwicara. U Rwanda rwitabiriye imikino ya Commonwealth ku nshuro yambere mu mikino ya 2010 yabereye i Delhi mu Buhinde, nyuma yokwinjira muri Commonwealth umwaka wabanjirije uwo. Abakinnyi 'u Rwanda bitabiriye imikino ngororamubiri, guterana iteramakofe, gusiganwa kumagare mumuhanda no koga. U Rwanda rwohereje abakinnyi mu mikino ya 2014 kugira ngo bahatanire imikino ngororamubiri, guterana iteramakofe, gusiganwa kumagare, koga no guterura ibiremereye. Ikipe yu Rwanda mu mikino y'urubyiruko ya Afurika ya 2014 yarifite umubare munini w'abakinnyi b'abagore (abakinnyi 29 muri 49 bose hamwe) kurusha abandi bakinnyi bose bitabiriye.
Basketball nimwe mumikino ikunzwe cyane mu Rwanda, ikaba ariya kabiri nyuma y’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru kandi ikaba ari yo mikino irebwa cyane mu gihugu. Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda ryabaye umunyamuryango wIshyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Basketball kuva muwi 1977. Mbere yomuri 2000, ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball mu Rwanda ntiyari izwi cyane hanze yigihugu, ariko kuva hagati mumyaka ya 2000 yakomeje kumenyekana ku rubyiniro rwa Afurika. Ikipe y’abagabo yamaze kwegukana itike yokugera mu cyiciro cyanyuma cya Shampiyona ya Basketball muri Afurika inshuro enye zikurikiranya kuva mu 2007. Igihugu cyasabye kwakira Shampiyona ya Basketball muri Afurika ya 2013, ariko uburenganzira bwo kwakira irushanwa bwahawe Ivory Coast.
AfroBasket 2021 yahawe Kigali. Kubutaka bwiwabo, u Rwanda rwatsinze Angola, wegukanye ibihembo 10 bya AfroBasket hagati yi 1989 na 2013. Alex Mpoyo womu Rwanda yagize ati:"Nibyiza kubona kakazi kacu ko guhagararira igihugu cyacu neza gashimwa cyane. Mu by'ukuri, sinabura gushimira bihagije abafana ibihumbi baje kudushyigikira, baririmba indirimbo zabo nimbyino zabo mumukino wose, ndetse nomu gihe twari inyuma. Inkunga yabo idashingiye kukiguzi yatubereye isoko ikomeye yinkunga."
Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda riyoborwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru mu Rwanda (FERWAFA), ryashinzwe muwi 1972 ryemererwa kwinjira muri FIFA muwi 1978. FERWAFA kandi ifitanye isano nishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru muri Afurika (CAF) n'Inama y'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba n'iyo Hagati (CECAFA). Ikipe y'igihugu yayo ya mbere yakinnye igikombe cya Afurika mwirushanwa ryo mu 2004. Ikipe yambere yu Rwanda yatwaye igikombe cya CECAFA muwi 1999, ubwo igihugu cyakiraga iri rushanwa. Igikombe cya CECAFA cy'Amakipe kizwi nka Kagame Interclub Cup kuva muri 2002, ubwo Perezida w'u Rwanda Kagame yatangiraga gutera inkunga iri rushanwa. Ikipe y'igihugu ntiragera kurutonde rw'abahatanira igikombe cy'isi. Irushanwa rikomeye ryumupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda ni ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda.
Volleyball yo ku mucanga.
U Rwanda rufite amakipe yigihugu ya Volleyball yoku mucanga yabagabo n'abagore. Muri Kamena 2021, umutoza mukuru wamakipe yombi yari Jean Paul Mana, wayoboye amahugurwa yabereye kumucanga wa Lake Kivu mu Karere ka Rubavu.
Mugikombe cyomuri 2018–2020 CAVB Beach Volleyball Continental Cup Rwanda yarihagarariwe namakipe abiri mugice cy’abagore aribo Charlotte Nzayisenga na Valentine Munezero, ndetse na Benitha Mukandayisenga na Seraphine Mukantabana. Abakinnyi bigitsina gabo ni Olivier Ntagengwa, Patrick Kavalo Akumuntu, Venuste G amas na Fils Habanzintwari.
Cricket yavuzwe karumwe mumikino ikura vuba mu Rwanda. Uyu mukino watangiye gukundwa cyane mugihugu ubwo impunzi zagarukaga ziva muri Kenya, ahozari zarize gukina uyu mukino. Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Cricket mu Rwanda (RCA) ryashinzwe mu 1999 kandi ryemerwa n’Inama Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket muri 2003. Iterambere ryuyu mukino mu gihugu ryatewe inkunga numuryango wabagiraneza ukorera mu Bwongereza witwa Cricket Without Boundaries, ugamije kunoza ubukangurambaga ku cyorezo cya SIDA binyuze mu mukino, ndetse n’umuryango wa Marylebone Cricket Club Foundation. Uyumukino utera inkunga umushinga wo kubaka ikibuga cy’igihugu cya Cricket mu nkengero za Kigali. Ubunyamuryango bw’u Rwanda muri Commonwealth bwashimiwe kuba bwarafashije gukurura umukino wa Cricket mu gihugu, aho abagabo nabagore bawukina mubigo by’imfubyi, amashuri, zakaminuza n’amakipe ya Cricket.
Gusiganwa ku magare byakunze gufatwa nk'uburyo bwogutwara abantu mu Rwanda, ariko mu minsi ishize habayeho iterambere mu mikino yo gusiganwa ku magare mu gihugu. Umukinnyi w'amagare yo mu misozi akaba numukinnyi w'amagare wo mu muhanda Adrien Niyonshuti yabaye Umunyarwanda wambere wasinye amasezerano y'umwuga nikipe mpuzamahanga y'amagare, yinjiye muri MTN Qhubeka mu 2009. Ikipe y'igihugu y'amagare, Team Rwanda, yashinzwe muri 2007 n'Abanyamerika Jock Boyer, wahoze ari umukinnyi wamagare w'umwuga, na Tom Ritchey, rwiyemezamirimo wamagare. Ikipe ya Rwanda yanditswe mugitabo, "Land of Second Chances: The Impossible Rise of Rwanda's Cycling Team" na filime, "Rising from Ashes". Irushanwa rya Tour of Rwanda ryabaye bwambere muwi 1988. Mbere ya 2009, ryitabiriwe cyane cyane n'abanyamagare bomu gihugu n'abaturutse mubihugu by'abaturanyi, ariko mu mpera za 2008 ryemejwe na Union Cycliste Internationale kandi kuva muri 2009 ryashyizwe mw' irushanwa rya UCI Africa Tour.
Shampiyona y'Isi ya UCI Road ryabereye murii Kigali muri Nzeri 2025.
Uruhare rwa siporo mu mibereho myiza.
Siporo ifatwa nabamwe nk'uburyo bwo kugera kubwiyunge nyuma yamakimbirane mu Rwanda, kandi imiryango myinshi igira uruhare mugukoresha siporo muguteza imbere ubwiyunge. Politiki y'iterambere rya siporo y'igihugu irimo muntego zayo guteza imbere "ikoreshwa rya siporo nk'inzira ikomeye y'iterambere no kubaka amahoro", kandi guverinoma yiyemeje guteza imbere ikoreshwa rya siporo muzindi ntego zitandukanye z'iterambere, harimo n'uburezi.

Sadio Mané (wavutse kwi 10 Mata 1992) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga womuri Senegali ukina nkumukinnyi wo ku ruhande rw'ibumoso mwikipe ya Al-Nassr yo muri Saudi Pro League n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Senegali. Afatwa cyane nkumwe mubakinnyi beza bomu gihecye ndetse n'umwe mubakinnyi bakomeye b'Abanyafurika bibihe byose. [a]
Mané yatangiye umwuga wemu ikipe ya Metz yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu mikino ya Ligue 2 afite imyaka 19, ariko yaje kuvamo nyuma yumwaka umwe ajya mwikipe ya Red Bull Salzburg yomuri Otirishiya muri 2012 kugiciro cya €4. miliyoni, atsindira igikombe cya shampiyona n'igikombe cy'imbere mu gihugu mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2013-14. Nyuma yiyo mpeshyi, Mané yerekeje mu ikipe yomu Bwongereza ya Southampton ku giciro cyanyuma cy'ikipe kingana na £11.8. miliyoni. Aho niho yashyizeho agahigo gashya ka Premier League ko gutsinda ibitego bitatu kunshuro ya mbere, yatsinze mumasegonda 176 ubwo batsindaga Aston Villa ibitego 6-1 muri 2015.
Mané yasinye amasezerano nikipe ya Liverpool muri 2016, ku giciro cya miliyoni 34 z'amapawundi, bimugira umukinnyi uhenze cyane muri Afurika mumateka icyogihe. Nyuma yo gukora abakinnyi batatu bakomeye bateye hamwe na Mohamed Salah na Roberto Firmino nyuma yokugenda kwa Philippe Coutinho, yafashije ikipe kugera kumikino yanyuma ya UEFA Champions League yikurikiranya muri 2018 na 2019, ayitsindira iyi ya nyuma. Yanarangije ari umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona ya 2018-19, atwara igikombe cya zahabu cya Premier League. Mané yaje gufasha Liverpool kurangiza imyaka 30 yo guhatanira igikombe cya shampiyona yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona cya 2019-20. MuUkwakira 2021, yatsinze igitego cye cya 100 cya Premier League, abumnyafurika wa gatatu ugeze kuruyu mwanya. Mané yarangije ari uwa kane nuwa kabiri mwirushanwa rya Ballon d'Or rya 2019 na 2022 ; naho muri FIFA Men's Player mwiza cyane yageze ku mwanya wa gatanu mu 2019 n'uwa kane mu 2020.
Kurwego mpuzamahanga, Mané amaze gutsinda ibitego 53 mu mikino 126 yakinnye muri Senegal kuva yatangira gukina muri 2012, kandi ubura mu bakinnyi batsinze ibitego byinshi mu gihugu cye, akaba n'uwa kabiri mu mikino yose. Yahagarariye Senegal mu mikino Olempike ya 2012, ndetse nomu mikino ya 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023 na 2025 y'igikombe cya Afurika. Mu irushanwa ryomuri 2019, Mané yafashije Senegal kurangiza ariya kabiri, maze nyuma y'umwaka umwe, agirwa umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umwaka muri Afurika. Ku mukino wa nyuma wa 2021, Mané yatsinze igitego cy'intsinzi mugutera penaliti byatumye Senegal iba umukinnyi wa mbere w'igikombe cy' Afurika, ndetse anagirwa umukinnyi w'irushanwa. Muri 2022, yambitswe ikamba ry'umukinnyi w'umwaka muri Afurika kunshuro yakabiri. Mané yanahagarariye igihugu cye mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2018, ubwo yakinnye bwakabiri muriri rushanwa. Nyuma Mané yayoboye Senegali mu gikombe cyayo cyakabiri cya AFCON mu 2025, yongera kugirwa umukinnyi mwiza w'irushanwa.
Mané yavukiye mumuryango w’aba Guineya i Bambali, Sédhiou, muri Senegali. Yakuriye mu muryango w’abanyamadini. Yifuzaga umwuga mumupira wamaguru, arikose (wari imamu) yamubujije gukina uwomukino akiri umwana. Se yashakaga kashyira imbere amasomo ye yidini, icyakora, se yapfuye afite imyaka irindwi. Afite imyaka 15, yahunze umudugudu w’iwabo abifashijwemo n’inshuti ye yomu bwana, Luc Djiboune, ajya i Dakar gukurikirana intego yeyo kuba umukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru; kuvicyogihe yashyigikiwe numuryango wekugira ngagere ku bushobozi bwe.
Muri 2009, ubwo yakinaga muri M'Bour, yabonwe nabashinzwe umutekano maze nyuma yerekeza kuri Génération Foot, ikipe yafashije kuzamuka mucyiciro cyakabiri mumwaka wa 2010-11.
Muri 2011, Mané yinjiye muri Metz yagiranye ubufatanye na Génération Foot. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere kuri 14 Mutarama 2012, aza gusimbura Kévin Diaz kumunota wa 75 mu mukino batsinzwe na Bastia murugo 0-1 muri Ligue 2. Yakinnye imikino 19 mu mwaka we wa mbere wa shampiyona, 12 arumukinnyi ubanza, anatsinda igitego kimwe mumukino batsinzwe na Guingamp 2-5 kuri Stade Saint-Symphorien kuri 4 Gicurasi. Metz yamanuwe muri Championnat National mu mpera z'uyu mwaka wa shampiyona.
Metz yashyizeho igiciro cyifuzwa cya €2 miliyoni kuri Mané, kandi yakuruye abantu benshi, harimo numuyobozi wa siporo wa Red Bull Salzburg yo muri Otirishiya, Ralf Rangnick. Nyuma yo guhabwa poromosiyo nyinshi mumpeshyi, Metz yongereye igiciro cyayo cyogusaba kigera kuri €4. miliyoni, maze yimukira i Salzburg kuri 31 Kanama 2012, amafaranga yagatatu menshi Metz yari yarahawe yokugura abakinnyi.
Yatsinze ibitego bitatu (hat-trick) byebya mbere mwikipe kuri 31 Ukwakira, ubwo batsindaga SC Kalsdorf ibitego 3-1 mumukino wagatatu w'igikombe cya Austrian Cup.
Kuri 27 Ukwakira 2013, yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere cya hat-trick muri Bundesliga yomuri Otirishiya, ubwo batsindaga Grödig ibitego 3-0 mu kibuga. Yatsinze ikindi gitego cyagatatu ku ya 7 Gicurasi 2014 ubwo Salzburg yatsindaga Horn ibitego 7-0 mumikino yakimwe cya kabiri cy'igikombe; shampiyona yarangiye ikipeye itsinze ibitego bibiri byomu gihugu. Mumpera za Kanama 2014, Mané yatumye avamuri iyi kipe, ataje mumyitozo ndetse nomu mukino ukomeye cyane kuri Salzburg icyogihe kugira ngoyegukane igikombe cya Champions League.
Igihembwe cya 2014–15.
Kw' itariki ya 1 Nzeri 2014, Mané yerekeje mw' ikipe ya Southampton yo mu cyiciro cya mbere ku giciro cya £11.8. miliyoni, asinya amasezerano y'imyaka ine. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere nyuma y'iminsi 22 mumukino batsinze Arsenal 2-1 mu gikombe cya League, atsinda igitego cya mbere cya Southampton. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere muri shampiyona mumukino wongeye gutsinda Queens Park Rangers 2-1 ku ya 27 Nzeri, atangira anafasha Ryan Bertrand gutsinda igitego cya mbere mu mukino. Yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere muriyi kipe mumukino batsinze Sunderland 8-0 kuri 18 Ukwakira, nubwo iki gitego cyaje kwitwa igitego cya Patrick van Aanholt. Ariko, yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere mumukino wewakurikiyeho, batsinze Stoke City 1-0 nyuma y'icyumweru kimwe.
Mu Ukuboza na Mutarama yatsinze ibitego mumikino itatu yikurikiranya, ubwo yakinaga na Crystal Palace, Chelsea na Arsenal. Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu mpera z'ikiruhuko mu mukino wa shampiyona wa Queens Park Rangers yatsinzemo 1-0 ku ya 7 Gashyantare 2015 ndetse nomu rugo yatsinzemo Crystal Palace kuya 3 Werurwe. Ariko, Mané yari yakuwe mu bakinnyi bambere ba Southampton ubwo batsindwaga na Liverpool 0-2 murugo kuri 22 Gashyantare nk'igihano cyogutinda kugera kukibuga.
Kw' itariki ya 16 Gicurasi, ubwo Southampton yakinaga umukino wanyuma murugo muruyu mwaka w'imikino, Mané yatsinze ibitego bitatu muminota 2 n'amasegonda 56 mumukino batsinzemo Aston Villa ibitego 6-1, bituma ashyiraho agahigo gashya muri Premier League ko gutsinda ibitego bitatu byihuse cyane. Aka gahigo kari gafitwe kuva muwi 1994 na Robbie Fowler, watsinze ibitego bitatu kuri Arsenal muminota 4 n'amasegonda 33. Mané yarangije shampiyona afite ibitego 10 mumikino 32 yakinnye mu marushanwa yose.
Igihembwe cya 2015–16.
Mané yatangiye umwaka w'imikino wa 2015-16 atsinda ibitego bibiri byatanze imipira mumukino wa gatatu wa UEFA Europa League, Vitesse Arnhem ari mu rugo, anatsinda igitego mu mukino wokwishyura, ubwo Southampton yageraga mucyiciro gikurikiraho ibitego 5-0. Kuya 2 Ukuboza, byamutwaye amasegonda 39 kugira ngafungure igitego ubwoyakinaga na Liverpool muri kimwe cyakane cyirushanwa rya League Cup, ariko Saints yaje gutsindwa ibitego 6-1 mu rugo.
Kuya 2 Mutarama 2016, yongeye gukurwa mubakinnyi babanzamo numutoza Ronald Koeman kumukino wabereye muri Norwich City ubwo yazaga akererewe munama mbere yumukino. Yahawe ikarita itukura kuri 12 Werurwe ubwo batsindaga Stoke City ibitego 2-1 kubera kugongana na Erik Pieters, nubwo ibibyahise bivanwaho mubujurire.
Nyuma yo kudatsinda igitego muri shampiyona mugihe cy'amezi arenga ane, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu ntsinzi ya Liverpool kubitego 3-2 ku ya 20 Werurwe 2016, akurikizaho ibitego bitanu mumikino itanu yakurikiyeho, harimo nigitego cya gatatu muntsinzi ya Manchester City ku bitego 4-2 kuya 1 Gicurasi. Yarangije shampiyona ari umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Southampton, afite ibitego 15 mumikino yose. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Igihembwe cya 2016–17.
Kw'itariki ya 28 Kamena 2016, Mané yinjiye muri Liverpool kugiciro cya £34 miliyoni (zishobora kwiyongera zikagera kuri 36£ miliyoni) kumasezerano yimyaka itanu. Amafaranga yokugura abakinnyi yamugize umukinnyi uhenze cyane muri Afurika mumateka icyo gihe. Kuri 14 Kanama, yakinnye umukino we wambere muri Premier League mw'ikipe ya Reds, atsinda igitego cya kane mumukino batsinzemo Arsenal 4-3 hanze. Nyuma yogutsindwa na Liverpool na Burnley kubera imvune yoroheje ku rutugu, Mané yagarutse mubakinnyi bambere bakinnye na Burton Albion mu gikombe cya League Cup ahoyatsinzemo ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinzemo ibitego 5-0.
Kw' itariki 19 Ukuboza, Mané yatsinze igitego kimwe rukumbi muri Merseyside derby ya 227 mu minota y'inyongera bakina na Everton kuri Goodison Park. Kw' itariki 11 Gashyantare 2017, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mu minota ibiri bakina na Tottenham Hotspur i Anfield, ibi bikaba byaratumye Liverpool itsinda shampiyona ya mbere muri 2017. Kwi'tariki 20 Mata 2017, Mané yatoranyijwe mu ikipe y'umwaka ya PFA nyuma yo gutsinda ibitego 13 muri shampiyona ye yambere muri Liverpool. Nubwo yatakaje igice cyanyuma cy'imikino kubera imvune, Mané yahawe igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umwaka wa Liverpool ku ya 9 Gicurasi 2017.
Igihembwe cya 2017–18.
Mu mukino wambere w'umwaka mushya, kuri 12 Kanama 2017, mukibuga cy'i Watford, Mané yatsinze igitego cya mbere cya Liverpool muri uyumwaka mumukino banganyije 3-3. Yagizwe umukinnyi w'ukwezi muri Premier League nyuma yogutsinda igitego kimwe muriburi mukino itatu ikipe ya Reds yakinnye muri Kanama. Kuya 9 Nzeri 2017, yahawe ikarita itukura mugice cya mbere cy'umukino batsinzwemo na Manchester City ibitego 5-0 kubera umupira mwinshi bakinanye na Ederson, bituma ahagarikwa imikino itatu. Mané, Mohamed Salah, Roberto Firmino na Philippe Coutinho bagize itsinda ry'abakinnyi bateye cyane bise "Fab Four" na "Fab Three" nyuma yokuva mumwaka w'imikino hagati.
Kuri 14 Gashyantare 2018, Mané yatsinze ibitego bitatu byambere mwikipe ya Liverpool ubwo yatsindaga Porto ibitego 5-0 mu mukino wa mberewa UEFA Champions League wo mu mwaka wa 2017-18. Mukubikora, yabaye umukinnyi wa kabiri gusa utsinze ibitego bitatu bya gatatu mw'ikipe y'i Burayi. Nyuma, atsinze igitego mu mukino batsinzemo AFC Bournemouth ibitego 3-0 ku ya 14 Mata, yarenze agahigo ka Demba Ba kogutsinda ibitego 43, aba umunyasenegali watsinze ibitego byinshi mumateka ya Premier League.
Kw' itariki ya 26 Gicurasi, ubwo bakinaga umukino wa nyuma wa UEFA Champions League na Real Madrid mu 2018, Mané yatsinze igitego cya Liverpool cyokunganya ubwo batsindwaga ibitego 3-1. Mukubikora, yabaye umukinnyi wambere wa Senegali utsinze igitego kumukino wa nyuma w'irushanwa. Igitego cye cyari icya 10 muri uyu mwaka w'imikino, aho Liverpool yabaye ikipe ya mbere mumateka ifite abakinnyi batatu batsinze ibitego 10+ mumwaka umwe w'imikino wa Champions League, aho Mané yageze kuntambwe ishimishije arikumwe na bagenzi be ba rutahizamu Salah na Firmino.
Igihembwe cya 2018–19.
Kuri 22 Ugushyingo 2018, Mané yasinye amasezerano mashya y'igihe kirekire na Liverpool. Ku ya 10 Werurwe 2019, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinzemo Burnley ibitego 4-2, icya kabiri kikaba cyari igitego cyecya 50 mwirushanwa muri Liverpool. Ibitego bye byamugize umukinnyi wa gatanu wa Liverpool utsinze ibitego mumikino itandatu yikurikiranya ya Premier League nyuma ya Michael Owen, Fernando Torres, Luis Suárez na Salah. Nyuma y'iminsi itatu, yatsinze ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinzemo Bayern Munich ibitego 3-1 kugira ngo afashe Liverpool kugera muri kimwe cyakane cya Champions League. Mukubikora, yabaye umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi hanze y'urugo mu irushanwa afite ibitego birindwi. Mu mukino wakurikiyeho wa Liverpool, yatsinze indi rekodi ya Ba, aba umukinnyi wa Senegali watsinze ibitego byinshi mu mwaka umwe w'imikino ya Premier League, nyuma yo gutsinda igitego cye cya 17 mumwaka w'imikino ubwo batsindaga Fulham ibitego 2-1. Kw' itariki ya 20 Mata, yari umwe mubakinnyi batandatu batoranyijwe mubahatanira igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umwaka wa PFA ari kumwe na mugenzi we Virgil van Dijk. Yanatoranyijwe mu ikipe y'umwaka ya PFA arikumwe na bagenzi beba Liverpool, Trent Alexander-Arnold, Andrew Robertson na Van Dijk.
Kumunsi wa nyuma w'imikino yomu gihugu, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinze Wolverhampton Wanderers ibitego 2-0. Ibitego bibiri yatsinze byatumye atsinda ibitego 22 muri uyumwaka, bituma asangira igihembo cya Golden Boot na Salah na Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang wa Arsenal. Kuya 1 Kamena, Mané yafashije Liverpool gutsinda penaliti hakiri kare ku mukino wa nyuma wa UEFA Champions League 2019 ubwo bakinaga na Tottenham, nyuma y'amasegonda 24 gusa umukino utangiye, nyuma y'uko umupira wewakubiswe ukuboko kwa Moussa Sissoko mugice cy'amahina; Salah yaje gukubita umupira awukuramo maze atangira gutsinda, maze Liverpool itsinda ibitego 2-0 maze yegukana igikombe.
Igihembwe cya 2019–20.
Kw' itariki 14 Kanama 2019, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri ku mukino wanyuma wa UEFA Super Cup 2019 bakinnye na Chelsea mumukino Liverpool yatsinzemo ibitego 5-4 kuri penaliti nyuma yuko umukino urangiye ari 2-2 nyuma y’iminota 120. Mané yagizwe umukinnyi w’umukinnyi mwiza kurusha abandi. Nyuma y’ukwezi kumwe gusa, yatsinze ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinzemo Newcastle United ibitego 3-1 ndetse yongera imikino 50 yakinnye Liverpool i Anfield, umukinnyi uwo ari wewese ukina kuri sitade runaka. Kunshuro yeya 100 akina muri Premier League akinira Liverpool ku ya 5 Ukwakira, Mané yatsinze igitego cyecya 50 muri shampiyona muriyi kipe ubwo batsindaga Leicester City ibitego 2-1.
Kw' itariki ya 21 Ukwakira, Mané yashyizwe kurutonde rw'abakinnyi 30 bazahatanira Ballon d'Or ya 2019. Kw' itariki ya 2 Ukuboza yarangije ari kumwanya wakanemu guhatanira igihembo, inyuma ya Lionel Messi, mugenzi we Virgil van Dijk wa Liverpool na Cristiano Ronaldo. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, yatsinze igitego kimwe anatanga izindi gitego ebyiri ubwo Liverpool yatsindaga Everton 5-2 muri Merseyside derby, bituma bongera imikino yabo 32 mumupira w'amaguru utaratsindwa, waragahigo gashya k'ikipe. Nyuma muriko kwezi, Liverpool yegukanye igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA Club cya 2019, Mané ashyiraho igitego cyatsinzwe na Firmino ku mukino wa nyuma bakinnye na Flamengo.
Kw'itariki ya 7 Mutarama 2020, Mané yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru w’umwaka muri Afurika muri CAF. Numunyasenegali wakabiri gusa (nyuma ya El Hadji Diouf) wegukanye ikigihembo.
Kuri 24 Gashyantare, Mané yatsinze igitego cy'intsinzi mumukino bakinnye na West Ham United ku bitego 3-2 mukibuga cya Premier League ubwo Liverpool yatsindaga imikino 21 mukibuga cyayo yikurikiranya, agahigo kashampiyona gasangiwe n'ikipe ya Liverpool ya Bill Shankly kuva muwi 1972, ndetse anagatsinda imikino 18 yikurikiranya mukibuga cya Premier League. Ku ya 7 Werurwe, Mané yatsinze igitego cy'intsinzi mumukino bakinnye na Bournemouth ku bitego 2-1 i Anfield ubwo Liverpool yashyiragaho agahigo gashya mu Bwongereza ko gutsinda imikino 22 yikurikiranya mukibuga cyayo. Liverpool yakomeje gutwara igikombe cya Premier League mumpera z'umwaka w'imikino.
Igihembwe cya 2020–21.
Kuri 20 Nzeri 2020, Mané yafunguye amanota yemuri Premier League ya 2020-21, atsinda ibitego byombi Liverpool yatsinze Chelsea ibitego 2-0. Kuya 2 Ukwakira 2020, Mané yagaragaye ko arwaye COVID-19. Bitewe nuko we na Liverpool bari bameze nabi, Mané yavuze ko 2020-21 ari wo mwaka mubi cyane mumwuga we. Ku ya 23 Gicurasi 2021, umunsi wanyuma wa shampiyona ya shampiyona, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri ubwo yatsindaga Crystal Palace ibitego 2-0, bituma Liverpool ibiya gatatu ndetse ikanatwara igikombe cya Champions League.
Igihembwe cya 2021–22.
Kuri 18 Nzeri 2021, Mané yatsinze igitego cyecya 100 cya Liverpool mumukino batsinzemo Crystal Palace mu rugo 3-0 muri Premier League. Igitego batsinzemo Crystal Palace cyanatumye Mané ashyiraho agahigo gashya ka Premier League aba umukinnyi wambere utsinze igitego mumikino icyenda yikurikiranya ya shampiyona bakina n'uwo bahanganye. Kuri 16 Ukwakira, Mané yatsinze igitego cye cya 100 cya Premier League — aba umunyafurika wa gatatu ugeze ku kimenyetso nyuma ya Didier Drogba na Salah — igitego cya mbere cya Liverpool mu mukino batsinzemo Watford 5-0. Kuya 10 Mata 2022, isabukuru yey'imyaka 30, Mané yatsinze igitego cya Liverpool cyo kunganya mumukino banganyamo 2-2 na Manchester City. Mané yakurikiyeho ibi atsinda ibitego bibiri kuri 16 Mata kuri sitade ya Wembley muri kimwe cya kabiri cya FA Cup, mumukino batsinzemo ibitego 3-2 byafashije Liverpool kugera kumukino wa nyuma wa FA Cup kuva muri 2012, amaherezo batsinze. Kuya 3 Gicurasi, yatsinze igitego cy’intsinzi mumukino batsinzemo Villarreal ibitego 3-2 hanze muri kimwe cyakabiri cya Champions League, bituma ikipe ye ikomeza gukina umukino wa nyuma, Liverpool yaje gutsindwa na Real Madrid igitego 1-0. Liverpool yabuze amahirwe yokugera kunshuro enye z’amateka, iba iyakabiri muri Premier League nomuri UEFA Champions League ya 2021-22 ariko itwara igikombe cya EFL na FA Cup.
Kuri 22 Kamena 2022, Mané yinjiye mwikipe ya Bundesliga Bayern Munich kumasezerano n'ikipe y'Ubudage kugeza kuri 30 Kamena 2025. Byatangajwe ko amafaranga yari afite ari miliyoni 32 z'amayero (miliyoni 27.4 z'amayero) ashobora kwiyongera akagera kuri miliyoni 41 z'amayero (miliyoni 35 z'amayero) bitewe n'uko yakinnye ndetse n'ibyo yagezeho kugiti cye nomu ikipe. Kuri 30 Nyakanga 2022, Mané yatangiye gukina umukino wewa mbere kumugaragaro, atangira muri DFL-Supercup ya 2022 maze atsinda igitego cyecya mbere afasha Bayern gutsinda RB Leipzig ibitego 5-3 kuri Red Bull Arena. Ibi yakurikiyeho nyuma y'icyumweru kimwe atsinda igitego cyecya mbere cya Bundesliga ubwo batsindaga Eintracht Frankfurt ibitego 6-1.
Kw' itariki 8 Ugushyingo, Mané yagize imvune maze biba ngombwa kava mukibuga nyuma y'iminota 20 Bayern itsinze Werder Bremen ibitego 6-1. Iyimvune yamubujije kwitabira igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2022, biba ngombwa kabagwa mu ijosi rye ry'iburyo. Yamaze amezi atatu adakina, agaruka kw' itariki ya 26 Gashyantare 2023 nk'umusimbura, aza gukina ku munota wa 65 asimbura Kingsley Coman ubwo Bayern yatsindaga Union Berlin ibitego 3-0.
Kuri 13 Mata, Mané yahagaritswe ndetse anacibwa amande na Bayern, nyuma y'amakuru yavugaga ko yakubise mugenzi we Leroy Sané mucyumba cy'uruganiriro nyuma yogutsindwa na Manchester City mugice cyakane cya Champions League ibitego 3-0. Kuri 28 Gicurasi, Bayern Munich yatwaye igikombe cya Bundesliga nyuma yoguhabwa amanota abiri nikipe ya mbere ya shampiyona Borussia Dortmund. ""
Kuya 1 Kanama 2023, ikipe ya Al Nassr yo muri Saudi Pro League yatangaje ko yasinyishije Mané. Mané yaje gutangaza ko abahoze bakinana muri Liverpool, Fabinho na Roberto Firmino, bari barigeze kuvugana nawe kugira ngo bamubwire kashobora kujya mumakipe yabo, Al-Ittihad na Al-Ahli muri Arabiya Sawudite. Mané yavuze kandi kuwahoze ari kapiteni we, Jordan Henderson, yari yamwoherereje ubutumwa bwiza ubwo yajyaga muri Arabiya Sawudite. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, yakinnye umukino wewa mbere asimbuye Abdulaziz Al-Aliwa mu gice cya mbere cy'umukino banganya na Zamalek 1-1 mu gikombe cya Arab Club Champions Cup cya 2023. Yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere muriyi kipe kuya 14 Kanama ubwo batsindwaga na Al-Ettifaq 2-1 muri shampiyona.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mané yari mu ikipe ya Senegal mu irushanwa Olempike ryo mu 2012, kandi yatangiye buri mukino ubwo banyuraga mu itsinda rya A nk'aba kabiri imbere y'Ubwongereza mbere yogutsindwa ibitego 4-2 nyuma y'iminota y'inyongera muri kimwe cyakane cyanyuma na Mexico yaje kuba umukinnyi wambere.
Mané yakuwe mu ikipe ya Senegali yitabiriye Igikombe cya Afurika cya 2015 nyuma y'imvune yagize mumukino ikipe ya Southampton yatsinzemo Arsenal ibitego 2-0 kuya 1 Mutarama 2015. Nyuma yaje kugaruka mwikipe, maze atangira imikino ibiri yanyuma mumatsinda bakina na Afurika y'Epfo na Algeria mu mukino basohowe mu matsinda.
Mané yahagarariye Senegal mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2017 cyabereye muri Gabon, anatsinda igitego mumikino ibiri yambere y'igihugu, atsinda Tunisia na Zimbabwe ibitego 2-0. Nyuma yo kunganya igitego kubusa mumukino wakimwe cya kane cyanyuma na Kameruni, yahushije penaliti mu mukino wahuje Senegal n'ikipe ye, aho Senegal yasezerewe mwirushanwa.
Muri Gicurasi 2018, Mané yashyizwe mwikipe ya Senegal yabakinnyi 23 bazitabira Igikombe cy’Isi cya FIFA cya 2018 mu Burusiya. Yatsinze igitego cyambere mumukino banganya n’Ubuyapani 2-2 mu cyiciro cy’amatsinda. Mané yatangiye imikino yose itatu ya Senegal mu matsinda ubwo yasezererwaga nyuma yicyiciro cyambere, arangiza arimunsi y’Ubuyapani ku manota y’umukino utaberanye.
Mané yongeye guhamagarwa mwikipe yanyuma ya Senegali izakina igikombe cya Afurika cya 2019. Yatsinze ibitego bibiri anahusha penaliti mumukino batsinzemo Kenya ibitego 3-0, ubwo Senegali yarangizaga kumwanya wakabiri mu matsinda ikanagera ku cyiciro cya 16. Mané yatsinze igitego kimwe rukumbi mumukino anahusha ikindi gitego mumukino Senegali yatsinzemo Uganda igitego 1-0 mucyiciro cya 16. Yakinnye imikino itatu yakurikiyeho ya Senegali ubwo yageraga ku mukino wa nyuma, itsindwa na Algeria igitego 1-0 mumukino wo kwisubiramo wa Senegali wambere w'irushanwa. Nubwo yarangije irushanwa aruwa kabiri, Mané yashyizwe mu ikipe y'irushanwa.
Mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2021, Mané yakinnye muri Senegal ubwo yatsindaga irushanwa ku nshuro yambere. Mu mukino wa nyuma yakinnye na Misiri - umukino wamuhuje namugenzi wewa Liverpool Mohamed Salah - Mané yabonye penaliti yigabanuka kumunota wa 7, ariko akomeza gutsinda igitego cyatsinze mugutera penaliti. Uretse gutsinda igitego cyambere cyatsinzwe kugira ngo yegukane igikombe, Mané yatsinze ibitego bitatu anatanga imipira ibiri mbere y'umukino wanyuma, ndetse atorwa nk'umukinnyi w'irushanwa. Mu cyiciro cya gatatu cy'imikino yo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya 2022, yanatsinze igitego cyatsinze mu gutera penaliti ubwo bakinaga na Misiri nyuma yokunganya igitego 1-1 ku mukino wose, kugira ngo igihugu cyekijye mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2022.
Kwitariki ya 4 Kamena 2022, Mané yatsinze ibitego bitatu mumukino batsinzemo Benin ibitego 3-1 mu mikino yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2023, maze abumukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Senegal n'ibitego 32, arusha Henri Camara.
Kw' itariki 11 Ugushyingo 2022, Mané yashyizwe mw' ikipe y’abakinnyi 26 ba Senegal bazitabira igikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cyabereye muri Qatar muri 2022, nubwo yagize imvune ubwo Bayern Munich yatsindaga Werder Bremen ibitego 6-1 muminsi mike mbere yaho. Ariko, kw'itariki 17 Ugushyingo, Mané yakuwe mw' irushanwa maze ava mw' ikipe.
Mané yakinnye umukino we wa 100 muri Senegal kuri 18 Ugushyingo muri 2023, atsinda ibitego bibiri mumukino wo guhatanira itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2026 ubwo bakinaga na Sudani y'Epfo.
Mu Ukuboza 2023, Mané yashyizwe mw' ikipe ya Senegali yitabiriye imikino y’igikombe cya Afurika cya 2023 yabereye muri Ivory Coast. Yasoje imikino y’amatsinda afite igitego kimwe kuri Kameruni ndetse anatanga imipira ivuyemo ibitego kuri Gambia na Guinée. Hanyuma yakinnye iminota 120 yose kuri Ivory Coast mucyiciro cya 16, afasha Habib Diallo gutsinda igitego cya Senegali. Nyuma y’uko umukino urangiye banganya 1-1 nyuma y’iminota yinyongera, Senegali yakuwemo nabakiriye imikino ndetse nabayitsinze mugutera penaliti.
Kw' itariki 14 Ukwakira 2025, Mané yatsinze ibitego bibiri mumukino batsinze Mauritania ibitego 4-0, bituma Senegali yemererwa kujyamu gikombe cy'isi cya 2026. Nyuma yuwo mwaka, yahamagawe mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2025.
Kuri 14 Mutarama 2026, igitego cya Mané cyatsinze Misiri 1-0 muri kimwe cyakabiri mu gikombe cya Afurika. Kuri 18 Mutarama, Senegali yabashije gutsinda igihugu cyakira Maroc 1-0 nyuma y'iminota y'inyongera ku mukino wa nyuma, Mané atwara igikombe nkumukapiteni w'igihugu cye ndetse anahabwa igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza mw' irushanwa.
Umwirondoro w'umukinnyi.
Fabinho wahoze akinira Liverpool yasobanuye Mané nk'umukinnyi wuzuye ukina "afite imbaraga nyinshi kandi yitonze". Jamie Carragher wahoze ari myugariro wa Liverpool yise Mané "umukinnyi woku ruhande rwisi", amugereranya numukinnyi nka John Barnes wahoze akinira Liverpool. Yanagereranyijwe na Cristiano Ronaldo nuwahoze ari myugariro wa Ajax Danny Blind, wamushimiye ubuhanga bwebwo gutsinda ibitego akoresheje amaguru nimitwe, hamwe no gukora "imipira itangaje".
Mané, umukinnyi ukina imbere mukibuga ufite ubushobozi bwo gutsinda ibitego byinshi, akaba afite umwihariko wokurangiza neza, kwihuta, ubuhanga, namayeri mugutwara ibitego, ndetse no gufata ibyemezo, kumenya gukoresha ubuhanga bwemu mikinire, guhanga udushya, ubuhanga, kuringaniza, kugenzura, gukora kumupira, nogukoresha imbaraga ze mu gukubita umupira. [Yanashimiwe mw' itangazamakuru kubera ubuhanga bwemu gukina, gutanga imipira, nokumenya kugera ku myanya myiza, ahashobora gutsinda ibitego cyangwa guha amahirwe bagenzi be. Azwiho kubumuntu utuje kandi ugira ubwoba, ubushobozi bwebwo guhangana n'igitutu nabwo bwagaragajwe nk'imwe mumbaraga ze zikomeye. Uretse ubuhanga bwebwo gusatira, tekiniki, noguhanga, abakinnyi bebakomeye mukazi ko kwirwanaho nabo bagaragaje ubuhanga bwe mumikinire, ndetse n'ubushobozi bwe mukirere, nubwo afite amanota. Mané ubusanzwe akina nk'umukinnyi woku ruhande rw'ibumoso, umwanya umwemerera gukata hagati nogutera izamu akoresheje ikirenge cye cy'iburyo gikomeye. Mu gihembwe cya 2021-22, ubwo yasinyishaga Luis Díaz, Mané yatangiye gukina cyane nkarutahizamu woagati kandi atera imbere muruwo mwanya. Mu 2022, Kyle Walker yavuze ko Mané arumwe mu bakinnyi bakomeye cyane yigeze guhura nabo mumwuga we.
Umuryango n'ubugiraneza.
Muri 2019, Mané yatanze £250.000 ($ 319,103 ; € 284,813) yokubaka ishuri mumujyi akomokamo wa Bambali, muri Senegali. Muri Werurwe 2020, Mané yatanze £41.000 ($ 52,564 ; € 46,083) kurikomite y'igihugu irwanya COVID-19 muri Senegali. Muri 2021, yatanze £500.000 ($ 684,932 ; € 561,987) mu kubaka ibitaro i Bambali. Byongeye kandi, yanatanze inkunga yokubaka sitasiyo ya lisansi n'ibiro by'iposita ku baturage bomu gace atuyemo, ahishuri mudasobwa zigendanwa na interineti kubuntu bivuye kuri serivisi ya interineti ya 4G yateye inkunga mu mudugudu. Muri rusange, yakoresheje arenga £700.000 ($ 958,904 ; € 786,782) muri izi nyubako. Byongeye kandi, yategetse buri muryango mugace atuyemo kagizwe n'abantu 2.000 guhabwa amafaranga y'inyongera kukwezi. Aya mafaranga angana n'umushahara w'ukwezi kumuturage wa Senegali ku mushahara muto.
Mané kandi ni intumwa ya Right To Play, umuryango mpuzamahanga udaharanira inyungu ufite intego yokongerera ubushobozi abana batishoboye. Yakoranye nuyu muryango udaharanira inyungu mugutanga uburinganire nokongerera ubushobozi abakobwa nabagore bato muri Senegali, "akamaro ko kumenya akamaro k'abakobwa n'abahungu ko kubona amahirwe yo gukina no kwiga".
Ubwo yari muri Liverpool, Mané yari atuye i Allerton, muri Liverpool, kandi yibwe inshuro ebyiri, rimwe mugushyingo 2017 naryo muri Gashyantare 2019. Ni umuyisilamu ukora akazi kandi rimwe narimwe agaragara akora du'a mbere yuko burimukino utangira.
Yagizwe Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Umuryango w’Intare w’Igihugu na Perezida wa Senegal Macky Sall nyuma yintsinzi yigihugu mugikombe cya Afurika cyo muri 2021.
Yashakanye na Aisha Tamba, umurusha imyaka 13, kuri 7 Mutarama 2024 binyuze mu mihango ya Isilamu. Ubwo bashyingiranwaga, yarafite imyaka 31 naho umugore wafite imyaka 18. Bivugwa kobari barahuye imyaka irenga ibiri mbere yaho.

Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda Icyiciro cya 2 nirushanwa rya kabiri rya Basketball mu bagabo mu Rwanda, nyuma ya Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL). Kuya 1 Ukuboza 2021, FERWABA yatangaje ishyirwaho ry'irushanwa rishya. Igihembwe cyambere cyatangiye kuya 1 Mata 2022, amakipe cumi n'atandatu agabanyijemo amatsinda atatu. Kugeza muri 2024, shampiyona ifite amakipe 24.
Abatwaye igikombe n'aba kabiri muri shampiyona bazamurwa mucyiciro cyakabiri cya Basketball muri Rwanda mumwaka w'imikino ukurikira.
Amakipe 24 akurikira agize ishami rya 2 muri shampiyona ya 2024.

William Luwagga Kamanyi (wavutse muwi 1942) yahoze arumukinnyi wa Uganda ukina umukino wogusimbuka kure, umukinnyi wa cricket, akaba n'umutoza wasiporo. Yahagarariye Uganda mu mikino yomuri 1962 y'Ubwongereza n'imikino ya Commonwealth ndetse n'imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1964, nyuma aza gutoza ikipe y'igihugu ya cricket yo muri Uganda.
Kamanyi yitabiriye King's College Budo. Mu irushanwa ry'abagabo ryo gusimbuka kure mumikino ya British Empire Games yo muri 1962 yabereye i Perth, muri Ositaraliya y'Uburengerazuba, yaje kumwanya wa cumi mubakinnyi cumi n'icyenda, asimbuka. Ibi byashyizeho agahigo k’igihugu cya Uganda mugihe cy’imyaka 14. Muri iryo rushanwa ryabereye i Tokyo mu mpeshyi yomuwi 1964, Kamanyi yanditswe nk’umuhatanira, ariko raporo ye yagaragazaga ko "atahari". Nyuma yokurangiza umwuga wewo gukina siporo, yahisemo kwibanda kuri cricket, ahagararira ikipe y’igihugu ya Uganda nk’umukinnyi w’umuhanga hagati ya 1971 na 1983.
Hagati yi 1998 na 2001, Kamanyi yabaye umutoza mukuru wikipe y'igihugu ya cricket ya Uganda. Muricyo gihe, yanatoje ikipe yigihugu y'abagore bari munsi y'imyaka 19 ya Uganda mu irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abari munsi y'imyaka 19 ryo mu 2001, kandi yagize uruhare mugushinga ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore. Muri Nyakanga 2007, Kamanyi yagizwe umuyobozi ushinzwe iterambere ry'ishyirahamwe ry'umukino wa cricket muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, asimbuye umunyakenya Tom Tikolo. Imwe mu nshingano ze za mbere muri uyumwanya kwari ukugenzura kwimura ibiro by'iterambere biva muri Nairobi, muri Kenya, bijya i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Yanakoranye bya hafi nikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda yarikiri nto, ayibera umutoza mwirushanwa ry'isi rya cricket muri Afurika ry'icyiciro cya gatatu rya 2009. Muri 2014, Kamanyi yahawe igihembo cy'ubuzima bwose cyatanzwe n'inama mpuzamahanga ya cricket.

Ishyirahamwe ry'abakina umupira wa Rugby mu Rwanda numukino muto ariko urimo gukura. Ikipe y'igihugu ubiri ku mwanya wa 95 n'isi yose ya Rugby
Urwego rushinzwe imiyoborere.
Siporo iyobowe na Fédération Rwandaise de Rugby.
U Rwanda rwahoze rukoronejwe n'Ububiligi, kandi umukino watangiye kugaragara aho ngaho.
Mugihe cy'ubukoloni, umupira wa Rugby womu Rwanda wari ufite umupira woroshye ariko uhoraho; icyakora, wagiye ugabanuka nyuma y'ubwigenge bw'u Rwanda, kandi amahano yomu ntambara yo mumyaka yowi 1990 yangije umukino cyane.
Ariko, imiryango y’ubutabazi yahageze nyuma y’iryo shyano yongeye gutangiza umukino, urimo kwitabwaho na benshi murubyiruko. Hari umuntu umwe wagize ati: "Mumyaka yanjye yose, ntarabona ishyaka n’icyifuzo cyo gukina rugby nkuko nabikoze mu Rwanda. Abahungu bafite ishyaka ryo kwiga byinshi mumukino uko bashoboye kose."
Ubu u Rwanda rufite ikipe y'igihugu ya rugby y'abagabo n'abagore.

Mbere yashampiyona yomuri 2004-2008...

Hamwe n'amakipe cumi n'atandatu gusa yanditswe, nta kumanuka mucyiciro cyakabiri, ariko hateganijwe gushyiraho shampiyona yoku rwego rwakabiri. Espoir BBC ni ikipe y'abagabo babigize umwuga ikina ya Basketball yo mu Rwanda ifite icyicaro i Kigali. Iyi kipe ikaba ikina mu irushanwa muri Shampiyona y'igihugu ya Basketball mu Rwanda.
Ubusanzwe, iyi kipe yagiye igaragaza abakinnyi batandukanye bagiye ndetse mu makipe menshi m'ugihugu by'afurika.
2003–04, 2011–12, 2012–13, 2013–14, 2014–15

Chancel Ndaye (yavutse ku ya 14 Mata 1999) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu Burundi, ukinira ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru nka myugariro.
Yakuriye mu rwego rw'urubyiruko rwa LLB Académic, muri Gashyantare 2019 yerekeje i Burayi asinya amasezerano n'ikipe ya Tchèque yo muri Vyškov.
Ku itariki ya 20 Ukuboza 2019 muri uwo mwaka, yimukiye muri Las Vegas Lights burundu.
Yahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 mu gikombe cya Afurika cy'ibihugu by'abatarengeje imyaka 20 cya 2019.

Imikino ya nyuma ya BAL yo muri 2021 niyo yari shampiyona y'umwaka wa mbere wa Basketball Africa League (BAL). Umukino wa nyuma wabereye muri Kigali Arena i Kigali kuri 30 Gicurasi 2021. Umukino wahuje ikipe yomuri Misiri ya Zamalek n'ikipe yomuri Tuniziya ya US Monastir.
Bitewe n'amabwiriza y'icyorezo cya COVID-19, ubwitabire mukibuga bwari buke kandi abantu 1.789 bari bahari. Zamalek yatsinze ikipe ya Monastir yomuri Tuniziya amanota 76-63 itwara igikombe cyayo cyambere cya BAL n'igikombe cya kabiri cya Afurika, nyuma yo kwegukana igikombe cya Afurika cyomuwi 1992. Kubera iyompamvu, ikipe yegukanye igikombe cya FIBA Intercontinental Cup cya 2021. Walter Hodge wa Zamalek yagizwe umukinnyi w’inararibonye mu mikino ya shampiyona nyuma y’umukino wanyuma.
Kuya 1 Kanama 2019, Kigali Arena, yubatswe kandi ifungurwa muri 2019, yatangajwe ko izakira imikino ya nyuma yabane y'irushanwa rya BAL. Iyisitade ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu bagera ku 10.000, ikaba yarakiriye imikino yogushaka itike ya AfroBasket 2021 ndetse na shampiyona y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda mbere yaho.
Imiterere ya shampiyona yaje guhindurwa maze shampiyona yose ibera muri Kigali. Kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19, ubwitabire bwari buke kandi abareba bose bagombaga gukurikiza amategeko agenga intera hagati y’abantu.
Monastir yo muri Amerika.
US Monastir yegukanye igikombe cya Pro A muri 2019, kugira ngo yegukane shampiyona ya mbere ya BAL. Iyikipe yanatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona muri 2020 kandi yegukanye shampiyona yomuri 2020-21 kuya 27 Mata 2021, nyuma yo gutsinda ikipeya Ezzahra Sports mumikino ya nyuma. kugira ngo yegukane ibikombe 6 muri shampiyona. Kuya 12 Mata 2021, iyi kipe yasinyishije Mounir Ben Slimane nk'umutoza wayo mushya.
Muri 2014, Monastir yatangiye gukina shampiyona ya FIBA Africa Club Championship, shampiyona ikomeye ku mugabane wa Afurika, kunshuro yambere. Muri 2017, iyikipe yarangije iriku mwanya wa gatatu muri shampiyona y’umugabane wa Afurika.
Ikipe ya Monastir yaririmo abakinnyi barindwi bari n'abakinnyi b'ikipe y'igihugu ya Tuniziya. Mu gihe cya BAL, ikipe yitwaye neza mumatsinda itsinda abo bahanganye bose, ikaba ari yo kipe yonyine yabashije kubona amanota arenga 100 mumukino umwe ubwo yatsindaga GNBC yomuri Madagasikari kumanota 113 kuri 66. Yaje kuba iyambere mumikino yanyuma kandi yafashwe nk' "abakunzwe" kugikombe mbere y'uko shampiyona itangira na "ESPN".
Zamalek yegukanye igikombe cya Egyptian Super League muri 2019, igikombe cyayo cyambere mumyaka 11, kugira ngo yegukane shampiyona yambere ya BAL. Mu myaka yomuwi 1990, iyi kipe yari yatsinze kurwego rw'umugabane ndetse n'igikombe cya FIBA Africa Basketball League mu 1992 n'icya nyuma cyatsinzwe muwi 1998. Ukongeraho imikino ya nyuma mwirushanwa ryahoze ari FIBA, uyu wari umukino wa gatanu wanyuma wa Zamalek ku mugabane w'umugabane.
Ni womwaka wa mbere w’imikino uyobowe n’umutoza mukuru w’umunya-Espagne Augustí Julbe, waje avuye muri Gran Canaria. Mu gihe cyo gukina muri BAL, Zamalek yarikiri mu mikino ya kimwe cya kabiri cya Shampiyona ya Misiri yomuri 2020-21. Mbere y’umwaka w’imikino, ikipe yikomeje hamwe na Michael Fakuade, Mouloukou Diabate na Chinemelu Elonu. Ikipe yakinnye neza cyane mumatsinda, itsinda abo bahanganye bose uko ari batatu, ijya mumikino ya nyuma y’imikino nk’iy’aba kabiri.
Nubwo ikipe ya Monastir ya Amerika yari itowe mbere y'umukino, Zamalek yatsinze umukino wa nyuma kuburyo butangaje. Mohab Yasser, umukinnyi muto mumwaka wa shampiyona ya BAL kumyaka 18, yatanze amanota 14 nyuma yogutera 6-kuri-8 mukibuga. Abakinnyi batatu ba Solo Diabate, Michael Fakuade na Chinemelu Elonu bongereye amanota 40 avuye kuntebe y'abasimbura. Hasigaye iminota umunani ngo umukino ugere, Zamalek yafunguye amanota 15 maze ibasha gutsinda BAL bwambere. Walter Hodge, umukinnyi wa Zamalek ukina amanota 12, anatanga imipira 4, maze ahabwa igihembo cya mbere cya BAL Most Valuable Player. Hodge yariyakiniye US Monastir mumwaka ushize.

Imikino ya nyuma ya BAL yo mu 2022 yarumukino wa shampiyona y'umwaka wa 2022 wa BAL, umwaka wakabiri wa Basketball Africa League (BAL). Umukino wanyuma wabereye muri BK Arena i Kigali kuri 28 Gicurasi 2022, hagati y'ikipe yomuri Angola Petro de Luanda nikipe yomuri Tuniziya ya US Monastir.
US Monastir yatsinze umukino nyuma yo kwitwara neza mugice cya kane, yegukana igikombe cya mbere cya BAL ndetse n'igikombe cyambere cya Afurika. Uyu mukino witabiriwe n'abantu 10.000 bagurishijwe.
"Mu mbonerahamwe ikurikira, imikino ya nyuma muri FIBA Africa Clubs Champions Cup iri mu nyandiko nto."
Kw' itariki ya 9 Ukuboza 2021, BK Arena, icyo gihe yiswe "Kigali Arena", yatangajwe nkaho hazabera imikino ya Playoffs ya BAL yo mu 2022. Iyiyari final yakabiri yikurikiranya yabereye muriyo stade.
Petro de Luanda yegukanye igikombe cyumwaka wa 2020-21, anagarura umutoza wa Brezili José Neto mumwaka wakabiri w'imikino. Itsinda ry'abakinnyi bakomeye ryakomeje kuba ryiza, Anderson Correia na Yanick Moreira basinyishijwe nk'abakinnyi bongerewe imbaraga kuri 15 Werurwe 2022.
Petro yagize ibihe byiza cyane mumateka, kuko yegukanye shampiyona ya Basketball ya Angola yo mu 2021-22 ifite agahigo ko kudatsindwa k'ibitego 33-0. Kuri 11 Gicurasi 2022, yegukanye igikombe cyayocya 15 cy'igihugu nyuma yogutsinda Interclube mumikino yanyuma y'igihugu. Ubwo ikipe yanatwaraga igikombe cya Angola na Angola Supercup, yegukanye igikombe cyayo cyambere cy'igihugu.
Mu nama ya BAL Nile yo mu 2022, Petro yarangije ariku mwanya wakabiri nyuma yo gutsindwa na Zamalek gusa. Ku 8 Gicurasi, umukinnyi w’umunyamerika EC Matthews yongewe kurutonde rw’abakinnyi mbere y’imikino ya nyuma. Nyuma yo gutsinda AS Salé mumukino wongeye gukinirwa muri kimwe cyakane cy’irangiza cy’umwaka ushize, Petro yatsinze FAP igera kumukino wanyuma wa BAL wa mbere ndetse n’umukino wa yuma wa cyendaku mugabane wa Afurika.
Monastir yo muri Amerika.
US Monastir yegukanye igikombe cyakabiri cya BAL nyuma yokwegukana igikombe cya Championnat National A cyomuri 2020-21. Mu gihe cy'ikiruhuko cy'izabukuru, iyikipe yatakaje abakinnyi bayo b'ibyamamare ba All-BAL Omar Abada na Makrem Ben Romdhane mugihe cy'ikiruhuko cy'izabukuru ubwo basinye amasezerano muri Arabiya Sawudite na Porutugali. Abakinnyi bakomeye bashyizwemo Solo Diabate na Michael Dixon, mugihe Ater Majok yongeye gusinya amasezerano.
Mu marushanwa yayo yo mugihugu imbere, Monastir yagize ikindi gihembwe gikomeye ubwo yegukanaga igikombe cyayo cyakane cyikurikiranya cy’igihugu kuwi 11 Gicurasi 2022, nyuma yo gutsinda Ezzahra Sports kumukino wanyuma. Nyuma y’iminsi itatu, kuri 14 Gicurasi, Monastir yanatwaye igikombe cya Tuniziya irangiza igikombe cyakabiri.
Mu nama ya 2022 ya BAL Sahara, Monastir yabaye iyakabiri nyuma yo gutsindwa bitunguranye n'ikipe yomu Rwanda REG. Mbere y'imikino ya nyuma y'amajonjora, ikipe yongeye gukomezwa n'umuzamu w'umunyamerika Julius Coles Jr. Murikimwe cyakane cy'irangiza, ikipe yatsinze Cape Town Tigers kukinyuranyo cy'amanota 39 kumwaka w'imikino. Mumikino ya kimwe cyakabiri cy'irangiza, ikipe yatsinze Zamalek kugira ngoyihorere kugutsindwa kwanyuma mumwaka ushize.
Mugice cyambere, ikipe ya US Monastir yatsinze imikino 17-18 mugice cyambere. Mugice cyakabiri, Petro de Luanda yatsinze imikino 8-0 irimo ibitego bitatubya Gerson Gonçalves na Carlos Morais, bituma igice cy mbere kirangira arimbere kumanota 40-33. Monastir yatsinze 0-8 inyuma y'umurongo w'amanota atatu mugice cyambere, maze abakinnyi ba Tunisia barushwa amanota 17-2 n'Abanya Angola. Nyuma yo gukubita umupira mugice cyagatatu, Monastir yari inyuma y'amanota 57-59 gusa. Michael Dixon yatsinze amanota atatu yatumye Monastir izamuka kumanota 60-59, ari na yoyari iyoboye igice cyakabiri. Abakinnyi bakomeye ba Petro, Jone Pedro na Yanick Moreira, bombi batsinzwe amakosa hasigaye iminota 8 n'umunota 1 ngumukino ugende neza. Hasigaye iminota itatu ngumukino ugende neza, Carlos Morais yakoze ikosa ridasanzwe, Monastir aryifashisha atsinda amanota 72-67. Umukino warangiye hasigaye amasegonda 30 ngo Radhouane Slimane atsinde umupira nyuma yo gutsindwa na Julius Coles Jr. maze atsinda igitego bituma Monastir atsinda amanota 78–72. Nyuma yo gutsindwa na Petro de Luanda, rutahizamu wa Monastir Firas Lahyani yibye umupira ariko nta mahirwe yahaye Petro yo kugaruka. Michael Dixon yateye umupira 7 kuri 10 mukibuga maze atsinda amanota 21 n'imipira 6 yavuyemo ibitego, kandi nyuma yo kwitwara neza cyane, yagizwe umukinnyi ukomeye cyane muri BAL, nyuma ya Walter Hodge nk'uwa kabiri wegukanye iki gihembo. Ater Majok wohagati muri Monastir, watsinze amanota 14 mu mukino, yagizwe umukinnyi w'umwaka w'ubwirinzi muri BAL. Gerson Gonçalves yatsinze amanota 28 mu ikipe ya Angola yatsinzwe, akurikirwa n'amanota 18 ya Yanick Moreira avuye ku ntebe y'abasimbura.
Murwego rwokwizihiza shampiyona yabo, Monastir ya Amerika yakiriwe mu ngoro ya Carthage na Perezida wa Tuniziya Kais Saied. Ikipe yanashimiwe kuri Twitter na Barack Obama, wahoze ari Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika akaba n'umushoramari muri BAL.

Shampiyona ya Basketball y'u Rwanda (RBL) (yahoze yitwa shampiyona y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda) niyo shampiyona ikomeye ya Basketball y'umwuga mu Rwanda. Ubusanzwe shampiyona yayitangira mu Gushyingo kugeza muri Nzeri. Abatsinze shampiyona ya NBL batsindira imikinoyo guhatanira itike ya Basketball Africa League (BAL).
Shampiyona ubigizwe n'amakipe 10, menshi muriyo akaba aturuka mmurwa mukuru w'igihugu wa Kigali. Shampiyona ya RBL ubu ni APR, ikaba ariyo kipe ifite ibihembo byinshi muri shampiyona imaze gutwara ibikombe 16. Andi makipe azwi ni REG na Patriots, bahanganye nabo, bamaze imyaka myinshi bakomeye.
Kuva mumwaka w'imikino wa 2021-22, FERWABA inategura ishami rya 2 rya RBL ahamakipe abiri yanyuma muri RBL ariyo amanuka.
Umukino wa Basketball watangijwe mu Rwanda muwi 1930 n'abapadiri Gatolika, bigishaga uyu mukino bwambere mumashuri yisumbuye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Mumyaka yakurikiyeho, umubare w'uyu mukino wariyongereye ukw' igisirikare n'ibigo bimwe na bimwe bya leta byashinze amakipe ya Basketball. Muwi 1974, ishyirahamwe ry'igihugu rya Basketball FERWABA ryashinzwe. Nyuma y'imyaka itatu, muwi 1977, hashinzwe shampiyona yambere y'igihugu.
Jenoside yo mu Rwanda yomuwi 1994 yasubije inyuma siporo, kuko abakinnyi b'Abatutsi, abarebaga n'abayobozi bapfuye ndetse n'ibikorwa remezo by'ingenzi byarasenyutse.
Mumyaka yaza 2000, APR yari ikipe ikomeye mu Rwanda kandi yitabiriye igikombe cya FIBA Africa Clubs Champions Cup inshuro eshatu. Umusaruro mwiza yakuyemo numudari wa bronze muri 2009.
Kuva muri 2011 kugeza 2015, Espoir BBC yegukanye ibikombe bine by'igihugu bikurikirana. Kuva icyo gihe, amakipe abiri mashya REG (yafitwe na Rwanda Energy Group) na Patriots yinjiye muri shampiyona. Ayo makipe yombi yahanganye kandi yakinnye mumikino ya nyuma mugihe cy'imyaka myinshi.
Mumyaka yaza 2020, shampiyona ya Basketball Africa League (BAL) yatangijwe - imikino ya mbere yakinwe na BK Arena i Kigali. Patriots yarangije kumwanya wakane mumwaka wa mbere washampiyona wa 2021. Shampiyona yahinduye izina yitwa Rwanda Basketball League (RBL) mu 2023. FERWABA yatangije amarushanwa abiri mashya, igikombe cy'u Rwanda n'igikombe cya Rwanda Super Cup, mumwaka wa 2024.
Imikino ya shampiyona mugihembwe gisanzwe ikunze kubera mucyumba cyomu nzucya Lycée de Kigali, gishobora kwakira abantu 1.500, nyuma y’uko cyavuguruwe na FERWABA na NBA Africa muri 2023. Indi mikino ikinirwa mucyumba cyo munzu cya Kaminuza ya Kepler. Imikino ya Playoffs ikunze kubera muri BK Arena ifite imyanya 10.000 (yahoze yitwa Kigali Arena), yafunguwe muri 2019. Indi salle ikoreshwa ni Petit Arena, iherutse kuvugururwa kugira ngo ijyemo abantu 1.500.
Amakipe akurikira azakina muri shampiyona ya BAL ya 2025:
Urutonde rw'abakinnyi bose bakomeye mwikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda banditseho kobazatwara igikombe cya shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere:
Imikino ya nyuma (2007–ubu).
Urutonde rw'imikino yanyuma ya shampiyona y'imikino yanyuma, cyangwa niba bidahuye n'urutonde rwanyuma rw'imikino y'umwaka wimikino.
Ibihembo by'umuntu ku giti cye.
Umukinnyi w'agaciro kurusha abandi.
Nyuma yaburi mwaka w'imikino wa RBL, umukinnyi umwe ahabwa umwanya w'umukinnyi w'agaciro kurusha abandi mw' irushanwa. Olivier Shyaka niwe mukinnyi wenyine watsindiye nibura ibihembo bibiri bya MVP. Kuvamu mwaka w'imikino wa 2023, RBL ifite igihembo cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mumwaka w'imikino usanzwe, ndetse n'ikindi gitandukanye cy'umukinnyi witwaye neza mumikino yanyuma y'imikino.
Umukinnyi w’indashyikirwa mu mikino ya Playoffs.
Kuva muri 2023, shampiyona itanga igihembo kumukinnyi witwaye neza mumikino yanyuma y’imikino.
Abakinnyi banditse munyuguti zitukura batorewe kuba umukinnyi w'agaciro kurusha abandi muri uyumwaka w'imikino.
Mu marushanwa ya Afurika.
Buri mwaka, abakinnyi batwaye igikombe cya NBL bashyirwaga mumarushanwa yo guhatanira itike ya FIBA Africa Basketball League, irushanwa ryambere muri Afurika. Kuva muri 2020, iyi shampiyona yasimbuwe na Basketball Africa League (BAL). Urutonde rukurikira rugaragaza amakipe yomu Rwanda yakinnye irushanwa rikomeye:
Muri shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika.
Kuva mumwaka w'imikino wa 2023, abakinnyi batwaye igikombe cya RBL bemerewe kwinjira muri BAL, kuko irushanwa ryabagennye nk'isoko ryagenwe.

IPRC-Kigali BBC ni ikipe ikina umukimo w'amaboko wa basketball mu Rwanda, ifite icyicaro mu karere ka Kicukiro muri Kigali. Ikaba ibarizwa mu ishuri rikuri rya IPRC Kigali Polytechnic University. Abakinnyi benshi bakaba banakina mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda, nka Dieudonné Ndizeye. IPRC-Kigali yamanuwe muri Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda mu cyiciro cya 2 muri shampiyona ya 2023, cyiciro cya 2.

Kepler Basketball Club ni ikipe y’ababigize umwuga m’umukino wa basketball mu Rwanda ifite icyicaro i Kigali mu Rwanda. ikaba iyoborwa kandi ishingiye ku ikigo cy’uburezi cya Kepler. Ikipe y’abagabo ikina muri shampiyona y’umukino wa basketball y’u Rwanda (RBL) kuva mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2024.
Ikipe ikinira mu kibuga cyo hanze nk omuri kaminuza ariko yatangiye kubaka ikibuga cyayo cyo mu nzu gifite imyanya 1.500 muri 2024.

REG BBC ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaboko ya basktaball ikina muri shampiyona ya basketball yu Rwanda. REG BBC ikaba ishingiye ku cy'ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe gutanga amashanyarazi mu Rwanda, ikaba yaratwaye shampiyona myaka ya 2017, 2021 na 2022.
REG BBC yashinzwe muri 2016, maze itwara igikombe cya mbere muri 2017, iza kwitabira amarushanwa y furika ya basketball muri 2018 na 2019.

Orion Basketball Club ni ikipe y’abakina umukino wa maboko wa Basketball mu Rwanda ibarizwa i Kigali mu Rwanda. orion ikina muri shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Orion yashinzwe muri 2022 itangira gukina mu cyiciro cya 2 ihita izamurwa mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Iyi kipe yashinzwe na James Mutabazi. hamwe n'bandi bashoramari barimo Jarred Harrington. Izina ry'iyi kipe risobanura "Inyenyeri irabagirana".

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry’abagore rya T20 ryomu 2025 ryarirushanwa mpuzamahanga rya Twenty20 (T20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuya 3 kugeza kuya 14 Kamena 2025. Amakipe yitabiriye ni Brezili, Kameruni, Malawi, Nijeriya, u Rwanda, Sierra Leone, Tanzaniya, Uganda na Zimbabwe High Performance XI. Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ryabaye ku nshuro ya cumi na rimwe ryibukije isabukuru y’imyaka 31 jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Uganda niyo yarintwari, imaze kwegukana irushanwa ryo muri 2024.
Amakipe yakinnye mu irushanwa ryo gusiganwa ku maguru, nyuma y’aho ane yambere agana murikimwe cya kabiri cy’irangiza. U Rwanda rwarangije arurwa mbere mw' irushanwa ryo gusiganwa kumaguru, rutsinda imikino umunani mumikino icyenda.
Tanzaniya yatsinze u Rwanda amanota 16 muri kimwe cyakabiri cy’irangiza, umukino warurimo amanota make. Uganda yatsinzwe na Zimbabwe High Performance XI amanota 1 mukindi gice cyakabiri cy’irangiza, nyuma yogutsindwa kuva kuri 83/2 kugeza kuri 92 zose. Tanzaniya yatsinze Zimbabwe High Performance XI amanota 32 kumukino wanyuma.

Ishyirahamwe ry'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (French) nurwego ruyobora basketball mu Rwanda. Ruyobora ikipe y'igihugu ya basketball y'u Rwanda ndetse n'amakipe akomeye ya NBL n'andi makipe y'abatarabigize umwuga.
Muwi 1930, basketball yazanywe bwambere mu Rwanda n'abapadiri gatolika, imikino yambere yakinwe mumashuri yisumbuye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Nyuma y'ubwigenge muwi 1962, hashinzwe amakipe mashya mu gisirikare no mubigo bimwe na bimwe bya leta. Muwi 1974, ishyirahamwe ry'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda ryashinzwe, maze shampiyona yambere y'igihugu iratangira nyuma y'imyaka itatu.

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry’abagore rya T20 ryo muri 2019 ryarirushanwa ry’abagore rya T20I (WT20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuri 18 kugeza kuri 23 Kamena 2019. Iri ryari irushanwa rya gatandatu rya Kwibuka T20 ribera buri mwaka, ryateguwe bwa mbere muri 2014 mu rwego rwo kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Abitabiriye namakipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda, Uganda, Mali na Tanzaniya, aho amakipe abiri ya nyuma yitabiriye irushanwa bwambere mugihe Kenya yarifite igikombe ivuyemo kubera kubura inkunga. Nubwa mbere mumateka y'iri rushanwa imikino yemejwe nk'imikino mpuzamahanga y'abagore ya Twenty20 International (WT20I) nk'uko byatangajwe na ICC byo guha imikino yose yakinwe hagati y'amakipe afatanyije nyuma yi 1 Nyakanga 2018. Imikino yose yakinwe kuri sitade mpuzamahanga ya Cricket ya Gahanga i Kigali. Kenya yari imaze gutwara igikombe inshuro eshatu (2015, 2017, 2018) mugihe Uganda yari yagitwaye kabiri, icya mbere muri 2014 ndetse no muri 2016. Tanzania Women yatwaye igikombe cy'uyu mwaka itsinze imikino yayo yose bityo iguma idatsindwa, mugihe abakinnyi babiri b'Abagande, Rita Musamali na Joyce Apio baba abatsinze amanota menshi ndetse n'abafashe amanota menshi.
Mu mukino wa 2 w'irushanwa, ikipe y'abagore ya Mali yatsinzwe amanota atandatu muma overs icyenda n'ikipe yakiriye irirushanwa, bituma iba ikipe iri hasi cyane mu mukino wa WT20I. Ikipe y'u Rwanda yatsinze amanota arindwi mumipira ine gusa, bituma itsinda umukino kumanota icumi, isigarana imipira 116. Mumukino wa gatanu w'irushanwa na Mali, Uganda yatsinze amanota 314/2 mu ma overs 20, bituma iba ikipe iri hejuru mu ma shampiyona mpuzamahanga ya Twenty20 y'abagore. Nubwa mbere mumukino mpuzamahanga wa cricket wa T20, mu bagabo cyangwa abagore, ikipe yatsinze amanota 300. Ikipe ya Mali yatsinzwe amanota 10 muma overs 11.1, ikaba ari yoya kabiri muma shampiyona make muri WT20Is. Intsinzi (amanota 304) nayo yari nini cyane mu mukino wa WT20I.
Byari biteganijwe kwirushanwa rya karindwi rizaba muri Kamena 2020, ariko ryasubitswe kugeza mumwaka ukurikiyeho kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19.

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry'abagore rya T20 ryo muri 2021 ryari irushanwa ry'abagore rya T20I (WT20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuya 6 kugeza kuya 12 Kamena 2021. Iri iryari irushanwa rya karindwi rya Kwibuka T20 ribera buri mwaka, ryateguwe bwa mbere muri 2014 murwego rwo kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muwi 1994. Imikino yose yakinwe kuri sitade mpuzamahanga ya Cricket ya Gahanga i Kigali. Tanzaniya yegukanye irushanwa rya 2019 ariko ntiyarinze igikombe uyumwaka. Irushanwa ryomuri 2020 ryahagaritswe kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Irushanwa ryo muri 2021 ryatangajwe bwa imbere ko rizahuza amakipe atanu, aho amakipe y'abagore ariyo Rwanda, Botswana, Namibia, Nijeriya na Uganda imaze gutwara igikombe inshuro ebyiri. Kuri 29 Gicurasi 2021, byemejwe ko Kenya imaze gutwara igikombe inshuro eshatu nayo izitabira. Botswana, Namibia na Nijeriya bakinnye irushanwa ryaKwibuka ku nshuro yambere. Amakipe atandatu yashyizwe mumatsinda abiri y'abantu batatu. Ariko, Uganda yasezerewe mwirushanwa kuya 3 Kamena 2021 kubera ibizamini bya COVID-19 mu nkambi yabo. Mbere yuko ivamo, Uganda yariyashyizeho itsinda ry'agateganyo ry'irushanwa.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Cricket mu Rwanda ryatangaje ko rigamije gukomeza kunoza irushanwa ryaKwibuka binyuze mugushyiramo Zimbabwe buri gihe mumyaka irimbere no gutumira amakipe akomeye aturutse i Burayi n’ahandi, bavuga kobamaze kugirana ibiganiro byiza n’Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Cricket mu Budage n’Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Cricket muri Brezili.
Namibia yatsinze imikino ine yose yakinnye mumatsinda, ibikipe yambere yemerewe kujya muri ½ cy’irangiza. Ikipe yakiriye iyikipe, u Rwanda, yatsinze Nijeriya mumukino wayo wanyuma mu matsinda, yemeza ko izakina muri ½ cy’irangiza. Kenya nayo yabonye umwanya muri ½ cy’irangiza. Mumukino wa nyuma mumatsinda, Nijeriya yatsinze Botswana kumanota atatu, iba ikipe yakane kandi yanyuma yemerewe kujya muri ½ cy’irangiza. Namibia na Kenya zageze ku mukino wanyuma zitsinze Nijeriya n’u Rwanda muburyo bushimishije.
U Rwanda rwarangije irushanwa ruriku mwanya wa gatatu, nyuma yogutsinda Nijeriya amanota umunani mumukino wo kwishyura. Kenya yegukanye igikombe cya Kwibuka T20 cyakane nyuma yogutsinda Namibiya amanota 7 kumukino wanyuma. Queentor Abel womuri Kenya watsinze amarushanwa yose niwe watowe nk'umukinnyi w'irushanwa, nyuma yogutsinda amanota 165 nogutsinda amanota 7.

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry’abagore rya T20 ryo mu 2022 ryarirushanwa rya Cricket ry’abagore rya T20I (WT20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuya 9 kugeza kuya 18 Kamena 2022. Iri ryari irushanwa rya munani rya Kwibuka T20 ribera buri mwaka, ryakinwe bwambere muri 2014 murwego rwo kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muwi 1994. Imikino yakinwe ahantu habiri mumujyi wa Kigali - Sitade Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket ya Gahanga na IPRC Cricket Ground. Kenya niyo yari igikombe cy’abakandida, nyuma yo kwegukana irushanwa rya 2021. Ni ku nshuro yakane Kenya yegukanye irirushanwa.
Amakipe cumi n'umwe yatangajwe ko azitabira uyumwaka, ugereranyije n'andi atanu muri 2021, bigaragaza ko irushanwa rya Kwibuka rikomeje kwiyongera nokumenyekana. Amakipe yemejwe mbere kazitabira ni u Rwanda rwakiriye imikino, Kenya yatwaye igikombe, Tanzania na Uganda zabanje kwegukana igikombe, ndetse na Botswana, Nijeriya, bagaragaye bwa mbere mw'irushanwa rya Kwibuka, Brezili, Ubudage, Ghana, Sierra Leone na Zimbabwe. Ariko, irushanwa ryaje kugabanuka rigera ku makipe umunani. Iri ryarirushanwa ryambere rya Kwibuka ryahuje amakipe aturutse hanze ya Afurika.
Nyuma y'iminsi itatu yambere y'imikino, Kenya na Nijeriya ntibyatsinzwe, buri kimwe kine kine kinesha. Kumunsi wakane, Tanzania yakomeje amateka yayo 100% itsinda Abanyakenya, kandi izamuka kumwanya wambere nyuma y'uko Nijeriya itsinzwe bwambere nyuma yo gutsindwa na Uganda kumanota 43 gusa. Nyuma y'uko imikino yo gusiganwa kumaguru irangiye, Kenya na Tanzania itaratsindwa byaje kwegukana itike yokujya kumukino w nyuma, mugihe ikipe yakiriye iyi mikino yatsinze Uganda kumwanya wagatatu.
Kumunsi wa mbere w'imikino yanyuma, Ubudage bwatsinze Botswana burangiza kumwanya wa karindwi, naho Nijeriya itsinda Brezili irangiza kumwanya wa gatanu murirusange. Ku munsi wanyuma w'irushanwa, Uganda yatsinze u Rwanda irangiza kumwanya wagatatu, na Tanzania itsinda Kenya kumukino wanyuma itwara irushanwa kunshuro yakabiri. Tanzaniya yari yatwaye irushanwa mugihe yari imaze gukina muri 2019, ariko ntiyashoboye kurwanira igikombe muri 2021 kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19.

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry’abagore rya T20 ryo muri 2023 ryariirushanwa mpuzamahanga rya Twenty20 (T20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kwi 10 kugeza kuri 17 Kamena 2023. Ryari irushanwa rya cyenda rya Kwibuka T20 ribera buri mwaka, ryakinwe bwambere muri 2014 muri rwego rwo kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muwi 1994.
Tanzaniya yari yatwaye irushanwa rya 2022, ariko ntibitabiriye irushanwa ryo muri 2023, ryari ririmo u Rwanda, Botswana, Kenya, Nijeriya na Uganda.
Nijeriya yatangiye neza, itsinda imikino yayo itatu yambere itunguranye, ifata umwanya wambere mw' irushanwa. Ikipe ya round-robin yari ihanganye cyane, amaherezo ikipe yakiriye imikino na Nijeriya mw' irushanwa ryo kwegukana umwanya wa kabiri kumukino wanyuma inyuma ya Uganda. Uganda niyo yayoboye urutonde rw'imikino, itsinda imikino irindwi yambere ya round-robin, mbere yo gutsindwa na Nijeriya.
U Rwanda rwatsinze Uganda kumukino wanyuma muburyo butunguranye kumanota 6. Iyi niyo ntsinzi yambere u Rwanda rutsinze Uganda, ikaba ari n'inshuro yambere rutsindira irushanwa rya Kwibuka.

Irushanwa rya Kwibuka ry’abagore rya T20 ryo muri 2024 ryarirushanwa mpuzamahanga rya Twenty20 (T20I) ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuya 30 Gicurasi kugeza kuya 8 Kamena 2024. Ryari irushanwa rya cumi ngarukamwaka rya Kwibuka T20, ryakinwe bwambere muri 2014 mu rwego rwo kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Amakipe yitabiriye ni Botswana, Kameruni, Kenya, Malawi, Nijeriya, u Rwanda, Uganda na Zimbabwe A. Irushanwa ryari rigizwe n’imikino yo kuzenguruka, nyuma y’aho amakipe abiri yambere yerekeje kumukino wanyuma. U Rwanda nirwo rwatwaye igikombe, rumaze kwegukana irushanwa kunshuro ya mbere muri 2023.
Intsinzi yatsinzwe n'u Rwanda kumanota 12 yatumye Uganda iba iya mbere mukubona umwanya wa nyuma, kuko yatsinze buri mukino mumikino itandatu yambere. Ibi byanasobanuye kikipe yakiriye iyimikino yagombaga kuba yaragombaga gutsinda Zimbabwe A mumukino wayo wa nyuma mw'irushanwa ryo gusiganwa kumaguru kugira ngo ibone amahirwe yokugera kumukino wa nyuma. U Rwanda rwabashije gutsinda umukino, ariko amahirwe yogutsinda ntabwo yari ahagije kugira ngoyemererwe kugera kumukino wa nyuma, kuko Zimbabwe yazamutse ku gipimo cy'amanota.
Uganda yatsinze Zimbabwe A kumanota 2 mumukino wanyuma wari ugoye cyane kandi ufite amanota make. U Rwanda rwatsinze Nijeriya ruhita rwegukana umwanya wagatatu, Kenya itsinda Botswana mumukino wo guhatanira umwanya wa gatanu, naho Malawi ifata umwanya wa karindwi imbere ya Kameruni. Kelis Ndhlovu womuri Zimbabwe niwe watowe nk'umukinnyi w'irushanwa.

John Hakizimana (wavutse kuya 26 Ukwakira 1996) numunyarwanda wiruka interandende. Mu 2018, yitabiriyirushanwa rya “half marathon” ry’abagabo mwirushanwa rya “IAAF World Half Marathon Championships” ryabereye i Valencia muri Esipanye ryo mu 2018. Yarangije ari ku mwanya wa 34.
Mu 2019, yahagarariye u Rwanda mumikino y’isi yagisirikare yabereye i Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu 2019. Yatsindiye umudari wa bronze mwirushanwa rya marato ry’abagabo.
Yahagarariye u Rwanda mumikino Olempike yomumpeshyi yabereye i Tokyo mu Buyapani mu 2020. Yitabiriye marato y'abagabo ariko ntiyarangiza isiganwa rye.
Mu Gushyingo 2023, Hakizimana yahawigihano cy'imyaka ibiri n'Ishami rishinzwe Iterambere ry'Imikino kucyaha cyokutubahiriza amategeko yokurwanya imiti ikoreshwa mugutera imiti iyobyabwenge nyuma yogupimwa Triamcinolone acetonide mu irushanwa ry'isi rya 2023 nyuma yo kwiruka marato y'abagabo. Kumwanyawa cyenda yakuweho.

United Generations Basketball, izwi kandi nka UGB, ni ikipe y’umukino wa basketball y’u Rwanda ifite icyicaro i Kigali. Iyikipe ikina muri shampiyona y’umukino wa basketball y’u Rwanda (RBL), ishami rikomeye mugihugu kuva muwi 1998.
Iyikipe ifitwe n'umuririmbyi Bruce Melodie, wabaye umunyamigabane muri 2024. Buri mwaka, UGB itegura irushanwa ry'imurikagurisha ryitwa Legacy Tournament murwego rwo guha icyubahiro abashinze amakipe Championat Aimable na Jean De Dieu Nizeyimana. Mubakinnyi bazwi cyane muriyi kipe harimo Jean Jacques Boissy na Guibert Nijimbere.
Mumwaka wa shampiyona wa 2025, umutoza Yves Murenzi yasezerewe kukazi kogutoza hagati mumwaka wa shampiyona asimburwa n'umutoza w'Umurundi Olivier Ndayiragije.

Tigers Basketball Club (yashinzwe muri 2019) ni ikipe y'umukino wa maboko wa Basketball w'abigize umwuga ibarizwa i Kigali. Tigers BBC ikina muri imikino ya shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda cyitwa Rwanda Basketball League (RBL).
Tigers BBC ni kiipe yashinzwe na rwiyemezamirimo ndetse yahoze akinira basketball mu Rwanda witwa Francis Shyaka. Ighe yitwaye neza ni umwanya wabo wa 4 muri shampiyona yo muri 2021-22. Ukuboza 2024, iyi kipe yasinyishije Henry Mwinuka, wari wabaye umutoza mwiza wa shampityona ya RBL inshuro eshanu yikurikiranya, nk'umutoza wabo mushya.

United Generations Basketball cyangwa se izwi kandi ku izina rya UGB, yashizwe muri 1998 ni ikipe ikina ikoresheje a maboko ya Basketball y'abigize umwuga ibarizwa Kigali mu Rwanda. Iyi kipe ikina muri shampiyona ya maboko ya Basketball yitwa Rwanda Basketball League (RBL), ibarizwa mu icyiciro cya mbere.
UGB yashinzwe nitsinda ry'abantu batandukanye aho ndetse iyoborwa n'umuririrmbyi Bruce Melodie akaba numwe mubanyamigabane bayo kuva muri 2024.

ya Kigali Titans ni ikipe y'abagabo babigize umwuga ibarizwa muri ya Basketball y’u Rwanda ikaba ikorera i Kigali. Iyi kipe ikina mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL D2).
iyi kipe washinzwe muri 2021 n'umucuruzi w'imiti witwa Eugene Rubonera Junior nyuma y'aho FERWABA itangarije ko izashyiraho ikigo cya kabiri cy'igihugu cy'amakipe y'abagabo. Cyril Kalima yagizwe umutoza mukuru wayo.
Titans yinjiye mu cyiciro cya 2 cya RBL mu mwaka wayo wa mbere w'imikino, maze ihita yegukana igikombe cya shampiyona cyoyo cy'ambere muri 2021-22 cyatumye izamuka muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere. Imikino ya nyuma y'icyiciro cya 2 yatsinzwe na Orion BBC ibitego 2-0. Mu mwaka wayo wa kabiri w'imikino, Titans yasinyishije abakinnyi mpuzamahanga Will Perry, Francis Azolibe na Álvaro Calvo Masa.
Muri shampiyona ya 2024, Titans yarangije iri ku mwanya wa 10 ari nawo wa nyuma, bityo isubizwa mu cyiciro cya 2.

Armée Patriotique Rwandaise Basketball Club, izwi cyane nka APR BBC, ni ikipe y’umukino w'amaboko wa Basketball yo mu Rwanda ifite icyicaro i Kigali. Itunzwe kandi igaterwa inkunga na Minisiteri y’Ingabo z’u Rwanda, ikina muri shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL) no muri Basketball Africa League (BAL) kuva mwaka wa 2024. Iyi kipe yitwa "Lions ", ni yo kipe ifite ibikombo byinshi mu gihugu, kuko APR imaze gutwara igikombe cy’igihugu inshuro 16.
Iyi kipe yashinzwe mu gihe cy'intambara yo kubohora u Rwanda (RPF) mu ntambara y'abenegihugu muri 1993, kugira ngo ikore nk'uburyo bwo gushakisha no kwigarurira abasirikare mu gihe cy'imirwano yo guhagarika imirwano hagati y'ibiganiro by'amahoro byaje gutuma hashyirwaho umukono ku masezerano ya Arusha. Ku ruhande rw'ikipe ya basketball, RPF yazanye amakipe muri volleyball na football, akomeje gukora neza.
Kuva muri 1995 kugeza muri 2003, APR yatwaye ibikombe cy'igihugu icyenda cyikurikiranya.
Ikipe yatowje n'umutoza mukuru wavukiye muri Kenya, Cliff Uwuor, muri 2005. Yatwaye igikombe cya FIBA Africa Zone 5 Club Championship muri 2008, inatwara ibikombe bya shampiyona muri 2005, 2006, 2009 na 2010.
APR WBBC ni ikipe y'abagore y'iyi kipe ikina muri shampiyona y'abagore ya Basketball y'u Rwanda kandi yahagarariye igihugu mu gikombe cya shampiyona y'abagore ya FIBA muri Afurika cya 2022.
