Sitade ya Kigali Pelé, izwi ku izina rya Sitade y'Akarere ka Nyamirambo cyangwa sitade regional i Nyamirambo, ni sitade ifite ikorerwamo ibintu bitandukanye iherereye mu gace ka Nyamirambo muri Kigali, mu Rwanda. Kuri ubu ikoreshwa mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi yakira amakipe atandukanye muri Shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru mu RWanda, harimo APR FC na Rayon Sports.
Ifite ubusitani cyangwa ubwatsi bw'ubukorano kandi yakira abantu 22.000. Sitade yafashwe nk'aho idakwiriye kwakirira imikino mpuzamahanga muri 2021 n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru muri Afurika, ivugururwa muri Mutarama 2023 mbere y'inama ya 73 ya FIFA, yabereye i Kigali. Yongeye gufungura ku ya 15 Werurwe 2023, maze ihindurirwa izina mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wo muri Brezili Pelé na perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame na perezida wa FIFA Gianni Infantino.
Muri 1998, sitade yakoreshejwe mu kwica abantu bane bahamwe n'icyaha cyo kugira uruhare muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda, barimo Froduald Karamira.

Asamoah Gyan (/ˌ æ s ə ˈ m oʊ ə ˈdʒɑːn / ASS -ə- ASS - ə JAHN ; yavutse kuri 22 Ugushyingo 1985) numukinnyi wahoze arumukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga muri Ghana wakinaga nka rutahizamu. Yahoze ari kapiteni w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Ghana.
Gyan yatangiye umwuga we muri 2003 mw' ikipe ya Liberty Professionals yo muri Ghana, atsinda ibitego icumi mumikino cumi n'itandatu. Hanyuma yamaze imyaka itatu mw' ikipe ya Serie. Yabaye ikipe ya Udinese mugihembwe cy'imyaka ibiri yatijwe muri Modena, atsinda ibitego inshuro cumi n'eshanu mumikino 53 ya shampiyona no muri Udinese aho yatsinze ibitego inshuro 11 mumikino 39 ya shampiyona. Muri 2008, Gyan yinjiye mw' ikipe ya Rennes yo muri Ligue 1, atsinda ibitego inshuro cumi n'enye mumikino mirongo ine n'umunani ya shampiyona mumyaka ibiri. Mur i2010, Gyan yinjiye mw' ikipe ya Sunderland yo muri Premier League icyo gihe, arangiza agahigo kiyikipe ko kugura abakinnyi no gutsinda ibitego inshuro icumi mumikino mirongo itatu n'ine ya Premier League mumyaka ibiri.
Muri 2011, Gyan yinjiye muri Al Ain yomuri UAE Pro League ku nguzanyo maze aba umukinnyi wambere mugutsinda ibitego muri shampiyona, atsinda ibitego 22 mumikino 18. Mumwaka wakurikiyeho, Gyan yinjiye muri Al Ain burundu maze ayifasha kugumana igikombe cya Pro League, yongera kurangiza ari umukinnyi wambere mugutsinda ibitego muri shampiyona, atsinda ibitego 31 mumikino 22. Mu mwaka wa shampiyona wa 2013-14, Gyan yarangije arumukinnyi wambere mugutsinda ibitego byinshi ku nshuro yagatatu, atsinda ibitego 29 mumikino 26.
Gyan niwe mukinnyi wambere mubakinnyi batsinze ibitego byinshi mw'ikipe y'igihugu ya Ghana, afite ibitego 51. Yahagarariye Ghana mu bikombe by'isi bya FIFA byomuri 2006, 2010 na 2014. Afite ibitego bitandatu, niwe mukinnyi wambere mubanyafurika mu mateka y'igikombe cy'isi. Gyan yanahagarariye Ghana mumikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2004 nomu bikombe birindwi bya Afurika (2008, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2015, 2017 na 2019), ayifasha kurangiza kumwanya wagatatu muri 2008 noku mwanya wakabiri muri 2010 na 2015. Yatangije igitabo cye cy'amateka, cyitwa "LeGYAndry" muri Hoteli ya Kempinski Gold Coast i Accra. Kuri 20 Kamena 2023, Gyan yatangaje kasezeye mumupira w'amaguru.
Gyan numuhererezi mubabyeyi be, Baffour Gyan Mensah (Se) na nyakwigendera Madamu Cecilia Amoako (Nyina). Mukuru we Baffour Gyan nawe yahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga. Gyan yashakanye na Gifty Sandra Dzamesi kandi babyaranye abana batatu, aribo Rafael Gyan, Frederick Gyan, Floyd Gyan.
Abanyamwuga mu by'ubwisanzure.
Yavukiye i Accra, Gyan yize amashuri yeya mbere muri Seven Great Princess Academy i Dansoman muwi 1999, naho amashuri yisumbuye ayashyira muri Accra Academy kuva muwi 1999 kugeza muri 2002. Gyan yatangiye umwuga we mu ikipe ya Liberty Professionals yo muri Ghana iherereye i Accra. Mumwaka umwe rukumbi yamaze mw' ikipe, yakinnye imikino 16 ya shampiyona muri Ghana Premier League, anatsinda ibitego 10. Yarangije umwaka arumukinnyi wa gatatu watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona.
Nyuma yogusinya amasezerano muri Udinese muri 2003, yamaze imyaka ibiri agurishijwe muri Serie B club Modena kugira ngabone ubunararibonye mumikino. Nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu gikombe cy'isi cya 2006, yakuruye ikipe yomu Burusiya ya Lokomotiv Moscow. Gyan yasubiye muri Udinese muntangiriro za 2006, ariko kuri 17 Gashyantare 2007, Udinese yakuyemo amasezerano yo kumugurisha mu idirishya ryo kugura no kugurisha mukwezi kwa Mutarama. Uyu rutahizamu yari hafi gusinya amasezerano y'imyaka itatu muri Lokomotiv Moscow Club yo mu Burusiya kuri miliyoni 10.5 z'amadolari y'Amerika, akaba ariyo mafaranga yakane mumateka y'umupira w'amaguru w'Uburusiya. Gyan yabwiye BBC Sport ati: "Rubanda Udinese yashakaga kunsimbuza ntiyabasinyiye." "Nabwiwe kubu ngomba kuguma mu Butaliyani mugihe cyose cy'umwaka."
Kw' itariki ya 10 Kanama 2007, hamwe na Fabio Quagliarella, Gyan yasinye amasezerano y’imyaka itanu yogukomeza muri Udinese kugeza kuri 30 Kamena 2012, nk'igihembo cy’uko yitwaye neza mu mikino yo kwitegura shampiyona yomuri 2007-08. Asamoah yagize ati: "Nahisemo kuguma hano kuko ari imwe muri shampiyona zikomeye ku isi," ati: "Hari amahirwe yogukina umupira w'amaguru usanzwe hano kugira ngombe umukinnyi mwiza. "Ndishimye n'amasezerano mashya kandi nziko nshobora gufasha Udinese kugera kubintu by'ejo hazaza". Gyan na Quagliarella bongereye amasezerano yabo batsinze ibitego bibiri buri umwe mumukino Udinese yatsinzemo ibitego 7-0 nyuma yaho kuruwo mugoroba.
Kuri 29 Nyakanga 2007, nyuma yokwitwara neza mumikino yo kwitegura shampiyona, harimono gutsinda ibitego bitatu mumukino wa gicuti bakinnye n'ikipe ya Spezia yo muri Serie B kuri 25 Nyakanga 2007, mbere yuko Udinese isezeranya amasezerano y'igihe kirekire. Gyan yatsinze ibitego umunani muri 2006-07 afasha ikipe ya Stadio Friuli kurangiza kumwanya wa 10 muri Serie A.
Gyan yakomerekejwe n'imvune mumwaka wa shampiyona womri 2007-08, ntiyasubiye kugaragara mw' ikipe ya Udinese nyuma ya Mutarama 2008, amaze gukina imikino 13 gusa muri Serie A kandi atsinda ibitego 3 muruwo mwaka w'imikino.
Kuri 11 Nyakanga 2008, Gyan yasinyishijwe n'ikipe ya Stade Rennais yo muri Ligue 1 mugihe cy'imyaka ine kugiciro cya miliyoni 8 z'amayero. Gyan yakinnye inshuro 48 muri Rennes, atsinda ibitego 14. Mu mpera z'ikipe yeya Rennes, yamenyekanye cyane kubera ubuhanga bwe mugutsinda ibitego, atsinda ibitego 13 muri shampiyona yomu mwaka wa 2009-10. Ariko, Gyan yakinnye imikino itatu gusa muri Ligue 1 mumwaka wakurikiyeho, bituma imikino yeyose igera kuri 53, mbere yuko yerekeza muri Sunderland.
Kw'itariki 31 Kanama 2010, Gyan yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ine n'ikipe ya Sunderland kwikipe ya miliyoni 13 z'amapawundi. Nyuma Gyan yahawe umupira wa nimero 33 muri Sunderland. Yatsinze igitego ku mukino we wa mbere Sunderland yakinaga na Wigan Athletic ku ya 11 Nzeri nyuma yo kwinjira asimbuye Danny Welbeck. Umukino warangiye banganyije 1-1, Antolín Alcaraz atsinda igitego cyokunganya cya Wigan. Yatangiye Sunderland atsinda igitego kimwe rukumbi ubwo bavaga mu gikombe cya League Cup batsinzwe na West Ham United. Gyan yatsinze igitego bibiri kumukino wewa mbere wa Premier League muriyi kipe ubwo batsindaga Stoke City ibitego 2-0 ku ya 6 Ugushyingo. Igitego cyecya mbere cyabonetse kumunota wa 9 ubwo umunyezamu Asmir Begović yateraga Nedum Onuoha ishoti, Gyan ari kumwe nawe agatsinda igitego cyokwisubiraho, naho icya kabiri cyabonetse ku munota wa 86, bituma "Black Cats" itsinda ibitego 2-0. Nyuma y'iminsi itatu, yakurikiyeho atsinda igitego cyokunganya na Tottenham kuri White Hart Lane mu mukino banganyije 1-1 ubwo Sunderland yazamukaga ku mwanya wakarindwi kurutonde. Yanatsinze igitego mumukino Sunderland yatsinze 3-0 kuri Stamford Bridge na Chelsea. Gyan yatsinze igitego cyagatatu cya Sunderland mumukino batsinze Blackburn Rovers 3-0 kuya 1 Mutarama 2011.
Kuri 16 Mutarama 2011, yatangiye gukina n'ikipe ya Newcastle United yo mugace, ayitsinda igitego cyo kunganya kumunota wa 94, bituma Newcastle ibona intsinzi yayo yakabiri y'umwaka w'imikino ubwo bakinaga na Sunderland. Gyan yongeye gutsinda ibitego byinshi ubwo yatsindaga igitego hanze ya Stoke City kuya 5 Gashyantare 2011. Yatsinze igitego kumunota wa 11 ubwo bakinaga na Tottenham kuri 12 Gashyantare 2011. Igitego gikurikiyeho cya Gyan cyaje kuri 23 Mata ubwo Sunderland yatsindaga Wigan Athletic ibitego 4-2, umukino warangiye mbere y'igihe kuruyu mukinnyi kuko yasimbuwe nyuma y'imvune y'akaguru byitezwe ko azabura shampiyona isigaye. Gyan yakize neza ku gihe kugira ngo yinjire mumukino wa nyuma wa Sunderland muruyu mwaka w'imikino muri West Ham ariko ntabwo yongeyeho amanota yeyo kurangiza umwaka wewa mbere mumupira w'amaguru w'Ubwongereza afite ibitego 10 muri shampiyona. Gyan yatwaye umupira wa 3 mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2011-12, umubare w'ikipe yambaye muri Ghana.
Kw' itariki ya 10 Nzeri 2011, byemejwe kurubuga rwa Sunderland ko Gyan azagenda ku nguzanyo y'umwaka wose mw' ikipe ya Al Ain FC. Mu gihe hari havugwaga amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 6 z'amapawundi yishyuwe mu gihe cy'inguzanyo, aho Gyan yahabwaga umushahara we wa mbere inshuro enye, Perezida Niall Quinn yashimangiye inyungu z'amafaranga z'amasezerano kuri Sunderland n'umukinnyi. Uyu munya Ghana yarangije shampiyona ari kumwe na Al Ain ayifasha gutsinda imikino ya shampiyona kunshuro yacumi, kandi niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona, atsinda ibitego 22 muri shampiyona.
Ubwo Martin O'Neill yabaga umutoza wa Sunderland kw'itariki 8 Ukuboza 2011, yatekereje kuburyo bwo kwirukana Gyan mu ikipe ye yatijwe.
Gyan yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka itanu muri Al Ain kuya 6 Nyakanga 2012, afite agaciro karenga miliyoni 6 z'amapawundi kuriburi mwaka w'imikino. Niwe watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona ya UAE mu mwaka w'imikino womuri 2013, kandi yafashije ikipeye kugumana igikombe cya shampiyona. Kuri 24 Nyakanga 2014, Gyan yatangaje ku rubuga rwe bwite koyasinye amasezerano yokongera amasezerano muri Al-Ain, ahabwa amasezerano meza kandi amuhuza n'iyi kipe kugeza muri 2018.
Kw' itariki ya 7 Nyakanga 2015, Gyan yemeje ku rubuga rwe bwite ko yavuye muri Al Ain kandi ko yagombaga kujya mw' ikipe ya Shanghai SIPG yo mu Bushinwa. Shanghai SIPG yatangaje ku mugaragaro ko yasinyishije Gyan avuye muri Al Ain amafaranga atatangajwe. Hanyuma byagaragaye kumushahara waburi cyumweru wa Gyan ungana na £227.000 mw' ikipe yeyo muBushinwa wahise umugira umwe mubakinnyi bahembwa neza kw' isi.
Kwi tariki 5 Nyakanga 2017, yinjiye mw' ikipe ya Kayserispor yo muri Turukiya. Kuya 9 Kanama 2019, Gyan yavuye muri Kayserispor.
Amajyaruguru y'Uburasirazuba bw'Isi.
Kuri 19 Nzeri 2019, yinjiye mw' ikipe ya NorthEast United yomuri Indian Super League. Kuri 26 Ukwakira 2019, yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere mw' ikipe ya Northeast United FC ubwo bakinaga na Odisha FC kumunota wa 84 w'umukino ubwo ikipeye yatsindaga umukino kubitego 2-1. Hagati mumwaka w'imikino, yagize imvune yatumye adakina shampiyona yose, maze kuri 15 Mutarama 2020, avanwa muriyi kipe ku mugaragaro, rutahizamu w'umunya-Ireland Andy Keogh asimburwa nk'umusimbura. Yarangije igihe cyemuri Northeast United atsinda ibitego 4 mumikino 8.
Kuri 1 Ugushyingo 2020, Gyan yagarutse muri Ghana ajya mw' ikipe ya Legon Cities, munguzanyo irenga miliyoni imwe y'amadolari. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere kuri 27 Ugushyingo 2020, aza gukina ku munota wa 71 atsinze Raphael Ocloo mumukino banganya na Medeama kubusa, birangira amaze imyaka 17 agarutse muri Ghana Premier League kuva yava mw' ikipe yeya Liberty Professionals akiri muto, asinya mw'ikipe ya Udinese yomu Butaliyani. Kuya 3 Kamena 2021, Gyan yatangiye umukino wewa mbere mw' ikipe ya "Royals" mu mukino wa shampiyona ya FA Cup ya Ghana yo mu 2021 bakina na Uncle 'T', warangiye batsinze ibitego 2-1 kuri Accra Sports Stadium kugitego cya Richmond Antwi.
Ikiruhuko cy'izabukuru.
Gyan yatangaje kasezeye mumupira w'amaguru kuri 20 Kamena 2023, ibibikaba byararangiye mumyaka makumyabiri yamaze akina umupira w'amaguru. Iri tangazo ryabereye munama ngarukamwaka ya 30 ya Afreximbank yabereye mu kigo mpuzamahanga cy'inama cya Accra.
Itangazo rya Gyan ryo gusezera kukazi ryeryagaragaje kigihe cyari kigeze ngo asezera kumwuga we ukomeye wogukina, yemera iterambere risanzwe abakinnyi bose b'umupira w'amaguru bahura naryo. Yashimiye igihugu cye, umuryango we, bagenzi be, n'abandi bose bagize uruhare mu ugendo rwe rw'umupira w'amaguru. Gyan yanagaragaje kafite intego yogukomeza kwitabira uyumukino, yibanda ku gutoza, ubucuruzi bw'umupira w'amaguru, nogushakisha, mugihe akomeje guteza imbere impano z'abana bato, nk'uko bigaragazwa n'uruhare rwe ruherutse mw' irushanwa rya Afurika rya Baby Jet U16.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Gyan yakinnye umukino wewa mbere mpuzamahanga afite imyaka 17, iminsi itatu mbere y'isabukuru ye y'imyaka 18. Gyan yatsinze igitego mumukino wewa mbere mpuzamahanga mw' ikipe ya Ghana bakinnye na Somalia kuri 19 Ugushyingo 2003, kumunota wa 90. Yaje mu mwanya wa Nana Arhin Duah kumunota wa 77 mu mukino wo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2006, iminsi itatu mbere y'uko yuzuza imyaka 18; afasha Ghana gutsinda uwomukino, kandi aba umukinnyi muto kurusha abandi bose batsinze igitego muri Ghana.
Yatsinze ibitego bine mumikino irindwi mugihe cyo gushaka itike yokujya mgikombe cy'isi, afasha Ghana kwegukana itike yokujya mugikombe cy'isi cya mbere mumateka. Yari mw' ikipe ya Ghana Olempike yo mu 2004, yavuye mu cyiciro cya mbere, arangije ari kumwanya wa gatatu mw' itsinda rya B.
Yanatsinze igitego cyihuta cyane mw' irushanwa nyuma y'amasegonda 68. Igitego cya mbere cya Ghana mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA, cyaje mu mukino bakinnye na Repubulika ya Tchèque kuri 17 Kamena kuri RheinEnergieStadion i Cologne, mu Budage, cyatumye Black Stars itsinda ibitego 2-0. Yahushije penaliti nyuma y'umukino, maze abona ikarita y'umuhondo imubuza gukina umukino wanyuma mumatsinda kubera kugerageza gufata penaliti hakiri kare cyane. Mu mukino Ghana yatsinzwe na Brezili mu cyiciro cya 16, yirukanwe kumunota wa 81 nyuma yokubona penaliti yakabiri mumukino (yo kwibira).
Kw' itariki ya 24 Mutarama 2008, mu gikombe cya Afurika, Gyan na murumuna we Baffour bahisemo kuva muri Black Stars nyuma yokunengwa nyuma yogutsinda Namibia igitego 1-0. Itangazamakuru ryamenye kabo bavandimwe bari bapakuruye imizigo yabo kandi ko biteguye kuva muri hoteli y'ikipe ariko bagenzi babo barabingingaga. Mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2010, Asamoah Gyan yafashije ikipe ya Ghana, yari yakomerekejwe n'imvune mumikino yanyuma. Gyan yatsinze ibitego bitatu muribine bya Ghana mw' irushanwa.
Gyan yatsinze penaliti kumunota wa 85 w'umukino wambere wa Ghana mu gikombe cy'isi cya 2010 ubwo yakinaga na Seribiya igitego 1-0. Yakubise izamu kumunota wa 92 mbere yo gusimbuzwa amashyi menshi mbere gato y'uko ifirimbi ya nyuma irangira. Mumukino wa kabiri wa Ghana, yatsinze penaliti kumunota wa 26 kugira ngangane amanota maze ikipe yibone amanota 1-1 na Ositaraliya.
Mumukino wa 1/8 cya shampiyona bakinnye na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yatsinze igitego mu minota y'inyongera bituma Ghana itsinda ibitego 2-1 bityo iba ikipe yagatatu ya Afurika mumateka yemerewe kugera muri kimwe cyakane cy'irushanwa, nyuma ya Kameruni na Senegal. Mumukino wa 1/4 cya shampiyona bakinnye na Uruguay, nyuma y'uko Luis Suárez afashe umupira kumurongo w'izamu, yahushije penaliti nta mwanya usigaye mu minota y'inyongera, akubita umupira ku rutare rw'izamu bituma biba ngombwa ko hafatwa penaliti kugira ngo hamenyekane umukino. Yahinduye penaliti ye muminota yakurikiyeho, ariko Uruguay ikomeza gutsinda penaliti 4-2.
Kunshuro ya kabiri mmwuga we, Gyan yabuze penaliti ikomeye mw' irushanwa rikomeye ubwo yatsindwaga penaliti mumukino wa 1/2 w'igikombe cya Afurika cya 2012. Ghana yakomeje gutsindwa igitego 1-0. Nyuma yokubura penaliti, Gyan yahisemo "kuruhuka burundu" mu mupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga. Kuya 8 Gicurasi 2012, yatangaje koyagarutse mw' ikipe ya Black Stars.
Kw' itariki ya 7 Kamena 2013, yatsinze ibitego 2 mumukino batsinzemo Sudani ibitego 3-1 mumukino wo gushaka itike yogukina igikombe cy'isi, bituma abumukinnyi wambere mu gutsinda ibitego byinshi muricyo gihugu, arusha ibitego 33 bya Abedi Pele.
Kw' itariki ya 2 Kamena 2014, Gyan yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Ghana izakina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2014. Mumukino wambere w'ikipe, yayoboye Black Stars batsinzwe na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ibitego 2-1. Yatsinze igitego cyecya mbere muriryo rushanwa ubwobanganyaga n'Ubudage ibitego 2-2, anganya agahigo ka Roger Milla k'ibitego bitanu bya FIFA mu gikombe cy'isi. Mu mukino wanyuma w'amatsinda, yabaye umukinnyi wambere w'umunyafurika mumateka y'igikombe cy'isi atsinda igitego cya Black Stars ubwo batsindwaga na Porutugali ibitego 2-1.
Mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2015, Gyan yasibye umukino wambere wa Ghana, batsinzwe na Senegal ibitego 2-1, ndetse arwara malariya "itari yoroshye". Yagarutse kumukino wakabiri, atsinda igitego cy'intsinzi kumunota wanyuma batsinze Algeria ikipe ikundwa mw' irushanwa mumukino batsinze Black Stars igitego 1-0. Guhunga mpuzamahanga kwamaze umwaka urenga byarangiye mu Ukwakira 2018 ubwo Gyan yahamagarwaga mw' ikipe ya Ghana mumikino ibiri yo gushaka itike yo gukina Igikombe cya Afurika cya 2019 na Sierra Leone.
Yatangaje ko asezeye mumupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga kuri 20 Gicurasi 2019, ukwezi kumwe mbere y'uko igikombe cya Afurika cya 2019 kibera. Ariko, nyuma y'umunsi umwe Gyan yahinduye icyemezo cyenyuma yokuganira na perezida wa Ghana, Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo. Muntangiriro za Kanama 2022, Gyan yasohoye itangazo rivuga koyari arimo gukora imyitozo kugira ngo asubire ku buzima bwiza kugira ngakine igikombe cy'isi cyomuri 2022 muri Qatar. Gyan ntiyari mw' ikipe y'abakinnyi 26 batoranyijwe guhagararira Ghana mugikombe cy'isi cya 2022 kandi kuva icyo gihe yari umufana ukomeye wa Black Stars kandi akaba yarayoboye amaserukiramuco n'imihango y'abafana. Gyan yasezeye nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri Ghana, atsinda ibitego 51 mu mikino 109 yakinnye mugihugu cye. Yanasezeye kumwanya wewo kuba umukinnyi w’umunyafurika watsinze ibitego byinshi mumateka y’igikombe cy’isi, aho yatsinze ibitego bitandatu.
Umupira w'amaguru wo hanze.
Kwamamaza umukino w'iteramakofe.
Muri Kamena 2012, Gyan yibanze kukuzamura umupira w'amaguru maze atangaza kazakorera igitaramo cyecya mbere cy'umukino w'iteramakofe muri Ghana. Kuya 6 Nyakanga 2012, Asamoah Gyan yagize ati:
Muri Gashyantare 2021, amasezerano hagati ya Baby Jet Promotions na Emmanuel Tagoe warumukinnyi w’iteramakofe wenyine muriyi promotion yaraseswaga. Amasezerano yariay’igihe kuvamu Ukwakira 2018 kugeza mu Gushyingo 2021.
Isosiyete y'indege ya Baby Jet.
Guhera mu Ukwakira 2017, Asamoah Gyan yahawe "uruhushya rwo gutwara ibintu mukirere" (ACL) n'Ikigo gishinzwe iby'indege za gisivili muri Ghana (GCAA). Nk'uko bivugwa n'Ibiro Ntaramakuru bya Ghana, ururuganda rushya rwitwa Baby Jet Airlines. Hamwe n'uruhushya muntoki, ururuganda rushya ubu rwemerewe gutangirana n'urugendo rwarwo rwokwemeza korufite uburenganzira bwogutwara ibintu mu kirere (AOC).
Yatangiye gukina Tennis muri 2020 kugira ngo akomeze kugira ubuzima bwiza nyuma y'ikiruhuko kirekire kubera imvune. Baby Jet promotions yahujwe na MANCWA Commodities kugira ngitware irushanwa rya Top 16 Invitational murwego rwo guteza imbere siporo.

NIYOMUGABO j.Claude ni Umunyarwanda ukina ymupira w' amaguru, ya vutse muri 1997, avukira mu mujyi wa Kigali. kugeza ubu akinira ikipe ya APR FC, ikina icyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda, ikindi Claude akina nka myugariro kuruhande rw' ibumoso akaba afite uburebure bwa 1.72m.

Umukino wanyuma wa BAL wo mu 2023 wari umukino wa shampiyona y'umwaka wa 2023 wa BAL, umwaka wagatatu wa Basketball Africa League (BAL), kandi wasoje imikino ya nyuma. Umukino wanyuma wakinwe kuya 27 Gicurasi 2023 muri BK Arena i Kigali, mu Rwanda, mu mwaka wa gatatu wikurikiranya. Umukino wanyuma wahuje ikipe yomuri Misiri Al Ahly n'ikipe yo muri Senegali AS Douanes.
Al Ahly yegukanyigikombe cyayocyambere nyumayogutsinda AS Douanes amanota 80–65 ku nshuro yambere ya BAL ndetse n'igikombe cyakabiri cy'umugabane w'Afurika, nyuma y'igikombe cya FIBA Africa Club Champions Cup mu 2016. Umutoza mukuru wa Al Ahly Augustí Julbe yabaye umutoza wa mbere wegukanye igikombe cya BAL inshuro ebyiri, mu gihe Nuni Omot yagizwe umukinnyi w'agaciro kurusha abandi (MVP) muri shampiyona nyuma y'umukino.
Nk’abatwaye igikombe cya BAL, Al Ahly yegukanye itike yokwitabira igikombe cya FIBA Intercontinental Cup cya 2023, ahoyarangije ariyakane.
Mumbonerahamwe ikurikira, imikino yanyuma muri FIBA Africa Clubs Champions Cup irimu nyuguti nto. Amakipe yombiyagaragaye bwambere muri BAL Final. Al Ahly yari yakinnye umukino wa nyuma wa FIBA ACC inshuro eshatu mbere, kandi yatsinze rimwemu 2016. AS Douanes ntiyigeze igaragara mumukino wanyuma wa'Afurika, kandi ni yo kipe ya mbere yakinnye umukino wa nyuma wa Afurika kuva kuri Jeanne d'Arc imyaka 31 mbereyaho (mu 1992).
Ikibuga cya BK Arena cyakoreshejwe nk'ikibuga cyakirimikino yanyuma ndetse n'icya nyuma mu mwaka wagatatu wikurikiranya, hakurikijwamasezerano BAL yagiranye na Minisiteri y'Imikino mu Rwanda.
Al Ahly yujujibisabwa mumwaka wa 2023 ubwoyegukanaga shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere cya Basketball yomu Misiri ya 2021-22, nyumayogutsinda Al Ittihad Alexandria ku mukino wa nyuma. Ikipe izwi ku rwego rw’umugabane w’Afurika, uyuwarumwaka wayo wambere muri BAL iyobowe n’umutoza Augustí Julbe. Julbe yari yamaze gutwara shampiyona ya BAL mu 2021 ari kumwe na Zamalek. Iyikipe yaguze rutahizamu womuri Sudani y’Epfo Nuni Omot, ndetse n’umuzamu w’umunyamerika Michael Thompson, wavuye mukiruhuko cy’izabukuru muri BAL. Mu nama yabereye i Cairo, Al Ahly yatsinzimikino inemuri itanu. Mumukino na Petro de Luanda, yatsinzwe n’umukino uvunacyane.
Hagati y’icyiciro cy’amatsinda n’imikino yanyuma ya BAL, Al Ahly yegukanyigikombe cyakarindwi cya Misiri nyumayo gutsinda Al Ittihad Alexandria muri shampiyona y’igihugu ya Basketball yomu 2022-23.
Mbere y'imikinoyanyuma y'imikino, Al Ahly yongeyimbaraga mwikipe yabikoresheje Michael Fakuade, wari warakiniye iyi kipe mu 2021. Nyumayogutsinda ikipe yomu Rwanda REG mu gice cya kane cy'irangiza, Al Ahly yatsinze ikipe yomuri Mali Stade Malien mugice cya kabiri cy'irangiza nyuma y'amanota 21 ya Ehab Amin.
AS Douanes yinjiye mumwaka wa 2023 nyumayogutwara igikombe cya Senegal mumwaka wa 2022, igaruka nyuma y'umwaka umwe idakinamuri shampiyona. Douanes, iyobowe n'umutoza mukuru Pabi Gueye kuva mu 2013, yaguze Chris Crawford na Terrell Stoglin nk'abakinnyi b'Abanyamerika baturutse hanze. Crawford yari amaze imyaka ibiri akina muri BAL, Stoglin akabariwe watwayigikombe cya BAL inshurebyiri.
Ikipe yatsinzwimikino ibiryambere y'umwaka w'imikino, nyumayahwikipe yasezereye Stoglin mu ikipeyayo. Nyumay'ibi, Douanes yatsinzimikino itatu yikurikiranya ndetsibasha kwemererwa kujya mu mikino ya nyuma nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe ya US Monastir kumunsi wanyuma w'umukino. Yanasezereye Monastir, mazikomeza ishingiye kumukino wahujamakipe atanu afite agahigo kogutsinda 3-2.
Mu mikino ya Playoffs ya BAL yomu 2023, Douanes yatsinze Ferroviário da Beira byoroshye, mbere yo guhura na Petro de Luanda wariwabaye uwakabiri muri ½ cy'irangiza. Nyuma y'amanota 28 ya Jean Jacques Boissy n'amanota 26 ya Crawford, Douanes yatsinze ikipe y'Angola muburyo bwafatwaga nk'intsinzi itangaje. Kwitariki ya 26 Gicurasi, umunsumwe mbere y'umukino wa nyuma, Pabi Gueye yatorewe kuba umutoza w'umwaka wa BAL.
Igitaramo cya nyuma y'igice cy'umunsi.
Igitaramo cyakozwe mugice cyakabiri cyakozwe na Bruce Melodie, Pheelz na DJ Neptune.
Khaman Maluach yatangijumukino muri AS Douanes, niwemukinnyi mutowatangiye umukino wa shampiyona ya BAL afite imyaka 16. Chris Crawford womuri AS Douanes yatangijumukino n'amanota atatu yatumye Abanyasenegali batsinda 3-0. Amr Zahran wa Al Ahly yasubije umupira n'amanota atatu ubwo Abanyamisiri banganyaga, kuko AS Douanes yayoboye amasegonda 23 kuko Al Ahly itashoboraga kuva aho iri. Nyuma y'uko Nuni Omot atsinze igitego, Al Ahly iyoboye 17-10 nyuma y'igice cya mbere cy'amanota make.
Mugice cyagatatu, Abanyegiputa batsinzibitego bibiri byatsinzwe na Corey Webster na Ehab Amin, bituma batsinda amanota 13. Igicecyagatatu cyarangiye Al Ahly iyoboyeneza amanota 17 kuri 63–46. AS Douanes yatsinze amanota abiri gusa yatsinzwe mumukinowose, inatsinda ibitego 6% gusa, itsinda bibirigusa munshuro 31 yagerageje. Chris Crawford, waruyoboye Douanes mugutsinda ibitego byinshi, yatsinzwe amanota 9 gusa n'izamu rya Al Ahly.
Ibisobanuro birambuye.
Al Ahly yabayikipe ya gatatu murirusange, ndetse n'ikipe ya kabiri yomu Misiri yegukanye igikombe cya BAL, nyuma ya Zamalek mu 2021. Augustí Julbe yabayumutoza wambere wegukanye ibikombe bibiri bya BAL, nyuma y'igikombe cyemuri Zamalek mu 2021. Umukinnyi wambere Michael Fakuade yabayumukinnyi wa kabiri wegukanye ibikombe bibiri bya BAL, nyuma ya Solo Diabate.
Nuni Omot wa Al Ahly, watsinzamanota 22 menshi kumukino wanyuma, yagizwumukinnyi w’agaciro kanini muri BAL nyumay’umukino. Chris Crawford na Jean Jacques Boissy barinze ikipe ya AS Douanes bashyizwe mu ikipe ya mbere ya All-BAL, baba abakinnyi ba mbere muri iyo kipe batoranyijwemurikigihembo.
Nk’umukinnyi watsinze umukino wanyuma, Al Ahly yegukanye itikeyokwitabira igikombe cya FIBA Intercontinental Cup muri Singapuru mu 2023. Mugikombe cya Intercontinental, Al Ahly yubatse amatekibikipe yambere y'Afurika itsinze umukino nyumayo gutsinda NBA G League Ignite ku ya 21 Nzeri. Yarangije iri ku mwanya wa kane mu makipe atandatu.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro muri Brezili, kuva kuya 5 kugeza kuri 21 Kanama 2016. Iyi yari inshuro yacyenda igihugu kiyitabiriye mumikino Olempike yomu mpeshyi.
Komite y'igihugu y'imikino Olempike na Siporo mu Gifaransa (French) yatoranyije itsinda ry’abakinnyi barindwi, abagabo bane n’abagore batatu, kugira ngobahiganwe gusa mumikino ngororamubiri, gusiganwa kumagare mumuhanda, gusiganwa kumagare mumisozi nokoga mu mikino Olempike, bihuye n’ingano y’abakinnyi b’igihugu n’abakina London 2012. Itsinda ry’abahagarariye u Rwanda ryari rigizwe n’abakinnyi babiri bagarutse mumikino Olempike baturutse mumikino yabanje, barimo Claudette Mukasakindi wiruka marato, n’umusiganwa ku magare Adrien Niyonshuti, wasubiyemo inshingano zezo gutwara ibendera ry’igihugu kunshuro ya kabiri mumuhango wogufungura.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye amarushanwa ya Paralympic yo mu mpeshyi ya 2016 yabereye i Rio de Janeiro muri Brezili, kuva kuya 7 Nzeri kugeza kuri 18 Nzeri 2016.
Komite y’Imikino y’Abamugaye mu Rwanda yahawe igihembo cya Agitos Grant Award, aho inkunga yagenewe iterambere ry’inzira y’abakinnyi muri Rio na Tokyo. Iyinkunga yagiriye akamaro abakinnyi 900 hirya nohino mugihugu, mugihe yanagenewe guhugura abatoza, abashyira mubyiciro n’abasifuzi mu Rwanda.
Intego ya Rwanda NPC ni ukohereza itsinda rinini ry’abamugaye i Rio.
Ishyirwa mu byiciro ry'abafite ubumuga.
Buriwese witabiriye Paralympic afite ubumuga bwebushyirwa mu byiciro bitanu by'ubumuga ; gucibwamo ibice, indwara ishobora kuvukanwa cyangwa igaterwa n'imvune cyangwa indwara; ubumuga bwo mu bwonko ; abakinnyi b'ibimuga, akenshi usanga hari ahobihurira n'ibindi byiciro; ubumuga bwo kutabona, harimo n'ubuhumyi ; Les autres, ubumuga ubwaribwo bwose bw'umubiri budashyirwa mucyiciro kimwe gusa, urugero nk'ubudashyikirwa cyangwa indwara nyinshi zo mu bwonko. Buri siporo ya Paralympic igira ibyiciro byayo, bitewe n'ibyo umubiri ukeneye mw' irushanwa. Ibirori bihabwa kode, igizwe n'imibare n'inyuguti, isobanura ubwoko bw'ibirori n'ibyiciro by'abakinnyi bahatanira. Imikino imwe n'imwe, nk'imikino ngororamubiri, igabanya abakinnyi hakurikijwe icyiciro n'uburemere bw'ubumuga bwabo, indi mikino, urugero nko koga, abarushanwa mumatsinda atandukanye hamwe, itandukaniro ryonyine rishingiye kuburemere bw'ubumuga.
Hermas Cliff Muvunyi yatoranyijwe guhagararira u Rwanda mumikino Paralempike yo mumpeshyi yo muri 2016 mumarushanwa ya T46 metero 400 na metero 1500. Muyunyi yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo yegukane i Rio mumarushanwa y'isi ya IPC Athletics World Championships yabereye i Doha muri Qatar muri 2015. Mbere y'imikino, yatangaje kazasezera kukazi nirangira imikino ya Rio. Agiye muri Rio, Muyunyi yaratuye muri Sitade y'Igihugu y'Amahoro aho yakoreye imyitozo na Eric Karasira.

Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza ya 2019-20 yari shampiyona ya 43 ya shampiyona y'Ubwongereza, shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru yomu cyiciro cyambere mu Rwanda. Shampiyona yatangiye kuya 4 Ukwakira muri 2019.
Shampiyona yahungabanyijwe n'icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyatumye imikino yomu cyiciro cya 24 ikinirwa mumuhezo ariko mbere y'uko icyiciro kirangira, shampiyona yahagaritswe kuri 22 Gicurasi. Urutonde rw'imikino nyuma y'icyiciro cya 23 rufatwa nk'urwa nyuma.
Amakipe 16 yose hamwe niyo azahatana muruyu mwaka w'imikino wa 2019-20, ahikipe yambere izahatanira igikombe cya CAF Champions League, iyakabiri izahatanira igikombe cya CAF Confederation Cup, naho iyakabiri izatangirira mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'u Rwanda.

Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza ya 2024–25 ni shampiyona ya 48 ya shampiyona y'Ubwongereza, shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda. Shampiyona yatangiye kuri 15 Kanama 2024 irangira kuri 28 Gicurasi 2025. APR FC yambitswe igikombe, yegukana igikombe cyagatandatu yikurikiranya, Rayon Sports iriku mwanya wakabiri. Muhazi United na Vision FC nizo kipe zombi zavuye muri shampiyona y'Ubwongereza.
Incamake y'igihembwe.
Muntangiriro z'uyu mwaka w'imikino, kugeza mumpera za 2024, ikipe ya Rayon Sports yari yiganjemo abakinnyi bayo ba Rayon Sports, bari barimo bashakisha igikombe cyabo cyambere kuva mumwaka wa 2018-19. Nyuma y'imikino icumi, iyikipe yayoboye urutonde rw'abakinnyi ku manota atandatu imbere ya AS Kigali, ahorutahizamu w'umunyasenegali Ngagne Fall ari wewayoboye abandi batsinze ibitego bitandatu. APR FC, yatwaye ibikombe bitanu byabanje, yari kumwanya wagatanu muntangiriro z'Ukuboza, ariko yari imaze gukina imikino myinshi mike ugereranyije n'abo bahanganye.
Shampiyona yafashe ikiruhuko hagati mumwaka wa shampiyona muri Mutarama, Rayon Sports yariyoboye amanota atanu icyogihe nyuma y’uko yombi na APR yari ku mwanya wakabiri batsinzwe imikino yabo yanyuma mbere y’ikiruhuko, haba kuri Sitade ya Huye, Mukura Victory Sports na Amagaju. Amakipe abiri yambere yari arusha andi makipe menshi muriki cyiciro, AS Kigali yari kumwanya wa gatatu yarinyuma ya APR amanota atandatu mugihe cy’ikiruhuko.
Shampiyona yongeye gusubukurwa muri Gashyantare, aho APR yagabanyije amanota abirubwo amakipe yombi yahuraga kumukino wa kabiri w'umwaka kuya 9 Werurwe kuri Sitade Amahoro. Uyumukino warangiye ari 0-0 nta mpande zombi zabonye amahirwe menshi yo gutsinda.
Muri Mata, Rayon Sports yirukanye umutoza wayo Robertinho nyuma yo kunganya na Marine FC ibitego 2-2. Iyikipe yari imaze gukina imikino itatu gusa mw' icumi mbere y’iyo ngingo, kandi yatakaje umwanya wa mbere ku rutonde rw’amakipe yatsinzwe na APR. Nubwa mbere Rayon itarayobora urutonde kuva umwaka wa 2025 watangira. Claude Rwaka, umutoza w’abagore wa Ryon wegukanye igikombe, yasimbuye Robertinho.
Kw' itariki ya 17 Gicurasi, umukino wa Bugesera na Rayon Sports wagombaga gusubikwa nyuma y'iminota 57 ubwo abafana ba Rayon batangiraga kwigaragambya nogutera ibisasu mukibuga. Icyo gihe Bugesera yariyoboye ibitego 2-0, Umar Abba akaba yari amaze gutsinda igitego cyakabiri binyuze muri penaliti iteye ubwoba, nyuma gato y'uko Rayon yangiwe penaliti yayo kugira ngigere kumukino. APR yatsinze umukino wayo kuruwo munsi, itsinda Gorilla FC igitego 1-0 - igitego kimwe rukumbi cyaje nogutsindwa na penaliti iteye ikibazo - kandi yatsinze amanota abiri kumwanya wa mbere w'ikipe. Umukino wa Bugesera na Rayon wasubukuwe nyuma y'iminsi ine, uhereye ahowari warasubitswe, kandi nubwo yatsinze igitego kumunota wa 84, yatsinzwe umukino ibitego 2-1.
Vision FC yabaye ikipe ya mbere yasezerewe kuri 13 Gicurasi nyuma y'umwaka umwe mucyiciro cyambere, nyuma yogutsindwa na Marines FC ibitego 2-1. Hanyuma APR FC yegukanye igikombe cya Premier League kuri 24 Gicurasi ubwo yatsindaga Muhazi United igitego 1-0, mu gihe Rayon Sports yanganyije na Vision FC ku busa. Iyintsinzi yahaye APR amanota animbere ya Rayon hasigaye umukino umwe gusa ngo irangire. Intambara yokwirinda umwanya wakabiri wo kumanuka mu cyiciro cya kabiri yagiye kumunsi wanyuma, ubwo Amagaju yahuraga na Muhazi United, ifite amanota atatu imbere y'abo bahanganye. Amagaju yatsinze umukino ibitego 2-1, igabanya Muhazi ijya mucyiciro cyakabiri.
Igikombe cya APR cyaricya 23 muri rusange muri shampiyona y'u Rwanda - cyongereye agahigo kabo - ndetse n'igikombe cya 6 cyikurikiranya muntangiriro za 2020. Barangije kandi igikombe cya kabiri cya shampiyona n'igikombe, ndetse batwaye igikombe cy'u Rwanda cyo muri 2024-25.
Umuhango wo gutanga ibihembo wabereye muri Kigali Convention Centre kuri 30 Gicurasi 2025, murwego rwoguha icyubahiro abakinnyi bagize uruhare runini mumwaka wa 2024-25. Clement Niyigena womuri APR yegukanye igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza, Djibirl Ouattara womuri APR na Umar Abba womuri Bugesera nabo bari mumarushanwa yo guhatanira igihembo. Niyigena kandi yari yatwaye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'irushanwa rya Kagame Interclub Cup 2024 mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa shampiyona.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye imikino y’isi ya gisirikare ya 2019 yabereye i Wuhan mu Bushinwa kuva kuri 18 kugeza kuri 27 Ukwakira 2019. Muri rusange, abakinnyi bahagarariye u Rwanda begukanye umudari umwe wa bronze, maze igihugu kirangiza kumwanya wa 56 kurutonde rw’imidari.

Clementine Mukandanga (wavutse 8 Ukuboza 1985) numukinnyi wamarato mu Rwanda.
Mu 2014, yitabiriye imikino ya Commonwealth Games ya 2014 kumunota wa 34:12:31 ubwo yarangizaga kumwanya wacumi mumukino wanyuma w’abagore wa metero 10000 i Glasgow. Mukandanga yatsinze irushanwa rya siporo rya kilometero 5 rizwi nka 'Christmas Run' ryabereye kuri Sitade y’Igihugu y’Amahoro mu Kuboza 2014.
Mukandanga yarangije aruwa gatandatu mukwiruka metero 10.000 mu mikino ya Afurika yabereye muri Repubulika ya Kongo mu 2015. Yitabiriye irushanwa rya Afurika ry’abakinnyi bakuru ryabereye i Durban mu 2016, aho yarangije ari uwa karindwi mu isiganwa rya metero 10.000 ndetse akuzuza ibisabwabyo kwitabira imikino Olempike yo mumpeshyi ya 2016 bitewe n’uko yitwayeneza. Mu 2017, yegukanye irushanwa rya 10 ry’u Rwanda. km kwambukiranya igihugu muri Kicukiro.
Mu 2018, yarangijaruwa gatatu muri Marathon ya Firenze mazeyuzuza ibisabwa mu irushanwa ry’isi, yirutse iminota 2 n’iminota 30 n’iminota 50. Yitabiriye i Doha muri Shampiyona y’Isi ya Siporo yo mu 2019. Mu 2020, yatsinze Marathon ya Varma muri Bulugariya akoresheje iminota 2 n’iminota 35 n’iminota 14.
Mukandanga yashyizeho igihembo cya 2:25:54 kugirangoyegukane Marathon ya Firenze mu Gushyingo 2023. Ibibyaribyihutacyane ugereranyije n'iminota ibiri yari afite mbere y'umwaka wabanjirije uwo, ndetse n'icyabereye i Firenze, aho yarangije ari uwa gatatu.
Mukandanga afite icyicaro i Siena, mu Butaliyani.

Daphrose Nyiramutuzo (yavutse 1 Nzeri 1972) numunyarwanda wiruka hagati.
Mu 1987, Nyiramutuzo yitabiriye imikino y'Afurika yo Hagati yabereye i Brazzaville, muri Repubulika ya Kongo, yegukana umudariwa feza mwisiganwa ry’abagore ryametero 1500 akoresheje iminota 4 n'iminota 38.5.
Nyiramutuzo yanasiganwaga mukwiruka metero 1500 mu bagore ndetse nomu kwiruka metero 3000 mu bagore mumikino Olempike yomumpeshyi yabereye i Seoul muri Koreya y'Epfo mu 1988.

Laurence Niyonsaba (wavutse ku ya 14 Kamena 1973) n'umukinnyi w’Umunyarwanda wiruka intera yohagati. Yitabiriye irushanwa rya metero 1500 mubagore mumikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1992.
Niyonsaba niwewenyine wasiganwaga metero 1500 washoboye guhagararira u Rwanda mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1992. Muriyomikino, Niyonsaba yarangijaruwa 11 mugihe yarafite imbaraganyinshi, ananirwa kujyamumikino yanyuma.
Muri Mata 1993, Niyonsabayashyizeho agahigo k'igihugu cy'u Rwanda ko gusiganwa metero 1000 mwirushanwa ryabereye i Saint-Maur mu Bufaransa mumupira w'amaguru. Nyumay'uwo mwaka, yujuje ibisabwa mukwiruka metero 800 na metero 1500 mu irushanwa ry'isi rya 1993 mu mikino ngororamubiri. Yarangije aruwa 6 mugusiganwa metero 800 nokumwanya wa 12 mu gusiganwa metero 1500, ananirwa gukomeza murayomarushanwa yombi.

Isonga FC nikipe yumupira wamaguru yu Rwanda, ifite icyicaro i Kigali.
Iyikipe yashinzwe mu 2011.
Muri Kamena 2013, ikipeyarekuye ikipeyayoyose nyuma yo gusezererwa muri Primus National Football League.

Umukino wa nyuma wa shampiyona nyafurika BAL 2024, wari umukino wa shampiyona y'umwaka wa 2024 muri BAL, mu mwaka wa gatatu wa Basketball nyafurika (BAL), ndetse n'isozwa ry'imikino ya nyuma. Umukino wa nyuma wabaye ku ya 1 Kamena 2024 kuri BK Arena i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Umukino wa nyuma wahuje ikipe yo muri Angola Petro de Luanda n'ikipe yo muri Libiya Al Ahly Ly.
Petro de Luada yatsinze Al Ahly Ly ku manota 107–94, yegukana igikombe cya BAL ndetse n'igikombe cya gatatu k'umugabane w'afurika, harimo n'igikombe cya FIBA afurika. Mu kubikora, babaye kandi ikipe ya mbere yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara yegukanye igikombe cya BAL. Nk'abatsinze, kandi Petro de Luanda, yegukanye igikombe cya FIBA cyo muri 2024.
Petro de Luanda abaye ikipe ya kabiri yakinnye imikino ibiri ya nyuma ya BAL, yikurikiranya gusa amaze gukina no gutsindwa imikino muri 2022. Al Ahly Ly niyo kipe ya mbere yo muri Libiya yakinnye umukino wanyuma, ndetse nitsinda rya mbere ryujuje ibisabwa binyuze mu majonjora yo mu muhanda ugana BAL muri shampiyona imwe yakinnye umukino wanyuma.

Imikino ya 2022 BAL Playoffs yari iya kabiri mumikino yanyuma ya Basketball Africa League (BAL) kandi yari irushanwa ryanyuma ry’umwaka wa 2022 BAL. Imikino yanyuma yatangiye kuri 21 Gicurasi 2022 irangira kuri 28 Gicurasi 2022 hamwe n’imikino ya nyuma. Mumwaka wa kabiri wikurikiranya, imikino yose yanyuma yakinwe muri [Arena i Kigali, mu Rwanda.

Inzego ziyobora imikino itandukanye izwi ku isi:
Sosiyoloji ya siporo.
Sosiologiya ya siporo ni igice cy’isomo ry’imibereho y’abantu kigamije kwiga siporo hifashishijwe imiterere y’amatsinda n’imico itandukanye. Uru rwego rwanasuzumye uburyo amacakubiri atandukanye hagati y’ibitsina mu mikino ashobora kugira ingaruka ku matsinda y’abagore.
Imitekerereze y'abantu ku mikino.
Imitekerereze ya siporo ni inyigo y'uburyo ibintu byo mu mutwe bishobora kugira ingaruka ku kwitabira siporo z'umwuga n'imyidagaduro, ndetse n'uburyo siporo igira ingaruka ku miterere y'imitekerereze y'umukinnyi. Nyuma yo gukundwa cyane mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, ubu ni ishami rya siyansi rizwi kandi rijyanye n'imikino myinshi itandukanye. Abahanga mu by'imitekerereze ya siporo bo muri iki gihe bakunze gukoresha uburyo bwo gushyiraho intego, ubuhanga bwo kureba ibintu mu buryo bugezweho n'uburyo bwo gukora mbere y'uko abakinnyi bagera ku ntego zabo.

Denis Omedi (wavutse kuya 13 Kamena 1994) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umunya-Uganda ukina nka rutahizamu mwikipe ya APR yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'u Rwanda ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda.
Omedi yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri Booma FC iherereye mukarere ka Masindi, nyumaza kujya muri Kitara FC kuvamu 2023 kugeza 2024, azanokujya mwikipe ya APR FC yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda mu 2025, yatsinze ibitego 15 muri Uganda Premier League. Omedi yahawe igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'ukwezi kwa Gashyantare 2024, mubihembo bya Real Stars Awards byabereye i Lugogo.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Omedi yakinnyimikino icumi muri Uganda Cranes, yatsinzibitego bitatu anatanga imipira ine ivamo ibitego. Denis Omedi yafashije Uganda kubonumwanya mwirushanwa rya Afurika ry’ibihugu 2025 rizabera muri Maroc, yatsinze igitego kimwe ubwo yakinaga na Bafana Bafana mu mukino wo gushaka itike ya AFCON 2025 warangiye banganya ibitego 2-2.
Ibihembo n'ibitaramo.
Omedi yatowe mwirushanwa rya FIFA Puskas Award 2024 kubera igitego cye cya rabona yatsinze KCCA mu irushanwa rya FUFA Super 8. Ikigitego kizahatanirwa mubandi bakinnyi 10 barimo Hassan Al Haydos, Terry Antonis, Yassine Benzia, Walter Bou, Michaell Chirinos, Federico Dimarco, Alejandro Garnacho, Mohammed Kudus, Jaden Philogene na Paul Onuachu. Igitego cya rabona cyanatowe mu cyiciro cy’Intego y’Umwaka mubihembo bya CAF Awards 2024, bityo kikaba aricyogitego cyonyine hamwe n’umupira Benzia yatsinzemo Algeria kuri Afurika y'Epfo, cyahawe imyanya yombi ya CAF na Puskas.
Mubihembo bya FIFA Puskás Awards bya 2024, rutahizamu wa Kitara FC na Uganda Cranes yarangije ari uwa gatatu n'amanota 16 yose hamwe. Gutoranywa kwekwishimira igitego cyecya rabona yatsinze kuri KCCA FC. Ikigihembo cyahawumukinnyi wa Manchester United na Argentine Alejandro Garnacho, igitegocyecyamuhesheje umwanya wambere n'amanota 26, gikurikirwa n'igitego cya Yassine Benzia kur'Afurika y'Epfo, cyabonye amanota 22.
Byongeye kandi, Omedi yarimubahatanira ibihembo bya CAF bya 2024, ahoyatorewe umwanya woguhatanira igihembo cy'intsinzi y'umwaka. Nubwoyitwaye nezacyane, yabaye uwagatandatu mu matora n'amajwi 13.766. Iki gihembo cyatsindiwe na Mabululu wo muri Angola. Kuba Omedi yarashyizwe muri ibi bihembo by'icyubahiro byatumye amenyekana cyane kandi yongera amahirwe yeyokugura abakinnyi. Amasezerano yey'akazi muri Kitara FC azarangira mu mpera z'uyu mwaka wa 2024, kandi asanzwe afitamakipe aturutse muri Esipanye, Pyramids FC yo muri Misiri na Gor Mahia yomuri Kenya. Yanabonye amakipaturutse muri Afurika y'Epfo na Libiya kuva mwirushanwa ryokugura abakinnyi ryabanje.

Kongere ya 73 ya FIFA yabereye muri BK Arena i Kigali, mu Rwanda, ku ya 16 Werurwe 2023.
Amatora ya perezida yo mu 2023.
Kuya 31 Werurwe 2022, munama ya 72 ya FIFA yabereye i Doha, Perezida wa FIFA ucyuye igihe Gianni Infantino yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya gatatu. Nyuma y'itariki ntarengwa yoku ya 18 Ugushyingo 2022, niwemukandida wenyine, bityo atsindamatora ashima.

Imikino ya Paralempike y'Imbeho nirushanwa mpuzamahangarihuza abakinnyi bafitubumuga bw'umubiri, amaso, n'ubwonko ahobarushanwa mumikino y'urubura n'urubura. Irirushanwa ririmo abakinnyi bafitubumuga bwokugenda, ubumuga bwogucikamibice, ubumuga bwokutabona, n'ubumuga bwo mu bwonko. Imikino ya Paralempike y'Imbeho iba buri myaka ine nyuma y'imikino Olempike y'Imbeho kandi (kuva mu 1992) yaberaga muruwomujyi. Komite Mpuzamahanga y'Imikino ya Paralempike (IPC) igenzura iyimikino. Imidari itangwa muriburi irushanwa: zahabu kumwanya wambere, feza kuwa kabiri, n'umuringa kuwa gatatu, hakurikijwe umuco w'uko imikino Olempike yatangiye mu 1904.
Imikino ya Paralympic y'itumba yatangiye mu 1976 i Örnsköldsvik, muri Suwede. Iyomikino niyo ya mbere Paralympic yagaragayemo abakinnyi batari abagendera kuntebe z'abamugaye. Imikino yagutse kandi ikura, harimo n'imikino ya Paralympic y'impeshyi, ibigice cy'imikino mpuzamahanga minini nyuma ya Olempike. Bitewe n'uko yagutse, hakenewe uburyo bwihariye bwo gushyira mu byiciro. Ububuryo kandi bwatejimpaka kandi bufungura inzira zitandukanye zogukopera, byangije ubunyangamugayo bw'imikino.
Noruveje yabayigihugu kiri kumwanya wambere (imidari) mumikino ine ya Paralempike y'itumba: 1980, 1988, 1994, na 1998. Ubudage bwabaye igihugu kiri kumwanya wambere (imidari) mu mikino itatu ya Paralempike y'itumba: 1976, 2002, na 2010. Uburusiya (2006 na 2014) na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika (1992 na 2018) byabaye igihugu kiri ku mwanya wa mbere inshuro ebyiri buri kimwe. Otirishiya (1984) n'Ubushinwa (2022) byabaye igihugu kiri kumwanya wa mbere inshuro imwe buri kimwe.
Inkomoko y'imikino ya Paralympic y'itumba isacyane n'imikino ya Paralympic y'impeshyi. Abasirikare bakomeretse bavuye mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yosebashakaga siporo nk'inzira yo gukira. Yateguwe na Dr. Ludwig Guttmann, amarushanwa y'imikino hagati y'ibitaro by'Abongereza byakiraga indwara yatangiyemu 1948 akomeza kugeza mu 1960 ubwimikino Olempike yaberaga i Roma nyuma y'imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1960. Abakinnyi b'amagare barenga 400 bitabiriye imikino ya Paralympic yo mu 1960, yajekwitwa Paralympic ya mbere.
Sepp Zwicknagl, watangije imikino yogusiganwa kurubura kubakinnyi bafite ubumuga, yari umukinnyi wo gusiganwa ku rubura wo muri Otirishiya ufite amaguru abiri, wagerageje gusiganwa ku rubura akoresheje ibyuma bisimbura. Akazi ke kafashije abantu bafite ubumuga kwitabira imikino yo mu gihe cy'itumba. Iterambere ryagenze buhoro, kandi nibwo mu 1974 habaye irushanwa rya mbere ryemewe ku isi ku bakinnyi bafite ubumuga, ryarimo gusiganwa ku misozi no gusiganwa ku maguru. Imikino yambere y’abamugaye yabereye mugihe cy'itumba mu 1976 i Örnsköldsvik, muri Suwede kuva ku ya 21 kugeza ku ya 28 Gashyantare. Imikino yogusiganwa ku rubura mumisozi miremire no mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba nibyo byari ingenzi ariko gusiganwa kurubura byashyizwemo nk'igikorwa cyokwerekana. Hari abakinnyi 198 bitabiriye baturutse mu bihugu 16, kandi ni bwo bwa mbere abakinnyi bafite ubumuga uretse abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bw'ibimuga bemerewe gusiganwa.
Guhera mu 1988, imikino Olempike y'abamugaye yomu mpeshyi yabereye mumujyi umwe n'imikino Olempike y'impeshyi. Ibibyatewe n'amasezerano yagiranyehagati ya Komite Mpuzamahanga Olempike (IOC) na Komite Mpuzamahanga y'abamugaye (IPC). Imikino ya Paralempike y'imbeho yo mu 1992 ni yoyambere mumikino y'imbeho yakoresheje ibikoresho bimwe n'imikino Olempike y'imbeho.
Abakinnyi bakopfoye cyanemukugaragaza ubumuga kugira ngobagire amahirwe yoguhangana, no gukoresha imiti yongerimbaraga. Umudagukina skiing Thomas Oelsner yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa Paralympian mugihe cy'itumba wapimwe imiti ya steroide mu 2002. Yariyaratsindiye imidari ibiriya zahabu mumikino yomumisozi miremire arikoyambuwe imidari ye. Imwemu mpungenge abayobozi ba Paralympic ububahanganye nuburyo bwokongera umuvuduko w'amaraso, buzwi nka autonomic dysreflexia. Ukwiyongera k'umuvuduko w'amaraso gushobora kongera imikorere kukigero cya 15% kandi ningirakamaro cyane mumikino yokwihangana nko gusiganwa ku maguru. Kongera umuvuduko w'amaraso abakinnyi baterihungabana kumaguru nkana munsi y'igikomere cy'umugongo. Iri hungabana rishobora kuba ririmo kuvunika amagufwa, guhambira ingingo cyane nogukoresha amasogisi yogukandacyane. Imvunentibabaza umukinnyi ariko igira ingaruka ku mubiri kandi igira ingaruka ku muvuduko w'amaraso w'umukinnyi, kimwe n'uburyo bushobora gukoreshwa nkokureka uruhago rukazura cyane.
Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Imikino y’Abamugaye (IPC) yasanze ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko uburyo bwo gusiganwa ku maguru bwakozwe mu mikino y’abamugaye yo mu gihe cy’itumba ya 2014 i Sochi. Kuya 7 Kanama 2016, Inama Nyobozi ya IPC yatoye kumugaragaro kwikipe yose y’Uburusiya ibujijwe kwitabira imikino y’abamugaye yo mu mpeshyi ya 2016, ivuga ko Komite y’Imikino y’Abamugaye y’Uburusiya idashobora gushyira mubikorwa Itegeko rya IPC ryokurwanya imiti ikoreshwa mu gusiganwa ku maguru n’Itegeko Mpuzamahanga ryo kurwanya imiti ikoreshwa mugusiganwa kumaguru, ariryo "gisabwa n’itegeko nshinga". Perezida wa IPC, Sir Philip Craven, yavuze ko guverinoma y’Uburusiya "yananiwe cyane abakinnyi bayo ba Para". Perezida w’Inama y’Abakinnyi ba IPC, Todd Nicholson, yavuzeko Uburusiya bwakoresheje abakinnyi nk'"abakoresha imbaraga" kugira ngo "byerekane ubuhanga ku isi".
Ibyiciro by'abafite ubumuga.
IPC yashyizeho ibyicirobitandatu by'abafite ubumuga birebimikino y'abafite ubumuga yomu mpeshyi n'iy'itumba. Abakinnyi bafitebumwe murububumuga bw'umubiri bashobora kwitabira imikino y'abafite ubumuga, nubwo atari buri siporo ishobora kwemerera buricyiciro cy'abafite ubumuga.
Gushyira mu byiciro.
Mubyiciro bitandatu by'abafitubumuga, abakinnyi bagombakugabanywa hakurikijwe urwego rw'ubumugabwabo. Uburyo bwo gushyira mubyiciro butandukanye bitewe n'imikino. Uburyo bugenewe gufungura imikino ya Paralympic ku bakinnyi benshi bashoboka, bashobora kwitabira amarushanwa atunganye n'abakinnyi bafite ubushobozi bumwe. Ibintubingana cyane mu marushanwa y'abadafite ubumuga ni ibyiciro by'imyaka mu mikino y'abana bato, n'ibiro mu mikino yokurwana, guterana iteramakofe, noguterura ibiremereye. Ibyiciro biratandukanye hakurikijwe ubuhanga butandukanye busabwa kugira ngo umuntu akore uyumukino. Ikibazo gikomeye muri gahunda yogushyira mubyiciro nuburyobwo gusobanurubwoko bwinshi n'uburemere bw'ubumuga. Kubera iyompamvu, hazabaho ubumuga butandukanye mucyicirorunaka. Ibikurikira ni urutonde rw'imikino ya Paralympic y'itumba n'uburyo ishyirwa mubyiciro.
Gusiganwa kurubura mumisozi miremire: Haribintu bibiri mugusiganwa kurubura mumisozi miremire: slalom na slalom nini. Gusiganwa ku rubura mu misozi miremire byakira abakinnyi bafite ubumugabukurikira: imvune z'umugongo, indwara zomubwonko, gucibwa ibice by'umubiri, "Les Autres" n'ubumuga bwo kutabona neza. Hariibyiciro cumi na kimwe, birindwi kubakinnyi bahagaze, bitatu ku bakinnyi bicaye, na bitatu kubakinnyi bafitubumuga bwokutabona. Ibyiciro bigenwa n'urwego rw'imikorere y'abakinnyi n'ibikenewe kubikoresho bibafasha (prosthesis, inkingi zo gusiganwa ku rubura, nibindi). Umusaraba wa Snowboard ubu uri muri iki cyiciro, nubwo amarushanwa azabaho gusa mu byiciro bike (reba hepfo).
Biathlon: Biathlon nuruhurirane rw'imikino yogusiganwa kurubura hamwenokurasa intego. Bisaba imbaraga z'umubiri nokurasaneza. Ibibirori bifunguye kubakinnyi bafitubumuga bw'umubiri n'ubumuga bwokutabona. Haribyiciro cumi na bitanu ahwabakinnyi bazashyirwamo bitewe n'urwego rw'imikorere yabo. Ibyiciro cumi na bibiri ni iby'abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bw'umubiri naho bitatu ni iby'abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Abakinnyi barushanwa hamwe, kandi igihe cyo kurangiza gishyirwa muburyo bw'icyiciro cyabo cy'ubumuga kugira ngo hamenyekane uko abakinnyi barangiza muri rusange. Abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwokutabona bashobora guhatana binyuze mu gukoresha ibimenyetso by'amajwi. Ubukana bw'ibimenyetso buratandukanye bitewe niba umukinnyi arikuntego cyangwa atari yo.
Gusiganwa ku rubura mu misozi miremire: Gusiganwa kurubura mumisozi miremire, bizwi kandi nka Nordic skiing, bifunguye ku bakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, ubumuga bwo kutabona neza nokutabona neza. Hariho ibyiciro cumi na bitanu, bitatu ku bakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona neza, icyenda kubakinnyi bahagaze na bitatu kubakinnyi bicaye. Ibyiciro bigenwa mu buryo bumwe no gusiganwa kurubura mu misozi miremire hibandwa ku rwego rw'imikorere y'abakinnyi n'uburyo bakeneye ibikoresho bibafasha.
Hoki yo mu Rubura: Hoki yomu Rubura ifunguye gusakubakinnyi bafite ubumuga bw'umubiri mu gice cyohasi cy'umubiri wabo. Kuva mu 2010 yabaye umukinuvanze n'ibitsina mumikino Paralympique y'itumba, ariko abakinnyi b'abagore baracyari bake Uyu mukino ukinwa hakoreshejwe amategeko mpuzamahanga ya hoki hamwe n'impinduka zimwe na zimwe. Abakinnyi bicara ku rubura rufite ibyuma bibiri byemerera puck kujya munsi y'urubura. Bakoresha kandi inkoni ebyiri, zifite icyuma gisunika n'icyuma gifata amasasu. Abakinnyi bashyizwe mu matsinda atatu: itsinda rya 1 ni iry'abakinnyi badafiticyuma gifata amasasu cyangwa bafite ubumuga bukomeye mu ngingo zo hejuru no hasi, itsinda rya 2 ni iry'abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwo kwicara n'ubumuga buciriritse mugingo zabonaho abakinnyi bomwitsinda rya 3 bafite uburinganire bwiza n'ubumuga buciriritse mungingo zabo zohejuru nohasi.
Gusimbuka kw'abamugaye: Gusimbuka kw'abamugaye nigikorwa cy'ikipe y'abakinnyi bafite ubumuga buhoraho bwo hasibubasaba gukoresha intebe y'abamugaye mubuzima bwabobwa buri munsi. Abakinnyi bafitubumuga bwomumutwe cyangwindwara ya Sclerosis nyinshi nabo bashobora gukina iyo bakoresheje intebe y'abamugaye. Gutanga ibuye bishobora gukorwa hakoreshejwe intoki cyangwahakoreshejwe inkingi. Ntabyiciro biharimuri ikigikorwa uretseko abakinnyi bose bitabiriye bagomba kuba bakeneye intebe y'abamugaye kugira ngo bashobore kugenda buri munsi.
Para snowboard: Kuya 2 Gicurasi 2012, Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Imikino y’Abamugaye (IPC) yemeje kumugaragaro Para snowboarding (yahoze yitwa "adaptive snowboarding") nk'umudari mu mikino ya Para snowboarding yo mu gihe cy'itumba ya 2014 munsi ya Alpine Skiing. Habayeho amarushanwa yo gusiganwa ku rubura kubagabo n'abagore. Irushanwa rya mbere ry’imikino y’abamugaye ryabereyemo abakinnyi bafite ubumuga bw’amaguru yo hasi gusa. Abakinnyi baciwe ingingo bemerewe kwambara icyuma gikingira. Ibirori byabereye mu buryo bw’igihe, ariko nta buryo bwakozwe hashingiwe kurwego rw’ubumuga bw’umukinnyi. Mumikino y’abamugaye yo mu gihe cy'itumba ya 2018, umubare w’imikino wariyongereye uva kuri 2 ugera kuri 10, aho ibice by’amaguru yo hasi byagabanyijwemo amatsinda abiri (LL-1 kubafite ubumuga bukomeye na LL-2 ku bafite ubumuga buke), ndetse no kongeramo slalom ya banki. Irushanwa ryo gusiganwa ku rubura ryakozwe muburyo bwoguhangana n’itsinda ry’abakinnyi (snowboard cross) hamwe n’amarushanwa menshi yo gukubitana kugirangohamenyekane abatsinze imidari. Mu 2022, hongeweho amarushanwa ku bakinnyi bafite ubumuga bwohejuru, ariko IPC yakuyeho icyiciro cya LL-1 cy’abagore kubera ibura ry’abakinnyi muri iryotsinda. Abobakinnyi babanje kubuzwa nagato kwitabira irushanwa kugeza ubwo Brenna Huckaby womuri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yatsinze mu rubanza rwo "guhangana" n’itsinda rya LL-2.
Urutonde rw'imikino Paralempike.
Hari igihe imikino itandukanye yagiye iba igice cya gahunda ya Paralympic.
Imbonerahamwe y'imidari y'ibihe byose.
Dukurikije amakuruyemewe ya Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Imikino y’Abamugaye. Iyi mbonerahamwe igaragaza ibihugu 20 byambere, hakurikijwe umubare wazahabu, hanyuma ifeza, hanyuma umuringa.
Urutonde rw'imikino ya Paralympic y'itumba.

AKAMARO K'UTUREMANGINGO
Uturemangingondodo cyangwa Fibres mu ndimi z’amahanga ni ubwoko bw’ibiribwa bibarirwa mu binyamasukari, bikaba ari ingenzi mu mubiri w’umuntu kuko bifasha igogora ry’ibiryo ndetse no kugabanya ibyago byo kurwara indwara zitandukanye zirimo iz’umutima, diyabete, kanseri ndetse n’izindi ndwara zangiza amara..
Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bagaragaza ko utu turemangingondodo cyangwa Fibres zigabanijemo ibice bibiri ari byo: Uturemangingondodo tuyenga mu mazi (Fibres Soluble) dufasha mu kugabanya ingano ya Cholesterol igihe yabaye nyinshi mu mubi, n’uturemangingondodo tutayenga ni ukuvuga tutivanga mu mazi tugafasha ibindi biryo guca mu rwungano ngogozi tugasukura amara ndetse tukanayarinda kwangirika kwa hato na hato.
Ushobora kwibaza ingano y’utu turemangingondodo ukwiye gufata ku munsi, dore igisubizo:
Amakuru dukesha ikigo cy’abahanga mu by’ubuvuzi Institute of medicine avuga ko nibura: Abagore bagomba gufata garama g 25 ku munsi, Abagabo bagomba gufata g 38, Abana bari hagati y’imyaka 5-11 bagomba gufata g 20, Abana bari hagati y’imyaka 12-16 bagomba g25 naho guhera ku myaka 16 kuzamura bagomba gufata g30.
Ese utu turemangingondodo wadukurahe?
Hamwe mu ho abashakashatsi bagaragaje hashobora kuboneka fibre ni: Inkeri, amacunga, indimu, imineke, inanasi, pome, karoti, ibijumba, ibirayi, amashu, amashaza n’ibishyimbo, Soya, ibigori, ubunyobwa, amapera n’imboga. Abashakashatsi bavuga ko uramutse ufashe ibi biribwa neza ntaho ushobora guhurira n’ikibazo cy’impatwe, indwara zifata amara, diabete n’izindi.

Ubuhinzi bw'urutoki mu karere kacu bukorerwa kuri hegitari ibihumbi 25, hirya no hino mu mirenge,bukaba bwigange cyane mu Murenge wa Mushikiri. Muri iki gihe cy'impeshyi cyangwa mu Ki umusaruro w'uurutoki nubwo uba uboneka cyane; Bifasha abaturage kwihaza mu biribwa no kwiteza imbere mu bukangu.

Ibidukikije: ni buri kintu cyose cyizengurutse uyu mubumbe dutuyemo mubuzima bwacu bwa buri munsi.
Mu Rwanda hashyizweho ibigo bitandukanye byo kubungabunga ibidukikije ndetse hatangizwa umunsi nyamukuru wo kubibungabunga.
Watangiye Mu mwaka wa 1972 uyu munsi ukaba wizihizwa kuri buri tariki 05 zaburi mwaka.Buri mwaka u Rwanda narwo rufatanya n’amahanga kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ibidukikije, uyu munsi ukaba ubanzirizwa n’icyumweru k’ibidukikije. Muri uyu mwaka, iki cyumweru kikazasozwa ku tariki 25/05-05/06/2013 hanizihizwa umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ibidukikije.Mu mwaka wa 2010, Mu Rwanda bakiriye ku rwego rw’isi, umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ibidukikije. Akaba ari amateka abantu batazibagirwa mu Rwanda, ubwo intumwa zo mu bihugu bitandukanye byo ku isi byifatanyaga n’u Rwanda mubirori byakomatanijwe hamwe n’umunsi wo kwita izina abana bi ngagi.

Forever Living Products (FLP) is a U.S.-based multi-level marketing (MLM) company founded in 1978 by Rex Maughan. The company is best known for its aloe Vera–based health, wellness, and skincare products.
Forever Living Products is a multi-level marketing company which was founded in 1978 in Tempe, Arizona by Rex Maughan. The company has reported a network of 9.3 million distributors and revenue of $4 billion in 2021, and in 2006 they reported having 4,100 employees.
Forever Living was founded in 1978 in Tempe, Arizona by Rex Maughan. By the 1990s, Rex Maughan had purchased the Texas company Aloe Vera of America, with Aloe Vera of America selling its products to Forever Living for distribution. Some journalists have likened the multi-level marketing business model of Forever Living's distribution system to that of a pyramid scheme.
In 1983, the company was named No. 6 on "Inc. Magazine"'s annual Inc. 500 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States.
