Albert Roger Miller (wavutse kuya 20 Gicurasi 1952), uzwi kwizina rya Roger Milla, ni Umunyakameruni wahozari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigizumwuga wakinnye nk'umukinnyi wa mbere. Yari umwe mu bakinnyi ba mbere b'Abanyafurika babaye icyamamare gikomeye ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Yakinnye mu bikombe bitatu by'isi mwikipe y'igihugu ya Kameruni.
Yageze kurwegompuzamahanga afitimyaka 38, iyomyaka abakinnyibenshi barutahizamu bagiye mukiruhuko cy'izabukuru, atsindibitego bine mugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990, aba umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mu mateka y'igikombe cy'isi icyo gihe. Yafashije Kameruni kuba ikipe ya mbere y'Afurika kugera murikimwe cyakane cy'irushanwa ry'igikombe cy'isi. Nyuma y'imyaka ine, afitimyaka 42, Milla yatsinze agahigoke nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mu gikombe cy'isi ubwo yatsindaga Uburusiya mugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1994.
Milla yakundaga kwishimira ibitego yiruka kwibendera ry'imfuruka akanabyina imbyino isa n'iya lambada. Mu 2004, Pelé yashyizwe kurutonde rwa FIFA rw'abakinnyi 100 bakomeye kwisi. Mu 2007, Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru muri Afurika ryashyizeho Milla nk'umukinnyi mwiza w'umunyafurika mumyaka 50 ishize. Mugihecyogusezera, yafatwaga nk'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mukarere k'Afurika mu mikino yanyuma y'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA aho yatsinze ibitego bitanu, kandagahigo kekaza gusimburwa n'umukinnyi wa Ghana Asamoah Gyan.
Icyemezo cye cy'amavuko ndetse na pasiporo yebigaragaza koyitwa Roger Miller bitewe n'ikosa ry'umwanditsi nokutumvikana. Ababyeyibe bashakaga kumuhizina ry'umuryango wa nyirarume 'Milla' ubwo yavukaga. Yakundaga kwitwa Miller igihecyose yagaragaye mumikino mpuzamahanga ikomeye, impapuro z'ibarurishamibare zimuvugaho ubwo Miller yavugaga byinshi kuburyo izina ryeryari ryaravuzwe nabikandi rikamenyekana nabi mumiryango mpuzamahanga. Umuryangowe wimukiye i Douala afitimyaka 11.
Se yakoraga kumihanda yagariyamoshi, naho Milla agiramahirwe yokuzenguruka igihugucyose inshuro nyinshi mubwanabwe. Yakuriye mumihanda ya Yaoundé kandiyakomokaga mumuryango usanzwe w’abantu bomucyiciro cy’abakene kuburyo ababyeyibe bashoboye kumuha uburere buhagije. Ariko, ababyeyibe ntibashimishijwenokubonako Milla arimogushakumupira w’amaguru, maze batangira kwanga kwemera ko umuhungu wabo akina umukino w’umupira w’amaguru.
Yize ubuhanga bwogukinumupira w'amaguru atambayinkweto arikumwe n'abandi banamu mihanda y'igitaka nomumihanda, kandakenshi yakinagafite agacupa k'umuhondo cyangwa agacupa nk'uburyo bwo gusimbura umupira. Yari afite kandi akamenyero ko gutera indimu n'udutambaro dufatanye mumipira. We n'abandi bana bagombaga gukinira mu bibuga byuzuye ivumbi kubera ko muri Kameruni nta mashuri y'abana yari yarashinze amashuri makuru y'umupira w'amaguru icyo gihe kandi muri Kameruni ntabibuga byiza byari bifite kandi nta n'ubushobozi bwo kugira abatoza bafite uburenganzira bwo kugira. Byagaragayeko Milla yakinagumupira w'amaguru murwegorwo kwidagaduragusa, kwishimisha no kwidagadura kandi ko atatekereje cyane kubigira umwuga we, maze akomeza kunoza ubuhanga bwe mumupira w'amaguru mubiruhuko by'ishuri.
Roger Milla ubweyavuzeko yarangije amashuri yisumbuye arikibyoyavuze byanenzwe nabamwe mubanditsi bomuri Kameruni. Afite abavandimwe batatu bafite amazina atandukanye nka Joseph Debouba, Jacques Edjanque na Alexandre Diboussi. Yagiye kureka siporo nyuma y'urupfu rwa nyina mu rugo mu gihe yakinaga umupira w'amaguru mukibuga cyakure ndetse nokubera ko umugorewe yaratwite ubwo aba bombi bari bategereje umwana wabo wa kabiri.
Imyaka yo mu ntangiriro.
Yakiniyikipe y’abanabatoya Eclair de Douala afitimyaka 13, yitabira amarushanwa y’ishuri gusa. Nyumayaje kwemeza ababyeyibe nyumayo kwitwara neza mumikino y’imyaka.
Yakinnye bwambere mwikipe y’abakuruya Eclair de Douala mucyiciro cyakabiri cya shampiyona ya Kameruni afitimyaka 15. Nyuma y’imyakibiri, afitimyaka 17, yabayumukinnyi wa shampiyona yogusimbuka cyane mumashuriyo muri Kameruni. Yasinyamasezerano mwikipe y’icyiciro cya mbere ya Léopard Douala mu 1970 afite imyaka 18, amaherezo yegukana ibikombe bitatu bya shampiyona ya Kameruni muriyokipe. Yanatsinze ibitego 89 mumikino 116 yakinnye muri Léopard Douala mu gihe cy’imyaka ine. Nyuma y’aho yerekeje muri Tonnerre Yaoundé mu 1974 nyuma y’imyaka ine amaze akinaneza muri Léopard Douala. Yatwayigikombe cy'Afurika cy’abatsinze ibikombe muri Tonnerre Yaoundé, naho mu ikipe ya Tonnerre Yaoundé atsinda ibitego 69 mu mikino 87.
Kwimukira mu Bufaransa.
Yimukiye mu Bufaransa afitimyaka 25 mu 1977 ahoyamaze imyaka 12 akiniramakipe atandukanye. Mu 1977, yakuruwe n'ikipe yomu Bufaransa ya Valenciennes ajya i Burayi. Aho yatsinzibitego 6 mumikino 28 ya shampiyona mumyakibiri. Mu 1979, yinjiye muri AS Monaco, aho yatwaye igikombe cy'Ubufaransa mu 1980 anatsinda ibitego 5 mumikino 25 ya shampiyona n'igikombe. Yari yaragize ibibazo byinshi by'imvune mugihegito yamazemuri shampiyona, maze abayobozi b'ikipe ye bahitamo kumurekura mu mpera z'umwaka w'imikino. Umwaka wakurikiyeho, yinjiye muri Bastia, aho yamaze imyaka ine. Milla yatsinze ibitego 42 mu mikino 133 y'amarushanwa kandi yagize uruhare runini mu gufasha ikipe gutwara igikombe cy'Ubufaransa mu 1981.
Nyuma y’ahoyerekeje muri Saint-Etienne mu 1984, abumunyamuryango ukomeyew’iyikipe, yari irimo gukiranyuma y’ikibazo gikomeye cya ruswa mu 1982 ndetse no kumanuka mu cyiciro cya 2, nyuma yo kugurisha abakinnyi benshi bambere. Murirusange yakinnyimikino 69 muriyi kipe atsinda ibitego 36, anagira uruhare mugufasha iyikipe kongerakwinjira mucyiciro cyambere. Hanyuma yakinnye muri Montpellier kuva mu 1986 kugeza mu 1989, aho Milla yaje kuba umwe mu batoza b’iyi kipe nyuma yo gusezera mumupira w’amaguru mu Bufaransa. ["Bikenewe"] Mu mwakawe wambere w'imikino, Milla yatsinze ibitego 18 mumikino 33 isanzwe y'umwaka, byafashije Montpellier kugaruka mu cyiciro cya 1. Muri rusange, yatsinze ibitego 41 mu mikino 103 yakinnye muri Montpellier.
Milla yavuye mumupira w'amaguru w'Abafaransa afitimyaka 37 mu 1989 ajya i Réunion mu Nyanja y'Abahinde ahoyakiniye JS Saint-Pierroise. Nyumayogutsinda mugikombe cy'isi, yasubiye i Tonnerre muri Kameruni mugihe cy'imyaka ine. Yarangije iminsiye akina mumakipabiri muri Indoneziya nyuma y'igikombe cy'isi cyomu 1994, asezerera muri uyu mukino mu mpera z'umwaka w'imikino wo mu 1996. Umubare w'ibitego yatsinze muri shampiyona yomuri Indoneziya warenze umubarew'imikino yari yarakinnye muri iryo rushanwa, aho ibitego 41 byabonetse mumikino 35 gusa mugihe cy'imyaka ibiri.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Milla yakiniyikipe y'igihugu inshuro 77, atsinda ibitego 43. Milla yakinnye bwambere muri Kameruni mu 1973 ubwo yakinaga na Zaire mumukino wogushaka itike yogukina igikombe cy'isi.
Yakinnye imikino yeyambere mugikombe cy'isi mugikombe cy'isi gifatwa nk'icya mbere mwikipe ya Kameruni ubwoyegukanaga igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1982 nyuma yo gutsinda imikino yombi ya nyuma bakina na Maroc mumikino yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1982 mu karere ka Afurika. Milla yagize uruhare runini mugufasha Kameruni kwegukana itike yo kujya mu gikombe cy'isi cyo mu 1982, atsinda amanotamenshi mumikino yo guhatanira itike yokujya mugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyomu 1982 mumarushanwa yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu karere ka Afurika. Yahuye n'amarangamutima atandukanye mugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1982, igitego cyatsinzwe na Peru mumukinowabo wambere. Kameruni yatsinzwe imikino itatu mu mikino itatu yomucyiciro cyambere. Nyuma y'imyakibiri, yarimwikipe yahatanaga mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1984 i Los Angeles, muri California. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Milla yarumukinnyi w’ingenzi mwikipe ya Kameruni yegukanye igikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 1984 aho Kameruni yatsinze Nijeriya ibitego 3-1 ku mukino wa nyuma bituma Kameruni yegukana igikombecyambere cy’umugabane. Yarumukinnyi ukomeye mwikipe ya Kameruni yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri nyuma ya Misiri ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 1986, kandi yahawe igihembo cy’umukinnyi mwiza muri iryo rushanwakuko yatsinze ibitego byinshi n’ibitego 4. Yanatoranyijwe mu ikipe y’igikombe cy'Afurika cyomu 1986. Yanabaye umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mugikombe cy'Afurika cyo mu 1988, atsinda ibitego 2 hamwe na Lakhdar Belloumi wo muri Alijeriya, Abdoulaye Traoré wo muri Ivory Coast na Gamal Abdelhamid wo muri Misiri. Yongeye kugira uruhare runini mu gutsinda kwa Kameruni mugikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 1988, kandi kubera uburyo yitwaye neza muri iryo rushanwa, yagizwe umukinnyi w’irushanwa, ndetse anashyirwa mwikipe y’igikombe cy'Afurika cyomu 1988.
Mu 1988, afitimyaka 36, Milla yizihije ikiruhuko cyecyogusezera kumupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga, yizihiza yubile muri Kameruni. Ariko, mu 1990, yahamagawe na Perezida wa Kameruni Paul Biya, wamwinginze ngwavemukiruhuko cy'izabukuru mpuzamahanga agaruke mu ikipe y'igihugu. Yarabyemeye, maze ajya mu Butaliyani mu ikipe ya "Indomitable Lions" mu gikombe cy'isi cyo mu 1990, aho yateraga igitangaza. Byagaragaye ko Paul Biya yashakaga ko Milla akina mu gikombe cy'isi nyuma yo kureba Milla akina mumukino w'urukundo wabereye i Douala aho Milla yatsinze ibitego bibiri. Nyumayogushimangira kwa Perezida wa Kameruni, Milla yahisemo kugaruka mu mupira w'amaguru mpuzamahanga atanga itangazo ku mugaragaro muri Gicurasi 1990.
Bivugwa kandiko abenshi mubakinnyi bakinana muri Kameruni ndetse n'umutoza mukuru w'igihugu Valery Nepomnyashchy ukomokamu Burusiya batashakaga ko Milla aba mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990. Biya yatanze itegeko rimuhamagarira kugaruka mu ikipe y'igihugu maze Biya asinya ku mugaragaro itegeko risaba kandi rihatira umutoza kumutoranya mwikipe y'igikombe cy'isi. Byavuzwe kandiko abanyamakuruba siporo bazwi muri Kameruni hamwe n'abafana batangiye gahunda yo gusubiza Milla mwikipe y'igihugu nyuma y'uko Kameruni yitwaye nabimu gikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 1990 muri Alijeriya aho Kameruni yavaga mumatsinda itsindwa na Gambia na Senegal.
Igikombe cy'Isi cyo mu 1990.
Milla yatsinze ibitegobye binebyose muririrushanwa nk'umusimburubwo yatangiragaburi mukino w'irushanwa kuntebe y'abasimbura. Yatangiye mugice cya kabiri mumikino inemuri itanu y'igikombe cy'isi, anagaragara mugice cyambere inshurimwe. Ibitegobyebibiri by'ingenzi yatsinze mu gice cya kabiri cy'umukino yakinnye na Rumaniya mu minota ibirigusa muminota y'inyongera aho yongeye kugaragara nk'umusimbura, maze akurikira ubuhanga bwe, afatwank'intwari muri Kameruni. Umutoza Valery Nepomnyashchy ni we wahisemo kuzana Milla mberegato y'umukino yakinnye na Rumaniya azi neza ko intsinzi izaha Kameruni umwanya mu cyiciro cya 16, maze umutoza nyuma yemeza akamaro ka Milla nyuma yo gutsinda bikomeye Kameruni mu mukino watsinzwe cyane na Argentine, ikipe ya Argentina. Yarumukinnyi mukurucyane wakiniraga hanze mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990, kandiyari umukinnyi wa kabiri mukuru mu irushanwa nyuma ya Peter Shilton w'Umwongereza.
Milla w'imyaka 38 y'amavuko yabayumwe mubakinnyi bakomeye mwirushanwa. Yatsinze ibitego binemu Butaliyani, yishimira burikimwe abyina azungurukibendera ry'imfuruka, ibibikaba byarakunze gukundwa kuva icyo gihe. Ibitego bibiri yatsinze Rumaniya mu mukino wa kabiri wa Kameruni, n'ibindi bibiri yatsinze mu minota 16 y'inyongera yatsinze Kolombiya mu mikino 16 ya nyuma, bituma Kameruni igera muri kimwe cyakane cy'irangiza, ikipe ya Afurika yari yageze kure mu gikombe cy'isi (Senegal na Ghana byahuye n'iki gikombe mu 2002 na 2010, mu gihe Maroc yayirenze igera muri kimwe cya kabiri cy'irangiza mu 2022). Mumukino wa kimwe cyakane cy'irangiza n'Ubwongereza, Milla yemeje ko ari umukinnyi w'icyamamare cyane mugice cya kabiri cy'irushanwa, Kameruni irushwa igitego 1-0, inganya penaliti, hanyuma ishyiraho igitego cya Ekeke, bituma Kameruni ibona amanota 2-1, mberey'uko Ubwongereza butsinda penaliti ebyiri, maze butsinda 3-2 nyuma y'iminota y'inyongera. Bitewe n'uko yakinnye mu Butaliyani, yongeye kugirwa umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umwaka muri Afurika. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Igitego cyecyakabiricyo kwishimirikipe ya Kolombiya cyabaye icyamamare ku isiyose kandi cyakoreshejwe na Coca-Cola nk'uko bigaragara mumatangazo nka Coca-Cola yo mu gikombe cy'isi cyo mu 2010.
Igikombe cy'Isi cyo mu 1994.
Milla yagarutse mugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyomu 1994 afitimyaka 42, akaba ariwemukinnyi ukuzwecyane kurushabandibose bakinnye mu gikombe cy'isi kugeza mu irushanwa rya 2014 ubwo Faryd Mondragón womuri Kolombiya yinjiye mu mukino w'amatsinda n'Ubuyapani ubwo yari afite imyaka 43 n'iminsi 3. Agahigo ka Mondragon katsinzwe na Essam El Hadary mu 2018. Kameruni yakuwe mu matsinda; icyakora, Milla yatsinze igitego mu ikipe y'Uburusiya, ashyiraho agahigo ko kuba umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi mwirushanwa ry'igikombe cy'isi, asesa agahigo yari yashyizeho mu 1990. Yakinnye umukino mpuzamahanga bwa nyuma mu mukino wa gicuti na Afurika y'Epfo mu Ukuboza 1994.
Umwuga nyuma yo gukina.
Ubunintumwa y’ingenzi mubikorwa by'Afurika. Anakora nk’umukorerabushake mu matsinda atandukanye arimo n’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cyita ku Bidukikije. Yanafunguye amasosiyete abiri yo kongera gukoresha iplastike mumabuye yomumuhanda. Mu 2004, yashyizwe mwrushanwa rya FIFA 100, urutonde rw’abakinnyi 125 b’umupira w’amaguru bakomeye batoranyijwe na Pelé mu birori byokwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka ijana ya FIFA.
Yatoje Montpellier kuvamu 2001 kugezamu 2007. Yanabaye umutoza wa Tonnerre mugihe cy'imyaka ine hagatiya 2007 na 2011.
Yagizwe perezida w’icyubahiro w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Kameruni muri Werurwe 2008. Ariko, yakuwekuruwomwanya w’umuyobozi w’icyubahiro muri Gicurasi 2012 nyumayokunenga abayobozi bakuru b’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Kameruni ku bijyanye n’ihagarikwa ry’igihekirekire rya Samuel Eto'o.
Kwitariki ya 24 Ugushyingo 2022, yahawicyubahiro na FIFA kubw'ibyo yagezehubwo Perezida wa FIFA Gianni Infantino yamushyikirizaga icyapambere gato y'uko umukino w'amatsinda utangira hagatiya Kameruni n'Ubusuwisi mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2022 kuri sitade ya Al Janoub, Milla nawe yatumiwe kumugaragaro nk'umushyitsi wihariye na Perezida wa FIFA kugirango arebe uwomukino.
Ibirori bye by’ubuhanga muburyo bw’imbyino ya Makossa mugace k’ibendera ry’imfuruka mu gikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990 byahinduye uko abantu batangiye kubona umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika muburyo bwiza. Ibirori bye byafashwe nk’ibyakunzwe ako kanya kandi byateraga imbaraga nziza kubarebaga mugikombe cy’isi. Yabayikiganiro cy’abantubenshi mu mujyi nomwirushanwa mugikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990 bitewe ahanini n’ubuhanga bwe mu kibuga, ibirori byokubyina nokubera ubuhangabwe. Nyuma yaje kwitwa "Umwami w’Ibendera ry’imfuruka".
Mu 2020, wehamwe n'abakinnyi bagenzibebo muri Kameruni bahawamazu atatuyokuraramo nk'impano zogushimira igihebatsinze nezamugikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 1990. Ariko, byabaye ngombwa ko bategereza imyaka 30 kugirangobahabwe iyompanonubwo Perezida Paul Biya yari yarabisezeranye mberemu 1990. Uyumushinga watinzecyane nyuma y'impungenge zijyanye na ruswa n'imikoreremibi kurutonde rw'abagenerwabikorwa 44.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bya Kameruni ni byo bya mbere, inkingi y'amanota igaragaza amanota nyuma ya buri gitego cya Milla."

Darko Balaban (; yavutse ku wa 22 Nzeri 1989) ni umukinnyi wa umukino wa basketball w’umunyaseribiya wabigize umwuga.
Umwuga we w’umukino.
Balaban yakuriye muri KK Sport Key yo mu aho yakinnye kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2007 ubwo yimukiraga muri Partizan. Mu 2010 yimukiye muri Crvena zvezda aho yamaze umwaka umwe.
Mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2011–12 yasinyiye aho yagize umwaka mwiza cyane maze yitwa umukinnyi mwiza (MVP) wa shampiyona ya basketball ya Serbia.
Muri Werurwe 2012 yasinyiye mu Serbian Super League ariko yakinnye imikino icyenda gusa ahita ava mu ikipe. Mu mwaka wakurikiyeho yatangiriye muri Târgu Mureş ariko ayivamo mu Ukuboza 2012.
Mu Ukwakira 2013 yasinyiye Vršac. Yayivuyemo amaze gukina imikino ibiri gusa asinya muri. Muri Gashyantare 2014 yasubiye muri Serbia asinyira ikipe ye ya mbere Smederevo.
Muri Nzeri 2014 yasinyiye ikipe yo muri Hongiriya Naturtex SZTE-Szedeák mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2014–15.
Ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2015 yasinyiye ikipe yo mu Bugereki PAOK. Nyuma yaje kuyivamo muri uko kwezi amaze gukina imikino ibiri ya shampiyona yo mu Bugereki n’imikino itatu ya. Ku wa 2 Ukuboza 2015 yasinyiye ikipe yo muri Romania Dinamo București kugeza shampiyona ya 2015–16 irangiye.
Ku wa 16 Ugushyingo 2017 yasinyiye Borac Čačak kugeza umwaka w’imikino wa 2017–18 urangiye. Ku wa 18 Kanama 2018 yasinyiye Melilla yo muri LEB Oro.
Mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2021–22 yakiniye Kouchin Amol yo muri Iranian Basketball Super League.
Muri Nyakanga 2022, Balaban yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Rwanda APR ikina muri Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL).

Ikibuga cya Kaminuza ya Polytechnic ni ikibuga cya cricket kiri i Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mu Kwakira 2021,iki kibuga ni cyo cyabereye imikino yo mu itsinda A mu majonjora yo guhatanira itike yo kuzakina igikombe cy'isi cyo muri 2021 muri ICC mu gikombe cy'isi cya Afurika cyitabiriwe n'amakipe y'ibihugu ya Cricket mu bagabo nka Eswatini, Gana, Lesoto, Malawi, Seyishele, Uganda ndetse n'u Rwanda rwakiriye. Mbere yuko amarushanwa atangira, ikibuga cya ravuguruwe kugirango kigere ku rwego rwo kwemerwa na ICC.

Rwanda Cricket Association cyangwa se ni Ishyirahamwe ry'umukino wa Cricket mu Rwanda ni urwego cyangwa urugaga rukuru ruyobora siporo ya Cricket mu Rwanda. Icyicaro cyayo giherereye mu karere ka Kicukiro mu mujyi wa Kigali.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Cricket mu Rwanda ni ryo rihagarariye u Rwanda mu Nama Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket, rikaba n’umunyamuryango wungirije, rikaba rimaze igihe rikorera muri iryo shyirahamwe kuva muri 2003. Ndetse ni n’umunyamuryango w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino wa Cricket muri Afurika.
Sitade ya Cricket ya Gahanga hamwe n'ikibuga cya Cricket cya IPRC ni byo bibuga by'ingenzi bya Cricket mu Rwanda.

Rwanda national cricket team ni ikipe y'igihugu ya Cricket mu Rwanda ihagararira u Rwanda mu mikino mpuzamahanga. yabaye umunyamuryango w’inama mpuzamahanga ya Cricket (ICC) muri 2003 ndetse ni n’umunyamuryango wungirije muri 2017.
Rwanda national cricket muri 2004 yitabira amarushanwa yo mu karere ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ku nshuro yabo ya mbere. Muri Shampiyona nyafurika ikina mu 2004, aho yarangije ku mwanya wa karindwi muri Afurika y'Epfo. Muri 2006 barushanijwe mu cyiciro cya gatatu mu karere ka Afurika muri Shampiyona y’isi ya Cricket, batezimbere imikorere yabo barangiza ku mwanya wa gatandatu. Bagumye mu cyiciro cya gatatu mu 2008.

Ikipe y'abagore ya Cricket y'u Rwanda yazengurutse ikina muri nijeriya muri Mutarama 2019 kugira ngo ikine imikino y'aginshuti n'amakipe itanu y'abagore muri Twenty20 International (WT20I) (nyuma ryaje kwitwa irushanwa rya cricket rya Nigeria. Iyi ni yo mikino ya mbere ifite urwego rwa WT20I yakinwe n'impande zombi, nyuma y'uko Inama Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket itangaje ko imikino yose ikinwa hagati y'amakipe y'abagore kuva kuya tariki ya 1 Nyakanga 2018 izaba ifite urwego rwuzuye rwa T20I. Ahabereye imikino yose ni muri Sitade y'Igihugu i Abuja.
Nijeriya yatsinze U Rwanda uruhererekane rw'amaseti 3-2. Irushanwa ryahaye amakipe yombi imyiteguro yayo mbere y'irushanwa rya ICC Women's Qualifier Africa ryo muri 2019, ryabereye muri Zimbabwe muri Gicurasi 2019.

Igihugu gishobora gushyirwa mucyiciro cy’ibihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere iyocyujuje ibi bikurikira bitatu:
Kugeza mu Ukuboza 2024, ibihugu 44 byaribikiri mucyiciro cya LDC, mugihe umunani byarangije hagatiya 1994 na 2024. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ubucuruzi (WTO) wemeyurutonde rwa Loni kandi uvugako "Ingamba zafashwe murwego rwa WTO zishobora gufasha LDC kongera ibyo zohereza mu mahanga kubindibihugu bigize WTO nogukurura ishoramari. Mubihugu byinshi biri munzira y’amajyambere, amavugurura ashyigikira isoko yashishikarije iterambere ryihuse, gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa byoherezwa mumahanga, nokugira uruhare rugaragara mu bucuruzi bw’ibihugu byinshi."
Ibipimo ngenderwaho bya LDC bisuzumwa burimyaka itatu na Komite ishinzwe Politiki y'Iterambere (CDP) y'Inama y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ishinzwe Ubukungu n'Imibereho Myiza (ECOSOC). Ibihugu bishobora gukurwa mucyiciro cya LDC iyibipimo birengeje ibibipimo mu isuzuma rikurikiranye inshuro eshatu. Ibiro by'Umuryango w'Abibumbye by'Intumwa Nkuru y'Ibihugu Bikiri mu Majyambere, Ibihugu Bidakora ku Nyanja n'Ibihugu Bikiri mu Majyambere Bito (UN-OHRLLS) bihuzinkunga ya Loni kandibigatanga serivisi z'ubuvugizi kubihugu Bikiri mu Majyambere Myiza. Icyiciro (as of December 2024) ireba ibihugu 44.
Munama yakane ya Loni kubihugu bya LDCs, yabaye muri Gicurasi 2011, intumwa zemeye intego igamije kuzamura nibura kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibihugu bya LDCs biriho ubumumyaka icumi iri imbere. Kugeza mu 2018, ibihugu icumi cyangwa birenga byari byitezwe kobizarangiza mu 2024, muri Bangladesh byaribyujuje ibisabwa byose mu 2018.
Ntagihugu cyujujibisabwa ubukandi haribihugu bitatu byaribyujuje ibisabwa kugirango bibe LDC, arikobyanze gushyirwa murutonde, bibaza nibamakuru ya CDP afitukuri cyangwukuri: Ghana (ntikibyujuje ibisabwa kuvamu 1994), Papua Nouvelle-Guinée (ntikibyujuje ibisabwa kuva mu 2009), na Zimbabwe (ntikibyujuje ibisabwa kuva mu 2018).
Imikoreshereze n'amagambo ahinnye.
Ibihugu bikiri munzira y'amajyambere bishobora gutandukanywa n'ibihugu bikiri munzira y'amajyambere, "ibihugu bikiri munzira y'amajyambere", "ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere", cyangwa andi magambo asa nayo.
Ijambo "igihugu kidateye imbere cyane" (LEDC) naryo rikoreshwa murikigihe. Arikokugira ngo hirindwe urujijo hagati y'"igihugu kidateye imberecyane" n'"igihugu kidateye imbere cyane" (bishobora gusobanurwa mu magambo ahinnye nka LDC), nokugirango hirindwurujijo n'igihugu kidateye imbere kidakora kunyanja (bishobora gusobanurwa mu magambo ahinnye nka LLDC), "igihugu kidatera imbere" gikoreshwa cyane kuruta "igihugu kidateyimberecyane".
Mwisuzuma ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu 2018, Umuryango w’Abibumbye wasobanuye ko ibihugu bitagira ingano mubihugu bya LDC byujuje ibipimo bitatu, kimwemuribyo kikabacyari ikigereranyo cy’imyaka itatu cy’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu (GNI) kuri burimuturage kirimunsi y’amadolari y’Amerika 1,025.
Habayeho inameshanu z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye kubihugu bya LDC, zibaburimyaka icumi. Ebyiri za mbere zabereye i Paris, mu 1981 na 1991; iyagatatu yabereye i Buruseli mu 2001.
Inamaya kane ya Loni ku bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere (LDC-IV) yabereye i Istanbul muri Turukiya, ku ya 9-13 Gicurasi 2011. Yitabiriwe na Ban Ki-moon, umuyobozi wa Loni, hamwe n’abaminisitiri b’intebe n’abakuru b’ibihugu bagera kuri 50. Iyi nama yemeje intego yogukura kimwe cyakabiri cy’ibihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere mucyiciro cya LDC mu 2022. Kimwe n’amasezerano y’iterambere ya Seoul yateguwe mu 2010, hashyizwe imbaragacyane mukongera ubushobozi bwo gukora umusaruro n’ibikorwa remezo bifatika, ahwimiryango myinshi itegamiye kuri leta itishimiye imbaraga zishyirwa kurwego rw’abikorera.
Inama ya Gatanu y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye kubihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere (LDC-V) yagabanyijwemo ibice bibiri mugihe kingana n’umwaka, hagatiy’icyicaro gikuru cya Loni i New York ku ya 17 Werurwe 2022 na Doha kuya 5-9 Werurwe 2023.
Ibibazo bijyanye n'amategeko agengubucuruzi mpuzamahanga na za LDC byakuruye itangazamakuru na politiki cyanebitewe n'ibiganiro bya Doha Round of World Trade Organization (WTO) byasenyutse vuba ahabyitwaga uruzinduko rw'iterambere. Mugihe cya Minisitiri wa Hong Kong wa WTO, hemejwe ko za LDC zishobora kubona 100% by'inyungu kumasoko y'Amerika mu gihe uruzinduko rwarangiye. Ariko isesengura ry'amasezerano yakozwe n'imiryango itegamiye kuri leta ryagaragaje ko inyandiko y'amasezerano ya LDC yari yatanzwe yari ifite icyuhokinini gishobora gutuma ubwishingizi buke kuruta 100% by'inyungu ku masoko y'ibihugu bikize, ndetse bishobora no gusiba uburyo bumwe na bumwe bwa LDCs bwokugera kumasoko y'ibihugu bikize mu buryo budafite imisoro. Kutanyurwa n'ibi cyuho byatumye bamwe mu bahanga mu by'ubukungu basaba ko amasezerano ya Hong Kong avugururwa. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Chiedu Osakwe, kuvamu 2001, Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubufatanye mubya Tekiniki mu Bunyamabanga bwa WTO, akaba n’umujyanama w’Umuyobozi Mukuru kubibazo by’ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere, yagizwe Umuhuzabikorwa wihariye wa WTO kubihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere kuva mu 1999. Yakoranye bya hafi n’izindi nzego eshanu hamwe na WTO zigize Urwego rw’ibikorwa bihuriweho ku bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Baganiriye ku bibazo byokubona isoko, ingingo zihariye n’izitandukanye kubihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere, uruhare rw’ibihugu bikiri munzira y’ubucuruzi bw’ibihugu byinshi, n’ibibazo by’iterambere, cyane cyane inyungu z’ibihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere muri politiki y’ipiganwa. Munama ya 28 ya G8 yabereye i Kananaskis, muri Alberta, Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Kanada Jean Chrétien yatanze igitekerezo kandi ashyira mu bikorwa gahunda yo kubona isoko, kugira ngo ibihugu 48 bikiri munzira y’ubucuruzi bishobore kungukira mu "bucuruzi butari inkunga". Byongeye kandi, Intego ya 14 y’Iterambere Rirambye ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ishyigikira ko LDC zifatwa muburyo bwihariye kandi butandukanye nk’igice cy’ingenzi cy’ibiganiro byo gutanga inkunga kuburobyi muri WTO.
Ibyifuzwa byo kugera ku isoko.
Ibihugu byinshibiha uburenganzira bwokugera kubihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere. Urugero, Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi washyize mubikorwa gahunda ya Everything but Arms, mu gihe Ubusuwisi buha uburenganzira bwo kugera kwisoko ry’ibicuruzwa byose ku bihugu bikirimu nzira y’amajyambere. Kugera kwisoko ry’u Buyapani na byonubuntu kubihugu bikiri munzira y’amajyambere.
Guhera kwitarikiya 1 Ukuboza 2024, Ubushinwa bwakuyeho imisoro kubicuruzwa byinjizwaga mu bihugu byose Umuryango w’Abibumbye ushyira mubyiciro ko bitaratera imbere kandi Ubushinwa bufitanye umubano wa dipolomasi. Ibihugu mirongo itatu na bitatu bizungukira muri aya masezerano biri mur'Afurika nahibihugu bitari iby'Afurika bihabwa imisorontamisoro ni Yemeni, Kiribati, Ibirwa bya Salomo, Afuganisitani, Bangladesh, Kamboje, Lawosi, Miyanimari, Nepali, na Timoru y’Iburasirazuba.
Urutonde rw'ibihugu.
Ibihugu 44 bikurikira bikurikira byashyizwe kurutonde nk’ibihugu cyanen’umuryango w’abibumbye guhera mu Kuboza 2024:​​​​​​.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
Hakurikijwe umugabane cyangwa akarere.
Hari ibihugu 32 byashyizwe mu cyiciro cy’ibihugu bidakize cyane mur'Afurika, 8 muri Aziya, 3 muri Oseyaniya, nakimwe mur'Amerika.
Urutonde rw' "ibihugu bidateye imberecyane" nk'uko Umuryango w'Abibumbye ubivuga, bimwe muribyo bikaba biri mubihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere bidakora kunyanja n'ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere byo mubirwa bito:
Ibipimobitatu (umutungo w’abantu, ibibazo by’ubukungu n’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu kuri buri muturage) bigenzurwa na Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Iterambere buri myaka itatu. Ibihugu bigomba kuzuza bibiri muribitatu mwisuzuma rikurikiranye ry’imyaka itatukugira ngo bisuzumwe mbere yo kurangiza amasomo. Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Iterambere yohereza inama zayo zo kwemeza Inama y’Ubukungu n’Imibereho Myiza (ECOSOC).
Nyuma yogutangiza icyiciro cya LDC, ibihugu umunani byarangije kugera kurwego "rw'igihugu gikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere". Igihugu cyambere cyarangije kugera kurwego rw'ubukungu ni Botswana mu 1994. Igihugucyakabiri cyari Cape Verde mu 2007. Maldives yarangije kugera ku rwego "rw'igihugu gikiri munzira y'amajyambere" muntangiriro za 2011, Samoa mu 2014, Guinée Equatorial mu 2017, Vanuatu mu Ukuboza 2020, Bhutan mu Ukuboza 2023, na São Tomé na Príncipe mu Ukuboza 2024.
Ibihugu bikurikira ntibikiri mu itsinda ry’ "ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere":

Tchoukball / / ˈtʃuːkbɔːl / CHOOK - ball CHOOK numukino w’ikipe yomunzu, ukinirwa n’amakipe y’abakinnyi 7. Wakorewe mu Busuwisi mumyaka ya 1970, kandi ukunzwecyane muri Singapuru, Ubusuwisi na Tayiwani, arikowabaye umukinompuzamahanga ufite amashyirahamwe y’ibihugumu bihugu birenga 60. Uyoborwa n’Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Tchoukball (FITB), ryashinzwe mu 1971.
Ubusanzwe ukinwumupira urimukibuga cyomunzu ufite agapira gato kogukubita umupira kumpera zose. Amakipe atsinda igitego atsinda umupira kuri rebounder hanyuma akawutera gukubita hasi mukibuga adafatiwe n'ikipe irikuruhande. Uyumukino wagenewe kugabanya imvune, kandi birabujijwe gukoranaho n'abakinnyi.
Tchoukball yashinzwe mu Busuwisi na Hermann Brandt, waruhangayikishijwe n'imvune nyinshi zikomeye mu bakinnyi zikomoka kumikino ikunda guterubukana nogukorakora kumubiri. Yizeraga ko siporo idakwiye kuba iy'abatsinze gusa, ahubwo ikanagira uruhare mukurema umuryango mwiza kandi w'ubumuntu. Yashushanyije tchoukball kugirangibirimo ibice bya handball (ikinwa n'amaboko, kandi imipira ikoreshwa isa), volleyball (kuko ikipe irinda igomba gukumira umupira kugwa) na squash (kubera ko hari rebound).
Inkomoko y'umwimerere.
Izina rya tchoukball (rizwi nka "choukball", hamwe na "t" ituje) rikomoka kwijwi ry'umupira "tchouk" umupira ukora iyuvuye kugitereko.
Amakipe ashobora kubagizwe n'abakinnyi 12, ariko 7 gusa nibobashobora kuba barimukibuga igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
Gukoranaho n'abakinnyi birabujijwe, kandi bamyugariro ntibashobora kugeragezagufata imipira y'ikipe irigutera. Abakinnyi bashobora guterintambwe eshatu n'umupira, bagafata umupira mugihe cy'amasegonda atatu. Amakipe ntashobora kurenza inshuro eshatu mbereyokurasa rebounder.
Bitewe n'icyiciro cy'abakinnyi (Abagabo, Abagore, Urubyiruko), inganozitandukanye z'imipira zirakoreshwa. Iyi mipira iri hagati ya metero 54 n'umuzenguruko. – 60 cm n'uburemere kuvakuri 325 kugeza 475 garama.
Amakipe abiri y’abakinnyi 7 burikimwe (abagabo cyangwa abagore) arahatanira kubonamanota, ikipifite amanotamenshi kumusozo igatsinda umukino. Iyikipe ibonye inota, kugenzurumupira bihabwa indikipe.
Burikipe igizwe n'ibi bikurikira: Abashoferi 2 b'iburyo cyangwa iburyo; Abashoferi 2 b'ibumoso cyangwa ibumoso; Abakinnyi 2 cyangwa 3 b'inyuma cyangwumupira wimbere; Umupira 1 wo hagati cyangwa umupirawohagati (cyangwa nta n'umwe nibahakoreshejwe abakinnyi 3 b'inyuma).
Buriruhande rw'ikibuga rugizwe n'umurashe ibumoso, umurashiburyo n'umwunganizi umwe cyangwa babiri, mugihe hagati akenshibahafi y'ikibuga hagati iyohakoreshejwe iyi fome. Abarashe muri rusange nibo bashinzwe kurasa nubwo rimwe na rimwe umwunganizi ashobora no gufata ishoti. Ababunganizi bashinzwe guhuza umurongo wa mbere w'ubwugarizi mu gihe fome yo hagati iyobora umurongo wa kabiri w'ubwugarizi. Arikwizindi fomesiyo zirimo kudakoresha fome yo hagati, ikipe yanyura hagati igatera umupira wose ku barashi/imbere. Ibibiha undimwunganizi wo ku murongo wa mbere cyangwa undi mwunganizi wo ku murongo wa kabiri wihariye.
Abakinnyi bafitumupira bashobora gutera intambwe zitarenze 3, bagafata umupira mugihe kitarenze amasegonda 3. Gusimbuka umupirantibyemewe.
Iyumupira utararangiye (umupira ukozehasi cyangwurenze imbibi), indikipe ifatuburenganzira bwo kuwutsinda.
Ikipirinda ntishobora kubangamira uteramugihe cyoguhanumupira.
Kwikipe itangamanota, kwinjira mugace kabujijwe n'umupira ntibyemewe. Umupirugomba kurekurwa mbereyuko umukinnyi agwa mugace kabujijwe.
Uretsumupira wa tchouk usanzwe womunzu, harikandi umupira wa tchouk wokumucanga n'umupira wa tchouk wo ku ntebe y'abamugaye, ufite amategeko atandukanye gato. Hariho kandi imikino y'urubyiruko na za kaminuza, itandukanye n'imikino ifunguye.
Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Tchoukball (FITB).
FITB, yashinzwe mu 1971, ifite icyicaro i Genève mu Busuwisi. Kugeza mu 2021, igizwe n'amashyirahamwe 50 y'abanyamuryango n'ibihugu 22 (15+7) bifitUhagarariye FITB wagenwe. Ishyigikira kandi ikagira inama amashyirahamwe y'ibihugu n'abantu kugiti cyabobiteguye gukwirakwiza tchoukball muturere dushya. Urugero, tchoukball iherutse gushyirwa murigahunda y'amashuri y'uturere tumwe na tumwetwa Senegali. FITB yari siporo y'imyigaragambyo mu mikino y'Isi yomu 2009, yabereye i Kaohsiung muri Tayiwani.
Kurwego rw'isi, tchoukball yiganjemo amakipe yomuri Tayiwani kuvamu 1980. Kuvicyogihe batsinzwe gusa nimu 2004 ubwo batsindwaga n'Ubusuwisi kumukino wanyuma w'abagabo, nomu 2023, ubwo Ubutaliyani bwabatsindaga muri kimwe cyakabiri cy'irangiza cy'abagore.
Shampiyona y'Isi y'Urubyiruko rwa Tchoukball.
Shampiyona ya 6 ya FITB y'urubyiruko rwa Tchoukball 2023
Ibirori byo mu karere.
Shampiyona y'ingimbi za Aziya Pacific Tchoukball.
Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru wa Aziya-Pasifika - APYTC
Mu 2014, Shampiyona ya 3 y'urubyiruko rwa Aziya Pacific Tchoukball yabereye muri Singapuru. Mu 2016, Shampiyona ya 4 y'urubyiruko rwa Aziya Pacific Tchoukball yabereye muri Taoyuan, muri Tayiwani.
Shampiyona ya 7 y'abakiri bato ba Aziya Pacific Tchoukball 2024, kuva ku ya 19 Nyakanga kugeza ku ya 21 Nyakanga 2024, i Johor Bahru muri Maleziya.

Abadage-Abadage (German) cyangw'Abadage b'Abirabura (German) nabaturage b'Abadage bafitinkomoko ikomoka mumokoyose y'abirabura yomur'Afurika.
Imijyi nka Hamburg na Frankfurt, yahoze arahantu haninihatuwe n’abantu benshi nyuma y’Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi Yose n’abimukira baherutse, ifite imiryango myinshi y’Abadage n’Abanyafrika. Hamwe n’ubucuruzi n’abimukira banone, imiryango nka Frankfurt, Berlin, Munich, na Cologne ifite umubare ugenda wiyongera w’Abadage b’Abanyafrika. Ibarura ry’Abadage ntirikoresha ubwoko nk’icyiciro. Umubare w’abantu "bafite amateka maremare y’abimukira" ("mit Migrationshintergrund im weiteren Sinn", bivuze kobafite niburanyogokuru umwewavukiye hanze y’Ubudage), bivugwa ko barenga miliyoni 1.000.000. "Umuryango Schwarzer Deutscher" (“Abirabura b’Abadage Initiative”) uvugako Abadage bosebafite inkomoko mur' Afurika barenga miliyoni 1.000.000.
Murirusange, nibura abantu 711 000 bafitinkomoko mur'Afurika yomuri Subsharan.
Imibanire y'Abanyafurika n'Abadage kuva mu 1600 kugeza mu mpera za 1800.
Mu myaka ya 1720, Anton Wilhelm Amo wavukiye muri Gana yatewinkunga n'umutware w'Umudage kugira ngo abe Umunyafurika wa mbere wize kaminuza y'i Burayi; amaze kurangiza amasomo ye, yigishaga kandi yandika muri filozofiya. Nyuma, Abanyafurika bazanywe nk'abacakara baturutse ku nkombe y'iburengerazuba bwa Afurika aho imirima myinshi y'Abadage yashinzwe, cyane cyane ku Nkombe ya Zahabu. Nyumay'aho Umwami Friedrich Wilhelm wa I wa Prussia agurishije imirima ye ya Ghana Groß Friedrichsburg muri Afurika mu 1717, aho abantu bageraku 30.000 bari baragurishijwe muri Dutch East India Company, ba nyirayo bashya bategetswe n'amasezerano yo "kohereza abahungu 12 b'abirabura, batandatu muribobari bambaye iminyururu ya zahabu," kumwami. Abana b'abacakara bajyanywe i Potsdam na Berlin.
Imibanire y'Abanyafurika n'Abadage hagati ya 1884 na 1945.
Munama yabereye i Berlin muri Kongo mu 1884, yitabiriwe n'ibihugu bikomeye byose by'icyo gihe, ibihugu by'i Burayi byagabanyije Afurika mo ibice by'ingenzi byagenzuraga. Ubudage bwagenzuraga koloni mukarere k'ibiyaga bigari bya Afurika na Afurika y'Iburengerazuba, aho Abanyafurika benshi bimukiye mu Budage bwa mbere. Ubudage bwashyizeho inzobere mu miyoborere n'ubukungu by'abakoloni, kandi urubyiruko rwinshi rw'Abanyafurika rwagiye mu Budage kwigishwa. Bamwe bahawe amashuri makuru mumashuri na za kaminuza z'Abadage, ariko abenshi bahuguwe mubigo by'amahugurwa y'ubutumwa n'amahugurwa y'abakoloni nk'abayobozi cyangwa abarimu b'ubutumwa bw'imbere mugihugu. Abanyafurika bakunzekuba abasemuzi b'indimi nyafurika mubigo by'ubushakashatsi by'Abadage n'Abanyafurika, ndetseno mu buyobozi bw'abakoloni. Abandi bimukiye mu Budage nk'abahoze ari abasirikare bashinzwe kurinda Abadage, Askari. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Akarere ka Afrikanisches Viertel ka Berlin nako numurage w’igihe cy’ubukoloni, ahwimihanda myinshi n’ibibuga by’amakuru byitiriwe ibihugu n’ahantu bifitanye isano n’ubwami bw’Abadage bwakolonijwe. Ubuniho harigice kinini cy’abaturage b’i Berlin bafitumurage w’Abanyafurika.
Abashakanye b’amoko atandukanye bomuturere twa koloni bashyizwemo igitutu gikomeye mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye kugitsina, birimogutesha agaciro ishyingiranwa, gutangaza ko abana b’amoko atandukanye aribirarane, nokubambura ubwenegihugu bw’Ubudage. Mugihe cy’itsembatsemba ry’Abanama mu 1907 n’Ubudage, umuyobozi w’Abadage ushinzwe ibibazo by’ubukoloni, Bernhard Dernburg, yavuzeko "amwe mu moko kavukire, kimwe n’inyamaswa zimwenazimwe, agomba kurimburwa".
Repubulika ya Weimar.
Mugihe cy'Intambara ya Mbere y'Isi Yose, Ababiligi, Abongereza n'Abafaransa bigaruriye koloni z'Ubudage mur'Afurika. Imiterere y'abakoloni b'Abanyafurika mu Budage yarahindutse muburyo butandukanye. Urugero, Abanyafurika bari bafite ikarita y'indangamuntu y'Abadage ya gikoloni bari bafite uburenganzira bwo gufatwa nk' "abanyamuryango b'uturere twahoze dukingirwa ". Nyuma y'Amasezerano ya Versailles (1919), Abanyafurika bashishikarijwe kubabaturage b'ibihugu bategetswe, arikwabenshi bahitamo kugumahobari. Mubusabe bwinshi (bwanditswe nezakuri Togoland y'Abadage na P. Sebald na Kameruni na A. Rüger), bagerageje kumenyesha abaturage b'Abadage ukwibintu byaribimeze muri koloni, kandibakomeje gusabubufasha n'inkunga by'Abadage. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Abanyafurika bashinze ikinyamakuru kivuga kundimi ebyiri cyasohotse mu Kidage no mu kidage: "Elolombe ya Kameruni" (Izuba rya Kameruni). Itsinda rya politiki ry’Abadage b’Abirabura ryashinze ishami ry’Abadage ry’umuryango uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu ufiticyicaro i Paris, Ligue de défense de la race nègre (Icyongereza: League for the Defense of the Negro Race) nk’ikinyamakuru "Liga zur Verteidigung der Negerrasse", ku ya 17 Nzeri 1929.
Imitererey’Abadage b’Abanyafrika mu Budage yarushijeho kuba mibi mu gihe cy’Abanazi. Abadage b’Abanyafrika batakaje pasiporo zabo. Imiterere y’akazi n’ingendo byagoranye cyane ku bahanzi b’Abadage b’Abanyafrika, abakoramunjyana zitandukanye, abakora mumyitozo ya sirkisi cyangwa filime. Kubera politiki y’Abanazi, abakoresha ntibashoboye kugumana cyangwa guha akazi abakozi b’Abadage b’Abanyafrika.
Abadage b’aba-Afro-Udage mu Budage baribaragizwe akato mumuryango kandibabujijwe gukoranimibonano mpuzabitsina nogushyingiranwa n’Aba-Aryan n’amategeko ya Nuremberg. Mwihohoterwa ryakomeje gukorwa kubitwaga aba-Rhineland, abayobozi b’Abanazi bashyize abana b’aba-Afro-Udage bagera kuri 500 bo muri Rhineland mukato. Abadage b’aba-Afro-Udage bafatwaga nk’ "abanzi b’igihugu gishingiye ku bwoko", hamwe n’Abayahudi n’Abaromani. Abanazi babanje gushaka gukuraho Abayahudi n’Abaromani mugihugu cy’Ubudage binyuze mukwirukana (nomunyuma bagakurwaho), mugihe Abadage b’aba-Afro-Udage bagombaga gukurwaho burundu kandamaherezo bagakurwaho binyuze mukato.
Bamwe mu Badage b'abirabura babayeho muriicyogihe nyumabanditse kubyobanyuzemo. Mu 1999, Hans Massaquoi yasohoye igitabo "cyitwa Destined to Witness" kivuga kubuzimabwe mu Budage ku ngoma ya Nazi, naho mu 2013 Theodor Wonja Michael, wari n'umutangabuhamya mukurumuri filime filime filime "Pages in the Factory of Dreams", yasohoye igitabo kivuga kubuzima bwe, "Deutsch Sein und Schwarz dazu."
Irangira ry'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose ryazanyingabo z'ibihugu by'Abongereza n'Abafaransa mu Budage. Ingabo z'Abanyamerika, Abongereza n'Abafaransa zarizirimo abasirikare benshi b'Abanyamerika b'Abanyafurika, Abanyakarayibe cyangwa Abanyafurika, kandi bamwe muri bo babyaranye abana n'abagore b'Abadage. Icyo gihe, izi ngabo muri rusange zakurikizaga amategeko yokudahuza abavandimwe kandizabuzaga ishyingiranwa ry'abasivili n'abasirikare. Abana bagera ku 5,000 murabobana b'Abanyakariyabeti b'amoko abiri bavutse nyuma y'intambara mu 1955. Ababyeyi benshi b'Abadage b'abagore bonyine babyaye "abana b'umukara", ariko ibihumbi n'ibihumbi barerwaga n'imiryango y'Abanyamerika kandi bakurira muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika. Akenshi ntibamenyaga inkomoko yabo kugeza bageze mukigero cy'imyaka mikuru.
Kugeza kwiherezo ry’Intambara y’Ubutita, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z' Amerika zagumanye abasirikare ba Amerika barenga 100.000 ku butaka bw’Ubudage. Mugihecy’aho, ababagabo bashinze ubuzimabwabo mu Budage. Akenshibazanaga imiryango cyangwa bagashinga indimishya ifite abagore n’abana b’Abadage bomubwoko bw’Abadage. Guverinoma y’Ubudage bw’Iburengerazuba yashyizeho politiki yo gushyira mukato cyangwa gukura mu Budage abobana yitaga "abana b’abazungu b’amoko atandukanye".
Audre Lorde, umwanditsi w’umwirabura w’Umunyamerika akaba n’umurwanizi, yamazimyaka kuva mu 1984 kugeza mu 1992 yigisha muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Berlin. Mugihe yamazemu Budage, akenshi hitwaga "Imyaka ya Berlin," yafashije mu gutuma ijambo "Afro-German" rishyirwa mu itsinda ryibanda ku guhuza amoko, igitsina n’imibonano mpuzabitsina. Yashishikarijabagore b’abirabura b’Abadage nka May Ayim na Ika Hügel-Marshall kwandika nogusohora imivugo n’amateka y’ubuzima bwabo kugirango bamenyekane. Yakurikiranye ubugore bw’ibihugu kwisi kandakora nk’umuvugizi w’iryo tsinda mu Budage. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Kuvamu 1981, Ubudage bwabonye abimukira baturutse mubihugu by'Afurika, cyanecyane Nijeriya, Eritereya na Gana, bashakaga ubuhungiro bwa politiki, akazi cyangwa amasomo muri za kaminuza zomu Budage.
Hasihari amatsinda manini cyane yomur'Afurika (yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara) mu Budage. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Ivanguramoko n'urwego rw'imibereho.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n'Ikigo cy'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi gishinzwe Uburenganzira bw'ibanze, bukorerwa ubushakashatsi ku bimukira barenga 16.000, barimo abantu barenga 6.700 bavukiye mur'Afurika yomunsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara. Nk'ukubushakashatsi bubivuga, igipimo cy'ivangura cyavuzwe cyane mumyaka ishize cyari mu Burayi buvuga Ikidage, cyane cyane mu Budage - aho 54% batangaje kobahuye n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku ivanguramoko, hejuru cyane y'impuzandengo ya 30% y'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi
Abadage bazwi cyane mu Budage bw'iki gihe.
Ubuhanzi, umuco na muzika.
Ubuzima bw'umuco bw'Abanyafurika-Abadage burangwa n'uburyo butandukanye n'uburyo bugoye. Nyuma yo kugaragara kwa MTV na Viva, gukundwa kw'umuco wa pop w'Abanyamerika kwatumye Abanyafurika-Abadage bahagararirwa mu itangazamakuru n'umuco w'Abadage.
May Ayim (1960-1996), yari umusizi w’umudage ukomoka muri Afurika, umurezi akaba n’umurwanashyaka. Yari umwanditsi wungirije w’igitabo "Farbe bekennen", aho ubuhinduzi bwe mu Cyongereza bwasohotse nka "Showing Our Colors: Afro-German Women Speak Out".
Abahanzi bazwi cyane bakomoka mu Budage barimo:
Filime na televiziyo.
"SFD - Schwarze Filmschaffende in Deutschland" ("Abakora Filimi b'Abirabura mu Budage") ni ishyirahamwe ry'abanyamwuga rikorera i Berlin rigenewe abayobozi ba filime, abatunganya filime, abanditsi ba filime, n'abakinnyi b'ikinamico b'Abadage bakomoka muri Afurika cyangwa abirabura batuye mu Budage. Bateguye urukurikirane rwa "New Perspectives" mu Iserukiramuco Mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Berlin.
Abanyafurika b'Abadage bazwi cyane muri filime na televiziyo barimo:

Joseph Mayanja (wavutse kuya 30 mata 1979), uzwicyane kwizina ry'ubuhanzi rya Jose Chameleone, numuhanzi akaba n'umucuranzi w'umunya -Uganduririmba injyana ya AfroBeat. Aririmba mu rurimi rw'Ikiganda, Icyongereza n'Igiswahili.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'uburezi.
Joseph Mayanja yavutse kuya 30 Mata 1979 kuri Gerald na Prossy Mayanja mukarere ka Kampala, akabumwana wa kane mubana umunani.
Yize mwishuri ribanza rya Nakasero, mwishuri ryisumbuye rya Mengo, mwishuri ryisumbuye rya Kawempe Muslim, mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Katikamu rya karindwi ry’abadivantisiti, no mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Progressive Senior.
Yahimbye indirimbo y’ishuri ryisumbuye rya Kawempe Muslim. Niumwe mubagize Kiliziya Gatolika y’i Roma muri Uganda.
Injyana ya Chameleone nuruvange rw'indirimbo gakondo zomuri Uganda, rhumba yo muri Afurika yo Hagati, zouk, na reggae.
Umwuga wewatangiye mu 1996 nk'umu DJ muri Missouri night club i Kampala. Yatangiye gukora nk'umucuranzi mu 1998 muri Kenya arikumwe n'itsinda rya Ogopa Deejays, icyogihe rikaba ryari irya Kenya, ryasohoye indirimbo yeyambere, "Bageya", yari irimo umuhanzi w'umunyakenya Redsan.
Chameleone yashyizahagaragara alubumu yeyambere, "Mama Mia", mu 2000. Kugeza mu 2013, yari amaze gushyira ahagaragara alubumu 13 zose, zirimo "Kipepeo", "Shida za dunia", "Valu valu", "Bayuda", "Badilisha", "Banana nziza" na "Nyampinga".
Nubwumuzikiwe ukunzwe hiryanohino kumugabane w' Afurika, abafana be benshi/abamwumva bakomoka cyane cyane mu gice cyo hagati cya Afurika (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, u Rwanda, u Burundi, Kenya, Uganda, na Tanzaniya).
Yaririmbye imbere y'abantu benshi cyane kuri sitade ya Lugogo Cricket Oval i Kampala.
Chameleone yakoreye ibitaramo mpuzamahanga, harimo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Kanada, Ubwongereza, Suwede, Ububiligi, Maleziya, Ubushinwa, Afurika y'Epfo, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Zambiya, Malawi, Sudani y'Epfo, Ubudage, n'Ubusuwisi. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Yazengurutse Ositaraliya mu 2017 no muri Werurwe 2023.
Muri Gashyantare 2023, Chameleone yakozigitaramo cyiza cyitwa "Gwanga Mujje", bisobanura "reka igihugu cyose kizitabire". Ikigitaramo cyabereye i Lugogo Cricket Oval i Kampala. Igitaramo cyari giteganyijwe mbere y'itariki, cyasubitswe kuberimvura nyinshi maze cyimurirwa kuya 24 Gashyantare 2023.
Chameleone yateguye igikorwa cy’urukundo cyagurishijwe cyanecyitwa "One Man, One Million" muri Victoria Hall i Kampala. Ikigikorwa cyashyigikiwe na Madamu wa Perezida wa Uganda, Janet Museveni, kandi abitabiriye basabwaga kwishyura miliyoni imwe y’amashilingi ya Uganda kugira ngo bitabire.
Ikirango cy'umuziki.
Chameleone ni Umuyobozi Mukuru w’inzu y’umuziki ya Leone Island. Abahanzi bafitanye isano n’iyi nzu barimo nyakwigendera Mosey Radio, Weasel, nyakwigendera AK 47 Mayanja, King Saha, Papa Cidy, Pallaso, Melody Uganda, Yung Mulo na Big Eye.
Uwahoze ari Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Uganda, Rebecca Kadaga, yagennye Chameleone kuba Ambasaderi wa Busoga Tourism Initiative.
Anayobora Chameleone Foundation, igamije guteza imbere ubumenyi n'impano mu rubyiruko rudafite amahirwe.
Chameleone ni umwe mu bagize ihuriro ry'abahanzi bakoresha icyamamare cyabo n'ubutunzi bwabo mu gufasha kugabanya ubukene no gukora ubukangurambaga ku cyorezo cya SIDA.
Yiyamamarije umwanya wa Meya wa Kampala mu 2021.

Imikino ya BRICS+ nirushanwa ryaburi mwaka rihuza imikino myinshi ritegurwa n'ibihugu bya BRICS. Irirushanwa murirusange ritegurwa n'igihugu kiyobora itsinda muri uwomwaka.
Nyumay'uko irushanwa ry'ibanze ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'abari munsiy'imyaka 17 ryabereye i Goa mu 2016, irushanwa ryambere rya BRICS ryabereye i Guangzhou mu Bushinwa mu 2017. Imikino yambereyarigizwe na volleyball, wushu, na taolu.
Imikinoyakurikiyehoyabereye i Johannesburg mu 2018, igizwe na volleyball y'abagabo n'abagore ndetse n'umupira w'amaguru w'ishyirahamwe ry'abagore.
Ntibyakozwemu 2019 na 2020, kubericyorezo cya COVID-19.
Imikino ya BRICS yomu 2021 yagombagagutegurwa n'Ubuhinde, kandiyagombaga guhuzwa n'imikino ya Khelo India yariteganyijwe muriuwomwaka. Iritangazoryatanzwe na Minisitiri w'Ubuhinde wa Siporo n'Urubyiruko, Kiren Rijiju, mu nama y'Abaminisitiri ba Siporo bomu bihugu bya BRICS. Ubuhinde bwabaye umuyobozi w'itsinda mpuzamahanga ryigenga ry'ibihugu bitanu mu 2021. Imikino yagombaga kubera mugihekimwe nahantu hamwe n'imikino ya Khelo India 2021, ariko amaherezibintibyakomeje.
Ikigikorwa cyomu 2022 cyateguwe n'Ubushinwa, arikonticyashoboraga kubera imbonankubone bitewe na politiki y'akarere yerekeye icyorezo cya coronavirus.
Iki gikorwa cya 2023 cyateguwe na Afurika y'Epfo mu Kwakira kibera i Durban. [bikenewe kuvugururwa]
Uburusiya bwakoreye irushanwa rya 2024 i Kazan.
Inyandiko zasohotse.

Umuziki waje kugaragara nka zimwe mu mpamvu zatuma umuntu abaho yishimye cyangwa se zikaba zafashwa mu kuzamura ibyiyumviro byiza kuri buri muntu wese.
Abashakashatsi bagaragaza ko umuziki ufite mu mimaro imwe n'imwe ikurikira:
. Uwo bita Daniyeli levitini(Daniel levitin).Uyu ni umushakashatsi mu by’ubwonko (neuroscientist) akaba n'umwanditsi w’igitabo cyitwa "“This Is Your Brain on Music.”" uyu mushakashatsi yerekanye ko umuziki ugabanya umusemburo wa cortisol utera stress kandi ugatuma umubiri ukora dopamine ituma umuntu ayumva amerewe neza.
. Undi mushakashatsi twavuga bamwita Dr sylvain Moreno akaba akorera ubushakashatsi bwe muri kaminuza ya New york(USA) yerekanye ko 90% by’abana bigishijwe umuziki mu gihe cy’ukwezi kumwe gusa bagaragaje kwiyongera kw’ubwenge (verbal intelligence) no gusobanukirwa amagambo vuba.
. undi mushakashatsi twavugaho ni Nina Kraus ari umuyobozi w'ishami ryitwa Auditory neuroscience akaba yarerekanye ko kwiga gukoresha ibicurangisho bituma ubwonko bumenya gutandukanya amajwi neza, bigafasha mu kwiga indimi no mu mibanire n’abandi.
Ibi ni bimwe mu bigaragaza akamaro k'umuziki kandi akaba ari nawo ukunzwe cyane cyane ko ukoreshwa mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi.

Umuhanzi Ririmba (izina rye ryiteka ni Gisa Cy'Ingozo) ni umwe mu bahanzi bakomeje kwigarurira imitima y'urubyiruko mu Rwanda, cyane cyane binyuze mu njyana ya n'iyitwa Kinyatrap.
Dore ibintu by'ingenzi wamenya kuri we:
Injyana n'Imiterere ().
Ririmba azwiho ijwi ririmo "" ikoreshejwe mu buryo bw'umwimerere ndetse n'amagambo (lyrics) akunze kugaruka ku buzima bwo mu muhanda, urukundo, n'icyizere cy'ejo hazaza. Ni umwe mu bagize itsinda rya LoudSound Music, ririmo n'abandi bahanzi bakomeye nka Bushali na Slum Drip.
Indirimbo ze zakunzwe.
Ririmba amaze gusohora indirimbo nyinshi zakoze ku mitima y'abantu, zimwe muri zo harimo:
Akamaro ke muri Kinyatrap.
Ririmba afatwa nk' "Imbaraga zihishe" (The hidden gem) muri Kinyatrap. Mu gihe Bushali azwiho imbaraga nyinshi ku rubyiniro (energy), Ririmba we azwiho kuzana injyana ituze, irimo amarangamutima (melodic vibes) ituma indirimbo zabo zirushaho kuryoha.
Hari igihe abantu bamwitiranya na Gisa cy'Ingozo (umuhanzi w'ijwi rirangurura wamenyekanye mu myaka yo hambere), ariko uyu Ririmba ni undi muhanzi mushya w'ikiragano gishya (New School).

Solange Nyiraneza (wavutse kuya 28 Kamena 1996) numukinnyi w’umunyarwanda wa Volleyball ukinira Sitting ukinamarushanwa ya Volleyball. Yahatanye mumikino Paralympic yomumpeshyi ya 2016, 2020 na 2024.
Ababyeyi ba Nyiraneza, baribavanze n’Abahutu n’Abatutsi, bishwe mubujura ubwo yari afite amezi atatu, mushikiwe mukuru na murumunawe baramureraga. Solange amazimyaka itanu, yagiye gukina hanzenamurumunawe agwa avunika patella, ahisha igikomerecye mugihe cy’icyumweru kugirango mushiki we atamurakarira. Bamujyanye kwamuganga gupimwa ubucucike bw’amagufwa, nyumabiza kugaragarako Nyiraneza yari afite kanseri y’amagufwa, yaciwe ukuguru kwekw’ibumosomunsi y’ikibuno.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye irushanwa rya Paralympic ryo mu mpeshyi ryabereye i Atene mu Bugereki mu 2004. Ikipeyaririmo umugabo umwe n'umugorumwe. Abakinnyi baturutse mu Rwanda begukanye umudari umwe wa bronze barangiza kumwanya wa 73 ku rutonde rw'imidari.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye amarushanwa ya Paralympic yo mu mpeshyi ya 2012 yabereye i Londres mu Bwongereza, kuva kuya 29 Kanama kugeza kuya 9 Nzeri 2012.
Dominique Bizimana yabaye Perezida wa Komite y'Igihugu y'Imikino y'Abamugaye mu Rwanda mu 2012, ndetse nokubumwe mubagizikipe y'igihugu y'abagabo ya sitting volleyball. Itsinda ry'abahagarariye itsinda ryacumbitse muri Cavesson House mumudugudu w'abamugaye.
Irushanwa ry'abagabo.
Iyikipe niyo yambere yomur'Afurika yomunsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara yitabiriye imikino ya Paralempike. Benshi mu bagize ikipe bagiye i Londres barokotse cyangwa bafite imiryango yarokotse jenoside yakorewe mu Rwanda. Babiri mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu batakaje amaguru n'amaboko barwana n'abakoze jenoside yakorewe mu 1992. Umwemurabo bagizikipe watakaje ukuguru ni Dominique Bizimana.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye amarushanwa ya Paralympic yomumpeshyi ya 2020 yabereye i Tokyo mu Buyapani, kuva kuya 24 Kanama na 5 Nzeri 2021. Uyuwari umunsi wagatandatu rwitabiriye amarushanwa ya Paralympic yomumpeshyi kuva mu 2000.
Volleyball yo kwicara.
Ikipe y'abagore yomu Rwanda ya sitting volleyball yegukanye itike yokwitabira imikino ya Paralympic yomumpeshyi ya 2020 nyumayogutsinda imikino ya ParaVolley Africa Zonal Championships yomu 2019.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye irushanwa rya Paralympic ryo mumpeshyi ya 2024 ryabereye i Paris mu Bufaransa, kuva kuya 28 Kanama kugeza kuya 8 Nzeri 2024. Ryarirushanwa rya karindwi ryikurikiranya ry’igihugu muri Paralympic zomumpeshyi, kuvaho igihugucyatangiriye mu 2000.
Urutonde rw'abahatana muri iyi mikino rukurikira.
Emmanual Niyibizi yegukanye itike nyumayo gutsindira umudari wa zahabu muri Grand Prix y'isi ya Dubai 2024 kuya 15 Gashyantare 2024.
Volleyball yo kwicara.
Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda yinjiye mumikino Paralempike bitewe n'umudari wa zahabu yatsindiye, mwirushanwa ry'Afurika rya Sitting Volleyball ryomu 2024 ryabereye i Lagos muri Nijeriya.
Kwitarikiya 27 Kanama 2024, Claudine Bazubagira womwikipe ya sitting volleyball yaburiwe irengero na Komite Olempike y'u Rwanda, nyuma y'uko batari bakimubona kuvabavuye mu nkambi y'ikipe i Courbevoie kwitariki ya 20 Kanama.

U Rwanda rwitabiriye imikino Olempike y'ingimbi yomumpeshyi ya 2014, i Nanjing, mu Bushinwa kuva kuya 16 Kanama kugeza kuya 28 Kanama 2014.
U Rwanda rwabonye abakinnyi bane.
Volleyball yo ku mucanga.
U Rwanda rwatsinze ikipe y'abahungu n'abakobwa binyuze mu kwitwara neza mu irushanwa rya CAVB Qualification Tournament.
U Rwanda rwahawe ikipe y'abakobwa kugira ngo ihiganwe na komisiyo y'ibihugu bitatu.
U Rwanda rwabonye itike yo koga umwe.

Kwibuka T20 Tournament cyangwa se irushanwa ryo Kwibuka T20, ni irushanwa rikorwa n’abagore mu mukino wa Cricket ribera mu Rwanda buri mwaka kuva muri 2014. Iri rushanwa mbere ryabanje kwitwa irushanwa rya Kwibuka Cricket for Peace, rigamije kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Mu mikino ya mbere, iri rushanwa ryitabiriwe n’ibihugu byo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, ariko ryagiye rikura mu myaka yakurikiyeho rigera ku makipe yo hirya no hino muri Afurika no hanze yayo.
Imikino ya mbere yabaye muri Kamena 2014 ku kibuga cya Kicukiro, kizwi nka Sitade Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket ya Gahanga i Kigali, ndetse yakiriye irushanwa ry'imikino itanu hagati y'u Rwanda na Uganda, ryatsinzwe n'Abagande ku bitego 4-1. Iyi mikino ya 2015, Kenya yiritabiriye hamwe nu Rwanda na Uganda. Abanyakenya batsinze imikino yabo yose kugira ngo begukane igikombe, mu gihe abari bakiriye iyi mikino bananiwe gutsinda. Kenya yikuye mu irushanwa rya 2016, bituma u Rwanda na Uganda bakina umukino wa 2016, maze abashyitsi batsinda ku bitego 4-0. Uganda nayo yatsinze irushanwa rya 40-overs umunsi umwe nyuma y'uko imikino ya T20 irangiye.

Skol Adrien Cycling Academy cyangwa se ishuri rya Skol ry'adrien Cycling Academy, ni ikipe yababigize umwuga ibarizwa mu Rwanda, basiganwa ku magare mu muhanda. Iyi kipe yashinzwe muri 2020 n’uwahoze ari umukinnyi w’amagare Adrien Niyonshuti Adrien kugira ngo ifashe guteza imbere abakiri bato b’abasiganwa ku magare bo mu Rwanda ibarizwa mu makipe yo ku rwego rwa afurika.

Adrien Niyonshuti (yavutse ku ya 2 Mutarama 1987) ni Umunyarwanda wahoze asiganwa ku magare wa bigize umwuga, yakinnye mu ikipe ya Team Dimension Data yo muri afurika y'epfo kuva mu 2009 kugeza 2017.Mu 2021, yakoraga nk'umuyobozi wa siporo mu ikipe ya UCI Continental Team Skol Adrien Cycling Academy.. Muri 2023, aza ku yobora ikipe y'igihugu yo gusiganwa ku magare muri Bénini yitegura imikino ya Shampiyona y'isi yari kubera mu Rwanda muri 2025.
Adrien yari afite abavandimwe batandatu gusa bishwe muri jenoside yakorewe mu Rwanda muri 1994. Nilyonshuti yatangiye gutwara igare yahawe na nyirarume akiri ingimbi ubwo yamenyaga uwahoze ari umunyegare wabigize umwuga Jacques Boyer muri 2006 mu irushanwa rya mbere rya Wooden Bike Classic.
Niyonshuti yavukiye i Rwamagana, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda, yatangiye gusiganwa ku magare y'abatarabigize umwuga afite imyaka cumi n'itandatu. Muri 2006, yamenyanye n'uwahoze ari umukinnyi w'amagare w'umwuga, Jacques Boyer, wari umunyamerika wa mbere wagiye mu irushanwa rya Tour de France, yakoreraga mu Rwanda mu mushinga wo gutumiza amagare y'imizigo ku bahinzi ba kawa. Boyer yanabaye umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda ishinzwe gusiganwa ku magare, anashaka Niyonshuti ngo ajye mu isiganwa. Niyonshuti yagize umusaruro mwiza mu masiganwa yo mu gace nka Tour of Rwanda, aho yarangije mu myaka icumi ya mbere yikurikiranya kandi atsinda kuva 2006 na 2008.

Ishyirahamwe ry’amagare mu Rwanda ni urwego ruyobora umukino wa magare mu Rwanda. ni umunyamuryango w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wo gusiganwa ku magare muri Afurika ndetse n’ubumwe bwamagare ku isi.
Perezida wa federatiyo mu Rwanda yari Murenzi Abdallah, wahoze ari umuyobozi w'Akarere ka Nyanza, watowe ku ya 22 Ukuboza 2019. Murenzi yasimbuye Aimable Bayingana, weguye mu ntangiriro z'uku kwezi kubera ibirego bya ruswa n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina,
Komite ishinzwe imiyoborere ya federatiyo igizwe na perezida, ba visi perezida babiri, umunyamabanga mukuru, umubitsi n'abajyanama batatu, bose bakaba ari imyanya yatowe.

Nikipe yashinzwe na Police y'urwanda hagamijwe guteza imbere volleyball y'abagore no gutuma Police y'urwanda Igira uruhare muri Siporo.
