yagiye ihagararira uRwanda mu marushanwa y’amakipe ya Afurika nka African Women’s Club Volleyball Championship.

Murenzi Abdallah ni umuyobozi w'ikipe ya Rayon sprots fc akaba yarahoze ari umuyobozi wa federatiyo y'amagare mu Rwanda, ndetse ya yoboye akarere ka Nyanza.
Murenzi Abdallah ni umugabo ubarizwa m'ubamusiramu, ufie umugore n'abana, ise nawe akaba yarakinnye mu ikipe ya rayon sprots fc.

Aimable Bayingana (yavutse ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1970) yari umuyobozi mukuru w’imikino mu Rwanda.
Bayingana yabaye perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’amagare mu Rwanda hagati ya 2007 na 2019. Kuva mu Kwakira 2018 kugeza mu Ukuboza 2019, yayoboye nk’umuyobozi w'ishyirahamwe ry’amagare rihuza ibihugu 33 bivuga igifaransa.
Bayingana yavutse ku ya 14 Nyakanga 1970, i Gatsibo, Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda. Afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu by'ubugeni yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Lomé, muri Togo.
Ku ya 5 Ukuboza 2007, mu gikorwa cyabereye kuri Sitade Amahoro, Bayingana yatorewe kuba perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abahoze ari abasiganwa mu magare mu Rwanda, ubu akaba ari FERWACY asimbuye Hon. Kamanda Charles wari umuyobozi kuva muri 2002, yayoboye uyu mwanya kugeza mu Ukuboza 2019. Kuva mu 2009 kugeza mu Ukuboza 2019, yari Perezida wa Komite Ishinzwe Gutegura Tour Du Rwanda.
Kuva mu 2013 kugeza mu 2019, Bayingana yabaye umwe mu bagize komite nshingwabikorwa barindwi b’ishyirahamwe ry’abasiganwa ku magare muri Afurika, muri uyu mwanya yatorewe kuyobora shampiyona y’umugabane w’Afurika y’amagare yabereye i Sharm El Sheikh, mu Misiri.
Bayingana yari na perezida w'amagre w'abavuga ififaransa kuva mu Kwakira 2018 kugeza Ukuboza 2019. Muri uyu mwanya yateguye Kigali Union Cycliste Internationale Junior Race muri Gicurasi 2019, irushanwa mpuzamahanga ry’imikino y’amagare ry’urubyiruko ryabereye i Kigali ryateguwe na Union Francophone de Cyclisme ku bufatanye na FERWACY na Association Internationale des maires Francophones.
Muri 2009, Bayingana yafashije kwandika tour du Rwanda mu cyiciro cya 2.2 cy'amasiganwa, yazamuwe igera ku cyiciro cya 2.1 kuva muri 2019.
Bayingana mu gihe cye, u Rwanda rwateguye amarushanwa ya Afurika yo gusiganwa ku magare mu muhanda ku nshuro ya mbere muri 2010, ndetse no ku nshuro ya kabiri mu 2018. U Rwanda rwanateguye amarushanwa ya Afurika yo gusiganwa ku magare mu misozi ku nshuro ya mbere mu 2015. Muri Nzeri 2019, u Rwanda rwohereje ubusabe bwemewe bwo kwakira amarushanwa y’isi yo gusiganwa ku magare mu 2025.
Muri 2018, ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda yo gusiganwa ku magare na Areruya Joseph begukanye irushanwa ry'amagare rya Tropicale Amissa Bongo (Tour du Gabon), ryari ku nshuro ya mbere ikipe ya Afurika iba ku rutonde rw'amakipe y'afurika atwara iri rushanwa. Mu gihe yamaze ku buyobozi, abakinnyi b'amagare b'u Rwanda begukanye Tour du Rwanda inshuro eshanu, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, na 2018.
Ku ya 18 Gashyantare 2018, Bayingana yahawe igihembo cy'ishimwe na Dr Mohamed Wagih Azzam perezida w'ishyirahamwe ry'abasiganwa ku magare muri Afurika kubera akazi gakomeye yakoze mu guteza imbere umukino w'amagare mu Rwanda no muri Afurika.

Shampiyona ya magare yo mu muhanda mu Rwanda iba buri mwaka kugira ngo hamenyekane abakinnyi batsinze mu isiganwa ryo mu muhanda, mu byiciro bitandukanye. Iyi shampiyona yabanje kuba muri 2010, kuva mu 2015 irimo icyiciro cy’abatarengeje imyaka 23.

Kagame cecafa muri 2014 ryari irya 39, ritegurwa na CECAFA. Ribera i Kigali, mu Rwanda kuva ku ya 8 kugeza ku ya 24 Kanama. U Rwanda ruri kwakira iri rushanwa ku nshuro ya kane kuva ryatangira muri 1974.
ikinyamakuru cyo muri Afurika y’Epfo witwa super sporti wabonye uburenganzira bwo kwerekana imikino yose yakinwe muri iryo rushanwa.
Ku ya 11 Nyakanga 2014, tombola y'uko amakipe azitabira irushanwa yashyizwe ahagaragara kuri Sitade Amahoro, imwe mu mbuga za cecafa mu Rwanda. Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame, umuterankunga w'irushanwa, yiyemeje gutanga amadorari ya Amerika 60.000 ku gihembo, mu gihe andi madorari ya Amerika 15.000 yemewe mu gutegura irushanwa. Yanga yari iteganijwe nk'uhagarariye Tanzaniya ariko yakuweho na CECAFA kuko ikipe yahisemo gushyiramo ikipe ya kabiri muri iri rushanwa, binyuranyije n'amategeko agenga irushanwa, maze isimburwa na Azam. Kimwe n'ikipe yatwaye igikombe cy'Uburundi Flambo y'ubrasirazuba yasimbuwe na Atlético olempike n'ikipe ya Ethiopian kofi yasimbuwe na Adama.
Amakipe 14 akurikira yitabiriye irushanwa:
Icyiciro cy'amatsinda cyarimo amakipe cumi n'ane, aho amakipe atanu mu itsinda rya A na B n'amakipe ane mu itsinda rya C. Amakipe atatu mu itsinda rya A na B n'amakipe abiri mu itsinda rya C yageze ku cyiciro cya 16.

Shampiyona y’igihugu y’amagare basiganwa ni gihe iba buri mwaka kugira ngo hamenyekane abakinnyi batwara igikombe mu mukino w’amagare mu byiciro bitandukanye basiganwa n'igihe. Iyi shampiyona yabanje kuba muri 2014, kuva mu 2015 irimo icyiciro cy’abatarengeje imyaka 23.

Electrogaz FC ni ikipe ikina umupira w'amaguru muri yabarizwaga muri shampiyona y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda. Iyi kipe yashinzwe muri 2008. Yitiriwe ikigo cy'amashanyarazi n'amazi cyo mu Rwanda cyitwa Electrogaz. Muri 2010 birukanywe muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere kuko abakinnyi batari bahembwa.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore ya criket y'u Rwanda ihagararira u Rwanda mu mukino mpuzamahanga w'abagore wa criket.
Ikipe y'abagore y'u Rwanda yakinnye bwa mbere muri 2007, bakinnye imikino ibiri na Uganda mu Kuboza uwo mwaka, mbere yo kwitabira Shampiyona y'abagore yo mu Karere ka Afurika y'Iburasirazuba yo muri 2008-09. Kuva muri 2014, iyi yitabiriye irushanwa rya Kwibuka T20 buri mwaka.
Muri Mata 2018, Inama Mpuzamahanga ya Cricket yahaye uburenganzira bwose abagore mu mikino mpuzamahanga ya Twenty20 ku banyamuryango bayo bose, imikino yose ya Twenty20 yakinwe hagati y'abagore b'u Rwanda n'abandi banyamuryango ba ICC kuva ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2018 yari WT20Is yuzuye.
U Rwanda Rwaje kwakira umukino warwo wa mbere wa WT20I ku ya 26 Mutarama 2019, mu mikino itanu rwakinnye na Nigeriya.
Mu bihembo bya 2019, bishimira iterambere rya siporo mu bihugu bifitanye isano n’ibifitanye isano, u Rwanda rwahawe ibihembo bibiri muri bitandatu byatanzwe Gahunda y’Umwaka y’Abagore, n’Umuco w’Abagore b’Umwaka.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore ya Volleyball yu Rwanda ihagararira i igihugu Rwanda mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga ya Volleyball y'abagore n'imikino ya gicuti.
Ikipe yitabirye imikino ya shampiyona y'abagore ya Volleyball muri Afurika yo muri 2001, 2007 na 2021.
Muri 2008, byatangajwe ko ikipe yagerageje gushaka umutoza w’umunyakenya Paul Bitok abe umutoza wabo w’igihugu, ariko yanze kuza maze ajya i Budapest kwiga. Bitok yaje kugaruka mu Rwanda yatangije imyitozo kuva akiri muto. Hashinzwe ingando mu ntara aho abakinnyi bakiri bato bashoboraga gutezwa imbere. Ubwo yavagayo mu 2020, u Rwanda rwari rufite amakipe yahatanaga ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu byiciro byose by’imyaka kandi ikipe y’igihugu ni yo yatwaye igikombe cya Afurika.
Guhera muri 2021, umutoza mukuru w'ikipe yari Paulo de Tarso.

Shampiyona y'abagore ya Basketball mu Rwanda ni shampiyona iteura irushanwa rya Basketball mu bagore ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu Rwanda. Ritegurwa na FERWABA, ishyirahamwe ry'igihugu rya Basketball mu Rwanda.
Ikipe ifite ibikombe byinshi mu mateka ya shampiyona ni APR WBBC.
Amakipe agize RWBL mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2024 ni aya:

Assouma Uwizeye (Yavutse ku ya 6 Mata 1996) ni umukinnyi w'umukino wa maboko wa Basketball w'Umunyarwanda, akina mu ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda.
Uwizeye yahagarariye u Rwanda mu gikombe cya shampiyona y'abagore ya FIBA muri 2022, aho yatsinze amanota 9.3 hamwe na rebandi zigera kuri 8.8 kuri buri mukino.
Mu gihe cy'amajonjora ya 2023 Fiba y'abagore mu cyiciro cya gatanu cya AfroBasket, Uwizeye yamenyekanye nk'umwe mu bitwaye neza hamwe na Odile Tetero na Marie Imanizabayo, bavuye ku ntebe y'abasimbura batsinda amanota 15 ndetse batsinda impuzandengo ya rebounds 5. Yanitabiriye kandi Afrobasket y'abagore ya 2023 aho yatsinze amanota 6 na rebandi 2 mu gice cya mbere cy'umukino.

Ineza Sifa (yavutse ku ya 14 Werurwe 2002) ni umukinnyi w'umukino w'amaboko wa Basketball w’Umunyarwanda, akina nkuzibira mu ikipe ya Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders ndetse no mu ikipe y’igihugu y’abagore ya Basketball yu Rwanda.
Sifa yize muri Greenforest Christian Academy i Decatur, muri Jeworujiya, aho yakinaga umukino wa Basketball.
Ku itariki ya 17 Ugushyingo 2021, Sifa Ineza Joyeuse yiyemeje gukina basketball muri kaminuza muri FIU mu gihe cyo gusinya amasezerano. Yimukiye muri Tennessee yo Hagati nyuma y'umwaka w'imikino.
Ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Sifa yahagarariye u Rwanda bwa mbere muri 2018 ubwo yahamagarwaga mu ikipe y'igihugu y'abatarengeje imyaka 18 kugira ngo akine shampiyona y'abagore ya FIBA U-18. Yongeye guhamagarwa mu ikipe y'igihugu y'abakuze mu gihe cy'amarushanwa ya Afrobasket y'abagore ya 2019, Afrobasket y'abagore ya 2021 ya FIBA-Amarushanwa ya Afrobasket y'abagore ya 2023.

Janai Croom Robertson (yavutse ku ya 23 Kamena 1999) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Basketball akaba ari umunyarwanda ukomoka ariko ukomoka muri Amerika.
Croom yavutse ku ya 23 Kamena 1999 i Cranston, muri Rhode Island, avukana na John Crooms ndetse na Lisa Robertson. Yize mu ishuri rya Mutagatifu Andereya i Barrington, muri Rhode Island, aho yakiniga mu ikipe ya Basketball yaho.
Croom yakiniye Ohio State Buckeyes mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri (2018 kugeza 2020), Michigan State Spartans kuva mu 2020 kugeza 2021 mbere yo kujya muri Providence Friars mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri (2021 kugeza 2023). Nk'umukinnyi wa kabiri muri Ohio State mu 2019-20, yakinnye imikino 32, yatangiriyeho imikino 10, atsinda amanota 6.8 kuri buri mukino.
Muri 2022, ubwo yari mu itsinda rya Providence Friars, yabonye ibihembo ari kumwe na Kylee Sheppard.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Croom yakiniye u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya AfroBasket ry’abagore rya FIBA ryo muri 2023 aho yatsinze amanota 13.6, agace ka 5.6 atera imipira ndetse n’imipira ivamo ibitego 2.8 kuri buri mukino mu irushanwa.

Kubwimana Kazingufu Ali (yavutse 29 Ukuboza 1995) ni umukinnyi wamaboko wa basketball w'abigize umwuga, ukinira REG ndeste nu Rwanda. Guhagarara kuri 1.80 m, akina nk'umuzamu w'inyuma.
Ali ni umukinnyi w’umuzamu uzwi cyane kubera umuvuduko we, nkuko bamwe mu bafana bakunze kumwita Umuntu ufite ibihaha bine; ashobora kandi gukoreshwa nk'Umurinzi wo Gushotora, kandi ni umuhanga mu gushotora amanota atatu. Yakinnye n'abandi banyamwuga benshi bazwi nka Shime (gutsinda muri IPRC Kigali Basketball club); Sani Eric (hagati muri IPRC South Basketball club) na Marc Rushagaza (muri Patriots BBC).
Ali yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda kuva muri 2014.

Kendall Lamar Gray (yavutse ku ya 5 Gicurasi 1992) ni umukinnyi ukoresha amaboko ukina Basketball, ni umunyarwanda wavukiye muri Amerika, ubu akaba akinira REG BBC. Yakinnye Basketball ari muri kaminuza ya Delaware State, aba umukinnyi w’umwaka mu mikino yo hagati mu burasirazuba bwa 2014-15.
Gray yavukiye i Merced, muri Californiya gusa yakuriye i Dover, muri Delaware. Yatsindiye amanota atatu ya kaminuza ubwo yakinaga mu ishuri rikuru rya Polytech i Woodside, muri Delaware. Muri 2010, yabonye ikipe mu irushanwa ry'omu majyepfo Mu mwaka wa nyuma w’imikino ya Gray yatsinze amanota 15, rebandi 12, na bloke 11 kuri buri mukino. Hanyuma yiyemeje gukinira ikipe ya Delaware Sitate muri kaminuza.
Nyuma yo kudakinira mu irushanwa rya NBA ryo muri 2015, Gray yasinye amasezerano na Medi Bayreuth yo muri Basketball Bundesliga ku ya 23 Nyakanga 2015. Ku ya 18 Mutarama 2016, yatandukanye na Medi Bayreuth. Ku ya 31 Werurwe, yaguzwe na Iowa Energy yo muri NBA ariko ntiyayikinira.
Ku ya 23 Kanama 2016, Gray yasinye amasezerano na MKS Dąbrowa Gornicza wo muri shampiyona ya Polonye.

Ntore Habimana (wavutse ku ya 15 Kanama 1997) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Basketball yavukiye muri canada, ukinira APR muri Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda. Ni umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Habimana yavukiye Mississauga, muri Ontario kwa se w'u Rwanda na nyina w'Abarundi, bari barimukiye muri canada muri 1994. Akiri umwana, yasengaga ibigirwamana cyitwa Vince Carter.

Igikomangoma Chinenye Ibeh (yavutse ku ya 3 Kamena 1994) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w’umunyamerika ufite inkomoko mu Rwanda, akaba yaranakiniye ikipe ya Patriots yo muri shampiyona ya basketall yu Rwanda.
Ibeh yakinnye basketball muri kaminuza muri Texasi kuva mu 2012 kugeza 2016. Ibeh yatsindiye amanota 17, afata ribandi 10 ndetse anatera amashoti atanu mu mukino batsinze amanota 71-54 ku ya 26 Mutarama 2016. Nku mukinnyi wo mu cyiciro cya kabiri, yinjiye mu mwanya munini kubera imvune ya Cameron Ridley. Yatsinze amanota 4.1, ribandi 5.0, na bloki 2.0 kuri buri mukino, atera 57.8%. Yagizwe umukinnyi w'umwaka w'abakinnyi 12 bakomeye mu 2016, atoranywa mu ikipe ya 12 bakomeye mu myitozo.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Inzitiramubu zo mu birwa bya Isilande (2017–2018).
Long Island Nets, ishami rya NBA rya Brooklyn, yasiniye Ibeh muri Gashyantare 2017. Mu mukino we wa kabiri na Nets, Ibeh yatsinze amanota 3 na rebounds 6 mu minota hafi 15.

Prosper Karangwa (yavutse ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1978) ni Umunyakanada ufite ubwenegihugu bwu Rwanda, wahoze akina umukino wa Basketball w'abigize umwuga, akaba n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ibiro bya Visi Perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Basketball, afite inshingano z’umuyobozi mukuru wa delaware.
Karangwa mu mashuri y'isumbuye yize ubuforomo ndetse akaba n'umuhanga mu by'imiti, yabanje gukurira mu Burundi yimukira i Montreal n'umuryango we afite imyaka icyenda. Yakinnye umukino wa Basketball mu Ishuri Rikuru ry’imikino ngororamubiri ryo muri Siena College imyaka ine (1999–2003).

Kami Kabange (yavutse ku ya 2 Nyakanga 1984) ni umukinnyi w’umunyarwanda wavukiye muri Kongo wahoze akinira basketball. Ureshya na metero 2.03, akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati. Yamaze imyaka 12 mu ikipe zitandukanye zo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba akina. Yavukiye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, afite ubwenegihugu bw'u Rwanda kandi yahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Kabange yavukiye i Likasi, yatangiye gukina basketball akiri muto, abifashijwemo n'abavandimwe be. Afite imyaka 17, Lubumbashi Sporti yamubonye, imuha kujya gukina muri shampiyona ya Kongo.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Nyuma yo gukina umwaka umwe muri Lubumbashi Sport, Kabange yakinnye umwaka ibiri muri Besa Mazembe.
Kabange yatangiye umwuga we mu Rwanda muri APR bbc, ayobowe n'umutoza mukuru Cliff Owuor. Mu mwaka we wa mbere w'imikino, yafashije ikipe ye kwegukana ibikombe bya shampiyona y'igihugu ya Rwanda.

Darryl Nganji NKURIKIYINKA ni Umunyarwanda ufite ubwenegihugu bw' ububirigi, akaba ari umukinnyi w' umupira w' amaguru. Darryl yavutse kuwa 24 gicurasi, 2005 kugeza ubu akinira ikipe ya standard de liege mu bubirigi ndetse agakinira n' ikipe y' igihugu y' u Rwanda amavubi.

Thiago Cordeiro ku ya 30 Mata 1981 wavukiye i Nyamirambo, mu Rwanda ni umukinnyi wa Basketball ukomoka muri Burezili wakiniye mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda ya Basketball mu irushanwa rya FIBA Africa Championship ryo muri 2009. Yakiniye Dayton Flyers basketball y'abagabo mu mwaka wa 2007-08.
Kayijuka yiyongereye mu ikipe y’u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya FIBA rya Afurika ryo muri 2009 nyuma y’uko abakinnyi babiri b’u Rwanda bavuye mu irushanwa ibyumweru bitatu mbere y’uko umukino utangira wari uteganyijwe. Nubwo byari bimeze bityo, Kayijuka yatsinze amanota 5.8 ya PPG, 5 RPG, na 1.6 BPG mu gihe yafatanyaga na Robert Thomson, mu afasha Abanyarwanda kurangiza ku mwanya wa 9 ndetse no kwitwara neza kugeza ubu mu irushanwa rya Afurika.

Matthew Miller (yavutse ku ya 11 Ukuboza 1982) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w'Umunyamerika ufite ibyangombwa by'u Rwanda, wakiniye ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda ya Basketball mu irushanwa rya shampiyona nyafurika muri 2007 na 2009.
Miller wavukiye i Aurora, muri Ilino, ni umunyamerika kavukire wakinnye basketball muri kaminuza ya Belarimine. Miller ni umwe mu bakinnyi benshi bashinjwa kuba umucanshuro w’ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball y’u Rwanda kuko gifite umuco muto wa Basketball cyabaye kimwe mu makipe akomeye muri Afurika. Miller, hamwe na Robert Thomson, bagiranye impaka ku irushanwa rya FIBA Africa Championship ryo muri 2009 ubwo ikipe ya Maroke yahanganye hafi kwanga gukina umukino wo gufungura nyuma yo gushinja aba bombi kuba abacanshuro b’u Rwanda, nubwo bombi bakinnye n’u Rwanda kuva muri 2007., Miller yari umwe mu bakinnyi bakomeye b’u Rwanda muri iri rushanwa, aho yakuyemo impuzandengo ya 13.2 mu ikipe.

Ikoranabuhanga ni iritugeza ku majyambere. Tugomba kurikoresha mu bintu byubaka kandi biteza imbere Igihugu, ubwo wiyibagije igihombo wigeze kugira kubera ko utari wakamenya mudasobwa? Ubika amakuru ku mpapuro, mwakwimura ibintu ukayoberwa aho urupapuro umukiriya yari yarabasinyiye aguza miriyoni yose rwagiye! Ntiwayishyuye se da! Mwumvaneza: Yego di! No kohererezanya amafaranga ubu bisigaye ari nk’ubufindo? Munyawera:Unteye kwibuka n’ikindi. Uzi ko wa mubyara wange uba i Bwotamasimbi nange yanyoherereje ku madorari? Mwumvaneza:Barayankase ariko! Munyawera:Yego ariko ikibazo kigakemuka. Wowe uracyakinisha ikoranabuhanga! Uzansure ariko nkwereke ya nzu nshaka kubaka uko imeze. Mwumvaneza:Nawe noneho uri umuti w’amenyo! Urayinyereka utari wanasiza ikibanza? Munyawera: Ni rya koranabuhanga nakubwiraga nyine rya mudasobwa! Igishushanyo cyayo kiri muri mudasobwa nyine! Tanga nibura ingero enye z’ibyiza by’ikoranabuhanga rikoresha mudasobwa byagaragajwe mu mwandiko.

Axel Mpoyo (yavutse ku ya 5 Mutarama 1997) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w’Umunyarwanda ukinira ikipe ya APR muri shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda na Basketball ny'afurika yitwa BAL ndetse anakinira ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda.
Mpoyo yavukiye i Kinshasa muri RDC, kuri se w’Umunyekongo akaba na nyina w’Umunyarwanda. Afite abavandimwe babiri na mushiki we. Yavuye mu gihugu akiri muto ajya muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya meridiane muri Idaho. Muri Meridiane, yanagerageje umupira w’amaguru n’imikino yo kwiruka, mbere yo guhitamo gukomeza basketball amaze gukura.
Mpoyo yakinnye muri kaminuza ya Grambling Sitate University, akinira ikipe ya basketball ya Tigers.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Mu mwaka we mushya, Mpoyo yakiniye ikipe ya shipure yitwa APOEL mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Basketball cya shipure. Ntiyarangije shampiyona ari kumwe n'iyi kipe, kuko yimukiye muri KB Trepça muri Kosovo hagati mu mwaka w'imikino.
Mpoyo yakinnye n'ikipe y'u Rwanda REG bbc kuva mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2021-22. Yafashije REG kwegukana igikombe cya shampiyona cya 2021-22, anahabwa umwanya wa MVP. yakinnye nayo muri Basketball nyafurika ya BAL mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2023 na 2024.
Mu Ukwakira 2022, Mpoyo yinjiye mu ikipe y'u Rwanda ya APR muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL). Yayifashije kwegukana igikombe cya RBL mu 2023 na 2024.
Muri shampiyona ya 2023-24, Mpoyo yakinnye muri Arigentine mu ikipe ya Pico FC.
Ku itariki ya 13 Kamena 2025, Mpoyo yatsinze ibitego 10 by'amanota atatu mu mukino wa gatatu mu mwaka wa 2025 wa BAL, ashyiraho agahigo gashya ka Basketball nyafurica ya BAL. Yarenze agahigo kashyizweho na Will Perry, wari watsinze ibitego icyenda by'amanota atatu. Imikinire ya Mpoyo yafashije APR gutsinda umukino, ishyiraho agahigo ka shampiyona mu manota menshi mu mukino ifite amanota 123, irangiza iri ku mwanya wa gatatu.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Mpoyo yahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda, kandi yakinnye n'ikipe muri FIBA Afro Basket muri 2021, ndetse no mu yandi marushanwa yo kwitegura.

Kanseri y’ibihaha ni imwe mu ndwara zitandura zizahaje umubare munini w’abatuye Isi, aho zinatwara ubuzima bw’abatagira ingano buri mwaka. Binavugwa ko iyi kanseri ari imwe mu ziganje mu bantu kurusha izindi kuko iza ku mwanya wa kabiri
Imibare yatangajwe n’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga ushinzwe kurwanya Kanseri, ugaragaza ko nko mu mwaka wa 2020 ku isi hose habonetse abarwayi ba kanseri basaga miliyoni 2.2, kikavuga ko gukoresha itabi cyangwa kurinywa byongera ibyago byo kwandura iyi ndwara ihangayikishije ubuzima rusange.
Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rivuga ko hafi umuntu umwe muri batanu bicwa n’ubwoko butandukanye bwa kanseri baba bambuwe ubuzima na kanseri y’ibihaha. Nubwo iri ku kigero kimwe n’icy’abandura kanseri y’ibere, kanseri y’ibihaha yo yica abantu baruta abicwa n’iy’ibere, iy’amara ndetse n’iya Prostate ubateranyije.
Ubuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe kurwanya indwara zitandura mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima (RBC) bwatangaje ko abanywi b’itabi baba bafite ibyago byikubye inshuro zisaga 22 zo kurwara kanseri y’ibihaha mu buzima bwabo, bakagira ibyago byo kurwara umutima ndetse n’uruhu rugasaza vuba.
Ubuyobozi bwa RBC, mu butumwa bwanyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, bwagize buti: “Iyemeze kurivaho kugira ngo ubeho ubuzima buzira umuze.”
Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bavuga ko iyi kanseri ihera mu bihaha ifata mu moko abiri y’ingenzi ari yo yiswe mu rurimi rw’amahanga “non-small cell lung cancer” na “small cell lung cancer”.
Uretse abashobora kwandura banyoye itabi, binavugwa ko n’abakunda kwegera aho banywera itabi bashobora kwandura iyo kanseri, kimwe n’abashobora guhumeka ubwoko bw’uburozi bwo mu muryango umwe n’uwo mu itabi.
Bimwe mu bimenyetso by’ibi kanseri harimo inkorora idakira akenshi ukorora agacira amaraso, gutakaza ibilo no guhungetwa, kubabara mu gatuza, kubura ikiryi, kunanirwa guhumeka n’ibindi. Ibyinshi muri ibyo bimenyetso bigaragara iyo kanseri yatangiye kurenga umuntu.
Bumwe mu buvuzi bushobora guhabwa uwayirwaye harimo kumutera imiti, kumubaga, kumushiririza, kumuha imiti igabanya ibibazo bimwe na bimwe ndetse no kumwongerera ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri.

Aristide Mugabe (yavutse ku ya 11 Gashyantare 1988) yahoze ari umukinnyi wa Basketball w’Umunyarwanda ubu ni umutoza wa Kepler BBC wo muri shampiyona y’umukino wa Basketball y’u Rwanda (RBL). Yakinnye imyaka 11 mu ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda. Afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinnyi beza mu mateka ya Basketball y’u Rwanda.
Atangiye umwuga we muri Rusizi, Mugabe yasinye amasezerano muri Espoir muri 2009, afasha ikipe ye kwegukana ibikombe bine bya RBL ndetse atwara ibihembo bibiri bya MVP. Muri 2015, yerekeje muri Patriots aho yatwaye ibindi bikombe bine. Mugabe ni umwe mu bakinnyi bafite ibihembo byinshi mu mateka ya Basketball yo mu Rwanda.
Ku ruhande rw'u Rwanda, Mugabe yakinnye amarushanwa atatu ya afurika.
Mugabe yavukiye mu inkambi ya yoborwaga na Habiryayo na Veneranda Mukamurehe i Maraba, umurenge wo mu Karere ka Huye mu Rwanda, akaba yari uwa kabiri mu muryango w'abahungu batatu. Yakuze akina umupira w'amaguru n'abandi bana bo mu gace atuyemo.
Muri 1994, ubwo Mugabe yari afite imyaka itandatu, se, bakuru be n'abandi bato, n'abandi bene wabo bishwe n'umutwe w'Interahamwe muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Nyuma y'urupfu rwabo, baza kwimuka kugira ngo ahunge Interahamwe. we na nyina bimuriwe mu Burundi n'umuryango we.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Muri 2007, Mugabe yakinnye bwa mbere muri shampiyona y'igihugu ya Basketball (NBL), shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda, ari kumwe na Rusizi BBC. Nyuma y'imyaka ibiri, yinjiye mu ikipe y'u Rwanda ya Espoir BBC. Mugabe yanakinnye mu mikino yo gushaka itike ya Shampiyona ya FIBA Afurike muri 2009 ndetse no muri Cericle Siporitifu ya Kigali (CSK) muri 2010. Muri 2012, Mugabe yayoboye Espoir muri shampiyona yayo ya mbere ya Zone V, itike yo kujya mu gikombe cya 2012 cya igikombe FIBA afurika, ndetse yagizwe n'umukinnyi mwiza wa Basketball nyuma yo kwegukana igikombe gisanzwe cy'umwaka n'igikombe gitangira shampiyona. Mu 2013, yongeye kuba umukinnyi mwiza nyuma yo gufasha Espoir BBC kwegukana igikombe gisanzwe cy'umwaka n'igikombe
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Mugabe yakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda imyaka 11, akaba yaranabaye kapiteni muri iyo mikino myinshi. Yakinnye muri Basketball ya afurika mu 2011, 2013, na 2017. Mugabe yatangaje ko agiye gusezera mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2021.
Mu ntangiriro za 2014, Mugabe yarangije muri Kaminuza y’Abadivantisiti b’Abalayiki ya Kigali (UNILAK) i Kigali afite impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu by’imari. Yakoreye muri Banki ya Kigali, nyuma aza no kuba umucungamari wa sosiyete y’umutekano yo mu Rwanda ISCO.

Siporo nikintu cy'ingenzi mu muco wa Kenya. Siporo gakondo zitandukanye zaranzwe mumuco wa Kenya kuva mu mateka yayo ya kera. Imwemumikino gakondo n'imikino yamenyekanye muri Kenya kuva kera harimo imikino yo gusiganwa, imyitozo ngororamubiri yogusiganwa, imirwano y'inkoni, guhiga (gukoresha amacumu n'imyambi), imikino yokukibaho, imikino y'ibimasa n'imbyino.
Imikino myinshi igezweho muri Kenya yatangiye mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abongereza. Amakipe y'abahanga mu buryo bw'amatsinda yateguwe n'abimukira b'Abongereza bakolonijwe n'abafatanyabikorwa b'Abanyaziya kuva mu 1922, mbere y'uko amashuri yemewe ashingwa. Siporo yatangijwe mumashuri mu 1925. Gahunda yokwigisha siporo binyuze mumyitozo ngororamubiri mumashuri (ibikorwa byo hanze y'amasomo) yateguwe mu 1935. Umupira w'amaguru na siporo (gusiganwa ku maguru) niyo mikino ya mbere yateguwe muburyo bw'umwuga.
Murikigihe, imikinomyinshi ikunzwe muri Kenya, ikorwa haba muburyo bw'umwuga ndetse nomu kwidagadura. Umukino ukunzwe cyane muri Kenya numupira w'amaguru. Imikino ikinirwa muri Kenya murikigihe irimo siporo (gusiganwa kumaguru n'ibindi bikorwa byo kwiruka), cricket, hockey yo mu kibuga, imikino yo gutwara imodoka, umupira w'amaguru w'ishyirahamwe, rugby union, volleyball, basketball, koga no kwibira, umupira w'intoki w'ikipe, netball, rounders, baseball, kurasa, softball, gusiganwa ku magare, imikino yo kurwana (iteramakofe, karate ya Shotokan, karate ya Goju Ryu, karate ya Shorin Ryu, kickboxing, judo, Mantis kenPo na taekwondo), Tennis yo mu gasozi, Tennis yo ku meza, Squash, Badminton, Golf, Canoeing, Chess, Goal Ball, Kugendera ku mafarashi/Equestrianism, Polo, Kuterura ibiremereye, Gukina, Kurasa imiheto, Roller Sports, Hockey yo mu rubura na Siporo yo mu misozi - Kenya.
Kwisi yose, Kenya izwi cyane cyane kubera kwiganza mu masiganwa yo hagati n'ay'intera ndende.
Siporo (imikino yo gusiganwa ku maguru no kwiruka).
Siporo (gusiganwa ku maguru) yari imwe mu mikino ibiri igezweho (hamwe n'umupira w'amaguru) yateguwe ku mugaragaro muri Kenya. Kenya yagiye itanga igikombe cy'imikino Olempike na Commonwealth mu mikino itandukanye yo kwiruka, cyane cyane mu myaka 800 ishize. m, 1,500 m, 3,000 m steeplechase, 5,000 m, 10.000 m na marato. Abakinnyi ba Kenya (cyane cyane Kalenjin) bakomeje kwigarurira isi yo kwiruka intera ndende, nubwo amarushanwa ya Maroc na Etiyopiya yagabanyije ubu buhanga. Abakinnyi bazwi cyane muri Kenya barimo Catherine Ndereba wegukanye Marato ya Boston inshuro enye mubagore, akaba n'uwatwaye igikombe cy'isi inshuro ebyiri, Paul Tergat wahoze afite agahigo kwisi muri Marato, na John Ngugi. Ikibazo cy'impamvu Abanyakenya aribobitwaye cyane mukwiruka intera ndende cyatumye habaho ibisobanuro bitandukanye bijyanye n'imiterere y'ubutaka, cyangwa imiterere y'amagufwa, cyangwa indyo.
Kurikirana ibikorwa.
Kipchoge Keino, wegukanye igikombe cya Olempike n'imikino ya Commonwealth mukiruhuko cy'izabukuru, yafashije mugutangiza ingoma ya Kenya yomumyakaya 1970, hanyuma akurikirwa na Henry Rono, wegukanye igikombe cya Commonwealth, watsinze agahigo k'isi.
Kenya yegukanye imidari myinshi mumikino Olempike ya Beijing, imidari 6 ya zahabu, imidari 4 ya feza n'imidari 4 ya bronze, bitumibigihugu cyatsinzecyane mur'Afurika mumikino Olempike yo mu 2008. Abakinnyi bashya bakunze kwitabwaho, nka Pamela Jelimo, wegukanyumudari wa zahabu mubagore wa metero 800 watsindiye igihembo cya Golden League, na Samuel Wanjiru wegukanye marathon y'abagabo.
Ibirori byo mu kibuga.
Julius Yego yabayumukinnyi wambere w’umunyakenya utsindiyumudari wa zahabu mumikino ya Commonwealth ubwoyegukanagigikombe cyogusiganwa kumacumu mwirushanwa rya 2014 ryabereye i Glasgow (umunyakenya mugenzi we John Makaya yari yatwaye umudari wa bronze mu irushanwa nk’iryo imyaka mirongo ine mbereyaho mumarushanwa ya Commonwealth yo mu 1974 i Christchurch). Umwaka wakurikiyeho yatwaye umudari wambere wa zahabu mu irushanwa rya shampiyona y’isi ya Kenya mwirushanwa rya shampiyona y’isi ya 2015 mu mikino ngororamubiri i Beijing, aho yashyizeho agahigo gashya ka miliyoni 92.72 mugihe yaragiye gutsinda.
Abakinnyi b'abanyakenya bitwaye neza mwirushanwa rya IAAF World Cross Country Championship mumyaka 25 ishize, bakomeje gutsindira Etiyopiya; kuvamu 1986 kugeza 2011, umwaka ushize iryo siganwa ryabaga burimwaka, ikipey'abagabo ya Kenya yegukanye ibikombe 24 by'isi, harimo 18 byikurikiranya kugeza Etiyopiya yegukanye mu 2004-05. Ikipey'abagabo bato yegukanye ibikombe 23 kuva mu 1988, nahwikipe y'abagore yegukanye ibikombe bine byikurikiranya kuvamu 2009. Abanyekenyabato ba Kenya begukanye ibikombe 15 by'isi. Inshuro eshanu - mu 1991 (Ububiligi), 1993 (Esipanye), 1995 (Ubwongereza), 1996 (Afurika y'Epfo) na 2010 (Polonye) - Kenya yagize igikombe mu marushanwa y'abagabo n'abagore y'abakuze n'abato.
Abagabo batatubo muri Kenya nibobonyine begukanye ibikombe by'isi byogusiganwa kumaguru kurwego rw'abagabo, kandibabiri muribobegukanye amakamba menshi. John Ngugi yabayuwa mbere wegukanye igikombe cy'isi inshureshanu (1986–89, 1992). Paul Tergat, ukina mugihugu, yabaye uwa mbere wegukanye ibikombe bitanu yikurikiranya (1995–1999). Edith Masai yegukanye isiganwa rigufi ry'abagore rya kilometero 4 inshuro eshatu zikurikiranya (2003–2004).
Abasiganwa baturutse muri Kenya birutse inshuro zirindwi munshuro 10 zihutacyane mukwiruka ibirometero 26.2. Banabaye bamwe mubatsinzecyane mwisiganwa rya Marato ku isi: Boston, New York, Londres, Berlin, Chicago na Tokyo. Umubare udasanzwe w’abatsinze marato ni Kalenjin.
Ibrahim Hussein yegukanyintsinzi yambere muntsinzi eshatu za Marato ya Boston mu 1988, mu gihekitarenze umwakumwe nyumayogutsinda Marato ya New York City. Hussein yatsinze intsinzi zikurikiranye i Boston mu 1991-92. Abagabo b'Abanyakenya baciye agahigo muri Marato ya Boston inshuro 20 kuvamu 1988, hariminshuro 10 zikurikiranya kuvamu 1991 kugezamu 2000. Abagore b'Abanyakenya batsinze i Boston inshuro 10, enye murizo zigatsindwa n'umugore umwe. Abatsinze bazwi:
Marato yo mu Mujyi wa New York.
Intsinzi ya Hussein muri Marato ya New York City mugihe cy'impeshyi ya 1987 yari iya mbere yakozwe n'umwirutsi ufite inkomoko mur'Afurika muri iri rushanwa. Nyuma y'imyaka itatu, Douglas Wakiihuri yatsinzisiganwa ritangirira muri Staten Island rigaca muri Queens, Brooklyn na Bronx, rigasozwa muri Pariki Nkuru ya Manhattan. Abagabo b'Abanyakenya batsinze irisiganwa inshuro umunani, naho abagore b'Abanyakenya batsinda batandatu mucyiciro cyabose. Muri bo:
Douglas Wakiihuri yatsinzisiganwa mu 1989; byarigufata imyaka 15 mberey'uko undimunya Kenya witwa Evans Rutto atsinda i Londres. Martin Lel yatsinze intsinzi eshatu muriirirushanwa kandi yashyizeho agahigo kogukoresha iminota 2:05:15 mu 2008. Mary Keitany yatwaye ibikombe bikurikirana mu 2011-12.
Marato ya Chicago yabaye bwambere mu 1977. Abasiganwa baturutse muri Kenya batsinze irushanwa ry’abagabo inshuro 12, harimo icyenda zikurikiranya kuvamu 2003 kugeza 2011.
Abagabo b'Abanyakenya batsinze amasiganwa atatu ashize ya Marathon ya Berlin (kuvamu 2012) n'andi 12 murirusange, harimintsinzi zirindwi zikurikiranya kuvamu 1999 kugeza 2005. Patrick Makau Musyoki yatsinze mumyaka yikurikiranya mu 2010 na 2011, ayayanyuma akaba yarayatsinze mu gihe cy'amasaha 2 n'iminota 3 n'iminota 38 ku isi.
Irushanwa rishya rya Marato y'Isi, Marato ya mbere ya Tokyo yabayemu 2007. Daniel Njenga yatsinzisiganwa ryambere akoresheje iminota 2:09:45. Abakinnyi b'Abanyakenya batsinze iri siganwa inshuro enye, harimo na Dennis Kimetto watwaye igikombe cya 2013, washyizeho agahigo ko kwiruka (2:06:50).
Samuel Wanjiruyabaye umunyakenya wambere wabayumukinnyi wambere mumikino Olempike muri marathon ubwoyirukaga agahigo k'imikino Olempike kunshuro ya 2:06:32 atsindirumudari wa zahabu i Beijing mu 2008.
Impinduka mu bwenegihugu.
Muminsi ishize, habayehimpaka mumakipe y’imikino ngororamubiri ya Kenya, aho abakinnyi benshi ba Kenya bagiye guhagararira ibindi bihugu, cyanecyane Bahrain na Qatar. Minisiteri ya Siporo ya Kenya yagerageje guhagarika abakinnyi bashya, ariko bakomeje, Bernard Lagat ari we uheruka, ahitamo guhagararira Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ibyinshi muri ibi bishya bibaho bitewe n’ubukungu cyangwa amikoro, arikobamwe mubakinnyi b’abahanga ba Kenya badashobora kwinjira mwikipe ikomeye y’igihugu cyabonabo biroroshye kuzuzibisabwa binyuze mukwiyamamariza ibindibihugu.
Umupira w'amaguru w'ishyirahamwe.
Umupira w'amaguru numukino ukunzwecyane muri Kenya. Kenya yarigihugu gikomeye mukarere k'umupira w'amaguru, arikimbaragazayo zarasenyutse kuberamakimbirane arimu Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru rya Kenya. Ibibyatumye FIFA ihagarikwa muri Werurwe 2007. Umupira w'amaguru muri Kenya ubu ugenzurwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru rya Kenya. Kombii Betty Nanjalah umwe mubashinze Ishyirahamwe ry'Urubyiruko rwa Siporo rya Mathere (MYSA) - Kenya, Urugendo rwambere muri Noruveje mu 1991, arikumwe n'itsinda ry'abakinnyi 16 baturutse mumihanda ya Nairobi. Yatojwe nk'umusifuzi w'Umupira w'Amaguru.
Ishyirahamwe ry'abakina rugby.
Kenya irimo kwihesha izina mwikipe ya rugby. Irakunzwe cyane muri Kenya cyanecyane mu irushanwa rya Safari Sevens ngarukamwaka. Ikipe ya Kenya sevens yaje kumwanya wa 9 mu mikino y’isi ya IRB Sevens mu mwaka wa 2006.
Kenya kandiyabaye ikipikomeye muri Volleyball y'abagore mur'Afurika, ahwamakipe yomuri Kenya yegukanye amarushanwa 13 y'Afurika, kandi ikipe y'igihugu iyoboye shampiyona y'umugabane w'Afurika ifite ibikombe 9 kuva mu 1991. Ikipey'abagore nayoyagiyeyitabira imikino Olempike na Shampiyona y'Isi ariko nta ntsinzi igaragara yatsinze.
Umukino wa Basketball numukinukunzwecyane muri Kenya, cyane cyane murubyiruko. Iki gihugu gisanzwe gicumbikiye abakinnyi benshi batsinze ba NCAA yomur'Amerika, ifatwa nk'itsinda rikomeye ku isi rya basketball ku banyeshuri ba Kaminuza na Kaminuza. Abakinnyi bazwi cyane barimo Joel Awich (Cal Poly), Tylor Ongwae (LA-Monroe) na Tom Wamukota (State ya Wichita). Nyamara, umubare w'Abanyakenya bakina nk'ababigize umwuga mu makipe akomeye mu Burayi no muri Aziya uracyari muto.
Ikipey'igihugu ya Kenya yagizimyaka myizacyane hagatiya za 80 na 90 ubwoyemererwaga kwitabira Shampiyona ya Basketball y'Afurika inshuro nyinshindetse inagera nomuri Final Four mu 1993 ubwo i Nairobi yakiraga irirushanwa.
Muri Mutarama 2021, Liz Mills yafashe ikipey'igihugu ya Kenya y'abagabo. Iyobowe na Mills, Kenya yegukanye igikombe cyayo cya mbere cya AfroBasket mumyaka 28. Mumarushanwa ya AfroBasket 2021, Kenya yatsinze Angola yatwayigikombe cy'Afurika inshuro 11 kunshuro ya mberemumateka. Mumakipe ya 2021 FIBA AfroBasket Kenya yarangije irikumwanya wa 9 muri 16.
Cricket nundimukino ukunzwe kandutsindacyane mwikipe. Kenya yitabiriye igikombe cy'isi cya Cricket kuvamu 1996. Yatsinze amwe mumakipe akomeye kwisi ndetse igera murikimwe cya kabiri cy'irushanwa ryomu 2003. Yanatsinze igikombe cyambere cy'isi cya Cricket League cyabereye i Nairobi ndetseyitabira imikino ya T20 y'isi. Guhera muri Mutarama 2018, kapiteni wabo ni Rakep Patel.
Hockey yomu kibuga nayikinirwa muri Kenya. Ikipe y'igihugu ya Hockey y'abagabo ya Kenya yagize amanota meza cyane mu gikombe cy'isi cya Hockey mu 1971, ubwoyarangizaga ku mwanya wa kane.
Iyikipe kandiyitabiriye imikino Olempike y'impeshyi inshurondwi, irangiza kumwanya wa 6 mu 1964. Ikipibarizwa muri sitade ya City Park Hockey i Nairobi. Umukino wa Hockey muri Kenya ugenzurwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umukino wa Hockey rya Kenya (KHU).
Guhera muri Mata 2021, Kenya nimwe mubihugu bine by'Afurika bigize Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Lacrosse ririmogukuravuba.
Kunshuro yambere, Kenya izakina n'ikipe y'igihugu mwirushanwa rya Lacrosse ry'isi ry'abatarengeje imyaka 19 ryo mu 2022.
Umupira wa baseball.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Baseball muri Kenya (BFK) na Kenya Little League (KLL) byakomeje guteza imbere umukino wa baseball muri Kenya kuva mu 1992 na 2010. Uyumukino wakomeje guterimbere mumyaka ya za 90 mbereyokugabanuka mumyaka ya za 2000. Kenya yarimaze kwitabira imikino ya All Africa Games, imikino ya Kenko muri Zambiya, n’iserukiramuco ry’abana rya Baseball kwisi mu Buyapani (inshuro 4). Kenya yakiriye imikino yoguhatanira itike y’igikombe cy’isi cya Afurika y’abatarengeje imyaka 18 muri kaminuza ya Meru y’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga (MUST) kuva kuya 15 kugeza ku ya 20 Ukuboza 2014. Uyumukino ukunzwe cyane i Nairobi, Meru, Migori na Makueni. Ukinwa mumashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, muriza kaminuza na za kaminuza biyobowe na MUST. Solomon Gacece niwe wari perezida umaze igihe kinini, naho George Mahinda akaba Umunyamabanga Mukuru.
Ikipe ya Kenya Little League yashinzwe na Little League Baseball i Williamsport, muri leta ya Pennsylvania muri Amerika mu 2010, ikaba yarakoreraga i Meru mbereyuko ikwirakwira i Nairobi na Mombasa. Ubu Uturere tugera kuri 24 dufite baseball, naho Akarere ka Meru kitwa kwari ko gatuye Baseball muri Afurika.
Umukino wa Baseball urimogutangira mubihugu by'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba nka Kenya, Uganda, Tanzaniya, Etiyopiya n'u Rwanda. Shampiyona ngarukamwaka y'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba yabereye i Migori ku nshuro yambere kandi byitezwe kwizongera kuba. Kenya yitabiriye imikino Olempike yabereye mu Buyapani mu 2020.
Umupira wa Softball.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ya softball rya Kenya Little League ririmogutezimbere imikinoya softball usibye baseball muturere nka Meru, Nairobi na Mombasa, naho Nairobi ikabari indimikino ya softball ikunzwecyane.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Softball muri Kenya ririguteza imbere uyumukino cyanecyane muri za kaminuza.
Siporo y'imodoka muri Kenya iyoborwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Imikino y'Amamodoka rya Kenya (KMSF). KMSF ifitanyisano n'inzego zitandukanye zigenga siporo y'imodoka kwisi zirimo Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry'Abatwara Moto (FIM) rigenga isiganwa rya moto, n'Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry'Abatwara Moto (FIA) rigenzura amashyirahamwe y'abatwara imodoka, abakoresha imodoka, kandirikanategura Shampiyona y'Isi y'Amarushanwa y'Amamodoka (WRC).
Siporo yambere y’ababigize umwuga mugutwara imodoka muri Kenya, East African Coronation Safari, yateguwe murwego rwokwizihiza ishingwa ry’Umwamikazi Elizabeth wa II ku ya 2 Kamena 1953. Irirushanwa ngarukamwaka ryahinduriwe izina rya East African Safari Rally kuva mu 1954 kugeza mu 1975, na Safari Rally kuva mu 1975 kugezubu. Safari Rally ifitibyiciro 13 yashyizwe mu irushanwaryambere ryateguwe na FIA World Rally Championships (WRC) nk'icyiciro cya kane mu byiciro 13 byari bigize igihembwe cya WRC mu 1973. Ian Duncan niwe Munyakenya wenyine watsinze irushanwa rya WRC, Safari Rally mu 1994.
Irushanwa ry'Afurika ry’Imikino y’Amagare (ARC) nikigo cy’akarere cya FIA kandi gikoresha ibihembo ngarukamwaka by’imikino y’amagare, ahwimikino y’amarushanwa ibumunani mubihugu umunani (Zimbabwe, Afurika y’Epfo, Zambiya, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzaniya, u Rwanda na Madagasikari) kuvamuri Werurwe kugeza Ugushyingo, uretse mu Ukwakira. Safari Rally yemejwe nk'imwe mu mikino ikomeye kwisi. Umunyakenya w’icyamamare, Shekhar Mehta / Nissan, yegukanye igihembwecyambere cya ARC (1981) mu gihe Davis Horsey / Peugeot ari we Munyakenya wa nyuma wegukanye ARC mu 1984.
Mugace ka Kenya, umukinnyi wa Kenya National Rally Champion atoranywa mumanota yakusanyijwe mu byiciro byinshi byatewe inkunga na KCB. Ian Duncan ni we watwaye igikombe cya KNR cya 2011. Patrick Njiru /David Williamson niwe mushoferi wambere w’umunyafurika wegukanye igikombe cya Kenya National Rally Championship. Yakinnye muburyo buheruka mu 2002 mbere yo gusezera mu marushanwa. Ariko Njiru yakomeje guteguranokwitabira amarushanwa y’abagiraneza. Ian Duncan ni we mushoferi watsinze cyane muri Kenya ukomeje kugaragara mu marushanwa atandukanye y’imodoka kugezubu. Urupapuro rwerw'ibanze ni uru rukurikira: 1) Umunyakenya wenyine watsinzirushanwa rya WRC (Trust Bank Safari Rally ya 42, 1994), 2) Yatwaye Kenyan Rally Championship inshuro esheshatu (1987, 1988, 1989, 1991, 2000, na 2011), 3) Yatwaye East African Classic Safari Rally mu 2009 (yasiganwaga mwirushanwa rimwemu Ugushyingo 2011), 4) Yatwaye Guru Nanak Rally Championship inshuro 11, na 5) Yatwaye umukinnyi w’imikino wa Motorsport w’umwaka wa 2010!
Abashoferi b'ibyamamare bavukiyemuri Kenya murururukurikirane rwa WRC: Joginder Singh (1973–1980), Shekhar Mehta (1973–1987), Patrick Njiru (1983–1998), na Ian Duncan (1983–1999).
Abandibashoferi bakomeyebatwara imodoka muri Kenya uyumunsi: Carl Tundo, Azar Anwar, Lee Rose, Jas Mangat, na Ben Muchemi.
Bamwemubashoferi ba KNRC bafitibizigabibiri: James Kirimi, Patrick Kibara, Joe Muchiri, Adnan Suhail, na Niaz Bashir.
Muri Kenya, motocross ifititsinda rinini ry’abakinnyi mumikino yose y’imodoka. Haribyiciro bitandatu muri motocross: MX50, MX65, MX85, MX125, MX2, n’icyiciro cy’abasohoka, MX1. Bamwe mu bakinnyi bakomeye ba Kenya Motocross barimo Shivam Vinayak, Charles Mugo, Cruze Muigai, Anthony Nielsen, Mohammed Anwar, na Tutu Maina. Shivam niwemukinnyi wa motocross ufite imitako myinshi muri Kenya, afite ibikombe nka MXI National Champion, FIM Central African Motocross Champion, na Kenyan Motorcycle Cross Champion. Ku ya 28 Kanama 2011, ubwo habaga shampiyona ya FIM Africa Motocross i Harare, muri Zimbabwe, Kenya yari ihagarariwe n'abakinnyi batatu (Tutu Maina (MX125), Dekker Kihara (MX50), na Rolf Kihara (MX65) kandi yarangije ari iya 4 mu bihugu bitandatu byari bihagarariwe. Kuva kuya 14 kugeza ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2011, Kenya yakiriye shampiyona ya FIM Africa Cross Country Bike na Quad Team muri Soysambu Conservancy nziza cyane i Nakuru.
Enduros na cross country.
Kenya ifitamarushanwa ya Enduro burimwaka nka Shampiyona y'Igihugu ya Enduro, JCB/Ganatra Plant and Equipment Cross Country Rally Challenge. Kenya kandiyitabira amarushanwa ya FIM Africa Enduro Championships. Shivam Vinayak numwe mubakinnyi b'amagare bakomeye ba Enduro muri Kenya, akabanakina muri motocross. Amarushanwa ya Enduro kandakurura amagare ane y'amapine ane azwi nka All Terrain Vehicles (ATV) afitabakinnyi b'abahanga nka Shazar Anwar, Murage Waigwa, Abid Ganatra, na Gurraj Singh. Enduro kandi ishimira Buggy Racing ikurura abashoferi b'inararibonye nka Ian Duncan na Samir Khan.
Imodoka zombi zitwarabantu n'imodoka zitwara abagenzi zirushanwa mur'Autocross muri Kenya. Shampiyona ikomeye ni Shampiyona y'Igihugu ya Autocross. Keith Henrie ni we watwaye igikombe cya National Autocross mu 2011. Abandi bakinnyibakina autocross muri Kenya barimo Charles Mugo, Samir Khan, na Rajbir Rai. Abashoferi ba Rally nka Ben Muchemi w'icyamamare na bagenzi be Stella Macharia na Onkar Rai bakunze kwitabira irushanwa rya Autocross.
Ikinicyo cyiciro cyanyuma cy’amasiganwa y’imodoka muri Kenya. Isiganwa rya Grand Prix rya Kenya rikoresha go-karts mumasiganwa yokwidagadura, irushanwa rya metero 500. Abategura Karting bakira abantu kugiticyabo, ibigo, n’amashuri mumarushanwa atandukanye. Ariko muri Kenya, gutembera mumagare hibandwa cyane kukwishimisha nokubunararibonye bw’amasiganwa y’imodoka.
Kenya yagizintsinzi ikomeye mukoga ukurikije ko ari umukino w’umuntu kugiticye.
Ibikorwa byogusiganwa mubwato bwa Canoe-kayak byatangiriye muri Kenya munsi y’ishyirahamwe rya Kenya Rowing and Canoe Association, nyumayokwinjira mwishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya Canoe (ICF) mu 2003 nyuma y’uko Seifudin Patwa yitabiriye icyicaro gikuru cya ICF mu 2003 i Madrid, muri Esipanye.
Ubucuruzi bwokumazi bwashinzwe muri Kenya mugihe cy'ubukoloni, ubwo Mombasa Rowing Club yashingwaga mu myaka ya 1930 i Liwatoni, Mombasa. Iyi Club yakoraga nk'ikipe y'imyidagaduro, rimwe na rimwe irushanwa ry'amato y'intambara yazaga mu mazi cyane cyane British Navy, nyuma ifatanyije na Kenya Navy, ariko iyi Club n'ibikorwa byo ku mazi byahagaze mu 1991 kubera amakimbirane y'ubutaka n'ikigo cy'uburobyi cyari hafi aho. Ubushake bwongeye kubyutswa muntangiriro za 1995, ubwohashingwaga ishyirahamwe ry'abarobyi bokumazi rya Kenya, urwego rw'igihugu rwarirushinzwe, rwashinzwe na Seifudin Patwa na Alisdair Macdonald, rwari rufitanye isano n'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry'abarobyi bokumazi (FISA) na Komite y'igihugu y'imikino Olempike n'ibikorwa byo ku mazi byatangiye gushyamirana muri Tudor Creek, Mombasa.
Ubushake bwo gutemberera mumazi bwaragarutse muri Kenya Navy mugihe Mombasa Rowing Club yimukiye muri Tudor Creek. Mu 2000, ikipeya The Rowing yahatanye bwa mbere hanze ya Kenya mu irushanwa rya 4th Africa Rowing Championship ryabereye i Pretoria mur'Afurika y'Epfo n'abasare 8, bose baturutse muri Kenya Navy. Mu 2003, Canoeing yongeweho nk'igikorwa mu ishyirahamwe ry'igihugu ryaje guhinduka Kenya Rowing and Canoe Association nyumayokuba yari ifitanye isano n'ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ry'abasare (ICF) muruwomwaka.
Mu 2003, Kenya yegukanyitike yambere mwirushanwa ryogusiganwa kumazi (Rowing) mu mikino Olempike yabereye i Athens mu mwaka wa 2004 mu cyiciro cya Single Scull binyuze kuri Ibragim Githiga, umusirikare wo mu ngabo za Kenya. Nubwo umusaruro wewanyuma utarimwiza cyane, wari intambwe nziza mwiterambere ry’abasiganwa ku mazi muri Kenya. Kenya yongeye kwegukana itike ya Single scull mumikino Olempike ya Beijing mu 2008.
Nubwo Kenya yohereje abarashe mumikino Olempike kuva mu 1956 (hamwe n'ibibazo), iki gikorwa cyakomeje kuba umukino w'abantu bake. Kuva mumyaka ya 1970, abarashe muri Kenya ubu babarirwa muri kimwe cya kabiri cy'Abanyafurika n'igice cy'Abahinde. Abakinnyi bazwi cyane mu mateka ya kera n'abatsinze Olempike ni John Harun Mwau (ubunumunyapolitiki) n'uwarashe imbunda zomubwoko bwa pistolet Shuaib Adam. Uwarashe imbunda zomubwoko bwa ISSF muri Kenya yagaragaye mu mahanga mu mikino ya Commonwealth Games 2010 nomumikino ya Afurika 2011. Uyumukino ufite ibibazobyo kudatera inkunga, kubura amakipe, kuburabatoza n'itegeko rishaje ryo kugaba intwaro, arikufite urwegorugezweho i Nairobi, n'impano zikomeye zitaratera imbereneza.
Muri Kenya, gukoresha imiheto byakoreshejwe muburyo bwa gakondo. Byakoreshejwe muguhiga, muntambara nomumikino. Mu 2002, ishyirahamwe ry’abarashibo muri Kenya ryafunguwe kugira ngorikemure ikibazo cy’aho abarashi bashobora gukinira mumikino mpuzamahanga cyari kiri kwiyongera. Ibibyaje nogushinga itsinda ry’abarashi bomuri Kenya.
Siporo zo mu misozi.
Siporo yomu misozi niyo siporo nshya muri Kenya. Nimikino ihuriweho ifitanyisano n'abantu ku giti cyabo n'ikipe irimo kwiruka intera ndende, Ishuri ry'Imigozi miremire, Kuzamuka imisozi no Kumanuka mu ishyamba, byose bikorerwa mwishyamba. Ishuri ry'Ubukerarugendo n'Ubuyobozi rya Mt. Kenya (KESAL) ryakoze Siporo yo mu misozi ku ya 22 Ukwakira 2011. Abatsinze mu irushanwa rya mbere ni Benard Waweru – Abagabo 21 km Isiganwa ry'ishyamba ry'abakuze mu gihe 21 z'abagore bakuze km yegukanwe n'umukinnyi w'umuhanga mukwiruka mumuhanda witwa Pauline Wangui. Sammy Ndungu yegukanye igihembo cya Sky Marathon naho Kaminuza ya Methodiste ya Kenya (KEMU) yegukana igihembo cya Extreme Adventure. Reba kwipaji ya Mountain Sport-Kenya kugira ngo umenye byinshi.
Indi mikino ku giti cye.
Waruinge Nakayama numwe mubakinnyi b'iteramakofe bakomeye muri Kenya. Yavukiye muri Philip Warunige, yahinduye izinarye nyumayo kwimukira mu Buyapani. Wairunge yegukanye umudari wa feza nk'umukinnyi wa Bantamweight mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1972 yabereye i Munich mu Budage nk'umukinnyi utarabigize umwuga, mbere y'uko atangira umwuga wabigize umwuga watumye hafiyegukana igikombe cy'isi, atsindwa kabiri, kugikombe cy'isi cya WBC cya Super-Bantamweight akina na Rigoberto Riasco, ndetse nyuma, kugikombe cy'isi cya Bantamweight ikina na Carlos Zarate. Yanatwaye kandi shampiyona y'igihugu y'Ubuyapani ya Super-Bantamweight.
Uyumukinnyi w’amagare wavukiye muri Kenya, Chris Froome, yagaragaye muntangiriro za 2010 nk'umwe mu bakinnyi b’amagare bakomeye ku isi, atsinda irushanwa rya Vuelta a Espagne ryo mu 2011 na Tour de France yo mu 2012 mbereyokwegukana umudari wa bronze mu irushanwa ry’igihe mu mikino Olempike yo mu 2012 na Tour de France yo mu 2013, aba umukinnyi wa mbere w’umunyafurika wavukiye muri Afurika wegukanye iri siganwa. Froome yatwaye igare nk’umunyakenya mbere yo guhindura ubwenegihugu bwe kugira ngahagarariye Ubwongereza mbere ya Tour de France yo mu 2008. Yatwayirushanwa ryeryakabiri rya Tour mu 2015 n’irya gatatu mu mwaka wakurikiyeho, akurikirwa n’irindi rushanwa rya bronze mumikino Olempike yo mu 2016. Froome yatojwe n’umunyakenya w’umwuga w’amagare witwa David Kinjah mumyaka yeyambere.
Ikipe y’abasiganwa kumagareyo muri Kenya, Kenyan Riders, yashinzwe mu 2009 n’umufotozi w’umunya-Singapur Nicholas Leong nyuma yokubona abasiganwa b’amagare bo muri Kenya bigaruriye isiganwa rya Marathon rya Singapore. Mu 2016, Kenyan Riders yifatanyije n’ikipe y’abahanga muri Downunder bakora Kenyan Riders Downunder, ikipe yambere ya UCI Continental yiyandikishije mur'Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. René van Velhuijzen yateje imbere 1000 Urugendo rw'amagare rushingiye kuri Safari km, bityorukururabanyamagare bomu misozi muri Kenya kugira ngobagire ubuzimabwiza. Urugendo rw'amagare rwo muri Kenya. Archived
Siporo yo mu bwoko bwa roller.
Siporo yogusiganwa kumaguru, cyanecyane gusiganwa kumaguru muri Kenya, iyoborwa n’ishyirahamwe rya Roller Sports Kenya (RSKF). Irishyirahamwe ryashinzwe mu 1997, ritegura ibyiciro bitandukanye by’amasiganwa nko gusiganwa kumaguru ku maguru, no gusiganwa ku maguru ku maguru. KSKF ifitanye isano n’ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga rya siporo yo gusiganwa ku maguru. Amasiganwa/ibikorwa by’ishyirahamwe biberacyane cyane muri Moi International Sports Complex, Kasarani. Hariho amarushanwa 3 kugeza kuri 4 buri mwaka harimo n’ayo ishyirahamwe rikoreramo, abera i Bomet, Rift Valley (2011).
Ikigo cy'igihugu cy'imikino.
Minisiteri ya Siporo, Umuco n'Ubuhanzi niyifite urwegorwo hejuru mumiterere y'imikino muri Kenya. Minisitiri wa Siporo ashyira mubikorwa politiki zijyanye n'iterambere rya siporo, kandi akaganira ku mishinga y'amategeko ya siporo munteko ishinga amategeko. Komiseri wa siporo, muri Minisiteri ya Siporo, akora nk'umujyanama wa leta kubibazo bya siporo, agashushanya kandi agasuzuma politiki, kandi agakomeza amahame ngenderwaho mwishami rya siporo. Burikarere gafite abahagarariye guverinoma bashinzwe siporo muri guverinoma.
Inama y'Igihugu ya Siporo ya Kenya ishyirwaho n'abanyamuryango batowe baturutse mu mikino yose muri Kenya kugirango barebe kwimikino yose ingana mu iterambere, mu kuzamura no guhagararirwa mu marushanwa akomeye, haba mugihugu nomumahanga ndetse nomu yindi mirimo. Komite y'Igihugu ya Olempike ya Kenya (NOCK) itegura abakinnyi ba Kenya bazitabira imikino Olempike kandi ikorana n'izindi nzego za siporo muguteza imbere noguteza imbere imikino muri icyo gihugu.
Umuryango w'imikino muri kaminuza.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ya za Kaminuza za Kenya niryo shyirahamwe riyoboramashuri makuru na za kaminuza muri Kenya.
Ikigo cy'imikino y'amashuri.
Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’amashuri abanza ya Kenya (KPSA) n’Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’amashuri yisumbuye ya Kenya ni zonzego ziyobora imikino mumashuri abanza (icyiciro cya 1 kugeza kucya 8) n’amashuri yisumbuye (icyiciro cya 1 kugeza kucya 4)
Siporo y'urubyiruko.
Iterambere ry’amashyirahamwe y’urubyiruko mumikino muri Kenya ryakurikiye itsindwa ry’uburezi bw’imyitozo ngororamubiri mumashuri. Gahunda yambere y’urubyiruko mumikino, Ishyirahamwe ry’Urubyiruko mu mikino ya Mathare ryashinzwe mu 1987. Kuva icyo gihe, inzego za leta, imiryango itari iya leta (imiryango itegamiye kuri leta), n’amatsinda mpuzamahanga nka Loni, yakomeje gushyiraho gahunda z’urubyiruko mumijyi ituwe cyane, bihabanabenshi bo muri Kenya amahirweyo kwitabira siporo.

Carlos Monroe (yavutse ku ya 5 Gicurasi 1987 i Philadelphia, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ariko u Rwanda ruza kumuha ubwenegihugu akina nku mukinnyi wu RWanda kumazin ya Carlos Mugabo wavutse ku ya 12 Kanama 1986 i Nyarugenge) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w'Umunyamerika wari mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda ya Basketball mu irushanwa rya FIBA afurike ryo mu 2009. Yakiniye ikipe ya Basketball y'abagabo ya Folorida Atelantike Owls kuva muri 2005 kugeza muri 2009.
Mugabo yinjiye mu ikipe y’u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya FIBA rya Afurika ryo muri 2009 nyuma y’uko abakinnyi babiri b’u Rwanda bavuye mu irushanwa ibyumweru bitatu mbere y’uko umukino utangira wari uteganyijwe. yatsinze amanota 10.6 ya PPG, 5.8 ya RPG, na 2.0 ya SPG kugira ngo afashe Abanyarwanda kurangiza ku mwanya wa 9 ndetse no kwitwara neza kugeza ubu mu irushanwa rya Afurika.

Gisubizo Merci ni Umunyarwanda ukina umukino w'amaboko uzwi nka volleyball mu Rwanda. Wavutse ku wa 23/12/2004 yavukiye Kandi akurira mu rwanda.Arinaho yatangiye kugaragariza impano ye yogukina umukino wamaboko volleyball.
Mu makipe yakiniye harimo APR VC kuva mu mwaka wa 2021 ubwo yayisinyiraga amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri avuye mu ikipe ya Don Bosco Gatenga aho yari amaze kuyihesha igikombe cya shampiyona yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri,kandi yakiniye amakipe atandukanye y’abato ndetse yanayoboye bagenzi be batarengeje imyaka 21 mu ikipe y’igihugu mu mikino yabereye mu gihugu cya Tuniziya muri 2022.
ubu gisubizo merci akinira ikipe ya REG VC aka ari ikipe ya bagabo ishingiye ku kigo cy'igihugu cya mashanyarazi.

Jean-Victor Mukama (yavutse ku ya 24 Kanama 1994) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w’abigize umwuga w’umunyarwanda ukomoka muri canada. Afite 203 cm, ni umukinnyi ukina imbere asatira.
Mu Ukwakira 2019, Mukama yakinnye amarushanwa ya Raptors 905 maze yongerwa ku rutonde rw'abakinnyi bakina ariko aza kurekurwa mbere yo gutangira imikino.
Mu Ukuboza 2019, Mukama yasinye amasezerano na Patriots BBC yo mu Rwanda kugira ngo akine amarushanwa yo guhatanira itike ya BAL yo muri 2020.. Mu mukino wa nyuma w’amarushanwa yo guhatanira itike bakinnye na GNBC, Mukama yatsinze amanota 18.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Mu Gushyingo 2020, Mukama yatoranyijwe mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda mu mikino yo gushaka itike yo kuzakina Afurika Basketball yo muri 2021.
Mukama yavukiye i Quebec, yimukiye mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda muri 2003, amarayo imyaka ine mbere yo gusubira muri canada.

Dieudonné Ndayisaba Ndizeye (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukwakira 1996) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w'umunyarwanda, ukinira APR BBC muri Shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL) n'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda. yabaye umukinnyi mwiza muri RBL inshuro eshatu ndetse yatwayee shampiyona inshuro imwe muri 2019. Ndizeye yakinnye ishuro bibiri BAL ari muri REG.
Ndizeye yatangiye umwuga wa basketball ari muri IPRC-Kigali muri Shampiyona y'igihugu ya Basketball mu 2015. Muri 2017, Ndizeye yinjiye muri Patriot BBC. Yahawe igihembo cya shampiyona y'igihugu MVP muri shampiyona ya 2018–19.Mu Gushyingo 2021, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Cobra Sport yo muri Sudani y'Amajyepfo kugira ngo abakinire mu marushanwa yo gushaka itike ya BAL 2022. Yafashije Cobra kuza BAL kunshuro y'ambere.

William Robeyns (yavutse ku ya 23 Gashyantare 1996) ni umukinnyi wa basketball ufite ubwenegihugu bw’ababiligi n'u Rwanda, uheruka gukinira ikipe Liège ya Basket muri shampiyona ya BNXT. Ahagarariye kandi ikipe y'igihugu ya basketball yu Rwanda.
Robeyns yakiniye Phoenix Brussels kuva muri 2018 kugeza 2021. Mu mwaka wa shampiyona wa 2020-21, yatsinze amanota 9.0 buri mukino. Ku itariki ya 20 Gicurasi 2021, Robeyns yasinye amasezerano na Liege ya Basket.
Mu mwaka wa 2022 mu kiruhuko, Robeyns yakiniye APR bbc muri shampiyona ya Basketball y'u Rwanda. Ku ya 4 Gicurasi 2024, Robeyns yakinnye bwa mbere muri shampiyona ya Basketball afurike (BAL) ari kumwe na APR, atsinda amanota 6 na ribandi 5 mu mukino batsinze US Monastir mu minota y'inyongera.
Umwuga w'ikipe y'igihugu.
Muri Kanama 2021, Robeyn yongerewe ku rutonde rw'abakinnyi bakina umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Ku itariki ya 25 Kanama 2021, Robeyn yakinnye umukino we wa mbere ku munsi wa mbere w'irushanwa maze atanga amanota 24 ku ntsinzi ya DR Congo ku manota 81 - 68.
Yatsindiye umudari mu irushanwa rya FIBA afurike ryo mu 2023 ryabereye muri Angola, rikaba ari ryo rya mbere igihugu cyarangije ku mwanya wa mbere mu irushanwa mpuzamahanga.

Robert Thomson (yavutse ku ya 28 Mutarama 1982) Ni umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'abagabo yu Rwanda. Thomson yavukiye muri Penesilivaniya, yarangije amashuri yisumbuye i Valey, muri Penesilivaniya. Yakinnye basketball muri kaminuza ya Fairfield.
Thomson yimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2006 nyuma yo kurangiza muri Fairfield no gukina imyaka ibiri ya basketball y'ababigize umwuga muri Hongiriya no mu Butaliyani. Thomson yaje kubona pasiporo yu Rwanda aba umwe mu bagize ikipe y’u Rwanda, yarangirije kumwannya wa cyenda muri Shampiyona y’Afurika ya FIBA ​​2009 ndetse na 2007.

Jermaine Lamarr Cole (yavutse ku ya 28 Mutarama 1985) ni umuraperi ukomoka muri umunyamerika akaba atunganya amajwi y'indirimbo. Yavukiye mu kigo cya gisirikare mu Budage akurira i Fayetteville, muri Carolina y’Amajyaruguru, Cole yatangiye kumenyekana nk’umuraperi nyuma yo gusohora indirimbo za mbere, mu ntangiriro za 2007. Agamije gukomeza umwuga we wa muzika, yasinye amasezerano na Roc Nation ya Jay-Z muri 2009 anasohora izindi ndirimbo ebyirii.
Umwuga wa Basketball.
Cole yakinnye basketball mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Terri Saniforde muri Carolina y'Amajyaruguru. yagerageje kujya muri Kaminuza ya St. John kandi yari umwe mu bakinnyi 10 bahamagawe mu mwaka we wa kabiri. Mu 2012, Cole yakiniye ikipe y'Iburasirazuba mu mukino w'ibyamamare wa NBA. Mu 2013, Cole yabwiye "Sports Illustrated" ati: "Siporo nibwo yatangira kuri njye. Ijyanye n'ubuzima bwanjye. Rap ni ikintu gikunda amarushanwa. Niyo mpamvu ntagomba kureka siporo. Ngomba gukomeza. Ni ubuzima bwanjye mu bundi buryo.
Mu Rwanda yaje gukinira Patriots BBC ubwo yari mu marushanwa ya shampiyona yu Rwanda, ndetse na marushamwa nyafurika ya bale
Mu 2014, mu kiganiro na Angie Martinez, Cole yashyize Tupac, The Notorious BIG, Nas, na Jay- Z mu baraperi be bane ba mbere mu bihe byose, naho André 3000 na Eminem bazamuka ku mwanya wa gatanu.

Brandon Jay Costner (yavutse ku ya 21 Nyakanga 1987) ni umunyamerika wahoze ari umukinnyi wa Basketball w'aba bigize umwuga, ubu akaba ari mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru. Aherutse gukinira amakipe yo muri Porito Rico nka Grises ya Humaca na Santerosi y'aguada yo muri Baloncesto nacional. Yakiniye basketball ya kaminuza muri NC.
Muri Mutarama 2018, Costner yasinye amasezerano na Champe vile yo muri Libani Basketball.
Muri Gicurasi 2021, yinjiye mu ikipe y'u Rwanda ya Patriots BBC kugira ngo akine mu mwaka w'imikino wa shampiyona wa 2021 muri BAL.

Marcus Christopher Crawford (yavutse ku ya 30 Nzeri 1992) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w’umunyamerika w'abigize umwuga muri Paisasi wo muri Baloncesito Colombiano. Yakinnye Basketball muri Kaminuza ya Memphis, kandi yakinnye nk'umunyamwuga mu makipe yo mu Burayi, Afurika na Amerika y'Epfo. Yatoranyijwe inshuro ebyiri mu ikipe ya mbere ya BAL kuko yabarizwa mu ikipe ya Patriots BBC muri ayo marushanwa.
Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 2022, Crawford yinjiye muri Al Wahda Damascus yo muri shampiyona ya Basketball ya Siriya.
Ku ya 23 Kanama 2022, yinjiye muri Patriots BBC yo muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Ku ya 26 Kanama, Crawford yatsinze amanota 8 mu mukino we wa mbere ubwo yatsindaga Tigers BBC amanota 91-45. Patriots yatsinzwe na REG bbc mu mikino ya nyuma ya shampiyona, bityo iba iya kabiri.

Michael Andre Dixon Jr. (yavutse ku ya 1 Ukuboza 1990) ni umukinnyi w'umunyamwuga wa basketball yavukiye muri Jeworujiya, ubu akaba akinira ikipe Clubu Afurike yo muri shampioyna pro a. Yakinnye basketball ya kaminuza muri Misuri na Memphis.
Dixon Jr. yegukanye igikombe cya BAL muri 2022 ari kumwe na US Monastir, anaba umukinnyi mwiza wirushanwa.
Muri Kanama 2023, Dixon yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Rwanda ya Patriots BBC yo muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL). Yakinnye umukino wa mbere ku ya 12 Kanama, atsinda amanota 20 niyo menshi mu mukino batsinze ahanganye APR BBC.
Mu Ukuboza 2023, Dixon yinjiye muri APR BBC, ikipe yatwaye igikombe cy'igihugu cy'u Rwanda.

Ater James Majok (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1987) ni umukinnyi ukina basketball w'abigize umwuga, ukina muri Rajawali Medane wo muri shampoyona ya indoneziya Basketball (IBL). Yavukiye muri Sudani akurira muri Ositaraliya, Majok ahagararira Libani ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Yatoranyijwe na Los Angeles ya lakazi mu mukino wa NBA wo muri 2011, aza ku mwanya wa 58 muri rusange.. Majok afite uburebure bwa metero 2.11, ahanini agaragara cyane mu bijyanye n'ubuhanga bwe mubwugarizi. Yabaye umukinnyi w'umwaka mu 2022 urinda muri BAL.
Muri Werurwe 2023, Majok yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yo muri Angola yitwa Petro ya Luanda, ikipe ya Monastir yahanganye nayo mu mukino wa nyuma wa BAL w'umwaka ushize., maze barangiza ari aba kane hamwe na Petro.
Muri Kanama 2023, Majok yinjiye mu ikipe yo mu Rwanda ya Patriots BBC mu gihe cy'imikino ya shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL).

Joe Guibert Nijimbere (yavutse ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1996) ni umukinnyi wa basketball ukomoka i Burundi ukinira ikipe Kepler BBC n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball.
Nijimbere yavutse ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1996 i Mutanga. ni umwana wa kabiri mu bana 9. Yakuriye mu mikino ya basketball hamwe na se ndetse hamwe na barumuna be batatu, bose bakaba baraje gukina uwo mukino.
Muri 2019, yinjiye muri Patriots BBC kandi yari mu ikipe yabashije kwitabira shampiyona yo muri 2020 BAL. Yatorewe kuba umukinnyi mwiza w'irushanwa ryo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi rya 2019, anatsinda irushanwa ry'amanota atatu mu mukino.
Yinjiye muri Dynamo mu Kwakira 2023 mbere y'irushanwa rya BAL ryo mu 2024. Muri Mata 2024, Nijimbere yasinye amasezerano na Kepler BBC yo muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda.

A'Darius Lamar Pegues (yavutse ku ya 21 Werurwe 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina Basketball ukomoka umugand wavukiye muri Amerika, akaba yarakiniye Patriots BBC mu ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Afite metero 2.08, akina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati.
Mu Gushyingo 2019, Pegues yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yo mu Rwanda ya Patriots BBC kugira ngo akine mu irushanwa ryo gushaka itike yo gukina imikino ya Basketball muri afurike (BAL). Pegues na Patriots babana itike.
Pegues yahagarariye Uganda mu irushanwa rya afurika Basket ryo muri 2017 ryabereye muri Tuniziya na Senegal, aho yatsinze ibitego byinshi mu ikipe.

William Kiah Perry (yavutse ku ya 11 Ukwakira 1994) ni umukinnyi wa Basketball w'umunyamerika ubarizwa mu babigize umwuga. Areshya na metero 1.83. Perry akina nk'umuzamu w'inyuma. Yahoze ari umukinnyi muri kaminuza ya Lenoir, amaze imyaka myinshi akina umukino wa Basketball mu Burayi no muri afurika. Perry yari afite agahigo ko gutsinda amanota menshi mu mukino umwe wa BAL, ni umukinnyi wakinnye mu ikipe ya mbere y'abakinyi beza ba BAL inshuro imwe ndetse akaba n'umukinnyi wegukanye igihembo cy'umugabo mwiza muri BAL inshuro ebyiri.
Kigali Titans (2023).
Ku ya 8 Mutarama 2023, Perry yinjiye muri Kigali Titans yo muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL) ku masezerano y'ukwezi kumwe.

Igikombe cy'u Rwanda cyo muri 2017–18 nigihembwe cya 36 cy'irushanwa ry'igikombe cy'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda. Irirushanwa ritegurwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru mu Rwanda (RAF) kandi rifunguye kumakipe yose yomu Rwanda.
