Igikombe cya CECAFA cyo mu 1999 cyaricya 23 cyirushanwa. Cyabereye mu Rwanda, kandi cyatsinzwe n'ikipe yakabiri y'u Rwanda. Imikino yakinwe hagati ya 24 Nyakanga na 7 Kanama.
U Rwanda rwohereje amakipe abiri: Rwanda A na Rwanda B.
Icyiciro cy'itsinda.
"Rwanda B yarangije ku mwanya wakabiri kugiceri cyashyizwe kumwanya wambere."

Igikombe cya CECAFA cyo muri 2001 cyarirushanwa rya 25 ry’umupira w’amaguru ryahuje amakipe yomuri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’iyo Hagati. Iyimikino yakinwe mu Rwanda, rwari rwaherukaga kwakira irirushanwa imyaka ibiri mbere yaho, mu 1999. Imikino yose muriri rushanwa yakinwe kuva kuya 8 Ukuboza 2001, ubwo u Rwanda rwatsindaga Somalia, kugeza ku ya 22 Ukuboza 2001, ubwo habaga imikino yo guhatanira umwanya wanyuma n’uwa gatatu. Mbere y’irushanwa, Sudani yakuyemo ubwitabire bwayo, bityo ihagarikwa mumarushanwa yose ya CECAFA mugihe kitazwi. Ariko, guhagarikwa kwakuweho igihe cyokwitabira igikombe cya CECAFA cyo mu 2002.
Amakipe cumi n'umwe yinjiye muriri rushanwa, abiri arenga ayoyari yahatanye mu irushanwa ryabanje. Icyakora, haribihugu icumi gusa byahatanye mu gikombe cya 2001, kuko u Rwanda rwakiriye irirushanwa, rwinjiye mu Rwanda (A) na Rwanda (B). Ubwo u Rwanda rwaherukaga kwakira irirushanwa, mu 1999, nabwo bwinjiye mumakipe abiri: u Rwanda (A) rwarangije ku mwanya wagatatu, rutsinda u Burundi kumwanya wa gatatu, naho u Rwanda (B) rutsinda iri rushanwa, rutsinda Kenya 3 - 1 ku mukino wa nyuma. Hari amahirwe amwe mugikombe cya CECAFA cya 2001 ku Rwanda, ubwo amakipe yombi yatsindiraga mumatsinda yabo kumwanya wa kabiri, imiterere y'iri rushanwa bivuze ko amakipe yombi yo mu Rwanda ashobora guhangana kumukino wanyuma aramutse akomeje kugeza ubu, nk'uko amakipe yombi yomuri Uganda yabigenje mw irushanwa rya 2000. Nubwo Tanzania na Uganda zombi zatsinzwe muri kimwe cya kane cy’irangiza n’u Rwanda mu 2001, muri kimwe cya kabiri cy’irangiza, u Rwanda rwatsinzwe na Etiyopiya, na Kenya, ikipe Rwanda (A) yari yatsinze muwi 1999 itwara igikombe. Bityo, amakipe yombi y’u Rwanda yahuriye mumukino woguhatanira umwanya wa gatatu mu 2001, kandi nyuma yo kurangiza ari 1 - 1 nyuma y’igihe gisanzwe, u Rwanda (A) rwatsinze 5 - 3 muri penaliti. Amakipe abiri kumukino wanyuma, Kenya na Etiyopiya, yombi yatsinze amatsinda yayo (itsinda A n’itsinda C uko bikurikirana). 2001 wari umwaka mwiza kuri Etiyopiya, ntiyatsinze Kenya 2 - 1 gusa kumukino wanyuma wa CECAFA Cup, ahubwo yanatsinze ikipe yabo y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 yatsindiye igikombe cya FIFA cy’isi cy’ingimbi cyabereye muri Argentine mu 2001, iyini yonshuro ya mbere Etiyopiya yemerewe kwitabira iri rushanwa. Ubwo bageraga kumukino wa nyuma, Etiyopiya ntiyari yarigeze itsindwa umukino wanyuma wa CECAFA nyuma yogukina umukino umwe mbere y’uwo mukino, ariko kugeza nan’ubu Etiyopiya ntiratsindwa ubwo yageraga kumukino wanyuma, ikintu cyabaye inshuro enye. Gusenya Djibouti na Uganda 10 - 1 nibyo byatsinze byinshi mumateka y’igikombe cya CECAFA.
Igikombe cya CECAFA gifatwa nk'irushanwa ryakera cyane muri Afurika ry'umupira w'amaguru, kandi rihuriwemo n'amakipe yomuri Afurika yo Hagati n'Amajyepfo. Irirushanwa ryabanje kwitwa Gossage Cup, ryahatanirwaga n'ibihugu bine bya Kenya, Uganda, Tanganyika (Tanzania y'ubu), na Zanzibar, kuva mu 1929 kugeza muwi 1965. Muwi 1967, ikigikombe cyahindutse igikombe cy'amakipe y'abakuru bo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba n'iyo Hagati, gikunze kugabanywamo igikombe cy'imikino, cyahatanirwaga imyaka itanu, kugeza muwi 1971, mbere y'uko igikombe cya CECAFA gitangira mu 1973. Ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya 2000 yari Uganda (A), muri 2001 Uganda yatsinze itsinda ryayo iriku mwanya wa gatatu arinawo wanyuma wo gushaka itike; yari inyuma y'Uburundi amanota 3 n'ikirenge cya Tanzania amanota 6, ariko nyuma yaho yakuwemo murikimwe cyakane cy'irangiza ihanganye n'u Rwanda (A). Ethiopia, ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya 2001, yakuwemo muri kimwe cyakabiri cya 2000 na Uganda (B), nubwo yatsinze u Rwanda igera kumwanya wa gatatu.
Amakipe 11 yo mubihugu 9 yahatanye, amakipe ane yo mw' irushanwa rya mbere (usibye Tanganyika, yahinduye amazina ubu yitwa Tanzaniya), harimo n'ibihugu byose 8 byahatanye mugikombe cya CECAFA cyo muri 2000 hiyongereyeho Tanzaniya na Zanzibar.
Icyiciro cy'itsinda.
Icyiciro cy'amatsinda cyatangiye kuya 8 Ukuboza kirangira ku ya 15 Ukuboza, umukino wanyuma w'itsinda A wahuje u Rwanda (A) na Kenya, n'umukino wanyuma w'itsinda C wahuje u Rwanda (B) na Etiyopiya. Mu mpera z'icyiciro cy'amatsinda, amakipe yarangije ari kumwanya wanyuma mw' itsinda ryabo yasezerewe, hamwe n'ikipe yarangije iriku mwanya wagatatu ibona amanota menshi ugereranije n'andi makipe yabaye ayagatatu mu andi matsinda. Kubera kohari umubare udasanzwe w'amakipe, itsinda C ryari rifite ikipe imwe ibura, hamwe n'amakipe atatu, bityo gahunda ikaba yagabanutse, yakira imikino itatu gusa kumatsinda atandatu ya A na B. Iyamakipe abiri cyangwa menshi angana kumanota nyuma y’uko imikino y’amatsinda irangiye, ibi bikurikira birakurikizwa kugira ngohamenyekane urutonde (muburyo bwo kumanuka):
Icyiciro cyo gukubita.
Imikino ya kimwe cya kane.
Amakipe akurikiranwa hakurikijwe ibipimo bimwebyo kunganya nkuko bigenda mu matsinda, usibye amakipe aneya mbere.

Igikombe cya CECAFA cyo muri 2005 cyaricya 29 cy'irushanwa. Cyabereye mu Rwanda, kandi cyatsinzwe na Ethiopia. Imikino yakinwe hagatiya 26 Ugushyingo kugeza 10 Ukuboza. Imikino yos yakinwe muri Stade Amahoro i Kigali.
Kenya yasezerewe kuberakunanirwa kwishyura amafarangaya CECAFA.
Icyiciro cy'itsinda.
Icyiciro cya Knockout.

Irushanwa ry’ingimbi za Afurika ryo muri 2009 ni irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru ry’abakinnyi bari munsi y’imyaka 20. Ryabereye mu Rwanda kuva kuya 18 Mutarama kugeza kuya 1 Gashyantare 2009. Ryanabaye irushanwa ry’amanota yokwitabira igikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cy’abatarengeje imyaka 20 cyo mu 2009.
Umukino wambere wakinwe kuya 18, 19 cyangwa 20 Mata 2008. Umukino wakabiri wabereye ku ya 2, 3 cyangwa 4 Gicurasi 2008. Abatsinze berekeje mucyiciro cyambere.
Kongo, Nijeriya, Zambiya, Gambia, Côte d'Ivoire, Misiri, Kameruni, Benin, Maroc, Tuniziya, Mali, Gana, Angola, Gabon, Afurika y'Epfo na Burkina Faso byose byatsindiye amahirwe yokwitabira icyiciro cyambere.
Imikino y'icyiciro cya mbere yabereye kumatariki ya 27, 28 na 29 Kamena 2008. Imikino yakabiri yabereye kumatariki ya 11, 12 na 13 Nyakanga 2008. Abatsinze bemerewe kujya mucyiciro cyakabiri.
Icyiciro cya kabiri.
Imikino yambere yakinwe kw' itariki ya 26, 27 na 28 Nzeri. Imikino yakabiri yakinwe kw' itariki ya 11, 12 na 13 Ukwakira. Abatsinze bemerewe kujya mumikino yanyuma.
Amakipe akurikira yinjiye mw' irushanwa:
Icyiciro cy'itsinda.
Icyiciro cya Knockout.
Imikino yo kwerekeza mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 20.
Amakipe ane yitwaye neza kurusha ayandi yegukanye itike yo kwitabira igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 20 cyo mu 2009.

Shampiyona y'Afurika y'abatarengeje imyaka 17 yomuri 2011 yarirushanwa ry'umupira w'amaguru ryateguwe n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru muri Afurika (CAF). Irirushanwa ryabereye mu Rwanda. Amakipe ane yambere yabashije kwitabira Igikombe cy'Isi cya FIFA cy'Abatarengeje imyaka 17 cyo mu 2011.
Icyiciro cy'itsinda.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'abatarengeje imyaka 17 y'u Rwanda nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'urubyiruko ikorera munsi y'ubuyobozi bw'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda. Inshingano yayo y'ibanze niterambere ry'abakinnyi murwego rwo kwitegura ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'abakuze y'u Rwanda.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda y'umupira w'amaguru y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 ihagarariye u Rwanda mumarushanwa mpuzamahanga yumupira w'amaguru w'abangavu nabagore.
Ikipe yitabiriye irushanwa ry’abagore ba Afurika batarengeje imyaka 20 ryomu 2022 idashoboye kwitabira igikombe cyisi cya FIFA cy’abagore batarengeje imyaka 20 cyomuri 2022.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda ihagarariye u Rwanda mu mupira w'amaguru w'abagore kandi igenzurwa nishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'u Rwanda. Kugeza ububyari biteganyijwe ko izitabira irushanwa rimwe rikomeye, irushanwa ryambere ry'abagore ryabereye i Zanzibar muKwakira 2007, ariko iryo rushanwa ryajeguhagarikwa. Amaherezo ryatangiye gukinwa na Kenya muri Gashyantare 2014. Iyikipe yitwa "The She-Amavubi" (mu Kinyarwanda bisobanura "The She-Wasps").
Kugeza ubu kuya 16 Kanama 2024, ikipey'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda iriku mwanya wa 167 kw' isi n'amanota 874.81.
Iterambere ry'umupira w'amaguru w'abagore muri Afurika rihura n'ibibazo byinshi, birimo kubona uburezi buke, ubukene mubagore muri sosiyete murirusange, n'ubusumbane bw'ibanze burimuri iyo sosiyete butuma rimwe narimwe habaho ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwamuntu kubagore. Muri icyo gihe, iyabagore bafite impano mumupira w'amaguru bavutse, benshi bahitamo kujya mumahanga kugira ngo bongere amahirwe yogukina. Kubura inkunga bibangamira iterambere ry'umupira w'amaguru w'abagore mukarere kuko inkunga nyinshi zigenerwa ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore zituruka kuri FIFA, ntabwo zituruka kw' ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'igihugu.
Mu Rwanda, gahunda yambere y’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore yashyizweho muri 2000. "Kicking for Reconciliation" yashinzwe mumpera z’imyaka ya 2000, kandi yahuje abakinnyi bakiri bato barenga 100 murwego rwo "gukiza igihugu cyabonye jenoside mbicyane kuvamu Ntambara ya Kabiri y’Isi Yose" binyuze murisiporo. Iyigahunda yari ifunguye ku Batutsi n’Abahutu. Mu 2008, ibi byarimo amarushanwa y’amashuri naza kaminuza. Umupira w’amaguru w’abagore washyigikiwe n’umukozi umwe w’ishyirahamwe ry’igihugu ryihariye muri 2006. Siporo y’abagore, harimo n’umupira w’amaguru, ntiyatangajwe cyane mw' itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda. Shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru y’abagore yashinzwe mu 2008, kandi igihugu nicyo cyonyine muri aka karere gifite shampiyona ihamye, ariko kiracyafite imbogamizi zijyanye nogutera inkunga amakipe, aho inkunga nyinshi ituruka kuri FIFA. Grace Nyinawumuntu yabaye umusifuzi wa mbere w’umugore ku rwego rw’ikirenga mu Rwanda muri 2004, ndetse aba umugore wambere utoza ikipe y’ababigize umwuga mugihugu muri 2009. Ikipe ye y’abagore b’abahanga yakomeje kwegukana igikombe cyashampiyona kubuyobozi bwe. Kubura amahirwe y gukina umupira w’amaguru yo kurwego rwohejuru muri Uganda byatumye bamwe mu bakinnyi bava ahobajya mu Rwanda gushaka amahirwe yogukina muri shampiyona y’ababigize umwuga yo muri icyo gihugu.
Amahugurwa mpuzamahanga yerekeye abagore nimake mu Rwanda. Hagati ya 1991 na 2010, nta masomo y’akarere ya FIFA FUTURO III yagenewe gutoza abagore, ntanama y’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore yabereye mugihugu, kandi ntamasomo ya FIFA MA yabereye kumupira w’amaguru w’abagore n’urubyiruko. Kurwego mpuzamahanga, mu 2007, intumwa y’igihugu yitabiriye inama y’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore yatewe inkunga na FIFA mu Bushinwa. Felicite Rwemarika ni umuyobozi w’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore muricyo gihugu. Ashimirwa guteza imbere siporo mugihugu ashinga Ishyirahamwe ry’Abagore muri Kigali mumupira w’amaguru n’ibindi.
Yahagaritswe kwitabira mu 2007.
Igikombe cy’irushanwa ry’abagore mu nama y’umupira w’amaguru y’ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’iyo Hagati (CECAFA) cyagombaga kubera i Zanzibar mu Ukwakira 2007, igikorwa u Rwanda rwari ruteganya kohereza ikipe y’igihugu kwitabira, ariko irushanwa ryarahagaritswe. Irushanwa ryagombaga guterwa inkunga n’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika. Umunyamabanga w’Inama y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba niyo Hagati, Nicholas Musonye, yavuze kuriki gikorwa ati: "CAF irashaka guteza imbere umupira w’amaguru w’abagore muraka karere murwego rwo kuzirikana intambwe CECAFA yagezeho mumyaka yashize. CAF irashima ibyo CECAFA yakoze nubwo ishyirahamwe ryanyuzemo mu ngorane, kuva kubibazo by’amafaranga kugeza kumiterere mibi yapolitiki mubihugu bigize umuryango n’imicungire mibi y’amashyirahamwe. Ibihugu bigize umuryango mu karere ka CECAFA ntibyigeze bifata umupira w’amaguru w’abagore nk’ikintu gikomeye. CAF ubu irashaka gutera inkunga gahunda y’igihe kirekire yo gukurura abagore bomuri akakarere mumukino."
Ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda irakinira imikino yayo yanyuma ku kibuga cy'imikino cya Nyamirambo.
Ikipe y'igihugu y'abakuru.
Nubwo ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'u Rwanda y'umupira w'amaguru y'abagore bari munsi y'imyaka 20 yari ihari kandi ikina imikino kugeza muri 2009 mumikino yo gushaka itike y'igikombe cy'isi cy'abagore cya FIFA U-20 mu 2010, ikipe y'igihugu y'abakuru ntabwo yitabiriye imikino yomu myaka ya 2010. Ntakipe y'abakuru yitabiriye shampiyona y'abagore ya Afurika yomu 2010 mumikino ibanza cyangwa imikino yose ya Afurika yo muri 2011. Muri Werurwe 2012, iyikipe ntiyashyizwe kurutonde rw'isi na FIFA kandi nta kipe y'igihugu y'abakuru yari ihari. Ariko, ikipe y'igihugu y'abakuru yakinnye umukino wayo wambere kumugaragaro kuya 16 Gashyantare 2014.
She-Amavubi yatangiye gukina kuya 16 Mutarama 2014, mucyiciro cyambere cyogushaka itike yo gukina shampiyona y'abagore ya Afurika mu 2014, bakinnye na Kenya muri Stade Régional Nyamirambo i Kigali. Batsinze igitego 1-0 kugitego cyatsinzwe na Alice Niyoyita kumunota wa 29 mu mukino wa mbere. Mumukino wakabiri wabereye kuri sitade ya Kenyatta, Machakos, muri Kenya batsinzwe ibitego 2-1 igitego kimwe cyatsinzwe na Jeanne Nyirahatashima. U Rwanda rwinjiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri hakurikijwe itegeko ry'ibitego byo hanze nyuma yokurangiza 2-2 ku giteranyo cy'ibitego, rukina na Nijeriya. Umukino wabo wagatatu wemewe waranzweho impaka kuya 13 Gicurasi 2014 na Zambia maze urangira batsinzwe ibitego 3-0, biba ari ubwa gatatu batsinzwe. Bahanganye mumukino wakabiri wo gushaka itike yogukina shampiyona y'abagore ya Afurika mu 2014 na Nijeriya ku ya 24 Gicurasi 2014, batsindwa ibitego 4-1. Igitego cyatsinzwe na Clementine Mukamana kumunota wa 53. Mumukino wa kabiri, wongeye guhatana na Nijeriya ku ya 7 Kamena 2014, ikipe ya She-Amavubi yatsinzwe ibitego 8-0, bituma itagera mu irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo mu 2014 kubitego 12-1.
Gloria Nibagwire abaye capitaine wambere wa She-Amavubi.
U Rwanda rwitabiriye shampiyona ya CECAFA y'abagore ya 2016, rutsindwa imikinoyombi ku manota 3-2, rutsinzwe na Tanzania na Etiyopiya.
Ishyirahamwe ry’abagore mu Rwanda ryakiriye shampiyona ya CECAFA y’abagore ya 2018. Sitade y’akarere ka Nyamirambo yakiriye imikino yose 10 mw' irushanwa rya round robin. U Rwanda rwatsinze Tanzania (iyabaye iyambere) 1-0 ariko rurangiza arurwa nyuma rufite amanota 4 mu mikino 4 rwakinnye.
Umupira w'amaguru w'abagore mu Rwanda - ikipe ya 'She-Wasps' yasezereye Kenya mucyiciro cyambere cy'irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore (AWC) ryo muri 2014.
Ibisubizo n'imikino.
Urutonde rw'ibyavuye mumikino mumezi 12 ashize, hamwe n'imikino yose izaza yateganijwe.
Agahigo kuri buri muhanganye.
Imbonerahamwe ikurikira igaragaza agahigo k'u Rwanda kurwego mpuzamahanga rw'ibihe byose kuriburi mukinnyi uhanganye:
Abahamagawe vuba aha.
Abakinnyi bakurikira bahamagawe mw'ikipe y'u Rwanda mumezi 12 ashize.

Tom Wamukota (yavutse ku ya 28 Nzeri 1993) ni umukinnyi ukora Basketball ubikora nk'uwabigize umwuga ukomoka muri kenya ukinira ikipe ya APR BBC ikorera mu ishyirahamwe ry'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. akaba yarakiniye ikipe y'igihugu ya Kenya.
Wamukota yakinnye imyaka ibiri mu ikipe ya basketball y'abagabo ya Wichita sitate. Ni we mukinnyi wa mbere w'Umunyakenya wakinnye muri Suwet 16 y'irushanwa rya NCAA.
Mu mpeshyi ya 2018, yakiniye ikipe ya aguilas ya durango muri megizike. Mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2018-19, yakinnye n'ikipe ya mas yo muri maroke.
Muri 2019, Wamukota yakiniye muri Tuniziya muri Monastir ya amerika ndetse na nyuma yaho akinira JS Kairouan.
Yabaye umwe mu bagize ikipe y'igihugu ya Kenya mu irushanwa rya afurike basketball ya 2021 ryabereye i Kigali mu Rwanda.

Carlton Edward Bragg Jr. (yavutse ku ya 14 Ukuboza 1995) ni umukinnyi w’umukino wa Basketball, ukomoka muri amerika ukina nk' uwabigize umwuga ukina muri APR shampiyona ya basketball yu Rwanda (RBL) na shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball (BAL). Yakinnye kandi mui basketball ya kaminuza muri New Mexico Lobosi na Kansas.
Ku ya 5 Kanama 2021, Carlton Edward Bragg Jr yasinyanye amasezerano na Belediye wo muri Shampiyona ya mbere ya Basketball ya Turukiya (TBL). Ku ya 8 Ukuboza 2025, Bragg yatangajwe nk'umukinnyi mushya wa baye uwa mbere m’u Rwanda, muri APR BBC muri shampiyona ya basketbal yu Rwanda (RBL) na shampiyona nya furika ya Basketball (BAL).

Aliou Fadiala Diarra (yavutse ku ya 31 Ukuboza 2001) ni umukinnyi ukora umukino basketball ukomoka muri mali wa bigize umwuga, wakinaga mu ikipe ya Virtus Bologna yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cya Lega (LBA). Diarra yashyizwe mu makipe yo hanze nka Sitade mali kandi ntiyari azwi mu ma kipe ya basketball y’a babigize umwuga kugeza ubwo yamenyekanye mu 2023 kubera uburyo yitwaye muri shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball (BAL). Mu mwaka we wa mbere, yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w’umwaka mu bw'ugarizi ukina muri BAL ndetse anashyirwa mu ikipe ya mbere ya bakinnyi beza ba BAL. Yatsindiye igihembo cya kabiri nka nyugariro muri BAL yo muri 2025. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Diarra yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikipe y’igihugu ya Mali muri 2023 maze abageza ku mudari wa feza muri shampiyona ya FIBA y'afurika 2025.
Ku itariki ya 17 Nyakanga 2024, Diarra yasinye amasezerano y'umwaka umwe na APR BBC yatwaye igikombe m'u Rwanda muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL). Yatwaye ibikombe bibiri bya RBL n'igikombe cy'u Rwanda mu mwaka wa mbere mu ikipe ya Lions.

Jackson Niyomugabo (wavutse ku ya 18 Mata 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wo koga mu mikino ya Olempike w’u Rwanda. Akomoka i Kibuye mu karere k’uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Yakuriye koga mu mazi y’ikiyaga cya Kivu ku mupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Se yapfuye akiri muto, naho Jackson ahabwa imbaraga na nyina, uhinga agace gato k’umuryango mu misozi iri hejuru y’ikiyaga cya Kivu.
Kuba Niyomugabo yari umuntu uciye bugufi ntibyamuhaye amahirwe yo guhugurwa cyane mu mwuga. Yize koga ndetse anakunda umukino wo koga kuko yasomye igitabo yahawe n'umwarimu wo mu mashuri yisumbuye. Yubatse kwihangana no kwihangana mu koga hagati y'ibirwa byo mu misozi miremire mu kiyaga, kandi rimwe na rimwe yemererwaga koga muri hoteli y'ubukerarugendo mu murwa mukuru, Kigali.
Niyomugabo yitabiriye irushanwa ry’isi rya Aquatics ryabereye muri Ositaraliya mu 2007, nubwo atagize amahirwe yo gutsindira umudari. Yahagarariye Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu koga mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2008 n’imikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2012.

Rolly Fula Nganga (yavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 1993) ni umukinnyi w'abigize umwuga muri Basketball ukomoka muri Congo, w'akiniye ikipe nka APR BBC, Bangui Sporting Club n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. areshya na metero 198, akina nk'arutahizamu.
Mu Gushyingo 2022, yari ku rutonde rw'abakinnyi b'akinira ikipe ya Bangui Siporutinge mu gihe cy'urugendo rugana BAL rwo muri 2023.
Muri Mutarama 2023, Fula Nganga yasinye amasezerano muri APR BBC ikina muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL). Yatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona ya RBL yo muri 2023, igikombe cya mbere cua APR BBC imaze imyaka 14.

Dario Nathan Henry Hunt (yavutse ku ya 2 Gicurasi 1989) ni umukinnyi ukora Basketball w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri amerika. Yakinnye imyaka ine muri kaminuza ya Nevada, yakinnye inshuro eshatu mu ikipe ya wac, ndetse anahabwa igihembo cya kabiri muri wac inshuro ya 2.
Hunt yakinnye mu Burayi, nko muri Ukerene, Otirishiya, Ubutaliyani, Ubufaransa, n’Ububiligi no muri Ositaraliya.
Hunt ni umuhungu ukomoka kubabyeyi b'abasirikare babiri bahoze mu ngabo zirwanira mu kirere, yavukiye i Tampa, muri leta ya Folorida. Yakuriye mu Buyapani no muri Turukiya. Yize amashuri abanza atanu atandukanye n'amashuri yisumbuye abiri.
Muri Mutarama 2024, Hunt yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe ya APR BBC yo mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2024 muri shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda na shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball.

Cedric Wesley Isom (yavutse ku ya 6 Kamena 1984) ni umukinnyi ukora umukino Basketball ukomoka muri amerika wa kiniraga ikipe ya APR muri shampiyona y’igihugu ya Basketball y’u Rwanda.
Yavukiye i Newton muri Texasi arangiza mu ishuri rya Texasi muri 2006. Isom yakinnye muri Islande, Rwanda, Angola, Porutugali no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu. Yatwaye igikombe cya Shampiyona ya Angola muri 2011, 2013 na 2016.
Muri 2013, Isom yinjiye mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'u Rwanda kugira ngo yitegure irushanwa rya shampiyona nyafurika muri Basket muri 2013, ariko ntabwo yari mu rutonde rwa nyuma rw'abakinnyi.

Alphonse Munyeshyaka ni umukinnyi ukomoka akanakinira ikipe wo mu Rwanda wiruka intera yo hagati mu mikino Olempike. Yahagarariye igihugu cye mu kwiruka metero 1500 mu bagabo mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yo mu 1996. Igihe cye cyari 3:58.75.

Amarushanwa yoguhatanira itike yo kwitabira shampiyona y'ibihugu bya Afurika yo muri 2016 yari irushanwa ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'abagabo ryahisemo amakipe yitabiriye shampiyona y'ibihugu bya Afurika yo muri 2016. Abakinnyi b'ikipe y'igihugu bakinaga muri shampiyona y'igihugu cyabo nibo bonyine bemerewe kwitabira irirushanwa.
Amakipe cumi n'atandatu yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngakine irushanwa ryanyuma, harimo n'u Rwanda rwujuje ibisabwa muburyo bwikora nk'urwakira imikino.
Amakipe y'igihugu 42 y'abanyamuryango ba CAF yinjiye mucyiciro cyogushaka itike, agabanyijemo uturere hakurikijwe amakipe y'uturere.
Muri Zone y'Amajyaruguru, amakipe yakinnye hagati yayo kuburyo bwo gusiganwa ku maguru abiri. Amakipe yashyizwe ku rutonde hakurikijwe amanota (amanota 3 kintsinzi, inota 1 ku banganyije, amanota 0 ku itsindwa). Iyamanota angana, amanota yakoreshwaga muburyo bukurikira:
Muyandi matsinda yose, imikino yogushaka itike yakinwe muburyo bwo kwishyura, umukino ukinwa murugo nohanze. Iyamanota yose yanganaga nyuma y'umukino wakabiri, itegeko ryo gutsinda ibitego hanze ryakurikizwaga, kandi niba bingana, gutera penaliti byakoreshwaga kugira ngo hamenyekane uwatsinze (nta mwanya w'inyongera wakinwaga).
Amakipe abiri yambere muri Zone y'Amajyaruguru n'andi 13 yatsinze mucyiciro cyambere mutundi turere twose niyo yabashije kwitabira irushanwa ryanyuma.
Tombola yabaye kuya 5 Mata 2015, saa 16h00 UTC+2, kucyicaro gikuru cya CAF i Cairo, muri Misiri.
Gahunda y'imikino yogushaka itike yari ikurikira.

Amakipe yujuje ibisabwa.
Amakipe 16 akurikira niyo yabashije kwitabira irushanwa ryanyuma.
1 Inyuguti ikoze mu nyuguti zitukura igaragaza umukinnyi watwaye igikombe muruwo mwaka. "Inyuguti ikoze munyuguti zitukura" igaragaza uwakiriye igikombe muruwo mwaka.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda y'umupira w'amaguru y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 ihagarariye u Rwanda mu mupira w'amaguru kuriyi myaka kandi igenzurwa n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'u Rwanda. Iyikipe ihatanira igikombe cya Afurika cy'abatarengeje imyaka 20, kiba buri myaka ibiri, ndetse n'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 20.
Abakinnyi bakurikira bahamagawe mumikino yo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cya Afurika cy'abatarengeje imyaka 20 bazakina na Sudani y'Epfo muri 2015.

Ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda y'umupira w'amaguru y'abatarengeje imyaka 17 ihagarariye u Rwanda mu mupira w'amaguru kurwego rw'imyaka irimunsi y'imyaka 17, ikaba igenzurwa n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ry'u Rwanda. Iyikipe yitabira igikombe cya Afurika cy'ibihugu by'abatarengeje imyaka 17 n'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 17, byombi biba burimyaka ibiri.
URwanda rwitabiriye igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 17 kunshuro yambere muri 2011, nyuma yoku mwanya mu gikombe cya Afurika cy'abatarengeje imyaka 17 cyabereye mu Rwanda mu 2011. Ariko, basezerewe mumatsinda nyuma yogutsindwa n'Ubwongereza na Uruguay, ndetse bakina banganyije na Kanada.
Iyi kipe ubitozwa na Richard Tardy womu Bufaransa, wahoze atoza ikipeya Aris yo mu Bugereki ya Super League ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Libani.
Agahigo ko guhatana.
Agahigo k'igikombe cya Afurika cy'ibihugu by'abatarengeje imyaka 17.
1. Imikino yatombola irimo imikino yogukubitana yagenwe na penaliti.
Abakinnyi bakurikira nibo batoranyijwe mw'ikipe y’abatarengeje imyaka 17 mu gikombe cy’isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2011. Amakipe niyo yatoranyijwe kuya 18 Kamena 2011.
Inyandiko y'abantu bose.
Imbonerahamwe ikurikira igaragaza agahigo k'u Rwanda mumikino y'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA ku batarengeje imyaka 17.

Oliver Amani Mbekeka (wavutse kuya 22 Kanama 1979) ni umutoza w'umupira w'amaguru akaba n'umukinnyi wahoze akina imbere. Yahoze arumukinnyi w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda na DR Congo, akaba n'umugore wambere wayoboye ikipe y'abagabo nk'umutoza mukuru muri Uganda.
Mbekaka yakiniye Kampala Women, City Stars naShe Corporate muri Uganda, Source de Kivu na OCL City muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo ndetse na APR FC yomu Rwanda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mbekaka yakiniye Uganda kurwego rwo hejuru mugihe cy'irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo mu 2000 ndetse nomu ijonjora rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo mu 2002. Yakinnye imikino mpuzamahanga 12.
Intego mpuzamahanga.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bya Uganda nibyo byambere mugutsinda ibitego"
Nyuma y'uko Uganda ivuye mu marushanwa yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu gikombe cy'Afurika cy'abagore mu 2004 mbere y'imikino y'ibanze yakinnye na Malawi, Mbekeka namugenzi we w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umugande Annet Nakimbugwe bimukiye mumahanga. Kubera kobari muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi yaKongo, bagizwe abakinnyi nka Oliva Amani na Annette Nshimire, kandi bahagarariye igihugu mu irushanwa ry'isi rya FIFA ry'abagore batarengeje imyaka 20 ryo mu 2006. Yaje gukinira Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi yaKongo kurwego rwo hejuru mu irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo mu 2006.
Mbekaka yatoje Lady Doves Masindi muriUganda ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 ya Uganda.
Oliver Mbekaka niUmutoza Mukuru akaba n'Umuyobozi w'agateganyo wa Lugazi FC.

Annet Nakimbugwe n' umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukina hagati. Yabaye umwemu bakinnyi b'ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore ya Uganda ndetse nikipe ya DR Congo y'abatarengeje imyaka 20.
Nakimbugwe yakiniye Source de Kivu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi yaKongo, muri APR FC mu Rwanda nomuri Buikwe SheRed Stars muri Uganda.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Nakimbugwe yakiniye Uganda kurwego rwo hejuru mw' irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo mu 2000 ndetse nomu irushanwa rya Afurika ry'abagore ryo muri 2002.
Intego mpuzamahanga.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bya Uganda nibyo bya mbere mugutsinda ibitego"
Nyuma y'uko Uganda ivuye mu marushanwa yo gushaka itike yo kujya mu gikombe cy'Afurika cy'abagore muri 2004 mbere y'imikino y'ibanze yakinnye na Malawi, Nakimbugwe namugenzi we w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umugande Oliver Mbeka bagiye mumahanga. Kubera kobari muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, bagizwe abakinnyi basanzwe nka Annette Nshimire na Oliva Amani, ndetse bahagararira igihugu mw' irushanwa ry'isi rya FIFA ry'abagore batarengeje imyaka 20 ryo mu 2006. Yanakinnye icyiciro cyakurikiyeho muri 2008.
Umukobwa wa Nakimbugwe, Hasifah Nassuna, nawe ni umupira w'amaguru kandi bombibahuye mumikino ya shampiyona y'abagore ya Uganda.

Danielita Favour Nambatya (wavutse kuya 14 Ugushyingo 2000) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'abagore womuri Uganda, akabakina nk'umukinnyi wa mbere mu ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'abagore yomu Rwanda yitwa Apaer Women's Football Club ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore yo muri Uganda.
Yavukiye mu bitaro bya Mulago, Kampala, avukana na Peruth Onuonga, akaba n'umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wahoze arimu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru Mathias Ssonko. Mushiki we Precious Najjemba nawe yigeze kuba umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru muri Kaminuza ya Mutesa I Royal mumuryango w'abantu 6.
Nambatya yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru afite imyaka irindwi ubwo yigaga mumwaka wa gatatu w'amashuri abanza muri By Pass Standard Academy i Kyebando, nyuma ajya mw' ishuri ribanza rya Old Mulago. Muminsi ya mbere yatojwe muri All Stars Sports Academy iyobowe n'umutoza Muyitale, maze agaragara mw' ishuri ribanza rya Old Mulago kurwego rw'amashuri abanza. Nambatya yahoze ari umukinnyi mu ishuri rikuru rya Masaka ryahoze ari Agha Khan, aho yize kugeza mumwaka wa gatatu w'amashuri abanza hamwe n'umutoza Jimmy Kisekka, nyuma yinjiye muri ST Mary's Kitende mumwaka wa kane w'amashuri abanza na Kawempe Muslim SS mu cyiciro cya mbere hamwe n'umutoza Moses Nkata na Ayub Khalifa, Ishuri ry'Ubucuruzi rya Kaminuza ya Makerere na Kaminuza ya Royal ya Muteesa I.
Nambatya yinjiye muri Kawempe Muslim LFC avuye muri Kawempe Muslim SS ubwo yazamurwaga muntera akina muri FUFA Women Elite League, shampiyona y’abagore ya Uganda yari shampiyona ikomeye y’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore icyarimwe. Nambatya yakinnye muri Kawempe mugihe cy’imyaka itatu kuva muri 2015 kugeza mumpera za 2018, atsinda ibitego 27 bya shampiyona muricyo gihe. Mu mwaka wa mbere w’imikino wa 2015 yatsinze ibitego 6 bya shampiyona, 8 muri 2015/16 na 13 muri 2016/17.
Muteesa I Royal University WFC..
Avuye i Kawempe, Nambatya yinjiye muri Kaminuza ya Muteesa I Royal mucyiciro cyakabiri cya kaminuza mubukerarugendo nogucunga amahoteli, maze arangiza akinirayo umwaka n'igice akina muri FUFA Women Elite League kugeza mumwaka w'imikino wa 2018-2019.
Ishuri ry'Ubucuruzi rya Kaminuza ya Makerere (MUBS).
Nambatya yavuye i Muteesa muri 2019 ajya muri MUBS mw' isomo rya siyansi mu bijyanye no kwamamaza.
Nambatya yinjiye muri She Corporate mu 2020 kandi yari mw' ikipe yegukanye igikombe cya FUFA Women Super League mumwaka wa 2021-22. Favour yari uwa kabiri mubatsinze ibitego muri shampiyona n'ibitego 10 ubwo Fazila Ikwaput na Hasifah Nassuuna basangiraga inkweto. Mumwaka wa 2022/23 arikumwe na She Corporate, Nambatya yatsinze ibitego bitandatu muri CAF Women Champions League (CECAFA Zone Qualifiers).
Ku itariki ya 25 Mutarama 2023, Nambatya yasinye amasezerano y'igihe gito na Apear Women Fc yomu Rwanda ikina muri shampiyona y'abagore mu
Nambatya afite umugisha wogukora kumupira ku nshuro yambere, kandi nimukinnyi w'ikipe kandi agatera imipira mu byiciro byose. Mugihe cy'umukino, Nambatya kandi akomeza kugira ishusho nk'iy'umukinnyi uhiga igitego kugira ngo arangize hafi y'aho atera imipira akoresheje imbaraga nyinshi n'imitwe ikomeye. Nubwo yari umuhanga mukugenzura imipira hafi, gutera umutwe, gutera imipira, gutera imipira nokuyitera neza.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Mu 2012, yahamagawe bwambere n'ikipe ye kugira ngahagararire ikipe y'igihugu y'abagore ya Uganda. Kandi yahamagawe n'amakipe y'igihugu arenga atanu. Nambatya yari mubakinnyi ba CAF U-20 mubagore bahamagawe na Uganda muri 2017, batsinze Sudani y'Epfo ibitego 22-0 nubwo yatakaje icyiciro gikurikiraho kubera amafaranga.

Marie Grace Nyinawumuntu (wavutse kuya 16 Ukuboza 1982) numuyobozi w’umupira wamaguru mu Rwanda akaba yarahoze arumupira wamaguru.
Nyinawumuntu yakuriye mumikino ya siporo hamwe na babyara be b'abahungu.
Nyinawumuntu yitabiriye Lycée de Kigali mu Rwanda. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ihanitse mu myigire y’umubiri na siporo ndetse n’icyiciro cya kaminuza mubucuruzi bw’ubucuruzi.
Nyinawumuntu yakiniye umujyi wa Kigali, aho yasobanuwe ko "imikinire yitangaje yamuhesheje umwanya mw' ikipe y'igihugu".
Nyinawumuntu yakoraga cyane nkamyugariro wo hagati.
Nyinawumuntu numusifuzi wambere wumugore wu Rwanda numutoza wambere wumupira wamaguru wumugore wu Rwanda. Nyinawumuntu yitabiriye amahugurwa yabatoza muBudage muri 2008. Yayoboye ikipe yu Rwanda AS Kigali, afasha iyikipe gutwara shampiyona.
Se wa Nyinawumuntu yapfuye muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda. Yashakanye n'umunyamategeko.

AS Kigali Women's Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'abagore yomu Rwanda yitabira shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru y'abagore yo mu Rwanda. Iyikipe ifite icyicaro mumujyi wa Kigali kandi ikinira imikino yayo yanyuma kuri sitade ya Kigali iherereye i Nyamirambo.
AS Kigali, ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yashinzwe muri 2008, iterwa inkunga n'Umujyi wa Kigali. Ifite intsinzi nyinshi z'igikombe kuva muri 2009 kugeza 2018.
Mumwaka w'imikino wa 2017-2018, intsinzi ikomeye yatsinzwe na Scandinavia WFC 1-0 kumukino wanyuma yatumye AS Kigali yegukana igikombe cyacumi yikurikiranya. Ariko, umwaka wakurikiyeho wabayemo ibintu bitunguranye ubwo Kigali yananirwaga gutwara igikombe, bikaba ari ibihe by'amateka mumateka y'iyi kipe.
Muri shampiyona ya 2021-2022, AS Kigali yagaragaje imbaraga zayo ubwo yatsindaga imikino 15. Nubwo yatsinzwe kumunsi wa nyuma washampiyona, ikipe yabashije kwegukana ikindi gikombe cyashampiyona. Ibibyatumye ihabwa icyubahiro cyoguhagararira u Rwanda muri CAF Women's Champions League ya 2022. Ariko, urugendo rwabo rwarangiye muri 1/2 cy'irangiza mu mikino ya CECAFA y'abagore ya CAF, batsindwa na Simba Queens. Nubwo bimeze bityo, Kigali yakomeje gutsinda ubwo yatsindaga mugikombe cy'amahoro, itsinda Kamonyi FC intsinzi ikomeye ku bitego 4-0.
Muri 2023, AS Kigali yahuye n'ibibazo bikomeye by'amafaranga, bituma badashobora guhaza ibyifuzo by'abakinnyi babo kumushahara. Umuterankunga w'iyi kipe yagize uruhare mukubakiza ibibazo by'ubukungu. Ubu bufasha bwabaye ingenzi cyane ubwo AS Kigali yegukanaga igikombe cya 12 cya shampiyona y'u Rwanda, bigaragaza imbaraga n'ubwitange bwabo muruyu mukino.

Samuel Léopold Marie Gueulette (wavutse kuya 19 Gicurasi muri 2000) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukina hagati mw' ikipe ya La Louvière yo mu Bubiligi ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Gueulette yatangiye umwuga wewo mucyiciro cya kabiri mw' ikipe ya Tubize yomu Bubiligi, mbere yo kwerekeza muri Roeselare kuya 27 Nyakanga 2020.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Gueulette yavukiye mu Rwanda kuri se w'Umubiligi akaba nanyina w'Umunyarwanda, yimukiye mu Bubiligi akiri muto. Yahagarariye ikipe y'Urwanda y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 mumikino ibiri yo guhatanira itike yo gukina Igikombe cya Afurika cy'Abatarengeje imyaka 20 cya 2019 muri 2018. Yanahamagawe mu ikipe y'Urwanda y'abatarengeje imyaka 23 mumukino wo guhatanira itike yo gukina Igikombe cya Afurika cy'Abatarengeje imyaka 23 cya 2019 muri 2018. Yabanje mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda mumukino wagicuti batsinze Repubulika ya Centre Africa ibitego 2-0 kuya 3 Kamena 2021.

Patrick Sibomana (wavutse kuya 15 Ukwakira 1996) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukina hagati mw' ikipe ya Al-Wahda Tripoli.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'u Rwanda ku isonga."

Israel Oyoro Otobo (yavutse ku ya 31 Gicurasi 2004) ni umukinnyi ukina Basketball w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Nijeriya ubu akinira ikipe ya City Oil. Akinira mu kibuga hagati, anakinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Nijeriya kuva muri 2023.

Eloi Maniraguha (yavutse kuya 1 Mutarama 1995), mberewitwaga Eloi Imaniraguha, numukinnyi wokoga mumikino Olempike w’u Rwanda. Yahagarariye igihugucye nka Eloi Imaniraguha mumikino Olempike y’impeshyi ya 2016 mwirushanwa ry’abagabo ryo kwiruka metero 50 ahoyari kumwanya wa 68 akoresheje amasegonda 26.43. Ntiyageze mu irushanwa rya 1/2. Yanitabiriye kandi nka Eloi Maniraguha mumikino Olempike y’impeshyi ya 2020 mwirushanwa ry’abagabo ryo kwiruka metero 50 nomumikino ya Commonwealth ya 2022 mumikino y’abagabo yokwiruka metero 50 n’iy’abagabo yo kwiruka metero 100.

Jean-Claude Gasigwa (8 Nyakanga 1983 – 8 Mutarama 2015) yarumukinnyi wa tennis w’umwuga w’Umunyarwanda. Yarumwe mubagize ikipe ya Rwanda Davis Cup mberey’uko apfa mu 2015. Yatwaye Kenya Open mu 2008, Tanzania Open mu 2011 na Uganda Open mu 2009, 2012 na 2013.
Gasigwa yaguye mukantu mazapfa ubwo yarimu myitozo muri Cercle Sportif de Kigali. Yari afite imyaka 31.

Samuel Mugisha (wavutse kuya 5 Ukuboza 1997) numunyarwanda ukina kwigare, ubakaba atwarikipe ya UCI Continental ProTouch. Yatsindiye Tour of Rwanda mu 2018.
Muri Nzeri 2022, Mugisha yagiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika mwirushanwa rya Maryland Cycling Classic rya 2022. Ariko, nyumayo kugera kukibuga cy'indege ntiyageze kuri hoteli kandi nyuma y'umunsi umwe ntabwo yari muntangiriro z'isiganwa, nyumikipeye yatangaje koyaburiwe irengero. Amashusho ya kamera yavuye kukibuga cy'indege yerekanaga Mugisha anyura mu igenzura rya pasiporo yinjira mumodoka arikumwe n'abantu babiri "yarazineza".

Leonce Sekama (wavutse kuya 17 Ugushyingo 1980) ni umunyarwanda wahoze ari umunyeshuri wo koga, akaba yari umuhanga mumikino yokwiruka muburyo bwa freestyle. Sekama yujuje ibisabwa mu mikino yo kwiruka mu buryo bwa freestyle ya metero 50 mu bagabo mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yabereye i Athens mu 2004, ahabwa umwanya wa Universality na FINA mu gihe cyo kwinjira ari 30.57. Yahanganye n'abandi bakinnyi barindwi bo koga mu cyiciro cya kabiri, barimo Malique Williams w'imyaka 15 womur'Antigua na Barbuda. Yavuguruye umupira w'amasegonda 30 maze atsinda amanota 28.99 mubuzimabwebwose, bituma abona umwanya wa kane arusha Anderson Bonabart wo muri Micronesia watsinze amasegonda 2.24. Sekama yananiwe kugera murikimwe cya kabiri cy'irushanwa, kuko yaje kumwanya wa mirongo irindwi n'umunani muri rusange mu boga 86 mu mikino ibanza.

Robert Thomson (wavutse kuya 28 Mutarama 1982) numukinnyi wa Basketball w’Umunyarwanda ufitinkomoko mur'Amerika ubukinira ikipe ya CS Gaz Metan Mediaş yo muri Romanian Basketball League. Ni umwe mu bagize ikipe y’igihugu y’abagabo ya Basketball y’Urwanda.
Thomson yavukiye muri Pennsylvania, arangiza amashuriye mwishuri ryisumbuye rya Saucon Valley i Hellertown, muri Pennsylvania. Yakinnye umukino wa basketball muri kaminuza ya Fairfield.
Thomson yimukiye mu Rwanda mu 2006 nyuma yokurangiza i Fairfield nogukina imyaka ibiri ya Basketball y'umwuga muri Hongiriya no mu Butaliyani. Nyuma Thomson yabonye pasiporo y'u Rwanda kandi yarumwe mubagize ikipe y'u Rwanda yaje kumwanya wa cyenda muri Shampiyona ya Afurika ya FIBA yo mu 2009 ndetse no mu 2007 yegukanye igikombe cya mbere cya Afurika mu mateka y'u Rwanda. Thomson yayoboye abakinnyi bose mugusiganwa kumaguru n'iminota kuri burimukino mwirushanwa rya 2009.

Fred Yannick Uwase (wavutse kuya 16 Gicurasi 1994 i Paris) numukinnyi wa Judo w’Umunyarwanda. Yitabiriyirushanwa ry’abagabo ripima ibiro 73 mumikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi ya 2012, maze asezererwa na Bruno Mendonca mucyiciro cya kabiri.

Max Houkes na Clément Tabur nibobatwaye igikombe arikobahisemo kutarwanira igikombe cyabo.

Espérance Football Club niikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ifiticyicaro i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Ubu irushanwa muri shampiyona y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda, kandikinira imikino yayoyanyuma kuri Stade Mumena. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]

Etincelles Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ifiticyicaro i Gisenyi mu Rwanda. Ubu irakina muri shampiyona y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda kandi ikinimikino yayo yaberaga murugo kuri sitade y'umuganda ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 5,000.

Gicumbi Football Club ni club yumupira wamaguru i Byumba, mu Rwanda. Kugezubu barushanwe mucyiciro cyakabiri cy'u Rwanda, bakinimikino yabomurugo kuri Stade Gicumbi.
Nyuma yokurangiza kumwanya wanyuma nokumanuka mucyiciro cyambere mu 2022, Gicumbi yabuze amahirwe yo kuzamuka muri shampiyona y'u Rwanda ya 2023/24.

Igikombe cy'Intwari, kizwi kandinka Irushanwa ry'Umunsi w'Intwari, nirushanwa ngarukamwaka ry'igikombe cya basketball kumakipe akomeye mu Rwanda. Amarushanwa y'Igikombe cy'Intwari ategurwa n'amashyirahamwe yabo kubufatanye n'Ishami rishinzwe Intwari, Imidari y'Igihugu n'Imidari y'Icyubahiro (CHENO). Umukino wanyuma w'igikombe ukinwa buri mwaka ku Munsi w'Intwari z'Igihugu kuya 1 Gashyantare.
Kuva mu 2024, amakipe y'abagabo yomu Rwanda afitirindi rushanwa ryateguwe na FERWABA mugikombe cya Basketball cy'u Rwanda.

Ndagano Junior (wavutse kuya 25 Ukwakira 1985) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umubiligi wavukiye mu Rwanda, ubakaba arangije amasezerano ye.
Ndagano numukinnyi ukina imbere cyangwa myugariro ukoresha uruhande rw'ibumoso. Yatangiye umwuga we mw' ikipe y'ingimbi ya KV Turnhout mbere yuko asinyishwa na KRC Genk afite imyaka 16. Nyuma y'imyaka ibirimuri Genk yerekeje muri KV Mechelen ariko ntiyashoboye kwinjira mw' ikipe yambere. Kuva icyo gihe yakiniye amakipe atandukanye yoku mugabane w'i Burayi, harimo n'igihe yamaze muri Paris FC, igihe cyegihoraho cyane arimuri Dessel Sport mu cyiciro cyakabiri.
Muri 2011 Ndagano Junior yatoranyijwe mw' itsinda ry'abakinnyi b'i Burayi bafite inkomoko mu Rwanda kugira ngobaze mu Rwanda muburyo bwa gicuti. Ibibyatumye ahamagarwa mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.

Mu 2012, iyikipe yaguzwe na Rayon Sports, nayikorera mumujyi wa Nyanza.

Jean Claude Ndoli (wavutse kuya 7 Nzeri 1986 i Kibungo) numukinnyi w’umupira wamaguru wavukiye mu Rwanda, kurubu ukinira Musanze Butare muri Shampiyona y’u Rwanda.
Yasinye amasezerano muri APR FC muri 2006, avuye muri Polisi ya Rwanda. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere muri APR FC mumukino wambere w'umwaka wa shampiyona y'u Rwanda ya 2006 ubwo bakinaga na SC Kiyovu Sport.
Yakinnye na APR FC kuva muri 2005 kugeza 2016, Ndoli yatwaye ibikombe 10 bya Shampiyona y'Urwanda n'ibikombe 7 by'Urwanda. Yagabanyije imirimo ye, anatoza abazamu mugihe yamaze muri APR FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.

Yatangiriye mu izamu ubwo u Rwanda rwatsindwaga umukino wanyuma wa CECAFA Cup mu 2009 na Uganda ibitego 2-0. Ndoli yaherukaga guhamagarwa muri 2016.

Hagati yo muri 2005 na 2008 yatwaye shampiyona y'u Rwanda inshuro 4 yikurikiranya, ndetse aba n'umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona mu 2006.
Yakinnye umukino umwe muri 2006 mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda.

Michel Kamanzi (wavutse kuya 29 Nzeri 1979) numukinnyi wahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda, uzwiho kuba yarakinnye hagati mu ikipe ya TuSpo Richrath.
Kamanzi yimukiye mu Budage abisabwe n'umwe mubanyagihugu be.
Muri 2004, Kamanzi yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yomu cyiciro cyakane cy'Ubudage nyuma yo gukinira ikipe ya SG Betzdorf mu cyiciro cyagatanu cy'Ubudage.

Karim Kamanzi (wavutse kuya 18 Werurwe muwi 1983) ni rutahizamu w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda wasezerewe. Yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda mu gikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 2004.

Claude Kalisa (wavutse kuya 6 Kamena 1977)) ni umunyarwanda wahoze arimyugariro w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga. Afatanyije na mugenzi we Désiré Mbonabucya, Kalisa yabaye inkingi y'umugongo y'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda yitabiriye Igikombe cya Afurika cy'Ibihugu cya 2004.
Kalisa yatangiye gukina umupira w'amaguru w'ababigize umwuga mu Bushinwa mu ikipe ya Yanbian Century, kandi yamaze ibihembwe bitandatu byanyuma by'umwuga wemu Bubiligi mu ikipe ya K. Sint-Truidense VV. Yasezeye kukazi kubera imvune yomu ivi muri 2007.
Se wa Kalisa yishwe mu ntambara y’abenegihugu mugihugu cyecy’u Rwanda.

Djihad Bizimana (wavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1996) afite uburebure bwa metero imwe na centimetero mirongwinani (1,80m) Akaba yaravukiye mugihugu cy'u Rwanda muntara y'uburengerazuba (Gisenyi)ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru mugihugu cy'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukina nk'umukinnyi wo hagati mu ikipe ya CS Constantine yo muri Alijeriya ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Bizimana Djihad yakinnye mu ikipe y'urubyiruko ya Etincelles kuva afite imyaka 15, akaba yaratangiye gukina muri Rayon sport Fc. Ku ya 26 Mata 2018, Bizimana yinjiye muri Waasland-Beveren avuye mu ikipe ya APR FC yo mu Rwanda. Bizimana yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Waasland-Beveren mu mukino wahuje ikipe ya SV Zulte Waregem yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Bubiligi, aho yakinnye na SV Zulte Waregem ibitego 2-2 ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2018.
Ku itariki ya 28 Gicurasi 2021, yemeye kujya muri Deinze mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'Ububiligi.
Ku itariki ya 26 Nyakanga 2023, yinjiye mu ikipe ya FC Kryvbas yo muri Ukraine muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere muri iyi kipe mu mukino wahuje ikipe ya Oleksandriya na Oleksandriya, aza gusimbuza ku munota wa 46.
Ku ya 6 Gashyantare 2025, Bizimana Djihad yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri na Al Ahli SC ku giciro kitatangajwe hejuru.
Ku itariki ya 31 Mutarama 2026, yinjiye mu ikipe ya CS Constantine yo muri Alijeriya.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Bizimana Djihad yari umukinnyi mpuzamahanga w’ingimbi mu ikipe y’u Rwanda. Yabanje mu ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda mu mukino wa gicuti batsinzwemo na Zambia ibitego 2-0 ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2015.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'u Rwanda ku isonga."

Joseph Honoré Kabongo (yavutse 1 Mutarama muwi 1985 i Brazzaville ) numukinnyi wahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu Rwanda.
Yatangiye gukina muri Renaissance Kigali, mbere yokujya muri Patro Maasmechelen muri Nyakanga 2004. Kabongo yavuye mw' ikipe nyuma y'amezi 6 mu Bubiligi ajya muri Sakaryaspor muri Turukiya muri Mutarama 2005, yakinnye imikino 5 mbere yokujya muri Hakoah Ramat-Gan muri Nyakanga 2006. Than yasubiye muri APR FC muri Mutarama 2007, nyuma y'umwaka umwe muri Gashyantare 2008 ava muri APR ajya muri Somaliya gusinya amasezerano na Goldogob FC. Ikipe yomuri Tayilande yitwa Samut Songkhram FC yamuguze muri Nyakanga 2008, ariko muruyu mwaka w'imikino wa Nyakanga 2009 yakiniye Tanzania Champions Young Africans FC.
Yakinnye kuva muri 2005 kugeza mu 2007 mu ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda. Kabongo yanahawe ikamba ryerya mbere k ya 27 Werurwe 2005 ubwo yakinaga n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Algeria. Yanabaye mw' ikipe y'abatarengeje imyaka 17 yo muri Kongo..

Jean-Claude Iranzi (wavutse kuya 5 Ukwakira 1990) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga, akaba aherutse gukinira ikipe ya Rayon Sports yo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'u Rwanda.
Iranzi yavukiye i Kigali. Yatangiye umwuga we muri 2004 muri SC Kiyovu Sport, azamurwa mu ntera mw' ikipe ya shampiyona y'u Rwanda yo muri 2006. Yakinnye bwa mbere muri Kiyovu Sport muri Kamena 2006.
Mu Ukuboza 2008, Iranzi yasinye amasezerano na APR FC, ikipe yambere yatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona y'u Rwanda. Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere wa APR FC mumukino wagicuti wateguwe n'ikipe ya Police FC. Afatanyije na APR, Iranzi yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona y'u Rwanda cyomu 2009-10, bityo abona umwanya muri CAF Champions League yo mu 2011, aho APR yasezerewe mucyiciro cyambere na Club Africain yomuri Tuniziya ku manota 2-6. APR yongeye kuba igikombe cya shampiyona y'Ubwongereza muri 2010-11, bityo ikina muri CAF Champions League yo mu 2012.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Iranzi yakinnye shampiyona y'ingimbi z'abatarengeje imyaka 20 yabereye mu Rwanda. Yakinnye umukino we wa mbere mw' ikipe ya "Wasps" ku ya 21 Kamena 2008 mu mukino wo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cya 2010 yakinnye n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Maroc. Igitego cyambere mpuzamahanga cya Iranzi cyabonetse kuya 26 Werurwe 2011 murwego rwo gushaka itike yo gukina igikombe cya Afurika cya 2012. Iki gitego cyatsinzwe ku munota wa 44, cyatumye u Rwanda rutsinda Burundi igitego 1-0. U Rwanda rwatsinze umukino kumanota 3-1.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota u Rwanda rwatsinze mbere, inkingi y'amanota igaragaza amanota nyuma yaburi gitego cyaIranzi."

Emmanuel Imanishimwe (wavutse kuya 2 Gashyantare 1995) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukina inyuma y'ibumoso mw' ikipe ya AEL Limassol n'ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Muri Kanama 2021, yinjiye mw' ikipe ya AS FAR yomuri Maroc ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu ku giciro cyamiliyoni 130 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda.

Hakizimana Muhadjiri (wavutse kuya 13 Kanama 1994) uzwi kandi ku izina rya "HD" ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'u Rwanda wabigize umwuga ukinira ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Kw' itariki ya 26 Kamena 2022, Hakizimana yinjiye mw' ikipe ya Al-Kholood yomuri Arabiya Sawudite.
Yatangiye gukina kurwego mpuzamahanga kuya 3 Ugushyingo 2016 mumikino yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2017, anatsinda igitego cye cyambere ubwo bakinaga na Ghana banganyaga igitego 1-1.
Mumikino yo guhatanira itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2022, yatsinze ibitego bibiri muriburi mukino mumikino ibiri yikurikiranya yatsinzemo ikipe ya Seychelles.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'u Rwanda kw' isonga."

Jean-Pierre Mabula Hakiri (wavutse kuya 15 Nyakanga 1987) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda uzwiho kuba yarakiniye imikino Olempike ya Sydney muri Ositaraliya muri 2016.
Yitabiriye imikino itatu yokwitegura na Sydney Olympic muri Ositaraliya mumpeshyi ya 2016, Hariri yari amaze gukora imyitozo nabo kuya 3 Nyakanga kandi yagombaga gusinya amasezerano y'imyaka 2, yatangiye ubwo Olympic yatsindwaga na Rockdale City Suns ibitego 0-2, agaragaza imbaraga nyinshi nubwo yakuyemo ikarita itukura kumunota wa 75.
Uyu munyarwanda ni umukirisitu kandi yashatse mu 2015.

Jean-Paul Habyarimana (wavutse kuya 17 Kanama 1982) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda. Yakinnye imikino itatu mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda kuva muri 2002 kugeza mu 2004. Yanatoranyijwe mw' ikipe y'u Rwanda yitabiriye irushanwa rya Afurika ryo mu 2004.

Steven Emmanuel Godfroid Kunduma (wavutse kuya 16 Werurwe 1990) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukinira ikipe ya KSV Temse yomu Bubiligi nk'umukinnyi wo hagati. Yavukiye mu Bubiligi, ahagararira u Rwanda kurwego mpuzamahanga.
Godfroid yakinnye umupira w'amaguru mumakipe yo mu Bubiligi mw' ikipe ya Charleroi, Jeunesse Turque na Saint-Gilloise. Godfroid yinjiye muri KSV Temse mbere y'umwaka w'imikino wa 2019-20.
Yakinnye umukino wewa mbere mpuzamahanga mu Rwanda muri 2012, kandi yakinnye imikino yogushaka itike yogukina igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA.

Eric Gasana (wavutse kuya 15 Gicurasi 1986) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda ukina inyuma kuruhande rw'iburyo. Yitabiriye igikombe cya Afurika cya 2012 arikumwe n'ikipe y'igihugu y'Urwanda.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragazwa n'umubare w'ibitego by'u Rwanda, inkingi y'amanota igaragaza amanota nyuma yaburi gitego cyaGasana."

Fritz Emeran Nkusi (wavutse kuya 28 Werurwe muwi 1976) yahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga wakinaga nk'umukinnyi w'inyuma w'iburyo. Yavukiye i Guadeloupe, akinira ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda.
Nkusi wavukiye muri Les Abymes, Guadeloupe, yakiniye Monaco B, Saint-Lô, Rennes B, Stade Poitevin, Saint-Denis Saint-Leu, KV Mechelen, Genk, Fortuna Sittard, Gueugnon, FC Bruxelles, La Louvière, Asteras Tripolis, Levadiakos, Saint-Leventiakos.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Emeran yavukiye i Guadeloupe mu Bufaransa, yashakanye n'umunyarwandakazi wahawe ubwenegihugu bw'u Rwanda. Yatsindiye u Rwanda imipira 6 hagati yo muri 2005 na 2007.
Ni e w'umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umufaransa Noam Emeran.

Andrew Buteera (wavutse kuya 3 Ukwakira 1994) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda ukina hagati mw' ikipe ya APR n'ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda.
Buteera yavukiye i Kampala, Buteera yatangiye umwuga wemuri Proline muri Uganda muri 2011 mbere yokujya muri APR ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri muri 2012.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Buteera yakinnye umukino wewa mbere mpuzamahanga mw' ikipe y'u Rwanda kuya 3 Nzeri 2011 ubwo batsindwaga na Ivory Coast ibitego 5-0 mu mikino yo guhatanira itike yo kujya mu gikombe cya Afurika cya 2012.

Boba Bola (wavutse kuya 2 Ukwakira 1985) yahoze arumukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru wabigize umwuga wakinaga nk'umukinnyi wa mbere. Yavukiye muri Zaire, ahagararira ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda kurwego mpuzamahanga.
Bola yinjiye muri Landskrona BoIS muri 2005, avuye muri APR FC. Yari hafi gutizwa mu ikipe yo muri Suwede yitwa IF Limhamn Bunkeflo ariko urukundo ntirwagenze neza, ahubwo yatijwe muri Bodens BK. Yakinnye imikino 26 atsinda ibitego 3 muri Landskrona BoIS, mbere yuko agenda kuya 22 Ukuboza 2008. Yazamuwe nyuma y'umwaka wa 2008 mw' ikipe y'abasimbura ya Landskrona BoIS kandi yari mu igeragezwa muri Motala AIF. Mumpeshyi ya 2009 n'igice cy'umwaka muri Landskrona BoIS II yasinye amasezerano muri Syrianska IF Kerburan. Muri Werurwe 2010, nyuma yokurekurwa na Syrianska IF yasinye muri Panellinios IF. Muri Kanama 2010 yasinye amasezerano muri Finnish Atlantis FC.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Bola yavukiye muri Zaire, yahagarariye ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda kurwego mpuzamahanga kandi yari umukinnyi ukomeye mw' ikipe ya "Amavubi".

Bokota Kamana Labama (wavutse kuya 6 Mata 1985 i Kinshasa) numukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umunyarwanda ukomoka mugihugu cya Rayon Sport.
Bokota yakinnye mbere muri Rayon Sport na Armée Patriotique Rwandaise FC. ["Bikenewe"] Yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umwaka wa SMS Media ubwo yatangiraga gukina na Rayon.
Bokota yahawe igihano cy'umwaka umwe n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Rwanda mu 2009, maze yerekeza muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya congo gukinira amakipe yomuri ako gace FC Les Stars na DC Motema Pembe. Muri Kanama 2011, yasinye amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri muri Rayon Sport, atangira gukinira ikipe yomu Rwanda.
Kuya 8 Kanama 2012, rutahizamu waAmavubi Bokota Labama yinjiye muri Kiyovu Sports ku masezerano y'umwaka umwe.
Umwuga mpuzamahanga.
Bokota ubu n' umwe mubagize ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'u Rwanda. Igihugu yavukiyemo ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'u Rwanda ku isonga."

Canesius Bizimana (wavutse kuya 15 Mutarama 1984) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda. Yakinnye imikino itatu mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda muri 2003 na 2004. Yanatoranyijwe mw' ikipe y'u Rwanda yitabiriye irushanwa rya Afurika ryo mu 2004.

Léandre Bizagwira (wavutse kuya 15 Gicurasi 1977) yahoze ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda. Yakinnye imikino 14 mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda kuva muri 2000 kugeza muri 2004. Yanatoranyijwe mw' ikipe y'u Rwanda yitabiriye irushanwa rya Afurika ryo mu 2004.

Jean Rémy Bitana (wavutse kuya 5 Gicurasi 1984) ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda wakinnye imikino itanu mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'umupira w'amaguru y'Urwanda muri 2003 na 2004, harimo itatu mw' irushanwa rya Afurika ryo mu 2004.

Biramahire Abeddy (yavutse kw' itariki 4 Ukwakira 1998) numupira wamaguru wumupira wamaguru mu Rwanda.
Biramahire yavukiye i Kigali, mu Rwanda, maze atangira gukina umupira w'amaguru mucyiciro cya kabiri, asinya amasezerano na Heroes Football Club. Imikinire ya Biramahire yatumye yimurirwa muri Bugesera FC, uburyo yitwaye bwamuhesheje umwanya mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'abana b'abatarengeje "imyaka 20."
Biramahire yateye imbere mumupira w'amaguru mu Rwanda nyuma yo gusinya amasezerano na Police Fc mu 2017, mumwaka wa shampiyona ya 2016/2017 ya shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cy'u Rwanda. Kumyaka 20, yahawe igihembo cy'umukinnyi mwiza ukiri muto utanga icyizere kubera ubuhanga bwe n'ubwitange bwe mukibuga, ibi byanamuhesheje ishimwe no guhabwa umwanya mw' ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda Amavubi mw' ikipe ya CHAN (African Nations Championship) yabereye muri Maroc muri 2018.
Biramahire yagize uruhare runini mukurangiza neza kumwanya wakabiri muri uyu mwaka w'imikino, nyuma yo kubura igikombe cya shampiyona muri APR FC. Muri 2018, yerekeje muri Club Sportif Sfaxien nyuma yokongera gusimbuza u Rwanda na Tunisia na Nshuti Innocent avuye muri APR FC ajya muri Stade Tunisien muri uwomwaka.
"Amanota n'ibisubizo bigaragaza amanota y'u Rwanda ku isonga."

RYAN Joseph OBE GIGGS wo mu gihugu cya wales yari umukinnyi w'umupira wamaguru wavutse mu kwezi kwa cumi na kumwe mu gihumbi kimwe na magana cyenda mirongo irindwi na gatatu akaba yaravuye mu gukina bitewe nuko imyaka ye yaritakimwemerera ariko, Ubungubu Ryan giggs asigaye akora ibyerekeranye na business ye yakoze ariko bitavanyemo ko akiba mubuzima bwumupira w'amaguru kuko ikipe ya Salford city.

Teafale Marquise Lenard Jr. (yavutse ku ya 21 Nyakanga 2002) ni umukinnyi ukina Basketball akaba umunyamerika w'abigize umwuga wakiniye ikipe ya APR ya mu mikino ya shampiyona nya furika ya Basketball (BAL).
Teafale yakinnye bwa mbere mu ikipe ya Texas muri NBA, aho yinjiye mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2023-24. Yatsinze amanota 10.2 na ribandi 3.9 mu myaka ibiri yamaze muri iyo kipe.
Lenard yinjiye mu ikipe ya Afurika y'Epfo ya MBB mu mwaka wa 2025 wa shampiyona nya furika ya Basketball (BAL). Ku ya 20 Gicurasi 2025, yatsinze amanota 39 menshi cyane mu ikipe ya MBB ubwo yatsindwaga na Al Ahli. Yatsinze shampiyona mu gutsinda amanota 22.7 kuri buri mukino, ndetse no mu kwiba amanota 3.5 kuri buri mukino. Yanatsinze impuzandengo ya 7.3 rebounds na 2.7 blocks kuri buri mukino. Ku ya 14 Kamena, Lenard yashyizwe mu ikipe ya kabiri ya sitari ba BAL.
Muri Gashyantare 2026, Lenard yinjiye mu ikipe ya APR yo mu Rwanda mbere y'umwaka w'imikino wa shampiyona ya BAL wa 2026.
Lenard ni umuhungu wa Ashley Lenard na Teafale Lenard, Sr., kandi afite abavandimwe babiri. Umukinnyi akunda cyane ni Kobe Bryant.

Dane Miller Jr. (yavutse ku ya 10 Gicurasi 1990) ni umukinnyi ukina basketball ukomoka muri amerika wa kiniye APR BBC yo muri shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball (BAL). Yatoranyijwe mu ikipe ya mbere ya bakinnyi beza muri 2023, ubwo yakiniraga ikipe ya SLAC.
Miller Jr. yakiniye mu ikipe ya Rutgers mugihe cy'imyaka ine. Yashyizwe mu ikipe ya Big Rookie muri 2010.
Ku ya 15 Kanama 2020, Miller yasinye amasezerano na Snæfell wo muri shampiyona y a Icelande.
Muri Gicurasi 2025, Miller yinjiye muri APR BBC mu mwaka w'imikino wa shampiyona wo muri 2025 wa BAL, umwaka we wa kane wikurikiranya wa BAL.

Isaiah Miller Jr. (yavutse ku ya 9 Ugushyingo 1997) ni umukinnyi w’umunyamerika w abigize umwuga mu ikipe ya Austin yo muri shampiyona ya basketbal ya NBA. Yakinnye Basketball yo muri kaminuza mu ikipe ya Greensboro Spartans.
Ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2024, Miller yasinye amasezerano na APR muri shampiyona ya Basketball y'u Rwanda na ndetse aza gukina na shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball. Muri Kanama, APR yegukanye igikombe cya mbere cya Basketball y'u Rwanda bari kumwe, nyuma y'uko Miller yatsinze amanota 43 ku mukino wa nyuma bahanganye na REG BBC.
Ku ya 23 Nzeri 2024, Miller na APR begukanye igikombe cya RBL nyuma yo gutsinda Patriots ku mukino wa 6. Miller yatorewe kuba umukinnnyi mwiza w'irushanwa mu mikino ya nyuma.

Youssou Ndoye (yavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga 1991) ni umukinnyi w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Senegal. Yakinnye Basketball muri Kaminuza mu ikipe ya Bonaventure iwabo. Anakinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Senegali ndetse yabaye na Kapiteni wayo.
mu mashuri yisumbuye.
Ndoye yakinnye basketball mu m'amashuri yisumbuye muri cademi y'i Lee, mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri. yatsinze mesnhi kuri buri mukino, yashyizwe mu byiciro by'amashuri abanza mu ishuri rye ajya muri kaminuza.
Ku ya 23 Mata 2025, Ndoye yinjiye mu ikipe ya APR BBC yo mu shampiyona ya basketbal yu Rwanda (BAL). Ndoye yafashije APR kurangiza ku mwanya wa gatatu mu mwaka wa 2025, gusa yashyizwe mu ikipe ya kabiri ya nziza. Yatsinze amanota 9 na ribandi 6.8 muri shampiyona. Ku ya 18 Kamena.
Ku ya 12 Nyakanga 2025, Ndoye yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda (RBL) ari kumwe na APR, nyuma yo gutsinda REG BBC mu mukino wa nyuma. Yatsinze amanota 26 menshi, ndetse na ribandi 7 na n'imipira 3 mu mukino wa 5 ukomeye, nyuma yaho barangije batsinze. Ndoye yagizwe umukinnyi w’indashyikirwa mu iryo rushanwa.
Ndoye akinira ikipe y'igihugu ya Senegal, ndetse no muri shampiyona ya furika muri 2017 na 2021, yegukana umudari, ndetse no mu gikombe cy'isi cya Basketball cy o muri 2019.

Obadiah Arthur Noel (yavutse ku ya 28 Kamena 1999) ni umukinnyi w’umunyamerika w'abigize umwuga ukina mu APR BBC ya shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball (BAL) na shampiyona yu Rwanda ya Basketball (RBL). Yakinnye Basketball ya kaminuza ya umass.
Noel yatangiriye mu ikipe ya Tampa mu rwego rwo kwitegura imikino ya NBA yo muri 2021. Yashyizwe mu ikipe ya beza nyuma yo gutsinda amanota 14, imipira ribandi 2.8.
Ku ya 19 Mata 2024, Noel yasinye amasezerano na APR bbc yo muri shampiyona ya Basketball y'u Rwanda ba kinana na shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball. Noel yakinnye bwa mbere muri kimwe cya kabiri cy'irushanwa ryo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi maze atsinda amanota 26, imipira 7 yo kwiruka n'imipira 3 yo gupagasa REG.

Anunwa Nuni Omot (yavutse ku ya 3 Ukwakira 1994) ni umukinnyi w'abigize umwuga ukomoka muri Sudani y'Epfo ukina mu ikipe ya Beirut yo muri shampiyona Lebanese. Yakinnye kandi muri Basketball ya kaminuza muri Bayilore nyuma y'imyaka ibiri ajya muri Kaminuza ya Concorudiya.
Muri Gicurasi 2025, Omot yinjiye muri APR BBC aho yatwaye igikombe cy'u Rwanda mbere y'imikino ya nyuma ya BAL yo mu 2025, yongera gusubira muri shampiyona nyafurika ya Basketball, nyuma y'umwaka umwe atakiyikinamo.

Fiacre Ntwari yavutse ku ya 25 Nzeri 1999, avukira i Kigali ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda ukina nk'umunyezamu akaba afite uburebure bungana na 1.94m. Kuva mu 2023, yakiniye TS Gaxy FC.
Ntwari Fiacre yatangiye umupira w'amaguru muri Intare FC, Mu mwaka wa 2016, yakinnye bwa mbere mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'u Rwanda. Mu 2017, yerekeje muri APR FC yo mu cyiciro cya mbere. Muri 2017/2018 na 2019/2020, yatwaye igikombe cy'u Rwanda ari kumwe nabo, naho mu mwaka wa 2018/2019, aba uwa kabiri muri shampiyona y'u Rwanda. Mu 2020, yinjiye muri Marines FC, naho mu 2021 yinjiye muri AS Kigali FC. Mu mwaka wa 2021/2022, yatwaye igikombe cy'u Rwanda ari kumwe na AS Kigali. Mu 2023, yerekeje muri TS Galaxy FC.
Fiacre Ntwari yitabiriye umukino we wa mbere mu ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2021, ubwo yatsindwaga na Kenya ibitego 1-2 mu mikino yo guhatanira itike yo gukina igikombe cy'isi cya 2022, yabereye i Nairobi muri Kenya.

Chasson Randle (yavutse ku ya 5 Gashyantare 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina basketball ukomoka muri amerika w'abigize umwuga mu ikipe ya Rodou wo muri shampiyona ya Basketball y’Abagereki. Yakinnye basketball muri kaminuza muri Sitanforode. Ari mu mwaka wa nyuma w’amashuri yisumbuye mu 2014-15, yafatwaga nk'umwe mu bakinnyi bakomeye mu gihugu.
Stockton Kings (2024–2025).
Ku ya 30 Ukuboza 2024, Randle yagurishijwe muri sitoke Kingi mu irushanwa ry’amakipe atatu ryahuje Isilande Nete, Iowa ihabwa Amari Bailey wo muri Long Island naho Long Island igura Timme wo muri sitoke.
Ku ya 23 Mata 2025, Randle yasinye amasezerano na APR BBC muri Rwanda, aho yinjiye muri shampiyona nyafurika ya basketball (BAL).

Jean Jacques Boissy (yavutse ku ya 28 Mutarama 2000) ni umukinnyi ukinaumukino wa Basketball wo muri Senegal. Akina muri garde, yarangije muri academe ya Afurika yakinnye nk'umukinnyi w'abigize umwuga kuva muri 2021. Boissy yegukanye shampiyona y'afurika ya BAL muri 2025, akaba yari MVP muri uwo mwaka. Yanabaye umukinnyi w’ikipe ya mbere nziaza ya BAL inshuro ebyiri. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Boissy akinira ikipe y’igihugu ya Senegali kuva muri 2022, ndetse ayobora ikipe ye itwara umudari muri shampiyona ya furika 2025.
Muri Mutarama 2025, Boissy yasinye amasezerano na REG BBC yo muri shampiyona y'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda, agaruka muri shampiyona ku nshuro ya mbere mu myaka ine. Ku ya 22 Werurwe 2025, yatsinze amanota 32, hamwe na rebounds 7 na assists 6, atsinda Patriots mu gihembwe gisanzwe cya RBL. Ku ya 30 Mata 2025, Boissy yatsinze amanota 37 menshi cyane mu gihembwe batsinze Orion.

Cleveland Joseph Pancake Thomas Jr. (yavutse ku ya 2 Ukuboza 1993) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Basketball ukomoka muri amerika w'abigize umwuga muri shampiyona ya Basketball y’u Rwanda.
Muri Nyakanga 2023, yinjiye mu ikipe ya Dorados yo muri mexike.
Muri Gushyingo 2023, Thomas yinjiye kuri Pazi BBC muri Tanzaniya.
Thomas yakuye izina rya Pancake arikura kuri nyirakuru, wavuze ko inda ya nyina yari imeze nk'ipapayi mu gihe yari atwite. Ni umuntu ukunda ku ndwara umutwe kandi ashyigikira abantu ku bijyanye no kwiheba

Keanau Dennis Post (yavutse ku ya 4 Nzeri 1992) ni umukinnyi ukora basketball ukomoka mu gihugu cya Canada. Yakinnye basketball muri kaminuza ndetse no mu ikipe ya Ilinoyise.
Post yatangiriye amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rikuru rya Oak Bay aho yakiniraga umutoza mukuru Josh Elsdon. Yatsinze amanota 12.5 mu mikino ya shampiyona muri Oak Bay, anayobora ikipe ye mu irushanwa rya Regionale shampiyona ryo muri 2009-10, ahita ahabwa umwanya wa mwiza mu irushanwa. Mu mwaka we wa nyuma w'amashuri yisumbuye, yimukiye muri Westwind Academy.
Muri Nzeri 2021, Post yinjiye muri REG BBC yo mu shamiyona ya basketball yu Rwanda. Yafashije ikipe kwegukana shampiyona yabo ya kabiri.
Ku ya 23 Gashyantare 2022, Post yinjiye muri Taiwan ya Beer muri shampiyona ya basketball ya super.

Pitchou Kambuy Manga (yavutse ku ya 12 Ukuboza 1988) ni umukinnyi ukina umukino wa Basketball ukomoka muri Congo ukinira ikipe ya Tigers BBC iri muri shampiyona yu Rwanda ya Basketball. Anakinira ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball y’abagabo ya repubulika iharanira demukarasi ya Kongo.
Kuva muri 2011, Kambuy Manga yakiniye Mazembe kandi yakinnye inshuro nyinshi mu gikombe cya afurika ari kumwe niyi kipe.
Muri Gashyantare 2022, yinjiye muri REG BBC ya shampiyona ya Basketball y'u Rwanda Yashyizwe mu ikipe ya mbere ya mberenziza mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2021-22. Afatanyije na REG, Kambuy Manga yakinnye bwa mbere muri shampiyona ya Basketball yu Rwanda. Ku ya 14 Werurwe 2022, akaba yaratsinze amanota 16.

Abdoulaye N'Doye (yavutse ku ya 9 Werurwe 1998) ni umukinnyi ukora umukino wa Basketball w'abigize umwuga ukomoka m'ubufaransa wakiniraga ikipe ya basketball ya sartehe.
Ku itariki ya 5 Kanama 2020, N'Doye yasinye amasezerano na ikipe ya Monaco muri Pro.
Ku itariki ya 29 Nzeri 2021, yasinye amasezerano na BCM muri shampiyona ya LNB Pro.
