Ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'urubyiruko ya Muhoroni ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ikomoka muri Muhoroni, muri Kenya, ariko ikina imikino yayo yanyuma kuri sitade y'igihugu ya Nyayo i Nairobi. Ubirahatanira shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Kenya, aho yazamuwe nyuma yogutsinda shampiyona ya shampiyona ya KFF Nationwide ya 2011.
Ingimbi za Muhoroni zegukanye igikombe cya mbere muri 2016.

Ikipe ya cricket yo muri Afuganisitani yakoreye uruzinduko muri Kenya kuva kuya 2 kugeza kuya 11 Ukwakira 2010. Urugendo rwari rugizwe n'umukino umwe w'igikombe cya Intercontinental na ODI eshatu. Kenya yatsinze Afghanistan 2-1 mumukino wa ODI.

Sitade ya Afraha ni sitade ifite intego nyinshi i Nakuru, muri Kenya. Ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandini sitade ya Nakuru AllStars yo muri Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza ya Kenya na Ulinzi Stars yomuri Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza ya Kenya. Iyi sitade yakira abantu 8.200 yafunguwe muwi 1948.

Bandari Football Club ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yomuri Kenya ifite icyicaro i Mombasa. Iyi kipe ikinira imikino yayo ya mbere kukibuga cya Mbaraki Sports Club na sitade ya Mombasa County (iyi yanyuma ifite imyanya y'imyanya ingana inshuro enye), kandi ubu iri mw' irushanwa rya shampiyona ya Kenya nyuma yokurangiza shampiyona ya FKF Division One ya 2012 nk'ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya Zone A.
Iyikipe yakinnye kuva muwi 1960 kugeza muwi 1978 yitwa LASCO Football Club, ikurikirwa n'imyaka umunani yitwa Cargo Football Club. Muwi 1985, iyi kipe yifatanyije n'ikipe ya Kenya Ports Authority maze ishinga Bandari FC.
Iyi kipe yari yarakinnye mbere muri shampiyona ya Kenya, ariko yamanukaga nyuma y’umwaka w’imikino wi 1997. Bandari yabaye iyakabiri mumakipe yambere ya KPL 2017, 2018, inatwara igikombe cya KPL SportPesa Supercup 2018, bituma ibona umwanya wokujya mucyiciro cya CAF CONFEDERATION CUP.
Ikipe ya Dockers yakinnye na Al Ahly Shendi yomuri Sudani maze banganya 0-0 ku kibuga cyayo mbere yo kunganya na Shendi 1-1 mukibuga cyayo muri Sudani, bakuraho ikipe ifite icyicaro muri Sudani. Mu cyiciro cya kabiri, bashyizwe hamwe na US Ben Guardane womuri Tuniziya, maze bayikuraho muburyo nk'ubwo Ikipe yasezerewe muwi 1999. Yongeye kubyutswa mu 2004, iva mu makipe yohasi isubira muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere. Iyikipe yageze kumukino wa nyuma mu gikombe cya Kenya muwi 1986 ariko itsindwa na Gor Mahia (yabashije kwegukana igikombe cya Afurika cy'abatsinze inatsinda irushanwa).

Ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Maasai (MFF), rizwi kandi kw' izina ry'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Maasai, niryo shyirahamwe riyobora umupira w'amaguru mu baturage b'Abamasai bomuri Kenya na Tanzaniya. Icyicaro gikuru cyaryo kiri i Kiserian, muri Kenya.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru ryashinzwe muwi 2006, ryabaye umunyamuryango w’Inama Nshya y’Amashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Werurwe uwomwaka. Perezida waryo ubu ni Godfrey Ole Ntapatia, naho Solomon Kisemei Ntooki akaba umunyamabanga mukuru waryo.
Ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ya MFF igenzura ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ihagarariye Abamasai, ikoresha Sitade ya Talek nk’ikibuga cyayo cyambere, itarakina umukino uwari wowose mpuzamahanga, cyangwa ngoyinjire mu gikombe cy’isi cya Viva. Iyikipe yagombaga kwitabira iki gikombe cyayo cyo mu 2008, ariko ntiyashoboye kubikora kubera impamvu zitazwi.

Mahakama Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Yakinnye murwego rwo hejuru rw'umupira w'amaguru w'ababigize umwuga muri Kenya, shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Kenya, ariko yamanukaga muri 2008. Yashinzwe muri 2000 kandi ni iy'Ubucamanza bwa Kenya ("Mahakama" ni Igiswahili mu "gifaransa").
Muri 2009 ikipe yatwaye igikombe cya Nationwide League, yongera kuzamurwa muri Premier League.

Mara Sugar Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ifite icyicaro mu Karere ka Narok, muri Kenya. Iyikipe ubiri mu irushanwa rya shampiyona ya Kenya, ikinira imikino yayo yambere ku kibuga cya sitade ya Sony Awendo Green kandi iterwa inkunga na Transmara Sugar Company.

Mathare United Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'umwuga ikorera i Nairobi, muri Kenya. Iyi kipe yakinnye muri Shampiyona y'Icyiciro cya Mbere cya Kenya (icyiciro cyohejuru cya shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru ya Kenya), ariko muri 2023, iyikipe yamanuriwe mucyiciro cyakabiri, National Super League. Yashinzwe muwi 1994, Mathare United yegukanye igikombe cyayo cya mbere cya shampiyona mu mwaka wa 2008. Iyi kipe ikina imikino yayo yanyuma mu kigo mpuzamahanga cya siporo cya Moi i Kasarani.
2009 - Icyiciro cy'ibanze
2002 - Icyiciro cya mbere
1999 - Icyiciro cya Kabiri
2001 - Icyiciro cya mbere
Mathare Urubyiruko F.C. yabaye ikipigaburira Mathare United kugeza yazamuwe muri Premier League, ahoyabaye mukeba. Muri Kanama 2012, itsinda ryasheshwe. Shampiyona yiyi kipe yatewe inkunga na Triple5Bet, isosiyete ikora siporo muri Kenya.
Iyikipe ifite kandi ishami ry’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore ryitwa Mathare United Ladies' Football Club, ubikaba irushanwa muri shampiyona y’abagore ya Kenya.

Ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'urubyiruko ya Mathare yari ikipe ifite icyicaro i Nairobi muri Kenya. Yakinnye muri Shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cya Kenya ariko imanuka muri 2008. Yaherukaga kwitabira shampiyona ya FKF, icyiciro cyagatatu cy'umupira w'amaguru muri Kenya.
Iyikipe yari iy'ishyirahamwe ry'urubyiruko rwa siporo rya Mathare. Iyikipe yarikipe ifasha Mathare United, kugeza igihe Mathare Youth yazamuwe muri Premier League.
Kw' itariki ya 31 Kanama 2012, ikipe yarasenyutse bityo ivamu cyiciro cya mbere cya FKF mu 2012, hanyuma ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru muri Kenya rifata icyemezo cyo gusesa ibyavuye mu cyiciro cya kabiri byose. Ibi bivuze kamakipe yose yakinnye nayo yakuweho amanota cyangwa agasubizwa amanota yayo, bitewe n’ibyavuye mumikino, kandi imikino yose yari iteganyijwe yasubitswe.

Mean Machine RFC nikipe y’ishyirahamwe ry’abakina umupira w’amaguru i Nairobi muri Kenya. Ni uruhande ruhagarariye Kaminuza ya Nairobi kandi yashinzwe muwi 1977 mu gihe ishyirahamwe ry’abakina umupira w’amaguru muri Kenya ryakinwaga cyane n’abazungu n’abanyamahanga. Iyi kipe irimo abanyeshuri beza muri Kenya binjira muriyi kaminuza kandi baturuka mubigo bitandukanye bya Kaminuza nka Main Campus, Chiromo Campus, Parklands Campus, Lower Kabete Campus, Upper Kabete Campus, Kenya Science Campus ndetse na Mombasa Campus. Mumwaka wabo wambere, batwaye igikombe cya Kenya. Mean Machine yanatwaye shampiyona ya KRU inshuro ebyiri, muri 2018 na 2022 ndetse inatwara shampiyona yambere ya Varsity Cup League. Mumyaka ya 1980, iyi kipe yahatiwe gufungwa kubera igitutu cya politiki nyuma y’igerageza rya coup d'état ryo mu 1982, kandi abakinnyi benshi bagombaga gukinira andi makipe.

Mombasa United Fc nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ifite icyicaro i Mombasa muri Kenya. Iyikipe ubu iri mw' irushanwa rya shampiyona y'igihugu ya Kenya.
Iyikipe yahoze yitwa Magongo Rangers, yaguze izina ryayo ubu muri 2013 nyuma y'amasezerano y'ubuterankunga na The Modern Coast Company.
Ikipe ubu ikinira imikino yayo yanyuma ku kibuga cya Refinery.

Mt Kenya United Football Club ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'ababigize umwuga i Nairobi muri Kenya. Iyikipe ubu iri mw' irushanwa rya shampiyona ya Kenya nyuma yogutsindira itike yokuva muri Kenyan National Super League iriku mwanya wakabiri inyuma ya Posta Rangers.
Iyikipe yahinduye izina ryayo iva kuri Nakumatt ijya kuri Mt Kenya United mu Gushyingo 2018.

Sitade ya Muhoroni yahoze yitwa "Sitade ya Biafra" ni sitade ifite intego nyinshi i Muhoroni, muri Kenya. Yakoreshwaga cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi nisitade y'ikipe ya Muhoroni Youth yomuri Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza kuva muri 2012.
Iyisitade icumbikira abantu 20.000 kandi niya "Muhoroni Youth Football Club". Umufatanyabikorwa wa Clubs Champion ni Muhoroni Sugar Company yatanze ubutaka kubaturage. Nubwo iyi sosiyete mugucunga ubwishingizi bw'amasosiyete nuruganda rukora "Brown Sugar" rukomokamo "isukari ya Muhoroni".

Nemanja Milošević (yavutse ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1987) ni umukinnyi wa basketball ukina nku wabigize umwuga muri mu gihugu cya Montenegine ndetse akaba yarakiniye na ikipe ya UGB BBC yo mu Rwanda.
Umwuga w'ubunyamwuga.
Milošević yatangiye umwuga we mu gihugu cye cy'amavuko, mu ikipe ya Podigorica ndetse banatwarana igikombe cya shampiyona.
Mu 2012, yasinye amasezerano na Mornar Bar. Mu Gushyingo 2012, yavuye i Mornar asinya amasezerano muri Bulugariya.
Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2017, Milošević yasinye amasezerano n'ikipe yo muri Rumaniya yitwa ya CSM mu mwaka w'imikino wa 2017-18.

Patrick Ronald Rembert (yavutse ku ya 9 Mata 1990) ni umukinnyi w’abigize umwuga wa Basketball ukomoka muri amerika wakiniye ikipe ya United Generation Basketball (UGB BBC) muri Shampiyona y’a basketaball Rwandakandi yakinnye basketball ya kaminuza muri UC kuva 2007 kugeza 2011.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo, ku ya 7 Kanama 2011, Rembert yasinye amasezerano na Šentjur wo muri shampiyona A yo solovakiya. Ubwo yari mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza muri UC mu mwaka wa 2011-12, Rembert yatsinze amanota 12.2, agatsinda 3.3 na 3.3 byatanze imipira mu minota 33.1 mu mikino 32 yakinnye.
Ku ya 12 Ukuboza 2017, Rebert yatsinze amanota 45 mu mukino batsinzwemo na Tadamon Zouk ku manota 110-93. Ku ya 4 Kanama 2018, yasinye amasezerano na Lukoil Levski.

Rwanda Basketball Cup ni igikombe cya Basketball mu Rwanda ahanini ni amarushanwa ya basketball mu ma kipe y'abagabo mu Rwanda. Iri rushanwa rigizwe n'amakipe yo muri shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda ndetse n'icyiciro cya cyiciro cya 2 cya basketball mu Rwanda. Iri rushanwa ryatangijwe mu 2024 na FERWABA, naho APR BBC ni yo yatsinze ku nshuro ya mbere.
Abatwaye iri rushanwa bemerewe kujya mu gikombe cya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, irushanwa ryateguwe na FIBA.
RWanad Basketball Cup ni irushanwa ry'igikombe ritangirana n'itsinda ry'amakipe yo muri shampiyona ya Basketball mu Rwanda ndetse n'icyiciro cya cyiciro cya 2 cya basketball mu Rwanda noneho uwatsinze buri tsinda akomeza imikino yo kwishyura, ikinwa mu buryo bwo gukuranamo. Imikino ya kimwe cya kabiri ndetse n'isoza ikorwa muri wikendi imwe, kandi umukino wa gatatu urakinwa.

Siporo y'urubyiruko nurwego rurimo gukura muri Afurika, harimo no mu bihugu nka Nijeriya na Senegali.
Hockey yo mu kibuga.
Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Hockey mur'Afurika ryagizigikombe cy'Afurika cy’abagabo n’icy’abagore kuva mu 1988.
Amakipe menshi y'igihugu y'Afurika y'abakiri bato n'ingimbi yitabiriyamarushanwa mpuzamahanga. Ayomarushanwa arimo:

Lutte Traditionnelle (mururimi rw'umwimerere "rw'Umukino wo Gusiganwa kuMagurugakondo") ni ubwoko bw'imikino yogusiganwa kumaguru yomur'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba, izwinka Laamb muri Senegali no muri Gambia, Evala muri Togo, na KoKowa / Kokawa mu turere twa Hausa muri Nijeriya na Nijeriya, cyangwa "Lutte Traditionnelle" gusa, muri Nijeriya na Burkina Faso. Irushanwa mpuzamahanga riba mu gihe cya Jeux de la Francophonie na.
Kuvamumyaka ya 1950, imigenzo myinshi yomur' Afurika y'Iburengerazuba yashyizwe muri Lutte Traditionnelle kuko yabaye imikino ikomeye y'abareba n'ibirori by'umuco. Itandukaniro rikomeye ryabaye Laamb, cyangwa imikino yo gusiganwa muri Senegal, yemerera gutera ibipfunsi ("frappe"), ari yo yonyine mu mico yo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba yabikoze. Kuberakwishyirahamwe rinini n'ubukombe bya Lutte Traditionnelle byateye imbere kuva mu myaka ya 1990, abarwanyi ba Senegal ububakora imyitozoyombi, yitwa "Lutte Traditionnelle sans frappe" (kuri verisiyo mpuzamahanga) na "Lutte Traditionnelle avec frappe" kuri verisiyo ikomeye.
Muri Nijeriya, nomuturere twa Hausa muri Nijeriya, Kokawa yahindutse iyemewe kurwego rwa Afurika y'Iburengerazuba. Ahoniho igice cyoguterana cyashyizwe mwirushanwa ryihariye ryitwa Dambe. Byombi bikinirwa kumpande imwegakondo, nubwo Dambe yabaye ububiko bw'amatsinda y'abarwanyi bagenda.
Abarwanyi babiribarushanwa muruziga, mubirori byemewe bihambiriwe n'imifuka y'umucanga. Buri murwanyi agerageza gusohora undimuruziga, nubwo bashobora gutsinda bakubita undihasi cyangwa bakamutera imipira ine.
Umuryango mpuzamahanga.
Lutte Traditionnelle yakomeje kwiyongera mumiterere nogukundwa mubice byinshi by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba kuvamumyaka ya 1980. Hamwe n'amarushanwa y'ibihugu mu bihugu byinshi, imiryango myinshi yateguye amarushanwa mpuzamahanga, ibyo bikaba byarasabye guhuza amategeko. Amarushanwa mpuzamahanga abamugihe cya Jeux de la Francophonie kandi kuva mu 2000, agenzurwa n'urwego ruhuza amakipe rutegura. Mu 2008, Umuryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (ECOWAS) wateguye shampiyona mpuzamahanga ya mbere ya Lutte Traditionnelle i Dakar, utumira amakipe aturutse mu bihugu cumi n'umwe: Senegal, Mali, Nijeri, Nijeri, Burkina Faso, Gineya, Gambia, Guinée Bissau, Togo, Liberiya na La Côte d'Ivoire. Nijeria yatsinze irushanwa, ari na ryo rya mbere igihugu cy'Abongereza (hanze ya Gambia) gitsindiye irushanwa rikomeye rya Lutte.
Inzirayokwimukira muri Kanada yatumye abangavu b'abimukira bamenyera imikinoyogusiganwa muri Senegali, Mali na Mauritaniya mu mikino yo gusiganwa muri Kanada, ifite aho ihuriye n'imikino yo ku mugabane w'Amerika.

Harimikino gakondo itandukanye mur'Afurika. Irimubwoko butandukanye bwogusiganwa ku maguru, gusimbuka, kurwana inkoni, kubyina, imikino y’ukwezi n’imihango, koga, gusiganwa ku mafarashi, no gukirana, ndetse n’imikino yo ku kibaho n’imikino y’urusimbi.
Inkomoko n'ubwoko bwayo.
Mugihecyambere y’ubukoloni, abitabiraga imikinongororamubiri bashoboraga kugiricyubahiro, umwirondoro, n’ububasha. Harubwoko bumweburimo gusiganwa kumaguru, gusimbuka, kurwana inkoni, kubyina, urumuri rw’ukwezi n’imikino y’imihango, koga, gusiganwa ku mafarashi, no gusiganwa ku maguru. Murikigihe cyanyuma, abitabiriye bakundaga guhagararira umudugudu wabo cyangwa akarere kabo, bitoza kuva bakiri bato ibikorwa binini by’umuryango. Ubuhanga mu mikorere bwakunze kujyana no guhiga, imirimo yo kuragira, gukusanya ibiryo, n’abarwanyi. Mu bice bimwe na bimwe by’umugabane siporo yafatwaga nk’iy’ingenzi cyane, mu bindi bitari ibyo, urugero muri Setswana umukino wa hafi bivuze "umukino utari uw’ingenzi". Gusiganwa ku bwato byari bikunze kugaragara ku ruzi rwa Ubangi muri Afurika yo Hagati, kandi abarwanyi bakoraga imiheto, gutera amacumu, no gusiganwa ku nka. Siporo yari isanzwe ari iy’abagabo, kandi ahanini yabuzaga abagore, uretse mu mbyino, no mu bihe bimwe na bimwe gusiganwa ku maguru.: 41 Ariko imikino myinshi gakondo ntiyanditswe neza kandi yatsinzwe.
Urusimbi rwarirusanzwe kandirwakunze gukinwa kuburyo bukomeye, ahwimikino yasobanurwaga muburyo bujyanye n'ikirere. Uturere twakunzwe cyane ninkombe za Guinée na Afurika yo Hagati, ariko ubusanzwe rwarangwaga n'ibanga.: 47–8
Ubutegetsi bw’abakoloni bwabonaga kwaguka kwa siporo z’i Burayi nk’ingenzi ku " butumwa bwazo bwo guteza imbere umuco ", kandimikino myinshigakondo yarazimye. Inzego z’uburezi bw’abakoloni zashyizeho gahunda yo kwigisha siporo zomu Burengerazuba bw’isi, byatekerezwaga ko zishyira imbere "imico myiza", mugihe siporo gakondo yafatwaga nk' "iya kera, iy’ubusambanyi, kandi irwanya Ubukristo". Hari aho amashuri y’ivugabutumwa yashyigikiraga imikino gakondo yarifite amakipe y’i Burayi yahafi. Irushanwa ry’abatutsi "ryo" gusimbuka hejuru ryarubahwaga n’abakoloni. Imikino y’urusimbi nka "abbia" muri Kameruni yarahagaritswe.: 50
Mugihe cyanyuma y’ubukoloni, imikinoyomu Burengerazuba yashyizwe imberecyanekurusha imikino gakondo. Uburezi bw’imyitozo ngororamubiri murikigihe buracyashingiye ahanini ku buryo bw’ubukoloni/ubw’iburengerazuba, kandi imikino gakondo ntabwo ikunze gushyirwa mu nteganyanyigisho. Ntamikino gakondo ibaho mumikino y'Afurika. Ishyirahamwe ry’Imikino gakondo n’Imikino muri Afurika (ATSGC), ishami ry’Inama Mpuzamahanga y’Imikino gakondo n’Imikino (ICTSG), rigamije kurinda imikino gakondo muri Afurika, kandi imikino gakondo ya mbere muri Afurika iteganijwe kubera i Swakopmund, muri Namibiya muri Kamena 2026.
Imikino itari iyo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri.
Mancala yakinwe kugabane wose, kandi ifite amazina n'uburyo butandukanye, ku buryo yitwa "umukino w'igihugu wa Afurika".: 17

Komisiy'ishinzwe siporo ya Leta ya Lagos (LSSC) n'ikigo cy’ingenzi cya leta gishinzwe iterambere n’imicungire ya siporo muri Leta ya Lagos, muri Nijeriya.
Komisiyo ya Siporo ya Leta ya Lagos yashyizweho binyuze mu'itegeko (EO/AA01) kuya 17 Kamena 2015 na Akinwunmi Ambode, Guverineri wa Leta ya Lagos. Komisiyo yavuye mubiro bya siporo bya Minisiteri y'Urubyiruko, Siporo n'Iterambere ry'Imibereho Myiza (MYSSD) n'Inama Njyanama ya Siporo ya Leta ya Lagos. Amategeko agenga iyikomisiyo yashyizweho ubwo Guverineri yashyiragaho umukono kwitegeko riyigenga kuya 1 Gashyantare 2017. Ku ya 2 Gashyantare 20204, Guverineri wa Leta ya Lagos, Babajide Sanwo-Olu, yashyizeho Lekan Fatodu nk'umuyobozi mukuru wa Komisiyo ya Siporo ya Leta ya Lagos.
Ibikoresho bya siporo.
Amashyirahamwe y'imikino.
Komisiyigenzura amashyirahamwe 44 y’imikino, ashinzwe cyanecyane iterambere ry’imikino yo mu nzego z’ibanze.

Kudu dung-spitting (Bokdrol Spoeg mururimi rw'ikinyafurika) ni siporo ikorwa n'umuryango w'aba-Afrikaner mur'Afurika y'Epfo. Muri iryo rushanwa, uduce duto tw'amase y'impala zo mu bwoko bwa kudu turavurwa, aho intera ya kure cyane ari yo itsinda.
Gutera amacandwe kumatungo ya Kudu birakunzwe cyane kuburyo habahirushanwa ry’isi ngarukamwaka, aho siporo yemewe yatangiye mu 1994. Amarushanwa abera mumasoko amwe n’amwe y’abaturage, mu maserukiramuco y’imikino cyangwa mu birori by’ubukerarugendo mu bihuru, Natal na Cape y’Iburasirazuba. Bitandukanye n’imikino myinshi isa nayo, intera ipimwa uhereye ku kimenyetso ugera aho amacandwe ahagarara, aho kuba aho yatangiriye kugwa.
Agahigo k'isi muri uyumukino ni yashyizweho as of 2006 na Shaun van Rensburg wo muri Addo. Agahigo k'abagabo mu Bwongereza gafitwe na Dave Marshall kuri miliyoni 11.7 mu 2022, umukobwa we Harri akaba ari we wongeye kugiragahigo k'abagore kuri miliyoni 8.3 mu 2022. Bivugwa ko abahigi batangiye gukoresha utu duti mu marushanwa yo gucira amacandwe kugira ngo "bihorere" kumuhigo wabo, kuko kudu arinyamaswa isanzwe igoyeguhiga, kandi izwiho gusiga inzira y'utundi duti mugihe yashoboraga guhungumuhigi.
Harikandi inyandiko zigaragaza uburyo bwogutema amacandwe mu biti bya cherry, gutema imbuto z'imvura, gutema amacandwe mu biti bya prune, gutema amacandwe mu biti bya cricket y'umukara no gutema amacandwe mu mutobe w'itabi. Mu 2015, hashyizwehamarushanwa yogutema amacandwe y'intama mu Iserukiramuco rya Lady of The Lake ryabereye muri County Fermanagh muri Irilande y'Amajyaruguru.

Harahantu henshi hogukinira murubura mubihugu by'Afurika hakoreshwa muri hockey yomu rubura. Abakunda imikino bagiye bashinga amakipe y'ibihugu mu bihugu bitandukanye kandi hateganijwe igikombe cya mbere cy'ibihugu bya Afurika cya hockey yo mu rubura mu 2009. ["Hakenewe isoko itari iy'ibanze"] Igikombe cya mbere cya Afurika cya Hockey ku rubura cyari giteganyijwe kubera muri Afurika y'Epfo hagati ya 19-26 Nzeri 2009. Imikino ya shampiyona yagombaga gukinirwa ku kibuga cy'urubura cya "Festival Shopping Centre" i Kempton Park. Ibihugu bihanganye byagombaga kuba Afurika y'Epfo, Maroc na Alijeriya. Ariko, irushanwa ryasubitswe kubera ko ibihugu byatumiwe bitakiriye neza kandi ntibyigeze bikina.
Mu 2014, abakinnyi b'Abanyamisiri ba Anubis Ice Hockey Team, ikipe yambere ya hockey yomu Misiri yatangiye gukina igikombe cya mbere cy' Afurika hamwe n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Royal Moroccan Ice Hockey Federation. Mu 2016, igikombe cya mbere cya Afurika cya Hockey Clubs Cup cyabereye i Rabat muri Maroc hagati ya tariki ya 24 na 31 Nyakanga. Shampiyona yakinwe hagati y'amakipe 6 yomu Misiri, Maroc, Tuniziya na Alijeriya. Amakipe ya Kenya, Libiya n'Afurika y'Epfo nayo yari yatumiwe ariko ntiyitabira. Iki gikombe cyatsinzwe n'ikipe ya Tuniziya.
Afurika y'Amajyepfo.
Mur'Afurika y'Epfo, uyumukino uyoborwan'Ishyirahamwe ry'Umukino wa Hockey ku Rubura muri Afurika y'Epfo. Ikipe y'igihugu ya Hockey ku Rubura muri Afurika y'Epfo yabayumunyamuryango w'Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Hockey ku Rubura (IIHF) kuva mu 1937 kandi ishobora kuba ari yo gihugu cya mbere cya Hockey ku Rubura kuri uyu mugabane aho abakinnyi bayo benshi banakina Hockey ku Rubura muri Amerika. Afurika y'Epfo yakinnye bwambere kurwego mpuzamahanga itsindwa na Yugoslavia ibitego 12-3 mu itsinda rya C mu irushanwa ry'Isi rya Hockey ku Rubura ryo mu 1961. Amakipe ya Super League yo mur'Afurika y'Epfo arimo Johannesburg Wildcats, Pretoria Capitals na Cape Town Kings.
Afurika y'Amajyaruguru.
Alijeriya yabayabanyamuryango ba IIHF ku ya 26 Nzeri 2019. Mur'Alijeriya hari ikibuga kimwe cy’urubura. Hockey yo mu rubura muri Alijeriya iyoborwa na Hockey muri Alijeriya. Alijeriya ubu ifite ikipe imwe ya Hockey, HC Alger Corsaires mur'Algiers n’ishuri rya Hockey muri Setif.
Misiri ifitahantu 11 hokurira urubura mumijyi 6 muntara esheshatu zitandukanye. ["Hakenewe isoko ritari iry'ibanze"]
Igihugu cya Maroc cyomumajyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'Afurika gifitamakipe menshi ya hockey yomurubura nka Capitals, Ifis na Falcons bakoresha ikibuga cy'ubucuruzi mwiduka rinini i Rabat. Hockey yomurubura iyoborwa muri Maroc n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Royal Moroccan, kugeza ubu rikaba ari umunyamuryango wungirije wa IIHF kuva mu 2010. Ikipe y'igihugu ya Maroc ya hockey yo mu rubura yahagarariye igihugu cyabo mugikombe cy'igikombe cya Hockey yo mu barabu cyo mu 2008, i Dubai.
Ikibuga cyambere cya Tuniziya cyogukinira kurubura kiri kukibuga cya Blue Ice muri resort ya Yasmine Hammamet. Ikipe y'igihugu ya Tuniziya ya Hockey irigushingwa n'umukinnyi wa Hockey wo mu Bufaransa witwa Ihab Ayed, kandi iyoborwa n'ishyirahamwe rya Hockey yo mu Rubura rya Tuniziya Ikipe ya Tuniziya 'Carthage Eagles' niyo yatwaye igikombe cyambere cya Afurika.
Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Mu 2005, ikibuga cy'urubura cy'izuba cyafunguwe muri Hoteli ya Panari i Nairobi, muri Kenya. ["Hakenewe isoko ritari iry’ibanze"] Amashuri menshi yomuri Kenya yagaragajeko ashishikajwe no gushinga amakipe ya hockey yomurubura. Abakinnyi ba hockey bo muri Djibouti bazwiho kwitabira imikino imwe n’imwe ya hockey yo mu rubura mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika.

Ghana Badminton n'urwego rw'igihugu ruyobora badminton muri Ghana. Bashinzwe guhagararira, guhuza, kuyobora, kwamamaza no guteza imbere siporo kubufatanye bwa hafi n'inzego zifitanye isano. Ishyirahamwe rya Ghana Badminton ryibanda ku marushanwa yo mu nzego z'ibanze ndetse no guteza imbere Abanya-Ghana kugira ngo bajye mu marushanwa mu mikino Olempike, imikino ya Commonwealth, n'imikino Paralempike. Ishyirahamwe ry'igihugu ryashinzwe mu 1962, rikorana n'abaterankunga b'ibigo kugira ngo bategure ibirori mugace batuyemo no guteza imbere abakinnyi b'abahanga, abayobozi ba tekiniki, n'abatoza.
Ishyirahamwe ry'Igihugu n'umunyamuryango washinze Ishyirahamwe ry'Umukino wa Badminton muri Afurika, rikaba n'umunyamuryangushamikiye ku Ishyirahamwe ry'Isi rya Badminton (BWF). Murwego rwoguteza imbere uyumukino, ritanga gahunda z'amashuri abanza, ayisumbuye, n'ayisumbuye, badminton y'inararibonye itangwa n'amashuri, amakipe y'abaturage n'ay'uturere, iterambere ry'ubutoza ku rwego rw'igihugu, n'ibikorwa by'ingenzi.
Kuva ryashingwa mu 1962, Ishyirahamwe rya Badminton ryo muri Ghana rimaze kugira abaperezida barindwi.

ESPN Africa (izina rya ESPN) n'umuyoboro w’imikino wa televiziyo yishyurwa muri Afurika ufitwe na ESPN Inc., ikigo gihuriweho na The Walt Disney Company (ifitimigabane ingana na 80%) na Hearst Communications (ifite 20%) isigaye, cyatangijwe mu 2008 nka Setanta Sports gisubizwa izina muri Kanama 2014 nka Fox Sports, gisimbura Setanta Sports na Setanta Action. Uyu muyoboro ukorera mur'Afurika yomunsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara mu Cyongereza n’Igifaransa. Mbere yaho wabonekaga mugihegito mu 2016 mu Giporutugali.
Iyi channel ikomoka ku sosiyete itanga uburenganzira bwogukina yashinzwe n'umunyamakuru wa siporo womur'Afurika y'Epfo Barry Lambert, wahoze ari TVAfrica, yitwa LIM Africa, yajekwitwa Setanta Africa nyuma y'amasezerano na Setanta yabahaye uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ikirango ndetse banashinga urubuga rwomur'Afurika muri Kanama 2008. Iyi channel yakabiri, Setanta Action, yatangiye mu Gushyingo 2012, itangaza indi mikino cyane cyane imikino yo kurwana. Iyi channels yaguzwe na Fox International Channels mu Gushyingo 2013, naho muri Kanama 2014, Setanta Africa iba Fox Sports naho Setanta Action iba Fox Sports 2. Ku ya 30 Kanama 2019, amezi menshi nyuma y'uko Disney iguzumutungo munini wa Fox wo mu kinyejana cya 21, iyi channels n'urubuga byashyizwe munsi y'ikirango cya ESPN.
Gahunda zayo zibanda cyanecyane kumupira w'amaguru womuri Eredivisie, Premiership ya Ecosse, Belgian Pro League na English Football League. Uyumuyoboro wamazigihe kinini utangaza amarushanwa yomur'Amerika y'Epfo ya Copa Libertadores na Copa Sudamericana muri Afurika kugeza ubwo uburenganzira bwemejwe mu 2017. ["Icyitonderwa kirakenewe"]
Nanonibiganiro: NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAA, PFL, NRL rugby league na Basketball Africa League.
Mbereyaho, nk'ikigocya Setanta Africa cyarigifitwe n'Abanya-Irlande, ikigo cyatangazaga umupira w'amaguru wa GAA, hamwe n'umupira w'amaguru wa League of Ireland.
Muri Kanama 2019, byatangajwe kururubuga ruzahindura izina rukamenyekana nka ESPN Africa ku ya 30 Kanama 2019, bitewe n'uko Disney yaguze sosiyete ya 21st Century Fox.

Mumyaka yashize, Cape Verde yazamutse cyane mubice byinshi by'imikino.
Umukino wambere watangiriye ku kirwa cya São Vicente mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, umwe mu mikino ya mbere yazanywe kuri icyo kirwa warumukino wa tenisi na golf wazanywe n'Abongereza n'abagenzi banyura muri Cape Verde. Nyuma wageze i Santiago ahumurwamukuru w'abakoloni wari uherereye na Sal.
Gukoresha umupira w'amaguru n'uw'ingufu mu kuzunguza mukirere (Windsurfing) byarushijeho kwiyongera mugukoreshwa nogukundwa muri Cape Verde muri iki gihe.
Umupira w'amaguru niwomukino ukunzwe cyane muri Cape Verde kandumaze imyakamyinshi ubaho. Muri iki gihe ni kimwe mubihugu bike bidakoresha uburyobusanzwe bwokugabana amakipe (urugero: Gambia, ikindi gihugu gito gikoresha uburyo bw'igihugu bwo kugabana amakipe kandi gifite amakipe y'icyiciro cya mbere n'icya kabiri), ikindi gihugu gito ni São Tomé na Príncipe gikoresha uburyo bumwe na Cape Verde, ariko uburyo Cape Verde yakoresheje kugeza mu myaka ya 1990 ifitimikino ya shampiyona y'igihugu gusa, uwatsinze buri kirwa yitabira shampiyona y'igihugu, rimwe na rimwe iyo uwatsinze ikirwayatwaye shampiyona kukoyatwaye igikombe cy'igihugu mu mwaka ushize w'imikino, ikipe ya kabiri yitabira, uwatsinze irushanwa ry'igihugu yitabira mu mwaka ukurikiyeho w'imikino. Icya mbere cyabaye mu 1953 kandi ni Shampiyona y'Abakoloni yabaye kugeza mu 1974 ubwo Cape Verde yari iyobowe na Porutugali. Nyuma y'uko Cape Verde yigenga mu 1975, yakoze icya mbere mu 1976, amarushanwa atatu ya shampiyona yarahagaritswe, icya mbere cyari ikibazo cyokubona uwatsinze uturutse muri Sotavento, muruwo mwaka, ibindi birwa byitabiriye shampiyona y'igihugu. Mindelense kandi niyifite ibikombe byinshi by’igihugu aho ifite 12.
Shampiyona y’akarere ya mbere yari São Vicente, iyambere yabaye mu 1938. Mindelense yegukanye ibikombe byinshi bigera kuri 48, ikaba ariyo shampiyona y’akarere kanini kurusha izindi zose ku isi. Shampiyona ya Santiago Island ni iya kabiri ishampiyona ya kera cyane kandi kuva mu 2001 no kumugaragaro kuva mu 2003, yagabanyijwemo ibice bibiri. Harishampiyona 11 mu birwa 9, bibiri biri mu turere tw’Amajyaruguru n’Amajyepfo. Cape Verde ifite amakipe y’umupira w’amaguru arenga 100. Shampiyona y’ingimbi ibera mubirwa byinshi.
Igihugugifite kandi igikombe, igikombe cya super cup n'irushanwa rifungura muri buri karere, Santiago North Zone ntabwo ifite aya marushanwa. Ikigocya Cape Verdean Cup cyabaye ku nshuro ya mbere mu 2007, cyabaye inshuro enye kugeza mu 2012, nyuma kirahagarikwa. Uwatwaye igikombe muri buri kirwa yakinnye. Maio yakinnye kabiri naho Brava yakinnye rimwe. Santiago North ntiyigeze irushanwa. Haramarushanwa 11 y'ibikombe, Santiago North ntayifite, Santo Antão ifite Zone zombi zombi zomumajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo kandi kuva mu 2016, ku rwego rw'akarere.
Irushanwa rya Cape Verdean Super Cup ryabaye mu 2013, rikaba ryarabaye kunshuro yambere, shampiyona yariifitigikombe cyatwaye, Sporting Praia yegukana igikombe cyayocyonyine, nyuma y'umwaka umwe shampiyona yahuye n'igikombe cya super cup cyatwaye umwaka ushize, Mindelense yegukana igikombe cyayo cyonyine mu mwaka uheruka wa 2014.
Ikipe yambere yahatanye kurwego rw'Afurika ni Sporting Praia mu 1993, nyuma y'imyaka myinshi Cape Verde ibaye umunyamuryango wa CAF. Amakipe atanu yitabiriye harimo Sporting Praia, Mindelense, FC Derby, Boavista Praia na Travadores, ikipe imwegusa ya SC Atlético ni yo yakuwe mu ikipe mu 1992 bitewe nuko ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru ritavuzezina ry'uwayitabiriye kugihe.
Mindelense niyo kipe yakera cyane muri Cape Verde. Ifitekandi ikipe yomuburengerazuba bwa Afurika yose yitwa Tarrafal de Monte Trigo, ikipentoya n'iyindi nshya yitabiriye Santo Antão South Zone mu mwaka wa shampiyona wa 2013-14.
Amarushanwa yogutangiza (Igikombe cy’ishyirahamwe mubirwa bimwe na bimwe) agirigice kimwe n’ikipe ihura rimwe, andi agira ibyiciro bitatu cyangwa bine kurusha umukino wa nyuma.
Hanohari ibibugabyinshi byumupira wamaguru, Estádio da Várzea muri Praia, umurwamukuru niwo ukoreshwa cyane, uwa kabiri ni Mindelo wa Estádio Municipal Adérito Sena niwo wa kabiri ukoreshwa cyane. Santiago ifitibibuga byumupira wamagurucyane. Boa Vista, Maio na Brava bafite ikibuga kimwegusa.
Umukino wa Basketball niwomukino wa kabiri ukunzwe cyane mu gihugu, ukumenyekana gukomeje kwiyongera muri iki gihe. Uyumunsi nikimwe mubihugubike bidakoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gutandukanya amakipe, ikindi gihugu gito ni São Tomé na Príncipe gikoresha uburyo bumwe na Cape Verde, ariko uburyo Cape Verde yakoresheje kugeza mu myaka ya 1990 bufite umukino wa shampiyona y'igihugu gusa, uwatsinze burikirwa yitabira shampiyona y'igihugu, rimwe na rimwe iyuwatsinze ikirwa yatwaye igikombe ubwoyatwaraga igikombe cy'igihugu mu mwaka ushize w'imikino, ikipe ya kabiri irushanwa, uwatsinze irushanwa ry'igihugu arushanwa mu mwaka ukurikira.
Shampiyona yabanje kubanyuma y'ubwigenge.
ADESBA niyoyonyine yatwaye igikombe kurwego rw'umugabane w'Afurika mu 2015.
Indorerwamo zo mu mazi n'umuyaga.
Gukinamafi ntibikorerwa muri Kapu-Verde. Indimikino ifitanye isano nka kite na wind surfing ikunze kugaragara muri Kapu-Verde. Yatangijwe mu gihe cy'ubwigenge kandi yari yiganje cyane mu kirwa cya São Vicente. Nyuma y'intambwe z'ikinyejana cya 20, ubu bwoko bw'imikino bwari bukomeje kwiyongera mu bindi birwa cyane cyane Sal na Boa Vista bifitumucanga mwinshi n'ibirunga by'imisozi hamwe n'imiterere yabyo isa n'ubutayu. Abenshi muribo bari bamukerarugendo. Gukundwa kwayo kwakomeje kwiyongera mu myaka yashize mubirwa bibiribyo muburasirazuba ahanini n'abakerarugendo. Byatumye Sal na Boa Vista biba ibisanzwe mu gukina amafi na wind surfing mugihugu kandi kugeza na n'ubu.
Futsal, siporo yavukiye muri Brezili, ikomejegukundwa cyane muri Cape Verde.
Ikibuga gitocya golf giherereye hafi 3 km mumajyepfo ya Mindelo mukirwa cya São Vicente kandi ni cyo cya mbere cyabaye muri Cape Verde. Hateganijwe andimakipe ya golf cyane cyane mu kirwa cya Sal ndetse hafi ya Salamansa.
Volleyball nundi mukino ubera muri Cape Verde.
Cape Verde yari ifitikipe y'igihugu y'abagore mumukino wa volleyball yokumucanga yitabiriye igikombe cya CAVB Beach Volleyball Continental Cup 2018–2020.
Indimikino ikoreshwa murikigihugu ni Tennis na Cricket. Tennis iri kugenda ikundwa cyane n'abakinnyi mu myaka ya vuba aha. Indirimbo zizwi cyane muri iki gihugu ni i Praia's Várzea mu burengerazuba n'indi i Mindelo. Badminton muri Cape Verde ntabwo ikunzekugaragara.
Cricket ni ndi siporo, imwe mumikino yambere yazanywe muri Cape Verde mukirwa cya São Vicente. Icyo gihe, yakundwaga cyane n'Abongereza mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19 no mu myaka ya 1900 ubwo ubwato bwari bumaze gushya no kongeramo lisansi muri Porto Grande Bay. Cricket iracyakunzwe na n'uyu munsi ariko ntabwo ikunzwe cyanenkomuri icyogihe, igice kinini cy'iyi siporo kiri ku kirwa cya São Vicente, ikipe ya cricket iriho ubu ni GS Castilho.

Urutonde rw'ibibuga by'imikino mur'Afurika rukurikira. Biteguwe hakurikijwe ubushobozi bwabyo, ni ukuvuga umubare ntarengwa w'abareba sitade ishobora kwakira. Ibibuga byinshi binini muri Afurika bikoreshwa mu mupira w'amaguru (umupira w'amaguru), bimwe binakoreshwa mu mikino ngororamubiri na rugby. Ibibuga byo mur' Afurika bifitubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 30.000 cyangwa barenga birimo. Soccer City i Johannesburg ubu niyo sitade nini muri Afurika kuva aho ubushobozi bwayo bwongerewe bukagera ku bantu 94.700 mu gikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2010. Iki gikorwa, cyabaye muri Kamena-Nyakanga, nibwo bwambere igihugu cy'Afurika cyakiriye igikombe cy'isi. Imikino Olempike ntiyigeze ibera mur'Afurika.

Siporo mur'Afurika irateguwe, imikinomyinshi ifite shampiyona z’umwuga. Umupira w’amaguru (uzwi kandi kwizina rya ruhago) niwomukino ukunzwe cyane mu bihugu hafi ya byose bya Afurika. Ibihugu bimwe bya Afurika, nka Kenya na Etiyopiya, byiganje cyane mukwiruka intera ndende, mu gihe ibihugu bya Afurika y’Amajyaruguru nka Alijeriya, Misiri, Maroc na Tuniziya byiganje mu mukino wa handball. Rugby na golf bikunzwe cyane mu bihugu bike bya Afurika, nubwo rugby ikunzwe cyane mur'Afurika y’Epfo.
Siporo gakondo yasuzugurwaga cyane mugihe cy'ubukoloni, kandimyinshi irimogupfa cyangwa yarazimye kubera igitutu cyo kuvugurura, ariko nyinshi ziracyakunzwe nubwonta burenganzira cyangwa inkunga bya leta bifite.: 193–194 Mu 2010, Afurika y'Epfo yabaye igihugu cya mbere cya Afurika cyakiriye igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA.
Afurika ifiteamateka maremare y’imikino gakondo. Ubukoloni bw’i Burayi kuvamumpera z’ikinyejana cya cumi n’icyenda bwazanye imikino yo mu Burengerazuba bw’isi ku mugabane, mu gihe bwagabanyaga imikorere y’imikino yomugace, Abanyaburayi babonaga nk’imikino ishaje kandi irwanya Abakristo.
Siporo mur'Afurika mbere y’ikinyejana cyamakumyabiri hagati yakinwaga cyane cyane n’Abanyaburayi. Ibi byakoreshejwe mu gukomeza gutandukanya ibyiciro by’imibereho by’amoko yombi. Uburezi rusange bwa siporo bwashyizwe mu bikorwa mumijyi y’uturere tw'Afurika kugira ngo "bube heza" kandi bunoze umusaruro w’abaturage b’Abanyaburayi. Uko urubyaro rw’abahanga b’i Burayi n’abasangwabutaka bakurikiranaga uburezi, bamenyekanye mu mikino yari yaragenewe abimukira b’i Burayi. Aho ngaho, benshi muri bo babaye indashyikirwa maze baba "Inyenyeri za Siporo z’Abanyaburayi" kandi bubahwaga kubera ubwitange bwabo bwiza. Abo bakinnyi bashyizwe mu makipe y’igihugu y’Ubwongereza n’Ubufaransa kuko hari ubushobozi bwo kugaragaza ubuhanga bwabo mu mikino. Kuvicyogihe, uturere tw'Afurika twari twarakolonijwe twahagarariwe mu ruhando mpuzamahanga rwa siporo. Abakinnyi b’abahanga muturere twa Afurika tuvuga Icyongereza n’Igifaransa bitwaga "abasadukayo b’indashyikirwa." Akenshi babaga abana b’abasirikare bo muri Senegali bitwaga tirailleurs cyangwa abasirikare.
Nyuma y'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, nomugihe cyogusana imipaka y'Uburayi, Ubwongereza n'Ubufaransa byagoranye kugumana koloni zabo, cyane cyane bitewe n'ubwikunde bw'igihugu. Nyuma y'uko Umuryango w'Ibihugu ushingwa, Ubwongereza n'Ubufaransa byiyemeje gukurikiza amahame y'ubutegetsi bwiza, yavugaga ko abaturage bafituburenganzira bwo kwihitiramo ubuyobozi bwabo. Mbere y'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose irangiye, Afurika yafashe iya mbere kugira ngo yigenge ku burere bwa gikolonize bwashyizweho n'Ubwongereza n'Ubufaransa. Gushyira siporo mu mahanga byashingiye cyane ku bikorwa byo kwirukana ubukoloni, hamwe no kwinjizwa mu mikino Olempike. Afurika yakoresheje siporo nk'uburyo bwo kurwanya ivanguramoko no kurandura ivanguramoko rishingiye ku mwanya w'abaturage. Ubwo "abagome b'abanyacyubahiro" bagendaga bakundwa, abanyacyubahiro b'Abanyafurika bakoresheje aya mahirwe yo kurwanya ivanguramoko no guteza imbere siporo zomur'Afurika gusa, ahubwo no gushushanya ishusho ya Afurika nshya yigenga.
Mu 1956, umupiraw'amaguru waranzwe n'iterambere muri Afurika ubwo hashingwaga ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru mur'Afurika. Ubumwe bw'Afurika bwagaragajwe binyuze mu mikino, ariko bwagenzurwaga n'amashyirahamwe y'imikino yo mu Burengerazuba nka FIFA. Nyamara, mu mikino Olempike ya Roma yomu 1960, abakinnyi b'abirabura b'Abanyafurika bagize icyo bageraho mu nzego zabo, ndetse banatsinda imyanya ikomeye mumpera z'irushanwa. Siporo yatumy'Afurika irushaho gushakubwigenge, kandi muriki gih'Afurika izwicyane mumikino myinshi, cyane cyane mu mupira w'amaguru.
Kutagira icyo bivuzemur'Afurika mumikino mpuzamahanga biterwa no kutagira ibikorwa remezo. [
Ishyirahamwe ry'Umupira w'Amaguru.
Umupira w'amaguru w'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru (uzwi kandi ku izina rya football) ni wo mukino ukunzwe cyane muriburigihugu cya Afurika. Amakipe y'amakipe yomur'Afurika yitabira igikombe cya CAF Champions League na CAF Confederation Cup. Amakipe y'ibihugu by'Afurika yitabira igikombe cya Afurika ndetse no mu irushanwa ry'ibihugu bya Afurika kumakipe yomugace.
Umupira wa baseball.
Baseball ntabwigaragara cyane mur'Afurika. Ariko, Ishyirahamwe ry’Isi rya Baseball Softball ryatangije Baseball5, ubwoko bwa baseball bwomumuhanda, hamwe n’ibihugu icyenda byashinze, [a] mu rwego rwo kumenyekanisha uyumukino kumugabane.
Umukino wa Basketball nawukunzwe kumugabane wose, ahowagaragaye cyanemuri Nijeriya, Tuniziya, Misiri, Senegali, Ivory Coast, Kameruni na Angola, ndetse no muri Cape Verde na Sudani y'Epfo.
Umunya-Nigeria Hakeem Olajuwon (watwayigikombe cya NBA inshurebyiri mwikipe ya Houston Rockets) n'umwe mubakinnyi b'abanyamahanga beza mumateka ya NBA kandafatwa nk'ingenzi mu guteza imbere nogukurura umupira wa Basketball muri Afurika.
Cricket n'umukino ukunzwe cyanemu Bwongereza kandiwoherejwe mubindibice by'ubwami bwahoze ari Ubwongereza. Cricket ifitinkomoko mumajyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'Ubwongereza. Ikunzwe cyane mu Bwongereza na Pays de Galles, no mu bice by'Ubuholandi, no mu bindi bice by'isi, cyane cyane mumajyepfo y'Afurika, Ositaraliya, Nouvelle-Zélande no ku mugabane w'Ubuhinde. Ikinwa kugira ngo igerageze urwego rwa Cricket muri Afurika y'Epfo na Zimbabwe, kandi umusaruro ugaragara muri Kenya na Namibiya.
Umukino wa Hockey wo mu kibuga ukunzwe muturere twahoze arutw’Ubwongereza mur'Afurika, ukaba waragaragaye cyane muri Misiri, Nijeriya, Gana, Kenya, Namibiya, Botswana, Zimbabwe cyane cyane muri Afurika y’Epfo.
Hockey yo mu rubura.
Hockey yomurubura n'umukino w’abantu bake mur'Afurika, ahwibihugu bike by'Afurika byitabira.
Ishyirahamwe ry'abakina rugby.
Ishyirahamwe ry’abakina rugby rikunzwe cyane mur'Afurika y'Epfo (inshuro 4 z'abatwaye igikombe cy'isi mu 1995, 2007, 2019 na 2023) kandi ibindi bihugu bifite umusaruro ugaragara nka Maroc, Namibiya, Zimbabwe na Ivory Coast. Irushanwa rikomeye ku mugabane ni Igikombe cya Afurika kirimo amakipe yokurwego rwambere rwa rugby mur'Afurika, naho Igikombe cy’iterambere rya Afurika kirimo amakipe yokurwego rwa kabiri. Ikipe ya rugby yo muri Afurika y'Epfo ni yo yonyine yitabira irushanwa mpuzamahanga, The Rugby Championship. Inyandiko ya Albert Grundlingh ivuga kungaruka siporo yagizekubwenegihugu, cyanecyane uburyo rugby yahinduye imiterere y’aba-Afrikaner kurugero runaka. Kaminuza ya Stellenbosch yasobanuwe nk'"ikipe ikomeye" ya rugby yo muri Afurika y'Epfo yari irwanya kaminuza zivuga Icyongereza zigaragaza "umuzi wa Afrikandom".
Umupira w'intoki na volleyball birakunzwe cyane cyane mur'Afurika y'Amajyaruguru. Indimikino yo mumakipe nka polo yomumazi, hockey yo mubwoko bwa roller na netball nayikunzwe mubihugu bimwe na bimwe byo mu Burasirazuba n'Amajyepfo byo muri Afurika.
Siporo ku giti cy'umuntu ku giti cye.
Siporo kugiti cy’umuntu kugiti cye nayoningenzi cyane. Afurika ifitirushanwa rikomeye ry’imikino myinshi ryitwa All-Africa Games ryatangiye mu 1965 ryabereye i Brazzaville, Repubulika ya Kongo.
Siporo ni rimwe mumarushanwa akomeye mur'Afurika. Irirushanwa ryabaye igice cy’imikino ya Afurika kuvamu 1965. Shampiyona ya Siporo mur'Afurika yabanje kuba kabiri mumwaka kuva mu 1979. Shampiyona ya Afurika yo gusiganwa ku maguru yabanje kuba mu 1985 nyuma yaho kuva mu 2011. Shampiyona ya Afurika yo kwiruka mu misozi yabanje kuba kuva mu 2009.
Byongeye kandi, amarushanwa menshi ya IAAF World Cross Country Championships yabereye muri Afurika. Irushanwampuzamahanga rya Meeting International Mohammed VI d'Athlétisme de Rabat ryabereyemuri Maroc kuvamu 2008 nk'igice cya IAAF World Challenge na IAAF Diamond League. Mbereyaho, Meeting Grand Prix IAAF de Dakar yarigice cya IAAF Grand Prix na IAAF World Challenge. Marathon ya Cape Town yabayirushanwa rya IAAF Silver Label mu 2014 n'irushanwa rya IAAF Gold Label mu 2017.
Kenya na Etiyopiya byagaragaye cyane mumikino ngororamubiri mumikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi kuva mumyaka ya 1960, cyane cyane mu kwiruka intera yo hagati n'iy'intambwe ndende.
Irushanwa ry’amagare ryomumuhanda rya UCI Africa Tour ryatangiye kuba kuva mu 2005.
Ikipe ya Dimension Data, yahoze ari MTN–Qhubeka, niyokipe yambere y’Abanyafurika yinjiye muri Grand Tours mu 2015. Abagize ikipe bazwi barimo Jacques Janse van Rensburg na Youcef Reguigui.
Kenya n'u Rwanda biri kwiyongera mu gusiganwa ku magare ku isi.
Golf numukino ukunzekugaragara mur'Afurika. The Sunshine Tour ifite icyicaro mur'Afurika y'Epfo ariko inasura ibindi bihugu by'abaturanyi. Amarushanwa menshi yemejwe n'irushanwa ry'i Burayi, nka South African Open, South African PGA Championship, Alfred Dunhill Championship, Nedbank Golf Challenge, Africa Open, Joburg Open, Tshwane Open,
Abakinnyi ba golf bazwi cyane mur'Afurika barimo Bobby Locke, wegukanyigikombe cya British Open inshurenye mu 1949, 1950, 1952 na 1957; Gary Player, wegukanye igikombe cya British Open mu 1959, 1968 na 1974, The Masters mu 1961, 1974 na 1978, PGA Championship mu 1962 na 1972 na US Open mu 1965; Ernie Els, wegukanye igikombe cya US Open mu 1994, 1997 na British Open mu 2002 ; Nick Price, wegukanye igikombe cya PGA Championship mu 1992 na 1994 na British Open mu 1994; Retief Goosen ; Trevor Immelman ; Louis Oosthuizen na Charl Schwartzel.
Siporo y'imodoka ikunzwecyane mur'Afurika y'Epfo. Ikigihugu cyakiriye amasiganwa mpuzamahanga menshi, nka Grand Prix yo muri Afurika y'Epfo (Formula One), Grand Prix yo muri Afurika y'Epfo (Grand Prix) yo gusiganwa ku magare ya moto, n'ibindi. Grand Prix yo muri Maroc ni yo Grand Prix ya mbere mur'Afurika yakiriye Formula 1 mu 1958.
Safari Rally yarimwemu marushanwa y’isi ya Rally kuvamu 1973 kugezamu 2002, mbereyo kugaruka mu 2021. Mbere Rallye Côte d'Ivoire nayo yaberaga nk'irushanwa rya WRC kuva mu irushanwa ry’isi rya Rally ku bashoferi n'abakora kuva mu 1977 kugeza mu 1992. Isiganwa rya Dakar Rally ryabereye mur'Afurika y'Amajyaruguru kuva mu 1979 kugeza mu 2007, harimo inzira ya Ruguru-Amajyepfo mu 1992 n'inzira ya Iburengerazuba-Iburasirazuba mu 2000.
Jody Scheckter niwemushoferi wenyine w’imodoka ukomoka mur'Afurika wegukanye Formula 1 mu 1979, mu gihe Tony Maggs na John Love batsinze ibitegobyinshi. Giniel de Villiers yegukanye Dakar Rally mu 2009. Muri Motos, Afurika y'Epfo yari ifite/ifite abakinnyi bazwi nka Kork Ballington, Jon Ekerold, ubu akaba na Brad Binder, mu gihe abashoferi bo muri Rhodes barimo Ray Amm na Jim Redman.
Tenisi numukino w’abantu bake mur'Afurika.
Abakinnyi bazwibarimo Kevin Anderson, Irene Bowder Peacock, Jaroslav Drobný, Cliff Drysdale, Kevin Curren, Wayne Ferreira, Johan Kriek, Brian Norton, Sandra Reynolds, Eric Sturgess, Ian Vermaak, Amanda Coetzer na Kevin Anderson.
Irushanwa rya South African Open ryari mwirushanwa rya Grand Prix kuvamu 1972 kugeza mu 1989 ndetse n'irushanwa rya ATP Tour kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 2011.
Siporo zomumazi zikunzwe cyane mubihugu byokunkombe z'inyanja, kunkengero z'ibiyaga bigari n'imigezi. Gutembera mubwato, gukaraba, gukaraba mumazi ni ubwoko burikwiyongera muri Kenya, Afurika y'Epfo, Zambiya, u Rwanda na Uganda. Ishobora kwishimirwa haba nk'umukino ndetse n'uburyo bw'ubukerarugendo bukora, bwagenewe amatsinda y'abitabiriye imikino itandukanye n'urwego rw'imyitozo.
Hariho kandamarushanwa akomeye y’imikino yo kurwana n’imikino yo kurwana kumugabane.
Louis Phal niwewabaye umukinnyi wambere w’umunyafurika watwaye igikombe cy’isi cy’iteramakofe. Hari indi myaka 40 yagombaga gutsindira undimukinnyi watwaye igikombe cy’isi cy’iteramakofe mu ishusho ya Richard Ihetu. Hagati aho, nta buryo bwo kuyobora imikino y’iteramakofe bwabigize umwuga bwari buhari muri Afurika kugeza mu 1973, ubwo abahagarariye ibihugu icyenda bya Afurika bashingaga Ishyirahamwe ry’iteramakofe mur'Afurika. Kuya 30 Ukwakira 1974, Muhammad Ali na George Foreman barwaniye igikombe cy’abaremereye muri Zaire cyaje kwitwa Rumble in the Jungle.
Afurika imazegutsindira igikombe cy’isi cya shampiyona nyinshi, Azumah Nelson akaba ariwe uzwi cyane. [[
Afurika ntabwirabona umuntu utsinda muri Judo kwisi. Shampiyona ya Judo mur'Afurika niyo marushanwa akomeye ya Judo muri Afurika.
Karate yatangijwe bwambere mur'Afurika mumyaka ya 1960. Ishyirahamwe ry’Abanyafurika ry’Ishyirahamwe rya Karate niryo rishinzwe karate muri Afurika.
Ubumenyi bw'imirwano buvanze.
Abahanzi bakomeye bomur'Afurika barimo Israel Adesanya, umukinnyi wa UFC muburebure bwo hagati, Kamaru Usman, umukinnyi wa UFC muburebure bwohagati, na Francis Ngannou, umukinnyi wa UFC mu burebure bwo hejuru.
Irushanwa rya Extreme Fighting Championship (ryahoze ryitwa EFC Africa) nikigo cy'Afurika y'Epfo cyashinzwe mu 2009. Niryo shyirahamwe ryambere ry’imikino yo kurwana ivanze ku mugabane w'Afurika.
EFC Africa 19, yabereye muri Carnival City i Johannesburg kuya 19 Mata 2013, yayoboyizindi mikino mur'Afurika aho yarebwe abantubarenga miliyoni 1.8, aho 31.3% by'abareba televiziyo muri Afurika y'Epfo (SABC, e.tv na DStv byose hamwe) byashyizwe hamwe. Aya niyo manota menshi mu mateka ya EFC, arenga agahigo ka EFC Africa 12 kokurebwa abantu miliyoni 1.6 na 25.9% by'abareba. EFC 85 yasubitswe kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Taekwondo irimo gukuruko abantubenshi bitabira imikino Olempike. Afurika irimo kuzamuka nk'ikipe ikomeye muri Taekwondo. Taekwondo iyoborwa n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Abanyafurika rya Taekwondo.
Afurika y'Epfo yakiriye igikombe cy'isi cya Rugby cyo mu 1995, igikombe cy'isi cya Cricket cyo mu 2003 n'igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cyo mu 2010. Afurika yakiriyimikino ya Pan Arab esheshatu n'imikino ya Mediterane esheshatu. Durban, Afurika y'Epfo yatangajwe nk'iyakiriye imikino ya Commonwealth yo mu 2022 mu 2015, arikoyangiwe kwakirimikino muri 2017.
Amarushanwa akomeye kumugabane w'Afurika nimikino y'Afurika, Igikombe cy'Ibihugu bya Afurika, CAF Champions League, Shampiyona ya Afurika mu mikino ngororamubiri, Shampiyona ya Afurika mu marushanwa ya Rally na Sunshine Tour.
Ibirori byo mu karere.
Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
Icyiciro cya mbere cy'imikino y'Umuryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba (EACoG) (2018).
Abantu benshi bo mu bihugu by'Afurika bahagarariye ibihugu by'Afurika mu mikino Olempike y'itumba.

Ibihugu byinshi byomu turere dushyuha byitabiriye imikino Olempike y'itumba nubwonta kirere gifite cyokuyikoresha mugihe cy'itumba. Impamvu imwe nuko ibyobitabiriye ari inkuru zishishikaje abantu mu gihe cy'imikino.
Igihugu cyambere cy’ubushyuhe, arikokitari icy’ubushyuhe bwuzuye, cyitabiriye imikino Olempike y’itumba ni Megizike. Igice kinini cya Megizike kiri mumajyaruguru y’Uburengerazuba bwa Tropic of Cancer, kandi igice kinini cy’igihugu gifite ikirere cy’imisozi miremire cyangwa ikirere cy’ubushyuhe, bityo si igihugu cy’ubushyuhe gusa. Nubwo bimezebityo, Megizike yakinnye imikino Olempike y’itumba mu mikino Olempike y’itumba yo mu 1928 ifite ikipe y’abakinnyi batanu ba bobsleigh, yarangije ari iya cumi n’imwe murimakumyabiri na batatu bitabiriye. Megizike ntiyagarutse mu mikino y’itumba kugeza ku mikino Olempike y’itumba yo mu 1984.
Igihugu cyambere cy’ubushyuhe cyitabiriye imikino Olempike y’itumba ni Filipine, yohereje abasiganwa babiri bomumisozi miremire mumikino Olempike y’itumba yo mu 1972 yabereye i Sapporo, mu Buyapani. Ben Nanasca yaje ku mwanya wa 42 mugusiganwa ku rubura nini cyane (mu bitabiriye 73), naho Juan Cipriano ntiyarangije. Mugusiganwa ku rubura, nta n'umwe mu basiganwa bo mu misozi washoboye kurangiza. Costa Rica yabaye igihugu cya kabiri cyo mu turere dushyuha cyitabiriye imikino y’itumba, mu mikino Olempike y’itumba yo mu 1980 yabereye i Lake Placid, New York, aho Arturo Kinch yanitabiriye imikino yogusiganwa ku rubura. Kinch yazakomeza guhatanira Costa Rica mu yindi mikino itatu y’itumba, harimo n’imikino Olempike y’itumba yo mu 2006 afite imyaka 49. Aho niho yarangije ari uwa 96 mu myaka 15 Irushanwa ryo gusiganwa ku rubura mu misozi miremire ya km, ribanziriza Prawat Nagvajara yo muri Tayilande gusa, ikindi gihugu gishyuha.
Olempike y'itumba yomu 1988 yabereye i Calgary, Alberta, muri Kanada yakuruye ibihugu byinshi byo mu turere dushyuha, birimo Kosita Rika, Fiji, Guam, Gwatemala, Jamayika, Antilles zo mu Buholandi, Filipine, Porto Rico, n'Ibirwa bya Virgin bya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ikipe ya bobsleigh ya Jamayika yakunze abafana muriyimikino ndetse nyumayaho yajekuba intandaro ya filime "Cool Runnings" yomu 1993. Mumikino Olempike y'itumba yo mu 1994 nyuma y'imyaka itandatu, umukinnyi wa Jamayika witwa four-man sled yabonye umwanya wa cumi n'ine, imbere ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'Uburusiya, mu gihe Lascelles Brown wavukiye muri Jamayika yatsindiye Canada umwenda wa feza mu 2006.
Olempike y'itumba yomu 2006 yabereye i Turin mu Butaliyani niyoyabaye iyambere mumikino y'itumba muri Etiyopiya na Madagasikari. Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2010 yabereye i Vancouver, British Columbia, muri Kanada niyo yabaye iya mbere mu birwa bya Cayman, Kolombiya, Peru, na Ghana. Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2014 niyoyabaye iyambere mu mikino ya Dominica, Paraguay, Timor-Leste, Togo, Tonga, na Zimbabwe. Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2018 niyo yabaye iya mbere mumikino ya Ekwateri, Eritrea, Maleziya, Nijeriya, na Singapuru. Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2022 niyo yabaye iya mbere muri Hayiti. Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2026 niyo yabaye iya mbere muri Benin na Guinea-Bissau.
Kuya 14 Gashyantare 2026, umukinnyi womumisozi miremire witwa Lucas Pinheiro Braathen, wavukiye muri Noruveje ku mubyeyi w’Umunyabrezili akaba na se w’Umunyanoruveje, yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere wo muri Amerika y’Epfo, Amerika y’Epfo na Brezili ndetse n’umukinnyi wa mbere uhagarariye igihugu icyo aricyo cyose gishyuha watsindiye umudari mumikino Olempike y’itumba afite zahabu mwirushanwa rikomeye ry’abagabo rya slalom. Pinheiro Braathen ni Umunyabezili na Noruveje kandi yahoze ahatanira Noruveje, ariko nyuma azakwerekeza muri Brezili.
Urutonde rw'ibihugu bishyuha byitabiriye.
Ururutonde rw'ibihugu rurimo ibinyoma byose cyangwa byiganjemo muturere dushyuha kandi bifite ikirere gishyuha cyanecyane hakurikijwe uburyo bwa Köppen bwogushyira mu byiciro ikirere. Haragaragazwa ubwitabire bw'imyaka ya Olempike y'itumba.
Ibindibihugu bishyushye (biherereye muturere dushyuha, urugero) byitabiriye imikino y'itumba birimo Ositaraliya (ifite akarere gashyuha cyane mumajyaruguru, ikabayarabaye igihugu cya mbere cyo mu majyepfo y'isi cyatsindiye umudari wa zahabu mumikino Olempike y'itumba mu 2002), Bermuda, Taipei y'Ubushinwa, Eswatini, Hong Kong, Ubuhinde, Mexique, Afurika y'Epfo, Uruguay n'ibindi bihugu byinshi byo muri Afurika y'Amajyaruguru birimo Alijeriya, Misiri na Maroc.
Tonga yashatse kugaragara mumikino Olempike y'itumba mumikino Olempike yo mu gihe cy'itumba yo mu 2010 yinjiza umukinnyi umwe mu irushanwa, bikurura abantu bamwe mu itangazamakuru, ariko yaguye mucyiciro cyanyuma cy'amajonjora. Nyuma y'imyaka ibiri, yongeye gukurura abantu mu itangazamakuru ubwo byagaragaraga koyahinduye izinarye aryiyita umwe mu baterankunga be, ikigo cy'imyenda y'imbere, nk'umucuruzi. Icyogihe yari mumyitozo yo kugerageza kwinjira mu mikino Olempike y'itumba yo mu 2014.
Imikino ya Paralempike y'itumba.
Kugezamu 2022, ibihugu bitatu byomuturere dushyuha ni byo byahagarariwe mu mikino ya Paralympic y'itumba. Tofiri Kibuuka womuri Uganda yitabiriye umukino wo gusiganwa ku rubura mu mikino ya Paralympic y'itumba mu 1976 no mu mikino yo mu 1980. Nyuma y'uko Kibuuka abonye ubwenegihugu bwa Noruveje, yatangiye guhatanira Noruveje mu mikino Paralympic kuvamu 1984, atsindira imidari myinshi mu mikino ngororamubiri mu mikino Paralympic y'impeshyi. Brezili yohereje abakinnyi babiri mumukino wayo wa mbere muri Paralympic y'itumba ya 2014. Porto Rico yohereje umukinnyi umwemumukino wayo wa mbere muri Paralympic y'itumba ya 2022. El Salvador na Haiti biteganijwe kugaragara muri Paralympic y'itumba ya 2026, buri mukinnyi umwe, bikongeraho ibihugu bine byomuturere dushyuha, byinshi kugezubu.
Imikino Olempike y'ingimbi n'abangavu mu gihe cy'itumba.
Ibihugu bitanubyo muturere dushyuha byahagarariwe mumikino Olempike yambere y'urubyiruko mu gihe cy'itumba yabereye muri Innsbruck, muri Otirishiya.
Mumwaka wa 2020, Diego Amaya womuri Kolombiya yegukanye umudari wa feza mwirushanwa ryo gusiganwa ku maguru ry’abahungu. Nubwambere mumateka umukinnyi womugihugu gishyuha n’umunyamerika y’Epfo begukanye umudari mu irushanwa rya Olempike ry’itumba. Nyuma y’imyaka ine, Agnese Campeol womuri Tayilande yegukanye umudari wa feza mu irushanwa ry’abagore rya bobsleigh, naho Zion Bethônico wo muri Brezili yegukana umudari wa bronze mwirushanwa ry’abagabo ryo gusiganwa kurubura.

Ikipe ya Nigeria yitwa bobsled cyangwa ikipe ya Nigeria yitwa bobsleigh, ihagarariye Nigeria mumukino wa bobsled. Ikipeyambere yashinzwe mu 2016 na Seun Adigun, nk'ikipe y'abagore mu irushanwa ry'abagore 2. Mu 2017, bujuje ibisabwa kugira ngobabe Abanya-Nigeria bambere mu mikino Olempike y'itumba, ndetse n'Abanyafurika bambere mumukino wa bobsled mumikino Olempike y'itumba.
Ikipeyambere y'igihugu yashinzwe mu 2016 na Seun Adigun, mu irushanwa rya bobsleigh y'abagore babiri. Iyi kipe yiyishyuriraga amafaranga gusa, ntankunga y'amafaranga iturutse ku bayobozi ba Nijeriya. Gukusanya amafaranga yo kuyobora iyi kipe byagaragarije guverinoma ya Nijeriya ko ikeneye gushyiraho ishyirahamwe riyobora bobsled, kandi barabikoze, Bobsled &amp; Skeleton Federation of Nigeria (BSFN). Igerageza rya mbere ry'iyi kipe ryo kwemererwa kwitabira imikino Olempike y'itumba, ryari mu 2017, mu mikino Olempike y'itumba ya 2018 muri bobsledding, irushanwa ry'abagore babiri. Ikipe Olempike ya 2018 yari igizwe n'umushoferi Seun Adigun, n'abakoresha feri Ngozi Onwumere na Akuoma Omeoga. Mu Gushyingo 2017, iyi kipe yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo yifatanye mumikino Olempike. Iyokipe yujuje ibisabwa, ibibizaba arubwa mbere Nijeriya igaragaye mu mikino Olempike y'itumba; n'ikipe ya mbere y'Abanyafurika muri bobsled. Iyikipe yujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo yifatanye mu mikino Olempike, ikaba ari yo ihagarariye iyi kipe mu mikino Olempike y'itumba. Nijeriya yabaye kimwe mu bihugu umunani bya Afurika bizahagararirwa mu mikino Olempike y'itumba ya 2018. Onwumere yari yitwaje ibendera rya Nijeriya mu muhango wo gufungura imikino Olempike y'itumba ya 2018 Parade of Nations, maze agendana na bagenzi be babiri, hamwe na mugenzi we Simidele Adeagbo wo muri Nijeriya, waje mu cyiciro cy'abagore. Ikipe yarangije kumwanya wanyuma mumakipe 20 yahatanye. Nyuma y'imikino, amakipe atatu yari mu ikipe yasezeye muri bobsled, ariko yiyemeje guteza imbere siporo muri Nijeriya, guteza imbere ishyirahamwe ry'imikino muri Nijeriya, no guteza imbere imikino y'itumba n'imikino Olempike y'itumba mur'Afurika.
Ikipe yageze muri Nijeriya kwizihiza uburambe bwayo mumikino Olempike muri Werurwe 2018, yateguwe n'itsinda rya BSFN rishinzwe kwamamaza, Temple Management Company (TMC), itangiriye kukibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga cya Murtala Mohammed (MMIA) Ikeja Lagos.

Abashyakashatsi bavuga ko iyo unyoye amazi ashyushye mu gitondo bifasha urwungano ngogozi kubyuka rugakora neza mu kwakira ibyinjira mu mubiri. Bitandukanye no kunywa amazi akonje kuko iyo uyanyoye umaze kurya, atuma amavuta n’ibinure bikomera ku buryo igogora rigorana, ari yo mpamvu ari byiza kunywa amazi ashyushye wasoje kurya.mu mubiri w’umuntu mu gihe cy’imbeho akenshi hahindamushyitsi, kunywa ibishyushye biwurinda guhinda umushyitsi.Ibyo bifasha cyane abantu batuye cyangwa bakorera ahantu hakonje. Koga amazi ashyushye kandi bifasha imitsi ijyana amaraso gufunguka ikaguka, ibyo byorohereza amaraso gutembera neza mu mubiri.Iyo amaraso atembera neza mumubiri bituma ubuzima buhorana itoto bityo bikarinda ubuzima bwa muntu.

Umugore utwite asabwa kurya no kunywa bihagije kuko aba agaburira n'umwana uri munda,hari ibyo atemerewe kurya mu gihe atwite kuko byagira ingaruka mbi kumwana atwite.
= IBUNTU 2 UMUGORE UTWITE ATEMEREWE MU GIHE ATWITE =
1.NTAGOMBA KUNYWA ITABI
Umugore utwite abujijwe kunywa itabi,kuko bishyira umwana n'umubyeyi mu byago binyuranye,nko kuba inda yakwivumbagatanya ikaba yavamo, ikaba yavamo, umwana agapfira mu nda cyangwa akavuka atagejeje igihe.
2 NTAGOMBA KUNYWA INZOGA
Umugore utwite nagomba kunywa inzoga, kuko ishobora gutuma umwana agira ibibazo by'indwara z'umutima bikazamukurikirana ubuzima bwiza.

Mumbuto usangamo nka avoka,umwembe,ipapayi,nizindi hakabamo nimbonga.avoka ifite akamaro mubuzima bwumuntu gusa ariko ntago abantu bakunze kuyitaho kumafungururo yabo yaburimutsi kandi ningenzi.
Harikiganiro IGIHE giherutse kugirana n'inzobere mubijyanye ni mbonzamirire Mukakarisa Anastasie,yasobanuyeko buri rubuto ryose rugira akamaro mumubiri kandi buri rubuto rwose rugira umwihariko warwo. Ati"umuntu agize amahirwe yagenda arya kuri buri rubuto ryose kerek abaye afite indwara imubuza kurya urubuto runaka. Urugero nk'urubuto rwitwa inanansi nurubuto ruboneka kugiciro gito ariko nkabantu bafite uburwayi bw'igifu ntago bemerewa kurukoresha kuko rushobora kubatera "allergie"
Mukakarisa akomeza agira ati"kumuntu utabasha kubona imbuto zitandukanye byibuze agomba kugira urubuto rumwe akoresha kumunsi.
Abahanga mubijyanye n'ubuzima bavugako Avoka ikungahayemo,Potassium,Fiber na Vitamine B,C n'izindi zvitamine zitandukanye.
Umwembe nurundi rubuto rufitiye akamaro umubiri kuku rukungahayemo Vitamine C ikenerwa mugukora Prote'ines z'ingenzi ku menyo.
Imboga rwatswi zigira akamaro kanini ku buzima bwa muntu. kurya imboga bituma umubiri ubona ibyitwa 'acido basique'bikenerwa cyane ku maraso. Imboga cyane cyane imboga rwatsi zifitemo ibintu byongera amaraso.
Amazi nayo afite akamaro gakomeye kubuzima bw'amuntu kuko umuntu muzima bwe agomba kuba afite amazi nka 60%na65% kugirango umubiri ukore neza.
kandi amazi yoza igifu akanaruhura umubiri warurushye,igihe umuntu atanyonye amzi ajye yumvako ahobwe kuku amazi nubuzima kandi wibukeko amazi atuma utarwara byahato nahato.

Itegeko ‘Acte’ ryatowe ku wa Gatatu tariki 5 Ukwakira 2022, rivuga ko mu gihe hategerejwe “Ishyirwaho ry’inzego z’inzibacyuho, ishyaka rya MPSR, rizakomeza kurinda ubwigenge bw’igihugu, kurinda imbibi z’igihugu, kubahiriza amasezerano mpuzamahanga Burkina Faso yasinye...”
Itegeko Nshinga ry’icyo gihugu ryari ryabaye rihagaritswe nyuma ya Coup d’Etat ariko ubu ryasubijweho, kandi rirubahizwa uretse ingingo zaryo zinyuranyije na Acte fundamental.
Nyuma yo guhirika ku butegetsi Lieutenant-colonel Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba, na we wari wafashe ubutegetsi akoze coup d’Etat muri Mutarama 2022, Cap Ibrahim Traoré w’imyaka 34, abaye Perezida wa kabiri muto ku rwego rw'isi.

Kurahira kwa Tshisekedi: Abaperezida 18 baritezwe ko bari bwitabire
Intumwa nkuru ya perezida wa DR Congo, Serge Tshibangu, yatangaje ko abakuru b’ibihugu 18, ba visi perezida babiri, n’abahoze ari abakuru b’ibihugu bane, bitezwe i Kinshasa kuri uyu wa gatandatu mu muhango wo kurahira kwa Perezida watowe Felix Tshisekedi Kirombo.
Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kuri Stade des Martyrs mu ijoro ryo kuwa kane, Tshibangu, wari kumwe na Patrick Muyaya umuvugizi wa leta, yavuze ko abo bategetsi 18 biganjemo ab’ibihugu bya Africa “bamaze kwemeza ko bazitabira” uwo muhango wo kurahira kwa perezida.
Tshibangu yavuze kandi ko Joseph Kabila yatumiwe ubugira kabiri nk’uwahoze ari perezida ndetse nk’umusenateri ubuzima bwose wa DR Congo.
Kabila niwe wahererekanyije ubutegetsi na Tshisekedi mu myaka itanu ishize, gusa nyuma aba bagabo ntibongeye kuvuga rumwe aho nk’uwahoze ari perezida wa komisiyo y’amatora yavuze ko Tshisekedi yirengangije ibyo yari yarumvikanye na Kabila amaze kumugeza ku ntsinzi.
Kabila – udakunze kuvuga mu itangazamakuru – ashobora kutitabira kurahira kwa mugenzi we Tshisekedi. Barbara Nzimbi, umujyanama we mu by'itumanaho yatangaje ku rubuga X ko Kabila "ari i Johannesbourg muri Africa y'Epfo muri porogaramu y'amasomo ye".
Kabila amaze igihe akorera impamya bumenyi y'ikirenga muri kaminuza y'i Johannesbourg.
Mu byitezwe cyane mu muhango wo kuri uyu wa gatandatu wo kurahira harimo indahiro ya perezida, ijambo rye nyuma yo kurahira, n'akarasisi ka gisirikare, nk'uko bivugwa na Patrick Muyaya.
Ibiro ntaramakuru bya Congo, byasohoye urutonde ruriho abakuru b’ibihugu 22 batumiwe, barimo nka Evariste Ndahishimiye w’u Burundi, Brice Oligui wa Gabon, Cyril Ramaphosa wa Africa y’Epfo, Samia Suluhu wa Tanzania, Macky Sall wa Sénégal cyangwa Bola Tinubu wa Nigeria, William Ruto wa Kenya n’abandi ariko perezida w'u Rwanda POUL KAGAME ntawurimo.

Benediction Club ni ikipe y’amagare y'abigize umwuga ibarizwa mu karere ka Rubavu mu intara y'iburengerazuba i Gisenyi ikaba iabarizwa mu makipe yemewe n'ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino w’Amagare mu Rwanda, Afurika ndetse no ku isi. ikaba ikina nk’akipe iri mu cyiciro cya gatatu ku mugabane wa afurika.

Masengesho Vainqueur

Masengesho Vainqueur (wavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 2002) ni umukinnyi wa bigize umwuga ukomoka mu Rwanda mu karere ka Musanze.
Masengesho Vainqueur yitabiriye amarushanwa atandukanye hari tour du Rwanda muri 2026, aho yakinaga avuye mu ikipe ya Beneduction Club. MAsengesho yitabiriye andi marushanwa atandukanye nk'irushanwa ry'amagare ryo muri arigeriya ararirangiza, ndetse yitabiriye urishanwa ry'amagere ku isi muri 2023, kandi yaje kwitabira irushanwa ry'amagare ryo muri morice. mu Rwanda yakinnye ndetse atwara amarushanwa atandukanye nk'irushanwa ryakarere ka nyaruguru, irushanwa rya Sakumi Anselme ndetse niwe watwaye irushanwa ry'amagare mu Rwanda ry'abanyonga mu muhanda.

Shemu Nsengiyumva (yavutse ku wa 3 Gashyantare 1998) ni umukinnyi w'amagare w'umwuga w'Umunyarwanda. Ni inzobere mu gusiganwa n'igihe ("contre-la-montre"), akaba akinira ikipe yo ku rwego rw'umugabane ya Java-Inovotec Pro Team.
Yigaragaje muri shampiyona z'igihugu z'u Rwanda, yegukana umwanya wa mbere mu gusiganwa n'igihe mu 2025 nyuma yo kuba uwa kabiri mu 2023. Yanahagarariye u Rwanda muri shampiyona y'isi y'amagare yo mu 2025 yabereye i Kigali.
Shemu Nsengiyumva yavutse ku wa 3 Gashyantare 1998 mu Rwanda. Yatangiriye gusiganwa ku magare mu gihugu cye cy'amavuko, maze yigaragaza vuba mu masiganwa yo mu mihanda ya Afurika, cyane cyane mu gusiganwa n'igihe. Iterambere rye rihoraho ryatumye yinjira mu ikipe yo ku rwego rw'umugabane ("équipe continentale") ya Java-Inovotec Pro Team, akaba yaritabiriye amasiganwa menshi mpuzamahanga.
Nsengiyumva ari mu bakinnyi b'imbere mu gusiganwa n'igihe mu Rwanda: yagiye agera ku myanya y'imbere muri shampiyona z'igihugu, anahagararira igihugu cye ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Mu 2025 yegukanye shampiyona y'u Rwanda yo gusiganwa n'igihe, anegukana umudari wa feza muri shampiyona ya Afurika yo gusiganwa n'igihe hagati y'amakipe avanze abagabo n'abagore.
Muri Nzeri 2025, muri Shampiyona y'isi y'amagare 2025 yabereye i Kigali, yabaye uwa 25 mu bakinnyi 55 mu isiganwa ryo gusiganwa n'igihe ry'abakuru ("elite").

Java-Inovotec Pro ni ikipe y'amagareibarizwa i Ngarama mu karere ka Gatsibo, ikaba ikipe y'abigize umwuga ikaba ibarizwa mu Rwanda, ikaba ikina imikino ya Tour du Rwanda ndetse n'amarushanwa muzamahanga. Ni ikipe itoza kandi ikita ku iterambere ry'abakinnyi b'abanyarwanda, Ni ikipe ibarizwa mu cyiciro cya gatatu ku mugabane w'afurika, iyi kipe ikaba yaratwaye amarushanwa atandukanye mu Rwanda cyangwa muri afurika.

May Stars ni ikipe y'abigize umwuga ibarizwa mu Rwanda y'abigize umwuga aho izwiho kugira abakinnyi mpuzamahanga atari abanyarwanda gusa, ni ikipe yatwaye kandi yegukanye agace cyangwa irushanwa rya Kirehe Race muri 2025, ifite abakinnyi ba bagabo batarengeje imyaka 23 gusa. = Basketball Africa League (BAL) =
Basketball Africa League (BAL) ni shampiyona y’umwuga ya basketball ihuza amakipe akomeye yo muri Afurika. Yatangiye ku mugaragaro mu mwaka wa 2021 binyuze mu bufatanye bwa National Basketball Association (NBA) n’Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga rya Basketball (FIBA) (NBA, 2021). Ishyirwaho rya BAL ryabaye intambwe ikomeye mu mikino muri Afurika, kuko ari yo shampiyona ya mbere ishyigikiwe na NBA ikorera hanze ya Amerika ya Ruguru (FIBA, 2021). Intego yayo ni guteza imbere umukino wa basketball ku mugabane wa Afurika no guha abakinnyi, abatoza n’amakipe amahirwe yo kwigaragaza ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Iyi shampiyona igizwe n’amakipe 12 aturuka mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika (BAL, 2024). Amakipe ayijyamo atsindira shampiyona z’ibihugu byayo cyangwa akabinyura mu mikino yo gushaka itike ya BAL. Irushanwa ritangirana n’icyiciro cy’amatsinda, rikurikirwa na kamarampaka (playoffs), hanyuma hakabaho umukino wa nyuma (Finals) ugaragaza ikipe itwara igikombe (NBA Africa, 2023). Imikino ibera mu mijyi itandukanye yo muri Afurika buri mwaka, bigafasha abafana kubona basketball yo ku rwego rwo hejuru hafi yabo.
Kuva yatangira, BAL imaze kugira amakipe atandukanye yegukana igikombe. Mu 2021, Zamalek SC yo mu Misiri ni yo yegukanye igikombe cya mbere (NBA, 2021). Mu 2022, US Monastir yo muri Tuniziya yatwaye igikombe (BAL, 2022). Mu 2023, Al Ahly yo mu Misiri yegukanye igikombe (NBA Africa, 2023). Mu 2024, Petro de Luanda yo muri Angola yatwaye igikombe cyayo cya mbere cya BAL (BAL, 2024). Mu 2025, Al Ahli Tripoli yo muri Libiya yegukanye igikombe, iba ikipe ya mbere yo muri Libiya ibigezeho (BAL, 2025). Ibi bigaragaza ko urwego rwa basketball mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika rugenda ruzamuka kandi ko irushanwa ririmo guhatanira ku rwego rwo hejuru.
BAL yanagaragayemo abakinnyi bakoze amateka kubera imikinire yabo idasanzwe. Walter Hodge yabaye umukinnyi mwiza w’irushanwa (MVP) wa mbere mu 2021 (NBA, 2021). Nuni Omot yabonye igihembo cya MVP mu 2023 akinira Al Ahly (NBA Africa, 2023). Jean Jacques Boissy yabaye MVP mu 2025 kubera imikinire ye myiza muri uwo mwaka (BAL, 2025). Hari n’abandi bakinnyi bagaragaje ubuhanga budasanzwe, nka Terrell Stoglin uzwiho gutsinda amanota menshi, na Aliou Diarra wamamaye mu gufata imipira no kurinda neza (FIBA, 2024). Aba bakinnyi bagize uruhare rukomeye mu kuzamura urwego n’icyubahiro cya BAL.
Muri rusange, Basketball Africa League ni intambwe ikomeye mu iterambere rya basketball muri Afurika. Kubera guhuza impano zo ku mugabane wa Afurika n’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga, BAL ikomeje kwamamara no kurushaho gukomera buri mwaka (NBA Africa, 2024). Uko igenda yaguka, ni ko ikomeje kugira uruhare mu gushushanya ejo hazaza ha basketball muri Afurika no kuzamura izina ry’umugabane ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Ishimwe anicet ni Umunyarwanda akaba umukinnyi w'umupira wamaguru wabigize umwuga akaba akina kuruhande rw'ibumoso mwikipe y'igihugu amavubi,Anicet Ishimwe yavutse mumwaka wa 2003 mata 06.
Ishimwe anicet, yavuye muri olympique de Bea yo muri Tunisia yamutanze muri Assabah SC yo muri Libya mu gihe cy'amezi atandatu. Muri 2024 nibwo uyu mukinnyi yerekanywe muri Olympique de Bea yo mu cyiciro cta mbere muri Tunisia, gusa kubona umwanya ugahije wo gukina bikomeza kugorana.
Ibi byatumye ii ekipe imutanga muri Assabah SC yo mucyiciro cya mbere muri Libya kugirango ashake iminota ihagije yo gukina.
Ishimwe Anicet yakinnye muri APR FC nyuma yaho APR FC iza kumutiza Mukura FC.

Dedan Juma (rimwe na rimwe azwi nka Dedan Juma Onyango) ni umukinnyi wa filime na televiziyo wo muri Kenya ndetse akaba n’umuhanzi w’amajwi (voice-over artist). Yamenyekanye cyane kubera uruhare rwe muri series ya Showmax yitwa "Pepeta" ndetse no mu ikinamico ikunzwe cyane yitwa "Real Househelps of Kawangware."
Juma yakuriye i Nairobi, aho yavuze ko yahuye n'ibikorwa by'ubugizi bwa nabi n'ubuzima bwo mu muhanda kuva akiri muto. Yakoze ibyaha bito mu gihe cy'ubugimbi ariko yaretse ubwo buzima nyuma yo kubona inshuti ye imwica. Avuga ko ingaruka za nyina n'ukwizera kwe byamufashije gukina.
Juma yatangiye umwuga we wo gukina filime mu myaka ya 2010, agaragara muri televiziyo na filime zo mu gace k'iwabo. Yamenyekanye cyane mu gihugu kubera uruhare rwe nk'umupolisi mu ruhererekane rw'urwenya "rwa Real Househelps of Kawangware", nyuma aza gukina "Zeze" muri filime ya mbere ya Showmax "yitwa Pepeta". Yanagaragaye muri filime ngufi n'imishinga yo ku rubyiniro kandi agaragara mu bubiko mpuzamahanga bwa filime nka IMDb.
Nubwo azwiho gukina imikino y’abagizi ba nabi, abagize itsinda ry’abagizi ba nabi n’abashinzwe iperereza, Juma yavuze ku mbogamizi zo kuba umukinnyi w’inyuguti ndetse n’uko hakenewe imyanya itandukanye mu nganda za filime zo muri Kenya.
Mu biganiro byinshi, Juma yavuze ingorane abakinnyi benshi bo muri Kenya bahura nazo mu kubona amafaranga ahoraho mu buhanzi. Yavuze ko hagati y'imirimo yo gukina yakundaga kwishingikiriza ku mirimo idasanzwe nko gucuruza kugira ngo yibesheho. Ibitangazamakuru byamugaragaje nk'urugero rw'impinduka mu buzima bwe no kwihangana mu rwego rw'imyidagaduro muri Kenya.
Ubuzima bwe mu bwana.

Urupapuro ni igikoresho gikozwe mu biti, cyifashishwa mu kwandika no kubika amakuru yanditse, kikifashishwa mu gushushsanya no gusomerwaho amakuru yanditseho. Urupapuro nirwo ruzwi mu rurimi rw'icyongereza nka "paper".

Ubukirisitu niryo dini rifite Abayoboke benshi mu Rwanda, aho ariyo madini yiganjemo abayoboke mesnhi. Abaturage bo mu Rwanda bagera kuri 3% bavuga ko nta dini basengeramo, mu gihe abandi 3% bayobotse andi madini harimo. Abaturage bagera kuri 2% ni Abayisilamu (cyane cyane).
Hariho kandi umubare muto w’aba Baha'i, ndetse n’abandi bagendera ku myemerere iciriritse ya Gakondo. Kuva Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ibaye, habayeho kwiyongera kw’amatsinda mato y’amadini akenshi afitanye isano n’abakristo.
Hari imiryango mito y’Abahindu n’Ababuda, igizwe ahanini n’abayoboke b’abanyamahanga, cyane cyane abacuruzi bakomoka mu Bushinwa no mu Buhinde ndetse n’abarimu ba kaminuza n’abanyeshuri. ntayandi madini akunze kuza mu Rwanda, nubwo hari Ingoro y’Abahindu mu Rwanda aho abantu bajya basengera.

Muri muco nyarwanda, "Gutanga inka" ni umuhango ukomeye cyane ushushanya ubucuti, icyubahiro, n'ubumwe hagati y'abantu. Inka ntabwo yari itungo gusa, yari ikimenyetso cy'ubutunzi n'agaciro k'umuntu mu muryango.
Dore ubusobanuro bw’ingenzi bw’uyu muhango:
1. Guca Ubuhake (Guhana Inka).
Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, gutanga inka byari uburyo bwo kurema umubano hagati y’umutunzi (shebuja) n’umugaragu. Iyo shebuja yahaga umuntu inka, yabaga amuhaye ubushobozi bwo kubaho neza, kandi uwo muntu akamugaragariza ubudahemuka.
Mu muhango wo gushyingirwa, umuryango w’umuhungu utanga inka mu muryango w’umukobwa. Ibi ntibivuze "kugura" umukobwa, ahubwo ni:

Gucuragura ni umwe mu migenzo gakondo yo mu Rwanda, aho byakorwaga hagamijwe kuroga no kwifuriza inabi abo muru urwo rugo, kandi byakorwaga ucuragura yambaye ubusa, akabyina kurugo rwuwo yifuriza inabi ana tongera.
Amateka yo gucuragura mu Rwanda.
uyu mugenzo wo gucuragura wadutse mu Rwanda ahayingo muri 1500 ku ngoma y' umwami ndahiro, aha byadukanywe n' umunyabungokazi witwaga Maduna hamwe n' umuhunguwe witwaga Nkoma ya Nkondogoro, (Sekirasanyi ikirozi cyo mu Marangara), waje mu Rwanda azanye n' umuhungu we baturutse i bunyabungo ya zayire. mubisanzwe gucuragura ntibyari umuco w' abanyarwanda ahubwo byazanywe na Maduna,wanaje kuba umurozi w' umwami Yuhi ndahiro.

Gutongera ni umugenzo wo gusukiranya amagambo uyatura ku muntu cyangwa ku kintu ugamije ko ahinduka cyangwa gihinduka mu buryo Utongera ashaka ko kigendamo bitewe nuburyo yifuza. ni umugenzo ahanini ukoreshwa hagamijwe ikibi cyangwa ikiza kumuntu cyangwa kubintu runaka.
Mu nyandiko dukesha ikinyamakuru Igihe mu nkuru yanditswe muri 2013 bavuzeko Gutongera bikoreshwa n'Umupfumu atongera nk'inkoko aho ayitera umuti akayica akoresheje umushyo cyangwa akayirambika ku kirere akayibaga" ibyo nka bimwe mi migenzo bakora batongera abazimu bateye ngo babagushe neza.

Nikamwe mugakoresho kabazwaga mugiti akenshi kakinwaga "(Umukino") naba kiribato(Ababyiruka) Aho uwomumari wasongorwaga Hanyuma ugakubitishwa imigozi iboshwe mumigwegwe Maze kakizengurutsa kubutaka kujyeza igihe uwakubitaga uwo mumari yananirwaga cyangwa se agahusha kuwutsibura aho iyo uwabaga atsinzwe kuwutsibura yakirwaga nundi babaga barigukinana umo mukino.

Umurozi ni umuntu w'igitsina gabo cyangwa gore wifashisha ibyatsi gakondo, ibice by'imibiri y'inyamaswa (uruhu, ubwoya, amababa, inzara, ubwonko..) akabiha umuntu ashaka ko amera uko ashaka cyangwa akamwica ku mpamvu z'uko atamukeneye mu buzima bwe.

Kurumika no kurasaga ni imigenzo yacera Nyarwanda yakoreshwaga mubuvuzi gakondo nokurinda ibyago Abanyarwanda, bityo uwabikoraga akaba yarafite imyizere yuko iyobikozwe byanga byakunda birinda. Gusa kuri ubu abanyarwanda benshi ntibabyemera ndetse bavugako arimihango ya gipagani nubwo hari abaganga bavugako iyomigenzo yabaga aringirakamaro.
Amateka yo kurumika no kurasaga.
Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, hari imihango yakoreshwaga mu kuvura no kurinda indwara. Nubwo ubu abantu benshi bayifata nk’imigenzo ya gipagani, hari abaganga bavuga ko hari aho byafashaga. Muri iyo migenzo harimo kurasaga, aho bacagaga ku ruhu rw’umuntu bagashyiramo imiti yo kumuvura cyangwa kumurinda uburozi. Hari kandi kurumika, aho bacagaga bagakuramo amaraso bita mabi kugira ngo umuntu akire.
Abanyarwanda bakoreshaga kandi imyotso, cyane cyane ku bana, aho babotsaga ku gahanga cyangwa ku misaya kugira ngo barinde cyangwa bavure indwara z’amaso. Undi muco wari kugombora, wakoreshwaga mu kuvura umuntu warumwe n’inzoka, bashyiraho imiti yihariye bakavugamo n’imitongero.
Muri rusange, ubuvuzi gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda bwari bufite uburyo bwinshi n’imitekerereze yihariye, kandi hari aho bugikoreshwa no muri iki gihe mu kuvura zimwe mu ndwara.

Guca indasago ni umugenzo wakorwaga n'Abanyarwanda ndetse n'Abarundi ba kera bagamije ubuvuzi gakondo harimo gutunganya umubiri cg gukingira indwara zitandukanye. Mu guca indasago bakebaga gato ndetse gahoro ku gice cy'umubiri runaka bitewe n'ahafite uburwayi hagashyirwamo imiti. Indasago zabaga ari nk'ibibyimba, imyotso, n' ibindi.
Inkomoko yo guca indasago.
Guca indasago ni umutsiriko bakorerega ku muntu bagamije kumurinda kugirango batazamuroga, atazahura n' akaga, azagire urugo rwiza n' ibindi.

Sitade ya MKO Abiola nisitade ikoreshwamuburyo bwinshi i Abeokuta, muri Nijeriya. Ubu ikoreshwa cyanecyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi nisitade y'iwabo ya Gateway FC na Abeokuta Stormers SC. Iyisitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 10.000.
Izina ry'iyi sitade risobanura Moshood Kashimawo Olawale Abiola, umucuruzi, umunyamakuru, umunyapolitiki n'umunyacyubahiro w'Abeokuta, muri Leta ya Ogun.

Sitade ya Lekan Salami, izwikandi nka Sitade y'Adamasingba, ni sitade ifite intego nyinshi i Ibadan, muri Nijeriya. Iyisitade ikoreshwa cyanecyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru, ikoreshwa nk'ikibuga cya Shooting Stars n'andi makipe yomuri akogace. Ifitimyanya y'abareba 10.000.

Ikipe ya Tennis ya Lagos Lawn (yashinzwemu 1895) niyokipe yakera cyane muri Nijeriya. Iyi kipifite ubusobwa metero kare zigera ku 14.000 iherereye kuri 12 Tafawa Balewa Square mu kirwa cya Lagos.
Ishyirahamwe rya Tennis rya Lagos Lawn Club ryakiramarushanwa menshi ya Tennis, aho shampiyona ya Tennis ya Governor's Cup Lagos (GCLT), irushanwa rya ITF Pro-Circuit ngarukamwaka ritangamafaranga y'amadolari 100.000, rikaba ariryorizwicyane.

Ikipe ya Lagos Islanders nikipe ya Basketball yomuri Nijeriya ifiticyicaro i Lagos, yashinzwe mu 1984. Iyikipe yarifitwe n'umuhanzi w'umuziki wapfuye Sound Sultan kuvamu 2014. Bakinira imikino yabo yomurugo muri Rowe Park Sports Centre mugace ka Yaba.
Mu 2016, ikipe ya Islanders yakinnye mwirushanwa ryigenga rya Basketball muri Afurika (ABL). Kubera kwishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa Basketball muri Nijeriya (NBBF) ritemeraga iyi shampiyona, bahagaritswe mu marushanwa yomugihugu. Iryo egeko ryakuweho mu 2019.

Lagos Arena nikibuga cy’imbere kirikubakwa i Lekki, muri Leta ya Lagos, muri Nijeriya, kirimo kubakwa ubu. Iki kibuga kizaba gifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 12.000 kandikizaba aricyo kibuga kinini cyane cyimbere mugihugu. Byari byitezwe kwikibuga kizarangira mu Kuboza 2024. Iki kibuga kiri kubakwa mugace ka Victoria Island kandi kizatanga ahantuho gukoreribitaramo ndetse n’imikino ikomeye.
Uyumushinga wa miliyoni 100 z'amadolari wamenyekanye bwambere kwizina rya "Project Arena". Igishushanyo mbonera cyakozwe n'ikigo cy'ubwubatsi cyomuri Turukiya cya Yazan Design Architecture cyarangiye mu 2020. Akarere ka Lagos gaterwa inkunga n'ishyirahamwe ry'abikorera ku giti cyabo n'abashinzwe ubucuruzi bw'amazu, riyobowe na Tayo Amusan's Perspectives Corporation n'Ikigo cy'Ishoramari cya Nijeriya, bashoyemo 40.5%. Abandi bashoramari bo mu rwego rw'abikorera barimo Adino Capital Ltd., Ikigogishinzwe Ibikorwaremezo bya Siporo n'Iterambere ry'Imyidagaduro Ltd. na Persianas Group. Kubaka byatangiye kuya 24 Gashyantare 2024 kandi byatangajwe kobizarangira m'Ukuboza 2025.
Ariko, guhera m'Ukuboza 2025, imirimoyokubaka Lagos Arena yari ikiri ku rwego rw’inyubako, cyane cyane mu gihe cyo gupima ubutaka nokubushyiraho, bityo bigatuma igihe cyiza cyo kurangiza nogufungura Arena cyari ukuboza 2027.

Sitade ya Lafia Township nisitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshi i Lafia, muri Leta ya Nasarawa, muri Nijeriya yohagati. Ikoreshwa cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi nisitade ya Nasarawa United. Iyi sitade ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 10.000. Irimu Mujyi wa Lafia rwagati kumuhanda wa Jos-Makurdi.

Sitade ya Leta ya Kwara nisitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshi i Ilorin, Kwara, muri Nijeriya. Ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi nisitade ya Kwara United FC na ABS FC. Sitade ifite ubushobozi bwokwakirabantu 18.000 nyuma y'imirimo yokuvugurura yatangiye mu 2010. Iherereye kumuhanda wa Sitade, hafi y'umuhanda wa Ibrahim Taiwo.
Sitade yubatswe n'Umuyobozi wa Gisirikare muriyo leta, Brigadier George Innih, wari mukiruhuko cy'izabukuru, mu 1977.
Kuya 9 Ukuboza 2021, ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Nijeriya (NPFL) ryahagaritse ikibuga cy’imikino nyumay’uko cyatsinzwe ikizamini cy’ubunyangamugayo cyakoreshejwe mu byumba byo kwambariramo, ubwiherero, televiziyo, ahokamera zihagarara, n’amanota y’ikoranabuhanga. Iryo tegeko ryasubiwemo hanyuma rikurwaho kuya 14 Ukuboza 2021 nyuma yo kuvugururwa byihutirwa. Ariko, ikibuga nticyashoboraga gukinirwa muruwomwaka w’imikino kuko leta yemeye impinduka z’ikibuga murwego rwokuvugurura ikibuga.
Kwara United yitabiriyimikino ya shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru ya Nigeria kuvamu 2023 kugeza 2024, impuzandengo y’abitabiriye imikino yakinwe murugo ni 5,368.
Muri Kanama 2024, leta yatangiye gusananokuvugurura sitade kugira ngwikomeze kugendera ku bipimo bya NPFL.
