Sitade ya Jay Jay Okocha ni sitade irimuri Ogwashi-Uku, Aniocha y'Amajyepfo, muri Nijeriya yitiriwe uwahoze ari kapiteni wa Super Eagles Jay-Jay Okocha. Kurubikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi sitade ya Delta Force FC yakiniwe murugo. Iyi sitade yahinduwe izina rya Okocha muri Kamena 2008, ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 8.000 kandi yakiriye imikino ya Shampiyona ya WAFU y'abatarengeje imyaka 20 yatwaye na Ghana mu 2008.
Mu 2015, yabaye imwemumbuga zakiniwemo igikombe cya Delta State Federation Cup cyo mu 2015.
Nyuma y'imyaka icyenda, mwirushanwa rya 2024 Zenith Bank/Delta Principals Cup, ryabereye mu cyiciro cyakabiri cyanyuma cyahuje Ishuri Rikuru rya Umutu n'Ishuri Rikuru rya Utagbe, aho Ishuri Rikuru rya Utagbe ryageze kumukino wa nyuma ritsinda igitego 1-0.

Sitade ya Jolly Nyame ni sitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshi i Jalingo, muri Nijeriya. Ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandiniho Taraba FC iherereye. Sitade icumbikira abantu 12.000 kandiyubatswe mu 2002. Yitiriwe Guverineri w'iyo leta icyogihe, Hon. Jolly Nyame.

Sitade ya Ilaro ni sitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshi i Ilaro, muri Nijeriya. Yubatswe mu 2008, ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi ni sitade yomurugo ya Gateway FC. Sitade ifite ubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 12.000. Sitade ubiherereye kumuhanda wa Idogo muri Ilaro.

Sitade y'urwibutso rwa Chuba Ikpeazu ni sitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 5,000 iherereye Onitsha, muri Nijeriya, ikabayubatswe mu 2009. Ubuni sitade y'ikipe ya Anambra Pillars FC na Anambra United FC.

Sitade ya Hadejia ni sitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshi i Hadejia, muri Leta ya Jigawa, muri Nijeriya. Ubu ikoreshwa cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi nisitade ya Jigawa Golden Stars FC. Sitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 15.000.

Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri muri Nijeriya niryoriyobora siporo y’imikino ngororamubiri muri Nijeriya. Numunyamuryango w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Imikinongororamubiri muri Afurika n’Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry’Imikino ngororamubiri.
Yashinzwe nk'Inama Nkuru y'Ishyirahamwe ry'Imikino y'Abakinnyi b'Amaguru muri Nijeriya mu 1944. AFN itegura irushanwa ngarukamwaka rya AFN Golden League, rikaba ari irushanwa ry'imbere mu gihugu rifite imiterere isa n'iya IAAF Golden League ubwitakibaho. Mu 2017, Ibrahim Shehu Gusau yatorewekuba perezida w'iryo shyirahamwe. Kugezamuri Nyakanga 2024, Tonobok Okowa niwe perezida wa AFN.
Icyicaro cya AFN kirikuri Sitade y'Igihugu ya Nijeriya i Garki, Abuja.

Sitade ya Gabros ni sitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 3,000 i Nnewi, muri Nijeriya, hafi ya Beverly Hills Hotel. Ni sitade ya Gabros International na Godosky FC, ikaba yarikicaro cy'agateganyo cya Anambra United FC.
Ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Gabros na Sitade yayobyaje kugurishwa kuri Dr. Patrick Ifeanyi Ubah na Chief Gabriel Chukwuma. Sitade yakiriye imikino y'umupira w'amaguru ya NFPL Icyumweru cya 10. Ariko, Chief Gabriel Chukwuma yashimangiye kontagurishwa nk'iryo ryabayeho. Anavugako Dr. Patrick Ifeanyi Ubah yishyuye gusa ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru atari iyindi sitade nk'ikindi kigo.
M'Ukuboza 2015, Urukiko Rukuru rw’Intara y’Umurwa Mukuru (FCT) rwabujije Chief Gabriel Chukwuma kwivanga mu burenganzira bwa Dr. Patrick Ifeanyi Ubah na FC Ifeanyi Ubah bwo gukora nk’ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru no kwitabira shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru ya Nigeria (NPFL), nyuma y’uko uyumukinnyi wa mbere yavuzekoyigaruriye iyikipe kandi karimo kwitegura kwitabira shampiyona iri imbere.

Sitade Mpuzamahanga ya Enyimba ni sitade ikoreshwa mu buryo bwinshi i Aba, muri Nijeriya. Ubikoreshwa cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi ikora nk'ikibuga cya Enyimba FC nyuma yo kuvugururwa mu 2018, iyi sitade yakirabantu 16.000. Enyimba imaze kwegukana igikombe cy'umupira w'amaguru cya Nijeriya inshuro nyinshi. Enyimba FC yitabiriye imikino yomu rugo ingana na 3.496 mwirushanwa rya NPFL ryo mu 2023-24.

Sitade ya El-Kanemi nisitade ikoreshwan'abantu benshi i Maiduguri, muri Nijeriya. Ubu ikoreshwa cyanecyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandini sitade y'ikipe ya El-Kanemi Warriors. Sitade y'abantu 10.000 yitiriwumutegetsi wa Kanem-Borno Empire, Muhammad al-Amin al-Kanemi.

Sitade ya Eket Township nisitade ifitintego nyinshiherereye muri Eket, agace k'ubuyobozi bw'ibanze muri Leta ya Akwa Ibom, muri Nijeriya. Ebun Comets ni ikipe ya basketball yo muri Nijeriya, ifite icyicaro i Lagos. Ni imwe mu makipe afite amateka akomeye muri shampiyona ya Nijeriya.
Yegukanye shampiyona y'igihugu mu myaka ya 2000, harimo iya 2007, ndetse n'irushanwa rya Crown Elite Basketball Championship mu 2021.
Ebun Comets ni ikipe ifite amateka akomeye muri shampiyona ya Nijeriya, aho yasangiye ibikombe na Lagos Islanders mu gihe cy'imyaka igera kuri cumi n'itanu.
Mu ntangiriro z'umwaka w'imikino wa 2005–2006, Ebun Comets yari ifite igikombe cya shampiyona (Premier League), itozwa na Ayo Bakare. Mu 2007, yongeye kwegukana Premier League itsinze Union Bank amanota 74–64, ibona itike yo guhagararira Nijeriya mu marushanwa nyafurika.
Mu 2021, yageze ku mukino wa nyuma wa NBBF National Division One idatsinzwe, ihita izamurwa muri Premier League. Ku wa 14 Nyakanga 2021, yegukanye Crown Elite Basketball Championship itsinze Lagos Legends amanota 58–52.

["Bikenewe"] Imwemumakipe ya Nigeria yitwaye nezacyane, irushanwa muri Nigeria Women Premier League, ishami rinini ry’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore mugihugu. Bakinira imikino yaboyamu rugo kuri Sitade ya Stephen Keshi mumurwa mukuru wa Delta State Asaba. Umutozamukuru w’iyi kipe ubuni Peter Dedevbo.
Delta Queens yashinzwe na guverinoma ya Guverineri James Ibori muri Mutarama 2000. Ubuyobozi bw'iyi kipe bwari buyobowe na Komiseri wa Siporo, Solomon Ogba.

Sitade ya Bako Kontagora, izwikandi nka Minna Township Stadium, ni sitade ifitubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 5,000 i Minna, muri Nijeriya. Ubikoreshwa cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru. Niho Niger Tornadoes ituye. Mu 2017-18, Niger Tornadoes yitabiriye imikino yomu rugoyari 4,300 muri Sitade ya Bako Kontagora.
Leta ya Niger irimu igenamigambi ryokwagura ubushobozi bwa sitade ya Bako Kontagora bugera ku 30.000, icyakora, kubera kositade iri hagati mumujyi hamwe n'amazu yubatswe impande zose za sitade, ntamwanya munini wokwagura.

Ayodele "Ayo" Bakare (wavutse kuya 20 Werurwe 1960) numutoza wa basketball wabigize umwuga wo muri Nijeriya. Ubuni wemutoza mukuru wa Ebun Comets kandi amazimyaka myinshi atoza Nigeria.
Umwuga wo gutoza amakipe.
Bakare yabayeumutoza mukuru wa Ebun Comets muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere muri Nigeria.
Umwuga wo gutoza ikipe y'igihugu ya Nijeriya.
Bakare yahoze arumutozamukuru w'ikipe y'igihugu ya Basketball y'abagabo bakuru ya Nijeriya. Ikipeye ya Nijeriya yujujibisabwa kandi yitabiriye imikino Olempike yomumpeshyi ya 2012. Yeguye afite Umuyobozi wa Tekiniki w'amakipe mu 2014.

ಡಾ. ಶ್ರೀ. ಚಿತ್ರಭಾನು ಕೆ ಪೊದುವಾಲ್ (Dr. Shri Chithrabhanu K Poduval) ಅವರು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ, ಇಂಟ್ಯೂಟಿವ್ ಕನ್ಸಲ್ಟಂಟ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಆತ್ಮೀಯ ಸಲಹೆಗಾರರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇವರು ಕೇರಳ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಕಣ್ಣೂರು ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪಯ್ಯನ್ನೂರು ನಗರವನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವೇದ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ, ಗ್ರಹಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಟ್ಯೂಟಿವ್ (ಅಂತರ್ದೃಷ್ಟಿ) ಆಧಾರಿತ ವಿಧಾನಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವಾಣಿ ನೀಡುವ ಶೈಲಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಿತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಕ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ.
ಚಿತ್ರಭಾನು ಅವರು ಪಯ್ಯನ್ನೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಹೊಂದಿದ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು. ಬಾಲ್ಯದಿಂದಲೇ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ, ಮಂತ್ರ-ತಂತ್ರ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವೇದಾಧ್ಯಯನಗಳತ್ತ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ತೋರಿದರು. ಅವರ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿತು.
ಪಯ್ಯನ್ನೂರು ಪ್ರದೇಶವು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಶ್ರೀ ಸುಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣ್ಯ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ, ಪಯ್ಯನ್ನೂರುಗಾಗಿ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಪ್ರಭಾವದಿಂದ ಅವರು ವೇದ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯದತ್ತ ಆಕರ್ಷಿತರಾದರು.
ಅವರು ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಂಪರാഗത ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪರಿಣತಿ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಎಂದು ವರದಿಗಳು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
ಚಿತ್ರಭಾನು ಅವರು ಇಂಟ್ಯೂಟಿವ್ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಹಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳ ಗಣಿತೀಯ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ, ವೃತ್ತಿಜೀವನ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
ಕೆಲವು ವರದಿಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ವೇದ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಗಣನೀಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಪತ್ತೆಗೆ ಅವರು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ.
ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಗಮನಾರ್ಹತೆ.
ಚಿತ್ರಭಾನು ಅವರು 2014 ಮತ್ತು 2019ರ ಭಾರತದ ಲೋಕಸಭಾ ಚುನಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ ಅವರ ಜಯವನ್ನು ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವಾಣಿ ಮಾಡಿರುವುದಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆದಲ್ಲಿ "ದಿ ವೀಕ್" ಮಾಸಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಸಂದರ್ಶನ ಪ್ರಕಟಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.
2019ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1ರಂದು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಗ್ರಹ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯು ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೈವಿಕ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ನೀಡಿದ್ದರು. ನಂತರ ಈ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕೋವಿಡ್-19 ಮಹಾಮಾರಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೆಲವು ವರದಿಗಳು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
ಅವರು Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 ಮತ್ತು Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501 ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಸಹ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ಚಿತ್ರಭಾನು ಅವರು ಭಾರತ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಹೋಮ, ಹವನ ಹಾಗೂ ಆತ್ಮೀಯ ವಿಧಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೆರವೇರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರಾಚ್ಯ, ಯೂರೋಪ್, ರಷ್ಯಾ, ಜಪಾನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಮೇರಿಕಾ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಅನೇಕ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್‌ಗಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ಅವರು ಪರಂಪರাগত ವೇದ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸಿ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಶೈಲಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

Sitade ya Uyo Township ni sitade ikoreshwa muburyo bwinshiherereye i Uyo, umurwamukuru wa Leta ya Akwa Ibom, muri Nijeriya. Ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi ni sitade ya Akwa United FC yomuri Shampiyona y'Ubwongereza ya Nijeriya. Nin'ikigo cy'ibikorwa by'imiberehomyiza, umuco, politiki n'amadini. Igitaramo cya Noheli cya Akwa Ibom gikunzwe ngarukamwaka, gitegurwa na Guverinoma ya Leta ya Akwa Ibom, gihora giberakurisitade. Sitade iherereye hafi y'isoko rikomeye mu Mujyi wa Uyo, ryitwa Akpan Andem Market. Sitadifite ubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 5.000.
Imikino myinshi ya shampiyona yomugaceka Uyo n'inama za politiki biberahano.

Sitade ya Warri ni sitade ifitintego nyinshi i Warri, muri Nijeriya kumuhanda wa Cemetery. Ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandinihohasanzwe hacumbitse uwahoze ari ikipe ya Warri Wolves FC. Sitade yakiriyirushanwa ryanyuma rya Shampiyona y'Umupira w'Amaguru w'Abagore yo mu 2006 kandifite ubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 20.000, bose barebwa. Yavuguruwe kugirangihabwe igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'abatarengeje imyaka 17 cyo mu 2009.
Ibikoreshompuzamahanga byo gusiganwa ku maguru n'ibibuga byashyizwe murwegorwo gutegura amarushanwa y'imikino y'urubyiruko muri Afurika yomu 2013. Sisitemu yogupima interaya Timetronics Electronic Distance ni yo ya mbere ikoreshwa mu gihugu.

Tennis Rwanda Children’s Foundation (TRCF) ni umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta ufite icyicaro i Kigali mu Rwanda, ukaba warashinzwe n’umukinnyi wa Tennis w’icyamamare mu Rwanda, Umulisa Joselyne. Intego y’ingenzi y’uyu muryango ni ugukoresha umukino wa Tennis nka gihamya yo guhindura imibereho y’abana baturuka mu miryango itishoboye, haba mu buryo bw’umubiri n’ubw’imyitwarire.
= Intego n'indangagaciro =
TRCF igendera ku nkingi enye z’ingenzi: Ubucuti, Imyitwarire myiza mu mikino (Sportsmanship), Kubaha, n’Ubutariganya (Integrity).
Guha amahirwe abana bakeneye ubufasha, cyane cyane abo mu bice bikennye cyane mu Rwanda n’abo mu nkambi z’impunzi, binyuze mu kubigisha Tennis mu nzu z’imikino, ku bibuga by’imikino, n’ahandi hagenewe imyidagaduro.
Kwigisha abana ubumenyi ngiro bw’ubuzima bakura mu kibuga cya Tennis bakabwifashisha mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.
= Urutonde rw'inyandiko zifashishijwe =

Sitade ya Yakubu Gowon (yahozeari "Sitade ya Liberation") ni sitade ifitintego nyinshi irimugace ka Elekahia muri Port Harcourt, muri Nijeriya. Ubikoreshwa cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi ni sitade ya Rivers United FC, yahoze ari Dolphins FC. Sitade ifitubushobozibwo kwakira abantu 16.000.
Mu 2015, ryahinduriwe izina ry’uwahoze arumukuru w’igihugu wa gisirikare, Jenerali Yakubu Gowon.

Umuhango wo Kwerera umuntu witabye imana cyangwa wapfuye(gukura ikiriyo) mu mateka yu Rwanda ntaho byanditse igihe uwo muco watangiriye gusa numwe mihango y'ingenzi mu mibereho yabakurambere bacu bagize kandi nubu ukaba ugikorwa.
Uyu muhango washyiraga iherezo kugihe cy'icyunamo n'ishavu byo guherekeza uwitabye Imana, kumwerera rero byagaruraga umuryango mu buzima busanzwe.
Abakurambere bacu bizeragako iyo umuntu y'itabaga Imana byaturukaga ku mivumo cyangwa abazimu barakaye, gukura ikiriyo byari uburyo bwo guca uwo muvumo ngo utazakwira mu gihugu cyose cyangwa mu muryango.
Mu mateka umuhango wo Kwerera uwapfuye byakorwaga mu bwiru bukomeye, iyo umwami yabaga yaratanze ibyo bikatwereka ko uyu muco cyangwa uyu muhango umaze imyaka irenga magana inani (800) uriho, kuko abami bakuru bawukoraga.
Uyu muhango ku mugabo ukorwa byibura hashize igihe kitari munsi y'iminsi ine(4) naho umugore ntago byakorwa mbere y'iminsi itatu(3) nyuma yo ku mushyingura.
Ku bantu bazwi cyangwa abategetsi biratinda bategura uwo munsi wo Kwerera uwapfuye, Impamvu nyamukuru ituma habaho kwerera uwapfuye harimo: Kwiyeza kw'umuryango, gusubira mu mirimo n'ibindi.

Ntarugera Emmanuel, wamamaye cyane ku kabyiniriro ka Gisembe (yavutse mu mwaka wa 1961 – yicwa muri Kamena 1994), yari umukinnyi w'icyatwa w'umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda. Azwi cyane nk'inkingi ya mwamba mu ikipe ya Espoir BBC no kuba yarabaye icyitegererezo mu kuzamura impano z'abakiri bato mu myaka ya 1980 na 1990.
Ntarugera yakoraga muri Minisiteri y’Imirimo Rusange (MINITRAP) ariko akabifatanya no gukina umukino wa Basketball. Yari afite indeshyo ya metero ebyiri (2m), ibyatumaga akina mu mwanya wo hagati 'Pivot' (center), aho azwiho kuba yari umukinnyi ugoye guhagarikwa mu kibuga.
Yakinaga mu ikipe ya Espoir BBC, imwe mu makipe akomeye mu mateka ya Basketball y'u Rwanda, aho yafashije iyi kipe kwegukana ibikombe binyuranye, birimo n'irushanwa ryari ryateguwe na Hyundai mu myaka yo hambere.
Gisembe ntiyari azwiho gusa ubuhanga mu kibuga, ahubwo n’ubugiraneza no kwicisha bugufi. Amakuru aturuka kubo bakinanye, barimo Maître Munyangabe Pierre na Kabenga De Gaul, amuvuga nk'umuntu wahaga umwanya munini abato, akabigisha umukino wa basketbal kuri Club Rafiki i Nyamirambo nyuma y'akazi.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Gisembe yari mu bakinnyi ba Espoir BBC bagerageje guhungira muri Collège Saint André i Nyamirambo. Nubwo yagerageje kwihisha bitewe n'uko yari azwi cyane, yaje kwicwa muri Kamena 1994 muri Rwezamenyo, ajugunywa mu cyobo. Yishwe afite imyaka 33 y'amavuko.
Kugira ngo izina ryiwe n'umurage we bitazazima, nyuma ya Jenoside bagenzi be n'ishyirahamwe rya Basketball mu Rwanda batangije irushanwa ryo kumwibuka ryamenyekanye nka Gisembe Memorial Tournament. Iri rushanwa ryaje kwaguka riba iryo kwibuka abakinnyi, abatoza, n'abakunzi ba Basketball bose bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
= Urutonde rw'inyandiko zifashishijwe =

Bitumastic Football Club, mumagambo make, nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yomuri Uganda ikomoka i Kampala. Bakina mucyiciro cya kabiri cy'umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda, shampiyona nini ya Uganda.
Mu 1967 ikipeyatsinze irushanwa rya kabiri arinaryo ryanyuma ry’irushanwa ritazwi rya Ugandan Super League. Irushanwa ryemewe ryatangiye mu 1968.
Ubikipe ikinakuri sitade ya Muteesa II ifite ubushobozi bwogukiniraho mu 2020.
1967 – Icyiciro cy'ibanze

BIDCO Uganda Limited Jinja Football Club, na BUL Jinja FC, nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yo muri Uganda ikomoka i Jinja, mu Karere k'Iburasirazuba bw'igihugu. Iyikipe ifitwe na BIDCO Uganda Limited ifite icyicaro i Jinja. Bakina mucyiciro cyambere cy'umupira w'amaguru muri Uganda, shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere cya Uganda ndetse banakinira imikino yomurugo muri FUFA Technical Centre i Njeru.
Iyikipe yashinzwe hagati ya 2006 na 2007 nk'amarushanwa y'ishami rya Bidco Co. agamije inshingano z'ibigo mubijyanye nokwamamaza nokwamamaza Ibicuruzwa bya Bidco, binyuze muri ibyobateje imbere igitekerezo cyokujya mumakipe afitanyisano na Fufa.
Ikipe yakinnye muri FUFA Super League kunshuro yambere mu 2011, irangiza irikumwanya wa cumi na gatatu muricumi n'itandatu muri shampiyona y'uwomwaka w'imikino.
Ubuyobozi bw'ikipe bwambere bwayobowe na Rupesh, umufana w'umupira w'amaguru, na Rao Kodey warumubitsi w'ikigo akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru. Ubuyobozi buriho ububugizwe n'abayobozi b'ikipe Sankha Chatterjee na Leo Deng Hao, perezida Ronald Barente, Visi Perezida Martin Ocitti, umuyobozi mukuru w'ikipe Joseph Mutaka n'umuyobozi w'ikipe Alex Isabirye.
Kurubu ikipe ikinira kuri sitade ya Kakindu Municipal ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 1,000, aho basangiye n'indi kipe y'umupira w'amaguru, "Jinja Municipal Council Football Club".
Umutoza mukuru muri shampiyona ya shampiyona ya Uganda ya 2020/2021 ni Arthur Kyesimira, wigeze kubumukinnyi wo ku ruhande rw'ibumoso mwikipe y'igihugu ya Uganda, "Uganda Cranes". Abandibatoza b'ikipe barimo Peter Onen (umutozawungirije), David Kiwanuka (umutoza), na Bright Dhaira (umutozaw'abazamu).

Sitade ya Bunamwaya ni sitade ifitintego nyinshi irimu Mujyi wa Wakiso, muri Uganda. Ubu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu mikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi niyikibuga cya Bunamwaya SC yo muri Ugandan Super League. Iyi sitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 5.000.

Entebbe Cricket Oval nikibuga cya cricket, muri Entebbe, muri Uganda.
Muri Kanama 2021, ikibuga cyabereyemimikino ya 2021-22 Uganda Tri-Nation Series yahuje ikipe ya Uganda hamwe na Kenya na Nijeriya.
Ikibuga cyakiriyimikino 10 ya T20I kugeza ubu, ahwikipe yatsinze imikino itandatu, nahiyakabiri itsinze imikino itatu. Impuzandengo y'amanota yambere namanota 138.

FUFA Women Super League nimwe mumakipe akomeye y’umupira w’amaguru y’abagore mu gihugu cya Uganda, ikabayemejwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Uganda.
Mu 2019, shampiyona y’abagore yashyizwe mucyiciro cyakabiri cy’umupira w’amaguru w’abagore muri Uganda, FUFA Women Elite League yongeragushyirwa mucyiciro cyakabiri muri shampiyona y’abagore. Igihembwe cyambere cya shampiyona y’abagore yatangiranye n’amakipe 8, cyarangiye muburyobutunguranye muri Gicurasi 2020 kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Iyi shampiyona niyoyasimbuye shampiyona y’abagore ya Elite, yamaze imyaka itanu. Iyo shampiyona yakinwe mumatsinda y’uturere yakinnye imikino yokwishyura nyumaya shampiyona. Imikino yanyuma ya shampiyona yariyi:

Jinja North United FC nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda ifite icyicaro i Wakitaka / Namulesa Jinja City. Iyi kipe irushanwa muri FUFA Big League, shampiyona y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda yomucyiciro cyakabiri.
Iyikipe yashinzwe mu 2010 kugira ngihagararire abaturage bomumajyaruguru y'Umujyi wa Jinja n'uturere tuyikikije. Iyikipe yitabira amarushanwa ya FUFA, harimo FUFA Big League n'igikombe cya Uganda Cup.
Mugikombe cya Uganda cya 2021-22, Jinja North United yasezerewe na Maroons FC nyuma yo gutera penaliti nyumayokunganya 1-1 mu gihe cy’amategeko.
Mugihe cy'umwaka wa shampiyona ya FUFA Big League 2023-2024, iyikipe yitabiriye imikino itandukanye harimo n'aho yanganyije na Booma FC igitego 1-1.
Jinja North United ikinirimikino yayo yanyuma kukibuga cya Kyabazinga, giherereye i Bugembe, mu Mujyi wa Jinja. Iyisitade iberamo imikino ya shampiyona n'igikombe, ikabihuriweho n'amakipe menshi y'umupira w'amaguru murakokarere.
Itsinda rya tekiniki (2023- 2024).
Jinja North United FC iyoborwa n'ikipe ya tekiniki n'ubuyobozi ishinzwibikorwa by'umupira w'amaguru noguteza imbere abakinnyi.
Ikipe y'iyi kipigizwe ahanini n'abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru bomuri Uganda, bahuza abakinnyi b'inararibonye n'impano zikiri ntoya bakomoka mumakipe yomu gace batuyemo.

Kitara FC, izwikandi nka Kitara Football Club cyangwa The Royals, ni ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru y’ababigize umwuga yomuri Uganda ifiticyicaro i Hoima City. Ikina mucyiciro cya mbere cya shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru ya Uganda izwi nk'Uganda Premier League
Kitara FC yashinzwe mu 2010 n’abaturagebaho i Bunyoro babifashijwemo na Kabalega
Deo Kasozi niwuyoboye ikipe. Yafashe uyumwanya muri Nyakanga 2022, asimbuye Godfrey Bamwenda, wabaye perezida w’ikipe mugihe cy’imyaka 4 kuvamu 2018.
Kitara FC ikina by'agateganyo imikino yayoya nyuma murugo kuri sitade ya Hoima city.
Abafana ba Kitara FC murirusange bakomoka mukarere ka Bunyoro hamwe n'abandi bafana muri Uganda.

Igihembwe cya 2020/21
Kitara FC yasezerewe mucyiciro cyambere cya shampiyona ya Uganda ya 2020/21 mbere y'igihe nyuma y'icyorezo cya COVID-19 mur'Uganda, ifitamanota 13 mumikino 27 yakinnye.

Igihembwe cya 2023/24
Kitara FC yinjiye mumwaka mushya w'imikino, Umutoza Mukuru Brian Ssenyondo yegukanye igikombe cya Uganda Cup cya mbere muri Gicurasi 2024 ubwo yatsindaga NEC FC igitego 1-0 kuri Wankulukuku. Igitego cyatsinzwe n'umukinnyi wasimbuye Solomon Okwalinga mu gice cya kabiri kumunota wa 73. Umunyezamu wabo Jamil Kiyemba yatorewe kuba umukinnyi w'agaciro cyane ndetse n'umunyezamu mwiza w'irushanwa ryose ubwo Uganda Cup yizihizaga imyaka 50 imazishinzwe. Gutwara Uganda Cup byabemereye kobazitabira imikino y'ibanze ya CAF Confederation Cup, ahobatangiriye gukina kumugabane w'Afurika.
Barangije kumwanya wa kane muri shampiyona n'amanota 54 mu mikino 29, bamaze gutsinda imikino 16, banganya imikino 6 ndetse batsindwa imikino 7, bitumabarangiza barimunsi y'ikipe ya SC Villa irikumwanya wambere n'amanota 3 gusa.

Mukunzi Christophe (yavutse mu 1989) ni umukinnyi wa volleyball w’umunyarwanda wabigize umwuga, wamenyekanye cyane nka kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu ya volleyball y’u Rwanda ndetse n’uburyo yakinaga asatira anyuze ibumoso. Mukunzi yatangaje ko ahagaritse gukina volleyball nk'uwabigize umwuga ku wa 29 Mutarama 2024, amaze imyaka 18 muri uyu mukino.
= Amateka yerekeye siporo =
Mukunzi yatangiye kumenyekana muri volleyball mu makipe y’imbere mu gihugu nka Kigali Volleyball Club (KVC) na Gisagara Volleyball Club. Mu mwaka wa 2011, nibwo yatangiye gukina nk’uwabigize umwuga hanze y’u Rwanda (pro), asinyira ikipe ya Tarsana Club yo muri Libya.
Amakipe yakiniye hanze y'u Rwanda.

Amakipe yakiniye mu Rwanda.

Mu 2019, yinjiye mu ikipe ya REG (Rwanda Energy Group), naho mu mpera z’urugendo rwe yakiniraga ikipe ya Kepler, ari na yo yasezereyemo amaze kuyifasha kurangiza ku mwanya wa kane mu gikombe cy’akarere ka gatanu (CAVB Zone V Club Championship).

Kyetume Football Club nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru i Mukono, mur'Uganda ubikina muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere cya Uganda.
Hasigaye amezatatu ngo shampiyona ya 2018-19 ya FUFA Big League irangire, Kyetume FC yahayumutoza Allen Kabonge amasezerano y'amezi atatu kugira ngazamurwe muntera. Kabonge azwicyane mugutwara amakipe ane atandukanye yomucyiciro cya kabiri cya Uganda mucyiciro cya mbere.
Kyetume yajekwemererwa kujyamumikino ya nyuma ya FUFA Big League. Robert Ssentongo yatsinze igitego kimwe cyagatatu kuri Kyetume mumikino yanyuma yanyuma ya shampiyona, ikipe yatsinze Kansai Plascon ibitego 4-1, bituma ijyamucyiciro cya mbere cya Uganda kunshuro ya mbere mu mateka yayo.
Kyetume yahayakazi George "Best" Nsinga kugira ngwabe umutoza wabo mumwaka w'imikino wa 2019-20. Jackson Mayanja ubuniwe utozamukuru wabo.
Kyetume ikinira ahitwa Nakisunga Saaza Ground, ifitubushobozi bugera ku 1.000.

Lady Doves FC nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'abagore yo muri Uganda yitabira shampiyona y'abagore ya FUFA. Iyikipe ifiteicyicaro mumujyi wa Masindi.
Lady Doves FC yagiranye ubufatanye kumugaragaro n'ikipe ya Kitara FC yomuri Uganda. Ubu bufatanye bwashyizwe kumugaragaro nyumayogusinya amasezerano y'ubufatanye na perezida wa Kitara FC, Deo Kasozi na Nsingwire Godfrey, ba Lady Doves FC.
Lady Doves FC yegukanye $10000 nyuma yokumwanya wagatatu n'umudari wa bronze mu irushanwa rya mbere rya CAF Women's Champions League ryabereye mumurwa mukuru wa Kenya, Nairobi.
Mu 2022, Lady Doves FC yarangije umukinowayo idatsinzwe n'ikipe ya She Corporate kubitego 5 kubusa kurisitade ya Katusabe i Masindi.

Sitade ya Lugogo, izwikandi nka Lugogo Cricket Oval, nikibuga cya cricket kiri i Kampala, muri Uganda. Umukino wambere wafashwe amajwi wabereye kukibuga wabaye mu 1957 ubwo Abanya-Kenya Aziya bakinaga na Sunder Cricket Club. Yanamenyekanye cyane nk'ahantu habera ibitaramo byamuzika muri Uganda.
Muruwo mwaka Uganda yabanje gukoresha ikibuga ubwikipe y'igihugu yakinaga na Sunder Cricket Club. Ikibuga cyakoze umukino wambere w'icyiciro cya mbere ubwikipe ya East African Invitation XI yakinaga na Marylebone Cricket Club mu 1963.
Undimukino womucyiciro cyambere wakurikiyeho mu 1967 ubwo ikipe y' Afurika y'Iburasirazuba yakinaga n'Abahinde basuraga imikino. Imikino ikurikira yomu cyiciro cyambere yabereye ku kibuga ntiyageze mu 2005, ubw'Uganda yakinaga imikino ibirimuri Intercontinental Cup na Kenya na Namibia. Sitade ya Lugogo niyoyonyine muri Uganda yakoreyemo Cricket yo mu cyiciro cya mbere.
Ikibuga cya cricket gikikije ikibuga cya tennis n'ikibuga cy'umupira w'amaguru arinacyo kiberamo ikipe ya Kampala City Council FC.

Ikipe ya Mbarara United Football Club yarikipe y'umupira w'amaguru yomuri Uganda iherereye i Mbarara, muKarere ka Mbarara mu Burengerazuba bwa Uganda. Iyikipe yakinnyemuri shampiyona nini ya Uganda mumwaka wa 2009-10 ariko ubunta nyandiko za FUFA zemeza kiyi kipigikora.
Mbarara United FC yari imwemumakipe 8 yitabiriye shampiyona y’ibanze ya shampiyona y’igihugu ya mbere mu 1968-69, shampiyona ikaba ariyoyari ibanziriza shampiyona ya Ugandan Super League. Iyikipeyavuyemo nyumay’umwaka umwe kurwegorwohejuru arikimaze igihe 6 ikina umupira w’amagurumumyaka 9 mugihe cy’imyaka 40.
Baherukaga gukina muri Ugandan Super League mumwaka w'imikino wa 2008-09, kandintibari bameze nezakuko barangije kumwanya wa 14 n'amanota 35. Mumwaka wakurikiyeho wa 2009-10 binjiye muri Ugandan Big League, shampiyona nshya ya FUFA yomucyiciro cya kabiri, ariko ntacyo bahinduye muri Rwenzori Group. Umusaruro wabo wanyuma muri shampiyona ni intsinzi yaboyanyuma ya Masaka Municipal Council FC ku bitego 7-1. Iyikipe ntabwo yarikora mu myaka ishize.
Mbarara United FC yaterwaga inkunga n'abanyamuryango b'ikipe ndetse n'Inama Njyanama y'Umujyi wa Mbarara. Kubera ko Mbarara iherereye hafi y'umupaka w'amajyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'igihugu, ntibitangaje kubonabakinnyi b'abanyekongo basanzwe aribo bakunze kwigarurira ikipeyabo yambere.

Sitade ya Mutesa II ni sitade ifitintegonyinshi i Kampala, muri Uganda. Ubwikoreshwa cyane cyane mumikino y'umupira w'amaguru kandi niyikibuga cya Express FC yomuri Ugandan Super League. Iyi sitade ifitubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 20.200. Yitiriwe Mutesa II yo muri Buganda.

National Enterprise Corporation FC yitwa kandi NEC FC, nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya Uganda yashinzwe mu 2017 i Bugolobi, Kampala. Ikinamuri shampiyona y'icyiciro cya mbere cy'Uganda.
NEC FC yashinzwe mu 2017, izamurwamuntera ijyamuri FUFA mucyiciro cya 5 mu 2018 iyobowe n'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Nakawa.
Mu 2019, NEC FC yazamutse ijyamuri shampiyona y'akarere ya Kampala ivamucyiciro cya 4, nyumizamurwa ijyamuri FUFA Big League mu 2022 ahoyaje kumwanya wagatatu kurutonde rwa shampiyona bityizamuka muri shampiyona y'icyiciro cyambere cy'Uganda.
NEC FC yazamutse mur'Uganda Premier League shampiyona ya 2023/24 kunshuro yayoya mbere nyumayo kurangiza kumwanya wagatatu kurutonde rw'amakipe yakinnye muri FUFA Big League n'amanota 57 mu mikino 30 yakinnye, Julius Walugembe yatsinze ibitego 2 hamwe na Marvin Kavuma na Tonny Kiberu batsinze igitego kimwe buriwese bituma batsinda ibitego 4 byose hamwe, byatumyebatsinda kandibakazamuka.

Tooro United FC nikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ikomoka muri Uganda ya Fort Portal ubikinira mu cyiciro cyambere cya Star Times Uganda Premier League.
Iyikipe yashinzwe mu 2007 yitwa Soana FC, yakinnye kukibuga cya Kavumba i Wakiso. Iyikipe yitiriwikigo cy’ishoramari.
Soana yazamutse mucyiciro cyakabiri cya Ugandan Super League mu 2013. Bahisebiyubaka ubwobatsindaga imikino ine yambere y'uyu mwaka w'imikino, amaherezo babonumwanya wa gatanu.
Mumwaka wa 2018, Perezida w'ikipe wakomokaga mukarere ka Tooro mur'Uganda, yafashe icyemezo mazeyimurira ikipemuri Fort Portal.
Kuva icyogihe, Smart Obed yagurishije iyikipe kuri Mdm Alice Namatovu, wayoboye iyikipe kuva muri Big League kugeza kuri Star Times Uganda Premier League. Kubuyobozi bushya, iyikipe irimo kuva ku kuba umunyeshuri utarabigize umwuga ijya kukigo cy’imikino cyabigizumwuga. Perezida wa Mdm Alice Namatovu afitigitekerezo cyokuyihinduramo ikipe nyayo y’imikino, imeze nk’iyo kurwego mpuzamahanga.
Ikipe ubikinira kukibuga cy'imikino cya Buhinga gifite ubushobozi bwokwakira abantu 5000 i Fort Portal mukarere k'Iburengerazuba bwa Uganda.

Uganda yoherejitsinda ry’abahagarariye abandi mumarushanwa ya Paralympic yomu mpeshyi yomu 1976 yabereye i Toronto, muri Ontario, muri Kanada. Igihugucyinjiyemo umukinnyi umwe gusa, wahatanye mumikino ngororamubiri. Ntamudariyatsindiye.
Uganda yitabiriyimikino ya Paralympic, arikontabwo yitabiriye imikino Olempike yomumpeshyi yo mu 1976, kukoyitabiriye imikino yomur'Afurika yokwiyamamaza muri uwomwaka.
Nibwo bwanyuma Uganda yagaragaye muriyi mikino ya Paralympic y'impeshyi mbereya 1996.

Uganda yoherejitsinda ry’abahagarariye abandi mumarushanwa ya Paralympic yomumpeshyi yo mu 1996 yabereye i Atlanta, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika. Bityo, icyo gihugu cyagarutse mu mikino ya Paralympic yo mu mpeshyi nyuma y’imyaka makumyabiri kitagaragara. Cyakinjije umukinnyi umwegusa, wahatanye muguterura ibiremereye. Ntabwoyatsindiye umudari.

Ubupfumu mu Rwanda, ni umuco w'abanyarwanda kuva mu Rwanda rwohambere aho wari umuco gakondo, habaga harimo ibintu bitandukanye aha twavuga kuraguza, ubumaji, guhamura, guterekera, byabaga ari uburyo bwabo bwo gusenga, kumenya ibyabaye, ibizaba, ndetse no gukemura ibibazo mu muco w'i Rwanda byafatwaga nko gusenga.
Ubupfumu bwakorwaga n'abantu bitwa abapfumu, bakaba bari kuraguza, bikaba ari ibikorwa byakorwaga n’abanyarwanda bohambere hafi ya bose kuva ku mwami kugeza kubaturage ba giseseka, kugirango icyo bakora cyose bamenye niba bazagira intsinzi cyangwa ihirwe. Kuraguza cyangwa kuragura kw’abanyarwanda ba cyera ntabwo bwari ukuyoba, bitihise ibikorwa by’ubujiji nk’uko benshi babyumva. Cyari igikorwa kigaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bitanga kubikorwa by'imana yabo aho, bifuza kumenya uko bahagaze, kumenya icyerekezo ndetse n'ibindi byose bifuzaga kumenya.

Guterekera Mu Rwanda ni umuhango wo mu Rwanda rwohambere aho abakurambere babikoreshaga mu gusaba imbaraga cyangwa inama ku myuka ya ba sekuruza babo babaga batakiriho, babagisha inama, babaza itsinzi,cyangwa ikindi kintu cyose cyerekeranye ibihe byarangiye.
Umuhango wo guterekera ubundi ni bumwe mu bwoko bwo guterekera ubwoko bw'ubupfumu n'imyizerere byabakurambere bo mu Rwanda bukubiyemo rwabaga bukubiyemo ibintu byinshi bitandukanye, byenda gusa no kubandwa cyangwa guhamura.

Kuraguza mu Rwanda ni bumwe m' uburyo bw'imizerere bwo hambere mu bakurambere bu Rwanda bwabaga ari kureba kure cyangwa se kubona imbaraga zidasanzwe binyuze munzira zizwi za gipfumu. Kuraguza nawo ni umwe mu mico yarangaga abakurambere mu kwambaza.
Kera hariho abapfumu rero bakoresheje ibikoresho bigiye bitandukanye rwose ariko bigaterwa nahantu cyangwa abantu, aha twavuga, haba ari inyama zo mu nda z’inyamaswa cyangwa se n’iz’abantu, cyangwa sebakitegereza neza ukuntu inkoko itora hasi. Hari n’abakoreshaga ibibabi by’icyayi cyangwa imbuto z’ikawa.
Kuraguza ubu muri iki gihe bisa nibyajemo ibintu byinshi bisa naho ari ubutekamutwe cyangwa ubujura, aho muri iki gihe bakoresha wenda amakarita y’ubupfumu, utubumbe tw’ibirahuri byangiye bisigare mu bikoresho by'okubaka n’ibindi kugira ngo bamenye ibizaba ku muntu cyangwa baamenye amakuru atari asazwe azwi.

Ubuvuzi bwa gakondo cyangwa ubupfumu ni imwe mumihango yarangaga abanyarwanda ba kera, nka bimwe by'abafasha mu kuvura irwara bakaba bari baziko hari ibiti bivura, imizi y'ibiti, uruvange rw'ibyatsi n'ibindi...
Ubuvuzi bwa gakondo bukoresha ibikoresho bigiye bitandukanye ndetse no muburyo butandukanye harimo Kuragura umenye inzitizi mbere yo gukora igikorwa runaka, mu bikoresho harimo inka ku bami, inkoko, inzuzi, amavuta, n’urugimbu, ndetse Byifashishwaga mu gusaba umugeni, gukiza indwara, no kumenya ibizaba, rero ubupfumu cyangwa ubuvuzi bw'a gakondo bemeraga ko bafite impano ivuye ku ba kurambere ba ba sekuruza cyangwa ku Mana y'i Rwanda yabihereye.

Abavuzi Gakondo batandukanye na abapfumu ndetse n'abahanuzi, aba ni abantu bafite ibyo bakora bituma babita ayo mazina bose ntibitwa abapfumu kuko abavuzi bagihanga bamwe bishingikiriza cyangwa bizerera ku miti y'ibyatsi, naho abapfumu bishingikiriza mu ku baragurira inzuzi ndetse n'imbaraga zidasanzwe, Abahanuzi bafite impano yo kubona ibitabonwa na bose.
AGA ni Ihuriro nyarwanda rigizwe n'abanyarwanda ndetse n'abanyarwandakazi ry’abavuzi gakondo babarizwa mu Rwanda, ndetse abavuzi gakondo bakaba ari bamwe mu bemewe mu Rwanda mubufatanya n'abavuzi ba kizungu amagara.

ADEPR Rwanda ni rimwe mu ma torero agize Itorero rya ADEPR, nubwo ryatangiye mu Rwanda ariko rikorerA no mubindi bihugu, nka ADEPR Uganda, ADEPR Europe, ADEPR mu bubirigi.
Itorero rya ADEPR rimaze imyaka 82 rigeze mu Rwanda, aho ryatangiriye muntara y'uburengerazuba, kuri ubu rifte abayoboke basaga miliyoni 3. ADEPR iyoboye na pasiteri umushyumba mu kuru ni Ndayizeye Isaïe hamwe na Rutagarama Eugene umushyumba w'ungirije.

Ndayizeye Esaie ni umugabo akaba ari umunyarwanda ari kandi n'Umushumba Mukuru w'Itorero rya Pantekoti mu Rwanda rya ADEPR.
Ndayizeye Esaie afite umugore n'abana abahungu n'abakobwa,afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n'Uburezi, yabaye kandi umuyobozi wa Hope International Rwanda ndetse mbere yaho yari yabaye umuyobozi w'agashami gashinzwe kuzigama no kugurizanya muri uwo muryango.
Ndayizeye Esaie akaba yaratorewe kuyobora ADEPR nk'u mushumba Mukuru ku wa 25 Nzeri 2021, muri manda y’imyaka itandatu. Mbere yo gutorwa, yari yabanje kuyobora iri torero mu gihe cy'inzibacyuho kuva mu Ukwakira 2020.

Rutagarama Eugene ni Umushumba Mukuru Wungirije mu itorero rya ADEPR, akaba ari umwe mubafasha gushaka amavugurura muri iryo torero.
Rutagarama Eugene Pasiteri Rutagarama Eugene yize amashuri agiye atandukanye aha twavugako afite afite amashuri cyangwa afite icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu mu bijyanye n'imisoro (Taxation), ndeste icyiciro cya kabili cya kaminuza mu icungamutungo, kandi arimo kwiga amasomo y'ikirenga mu bijyanye n'iyobokamana.
Pasiteri Rutagarama Eugene imirimo yakoze muri Leta hari mu kigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe imisoro n'amahoro mu myanya itandukanye irimo kuba umugenzuzi mukuru w'imari n'umuyobozi w'ishami rishinzwe imisoro.
Pasiteri Rutagarama Eugene yabaye umuyobozi wa komite nyobozi ya ADEPR mu mujyi wa Kigali ndetse n'umuyobozi w'inama y'ubuyobozi ya Dove Hotel. ubu ni umuyobozi Wungirije guhera mu mwaka wa 2020 mu gihe cy'inzibacyuho, no mu mwaka wa 2021 atorwa burundu nk'umuyobozi w'ungirije wa ADEPR yungirije Pasiteri Ndayizeye Isaie.

kubandwa Imana mu Rwanda ni umuhango wakorwaga n'abakurambere b'u Rwanda ubahuza n'imana yabo, ubundi kubandwa kwari ukugaragaza ikimenyetso cyuko wa buyobotse, aha rero hakabamo imigenzo ihuza abantu n’imana, ndetse bityo ikanahurizamo abanyarwanda mu rukundo n’ubutwererane yabo. Imandwa ni zo zari zishyigikiye idini gakondo ikore neza.
Kubandwa bimeze nko kubatizwa muri iki gihe, na byo byari ukugaragaza ubuyoboke mu idini wahisemo. Ni umuhango wakorwaga ugamije kwimakaza ubusabane hamwe n' ubumana n’ubumuntu mu Banyarwanda bohambere, ni umuhango wadutse ku ngoma ya Ruganzu Ndoli, utangizwa ku ngoma y’umuhungu we Mutara Nsoro Semugeshi. Imigenzo isobetse yakorwaga mu muhango wo kubandwa Imana, ni yo yatumaga urushaho gukomera no gushinga imizi mu mitima y’Abanyarwanda.

Kunywana mu Rwanda ni igihango cyo kunywana, ari byo bakunze kwita guca ku nda, Ni umugenzo wakorwaga n’abantu babiri cyangwa se batatu cyangwa se barenze, byo gushaka kugaragaza ko bazakundana mu bwubahane bakabana neza mu mubano uzira guhemukirana, akaba ari umuhango nshimangira bumwe mu bantu, akaba ari ubudahemuka n’urukundo y’abanyarwanda.
Kunywana ubundi byari igihango cyangwa se kunywana, buri muntu mu bifuza kunywana amaraso, aha bacagana indasago ku nda, undi agafata amaraso ahavuye akayanywa, n’undi akabigenza atyo, rero mu kunywa ayo maraso hari n'amagambo y’indahiro babwiranaga hagati ya bo, aho bagiraga bati ndahiye imbere y’imana y’i Rwanda ko ntazatatira igihango tugiranye, ningitatira kizansame., usibye no kunywana igihango kw’abanyarwanda hagati ya bo, Umunyarwanda yashoboraga no kukinywera igihugu cye, akiyemeza kugipfira.

guhana Inka ni igihango cyo mu muco nyarwanda aho bahana Inka, ni igihango cyaremwe cyera cyane na Gihanga ahasaga mu mwaka yi 1100, ubwo yashyiraga Inka mu bigomba kwifashishwa mu mushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda cyane mu gisata cyari cyerekeye ububanyi n’amahanga.
Guhana Inka ni igihango cyo kugabirana Inka kiba hagati y’Umunyarwanda n’Inka, cyangwa se igihugu cye, umunyarwanda mugenzi we, umunyamahanga ukunda u Rwanda n’igihugu cye, Hanyuma umutunzi w’amashyo n’amagana, akaba yayifatiraho agirana igihango n’abandi, Igihango cyo guhana Inka, cyabanzirizwaga n’uko buri Munyarwanda na we agomba guhana igihango n’Inka kugira ngo zimukundire abashe kuzorora zororoke.

Guhana abageni ni gihango kirakomeye mu muco no mukwemera kwa banyarwanda, kuko kiva mu miryango ubwayo kigakomereza kuyahanye abageni, kigafata no ku bashyingiranywe ubwabo. rero Kurongorana k’umugore n’umugabo, ni umugenzo uri mu kwemera kwakera cyane aho bidasaza kugeza ku myaka ibihumbi n’ibihumbagiza, kuko gikomereza ku rubyaro rwabo. nimwe bigasabako babanza kuraguza cyangwa bagaterekera ngo bamenyeko indagu zibyemera.
umugeni baragurije inzuzi zikamwemera nabo mu muryanho bahita bamwemera, bakabashyigira urugo rugakomera, ndetse nabo bakabyemera batyo ko imana yabo babyemeye.

Igihango nkuko ibitabo bibisobanura mu kinyamakuru Igihe, ni amahame ngengamitekerereze na ngengamigenzereze, ya abakurambere bashyizemo imitsindo yo kubanisha abanyarwanda mu mibereho izira icyasha, Ibyo bihango, abakurambere mpangarwanda bari barabikagiriyemo imbaraga nyinshi zihambaye ku buryo ubirenzeho, bimusama agapfa.
hari ibihango by’Abanyarwanda, bari bazi neza bigera kuri bitanu, Uwaramukaga arenze ku masezerano yagiranye n’undi, igihango cyaramusamaga agapfa. Ibyo byarushagaho gutuma Abanyarwanda baziririza umugenzo wo guhana igihango, kandi bakanawukunda kuko wabafashaga guhamya ubwizerane hagati yabo.

Ibyatangajwe bisobanuye ko Yoweri Museveni w'imyaka 81 atorewe manda ya karindwi yikurikiranya nka perezida wa Uganda izatuma aguma ku butegetsi kugeza muri bibiri namirongo itatu(2031).
Ibyavuye mu matora bitangajwe nyuma y'iminsi itanu internet ikuweho muri Uganda.
Internet yasubijweho muri Uganda hashize amasaha bitangajwe ko Yoweri Museveni yatsinze amatora ya perezida.Internet yari yakuweho na leta ku wa kabiri w'iki cyumweru ivuga ko ari mu rwego rwo kwirinda ikwirakwira ry'amakuru yibihuha cyangwa se atari yo hamwe no kurinda umutekano w'igihugu.
Ishami rya ONU ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu ryamagaye iki gikorwa cyo kuvanaho interinet rivuga ko "giteye inkeke zikomeye".
Yari inshuro ya kabiri abategetsi ba Uganda bakuyeho internet mu gihugu mu matora ku mpamvu bavuga ko ari iz'umutekano. Ibi byakozwe bwa mbere mu 2021 bigira ingaruka ku barenga miliyoni 10 bayikoresha.
Bobi Wine n'abo mu ishyaka rye NUP bavuga ko gufunga internet "bigamije gukora uburiganya mu matora, isi itareba ibirimo kuba".
Kubera kubura internet mu gihugu byagoye BBC n'ibindi binyamakuru byigenga kugenzura ibyabaye mu matora no kugenzura ibyayavuyemo.
Komisiyo y'amatora yavuze ko abatoye bose hamwe ari abantu miliyoni 11.3 bangana na 52% by'abari biyandikishije gutora. Iyi komisiyo ivuga ko amajwi agera ku bihumbi 275 yabaye impfabusa, ayo akangana na 2.4%.

Perezida Maduro wa Venezuela yafatiwe mu gitero cy’igisirikare cya Amerika.
Perezida wa Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Donald Trump, yatangaje ko Perezida Nicolas Madulo wa Venezuela n’umugore we bafashwe bakajyanwa hanze y’igihugu cyabo aho akaba ari muri America, bikaba byabaye ubwo igisirikare cya Amerika cyagabaga ibitero bikomeye mu murwa mukuru wa Venezuela, Caracas mu ijoro ryakeye ry’uyu wa Gatandatatu tariki 3 Mutarama 2026.
Ibi bitero by’igisirikare cya Amerika byanibasiye ibikorwa bya gisirikare bitandukanye muri Caracas, ndetse no mu zindi Leta za Venezuela zirmo Miranda, La Guaira na Aragua, nk’uko amakuru aturuka muri iki gihugu yabitangaje cya Venezuela.
Ibi bibaye nyuma y’umwuka mubi umaze igihe hagati y’ibihugu byombi, aho Perezida Trump ashinja Maduro kuba ari we uyoboye abari mu ruhererekane rw’abacuruza ibiyobyabwenge, bituruka muri Venezuela byinjira muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Ibi birego ariko Perezida Maduro arabihakana, ahubwo agashinja Trump gushaka kumuhirika ku butegetsi, kugira ngo yigarurire umutungo kamere uri mu butaka bwa Venezuela, wiganjemo peteroli.
Ku wa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru, na bwo igisirikare cya Amerika cyatangaje ko cyarashe ubwato bwa Venezuela bwari buri mu mazi, aho cyavugaga ko bwari butwaye ibiyobyabwenge, icyo gitero kikaba cyaraguyemo abantu batanu.
Muri rusange, Amerika imaze kugaba ibitero birenga 30 ku hantu hatandukanye ivuga ko hari ibiyobyabwenge, ibyo bikaba biri mu muganbi mugari wa Trump wiswe ‘intambara ku biyobyabwenge’, bikaba bimaze kugwamo abantu basaga 110, kuva igitero cya mbere cyagabwa ku bwato bwa Venezuela ku itariki 2 Nzeri 2025, nk’uko BBC yabitangaje.
Ibi bitero kuri Venezuela, byatangiye hari hashize amezi make Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zongereye ibikorwa bya gisirikare mu birwa bya Caraïbes, zikavuga ko ziteguraga guhangana na Leta ya Perezida Maduro, zifata nk’umuyobozi w’igihugu utemewe, ariko kandi zivuga ko ari mu bacuruza ibiyobyabwenge.
Nicolas Maduro yayoboye Venezuela kuva ku itariki 19 Mata 2013, asimbuye Hugo Chávez na we utaracanaga uwaka na Amerika, wari umaze kwitaba Imana ndetse yari anabereye Visi Perezida. Maduro yongeye gutorerwa kuyobora iki gihugu mu 2018 ndetse no mu 2024, aho hose ariko amatora yaranzwe n’umwuka mubi, wanatumye iki gihugu gisubira inyuma mu bukungu nubwo gikize kuri peteroli.

Kuragura mu Rwanda ni umuhango ukorwa n'abapfumu, aho akabukira inzuzi akazitera impagarike, Iyo umupfumu ateye inzuzi zikikaraga ku mbehe, zigahindukiza imitwe zikarebana n'izindi nzovu zo haruguru ziba zeze bikaba ari ubuhoro.
Umupfumu akabukira inzuzi akazitera impagarike maze zabarara zikagwa kure inyuma y'imbehe zikaba ziterereje umuzimu w'umugabo waguye kure. Iyo ziguye zubaraye, zimwe ziteretse hejuru y'izindi ziba zishaka ko uwo mugabo abagirwa inka. Iyo Kanantuku ibaraye ikava ku mbehe, ikagwa i bumoso, iba imuterereje umuzimu w'umukobwa waguye kure y'iwabo, yaba igiye mu rukinga ngo ni umukobwa wapfuye atarongowe yabishakaga. Naho rero iyo kanantuku ibaraye hasi i buryo ikaba imuterereje umuzimu w'umugabo waguye kure.

Phoebe Kanyange ni umunyapolitiki wo mu Rwanda, ubu akaba ari umwe mu bagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Rwanda mu Mutwe w’Abadepite. Muri Nzeri 2016 yasimbuye Christine Mukabunani ku mwanya w’umuvugizi w’Ihuriro ry’Igihugu ry’Imitwe ya Politiki (National Consultative Forum of Political Organisations).
Hari uduce tumwe na tumwe tudafite amazi n’amashanyarazi. Ibi ni byo nzashyira imbere mu byo nzitaho cyane nintorwa.
Phoebe Kanyange yabaye umwe mu bayobozi bakomeye mu Ishyaka PSP (Party for Solidarity and Progress) aho yigeze kuba Perezida waryo. Azwi nk’umunyapolitiki ufite uburambe, wagize uruhare mu guteza imbere imiyoborere n’imikoranire y’imitwe ya politiki mu Rwanda. Yagize uruhare mu biganiro n’ibikorwa by’imitwe ya politiki hagamijwe kubaka demokarasi n’ubwumvikane hagati y’amashyaka. Mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, yagize uruhare muri komite zitandukanye, zirimo izirebana n’imiyoborere n’uburinganire.

Chantal Butare ni umunyarwandakazi w’umushoramari mu buhinzi n’ubworozi uzwi cyane kubera ibikorwa bye byo guteza imbere aborozi n’abagore bo mu cyaro. Yavukiye kandi akurira mu Rwanda, aho yakuriye abona ko ubuhinzi n’ubworozi ari inkingi y’imibereho y’abaturage benshi.Yari afite imyaka 21 mu mwaka wa 2015 igihe yatoranywaga mu rubyiruko rw’abashoramari bato muri Afurika..
Mu gihe yari umunyeshuri muri kaminuza y'u Rwanda, yatangiye gutekereza ku buryo yafasha abaturage bo mu cyaro cyane cyane abagore bahabwa inka muri gahunda ya Girinka ariko bakagira ikibazo cyo kubona amasoko y'amata yabo.
