Uyu mushinga we wafashije abarenga 3,000 borora kubona amasoko y’amata yabo kandi unatanga akazi ku bantu bakora mu gukusanya amata.
“Icyerekezo cyanjye ni ugufasha kurwanya ubukene n’inzara mu bantu batishoboye bo mu muryango mugari wanjye.”

Amasunzu mu Rwanda yari imisatsi yabaga ku mitwe yabanyarwanda cyangwa abanyarwandakazi, ikaba ari ikimenyetso cy'umuco mu Rwanda, berekane ko bafite icyubahiro, ari intwari, ububasha cyangwa ko bakomeye. Gusa nanone abangavu cyangwa urubyiruka na bo bayiyogosheshaga bakurure abantu ko bagejeje igihe cyo gushyingirwa no kurongorwa.
Amasunzu yari afite imiterere itangaje ndetse ubwayo nk'amasunzu ntiyari imisatsi isanzwe, akaba yari imisatsi yo goshwaga mu buryo bugezweho ku mpande z'umutwe muri icyo gihe cya cyera mu bakurambere, yabaga izinze muburyo budasanzwe habaga hari n'izamuye. Hariho uburyo busaga 30 bwari buzwi bwo gutera amasunzu.
Amasunzu yari imisatsi barwaga cyane naba kera mu muco gakondo, ku bakuru b'imisozi, abagabo b'intwari, ndetse n'ingimbi n'abangavu.

Imigara mu Rwanda ni ibyambarwa bya cyera aho yari imyenda ikozwe mu mpu yambarwaga n'abagabo, cyangwa ibishishwa by'ibiti aho yabaga ifite umwanya wihariye mu muco wa kinyarwanda.
Ubundi Umugara wabaga ukoze mu binusu birebire, bakabikata bakabisekura cyangwa se bakabikubita bakoresheje igiti cyangwa ibuye nyuma bakaza kubyoza mu mazi menshi ubundi bakabyanika, bakabona ku bikoresha.

Abanyarwanda ba kera dukomokaho bari bafite uburyo bakoraga imyambaro bambara mubikoresho bitandukanye haba mu mpu z’inyamaswa, mu bishishwa by’ibiti nk’ibivumu n’ibivovo by’insina. Bifashishaga ubumenyi gakondo mu gukora imyambaro myiza, yerekana indangagaciro z’umuco na kirazira hari imyambaro bari bafite twavuga.

Inkanda mu muco nyarwanda ni imyenda yabaga ikoze mu ruhu rw'inka rutunganyije cyane, ni imyenda igaragaza umuco cynagwa umwambaro gakondo w'ambarwaga n'abakobwa ndetse na bagore bo mu Rwanda mu bakurambere bi gihugu, ikaba yari imyambaro y'icyubahoro n'umurimbo, yambarwaga n'abagore bashatse vuba.
Inkanda ni imyambarire y'abaga yambarwa na abagore aho bayikenyeraga mu mabere bayambaye, maze bagasokoza imisatsi yabo yu uruhanika cyangwa amasunzu, yarwambaraga mu birori bagirango bagaragaze umuco nyarwanda.

Uruyonga mu muco nyarwanda ni imwe mu myambaro yagiye igaragaza umuco nyarwanda, ni umwe mu myambaro gakondo yambarwaga n’urubyiruko rwo mu Rwanda rwo hambere, nk’ikimenyetso cy’uburanga, icyubahiro, n’isuku.
Uruyonga ubundi ni mwambaro ugaragaza uburyo ingimbi zo hambere zubahaga umuco wazo mu myambarire, itandukanye n’imyambaro y’uyu munsi nk'uko bigaragazwa n'ubushakashatsi bw'Inteko y'Umuco, uruyonga yambarwaga n'ingimbi mu birori, imbyino, n'imikino byabaga bitandukanye.

Uruhu rw’ingwe ni uruhu rwari umwambaro mu bakurambere bu Rwanda kuva kera, ni uruhu rwi nyamaswa yitwa ingwe, ikaba ari inyamaswa ifite uruhu rugira amabara meza, amabara y'umuhondo, umweru cyangwa umukara. uru ruhu rukaba rwambarwaga n'abafite ubushobozi byarerekaga icyubahiro.

Gushikisha mu Rwanda, ni igikorwa cyo gusura abapfumu cyangwa abashitsi ufite intego yo kuraguza, gusobabanuza ibyahishwe, cyangwa kumenya ibizaba ukoresheje imbaraga z'imyuka itandukanye.
Gusjikisha ubundi bikunze gukorwa n'abashaka kuvugana n'abantu bapfuye cyangwa gushaka ubufasha mu bapfuye haba ibitekerezo, imbaraga cyangwa ibindi.

Nyiramavugo Kankazi Radegonde yavukiye mu Rwanda mu mpera z’ikinyejana cya 19 (hafi mu myaka ya 1880). Yakuriye mu muryango w’abanyacyubahiro mu bwami bw’u Rwanda, aho yize indangagaciro z’umuco nyarwanda zirimo ubutwari, ubwenge mu gutanga inama, n’ubuyobozi.
Yaje gushyingirwa n’Umwami Yuhi V Musinga, wari warabaye umwami w’u Rwanda kuva mu 1896 kugeza mu 1931. Mu muryango wabo ni ho havutse umuhungu wabo Mutara III Rudahigwa mu 1911.
Uruhare rwe mu bwami bw’u Rwanda
Nyiramavugo Kankazi yari azwiho kugira ubwenge n’ubushishozi mu gutanga inama. Yafashaga cyane umuhungu we mu miyoborere y’igihugu. Abanditsi b’amateka bavuga ko yakundaga kuganira n’umwami akamugira inama ku bibazo by’igihugu no ku miyoborere myiza.
Yagize kandi uruhare mu bintu byinshi byabereye mu bwami, harimo:
Ku wa 17 Ukwakira 1943, Nyiramavugo Kankazi hamwe n’umuhungu we Mutara III Rudahigwa babatijwe muri Kiliziya Gatolika i Kabgayi Cathedral.
Muri icyo gihe ni bwo yahise ahabwa izina rya gikirisitu Radegonde. Icyo gikorwa cyabaye ikintu gikomeye mu mateka y’u Rwanda kuko cyari igihe umwami n’umugabekazi bemeraga ku mugaragaro ukwemera kwa gikirisitu.
Igihe umuhungu we yari ku ngoma.
Mu 1931, abakoloni b'Ababiligi bakuye Yuhi V Musinga ku ngoma, maze umuhungu we Mutara III Rudahigwa aba umwami mushya w'u Rwanda.
Nyuma yaho, Nyiramavugo Kankazi yabaye umugabekazi(Queen mother). Yakomeje kuba hafi y'umuhungu we, amugira inama ku miyoborere n'iterambere ry'igihugu.
Mu 1959, igihe Umwami Rudahigwa yapfiraga i Bujumbura mu Burundi, Nyiramavugo Kankazi yagize uruhare mu gucyura umurambo we ukazanwa mu Rwanda kugira ngo ashyingurwe mu cyubahiro.
Imico n’indangagaciro zamurangaga.
Nyiramavugo Kankazi yari azwiho:
Abantu benshi bamwibuka nk’umugore w’ubwenge n’icyubahiro mu bwami bw’u Rwanda.
Imvugo cyangwa ijambo rimuvugwaho (Quote).
Mu mateka y’u Rwanda, Nyiramavugo Kankazi akunze kuvugwaho amagambo agaragaza uruhare rwe mu kuyobora no kugira inama umwami.
Urugero rw’imvugo imusobanura:"“Umugabekazi Nyiramavugo Kankazi yari inkingi y’ubwenge n’inama mu bwami, aho yakundaga gufasha umwami gufata ibyemezo byiza ku gihugu.”"(Iyi mvugo ikoreshwa n’abanditsi b’amateka mu gusobanura uruhare rwe.)

Gusaba umugeni ni umwe mu mihango ikomeye cyane mu muco nyarwanda uba mbere y’ubukwe bwo mw'idini cyangwa itorero. Ni umuhango aho umuryango w’umusore ujya gusaba umukobwa mu muryango we, bakaganira ku mubano w’abana babo no ku bijyanye n’ubukwe.
Ibikorwa bibanziriza gusaba umugeni.
Umusore abanza kubwira ababyeyi be ko ashaka kurongora cyangwa gushaka umugore. Umuryango w’umusore uhitamo abavugizi cyangwa abakuru bu muryango aribo bakunze kwitwa abasaza (abantu bavuga mu muhango), ubundi bakamenyesha umuryango w’umukobwa umunsi bazaziraho gusaba.
Kugera mu rugo rw’umukobwa no gutangira umuhango wo gusaba umugeni.
Umuryango w’umusore ugera mu rugo rw’umukobwa witwaje impano arizo zizwi nkibisabishwa akenshi haba harimo ibiseke birimo ibiribwa, inkangara irimo inzoga ya kinyarwanda isaba umugeni, ibyo kunywa, amasuka abiri(2) harimo isuka na majagu, akananjoro kahira ubwatsi nikibumbiro n’ibindi.Abavugizi b’impande zombi batangira ikiganiro mu mvugo y’umuco harimo ibiganiro,imivugo n’amagambo yo kwubahana.
Ikiganiro cyo gusaba.
Ikiganiro cyo gusaba ni igice cy’ingenzi cyane mu muhango wo gusaba umugeni. Aha ni ho abakuru b'imiryango yombi bagirana ibiganiro byubaha, bakoresheje amagambo y’umuco, imigani, n’imvugo irimo ubwitonzi.
1. Gutangira ikiganiro.
Iyo abashyitsi bageze mu rugo rwiwabo w’umukobwa babanza kubaramutsa no kubakira neza. Abavugizi cyangwa abakuru bumuryango w’umukobwa babaza abashyitsi bati:"“Mwadusuye muturutse he? Ni iki kibazanye?”," Ibi ntibabazwa mu buryo busanzwe gusa, ahubwo babivuga mu mvugo y’umuco yuje ikinyabupfura.
2. Gusobanura impamvu yabazanye.
Abavugizi b’umusore ni bo batangira gusobanura impamvu yabazanye.Akenshi bavuga mu buryo bw’ikinyabupfura bavuga ko baje gushaka ururabo cyangwa umutako uri muri urwo rugo mbese bazimiza ariko bashaka kuvuga ko bashaka umukobwa muri urwo rugo. Ntibavuga izina ry’umukobwa ako kanya, babanza gukoresha amagambo azimije.
Urugero rw’amagambo bashobora kuvuga harimo naya“Twumvise ko muri uru rugo hari ururabo rwiza cyane twifuza ko rwazaba mu rugo rwacu, ni yo mpamvu twaje gusaba.” ubundi uko ikiganiro kienga gikura bakaza kwerura bavuga ko basaba umugeni.
3. Ibibazo biva ku ruhande rw’umukobwa.
Abavugizi b’umukobwa ntibahita bemera. Babanza kubaza ibibazo nka:uwo musore musabira ni nde?,akomoka he?, afite iyihe myitwarire? ese ashobora kwita ku mukobwa wacu neza? Ibi bikorwa mu mvugo itaziguye cyane, ahubwo mu migani n’ibitekerezo by’umuco.
Iyo ikiganiro kimaze kugenda neza abavugizi b’umusore bavuga izina ry’umukobwa bashaka. Abavugizi b’umukobwa babaza mu rugo niba uwo mukobwa yemera uwo musore.Iyo yemeye, ikiganiro gikomeza neza.Nyuma y’ibiganiro impande zombi zemeranya ku mubano w’abana babo.Bashobora gutangira kuganira ku nkwano n’intambwe zizakurikiraho.Iyo byumvikanyweho neza, bavuga ko ubusabe bwemewe.
Ikiganiro cyo gusaba ni ingenzi cyane kuko kibumbatiye umuco w'ubwubahane hagati y’imiryango.Gishyira imbere ubushishozi n’imvugo y’umuco nyarwanda.Gihuza imiryango yombi mbere y’ubukwe.
Inkwano ni kimwe mu bice by’ingenzi cyane mu muhango wo gusaba umugeni mu muco nyarwanda. Inkwano ni impano umuryango w’umusore uha umuryango w’umukobwa nk’ikimenyetso cy’icyubahiro n’ishimwe ku babyeyi bareze umukobwa. Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, inkwano yatangwaga cyane cyane mu nka, kuko inka zari ikimenyetso cy’ubukire, icyubahiro n’umugisha mu muryango. Gutanga inkwano ntibyari kugura umukobwa, ahubwo byari uburyo bwo gushimira ababyeyi bamureze no kwerekana ko umusore n’umuryango we biteguye kubaka urugo rushingiye ku kubahana.
Iyo ikiganiro cyo gusaba kigenda neza kandi impande zombi zishimanye, abavugizi batangira kuganira ku bijyanye n’inkwano. Iki kiganiro gikorerwa mu bwitonzi no mu mvugo y’umuco, aho buri muryango agira uruhare mu kugena uko inkwano izatangwa. Abavugizi b’umuryango w’umukobwa bashobora kuvuga umubare w’inka wifuzwa, hanyuma abavugizi b’umusore bakagaragaza icyo bashoboye gutanga. Ibiganiro bigamije kugera ku bwumvikane bwubaka aho kuba impaka. Intego nyamukuru ni uko imiryango yombi yumvikana kandi igakomeza kugirana umubano mwiza.
Mu gihe cyo kuganira ku nkwano, hanemeranywa uburyo izatangwa n’igihe izatangwa. Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, inkwano yashoboraga gutangwa yose icyarimwe cyangwa igatangwa mu byiciro bitewe n’ubushobozi bw’umuryango w’umusore. Hari igihe umuryango w’umukobwa wemereraga umusore gutanga igice cy’inkwano ku munsi runaka hanyuma ibisigaye bikazatangwa nyuma. Ibi byagaragazaga ubwumvikane n’ubufatanye hagati y’imiryango yombi. Muri iki gihe, nubwo inkwano ikiri igice cy’umuco, hari aho usanga inka zisimbuzwa amafaranga cyangwa ibindi bintu bitewe n’imibereho y’iki gihe.

Gufata irembo ry’umugeni ni umwe mu mihango y’ingenzi ikorwa mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda. Uyu muhango uba mbere gato yo kujyana umugeni mu rugo rw’umugabo. Ukorwa nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko umuryango w’umusore ugeze ku muryango w’umukobwa ugiye kumujyana, kandi ugakorwa mu buryo bw’umuco burimo ibyishimo, indirimbo n’imvugo zubaha impande zombi.
Mu muco nyarwanda, irembo rifatwa nk’ahantu h’ingenzi cyane mu rugo kuko ari ho abashyitsi binjirira. Iyo umuryango w’umusore ugeze ku rugo rw’umukobwa ku munsi w’ubukwe, bahagarara ku irembo mbere yo kwinjira mu rugo. Icyo gihe hatangira ibiganiro cyangwa imikino y’umuco hagati y’abantu bahagarariye umuryango w’umukobwa n’abahagarariye umuryango w’umusore. Intego ni ukugaragaza ko umuryango w’umusore uje mu cyubahiro kandi witeguye kubaha umuryango w’umukobwa.
Muri uwo muhango, akenshi abahagarariye umuryango w’umukobwa bashobora kubanza kubuza abashyitsi kwinjira, bakababaza impamvu baje n’icyo bashaka muri urwo rugo. Ibi bikorwa mu buryo busetsa kandi bushimishije, ariko bifite n’igisobanuro cy’umuco. Abavugizi cyangwa abantu bo ku ruhande rw’umusore basobanura ko baje gutwara umugeni bemerewe mbere mu muhango wo gusaba. Bashobora no gutanga impano cyangwa amafaranga make nk’ikimenyetso cyo gufungura irembo.
Iyo ibiganiro birangiye neza, umuryango w’umukobwa wemera gufungura irembo. Ibi bivuze ko bemeye ko abashyitsi binjira mu rugo kandi ko umugeni ashobora gutegurwa ngo ajyanwe mu rugo rw’umugabo. Uyu mwanya uba ari uw’ibyishimo kuko akenshi habaho kuririmba indirimbo z’umuco, kubyina no kwishimira uwo munsi wihariye mu buzima bw’umugeni n’umuryango we.
Nyuma yo gufungura irembo, abashyitsi binjira mu rugo bagakomeza indi mihango y’ubukwe nko kwakira umugeni, kumusezera ku muryango we, no gutangira urugendo rumujyana mu rugo rw’umugabo. Bityo, gufata irembo ni ikimenyetso cy’uko urugendo rwo kwimura umugeni rutangiye ku mugaragaro kandi ko imiryango yombi yemeye gukomeza uwo mubano w’ubushyingiranwa.
Muri rusange, umuhango wo gufata irembo ni igice cy’umuco nyarwanda cyuzuyemo ibyishimo, gusabana n’icyubahiro hagati y’imiryango. Ugaragaza ko ubukwe atari ihuriro ry’abantu babiri gusa, ahubwo ari ihuriro ry’imiryango ibiri igiye kubana mu mubano mushya.

Umuhango wo gusaba irembo ry’umugeni ni umwe mu mihango igaragara mu muco nyarwanda ibanziriza umuhango wo gusaba umugeni. Uyu muhango uba ari intambwe ya mbere yerekana ko umusore n’umuryango we bafite umugambi wo kuzaza gusaba umukobwa ku mugaragaro. Ni umuhango woroshye ugereranyije no gusaba nyirizina, kandi ugamije gutangiza umubano hagati y’imiryango yombi no gutegura inzira izaganisha ku gusaba no ku bukwe.
Mu muco nyarwanda, gusaba irembo bisobanura ko umuryango w’umusore ujya mu rugo rw’umukobwa gusaba uburenganzira bwo kuzaza gusaba umukobwa wabo ku mugaragaro. Muri uwo muhango, abantu bake baturutse ku muryango w’umusore ni bo bajya gusura umuryango w’umukobwa, akenshi harimo ababyeyi cyangwa abahagarariye umuryango. Bageze mu rugo rw’umukobwa, baganira n’ababyeyi be mu buryo bwubaha, bakababwira ko umusore wabo akunda umukobwa wabo kandi ko bifuza kuzaza gusaba mu buryo bwemewe n’umuco.
Uko umuhango ukorwa.
Ibiganiro byo gusaba irembo bikorwa mu mwuka w’ubwubahane no kuganira neza hagati y’impande zombi. Umuryango w’umukobwa ushobora kubaza ibibazo bitandukanye kugira ngo umenye neza umuryango w’umusore n’impamvu bashaka uwo mukobwa. Intego nyamukuru si ugufata imyanzuro ikomeye nk’iyo mu gusaba nyirizina, ahubwo ni ugutangiza umubano no kumenyana hagati y’imiryango. Iyo ibiganiro bigenda neza, umuryango w’umukobwa wemera ko umuryango w’umusore uzaza gusaba umukobwa mu muhango uteguye neza.
Iyo irembo ryemewe, biba bivuze ko umuryango w’umukobwa wemeye kwakira umuryango w’umusore mu muhango wo gusaba uzaba nyuma. Icyo gihe bashobora no kumvikana ku gihe cyangwa ku buryo uwo muhango uzategurwa. Ibi bituma gusaba nyirizina bigenda neza kuko imiryango iba yamaze kumenyana no kubaka icyizere hagati yayo.
Muri rusange, gusaba irembo ni intambwe y’ingenzi mu muco nyarwanda kuko itegura inzira iganisha ku gusaba umugeni. Uyu muhango ufasha imiryango yombi kumenyana, kuganira no gutangira kubaka umubano uzavamo ubukwe. Ni bwo buryo bwo kubahiriza umuco w’icyubahiro no kwerekana ko ubukwe atari umubano w’abantu babiri gusa, ahubwo ari isano ihuza imiryango ibiri.

Umuhamuro ni ibigabiro, imihango, cyangwa amagambo y'indangagaciro yakoreshwaga mu muco nyarwanda, cyane cyane mu gushimangira ubwami, ubumwe, n'imigenzo y'Imandwa. Ibi bikorwa bishimangira ubumwe n'umuco nyarwanda.
Umuhamuro ubundi iri ambo ryumvikana nk'imvugo ikoreshwa mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo cyangwa se inshoberamahanga, bitavugwa mu buryo bweruye ngo yumvikane ako kanya, ahubwo ikeneye gusobanurwa n'abazi umuco n'amateka y'u Rwanda.

Kubandwa Imana ni umuhango watangiye mu wa 1510 mu ntango y’Ingoma ya Ruganzu II Ndoli, akaba ari umuhango wahurizaga hamwe Abanyarwanda mu Icyeza Mana, icyo gihe ni ho hahanzwe idini y’Abanyarwanda, akaba ari naryo zina rusange ry’abari bibumbiye muri uwo muryango.
Kubandwa byatangiye mu muhango watangijwe na Ryangombe rya Babinga mwene Nyundo ukomoka mu Bufumbira muri Uganda, akaba yarakomokaga mu bwoko bw’Abanyoro mu nzu y’Abakonjo yari umupfumu.
Imandwa nizo zari zishyigikiye idini gakondo, kubandwa kwari ukugaragaza ikimenyetso cy’ubuyoboke, hakabamo imigenzo ihuza abantu n’Imana.

Gukwa umugeni ni umwe mu mihango y’ingenzi cyane mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda. Uyu muhango uba nyuma y’uko umuryango w’umusore wamaze gusaba umukobwa kandi impande zombi zumvikanye ku mubano w’abana babo. Gukwa bisobanura gutanga inkwano, ni ukuvuga impano umuryango w’umusore uha umuryango w’umukobwa nk’ikimenyetso cy’icyubahiro no gushimira ababyeyi bamureze.
Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, inkwano yatangwaga cyane cyane mu nka, kuko inka zari ikimenyetso cy’ubukire, icyubahiro n’umugisha mu muryango. Gutanga inkwano ntibyari bivuze kugura umukobwa, ahubwo byari uburyo bwo gushimira ababyeyi bamureze no kugaragaza ko umusore n’umuryango we biteguye kwakira umukobwa mu muryango wabo. Inkwano yashimangiraga umubano hagati y’imiryango yombi kandi ikaba ikimenyetso cy’uko ubukwe bwemewe n’imiryango yombi.
Uko umuhango wo gukwa umugeni ukorwa.
Mu muhango wo gukwa, umuryango w’umusore wateguraga inka cyangwa ibindi bintu byemeranyijweho bakabijyana mu rugo rw’umukobwa. Abagize imiryango yombi barahuraga bakishimira uwo muhango, bagasangira ibiryo n’ibinyobwa mu byishimo. Icyo gihe habaga n’indirimbo n’imbyino z’umuco zagaragazaga ibyishimo byo gukomeza umubano hagati y’imiryango.
Hari n’igihe inkwano yatangwaga mu byiciro bitewe n’ubushobozi bw’umuryango w’umusore. Bashoboraga gutanga igice cyayo ku munsi runaka, hanyuma ibisigaye bikazatangwa nyuma. Ibi byagaragazaga ubwumvikane n’ubufatanye hagati y’imiryango yombi. Muri iki gihe cya none, nubwo umuco wo gutanga inkwano ukiriho, hari aho usanga inka zisimbuzwa amafaranga cyangwa ibindi bintu bitewe n’imibereho y’iki gihe.
Mu by’ukuri, umuhango wo gukwa ni intambwe ikomeye mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda kuko ushishikariza kubahana hagati y’imiryango, gushimira ababyeyi b’umukobwa no gushimangira isano iri hagati y’imiryango yombi. Uyu muhango ni na wo utuma ubukwe bwitabirwa n’imiryango yombi mu buryo bwemewe n’umuco, bityo ukaba igice gikomeye cy’umuco nyarwanda.

Imigenzoya hozeho mu Rwanda rwo hambere aho nka banyarwanda twari dufite imico n’imigenzo nk'abanyarwanda imwe muri iyo igenda isimburwa n’indi nkuko ibihe bisimburana. Imigenzo, imwe n'imwe harimo iyo twagiye twasigiwe n’abasokuruza ndetse n'abakurambere harimo imyiza myinshi.
hari imimigenzo myinshi twagira nka banyarwanda kuva kera ku u Rwanda rwaremwa na Gihanga ngoma igihumbi harimo iyi gufashanya mu byerekeye imyaka n’amatungo, gutabarana no kwakira abashyitsi. Kuva kera Abanyarwanda bahoze bafashanya, bagakorera hamwe. ibyo bikaboneka cyane cyane kuguzanya, kwata no kugwatiriza. iyo umuntu yabaga yejeje imyaka, undi atareza cyangwa yararumbije, uwejeje yagurizaga utejeje; na we akazamwishyura cyangwa akazamwitura ku bundi buryo.Uwabaga akeneye umurima, yajyaga kwa mugenzi we akabimutekerereza; mugenzi we akamwatira umurima, agateramo imyaka yamara kweza akazamuha icyatamurima.

Kwakira umukazana ni umwe mu mihango ikomeye cyane mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda, kandi ni igice gikurikira umuhango wo gukwa Umugeni. Uyu muhango uba ku munsi umugeni ajyanwa mu rugo rw’umugabo, aho umuryango w’umugabo umwakira ku mugaragaro nk’umunyamuryango mushya. Ni intambwe yerekana ko umugeni yinjiye mu muryango w’umugabo kandi ko ubuzima bushya bwo kubaka urugo butangiye mu buryo bw’umuco n’icyubahiro.
Intangiriro y’umuhango.
Iyo umugeni ageze mu rugo rw’umugabo, umuryango we ndetse n’abashyitsi baturutse ku mpande zombi baba bahari. Ababyeyi b’umugabo, abavugizi n’abandi bantu b’ingenzi mu muryango bahita bamwakira ku irembo ry’urugo, akenshi habaho indirimbo z’umuco n’imbyino bigaragaza ibyishimo byo kwakira umukazana.
Uyu muhango si ukwemera gusa ko umugeni yinjiye mu rugo, ahubwo ni ikimenyetso cy’icyubahiro, aho abashyitsi bose hamwe n’umuryango w’umugabo berekana ko bemeye umukazana nk’umunyamuryango mushya.
Imyitwarire y’umukazana.
Mu muco nyarwanda, umukazana agomba kwitwara mu buryo bwubahisha umuryango mushya yashatsemo, asezera ku muryango w’iwabo,birangiye akerekana ko yiteguye kuba mu muryango mushya, aba agomba kwambara neza bijyanye n'umuco, akagaragaza isura nziza n’icyubahiro ikindi aba agomba kwigira ku babyeyi n’abasaza b’umugabo mu by’umuco n’imyitwarire y’urugo. Uuyu mwanya uba ari ingenzi cyane kuko werekana ko umugeni azi inshingano ze z’urugo.
Ibirori bijyana no kwakira umukazana.
Iyo umukazana amaze kwakirwa, akenshi habaho ibikorwa bikurikira: Kuririmba no kubyina indirimbo z’umuco zishimira umubano mushya.guutanga impano ntoya ku muryango w’umugabo cyangwa ku mukazana kugira ngo bamwakire neza,abashyitsi baturutse ku mpande zombi basangira ibiryo n’ibinyobwa, bagashimangira umubano hagati y’imiryango. Uyu muhango uba umwanya wo kwishimira ubuzima bushya bwo kubaka urugo no kugaragaza umuco nyarwanda mu buryo bufatika.
Akamaro kuyu muhango.
Guhuza imiryango yombi,kwakira umukazana ni intambwe ishimangira ko imiryango yombi yemeye umubano.Kwerekana icyubahiro n’umuco, Umukazana yinjiye mu rugo rw’umugabo mu buryo bw’icyubahiro kandi ababyeyi b’umugabo bamwakiriye neza.Gutangira ubuzima bw’urugo bushya, Uyu muhango uherekeza umugeni mu rugo rwe rushya, akiga inshingano n’imyitwarire y’urugo.
Mu by’ukuri, kwakira umukazana ni umuhango w’ingenzi mu bukwe nyarwanda kuko ushyira ku mugaragaro ko umugeni yinjiye mu muryango w’umugabo, uherekeza ubuzima bushya bw’urugo, kandi ukazana ibyishimo n’ubwubahane hagati y’imiryango yombi.

Ibigabiro ni ibiti byabaga mu Rwanda, ibigabiro bikaba byari ibiti by'imivumu cyangwa ibihondohondo batera ahantu hari urugo rw'umwami, cyangwa se ingoro yu Mwami, kandi bajyaga babitera ndetse n'ahantu bashyinguye umugongo wu mwami, ngo hatazibagirana, Byafatwaga kandi nk'ibigabiro by'igihugu.
Ibigabiro kandi byari ibigabiro byari bifite akamaro gakomeye mu Rwanda, nkaho byari ibimenyetso by'ububasha bw'umwami, ubusugire bw'igihugu, n'imigenzo y'umuco nyarwanda,

Mu muco nyarwanda, umuhango wo gutekesha umukwe n’umugeni ni umwe mu mihango y’ubukwe igaragaza ubushobozi bw’abashyingiranwa mu mirimo y’urugo n’ubwumvikane hagati yabo. Uyu muhango ukunze gukorwa nyuma yo kwakira umukazana mu rugo rw’umugabo, kandi uba umwanya wo kwerekana ko bombi biteguye gufatanya mu rugo no kubaka umuryango.
Intangiriro y’umuhango.
Uyu muhango ukurikira iminsi mike nyuma y’ubukwe, bitewe n’imico y’umuryango. uyu muhango utegurwa n'umuryango w'umukwe mu rwego rwo kubaha uburenganzira bwo gutangira guteka no kwita ku rugo rwabo. Mu muco nyarwanda, umukwe n’umugeni basabwa kugaragaza ubuhanga n’ubwitonzi mu mirimo y’urugo, cyane cyane mu gutegura amafunguro cyangwa ibikorwa bifatika by’urugo.
Mu gihe cy’umuhango, umukazana agaragaza ubushobozi bwo guteka amafunguro y’umuco, gutegura ibiryo, no gukora imirimo yo mu rugo.Umukwe afasha cyangwa akorana n'umugeni mu gutegura ibyo bikorwa, agaragaza ko ashoboye gufatanya mu rugo.Uyu muhango ukorwa mu buryo bwo kugaragaza ubushobozi n’ubushake bwo kubaka urugo rugendera ku muco.
Ibyo umukwe n’umugeni bagaragaza.
Mu gihe cyo gutekesha,umugeni agaragaza ubushobozi bwo gutegura no guteka ibiryo by’umuryango, kandi akabikora mu buryo bw’umuco n’ubwitonzi.umukwe afatanya cyangwa ayobora igikorwa mu buryo buboneye, agaragaza ko ari umugabo witeguye gufasha no gukorana umugeni.Bombi bagaragaza ubwumvikane no kwubahana hagati yabo n’umuryango wabo.Uyu muhango kandi uba umwanya wo kwerekana ko ubuzima bw’urugo bushya buherekejwe n’ubufatanye n’ubushishozi.
Gushimangira ubwumvikane bw’abashyingiranwa, uyu muhango ugaragaza ko umukwe n’umugeni bashobora gufatanya mu rugo.Kwerekana ubushobozi bw’umugeni n’umukwe mu muryango,ababyeyi n’abashyitsi babona ko bombi biteguye inshingano z’urugo.Guhuza imiryango n’abashyitsi,indirimbo, imbyino n’ibirori bikurikirana umuhango bigaragaza ibyishimo n’icyubahiro hagati y’imiryango yombi.
Umwihariko w’uyu muhango.
Uyu muhango utandukanye no gutekesha umugeni wenyine kuko wibanda ku bufatanye bw’abashyingiranwa bombi. Bugaragaza ko ubukwe nyarwanda atari umubano w’abantu babiri gusa, ahubwo ari ubufatanye bw’imiryango, ubushobozi bw’abashyingiranwa n’ubwumvikane mu rugo.
Mu by’ukuri, gutekesha umukwe n’umugeni ni umuhango w’ingenzi kuko utuma habaho icyizere hagati y’abashyingiranwa, kugaragaza ubushobozi bwo gufatanya mu rugo no gukomeza umuco nyarwanda mu bukwe.

Urukonjo ni ururimi rw’ikinyabupfura n’ikinyabwenge rwakoreshwaga mu mateka n’umuco nyarwanda, cyane cyane mu mihango yabaga iyo gukorera imandwa cyangwa se imyambaro y’icyubahiro. Uru rurimi rw'urukonje kandi rugizwe n’amagambo yihariye, asimbura amagambo asanzwe y’Ikinyarwanda ku mpamvu z’ubupfumu, kubandwa, cyangwa kugaragaza icyubahiro.

Gutwikurura abageni ni umwe mu mihango y’ingenzi mu bukwe bwa kinyarwanda, ukaba uba ku musozo w’ubukwe cyangwa ku munsi umugeni ajyanwa mu rugo rw’umugabo. Uyu muhango ugaragaza gutangira urugendo rushya rw’abashyingiranwa nk’umugabo n’umugore, kandi uba ari umwanya wo kwerekana ibyishimo, icyubahiro no guha umugeni n’umukwe inama n’ihumure n’umuryango.
Intangiriro y’umuhango.
Gutwikurura abageni bivuga gufata umugeni n’umukwe bakava ku rugo rw’umuryango w’umukobwa bajya mu rugo rw’umugabo cyangwa ku rugo rushya rwabo. Mu muco nyarwanda, uyu muhango uba umwanya wo gusezera ku babyeyi b’umukazana n’abandi bagize umuryango. Umwanya wo gutangira inshingano zo kwubabaka urugo nkabashakanye aho umugeni n'umukwe bagaragarizanya amarangamutima n’ubwuzu hagati yabo. Uherekezwa n’indirimbo z’umuco, imbyino n’ibirori byo kwishimira umubano n'ubuzima bushya.
Uyu munsi uba ari intangiriro y’ubuzima bw’urugo rushya kandi uba umwanya wo kwerekana icyubahiro ku muryango w’umukobwa no ku muryango w’umugabo.
Imyitwarire y’abageni.
Mu gihe cyo gutwikurura, abageni bagomba Kwitwararika, bakiyubaha, bakerekana ko bubaha umuryango w’umukobwa n’umugabo.Kugaragaza ibyishimo no gushimira umuryango, cyane cyane ababyeyi bamureze umukazana. Kwitegura ubuzima bushya mu muryango w’umugabo, bagaragaza ubwumvikane n’ubufatanye.Akenshi, abageni bagiye mu rugo rushya cyangwa ahantu ubukwe bukomereza, baherekejwe n’abavugizi, ababyeyi n’abashyitsi, bagaragaza ibimenyetso by’icyubahiro n’ubushuti hagati y’imiryango.
Ibirori bijyana n’umuhango.
Gutwikurura abageni akenshi bijyana n’ibikorwa birimo:Indirimbo n’imbyino z’umuco zerekana ibyishimo by’umuryango,gutanga impano cyangwa amafaranga y’ishimwe ku muryango w’umukobwa.Gusangira ibiryo n’ibinyobwa n’abashyitsi kugira ngo ibyishimo byuzure umuryango wombi.Uyu muhango uba igice gikomeye cy’ubukwe kuko ugaragaza ko ubukwe burangiye ku mugaragaro, umugeni n’umukwe batangiye ubuzima bushya, kandi imiryango yombi ihuriza hamwe ibyishimo n’icyubahiro.
Gusezera ku muryango w’umukobwa no kugaragaza icyubahiro.Gutangira urugendo rushya rw’urugo nk’umugabo n’umugore.Guhuza imiryango yombi mu byishimo n’umuco.Kwerekana ubwumvikane n’ubufatanye bw’abageni ku mugaragaro.

Umuhango wo kujya guca mw’irembo kw’abageni ni umwe mu mihango y’ingenzi ikurikiraho nyuma y’ubukwe nyarwanda. Uyu muhango ukorwa nyuma y’uko umugeni ajyanwe mu rugo rw’umugabo, aho abageni hamwe n’umuryango w’umusore bajyana umugeni gusura urugo rw’iwabo. Ni umuhango w’icyubahiro kandi w’amarangamutima, kandi ugamije guhuza imiryango yombi nyuma y’ubukwe no gukomeza umubano n’umuco.
Guhuza imiryango yombi nyuma y’ubukwe no kujya gushimira umuryango w'umukobwa ko wabahaye umugeni mwiza. Umugeni asubira mu rugo rw’iwabo hamwe n’umugabo we kugira ngo imiryango ikomeze gusabana mu rwego rwo kwerekana icyubahiro ku muryango w’umukazana,umugeni agaragaza ko akomeje kubaha ababyeyi n’umuryango we. uyu muhango kandi ishimangira umubano n’ubwumvikane Uyu muhango ugaragaza ko abageni n’imiryango yabo bashyigikiye ubukwe kandi biteguye gufatanya mu byishimo n’inshingano z’urugo.
Uko umuhango ukorwa.
Umuryango w’umusore hamwe n’abageni bategura urugendo berekeza mu rugo rwaho umukobwa avuka. Bitwaza inkangara irimo ishimwe ry'umuryango ko babahaye umugeni mwiza, iyo batashimye umugeni bafata inkangara bakuzuzamo ibyatsi byitwa ibitovu murwego rwo kwerekana ko umugeni babahaye batamushimye. Abageni bahabwa ikaze n’umuryango umukazana avukamo ku irembo ry’urugo, baririmba indirimbo z’umuco.
Muri uyu muhango, abageni baganira n’umuryango w’umukazana, basangira ibiryo n’ibinyobwa, banaganira ku buzima bushya bw’urugo.Umugeni agaragaza ubwitonzi n’ubushishozi mu rugo rwe rwa kera, naho umugabo agaragaza icyubahiro ku muryango w’umukazana.
Ibirori n’imyitwarire.
Abashyitsi n’imiryango baririmba kandi babyina kugira ngo bagaragaze ibyishimo byo gusabana.Uyu muhango ushobora kujyana no gutanga impano nk’ikimenyetso cy’icyubahiro n’ubushuti. Umuryango w’umukazana n’umuryango w’umusore basangira ibiryo, bagasangira ibyishimo by’umubano mushya.Umuhango ukomeza kugeza abageni bateguye gusubira mu rugo rwabo, ariko umubano hagati y’imiryango yombi ugahora uhamye kubera ibyishimo no gusabana byagaragajwe.
Uyu muhango ugaragaza ko abageni bashyigikiwe n’imiryango yabo mu rugo rushya.Umugeni akomeza kugaragaza ko yubaha ababyeyi be n’umuryango.Uyu muhango uhuza indirimbo, imbyino, n’ibirori byo gusabana.Bifasha ko imiryango ikomeza kubana neza no gufashanya mu bihe bitandukanye.
Muri rusange, umuhango wo kujya guca mw’irembo kw’abageni ni intambwe ikomeye mu gukomeza ubufatanye n’ubusabane hagati y’abageni n’imiryango yabo nyuma y’ubukwe, kandi ni igice cy’umuco nyarwanda kigaragaza icyubahiro, ibyishimo n’ubwumvikane.

Ibigabiro bya Nyabakonjo ubundi ibigabiro ni ibiti by'imivumu cyangwa byaba ibiti by'ibihondohondo batera ahantu hari urugo rw'umwami, cyangwa se bashyinguye ingoro wu Mwami, ngo hatazibagirana, Byafatwaga kandi nk'ibigabiro by'igihugu.
Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo yari ubwami bw’i Bwanacyambwe, rero ibimenyetso ndangamateka by’ibigabiro byaho abami b’u Bwanacyambwe byaho bari batuye birahari kuva 1378-2019 biri mu Mudugudu wa Amahoro, Kagali ka Rukiri II mu Murenge wa Remera mu Karere ka Gasabo.

ibigabiro bya Rwabugiri ni ibiti nk’imivumu cyangwa ibihondohondo biteye aho abami babaga batuye ku ngo zabo bakundaga kuhatera ibyo biti maze bikitwa ibigabiro.
ibigabiro bya Rwabugiri ibigabiro bya Rwabugiri byahoze i Rwamagana byari byinshi kandi ari binini cyane, byatemwe nyuma y’Intambara ya mbere y’Isi. Byatemeshejwe n’abapadiri bubaka Misiyoni ya Rwamagana, babifashijwemo n’umutware witwaga Rwabutogo rwa Kabare ka Rwakagara wategekaga u Buganza bw’epfo.

Nkungu iherereye mu karere kahoze ari u Buganza bw’epfo. Ubu ni mu Mudugudu wa Kiryango, Akagari ka Nkungu, Umurenge wa Munyaga, mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba, akaba ariho hari ibigabiro bya Nkungu, rero niho mu kinyejana cya 15 ku ngoma ya Ruganzu I Bwimba, yagiye kuhabera umucengeri mu Gisaka.
Ibigabiro bya Nkungu aho niho Ruganzu I Bwimba yatangiye maze hamera igiti cy’umuguruka kirakura kiba inganzamarumbo, kandi abantu bakagitinya kuko cyameze aho umwami yatangiye Nyuma y’igihe kirekire, icyo giti kirasaza kigwa hasi kirahaborera gusa hari n’ikindi giti cy’umuguruka kinini kandi kirekire, bivugwa ko cyashibutse ku muzi w’icyo cyahoze aho umwami yatangiye.

Umusozi wa Munyaga ni umusozi uri ku nkengero z’aho u Rwanda rwa hanaga urubibi na rwagabaniraga ndetse na Gisaka, mbere y’uko rwigarurira icyo gihugu mu kinyejana cya 19 ku ngoma ya Mutara II Rwogera. Ingabo zabaga ziri ku rugerero zirinze inkiko z’u Rwanda.
Ibigabiro bya Munyaga.
Ibigabiro bya Munyaga ni ibigabiro bya Sharangabo na Ndabarasa na we wari igikomangoma yabaye kuri urwo rugerero rw’i Munyaga ari kumwe n’Abakemba, Mu mpinga y’uwo musozi ari na ho hahoze urugerero, hitwa mu Nkamba kuva icyo gihe kugeza magingo aya. Ubu ni mu Mudugudu wa Kigabiro, Akagari ka Kaduha, Umurenge wa Munyaga, Akarere ka Rwamagana.

Ubukannyi mu Rwanda, wari umwuga wari utunze benshi bakuragamo imyenda yo kwambara mu impu zitandukanye ndetse Uyu mwuga wari ufitiye Abanyarwanda akamaro gakomeye kuko wari ubaatunze kandi wari umwe mu mirimo gakondo ya ba kurambere, ababukoraga bitwaga abakannyi.
Ubukannyi bwari uburyo bwo kuboha cyangwa gutunganya impu z’inyamaswa nk'inka, ihene, intama cyangwa izindi nyamaswa z'ishyamba) kugira ngo zivemo imyenda yoroshye kandi ikwiriye kwambarwa.

Umunsi wa Pasiki ni umunsi abemera Yesu kristo (Yezu kristu) wari umwana w’Imana bivugwa yuko yazutseho, nyuma y’iminsi itatu yari amaze mu gituro, yari amaze mumva. Ni umunsi usobanura intsinzi y’ubuzima ku rupfu nu mucyo ku mwijima, akaba ari umunsi ngaruka mwaka mu myemerere ya Gikristo.
Umunsi wa Pasika ni umunsi abakristo bizihiza ko Yesu yazutse kugira ngo akize abantu imbaraga z’icyaha n’urupfu, abahuze n’Imana Data, buri mwaka irzihizwa gusa nta tariki izwi neza bizihirizaho uyi munsi.
Pasika ifite inkomoko mu migenzo ya kera mu idini y'abayahudi bibuka uko Imana yabakuye mu bubata bwa Misiri. Hari n’ibimenyetso bimwe byaje bivuye mu migenzo ya kera (nko gukoresha amagi n’inkwavu) bishushanya uburumbuke n’ubuzima bushya.

ukwezi kwa Ramadhan cyangwa igisibo cya Ramadhan cyangwa se Ramadan ni ukwezi kwa cyenda ku ngengabihe ya kisilamu ku isi, aba ari ukwezi gutagatifu kurusha ayandi yose mu idini ya Islamu. Iki ni ukwezi kugenewe gusenga, kwiyiriza, no kwegera Imana, kandi ni imwe mu nkingi eshanu z’idini ya Isilamu.
Ukwezi kwa Ramadhan aha muri uku kwezi, abayisilamu basubiramo igitabo gitagatifu cya Qu'ran, bakiyongerera amasengesho, kandi bakitwara neza, bagaragaza ubugwaneza no gufasha abakene, Abayisilamu bafite ubuzima bwiza basabwa kwiyiriza (kureka kurya no kunywa) kuva mu rukerera kugeza izuba rirenze.
Muri Ramadhan abayisilamu bose basenze umunsi wose batariye maze buri mugoroba izuba rirenze, bararya maze bagafata bafungura, kenshi bakabikora bahuriye hamwe n'imiryango cyangwa inshuti zabo.

Umunsi mukuru wa Noheli ni umwe mu minsi mikuru igize umwaka twizihiza mu Rwanda ariko cyane cyane umwaka wa Gikristo, wizihizwa n’abantu batari bacye hirya no hino ku Isi. Kuri uyu munsi abakirisitu bajya mu nsengero kw'izihiza ivuka rya Yezu / Yesu kristo/kristu) wavukiye i Betelehemu.
Uko watangiye kwizihizwa.
Noheli nk'umunsi watangiye kwizihizwa nk’umunsi w’ikiruhuko ahagana mu kinyejana cya 4, rero Noheli yizihijwe bwa mbere kuwa 25 Ukuboza mu mwaka wa 336 nyuma y’ivuka rya Yezu/ Yesu mu bwami bw’Abaromani, umwami Constantin, umwami w’Abaromani na Papa Liberius Ahagana mu kinyejana cya 3 cyangwa icya 4, nibwo uyu munsi mukuru wa Noheli watangiye kwizihizwa nk’umunsi abantu bibukaho ivuka ry’umukiza Yezu / Yesu Kristu.

Umuganura mu Rwanda ni umwe mu munsi mukuru w'ingirakamaro mu muco w'u Rwanda ukaba ari umunis wizihizwa ku munsi 5 wu kwezi kwa Kanama waburi mwaka. Ubundi uyu munsi usobanura kurya cyangwa kuganura ku mbuto za mbere zeze cyangwa "gusangira ku musaruro wabonetse muri icyo gihe cy'ihinga, n’isarura aho Abanyarwanda bishimira ibyagezweho mu ngeri zinyuranye z'ubuzima.
Umuganura mu Rwanda watangiye kwizihizwa mu Rwanda ku ngoma ya Gihanga Ngomijana mu kinyejana cya 9. Waje guhabwa imbaraga zidasanzwe n'Umwami Ruganzu II Ndoli mu kinyejana cya 16 nyuma yo kubohora igihugu.
Umunsi wu muganura mu Rwanda ni umunsi w'ubusabane aho imiryango n'inshuti bahura bagasangira ibiribwa gakondo aha harimo umutsima, ibishyimbo, n'amata, rukasharara, ndetse bakananywa. Mu birori byo ku rwego rw'igihugu, habaho imbyino gakondo, imivugo, n'imikino.
Umuganura nyuma yo gusubizwa agaciro wari ufite maze na Guverinoma y'u Rwanda kuva mu 2011, Umuganura ntiwizihizwa gusa mu rwego rw'ubuhinzi. Muri iki gihe, Abanyarwanda bishimira umusaruro uva mu ngeri zose zirimo, Ikoranabuhanga, Uburezi, n'Inganda, Ubuzima, Imikino, n'Ubukerarugendo hamwe n'imiyoborere n'iterambere.

Ubunani ubundi ni umunsi wa mbere utangira umwaka mushya, mbese ni itariki ya mbere Mutarama, ni umunsi abantu bakunda kuba bari mu birori, mu miryango yayo,hari impano zitanduaknye, ndetse usanga n'abacuruzi bakatuye ibintu bagurisha, Ni ikiruhuko rusange aho abantu bajya mu nsengero, ibitaramo, cyangwa bakitegura mu ngo, bakarangwa n'imyambarire mishya n'ibiryo byihariye.
Ubunani ubundi hakunzwe gucurangwa umuziki, hakabaho n'imbyino, ndetse n'ibishashi by'umuriro bicanwa, abana bakambikwa imyenda mishya, abandi bajya gusenga basa umugisha mu mwaka mushya, abandi bajya mu cyaro iwabo kurira ubunani n'imiryango yabo, abandi bagateka ibiryo bidasanzwe nk'umuceri, inyama.

Ingoro ya Yezu Nyirimpuhwe ni ingoro yitiriwe Kwa Yezu Nyirimpuhwe, ni ingoro ntagatifu ya Kiliziya Gatolika ubundi iri ahantu hitiriwe Yezu nyirimpuhwe hakaba ari mu kibaya ariko kitwa icya mahoro, cyikaba giherereye mu murenge wa Ruhango, mu Karere ka Ruhango, Intara y'amajyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Kwa Yezu nyirimpuhwe ubundi ni ahantu hamenyekanye cyane bitewe n'abantu benshi bahajya bavuga ko bahakirira indwara zitandukanye kandi zikomeye ariko binyuze gusa binyuze mu isengesho. Kwa Yezu kristo nyirimpuhwe ni ishami rya Paruwasi Gatolika ya Ruhango, muri Diyosezi ya Kabgayi.

Ikinimba ni imbyino yo mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda, ubusanzwe ikorwa cyangwa imbyinwa n'urubyiruko bari mu mihango yo kurambagizanya. akaba ari indirimbo ziherekeza imbyino akenshi zigira inama abagore batashyingiranywe uko bakwitwara kuri ba sebukwe; kandi ubundi abagore ntibakoraga izi mbyino bamaze gushyingirwa.
Ubundi mu Rwanda rwo hambere ndetse nuba hari amako atatu y'imbyino, Izo mbyino zirimo
Gusa kubera iminsi yagiye yiyongera ndetse hakazamo nabandi bantu b'abanyarwanda hajemo izindi byino twaguva:

Imbyino yo Gusama cyangwa Gusaama, ni imbyino ikaba ari umwihariko n'umuco w'abaturage bo ku Nkombo, ni ikirwa giherereye mu Kiyaga cya Kivu mu Karere ka Nyamasheke, intara y'iburengerazuba bwu Rwanda. Iyi mbyino ifatwa nk'indangagaciro ikomeye ndetse n'akarusho kaka gace, ikaba izwiho umuvuduko n'uburyo budasanzwe bwo kunyeganyezamo ibice by'umubiri.
Gusama bifite Umwihariko mu mibyinire gusama birangwa no kunyeganyezwa kw'ibitugu n'umubiri wose mu buryo bujyanye n'ingoma n'amajwi yihariye y'abanya-Nkombo. Ni imbyino ifite imbaraga nyinshi kandi isaba ubuhanga bwo guhuza n'injyana, ndetse Itorero ry'Abasaamyi ni torero ni ryo rizwi cyane mu kubyina iyi njyana.

Imbyino y'ikinyemera ni imbyino ikomoka mu Majyaruguru y’Iburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, ahitwa mu Bigogwe nka Rwankeli, Nkuli, Akanage, Kingogo. Bitewe n’uko ako ari agace kiganjemo ubworozi bw’inka kuva mu bihe byo hambere, iyi mbyino bayiserukana barata inka, bikagaragarira no mu ndirimbo ziherekeza izo mbyino.
Ubyina ikinyemera yibanda cyane ku gutega amaboko yigana imiterere y’amahembe y’inka. Umubyimba nawo awukoresha aworoheje uretse ko igihe kigera hakazamo no gutigisa intugu. Userukana iyi mbyino acinya ikirenge hasi; agatangira ahozoza abyina mu buryo bworoheje, akageza igihe yongereramo imbaraga mu cyiciro cyitwa Umurindi w’inka. Ikinyemera ni imbyino iserukanwa n’ibitsina byombi bagatandukanira mu gutega maboko, mu ntambwe no buryo abagore bakoresha umwitero mu cyiciro kitwa kuvugutira inka.

Imbyino y'Igishakamba ni imbyino ikomoka mu Nkore mu gihugu cy’Ubuganda. Yaje kugera mu Rwanda inyuze mu Mutara w’i Ndorwa, mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda. Iza gusakara mu Buganza, ikwira mu gihugu hose.
Abagabo baseruka bacinya ikirenge inshuro ebyiri zikurikirana ku butaka babisikanya amaguru, ukw’ibumoso n’ukw’iburyo, bakabanza gucunda amaboko bayerekeza imbere n’inyuma cyangwa iburyo n’ibumoso. Igihe kiragera bakongera umurindi w’ikirenge, bakerekeza amaboko mu kirere bigana uko amahembe y’inka ateze. Abahimbawe cyane bacishamo bakizengurukaho ndetse bakaba banabisikana.
Abagore babyina igishakamba babanza guseruka ukwabo babyina kimwe nk’abagabo. Igihe kiragera bose bagasobeka bakajyanamo akanya, nyuma abagabo bagaca bugufi ndetse bamwe bagatera ivi, bakomera amashyi abagore. Abagore bakarushaho guhimbarwa, bakabigaragaza mu kwikunda no mu kunyeganyeza mu mbavu, mu gihe abagabo banyuzamo bakamamaho ibiganza iburyo n’ibumoso, bigana uko abungeri bakubita inka ibizinzo.

Imbyino rikomoka ku nshinga kubyina bisobanura guhondagura ibirenge ku butaka ku buryo buboneye ukabigira wikaraga mu mubyimba kandi urusaku rw’íbirenge rukajyanirana n'indirimbo yabigenewe. Naho ijambo imbyino ryo rigasobanura Indirimbo iherekejwe n'úmudiho.
Imbyino nyinshi mu Rwanda rwo hambere zari zishamikiye ku kuvuga inka n’bwiza. Koko rero, izi mbyino zivoma mu myireko ifite aho ihuriye n’urugamba kuko inka zivugwa ari inyambo zihanganishwa ku rugamba hagati y’Ibihogo n’Amagaju. Byongeye kandi, usanga ubwiza bw’inka (inyambo) bugererenywa n’ubwiza bw’Umunyarwandakazi.

Sherrie Silver Foundation ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu washinzwe mu mwaka wa 2015 na Sherrie Silver, umubyinnyi n’umutoza w’imbyino ukomoka mu Rwanda.
Uyu muryango ugamije gufasha abana n’urubyiruko kubona amahirwe yo kwiteza imbere binyuze mu mpano z’ubuhanzi n'imbyino, umuziki n’imyidagaduro.
Intego nyamukuru zawo ni ugufasha abana cyane cyane abaturuka mu miryango itishoboye kuvumbura impano zabo, kwiyubaka no kugira icyizere mu bushobozi bwabo. Binyuze mu mahugurwa, ibikorwa by’ubuhanzi n’inkunga mu mibereho n’uburezi, uyu muryango ugamije guteza imbere urubyiruko no kurufasha kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’umuryango nyarwanda.
Umuryango kandi utegura ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije Guteza Imbere Urwanda Rwejo
Sherrie Silver Foundation ni umuryango washinzwe na Sherrie Silver ugamije guteza imbere impano z’abana bo muri Afurika, cyane cyane abaturuka mu miryango itishoboye, binyuze mu buhanzi nko kubyina no kuririmba. Uyu muryango uha abana amahugurwa n’amahirwe yo kwagura impano zabo, bikabafasha kwiteza imbere no gufasha imiryango yabo mu mibereho

Gushyingura kuva mu Rwanda bajyaga kera Abanyarwanda bafite uko bashyingura ababo babaga bapfuye kuva kera mu bakurambere bari bafite uko babikora ndetse n'imihango bakoraga.
Mu muco wacu mu Rwanda abantu bazima bashimwa n'Imana n'abazimu bacu batazima bakajya kuruhukira muri Muhabura yahabuye abana b'u Rwanda, abajyaga mu muriro ntabwo bari abi Rwanda rero abajya muri Nyiragongo ihora yaka maze bagashya bagatokombera, mugihe ababaye ibirumirahabiri bacishwa muri kalisimbi bakabanza gukubitwa akanyafu n'ubukonje bwaho amaherezo bakazabona kujyanwa mu gitaramo cy'Abakuru b'i Rwanda muri Muhabura.
kera iyo bajyaga gushyingura hari imihango y’ikitegererezo bakoraga mu gutsirika umuzimu aribyo Guhambanwa ikara Umuntu wapfaga atarashatse cyangwa atarabyaye, akenshi yahambanwaga ikara.
Ibi byakorwaga kugira ngo umuzimu we utazagaruka guteza amahane mu muryango kandi byafatwaga nk’ikosa ry’umuryango kuba uwo muntu yaragejeje igihe cyo gushaka ntibabimufashemo, bityo bakamutsirika ngo atazaza kubishyuza.
Kera uwakubiswe n’inkuba mbere yo gushyingura uwishwe n’inkuba, habanzaga gukorwa imihango yo kugangahura no kuraguza kugira ngo bamenye icyateye icyo kiza.
Kirazira ku kiriyo byaraziraga kurya inyama mu kiriyo cy’uwapfuye, kuko byafatwaga nko kurya intumbi cyangwa se umurambo w'uwapfuye.

Nyirarumaga ni umwe mu bagore b’ingenzi cyane mu mateka ya gakondo nyarwanda. Yabaye Umugabekazi w’ingoboka ku ngoma ya Ruganzu II Ndoli, umwami wategetse u Rwanda mu kinyejana cya 16. Nyirarumaga yavukaga mu muryango w’Abasinga, kandi yari azwi cyane kubera ubwenge, ubwitange n’ubuhanga mu buhanzi bw’ubusizi. Mu mateka y’u Rwanda afatwa nk’umubyeyi w’ubusizi nyarwanda, kuko yagize uruhare rukomeye mu gutuma ubusizi bukoreshwa mu kubika amateka y’igihugu no gusingiza abami.
Nyirarumaga yabaye umuntu ukomeye mu buzima bwa Ruganzu II Ndoli. Igihe se wa Ruganzu yari amaze kwicwa n’abanzi, umwana we yahungiye i Karagwe (aho muri Tanzaniya y’ubu). Nyirarumaga yamubereye umurinzi n’umujyanama, ndetse aza kugirwa nyina w’ingoboka w’umwami (umugabekazi). Yagize uruhare rukomeye mu kumufasha kugaruka mu Rwanda no kongera kubaka igihugu cyari cyarasenyutse. Mu mateka bavuga ko yigeze no gukiza ubuzima bwa Ruganzu Ndoli igihe yari agoswe n’abashakaga kumwica, ndetse akababazwa cyane kuko yigeze no gutakaza urutoki kubera kwanga kuvuga aho umwami yari yihishe.
Mu buhanzi, Nyirarumaga ni we watangije uburyo bw’ubusizi bwitwa Impakanizi. Ubu ni ubusizi bwavugaga amateka y’abami n’igihugu, aho buri mwami yongerwaga mu gisigo nk’aho wongera isaro ku runigi. Ibi byari uburyo bwo kubika amateka y’u Rwanda mu magambo, kuko icyo gihe nta nyandiko zari zihari. Umwe mu mirimo ye izwi cyane ni igisigo cyitwa “Umunsi ameza imiryango yose”, cyavugaga inkomoko y’ingoma n’umuco w’Abanyarwanda. Ubu buryo bwo gusiga amateka mu bisigo bwaje kuba inkingi ikomeye y’umuco nyarwanda.
Nyirarumaga kandi yashyizeho Intebe y’Abasizi, aho abasizi b’ibwami bateraniraga bagahimba ibisigo by’amateka n’ibisingiza abami. Aho hantu hari ku musozi wa Kiruri mu karere ka Huye, ahafatwaga nk’ahera ku basizi. Abahanzi bazamukaga kuri uwo musozi mu gitondo bakicara mu bwigunge bagahimba ibisigo, hanyuma bakamanuka bakabigeza ku bami n’abantu. Uwo muco w’ubusizi wagize uruhare rukomeye mu kubika amateka y’u Rwanda mu buryo bw’imivugo n’inkuru.
Kubera uruhare rwe mu mateka n’umuco, Nyirarumaga afatwa nk’umwe mu bagore b’intwari mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Uyu munsi izina rye rikomeje kubahwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’umuco n’ubusizi, ndetse hari n’ibihembo n’ibirori byitiriwe izina rye bigamije guteza imbere ubusizi n’ubuvanganzo nyarwanda. Umurage yasize ni uko ubusizi bwabaye igikoresho cyo kubika amateka, gusigasira umuco no gukomeza kwigisha ibisekuru bizaza amateka y’igihugu.

Pirigatori ni inyigisho yo mu idini Gatolika ku isi ndetse no mu Rwanda, ivuga ko ari ahantu cyangwa imimerere abapfuye bafite ibyaha bito bito cyangwa batarangije guhanirwa ibyaha byabo bahawe imbabazi, banyura ngo bakurweho imyanda y'ibyaha mbese ba kweza mbere y'uko binjira mu ijuru.
Abagatolika bemera ko amasengesho n'ibitambo bya misa bishobora gufasha ubugingo buri mu pirigatori kwihuta kwinjira mu ijuru, ni nko kweza ubugingo kugira ngo bwemererwe kwinjira mu bwami bw'Imana butunganye.

Kwiyiriza ubusa ni igikorwa cy’abantu basenga Imana, bagikora kugira ngo bicuze ibbyaha bakoze cyangwa se Imana ibarebe neza.
Abatemerewe kwiyiriza.
Kwiriza ubusa ni ikintu cy’ingenzi mu buzima akaba ari ni ukumenya ko atari byiza kwiyiriza mu gihe uri gufata imiti cyangwa se ufite ubundi burwayi. Mu gihe wifuza kubikora kandi umeze utyo, ni ngombwa kubijyaho inama na muganga wawe. Abagore batwite n’abonsa bo babujijwe gukora iki gikorwa, kereka gusa igihe babisabwe n’abaganga.
Kwiyiriza ubusa ku mubiri wubukora ushaka uburyo wisukura, ukivanamo imyanda ishobora kuba yawangiza. Ibi bishoboka iyo umuntu atariye, utunyangingo twe duhindura imikorere tukabasha gusukura umubiri w’umuntu., nanone ni uko iyo umuntu atariye nko mu gihe cy’amasaha 12, umubiri we utangira gukoresha isukari wifashishije ibinure wabitse n’ibindi bitandukanye, ibi bikaba byagabanya ibyago byo kuba umuntu yarwara indwara zirimo umutima cyangwa se akagira umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso.

Amasengesho y'Agatatu cyangwa amasengesho yo ku wa Gatatu) ni amasengesho akunze kuba ku munsi w'agatatu akaza kumenyekana nk'amateraniro y'umunsi wose akaba ari ayo guhembuka n'ububyutse, no gusengera ibyifuza, kuramya, guhimbaza, ububyutse, kwiga ijambo ry'Imana akenshi akorerwa mu nsengero zitandukanye.

Amaturo ni ijambo ry'ikinyarwanda akaba ari ijambo ry'abanyamadini, aho bisobanura umusanzu, ituro, impano, utangana ubushake, bikaba biri muri gahunda z'imihango, idini, cyangwa se mu idini ya isilamu, Rero mu buryo bw'umwuka, bituma umuntu agera ku bakomeye. Mu muco nyarwanda n'uw'idini, bifatwa nk'ikimenyetso cyo gushimira Imana, gufasha abakene, no kwiyegereza abakomeye.
Intego z'amaturo atangwa kugira ngo ashyigikire imirimo y'Imana, gufasha abatishoboye, cyangwa gushimira, Amaturo akaba yitwa Zakat mu Isilamu akaba ari ituro ryoroheje rikuwe mu mutungo w'abishoboye rigahabwa abakene.

Icya cumi (cyangwa icyacumi) ni amafaranga cyangwa se ikintu cyose wungutse maze muribyo ugatanga kimwe mu bice icumi (1/10) by’ibyo umuntu yungutse bivuye mu musaruro, maze bikitwa ko gihabwa Imana haba mu misigiti cya urusengero.
Icyacumi gifite Inkomoko cyangwa cyatangiye gukoreshawa nkuko bi iboneka muri Bibiliya, aho Abisirayeli basabwaga kugitanga kugira ngo gishyigikire umurimo w’Imana n’abatambyi (Abalewi) batagiraga gakondo, Mu gihe cya kera, cyatangwaga mu biribwa cyangwa imyaka cyangwa amatungo, ariko muri iki gihe mu madini atandukanye gitangwa mu mafaranga.

urusengero ni inyubako cyangwa ahantu hagenewe guhurira abantu bari kuramya Imana, kumva ijambo ry'Imana, gutura ibitambo, no gukora imihango y'idini, bwese rufatwa nk'inzu yera yahariwe gusengerwamo Imana.
Mu Rwanda hari insengero zitandukanye aha twagaragaza nka:

Idini rifite inkomoko mu rurimi rw'Igiswahili cyangwa se mu rurimi rw'icyarabu rikaba risobanura Ukwemera. Idini ahanini imyemerere inshiye ku myizerere, cyangwa uburyo abantu basengamo bigendanye n'imihango, amahame bikuzwa n'itsinda ry'abantu kugirango bagaragaze ubumwe n'ubunyangamugayo.
idini rihaza icyifuzo cy'ibanze cy'umuntu cyo gushaka intego y'ubuzima no kumenya imbaraga zimukuriye. Icyakora, abantu benshi bagaragaza ko idini ritandukanye n' itorero cyangwa umubano wihariye n'Imana, aho idini rifatwa nk'uburyo bwo hanze n'amategeko, mu gihe kwizera nyakuri ari ibyo mu mutima.

Iteraniro cyangwa Itorero mu rwego rwa Gikristo, itorero ntirivuga inyubako cyangwa inzu gusa, ahubwo ryerekeza ku iteraniro ry'abantu, Ni ihuriro ry'abantu basangiye imibereho n'imyizerere muri Yesu Kristo, guhamagarwa mu bandi cyangwa guteranyiriza hamwe, rero itorero ni ihuriro cyangwa ishuri ry’abantu bahujwe n’imyizerere cyangwa idini cyangwa indangagaciro z’umuco n’iterambere.

Marie-France Munyampundu Gusenga, uzwi ku izina rya France Mpundu, ni umuhanzikazi w’Umunyarwandakazi wavukiye kandi akurira mu Karere ka Nyanza, mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda. Yatangiye kugaragaza impano yo kuririmba akiri muto, aririmba no muri korali ya Kiliziya. Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yo gutsinda irushanwa ry’impano mu muziki rya "I’m the Future" mu mwaka wa 2018. Mu mwaka wa 2025, yitabiriye irushanwa rya televiziyo "Secret Story Afrique", aho yageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma, arangiza ku mwanya wa kane.
France Mpundu yavukiye kandi akurira mu Karere ka Nyanza. Akiri muto, yakundaga kuririmba muri korali ya Kiliziya, ari na ho yakomeje guteza imbere impano ye. Yize amashuri abanza kuri St. Joseph Primary School, ayisumbuye mu cyiciro rusange kuri College Christ-Roi, akomereza mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy’amashuri yisumbuye kuri Notre Dame i Karubanda.
Urugendo rwa France Mpundu mu muziki rwamenyekanye cyane mu mwaka wa 2017, ubwo yitabiraga irushanwa rya "I’m the Future", ryateguwe na David Tuyishime uzwi nka David Pro. Yegukanye iryo rushanwa mu mwaka wa 2018, bituma abona amahirwe yo gukomeza guteza imbere umuziki we.
Mu ndirimbo ze harimo "Sinabirota", "Bitwayiki", "Gake", "Selfish Love", "Darlin" na "Umutima". Indirimbo "Darlin" yayikoranye na Yvan Buravan, naho "Over" ayikorana na Juno Kizigenza. Indirimbo ze za mbere zasohotse ubwo yari muri Future Record, inzu y’umuziki yari yarateguye irushanwa rya "I’m the Future".
Mu mwaka wa 2023, yatangiye gukorana na Huha Records, itsinda rifasha abahanzi barimo Juno Kizigenza. Iyi mikoranire yamufashije gukomeza gushyira hanze indirimbo no guteza imbere ibikorwa bye by’umuziki. Indirimbo "Umutima" yayikoze afatanyije na Juno Kizigenza, wamufashije no mu kuyandika.
Mu mwaka wa 2025, France Mpundu yitabiriye irushanwa rya televiziyo "", ryabereye muri Afurika y’Epfo kandi rikanyuzwa kuri Canal+ Magic. Yageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma ari kumwe n’abandi bahatanaga. Mugenzi we Moctar, ukomoka muri Niger, yamuhaye amahirwe yo guhita ajya muri finale nyuma yo kubona kode y’ibanga yamuhaga uburenganzira bwo gukomeza. Mu musozo w’irushanwa, Moctar yegukanye igihembo nyamukuru, naho France Mpundu arangiza ku mwanya wa kane.
Ku wa 16 Mutarama 2026, France Mpundu yakoze igitaramo cye cya mbere cya muzika mu buryo bwa "live" muri French Institute i Kigali. Yaririmbye indirimbo ze zirimo "Sinabirota" na "Darlin", anataramana na Juno Kizigenza, baririmbana indirimbo yabo "Over". Igitaramo cyitabiriwe n’abakunzi be n’abagize umuryango we.
Ku wa 6 Kamena 2026, France Mpundu yaririmbye mu birori byo gusoza icyiciro cya kabiri cy’irushanwa rya "Nouvelle Reine", ryabereye muri Côte d’Ivoire. Icyo gihe yari atwite inda nkuru yiteguraga kwibaruka. Inkuru yabivuzeho yasohotse muri "People TV" ku wa 6 Nyakanga 2026.
Ubuzima bw’umuryango.
France Mpundu na Moctar bahuriye mu irushanwa rya "Secret Story Afrique", aho umubano wabo wagiye umenyekana mu gihe irushanwa ryari rikomeje. Ku wa 15 Ugushyingo 2025, Moctar yamwambitse impeta y’urukundo amusaba ko bakomeza umubano wabo, maze France Mpundu arabyemera.
Ku wa 27 Nyakanga 2026, France Mpundu na Moctar bibarutse umwana wabo wa mbere. Ku wa 18 Nzeri 2026, Moctar yahaye France Mpundu imodoka yo mu bwoko bwa BYD Leopard 3. Ku wa 7 Ukwakira 2026, berekanye umwana wabo ku mugaragaro binyuze ku mafoto basangije abakunzi babo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.

Imisango y'ubukwe igiye itandukanye uhereye mu gihe cyohambere hagendewe ku muco,imyizerere naho abantu bagiye baherereye mu Rwanda.
Habanza Gusaba no Gufata Irembo.
Ni Imisango yaberega iwabo w'umukobwa, byabanzirizwaga no kurambagiza. Umuhango wo gusaba no gufata irembo bigomba kuba byihuse ubusanzwe mu muco nyarwanda ntawimana irembo igihe umuryango w'umusore wabaga wemerewe irembo, byakurikirwaga no gufata irembo. Igihe abo mu muryago w'umusore bagiye kumufatira irembo babaga bageze iwabo w'umukobwa, barabakira bakabazimanira n'uko uhagarariye umuryango w'umukobwa akababaza ikibagenza. Ise w'umusore cyangwa undi umuryango w'umusore batoranije nibo bajyaga gusaba no gufata irembo. Umuryango usaba watangaga inka y'ifatarembo ku bifite cyangwa isuka kubabaga baciriritse. Byabaga ari ubwa mbere imiryango yombi ihuye, ikaganira kubijyanye n'ubukwe, bakajya inama kubizakorwa n'ibizakenerwa mu ubukwe bw'abana babo.
Hakurikira Gusaba no Gukwa.
Mu imisango y'ubukwe gusaba umugeni ni umuhango wakurikiraga gufata irembo, nabwo ukabera iwabo w'umukobwa. Mu muhango wo gusaba, umuryango w'umusore watoranyaga abakwe bajya kuwusabira, bakagenda bayobowe n'umukwe mukuru, kandi bitwaje inzoga yo gusabisha. Wari umuhango woguha agaciro imiryango yombi kuko umusore ntiyabaga yemerewe gutwara umukobwa atamuhawe. Ibyo byari ikimenyetso cy'uko umuryango w'umuhungu uhaye agaciro umuryango wareze umukobwa. Mu guhe cyo gusaba umuryango w'umukobwa ntiwahitaga wemerera umuryango w'umusore umugeni, ibyo bikagaragaza kwihesha agaciro nk'umuryango no kugahesha abawukomokaho. Nyuma yogusaba hakurikiragaho umuhango wo gukwa ugakorwa n'umuryango w'umusore n'ubundi bikabera iwabo w'umukobwa. Umusore yakwaga inka,andi matungi cyangwa isuka gusa byose byitwaga ko bakoye inka. Inkwano byabaga ari ikimenyetso cy'uko imiryango ibaye inshuti. Inkwano yari ipfundo ry'ubumwe hagati y'imiryango yombi. Kandi mu muco nyarwanda inkwano ntiyabaga inzitizi, Yaba ibonetse cyangwa itabonetse, ntibyakuragaho k'ubukwe butaha. Igihe inkwano yabaga ibuze, umusore yashoboraga gutenda, bivuze gufata igihe aba kwa sebukwe akora akazi gasimbura inkwano cyangwa agahabwa umugeni w'ubuntu. ni uko imisango y'ubukwe igenda ikorwa.

Kurongora no kurongorwa byabanzirizwaga n'imisango y'ubukwe mu muco wa kinyarwanda. Iyo igihe cyabaga kigeze, umuryango w'umukobwa bahekaga umukobwa bakamushyira umuryango w'umusore.
Uburyo byakorwaga mu gihe cyo hambere.
Umukobwa igihe yabaga ageze kwa sebukwe, hari imihango yakorwaga yokumwakira igiye itandukanye bitewe na gace byakorerwagamo. Hari aho iyo yabaga akiri mubingi by'amarembo, yahagararaga hejuru yaho batabye urusyo, nyirabukwe akamukoza umwuko ku mpanga. Hari aho umugeni yinjiraga agasanga sebukwe yicaye ikambere akamwicaza ku bibero akamuha inka y'ibibero akabona kujyanwa mu mbere. Mu gihe ibirori by'ubukwe byabaga bigeze hagati. se w'umusore yamujyanaga kurongora. Mu kurongora hakoreshwaga umwishywa, umusore akawambika umugeni hanyuma akavuga ati ndakurongoye ndi kanaka mwene kanaka, maze ababyeyi bakavuza impundu. Ibirori byarakomezaga kugeza mu gitondo, abaje baherekeje umugeni bagasezera bagataha. Nyuma y'uko abaje bahetse umugeni bageze iwabo w'umukobwa bagashikiriza ababyeyibe umwishywa. Hakurikiragaho umuhango wo kwakira umwishywa ukabanzirizwa no gucunda.
Nta mukobwa washyingirwaga yaratakaje ubusugi kuko kubutakaza byabaga ari igisebo ku mukobwa, umuryango akomokamo n’igihugu. Uwabaga yatwise atarashyingirwa, yafatwaga nk’uwatesheje igihugu ubusugi, kugira ngo igihugu gisubirane iryo shema ry’ubusugi bwacyo, umukobwa bakamucira mu mahanga cyangwa bakamuroha. Nyuma yo kurongorwa, hari iminsi umugeni yamaraga ari mu nzu adasohoka. Muri icyo gihe cyo gutinya yaboheraga nyirabukwe akebo k’ibara rimwe, bitaga nyirabitabo. Gutinya byafashaga umukobwa kumenyerana n’umuryango ajemo, akamenya imyitwarire n’imico biranga umuryango mushya ajemo. Hakurikiraga gutwikurura. Ni umuhango wakorwaga hagamije gusohora umugeni kugira ngo bamuhe uburenganzira bwo kujya ahagaragara, kugira ngo atangire imirimo ye. Habanzaga gukura abageni mu nyegamo, kubogosha amasunzu, guha abana amata no kubereka imitwa.Mu kwerekwa imitwa, urugo rushya rwahabwaga ibyangombwa nkenerwa birimo ibikoresho, ibiribwa n’ibindi. Umuryango w’umukobwa wabaga wamuzaniye ibiribwa, imyaka n’ibikoresho byo mu gikoni. Umukwe mukuru ni we watumwaga mu rugo ngo ayobore uwo muhango, aherekejwe n’abakuze n’amasugi.

HAGENIMANA Jean Paul ni umuhanzi nyarwanda uzwi cyane kwizina rya Bushali, Bushali kandi ni we nkingi ya mwamba y'injyana nshya yitwa Kinyatrap. Yayihimbye afite imyaka 24 gusa, maze avanga injyana ivuye hanze n'umuco gakondo wacu.
Umudiho we utandukanye n'iyindi, Ihuza uburyo bwo kuririmba budasanzwe, ibisigo, n'ingoma zifite imbaraga, bigatuma Trap ihinduka umwimerere w’Abanyarwanda.
Ni umuhanzi ufite impano idasanzwe yo guhuza ibya kera n'ibigezeweho. Ibi nibyo bituma afatwa nk’umwe mu bahanzi b’ejo hazaza h’umuziki w’u Rwanda.
Bushali yatangiye kugaragara mu muziki mu mwaka wa 2016. Avuka mu muryango w'abana barindwi, akaba yaragize igitekerezo cyo gukora umuziki utandukanye n'uwo bandi bakoraga. Ntabwo yifuzaga kwigana injyana za America gusa, ahubwo yashakaga uburyo yahuza injyana igezweho n'imivugire ndetse n'umuco w'i Kigali, cyane cyane mu gace k'i Nyamirambo aho yakuriye.
Ivuka rya Kinyatrap na "Nituebue" (2018).
Umwaka wa 2018 ni wo wabaye imbarutso ikomeye mu mateka ye:
Guhanga Injyana: Bushali, ari kumwe n'abandi bahanzi nka B-Threy na Slum Drip, bashinze injyana bise Kinyatrap. iyi njyana ntabwo yari imudiho gusa, ahubwo yari uburyo bushya bwo gukoresha ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda (slang) mu muziki wa Trap.
Indirimbo "Nituebue": Mu Ugushyingo 2018, nibwo hasohotse indirimbo "Nituebue". Iyi ndirimbo yahinduye amateka, ituma Kinyatrap imenyekana mu gihugu hose kandi ituma Bushali n'abo bafatanyaga bamenyekana nk'abahanzi b'abahanga
Alubumu ya mbere: Murui uwo mwaka kandi yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere yise "Nyiramubande", yagaragaje ko ari umuhanzi uzi kuvuga amateka n'ubuzima bwo mu muryango nyarwanda.

Kubatizwa ni umuhango w'abakirisitu muri rusange, kubatizwa kandi birimo amako menshi bitewe n'amatorero cyangwa imyizerere, kwibizwa mu mazi menshi ku bavutse ubwakabiri(abarokore), cyangwa se gusukwa amazi mugahanga kuri kiriziya gatolika, akaba ari igikorwa cy'ingenzi mubuzima bwa gikristo kigaragaza ko umuntu yiyeguriye Imana, kandi akiyemeza gukurikira inyigisho za Yesu Kristo. Ijambo "kubatizwa" rikomoka mu rurimi rw'ikigiriki risobanura kwibiza mu mazi.
Kubatizwa ni iri jambo rikomoka ku rurimi rw'Ikigiriki risobanura kwibiza mu mazi, akaba ari nayo mpamvu imyizerere myinshi ishingiye kuri Bibiliya ishimangira ko umubatizo nyakuri ari uwo kwibizwa wese mu mazi menshi.
Kubatizwa kandi ni umuhango wo gutanga izina mu madini amwe namwe nka gatolika,kuko iyo utabatijwe akenshi usanga umuntu afite izina rimwe atemerewe kugira irya kabiri ugasanga rero umuntu afite ipfunwe ko adafite izina rya kabiri ndetse bakamwita ko ari umupagani.
Tukiri ku myizerere hari na batisimu ya Mwukawera/Roho mutagatifu bivugwa ko ari ugusabana n'imana kurwego rwo hejuru ndetse bakagira n'umwanya wo kuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana nkuko byabaye ku ntumwa kubantu bizera bibiliya.

Kera u Rwanda nk'igihu cyari gituwe n'abanyarwanda kavukire basangiye umuco, ururimi ndetse n'indagagaciro nakirazira
bagiraga ibikorwa bitandukanya byabafashaga mumibereho yabo yaburi munsi. Aho wasangaga bakora imirimo itandukanye y'amaboko nko kubaza, guhinga, gucura, kubumba, kuboha, kumasha, korora amatungo magufi n'amaremare ibi byatumaga babasha kwishakamo ibisubizo igihe amapfa yabaga abugarije.
by'umwihariko reka tugaruke kubyarangaga ibihe by'ubuhinzi mu u Rwanda rwakera nkumwe mu mirimo fatizo yakozwe kuvakera u Rwanda rwahangwa na Gihanga.
nubwo ubwo buhinzi bwakorwaga nkumwe mumirimo shingiro y'abatura Rwanda, ubuhinzi bwagenderaga kubihe bine byigenzi aribyo:
Umuhindo nka kimwe mubihe byingenzi by'ihinga mu Rwanda cyari igihe cyagiraga imvura iringaniye nkeya murugero, abahinga barahingaga ibihingwa by'amako atandukanye nk'amasaka, imyumbati, ibigori, ndetse n'ibishyimbo. cyari igihe cyiza cyagutera ibihingwa ngandura rugo, cyangwa se ibiribwa bw'ibanze. Umuhindo watangira mukwezi kwa Nzeri ukarangira mukwezi k'Ukuboza.
Urugaryi narwo rwari igihe kingenzi kiza mubihe byari bigize igihe cy'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda rwohambere, murikino gihe hagwaga imvura nkeya ndetse nizuba ridakanaganye aho babashaga gusarura ibihingwa byabaga byarahinzwe mu muhindo.
Igihe cy'urugaryi cyatangiraga mukwezi kwa Mutarama cyikarangirana na Gashyantare.
Itumba naryo nigihe cyari ngenzi mubihe by'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda aho inzura yagwaga ari nyinshi cyane bitandukanye no mubindi bihe byaranga ubuhinzi. abahinzi bahingaga ibihingwa bitandukanye harimo ibijumba, imyumbati, n'ibishyimbo by'itumba. Bitewe nimvura yagwaga arinyinshi kandi igihe kirekire byatumaga abahinzi bahinga ibihingwa bitangizwa namazi menshi cyangwa imvuranyinshi.
Impeshyi cyar'igihe cyizuba ry'inshi kandi ry'igihe kirekire aho abahinzi basaruraga mu itumba bakanafata umwanya wo kongera gutegura imirima guhanga ibyobo byogufata amazi y'isuri ashobora gutwara imyaka no kuraza ubutaka.
Ibibihe byose byari bishingiye kubuhanga gakondo bwo kumenya nogutegura ubuhinzi bashingiye ku kirere, aho abahinzi bakoreshaga ibikoresho byoroshye nk'isuka, imihoro, agataro ndetse nimbaragazabo. nubwo ububuhinzi bwateye imbere, ubu buryo bwoguhinga ukurikije ibihe by'imvura n'izuba bwarangaga u Rwanda rwo hambere.

Kanjongera yari umugabekazi kumazina yibwami yitwaga Kanjogera akaba yari nyina w'umwami Yuhi V Musinga, azwiho kuba umugore wari ufite imbaraga n’ijambo rikomeye mu mitegekere y’igihugu cyu Rwanda. Yagize uruhare mu bihe bikomeye by’amateka harimo no guhangana n’abakoloni.
Nyirayuhi Kanjogera yatwaranye ingoma n’abami nka Mibambwe IV Rutalindwa, ndese n’umuhungu we Yuhi V Musinga, kuva ku wa 15 Nzeri 1895 kugeza ku wa 12 Ugushyingo 1931, ubwo umwami Musinga na Nyirayuhi Kanjogera wari umubereye umugabekazi, babacaga ku bwami.Mu rufatiro rw’ibinyoma byifashishijwe mu mpinduramatwara ikuraho ubwami, hari n’ibinyoma byafatiwe kuri Kanjogera by’uko yashakaga guhagukura, agafata inkota akayishinga mu nda z’abana b’abahutu, akabapfumura akabona guhaguruka.

Mukazayire Nelly yavutse ku babyeyi b'Abanyarwanda mu Rwanda muri 1982. ni minisitit ushinzwe siporo mu Rwanda.

Mukazayire akora umuyobozi wa leta nka abaminisitiri kuva mu Kwakira 2018, yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru wa Biro y’amasezerano y’u Rwanda, ishami rya leta. Kuri ubu, ari ku rwego rwa Minisitiri w’igihugu.

Urwina rw’ibitoki mu muco nyarwanda ni igice cy’ingenzi cy’umuco w’ubuhinzi bw'ibitoki n’imihango y’imiryango. Ibitoki byari ifunguro rikomeye kandi ry’ingirakamaro, kandi urwina rwabyo rwafatwaga nk’ikimenyetso cy’umugisha n’ubutunzi mu muryango nya Rwanda. Ubuhinzi bw'urutoki bwafatwaga nkimwe munkingi ngandura rugo ndetse no mukwihaza kubiribwa ariko bikomoka kunsina ndetse nogusabana kwimiryango.
Urwina rw'ibitoki nirwo rwifashishwaga mukugirango babashe kubyaza urutoki inzoga mu ibitoki byabaga byeze nkumusaruro nkumusaruro warukomotsemo. kugeza nubu nubwo harikuza ikoranabuhanga mubijyanye no gutara ibitoki tuzi nka(smart urwina) hari bamwe mubanyarwa bakirukoresho mukubyaza umusaruro ubuhinzi bw'urutoki.
Mu guhuza ubuzima bwa buri munsi, urwina rw’ibitoki rwakoreshwaga mu buryo butandukanye. Abanyarwanda bo hambere babikoraga kugira ngo barusheho kugira umusaruro mwiza kandi urambye uturutse munsina. Urwina rw’ibitoki rwari rufite uburyo bwo kubika no gutunganya ibitoki mbere yo kubirya cyangwa kubigurisha, rugashyirwa ahantu haboneye kandi hameze neza, rugashyirwaho ibikoresho by’umwimerere n’isuku. Ibi byari bigamije kurinda ko ibitoki byangirika, bigatuma umuryango ukomeza kugira ubushobozi bwo kubona ifunguro ryiza.
Mu migenzo y’imihango, urwina rw’ibitoki rwafatwaga nkahantu cyangwa nk’igikoresho cy’ingenzi mu mihango y’ubukwe, ubusabane, n’amasabukuru y’umuryango. Hari ubwo ibitoki byavugwaga mu buryo bw’icyubahiro mu mihango yo gusangira cyangwa gutanga impano, bigaragaza umugisha, ubutunzi, n’icyubahiro cy’umuryango watanze ibitoki. Gutanga urwina rw’ibitoki byashimangiraga ubumwe n’ubusabane hagati y’imiryango, kandi byari bimwe mu bimenyetso by’uburumbuke.
Mu myemerere y’iyobokamana n’umuco, urwina rw’ibitoki rwafatwaga nk’ikimenyetso cy’umugisha w’Imana cyangwa w’abakurambere. Kubika, gutunganya no kurufata neza urwina rw’ibitoki, byari uburyo bwo kugaragaza ko umuryango wubaha imihango n’umuco, ndetse bikanafasha mu gukomeza gutunganya imyaka neza.
Muri make urwina rw’ibitoki ntabwo rwari urw’ifatizo gusa mu ifunguro, ahubwo rwari igice cy’ingenzi cy’umuco, umugisha n’ubutunzi bw’umuryango. Rugaragazaga uko Abanyarwanda bo hambere ndetse nabubu babona ifunguro, ubutunzi, n’imihango yabo, ndetse n’uburyo bwo kubyaza umusaruro muburyo bunoze ubuhinzi bw’urutoki.

Uwicyeza Pamella (yavutse 31 Mutarama 2000)ni umunyarwandakazi uzwi cyane nk'umugore w'umuhanzi witwa Mugisha Benjamin, uzwi nka The Ben. Pamella Uwicyeza yitabiriye amarushanwa ya Miss Rwanda mu 2019, aho yaje mu bakobwa 20 ba nyuma. Yavukiye mu Rwanda, bakaba bafitanye umwana umwe witwa Lunah.
Uwicyeza Pamella yize amashuri abanza ndetse yiga n'amashuri yisumbuye mu bijyanye n'Amateka, Ubukungu n'Ubumenyi bw'Isi (HEG) kuri APADE ku Kicukiro, yitabiriye Miss Rwanda 2019, ahagarariye Intara y'Amajyepfo, yabaye Igisonga cya Mbere cya Miss Zuri Africa Queen 2019, rero tariki 18 Werurwe 2025, nibwo yatangaje ko yibarutse imfura ye na The Ben.

Ubudehe mu muco gakondo w’Abanyarwanda ugamije gufashanya hagati y’abaturage bu Rwanda mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Mugihe cyohambere, abaturarwanda bafatanyaga mu mirimo y’ubuhinzi, ubworozi, kubaka amazu, ndetse no mu gihe cy’ibibazo by’umuryango cyangwa igihugu. Ubudehe ntago bwari busanzwe nk’akazi gusa, ahubwo bwari ikimenyetso cy’ubufatanye, ubumwe n’ubusabane mu muryango no mu baturanyi.
Mu muryango nyarwanda, ubudehe bwari uburyo bwo gushyigikirana no kwita ku mibereho y’abagize umuryango nyarwanda. Abagize umuryango bafashaga umwe kuw'undi mu gihe cyo guhinga, gusarura, cyangwa kubaka inzu. Ibi byatumaga abantu bakura, bakamenya gukorana neza, gufashanya, no kwiyubakira icyizere mu muryango. Ubudehe bwarimo kandi inyigisho ku kubaha abakuze no kurera abana mu bufatanye burambye hagati yabatuye umuryango nyarwanda. Mu muryango byari uburyo bwo kuganira, gufashanya no gusangira ibitekerezo ku mibereho y’umudugudu. Umuntu wese yashoboraga gutanga icyo ashoboye, yaba ari imbaraga, ubumenyi, cyangwa ibikoresho.
Indangagaciro z'ubudehe.
Ubudehe bwari bushingiye ku ndagaciro mu banyarwanda nku:
Ubumwe: guhuriza hamwe imbaraga mu nyungu z’abaturage rusange
Ubufatanye: kuzamurana mu buryo rusange aho kuba inyungu yawe bwite gusa.
Ubupfura n’icyubahiro: kubahana hagati yabavandimwe, abakuru n’abaturanyi.
Gusangira: kugabana umusaruro n’ibyo umuntu yagezeho mu bufatanye nta mururumba hagati y'abanyarwanda.
Ubudehe bwa mu igihe cya none.
Nubwo ubu abantu benshi babona ubudehe mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga cyangwa mu bikorwa bya leta nk’akazi rusange mu mudugudu, igitekerezo nyamukuru cy’ubudehe nticyahindutse, ni gufashanya no gushyigikirana hagati mubatura Rwanda ndetse n'abaturanyi. Hari n’ahantu ubudehe bukoreshwa mu mishinga y’ubukungu y’abaturage, mu guhingira hamwe, cyangwa mu kubaka ibikorwa rusange bibateza imbere.
Muri ikii gihe nanone Ubudehe ni gahunda yo gushyira imiryango nyarwanda mu byiciro hashingiwe ku mibereho n'ubukungu, ikoreshwa na Leta yu Rwanda mu gutanga ubufasha n'ingamba z'iterambere (nk'ubwisungane mu kwivuza, VUP, Girinka). Ubu hakoreshwa ibyiciro bitanu (A, B, C, D, E) byashyizweho mu 2021, bigamije kugaragaza abakeneye ubufasha binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga n'inyito nshyashya yubu.

Rehema Dudu (yavutse 25 Gicurasi)ni umugore wa Niyonzima Moses, akaba abarizwa muri Korali y’i Gihogwe, anazwi mu itsinda ry’abafasha umuhanzi Papi Clever uri mu muziki uhimbaza Imana, akaba n’umunyamakuru kuri Life Radio ya ADEPR, Umuhango wo gusezerana imbere y’Imana wabaye ku wa 14 Ugushyingo 2020.
Rehema Dudu ni umugore akaba ari umukristo mu itorero rya Adepr, akaba afite umugabo ndetse n'abana.

Mu Rwanda rwohambere mu muco wabanyarwanda guhunika cyari igikorwa cy'ingenzi kandi gifite agaciro kihariye kikaba cyararebanaga n'uburyo abantu bateguraga ibiribwa cyangwa ibikoresho bagamije kugirango birambe kandi baniteganiriza ibihe byamage byabagwirira.
Guhunika ni ukubika, gutunganya, cyangwa kurinda ibiribwa n'ibikoresho muburyo burambye kandi bwizewe kugirango birambe igihe kirekire kandi hanateganywa ko amapfa yatera bakabyifashisha. Nko mubuhinzi bafataga imyaka itandukanye nk'ibishyimbo, amasaka, imyumbati, ibitoki ndetse nibindi bitandukanye hagamijwe kugirango bazigame imbuto ndetse nibizabafasha kwihaza muribyo.
Mu muco guhunika byari nkimenyetso cyubuhanga n'ubunararibonye mu murya ngo. aho wasangaga umusaruro warabitswe neza muburyo bwoguteganyiriza ejo hazaza mu muryango, byari igikorwa cy'ubufatanye, aho ingeri zose bafatanyaga mukubungabunga ibyahunitswe.
Mu muco nyarwanda ndetse nubu ni uburyo bwo kwizigamira ugamije kubika, kurinda no gutunganya umusaruro muburyo buboneye kandi bwizewe nkigikorwa kingenze mu muryango kandi cyagaragazaga ubushishozi, icyubahiro, ubufatanye n'ubwitonzi mubanyarwanda.

Nyambo Jesca ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umukinnyikazi wa filime mu Rwanda, uzwi ku mazina yakazi ka Nyambo cyangwa Miss Nyambo Akina mu rukurikirane rw’amafilime atandukanye anyura kuri YouTube nka Ibanga cyangwa The Message, aho akunze kugaragara ari kumwe n’abandi bakinnyi nka Killaman cyangwa se Niyori.
Nyambo yahawe mugihe cyashize yigeze no guhabwa igihembo nk’umukinnyi mwiza wa filime w’umwaka mu Rwanda.

Muyango claudine (uzwi nka Coco yavutse wa 19 Werurwe 1997) ni umugore akaba ari umunyarwandakazi wamenyekanye cyane binyuze mu marushanwa y'ubwiza no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga akaba yarigeze guhatanira mu irishanwa ry'umbwiza missa Rwanda aba umukobwa uzi kwifotoza akaberwa neza.
Muyango claudine yavukiye mu intara ya Majyepfo y'u Rwanda ku wa 19 Werurwe 1997, yari mu irushanwa rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2019, aho yegukanye ikamba rya Miss Photogenike (umukobwa uzi kwifotoza akaberwa n'amafoto), Ni umugore w'umunyezamu w'ikipe y'igihugu Kimenyi Yves, bakaba bafitanye umwana w'umuhungu.

Kwizera Emelyne, uzwi ku mazina ya Ishanga, (yavutse mu 2002) ni umukobwa akaba ari umunyarwandakazi wamenyekanye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga biturutse ku mashusho y’urukozasoni yagiye asakaza, gusa muri Mutarama 2025 yage gupfugwa, akaba ayoboye itsinda ryitwa Rich Gang.
