Imivugo n’indirimbo by’inka ni kimwe mu bice by’ingenzi by’umuco nyarwanda, byerekana neza urukundo, icyubahiro n’agaciro Abanyarwanda bahaga inka. Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, inka ntiyari itungo risanzwe gusa kandi nomuri kinogihe, ahubwo yari ikimenyetso cy’ubutunzi, uburumbuke n’ishema ry’umuryango. Ni yo mpamvu abantu bayihimbazaga bayivuga mu buryo bwihariye, bakoresheje imivugo n’indirimbo.
Mu bisobanuro byimbitse, imivugo y’inka ni amagambo ahimbwe mu buryo bw’ubuhanzi, agaragaza imiterere, ubwiza n’imico y’inka. Umworozi yashimagizaga inka ye ayivuga imyato, ayigereranya n’ibintu byiza karemano bidukikije hano mw'isi. Ibi byari uburyo bwo kugaragaza ko inka ifite agaciro gakomeye, ndetse bikanafasha umworozi kuyitaho no kuyishimira. Imivugo y’inka yigishaga kandi kuvuga neza no gutunganya amagambo akoreshwa muburyo bwokuyitaho.
Ku rundi ruhande, indirimbo z’inka zari indirimbo zicurangwa cyangwa ziririmbwa n’aborozi igihe baragiye, bakama cyangwa baruhuka. Izi ndirimbo zagaragazaga ibyishimo, ituze n’urukundo bafitiye inka zabo. Zafashaga no gutuza inka, kuko byemerwaga ko inka yumva amajwi y’umworozi wayo, bityo igatuza cyangwa ikongera amata. Indirimbo z’inka zari n’uburyo bwo gusabana no gusangira umuco hagati y’aborozi.
Imivugo n’indirimbo by’inka byari bifite kandi uruhare mu kurinda no gukomeza umuco. Byifashishwaga mu kwigisha abakiri bato amateka, indangagaciro n’imyitwarire myiza. Abana bigaga kuvuga imivugo no kuririmba indirimbo, bigatuma bakura bazi kubaha inka, gukunda umurimo no kubaha umuco wabo. Ibi byafashaga mu gukomeza umuco nyarwanda no kuwurinda gusenyuka.
Mu ncamake, imivugo n’indirimbo by’inka ni uburyo bw’ubuhanzi bwagaragazaga urukundo n’icyubahiro Abanyarwanda bahaga inka, kandi bikagira uruhare mu myigire, mu busabane no mu kubungabunga umuco. Nka kimwe mu bimenyetso by’ingenzi byerekana uko inka zari ishingiro ry’ubuzima n’umuco nyarwanda.
urugero rw'indirimbo z’inka zaririmbwaga n’abashumba cyane cyane igihe baragiye cyangwa bakama:
“Ngwino nka yanjye nziza, Ngwino nkwamire amata meza, Uri umutungo wanjye,Uri ibyishimo byanjye.”
Iyi ndirimbo, Ihamagara inka mu buryo bwuje urukundo n'isano hagati y’umushumba n’inka
Indi ndirimbo ishobora kumvikana itya:“Inka zanjye nziza zirabyagiye,Zirantunga, ziratanga, Iyo ziri murwuri aba ari amahoro.
Imivugo y’inka yabaga igizwe n’amagambo meza, yuzuye ishimwe n’ubwiza bw'inka.
urugero: Inka yanjye ni iya gaciro, Iteye ishema ku gasozi,Ifite amabere yuzuye amata, Ni ishema ry’umuryango wanjye.

Mukagatete Emeline ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukina nka rutahizamu mu ikipe ya Rayon Sports Women Football Club mu Rwanda.
Mukagatete Emeline Azwiho kuba rutahizamu utanga umusaruro mu mikino ikomeye, ndetse ni rutahizamu ukina muri iyi kipe y'abagore ya Rayon Sports anyuza ku kuguru kwiburyo, kandi yatsinze igitego ikipe y' Indahangarwa WFC mu gikombe cy'Ubutwari ndetse yanatsinze muri FERWAFA Super Cup 2025.

Umunyarwandakazi ubundi ni ijambo ry'Ikinyarwanda risobanura umugore cyangwa umukobwa ukomoka mu Rwanda cyangwa se ufite inkomoka y'umwe mu bayeyi biwe bakomok mu Rwanda, Bagaragaza umuco binyuze mu mwambaro gakondo nku mushanana.cyangwa Ishabure.
Umunyarwandakazi ni Iri jambo rikoreshwa ku banyagihugu bose b'igitsina gore bafite ubwenegihugu bw'u Rwanda, baba batuye imbere cyangwa hanze y'igihugu, bazwiho kurangwa n'umuco nyarwanda, gukunda umurimo, n'uburanga.

Ihirwe Regine (yavutse 2006) ni umunyarwandakazi akaba ari n'umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru ukomoka mu Rwanda, ukina kuruhande rw'inyuma ibumoso muri bannyugariro mu ikipe ya Rayon Sports y'abagore.
Ihirwe Regine yaje kumenyekanye cyane mu mwaka wa 2025/2026 ubwo yavaga muri ikipe ya APR FC y'abagore yerekeza muri Rayon Sports nyuma y'urubanza rurerure.

Mu Rwanda rwakera, inka zari umutima w’ubuzima bw’Abanyarwanda. Ntizafatwaga gusa nk’itungo, ahubwo zari ikimenyetso cy’ubutunzi, icyubahiro n’ishema ry’umuryango. Umuntu wagiraga inka nyinshi yubahwaga mu bandi, kandi inka zakoreshwaga mu mibereho yose, zatangaga amata yo kunywa, zigatanga inkwano kubageni, ndetse zikaba n’impano yo kubaka ubucuti hagati y’imiryango. Inka zari zifite n’agaciro mu mihango y’umuco, aho zaririmbirwaga, zigahimbwa mu mivugo, ndetse zigahabwa amazina yihariye.
Imibereho y’inka muri icyo gihe yari ishingiye ku kwahura inka zikarishiriza kugasozi. Inka zaragirwaga ku misozi n’ahari ubwatsi bwinshi, zikabaho mu bwisanzure. Abashumba bazitaho buri munsi, baziririmbira indirimbo, bakazivuga imivugo, banazirinda indwara. Kwita ku nka byari igikorwa cy’icyubahiro, kandi habagaho imigenzo myinshi ijyanye n’isuku yazo, gukama amata, no kuzitaho mu buryo bwitondewe. Inka zari zifitanye isano ikomeye n’umuntu ku buryo zafatwaga nkizigize umuryango.
Mu Rwanda rw’ubu, imibereho y’inka yarahindutse kubera iterambere n’imihindagurikire y’ubuzima. Ubu hakunze gukoreshwa uburyo bwo kororera mu biraro, aho inka zitagisohoka cyane, ahubwo zororerwa mu biraro zigahabwa ubwatsi n’amazi byateguwe neza. Ibi byatumye habaho kongera umusaruro w’amata, kurinda ubutaka kwangirika, no gukoresha ubumenyi bugezweho mu korora. Aborozi bakoresha imiti, inkingo n’ubuvuzi bwa kijyambere mu kurinda indwara.
Nubwo uburyo bwo korora bwahindutse, inka ziracyafite agaciro gakomeye mu muco nyarwanda. Ziracyari ikimenyetso cy’iterambere n’imibereho myiza, kandi ziracyakoreshwa mu bintu bimwe na bimwe by’umuco nko gutanga inkwano cyangwa kwakiriza abashyitsi amata. Hari na gahunda z’igihugu zishyigikira ubworozi bw’inka, zigaragaza ko zigifite uruhare runini mu guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage.
u Rwanda rwakera inka zari zifite uruhare rukomeye mu muco n’imibereho ya buri munsi, zigahabwa icyubahiro gikomeye kandi zikabaho mu bwisanzure ku gasozi. Mu Rwanda rw’ubu, nubwo uburyo bwo kuyorora bwahindutse bugana ku ikoranabuhanga n’iterambere, agaciro n’icyubahiro cy’inka mu muco nyarwanda biracyahari kandi birakomeje.
Mu Rwanda rwakera, hariho inka zizwi cyane nk’inyambo. Izi nka zari iz’agaciro gakomeye cyane, cyane cyane mu bwami. Zatoranywaga hashingiwe ku bwiza bwazo: amahembe maremare, umubiri mwiza, n’imiterere itandukanye. Inyambo ntizari izo gutanga amata menshi cyane, ahubwo zari izo gushimisha no kugaragaza icyubahiro n’ubwami. Zaririmbirwaga indirimbo, zigahimbwa imivugo, kandi zikitabwaho mu buryo bwihariye cyane.
Inyambo zari zifite uruhare rukomeye mu mihango y’ubwami n’umuco. Zakoreshwaga mu birori bikomeye, zigatambagizwa mu buryo bw’icyubahiro, ndetse zikaba ikimenyetso cy’ubutware bw’Umwami. Abantu bazitagaho cyane, bakaziririmbira indirimbo zidasanzwe, bigatuma zimenyerana n’abantu ndetse zigahora zituje kandi zifite isuku.
Mu Rwanda rw’ubu, habaho ubwoko bw’inka bwahindutse kandi bwinshi. Ubu aborozi bibanda cyane ku nka zitanga amata menshi n’umusaruro mwinshi, nk’inka z’ikomoka mumahanga nk’izivanze n’iz’iwacu. Izi nka ntizitwarwa cyane ku bwiza cyangwa imiterere nk’uko byari bimeze ku nyambo, ahubwo harebwa umusaruro amata menshi, gukura vuba, n’inyungu mu bukungu.
Nanone kandi, inka zo muri iki gihe zororerwa mu buryo bwa kijyambere (nko mu biraro), zigahabwa ubwatsi bwateguwe neza, imiti n’inkingo, bigatuma zitanga umusaruro uhagije. Ubu ubworozi bwibanda ku guteza imbere ubukungu bw’umuryango n’igihugu, aho kuba gusa ikimenyetso cy’umuco n’icyubahiro.
Ariko nubwo hari izi mpinduka, inyambo ziracyafite agaciro mu muco nyarwanda. Zigaragara mu birori by’umuco, mu bukerarugendo no mu kwibuka amateka y’u Rwanda. Zikomeza kwibutsa Abanyarwanda inkomoko yabo n’uburyo inka zari zifite agaciro gakomeye mu mibereho ya kera.

Imigenzo y’isuku ku nka mu muco nyarwanda yari ingenzi cyane, kuko inka zafatwaga nk’umutungo w’agaciro kandi zigahabwa icyubahiro gikomeye. Isuku ntiyari igamije gusa kurinda ubuzima bw’inka, ahubwo yari n’ikimenyetso cy’umuco, ubupfura n’imibereho myiza y’umuryango.
Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, isuku y’inka yakorwaga burimunsi. Aborozi bahanaguraga inka zabo, bakazisukura umubiri wose kugira ngo zikureho umwanda n’udukoko. Ibi byakorwaga cyane cyane mu gitondo cyangwa nimugoroba, bigafasha inka kumererwa neza no kwirinda indwara. Inka isukuye yafatwaga nk’ikimenyetso cy’umworozi wita ku mutungo we kandi wubaha umuco.
Ikindi gikomeye ni isuku y’ikiraro. Ibiraro by’inka byagombaga guhorana isuku, bikurwamo amase zabaga zataye mukiraro buri gihe, bigasukurwamo amazi cyangwa bikubakirwa mu buryo butuma umwanda utinjiramo. Ibi byafashaga kurinda indwara no gutuma inka zibaho neza. Kandi umworozi wabaga afite ikiraro gisukuye yubahwaga mu bandi, kuko byagaragazaga ko afite gahunda n’ubwitonzi.
Mu muco nyarwanda, isuku y’amata n’ibikoresho byayo na yo yari ingenzi cyane. Icyansi n’ibindi bikoresho byakoreshwaga mu gukama byabanzaga guhanagurwa cyangwa kozwa kugira ngo bisukure kandi biha amata impumuro nziza. Ibi byerekana ko isuku y’inka itandukanye n’isuku y’amata, ariko byose byahuriraga ku kwita ku mutungo w’inka.
Nanone kandi, kwita ku ruhu n’imiterere y’inka byari igice cy’isuku. Aborozi bakuragaho udusazi, bakayihanagura, zicanirwa amafumba kubiraro yirukana amazi ndetse bakayitaho kugira ngo igire umubiri mwiza n’uburanga bushimishije. Ibi byari ingenzi cyane ku nka zifite agaciro nk’inyambo, kuko zo zar'izigaragaza n'icyubahiro cy’umuryango cyangwa cy’ubwami.
Ikindi ni uko inka zanywaga amazi meza hafukurwa ibibumbiro zinyweramo,kandi zigahabwa ubwatsi bwiza kuturiro twabugenewe. Isuku ntiyarebaga hanze gusa, ahubwo yanarebaga ku byo inka zirya n’ibyo zinywa ndetse nibyo ziryamira. Ibi byafashaga inka kugira ubuzima bwiza no gutanga amata meza kandi menshi. imigenzo y'isuku ku nka mu muco nyarwanda yari igamije: kurinda ubuzima, kongera umusaruro w'amata, kugaragaza icyubahiro n'ubutunzi bw'umuryango, gutoza abantu ubwitonzi n'isuku mu mibereho yabo. Ibi byose bigaragaza ko mu muco nyarwanda, isuku y’inka yari igice cy’indangagaciro z’imibereho myiza, kandi ko kwita ku nka byafatwaga nk’inshingano ikomeye.
Mu muco nyarwanda, hari ibintu byinshi byari bibujijwe gukorwa ku nka, cyane cyane ibirebana n’isuku n’imibereho yayo, kuko inka yafatwaga nk’umutungo w’agaciro kandi wubahwa. Muribyo harimo: Kureka inka mu mwanda, Kudakaraba ibikoresho by’amata, Gukama inka wanduye ndetse no kureka inka igira udukoko n'indwara byafatwaga nkokudaha umutung agaciro.

Kubogora amata mu muco wabanyarwa nigikorwa gifatwa nko kumena amata utari ugambiriye kuyamena hasi, mugihe wabaga winikije uri mugikorwa cyo gukama, urikuyabuganiza uyavana mucyansi uyabuganiza mukindi ndetse niyo wabaga urimogukama winikije inka igatera umugeri amata akameneka bavukako inka yateye umugeri ikabogora amata.
Mu mumuco wabanyarwanda iyo umennye amata wabigambiriye nabyo bifite indi nyito itandukanye no ku yabogora.

Kubyarira amata mu muco nyarwanda bikorwana naborozi b'inka kuko ni umugenzo ukorwa mugihe amata yabaga yakamwe akabuganizwa mucyansi agaterekwa kuruhimbi, iyo habagabo impamvu ituma ayo mata ahumana cyangwa iyo yaterekwaga agamijwe kuba yanyobwa ari ikivuguto hanyuma akarinda agera ubwo ahinduka umushari barayafata bakayamena kubushake bwabo bitewe nizo mpamvu twavuze hejuri nibyo byitwa kubyariira amata cyangwa kubikira amata.

Mu mateka n'umuco by'u Rwanda, ingoro yari inzu cyangwa urusobe rw'inyubako zidasanzwe zabagamo umwami, ariko si aho yabaga gusa yari nkikimenyetso cy'ubutegetsi, ubusugire bw'igihugu n'umuco nyarwanda. Ingoro y'umwami yabaga ari ahantu hatoranijwe neza kugirango hagaragaze icyubahiro n'icyerekezo cy'ubwami. Yubakwaga hakoreshejwe ibikoresho by'umwimerere nk'ibiti, ibyatsi ariko hubahirizwa imiterere yihariye.
Igenamiterere ry'ingoro ryakurikizaga gahunda ituma habaho ubwirinzi, ituze n'imigendekere myiza y'uzima bw'ibwami, aho buri gice cyabaga gifite inshingano yihariye. Impamvu umwami yabaga mu ngoro nk'iyi ni uko yagombaga kuba ahantu hamurinda, hamugaragaza nk'umuyobozi w'igihugu kandi hakana mworohereza kuyobora abaturage, kwakira abashyitsi n'abatware, no gukorera imihango y'umuco n'ubutegetsi.
Ingoro y"umwami yari ifite ibintu byihariye byayitandukanyaga n'izindi nzu zisanzwe. Yabaga ifite ubwirinzi bukomeye, gahunda y'abantu bayibagamo harimo abiru, abagaragu, abarinzi, abashumba ndetse n'abagore b'umwami n'i,igenzo yihariye y'aho buriwese yabaga yemerewe kugera.
yari fite kandi imitako n'imiterere igaragaza ubwiza n'icubahiro by'ibwami, ndetse n'ahantu ho gukorera imihango y'umuco nk'imivugo, indirimbo nindi mihango y'ibwami.

Ibikorwa bya Nyirarunyonga.
Nyirarunyonga azwi ho ibikorwa byinshi bitandukanye byatumye yitwa uwo kurubu (shuga mami wa mbere). Yakundaga gusamabana n'abana babasore bakiri bato, maze ubwo abagore bagenzi be baje kumunegura impamvu asambana n'abana abyaye, arabasubiza ati:" Ntamupfakazi ugaya imboro." Nyirarunyonga kandi yaje kwudukana ingeso yo gusamabana n'abakwe be. Aha naho abagore bagenzi be baje kumubaza impamvu ashaka gusenyera abakobwa be, na none arabasubiza ati " Ntago arigusamba ahubwo mba mbatinyura".

Kwita Izina (2005), Izina Byishimo, izina ry’umwana w’ingagi ryiswe na Perezida Paul Kagame ku nshuro ya mbere.Kwita Izina,umuhango witabirwa n’umufasha wa Perezida wa Repuburika Jeanette Kagame rimwe na rimwe.Kwita Izina wabaye umuhango ngirakamaro ku isi mu kubungabunga ibidukikije.Kwita Izina, Umuhango witabirwa n’abantu bakomeye bavuye hirya no hino ku isi; abashakashatsi, abashoramari, abayobozi b’ibigo, abahanzi, abakinnyi, ibyamamare mu ngeri zitandukanye.. Kwita Izina mu mwaka wa 2008 k'Inshuro 4,umuhango witabiriwe na Craig Hatkoff umuyobozi wa Wildlife Direct, umwanditsi wa Owen and Mzee. We n’umukobwa we bise izina Mushya umwana w’ingagi. Kwita Izina,n'umuhango wanitabiriwe n’umuhanzi Oliver Ngoma muri 2008.Kwita Izina,biliyoni 12, 58 zimaze gutangwa mu gufasha abaturage baturiye pariki mu mishanga, kubaka amashuri, kubaka amavuriro, n’ibiraro. Kwita Izina 2017,umuhango witabiriwe na Mugisha Benjamin (The Ben) yise izina Uruyange umwana w’ingagi. Uwomwaka Kwita Izina,n'umuhango wanitabiriwe na Turahirwa Moise (Co Founder:Moshions) yise izina Kwanda.Kwita izina 2019 inshuro ya 15, witabiriwe na Amina Mohammed (Umunyamabanga wungirije w’umuryango w’Abibumye yise izina Ingoga umwana w’ingagi.Kwita izina uwo mwaka, n'umuhango witabiriwe na Meddy, yise izina Inkoramutima umwana w’ingagi. Kwita Izina 2021 k'unshuro ya 17,umuhango wabereye ku ikoranabuhanga kubera icyorezo cya COVID19. Kwita Izina 2022 (Inshuro 18), wabaye tariki ya 2 Nzeri 2022, Igikomangoma cya Walles Charles Philip Arhur George yise izina Ubwuzuzane. Umwana wo mu muryango Muhoza. Kwita Izina 2022 (Inshuro 18),umuhango witabiriwe na Didier Drogba yise izina Ishami umwana w’ingagi. Kwita Izina 2022 uwo mwaka,umuhango witabiriwe na Louise Mushikiwabo (OIF) yise izina Turikumwe, umwana wo mu muryango Ntambara. Kwita Izina 2023 ku nshuro ya 19, umuhango witabiriwe na Dr Zurab Pololikashvili uyobora UNWTO, wise izina Inshingano umwana w’ingagi. Kwita Izina, umuhango uha agaciro inyamaswa z’ingagi zirimo gucika ku isi ziba muri Pariki y’igihugu y’ibirunga. Kwita Izina uwo mwaka,n'umuhango witabiriwe na Mme Audrey Azoulay,(umuyobozi wa UNESCO) yise izina Ikirango umwana w’ingagi. Kwita Izina,umuhango wo guha agaciro, abaturage baturiye pariki, abavura inyamaswa, abakora mu gusigasira ibidukikije, abashakashatsi, abarinda n’abacunga parki n’abandi.

Umutambagiro mutagatifu ni igikorwa cyatangijwe na Abraham afatanyije n’umuhungu we Ismail. Bavuga ko Intumwa y’Imana Muhamad ari we waje gutangiza ku mugaragaro icyo gikorwa mu mwaka wa 9 wa Hijiri, ugendeye ku ndangaminsi y’Abayisilamu.
Umutambagiro mutagatifu ukorerwa i Macca mu ngoro yubatswe na Abraham n’umuhungu we Ismail. Abakora Umutambagiro Mutagatifu, bakora ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo amasengesho, gusura ibice bitandukanye by’amateka yaranze Intumwa y’Imana Muhammad no gukora indi mihango itandukanye igamije kwiyegereza Imana cyane. kandi bikaba ari itegeko kuri buri muyisilamu ufite ubushobozi bw’imbaraga z’umubiri n’iz’amafaranga. Ni itegeko rya Isilamu rireba umuntu ufite imyaka y’ubukure warenze imyaka yo kwitwa umwana; si itegeko ku mwana, si itegeko kandi ku muntu ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe. Ikindi kandi ku badafite imbaraga z’umubiri bari mu zabukuru cyangwa bafite ubumuga bw’ingingo bashyiriweho uburyo bwo gukora umutambagiro aho bahabwa utugare kugira ngo babashe kuzuza iyo nkingi ya gatanu. Kandi buri gihugu kiba gifite umubare ntarengwa w’abantu bacyo cyagenewe kujyana kuko bitemewe ko umuntu ajya gukora umutambagiro mutagatifu ku giti cye yijyanye atajyanye n’itsinda ry’abaturutse mu gihugu runaka bikaba kandi bibujijwe ko Igihugu cyajyana umunyamahanga. Mu bihe bya kera ibihugu byemererwaga gutwara abanyamahanga baza kubikuraho kuko byagaragaye ko hari abanyagihugu batabonaga ayo mahirwe kubera ko abanyamahanga babaye benshi kandi batanga amafaranga menshi kuko hari ibihugu biba bifite abayisilamu benshi ku buryo umubare bemerewe wuzura bakajya guhagurukira mu bindi bihugu biza guhagarikwa.
Inkingi Eshanu z'Idini ya Isilamu.
Ubundi hari inkingi eshanu idini ya Isilamu ishingiraho zibimburirwa n’ inkinyi yo Kwemera Imana imwe rukumbi na Mohamed akaba intumwa yayo.Inkingi ya Kabiri ni Ugusenga nibura 5 ku munsi, inkingi ya gatatu ni ugutanga ituro ku muyisilamu wese ubushoboye, iryo turo rifasha abatishoboye. Inkingi ya kane ni Ugusiba mu gihe cy’ukwezi, bigakorwa rimwe mu mwaka, ariko umuyisilamu ubishatse wifuza kubona ibihembo by’Imana, ahobora no gusiba kenshi mu mwaka. Inkingi ya gatanu ni ugukora umutambagiro mutagatifu ubera i Maka,nibura rimwe mu buzima.Ibyo gukora umutambagiro mutagatifu i Maka, Abayisilamu babishingira ku mateka yo mu gitabo gitagatifu Korowani. Kuko aho i Maka ari ho hari inyubako ntagatifu yitwa Kaaba, ikaba yarubatswe ku itegeko ry’Imana yubakwa mu gihe cy’umukurambere Aburahamu. Intumwa y’Imana Mohamed nayo ikomoka mu gisekuru cya Aburahamu yahawe inshingano zo gukomeza kubaka iyo nyubako kugira ngo Abayisilamu bo ku isi yose yajya baza kuyizenguruka baramya Imana.Umuyisilamu wese aho atuye hose ku isi, iyo asenga agomba kuba yerekeje uburanga bwe ahari iyo nyubako ntagatifu ya Kaaba.Mu misigiti yo mu Rwanda Ahubakwa “Minbar” wagereranya n’uruhimbi rwo mu rusengero, hagenwa bikurikije ahari iyo nyubako ntagatifu i Maka muri Arabia Saudite, no mu ngo z’Abayisilamu, ni ko bigenda, Umuyisilamu ugiye gusenga (Gusali) ntiyerekeza uburanga bwe aho abonye, ahubwo baba barigishijwe uko umuntu agena icyerekezo cy’i Maka ahari inyubako ntagatifu ya Kaaba, bityo agasali yerekejeyo isura.Ikindi kandi gituma Abayisilamu bakorera umutambagiro mutagatifu i Maka, ni uko ari ho idini ya isilamu yavukiye, ndetse n’intumwa y’Imana Mohamed akaba ari ho akomoka.Umutambagiro mutagatifu w’i Maka “Hijj” ugira amahame awugenga.Icya mbere ni uko uwukora ahitamo Hajj ashaka gukora kuko irimo amoko atatu ariyo “Tamattou” “Al Qiran” cyangwa “Al Ifrâd”. Yose ikaba imitambagiro yemewe, ariko bamwe mubasobanukiwe n’uyu mutambagiro Hajji bavuga ko bitandukanira ku bitambo, ngo iyo ufite igitambo ukora Tamattou, ariko udafite igitambo akora uwo mutambagiro witwa Al Ifrad. Ujya gutangira uwo mutambagiro, agomba kubanza akajya kuri imwe muri za “Miqat” esheshatu, ni ukuvuga aho abantu bagomba kunyura aho muri Arabia, bitewe n’aho baje baturutse. Aho kuri “Miqat” ni ahantu umuntu afatira umugambi w’uko agiye kwitwara mu mutambagiro mutagatifu. Iyo umuntu ageze kuri “Miqat”,ari umugabo agomba kwambara ibyo bita “Ihram”. Ihram ni ibintu bimeze nk’ibitenge cyangwa nk’amashuka y’umweru, kimwe akagikenyera ikindi akakitera, ariko nta kindi ashyiramo imbere, kuko ntibyemewe kwambara ikariso muri icyo gihe cy’umutambagiro. Abagore bo ngo bakomeza kwambara imyambaro yabo isanzwe ariko batipfutse mu maso no ku ntoki. Ku munsi wa 8 w’ukwezi kwa 12 ari na wo wambere w’umutambagiro, abakora umutambagiro mutagatifu barara mu Kibaya kitwa Mina, ni ahantu haba harateguwe neza, hubatswe amahema arimo ibyangombwa byose bikenewe ku Muyisilamu uje mu mutambagiro. Aho rero barara basenga, bavuga ko nta yindi Mana ibaho, bakitunganya, bubahiriza ibijyanye n’umutambagiro byose. Kuri uyu munsi kandi ukora urugendo abanza kujya mu Musigiti wa Al-Haram agasenga isengesho rya saa sita ryitwa “Dhor”. Iyo bukeye mu gitondo ku munsi wa 9, bajya mu Kibaya cya Arafat, aha mu kibaya cya Arafat ahari “Umusozi w’impuhwe “Djabani Rahma” aho Adamu yahuriye na Hawa (Eva) ni ahantu hafatwa nk’ahakomeye muri uwo mutambagiro, kuko barahirirwa, haba haje abahanga bakomeye muri Islamu bakigisha abari mu mutambagiro. Bahamara umunsi wose, bakahasengera bahava izuba rirenze, nimugoba bakarara ahitwa “Mouzdalifa”, ni ahantu hameze nka “transit “ bava mu Kibaya cya Arafat basubira Mina.

Kera hambere umugabo yabaye aho, az kubyara umwana w'umukobwa amwita izina Ndabaga. Amaze kumubyara, asiga ari uruhinja. Aratabara, nuko yabona abaturutse iwabo nabo baje kw'itabaro akababaza uko umwana we angana. Bakamubwira ngo ameze kuba inkumi ni mukuru. abandi batabaranye nawe bagakurwa bagataha, we akabura umukura, kuko yari yaravutse ari umwana umwe, nawe akaba yaratarabyara umutabazi.
Ndabaga akura atazi se, amaze kuba inkumi amaze kumenya ubwenge, yiga gusimbuka no kurasa. Aho kwitoza imirimo y;abakobwa, akihata imirimo y'abahungu gusa, abandi abandi bakabiseka batazi icyo abigirira. Ndabaga yashakaga uko yazajya gucungura se mu itabaro kuko yari ahamaze imyaka itabarika.
Ndabaga yaragiraga inka akazishora, akazicira icyarire, akazisasira, akazikenura kuburyo bwose. Ndabaga amaze kuba inkumi, ajya mu bucuzi,asaba kumucuzi kumuca amabere, ati "kandi nzabahemba" amabere ayamukirizaho, bamwomoza imigera icanye. amaze gukura abwira nyina ati "Ngiye gucungura data,dore ikigihe cyose amaze ibwami"
Ndabaga araboneza ajya gutabara. ageze mu rugerero aboneza asanga se,nta we abajije, aramwibwira. Nuko bajya ahiherereye. Ndabaga abwira se ko yize imiimo y'abahungu kuburyo nta muhungu umurusha gusimbuka cyangwa ngo amurushe kwivuga cyangwa kurasa. ata "Ejo uzizinduke utaha nzagusigarira ibwami." Buracya ise arataha.
Biratinda baza kumenya ko Ndabaga ari umukobwa! Babwira umwami,biramutangaza cyane, ati "Nta mukobwa ugira ubutwari nka we!" Nuko umwami ahamagaza ingabo zari mu itabaro ati "Nimutahe ibintu byageze iwa Ndabaga! Mbega n'iyo byageze u Rwanda rusigaye ruhuruza n'abagore!"
Umwami abaza Ndabaga Inka yazanye! Ndabaga ati "ni nyinshi." Umwami azimugororera zose kandi ati "Ugende ubwire so ko yabyaye!" Ni aha imvugo yavuye ngo "Ibintu byageze iwa Ndabaga!"
Ndabaga nti yari intwari gusa, ahubwo yari n'umunyabwenge n' umunyakuri wakundaga igihugu n'umuryango we cyane. Inkuru ye igaragaza ko nubwo yari umukobwa yashoboye gukora ibirenze ibyari byitenzwe kuri we icyo gihe. Ibi byatumye ahinduka urugero rwiza rw'ubutwari n'ubwitange ku Banyarwanda bose.
Iyinkuru itwigisha ko umuntu agomba kugira intego no gukorera inzozi ze atitaye ku byo abandi bavuga, Ndabaga yagaragaje ko ubwitange n'umurava bituma umuntu agera ku intsinzi.

Umutwarekazi Nyirakigwene ni mwene Mpabuka wa Ntembe rya Rutinywa rwa Sengenge rya ka Sekisengo cya Nzuki. Ni umusinga kazi wo munzu yabaganzu, abaganzu bakomoka kuri Nzuki za Semugeshi wa Ndoli. Mumwaka wa 1980-1990, bwakozwe imiryango y'abaganzu wasangaga yiganje mu cyahoze ari Butare ku misozi ya Mbazi,Muganza,Nyaruhengeri. Naho mu cyahoze ari Kibuye bari ku misozi nka Gishyita, Rwamagatamu na Kivumu. Muri Gitarama wabasanga ahitwa i masango.
Umutwarekazi Nyirakigwene, mu mabyiruka ye yashyingiwe umuhungu wa Kabare ka Rwakagara witwa Nyantabana watwaraga i Mbuye mu Nduga. Umutware Nyantabana yabyaranye na Nyirakigwene Umwana w'umuhungu bamwita Bangambiki. Uyu Nyanatabana yaje gutabaruka,bivugwa ko yari muto cyane.
Nyirakigwene akimara kuba umupfakazi,yasabye Umwami Yuhi V Musinga ko yasimbura umugabo we ku butware kuko umwana wabo yari muto. Nyirakigwene uyu yaje gutwara kugeza ubwo umwana we akuriye yuzuza imyaka imwemerera kuba yaba umutware.
Nyiakigwene yabaye umutwarekazi wa i Mbuye mu Nduga ubu ni mu karere ka Muhanga. Nkumutwarekazi yari umuyobozi wigitinyiro cyinshi kandi wanga akarengane n'ubusumbane mubo yayoboraga. Yarafite uburanga buhebuje, abahanzi n'abasizi baramutatse biratinda mu ndirimbo no mu bisigo. Inanga y'igisingizo izwi cyane kandi yanaririmbwaga i bwami ni yitwa " Garuka " aho abasizi n'abahanzi bamutakaga.
Umutwarekazi Nyirakigwene yavukanaga n'abatware batwaraga imisozi itandukanye mu Rwanda aribo Rugiga, Kanuma na Sekanyambo. Muri abao hiyongeraho Nyiramasuka, Umugore wa Furumba Symphorien w'umurinyonza watwaye i Kirengo Nduga

Nyiramibambwe ni umwe mubagore bavugwa cyane mumateka y'u Rwanda,cyane mu gihe cy'ubwami. Yari azwi Nkumugore w'umwami witwaga Mibambwe I Sekarongoro Mutabazi, umwe mu bami bakomeye bo hambere mumateka y'urwanda.
Nyiramibambwe yari umugabekazi, kandi izina rye rikomoka ku mugabo we Mibambwe. Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera,umugore w'umami yitirirwaga izina ry'umwami, ari ho haturutse Nyiramibambwe.
Amateka yaranze Nyiramibambwe.
Yafashaga umwami kuyobora igihugu cyane mu mibereho n'ubuzima bw'ibwami nk'umugabe kazi kandi yagiraga ijambo rikomeye mubibazo by'ibwami harimo n'imibanire y'imiryango n'abatware.
Yari mu bagore bagize uruhare mugukomeza umuco n'imigenzo y'abanyarwanda bo hambere.
Nubwo atanditsweho amateka menshi cyane ku buryo burambuye nk'ay'abami, Nyiramibambwe yakunze kuvugwa nk'urugero rwabagore bafite ijambo rikomeye mu bwami bw'u Rwanda bwa Kera ikindi gikomeye kurusha ibindi nuko yagiraga igitsure cyatumaga abasha kunoza inshingano ze nkumugabe kazi.

Tadhim Uwizeye ni umwe mu bagore b’Abanyarwanda bageze ku rwego rwo hejuru mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga n’ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet (e-commerce). Ni we washinze kandi akaba umuyobozi mukuru (CEO) wa kompanyi yitwa Olado Business Group, yatangiye mu mwaka wa 2017, igamije koroshya uburyo abantu bagura bakanagurisha ibicuruzwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga.
Tadhim Uwizeye yize amasomo ajyanye na computer science n’imicungire y’amakuru (information systems management). Ibi byamufashije kugira ubumenyi bukomeye mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga ndetse n’ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet.
= Umwuga n’ibikorwa bye =
Mbere yo gutangiza ubucuruzi bwe, Tadhim yakoraga mu rwego rw’ikoranabuhanga (IT). Nyuma y’uko kompanyi yakoragamo ifunze, yabonye ko ari amahirwe yo gutangira umushinga we bwite. Ni bwo yashinze Olado, urubuga ruhuza abaguzi n’abagurisha, rugateza imbere cyane cyane ibicuruzwa bikorerwa mu Rwanda (Made in Rwanda).
Afite uburambe burenga imyaka 10 mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga, ubucuruzi n’iterambere ry’imishinga (entrepreneurship), kandi yagiye anagira uruhare mu gufasha urubyiruko n’abagore kwiteza imbere binyuze mu mahugurwa no kubagira inama (mentorship).
= Uruhare mu iterambere n’ubuyobozi =
Tadhim Uwizeye ni umwe mu bagore b’indashyikirwa mu Rwanda mu guteza imbere ubucuruzi bukoresha ikoranabuhanga. Yatoranyijwe no kuba umuyobozi (Community Leader) mu mushinga wa eTrade for Women ugamije guteza imbere abagore mu bucuruzi n’ikoranabuhanga ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Yagize kandi uruhare mu guteza imbere imishinga ifasha ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse (MSMEs) gukoresha e-commerce, cyane cyane mu gihe cya COVID-19, aho ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet bwagize akamaro kanini.
= Icyerekezo n’intego =
Intego nyamukuru ya Tadhim Uwizeye ni uguhindura uburyo Abanyarwanda bagura n’uko bagurisha, bakoresha ikoranabuhanga mu buryo bworoshye. Yanagaragaje ko nubwo e-commerce yatangiye igihirahiro mu Rwanda, yakomeje gukora cyane mu gushishikariza abantu kuyikoresha no kuyizera.

Ikinyabirayi ni igikoresho gikozwe mu giti, cyakoreshwaga mu kubika no gutunganya amata. Cyabaga kibajwe neza n’ababaji (abahanga mu kubaza ibiti), kikagira isura nziza kandi gishobora no gushushanywa.
= Uko cyakoreshwaga =
Mu muco nyarwanda, amata yari afite agaciro kanini cyane. Ikinyabirayi cyakoreshwaga mu:
Cyabaga gifite igifuniko kugira ngo amata adahumanywa n’umukungugu cyangwa udukoko.
= Imiterere n’ubukorikori =
Ikinyabirayi cyakorwaga mu biti bikomeye, kikaba:
Ibi byagaragazaga ubuhanga bw’ababaji b’Abanyarwanda ba kera.
= Akamaro mu muco nyarwanda =
Ikinyabirayi nticyari igikoresho gisanzwe gusa, ahubwo:

Nyiransibura wanyaye i kivu tumuzi cyangwa se tumwumva munkuru nyinshi zitandukanye zanditswe zivuga kumateka y'u Rwanda rwohambere. Nyiransibura avugako yamenyekanye mu myaka 800 ishize. amataka avugako inkuru y'uko yanyaye ikivu ngo byaturutse aho yaratwite inda agiye kuyibyara mu iguhe isuha yarimenetse ngo nibwo habaye ikiyaga cya kivu.

Ubutwari bwa Robwa Nyiramateke.
Igikomangoma Robwa Nyiramateke yemeye kumena amaraso ngo atabyarana n'umwami w'igisaka hato i Gisaka kitazigarurira u Rwanda.
kubazi amateka y'u Rwanda, ikigikomangoma Robwa ni ishema n'icyubahiro kubanyarwandakazi aho bava bakagera.
uyumukobwa yategetswe na se kurongorwa nabo mu gihugu cya Gisaka arabyanga abitegetswe na se. nyuma yuko se amaze gutanga kungoma nibwo baje kumushyingira gukagahato ariko arabarwanya kugeza ubwo yaje kugwa hasi bamutega ingoma ayigwa kurutsike acikamo kabiri umwana wari uri undanda ye aragwa maze nawe arapfa maze apfa nkumutabazi na musaza we Bwimba.
Urupfu rwa Rwoba rwamugize ikimenya bose mu bakobwa n'abagore bose mumateka y'u Rwanda. ntiyatinye kumenera amaraso igihugu nubwo yari akiri muto ndetse akaba yari n'igikomangoma waribuzavemo umugabekazi w'igisaka. Ndetse yanga nkubyarana n'umwami w' i Gisaka
Mugikorwa gikomeye yitanze atyo apfana numwana yari atwite. Ibi byamugize intwari ikomeye mumateka y' uRwanda, Robwa afatwa nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubwitange, ubudahemuka n'urukundo rwinshi yakundaga igihugu cye.

Mwene Gihanga na Nyamususa, akaba umukobwa umwe rukumbi mubahungu umunani Gihanga yabyaye kubagore batandukanye. Nyirarucyaba yaje gukura arashyingirwa mubazigaba bagengaga ingoma y'u Mubali aha nyirakuru Nyirarukanganga yakomokaga. Amate ntago atwereka uwo bashakanye ariko baje kubyarana umwna w'umuhungu bamwita Gacyaba.
Gacyaba ni we sekuru w'ubwoko bw'abacyaba bagenga Ingoma y'Ubugara, nubwo Nyirarucyaba yashyingiwe amateka atwereka ko yari umwe mubanyamirimo ku ngoma ya se, ariko babita abakozi b'igihugu muri icyo gihe. Yabaye umuyobozi w'umugore wambere munzego zohejuru z'igihugu mu mateka y'u Rwanda. Niwe wari umutware w'ingabo zitwaga "Abahiza" Wari umutwe w'ingabo zishinzwe kwikorera imitwaro yose y'ibwami.
Ubutwari n'ibigwi bye amanyekana cyane ndetse n'abana be bose

Ibonekerwa ry’i Kibeho ryabaye mu mwaka wa 1981 ryabereye i Kibeho, rero Kibeho ni umujyi muto uherereye mucyahoze ari Gikongoro ubu ni mu karere ka Nyaruguru mu intara ya majyepfo y’u Rwanda. Ni ahantu hamenyekanye igihe habaga amabonekerwa Mariya Klara Mukangango, Alphonsine Mumureke na Nathalie Mukamazimpaka ubu afite imyaka 50.
Ikibeho niho naho hari ishusho ya Yezu ku rwego rwa Afurika ifite icyicaro aho i Kibeho; niyo shusho nini ku isi ifite uburebure bwa metero esheshatu (6), ipima ibiro magana cyenda na mirongo itanu (950 kg), Iyo shusho igaragara ahantu hatandatu ku Isi kuko buri mugabane w’Isi ufite ishusho imwe nk’iyo. Umugabane w’Afurika rero ishusho wagennye iri ku musozi wa Nyarushishi uherereye mu murenge wa Kibeho, akarere ka Nyaruguru mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo.
Ku italiki ya 28 Ugushyingo mu mwaka w’i 1981, mu ishuri ryisumbuye ry’abakobwa ry’i Kibeho habereye ibintu bidasanzwe. Ubwo hari mu ma saha ya nyuma ya saa sita abana barangije gufungura, ariko bakiri hamwe mu cyumba cy’amafunguro, umukobwa witwa Alphonsine Mumureke wari ageze mu kigero cy’imyaka cumi n’itandatu, yumvise ijwi ryoroheje rimuhamagara mu kinyarwanda rigira riti: “Mwana wanjye”. Ubwo nawe ahaguruka bwangu akurikira iryo jwi ridasanzwe mu kirongozi, maze abona umugore ufite ubwiza buhebuje amuhagaze imbere,Yari yambaye umwambaro wera kandi yitwikirije umwenda w’ubururu mu mutwe. Ibiganza bye byari bibumbiye mu gituza, ariko intoki zireba hejuru. Nta nkweto yari yambaye. Alphonsine amubazanya igihunga agira ati: “Uri nde ?” Uwo mugore amusubiza bwangu avuga ati:“Ndi Nyina wa Jambo”.

Ugukomezwa ni isakaramentu rya Yezu Kristo wazutse aduheramo imbaraga zihariye za Roho Mutagatifu, zituma tubera Kristu abagabo mu bantu maze tukamuvugira tu kamwamamaza dushize amanga.
Ugukomezwa ni isakaramentu rifatwa nk’urugendo rwo kuzuza ibyatangiye mu Ibatizwa, aho umukirisitu aba umuhamya wa Kristu agashobora kurwanirira ukwizera kwe mu magambo no mu bikorwa,
gukomezwa ubusanzwe ritangwa n'umwepiskopi (cyangwa umupapadiri yabiherewe uburenganzira), ashyira amavuta matagatifu (cyangwa Karisima ku ruhanga rw'uwemejwe, amuvuraho amagambo agira ati: Habwa ikimenyetso cya Roho Mutagatifu, ingabire y'Imana.

Umuranga yafatwaga nk'inkingi yamwamba y'umuryango mu Rwanda rwohambere.
Umuranga yafashaga m'Umuhango w'ubukwe.
Umukobwa wabaga atarabona umushima akamushimagiza akamuranga mu muryango ufite umusore, yaheraga iwabo n’ubwo bitakundaga kubaho. Iyo niyo yabaye inkomoko y’umugani w’Ikinyarwanda ugira uti Umukobwa wabuze umuranga, yaheze mwa nyina. Cyari ikizira mu Rwanda rwo hambere ko Umusore cyangwa se inkumi birambagiriza, ababyeyi na bo byari umuziro ko binjira mu byo gushakira abana babo. Aho rero niho hakenerwaga umuhuza w’imiryango yombi ngo izagere ku ntego yo kubana, uwo niwe bitaga Umuranga. Mu muco wo mu Rwanda rwo hambere na n’ubu utaracika, habagaho umuntu witwaga Umuranga wabaga afite uruhare runini mu bukwe bwa Kinyarwanda, akagira inshingano zikomeye zo guhuza imiryango ibiri ikabasha gushyingirana. Umuranga ni we wafashaga imiryango y’abateganya gushyingiranwa kumenyana no gutunganya neza imihango ijyanye no kurambagizanya kwayo. Umuranga yabaga ari inshuti y’imiryango yombi ishaka guhana abageni cyangwa akaba umuvandimwe w’umuryango umwe, ariko aziranye n’abantu bo mu muryango bashakamo amaboko. Iyo umuranga yamenyeshaga imiryango uwo yatoranyije, umusore n’inkumi bashoboraga guhura, bakamenyana cyangwa bakaganira mu buryo busanzwe.
Umuranga yabagaho ate muri sosiyete.
Umuranga yatoranywaga n’imiryango ifite abasore n’inkumi bagejeje igihe cy’ubukure bashobora kuba bashyingiranwa, niyo mpamvu wasangaga agasozi aka n’aka gafite umuranga umwe udahinduka, bitewe n’imyitwarire myiza bamubonyeho. Umuranga yabaga ari umuntu ukomeye mu muryango nyarwanda, by’umwihariko agace atuyemo, yabaga ari umuntu uzi kubana no kuganira, ku buryo abasha gutanga ibisubizo ku bintu runaka byananiranye. Niyo mpamvu umuntu umeze atyo yitabazwaga kenshi mu birori bihuza abantu benshi nk’ubukwe. Umuranga yashoboraga guhuza imiryango ifite abana bakuze bashobora gushaka, akabaranga yaba yabisabwe cyangwa se atabisabwe, maze akazagira ubuhanga n’ubugeni bwo kuzahuza imiryango yombi ayereka ukuri nyako k’uko bashobora gushyingirana. Ni we muntu wagiraga imirimo myinshi mu muhango w’ubukwe, haba mbere yabwo ndetse na nyuma yabwo. Uw’ibanze ari nawo wamuhaga iryo zina, ni uwo kuranga umukobwa wa kanaka ugeze igihe cyo kurongorwa, akamurangira umuhungu wa kanaka na we ukeneye kurongora.

Ukaristiya ni Isakaramentu ririmo Yezu kristu ubwe gusa, n’umubiri we n’amaraso ye, mu bimenyetso by’umugati na divayi, akatubera icyarimwe Igitambo, Ifunguro n’Incuti tubana.
Abakristu bahimbaza iri sakaramentu binyuze mu Gitambo cya Misa, kandi bakagaragaza ukwemera kwabo binyuze mu gushengerera Yezu mu Isakaramentu no gukora ingendo nyagatifu aribyo imitambagiro.

Igihango cyo kugabirana Inka kiba hagati y’Umunyarwanda n’Inka, igihugu cye, umunyarwanda mugenzi we, umunyamahanga ukunda u Rwanda.
Igihango cyo Kugabirana.
Igihango cyo kugabirana n'igihango cyo guhana Inka, ni kimwe mu bihango u Rwanda rwasangiraga n’amahanga kimwe no gushyingirana. Igihango cyo guhana Inka, cyabanzirizwaga n’uko buri Munyarwanda na we agomba guhana igihango n’Inka kugira ngo zimukundire abashe kuzorora zororoke. Hanyuma umutunzi w’amashyo n’amagana, akaba yayifatiraho agirana igihango n’abandi. Mu igihango cyo guhana Inka kw’Abanyarwanda, byatumye ihabwa imimaro irenze iyo yari ifite mu muco n’amateka y’u Rwanda. Inka yarenze kuba itungo ryororwa ngo ritange ifumbire n’ amata, inyama n’impu zo kwambara, ihinduka n’igikoresho cya Politiki y’Ububanyi n’amahanga, Imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Ubukungu, n’umutekano. Igihango cyo guhana Inka, ni kimwe mu bihango by’Abanyarwanda bimaze igihe kirekire, kuko cyahanganywe n’u Rwanda. Igihango cyo guhana Inka, ni igihango cyaremwe na Gihanga ahasaga mu wa 1100, ubwo yashyiraga Inka mu bigomba kwifashishwa mu mushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda cyane cyane mu gisata cy’Ububanyi n’amahanga.Muri ibyo bihe, ni bwo Gihanga yaremye gahunda yitwaga “Gabirwa” yari igamije guteza imbere ubworozi bw’Inka no kuzigaba. Haherewe ku bihugu bituranye n’u Rwanda byari bitaratera imbere ku bworozi bw’Inka nk’u Buliza n’u Bwanacyambwe.

MURAGIJIMANA VESTINE uzwi ku izina rya Isimbi the model ukunda kwiyita umukobwa wo mu cyaro ni umunyarwandakazi wa rwiyemezamirimo, umunyamideli, ndetse n'umu infuruwensa wavukiye i Gitwe mu Karere ka Ruhango. Yavutse mu 1990 avukira mu muryango wishimye yaje kubura mu 1994 muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda; azakubura bamubona nyuma y'imyaka 5 aho yasanzwe mu kigo cy'imfubyi atangira kurerwa na nyirakuru kuva icyo gihe. Isimbi kuva kera yari umukobwa w'umushabitsi aho yacuruzaga imboga n'imbuto afite imyaka 9 agakuramo ayo kwishyura ibikoresho by'ishuri ndetse akanafasha nyirakuru kuko bari abana benshi.
Yashakanye na SHAUL HATZIR uturuka muri Isiraheli(Israel) muri 2022. Bahuye 2018 muri Kigali Convention Center bose bavuye mu nama, amwambika impeta ya fiyansaye 2019, basezerana mu rukiko 2021, kuri 20 Gashyantare 2022 nibwo bakoze ubukwe muri Kigali Concention center.
Afite ibikorwa bitandukanye ahuriza mu kigo kimwe cyitwa ISIMBI GROUP kigizwe na:
Ni umwe mu banyarwandakazi bizerako gusangiza abandi inkuru ye byafasha wa mwana w'umukobwa uri guca mu bihe bikomeye.Aho agira ati:"Nshaka ko inkuru yanjye abo bana bato babakobwa batagomba gucika intege mu gushaka ubuzima bwiza."

Inkomoko y’urushako ni Imana. Urushako rukwiye kubaho uko Imana ishaka kandi rugaharanira inyungu z’Imana. Urushako si amasezerano ahubwo ni isezerano cyangwa igihango.
Ibyo Twamenya ku Igihango cy'Urushako.
Igihango ntikigira iherezo kuko ntacyo wakora ngo usibe amateka, ahubwo uhora wibukako hari igihango wagiranye n’umuntu. Ku ruhande rwawe ukora ku buryo ubuhemu butazaguturukaho kugira ngo no mu gihe byanze rwose, umutima ntuzigere ugushinja ko ari wowe watatiye igihango. Urugo rwubakwa n’imbabazi, iyo uhuye n’uwagiriye ibibazo mu rushako ntakubwira intege nke ze ahubwo avuga iza mugenzi we. Agaragaza ko mugenzi we ari we umunanije. Umuntu wese muri twe anezeze mugenzi we kugira ngo amubere inyunganizi amukomeze, buri wese akwiriye gufasha mugenzi we kugira ngo amwunganire, amukomeze. Hari abantu bajya murushako bumva bagiye kugerageza kugira ngo nibyanga bazatandukane. Gusa iyo wiyemeje, burya ujye umenya ko ari akaramata kandi ko uzaba wanditse amateka atazibagirana. Kimwe mu bituma ingo zangirika ni uko inyinshi nta Mana ibamo. Igihe cyose Imana atari yo yabanje imbere mu rushako, ngo ibe urufatiro rwubakiyeho, umenyako imiyaga niza bitazoroha. Ntibivuzeko ingo z’abubaha Imana zidahura n’ibibazo. Biraza ariko urufatiro rw’iyo nzu urushako rukomeza gukomera. Urugo ni umushinga watangijwe n’Imana mu ngobyi ya Edeni. Kuva icyo gihe ibibera mu rugo Imana ibikurikiranira hafi kuko ntiyari gukomeza kubumbabumba itaka ngo abantu babeho. Ahubwo yahisemo guhuza umugabo n’umugore ngo babyare bororoke bakwire isi, bigishe urubyaro rwabo kuramya Imana. Kandi Uwiteka Imana iravuga iti si byiza ko umuntu aba wenyine, imuremere umufasha umukwiriye.

Isakaramentu ni ijambo risobanura ikimenyetso kigaragara cy’ubuntu bw’Imana kidashobora kubonwa n’amaso, cyashyizweho na Yezu Kristu kugira ngo kiduhe ubugingo n'ubutagatifu.
Hari amasakaramentu yo kwinjira mu bukristu:

Yahoze ari umunyamakuru wa Radiyo Rwanda, akaba azwiho kuba ari umunyamakuru wakoze kuri Radio Rwanda imyaka irenga mirongo ine ndetse no kuba yarabyariye muri Sitidiyo ya Radio ubwo yararimo gusoma amakuru.
Victoria NGANYIRA yavutse mu mwaka wa 1940 avukira mu karere ka Kamonyi. Yigiye amashuri abanza muri aka karere, naho amashuri yisumbuye ayigira mu kigo kigisha ibijyanye nokwigisha cyitwa Muramba Teachers Training College giherereye ku Gisenyi. Nyuma yo gusoza mashuri yisumbuye yigishije umwaka umwe, nyuma atangira gukora kuri Radio Rwanda, aho yakoze mu kiganiro WARI UZI KO? imyaka isaga 42.
Victiria NGANYIRA yabyaye abana barindwi, harimo Louise Victoria NGANYIRA na we waje kuba umunyamakuru

Igitambo cya Misa ni isengesho ry'ikirenga mu idini rya Gatolika, aho abemera begerana n'Imana kugira ngo bazirikane kandi basubire mu buryo bw'iyobera ry'urupfu n'izuka bya yezu Kristu.
Misa igabanyijemo ibice bibiri by'ingenzi, harimo liturujiya y’Ijambo ni gusoma no kumva ijambo ry'Imana mu ntagatifu, ndetse hari na liturujiya y’Ukaristiya aribyo guhazwa, aho abemera barya Umubiri wa Kristu mu buryo bw'umugati na divayi bihindutse.

Isengesho ni ukuganira n'Imana. Ni ikiganiro kiba hagati y'umuntu n'Imana yamuremye rero Isengesho ni yo nzira ya mbere Abizera bahawe yo kumenyesha Imana amarangamutima yabo no kubaho mu busabane bweruye hagati yabo n'Imana.
Isengesho ushobora kurikora uvuga byumvikana cyangwa se kimwe rishobora gukorwa bucece, utavuga, isengesho rikorwa hagati y'umuntu umwe n'Imana, cyangwa hagati y'abantu benshi mbese itsinda icyarimwe n'Imana. Isengesho hari ibintu 3 by'ingenzi rigomba kuba ryujuje:

Yabaye umunyamakuru wa Radiyo Rwanda kuva mukwa 12 mu mwaka wa 2002 kugeza mu mwaka wa 2013. Ni umukobwa wa Victoria NGANYIRA wahoze ari umunyamakuru kuri Radiyo Rwanda..
Louise Victoire Nganyira yavukiye muri Sitidiyo we n'impanga ye NGANYIRA Louis Victor, ubwo mama wa bo Nganyira Victoria yasomaga amatangazo. Louise Victoire yize muri Kaminuza Nkuru y'U Rwanda mu bijyanye n'uburezi. Mu mwaka wa 2002 Louise Victoire NGANYIRA yatangiye gukora kuri Radiyo Rwanda, nyuma aza kuhava ajya kwikorera mu mwaka wa 2013
Ikintu gikomeye batojwe numubyeyi wabo ni ugusenga,kwihanganirana mubuzima bwabo bwose kuko ntazibana zidakomanya amahembe. Ikndi yabaraze kwiga nk'impamba izababeshaho muminsi y'ubuzima bwabo kandi koko Imana yarabafashije babigeraho. Akunda kugira inama urubyiruko ngo bajye basenga cyane badaheranwa na gahinda k'ibibazo bahuye nabyo, kwirinda kujarajara mukazi, kunoza akazi kabo kudahemuka kandi rugakundana rudashingiye kubintu cyangwa ikintu kindi icyaricyo cyose.

Igaburo Ryera cyangwa Ifunguro Ryera) ni umuhango ukomeye mu bukristo ushushanya gusangira umubiri n'amaraso bya Yesu Kristo binyuze mu kurya umutsima no kunywa amaraso yiwe nkingi yu bukrosto ndetse n'ikimenyesho Yesu Kristo yadusigiye.
Igaburo ryera mu matorero menshi, uyu muhango ugenewe abamaze kwizera no kubatizwa, kandi basabwa kubanza kwisuzuma mu mutima no kwihana ibyaha mbere yo kuwegera, ndetse abapasteri cyangwa abayobozi b'itorero bakoresha uyu muhango nk'ikimenyetso cyo kuvugurura isezerano hagati y'umwizera n'Imana.

Ukaristiya ni isengesho rikuru, risingiza Imana kandi rikayishimira. Nk’uko Gatigisimu ibivuga. Ukaristiya ni isakramentu ririmo Yezu Kristu n’umubiri we n’amaraso ye, mu bimenyetso by’umugati na Divayi, akabera icyarimwe igitambo.
Tumenye Isakramentu Ukaristiya.
Ukaristiya rikomoka ku ijambo ry’ikigereki (Eucharistia), riva ku nshinga (Eucharistein) bivuga gushimira, rikavuga kandi kimwe n’irindi jambo (Eulogein). Aya magambo yibutsa ugushimira kw’Abayahudi, igihe bamamazaga ibikorwa by’Imana cyane cyane mu gihe cya Pasika. Gutura igitambo cy’Ukaristiya ni ugusangira isengesho ryo kwibuka gushimira Imana. Kuva kera gushimira Imana biri mu muco w’abantu bayo. Umunsi mukuru w’Isakaramentu Ritagatifu ry’umubiri n’amaraso bya Yezu, wahimbajwe bwa mbere mu mateka mu mwaka wa 1246. Kuwizihiza bwa mbere byabaye mu kinyejana cya cumi na gatatu biturutse ku mubikira Yuliyana wa Koroniyo Julienne de Cornillon, muri Diyoseze ya Liyeje (Liège) mu Bubiligi. Ni Papa Urbain IV wasabyeko uwo munsi mukuru wajya uhimbazwa muri Kiliziya y’isi yose. Icyari kigamijwe mu guhimbaza uwo munsi mukuru batambagiza Isakaramentu ritagatifu, kwari ukongera gushishikariza abakiristu kujya bahazwa ari benshi, kuko muri icyo gihe bahazwaga ari ngerere, bivuze ko ntacyo Yezu uri mu isakaramentu ry’Ukarisitiya yari akibabwiye. Nyamara kwa kino gihe, iyo umuntu yitegereje, kuba abantu bahazwa ari benshi cyane, si cyo kimenyetso gifatika cy’urukundo n’inyota abantu bafitiye Yezu uri muri Karistiya.
Amateka y'Isakrantu ry'Ukaristiya.
Isakaramentu Ritagatifu nyuma yo guhaza basigazaga Isakaramentu rigenewe abarwayi n’abagiye gupfa, nta kindi babaga bagambiriye. Kuva mu 1209, umubikira Yuliyana yagize amabonekerwa menshi, maze umunsi umwe ahishurirwa ko hari umunsi ubuze muri Kiliziya gatolika ari wo w’Isakaramentu Ritagatifu. Uwo mubikira yasabwe guharanira ko wajyaho kugira ngo abakirisitu bemere ko Yezu Kristu ari mu Isakaramentu ry’Ukaristiya, ubutumwa arabutangira, ariko ahura n’ibigeragezo. Abakire bo muri uwo mujyi bahagurukiye kumurwanya kuko basabwaga gusiba kurya kuri uwo munsi, ntibabone uko binezeza. Abihayimana na bo baramurwanyije bamushinja kwihangishwaho. Byamuviriyemo guhunga, ava aho yari atuye mu muryango, akihishahisha mu bigo by’abihayimana.Ibyo bigeragezo ntibyamubujije gukomeza gushishikariza abantu uwo munsi mukuru waje kwemerwa na Papa Urban wa 4 tariki ya 8 Nzeri mu mwaka 1264. Icyemezo cya Papa Urban cyanafatiye ku kuba muri icyo gihe hari umupadiri w’i Boheme witwa Petero wa Prage washidikanyaga bikomeye ko Yezu ashobora kuba ari mu bimenyetso by’Umugati na Divayi, waje kubigaragarizwa mu buryo bufatika. Umunsi umwe uwo mupadiri yari yakoze urugendo nyobokamana, arimo atura igitambo cya Misa, ageze mu gihe cya konsekarasiyo aho padiri azamura umugati na Divayi yigana Yezu wavuze ko ari umubiri n’amaraso ye abona Hositiya ihindutse ukundi, ifata ibara ry’iroza, maze itangira kuva amaraso, ibitonyanga byayo bigwa ku nsasirwagitambo no hasi kuri sima. Icyo gihe uwo mupadiri ngo yahise agwa mu kantu, abura icyo akora n’icyo areka, nuko kera kabaye yigira inama yo gusubika igitambo cya Misa, afata rya sakaramentu arijyana mu Sakirisitiya. Ibi byahuruje abantu benshi harimo na Papa Urban wa 4, waje gutangaza ku mugaragaro ko hagomba kubaho muri Kiliziya umunsi mukuru w’Isakaramentu Ritagatifu kugira ngo abakirisitu baramye Yezu uri mu gisa n’Umugati na Divayi.Uwo munsi yawushyize ku munsi wa kane ukurikira iminsi umunani nyuma ya Pentekositi, awugira itegeko ku bakristu bose, anasaba uwaje kuba Mutagatifu Tomasi w’Akwini gushyira ku murongo ibijyanye n’uko uzajya ugenda.Icyakora, icyo gihe habayeho abasenyeri n’abahanga mu bya tewolojiya inyigisho z’ubuhanga mu by’iyobokamana barwanyije icyo cyemezo, byatumye Papa Clement wa 5 akigarukaho, yemeza burundu uwo munsi mu mwaka 1311. Kugeza icyo gihe, umutambagiro ntiwagendaga nk’uko tuwuzi uyu munsi. Washyizweho na Papa Yohani wa 22, mu mwaka 1318, wasabye ko igihe bizihiza uwo munsi abakirisitu bazajya bakora umutambagiro mu muhanda no mu mayira kugira ngo Yezu ayihe umugisha. Inama Nkuru ya Kiliziya yabereye i Taranti mu mwaka wa 1545 kugeza mu mwaka 1563 nayo yemeje uwo mutambagiro, maze ihamya ko iyo abakirisitu batambagiza Isakaramentu Ritagatifu ku manywa y’ihangu baba bahamya ukwemera kwabo ko Yezu ari rwose mu Isakaramentu Ritagatifu ry’Ukaristiya.I Roma ho umutambagiro watangiye gukorwa mu kinyejana cya 15, igihe Nicolas wa 5 yari Papa.

Igitaramo ni ibirori, umuhango, cyangwa ikoraniro ry’abantu rigamije kwidagadura, gusabana, kwizihiza umuco, cyangwa kwiga binyuze mu ndirimbo, imbyino, imivugo, n’umurishyo w’ingoma, gusa hari ibitaramo nyarwanda ndetse n'ibitaramo bya gikristo.
mu gitaramo habagamo gahunda nyinshi twavugako habaga harimo nko:

Gushengera ni ukurangamira Yezu Kristu uri mu isakaramentu ry’ukaristiya, ukamwiyegurira wese mu ndoro no mu bitekerezo bityo ugashobora gutuza no kumutega amatwi ngo wumve icyo akuganiriza.
Ibindi wamenya ku Gushengerera.
Mu gihe cyo gushengerera, ukaristiya ntagatifu ishyirwa mu gikoresho cyabugenewe cyererana ku buryo isakaramentu rigaragarira ushoboye kureba icyo gikoresho. Mu masengesho yose abaho muri kiliziya gatolika, irisaba umutuzo kurusha ayandi ni iri ryo gushengerera. Bisaba umutuzo uhagije, ugomba gutuza muri wowe, ugacecekesha amajwi yose akubyiganiramo. Ushengerera agirwa inama yo kudahambira umutima we ku bitekerezo bidafite akamaro. Ibibazo, imihangayiko, umujinya n’ibindi bikurimo ntugomba kubyizirikaho ahubwo ubitura Yezu ugaharanira ko muri iryo sengesho nta wundi wundi Roho, umutima n’ubwenge byawe bizirikanaho keretse Yezu uri aho mu karistiya. Ibi ntabwo byoroheye umuntu, niyo mpamvu tugomba gusaba Imana ingabire yo kwisiga no kwizera. Ni ngombwa kumenya ko uri cyangwa winjiye ahantu ho gusengera, aho urahurira na Yezu mu Isakaramentu ry’Ukaristiya; bityo ni ngombwa gutegurira ku buryo bwimbitse umutima wawe kwinjira aho hantu.Ushengerera ntagomba kumara umwanya we asaba cyangwa aganya. Agomba gushimira agasabana n’Imana. Aho kwirirwa atekereza ku byo abura, ushengerera agomba gushimira Imana uko abayeho, ibyo atunze ndetse n’ibyo azabona ejo. Mu gihe unaniwe cyangwa uhuye n’ibirangaza bikurogoya, ntugomba gucika intege ahubwo ongera utangire isengesho ryawe ryo mu mutima rituje kandi usabe inkunga ya Roho Mutagatifu kugira ngo imbaraga ze zigaragarize mu ntege nke zawe kandi zikubere buri gihe umuyobozi wawe.Kuguma mu mutuzo urimo uzirikane ko Bikira Mariya, inyenyeri yo mu rukerera akaba n’irembo ry’ijuru akuri hafi mu rugendo rwawe akwereka inzira kandi akugeze mu Ijuru. Ni we uzakumvisha ko igihe urangamiye Yezu mu mutuzo, uzabona ubutatu butagatifu muri wowe.

Ni ibitaramo byatangiye muri kamena mwaka wa 2019 muri 2020 bikomwa munkokora nicyorezo cya COVID-19 gusa bikanyuzwa kuri terevisiyo y'Igihugu aho abahanzi bagiye batandukanye bataramiraga abakunzi babo babasusurutsa mu bihe bya guma mu rugo.
Ibyo wamenya kw'ibi Bitaramo.
Ni ibitamo by'umuziki byari bisanzwe byitwa Iwacu Muzika Festival byahindutse MTN Iwacu Muzika Festival nyuma y'uko sosiyete ya MTN ibaye umutera nkunga mukuru w'ibi bitaramo bitegurwa na EAP.Ni ibitaramo byitabirwa n’abahanzi batandukanye bagezweho, hagamijwe gutanga ibyishimo ku bakunzi b’umuziki. MTN Iwacu Muzika Festival ni iserukiramuco ry’ibitaramo bizenguruka igihugu biba buri mwaka.Abahanzi bagaragaza ko ari amahirwe adasanzwe yo baba babonye yo kongera gutaramira abakunzi babo hirya no hino mu gihugu bakabizeza kuzatanga ibyishimo bidacagase. Umwaka ushize, ibi bitaramo byari byatumiwemo abahanzi nka King James, Riderman, Bull Dogg, Juno Kizigenza, Ariel Wayz, Kivumbi King, na Nel Ngabo. Abo barimo abahanzi bakiri bato nka Juno Kizigenza, Kivumbi King, Ariel Wayz na Nel Ngabo, usanga bakunzwe na benshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu, ariko batarashobora gususurutsa abakunzi babo hirya no hino. Ibi bitaramo bitegurwa na Sosiyete ya MTN Rwanda ku bufatanye na EAP Rwanda, bikomeje gushyira hamwe bamwe mu bahanzi bakomeye mu gihugu no hanze yacyo. Kuri taliki 11 Gashyantare uyumwaka wa 2026 EAP isanzwe itegura ibi bitaramo yatangaje ko kuri iyi nshuro bizabera mu mijyi irindwi y’u Rwanda. Bavuga ko ibi bitaramo bizatangira ku taliki ya 20 Kamena 2026 bikarangira ku tariki ya 1 Kanama 2026, bizaca mu mijyi nka Huye, Ngoma, Nyagatare, Karongi, Muhanga, Musanze na Rubavu. Byitezwe ko ibi bitaramo bizitabirwa n’abahanzi batandukanye bagezweho, hagamijwe gutanga ibyishimo ku bakunzi b’umuziki.

Umutambagiro ni urugendo rw'imyemerere rukorewe hamwe n'abizera kumwe cyangwa se akaba ari igikorwa cyo kugendera hamwe gikunze gukorwa n'abakirisitu bo mu idini gaturika, cyangwa se kandi abayisilamu bakora urugendo rutagafitu bakunze kwita Hijja aho baba bagana ahantu hatagatifu.
Rero muri kiliziya Gatolika, umutambagiro ukunze kuba ari uwo kwereka icyubahiro baha Yezu Kristo mu Isakaramentu, ndetse no kuzirikana ububabare yagize, baba bagenda n'amaguru ndetse no kuririmba indirimbo.
Umutambagiro wa basilamu witwa Hijja, aho abayisilamu bakora urugendo rugana i Maka, ruzwi nka Hijja, bikaba ari inkingi ya gatanu y'ubuyisilamu ku bafite ubushoboziaho bagomba kuya I Maka.

Roho mutagatifu cyangwa se umwuka wera usobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye bitewe n'imyemerere ya gikristo, ariko ahanini ufatwa nk'imbaraga z'Imana muri rusange.
Amatorero menshi yigisha ko Umwuka Wera ari Imana mu buryo bwuzuye, akaba uwa gatatu mu cyitwa Ubutatu Butagatifu (Data, Umwana, n'Umwuka Wera), Umwuka Wera afasha abizera kunesha ibishuko, kugira imico myiza (imbuto z'Umwuka), no gusobanukirwa Ibyanditswe Byera.

Ikiriyo ubundi ni umuhango w'abanyarwanda kuva kera mubakurambere akaba uwo kuboroga no guhoza umuryango wabapfushije, aho abaturanyi, inshuti n'abavandimwe bateranira mu rugo rw'uwapfushije bakamara iminsi m'ugahinda, bakamufasha kwakira no guhangana n'urupfu.
Ikiriyo ni ni umwanya w'ubumwe n'ubufatanye mu bihe by'akababaro kandi ni igihe kirangwa no gusangira, guhumuriza ababuze, ndetse n'imigenzo irimo no gukura ikiriyo cyangwa se gusoza ikiriyo.

Gufata irembo cyangwa Gusaba irembo ni umuhango gakondo wakorwaga n'bakurambere bu Rwanda m'ubukwe nyarwanda, ukaba ariwo ukurikiraho nyuma yo kurambagiza, aho umuryango w'umusore avukamo ujya gusaba maze nyuma yaho umuryango w'umukobwa ubyemeye bagashinga urugo. Byerekana guhabwa ikaze kw'abakwe, ikaba intambwe ya mbere y'imikoranire ishyira akadomo ku kurambagiza.
Gufata irembo Uko bikorwa nuko umuryango w'umusore uzana inzoga ziherekejwe n'isuka y'ifatarembo hamwe n'inka y'ifatarembo, hakaba hari umwanya wokwakira abakwe, kumenyesha ko umukobwa asabwe, ndetse n'ibimenyetso nk'isando mbese akabando k'umusave byashyirwaga mu bikingi by'amarembo, habaga hari abasaza n'imiryango yombi, ariko umusore n'umukobwa ntibabonekagamo muri ibyo birori.

umuhango ni ijambo rifite ibisobanuro binyuranye bitewe n'aho rikoreshejwe, haba mu muco n'Imigenzo, mu buzima bw'Igitsina Gore ndetse no mu mibanire y'abantu. Umuhango ni igikorwa cyangwa umugenzo ukorwa mu buryo bwihariye kandi bukurikiza amabwiriza runaka yateganyijwe. Ibi bikunze kugaragara mu bihe by'ingenzi by'ubuzima.
Umuhango ubukwe ubundi rikoreshwa ahantu hatandukanye muburyo butandukanye, haba mu bukwe, Kwita umwana izina, Imihango y'iyobokamana gakondo, Gushyingura, Imihango, (Ibi ni ikimenyetso by'umukobwa cyuko umubiri we ukuze kandi ushobora kubyara, Umuhango nanone kandi ushobora gusobanura igikorwa cyo gusura abantu cyangwa guhura na bo mu buryo bw'icyubahiro.

Igisirimba ni imbyino gakondo y'umuco nyarwanda, ikunze kugaragara nk'imbyino y'ibyishimo, ishimwe, n'umunezero mwinshi mu bitaramo ndetse cyane cyane mu nsengero, aho abantu babyina bazunguriza amaboko n'amaguru bafatanyije, basimbuka hejuru bagaruka hasi biherekewe n'umudiho.
Igisirimba Mu gihe cya none ni imbyino ikoreshwa mu kuramya no guhimbaza Imana nk'ikimenyetso cy'ibyishimo by'abakristu, Ababyinnyi bakunze gukora uruziga, bakazunguza amaboko n'ibitugu, bagacinya akadiho, rimwe na rimwe bakaba bakunze gukoreshamo amapendo bayibyina.

Ikigoyi ni ururimi rw’Ikirera rushamikiye ku kinyrwanda, aho rukoreshwa n'abaturage bo mu duce tumwe na tumwe tw'u Rwanda. Ni rumwe mu ndimi zunganira Ikinyarwanda m'umwimerere warwo.
Ikigoyi ubundi ni ururimi rukoreshwa n' imiryango imwe n’imwe yo mu karere twa Rubavu na ndetse n'akarere ka Nyabihu aho usanga mu muryango ugizwe n'umugabo, umugore n’abana bavuga Ikinyarwanda, ariko usamga umwe muribo avuga Ikigoyi. Ni nako bimeze ku miryango ituye mu karere ka Burera.

Kwirabura ni ijambo rya kera mu kinyarwanda mu muco wa kera wa bakurambere, byerekezaga ko ari umuhango wo kujya mu cyunamo cyangwa kugaragaza agahinda k'uwapfuye.
Kwera ni uburyo bw’uruhererekane rwo kwakira urupfu. Kwirabura byabanzirizaga no kwera akaba wari umuhango wo gusoza ikiriyo abantu bakiyuhagira cyangwa bakisiga ingwa ko igihe cya marira kirangiye batangiye ubuzima bushya.

Kwera ni umuhango wo mu muco nyarwanda mu bakurambere, Kwera kujya kujyana no Kwirabura, Mu muco nyarwanda wa kera, kwera wari umuhango wakorwaga nyuma y’igihe cy’icyunamo mbese (kwirabura) cyo gupfusha umuntu. Wari umuhango wo kuva mu kigandalo no gusubira mu buzima busanzwe nyuma yu mubabaro n'agahinda.
Kugandara ni igihe cy’icyunamo n’agahinda k’umuryango wapfushije. Muri iki gihe, abantu baba bari mu mwijima (umukara), ntabwo biyogosheshaga, kandi bakiyiriza ubusa, bimwe mu bikorwa by’ibyishimo bakabihagarika nk’ikimenyetso cy’akababaro no kunamira uwagiye.

Icyunamo ni umuhango wa kera mu bakurambere mu muco nyarwanda, ni igihe cy'akababaro kidasanzwe cyo kwibuka ndetse no guha icyubahiro uwapfuye. mu muco, babaga bagamije gufashanya, guhumurizanya, no guha ikiriyo n’icyubahiro ababuze ababo.
mu cyunamo bacanaga Umuriro w’Icyunamo mu muco wa kera, mu gihe cy’icyunamo cyangwa ikiriyo nk’ikimenyetso cyo kugaragariza abantu uburyo ubuzima bwabo bugenda.
Icyunamo cy'Igihugu:.
Uyu munsi mu Rwanda, Icyunamo rikoreshwa cyane mu gihe cy' Icyumweru cy'Icyunamo gitangira ku itariki ya 7 Mata, cyibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, kikaba kirangwa n'ituze, ibiganiro, no gusura inzibutso.

Gukaraba nyuma y'urupfu ni umuhango wo kwiyeza cyangwa gukaraba intoki mwihunguraho urupfu, uyu ni umwe mu migenzo cyangwa imihango yabagaho nyuma yo gushyingura umuntu abavuye gushyingura bagombaga gukaraba kugira ngo biyambure umwaku cyangwa igitsure cy'urupfu, bakagaruka mu buzima busanzwe bameze nk'abatojwe cyangwa abejejwe.
Gukaraba mu muco ntibigarukira ku mazi n'isabune gusa, ahubwo ni n'uburyo bwo kwipakurura amakuba cyangwa kwitegura gukomeza gukora imihango y'ubuzima busanzwe nyuma y'umubabaro.

Kwiraba ivu cyangwa gusigwa ivu ni umuhango ukorwa n'abakirisitu, cyane cyane mu idini rya kiliziya gaturika, uba ku munsi Uwa Gatatu w'Ivu. Uyu munsi uba ari uwa mbere w'Igisibo Gishya buri mwaka mbese utangira iminsi 40 yo kwi tegura Pasika, izuka rya Yezu kristo.
Ivu rikoreshwa ahangaha ntabwo rituruka ku bintu ibyo ari byo byose; akenshi ivu rikoreshwa riva mu mashami y'imigano cyangwa indi mikindo yabaga yakoreshejwe ku cyumweru cy'amashami y'umwaka wawubanjirije, maze agashyirwa mu muriro akavamo ivu.

Umunsi wa Mashami ni umunsi mukuru w'abakirisitu wizihizwa ku cyumweru kibanziriza Pasika, ni umunsi w'izihizwa n'idini ya kiliziya gatolike. uyu munsi ufatwa nk'intangiriro y'Icyumweru gitagatifu.
ni umunsi wizihizwa mu rwego rwo kwibuka igihe Yezu Kristu yinjiraga mu mugi wa Yeruzalemu nk'umwami, abemera bitwaza amashami y'imikindo mu gutambagira, bashaka kwigana uko abantu ba kera bakiriye Yezu bayasanza mu nzira no kuyazunguza mu kirere bamusingiza.

Bwa mbere ku myaka irenga mirongo inani uyu Pst. Madeline Ndayisenga ni umwe mu bagore bagize uruhare mu guhatanira akoreshe imbaraga ze zose mu kugira ngo abashe gusengerwa ajye mu kiciro cy'abashumba b'itorero rya (ADEPR) mu Rwanda. Nkumwe mu bagore ba mbere bahawe inshingano z'ubushumba muri iri torero, taliki ya 9 Ukuboza 2025 mu birori byabereye mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, Umurenge wa Gasaka.
Mbere y'uko yimitswe agahabwa uburenganzira bwo kuba Umushumba Mukuru, yakunze kugaragara nk'umuvugabutumwa ndetse akaba n'umwe mu bayobozi b'abagore bashyize imbaraga mu bikorwa by'iyobokamana mu mibereho myiza y'abakirisitu.
Yabaye umusemburo w'impinduka muri ADEPR, aho yerekanye ko abagore bafite ubushobozi bwo kuyobora amatorero n'amaparuwasi ku rwego rw'Ubushumba. Kandi azwiho gufasha no kwigisha ijambo ry'Imana abakirisito mu buryo bw'umwuka, cyane mu bice by'amajyepfo y'u Rwanda aho akorera mu buzima bwe busanzwe bwa buri munsi.
Kimwe n'abandi bayobozi bo muri ADEPR, agira uruhare mu bikorwa by'amajyambere n'imibereho myiza no gufasha abadafite ubushobozi binyuze mu muryango w'itorero.

Ibirundo, Abadivantisite b'umunsi wa karindwi ni rimwe mu matorero abarizwa mu Rwanda kuva mumyaka myinshi itambutse ageza inyigisho z'ubutumwa bwiza kubemera bab'anyarwanda. hari ibikorwa binshi bitandukanye imigenzo, n'imihango babahiriza hari nicyi bita ibirundo.
Ibirundo nigahunda idasanzwe yo gutanga amaturo cyangwa ituro ryo gushima Imana ibyo yagejeje ku bizera basengera mu itorero mugihe cy'umwaka. Bitandukanye nicyacumi gitangwa cyangwa ituro risanzwe ritangwa ryaburi sabato, uhubwo ni umwanya abizera bafatanyiriza hamwe gushima Imana kubwimigisha yabahaye mu mirirmo bakora yabo nk'ubuhizi,ubucuruzi, ububumbyi, nibindi bitandukanye bibafasha mukwiteza imbere.
Impamvu babyita Ibirundo?
Inyito "Ibirundo" bikomoka kuburyo kera amaturo yakusanywaga mu gihe cya Bibiliya mu gihe cy'ubwami Hezekiya, aho abantu bazanaga imyaka yabo bakayishyira hamwe kugeza ibaye ibiundo bini cyane. Si imyaka gusa baturaga bashoboraga no gutura amafaranga agakusanyirizwa hamwe kugeza abaye menshi Nkicyerekanaga ubwinshi bw'ishimwe ry'abizera. Iyigahunda ishingiye kubivugwa mubitabo 2Ngoma 31:4-10, aho abisirayeli bazanye amaturo menshi cyane bakayarunda hasi biba ibirundo.
Niryari ayamaturo atangwa?
Mu Rwand ayamaturo y'ibirundo atangwa akunze gutangwa hagati y'amezi ya Gicurasi na Nyakanga. A kenshi bishingira kugihe kisarura kuri burigice kugirango abantu babone ibyo bashima Imana babikuyemu byo basaruye cyagwa mu nyungu babonye mu mirimo yaba bakora yaburi munsi.

Jeanne Francoise Mubiligi, ni umwe mubagore mbarwa bayoboye ibigo bitandukanye muri Africa, Kugeza ubu murwanda ayoboye Urugaga rwabikorera(PSF), ururugaga rubumbatiye ibihumbi by'ibigo by'ubucuruzi bifite agaciro kabarirwa mu mafaranga menshi. Yayoboye PSF kuva muri Gashyantare 2023, nyuma yaho uwari ukiyoboye yeguye kunshingano Robert Bapfakurera. yayoboye kandi ikigo gikora imirimo y'ubwubatsi cya E.M.P Ltd.
Ibikorwa by'indashyikirwa yakoze.
Nkuko twabivuze hejuru ni umuyobozi muru w'urwego rwbikorera murwanda kandi ya nayoboye ikigo gikomeye gikora ibijyanye n'ubwubatsi cya E.M.P Ltd.
Yayoboye ihuririro rikuru ry'inama yabagore bikorera kugiti cyabo, ikindi yabashije no mukuba yagiragize uruhare mwihinduka rijyanye n'imisoro kubikorera. agira uruhare rukomeye mugushakira abanyeshuri basoje amashuri kubashakira aho biga bimenyereza akazi murwego rwo kubongerera ubumenyi bufite ireme.

Nathalie Mukamazimpaka ni umwe mu banyarwandakazi byemejwe ko babonekewe ikibeho, yavutse mu 1964, akomoka mucyahoze ar'intara ya Gikongoro ubu ni mu majyepfo mukarere ka Nyaruguru ababyeyi be ni Laurent Ngango na Gaudance Mukabaziga.
Icyatumye Amenyekana
Ni umwe mubakobwa batatu babonekewe babona bikiramariya i Kibeho mu Rwanda. Yatangiye kubona ibyo yise amabonekerwa ku 12 Mutarama 1982 ubwo yari umunyeshuri mu ishuri ry'abakobwa i Kibeho Mwishuri rikuru, yabonekewe arihamwe Alphonsine Mumureke na Marie claire Mukangango.
Aya mabonekerwa yabaye hagati muwi 1981-1983 ariko ntiyahita yemerwa akomeza kugera mu 1989 ubwo yaje kongera kuba.
Bakavugako babonye Bikiramariya witwa Nyina wa Jambo, yabahaga ubutumwa ababwira ati "Mwicuze ibyaha byanyu, Musenge cyane, Mukunde kandi Mubababarirane.". Ku ya 15 Kanama 1982, Nathalie na bagenzi be babonye iyerekwa riteye ubwoba babona amaraso menshi, abantu bapfa bicwa nibindi byinshi bivugwako byari ubuhanuzi kuri Jenocide yakozwe mu 1994.
Mu 2001 nibwo hemejwe na Kiliziya ko ayamabonekerwa ari ukuri bwambere mubantu bemejwe kumugaragaro harimo uyu Nathalie.
Mugihe cya Jenocide yahungiye mugihugu cya Congo ahava ajya muri Kenya Nyuma yaho yagarutse i Kibeho, yiyeguriye ubuzima bwo gusenga no kwakira abaje gusura aho hantu. kugeza nubu aracyari i Kibeho.

U Rwanda n' Iterambere ry' Uburinganire.
u rwanda rumaze gutera intambwe ikomeye mu kwimakaza uburinganire n'ubushobozi bw' abagore mu myaka irenga 30 ishize. ibi byabaye urugendo rutoroshye kuko mumatekaumuco w'igihugu wari ushingiye ku butegesti bw'abagabo bwagiraga abagore abo mu rwego rwo hasi batabona amahirwe angana naya bagabo.
Uruhare rwa Rose Rwabuhihi mu iterambere.
Rose rwabuhihi i umwe mu bagize uruhare rukomeye muri uru rugendo.yabaye Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe gukurikirana ihame ry'uburinganire (chief gender monitor). yagize uruhare mu kongera kubaka igihugu nyuma ya jenoside yakorewe Abatusti mu 1994,no gushyiraho amategeko n'amahame arengera abagore.
Ubuzima bwa Rose Rwabuhihi.
Rwabuhihi yavukiye i kigali ariko ajya mubuhungiro mu mwaka 1960 kubera imvururu zari zishingiye ku moko. yize mubihugu bitandukanye, aza kubona buruse imujyana kwiga itangaza makuru n'itumanaho mumahanga nutwo atari yarigeze abyifuza na mbere.
Uburyo itangazamakuru yize ryamuhinduriye ubuzima..
Nubwo itangaza makuru atari inzozi ze ryamufashije gufungura amaso kubibazo byugarije
abagore n'abakobwa. yabonye ihohoterwa n'akarengane bakorerwaga, bituma yiyemeza guharanira uburenganzira bwabo no gushaka icyo yakora ngo abateze imbere.
Uburyo yiyemeje kurengera abagore n 'abakobwa.
Mu myaka 1980, abagore bari ibibazo bikomeye mu bihugu byinshi byo muri africa, Rwabuhihi yabonye ko abagore bafite ubushobozi bwo gukora no gukemura ibibazo bitandukanye, ariko badafite amahirwe cyangwa ijwi. Ibi byatumye yiyemeza kubafasha kubona uburenganzira, ubuvugizi n'amahirwe angana n'ay'abagabo.
Uburyo Rose yavuye mwitangazamakuru akajya mu bidukikije..
Nyuma y'itangazamakuru, yinjiye mu bikorwa byo kurengera ibidukikije. yabonye ko abagore bagira uruhare runini mu gukoresha umutungo kamere, bityo bagomba no kugira uruhare mu kuyirinda no kuyiteza imbere.
Gukangurira abaturage binyuze kuri radio.
Rwabuhihi yakoresheje radiyo nk'uburyo bwo kwigisha abaturage uburenganzira bwabo,cyane cyane mu byaro. yigishaga abagabo n'abahungu kubaha no gushyigikira uburinganire.
Akazi ke mu muryango w'abibumbye no mu Rwanda..
Rose Rwabuhihi yakoranye n'umuryango wabibumbye (UN) imyaka myinshi, aho yunguste ubunararibonye kubwego mpuzamahanga. yagaruste mu Rwanda mu mwaka 1995, akora muri minisiteri y'uburinganire, nyuma aza kuba Chief Gender Monitor mu 2013.
Iterambere ry' uburinganire mu Rwanda..
Mu myaka 30 ishize u Rwanda rwageze ku iterambere rikomeye harimo nko kuba abagore bafite uburenganzira ku mutungo, uburezi, kwitabira politike nibindi. ibi byari ibintu bidashoboka mbbereya 1994.
Uburezi nk'Inkingi y'iterambere.
U Rwanda rwashyize imbaraga mu guteza imbere uburezi bw'abakobwa. Ubu abakobwa n'abahungu bafite amahirwe angana mu mashuri no mu masomo yose, nubwo hakiri icyuho mu masomo ya siyance nikoranabuhanga.
Imyumvire yabatuturage..
Nubwo amategeko ateza imbere uburinganire, haracyari imyumvire ya kera igifata abagore nk'abagomba kuba mu nshingano zimwe gusa. guhindura iyi myumvire ni cyo kibazo gikomeye gisigaye.
intabwe zatewe mu buzima n'imari..
Abagore ubu bashobora gufungura konti muri bank, gutunga umutungo no kuyobora ibigo.hari n' abagore bari mu myanya ikomeye nk'ubuyobozi bwa banki nkuru. naho mubuzima impfu zababyeyi bapfa babyara zaragabanuste cne.
Imbogamizi zigisigaye.
Nubwo hari iterambere ariko hari nimbogamizi abagore bagihura nazo, nko kwizerwa mubucuruzi, gushyirwaho igitutu cyo gushyingirwa kare, n'imyumvire ibabuza kwiga amasomo akomeye
Uruhare rwitangazamakuru mu guhindura imyumvire.
Rwabuhihi asanga itangazamakuru rigomba kugira uruhare rukomeye muguhindura imyumvire yabanyarwanda nko:
ibi byafasha guhindura uko sosiyette ibabona
Icyerekezo cy'ahazaza.
Rwabuhihi yifuza u rwanda aho umuntu adacirwa urubanza hashingiwe ku gistina cye, ahubwo ashingiye ku bushobozi bwe. ashaka igihugu aho abana bose,abahungu n' abakobwa, bagira amahirwe angana yo gustinda.

Amateka ya Chantal Kayitesi
Chantal Kayitesi ni umwe mu Banyarwanda bafite inkuru ikomeye y'ubuzima, igaragaza ububabare n'ubutwari mubihe byabanjirije Jenocide yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Yari umwe mu barokotse ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abagogwe mu Majyaruguru y'u Rwanda hagati ya 1991 na 1993, aho benshi mu bagabo n'abahungu bishwe, abagore n'abana bagahungira ahantu hatandukanye bashaka ubuhungiro.
Mugihe yari amaze gukubitwa bikome n'ingabo za leta, Chantal yasigaye atekereza ko ubuzima bwe burangiye. Icyakora, yahuriye n'ingabo za RPA (Inkotanyi) zamutabaraga zimwizeza umutekano. Uwo mwanya wabaye intangiriro y'ubuzima bushya kuri we.
Chantal yahise atanga amakuru ku bandi bagogwe bari bagiye kwicirwa ku rusengero rwa Mugali. Inkotanyi zateguye igikorwa cyo kubarokora zibasha kubakura aho bari bari mukaga. Zibajyana ahatekanye. Ibi byatumye abantu barenga 300 barokoka urupfu rwa rubategereje.
Nyuma y'aho, Chantal yakomeje kubaho ubuzima bushya, anatanga ubuhamya ku mateka mabi yabaye mu Rwanda. Anashimira Inkotanyi zamurokoye. Uyu munsi, afite icyifuzo cyo kwandika igitabo kizafasha abigihe kizaza kumenya amateka n'amasomo akomeye yakuye muri ibyo bihe.
Inkuru ya Chantal Kayitesi ni urugero rw'ubutwari, ukwihangana n'icyizere, igaraza ko n'iyo bihe biba bibi gute, ubuzima bushobora kongera kubakwa bundi bushya.

Amateka ya Beatrice Mukankusi.
Beatrice Mukankusi yabaye umukozi uhoraho mu Muryango w'Abaholandi ushinzwe iterambere witwa SNV(the netherlands development organization) mu gihe cyimyaka 17 yose, kuva 2001-2019 yakoraga mubyiciro bijyanye nuburinganire, imiyoborere myiza ndeste n'imicungire ihuriweho y'umutungo w'amazi. akaba afite impamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza (Master's) mubyubucuruzi nimiyoborere(Business Administration), kandi ni ninzobere mu bijyanye n'amazi,nisuku n'isukura
Mukasine Beatrice yari umwarimu ukiri muto wigishaga mu mashuri yisumbuye mu ntara y'amajyepfo mu rwanda igihe amashuri yafungwaga kubera jenoside yakorewe abatusti. nyuma yabo yatangiye igikorwa cyo kongera guhuza abana batabnye nimiryango yabo, yaba iyabo bwite cyangwa imiryango ibakira.yagize kandi uruhare rukomeye mu gukangurira abagore kumenya uburenganzira bwabo, cyane cyane ku bijyanye no gutanga no kuzungura umutungo.
Yakoze kandi muri Minisiteri y'uburinganire no mu Muryango w'Abibumbye, aho yungutse ubunararibonye mpuzamahanga. Mu 2013, yabaye Perezida w'Inama y'Igihugu y'Abagore.
Kugeza ubu muri Ministeri y'Umukozi Ushinzwe umushinga wa Water for Virungas, ugamije guteza imbere imicungire y'amazi no kugabanya amakimbirane mu gace ka Virung. Afite ubunararibonye mu gukorana n'abaturage no guteza imbere uburinganire n'iterambere rirambye.

Marie claire Mukanga umwe mu bagize itsinda ry'abakobwa batatu(3) bagize amabonekerwa i Kibeho, yavutse mu 1961 muri paruwase ya Mushubi, aha hoze ari Rusekera muri diyosezi ya Gikongoro, ubu ni muntara y'amajyepfo. se umubyara yitwa Baseka, nyina akitwa Velonika Nyirantuza, witwbyebye imana mu 2009 gusa se yaje kwitaba Imana akiri muto cyane. Yvukiye mu muryango wabana barindwi yabatijwe taliki ya 12 Kamena 1966 afite imyaka itanu, yahawe isakaramentu ry'ukarisitiya taliki ya 15 Kamena 1969 akamezwa mu 1975.
Imibereho yamuranze.
Mukangango Marie claire yari umwana usanzwe uturuka mu mumuryango utishoboye bituruka kubibazo yahuye nabyo byokubura umubyeyi akiri muto, amashuri abanza yayize mu kigo cya Bishyiga ku Gikongoro ubu ni muri paruwasi ya Bishyiga. Yaje gutsinda ikizamini cya leta kumanota yambere yoherezwa gutangira ayisumbuye muri Gisenyi naho ahava akomereza kwiga muri Rwunge(College) yabakobwa i Kibeho mu mwaka wa mashuri wa 1977-19778.
Aha ninabwo hahise hazamo amabonekerwa yagiriye ikibeho nkayabaye 15/8/1985 aho yahawe ubutumwa bwo kwigisha aba kirisitu ishapule y'ububare burindwi. yaje kuva i Kibeho amaze kwiga ntiyabasha gukomeza kuba yakwiha Imana ahubwo yaje Gushyingirwa mu mwaka 1987, nyuama azakwitaba Imana we n'umutware we muri Jenocide yo 1994 batarabyara umwana.

Ikindi yakundaga gutebya, gutera urwenya nabandi gusabana, kubyina akananga akarengane kabagenzi. Muri rusange yabaniraga neza abantu bose kandi agakunda gusenga cyane

Umukobwa wahize abandi mu marushanwa y'Imibare ku munsi Mpuzamahanga w'Imibare..
Igiraneza ange wiga kuri New Vision HIgh School mu Mujyi wa Kigali, yaje ku mwanya wa Kabiri mu marushanwa yateguriwe abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri yisumbuye mu Mibare, akaba n'uwa mbere mu bakobwa, yavuze ko abakobwa benshi batinye imibare kuko badakunda kwigora.
Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w'Imibare (π-day) wizihizwa buri tariki ya 14 Werurwe, hazirikanwa akamaro kayo muri sosiyete. Mu Rwanda wizihijwe ku nshuro ya kabiri ku bufatanye bwa Kaminuuza y'Urwanda n'ibindi bigo bifite aho bihuriye no guteza imbere siyansi.
Aya marushanwa yahuje abana 114 barimo abakobwa 55 n'abahungu 59 baturutse mu Mujyi wa Kigali no mutundi turere dutandatu, mu bigo 24 by'amashuri.
Muri rusange uwa mbere yabaye Munezero Aimee Cedrick wiga kuri Petit Seminaire Ndera wahembwe iPAD n'amadorari 500, uwa kabiri aba Igiraneza Ange wiga kuri New Vision High School wahembwe amadorali 500 n'impamyabushobozi naho uwa Gatatu aba Magambo Richard na we wiga kuri Petit Seminaire Ndera wahembwe amadorali 500.
Mu butumwa Ange yahaye abandi bakobwa yagize ati " Ikintu gikenewe ni uko bagomba kumenya ko imibare ikenewe ahantu hose, ikintu cyose ni imibare, niyo waba utambuka ni imibare uba ukoresha."
