Giramata olga ni muntu ki?
Giramata olga ni umwe mu bahanzi babakobwa bakizamuka mu rwanda yatangiye kumenyekana mu ruhando rwa muzika ahagana mu mwaka wa 2019-2020.
Giramata yitabiriye irushanwa rya miss rwanda 2022 afite igitekerezo cyo kuvugira abahanzikazi bahura n'ibibazo byo gusabwa ruswa irimo n'ishingiye ku gitsina
Giramata yemeza ko icyo ashimira imana ari uko yabashije kunyura mu mitego yamusabaga no gutanga ruswa ariko akahava atayitanze
Kuri ubu Giramata ni umwe mu bahanzi binjijwe muri SAGE music, sosiyete nshya ifasha abahanzi yinjiye ku isoko ry'urwanda

Uwineza Catherine, umu Physiotherapist w' amakipe akomeye muri Tour du Rwanda.
Tour du Rwanda ni iki?
Isiganwa mpuzamahanga ry'amagare rya Tour du Rwanda, ni irushanwa riba ririmo amakipe n'abakinnyi bakomeye, ariko nanone kugira ngo bitware neza, haba hari ababafasha barimo abakanishi n'abaganga.
Ubuzima bwa Uwineza Catherine ku bijyanye n'umwuga we
Uwineza Catherine, umaze imyaka umunani akora akazi ko kunanura imitsi y'abakinnyi mu makipe akina Tour du Rwanda n'andi marushanwa y'amagare akomeye, yize amashuri ye yose mu Rwanda mu bijyanye n'Ubugenge, Ubutabire n'Ibinyabuzima, aminuriza muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda mu Ishami ry'Ubuzima n'Ubuvuzi, aho yamaze imyaka ine yiga Physiotherapy.
Yinjiye mu mukino w'amagare mu 2018, ubwo yakoranaga n'Ikipe y'igihugu y'u Rwanda y'Abagore yari mu mikino ya Shampiyona ya Afurika.
Mu 2022 yahise atangira gukorana na Saris Rouvy Sauerland Team yo mu budage, ari nayo yaje guhinduka Rembe-Rad-Net Pro Cycling Team ari nayo akorana nayo kugeza ubu.
Akorera he mu busanzwe?
Iyo nta marushanwa ahari, Uwineza aba ari umukozi muri HVP Gatagara Orthopedic and Rehabilitation Hospital, aho akorera akazi ke ka buri munsi ko gufasha abarwayi kunanura imitsi.

Umuryango remezo cyangwa umuryangoremezo ni umuryango shingiro muri Kiliziya Gatolika ku rwego rw’ibanze mbese kurwego rwohasi, aho abakristu batuye begeranye haba mu midugudu, akagari cyangwa se mu masegiteri, ibi bishyira hamwe imiryango kugirango basangire Ijambo ry’Imana, basengere hamwe, ndetse kandi bafashanye mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
Ishingano z'umuryango remezo.
umuryango remezo haba hari inshingano zitandukanye twavuga gusangira Ijambo ry'Imana abagize umuryango remezo barahura bagasomera hamwe Bibiliya, ijambo ry'Imana, kandi ni ihuriro ryo gusengera hamwe, ndetse Ubufatanye n'Urukundo.

Paruwasi ni icyicaro cy'ubuyobozi cyangwa kikaba uhurira rya santarale,umidugudu, Sikilisali bakorera imimuriko, ndetse n'ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya gatolika cyangwa amadini yandi asazwe gusa muri Kiliziya Gatolika kiba kigizwe n'abakristu batuye mu gace kamwe k'akarere runaka, bayobowe na Padiri Mukuru cyangwa pasiteri ariwe mushyumba.
Kuri Paruwasi niha habera ibinyu byinshi bitandukanye harimo ubuyobozi icyicaro cya padiri mukuru, ndetse no gutanga inshingano nko gutanga amasakaramentu, kwigisha ijambo ry'Imana, no gufasha binyuze muri Caritasi. paruwasi ya mbere yashinzwe mbere mu Rwanda ni Save yashinzwe muri 1900.

Kwita izina ni umugenzo wa bakurambere aho wakorerwaga umwana wuruhinja wavutse, maze bakamwakira umuntu mushya kuva cyera mu muryango w’Abanyarwanda, habaga hari ababyeyi n’abaturanyi baje kumuterura.
ubunnyano rero impamvu kwita izina babyita ubunnyano, nuko abana babahaga ibyo kurya ku ntara ariko bakaba babumbabumbye utubumbe twinshi, tumeze nk’uko umwana annya impande zose, ariko abo bana bagataha iwabo ari uko umwana aneye.

Gutwikurura ni umuhango wa korwaga nyuma ubwo babaga bamaze gusoza imihango y’ubukwe mu muco nyarwanda. rero iri jambo gutwikurura ikomoka ku nshinga gutwikura, bishaka kuvuga gukura umwitwikiro ku mugeni.
ibikorwa mu gutwikurura.
Uyu muhango wo gutwikurura ufite ibikorwa biyana nawo, ahatwavuga gusohora umugeni aho cyari igikorwa cyo guha umugeni uburenganzira bwo gusohoka mu muryango mbese mu inyegamo, akajya ahagaragara kugira ngo atangire imirimo yomu rugo rushya, Kumenyera umuryango, Bibafasha umugeni kumenyerana n'umuryango mushya ashatsemo, kumenya imyitwarire n'imico yawo.

Kurambagiza ni umwe mu migenzo yakorwaga n'abacyera abakurambere, aho cyari igikorwa cyangwa urugendo rutoroshye rwo kumenyana no gusuzuma niba imiryango ibili ifite ibantu abantu babiri bakundana bashobora kubana mbese kureba ko umugabo ndetse n'umugore niba bombi bufite intego n'indangagaciro bihuye mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo gushyingiranwa.
Kurambagiza byari bifite Intego yo gushinga urugo, Kurambagiza nyakuri ntibiba ari ukwishimisha gusa, ahubwo biba bifite intego yo kureba niba mwazubaka urugo, Kumenyana byimbitse, Ni umwanya wo kuganira ku mico, amateka, n'imyizerere ya buri wese kugira ngo mumenye niba mushobora kuzuzanya, kandi ni umwanya usaba ubushishozi, bisaba kureba imyifatire y'undi, kumenya imiryango avukamo, n'uburyo afata ibyemezo.

Umuryango ubundi ugizwe n'umugabo, umugore, n'abana, ariko ukaba ushobora no kwaguka ukageza kuri ba sekuru, ba nyogokuru, n'abandi banyamuryango.ubundi umuryango ni ihuriro ry'abantu bafitanye isano wenda rishingiye ku gushyingiranwa, ku maraso, cyangwa ku kurera, umuryango ufatwa nk'inkingi ya mwamba y'ubuzima n'iterambere.
Burya umuryango ubaho gusa atari kuba dusangiye amaraso,ni harya hantu abantu bose baba bagukunda, uko waba umeze kose,aho banezerererwa iterambere ryawe uko biba biri kose.

Gusaba umugeni ni umuhango wakurikiraga uwo gufata irembo, ukabera iwabo w’umukobwa, mu muhango wo gusaba, umuryango w’umusore watoranyaga abakwe bajya kuwusabira, bakagenda bayobowe n’umukwe mukuru, bitwaje inzoga yo gusabisha.
Gusaba ukaba wari umuhango wo guha agaciro imiryango w'umukobwa, kuko umusore ntiyabaga yemerewe gutwara umukobwa atamuhawe, Ibyo byari ikimenyetso cy’uko umuryango w’umuhungu uha agaciro umuryango wareze umukobwa. gusa ariko nanone mu gihe cyo gusaba, umuryango w’umukobwa ntiwahitaga wemerera umuryango w’umusore umugeni, ibyo bikagaragaza kwihesha agaciro nk’umuryango no kugahesha abawukumokamo.

Gukwa ni umuhango wabaga nyuma yo gusaba, mu muhango wo gukwa wakorwaga n’umuryango w’umusore kandi ukabera iwabo w’umukobwa. Umusore yakwaga inka, isuka cyangwa andi matungo nubwo hose bavugaga ko bakoye inka.
Inkwano yabaga ari ikimenyetso hagati y’imiryango yombi, ko ibaye inshuti. Inkwano yari ipfundo ry’ubumwe hagati y’imiryango yombi,mu muco Nyarwanda, inkwano ntiyabaga inzitizi. Yaba yabonetse cyangwa itabonetse, ntibyabuzaga ubukwe gutaha. Igihe inkwano yabaga ibuze, umusore yashoboraga gutenda, ni ukuvuga gufata igihe aba kwa sebukwe akora akazi gasimbura inkwano cyangwa agahabwa umugeni w’ubuntu.

Gutebutsa uyu ni umuhango ukomeye ukurikira gusaba no gukwa, Aha umuryango w’umusore ujyaga iwabo w'umuryango w’umukobwa hagamijwe kuganira ku gihe umugeni bazamubazanira mbese igihe bazamubahekera bakamubazanira.
Gutebutsa hari uduce tumwe na tumwe gutebutsa byakorwaga cyangwa bikorwa inshuro zirenzwe imwe, aha umuryango w’umukobwa ugakomeza kwihagararaho kugira ngo umuryango w’umusore ubone agaciro k’umukobwa wabo.

Kurongorana ni umuhango uba hagati y'umugabo n'umugore baherejwe n'imiryango yabo yombi bagiye kurongorana, akaba ari igihe iyo kigeze, umuryango w’umukobwa waramuhekaga ukamushyira umuryango w’umusore. Iyo yabaga ageze kwa sebukwe, hari imihango yakorwaga yo kumwakira ikagenda itandukana bitewe n’agace.
Umugeni iyo yabaga akiri mu bikingi by’amarembo, yahagararaga hejuru y’aho batabye urusyo, nyirabukwe akamukoza umwuko ku mpanga gusa nanone umugeni arakomeza maze akinjira agasanga sebukwe yicaye ikambere akamwica ku bibero akanamuha inka y’ibibero akabona kujyanwa mu mbere.
Iyo ibirori by’ubukwe byabaga bigeze hagati, se w’umusore yamujyanaga kurongora, mu kurongora hakoreshwaga umwishywa, umusore akawambika umugeni hanyuma akivuga ati ndakurongoye ndi kanaka mwene kanaka’ maze ababyeyi bakavuza impundu. Ibirori byarakomezaga kugeza mu gitondo, abaje baherekeje umugeni bagasezera bagataha.
Nta mukobwa washyingirwaga yaratakaje ubusugi kuko kubutakaza byabaga ari igisebo ku mukobwa, umuryango akomokamo n’igihugu. Uwabaga yatwise atarashyingirwa, yafatwaga nk’uwatesheje igihugu ubusugi, kugira ngo igihugu gisubirane iryo shema ry’ubusugi bwacyo, umukobwa bakamucira mu mahanga cyangwa bakamuroha.

Gutinya umwanya cyangwa igihe kiba nyuma y'ubukwe akaba ari umuhango wo mu muco nyarwanda gakondo kuva kera mu bakurambere mu Rwanda, aho umugeni yamaraga mu nzu i kambere iminsi runaka iminsi igera kuri 7 cyangwa irenga nyuma yo kurongorwa, ntajye ahagaragara cyangwa ngo akore imirimo yo mu rugo.
Gutinya byasoza n'umuhango wasozwaga n'undi muhango witwa Gutwikurura, aho umugeni yasohorwaga akerekanwa ku mugaragaro maze agatangira imirimo ye nk'umugore mu rugo rwe.

Ubukwe ni umuhango ubumbatiye Umuco nyarwanda. Uyu muhango w'ubukwe ukorwa hagati y'imiryango ibiri ihana umugeni n'umukwe, ni ukuvuga umuryango w'umusore n'umukobwa, Ubukwe ni itangiriro ryo kubaho k'umuryango, ubukwe akaba ari igihe abafashe Umwanzuro wo kubana batanya binyuze mu mucyo, bakemera gushyigikirwa maze nabo bakajya kubaka umuryango wabo witezweho kwagura igihugu binyuze mu kubyara no kurera abana bazaba Rwanda rwejo.
Ubukwe bugira imihango mwinshi itandukanye aha twavuga:

Gushyingirwa ni umuhango cyangwa isezerano ryo guhuza umugabo n'umugore bakemeranya kubana akaramata nk'umuryango umwe, harimo abemeza gushyingirwa mu idini cyangwa gushyingirwa mu mategeko gusa, ariko abashyingirwa ni abafite nibura imyaka 18.
Gushyingirwa ni igikorwa cyo guhamya isezerano ry'abashakanye imbere y'ubuyobozi bwa Leta mbese mu murenge, aho biyemeza kubana no gufashanya bakurikije amategeko agenga umuryango,Ku bemera Imana, gushyingirwa bifatwa nk'isakaramentu cyangwa umuhamagaro uturuka ku Mana, aho umugabo n'umugore bafatanya mu kurema no kurera umuryango mushya, Intego nyamukuru ni ugushinga urugo rugengwa n'urukundo, ubwuzuzanye, no gukomeza igisekuru binyuze mu kubyara no kurera neza.

Tungurusumu benshi bakoresha nk’ibirungo mu mboga zitandukanye,benshi baziko zitekwa gusa,nyamara kuyirya ari mbisi mu gihe cy’amafunguro bigira akamaro kanini mu kurinda indwara zitandukanye.
Umuntu wese ufite igikomere aho ariho hose, haba ari inyuma cyangwa imbere mu mubiri, ntabwo yemerewe gukoresha tungurusumu.
Urugero ni nk’umugore cyangwa umukobwa uri mu mihango cyangwa wabyaye, ndetse n’undi muntu wese ufite igikomere inyuma ku mubiri cyangwa n’ahandi hose haba hashobora kuva amaraso.
Umugore utwite, kuva agisama kurinda abyaye na we ntiyemerewe gukoresha tungurusumu kuko tungurusumu ikora mu kongera ubwaguke bw’imitsi kugira ngo amaraso atembere neza.
Ku mubyeyi utwite rero twibuke ko aba afite ingobyi umwana arimo ari nayo imugaburira ikabahuza bombi.
Iyi ngobyi rero ibamo imitsi nk’iba mu bindi bice by’umubiri. Umubyeyi aramutse akoresheje tungurusumu rero amaraso agatembera muri iyo mitsi mu buryo budasanzwe, iyo ngobyi ishobora guhita irekura wa mwana yari ifashe bityo inda ikavamo.
Abantu barwaye igifu (ulcere gastrique)na bo ntibemerewe gukoresha tungurusumu kuko mu biyigize harimo amatembabuzi ashobora kugera mu gifu akamurya,ndetse n’abana bari munsi y’imyaka 2 n’umubyeyi wonsa umwana uri munsi y’amezi 6.
Kwirinda ni inshingano ya buri wese,kuko kwivuza bigora kuruta kwita ku buzima bwacu butahura n’ibibazo.

Gusezerana mu murenge cyangwa gusezerana mu mategeko cyangwa se gusezerana imbere y'amategeko mu Rwanda ni umuhango wemewe n'itegeko rigenga abantu n'umuryango, ni umuhango ukorerwa imbere y'umwanditsi w'irangamimerere mu murenge, ugashimangira urushako, ukubahiriza uburenganzira bw'abashyingiranywe ku mutungo n'abana.
Gusezerana mu murenge bisaba kuba ufite imyaka 18, ndetse hari ibyangombwa ugomba kuba ifite, ibi bisabirwa ku Irembo mu Rwanda, nibura iminsi 23 mbere y'ubukwe, bisaba kandi ibyemezo by'amavuko, indangamuntu, n'inyandiko zigaragaza ko ari ingaragu, ubutane, cyangwa gupfakara.
Gusezerana mu murenge abashakanye bahitamo uburyo butatu bwo gucunga umutungo wabo, burimo ivangamutungo rusange, ivangamutungo w’umuhahano, n’ivanguramutungo risesuye cyangwa se uburyo bwa kane bwo gucunga umutungo aho abashaka gushyingiranwa bazajya bitegurira amasezerano y’uburyo bashaka ko umutungo wabo ucungwa.

Gusezerana imbere y'Imana cyangwa gusezerana mu idini ni umuhango ukomeye w'iyobokamana aho ari umuhango ubanziriza gusezerana imbere y'amategeko ya Leta yu Rwanda,aho abateganya kubana nk'umugabo n'umugore bahamya isezerano ryabo imbere y'Imana n'imbaga y'abantu.
Gusezerana imbere y'Imana ni umwanya wo guhabwa umugisha n'Imana binyuze mu bayobozi b'idini harimo abashumba, abapadiri, cyangwa abashehe, Amadini amwe na hamwe nka ADEPR cyangwa Abadivantisite asaba ko abagiye kubana baba bahuje imyemerere cyangwa idini, mu gihe andi nka Kiliziya Gatolika na Angilikani ashobora gusezeranya abadahuje imyizerere. gusezerana mu idini ya Islam icyo bita Nikah bishobora gutwara abageni amafaranga ibihumbi 30 Frw kugeza kuri 230 Frw bitewe n'aho umuhango ubera n'ibindi byangombwa.
Mu madini menshi, abantu babana badasezeranye mu idini cyangwa imbere y'Imana bafatwa nk'abaguye mu cyaha cyangwa se uburaya, kandi bashobora guhagarikwa ku mirimo y'itorero cyangwa ntibahabwe amasakramentu.

MUKASAHAHA DIANE ni umugore w'umunyarwandakazi ufite umugabo umwe n'abana bane(4),yamenyekanye nkumugore windashyikirwa mu Rwana.
Mukasahaha Diane yize amashuri abanza nayisumbuye, afite impamyabumenyi zitandukanye harimo iya Bachelor muby'ubuforomo,iy'icyiciro cya kabiri(Master's)mubuzima rusange(public healthy)yakuye muri kaminuza ya Manchester,afite kandi na Dipolome mu kwita ku barwayi bageze mubihe bikomeye(palliative care)yakuye mu Bufaransa.
Mukasahaha Diane niwe Munyarwanda wabashije kugera mu 10 bambere mu marushanwa ya AFRICA'S BUSINESS HEROES ahemba ba rwiyemezamirimo bafite imishinga myiza aho yacyuye ibihumbi 100$(arenga milion 145 Rwf).Yashinze aba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa sosiyete ya DIKAM Ltd,uruganda rukora imyenda rwibanda kuguteza imbere abagore n'urubyiruko.Yamenyekanye cyane nyuma yo guhindura umwuga we yarafite mubuzima rusange akinjira mu nganda.

Ubunane ni ijambo rikoreshwa mu Kinyarwanda risobanura umunsi mukuru umunsi w'ambere utangira umwaka mushya wizihizwa tariki ya 1 Mutarama, Ubunane ni ijambo rifite inkomoko ku rurimi rw'Igifaransa ("Bonne Année"), bishatse kuvuga Umwaka mwiza.
Inkomoko ry'ijambo ubunane ryakomotse ku buryo Abanyarwanda bakiriye interuro y'Igifaransa Bonne Année. Kera, abana bavutse kuri uyu munsi akunze kwitwa ba Bunani niba ari abahungu cyangwa Mukabunani niba ari abakobwa.
Ubunane ni igihe cyo gusura imiryango, gusangira ifunguro rya saa sita ridasanzwe, no guhana impano.

Kuvumba mu Kinyarwanda ni umwe mu muco wa kera w'abanyarwanda, ni ijambo rikoreshwa cyane mu rurimi rw'abantu baciriritse ku giti cyabo bikaba bivuze kujya mu birori, mu bukwe, cyangwa ahatari ibiryo utatumiwe, ugamije kurya, kunywa, no kwishimana n'abandi ariko utaratumiwemo.

Ubugeni mu muco nyarwanda ni isomo cyangwa ubumenyi bukubiyemo ibintu byose bijyanye n'ubuhanzi, ubwiza, n'ubuhanga bw'ibyaremwe n'abantu mu buryo bugaragaza imibereho n'indangagaciro by'Abanyarwanda.
Umuco nyarwanda wari ufite ubugeni bwinshi harimo ubugeni bw'amabara nk'ibishushanyo, ibimenyetso, Ubugeni bw'umuziki hazagamo icyembe, Ubugeni bw'imbyino, Ubugeni bw'ubukorikori.

Ubworozi bw'amafi mu Rwanda ni umwuga urimo gutera imbere cyane,ukorwa ahantu hatandukanye hagamijwe kongera umusaruro w'amafi kuko ari isoko nziza y'intungamubiri.
Ahanini ubworozi bw'amafi muri rusange bukorwa ahantu hakurikira:
Ibintu by'ingenzi byitabwaho mu bworozi bw'amafi:

Nubwo buri wese aziko amazi arimeza mu mubiri ariko nanone ntago twakirengagiza ko iyo urungeje urugero rw'ayougomba kuba ufite kobishoboraguteza ikibazo.
Mugihe abahanga badahwema kugira inama abagwayi kunywa amazi menshi,abahanga nano bavugako amazi menshi mu mubiri atari meza.
Umuganga, wo mubitaro byo muri Tanzaniabyitwa 'Hospital ya taifa Muhimbili(MNH)'Dr Sadick Sizya, avugako iyo amazi abaye menshi mu mubiri kurusha ayakenewe atari byiza,kuko icyogihe umuntu yisanga mubyago byo kugira uburozi mu mubiri bituma hari ubutare bw'ingenzi bugabanuka,harimo n'ubwitwa Sodium.
Dr Sadick sizya,aganira n'ikinyamakuru kitwa'mwananchi yagize ati'Hari ubwo abantu dushishikariza kunywa amazi menshi tutitaye kurugero rwayo.
Byashobokako umuntu yabona mugenzi we anywa amazi nka litiro eshanu ku munsi maze nawe agatangira kumwigana.kandi atitaye kubanza ngo amenye ko umubiri we ubyemerewe cyangwa utabyemerewe.

Inzobere mu bijyanye nubuzima bw'abana bato zigaragazako abanabagenda bahura n'ibibazo bitandukanye by'ubuzima, bitewe ntokudakora imyitozo ngorora mubiriri birimo,kugira umubyibuho ukabije,kugira inda itandukanye ningano yibindi bice bye byumubiri.
Dore bimwe mubyiza byogukora imyitozo ku bana bato
Kwigirir icyizere abana bakora imyitozo bibafasha mukubongerera ikizere ndetse nokugararagara neza mubijye ni shusho yumubiri wabo.
Gukomera amagufa imyitozo ifasha umwana kutiremereza nk' igihe yurira ahantu cyangwa asimbuka ari byo binamufasha mukongera uburemere bw'amagufaye no gukomera kwayo.

Bruce Melodie ni umuhanzi ufite amateka maremare haba k'ubuzimabwe ndetse no mumuziki. kandi nawe ntatinya kuvugako ari "bavakure".Ariko ibyo byose yarabirenze ubu ni umuhanzi wikirangirire murwanda.indirimboze zirakunzwe cyane muri Africa ndetse amaze no kwigarurira imitima y'abantu benshi cyane cyane muri Afrika y'iburasirazuba nko muri kenya nahandi muri Africa.Murwanda ho yamaze gufata abantu bugwate kuburyo n'abamwangaga batangiye gukunda ibihangano bye.Akunze kwitabazwa n'abahanzi benshi ngo baririmbane,kuko indirimbo yashyizemo ibirungo ntakabuza irakundwa.Itahiwacu bruce uzwi ku izina nka bruce melodie kandi yakuze abwirwa ko ari mubi ariko ibyo ntibyamwangarije kariyeri ngobimubuze gukomeza umwuga we w'ubuhanzi.Bruce melodie ubu numwe muhanzi bahagaze neza mu muziki nyarwanda kandi bakunzwe cyane.Bruce Itahiwacu yavutse mu 1992 i kanombe mu mugi wa kigalih

Umwuka utari mwiza mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati uri guteza ibura rya gaz helium ku isi bikaba byaratangiye kugira ingaruka mbi kunganda z'ikoranabuhanga.
Helium ni ingenzi cyane mu gukora utwuma duto cyane tubika amakuru [chips], by’umwihariko mu gukonjesha no gukora ibisaba ubwitonzi, ubuhanga n’ubushishozi bwo hejuru.
Ibibazo by'umutekano muke no gukererwa mu bijyanye n'ubwikorezi biri gutuma ibiciro byiyi gaze bizamuka cyane bigatuma igorana kuboneka. abayobozi b'ibigo by'ikoranabuhanga bavuga ko ibi bibazo bikomeje kudindiza akazi kabo.
Ibigo byinshi biri kugorwa no kubona abandi babigezaho iyi gaz, aho ubu bimwe biri kwerekeza amaso muri Amerika.
Ibikoresho by’ibanze bituruka mu bihugu nka Israel na byo biri kuba bike kubera ubukererwe bukomeye mu bwikorezi.
Inzobere zivuga ko helium nikomeza kubura, inganda zishobora kuzagabanya cyangwa guhagarika burundu gukora utwuma duto tubika amakuru [chips].
Kubera ko chips ari ubwonko bw’ibikoresho byinshi by’ikoranabuhanga tumenyereye, ibi bivuga ko habaho n’igabanyuka rikomeye mu bikoresho byinshi nka telefoni zigezweho, ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi, n’iby’imodoka.

Aya mafaranga ngo ashobora no kwikuba gatatu mu gihe haba hakoreshejwe imbuto nshya y’ibihumyo abo bahinzi bahuguriwe gukoresha.
Bavuga ko ikilo(kg) kimwe cy’ibihumyo byari bisanzwe bya ’oyster’ ari amafaranga 2,000Frw, mu gihe icy’ibihumyo bishya bya ’button’ kigurishwa arenze 5,000Frw.
Umukozi w’Ikigo ’Development Network’ gihinga kikanatunganya ibihumyo, witwa Antoinette Nyirazaninka avuga ko Abanyarwanda babura ubutaka bungana na m² imwe yo guhingaho ibihumyo ari bake cyane mu Gihugu.
Nyirazaninka agira ati "Wahinga imigina 62 kuri m² imwe, buri mugina weramo amagarama(g) 500, wakuba na 62 ukareba, mu minsi iri hagati y’irindwi n’icumi (7-10) uba watangiye gusarura ugana isoko hagashira amezi atatu. Ibihumbi 50Frw washoye waba wayabonye ndetse wasigaranye na cya gishoro cyangwa waranguye indi migina."
Undi muhinzi w’ibihumyo witwa Bizimana Vincent avuga ko iki kiribwa gifite isoko rinini cyane haba mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.
Bizimana avuga ko umuhinzi wabishyizemo umwete ashobora kubona umusaruro w’ibiro 50-100 ku munsi kandi mu gihe cyose cy’umwaka, kuko bihingwa ahantu hatwikiriye bikavomererwa.

Ubu bworozi bw'amafi buri gukorerwa mu nkengero z'Ikiyaga cya Mugesera mu Murenge wa Rukumberi mu Karere ka Ngoma. Bukorwa n'ikigo cyitwa National YIPIN Technology Agriculture cyashinzwe na Fuan Lin.
Uyu mugabo yaguze ubutaka bungana na hegitari 3.5 iruhande rw'Ikiyaga cya Mugesera. yabwubatseho uruganda rutunganya ibiryo by'amafi, ubuso busigaye abwubakamo 'green house' nini, azishyiramo ibigega 150 ari nabyo agenda yororeramo amafi kuva atangiye kuyategura akiri mato kugeza ku manini ajyana ku isoko.
Higaneza Sylas usanzwe ari umutekanisiye muri ubu bworozi bw'amafi, Yavuze ko ubu buryo bw'ibigega mu bworozi bw'amafi busa n'aho buri kugeragezwa mu kureba ko bwatanga umusaruro mwinshi urenzeuw'ubundi buryo bwajya bukoreshwa mu Rwanda nka kareremba.
Ati "Ugereranyije igihe tumaze cy'umwaka umwe, tumaze gusarura toni zirenga 50 z'amafi,turi kugenda twongera ibigega kuko twabonye ko bigenda neza."
Higaneza yavuze ko kimwe mu bintu bibagora muri ubu bworozi ari uburyo umuriro ubura rimwe na rimwe kandi uba ari ingenzi cyane ku buryo bisanga bakoresheje mazutu nyinshi.
Yavuze ko kandi abatekenisiye bazi iby'amafi ari bake cyane ku buryo bakigorwa no kwigisha Abanyarwanda babfasha mu gukurikirana aya mafi.
Higaneza yavuze ko isoko ry'amafi mu Rwanda rihari rinini cyane ku buryo batapfa kurihaza, ashimangira ko bashaka kongera umubare w'ibigega kuko babonye ko ubu buryo butuma ifi ziboneka vuba kandi ari nyinshi.

= WithinTech Rwanda =
WithinTech Rwanda ni umuryango w’ikoranabuhanga ufite intego yo guteza imbere urubyiruko binyuze mu kubaha ubumenyi mu bijyanye na coding, robotics, na digital skills zitandukanye. Washinzwe n’umukobwa ukiri muto witwa Aline Niyomungeli, ufite icyerekezo cyo guteza imbere abakobwa n’abahungu mu ikoranabuhanga no kubafasha kubona amahirwe mu isi ya digital.
WithinTech Rwanda yashinzwe hagamijwe gukemura ikibazo cy’abakiri bato badafite amahirwe yo kubona ubumenyi bujyanye n’ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Aline Niyomungeli yatangiye uyu muryango ashingiye ku bunararibonye bwe mu kwigisha no gukorana n’urubyiruko, aho yabonye ko hari icyuho kinini mu myigire ya digital skills cyane cyane ku bakobwa.
Uyu muryango watangiye ari igitekerezo gito, ariko ugenda waguka binyuze mu mahugurwa, camps, n’ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije guteza imbere urubyiruko.
Intego ya WithinTech Rwanda ni:
Icyerekezo (Vision).
WithinTech Rwanda ifite icyerekezo cyo kuba umuryango uyoboye mu guteza imbere ubumenyi bw’ikoranabuhanga mu rubyiruko mu Rwanda no muri Afurika, aho buri mwana wese yagira amahirwe angana yo kwiga no gukoresha ikoranabuhanga mu buzima bwe bwa buri munsi.
Ibikorwa n’ingaruka (Impact).
WithinTech Rwanda imaze kugira uruhare rukomeye mu:
Abanyeshuri benshi bamaze kunyura muri izi gahunda bagaragaje impinduka zirimo:
Uruhare mu muryango nyarwanda.
WithinTech Rwanda igira uruhare mu guteza imbere gahunda za leta zigamije kubaka ubukungu bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga. Uyu muryango ukorana n’ibigo by’amashuri, abafatanyabikorwa, n’imiryango itandukanye mu rwego rwo kugeza ubumenyi ku rubyiruko rwinshi.
WithinTech Rwanda ni urugero rwiza rw’uko urubyiruko rushobora gutangiza impinduka mu gihugu, ruyobowe n’umukobwa ukiri muto Aline Niyomungeli, ukomeje guharanira ko nta mwana usigara inyuma mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga
Niba ushaka byinshi kuri iyi nkuru masura imbuga za Withintech Rwanda
withintech official website

KATABARWA MURENZI Gilbert ni umunyarwanda wavukiye mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda. Akaba afite impamyabumenyi yikirenga (Doctorate) akaba na engeniyeri (Engineer) aho yabikuye muri Kaminuza yo mu Bushinwa, Shanghai bita Tongji University. Muri iyi Kaminuza kandi ni umwarimu mu bijyanye na (Ubuhanga ku bumenyi bw'isi)Ge-informatics na (Kugenzura) Surveying muri iyo Kaminuza. Muri ibyo ni byo yize akan=ba yarihuguye no ku mujya uri mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga(Smart City Development).
Ubushakashatsi yakoze.
Katabarwa Murenzi Gilbert yavumbuye ikoranabuhanga rya "Maglev Obsatcle detection" ryerekana mbere inzitizi ziri mu nzira ya Gari ya Moshi zizwi nka "Maglev" bityo bikayirinda gukora impanuka.Mu 2002 u Bushinwa niho bwatangiye gukoresha bwa mbere gari ya moshi izwi nka Maglev (magnetic levitation) zigira umuvuduko mwinshi cyane zikaba ziri mu zihuta cyane ku Isi.Ni gari ya moshi ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya rukuruzi, aho igice cyayo gitwara abagenzi kigenda gikururuka ku nzira ikozwe muri rukuruzi, bikayiha imbaraga zidasanzwe zo kwihuta.

Alice Niragire ni umuganga w'umunyarwandakazi w'inzobere mu kubaga(general surgeon),uzwi cyane kuba ariwe mugore wa mbere mu Rwanda muri ako kazi. Yavukiye mu Karere ka Ruhango, intara y'amajyepfo mu mwaka 1982.
Amashuri abanza yayize Ecole Primaire de Nyarurama, ayisumbuye ayiga muri Ecole des sciences Byimana ahiga Biology and Chemistry. Mu mwaka 2004 nibwo yagiye kwiga muri Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda, yiga mu ishami ry'ubuvuzi bw'abantu (General medecine and surgery) Imyaka 6. Mu mwaka wa 2015 nibwo yaje gusoza amasomo y'ikirenga(masters) mu kubaga(MMed Surgery). Aba abaye umugore wa mbere wabonye iyo mpamyabumenyi mu Rwanda kuva iyi gahunda yatangira mu mwaka wa 2006.
Dr Niragire yakoze mu bitaro bitandukanye mu Rwanda, aho yatangiriye gukora hari mu bitari bya Rwamagana, aho yakoraga mu bikorwa byo kubaga no kuvura abarwayi, akaba yarahakoze umwaka umwe.Nyuma yaho yaje kwimukira muri Kigali University Teaching Hospital (CHUK), bimwe mu bitaro bikuru byigisha mu Rwanda, aho akorera nka General Surgeon.
Kamwe mu kazi akorayo nuri munsi harimo:

Dr Francoise MUKAGAJU.
Dr Francoise Mukagaju ni umuganga w'umunyarwanda w'inzobere mu kubaga no gusana imyanya y'umubiri (plastic and reconstructive surgery). Azwi nko kuba ari we mugore wa mbere wabaye umu plastic surgeon mu Rwanda, akaba ari umwe mu bagize uruhare rukomeye mu guteza imbere ubu buvuzi mu gihugu.
Dr Mukagaju yatangiye yiga ubuvuzi rusange (general medecine) muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda. Nyuma yaje gukomeza mu mahugurwa yihariye ya Plastic surgery, binyuze mu bufatanye bwa University of Rwanda na Operation Smile. Icyo gihe yahakuye ubumenyi n'ubunararibonye bwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, bituma aba umwe mu baganga ba mbere batojwe neza muru uru rwego mu Rwanda.
Dr Mukagaju akora nka Plastic Surgeon mu Rwanda, akorera cyane cyane mu bitaro bikomeye byitiriwe umwami Fayisari (King Faisal Hospital Rwanda).
Bimwe mubyo akora harimo: Kubaga no gusana imyanya yangiritse (reconstructive surgery), Kuvura abana bafite ibibazo by'ibibari(Cleft Lip and Palate), ndetse kandi akanagaragara mu bushakashatsi mpuzamahanga ku bijyanye no kubaga no gusana imyanya y'umubiri.
Uruhare mpuzamahanga.
Dr Mukagaju akorana n'imiryango mpuzamahanga mu bikorwa byo gutoza abaganga bashya, guteza imbere ubuvuzi mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, gutanga ubuvuzi ku bantu badafite ubushobozi. Akaba afite uruhare mu ishingwa nrya Operation Smile, ifasha abana bafite ibibazo byo mu maso.

Urwibutso rwa Gisuna ni rumwe mu nzibutso zihariye zishyinguyemo Abatutsi bishwe mu 1994, mu myaka yabanje guhera mu 1959, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994Abatutsi batangiye kicwa mu buryo bw’agashinyaguro burimo gutwikirwa amazu,kumeneshwa,babita amazina mabi abatesha agaciro n’ubundi bugizi bwa nabi, batangira kubeshyerwa ko ari ibyitso by’Inkotanyi; Uyu munsi, uru rwibutso rwa Gisuna rufite uruhare rukomeye mu kubungabunga aya amateka ya Jenoside no kwibutsa abakiriho kuzirikana no kumenya amateka mabi yaranze igihugu cyacu Jenoside%20n'ibibi%20byayo%2C%20birakomeza%20gutizwa%20umurindi%20n'uburyo ingaruka mbi z’urwango n’ivangura, hagamijwe kubaka igihugu kirangwa n’ubumwe n’amahoro.
AHO URWIBUTSO RWA GISUNA RUHEREREYE.
Urwibutso rwa Gisuna ruherereye mu karere ka Gicumbi, mu murenge wa Byumba, ahahoze ari Perefegitura ya Byumba, rukaba rushyinguyemo imibiri y’Abatutsi bakuwe mu turere dutandukanye turimo Gatsibo, Nyagatare na Rulindo, ndetse no mu zahoze ari komine nka Muhura, Ngarama, Murambi, Muvumba, Kizinga, Buyoga na Tumba; uru rwibutso rufite amateka akomeye mu kubungabunga amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, no gukomeza kwibutsa abanyarwanda bose n'abandi muri rusange kurwanya no kurandura ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kugira ngo dukumire burundu Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 no kubaka ubumwe n’amahoro burambye.
AMATEKA YA JENOSIDE YAKOREWE ABATUTSI MU 1994 MU RWANDA.
Ubwo Inkotanyi zatangizaga urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu tariki ya 1 Ukwakira 1990, Abatutsi benshi bo mu zahoze ari komini mu Majyaruguru batangiye gutabwa muri yombi bashinjwa kuba ibyitso, bafungirwa ahari urukiko rwa Perefegitura ya Byumba hafi y’igisirikare; ubuhamya bwa bamwe mu barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, barimo Mupenzi Joseph, avuga ko kuva tariki ya 3 Ukwakira 1990 hatangiye igikorwa cyo gufata Abatutsi mu mujyi wa Byumba no mu nkengero zawo, bagakorerwa iyicarubozo rikomeye, bakicwa mu buryo bw’agashinyaguro burimo gutemwa, gutwikwa no gutwikirwa, ndetse no gusukwaho ibintu bishyushye,Abatutsi bafashwe bavanywe mu bice bitandukanye nka Murambi, Muhura na Muvumba babita “Inyenzi”, bagashyirwa mu kato bagakorerwa ubugome bukabije aho bamwe bicwaga nyuma yo kujyanwa mu kigo cya gisirikare, abandi bakajugunywa mu byobo ari bazima ndetse n'abandi Batutsi bakorerwaga iyicarubozo, mu gihe Abatutsi bamwe barokotse barekuwe nyuma y’amezi abiri n’akanama kari kagizwe n’abayobozi barimo Superefe na Burugumesitiri, ariko benshi mu baturukaga mu zindi komini bagahitanwa n’ubwicanyi bw’indengakamere bwabibasiye bubasanga mu mayira.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamigina ni urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Tare, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo mu Rwanda, rwibukirwamo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Uru rwibutso rushyinguwemo imibiri y’abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994,biciwe muri ako gace no mu nkengero zako, rukaba rufite uruhare mu gusigasira amateka no kwigisha ku ngaruka z’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.Ku wa 20 Mata 2025, imibiri irenga ibihumbi bine (4,200) yari ishyinguye kuri uru rwibutso yimuriwe mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi ruherereye mu Murenge wa Gasaka, mu rwego rwo kurushaho kunoza imicungire no kubungabunga inzibutso za Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994 no guha icyubahiro gikwiye abacu abazize Jenoside.
Ku wa 20 Mata 2025, imibiri 4,201 y’abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yari ishyinguye mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamigina ruherereye mu Murenge wa Tare, yimuriwe mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi ruherereye mu Murenge wa Gasaka, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Iki gikorwa cyari kigamije guhuza inzibutso za Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu rwego rwo kurushaho kubungabunga amateka no kunoza imicungire y'inzibutso.Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Nyamagabe bwatangaje ko kwimura iyo mibiri byakozwe ku bufatanye n’imiryango yarifite ababo bashyinguwe kuri uru rwibutso, bakaba barabyemeye hagamijwe kubaha icyubahiro gikwiye no gusigasira amateka. Umuyobozi w’Akarere yashimiye imiryango yemeye icyo gikorwa, abizeza ko aho uru rwibutso rwari ruherereye hazakomeza kwitabwaho nk’ikimenyetso cy’amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.Iki gikorwa cyakurikiwe n’Umugoroba wo kwibuka wabereye ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamigina, witabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye, barimo Perezida w’Inama Njyanama y’Akarere, abayobozi bungirije b’Akarere n’abahagarariye inzego z’umutekano, amadini n’amatorero, hamwe n’abaturage.Imibiri yimuwe yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro ku wa 21 Mata 2025 mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi, hamwe n’indi mibiri umunani, igizwe n’irindwi yari ishyinguye mu miryango n’umwe wabonetse nyuma.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi rwa Kiziguro ni urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Kiziguro, mu Karere ka Gatsibo, mu Rwanda. Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Kiziguro ruherereye mu murenge wa Kiziguro, mu karere ka Gatsibo. Ni ahantu ho kwibuka, gusobanukirwa amateka no guha icyubahiro Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Mu minsi ya mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Abatutsi benshi bo mu cyahoze ari komini Murambi no mu nkengero zaho bahungiye kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Kiziguro. Bizeraga ko bashobora kuharokokera.
Ku wa 11 Mata 1994, abagabye igitero barimo Interahamwe, abasirikare n'abandi bafatanyije na bo bateye Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri paruwasi. Ubwicanyi bwatangiye mu gitondo bukomeza kugeza nimugoroba.
Abari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi ya Kiziguro biciwe mu bice bitandukanye by'iyo paruwasi. Muri ibyo bice harimo igikari cy'abapadiri, hafi y'amashuri, ku bitaro bya Kiziguro no mu nkengero z'urusengero. Imibiri ya bamwe mu bishwe yajugunywe mu byobo byari hafi aho, indi ijugunywa mu rwobo rurerure rwari munsi y'amashuri.
Jenoside muri ako gace yateguwe kandi ishyirwa mu bikorwa n'abayobozi b'inzego nkuru n'iz'ibanze, bafatanyije n'Interahamwe n'abasirikare baturutse mu bigo bya gisirikare bitandukanye.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, hashyizweho Urwibutso rwa Kiziguro kugira ngo rushyingurwemo imibiri y'abishwe kandi rubungabunge amateka y'ibyabereye muri ako gace.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside irenga ibihumbi 20.132. Mu gihe cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 31, hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro indi mibiri 21 yari imaze kuboneka.
Urwibutso rwa Kiziguro rufasha mu bikorwa byo kwibuka, kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no guhangana n'ipfobya n'ihakana rya Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Musange ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Musange, mu Akarere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Uru rwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri irenga 26 000. Rwakira buri mwaka imihango yo "Kwibuka".
Urwibutso ruri mu Kagari ka Jenda, mu Murenge wa Musange, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Aha hahoze ari Komini Musange, muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro.
Ubwicanyi bwabereye i Musange.
Mu minsi ya mbere ya Jenoside, abicanyi baturutse muri Komini Karambo bageze muri Musange. Ku wa 15 Mata 1994, abantu benshi bateraniye ku isoko rya Masizi. Bashakaga gutera Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku biro bya Komini Musange. Abapolisi barashe mu kirere, abo bantu baratatana. Abatutsi bamwe bo muri Musange bahungiye kuri Paruwasi ya Kaduha.
Musange ni agace k'imisozi miremire, amashyamba n'ibihuru. Interahamwe zatwikaga ibihuru n'amazu kugira ngo hatagira uwihisha. Abatutsi bamwe bahungiye mu mashuri abanza ya Masagara na Musange. Abandi bahungiye mu nsengero, nka ADEPR Masizi na Kiliziya Gatolika ya Masagara. Interahamwe n'abasirikare ba FAR babasangagayo barabica. Bamwe barokotse kubera Abahutu babahishe.
Urwibutso rwa Musange ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu cyahoze ari Gikongoro, Abatutsi bishwe kuva mu Ugushyingo 1959. Mu Ukuboza 1963, Abatutsi bagera ku 2 500 biciwe kuri Paruwasi ya Cyanika.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, bamwe mu bayikoze baburanishijwe n'inkiko Gacaca. Mu 2004, imibiri y'Abatutsi yabonetse yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro muri uru rwibutso. Urwibutso rwavuguruwe hagati ya 2018 na 2019.
Urwibutso rwa Musange ruruhukiyemo imibiri irenga 26 000. Buri mwaka, abaturage ba Musange bahurira ku rwibutso mu gihe cyo kwibuka.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi rwa Muyumbu ni urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Muyumbu, Akarere ka Rwamagana, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Rwibukirwaho Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kandi ni hamwe mu hantu ha mbere hashyizweho mu Rwanda hagamijwe gushyingura mu cyubahiro no kwibuka abazize Jenoside. Mu 2026, amakuru yatangajwe yagaragazaga ko urwibutso rwari rushyinguyemo imibiri 14 401.
Urwibutso rwa Muyumbu ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Aho urwibutso ruherereye.
Urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Muyumbu, mu Akarere ka Rwamagana, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, iburasirazuba bwa Kigali.
Muyumbu ni kamwe mu duce two mu Karere ka Rwamagana twegereye umujyi wa Kigali. Urwibutso ni rumwe mu nzibutso zashyizweho mu Rwanda kugira ngo zibungabunge amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kandi zibe ahantu ho kunamira no gushyingura mu cyubahiro abazize Jenoside.
Ku wa 13 Ugushyingo 1994, i Muyumbu hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro imibiri 400 y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside. Amakuru yatangajwe mu 2026 avuga ko icyo ari cyo gikorwa cya mbere cyo gushyingura mu rwibutso rwa Jenoside cyabaye mu Rwanda. "The New Times" na yo yagaragaje Muyumbu nk'ahari urwibutso rwa mbere rwa Jenoside mu Rwanda.
Mu Mata 2017, indi mibiri 26 yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro kuri uru rwibutso.
Ku wa 11 Mata 2022, hashyinguwe indi mibiri icumi yari yabonetse, irimo irindwi yabonetse mu Murenge wa Nzige n'itatu yabonetse mu Murenge wa Muyumbu. Icyo gihe iyi mibiri yiyongereye ku 14 309 yari isanzwe ishyinguye muri uru rwibutso, bituma yose iba 14 319.
Ku wa 11 Mata 2026, hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro indi mibiri ine yari iherutse kuboneka. Ku wa 29 Mata 2026, "Muhazi Yacu" yatangaje ko urwibutso rwari rushyinguyemo imibiri 14 401.
Kwibuka no kubungabunga amateka.
Ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Muyumbu habera ibikorwa byo Kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kunamira abahashyinguye no gushyingura mu cyubahiro imibiri igenda iboneka.
Abayobozi b'Akarere ka Rwamagana bagaragaje ko ibikorwa byo kwibuka bifasha no kwigisha urubyiruko amateka ya Jenoside, ubumwe, kubana neza no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.
Mu 2026, Perezida wa IBUKA mu Karere ka Rwamagana, Musabyeyezu Dative, yagaragaje impungenge z'uko hakiri imibiri y'abazize Jenoside itaraboneka kubera ko hari abantu bataratanga amakuru y'aho yajugunywe. Minisitiri w'Uburinganire n'Iterambere ry'Umuryango, Uwimana Consolée, na we yasabye abafite ayo makuru kuyatanga kugira ngo imibiri itaraboneka ishobore gushyingurwa mu cyubahiro.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mutete ni urwibutso rushyingurwemo imibiri 1,095 ya abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mutete ruherereye mu murenge wa Mutete, mu Karere ka Gicumbi, mu ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Mutete ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Amateka y'urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mutete mbere y’uko ruvugururwa agaragaza ko rwari rushyinguwemo imibiri 1,049 y'abazize jenocide ya mu buryo bworoheje imibiri y’abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 biciwe mu murenge wa Mutete n’inkengero zaho. Mu gihe cya Jenoside n’imyaka ya mbere yakurikiyeho, abaharokokeye n’abaturage bashyinguye ababo mu mva rusange zitari zifite ibikorwa remezo bihagije cyangwa imiterere ijyanye n’icyubahiro gikwiye. Uru rwibutso rwabanje kuba rudafite inyubako zihagije, rutunganijwe neza cyangwa ibisobanuro birambuye ku mateka, bikagabanya ubushobozi bwo kwakira abarusura no gutanga inyigisho zihagije ku mateka ya Jenoside. Nyuma, Leta n’abafatanyabikorwa batangiye ibikorwa byo kuruvugurura no kurushyira ku rwego rushimangira icyubahiro cy’abahashyinguye no kurufasha kuba ahantu hizewe ho kwibukira no kwigira ku mateka.
Ivurugurura ryur'urwibutso.
Uru rwibutso rwa Mutete rwari rusanzwe rushyinguwemo imibiri 1,049 ariko rutaravugururwa, muri iyo 33 yavanywe mu ngo z'abantu aho yari ishyinguwe naho 13 yavanywe mu rundi rwibutso rwa Nyamiyaga aho bita mataba, ubu uru rwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri igera ku 1095.
Amateka yaranze Mutete mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ni amateka akomeye kandi ababaje, agaragaza ubwicanyi bukabije, ubuhunzi n’ingaruka zikomeye ku baturage.
Mutete ni agace kari mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda (mu Karere ka Gicumbi ubu). Jenoside itangiye muri Mata 1994, ubwicanyi bwahise butangira no muri aka gace, cyane cyane bwibasira Abatutsi.
Ibyabaye muri Mutete Abatutsi benshi bo muri Mutete barishwe mu buryo bw’agashinyaguro n’interahamwe. Hari abagerageje guhungira mu misozi no mu mashyamba, ariko benshi baricwaga bakurikiranywe. Abaturage bamwe bashatse guhungira ku mipaka ya Uganda kubera ko Mutete yegereye umupaka, ariko si bose bahageze neza. Abari abayobozi cyangwa abari bafite ububasha muri ako gace bagize uruhare mu gutegura no gushyigikira ubwicanyi.
Ubutabazi n’ihagarikwa rya Jenoside. Jenoside yaje guhagarikwa n’ingabo za Rwanda Patriotic Front, zagiye zifata uduce dutandukanye tw’igihugu harimo n’aka gace ka Mutete. Ibi byatumye ubwicanyi buhagarara, nubwo hari hashize iminsi myinshi abantu bamaze kwicwa.
Ingaruka ku baturage ba Mutete Abantu benshi bahasize ubuzima. Hari imiryango yatsembwe burundu. Abacitse ku icumu basigaye bafite ibikomere byo ku mubiri no ku mutima. Abaturage benshi bahungiye mu bihugu by’abaturanyi mbere yo kugaruka nyuma. 5. Kwibuka no kubaka ubumwe Uyu munsi, Mutete kimwe n’ahandi mu Rwanda, hibandwa ku: Kwibuka Jenoside buri mwaka mu gihe cya Kwibuka. Kwigisha amateka nyayo kugira ngo Jenoside itazongera kubaho ukundi. Kubaka ubumwe n’ubwiyunge hagati y’Abanyarwanda.

Urwibutso rwa Mibirizi ni urwibutso rusigasiye imibiri yabazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, ruherereye mu karere ka Rusizi,mu murenge wa Nyakarenzo (hafi ya paruwasi ya Mibirizi),mu Kagari ka Mibirizi.Uru rwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri yAbatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Imibiri 520 y'abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yari ishyinguye mu buryo budahwitse hafi y'ingo yashyinguwe mu rwibutso rwa Mibirizi ruri mu karere ka Rusizi tariki 30/02/2013. Urwibutso rwa Mibirizi rumaze gushyingurwamo imibiri y'irakarengane 7520.
Iyi mibiri yavuye mu mirenge ya Nyakarenzo na Rwimbogo nk'uko byatangajwe n'imiryango ifite Abatutsi babo bazize Jenoside baruhukiye mu rwibutso rwa Mibirizi. Banagaruka ku mateka n'inzira y'umusaraba abashyinguwe banyuzemo mbere yuko bicwa n'Interahamwe aho bamwe bajugunywaga mu byobo ari bazima,bakabatemagura,bakabicisha uduhiri,amacumu,n'ibindi abandi bakicwa n'inzara kugera banogotse.
Abafite ababo baruhukiye muri uru rwibutso rwa Mibirizi bavuga ko uburyo rwubatse bitajyanye n'igihe kandi ko bidahesha agaciro abaruhukiye muri urwo rwibutso.
Ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Rusizi buvuga ko kugeza ubu mu karere ka Rusizi hari inzibutso zirindwi(7) ziruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, eshatu murizo ziri ku rwego rw'Akarere bakifuza kandi ko zizagenda zivugururwa uko ubushobozi buzagenda buboneka..
filime mbarankuru ngufi ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi i mibirizi.
kanda hano wumve ubuhamya mubihangano (videwo)

Urwibusto rwa Mvuzo ni rumwe mu rwibusto rubiste imibiri yinzirakarengane zishwe mu mwaka 1994 ingana n' ibihumbi 6,709
Urwibusto rwa Mvuzo ni urwibusto ruherereye mu ntara yamajyaruguru mu karere ka Rulindo mu murenge wa murambi
Amateka yur' URwibusto rwa Mvuzo.
Urwibusto rwa Mvuzo rufite amateka akomeye cyane kubera ko jenocide yahabaye ari naho ibirindiro by'ingabo za FAR n'abayobozi bakomeye bayishyigikiraga, iyi misozi yari ituwe n'imiryango myinshi y'Abatusti, ariko abenshi barishwe ku buryo hari ni miryango burundu.
abahakomokeye bavuga ko mbere ya jenoside abantu bari babanye neza, ariko jenoside iza kubatanya cyane. Hari kandi nindirimbo " Mfura zo ku Mugote" yumuhanzi Munyanshoza dieudonnne igaragaza ayo mateka, igatera amarangamutima aba hakomoste.
jenoside murako gace yakajijwe nintera hamwe n'ubukangura mbaga bwa bayobozi MRND, ndeste n'indirimbo zibira urwango. Nyuma ya jenoside,haracyari ikibazo cyo kutabona imibiri yabishwe ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro kuko hari abantu banze kwerekana aho bayijugunye.
Nubwo bimeze bityo, abarokoste jenoside bashimira leta y'urwanda n'Inkotanyi zabarokoye, kuko zabafashije kongera kubaho neza no kwiyubaka, bagaragaza ko bababariye abahemukiye, ariko bagasaba ko bagaragaza aho imibiri y'abishwe iri.
Abayobozi basaba abaturage gukomeza gufasha abarokoste jenoside, kwirindaingenga bitekerezo yayo no kuyirwanya, cyane cyane mu rubyiruko, kugira ngo igihugu gikomeze kubakwa mu bumwe n'ubwiyunge.

Guhugura abagororwa bari kurangiza ibihano ku byaha bya Jenoside.
Minisiteri y'ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda n'Inshingano Mboneragihugu (Minubumwe) yatangaje ko kuva muri werurwe 2025 itangije gahunda yo guhugura abangororwa bari kuarangiza ibihano ku byaha bya Jenoside kugeza ubu nta n'umwe mu barekuwe wari wagaragaraye mu isubiracyaha nk'uko byagijyaga bigenda.
Ni amahugurwa yahawe abagororwa baribarangije ibihano bahise barekurwa n'ababirangije mu mwaka wa 2025 bakayahabwa kugeza ku itariki ya 18 Werurwe 2026.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi rwa Rutare ni rumwe mu nzibutso zibumbatiye amateka n’ukuri ku byabaye mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruherereye mu Murenge wa Rutare, Akarere ka Gicumbi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru. Uru rwibutso rushyinguyemo mu cyubahiro imibiri isaga 2,000 y’abazize Jenoside, rukaba ahantu ho kwibukira, kwigira amateka no gushishikariza abaturarwanda n’abashyitsi kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge. Nk’izindi nzibutso zo mu gihugu, Urwibutso rwa Rutare rufite uruhare rukomeye mu kubungabunga amateka, guha icyubahiro abishwe muri Jenoside no gukomeza guhangana n’ingaruka za Jenoside.
Urwibutso rwa Rutare ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Amateka y’Urwibutso rwa Rutare ashingiye ku byabaye mu cyahoze ari Komini Rutare muri Perefegitura ya Byumba, aho Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yatwaye ubuzima bw' Abatutsi benshi bazira uko bavutse. Muri ako gace, nk’ahandi henshi mu gihugu, Jenoside yateguwe igihe kirekire hashingiwe ku macakubiri n’urwango byabibwe n’ubutegetsi bwariho icyo gihe.Mu gihe cya Jenoside, Abatutsi benshi bo mu Murenge wa Rutare bahigwaga n’interahamwe ndetse n’abasirikare, Abatutsi bamwe bakicirwa mu ngo zabo abandi bakicirwa mu bice bari bahungiyemo bashaka ubuhungiro. Hari n’abagerageje kwihisha cyangwa guhunga, ariko benshi baricwa. Nyuma y’uko Jenoside ihagaritswe n’Ingabo za RPA-Inkotanyi, hatangiye igikorwa cyo gushakisha imibiri y’Abatutsi bishwe kugira ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro.Urwibutso rwa Rutare rwashyizweho kugira ngo ruhuze kandi rusigasire imibiri y’Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside, ndetse rukaba n’ahantu ho kwigisha amateka y’ukuri ku byabaye. Kugeza ubu, uru rwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri igera kuri 275 y’abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.Uretse kuba ari ahashyinguwe Abatutsi bishwe, uru rwibutso rukoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwibuka buri mwaka, cyane cyane mu cyumweru cy’icyunamo n’iminsi 100 yo kwibuka Jenoside, aho abaturage, abayobozi n’abashyitsi bahahurira bagasubiza amaso inyuma, bagaha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside, ndetse bagafata ingamba zo kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside no kubaka ejo hazaza harangwa n’amahoro n’ubumwe.
Bumwe mu buhamya bw'Aabatutsi barokotse Jenoside muri Rutare:.
Gutangiza icyumweru cy'icyunamo n'iminsi 100 yo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 32 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, mu karere ka Gicumbi, byabereye mu Murenge wa Rutare kuwa Kabiri tariki ya 7 Mata 2026.Mu buhamya bwa Higiro Damas warokokeye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu cyahoze ari komini Rutare muri perefegitura ya Byumba, yagarutse ku buryo higishijwe amacakubiri n'ivangura mu Banyarwanda nuko urwango rwo kwanga Abatutsi rwabibwe n'ubutegetsi imyaka myinshi kugeza ubwo habaga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.Higiro yavuze ko muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yahizwe n'interahamwe zashakaga kumwica ndetse ko bigeze no kumubika bavuga ko yapfuye mu byukuri ataribyo, anashimira Inkotanyi zarokoye Abatutsi barimo abari bahunguye ku mupadiri ukomoka muri Espagne.Yagize ati "Iyo mvura rero imbera igisubizo, nzamuka muri iyo mvura ndaza ngaruka aha ariko kubera ko bambonye manuka ntibambone nzamuka baramutse babwira ab'iwacu ko napfuye, naguye ahangaha."Kamizikunze Anastase Perezida wa IBUKA mu karere ka Gicumbi yashimiye Inkotanyi zemeye kwitanga zihagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.Yagize ati "Hari abo dushima bakoze ijoro n'amanywa aribo Nkotanyi ndetse na hano i Rutare niko byagenze, hari abasirikare bitanze, yemwe hari n'abasiviri bitanze, kugirango uyu munsi tube turiho, birumvikana hari n'abatakaje ubuzima bwabo kugirango baturokore."

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo-Ngoma ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ruherereye mu Murenge wa Kibungo, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Rushyinguwemo imibiri y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside mu Mujyi wa Kibungo no mu bice bitandukanye by'icyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo. Mu 2026, amakuru yatangajwe yagaragazaga ko urwibutso rwari rushyinguwemo imibiri isaga 25 000.
Urwibutso ni ahantu ho kunamira abazize Jenoside, gushyingura mu cyubahiro imibiri igenda iboneka no kubungabunga amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo.
Urwibutso rwa Kibungo - Ngoma ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Aho urwibutso ruherereye.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo-Ngoma ruherereye mu Murenge wa Kibungo, ari na wo urimo umujyi ukoreramo ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Urwibutso ruri ku bipimo by'isi bya 2°09′53.18″ S na 30°32′29.58″ E.
Kibungo yari icyicaro cy'icyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo. Iyo perefegitura yari igizwe n'amakomini 11 ari yo Kayonza, Rutonde, Muhazi, Rukara, Kabarondo, Kigarama, Birenga, Mugesera, Sake, Rukira na Rusumo. Ubu uturere twaho tugabanyijwemo ahanini Rwamagana, Kayonza, Ngoma na Kirehe.
Jenoside mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) bugaragaza ko Abatutsi bo mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo bahuye n'ivangura, itotezwa n'ubwicanyi mu myaka yabanjirije Jenoside yo mu 1994. Ubushakashatsi bwa CNLG bugaragaza ko mu 1994 ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri iyo perefegitura bwabaye cyane hagati ya tariki ya 7 n'iya 27 Mata.
Mu Mujyi wa Kibungo, ahantu Abatutsi benshi bahungiye harimo Economat ya Kibungo, yari imwe mu nyubako z'Diyosezi ya Kibungo, ibitaro n'ahandi batekerezaga ko bashobora kubona ubuhungiro.
Ku wa 13 Mata 1994, abicanyi bageze kuri Economat ya Kibungo bagamije gutera ubwoba Abatutsi bari bahahungiye. Ku wa 15 Mata, abasirikare n'Interahamwe bagabye ibitero kuri iyo Economat, hicwa benshi mu bari bayihungiyemo.
Amakuru y'ubuyobozi bw'Intara y'Iburasirazuba agaragaza kandi ko ku wa 15 Mata 1994 Abatutsi benshi bari bahungiye kuri Economat ya Kibungo no mu Bitaro bya Kibungo bishwe.
Ubushakashatsi bwa CNLG bugaragaza ko mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo hari imitwe yitwaraga gisirikare n'Interahamwe zari zaratojwe mbere ya Jenoside, kandi ko abayobozi benshi bo mu nzego z'ibanze bagize uruhare mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa ubwicanyi.
Ishyirwaho n'iyubakwa ry'urwibutso.
Nyuma yo guhagarika Jenoside, hatangiye ibikorwa byo gushakisha imibiri y'Abatutsi bishwe, kuyikura mu mva rusange no mu handi yari yarajugunywe, no kuyishyingura mu cyubahiro.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo rwubatswe bwa mbere mu 1997, hamwe n'izindi nzibutso zari zarashyizweho muri ako gace. Uko imyaka yagiye ishira, hagaragaye ko inyubako ya mbere itari ihagije mu kubungabunga neza imibiri yari irushyinguwemo, bituma hatangira gahunda yo kuruvugurura no kurwubaka ku buryo bugezweho.
Mu rwego rwo kubungabunga inzibutso no guhuriza hamwe imibiri yari ishyinguye mu nzibutso nto, Akarere ka Ngoma kagiye gateganya inzibutso nke z'ingenzi zo ku rwego rw'Akarere. Urwibutso rwa Kibungo rwari rumwe muri zo.
Gushyingura imibiri mu cyubahiro.
Ku wa 15 Mata 2017, imibiri y'Abatutsi basaga 7 000 bishwe muri Jenoside, yari yarakuwe mu bice bitandukanye by'Akarere ka Ngoma, yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo.
Mu 2024, ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Ngoma bwatangaje ko urwibutso rwari rushyinguwemo imibiri y'Abatutsi basaga 25 000 bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ku wa 15 Mata 2025, mu gihe cyo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 31 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro indi mibiri umunani y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside. Iyo mibiri yari yarabonetse mu Mirenge ya Remera na Kibungo.
Mu 2026, mu gihe cyo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 32, amakuru yatangajwe yongeye kugaragaza ko imibiri y'Abatutsi basaga 25 000 yari iruhukiye mu Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo-Ngoma.
Kwibuka no kubungabunga amateka.
Ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo-Ngoma habera ibikorwa byo Kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu Karere ka Ngoma, uru rwibutso ni hamwe mu hantu h'ingenzi habera imihango yo gutangiza no gukomeza ibikorwa byo kwibuka ku rwego rw'Akarere.
Muri ibyo bikorwa, abarokotse Jenoside batanga ubuhamya, abayobozi n'abaturage bakunamira abahashyinguye kandi bagashyira indabo ku mva. Ibikorwa byo kwibuka bikoreshwa kandi mu kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside, gushishikariza urubyiruko kuyamenya no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.
Ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Ngoma n'Intara y'Iburasirazuba bwagiye busaba abaturage bafite amakuru y'aho hakiri imibiri y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside kuyatanga kugira ngo iyo mibiri iboneke kandi ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro.
Mu 2026, abayobozi bongeye gushimangira ko kubungabunga amateka y'ibyabereye i Kibungo ari uburyo bwo gufasha abarokotse n'abazavuka kumenya amateka no kurwanya ihakana n'ipfobya rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House: ni amahoteli y' ubukerarugendo aherereye mu karere ka musanze,mu murenge wa kinigi,kumbibi z'ibirunga.
iyi hoteli ifatwa nkiyi icyiciro cyo hejuru cyane bimenyerewe nka hoteli y' inyenyeri 5 (5-star hotel).ikaba ifite ibyumba 13 bose hamwe.uyu mushinga wa amahoheli watangijwe ni umuyobozi mukuru luke bailes.singita kwitonda lodge and kataza house yafunguwe kumugaragaro tariki 1 kanama 2019 na perezida wa repubulika

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rwamagana ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri mu Murenge wa Kigabiro, mu Akarere ka Rwamagana, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo abazize Jenoside. Ni ahantu ho kwibuka no kunamira abazize Jenoside. Akarere ka Rwamagana gafite izindi nzibutso nyinshi za Jenoside.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Kigabiro, mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Ako karere kari mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Urwibutso rwa Rwamagana ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu. Inzibutso za Jenoside zikoreshwa mu gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka.
Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO. Izo nzibutso ni Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Rwamagana rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwabereye mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo. Ruri mu nzibutso zashyizweho nyuma ya 1994 mu Karere ka Rwamagana.
Mu 2022, "KT Press" yavuze ko Akarere ka Rwamagana gafite inzibutso 11. Izo nzibutso zishyinguyemo nibura abazize Jenoside 83 729. Mu 2023, "The New Times" yatanze umubare wa 83 851.
Mu Karere ka Rwamagana, ubwicanyi buzwi cyane ni ubwabereye i Mwulire. Abatutsi benshi bahungiye ku musozi wa Mwulire. Birwanyeho hafi ibyumweru bibiri. Nyuma, Interahamwe zifashijwe n'abayobozi n'ingabo za Leta zarabishe. Nibura abantu 15 000 biciwe ku musozi wa Mwulire.
Imibiri y'abazize Jenoside iracyashyingurwa mu cyubahiro. Urugero, muri Mata 2024, imibiri 128 yashyinguwe mu rwibutso rwa Mwulire.
Mu 2023, ubuyobozi bw'akarere bwavuze ko inzibutso 11 zizahurizwa hamwe. Zizasigara ari inzibutso 6. Iteka ryo mu 2019 rigena uko inzibutso za Jenoside zihurizwa hamwe.
Buri mwaka, imihango yo "Kwibuka" ibera mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Urugero, mu 2019 imihango yabereye ku rwibutso rwa Mwulire. Mu 2023, imihango yo kwibuka abana bishwe muri Jenoside yabereye i Sovu, mu Murenge wa Kigabiro.
Itegeko ryo mu 2016 rigena imihango yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Iryo tegeko rigena kandi imicungire y'inzibutso za Jenoside.

"INGARUKA ZA JENOCIDE YAKOREWE ABATUTSI MU RWANDA"
Jenoside ni igikorwa kibi cyane aho itsinda ry’abantu (nk’ubwoko, idini, igihugu cyangwa itsinda runaka) rigerageza kurimburwa burundu cyangwa igice kinini cyaryo. Ibi bikorwa ku bushake, kandi bishobora gukorwa mu buryo butandukanye nko:
Jenocide yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 (Genocide against the Tutsi) ni kimwe mu bihe bikomeye cyane byaranze amateka y’u Rwanda. Yabaye mu gihe gito cyane cy’amezi atatu, ariko yangiza bikomeye ubuzima bw’abantu, ubukungu bw’igihugu, ndetse n’imibanire y’Abanyarwanda. Ingaruka zayo zabaye ndende kandi zikomeye, zigaragara kugeza n’uyu munsi mu nzego zitandukanye z’ubuzima bw’igihugu.
Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ni kimwe mu bihe bikomeye cyane byaranze amateka y’u Rwanda. Yabaye mu gihe gito cyane cy’amezi atatu, ariko yangiza bikomeye ubuzima bw’abantu, ubukungu bw’igihugu, ndetse n’imibanire y’Abanyarwanda. Ingaruka zayo zabaye ndende kandi zikomeye, zigaragara kugeza n’uyu munsi mu nzego zitandukanye z’ubuzima bw’igihugu.
Mbere na mbere, Jenoside yasize igihombo gikomeye cy’abantu. Abantu barenga miliyoni imwe barishwe, bituma imiryango myinshi isenyuka burundu. Abana benshi basigaye ari imfubyi, abandi babaho mu miryango iyobowe n’abana (child-headed families), mu gihe abapfakazi benshi basigaye mu buzima bugoye cyane. Iki gihombo cyagize ingaruka zikomeye ku mibare y’abaturage no ku bushobozi bw’igihugu bwo kongera kwiyubaka.
Ikindi kandi, Jenoside yasize ihungabana rikomeye ryo mu mutwe ku bayirokotse. Abacitse ku icumu benshi bagize ibibazo bikomeye byo mu mutwe nko kwiheba, guhora bibuka ibihe bibi banyuzemo, ndetse n’ubwoba bukabije. Ibi byatumye benshi batabasha gukomeza ubuzima busanzwe, kandi byagize ingaruka ku mikurire y’abana bakuriye muri ayo mateka. Ihungabana si ikibazo cy’igihe gito gusa, ahubwo ni ikibazo gikomeza kugaragara mu mibereho y’abantu no mu muryango nyarwanda.
Ku ruhande rw’ubukungu, Jenoside yasenye bikomeye ibikorwa by’iterambere. Ubuhinzi, ubucuruzi n’inganda byarahungabanye kubera kubura abakozi n’abakiriya. Ibikorwaremezo byinshi nk’amashuri, imihanda n’ibitaro byarasenywe. Byongeye kandi, abakozi benshi b’abahanga n’abafite ubumenyi barishwe cyangwa bahunga igihugu, bituma habaho icyuho gikomeye mu bumenyi (brain drain). Ibi byose byatumye u Rwanda rusubira inyuma cyane mu iterambere, bisaba igihe kinini n’imbaraga nyinshi kugira ngo rwongere kwiyubaka.
Jenoside yanagize ingaruka zikomeye ku mibanire y’abantu. Icyizere hagati y’Abanyarwanda cyarasenyutse, urwango n’amacakubiri biriyongera. Kubana hagati y’abacitse ku icumu n’abakoze ibyaha cyangwa imiryango yabo byabaye ikibazo gikomeye. Gusa nyuma y’igihe, igihugu cyashyizeho gahunda zitandukanye zigamije kugarura ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, harimo n’izashyigikiwe na National Unity and Reconciliation Commission, zafashije Abanyarwanda kongera kubana mu mahoro.
Nanone kandi, Jenoside yateje ikibazo gikomeye cy’impunzi. Abantu benshi bahunze igihugu bajya mu bihugu bituranye nka Democratic Republic of the Congo, Tanzania na Uganda, mu gihe abandi babaye abimuwe mu byabo imbere mu gihugu. Ubuzima mu nkambi z’impunzi bwari bugoye cyane, burimo ubukene, inzara n’indwara, bikomeza kongera ubukana bw’ingaruka za Jenoside.
By’umwihariko, abagore n’abana bahuye n’ihohoterwa rikomeye. Abagore benshi bafashwe ku ngufu, bamwe banduzwa indwara nka VIH/SIDA. Abana benshi bahohotewe cyangwa bagizwe impfubyi, abandi bavukira muri ayo mahano, bakura bafite ibibazo by’imibereho n’irondabwoko. Ibi byasize ibikomere bikomeye ku buzima bw’aba baturage.
Mu rwego rwo kugarura ubutabera, hashyizweho uburyo butandukanye bwo gukurikirana abakoze Jenoside. Inkiko gakondo za Gacaca zafashije kuburanisha ibihumbi by’abakekwagaho ibyaha, mu gihe urwego mpuzamahanga nka International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda rwakurikiranye abari abayobozi n’abateguye Jenoside. Ibi byagize uruhare mu kugarura ubutabera no kongera icyizere mu baturage.
Nubwo Jenoside yasize ibikomere bikomeye, u Rwanda rwafashe inzira yo kwiyubaka bushya. Hashyizweho gahunda zo kwibuka Jenoside buri mwaka, hubakwa inzibutso, ndetse hashyirwa imbaraga mu kwigisha amateka kugira ngo Jenoside itazongera kubaho ukundi. Igihugu cyashyize imbere ubumwe, amahoro n’iterambere, bituma kiba urugero rwiza ku bindi bihugu.
Mu gusoza, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yasize ingaruka zikomeye kandi z’igihe kirekire ku Rwanda. Nubwo byari ibihe bikomeye cyane, u Rwanda rwerekanye ko bishoboka kongera kubaka igihugu no kugarura ubumwe bw’abaturage. Iyi Jenoside itwigisha akamaro ko kurwanya ivangura, kubaha ubuzima bw’umuntu, no kubaka amahoro arambye.

Itegurwa rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ryatangiye kera binyuze mu kubiba amacakubiri n’ivangura rishingiye ku moko. Guhera mu gihe cy’abakoroni no mu Repubulika ya mbere n'iya kabiri, Abatutsi batangiye kugaragazwa nk’abanyamahanga n’abanzi b’igihugu. Hashyizweho indangamuntu zanditsemo amoko kugira ngo bitwaze uburyo bwo kubatoteza, kubambura uburenganzira bwabo, no kubameneshea mu nzego z’uburezi n’umurimo, ibyo byose bikaba byari urufatiro rwo kumvisha abaturage ko Umututsi atari umunyarwanda nk'abandi.
Mu ntangiriro z’imyaka ya 1990, itegurwa ryahinduye isura rishyirwa mu bikorwa binyuze mu ikubitiro ry’itangazamakuru ry’urwango n’icengezamatwara mubisha. Hashyizweho radio RTLM n’ikinyamakuru Kangura byakwirakwizaga amagambo n’inyandiko bisebya Abatutsi, babita "Inyenzi" n’ibindi bikoresho by’itoteza. Inyandiko nka "Amategeko icumi y'Abahutu" yagize uruhare rukomeye mu gushishikariza abaturage kwanga no guha akato Abatutsi, bituma igice kimwe cy'abaturage cyumva ko kwica undi ari inshingano yo kurinda igihugu.
Hagati aho, ubutegetsi bwariho bwatangiye gushinga no gutoza gisirikare imitwe y’urubyiruko rw’Inkeragutabara ruzwi nka Interahamwe n’Impuzamugambi. Urwo rubyiruko rwahabwaga imyitozo yo kwica no gukoresha intwaro mu gihugu hose, ndetse runahabwa intwaro gakondo n’imbunda. Muri icyo gihe, inzego z’ubuyobozi bwite bwa Leta zakoze amalisiti y’Abatutsi n’abahutu batavugaga rumwe n’ubutegetsi kugira ngo bazahite bicwa umunsi umushinga nyirizina watangiye.
Mbere y’uko Jenoside nyirizina itangira muri Mata 1994, habayeho amagerageza y'ubwicanyi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu nka Kibirira, Bugesera, na Mutara. Ibi bikorwa byari bigamije kureba uko abaturage bitwara mu bwicanyi no gusuzuma niba amahanga azagira icyo akora. Kubera ko amahanga yacecetse kuri ayo magerageza, abateguraga Jenoside bahawe intege zo gukomeza umushinga wabo, kugeza igihe ihanurwa ry'indege ya Habyarimana ryakoreshejwe nk'imbarutso yo gutangiza itsembatsembanyi ryari ryarateguwe mu buryo bwose: mu mitekerereze, mu nzego z’ubuyobozi, no mu bikoresho.

Umugenzo wo Gutsirika.
Gutsirika ni umugenzo gakondo ukorwaga mu muco nyabanyarwanda hagamijwe gukumira, gukingira cyangwa kurinda abantu ndetse nibintu kugirango hatagira ikibi kigera kubantu cyangwa ibintu.
Umugenzo wo gutsirika wakorwaga n'abakurambere gusa no mur'iyinsi hari abakibikora nkumuco. Dore uburyo butandukanye gutsirika byakorwagamo ni ubu:
Gukingira ikibi (Ubwirinzi):.
Ni umugenzo abakurambere bakoraga bafunze inzira z'ikibi(nk'uburozi, imbaraga mbi cyangwa umuvumo) kugirango zitagera kumuntu, kunyamanswa cyangwa se ku matungo.
Gukingira umuhoro/ubutaka:.
Ni ugufunga ikibanza cyangwa imyaka kugira ngo ntihagire inyamanswa cyangwa umuntu ubyangiza, binyuze mu mihango y'ubupfumu gakondo.
Gukumira ibyonnyi by'imyaka:.
Mu muco n'imigenzo gakondo yab'abanyarwanda hari ubwo gutsirika byakoreshwaga mubahinzi bakumira ibyonnyi bishobora kwangiza umusaruro wimyaka bahinze nk'amasaka, amashaza,ibitoki, ubunyobwa nibindi bitandukanye.

Ni umugenzo gakondo wakorwaga nabanyarwa bo hambere mbere yuko abakoroni baza, kuganagahura byabagaho igihe inkuba yabagakubise abantu cyangwa ahantu kugirango hakumirwe kuba yakongera gukubita aho hantu.
bivugwako iyo inkuba yakubitaga ahantu habaga hari ubwandu ubwo bwandu bukavanwaho nuko bakoraga ikigikorwa cyo kugangahura kuko cyaraziraga kuba inkuba yakubita umuntu, itungo cyangwa igiti ngo babe harigikorwa kindi bakora kuri uwo muntu cyangwa icyo kintu batarakigangahura.
kugangahura byakorwaga hifashishijwe urubingo,amazi y'ubuhoro, kamaramahano,umunyu n'ibindi bitandukanye.
Ese iyo inkuba yakubitaga ahantu cyangwa umuntu byagendaga gute?
Bafataga ayo mazi avanze n'imiti itandukanye bakayatera hahantu inkuba yakubise Noneho bijyanye n'indagu babaga bereje, bagahumanura aho hantu ibyo bigakorwa kugirango hatazagira uwo byongera kubaho aho hantu cyangwa se umuzimu w'abo bantu akaba yatera abasigaye.
kandi ntibyari byemewe gukora kumuntu wakubiswe n'inkuba umugangahuzi atarahagera ngo bamugangahure

Ni ubwicanyi bwateguwe kandi bugakorwa bugamije kurimbura itsinda ry’abantu binzirakarengane hashingiwe ku bwoko bwabo, akarere bakomokamo, ibara ryuruhu nibindi baba batarahisemo bo ubwabo.Urugero rukomeye ni Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yabaye hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994 ya tangiye ku wa 7 mata, aho Abatutsi barenga miliyoni bishwe bazira uko bavutse.
Mu rwego rwo gusigasira ayo mateka asharira igihugu cyanyuzemo hari zimwe mu nzibutso za jenocide yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda Zubatswe twavugamo:

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mvuzo ruherereye mu Karere ka Rulindo mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Rwibukirwaho Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, cyane cyane abiciwe ku misozi ya Mvuzo na Mugote. Muri uru rwibutso hashyinguwe imibiri isaga 6,700, rukaba ruri mu nzibutso z'ingenzi ho kwibukira amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 muri ako gace.
Urwibutso rwa Mvuzo ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Mvuzo ruherereye mu Murenge wa Murambi, mu Karere ka Rulindo. Umusozi wa Mvuzo uteganye n’uwa Mugote uherereye mu Murenge wa Ngoma, iyo misozi yombi igakikizwa n’imirenge ya Cyinzuzi, Burega, Masoro na Ntarabana, ahahoze ari Komini Buriza. Aka gace kazwi kandi nka Remera y’Abaforongo, gafite amateka y'u Rwanda ya kera ajyanye n’Igikomangoma Mibambwe I Sekarongoro I Mutabazi uzwi nka Forongo.
Amateka ya Jenoside.
Mbere ya Jenoside, Mvuzo na Mugote byari bituwe n’Abatutsi benshi babanaga n’abandi baturage mu mahoro. Icyakora, mu gihe cya Jenoside, ako gace kabaye hamwe mu habaye ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu buryo bukomeye bitewe n’imiterere yaho igoye guhunga no kwihisha, ndetse no kuba hari ibirindiro bikomeye by’ingabo za FAR zari zifite intwaro zikomeye. Jenoside yaho yahawe ingufu n’abayobozi bakomeye b’icyo gihe bakomokaga muri ako gace, barimo abanyapolitiki ba.
Interahamwe zakoraga Jenoside zari zarahuguriwe i Gako, zikora ubwicanyi bukomeye zica Abatutsi ziyobowe n’abari bazwi cyane muri ako gace. By’umwihariko, ubukangurambaga bwakozwe n’abayobozi nka Mathieu Ngirumpatse bwafashije gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside, bufashwa n’indirimbo z’urwango zakwirakwizwaga muri icyo gihe.
Jenoside yabereye muri ako gace yatumye imiryango myinshi y’Abatutsi izima burundu; bivugwa ko hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’imiryango yaho cyarimbuwe ku buryo nta warokotse wo gusigara atanga ubuhamya. Jenoside muri aka gace yarangiye itinze ugereranije n’ahandi mu gihugu, kuko ingabo za FAR zari zigihanganye n’Inkotanyi kugeza ku itariki ya 5 Nyakanga 1994.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, hubatswe urwibutso rwa Mvuzo rushyingurwamo imibiri y’abazize Jenoside, nubwo kugeza n’ubu hari imibiri igishakishwa kugira ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro. Uru rwibutso rukoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwibuka no kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside, ndetse rukaba ikimenyetso cy’ingaruka Jenoside yasize muri aka gace.

Umurenge wa Musange ni umwe mu mirenge 17 igize Akarere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Musange wari utuwe n'abaturage 20 345. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro. Umuryango GiveDirectly watangije umushinga wo guha amafaranga ingo zo muri uyu murenge.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Musange ni umwe mu mirenge 17 y'Akarere ka Nyamagabe.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Musange wari utuwe n'abaturage 18 680. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 20 345. Abagabo bari 9 885. Abagore bari 10 460.
Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Umuhanda uhuza Umurenge wa Musange n'umujyi wa Nyamagabe ufite uburebure bwa kilometero 30. Mu Ukwakira 2012, Kigali Today yatangaje ko uwo muhanda ugiye gukorwa.
Imishinga y’iterambere.
Umuryango GiveDirectly watangije umushinga mu Murenge wa Musange. Uwo mushinga wari guha ingo zo muri uyu murenge amafaranga arenga 800 000. Ayo mafaranga yari gutangwa mu byiciro bibiri. Abakozi ba GiveDirectly ni bo bari gusura ingo. Abaturage basabwe kwirinda abantu babaka ruswa. Iyi nkunga ifasha imiryango kugura amatungo no kuvugurura amazu.

Kuri iyo taliki nibwo Interahamwe n'umutwe w'abasirikare barindaga Perezida Habyarimana Juvenal batangiye gushyiraho amabariyeri mu duce twinshi tw'Umujyi wa Kigali no kwica Abatutsi.
Uwari Minisitiri w'intebe, Uwilingiyimana Agathe n'abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi bo mu ngabo z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye bari bashinzwe umutekano we, bishwe babanje gukorerwa iycarubozo n'abasirikare ba Leta y'u Rwanda.
Mu mugambi wo kwica abanyepolitiki batavugaga rumwe na Leta ya Habyarimana ndetse batari bashyigikiye umugambi wa Jenoside, Perezida w'Urukiko rushinzwe kurinda Itegeko Nshinga, Kavamahanga Joseph,ba Minisitiri Frederick Nzamurambaho wari na Perezida wa PSD,Felicien Ngango, wari Visi Perezida wa PSD, Faustin Rucogoza na Landouald Ndasingwa bishwe ku ikubitiro n'Abasirikare barindaga Habyarimana.
Kuri uyu munsi kandi ni nabwo Major Ntabakuze Aloys, wayoboraga umutwe w'aba Para-commando yategetse abasirikare yayoboraga gutangira kwica abafite indangamuntu z'Aabatutsi n'abataravugaga rumwe n'ubutegetsi batuye hafi y'ikigo cya gisirikare, ahitwa mu kajagari i Kanombe.
Kuko uwo munsi taliki 7 Mata,abasirikare bafatanije n'interahamwe bishe Abatutsi basaga 500, kuri iyi taliki kandi Abatutsi bagera kuri 17 biganjemo abapadiri,abaseminari n'ababikira barishwe.
Mu bishwe harimo Padiri w'Umuyezuwiti Chrysologue Mahame wari ufite imyaka 67, wayoboraga Centre Christus i Remera akaba yari mu bashinze Umuryango uharanira Uburenganzira bwa Muntu no Kwimakaza Amahoro. Abo bosebishwe n'abasirikare barindaga Umukuru w'Igihugu bafatanije n'interahamwe.
Interahamwe n'Abasirikare barindaga umukuru w'Igihugu bari bafite umugambi wo kujya kwica Abatutsi bari muri Sitade Amahoro hafatwaga nk'ahantu harinzwe kubera ko hari hakambitse Ingabo z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye MINUAR.
Uwo mugambi kuburizwamo n'imirwano hagati y'ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi n'abasirikare barindaga umukuru w'Igihugu bituma abenshi mu Batutsi bari muri Sitade Amahoro barokoka.
Kuri iyi taliki kandi Radiyo Muhabura ya FPR Inkotanyi ni yo yabaye iya mbere mu kwamagana iyicwa ry'Abatutsi n'Abanyapolitiki b'Abahutu batari bashyigikiye Jenoside.Umugaba Mukuru w'Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi yatangaje ko bafite inshingano zikomeye zo kurinda abaturage b'inzirakarengane b'Abatutsi bicwaga.
Ubwo Radiyo Rwanda RTLM yacishagaho itangazo ryashizweho umukono na Col.Bagosora mu izina rya Minisitiri w'Ingabo ryemezaga urupfu rw'umukuru w'Igihugu Perezida Habyarimana Juvenal, muri ako kanya ku Kacyiru Interahamwe zahise zishinga za bariyeri zitangira kwica Abatutsi.Ubwicanyi bwakwiriye hirya no hino mu Rwanda, Aabatutsi babarirwa mu bihumbi baricwa.
Ubwicanyi bwabaga buyobowe na ba Burugumesitiri n'abandi bayobozi bo mu nzego z'ibanze.Kuri Komini Giciye, hiciwe Abatutsi benshi barimo n'umugore wa Bazivamo Christophe.Muyahoze ari komini Runda yegeranye na Kigali, ubu ni mu Karere ka Kamonyi, ubwicanyi bwatangiye ku italiki ya 7 Mata 1994.
Abatutsi biciwe mu duce dutandukanye twa Komini Runda nka Biharabuge, kuri Nyabarongo ahitwa mu Rubamba, ku Isenga, kuri Ruliba, mu Gasharara, ku Idongo, kuri Sitasiyo i Runda, kuri bariyeri ya Bishenyi hari n'abajugunywe mu cyuzi cya Cyabariza.Abatutsi biciwe kuri Cocobeka n'ahitwa Intwari kuri Nyabarongo mu yahoze ari Komini Kayenzi.
Muri Komini Gisuma, Perefegitura ya Cyangugu, abajandarume batangiye kwica Abatutsi. Abatutsi biciwe ahitwa Ruramba, ubu niho mu karere ka Nyaruguru.Muri Muko, Perefegitura ya Gikongoro, abicanyi bagera ku ijana, bayobowe n'umukuru wa Polisi ya komini afatanije na Burugumesitiri Kayihura, bishe Abatutsi bagera kuri 14 bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi ya Mushubi.
Intagondwa y'umu CDR akaba na Burugumesitiri wa Komini Bicumbi,Rugambarara Juvenal yateguye umugambi wo kwica Abatutsi muri Komini Bicumbi. Uyu Rugambarara yemereye urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda ko we ubwe yishe Abatutsi bagera ku 100. Kwica Abatutsi byakomereje i Nyamata muri Bugesera na Sake muri Perefegitura ya Kibungo.
Abatutsi barenga 800 biganjemo abana n'abagore bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Nyundo, muri Gisenyi, barishwe.Ubwicanyi mu yahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gisenyi bwateguwe kandi buyoborwa n'uwari umuyobozi w'Ingabo muri ako gace Col. Nsengiyumva Anatole.
Ku mugoroba wa taliki ya 7 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bagera kuri 50 biciwe mu iseminari Ntoya ya Nyundo, abageraku 150 bicirwa muri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Bisasamana.Ahitwa Kabasheja mu Murenge wa Rugerero, hiciwe Abatutsi bari bakuwe n'interahamwe kuri Komini Rubavu, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu.
Abatutsi biciwe muri Centre St Pierre, mu Nzu y'abakobwa ba Musenyeri, mu yahoze ari Rwandex ya Gisenyi,ku kiliziya Stella Maris no kuri Komini Rouge, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Uwari Burugumesitiri wa Komine Mukingo, muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, Kajerijeri Juvenal yatwaye abapolisi n'interahamwe bajya kwica Abatutsi bagera kuri 43 bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi ya Busogo.
Habaye inama yo gutangiza Jenoside, ibera kwa Nzirorera Joseph, wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa MRND, yitabirwa na Col.Ephrem Setako, Harerimana (wari Burugumesitiri wa Komini Nkuli muri icyo gihe, Col Augustin Bizimungu, Casimir Bizimungu, Jean Baptiste Nyabusore, Esdras Baheza, Jonathan Bambonye, Jean Damascene Niyoyita, Dominique Gatsimbanyi, Assiel Ndisetse na Lazare Ndangiza.
Interahamwe zagumye hanze zitegereje ikiva mu nama, iyo nama yafashe icyemezo ko Abatutsi bicwa bitarenze mu gitondo.Hemejwe kandi ko hatangwa imbunda no gushyiraho bariyeri; Coloneli Bizimungu ashingwa gushyira mu bikorwa icyo cyemezo; atanga imbunda aziha abari ba konseye na bo baziha abaturage n'abakuru b'interahamwe barimo Burugumesitiri Kajerijeri na Baheza Esdras.
Kuri iyo taliki 7 Mata, mu masaha y'isacyenda Abatutsi bose bari bamaze kwicwa, imitungo yabo yasahuwe n'inzu zatwitswe ku buryo iminsi yakurikiyeho interahamwe n'amahindure(laves) bajyaga gutanga umusada ahandi; ni muri urwo rwego zagiye kwica Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku Rukiko rw'Ubujurire mu Mmujyi wa Ruhengeri, Nyabihu, Musumba(Nkuri) na Nyakinama.
Icyo gihe urugamba rw'Ingabo zaRPF Inkotanyi rwararakomeje bafata uduce tw'u Mutara, utwa Ruhengeri na Byumba ari nako barokora Abatutsi bicwaga n'interahamwe n'abasirikare ba Leta ya Habyarimana. Icyo gihe Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zarokoye Abatutsi muri za Komini nka Buyoga, Mugambazi,Rutongo, Giti, Bwisige na Rutare.
Ku mugoroba wo ku italiki ya 7 Mata 1994,ni bwo abasirikare 200 b'Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi basohotse muri CND, bagerageza kurokora Abatutsi bari batuye mu duce dukikije CND(ubu ni inyubako ikoreramo Inteko Ishinga Amategeko).Muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro, kuri iyi taliki, Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi Mushubi ubu habarizwa mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, barishwe bose.
Kuva ku italiki 7 kugeza ku ya 12 Mata 1994, Abatutsi biciwe mu Murenge wa Muko, muri Centre ya Kigoma ahitwa Ngangi n'ahitwa Mayora, mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Hishwe Abatutsi mu Bugarama muri Perefegitura ya Cyangungu, ubu ni mu Karere Rusizi, babakuraga mu ngo zabo bagahita babica bakabaroha mu Migezi ya Rusizi, Ruhwa na Rubyiro. Hishwe kandi Abatutsi i Gikundamvura(Hinduka)muri Rusizi.
Hishwe Abatutsi muri Centre ya Kivuruga,hishwe Abatutsi ku biro bya Komine Musasa no mu nkengero zayo, hishwe abatutsi i Muhondo(Gakenke), Hishwe Abatutsi ku yahoze ari komini Tare, hishwe Abatutsi ku bitaro bya Nemba no muri Centre ya Gakenke, hishwe Abatutsi b'i Kananira muri Nkungu (Cyangugu), Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Rusengero rw'Abadive rwa Hesha mu Murenge wa Mukamira bari bavanwe muri Segiteri Nanga muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, barishwe ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu, Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Rusengero rw'Abadive rwa Gisizi mu Murenge wa Muringa, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu, barishwe.
Hishwe Abatutsi Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu kigo cya Gisirikare cya Mukamira muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu, hishwe kandi Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Kiliziya ya Rambura mu Murenge wa Rambura, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu, hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu kigo cya Gisirikare cya Bigogwe muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu, hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Segiteri Byahi muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu.

Bamwe mu bahinzi bo mu Karere ka Nyagatare bafite impungenge z'umusaruro bazabona mu gihembwe cy'ihingacya 2025 B,nyuma y'aho imvura itinze kugwa.
Ibi babigarutseho ku wa 20 werurwe 2025 ubwo hatangizwaga igihembwe cy'ihinga cya 2025 B e mu Murenge wa Rukoimo ahatewe imbuto y'ibishyimbo yitwa RWR3194.
