Bamwe mubantu bazi ibijyanye ni byurukundo bakangurira abakunda ko batagomba kubeshyanya cyangwa kugira nakimwe bakingana.gusa ariko nanone haribimwe bigararagako dukwiye kubahisha. harimo:
Umubare w'abo mwakoranye iminonano mpuzabitsina
harimo bamwe babibwira abakunzi babo kugirango bizerane maze bakababwira imibare yabo babikoranye gusa kubushakashatsi bwakozwe bwagaragajeko atari byiza kuko harigihe wamukomeretsa muburyo utazi.
Abantu uba wumva ufitiye urukundo
Impamvu nuko umuntu mukundana urukundo rwanyu rufite intego biba bivuzeko ntawundi muntu wemerewe kujya murukundo nawe.
Kumubwira aabandi banu bakubwirako bagukunda
bamwe muba mumva mwabivuga kandi nanikibi mugamije gusa iyo ubwiye umukunzi wawe umukobwa cyangwa umuhungu urikukubwirako arikugukunda sibyiza pe kuko uwo mukundana asobora kubyakira uko utabimubwiye akumvako ushaka kumuca inyuma cyangwase kumwanga.

Muri Mata 2026, hagaragaye icyorezo cya hantavirusi cyatewe na virusi ya Andes mu bwato bw’Abaholandi bwa MV "Hondius". Ku ya 1 Mata 2026, ubwato bwavuye muri Ushuaia, muri Arijantine. Umugenzi wari muri ubwo bwato yapfuye azize iyo virusi ku ya 11 Mata. Umurambo we wakuwe mu bwato i Saint Helena ku ya 24 Mata, aho umugore we yavuye mbere y’uko apfira mu bitaro i Johannesburg nyuma y’iminsi ibiri. Umugenzi wa gatatu yapfiriye muri ubwo bwato.
Umugenzi w’Umwongereza yoherejwe kuvurirwa i Johannesburg, mu buzima bugoye ariko buhamye. Nubwo ubwato bwamaze iminsi itatu buhagaze i Praia, muri Kapu Veri, nta muntu wabuvuyemo kuko ibigo byo muri ako gace bitashoboye kwimurwa mu buryo bwizewe. Nyuma y’uko Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ya Esipanye yemeje ko ubwato bugera mu birwa bya Canary, bwahagurutse yerekeza i Tenerife ku ya 6 Gicurasi, aho abagenzi bagomba kwimurwa mu bihugu byabo.

MV "Hondius" ni ubwato bw’Abaholandi butwara abantu mu ngendo bufitwe na Oceanwide Expeditions. Bwakozwe na Brodosplit i Split, muri Korowatiya, bwatangiye gukoreshwa mu 2019 kandi bukorera cyane cyane mu turere twa Antarigitika.

Orthohantavirus ni ubwoko bwa virusi zirimo hantavirusi zose (umuryango wa "Hantaviridae") zitera indwara mu bantu. Hantavirusi zisanzwe ziboneka cyane cyane mu mbeba. Ubwandu bwitwa ubwandu bwa hantavirusi.

Education Perfect (EP; Ikinyarwanda: "Uburezi Butunganye") ni ikigo cy’ikoranabuhanga mu burezi gikorera muri Nuveli Zelande gitanga urubuga rwo kwigira kuri interineti rugenewe gufasha abanyeshuri n’abarimu mu masomo atandukanye. Uru rubuga rutanga amasomo ahuza, isuzumabumenyi, n’ibikoresho byo gusesengura kugira ngo byorohereze imyigire yihariye no gukurikirana iterambere ry’abanyeshuri.

Ikibazo cy’umutekano wa Canvas ni ikibazo gikomeje kugaragara ku mutekano w’ikoranabuhanga, guhagarara no kwangiza amakuru ku birebana na Canvas LMS, sisitemu yo gucunga imyigire ikorwa n’ikigo cyigenga Instructure. Mu ntangiriro za Gicurasi 2026, Instructure yatangaje ko irimo gukora iperereza ku kibazo cy’umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga kijyanye n’amakuru amwe n’amwe y’abakoresha, harimo amazina, aderesi za imeri, nimero z’indangamuntu z’abanyeshuri, n’ubutumwa mu bakoresha. Isosiyete yavuze ko nta bimenyetso yabonye bigaragaza ko ijambo ry’ibanga, amatariki y’amavuko, indangamuntu za leta, cyangwa amakuru y’imari byagize uruhare muri ubu bujura.
Nubwo Instructure yavugaga ko ikibazo cyakemutse, ku ya 7 Gicurasi, Canvas yongeye kwibasirwa; urupapuro rwayo rwo kwinjira rwasimbuwe n'ubutumwa bwa ransomware bwa ShinyHunters, itsinda ry'abagizi ba nabi ryatangaje ko ariryo ryabigizemo uruhare. ShinyHunters yateye ubwoba ko izasohora amakuru y'ibanga ya Canvas keretse iyo incungu yayo yishyuwe bitarenze impera z'itariki ya 12 Gicurasi. Ariko, kugeza ku itariki ya 8 Gicurasi, Instructure yatangaje ku rubuga rwabo nta kibazo na kimwe cyabayeho gifitanye isano n'urukozasoni rwo ku ya 7-8 Gicurasi, kandi ivuga ko abakoresha benshi bongeye kubona urubuga rwabo.

Ngayaboshya samuel ni umunyarwanda, wavukiye mu karere ka nyamagabe umurenge wa gatare
akaba afite impamyabumenyi y'ikiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza yakuye muri unuversity of Rwanda ishami rya huye mubirebana n'ubukungu(international economics)
akaba yaravutse kuwa 28 werurwe 1996, arubatse afite umugore umwe.

BTN TV Rwanda ni imwe muri televiziyo yigenga ikorera mu Rwanda, ifite icyicaro gikuru i Kigali mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2012, yandikwa mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko mu 2013, BTN TV Rwanda igamije guteza imbere itangazamakuru rigezweho, imyidagaduro n’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda.
BTN TV izwi kandi nka “Big Television Network”, ikaba ifite imiyoboro irimo BTN TV na B+ TV. Iyi televiziyo itangaza ibiganiro byinshi mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda birimo amakuru, siporo, ikoranabuhanga, umuco, ubuzima ndetse n’imyidagaduro.
BTN TV yagiye ikora ibikorwa byinshi bifasha urubyiruko n’abahanzi nyarwanda, harimo amarushanwa y’imbyino, ibiganiro by’imyidagaduro ndetse no guha umwanya impano nshya. Yanabaye imwe muri televiziyo zikoresha cyane uburyo bwa Live Streaming mu gutambutsa amakuru n’ibiganiro mu Rwanda.
Iyi televiziyo iboneka kuri StarTimes, Canal+ ndetse no kuri internet binyuze ku rubuga rwayo rwa official. BTN TV ikomeje kuba umwe mu miyoboro ikurikirwa cyane mu Rwanda mu bijyanye n’amakuru, siporo n’imyidagaduro.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gashora, ni urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri isaga 5,200 y'Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Gashora ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gashora,ruherereye mu Karere ka Bugesera, Intara y'Iburasirazuba, rushyinguyemo imibiri isaga 5,200 y'Abatutsi bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Uru rwibutso rwibukiramo cyane cyane abiciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Gashora, harimo n'abishwe nyuma yo guhungira kuri ISAR Karama na Kiliziya.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, agace ka Gashora kari mu hiciwe Abatutsi benshi cyane. Abatutsi benshi bahungiye mu nsengero, ku bigo by’amashuri no mu bice batekerezaga ko byari kubarinda, ariko bicirwayo n’Interahamwe hamwe n’abasirikare bari bafatanyije na Leta yariho icyo gihe.
Hari n’abajugunywe mu byobo cyangwa mu bishanga, bituma hari imibiri yakomeje kuboneka nyuma y’imyaka myinshi Jenoside ihagaritswe.

Umurenge wa Nyankenke ni umwe mu mirenge 21 igize Akarere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Nyankenke wari utuwe n'abaturage 27 183. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Gicumbi kagizwe n'imirenge 21. Umurenge wa Nyankenke ni umwe muri yo.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Nyankenke wari utuwe n'abaturage 21 560. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 27 183. Abagabo bari 14 830. Abagore bari 12 353.
Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.

Nyuma y'umunsi umwe Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi itangiye mu Rwanda, taliki ya 8 Mata 1994 ubwicanyi bwarakomeje mu bice bitandukanye by'igihugu, ku rundi ruhande ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi nazo zakomeje urugamba zigamije guhagarika Jenoside.
Kuri iyi taliki, Maj. Gen. Paul Kagame wari Umugaba Mukuru w'Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi, yatangaje ko atangiye intambara kuri Leta yakoraga Jenoside kuko bitari bigishoboka kubahiriza amasezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha. Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zatangije urugamba mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ziyemeza guhagarika Jenoside mu maguru mashya. Nkuko tubikesha CNLG, izi ngabo zubuye imirwano mu duce twa Byumba na Ruhengeri kugira ngo zihagarike Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi.
Mu Karere ka Nyaruguru Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu ruganda rw'icyayi rwa Mata barishwe bose. Uwo munsi Abatutsi bageragezaga guhungira mu cyahoze ari Zaire, interahamwe zarabatangiraga, zikabakusanyiriza ahitwa Rusura, mu Murenge wa Bugeshi muri Gisenyi, zikabica. Abasirikare b'Abafaransa n'Ababiligi, batangiye igikorwa cyo gucyura abanyaburayi babaga mu Rwanda. Abafaransa bacyita Operation Amarylis naho Ababiligi bacyita Silver Back.
Abatutsi bari bahungiye Mwiri ku musozi wa Nyawera (muri Kayonza)barishwe. Interahamwe n'abasirikare barindaga Perezida Habyarimana Juvenal bishe Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi Gatolika yitiriwe Mutagatifu Karoli Lwanga no mu kigo cy'Abafureri b'Abayozefiti i Nyamirambo.
-Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Ishuri rya St Andre i Nyamirambo barishwe. Kuva ku italiki ya 8, 14, 25 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Ruhuha, barishwe. Ubwicanyi bwibasiye Abatutsi bwatangiye muri Komini Rutsiro muri Perefegitura ya Kibuye.
Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zageze i Kigali, Kagame Paul amenyesha MINUAR ko agiye kohereza umutwe w'Ingabo gufatanya n'Ingabo za Leta mu guhagarika ubwicanyi bwakorwaga n'Abasirikare barindaga Perezida Habyarimana. Mu Kinigi, Koloneli Setako Ephrem yategetse Interahamwe kwica Abatutsi baho. Uwo munsi Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zahageze zibasha kurokora bake bari basigaye bataricwa.
Abatutsi bagera ku 5000 bari bahungiye ku rusengero rw'Abadiventisite rwa Cyambara mu Murenge wa Bigogwe muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Bitaro bya Shyira muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyabihu.
Hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku rusengero rw'Adiventisiti rwa Mudende muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku rusengero rw'Adiventisiti rwa Bweramana muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku rusengero rwa ADEPR Kabumba, Perefegitura ya Gisenyi barishwe. Abatutsi bari bahungiye muri Kaminuza y'Adiventisiti ya Mudende muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi barishwe, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Hishwe Abatutsi ku musozi wa Kesho muri Rubaya(Ngororero).
Hishwe Abatutsi i Kavumu no mu nkengero zaho(mu yari Komini Ramba). Hishwe Abatutsi benshi muri Centre ya Gakenke. Hishwe Abatutsi i Bukeri(muri Komini Ndusu) ku mugezi wa Mukungwa ku gice kigana muri Vunga. Hishwe Abatutsi kuri Superefegitura ya Busengo.

Taliki ya 9 Mata 1994, Ingabo z'Abafaransa zatereranye Abatutsi. Leta y'abicanyi yakomeje umugambi wayo mubisha wo gutsemba Abatutsi hirya no hino mu gihugu. Iyi nyandiko igaragaza hamwe mu hantu hashoboye kumenyekana hiciwe Abatutsi taliki ya 9 Mata 1994, Ingabo z'Abafaransa baje mu cyo bise Operation Amaryllis zatereranye Abatutsi mu maboko y'abicanyi.
Taliki ya 9 Mata 1994, ni bwo icyo bise Operation Amaryllis yatangiye mu Rwanda kugera taliki 12 Mata. Igisobanuro cy'iyo operasiyo kwari ugucyura Abafaransa n'abanyamahanga bari mu Rwanda. Iyo Operasiyo yabaye igihe Abatutsi bicwaga cyane muri Kigali n'ahandi henshi mu gihugu, bicwa n'abasirikare n'interahamwe. Izo ngabo z'abafaransa zarebaga Abatutsi bicwaga nyamara ntibigeze babatabara, barabaretse baricwa bikomereza gucyura bene wabo.
Abafaransa ntibashatse gutabara kugira ngo bahagarike ubwicanyi bwakorerwaga mu maso yabo, cyane cyane ku kibuga cy'indege cya Kanombe bahasize benshi babasigira interahamwe. Hari Abatutsi bari bashoboye kurira mu modoka z'Abasirikare b'Abafaransa zacyuraga abanyamahanga, ariko bagera kuri bariyeri bakabakuramo bakabicira imbere y'Ingabo z'Abafaransa. Imiryango yarimo abashakanye hagati y'Umufaransa n'Umunyarwanda barabatandukanije, abanza gutandukana barabasiga. Mu marira menshi abagore bashakanye n'Abanyarwanda basabye ko abo bashakanye n'abana babo, babatwara baranga. Abakozi ba ambasade y'u Bufaransa cyane cyane Abatutsi barasigaye, abenshi baricwa. Nyamara ambasade y'u Bufaransa yafunguriye imiryango yayo umuryango w'uwahoze ari perezida, abari mu mutwe w'abicanyi bashyizweho na Leta yariho, n'ibyegera bya Habyarimana Juvenal byari ku isonga ry'Akazu. Abatutsi bageragezaga kurira urukuta rwa ambasade y'u Bufaransa barakubitwaga bakabasubiza inyuma, interahamwe zirabica. Abakozi bo mu nzu yareraga imfubyi(Orphelinat Ste Agatha) yari iya Agathe Kanziga umugore wa Habyarimana Juvenal, barabatwaye, ariko u Bufaransa bwima ubuhungiro abana ba nyakwigendera Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwiringiyimana, wari umaze iminsi 2 yishwe n'abasirikare b'u Rwanda bayobowe na Majoro Bernard Ntuyahaga. Icyemezo cyo gucyura Abafaransa nticyafashwe indege ya Habyarimana ikimara guhanurwa cyangwa se iminsi 2 yakurikiyeho, icyo cyemezo cyafashwe n'Abanyepolitiki bashakaga guha ingufu ingabo z'u Rwanda zari ku rugamba.
Uwo munsi, umuryango wa Hbyarimana n'abandi bahezanguni buriye indege z'Abafaransa bajyanwa i Bangui, bakomereza i Paris. Mu ntagondwa z'abajenosideri batwawe n'Ingabo z'Abafaransa harimo Felisiyani Kabuga wabaye umushoramari wa Jenoside na Ferdinard Nahimana wabaye umukangurambaga wa Jenoside. Bombi bari mu bashinze RTLM yakoreshejwe mu kwamamaza ikorwa rya Jenoside, ishyirwaho rya guverinoma y'abicanyi yari iyobowe na Kambanda. Mu gitondo cy'italiki ya 8 Mata, Bagosora yakoranyije abayobozi bagize Hutu-Power, kugira ngo bashyireho guverinoma, bose bavaga mu mashyaka y'abahezanguni. Ishyirwaho ry'iyo guverinoma ryabereye muri Ambasade y'Abafaransa. MRND yari ihagarariwe na Matayo Ngirumpatse,Edouard Karemera, visi perezida we na Joseph Nzirorera, umunyamabanga Mukuru, MDR ihagarariwe na Froduald Karamira, Donat Murego, PL ihagarariwe na Justin Mugenzi na Agnes Ntamabyariro, PSD yari ihagarariwe na Francois Ndungutse na Hyacinthe Nsengiyumva Rafiki, PDC ihagarariwe na Jean- Marie Vianney Sibomana, Celestin Kabanda na Gaspard Ruhumuriza. MRND yashyizweho na Dr Theodore Sindikubwabo nka Perezida wa Repubulika, Bagosora nawe ashyiraho Jean Kambanda ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'intebe.
Iyo guverinoma yari ifite gahunda imwe gusa; gutanga umurongo w'uko Jenoside igomba gukorwa mu gihugu cyose, gutanga intwaro, gukangurira abaturage gukora Jenoside no kuyisobanurira mu mahanga. Abatutsi biciwe kuri Paruwasi gatolika yitiriwe Mutagatifu Visenti wa Pallotti i Gikondo muri Kigali. Taliki ya 09 Mata 1994, interahamwe n'abasirikare barindaga Habyarimana, bishe Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri paruwasi gatulika yitiriwe Mutagatifu Visenti wa Pallotti i Gikondo bagera kuri 500. Kuri uwo munsi, Ingabo za Loni zaboneye ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi biganjemo abana muri Kiliziya i Gikondo. Uwo munsi kandi ni nabwo abasirikare ba Leta batwitse Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda II munsi ya Hoteli BAOBAB. Ikinyamakuru cy'Abafaransa Liberation ni cyo cya mbere cyise ubwo bwicanyi Jenoside, mu nyandiko yanditswe n'umunyamakuru Philippe Ceppi wari mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside. Abatutsi bakomeje kwicwa ahantu hanyuranye mu gihugu; muri Kibungo, Kigali, Ruhengeri, na Kibuye. Kuri uwo munsi kandi Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku misozi ya Murama, Murundi, Mwiri, Nyamirama, na Kabare mu Karere ka Kayonza, kimwe n'abari bahungiye kuri paruwasi gatolika ya Kabuye mu Murenge wa Jabana mu Karere ka Gasabo barishwe.
Interahamwe zishe Abatutsi bari bahungiye muri Segiteri Nyagatare I mu Karere ka Nyagatare ndetse n'abari bahungiye kuri paruwasi ya Zaza muri Kibungo aho guhera taliki 09 Mata ubwo bwicanyi bwarakomeje, ababarirwa hagati ya 500 na 800 bishwe. Guhera taliki ya 09 Mata, Interahamwe zatangiye kwica Abatutsi bari bahungiye i Kiramuruzi mu Karere ka Gatsibo, hamwe n'abari bahungiye ku musozi wa Nyamagumba muri Komine Mabanza muri Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Mu minsi yakurikiyeho hishwe Abatutsi barenga 12000. Kuri uwo munsi na none, hishwe Abatutsi bari bahungiye i Nybikenke, ku biro byahoze ari iby'Umurenge wa Karama muri Bumbogo ndetse n'ahandi hantu hatandukanye harimo i Cyabingo muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, muri centre y'ubucuruzi ya Karama no mu Mataba mu Karere ka Gakenke, ku rusengero rw'Ababatisita rwa Rusiza muri Kabumba, Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, muri Kiliziya ya Nyundo no mu nkengero zayo, ndetse no muri Maternite ya Nyundo muri Perefegitura ya Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Ahitwa mu Kivuruga muri Komini Cyabingo hari huzuye abasirikare batangiraga Abatutsi bageragezaga guhunga. Uretse aho kuri bariyeri, Abatutsi biciwe i Cyabingo na Busengo. Interahamwe zabishe zazaga kuri kaburimbo ahitwa kuri Mukinga zifite ibiganza by'abo zamaze kwica; zigakomereza i Rwaza mu yari Komini Ruhondo kwica abandi Batutsi.
Umusozo; Ubwicanyi bwibasiye Abatutsi bwarakomeje hirya no hino mu gihugu, bukorwa kimwe, ni ukuvuga ko uwitwa Umututsi wese yishwe, abenshi bishwe bahunga. Kuri iyi taliki abenshi biciwe mu nsengero na za kiliziya, kuko abantu bibeshyaga ko bashobora kuharokokera.

Taliki ya 10 Mata 1994, umunsi abasirikare ba Habyarimana Juvenal bishe abarwayi kuri Faisal, kuri iyi taliki ubwicanyi bwarakomeje mu buryo bukomeye aho mu bice byinshi abatutsi bishwe mu buryo butagira ingano. Icyo gihe abasirikare barindaga Perezida Habyarimana Juvenal barashe amasasu bikomeye ku Bitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal, bica abarwayi 29, abandi bagera kuri 70 barakomereka.
Ni wo munsi Abatutsi barenga 7564 biciwe kuri Kiliziya Gatolika i Gahanga muri Komini Kanombe, abarenga 2522 bicirwa i Karembure, muri Gahanga. Ibitero byabishe biyobowe n'uwari wungirije Burugumesitiri muri Komini Kanombe n'abapolisi ba Komini, hiyongereyeho uwari konseye wa Gahanga akaba yarahoze mu gisirikare ndetse n'abandi bantu bavuye mu gisirikare aribo Zirarushya, Kimonyo,Francais, hiyongeraho abasirikare bari barinze ikiraro cya Kanzenze n'abari ku musozi wa Rebero barindaga RADAR bose bahuriye i Gahanga. Icyo gihe kandi abatutsi bari bahungiye ku biro bya Komini Gashora no mu kigo cya ISAR Karama (ubu ni mu Murenge wa Ririma), barishwe bose.
Kuva taliki 10 kugeza 15 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bajyanwaga kwicwa n'abasirikare muri Camp GP ku Kimihurira. Abari bahungiye ku Bitaro bya Kiziguro (ubu ni mu Karere ka Gatsibo), nabo nibwo bishwe. Ikindi kandi Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku ishuri ribanza rya Gikumba muri Bumbogo, barishwe. Interahamwe zo muri Komini Ngororero na Giciye ku Gisenyi, zishe Abatutsi barenga 14500 bari bahungiye ku Ngoro ya Muvoma. Harokotse abantu babiri gusa. Ni cyo gihe Ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu Rwanda, yafunze imiryango yayo maze Ambasaderi Rawson hamwe n'abandi banyamerika 250 barahungishwa. Mu mujyi wa Kigali kandi Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku Bigega bya Gatsata, barishwe.
Imibiri ivangavanze n'inkomere igera ku 10,000 y'Abatutsi yaratoraguwe mu mihanda ya Kigali maze ijyanwa mu Bitaro binyuranye. Kuri Kiliziya Gatolika ya Ruhuha no mu nkengero zayo muri Komini Ngenda, muri Bugesera; kuri iyi taliki hiciwe Abatutsi bagera 10,000. Impuzamugambi zifatanije n'interahamwe zishe Abatutsi bagera 10,000 bari bahungiye kuri Komini Gashora no ku kiyaga cya Rumira na Kidogo muri Bugesera. Ni nawo munsi Umutwe w'ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi wari uturutse Byumba wageze muri CND uje gufasha Ingabo zari zihari gukomeza kurokora Abatutsi bicwaga.
Abarwayi bagera ku 100 biciwe mu Bitaro bya Kigali (CHUK) bishwe n'abasirikare ba Leta. Ni nako kandi Abatutsi benshi b'i Kangazi muri Nkanka (Cyangungu) baroshywe mu Kiyaga cya Kivu. Ahandi habereye ubwicanyi bukomeye; hishwe Abatutsi b'i Ntura muri Giheke(Cyangugu), hishwe Abatutsi b'i Ntendezi, Hishwe Abatutsi benshi i Musasa muri Centre ya Ruli, hishwe Abatutsi i Rwankuba.

Ni umurenge ufite amateka akomeye n'iterambere rishingiye ku bikorwaremezo n'ubuhinzi.Ibintu by'ingenzi byaranga uyu murenge bikurikira hano:Ubuyobozi n'ImiterereUbuyobozi: Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa (Gitifu) w’uyu murenge ni Gasasa Evergiste.Abaturage: Umurenge utuwe n'abaturage basaga ibihumbi 24.Utugari: Ugizwe n'utugari 9, turimo Akagari ka Gasiza, Huro, Ruganda, n'akazi ka Bwenda.Ibiro by'Umurenge: Hubatswe inyubako nshya igezweho igeretse inshuro imwe mu Mudugudu wa Gahinga, Akagari ka Gasiza, yuzuye itwaye amafaranga y'u Rwanda asaga miliyoni 380.Imihanda: Muhondo iri mu mirenge ikora ku muhanda wa Kaburimbo.

Umurenge wa Rushashi ni umwe mu mirenge 19 igize Akarere ka Gakenke, mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Rushashi wari utuwe n'abaturage 18 835. Ugizwe n'utugari 8. Koperative y’abahinzi b’ikawa Abakundakawa ikorera muri uyu murenge.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Akarere ka Gakenke kagizwe n'imirenge 19, utugari 97 n'imidugudu 617. Umurenge wa Rushashi ugizwe n'utugari 8:
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Rushashi wari utuwe n'abaturage 17 806. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 18 835. Abagabo bari 8 974. Abagore bari 9 861. Abaturage 6 368 bari bafite munsi y’imyaka 15. Abaturage 11 194 bari bafite imyaka hagati ya 15 na 64. Abaturage 1 273 bari bafite imyaka 65 cyangwa irenga. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Ubuhinzi bw’ikawa ni kimwe mu bikorwa by’ubukungu muri Rushashi. Koperative Abakundakawa ikorera mu Murenge wa Rushashi. Yashinzwe mu 2004. Ifite abanyamuryango 1 962.
Igishushanyombonera cy’Akarere ka Gakenke giteganya guteza imbere isantere ya Rushashi. Iyi santere iri ku muhanda uhuza Giticyinyoni, Ruli na Gakenke.

LinkedIn ni urubuga nkoranyambaga rw'abanyamwuga rukoreshwa mu kubaka umuyoboro w'imibanire y'akazi, gushaka no gutanga akazi, kwamamaza ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi no gusangira ubumenyi bw'umwuga. Ni rwo rubuga runini ku isi rw'abanyamwuga, rufite abanyamuryango barenga miliyari imwe mu bihugu n'uturere birenga 200.
Urubuga rwashinzwe mu 2002, rutangira gukoreshwa ku mugaragaro mu 2003. Kuva mu 2016 ni ishami rya Microsoft, nyuma yo kugurwa ku gaciro ka miliyari 26.2 z'amadolari ya Amerika.
LinkedIn yashinzwe na Reid Hoffman afatanyije na Allen Blue, Konstantin Guericke, Eric Ly na Jean-Luc Vaillant. Igitekerezo cyari ugukora urubuga rwafasha abanyamwuga kubaka no gukomeza umubano w'akazi hakoreshejwe interineti.
Urubuga rwatangiye gukoreshwa ku mugaragaro muri Gicurasi 2003.
Mu 2005, LinkedIn yatangiye gutanga serivisi zo gutangaza imyanya y'akazi no gufasha ibigo gushaka abakozi.
Mu 2007, isosiyete yatangiye kubona inyungu mu bikorwa byayo, kandi yari imaze kugira abanyamuryango barenga miliyoni 15.
Mu 2011, LinkedIn yinjiye ku isoko ry'imigabane (IPO), ikusanya miliyoni 353 z'amadolari ya Amerika kandi iba imwe mu masosiyete ya mbere y'imbuga nkoranyambaga ageze kuri urwo rwego.
Mu 2016, Microsoft yatangaje gahunda yo kugura LinkedIn ku gaciro ka miliyari 26.2 z'amadolari. Ubugure bwarangiye mu Ukuboza 2016, LinkedIn ikomeza gukoresha izina ryayo n'imiterere yayo nk'ishami rya Microsoft.
Abakoresha LinkedIn bashobora gukora urupapuro rw'umwirondoro rw'umwuga rurimo:
Abakoresha bashobora kandi guhuza n'abandi banyamwuga, gukurikira ibigo, amashuri makuru, imiryango n'impuguke mu nzego zitandukanye.
Gushaka no gutanga akazi.
Kimwe mu bikorwa by'ingenzi bya LinkedIn ni uguhuza abakoresha n'abashaka akazi. Ibigo bishobora gutangaza imyanya y'akazi, gushakisha abakandida no kubatumira gusaba akazi.
Abashaka akazi bashobora: Gushakisha imyanya y'akazi, Kohereza ubusabe, Kwakira amatangazo y'akazi mashya, Kugaragaza ubumenyi n'uburambe bwabo. Kubona amakuru ku masosiyete n'abakozi bayakoreramo. Izi serivisi zabaye imwe mu nkingi z'ingenzi z'ubucuruzi bwa LinkedIn.
Ibirimo n'itumanaho.
LinkedIn yemerera abakoresha gutangaza inyandiko, amashusho, amafoto n'ibitekerezo ku ngingo zirebana n'umwuga, ubucuruzi, ikoranabuhanga n'ubuyobozi.
Abakoresha bashobora:
Ubushakashatsi bw'isosiyete bwerekanye ko gushakisha amakuru ari kimwe mu bikorwa bikunze gukorwa ku rubuga.
Amahugurwa n'ubumenyi.
LinkedIn itanga serivisi z'amahugurwa kuri interineti binyuze muri LinkedIn Learning. Amasomo akubiyemo:
Ikoranabuhanga, Ubuyobozi, Ubucuruzi,Itumanaho, Icungamutungo, Ubugeni n'itangazamakuru.
Iyi gahunda yaturutse ku kwagura ibikorwa by'isosiyete nyuma yo kugura urubuga rw'amahugurwa Lynda.com.
Ubucuruzi n'inkomoko y'amafaranga.
LinkedIn yinjiza amafaranga binyuze mu:
Izi ni zo nkingi z'ingenzi zigize ubucuruzi bw'isosiyete.
LinkedIn ikoreshwa n'abayobozi, abanyeshuri, abashakashatsi, ibigo n'imiryango mpuzamahanga. Nk'uko isosiyete ibitangaza, ifite abanyamuryango barenga miliyari imwe ku isi.
Urubuga rwashyigikiye indimi nyinshi kandi rwagiye rwagura ibikorwa byarwo mu bihugu bitandukanye, harimo no gutangiza serivisi z'Igishinwa mu 2014.
Nk'izindi mbuga nini zo kuri interineti, LinkedIn yagiye ihura n'ibibazo birebana na: Kurinda amakuru bwite y'abakoresha, Umutekano w'amakuru, Imyirondoro ituzuye cyangwa idahwitse, Gukoresha amakuru y'abakoresha mu buryo bwubahiriza amategeko.
Isosiyete ikomeje kuvugurura uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru no kuzamura ubuziranenge bw'ibikubiye ku rubuga.

Shakira Isabel Mebarak Ripoll (wavutse ku ya 2 Gashyantare 1977) ni umuririmbyi n’umubyinnyi w’Umunyakolombiya, uzwi cyane ku izina ry'Umwamikazi w'umuziki wa Latin. Afatwa nk’umwe mu bahanzi bagize uruhare rukomeye mu kinyejana cya 21 kandi nk’umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye mu mateka yose. Azwi cyane ku ndirimbo ye yitwa "Hips Don't Lie".

Kubuguza ubundi umukino ufasha abawukina kumenya kubara neza no gutekereza neza kuko mu byo ugomba gukora ngo utsinde harimo no kubara inka z’uwo mukina, ugakora ku buryo inka zawe bataza kuzirya kugira ngo atagutsinda.

Gukina Igisoro Igisoro ni umwe mu mikino izwi ko ari iya kera cyane mu Rwanda. Igisoro kibazwa mu giti cyangwa kikabumbwa ariko n’abana bashobora kugikora bacukura utwobo mu butaka. Igisoro kigizwe n’impande ebyiri, buri ruhande rugizwe n’utwobo cumi na dutandatu aho buri kamwe kitwa icuba. Bivuze ko utwobo twose tugize igisoro ari mirongo itatu na tubiri. Igisoro gikinwa n’abantu babiri bakoresheje utubuye tw’igisoro mirongo itandatu na tune.

Urukiramende rugira uduti dutatu, udushingwa tubiri n’umutambiko wa gatatu. Abakina uyu mukino bagenda basimbuka maze ugushije umutambiko w’urukiramende bakavuga ko arunereye. Abo basimbuka bahora bunguruza bazamura hejuru bagahagararira aho rubananiriye. Uyu mukino wakundwaga cyane n’urubyiruko kuko wabashimishaga kandi ukerekana ko koko bafite ingufu.

Sebutimbiri ni ugusimbuka uzamuriye rimwe amaguru ugasimbuka inkiramende zikurikiranye. Iyo abantu bakinaga Sebutimbiri bakurikiranyaga inkiramende zigeze kuri esheshatu bakagenda bazisimbuka Sebutimbiri. Izo nkiramende aba ari ngufi cyane nka sentimetero mirongo itanu, ugushije rumwe akaba aratsinzwe.

Intembe ubundi ni inguri y’insina babazagamo uruziga rwo guhirika, rwabaga rufite hagati umwenge babonezamo barasa. Abakinaga intembe babaga bafite umuheto n’imyambi y’ibisongo bagahagarara kuri gahunda bitegeye kuyibonezamo. Umwe akayihirika imbere yabo, hakavamo uboneza akayirasa yihirika akaboneza muri wa mwenge wayo akaba atsinze abandi igitego maze bagakomeza bose bakarushanwa.

Kumasha Kumasha ni umukino wo kurushanwa kuboneza. Bareba ahantu hameze neza bakahateranira bafite umuheto n’impiru, bakareba icyo bashinga ngo bakimashe. Ibi babyitaga kandi kurasa intego. Bamwe bakundaga gushinga nk’umutumba w’insina. Uyu mukino watumaga urubyiruko rwitoza kuboneza kugira ngo ku rugamba cyangwa mu muhigo bazashobore guhiga abandi.

Kwiyakira byarakorwanga n’abakurambere b’abanyarwanda ubwo babaga bari mu mukino w’amahigi. Ni umukino abakurambere bakinaga bahiga inyamaswa aho muri uwo muhigo bashoboraga kuvanamo ibyo kurya, imyambaro n’ibindi. Uyu ntubarwa nk’umukino gusa kuko wari n’umwuga wa mbere wakozwe n’abanyarwanda bo hambere mbere yo kumenya guhinga no korora.

IGIHE ni ikinyamakuru cyo kuri interineti cyo mu Rwanda. Gitangaza amakuru mu Ikinyarwanda, mu Icyongereza no mu Igifaransa.
IGIHE cyashinzwe na Meilleur Murindabigwi. Ni kimwe mu binyamakuru bisomwa cyane mu Rwanda.
Meilleur Murindabigwi ni we washinze IGIHE. Ni umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo IGIHE Ltd. Mu ntangiriro, abanyamakuru benshi ba IGIHE bari abanyeshuri ba kaminuza. Abasomyi bashobora gutanga ibitekerezo ku nkuru.
Mu mwaka wa 2011, Murindabigwi yahawe igihembo na Jeannette Kagame. Yagihawe kubera ko yashinze IGIHE.
Nk'uko IREX ibivuga, abantu bari hagati ya 50 000 na 80 000 basuraga urubuga rwa IGIHE buri munsi.
Mu mwaka wa 2024, IGIHE cyari gifite abantu barenga 396 000 bagikurikira kuri Facebook. Cyari gifite kandi abarenga 596 000 kuri X, n'abarenga 423 000 kuri Instagram.

Nyama-Nyama-Nyama ni umukino umwana umwe aho agatangira kuririrmba Nyama-Nyama-Nyama” bisobanuye ‘’imyama” mu giswahire. Abandi bagasubiramo ibyo ubayoboye avuze banasimbuka. Uyoboye umukino akavuga amazina y’inyamanswa zitandukanye. Iyo inyamanswa avuze iribwa muri Kenya (cyangwa mu kindi gihugu umukino urimo gukinirwamo) abandi bagasimbuka bavuga ngo “Nyama”. Iyo uyoboye umukino avuze inyanswa itaribwa, abandi baba bagomba kuguma bahagaze. Iyo umwe muribo asimbutse,aba atsinzwe akava mu mukino. Umukino ugakomeza kugeza ubwo hasigara umuntu umwe akaba ariwe utsinze.

Itsinda rihitamo umuyobozi noneho abana bagahagarara kuri kimwe cya kabiri cy’uruziga bareba umuyobozi. Umuyobozi areba umwe kubari ku mpande.Bose bagasimbuka bakoma mu mashyi. Bagakomeza gusimmbuka bajyana ikirenge kiwe imbere. Iyo hagize ushyira ikirenge imbere gihuje nicyo umuyobozi yashyizeyo, uuyobozi ahita afata umwanya wuwo akamusimbura ku kuyobora umukina. Umuyobozi mushya asubiramo icyo gikorwa ku bandi bakinnyi kuri kuruziga.
Iyo bashyize imbere ikirenge gitandukanye nicyo umuyobozi yashyizeyo akomereza k’uwundi mukinnyi.

Agatambaro ku mwana ni abana bicara hamwe ku ruziga barebana.bagahitamo umuyobozi.Agafata agatambaro akagapfumbatiza neza mu ntoki kuburyo katagaragara.Akagenda azenguruka aririmba ngo “ Agambaro k’umwana karihe?”, abandi bagasubiza ngo ngako karahise agakomeza kubabaza ati “Mugahishure turore” bamusubiza bati ndanze batanseka.Umuyobozi agashyira agatambaro inyuma yumwe mubandi bakinnyi mw’ibanga Agahita atangira kwihuta azenguruka uruziga.Iyo ageze aho yashyize agatambaro ahita yicara,uwo yagashyize inyuma akamusimbura mu kuyobora umukino mu gihe atashoboye kukamutera mu mugongo ataragera aho yicara.

Ikibariro nyarwanda mu abanyarwanda bo hambere babaraga iminsi, amezi n’imyaka bagendeye ku kwezi, imyanya yako ikaba ari yo igenga imihango, ariko amezi akagomba guhura n’ibihe by’imvura n’izuba, kuko ari byo byagengaga imirimo y’ubuhinzi, n’imihango yabwo, Guhuza ibyo byose rero ntibyabaga byoroshye. Wari umurimo ugomba ubwenge n’ubushishozi, cyane cyane mu byo kugena ikibariro cy’imihango ikorwa mu gihugu cyose. Ariko no muri rubanda hasangwa abafite ubumenyi buhagije mu bireba ubuzima bwabo n’ubw’umuryango.

Imihango y'Ubwiru ni nayo yitwa inzira z’ubwiru. Inzira rero ni urujyano rw’imihango y’ubwiru yagengaga imirimo mikuru y’ibwami n’imibereho y’Abanyarwanda. Inzira zari 18, ariko hamenyekanye 17 gusa. Muri iyo mihango habagamo iy’ingarukamwaka, iy’ingarukakinyejana, n’indi ikorwa iyo habaye impamvu. Mu mihango yakorwaga habaye impamvu harimo iyimika n'ishyingura ry’abami, hakaba igenewe gusubya ibiza n’amahano, no kugwiza ibyiza, kurumbura no gutanga umugisha. Mu ngarukakinyejana, harimo umuhango mukuru cyane wo “kubyarira” umuriro wa Gihanga, wakorwaga ku ngoma ya Yuhi, uko amazina y’abami yakurikiranaga.

Imihango y'Ubwiru yagiraga abahanga bayo, ikagira abafataga amagambo yayo mu mutwe, igihe cyagera bakayasubiramo. Iby'Ubwiru byagenzurwaga n'Abami, bakabishinga Abiru mu nzego zabo, ariko bakabikurikirana, ngo hatazagira igitakara cyangwa kigahinduka, bikaguma uko abakurambere basize babitegetse. Imihango y’ubwiru yabwiwe Padiri Alexis Kagame mu mwaka wa 1945, arayandika, hanyuma iza gusohorwa na M. D'Hertefelt &amp; A. Coupez mu wa 1964, mu gitabo bise "La Royauté sacrée de l'ancien Rwanda".
Icyo gitabo kirimo Ubwiru uko Padri Kagame yabwanditse mu Kinyarwanda, inzira bazihindura no mu rurimi rw’Igifaransa, zisohoka mu gitabo kimwe, ziri muri izo ndimi zombi. Mu gitabo cy'ubwiru harimo Inzira 17, ariko Kagame yavuze ko yasanze zari 19, izibuzemo zikaba iyo kwimika amapfizi, n’iyo gutaha umurwa w’umwami, ariko ntiyavuze uko zamucitse.

Imihango ngaruka mwaka yari imihango y’ubwiru ya buri mwaka iri mu yarebwaga n’Abanyarwanda bose, igakorwa mu gihugu cyose. Indi na yo, rubanda rwayigiragamo uruhare, ariko ruto, ibyinshi ari ibigenewe gukorwa n’umwami n’umugabekazi n’abiru gusa. Iyi mihango ya buri mwaka, yikurikiranyaga ihereye mu kwa Gicurasi, igihugu kinjira mu cyunamo, icyo kikazakurwa mu kwa Kamena, n’ibirori byako, byamaraga icyumweru, bikitwa “gukura Gicurasi”. Ibyo bikarangira bajya kwitegura umuganura, kuko wategurwaga nk’ubukwe, urugo ruzakira umuryango mugari n’incuti rugatwererwa, ariko bagasurana bamaze kuganura mu rwabo rugo.

Icyunamo cya Gicurasi yari icyunamo cyari umuhango utegura uwa Kamena, maze yombi hamwe igategura uw’Umuganura, wo muri Nyakanga. Icyunamo cyatangiraga ku mboneka ya Gicurasi.
Ku mboneka ibwami batangiraga igihe cyo guceceka, ibirori bigahagarara, imirimo ikagumya igakorwa, ariko bucece. Ingoma ntizongere kuvuga, keretse Indamutsa, kuko yari ngombwa mu mirimo y’umwami.
Mu myijima y’uko kwezi kwa Gicurasi igihugu cyose gitangira icyunamo, ibirori byose bigahagarara, mbese bikaba nk’igihe cyo kwirabura, kizakurwaho n’ibirori bya Kamena.

Ibirori bya Kamena mu mboneka za Kamena, batangiraga imihango y’icyunamuro, bakayita "gukura Gicurasi." Babaga bibuka uko Ruganzu Ndori yunamuye u Rwanda, igihe rwayogozwaga n’Abagara biturutse ku bugambanyi bw’Abanyabyinshi ba Byinshi bya Bamara ba Yuhi Gahima.
Bagakora imihango myiza yibuka uko umutabazi Ruganzu Ndori yaje nk’ukwezi muri iryo curaburindi, abundutse i Karagwe kwa Karemera, umugabo wa nyirasenge witwiga Nyabunyana.

Umuganura wakorwaga mu kwezi kwa Nyakanga, ku nzora, nk’uko turi bubyerekane, ukaba umunsi mukuru wo kwibuka amasaka ya mbere yasaruwe mu Rwanda, Ruganzu Ndori amaze kurwunamura. Icyo gihe u Rwanda rwakoze iminsi mikuru ikomeye yo gusangira uwo mutsima w'amasaka yeze mbere y’andi, ari ko kuganura.
Hari bamwe mu bakiri bato bajya bavuga ko umuganura ari umunsi mukuru w’umusaruro, ariko si byo: ni umunsi wo kuganura – kurya amasaka yatanze ayandi kwera. Ntawayaryaga ataraganura.

Kibariro cya Myaka ya Gihe uhereye ku baturage basanzwe, bafite ubumenyi bw’ukwezi n’imyanya yako, akibwira ko byaturukaga ku gukunda kwitegereza ikirere. Ariko iryo shishoza ry’ikirere baribangikanyaga n’ubumenyi bw’ibihe by’imvura n’iby’amapfa, n’ibimera bihingwa n’ibyimeza, bakabigereranya n’ibihe by’ukwezi.
Birumvikana rero ko niba rubanda rwaritegerezaga ikirere, abiru bari bashinzwe gutegura imihango bakurikije igihe cyayigenewe, basuzumaga ijuru kurusha abaturage. Uwo mwete ugatuma bamenya ukwezi kwakurikizwa mu kugena ikibariro cy’umwaka, n’icy’imihango.

Ihagikamwaka Kera isi yose yabaraga umwaka ikurikije ibihembwe by’ukwezi, bakabigenderaho bategura imirimo y’ubuhinzi, n’iy’imihango n’iminsi mikuru y’iyobokamana. Hakaba ibihugu bigira abahanga babikurikirana, ariko bakundaga kuboneka mu banyamihango, kuko ikibandwagaho cyane cyari ikibariro cy’imihango nyine. Bakanabigira ibanga, bikajya mu mabanga y’ubwiru

Ukwezi kw’ihagiko ukwezi kw’ihagiko kwajyaga mbere ya Gicurasi, ikisunika, igasunika Kamena, kugira ngo Nyakanga izahurirane n’umwero w’amasaka. Ubwo amasaka aba atarera neza, ariko ntihaburemo azakoreshwa mu kuganura. Kagame avuga ko Mata ari ko kwezi kw’ihagiko, ariko nk’uko tubizi, Mata ni ukwezi kwihariye. Ahubwo ihagiko ryongerwa kuri Mata, nk’aho ari Mata ikomeje.

2. Ukwakira: novembre

Inzira y’Umuganura yerekana ibihe byo kubiba no kuganura, ariko bishingiye ku masaka yabibwaga mu cyi15, mu nkuka z’ibishanga. Ntituzi igihe wimukiye ku masaka abibwa mu kwa mbere, ntituzi n’icyabiteye, ariko ni byo dukurikiza muri iyi nyigo.

Ubwuzu ni ubushobozi bwo gukunda icyo ubwenge bwashimye. Ubwuzu bukurikira ubwenge. Kimwe n'igice cy'ubwenge, igice cy'ubwuzu nacyo kiragutse. Muri iki gice cy'umutima, hatsitsemo imbaraga z'urukundo zitangaje.

Ubushake Ni ubushobozi butagira ingano. Ni imbaraga zigambiriye gushyira mu ngiro igikwiye. Izo mbaraga z'umutima zipfunduka iyo ubwenge bwemeje ko ikigambiriwe gukorwa gikwiye kandi umutima wagikunze.

Inkeneragihamya mu muco ni wo shingiro ry’iterambere rirambye: mu migirire n’imyitwarire ya muntu mu muryango ni iki kitari umuco? - Ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n’isakazabumenyi rifite uruhare rukomeye mu gutuma umuco ukungahara, ugakwira, kandi ukabyazwa ubukungu. Ikoranabuhanga ariko na none ni umuyoboro ushobora kwifashishwa mu gutokoza umuco.

Iterambere ry’ibihugu Kimwe mu biranga umuntu ku isi yose no mu bihe byose ni iterambere. Rikaba indatana n'imigirire y'umuryango w'abantu, uko waba uteye imbere kose mu by'ikoranabuhanga n'inganda. Ni igipimo kigaragaza imibereho myiza y'umuryango w'abantu bitabaye ngombwa ko hitabwa ku buhambare bw'ikoranabuhanga na politiki ihanitse nk'uko bimeze ku bihugu byo mu burengerazuba bw'isi.

Umuco n’Itegeko Nshinga muco ni isoko ivomwamo imigirire n’uburyo bw’imikorere igamije iterambere, nk’uko bishimangirwa n’Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ryo mu 2003 ryavuguruwe mu 2015, mu ngingo yayo ya 11. Rihamya ko umuco ari isoko yo kwishakamo ibisubizo (Repubulika y'u Rwanda, 2015).

Umuco na politiki z’iterambere Icyerekezo 2050 gihamya ko u Rwanda rwihaye intego yo kuba igihugu gikize gishingiye ku umuco wo kugira ishyaka no guhiganwa mu nzego zose. Kimwe mu byo kwitabwaho by’ingenzi ni ugupiganwa mu by’iterambere ry’ubukungu hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, uguhanga ibishya binyuze mu inozaburyo, gukora ubushakashatsi, kubaka ibikorwaremezo bifite ireme, gukora ibikorwa bibyara umusaruro ku giciro gikwiye no kongera uburyo bw’ibyazamusaruro.

Politiki y’umuco iteganya ko umuco w’u Rwanda ugomba kwagura amarembo ugasabana n’indi mico mu gihe iyo mishyikirano ikungahaza Abanyarwanda, igatuma ibihugu birushaho kumvikana no kugira amahoro. Ibyo bigakorwa mu bwubahe bw’umwihariko wa buri muco, ubw’urusobe n’ubwuzuzanye by’imico.

Kurambagiza ni ukureba uburanga bw’umukobwa cyangwa umuhungu, ubwiza, imico n’imyifatire bye. Mu kurambagiza kandi habagaho kumenya no kugenzura imyitwarire, imibereho, imikorere, isuku ndetse n’umuryango umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa akomokamo kugira ngo umenye niba yarahawe uburere.

Gusaba no gufata irembo ni umuhango wakurikiraga kurambagiza, ukabera iwabo w’umukobwa. Uyu muhango wari ugamije guhuza umuryango w’umusore ku nshuro ya mbere n’umuryango w’umukobwa mu rwego rwo kumenyana mbere y’uko baziyemeza guhana abageni. Imisango yo gusaba no gufata irembo akenshi irihuta kuko ubusanzwe mu kinyarwanda ntawimana Iyo umuryango w’umusore wemerewe irembo, hakurikiraho umuhango wo kurifata.

Gusaba ni umuhango ukurikira uwo gufata irembo ukabera iwabo w’umukobwa. Mu muhango wo gusaba umuryango w’umusore watoranyaga abakwe bajya kuwusabira, bakagenda bayobowe n’umukwe mukuru bakagenda bitwaje inzoga zo gusabisha.

Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, mbere yo kurongora no kurongorwa umuryango w’umukobwa waramuhekaga ukamushyira uw’umusore. Iyo yabaga ageze kwa sebukwe bitewe n’akarere, hari imihango yakorwaga mu kumwakira. Hari aho, akiri mu bikingi by’amarembo yahagararaga hejuru y’aho batabye urusyo nyirabukwe akamukoza umwuko mu mpanga. Ahandi, umugeni yarinjiraga agasanga sebukwe yicaye ikambere akamwicaza ku bibero, akanamuha inka y’ibibero akabona kujyanwa mu mbere.

Gutekesha Gutekesha cyangwa gukora ku mashyiga ni umuhango wakorwaga n’iwabo w’umuhungu nyuma yo kurongora kugira ngo bamushyigikire mu rugo rushya. Uyu muhango wakorwaga n’umugeni, umugabo we na nyirabukwe na sebukwe. Nyirabukwe yamuzaniraga bimwe mu bikoresho byo mu rugo nk’urukebano cyangwa akabindi. Uyu muhango wari ugamije guha uburenganzira bwo gukora imirimo no gutinyuka sebukwe na nyirabukwe. Muri uyu muhango umusore n’umukobwa bakoraga umuhango wo gufatanya guteka ibyo ababyeyi babaga bazanye.

Guca mu irembo byakorwaga n’umusore washyingiwe n’umugeni we, ubwo basuraga iwabo w’umukobwa. Uyu muhango wabaga nyuma y’igihe runaka abashyingiwe baramenyereye urugo kandi baratangiye kurukorera, umusore akajya gukura ubwatsi.

Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, ubukwe bwari ubw’umuryango. Imiryango iyo yabonaga ko umusore cyangwa inkumi bakuze kandi ko bageze igihe cyo gushinga urugo, yatangiraga gutera intambwe zagenwaga n’umuco. Umugeni yasabwaga umuryango kandi agahabwa umuryango w’umusore bityo amakimbirane n’ibindi bibazo byashoboraga kuvuka muri urwo rugo rushya byakemurwaga n’umuryango uhurije hamwe (Kwirinda no Gukemura amakimbirane mu miryango).

Guca mu irembo byakorwaga n’umusore washyingiwe n’umugeni we, ubwo basuraga iwabo w’umukobwa. Uyu muhango wabaga nyuma y’igihe runaka abashyingiwe baramenyereye urugo kandi baratangiye kurukorera, umusore akajya gukura ubwatsi.
Muri uyu muhango bajyanaga na se w’umuhungu, umuranga cyangwa se undi muntu washoboraga kubavugira ijambo. Bajyanaga inzoga basangira kandi bakaganira hagamijwe gushimira umuryango w’umukobwa ko watanze umugeni mwiza.
Muri uyu muhango dusangamo indangagaciro yo gushima no gushimira kubera ko urugo rushya rwafataga umwanya rukajya gushimira umuryango wabashyingiye. Ibi byatumaga imiryango irushaho kubana neza n’umurunga wayo ugakomera.

Ibibazo bigaragara mu bukwe muri iki gihe, ahanini biterwa n’uko umuryango utagiha agaciro umuco n’intego nyamukuru y’ubukwe. Ibi bituma umusore, inkumi n’imiryango bakomokamo muri rusange bavanga ibyo umuco w’u Rwanda ugena n’ibiva mu mahanga mu mihango y’ubukwe.
Umuco urakura, uratanga kandi ukakira. Ariko mu mihango ndangamuco nk’iy’ubukwe haba hakwiriye guhabwa agaciro indangagaciro zawo kubera akamaro kazo mu kubaka no gushimangira uwo muhango n’icyo ugamije mu kubaka umuryango nyarwanda.
Kugira ngo ibi bikemuke, ni ngombwa ko buri wese abigiramo uruhare, akamenya indangagaciro dusanga mu mihango y’ubukwe zadufasha kubaka umuryango uhamye kandi ukomeye.

umurimo ni igikorwa gikoreshejwe imbaraga z’umubiri cyangwa z’ubwonko kugira ngo umuntu agere ku ntego cyangwa ibisubizo. Umurimo rero ni inkingi ya mwamba, ituma umuntu agera ku ntego yihaye zose akoresheje ubwenge cyangwa imbaraga z’amaboko ye.
Ni na yo mpamvu Leta y’u Rwanda yawushyize mu bigomba kuranga Abanyarwanda kugira ngo bazagere ku ntego bihaye, biteze imbere, bashobore kwihaza mu ngo ndetse banasagurire amasoko. Ikindi kandi iyo wakoze bigutera kugira ubuzima bwiza, umubiri wawe ukubakika kandi ibyo ukura mu murimo ukora bikagufasha kubaho neza.
Dushishikarizwa kudasuzugura akazi kuko burya ngo Nta kazi k’umunyagara kabaho” ikindi ngo Udakora ntakarye.

Gukunda Igihugu ni amagambo abiri abumbye ijambo rimwe. Gukunda bivuga kumva ubwuzu bwimbitse ufitiye umuntu cyangwa kwishimira cyane. Bamwe bajya bavuga ngo urukundo ni impumyi abandi ngo urukundo ni ukurindagira k’umutima, gutuma ubona umuntu mu buryo butandukanye n’ubwo abandi bamubonamo, ukanishyiramo ko afite uruhare rukomeye mu buzima bwawe”. Aha rero si kimwe no gukunda igihugu.

Philip Belmont Cameli (wavutse ku ya 28 Gashyantare 1998) ni umukinnyi wa filime w’umunyamerika, uzwi cyane kubera filime yakinnye yitwa Jamie Spano muri filime "Saved by the Bell" reboot (2020–2021), Eli muri filime ya Netflix "yitwa " (2022) na Garrett Graham muri serivise ya Amazon Prime Video "Off Campus" (2026–Kugeza ubu).
Phillip Belmont Cameli yavukiye i Naperville, muri leta ya Illinois.
Ahanini bijyanye n' inkomoko ya se aturuka mu Butaliyani. Sekuruza we, Belmondo Cameli, yavukiye i San Benedetto del Tronto mbere yo kwimukira muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika maze ahindura izina rye ry'umuryango yitwa Belmont. Ababyeyi ba Cameli ni bo bamuhaye iryo zina rya sogokuru.
Mu mashuri yisumbuye, yakinaga imikino itatu. Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri ye, yize muri Kaminuza ya Illinois nk'ishuri rikuru ry'ubucuruzi mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe mbere yo kuhava. Yagumye i Chicago umwaka umwe akurikirana umwuga wo kwerekana imideli, hanyuma yimukira i Los Angeles mu 2019. Afite mukuru we, Patrick, na mushiki we muto, Julia.
Cameli yatangiye gukina filime ubwo yatumirwaga muri "Empire" mu 2018. Yamenyekanye cyane kubera gukina Jamie Spano, umuhungu w' umukinnyi wa Elizabeth Berkley witwa Jessie Spano, muri filime "ya Saved by the Bell".
Mu 2022, Cameli yakinnye muri filime ya Netflix "yitwa Along for the Ride", ishingiye ku gitabo cya Sarah Dessen. Yakinnye ari Eli, umuntu utuje ugirana isano n'umukinnyi w'ingenzi muri iyo filimi.
Yakinnye Frankie Boy muri filime y'aba polisi "yitwa The Alto Knights", yasohotse mu 2025.
Cameli yagaragaye muri "Until Dawn", fiime ishingiye k'umukino wa videwo (video game) wo muri 2015 wakozwe na kompanyi ya Supermassive games witwa "Until Dawn". Iyi filime yasohotse ku wa 25 Mata 2025, igaragaza inkuru nshya n'abakinnyi, aho Cameli akina nka Abe.
Mu 2026, Cameli yakinnye nka Garrett Graham muri serivise ya "Off Campus" kuri Amazon Prime Video.
Mu 2018, Cameli yahaye impyiko ye umuntu atazi mu runigi rw'abantu 14 rwatumye abantu barindwi barokoka.
Ku wa 6 Kamena 2026, Cameli yacuranze indirimbo "Girls" hamwe na The Kid LAROI nyuma y'uko indirimbo igaragaye mu kiganiro cya televiziyo "cya Off Campus".

Rwanda Water Resources Board (RWB) ni ikigo cya Leta y'uRwanda gifite inshingano zo gucunga, kurengera no guteza imbere umutungo w'amazi mu gihugu. RWB yashyizweho n'Itegeko No. 71/2019 ryo ku wa 29 Mutarama 2020, kandi ifite ubuzima gatozi n'ubwisanzure mu micungire y'ubutegetsi n'iy'imari. Ikora nk'urwego rwa Leta rutagamije inyungu z'ubucuruzi.
Rwanda Water Resource Board yashinzwe hagamijwe gukomeza kunoza imicungire y'umutungo w'amazi mu Rwanda no gushyira mu bikorwa politiki, amategeko n'ingamba z'igihugu zijyanye n'umutungo w'amazi. Icyicaro gikuru cyayo giherereye iKigali, umurwa mukuru w'u Rwanda
Intego nyamukuru ya Rwanda Water Resource Board ni uguharanira ko amazi ahagije kandi acunzwe neza aboneka kugira ngo ashyigikire iterambere rirambye ry'igihugu.

Imiti isukura amazi (mu cyongereza: "Water treatment chemicals") ni ibinyabutabire bikoreshwa mu gukuraho umwanda, imyanda ikomeye, bagiteri, virusi, n'ibindi bintu bishobora kwanduza amazi kugira ngo abe akwiye gukoreshwa n'abantu cyangwa mu nganda. Iyi miti ifite uruhare runini mu kubungabunga ubuzima n'isuku, dore ko ku isi yose abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 3.4 bapfa buri mwaka kubera indwara ziterwa no kutagira amazi meza yo kunywa.

= Inyandiko zifashishijwe =

Ikiraro cya Kyaka, rimwe na rimwe cyitwa ikiraro cya Akagera, ni ikiraro muri Tanzaniya cyambukiranya uruzi rwa Kagera. Iki kiraro cyaturikijwe n'inzobere zo muri Uganda zo muri Kilembe Mines mu 1978 mu gihe cy'intambara ya Uganda na Tanzaniya.
Ikiraro cy'ubu (truss) ni ikiraro cya Callender-Hamilton gitangwa n'abakora ibyuma by'ubwubatsi b'Abongereza Painter Brothers.

Water Access Rwanda ni ikigo cy'imibereho myiza n'ubucuruzi (social enterprise) gikorera mu Rwanda, gifite intego yo gutanga amazi meza kandi yizewe ku baturage binyuze mu kubaka no gucunga ibikorwa remezo byamazi. Cyashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2014, gifite icyicaro i Kigali, kandi gikora ibikorwa byacyo no mu bindi bihugu byo mu Karere ka Afurika y'Iburasirazuba
Water Access Rwanda yashinzwe muri 2014 hagamijwe gukemura ikibazo cy'ibura ry'amazi meza no guteza imbere uburyo burambye bwo kugeza amazi ku baturage. Kuva cyashingwa, ikigo cyagiye cyagura ibikorwa byacyo mu Rwanda ndetse no mu bihugu bituranye birimo Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, u Burundi na Uganda.
Intego ya Water Access Rwanda ni ugushyiraho ibikorwa remezo by'amazi byizewe, byoroshye kugerwaho kandi bihendutse muri Afurika.
Icyerekezo cy'ikigo ni uko amazi meza yaboneka ku buryo bworoshye "ku gufungura robine" (safe water at the turn of a tap)
Ingaruka kubaturage.
Nkuko imibare yatangajwe niki kigo igaragaza abaturage barenga 230,000 bafite amazi meza babikesha ibikorwa Water Access Rwanda kandi yubatse kandi icunga imiyoboro mito y’amazi (mini-grids) ifasha abaturage bo mu bice by’icyaro kubona amazi meza hafi yabo

Uburyo bugezweho bwo gutunganya amazi ni bumwe mu buryo bukoreshwa mu nganda n'imijyi hagamijwe guhangana n'ikibazo cy'ibura ry'amazi meza ku isi no mu Rwanda muri rusange. Bitewe n'ubwiyongere bw'abaturage, iterambere ry'imijyi, n'iry'ubukungu, amazi asanzwe ntabwo aba agihagije, bityo chimie n'ikoranabuhanga bikaba byarahaye inganda uburyo bushya bwo gutanga amazi meza yo guteka, kunywa, kuhira, n'ay'inganda.
= Uburyo 4 bwifashishwa mu gutunganya amazi =

Ikiraro Mpuzamahanga cya Rusumo ni ikiraro mpuzamahanga, cyafunguwe muri 2014, hakurya y'uruzi rw'Akagera. Gisimbura ikiraro cyahoze ari icya Rusomo cyahuzaga u Rwanda na Tanzaniya. Uyu mushinga watewe inkunga n'Ikigo Mpuzamahanga cy'Ubutwererane cy'Abayapani.

Uruzi rwa Mono ni rwo ruzi runini rwo mu burasirazuba bwa Togo.
Ufite uburebure bwa kilometero 400 (250 km), kandi utemba amazi mu kibaya kingana na kilometero kare 7.700 (7.700 sq mi), uzamuka hagati y'umujyi wa Sokodé n'umupaka na Benin, maze ugatemba ugana mu majyepfo. Mu gice cy'amajyepfo y'uruzi ugana ku munwa warwo, ugize umupaka mpuzamahanga hagati ya Togo na Benin. Uruzi rutemba mu kiyaga cya Benin runyuze mu nzira nini y'amazi y'umunyu n'ibiyaga, harimo n'ikiyaga cya Togo.[1] Igice cy'uruzi cyegereye umunwa warwo ni cyo cyonyine gishobora gukoreshwa mu mazi. Igice kinini cy'uruzi kiri ku kibaya cyo hejuru gihingwamo ibigori, ibirayi, umuceri, ipamba n'imyumbati.[2]
Uruzi rufite uruzitiro ruri ku ntera ya kilometero 160 (mi 99) uvuye ku munwa warwo n'urugomero rwa Nangbeto, ubufatanye hagati ya Benin na Togo bwarangiye mu 1987. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje inyungu z'ubukungu zikomoka kuri urwo rugomero, harimo ubukerarugendo n'uburobyi mu kiyaga kiri inyuma yarwo. Iyubakwa ry'urwo rugomero ryakuyeho abantu bari hagati ya 7.600 na 10.000, ariko ubushakashatsi bwerekana ko rwahinduye cyane ibidukikije by'ikiyaga kiri ku munwa w'uruzi binyuze mu kugabanya ihindagurika ry'ibihe mu gihe cy'amazi. Umushinga wa kabiri w'urugomero, Adjarala, watanzweho igitekerezo cyo kubakwa ku ruzi ruri hagati ya Nangbeto n'umunwa w'uruzi mu myaka ya 1990 [1] ariko ntirwabonye inkunga kugeza mu 2017 ubwo Ikigega cy'Iterambere ry'Ubushinwa n'Afurika cyemeye gushyigikira uyu mushinga. [2] Kubaka urwo rugomero ni kimwe mu bigize gahunda ya leta yo kongera ubushobozi bwo gutanga amashanyarazi mu gihugu cya Benin kuva kuri 20 kugeza kuri 70% kuko amashanyarazi menshi ya Togo na Benin agomba gutumizwa mu rugomero rwa Akosombo muri Ghana. [3]
Hafi ya kilometero 35 (22 mi) uvuye ku kanwa kayo, hari imigezi itandatu ikurikiranye. Munsi yayo, uruzi rugenda buhoro kandi rutemba mu kibaya cyuzuyemo imyuzure, kandi hari agace kanini k'ibishanga bihana imbibi muri Togo na Benin. Aka gace gafite urubingo rwinshi, sedges n'ibyatsi, kandi muri urwo ruzi harimo manatee, ingona n'imvubu.[1]

Uruzi rwa Afram ni uruzi rufite uburebure bwa kilometero 100 (mil 62) ruherereye muri Ghana. Mbere y'uko hubakwa urugomero rwa Akosombo mu myaka ya za 1960, Afram rwari rumwe mu nzuzi nini zisuka mu Ruzi rwa Volta. Muri iki gihe, rukomeje kuba uruzi rw'ingenzi rusuka mu kiyaga cya Volta (Lake Volta).
Uru ruzi rutembera rwerekeza ahanini mu majyepfo y'uberengerazuba (sourthwest) kandi rukusanya amazi yose ava mu migezi ya Kwahu, rukayageza mur Lake Volta.

Umugezi wa Kiwira ni uruzi ruherereye mu Karere ka Rungwe rukagera no mu Karere ka Kyela mu ntara ya Mbeya, mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya.
Uruzi ruzamuka mu misozi ya Poroto ahashyira mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'intara ya Mbeya kandi rubona imigezi myinshi ituruka ku misozi ya Rungwe, harimo Marogala, Sinini, Kipoke, Kilasi na Mulagala. Amasumo ya Kijungu ari ku nzira yo hejuru y'uruzi. Hanyuma atemba mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba akamanuka mu mpera y'amajyaruguru y'ikiyaga cya Malawi hafi y'umujyi wa Kyela. Inzira yo hasi inyura mu kibaya cya Kyela, kiri mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'ikiyaga cya Malawi mu kibaya cya East African Rift. Ikibaya cya Kyela gihingwa cyane hamwe n'umuceri n'ibindi bihingwa.

RUSUMO yari akarere(akarere)mu cyahoze ari intara yu Rwanda ya kibungo.Aka kaarere kavanyweho hamwe n'intara ya kibungo.mu kuvugurura inzego z'ibanze mu 2006. Abaturage 149.643(imibare 2002):ubuso:kilometero kar601.Itandukanijwe na tanzania n'umugezi wa kagera n'amazi ya Rusumo.
Hariho kandi umujyi wa iryo zina umujyi

Uruzi rwa Mwogo ni uruzi ruherereye mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda rutembera m'umugezi wa Nyabarongo.
Umugezi wa Mwogo uturuka mu gihugu cy’amashyamba mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda mu burasirazuba bw’igice cya Kongo-Nile. [1] Ukaba ufite amasoko mu murenge wa Kitabi mu Karere ka Nyamagabe. Unyura iburasirazuba unyuze Nyarusiza ukomeza mu Karere ka Huye. [2] Uca mu gice cy'amajyaruguru y’uburasirazuba bw' igihugu unyuze mu gice cy’uburengerazuba bw’aka karere, winjira mu karere ka Nyanza. [3] Mu karere ka Nyanza unyura mu majyaruguru y’uburasirazuba, unyura i Mweya aho uruzi rwa Gihimbi rwinjirira uturutse ibumoso. [4] Munsi y’iyi ngingo uhurira n’uruzi rwa Rukarara uturutse ibumoso. [2] Hanyuma ugizeumupaka w’iburengerazuba bw’Akarere ka Ruhango kugeza igihe uhurira ibumoso n’uruzi rwa Mbirurume mu majyepfo ya Bwakira. Umugezi uhuriweho witwa uruzi rwa Nyabarongo, rukomeza mu majyaruguru. [5] [a]
Mwogo ni imwe mu masoko y'ingenzi y'uruzi rwa Nyawarungu. [1] Ibipimo by'imvura n'amazi aturuka mu kirere kuri sitasiyo ya Nyabisindu bigaragaza ko ikibaya cy'uruzi rwa Mwogo gitanga amazi angana na. [8] Mu bice bimwe by'ikibaya cy'umugezi, imisozi yaciwemo ibiti, bitera isuri n'ibibazo byo kuzura umucanga. Harimo gushyirwamo imbaraga zo kongera gutera ibiti. [9] Mwogo na Rukarara ni byo bitanga isoko y'amazi y'umujyi wa Nyanza. [10]

Umugezi wa Ruvu uturuka mu majyepfo y'imisozi ya Uluguru, ukamanuka werekeza iburasirazuba ukagera mu Nyanja y'Ubuhinde hafi ya Bagamoyo. Umugezi wawo munini wisuka mo ni umugezi wa Ngerengere, uturuka mu majyaruguru ya Uluguru, ugatemba mu mujyi wa Morogoro mbere yo kwinjira muri Ruvu. Ruvu yambukanya ahantu hafite ubuso bwa11.789. km², harimo ibice by'akarere ka Morogoro na Pwani. Agace k'umugezi wa Wami kari mu majyaruguru no mu burengerazuba, naho agace k'umugezi wa Rufiji kari mu majyepfo.
Umugezi wa Ruvu ni isoko y'amazi y'ingenzi ku ngo, imirima ivomererwa, n'inganda zo mu duce turi ku nkengero z'uruzi. Ni nawo soko y'ingenzi y'amazi ya Dar es Salaam, umujyi munini muri Tanzaniya, uherereye ku nkombe z'iburasirazuba bw'umugezi wa Ruvu. Uhura n'ikibazo cy'umwanda ukabije uterwa no kurekura amazi y'ingo adasukuwe n'amazi mabi y'inganda mu ruzi.

Uruzi rwa Knysna (mu rurimi rw'ikinyafurika: Knysnarivier) ni uruzi rutemba mu ntara ya Cape y'Iburengerazuba muri Afurika y'Epfo. Rufite isoko mu misozi ya Outeniqua, mu karere ka Edeni, hanyuma rugana mu Nyanja y'Ubuhinde, aho rufungukira n'umugezi munini, aho hari umujyi wa Knysna, izina ryawo rikomoka ku ruzi. Inzira yarwo, ifite uburebure bwa kilometero 40, ni yo ishobora gukoreshwa mu bwato mu gice cyayo cya nyuma gusa.
Umunwa w'uruzi witwa Imitwe.
Izina Knysna ryagaragaye mu nyandiko zitandukanye kuva ahagana mu myaka ya 1770.[1] Ryitwaga 'Nysna' muri imwe mu nzandiko za mbere za James Callander, umusare wo muri Ecosse, woherejwe na guverinoma ya gikoloni ya Cape mu 1798 kugira ngo akore ubushakashatsi kandi atange raporo ku mashyamba, ibigobe n'imigezi byo muri ako karere. Yiyubakiye inzu muri The Heads. Ashushanya ikarita ya mbere y'uruzi rwa Knysna "Imbonerahamwe ya Knysna, Inkombe y'inyanja, Amaki arindwi mu burengerazuba bwa Plettenberg's Bay" kandi agaragaza igitekerezo cye cy'uko Knysna iruta kure Plettenberg Bay nk'ahantu ho kohereza ibiti.[2]

Urubuga rwa Bibiliya
Pishon (Igiheburayo: פִּישׁוֹן Pīšōn; Ikigereki Koine: Φισών Phisṓn) ni umwe mu nzuzi enye (hamwe na Hiddekel (Tigiri), Perath (Efurate) na Gihoni) zavuzwe mu gitabo cya Bibiliya cy'Intangiriro. Muri icyo gice, uruzi rutemba ruva muri Edeni ruvomera ubusitani bwa Edeni kandi kuva aho rugabanyamo imigezi ine yitwa imigezi. Pishon isobanurwa ko izengurutse "igihugu cyose cya Havila ahari zahabu; bdeliyumu n'ibuye rya onigisi." [2]
Bitandukanye na Tigiri na Efurate, Pishon ntabwo yigeze iboneka neza. Bivugwa muri make hamwe na Tigiri mu Bwenge bwa Siraki (24: 25/35), ariko iyi nyandiko ntigaragaza urumuri aho uruzi ruherereye. Umuhanga mu by'amateka y'Abayahudi n'Abaroma Flavius ​​Josephus, mu ntangiriro ya kera ya kera y'Abayahudi (mu kinyejana cya mbere nyuma ya Yesu) yerekanye Pishoni n'Agatsiko. [1] Umwarimu w’Abafaransa wo mu kinyejana cya 5 Rashi yabigaragaje na Nili.
Bamwe mu bahanga bo mu gihe cya none nka Antoine Augustin Calmet (1672–1757) n'abandi bantu bakurikiyeho nka Ernst Friedrich Karl Rosenmüller (1768–1835), na Carl Friedrich Keil (1807–1888), bizeraga ko uruzi rwakomokagaho [Edeni] rwari akarere k'amasoko: "Pishoni na Gihoni byari imigezi yo mu misozi. Iya mbere ishobora kuba yari Phasis cyangwa Araxes, naho iya nyuma ikaba Oxus."[1]
James A. Sauer, wahoze ari umuyobozi w’Ingoro Ndangamurage ya Semitic ya Harvard, yavuze ashingiye ku bumenyi bw’isi n’amateka ko Pishon yerekezaga ku cyahoze ari Wadi al-Batin, umuyoboro w’amazi w’amazi usanzwe uturuka mu misozi ya Hijaz hafi ya Medina, ugana mu majyaruguru y’uburasirazuba ugana muri Koweti. [1] Akoresheje amafoto ya satelite, Farouk El-Baz wo muri Kaminuza ya Boston yakurikiranye umuyoboro w’amazi uturutse muri Koweti ugana kuri Wadi al-Batin n’umuyoboro wa Wadi al-Rummah uturuka hafi ya Medina kuri Jibāl al Abyaḑ. [2]
David Rohl yavuze ko Pishoni ari Uizhun, [agace gakenewe] gashyira Havila mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Mezopotamiya. Uizhun izwi muri ako gace nk'uruzi rwa Zahabu. Izamuka hafi y'umugezi wa stratovolcano Sahand, inyura hagati y'ibirombe bya zahabu bya kera n'imirongo ya lapis lazuli mbere yo kugaburira inyanja ya Kaspiyani. Uwo mutungo kamere uhuye n'uwo mu gihugu cya Havila mu Itangiriro.[1]
Dan'el Kahn wo muri Kaminuza ya Haifa yavuze ko izina Pishon rishobora kuba ryaraturutse ku ijambo ryo mu Misiri pA-Shen, risobanura inyanja. Ikarita y'Isi ya Babiloni yita inyanja "uruzi rusharira".[1]Itangiriro 2:10

Uruzi rwa Chambeshi (cyangwa Chambezi) rwo mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'igihugu cya Zambiya ni rwo ruzi rufite uburebure bunni cyane kurusha uruzi rwa Kongo (mu burebure) bityo rukaba rufatwa nk'isoko y'uruzi rwa Kongo. (Ariko, ukurikije ingano y'amazi, uruzi rwa Lualaba rutanga mumigezi myinshi igana muri Kongo.)
Chambeshi izamuka nk'umugezi mu misozi yo mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Zambiya hafi y'ikiyaga cya Tanganyika ku butumburuke bwa hejuru y'inyanja. Itemba ku gipimo cya 480 km mu bishanga bya Bangweulu, biri mu kiyaga cya Bangweulu. Mu mpera z'igihe cy'imvura muri Gicurasi, uruzi ruzana umwuzure ukongera amazi mu bishanga kandi ukazura ubwatsi bwa Zambezi mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba. Amazi ahita atemba ava mu bishanga nk'uruzi rwa Luapula.
Ku bantu barenga 100 km y'uburebure bwarwo uko rutemba mu burasirazuba bwa Kasama, uruzi rugizwe n'imiyoboro myinshi mu bishanga bigera kuri 2 ubugari bwa km, mu kibaya cyuzuyemo amazi kugeza kuri 25 Ubugari bwa kilometero. Munsi y'uruzi, aho ruhurira n'umuhanda wa Kasama-Mpika na gari ya moshi ya Tazara, umuyoboro munini uhoraho ufite ubugari bwa metero 100, kandi ubugari bwa metero 400 mu gihe cy'umwuzure.

Cuvo ni uruzi ruri muri Angola yo hagati. Umugezi uturuka ku nyanja ya Atalantika ku kigobe cya Benguela, mu ntara ya Cuanza Sul. Kwitwa Cuvo byavuye mu nkengero z'uru ruzi zo hejuru, inzira yo hasi yitwa Keve cyangwa Queve. Uruzi rushobora kugendwamo n'amato ugana ku masumo ya Binga hafi ya Gabela.
Inkombe zayo z'ingenzi zirimo uruzi rwa Cussoi.
Uruzi rushobora kuba ari rwo ruherereye mu majyepfo y'ubwoko bw'inyoni zo muri Afurika. Ikibaya cya amazi cy'uruzi n'ishyamba rya Kumbira ni bimwe mu bigize ahantu h'ingenzi h'inyoni hafite amoko menshi y'inyoni adakunze kuboneka ahandi hantu.
Umunwa w'uruzi ufite ahantu hameze nk'ibiti bya mangrove.

Uruzi rwa koko ni uruzi ruherereye mukarere ka rusizi mumajyepfo y'iburengerazuba bw' u rwanda.rukaba ari uzuzi rw'ruhwa rutembera iburyo rugize umupaka uhuza uturere tw'iburengerazuba bw'urwanda n'u burundi mu burebure bwarwo bwinshi runyura muri pariki y'igihugu ya Nyungwe

Uruzi rwa makhaleng ni uruzi rwo mu burengerazuba bwa lesotho. Ruzamuka mu misozi ya maloti, muri rusange rutemba mu cyerekezo cy'amajyepfo rugan ku ruzi rwa Orange ku mupaka na Free State muri Afurika y'epfo.
uruzi rutukura mu majyaruguru y'uburengera y'uburengerazuba, ku butumburuke bwa metero 2,886 (ft 9,469) mu misozi ya Machache iri muri Maluti. Rutemba rugana mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba, rukanyura mu misozi miremire ya lesotho, rukanyura,ruknyura mu mijyi n'imidugud nka Molimo-nthuse, Makhaleng, Ramabanta na Qaba. Nyuma yaho, rwisuka mu ruzi rwa Orange ku mupaka uhuza Free State n'igihugu cya Lesotho, hafi y'ikiraro cya Makhaleng. Ku butumburuke bwa metero 1,400 (ibirenge 4,593), ahantu uru ruzi rwa Makhaleng rwisukira mu rwa Orange ni ho hantu h'ubutumburuke buke kurusha ahandi hose muri Lesotho.

Umugezi Agwei cyangwa umugezi wa Agwei, nanone wandika Agvey, ni umugezi utemba mu ruzi rwa Pibor runyura mu burasirazuba bwa Sudani y'Amajyepfo. Imigezi yarwo irimo imigezi ya Abara na Kongkong. Umugezi ni "wadi", cyangwa ravine, gishobora kuma mu gihe cy'izuba ariko kigahita kiba umuyoboro w'amazi bitewe n'imvura nyinshi mu gihe cy'imvura.

Umugezi wa Storms (Afrikaans) n'uruzi ruri muntara ya Cape y'Iburasirazuba muri Afurika y'Epfo. Umugezi uturuka muri Pariki y'Igihugu ya Tsitsikamma. Inzira ya Otter y'iminsi 5 itangirira kumugezi wa Storms.

uruzi rwa Adabay ni uruzi rwo muri etiyopiya yo hagati hamwe n'uruzi rwa wanchet,rwagennye akarere kahoze ari marra Biete.Inkombe zarwo zirimo chacha,beresa,n'indi migezi itatu ihurira hejuru y'umugezi muremure.

Uruzi rwa Maputo (Portuguese), Ndetse rukunze kwitwa Great Usutu, uruzi rwa Lusutfu, cyangwa uruzi rwa Suthu, ni uruzi rwo muri Afurika y'Epfo, Eswatini, na Mozambike. Izina "Suthu" risobanura abaturage ba Basotho bari batuye hafi yarwo, ariko Swaziland yabagabagaho ibitero. Ndeste bikaba bivugwa ko ryasonara ibara ryumukara wijimye, kandi bisobanura amazi y'urwondo yo mu ruzi. Hagati aho izina Maputo risobanura Umwami Mabhudu Tembe, wategetse mu kinyejana cya XVIII muri ako karere.
Uruzi ruzamuka hafi ya Amsterdam, Mpumalanga, Afurika y'Epfo, Eswatini akaba ariho runyura muburas, aho rwinjira mu misozi ya Lebombo. Ikibaya cya km kigize umupaka uri hagati ya Eswatini na Afurika y'Epfo. Ku birometero bigera kuri makumyabiri, kigize umupaka uri hagati ya Afurika y'Epfo (intara ya Kwazulu-Natali) na Mozambike. Aho ngaho, muri Pariki y'inyamaswa ya Ndumo, yinjirira umugezi wayo munini, uruzi rwa Pongola. Uhita unyura mu kibaya cyo ku nkombe za Mozambike ukamena cyangwase ukisuka mu majyepfo ya Maputo Bay, nko muri kilometero 85 uvuye aho.
Muri Eswatini, uruzi rwitwa Great Usutu cyangwa Lusutfu rutemba no mu mujyi ya Bhunya, Luyengo, Siphofaneni, na Big Bend. Umujyi wa Big Bend uri hafi y'aho uruzi runyura mu buryo butunguranye. Great Usutu ni wo mugezi munini muri Eswatini, niho hari agace gato ka Eswatini (metero 21 hejuru y'inyanja), kandi azwiho kugira amazi yurwererane.ndetse nta ni mijyi minini yabashije kwirema ku hafi yaarwo kubera ibibaya ibibaya birerire bito na mashyamba menshi. Ariko, niho hari ibibuga bimwe na bimwe bya golf, amahoteli, n'ibidukikije.
Kuva inkomoko kugeza ku munwa, uko bikurikirana, imigezi ni: Sihanahana, Bonnie Brook, Mpuluzi, Buhlungu, Umvenvane, Lusushwana, Sidvokodvo, Mkhondvo, Mhlamani, Mzimneni, Mzimphofu, Mhlathuzane, Mtsindzekwa, Nyetane, Funuane R,

Uruzi rwa South Fork Kern ni umugezi utembamo uruzi rwa Kern muri Sierra Nevada muri leta ya California muri Amerika. Ni rumwe mu migezi iri mu majyepfo cyane ku musozi w’iburengerazuba bw’imisozi, kandi rutemba amazi mu gihugu cy’imisozi miremire kandi yumye ifite ku nkengero za Sierra Crest. Agace ko hejuru k'Amajyepfo gaca mu mikokwe miremire, ariko kandi gatuma amazi mu kibaya gishashe kandi cyuzuye ibishanga mbere yo kwinjira mu ruzi rwa Kern ku kiyaga cya Isabella.
Uruzi rutangirira mu ishyamba rya Leta rya Inyo (Inyo National Forest), ku ruhande rwa Tulare ku murongo utandukanya Inyo County na Tulare County, mu kibaya gito ku mpinga ya Sierra Crest, hafi y'inzira ya Pacific Crest Trail. Uruzi runyura mu majyepfo, runyura mu bibaya n'imigezi migari, rugenda rwegera cyane Golden Trout Creek, umugezi w'uruzi rwa Kern uri iburengerazuba. Igice kinini cy'inzira y'uruzi mu majyepfo kiri hafi gato y'iburengerazuba bwa Owens Valley, ikibaya kiri iburasirazuba ku musozi wa Sierra.
Hanyuma uruzi rwinjira mu ishyamba rya Sequoia National Forest maze rufata Trout Creek iburyo. Ukinjira mu mwobo, uruzi runyura mu buso -umugezi munini mbere yo kuva mu misozi hafi ya Onyx. Aho niho wakira umugezi wa Canebrake hanyuma ukerekeza mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba. Hanyuma South Fork Kern inyura muri Weldon na Kern River Preserve. Iyo yegereye ikiyaga cya Isabella amazi yayo yihuta agenda buhoro buhoro akwirakwira mu bishanga binini. Uruzi rwinjira mu kigega kiri ku mpera y'uruzi ruto. Aho rwahuriraga n'uruzi rwa Kern ruri munsi y'ikiyaga, cyagizwe n'urugomero rwa Isabella.
Ikibaya cy'uruzi rwa Lower South Fork Kern cyigeze guturwa n'ubwoko bwa Tübatulabal na Kawaiisu. Abantu bamaze imyaka igera ku 3.000 batuye ku nkengero z'uruzi. Mu 1834, Joseph R. Walker n'itsinda rye ry'abashakashatsi basuye ku nkengero z'uruzi bagerageza gushaka inzira yo hasi inyura mu misozi ya Sierra Nevada. Mu rugendo rwabo, bavumbuye Walker Pass, kilometero imwe hejuru y'inyanja, iri ku isoko ry'umugezi wa Canebrake, uruzi runini rwa South Fork. Walker yagarutse mu 1843, ayoboye itsinda rya mbere ry'abimukira bambuka Sierra banyuze muri iyo nzira. Ibitero bya zahabu byazanye abacukuzi b'amabuye y'agaciro muri ako gace mu myaka ya 1850 na 1860, kandi imiturire ya mbere ihoraho ku nkengero z'uruzi yubatswe mu 1859. Habayeho amakimbirane hagati y'abashya n'abaturage kavukire, maze umutwe w'ingabo za Amerika, Camp Leonard, ushingwa ku ruzi kugira ngo ugenzure ako gace.
Igice kinini cy'uruzi gitemba amazi menshi – nta ngomero zirimo kandi hari inzira nke zo kunyuramo – uretse kimwe gusa. Mu 1953, urugomero rwa Isabella rwubatswe ku ruzi rwa Kern hafi ya Bodfish n'ingabo za Amerika zishinzwe injeniyeri, rwuzura ibice byo hasi bya North Fork Kern (igiti kinini kiri hejuru ya Isabella) na South Fork Kern munsi y'ikiyaga cya Isabella kugira ngo rutange uburyo bwo kugenzura imyuzure n'amashanyarazi. Ariko, habayeho ibibazo ku nyubako y'urugomero, bitera ibyago byinshi byo kwangirika. Gusenyuka k'urugomero, bishobora guterwa n'umutingito ku cyuho cya Kern Canyon kiri munsi y'inyubako, bishobora kurenga umujyi wa Bakersfield mu masaha make.
Byongeye kandi, ibibaya bya Kern yo hepfo, South Fork Kern na Canebrake Creek bitanga inzira y'ingenzi yo gutwara abantu. Umuhanda wa Leta ya California 178 unyuramo, uhuza Bakersfield na Inyokern, biri ku mpande zombi za Sierra, unyuze kuri Walker Pass. SR178 ni imwe mu nzira nke zinyura muri iki gice cy'imisozi. Uyu muhanda watangiye kubakwa mu myaka ya 1890. Wongewe kuri sisitemu y'imihanda ya leta ya California mu 1919, kandi wakozwemo kaburimbo mu 1940.

Uruzi rwa Munyati (ruzwi ku izina ry'uruzi rwa Umniati) ruri muri Zimbabwe. Ku butegetsi bwa Rhodesiya, rwitiriwe Umniati, ariko imyandikire yarwo yahinduwe mu maka 1983 kugira ngo rumeze neza n'imvugo nyayo ya shona.
Uruzi ruturuka mu burasirazuba bwa Mashonalande, mu majyaruguru ya chivuhu, kandi rugera kubiro metero 100 mu majyepfo ya Harare. Utembera hafi mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba kandi igice kinini cy'uburebure bwawo cyabanje kuba umupaka w'amajyepfo y'intara ya Mashonalande. Uruzi ruhuriraho n'uruzi rwa Mupfure (ruzwi kandi nka Umfuli). Munsi y'iyi ngingo, uru ruzi rukunze kwitwa Sanyati. Nyuma y'amazi agera ku ibiro metero 500 uruzi rutemba rujya muri Kariba (igice cya Zambezi kiri hagati y'urugomero rwa Kariba n'ikibaya cya Batoka), bigatuma kiba igice cy'umugezi cya Zambezi.
Uruzi rurahinduka cyane, rugaragaza itandukaniro rikomeye mu miterere y'ikirere hagati y'ibihe by'izuba n'iby'imvura. Hagati y'Ukuboza na Gicurasi rutemba cyane kandi rugera kuri metero 3 mu bujyakuzimu ku kibaya, mu bugari (nubwo ari ndende kuva kuri metero 80 kugeza 100 ayi cy'umwaka, iragabanuka cyane kandi itemba buhoro, akenshi metero 2 gusa ndende, kandi hafi yumuka mu bihe bidasanzwe mu gihe cy'amapfa akomeye; nk'uko byaherukaga mu 1984.
Igitonyanga kinini ku ruzi kiri ku Masumo ya Gandavaroyi. Nk’uko bivugwa mu rurimi rw’igishona, "ganda" bivuga " gutera ", naho "varoyi" bivuga "abapfumu", "mu buryo busanzwe bwo gusiga no gukoresha neza, abaturage bo muri ako gace bise cataract bakurikije umuco mwiza bari bafite wo gutera abapfumu bazwiho kuba hejuru y’isumo. Aha hantu byakekwaga ko ari hera kandi kugeza n’uyu munsi, abaturage bake ni bo bakunda gusura aha hantu. Nyuma y’iki gitonyanga, umugezi munini ni uruzi rwa Mvumvuze runyura muri Vashe.

Uruzi rwa Kulfo ni uruzi ruri mu majyepfo ya Etiyopiya ruzamuka mu gice cy'iburengerazuba cy'agasozi ka Etiyopiya gakomeye mu misozi ya Guge.
Inyura muri Arba Minch hanyuma ikanyura muri Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nechisar ku gice cy'ubuso kiri hagati y'ikiyaga cya Chamo n'ikiyaga cya Abaya. Ubusanzwe imanuka mu kiyaga cya Chamo ariko ishobora no kumanuka mu kiyaga cya Abaya nyuma y'imvura nyinshi inyuze mu gace k'uburengerazuba bw'amajyepfo y'ikibuga cy'indege cya Arba Minch.
Ahantu ho hasi h'uruzi rwa Kulfo hakora nk'inzira y'amazi yinjira mu kiyaga cya Abaya mu kiyaga cya Chamo iyo hari ikiyaga kinini. Aho amazi y'amazi yiyongereye haba munsi y'umufana w'amazi ku butumburuke bwa metero 1.190 (kuri 6°00′39″N 37°35′07″E﻿ / ﻿6.0109°N 37.5854°E). Hanyuma amazi y'ikiyaga asohoka mu kiyaga cya Chamo.[1]
Ikiraro cy'ingenzi ku ruzi cyaravuguruwe mu 2006. Uruzi rwumye cyane mu myaka ya vuba aha.
Ni uruzi rufite ubugari bwa metero 300. Rufite ubugari bwa metero 20 hafi y'umunwa warwo, rufite ubuhaname bwa metero 10/km. Ubugari bw'imyenda yo kuryamaho ni mm 14 (urubura).[1]
Ubwikorezi bw'imyanda.
Uruzi rutwara toni 53.480 z'imitwaro yo kuryamaho na toni 327.230 z'ibishanga birekuye buri mwaka mu kiyaga cya Chamo.[1]
Udukoko two mu turere dushyuha.
Isesengura rya cytotaxonomic rya chromosomes z'ibibuno zo mu gace k'uruzi rwa Kulfo ryagaragaje ko hari ubwoko bubiri bushya bw'udusimba tw'umukara mu ruzi, Simulium kulfoense na S. soderense; nyamara bitandukanye n'izindi dusimba tw'umukara, ubwo bwoko si bwo butwara Onchocerca volvulus.[1]

Uruzi rwa Comaile (nanone rwitwa Komalie) rufite isoko hagati y'imijyi ya Adi Keyh na Senafe. Rutemba rugana mu burasirazuba bwa Eritrea kugeza mu mujyi muto wa Foro hafi y'inkombe z'inyanja itukura. Aha hantu ruhurira n'izindi nzuzi ebyiri, uruzi rwa Aligide n'uruzi rwa Haddas. Kuva aha rukomeza kugeza rusendereye mu Nyanja itukura.[1]: 2
Finlinson, George T.; Reclamation, Ibiro bya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bya (1962). Raporo ku mushinga wa Zula Plain, Eritrea (Raporo). Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere mpuzamahanga.

Uruzi rwa Atakora ni umugezi w’ikiyaga cya Volta muri Ghana, rutemba nko muri kilometero 60 ugana iburasirazuba bw’ikiyaga cya Volta. Inzira yarwo yose iri mu majyepfo ya Ghana.[1]

Umugezi wa Alwero (nanone wandikwa Aloru, Aluoro na Alwero) ni umugezi muri Abobo wearda wo mu karere ka Gambela, muri Etiyopiya. Itemba muri parike y'igihugu ya Gambela no mu bishanga ukaruhukira mu ruzi rwa Openo / Baro.
Mu mwaka wa 2012, Saudi Star yateganyaga kuyobya amazi menshi ava mu ruzi anyuze mu umuyoboro wa sima wo kuhira umuceri.

Aguelmame Sidi Ali ni ikiyaga cyo mu Ntara ya Khénifra, Béni Mellal-Khénifra, muri Maroc. Aguelmame Sidi Ali iherereye ku butumburuke bwa metero 2,080, ifite ubuso bungana na n'uburebure bwa. Iri hafi y'umupaka w'intara ya Ifrane mu misozi ya Middle Atlas. Ni igice cya Pariki y'Igihugu ya Khenifra, agace karinzwe kashinzwe mu 2008.
Ikiyaga giherereye mu misozi ya Middle Atlas ku butumburuke bwa kandi ifite ubuso bungana na. Yakorewe muri Upper Miocene / Quaternary aho ibice bibiri bihurira. Iherereye mu mwobo karemano mu rutare rwa basalt kandi ikorwa mu bibaya bibiri, bitandukanyijwe n'umuraba w'amazi ugaragara iyo urugero rw'amazi rugabanutse. Itungwa n'amazi atemba, urubura rushonga n'amasoko ya karst. pH ni 9.1 kandi ubutare burimo ni buke cyane hamwe n'ubushobozi bwo gutwara amashanyarazi bwa 1200–1600 uScm-1.
Ubumenyi bw'ibidukikije.
Agace gakikije ikiyaga kari gafite amashyamba meza arimo Atlas cedar ("Cedrus atlantica"), ariko vuba aha, iri shyamba ryangiritse kandi agace gakikije ikiyaga kabaye ibihuru byumye, byuzuye amahwa byiganjemo juniper yo muri Esipanye ("Juniperus thurifera"). Plankton n'ibimera biri mu kiyaga bikungahaye kuri diatome, cyane cyane ibyo mu bwoko bwa "Cyclotella", kandi ibi byakoreshejwe mu gutanga ibimenyetso by'imiterere y'ikirere n'impinduka zijyanye n'ikirere cy'amazi mu kiyaga mu myaka myinshi ishize.
Mu mwaka wa 2005, Aguelmams Sidi Ali / Tifounassine complex, ibishanga bitatu byo mu misozi biri ku butumburuke buri hagati ya, byagizwe ahantu ha Ramsar; bitanga ahantu hakomeye ho gucumbikira inyoni zo mu bishanga zimuka mu gihe cy'itumba harimo n'inyoni zo mu bwoko bwa ruddy shelduck ("Tadorna ferruginea") n'inyoni zo mu bwoko bwa crested coot ("Fulica cristata"). Kugabanuka kw'imvura byatumye amazi y'ikiyaga agabanuka, kandi igishanga cyari kiri ku mpera y'uburengerazuba bw'amajyepfo ntikikiriho. Kuba abashumba b'inka n'ihene baragiraga amashyo y'intama n'ihene mu mpeshyi no mu mpeshyi byakuyeho ibimera byo mu mazi ku nkengero z'ikiyaga. Umubare muto w'inyoni zo mu mazi zisura ikiyaga mu gihe cy'itumba kandi inyoni nini yo mu bwoko bwa crested grebe ntiyororokera hano. Nubwo irinzwe, inyoni zo mu bwoko bwa ruddy shelduck n'izindi nyoni zo mu gasozi zihura n'ubujura bw'amafi.
Iki kiyaga cyari ahantu honyine ku isi habaga "Salmo pallaryi", ubwoko bw'inyamaswa zo mu bwoko bwa trout, ariko ayo mafi yarazimye nyuma y'uko inyoni yo mu bwoko bwa common carp ("Cyprinus carpio") irekuwe mu kiyaga mu 1934. Pike yo mu majyaruguru ("Esox lucius") na zander ("Sander lucioperca"), ni andi moko y'amafi atari ay'umwimerere nayo yazanywe muri icyo kiyaga.

Volta y'umweru cyangwa Nakambé (mu gifaransa: Volta blanche) ni yo nkomoko y'uruzi rwa Volta, umuyoboro w'amazi mukuru wa Ghana.[1][2] Volta y'umweru ituruka mu majyaruguru ya Burkina Faso, inyura mu majyaruguru ya Ghana ikajya mu kiyaga cya Volta muri Ghana.[1] Imigezi ikomeye ya Volta y'umweru ni Volta y'umukara na Volta y'umutuku.[1]
Volta Yera ni imwe mu migezi y’ingenzi y’uruzi rwa Volta. Ituruka muri Burkina Faso nka Nakanbé ikamanuka mu majyepfo igana mu majyaruguru ya Ghana kugira ngo ikore ikiyaga cya Volta.[3] Ikibaya cy’uruzi rwa Volta kigizwe n’ibibaya by’amazi by’uruzi rwa Volta n’amashami yarwo atandukanye, harimo ibibaya by’amazi bya Volta Yera, Volta Yirabura, Volta Itukura, Oti, na Volta yo hasi.[4]
Ikibaya cya White Volta giherereye mu bice bimwe na bimwe bya Burkina Faso na Gana. Muri Gana, White Volta ni ingenzi mu karere k'amajyaruguru y'igihugu, aho itanga amahirwe yo kubaho mu cyaro binyuze mu buhinzi bwo mu bibaya byuzuyemo imyuzure, kuhira amatungo, kuroba no gukoresha amazi yo mu ngo.[5] Akamaro kayo kari mu kuba umuyoboro w'amazi yo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba anyura mu turere dutandukanye twa Volta.
Volta Yera ihera ku ruzi rwitwa Nakanbé muri Burkina Faso. Volta Itukura, cyangwa Nazinon, kimwe na Sissili, ni bibiri mu migezi minini ya Volta Yera, kandi ikomoka no muri Burkina Faso.[4] Hariho kandi Volta Yirabura, cyangwa Mouhoun, imwe mu mashami y'ingenzi muri sisitemu ya Volta; icyakora, igomba gufatwa ukwayo nk'isoko ry'uruzi rwa Volta rwose.[4][3]
Imigezi ya White Volta iha uruzi akamaro karwo mu karere kubera ko amazi n'ubushobozi bwo kuzura ku nkengero z'uruzi biterwa n'ingano y'imvura muri Burkina Faso.[6]
Volta y'umweru ni isoko ikomeye y'amazi yo kunywa ku baturage benshi bo ku nkengero zayo no kure y'umuyoboro w'amazi. Inatera imyuzure mu bihe by'umwaka ku baturage benshi bo ku nkengero zayo.[7]

Nini ni uruzi ruri mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Ghana. Ni rumwe mu ruzi rwahawe izina rya Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nini-Suhien (ubu ibarizwa mu gace gashinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije ka Ankasa).[1] Itemba mu ruzi rwa Tano.

Coporolo ni uruzi rugenda ruhagarara muri Angola. Rutemba muri Dombe Grande mu Ntara ya Benguela. Hari igihe rwafatwaga nk'umugezi uhoraho.[1] Inka yarwo iri ku Nyanja ya Atalantika kandi ubuso bw'amazi bugera kuri kilometero kare 15,674 (6,052 mi).
Imyuzure y'ibihe ni ikibazo gikomeje kugaragara aho abantu 6.700 bakuwe mu byabo bazize umwuzure muri Nyakanga 2011. [2] Imirimo yo kugenzura imyuzure y'ibihe kugira ngo barinde umujyi n'imirima yagombaga gukorwa mu mwaka ukurikiyeho.

Uruzi rwa Faro ni umugezi ufite uburebure bwa kilometero 310 utemba ukata ku mupaka uhuza Nijeriya na Kameruni muri Afurika. Uyu mugezi ukomoka mu gace k'imisozi miremire twa Adamawa (Adamawa Plateau) gasanzwe gaherereye mu majyepfo y’uburasirazuba bw’umujyi wa Ngaoundéré, mu Karere ka Adamawa muri Kameruni. Faro iza kwisuka mu ruzi rwa Benue, aho rurema ihuriro ryazo neza neza ku mupaka uhuza ibi bihugu byombi

Angereb izwi kandi nka Bahr as-Salam ni umugezi wo muri Etiyopiya na Sudani y'iburasirazuba, rukaba rumwe mu masoko ya Nili. Ruzamuka hafi ya Daqwa, mu majyaruguru y'umujyi wa Gondar mu Karere ka Amhara, rutemba rugana iburengerazuba rugana ku ruzi rwa Atbarah. Akarere k'amateka ka Armachiho gaherereye ku nzira yako.
Urugomero rwa Angereb, rwatangiye gukoreshwa mu mwaka wa 1997, rwari rugamije gukemura ikibazo cy'amazi meza mu mujyi mu gihe cy'imyaka 25. Ikigega cya Angereb n'amasoko y'amazi yo munsi y'ubutaka abiri ni byo bitanga amazi menshi muri uyu mujyi, hamwe n'ubushobozi bwo gukora bwa metero kube 8,298 ku munsi.

Uruzi rwa Black Kei, ruva mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Queenstown, nyuma rugahura n'uruzi rwa White Kei, zikabyara uruzi rwa Great Kei. Imidugudu myinshi iherereye ku nkombe zarwo, harimo McBride Village, Qabi, Ntabelanga, Thornhill, Loudon, Mitford, Basoto, Baccle's Farm na Tentergate.
Urugomero rwa Thrift ni rwo rugira akamaro gakomeye nk' ikigega cy' amazi kuri uruzi. Kuri ubu uru ruzi ni igice cya..
Igice cyo hejuru cy'uru ruzi kigize umupaka wo mu burengerazuba Tsolwana Nature Reserve, kandi hagati mu myaka ya 1800, Black Kei n'umugezi wayo wa Klipplaat byagize urubibi rw'amajyaruguru rwa Kaffraria y'Abongereza. Imigezi ya Klaas Smits na Klipplaat niyo migezi ikomeye igeramo.

Uruzi rwa Kulpawn ni rumwe mu migezi minini yo mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Ghana, hamwe n'imigezi ya Black Volta na Sisili. Rutemba mu Karere ka Municipal ka Wa.[1] Ishyamba ry'inkombe rikikije inkengero za Kulpawn muri Wahabu rikunzwe cyane n'abahanga mu by'inyoni, bitewe n'ubwoko bwinshi bw'inyoni.[2].
