Inshamake ku ntambara ya Iran na USA.
Kuva uyu mwaka watangira hagiye humvikana gushyamirana ndetse no kumvikana hgati y'igihugu cya iran ndetse na america zimwe mu mpamvu nyamukuru wamenya zazamuye uyu mwuka utari mwiza hagati y'ibi bihugu bibiri harimo gahunda yicurwa z'intwaro za kirimbuzi ya Iran. Kuva uyu mwaka watangira America yakomeje kwikoma gahunda ya Iran yikorwa ryibitwaro bya kirimbuzi aribyo byagiye bituma America ifatira Iran ibihano by'ubukungu bikomeye.
America kandi yakomeje gushinja Iran ubufatanye ndetse n'imikoranire yahafi n' imitwe yo mu karere nkiri muri Iraq, Syria, Yemen ndetse na Lebanon, igenzura ry'umuhora wa Hormuz nacyo nikimwe mubyakomeje kuzambya umubano hagati y'ibi bihugu dore ko ari hamwe muho petroli nyinshi inyura kwisi. Poltiki n'inyungu mu burasuirazuba bwo hagati nabyo nikimwe mu byakomeje kugarukwaho muri iyi mibanire itari myiza.
Ubushyamirane Hagati y'ibihugu byombi.
Nubwo uyu mwaka aribwo ubushyamirane bwagaragaye cyane ariko,ubu bushyamirane nubwa kera. Guhera 2003 kugera 2010 Iran na America bishinjanya kugira uruhare mu ntambara ya Iraq ndetse n'uruhare rw'impande zombi mu karere. Ku wa 3 Mutarama 2020 america yari iyobowe na perezida Donald Trump yategetse indege itagira umudereva(drone) kwataka mu murwa mukuru wa Iraq i Baghdad, muri icyo gitero hiciwemo General Qasem Soleiman umuyobozi ukomeye wa Iran muri Quds force akaba yari umwe mu bayobozi ba Iran bakomeye mu bikorwa byo hanze,America yo ivugako yishe uyu mugabo kubw'uruhare rwe mu gushyigikira ibitero ku basirikare ba America muri iraq. Nyuma yiki igikorwa Iran yasubije ivuga ko izihorera.
Guhera mu mwaka wa 2025 ibitero hagati ya America na Iran byaratangiye.America yatangiye ibitero ku bikorwa bya kirimbuzi bya Iran, Iran nayo muburyo bwo gusubiza yahise igaba ibitero ku birindiro bya America mu karere ndetse hiyongeraho n' ibitero bya done na misile. Sibyo gusa kuko Iran yatangiye guhungabanya ubukungu binyuze mu gufunga inzira ya Hormuz, iyi ikaba ari inzira inyuramo hafi 20% ya peteroli y'isi. Ibi ntibyagize ingaruka ku bukungu bw'America gusa kuko byagize ingaruka kubukungu bwisi yose muri rusange,ibiciro bya peteroli byarazamutse cyane ibi byatumye america yongera ingabo mu nyanja mu rwego rwo gutera ubwoba Iran.
Gusa kumunsi wanone hagiye haba intambwe y'amahoro aho hagiye haba ibiganiro by'amahoro ku mpande zombi mu buryo bwo guhagarika intambara. Hateguwe amasezerano yo gufungura umuhora wo Hormuz, kugabanya ibihano kuri Iran, ibiganiro ku ntwaro za kirimbuzi ndetse n'ibindi. Gusa nubwo ibyo byose biba haracyagaragara kutizerana hagati y'impande zombi, ndetse n'ibiganiro hagati ya Iran na America bituzuye.

KADUHA ni umwe mumirenge cuminirindwi igize akarere ka Nyamagabe muntara y'amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Uhana imbibi nimirenge nka Musange, Mushubi na Gatare mukarere yo mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, ndetse Nyagisozi wo mu Karere ka Nyanza tutibagiwe Umurenge wa Twumba wo muri karongi.Numurenge ugizwe nutugari dutanu aritwo ;
Uyu murenge Muri Repubulika ya Mbere n'Iya Kabiri, Mu rwego rw'imitegekere y'igihugu ya kera, wari Komini (Commune Kaduha) yabarizwaga muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro mucyahoze cyitwa gikongoro.Amateka mabi ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 naho kimwe n'ibindi bice byari bigize icyahoze ari Gikongoro (byaranzwe n'ubugome n'ugutonesha by'abayobozi b'icyo gihe nka Bucyibaruta na n'abandi), Kaduha yagize amateka ababaje cyane. Abatutsi benshi b’i Kaduha n’abari bahatungutse baturutse mu bice bihakikije barahahungiye (cyane cyane ku Kiliziya Gatolika n'Ibitaro bya Kaduha).

Ikiyaga cya Rwanyakazinga ni ikiyaga cyo mu Rwanda. Kiri muri Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ni ikiyaga cya kabiri kinini muri pariki, nyuma y'Ikiyaga cya Ihema. Gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 19,6. Amazi yacyo si maremare. Abarobyi barobamo amafi. Ba mukerarugendo bagitemberamo mu bwato.
Ikiyaga cya Rwanyakazinga kiri mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Pariki y'Akagera. Gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 19,6. Umuzenguruko wacyo ni kilometero 43,7. Gifite uburebure bwa kilometero 10,3 n'ubugari bwa kilometero 4,3. Ubujyakuzimu ntarengwa bwacyo ni metero 4,3. Ubujyakuzimu bwo hagati ni metero 2,6.
Igice cy'amajyaruguru cy'ikiyaga kiri mu Murenge wa Karangazi, mu Akarere ka Nyagatare. Igice cy'amajyepfo kiri mu Murenge wa Rwimbogo, mu Akarere ka Gatsibo. Mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'ikiyaga hari Ikiyaga cya Mihindi.
Ibiyaga byombi biri hafi y'Umugezi wa Kagera, mu bishanga by'Akagera. Ibiyaga byinshi ntibihora bihuye n'umugezi wa Kagera. Bihura na wo mu gihe cy'imvura gusa. Igihe cy'imvura kiba kabiri mu mwaka. Muri icyo gihe, imigezi mito myinshi na yo itemba igana mu biyaga. Ni yo mpamvu urugero rw'amazi ruhinduka hagati ya metero 1 na metero 1,5. Imvura igwa mu karere ni milimetero 650 kugeza kuri 900 mu mwaka.
Mu kiyaga cya Rwanyakazinga haba imvubu n'ingona. Hanaba ubwoko bwinshi bw'inyoni zo mu mazi. Amashyo y'imbogo akunze kugaragara ku nkombe z'ikiyaga.
Uburobyi bukorerwa mu kiyaga. Mu mwaka wa 1975–1976, abarobyi 15 ni bo barobaga muri iki kiyaga.
Ikiyaga gisurwa na ba mukerarugendo. Inkambi ya Magashi (Magashi Camp) iri hafi y'ikiyaga. Abacumbitse muri iyo nkambi bashobora gutembera mu bwato ku kiyaga.

Ikiyaga cya Mihindi ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Kiri muri Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Kiri hafi y'umupaka wa Tanzaniya.
Ikiyaga cya Mihindi gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 10,9. Kizwiho imvubu. Ba mukerarugendo basura Pariki y'Akagera bakunze kugihagararaho.
Ikiyaga cya Mihindi kiri mu Murenge wa Rwimbogo, mu Karere ka Gatsibo. Kiri mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'umupaka wa Tanzaniya. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 282.
Ikiyaga cya Mihindi gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 10,9. Uburebure bwacyo bugera kuri kilometero 4,2. Ubugari bwacyo bugera kuri kilometero 3,9. Inkombe zacyo zifite uburebure bwa kilometero 14,5. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri metero 6,8. Ubujyakuzimu buringaniye ni metero 4,4. Mu mwaka wa 1975, abarobyi umunani ni bo barobaga muri iki kiyaga.
Ibinyabuzima n'ubukerarugendo.
Ikiyaga cya Mihindi gikikijwe n'ibishanga by'urufunzo. Inyamaswa nyinshi zibera mu rufunzo ziboneka hafi yacyo. Ku nkombe zacyo hari ahantu hitwa «Hippo Beach». Aho hantu ba mukerarugendo babona imvubu nyinshi.
Hafi y'ikiyaga hari ahantu ba mukerarugendo bafatira amafunguro. Hafite ubwiherero n'intebe ziri mu gicucu. Hari kandi ahantu ho gukambika.

Ikiyaga cya Nasho ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Giherereye mu Murenge wa Ndego, mu Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ikiyaga cya Nasho gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 13,7. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo ntiburenga metero 6,3. Kiri mu kibaya cya Nasho, hamwe n'ibiyaga bya Cyambwe na Mpanga. Urufunzo ni rwo rwiganje mu bimera byacyo. Muri iki kiyaga hakorerwa uburobyi.
Ikiyaga cya Nasho kiri mu Murenge wa Ndego. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1.286. Kiri ku ntera ya kilometero 25 mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'umujyi wa Kibungo. Ikiyaga cya Cyambwe kiri ku ntera ya kilometero 2,7 mu burasirazuba bwacyo.
Ikiyaga cya Nasho gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 13,7. Uburebure bwacyo ni kilometero 8,4. Ubugari bwacyo bugera kuri kilometero 2,1. Inkombe zacyo zifite uburebure bwa kilometero 27,8. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri metero 6,3. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugereranyije ni metero 4,2. Kirimo metero kibe miliyoni 43 z'amazi.
Ikiyaga cya Nasho kiri mu biyaga by'ikibaya cya Nasho, hamwe n'ibiyaga bya Cyambwe na Mpanga. Ibimera byiganje muri ibi biyaga ni urufunzo ("Cyperus papyrus") na "Nymphaea nouchallii". Ku nkombe no ku birwa bito by'ibi biyaga hari amashyamba.
Mu kiyaga cya Nasho hakorerwa uburobyi. Mu 1975, umusaruro w'amafi wari toni 50. Mu 1975–1976, abarobyi bari 28.

Ikiyaga cya Cyohoha y'amajyaruguru ni ikiyaga cyo mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Akarere ka Bugesera. Kiri mu majyaruguru y'Ikiyaga cya Cyohoha y'amajyepfo.
Ikiyaga cya Cyohoha y'amajyaruguru cyakamye hafi ya cyose mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000. Kibangamiwe n'ibimera byororoka cyane mu mazi. Abaturage bagikoresha mu ngo no kuhira imyaka.
Ikiyaga cya Cyohoha y'amajyaruguru kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 1 344. Uburebure bwacyo ni km 10,44. Gikikijwe n'imirenge ine: Mayange, Musenyi, Ngeruka na Mareba.
Ikiyaga cyakamye hafi ya cyose mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000. Nyuma yaho, ubuso bw'amazi asigaye bwari km² 0,56. Amafoto y'icyogajuru yerekana ko ubuso bw'ikiyaga bwiyongereye. Bwavuye kuri ha 345,5 mu mwaka wa 2014, bugera kuri ha 588,5 mu mwaka wa 2018.
Ibimera bitatu ni byo byiganje mu kiyaga. Ni "Ceratophyllum demersum", "Nymphaea nouchalii" na "Potamogeton crispus". "Ceratophyllum demersum" ni cyo gikwirakwira cyane. Ibimera bikurwa mu kiyaga n'intoki. Abakozi babijyana ku nkombe bakoresheje ubwato.
Amafi menshi yo mu kiyaga ni ay'ubwoko butatu: tilapiya, "Clarias" na "Protopterus".
Abaturage bakoresha amazi y'ikiyaga mu ngo. Barayanywa, bakayatekesha kandi bakayamesesha. Bayuhira imyaka kandi bayaha amatungo. Ikiyaga gikoreshwa no mu bwikorezi.

Uru ni urutonde rw'imigezi n'inzuzi byo muri Alijeriya. Uru rutonde rutunganyijwe kuva iburengerazuba ugana iburasirazuba hakurikijwe ibibasumba by'amazi (drainage basins), aho imigezi iyisukamo (tributaries) yagiye ishyirwa mu migereka munsi y'izina rya buri mugezi munini.

Uruzi rwa Bou Sellam ni uruzi rwo mu gace ka Maghreb muri Alijeriya, mu Ntara ya Bordj Bou Arréridj.[1][2] Uru ruzi rutemba ruca mu Kibaya cya Bou Sellam, kandi rukomwa mu nkokora n'Urugomero rwa Ain Zada.[3]
Ikibasumba cya Bou Sellam giffunzwe mu majyaruguru n'Umugando wa Gueldamane (Mount Gueldamane), guhera aho uru ruzi ruhurira n'Umugezi wa Sahel (Oued Sahel). Umugezi wa Bou Sellam (Wadi Bou Sellam) umanuka uturutse ku migezi y'amajyepfo y'Umugando wa Megris (Mount Megris); ugizwe n'imigezi itanu ari yo: Umugezi wa Mahouan, Umugezi wa Mohammed el Hannach, Umugezi wa Ouricia, Umugezi wa Goussimet n'Umugezi wa Fermatou, ikaba ihurira mu majyaruguru ya Setif. Nyuma yaho, uyu mugezi uhita ufata izina rya Oued Bou Sellam; ubanza gutemba ugana mu majyepfo n'amajyepfo y'uburengerazuba, ukanyura ku ntera y'ibirometero bitatu mu burengerazuba bwa Setif, hanyuma ukambuka urwunge rw'imisozi ari na ho ukomora isoko yawo hagati y'imisozi ya Tafat (djebel Tafat) na Guergour.
Umugezi wa Bou Sellam (Oued Bou Sellam) rwakira umugezi wa Malah (wadi Malah), ukomora isoko yawo i Aïn Arnat mu rugomero rwa Aïn Zada. Nyuma yo kwambuka urugomero rwa Aïn Zada, ruca mu burasirazuba bwa komini ya Khelil maze rwakira imigezi ibiri mishya iyisukamo: Umugezi wa Khelil (Wadi Khelil), utemba uturutse ku nkombe y'ibumosao i Besbassa rwagati na El Kherba n'urugomero rwa Aïn Zada, ndetse n'umugezi wa Taissa (wadi Taissa) uza duto mbere yaho uturutse ku nkombe y'iburyo.
Muri iki gice cyose cy'umuhanda warwo, Bou Sellam yuhiraga ikibaya gikungahaye cya Ameur, Ouled Mosli na Gherazla. Ku rundi ruhande, guhera mu rwangano rw'imanga rwa Guergour (Guergour gorges), rwatembaga mu gace k'imisozi miremire cyane n'amakorosi, rukagera mu ngenge z'umusozi wa Guifsar, aho rwitindurikaga rugakata rugana iburengerazuba maze rukisuka mu mugezi wa Sahel (wadi Sahel) begetanye n'agasongero k'umusozi wa Akbou
Umugezi wa Bou Sellam (Oued Bou Sellam) urimo amashami 36% y'amoko y'ifi aboneka mu mazi yo mu gihugu rwagati muri Alijeriya (amoko 15).[1]

Imiterere y'Ikibasumba (Basin features).
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès (Boumerdès Valley) ni umugezi ukomora isoko yawo mu Misozi ya Khachna (Khachna Mountains) maze ugaca mu gace ka Kabylia, ukanyura mu Ntara ya Boumerdès hanyuma ukisuka mu Nyanja ya Mediterane (Mediterranean Sea) hafi y’umujyi wa Boumerdès.[1]
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès kirangwa n'amapfunda y'umugezi (riverbed) atarandwamo ibishishwa by'amabuye (schist) cyangwa ibumba.[1] Iyi miterere, isangiye n'iyindi migezi nka Bikibaya cya Arbia (Arbia Valley), Umugezi wa Meraldene (Meraldene River), Ikibaya cya Boudouaou (Boudouaou Valley), n'Umugezi wa Isser (Isser River), yorohereza ikurwa ry'umusenyi n'amabuye y'amakoro (gravel) bikoreshwa mu gukora amasherezo (mortar) n'amashandari (concrete).[2][3]
Amapfunda y'umugezi w'Ikibaya cya Boumerdès akora nk'inzira karemano, akagira ubugari buri hagati ya metero 5 n'ama-600. Ugenda umanuka gahoro gahoro guhera aho uhurira n'Umugezi wa Meraldene (Meraldene River) n'Ikibaya cya Arbia (Arbia Valley) mu gace ka Thénia Beni Aicha, hafi y'Umusozi wa Bouarous mu majyepfo, maze ugatemba ugana aho usukira mu Nyanja ya Mediterane mu burasirazuba bw'umujyi wa Boumerdès.[1]
Ubu bukeregese buri mu rugero (moderate slope) bwapfuye gushyigikira iyubakwa ry'Urugomero rwa Thenia Beni Aicha mu mwaka wa 1913.[1] Mu gihe cy'imvura, umubandama w'amazi uriyongera, ibyo bika byarateye iyubakwa ry'ibiriti n'inzira z'Abanyamaguru mu rwego rwo korohereza ingendo z'abaturage batuye mu midugudu n'amajaruguru agize inkombe zayo.
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès (Boumerdès Valley) gica mu ntara imwe rukumbi yo ku nkombe muri Alijeriya, kikanyura mu Misozi ya Khachna (Khachna Mountains).[1]
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès (Boumerdès Valley) gihurira n'indi migezi n'inzuzi bitandukanye mu nzira yacyo mu Ntara ya Boumerdès.[1]
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès (Boumerdès Valley) gica mu rugomero runaka n'ingomero zitandukanye mu nzira yacyo mu Ntara ya Boumerdès.[1]
Imihanda y' Igihugu.
Ikibaya cya Boumerdès (Boumerdès Valley) gihurira n'imihanda itandukanye ya Leta (national roads) mu nzira yacyo.[1]

Izina ry'amavuko (Native name): وادي الشلف (Icyarabu)
Ahantu giherereye (Location)
Igihugu (Country): Alijeriya (Algeria)
Imijyi (Cities): * Mostaganem
Imiterere y'umubiri (Physical characteristics)
Isoko (Source): Boughezoul
Aho rwasukira (Mouth): Inyanja ya Mediterane (Mediterranean Sea)
Ibyerekezo (Coordinates): 36°02′22″N 0°07′59″E / 36.03944°N 0.13306°E
Uburebure (Length): Ibirometero 725 (725 km / mi 450
Umugezi wa Chelif (Icyarabu: وادي الشلف) (unyuzwe niba wandikwa nka Chéliff cyangwa Sheliff[3]) ni uruzi rufite uburebure bw’ibirometero 700 (mi 430) ruri muri Alijeriya, rukaba ari na rwo ruremure cyane mu gihugu. Ruhera mu mizingo y'imisozi ya Saharan Atlas hafi y'umujyi wa Boughezoul, rukanyura mu mizingo ya Tell Atlas maze rukisuka mu Nyanja ya Mediterane mu majyaruguru y'umujyi wa Mostaganem. Urwego rw'amazi muri uyu mugezi rukunze guhindagurika cyane. Uru ruzi rwifashishwa mu kuhira imiryanyo (cyane cyane mu gice cyarwo cyo munsi).
Uyu mugezi wigeze kwitwa kandi Umugezi wa Mekerra n'Umugezi wa Sig.

Uko Basebya ba Nyirantwari yavutse.
Basebya ba Nyirantwari yari umwe mu bagabo bazwi cyane mu mateka y’amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Yavukiye i Rutangira mu gishanga cy’Urugezi, nyuma y’uko nyina Nyirantwari akijijwe urupfu yari yarakatiwe azira gutwara inda y’indaro. Nyirantwari yari yajyanywe ku musozi wa Nkondo ngo arohwe, ariko abatwa bo kuri Rutangira bamugirira impuhwe, maze umwe muri bo witwaga Kiroha aramurongora. Muri uwo muryango ni ho Basebya yavukiye akanakurira. Akiri muto yamenye amateka y’akarengane kageze kuri nyina, bituma akura afite umutima wo kwigomeka no kwihimura ku butegetsi bwari bwarashatse kumwambura ubuzima mbere y’uko avuka
Ibikorwa bya Basebya ba Nyirantwari.
Amaze gukura, Basebya yabaye umugabo w’umunyambaraga n’ubutwari budasanzwe. Yashoboye kwegeranya abasore benshi batishimiraga ubutegetsi bw’icyo gihe, ashinga umutwe w’ingabo witwaga Ibijabura. Uwo mutwe wari ugizwe ahanini n’abasore b’intwari bakoreraga mu gace k’Urugezi no mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Basebya yari azwi cyane mu byivugo, aho yivugaga izina rya “Rwirahira”, kandi yari yaramenyekanye nk’umuntu utinyuka guhangara abatware n’abayobozi. Mu gihe cy’ingoma ya Yuhi V Musinga, yaje kwigomeka ashaka kwigira umuhinza no gutegeka uduce tw’u Burera, u Rukiga n’ahandi haturiye Urugezi.
Ibikorwa bya Basebya n’Ibijabura byateje impagarara zikomeye mu majyaruguru y’Igihugu. Basahuraga amaturo yagombaga kujyanwa ibwami, bakagaba ibitero ku baturage no ku bayobozi bashyigikiye umwami. Kubera iyo myitwarire, umwami Musinga yohereje ingabo z’Indugaruga kugira ngo zimurwanye. Mu rugamba rwa mbere, Basebya n’ingabo ze barazitsinze, bituma izina rye rirushaho kwamamara. Umwami yaje kongera kohereza izindi ngabo zikomeye zirimo intwari Rurangangabo, ariko gukomeza kumutsinda byakomeje kugorana kubera ko yari azi neza ibice by’ibishanga n’imisozi byamuhishaga.
Kubera ko intambara itari gutanga umusaruro, umutware Rwubusisi rwa Cyigenza yafashe icyemezo cyo gukoresha amayeri. Yiyitiriye ko ashaka kuyoboka Basebya kandi ko amuzaniye amaturo n’inzoga. Mu birago yari yitwaje yari yahishemo imiheto, imyambi n’izindi ntwaro. Basebya amaze kwakira Rwubusisi nk’inshuti n’umufatanyabikorwa, yahise amusumira aramufata, maze abasirikare bari kumwe na we batangira kurasa no gutatanya ingabo za Basebya. Ibijabura byinshi byarahunze, abandi baricwa, naho Basebya afatwa ari muzima ajyanwa ibwami.
Nyuma yo gufatwa, Basebya yashyikirijwe ubuyobozi bwari bufatanyije n’Abadage bari bamaze kugera mu Rwanda. Yaciriwe urubanza, maze yicwa n’ingabo z’Abadage. Urupfu rwe rwashyize iherezo ku myigomeko yari amaze imyaka myinshi ayoboye mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Nubwo yatsinzwe, Basebya ba Nyirantwari yakomeje kwibukwa nk’umwe mu bagabo b’intwari kandi b’intagondwa bahanganye n’ubutegetsi bwa cyami n’ubukoloni. Kugeza n’ubu, amazina nka Rutangira, Urugezi na Ruhindamyambi aracyibutsa amateka ye n’uruhare yagize mu mateka y’u Rwanda rwo hambere.

Lucky Nzeyimana ni umunyamakuru uzwi cyane mu cyiciro cy'abakora inkuru z'imyidagaduro kuri Royal TV, yakoreye kandi Radiyo Isango Star na City Radiyo mu biganiro by'imyidagaduro mu gice cy'abahanzi n'umuziki. Yaje kwimukira kuri Lemigo TV(isigaye yitwa Royal TV) mu mwaka wa 2014.
Lucky Nzeyimana yize amashuri abanza ndetse n'ayisumbuye aho yize ibijyanye n'itangazamakuru n'itumanaho(Journalism and communication) aho afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya 2 cya Kaminuza(Bachelor's Degree), akaba yarayize muri Kaminuza y'abapantekositi (pantecostal University) muri Uganda.
Lucky Nzeyimana yavutse mu bana bane(4) akaba ari we mfura muri abo bana uko ari bane. Lucky Nzeyimana yasezeranye n'umukunzi we Murekatete Divine kuwa gatandatu taliki ya 15 Ukwakira 2016 mu idini rya Islam. Ibirori byo kwishimira isezerano ryaba bombi, ryabereye Kicukiro ruguru y'ibiro by'Akarere.

Kagabo Jean Pierre ni umunyarwanda wamaze imyaka irenga 22 akorera itangazamakuru(Rwanda Broadcasting Agency), yatangiye gukora itangazamakuru mu mwaka wa 2003 RBA ikitwa ORINFOR(Office Rwandais d'Information),aho iri zina ryahinduwe mu mwaka wa 2013.
Kagabo Jean Pierre yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye aho afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya 3 cya Kaminuza(Master's Degree) yakuye muri Politechnico di Torino mu mwaka wa 2013, mu binyanye n'itumanaho rikoresha ikoranabuhanga ridakenera insinga. Afite n'ubunararibonye n'ubumenyi buhambaye mu bwubatsi n'ubuhanga, itumanaho, AutoCAD, GSM, ndetse n'ikoranabuhanga rya Wireless.

Ibitaramo bya Summer Country Tour 2026 byatangiriye mu Karere ka Musanze ku wa 13 Kamena 2026, bihuriza hamwe abahanzi bakunzwe cyane barimo Bruce Melodie, The Ben, Kitoko na Bwiza. Byabereye muri Stade Ubworoherane, aho ibihumbi by’abakunzi b’umuziki byari byateraniye gushyigikira abahanzi babo. Ubwitabire bwari hejuru cyane, abafana bagaragara bafite ibyapa n’ibimenyetso byerekana abo bashyigikiye, ibintu byatumye iki gitaramo kirangwa n’ishyaka n’ibyishimo kuva gitangiye kugeza kirangiye.
Mbere y’uko abahanzi bakuru bataramira abafana, Kevin Montana wo mu Karere ka Musanze yabanje gususurutsa abari bitabiriye. Nyuma ye, Bwiza yahamagariwe ku rubyiniro maze atanga ibyishimo mu ndirimbo zirimo "Gake Gake", "Boda Boda", "Best Friend" na "Ogera". Uyu muhanzikazi yakoresheje imbaraga nyinshi asusurutsa abafana, ndetse nk’uko asanzwe abigenza mu bitaramo byo mu ntara, yanatoranyije umusore mu bafana babyinana zimwe mu ndirimbo ze, ibintu byashimishije benshi.
Kitoko wakurikiyeho yongeye gutaramira i Musanze nyuma y’imyaka myinshi atahagera. Yaririmbye nyinshi mu ndirimbo zamugize icyamamare kuva mu myaka yashize, abafana be bamugaragariza urukundo rwinshi ndetse basimbukana na we mu ndirimbo zitandukanye. Nyuma ye, The Ben yamaze iminota 45 ku rubyiniro, agaragaza ubuhanga n’imbaraga by’umutaramyi umaze igihe mu muziki. Yari yitwaje ababyinnyi benshi kandi abafana bamuririmbanye hafi indirimbo ze zose, bagaragaza ko bari bamukumbuye cyane.
Igitaramo cyasojwe na Bruce Melodie wamaze isaha n’iminota 15 ku rubyiniro. Yatangiye aririmba indirimbo zituje zizwi n’abafana, nyuma agenda azamura umuvuduko kugeza ubwo stade yose yuzuyemo ibyishimo n’imbyino. Abafana be bamuririmbyeho kandi bamugaragariza urukundo rudasanzwe. Bruce Melodie na The Ben bombi bagaragaje urwego rwo hejuru rwo gutaramira abantu, bituma benshi bavuga ko ari bo bagaragaye cyane muri iki gitaramo cya mbere cya Summer Country Tour
Uretse ibyishimo byaranze iki gitaramo, cyanabereye amahirwe akomeye abacuruzi bo muri aka karere. Abacuruza amafunguro, ibinyobwa ndetse n’abatanga serivisi zo gucumbikira abantu bavuga ko bungutse amafaranga menshi kubera umubare munini w’abashyitsi bari baje gukurikirana igitaramo. Bamwe mu bacuruzi batangaje ko bacuruje inshuro nyinshi ugereranyije n’ibyo basanzwe bacuruza ku munsi usanzwe, mu gihe amacumbi na yo yakiriye abakiliya benshi baturutse mu bice bitandukanye by’Igihugu

Kabendera Shinani yari umunyamakuru wari ufite amaraso ya Uganda, Tanzania n'u Rwanda. Uyu Shinani yishwe 2000 azize abagizi ba nabi, akaba yarazwi mu kuvuga amakuru ndetse no kogeza umupira wa maguru mu rurimi rw'Igiswahili.
Amateka ya kabendera shinani.
Kabendera Shinani yavutse taliki 12/12/1949 yavukiye muri Tanzania k'umugabo ukomoka muri Uganda n'umugore ukomoka muri Tanzania, ariko Shinani akaba yarafashe ubwenegihugu bwa nyina. Ababyeyi ba Shinani batandukanye ari muto nyina agaruka mu Rwanda(i Nyanza), hanyuma Shinani amaze kugeza imyaka 22 yigira inama yo kuza mu Rwanda gushaka nyina ahagana mu 1972, nawe birangira ahashatse umunyarwandakazi ariwe nyina wa Tdjala,nawe wamenyekanye nka Tdjala Kabendera wateye ikirenge mu cya se mu itangazamakuru. Shinani yageze mu Rwanda ntiyahita abonana na nyina ariko aza kubona akazi k'itangazamakuru kuko mu itangazamakuru bashakaga umuntu utyaye mu rurimi rw'Igiswahili abona akazi atyo kuko ururimi rwe kavukire ari Igiswahili nk'umutanzaniya uvuka k'umunyarwandakazi. Kabendera Shinani uretse n'itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda yakoze no ku maradiyo mpuzamahanga mu mashami y'Igiswahili.

Kalinda Viateur yari umunyamakuru wari umuhanga cyane mu mwuga we, kuko yarafite ijwi ryiza ryo kogeza umupira w'amaguru. Yapfuye azize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda.
Amateka ya kalinda viateur.
Kalinda Viateur yari umuhanga mu mwuga we, abakunzi n'abafana b'umupira baramuzi ndetse baramwibuka kuko yari umuhanga cyane mu kogeza umupira ndetse n'amagambo menshi akoreshwa mu kogeza umupira w'amaguru niwe wayahimbye nka; Rwanyeganyeze(Igitego cyigiyemo), kurengura umupira(Degagement en main), urubuga rw'amahina(surface de reparation), Ruhago(umupira wo gukona"ballon"), Umurongo w'abagatanu(Ligne defensif), Kwamurura inyoni(gutera ishoti ariko umupira ukinyurira hejuru y'izamu kure cyane), n'andi agiye atandukanye avugwa mu gihe cyo kogeza umupira w'amaguru.

Perefegitura z’u Rwanda zari inzego z’ubutegetsi bwite bwa Leta zakoreshwaga mu Rwanda mbere y’ivugurura ry’imitegekere ryabaye mu mwaka wa 2006.
Perefegitura 10 z’u Rwanda (1962-1992).
Izi perefegitura zari zigizwe na za komini 143, buri imwe yose ikayoborwa na Burugumesitiri washyirwagaho na perezida wa Repubulika ya II.
Perefegitura 11 z’u Rwanda (1992-1996).
Bigeze muri 1992, hakaswe indi perefegitura nshya muri Kigali: haba kigali ebyiri ari zo Kigali-ville (Umugi wa Kigali) na Kigali-rural (Kigali-Ngari).

Uwera Jean Maurise ni umugabo w'imyaka 44 y'amavuko ufite abana 3. Uwera Jean Maurise yatangiye umwuga w'itangazamakuru mu mwaka wa 2011 nk'umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa by'ikorwa ry'ibiganiro muri Flash FM&amp;TV, yari yabanje gukora mu rwego rw'amahoteli n'ubukerarugendo.
Uwera Jean Maurise yize amashuri abanza ndetse n'ayisumbuye, afite impamyabushobozi ya kaminuza mu itangazamakuru n'itumanaho(Journalism and communication) yakuye muri Catholique Institute of Kabgayi.
Jean Maurise Uwera yashyizwe ku mwanya w'Umuvugizi wungirije wa Guverinoma asimbuye Alain Mukarulinda, witabye Imana mu ntangiriro z'umwaka wa 2025. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2025 yari Umuyobozi Mukuru wa 93.9 SK FM, radiyo ikorera i Kigali yibanda ku makuru y'ubucuruzi n'ibiganiro bifitiye rubanda akamaro. Muri uwo mwanya yari ashinzwe kuyobora icyerekezo cya radiyo n'imikorere yayo y'itangazamakuru. Yakoze kuri Flash FM&amp;TV, yakoze kuri RTV(Rwanda Television), ndetse aba n'Umuyobozi wa Radiyo Magic FM.

Ubwenge Buhangano niki?
Ubwenge Buhangano (AI) ni ikoranabuhanga rituma imashini cyangwa mudasobwa zishobora gutekereza, kwiga, no gukora imirimo isanzwe ikorwa n'ubwenge bw'abantu, AI mu Rwanda ni rimwe mu mashami y'ikoranabuhanga arimo kwihutisha iterambere mu nzego zitandukanye zirimo ubuzima, uburezi, ubuhinzi, n'imiyoborere. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yashyizeho politiki zigamije gushyigikira ishoramari muri uru rwego no guhugura urubyiruko kugira ngo igihugu kibe ihuriro ry'ikoranabuhano ku Isi
U Rwanda na UAE byashyize umukono ku masezerano i Dubai ku wa 31 Nyakanga 2025 agamije guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga no gushyira mu bikorwa amahame ya C4IR. Aya masezerano ashyigikira gahunda ya NST2 y’u Rwanda igamije kwihutisha iterambere ry’ubukungu bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga kandi muri iyo gahunda, abantu babarirwa muri miliyoni, cyane cyane urubyiruko, bazahabwa amasomo ya coding mu myaka itanu iri imbere, mu gihe abandi ibihumbi 500 bazahugurwa ku rwego rwo hejuru mu ikoranabuhanga hagamijwe kongera ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bwabo
Ese ubwenge Buhangano Busasimbura Umuntu?
Ubwenge buhangano (AI) ntibuzasimbura ubwenge bwa muntu cyangwa abarimu, ahubwo buzabafasha gukora akazi kabo neza kandi vuba. Ibi byagarutsweho n’impuguke mu kiganiro EdTech Monday, zigaragaza ko AI ifasha abarimu gukurikirana imyigire y’abanyeshuri no gukosora imikoro mu gihe gito, ariko ko icyemezo cya nyuma n’ubusesenguzi bikomeza gukorwa n’umuntu, n'ubwo u Rwanda rukomeje guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga no guhugura abarimu benshi ku ikoreshwa rya AI mu burezi, haracyari imbogamizi zirimo ibura ry’ububiko buhagije bw’amakuru (Data Centre). Impuguke zirasaba abanyeshuri n’abarimu gukomeza kwihugura mu ikoranabuhanga no gukoresha AI nk’igikoresho kibafasha, aho kubifata nk’ikizasimbura abantu
Ubwenge Buhangano mu Itangazamakuru.
Ubwenge buhangano (AI) bukomeje guhindura uburyo itangazamakuru rikora, bufasha mu gukusanya, gutunganya no gutangaza amakuru mu buryo bwihuse kandi bunoze. Nubwo iri koranabuhanga ritanga amahirwe menshi yo koroshya akazi no kongera umusaruro, impuguke zigaragaza ko ridashobora gusimbura burundu abanyamakuru. Ahubwo AI ikwiye gukoreshwa nk’igikoresho kibafasha gukora neza no gutanga amakuru ku gihe, mu gihe umuntu akomeza kugira uruhare rukomeye mu kugenzura no gufata ibyemezo bya nyuma. Ibi bituma amahame y’itangazamakuru, arimo ukuri, ubwizerwe n’ubunyamwuga, akomeza kubahirizwa nubwo ikoranabuhanga rikomeje gutera imbere

Umutoni Uwase Belinda wavukiye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, akaza no kwiyamamaza nka Nyampinga w'u Rwanda, yasezeranye n'umukunzi we Theo Gakire Ntarugero, umuhango wabereye mu mujyi wa Kigali mu busitani bwa SunSet i Kagugu mu gihe gusezerana imbere y'Imana byabaye taliki 7 Ukwakira 2017. Bafitanye abana b'impanga yibarutse mu ijoro ryo kuwa 2 taliki 23 Mutarama 2018, nyuma y'amezi ane bari bamaze barushinze.

Havugimana Saidi ni umunyarwanda witeje imbere aho yashinze ikigo cyitwa Haji Enterprise izwi mu bucuruzi bw'ibiribwa bihiye cyane cyane amata. Yavutse 1967 afite umugore umwe n'abana 5 (abakobwa 3 n'abahungu 2).
Nubwo ari umucuruzi, yize amashuri abanza ndetse n'ayisumbuye aho yize i Runyombyi hafi y'umupaka w'u Rwanda n'Uburundi. Ubu ni umunyeshuri wiga muri Masters mu ishuri rya INLAK mu ishami rya MBA(Masters in Business Administration).
Havugimana Saidi ubu ni umucuruzi ufite ubucuruzi bwamaze kubaka izina aho bita kwa Haji Enterprise iherereye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo mu Karere ka Nyanza aho acururuza ibiribwa bitetse cyane cyane abantu benshi bazi amata. Aho izina Haji ryavuye, ni Abakongomani bajyaga baza bavuga ko bagiye kwa Haji, biza kurangira abantu bose ariryo zina bahitiriye. Iki kigo cyamaze kwaguka kuko kigira abakozi bagera ku 100 k'umunsi bitewe n'akazi kaba gahari byaba ngombwa bakiyongera.

Umutesi Vanessa ni Umuyobozi w'Ibikorwa by'Umusaruro(Production Manager) ufite ubunararibonye buhamye, wagaragaje ibikorwa by'indashyikirwa muri Brand Speak Global by'umwihariko mu kunoza imikorere no kugabanya ibiciro by'umusaruro. Afite ubumenyi buhambaye mu gutegura umusaruro no gucunga ibikorwa byawo. Aho yashoboye gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba za Lean Management zafashije kongera umusaruro, kunoza imigendekere no kuzamura imikorere rusange. Afite ubushobozi bwo kuzamura amakipe.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Manyagiro ni ikigo cy'ubuzima giherereye mu murenge wa Manyagiro, mu Karere ka Gicumbi, Intara y'Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Cyashyizweho mu rwego rwo kongera no kunoza itangwa rya serivisi z'ubuzima zegerejwe abaturage, hagamijwe korohereza abatuye ako gace kubona ubuvuzi bw'ibanze n'izindi serivisi zifitanye isano n'ubuzima.
serivisi zihatangirwa:.
Iki kigo nderabuzima gitanga serivisi zitandukanye zirimo kuvura indwara zisanzwe, kwita ku bagore batwite mbere na nyuma yo kubyara, gukingira abana, kuboneza urubyaro, gukurikirana imikurire y'abana, ndetse no gutanga ubujyanama ku bijyanye n'isuku n'imibereho myiza. Gikora kandi nk'ihuriro ry'ingenzi rifasha abaturage kubona serivisi z'ubuzima ku gihe no gukumira indwara binyuze mu bukangurambaga n'uburezi bw'ubuzima.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Manyagiro gifite uruhare rukomeye mu kuzamura imibereho myiza y'abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Manyagiro n'indi mirenge ituranye. Binyuze muri serivisi gitanga, gifasha kugabanya intera abaturage bakoraga bajya gushaka ubuvuzi no guteza imbere ubuzima rusange bw'abaturage bo mu Karere ka Gicumbi.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Muyumbu ni ivuriro rya leta ry'ibanze riherereye mu Murenge wa Muyumbu, mu Karere ka Rwamagana, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z'ubuzima bw'ibanze ku banyarwanda banyuranye.
Imiterere n'Ahantu giherereye.
Iki kigo gihereye mu Murenge wa Muyumbu muri Rwamagana. Kubera kwegera umujyi wa Kigali, uyu murenge wagize ubwiyongere bukabije bw'abaturage mu myaka ya vuba. Ibi byatumye habaho n'ubwiyongere bw'abakeneye serivise.
Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z'ibanze zirimo:
Ivugururwa n'Ukwagurwa kwacyo.
Mbere iki kigo cyari gito kigakora mu mazu ashaje, ibi bikabangamira serivisi zihabwa abagana ivuriro. Muri uwo rwego, hatangijwe umushinga wo kuryagura no kurivugurura ufite agaciro k'amafaranga y'u Rwanda arenga miliyoni 700 (700,000,000 Frw).Uyu mushinga watewe inkunga n'ubufatanye bwa Minisiteri y'Ubuzima (MoH), Akarere ka Rwamagana, n'umuryango utegamiye kuri leta wa Health Builders. Iri vagururwa ryafashije mu kongera ibyumba by'ababyeyi, ibyumba by'abari gukurikiranwa n'abaganga, n'aho kwakirira abaganga b’inzobere, bituma abaturage batagikora ingendo ndende bajya ku Bitaro bya Rwamagana cyangwa i Kigali.

Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi ni rimwe mu matorero amaze igihe kirekire mu Rwanda, aho ryatangiye ibikorwa byaryo mu mwaka wa 1919 rizanwe n’abamisiyoneri Daniel Elie Delhove na Henry MonnierAba bagabo bageze i Kilinda muri Werurwe 1919 batangira umurimo w’ivugabutumwa, bakusanya abakirisitu bari barasizwe n’abamisiyoneri bari baravuye mu Rwanda nyuma y’intambara ya mbere y’isi yose. Nyuma baguye ibikorwa byabo hirya no hino mu gihugu, aho Delhove yerekeje i Nyanza agashinga Misiyoni ya Gitwe mu 1920, nyuma yo guhabwa ubutaka n’Umwami Musinga.
Itariki ya 31 Kanama 2019 izahora yibukwa mu mateka y’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi mu Rwanda, ubwo ryizihizaga isabukuru y’imyaka 100 rimaze ritangiye umurimo w’ivugabutumwa. Ibirori byabereye muri Stade Amahoro byitabiriwe n’ibihumbi by’abakirisitu baturutse hirya no hino mu gihugu, bashima Imana ku rugendo rurerure iri torero rimaze gukora kuva mu 1919
Mu ntangiriro z’iri torero, abaturage bake ni bo bitabiriye ubutumwa bwaryo, ariko ibikorwa by’ivugabutumwa n’uburezi byatumye rikura vuba. Ruvugihomvu ni we Munyarwanda wa mbere wabatijwe muri Misiyoni ya Gitwe mu 1924 ahabwa izina rya Yohani, akurikirwa na Rukangarajunga Petero, mu gihe Nyirabigwagwa Mariya yabaye umugore wa mbere wabatijwe mu 1925
Umuyobozi ushinzwe itangazamakuru mu itorero, Yadusoneye Onesphore, yavuze ko uyu munsi ari umwanya wo gushimira Imana ku iterambere ry’itorero, by’umwihariko mu burezi, ubuzima n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage. Yagaragaje ko ibikorwa by’iterambere by’itorero birimo amashuri, ibitaro nka Mugonero, ndetse n’imishinga y’uburezi n’ubuzima byagize uruhare rukomeye mu guteza imbere igihugu. Mu bikorwa by’ingenzi byaranze uyu munsi harimo no kugaragaza imishinga ikomeye itorero ryagezeho, nk’ishuri rikuru ry’ubuvuzi riri i Masoro mu Karere ka Gasabo, ndetse n’icyicaro gikuru cy’itorero giherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Hari kandi n’imibare igaragaza ko kugeza icyo gihe itorero ryari rifite abakirisitu barenga 962,766 hamwe n’insengero zigera ku 2,500 hirya no hino mu gihugu

Nshimiyimana Yunusu ni umukinnyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'Umunyarwanda ufite imyaka 24, ukina ku mwanya wa myugariro mu ikipe ya APR FC. Yavutse kuwa 31 Ukuboza 2001. Kugeza ubu Yunusu Nshimiyimana akinira ikipe ya APR FC.
Nshimiyimana Yunusu afite abavandimwe nabo bakina umupira w'amaguru aribo Fitina Omborenga, Sibomana Abubah akaba ari umutoza w'ungirije muri Gorilla FC yabaye myugariro w'ibumuso ukomeye hano mu Rwanda no mu Karere ndetse n'undi muvandimwe wabo witwa Yamini Salumu. Taliki ya 17 Werurwe 2025, nibwo aba bavandimwe bakiriye inkuru y'akababaro y'urupfu rwa se ubwo yari yitanye Imana.

Muhawenayo Gad ni umunyarwanda ukina umupira w'amaguru. Yavutse taliki 30 Ugushyingo 1995. Yakiniraga ikipe ya Gorilla FC nyuma aza kwerekeza muri Marine. Mu mwaka ushize 2025/26 ntabwo Muhawenimana Gad yabonye umwanya uhagije wo gukina, dore ko yakinnye imikino 16 yo muri BK Pro League, itandatu muri iyo akaba atari yo yinijijwe igitego. Izamu rye ryinjiyemo ibitego 18.
Musanze FC yayikiniye nk'umunyezamu w'imena, nyuma yerekeza muri Gorilla FC, yongera gusinya amasezerano muri Marine y'imyaka 2, yanatangajwe nk'umukinnyi mushya wa APR FC.

Sindi Paul Jesus ni umunyarwanda uzwi mu mupira w'amaguru, ufite imyaka 21 wavukiye mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Ubu akaba abarizwa mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda gukomerezayo akazi, akaba yaramaze gusinyira Marine FC amasezerano y'imyaka ibiri(2).
Tsindabatsinde, Rayon Sports, Marine FC.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Nyarubuye (mu Cyongereza: "Nyarubuye Medicalized Health Center"):ni ikigo cy'ubuvuzi gikomeye giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyarubuye, mu karere ka Kirehe, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Cyashinzwe bwa mbere mu myaka ya za 1950. Ku bw'ivugururwa rigezweho cyahawemo ubushobozi, cyashyizwe ku rwego rwisumbuye rw'ikigo nderabuzima gihabwa abaganga, bituma gitanga serivisi ku rwego rwa muganga w'inzobere (Dogiteri).
Serivisi n'Ubushobozi.
Iki kigo gifite ubushobozi nki bw'ibitaro bitewe n'ibikoresho n'abaganga bacyo. Bimwe mu bikorwa remezo n'izindi serivisi zikirangwamo harimo:

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Gacaca ni ikigo cy'ubuvuzi rusange giherereye mu Murenge wa Gacaca, mu karere ka Musanze, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Iki kigo cyubatswe mu rwego rwo kugabanya ingendo ndende abaturage b'uyu murenge bakoraga bajya kwivuriza mu mirenge baturanye nka Cyuve, Remera, Rwaza, na Gashaki.
Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z'ibanze z'ubuzima zirimo:
Iki kigo kiba cyunganirwa n'Ibitaro Bikuru bya Ruhengeri bikorera mu mujyi wa Musanze iyo hari abarwayi bakeneye ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho.
Umurenge wa Gacaca utuwe n’abaturage basaga ibihumbi 28, babarizwa mu Tugari 4 n’Imidugudu 24. Mbere y'umwaka wa 2022, uyu murenge wari umwe mu bice bigize Akarere ka Musanze bitagiraga ikigo nderabuzima na kimwe hafi. Ibi byatandukanyaga cyane uyu murenge n'indi 16 y'aka karere yari asanganywe ibigo nderabuzima.Abaturage barwaraga cyangwa ababyeyi babyara batoraga imajyeri bakora ingendo ndende. Bitabazaga ibigo nderabuzima byo mu mirenge bihana imbibi nka Cyuza,Remera na Gashaki.Kuba abaturage benshi barisukiraga Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Karwasa, byaviragamo uwo murenge ubushereke n'ubwiganze bw'abarwayi, bigatuma serivisi zaho zuzura imirongo miremire ndetse rimwe na rimwe abaforomo bakabarangarana kubera umuvundo.
Imyubakire n'Igishoro:.
Gukemura iki kibazo cy'ingendo n'umuvundo mu mavuriro bituranye, Ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Musanze bwafatanyije na guverinoma gutangiza umushinga mugari wo kubaka Ivuriro rya Gacaca. Mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2021, imirimo yo kucyubaka yari igeze ku kigero cya 70%. Inyubako zacyo zashyizweho zari kijyambere kandi zujuje ubuziranenge, zifite amashami yose akenerwa ku kigo nderabuzima cy'icyerekezo. Iki kigo cyuzuye gitwaye ingengo y'imari nini y'akarere maze gitangira gufungura imiryango no gutanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi ku mugaragaro mu kwezi kwa Mutarama 2022.
Ibindi bikorwa remezo hafi aho:.
Hafi y'iki kigo hashyizweho n'ibindi bikorwa by'iterambere birimo nka "Ubumwe Community ECD Center" itanga uburezi budaheza, ndetse n'umushinga mugari w'ikigo cyo gutunganya imyanda cy'Akarere ka Musanze cyubatswe mu Kagari ka Karwasa mu Murenge wa Gacaca.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kayumbu ni ivuriro rya leta ryubatse kagari ka Muyange mu Murenge wa Kayumbu, mu Karere ka Kamonyi, mu ntara y'amajyepfo mu Rwanda.
Uru ni urutonde rw’izindi serivisi z’ubuzima zitangwa n’Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kayumbu:
Serivisi z’Ingenzi z’Ubuvuzi.

Izindi Serivisi z’Ubuzima:

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kagugu ni ivuriro rya Leta riri mu Murenge wa Kinyinya, mu Karere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu Rwanda. Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z'ibanze z'ubuzima ku baturage benshi batuye mu nkengero zacyo.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Shagasha ni ivuriro ryubatse mu Murenge wa Gihundwe mu karere ka Rusizi, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba mu Rwanda.
Serivisi z’ibanze zitangwa n'iki kigo.
Muri iki gihe, Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Shagasha gitanga serivisi zinyuranye kandi zifatiye ahasigaye ubuzima bw'abaturage, zirimo:

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Karama (mu rurimi rw'icyongereza: "Karama Health Center") ni ivuriro rya Leta ry'ibanze riherereye mu Murenge wa Karama, mu Karere ka Huye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Iki kigo ngerabuzima kigengwa n'Ibitaro Bikuru by'Akarere ka Huye bikorera munsi ya Minisiteri y'Ubuzima (MINISANTE).
Ivuriro riri mu Murenge wa Karama, umwe mu mirenge 14 igize Akarere ka Huye. Giherereye hafi y'icyahoze ari ibiro bya Komini Runyinya mu mateka y'Ubuyobozi bwa kera, kikaba cyorohereza abaturage b'icyaro batuye kure y'Umujyi wa Huye (Butare) kubona ubuvuzi bwihuse.
Nka kimwe mu Bigo nderabuzima byateganyijwe na Leta y'u Rwanda mu rwego rwo kwegereza abaturage ubuvuzi, Karama itanga serivisi z'ibanze zirimo:

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Bumbogo (mu Cyongereza: "Bumbogo Health Center") ni ivuriro rya leta ryo ku rwego rw'ibanze riherereye mu Murenge wa Bumbogo, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu gihugu cy'u Rwanda. Iki kigo nderabuzima gicungwa n'Akarere ka Gasabo binyuze mu bitaro by'akarere bishinzwe kukibungabunga bya Kibagabaga (Ibitaro bya Kibagabaga).
Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z'ibanze z'ubuzima nk'uko biteganywa na Minisiteri y'Ubuzima mu Rwanda (MINISANTE):
Kwivuza n'Ubwisungane.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Bumbogo cyakira abaturage bafite ubwisungane mu kwivuza butandukanye, cyane cyane ubw'abagize Ubwisungane mu Kwivuza rusange (Mutuelle de Santé). Ibi bituma umuturage wishyura 10% gusa by'igiciro cy'imiti n'ubuvuzi ahabwa, ibindi bikishyurwa na Leta. Cyakira kandi n'abafite ubundi bwisungane bwemewe mu Rwanda.

Habukuyabaho Hyacinth uzwi nka Gitefano ni umugabo w'imyaka 48 wavukiye i Muhanga mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, afite abana batanu(5) umwana we mukuru afite imyaka 22 naho umuhererezi afite imyaka itandatu(6). Uyu Gitefano amaze kwamamara mu ikinamico Urunana, ni umwe mu bakinnyi bakunze kugaruka cyane mu mitwe ya benshi iyo hagize uhingutsa iby'iyi kinamico ikundwa n'ingeri zitandukanye z'ababasha kumva Ikinyarwanda.
Habukuyabaho Hyacinth amashuri abanza yayize aho bita ku Kivumu i Musambira mu Karere ka Kamonyi aho ababyeyi bimukiye ubwo yari akiri muto; ayisumbuye ayiga muri Ecole Technique de Save, ayasoreza mu Urwunge rw'amashuri Ndangaburezi ruherereye mu Ruhango.
Hyacinth yatangiiye gukina ikinamico kuva mu buto bwe, impano igenda ikura mpaka ageze muri ORINFOR aho yatangiriye kuyikuza no kuyimenyekanisha ku rwego rw'igihugu. Yatangiye iby'ikinamico kera akiri umwana muto yiga mu mashuri abanza mu 1983 aho yajyaga kwitoreza mu kigo cy'Abafurere mu muryango wa Andre Kagwa i Kabgayi. Mu mashuri yisumbuye yabyinjiyemo neza mu Ukwakira 1994, ubwo yajyaga gukora akazi k'ubutekenisiye muri Orinfor ubu yahindutse RBA. Ubu ni umutekenisiye mu kigo cy'igihugu cy'itangazamakuru RBA, abikomatanya no gukina amakinamico mu Urunana, Umurage ndetse no mu Indamutsa.

Nyirabagande Drocelle Fridaus wamamaye cyane mu ikinamico Urunana uzwi ku izina rya Langwida yitabye Imana ku myaka 64, ibi byabaye taliki ya 7 Kamena 2026 azize uburwayi bikekwa ko ari umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso.
Nyirabagande Drocelle Fridaus wari uzwi ku izina rya Langwida, yari atuye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge mu Murenge wa Nyamirambo mu Kagari ka Rugarama, mu Mudugudu wa Itetero. Langwida yatangiye kwiyumvamo impano yo gukina ikinamico ubwo yigaga mu mashuri abanza. Mu 1996, nibwo yagaragaje impano ye yo gukina, aho yatangiye akina mu itsinda rikorera mu muryango uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu aho bakinaga imikino ku ihohoterwa ryakorerwaga abagore. Mu 2000 nibwo yinjiye mu bakinnyi b'Urunana, muri uwo mukino ubu akaba yari afite abana babiri, Anyesi na Shyaka n'abuzukuru batatu barimo na Lupesu(Lopez), umukobwa we Anyesi yabyariye iwabo.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Nyange ni ikigo cy’ubuzima giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyange, Akarere ka Ngororero, mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba mu Rwanda. Gifasha abaturage mu mitangire ya serivisi z’ubuzima rusange, kikaba cyaravuguruwe mu buryo bujyanye n’igihe, hubakwa inyubako nshya n’ibikoresho bigezweho.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Nyarugunga ni rumwe mu bigo nderabuzima byo mu Mujyi wa Kigali, giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyarugunga mu karere ka Kicukiro kikaba gifasha abaturage mu rwego rw’ubuzima rusange, serivisi z’isuku, n’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Hanika ni ikigo cy’ubuzima cy’ibanze giherereye mu Murenge wa Busasamana, Akarere ka Nyanza, mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda. Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi rusange ku baturage bo muri ako gace ndetse no mu nkengero zako.
Iki kigo Nderabuzima giherereye mu Mudugudu wa Gihisi B, Akagari ka Kavumu, mu Murenge wa Busasamana, Akarere ka Nyanza. Ni kimwe mu bigo nderabuzima bifasha kwegereza abaturage serivisi z’ubuzima hafi yabo.
Serivisi zitangirwa.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Hanika gitanga serivisi z’ubuzima bw’ibanze zirimo:

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kazo ni ikigo nderabuzima giherereye mu murenge wa Kazo, Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda.
Iki kigo nderabuzima giherereye mu Mudugudu wa Umuyange, Akagari ka Gahurire, mu Murenge wa Kazo. Ni agace gatuwe n’abaturage barenga 32,000, bari basanzwe bajya kwivuza mu bindi bice birimo Kibungo, Mutenderi n’ibigo nderabuzima byo mu mirenge ihana imbibi na cyo.
Imirimo yo kubaka Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kazo yatangiye ku bufatanye bw’Akarere ka Ngoma n’umufatanyabikorwa NELSAP. Umushinga watwaye asaga miliyoni 630 Frw, ugamije kunoza serivisi z’ubuzima mu Murenge wa Kazo, wari umwe mu mirenge itari ifite ikigo nderabuzima cyuzuye.
Serivisi zihatangirwa.
Iki kigo nderabuzima gitanga serivisi z’ibanze z’ubuzima zirimo:
Akamaro ku baturage.
Kuzura kw’iki kigo nderabuzima byagabanyije cyane urugendo rurerure abaturage bakoraga bajya kwivuza mu bindi bigo nderabuzima nka Kibungo na Mutenderi. Ubu serivisi z’ubuvuzi ziboneka hafi, bikongera umutekano w’abarwayi n’ubwiza bw’ubuvuzi.
Imiterere y’ubuzima mu Murenge wa Kazo.
Umurenge wa Kazo utuwe n’abaturage barenga 32,450 nk’uko ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022 ribigaragaza. Ubu bafite uburyo bwiza bwo kubona serivisi z’ubuzima binyuze mu kigo nderabuzima cyabo cyuzuye.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kabuye ni ikigo nderabuzima giherereye mu Rwanda, mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z’ubuzima bw’ibanze ku baturage bo mu gace giherereyemo n’inkengero zacyo, kikaba ari kimwe mu bigo Nderabuzima bifasha mu kongera uburyo bwo kubona ubuvuzi hafi y’abaturage.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kabuye giherereye mu Karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu gace kazwi nka Kabuye. Aha ni ahantu hatuwe n’abaturage benshi, bigatuma serivisi z’ubuzima zitangwa n’iki kigo ziba ingenzi cyane.
Serivisi zihatangirwa.
Iki kigo nderabuzima gitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze zirimo:
Uruhare mu buzima rusange.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Kabuye gifite uruhare rukomeye mu guteza imbere ubuzima rusange bw’abaturage. Kiba hafi y’abaturage, kikabafasha kubona ubuvuzi bw’ibanze vuba, bityo kikagabanya umubare w’abajya mu bitaro bikuru ku ndwara zoroheje.
Imiyoborere n’imikoranire.
Nk’ibindi bigo nderabuzima byo mu Rwanda, gikorana n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima (RBC) ndetse n’ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze mu kunoza serivisi z’ubuzima no guteza imbere gahunda z’ubukangurambaga ku buzima.

Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Ngeruka ni ikigo cy’ubuzima cya Leta giherereye mu Murenge wa Ngeruka, Akarere ka Bugesera, Intara y’Iburasirazuba mu Rwanda. Iki kigo gitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze ku baturage batuye muri ako gace no mu nkengero zako.
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Ngeruka kiri mu Murenge wa Ngeruka, umwe mu mirenge igize Akarere ka Bugesera. Aka gace kazwi cyane kubera ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, kandi gatuwe n’abaturage benshi bakeneye serivisi z’ubuzima zegereye aho batuye.

Impamvu zatumye insengero zifungwa.
Insengero nyinshi mu Rwanda zafunzwe n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyoborere (RGB) kubera kutuzuza ibisabwa n’amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga ibikorwa by’amadini n’amatorero. Mu bugenzuzi bwakozwe, byagaragaye ko zimwe mu nsengero zakoreraga mu nyubako zitujuje ubuziranenge, zitagira imirindankuba, inzira zihagije zo gusohokamo mu gihe cy’impanuka, cyangwa izindi ngamba z’umutekano zarindaga abasengeramo. Hari kandi izakoraga zidafite ubuzima gatozi cyangwa zitemerewe gukora mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko. Rayina Laf, wavutse ku itariki ya13 septembre 1933 i Genoa maze apfa ku itariki ya11 décembre 2024 Ni umunyamategeko n'umwarimu wagize uruhare runini mu burezi bw'amategeko no guharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu mu Rwanda. Azwi cyane cyane kubera uruhare yagize mu gusana urwego rw'ubutabera mu Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside yo mu 1994 no gushinga Ishuri ryigenga rya Ahazaza.
Urubyiruko n'amahugurwa.
Rayina Laf yavukiye i Genoa mu Butaliyani, kuri se w’umunyabuligariya (umushushanyi) na nyina w’umutaliyani; izina rye ry’ubukobwa ryari Stefanoff. Yize amategeko mu Butaliyani, mu Bwongereza no mu Bufaransa, yibanda ku mategeko mpuzamahanga n’amategeko mpanabyaha. Yakomeje kwitwa Georges Luff, izina ry'umugabo we w' umwongereza (ari naho yakuye ubwenegihugu), nubwo baje gutandukana. Nyuma yo kuba i Barcelone n’umugabo we, aho babyaranye abana batatu, umuryango wimukiye mu Bubiligi. Yabonye impamyabumenyi ye y’ubunyangamugayo muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Buruseli (ULB) ndetse akora ibijyanye n’amategeko mu rugaga rw’abavoka i Buruseli mbere yo gukorera Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
Mu 1995, yagiye mu Rwanda nk'umwe mu bagize ubutumwa bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye bwo gufasha mu gusana urwego rw'ubutabera rw'igihugu. Yahuguye abanyamategeko ndetse atanga inama za tekiniki n'amategeko ku bayobozi ba leta.
Nk’umwarimu, Rayina Laf yigishije amasomo mu mategeko mpanabyaha, imitunganyirize y’ubutabera n’ubumenyi bwa politiki muri Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda (ubu ni UR) no mu Ishuri ry'ikirenga Gatolika rya Kabgayi (ICK).
Ishuri ryigenga rya Ahazaza.
Mu 2006, yashinze Ishuri Rigenga rya Ahazaza riri i Muhanga, mu Rwanda, agamije gutanga uburezi bufite ireme ku bana bakomoka mu miryango itishoboye. Iri shuri, rimwe mu mashuri ya mbere yemewe mpuzamahanga (Cambridge) muri ako karere, ryatanze buruse ku banyeshuri benshi.
Rayina Laf yahariye ubuzima bwe kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu no kubona uburezi bungana. Akunze kuvugwa nk'umuntu ukomeye mu guteza imbere ubutabera n'uburezi mu Rwanda. Yahawe igihembo cya Heneri La Fontene cya 2021.
Rayina Laf yapfiriye ku itariki ya11 Ukuboza 2024, afite imyaka 91, mu Bubiligi.
Akazi ke ko gushyigikira ubutabera n'uburezi kasize ikimenyetso kirambye ku Rwanda, kandi ahora avugwa nk'uwabitangiye n'abahoze ari abakozi be ndetse n'abanyeshuri.

Ingofero ya polo yo mu mazi n'agatambaro ko mu mutwe gakoreshwa mu mikino yo mu mazi. Izi ngofero zikoreshwa mu kwerekana umukinnyi n'ikipe ye, ndetse no kurinda amatwi ye imvune zishobora guterwa n'umupira wa polo wo mu mazi ukubise umutwe cyangwa se kind gice cyose giherereye ku mutwe.
Ikoreshwa ry' ingofero ya polo yo mumazi.
Ingofero zitandukanywa bitewe n'umubare wanditseho ndetse n'ibara. Abakinnyi b'ikipe y'abashyitsi bambara ingofero z'umukara, mu gihe abakinnyi b'ikipe y'iwabo bambara ingofero z'umweru. Abazamu bambara ingofero z'umutuku zifite inomero "1", mu gihe abasimbura bazamu bafite ingofero zifite inomero "1-A" mu mikino ya NCAA, cyangwa "13" mu mikino mpuzamahanga ya FINA. Bityo, buri kipe izaba ifite amaseti abiri y'ingofero: imwe y'umweru indi ifite ibara ryijimye. Dukurikije amategeko ya "NFHS yo" gukina umupira wo mu mazi, imibare iri ku ngofero itandukanya ibara ry'ingofero, kandi ibara ry'ingofero n'ibara ry'umubare bitandukanya ibara ry'umupira.
lkoreshwa n'mu mikino yo munsi y'amazi.
Mu mupira w'amaguru wo munsi y'amazi, Hockey yo munsi y'amazi na Rugby yo munsi y'amazi, abarushanwa bambara ingofero za polo zo mu mazi kugira ngo bamenye amakipe bakinira, kandi barinde abantu impanuka nko gucika kw'amatwi bitewe n'ibyuma by'ibaba byakoze ku gutwi. Abakinnyi bakina muri Hockey yo munsi y'amazi na Rugby yo munsi y'amazi bambara rimwe mu mabara abiri - ingofero z'umweru cyangwa iz'umukara (ni ukuvuga ubururu cyangwa umukara) mu gihe abasifuzi bo mu mazi bambara ingofero zitukura. Umupira w'amaguru wo munsi y'amazi usa n'aho ukurikiza iyi ngingo. Ingofero zikoreshwa kandi muri Aquathlon (gusiganwa munsi y'amazi) mu rwego rwo kumenyana; umwe mu bahatana yambara ingofero y'umutuku cyangwa ubururu mu gihe undi muhatana yambara ingofero y'umweru cyangwa umuhondo.

Arena SpA ni ikigo cy’Abataliyani gikora imyenda yo kogana mu ma rushanwa cyashinzwe mu 1973 na Horst Dassler. Iki kigo ubu gifite icyicaro gikuru i Tolentino, mu Butaliyani. Mu 1990, Arena yagurishijwe n' ikigo cy'Adidas ku kigo cy’Abayapani cyitwa Descente Ltd., kigicuruza ibicuruzwa byacyo.
Ifite amashami mu bihugu bigiye bitandukanye harimo Ubufaransa, mu Budage, no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikaba ikora binyuze mu muyoboro mpuzamahanga w’abakwirakwiza ibicuruzwa n’ababitanga, ikaba iboneka mu bihugu birenga 100 ku isi.
Arena yashinzwe mu 1973 na Horst Dassler, umuhungu wa Adolf Dassler aroi we wanashinze Adidas, area yashinzwe kugira ngo ikore imyenda yo kogana mu marushanwa. Igitekerezo cyo gukora imyenda ya siporo cyaje kuri Dassler nyuma y'uko Mark Spitz, wari umukinnyi mu marushanwa yo koga, yitwaye neza mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yabereye i Munich mu 1972, aho yatsindiye imidari irindwi ya zahabu.
Mu 1973, iki kigo cyashyize ahagaragara ubwoko bwa mbere bw'imyenda yo kogana, "Skinfit", ikozwe mu mwenda woroheje cyane upima amagarama 18 gusa. Nyuma y'umwaka umwe, Arena yasinye amasezerano yayo ya mbere yo gutera inkunga umukinnyi wabigize umwuga mu marushanwa yo koga wo muri Ositaraliya Shane Gould, wari waratsindiye imidari 5 ya Olempike i Munich. Arena yasohoye icyegeranyo cy'imyenda yo kogana yanditseho izina rye.
Nyuma yo kubona ko inkunga ari ingenzi ku ntsinzi y'ikirango cye, Arena yasinyishije abandi bakinnyi babigize umwuga mu mikino Olempike yo mu mpeshyi yabereye i Montreal mu 1976. Bamwe mu bakinnyi batewe inkunga harimo Mark Spitz, Novella Calligaris, Steve Furniss, David Wilkie, Shirley Babashoff, Gary Hall, Klaus Dibiasi, na Ulrika Knape, n'abandi.
Mu myaka ya 1980, Arena yakoze ikoti rya "Flyback", ryagenewe gufunga imishumi kugira ngo rikore imyenge minini y'ibitugu. Iyindi myenda yo kogana yakozwe ni "AquaRacer" (1990) na "X-Flat" (1997), mu gihe iki kigo cyakomeje gushaka impano nshya zo kongera ku rutonde rw'abaterankunga. Bamwe mu bakinnyi basinyiye ni Alexander Popov na Franziska van Almsick.

Ibiciro by'lbikomoka kuri peteroli byari bimaze igihe byaratumbagiye bishobora kuba bigiye kugabanuka nyuma yo kubona ko hashobora kuba hagiye kugaruka amahoro mu gice cy'uburasirazuba bwisi. Mu munsi ishize nibwo perezida w'igihugu cya Leta zunze ubumwe za America Donald Trump yagaragaje hashobora kuba hagiye kubaho agahenge ku macyimbirane yarahaze igihe avugwa hagati y'igihugu cye ndetse na Iran.
Nyuma yicyo gihe igiciro cy'ibikomoka kuri peteroli cyaragabanyutse kugera kigwa munsi y'amadorali ijana ku kagunguru. Ibi bije nyuma yuko bamwe badatinya kuvugango Ari ingaruka nziza ry'ifungurwa ry'umuhora wa Hormuzi.
Iri gabanuka r'ibikomoka kuri peteroli ribayeho nyuma yuko habayeho kwiyongera kw' ibi bikciro bibayeho mu ntangiriro z'umwaka nyuma yotangira ry'intambara ya Iran na Leta zunze ubumwe z'America yatangiye 28 Gashyantare yabangamiye urujya nuruza rw'amato anyura mu muhora wa Hormuzi acamo ahasaga kimwe cya gatanu kibikomoka kuri peteroli

Kuri uyu wa 8 Nyakanga 2026 habaye ibitero bisya hagati ya America na Iran.
Mu minsi ya vuba, umwuka mubi hagati ya Leta zunze ubumwe z'America na Iran wongeye gukomera cyane.Raporo zigaragaza ko habayeho ibitero bishya hagati y'impande zombi, ndetse n'ibikangisho byo gukomeza ibikorwa bya gisirikare, ibintu byashyize mu kaga umuhora wa horumuz, inzira inyuramo igice kinini cy'ubucuruzwa bwa peteroli ku isi.
America yagabye ibitero byinshi byo mu kirere ku birindiro bya gisirikare bya iran, ivuga ko byari igisubizo ku bitero bya Iran yari yagabye ku mato y'ubucuruzi anyura mu muhora wa Hormuz. Ibi bitero byibasiye ibikorwa by'ubwirinzi bwo mu kirere, radari, ububiko bwa missile n'ibindi bikorwa remezo bya gisisrikare.
Iran yahise isubiza irasa missile n'indege zitagira abapilote ku birindiro by'America biri muri Kuwait na Bahrain, inavuga ko ishobora kwagura ibitero n'ibikomeza. Pwerezida wa Leta zunze ubumwe z'America Donald Trump yavuze ko amasezerano y' agahenge yari arangiye, ariko asiga umuryango ufunguye ku biganiro by'amahoro mu gihe Iran yahagarika ibikorwa byayo. ibi byatumye impungenge z'uko intambara ishobora gukwira mu karere zongera kwiyongera.

Igikombe cy'isi ni irushanwa ry'imikino ku isi aho hitabira amakipe yaturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye cyangwa abantu ku giti cyabo bahagarariye ibihugu byabo bahatanira igikombe cy'isi. Igikombe cy'isi cya FIFA cy'ishyirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru, cyatangiye mu 1930. Kuva icyo gihe habayeho imikino myinshi yitwa "igikombe cy'isi", nka ICC Men's Cricket World Cup, ICC Men's T20 World Cup, ICC Men's T20 World Cup, Rugby World Cup, Rugby League Cup, Basketball World Cup, na Hockey World Cup.
Igikombe cy'isi muri rusange, nubwo atari buri gihe, gifatwa nk'irushanwa rikomeye mu mikino yacyo, aho uwatsinze abona icyubahiro gikomeye muri uwo mukino kandi akabasha kwegukana igikombe cy'abakinnyi beza cyane mu mikino yabo. Ariko, mu mikino imwe n'imwe, igikombe Olempike gifite nibura icyubahiro kimwe, mu gihe indi mikino nko kwibira no gukora siporo y'ubugeni itandukanye hagati y'amarushanwa yabo akomeye, nka Shampiyona y'Isi n'Imikino Olempike, n'Igikombe cy'Isi, gitegurwa nk'irushanwa rito ariko ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru.
Itandukaniro riri hagati y'igikombe cy'isi na shampiyona y'isi.
Amwe mu mashyirahamwe agenga siporo akunda izina " shampiyona y'isi " cyangwa irindi jambo rifitanye isano; amwe ndetse ategura igikombe cy'isi na shamipiyona y'isi gifite amategeko atandukanye. Ubusanzwe, amarushanwa nk'ayo aba mu buryo bubiri: irushanwa rigufi ry'igihe runaka cyangwa inama z'umwaka wose, ariko akenshi imikino myinshi igira igikombe cy'isi (ubusanzwe kiba kigizwe n'ibikorwa byinshi mu gihembwe kimwe), na shampiyona y'isi (ubusanzwe kiba igikorwa kimwe).
Igikombe cy'isi cyangwa shampiyona y'isi isanzwe rikorwa mu buryo bwa rya "knockout" (bibanzirizwa n'icyiciro cya mbere cy'amatsinda). Ibi biba mu minsi cyangwa ibyumweru byinshi, aho abitabiriye bagabanywaho kabiri, hanyuma irushanwa rikarangira ari umukino wa nyuma w'igikombe cy'isi. Uwatsinze (abatsinze) afata igikombe cya "World Champion" akagikomeza kugeza igihe irushanwa rizaba (ubusanzwe nyuma y'ine). Ubu buryo bukunze kugaragara mu mikino y'amakipe. Ariko mu mikino y'abantu ku giti cyabo, gutwara igikombe bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'igihe cy'irushanwa rikurikira hagati y'uwatsinze n'uwahanganye.
Imipangire y'igihe kirekire y'umwaka.
Igitekerezo gitandukanye, gikunzwe mu mikino y’abantu ku giti cyabo, ni irushanwa rimara umwaka wose rifite inama nyinshi mu gihe cyaryo. Muri ubu buryo, gutsinda mu nama y’abantu ku giti cyabo binjiza amanota menshi, kandi, ubusanzwe, imyanya myinshi iri munsi yayo ibona amanota ajyanye n’umwanya wabo. Abarushanwa bakusanya amanota menshi mu gihe cy’umwaka (akenshi " igihembwe ") kandi igiteranyo cyabo cyose nyuma y’uko inama zose zirangiye ni cyo kigena umukinnyi watwaye igikombe cy’isi cyangwa, mu buryo bworoshye, umukinnyi watsinze igikombe cy’isi. Hanyuma uwatsinze afatwa nk’umukinnyi watwaye igikombe kugeza ku gikombe cy’isi gitaha.

umusozi wa Warren () uherereye mu misozi miremire ya Wind River muri Leta ya Wyoming muri Amerika. Iri songa ni ryo songa rya gatatu mu misozi miremire rikaba n'irya kane rirerire muri Wyoming. Isonga riherereye mu butayu bwa Fitzpatrick bw'ishyamba rya Shoshone National Forest kandi rizamuka hejuru y'ibirunga byinshi, izwi cyane ni Dinwoody Glacier iri mu majyaruguru y'umunara w'isonga. Uwo musozi uri ku nkengero, ariko nturi imbere, haba muri Bridger National Forest cyangwa Sublette County, Wyoming.
Amamadubu n'ikibazo gihangayikishije muri iyi misozi miremire ya Wind River. Hari n'izindi mpungenge, harimo udukoko dutandukanye, inkongi z'umuriro, urubura rubi n'ubukonje bwo mu ijoro.
Icy'ingenzi ni uko habayeho impanuka zikomeye, harimo impfu ziturutse ku mpanuka, ziterwa no kugwa mu misozi miremire no kubera amabuye agwa, mu myaka yashize, harimo 1993, 2007 (harimo umuyobozi w'inararibonye wa NOLS), 2015 na 2018. Izindi mpanuka zirimo indege yakomeretse cyane yajyanywe hafi y'umusozi wa SquareTop mu 2005, n'impanuka y'umugenzi waguye mu misozi (iterwa no kugwa ku buryo butunguranye) mu 2006 yahuje leta n'abayirokoye. Ikigo gishinzwe amashyamba cya Amerika ntigitanga inyandiko zivuguruye ku mubare wemewe w'abapfuye muri Wind River Range.

Pariki ya Leta ya Ahjumawi Lava Springs ni pariki ya leta ya California muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iyi pariki iherereye mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Shasta County kandi abantu benshi bayigeraho bakoresheje ubwato gusa.
Pariki ifite kandi ntarengwa ubugari bwa, kandi ifite y'inkombe. Ibungabunga ubutayu bw'amasoko y'amazi meza n'amazi aheruka gutemba mu buryo bw'ubutaka. Imigezi irimo uruzi rwa Fall n'imigezi n'ibiyaga bifitanye isano. Inkombe ifite ibigobe by'ubururu n'ibirwa byuzuye ibiti ku burebure bwabyo. Hafi y'amasoko hari ibisigazwa by'imitego y'amafi yubatswe n'amoko kavukire ya Kaliforuniya nka Achomawi, aho iyi pariki yitiriwe. Inkuta z'amabuye magufi zikingiye ibidendezi bito cyane aho bafashe sucker na trout. Hafi bibiri bya gatatu bya itwikiriwe n'amabuye yo mu bwoko bwa basalt y'umukara itose ishyizwe mu mazi y'ibirunga mu myaka ibihumbi bibiri kugeza ku bihumbi bitanu ishize.
Leta ya Kaliforuniya yafashe ubwo butaka bwabikorera ku va mu 1975.
Pacific Gas &amp; Electric ifite ibice binini by'igishanga cyo muri ako gace. Igice kinini cy'inkombe za pariki kiri ku kiyaga kinini, cyakozwe igihe hashyirwaga imiyoboro y'amazi n'imiyoboro y'amazi. Hakozwe ubuhinzi bwa muskrat kugeza mu myaka ya 1930. Muskrat iracyagaragara mu bishanga byo muri ako gace. Ubwoko bwizi nyamaswa zitari iza gakondo buzwiho guhindura aho buba mu bishanga, byongera ibyago byo kuzura.
Nta mihanda rusange ijya kuri pariki ihari. Imodoka z’abantu ku giti cyabo zibujijwe kwinjiramo. Abashyitsi bashobora gushyira ubwato mu kiyaga kinini mu itangirizwa ry’ubwato rusange bwa Pacific Gas &amp;amp; Electric (PG&amp;E) buzwi nka Rat Farm.
Hari ahantu hatatu ho kuba mugihe wasuye iyi pariki. Abashyitsi bashobora kunyura mu nzira nto zo mu mazi bakoresheje ubwato cyangwa kayaks. Hari inzira zo gutemberamo zigera kuri kilometero 30. Kuroba birabujijwe ariko guhiga birabujijwe.
Abanyamerika kavukire.
Izina ry'iyi pariki riha icyubahiro Achomawi (rishobora kwandikwa nka "Ajumawi", "Achumawi", na "Ahjumawi") izina ryayo risobanura "aho amazi ahurira". Iyi pariki iherereye aho uruzi rwa Fall ruhurira, uruzi rwa Pit, rufite imigezi mito n'imigezi. Achomawi ni imwe mu matsinda cumi n'amwe y'ubwoko bwa Pit River bw'abaturage kavukire. Aba baturage batuye muri iyi pariki bitaga ku migezi yo muri ako gace, bakurikirana aho amafi avuka kandi bakagabanya amafi yabo kugira ngo bazigame amafi bakoreshaga nk'ibiribwa. Achomawi aracyatuye muri ako gace.
Amateka y'ibimera karemano.
Pariki ni imwe mu nzira nini cyane z'amazi yo munsi y'amazi mu gihugu." Bakora hafi y'amazi meza ku munsi mu migezi yo hejuru y'ubutaka. Amazi yo mu masoko aturuka mu gushonga kw'urubura mu misozi miremire ya Medicine Lake Volcano.
Iyi pariki iri mu gice aho Modoc Plateau ihinduka akarere k’ibimera ku nkombe. Akarere kahoze karashinzwe n’ibikorwa by’ibirunga kandi gafite ibintu byinshi bifitanye isano na geologiya, nk’imiyoboro ya lava n’ibirunga byuzuyemo amazi y’isoko, amamsoko n'ibindi.
Ibimera byo muri aka gace birimo ibiti bya pinusi, ceanothus, juniper yo mu burengerazuba, birchleaf na curlleaf mountain mahogany, na Garry oak. Inyoni zo muri ako gace zirimo Canada geese, snow geese, American white pelicans, blue-winged teal, Lewis's woodpeckers, northern pygmy owls, na ospreys. Izindi nyamaswa zirimo impongo n'imbwa.

Ibishanga "bya Myristica" n'ubwoko bw'ishyamba ry'ibishanga by'amazi meza bigizwe ahanini n'ubwoko bwa "Myristica". Ibi biboneka mu duce dutatu two mu Buhinde. Ibishanga bya "Myristica" bikunzwe kuzura amazi binyuze mu mizi y'ibiti n'imizi y'amavi. Ibishanga bya "Myristica" biboneka mu karere ka Uttara Kanada muri Leta ya Karnataka no mu majyepfo ya Kerala, mu mirima yera mo cyane cyane ya Goa n'ahantu habiri muri Maharashtra.
Ibishanga bya "Myristica" byasobanuwe nk'ubwoko butandukanye bw'ishyamba ry'inzitane na Krishnamurthy mu 1960. Ibi byibanzweho mu 1988 ubwo Rodgers na Panwar babivugaga nk'urusobe rw'amashyamba ruri mu kaga gakomeye mu Buhinde. Ibishanga byo muri Karnataka byakozweho ubushakashatsi burambuye na Chandran, MDS na bagenzi be mu 1999.
Nair, PV n'itsinda bafatanyije bakoze ubushakashatsi burambuye ku bimera n'inyamaswa bigaragara muri bishanga bya "Myristica" byo mu majyepfo ya Kerala mu 2007. Muri Kerala, ibishanga bya Myristica biboneka cyane mu turere twa Kulathupuzha, Anchal na Shendurney nukuvga mu karere ka Kollam. Nair PV na Pandalai bongeye kuvugurura ubwoko bumwe bw'ibiti byo mu bishanga mu 2012.
Gushushanya amakarita.
Ibishanga biri ku mpande zombi z'imigezi. Umupaka w'ibishanga ugaragara neza mu murima bitewe n'imizi y'ibiti. Chandran n'itsinda bafatanyije bashoboye kubona ibishanga bisaga 51 muri Uttara Kannada. Bashoboye kubyerekana ku makarita, no gusobanura aho biherereye, ariko ikarita nyayo y'imipaka ntiyageragejwe. Ikarita ya Nairpv na bagenzi be mu 2007 yari irambuye kandi bashushanyije ibishanga 60 bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga rya GPS. Ibishanga byari bifite ubuso buri hagati ya hegitari 0.25 na 10. Ibishanga biri mu buryo bubiri bw'imigezi bukwirakwiriye mu turere tubiri. Ikarita y'imipaka yagaragaje ko ubuso bwose bw'ibishanga bya Myristica muri Kerala ari hafi 1.5 km2, bingana na 0.004% by'ubutaka bwose bwa Kerala (38.864 km2) na 0.014% by'ubuso bwose bw'ishyamba rya Kerala (11.126 km2). Ibishanga byo muri Karnataka biri ku butumburuke bwa metero 300, ibishanga byo muri Kerala biri ku butumburuke bwa metero 200.
Chandran na bagenzi be bafatanyije batanze ibisobanuro birambuye ku bimera bagendeye ku bushakashatsi bakoze. Basanze ibimera 63 muri 130 by'indabyo byagaragaye biboneka mu Burengerazuba bwa Ghats mu Buhinde. Ubwoko bw'ibiti bw'ingenzi ni "Gymnocranthera canarica, Myristica fatua, Mastixia arborea, Semecarpus travancorica, Hopea ponga, Lophopetalum wightianum, Holigarna grahami, Sysygium laetum", nibindi. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Nair na bagenzi be bo mu majyepfo ya Kerala mu 2007 bwerekana ibiti mirongo inani na bibiri n'ubwoko mirongo icyenda na bine by'ibimera/ibihuru. Imirasire mirongo ine n'icyenda nayo yaranditswe. Ubwoko cumi na bubiri muri ibi bimera bwashyizwe ku rutonde rw'ibimera kandi amoko agera kuri 28 muri byo aboneka mu Burengerazuba bwa Ghats. Mu bice 19 by'icyitegererezo, "Gymnacranthera farquhariana" yari yiganje mu bice 10. "Myristica fatua" yari yiganje mu bishanga 6. Mu bice bisigaye, "Vateria indica" yari yiganje. "Holigarna arnottiana" na "Lophopetalum wightianum" byiganje mu zindi ngamba ebyiri.
Nair na bagenzi be bo mu majyepfo ya Kerala mu 2007 bibanze no ku nyamaswa. Ubwinshi bw'ibinyabuzima byo mu bishanga bya Myristica bwari bugizwe na Platyhelminthes - (Bipalium-2, tapeworm-1) amoko 3, Nemathelminthes - ubwoko 1, Annelida (Oligochaeta -2 na Hirudinea -2) amoko 4, Mollusca - amoko 10, Crustacean itazwi - ubwoko 1, Insecta - amoko 281 agize imiryango 83 yamenyekanye, Myriapoda - amoko 6 na Arachnidae amoko 54, Pisces amoko 14, Amphibia amoko 56, Reptilia amoko 55, Aves amoko 129 na Mammalia amoko 27. Isesengura ry'imibare y'ubushakashatsi bwa herpetofauna ryagaragaje ko hari itandukaniro mu miterere y'ibidukikije imbere no hanze y'igishanga rigira uruhare runini mu kugenzura ubwinshi bw'ibinyabuzima n'ubwinshi bw'inyamaswa zo mu mazi n'izikururuka. Inyamaswa zo mu bwoko bwa Amfibia zari zoroshye guhura n’impinduka mu bidukikije. Imiterere y’ubwinshi n’ubwinshi ku manywa na n'ijoro, mu bishanga no mu mezi yaratandukanye. Nta tandukaniro rinini ryagaragaye mu miterere y’ubwinshi bw'inyamanswa bwanditswe mu myaka ibiri. Inyamaswa nyinshi zanditswe ziri mu byiciro by’urutonde rutukura n’ibyagaragaye mu gace k’ibirwa hagendew kubushakashatsi.
Nair na bagenzi be bo mu majyepfo ya Kerala bagaragaza ubwinshi bw'ibinyabuzima byo mu mashyamba y'ibishanga bya Myristica. Ubushakashatsi kandi bwerekana ko hari amwe mu amakuru adafite aho ahuriye n'ubushakashatsi bushobora kuzu zuzwa gusa n'ubundi bushakashatsi muri aka karere. Ikibazo n'uburyo ubundi bushakashatsi bushobora gukorwa hatabayeho guhungabanya urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima by'ibi bishanga. Ikibazo cy'ingenzi ni ukumenya niba abantu bose bagomba kubuzwa kwinjira mu bishanga byiza kandi bitabangamiye cyane, hagasigara gusa ibishanga bibangamiye abantu (ubukerarugendo n'ubushakashatsi ku bumenyi). Kubungabunga ibi bishanga bito kandi bitatanye bigomba no gukemura ibibazo biri mu duce dukikije ibi bishanga. Ingamba zo gucunga no kubungabunga zatanzwe muri urwo rwego haruguru.

Bwishyura ni umwe mu mirenge 13 igize Akarere ka Karongi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Ufite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 46,21. Mu 2022, wari utuwe n’abaturage 40.720.
Mu 1994, Sitade ya Gatwaro yari muri Segiteri ya Bwishyura. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Abatutsi biciwe muri iyo sitade.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Bwishyura ni umwe mu mirenge 13 y’Akarere ka Karongi. Ufite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 46,21.
Ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012 ryabaruye abaturage 31.960. Ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022 ryabaruye abaturage 40.720. Abagabo bari 19.930. Abagore bari 20.790. Abaturage 18.530 batuye mu mujyi. Abaturage 22.190 batuye mu cyaro. Ubucucike bwari abaturage 881 kuri kilometero kare.
Umurenge wa Bwishyura ugabanyijemo utugari. Akagari na ko kagabanyijemo imidugudu. Kiniha ni kamwe mu tugari tw’Umurenge wa Bwishyura. Umudugudu wa Ruganda uri mu Kagari ka Kiniha.
Mu 1994, Bwishyura yari segiteri ya Komine Gitesi, muri Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Sitade ya Gatwaro yari yubatse muri Segiteri ya Bwishyura. Ibitaro bya Kibuye byari bifatanye n’iyo sitade.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abategetsi ba Perefegitura ya Kibuye bajyanye Abatutsi muri Sitade ya Gatwaro. Ku isonga ryabo hari Perefe Clément Kayishema. Ubwicanyi muri sitade bwatangiye ku cyumweru tariki ya 18 Mata 1994.
Iruhande rw’ahahoze Sitade ya Gatwaro, mu mujyi wa Kibuye, hari urwibutso rwa Jenoside.

Lamine Yamal ni umwe mu bakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru bakiri bato bafite impano idasanzwe mu mikino w'umupira w'amaguru muri iki gihe. Uyu mukinnyi akina nka rutahizamu anyura kuruhande rw'ibiryo mu ikipe ya FC Barcelona no mu ikipe y'igihugu ya Espanye.
Lamine Yamal yavutse ku itariki ya 13 Nyakanga 2007 avukira Esplugues de Llobregat, muri Kataluniya (Esipanye). Uyu mukinnyi avuka kuri Mounir Nasraoui ari we papa we akaba akomoka muri Marroc, naho nyina Sheila Ebana akaba akomoka muri Gunea Ekwatoriyali. Uyu mukinnyi ku myaka ye mike yakuriye mu gace ka Rocafonda i Mataro ikaba ari nayo mpamvu uyu mukinnyi iyamaze gutsinda igitego akunda gukora ikimenyetso cy'intoki cyerekana nimero 304 ikaba yari kode y'iposita y'i Rocafonda akaba abikoresha mu buryo bwo kuhazirikana no mu kuhaha agaciro.
Uko yisanze akinira Fc Barcelona ndetse n'ikipe y'igihugu ya Espanye.
Lamine yamal yatangiye ibya kariyeri ye yo gukina umupira mu ishuri ry'umupira w'amaguru rya Barcelona rya La Masia afite imyaka 7 gusa, azamuka vuba cyane kubera ubuhanga bwe. Muri Mata 2023, afite imyaka 15 n'am,amezi 9 yabaye umukinnyi muto kurusha abandi bakiniye ikipe nkuru ya Barcelona mu kinyejana cya 21. sibyo gusa kuko Lamine Yamal yabaye umukinnyi muto watsinze igitego muri shampiyona ya La Liga,Supercopa de Espana, na Copa del Rey.
Muri Nzeri 2023, yabaye umukinnyi muto watsindiye Esipanye kandi akaba n'umuto wayitsindiye igitego ku mukino wayihuje na Geworogiya. Sibyo gusa kuko uyumukinnyi yahesheje Esipanye igikombe k'iburayi (Euro 2024) aho yabaye umukinnyi muto kurusha abandi watwaye iki gikombe, ahabwa n'igijhembo cy'umukinnyi muto mwiza wirushanwa (Young Player of the Tournament), igitego yatsinze ubufaransa muri kimwe cya kabiri cyatorewe kuba igitego cyiza kirushanwa, Sibyo gusa kuko uyu mukinnyi yanafashize igihugu ke gutwara igikombe cy'isi cya 2026.

CECAFA KAGAME CUP ni irushanwa rihuza amakipe akomeye uo muri Afurika y'iburasirazuba no hagati (CECAFA ZONE). Mu 2026 ryabereye i Kigali, Rwanda kuva ku wa 24 Nyakanga kugeza ku wa 7 Kanama 2026, ikaba ari imikino yakiniwe ku bibuga aribyo Amahoro stadium na Kigali Pele stadium.
Iri rushanwa ryitabiriwe n'amakipe 12 yaragabanyije mu matsinda atatu(3)
Rayon Sport yaherukaga kugitwara mu 1988, yongeye kugitwara hashize imyaka 28 itsinze Gor Mahia yashakaag icya Kane ibitego 2 kuri 1.
Udushya twabaye muri CECAFA KAGAME CUP 2026.
Iri rushanwa ryatangiye ikipe ya APR Fc ikubitwa ibitego 5 na Gor Mahia mu mukino wafunguye irir rushanwa. Jamus Fc ikipe yaje ititezweho byinshi yabaye imwe mu makipe yatangaje abantu cyane kubera ukuntu yitwaye neza bikaza no kuyiha amahirwe yo gukina imikino ya kimwe cya kabiri kirangiza.
Bimwe kubyo wamenya ku bakinnyi bahize abandi, Emmanuel Nshimiyimana kapiteni wa Rayon Sport yahawe igihembo cya Best Player of CECAFA Kagame cup 2026 kubera uruhare rukomeye yagize mu gufasha Rayons Sport kwegukan igikombe ndetse ikipe ya Al Hilar yatwaye umwanya wa 3 itsinze Jamus FC

Amabwiriza mashya ya Rwanda FDA agenga ibinyobwa bisindisha, yasize amoko 52 y'inzoga afatiwe ibyemezo byo guhagarikwa ndetse no kutemererwa gucuruzwa ku isoko ry' u Rwanda bitewe n'ibipimo by'umutekano n'ubuziranenge..
Ku wa 20 Nyakanga 2026, Polisi y' u Rwanda yatangije gahunda ya "SI ZO ZAWE, ZANGE" yo kurwanya inzoga zitemewe cyangwa zahinduwemo ibintu bishobora guteza uburwayi. Ibi bije nyuma y' amakuru mashya y'ihagarikwa ry'agateganyo itumizwa mu Rwanda ry' amoko 52 y'ibinyobwa bisembuye.
Itangazo rya Rwanda FDA ryasabye guhagarika itumizwa,ikwirakwiza ry'inzoga zitemewe zirimo izizwi cyane arizo Kiwingu Spirit, Konyagi, Diamonda Rock Gin zikorerwa muri Tanzania, Gilbey's Flavored Gin ikorerwa muri Uganda ndetse n'izindi. Si izo gusa kuko mu moko menshi yahagaritswe harimo izituruka muri Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi, India na Polanda.
Iki cyemezo cyashyizweho mu rwego rwo kurengera ubuzima bw'abaturage no kugenzura ubuziranenge bw'ibinyobwa bisembuye, Rwanda FDA ikigo gifite inshingano zo kugenzura ibicuruzwa bishobora kugira ingaruka kubuzima rusange

Intara ya Beyla ni agace k'ubuyobozi bwa Gineya, gaherereye mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'igihugu. Umurwa mukuru wayo ni umujyi wa Beyla.
Mbere y'itegeko ryo ku ya 20 Kanama 2026, agace k'intara ya Beyla kari mu gace ka Nzerekore. Icyo gihe umujyi wa Beyla wari umurwa mukuru w'intara yitwaga iryo zina. Iteka rya Perezida ryashyizeho Beyla nk'intara kubuyobozi bwuzuye, gafite ububasha ku turere twa Beyla (umurwa mukuru), Sinko, Kouankan na Karala. Yashinzwe nk'agace k'ubuyobozi n'itegeko rya perezida ryo ku ya 20 Kanama 2026, rishyiraho Intara 11 n'uturere dushya 2.

(lit, Obradoiro Inshuti za Basketball Club), izwi kandi nka Monbus Obradoiro kubwimpamvu zo gutera inkunga, ni ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru ya basketball ifite icyicaro i Santiago de Compostela, Galicia. Hafidh Ameir Hassan, wavutse ku ya 1 Mutarama 1946 i Kisakasaka, agapfa ku ya 7 Nzeri 2026 i Zanzibar, yari umuhanga mu by'ubuhinzi n'uwahoze ari umuyobozi mu rwego rw'ubuhinzi muri Tanzaniya, akaba yari umugabo wa Perezida Samia Suluhu Hassan. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yabaye umugabo wa mbere wa Perezida wa Tanzaniya witiriwe "First Gentleman", nyuma y'uko Samia Suluhu Hassan abaye Perezida muri Werurwe 2021.
Hafidh Ameir Hassan yavukiye i Kisakasaka, muri Zanzibar, ku ya 1 Mutarama 1946. Kisakasaka iherereye mu karere ka Magharibi B, mu gice cya Unguja Urban-West. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yize amashuri abanza i Kombeni Shakani, akomereza amashuri yisumbuye muri Tumekuja School i Mkunazini, aho Hafidh Ameir Hassan yarangirije mu 1965.
Mu 1970, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yatangiye kwiga muri Zanzibar Teachers' College, arangiza amasomo mu 1973. Nyuma yaho Hafidh Ameir Hassan yabaye umwarimu mu bigo bitandukanye by'amashuri muri Tanzaniya. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yaje kwerekeza mu buhinzi, akurikirana amahugurwa yihariye muri Uyole Agricultural College i Mbeya.
Mu 1982, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yabaye umwigisha w'ubuhinzi muri Fidel Castro School ku kirwa cya Pemba. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yakomeje amahugurwa hanze y'igihugu, harimo muri Sri Lanka, aho Hafidh Ameir Hassan yize ubuhinzi kandi agira ubumenyi bwihariye mu buhinzi bw'imikindo itanga cocotier. Nyuma yaho, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yakurikiranye mu Bwongereza amahugurwa yo ku rwego rwa master's mu by'ubukanishi bukoreshwa mu buhinzi, yibanda ku mashini z'ubuhinzi.
Nyuma yo gusubira i Zanzibar, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yakoreye Minisiteri y'Ubuhinzi ya Zanzibar kugeza Hafidh Ameir Hassan agiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2005. Nyuma yaho Hafidh Ameir Hassan yakomeje kwigisha muri Kizimbani Agricultural College.
Ubuzima bw'umuryango.
Hafidh Ameir Hassan yashakanye na Samia Suluhu Hassan mu 1978. Hafidh Ameir Hassan na Samia Suluhu Hassan babyaranye abana bane, abahungu batatu n'umukobwa umwe. Umukobwa wa Hafidh Ameir Hassan na Samia Suluhu Hassan, Wanu Hafidh Ameir, yinjiye muri politiki kandi yakoze imirimo ya Leta muri Tanzaniya.
First Gentleman wa Tanzaniya.
Igihe Samia Suluhu Hassan yabaga Perezida wa Repubulika Yunze Ubumwe ya Tanzaniya muri Werurwe 2021, nyuma y'urupfu rwa Perezida John Magufuli, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yabaye umugabo wa mbere washakanye n'umuntu wari uyoboye Tanzaniya ku mwanya wa Perezida. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yatangiye kwitwa "First Gentleman" wa Tanzaniya.
Mu gihe Samia Suluhu Hassan yari afite uruhare muri politiki y'igihugu, Hafidh Ameir Hassan yakomeje kutagaragara cyane mu bikorwa rusange. Hafidh Ameir Hassan yari azwi cyane kubera umwuga wa Hafidh Ameir Hassan mu buhinzi no mu burezi.
Hafidh Ameir Hassan yapfuye ku ya 7 Nzeri 2026 mu bitaro bya Emilio Mzena Memorial i Zanzibar, aho Hafidh Ameir Hassan yari arimo kuvurwa indwara y'umutima. Urupfu rwa Hafidh Ameir Hassan rwatangajwe na Visi Perezida wa Tanzaniya Deogratius Ndejembi, wahumurije Samia Suluhu Hassan, umuryango wa Hafidh Ameir Hassan n'abandi bari hafi ya Hafidh Ameir Hassan.
Hafidh Ameir Hassan yashyinguwe uwo munsi i Kizimkazi, muri Zanzibar. Mu muhango wo gushyingura Hafidh Ameir Hassan hari abayobozi ba Leta, abanyamadini n'abanyapolitiki bo muri Tanzaniya.

Mausole ya Sarakawa (mu Gifaransa: "Mausolée de Sarakawa") ni ahantu h'urwibutso haherereye i Sarakawa, muri komine ya Kozah 2, mu Perefegitura ya Kozah, Intara ya Kara, muri Togo. Hibutsa impanuka y'indege yabaye ku wa 24 Mutarama 1974, ubwo indege y'ingabo zirwanira mu kirere za Togo yari itwaye Perezida Gnassingbé Eyadéma n'abandi bayobozi yagwaga hafi ya Sarakawa. Eyadéma yararokotse, ariko abantu benshi bari muri iyo ndege barapfa.
Aho hantu h'urwibutso harimo ibisigazwa by'indege, igishushanyo cya Gnassingbé Eyadéma n'inzibutso zahariwe abapfiriye muri iyo mpanuka. Ni na ho hakorerwa buri mwaka imihango ya Leta yo kwibuka ibyabaye.
Ku wa 24 Mutarama 1974, indege yo mu bwoko bwa Douglas C-47 Skytrain y'ingabo zirwanira mu kirere za Togo, yari itwaye Perezida Gnassingbé Eyadéma hamwe n'abayobozi benshi ba politiki n'abasirikare, yakoze impanuka hafi ya Sarakawa ubwo yavaga i Lomé yerekeza i Pya. Eyadéma yararokotse, ariko abantu benshi bari muri iyo ndege barapfa.
Nyuma y'impanuka, Eyadéma yavuze ko yari yaratewe n'igikorwa cyo kwangiza indege, kijyanye n'amakimbirane yari ashingiye ku bucukuzi bwa fosifate muri Togo. Kubera iyo mpamvu, mu mihango yemewe ya Leta ya Togo, ibyabaye byakunze kwitwa "igitero cya Sarakawa" (mu Gifaransa: "attentat de Sarakawa"), nubwo izindi nyandiko zibifata nk'impanuka y'indege.
Mausole yubatswe nyuma y'iyo mpanuka, maze igenda itunganywa kugira ngo ibe urwibutso rw'igihugu n'ahantu hakorerwa imihango yo kwibuka.
Ahantu h'urwibutso harimo ibisigazwa by'indege yakoze impanuka. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku kamaro ka politiki n'ibimenyetso byubatswe ku mateka ya Sarakawa bugaragaza ko ibisigazwa by'indege ari kimwe mu bintu by'ingenzi bigize urwo rwibutso.
Aho hantu kandi hari igishushanyo cya Gnassingbé Eyadéma ahagaze, gikikijwe n'ahantu hatatu h'urwibutso hari amafoto y'abajenerali batatu bapfiriye muri iyo mpanuka.
Imihango yo kwibuka.
Imihango yemewe yo kwibuka ibyabaye ikorerwa kuri mausole hafi y'itariki ya 24 Mutarama buri mwaka, ari yo sabukuru y'impanuka. Ubusanzwe iyo mihango irimo gushyira indabo ku rwibutso no guha icyubahiro abapfiriye muri iyo mpanuka.
Abayobozi bakuru ba politiki, ubutegetsi, igisirikare n'abayobozi gakondo bakunze kwitabira iyo mihango. Faure Gnassingbé yayoboye imihango myinshi yo kwibuka yabereye aho. Mu muhango wo kwizihiza isabukuru ya 52 wabaye muri Mutarama 2026, yashyize indabo kuri mausole ari Perezida w'Inama.
Gusana no kuvugurura.
Mausole ya Sarakawa yagiye isanwa kandi ivugururwa inshuro zitandukanye. Mu 2020, Guverinoma ya Togo yagennye miliyoni 25 z'amafaranga CFA kugira ngo hakorwe imirimo yo kuyisana.
Muri Gashyantare 2021, Guverinoma yatangaje indi gahunda yo kuvugurura urwibutso, imirimo yari iteganyijwe kumara amezi atatu.
Mu 2025, Minisiteri y'Ibikorwa Remezo n'Imirimo ya Leta yongeye gutangaza isoko ry'imirimo yo kuvugurura Mausole ya Sarakawa.

Ibishushanyo byo ku rutare bya Namoudjoga ni itsinda ry'ibishushanyo byo ku rutare biri ku misozi ya Namoudjoga, mu Ntara ya Savanes, mu majyaruguru ya Togo, hafi ya Dapaong.
