Ibyo bishushanyo biri ku rutare runini rwikinga kandi bigaragaza abantu, inyamaswa, abagendera ku mafarashi n'ibimenyetso bya jewometiri. Ni bimwe mu hantu henshi hari ubuhanzi bwo ku rutare mu karere ka Dapaong, harimo n'ibishushanyo byo muri Sogou na Maogdjoal.
Ahantu ha Namoudjoga hari nko ku bilometero 25 kugeza kuri 30 mu burasirazuba bwa Dapaong, hafi y'umudugudu wa Namoudjoga, ku muhanda uva Dapaong ujya Namoudjoga unyuze i Korbongou. Hari nko ku bilometero 25 uvuye i Dapaong.
Ibishushanyo biri ku rutare runini rwakozwe n'ibidukikije, rufite isura isa n'iy'ikinyabihumyo kandi rukaba rumeze nk'ubwihisho bwo ku rutare. Ahandi hari ibishushanyo byo ku rutare muri ako karere harimo imisozi ya Sodjoual i Sogou na Maogdjoal, mu karere kagari ka Dapaong.
Ibyo bishushanyo bigaragaza abantu, inyamaswa, abagendera ku mafarashi n'ibimenyetso bya jewometiri. I Namoudjoga havugwa amatsinda ane y'ibishushanyo. Itsinda rya mbere ririmo umuntu ugendera ku ifarashi, inyamaswa ebyiri, umuntu n'ibimenyetso bibiri bya jewometiri bitaramenyekana neza. Itsinda rya kabiri rigaragaza umuntu ugendera ku ifarashi hamwe n'amafarashi abiri, naho itsinda rya kane ririmo abantu bagera kuri batanu bagendera ku mafarashi n'umuntu uhagaze.
Ahantu ha Sogou hegeranye na Namoudjoga hari ibice byinshi by'amabuye bishushanyijeho. Mu bimenyetso byanditswe ko bihari harimo imirongo ihagaze n'iryamye, imirongo y'utudomo, inziga, utudomo twihariye, abagendera ku mafarashi n'inyamaswa, hamwe n'ibimenyetso bya jewometiri n'ibishushanyo by'abantu n'inyamaswa.
Imiterere y'ubucukumbuzi.
Hafi y'ubwihisho bwo ku rutare bwa Namoudjoga habonetse ibikoresho by'ubucukumbuzi, birimo ibisigazwa by'ibikoresho by'amabuye bikozwe muri silex, ibice by'ibikoresho by'ibumba n'ibisigazwa bifitanye isano n'ikorwa rya kera ry'icyuma. Mu karere kagari ka Dapaong kandi habonetse ibimenyetso by'ikorwa ry'ibikoresho by'amabuye byo mu bihe bya kera. Muri ako karere kandi habonetse ibimenyetso byerekana ko abantu bahatuye kuva kera.
Ivumburwa n'iyandikwa.
Ibishushanyo byo ku rutare bya Namoudjoga na Sogou byavumbuwe mu 1990 n'abamisiyoneri. Nyuma byashyizwe mu nyandiko zisobanura ahantu h'ubucukumbuzi n'umurage ndangamuco wo mu majyaruguru ya Togo.
Kubungabunga, ubukerarugendo n'umurage ndangamuco.
Ibishushanyo byugarijwe n'isuri, ihindagurika ry'ikirere n'ibikorwa by'abantu. Mu 2025, isuri, imiterere y'ikirere n'ikorwa ry'ubwangizi byari bibangamiye aho hantu, kandi hari ingamba nke zo kuhakingira. Gukorakora ku mabuye nta mbogamizi na byo bituma ibishushanyo bigenda bishira.
Ibishushanyo byo ku rutare bya Namoudjoga byamamazwa nk'ahantu ndangamuco kandi hakurura ba mukerarugendo mu majyaruguru ya Togo. Aho hantu hafatwa nk'hamwe mu hantu nyamukuru hakurura ba mukerarugendo mu karere ka Dapaong.
Inyandiko z'ubukerarugendo zivuga kuri Dapaong zikunze guhuza Namoudjoga n'ahandi hantu ndangamuco ho mu karere, harimo ubuvumo n'ibigega byo ku misozi bya Nok na Maproug, hamwe n'inzu ndangamurage y'akarere ya Dapaong.

Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Kara () ni inzu ndangamurage iherereye i Kara, muri Togo.
Iherereye mu Ngoro y'Inama ya Kara, kandi ibika ikanerekana ibintu bijyanye n'imigenzo, imibereho n'amateka y'umuco y'abaturage bo muri ako karere.
Inzu ndangamurage yafunguwe mu 1983.
Ni imwe mu nzu ndangamurage rusange zo ku rwego rw'uturere muri Togo. Izindi ni Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Maritime iri i Aného, Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Centrale iri i Sokodé n'Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Savanes iri i Dapaong.
Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Kara iri mu Ngoro y'Inama ya Kara.
Inzu ndangamurage yerekana ibintu bijyanye n'imibereho ya buri munsi n'umurage ndangamuco w'abaturage bo mu Karere ka Kara. Ibyegeranyo byayo birimo ibikoresho by'ubuhinzi n'iby'ubuhigi, ibikoresho byo mu rugo, ibikoresho bya muzika, imyambaro gakondo, ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu mihango n'amafoto.
Ibyegeranyo binagaragaza uburyo bwo guhinga, ubukorikori, ububoshyi, imihango gakondo, imihango yo gushyingura n'indi migenzo n'imibereho y'abaturage.
Inzu ndangamurage ibika kandi inyandiko n'amafoto bijyanye n'amateka ya vuba ya Togo. Muri byo harimo amakuru ajyanye n'uwahoze ari Perezida wa Togo Gnassingbé Eyadéma, wavukiye muri ako karere, hamwe n'impanuka y'indege yabereye i Sarakawa mu 1974.
Kubungabunga no gucunga ibyegeranyo.
Muri Gicurasi 2024, itsinda ry'abahanga bo mu buyobozi bwa Togo bushinzwe umurage ndangamuco ryakoze isuzuma ry'uburyo ibyegeranyo byo mu nzu ndangamurage rusange zo mu gihugu bibungabungwa. Inzu Ndangamurage y'Akarere ka Kara yari mu bigo byasuwe muri iryo suzuma.
Iryo suzuma ryarebaga ibintu biri mu imurikagurisha rihoraho no mu bubiko bw'inzu ndangamurage, inyandiko zibisobanura, uko bibungabunzwe ndetse n'ingamba zikenewe kugira ngo birusheho kurindwa.

Filime ya Our Lady of the Nile (Bikira Mariya wa Nile) yo mu mwaka w'2019 yayobowe kandi inandikirwa na Atiq Rahimi. Iyi filime ishingiye ku gitabo cyasohotse mu mwaka w'2012 cyitwa "Our Lady of the Nile" cyanditswe n'umwanditsi w'Umunyarwandakazi witwa Scholastique Mukasonga, ni igitabo kivuga ku mateka y'u Rwanda, mu ntangiriro z'amakimbirane hagati y'Abahutu n'Abatutsi yaje kurangira habayeho jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Iyi filime ivuga ku Rwanda mu ntangiriro z'umwaka w' 1990 mu ishuri ry’abakobwa b’abagatolika ry’abana bato, Our Lady of the Nile, riri hafi y’isoko y’uruzi rwa Nili. Iri shuri rihuza abanyeshuri bakomokaga mu miryango y’Abahutu n’Abatutsi, riyobowe n’abapadiri n’abarimu b’i Burayi. Nubwo ikigo cyatezaga imbere umuco mwiza n'indangagaciro z'idini, amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko yari agihari. Abanyeshuri b'Abatutsi bahuraga n'ivangura ridasanzwe, mu gihe abanyeshuri b'Abahutu bashishikarizwa kugaragaza ubwoko bwabo. Uko ibibazo bya politiki byarushagaho kwiyongera mu gihugu hose, ni na ko urwango muri iryo shuri rwarushagaho kwiyongera. Babitewe n’ibitekerezo bya poropaganda n’igitutu cyo mu miryango, bamwe mu banyeshuri bakoraga ibikorwa byo kwirukana no guhohotera bagenzi babo b’Abatutsi. Gusenyuka kw'amategeko muri iryo ishuri bigaragaza isenyuka rikomeye ry'imibereho ryabaye mu muryango nyarwanda, bikaba byaraganishije u Rwanda kuri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Iserukiramuco Mpuzamahanga rya Filime rya Berlin rya 2020, ryatsindiye: Crystal Bear (Generation 14plus) Filime nziza.

Irimbi ry'Abadage rya Lomé ni irimbi rya kera riri i Lomé muri Togo. Ni kimwe mu bisigazwa by'amateka y'ubukoloni bw'Abadage muri Togo. Ririmo imva z'abamisiyoneri, abacuruzi, abayobozi b'ubutegetsi bw'Abadage ndetse n'Abanyatogo.
Irimbi ryashinzwe mu 1893. Imva ya kera cyane ihari ni iy'umuntu wapfuye mu 1889, umurambo we ukaza kwimurirwa muri iri rimbi nyuma.
Mu 1902, guverineri w'Abadage August Köhler yategetse ko abakozi b'ubutegetsi bw'Abadage bapfiraga muri Togo bashyingurwa muri icyo gihugu aho koherezwa mu Budage. Köhler na we yapfuye nyuma y'amezi make maze ashyingurwa muri iri rimbi.
Irimbi ririmo imva zirenga mirongo ine zo mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abadage. Mu bantu bahashyinguwe harimo abamisiyoneri, abacuruzi n'abakozi b'ubutegetsi. Nyuma y'ubutegetsi bw'Abadage, Abanyatogo barimo abapasiteri Andreas Aku na Robert Baeta na bo bahashyinguwe.
Irimbi riherereye hafi y'inyanja i Lomé, ku muhanda wa Tokmake wahoze witwa "Bremer Straße" mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abadage. Rikikijwe n'urukuta kandi irembo rikuru rireba mu cyerekezo cy'inyanja.
Irimbi riri mu bisigazwa by'amateka y'ubukoloni bw'Abadage muri Togo byashyizwe mu bikorwa byo kumenyekanisha umurage w'amateka na Goethe-Institut.

Irimbi ry'Abadage rya Mango ni irimbi n'ahantu ndangamateka biherereye i Mango, mu karere ka Savanes mu majyaruguru ya Togo. Harimo imva z'abasirikare batatu b'Abadage bapfuye mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19.
Iri rimbi riri mu hantu ndangamateka hagize umurage ndangamuco wa Togo.
Irimbi rifitanye isano n'igihe Togo yari ubukoloni bw'Ubudage. Abasirikare batatu b'Abadage, Wilhelm Bierwerth, Henrich Werner na Theodor Heitman, ni bo bahashyinguye. Bari bakorera i Sansaanné, ubu hitwa Mango, kandi bapfuye mu 1896 no mu 1899.
Iri rimbi ryavuguruwe mu 1990.
Ku wa 18 Ugushyingo 2012, Joseph Weiss, wari ambasaderi w'Ubudage muri Togo, yasuye irimbi ry'Abadage rya Mango kugira ngo yunamire abasirikare bahashyinguye. Yashyize indabo ku mva zabo ari kumwe n'abahagarariye ubuyobozi bwa Togo n'Ubudage ndetse n'abasirikare bakuru ba Togo.
Uyu muhango wanagaragajwe nk'igikorwa cyo kwibuka no gushimangira amahoro n'ubwiyunge hagati ya Togo n'Ubudage.
Irimbi ry'Abadage rya Mango ryashyizwe ku rutonde rw'ahantu ndangamateka n'umutungo ndangamuco wa Togo rwasohotse mu Igazeti ya Leta mu 2017. Ruri kumwe n'ibindi bimenyetso by'igihe cy'Abadage i Mango, birimo iriba ry'Abadage, inyubako ya gasutamo, ikiraro cyo ku ruzi rwa Oti n'inyubako yahoze ari iposita y'Abadage.
Komini ya Oti 1 na yo igaragaza iri rimbi nk'ahantu ndangamateka hashobora gusurwa i Mango.

Centre hospitalier universitaire Sylvanus Olympio (CHU Sylvanus-Olympio cyangwa CHU-SO) ni ibitaro bya Leta biri i Lomé muri Togo. Ni kimwe mu bigo bikomeye by'ubuvuzi byifashishwa mu koherezamo abarwayi muri Togo. Bitanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi, bikigishirizwamo abaganga kandi bigakorerwamo ubushakashatsi ku bufatanye n'Ishami ry'Ubumenyi bw'Ubuzima rya Kaminuza ya Lomé.
Kubaka ibi bitaro byatangiye mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1940. Ibuye ry'ifatizo ryashyizweho ku wa 19 Ugushyingo 1949, maze ibitaro bifungurwa mu 1954, icyo gihe byitwaga "Centre national hospitalier" (CNH).
Mu 1971, ubwo hashyirwagaho ishuri ry'ubuvuzi muri Kaminuza ya Bénin yaje guhinduka Kaminuza ya Lomé, ikigo cyahawe urwego rw'ibitaro bya kaminuza, cyitwa "Centre hospitalier universitaire de Lomé-Tokoin". Icyo cyemezo cyemejwe n'iteka nimero 71-184 ryo ku wa 12 Ukwakira 1971.
Ku wa 26 Mata 2012, ibitaro byiswe "Centre hospitalier universitaire Sylvanus Olympio", mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Sylvanus Olympio, wabaye perezida wa mbere wa Togo. Iryo zina ryemejwe n'iteka nimero 2012-020/PR.
CHU Sylvanus Olympio ifite inshingano eshatu z'ibanze: gutanga ubuvuzi, kwigisha no gukora ubushakashatsi.
Ibitaro byakira abarwayi baza kwisuzumisha n'abakeneye kuryamishwa, kandi bikita ku ndwara n'impanuka byihutirwa, harimo n'ibisaba kubagwa. Bitanga ubuvuzi rusange n'ubw'inzobere.
Mu mashami y'ubuvuzi harimo ay'indwara z'umutima, ubuvuzi bw'indwara zo mu mubiri, endocrinologie, indwara z'impyiko, iz'imyakura, iz'ubuhumekero, rubagimpande n'indwara zandura. Hari kandi anesthésie-réanimation, kubaga rusange, kubaga abana, neurochirurgie, ubuvuzi bw'amaso, oto-rhino-laryngologie, urologie-andrologie n'ubuvuzi bw'imvune n'amagufwa.
CHU-SO ifite kandi serivisi z'ubuvuzi bw'abagore n'ibyerekeye kubyara, iz'abana n'abana bavutse imburagihe, laboratwari n'imaging y'ubuvuzi.
Ibitaro bigira uruhare mu guhugura abanyeshuri n'abaganga bari mu myitozo mu byiciro bitandukanye by'ubuvuzi, ku bufatanye n'Ishami ry'Ubumenyi bw'Ubuzima rya Kaminuza ya Lomé. Abanyeshuri bahakorera imyitozo yo kwa muganga n'amahugurwa yihariye mu mashami atandukanye.
CHU Sylvanus Olympio ikorerwamo kandi ubushakashatsi bw'ubuvuzi n'ubwa siyansi. Mu mashami yayo hakorerwa inyigo za kaminuza n'ubushakashatsi bukorerwa ku barwayi.
Serivisi n'ibikoresho.
CHU Sylvanus Olympio igizwe n'amashami y'ubuvuzi, kubaga, kuvura abana n'ubuvuzi bw'abagore n'ibyerekeye kubyara, hamwe na serivisi zo gusuzuma indwara na farumasi.
Serivisi zifasha mu gusuzuma zirimo anatomie na cytologie pathologiques, biochimie, hématologie na immunologie, histologie-embryologie, bactériologie, virologie na parasitologie. Ikigo gifite kandi radiologie, imaging y'ubuvuzi na farumasi y'ibitaro.
CHU Sylvanus Olympio yagiye ivugururwa mu rwego rwo kunoza inyubako n'ibikoresho byayo. Mu 2022, Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Iterambere (PNUD) ryagize uruhare mu gusana no guha ibikoresho ishami rishinzwe kwakira indembe zikeneye kubagwa.
Imirimo yamaze amezi cumi n'abiri, irimo gusana inyubako, gutunganya icyumba cyo kubagiramo no gushyiramo ibikoresho bishya by'ubuvuzi. Yatwaye amafaranga arenga miliyoni 200 z'amafaranga CFA, kandi ubushobozi bw'ishami ry'indembe zikeneye kubagwa bwavuye ku bitanda 12 bugera kuri 30. Ibitaro byanashyizwemo scanner mu rwego rwo kongera ubushobozi bw'imaging y'ubuvuzi.
Imiyoborere n'ubushobozi.
CHU Sylvanus Olympio iri ku butaka bwa hegitari zigera ku 10 mu gace ka Tokoin i Lomé. Ifite ubushobozi bw'ibitaro bwagenwe ku bitanda 1,138, kandi ikoresha abakozi barenga 1,000.
Mu 2017, mu ivugurura ry'imicungire y'ibitaro rishingiye ku masezerano, CHU-SO yasobanuwe nk'ikigo cya Leta gifite ubuzima gatozi n'ubwigenge mu micungire y'imari. Icyo gihe ubushobozi bwari ibitanda 1,138, muri byo 830 bikaba ari byo byakoraga, naho abakozi bari 1,271.

Rudy Ursula Hombenet Anvingui (9 Kanama 1988 – 27 Kanama 2026) yari umunyamakuru wo muri Gabon. Yakoreye cyane ikinyamakuru "L'Union", aho yabaye umunyamakuru, umwanditsi w'inkuru zihoraho ndetse akanagira uruhare mu guteza imbere itangazamakuru ryacyo ryo kuri interineti.
Amashuri n'intangiriro z'umwuga.
Hombenet Anvingui yize muri Université Omar-Bongo i Libreville, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n'itumanaho n'itangazamakuru.
Mu rwego rwo kongera ubumenyi bw'umwuga, yanitabiriye amahugurwa yo hanze y'igihugu, harimo ayo yakoreye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Hombenet Anvingui wakomokaga i Moanda, yatangiye gukora mu bitangazamakuru mbere yo kujya muri "L'Union". Mu 2016 yatangiye kuhakorera nk'umunyamakuru wigenga, aza guhabwa akazi gahoraho muri Nyakanga 2019.
Yibandaga cyane ku ngingo z'imibereho y'abaturage, zirimo uburezi, uburenganzira bw'abagore, ikoranabuhanga n'ubuzima rusange. Muri "L'Union" yakoze nk'umunyamakuru n'umwanditsi w'inkuru z'ubuzima, ndetse agira uruhare mu guteza imbere urubuga rw'ikinyamakuru n'ibindi bikorwa byacyo byo kuri interineti.
Yanagize uruhare mu gutegura uburyo bushya bwo gutangaza amakuru, burimo ibiganiro "Face à L'Union" na "L'U Express".
Muri Kamena 2026, Hombenet Anvingui yahawe igihembo cy'umunyamakuru mwiza w'itangazamakuru ryanditse mu bihembo bya Makongonio, bigenewe abanyamakuru bo muri Gabon.
Rudy Ursula Hombenet Anvingui yapfiriye i Libreville mu ijoro ryo ku wa 26 rishyira ku wa 27 Kanama 2026, afite imyaka 38.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kamembe ni urwibutso ruherereye i Kamembe, mu Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda. Rushyinguyemo kandi rwibukirwamo Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, by'umwihariko abiciwe mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu. Kuri uru rwibutso hanabera ibikorwa ngarukamwaka byo Kwibuka.
Urwibutso rwa Kamembe ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kamembe ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'imva rusange nyinshi ziri mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo, zibumbatiye amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Zimwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside, nk'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero, zashyizwe mu Murage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kamembe ruherereye iruhande rwa Sitade Kamarampaka, mu Murenge wa Kamembe, Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu.
Kamembe iherereye mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu, aho itotezwa ry'Abatutsi (kumeneshwa, gufungwa n'ubundi bugizi bwa nabi) ryatangiye kuva mu 1959, rikongera gukaza umurego mu 1963–1964 no mu 1973. Hagati ya 1990 na 1994, gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside byitabiriwe n'abayobozi ba Leta, ab'inzego z'ubutegetsi n'iz'umutekano kugeza ku rwego rw'ibanze; abasivili baratojwe bahabwa intwaro, kandi bariyeri zishyirwa mu mujyi wa Kamembe no mu nkengero zawo. Nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege ku wa 6 Mata 1994, ubwicanyi bwakajije umurego muri perefegitura; i Cyangugu bwakomeje kugeza mu mpera za Kanama 1994, nyuma y'ahandi henshi mu gihugu. Kuba ingabo za Opération Turquoise zari i Kamembe (muri «Zone humanitaire sûre») ntibyabujije ibyaha gukomeza; hari ibikorwa by'ubugizi bwa nabi byavuzwe kandi abenshi mu bakoze Jenoside bahungiye mu yahoze ari Zayire, ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Urwibutso rwa Kamembe rwubatswe kugira ngo rushyingure mu cyubahiro imibiri y'abazize Jenoside, rubungabunge amazina y'abamenyekanye kandi rube ahantu ho kwibukira no kwigisha amateka, cyane cyane mu bikorwa ngarukamwaka byo "Kwibuka".
Amateka rusange (1959–1993).
Amateka y'itotezwa ry'Abatutsi mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu ni maremare, kandi yatangiye kuva mu 1959.
Ubwicanyi bwabaye mbere ya Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Mu mvururu zo hagati ya 1959 na 1961, Abatutsi barishwe, amazu yabo aratwikwa, imitungo yabo irasahurwa, birukanwa mu kazi no mu mashuri, bituma abarokotse bahungira mu Burundi no mu yahoze ari Zayire. Guhera mu mpera za 1960, abanyapolitiki, cyane cyane abarwanashyaka ba PARMEHUTU, babibye urwango, bituma guhera mu Ugushyingo 1960 haba ubukangurambaga bukomeye bwo guhohotera no kumenesha Abatutsi.
Mu mvururu za 1963–1964, ubwicanyi bwageze ku rwego rukabije mu 1963: Abatutsi benshi bishwe ku itegeko rya perefe Pascal Ngirabatware, wiswe «Gahini». Imyaka ya 1964 na 1973 yibukwa nk'«itazibagirana» kubera ubwicanyi, kwirukanwa mu mashuri no mu kazi ndetse no kwamburwa imitungo. Muri Gashyantare 1964, ikinyamakuru "La Tribune de Lausanne" cyise ibyo bikorwa «jenoside nyayo mu Rwanda», naho ikinyamakuru "France Soir" kivuga iyicwa ry'«Abatutsi 12.000».
Mu 1973, mbere y'uko Perezida Grégoire Kayibanda ahirikwa ku butegetsi na Juvénal Habyarimana, Perefegitura ya Cyangugu yibasiwe n'imvururu zikomeye. Abatutsi birukanwe mu mashuri no mu kazi, imidugudu yabo iratwikwa kandi imitungo yabo irasahurwa. Ubwo bwicanyi bwo mu 1973 bwiswe «Kajwangara», kubera ko ababukoraga biyoberanyaga bitera umucanga ("jwangara") bahiga Abatutsi.
Imyiteguro ya Jenoside yatangiye mu 1990. Guhera mu Ukwakira 1990, Abatutsi bo muri ako gace baratotejwe bikomeye, barahohoterwa kandi barafungwa bashinjwa gukorana n'Inkotanyi. Ibinyamakuru nka "Kangura" na "Imvaho" byakwirakwijwe cyane muri perefegitura bibiba urwango.
Ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Jenoside i Kamembe mu 1994.
Komini Kamembe yari icyicaro cya Perefegitura ya Cyangugu, irimo inzego z'ubuyobozi bwa gisivili n'iza gisirikare, harimo n'inkambi ya gisirikare ya Karambo yayoborwaga na Liyetona Samuel Imanishimwe mu 1994.
Jenoside yatangiye mu cyahoze ari Komini Kamembe ku wa 7 Mata 1994, mu mujyi wa Kamembe. Mu ba mbere bishwe harimo Dogiteri Ignace Nagapfizi, wari umuyobozi w'ubuvuzi mu Karere k'Ubuzima ka Cyangugu akaba n'umurwanashyaka w'ishyaka PL; yishwe maze atwikirwa imbere y'urugo rwe ahitwa i Mucyo, ahagana saa yine za mu gitondo. Abandi Batutsi bari bazwi mu mujyi na bo barishwe, barimo Karangwa (umucuruzi ukomeye akaba n'umurwanashyaka wa PSD), Anicet Niyonzima (umurwanashyaka wa PL), Ndayisaba n'umuryango we, na Kongo (umucuruzi).
Ubwicanyi bwahise bukwira muri komini yose, bworoherejwe n'imyiteguro n'ibikoresho Interahamwe zari zarahawe.
Ahabereye ubwicanyi n'abagizemo uruhare.
Mu cyahoze ari Segiteri Kamembe, Abatutsi biciwe i Kadasomwa, kuri Sitade Kamarampaka n'inkengero zayo, mu cyahoze ari Selire ya Gatovu no mu nkengero z'umujyi. Ku wa 14 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bari bahunze ubwicanyi bava muri Komini Gisuma biciwe i Kadasomwa.
Mu mujyi wa Kamembe hari bariyeri zikomeye, harimo iy'i Cyapa ku muhanda wa kaburimbo, yashyizweho nyuma y'igitero cya FPR-Inkotanyi cyo mu Ukwakira 1990. Yabanje gucungwa n'abajandarume, nyuma icungwa n'Interahamwe, ikurwaho muri Nyakanga 1994 ubwo Guverinoma y'abatabazi yahungiraga muri Kongo.
Mu bashinjwa cyane ubwicanyi bwabereye kuri Sitade Kamarampaka no mu nkengero zayo harimo perefe wa Cyangugu, Liyetona Samuel Imanishimwe wayoboraga inkambi ya gisirikare ya Karambo, umushinjacyaha w'i Cyangugu, umuyobozi wa jandarumeri y'i Cyangugu na burugumesitiri wa Kamembe.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kamembe rushyinguyemo imibiri y'Abatutsi biciwe ahantu hatandukanye mu cyahoze ari Komini Kamembe no muri Cyangugu: kuri Sitade Kamarampaka n'inkengero zayo, i Kadasomwa, kuri Paruwasi ya Katedarali ya Cyangugu n'inkengero zayo, mu mujyi wa Kamembe no mu karere k'amashuri ka Gihundwe.
Umwihariko wa Jenoside mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu.
Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Perefegitura ya Cyangugu ifite umwihariko ugaragara:
Ubugome bukabije no kurya abantu.
Perefegitura izwiho ubugome bukabije bw'ubwicanyi bwahabereye. Hakorewe iyicarubozo rikomeye, harimo gutemagura abishwe no kotsa inyama zabo ku mishito ngo ziribwe.
Igihe yamaze n'uruhare rw'abaturage.
Ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Jenoside i Cyangugu ryaranzwe n'igihe kirekire ryamaze ndetse n'uruhare runini rw'ingeri zinyuranye z'abaturage.
Uruhare rwa Opération Turquoise.
Jenoside yabereye no muri «Zone humanitaire sûre» (ZHS) yagenzurwaga n'ingabo z'Abafaransa za Opération Turquoise, yarimo Cyangugu, Gikongoro na Kibuye. Ingabo z'Abafaransa, inyinshi zari zifite ibirindiro ku kibuga cy'indege cya Kamembe, zishinjwa gukorana n'Interahamwe n'abajandarume kuri bariyeri zo mu mujyi wa Cyangugu. Abatutsi biciwe ku kibuga cy'indege izo ngabo zihari, kandi abakoze Jenoside bahungiye muri ZHS.
Uruhare rw'abayobozi.
Abayobozi benshi b'icyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu baburanishijwe ku ruhare bagize mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside. Muri bo harimo Liyetona Samuel Imanishimwe, waburanishijwe n'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR), wahoze ari perefe Emmanuel Bagambiki (wagizwe umwere na TPIR), ndetse na ba burugumesitiri b'amakomini nka Jean-Napoléon Mubiligi wa Kamembe, bahamijwe ibyaha n'inkiko Gacaca.
Kubera ko ruri hafi ya Sitade Kamarampaka n'umujyi wa Cyangugu (Kamembe), Urwibutso rwa Kamembe ni ahantu h'ingenzi ho kwibuka amateka mabi n'umwihariko w'ubugome bwa Jenoside muri iyi yahoze ari perefegitura. Rufite ibyumba by'imurikabikorwa n'imva rusange zibungabungiwemo imibiri y'abishwe, ndetse n'ahantu ho kwibukira hifashishwa mu bikorwa bya "Kwibuka".

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gashirabwoba ni urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Bushenge, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, Intara y'Iburengerazuba, mu Rwanda. Rwibuka Abatutsi biciwe i Gashirabwoba no mu bindi bice bya Nyamasheke mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gashirabwoba ruherereye mu Murenge wa Bushenge, Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu.
Urwibutso rwa Gashirabwoba ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'ahantu hashyinguwe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Mu nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, iza Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero zanditswe ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi rwa UNESCO.
Urwibutso rwa Gashirabwoba ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Gashirabwoba rwashyizweho kugira ngo rubungabunge amateka kandi rwibuke Abatutsi biciwe i Gashirabwoba no mu tundi duce tw'Akarere ka Nyamasheke mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Mu 2017, hatangijwe imirimo yo kubaka urwibutso rushya rwa Gashirabwoba, umushinga wari uteganyijwe gutwara amafaranga y'u Rwanda arenga miliyoni 400.
Ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2019, imibiri 15 629 y'abazize Jenoside yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro kuri uru rwibutso. Muri yo harimo imibiri 13 577 yari isanzwe ishyinguye i Gashirabwoba, 1 039 yakuwe ku rwibutso rwa Giheke, 675 yakuwe ku rwa Muyange, 268 yakuwe i Kidashira n'imibiri 70 yari yarashyinguwe mu ngo zo mu Murenge wa Bushenge.
Iyo mihango yahuje abarokotse Jenoside, abayobozi n'abaturage, kandi yari igamije guha icyubahiro imibiri yari yarabonetse cyangwa yari yarashyinguwe ahandi mbere yo kwimurirwa i Gashirabwoba.
Mu 2025, indi mibiri 30 y'abazize Jenoside yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro muri Nyamasheke mu muhango wabereye ku rwibutso rwa Gashirabwoba.
Urwibutso rufite ahashyinguwe imibiri y'abazize Jenoside, inyubako zagenewe ibikorwa byo kwibuka n'ahantu ho kwigishiriza amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Raporo ya CNLG ivuga kandi ko urwibutso rufite isomero ryagenewe kubikwamo ibitabo n'inyandiko zivuga ku mateka ya Jenoside.
Urwibutso runakoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwigisha no kurwanya ihakanwa rya Jenoside. Mu mihango yo kwibuka, rwakira abarokotse Jenoside, abanyeshuri, abayobozi b'amadini n'abahagarariye inzego za Leta.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Remera ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ruherereye mu Murenge wa Remera, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda. Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'Abatutsi biciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Kigarama, by'umwihariko abiciwe ku biro by'iyo komini no mu nkengero zabyo.
Urwibutso ruherereye hafi y'ibiro by'Umurenge wa Remera, mu gice cy'icyaro cy'Akarere ka Ngoma. Ruri hafi y'umuhanda, ibintu byateje ikibazo mu 2014 ubwo imbago z'umuhanda zageraga ku butaka bw'urwibutso.
Mu mitegekere yahozeho mbere ya 1994, Remera yari umwe mu mirenge 11 ya Komini Kigarama yo muri Perefegitura ya Kibungo. Indi mirenge yari Kabare I, Kabare II, Rurenge, Gasetsa, Kaberangwe, Vumwe, Gashanda, Fukwe, Rubona na Kansana.
Bamwe mu bayobozi bo muri Perefegitura ya Kibungo bagize uruhare mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside bakomokaga muri Komini Kigarama. Muri ako gace, Interahamwe n'indi mitwe yitwaraga gisirikare yagize uruhare mu kwibasira Abatutsi mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, mu Rwanda hashyizweho inzibutso zitandukanye zo gushyinguramo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside, kubungabunga amateka no gutanga ahantu ho kwibuka no kwigisha.
Urwibutso rwa Remera ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege yari itwaye Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana ku wa 6 Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi bo mu mirenge ya Komini Kigarama bahungiye ku biro bya komini byari i Remera bashaka ubuhungiro.
Mu gitondo cyo ku wa 7 Mata, Interahamwe zari zashyize bariyeri ku mihanda ijya ku biro bya komini zatangiye guhagarika no kwibasira Abatutsi bashakaga kuhagera. Raporo ya CNLG ivuga ko abantu bari hagati ya 1 500 na 2 000 bari bamaze guteranira ku biro bya komini, mu gihe abandi, harimo abakomeretse, bakomezaga kuhagera.
Ku wa 8 Mata 1994, burugumesitiri Emmanuel Mugiraneza, Colonel Pierre Célestin Rwagafilita na Minisitiri Prosper Mugiraneza bagiye ku biro bya komini aho Abatutsi bari bahungiye babasabye kubarinda. Nyuma gato y'uko bahavuye, Interahamwe witwaga Emmanuel Muhinda yateye gerenade mu bantu bari bateraniye aho, yica bamwe abandi barakomereka; ubwicanyi bwakomeje nyuma y'icyo gitero.
Ku wa 11 Mata, Interahamwe zongeye gutera abari bahungiye ku biro bya komini. Brigadier Pierre Musonera wagerageje kubarinda yambuwe intwaro ku mabwiriza y'abayobozi, nyuma aricwa.
Ku wa 12 Mata, Lieutenant-colonel Anselme Nkuriyekubona yajyanye n'abasirikare, Interahamwe n'abari mu mutwe wa Simba Bataliani kongera gutera Abatutsi bari ku biro bya komini. Igitero kinini cyakurikiyeho ku wa 15 Mata 1994 cyibasiye benshi mu bari bakiri aho.
Nyuma y'uko Ingabo za FPR zifashe Komini Kigarama ahagana ku wa 20 Mata, bamwe mu barokotse bavanywe aho bajyanwa kuvurwa. Raporo ya CNLG ishyira Remera mu hantu h'ingenzi habereye ubwicanyi muri Komini Kigarama hagati ya 7 na 15 Mata 1994, kandi ivuga ko hari abantu batwitswe ari bazima abandi bagashyingurwa mu cyobo cyari hafi y'ibiro bya komini.
Ishyirwaho n'iterambere ry'urwibutso.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, imibiri y'abiciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Kigarama yaravanywe ahantu hatandukanye, ishyirwa mu rwibutso rwubatswe i Remera ku butaka bwariho ibiro bya komini.
Mu 2014, ubuyobozi bw'Akarere ka Ngoma bwavuze ko urwibutso rwari ruri hafi cyane y'umuhanda kandi ko rwagombaga kwimurwa kubera imiterere y'ahantu. Hari gahunda yo kwimurira imibiri y'abantu bagera ku 2 900 ku Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibungo-Ngoma, rumwe mu nzibutso zari zaratoranyijwe ku rwego rw'akarere.
Mu gihe cyo gusoza icyumweru cyo kwibuka muri Mata 2014, abarokotse bo mu Murenge wa Remera basabye ko imibiri y'ababo yaguma i Remera kugira ngo amateka y'ubwicanyi bwabereye mu cyahoze ari Komini Kigarama akomeze kubungabungwa aho yabereye. Imiryango y'abazize Jenoside n'abayobozi b'amadini banasabye kugira uruhare mu kubaka urwibutso rwujuje ibisabwa aho kwimurira imibiri i Kibungo.
Urwibutso rwa Remera rufite ahashyinguwe hamwe imibiri y'abazize Jenoside n'ahantu ho gukorera imihango ngarukamwaka yo Kwibuka.
Rukoreshwa kandi nk'ahantu hahurira abarokotse, imiryango y'abazize Jenoside n'abaturage bo mu cyahoze ari Komini Kigarama. Mu bikorwa byo kwibuka habamo ubuhamya, ibiganiro ku mateka no kwigisha kurwanya guhakana no gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukara ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ruherereye mu Murenge wa Rukara, mu Akarere ka Kayonza, Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda. Rushyinguyemo kandi rwibukirwamo Abatutsi biciwe i Rukara no mu duce tuyikikije.
Urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Rukara, mu Karere ka Kayonza, Intara y'Iburasirazuba. Ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri muri ako karere.
Urwibutso rwa Rukara ni rumwe mu nzibutso zibungabunga imibiri y'abazize Jenoside, zikakira ibikorwa byo Kwibuka kandi zigafasha mu kubungabunga no kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Urwibutso rwa Rukara ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ubwicanyi bwabereye i Rukara no mu nkengero zaho, by'umwihariko hafi ya misiyoni gatolika ya Rukara. Amafoto yafashwe muri Gicurasi 1994 agaragaza imibiri n'ibisigazwa by'abantu ku butaka bwa misiyoni, aho Abatutsi babarirwa mu magana bishwe muri Mata 1994.
Muri Gicurasi 2014, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside barenga 8 000 yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro ku rwibutso rwa Rukara mu Karere ka Kayonza.
Urwibutso rwa Rukara rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Rukara no mu nkengero zaho. Rukoreshwa nk'ahantu ho kunamira abazize Jenoside no kwibukira abashyinguwe kuri urwo rwibutso.
Mu bihe byo Kwibuka, urwibutso rusurwa n'abarokotse Jenoside, imiryango y'abazize Jenoside, abaturage n'abandi basura aho hantu kugira ngo bibuke kandi bunamire abazize Jenoside.

Institut facultaire des sciences agronomiques de Yangambi (IFA-Yangambi) ni ikigo cya Leta cy'amashuri makuru cyo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, cyibanda ku bumenyi bw'ubuhinzi, amashyamba n'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo. Gifitanye amateka n'ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi cya Yangambi mu ntara ya Tshopo, naho ibikorwa byacyo by'amasomo bikorerwa i Kisangani.
Inkomoko ya IFA-Yangambi ishyirwa mu 1971, ubwo amashami yigishaga ubuhinzi ya Université Lovanium i Kinshasa, Université officielle du Congo i Lubumbashi na Université libre du Congo i Kisangani yahurizwaga hamwe.
Hari amasoko atanga amatariki atandukanye yerekeye ishingwa ry'ikigo. "World Higher Education Database" na Infocongo bivuga 1971, mu gihe Agence universitaire de la Francophonie (AUF) ivuga ko IFA-Yangambi yashinzwe mu 1976.
IFA-Yangambi iri mu murage w'ubushakashatsi bwa Yangambi, ahahoze icyicaro cya "Institut national pour l'étude agronomique du Congo belge" (INEAC), nyuma yabaye "Institut national pour l'étude et la recherche agronomiques" (INERA). Ibikorwa by'amasomo byaje kwimurirwa i Kisangani, mu gihe Yangambi yakomeje kuba ahantu hakorerwa ubushakashatsi n'igerageza mu buhinzi.
Imiterere n'ubuyobozi.
IFA-Yangambi ni ikigo cya Leta kiri mu rwego rw'amashuri makuru ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. PRISM-RDC ya Minisiteri y'Amashuri Makuru igishyira mu bigo bya Leta byo mu ntara ya Tshopo, mu mujyi wa Kisangani.
Michel Baudouin ni umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo.
IFA-Yangambi itanga amasomo mu mashami atandukanye y'ubumenyi bw'ubuhinzi. Arimo:
Ikigo gitanga impamyabumenyi kuva ku cyiciro cya mbere kugeza kuri doktora, harimo "graduat", "licence", "Diplôme d'études supérieures" (DES) na doktora. Mu mwaka w'amashuri wa 2022–2023, cyari gifite abanyeshuri bagera ku 5.300.
Ubushakashatsi n'ubufatanye.
Ubushakashatsi bwa IFA-Yangambi bwibanda ku buhinzi, amashyamba, urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima no gucunga umutungo kamere. Ikigo gifatanya n'imishinga mpuzamahanga y'ubushakashatsi n'amahugurwa.
Mu 2024, IFA-Yangambi yabaye kimwe mu bigo bifatanya mu mushinga "INTERACT-Africa", ugamije guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga ritangiza ibidukikije, kugabanya ingaruka z'imihindagurikire y'ikirere no guteza imbere ikoreshwa rirambye ry'umutungo kamere.

Salma Maoulidi ni umunyamategeko, umuharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu akaba n'umuharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore ukomoka muri Tanzaniya. Ni umuyobozi mukuru w'umuryango SahibaSisters Foundation, ihuriro ry'abagore b'Abayisilamu muri Tanzaniya.
Maoulidi yabaye umwe mu bagize Komisiyo ishinzwe kuvugurura Itegeko Nshinga rya Tanzaniya, yashyizweho mu mwaka wa 2011, ahagarariye ikirwa cya Zanzibar.
Ni umwe mu bashinze SahibaSisters Foundation, urubuga n'ihuriro ry'abagore rigamije kubafasha mu myigishirize, mu kubatoza no mu kubaka umuryango uharanira uburenganzira bwabo. Yakoze kandi nk'umujyanama mu muryango wahoze witwa East Africa Support Unit for NGOs (EASUN), ndetse akora muri Oxfam Tanzania nk'umuhuzabikorwa wa gahunda zijyanye n'uburinganire.
Maoulidi yanditse inyandiko nyinshi mu kinyamakuru "Pambazuka News" ku burenganzira bw'abagore, ku ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore, ku burezi bw'abakuze no ku Itegeko Nshinga rya Tanzaniya.

Laré Batouth Penn ni umuhanga mu bumenyi bw'imibanire y'abantu (sosiyolojiya), umwarimu-mushakashatsi akaba n'uwahoze ari umudepite wo muri Togo.
Laré Batouth Penn yize muri Kaminuza Jean-Moulin Lyon 3 mu Ubufaransa, aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu bumenyi bwa politiki n'imibanire mpuzamahanga. Ni umwarimu mukuru ("maître de conférences") mu bumenyi bw'imibanire y'abantu mu bigo n'ibikorwa bya Leta muri Kaminuza ya Lomé.
Ubushakashatsi bwe bwibanda ku ruhare rw'itumanaho mu iterambere ry'ibigo, ku mikoranire hagati y'ibibazo bya politiki n'imiterere y'ibigo, ndetse no ku gukusanya no gukoresha amakuru y'ubukungu ("intelligence économique") mu miyoborere y'ibigo.
Ubushakashatsi bwe bunareba kandi politiki zijyanye n'inyanja, umutekano wo mu nyanja n'inzibacyuho igana ku bukungu bushingiye ku nyanja ("économie bleue") muri Togo.
Ibikorwa bya politiki.
Laré Batouth Penn yabaye umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Togo. Yinjiye mu Nteko mu Ukuboza 2007, asimbuye Noupokou Dammipi wari weguye, ahagarariye ifasi y'amatora ya Oti, ku rutonde rw'ishyaka Rassemblement du peuple togolais (RPT).
Nk'umunyamuryango w'ishyaka Union pour la République (UNIR), yongeye gutorerwa kuba umudepite mu matora y'abadepite yo ku wa 25 Nyakanga 2013.
Mu mwaka wa 2019, yagizwe umuyobozi w'ibiro ("chef de cabinet") by'Inama Nkuru ishinzwe iby'Inyanja ("Haut Conseil pour la mer"), urwego rwa Leta ya Togo rushinzwe gufasha mu guhuza ibikorwa bya Leta mu bijyanye n'inyanja.
Muri iki gihe, Laré Batouth Penn ni perezida w'umuryango Ti-Mondo.

Nomonde Mihlali "Mickey" Meji (yavutse ku wa 9 Nzeri 1980 – apfa ku wa 13 Kanama 2026) yari umuharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore n'abakobwa wo muri Afurika y'Epfo, akaba yararwanyaga ikoreshwa ry'abantu mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato n'uburaya. Yakomokaga i Mthatha (Umtata) mu Ntara ya Eastern Cape. Nk'umuntu warokotse uburaya, yagize uruhare mu bikorwa byinshi by'imbere mu gihugu no ku rwego mpuzamahanga bijyanye n'uburenganzira bwa muntu, kurwanya virusi itera SIDA, ndetse na politiki za Leta ku bijyanye n'uburaya.
Meji yavutse ku wa 9 Nzeri 1980. Yari afite impamyabumenyi mu itumanaho n'itangazamakuru.
Ubuhamya bwe bwite nk'uwarokotse uburaya bwari ishingiro ry'ibikorwa bye. Mu mbwirwaruhame ze, yahuzaga ubusumbane mu by'ubukungu n'imibereho muri Afurika y'Epfo, ingaruka za apartheid, n'uburyo bunyuranye abagore bamwe bakoreshwa mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato.
Yakoranye n'umuryango wo muri Afurika y'Epfo witwa Embrace Dignity, uharanira ko uburaya buvanwaho kandi ufasha abagore bahuye n'icuruzwa ry'abantu n'uburaya. Meji yafashije kandi mu gushinga imiryango n'amahuriro y'abarokotse, ahagararira sosiyete sivile mu nama nyinshi z'imbere mu gihugu n'izo ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Mu mwaka wa 2016, Meji yinjiye muri Embrace Dignity nk'ushinzwe gahunda yo gufasha abarokotse. Akazi ke kibandaga ku burenganzira bw'abagore, ikoreshwa ry'abantu mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato, icuruzwa ry'abantu, n'ingaruka uburaya bugira ku mibereho no ku buzima.
Yafashije kandi mu kubaka amahuriro y'abarokotse. Afatanyije n'abandi barokotse uburaya, yagize uruhare mu ivuka ry'urugaga rw'abarokotse muri Afurika, ashinga gahunda yitwa Survivors Support and Empowerment Programme, igamije gufasha no guha ubushobozi abantu banyuze mu buraya.
Meji yatangaga ibiganiro mu nama no mu mpaka zijyanye n'uburenganzira bwa muntu, uburaya n'ubuzima rusange. Yitabiriye by'umwihariko Inama ya 5 ya Afurika y'Epfo kuri SIDA n'Inama Mpuzamahanga kuri SIDA n'Indwara Zandurira mu Mibonano Mpuzabitsina muri Afurika (ICASA), aho yanamurikiye ubushakashatsi bwe.
Muri Werurwe 2018, yayoboye itsinda ry'abarokotse mu iburanisha ryateguwe n'Ihuriro ry'Abagore b'Amashyaka Menshi (Multi-Party Women's Caucus) mu Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Afurika y'Epfo, ku mushinga wo kuvugurura amategeko agenga uburaya bw'abantu bakuru. Icyo gihe yashyigikiye ko uburaya buvanwaho burundu, anenga guhana abantu bagurisha imibonano mpuzabitsina.
Meji yashyigikiye icyitegererezo cy'itegeko Embrace Dignity yise "Sankara Equality Act". Uwo mushinga ugamije gukura mu byaha kugurisha imibonano mpuzabitsina, ariko ugahana kuyigura n'uburyo bumwe bwo koroshya uburaya, bijyanye na gahunda zo gufasha abantu kuva mu buraya no kubaherekeza. Ubu buryo bumeze nk'ubwitwa "icyitegererezo cy'ibihugu bya Nordic" ("Nordic model").
Yanengaga kandi uburyo bwo kwemera no kugenga uburaya bwakoreshejwe mu bihugu bimwe, avuga ko butavanaho uburyo abantu bakoreshwa mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato.
Imyanya yo mu gihugu no ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Meji yabaye mu nzego nyinshi zishinzwe ubuzima rusange, uburenganzira bwa muntu na politiki zireba abagore.
Yahagarariye imiryango itari iya Leta ku mugabane wa Afurika mu Nama Ihuza Gahunda (Programme Coordinating Board) ya UNAIDS, gahunda y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye yo kurwanya virusi itera SIDA. Yari kandi umunyamuryango w'Inama y'Igihugu ya Afurika y'Epfo ishinzwe kurwanya SIDA (SANAC), aho yahagarariraga urwego rumwe.
Yitabiriye inama n'ibiganiro byinshi byo mu gihugu, mu karere no ku rwego mpuzamahanga ku burenganzira bw'abagore, virusi itera SIDA n'ikoreshwa ry'abantu mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato.
Ubuzima bwite n'urupfu.
Meji yari umubyeyi w'abana batatu. Yapfuye ku wa 13 Kanama 2026, afite imyaka 45, habura ibyumweru bike ngo yuzuze imyaka 46.
Meji yahawe igihembo cyitwa "Advancing Freedom Award" mu nama ya Coalition to End Sexual Exploitation (CESE), kubera uruhare rwe mu kurwanya ikoreshwa ry'abantu mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato no gufasha abarokotse.

Faille d'Aledjo ("Umuhora wa Aledjo") ni ahantu nyaburanga n'inzira y'umuhanda yaciwe mu musozi, iherereye muri Perefegitura ya Assoli, mu Ntara ya Kara, mu majyaruguru ya Togo. Iri ku birometero bigera kuri 36 mu majyaruguru y'umujyi wa Sokodé, kandi kuva kera ni inzira ihuza amajyepfo n'amajyaruguru y'igihugu. Izwi cyane kubera umuhora munini waciwe mu Misozi ya Togo, kugira ngo unyuzwemo umuhanda w'igihugu nimero 1.
Imiterere n'aho iherereye.
Faille d'Aledjo iherereye mu Misozi ya Togo, ari yo gice cy'amajyepfo cy'Imisozi ya Atakora. Iri ku butumburuke buringaniye bwa metero zigera kuri 650, hafi y'umudugudu wa Aledjo Kadara. Ntigomba kwitiranywa n'agace kitwa Alédjo kari muri Bénin. Iri ku birometero bigera kuri 378 mu majyaruguru y'umujyi wa Lomé, kandi igaragaza aho Intara yo Hagati (Centrale) ihurira n'Intara ya Kara.
Imirimo ya mbere yo gutunganya iyi nzira yatangiye mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abadage, mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, hagamijwe koroshya ubuhahirane hagati y'amajyepfo n'amajyaruguru y'igihugu. Umuhora uriho ubu waciwe mu musozi mu myaka ya 1950. Watumye habaho umuhanda munini uhuza Lomé na Cinkassé, ku mupaka na Burkina Faso. Mu myaka myinshi, Faille d'Aledjo yabaye inzira y'ingenzi yo gutwara ibicuruzwa no kunyuzamo amakamyo manini yerekeza mu bihugu byo mu karere ka Sahel.
Ibikorwaremezo by'umuhanda.
Umuhanda unyura muri uyu muhora ni wo wahoze ari inzira y'umuhanda w'igihugu nimero 1. Kubera ubuhaname, ubugufi bw'inzira n'imbogamizi za tekiniki, iki gice cy'umuhanda cyafatwaga igihe kirekire nk'igikomeye kunyuramo, cyane cyane ku binyabiziga biremereye. Mu myaka ya 2010, hubatswe umuhanda mushya wo kuzenguruka (déviation) hagamijwe kongera umutekano no koroshya urujya n'uruza hagati ya Sokodé na Kara. Kuva uwo muhanda mushya watangira gukoreshwa, amakamyo ntiyemerewe kunyura muri uyu muhora, ubu ukaba ukoreshwa cyane cyane n'imodoka nto.
Iyubakwa n'isanwa ry'uwo muhanda wo kuzenguruka byanenzwe n'itangazamakuru ryo muri Togo, kubera gutinda kw'imirimo, kwangirika kw'umuhanda imburagihe, no gukekwa ko imirimo itakozwe neza. Inshuro nyinshi, gufunga by'agateganyo uwo muhanda mushya byatumye imodoka zongera kunyura mu muhanda wa kera unyura muri uyu muhora. Ibyo bibazo byateje impaka mu ruhame ku micungire y'imirimo minini yo kubaka imihanda muri Togo.
Ubukerarugendo n'umurage.
Muri iki gihe, Faille d'Aledjo ifatwa nk'ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa na ba mukerarugendo, hafite ubwiza bw'imiterere y'igihugu. Uhereye aho, ubona neza imisozi n'imibande bihakikije, kandi umuhanda unyura mu midugudu myinshi ya gakondo. Ikunze kuvugwa nk'imwe mu hantu h'ikirango mu majyaruguru ya Togo, kandi ikurura abashyitsi bashishikajwe n'imiterere y'isi, amateka y'ibikorwaremezo n'ingendo n'amaguru. Ifatwa kandi nk'ahantu hafite agaciro mu bumenyi n'umurage kamere.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bigogwe ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri i Bigogwe, mu Umurenge wa Kanzenze, mu Akarere ka Rubavu, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri 9 042 y'abazize Jenoside. Abo bantu biciwe mu yahoze ari komini Mutura na Rwerere. Urwibutso rwavuguruwe kandi rwagurwa hagati ya 2023 na 2025.
Urwibutso rwa Bigogwe ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yo mu 1994, Abatutsi benshi biciwe i Bigogwe no mu nkengero zaho. Ubwicanyi bwakorewe ahantu henshi. Bimwe muri ibyo bice biri mu Akarere ka Nyabihu: Bigogwe, Jenda na Kabatwa. Ibindi biri mu Akarere ka Rubavu: Kanzenze na Mudende. Ibyo bice byari mu yahoze ari komini Mutura na Rwerere.
Umuryango Ibuka wo mu Karere ka Rubavu uvuga ko ubwicanyi bwakozwe cyane n'abasirikare b'abakomando. Abo basirikare bari mu kigo cya gisirikare cya Bigogwe.
Mbere y'ivugururwa, aha hari imva rusange gusa. Iyo mva ntiyari yujuje ibisabwa ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside. Imirimo yo kuvugurura no kwagura urwibutso yatangiye ku wa 18 Werurwe 2023. Mu gihe cy'imirimo, imibiri yimuriwe by'agateganyo mu Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyundo.
Ku wa 10 Mata 2023, abakozi babonye gerenade mu gihe bacukuraga. Nta muntu wakomeretse. RIB yatwaye iyo gerenade. Imirimo yakomeje uwo munsi.
Imirimo yarangiye mu 2025. Yatwaye amafaranga y'u Rwanda arenga miliyari imwe. Imibiri yari iteganyijwe kugarurwa mu rwibutso ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2025.
Urwibutso rushya rufite imva rusange iri munsi y'ubutaka. Rufite kandi urumuri rw'icyizere. Hari igice cy'amateka, aho kwakirira abashyitsi, inzu mberabyombi n'ibiro. Hari n'ubusitani bw'urwibutso. Urwibutso rufite uburyo bwo kuzimya inkongi na kamera z'umutekano.
Urwibutso ruri hafi y'urutare rwitwa Ibere rya Bigogwe.
Urwibutso rwakira ibikorwa byo Kwibuka abazize Jenoside. Ku wa 15 Gicurasi 2026, abantu bafashe umunota wo guceceka ku rwibutso. Uwarokotse Jenoside i Bigogwe yatanze ubuhamya. Ku wa 29 Gicurasi 2026, Komisiyo y'Igihugu y'Uburenganzira bwa Muntu yibukiye kuri uru rwibutso.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rubengera ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda haherereye i Rubengera, mu Akarere ka Karongi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda.
Ruruhukiyemo imibiri 3 439 y'abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, biciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza, igice kimwe cyayo kikaba ari cyo Murenge wa Rubengera w'ubu.
Urwibutso rwubatswe mu Murenge wa Rubengera, mu Akarere ka Karongi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba. Ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri mu Karere ka Karongi, hamwe n'iza Bisesero, Gatwaro, Mubuga, Nyamishaba n'ahandi hantu ho kwibukira ho mu nzego z'ibanze.
Urwibutso rwa Rubengera ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ahari urwibutso rwa Rubengera ni mu gice cy'icyahoze ari Komini Mabanza, mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Mu gihe cyo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 31 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, cyabaye ku wa 24 Mata 2025, Akarere ka Karongi kagaragaje ko uru rwibutso rwibukirwamo Abatutsi biciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza, ubu ni Umurenge wa Rubengera.
Imiterere n'ubwicanyi.
Urwibutso rubungabunga urwibutso rw'abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza no mu Murenge wa Rubengera w'ubu. Akarere ka Karongi kavuga ko hashyinguwe imibiri 3 439 y'abazize Jenoside.
Kugira aha hantu ahantu ho kwibukira.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Rubengera yabaye ahantu ho gushyingura no kwibukira abiciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza. Mu rwego rwa "Kwibuka", hategurwa ibikorwa byo kwibuka birimo urugendo rwo kwibuka, kunamira imibiri ishyinguye no gushyira indabo ku mva.
Mu gihe cyo kwibuka cyo mu 2025, abahagarariye Akarere na Ibuka bibukije ko ari ngombwa gufasha abarokotse, kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside no kumenya ahantu hakiri imibiri y'abazize Jenoside itarashyingurwa mu cyubahiro.
Ivugururwa ry'urwibutso.
Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2010, i Rubengera hubatswe urwibutso rushya. Mu 2012, umuryango World Vision watanze amafaranga y'u Rwanda miliyoni 30 yo kubaka imva rusange nshya igenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Uwo mushinga watangijwe nyuma y'uko urwibutso rwa kera rwangiritse, rwangijwe n'amazi y'imvura no gusaza kw'inyubako. Ibuye ry'ifatizo ryashyizweho ku wa 14 Kamena 2012, hafi y'imva rusange ya kera.
Urwibutso rwa Rubengera rubungabunga urwibutso rw'Abatutsi biciwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza, igice kimwe cyayo kikaba ari Umurenge wa Rubengera w'ubu. Akarere ka Karongi kavuga ko hashyinguwe imibiri 3 439 y'abazize Jenoside.
Uko Jenoside yagenze mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza byanditswe mu bushakashatsi bwa Philip Verwimp ku Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Ubwo bushakashatsi, bushingiye ku gitabo cya Ibuka kibaruramo abazize Jenoside bagera ku 59 050 muri perefegitura, bugaragaza ko Abatutsi 9 257 bo muri Komini Mabanza bishwe, ni ukuvuga hafi 86% by'Abatutsi bo muri iyo komini; abarokotse babaruwe ni 1 477.
Ubushakashatsi bwa Verwimp bugaragaza kandi ko amahirwe yo kurokoka yatandukanaga bitewe n'amasegiteri ya Mabanza. Abatutsi batagiye kuri sitade y'umupira w'amaguru ya Kibuye n'abahungiye mu misozi aho bagerageje kwirwanaho bagize amahirwe menshi yo kurokoka kurusha abakusanyirijwe ahantu hanini hahurizwaga abantu benshi. Segiteri ya Rubengera iri mu masegiteri yakorewe isesengura ry'imibare ku irokoka mu cyahoze ari Komini Mabanza.
Inyandiko z'ubucamanza zerekeye Ignace Bagilishema, wahoze ari burugumesitiri wa Mabanza, na zo zigaragaza ko amatsinda y'Interahamwe yanyuraga muri Segiteri ya Rubengera. Mu ibaruwa yo ku wa 24 Kamena 1994, Bagilishema avuga ko Interahamwe zaturutse i Gisenyi kuza kongera ingufu mu bitero byagabwe ku Batutsi bo mu Bisesero hagati ya 19 na 22 Kamena 1994 zagombaga guhagarara mu isantere ya Rubengera, i Mabanza, kugira ngo zihagabe igitero. Iyo nyandiko ivuga kandi bariyeri yari yashyizwe imbere y'ibiro bya komini n'amasasu yatumye abaturage bo muri Segiteri ya Rubengera bahunga.
Ubu urwibutso ni ahantu ho gushyingura no kwibukira. Mu gihe cyo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 31 cyabereye i Rubengera ku wa 24 Mata 2025, umuhango warimo urugendo rugana ku rwibutso, kunamira imibiri ishyinguye no gushyira indabo ku mva. Abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze n'abahagarariye Ibuka basabye ko hakomeza gushakishwa ahantu hashobora kuba hakiri imibiri y'abazize Jenoside itarashyingurwa mu cyubahiro.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mugonero rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Mugonero, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Urwibutso ruri ahahoze ibitaro by'Abadiventisiti aho ibihumbi by'Abatutsi byiciwe ku wa 16 Mata 1994, kandi ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside isaga 17 000. Rurangwa n'inzu ibitsemo amagufwa, ibyapa by'urwibutso, ibishushanyo bibajwe bigaragaza ubugizi bwa nabi n'ivangura Abatutsi bakorewe, ndetse n'amagambo yanditse mu Ikinyarwanda agaragaza ku mugaragaro ubwoko bwabo, ibyatumye kugeza mu 2009 ruba urwibutso rwihariye mu Rwanda. Rufatwa nka kimwe mu bimenyetso by'ingenzi bya Jenoside, rukaberamo kenshi imihango yo kwibuka ya Leta kandi rugasurwa n'abantu baturutse mu gihugu no mu mahanga.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mugonero ruherereye mu Akarere ka Karongi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, ku kigo cy'ibitaro by'Abadiventisiti bya Mugonero, hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu. Ikibanza cyarwo cyegeranye n'icya Kaminuza y'Abadiventisiti yo muri Afurika yo Hagati.
Urwibutso rwa Mugonero ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mugonero ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'imva rusange nyinshi ziri ku butaka bw'u Rwanda no mu mahanga, zifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Enye muri zo — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — zashyizwe mu Murage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Urwibutso rwa Mugonero rwubatswe ahari ibitaro by'Abadiventisiti aho, ku wa 16 Mata 1994, ibihumbi by'Abatutsi, barimo abarwayi, abakozi b'ibitaro, abapasitori n'imiryango yabo, bishwe nyuma yo guhungira muri icyo kigo cy'ibitaro.
Aha hantu ni kimwe mu bimenyetso bikomeye by'ubwicanyi bwa Jenoside yo mu 1994, kandi ubu haruhukiye imibiri y'abazize Jenoside isaga 17 000.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mugonero rurangwa n'ibintu byinshi byihariye mu rwego rwo kwibuka no mu bimenyetso. Rurimo inzu ibitsemo amagufwa, ibyapa by'urwibutso n'ahantu ho kunamira, ndetse n'ibishushanyo bibajwe byihariye byubatswe ku bwinjiriro bw'urwibutso.
Ibyo bishushanyo bigizwe n'igice cya sima giteretseho umuhoro n'ubuhiri buteyeho imisumari, bikikijwe n'ibipfunsi bibiri bica iminyururu. Ibyo bikoresho bigereranya ubugizi bwa nabi bwa Jenoside, naho amaboko aboshye n'iminyururu agereranya ivangura rihoraho Abatutsi bakorewe. Inyubako iri iruhande, ibitsemo amagufwa y'abishwe, yanditseho mu Kinyarwanda amagambo agaragaza ku mugaragaro ko abishwe bari Abatutsi: «"Urwibutso rw’inzirakarengane z’Abatutsi bazize itsembabwoko ryo muri mata 1994, bishwe bunyamaswa Leta y’abagome irebera tuzahora tubibuka"».
Kugeza mu 2009, uru rwibutso ni rwo rwonyine mu Rwanda rwagaragazaga ku mugaragaro ubwoko bw'abishwe, bituma ruba urwibutso rwihariye mu nzibutso z'igihugu. Ibyo bishushanyo n'ayo magambo byateje impaka: bamwe babibonagamo inzitizi ku bwiyunge, abandi bashima uruhare rwabyo mu kubungabunga urwibutso rwihariye rw'Abatutsi bishwe.
Buri mwaka hano habera imihango ya Leta, cyane cyane ku wa 7 cyangwa ku wa 16 Mata, mu gihe cyagenwe cyo kwibuka Jenoside buri mwaka ("Kwibuka"), kandi urwibutso rusurwa n'abantu baturutse mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamasheke rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Nyamasheke, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamasheke ruherereye mu mujyi wa Nyamasheke, icyicaro cy'Akarere ka Nyamasheke, ku nkombe z'Ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamasheke ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamasheke ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'imva rusange nyinshi ziri ku butaka bw'u Rwanda no hanze yabwo, zifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Inzibutso enye zashyizwe mu Murage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamasheke rwashyizweho kugira ngo habe ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura mu cyubahiro abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri aka karere. Haruhukiye abazize Jenoside basaga 15 000, benshi muri bo bakaba barashyinguwe mu mihango yo gushyingura mu cyubahiro itegurwa buri mwaka.
Urwibutso rwakorewe amavugurura n'isanwa rikomeye, cyane cyane guhera mu 2012, kugira ngo hasubizwe ibyifuzo by'abarokotse kandi urwibutso rurusheho kubungabungwa.
Uruhare rw'abarokotse n'abaturage bo muri ako gace mu kubaka no kwita ku rwibutso rukunze kugarukwaho.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamasheke ruzwiho kuba hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu n'imyubakire yarwo yoroheje. Buri mwaka rwakira imihango yo kwibuka no gushyingura imibiri mu cyubahiro mu mva rusange. Imiryango n'abarokotse bahaza kunamira ababo.
Kuri uru rwibutso hari imurikabikorwa ry'amafoto n'ibyapa by'urwibutso, kandi ni ahantu ho kwigishiriza amahoro no gukumira Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyundo ni ahantu ho kwibukira haherereye i Nyundo, mu Akarere ka Rubavu, mu Rwanda. Rwibuka Abatutsi biciwe muri paruwasi ya Nyundo no mu masegiteri ayikikije hagati y'itariki ya 7 Mata n'iya 2 Gicurasi 1994, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Nyundo, mu Akarere ka Rubavu, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, hafi ya Katedrali ya Nyundo n'umugezi wa Sebeya.
Ni rumwe mu nzibutso, amarimbi n'imva rusange za kera bifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994. Enye muri izo nzibutso — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — zashyizwe ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO kuva mu 2023.
Urwibutso rwa Nyundo ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ubwicanyi bwo muri Mata na Gicurasi 1994.
Ibitero ku Batutsi b'i Nyundo byatangiye ku wa 7 Mata 1994, bukeye bw'ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, bikomeza kugeza ku wa 2 Gicurasi 1994. Abarwanashyaka b'Interahamwe n'aba CDR bateye imiryango y'Abatutsi yari ituye muri ako gace. Bamwe mu bagabye ibitero bari bambaye imyambaro imwe cyangwa bitwikiriye amakoma kugira ngo bamenyane.
Abatutsi benshi bahungiye mu kigo cya paruwasi gatolika ya Nyundo, bibwira ko bahakingirwa. Abari bakusanyirijwe mu nyubako za Kiliziya baragoswe, barabica. Muri bo harimo abagore n'abana bari bahungiye muri shapeli.
Ububiko bw'amateka ya Jenoside (Genocide Archive of Rwanda) bubarura abazize Jenoside bagera kuri 851 bashyinguye muri uru rwibutso. Uwo mubare urimo abiciwe mu kigo cya paruwasi ya Nyundo n'abaturutse mu masegiteri ya Nyundo, Kanama na Rugerero. Inyandiko ya kera y'ikarita y'Ikigo gishinzwe isesengura ry'imiterere y'ahantu (Center for Geographic Analysis) cya Kaminuza ya Harvard yo ivuga imibiri igera ku 2 100, itavuga niba uwo mubare ureba agace kamwe cyangwa igihe kimwe cyo gushyingura.
Ishyirwaho n'iyimurwa ry'urwibutso.
Nyuma ya Jenoside hubatswe urwibutso rwa mbere kugira ngo abazize Jenoside bashyingurwe kandi imiryango ibone aho kunamira ababo. Icyo gihe rwari mu kigo cya Kiliziya cya Nyundo, hagati y'ishuri n'iseminari.
Mu 2012, imyuzure y'umugezi wa Sebeya yangije urwibutso n'imva. Kubera ko ubutaka bwaho bwari bworoshye kwangirika, abayobozi bafashe icyemezo cyo kwimurira urwibutso ahantu hatibasirwa cyane n'imyuzure.
Urwibutso rushya rugamije kubungabunga imibiri, amazina n'amateka y'abiciwe muri paruwasi no mu masegiteri ayikikije. Rwifashishwa kandi mu gutegura imihango yo kwibuka no kugeza amateka ya Jenoside ku bandi.
Abazize Jenoside n'urwibutso rwa Diyosezi.
Urwibutso rurimo aho babika amagufwa, imva rusange, ibyapa byanditseho amazina y'abazize Jenoside bamenyekanye n'amafoto y'abihayimana bishwe mu 1994.
Umwepiskopi wa Nyundo, Anaclet Mwumvaneza, avuga ko uru rwibutso ari ho hashyinguwe abapadiri benshi ba Diyosezi bishwe muri Jenoside. Umushakashatsi Tom Ndahiro ahuza kandi aha hantu n'amateka y'abihayimana barwanyije ingengabitekerezo y'amoko n'ivangura, barimo uwahoze ari Umwepiskopi Aloys Bigirumwami.
Donatha Mukeshimana, warokotse Jenoside wo mu Murenge wa Nyundo, avuga ko imibiri y'abamwe mu bishwe yatemaguwe mbere yo gutwarwa mu ngorofani ikajugunywa mu byobo rusange. Avuga ko imibiri myinshi itaraboneka cyangwa ngo imenyekane.
Kwibuka no kubungabunga urwibutso.
Urwibutso rwakira imigoroba yo kwibuka, misa n'imihango yo kwibuka itegurwa mu gihe cya "Kwibuka" buri mwaka. Imiryango y'abazize Jenoside, abarokotse, abahagarariye Diyosezi n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze bahaza kunamira abishwe.
Abarokotse basaba ko amateka y'ubwicanyi bwakorewe muri Diyosezi ya Nyundo yandikwa neza kandi akagezwa ku barusura. Basaba kandi ko amafoto, ubuhamya n'ibintu bifitanye isano n'abishwe bibikwa neza.
Amashyirahamwe y'abarokotse, arimo Ibuka, agira uruhare mu bikorwa byo kwibuka no kugeza amateka ya Nyundo ku rubyiruko.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibeho rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Kibeho, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibeho ruherereye i Kibeho, mu Akarere ka Nyaruguru, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda, hafi y'ahantu h'amabonekerwa ya Bikira Mariya.
Urwibutso rwa Kibeho ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibeho rwubatswe aho, muri Mata 1994, ibihumbi by'Abatutsi byiciwe nyuma yo guhungira muri Kiliziya Gatolika no mu nkengero zayo. Aha hantu habereye ubwicanyi bw'ubugome bukabije, bwagizemo uruhare abasivili n'abarwanashyaka b'umutwe w'Interahamwe. Nyuma ya Jenoside, hubatswe urwibutso rwo guha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside basaga 28 000, imibiri yabo ikaba iruhukiye mu mva rusange.
Urwibutso rwa Kibeho rurangwa na Kiliziya ya Bikira Mariya w'Ababara, yangiritse cyane muri Jenoside, n'imurikwa ry'imyenda, amafoto n'ibintu bwite by'abazize Jenoside. Buri mwaka rwakira imihango yo kwibuka kandi rusurwa n'Abanyarwanda benshi n'abanyamahanga, cyane cyane kubera isano rufitanye n'amabonekerwa ya Bikira Mariya i Kibeho.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gisenyi ruherereye mu gice cyo hejuru cy'umujyi wa Gisenyi, hafi y'aho usohokera werekeza mu majyaruguru. Rwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Harashyinguye abantu bagera ku 12 000.
Uru rwibutso ni rumwe mu zitubatswe ahahoze kiliziya. Ni rumwe mu nzibutso z'igihugu zo mu Rwanda zibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Izindi ni Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ntarama, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye.
Mu Rwanda hari inzibutso zisaga 250 zanditse zibuka Jenoside.
Urwibutso rwa Gisenyi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso ni ho hashyinguye abantu bagera ku 12 000. Ni rwo rwa mbere rwubatswe na Ibuka. Harimo imva y'Umunyamerikakazi washinze ikigo cyita ku mfubyi.
Ku wa 22 Ugushyingo 1992, Léon Mugesera, icyo gihe wari mu biro bya politiki bya MRND, yavugiye i Gisenyi ati:

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ngororero rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Ngororero, umujyi wo mu Akarere ka Ngororero mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ngororero ruherereye i Ngororero, icyicaro cy'akarere kitwa izina rimwe, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Ngororero ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ngororero ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'imva rusange nyinshi ziri ku butaka bw'u Rwanda no hanze yabwo, zifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Zimwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri mu Murage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Urwibutso rwa Ngororero rwashyizweho kugira ngo hubahwe ibihumbi by'Abatutsi biciwe muri ako karere mu 1994.
Kuri uru rwibutso hari imva rusange nyinshi, n'inyubako zakira abarokotse n'imiryango mu gihe cyo kwibuka buri mwaka.
Mu 2009, hatangajwe ko urwibutso ruzavugururwa kugira ngo rurusheho kubungabunga urwibutso rw'abazize Jenoside no kwakira imihango ya Leta. Urwibutso ni kandi ahantu h'ingenzi mu bikorwa byo kwibuka Jenoside biba buri mwaka mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Ngororero ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'ibihumbi by'abazize Jenoside, kandi ni ahantu ho kunamira, kwigisha amateka no guhurira mu minsi ikomeye yo kwibuka.
Rurimo ibimenyetso by'urwibutso, ibyapa by'urwibutso n'ahantu ho kwakirira imiryango y'abazize Jenoside n'abarokotse.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Cyanika rwibuka ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 i Cyanika, mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda, mu Akarere ka Nyamagabe, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Cyanika ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Amateka n'aho ruherereye.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Cyanika ni rumwe mu hantu henshi mu Rwanda hagenewe kwibuka abazize Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Ruherereye mu Akarere ka Nyamagabe, hafi ya Murambi, mu Rwanda. Uru rwibutso rwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Rwatashywe mu 2012 na Jeannette Kagame, kandi ni ahantu ho kunamira no kwibuka ibihumbi by'Abatutsi biciwe muri aka karere.
Urwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside isaga 35 000, kandi ni ahantu abarokotse n'imiryango yabuze ababo bibukira kandi bagatekereza ku bugome bwakozwe.
Damascene, ukora ku rwibutso rwa Cyanika, yabwiye umushakashatsi Julia Viebach mu 2014 ati:
Mu Ukwakira 2019, mu muhango wabereye ku rwibutso rwa Cyanika, Minisitiri w'Ubutabera, Johnston Busingye, yongeye gushimangira ko Leta itazihanganira abahisha amakuru y'aho imibiri y'abazize Jenoside iri, ashimangira akamaro ko gukorera mu mucyo n'ubutabera ku miryango y'abazize Jenoside.
Amateka y'ubwicanyi.
Muri Jenoside, Kiliziya Gatolika ya Cyanika yabaye ahantu h'ubwicanyi aho Abatutsi benshi bari bahahungiye biciwe. Padiri mukuru wa paruwasi, Joseph Niyomugabo, yanze gutererana impunzi, nawe aricwa muri Mata 1994.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kaduha rwibuka abazize ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994 muri paruwasi ya Kaduha, mu Akarere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kaduha rwubatse mu Mudugudu wa Bamba, Akagari ka Kavumu, Umurenge wa Kaduha, Akarere ka Nyamagabe, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gikongoro.
Urwibutso rwa Kaduha ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kaduha ni rumwe mu nzibutso n'imva rusange nyinshi ziri ku butaka bw'u Rwanda no hanze yabwo, zifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ubwo yarutahaga, Paul Kagame yashimangiye ko ari ngombwa kwibuka ibyabaye kugira ngo Jenoside itazongera kubaho ukundi. Yashishikarije Abanyarwanda guhangana n'ibibazo bateza imbere ubumwe, ubutabera, ubwiyunge, no kurwanya ubukene n'imiyoborere mibi.
Ubwicanyi bukomeye bwabereye i Kaduha ku wa 21 Mata 1994. Kaduha ni hamwe mu hantu h'ingenzi habereye ubwicanyi muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro, nyuma ya Mushubi (7 Mata), Kibeho (14 Mata) na Muganza (16 Mata). Ibihumbi by'Abatutsi bari barigeze guhungira muri paruwasi za Kaduha, Cyanika na Kibeho mu bwicanyi bwo muri Noheli ya 1963–1964.
Igitero cyo ku wa 21 Mata 1994 cyibasiye kiliziya n'inyubako za paruwasi, ndetse n'ibigo nderabuzima n'amashuri byari hafi aho. Abatangabuhamya basobanura uko impunzi zakusanyirijwe i Kaduha babwirwa ko ari ukugira ngo zirindwe, hanyuma zikicwa. Claude Ndorimana warokotse, wigaga mu ishuri ry'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi rya Kaduha, yavuze ko yahungiye muri paruwasi ari kumwe n'umuryango we, amaze kumva ko bene wabo bishwe. Yatanze ubuhamya ku bwicanyi bwabereye mu ishuri no mu bitaro, no ku ishyingurwa ry'abishwe, barimo na murumuna we w'imyaka itandatu wari ukiri muzima. François Shikama, umuhinzi, na we yatanze ubuhamya ko yabonye abantu bicirwa kuri bariyeri yari hafi y'«Umuzungukazi» (Umubikira Milgitha) no kuri kiliziya.
Imva rusange z'i Kaduha zabanje kuba imyobo impunzi zacukuye zibitegetswe n'abayobozi, bavuga ko ari imisarane, nyuma iza kujugunywamo imirambo y'abishwe. Hari ibihembo, nk'umuceri cyangwa amafaranga byatangwaga n'Umubikira Milgitha, byahabwaga abatwaraga imirambo.
Ku rwibutso rwa Kaduha hakunze kubera imihango yo kwibuka. Itariki yo kwibuka ihindagurika buri mwaka bitewe na gahunda y'inzego z'ubuyobozi, ariko nk'uko abatangabuhamya babyemeza, yakabaye iya 21 Mata, umunsi Abatutsi bari bahungiye muri kiliziya bishwe.
Urwibutso rwa Kaduha rwubatswe ku bufatanye bw'abaturage. Ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gusura, kandi ni ingenzi mu bushakashatsi ku mateka ya Jenoside, cyane cyane kubera inyandiko n'amafoto byabitswe n'umubikira w'Umudage Milgitha Kösser (1936–2016). Yari umuyobozi w'ikigo nderabuzima cya Kaduha kuva mu 1973, akaba yarabaye umuhamya utagira icyo ashobora gukora ku wa 21 Mata 1994. Yakoze alubumu y'amafoto 193, yo hagati ya 1992 na 1995, agaragaza uburemere bw'ubwicanyi n'isenywa ry'ibintu, ndetse no gutesha agaciro imirambo, ahantu n'ibintu by'idini. Iyo alubumu ni inyandiko y'ingenzi yo gusobanukirwa n'ibyabereye i Kaduha.
Ubushakashatsi ku byabereye i Kaduha bugaragaza kandi uburyo abakoze Jenoside bagoretse ururimi: amagambo nka "gutabara" yakoreshwaga mu kuvuga kongera ingufu z'udutsiko tw'abicanyi. Imvugo zijyanye n'«akazi» cyangwa «inshingano z'ubuyobozi» zasobanuraga uburinzi bwo kuri bariyeri zicirwagaho abantu. N'amagambo yo mu birori yakoreshejwe mu kuvuga ibirori by'abicanyi.
Imiterere y'i Kaduha, ifite imisozi ihanamye n'imikoki miremire, yahinduye paruwasi umutego mu gihe cy'ubwicanyi, bituma guhunga bitashobokera abishwe batari bafite uko birwanaho.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro ni urwibutso ruri i Kigali, mu Akarere ka Kicukiro, aho haruhukiye abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 basaga 100 000. Aha hantu hafitanye isano rya hafi n'igenda ry'ingabo za MINUAR zari mu Ishuri ry'Imyuga (École technique officielle, ETO) rya Kicukiro ku wa 11 Mata 1994, n'ubwicanyi bwakurikiyeho ku musozi wa Nyanza.
Urwibutso ruri i Nyanza, mu Murenge wa Kagarama, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'umujyi rwagati wa Kigali, hafi y'ishuri "Integrated Polytechnic Regional College" (IPRC), ryahoze ari École technique officielle ya Kicukiro (ETO).
Urwibutso rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro ni ahantu ho kwibukira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri mu nzibutso z'igihugu zahariwe kwibuka ibyo byabaye. Ruri iruhande rw'Ubusitani bw'urwibutso bwa Nyanza, ubusitani bwo kwigisha amateka bwatashywe mu 2022.
Uru rwibutso ni rumwe mu nzibutso, imva rusange n'ahantu ho kwibukira biri hirya no hino mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, bifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994. Enye muri zo — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — zashyizwe mu Murage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Ku wa 11 Mata 1994, nyuma y'igenda ry'ingabo z'Ababiligi za MINUAR zari zirinze École technique officielle ya Kicukiro, ibihumbi by'impunzi z'Abatutsi byategetswe kuva mu kigo cy'ishuri bijyanwa ku musozi wa Nyanza, aho byiciwe ku gicamunsi. Bivugwa ko hishwe abantu nibura 2 000, barimo abana benshi.
Mu myaka yakurikiyeho, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yataburuwe mu bice bitandukanye by'umujyi yagiye ikusanyirizwa i Nyanza igashyingurwa mu cyubahiro. Muri Gicurasi 2022, imibiri mishya 9 181 yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro kuri uru rwibutso. Muri Mata 2021, ubuyobozi bw'Umujyi wa Kigali bwavugaga ko i Nyanza hashyinguye abantu basaga 96 000, umubare wageze ku basaga 105 000 nk'uko byatangajwe ku mugaragaro mu gihe cya "Kwibuka31" mu 2025. Ubusitani bw'urwibutso buri iruhande rwarwo, bwatekerejwe n'umuryango Ibuka ufatanyije n'umunyabugeni Bruce Clarke, bwatashywe ku mugaragaro ku wa 11 Nzeri 2022 na Jeannette Kagame.
Urwibutso rurimo imva rusange nyinshi zisizweho amakaro n'ibyapa byanditseho amazina y'abazize Jenoside. Buri mwaka rwakira imihango yo Kwibuka n'urugendo rwo kwibuka ("Walk to Remember") ruhera kuri IPRC (yahoze ari ETO).
Urwibutso ruri ku rutonde rwa Ibuka, rugaragaza ko ruri i Kicukiro kandi rufite imva rusange enye z'ingenzi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rusiga ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu Murenge wa Rusiga, mu Akarere ka Rulindo, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda.
Itorero ry'Abapantekoti rya Rusiga na Kiliziya Gatolika ya Rulindo ni ho hantu h'ingenzi habereye ubwicanyi.
Urwibutso rwa Rusiga ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Hashyinguwe abazize Jenoside basaga 6 400.
Mu Karere ka Rulindo hari ahandi hantu umunani ho kwibukira no gushyingura; muri aho hantu hose, harimo n'urwibutso rwa Rusiga, hashyinguwe abazize Jenoside 18 600 (imibare yo muri Werurwe 2014).
Ubwicanyi bw'Abatutsi bwabereye mu karere, cyane cyane mu Itorero ry'Abapantekoti rya Rusiga no muri Kiliziya Gatolika ya Rulindo.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bazize ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Macuba, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Macuba, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba. Ruri mu gice cy'iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda kirimo inzibutso nyinshi zagenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Urwibutso rwa Bazize ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu. Izo nzibutso zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro abazize Jenoside, kubunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka.
Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Bazize ruri mu hantu ho kwibukira hashyizweho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kugira ngo habungabungwe urwibutso rw'abayizize bo mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke.
Inyandiko z'ingengo y'imari y'Akarere ka Nyamasheke zigaragaza amafaranga yagenewe kubungabunga inzibutso za Jenoside no gukora imirimo ijyanye n'inzibutso zo muri ako karere.
Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, urwibutso rwa Bazize ni ahantu ho gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kunamira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso z'igihugu zakira imihango yo Kwibuka n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Birogo ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Gihombo, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Gihombo, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba. Ruri mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu gice kirimo ahantu henshi ho kwibukira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Urwibutso rwa Birogo ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu. Inzibutso zo mu Rwanda ni ahantu ho gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka.
Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Birogo ruri mu hantu ho kwibukira hashyizweho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kugira ngo habungabungwe urwibutso rw'abayizize bo mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke.
Inyandiko z'ingengo y'imari y'Akarere ka Nyamasheke zigaragaza amafaranga yagenewe kubungabunga inzibutso za Jenoside no gukora imirimo ijyanye n'inzibutso zo muri ako karere.
Ku wa 13 Mata 1994, imodoka y'imbangukiragutabara yari itwaye abagore babiri b'Abatutsi, Dativa na Brigitte, abana babo n'umukobwa umwe ukiri muto, yahagarikiwe i Birogo na Joseph Mpambara n'abandi bagabo. Abari mu modoka bahatiwe gukomeza urugendo berekeza i Mugonero, imodoka ikikijwe n'abagabye igitero. Bageze i Mugonero, Dativa, Brigitte n'abana babo bakubiswe imihoro n'amahiri, baricwa.
Mu gitabo cye "Briseurs de destins", François-Xavier Nsanzuwera avuga urubanza rwa Joseph Mpambara mu isesengura rye ku mabariyeri yakoreshejwe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Asobanura ko amabariyeri yashyizweho muri Jenoside yakoreshwaga mu kumenya no gufata Abatutsi n'Abahutu bazwi ko batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, kandi ko yari ahantu hakorerwaga ihohoterwa, harimo n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ryakorerwaga abagore b'Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Musanze (rwahoze rwitwa urwa Ruhengeri) ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu mujyi wa Musanze, mu Akarere ka Musanze, mu Intara y'Amajyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Rwakira buri mwaka imihango yo "Kwibuka".
Urwibutso rwashyizwe mu nyubako yahoze ari iy'Urukiko rw'Ubujurire rwa Ruhengeri, ku muhanda munini w'umujyi wa Musanze. Rwafunguwe nyuma yo gutunganya iyo nyubako no kwimura imibiri yari ishyinguye mu rwibutso rwa kera rwa Muhoza.
Ubwicanyi bwabereye mu rukiko.
Hagati ya tariki ya 12 na 14 Mata 1994, Abatutsi babarirwa mu magana bo mu makomini ya Nyarutovu, Gatonde na Ndusu (mu cyahoze ari Superefegitura ya Busengo, ubu ni mu Akarere ka Gakenke) bajyanywe ku Rukiko rw'Ubujurire rwa Ruhengeri, bicirwa mu cyumba cy'iburanisha: baterewe ibyuka biryana mu maso, ibisasu, banakubitwa intwaro za gakondo. Benshi mu bishwe bari abakozi ba Leta n'abandi banyamwuga (abarimu, abaganga n'abaforomo, abakozi ba banki, abashoferi, abahinzi-borozi b'abahanga), ndetse n'abakozi b'urukiko ubwarwo.
Urwibutso rwa Musanze ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mbere y'uko uru rwibutso rwubakwa, abazize Jenoside bo muri ako karere bari bashyinguye cyane cyane mu rwibutso rwa Muhoza, mu mujyi wa Musanze. Mu 2019, abarokotse Jenoside basabye ko hashyirwaho ahantu ho gushyingura heza kandi harinzwe neza.
Mu 2021, inzego z'ubuyobozi zatangaje ko inyubako yahoze ari iy'Urukiko rw'Ubujurire igiye guhindurwa urwibutso. Ku wa 15 Mata 2022, imibiri irenga 800 yimuwe i Muhoza yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rushya.
Urwibutso ruri ku muhanda munini wo mu mujyi wa Musanze (Ruhengeri), umurwa mukuru w'Intara y'Amajyaruguru. Ni rwo rwibutso rw'Akarere, kandi rusurwa kenshi n'amashuri yo muri ako gace.
Mu muhango wo gushyingura wo ku wa 15 Mata 2022, Perezida w'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga, Faustin Nteziryayo, yavuze ko kwicira abantu b'inzirakarengane mu cyumba cy'iburanisha ari ibintu bitari byarigeze bibaho mu Rwanda, kandi ko n'ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko bitigeze bibaho ahandi hose. Minisitiri Jean-Damascène Bizimana we yibukije ko Jenoside yageragerejwe mu bice bitandukanye bya Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri mbere ya 1994.
Kugeza ku wa 15 Mata 2022, abazize Jenoside barenga 1 500 bari bashyinguye mu nzibutso eshatu zo mu Karere ka Musanze; hari n'indi mibiri itaraboneka, kandi abaturage basabwa gutanga amakuru ku hantu hakiri imibiri itarashyingurwa.
Urwibutso rwakira buri mwaka imihango ya "Kwibuka", irimo urugendo rwo kwibuka, ijoro ryo kwibuka no gushyira indabo ku mva, ndetse n'ibikorwa by'uburezi bikorwa ku bufatanye n'amashuri na za kaminuza zo muri ako karere.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gahanga ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Gahanga, mu Akarere ka Kicukiro, mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri i Gahanga, mu gice cy'amajyepfo y'uburasirazuba bw'Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Akarere ka Kicukiro. Ruri hafi ya Kiliziya Gatolika ya Gahanga, rwegeranye n'ahandi hantu ho kwibukira ho muri uwo murenge, nka Karembure.
Urwibutso rwa Gahanga ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ubwicanyi bwo muri Kiliziya ya Gahanga.
Guhera ku wa 8 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bahungiye muri Kiliziya ya Gahanga. Ku wa 9 Mata, abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze bategetse Abahutu kuvamo, Abatutsi basigara bonyine. Ku wa 10 Mata 1994 ubwicanyi bwaratangiye, ariko Abatutsi barirwanaho basubiza inyuma Interahamwe. Konseye Buregeya yahise yitabaza abasirikare, baza barasa abari muri kiliziya, maze Interahamwe zisonga inkomere. Hafi y'Abatutsi bose bari muri kiliziya barishwe, na bake barokotse bakomereka bikabije.
Ishyingurwa ry'imibiri.
Mu 1996, imibiri yari imaze kuboneka yarakusanyijwe ishyingurwa mu cyubahiro muri uru rwibutso. Mu 2020, KT Press yavugaga ko urwibutso rurimo imibiri irenga 7 000.
Ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2023, imibiri 10 224 yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rwa Gahanga. Imwe muri yo yari yarabonetse kuri Kiliziya ya Gahanga, indi ivanwa mu mva rusange za Nunga na Karembure. Minisitiri w'Abakozi ba Leta n'Umurimo, Fanfan Kayirangwa Rwanyindo, yavuze ko iyo mibiri yari itatanyije mu hantu hatandukanye itari ishyinguwe mu buryo bukwiye.
Buri mwaka, urwibutso rwa Gahanga rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" yitabirwa n'imiryango y'abazize Jenoside, abarokotse n'abayobozi; mu gihe cyo kwibuka hakomeza gushyingurwa mu cyubahiro imibiri igenda iboneka.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Jabana ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu gace k'Umurenge wa Jabana w'ubu, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu majyaruguru y'Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, hafi y'uruganda rw'isukari rwa Kabuye (Kabuye Sugar Factory).
Urwibutso rwa Jabana ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, harimo n'izo mu Mujyi wa Kigali nk'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ku Gisozi.
Mu 1994, ubwicanyi bwo muri ako gace bwakozwe n'abarwanyi b'umutwe wa Nyaconga bahungaga ingabo za RPA, hamwe n'amatsinda y'Interahamwe yayoborwaga n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze. Mu bagize uruhare harimo burugumesitiri ndetse n'abayobozi b'inganda n'insyo bo muri ako gace, batanze intwaro kandi bategura ubwicanyi.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yo muri Jabana no mu mirenge ihakikije yakusanyirijwe muri uru rwibutso ishyingurwa mu cyubahiro.
Mu 2025, urwibutso rwari ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside 333, ikomoka mu mirenge itanu: Jabana, Nduba, Jali, Gatsata na Ndera.
Urwibutso rwakira ibikorwa byo "Kwibuka" bitegurwa n'abarokotse, inzego n'ibigo byo muri ako gace. Nko ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2025, abakozi b'uruganda rwa Kabuye Sugar Factory bakoze urugendo rwo kwibuka ("walk to remember") kuva ku ruganda kugera ku rwibutso, bafata umunota wo kwibuka, bumva ubuhamya bw'abarokotse, banasobanurirwa amateka ya Jenoside mu cyahoze ari Segiteri ya Kabuye, i Jabana, igice cya Segiteri ya Muhororo n'i Masoro.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kibagabaga ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Kibagabaga, mu Murenge wa Kimironko, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri i Kibagabaga, mu Murenge wa Kimironko, mu gice cy'amajyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'Umujyi wa Kigali, mu Akarere ka Gasabo. Ruri hafi y'umuhanda munini; mu 2024, abayobozi bagaragaje ko uko kwegerana n'umuhanda guteza impungenge ku mutekano w'urwibutso, bavuga ko hateganywa uburyo bwo gukemura icyo kibazo.
Urwibutso rwa Kibagabaga ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka. Mu Mujyi wa Kigali harimo n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ku Gisozi, ruri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO hamwe n'inzibutso za Nyamata, Murambi na Bisesero.
