Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Abatutsi benshi bahungiye mu rusengero rwari hafi y'ahari urwibutso ubu, maze bahicirwa. Indi mibiri yagiye iboneka ahandi hantu hatandukanye mu Murenge wa Kimironko.
Mu 2024, urwibutso rwa Kibagabaga rwibukirwagamo Abatutsi bagera ku 23 141. Buri mwaka rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" y'Umurenge wa Kimironko; nko ku wa 11 Mata 2024, witabiriwe n'abayobozi barimo Umuyobozi w'Akarere ka Gasabo, Pauline Umwali, na Minisitiri w'Ubuhinzi n'Ubworozi, Dr. Ildephonse Musafiri.
Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso z'igihugu zakira imihango yo kwibuka n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kinyinya ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Murama, mu Murenge wa Kinyinya, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri i Murama, mu Murenge wa Kinyinya, mu Akarere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali.
Urwibutso rwa Kinyinya ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka. Mu Mujyi wa Kigali harimo n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ku Gisozi, ruri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO hamwe n'inzibutso za Nyamata, Murambi na Bisesero.
Nk'uko byavuzwe mu buhamya bwatanzwe mu gihe cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 32 i Kinyinya, Abatutsi bari batuye ku musozi wa Kinyinya bishwe n'abasirikare b'ubutegetsi bwa Juvénal Habyarimana n'Interahamwe. Ubwicanyi bwatangiye nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida Habyarimana ku wa 6 Mata 1994, abicanyi bagenda basoma amazina y'abo bagombaga kwica, ibigaragaza ko bari barabateguye mbere.
Mu 2025, urwibutso rwa Kinyinya rwari ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside 441. Ku rwibutso hari urutonde rw'amazina 411 y'Abatutsi biciwe ku musozi wa Kinyinya, rugenda rwuzuzwa uko abandi bazize Jenoside bamenyekana.
Urwibutso kandi rufitanye isano n'amateka y'amashuri yo muri ako gace. Ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2025, umuhango wo kwibuka wateguwe na Groupe Scolaire Kinyinya watangiriye ku rwibutso rwa Kinyinya i Murama, ukomereza ku ishuri; hibukwa abarimu 12 n'abanyeshuri 6 b'icyahoze ari ishuri ribanza rya Kinyinya bishwe muri Jenoside.
Rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko y'u Rwanda agenga kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Cyabakamyi (ruzwi kandi nk'urwibutso rw'i Nyabinyenga) ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Nyabinyenga, mu Murenge wa Cyabakamyi, mu Akarere ka Nyanza, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri ku musozi wa Nyabinyenga, hafi ya Paruwasi ya Nyabinyenga n'ibiro by'Akagari ka Nyabinyenga, mu Murenge wa Cyabakamyi, mu Akarere ka Nyanza.
Urwibutso rwa Cyabakamyi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zibaruwe mu bushakashatsi bwa Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) ku hantu habereye Jenoside.
Nk'uko Minisiteri y'Ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda n'Inshingano Mboneragihugu (MINUBUMWE) ibivuga, guhera ku wa 22 Mata 1994 Abatutsi batangiye kurimburwa ahantu hatandukanye muri Perefegitura ya Butare, harimo n'i Nyabinyenga.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yabonetse muri ako gace yashyinguwe muri uru rwibutso.
Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko agenga kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Cyahinda ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Cyahinda, mu Akarere ka Nyaruguru, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Cyahinda, mu Akarere ka Nyaruguru. Rufitanye isano na Paruwasi Gatolika ya Cyahinda, yiciwemo Abatutsi benshi muri Jenoside, mu cyahoze ari Komini Nyakizu, Perefegitura ya Butare.
Urwibutso rwa Cyahinda ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ubwicanyi bwo kuri Paruwasi ya Cyahinda.
Nk'uko raporo ya Human Rights Watch ibivuga, Abatutsi benshi bo muri Komini Nyakizu n'abaturutse mu makomini ahakikije, cyane cyane mu Gikongoro, bahungiye kuri Kiliziya ya Cyahinda. Burugumesitiri wa Nyakizu, Ladislas Ntaganzwa, yabizezaga umutekano ("Nimuze muri komini yanjye, muzaba mutekanye"), mu gihe yateguraga ubwicanyi mu ibanga.
Hagati ya tariki ya 15 na 19 Mata 1994, impunzi zari kuri Kiliziya ya Cyahinda zagabweho ibitero byayobowe na Ntaganzwa. Ibyo bitero byagizwemo uruhare n'abapolisi b'igihugu (Gendarmerie), abasirikare, abapolisi ba komini, impunzi z'Abarundi zitwaje intwaro, abarwanashyaka ba MDR-Power, Interahamwe zaturutse mu Gikongoro, ndetse n'abaturage ba Nyakizu n'ab'amakomini ahakikije. Human Rights Watch igereranya ko abishwe bari hagati ya 5 500 na 15 000, abenshi muri bo bakaba bari abagore, abana n'abasaza.
Ku wa 18 Mata 2010, imibiri 142 y'abazize Jenoside yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rwa Cyahinda. Muri uwo muhango, Padiri mukuru wa Paruwasi ya Cyahinda, Innocent Gakwaya, yasabye abihaye Imana bagize uruhare muri Jenoside kwigaragaza no gusaba imbabazi.
Urwibutso ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kunamira no kwibuka abiciwe i Cyahinda. Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko agenga kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Cyarwa ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Tumba, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda. Ruruhukiyemo imibiri irenga 11 000 y'abazize Jenoside.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Tumba, mu Akarere ka Huye, hafi y'umujyi wa Butare.
Urwibutso rwa Cyarwa ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Cyarwa ruri mu hantu ho kwibukira hafitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare, ahabereye ubwicanyi bwinshi mu 1994.
Mu muhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 28 wabereye i Cyarwa ku wa 21 Mata 2022, abatanze ubuhamya bagaragaje ko Jenoside muri ako gace yatangiye nyuma y'ijambo Perezida w'agateganyo, Théodore Sindikubwabo, yavugiye i Butare ku wa 19 Mata 1994, akangurira abantu kwica. Minisitiri w'Ubuzima, Dr. Daniel Ngamije, yavuze ko Sindikubwabo "yari umuganga ariko ahitamo kuba umwicanyi".
Urwibutso rwa Cyarwa ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside irenga 11 000.
Ku wa 15 Gicurasi 2021, imibiri 48 yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro muri uru rwibutso: 47 yari yabonetse mu Mudugudu w'Akamuhoza hagati ya tariki ya 26 na 28 Mata 2021, n'umwe wavanywe mu Murenge wa Ngoma. Umuhango witabiriwe na Visi Perezida wa Sena, Espérance Nyirasafari, na Perezida wa Ibuka mu Karere ka Huye, Théodate Siboyintore.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Giheke ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Giheke, mu Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Giheke, mu Akarere ka Rusizi, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Giheke ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Giheke ruri mu hantu ho kwibukira hashyizweho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kugira ngo habungabungwe urwibutso rw'abayizize bo mu Akarere ka Rusizi.
Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, urwibutso rwa Giheke ni ahantu ho gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kunamira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kandi rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kabgayi ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Kabgayi, mu Akarere ka Muhanga, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda. Rwibutsa Abatutsi benshi bahungiye i Kabgayi muri Jenoside, bakahicirwa cyangwa bagakurwayo bakajya kwicirwa ahandi.
Urwibutso ruri ku musozi wa Kabgayi, mu majyepfo y'umujyi wa Muhanga (wahoze witwa Gitarama), hafi ya Katederali ya Kabgayi, ibitaro bya Kabgayi n'ibigo by'amashuri bya Kiliziya Gatolika.
Urwibutso rwa Kabgayi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ubuhungiro bw'i Kabgayi.
Muri Jenoside, Kabgayi yabaye ubuhungiro bw'Abatutsi ibihumbi n'ibihumbi baturutse mu makomini ya Perefegitura ya Gitarama, cyane cyane Mushubati, Tambwe, Ntongwe, Mugina, Taba na Buringa, ndetse n'abari bahunze ubwicanyi bw'i Kigali. Bahungiye mu ishuri ribanza, muri Petit Séminaire ya Kabgayi, mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Saint-Joseph no mu kigo cy'ababikira cyitwaga CND, bizeye ko nk'uko byagenze mu 1959, kugera ku butaka bwa Kiliziya byari kubarinda.
Guhera ku wa 15 Mata 1994, Padiri Vjeko Ćurić, umupadiri w'Umufaransisikani, yatangiye gutwara impunzi zari i Kivumu azijyana i Kabgayi, akajya aha ruswa Interahamwe zabaga ziri kuri bariyeri. Muri Gicurasi 1994, Human Rights Watch yagereranyaga ko i Kabgayi hari abantu bagera ku 50 000 bavanywe mu byabo, abenshi muri bo bakaba Abatutsi, kandi ko Leta y'icyo gihe yanze kwemera ko ibitaro bya Kabgayi bitagira aho bibogamiye.
Ubuzima bw'impunzi i Kabgayi bwari bugoye cyane: abicanyi bahoraga bagaba ibitero, bagatoranya abo bica, kandi uwageragezaga gusohoka yashoboraga gufatwa akicwa n'Interahamwe. Abatutsi benshi, cyane cyane abagabo n'abahungu, barakusanywaga bagashyirwa mu mabisi ya ONATRACOM, bakajyanwa i Ngororero bakahicirwa. Human Rights Watch na yo yavuze ko amatsinda y'abantu yakurwaga mu nkambi y'impunzi z'Abatutsi yari mu kigo cya Kiliziya i Kabgayi, akajyanwa kwicwa. Abarokotse bavuga kandi ko abagore n'abakobwa bafatwaga ku ngufu, abagabo bakajyanwa ahantu hatazwi bakicwa.
Ku wa 2 Kamena 1994, ahagana saa tatu za mu gitondo, ingabo za FPR-Inkotanyi zafashe Kabgayi, zirokora impunzi zari zikiri yo.
Urwibutso ruri munsi y'umusozi wa Katederali ya Kabgayi, hafi y'ibitaro. Kimwe n'izindi nzibutso zo mu Rwanda, rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" iteganywa n'amategeko.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Karama ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Karama, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Ruhurije hamwe imibiri y'Abatutsi ibihumbi mirongo biciwe i Karama no mu makomini ahakikije, bari bakusanyirijwe kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Karama, nyuma ya Jenoside bagashyingurwa mu mva n'ibyumba by'imibiri byubatswe aho.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Karama, umwe mu mirenge cumi n'ine igize Akarere ka Huye mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo, mu burasirazuba bw'umujyi wa Butare (Huye). Ruri hafi ya Kiliziya Gatolika ya Karama, ahantu hirengeye hagerwa unyuze mu muhanda w'itaka uturuka ku muhanda uhuza Huye na Nyaruguru.
Urwibutso rwa Karama ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu 1994, Karama yari mu cyahoze ari Komini Runyinya, muri Perefegitura ya Butare, agace abayobozi ba gisivili, aba gisirikare n'ab'amadini bagizemo uruhare rukomeye mu gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside. Abatutsi bahungaga ibitero mu makomini aturanye ya Runyinya, Rwamiko, Mubuga, Maraba cyangwa Nyakizu boherezwaga kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Karama, bizezwa ko ari ubuhungiro.
Kuva Jenoside irangiye, buri murenge wo mu Karere ka Huye ufite ahantu ho kwibukira abazize Jenoside, kandi urwibutso rwa Karama rwagiye ruba rumwe mu nzibutso z'ingenzi z'akarere.
Ubwicanyi bwo mu 1994.
Nyuma y'igitero cyagabwe ku kigo cy'amashuri cya Murambi ku wa 20 na 21 Mata 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi bakusanyirijwe n'abayobozi ba komini kuri Paruwasi ya Karama, mu cyahoze ari Komini Runyinya. Impunzi zaturutse mu makomini atandukanye ya Perefegitura ya Butare, zikusanyirizwa muri kiliziya, mu mashuri no ku isoko ryari hafi aho, zibarurwa kandi zigabanywa hakurikijwe segiteri zaturutsemo.
Abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze n'abajandarume bafunze amazi, banashyira uburozi mu mugezi wari hafi kugira ngo impunzi zibure amazi meza, hanyuma bagaba ibitero bihuriweho bakoresheje za gerenade, imbunda n'intwaro gakondo. Ku wa 21 Mata 1994, nyuma y'umunsi wose w'ubwicanyi, abenshi mu bari bahungiye i Karama barishwe. Abarokotse bavuga kandi ko igikoma cyahawe abagore n'abana bari basigaye aho cyari kirimo uburozi, gihitana amagana muri bo.
Imibiri y'abishwe yajugunywe mu byobo byinshi byacukuwe hirya no hino ya paruwasi no ku misozi ihakikije. Ibigereranyo bihari bivuga ko i Karama hiciwe Abatutsi ibihumbi mirongo, abagera ku 70 000 muri bo bakaba bashyinguye mu rwibutso ubu.
Ishyirwaho n'iterambere ry'urwibutso.
Nyuma ya 1994, imva rusange zari hirya no hino i Karama zagiye zifukurwa buhoro buhoro, imibiri ikusanyirizwa mu nzu y'agateganyo yari ku kibanza cya paruwasi. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2010, Leta y'u Rwanda yashyize Karama ku rutonde rw'ahantu ho kwibukira hagomba kubungabungwa, igenera ingengo y'imari yo kubaka urwibutso rufatika muri uwo murenge.
Imirimo yo gutunganya aho hantu yatumye imibiri ibihumbi yavanywe mu byobo 1 335 byabaruwe mu cyahoze ari Komini Runyinya ihurizwa hamwe ikongera gushyingurwa. Ubu urwibutso ruruhukiyemo imibiri y'Abatutsi igereranywa hagati ya 68 000 na 75 000, bigatuma ruba rumwe mu nzibutso nini z'Akarere ka Huye.
Hagati ya 2020 na 2024, inzego za Leta n'imiryango y'abarokotse bateguye imihango yo "Kwibuka" i Karama, bashimangira ko ari ngombwa kurushaho kunoza ibikorwaremezo by'aho hantu no kuhashyira ku rwego rw'urwibutso rw'akarere. Abarokotse n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze basaba ko hubakwa inyubako nshya zo kumurikiramo amateka no gutunganya umuhanda ugerayo.
Urwibutso rwa Karama rugizwe n'inzu nini ibitswemo imibiri, imva zipfundikiye, ikibuga cyo gukoreramo imihango n'umusaraba munini ugaragara uri ku muhanda Huye–Nyaruguru. Ni ahantu imiryango ikomoka mu cyahoze ari Komini Runyinya no mu makomini aturanye iza kunamira ababo, igategura buri mwaka imihango yo kwibuka, ubuhamya n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ipfobya rya Jenoside.
Kubera umubare munini w'abahashyinguye n'amateka yihariye ya Paruwasi ya Karama muri Jenoside, abarokotse bafata aha hantu nk'ahantu h'ingenzi ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu karere ka Huye.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mayunzwe ni ahantu ho kwibukira haherereye i Mayunzwe, mu Akarere ka Ruhango (Intara y'Amajyepfo, Rwanda). Rwunamira abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kandi rwakira buri mwaka imihango yo "Kwibuka".
Urwibutso rufitanye isano n'ahantu hitwa «Karuvariyo» ("Kaluvariyo"), ku musozi uri hafi aho, ahiciwe Abatutsi b'i Mayunzwe muri Mata 1994.
Urwibutso ruri i Mayunzwe, mu Murenge wa Mbuye (Akarere ka Ruhango, Intara y'Amajyepfo). Aka gace kari mu burengerazuba bwa Kigali, hafi ya Muhanga (yahoze yitwa Gitarama).
Urwibutso rwa Mayunzwe ni rumwe mu nzibutso, imva rusange n'ahantu ho kwibukira biri hirya no hino mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, bifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994. Muri izo nzibutso, enye — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Ku wa 24 Mata 1994, Abatutsi biciwe i Mayunzwe, cyane cyane ahitwa «Karuvariyo». Amakuru yo muri ako gace agereranya ko uwo munsi hishwe abantu amagana. Umwanditsi Charles Habonimana, wavukiye i Mayunzwe, yarokotse ubwo bwicanyi maze abwandikaho igitabo "Moi, le dernier Tutsi" (2019).
Nyuma ya Jenoside, i Mayunzwe hubatswe urwibutso. Inyandiko z'ingengo y'imari zigaragaza imirimo yo kubaka no gusana urwibutso yatewe inkunga n'Akarere ka Ruhango.
Urwibutso rufitanye isano ya bugufi n'ahitwa «Karuvariyo», ku musozi uri hafi aho, ahiciwe abenshi mu bazize Jenoside b'i Mayunzwe ku wa 24 Mata 1994; ibigereranyo byo muri ako gace bivuga ko muri segiteri ya Mayunzwe honyine hishwe abarenga 850. Mu bavugwa ko bayoboye cyangwa bashishikarije ubwicanyi harimo François Murekambanze, wari konseye wa segiteri, hamwe n'abicanyi baturutse ahandi.
Aha hantu hakoreshwa buri gihe mu bikorwa byo kwibuka ("Kwibuka"), kandi hari umushinga wo kubaka «inzira y'amateka» igana kuri Karuvariyo.
Urwibutso rwakira buri mwaka imihango yo "Kwibuka" (ijoro ryo kwibuka, gushyira indabo ku mva, urugendo rwo kwibuka) n'ibikorwa byo kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside bitegurwa n'inzego z'ibanze n'imiryango y'abarokotse.
Charles Habonimana, mu gitabo cye "Moi, le dernier Tutsi", avuga uko abo mu muryango we bishwe n'uko we yarokotse muri Mata 1994 aha hantu.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Mugombwa ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Mugombwa, mu Akarere ka Gisagara, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Mugombwa, mu Akarere ka Gisagara, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Rufitanye isano na Paruwasi Gatolika ya Mugombwa, ivugwa mu hantu hiciwe Abatutsi muri Jenoside mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare.
Urwibutso rwa Mugombwa ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Mugombwa rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Paruwasi Gatolika ya Mugombwa ivugwa nk'ahantu hiciwe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994, cyane cyane mu bitero byagizwemo uruhare n'impunzi z'Abarundi zari zituye muri ako gace.
Muri Mata 2010, imibiri 40 y'abazize Jenoside yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rwa Mugombwa. Muri uwo muhango, Umuvunyi Mukuru Tito Rutaremara yasabye abakoze Jenoside kwemera uruhare rwabo no gusaba imbabazi.
Mu 2016, mu Akarere ka Gisagara havumbuwe imva rusange, mu bikorwa byo gushakisha imibiri y'abazize Jenoside. Ibyo byibukije akamaro ko kumenya, gutaburura no gushyingura mu cyubahiro imibiri y'abazize Jenoside muri ako karere.
Ubwicanyi bwo kuri Paruwasi ya Mugombwa.
Urwibutso rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe kuri Paruwasi Gatolika ya Mugombwa, yari mu cyahoze ari Komini Muganza, Perefegitura ya Butare. Ku wa 20 na 21 Mata 1994, Abatutsi baturutse i Muganza, Kibayi, Nyaruhengeri no mu nkengero z'umusozi wa Nyange bahungiye muri Kiliziya ya Mugombwa. Nk'uko Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) ibivuga, Abatutsi bagera ku 26 700 biciwe kuri Paruwasi ya Mugombwa.
Ubwicanyi bwateguwe hafi ya kiliziya, aho impunzi zari zafungiwe mbere y'igitero. Raporo ya CNLG ivuga ko inzugi zakingishijwe, hanyuma abagabye igitero bakazisenya bakoresheje imbunda na za gerenade, mbere yo gutwika inyubako bakoresheje lisansi. Iyo raporo ivuga kandi ko mu babigizemo uruhare harimo Élie Ndayambaje, wahoze ari burugumesitiri wa Muganza, abayobozi ba komini, Interahamwe n'impunzi z'Abahutu b'Abarundi zari zituye muri ako gace.
Ibyabereye i Mugombwa byanditswe kandi n'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR/ICTR) mu rubanza ruzwi nka «Butare». Urubanza rwo ku rwego rwa mbere rwagaragaje ko ibitero byagabwe kuri Kiliziya ya Mugombwa ku wa 20 na 21 Mata 1994, kandi ko icyo gihe hari hahungiye impunzi ibihumbi, abenshi muri bo bakaba Abatutsi. Mu bujurire, igihano Élie Ndayambaje yahawe cyo gufasha no gushishikariza ubwicanyi bw'Abatutsi kuri Kiliziya ya Mugombwa ku wa 20 na 21 Mata 1994 cyaremejwe.
Uruhare rw'impunzi z'Abarundi.
Kuba impunzi z'Abarundi zaragize uruhare muri ibyo bitero ni ikintu gikunze kuvugwa mu nkuru zo muri ako gace. Nk'uko "KT Press" ibivuga, impunzi z'Abahutu b'Abarundi zari zituye mu nkambi zegereye umupaka, cyane cyane hafi ya Nyange, zagize uruhare runini mu bitero byagabwe kuri paruwasi no mu midugudu iyikikije. Iyo nkuru ivuga kandi ko abishwe bashyinguwe mu rwibutso ruri mu kigo cya paruwasi, aho haba haruhukiye abantu 43 471, hiyongereyeho abagera ku 6 000 bashyinguye ahandi hantu hatatu haturanye.
Urwibutso ubu ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kunamira no kwibuka abiciwe i Mugombwa. Ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso za Jenoside z'igihugu, zakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

"Ntibyitiranywe n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro."
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyanza rwibutsa Abatutsi bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, i Nyanza, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Rwafunguwe ku mugaragaro ku wa 21 Mata 2014, kandi rubitse imibiri y'abazize Jenoside igera ku 20 000.
Urwibutso ruri mu Mudugudu wa Murambi, Akagari ka Rwesero, Umurenge wa Busasamana, mu Akarere ka Nyanza, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Rwubatswe ku kibanza cya Leta cyari kiriho inzu y'Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa yitwaga «Cercle», aho Umwami yakoreraga inama n'abatware be.
Urwibutso rwa Nyanza ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Nyanza ni rumwe mu nzibutso nyinshi zagenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Umujyi wa Nyanza uzwi kandi kubera Ingoro Ndangamurage y'Umwami i Rukari, ndetse n'amateka yawo nk'icyahoze ari umurwa w'ubwami. Mu 1994, aho urwibutso ruri hari muri Selire Murambi, Segiteri Rwesero, Komini Nyabisindu, Perefegitura ya Butare.
Ubwicanyi bwatangiye muri ako gace ahagana ku wa 15 Mata 1994, ubwo umuntu wa mbere yicirwaga i Rwabicuma. Burugumesitiri wa Komini Nyabisindu, Jean-Marie Vianney Gisagara, wakanguriraga abaturage kutijandika mu bwicanyi, yarafashwe arabohwa, azengurutswa umujyi wa Nyanza aziritse ku modoka, aricwa. Nyuma y'urupfu rwe, ubwicanyi busesuye bwatangiye ku wa 20 Mata 1994.
Ubwicanyi bwabereye mu mujyi wa Nyanza no mu nkengero zawo, i Busasamana, i Rwabicuma, i Mukingo, i Mpanga n'ahandi. Ku gasozi ka Nyamiyaga, Abatutsi bagerageje kwirwanaho bakoresheje amabuye, ariko bicwa n'amasasu y'abajandarume. Kubera ko hari bariyeri hose, abenshi biciwe mu ngo zabo. Imibiri y'abishwe yajugunywe kuri sitade ya Nyanza no mu cyuzi cya Nyamagana. Jenoside yahagaritswe i Nyanza ku wa 28–29 Gicurasi 1994.
Ishyirwaho ry'urwibutso.
Kubera ko aho imibiri yari ishyinguye kuri sitade nta bwinyagamburiro hari hafite, Akarere ka Nyanza kafashe icyemezo cyo kubaka urwibutso rushya no kwimurirayo imibiri. Rwatashywe ku wa 21 Mata 2014. Rushyinguyemo imibiri yavanywe kuri sitade n'indi yari ishyinguye hirya no hino mu masambu no mu ngo; hateganyijwe kandi kwimurirwamo imibiri iri mu nzibutso za Kavumu na Mwima.
Abashyinguye mu rwibutso rwa Nyanza bagereranywa ku 20 011, kandi umubare uziyongera uko imibiri mishya izagenda iboneka. Umunsi wo kwibuka ni ku wa 21 Mata buri mwaka, kuko ari bwo ubwicanyi bweruye bwatangiye i Nyanza. Hari ubusitani bwagutse, kandi inzu ya «Cercle» y'Umwami Rudahigwa iteganyirizwa kuba inzu y'amateka.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rubona ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haherereye ku butaka bw'icyahoze ari ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi mu buhinzi cya ISAR Rubona, mu Murenge wa Rusatira, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'Abatutsi bazize Jenoside, barimo abakozi b'icyo kigo n'imiryango yabo, ndetse n'impunzi zari zaturutse mu makomini aturanye.
Urwibutso ruri mu kigo cy'ubushakashatsi cya Rubona cy'Ikigo cy'Igihugu Gishinzwe Guteza Imbere Ubuhinzi n'Ubworozi (Rwanda Agriculture Board, RAB), mu Mudugudu wa Rubona, Akagari ka Kiruhura, Umurenge wa Rusatira, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Ruri mu nzibutso za Jenoside zabaruwe ku mugaragaro n'inzego z'ubuyobozi bw'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Rubona ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mbere ya 1994, ISAR Rubona yari ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi mu buhinzi cy'Ikigo cy'Ubushakashatsi mu by'Ubuhinzi mu Rwanda (ISAR), gikikijwe n'imisozi y'icyaro yo mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare. Jenoside igitangira, Abatutsi benshi bo muri icyo kigo no mu makomini aturanye ya Ruhashya, Rusatira, Mbazi, Mugusa, Maraba n'agace ka Gikongoro bahungiye ku musozi wa Rubona, bizeye ko bazarindwa n'uko hari ikigo cy'igihugu n'inzego z'umutekano.
Ku wa 26 Mata 1994, ibitero byaturutse mu makomini atandukanye aturanye byagabwe ku mpunzi z'Abatutsi zari zikusanyirijwe mu kigo cya ISAR Rubona no ku musozi wa Rubona. Interahamwe, abajandarume, abasirikare n'abapolisi bagize uruhare mu bwicanyi bwamaze umunsi wose n'ijoro ryose, bwibasiye abakozi b'ikigo n'imiryango yabo, ndetse n'abari basubijwe inyuma bagerageza guhungira i Burundi. Raporo ya CNLG ivuga ko mu bayobozi bo muri ako gace bagize uruhare muri ubwo bwicanyi harimo Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ISAR, Charles Ndereyehe, umuyobozi w'ikigo cya Rubona Joseph Mulindangabo, ushinzwe abakozi Didace Mugemana n'abandi bayobozi n'Interahamwe bateguye ibarura ry'Abatutsi kandi bahuza ibitero.
Nyuma y'ubwicanyi bwa mbere, bamwe mu barokotse bakusanyirijwe ahitwa i Gakera, munsi y'umusozi wa Rubona, bizezwa ko ubwicanyi buzahagarara, nyuma bongera kugabwaho ibitero baricwa mu ntangiriro za Gicurasi 1994. Ibigereranyo bivuga ko abakozi ba ISAR Rubona n'ababo bagera kuri mirongo irindwi biciwe aha hantu, mu gihe umubare wose w'abishwe, harimo n'impunzi zaturutse mu makomini aturanye, ari munini kandi bigoye kuwumenya.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yatabururwe aha hantu no mu nkengero zaho yagiye ihurizwa hamwe mu mva rusange y'urwibutso rwa Rubona. Iyo raporo ivuga ko hashyinguwe abantu bagera ku 120 bamenyekanye, mu gihe indi mibiri itaraboneka ikiri mu mva rusange cyangwa mu bishanga.
Buri mwaka, Ikigo RAB n'abarokotse bategura imihango yo kwibuka muri icyo gihe cya "Kwibuka". Iyo mihango kandi iba umwanya wo kwibutsa imanza zaciriwe bamwe mu bahoze ari abayobozi ba ISAR Rubona, nka Venant Rutunga, woherejwe n'u Buholandi akaburanishirizwa mu Rwanda kubera uruhare rwe mu bwicanyi bwabereye aha hantu.
Urwibutso rwa Rubona ruri ku buso bungana na hegitari 0,1 mu kigo cy'ubushakashatsi, rukagira imva rusange n'ikimenyetso cy'urwibutso byerekana aho abazize Jenoside baruhukiye. Ni ahantu imiryango y'abazize Jenoside, abarokotse bo mu karere ka Huye n'abakozi b'urwego rw'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda bazira kunamira bagenzi babo biciwe mu 1994.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ruhashya ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Ruhashya, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Ruhashya, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo. Ruri ku rutonde rw'inzibutso za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Ruhashya ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Ruhashya ruri mu hantu ho kwibukira hashyizweho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, kugira ngo habungabungwe urwibutso rw'abayizize bo mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Butare, ubu iri mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo.
Mu 2006, itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda ryavuze ku muhango wo kwibuka wabereye ku rwibutso rwa Ruhashya, aho abarokotse batanze ubuhamya ku bugome bakorewe muri Jenoside.
Muri Mata 2011, imibiri 122 y'abazize Jenoside yashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rwa Ruhashya, mu mihango yateguwe mu Akarere ka Huye.
Aha hantu hari imishinga yo kuhasana no kuhagura. Mu 2023, Akarere ka Huye kasohoye isoko ryo gusana no kwagura urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ruhashya.
Jenoside i Ruhashya.
Jenoside i Ruhashya yaranzwe no kuva ku kwirwanaho kwa mbere ikagera ku bwicanyi buteguwe. Mu cyahoze ari Komini Ruhashya, ubu iri mu Akarere ka Huye, ubwicanyi bwatangiye ahagana ku wa 22 Mata 1994. Burugumesitiri Martin Rudakubana ngo yabanje kugerageza kurwanya ibitero byibasiraga Abatutsi, nyuma ahindura imyitwarire nyuma y'inama yabereye i Butare ku wa 19 Mata 1994, ayigarukamo yambaye imyenda ya gisirikare. Abatutsi bahungiye ahantu hatandukanye, harimo ku biro bya Komini Ruhashya, muri ISAR Songa, muri ISAR Rubona, ku musozi wa Rubaba, i Mwendo n'i Rugogwe. I Rubaba, amatsinda amwe yagerageje kwirwanaho mbere y'uko abajandarume baza kurasa ku mpunzi.
Ubwicanyi bwakozwe mu byiciro bitandukanye hagati ya tariki ya 21 Mata 1994 n'impera z'ukwezi kwa Mata. Abatutsi bari bahungiye i Rubaba bishwe ku wa 21 Mata 1994, abari ku biro bya komini ya Ruhashya bicwa ku wa 24 na 25 Mata 1994, naho abari bahungiye muri ISAR Songa bicwa ku wa 28 Mata 1994. Ibitero byagabwe n'Interahamwe n'amatsinda yaturutse mu turere dutandukanye duturanye, harimo icyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gikongoro, Maraba, Rusatira na Kinyamakara. Raporo yerekeye Huye ivuga kandi uruhare rwa Aloys Simba mu bitero byagabwe ku Batutsi bari bahungiye muri Komini Ruhashya, cyane cyane i Rugogwe n'i Gashoba.
Ikindi cyihariye kuri Ruhashya ni uko ahantu hiciwe abantu hari hatatanye. Abatutsi ntibiciwe gusa aho bari bahungiye ari benshi, ahubwo bicirwaga no kuri bariyeri zashyizwe mu masantere no ku mihanda, nka bariyeri za Rwaniro, Mwogo, kwa Godefroid Ngenzi no kwa Rukundo. Ibyo bisobanura impamvu mu Murenge wa Ruhashya w'ubu hari ahantu henshi ho kwibukira, harimo inzibutso za Ruhashya, Mwendo na ISAR Songa.
Urwibutso ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kunamira no kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso z'igihugu zakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Songa ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri i Songa, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri hafi y'ikigo cya ISAR Songa. Muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi bahahungiye. Ku wa 28 Mata 1994, abajandarume n'Interahamwe babagabyeho igitero gikomeye. Abantu bake gusa ni bo barokotse.
Urwibutso ruri ku muhanda ugana i Butare. Ruri mu majyepfo y'igihugu, mu Akarere ka Huye.
Ikigo cy'Ubushakashatsi mu by'Ubuhinzi mu Rwanda (ISAR) cyari gifite ishami i Songa. Mu 1994, Songa yari muri Superefegitura ya Nyabisindu. Ubu ni mu Karere ka Huye.
Urwibutso rwa Songa ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu ntangiriro za Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi bahungiye muri ISAR Songa. Bizeraga ko ikigo cya Leta kizabarinda. Umubare wabo wageze ku bantu bagera ku 3 400.
Tharcisse Sinzi yari umwarimu wa karate. Yakoraga muri Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda i Butare. Na we yahungiye muri ISAR Songa. Guhera ku wa 13 Mata, yayoboye impunzi mu kwirwanaho.
Ubwicanyi bwo ku wa 28 Mata 1994.
Ku wa 27 Mata 1994, kajugujugu ya gisirikare yaje kugenzura aho hantu. Bukeye bwaho, ku wa 28 Mata, impunzi zagabweho igitero gikomeye. Abagabye igitero bari abajandarume, abasirikare n'Interahamwe. Bamwe mu bajandarume baturutse i Nyanza.
Abagabye igitero bakoresheje intwaro ziremereye na gerenade. Abagabo benshi barishwe. Abagore benshi bafashwe ku ngufu. Mu mpunzi zisaga 3 000, abantu 118 gusa ni bo bageze i Burundi ari bazima.
Uruhare n'ubutabera.
Philippe Hategekimana yari umwofisiye muto wa Jandarumeri y'i Nyanza. Yari afite ipeti rya Adjudant-chef. Yitwaga «Biguma». Mu Bufaransa, yaje kwitwa Philippe Manier. Ubushinjacyaha bwamushinje kuyobora no kugira uruhare mu bwicanyi bwo muri ISAR Songa.
Ku wa 28 Kamena 2023, Urukiko rwa Rubanda (Cour d'assises) rw'i Paris rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Yajuririye icyo cyemezo. Mu rubanza rw'ubujurire, abarokotse ISAR Songa batanze ubuhamya. Ku wa 17 Ukuboza 2024, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje igifungo cya burundu.
Charles Ndereyehe yari umuyobozi wa ISAR. Ashinjwa gutegura ubwicanyi bw'abakozi b'Abatutsi n'impunzi. Ashinjwa kandi gukoresha imodoka z'ikigo mu gutwara abicanyi.
Urwibutso ni ahantu ho kunamira no kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Rukoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwibuka no kwigisha amateka, harimo gusura aho hantu n'imihango yo "Kwibuka".

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa UNR Butare ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri mu kigo cya Huye cya Kaminuza y'u Rwanda, mu Akarere ka Huye, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwibuka abanyeshuri, abarimu n'abakozi ba Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda (UNR) bishwe mu 1994. Ubwicanyi muri kaminuza bwatangiye ku wa 20 n'uwa 21 Mata 1994.
Urwibutso ruri mu kigo cya Huye cya Kaminuza y'u Rwanda. Ruri hafi y'irembo ry'ikigo. Ruri mu Murenge wa Ngoma. Mu 1994, aho hantu hari muri Komini Ngoma, muri Perefegitura ya Butare.
Urwibutso rwa UNR Butare ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda.
Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda (UNR) yashinzwe i Butare mu 1963. Muri Gashyantare 1973, abanyeshuri n'abakozi b'Abatutsi birukanwe muri kaminuza. Mu 1994, kaminuza yarasahuwe.
Ubwicanyi bwo mu 1994.
Ku wa 19 Mata 1994, Perezida w'inzibacyuho Théodore Sindikubwabo yavugiye ijambo i Butare. Muri iryo jambo, yashishikarije Abahutu kwica Abatutsi.
Ubwicanyi muri kaminuza bwatangiye ku wa 20 n'uwa 21 Mata 1994. Abanyeshuri, abarimu n'abakozi b'Abatutsi barishwe. Bamwe mu banyeshuri n'abarimu b'Abahutu b'intagondwa bagize uruhare mu bwicanyi. Bafashije gukora urutonde rw'Abatutsi bagenzi babo. Mu buhamya, havugwamo abantu icyenda, barimo Sosthène Munyemana. Muri kaminuza, abanyeshuri bishe abanyeshuri bagenzi babo. Abarimu na bo bishe abarimu bagenzi babo.
Ishingwa ry'urwibutso.
Mu 1995, abarokotse bagarutse muri kaminuza. Bashyinguye mu cyubahiro abari bari mu mva rusange. Babifashijwemo n'ubuyobozi bwa kaminuza, AERG na AGEUNR.
Guhera mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1990, Leta y'u Rwanda yashyizeho politiki yo kwibuka. Iyo politiki igamije kumenya ahabereye ubwicanyi no gushyingura abazize Jenoside mu cyubahiro. Ikigo cya kaminuza cya Butare kiri ku rutonde rw'ahantu habereye Jenoside.
Ku wa 21 Mata 2012, imibiri y'abantu 15 yashyinguwe mu rwibutso. Yari yakuwe mu mva rusange iri hafi y'icumbi ry'abanyeshuri b'abahungu.
Imibiri ishyinguwe hakurikijwe amashami ya kaminuza na serivisi abazize bakoragamo. Umubare w'abashyinguwe aho ntuvugwaho rumwe. Raphaël Nkaka avuga imibiri 422. KT Press ivuga imibiri 565. Kaminuza y'u Rwanda ivuga abantu barenga 450 bo mu muryango wayo.
Buri mwaka, mu gihe cyo "Kwibuka", kaminuza itegura imihango yo kwibuka kuri urwo rwibutso.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kayonza-Mukarange ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haherereye mu Murenge wa Mukarange, mu Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ruhurije hamwe imibiri y'Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi biciwe mu nsengero no mu duce two mu karere ka Kayonza muri Mata 1994.
Urwibutso ruri ku musozi wa Mukarange, hafi y'umujyi wa Kayonza, ku muhanda Kigali–Kayonza–Kagitumba, mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Ruri mu nzibutso za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi zabaruwe ku mugaragaro n'inzego z'ubuyobozi bw'u Rwanda.
Imibiri ishyinguye i Kayonza-Mukarange yavanywe mu Murenge wa Mukarange no mu nkengero zawo mu Karere ka Kayonza, aho Abatutsi benshi bari bahungiye mu nsengero zitandukanye no ku nyubako za Leta muri Mata 1994.
Muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi bo mu karere ka Kayonza bahungiye mu nsengero za Paruwasi Gatolika ya Mukarange no mu zindi nsengero zari hafi aho, nyuma y'uko ubwicanyi butangira mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo. Ku wa 12 Mata 1994, mu gitondo, Interahamwe zateye Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Paruwasi ya Mukarange. Abatutsi barenga 5 000 bahiciwe uwo munsi. Inyandiko z'ubucamanza n'iz'amateka zivuga uruhare rwa burugumesitiri Jean-Baptiste Gatete mu gukangurira Interahamwe n'abasirikare kugaba ibitero ku mpunzi i Kiziguro n'i Mukarange.
Ku wa 11 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu rusengero rw'Abangilikani rwa Midiho, mu Kagari ka Nyagatovu (Umurenge wa Mukarange), bishwe nyuma y'igitero cy'Interahamwe zo muri ako gace; imibiri yabo ntiyose yabonetse. Mu minsi yakurikiyeho, Paruwasi Gatolika ya Mukarange yabereyemo ubwicanyi bukomeye, aho impunzi ibihumbi zishwe n'Interahamwe n'abasirikare bari bagose aho hantu.
Nyuma y'uko Jenoside ihagarara muri Nyakanga 1994, inzego z'ibanze n'imiryango y'abarokotse, cyane cyane Ibuka yo muri ako karere, bateguye igikorwa cyo gutaburura buhoro buhoro imva rusange no gushyingura abazize Jenoside ahantu hamwe i Mukarange. Mu 2011, habaye umuhango wo gushyingura mu cyubahiro abazize Jenoside bagera kuri 850, imibiri yabo ikaba yarabonetse mu mirenge itandukanye ya Kayonza ikimurirwa i Mukarange.
Mu myaka ya 2010, ibikorwa nk'ibyo byo gushakisha no kongera gushyingura imibiri y'abazize Jenoside byakozwe i Mukarange no mu yandi makomini y'akarere, bituma umubare w'abashyinguye mu rwibutso ugenda wiyongera. Inkuru z'itangazamakuru zivuga abazize Jenoside ibihumbi, bamwe bakagereranya ko abashyinguye aha hantu barenga 9 000. Mu 2023, urwibutso rwari rushyinguyemo imibiri irenga 8 700. Ni rwo runini mu nzibutso zirindwi z'Akarere ka Kayonza.
Guhera mu mpera z'imyaka ya 2010, imishinga yo kwagura no kuvugurura urwibutso yatewe inkunga muri gahunda z'ishoramari rya Leta. Inyandiko z'ingengo y'imari za Minisiteri y'Imari n'Igenamigambi zivuga ibyiciro bitandukanye byo kubaka «inzu y'amateka» n'ibindi bikorwa ku rwibutso rwa Mukarange. Mu 2020, itangazamakuru ryavuze imirimo yo kunoza urwibutso nyamukuru rw'Akarere ka Kayonza, ruri i Mukarange. Mu 2022, Akarere ka Kayonza katangiye kuvugurura urwibutso. Imirimo yagenewe miliyoni 700 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda. Inyubako nshya igeretse ifite ishusho y'icumu. Icumu ni imwe mu ntwaro zakoreshejwe mu bwicanyi. Iyo nyubako irimo ibiro n'imurikabikorwa ku mateka ya Jenoside mu yahoze ari amakomini ya Kabarondo, Muhazi, Rukara na Kayonza.
Buri mwaka urwibutso rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" ku rwego rw'Akarere ka Kayonza, yitabirwa n'abarokotse, imiryango itari iya Leta, amashuri n'inzego za Leta. Ku wa 12 Mata 2026, mu muhango wo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 32, hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro imibiri 27.
Urwibutso rugizwe n'imva rusange zipfundikishijwe amabuye, ahantu ho kunamira, amabuye y'urwibutso n'inyubako igenewe imurikabikorwa rihoraho ku mateka ya Jenoside mu Karere ka Kayonza. Urutonde rw'amazina y'abazize Jenoside rugenda rwuzuzwa hifashishijwe ubuhamya bw'abarokotse n'ubushakashatsi bwa Ibuka n'inzego z'ibanze.
Hategurwa ingendo-shuri z'abanyeshuri n'intumwa z'inzego za Leta, baza kumva ubuhamya bw'abarokotse no gutekereza ku bijyanye no kwibuka, ubutabera n'ubwiyunge mu Rwanda.
Inzibutso z'Akarere ka Kayonza.
Mu ntangiriro za 2023, Akarere ka Kayonza kari gafite inzibutso za Jenoside zirindwi. Zari zishyinguyemo imibiri irenga 25 000. Muri uwo mwaka, akarere kemerewe gusigarana inzibutso eshanu.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamirama ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, haherereye i Nyamirama, mu Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamirama ruri mu Murenge wa Nyamirama, mu Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Umurenge wa Nyamirama ni umwe mu mirenge igize Akarere ka Kayonza.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamirama ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamirama ni rumwe mu nzibutso, imva rusange n'ahantu ho kwibukira bifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Urwibutso rwahariwe kwibuka Abatutsi biciwe mu gace ka Nyamirama muri Jenoside yo mu 1994. Nk'uko raporo ya Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) ibivuga, ubwicanyi bwabereye mu Murenge wa Nyamirama no mu duce duturanye twa Ruramira na Nyarusange hagati ya tariki ya 9 na 17 Mata 1994. Iyo raporo ivuga ko Abatutsi ibihumbi bajugunywe mu rugomero ruri hagati ya Nyamirama na Ruramira.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamirama rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe mu Murenge wa Nyamirama no ku nkengero z'urugomero ruri hagati ya Nyamirama na Ruramira. Rwibutsa ubugome bwakorewe Abatutsi muri iki gice cy'icyahoze ari Kibungo mu byumweru bya mbere bya Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Jenoside mu Murenge wa Nyamirama yaranzwe n'ubwicanyi bwatangiye kare n'umugambi wo gusibanganya ibimenyetso by'ibyaha. Guhera ku wa 9 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku misozi ya Nyamirama baribasiwe baricwa. Ahantu h'ingenzi hiciwe abantu habonetse mu Kagari ka Kabuye, inyuma y'Urukiko rwa Kanto. Ku bijyanye no guhisha ibimenyetso, byanditswe ko «muri Segiteri Nyamirama, Selire Kabuye, inyuma y'Urukiko rwa Kanto, imibiri yahambwe mu cyobo, maze abantu benshi bishwe baratwikwa kugira ngo hasibangane ibimenyetso byose».
Abakoze Jenoside, bayobowe na konseye Paul Gakwavu n'uwitwa Murego, batwitse imibiri kugira ngo «basibanganye ibimenyetso byose». Ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside yakomeje kugaragara muri uwo murenge igihe kirekire nyuma y'ibyo byaha: mu 2014, mu ishuri ryo muri ako gace havuzwe ibikorwa byo gutoteza abarokotse n'amagambo abakomeretsa, bigaragaza ko bamwe mu barimu bagize uruhare mu gukwirakwiza urwo rwango.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukira ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye i Rukira, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Rukira, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Urwibutso rwa Rukira ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Rukira rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Umurenge wa Rukira uri hafi ya Nyarubuye, ahandi hantu h'ingenzi habereye ubwicanyi mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda.
Nk'uko ubuhamya bwakusanyirijwe ku rwibutso rwa Nyarubuye bubivuga, abaturage b'i Nyarubuye bari bamenye ko ubwicanyi bwari bwatangiye i Rukira mbere y'uko bugera iwabo.
Mu 2003, urukiko rwo mu Rwanda rwaburanishirije i Rukira rwakatiye abantu cumi n'umunani kubera ibyaha bya Jenoside byakorewe mu gace ka Nyarubuye na Rukira. Ibihano byatanzwe byari hagati y'imyaka myinshi y'igifungo n'igifungo cya burundu.
Urwibutso ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kunamira no kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Rufitanye isano n'urwibutso rw'ubwicanyi bwakorewe mu Murenge wa Rukira no mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo.
Ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso z'igihugu zakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" n'ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihakana n'ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Rukumberi ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Rukumberi, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda.
Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside irenga 40 000, iruhukiye mu mva rusange.
Urwibutso ruri rwagati mu Murenge wa Rukumberi, mu cyaro cy'Akarere ka Ngoma, mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Ruri mu gace k'imisozi n'ibishanga ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Mugesera n'ibibaya bikunze kurengerwa n'amazi, aho imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yagiye iboneka uko imyaka yagiye ihita.
Urwibutso rwa Rukumberi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Umurenge wa Rukumberi ni umwe mu mirenge cumi n'ine igize Akarere ka Ngoma, hamwe na Gashanda, Jarama, Karembo, Kazo, Kibungo, Mugesera, Murama, Mutenderi, Remera, Rukira, Rurenge, Sake na Zaza. Guhera mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1950 no mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1960, imiryango y'Abatutsi yaturutse mu tundi duce tw'igihugu yimuriwe ku gahato ituzwa muri aka gace kari kitaruye, karangwaga n'ibishanga byuzuyemo isazi ya tsetse n'ibyago byo kurwara indwara y'ibitotsi. Iyo politiki yagize uruhare mu guheza Abatutsi bari batujwe i Rukumberi no guhungabanya imibereho yabo igihe kirekire.
Nyuma ya 1994, Leta y'u Rwanda yagiye ishyiraho urusobe rw'inzibutso zigenewe guhuriza hamwe imibiri y'abazize Jenoside no kuba ahantu ho kwigira no kunamira. Urwibutso rwa Rukumberi ruri muri izo nzibutso ziri mu ntara zitandukanye z'u Rwanda.
Muri Jenoside yo mu 1994, Abatutsi b'i Rukumberi bibasiwe n'Interahamwe n'amatsinda yitwaje intwaro yashyigikiwe n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze. Ubwicanyi bwageze ku ndunduro ahagana ku wa 16 Mata 1994; itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda rivuga ko hafi ya bose mu Batutsi bo muri ako gace bishwe.
Mu myaka yakurikiye Jenoside, i Rukumberi hashyizwe ahantu ho gushyingura abantu benshi hamwe, hagenewe imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yabonekaga mu bishanga no mu mazu yatawe. Guhera mu myaka ya 2010, hakozwe ibikorwa byo gutaburura imibiri mu nkengero, cyane cyane ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Mugesera, bituma havumburwa izindi mva rusange, imibiri ikongera gushyingurwa mu rwibutso.
Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2019, inzego z'ubuyobozi zatangaje ko imibiri y'abazize Jenoside irenga 40 000 igiye kwimurirwa no gushyingurwa mu rwibutso rushya rw'i Rukumberi, rwubatswe kugira ngo babone aho gushyingurwa mu cyubahiro kurushaho, n'ibikorwaremezo bikwiye imihango yo kwibuka. Ku wa 20 Gicurasi 2019, umuhango wateguwe ku rwego rw'Akarere ka Ngoma waranze ishyingurwa ry'iyo mibiri mu mva zateguwe ku rwibutso rwa Rukumberi, witabirwa n'abarokotse, abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze n'intumwa zaturutse mu tundi duce tw'u Rwanda.
Kuva icyo gihe, ibigo bya Leta n'iby'abikorera bigira uruhare mu kubungabunga no kuvugurura urwibutso. Mu 2022, isosiyete AOS Limited yatanze ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi kandi yifatanya n'abakozi bayo mu mihango yo kwibuka yabereye aho hantu. Ibikorwa byo gutaburura imibiri bikomeje mu Murenge wa Rukumberi, cyane cyane nyuma yo kubona amagufwa ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Mugesera cyangwa hafi y'amasambu y'abakoze Jenoside, kugira ngo imibiri yimurirwe mu rwibutso.
Urwibutso rwa Rukumberi rugizwe n'imva rusange zubakishijwe amatafari, ikibuga cyo gukoreramo imihango yo kunamira n'amabuye y'urwibutso menshi yibutsa amateka y'Abatutsi bimuriwe muri aka gace nyuma bakicwa mu 1994. Rwakira buri mwaka imihango yo "Kwibuka", ingendo-shuri z'abanyeshuri n'ibikorwa by'umuganda bitegurwa n'inzego z'ibanze, imiryango y'abarokotse n'ibigo bitandukanye byo mu Rwanda.
Inkuru z'itangazamakuru zigaragaza Rukumberi nk'ahantu habera ibikorwa by'ubwiyunge hagati y'abarokotse n'abakoze ibyaha, binyuze mu nama rusange n'imihango aho abarokotse bababarira abakoze Jenoside bicuza.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Zaza ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri i Zaza, mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside bo mu mirenge myinshi. Muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi barenga 1 000 biciwe kuri paruwasi ya Zaza.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Zaza, mu Karere ka Ngoma. Ako karere kari mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Mu Karere ka Ngoma hari izindi nzibutso za Jenoside. Muri zo harimo Kibungo-Ngoma, Rukira na Rukumberi.
Urwibutso rwa Zaza ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Zaza yari mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibungo.
Ubwicanyi bwo kuri paruwasi ya Zaza.
Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana amaze gupfa, ubwicanyi bwatangiye muri ako gace. Ku wa 8 Mata 1994, abarokotse ubwicanyi bw'i Sake bageze kuri paruwasi ya Zaza. Abatutsi benshi bahungiye muri kiliziya. Bizeraga ko bazahabona umutekano.
Abicanyi bari Interahamwe za MRND n'Impuzamugambi za CDR. Bari bagera kuri 400. Bari barateguwe n'umudepite wa MRND Sylvain Mutaruka. Ingabo za Leta zarabashyigikiye. Abicanyi bari bafite urutonde rw'abagombaga kwicwa.
Abicanyi binjiye muri kiliziya. Bahiciye nibura abantu 600. Abarokotse bahungiye mu Iseminari Nto ya Zaza. Abicanyi bongeye kubatera. Abantu batandatu gusa ni bo barokotse: abapadiri bane n'abahungu babiri.
Inkomoko ntizivuga amatariki amwe. L'Humanité ivuga ko ubwicanyi bwatangiye ku cyumweru tariki ya 9 Mata. AllAfrica ivuga ko bwabaye hagati ya tariki ya 10 n'iya 11 Mata 1994. Ivuga ko Abatutsi barenga 1 000 bahiciwe. Ubwo bwicanyi bwagizwemo uruhare n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze.
Nyuma ya 1994, imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yataburuwe mu mirenge myinshi. Iyo mibiri yashyinguwe i Zaza. Imibiri myinshi yavuye mu mirenge ya Mugesera, Gashanda, Karembo na Zaza. Imihango yo kwibuka ihabera nibura kuva mu myaka ya 2000.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 2010, Akarere ka Ngoma kateganyije imirimo yo kurangiza no kuvugurura urwibutso.
Urwibutso rwa Zaza ni ahantu ho kunamira abazize Jenoside. Ni n'ahantu ho kubashyingura mu cyubahiro no kwigisha amateka ya Jenoside. Buri mwaka, imihango yo "Kwibuka" ihabera.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamishaba ni ahantu ho kwibukira no gushyingura abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye mu Murenge wa Mubuga, mu Akarere ka Karongi, mu Rwanda.
Urwibutso ruri mu Murenge wa Mubuga, mu Akarere ka Karongi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba. Ruri ku nkombe z'Ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu gace k'icyahoze ari Ishuri ry'Ubuhinzi n'Amashyamba rya Nyamishaba, rikunze kwitwa EAFO Nyamishaba.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamishaba ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kunamira, kubika amateka no kwibuka. Inzibutso enye za Jenoside zo mu Rwanda ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamishaba rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibuye muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Icyahoze ari ishuri rya EAFO Nyamishaba kivugwa mu hantu hiciwe Abatutsi, barimo abakozi, abanyeshuri n'abaturage bari bahahungiye. Bamwe mu bishwe bajugunywe mu Ikiyaga cya Kivu.
Mu Karere ka Karongi hategurwa imihango yo kwibuka abiciwe mu cyahoze ari ETO Kibuye no muri EAFO Nyamishaba.
Ubwicanyi bwa Nyamishaba buvugwa kandi mu manza zijyanye na Jenoside. Mu 2026, mu rubanza rw'ubujurire rwa Claude Muhayimana mu Bufaransa, abatangabuhamya bavuze ku bwicanyi bwabereye i Nyamishaba ku wa 15 Mata 1994, ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Kivu. Itangazamakuru ryavuze kandi ko Claude Muhayimana yakatiwe mu bujurire igifungo cy'imyaka cumi n'ine kubera ubufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu, mu rubanza rujyanye no gutwara Interahamwe azijyana ahantu hatandukanye habereye ubwicanyi mu gace ka Kibuye.
Urwibutso rwa Nyamishaba rufitanye isano n'ubwicanyi bwakorewe hafi y'icyahoze ari Ishuri ry'Ubuhinzi n'Amashyamba EAFO Nyamishaba, ubu riri muri IPRC Karongi. Nk'uko IPRC Karongi ibivuga, abakozi, abanyeshuri b'icyahoze ari EAFO Nyamishaba n'Abatutsi bari bahahungiye bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994; benshi mu bishwe nyuma bajugunywe mu kiyaga cya Kivu.
Ubuhamya bwatanzwe mu mihango yo kwibuka bwerekana ko ibitero byatangiye i Nyamishaba ku wa 15 Mata 1994. Abari bahungiye mu nyubako za EAFO bakuwe aho bari bihishe, bajyanwa ku kiyaga baricwa; bamwe bakurikiranywe n'ubwato igihe bageragezaga kurokoka boga. Abarokotse bashinja kandi bamwe mu banyeshuri n'abakozi b'icyo kigo kuba baragize uruhare mu kwerekana abari bihishe no kubajyana aho biciwe.
Aha hantu hafite umwihariko wo gushyingura kubera ikiyaga cya Kivu. IPRC Karongi ivuga ko mu rwibutso rwa Nyamishaba haruhukiye Abatutsi barenga 3 000, mu gihe umubare w'abajugunywe mu kiyaga utazwi. Muri Kanama 2024, imibiri 18 y'abazize Jenoside yabonetse ku nkombe z'ikiyaga cya Kivu, hafi y'icyahoze ari EAFO Nyamishaba; yajyanywe mu rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gatwaro kugira ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro.
Urwibutso rwatoranyijwe mu nzibutso zizagumaho muri gahunda yo guhuriza hamwe inzibutso zo mu Akarere ka Karongi. Mu 2026, itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda ryavuze ko Nyamishaba igomba kugumaho kubera agaciro kayo muri ako gace n'umubare w'imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yabonetse mu kiyaga cya Kivu. Ibyo bijyanye na politiki y'igihugu yo kubungabunga ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, iteganywa n'amategeko y'u Rwanda agenga imihango yo kwibuka.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarushishi ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, haherereye ku misozi ya Nyarushishi, hafi ya Cyangugu, mu Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba.
Ruhurije hamwe imibiri y'abazize Jenoside ibihumbi yataburuwe mu mirenge itandukanye y'akarere, ishyingurwa mu rwibutso no mu mva rusange.
Urwibutso ruri ku misozi ya Nyarushishi, hafi y'umujyi wa Cyangugu n'Ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda. Aha hantu hari mu Akarere ka Rusizi, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba.
Urwibutso rwa Nyarushishi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Nyarushishi ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso zashyizweho mu Rwanda nyuma ya 1994, rwahuzwaga na Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG, ubu ni MINUBUMWE). Zimwe muri izo nzibutso zashyizwe ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO, nka Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero.
Inkambi y'impunzi yo mu 1994.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abayobozi n'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wa Croix-Rouge bakusanyirije i Nyarushishi Abatutsi ibihumbi bo muri Perefegitura ya Cyangugu, bavanywe ahantu nka sitade Kamarampaka. Ibigereranyo bivuga ko abantu bari hagati ya 8 000 na hafi 12 000 bakusanyirijwe muri iyo nkambi hagati ya Mata na Nzeri 1994.
Inkambi yabaye imwe mu ntego z'ingenzi z'Opération Turquoise, igikorwa cya gisirikare cy'Ubufaransa cyemejwe n'icyemezo nimero 929 cy'Akanama k'Umutekano k'Umuryango w'Abibumbye. Imitwe ya Légion étrangère yafashe inkambi mu mpera za Kamena 1994 kugira ngo irinde impunzi, nyuma y'aho imva rusange zivumbuwe mu gace ka Nyarushishi. Itangazamakuru n'ubushakashatsi bumwe bigaragaza ko kuba ingabo z'Ubufaransa zari muri iyo nkambi bitavugwaho rumwe, bijyanye n'impaka ku ruhare rwa Opération Turquoise n'ibirego by'ihohoterwa, harimo no gufata ku ngufu, bamwe mu basirikare bakoreye abagore b'impunzi.
Ishyirwaho ry'urwibutso.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, ahantu ha Nyarushishi hatoranyijwe kugira ngo hashyirwe urwibutso n'imva rusange zigenewe abazize Jenoside bo mu Karere ka Rusizi. Imihango yo gushyingura abantu benshi icyarimwe yatangiye kuhabera guhera mu myaka ya 2000, imibiri yabonetse mu makomini atandukanye igenda yimurirwayo.
Mu 2014, Akarere ka Rusizi kongeye gutangiza imirimo yo kubaka urwibutso runini, gatangaza ingengo y'imari igera kuri miliyoni 50 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda yo kubaka «inzu ndangamurage-rwibutso» igezweho no kuvugurura igishushanyo cya mbere cy'aho hantu.
Muri Kamena 2018, mu muhango wo gushyingura wabereye i Nyarushishi, abazize Jenoside barenga 3 500 bataburuwe mu mva zari zitatanye muri ako gace bashyinguwe mu cyubahiro.
Kwibuka n'imikoreshereze y'ubu.
Urwibutso rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka" mu Karere ka Rusizi, irimo amajoro yo kwibuka, gushyira indabo ku mva n'ubuhamya bw'abarokotse. Aha hantu hakoreshwa kandi nk'ahantu ho kwigira ku mashuri yo muri ako gace no ku bashyitsi baturutse mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, mu ngendo zo kwibuka zitegurwa ku bufatanye n'imiryango y'abarokotse n'inzego z'ibanze.
Urwibutso rwa Nyarushishi rufitanye isano ya hafi n'amateka y'inkambi y'impunzi yo mu 1994, yabaye ku isonga mu mpaka ku bikorwa by'Ubufaransa n'umuryango mpuzamahanga muri Jenoside. Imihango ibera aha hantu ihuza kwibuka abahashyinguye no gutekereza kuri icyo gice cya Opération Turquoise.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Shangi rwibutsa ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi i Shangi, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke k'ubu, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba y'u Rwanda, muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Shangi rwubatswe iruhande rwa Paruwasi ya Shangi, mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke, mu Ntara y'Iburengerazuba, hafi y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu. Rubitse imibiri y'abiciwe kuri paruwasi no mu nkengero zayo.
Urwibutso rwa Shangi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Shangi ni rumwe mu nzibutso, imva rusange n'ahantu ho kwibukira biri mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, bifitanye isano na Jenoside yo mu 1994. Enye muri zo — Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi na Bisesero — ziri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Paruwasi Gatolika ya Shangi yari mu cyahoze ari Komini Gafunzo, muri Segiteri ya Shangi; ubu iri mu Akarere ka Nyamasheke. Itotezwa ry'Abatutsi ryaho ryatangiye kera, kuko ubugizi bwa nabi bwagaragaye kuva mu myaka ya 1960, harimo gutwika amazu no gufata abakirisitu bavaga mu misa ya Noheli kuri paruwasi. Guhera mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, mu gihe cy'intambara yatangijwe na FPR, iryo totezwa ryariyongereye. Nk'uko Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) ibivuga, abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze ba MRND na MDR bagize uruhare mu guheza Abatutsi: abize cyangwa abakoraga mu nzego za Leta birukanwe ku mirimo yabo, kandi Abahutu bashakanye n'Abatutsikazi bashyirwaho igitutu ngo babirukane. Mu 1993, Interahamwe za Gafunzo zatorejwe ku ruganda rw'icyayi rwa Shagasha, zifashijwe n'abayobozi b'ubutegetsi n'abasirikare bo muri Perefegitura ya Cyangugu.
Ibitero byo muri Mata 1994.
Guhera ku wa 8 Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi b'i Shangi no mu nkengero zaho bahungiye kuri paruwasi, bizeye kuharindirwa. Abantu ibihumbi, baturutse cyane cyane mu makomini ya Gafunzo na Gisuma, bahakusanyirijwe; bamwe ngo bahajyanywe cyangwa bategetswe kujyayo n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze. Icyo gihe kandi hashyizweho bariyeri muri ako gace, Interahamwe ziririmba indirimbo zikangurira gutsemba Abatutsi. Ibitero bya mbere ku mpunzi byabaye ku wa 12 na 13 Mata. Impunzi zari muri paruwasi zagerageje kwirwanaho zisubiza inyuma ibitero byinshi. Abagabye ibitero bakoresheje kandi amayeri yo kuzinaniza: bafunze amatiyo y'amazi ya paruwasi kugira ngo impunzi zicwe n'inyota, kandi abageragezaga kumanuka ku kiyaga cya Kivu kuvoma baricwaga.
Ku wa 14 Mata 1994, Interahamwe, cyane cyane iziturutse i Nyamirundi ziyobowe n'uwitwa Pima, zagabye igitero gikomeye. Mbere y'igitero, Interahamwe zanyuze kuri Komini Gafunzo gufata intwaro na za gerenade, zihabwa ku mabwiriza ya burugumesitiri Charles Karorero. Indi nkomoko yerekeye Jenoside mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu ivuga kandi igitero cyo ku wa 15 Mata cyayobowe na Epimaque Uburiyemuye, alias Pima, n'Interahamwe z'i Nyabitekeri, cyahitanye abantu barenga ijana bari bahungiye i Shangi.
Ku wa 18 Mata 1994, intumwa za perefegitura ziyobowe na superefe Théodore Munyangabe zakoranyije abakonseye bo muri ako gace, zibasaba gukora urutonde rw'Abatutsi bahunze ingo zabo n'aho bahungiye. Mu minsi yakurikiyeho, Padiri Aimé Mategeko, superefe Munyangabe n'abakozi ba komini bajyaga kenshi kuri paruwasi gukuramo abagabo bakuru, abahungu n'abize. Abo bantu batoranywaga bitwajwe ko bagombaga kubazwa i Kamembe ku bijyanye n'intwaro bivugwa ko bari bafite zo gutera Abahutu. Nta n'umwe mu bajyanywe wagarutse. Izindi nkuru zivuga ko hatoranyijwe abagabo mirongo ine na babiri b'abakomeye cyangwa abize, bajyanwa kuri sitade Kamarampaka nyuma baricwa, cyane cyane i Bushenge.
Nyuma y'igitero cyasubijwe inyuma ku wa 27 Mata, igitero gikomeye cyagabwe kuri paruwasi ku wa 29 Mata 1994. Cyayobowe n'Interahamwe za Yusufu Munyakazi, zaturutse i Bugarama mu makamyo menshi, zitwaje imihoro, amahiri, imbunda na za gerenade. Abagabye igitero bibasiye impunzi zari zikusanyirijwe muri kiliziya no mu nyubako za paruwasi. Nk'uko abarokotse babivuga, ubwicanyi bwakomeje kugeza ku mugoroba; abakobwa bari barokotse bahise bajyanwa gufatwa ku ngufu. Bukeye bwaho, Interahamwe zagarutse gusonga inkomere n'abari bakiri bazima. Imibiri yajugunywe mu cyobo kinini cyiswe «Croix-Rouge», cyari imisarane ya kera y'ishuri ribanza rya Shangi. Icyo cyobo kimaze kuzura, hacukuwe ibindi kugira ngo imibiri ihishwe kandi inyubako za paruwasi zisukurwe.
Abayobozi benshi bo muri ako gace bavugwa mu nkomoko zerekeye ubwicanyi bw'i Shangi. Théodore Munyangabe, ukomoka muri ako gace, avugwa nk'umwe mu bateguye ubwicanyi n'abatoranyije abicwa. Padiri Aimé Mategeko avugwa nk'uwagize uruhare mu kugambanira impunzi no mu bikorwa byatumye zicwa; nyuma yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu kubera icyaha cya Jenoside. Andi mazina avugwa mu nkomoko arimo burugumesitiri Charles Karorero, burigadiye wa komini Philippe Sekanyambo, Étienne Gatamobwa wari ukuriye CDR muri ako gace, na Siméon Nchamihigo, wari umushinjacyaha wungirije, uvugwa ko yagenzuraga ako gace kandi agatanga intwaro ku Nterahamwe.
Urwibutso rwa Shangi rwubatswe kugira ngo hunamirwe Abatutsi biciwe kuri paruwasi no mu nkengero zayo, cyane cyane mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu. Ruhurije hamwe imibiri y'abazize ubwicanyi bwakorewe aha hantu no muri ako gace barenga 4 000. Havugwa kandi ibikorwa byo kwirwanaho mu Murenge wa Shangi, cyane cyane i Mugera, aho umuryango w'Abatamu ngo wirwanyeho bikomeye mbere yo gutsembwa, hapfa abantu barenga 350 nk'uko inkomoko zerekeye ahantu habereye ubwicanyi mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Cyangugu zibivuga.
Ubu urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Shangi ni ahantu ho gushyingura, kunamira no kwigisha amateka, hagenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri uyu murenge. Kuba ruri hafi ya kiliziya aho impunzi nyinshi zari zahungiye muri Mata 1994 byibutsa uruhare paruwasi yagize nk'ubuhungiro, ibitero byagiye bihagabwa, n'uburyo bwakoreshejwe mu gutoranya, gutandukanya no gutsemba abazize Jenoside. Ruri mu rusobe rw'inzibutso zo mu Rwanda zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura, kwibuka no kwigisha.

Urwibutso rw'Abasirikare b'Ababiligi (mu Gifaransa: "Mémorial des gardiens de la paix Belges") ni urwibutso ruri mu kigo cyahoze ari icya gisirikare cya "Camp Kigali" i Kigali, mu Rwanda. Inkingi icumi zubatswe aho hantu zibutsa abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi b'ingabo za MINUAR bishwe ku wa 7 Mata 1994, igihe ubwicanyi bwatangiraga mu ntangiriro za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Uru rwibutso ni rumwe mu nzibutso zitubatswe ku kibanza rusange. Ni kimwe mu bibanza byinshi byo kwibuka biri mu Rwanda, byibutsa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Mu nzibutso z'igihugu harimo Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murambi, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ntarama, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali n'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyarubuye.
Mu Rwanda habarurwa ibibanza by'urwibutso birenga 250 byanditswe, byibutsa Jenoside.
Amateka n'imiterere y'ibihe.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1950, mu gihe cy'ubwigenge bw'ibihugu byinshi by'Afurika, u Rwanda rwaranzwe n'ubwiyongere bw'amakimbirane mu muryango n'urugomo rushingiye ku moko. Ibyo byakomeje na nyuma y'uko igihugu kibona ubwigenge ku Ububiligi mu 1962.
Muri Kanama 1993, kubera imbaraga z'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Afurika (OUA) n'iza guverinoma zo mu karere mu gushaka amahoro, isinywa ry'Amasezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha ryasaga n'irirangije intambara (yatangiye mu 1990) hagati ya guverinoma y'u Rwanda y'icyo gihe na FPR. Mu Ukwakira 1993, Akanama k'Umutekano ka Loni kashyizeho Ubutumwa bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye bwo gufasha u Rwanda (MINUAR), bwari bufite inshingano zo kubungabunga amahoro, gutanga ubufasha bw'ubutabazi no gushyigikira muri rusange inzira y'amahoro.
Ku wa 6 Mata 1994, urupfu rw'Abaperezida b'u Burundi n'u Rwanda, mu ndege yahanuwe na misile, rwabaye imbarutso ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yari imaze amezi menshi itegurwa. Abishwe bagereranywa na miliyoni imwe. Mu gihe kitageze ku isaha igice nyuma y'uko indege ihanuka, bariyeri zagenzurwaga n'abarwanyi b'Abahutu, akenshi bafashijwe na jandarumori cyangwa abasirikare, zarashyizweho kugira ngo zitahure Abatutsi zibice.
Ku wa 7 Mata, Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines (RTLM) yatangaje ikiganiro gishinja FPR n'abasirikare b'Ababiligi ba MINUAR kuba ari bo bahanuye indege, itangira gushishikariza Abahutu kurimbura «inyenzi z'Abatutsi». Nyuma y'aho kuri uwo munsi, Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana n'abasirikare 10 b'Ababiligi b'ingabo za Loni zishinzwe kubungabunga amahoro bari bashinzwe kumurinda bishwe bunyamaswa n'abasirikare ba guverinoma y'u Rwanda. Nyuma y'iyicwa ry'abasirikare bayo, Ububiligi bwafashe icyemezo cyo gucyura ingabo zabwo za Loni.
Uko byagenze ku wa 6 n'uwa 7 Mata 1994 ku ruhande rw'abasirikare ba 2e Commando.
Uko byagenze ku wa 6 n'uwa 7 Mata 1994 ku ruhande rw'abasirikare ba 2e Commando
6 Mata, saa 20:30: Indege yari igeze ku kibuga cy'indege cya Kigali, itwaye Perezida w'u Rwanda Juvénal Habyarimana na Perezida w'u Burundi Cyprien Ntaryamira, yahanuwe na misile zirasirwa ku butaka, hapfa kandi abaminisitiri babiri b'u Burundi, umugaba mukuru w'ingabo z'u Rwanda, abandi bayobozi n'abakozi b'indege b'Abafaransa.
Agahenge karahagaze mu buryo butunguranye. Ibihuha bikwirakwira ko Ababiligi ari bo bahanuye indege ya Perezida.
Saa 22:00: Hashyizweho komite ishinzwe ibibazo byihutirwa. Jenerali Roméo Dallaire, umuyobozi w'ingabo za MINUAR, ajya mu nama asangamo Koloneli Théoneste Bagosora, umuyobozi w'ibiro bya Minisitiri w'Ingabo. Icyifuzo cy'uko Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana, ubundi wari ku isonga mu murongo w'abasimbura, yageza ijambo ku gihugu, cyaranzwe.
7 Mata, saa 01:18: Nyamara, ku itegeko rya Jenerali Dallaire, umuyobozi wa MINUAR ushinzwe agace ka Kigali, Koloneli Luc Marchal, ashinga batayo ya 2 ya Commando y'Ababiligi guherekeza Minisitiri w'Intebe kuri Radiyo Rwanda no kurinda aho hantu. Yagombaga kugeza ijambo ku gihugu saa 05:30.
Liyetona-Koloneli Joseph Dewez, umuyobozi wa batayo, agaragaza gushidikanya kuri ubwo butumwa mu bihe byari bikomeye cyane.
Saa 02:16: Liyetona Thierry Lotin, wari ufite itsinda ry'abasirikare ba Mortiers ba batayo ya 2 ya Commando ku kibuga cy'indege n'amajipe yabo abiri bagiye gushyiramo lisansi, ahabwa ubwo butumwa. Agomba gufata amajipe ane (inshuro ebyiri z'iherekeza risanzwe).
Saa 03:19: Mu nzira ajya gusohoza ubwo butumwa, Liyetona Lotin ahagarikwa kuri bariyeri, kuri kilometero imwe gusa uvuye mu rugo rwa Minisitiri w'Intebe. Atakaza igihe kinini aganira kandi ategereje umusirikare w'u Rwanda ushinzwe guhuza ibikorwa utigeze uza.
Saa 05:12: Liyetona Lotin amaherezo ayoborwa mu wundi muhanda. Mu mujyi hose humvikana amasasu ahandi n'ahandi.
Saa 05:42: Amajipe y'itsinda rya Mortiers agera aho yagombaga kujya. Abasirikare bahura n'abasirikare batanu ba MINUAR bo muri Ghana n'abajandarume batanu b'Abanyarwanda bari bashinzwe umutekano wa Minisitiri w'Intebe. Ako kanya, abasirikare b'u Rwanda bafite imodoka z'intambara n'abarinzi ba Perezida bagota aho bari, barasa ku rugo.
Saa 05:47: Liyetona Lotin asuzuma uko ibintu bimeze. Ubutumwa bwo guherekeza Minisitiri w'Intebe kuri radiyo buhagarikwa. Itsinda rya Liyetona Lotin ntiryirwanaho, kuko abasirikare b'u Rwanda batari babarasaho. Liyetona-Koloneli Dewez na we ababwira kutarasa.
Saa 06:03: Itsinda rimenyesha ko amajipe yaryo yangijwe.
Saa 06:55: Abasirikare b'u Rwanda bategeka itsinda gushyira hasi intwaro no kwitanga. Liyetona-Koloneli Dewez agira inama Liyetona Lotin yo kutabikora, ahubwo agashaka ibiganiro.
Saa 07:00: Umuyobozi wa kompanyi ya 2e Commando, wari nko ku birometero bibiri uvuye mu rugo rwa Minisitiri w'Intebe, asaba gutabara n'itsinda ryongerewe imbaraga. Ubuyobozi bwa batayo bwanga icyo cyifuzo.
Saa 07:40: Minisitiri w'Intebe ahungira mu nzu yari hafi aho, aherekejwe n'abajandarume. Nyuma (saa 11:45), we n'umugabo we bavumbuwe n'itsinda ry'Abarinzi ba Perezida, baricwa.
Saa 08:44: Liyetona Lotin amenyesha ubugome bw'abasirikare b'u Rwanda bamukikije. Batayo ya 2 isaba amabwiriza Koloneli Marchal, wumvaga ibiganiro kuri radiyo ya batayo.
Saa 08:49: Liyetona-Koloneli Dewez asubiramo ko itsinda ridakwiye gushyira hasi intwaro, ariko bikaba byatinze: abasirikare bane bari bamaze kwamburwa intwaro no kuryamishwa hasi. Liyetona Lotin yitanga abyemerewe n'ubuyobozi bwa batayo n'ubw'agace.
Itsinda ry'Ababiligi n'abasirikare bo muri Ghana bafatwa mpiri na Majoro Bernard Ntuyahaga wo mu biro bikuru by'ingabo z'u Rwanda. Batwarwa muri minibisi.
Ahagana saa 09:00: Bagera i "Camp Kigali", ikigo cya gisirikare cy'u Rwanda kitari kure y'aho.
Akigerayo, Liyetona Lotin ahura na Kapiteni Kodjo Apedo, ku biro bya Loni byari hafi aho. Uwo kapiteni yari umusirikare wa MINUAR ukomoka muri Togo, ushinzwe guhuza ibikorwa muri icyo kigo.
Muri ako kanya, Majoro Ntuyahaga akwirakwiza ibihuha ko izo mfungwa z'Ababiligi ari zo zahanuye indege ya Perezida, akabyutsa uburakari bw'abasirikare b'u Rwanda bari aho. Imbaga yitwaje imigongo y'imbunda, amabuye n'imbunda, itangira gukubita no kwica izo mfungwa zitari zitwaje intwaro.
Saa 09:06: Liyetona abasha kuvugana bwa nyuma n'abamukuriye kugira ngo abamenyeshe ibibazo arimo, akoresheje radiyo ya kapiteni wo muri Togo.
Saa 09:08: Liyetona-Koloneli Dewez asaba ubuyobozi bw'agace ubufasha bwo gutabara. Koloneli Marchal amenyesha umwe mu bagize ibiro bya Jenerali Dallaire, asaba ko icyo kibazo kizaganirwaho n'abayobozi b'u Rwanda mu nama yari iteganyijwe saa 10:00.
Hagati aho, abasirikare bane ba Liyetona Lotin bapfa bazize inkoni n'ibyuma by'imbunda ("baïonnettes"). Abandi, bakomeretse bikabije, bacika iyo mbaga bagera kuri Liyetona Lotin mu biro bya Loni. Bafungirana imbere batangira kwirwanaho ngo barokore ubuzima bwabo.
Imyigaragambyo y'abasirikare ("mutinerie") i "Camp Kigali" iba yose igihe abasirikare b'u Rwanda bamena ububiko bw'intwaro bw'ikigo kugira ngo bitwaze intwaro. Ibiro birasirwaho cyane, maze undi musirikare wa Para-Commando w'Umubiligi arapfa.
Mu gihe igitero cyari gihagaze gato, Kapiteni Apedo n'abasirikare batanu bo muri Ghana bakurwa muri ibyo biro.
Mbere gato ya saa 10:00: Jenerali Dallaire ava ku cyicaro cye ajya mu nama. Amara isaha mu nzira. Amenyeshwa ikibazo kirebana n'abasirikare b'Ababiligi ba MINUAR.
Saa 10:40: Umusirikare w'u Rwanda ushaka kwinjira mu biro yamburwa intwaro akicwa na Liyetona Lotin wari wasigaranye pisitori ye. Habaho kurasana. Abasirikare b'u Rwanda barakomereka abandi barapfa.
Saa 10:50: Ajya mu nama, Jenerali Dallaire anyura imbere y'irembo rya "Camp Kigali", kuri metero 30 gusa uvuye aho ibyo byaberaga. Abona imirambo y'abasirikare ba MINUAR iri hasi. Ategeka ko imodoka ihagarara, ariko umushoferi we w'Umunyarwanda aranga, amubwira ko bari mu kaga kuko hari imyigaragambyo y'abasirikare.
Saa 10:55: Jenerali Dallaire agera aho inama yabereye, kuri metero 200 gusa uvuye aho ibyo byaberaga, ahahurira na Kapiteni Apedo n'abasirikare bo muri Ghana bari bemerewe kuva mu kigo. Bamumenyesha ibibera i "Camp Kigali". Igitangaje ni uko Jenerali Dallaire nta gikorwa na kimwe yakoze ngo akemure icyo kibazo. Ntiyanakivuzeho mu nama yamaze kugeza saa 12:15. Nk'uko yabyanditse mu gitabo cye "J'ai serré la main du diable", yageragezaga gusobanukirwa n'uko ibintu byari bimeze.
Ahagana saa 13:00: Ibyuka biryana mu maso n'ibisasu bya gerenade bijugunywa binyuze mu mwobo wo ku gisenge. Ibyo bishyira iherezo ku kwirwanaho gutangaje kw'aba Para-Commandos b'Ababiligi.
Nyuma ya saa sita, imirambo yabo yasahuwe kandi igacibwa ibice ijyanwa mu buruhukiro bw'ibitaro bya Kigali, igerekeranywa. Nimugoroba, Jenerali Dallaire ajya ku bitaro. Ntiyabasha kumenya umubare w'abasirikare be bapfuye.
Kwibuka Ababiligi bishwe.
Nk'uko bivugwa mu mwanzuro wa 2150 w'Akanama k'Umutekano k'Umuryango w'Abibumbye (wemejwe n'abagize akanama bose mu 2014), werekeye gukumira no kurwanya jenoside, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda yahitanye abantu bagera kuri miliyoni mu minsi 100. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, n'Abahutu n'abandi bantu barwanyaga jenoside barishwe.
Ububiligi bwo bubabazwa n'abantu 22 bwabuze: abasirikare 10 b'ingabo za Loni bari bashinzwe kurinda Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana (na we wishwe), n'abasivili 12 bishwe ahanini kubera ko bari Ababiligi.
Urutonde rw'Ababiligi 22 bishwe mu 1994.
Christine André | Bruno Bassinne | Claire Beckers-Bucyana | Katia Bucyana | Albert Craemers | Alain Debatty | Olivier Dulieu | Christophe Dupont | Michel Gigi | Antoine Godfriaux | Paul Kesenne | Yannick Leroy | Hélène Laveque | Stéphane Lhoir | Thierry Lotin | Bruno Meaux | Louis Plescia | Christophe Renwa | Annie Roland-Mugwaneza | Etienne Staelgraeve | Marc Uyttebroeck | Paul Van Vynckt
Icyapa cyo kwibuka cya guverinoma y'Ububiligi n'amabuye 10 yo kwibuka byashyizweho ku wa 7 Mata 2000 mu rwego rwo kwibuka abasirikare 10 b'Ababiligi bishwe i Kigali ku wa 7 Mata 1994, bari mu butumwa bw'amahoro mu Rwanda.
Icyubahiro cyahawe na guverinoma y'Ububiligi, ku wa 7 Mata 2000.
Uruhare rw'itangazamakuru ry'urwango.
Bagaragazwa nk'ibyitso bya FPR cyangwa nk'abagize uruhare mu iyicwa rya Perezida Habyarimana, Ababiligi bari mu banyamahanga bibasiwe cyane n'icengezamatwara ry'«itangazamakuru ry'urwango», cyane cyane Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines (RTLM) n'ikinyamakuru Kangura.
Itegurwa ry'itsembatsemba ry'Abatutsi ndetse n'umugambi wo kwibasira Ababiligi, cyane cyane abasirikare, byari byaramenyeshejwe muri «"Genocide Fax"». Iyo fagisi yoherejwe na Roméo Dallaire ku cyicaro cya Loni i New York ku wa 11 Mutarama 1994, hafi amezi atatu mbere y'uko Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi itangira. Ivuga ku kiganiro umwanditsi wayo yagiranye n'umuyobozi mu barwanyi b'Interahamwe wari uzi imigambi ya jenoside, kandi ni ikimenyetso cy'uko umuryango mpuzamahanga wananiwe gukumira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Ibice by'iyo «"Genocide Fax"» (mu Cyongereza):
Uruhare rw'Ububiligi n'ingaruka.
Muri Mata 1997, Sena y'Ububiligi yafashe icyemezo cyo gushyiraho komisiyo y'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yo gukora iperereza kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Imyanzuro y'iyo raporo igaragaza cyane cyane uruhare rusange:
Mu ijambo ry'amateka ryo ku wa 7 Mata 2000, mu gihe cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 6 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi i Kigali, Guy Verhofstadt (wari Minisitiri w'Intebe icyo gihe) yemereye imbere y'Abanyarwanda uruhare rw'Ububiligi muri Jenoside yo mu 1994:
Ubutabera nyuma ya Jenoside.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, urwego rw'ubutabera rw'u Rwanda, rwari rwarazahajwe cyane n'intambara, ntirwashoboraga kuburanisha mu buryo bwuzuye abakekwagaho jenoside (hafashwe abakekwa barenga 120 000, mu gihe urwego rw'ubutabera rwashoboraga kuburanisha nka 1 000 gusa ku mwaka).
Ububiligi bwatanze umusanzu mu Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR/ICTR), rwashyizweho na Loni (Ugushyingo 1994 – Ukuboza 2015) rukagira icyicaro i Arusha (Tanzaniya). Umusaruro warwo w'abantu 61 bahamijwe ibyaha wagiye unengwa.
Mu rwego rwo kwihutisha imanza no gushyira mu bikorwa inzira y'ubwiyunge bw'igihugu, guverinoma y'u Rwanda yashyizeho Inkiko Gacaca, uburyo bw'ubutabera ku rwego rw'ibanze bushingiye ku mico gakondo.
Nyuma yo kuburanisha imanza 1 958 634, Inkiko Gacaca zasojwe ku mugaragaro ku wa 18 Kamena 2012.
Ububiligi ni cyo gihugu cya mbere cy'amahanga cyaburanishije kandi kigahamya ibyaha abakoze jenoside b'Abanyarwanda ku butaka bwacyo; imanza zaciwe n'inkiko z'igihugu z'Ububiligi zishingiye ku ihame ry'ububasha bw'inkiko ku isi yose ("compétence universelle").
Urubanza rwa Butare Bane.
Alphonse Higaniro, Vincent Ntezimana, Consolata Mukangango na Julienne Mukabutera bafatiwe ku butaka bw'Ububiligi bakurikiranyweho uruhare mu bwicanyi bwabereye muri Perefegitura ya Butare hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994.
Bahamijwe ibyaha n'Urukiko rwa Rubanda ("Cour d'assises") rw'i Buruseli ku wa 8 Kamena 2001 (Ikigeragezo cya Butare Bane), bakatirwa igifungo kiri hagati y'imyaka 12 na 20.
Urubanza rwa Bernard Ntuyahaga.
Bernard Ntuyahaga, wahoze ari Majoro mu Ngabo z'u Rwanda (FAR), yakatiwe ku wa 5 Nyakanga 2007 n'Urukiko rwa Rubanda rw'i Buruseli igifungo cy'imyaka 20 kubera iyicwa ry'abasirikare 10 b'Ababiligi ba Loni, irya Minisitiri w'Intebe w'u Rwanda Agathe Uwilingiyimana n'iry'Abanyarwanda benshi, cyane cyane muri Perefegitura za Kigali na Butare. Amaze imyaka 20 muri gereza mu Bubiligi, Bernard Ntuyahaga yirukanywe asubizwa mu Rwanda mu Ukuboza 2018.
Ibikorwa byo gukurikirana abandi bakekwaho jenoside byarakomeje.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kamonyi ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haherereye mu Murenge wa Gacurabwenge, mu Akarere ka Kamonyi, mu Intara y'Amajyepfo, mu Rwanda.
Rwibutsa Abatutsi biciwe muri ako gace mu 1994, imibiri yabo ikaba yarakusanyijwe igashyingurwa aho. Imibiri y'abazize Jenoside isaga 47 000 ishyinguye mu mva rusange z'urwibutso rwa Kamonyi, rwubatswe ku muhanda Kigali–Huye, mu gace ka Kibuza.
Urwibutso ruri ku musozi wa Kibuza, mu Murenge wa Gacurabwenge, ari na wo cyicaro cy'Akarere ka Kamonyi, iruhande rw'umuhanda wa kaburimbo Kigali–Muhanga (umuhanda Kigali–Huye). Ruri hafi y'ibiro by'Umurenge wa Gacurabwenge, kandi ruroroshye kugerwaho uturutse i Kigali.
Urwibutso rwa Kamonyi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mbere ya 1994, agace ka Kamonyi kari muri Perefegitura ya Gitarama. Ubushakashatsi bwa Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) bugaragaza ko ari hamwe mu hantu abayobozi ba komini n'ab'igihugu bakanguriye abaturage gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ubuhamya bwatanzwe nyuma ya Jenoside buvuga ko Abatutsi birukanwaga muri paruwasi no ku masoko byo hafi bakajyanwa mu gace ka Kibuza, aho ibitero by'Interahamwe n'abasirikare byahitanye benshi; imibiri yabo nyuma yimuriwe mu rwibutso rwa Kamonyi.
Urwibutso rwa Kamonyi ruri mu nzibutso za Jenoside zabaruwe na CNLG, nyuma na Minisiteri y'Ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda n'Inshingano Mboneragihugu (MINUBUMWE), hamwe n'izindi nka Nyamata, Murambi, Bisesero cyangwa Gisozi.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, abarokotse n'imiryango y'abazize Jenoside, bafashijwe n'inzego z'ibanze n'umuryango w'abarokotse Ibuka, bakusanyirije ku musozi wa Kibuza imibiri y'Abatutsi biciwe mu gace ka Musambira, Gacurabwenge n'amakomini ahakikije. Aho hantu hagiye hatunganywa buhoro buhoro hahinduka urwibutso rufite imva rusange zubakishijwe amatafari, imva z'abantu benshi n'ahantu ho kunamira.
Hagati mu myaka ya 2000, umuryango w'Abongereza Survivors Fund (SURF) watanze inkunga yo kubaka, hafi y'urwibutso, inyubako igenewe ibikorwa byo kwibuka no kubika inyandiko. Mu 2015, iyo nyubako yashyikirijwe ku mugaragaro Komisiyo y'Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) kugira ngo ikoreshwe nk'ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Mu 2025, MINUBUMWE yatangaje ko i Kamonyi hagiye gufungurwa ikigo cy'igihugu cy'ububiko bw'inyandiko n'ubushakashatsi ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kizifashisha ibikorwaremezo bisanzwe biri mu karere, kigatuma Kamonyi iba ihuriro ry'ubushakashatsi no kwibuka.
Urwibutso rwa Kamonyi rugizwe n'imva rusange zubakishijwe beto, zishyinguyemo imibiri y'ibihumbi by'abazize Jenoside yakuwe ahantu hatandukanye muri ako gace, cyane cyane mu cyahoze ari Komini Musambira. Hari amabuye n'ibimenyetso byibutsa ubwicanyi bwabereye mu gace ka Kibuza no mu mirenge ihakikije, ndetse n'urwibutso rw'Abatutsi bo mu Karere ka Kamonyi.
Urwibutso rwakira imihango yo "Kwibuka", gusurwa n'amatsinda y'abanyeshuri, n'intumwa z'ibigo bya Leta n'iby'abikorera bahategurira ibikorwa by'uburere mboneragihugu no kwibuka. Inyubako y'ubushakashatsi yubatswe na SURF igashyikirizwa CNLG ikoreshwa mu mahugurwa, mu nama z'abarokotse no mu bikorwa byo kwandika amateka bijyanye no gukumira Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Ggolo ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haherereye i Ggolo, mu karere ka Mpigi, muri Uganda.
Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yatembanywe n'imigezi yo mu Rwanda, hanyuma ikagera mu kiyaga cya Victoriya, mbere yo gukurwamo igashyingurwa ku butaka bwa Uganda.
Urwibutso ruri i Ggolo, mu karere ka Mpigi, ku nkombe za Uganda z'ikiyaga cya Victoriya. Ni rumwe mu hantu hashyinguwe muri Uganda abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi imibiri yabo yabonetse imaze gutembanwa n'amazi ikagera mu kiyaga cya Victoriya.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abishwe bajugunywaga mu migezi, irimo Nyabarongo n'Akagera, yisuka mu kibaya cy'ikiyaga cya Victoriya. Imibiri yaje kuboneka mu mazi no ku nkombe za Uganda z'icyo kiyaga.
Muri Uganda habarurwa ahantu hatatu ho gushyingura no kwibukira abo bazize Jenoside: Ggolo, mu karere ka Mpigi, Lambu, mu karere ka Masaka, na Kasensero, mu karere ka Rakai.
Jenoside yo mu 1994.
