Mu 1994, muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abantu bicirwaga mu Rwanda hanyuma bakajugunywa mu migezi. Amazi yatwaye imibiri ayigeza mu kiyaga cya Victoriya, igera ku nkombe zitandukanye za Uganda. Inzego z'ubuyobozi n'abaturage bo muri ako gace bagize uruhare mu kuyikuramo no kuyishyingura.
Ahantu ha Ggolo hafitanye isano n'ibyo bikorwa byo gushyingura byabereye muri Uganda, ku bazize Jenoside akenshi batashoboraga kumenyekana umwe ku wundi. Habungabunga urwibutso rw'abantu biciwe mu Rwanda bagashyingurwa hanze y'ubutaka bw'u Rwanda kubera ko imibiri yabo yatwawe n'amazi.
Ishyirwaho n'iterambere ry'urwibutso.
Urwibutso rwa Ggolo ruri mu nzibutso eshatu zo muri Uganda zagenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi babonetse mu kiyaga cya Victoriya. Nk'uko Ambasade y'u Rwanda muri Uganda ibivuga, muri izo nzibutso uko ari eshatu hashyinguwe abazize Jenoside 10 983: 4 771 i Ggolo, 3 337 i Lambu na 2 875 i Kasensero.
Mu 2020, havuzwe ibiganiro hagati y'u Rwanda na Uganda ku bijyanye no gutunga cyangwa gucunga ubutaka buriho inzibutso za Jenoside ziri mu mahanga, harimo iza Ggolo, Lambu na Kasensero. Intego yavuzwe ni ukugira ngo u Rwanda rubashe kwita ku bubungabunga no ku isuku by'aho hantu ho kwibukira.
Urwibutso rwa Ggolo rwihariye kuko ruri hanze y'u Rwanda. Rufitanye isano n'amateka y'abazize Jenoside imibiri yabo yatwawe n'amazi nyuma y'ubwicanyi bwo mu 1994, ikaboneka muri Uganda.
Ni ahantu imiryango, abarokotse, Abanyarwanda baba muri Uganda n'abayobozi bitabira buri mwaka imihango yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi baza kunamira. Hakorerwa imihango yo kwibuka mu gihe cya "Kwibuka", igihe ngarukamwaka cyo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kasensero ni ahantu ho kwibukira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haherereye i Kasensero, mu karere ka Rakai, muri Uganda.
Rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize Jenoside yatembanywe n'imigezi yo mu Rwanda, hanyuma ikagera mu kiyaga cya Victoriya, mbere yo gukurwamo igashyingurwa ku butaka bwa Uganda.
Urwibutso ruri i Kasensero, mu karere ka Rakai, ku nkombe za Uganda z'ikiyaga cya Victoriya. Ni rumwe mu hantu hashyinguwe muri Uganda abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi imibiri yabo yabonetse imaze gutembanwa n'amazi ikagera mu kiyaga cya Victoriya.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abishwe bajugunywaga mu migezi, irimo Nyabarongo n'Akagera, yisuka mu kibaya cy'ikiyaga cya Victoriya. Imibiri yaje kuboneka mu mazi no ku nkombe za Uganda z'icyo kiyaga.
Muri Uganda habarurwa ahantu hatatu ho gushyingura no kwibukira abo bazize Jenoside: Ggolo, mu karere ka Mpigi, Lambu, mu karere ka Masaka, na Kasensero, mu karere ka Rakai.
Jenoside yo mu 1994.

Jenoside yo mu 1994.

Ishyirwaho n'iterambere ry'urwibutso.
Urwibutso rwa Lambu ruri mu nzibutso eshatu zo muri Uganda zagenewe abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi babonetse mu kiyaga cya Victoriya. Mu 2023, habereye umuhango wo kwibuka ku rwibutso rwa Lambu, mu karere ka Masaka, witabiriwe n'abagize umuryango w'Abanyarwanda baba muri Uganda, abayobozi n'Abagande.

Chantal Umuhoza (yavutse mu 1986) ni Umunyarwandakazi uharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore ("feminisiti") n'ubumwe bw'Afurika ("panafurikanisiti"), akaba n'impuguke mu bijyanye n'ubutabera mbonezamubano n'ubutabera mu by'ubukungu. Ni we washinze akaba n'umuyobozi mukuru wa SPECTRA, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta w'urubyiruko rw'abafeminisiti mu Rwanda, kandi akunze kugira uruhare mu nama zo mu karere no ku rwego mpuzamahanga zigaruka ku burenganzira bw'abagore.
Chantal Umuhoza yavutse mu 1986 mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Ni umwana wa gatatu mu bakobwa bane bavukana. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yabuze ababyeyi be bombi na bashiki be babiri.
Avuga ko urugamba rwe rwo guharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore rwashibutse mu bihe bya nyuma ya Jenoside, igihe sosiyete nyarwanda, yari isanzwe yiganjemo imyumvire ishyira imbere abagabo, yabonye abagore bagira uruhare rugenda rwiyongera mu kongera kubaka igihugu, bitewe n'ubusumbane mu mubare w'abaturage bwasizwe n'ubwicanyi.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Chantal Umuhoza yimukiye muri Ubugande, ari na ho yarangirije amashuri yisumbuye. Yagarutse mu Rwanda kwiga muri Kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu ubukungu.
Nyuma yaho, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("Master of Arts") mu burenganzira bwa muntu, uburinganire n'ubushakashatsi ku makimbirane ("Human Rights, Gender and Conflict Studies: Social Justice Perspectives"), muri International Institute of Social Studies mu Buholandi, mu mwaka w'amashuri wa 2013–2014.
Chantal Umuhoza afite uburambe bw'imyaka irenga 20 akorana n'imiryango itandukanye ya sosiyete sivile, abikorera, imiryango mpuzamahanga n'inzego za Leta. Ubuhanga bwe bwibanda ku butabera mu by'imibonano mpuzabitsina n'imyororokere, ubutabera mu by'ubukungu, ubuyobozi bushingiye ku mahame ya feminisime, kubaka imiryango iharanira impinduka, gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa politiki, n'ubuvugizi.
Mu 2012, yari umuhuzabikorwa w'imishinga mu Ishyirahamwe Nyarwanda riharanira Imibereho Myiza y'Umuryango (ARBEF).
Mu 2016, afatanyije n'abandi bakobwa b'abafeminisiti, yashinze SPECTRA, umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta w'urubyiruko rw'abafeminisiti mu Rwanda, washinzwe n'urubyiruko rw'abafeminisiti kandi ukorera urwo rubyiruko. Uwo muryango ugamije kubaka urugaga ruhamye rw'abayobozi bakiri bato b'abafeminisiti bagira uruhare mu guharanira ubutabera mbonezamubano bw'abakobwa n'abagore bakiri bato, binyuze mu kongerera abantu ubushobozi, mu gutoza hagati y'ibisekuru no mu buvugizi.
Ayobora kandi "Tanga Community by SPECTRA", ikigo nyarwanda cy'ubucuruzi bugamije imibereho myiza ("social enterprise"), gishingiye ku mahame y'abafeminisiti b'Abanyafurika, kigamije guteza imbere ibikorwa by'abagore, abakobwa n'urubyiruko.
Ibikorwa ku rwego rw'akarere n'isi.
Ku rwego rwa Afurika, Chantal Umuhoza yagize uruhare mu isesengura no mu guhindura politiki mu nzego z'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AU): yabaye umwe mu bagize Inama Ngishwanama y'Urubyiruko ya AU, atanga inama mu ishami rya AU rishinzwe uburinganire, kandi ari mu muryango w'abagore b'Abanyafurika b'abahuza (FEMWISE) mu ishami rishinzwe amahoro n'umutekano.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, yagize uruhare mu nama z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, zirimo Komisiyo ishinzwe Abaturage n'Iterambere, Komisiyo ishinzwe Imibereho y'Abagore (CSW) n'Inama ishinzwe Uburenganzira bwa Muntu. Akurikirana kandi ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'Intego z'Iterambere Rirambye (SDGs) ku rwego rw'igihugu, rw'akarere n'urw'isi, kandi yagize uruhare mu bikorwa bya "Generation Equality" bya UN Women.
Chantal Umuhoza ashimangira ko mbere ya Jenoside, umugore mu Rwanda yahabwaga agaciro gusa ku bijyanye no kubyara no kwita ku rugo:

Uruganda rw'Igihugu rutunganya Zahabu rwa Burkina Faso (Raffinor-BF, mu Gifaransa: "Raffinerie nationale d'or du Burkina Faso") ni ikigo gitunganya zahabu giherereye i Wagadugu, muri Burukina Faso. Cyashyiriweho guhindura doré (uruvange rw'ibyuma rugizwe ahanini na zahabu) ikomoka ku musaruro wa zahabu, ikabyazwamo utubari twa zahabu iyunguruye neza.
Uru ruganda rwatashywe ku wa 28 Nzeri 2026 na Perezida wa Burkina Faso, Ibrahim Traoré, ari kumwe n'abagize guverinoma ye. Rufatwa nk'uruganda rwa mbere rutunganya zahabu muri Burkina Faso.
Iyubakwa ry'uru ruganda ryatangiye mu Ugushyingo 2023. Rwubatswe hagamijwe kongera ubushobozi bw'igihugu bwo gutunganya zahabu icukurwa muri Burkina Faso. Uru ruganda ruherereye mu karere ka 12 k'umujyi wa Wagadugu, rwubatswe ku butaka bungana na hegitari 5. Rugizwe by'umwihariko n'aho bashongeshereza ibyuma, laboratwari isuzuma, ububiko bwa zahabu, iduka ry'imitako n'inyubako y'ubuyobozi.
Rwatwaye amafaranga arenga miliyari 11 z'amafaranga ya CFA. Rwatewe inkunga ahanini na Leta binyuze mu Kigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Amabuye y'Agaciro (SONASP), hamwe n'uruhare rw'abafatanyabikorwa b'abikorera bo mu gihugu.
Ibikoresho n'ubushobozi.
RAFFINOR-BF ikoresha ibikoresho bikora ubwabyo kandi ikora mu buryo bufunze ("circuit fermé"). Yubatswe hakurikijwe amahame agamije kugabanya imyanda isohoka mu gihe cyo gutunganya zahabu. Uruganda rufite imiterere igizwe n'ibice ("modulaire") ituma hashobora kongerwaho indi mirongo mishya yo gutunganya. Mu cyiciro cya mbere, ubushobozi bwarwo bubarwa ni toni 164 za zahabu ku mwaka. Icyiciro cya kabiri kigomba kuzamura ubu bushobozi bukagera kuri toni 515 ku mwaka.
Uru ruganda rugomba kandi guhindura doré mo utubari twa zahabu iyunguruye ifite isuku ya 99,99 %.
Gutangiza RAFFINOR-BF biri muri politiki ya guverinoma ya Burkina Faso igamije kongera itunganyirizwa mu gihugu ry'umutungo kamere wayo w'amabuye y'agaciro. Abayobozi bifuza ko igice kinini cy'agaciro kiyongera gikomoka ku bucukuzi bwa zahabu cyaguma ku butaka bwa Burkina Faso.
Uru ruganda rugomba kandi gufasha kongera ikurikiranwa ry'inkomoko ya zahabu icukurwa muri Burkina Faso no kunoza igenzura ry'amafaranga ajyanye n'ubucuruzi bwayo. Rwashyizweho kandi kugira ngo rufashe kurwanya uburiganya, ubucuruzi bwa magendu n'iyezandonke mu gihugu.
Perezida Ibrahim Traoré avuga ko uru ruganda ari intambwe ya mbere ya politiki yagutse yo gutunganyiriza mu gihugu umutungo w'amabuye y'agaciro. Yatangaje ko guverinoma ye yifuza no guteza imbere itunganywa ry'ibindi byuma bicukurwa mu gihugu:
RAFFINOR-BF igomba gutanga imirimo igera ku 100 itaziguye n'imirimo 5 000 iziguye. Uru ruganda rugomba kandi kugira uruhare mu guhugura abakozi b'inzobere mu mirimo ijyanye no gutunganya no guhindura ibyuma. Muri urwo rwego, guverinoma ifata iterambere ry'ubumenyi bw'abenegihugu nk'ikintu cy'ingenzi kugira ngo uru ruganda rukore kandi rubungabungwe n'abo mu gihugu.
Burkina Faso ni kimwe mu bihugu bicukura zahabu muri Afurika yo munsi y'Ubutayu bwa Sahara. Umusaruro wa zahabu w'igihugu warenze toni 94 mu 2025. Gushyiraho ubu bushobozi bw'igihugu bwo gutunganya zahabu bigamije kugabanya kwishingikiriza ku gutunganyirizwa kwa zahabu mu mahanga no gushimangira ubugenzuzi bw'igihugu ku ruhererekane nyongeragaciro rw'uyu mutungo. Abayobozi ba Burkina Faso bifuza kandi ko RAFFINOR-BF yaba igikoresho gishobora gufasha guteza imbere ibikorwa byo gutunganya zahabu ku rwego rw'akarere muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba.

Ibrahim Traoré (wavutse ku wa 14 Werurwe 1988 i Kéra, muri komine ya Bondokuy, muri Burukina Faso) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaburukinafaso, akaba ari Umukuru w'Igihugu cya Burkina Faso kuva ku wa 30 Nzeri 2022.
Yahiritse ku butegetsi Lieutenant-colonel Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba binyuze muri kudeta, afata ubuyobozi bw'Umutwe wo Gukunda Igihugu ugamije Kurinda no Kugarura Ituze ("Mouvement patriotique pour la sauvegarde et la restauration", MPSR) ku wa 30 Nzeri 2022. Mu ngabo za Burkina Faso, afite ipeti rya Kapiteni.
Igihe yageraga ku butegetsi afite imyaka 34, ni we wari umukuru w'igihugu ukiri muto kurusha abandi ku isi.
Ibrahim Traoré yavukiye i Kéra, muri komine ya Bondokuy, ku wa 14 Werurwe 1988.
Yize amashuri abanza mu ishuri rya Leta rya Bondokuy. Amashuri yisumbuye yayigiye muri "lycée mixte d'Accart-ville" i Bobo-Dioulasso, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye ("baccalauréat série D") mu 2006.
Mu 2006, yinjiye muri Kaminuza ya Wagadugu (ubu yitwa Kaminuza Joseph Ki-Zerbo), mu ishami ry'ubumenyi n'ikoranabuhanga, mu gice cy'ubutabire, ibinyabuzima n'ubumenyi bw'isi (géologie). Mu 2010, yarangije afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri ("maîtrise") mu bumenyi bw'isi, ayibonana amanota meza.
Igihe yari mu masomo, yari umurwanashyaka w'Ishyirahamwe ry'Igihugu ry'Abanyeshuri ba Burkina (ANEB), umuryango w'abanyeshuri ugendera ku bitekerezo bya Marx. Yari kandi hafi y'amashyirahamwe y'Abayisilamu, akaba n'umunyamuryango w'Ishyirahamwe ry'Abanyeshuri b'Abayisilamu.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Traoré ntiyanyuze mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya "Prytanée militaire de Kadiogo" (PMK), bitandukanye n'uwo yasimbuye, Damiba, ndetse n'abandi basirikare bakuru benshi bo muri Burkina Faso. Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza, yinjiye mu gisirikare mu 2010. Yatorejwe mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare Georges Namoano, ishuri rihugura abofisiye riri i Pô, ahasoza ari uwa kabiri mu bo bari bigana. Nyuma yaho yazamutse vuba mu mapeti ya gisirikare.
Mu 2012 yabaye Sous-lieutenant, nyuma y'imyaka ibiri ahabwa ipeti rya Lieutenant, maze mu 2020 azamurwa ku ipeti rya Kapiteni. Muri Werurwe 2022, Perezida Paul-Henri Damiba yamugize umukuru w'imbunda nini (artillerie) muri Batayo ya 10 ishinzwe ubuyobozi, ubufasha n'ingoboka (10e RCAS) ifite icyicaro i Kaya.
Kapiteni Traoré yagize uruhare mu bikorwa byinshi bya gisirikare byo kurwanya iterabwoba, cyane cyane i Djibo, aho yari ayobowe na Lieutenant-colonel Damiba, icyo gihe wari umuyobozi w'itsinda ry'ingabo zirwanya iterabwoba mu 2017. Yanagize uruhare mu gikorwa cya gisirikare cyiswe "Otapuanu" mu 2019, kandi yakoreye mu itsinda ry'ingabo ryari i Markoye, mu ntara ya Sahel.
Perezida wa Burkina Faso.
Kudeta zo muri Mutarama na Nzeri 2022 n'ifatwa ry'ubutegetsi.
Ibrahim Traoré yafashe ubutegetsi binyuze muri kudeta ku wa 30 Nzeri 2022, amaze gutangaza ko Damiba akuwe ku butegetsi. Iyo yari kudeta ya kabiri igihugu cyari kibonye muri uwo mwaka. Kapiteni Traoré yari umwe mu basirikare bakuru bagize uruhare muri kudeta yahiritse Perezida Roch Marc Christian Kaboré, igashyira ku butegetsi Lieutenant-colonel Damiba, perezida wa MPSR, ku wa 24 Mutarama 2022.
Bitewe n'umutekano wari ukomeje kuzamba no kuba ibyemezo byafashwe mu gihe cya kudeta ya mbere bitarubahirijwe, abo basirikare bahisemo gukura ku butegetsi Perezida Damiba ku wa 30 Nzeri 2022, maze Ibrahim Traoré afata ubuyobozi bwa MPSR. Iyi kudeta yakurikiye ibitero byinshi by'iterabwoba byahitanye abantu benshi, cyane cyane icyabereye i Gaskindé, mu majyaruguru ya Burkina Faso, aho imodoka zari zitwaye ibiribwa zaguye mu gico cy'abaterabwoba. Imibare yatangajwe na Leta yavugaga abasirikare 11 bishwe n'abasivili benshi baburiwe irengero, mu gihe andi makuru yavugaga abasivili bagera ku ijana bishwe. Damiba yaje kwegura ku wa 2 Ukwakira 2022.
Amaze gufata ubutegetsi ku wa 30 Nzeri, Ibrahim Traoré yatangaje ati:
Ku wa 6 Ukwakira, itegeko shingiro ryagaruye Itegeko Nshinga maze ritangaza ko Traoré ari Umukuru w'Igihugu. Yabaye atyo Umuyisilamu wa mbere ugeze kuri uwo mwanya kuva Saye Zerbo yahirikwa ku butegetsi mu 1982.
Avuga ko ari gukemura gusa ibibazo by'ibanze by'igihugu, Traoré yatangaje ko perezida w'inzibacyuho, yaba umusivili cyangwa umusirikare, azatoranywa n'inama nkuru y'igihugu ("assises") ku wa 14 Ukwakira 2022. Abamushyigikiye bakoze imyigaragambyo basaba ko ari we wahabwa kuyobora igihugu, maze ahabwa kuyobora inzibacyuho nk'umuyobozi wa MPSR. Ku wa 21 Ukwakira, yarahiriye kuba Perezida w'inzibacyuho imbere y'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga. Mu Ugushyingo, yanze guhembwa umushahara wa perezida, ahitamo kuguma ahembwa uwa kapiteni.
Ku wa 3 Gashyantare 2023, Ibrahim Traoré yatangaje ibitero bikomeye byari bigiye kugabwa ku barwanyi b'intagondwa z'abajihadi, asaba abaturage kumushyigikira. Muri Mata 2023, yatangaje ko igihugu cyose kigomba kwitegura urugamba ("mobilisation générale"). Muri Gicurasi, yavuze ku bihugu "by'inshuti" bafatanya cyangwa bongera ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare: Uburusiya, aho abacancuro b'itsinda rya Wagner bashobora kuba bari muri Burkina Faso, Turukiya imuha indege zitagira abapilote (drones) zo mu bwoko bwa Bayraktar TB2, ndetse na Koreya y’Amajyaruguru yatekerezaga ko yamuha intwaro. Icyo gihe, guverinoma yahisemo kwifashisha ingabo zayo bwite mu kurwanya abajihadi, kandi ntibyagaragaraga ko yasabye ubufasha bw'Abarusiya ba Wagner. Mu rwego rwo gukaza urugamba rwo kurwanya iterabwoba, guverinoma ye yateguye igikorwa kidasanzwe cyo kwinjiza abasirikare 3 000, ndetse no kwinjiza abafasha b'ingabo 50 000 bitwa "Abakorerabushake bo kurinda Igihugu" ("Volontaires pour la défense de la patrie", VDP).
Kubera ko ingengo y'imari ya Leta, yari yazahajwe n'ibihano by'ubukungu, itabashaga gutera inkunga urugamba rwo kurwanya abajihadi, guverinoma yongereye imisoro.
Bitewe n'imyaka ye, uburambe afite ku rugamba n'imivugire ye, Ibrahim Traoré akundwa n'urubyiruko, rugize abarenga 70 % by'abaturage ariko rukaba rudahagarariwe bihagije mu nzego za politiki. Mu ijambo rye akunze kwifashisha ibitekerezo bya Thomas Sankara, nko guharanira ubusugire bw'igihugu no kwamagana ubukoloni bushya ("impérialisme"). Akurikiza politiki irwanya Ubufaransa, bimuhesha gushyigikirwa n'abaharanira ubumwe bwa Afurika ("panafricanistes") ndetse n'Abayisilamu b'Abawahabi. Nyamara, uretse uko gukundwa, sosiyete sivile, abanyamakuru, abacamanza n'abayobozi b'amashyaka bibasirwa n'igitugu cy'ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare, rimwe na rimwe bakajyanwa ku ngufu mu gisirikare ku rugamba. Abasivili na bo bahuye n'ibyo, ndetse bamwe baburirwa irengero ku gahato.
Ku wa 16 Nzeri 2023, Ibrahim Traoré, ari kumwe na Colonel Assimi Goïta na Jenerali Abdourahamane Tiani, bashinze Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel ("Alliance des États du Sahel", AES), amasezerano yo gutabarana hagati ya Mali, Nigeri na Burukina Faso. Ku wa 28 Mutarama 2024, yakuye Burkina Faso mu Muryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO).
Amaze kurokoka umugambi wa kudeta muri Nzeri 2023, yitabaje abasirikare b'Abarusiya ngo bamurinde. Mu Ukuboza, Minisitiri w'Intebe mushya, Apollinaire Joachim Kyélem de Tambèla, yatangaje ko Uburusiya buzafasha mu ivugurura ry'ingabo za Burkina Faso, cyane cyane mu gushyiraho batayo nshya zo gutabara byihuse, mu gihe Ubushinwa na Turukiya na byo byari kuzatanga ubufasha. Muri icyo gihe kandi, guverinoma ya Burkina Faso yasinye amasezerano n'Uburusiya yo kubaka uruganda rutanga amashanyarazi akomoka ku ngufu za nikleyeri.
Ku wa 25 Gicurasi 2024, nyuma y'indi nama nkuru y'inzibacyuho itaritabiriwe n'amatsinda ya sosiyete sivile n'amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Ibrahim Traoré, inzibacyuho yongerewe imyaka itanu (guhera ku wa 2 Nyakanga 2024) hemejwe itegeko rishya ("charte") rimuha izina rya Perezida wa Burkina Faso, rikanamwemerera kuzaziyamamaza mu matora azakurikira. Iyi nama yabaye hashize iminsi mike habaye indi isa na yo muri Mali, igihugu bafatanyije, na yo yongereye inzibacyuho imyaka itanu. Uwo munsi nyine, Traoré yashyize umukono kuri iryo tegeko rishya, bituma ritangira gukurikizwa.
Ku wa 11 Kamena 2024, abajihadi b'Itsinda rishyigikira Isilamu n'Abayisilamu (JNIM) bagabye igitero ku kigo cya gisirikare no muri komine ya Mansila. Bukeye bwaho, igisasu cyarashwe ku cyicaro cya Televiziyo y'igihugu (RTB), hafi y'ingoro ya perezida i Wagadugu, abakirashe ntibamenyekana. Mu minsi yakurikiyeho, kuba Ibrahim Traoré atagaragaraga cyane mu ruhame byateje ibibazo mu Banyaburukinafaso. Abasirikare ba Mali n'abacancuro b'Abarusiya ba Wagner bageze i Wagadugu muri iyo minsi, ariko inshingano zabo ntizasobanuwe. Inama y'Abaminisitiri yagombaga kuyobora ku wa 19 Kamena 2024 yimuriwe bukeye bwaho, maze Traoré yongera kugaragara icyo gihe. Muri Kanama, igihugu cyagabweho igitero cy'iterabwoba cy'abajihadi cyahitanye abantu benshi kurusha ibindi byose mu mateka yacyo, mu mudugudu wa Barsalogho mu majyaruguru rwagati y'igihugu, aho abaturage bari hagati ya 300 na 400 bishwe n'Itsinda rishyigikira Isilamu n'Abayisilamu (JNIM).
Amashusho n'amafoto by'impimbano byakozwe hifashishijwe ubwenge buhangano (AI), birata Ibrahim Traoré, byuzuye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Muri ayo mashusho, akozwe neza cyangwa nabi, kapiteni agaragazwa nk'umuyobozi w'intwari urinda abaturage be, kandi akwirakwizwa na konti z'impimbano. Ayo mashusho, atagenewe abaturage ba Burkina Faso, rimwe na rimwe arebwa n'abantu babarirwa muri za miliyoni, kandi akenshi akurura ibitekerezo by'abamushima, haba muri Afurika ivuga Igifaransa aho Ibrahim Traoré asanzwe azwi, haba muri Afurika ivuga Icyongereza, cyane cyane muri Gana, Nijeriya na Kenya, ndetse no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika no mu birwa bya Karayibe. Ayo mashusho amwerekana ari kumwe n'ibyamamare by'isi nka Beyoncé, Rihanna cyangwa Justin Bieber. Andi mashusho menshi y'impimbano agaragaza "ubukungu bwa Burkina Faso butera imbere, bubasha gukora telefoni zigezweho, ibinyabiziga n'imashini z'ubuhinzi".
Ku wa 23 Ukuboza 2025, yasimbuye Assimi Goïta ku mwanya wa Perezida w'Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel.
Ku wa 29 Mutarama 2026, nyuma y'inama y'Abaminisitiri, guverinoma ya gisirikare yasheshe amashyaka ya politiki yose.
Ku wa 3 Mata 2026, mu kiganiro yagiriye kuri Televiziyo y'igihugu (RTB), Kapiteni Ibrahim Traoré yatangaje ko Burkina Faso igomba kwibagirwa igitekerezo cya demokarasi, avuga ko muri iki gihe gikoreshwa n'abakoloni bashya ("impérialistes"):

Assimi Goïta (wavutse ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 1983 i Bamako, muri Mali) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyamali, akaba ayoboye Mali kuva mu 2021. Afite ipeti rya Jenerali w'ingabo ("général d'armée"), ari ryo peti risumba ayandi mu gihugu.
Yabaye perezida w'Akanama k'Igihugu gashinzwe Gukiza Abaturage ("Comité national pour le salut du peuple", CNSP), agatsiko k'abasirikare kahiritse ku butegetsi Perezida Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta muri kudeta yo muri Kanama 2020. Nyuma yaho yabaye visi-perezida w'inzibacyuho iyobowe na Bah N'Daw, ariko akomeza kuba we nyir'ububasha nyakuri mu gihugu. Muri Gicurasi 2021, yakoze indi kudeta, maze aba Perezida w'inzibacyuho.
Ku butegetsi bwe, Mali yacanye umubano mu bya gisirikare n'Ubufaransa, yegera Uburusiya n'itsinda ry'abacancuro rya Wagner, ndetse ivana mu Muryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO). Hamwe n'abayobozi ba gisirikare ba Burukina Faso na Nigeri, yashinze Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel (AES), aba perezida waryo wa mbere kuva mu 2024 kugeza mu 2025. Ubutegetsi bwe burangwa n'igitugu: amatora yasubitswe igihe kitazwi, amashyaka ya politiki yose yasheshwe mu 2025, maze ahabwa manda y'imyaka itanu ishobora kongerwa nta matora.
Assimi Goïta ni uwo mu bwoko bw'Abaminyanka ("Minianka"). Yavukiye i Bamako ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 1983, akaba umwana w'umusirikare mukuru wo mu ngabo za Mali. Yize mu mashuri ya gisirikare ya Mali, by'umwihariko muri Prytanée militaire de Kati no mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Koulikoro ("École militaire interarmes", EMIA).
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Goïta yabaye Koloneli muri Batayo yigenga y'ingabo zidasanzwe ("Bataillon autonome des forces spéciales"), ayobora ingabo zidasanzwe za Mali mu gice cyo hagati cy'igihugu. Yagize uruhare mu rugamba rwo kurwanya inyeshyamba z'abajihadi mu Mali.
Yahawe andi mahugurwa ya gisirikare na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, Ubufaransa n'Ubudage, kandi yakoranye n'ingabo zidasanzwe z'Amerika ("Green Berets"). Mu 2018, yahuye na Mamady Doumbouya, waje nyuma gukora kudeta muri Gineya akaba perezida waho.
Kudeta ya 2020 n'umwanya wa visi-perezida.
Assimi Goïta ni umwe mu bateguye kudeta yo mu 2020 yahiritse Perezida Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta, ari kumwe na Ismaël Wagué, Malick Diaw, Sadio Camara na Modibo Koné. Abo basirikare biyemeje gutegura amatora mashya. Ku wa 19 Kanama 2020, yagizwe perezida w'Akanama k'Igihugu gashinzwe Gukiza Abaturage (CNSP). Ku wa 24 Kanama 2020, itegeko shingiro ryemejwe na CNSP ryamugize Umukuru w'Igihugu wa Mali mu buryo bufatika ("de facto").
CEDEAO yashyize igitutu ku gatsiko k'abasirikare kugira ngo igihugu kiyoborwe n'umusivili. Umuryango mpuzamahanga wanze ko ari we wayobora inzibacyuho, cyangwa ko yasimbura perezida w'inzibacyuho, n'iyo yava mu gisirikare. Ku wa 21 Nzeri 2020, itsinda ry'abatora 17 ryamugize visi-perezida w'inzibacyuho, naho Bah N'Daw wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Ingabo agirwa Perezida w'inzibacyuho; bari bagenewe kumara amezi 18 kugeza habaye amatora. Barahiye ku wa 25 Nzeri 2020. Ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2020, hasohotse itegeko ry'inzibacyuho ("charte de la transition") ryavugaga, bisabwe na CEDEAO, ko visi-perezida "ushinzwe ibibazo by'ingabo n'umutekano" adashobora gusimbura Perezida Bah N'Daw. Nyamara, Assimi Goïta yakomeje kuba we nyir'ububasha nyakuri mu gihugu.
Goïta ashima cyane uwahoze ari Perezida wa Burkina Faso, Thomas Sankara. Mu 2020, mu nama ya CEDEAO yabereye i Peduase muri Gana, yahuye n'uwahoze ari Perezida wa Gana, Jerry Rawlings, baganira ku itangizwa ry'inzibacyuho muri Mali.
Ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2021, nyuma gato y'itangazwa rya guverinoma ya kabiri iyobowe na Moctar Ouane, itarimo abakoloneli babiri bahoze muri CNSP (Modibo Koné na Sadio Camara), Perezida Bah N'Daw, Minisitiri w'Intebe na Minisitiri w'Ingabo bafashwe, bajyanwa i Kati barinzwe n'abasirikare. Bukeye bwaho, Koloneli Assimi Goïta yatangaje ko yambuye Perezida na Minisitiri w'Intebe ububasha bwabo, abashinja "kudindiza" inzibacyuho no gushyiraho guverinoma nshya batabanje kumugisha inama. Koko, itegeko ry'inzibacyuho ryamuhaga uburenganzira bwo kugira icyo avuga ku ihitamo rya Minisitiri w'Ingabo n'uw'Umutekano, imyanya yari isanzwe ifitwe n'inshuti ze Camara na Koné. Amaze gufata ubutegetsi, yasubije Sadio Camara ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Ingabo.
Iyo kudeta yatumye Assimi Goïta aba Perezida w'inzibacyuho w'agateganyo. Ku wa 28 Gicurasi 2021, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko umwanya wa perezida utagira nyirawo, maze rumutangaza nka Perezida w'inzibacyuho, Umukuru w'Igihugu, kugeza inzibacyuho irangiye. Bidatinze, yegereye Ihuriro ry'Igihugu ry'Abakozi ba Mali (UNTM), ryari ryateguye imyigaragambyo y'abakozi.
Uwo munsi nyine, yatangaje ko umwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe uzahabwa ihuriro ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Mouvement du 5 Juin – Rassemblement des forces patriotiques (M5-RFP). Iryo huriro ryatoranyije umuyobozi waryo, Choguel Kokalla Maïga, wagiye ku buyobozi bwa guverinoma ku wa 7 Kamena 2021, nyuma y'aho Goïta arahiriye imbere y'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga.
Ku wa 20 Nyakanga 2021, mu birori by'Ilayidi ("Aïd al-Adha"), umugabo witwaje icyuma yagerageje kumutera icyuma ari mu isengesho mu Musigiti Mukuru wa Bamako, ariko ntiyakomereka. Abantu babiri bafashwe n'inzego z'umutekano, ariko umwe muri bo yaje kugaragara ko ari umusirikare wo mu ngabo zidasanzwe wakekwagaho ubufatanyacyaha atari byo. Uwamuteye, wari umwarimu, yapfiriye muri gereza nyuma y'iminsi itanu, icyamwishe ntikimenyekana.
Kongera igihe cy'inzibacyuho.
Mu Ukuboza 2021, nyuma y'inama nkuru y'igihugu yiswe "Assises nationales pour la refondation", yasabye ko inzibacyuho yongerwa kuva ku mezi atandatu kugeza ku myaka itanu kugira ngo hakorwe amavugurura ya politiki, Assimi Goïta yatangaje ko yifuza kongera inzibacyuho imyaka itanu. Yateganyaga kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga muri Mutarama 2024, amatora y'abadepite n'ay'abasenateri mu Ugushyingo 2025, n'amatora ya perezida mu Ukuboza 2026. Iyo gahunda yaganiriweho mu nama idasanzwe ya CEDEAO yo ku wa 9 Mutarama 2022. Iyo nama yanze iyo gahunda, ifunga imipaka yayo na Mali, ihamagaza abambasaderi kandi ishyiraho ibihano by'ubukungu.
Ku wa 21 Gashyantare 2022, itegeko ry'inzibacyuho ryarahinduwe, inzibacyuho yongerwa igihe kitarenze imyaka itanu. Iryo tegeko ryavugaga kandi ko Assimi Goïta atemerewe kwiyamamaza mu matora ya perezida keretse yeguye, kandi ko perezida w'Inama y'Igihugu y'Inzibacyuho (CNT) ari we wasimbura Perezida w'inzibacyuho. Ku wa 21 Kanama 2022, Goïta yagize Abdoulaye Maïga Minisitiri w'Intebe w'agateganyo, asimbura Choguel Kokalla Maïga wari mu bitaro kuva ku wa 10 Kanama.
Mu Kamena 2023, habaye kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga rishya; ku wa 23 Kamena hatangajwe ko ryemejwe ku majwi 97 %, abitabiriye bakaba 39,4 % by'abiyandikishije. Abanenga iryo tegeko bavuze ko kamarampaka itanyuze mu mucyo, kandi ko ryongereye ububasha bwa perezida, bigatuma amavugurura ya demokarasi arushaho kugorana.
Igihe cy'inzibacyuho, cyari cyarashyizweho n'iteka rya perezida, cyarangiye ku wa 26 Werurwe 2024 nta matora abaye. Muri Mata 2024, Minisitiri w'Intebe Maïga yatangaje ko amatora azaba nyuma y'ibiganiro hagati y'Abanyamali n'igihe igihugu kizaba gifite ituze. Muri icyo gihe, ibikorwa by'amashyaka byarahagaritswe, kandi itangazamakuru ryose ribuzwa kubivugaho. Ku wa 10 Gicurasi 2024, ibiganiro hagati y'Abanyamali byasabye ko inzibacyuho yongerwa indi myaka iri hagati y'ibiri n'itanu, ko umubare w'amashyaka ugabanywa kandi ntahabwe inkunga ya Leta, ndetse ko Goïta yiyamamaza mu matora ya perezida, akanazamurwa ku ipeti rya Jenerali hamwe n'abandi bayobozi bane b'agatsiko k'abasirikare. Amashyaka menshi yamaganye ibyo byemezo, avuga ko ibyo biganiro byateguwe n'agatsiko k'abasirikare kugira ngo kagume ku butegetsi, kandi ko ababyitabiriye batatowe.
Ku wa 16 Ukwakira 2024, inama y'abaminisitiri yamugize Jenerali w'ingabo ("général d'armée") "ku buryo budasanzwe". Afite inyenyeri eshanu, akaba ari we musirikare ufite ipeti risumba ayandi muri Mali.
Ku wa 20 Ugushyingo 2024, yirukanye Minisitiri w'Intebe Choguel Kokalla Maïga, wari washinje agatsiko k'abasirikare kutamureka ngo ayobore no kwanga gushyiraho itariki y'amatora, maze asesa guverinoma ye. Bukeye bwaho, yashyizeho Jenerali Abdoulaye Maïga ngo amusimbure.
Iseswa ry'amashyaka na manda itagira iherezo.
Ku wa 28 na 29 Mata 2025, habaye indi nama nkuru y'igihugu, amashyaka menshi ya politiki atitabiriye. Yasabye ko Assimi Goïta agirwa Perezida wa Repubulika mu gihe cy'imyaka itanu ishobora kongerwa, kandi ko amashyaka ya politiki aseswa. Ku wa 3 Gicurasi, amagana y'abayoboke b'ayo mashyaka bakoze imyigaragambyo imbere y'Ingoro y'Umuco i Bamako, basaba ko inzibacyuho irangira bitarenze ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2025. Indi nama yari iteganyijwe kubera ku Nzu y'Itangazamakuru yaburijwemo n'abantu boherejwe n'agatsiko k'abasirikare. Mu gihe hari hateganyijwe imyigaragambyo ku wa 9 Gicurasi, ubutegetsi bwahagaritse ibikorwa by'amashyaka ku wa 7 Gicurasi.
Ku wa 12 Gicurasi 2025, Inama y'Igihugu y'Inzibacyuho yatoye ivanwaho ry'itegeko rigenga amashyaka, maze Goïta arishyiraho umukono bukeye bwaho, ku wa 13 Gicurasi. Uwo munsi nyine, nyuma y'inama y'abaminisitiri, yasheshe amashyaka yose ya politiki, anabuza abayoboke bayo guhurira hamwe. Icyo cyemezo cyajyanye no guhagarika itangazwa rya televiziyo TV5 Monde muri Mali.
Ku wa 11 Kamena 2025, inama y'abaminisitiri yemeje ko manda ye yongerwa imyaka itanu nta matora abaye. Ku wa 3 Nyakanga 2025, Inama y'Igihugu y'Inzibacyuho yemeje ivugurura ry'itegeko ry'inzibacyuho rimuha manda y'imyaka itanu ishobora kongerwa "inshuro zose bizaba ngombwa" nta matora, kandi rikamwemerera kuziyamamaza mu matora ya perezida azakurikira. Iryo tegeko ryashyizweho umukono ku wa 8 Nyakanga 2025.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2023, Goïta yababariye abasirikare 46 ba Côte d'Ivoire bari barakatiwe n'inkiko za Mali mu Ukuboza 2022.
Muri Nyakanga 2023, yitabiriye Inama y'Uburusiya n'Afurika yabereye i Saint-Pétersbourg, rukaba rwari urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga kuva kudeta yo mu 2021. Nyuma y'iyo nama, yahuye na Perezida Vladimir Putin baganira ku nkunga y'ubukungu n'ubutabazi Uburusiya buha Mali. Muri iyo nama, Goïta yashinje ibihugu byafatiye Mali ibihano "gukoresha uburyo bw'ubukoloni bushya".
Nyuma ya kudeta yo muri Nyakanga 2023 muri Nigeri, Goïta yashyigikiye agatsiko k'abasirikare kafashe ubutegetsi muri icyo gihugu (CNSP), maze na ko kemerera ingabo za Mali kwinjira muri Nigeri. Ku wa 16 Nzeri 2023, ari kumwe na Kapiteni Ibrahim Traoré wa Burkina Faso na Jenerali Abdourahamane Tiani wa Nigeri, yashinze Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel (AES). Muri Mutarama 2024, Mali yatangaje ko ivuye muri CEDEAO. Goïta yabaye perezida wa mbere w'Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel kuva ku wa 6 Nyakanga 2024 kugeza mu Ukuboza 2025, asimburwa na Ibrahim Traoré.
Muri Ukwakira 2023, yagiranye ikiganiro kuri telefoni na Putin, kikaba cyari icya gatatu mu mezi atageze kuri abiri, baganira ku bucuruzi n'umutekano. Nyuma yaho, yashimiye ku mugaragaro "inkunga yose Uburusiya buha Mali".
Muri Ukwakira 2024, yakiriye intumwa z'inteko ishinga amategeko ya Turukiya mu rwego rwo gutandukanya abafatanyabikorwa ba Mali mu bukungu no mu by'umutekano. Turukiya yagaragaje ko ishyigikiye ingabo za Mali (FAMa) mu rugamba rwo kurwanya iterabwoba; muri Nyakanga 2024, Perezida wa Turukiya Recep Tayyip Erdoğan yari yamwijeje inkunga ye mu kiganiro kuri telefoni.
Ibitero byo muri Mata 2026.
Ku wa 25 Mata 2026, Umutwe wo Kubohora Azawad (FLA) n'Itsinda rishyigikira Isilamu n'Abayisilamu (JNIM) bagabye hamwe ibitero mu bice byinshi bya Mali. Nk'uko ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare bubivuga, abarwanyi bagerageje kwica Goïta bakoresheje imodoka yuzuyemo ibisasu bari bagenewe kohereza ku nzu ye. Yamaze iminsi atagaragara mu ruhame, yongera kugaragara ku wa 29 Mata ubwo yakiraga ambasaderi w'Uburusiya. Ku wa 4 Gicurasi 2026, yigize Minisitiri w'Ingabo, asimbura Sadio Camara wiciwe muri ibyo bitero, naho umugaba mukuru w'ingabo Oumar Diarra agirwa Minisitiri wungirije.
Politiki y'ubukungu.
Ku butegetsi bwa Goïta, umugabane wa Leta mu mishinga y'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro wavuye kuri 20 % ugera kuri 35 %, Leta ikagira n'uburenganzira bwo kongeraho andi 10 %. Ibigo by'ubucukuzi bisabwa kwishyura imisoro mishya no kwishyura imisoro byari birimo, bitabikora bigahanwa bikomeye. Ashyigikira ko ibigo bihinduka ibya Leta, nk'uko byagenze ku birombe bibiri bya zahabu, Morila na Yatela, ubu biri mu maboko ya Leta yose. Igenzura ryategetswe na Goïta ryagaragaje ko hari "amakosa" mu masezerano y'ubucukuzi.
Assimi Goïta yiyerekana nk'"Umurinzi n'Umubohozi wa Mali" kandi nk'"umuntu udasanzwe mu bihe bidasanzwe", isura ijyanye n'imigani n'imigenzo ya Mali. Imvugo ye yo kubohora igihugu ifatwa nk'iy'abaharanira kubungabunga imigenzo bashingiye ku rubanda ("populisme conservateur"), aho kuba iy'impinduramatwara y'ibumoso.
Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2023 n'umuryango w'Abadage Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung bwagaragaje ko Abanyamali benshi cyane bishimiye ubutegetsi bw'inzibacyuho buyobowe na Assimi Goïta.
Assimi Goïta yashakanye na Lala Diallo. Ni Umuyisilamu.

Abdourahamane Tiani (rimwe na rimwe yandikwa Tchiani mu binyamakuru byo mu Burengerazuba; yavutse mu 1964 i Toukounous, mu karere ka Filingué, muri Nigeri) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyanijeri, akaba Perezida wa Nigeri kuva mu 2025. Afite ipeti rya Jenerali w'ingabo ("général d'armée").
Kuva mu 2011 kugeza mu 2023, yayoboye ingabo zirinda Perezida wa Repubulika. Muri Nyakanga 2023, yahiritse ku butegetsi Perezida Mohamed Bazoum, ayobora Akanama k'Igihugu gashinzwe Kurengera Igihugu ("Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie", CNSP), agatsiko k'abasirikare kafashe ubutegetsi. Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2025, yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Repubulika mu gihe cy'imyaka itanu.
Ku butegetsi bwe, Nigeri yavuye mu Muryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO), ishinga Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel (AES) hamwe na Mali na Burukina Faso, yirukana ingabo z'Ubufaransa n'iza Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, kandi yegera Uburusiya. Akunzwe na benshi mu gihugu kubera imvugo ye irwanya ubukoloni bushya kandi iharanira ubumwe bw'Afurika, ariko ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa nk'ubw'igitugu.
Abdourahamane Tiani yavutse mu 1964 mu muryango w'Abahawusa. Akomoka i Toukounous, mu Ntara ya Tillabéri, akarere k'iburengerazuba bw'igihugu gakunze kuvamo abasirikare benshi b'ingabo za Nigeri.
Yize amashuri abanza iwabo i Toukounous, akomereza muri "Collège d'enseignement général" (CEG) ya Filingué, arangiriza amashuri yisumbuye i Niamey, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye (baccalauréat série D) mu 1984. Uwo mwaka, yinjiye mu gisirikare, yiga mu Ishuri rikuru ry'abofisiye rya Thiès, muri Senegali.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Mbere yo kuyobora ingabo zirinda Perezida, yayoboye ingabo mu ntara za Zinder, Agadez na Diffa, aho yarwanyaga icuruzwa ry'ibiyobyabwenge. Yahawe amahugurwa y'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka i Montpellier mu Ubufaransa, i Benguerir muri Maroke n'i Koulikoro muri Mali, ndetse no muri "College of International Security Affairs" (CISA) i Washington, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika.
Mu 1989, ni we musirikare mukuru wa mbere wageze ahaguye indege ya UTA Flight 772 mu butayu bwa Ténéré, abiherwa umudari. Yakoze kandi mu butumwa bwo kubungabunga amahoro bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye muri Côte d'Ivoire, muri Sudani no muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ndetse no mu Ngabo zihuriweho n'ibihugu byinshi ("Force multinationale mixte") zashyizweho na Nigeri, Cadi, Nijeriya na Kameruni kurwanya Boko Haram.
Mu 2011, Perezida Mahamadou Issoufou yamugize umuyobozi w'ingabo zirinda Perezida, maze aba umwe mu bamwizeraga cyane; mu 2018, Issoufou yamuzamuye ku ipeti rya Jenerali wa burigade. Mu 2015, yashinjwe kugira uruhare mu mugambi wo guhirika Issoufou, ariko ahakana ibyo aregwa imbere y'urukiko.
Mu 2021, ni we wayoboye umutwe waburijemo umugambi wa kudeta, ubwo itsinda ry'abasirikare ryageragezaga gufata ingoro ya perezida, habura iminsi ibiri ngo Issoufou ahererekanye ubutegetsi n'uwamusimbuye watowe mu buryo bwa demokarasi, Mohamed Bazoum. Muri Mata 2021, Bazoum yamugumishije ku mwanya we. Tiani yagize uruhare mu kuburizamo imigambi ibiri ya kudeta yari igamije Bazoum, mbere y'uko na we amuhirika.
Ku wa 26 Nyakanga 2023, Tiani yategetse abasirikare barinda Perezida gufunga Bazoum mu nzu ye y'i Niamey. Bazoum yari ateganya kumukura ku mwanya we: nk'uko abamwegereye babivuga, yari yarabyemeje mu nama y'abaminisitiri yo ku wa 24 Nyakanga, kuko umubano wabo wari warazambye. Iyirukanwa rye n'ivugurura ry'ingabo zirinda Perezida byari biteganyijwe ku wa 27 Nyakanga 2023. Kuva icyo gihe, Bazoum n'umugore we Hadiza bafungiwe mu gice kimwe cy'inzu ya perezida.
Ku wa 28 Nyakanga 2023, nyuma y'iminsi ibiri y'imishyikirano mu ngabo, Tiani yagaragaye kuri televiziyo y'igihugu nka perezida wa CNSP. Yavuze ko kudeta yakozwe kugira ngo hirindwe "irimbuka rigenda buhoro buhoro kandi ridashobora kwirindwa" ry'igihugu, ashinja Bazoum guhisha "ukuri gukomeye" kw'igihugu, yise "ikirundo cy'abapfuye, abavuye mu byabo, ugusuzugurwa n'agahinda". Yanenze kandi ko ingamba z'umutekano za guverinoma nta musaruro zatanze.
Ku wa 4 Kanama 2023, yakoze impinduka za mbere mu ngabo: hafi abagaba bakuru bose b'ingabo basimbuwe, abamwegereye n'inshuti ze bazamurwa mu ntera. Ku wa 7 Kanama 2023, yagize Ali Lamine Zeine, wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Imari, Minisitiri w'Intebe. Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 9 Kanama 2023, mbere gato y'inama idasanzwe ya CEDEAO yerekeye Nigeri, CNSP yashyizeho guverinoma y'inzibacyuho, maze ku wa 11 Kanama ayobora inama ya mbere y'abaminisitiri.
CEDEAO yasubije kuri iyo kudeta ishyiraho ibihano bikaze kurusha ibindi byose yigeze gufatira igihugu kinyamuryango: gufunga imipaka yose na Nigeri, guhagarika ihererekanya ry'amafaranga no gufatira umutungo w'igihugu mu mabanki yo hanze, isaba ko Bazoum asubizwa ku butegetsi. Ku wa 19 Kanama 2023, mu ijambo yagejeje ku baturage, Tiani yatangaje ibiganiro by'igihugu bihuriweho na bose n'inzibacyuho y'imyaka itatu. Yamaganye ibihano bya CEDEAO, avuga ko "binyuranyije n'amategeko kandi bitarimo ubumuntu"; CEDEAO yo yanze iyo nzibacyuho y'imyaka itatu, isaba ko ubutegetsi buhita bushyikirizwa abasivili. Uwo munsi, intumwa za CEDEAO zari i Niamey zahuye n'agatsiko k'abasirikare ndetse na Bazoum wahiritswe. Ni bwo bwa nyuma bahuye na we.
Nigeri imaze kuva muri CEDEAO hamwe na Mali na Burkina Faso mu 2024, uwo muryango wakuyeho ibihano kubera impamvu z'ubutabazi.
Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel n'ububanyi n'amahanga.
Tiani yahuye n'abayobozi ba Mali na Burkina Faso, biyemeza gufatanya mu by'umutekano no muri politiki mu rwego rw'Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel (AES), ryabaye Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu ("Confédération") muri Nyakanga 2024. Ingabo za Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'iz'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi zavuye mu gihugu, maze Nigeri yegera Uburusiya; abacancuro b'itsinda rya Wagner boherejwe gufasha Nigeri kurwanya inyeshyamba z'abajihadi.
Mu Ukuboza 2024, Tiani yashinje Ubufaransa na Nijeriya gufatanya n'imitwe y'inyeshyamba kugira ngo bahungabanye ubutegetsi bwa Nigeri, ashinja kandi Nijeriya kwangiza umuyoboro wa peteroli ugana muri Bene; Nijeriya yahakanye ibyo birego.
Kuba Perezida wa Repubulika.
Kuva ku wa 15 kugeza ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2025, habaye inama nkuru y'ivugurura ry'igihugu ("assises de la refondation"). Yasabye ko Tiani agirwa Perezida wa Repubulika mu gihe cy'imyaka itanu ishobora kongerwa, ahabwa ipeti rya Jenerali w'ingabo, yemeza itegeko ry'ivugurura ("charte de la refondation") kandi isaba ko amashyaka ya politiki aseswa.
Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2025, yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Repubulika mu gihe cy'imyaka itanu, imbere y'uwahoze ari Perezida Mahamadou Issoufou n'intumwa z'Ihuriro ry'Ibihugu bya Sahel. Uwo munsi, yazamuwe ku ipeti rya Jenerali w'ingabo, ashyira umukono ku itegeko nshinga ry'inzibacyuho, maze asesa amashyaka yose ya politiki.
Abasesenguzi bavuga ko politiki ye y'imbere mu gihugu ifite intego eshatu z'ingenzi: kuvugurura igisirikare, guteza imbere ubukungu (harimo kugabanya kwishingikiriza kuri uraniyumu binyuze mu gushora imari mu buhinzi, ibikorwa remezo n'ingufu zisubira), no kurwanya ruswa.
Politiki y'imibereho myiza.
Tiani akurikiza politiki ishyigikira imigenzo gakondo. Yakuyeho itegeko No 2015-36 rirwanya icuruzwa ry'abimukira, ryabuzaga ivangura rishingiye ku mpamvu zitandukanye harimo n'icyerekezo cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina. Muri Kamena 2026, igitabo gishya cy'amategeko ahana cyashyizeho igifungo cy'imyaka 5 kugeza ku 10 ku bakora ubutinganyi.
Itegeko nshinga ry'inzibacyuho ryo mu 2025 ryagize Igihawusa ururimi rw'igihugu, Igifaransa kigabanyirizwa agaciro.
Politiki y'ubukungu.
Muri Ukwakira 2023, ibihano n'ihagarikwa ry'inkunga mpuzamahanga byatumye Nigeri iba kimwe mu bihugu bikennye cyane ku isi. Agatsiko k'abasirikare kagabanyije ingengo y'imari ya 2023 ho 40 %. Nijeriya, yahaga Nigeri 71 % by'amashanyarazi yayo mbere ya kudeta, yahagaritse kuyaha, ku buryo muri Ukwakira 2023 ikigo cya Leta Nigelec cyabashaga gutanga hagati ya kimwe cya kane na kimwe cya kabiri cy'amashanyarazi akenewe mu gihugu.
Muri Gashyantare 2024, hashyizweho itegeko rishya ryatumye amafaranga akoreshwa mu gisirikare atagengwa n'amategeko y'amasoko ya Leta, bigatuma kugura intwaro no gukoresha abacancuro byihuta. Muri Kamena 2024, ubutegetsi bwambuye ikigo cy'Abafaransa Orano uruhushya rwo gucukura uraniyumu mu kirombe cya Imouraren, kimwe mu binini ku isi, maze nyuma y'iminsi mike gitangaza ko icyo kirombe gisubijwe mu mutungo rusange wa Leta.
Umugambi wa kudeta wo mu 2026.
Muri Kanama 2026, abasirikare bigometse bagerageje guhirika Tiani i Niamey. Visi-perezida wa CNSP, Salifou Modi, yatangaje kuri televiziyo y'igihugu ko uwo mugambi waburijwemo.
Mu gihugu, hakwirakwijwe poropaganda n'indirimbo zimushyigikira. Umushakashatsi Taiwo Adeagbo avuga ko Abahawusa, ari bo benshi muri Nigeri, batashyigikiraga Bazoum kubera inkomoko ye y'Abarabu ba Ouled Slimane, maze bakaba abayoboke ba Tiani kubera imvugo ye ishingiye ku bwoko no ku rubanda.
Tiani arubatse, akaba afite abana batanu. Avuga Igifaransa, Igihawusa, Ikizarma n'Icyongereza.

Abdelmadjid Tebboune (mu Cyarabu: عبد المجيد تبون; wavutse ku wa 17 Ugushyingo 1945 i Mécheria, muri Aligeriya) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaligeriya, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Aligeriya akaba na Minisitiri w'Ingabo z'Igihugu kuva mu 2019.
Yabaye guverineri ("wali") w'intara nyinshi, aba minisitiri inshuro nyinshi ku butegetsi bwa Chadli Bendjedid na Abdelaziz Bouteflika, cyane cyane Minisitiri w'Imiturire. Yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe kuva muri Gicurasi kugeza muri Kanama 2017, ari we Minisitiri w'Intebe wamaze igihe gito kurusha abandi mu mateka y'igihugu. Mu Ukuboza 2019, nyuma y'imyigaragambyo ya "Hirak" yatumye Bouteflika yegura, yatorewe kuba Perezida wa Repubulika mu matora yitabiriwe na bake. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2024 ku majwi 84,3 %.
Ku butegetsi bwe, Itegeko Nshinga ryavuguruwe mu 2020 no mu 2026, ariko abanenga ubutegetsi bwe bavuga ko ubwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru n'ubw'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bwagabanutse. Mu bubanyi n'amahanga, umubano wa Aligeriya na Maroke n'Ubufaransa warazambye, mu gihe yegereye Uburusiya, Ubushinwa n'Ubutaliyani.
Umuryango n'amashuri.
Abdelmadjid Tebboune yavutse ku wa 17 Ugushyingo 1945 i Mécheria, mu ntara ya Naâma y'ubu, icyo gihe yari mu karere ka Aïn Sefra. Akomoka mu muryango wo muri komine ya Boussemghoun, mu ntara ya El-Bayadh y'ubu, mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bwa Aligeriya. Se, Ahmed Tebboune, yari "cheikh" wo mu Ishyirahamwe ry'Abamenyi b'Abayisilamu ba Aligeriya ("Association des oulémas musulmans algériens"), akaba n'umusirikare. Yarangije amashuri mu Ishuri rikuru ry'Igihugu ry'Ubuyobozi ("École nationale d'administration", ENA) mu 1969, mu gice cy'ubukungu n'imari.
Yatangiye akazi mu 1969 nk'umuyobozi w'imenyereza mu ntara ya Saoura; icyo gihe yinjiye mu ishyaka rya "Front de libération nationale" (FLN). Yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w'intara za Djelfa (1975–1976), Adrar (1977–1979), Blida (1979–1982) na M'Sila (1982–1983). Nyuma yaho yabaye guverineri ("wali") w'intara ya Adrar (1983–1984), iya Tiaret (1984–1989) n'iya Tizi Ouzou (1989–1991).
Urugendo muri politiki.
Muri Kamena 1991, yagizwe Minisitiri wungirije ushinzwe inzego z'ibanze muri guverinoma ya Sid Ahmed Ghozali, ava muri guverinoma mu 1992. Mu 1999, Perezida Abdelaziz Bouteflika yamugize Minisitiri w'Itumanaho n'Umuco, nyuma y'amezi atandatu asubizwa ku mwanya wa Minisitiri wungirije ushinzwe inzego z'ibanze. Mu 2001, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Imiturire n'Imigi, umwanya yamazeho kugeza mu 2002. Muri icyo gihe, izina rye ryavuzwe mu rubanza rwa "Khalifa", rwerekeye isenyuka ry'itsinda ry'ibigo by'umucuruzi Rafik Khalifa.
Ku wa 3 Nzeri 2012, yongeye kugirwa Minisitiri w'Imiturire n'Imigi muri guverinoma ya Abdelmalek Sellal, umwanya yagumyeho kugeza mu 2017. Ku wa 19 Mutarama 2017, nyuma y'urupfu rwa Bakhti Belaïb, yahawe n'umwanya wa Minisitiri w'Ubucuruzi w'agateganyo.
Minisitiri w'Intebe (2017).
Ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2017, nyuma y'amatora y'abadepite, Bouteflika yamugize Minisitiri w'Intebe asimbura Abdelmalek Sellal; icyo gihe yafatwaga nk'inshuti y'umugaba mukuru w'ingabo, Ahmed Gaïd Salah. Guverinoma ye yashyizweho ku wa 25 Gicurasi.
Ku wa 15 Kanama 2017, nyuma y'amezi atageze kuri atatu, Bouteflika yaramwirukanye amusimbuza Ahmed Ouyahia. Impamvu zavuzwe ni ubushake bwe bwo kugabanya ibitumizwa mu mahanga no kurwanya ruswa, ndetse n'icyo ibiro bya perezida byise "gutoteza abacuruzi". Muri Nyakanga, guverinoma ye yari yihanangirije ibigo binini byari byatsindiye amasoko ya Leta, harimo ikigo ETRHB cy'umucuruzi Ali Haddad, wari inshuti ya Saïd Bouteflika, murumuna wa Perezida. Yabaye atyo Minisitiri w'Intebe wamaze igihe gito kurusha abandi mu mateka ya Aligeriya. Izo ngamba zatumye akundwa n'abaturage, avugwa nk'ushobora gusimbura Bouteflika.
Amatora ya perezida yo mu 2019.
Muri Nzeri 2019, mu gihe cy'imyigaragambyo ya "Hirak" yari yatumye Bouteflika yegura, yatangaje ko aziyamamaza mu matora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza. Yiyita "umukandida w'abaturage", yasezeranyije kuvugurura Itegeko Nshinga n'itegeko ry'amatora no gushyiraho "demokarasi nyayo". Abigaragambyaga baramwamaganye, abamunenga bakamwita "umukandida w'igisirikare".
Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 2019, yatowe ku majwi 58 % mu cyiciro cya mbere, mu matora abantu batageze kuri 40 % bitabiriye, atsinze abakandida b'amashyaka abiri makuru, FLN na RND. Abasesenguzi bamwe bavuze ko imibare yatangajwe "iteye amakenga". Mu kiganiro cye cya mbere n'abanyamakuru nyuma yo gutorwa, yavuze ko arambuye ukuboko kuri "Hirak" kandi ashyigikiye ibiganiro.
Perezida wa Repubulika.
Irahira n'ingamba za mbere.
Ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2019, yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Rubanda ya Aligeriya. Ni we Perezida wa mbere wa Aligeriya utarabaye umurwanyi ("moudjahid") mu ntambara y'ubwigenge, akaba kandi ari we wari ukuze kurusha abandi atangiye manda. Yasabye ko atazongera kwitwa "Nyakubahwa" ("Excellence"), izina ryari ryarakoreshejwe cyane ku butegetsi bwa Bouteflika. Ku wa 28 Ukuboza 2019, yagize Abdelaziz Djerad Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga.
Ku wa 8 Mutarama 2020, yashyizeho akanama k'impuguke 17, abenshi bakaba ari abarimu b'amategeko nshinga, kayobowe na Ahmed Laraba, gashinzwe gutegura ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga. Yagasabye kwibanda ku ngingo zirindwi, harimo kongera uburenganzira bw'abaturage, kurwanya ruswa, kuringaniza ububasha, kwigenga kw'ubucamanza, no gushyiraho manda ebyiri gusa ku mukuru w'igihugu, "zidashobora guhinduka". Umushinga watangajwe ku wa 7 Gicurasi 2020 wanenzwe kuko utahinduraga ubutegetsi bushingiye cyane kuri perezida.
Kamarampaka yo ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2020 yemeje iryo vugurura ku majwi 66,8 %, ariko abitabiriye bari 23 % gusa; Tebboune yashyize umukono ku iteka ririshyira mu bikorwa ku wa 30 Ukuboza 2020. Ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2021, yasheshe Inteko Ishinga Amategeko (APN), ategeka amatora y'abadepite mbere y'igihe.
Mu 2026, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yemeje ku bwiganze busesuye irindi vugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga. Abahanga mu mategeko barimo Massensen Cherbi na Mouloud Boumghar bavuga ko iryo vugurura ryongereye ububasha bwa Perezida. Nyuma y'inkongi z'amashyamba zo mu 2026, Tebboune yasabye ko igitabo cy'amategeko ahana kivugururwa kugira ngo abatwika amashyamba bahanishwe igihano cy'urupfu.
Umuhanga mu mateka Jean-Pierre Filiu avuga ko umugaba mukuru w'ingabo, Saïd Chengriha, ari we ufite ububasha bukomeye kurusha Perezida; ikinyamakuru "Jeune Afrique" cyo kivuga ko bombi ari bo bagabo babiri bakomeye kurusha abandi mu gihugu.
"Hirak" n'ubwisanzure.
Muri Gashyantare 2020, Tebboune yavuze ko "Hirak" ari "ikintu cyiza cyakijije igihugu", maze ashyiraho ku wa 22 Gashyantare "Umunsi w'igihugu w'ubuvandimwe n'ubumwe hagati y'abaturage n'ingabo zabo kubera demokarasi". Ku wa 17 Werurwe 2020, mu rwego rwo kurwanya icyorezo cya COVID-19, yabujije imyigaragambyo yose. Amnesty International yamaganye ko, mu gihe amaso yose yari ku cyorezo, ubutegetsi bwihutishaga ikurikiranwa n'imanza z'abarwanashyaka, abanyamakuru n'abashyigikiye "Hirak".
Ku wa 1 Werurwe 2020, avuga ku ifungwa ry'abanyamakuru barimo Khaled Drareni, yavuze ko bamwe muri bo bakorera itangazamakuru ry'amahanga "ritewe inkunga n'amahanga" kugira ngo risenye inzego z'igihugu. Ku wa 15 Nzeri 2020, Drareni yakatiwe mu bujurire igifungo cy'imyaka ibiri. Ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2021, Tebboune yahaye imbabazi abantu bagera kuri 60 bari bafunzwe kubera "Hirak". Ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2024, ku isabukuru y'imyaka 70 y'itangazo ryo ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 1954, yahaye imbabazi imfungwa zirenga 4 000, barimo umunyamakuru Ihsane El Kadi.
Indwara ya COVID-19.
Muri Ukwakira 2020, byatangajwe ko Tebboune yanduye COVID-19; ku wa 28 Ukwakira yajyanywe mu Budage kuvurwa, Minisitiri w'Intebe Abdelaziz Djerad amusimbura mu mirimo ye. Yagarutse muri Aligeriya ku wa 29 Ukuboza 2020, asubira i Berlin ku wa 10 Mutarama 2021 kubagwa ikirenge kubera ingaruka za COVID-19, agaruka ku wa 12 Gashyantare 2021.
Ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2022, yatangaje ko urubyiruko rufite hagati y'imyaka 19 na 40 rudafite akazi ruzajya ruhabwa amafaranga y'ingoboka, mu gihe ubushomeri bwari burenze 15 %. Nyuma y'igitero cy'Uburusiya kuri Ukraine, yemereye Ubutaliyani n'Uburayi kongererwa gaze; ku wa 18 Nyakanga 2022, yasinyanye na Minisitiri w'Intebe w'Ubutaliyani Mario Draghi amasezerano y'agaciro ka miliyari 4 z'amayero, bituma Aligeriya iba igihugu cya mbere gihaye Ubutaliyani gaze nyinshi. Muri Nzeri 2022, yatangaje ko ashaka gutandukanya ubukungu bw'igihugu no kongera ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bitari peteroli na gaze.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Mu gihe cy'intambara yo muri Libiya, Aligeriya yongeye kugira uruhare muri icyo kibazo; Tebboune yitabiriye inama ya Berlin yerekeye Libiya ku wa 19 Mutarama 2020, kandi muri Nyakanga 2021 yemereye Libiya "ubufasha bwuzuye" ubwo yakiraga Mohamed el-Menfi. Ku wa 24 Mutarama 2022, yasuye Perezida wa Misiri Abdel Fattah al-Sissi i Kayiro, akaba ari bwo bwa mbere Perezida wa Aligeriya yari asuye Misiri kuva mu 2008.
Ku wa 27 Gicurasi 2020, nyuma y'ishyirwa ahagaragara rya filime mbarankuru ebyiri ku "Hirak" kuri televiziyo z'Abafaransa, Aligeriya yahamagaje ambasaderi wayo i Paris. Ku wa 7 Gicurasi 2020, yagize ku wa 8 Gicurasi "umunsi wo kwibuka" ubwicanyi bwabereye i Sétif, Guelma na Kherrata mu 1945, kandi yashimye icyemezo cy'Ubufaransa cyo gusubiza Aligeriya ibihanga by'abarwanyi 24 bishwe mu gihe cy'ubukoloni. Mu Ukuboza 2022, yakiriye Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Ubufaransa Gérald Darmanin, bakemura ikibazo cya viza zari zaragabanyijwe kuva muri Nzeri 2021.
Kuva mu 2021, Aligeriya na Maroke bafitanye amakimbirane ya dipolomasi nyuma y'aho Maroke isubukuriye umubano na Isiraheli; ibihugu byombi bihanganye ku kibazo cya Sahara y'Iburengerazuba, aho Aligeriya ishyigikira ubwigenge bwayo. Aligeriya ifitanye umubano wihariye na Tuniziya ya Kaïs Saïed. Ku wa 13 Kamena 2023, yatangiye uruzinduko rw'iminsi itatu mu Burusiya, aho we na Vladimir Putin biyemeje gukomeza "ubufatanye bw'ingenzi" hagati y'ibihugu byombi; kuva ku wa 17 kugeza ku wa 21 Nyakanga 2023, yasuye Ubushinwa. Mu 2024, yanenze intambara ya Isiraheli muri Gaza, ayishinja jenoside ku Banyapalestina.
Muri Mutarama 2024, yamaganye "ibikorwa by'ubwanzi" bya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu, azishinja gushaka guhungabanya Aligeriya n'umubano wayo n'abaturanyi bayo, nka Mali, Nigeri na Libiya, kugira ngo zishyigikire Maroke. Ku wa 10 Nzeri 2026, Aligeriya yacanye umubano wa dipolomasi na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu, yirukana ambasaderi wazo.
Amatora ya perezida yo mu 2024.
Muri Gicurasi 2024, ishyaka El Bina rya Abdelkader Bengrina ryatangaje ko rishyigikiye Perezida uriho, maze Tebboune yemeza kandidatire ye ku wa 11 Nyakanga. Mu kwiyamamaza, yakoreshaga cyane urubuga rwa TikTok, bimuhesha akazina ka "Tonton Tebboune" (Nyirarume Tebboune) ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.
Ku wa 7 Nzeri 2024, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 84,3 %. Imibare y'abitabiriye amatora, yavuye kuri 26,46 % igera kuri 48,03 % mu masaha atatu, yateje impaka mu bakurikiranira hafi amatora n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Ibyavuye mu matora bya nyuma, byatangajwe ku wa 14 Nzeri, byari bitandukanye cyane n'iby'agateganyo: amajwi ya Tebboune yavuye kuri 94,65 % agera kuri 84,30 %.
Tebboune yashakanye na Fatima Zohra Bella, bafitanye abana batanu: Saloua, Maha, Salaheddine Ilyes, Mohamed na Khaled. Umuhungu we Khaled yafunzwe muri Kamena 2018 mu rubanza rwa ruswa, agirwa umwere muri Gashyantare 2020. Tebboune azwiho kunywa itabi cyane.
Kuva Liamine Zéroual yapfa mu 2026, ni we Perezida wa Aligeriya wenyine ukiriho.

João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço (wavutse ku wa 5 Werurwe 1954 i Lobito, muri Angola) ni umujenerali n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyangola, akaba Perezida wa gatatu wa Repubulika ya Angola kuva ku wa 26 Nzeri 2017. Kuva muri Nzeri 2018, ni na we Perezida w'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi, "Movimento Popular de Libertação de Angola" (MPLA).
Yarwanye intambara y'ubwigenge bwa Angola, yiga amateka mu Ubumwe bw'Abasoviyeti, nyuma aba guverineri w'intara, umunyamabanga mukuru wa MPLA (1998–2003), visi-perezida wa mbere w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko (2003–2014) na Minisitiri w'Ingabo (2014–2017). Yasimbuye José Eduardo dos Santos wari umaze imyaka 38 ku butegetsi.
Ku butegetsi bwe, yarwanyije ruswa n'ikimenyane by'umuryango wa dos Santos, ndetse yegereza Angola ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2022. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2025 kugeza muri Gashyantare 2026, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika, kandi yabaye umuhuza mu makimbirane yo mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Lourenço yakuriye mu muryango w'abana icumi wari ufite ibitekerezo bya politiki. Se, Sequeira João Lourenço (1923–1999), wakomokaga i Malanje, yari umuganga akaba n'uharanira ubwigenge, wafunzwe imyaka itatu n'ubutegetsi bw'abakoloni b'Abanyaporutigali azira ibikorwa bya politiki. Nyina, Josefa Gonçalves Cipriano Lourenço (1928–1997), wakomokaga i Namibe, yari umudozi. Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye mu ntara ya Bié n'i Luanda.
Amashuri n'urugendo mu gisirikare.
Yize mu Ishuri ry'Inganda rya Luanda. Muri Kanama 1974, nyuma y'isenyuka ry'ubutegetsi bw'abakoloni b'Abanyaporutigali, yari mu itsinda rya mbere ry'abasirikare ba MPLA binjiye mu gihugu banyuze i Miconge, berekeza mu mujyi wa Cabinda. Yarwanye intambara y'ubwigenge bwa Angola, nyuma arwana ku ruhande rwa MPLA mu ntambara y'abenegihugu.
Yahuguwe mu by'imbunda nini ("artillerie"), aba umusirikare ushinzwe politiki muri MPLA. Kuva mu 1978 kugeza mu 1982, yize mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare n'irya politiki rya Lenin mu Bumwe bw'Abasoviyeti, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu mateka. Yabaye komiseri w'intara, hanyuma umuyobozi w'ishami rikuru rya politiki ry'Ingabo za rubanda zo kubohora Angola (FAPLA).
Urugendo muri politiki.
Mu 1984, yagizwe guverineri w'intara ya Moxico, maze muri Mata 1986, Perezida José Eduardo dos Santos amugira guverineri w'intara ya Benguela. Kuva mu 1992 kugeza mu 1997, yari umunyamabanga ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri MPLA, naho kuva mu 1993 kugeza mu 1998 ayobora itsinda ry'abadepite ba MPLA mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko.
Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 1998, yatorewe kuba umunyamabanga mukuru wa MPLA, bavuga ko ari ku bw'ubushake bwa dos Santos, ndetse abantu bakeka ko ashobora kuzamusimbura. Ariko mu 2001, ubwo dos Santos yavugaga ko atazongera kwiyamamaza, Lourenço yagaragaje ku mugaragaro ko yifuza kuba umukandida wa MPLA; ibyo byamuteranyije na dos Santos, utari afite umugambi nyakuri wo kuva ku butegetsi, ahubwo washakaga kumenya abo bahanganye. Mu Ukuboza 2003, yasimbuwe ku mwanya w'umunyamabanga mukuru wa MPLA.
Kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2014, yabaye visi-perezida wa mbere w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Muri Mata 2014, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ingabo, maze muri Kanama 2016 agirwa visi-perezida wa MPLA.
Manda ya mbere (2017–2022).
Mu Ukuboza 2016, MPLA yamutoranyije kuba umukandida wayo wa mbere ku rutonde rw'amatora y'abadepite yo muri Kanama 2017. Yafatwaga nk'umuntu w'inararibonye wo mu ishyaka, ushyira mu gaciro. Muri Gashyantare 2017, dos Santos yatangaje ku mugaragaro ko atazongera kwiyamamaza, kandi ko Lourenço ari we mukandida wa MPLA. Nk'uko Itegeko Nshinga ryo mu 2010 ribiteganya, umuntu uri ku isonga ry'urutonde rw'ishyaka ribonye amajwi menshi mu matora rusange ahita aba Perezida wa Repubulika. MPLA imaze gutsinda amatora ibona imyanya 150, Lourenço yabaye Perezida, ararahira ku wa 26 Nzeri 2017.
Lourenço yarwanyije ikimenyane cyari cyarashyizweho n'uwo yasimbuye: mu Ugushyingo 2017, yirukanye Isabel dos Santos, umukobwa wa dos Santos, ku buyobozi bw'ikigo cya peteroli cya Leta Sonangol; muri Mutarama 2018, yirukana José Filomeno dos Santos, umuhungu we, ku buyobozi bw'ikigega cy'igihugu cy'ishoramari. Nyamara, umuryango wa dos Santos wakomeje kugenzura ibice byinshi by'ubukungu bwa Angola. Mu 2018, yasimbuje umuyobozi w'inzego z'iperereza (SINSE), hanyuma n'umugaba mukuru w'ingabo, nyuma y'uko aregwa mu rubanza rwa ruswa.
Ku wa 8 Nzeri 2018, mu nama nkuru ya MPLA, yatorewe kuyobora iryo shyaka ku majwi 98,59 %, asimbura dos Santos. Nyamara, igihugu cyakomeje guhura n'ibibazo by'ubukungu: ubukungu bwasubiye inyuma mu 2018, ubushomeri bugera hafi kuri 20 %, n'izamuka ry'ibiciro rikomeza kuba hejuru.
Muri Kamena 2018, Lourenço yemeye ishyirahamwe rya mbere ry'abaryamana bahuje ibitsina muri Angola. Muri Mutarama 2019, yakuyeho itegeko ry'abakoloni ryo mu 1886 ryahanaga ubutinganyi, abuza ivangura ribakorerwa, kandi yemera gukuramo inda iyo umugore yafashwe ku ngufu cyangwa ubuzima bwe cyangwa ubw'umwana buri mu kaga.
Ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2019, mu ruzinduko muri Kiba, yahawe umudari wa José Martí, ari wo mudari usumba iyindi muri icyo gihugu. Mu 2021, yasabye imbabazi ku mugaragaro ku bw'ubwicanyi bwakozwe mu guhashya umugambi wa kudeta wo ku wa 27 Gicurasi 1977, wahitanye abantu ibihumbi. Muri Nzeri 2020, umuyobozi w'ibiro bye, Edeltrudes Costa, yashinjwe n'iperereza ry'abanyamakuru kunyereza umutungo wa Leta, bituma abigaragambya i Luanda basaba ko yirukanwa.
Manda ya kabiri (kuva 2022).
Manda ye ya mbere yaranzwe cyane no kurwanya ruswa, ariko politiki ye y'ubukungu (gutandukanya inkomoko y'amafaranga y'igihugu no kwegurira abikorera ibigo bya Leta) ntiyagabanyije ubukene, bituma akundwa na bake. Mu matora rusange yo muri Kanama 2022, MPLA yabonye 51,17 % by'amajwi, ishyaka rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, UNITA, ribona 43,95 %. UNITA yanze ibyavuye mu matora, ariko Lourenço yongera kuba Perezida.
Ku butegetsi bwe, Angola, yari ifitanye umubano wihariye n'Ubumwe bw'Abasoviyeti hanyuma n'Uburusiya, yegereye ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba; mu 2024, Joe Biden yabaye Perezida wa mbere wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika usuye Angola. Muri Nyakanga 2025, imyigaragambyo yamagana izamuka ry'igiciro cya lisansi yahitanye abantu 22 mu minsi itatu, mu gihugu aho 40 % by'abaturage bari munsi y'umurongo w'ubukene. Mbere y'uko manda ye irangira, yihutishije kwegurira abikorera ibigo bya Leta; Itegeko Nshinga ntirimwemerera kwiyamamaza mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2027.
Ubumwe bwa Afurika n'ubuhuza.
Kuva ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2025 kugeza ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2026, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika. Yafashije kandi mu biganiro na Perezida wa Gabon Brice Oligui Nguema, byatumye uwo yahiritse ku butegetsi mu 2023, Ali Bongo, n'umuryango we barekurwa bajya kuba i Luanda. Mu 2025, yatanzwe nk'umukandida w'Igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel cy'Amahoro.
Kuva muri Nyakanga 2022 kugeza muri Werurwe 2025, yari umuhuza washyizweho n'Ubumwe bwa Afurika mu nzira y'amahoro yiswe "Processus de Luanda", igamije kugarura amahoro mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yateguye inama nyinshi i Luanda zahuje abayobozi ba Kongo, u Rwanda n'abandi, zivamo amasezerano yo guhagarika imirwano, nubwo akenshi yarenzwagaho n'umutwe wa M23. Muri Werurwe 2024, yasubukuye ibiganiro, bivamo andi masezerano yo guhagarika imirwano muri Nyakanga 2024. Nyuma y'inama yo ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2024 yari igamije guhuza Félix Tshisekedi na Paul Kagame ariko ntiyabe, n'ukwanga kw'abarwanyi ba M23 kwitabira ibiganiro byo ku wa 18 Werurwe 2025, Angola yatangaje ko ihagaritse ubuhuza bwayo.
Yashakanye na Ana Afonso Dias Lourenço, umudepite wa MPLA wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Igenamigambi (1997–2012) akaba yarakoreye Banki y'Isi. Bafitanye abakobwa batatu; afite kandi umuhungu w'imfura, Henrique Manuel Pires Lourenço, yabyaranye n'undi mugore, n'abandi bana babiri. Uretse Igiporutigali, avuga Ikirusiya, Icyesipanyolo n'Icyongereza. Akiri muto, yakinaga karate (afite umukandara w'umukara) n'umupira w'amaguru; akunda gusoma, gukina échecs no kugendera ku mafarashi.

Kossi Mbueke Romuald Wadagni (wavutse ku wa 20 Kamena 1976 i Lokossa, muri Bene) ni umuhanga mu ibaruramari n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyabene, akaba Perezida wa cyenda wa Repubulika ya Bene kuva ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2026.
Yamaze imyaka 17 akorera ikigo mpuzamahanga cy'igenzura n'ubujyanama Deloitte mu Ubufaransa, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika no muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mu 2016, Perezida Patrice Talon yamugize Minisitiri w'Ubukungu n'Imari, umwanya yamazeho imyaka icumi, avugurura cyane ubukungu bw'igihugu no gucunga imyenda ya Leta.
Mu matora ya perezida yo muri Mata 2026, ashyigikiwe na Talon n'amashyaka ari ku butegetsi, yatsinze ku majwi agera kuri 94 %.
Romuald Wadagni yavukiye i Lokossa ku wa 20 Kamena 1976, akaba ari imfura mu bana batanu. Se, Nestor Wadagni, wari impuguke mu ibarurishamibare n'ubukungu wize muri ENSAE, yakoze imirimo ikomeye mu butegetsi bwa Bene, maze amaze kujya mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru yandika igitabo cy'ubushakashatsi (thèse) mu mibare; nyina ni umushoramari. Akiri muto, yakundaga imirimo y'amaboko, yiga ubwubatsi n'ubukanishi.
Amaze kubona impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye mu bumenyi muri Bene, yakomereje amashuri mu Bufaransa. Kuva mu 1995 kugeza mu 1999, yize muri "École supérieure des affaires" (ESA) ya Grenoble, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu by'imari ari uwa mbere mu ishuri rye. Ari i Grenoble, yahuye n'umufatanyabikorwa wa Deloitte wamushyize muri icyo kigo mu 1998.
Umwuga muri Deloitte.
Arangije amashuri, yakoreye ibiro bya Deloitte i Lyon imyaka ine. Mu 2003, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'umuhanga mu ibaruramari wo muri Amerika ("Certified Public Accountant"), ajya i Boston aho yabaye umuyobozi w'igenzura ("Audit Manager") kugeza mu 2006, akorana n'ibigo binini nka Orange. Mu 2007, yahuguriwe muri "Harvard Business School" mu by'ishoramari.
Mu 2012, afite imyaka 36, yabaye umufatanyabikorwa ("associé") wa Deloitte, akaba ari we wari ukiri muto kurusha abandi mu mateka y'icyo kigo. Uwo mwaka, yafunguye ibiro bya Deloitte i Kinshasa n'i Lubumbashi. Muri Ugushyingo 2015, yagizwe umuyobozi w'igenzura muri Afurika ivuga Igifaransa. Mu 2016, yari amaze imyaka 17 akorera Deloitte i Paris, Lyon, Boston, New York na Lubumbashi, azwiho ubuhanga mu mahame mpuzamahanga y'ibaruramari (IFRS).
Minisitiri w'Ubukungu n'Imari (2016–2026).
Ku wa 7 Mata 2016, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ubukungu n'Imari muri guverinoma ya mbere ya Patrice Talon. Mu gihugu cyari kiremerewe n'imyenda, yashyize imbere gutunganya imari ya Leta kugira ngo Bene yizerwe n'abaterankunga, ashyiraho politiki yo gucunga imyenda hakiri kare. Ibyo byatumye igihugu kibasha kuguza igihe kirekire no ku nyungu ziri hasi ugereranyije n'ibindi bihugu byo mu karere nka Côte d'Ivoire na Senegali.
Muri Ukwakira 2018, yashakiye Bene inguzanyo ya miliyoni 260 z'amayero ku masoko mpuzamahanga, ubwa mbere mu mateka y'igihugu. Muri Werurwe 2019, yayoboye isohorwa rya mbere ry'impapuro mpeshamwenda mpuzamahanga ("eurobond") za Bene, zifite agaciro ka miliyoni 500 z'amayero. Ku wa 12 Mutarama 2021, Bene yasohoye "eurobonds" ebyiri, harimo imwe y'imyaka 31, bituma iba mu bihugu bike bikizamuka bifite impapuro nk'izo zirengeje imyaka 30. Muri Nyakanga 2021, Bene yabaye igihugu cya mbere cya Afurika gisohoye "eurobond" igenewe gutera inkunga imishinga y'Intego z'Iterambere Rirambye z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 500 z'amayero. Ku wa 29 Ugushyingo 2021, Bene yishyuye mbere y'igihe igice cy'umwenda wayo, bituma izigama miliyoni 55 z'amayero z'inyungu.
Mu gihe cy'icyorezo cya COVID-19, ubukungu bwa Bene bwakomeje guhagarara neza: mu 2021 bwazamutseho 7,2 %. Muri Werurwe 2021, ikigo Moody's cyazamuye amanota y'igihugu kuva kuri B2 kugera kuri B1. Mu 2020, nk'uko UNCTAD ibivuga, Bene yabaye igihugu cya mbere ku isi aho gushinga ikigo byoroshye kandi byihuta kurusha ahandi. Kuva mu 2018 kugeza mu 2020, yayoboye Inama y'Abaminisitiri ya UEMOA, ayobora amavugurura arimo n'irya "franc CFA", Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere yise "ay'amateka".
Muri Gicurasi 2021, Talon yamugumishije ku mwanya we. Mu 2022, mu gihe cy'ingaruka za COVID-19 n'intambara yo muri Ukraine, guverinoma yashoye miliyari 41 z'amafaranga CFA mu kugabanya ibiciro by'ibicuruzwa by'ibanze. Muri Mata 2022, yayoboye intumwa za Bene i Washington, bagirana na FMI amasezerano y'inkunga ya miliyoni 700 z'amadolari. Mu ntangiriro za 2023, Talon yamwongereye inshingano z'ubufatanye mpuzamahanga n'iz'umutekano, cyane cyane kurinda amajyaruguru y'igihugu no kugura ibikoresho bya gisirikare.
Muri Gashyantare 2024, Bene yasohoye impapuro mpeshamwenda za mbere mu madolari y'Amerika, ibona miliyoni 750 z'amadolari. Muri Mata 2024, ikigo Standard &amp; Poor's cyazamuye amanota y'inguzanyo ya Bene kuva kuri "B+" kugera kuri "BB−", rikaba rimwe mu manota meza muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara nyuma ya Botswana, Maurice na Côte d'Ivoire. Muri Gicurasi 2024, ubushakashatsi bwa "Open Budget Survey" bwashyize Bene ku mwanya wa mbere mu bihugu bivuga Igifaransa mu bijyanye no gukorera mu mucyo mu ngengo y'imari. Muri Ugushyingo 2024, muri COP 29 i Bakou, yatanze gahunda yo gutera inkunga urugamba rwo kurwanya imihindagurikire y'ibihe. Mu ntangiriro za 2025, abantu benshi bifuzaga ko yiyamamariza kuyobora Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere, ariko ntiyabikora.
Ku wa 31 Kanama 2025, amashyaka abiri ashyigikiye Perezida, UPR na BR, yamutoranyije kuba umukandida wayo mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2026, nyuma y'inama yabereye kwa Patrice Talon. Wadagni ntabarizwa mu ishyaka na rimwe. Talon ntiyari yemerewe kwiyamamaza manda ya gatatu. Uwo bafatanyije kwiyamamaza ku mwanya wa visi-perezida yari Mariam Chabi Talata, visi-perezida wari usanzweho.
Mu matora yo ku wa 12 Mata 2026, yatsinze ku majwi 94,05 %. Umukandida w'ishyaka ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi "Les Démocrates" ntiyabashije kwiyamamaza kubera kutabona abamushyigikira ("parrainages") bahagije. Abitabiriye amatora bari 58,75 %, kandi CEDEAO yashimye uko amatora yagenze. Nk'uko TV5 Monde ibivuga, intsinzi ye yashingiye ku cyizere yari yaragiriwe kubera amavugurura y'ubukungu yakoze ari Minisitiri w'Imari.
Ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2026, yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Bene mu gihe cy'imyaka irindwi, asimbura Patrice Talon, kandi uwo munsi ashyiraho guverinoma ye. Ku wa 1 Kamena 2026, yakoreye urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga ari Perezida muri Nijeriya.
Romuald Wadagni afite abana babiri.

Duma Gideon Boko (wavutse ku wa 31 Ukuboza 1969 i Mahalapye, muri Botswana) ni umunyamategeko n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyabotswana, akaba Perezida wa gatandatu wa Repubulika ya Botswana kuva ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2024.
Yayoboye ishyaka "Botswana National Front" (BNF) kuva mu 2010, ashinga ihuriro ry'amashyaka atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi "Umbrella for Democratic Change" (UDC), aba Umuyobozi w'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2019. Mu matora rusange yo mu 2024, yatsinze ishyaka "Botswana Democratic Party" (BDP) ryari ku butegetsi kuva igihugu kibona ubwigenge mu 1966: ni bwo bwa mbere mu mateka ya Botswana ubutegetsi bwahererekanyijwe hagati y'amashyaka.
Afatwa nk'uharanira demokarasi ishingiye ku mibereho myiza y'abaturage ("social-démocrate").
Duma Boko yavukiye i Mahalapye, umudugudu wo mu Ntara yo Hagati, uri ku birometero 200 mu majyaruguru y'umurwa mukuru Gaborone. Se, witabye Imana mu 2004, yari umwarimu muri Madiba Brigades. Mu 1987, yatangiye kwiga amategeko muri Kaminuza ya Botswana, aho yatorewe kujya mu nama ihagarariye abanyeshuri; arangiza mu 1993, akomereza muri "Harvard Law School" muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu mategeko (LLM) mu 1995.
Kuva mu 1993 kugeza mu 2003, yigishije amategeko muri Kaminuza ya Botswana, anayobora ikigo cy'abavoka. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000, yandikaga inkuru mu kinyamakuru "The Monitor", anenga abacamanza n'abashakashatsi kudakora ubushakashatsi buhagije.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Boko yinjiye mu ishyaka rya "Botswana National Front" afite imyaka 21, aryobora kuva mu 2010. Abatavuga rumwe na we bamureze mu nkiko bavuga ko ubwo BNF yacikagamo ibice mu 2000 yari yabaye umwe mu bashinze "National Democratic Front", ariko atsinda urwo rubanza. BNF yifatanyije n'amashyaka "Botswana Movement for Democracy" na "Botswana Peoples Party" bashinga ihuriro "Umbrella for Democratic Change" (UDC); abayoboke bamwe ba BNF baramureze, ariko atsinda imanza zose.
Mu matora rusange yo mu 2014, UDC iyobowe na Boko yabaye iya kabiri, ibona imyanya 17 ku 37 ya BDP, maze aba Umuyobozi w'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Mu matora yo mu 2019, yatsinzwe na Anna Mokgethi wa BDP mu ntara y'itora ya Gaborone Bonnington North, atakaza uwo mwanya. Yavuze ko habayeho uburiganya bukomeye mu matora bugamije gufasha Perezida Mokgweetsi Masisi.
Mu matora rusange yo mu 2024, yongeye kuba umukandida wa UDC ku nshuro ya gatatu, afatanyije na Ndaba Gaolathe ku mwanya wa visi-perezida. Yiyamamaje avuga ko azatandukanya ubukungu bw'igihugu kugira ngo budashingira gusa ku bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, kandi azazamura imishahara, amafaranga ahabwa abanyeshuri n'izabukuru. Yasezeranyije kandi guha impushya z'akazi no gutura Abanyazimbabwe benshi badafite ibyangombwa bari mu gihugu, no kongera kuganira ku masezerano y'ubufatanye na sosiyete ya De Beers mu bijyanye na diyama.
Ku wa 30 Ukwakira 2024, ihuriro rye ryabonye imyanya 36 kuri 69 mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, mu gihe BDP isigarana imyanya ine gusa. Perezida Masisi yemeye ko yatsinzwe, aba Perezida wa mbere wa Botswana utongeye gutorwa.
Perezida wa Botswana.
Duma Boko yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2024, habaho n'undi muhango rusange ku wa 8 Ugushyingo. Ni we Perezida wa mbere utaravuye muri BDP, n'uwa mbere wavutse nyuma y'ubwigenge. Ni bwo bwa mbere kuva mu 1966 ishyaka ryahoze ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ritsinze amatora.
Mu ijambo rye rya mbere ku miterere y'igihugu, mu Ugushyingo 2024, yavuze ko guverinoma ye izateza imbere ingufu z'izuba, urumogi rukoreshwa mu buvuzi n'ikivuguto cy'inganda ("chanvre"), kandi ko yaganiriye na Elon Musk ku kugeza interineti ku gihugu cyose binyuze kuri Starlink. Muri Werurwe 2025, Botswana yohereje mu kirere icyogajuru cyayo cya mbere, BOTSAT-1, kivuye ku bibuga bya SpaceX muri Kaliforuniya.
Ku wa 25 Kanama 2025, yatangaje ibihe bidasanzwe by'ubuzima mu gihugu cyose, kubera ibura ry'imiti n'ibikoresho byo kwa muganga ryatewe n'ingengo y'imari idahagije n'igabanuka ry'inkunga ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika (USAID). Nyuma y'iyo ngorane, yatangaje amavugurura mu rwego rw'ubuzima, harimo kuvugurura ikigo gishinzwe kugura imiti no gushyiraho ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe amakuru y'ubuzima.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Amaze gutorwa, yavuze ko ashyigikiye politiki y'ububanyi n'amahanga idafite aho ibogamiye, nk'iy'u Busuwisi. Muri Mutarama 2025, we na Perezida w'u Bushinwa Xi Jinping bohererezanye ubutumwa bwo kwizihiza isabukuru y'imyaka 50 y'umubano w'ibihugu byombi.
Muri Werurwe 2025, yagiye i Washington ahura n'Umunyamabanga wa Leta w'Amerika, Marco Rubio. Umubano n'Amerika waje kurangwa n'ibibazo by'ubucuruzi: ku wa 1 Kanama 2025, Amerika yashyize umusoro wa 37 % ku bicuruzwa bya Botswana, bibangamira ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bya diyama; Botswana yatanze icyifuzo cyo guha Amerika uburenganzira bwa mbere bwo gushakisha amabuye y'agaciro y'ingenzi mu turere dutatu. Muri Ukwakira 2025, uwo musoro wari wageze kuri 15 %. Mu 2026, Boko yagize ati: "Perezida Trump ashyira imbere Amerika, nanjye nshyira imbere Botswana". Muri Nzeri 2026, yakiriye mu ruzinduko rwa Leta Sultani wa Omani, Haitham bin Tariq.

Évariste Ndayishimiye (wavutse ku wa 17 Kamena 1968 i Giheta, mu Ntara ya Gitega, mu Burundi) ni umujenerali n'umunyapolitiki w'Umurundi, akaba Perezida wa cumi wa Repubulika y'u Burundi kuva ku wa 18 Kamena 2020. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2026, ni na we Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika.
Mu gihe cy'intambara y'abenegihugu yo mu Burundi, yinjiye mu mutwe w'inyeshyamba "Conseil national pour la défense de la démocratie – Forces pour la défense de la démocratie" (CNDD-FDD), azamuka mu ntera mu ngabo zawo. Intambara irangiye, yinjiye mu ngabo z'igihugu, aba Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Imbere mu Gihugu, hanyuma akora mu biro bya Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza. Kuva mu 2016 kugeza mu 2020, yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru wa CNDD-FDD, ishyaka riri ku butegetsi.
Nkurunziza yamushyigikiye kugira ngo amusimbure mu matora yo mu 2020, maze atsinda ku majwi agera kuri 69 %. Ubutegetsi bwe bwanenzwe n'imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Évariste Ndayishimiye yavutse ku wa 17 Kamena 1968 i Musama, muri zone ya Kabanga, muri komine ya Giheta, mu Ntara ya Gitega. Ni umukirisitu Gatolika. Yatangiye kwiga amategeko muri Kaminuza y'u Burundi; mu 1995, ubwo abanyeshuri b'Abahutu bicwaga muri iyo kaminuza mu gihe cy'urugomo rushingiye ku moko rwajyanye n'intambara y'abenegihugu (1993–2005), yari umwe mu banyeshuri b'Abahutu bake bari bakiri muri iyo kaminuza, arokoka ku buryo bwa hafi.
Intambara y'abenegihugu.
Yahunze igihugu, aba umwe mu ba mbere binjiye mu mutwe w'inyeshyamba "Forces de défense de la démocratie" (FDD), washinzwe nyuma y'iyicwa rya Perezida w'Umuhutu Melchior Ndadaye; bamwe mu bagize umuryango we barishwe. Mu gihe cy'imyaka icumi, mu birindiro bya FDD mu ishyamba rya Kibira no mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, yabaye umuyobozi w'ingabo mu turere dutandukanye, azamuka mu ntera zose za gisirikare. Yahimbwe izina rya "Neva". Intambara irangiye, yari ayoboye ibiro bishinzwe gutegura politiki y'urugamba.
Urugendo mu gisirikare no muri politiki.
Amasezerano ya Arusha yo mu 2000 yagiye arangiza intambara buhoro buhoro: FDD yayasinye mu mpera za 2002, ireka urugamba rw'intwaro. Mu 2005, Ndayishimiye yagizwe umugaba mukuru wungirije w'Ingabo nshya z'igihugu (FDN) afite ipeti rya Jenerali. Kuva mu 2006 kugeza mu 2007, yabaye Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Imbere mu Gihugu.
Nyuma yaho, yabaye umukuru w'ibiro bya gisirikare bya Perezida Nkurunziza kugeza mu 2014, hanyuma mu 2015 ayobora ibiro bye bya gisivili. Muri icyo gihe, yize muri "Wisdom University of Africa", ahabona impamyabumenyi mu 2014, kandi ayobora Komite y'Igihugu y'Imikino Olempike igihe kirekire. Muri Kanama 2016, yatorewe kuba umunyamabanga mukuru wa CNDD-FDD, asimbura Pascal Nyabenda; bitandukanye n'uwo yasimbuye wakundaga kwibasira umuryango mpuzamahanga n'ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba, we yagaragaje ubushake bwo kuganira.
Perezida w'u Burundi.
Mu 2018, nyuma y'aho abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi biyongereye, Nkurunziza yatangaje ko atazongera kwiyamamaza mu 2020. Ku wa 26 Mutarama 2020, mu nama nkuru ya CNDD-FDD yabereye i Gitega, Ndayishimiye yatoranyijwe kuba umukandida w'ishyaka mu matora ya perezida yo ku wa 20 Gicurasi 2020. Byavugwaga ko Nkurunziza yashakaga gukomeza kuyobora igihugu yihishe inyuma ye, ariko kandi ko yari umukandida wumvikanyweho na Nkurunziza n'abajenerali ba CNDD-FDD; Ndayishimiye ntiyari ahujwe n'ihohoterwa rikomeye ryabaye ku butegetsi bwa Nkurunziza, kandi yafatwaga nk'utari umunyagitugu kurusha abandi.
Yatsinze amatora ku majwi 68,72 %, atsinda umukandida ukomeye w'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Agathon Rwasa wa CNL, wabonye 24,19 %. Ubunyangamugayo bw'ayo matora bwashidikanyijweho cyane, kandi yabaye mu gihe cy'icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Urupfu rwa Nkurunziza n'irahira.
Ihererekanyabubasha ryari riteganyijwe ku wa 20 Kanama 2020, ariko Nkurunziza yapfuye mu buryo butunguranye ku wa 8 Kamena 2020; guverinoma yavuze ko yazize "guhagarara k'umutima", mu gihe abenshi bakekaga ko yazize COVID-19. Ku wa 12 Kamena, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko nta gihe cy'inzibacyuho gikenewe, rutegeka ko Ndayishimiye arahira "vuba bishoboka". Yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku wa 18 Kamena 2020 muri sitade Ingoma y'i Gitega, amezi abiri mbere y'igihe cyari giteganyijwe, asezeranya gukomeza ibikorwa by'uwo yasimbuye.
Ku wa 28 Kamena 2020, yashyizeho guverinoma ye ya mbere, agabanya umubare w'abaminisitiri uva kuri 21 ujya kuri 15; Alain-Guillaume Bunyoni yagizwe Minisitiri w'Intebe, Prosper Bazombanza aba Visi-Perezida. Yagaragaje ko adashaka kwitarura amahanga nk'uwo yasimbuye, akorera ingendo nyinshi mu mahanga.
Atangira manda, yafashe COVID-19 nk'"umwanzi ukomeye kurusha abandi" w'igihugu, agabanya igiciro cy'isabune n'amazi kandi ategeka ko abantu bapimwa. Muri Mutarama 2021, yafunze imipaka y'igihugu. Nyamara muri Gashyantare 2021, u Burundi bwanze inkingo z'ikigega COVAX, mbere y'uko muri Ukwakira 2021 bwakira doze 500 000 z'urukingo rw'Abashinwa Sinopharm.
Ku wa 4 Nzeri 2022, mu ijambo rye, yanenze Minisitiri w'Intebe Bunyoni atamuvuze izina, avuga ko ashaka kumuhirika. Ku wa 7 Nzeri, guverinoma ya Bunyoni yakuweho, Gervais Ndirakobuca agirwa Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Mu Ukuboza 2022, yitabiriye inama ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'Afurika i Washington. Muri Nyakanga 2023, yitabiriye inama y'Uburusiya n'Afurika i Saint-Pétersbourg ahura na Vladimir Putin, hanyuma ahura na Xi Jinping mu Ubushinwa. Kuva mu 2024, ashishikariza abikorera n'abanyamahanga gushora imari mu bukerarugendo.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Mu Burundi, ubutinganyi bwahanwaga n'amategeko kuva mu 2009. Muri Werurwe 2023, abantu 24 bashinjwe "imibonano mpuzabitsina y'abahuje ibitsina", maze Ndayishimiye asaba ko abaryamana bahuje ibitsina "bacibwa". Ku wa 29 Ukuboza 2023, abajijwe ku ishyingiranwa ry'abahuje ibitsina, yavuze ko bakwiye "gushyirwa muri sitade bagaterwa amabuye", ashinja ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba guhatira ibihugu bito kwemera ibyo bikorwa bikoresheje inkunga. Muri Kanama 2024, raporo ya Amnesty International yamaganye "iterabwoba, itotezwa, ifatwa n'ifungwa binyuranyije n'amategeko" by'abarwanashyaka n'abanyamakuru ku butegetsi bwe.
