Ku wa 17 Nyakanga 2025, Ubumwe bwa Afurika bwamugize intumwa yihariye mu karere ka Sahel. Ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2026, mu nama ya 39 isanzwe y'abakuru b'ibihugu by'Ubumwe bwa Afurika yabereye Addis-Abeba, yatorewe kuba Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe.

Paul Biya (amazina ye y'amavuko: Paul Barthélemy Biya'a bi Mvondo; wavutse ku wa 13 Gashyantare 1933 i Mvomeka'a, mu karere ka Dja-et-Lobo, muri Kameruni) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyakameruni, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Kameruni kuva ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 1982. Mbere yaho, yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe kuva mu 1975 kugeza mu 1982.
Yazamutse mu nzego z'ubutegetsi ku gihe cya Perezida Ahmadou Ahidjo, amusimbura amaze kwegura mu buryo butunguranye mu 1982. Yakomeje ububasha bwe nyuma y'umugambi wa kudeta waburijwemo mu 1984. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, ashyizweho igitutu, yemeye amashyaka menshi. Yongeye gutorwa mu 1992, 1997, 2004, 2011, 2018 na 2025, ariko abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba bakavuga ko buri matora yarangwaga n'uburiganya.
Afite imyaka irenga 90, ni we mukuru w'igihugu ukuze kurusha abandi ku isi, akaba n'uwa kabiri mu baperezida bamaze igihe kirekire ku butegetsi, nyuma ya Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo wa Gineya Ekwatoriyale. Ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa nk'ubw'igitugu.
Umuryango n'amashuri.
Paul Biya yavukiye mu mudugudu wo mu majyepfo ya Kameruni, hagati mu ishyamba rya ekwateri, ahantu hari hayobowe n'Ubufaransa. Ni umuhungu wa Anastasie Eyenga Ellé na Étienne Mvondo Assam, umukateshiste wifuzaga ko azaba padiri, bituma amujyana mu ishuri gatolika rya Nden, hanyuma mu iseminari za Édéa na Akono. Ni Umugatolika ukomeye ku idini.
Amaze kwiga amashuri yisumbuye muri lycée Général-Leclerc i Yaoundé, yakomereje i Paris muri lycée Louis-le-Grand, muri Kaminuza ya Sorbonne, muri "Institut d'études politiques" (aho yakuye impamyabumenyi y'amategeko rusange mu 1961) no muri "Institut des hautes études d'outre-mer". Akiri umunyeshuri, yabaye umwenegihugu w'Ubufaransa, ariko nyuma arabureka asubiye muri Kameruni gukora mu butegetsi.
Mu 1961, yashakanye na Jeanne-Irène Biya, witabye Imana ku wa 29 Nyakanga 1992; barera umuhungu we Franck Biya, wavutse mu 1971. Franck Biya avugwa nk'ushobora kuzamusimbura. Ku wa 23 Mata 1994, yashakanye na Chantal Vigouroux, amurusha imyaka 36, babyarana Paul Junior na Brenda Biya.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Mu Ukwakira 1962, yashyizwe mu biro bya Perezida Ahmadou Ahidjo nk'ushinzwe ubutumwa ("chargé de mission"). Mu 1965, yabaye umuyobozi w'ibiro bya Minisitiri w'Uburezi, Urubyiruko n'Umuco, hanyuma umunyamabanga mukuru w'iyo minisiteri. Mu 1967–1968, yabaye umuyobozi w'ibiro bya gisivili bya Perezida, hanyuma umunyamabanga mukuru w'ibiro bya Perezida afite ipeti rya minisitiri; mu Kamena 1970, agirwa Minisitiri wa Leta.
Ku wa 30 Kamena 1975, Ahidjo yamugize Minisitiri w'Intebe. Itegeko ryo ku wa 29 Kamena 1979 ryamugize uzasimbura Perezida igihe habayeho icyuho.
Perezida wa Kameruni.
Gufata ubutegetsi n'umugambi wa kudeta wo mu 1984.
Ku wa 4 Ugushyingo 1982, Ahidjo yeguye mu buryo butunguranye, maze Paul Biya aba Perezida wa Repubulika ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 1982. Ahidjo n'uwamusimbuye ntibatinze guhangana. Ku wa 14 Nzeri 1984, Biya yatorewe kuyobora ishyaka rimwe rukumbi rya UNC, maze ku wa 24 Werurwe 1985 arihindura "Rassemblement démocratique du peuple camerounais" (RDPC).
Ku wa 6 Mata 1984, yarokotse umugambi wa kudeta wakozwe n'abasirikare b'ingabo zirinda Repubulika. Bamwe mu bagerageje kumuhirika barafashwe, abandi baricwa. Ahidjo, washinjwe kugira uruhare muri uwo mugambi, yakatiwe igihano cy'urupfu adahari, nyuma Biya amuha imbabazi. Ihashywa ryibasiye cyane cyane uturere two mu majyaruguru, aho abantu amagana bishwe.
Ubukungu n'amashyaka menshi.
Yatowe ari umukandida umwe rukumbi mu 1984 no mu 1988. Yemeye gahunda y'ivugurura ry'ubukungu yatanzwe n'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI) na Banki y'Isi: kwegurira abikorera ibigo bya Leta, kugabanya amafaranga akoreshwa mu mibereho myiza; imishahara y'abakozi ba Leta yagabanyijweho 60 %.
Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, nyuma y'ibikorwa byo kwanga kumvira ubutegetsi byiswe "Imigi yapfuye" ("Villes mortes") n'imyigaragambyo, yihutishije ishyirwaho ry'amashyaka menshi, akuraho amategeko "arwanya ubugambanyi" yari yarashyizweho n'uwo yasimbuye, yemerera itangazamakuru ryigenga. Mu matora ya mbere y'amashyaka menshi yo mu 1992, yatangajwe ko yatsinze John Fru Ndi ku majwi 40 % kuri 36 %, ibyavuye mu matora abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze. Yongeye gutorwa mu 1997 (92,6 %) no mu 2004 (70,9 %). Kuva mu 1992, yagerageje gucamo ibice abamurwanya; mu 2025, Kameruni yari ifite amashyaka agera kuri 300, amwe aterwa inkunga na guverinoma.
Ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryo mu 2008.
Mu Ukuboza 2007, yatangaje ko ashaka guhindura Itegeko Nshinga ryagabanyaga manda ya perezida kuri ebyiri. Uwo mushinga wanamuhaga ubudahangarwa imbere y'ubucamanza ku bikorwa yakoze ari ku butegetsi. Muri Gashyantare 2008, habaye imyigaragambyo yasabaga igabanuka ry'ibiciro n'iyegura rya Biya; yahashywe bikomeye, ihitana abantu bagera ku ijana, abandi ibihumbi barafungwa. Ivugurura ryemejwe n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko mu 2008. Ku wa 21 Ukwakira 2011, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 78 %; ambasaderi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, Robert Jackson, yamaganye "amakosa ku nzego zose".
Ibibazo by'umutekano.
Mu 2014, inyeshyamba za Boko Haram zaturutse muri Nijeriya zinjira muri Kameruni. Muri Gicurasi 2014, Biya na mugenzi we wa Cadi Idriss Déby batangaje intambara kuri Boko Haram, bohereza ingabo ku mupaka. Muri Nzeri 2018, Kameruni yatangaje ko Boko Haram yasubijwe inyuma, nubwo imirwano yakomeje mu turere tw'umupaka.
Mu Ugushyingo 2016, mu turere tuvuga Icyongereza two mu Majyaruguru y'Uburengerazuba n'Amajyepfo y'Uburengerazuba, abarimu n'abanyamategeko bigaragambije bamagana ishyirwa ry'abavuga Igifaransa muri utwo turere n'iyimikwa ry'amategeko y'Abaromani aho kuba "common law". Benshi basabaga gusubira ku butegetsi bwa federasiyo, abandi bake basaba ubwigenge bw'igihugu gishya bise "Ambazonia"; Biya yanze ibyo bisabwa byombi. Mu mpera za 2017, igice cy'abashaka kwitandukanya cyafashe intwaro. Ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 2017, nyuma y'iyicwa ry'abasirikare n'abapolisi, Biya yavuze ko Kameruni yibasiwe n'"agatsiko k'abaterabwoba", ijambo radio ya Leta yafashe nk'itangazwa ry'intambara.
Amatora yo mu 2018 no mu 2025.
Ku wa 7 Ukwakira 2018, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 71,3 %, mu matora yaranzwe n'urugomo n'ubwitabire buke. Mu 2020, guceceka kwe mu gihe cy'icyorezo cya COVID-19 kwaranenzwe.
Ku wa 13 Nyakanga 2025, afite imyaka 92, yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya munani mu matora yo ku wa 12 Ukwakira 2025. Ku wa 27 Ukwakira, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwatangaje ko yatsinze ku majwi 53,66 %, imbere ya Issa Tchiroma Bakary, na we wavugaga ko ari we watsinze. Nyuma y'amatora, habaye imyigaragambyo yamagana uburiganya. Yarahiriye manda ya munani ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 2025, imyigaragambyo ikomeje; Issa Tchiroma yahise ahungira muri Gambiya.
Ubuzima bwe n'uzamusimbura.
Kuva mu myaka ya 2010, kujya kenshi mu mahanga mu "ngendo bwite" byateje impungenge ku buzima bwe; inshuro nyinshi havuzwe ko yapfuye. Mu Nzeri n'Ukwakira 2024, yamaze iminsi 50 atagaragara mu ruhame; ku wa 9 Ukwakira, Minisitiri w'Ubutegetsi bw'Igihugu Paul Atanga Nji yabujije itangazamakuru kuvuga ku buzima bwa Perezida.
Muri Mata 2026, nyuma y'itora ry'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, Biya yasinye iteka risubizaho umwanya wa visi-perezida, uwo azishyiriraho ubwe, kugira ngo "hizerwe ukomeza kw'imirimo ya Leta" igihe habayeho icyuho; abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi babyise "kudeta ishingiye ku nzego". Ku wa 20 Kanama 2026, afite imyaka 93, yagarutse i Yaoundé nyuma y'iminsi 74 ari mu mahanga, nta bisobanuro bitanzwe; ikinyamakuru "Jeune Afrique" cyavuze ko yabagiwe ivi i Genève.
Isesengura n'inenge.
Ubutegetsi bwe bukunze kwitwa ubw'igitugu. Imiryango nka Amnesty International yanenze ubutegetsi bwe kubuza abaturage uburenganzira bw'ibanze no guhohotera uburenganzira bwa muntu. Ifungwa ry'abanyamakuru, abanditsi, abayobozi b'amasendika n'abarwanashyaka ni kenshi. Human Rights Watch yamaganye "ihashywa rikomeye" ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Abamushyigikiye bo bavuga ko ku butegetsi bwe habayeho iterambere, nka demokarasi, irekurwa ry'imfungwa za politiki n'ubwinshi bw'abakandida.
Mu 2006, hatangijwe ibikorwa byo kurwanya ruswa byiswe "Épervier", byatumye abayobozi bakuru benshi bafungwa, nubwo bikekwa ko byakoreshejwe mu gukuraho abo bahanganye. Transparency International yashyize Kameruni ku mwanya w'igihugu cyamunzwe na ruswa kurusha ibindi ku isi mu 1998 no mu 1999, no ku mwanya wa 145 kuri 176 mu 2018.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ubutegetsi bwe bushyigikiwe n'Ubufaransa, buhereza Kameruni intwaro, butoza ingabo zayo kandi akaba ari bwo bushora imari nyinshi muri icyo gihugu. Mu 1986, yasubukuye umubano na Isiraheli, wari warahagaze kuva mu 1973; umutwe w'ingabo zihuta (BIR) uhabwa ibikoresho kandi utozwa na Isiraheli. Ku wa 10 Ukwakira 2002, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga rw'Ubutabera rwemeje ko igice cya Bakassi cyari mu makimbirane na Nijeriya ari icya Kameruni; ihererekanya ry'icyo gice ryakozwe mu mahoro hakurikijwe amasezerano ya Greentree yo mu 2006.

José Maria Pereira Neves (wavutse ku wa 28 Werurwe 1960 i Santa Catarina, ku kirwa cya Santiago, muri Kapu Veri) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyakapuveri wo mu ishyaka "Partido Africano da Independência de Cabo Verde" (PAICV), akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Kapu Veri kuva ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 2021.
Yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe imyaka 15, kuva mu 2001 kugeza mu 2016. Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2021, yatsinze mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 51,7 %.
José Maria Neves yavukiye ku kirwa cya Santiago mu 1960. Akiri ingimbi, yatangiye gushishikazwa na politiki, ayobora umuryango w'urubyiruko uharanira ubwigenge mu gihe Kapu Veri yavaga mu bukoloni bw'Abanyaporutigali mu 1975. Yize muri "Escola de Administração de Empresas de São Paulo" ya Fundação Getúlio Vargas, muri Burezili.
Mu myaka ya 1980, yagarutse muri Kapu Veri akora mu nzego zitandukanye za Leta. Kuva mu 1987 kugeza mu 1989, yari umuhuzabikorwa w'umushinga w'ivugurura no kuvugurura ubutegetsi; yanayoboye Ikigo cy'Igihugu cy'Amahugurwa mu Butegetsi bwa Leta, hanyuma kuva mu 1989 kugeza mu 1998 aba umujyanama mu bijyanye n'amahugurwa n'iterambere ry'abakozi.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1980, yinjiye mu ishami ry'urubyiruko rya PAICV, icyo gihe ryari ishyaka rimwe rukumbi. Mu 1996, yiyamamaje ku rutonde rwa PAICV, ryari ryabaye ishyaka ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, mu ntara y'itora ya Santa Catarina. Mu nama nkuru ya PAICV yo muri Nzeri 1997, yiyamamarije kuyobora ishyaka ariko atsindwa na Pedro Pires. Mu Kamena 2000, ubwo yari perezida w'inama njyanama ya Santa Catarina, yatorewe kuyobora PAICV.
Minisitiri w'Intebe (2001–2016).
Yayoboye PAICV itsinda amatora y'abadepite yo ku wa 14 Mutarama 2001, aba Minisitiri w'Intebe. Yashyizeho umubano wa dipolomasi n'Ubushinwa. Mu 2002, yasinyanye n'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi amasezerano yihariye, yatangajwe ku wa 15 Ugushyingo 2005; mu 2007, yasabye ko Kapu Veri igirana umubano wihariye n'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi kubera ko yegereye ibirwa bya Macaronésie biri muri Esipanye na Porutigali. Kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2004, yari na Minisitiri w'Imari. Muri Kanama 2005, yasuye Burezili, ahura na Perezida Lula da Silva, baganira ku ishoramari muri Kapu Veri, harimo na Kaminuza ya Kapu Veri, kaminuza ya mbere ya Leta muri icyo gihugu.
Ku wa 22 Mutarama 2006, ishyaka rye ryongeye gutsinda amatora y'abadepite ku majwi 52,28 %, maze ku wa 7 Werurwe atangira manda ye ya kabiri. Banki y'Isi n'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari bashimye politiki ye y'ubukungu n'imari. Mu Ukuboza 2006, yavuze ko nubwo ubucakara n'ubukoloni byagize ingaruka mbi kuri Afurika, abayobozi b'Afurika ari bo ba mbere bafite inshingano ku bibazo by'umugabane muri iki gihe. Ku wa 2 Mutarama 2007, yatangaje ko ashaka ko Kapu Veri igira umwanya wihariye muri CEDEAO.
Ku wa 27 Kamena 2008, yashyizeho guverinoma nshya yari irimo abagore umunani ku baminisitiri 15, iba guverinoma ya mbere muri Kapu Veri ifite abagore benshi kurusha abagabo. Ku wa 6 Gashyantare 2011, yongeye gutorwa ku nshuro ya gatatu, ishyaka rye ribona 52,68 % n'imyanya 38 kuri 72. Mu matora y'abadepite yo muri Werurwe 2016, ishyaka ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, "Movimento para a Democracia" (MpD), ryatsinze ku majwi arenga 53 %, maze ku wa 22 Mata 2016 asimburwa na Ulisses Correia e Silva ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Perezida wa Kapu Veri.
Mu matora ya perezida yo ku wa 17 Ukwakira 2021, yatsinze mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 51,7 %, imbere ya Carlos Veiga wa MpD wabonye 42,4 %; Veiga yahise yemera ko yatsinzwe. Iyo ntsinzi yatumye habaho ubufatanye bw'ubutegetsi ("cohabitation") na Minisitiri w'Intebe Ulisses Correia e Silva wo muri MpD. Yatangiye imirimo ku wa 9 Ugushyingo 2021.
Neves yanditse ibitabo n'inyandiko byinshi, bimwe byasohotse mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika, mu Burayi no muri Burezili, birimo:

Faustin-Archange Touadéra (wavutse ku wa 21 Mata 1957 i Bangui) ni umwarimu w'imibare n'umunyapolitiki wo muri Repubulika ya Santara Afurika, akaba Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva muri Werurwe 2016. Mbere yaho, yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe kuva mu 2008 kugeza mu 2013 ku butegetsi bwa François Bozizé.
Yatorewe kuba Perezida mu 2016, yongera gutorwa mu 2020–2021 no mu 2025, mu matora yitabiriwe na bake kandi arangwa n'urugomo. Kuva yagera ku butegetsi, yegereye Uburusiya: itsinda ry'abacancuro b'Abarusiya rya Wagner rimurinda kandi rimufasha guhashya inyeshyamba. Ku butegetsi bwe, Itegeko Nshinga ryavanyeho umubare ntarengwa wa manda mu 2023, kandi abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi barahohoterwa.
Faustin-Archange Touadéra yavukiye i Bangui ku wa 21 Mata 1957, mu muryango w'abana icumi wo mu gace ka rubanda rugufi ka Boy-Rabe; se yari umushoferi, nyina ari umuhinzi. Yize amashuri yisumbuye muri Collège Barthélemy Boganda i Bangui, abona impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye mu 1976, hanyuma yiga muri Kaminuza ya Bangui no muri Kaminuza ya Abidjan. Mu 1986, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (doctorat) mu mibare muri Kaminuza ya Lille I mu Ubufaransa, maze mu 2004 abona iya kabiri muri Kaminuza ya Yaoundé muri Kameruni.
Mu 1987, yabaye umwarimu wungirije w'imibare muri Kaminuza ya Bangui, aba visi-dekani w'ishami ry'ubumenyi kuva mu 1989 kugeza mu 1992. Mu 1999, yinjiye muri Komite ihuriweho n'ibihugu ishinzwe guhuza integanyanyigisho z'imibare mu bihugu bivuga Igifaransa n'ibyo mu Nyanja y'Abahinde (CIEHPM), ayiyobora kuva mu 2001 kugeza mu 2003. Muri Gicurasi 2004, yabaye visi-chanseliye wa Kaminuza ya Bangui, hanyuma ayibera umuyobozi mukuru (recteur) kuva mu 2005 kugeza mu 2008, atangiza gahunda yo kwigisha kwihangira imirimo n'ihuriro rya kaminuza "Euclid".
Minisitiri w'Intebe (2008–2013).
Ku wa 22 Mutarama 2008, Perezida François Bozizé yamugize Minisitiri w'Intebe, nyuma y'iyegura rya Élie Doté. Nyuma y'ibiganiro by'igihugu byo mu Ukuboza 2008, Bozizé yasheshe guverinoma ye ku wa 18 Mutarama 2009, ariko bukeye bwaho amugira Minisitiri w'Intebe ku nshuro ya kabiri. Ku wa 12 Mutarama 2013, nyuma y'amasezerano y'amahoro ya Libreville hagati ya guverinoma n'ihuriro ry'inyeshyamba rya Séléka, yategekaga ko Minisitiri w'Intebe mushya ava mu batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Bozizé yaramwirukanye.
Mu 2014, yahungiye ku kigo cy'Umuryango w'Abibumbye i Bangui amezi atandatu, hanyuma ajya i Villeneuve-d'Ascq mu Bufaransa hamwe n'umugore we n'abana be batatu.
Perezida wa Repubulika.
Yagarutse mu gihugu mu 2015, yiyamamaza nk'umukandida wigenga mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2015–2016. Mu cyiciro cya mbere, yabaye uwa kabiri ku majwi 19 %, inyuma ya Anicet-Georges Dologuélé (23,7 %), ariko mu cyiciro cya kabiri atsinda ku majwi 62,7 %. Yarahiye ku wa 30 Werurwe 2016, asimbura Perezida w'inzibacyuho Catherine Samba-Panza, asezeranya gushyira intwaro hasi no kugira igihugu "kimwe, cy'amahoro, cyerekeje ku iterambere". Ku wa 2 Mata 2016, yagize Simplice Sarandji Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Amaze kurahira, Ubufaransa bwatangaje ko burangije igikorwa cya gisirikare cya Sangaris, bwari bufitemo abasirikare bagera ku 2 500 bafashaga ingabo z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye zigera ku 10 000. Touadéra yitabaje itsinda ry'abacancuro b'Abarusiya rya Wagner kugira ngo rifashe kugarura umutekano; ibyo byatumye umubano n'Ubufaransa uzamba, Perezida Emmanuel Macron ahagarika inkunga y'ubukungu. Abarinda Touadéra bavugwa ko ari abo muri Wagner. Muri Gashyantare 2022, yari umwe mu bakuru b'ibihugu bake bashyigikiye icyemezo cya Vladimir Putin cyo kwemera ubwigenge bwa Donetsk na Louhansk.
Ku wa 18 Mutarama 2021, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 53,16 %.
Muri Mata 2022, Repubulika ya Santara Afurika yemeje ko Bitcoin iba ifaranga ryemewe mu gihugu, iba igihugu cya kabiri ku isi kibikoze nyuma ya El Salvador; iyo gahunda yaretswe mu 2023. Muri Werurwe 2023, yafashe ubuyobozi bw'Umuryango w'Ubukungu n'Ifaranga wa Afurika yo Hagati (CEMAC). Muri Nyakanga 2023, yitabiriye inama y'Uburusiya n'Afurika i Saint-Pétersbourg, avuga ko Uburusiya "bwafashije kurokora demokarasi no gukumira intambara y'abenegihugu".
Muri Nyakanga 2023, kamarampaka yo kuvugurura Itegeko Nshinga yongereye manda ya perezida kuva ku myaka itanu ikagera ku irindwi, ivanaho umubare ntarengwa wa manda; mu Ukwakira 2022, Touadéra yari yirukanye perezida w'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga, rwari rwemeje ko iyo kamarampaka inyuranyije n'Itegeko Nshinga. Muri Mata 2024, yakiriwe ku nshuro ya kabiri mu ngoro y'Élysée i Paris, asinya gahunda yo kugarura umubano hagati y'ibihugu byombi. Ku wa 10 Gashyantare 2025, yatangije ifaranga ry'ikoranabuhanga "$CAR", ryamaze igihe gito rifite agaciro ka miliyoni 900 z'amadolari mbere yo guta agaciro karenga 90 %.
Muri Nyakanga 2025, ishyaka rye "Mouvement Cœurs unis" ryamutoranyije kuba umukandida mu matora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza 2025. Mu Ugushyingo 2025, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwamwemereye kongera kwiyamamaza, nubwo abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavugaga ko atujuje ibisabwa. Mbere y'amatora, yakoresheje ububasha bwa Leta kugira ngo abuze abakandida batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi kwiyamamaza. Ku wa 19 Mutarama 2026, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwatangaje ko yatsinze mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 77,9 %, imbere ya Anicet-Georges Dologuélé (13,1 %); abitabiriye amatora bari 52,4 %. Abo bahanganye bamaganye uburiganya, basaba ko amatora aseswa.
Touadéra yabaye umudiyakoni mu itorero ry'Ababatisita ("Union fraternelle des Églises baptistes"), kandi aracyari umunyamuryango waryo. Afite abagore babiri, Brigitte Touadéra na Tina Marguerite Touadéra, n'abana batatu.

Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno (mu Cyarabu: محمد إدريس ديبي إتنو; wavutse ku wa 4 Mata 1984 i N'Djamena, muri Cade), uzwi kandi ku izina rya Kaka, ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyacade, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Cade kuva ku wa 21 Mata 2021.
Nyuma y'urupfu rutunguranye rwa se, Perezida Idriss Déby, wiciwe ku rugamba muri Mata 2021, yayoboye Akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho, aba umukuru w'igihugu mu buryo bwateje impaka, kuko Itegeko Nshinga ritubahirijwe. Yatsinze amatora ya perezida yo mu 2024, kandi mu Ukuboza 2024 ahabwa ipeti rya Maréchal wa Cade.
Ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa nk'ubw'igitugu, burangwa n'ihashywa rikaze ry'imyigaragambyo, harimo iryo ku wa 20 Ukwakira 2022, no kubuza abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi kwisanzura.
Inkomoko n'amashuri.
Mahamat Idriss Déby ni umuhungu wa Idriss Déby, icyo gihe wari umugaba mukuru w'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka, n'umubyeyi w'Umugorane. Yarezwe na nyirakuru, nyina wa Idriss Déby, ari na yo mpamvu bamwita "Mahamat Kaka" ("kaka" bisobanura "nyirakuru" mu Cyarabu cya Cade). Yize amashuri yisumbuye muri Cade no mu Ubufaransa, aho yamaze umwaka n'igice muri lycée militaire d'Aix-en-Provence. Agarutse, yize mu ishuri ry'abofisiye ry'ingabo za Cade (Gémia), arisohokamo ari sous-lieutenant.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Se yamushyize mu Buyobozi bukuru bushinzwe umutekano w'inzego za Leta (DGSSIE), ingabo zirinda ubutegetsi, ari umuyobozi wungirije w'itsinda ry'abasirikare barwanira ku butaka. Yarwanye bwa mbere muri Mata 2006, ubwo inyeshyamba zateraga umurwa mukuru, azamurwa ku ipeti rya komanda. Muri Gicurasi 2009, yagizwe Jenerali wa burigade, ayobora hamwe n'abandi ingabo za Cade mu ntambara ya Am-Dam, aho inyeshyamba za Timan Erdimi zatsinzwe mu burasirazuba bwa Cade.
Mu 2013, yabaye umuyobozi wungirije w'ingabo za Cade zoherejwe muri Mali (FATIM), arwana mu misozi ya Adrar des Ifoghas; nyuma afata ubuyobozi bwuzuye bw'izo ngabo. Ku wa 20 Nzeri 2014, yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru wa DGSSIE. Yagizwe Jenerali w'ingabo ("général de corps d'armée") mu Ukwakira 2018, Jenerali w'ingabo usumba abandi ("général d'armée") ku wa 2 Ukuboza 2021, maze ku wa 9 Ukuboza 2024 Inama y'Igihugu y'Inzibacyuho imuha icyubahiro cya Maréchal.
Akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 21 Mata 2021, nyuma y'urupfu rwa Idriss Déby wiciwe mu ntambara n'inyeshyamba za FACT mu majyaruguru y'igihugu, yafashe ubuyobozi bw'Akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho, aba Perezida wa Repubulika. Itegeko Nshinga, ryavugaga ko Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ari we usimbura Perezida mu gihe cy'iminsi 45 kugeza kuri 90 kugeza habaye amatora, ryarahagaritswe; bamwe mu banyapolitiki babyise kudeta. Igisirikare cyasheshe Inteko Ishinga Amategeko na guverinoma, gifunga imipaka, gitangaza inzibacyuho y'amezi 18. Ubufaransa bwashyigikiye iyo nzibacyuho, buvuga ko "ibihe bidasanzwe" byatewe n'inyeshyamba; Perezida Emmanuel Macron yitabiriye umuhango wo gushyingura Idriss Déby, yiyemeza gushyigikira Mahamat Déby.
Ku wa 25 Nzeri 2021, yashyizeho abagize Inama y'Igihugu y'Inzibacyuho 93. Ku wa 8 Kanama 2022, i Doha, guverinoma yasinyanye n'imitwe myinshi y'inyeshyamba amasezerano y'amahoro, ariko FACT n'indi mitwe itavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi barayanze. Ku wa 20 Kanama 2022, yatangije ibiganiro by'igihugu bihuriweho na bose (DNIS), byitabiriwe n'intumwa 1 400, ariko bimwe mu bice bya sosiyete sivile birabyamagana byita "monologue".
Perezida w'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 3 Ukwakira 2022, ibiganiro by'igihugu byongereye igihe cy'inzibacyuho, binemerera abayobozi b'inzibacyuho kuziyamamaza mu matora, bitandukanye n'ibyo Ubumwe bwa Afurika bwasabaga. Akanama ka gisirikare kamaze guseswa ku wa 8 Ukwakira 2022, yabaye Perezida w'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 20 Ukwakira 2022, itariki yari yarateganyirijwe amatora, habaye imyigaragambyo ikomeye yaharaniraga demokarasi i N'Djamena n'i Moundou, yateguwe na Wakit Tamma n'ishyaka "Les Transformateurs" rya Succès Masra. Inzego z'umutekano zayihashye bikomeye: abantu bari hagati ya 50 na 200 barapfuye, abarenga 600 barafungwa; uwo munsi wiswe "Ku wa Kane w'umukara". Muri Werurwe 2023, yahaye imbabazi 259 mu bari bakatiwe kubera iyo myigaragambyo, n'inyeshyamba 380 za FACT zari zarakatiwe gufungwa burundu.
Ku wa 13 Mutarama 2024, ishyaka rye "Mouvement patriotique du salut" (MPS) ryamutoranyije kuba umukandida mu matora ya perezida yo ku wa 6 Gicurasi 2024. Ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2024, umukandida ukomeye bari bahanganye, Yaya Dillo Djérou, yishwe n'inzego z'umutekano. Mu matora, yatsinze ku majwi 61 %, imbere ya Minisitiri w'Intebe Succès Masra (18,53 %), wari wavuze ko ari we watsinze. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida watowe ku wa 23 Gicurasi 2024, maze agira Allamaye Halina Minisitiri w'Intebe. Ku wa 29 Mutarama 2025, yatorewe kuyobora MPS.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ku wa 5 Kamena 2025, yahagaritse gutanga viza ku Banyamerika, mu rwego rwo kwihimura ku cyemezo cya Perezida Donald Trump cyo kubuza Abanyacade kwinjira muri Amerika. Nk'uko "Le Monde" ibivuga, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu ni zo zimutera inkunga ikomeye, maze na we akemerera intwaro zigenewe umutwe wa "Forces de soutien rapide" (RSF) wo muri Sudani kunyura ku butaka bwa Cade. Muri Nyakanga 2026, Cade yatangaje ko ivuye mu Rukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha (CPI), aho we n'abandi bayobozi bakuru bari bararezwe kuva mu Ukuboza 2025 kubera "ubufatanyacyaha mu byaha mpuzamahanga byakorewe muri Sudani".
Muri Mutarama 2024, ubushinjacyaha bw'Ubufaransa bushinzwe ibyaha by'imari (PNF) bwatangije iperereza ku kunyereza umutungo wa Leta, nyuma y'aho ikinyamakuru "Mediapart" gitangaje ko hagati ya 2021 na 2023 yakoresheje hafi miliyoni imwe y'amayero ku mudozi uzwi w'i Paris, mu gihugu aho 35 % by'abaturage bari mu bukene bukabije. Iryo perereza rireba n'imitungo itimukanwa y'umuryango we mu Bufaransa, ifite agaciro nibura ka miliyoni 30 z'amayero. Muri Werurwe 2026, "Mediapart" yatangaje ko we n'abamuherekeza bakoresheje hafi 860 000 by'amayero muri hoteli Royal Monceau i Paris, hafi ya yose yishyuwe mu mafaranga y'intoki. Ku wa 21 Mutarama 2025, murumuna we Adam Idriss Déby Itno yamwandikiye ibaruwa amusaba kwegura.
Ni Umuyisilamu ukomeye ku idini, akaba afite abana icyenda. Afite abagore batatu; uwa gatatu, umunyamakuru Dahabaya Oumar Souni, afatwa nka Madamu wa Perezida, akaba n'umujyanama mu itumanaho mu biro bya Perezida.
Muri Mata 2024, yasohoye igitabo kivuga ku buzima bwe, "De bédouin à président". Ku wa 15 Mutarama 2026, yahawe Igihembo nyafurika cy'amahoro.

Azali Assoumani (mu Cyarabu: غزالي عثماني; wavutse ku wa 1 Mutarama 1959 i Mitsoudjé, muri Komore) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyakomore, akaba Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Komore kuva mu 2016, nyuma yo kuba umukuru w'igihugu kuva mu 1999 kugeza mu 2006.
Yafashe ubutegetsi binyuze muri kudeta ku wa 30 Mata 1999, nyuma atorerwa kuba Perezida mu 2002, 2016, 2019 na 2024. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2023 kugeza muri Gashyantare 2024, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika. Ubutegetsi bwe bwa vuba aha bufatwa nk'ubugenda burushaho kuba ubw'igitugu.
Azali Assoumani yavukiye mu muryango w'abahinzi i Mitsoudjé, mu majyepfo y'ikirwa cya Grande Comore, maze yinjira mu gisirikare. Mu 1995, ubwo umucancuro w'Umufaransa Bob Denard yakoraga kudeta, Azali yari komanda, akaba umwe mu bofisiye bake batayigizemo uruhare. Nyuma yaho, yize mu "École de guerre" mu Ubufaransa no mu "Académie royale militaire" ya Meknès muri Maroke. Agarutse muri Komore, yahise azamurwa ku ipeti rya koloneli.
Ku butegetsi (1999–2006).
Ku wa 30 Mata 1999, Koloneli Azali yafashe ubutegetsi, ahirika Perezida w'agateganyo Tadjidine Ben Saïd Massounde. Abasirikare bavuze ko babikoze kugira ngo barinde ubusugire bw'igihugu, kuko Massounde yaganiraga n'abahagarariye ikirwa cya Anjouan ku bwigenge cyangwa ubwisanzure bwisumbuyeho bw'icyo kirwa.
Ku wa 23 Ukuboza 2001, yemeje binyuze muri kamarampaka Itegeko Nshinga rishya. Iryo tegeko ryashyizeho ubuperezida busimburanwa hagati y'ibirwa, riha ibirwa ubwisanzure bwagutse, buri kirwa gifite itegeko shingiro ryacyo, ibendera n'ubuyobozi bwacyo. Igihugu cyavuye ku izina rya Repubulika ya Kisilamu ya Federasiyo ya Komore, cyitwa Ubumwe bwa Komore.
Mu gihe cy'amatora yo mu 2002, habayeho imirwano hagati y'inzego z'umutekano n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, n'ifatwa ry'abantu binyuranyije n'amategeko. Ku wa 21 Mutarama 2002, yeguye kugira ngo yiyamamaze, asimburwa by'agateganyo na Hamadi Madi Boléro. Yatsinze amatora ya perezida y'amashyaka menshi yo ku wa 14 Mata 2002 ku majwi 75 %, atangira imirimo ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2002. Manda ye yaranzwe n'amakimbirane ku bubasha, kuko yanze kwegurira ibirwa ububasha nk'uko Itegeko Nshinga ryabiteganyaga.
Itegeko Nshinga ryavugaga ko Perezida agomba guturuka ku kirwa gitandukanye n'icyo uwamubanjirije yaturukagaho; ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2006, yasimbuwe na Ahmed Abdallah Mohamed Sambi wo ku kirwa cya Anjouan. Mu 2009, yasohoye igitabo yise "Quand j'étais président", yirata ko yavuye ku butegetsi manda ye irangiye, bitandukanye n'abandi bakuru b'ibihugu benshi b'Afurika.
Gusubira ku butegetsi (kuva 2016).
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2016, yabaye uwa gatatu mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 14,96 %, hanyuma atsinda icyiciro cya kabiri ku wa 10 Mata 2016 ku majwi 40,98 %. We na Mohamed Ali Soilihi bamaganye ibyavuye mu matora kubera uburiganya, bituma habaho icyiciro cya gatatu ku kirwa cya Anjouan ku wa 11 Gicurasi. Ku wa 15 Gicurasi 2016, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwatangaje ko yatsinze ku majwi 41,43 %. Yasimbuye Ikililou Dhoinine ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2016, manda y'imyaka itanu.
Ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga n'amatora yo mu 2019.
Abatavuga rumwe na we bamushinje guhindura Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo agume ku butegetsi kugeza mu 2029. Ifungwa ry'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga n'Urukiko rurwanya ruswa ryatumye Ubumwe bw'Uburayi buhagarika ubufatanye bwose na Komore; Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Loni, António Guterres, na we yagaragaje impungenge ku "kubuza kenshi ubwisanzure bw'abaturage n'uburenganzira bwa demokarasi". Yafungishije kandi umuntu ukomeye mu bamurwanya, Perezida wahozeho Ahmed Abdallah Sambi, waje gukatirwa gufungwa burundu nyuma y'imyaka ine azira kunyereza umutungo.
Ku wa 13 Gashyantare 2019, yeguye kugira ngo yiyamamaze mu matora yo ku wa 24 Werurwe 2019, atsinda mu cyiciro cya mbere. Itsinda ry'indorerezi z'Ubumwe bwa Afurika ryagaragaje "imvururu no kwangiza udusanduku tw'amatora". Yongeye gutangira imirimo ku wa 3 Mata 2019.
Ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2023, yasimbuye Perezida wa Senegali Macky Sall ku buyobozi bw'Ubumwe bwa Afurika, manda y'umwaka umwe. Ubuyobozi bwe bwaranzwe n'umubano mwiza n'ibindi bihugu, ariko bunengwa intege nke ku bibazo bikomeye nk'umutekano. Muri Nyakanga 2023, yitabiriye inama y'Uburusiya n'Afurika i Saint-Pétersbourg.
Mu Ugushyingo 2023, yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya kane mu matora yo ku wa 14 Mutarama 2024. Mu Ukuboza 2023, yakuye ku mwanya umucamanza mukuru wari ushinzwe gukurikirana amatora, Harimia Ahmed. Ku wa 16 Mutarama 2024, komisiyo y'amatora yatangaje ko yatsinze mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 62,97 %; abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze ibyavuye mu matora byose, bavuga ko habayeho uburiganya bukabije, habaho n'urugomo i Moroni. Yarahiriye manda ya kane ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2024.
Ku wa 7 Kanama 2024, yagize umuhungu we Nour El Fath, ufatwa nk'uzamusimbura, umunyamabanga mukuru wa guverinoma afite ububasha bwagutse, bituma abantu benshi bavuga ko ubutegetsi bwe buhinduka nk'ubwami. Ku wa 13 Nzeri 2024, yakomerekejwe gato ku mutwe n'umusirikare w'imyaka 24 wamuteye icyuma mu muhango wo gushyingura i Salimani; uwo musirikare yafashwe, ariko bukeye bwaho asangwa yapfiriye muri kasho. Muri Mutarama 2025, ishyaka rye ryatsinze amatora y'abadepite, ribona imyanya 28 kuri 33; abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze ibyavuye mu matora.

Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo (wavutse ku wa 13 Kamena 1963 i Kinshasa) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyekongo, akaba Perezida wa gatanu wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuva mu 2019. Abamushyigikiye bamwita "Fatshi".
Ni umuhungu wa Étienne Tshisekedi, wabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Zayire inshuro eshatu akaba n'umuntu ukomeye mu batavugaga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bwa Mobutu Sese Seko. Yamusimbuye ku buyobozi bw'ishyaka "Union pour la démocratie et le progrès social" (UDPS), ishyaka rya kera kandi rinini muri icyo gihugu. Yatsinze amatora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza 2018, nubwo indorerezi n'abandi batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavuze ko habayeho uburiganya; ayo matora yatumye, ku nshuro ya mbere kuva igihugu kibona ubwigenge mu 1960, ubutegetsi buhererekanywa mu mahoro. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2023.
Kuva mu 2021 kugeza mu 2022, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika. Manda ze zaranzwe n'intambara yo mu burasirazuba bw'igihugu, cyane cyane imirwano n'umutwe wa M23.
Félix Tshisekedi ni Umuluba, akaba umwana wa gatatu mu bana batanu ba Étienne Tshisekedi na Marthe. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1980, ubwo se yashingaga UDPS akarwanya ku mugaragaro Mobutu, umuryango we woherejwe mu buhungiro mu Kasaï, bituma amasomo ye ahagarara; mu 1985, Mobutu yemereye we, nyina n'abavandimwe be kuva mu Kasaï, se ajya mu Bubiligi.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Yinjiye muri UDPS, ishyaka ryayoborwaga na se, aba umwe mu bayobozi baryo; mu mpera za 2008, yagizwe umunyamabanga w'igihugu ushinzwe ububanyi n'amahanga muri UDPS. Mu Ugushyingo 2011, yatorewe kuba umudepite i Mbuji-Mayi, ariko yanga kujya mu Nteko akurikije amabwiriza ya se wavugaga ko amatora yabayemo uburiganya; mandat ye yakuweho ku wa 18 Kamena 2013. Mu Ukwakira 2016, yagizwe umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije wa UDPS.
Mu gihe cy'ikibazo cya politiki cyo mu 2016, cyatewe n'ubushake bwa Joseph Kabila bwo gusubika amatora, yari mu ntumwa z'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi zaganiraga na Kabila, ibiganiro byavuyemo amasezerano ya Saint-Sylvestre yo ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2016. Mu Werurwe 2017, yabaye umuyobozi wungirije w'ihuriro ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ("Rassemblement") hamwe na Pierre Lumbi.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa se ku wa 1 Gashyantare 2017, ku wa 31 Werurwe 2018 yatorewe kuyobora UDPS, kandi uwo munsi ishyaka rimutoranya kuba umukandida mu matora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza 2018. Ku wa 10 Mutarama 2019, byatangajwe ko yatsinze, imbere ya Martin Fayulu na Emmanuel Ramazani Shadary washyigikirwaga na Kabila. Fayulu yavuze ko habayeho uburiganya, ariko ku wa 19 Mutarama 2019 Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwanga ikirego cye. Yarahiye ku wa 24 Mutarama 2019; ni bwo bwa mbere kuva mu 1960 Perezida uriho ahererekanyije ubutegetsi n'uwo mu batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi mu mahoro.
Manda ya mbere (2019–2023).
Ihuriro "Front commun pour le Congo" (FCC) rishyigikiye Kabila ryari rifite ubwiganze mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko no mu buyobozi bw'intara, bituma mu mezi atandatu ya mbere ubushobozi bwe bwo kuyobora no gushyiraho Minisitiri w'Intebe bugabanuka. Ku wa 13 Werurwe 2019, yahaye imbabazi imfungwa zigera kuri 700, harimo n'abatavugaga rumwe na Kabila. Ku wa 20 Gicurasi 2019, yumvikanye na FCC, agira Sylvestre Ilunga Minisitiri w'Intebe, maze muri Nyakanga 2019 hashyirwaho guverinoma y'abaminisitiri 65 basaranganyijwe hagati ya FCC n'ihuriro rye CACH.
Muri Mata 2020, umuyobozi w'ibiro bye akaba n'inshuti ye ikomeye muri politiki, Vital Kamerhe, yafunzwe ashinjwa kunyereza amafaranga ya gahunda y'iminsi 100; ku wa 20 Kamena 2020, yakatiwe imyaka 20 y'imirimo y'agahato, ariko mu Kamena 2022 urukiko rw'ubujurire ruramugira umwere. Muri Werurwe 2023, Kamerhe yagizwe Minisitiri w'Intebe wungirije ushinzwe Ubukungu.
Nyuma y'uko ubufatanye na Kabila busenyutse kandi abadepite benshi bakamuyoboka, ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2021 yagize Jean-Michel Sama Lukonde Minisitiri w'Intebe; ku wa 12 Mata 2021, guverinoma nshya yashyizweho, irangiza ku mugaragaro ubufatanye bw'imyaka ibiri na Kabila.
Umutekano n'ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ku wa 30 Mata 2021, yatangaje ibihe bidasanzwe ("état de siège") mu ntara za Ituri na Kivu y'Amajyaruguru, kubera ubwiyongere bw'urugomo rw'imitwe yitwaje intwaro. Ku wa 6 Gashyantare 2021, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika, asimburwa na Macky Sall muri Gashyantare 2022. Muri Kanama 2022, yafashe ubuyobozi bw'umuryango SADC mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe.
Muri Kamena 2022, nyuma y'uko umutwe wa M23 wongeye kugaba ibitero, Tshisekedi yashinje u Rwanda gushyigikira uwo mutwe; u Rwanda rwahakanye ibyo birego. Mu Ukwakira 2022, Kongo yirukanye ambasaderi w'u Rwanda, maze mu Ugushyingo Tshisekedi asaba urubyiruko kwinjira mu gisirikare. Yanze kuzana abacancuro b'Abarusiya, ahubwo akoresha ibigo byigenga bya gisirikare by'Abanyarumaniya, n'ingabo za EAC na SADC muri Kivu. Muri Gicurasi 2023, yasuye Ubushinwa ahura na Xi Jinping, ashaka kongera kuganira ku masezerano y'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro yari yarasinywe ku butegetsi bwa Kabila.
Ku wa 18 Mutarama 2025, yongeye kuvuga ko Kinshasa itazagirana ibiganiro na M23. Nyuma y'igitero cya M23 cyafashe umujyi wa Goma, Kongo yacanye umubano wa dipolomasi n'u Rwanda ku wa 26 Mutarama 2025, Tshisekedi ahamagarira abaturage gushyigikira ingabo za FARDC. Ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2025, yashinje u Rwanda kurenga ku masezerano y'amahoro yari aherutse gusinywa. Mu Ukwakira 2024, yari yigaragambije ava mu nama y'ibihugu bivuga Igifaransa i Paris, kubera ko Perezida Emmanuel Macron atavuze ku ntambara yo mu burasirazuba bwa Kongo.
Afatwa nk'umwe mu bakuru b'ibihugu by'Afurika bashyigikira cyane Isiraheli; muri Nzeri 2026, nyuma y'uruzinduko muri Isiraheli, yatangaje ko ashaka kwimurira ambasade ya Kongo i Yeruzalemu.
Manda ya kabiri (kuva 2024).
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza 2023, yashyigikiwe na Vital Kamerhe na Jean-Pierre Bemba. Ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2023, byatangajwe ko yatsinze ku majwi 73,34 %; abakandida icyenda batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze ibyavuye mu matora, basaba ko asubirwamo. Yarahiriye manda ya kabiri ku wa 20 Mutarama 2024. Ku wa 1 Mata 2024, yagize Judith Suminwa Tuluka Minisitiri w'Intebe, akaba ari we mugore wa mbere wabaye kuri uwo mwanya.
Ku wa 19 Gicurasi 2024, yarokotse umugambi wa kudeta wayobowe na Christian Malanga, warasiwe mu ngoro y'igihugu n'abasirikare barinda Repubulika; uwo mugambi wahitanye abantu batandatu.
Ku wa 24 Gashyantare 2025, raporo y'imiryango irwanya ruswa yanenze ubuzima buhenze bw'inzego za Leta, harimo izamuka rya 19 % ry'ingengo y'imari y'ibiro bya Perezida hagati ya 2023 na 2024. Kuva mu 2024, Tshisekedi yifuza guhindura Itegeko Nshinga ryo mu 2006, rigena manda ebyiri gusa, kugira ngo abashe kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu mu 2028; muri Kamena 2026, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko na Sena byemeje itegeko rigenga kamarampaka, ariko abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'Inama y'Abepiskopi Gatolika (Cenco) barabyamagana.
Umuco n'ibidukikije.
Ku wa 25 Werurwe 2021, yatangije igihembo nyafurika cy'ubuvanganzo gihabwa abanditsi b'Abanyafurika. Muri Nzeri 2021, yashyizeho ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe impinduka mu bidukikije n'iterambere rirambye (ACTEDD), kandi muri COP26 yiyemeje guhagarika no gusubiza inyuma itemwa ry'amashyamba bitarenze 2030.
Félix Tshisekedi yashakanye na Denise Nyakeru, bafitanye abana batanu. Mu 2015, yabaye umupantekoti, yinjira mu itorero ry'Assemblées de Dieu.

Ismaïl Omar Guelleh (mu Gisomali: "Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle"; mu Cyarabu: إسماعيل عمر جيله; wavutse ku wa 27 Ugushyingo 1947 i Dire Dawa, muri Etiyopiya), akunze kwitwa IOG, ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyajibuti, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Jibuti kuva mu 1999.
Yatorewe bwa mbere mu 1999 nk'uwatoranyijwe ngo asimbure nyirarume Hassan Gouled Aptidon, wari uyoboye Jibuti kuva igihugu kibona ubwigenge mu 1977. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2005, 2011, 2016, 2021 na 2026, mu matora abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bakunze kwanga kwitabira bavuga ko arimo uburiganya bukabije. Afatwa n'imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu n'ibihugu bimwe by'amahanga nk'umunyagitugu.
Ismaïl Omar Guelleh yavukiye i Dire Dawa, muri Etiyopiya, mu muryango wo mu bwoko bw'Abamamassan bo mu Bisa ("Issas"), igice cy'Abasomali gikomeye muri politiki. Se, Omar Guelleh, yari umwe mu barimu ba mbere b'abenegihugu mu myaka ya 1930, nyuma akorera ikigo cy'inzira ya gari ya moshi ihuza Jibuti na Addis-Abeba, cyari gifite icyicaro i Dire Dawa. Yize mu ishuri rya Korowani i Dire Dawa, hanyuma mu ishuri ry'Abafaransa Charles-de-Foucauld i Jibuti.
Mu 1965, afite imyaka 18, yatangiye gukora mu nzego z'iperereza z'ubutegetsi bw'Abafaransa, kuko yavugaga Icyamuhariki, Igisomali, Icyarabu, Igifaransa, Igitaliyani n'Icyongereza. Mu 1974, yahagaritswe ku kazi kuko yakekwagaho guha amakuru abaharaniraga ubwigenge. Yinjiye mu ishyaka "Ligue populaire africaine pour l'indépendance" (LPAI) ryayoborwaga na Hassan Gouled Aptidon.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Mu 1977, yari mu ntumwa zaganiriye n'Ubufaransa ku bwigenge bw'igihugu, bwatangajwe ku wa 27 Kamena 1977. Perezida mushya, Hassan Gouled Aptidon, yamugize umuyobozi w'ibiro bye, umwanya yamazeho imyaka irenga 20. Yayoboye kandi inzego z'umutekano n'iperereza, bimuhesha izina ry'"umugabo ukomeye". Yari umunyamuryango w'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi, "Rassemblement populaire pour le progrès" (RPP), kuva ryashingwa mu 1979.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1980, umutwe w'inyeshyamba "Front pour la restauration de l'unité et de la démocratie" (FRUD) wagaragaye mu majyaruguru y'igihugu. Guelleh, wagize uruhare mu biganiro byo gushyiraho amashyaka menshi, yabashije gucamo ibice FRUD, ariko kongera umubare w'abasirikare kuva ku 3 000 ukagera ku 15 000 byashyize igihugu mu bibazo by'imari, bituma gisaba ubufasha Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI).
Manda ya mbere n'iya kabiri (1999–2011).
Ku wa 4 Gashyantare 1999, Gouled Aptidon yatangaje ko azava ku butegetsi, maze RPP itoranya Guelleh kuba umukandida wayo. Ku wa 9 Mata 1999, yatsinze amatora ku majwi 74,02 %, atsinda Moussa Ahmed Idriss; atangira imirimo ku wa 8 Gicurasi 1999. Muri Nzeri 1999, Moussa Ahmed Idriss yarafashwe ashinjwa "guca intege ingabo". Mu Ukuboza 2000, yirukanye umuyobozi wa polisi y'igihugu, Yacin Yabeh, bituma abapolisi bamushyigikiye bigomeka ariko ntibabigereho. Ku wa 12 Gicurasi 2001, igice cya FRUD cyari gisigaye kirwana cyasinye amasezerano y'amahoro, bisoza amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko yari amaze igihe kirekire.
Kuva mu 2000, yakurikije politiki yo guteza imbere ubukungu, harimo kwegurira abikorera imicungire y'icyambu cya Jibuti, cyahawe ikigo DP World cyo muri Dubai ku wa 1 Kamena 2000. Kaminuza ya mbere ya Jibuti yafunguwe mu 2000.
Mu matora yo ku wa 8 Mata 2005, ni we mukandida wenyine wiyamamaje, maze atsinda; yarahiriye manda ya kabiri ku wa 7 Gicurasi 2005, avuga ko ari yo ya nyuma. Nyamara mu Mata 2010, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yahinduye Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo abashe kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu, bitera imyigaragambyo yahashywe, abayobozi b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi barafungwa.
Manda ya gatatu kugeza ku ya gatandatu (kuva 2011).
Ku wa 8 Mata 2011, yongeye gutorwa mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 80,6 %; Human Rights Watch yashidikanyije ku bunyangamugayo bw'ayo matora, kuko abayobozi b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bari barafunzwe kabiri mbere y'amatora. Muri Kanama 2014, bivugwa ko umwe mu barinzi be yamurasheho mu muhango wabereye ku kibuga cy'indege, ariko ntiyamufata. Mu matora yo ku wa 8 Mata 2016, yatsinze ku majwi 86,28 %; mbere y'amatora, itsinda ry'abanyamakuru ba BBC ryarafashwe rirukanwa mu gihugu.
Ku wa 9 Mata 2021, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 98,58 %, atangira manda ya gatanu ku wa 15 Gicurasi 2021. Muri Kamena 2021, yategetse ko abaturage n'abanyamahanga baba muri Jibuti bakingirwa COVID-19 ku gahato. Ku wa 10 Mata 2026, yatorewe manda ya gatandatu ku majwi 97,81 %, ararahira ku wa 9 Gicurasi 2026.
Isesengura ry'ubutegetsi bwe.
Ku butegetsi bwe, yashyize abo mu muryango we mu myanya ikomeye ya politiki n'ubukungu: umugore we, Kadra Mahamoud Haid, afatwa nka visi-perezida mu buryo bufatika, abakobwa be bombi bafite uruhare runini mu bujyanama no mu bucuruzi, naho murumuna we Saad Omar Guelleh ayobora icyambu cya Jibuti. Ubutumwa bwa ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika bwo mu 2004 bwavuze ko Jibuti ari "umujyi-gihugu w'ubucuruzi ugenzurwa n'umuntu umwe, Ismaïl Omar Guelleh". Mu 2020, Reporters sans frontières yashyize Jibuti ku mwanya wa 176 kuri 179 mu bwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru, ivuga ko hari "iterabwoba ku itangazamakuru". Raporo ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika yo mu 2020 ku burenganzira bwa muntu yavuze ku bwicanyi bunyuranyije n'amategeko, iyicarubozo n'ikumirwa rikomeye ry'ubwisanzure bwo kuvuga.
Umubano n'Ubushinwa n'ubukungu.
Guelleh yakoresheje aho igihugu cye giherereye mu buryo bw'ingenzi, ashora imari myinshi mu byambu n'ibikorwa remezo by'ubwikorezi. Kuva mu 2013, yegereye Ubushinwa, bwashinze ikigo cya gisirikare cyo mu mazi muri Jibuti mu 2017. Yifuza kugira Jibuti "Singapuru ya Afurika". Muri Gashyantare 2018, yambuye ku iteka rya perezida ikigo DP World uburenganzira bwo gucunga ikigo cy'ibikoresho bya Doraleh, akabuha ikigo cya Leta; mu 2020, Urukiko mpuzamahanga rw'ubukemurampaka rwa Londres rwemeje ko icyo cyemezo kinyuranyije n'amategeko, ariko Jibuti iranga. Nubwo ubukungu bwazamutse, ubushomeri bukomeje kuba bwinshi, cyane cyane mu rubyiruko: mu 2015, bwari 39 %.
Urubanza rwa Borrel.
Kuva mu 2004, urubanza rw'umucamanza w'Umufaransa Bernard Borrel, wapfiriye muri Jibuti mu 1995, rwazambije umubano n'Ubufaransa, kuko umupfakazi we, Élisabeth Borrel, yashinjaga Perezida Guelleh kuba umwe mu bategetse iyicwa rye. Muri Gashyantare 2007, umucamanza w'Umufaransa yasabye kumwumva nk'umutangabuhamya, ariko Minisiteri y'Ubutabera y'Ubufaransa ivuga ko adashobora guhatirwa gutanga ubuhamya kubera ubudahangarwa bwe.
Yashakanye na Kadra Mahamoud Haid, bafitanye abana bane. Ku wa 25 Mutarama 2019, Ubuhinde bwamuhaye umudari wa Padma Vibhushan, kubera uruhare rwe mu guhungisha Abahinde muri Yemeni.

Abdel Fattah al-Sissi (mu Cyarabu: عبد الفتاح السيسي; wavutse ku wa 19 Ugushyingo 1954 i Kayiro, muri Misiri) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyamisiri ufite ipeti rya Maréchal, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika y'Abarabu ya Misiri kuva ku wa 8 Kamena 2014.
Yize mu mashuri ya gisirikare yo muri Misiri, mu Bwongereza no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika. Perezida Hosni Moubarak yamugize umuyobozi w'iperereza rya gisirikare. Nyuma y'impinduramatwara yo muri Misiri yo mu 2011 n'itorwa rya Mohamed Morsi mu 2012, Morsi yamugize Minisitiri w'Ingabo. Ku wa 3 Nyakanga 2013, yahiritse Morsi binyuze muri kudeta ya gisirikare, maze mu 2014 atorerwa kuba Perezida ku majwi 96,9 %, mu matora yateje impaka. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2018 (97,1 %) no mu 2023 (89,6 %). Kuva mu 2019 kugeza mu 2020, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika.
Yiyerekana nk'uharanira impinduka n'umutekano, ateza imbere imishinga minini (kwagura umuyoboro wa Suez, kubaka umurwa mukuru mushya w'ubutegetsi, ingoro ndangamurage nkuru ya Misiri), ariko ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa nk'ubw'igitugu, burangwa n'ihashywa rikaze ry'abamunenga, iyicarubozo n'ibura ry'abantu ku gahato.
Abdel Fattah al-Sissi akomoka mu muryango w'abacuruzi bato b'i Kayiro, akaba umwe mu bahungu batatu mu bana umunani. Yavukiye i Gamaleya, mu gice cya Kayiro ya kera. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya gisirikare, maze mu 1973 yinjira mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare, ahitamo ingabo zirwanira ku butaka zigendera ku modoka z'intambara. Yize kandi muri "Command &amp; Staff College" yo muri Misiri, mu 1992 ajya mu ishuri rya gisirikare ryo mu Bwongereza i Watchfield, naho mu 2006 yiga muri "United States Army War College", aho yanditse inyandiko yise "Demokarasi mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati".
Yashakanye na Entissar Amer mu 1977; bafitanye abana bane: abahungu batatu (Moustafa, Mahmoud na Hassan) n'umukobwa umwe (Aya). Azwiho kuba umunyedini, uzi Korowani mu mutwe.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Yatangiye umwuga we mu ngabo zirwanira ku butaka, aba umwe mu bahagarariye ingabo muri ambasade ya Misiri muri Arabiya Sawudite, hanyuma umuyobozi w'ingabo zo mu karere k'amajyaruguru ka Alegisandiriya. Mu Kamena 2011, ubwo yari umuyobozi w'iperereza rya gisirikare akaba n'umwe mu bagize Inama nkuru y'ingabo (CSFA) yayoboraga igihugu nyuma y'iyegura rya Moubarak, yashyigikiye ko abagore bigaragambyaga bapimwa ubusugi "kugira ngo ingabo zirindwe ibirego by'ifatwa ku ngufu".
Urugendo muri politiki.
Minisitiri w'Ingabo na kudeta ya 2013.
Muri Kanama 2012, Perezida Mohamed Morsi wo mu muryango w'Abavandimwe b'Abayisilamu ("Frères musulmans") yamugize Minisitiri w'Ingabo, asimbura Mohamed Hussein Tantawi. Kuri uwo mwanya, yongereye imishahara y'abasirikare n'abofisiye.
Mu gihe cy'imyigaragambyo ikomeye yo muri Kamena na Nyakanga 2013 yasabaga ko Morsi yegura, yavuze ko ingabo zifite inshingano "zo kwinjira mu kibazo kugira ngo Misiri itinjira mu mwobo w'amakimbirane"; ku wa 3 Nyakanga 2013, yahiritse Morsi binyuze muri kudeta ya gisirikare. Uwo munsi, yashyizeho umucamanza Adli Mansour, perezida w'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga, nka Perezida w'agateganyo.
Yayoboye ihashywa rikaze ry'Abavandimwe b'Abayisilamu, aho abantu barenga 1 600 bishwe mu bwicanyi bwo ku bibuga bya Rabaa na Nahda; Human Rights Watch yabwise "bumwe mu bwicanyi bukomeye bw'abigaragambya mu mateka ya vuba". Nyuma yaho, yibasiye n'abafatanyabikorwa be b'abasekuleri, abakura muri guverinoma no gufunga abarwanashyaka babo.
Ku wa 27 Mutarama 2014, yazamuwe ku ipeti rya Maréchal. Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2014, yeguye ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Ingabo kugira ngo yiyamamarize kuba Perezida. Ku wa 28 Gicurasi 2014, yatsinze amatora ku majwi 96 %, mu gihe hakekwaga uburiganya. Yarahiye ku wa 8 Kamena 2014, aba Perezida wa gatandatu wa Repubulika y'Abarabu ya Misiri.
Muri Kanama 2014, yatangije umushinga w'umuyoboro mushya wa Suez, wikubye kabiri ubushobozi bw'uwari usanzweho, utwara miliyari 8,4 z'amadolari yose yaturutse mu Misiri; wafunguwe ku wa 6 Kanama 2015. Yatangije kandi umushinga w'imihanda y'igihugu ireshya n'ibirometero birenga 4 400, n'uw'umurwa mukuru mushya w'ubutegetsi uri mu burasirazuba bwa Kayiro. Mu 2016, yiyemeje gukuraho utujagari twose dushobora guteza akaga mu myaka ibiri.
Politiki y'ubukungu.
Yashyizeho amavugurura y'ubukungu yo gukuraho ibyari bisigaye bya politiki y'imibereho myiza yo ku gihe cya Nasser: kugabanya inkunga ya Leta ku ngufu n'amashanyarazi, gushyiraho umusoro ku nyongeragaciro (TVA), kuzamura ibiciro by'itike ya metero ya Kayiro no guhagarika izamuka ry'imishahara y'abakozi ba Leta. Raporo ya Banki y'Isi yo muri Mata 2019 yagaragaje ko 60 % by'Abanyamisiri bari mu bukene cyangwa mu buzima bugoye. Muri Kamena 2018, umwenda w'igihugu wageze ku rwego rutigeze rubaho (miliyari 92,6 z'amadolari), bitewe ahanini n'ingengo y'imari ya gisirikare n'inyungu z'umwenda.
Amatora yo mu 2018 n'ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga.
Muri Mutarama 2018, yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya kabiri. Abantu benshi bari batangaje ko baziyamamaza, barimo Ahmed Chafik na Sami Anan, baratewe ubwoba cyangwa barafungwa. Ku wa 2 Mata 2018, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 97,08 %, mu matora aho uwo bari bahanganye wenyine na we yari amushyigikiye.
Ku wa 16 Mata 2019, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yemeje ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryongereye manda ye imyaka ibiri kandi rimwemerera kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu y'imyaka itandatu; kamarampaka yo kuva ku wa 20 kugeza ku wa 22 Mata 2019 yaryemeje ku majwi 88,8 %. Muri Nzeri 2019, nyuma y'aho umucuruzi uri mu buhungiro Mohamed Ali amushinje ruswa, habaye imyigaragambyo mu migi myinshi; abantu bagera ku 2 000 barafashwe.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Kuva yagera ku butegetsi muri Nyakanga 2013, ibihumbi by'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bishwe cyangwa barafungwa, abandi amagana baburirwa irengero. Nk'uko Human Rights Watch ibivuga, abantu 60 000 bafashwe kuva mu 2013, kandi polisi n'inzego z'umutekano bakoresha iyicarubozo kenshi. Muri Gashyantare 2016, umurambo w'umunyeshuri w'Umutaliyani Giulio Regeni, wishwe akorewe iyicarubozo, wabonetse i Kayiro, bitera ikibazo cya dipolomasi hagati ya Misiri n'Ubutaliyani. Ku wa 17 Kamena 2019, Mohamed Morsi wari ufunzwe yapfiriye mu rukiko. Mu Ukuboza 2020, Perezida w'Ubufaransa Emmanuel Macron yamuhaye umudari usumba iyindi wa "Légion d'honneur", bituma bamwe mu Bataliyani bawuhawe bawusubiza mu rwego rwo kwamagana.
Ku wa 18 Ukuboza 2023, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 89,6 %, atangira manda ya gatatu, igomba kuba iya nyuma nk'uko Itegeko Nshinga ribiteganya; yarahiye ku wa 2 Mata 2024.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga ari Perezida, ku wa 25 Kamena 2014, rwabaye muri Aligeriya. Umubano na Isiraheli waratejwe imbere nyuma y'ikurwaho rya Morsi; ikinyamakuru "The Economist" cyamwise "umuyobozi wa Misiri ushyigikiye Isiraheli kurusha abandi bose". Ubutegetsi bwe bushyigikira igisubizo cy'ibihugu bibiri, Palestine ifite umurwa mukuru i Yeruzalemu y'Iburasirazuba. Mu Ukwakira 2023, mu gihe cy'intambara yo muri Gaza, yavuze ko ibisasu Isiraheli yateraga muri Gaza "byarenze uburenganzira bwo kwirwanaho, bihinduka igihano rusange ku bantu miliyoni 2,3". Muri Kamena 2025, yahagaritse urugendo mpuzamahanga rwerekezaga muri Gaza.
Amakimbirane hagati ya Misiri na Etiyopiya ku rugomero rwa Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam yarakomeje mu 2021; Sissi yagize ati: "Ndabwira abavandimwe bacu bo muri Etiyopiya, ntitukagere aho mukora ku gitonyanga na kimwe cy'amazi ya Misiri, kuko inzira zose zirafunguye". Mu 2019, Emmanuel Macron yamutumiye mu nama ya G7 i Biarritz.

Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo (wavutse ku wa 5 Kamena 1942 i Acoacán, mu karere ka Mongomo, muri Gineya Ekwatoriyale) ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'uwahoze ari umusirikare wo muri Gineya Ekwatoriyale, uyoboye icyo gihugu kuva mu 1979, akaba ari Perezida wacyo wa kabiri kuva mu 1982.
Amaze kwiga mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Zaragoza muri Esipanye, yabaye mu myanya myinshi ku butegetsi bwa nyirarume Francisco Macías Nguema, harimo n'uw'umuyobozi wa gereza ya Playa Negra ("Black Beach"), izwiho guhohotera uburenganzira bwa muntu. Mu 1979, yahiritse Macías binyuze muri kudeta ya gisirikare. Mu 1987, yashinze ishyaka "Parti démocratique de Guinée équatoriale" (PDGE), ryabaye ishyaka rimwe rukumbi ryemewe kugeza mu 1992. Ku butegetsi bwe, Gineya Ekwatoriyale yabaye igihugu gikomeye mu gucukura peteroli kuva mu myaka ya 1990. Kuva mu 2011 kugeza mu 2012, yabaye Perezida w'Ubumwe bwa Afurika.
Afatwa nk'umunyagitugu uyoboye ubutegetsi burangwa na ruswa ikabije, ikoreshwa nabi ry'ububasha, ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu n'ikimenyane. Ni we mukuru w'igihugu utari umwami umaze igihe kirekire ku butegetsi ku isi, nyuma ya Paul Biya wa Kameruni.
Teodoro Obiang yavukiye mu muryango wo mu bwoko bw'Abesangui, ku wa 5 Kamena 1942, mu gace kari mu bukoloni bwa Esipanye, ku mupaka n'Gabon y'ubu. Ni umwana wa gatatu mu bana icumi ba Santiago Nguema Eneme Obama na María Mbasogo Ngui, bombi b'Abanyagabon bari barimukiye muri Gineya ya Esipanye kugira ngo birinde umusoro w'umubiri no kungukira mu bukungu bwari bwifashe neza. Nyina amaze gupfa, we n'abavandimwe be barezwe na se n'umugore we mushya, Carmen Mikue Mbira.
Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 1968, yashakanye na Constancia Mangue Nsue; umuhungu wabo, Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue ("Teodorín"), ni Visi-perezida w'igihugu. Afite abandi bagore, kandi abana be benshi bari mu myanya ikomeye muri guverinoma.
Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye mu kigo cya Cardenal Cisneros cya Ebibeyin no mu kigo cya La Salle cya Bata. Kuva mu 1963 kugeza mu 1965, yize mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Zaragoza muri Esipanye, ahavana ipeti rya sous-lieutenant.
Urugendo mu gisirikare ku butegetsi bwa Macías.
Mu 1969, nyirarume Perezida Francisco Macías Nguema yamugize lieutenant mu ngabo z'igihugu. Mu 1971, yazamuwe ku ipeti rya kapiteni kubera uruhare rwe mu kuvumbura umugambi wa kudeta, hanyuma aba komanda mu 1975. Mu 1979, yabaye Minisitiri wungirije w'Ingabo afite ipeti rya lieutenant-colonel. Mu myaka myinshi, yayoboye gereza ya Playa Negra n'urwego rwose rw'amagereza mu gihugu, aba na guverineri w'ikirwa cya Bioko n'umuyobozi w'ingabo z'igihugu.
Perezida wa Gineya Ekwatoriyale.
Nyuma y'aho Macías ategetse ko abantu benshi bo mu muryango wabo bicwa, barimo na murumuna wa Obiang, Obiang n'abandi bari hafi ya Macías bakeka ko yasaze. Ku wa 3 Kanama 1979, Obiang yamuhiritse muri kudeta yamenekeyemo amaraso, maze amushyikiriza urukiko ku byaha yakoze, harimo jenoside y'Ababubi; Macías yakatiwe urwo gupfa, aricwa arashwe ku wa 29 Nzeri 1979. Obiang yatangaje ko ubutegetsi bushya buzatangira bundi bushya: yahaye imbabazi imfungwa za politiki, akuraho imirimo y'agahato, kandi yongera kwemera ubukirisitu bwari bwarabujijwe, ariko ntiyavuze ku ruhare rwe mu byaha by'ubutegetsi bwa Macías.
Itegeko Nshinga rishya n'amatora.
Mu 1982, igihugu cyasubiye ku butegetsi bwa gisivili mu izina, gishyiraho Itegeko Nshinga rishya; Obiang yatorewe kuba Perezida nta wundi bahanganye, ararahira ku wa 12 Ukwakira 1982. Yongeye gutorwa mu 1989 ari wenyine. Nyuma y'aho amashyaka menshi yemerewe mu 1992, yongeye gutorwa mu 1996 no mu 2002 ku majwi 98 %, mu matora indorerezi mpuzamahanga zavuze ko arimo uburiganya; mu 2002, mu ntara imwe y'itora, yabonye 103 % by'amajwi. Mu 2009, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 97 %, nanone havugwa uburiganya n'iterabwoba. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2016 no mu 2022.
PDGE ifite ububasha hafi bwose, kandi Itegeko Nshinga riha Perezida ububasha bwagutse, harimo n'ubwo kuyobora binyuze mu mateka. Ubwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru bugarukira cyane: ibinyamakuru hafi ya byose ni ibya Leta cyangwa iby'umuhungu we Teodorín.
Mu 2004, habaye umugambi wa kudeta wateguwe n'abacancuro b'abanyamahanga, uyobowe n'Umwongereza Simon Mann, waje gukatirwa gufungwa imyaka 34. Muri Nzeri 2022, Obiang yashyize umukono ku itegeko rikuraho igihano cy'urupfu, icyemezo cyashimwe ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Umubano na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika warazambye mu 1993, ambasade y'Amerika ifungwa mu 1996. Nyuma y'ibitero byo ku wa 11 Nzeri 2001, Amerika yongeye kwita ku bihugu by'Afurika bicukura peteroli; mu ruzinduko rwe rwo mu 2006, Umunyamabanga wa Leta Condoleezza Rice yamwise "inshuti nziza". Ambasade nshya y'Amerika yafunguwe mu 2013. Ku wa 26 Nzeri 2024, yasuye Moscou ahura na Perezida Vladimir Putin.
Ubukungu n'umurwa mukuru mushya.
Mu 1995, sosiyete ExxonMobil yavumbuye peteroli mu gihugu, maze Gineya Ekwatoriyale iba igihugu cya gatatu mu bihugu byo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara bicukura peteroli nyinshi, nyuma ya Nijeriya na Angola. Nubwo igihugu gifite umusaruro mbumbe ku muturage uri hejuru muri Afurika, ubukire bwacyo bugabanywa nabi cyane, ahanini buri mu maboko y'umuryango uri ku butegetsi. Nk'uko "Forbes" ibivuga, Obiang afite umutungo wa miliyoni 600 z'amadolari.
Mu 2012, yategetse kubaka umujyi mushya, Ciudad de la Paz (wahoze witwa Oyala), ku mugabane, kugira ngo usimbure Malabo ku mwanya w'umurwa mukuru. Ku wa 2 Mutarama 2026, yasinye iteka rigira Ciudad de la Paz umurwa mukuru ku mugaragaro.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Mu 2006, yasinye iteka ribuza iyicarubozo, ariko imiryango nka Human Rights Watch na Amnesty International ikomeza kugaragaza iyicarubozo, gukubitwa, impfu zidasobanuwe n'ifungwa rinyuranyije n'amategeko mu magereza. Freedom House yamwise umwe mu banyagitugu "biba umutungo w'igihugu kurusha abandi" bakiriho. Muri Nyakanga 2003, radiyo ya Leta yamwise "Imana y'igihugu" ifite "ububasha bwose ku bantu n'ibintu". Mu 2024, ubutegetsi bwe bwahashye imyigaragambyo ku kirwa cya Annobón, buhagarika itumanaho na interineti kuri icyo kirwa.
Ruswa n'imitungo y'inyerezo.
Ikinyamakuru "Los Angeles Times" cyagaragaje ko amasosiyete akomeye y'Abanyamerika acukura peteroli yishyuraga amafaranga kuri konti igenzurwa na Perezida muri banki ya Riggs i Washington. Mu Bufaransa, mu rubanza ruzwi nka "biens mal acquis", ubucamanza bwafatiriye ibintu mu nzu y'umuryango we iri ku muhanda wa Avenue Foch i Paris, ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 100 z'amayero. Muri Nyakanga 2021, umuhungu we Teodorín yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka itatu gisubitse n'ihazabu ya miliyoni 30 z'amayero. Muri Gicurasi 2009, ubushinjacyaha bwa Esipanye bushinzwe kurwanya ruswa bwasabye iperereza ku iyezandonke ku makonti ye muri Esipanye.

Isaias Afwerki (mu Gitigrinya: ኢሳይያስ ኣፈወርቂ; wavutse ku wa 2 Gashyantare 1946 i Asmara) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyeritereya, akaba ari we Perezida wa mbere kandi wenyine wa Eritereya kuva igihugu kibona ubwigenge mu 1993.
Yarwanye mu ntambara y'ubwigenge bwa Eritereya yo kwigobotora Etiyopiya, aba umuyobozi w'Ingabo za rubanda zo kubohora Eritereya ("Eritrean People's Liberation Front", EPLF). Kuva igihugu kibonye ubwigenge, ayoboye ishyaka rimwe rukumbi, "People's Front for Democracy and Justice" (PFDJ), nta matora ya perezida arigera aba. Imiryango mpuzamahanga myinshi ifata ubutegetsi bwe nk'ubw'igitugu; bwagereranyijwe n'ubwa Koreya ya Ruguru, bwiswe "Koreya ya Ruguru ya Afurika".
Isaias Afwerki yavukiye i Asmara ku wa 2 Gashyantare 1946, ubwo Eritereya yari mu butegetsi bw'Abongereza. Se, ukomoka mu mudugudu wa Tselot hafi ya Asmara, yari umukozi muto mu kigo cya Leta gishinzwe itabi; nyina yari umugore wo mu rugo. Yize mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Prince Makonnen i Asmara, aho yatangiye kuganira kuri politiki iharanira ubwigenge bwa Eritereya. Mu 1965, yatangiye kwiga ubwubatsi ("ingénierie") muri Kaminuza ya Haile Selassie I i Addis-Abeba, ariko ntiyakomeza amasomo.
Intambara y'ubwigenge.
Muri Nzeri 1966, yagiye i Kassala muri Sudani kwinjira mu mutwe "Eritrean Liberation Front" (ELF). Mu 1967, yari mu bantu batanu ba ELF bahawe amahugurwa na Leta y'Ubushinwa mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Nankin, aho yize amahame ya Mao n'amayeri y'intambara y'inyeshyamba. Agarutse, mu 1968 yabaye komiseri wa politiki mu karere ka 5 ka ELF. We n'abandi barwanyi b'Abakirisitu banenze ivangura ryakorerwaga Abakirisitu muri ELF; mu 1970 yabaye umuyobozi w'itsinda ryitandukanyije na ELF, maze mu 1971 ryandika inyandiko "Nihnan Elamanan" ("Twe n'intego zacu") yanditswe na we.
Mu 1973, hashinzwe "Eritrean People's Liberation Front" (EPLF), wahanganye na ELF mu ntambara yiswe "intambara y'abenegihugu ebyiri". Mu 1977, yatorewe kuba umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije wa EPLF, naho mu 1987 aba umunyamabanga mukuru wawo, abona ububasha busesuye kuri uwo mutwe. Muri Mata 1991, EPLF yafashe Asmara, maze nyuma y'ihirikwa ry'ubutegetsi bwa Derg muri Etiyopiya muri Gicurasi 1991, Isaias yabonye inkunga ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika ku bwigenge bwa Eritereya.
Perezida wa Eritereya.
Muri Mata 1993, habaye kamarampaka y'ubwigenge igenzurwa n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye; ubwigenge bwatangajwe ku wa 27 Mata 1993, maze ku wa 24 Gicurasi 1993, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko imutorera kuba Perezida wa Leta ya Eritereya. Ku wa 16 Gashyantare 1994, EPLF yahinduye izina iba "People's Front for Democracy and Justice" (PFDJ), Isaias akomeza kuba umunyamabanga mukuru wayo. Muri Gicurasi 1994, yashyizeho gahunda y'umurimo w'igihugu ku gahato, yagombaga kumara amezi 18.
Kuva atangira, yashyizeho ubutegetsi bw'ishyaka rimwe rukumbi, nta matora, n'ubukungu bugenzurwa na Leta, kandi abuza cyane ubwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru. Nyuma y'intambara ya kabiri na Etiyopiya (1998–2000), ubutegetsi bwe bwarushijeho kuba ubw'igitugu. Mu izina ry'"intambara yo kurengera igihugu", umurimo w'igihugu ku gahato wabaye uw'igihe kitazwi, bituma urubyiruko rwinshi ruhunga igihugu.
Mu 2001, abayobozi 15 ba PFDJ, bitwaga G-15, bandikiye Perezida ibaruwa ifunguye basaba amavugurura n'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryo mu 1997. Ku wa 18 Nzeri 2001, yafunze ibinyamakuru byose byigenga, abayobozi bakomeye b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi barafungwa; 11 mu bagize G-15 barafunzwe, kandi mu 2026 bari bataragera aho barekurwa. Mu bafunzwe harimo umunyamakuru Dawit Isaak, umaze imyaka irenga 20 afunzwe nta rubanza. Mu 2010, abajijwe igihe amatora azabera, yasubije ati: "Reka dutegereze imyaka mirongo itatu cyangwa ine".
Mu 2013, Amnesty International yavuze ko hari nibura imfungwa za politiki 10 000, kandi ko iyicarubozo rikoreshwa kenshi. Muri Kamena 2015, akanama k'Umuryango w'Abibumbye kamushinje kuyobora ubutegetsi bw'igitugu bukabije bukora ihohoterwa rishobora kuba ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu; mu 2016, komisiyo y'iperereza ya Loni yavuze ko habayeho "ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu" kuva mu 1991, ariko Eritereya yanze ibyo birego. Mu 2022, Freedom House yashyize Eritereya mu bihugu "bitisanzuye", ibona inota 1 kuri 40 mu burenganzira bwa politiki.
Mu 1997, yatangaje gahunda yo kwegurira abikorera ibigo 37 bya Leta, kandi Leta itanga impushya zo gucukura amabuye y'agaciro hafi ya Asmara. Mu 2009, yashyigikiye ko igihugu cyishingikiriza ku nzego zacyo bwite n'umutungo gifite, harimo ibikorwa remezo by'ingufu, ubwikorezi n'itumanaho. Nk'uko Banki y'Isi ibivuga, ubuhinzi n'ubucukuzi ni byo bifite uruhare runini mu bukungu; mu 2018, umusaruro mbumbe w'igihugu wazamutseho 12 %.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Kuva ku wa 6 Gicurasi 1998 kugeza mu 2000, Eritereya na Etiyopiya barwanye intambara ku mupaka utavugwaho rumwe wa Badme, ihitana abantu ibihumbi amagana. Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 2000, Eritereya yasinye amasezerano ya Alger, ariko ibihugu byombi bikomeza kuba mu bihe "bitari intambara bitari n'amahoro". Ku wa 9 Nyakanga 2018, Isaias na Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Etiyopiya Abiy Ahmed batangaje iherezo ry'intambara hagati y'ibihugu byombi; ku wa 11 Nzeri 2018, bafunguye imipaka yari ifunzwe kuva mu 1998, maze ku wa 16 Nzeri basinya amasezerano y'amahoro i Djeddah.
Mu ntambara ya Tigray yatangiye ku wa 3 Ugushyingo 2020, ingabo za Eritereya zafatanyije n'iza Etiyopiya kurwanya "Tigray People's Liberation Front" (TPLF); zashinjwe gusahura no kwica abaturage, cyane cyane i Axum. Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2021, nyuma y'igitutu mpuzamahanga, byatangajwe ko ingabo za Eritereya zizava muri Tigray.
Mu ntangiriro z'ubutegetsi bwe, yafatwaga nk'umuyobozi ugezweho, ndetse ashimwa na Perezida Bill Clinton. Yegereye Ubushinwa, bwashoye imari mu mabuye y'agaciro y'igihugu kandi bwubaka ibitaro bya Orotta i Asmara. Muri Nyakanga 2023, yitabiriye inama y'Uburusiya n'Afurika i Saint-Pétersbourg, ahura na Vladimir Putin, ahakana ku mugaragaro ko hari intambara hagati y'Uburusiya na Ukraine. Muri Gicurasi 2026, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika zateganyaga gukuraho ibihano kuri Eritereya, kubera agaciro k'Inyanja Itukura mu bya politiki.
Umubano na Sudani, wari mubi mu ntangiriro, wongeye gusubukurwa mu Ukuboza 2005, kandi Eritereya yagize uruhare mu gutuma habaho amasezerano y'amahoro hagati ya guverinoma ya Sudani n'ihuriro "Eastern Front".
Isaias Afwerki yashakanye na Saba Haile, bafitanye abana batatu: Abraham, Berhane na Elsa. Ururimi rwe kavukire ni Igitigrinya, ariko avuga neza Icyongereza, kandi azi Icyarabu n'Icyamuhariki.

Taye Atske Selassie Amde (mu Cyamuhariki: ታዬ አጽቀሥላሴ; wavutse ku wa 13 Mutarama 1956) ni umudipolomate n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyetiyopiya, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Federasiyo ya Etiyopiya kuva mu 2024. Muri Etiyopiya, umwanya wa Perezida ni uw'icyubahiro; ububasha bwo kuyobora igihugu buri mu maboko ya Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Mbere yo kuba Perezida, yabaye mu myanya myinshi ya dipolomasi, harimo ambasaderi wa Etiyopiya muri Misiri, uhagarariye igihugu cye burundu mu Muryango w'Abibumbye, na Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga.
Taye Atske Selassie yavukiye i Debark, mu karere ka Gondar. Yarangije muri Kaminuza ya Addis Ababa, ahabona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri mu bumenyi bwa politiki n'ububanyi n'amahanga, hanyuma mu 1989 abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu bubanyi n'amahanga n'ubushakashatsi ku ngamba ("strategic studies") muri Kaminuza ya Lancaster mu Bwongereza.
Umwuga wa dipolomasi.
Muri Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga, yabaye umujyanama mu ishami ry'Uburayi, umuyobozi w'ishami ry'Uburayi bw'Iburengerazuba, n'umuyobozi w'agateganyo ushinzwe itangazamakuru. Kuva mu Ukwakira 2002 kugeza mu Ugushyingo 2010, yabaye umujyanama muri ambasade ya Etiyopiya i Washington n'umukonseye mukuru i Los Angeles. Kuva mu 2017 kugeza mu 2018, yabaye ambasaderi wa Etiyopiya muri Misiri, maze mu 2018 aba uhagarariye Etiyopiya burundu mu Muryango w'Abibumbye. Kuri uwo mwanya, yanenze raporo ya komisiyo mpuzamahanga y'impuguke mu burenganzira bwa muntu yagaragazaga ibyaha byakozwe mu ntambara ya Tigray.
Nyuma y'iyegura rya Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga Demeke Mekonnen ku wa 26 Mutarama 2024, Taye yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga ku wa 8 Gashyantare 2024. Yayoboye ibiganiro bitari ibya bugufi na Somaliya, binyuze kuri Turukiya, ku cyifuzo cya Etiyopiya cyo gukodesha ibirometero 20 by'inkombe za Somaliland mu mwanya wo kwemera ubwigenge bwayo.
Perezida wa Etiyopiya.
Perezida Sahle-Work Zewde yavanywe ku mwanya we, bivugwa ko yari yashwanye na Minisitiri w'Intebe Abiy Ahmed. Ku wa 7 Ukwakira 2024, Taye Atske Selassie yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Etiyopiya. Afatwa nk'inshuti ya Abiy Ahmed, kandi atangira manda ye yagaragaje ubushake bwo kuganira.
Muri Gicurasi 2025, yasuye Moscou mu birori by'isabukuru y'imyaka 80 y'intsinzi yo mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi, atumiwe na Perezida Vladimir Putin.

Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema (wavutse ku wa 3 Werurwe 1975 i Ngouoni, mu ntara ya Haut-Ogooué, muri Gabon) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyagabon, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Gabon.
Ubwo yari umuyobozi w'ingabo zirinda Repubulika ("Garde républicaine"), yagize uruhare rukomeye muri kudeta yo ku wa 30 Kanama 2023 yahiritse Perezida Ali Bongo, maze aba Perezida w'inzibacyuho. Mu Mata 2025, yatsinze amatora ya perezida ku majwi agera kuri 95 %, ararahira ku wa 3 Gicurasi 2025 kuyobora igihugu mu gihe cy'imyaka irindwi.
Inkomoko n'amashuri.
Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema yavukiye i Ngouoni, mu karere ka Lékabi-Léwolo mu ntara ya Haut-Ogooué, intara ifatwa nk'indiri y'umuryango wa Bongo. Se yari umusirikare w'Umufang wo mu ntara ya Woleu-Ntem, naho nyina akaba Umuteke. Ni uwo mu muryango wa Bongo, kuko nyina ari mubyara wa nyina wa Perezida Omar Bongo; ni mubyara wa Ali Bongo ku ruhande rwa nyina. Yarezwe ahanini na nyina n'umuryango we i Haut-Ogooué, yiga muri Kaminuza ya Omar Bongo, hanyuma mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Meknès muri Maroke.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Yabaye umufasha wihariye ("aide de camp") wa Perezida Omar Bongo kugeza apfuye mu 2009. Nyuma y'itorwa rya Ali Bongo mu 2009, yoherejwe kuba umusirikare uhagarariye Gabon muri ambasade zayo muri Maroke no muri Senegali, ibyo ubwe yise "ubuhungiro".
Mu Ukwakira 2018, yagaruwe muri Gabon, asimbura Koloneli Frédéric Bongo, murumuna wa Ali Bongo, ku buyobozi bw'urwego rw'iperereza rw'ingabo zirinda Repubulika. Muri Mata 2019, yazamuwe ku ipeti rya Jenerali wa burigade, maze muri Mata 2020 afata ubuyobozi bw'ingabo zirinda Repubulika, asimbura Jenerali Grégoire Kouna. Yongereye cyane umutwe udasanzwe ushinzwe ibikorwa byihariye (SIS), uva ku basirikare bagera kuri 30 ugera ku barenga 300.
Kudeta ya 2023 n'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 30 Kanama 2023, amasaha make nyuma y'uko komisiyo y'amatora itangaje ko Ali Bongo yatsinze amatora ya perezida ku majwi 64 %, Oligui Nguema n'ingabo zirinda Repubulika bafashe ubutegetsi nta guhangana. Agatsiko k'abasirikare kiyise "Comité pour la transition et la restauration des institutions" (CTRI) kasheshe inzego zose za Repubulika, kamugira Perezida w'inzibacyuho. Mu kiganiro na "Le Monde", yavuze ko abasirikare bakoze kudeta kubera kutishimira kwariyongereye kuva Ali Bongo yarwara indwara yo mu bwonko mu 2018, icyemezo cye cyo kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu n'uburyo amatora yakozwe.
Ku wa 4 Nzeri 2023, yarahiriye kuba Perezida w'inzibacyuho mu ngoro ya Perezida i Libreville. Yasezeranyije amatora "yisanzuye kandi aciye mu mucyo", Itegeko Nshinga rishya binyuze muri kamarampaka, n'irekurwa ry'imfungwa zose za politiki. Ku wa 7 Nzeri 2023, yagize Raymond Ndong Sima Minisitiri w'Intebe w'inzibacyuho. Mu Ukwakira 2023, yaretse umushahara wa Perezida, akomeza guhembwa nk'umuyobozi w'ingabo zirinda Repubulika. Ku wa 10 Gashyantare 2024, ivugurura ry'itegeko ry'inzibacyuho ryamwemereye kuziyamamaza mu matora.
Kimwe mu byemezo bye bya mbere nyuma ya kudeta kwari ugufunga abantu bakekwagaho ruswa, barimo Noureddin Bongo Valentin, umuhungu wa Ali Bongo. Muri Gicurasi 2025, nyuma y'ubuhuza bwa Perezida wa Angola João Lourenço, Ali Bongo, umugore we n'umuhungu we barekuwe bajya kuba i Luanda.
Perezida wa Repubulika.
Ku wa 3 Werurwe 2025, yatangaje ko aziyamamaza mu matora ya perezida yo ku wa 12 Mata 2025. Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko yatsinze ku majwi 94,85 %, abitabiriye amatora bakaba 70,4 %. Yarahiriye manda y'imyaka irindwi ku wa 3 Gicurasi 2025.
Ku wa 5 Nyakanga 2025, yashinze ku mugaragaro ishyaka "Union démocratique des bâtisseurs" (UDB), risimbura ihuriro rye ry'amatora "Rassemblement des bâtisseurs". Mu matora y'abadepite yo mu 2025, UDB yabonye imyanya 101 kuri 140 mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, naho ishyaka ryahoze ku butegetsi, "Parti démocratique gabonais", riba irya mbere mu batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi rifite imyanya 17. Muri Kanama 2025, yatangaje itegeko ry'imbabazi rusange ku bagize uruhare muri kudeta yo mu 2023 no mu mugambi wa kudeta wo mu 2019.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Oligui Nguema yakomeje kandi yagura umubano n'ibihugu by'Uburengerazuba, harimo n'Ubufaransa bwahoze bukolonije Gabon; mu bihugu bitanu by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba n'iyo Hagati byabayemo kudeta kuva mu 2020, Gabon ni yo yonyine yasubiye vuba ku butegetsi bwa gisivili kandi ikomeza umubano wa hafi n'igihugu cyayikolonije. Perezida Emmanuel Macron yagiriye uruzinduko rwa Leta i Libreville ku wa 23–24 Ugushyingo 2025. Muri Gashyantare 2026, Gabon na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Abarabu basinyanye amasezerano yagutse y'ubufatanye mu bukungu, harimo n'umushinga w'icyambu cy'amazi maremare cya Mayumba.
Nk'uko iperereza ryo mu 2020 ry'ihuriro ry'abanyamakuru "Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project" (OCCRP) ribivuga, hagati ya 2015 na 2018 yaguze amafaranga mu ntoki inzu eshatu hafi ya Washington, zifite agaciro karenga miliyoni imwe y'amadolari; abajijwe kuri ibyo, yavuze ko ari "ibintu bye bwite".
Yashakanye na Zita Nyangui Oligui, maze muri Werurwe 2024 ashaka undi mugore, Anouchka Avome. Ni umukirisitu. Muramu we, Régis Onanga Ndiaye, ni Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga.

Adama Barrow (wavutse ku wa 16 Gashyantare 1965 i Mankamang Kunda, muri Gambiya) ni umucuruzi n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyagambiya, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Gambiya kuva ku wa 19 Mutarama 2017.
Ashyigikiwe n'ihuriro ry'amashyaka arindwi atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, yatsinze amatora ya perezida yo ku wa 1 Ukuboza 2016, atsinda Yahya Jammeh wari umaze imyaka 22 ku butegetsi. Jammeh yanze kuva ku butegetsi, bituma Barrow ararahira ari muri ambasade ya Gambiya i Dakar, muri Senegali, mbere y'uko igitero cya gisirikare cya CEDEAO gihatira Jammeh guhunga igihugu. Yongeye gutorwa mu Ukuboza 2021.
Adama Barrow yavukiye mu mudugudu wa Mankamang Kunda, mu nkengero z'umujyi wa Basse Santa Su, mu burasirazuba bwa Gambiya. Yize i Koba Kunda no mu Banjul, hanyuma ahabwa buruse yo kwiga mu ishuri ryisumbuye ry'Abayisilamu. Arangije amashuri, yakoreye ikigo cy'ingufu Alhagie Musa Njie &amp; Sons, azamuka kugeza abaye umuyobozi ushinzwe kugurisha.
Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000, yagiye i Londres, aho yize ibijyanye n'imitungo itimukanwa, akanakora nk'umuzamu kugira ngo yishyure amasomo; yavuze ko ubwo buzima bwamwubatse, ati: "Gukora amasaha 15 ku munsi byubaka umugabo". Agarutse muri Gambiya, mu 2006 yashinze ikigo cy'imitungo itimukanwa Majum Real Estate, akiyobora kugeza mu 2016.
Intangiriro muri politiki.
Yatangiye politiki mu ishyaka "National Reconciliation Party" (NRP), hanyuma mu 2007 yinjira mu ishyaka "United Democratic Party" (UDP), ariko atsindwa amatora y'abadepite. Mbere yo kwiyamamariza kuba Perezida, ntiyari yarigeze atorerwa umwanya uwo ari wo wose, ariko yari umubitsi wa UDP.
Amatora yo mu 2016 n'ihererekanyabubasha.
Ku wa 30 Ukwakira 2016, ihuriro ry'amashyaka arindwi atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ryamutoranyije kuba umukandida waryo, maze ava muri UDP kugira ngo yiyamamaze nk'umukandida wigenga. Yasezeranyije gusubiza Gambiya mu Muryango wa Commonwealth no mu Rukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga, kuvugurura inzego z'umutekano, no kuyobora guverinoma y'inzibacyuho akava ku butegetsi nyuma y'imyaka itatu. Ku wa 1 Ukuboza 2016, yatsinze amatora ku majwi 43,3 %, imbere ya Yahya Jammeh (39,6 %) na Mama Kandeh (17,1 %).
Mu ntangiriro, Jammeh yasaga n'uwemera ibyavuye mu matora, ariko ku wa 9 Ukuboza 2016 yatangaje ko abyanze "burundu"; Akanama gashinzwe umutekano ku isi ka Loni, Ubumwe bwa Afurika, CEDEAO n'abandi baramwamaganye. Barrow yahungiye muri Senegali kubera umutekano we. Ku wa 17 Mutarama 2017, Jammeh yatangaje ibihe bidasanzwe, maze bukeye bwaho Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yongera manda ye amezi atatu.
Ku wa 19 Mutarama 2017, Barrow yarahiriye kuba Perezida muri ambasade ya Gambiya i Dakar. Uwo munsi, ingabo za Senegali, Nijeriya na Gana zinjiye muri Gambiya mu gikorwa cya gisirikare cya CEDEAO kugira ngo zihatire Jammeh kuva ku butegetsi; ingabo za Gambiya ntizabarwanyije. Nyuma y'ubuhuza bwa Alpha Condé wa Gineya na Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz wa Moritaniya, Jammeh yemeye kuva ku butegetsi, ahunga igihugu ku wa 21 Mutarama 2017, ajya muri Gineya hanyuma muri Gineya Ekwatoriyale. Barrow yagarutse muri Gambiya ku wa 26 Mutarama 2017, maze ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2017 yongera kurahira muri Gambiya, muri sitade y'Ubwigenge i Bakau.
Perezida wa Gambiya.
Ku wa 23 Mutarama 2017, yagize Fatoumata Tambajang Visi-perezida. Yatangaje ko izina rirambuye ry'igihugu risubira kuba "Repubulika ya Gambiya" aho kuba "Repubulika ya Kisilamu ya Gambiya", nk'uko Jammeh yari yarabihinduye mu 2015. Mu ijambo rye ryo kurahira, yategetse ko imfungwa zose zafunzwe nta rubanza ku butegetsi bwa Jammeh zirekurwa; imfungwa 171 zo muri gereza ya Mile 2 zararekuwe. Yahagaritse icyemezo cyo kuva mu Rukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga, maze Minisitiri w'Ubutabera Ba Tambadou atangaza ishyirwaho rya Komisiyo y'Ukuri, Ubwiyunge n'Indishyi ku bahohotewe ku butegetsi bwa Jammeh. Yahinduye kandi urwego rw'iperereza rw'igihugu (NIA) rwari ruzwiho guhohotera abantu.
Ku wa 10 Gashyantare 2017, yarokotse umugambi wo kumwica ubwo yari mu isengesho mu musigiti wa King Fahd i Banjul. Ku wa 6 Mata 2017, ihuriro rye ryatsinze amatora y'abadepite. Ku wa 21 Nzeri 2017, yasinye amasezerano mpuzamahanga avanaho igihano cy'urupfu. Ku wa 8 Gashyantare 2018, Gambiya yasubiye mu Muryango wa Commonwealth.
Imyigaragambyo ya "Three Years Jotna".
Nubwo yari yasezeranyije kuva ku butegetsi nyuma y'imyaka itatu, yaje kwisubiraho, avuga ko Itegeko Nshinga rimusaba kurangiza manda y'imyaka itanu. Mu 2019 no mu ntangiriro za 2020, habaye imyigaragambyo ikomeye yiswe "Three Years Jotna" ("Imyaka itatu irahagije"), imusaba kuva ku butegetsi; guverinoma yayibujije, abantu amagana barafungwa, abandi batatu barapfa.
Ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2019, yirukanye Visi-perezida Ousainou Darboe n'abaminisitiri benshi ba UDP, maze nyuma y'amezi icumi ashinga ishyaka rye, "National People's Party" (NPP). Umushinga w'Itegeko Nshinga rishya, wagabanyaga manda ya perezida ku ebyiri, wanzwe n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ku wa 22 Nzeri 2020, maze Barrow ashinjwa kuba ari we wateguye iryo tsindwa.
Muri Nzeri 2021, yagiranye ubufatanye n'ishyaka rya Jammeh, "Alliance for Patriotic Reorientation and Construction" (APRC), nubwo Jammeh ubwe yabyamaganye. Mu Ukuboza 2021, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 53 %, atangira manda ya kabiri ku wa 19 Mutarama 2022. Ku wa 21 Ukuboza 2022, guverinoma yatangaje ko yaburijemo umugambi wa kudeta, abasirikare benshi barafungwa.
Adama Barrow ni Umuyisilamu, akaba afite abagore babiri: Fatoumatta Bah, bashakanye mu 1997, akaba Madamu wa Perezida, na Sarjo Mballow. Ku wa 15 Mutarama 2017, umuhungu we Habibu w'imyaka umunani yapfuye nyuma yo kurumwa n'imbwa; Barrow ntiyabashije kujya mu muhango wo kumushyingura kuko yari ari muri Senegali. Avuga ko avanze amoko: Abasarahule, Abamandinka n'Abafula. Ashyigikira ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'Abongereza Arsenal.

Mamadi Doumbouya (wavutse ku wa 5 Ukuboza 1984 i Kankan, muri Gineya) ni umusirikare n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyagineya, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Gineya.
Yagizwe umuyobozi w'Ingabo zidasanzwe za Gineya ("Groupement des forces spéciales") mu 2018, maze ku wa 5 Nzeri 2021 ayobora kudeta yahiritse Perezida Alpha Condé. Yabaye Perezida w'Akanama k'igihugu gashinzwe ubumwe n'iterambere ("Comité national du rassemblement pour le développement", CNRD) na Perezida w'inzibacyuho. Nubwo yari yarasezeranyije ko abagize agatsiko k'abasirikare batazemererwa kwiyamamaza, Itegeko Nshinga rishya ryo mu 2025 ryamwemereye kwiyamamaza; yatsinze amatora ya perezida yo mu Ukuboza 2025 ku majwi 86,7 %, ararahira ku wa 17 Mutarama 2026.
Ubutegetsi bwe burangwa n'ihashywa ry'abatavuga rumwe na bwo, ishimutwa n'ibura ry'abantu, iseswa ry'amashyaka n'ibitangazamakuru.
Inkomoko n'amashuri.
Mamadi Doumbouya ni umuhungu wa Karifala Doumbouya na Hadja Mandioula Sylla. Akomoka mu karere ka Kankan, umujyi wa kabiri munini muri Gineya, aho yize amashuri abanza. Itariki ye y'amavuko yagiye ivugwaho impaka: urubuga rw'ibiro bya Perezida rwabanje kuvuga ko ari ku wa 4 Werurwe 1980, mbere y'uko Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rwemeza ku wa 5 Ukuboza 1984 mu 2025.
Yabaye umusirikare mu mutwe w'Abanyamahanga w'ingabo z'Ubufaransa ("Légion étrangère") i Nîmes, arangiza amasezerano ye mu 2009 afite ipeti rya caporal, hanyuma mu 2012 asubira mu ngabo za Gineya. Yize mu "École de guerre" mu Bufaransa, abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu by'ingabo muri Kaminuza ya Paris-Panthéon-Assas. Yahawe kandi amahugurwa ya gisirikare muri Senegali, Gabon na Isiraheli, akorera ubutumwa muri Afuganisitani, Côte d'Ivoire, Jibuti na Repubulika ya Santara Afurika.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
