Kuva mu 2018, yayoboye Ingabo zidasanzwe za Gineya (GFS), umutwe w'intore z'ingabo zishinzwe kurwanya iterabwoba. Muri Gashyantare 2019, yitabiriye imyitozo ya gisirikare ya Flintlock yateguwe n'ingabo za Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika i Ouagadougou, kimwe na Assimi Goïta wa Mali. Yabaye lieutenant-colonel mu 2019, koloneli mu 2020. Ku wa 24 Mutarama 2024, yagizwe "général de corps d'armée", maze mu Ukuboza 2024 aba "général d'armée".
Kudeta ya 2021 n'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 5 Nzeri 2021, yatangaje ifatwa rya Perezida Alpha Condé, iseswa rya guverinoma, ihagarikwa ry'Itegeko Nshinga, isaha ntarengwa yo kugenda ("couvre-feu") n'ifungwa ry'imipaka. Yavuze ko ibyo byakozwe kubera "imiterere ya politiki n'ubukungu by'igihugu, imikorere mibi y'inzego za Repubulika, ikoreshwa nabi ry'ubutabera n'ihonyorwa ry'uburenganzira bw'abaturage". Ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2021, yarahiriye kuba Perezida w'inzibacyuho imbere y'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga. Itegeko ry'inzibacyuho ryavugaga ko we n'abandi bagize agatsiko k'abasirikare batemerewe kwiyamamaza mu matora azakurikira.
Ku wa 6 Ukwakira 2021, yagize Mohamed Béavogui Minisitiri w'Intebe; asimburwa na Bernard Goumou muri Kanama 2022, hanyuma na Bah Oury muri Gashyantare 2024. Muri Mata 2022, yategetse amasosiyete acukura bauxite, Gineya ifitemo ububiko bunini ku isi, kubaka inganda zitunganya alumine mu gihugu.
CEDEAO yamaganye uburebure bw'inzibacyuho, maze muri Nzeri 2022 ifatira ibihano agatsiko k'abasirikare. Mu Ukwakira 2022, Gineya na CEDEAO bumvikanye ku nzibacyuho y'imyaka ibiri itangira muri Mutarama 2023. Ariko ingengabihe ntiyubahirijwe: muri Nzeri 2024, guverinoma yatangaje ko amatora ya perezida yimuriwe mu 2025.
Itegeko Nshinga rishya n'amatora yo mu 2025.
Ku wa 21 Nzeri 2025, habaye kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga rishya, ryemejwe ku majwi 89,4 %. Iryo tegeko ryongereye manda ya perezida kuva ku myaka itanu kugeza ku irindwi, rishyiraho Sena, kandi ryemerera Perezida w'inzibacyuho kwiyamamaza; abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavuze ko habayeho uburiganya bukabije.
Ku wa 3 Ugushyingo 2025, yatanze kandidatire ye nk'umukandida wigenga. Mu matora yo ku wa 28 Ukuboza 2025, yatsinze ku majwi 86,7 %, ararahira ku wa 17 Mutarama 2026. Muri Mutarama 2026, Ubumwe bwa Afurika bwakuyeho ibihano bwari bwarafatiye Gineya nyuma ya kudeta.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ku wa 21 Nzeri 2021, yasuye Bamako, yakirwa na Koloneli Assimi Goïta. Perezida wa Siyera Lewone Julius Maada Bio ni we mukuru w'igihugu wa mbere wamusuye nyuma ya kudeta. Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame yamusuye muri Gineya; Doumbouya yavuze ko yifuza kuvugurura no kunga igihugu cye nk'uko Kagame yabigenje mu Rwanda. Ku wa 11 Kanama 2024, yitabiriye irahira rya Paul Kagame kuri manda ya kane, maze baganira ku mubano w'ibihugu byombi mu Urugwiro Village. Ku wa 1 Gicurasi 2025, yagiriye uruzinduko rwa Leta rwa kabiri mu Rwanda, mbere yo kwitabira irahira rya Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema muri Gabon.
Muri Nzeri 2024, yitabiriye inama y'ubufatanye hagati y'Ubushinwa n'Afurika (FOCAC) i Beijing, ahura na Xi Jinping, amugezaho gahunda ya "Simandou 2040" yerekeye ikirombe kinini cy'icyuma cya Simandou.
Ihashywa ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi.
Kuva mu 2021, agatsiko k'abasirikare kayobowe na Doumbouya kakajije ingamba zo kubuza ubwisanzure: amashyaka n'ibitangazamakuru byarahagaritswe, imyigaragambyo yabujijwe kuva muri Gicurasi 2022 irahashywa, kandi abayobozi benshi b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'aba sosiyete sivile barafashwe, barakatirwa cyangwa bahungira mu mahanga. Nk'uko Human Rights Watch ibivuga, nibura abantu 59 bishwe mu myigaragambyo hagati ya Kamena 2022 n'impera za 2024.
Ku wa 21 Gicurasi 2024, guverinoma yafunze ibitangazamakuru bitandatu byigenga bikomeye mu gihugu. Umunyamakuru Habib Marouane Camara yashimuswe ku wa 3 Ukuboza 2024 n'abajandarume i Conakry, kandi kugeza ubu ntaraboneka. Mu Ukwakira 2024, agatsiko k'abasirikare kasheshe amashyaka arenga 50, maze muri Werurwe 2026 gasesa andi mashyaka 40, harimo atatu akomeye atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi: UFDG, RPG na UFR.
Muri Nyakanga 2024, abarwanashyaka Foniké Menguè na Mamadou Billo Bah baburiwe irengero; ku wa 22 Nyakanga 2024, imiryango yabo yareze Doumbouya mu Bufaransa ishinja "ishimuta n'iyicarubozo". Muri Kamena 2025, uwahoze ari umukuru w'urugaga rw'abavoka, Mohamed Traoré, yashimuswe arakubitwa. Ku wa 28 Werurwe 2025, Doumbouya yahaye imbabazi kubera impamvu z'ubuzima uwahoze ari Perezida Moussa Dadis Camara, wari warakatiwe kubera ubwicanyi bwo mu 2009 bwahitanye abantu 156.
Akigera ku butegetsi, yashyizeho Urukiko rushinzwe guhana ibyaha by'ubukungu n'imari (CRIEF). Nyamara, ubutegetsi bwe bwavuzwemo amahano y'imari: muri Nzeri 2023, byatangajwe ko ikigo cy'Abashinwa kiri mu mushinga wa Simandou cyari cyarahaye ubutegetsi bwa Conakry miliyoni 75 z'amadolari mu 2021 nta mucyo. Mu mpera za 2024, toni zirenga enye za zahabu zabuze muri Banki Nkuru ya Gineya nyuma yo kwimurirwa i Dubai mu buryo budasobanutse.
Mamadi Doumbouya arubatse, akaba afite abana batandatu. Umugore we, Lauriane Doumbouya, ni Umufaransakazi akaba ari mu jandarumori y'Ubufaransa.

Horta Inta-A Na Man (uzwi kandi nka Horta N'Tam cyangwa N'Ta) ni umujenerali w'Umunyagineya-Biso, akaba Perezida w'inzibacyuho wa Gineya-Biso n'Umuyobozi w'Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa Gisirikare bushinzwe kugarura umutekano w'igihugu n'ituze rusange kuva kudeta yo mu Ugushyingo 2025 yahirika Perezida Umaro Sissoco Embaló.
Horta Inta-A Na Man yavutse mu myaka ya 1960, mu muryango wo mu bwoko bw'Ababalanta. Yize mu ishuri rya gisirikare ryo mu Bumwe bw'Abasoviyeti, kandi yambara ku mpuzankano ye ikirango cyo muri icyo gihe.
Urugendo mu gisirikare.
Yabaye umuyobozi wa batayo y'ingabo zirinda Perezida, maze afasha kurinda Perezida Umaro Sissoco Embaló mu mugambi wa kudeta wo muri Gashyantare 2022. Nyuma yaho, yazamuwe ku ipeti rya Jenerali wa burigade, agirwa umuyobozi w'Ingabo z'igihugu ("Guarda Nacional"), umwanya yamazeho kugeza muri Kamena 2023 ubwo yazamurwaga ku ipeti rya Jenerali majoro. Ku wa 1 Nzeri 2023, yagizwe umugaba mukuru w'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka, asimbura Jenerali Steve Lassana Massaly.
Kudeta ya 2025 n'inzibacyuho.
Ku wa 26 Ugushyingo 2025, Inta-A yagize uruhare muri kudeta yahiritse Perezida Umaro Sissoco Embaló, yari iyobowe na Jenerali wa burigade Dinis Incanha; hashyizweho Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa Gisirikare bushinzwe kugarura umutekano w'igihugu n'ituze rusange, buyobowe na Incanha. Bukeye bwaho, ku wa 27 Ugushyingo 2025, Incanha yeguye, maze Inta-A agirwa Perezida w'inzibacyuho, ararahira ku cyicaro gikuru cy'ingabo i Biso. Ingabo zatangaje ko azayobora mu gihe cy'inzibacyuho cy'umwaka umwe. Iyo kudeta yamaganywe n'umuryango mpuzamahanga, cyane cyane CEDEAO.
Nk'igikorwa cye cya mbere, yagize Ilídio Vieira Té, wari Minisitiri w'Imari ku butegetsi bwa Embaló, Minisitiri w'Intebe, ashyiraho guverinoma y'abantu 27. Ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2025, yatangaje ko hatazihanganirwa na gato abacuruza ibiyobyabwenge. Ku wa 22 Mutarama 2026, yasinye iteka rigena ko amatora y'abadepite n'aya perezida azaba ku wa 6 Ukuboza 2026.
Ku wa 11 Werurwe 2026, guverinoma y'inzibacyuho yashyizeho ibiciro ntarengwa by'imbuto za "cajou", igicuruzwa cy'ingenzi cy'igihugu. Mu mpera za Werurwe 2026, umurambo w'umurwanashyaka urwanya agatsiko k'abasirikare, Vigario Luis Balanta, wabonetse mu murima w'umuceri, bitera imyigaragambyo; abigaragambyaga bashinja agatsiko k'abasirikare urwo rupfu. Ku wa 10 Kanama 2026, yakoreye urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga muri Cade, maze ku wa 30 Kanama 2026 atora muri kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga.

Alassane Dramane Ouattara (akunze kwitwa ADO; wavutse ku wa 1 Mutarama 1942 i Dimbokro, muri Kote Divuwari) ni impuguke mu bukungu n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyakote Divuwari, akaba Perezida wa Repubulika ya Kote Divuwari kuva ku wa 6 Gicurasi 2011.
Yakoreye Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI) na Banki Nkuru y'Ibihugu by'Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (BCEAO), maze aba Minisitiri w'Intebe wa mbere wa Kote Divuwari kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 1993. Mu 1999, yatorewe kuyobora ishyaka "Rassemblement des républicains" (RDR), ariko ntiyemererwa kwiyamamaza mu matora ya perezida yo mu 1995 no mu 2000 kubera ingingo y'"ubunyakote Divuwari" ("ivoirité") yashyizwe mu mategeko y'amatora.
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2010, yatsinze ku majwi 54 % nk'uko komisiyo y'amatora n'umuryango mpuzamahanga hafi ya wose babyemeje, ariko Perezida Laurent Gbagbo yanga kuva ku butegetsi, bitera intambara yahitanye abantu bagera ku 3 000. Yatangiye imirimo nyuma y'ifatwa rya Gbagbo muri Mata 2011. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2015, 2020 na 2025.
Inkomoko n'umuryango.
Alassane Ouattara ni Umuyisilamu wo mu bwoko bw'Abamandingue. Ni umuhungu wa Dramane Ouattara, umwarimu akaba n'umucuruzi ukize, na Hadja Nabintou Cissé. Afite abana babiri yabyaranye n'umugore we wa mbere, Umunyamerikakazi Barbara Jean Davis. Ku wa 24 Kanama 1991, yashakanye i Paris na Dominique Nouvian, umushoramari wacungaga imitungo itimukanwa ya Perezida Félix Houphouët-Boigny. Murumuna we, Téné Birahima Ouattara, yabaye Minisitiri w'Ingabo kuva muri Werurwe 2021.
Abikesheje buruse, yize muri "Drexel Institute of Technology" no muri Kaminuza ya Pennsylvania muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ahakura impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu mu bukungu mu 1967, hanyuma impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (doctorat) mu 1972. Mu 1968, yinjiye muri FMI nk'impuguke mu bukungu. Yakoreye kandi BCEAO, aba visi-guverineri wayo (1983–1984), umuyobozi w'ishami ry'Afurika muri FMI kuva mu 1984, hanyuma guverineri wa BCEAO kuva mu 1988.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Minisitiri w'Intebe (1990–1993).
Ku wa 7 Ugushyingo 1990, Perezida Félix Houphouët-Boigny yamugize Minisitiri w'Intebe, umwanya wari umaze gushyirwaho n'ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga. Yakurikije politiki yo kugabanya amafaranga ya Leta yakomereye abaturage, ariko itunganya imari ya Leta. Ku wa 7 Ukuboza 1993, yatangaje kuri radio-televiziyo y'igihugu urupfu rwa Houphouët-Boigny, avuga ko "Kote Divuwari ibaye impfubyi"; nyuma y'iminsi ibiri yeguye, Henri Konan Bédié aba Perezida.
Ivoirité n'ubuhungiro.
Muri Nyakanga 1994, yabaye Umuyobozi mukuru wungirije wa FMI, Umunyafurika wa mbere wageze kuri uwo mwanya. Mu Ukuboza 1994, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yemeje ivugurura ry'amategeko y'amatora rivuga ko nta muntu ushobora gutorerwa kuba Perezida atari Umunyakote Divuwari kavukire ufite ababyeyi bombi b'Abanyakote Divuwari kavukire. Iyo ngingo y'"ubunyakote Divuwari" yari igamije kubuza Ouattara kwiyamamaza, kuko abamurwanyaga bavugaga ko se akomoka muri Burukina Faso; yateje urwango rushingiye ku moko n'urugomo rwa politiki.
Ku wa 31 Nyakanga 1999, yavuye muri FMI, maze bukeye bwaho atorerwa kuyobora RDR. Mu 2000, Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rwanze kandidatire ye mu matora ya perezida, ruvuga ko ari "uw'ubwenegihugu bushidikanywaho"; uwo mwaka, imirambo 57 y'abakekwagaho kumushyigikira yabonetse mu cyobo rusange cya Yopougon. Ku wa 20 Nzeri 2002, nyuma y'umugambi wa kudeta w'inyeshyamba zo mu majyaruguru, yarokotse ku buryo bwa hafi igitero cy'abashyigikiye Gbagbo cyatwitse inzu ye, ahungira muri ambasade y'u Budage, hanyuma ajya mu buhungiro muri Gabon no mu Bufaransa. Muri Mata 2005, ubuhuza bwa Perezida wa Afurika y'Epfo Thabo Mbeki bwatumye Gbagbo yemera kandidatire ye; ku wa 26 Mutarama 2006, yagarutse muri Kote Divuwari.
Amatora yo mu 2010 n'intambara.
Mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'amatora yo mu 2010, yabaye uwa kabiri ku majwi 32,1 %, inyuma ya Laurent Gbagbo (38 %), ariko mu cyiciro cya kabiri ashyigikirwa na Henri Konan Bédié. Komisiyo y'amatora yigenga yatangaje ko yatsinze ku majwi 54,1 %, ariko Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga, rwiganjemo abashyigikiye Gbagbo, rwatangaje Gbagbo nk'uwatsinze ku majwi 51,5 % nyuma yo guhagarika amajwi yo mu turere turindwi two mu majyaruguru. Umuryango mpuzamahanga hafi ya wose wasabye Gbagbo kuva ku butegetsi.
Ku wa 4 Ukuboza 2010, bombi bararahiye, Ouattara akorera mu ihoteli ya Golf i Abidjan. Ku wa 28 Werurwe 2011, ingabo zimushyigikiye, zitwaga "Forces républicaines de Côte d'Ivoire" (FRCI), zatangiye igitero gikomeye, maze ku wa 11 Mata 2011 Gbagbo n'umugore we Simone barafatwa.
Perezida wa Kote Divuwari.
Manda ya mbere (2011–2015).
Ku wa 4 Gicurasi 2011, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwamwemeje nka Perezida wa Repubulika, ararahira ku wa 6 Gicurasi 2011. Yatangaje ko ashaka kugarura umutekano no kunga Abanyakote Divuwari, nyuma y'intambara yahitanye abantu bagera ku 3 000; ku wa 20 Nyakanga 2011, yashyizeho Komisiyo y'ibiganiro, ukuri n'ubwiyunge iyobowe na Charles Konan Banny. Yasabye kandi Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga gukora iperereza ku bwicanyi bwakozwe.
Nyamara, Amnesty International yamushinje kwihanganira ibikorwa byo kwihimura ku bakekwaho gushyigikira Gbagbo, mu raporo yise "Itegeko ry'abatsinze" mu 2013, ivuga ko nta n'umwe mu bamushyigikiye wakurikiranywe n'ubutabera ku byaha byakozwe mu ntambara. Ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2015, yahaye imbabazi imfungwa 3 100 zo mu ntambara yakurikiye amatora, maze muri Kanama 2018 aha imbabazi abantu 800, barimo Simone Gbagbo.
Akigera ku butegetsi, yatangije gahunda yihutirwa yo kuzahura ubukungu bwari bwasubiye inyuma ho 8 %, n'ivugurura ry'urwego rwa kawa na kakawo mu 2012. Ingendo ze nyinshi mu mahanga zatumye Banki y'Isi na FMI bagabanya umwenda w'igihugu wo hanze ho miliyari 4,4 z'amadolari.
Manda ya kabiri n'iya gatatu (2015–2025).
Ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2015, yongeye gutorwa mu cyiciro cya mbere ku majwi 83,7 %. Mu 2017, abahoze ari inyeshyamba zo mu majyaruguru zamufashije gufata ubutegetsi mu 2011 bigometse inshuro nyinshi, basaba ibihembo.
Ku wa 5 Werurwe 2020, yatangaje ko atazongera kwiyamamaza, maze atoranya Minisitiri w'Intebe Amadou Gon Coulibaly kuba umukandida w'ishyaka RHDP. Gon Coulibaly amaze gupfa muri Nyakanga 2020, Ouattara yisubiyeho, atangaza ku wa 6 Kanama 2020 ko aziyamamariza manda ya gatatu. Iyo kandidatire yateje impaka kuko Itegeko Nshinga ryemeraga manda ebyiri gusa; Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko manda ye ya mbere, yatangiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya kera, itabarwa. Abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze kwitabira amatora, kandi abantu bagera kuri 30 bapfiriye mu mvururu. Yatsinze ku majwi 95,3 %, abitabiriye amatora bakaba 53,9 %, ararahira ku wa 14 Ukuboza 2020.
Manda ya kane (kuva 2025).
Ku wa 29 Nyakanga 2025, yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya kane mu matora yo ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2025. Kandidatire z'abayobozi b'amashyaka akomeye atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Laurent Gbagbo (PPA-CI) na Tidjane Thiam (PDCI-RDA), zanzwe n'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga; bombi bamaganye "ikinamico ry'amatora" na "kudeta ya gisivili". Yatsinze ku majwi agera kuri 90 %, abitabiriye amatora bakaba 50,09 %, ararahira ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2025.

Dafroza Gauthier, wavutse yitwa Dafroza Mukarumongi (4 Kanama 1954 – 3 Ukwakira 2026), yari injeniyeri mu by'ubutabire akaba n'umurwanashyaka w'Umufaransakazi ukomoka mu Rwanda. Yamenyekanye cyane kubera gukurikirana abagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bahungiye mu Bufaransa, kugira ngo bashyikirizwe ubutabera.
Mu 2001, we n'umugabo we Alain Gauthier bashinze ihuriro ry'abaregera indishyi ku Rwanda ("Collectif des parties civiles pour le Rwanda", CPCR). Ibikorwa byabo byatumye abagabo barindwi bagize uruhare muri jenoside bahamwa n'ibyaha burundu n'inkiko z'Ubufaransa. Umukwe we ni umuririmbyi akaba n'umwanditsi Gaël Faye.
Dafroza Mukarumongi yavukiye i Astrida (ubu ni Butare) ku ya 4 Kanama 1954, mu muryango w'Abatutsi b'abapasitori ukomoka mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda. Yahuye n'ihohoterwa rikiri muto: mu 1963, igihe yari afite imyaka icyenda, se yiciwe mu bwicanyi bwabereye i Gikongoro, maze we ahungira muri kiliziya ya Kibeho. Yize amashuri yisumbuye i Butare, nyuma yiga muri "Lycée de Kigali".
Ubuhunzi n'ubuzima mu Bufaransa.
Mu 1973, kubera ubwicanyi bwibasiye Abatutsi, yahunze igihugu. Yabanje kuba mu Uburundi hafi y'umujyi wa Kirundo, nyuma i Bujumbura, maze muri Nzeri 1973 ajya mu Ububiligi aho yakiriwe na musaza we, akomeza amashuri.
Mu 1975 yongeye guhura na Alain Gauthier, bari baramenyaniye i Butare aho yigishaga igifaransa. Bashyingiranwe mu 1977, ahabwa ubwenegihugu bw'Ubufaransa. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1980 batura i Reims, aho babyariye abana batatu.
Jenoside yo mu 1994.
Mu mpera za Gashyantare 1994 yasuye umuryango we i Kigali, asanga umujyi wuzuye Interahamwe n'imvugo z'urwango za Radiyo RTLM, maze nyina amusaba gusubira i Burayi. Ku ya 8 Mata 1994, nyina Suzana Mukamusoni yarasiwe imbere ya kiliziya ya Charles Lwanga i Nyamirambo; iyo nkuru yayibwiwe na Henri Blanchard. Mu gihe cya jenoside, abantu bagera kuri 80 bo mu muryango wa nyina barishwe.
Guharanira ubutabera.
Mu 1996, asubiye mu Rwanda, yumvise ubuhamya bw'abarokotse maze yiyemeza kubushyikiriza umunyamategeko i Paris. Mu 2001 yakurikiranye urubanza rw'«Abanyabutare bane» i Buruseli, urubanza rwa mbere rwa jenoside rwabereye mu mahanga.
Mu Gushyingo 2001, we n'umugabo we bashinze CPCR. Bajyaga mu Rwanda inshuro eshatu cyangwa enye mu mwaka gushaka ubuhamya bw'abarokotse, abahoze ari abicanyi n'imfungwa, bagakora amadosiye bashyikiriza ubutabera bw'Ubufaransa. Ni bo batanze hafi ibirego byose (bigera kuri 30) byatanzwe mu Bufaransa ku Banyarwanda bakekwaho jenoside, barimo Laurent Bucyibaruta, Félicien Kabuga, Philippe Hategekimana, Aloys Ntiwiragabo, Agathe Habyarimana, Padiri Wenceslas Munyeshyaka wa paruwasi ya Saint Famille na muganga Sosthène Munyemana.
Ishyirwaho ry'ishami ry'urukiko rw'i Paris rishinzwe ibyaha bya jenoside (2012) ryihutishije imanza. Muri Gashyantare 2014, mu rubanza rwa mbere, urwa Pascal Simbikangwa, Dafroza Gauthier yatanze ubuhamya; Simbikangwa yahamwe n'icyaha cya jenoside. Ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2024, muganga Eugene Rwamucyo, wari mu ba mbere bareze mu 2007, yakatiwe imyaka 27 y'igifungo. Kubera ibikorwa byabo, abashakanye ba Gauthier bakunze kwitwa «Aba-Klarsfeld b'u Rwanda».
Yakundaga gutanga ibiganiro mu mashuri no muri kaminuza, arwanya ihakana rya jenoside. Mu Gushyingo 2017, Perezida Paul Kagame yabahaye umudari w'ishimwe w'ubucuti budasanzwe. Mu 2023, filime mbarankuru n'igitabo cy'amashusho "Rwanda, à la poursuite des génocidaires" byavuze ku rugamba rwabo.
Dafroza Gauthier yapfuye ku ya 3 Ukwakira 2026 i Reims, afite imyaka 72, azize kanseri. Umuryango Ibuka wihanganishije umuryango we.

Joseph Nyuma Boakai (wavutse ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 1944 i Worsonga, mu ntara ya Lofa, muri Liberiya) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaliberiya, akaba Perezida wa 26 wa Liberiya kuva mu 2024.
Yabaye Minisitiri w'Ubuhinzi kuva mu 1983 kugeza mu 1985, hanyuma aba Visi-perezida wa Liberiya kuva mu 2006 kugeza mu 2018 ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Ellen Johnson Sirleaf. Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2017, yatsinzwe na George Weah, ariko mu matora yo mu 2023 aramutsinda.
Joseph Boakai yavukiye mu mudugudu wa Worsonga uri kure, mu karere ka Foya mu ntara ya Lofa, mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'igihugu hafi y'umupaka na Gineya. Ni uwo mu bwoko bw'Abakissi. Akomoka mu muryango w'abahinzi bakennye, ababyeyi be bombi batazi gusoma no kwandika. Ni umwe mu "basangwabutaka", si uwo mu bakomoka ku bacakara b'Abanyamerika babohowe bayoboye igihugu igihe kirekire.
Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye muri Siyera Lewone no muri Liberiya, hanyuma arangiza muri "College of West Africa" i Monrovia. Mu 1972, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri mu bucungamutungo muri Kaminuza ya Liberiya, akomereza muri Kaminuza ya Kansas muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika.
Yashakanye na Katumu Boakai, bafitanye abana bane. Ni Umubatisita, akaba umudiyakoni w'itorero Effort Baptist Church i Paynesville.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Yakoreye ikigo cya Leta gishinzwe kugurisha ibikomoka ku buhinzi (LPMC) kuva mu 1973 kugeza mu 1982. Kuva mu 1983 kugeza mu 1985, yabaye Minisitiri w'Ubuhinzi ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Samuel Doe, anayobora Ishyirahamwe ry'ibihugu 15 byo muri Afurika y'Iburengerazuba ry'iterambere ry'umuceri. Mu 1992, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo gitunganya peteroli (LPRC), hanyuma aba umujyanama wa Banki y'Isi i Washington.
Mu 2005, nyuma y'intambara z'abenegihugu zamaze igihe kirekire, yatorewe kuba Visi-perezida, afatanyije na Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, umugore wa mbere watorewe kuyobora igihugu cy'Afurika. Nka Visi-perezida, yayoboraga Sena, kandi yagenzuraga inzego zitandukanye, harimo n'akanama k'igihugu gashinzwe kwambura intwaro, gusezerera no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abahoze ari abarwanyi.
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2017, nk'umukandida wa "Unity Party", yageze mu cyiciro cya kabiri, ariko atsindwa n'uwahoze ari icyamamare mu mupira w'amaguru, George Weah, ku majwi 38,46 %.
Perezida wa Liberiya.
Mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'amatora ya perezida cyo ku wa 14 Ugushyingo 2023, yatsinze George Weah ku majwi 50,64 %. Ku wa 22 Mutarama 2024, afite imyaka 79, yarahiriye kuba Perezida, aba Perezida ukuze kurusha abandi mu mateka ya Liberiya. Mu muhango wo kurahira, ntiyabashije kurangiza ijambo rye, maze bamukura ku ruhimbi, bivugwa ko yari yagizweho ingaruka n'ubushyuhe.
Yashyize imbere kurwanya ruswa: yategetse igenzura ry'inzego zikomeye nka Banki Nkuru ya Liberiya, ahagarika abayobozi barenga 450, barimo n'abaminisitiri, kubera kutagaragaza imitungo yabo, kandi agabanya umushahara we ho 40 %. Mu mwaka we wa mbere, amanota ya Liberiya mu cyegeranyo cya Transparency International ku myumvire ya ruswa yazamutseho amanota abiri. Ku wa 5 Nyakanga 2025, yasabye imbabazi ku mugaragaro abahohotewe mu ntambara ya mbere n'iya kabiri z'abenegihugu muri Liberiya.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Politiki ye y'ububanyi n'amahanga yibanda kuri dipolomasi y'ubukungu, ishaka ko Liberiya iva ku kwishingikiriza ku nkunga ikajya ku bufatanye bushingiye ku bucuruzi n'ishoramari. Ku wa 9 Nyakanga 2025, yahuriye i Washington na Perezida Donald Trump, amusaba ko Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika zashora imari muri Liberiya. Muri Kamena 2025, Liberiya yatorewe kuba umunyamuryango udahoraho w'Akanama gashinzwe umutekano ku isi ka Loni mu gihe cya 2026–2027.

Mohamed Yunus el-Menfi (mu Cyarabu: محمد يونس المنفي; wavutse ku wa 3 Werurwe 1976) ni umudipolomate n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyalibiya, akaba Perezida w'Inama ya Perezidansi ya Libiya ("Presidential Council"), urwego ruhuriweho rukora nk'ubuyobozi bukuru bw'igihugu, kuva mu 2021.
Ku wa 5 Gashyantare 2021, yatorewe kuyobora iyo Nama mu Ihuriro ry'Ibiganiro bya Politiki rya Libiya ("Libyan Political Dialogue Forum") ryateguwe n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye. Asimbura Fayez el-Sarraj ku wa 15 Werurwe 2021. Mbere yaho, yari ambasaderi wa Libiya mu Ubugereki.
Ambasaderi mu Bugereki.
Mu 2018, yagizwe ambasaderi wa Libiya mu Bugereki. Igihe yari i Atene cyaranzwe n'umubano mubi hagati ya guverinoma y'ubumwe bw'igihugu ya Libiya (GNA) na guverinoma y'u Bugereki, kubera amasezerano yasinywe hagati ya Libiya na Turukiya ku mipaka yo mu nyanja, ari na yo ntandaro y'amakimbirane amaze igihe kirekire hagati ya Turukiya n'u Bugereki ku burenganzira bwo gucukura mu Nyanja ya Mediterane. Mu Ukuboza 2019, yirukanywe mu Bugereki.
Perezida w'Inama ya Perezidansi.
Mu buryo bwo guhitamo ubuyobozi bukuru buhuriweho bwagombaga kuyobora igihugu kugeza ku matora rusange yari ateganyijwe ku wa 24 Ukuboza 2021, el-Menfi yiyamamaje ku rutonde rumwe na Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe, hamwe na Musa Al-Koni na Abdullah al-Lafi nk'abagize Inama ya Perezidansi. Urutonde rwabo rwabonye amajwi 39, atanu arenga ay'urutonde rwa Aguila Saleh Issa na Fathi Bashagha. Ambasaderi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika yahakanye ko hari ibikorwa byo kugira icyo bihindura ku matora yo kurwanya el-Menfi. Ayo matora rusange ntiyigeze aba, kandi igihugu gikomeza gucikamo ibice hagati y'ubutegetsi bwa Tripoli mu burengerazuba n'ubwa Khalifa Haftar mu burasirazuba.
Ikibazo cya Banki Nkuru yo mu 2024.
Muri Kanama 2024, el-Menfi yakuye ku mwanya guverineri wa Banki Nkuru ya Libiya, Sadiq Al-Kabir, icyemezo cyateje impaka. Nyuma y'ukwezi, mu kiganiro cye cya mbere n'abanyamakuru bo mu Burengerazuba, yavuze ko Al-Kabir yacungaga nabi imari ya banki "nta buryo bwo kubazwa inshingano", kandi ko "yakoreshaga amacakubiri" hagati y'uburasirazuba n'uburengerazuba bwa Libiya.
Ku wa 25 Nzeri 2024, ubutegetsi bwa Tripoli n'ubwa Tobruk bushyigikiwe na Haftar bumvikanye ku guverineri w'agateganyo n'akanama gashinzwe imari ka banki, amasezerano yafashijwemo n'ubutumwa bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye muri Libiya; el-Menfi yavuze ko ayo masezerano yarinze umurwa mukuru Tripoli "intambara yari kwibasira banki nkuru mu buryo butaziguye". Muri uwo mwaka, mu nama rusange y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye i New York, yasinyanye n'Urugaga rw'Ubucuruzi rw'Abanyamerika muri Libiya amasezerano yo gushyigikira iterambere rirambye ry'ubukungu n'uruhare rw'amasosiyete y'Abanyamerika ku isoko rya Libiya.

Michaël Randrianirina (yavukiye i Sevohipoty, hafi ya Ambovombe, mu karere ka Androy mu majyepfo ya Madagasikari) ni umusirikare mukuru n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyamadagasikari, akaba Perezida wa Madagasikari kuva mu Ukwakira 2025 n'umuyobozi w'Inama ya Perezidansi ishinzwe kongera kubaka Repubulika ya Madagasikari ("Refondation"). Itariki ye y'amavuko ntivugwaho rumwe: bimwe mu bitangazamakuru bivuga ku wa 23 Kanama 1973, abandi bakavuga mu 1974.
Yabaye guverineri w'akarere ka Androy kuva mu 2016 kugeza mu 2018, hanyuma aba umuyobozi w'umutwe w'intore z'ingabo CAPSAT. Nk'umuyobozi wa CAPSAT, yabaye umuntu w'ingenzi mu myigaragambyo y'urubyiruko ("Generation Z") yo mu Ukwakira 2025, yatumye Perezida Andry Rajoelina ahunga igihugu kandi Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ikamukura ku butegetsi. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida imbere y'Urukiko Rukuru rurinda Itegeko Nshinga ku wa 17 Ukwakira 2025, nubwo ahakana ko habayeho kudeta.
Ubuzima n'urugendo mu gisirikare.
Michaël Randrianirina yahawe amahugurwa ya gisirikare mu Ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Antsirabe (ACMIL). Kuva mu 2016 kugeza mu 2018, ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Hery Rajaonarimampianina, yabaye guverineri w'akarere ka Androy. Nyuma yaho, yabaye umuyobozi wa batayo y'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka i Toliara kugeza muri Nyakanga 2022, hanyuma ayobora umutwe w'intore CAPSAT ("Corps d'armée des personnels et des services administratifs et techniques").
Buhoro buhoro, yabaye umwe mu banenga Perezida Andry Rajoelina. Ku wa 27 Ugushyingo 2023, yafashwe ashinjwa "gushishikariza abasirikare kwigomeka no kugerageza gukora kudeta", ajyanwa muri gereza ya Tsiafahy. Muri Gashyantare 2024, yararekuwe nyuma yo gukatirwa igihano gisubitse azira guhungabanya umutekano w'igihugu, maze asubira muri CAPSAT.
Ikibazo cya politiki cyo mu 2025.
Kuva ku wa 25 Nzeri 2025, imyigaragambyo y'urubyiruko yiswe iya "Generation Z" yatangiriye i Antananarivo, ibanza kwamagana ibura rya hato na hato ry'amashanyarazi n'amazi, hanyuma yamagana ruswa, ubuzima buhenze n'ubukene, isaba ko Perezida Rajoelina yegura.
Mu mpera z'icyumweru cyo ku wa 11–12 Ukwakira 2025, Koloneli Randrianirina n'abasirikare ba CAPSAT bavuye mu bigo byabo bajya kwifatanya n'abigaragambya, batangaza ko banze kurasa abaturage. Uwo mutwe wari warigeze no kugira uruhare rukomeye muri kudeta yo mu 2009 yazanye Rajoelina ku butegetsi. Ku wa 13 Ukwakira, CAPSAT yatangaje ko ifashe ubuyobozi bw'ingabo zose. Rajoelina yahunze igihugu ku wa 12 Ukwakira, bivugwa ko yatwawe n'indege ya gisirikare y'Abafaransa, maze ku wa 14 Ukwakira Inteko Ishinga Amategeko imukura ku butegetsi ku majwi 130. Randrianirina yahakanye ko habayeho kudeta, avuga ko ingabo "zasubije gusa ku guhamagarwa n'abaturage b'Abanyamadagasikari".
Perezida wa Madagasikari.
Ku wa 14 Ukwakira 2025, yatangaje ko ingabo zifashe ubutegetsi, zishyiraho Inama ya Perezidansi igizwe n'abasirikare n'abajandarume, zihagarika Itegeko Nshinga, Sena n'Urukiko Rukuru rurinda Itegeko Nshinga, ariko Inteko Ishinga Amategeko igakomeza imirimo. Uwo munsi, Urukiko Rukuru rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwamusabye gukora imirimo y'umukuru w'igihugu. Ku wa 16 Ukwakira, yisubiyeho ku iseswa rya Sena n'urwo Rukiko, maze ku wa 17 Ukwakira 2025 ararahira nka "Perezida w'Ivugurura rya Repubulika ya Madagasikari". Mu ijambo rye, yavuze ko ari "ihinduka ry'amateka" kandi yiyemeje "gutandukana n'ibya kera".
Kubera umwanya we w'umukuru w'igihugu, yagombaga no kuyobora Umuryango w'Iterambere wa Afurika y'Amajyepfo (SADC), ariko ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2025 guverinoma ye yatangaje ko iretse uwo mwanya; ku wa 7 Ugushyingo, Perezida wa Afurika y’Epfo Cyril Ramaphosa yawuhawe by'agateganyo.
Ku wa 20 Ukwakira 2025, yagize umucuruzi Herintsalama Rajaonarivelo Minisitiri w'Intebe. Mu kiganiro na "Sky News" ku wa 10 Ugushyingo, yasezeranyije amatora mu mezi 18 kugeza kuri 24 nyuma y'igihe cy'"ivugurura n'isanamitima", avuga ko azegura niba abaturage batakimushyigikiye. Ku wa 17 Ugushyingo 2025, yatangaje ibiganiro by'igihugu byose biyobowe n'Inama y'Amatorero ya Gikirisitu muri Madagasikari, kugira ngo hashyirweho uburyo bushya bw'imiyoborere, bikurikirwe na kamarampaka n'amatora ya perezida mu myaka ibiri; yasezeranyije kandi ishyirwaho ry'Inteko y'Urubyiruko.
Ku wa 12 Gashyantare 2026, yasuye Toamasina kureba ibyangijwe na serwakira Gezani. Ku wa 9 Werurwe 2026, yasheshe guverinoma ya Rajaonarivelo, nyuma y'imyigaragambyo y'imiryango y'urubyiruko yasabaga ko Minisitiri w'Intebe agenda, maze ku wa 15 Werurwe agira Mamitiana Rajaonarison Minisitiri w'Intebe. Yatangaje ko abifuza kuba abaminisitiri bazajya babanza gupimwa n'imashini isuzuma ibinyoma kugira ngo harwanywe ruswa.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Muri Mutarama 2026, yatangaje ko Madagasikari ishaka kuba umufatanyabikorwa w'ihuriro BRICS. Ku wa 19 Gashyantare 2026, yahuriye i Kremlin na Perezida w'Uburusiya Vladimir Putin, rukaba rwari urugendo rwe rwa mbere hanze y'Afurika. Ku wa 24 Gashyantare 2026, yakiriwe na Perezida Emmanuel Macron mu ngoro y'Élysée i Paris.
Ni umuyoboke ukomeye w'Itorero ry'Abaluteri rya Madagasikari, aho afite icyiciro cya "Mpiandry", umulayiki uhabwa inshingano z'ubudiyakoni. Yashakanye na Elisa Randrianirina.

Arthur Peter Mutharika (wavutse ku wa 18 Nyakanga 1940) ni umunyamategeko n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyamalawi, akaba Perezida wa Malawi kuva mu 2025. Yari yarabaye Perezida wa gatanu wa Malawi kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2020. Ni murumuna wa Perezida wa gatatu wa Malawi, Bingu wa Mutharika, kandi ayobora ishyaka "Democratic Progressive Party" (DPP) kuva mu 2012.
Ni umwarimu w'amategeko, inzobere mu mategeko mpuzamahanga y'ubukungu, amategeko mpuzamahanga n'amategeko nshinga agereranywa; yamaze imyaka igera kuri 30 aba muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Yatsinze amatora ya perezida yo mu 2014, ariko mu 2020 atsindwa na Lazarus Chakwera nyuma y'iseswa ry'amatora yo mu 2019 kubera amakosa. Mu 2025, afite imyaka 85, yongeye gutsinda Chakwera, aba Perezida wa Malawi ukuze kurusha abandi wagiye ku butegetsi akaba n'uwa mbere wayoboye manda ebyiri zidakurikiranye.
Peter Mutharika yavukiye mu karere ka Thyolo; ababyeyi be bari abarimu. Ibindi bitangazamakuru bivuga ko yavukiye i Zomba. Yize mu ishuri ribanza rya Mulanje Mission no mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Dedza. Mu 1965, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri mu mategeko muri Kaminuza ya Londres, hanyuma muri Kaminuza ya Yale abona iy'icyiciro cya gatatu mu 1966 n'impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu 1969. Kuva mu 1971, yemerewe gukora umwuga w'ubwunganizi muri Tanzaniya.
Yigishije muri Kaminuza ya Dar es Salaam (Tanzaniya), Kaminuza ya Haile Selassie (Etiyopiya), Kaminuza ya Rutgers (Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika), muri Kaminuza ya Makerere (Uganda), ndetse amara imyaka 37 yigisha muri Kaminuza ya Washington i Saint-Louis. Yabaye kandi umushakashatsi watumiwe muri "London School of Economics" n'umujyanama mu gikorwa cy'Urugaga rw'Abavoka b'Abanyamerika ku butegetsi bugendera ku mategeko muri Afurika. Muri Kanama 2011, yeguye ku mwanya w'umukemurampaka mu manza ebyiri z'Ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe gukemura amakimbirane ajyanye n'ishoramari (ICSID) zerekeye Zimbabwe, kubera impungenge ku kutabogama kwe zatewe n'umubano wa hafi wa murumuna we Bingu na guverinoma ya Robert Mugabe.
Urugendo muri politiki.
Kuva mu 2004, yabaye umujyanama wa mukuru we Perezida Bingu wa Mutharika ku bibazo by'ububanyi n'amahanga n'iby'imbere mu gihugu, kugeza apfuye ku wa 5 Mata 2012. Muri Gicurasi 2009, yatorewe kuba umudepite, maze aba Minisitiri w'Ubutabera, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Uburezi, Ubumenyi n'Ikoranabuhanga, naho kuva muri Nzeri 2011 aba Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga. Muri Kanama 2011, inama nkuru y'ishyaka DPP yamutoranyije kuba umukandida waryo mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2014.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Bingu mu 2012, yashinjwe kugerageza guhisha urwo rupfu no kubuza Visi-perezida Joyce Banda kumusimbura nk'uko Itegeko Nshinga ribiteganya; Banda yabaye Perezida ashyigikiwe n'ingabo. Habayeho kandi impaka ku bwenegihugu bwe, kuko Malawi itemera ubwenegihugu bubiri; ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika yemeje ko atari umwenegihugu w'Amerika, ahubwo afite gusa uruhushya rwo kuhatura ("Green card").
Manda ya mbere (2014–2020).
Ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2014, Perezida Joyce Banda yashatse guhagarika amatora yo ku wa 20 Gicurasi, avuga ko habayemo uburiganya, ariko Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rumusaba kutivanga mu matora; ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2014, yemeye ko yatsinzwe, maze Mutharika ararahira uwo munsi i Blantyre. Manda ye yaranzwe n'izamuka ry'ubukungu, aho izamuka ry'ibiciro ryavuye kuri 24 % mu 2014 rikagera munsi ya 10 % mu 2019, ariko kandi n'uburakari bw'abaturage kubera ruswa, ibura ry'ibiribwa n'ibura ry'amashanyarazi; mu 2018, abantu ibihumbi bigaragambije bamagana ruswa. Ubwe yashinjwe kwakira amadolari arenga 200 000 y'umucuruzi wari watsindiye isoko rya polisi.
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2019, yatangajwe ko yatsinze ku majwi 38,6 %, imbere ya Lazarus Chakwera (35,4 %), wavuze ko habayeho uburiganya. Ku wa 3 Gashyantare 2020, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwasheshe ayo matora, rutegeka ko asubirwamo; abamurwanyaga bamwita "Perezida Tipp-Ex". Mu matora yasubiwemo ku wa 23 Kamena 2020, yatsinzwe na Chakwera washyigikiwe n'ihuriro ry'amashyaka icyenda (Tonse Alliance), wabonye 59,3 % kuri 39,9 %.
Hagati ya manda zombi.
Muri Kanama 2020, Komisiyo yo kurwanya ruswa ya Malawi yafatiriye konti z'amabanki ze n'iz'umugore we, mu iperereza ku itumizwa rya sima ifite agaciro ka miliyari 5 za kwacha nta misoro. Muri Mutarama 2021, Urukiko Rukuru rwanze icyifuzo cye cyo gukuraho iryo fatira.
Manda ya kabiri (kuva 2025).
Muri Kanama 2024, DPP yamutoranyije kuba umukandida mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2025. Ku wa 16 Nzeri 2025, yatsinze ku majwi 56,8 %, imbere ya Perezida wari uriho Lazarus Chakwera (33 %). Ku wa 4 Ukwakira 2025, afite imyaka 85, yarahiriye manda ya kabiri muri sitade Kamuzu i Blantyre.
Ku wa 21 Ukwakira 2025, yatangaje ko amafaranga y'ishuri mu mashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye azakurwaho guhera muri Mutarama 2026, uretse ku mashuri y'abacumbikirwa. Guverinoma ye yaguze toni 200 000 z'ibigori muri Zambiya kugira ngo igaburire abantu barenga miliyoni enye bafite ikibazo cy'inzara, kandi ku wa 23 Ukwakira itangaza ko izabuza kohereza mu mahanga amabuye y'agaciro atatunganyijwe.
Afite abakobwa babiri, Moyenda na Monique, n'umuhungu umwe, Mahopela, yabyaranye n'umugore we wa mbere, Christophine, wapfuye azize kanseri ku wa 1 Mutarama 1990. Ku wa 21 Kamena 2014, yashakanye na Gertrude Maseko, umudepite. Ni umuyoboke w'Itorero rya Presbytériens.

Mohamed Ould Ghazouani (izina ryuzuye: "Mohamed Ould Cheikh Mohamed Ahmed Ould Ghazouani"; yavutse ku ya 31 Ukuboza 1956 i Boumdeid, mu ntara ya Assaba) ni umusirikare mukuru akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Moritaniya, Perezida wa cyenda w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 1 Kanama 2019. Mbere yo kuba perezida, yabaye umugaba mukuru w'ingabo (2008–2018) na Minisitiri w'Ingabo (2018–2019). Itorwa rye mu 2019 ryabaye ihererekanyabubasha rya mbere mu mahoro hagati y'abaperezida batowe muri Moritaniya kuva yabona ubwigenge. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2024, kandi yayoboye Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe kuva muri Gashyantare 2024 kugeza muri Gashyantare 2025.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Ghazouani yavukiye i Boumdeid, mu ntara ya Assaba, mu muryango w'Abasufi. Ni umuhungu w'umuyobozi w'iyobokamana w'ubwoko bw'Ideiboussat. Amakuru amwe avuga ko yavutse ku ya 4 Ukuboza 1956. Bivugwa ko yafashe mu mutwe Korowani yose.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye ("baccalauréat") mu 1977 i Rosso, maze yinjira mu gisirikare mu 1978. Yize mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Meknès muri Maroke, nyuma abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu bumenyi bw'ubuyobozi n'ubwa gisirikare.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Kuva mu 1987 kugeza mu 1991, yabaye umusirikare wungirije ("aide de camp") wa Perezida Maaouiya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya. Yahawe amahugurwa y'ingabo zigendera ku modoka z'intambara muri Iraki, ayobora batayo y'ibifaru, nyuma ayobora ishami ry'ubutasi bwa gisirikare ("Deuxième bureau").
Ghazouani yari umwe mu basirikare bakuru bagize akanama ka gisirikare kahiritse Taya ku butegetsi mu 2005, ndetse n'abahiritse Perezida Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi mu 2008, bayobowe na mugenzi we Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz. Ku ya 6 Kanama 2008, yagizwe umugaba mukuru w'ingabo, nyuma aba n'umuyobozi mukuru w'urwego rw'umutekano w'igihugu ("Sûreté nationale"). Azwiho uruhare rukomeye mu guhangana n'umutwe w'iterabwoba wa Al-Qaïda mu Majyaruguru ya Afurika (AQMI).
Mu Ukwakira 2018, Perezida Abdel Aziz yamugize Minisitiri w'Ingabo.
Perezida wa Moritaniya.
Ku ya 1 Werurwe 2019, Ghazouani yatangaje ko aziyamamariza umwanya wa perezida, ashyigikiwe n'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi ; ku ya 15 Werurwe yeguye ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Ingabo. Mu matora yo ku ya 22 Kamena 2019, yatsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 52,01%, akurikirwa na Biram Dah Abeid wagize 18,59%. Yarahiriye kuyobora igihugu ku ya 1 Kanama 2019.
Iryo hererekanyabubasha ryafashwe nk'iry'amateka, kuko ryari irya mbere mu mahoro hagati y'abaperezida babiri batowe kuva Moritaniya yabona ubwigenge mu 1960. Abakuru b'ibihugu cumi n'umwe bitabiriye umuhango w'irahira rye.
Ghazouani yavuguruye urwego rw'ubutasi (GSI) kandi afata ubuyobozi bw'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi. Yatandukanye n'imiyoborere ya mbere ye, atangiza ibiganiro n'imiryango itegamiye kuri leta ndetse n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ; ndetse Biram Dah Abeid ubwe yashimye iyo nzira. Yashyize imbere ubumwe bw'Abanyamoritaniya.
Umubano we na Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz warazambye: mu 2020, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yatangije iperereza ku micungire y'umutungo wa leta ku butegetsi bwa Abdel Aziz, maze uwo wahoze ari perezida akatirwa n'urukiko mu Ukuboza 2023.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Moritaniya iyobowe na Ghazouani ifatwa nk'umufatanyabikorwa w'ingenzi w'ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba mu kurwanya iterabwoba mu karere ka Sahel; kuva mu 2011, nta gitero cy'iterabwoba cyabaye ku butaka bwayo. Imbere mu gihugu, ubutegetsi bwe bwatangije gahunda y'ubwishingizi bw'indwara kuri bose. Yanishyuye ikiguzi cyo kuvuza umuhanzikazi Salka Mint Sneid.
Kuva muri Gashyantare 2024 kugeza muri Gashyantare 2025, Ghazouani yabaye umuyobozi w'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.
Muri Mata 2024, yatangaje ko aziyamamariza manda ya kabiri. Mu matora yo ku ya 29 Kamena 2024, yatsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 56,1%, nk'uko byatangajwe ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2024, maze yongera kurahira ku ya 1 Kanama 2024.
Mu Ukwakira 2024, yitabiriye inama y'ibihugu bya BRICS yabereye i Kazan mu Uburusiya, ahahurira na Perezida Vladimir Putin. Muri Nyakanga 2025, yakiriwe muri White House mu nama yahuje Perezida Donald Trump n'abakuru b'ibihugu bimwe bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba.
Ghazouani akomoka mu muryango w'Abasufi kandi akurikira umurongo wa Maliki mu idini rya Isilamu. Yashakanye na Mariem Mint Mohamed Fadel Ould Dah, umuganga w'amenyo mu gisirikare ; bafitanye abana batandatu. Umugore we azwiho guharanira uburenganzira bw'abana bafite indwara ya "autisme", cyane cyane binyuze mu kigo Centre Zayed.

Dharambeer Gokhool, uzwi cyane nka Dharam Gokhool (yavutse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1949 i Plaine des Roches), ni umwarimu wa kaminuza akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Morise, Perezida wa munani wa Repubulika ya Morise kuva mu Ukuboza 2024. Umwe mu bayoboke b'Ishyaka ry'Abakozi ("Parti travailliste"), yabaye umudepite, umuyobozi w'umujyi wa Vacoas-Phœnix, Minisitiri w'Uburezi (2005–2008) na Minisitiri w'Inganda, Ubumenyi n'Ubushakashatsi (2008–2010). Yatowe n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ku bwumvikane bwa bose ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2024.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Gokhool yavutse ku ya 25 Ukwakira 1949 mu mudugudu wa Plaine des Roches, muri Morise, mu muryango w'Abahindu. Se, Manilall Gokhool, yari umukozi usanzwe, naho nyina, Koshila Gokhool, yitaga ku rugo. Yakuriye mu muryango w'abakozi bo mu cyaro, ariko umuryango we umutera inkunga yo kwiga.
Yize mu ishuri rya leta rya Roches Noires, aho yafatwaga nk'umunyeshuri w'indashyikirwa, hanyuma mu ishuri rya leta rya Mapou. Mu 1975, yarangije amasomo muri Kaminuza ya Delhi mu Ubuhinde, maze agaruka muri Morise. Yabaye umwarimu muri Kaminuza ya Morise, ahabwa imyanya itandukanye irimo iy'umwarimu wungirije ("associate professor") n'umuyobozi ("dean") w'ishami ry'amategeko n'imiyoborere. Leta y'Ubufaransa yamugize "officier" mu Rutonde rw'icyubahiro witwa "Palmes académiques".
Gokhool yatangiye umwuga wa politiki mu 1976. Mu 1980, yinjiye mu ishyaka rya Mouvement militant mauricien (MMM). Mu 1982, yatorewe kuba umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ku rutonde rw'ihuriro rya MMM n'Ishyaka rya Gisosiyalisiti rya Morise (PSM), ryatsinze amatora uwo mwaka ku bwiganze busesuye. Nyuma y'icikamo ry'ihuriro rya MMM na PSM, Gokhool yagumye muri MMM, ariko atsindwa mu matora ya 1983 mu ntara y'itora ya Piton-Rivière-du-Rempart. Mu 1991, yagarutse mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ku rutonde rw'ihuriro rya MMM na Mouvement socialiste militant (MSM); ariko muri iyo manda, yimukiye mu Ishyaka ry'Abakozi.
Kuva mu 1991 kugeza mu 1993, yabaye umuyobozi ("maire") w'umujyi wa Vacoas-Phœnix. Kuva mu 1993 kugeza mu 1994, yabaye umunyamabanga wihariye w'inteko ("parliamentary private secretary"). Mu Ishyaka ry'Abakozi, yabaye umunyamabanga ushinzwe ubuyobozi mu 2003, hanyuma umunyamabanga mukuru kuva mu 2004 kugeza mu 2005.
Muri guverinoma ya kabiri ya Minisitiri w'Intebe Navin Ramgoolam, Gokhool yabaye Minisitiri w'Uburezi kuva mu 2005 kugeza mu 2008, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Inganda, Ubumenyi n'Ubushakashatsi kuva mu 2008 kugeza mu 2010. Nyuma y'amatora ya 2014, yiyamamarije kuba visi-perezida, ariko ntiyatorwa.
Ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2024, nyuma y'irangira rya manda ya Prithvirajsing Roopun, Gokhool yatowe n'abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ku bwumvikane bwa bose ngo abe Perezida wa munani wa Repubulika ya Morise, kuri manda y'imyaka itanu. Iryo tora ryaturutse ku bwumvikane hagati y'imitwe ya politiki ikomeye mu Nteko, kandi ryagaragaje isura ye nk'umuntu uhuza bose, wemerwa n'impande zose za politiki.
Muri Morise, umwanya wa perezida ahanini ni uw'icyubahiro n'uwo kurinda Itegeko Nshinga, kuko ububasha nyubahirizategeko buri mu maboko ya Minisitiri w'Intebe n'Inama y'Abaminisitiri. Gokhool yashyize imbere uburezi, ubumwe n'uburinganire, yiyemeza kuba umurinzi w'Itegeko Nshinga n'ikimenyetso cy'ubumwe bw'Abanyamorise bose. Yarahiriye kuyobora igihugu ku ya 7 Ukuboza 2024 mu ngoro ya State House i Réduit, mu muhango witabiriwe na Minisitiri w'Intebe, abagize guverinoma, abayobozi b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'abahagarariye imiryango itandukanye; yahawe kandi impeta y'icyubahiro ya "Grand Commander of the Order of the Star and Key of the Indian Ocean" (GCSK). Muri iyo nama imwe y'Inteko, Robert Hungley yatorewe kuba visi-perezida we.
Ku ya 11 Werurwe 2025, Gokhool yakiriye Minisitiri w'Intebe w'Ubuhinde, Narendra Modi, mu rugendo rw'akazi muri Morise. Mu muhango wabereye i Port-Louis, yahaye Modi impeta y'icyubahiro ya GCSK, icyubahiro gisumba ibindi gihabwa abasivili muri Morise, amushimira uruhare rwe mu gushimangira umubano w'ibihugu byombi. Muri urwo ruzinduko, Modi yasuye State House, aho Gokhool yamweretse ubusitani bw'ibimera bivura bya "Ayurveda".

Daniel Francisco Chapo (yavutse ku ya 6 Mutarama 1977 i Inhaminga) ni umunyamategeko akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Mozambike, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 15 Mutarama 2025. Umuyoboke w'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi rya FRELIMO, yabaye guverineri w'intara ya Inhambane kuva mu 2016 kugeza mu 2024, hanyuma aba umunyamabanga mukuru w'iryo shyaka n'umukandida waryo mu matora ya perezida ya 2024. Ni we mukandida wa mbere wa FRELIMO ku mwanya wa perezida wavutse nyuma y'ubwigenge bwa Mozambike mu 1975. Itsinzi ye mu matora ya 2024 yanenzwe cyane n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, kandi yakurikiwe n'imyigaragambyo yahitanye abantu benshi.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Chapo yavutse ku ya 6 Mutarama 1977 i Inhaminga, mu ntara ya Sofala. Yize amashuri abanza i Inhaminga (1982–1985) no mu karere ka Dondo (1986–1987), amashuri yisumbuye mu karere ka Dondo (1988–1996), hanyuma mu ishuri ryisumbuye Samora Machel i Beira (1997–1998). Yize amategeko muri Kaminuza Eduardo Mondlane i Maputo, ayirangiza mu 2000. Mu 2004, yabaye noteri. Mu 2014, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu micungire y'iterambere muri Kaminuza Gatolika ya Mozambike.
Kuva mu 1997 kugeza mu 1998, yari umunyamakuru kuri Radiyo Miramar i Beira, hanyuma kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2004 asoma amakuru kuri Televiziyo Miramar mu murwa mukuru. Mu 2005, yagizwe umubitsi w'impapuro z'ubutaka ("conservateur") i Nacala-Porto. Yimenyereje umwuga mu rugaga rw'abavoka (2007–2008), kandi mu 2009 yigishije ubumenyi bwa politiki n'amategeko nshinga muri Kaminuza Nderabarezi ya Maputo.
Chapo yinjiye muri politiki mu ishyaka rya FRELIMO mu 2009, ubwo yagirwaga umuyobozi w'akarere ka Nacala-a-Velha. Mu 2015, yabaye umuyobozi w'akarere ka Palma.
Guverineri wa Inhambane.
Ku ya 4 Werurwe 2016, Chapo yagizwe guverineri w'intara ya Inhambane, mu majyepfo y'igihugu. Nyuma y'ivugurura ry'uburyo abaguverineri bashyirwaho, yatorewe uwo mwanya mu matora rusange yo ku ya 15 Ukwakira 2019.
Umukandida ku mwanya wa perezida.
Ku ya 5 Gicurasi 2024, komite nkuru ya FRELIMO yamutoye ku majwi 225 (94%) ngo abe umukandida w'ishyaka mu matora ya perezida ya 2024, asimbura Filipe Nyusi wari urangije manda ze zemewe n'Itegeko Nshinga. Yatsinze cyane cyane Roque Silva Samuel, wari umunyamabanga mukuru wa FRELIMO. Kubera ko atari azwi cyane, gutorwa kwe kwatunguye benshi. Ku ya 13 Gicurasi, yagizwe umunyamabanga mukuru w'agateganyo w'ishyaka. Yeguye ku mwanya wa guverineri, maze ubwegure bwe bwemezwa n'inteko y'intara ku ya 23 Gicurasi, kugira ngo yitegure amatora yo ku ya 9 Ukwakira ; yasimbuwe na Eduardo Mussanhane, perezida w'inteko y'intara ya Inhambane.
Chapo ni we mukandida wa mbere wa FRELIMO ku mwanya wa perezida wavutse nyuma y'ubwigenge bwa Mozambike, bwabonetse mu 1975 nyuma y'ubukoloni bwa Porutigali. Kubera ubwiganze bwa FRELIMO muri politiki y'igihugu, yafatwaga nk'uzatsinda amatora.
Amatora ya 2024 n'impaka.
Ku ya 24 Ukwakira 2024, komisiyo y'amatora ya Mozambike yatangaje ko Chapo yatsinze amatora n'amajwi 71%. Ariko ayo matora yaranzwe n'ibirego by'uburiganya n'ibitagenze neza byinshi. Ishyaka PODEMOS ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ryanze ibyavuye mu matora, ritangaza ibarura ryaryo bwite ryerekanaga ko Venâncio Mondlane yatsinze n'amajwi 53%. Ibyavuye mu matora byanashidikanyijweho n'Inama y'Abepiskopi Gatolika ya Mozambike n'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi, mu gihe imyigaragambyo yo kubyamagana yahitanye nibura abantu 250, abenshi muri bo bakaba abigaragambyaga barashwe na polisi n'ingabo. Ku ya 23 Ukuboza 2024, Inama y'Itegeko Nshinga yemeje itsinzi ye, ariko imugenera amajwi 65,17%.
Perezida wa Mozambike.
Nubwo imyigaragambyo yakomeje, Chapo yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Mozambike ku ya 15 Mutarama 2025. Ku ya 18 Mutarama 2025, yagize Maria Benvinda Levy Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Chapo yashakanye na Gueta Selemane Chapo, bafitanye abana bane. Ni Umukristo.

Ndemupelila Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah (yavutse ku ya 29 Ukwakira 1952 i Onamutai), uzwi cyane ku izina rya NNN, ni umunyapolitiki wa Namibiya, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 21 Werurwe 2025. Ni we mugore wa mbere wabaye Perezida wa Namibiya. Umuyoboke w'ishyaka rya SWAPO kuva afite imyaka 14, yamaze imyaka myinshi mu buhungiro mbere y'ubwigenge, hanyuma aba umudepite kuva mu 1990. Yabaye minisitiri mu nzego zitandukanye, Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga (2012–2024), Visi-Minisitiri w'Intebe (2015–2024), na Visi-Perezida wa Repubulika (2024–2025). Mu 2017, yabaye umugore wa mbere watorewe kuba visi-perezida wa SWAPO, kandi ni we mugore wa mbere iryo shyaka ryatanze nk'umukandida ku mwanya wa perezida.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Netumbo Nandi yavutse ku ya 29 Ukwakira 1952 i Onamutai, muri Afurika y'Amajyepfo-Uburengerazuba (ubu ni Namibiya), hafi y'urubibe rw'intara za Ohangwena na Oshana. Ababyeyi be ni Justina Nekoto Shaduka-Nandi na Petrus Nandi. Se yari umupasiteri w'Itorero ry'Abangilikani. Ni uwa cyenda mu bana 13. Yize mu ishuri ry'Abangilikani rya St. Mary's Mission i Odibo.
Yatangiye ibikorwa bya politiki akiri ingimbi, yinjira muri SWAPO mu 1966, afite imyaka 14. Bidatinze, yabaye umuyobozi w'urugaga rw'urubyiruko rwa SWAPO, rwarwanyaga ubukoloni bwa Afurika y’Epfo; ibyo byatumye ahigwa, bimuhatira kwihisha.
Mu 1973, yagiye mu buhungiro muri Zambiya, aho yakoze ku cyicaro gikuru cya SWAPO i Lusaka kugeza mu 1975. Kuva mu 1975 kugeza mu 1976, yize mu ishuri rikuru ry'urubyiruko rw'Abakomunisiti (Komsomol) mu Bumwe bw'Abasoviyeti. Mu 1987, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya nyuma ya kaminuza mu buyobozi n'imicungire ya leta muri Glasgow College of Technology, mu Bwongereza; mu 1988, abona indi mu mibanire mpuzamahanga muri Kaminuza ya Keele, hanyuma mu 1989 abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu bumenyi bwa dipolomasi muri iyo kaminuza.
Kuva mu 1976 kugeza mu 1978, yari intumwa yungirije ya SWAPO muri Zambiya, hanyuma intumwa nkuru yayo muri icyo gihugu kugeza mu 1980. Kuva mu 1980 kugeza mu 1986, yari intumwa nkuru ya SWAPO muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, ifite icyicaro i Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya. Yabaye umwe mu bagize komite nkuru ya SWAPO kuva mu 1976 kugeza mu 1986.
Mu butegetsi bwa Namibiya yigenga.
Ni umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Namibiya kuva mu 1990. Yabaye Visi-Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 1996, na perezida w'urugaga rw'abagore rwa Namibiya (NANAWO) kuva mu 1991 kugeza mu 1994. Kuva mu 1996 kugeza mu 2000, ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Sam Nujoma, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru w'ishami rishinzwe iby'abagore mu biro bya Perezida, ahuza ibikorwa bya leta n'iby'abikorera mu guteza imbere gahunda zifasha abagore n'abana. Muri icyo gihe, Namibiya yashyizeho politiki y'igihugu y'uburinganire (1997), itegeko ry'uburinganire bw'abashakanye (1996) n'itegeko rirwanya gufata ku ngufu (2000), ryemera ko gufata ku ngufu bishobora no kubaho hagati y'abashakanye.
Mu 2000, yagizwe Minisitiri ushinzwe iby'Abagore n'Imibereho myiza y'Abana. Muri uwo mwanya, yashyigikiye itegeko rirwanya ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu ngo ryo mu 2003. Kuva mu 2005 kugeza mu 2010, yabaye Minisitiri w'Itangazamakuru, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Ibidukikije n'Ubukerarugendo kugeza mu Ukuboza 2012, ubwo yagirwaga Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga (minisiteri yaje kwitwa iy'Imibanire Mpuzamahanga n'Ubufatanye).
Mu Werurwe 2015, Perezida Hage Geingob yamugize Visi-Minisitiri w'Intebe, akomeza no kuba Minisitiri w'Imibanire Mpuzamahanga n'Ubufatanye. Muri SWAPO, ari muri komite nkuru no mu biro bya politiki, kandi ni umunyamabanga ushinzwe itangazamakuru n'ubukangurambaga, bigatuma aba umwe mu bavugizi b'ingenzi b'iryo shyaka.
Visi-Perezida n'amatora ya 2024.
Mu Ugushyingo 2022, yongeye gutorerwa kuba visi-perezida wa SWAPO, bigatuma aba umukandida ushoboka cyane w'ishyaka mu matora ya perezida ya 2024. Mu Werurwe 2023, yatangajwe ku mugaragaro nk'umukandida wa SWAPO. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Perezida Geingob muri Gashyantare 2024, Nangolo Mbumba wamusimbuye yamugize Visi-Perezida wa Repubulika ku ya 4 Gashyantare 2024; ni we mugore wa mbere wabaye kuri uwo mwanya.
Ku ya 3 Ukuboza 2024, komisiyo y'amatora yamutangaje nk'uwatsinze amatora ya perezida, aba umugore wa mbere watorewe kuyobora Namibiya. Yagize amajwi 683 560 (58,7%), atsinda Panduleni Itula na McHenry Venaani.
Perezida wa Namibiya.
Yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Namibiya ku ya 21 Werurwe 2025, asimbura Nangolo Mbumba. Mu ijambo yavuze arahira, yiyemeje gushyira imbere guhanga imirimo, agamije imirimo mishya 500 000, cyane cyane mu buhinzi, uburobyi, ubuhanzi na siporo.
Muri Mata 2025, yatangaje ko guhera mu 2026 leta izatanga amashuri makuru na kaminuza ku buntu mu bigo bya leta. Ku ya 27 Mata 2025, yirukanye Minisitiri w'Ubuhinzi, Uburobyi, Amazi n'Ivugurura ry'Ubutaka, Mac-Albert Hengari, nyuma y'uko afatwa akekwaho ruswa, ashinjwa kugerageza gucecekesha umugore wavugaga ko yamufashe ku ngufu.
Nandi-Ndaitwah aharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore n'uburinganire bw'ibitsina muri Namibiya. Ariko bamwe mu bamunenga bavuga ko afite ibitekerezo gakondo; mu kiganiro cyo mu 2022, umusesenguzi wa politiki Henning Melber yavuze ko atigeze ashyigikira uburenganzira bw'imyororokere cyangwa kurengera abaryamana bahuje ibitsina. Arwanya gukuramo inda, uretse mu bihe bidasanzwe cyane.
Yashakanye na Jenerali Liyetona (wavuye mu kazi) Epaphras Denga Ndaitwah, wahoze ari umugaba mukuru w'Ingabo za Namibiya ; bafitanye abana batatu. Akunda ibikorwa by'abana mu baturage no gusoma. Izina rya NNN akunze kwitwa rikoreshwa cyane na bagenzi be bo muri politiki.
Yahawe igihembo cy'Umuyobozi wa Politiki w'Umwaka muri Afurika n'icy'Umuyobozi w'Umugore w'Umwaka muri Afurika n'ikinyamakuru "African Leadership Magazine", ndetse n'igihembo cy'ubuyobozi bw'ibitekerezo ("thought leadership") mu bihembo by'iterambere rirambye bya Namibiya. Mu 2024, yahawe igihembo cy'ubuyobozi buhuza ibisekuru mu nama ya Nala Feminist. Yahawe kandi impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga y'icyubahiro na Kaminuza ya Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya.

Bola Ahmed Adekunle Tinubu (yavutse ku ya 29 Werurwe 1952 i Lagos) ni umunyapolitiki wa Nijeriya, Perezida wa 16 w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2023. Mbere yaho, yabaye senateri wa Lagos y'Iburengerazuba mu gihe cya Repubulika ya Gatatu (1992–1993), hanyuma aba Guverineri wa Leta ya Lagos kuva mu 1999 kugeza mu 2007. Nyuma y'amashuri y'icungamari muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, yakoreye ibigo bikomeye birimo Mobil, mbere yo kwinjira muri politiki. Yahungiye mu mahanga ku butegetsi bwa gisirikare bwa Sani Abacha, aharanira kugaruka kwa demokarasi. Nyuma yo kuva ku mwanya wa guverineri, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu ishingwa ry'ishyaka rya All Progressives Congress (APC) mu 2013, maze atsinda amatora ya perezida ya 2023. Ku butegetsi bwe, yakuyeho inkunga leta yatangaga ku bikomoka kuri peteroli kandi avugurura cyane politiki y'ubukungu, ariko ahura n'ibirego byinshi bya ruswa n'impaka ku byavuye mu matora.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Tinubu yavukiye i Lagos mu muryango w'Abayisilamu b'ubwoko bw'Abayoruba. Ni umuhungu wa Abibatu Mogaji, wari "Ìyál'ọ́jà" (umuyobozi w'abacuruzikazi) wa Lagos. Amasoko yizewe yemeza ko yavutse mu 1952, nubwo abatavuga rumwe na we bavuga ko akuze kurushaho, kandi amasoko amwe akagaragaza ko imyaka ye itigeze yemezwa neza.
Yize mu ishuri ribanza rya St. John's i Aroloya, muri Lagos, hanyuma muri Children Home School i Ibadan. Mu 1975, yagiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, yiga muri Richard J. Daley College i Chicago hanyuma muri Chicago State University, aho yize icungamari n'imicungire. Yakoze imirimo itandukanye, nko koza amasahani, kurinda nijoro no gutwara tagisi, kugira ngo abone amafaranga y'ishuri. Mu 1979, yarangije amasomo ahabwa impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza mu bucuruzi n'imiyoborere, afite amanota y'icyubahiro ("summa cum laude").
Umwuga mbere ya politiki.
Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri, Tinubu yabaye umucungamari mu bigo by'Abanyamerika Arthur Andersen, Deloitte na GTE Services Corporation. Yimukiye i Londres, aho yakoreye Mobil Oil UK, hanyuma mu myaka ya 1980 aba umuyobozi mukuru akaba n'umubitsi muri Mobil Producing Nigeria. Yaje kureka ako kazi kugira ngo yinjire muri politiki byuzuye.
Intangiriro y'umwuga wa politiki.
Tinubu yatangiye politiki mu 1991, yinjira mu Ishyaka rya Demokarasi Gisosiyalisiti (SDP), anashyigikira kandidatire ya Moshood Abiola. Mu 1992, yatorewe kuba senateri uhagarariye Lagos y'Iburengerazuba; muri Sena, yayoboye komisiyo ishinzwe amabanki, imari n'ingengo y'imari.
Nyuma y'iseswa ry'ibyavuye mu matora ya perezida yo ku ya 12 Kamena 1993, yabaye umwe mu bashinze ihuriro riharanira demokarasi rya National Democratic Coalition (NADECO), ryasabaga ko demokarasi igaruka kandi Abiola akemerwa nk'uwatsinze ayo matora. Nyuma y'ifatwa ry'ubutegetsi na Jenerali Sani Abacha, Tinubu yafashwe kenshi, arafungwa, aterwa ubwoba, bimuhatira guhunga igihugu. Yamaze mu buhungiro kuva mu 1994 kugeza mu 1998, akomeza guharanira demokarasi ari muri NADECO, agaruka nyuma y'urupfu rwa Abacha.
Guverineri wa Leta ya Lagos (1999–2007).
Mu matora ya 1999, yatsinze amatora y'ibanze y'ishyaka Alliance for Democracy (AD), maze muri Mutarama 1999 atorerwa kuba Guverineri wa Leta ya Lagos ; yatangiye imirimo ku ya 29 Gicurasi 1999. Mu 2003, yongeye gutorwa, aba guverineri wenyine wa AD wongeye gutorwa mu majyepfo y'iburengerazuba bw'igihugu, mu gihe izindi ntara zose zo muri ako karere zegukanywe n'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi rya PDP.
Ku butegetsi bwe, yashimiwe guhangana n'umubyigano w'imodoka mu mihanda, kunoza ikusanywa ry'imyanda no kurwanya ibyaha by'ubugizi bwa nabi bukoranye ubuhanga, kandi yatangije imishinga minini y'ibikorwa remezo. Yahawe ibihembo byinshi, birimo icya guverineri mwiza muri Nijeriya mu 2000. Yagiranye amakimbirane akomeye na guverinoma nkuru ya Olusegun Obasanjo, ku bijyanye n'ishyirwaho ry'inzego 37 nshya z'ibanze muri Lagos; ayo makimbirane yatumye guverinoma nkuru ifatira amafaranga yagenewe izo nzego, ariko Urukiko rw'Ikirenga ruza gutegeka ko asubizwa. Manda ye yarangiye ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2007, asimburwa na Babatunde Fashola, wari umuyobozi w'ibiro bye.
Nubwo atari akiri guverineri, Tinubu yakomeje kugira ijambo rikomeye muri politiki ya Lagos, cyane cyane mu guhitamo abamusimbura. Ni yo mpamvu akunze kwitwa «Umubyeyi wa batisimu wa Lagos» ("Godfather of Lagos").
Hagati ya 2007 na 2023.
Nyuma y'itsinzi ya PDP mu matora ya 2007, Tinubu yagize uruhare mu biganiro byo guhuza amashyaka atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Muri Gashyantare 2013, yari umwe mu bashinze ishyaka rya All Progressives Congress (APC), ryavutse ku ihuzwa ry'amashyaka akomeye atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi.
Mu 2014, yashyigikiye kandidatire ya Muhammadu Buhari ; yifuzaga kuba umukandida we ku mwanya wa visi-perezida, ariko uwo mwanya uhabwa Yemi Osinbajo, inshuti ye. Mu 2015, Buhari yatsinze amatora, bwa mbere perezida uri ku butegetsi muri Nijeriya atsindwa n'umukandida w'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Tinubu yafatwaga nk'umuyobozi utemewe ku mugaragaro wa APC ; muri Gashyantare 2018, Buhari yamushinze kuyobora komite y'ubwiyunge y'iryo shyaka, kugira ngo akemure amakimbirane yari arimo.
Ku ya 10 Mutarama 2022, Tinubu yatangaje ko aziyamamariza umwanya wa perezida. Ku ya 8 Kamena 2022, yatsinze amatora y'ibanze ya APC n'amajwi 1 271, atsinda Visi-Perezida Yemi Osinbajo na Rotimi Amaechi. Yahisemo Kashim Shettima nk'umukandida we ku mwanya wa visi-perezida.
Ku ya 1 Werurwe 2023, komisiyo y'amatora (INEC) yatangaje ko Tinubu yatsinze amatora ya perezida ku cyiciro cya mbere, n'amajwi 8 794 726 (36,6%), arusha Atiku Abubakar wa PDP (6 984 520) na Peter Obi w'Ishyaka ry'Abakozi (6 101 533). Ayo matora yaranzwe n'ibirego byo kugura amajwi, gutera ubwoba abatora, ibitero ku biro by'itora n'uburiganya. Abakandida batatu bakomeye batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi banze ibyavuye mu matora, basaba ko asubirwamo.
Perezida wa Nijeriya.
Tinubu yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Nijeriya ku ya 29 Gicurasi 2023 ku kibuga cya Eagle Square i Abuja, mu muhango witabiriwe n'abakuru b'ibihugu benshi. Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2023, yatorewe kuyobora Umuryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO).
Amavugurura y'ubukungu.
Mu ijambo yavuze arahira, Tinubu yatangaje ivanwaho ry'inkunga leta yatangaga ku bikomoka kuri peteroli. Ibyo byateje izamuka rikabije ry'ibiciro bya lisansi, maze ihuriro ry'abakozi (NLC) rihamagarira imyigaragambyo, nyuma iza guhagarikwa kubera ibiganiro na guverinoma. Iyo nkunga yatwaraga leta hafi miliyari 10 z'amadolari ku mwaka, kandi ivanwaho ryayo ryashimwe na Banki y'Isi.
Ku ya 9 Kamena 2023, yahagaritse ku mirimo Godwin Emefiele, guverineri wa Banki Nkuru ya Nijeriya, wahise afatwa na polisi y'ubutasi. Nyuma y'iminsi itanu, banki nkuru yakuyeho imbogamizi ku ivunjisha, bituma ifaranga rya "naira" rigera ku gaciro karyo kari hasi kurusha ibindi byose. Amavugurura ye y'ubukungu, akunze kwitwa "Tinubunomics", afatwa nk'akomeye kurusha ayabayeho kuva demokarasi yagaruka.
Umutekano n'ubuyobozi.
Ku ya 19 Kamena 2023, yagize Nuhu Ribadu Umujyanama mu by'Umutekano w'Igihugu, maze asimbuza abayobozi bakuru b'ingabo zose n'inzego z'umutekano. Uwo munsi kandi, yasheshe inama z'ubuyobozi z'ibigo byose bya leta.
Mu mpera za Nzeri 2025, ubutasi bwa gisirikare bwavumbuye umugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi bwe; abasirikare 16 barafashwe, kandi umutambagiro wa gisirikare w'umunsi w'ubwigenge wo ku ya 1 Ukwakira 2025 urasubikwa. Igisirikare cyabanje guhakana ayo makuru, kivuga ko ifatwa ryabo ryari irya disipulini. Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2025, Tinubu yasimbuje abayobozi bakuru b'ingabo.
Mu Ugushyingo 2025, Perezida Donald Trump wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika yashinje Nijeriya kunanirwa kurinda Abakristo ihohoterwa, ategeka ingabo z'Amerika kwitegura ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri icyo gihugu. Tinubu yahakanye ibyo birego, avuga ko guverinoma ye irinda abaturage bose hatitawe ku idini. Ku ya 25 Ukuboza 2025, ku busabe bwa guverinoma ya Nijeriya, Amerika yagabye igitero ku mutwe wa Leta ya Kisilamu ("État islamique") mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'igihugu.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga nka perezida rwabaye i Paris, mu Ubufaransa, muri Kamena 2023, yitabiriye inama mpuzamahanga ku bijyanye n'imari. Muri Kanama 2023, nyuma ya kudeta yabereye muri Nigeri, yashyigikiye igitekerezo cy'ubutabazi bwa gisirikare, maze abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi barabinenga. Mu Ukuboza 2025, yemereye ingabo za Nijeriya gutabara Bene, nyuma y'igerageza rya kudeta ryibasiye Perezida Patrice Talon.
Ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2025, ishyaka rya APC ryamutanze nk'umukandida waryo mu matora ya perezida ya 2027. Komisiyo y'amatora (INEC) yemeje kandidatire ye, hamwe na Kashim Shettima nk'umukandida ku mwanya wa visi-perezida.
Mu 1993, leta y'Amerika yafatiriye amafaranga yari kuri konti ze muri Amerika, ivuga ko hari impamvu zifatika zo gukeka ko akomoka ku icuruzwa rya heroyine; Tinubu yumvikanye na leta y'Amerika, yemera gutakaza amadolari agera ku 460 000. Muri Mata 2007, guverinoma nkuru yamujyanye imbere y'urukiko rushinzwe imyitwarire y'abayobozi ("Code of Conduct Tribunal"), imushinja gukoresha konti 16 zo mu mahanga mu buryo butemewe ; urubanza rwaje guteshwa agaciro ku mpamvu za tekiniki. Muri Mutarama 2009, komisiyo ishinzwe kurwanya ibyaha by'ubukungu (EFCC) yamuhanaguyeho ibyaha byo kunyereza umutungo no kwezwa kw'amafaranga.
Tinubu ni Umuyisilamu. Mu 1987, yashakanye na Oluremi Tinubu, wahoze ari senateri uhagarariye Lagos yo Hagati ; bafitanye abana batatu. Afite kandi abandi bana batatu yabyaye mbere ; umwe muri bo, Jide Tinubu, yapfiriye i Londres ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2017. Afite amazina abiri y'icyubahiro gakondo: "Asiwaju" wa Lagos na "Jagaba" wa Borgu.

Carlos Manuel Vila Nova (yavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 1959 i Neves) ni injeniyeri akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Sawo Tome na Purensipe, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2021. Mbere yo kwinjira muri politiki, yamaze imyaka myinshi mu rwego rw'amahoteli n'ubukerarugendo. Yabaye Minisitiri w'Imirimo ya Leta (2010–2012) na Minisitiri w'Ibikorwa Remezo, Umutungo Kamere n'Ibidukikije (2014–2018) muri guverinoma za Minisitiri w'Intebe Patrice Trovoada. Yatowe ari umukandida w'ishyaka rya Action démocratique indépendante (ADI) mu 2021, maze yongera gutorwa mu 2026.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Carlos Manuel Vila Nova yavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 1959 i Neves, umujyi uri mu karere ka Lembá, ku nkombe y'amajyaruguru y'ikirwa cya São Tomé. Mu 1985, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ubunyeniyeri mu itumanaho muri Kaminuza ya Oran, muri Aligeriya. Agarutse mu gihugu, yayoboye ishami ry'ikoranabuhanga mu kigo cya leta gishinzwe ibarurishamibare.
Umwuga mu bukerarugendo.
Mu 1988, yavuye mu kazi ka leta, aba umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri Hotel Miramar, yari hoteli yonyine mu gihugu icyo gihe. Mu 1992, yagizwe umuyobozi w'iyo hoteli, hanyuma mu 1997 aba umuyobozi wa Hotel Pousada Boa Vista. Yashinze kandi ikigo cy'ingendo cyitwa Mistral Voyages. Yakomeje gukora mu bukerarugendo kugeza yinjiye muri politiki mu 2010.
Nyuma y'itsinzi ya ADI mu matora y'abadepite yo mu 2010, Minisitiri w'Intebe Patrice Trovoada yamugize Minisitiri w'Imirimo ya Leta n'Umutungo Kamere muri guverinoma ya 14 ishingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga. Guverinoma yatakaje icyizere cy'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko mu 2012. Ubwo ADI yongeraga kubona ubwiganze busesuye mu matora ya 2014, Vila Nova yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ibikorwa Remezo, Umutungo Kamere n'Ibidukikije, umwanya yagumyeho kugeza ADI itsinzwe amatora ya 2018. Muri ayo matora, yatorewe kuba umudepite mu karere ka Água Grande.
Perezida wa Sawo Tome na Purensipe.
Mu matora ya perezida ya 2021, Perezida Evaristo Carvalho wari ku butegetsi, na we wo muri ADI, ntiyongeye kwiyamamaza, maze iryo shyaka ritanga Vila Nova nk'umukandida waryo. Yagize amajwi 39% ku cyiciro cya mbere, hanyuma atsinda icyiciro cya kabiri n'amajwi agera kuri 57–58%, imbere ya Guilherme Posser da Costa w'ishyaka MLSTP-PSD. Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2021, urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ko ari we perezida watowe, maze arahira ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2021.
Amakimbirane na Trovoada.
Ku ya 6 Mutarama 2025, Vila Nova yirukanye Minisitiri w'Intebe Patrice Trovoada na guverinoma ye, avuga ko Trovoada yamaraga igihe kirekire adahari kandi guverinoma ye ikananirwa gukemura ibibazo byinshi. Trovoada yavuze ko iryo yirukanwa ritemewe n'amategeko kandi rinyuranyije n'Itegeko Nshinga. Vila Nova yabanje gushyiraho Minisitiri w'Ubutabera, Ilza Amado Vaz, nka Minisitiri w'Intebe, ariko ahita yegura. Hanyuma yashyizeho Américo Ramos, utaremejwe na ADI, bituma anengwa kwirengagiza ubwiganze bw'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko.
Mu matora ya perezida yo ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2026, Vila Nova yongeye gutorwa ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 55,94%, yiyamamaje nk'umukandida wigenga ashyigikiwe na MLSTP-PSD, atsinda Nito Abreu washyigikiwe na ADI, wagize amajwi 41,42%.
Muri Werurwe 2026, hamwe na Minisitiri w'Intebe Américo Ramos n'itsinda ry'abashoramari mpuzamahanga Aequatoris, yatangaje umushinga wo gushinga ikigo cy'imari cya São Tomé ("São Tomé Financial Centre"), agace k'ubucuruzi kadasoreshwa kagamije gukurura ibigo mpuzamahanga bitanga serivisi.
Vila Nova yashakanye na Maria de Fátima Afonso Vila Nova, bafitanye abakobwa babiri.

Bassirou Diomaye Diakhar Faye (yavutse ku ya 25 Werurwe 1980 i Ndiaganiao), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Diomaye, ni umunyapolitiki wa Senegali, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 2 Mata 2024. Yahoze ari umugenzuzi w'imari ya leta n'umuyobozi w'ihuriro ry'abakozi, hanyuma aba umunyamabanga mukuru w'ishyaka rya PASTEF. Yafunzwe amezi agera kuri cumi n'umwe, afungurwa iminsi mike mbere y'amatora ya perezida ya 2024, aho yasimbuye Ousmane Sonko wari wangiwe kwiyamamaza. Yatsinze ayo matora ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 54,28%, aba perezida muto kurusha abandi bose mu mateka ya Senegali, n'umukandida wa mbere utavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi utsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere. Manda ye yaranzwe n'ikibazo gikomeye cy'imyenda ya leta n'amakimbirane na Minisitiri w'Intebe Sonko, uwo yaje kwirukana mu 2026. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2026, ayobora Umuryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO).
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Bassirou Diomaye Diakhar Faye yavutse ku ya 25 Werurwe 1980 i Ndiaganiao, mu karere ka M'bour, mu ntara ya Thiès. Akomoka mu bwoko bw'Abaserere. Yakuriye mu cyaro kandi akunze kugaragaza ko yishimira inkomoko ye. Se, Samba Faye, yari umuyoboke w'igihe kirekire w'Ishyaka rya Gisosiyalisiti rya Senegali. Sekuru yarwanye ku ruhande rw'Ubufaransa mu Ntambara ya Mbere y'Isi Yose, nyuma afungwa n'abakoloni b'Abafaransa kubera ko yaharaniraga ishingwa ry'ishuri ryisumbuye i Ndiaganiao, ari na ryo Faye yaje kwigamo.
Yize amashuri abanza mu mudugudu w'iwabo, ayisumbuye i M'Bour, abona impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye mu 2000. Yize amategeko muri Kaminuza Cheikh-Anta-Diop i Dakar, abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master"), hanyuma mu 2004 yinjira mu ishuri rikuru ry'ubuyobozi (ENA) rya Senegali. Yabaye umugenzuzi w'imari ya leta mu ishami ry'imisoro n'ubutaka, aho yamenyaniye na Ousmane Sonko. Yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w'ihuriro ry'abakozi b'imisoro n'ubutaka.
Faye yinjiye mu ishyaka rya Patriotes africains du Sénégal pour le travail, l'éthique et la fraternité (PASTEF) kuva ryashingwa mu 2014. Mu gihe Ousmane Sonko yari umuyobozi n'isura nyamukuru y'iryo shyaka, Faye we yari umwubatsi waryo, ashinzwe ibitekerezo by'ishyaka n'imitunganyirize yaryo y'imbere. Yagize uruhare mu gutegura gahunda ya Sonko mu matora ya perezida ya 2019, aho Sonko yabaye uwa gatatu n'amajwi hafi 16%. Mu 2021, ubwo Sonko yafungwaga, Faye yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru wa PASTEF. Mu matora y'inzego z'ibanze ya 2022, yiyamamarije kuyobora komine ya Ndiaganiao, ariko atsindwa na Tening Sène wo mu ishyaka rya Perezida Macky Sall.
Ku ya 14 Mata 2023, Faye yafatiwe i Dakar, akurikiranyweho «gukwirakwiza amakuru y'ibihuha, gusuzugura abacamanza no gusebya urwego rwa leta», nyuma y'ubutumwa yanditse ku mbuga nkoranyambaga anenga abacamanza bari bihutiye kuburanisha Sonko mu bujurire. Nyuma yaho, yongerewe ibindi byaha birimo «gushishikariza abantu kwigomeka», bituma afungwa igihe kitazwi.
Muri Gashyantare 2024, Perezida Macky Sall yagerageje gusubika amatora, ariko ibyo byateje imyigaragambyo ikomeye, maze Inama y'Itegeko Nshinga iburizamo iryo subikwa. Guverinoma yashyikirije Inteko itegeko ry'imbabazi rusange, ryatumye abantu babarirwa mu magana bafunzwe kubera politiki barekurwa. Iryo tegeko ryanenzwe na bamwe kuko ryahaga imbabazi n'abagize uruhare mu guhohotera abigaragambyaga hagati ya 2021 na 2024. Faye na Sonko barekuwe muri Werurwe 2024, iminsi mike mbere y'amatora.
Amatora ya perezida ya 2024.
Mu Ugushyingo 2023, kubera ko bitari bizwi niba Sonko azemererwa kwiyamamaza, PASTEF yatanze Faye nk'umukandida waryo nubwo yari afunzwe. Ku ya 20 Mutarama 2024, Inama y'Itegeko Nshinga yasohoye urutonde rwa nyuma rw'abakandida, Sonko atarimo; ariko kandidatire ya Faye yemejwe kuko atari yarigeze akatirwa. Sonko yahise atangaza ko amushyigikiye, ndetse n'uwahoze ari Perezida Abdoulaye Wade n'ishyaka rye PDS baramushyigikira ; umukandida Cheikh Tidiane Dieye na we yamuvaniyeho kandidatire ye.
Gahunda ye yiswe «Umushinga wa Senegali yigenga, iboneye kandi itera imbere». Yiyamamaje ari kumwe na Sonko, munsi y'intero «"Diomaye mooy Sonko"» («Diomaye ni Sonko»), yiyemeza guhanga imirimo, kurwanya ruswa no gusuzuma bundi bushya amasezerano yo mu rwego rw'ingufu. Yanatangaje umutungo we, asaba abandi bakandida kubigenza batyo.
Mu matora yo ku ya 24 Werurwe 2024, Faye yatsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 54,28%. Umukandida w'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi, Amadou Ba, na Perezida Macky Sall bemeye gutsindwa bamushimira. Ku myaka 44, yabaye perezida muto kurusha abandi bose watorewe kuyobora Senegali, umukandida wa mbere utavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi utsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere kuva igihugu cyabona ubwigenge mu 1960, akaba na perezida wa mbere ufite abagore barenze umwe ku mugaragaro.
Perezida wa Senegali.
Intangiriro ya manda.
Faye yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Senegali ku ya 2 Mata 2024, asimbura Macky Sall, yiyemeza kurwanya ruswa no kuvugurura ubukungu. Uwo munsi, yagize Ousmane Sonko Minisitiri w'Intebe, maze guverinoma nshya ishyirwaho ku ya 5 Mata. Ku ya 3 Mata, yategetse igenzura ry'urwego rw'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, peteroli na gaze.
Urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga yarukoreye muri Moritaniya, aho yahuriye na Perezida Mohamed Ould Ghazouani. Muri Gicurasi 2024, yasuye Gineya na Mali, ahura na Mamadi Doumbouya na Assimi Goïta, agaragaza ubushake bwo kugarura Mali, Burukina Faso na Nigeri muri CEDEAO. Ukwezi kwe kwa mbere ku butegetsi kwaranzwe no koroshya imihango ya leta, guca icyuho cyo gufata imyanya myinshi icyarimwe, no gutangaza raporo za kera ku buriganya na ruswa.
Ku ya 12 Nzeri 2024, mu gihe yari afitanye amakimbirane n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yari yiganjemo abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Faye yasheshe Inteko, ategeka amatora y'abadepite yo ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 2024. PASTEF yatsinze ayo matora ku bwiganze busesuye.
Ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi Carnegie Endowment cyagaragaje ko ubutegetsi bwe bwasubije agaciro uburenganzira bw'ibanze bwari bwarahungabanyijwe ku butegetsi bwamubanjirije, ariko kinavuga ko itangazamakuru ryakomeje gukorerwa igitutu, harimo no gukumira bimwe mu bitangazwa ("censure"). Muri Nyakanga 2025, yitabiriye inama yahuje Perezida Donald Trump n'abakuru b'ibihugu bimwe bya Afurika muri White House.
Ikibazo cy'imyenda ya leta.
Mu mpera za 2024, guverinoma ye yashyize ahagaragara amakosa yo mu icungamari yakozwe na guverinoma yabanje, n'umwenda munini igihugu cyari gifite utari waratangajwe. Amanota y'ubushobozi bwo kwishyura ya Senegali yaramanuwe, kandi Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI) gihagarika inguzanyo yacyo. Umwenda wa leta wongeye kubarwa, uva kuri 65% ugera kuri 111% by'umusaruro mbumbe w'igihugu, bituma Senegali iba kimwe mu bihugu bifite umwenda munini kurusha ibindi muri Afurika. Muri Kanama 2025, perezida na minisitiri w'intebe batangaje gahunda yo kuzahura ubukungu n'imibereho, igamije kubona miliyari 6 000 z'amafaranga ya CFA mu myaka itatu, ahanini binyuze mu kongera imisoro no kugabanya amafaranga leta isohora.
Gutandukana na Sonko.
Guhera mu 2025, havutse amakimbirane hagati ya Faye na Minisitiri w'Intebe Ousmane Sonko, cyane cyane ku bijyanye n'ishyirwaho ry'abayobozi bamwe n'uburyo bwo kwishyura umwenda wa leta. Ayo makimbirane yarushijeho gukara mu 2026, mu gihe cy'ikibazo cy'imari no guhangana kw'aba bombi ku matora ya perezida ataha. Ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2026, Faye yirukanye Sonko ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe, amusimbuza impuguke mu by'ubukungu Ahmadou Al Aminou Lô. Guverinoma nshya, yashyizweho ku ya 1 Kamena 2026, yagizwe ahanini n'abantu batari mu mashyaka n'abo mu miryango itegamiye kuri leta, nta ruhare rwa PASTEF. Ku ya 25 Nyakanga 2026, Faye yashinze ishyaka rishya ryitwa Kiiraay – Les Patriotes républicains.
Umuyobozi wa CEDEAO.
Ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2026, mu nama ya 69 y'abakuru b'ibihugu n'aba guverinoma yabereye i Freetown, Faye yagizwe umuyobozi wa CEDEAO, asimbura Julius Maada Bio.
Ibitekerezo bya politiki.
Faye avuga ko aharanira impinduka mu miyoborere no gukunda Afurika ("panafricanisme") bishingiye ku bitekerezo by'ibumoso, agamije gusubiza Senegali ubusugire bwayo; bamwe mu basesenguzi babona ko ibyo bigaragaza ubushake bwo kwitandukanya n'ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba, cyane cyane Ubufaransa. Yiyemeje kugabanya ububasha bwa perezida no kugarura umwanya wa visi-perezida. Yifuza kandi ivugurura ry'ifaranga rya CFA ku rwego rw'akarere, bitashoboka igihugu kigashyiraho ifaranga ryacyo bwite. Ashyigikiye gusubiramo amasezerano ya leta n'ibigo by'ubucuruzi mu rwego rw'ingufu, ubucukuzi n'uburobyi.
Faye afite abagore babiri. Umugore we wa mbere, Marie Khone Faye, ukomoka i Ndiaganiao, ni Umukristo ; bafitanye umukobwa umwe n'abahungu batatu, umwe muri bo akaba yaritiriwe Ousmane Sonko. Umugore we wa kabiri, Absa Faye, bashakanye mu 2023 i Keur Massar, ni Umuyisilamu; bafitanye umukobwa umwe. Mu gihe cy'akaruhuko, akunda ubuhinzi mu mirima y'iwabo, kandi yandika imivugo.

Patrick Herminie (yavutse ku ya 22 Nzeri 1963 i Baie Sainte-Anne, ku kirwa cya Praslin) ni umuganga akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Seyishele, Perezida wa gatandatu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2025. Mbere yo kwinjira muri politiki byuzuye, yakoze imyaka myinshi muri Minisiteri y'Ubuzima. Yabaye umudepite kuva mu 1993, aba Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Seyishele kuva mu 2007 kugeza mu 2016, hanyuma ayobora ishyaka rya United Seychelles (US), ishyaka rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, kuva mu 2021. Mu matora ya perezida ya 2025, yatsinze Perezida Wavel Ramkalawan wari ku butegetsi ku cyiciro cya kabiri.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Patrick Herminie yavutse ku ya 22 Nzeri 1963 mu bitaro bya Baie Sainte-Anne, ku kirwa cya Praslin, ikirwa cya kabiri mu bunini muri Seyishele. Ni uwa kane mu bana batanu. Nyina, Christa Herminie, yitaga ku rugo, naho se, Louis Herminie, yari umupolisi. Nyuma y'imyaka mike, umuryango we wimukiye ku kirwa cya Mahé.
Yize mu ishuri ry'abahungu rya Seychelles College, aho yanabaye kapiteni w'ikipe y'umupira w'amaguru y'abato. Nyuma yaho, yize ubuvuzi muri Kaminuza ya Charles i Prague, muri Cekosolovakiya, abona impamyabumenyi y'ubuganga mu 1990.
Agarutse muri Seyishele, Herminie yabaye umuganga mu bitaro bya Victoria mu 1990, hanyuma umuganga mukuru mu 1992. Mu 1995, yagizwe umuyobozi w'ishami ry'isuku y'ibidukikije muri Minisiteri y'Ubuzima; muri uwo mwaka, yahawe buruse ya Chevening na leta y'Ubwongereza, abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu buzima rusange muri Kaminuza ya Leeds. Mu 1996, yabaye umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe gukumira no kurwanya indwara, hanyuma mu 1998 umuyobozi mukuru w'ishami ry'ubuvuzi bw'ibanze muri Minisiteri y'Ubuzima, umwanya yagumyeho kugeza mu 2003.
Herminie yatangiye politiki mu 1992, ubwo yagirwaga umwe mu bagize komisiyo yateguye Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika ya Gatatu. Mu 1993, yatorewe kuba umudepite uhagarariye agace ka English River, yongera gutorwa mu 1998, 2002 na 2003. Kuva mu 1998, yabaye umuyobozi w'ibikorwa bya guverinoma mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko (umuyobozi w'abadepite b'ishyaka ryiganje), kandi yari mu bagize komite nkuru y'ishyaka ryari ku butegetsi, Seychelles People's Progressive Front.
Kuva mu 2007 kugeza mu 2016, Herminie yabaye Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Seyishele. Mu 2012, yatorewe kuyobora inama y'abaperezida b'inteko zishinga amategeko z'ibihugu bya Commonwealth (CSPOC) mu karere ka Afurika, hanyuma hagati ya 2015 na 2016 ayobora iyo nama ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Nyuma y'itsinzi y'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi mu matora y'abadepite yo muri Nzeri 2016, yasimbuwe na Patrick Pillay ku ya 27 Nzeri 2016.
Kuva mu 2017 kugeza mu 2020, Herminie yayoboye inama y'ubuyobozi y'ikigo gishya cyo gukumira ikoreshwa ry'ibiyobyabwenge no gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe ababaswe na byo (APDAR), cyashyizweho na Perezida Danny Faure, mu gihe Seyishele yari ihanganye n'icyorezo gikomeye cy'ikoreshwa rya heroyine. Ku ya 31 Mutarama 2021, yatorewe kuyobora ishyaka rya United Seychelles.
Mu Ukwakira 2023, ubushinjacyaha bwa Seyishele bwashinje Herminie icyaha cy'uburozi ("sorcellerie"), nyuma y'uko imirambo ibiri itabuwe ivumburwa ku kirwa cya Mahé muri Kanama 2023, maze izina rye rikaboneka muri telefone y'ukekwaho icyaha w'ibanze. Herminie yahakanye ibyo birego, avuga ko ari «uguhiga abarozi kwa politiki» kwa Perezida Ramkalawan, kugamije kumubuza kwiyamamaza. Ku ya 15 Gashyantare 2024, ibyo birego byose byarateshejwe agaciro.
Amatora ya perezida ya 2025.
Ku ya 4 Kamena 2024, ishyaka rye ryamutanze nk'umukandida waryo mu matora ya perezida ya 2025. Yibanze ku bibazo by'imibereho, yitirira umurage w'uwahoze ari Perezida France-Albert René, maze yiyemeza kumanura imyaka y'izabukuru ikagera kuri 63, kugabanya ibiciro by'ingendo rusange ku kigero cya 40% no kongera inyunganizi z'ubwiteganyirize. Yashyigikiye kandi kugenzura cyane imishinga y'ubukerarugendo, yiyemeza guhagarika amasezerano yahaye umushoramari wo muri Qatar ikirwa cya Assomption. Mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'amatora cyabaye kuva ku ya 9 kugeza ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2025, yatsinze Perezida Wavel Ramkalawan n'amajwi 52,7%.
Perezida wa Seyishele.
