Ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2025, Herminie yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa gatandatu wa Repubulika ya Seyishele, mu muhango wabereye kuri sitade Linité i Victoria. Uwo muhango witabiriwe n'abayobozi b'ibihugu byinshi, barimo Visi-Perezida w'Ubuhinde, Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Morise na Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Tanzaniya. Mu ijambo rye, yasubiyemo intero ye yo kwiyamamaza, «ku bw'abenshi, si ku bw'abake», yiyemeza kurwanya ubusumbane, guteza imbere ubuvuzi n'uburezi, no gutuma iterambere rigera ku Banyaseyishele bose. Guverinoma ye nshya, irimo abaminisitiri benshi bashya n'umubare w'abagore utarigeze ubaho, yitezwe kuba iya mbere mu mateka y'igihugu ifite uburinganire bw'abagabo n'abagore.
Mu 1991, Herminie yahuye na Veronique Sinon, baje gushyingiranwa. Bafitanye abana babiri: Venessa, umuganga, na Martin, injeniyeri.

Julius Maada Wonie Bio (yavutse ku ya 12 Gicurasi 1964 i Tihun) ni umusirikare mukuru wavuye mu ngabo akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Siyera Lewone, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 4 Mata 2018. Afite ipeti rya burigadiye jenerali. Mu 1992, yari umwe mu basirikare bato bahiritse ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Joseph Momoh, maze mu 1996 ahirika mugenzi we Valentine Strasser, ayobora igihugu kuva ku ya 16 Mutarama kugeza ku ya 29 Werurwe 1996, afite imyaka 32 gusa, mbere yo gushyikiriza ubutegetsi Perezida watowe, Ahmad Tejan Kabbah. Nyuma yo kuva mu gisirikare, yabaye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, hanyuma agaruka muri politiki mu ishyaka rya Sierra Leone People's Party (SLPP). Yatsinzwe amatora ya perezida ya 2012, atsinda aya 2018, yongera gutorwa mu 2023. Ku butegetsi bwe, yashyizeho uburezi bw'ibanze n'ayisumbuye ku buntu kandi akuraho igihano cy'urupfu. Kuva muri Kamena 2025 kugeza muri Nyakanga 2026, yayoboye Umuryango w'Ubukungu w'Ibihugu bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (CEDEAO).
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Julius Maada Wonie Bio yavutse ku ya 12 Gicurasi 1964 mu mudugudu wa Tihun, mu karere ka Bonthe, mu ntara y'Amajyepfo ya Siyera Lewone. Ni umwana wa 33 mu bana 35 b'umutware gakondo Charlie Bio II. Ni Umusherboro ("Sherbro"), kandi ni Umukristo Gatolika.
Yatangiye amashuri abanza mu ishuri Gatolika rya Tihun, ayarangiriza i Pujehun, aho yabanaga na mukuru we Agnes wari umwarimu. Hanyuma yize imyaka irindwi mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya leta rya Bo ("Bo School"), ariharangiza mu 1984.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Mu 1985, Bio yinjiye mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Benguema, hafi ya Freetown, arirangiza mu Ukwakira 1987 afite ipeti rya su-liyetona. Yakoreye mu birindiro bya Lungi no mu karere ka Kambia, mu mutwe wari ushinzwe kurwanya magendu ku mupaka na Gineya.
Mu 1990, yoherejwe muri Liberiya mu ngabo za CEDEAO zishinzwe kugarura amahoro (ECOMOG), mu gihe cy'intambara y'abenegihugu yari imaze kuduka muri icyo gihugu. Nyuma y'umwaka umwe, yagaruwe muri Siyera Lewone kurwanya inyeshyamba za Revolutionary United Front (RUF), zari zatangiye gutera imidugudu yo ku mupaka na Liberiya muri Werurwe 1991.
Kudeta n'ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare.
Ku ya 29 Mata 1992, Bio yari umwe mu basirikare bato bayobowe na Kapiteni Valentine Strasser bahiritse ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Joseph Momoh, washinjwaga kuba yarateje intambara y'abenegihugu (1991–2002). Abo basirikare bashinze akanama ka gisirikare kayoboraga igihugu, National Provisional Ruling Council (NPRC), kayobowe na Strasser. Bio yabanje kuba umunyamabanga wa leta ushinzwe Amajyepfo i Bo, hanyuma ushinzwe itangazamakuru, nyuma aba visi-perezida wa NPRC. Nyuma yaho, yasabye imbabazi ku iyicwa ry'abantu bagera kuri makumyabiri ryabaye muri iyo kudeta.
Ku ya 16 Mutarama 1996, Bio yayoboye kudeta yahiritse Strasser, nyuma y'amakimbirane mu buyobozi bwa NPRC ku bijyanye no kumvikana n'inyeshyamba za RUF mbere y'amatora y'amashyaka menshi yari ateganyijwe muri Werurwe 1996. Strasser yahise yoherezwa mu buhungiro i Conakry, muri Gineya. Bio yagaruye amatora y'amashyaka menshi, maze muri Werurwe 1996 ashyikiriza ubutegetsi Ahmad Tejan Kabbah wari umaze gutorwa.
Nyuma y'igisirikare.
Nyuma yo kuva mu gisirikare mu 1996, Bio yimukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, aho yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu bibazo mpuzamahanga muri American University i Washington. Yayoboye kandi ikigo cy'ubujyanama n'ishoramari cyitwa International Systems Science Corporation.
Kugaruka muri politiki.
Mu 2005, Bio yinjiye mu ishyaka rya SLPP, ariyamamariza kuriyobora mu nama yaryo yabereye i Makeni, aba uwa gatatu. Mu 2011, yatowe nk'umukandida wa SLPP mu matora ya perezida ya 2012; yatsinzwe na Perezida Ernest Bai Koroma wari ku butegetsi, abona amajwi 37,4% kuri 58,7% ya Koroma, ariko ashimangira SLPP nk'ishyaka rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi. Nyuma yaho, yatangiye amasomo y'impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu bumenyi bw'amahoro muri Kaminuza ya Bradford, mu Bwongereza.
Perezida wa Siyera Lewone.
Mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy'amatora ya perezida cyabaye ku ya 31 Werurwe 2018, Bio yatsinze Samura Kamara wo mu ishyaka ryari ku butegetsi, All People's Congress (APC), n'amajwi 51,8%. Yarahiriye kuba perezida ku ya 4 Mata 2018, nubwo uwo bari bahanganye yamaganaga ibyavuye mu matora.
Politiki y'imbere mu gihugu.
Mu kwezi kwe kwa mbere ku butegetsi, Bio yashyizeho uburezi bw'ibanze n'ayisumbuye ku buntu mu mashuri ya leta. Yahagaritse amasezerano y'inguzanyo ya miliyoni 400 z'amadolari yari yarasinywe na Koroma n'uBushinwa yo kubaka ikibuga cy'indege mpuzamahanga gishya, kandi atangiza igenzura ry'amasezerano y'ubucukuzi n'ibigo bya leta byo ku butegetsi bwabanje. Guverinoma ye yashinje Koroma na guverinoma ye ruswa ikabije.
Muri Gashyantare 2019, Bio yatangaje ibihe bidasanzwe kubera ubwiyongere bw'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, yongera ibihano ku cyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu; ibyo bihe bidasanzwe byavanyweho muri Kamena uwo mwaka. Mu 2022, yatangaje ko guverinoma ye ishyigikiye umushinga w'itegeko wagura uburenganzira bwo gukuramo inda. Muri Mutarama 2023, yasinye itegeko ry'uburinganire n'iterambere ry'abagore, risaba ko nibura 30% by'abakandida mu matora y'abadepite n'ay'inzego z'ibanze baba abagore.
Abatavuga rumwe na we bamunenga kubera ubukungu bw'igihugu bwifashe nabi. Muri Kanama 2022, imyigaragambyo yatewe n'izamuka ry'ibiciro yasabaga ko yegura, ihitana abantu benshi ; Bio yayifashe nk'igerageza ryo guhirika ubutegetsi.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Muri Nyakanga 2021, Bio yatumiwe mu nama mpuzamahanga ku burezi i Londres, kubera ibikorwa bye byo kwagura uburezi no guteza imbere ishuri ry'abakobwa. Muri Werurwe 2022, yasuye Viyetinamu. Muri Gicurasi 2023, yasabye ko intambara y'Uburusiya muri Ukraine ihagarara «ku bw'inyungu z'ikiremwamuntu», avuga ko yizeye ko dipolomasi iyobowe n'abayobozi b'Afurika yafasha kuyirangiza.
Mu matora rusange yo muri Kamena 2023, Bio yongeye gutorwa ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 56,17%, imbere ya Samura Kamara. Ariko indorerezi z'imbere mu gihugu n'izo mu mahanga zanenze kudakorera mu mucyo mu ibarura ry'amajwi, kandi Kamara yanze kwemera ibyavuye mu matora. Iminsi mike mbere y'amatora, ku ya 21 Kamena 2023, imyigaragambyo yabereye imbere y'icyicaro cya APC yahitanye nibura umuntu umwe.
Mu ntangiriro za 2025, ibinyamakuru byinshi byatangaje ko Jos Leijdekkers, umucuruzi w'ikiyobyabwenge cya kokayine ukomoka mu Buholandi wakatiwe adahari igifungo cy'imyaka 24, yari amaze igihe aba muri Siyera Lewone. Hagaragaye amashusho amwerekana mu misa yabereye i Freetown ku ya 1 Mutarama 2025, yicaye inyuma ya Perezida Bio, ari kumwe n'umwe mu bakobwa ba Bio, bivugwa ko yashakanye na we. Leta y'Ubuholandi yagaragaje impungenge ku kuba abayobozi ba Siyera Lewone nta cyo bakoze ku bijyanye na we.
Umuyobozi wa CEDEAO.
Ku ya 22 Kamena 2025, mu nama y'abakuru b'ibihugu yabereye i Abuja, muri Nijeriya, Bio yatorewe kuyobora CEDEAO. Yasimbuwe kuri uwo mwanya na Bassirou Diomaye Faye muri Nyakanga 2026.
Bio ni Umukristo Gatolika. Umugore we, Fatima Bio, ni umukinnyi wa filime w'Umuyisilamu, ufite inkomoko muri Gambiya no muri Siyera Lewone. Bashyingiranwe mu 2013 i Londres, mu muhango wahuje amadini yombi; bafitanye umwana umwe. Bio afite abandi bana batatu yabyaye mu bushyingiranwe bwa mbere. Bamenyaniye mu 2012 i Londres.

Université de l'Assomption au Congo (UAC), mu Kinyarwanda Kaminuza y'Asomusiyo muri Kongo, ni ishuri rikuru ryigenga ry'amashuri makuru na kaminuza riherereye mu mujyi wa Butembo, mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yashinzwe kandi iyoborwa n'Abasomusiyonisiti, umuryango w'abihayimana wa Kiliziya Gatolika.
Mu 1982, Abasomusiyonisiti bakoreraga ubutumwa muri Diyosezi ya Butembo-Beni bashinze ishuri rya filozofiya ryitwa Philosophat Saint-Augustin de Bulengera, kugira ngo ritegure abihayimana bazakomeza kwiga tewolojiya. Kuva mu 1993 kugeza mu 2002, iryo shuri ryari ishami rya Butembo rya Philosophat Saint-Augustin y'i Kinshasa.
Mu 2002, bisabwe na Minisiteri y'Amashuri Makuru, ryahinduye izina riba Institut supérieur Emmanuel d'Alzon de Butembo (ISEAB). Kubera intambara z'inyeshyamba, abanyeshuri ntibari bagishobora kujya i Kinshasa, maze Minisiteri yemera ko ishuri ryakira n'abalayiki.
Ku wa 18 Mata 2003, iteka rya minisitiri ryemereye ishuri gutanga impamyabumenyi (graduat) muri filozofiya, mu bumenyi n'ubuhanga bw'iterambere, no mu itumanaho. Ku wa 22 Ugushyingo 2018, ISEAB yahindutse kaminuza yuzuye yitwa Université de l'Assomption au Congo.
UAC iri munsi y'ubuyobozi bw'Abasomusiyonisiti. Yiyita kaminuza ya tekiniki yigenga ya Gatolika, ariko inyigisho zayo ntizishingiye ku idini. Mu 2023, umunyamabanga mukuru ushinzwe amasomo, Padiri Omer Kamate, yavuze ko ikibazo gikomeye ari ukubona abarimu bahoraho, kuko kaminuza ikoresha abarimu baturutse mu tundi turere.
Ikorana n'andi mashuri makuru, nka IFASIC mu itumanaho na Kaminuza ya Kinshasa (UNIKIN) mu yandi masomo.
Kuva mu 2023, UAC ifite amashami (facultés) atanu:
Kaminuza ifite kandi ishuri ry'ikirenga (école doctorale) n'ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi.
Ikigo gikuru cya UAC kiri ku musozi wa Bulengera, ugerwaho n'umuhanda w'ibumba; ikindi kigo kiri i Kambali, hafi ya Radio Moto Butembo-Beni. Abanyeshuri biga itumanaho bimenyerereza kuri Radio na Televiziyo Moto. Kaminuza ifite kandi laboratwari y'ikoranabuhanga, laboratwari y'ibinyabuzima (biotechnologie), umurima wo gutubura insina, na gahunda yo gucunga imyanda, harimo gukora amapave mu masashe.
Abanyeshuri n'amafaranga y'ishuri.
Mu 2023, UAC yari ifite abanyeshuri bagera kuri 900. Amafaranga yo kwiyandikisha ari hagati ya 340 na 500 by'amadolari y'Amerika, yishyurwa mu byiciro.

Hassan Sheikh Mohamud (mu Gisomali: "Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud"; yavutse ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 1955 i Jalalaqsi, mu ntara ya Hiiraan) ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'umwarimu wa kaminuza wa Somaliya, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva mu 2022, nyuma yo kuba yarakiyoboye bwa mbere kuva mu 2012 kugeza mu 2017. Mbere yo kwinjira muri politiki, yari umwarimu akaba n'umuyobozi muri SIMAD University, kaminuza yafatanyije gushinga i Mogadishu. Mu 2012, yatorewe n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko kuba perezida, maze ikinyamakuru "Time" kimushyira mu bantu 100 bavuga rikijyana ku isi mu 2013. Manda ye ya mbere yaranzwe n'ibitero by'umutwe wa al-Shabaab no kunengwa kubera ruswa n'ikoreshwa nabi ry'ububasha. Yatsinzwe mu 2017, ashinga ishyaka rya Union for Peace and Development, maze yongera gutorwa mu 2022. Mu 2026, kongererwa igihe kwa manda ye byateje impaka zikomeye.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Hassan Sheikh Mohamud yavukiye mu ntara ya Hiiraan. Se akomoka mu muryango w'Abagaal, umwe mu miryango migari y'Abahawiye, naho nyina akomoka mu muryango wa Hawadle. Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye iwabo. Mu 1978, yimukiye i Mogadishu, aho yize imyaka itatu mu ishuri rikuru ry'ubumenyingiro, abona impamyabumenyi mu ikoranabuhanga mu 1981.
Mu 1986, yagiye mu Ubuhinde, yiga muri Kaminuza ya Bhopal (ubu yitwa Barkatullah University), aharangiriza impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu burezi bw'ubumenyingiro mu 1988. Mu 2001, yakurikiye amasomo y'ubuhuza n'ubwiyunge muri Eastern Mennonite University, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Mu Ukwakira 2022, yamuritse igitabo cy'ubushakashatsi bw'impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (PhD) mu mahoro, imiyoborere n'iterambere muri University for Peace, aba perezida wa mbere wa Somaliya ubikoze ari ku butegetsi.
Umwuga mbere ya politiki.
Hassan yabanje kuba umwarimu mu ishuri ry'ubumenyingiro rya Lafole, hanyuma mu 1984 yinjira mu ishuri rikuru ryigisha abarimu b'ubumenyingiro rishamikiye kuri Kaminuza y'Igihugu ya Somaliya, aba umuyobozi w'ishami mu 1986. Ubwo intambara y'abenegihugu yadukaga mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, yagumye muri Somaliya, aba umujyanama w'imiryango itegamiye kuri leta n'ibigo by'Umuryango w'Abibumbye. Kuva mu 1993 kugeza mu 1995, yari umukozi ushinzwe uburezi muri UNICEF mu majyepfo no hagati mu gihugu. Mu 1999, yafatanyije gushinga ikigo cy'imicungire n'ubuyobozi (SIMAD) i Mogadishu, cyaje kuba SIMAD University, akibera umuyobozi kugeza mu 2010. Yigishije kandi ikoranabuhanga muri Kaminuza ya Mogadishu.
Mu 2011, yashinze ishyaka rya Peace and Development Party (PDP), maze muri Mata 2011 aritorerwa kuriyobora. Muri Kanama 2012, yabaye umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko nshya ya Leta Yunze Ubumwe ya Somaliya.
Manda ya mbere (2012–2017).
Ku ya 10 Nzeri 2012, abadepite bamutoreye kuba Perezida wa Somaliya. Mu cyiciro cya mbere cy'amatora, Perezida Sharif Sheikh Ahmed wari ku butegetsi yabaye uwa mbere n'amajwi 64, Hassan akurikiraho n'amajwi 60 ; mu cyiciro cya kabiri, Hassan yatsinze Sharif ku majwi 190 kuri 79. Nubwo habayeho ibirego bya ruswa n'igurwa ry'amajwi, Sharif yemeye ibyavuye mu matora. Itorwa rye ryashimwe n'umuryango mpuzamahanga, harimo Umuryango w'Abibumbye n'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe. Yarahiriye kuba perezida ku ya 16 Nzeri 2012, maze ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2012 agira Abdi Farah Shirdon Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Ibitero byamwibasiye.
Ku ya 12 Nzeri 2012, iminsi ibiri nyuma yo gutorwa, abiyahuzi n'abantu bitwaje intwaro bagabye igitero kuri hoteli Jazeera i Mogadishu, aho yari ari mu nama n'intumwa z'amahanga; Hassan ntiyakomeretse, akomeza ijambo rye imbere y'abanyamakuru. Umutwe wa al-Shabaab wigambye icyo gitero. Ku ya 3 Nzeri 2013, igisasu cyaturikiye hafi y'imodoka zari ziherekeje perezida i Merca. Ku ya 7 Ukwakira 2015, abarwanyi ba al-Shabaab bishe mwishywa we, Dr Liban Osman, i Mogadishu. Ku ya 18 Werurwe 2025, al-Shabaab yongeye kugerageza kumwica ikoresheje ibisasu byatezwe ku muhanda hafi y'ingoro ya Villa Somalia.
Politiki y'imbere mu gihugu.
Ubutegetsi bwe bwashyize imbere guteza imbere serivisi z'ibanze nk'ubuzima n'uburezi, no kongera kubaka ibikorwa remezo birimo icyambu n'ikibuga cy'indege cya Mogadishu, imihanda, amashuri n'ibitaro. Guverinoma ye yasabye ko hakurwaho igihano cyo kubuza Somaliya kugura intwaro, cyari cyarashyizweho n'Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano ka Loni mu 1992, kugira ngo ingabo z'igihugu zibashe guhangana n'inyeshyamba z'abiyitirira Isilamu. Icyo gihano cyaroroshejwe by'agateganyo mu 2013, maze ku ya 5 Werurwe 2014 Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano kemeza ko iryo yoroshya rikomeza.
Muri Mata 2013, yasubukuye ibiganiro by'ubwiyunge na Somaliland, intara yiyomoye mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba, abisinyira i Ankara, muri Turukiya, na Perezida wa Somaliland Ahmed Mahamoud Silanyo. Muri Kanama 2013, guverinoma ye yasinye amasezerano y'ubwiyunge n'ubuyobozi bwigenga bwa Jubaland i Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya.
Manda ye ya mbere yaranzwe n'amakimbirane n'abaminisitiri b'intebe be: mu Ugushyingo 2013, yasabye Abdi Farah Shirdon kwegura, maze abadepite batangiza icyifuzo cyo kumweguza ; mu 2014, yagiranye andi makimbirane na Minisitiri w'Intebe Abdiweli Sheikh Ahmed ku bijyanye n'ivugurura rya guverinoma. Mu ntangiriro za 2016, ubutegetsi bwe bwagenzuraga igice gito cyane cy'igihugu, kandi ntiyabashije gukemura ikibazo cya Somaliland. Mu 2017, yatsinzwe amatora na Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed «Farmaajo».
Manda ya kabiri (kuva mu 2022).
Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 2022, Hassan yongeye gutorwa kuba perezida, atsinda ku cyiciro cya gatatu Perezida Farmaajo wari ku butegetsi, wari waramutsinze mu 2017. Yiyemeje kugarura umutekano muri Somaliya, maze arahira ku ya 23 Gicurasi 2022. Ku ya 15 Kamena 2022, yagize Hamza Abdi Barre Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Ku ya 28 Ugushyingo 2024, mu makimbirane ku matora y'intara ya Jubaland, umucamanza wo muri iyo ntara yasohoye impapuro zo kumuta muri yombi, amushinja ubugambanyi no gushaka guteza intambara; guverinoma nkuru na yo yasohoye impapuro zo guta muri yombi Perezida wa Jubaland, Ahmed Madobe.
Muri Gashyantare 2026, mu kiganiro na Al Jazeera, yamaganye iyemezwa rya Somaliland nk'igihugu kigenga ryakozwe na Isirayeli, avuga ko ari ukwivanga mu bibazo by'igihugu cye kandi ko Somaliya itazemera ko Isirayeli ishyira ikigo cya gisirikare muri Somaliland.
Ku ya 15 Gicurasi 2026, nubwo abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavugaga ko manda ye irangiye uwo munsi, yatangaje ko Itegeko Nshinga ryavuguruwe ryongereye manda ya perezida kuva ku myaka ine ikagera ku myaka itanu, bityo manda ye ikazarangira ku ya 15 Gicurasi 2027.
Manda ye ya mbere yanenzwe cyane kubera ruswa ikabije, kubuza itangazamakuru ubwisanzure no gukoresha nabi ububasha. Itsinda ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye rishinzwe kugenzura Somaliya ryashinje ubutegetsi bwe guha intwaro al-Shabaab, kandi raporo yo mu 2013 yavuze ko hari umugambi wo kunyereza umutungo wa leta.
Muri Werurwe 2023, yagize umukobwa we, Jehan Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, umujyanama we mu bibazo mpuzamahanga, ibyo bikaba byarateje impaka, ndetse ambasaderi wa Somaliya muri Arabiya Sawudite yegura avuga ko yasuzuguwe n'abo hafi ya perezida.
Ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 2023, umuhungu we, Mohammed Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, yagonze umumotari w'Umunyaturukiya i Istanbul, ari mu modoka y'ambasade ya Somaliya; uwo mumotari yapfuye ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2023. Urukiko rwabanje kumukatira igifungo cy'imyaka ibiri n'igice, nyuma gihindurwa ihazabu.
Hassan Sheikh Mohamud yashakanye na Qamar Ali Omar, bafitanye abana barindwi.

Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa (yavutse ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 1952 i Soweto) ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'umucuruzi wa Afurika y’Epfo, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva muri Gashyantare 2018, akaba na perezida w'ishyaka rya African National Congress (ANC) kuva mu 2017. Yahoze ari impirimbanyi irwanya ivanguraruhu ("apartheid") n'umuyobozi w'ihuriro ry'abakozi bo mu birombe (NUM). Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, yari intumwa nkuru ya ANC mu mishyikirano yashyize iherezo kuri "apartheid", hanyuma ayobora Inteko Ishinga Itegeko Nshinga yateguye Itegeko Nshinga rya 1996. Nyuma yo kuva muri politiki mu 1996, yabaye umwe mu bacuruzi bakize kurusha abandi mu gihugu. Yagarutse muri politiki mu 2012, aba Visi-Perezida wa Repubulika kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2018, maze asimbura Jacob Zuma weguye. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2019 no mu 2024, ubwo ANC yatakazaga ubwiganze busesuye, bituma ashyiraho guverinoma y'ubumwe bw'igihugu. Yayoboye Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe kuva mu 2020 kugeza mu 2021.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Ramaphosa yavutse ku ya 17 Ugushyingo 1952 i Johannesburg, mu muryango woroheje ukomoka mu bwoko bw'Abavenda. Ni uwa kabiri mu bana batatu ba Erdmuth na Samuel Ramaphosa, wari umupolisi. Akiri umwana, agace k'iwabo karasenywe, umuryango we wimurirwa i Soweto. Yize mu mashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye i Soweto, hanyuma mu 1971 arangiriza amashuri yisumbuye i Sibasa, muri Venda.
Ku myaka 20, yatangiye kwiga amategeko muri Kaminuza y'Amajyaruguru (Turfloop). Yinjiye mu muryango w'abanyeshuri b'Abirabura (SASO), maze afungwa amezi cumi n'umwe mu 1974, yongera gufungwa mu 1976 nyuma y'imyivumbagatanyo ya Soweto. Yarangije amasomo y'amategeko muri Kaminuza ya Afurika y'Epfo (UNISA) mu 1981.
Ihuriro ry'abakozi no kurwanya "apartheid".
Mu 1981, Ramaphosa yabaye umujyanama mu by'amategeko w'ihuriro ry'amashyirahamwe y'abakozi (CUSA). Mu 1982, yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w'ihuriro ry'abakozi bo mu birombe (National Union of Mineworkers, NUM) ryari rimaze gushingwa, aho yayoboye imyigaragambyo ikomeye yo mu 1987, yabaye nini kurusha izindi mu mateka y'igihugu.
Mu 1991, yatorewe kuba umunyamabanga mukuru wa ANC, iyobowe na Nelson Mandela, maze aba intumwa nkuru ya ANC mu mishyikirano yashyize iherezo kuri "apartheid". Nyuma y'amatora ya mbere ya demokarasi yo muri Mata 1994, ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1994 yatorewe kuyobora Inteko Ishinga Itegeko Nshinga, ayobora itegurwa ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryemejwe mu 1996. Bamwe bamufataga nk'uwo Mandela yifuzaga ko azamusimbura, ariko mu 1997 Thabo Mbeki ni we wamusimbuye ku buyobozi bwa ANC.
Nyuma yo kuva muri politiki mu 1996, Ramaphosa yabaye umucuruzi ukomeye, abifashijwemo na politiki yo guteza imbere Abirabura mu bukungu. Yashinze ikigo cy'ishoramari cya Shanduka, cyashoye imari mu birombe, mu mitungo itimukanwa no mu masosiyete nka McDonald's na Coca-Cola muri Afurika y'Epfo. Yabaye kandi umuyobozi w'inama y'ubutegetsi ya MTN n'umwe mu bagize iy'ikigo cy'ubucukuzi Lonmin. Mu 2018, umutungo we wagereranywaga n'amadolari arenga miliyoni 450.
Mu Kanama 2012, ubwo yari mu buyobozi bwa Lonmin, abakozi b'ikirombe cya Marikana bakoze imyigaragambyo, maze polisi irasa abacukuzi 34. Ramaphosa yanenzwe kuba yarashyigikiye ko polisi itabara; nubwo komisiyo y'iperereza yamugize umwere, mu 2017 yasabye imbabazi ku ruhare rwe muri ayo makuba.
Kugaruka muri politiki.
Mu Ukuboza 2012, Ramaphosa yagarutse muri politiki, atorerwa kuba visi-perezida wa ANC. Ku ya 3 Kamena 2014, yabaye Visi-Perezida wa Repubulika ku butegetsi bwa Jacob Zuma, anayobora komisiyo y'igihugu ishinzwe igenamigambi.
Ku ya 18 Ukuboza 2017, yatorewe kuyobora ANC n'amajwi 2 440, atsinda Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma wagize amajwi 2 261. Icyo gihe, ANC yari mu bihe bikomeye: Perezida Zuma yari yugarijwe n'ibirego bya ruswa, ubushomeri bwari bugeze kuri 30%, kandi ubusumbane bwari bukabije.
Perezida wa Afurika y'Epfo.
Manda ya mbere (2018–2024).
Muri Gashyantare 2018, nyuma y'imishyikirano hagati ya ANC na Zuma, Zuma yeguye ku ya 14 Gashyantare 2018, amaze gukangishwa kweguzwa. Ku ya 15 Gashyantare 2018, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yatoreye Ramaphosa kuba Perezida wa Repubulika nta wundi bahatanye. Amasoko y'imari yahise yakira neza itorwa rye. Ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2018, yavuguruye guverinoma, akuramo abaminisitiri benshi bavugwagaho ibibazo ku butegetsi bwa Zuma, kandi agira David Mabuza Visi-Perezida.
Yashyigikiye ivugurura ry'ubutaka «rikomeye», maze mu mpera za Gashyantare 2018 Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yemeza umushinga wo kwambura ubutaka nta ngurane, hagamijwe gukosora ubusumbane bwasizwe na "apartheid". Muri Kanama 2018, yahagaritse umushinga wo kongera inganda z'ingufu za kirimbuzi, ashyira imbere ingufu zisubira.
Mu matora rusange yo muri Gicurasi 2019, ANC iyobowe na we yabonye amajwi 57,50%, amanota yo hasi kurusha ayo yari yarigeze kubona kugeza icyo gihe ; ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2019, Inteko yongeye kumutora kuba perezida. Ku ya 10 Gashyantare 2020, yafashe ubuyobozi bw'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe, asimbuye Abdel Fattah al-Sissi. Yayoboye kandi uburyo igihugu cyahanganye n'icyorezo cya COVID-19, ndetse n'imyivumbagatanyo ya 2021, yabaye mibi kurusha izindi kuva "apartheid" irangiye.
Ku ya 11 Kanama 2021, imbere ya komisiyo yakoraga iperereza kuri ruswa yo ku butegetsi bwa Zuma, yemeye ko icyo gihe ruswa yari yarashinze imizi mu nzego za leta.
Manda ya kabiri (kuva mu 2024).
Mu matora rusange ya 2024, ANC yabonye amajwi 40,18% gusa, itakaza ubwiganze busesuye bwa mbere kuva "apartheid" irangiye; ishyaka rishya Umkhonto we Sizwe (MK) rya Jacob Zuma ryabaye irya gatatu. Ku ya 14 Kamena 2024, Inteko yongeye gutorera Ramaphosa kuba perezida, ashyigikiwe n'ishyaka rya Democratic Alliance n'andi mashyaka, maze ashyiraho guverinoma y'ubumwe bw'igihugu. Yarahiriye ku ya 19 Kamena 2024 i Pretoria.
Muri Mutarama 2025, yasinye itegeko ryemerera leta kwambura ubutaka nta ngurane mu bihe bimwe, risimbura itegeko rya 1975 ryasabaga ko ba nyir'ubutaka bahabwa ingurane; iryo tegeko ryateje impaka ndetse no muri guverinoma ye. Muri uko kwezi, imiryango 25 y'abakorewe ibyaha mu gihe cya "apartheid" yareze guverinoma ye, iyishinja kudakora iperereza rihagije kuri ibyo byaha.
Ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 2025, nyuma y'uko Madagasikari yeguye ku buyobozi bw'Umuryango w'Iterambere ry'Afurika y'Amajyepfo (SADC), Ramaphosa yahawe kuwuyobora by'agateganyo.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga nka perezida yarukoreye muri Angola muri Werurwe 2018. Ku ya 20 Werurwe 2018, yasuye Kigali, mu Rwanda, ahura na Perezida Paul Kagame baganira ku kuzahura umubano w'ibihugu byombi, maze ku munsi ukurikiyeho asinya amasezerano ya Kigali ashyiraho isoko rusange ry'Afurika (ZLECAf). Muri Nyakanga 2018, yakiriye inama y'ibihugu bya BRICS i Johannesburg.
Nyuma y'igitero cy'Uburusiya muri Ukraine mu 2022, Ramaphosa yanze kwamagana Uburusiya cyangwa kubufatira ibihano, avuga ko kutagira aho abogamira ari ngombwa ngo abashe guhuza impande zombi. Muri Kamena 2023, yayoboye intumwa z'abakuru b'ibihugu by'Afurika zasuye Kyiv na Saint-Pétersbourg zitwaje umugambi w'amahoro, ariko Perezida Vladimir Putin awanga.
Ramaphosa yasabye ko intambara ya Gaza ihagarara, anenga ikumira ry'ibiribwa n'ibindi bikenerwa muri Gaza. Ku ya 29 Ukuboza 2023, Afurika y'Epfo yareze Isirayeli mu Rukiko Mpuzamahanga rw'Ubutabera (CIJ), iyishinja jenoside.
Muri Mutarama 2025, nyuma y'urupfu rw'abasirikare 13 b'Afurika y'Epfo bari mu butumwa bw'amahoro mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Minisitiri w'Ingabo wa Afurika y'Epfo yavuze ko Ramaphosa yari yaburiye Leta y'u Rwanda ko ibitero bikomeje byafatwa nk'«itangazwa ry'intambara». Ramaphosa yanditse ku rubuga rwa X ashinja ingabo z'u Rwanda kuba ari zo zabishe ; Leta y'u Rwanda yarabihakanye.
Ku ya 21 Gicurasi 2025, Ramaphosa yakiriwe muri White House na Perezida Donald Trump, mu gihe umubano w'ibihugu byombi wari warajemo agatotsi nyuma y'uko Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika zihaye ubuhungiro Abanyafurika y'Epfo b'Abazungu (Abafurikaneri) 59, zivuga ko batotezwa, ndetse no kubera itegeko ryo kwambura ubutaka.
Muri Kamena 2019, hatangijwe iperereza ku nkunga yahawe n'ikigo cy'ubucuruzi mu gihe cyo kwiyamamariza kuyobora ANC mu 2017. Yahuye kandi n'abamurwanya muri ANC, bari bagishyigikiye Jacob Zuma.
Muri Kamena 2022, uwahoze ari umuyobozi mukuru w'ubutasi yatanze ikirego amushinja ko muri Gashyantare 2020 yahishe ubujura bwabereye mu murima we wa Phala Phala, aho abajura bari bibye amadolari menshi yari ahishwe mu ntebe. Mu Ugushyingo 2022, komisiyo y'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yavuze ko hari impamvu zihagije zo kuganira ku kumweguza, ariko muri Werurwe 2023 umuvunyi ("Public Protector") yavuze ko nta mategeko yishe. Mu Ukwakira 2024, amashyaka abiri atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi yitabaje Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga asaba ko iyo dosiye isubukurwa. Muri Nyakanga 2026, urukiko rwahagaritse by'agateganyo inzira yo kumweguza yari yatangijwe n'Inteko, mu gihe ategereje igisubizo ku cyifuzo cye cyo kujuririra raporo ivuga ko yaba yarishe Itegeko Nshinga.
Ramaphosa yashakanye na Tshepo Motsepe, mushiki w'umuherwe Patrice Motsepe; afite abana bane. Ikinyamakuru "Forbes" cyamushyize mu bacuruzi bakize kurusha abandi mu gihugu, kandi ni we Munyafurika y'Epfo w'Umwirabura wa mbere wabaye umuherwe ufite miliyari.

Salva Kiir Mayardit (yavutse ku ya 13 Nzeri 1951 i Akon, mu karere ka Gogrial) ni umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Sudani y’Amajyepfo, Perezida wa mbere w'icyo gihugu kuva cyabona ubwigenge ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2011. Akomoka mu bwoko bw'Abadinka. Yinjiye mu nyeshyamba za Anyanya mu ntambara ya mbere y'abenegihugu ya Sudani, hanyuma aba umwungirije wa John Garang mu mutwe wa Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) mu ntambara ya kabiri. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Garang mu 2005, yamusimbuye ku buyobozi bwa SPLA, aba Perezida w'akarere kigenga ka Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Visi-Perezida wa mbere wa Sudani kugeza mu 2011. Ubutegetsi bwe bwaranzwe n'intambara y'abenegihugu yatangiye mu 2013 hagati y'abamushyigikiye n'aba Riek Machar wahoze ari visi-perezida we, yahitanye abantu bagera ku 400 000, ndetse n'ibirego bikomeye byo guhohotera uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Salva Kiir yavukiye mu mudugudu wa Akon, mu muryango w'aborozi b'Abadinka bo mu gace ka Awan-Chan, mu karere ka Gogrial, muri leta ya Warrap; icyo gihe ako gace kari mu Sudani yategekwaga n'Abongereza n'Abanyamisiri. Ni uwa munani mu bana icyenda ba nyina (abahungu batandatu n'abakobwa batatu). Se, Kuethpiny Thiik Atem (wapfuye mu 2007), yari umworozi w'inka wo mu muryango wa Payum, akagira abagore batatu n'abana 16; nyina, Awiei Rou Wol, yari umuhinzi wo mu muryango wa Payii.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Mu 1967, Kiir yinjiye mu nyeshyamba za Anyanya zarwaniraga ubwigenge bw'amajyepfo ya Sudani mu ntambara ya mbere y'abenegihugu. Ubwo amasezerano ya Addis Abeba yasinywaga mu 1972, yari umusirikare mukuru wo ku rwego rwo hasi, maze yinjizwa mu ngabo za Sudani nk'uko ayo masezerano yabiteganyaga. Mu 1983, ubwo intambara ya kabiri y'abenegihugu yadukaga, yinjiye mu mutwe wa Sudan People's Liberation Movement (SPLM) washinzwe na John Garang n'ingabo zawo, SPLA, aba umwungirije wa Garang. Mu 1997, yayoboye ingabo za SPLA mu gitero cyiswe "Operation Thunderbolt", cyatumye SPLA yigarurira igice kinini cy'intara ya Equatoria y'Iburengerazuba. Mu 2004, ibihuha by'uko yaba agiye kuvanwa ku mwanya w'umugaba mukuru wa SPLA byenda gucamo uwo mutwe ibice.
Nyuma y'amasezerano y'amahoro rusange ("Comprehensive Peace Agreement") yo muri Mutarama 2005, Garang yabaye Visi-Perezida wa Sudani, ariko apfa azize impanuka y'indege ya kajugujugu ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2005. Ku ya 11 Kanama 2005, Kiir yamusimbuye, aba Perezida w'akarere kigenga ka Sudani y'Amajyepfo na Visi-Perezida wa mbere wa Repubulika ya Sudani. Yafatwaga nk'uharanira ubwigenge kurusha Garang. Mu Ukwakira 2009, yavuze ko kamarampaka yari iteganyijwe izaba ari uguhitamo hagati yo kuba «umuturage wo ku rwego rwa kabiri mu gihugu cyawe» cyangwa «umuntu wigenga mu gihugu cyawe kigenga».
Mu matora ya Mata 2010, yongeye gutorerwa kuyobora Sudani y'Amajyepfo n'amajwi 93%; nubwo ayo matora yanenzwe n'indorerezi mpuzamahanga, iyo tsinzi yafashwe nk'intambwe ya mbere iganisha ku kwigenga. Perezida Omar El Bechir yongeye kumugira Visi-Perezida wa mbere wa Sudani.
Perezida wa Sudani y'Amajyepfo.
Muri kamarampaka yabaye kuva ku ya 9 kugeza ku ya 15 Mutarama 2011, 98,83% by'abatoye bahisemo ubwigenge. Ku ya 9 Nyakanga 2011, Sudani y'Amajyepfo yabaye igihugu cyigenga, Kiir aba Perezida wacyo wa mbere. Mu ijambo rye ry'irahira, yasabye abaturage «kubabarira nubwo tutazibagirwa» akarengane bakorewe na Sudani y'amajyaruguru, anatangaza imbabazi rusange ku mitwe yari yararwanyije SPLM. Nyuma y'ibyumweru bike, yaburiye abasirikare n'abapolisi ko gufata ku ngufu, iyicarubozo n'ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu bizakurikiranwa n'inkiko.
Politiki y'imbere mu gihugu.
Muri Kamena 2013, yahagaritse ku mirimo abaminisitiri babiri bakekwagaho ruswa. Kuva mu mpera za 2012, nyuma y'ibihuha by'umugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi, yavuguruye mu buryo butigeze bubaho ubuyobozi bwa guverinoma, ishyaka n'ingabo, yirukana abajenerali benshi. Muri Nyakanga 2013, yasheshe guverinoma yose, yirukana na Visi-Perezida Riek Machar, wari watangaje ko azahatanira umwanya wa perezida mu matora ya 2015. Machar yavuze ko iyo ari intambwe igana ku gitugu.
Hagati y'Ukuboza 2011 na Gashyantare 2012, imirwano hagati y'Abanuweri ba Lou n'Abamurle yahitanye abantu bagera kuri 800; kubura ubutabera kuri ubwo bwicanyi byanenzwe cyane. Ku butegetsi bwe kandi, abanyamakuru benshi barishwe: mu 2015, umunyamakuru Moi Peter Julius yarashwe i Juba, iminsi itatu nyuma y'uko Kiir avuga mu ruhame amagambo yafashwe nk'iterabwoba ku banyamakuru, kandi abanyamakuru batanu ba radiyo Raja FM bishwe mu gitero cyagabwe ku modoka bari barimo. Muri Mutarama 2023, abakozi batandatu b'ikigo cy'igihugu cy'itangazamakuru batawe muri yombi nyuma y'ikwirakwizwa ry'amashusho yerekana perezida mu muhango wo gutaha umuhanda, amashusho yateje impungenge ku buzima bwe; barekuwe nta cyaha baregwa.
Intambara y'abenegihugu.
Ku ya 15 Ukuboza 2013, nyuma y'inama y'ishyaka SPLM, imirwano yadukiye i Juba mu ngabo zirinda perezida. Bukeye, Kiir yashinje Machar n'abandi bayobozi gutegura kudeta, ibyo Machar yahakanye. Ibyo byabaye intangiriro y'intambara y'abenegihugu, yarimo n'amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko hagati y'Abadinka (ubwoko bwa Kiir) n'Abanuweri (ubwoko bwa Machar). Kugeza muri Mata 2018, iyo ntambara yari imaze guhitana abantu bagera ku 400 000. Mu 2017, ibice bimwe by'igihugu byibasiwe n'inzara, imiryango mpuzamahanga ivuga ko yatewe n'abantu kubera intambara ; abayobozi ba Loni bashinje guverinoma ya Kiir kubuza ko ibiribwa bigera mu duce tumwe.
Nyuma y'amasezerano y'agahenge yasinywe i Khartoum muri Kamena 2018, byemejwe ko Machar asubira ku mwanya wa Visi-Perezida wa mbere. Muri Nyakanga 2018, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yongereye manda ya Kiir imyaka itatu, kugeza mu 2021. Muri Kanama 2018, andi masezerano yasinyiwe i Khartoum yashyizeho guverinoma y'inzibacyuho, Kiir aha imbabazi Machar n'indi mitwe yitwaje intwaro, maze ku ya 12 Nzeri 2018 amasezerano y'amahoro asinyirwa i Addis Abeba. Nyuma y'ibiganiro byinshi, guverinoma y'ubumwe bw'igihugu yashyizweho ku ya 12 Werurwe 2020.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Mu Ukwakira 2011, Kiir yatangaje ko Sudani y'Amajyepfo isabye kwinjira mu Muryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba (EAC). Mu Ukuboza 2011, yasuye Isirayeli ayishimira inkunga yahaye inyeshyamba mu ntambara ya mbere y'abenegihugu.
Muri Werurwe 2012, ingabo za Sudani y'Amajyepfo zateye ikigo cy'ubucukuzi bwa peteroli cya Heglig, ku mupaka na Sudani, bituma habaho intambara ngufi ku mupaka. Ku ya 27 Nzeri 2012, Kiir na Perezida Omar El Bechir basinyiye i Addis Abeba amasezerano umunani yatumye ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bya peteroli bisubukurwa, hashyirwaho n'agace katarimo ingabo ku mupaka.
Nyuma y'itangira ry'intambara y'abenegihugu, Kiir yashinje Umuryango w'Abibumbye n'imiryango y'ubutabazi gushyigikira Machar. Ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2023, yatorewe kuyobora Umuryango w'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe. Ku ya 5 Nyakanga 2023, yari yatangaje ko aziyamamariza amatora ya perezida.
Kiir ni Umukristo Gatolika. Mu 2006, ubwo yasuraga White House, Perezida George W. Bush yamuhaye ingofero y'umukara yo mu bwoko bwa "stetson"; kuva icyo gihe, ntajya agaragara mu ruhame atayambaye.

Abdel Fattah al-Burhan Abdelrahman al-Burhan (yavutse ku ya 11 Nyakanga 1960 i Gandatu) ni umusirikare mukuru wa Sudani, uyoboye icyo gihugu kuva mu 2019. Nyuma y'impinduramatwara yo muri Mata 2019 yahiritse Perezida Omar El Bechir, yagizwe umuyobozi w'akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho, hanyuma ayobora Inama y'Ubusugire y'Inzibacyuho yari ihuriweho n'abasirikare n'abasivili. Mu Ukwakira 2021, yakoze kudeta ihirika guverinoma ya gisivili ya Minisitiri w'Intebe Abdallah Hamdok, maze yongera gushyiraho Inama y'Ubusugire ayobora. Kuva muri Mata 2023, ayoboye ingabo za Sudani mu ntambara y'abenegihugu zihanganyemo n'umutwe wa Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Mu Mutarama 2025, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika zamufatiye ibihano.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Abdel Fattah al-Burhan yavutse mu 1960 mu mudugudu wa Gandatu, mu majyaruguru ya Khartoum, mu muryango w'Abasufi wo mu bwoko bw'Abajaalin. Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye iwabo n'i Shendi, hanyuma yinjira mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Sudani. Yakurikiye amahugurwa ya gisirikare mu Misiri no muri Yorudaniya.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Al-Burhan yatangiye ari umusirikare mu ngabo zirinda imipaka, aza kuziyobora; yarwanye mu ntambara ya Darfur no mu ntambara ya kabiri y'abenegihugu ya Sudani, anaba umuyobozi w'ingabo mu karere ka Darfur. Yabaye umugaba wungirije w'ibikorwa by'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka, hanyuma mu 2018 aba umugaba w'ingabo zirwanira ku butaka. Yateguye kohereza ingabo za Sudani muri Yemeni mu ntambara y'abenegihugu yaho, akaba ari na we wahuzaga Sudani na Arabiya Sawudite na Nyarabu Zunze Ubumwe. Muri Gashyantare 2019, mu gihe cy'imyigaragambyo yamaganaga ubutegetsi bwa Omar El Bechir, yagizwe umugenzuzi mukuru w'ingabo, ahabwa ipeti rya jenerali liyetona.
Ubuyobozi bw'inzibacyuho.
Akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho.
Ku ya 12 Mata 2019, al-Burhan yasimbuye Ahmed Awad Ibn Auf ku buyobozi bw'akanama ka gisirikare k'inzibacyuho kari kamaze gushyirwaho nyuma yo guhirika Omar El Bechir. Bitandukanye n'uwo yasimbuye, ntiyafatwaga nk'inkingi y'ubutegetsi bwa kera. Yategetse ko abari bafunzwe na El Bechir barekurwa, kandi yizeza ko inzibacyuho itazarenza imyaka ibiri. Urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga yarukoreye mu Misiri, ahura na Perezida Abdel Fattah al-Sissi, hanyuma muri Nyarabu Zunze Ubumwe.
Ku ya 3 Kamena 2019, inzego z'umutekano, zirimo umutwe wa RSF, zatatanyije ku ngufu abigaragambyaga bari bakambitse imbere y'icyicaro gikuru cy'ingabo i Khartoum. Abantu benshi bararashwe, imirambo imwe iterwa mu ruzi rwa Nili, kandi imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu yavuze ko abantu amagana bakorewe iyicarubozo n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina. Nyuma y'ubwo bwicanyi, ibiganiro n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi byarahagaze, kandi interineti irahagarikwa, ibyo Human Rights Watch yise «ihohoterwa rikomeye ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu».
Inama y'Ubusugire y'Inzibacyuho.
Ku ya 20 Kanama 2019, nyuma y'amasezerano hagati y'abasirikare n'ihuriro ry'abasivili, hashyizweho Inama y'Ubusugire y'Inzibacyuho igizwe n'abantu cumi n'umwe, iyobowe na al-Burhan; yarahiye bukeye bwaho. Amasezerano y'amahoro ya Juba yo mu Ukwakira 2020 yongereye igihe cy'inzibacyuho, bituma al-Burhan akomeza kuyobora iyo nama aho kuyivaho muri 2021 nk'uko byari biteganyijwe.
Muri Gashyantare 2020, al-Burhan yahuriye i Entebbe, muri Ubugande, na Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Isirayeli Benjamin Netanyahu. Yagize uruhare rukomeye mu isubukurwa ry'umubano hagati ya Sudani na Isirayeli, ryemejwe ku ya 23 Ukwakira 2020, nubwo ritavugwagaho rumwe muri guverinoma no mu baturage; yarisobanuraga avuga inyungu z'ubukungu, cyane cyane kuvanwa kwa Sudani ku rutonde rw'Amerika rw'ibihugu bishyigikira iterabwoba.
Ku ya 25 Ukwakira 2021, al-Burhan yayoboye kudeta yahiritse guverinoma ya gisivili: Minisitiri w'Intebe Abdallah Hamdok n'abaminisitiri benshi barafashwe, hatangazwa ibihe bidasanzwe, interineti irahagarikwa, kandi imyigaragambyo ishyigikira ubutegetsi bwa gisivili iramagurwa. Ku ya 11 Ugushyingo 2021, yashyizeho Inama y'Ubusugire nshya ayobora. Ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 2021, Hamdok yasubijwe ku mwanya we ku bw'amasezerano n'amashyaka y'abasivili, ariko yegura muri Mutarama 2022. Mu mwaka wakurikiye kudeta, abigaragambyaga 117 barishwe.
Nyuma ya kudeta, al-Burhan yashyize abayoboke b'imitwe ya Kisilamu bari bakomeye ku butegetsi bwa El Bechir mu nzego z'ubutegetsi, cyane cyane mu ngabo. Muri Gashyantare 2023, yahuye na Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga w'Uburusiya, Sergey Lavrov.
Intambara y'abenegihugu.
Ku ya 15 Mata 2023, umutwe wa Rapid Support Forces (RSF) uyobowe na Jenerali Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo «Hemedti», wari umwungirije, wagabye ibitero ku birindiro by'ingabo mu gihugu hose, uvuga ko wigaruriye ingoro ya perezida n'ikibuga cy'indege cya Khartoum. Al-Burhan yamaze amezi menshi agotewe ku cyicaro gikuru cy'ingabo i Khartoum, kugeza muri Kanama 2023 ubwo yavanwagayo akajya i Port-Soudan, aho guverinoma ye ikorera kuva icyo gihe. Bivugwa ko RSF yahawe inkunga na Libiya, Nyarabu Zunze Ubumwe n'umutwe w'Abarusiya wa Wagner.
Muri Nyakanga 2024, al-Burhan yarokotse igitero cy'indege itagira umupilote cyagabwe ku kigo cya gisirikare cya Gebeit, aho yari yitabiriye umuhango wo gusoza amasomo y'abasirikare; abantu batanu barapfuye.
Ku ya 16 Mutarama 2025, Minisiteri y'Imari ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika yamufatiye ibihano, imushinja kwibasira abasivili n'ibikorwa remezo byabo, kubuza ubutabazi kugera ku baturage, kwanga kwitabira ibiganiro by'amahoro no guhungabanya inzira igana ku butegetsi bwa gisivili. Muri Kanama 2025, intumwa ye yasuye Isirayeli igamije kwihutisha ivugururwa ry'umubano w'ibihugu byombi.
Al-Burhan afite umugore n'abana batatu. Ku ya 6 Werurwe 2024, umuhungu we, Mohammed, yakomeretse bikomeye mu mpanuka y'ipikipiki i Ankara, muri Turukiya, apfa ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2024.

Samia Suluhu Hassan (yavutse ku ya 27 Mutarama 1960 muri Zanzibar) ni umunyapolitiki wa Tanzaniya, Perezida wa gatandatu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 19 Werurwe 2021. Ni we mugore wa mbere wabaye Perezida wa Tanzaniya. Umuyoboke w'ishyaka riri ku butegetsi rya Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM), yabanje kuba minisitiri muri guverinoma ya Zanzibar (2000–2010), hanyuma aba umudepite na Minisitiri wa Leta ushinzwe ibibazo by'Ubumwe (2010–2015). Mu 2015, yabaye umugore wa mbere wabaye Visi-Perezida wa Tanzaniya, iruhande rwa John Magufuli, maze amusimbura nyuma y'urupfu rwe muri Werurwe 2021. Mu ntangiriro ya manda ye, yafatwaga nk'umuntu uharanira impinduka n'ubwisanzure, ariko amatora ya 2025, yatsinze n'amajwi 97,66% nyuma y'uko ishyaka rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ribujijwe kwitabira, yakurikiwe n'imyigaragambyo yahosheshejwe ku ngufu, bituma ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa n'abasesenguzi benshi nk'ubw'igitugu.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Samia Suluhu yavutse ku ya 27 Mutarama 1960 muri Sultani ya Zanzibar, ku mwarimu n'umugore we; nyuma y'imyaka ine, Zanzibar yihuje na Tanganyika bibyara Tanzaniya. Yarangije amashuri yisumbuye mu 1977, atangira gukora nk'umwanditsi mu biro, muri Minisiteri y'Igenamigambi n'Iterambere.
Yakomeje amasomo igihe gito: mu 1986, yabonye impamyabumenyi mu buyobozi bwa leta mu ishuri rikuru ry'imicungire y'iterambere (ubu ni Mzumbe University). Kuva mu 1992 kugeza mu 1994, yize muri Kaminuza ya Manchester, mu Bwongereza, abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya nyuma ya kaminuza mu bukungu. Mu 2015, yabonye impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu iterambere ry'ubukungu bw'abaturage, binyuze muri gahunda ihuriweho na Open University of Tanzania na Southern New Hampshire University.
Mu 1988, yabaye umukozi ushinzwe iterambere muri guverinoma ya Zanzibar, hanyuma ayobora umushinga w'Ishami rya Loni ryita ku biribwa (PAM). Mu myaka ya 1990, yayoboye urwego rugenzura imiryango itegamiye kuri leta muri Zanzibar.
Mu 2000, Samia Suluhu yinjiye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Zanzibar ku rutonde rwa CCM, maze Perezida Amani Abeid Karume amugira Minisitiri w'Umurimo w'Urubyiruko, Abagore n'Abana. Muri uwo mwanya, yakuyeho itegeko ryabuzaga abakobwa babyaye gusubira mu ishuri. Ni we mugore wenyine wari minisitiri ukomeye muri guverinoma, kandi bagenzi be b'abagabo bakunze kutamuha agaciro kubera ko ari umugore. Mu 2005, yongeye gutorwa, agirwa Minisitiri w'Ubukerarugendo, Ubucuruzi n'Ishoramari.
Mu 2010, yatorewe kuba umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'igihugu, uhagarariye Makunduchi, n'amajwi arenga 80%. Perezida Jakaya Kikwete yamugize Minisitiri wa Leta ushinzwe ibibazo by'Ubumwe. Mu 2014, yatorewe kuba visi-perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Itegeko Nshinga yari ishinzwe gutegura Itegeko Nshinga rishya.
Muri Nyakanga 2015, umukandida wa CCM ku mwanya wa perezida, John Magufuli, yamuhisemo nk'umukandida ku mwanya wa visi-perezida, bitunguranye kuko hari abanyapolitiki bakomeye kurusha we ; ni we mugore wa mbere wahawe uwo mwanya mu mateka y'ishyaka. Batsinze amatora, maze ku ya 5 Ugushyingo 2015 arahirira kuba umugore wa mbere ubaye Visi-Perezida wa Tanzaniya. Mu 2020, bongeye gutorwa, nubwo indorerezi zigenga zavuze ko habayeho uburiganya.
Perezida wa Tanzaniya.
Ku ya 17 Werurwe 2021, Samia Suluhu yatangaje kuri televiziyo urupfu rwa Perezida Magufuli, wari umaze igihe atagaragara mu ruhame. Yarahiriye kuba perezida ku ya 19 Werurwe 2021, kugira ngo arangize manda ya kabiri ya Magufuli. Bivugwa ko hari ibice by'ishyaka byagerageje kumubuza kuba perezida. Yabaye umugore wa mbere uyoboye Tanzaniya, n'umuntu wa kabiri ukomoka muri Zanzibar ubaye perezida, nyuma ya Ali Hassan Mwinyi. Yagize Philip Mpango Visi-Perezida, yirukana abari inkoramutima za Magufuli, kandi yegera uwahoze ari Perezida Jakaya Kikwete.
Bitandukanye n'uwo yasimbuye wahakanaga uburemere bw'icyorezo cya COVID-19, Samia Suluhu yafashe ingamba zo kukirwanya: yategetse akato k'iminsi 14 ku bagenzi baturuka mu bihugu byagaragayemo ubwoko bushya bwa virusi, maze muri Nyakanga 2021 Tanzaniya yinjira muri gahunda ya COVAX yo gukingira. Yiyemeje kurangiza imishinga minini yatangijwe na Magufuli, irimo umuhanda wa gari ya moshi n'urugomero rw'amashanyarazi, no kugeza amashanyarazi n'amazi meza mu byaro. Yashyize imbere ubukerarugendo n'ishoramari ry'abanyamahanga, ndetse mu 2021 akina muri filime "The Royal Tour" igamije kumenyekanisha Tanzaniya. Mu 2022, ikinyamakuru "Time" cyamushyize mu bantu 100 bavuga rikijyana ku isi.
Mu ntangiriro ya manda ye, yafatwaga nk'umuntu uharanira demokarasi kurusha Magufuli. Yarekuye imfungwa za politiki, ahura n'abayobozi b'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, kandi yemerera ibinyamakuru byari byarafunzwe kongera gukora. Umuyobozi w'ishyaka rya Chadema, Freeman Mbowe, wari wafashwe muri 2021 ashinjwa iterabwoba, yararekuwe ibyaha bivanwaho, maze muri Werurwe 2022 ahura na perezida. Muri Gashyantare 2022, i Buruseli, yahuye na Tundu Lissu, umukandida wa Chadema mu matora ya 2020 wari mu buhungiro. Mu 2023, yakuyeho itegeko ryabuzaga amashyaka gukora inama rusange. Muri Kanama 2021, amagambo yavuze ku isura y'abakinnyi b'umupira w'amaguru b'abagore yateje impaka.
Amatora ya 2025 n'igitugu.
Muri Mutarama 2025, CCM yamutanze nk'umukandida wayo mu matora rusange yo mu Ukwakira 2025. Ishyaka rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Chadema, ryabujijwe kwitabira amatora, kandi umuyobozi waryo, Tundu Lissu, arafatwa ashinjwa ubugambanyi. Yatangajwe nk'uwatsinze amatora n'amajwi agera kuri 97%, maze ku ya 3 Ugushyingo 2025 arahira mu muhango utarimo abaturage. Indorerezi z'Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe zavuze ko ayo matora atubahirije amahame y'akarere n'ay'isi.
Ibyavuye mu matora byakurikiwe n'imyigaragambyo n'imvururu zahosheshejwe ku ngufu, interineti irahagarikwa. Imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu yashinje guverinoma ye gutegeka ko abasivili baraswa amasasu nyayo; Chadema yavuze ko yabaruye abantu bagera ku 1 000 bishwe, yita ibyo byaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Raporo za Loni zavuze ko abantu amagana bapfuye. Guverinoma yemeye ko hari abapfuye, ariko ivuga ko imibare y'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi «ikabije cyane».
Abasesenguzi benshi babona ko ubutegetsi bwe bwahindutse ubw'igitugu ; "The Economist" yavuze mu 2025 ko abantu benshi batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi baburiwe irengero. Muri Mutarama 2026, umuryango Index on Censorship wamwise «Umunyagitugu w'umwaka wa 2025» kubera ihonyorwa ry'ubwisanzure bwo kuvuga.
Itegeko Nshinga rya Tanzaniya ntirimwemerera kongera kwiyamamaza mu 2030, kuko yabaye perezida asimbuye uwari ku butegetsi hasigaye imyaka irenga itatu ngo manda irangire.
Mu 1978, Samia Suluhu yashakanye na Hafidh Ameir Hassan, impuguke mu buhinzi; bafitanye abahungu batatu n'umukobwa umwe. Umukobwa wabo, Mwanu Hafidh Ameir, ni umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Zanzibar. Umugabo we yapfuye azize indwara y'umutima ku ya 7 Nzeri 2026, ashyingurwa i Kizimkazi, muri Zanzibar.

Jean-Lucien Kwassi Lanyo Savi de Tové (yavutse ku ya 7 Gicurasi 1939 i Lomé) ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'umukozi wa leta wa Togo, Perezida wa gatanu w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2025. Yahoze ari umwe mu batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, afungwa ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Gnassingbé Eyadéma, hanyuma aza kwinjira muri guverinoma nka Minisitiri w'Ubucuruzi, Inganda n'Ubukorikori kuva mu 2005 kugeza mu 2007. Yabaye visi-perezida w'ishyaka rya Convergence patriotique panafricaine (CPP). Mu Gicurasi 2025, nyuma y'ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga ryahinduye Togo igihugu kiyoborwa n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, yatowe n'Inteko ku bwumvikane bwa bose ku mwanya wa perezida, ubu wabaye uw'icyubahiro, mu gihe ububasha bwinshi bwahawe Perezida w'Inama y'Abaminisitiri, Faure Gnassingbé. Afite imyaka 86, ni we muntu ukuze kurusha abandi wabaye Perezida wa Togo.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Savi de Tové yavukiye i Lomé, mu muryango w'Abewe. Yize amategeko muri Kaminuza ya Bordeaux, mu Ubufaransa, hanyuma abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu bumenyi bwa politiki muri Sorbonne, n'impamyabumenyi mu bushakashatsi ku iterambere ry'ubukungu muri Kaminuza ya Naples, mu Butaliyani.
Nyuma ya kudeta ya gisirikare yo muri Mutarama 1967, ku ya 6 Gashyantare 1967 yagizwe umunyamabanga mukuru wa Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga, afite imyaka 28. Mu 1969, ubwo Perezida Gnassingbé Eyadéma yashingaga ishyaka rimwe ryonyine ryemewe, Rassemblement du peuple togolais (RPT), Savi de Tové yararyinjiyemo. Mu 1974 no mu 1975, yasimbuwe ku mwanya w'umunyamabanga mukuru.
Ashinjwa kugira uruhare mu mugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi hamwe n'abandi banyapolitiki barimo Gilchrist Olympio, ku ya 12 Nyakanga 1979 yasohorewe impapuro zo kumuta muri yombi, arafungwa. Muri Kanama 1979, we n'abandi bantu bane bahamwe n'icyaha, akatirwa igifungo cy'imyaka icumi.
Mu 1986, yavuye muri RPT, maze yitabira imyigaragambyo ya 1990–1991 yasabaga ko amashyaka menshi yemerwa. Amashyaka menshi amaze kwemerwa mu 1991, yashinze ishyaka rya Parti des démocrates pour l'unité (PDU), kandi agira uruhare rukomeye mu Nama y'Igihugu yo muri Nyakanga–Kanama 1991 yashyizeho guverinoma y'inzibacyuho.
Ku ya 22 Werurwe 1993, mu nama yabereye i Cotonou, muri Bene, ihuriro ry'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi ryamutanze nka Minisitiri w'Intebe mu mwanya wa Joseph Kokou Koffigoh, ryashinjaga gukorana cyane na Perezida Eyadéma ; ariko guverinoma yanze iryo shyirwaho. Mu 1994, yiyamamarije kuba umudepite nk'umukandida wigenga, ariko ntiyatorwa.
Mu 1999, PDU yihuje n'andi mashyaka abiri, UTD na UTS, bibyara ishyaka rya Convergence patriotique panafricaine (CPP) riyobowe na Edem Kodjo, maze Savi de Tové aba visi-perezida wa mbere waryo. Muri Kamena 2005, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ubucuruzi, Inganda n'Ubukorikori, akomeza kuri uwo mwanya muri guverinoma ya Yawovi Agboyibo. Mu izina rya CPP, yasinye amasezerano ya politiki yasoje ibiganiro hagati y'Abanyatogo byo mu 2006. Mu matora y'abadepite yo mu Ukwakira 2007, yari uwa mbere ku rutonde rwa CPP mu karere ka Zio, ariko ishyaka ntiryabona umwanya n'umwe. Mu Ukuboza 2007, yavanywe muri guverinoma. Ku ya 27 Gicurasi 2009, yagizwe perezida w'urwego ruhoraho rw'ibiganiro n'ubwumvikane (CPDC).
Muri Gicurasi 2024, Togo yemeje Itegeko Nshinga rishya ryahinduye igihugu kiyoborwa na perezida kikaba kiyoborwa n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Ububasha bwinshi bwa perezida bwahawe umwanya mushya wa Perezida w'Inama y'Abaminisitiri, naho umwanya wa Perezida wa Repubulika uba uw'icyubahiro, utorwa n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko kuri manda y'imyaka ine ishobora kongerwa rimwe.
Ku ya 3 Gicurasi 2025, Savi de Tové yatowe ku bwumvikane bwa bose n'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko n'Inteko Nshingamategeko (Sena) bahuriye hamwe. Yarahiye uwo munsi, aba perezida wa mbere wa Repubulika ya Gatanu ya Togo, asimbura Faure Gnassingbé wabaye Perezida w'Inama y'Abaminisitiri, akaba ari we ufite ububasha bwinshi bw'ubuyobozi. Kubera ko yarahiye habura iminsi ine ngo yuzuze imyaka 86, ni we perezida ukuze kurusha abandi mu mateka ya Togo.

Kaïs Saïed (mu Cyarabu: قيس سعيد; yavutse ku ya 22 Gashyantare 1958 i Tunis) ni umunyapolitiki akaba n'impuguke mu mategeko nshinga wa Tunisiya, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 23 Ukwakira 2019. Yamaze imyaka myinshi ari umwarimu w'amategeko muri kaminuza, ndetse n'umwe mu bayobozi b'ishyirahamwe ry'Abanyatunisiya b'impuguke mu mategeko nshinga. Mu 2019, yiyamamaje nk'umukandida wigenga, azwiho kuba inyangamugayo, maze atsinda icyiciro cya kabiri cy'amatora n'amajwi 72,7%. Mu Nyakanga 2021, mu bihe by'ihagarara rya politiki n'icyorezo cya COVID-19, yiyambuye ububasha bwose, yirukana guverinoma kandi ahagarika Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, nyuma arayisesa, ibyo abamurwanya n'abasesenguzi benshi bise kudeta. Mu 2022, yakuyeho Itegeko Nshinga rya 2014, ashyiraho irindi ryemejwe na kamarampaka, riha ububasha bwinshi umukuru w'igihugu. Afatwa n'abenshi nk'umunyagitugu, yongeye gutorwa mu 2024 mu matora yaranzwe n'ubwitabire buke cyane.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Kaïs Saïed ni umuhungu wa Moncef Saïed, wari umukozi muri Minisiteri y'Imari, na Zakia Bellagha, wo mu muryango w'abakire b'i Tunis wari umugore wita ku rugo; umuryango we wari uwo mu cyiciro cyo hagati. Se wabo, Hicham Saïed, yabaye umuganga wa mbere ubaga abana muri Tunisiya. Yize amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rizwi rya Sadiki.
Saïed yize amategeko, akaba impuguke mu mategeko nshinga, nubwo atigeze abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga. Yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w'ishyirahamwe ry'Abanyatunisiya b'impuguke mu mategeko nshinga kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 1995, hanyuma visi-perezida waryo. Yayoboye ishami ry'amategeko ya leta muri Kaminuza ya Sousse kuva mu 1994 kugeza mu 1999, hanyuma yigisha mu ishami ry'ubumenyi bw'amategeko na politiki rya Tunis kuva mu 1999 kugeza agiye mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru mu 2018. Yanabaye impuguke mu bunyamabanga bukuru bw'Umuryango w'Ibihugu by'Abarabu (1989–1990) n'umwe mu bagize itsinda ry'impuguke ryasuzumye umushinga w'Itegeko Nshinga rya Tunisiya mu 2014.
Kwinjira muri politiki.
Saïed yagize uruhare mu mpinduramatwara ya Tunisiya yo mu 2010–2011. Ku ya 15 Mutarama 2011, umunsi umwe nyuma y'ihunga rya Perezida Zine el-Abidine Ben Ali, yasabye ko hashyirwaho inteko ishinga itegeko nshinga. Yashyigikiye ko Inteko Ishinga Amategeko isimburwa n'inteko igizwe n'abatowe mu buryo butaziguye, bashingiye ku turere, kandi bashobora kwamburwa manda yabo. Kuva mu 2013, yitabiriye inama nyinshi z'urubyiruko, maze mu 2016 hashingwa umutwe wa Mouassissoun wo gushyigikira imishinga ye.
Mu matora ya perezida ya 2019, Saïed yiyamamaje nk'umukandida wigenga, akoresha amafaranga make cyane, ashingira ku isura y'umuntu woroheje kandi uvuga Icyarabu cy'ubuvanganzo. Gahunda ye yibanze ku kurwanya ruswa no kubahiriza Itegeko Nshinga. Kubera imvugo ye itajegajega, bamwita «Robocop». Abenshi mu bamutoye bari urubyiruko rwize.
Yabaye uwa mbere mu cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 18,40%, akurikirwa n'umucuruzi Nabil Karoui (15,58%), wari ufunzwe. Mu cyiciro cya kabiri, yatsinze n'amajwi 72,71% kuri 27,29% ya Karoui. Nk'uko umusesenguzi Michaël Ayari abivuga, Saïed yagaragazaga ubunyangamugayo n'urugamba rwo kurwanya ruswa, n'ibyiringiro byatakaye byo mu 2011.
Perezida wa Tunisiya.
Intangiriro ya manda.
Ku ya 23 Ukwakira 2019, Saïed yarahiriye imbere y'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, yiyemeza kurwanya iterabwoba no kurinda uburenganzira bw'abagore, maze yakira ububasha bwa perezida ahawe na Mohamed Ennaceur wari perezida w'agateganyo. Yanze gutura mu ngoro ya perezida ya Carthage, ahitamo kuguma mu nzu ye bwite.
Yashinze Habib Jemli, umukandida w'ishyaka rya Kisilamu Ennahdha, gushyiraho guverinoma, ariko Inteko yanga guverinoma ye muri Mutarama 2020. Hanyuma yashyizeho Elyes Fakhfakh, wahawe icyizere n'Inteko ku ya 27 Gashyantare 2020, ariko yegura muri Nyakanga 2020. Ku ya 25 Nyakanga 2020, yashinze Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Imbere mu Gihugu, Hichem Mechichi, gushyiraho guverinoma, yemejwe ku ya 2 Nzeri 2020. Muri Mutarama 2021, yanze kwakira indahiro y'abaminisitiri bashya Mechichi yari yashyizeho, avuga ko bamwe bakekwagaho ruswa. Muri Mata 2021, yanze gushyira umukono ku itegeko ryashyiragaho Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga.
Iyigarurira ry'ububasha mu 2021.
Ku ya 25 Nyakanga 2021, umunsi w'Ibirori bya Repubulika, ibihumbi by'abigaragambyaga basabye iseswa ry'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, mu gihe icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyari gikomeje gukaza umurego. Muri iryo joro, yitwaje ingingo ya 80 y'Itegeko Nshinga, Saïed yirukanye guverinoma ya Mechichi, ahagarika imirimo y'Inteko, akuraho ubudahangarwa bw'abadepite, kandi atangaza ko azayobora igihugu akoresheje amateka. Ennahdha yahise ibyita «kudeta», kandi abasesenguzi benshi n'impuguke mu mategeko babyemeranyaho. Ku ya 22 Nzeri 2021, yemeje mu iteka ko yiyambitse ububasha bwo gushyiraho amategeko. Ku ya 29 Nzeri 2021, yashinze Najla Bouden gushyiraho guverinoma, aba umugore wa mbere ubaye Minisitiri w'Intebe muri Tunisiya no mu bihugu by'Abarabu.
Ku ya 30 Werurwe 2022, abadepite 120 bateraniye mu nama y'ikoranabuhanga batora ko ingamba zidasanzwe zihagarara; uwo munsi, Saïed yasheshe Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, anakangisha abadepite gukurikiranwa n'inkiko. Mu ntangiriro za 2023, polisi yafashe abantu benshi bo mu ihuriro rikomeye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, Front de salut national. Kubera ibyo, abenshi bamwita «perezida ufite ububasha bukabije» cyangwa umunyagitugu.
Itegeko Nshinga rya 2022.
Ku ya 30 Kamena 2022, Saïed yatangaje umushinga w'Itegeko Nshinga rishya riha ububasha bwinshi umukuru w'igihugu, kandi rivuga ko Isilamu ari intego ya leta n'isoko y'amategeko. Komisiyo Mpuzamahanga y'Abanyamategeko yavuze ko iyo nzira inyuranyije n'amategeko kandi itarimo ubunyangamugayo. Muri kamarampaka yo ku ya 25 Nyakanga 2022, abagera kuri 92–93% by'abatoye bemeje iryo Tegeko Nshinga, ariko ubwitabire bwari buke cyane.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Saïed afitanye umubano mwiza na Aligeriya ya Abdelmadjid Tebboune, yegera ibihugu by'Ikigobe nka Nyarabu Zunze Ubumwe, kandi ari hafi ya Perezida wa Misiri, Abdel Fattah al-Sissi. Muri Kanama 2022, yakiriye nk'umukuru w'igihugu Brahim Ghali, umuyobozi w'umutwe wa Polisario, bituma Maroke na Tunisiya bihamagaza ba ambasaderi babyo. Hagati ya 2023 na 2024, yakiriye kenshi Minisitiri w'Intebe w'Ubutaliyani, Giorgia Meloni, wageragezaga kumvikana na we ku bijyanye no kurwanya abimukira binjira mu Burayi mu buryo butemewe. Ku ya 12 Mata 2023, yasubukuye umubano wa dipolomasi na Siriya. Arwanya yivuye inyuma kugirana umubano na Isirayeli, avuga ko byaba ari «ubugambanyi bukomeye».
Mu matora ya perezida yo ku ya 6 Ukwakira 2024, Saïed yongeye gutorwa n'amajwi 90,69%. Muri Mata 2025, ibihano bikomeye by'igifungo byahawe abantu bagera kuri mirongo ine, barimo abanyapolitiki, abavoka n'abanyamakuru, mu rubanza rw'«umugambi wo guhungabanya umutekano wa leta», byanenzwe n'Ibiro bya Komiseri Mukuru wa Loni ushinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu, kimwe n'Ubufaransa n'Ubudage; Saïed yabyise «ukwivanga gukabije». Muri Nyakanga 2026, ikinyamakuru cyo mu Butaliyani "Il Foglio" cyatangaje ko yaba yajyanywe mu bitaro, ariko perezidansi ntiyabyemeza.
Ibitekerezo n'imyanya afata.
Ibitekerezo bye bya gakondo ntibishingiye ku idini, ariko "Le Monde" imushyira mu murongo w'abaharanira ubumwe bw'Abarabu. Arwanya ko abagore bazungura kimwe n'abagabo, kandi ashyigikiye igihano cy'urupfu. Avuga ko ubutinganyi ari ikibazo cy'umuntu ku giti cye, ariko ko budakwiriye kugaragara mu ruhame. Itegeko Nshinga rya 2022 rivuga ko Tunisiya ari kimwe mu bihugu bigize umuryango w'Abayisilamu ("oumma").
Ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2023, Saïed yavuze ko abimukira baturuka muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara ari «umugambi w'ubugizi bwa nabi» ugamije guhindura imiterere y'abaturage ba Tunisiya ; "Le Monde" na "Le Point" byavuze ko ayo magambo ashingiye ku gitekerezo cya «ugusimbuzwa gukomeye» ("grand remplacement"). Nyuma y'iryo jambo, abimukira benshi bo muri Afurika yo munsi ya Sahara batakaje akazi n'aho kuba, kandi nibura 1 300 muri bo bajyanywe na polisi ku mipaka na Libiya na Aligeriya, basigwa mu butayu.
Mu 2023, ibura ry'amazi ritewe n'imihindagurikire y'ibihe ryatumye guverinoma ishyiraho igabanywa ry'amazi mu turere tumwe.
Saïed yashakanye n'umucamanza Ichraf Chebil, bamenyaniye muri kaminuza ya Sousse aho yari umunyeshuri we; bafitanye abana batatu. Umuvandimwe we, Naoufel Saïed, na we ari muri politiki kandi aramushyigikira. Akunda umuziki wa kera w'Abarabu n'ubugeni bwo kwandika Icyarabu; amabaruwa ye yandikishije intoki mu nyandiko nziza ya Maghreb yaravuzwe cyane.

Hakainde Hichilema (yavutse ku ya 4 Kamena 1962), uzwi cyane ku nyuguti «HH» no ku izina rya «Bally», ni umucuruzi, umworozi akaba n'umunyapolitiki wa Zambiya, Perezida wa karindwi w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 24 Kanama 2021. Ayobora ishyaka rya United Party for National Development (UPND) kuva mu 2006. Yabaye umuyobozi w'ibigo by'ubugenzuzi bw'imari Coopers and Lybrand na Grant Thornton muri Zambiya, mbere yo kwinjira muri politiki. Yatsinzwe amatora ya perezida inshuro eshanu, harimo aya 2015 n'aya 2016 yatsinzwe na Edgar Lungu ku kinyuranyo gito. Mu 2017, yafunzwe amezi ane ashinjwa ubugambanyi, ifungwa ryamaganywe cyane mu gihugu no mu mahanga. Yatsinze amatora ya 2021 ku cyiciro cya mbere, yongera gutorwa mu 2026.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'umwuga.
Hichilema yavukiye mu mudugudu wo mu karere ka Monze, ku ya 4 Kamena 1962. Yahawe buruse yo kwiga muri Kaminuza ya Zambiya, ayirangiza mu 1986 afite impamyabumenyi mu bukungu n'imicungire y'ubucuruzi, hanyuma abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu (MBA) mu mari n'ingamba z'ubucuruzi muri Kaminuza ya Birmingham, mu Bwongereza. Yabaye umuyobozi mukuru wa Coopers and Lybrand Zambia kuva mu 1994 kugeza mu 1998, hanyuma uwa Grant Thornton Zambia kuva mu 1998 kugeza mu 2006. Ni umwe mu bantu bakize muri Zambiya, kandi ni uwa kabiri mu borozi b'inka benshi mu gihugu.
Mu 2006, nyuma y'urupfu rwa Anderson Mazoka, Hichilema yatorewe kuyobora ishyaka rya UPND, ndetse n'ihuriro ry'amashyaka atavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, United Democratic Alliance (UDA). Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2006, ashyigikiwe n'uwahoze ari Perezida Kenneth Kaunda, yabaye uwa gatatu n'amajwi agera kuri 25%. Mu matora yo mu 2008, yakurikiye urupfu rwa Perezida Levy Mwanawasa, yongeye kuba uwa gatatu n'amajwi 19,7%. Mu 2009, UPND yagiranye amasezerano n'ishyaka rya Patriotic Front rya Michael Sata, ariko asenyuka mu 2011.
Mu matora ya perezida yo muri Mutarama 2015, yatsinzwe na Edgar Lungu ku kinyuranyo gito cy'amajwi 27 757 (1,66%), maze avuga ko ayo matora yaranzwe n'uburiganya. Muri Kanama 2016, yongeye gutsindwa na Lungu ku kinyuranyo gito (47,6% kuri 50,4%).
Ifungwa ryo mu 2017.
Ku ya 11 Mata 2017, abapolisi binjiye ku ngufu iwe, baramufata, ashinjwa ubugambanyi no gushaka guhirika ubutegetsi, nyuma y'uko imodoka zari zimuherekeje zivugwaho kwanga guha inzira iz'umukuru w'igihugu. Abenshi babonaga ko icyo cyari ikosa ryo mu muhanda gusa, kidashobora gufatwa nk'ubugambanyi. Abapolisi bakoresheje imbaraga z'umurengera, bangiza inzu ye kandi bakubita abakozi be. Nyuma, Hichilema yavuze ko yafunzwe wenyine iminsi umunani nta biryo, nta mazi kandi akorerwa iyicarubozo.
Ifungwa rye ryamaganywe na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi, abepiskopi Gatolika ba Zambiya ndetse n'abanyapolitiki bo muri Afurika y'Epfo. Uwahoze ari Perezida wa Nijeriya, Olusegun Obasanjo, n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Commonwealth, Patricia Scotland, bamusuye muri gereza, mu gihe Perezida Lungu yatangaje ibihe bidasanzwe. Ku ya 16 Kanama 2017, ibyaha yashinjwaga byavanyweho, maze ararekurwa, ibyo byakiranwa ibyishimo mu gihugu hose. Muri Ukwakira 2017, umuryango Friedrich Naumann wamuhaye igihembo cy'ubwisanzure muri Afurika ("Africa Freedom Award").
Mu Ugushyingo 2017, inyandiko zizwi nka "Paradise Papers" zagaragaje ko yari umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'ubucukuzi AfNat Resources, cyanditswe muri Bermuda, igihugu kizwiho kudasoresha cyane ; amakuru nk'ayo yari yaragaragaye no mu nyandiko za "Panama Papers".
Perezida wa Zambiya.
Mu matora yo ku ya 12 Kanama 2021, Hichilema yatsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 59%, arusha Perezida Lungu wari ku butegetsi amanota arenga makumyabiri. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida wa Zambiya ku ya 24 Kanama 2021, kuri sitade ya National Heroes i Lusaka, afite Mutale Nalumango nka visi-perezida.
Avuga ko ari «umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe kwamamaza» igihugu, akora ingendo nyinshi zo kumenyekanisha ubukungu bwa Zambiya mu mahanga. Muri Gicurasi 2022, yashimiye ishoramari rinini mu bucukuzi bw'umuringa n'ubwa nikeli, kandi Zambiya isinyana na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo amasezerano yo guteza imbere inganda za batiri z'amashanyarazi. Mu 2022, we na Perezida wa Tanzaniya, Samia Suluhu Hassan, bemeranyije kuvugurura umuhanda wa gari ya moshi wa TAZARA. Muri uwo mwaka, Zambiya yatoye yamagana igitero cy'Uburusiya muri Ukraine mu Muryango w'Abibumbye. Mu 2022, yitabiriye inama y'abakuru b'ibihugu bya Commonwealth i Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mu Ukwakira 2024, yirukanye abacamanza batatu b'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga. Ku ya 4 Kamena 2026, yasinye itegeko rituma uburezi bw'ubuntu buba uburenganzira buhoraho.
Mu matora rusange ya 2026, yongeye gutorwa ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 60,5%, imbere ya Brian Mundubile wagize 37,9%. Nyuma y'amatora, abanyapolitiki benshi batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, barimo Mundubile, barafunzwe bashinjwa ubugambanyi, naho umunyapolitiki Mutotwe Kafwaya yicirwa mu gikorwa cya polisi.
Hichilema yashakanye na Mutinta, bafitanye abana batatu. Ni umuyoboke w'Itorero ry'Abadiventisiti b'Umunsi wa Karindwi.

Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa (yavutse ku ya 15 Nzeri 1942 i Shabani, ubu ni Zvishavane) ni umunyapolitiki wa Zimbabwe, Perezida w'icyo gihugu kuva ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2017. Akunze kwitwa «"Ngwena"» cyangwa «"Garwe"» («Ingona» mu Gishona). Yabaye impirimbanyi y'ubwigenge, afungwa imyaka icumi n'ubutegetsi bw'abakoloni ba Rodeziya. Nyuma y'ubwigenge mu 1980, yabaye umufatanyabikorwa wa hafi wa Robert Mugabe, ahabwa imyanya myinshi ikomeye muri guverinoma, harimo Minisitiri ushinzwe Umutekano w'Igihugu mu gihe cy'ubwicanyi bwa "Gukurahundi", bukaba bukimuvugwaho. Yabaye Visi-Perezida wa mbere kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2017, ubwo Mugabe yamwirukanaga; nyuma y'iminsi mike, kudeta y'igisirikare yatumye Mugabe yegura, Mnangagwa amusimbura. Yatsinze amatora yateje impaka yo mu 2018 n'ayo mu 2023, kandi ubutegetsi bwe bufatwa na benshi nk'ubw'igitugu.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Dambudzo Mnangagwa yavutse ku ya 15 Nzeri 1942 i Shabani, umujyi w'ubucukuzi muri Rodeziya y'Amajyepfo, ubukoloni bw'Abongereza. Ababyeyi be, Mafidhi na Mhurai Mnangagwa, bari abahinzi bo mu bwoko bw'Abakalanga, bufitanye isano n'Abashona. Sekuru yari mu rukiko rw'umwami w'Abandebele Lobengula, akarwanya Abongereza.
Mu 1952, se yagiranye amakimbirane n'umukozi w'ubukoloni wari wafatiriye amatungo y'abaturage, bituma umuryango wimukira muri Rodeziya y'Amajyaruguru (ubu ni Zambiya). Mnangagwa yakomereje amashuri i Mumbwa, hanyuma yiga imyuga y'ubwubatsi i Kafue no muri Hodgson Technical College, aho yirukanywe mu 1960 azira ibikorwa bya politiki.
Urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu.
Mu 1962, Mnangagwa yinjiye mu ishyaka rya Zimbabwe African People's Union (ZAPU), maze ajya muri Tanganyika (ubu ni Tanzaniya), hanyuma mu Misiri guhabwa imyitozo ya gisirikare. Muri Kanama 1963, yinjiye mu ishyaka rishya rya Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU). Yoherejwe mu Ubushinwa mu ngabo za ZANLA, aho yize ibitekerezo bya Marx muri Kaminuza ya Pekin, ahabwa imyitozo y'urugamba n'iy'ubutasi ; umubano yagiranye n'Ubushinwa wakomeje kwiyongera. Mu 1964, agarutse muri Tanganyika, yashinze itsinda ryitwa «Itsinda ry'Ingona» ("Crocodile Group").
Muri Mutarama 1965, iryo tsinda ryagabye ibitero mu burasirazuba bwa Rodeziya, rinangiza ibikoresho bya gari ya moshi hafi ya Fort Victoria (ubu ni Masvingo). Mnangagwa yarafashwe, yemera icyaha nyuma yo gukorerwa iyicarubozo, ahamwa n'icyaha. Abavoka be bavuze ko yari akiri muto, bityo ntiyakatirwa urwo gupfa, ahubwo akatirwa igifungo cy'imyaka icumi. Yafungiwe muri gereza zitandukanye, harimo iya Khami, aho yamaze imyaka irenga itandatu ari kumwe n'abandi bayobozi b'ubwigenge, barimo Robert Mugabe, maze baba inshuti magara. Amaze kurekurwa, yirukanwe muri Zambiya, yiga amategeko muri Kaminuza ya Zambiya, ayakora imyaka ibiri, hanyuma ajya muri Mozambike kwifatanya na ZANU, aho yabaye umwungirije akaba n'umurinzi wa Mugabe.
Umwuga wa politiki nyuma y'ubwigenge.
Kuva ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe mu 1980 kugeza mu 1988, Mnangagwa yabaye Minisitiri ushinzwe Umutekano w'Igihugu, ayobora n'urwego rw'ubutasi (CIO). Muri icyo gihe, kuva mu 1983 kugeza mu 1987, burigade ya gatanu y'ingabo za Zimbabwe, yari yaratojwe na Koreya ya Ruguru, yishe abasivili b'Abandebele bari hagati ya 20 000 na 30 000 mu ntara ya Matabeleland, mu bwicanyi buzwi nka "Gukurahundi". Mnangagwa ahakana uruhare urwo ari rwo rwose muri ubwo bwicanyi, ariko benshi, barimo ibihugu by'amahanga, abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu, bamushinja kuba yarabugizemo uruhare rukomeye. Mu ijambo yavuze muri Werurwe 1983, yagereranyije abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi n'udukoko ("cockroaches" na "bugs") dukeneye kwicishwa umuti wica udukoko. Muri icyo gihe, yashimangiye umubano n'ingabo n'inzego z'ubutasi, zikomeje kumubera inkingi.
Kuva mu 1988 kugeza mu 2000, yabaye Minisitiri w'Ubutabera, anaba Minisitiri w'Imari w'agateganyo kuva mu Ugushyingo 1995 kugeza muri Mata 1996. Kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2005, yabaye Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Imiturire yo mu Byaro kuva mu 2005 kugeza mu 2009, n'uw'Ingabo kuva mu 2009 kugeza mu 2013. Yagize uruhare rukomeye mu bikorwa by'urugomo byaranze amatora ya perezida yo mu 2008, ubwo yayoboraga ubukangurambaga bwa Mugabe, kandi abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bamushinje kugira uruhare mu rugomo rw'amatora ya 2013. Mu 2007, guverinoma yavuze ko yavumbuye umugambi w'abasirikare wo guhirika Mugabe no gushinga Mnangagwa gushyiraho guverinoma, ariko Mnangagwa avuga ko ntacyo yari abiziho.
Visi-Perezida no kwirukanwa.
Mu Ukuboza 2014, Mnangagwa yasimbuye Joice Mujuru ku mwanya wa Visi-Perezida wa mbere wa Zimbabwe, afatwa nk'ushobora gusimbura Mugabe wari ugeze mu zabukuru. Ariko Mugabe yifuzaga ko umugore we, Grace Mugabe, ari we umusimbura. Ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2017, Mugabe yirukanye Mnangagwa ku mwanya wa visi-perezida amushinja «kutaba indahemuka», ibyo bitashimishije ingabo ; Mnangagwa ahungira muri Afurika y’Epfo.
Ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2017, Jenerali Sibusiso Moyo yatangarije kuri televiziyo y'igihugu ko ingabo zifashe imihanda kugira ngo «zivane mu nzira abagizi ba nabi bari hafi ya Perezida Mugabe» ; Mugabe n'umugore we bafungiwe iwabo n'ingabo. Ku ya 19 Ugushyingo, komite nkuru ya ZANU–PF yakuye Mugabe ku buyobozi bw'ishyaka, imusimbuza Mnangagwa, inamutanga nk'umukandida wayo mu matora ya 2018. Ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 2017, Mugabe yeguye kugira ngo yirinde kweguzwa n'Inteko.
Perezida wa Zimbabwe.
Mnangagwa yagarutse muri Zimbabwe ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2017, maze arahirira kuba Perezida ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 2017. Bukeye, urukiko rwemeje ko kudeta yari ihuje n'Itegeko Nshinga. Ku ya 30 Ugushyingo 2017, yashyizeho guverinoma igizwe n'abayoboke ba ZANU–PF n'abasirikare babiri, barimo Sibusiso Moyo, wagizwe Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga. Ku ya 27 Ukuboza 2017, yagize Constantino Chiwenga na Kembo Mohadi ba visi-perezida. Yahaye amezi atatu abari barahishe amafaranga mu mahanga mu buryo butemewe kuyagarura mu gihugu, kandi yiyemeza kuvugurura politiki y'ubutaka kugira ngo bamwe mu bahinzi b'Abazungu bambuwe ubutaka bawusubizwe. Yagaragaje ubushake bwo kongera kubana neza n'ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba no kugaruka muri Commonwealth.
Muri Kamena 2018, mu gihe cy'ubukangurambaga bw'amatora i Bulawayo, igisasu cyatewe aho yari ari, ariko arokoka nta kibazo, mu gihe abandi bayobozi, barimo ba visi-perezida be bombi, bakomeretse. Ku ya 30 Nyakanga 2018, yatsinze amatora ya perezida ku kinyuranyo gito ku cyiciro cya mbere. Nelson Chamisa, umukandida w'ihuriro MDC, yanze ibyavuye mu matora, maze imyigaragambyo ikurikiraho ihitana abantu batandatu barashwe n'ingabo. Ku ya 24 Kanama 2018, Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rwemeje ibyavuye mu matora, maze arahira ku ya 26 Kanama.
Muri Mutarama 2019, izamuka ry'ibiciro bya lisansi rya 130% ryateje imyigaragambyo mu gihugu hose; inzego z'umutekano zayihoshesheje ku ngufu, abantu 12 barapfa kandi amagana arafatwa. Muri Werurwe 2021, Perezida Joe Biden wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika yanenze ubutegetsi bwe kubera guhohotera abaturage no kudakora amavugurura ya demokarasi, yongera ibihano Amerika yari yarafatiye Zimbabwe. Mu 2023, iperereza ry'itangazamakuru ryagaragaje urusobe rw'icuruzwa rya zahabu mu buryo bwa magendu rifitanye isano n'abantu ba hafi ye.
Muri Kanama 2023, Mnangagwa yongeye gutorwa n'amajwi 52,6%, ariko abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bavuga ko ayo matora atagenze neza. Ku ya 4 Werurwe 2024, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika zamufatiye ibihano, we n'umugore we Auxillia, Visi-Perezida Chiwenga n'abandi, kubera ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu, ruswa n'icuruzwa ry'amabuye y'agaciro mu buryo bwa magendu. Ku ya 31 Ukuboza 2024, yasinye itegeko rikuraho igihano cy'urupfu ku byaha byinshi, maze ibihano by'urupfu by'imfungwa zose bihindurwa igifungo.
Ku ya 2 Nzeri 2024, yatangaje ko atazashaka manda ya gatatu mu 2028. Ariko mu 2025, abahoze barwana urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu basabye ko yegura, mu gihe ibihuha byavugaga ko ashaka kongera igihe cye ku butegetsi. Ku ya 18 Ukwakira 2025, inama ya ZANU–PF i Mutare yemeje icyifuzo cyo kongera manda ye kugeza mu 2030 binyuze mu ivugurura ry'Itegeko Nshinga, maze muri Kamena 2026 imitwe yombi y'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yemeza ivugurura ryongera manda ya perezida kuva ku myaka itanu ikagera ku myaka irindwi.
Ibitekerezo bya politiki.
Mnangagwa arwanya yivuye inyuma igihano cy'urupfu, acyita «igitutsi ku cyubahiro cya muntu»; "La Croix" ihuza uwo murongo n'uko na we ubwe yari yarigeze kugikatirwa akiri muto.
Mnangagwa ni Umukristo w'Umuvanjeliste, akaba umuyoboke w'Itorero rya United Family International Church. Yashatse kabiri, kandi afite abana cumi n'umunani n'abuzukuru barenga icumi. Umugore we wa mbere, Jayne Matarise, bashakanye mu 1973, bakabyarana abana batandatu, yapfuye ku ya 31 Mutarama 2002 azize kanseri. Ikinyamakuru "Time" cyamushyize mu bantu 100 bavuga rikijyana ku isi mu 2018.

Hepatite ni indwara itera umwijima kubyimba. Ishobora kwibasira umwijima gusa cyangwa se ikaba yatera izindi ndwara nko; kuzana udusebe no gucika k’umwijima (fibrosis), cirrhosis na kanseri y’umwijima.

Umusonga ni indwara yo kubyimba mu bihaha yibasira cyane cyane udusaho duto tw’umwuka tuzwi nka alveoli. Ibimenyetso bikunze kuba birimo inkorora ikura cyangwa yumye, kubabara mu gatuza, umuriro, no kugorwa no guhumeka. Uburemere bw'iyi ndwara burahindagurika.
Ubusanzwe umusonga uterwa n'ubwandu bwa virusi cyangwa bagiteri, kandi akenshi uterwa n'izindi mikorobe, imiti imwe n'imwe cyangwa indwara zimwe na zimwe nk'indwara ziterwa n'umubiri. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo indwara ya cystic fibrosis, indwara idakira y’ibihaha (COPD), indwara ya sickle cell, asima, diyabete, umutima unanirwa, amateka yo kunywa itabi, ubushobozi buke bwo gukorora (nk'igihe umuntu arwaye indwara yo mu bwonko), hamwe n'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri budakora neza. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku bimenyetso no ku isuzuma ry'umubiri. Imirasire yo mu gituza, ibizamini by'amaraso, no gupima amatembabuzi y'amata bishobora gufasha kwemeza ko indwara yanduye. Iyi ndwara ishobora gushyirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe aho yavuye, nko kwandurira mu bitaro cyangwa kwakorewe mu muryango cyangwa kwandurira mu bitaro.
Urukingo rwo kwirinda ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bw'umusonga rurahari. Ubundi buryo bwo kwirinda burimo gukaraba intoki no kutanywa itabi. Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru. Umusonga w’ibihaha bikekwa ko uterwa na bagiteri uvurwa n’imiti yica udukoko. Iyo umusonga ukabije, umuntu wafashwe n’indwara muri rusange ajyanwa mu bitaro. Uburyo bwo kuvura umwuka wa ogisijeni bushobora gukoreshwa iyo urugero rwa ogisijeni ruri hasi.
Buri mwaka, umusonga wibasira abantu bagera kuri 450 miliyoni z'abantu ku isi (7% by'abaturage) kandi bigatera impfu zigera kuri miliyoni 4. Mu kinyejana cya 20, ubwo imiti yica udukoko n'inkingo byatangiraga gukoreshwa, ubuzima bwarushijeho kuba bwiza cyane. Nyamara, mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, ndetse no mu bakuze cyane, abakiri bato cyane n'abarwayi badakira, umusonga uracyari intandaro y'impfu nyinshi. Umusonga ukunze kugabanya igihe cyo kubabara mu bantu bari hafi gupfa, bityo witwa "inshuti y'uyu musaza".

Ketamine ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu gutangiza no kubungabunga ikinya. Bitera umuntu kumva ameze nk'uwihebye mu gihe bigabanya ububabare, gutuza no kwibagirwa. Izindi ngamba zirimo kugabanya ububabare mu bitaro by’inyongera no kuvura ububabare n’agahinda. Imikorere y'umutima, guhumeka, n'imikorere y'imiyoboro y'ubuhumekero muri rusange bikomeza gukora neza. Ingaruka zikunze gutangira mu minota itanu iyo zitanzwe hakoreshejwe urushinge, kandi zimara iminota 25.

Imirire mibi ni indwara iterwa no kurya indyo aho intungamubiri imwe cyangwa nyinshi zidahagije cyangwa zikaba nyinshi cyane ku buryo indyo itera ibibazo by'ubuzima. Bishobora kuba birimo karori, poroteyine, karubohidrati, ibinure, vitamine cyangwa imyunyungugu.
Intungamubiri zidahagije zitwa imirire mibi cyangwa indyo yuzuye mu gihe irenze urugero zitwa imirire mibi. Imirire mibi ikunze gukoreshwa mu gusobanura imirire mibi aho umuntu adahabwa karori, poroteyine, cyangwa intungamubiri zihagije. Iyo umuntu atwite cyangwa mbere y’imyaka ibiri, bishobora kumuviramo ibibazo bidashira mu mikurire y’umubiri n’iy’ubwonko. Kubura indyo yuzuye, bizwi nka inzara, bishobora kugira ibimenyetso birimo: uburebure bugufi, umubiri muto, imbaraga nke cyane, no kubyimba amaguru n'inda. Abantu bakunze kwandura indwara kandi bakunze kugira ibicurane. Ibimenyetso by'ibura ry'intungamubiri biterwa n'intungamubiri ntoya zibura.
Kurya nabi akenshi biterwa no kutagira ibiryo byiza bihagije byo kurya. Ibi bikunze kujyana n'ibiciro by'ibiribwa biri hejuru ndetse n'ubukene. Kutanywa ibere bishobora gutera indwara nyinshi zandura nka: indwara yo mu gifu, umusonga, malariya, na serumu, ibyo bikaba byongera ibyifuzo by’intungamubiri. Hari ubwoko bubiri bw'ingenzi bw'imirire mibi: imirire mibi iterwa na poroteyine n'ingufu no kubura indyo yuzuye. Imirire mibi iterwa n'ingufu za poroteyine ifite imiterere ibiri ikomeye: marasmus (kubura poroteyine na karori) na kwashiorkor (kubura poroteyine gusa). Ibura ry’intungamubiri rikunze kugaragara ririmo: kubura icyuma, iyode na vitamine A. Mu gihe cyo gutwita, bitewe n’uko umubiri ukeneye byinshi, kubura ibinure bishobora kwiyongera. Mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, imirire irenze urugero mu buryo bw'umubyibuho ukabije itangiye kugaragara mu miryango imwe n'iy'abantu badafite imirire myiza. Izindi mpamvu zitera imirire mibi zirimo kwiyica intege no kubagwa bariyatric.
Imbaraga zo kunoza imirire ni zimwe mu nzira nziza zo gufasha mu iterambere. Konsa bishobora kugabanya igipimo cy'imirire mibi n'impfu mu bana, kandi imbaraga zo guteza imbere uyu muco zikongera igipimo cy'uko abana bonsa. Ku bana bato, gutanga ibiryo (usibye amashereka) hagati y'amezi atandatu n'imyaka ibiri byongera umusaruro. Hari kandi ibimenyetso byiza bishyigikira ko abagore batwite ndetse no mu bana bato bo mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere bahabwa intungamubiri nyinshi. Kugira ngo abantu babikeneye cyane babone ibiribwa, haba mu gutanga ibiribwa no gutanga amafaranga kugira ngo abantu bagure ibiribwa mu masoko yo mu gace batuyemo, biragira akamaro.
Kugaburira abanyeshuri gusa ku ishuri ntibihagije. Gukemura ikibazo cy’imirire mibi ikabije mu rugo rw’umuntu ukoresheje ibiryo bivura byiteguye gukoreshwa birashoboka cyane. Ku bantu bafite imirire mibi ikomeye iterwa n'izindi ngorane z'ubuzima, ni byiza kuvurirwa mu bitaro. Ibi akenshi bikubiyemo gucunga isukari nke mu maraso n'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri, gukemura ikibazo cyo kubura amazi mu mubiri, no kugaburira buhoro buhoro. Imiti isanzwe ikoreshwa mu kurwanya indwara zandura akenshi irasabwa kubera ko hari ibyago byinshi byo kwandura. Ingamba z'igihe kirekire zirimo: kunoza ubuhinzi, kugabanya ubukene, kunoza isuku, no guteza imbere abagore.
Hari abantu 821 miliyoni z'abantu bafite imirire mibi ku isi mu 2018 (10.8% by'abaturage bose). Iri ni igabanuka rya 176 miliyoni z'abantu kuva mu 1990 ubwo 23% bari bafite imirire mibi, ariko hiyongeraho abantu bagera kuri 36 miliyoni kuva mu 2015, ubwo 10.6% bari bafite imirire mibi. Mu 2012, byagaragaye ko abandi bantu miliyari bari badafite vitamine n'imyunyungugu. Mu 2015, imirire mibi iterwa n’ingufu za poroteyine yagaragaye ko yahitanye abantu 323.000—igabanuka ugereranyije n’abapfuye 510.000 mu 1990. Izindi ntungamubiri zibura, zirimo kubura iyode no kubura amaraso mu by’ubutare, zitera izindi mfu 83.000.
