Mu 2010, imirire mibi ni yo yabaye intandaro ya 1.4% by'imyaka yose y'ubuzima yahinduwe n'ubumuga. Hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'impfu mu bana bivugwa ko ziterwa n'imirire mibi, nubwo impfu zidakunze kwitwa ko ari zo. Mu 2010, byavuzwe ko byagize uruhare mu rupfu rw’abagore n’abana bagera kuri miliyoni 1.5, nubwo bamwe bavuga ko umubare wabo ushobora kuba urenga 3 miliyoni. Indi 165 y'inyongera Abana miliyoni babarirwaga mu kigero cyo kugabanuka mu mikurire bitewe n’imirire mibi mu 2013. Kubura imirire myiza bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Hari amatsinda amwe afite igipimo cyo hejuru cy’ababura imirire myiza, harimo abagore—cyane cyane iyo batwite cyangwa bonsa— abana bari munsi y’imyaka itanu, ndetse n’abageze mu za bukuru. Ku bageze mu za bukuru, imirire mibi ikunze kugaragara bitewe n’ibintu by’umubiri, imitekerereze n’imibereho.

Thomas Isidore Noël Sankara (yavutse ku ya 21 Ukuboza 1949 i Yako, apfa yishwe ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1987 i Ouagadougou) yari umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaburukina, wayoboye Volta ya Ruguru, yaje kwitwa Burukina Faso, kuva mu 1983 kugeza mu 1987. Yari umuyoboke w'ibitekerezo bya gikomunisiti, uharanira ubwigenge nyabwo bw'Afurika, kurengera ibidukikije n'uburenganzira bw'abagore. Mu myaka ine yamaze ku butegetsi, yayoboye impinduramatwara yiswe «impinduramatwara ya demokarasi n'abaturage», irwanya ruswa, iteza imbere ubuhinzi, ubuzima n'uburezi, kandi ituma igihugu cyihaza mu biribwa; ariko nanone ubutegetsi bwe bwahohoteye amashyirahamwe y'abakozi n'amashyaka amwe atavuga rumwe na bwo. Ni we wahinduye izina ry'igihugu «Volta ya Ruguru» ryasizwe n'abakoloni, akacyita «Burkina Faso», bisobanura «igihugu cy'abantu b'inyangamugayo». Yiciwe muri kudeta yayobowe na mugenzi we Blaise Compaoré, waje gukatirwa igifungo cya burundu mu 2022 kubera urwo rupfu. Kugeza ubu, afatwa n'urubyiruko rwinshi rwa Afurika nk'intwari, akitwa «Che Guevara w'Afurika».
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Thomas Sankara yavutse ku ya 21 Ukuboza 1949 i Yako, muri Volta ya Ruguru yategekwaga n'Ubufaransa. Se yari Umusilmi-Mosi ukomoka mu mudugudu wa Sitoèga, naho nyina akaba Umumosi ukomoka i Ziniaré. Se, wahoze ari umusirikare mu ngabo z'Ubufaransa akaba yarafashwe mpiri mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, yaje kuba umujandarume ushinzwe ubuvuzi. Yakuriye mu muryango w'Abakristo Gatolika, afite abavandimwe benshi.
Yize amashuri yisumbuye i Bobo-Dioulasso, hanyuma mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Kadiogo i Ouagadougou. Yahawe amasomo y'abasirikare bakuru mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Yaoundé, muri Kameruni, hanyuma mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Antsirabe, muri Madagasikari, aho yize ubumenyi bwa politiki, ubukungu n'ubuhinzi. Muri Madagasikari, yabonye impinduramatwara yo mu 1972 yahiritse Perezida Philibert Tsiranana, bimutera igitekerezo cy'«impinduramatwara ya demokarasi n'abaturage».
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Yagarutse muri Volta ya Ruguru mu 1973 afite ipeti rya su-liyetona, ashinzwe gutoza abasirikare bashya; yashimangiraga ko «umusirikare udafite uburere bwa politiki bukunda igihugu aba ari umugizi wa nabi uteganyijwe». Mu 1974, yamenyekanye cyane mu ntambara yahuje igihugu cye na Mali. Mu 1976, yagizwe umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'igihugu cy'imyitozo y'abakomando i Pô. Hamwe na Blaise Compaoré, Henri Zongo na Jean-Baptiste Lingani, yashinze ihuriro ry'abasirikare bakuru b'abakomunisiti.
Kwinjira muri politiki.
Muri Nzeri 1981, Sankara yagizwe Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe Itangazamakuru muri guverinoma ya Koloneli Saye Zerbo, ariko yegura ku ya 21 Mata 1982 kubera ikurwaho ry'uburenganzira bwo kujya mu myigaragambyo y'abakozi, avuga kuri televiziyo ati: «Ishyano ku bacecekesha abaturage». Nyuma ya kudeta yo ku ya 7 Ugushyingo 1982 yashyize ku butegetsi Jean-Baptiste Ouédraogo, Sankara yagizwe Minisitiri w'Intebe muri Mutarama 1983. Yatangaje ku mugaragaro ko ashaka guca umubano wa «gikoloni gishya» na Ubufaransa, kandi atumira umuyobozi wa Libiya, Mouammar Kadhafi. Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1983, yarirukanywe, afungirwa iwe, bivugwa ko byatewe n'igitutu cy'Ubufaransa.
Perezida wa Burukina Faso.
Impinduramatwara yo mu 1983.
Imyigaragambyo y'abaturage yashyigikiwe n'amashyaka y'ibumoso n'amashyirahamwe y'abakozi yatumye arekurwa. Ku ya 4 Kanama 1983, abasirikare bo mu kigo cya Pô bayobowe na Blaise Compaoré binjiye i Ouagadougou, maze Sankara aba Perezida w'Inama y'Igihugu y'Impinduramatwara. Ku ya 4 Kanama 1984, igihugu cyiswe Burkina Faso.
Ubutegetsi bwe bwambuye abatware gakondo ububasha bwabo, bubuha Komite zirengera Impinduramatwara (CDR), zari zishinzwe umutekano, uburere bwa politiki, isuku n'ubukungu mu turere. Ariko izo komite zashinjwe kwitwara nk'imitwe yitwaje intwaro itera ubwoba, ndetse no guhohotera amashyirahamwe y'abakozi. Muri Kamena 1984, abantu barindwi bashinjwaga umugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi barishwe nyuma yo gukatirwa n'urukiko rwa gisirikare.
Politiki y'ubukungu n'imibereho.
Sankara yagabanyije amafaranga leta yakoreshaga mu mirimo isanzwe, ashyira imbere ishoramari; abaminisitiri bategetswe kugendera mu modoka zoroheje za Renault 5 aho kugendera mu modoka z'agaciro kenshi. Yashakaga ubukungu butishingikiriza ku mfashanyo z'amahanga, avuga ko «uguha ibyo kurya ari na we ugutegeka». Mu 1986, Burkina Faso yageze ku ntego yo guha buri muntu amafunguro abiri n'amazi litiro icumi ku munsi, maze intumwa ya Loni ishinzwe uburenganzira ku biribwa ivuga ko yatsinze inzara. Abakozi ba leta bashishikarijwe kwambara imyenda gakondo, "Faso dan fani".
Kuva mu 1983 kugeza mu 1985, abaturage miliyoni ebyiri bakingiwe imbasa, mugiga n'iseru, kandi ubutegetsi bwe bwubatse amazu menshi n'ibikorwa remezo. Mu kurwanya ubutayu, yatangije gahunda yo gutera ibiti miliyoni nyinshi no guca ibikorwa byo gutema amashyamba no gutwika ibihuru. Yashyize imbere kandi uburezi, mu gihugu cyari gifite abaturage 90% batazi gusoma no kwandika.
Mu guharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore, yakuyeho inkwano n'umuco wo guhererekanya abapfakazi, ashyiraho imyaka ntarengwa yo gushyingirwa, abuza gukeba abakobwa kandi arwanya ubuharike.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, Sankara yanenze uburyo bw'imari ku isi, Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari (FMI) na Banki y'Isi, kandi Burkina Faso ntiyafashe inguzanyo za FMI. Mu nama y'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Afurika (OUA) yabereye i Addis Abeba muri Nyakanga 1987, yavuze ijambo ryamamaye, ahamagarira ibihugu by'Afurika kwanga hamwe kwishyura imyenda. Yanenze cyane politiki y'Ubufaransa muri Afurika, by'umwihariko mu ruzinduko rwa Perezida François Mitterrand i Ouagadougou mu Ugushyingo 1986 ; inkunga y'Ubufaransa yagabanutseho 80% hagati ya 1983 na 1985. Yagiranye umubano mwiza na Cuba, yohereza urubyiruko rugera kuri 600 kwigayo, ndetse na Jerry Rawlings wa Gana na Mouammar Kadhafi. Mu 1985, intambara ngufi yamuhuje na Mali ku bijyanye n'akarere ka Agacher.
Kuva mu 1985, umubano wa Sankara na Blaise Compaoré warazambye cyane, kugeza ubwo batari bakivugana. Ku mugoroba wo ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1987, ubwo Sankara yari mu nama n'abagize ibiro bye mu nyubako ya Conseil de l'Entente i Ouagadougou, itsinda ry'abasirikare ryinjiye, ryica abamurindaga, hanyuma rimwica hamwe n'abandi bantu cumi na babiri. Nk'uko uwarokotse wenyine, Alouna Traoré, abivuga, Sankara yasohotse mbere y'abandi amanitse amaboko, avuga ati: «Ntimunyeganyege, ni jye bashaka». Muri iryo joro, Blaise Compaoré yafashe ubutegetsi, maze Sankara n'abo bapfanye bashyingurwa rwihishwa mu irimbi rya Dagnoën.
Iperereza n'urubanza.
Mu 2006, Komite ya Loni ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu yamaganye kuba nta rubanza cyangwa iperereza byari byarakozwe na leta ya Burukina Faso kuri urwo rupfu. Nyuma y'ihirikwa rya Compaoré mu 2014, umupfakazi wa Sankara, Mariam, yagarutse i Ouagadougou ku ya 14 Gicurasi 2015 kubazwa n'umucamanza. Ku ya 25 Gicurasi 2015, hatangiye gutaburura imibiri ikekwa kuba iya Sankara n'abo bapfanye ; isuzuma ryagaragaje ko umubiri we warashwe amasasu arenga icumi. Mu Ukuboza 2015, ubutabera bwa gisirikare bwasohoye impapuro mpuzamahanga zo guta muri yombi Compaoré, wari mu buhungiro muri Kote Divuwari. Mu 2017, Perezida Emmanuel Macron w'Ubufaransa yemeye ko inyandiko z'ibanga z'Ubufaransa zerekeye urwo rupfu zishyikirizwa ubutabera bwa Burukina Faso.
Urubanza rwatangiye ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2021. Ku ya 6 Mata 2022, Blaise Compaoré yahamwe n'icyaha cyo gutegeka iyicwa rya Sankara, akatirwa adahari igifungo cya burundu, kimwe na Gilbert Diendéré.
Sankara afatwa n'abatari bake muri Afurika nk'intwari, kandi akunze kugereranywa na Che Guevara na Patrice Lumumba. Mu 2019, ishusho ye yubatswe aho yiciwe i Ouagadougou. Mu 2023, guverinoma ya Burukina Faso yamushyize mu ntwari z'igihugu, kandi umuhanda munini wa Ouagadougou witwaga Boulevard Charles de Gaulle uhabwa izina rye. Mu 2025, Sankara n'abo bapfanye bashyinguwe mu cyubahiro mu mva yubatswe aho bari biciwe, ku Conseil de l'Entente.
Sankara yashakanye na Mariam Sankara, babyarana abahungu babiri, Philippe na Auguste.

Roch Marc Christian Kaboré (yavutse ku ya 25 Mata 1957 i Ouagadougou) ni umucungamari w'amabanki akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaburukina, wabaye Perezida wa Burukina Faso kuva ku ya 29 Ukuboza 2015 kugeza ahiritswe n'igisirikare ku ya 24 Mutarama 2022. Yize ubukungu mu Bufaransa, ayobora banki ya Banque internationale du Burkina (BIB), hanyuma aba minisitiri inshuro nyinshi ku butegetsi bwa Blaise Compaoré. Yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe kuva mu 1994 kugeza mu 1996, mu gihe cy'igabanywa ry'agaciro k'ifaranga rya CFA, hanyuma aba Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko kuva mu 2002 kugeza mu 2012. Mu 2014, yavuye mu ishyaka rya Compaoré, ashinga ishyaka rya Mouvement du peuple pour le progrès (MPP). Yatsinze amatora ya perezida ya 2015 ku cyiciro cya mbere, aba perezida wa mbere mu myaka 49 utari ufitanye isano n'igisirikare, yongera gutorwa mu 2020. Ubutegetsi bwe bwaranzwe n'ibitero by'imitwe y'iterabwoba, maze muri Mutarama 2022 ahirikwa na kudeta iyobowe na Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Kaboré yavukiye i Ouagadougou, mu muryango w'Abamosi b'Abakristo Gatolika. Se, Charles Bila Kaboré, yari umwarimu waje kuba Minisitiri w'Imari n'uw'Ubuzima ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Maurice Yaméogo, hanyuma visi-guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y'Ibihugu bya Afurika y'Iburengerazuba (BCEAO). Yize amashuri yisumbuye mu ishuri rya Saint-Jean-Baptiste-de-la-Salle i Ouagadougou, kuva mu 1968 kugeza mu 1975. Yize ubukungu muri Kaminuza ya Dijon, mu Ubufaransa, ahabona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri mu 1979 n'iy'icyiciro cya gatatu mu micungire mu 1980. Muri icyo gihe, yari umuyoboke w'ihuriro ry'abanyeshuri b'Abirabura b'Abanyafurika mu Bufaransa (FEANF).
Umwuga mu mabanki na politiki.
Agarutse mu gihugu, mu gihe cy'impinduramatwara ya Thomas Sankara, Kaboré yari umuyoboke w'umutwe wa politiki w'ibumoso, ULC-R. Mu 1984, afite imyaka 27, yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru wa Banque internationale du Burkina (BIB), imwe mu banki nkuru z'igihugu, kugeza muri Nzeri 1989. Muri uwo mwaka, Perezida Blaise Compaoré yamugize Minisitiri w'Ubwikorezi n'Itumanaho. Mu 1992, yatorewe kuba umudepite uhagarariye intara ya Kadiogo, hanyuma aba Minisitiri w'Imari n'Igenamigambi kuva mu 1992 kugeza mu 1993.
Ku ya 20 Werurwe 1994, nyuma y'igabanywa ry'agaciro k'ifaranga rya CFA ryateje izamuka rikabije ry'ibiciro, Compaoré yamugize Minisitiri w'Intebe. Muri Gashyantare 1996, ubwo ishyaka rishya rya Congrès pour la démocratie et le progrès (CDP) ryashingwaga, yeguye ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe, aba visi-perezida wa mbere w'iryo shyaka n'umujyanama wihariye wa perezida. Ku ya 6 Kamena 2002, yatorewe kuyobora Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, asimbura Mélégué Traoré, kandi yongera gutorerwa uwo mwanya mu 2007. Muri Kanama 2003, yabaye perezida wa CDP.
Kuva muri CDP no gushinga MPP.
Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2010, Kaboré yagiye ashyirwa ku ruhande muri CDP. Ku ya 6 Mutarama 2014, we n'abandi bayobozi bakomeye b'ishyaka, Simon Compaoré na Salif Diallo, beguye muri CDP, bamagana imiyoborere idaha abandi ijambo n'umugambi wo guhindura Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo Blaise Compaoré ashobore kongera kwiyamamaza mu 2015. Ku ya 25 Mutarama 2014, bashinze ishyaka rya Mouvement du peuple pour le progrès (MPP), riyoborwa na Kaboré. Mu mpera z'Ukwakira 2014, imyigaragambyo y'abaturage yahiritse Blaise Compaoré.
Perezida wa Burukina Faso.
Mu matora ya perezida yo ku ya 29 Ugushyingo 2015, Kaboré yatsinze ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 53,49%, imbere ya Zéphirin Diabré. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku ya 29 Ukuboza 2015, asimbura Michel Kafando wari perezida w'inzibacyuho. Yagize Paul Kaba Thiéba Minisitiri w'Intebe, ndetse afata n'inshingano za Minisitiri w'Ingabo kugeza mu 2017.
Ibyumweru bibiri nyuma yo kurahira, ku ya 15 Mutarama 2016, igitero cy'iterabwoba cyagabwe kuri resitora na hoteli i Ouagadougou, cyigambwe n'umutwe wa Al-Qaïda mu Majyaruguru ya Afurika (AQMI), gihitana abantu mirongo itatu. Ibindi bitero byakurikiyeho mu majyaruguru y'igihugu, hafi y'imipaka na Mali na Nigeri. Guverinoma ye yashyizeho ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe ubutasi, kandi Burukina Faso ifatanya n'ibihugu by'akarere mu itsinda rya G5 Sahel. Muri Mutarama 2019, Minisitiri w'Intebe Thiéba yeguye, asimburwa na Christophe Dabiré. Ku ya 22 Ugushyingo 2020, Kaboré yongeye gutorwa ku cyiciro cya mbere n'amajwi 57,87%.
Ihirikwa ry'ubutegetsi.
Ku ya 14 Ugushyingo 2021, abarwanyi b'imitwe ya kisilamu bateye ikigo cya gisirikare cya Inata, bica abasirikare 53 n'abasivili 4; ibyo byateje imyigaragambyo isaba ko Kaboré yegura, kubera ko ubutegetsi bwe bwananiwe kurinda abaturage. Ku ya 23 Mutarama 2022, abasirikare bigometse, maze bukeye Kaboré afatwa, ahirikwa ku butegetsi, Itegeko Nshinga rihagarikwa, maze Liyetona-Koloneli Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba aba umukuru w'igihugu. Umutwe wa gisirikare wakoze kudeta watangaje ibaruwa yanditswe n'intoki n'uwahoze ari perezida, yegura «ku bw'inyungu z'igihugu». Nk'uko Perezida wa Kote Divuwari, Alassane Ouattara, abivuga, Kaboré yahisemo kwegura kugira ngo yirinde imirwano hagati y'abasirikare. Yabanje gufungirwa mu kigo cya gisirikare, hanyuma iwe ; nyuma y'igitutu cya CEDEAO, yararekuwe muri Mata 2022.
Kaboré yashakanye na Sika Bella Kaboré, bamenyaniye mu Bufaransa ari abanyeshuri; bashyingiranwe mu 1982, bafitanye abana batatu.

Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba (yavutse mu Mutarama 1981 i Ouagadougou) ni umusirikare w'Umunyaburukina, wafite ipeti rya liyetona-koloneli, wabaye Perezida w'inzibacyuho wa Burukina Faso kuva ku ya 31 Mutarama kugeza ku ya 30 Nzeri 2022. Ku ya 24 Mutarama 2022, ayoboye umutwe wa gisirikare wiswe Mouvement patriotique pour la sauvegarde et la restauration (MPSR), yahiritse ku butegetsi Perezida Roch Marc Christian Kaboré, amushinja kunanirwa kurwanya imitwe y'iterabwoba. Nyuma y'amezi umunani gusa, ku ya 30 Nzeri 2022, na we yahiritswe n'undi musirikare, Kapiteni Ibrahim Traoré, maze ahungira muri Togo. Muri Mutarama 2026, yafatiwe i Lomé, yoherezwa muri Burukina Faso, aho akurikiranyweho ibyaha bitandukanye.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Damiba yavukiye i Ouagadougou mu Mutarama 1981. Yize mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Kadiogo ("Prytanée militaire de Kadiogo"), mu kiciro cyo mu 1992, no mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Georges Namoano i Pô. Yarangije amasomo mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya Paris ("École militaire"), aho yahuriye na Mamadi Doumbouya, waje kuyobora Gineya. Afite impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu bumenyi bw'ibyaha yakuye muri Conservatoire national des arts et métiers (CNAM) i Paris, n'impamyabumenyi y'impuguke mu micungire, ubuyobozi n'ingamba za gisirikare. Kuva mu 2010 kugeza mu 2020, yitabiriye amahugurwa menshi ya gisirikare yateguwe na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, nk'imyitozo ya Flintlock.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Damiba yahoze ari umwe mu bagize umutwe w'abarinzi ba perezida ("Régiment de sécurité présidentielle", RSP) wa Blaise Compaoré, awuvamo mu 2011 nyuma y'imyivumbagatanyo y'abasirikare. Mu 2019, yatanze ubuhamya mu rubanza rw'abagize uruhare muri kudeta yo mu 2015.
Kuva mu 2015 kugeza mu 2019, yayoboye abasirikare mu turere twa Sahel (i Dori) n'Amajyaruguru (i Ouahigouya), aho imitwe y'abarwanyi ba kisilamu yakoreraga. Mu 2021, yasohoye igitabo kivuga ku rugamba rwo kurwanya iterabwoba, "Armées ouest-africaines et terrorisme: réponses incertaines ?". Yamenyekanye kubera ibikorwa bye mu rugamba rwo kurwanya iyo mitwe, ndetse asaba ko guverinoma yakwitabaza abacancuro b'Abarusiya bo mu itsinda rya Wagner, ariko guverinoma ya Kaboré irabyanga. Mu Ukuboza 2021, nyuma y'igitero cy'iterabwoba ku kigo cya Inata cyahitanye abajandarume benshi, Perezida Kaboré yamugize umuyobozi w'akarere ka gatatu ka gisirikare, karimo Ouagadougou, Manga, Koudougou na Fada N'Gourma.
Perezida w'inzibacyuho.
Ku ya 24 Mutarama 2022, Damiba yayoboye kudeta yahiritse Perezida Kaboré na Minisitiri w'Intebe Lassina Zerbo. Abasirikare batangaje iseswa ry'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko na guverinoma, n'ihagarikwa ry'Itegeko Nshinga. Iyo kudeta yakiriwe neza n'abaturage benshi, bamwe bazamura amabendera y'Uburusiya. Ku ya 31 Mutarama, itegeko shingiro ryagaruye Itegeko Nshinga, rimuha umwanya wa Perezida ; Inama y'Itegeko Nshinga yamwemeje ku ya 10 Gashyantare, maze arahira ku ya 16 Gashyantare 2022. Ku ya 1 Werurwe, hemejwe amasezerano y'inzibacyuho y'imyaka itatu, maze ku ya 3 Werurwe agira Albert Ouédraogo Minisitiri w'Intebe.
Nubwo yari yiyemeje kugarura umutekano, ubutegetsi bwe ntibwashoboye gutsinda imitwe y'iterabwoba, yaje kugenzura hafi 40% by'igihugu muri Nzeri 2022. Nyuma y'ibitero bikomeye, ku ya 12 Nzeri 2022 yirukanye Minisitiri w'Ingabo, yifatira iyo minisiteri. Yakunze kugaragara yambaye ingofero itukura, bamwe babona ko yigana Thomas Sankara.
Ihirikwa n'ubuhungiro.
Ku ya 30 Nzeri 2022, abasirikare batishimiye imiyoborere ye, bayobowe na Kapiteni Ibrahim Traoré, baramuhiritse. Ubutegetsi bushya bwabanje kumushinja kugerageza guhungira mu kigo cya gisirikare cy'Abafaransa kugira ngo ategure kudeta, ibyo arabihakana. Ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2022, nyuma y'ubuhuza bw'abayobozi b'amadini n'aba gakondo, yemeye kwegura, asaba ingwate zirindwi, zirimo umutekano we n'uw'abamushyigikiye, maze ahungira muri Togo.
Muri Nyakanga 2024, yandikiye Ibrahim Traoré ibaruwa agaragaza impungenge ku iyongera ry'umutekano muke n'ihohoterwa rishobora gukorerwa abasivili. Muri Nzeri 2024, ubutegetsi bwa gisirikare bwamushinje gutegura umugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi, maze mu Ugushyingo 2024 avanwa mu ngabo hamwe n'abandi basirikare bakuru 15. Ku ya 16 Mutarama 2026, yafatiwe i Lomé, yoherezwa muri Burukina Faso, aho akurikiranyweho ibyaha birimo kunyereza umutungo wa leta n'ibikorwa byo guhungabanya umutekano.

Blaise Compaoré (yavutse ku ya 3 Gashyantare 1951 i Ziniaré) ni umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyaburukina, wabaye Perezida wa Burukina Faso kuva mu 1987 kugeza mu 2014, akaba ari we wayoboye icyo gihugu igihe kirekire kurusha abandi. Yari inshuti magara n'umwungirije wa Thomas Sankara, wamugize Minisitiri w'Ubutabera mu 1985, ariko ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1987 ayobora kudeta yaguyemo Sankara, maze afata ubutegetsi. Yasimbuje politiki y'impinduramatwara ya Sankara iyo yise «ikosora», agarura umubano mwiza n'Ubufaransa na Kote Divuwari. Yatsinze amatora ya 1991, 1998, 2005 na 2010, atafatwaga nk'ayakozwe mu bwisanzure n'ubutabera. Mu Ukwakira 2014, umugambi we wo guhindura Itegeko Nshinga kugira ngo yongere kwiyamamaza wateje imyigaragambyo ikomeye y'abaturage, bimuhatira kwegura no guhungira muri Kote Divuwari. Muri Mata 2022, yakatiwe adahari igifungo cya burundu, nyuma yo guhamwa n'icyaha cyo kugira uruhare mu iyicwa rya Sankara.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Blaise Compaoré yavukiye i Ziniaré, mu majyaruguru ya Ouagadougou, ku ya 3 Gashyantare 1951. Ni imfura mu bana barindwi; se, Bila Maurice Compaoré, yari yarabaye umusirikare mu ngabo z'Abafaransa mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Yize mu ishuri Gatolika i Fada N'Gourma, hanyuma i Ouagadougou. Nyuma y'urupfu rw'ababyeyi be, yabaye inshuti magara y'umuryango wa Thomas Sankara, ndetse se wa Sankara amufata nk'umwana we.
Mu 1971, nyuma y'imyigaragambyo y'abanyeshuri, yinjijwe ku ngufu mu gisirikare, maze ahitamo kuwugira umwuga. Mu 1973, yinjiye mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare rya Yaoundé, muri Kameruni, hanyuma akurikirana amahugurwa menshi mu Ubufaransa no muri Maroke. Mu 1981, yabaye umuyobozi w'ikigo cy'igihugu cy'imyitozo y'abakomando i Pô, maze mu 1982 aba kapiteni.
Mu butegetsi bwa Sankara.
Ku ya 4 Kanama 1983, Compaoré yayoboye abasirikare b'i Pô bashyize Thomas Sankara ku butegetsi. Ku butegetsi bwa Sankara, yari umwungirije, umwe mu bagize Inama y'Igihugu y'Impinduramatwara, Minisitiri wa Leta muri Perezidansi, hanyuma Minisitiri w'Ubutabera kuva mu 1985. Mu ntambara ya Agacher na Mali yo mu Ukuboza 1985, yayoboye abasirikare ba Burukina Faso.
Perezida wa Burukina Faso.
Ku ya 15 Ukwakira 1987, Compaoré yafashe ubutegetsi muri kudeta yaguyemo Thomas Sankara n'abandi bantu cumi na babiri. Yavuze ko Sankara «yagambaniye impinduramatwara», atangiza politiki y'«ikosora» ("rectification"), yagaruye umubano mwiza na Kote Divuwari n'Ubufaransa. Nyuma y'igihe gito, abandi bahoze ari bagenzi be mu butegetsi bwa Sankara, Henri Zongo na Jean-Baptiste Boukary Lingani, barishwe bashinjwa umugambi wo kumuhirika. Mu Mata 2006, Komite ya Loni ishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu yamaganye Burukina Faso kubera kwanga gukora iperereza ku rupfu rwa Sankara.
Mu 1989, Compaoré yashinze ishyaka rya Organisation pour la démocratie populaire/Mouvement du travail (ODP/MT), ryaje kwihuza n'andi mashyaka cumi n'abiri, rikabyara Congrès pour la démocratie et le progrès (CDP) ku ya 5 Gashyantare 1996. Ku ya 1 Ukuboza 1991, yatorewe kuba Perezida mu matora yanzwe n'abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, abaturage 25% gusa bakaba ari bo bitabiriye. Yongeye gutorwa ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 1998. Iminsi mike nyuma y'ayo matora, ku ya 13 Ukuboza 1998, umunyamakuru Norbert Zongo, wakoraga iperereza ku rupfu rw'umushoferi wa murumuna wa perezida, François Compaoré, yiciwe hamwe n'abandi bantu batatu; urwo rupfu rwateje imyigaragambyo ikomeye.
Mu 2005, nubwo Itegeko Nshinga ryavuguruwe mu 2000 ryagabanyaga manda za perezida, Inama y'Itegeko Nshinga yamwemereye kongera kwiyamamaza, maze ku ya 13 Ugushyingo 2005 yongera gutorwa n'amajwi 80,35%. Mu matora yo mu Ugushyingo 2010, yatorewe manda ya nyuma n'amajwi 80,15%. Mu 2011, urupfu rw'umunyeshuri wakubiswe n'abapolisi i Koudougou rwateje imyigaragambyo n'imyivumbagatanyo y'abasirikare mu gihugu hose.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Ubutegetsi bwa Compaoré bwashinjwe gushyigikira imitwe yitwaje intwaro mu karere: bwafashije Charles Taylor mu ntambara y'abenegihugu ya Liberiya, buhereza intwaro inyeshyamba za RUF muri Siyera Lewone, kandi bushyigikira inyeshyamba za Forces nouvelles muri Kote Divuwari. Nanone kandi, Compaoré yabaye umuhuza mu bibazo by'akarere: yayoboye ibiganiro hagati y'Abanyatogo mu 2006, ibiganiro byatumye hasinywa amasezerano y'amahoro ya Ouagadougou hagati ya Laurent Gbagbo na Guillaume Soro ku ya 4 Werurwe 2007, ndetse n'ibiganiro bijyanye na kudeta yo muri Mali mu 2012. Mu 2014, BBC yavuze ko yari umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye w'Ubufaransa na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika mu karere.
Impinduramatwara yo mu 2014.
Mu Ukwakira 2014, Compaoré yashakaga guhindura ingingo ya 37 y'Itegeko Nshinga, igabanya umubare wa manda za perezida, kugira ngo yiyamamarize manda ya gatanu mu 2015. Ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2014, ubwo Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yiteguraga gutora iryo vugurura, imyigaragambyo ikomeye yadutse i Ouagadougou no mu yindi mijyi; abigaragambyaga batwitse inyubako y'Inteko, maze ihohoterwa ry'inzego z'umutekano rihitana nibura abantu 30. Bukeye, ku ya 31 Ukwakira 2014, Compaoré yeguye, kuko ingabo zitari zikimushyigikiye. Afashijwe n'Ubufaransa, yahungiye muri Kote Divuwari, aho yahawe ubwenegihugu.
Urubanza rw'iyicwa rya Sankara.
Kuva mu Ukuboza 2015, ubutabera bwa gisirikare bwa Burukina Faso bwasohoye impapuro mpuzamahanga zo kumuta muri yombi kubera uruhare akekwaho mu iyicwa rya Sankara. Muri Mata 2021, yarezwe adahari, maze urubanza rutangira ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2021 ; Compaoré yanze kujya kuburanira i Ouagadougou, kandi Kote Divuwari ntiyashoboraga kumwohereza kuko ari umwenegihugu wayo. Ku ya 6 Mata 2022, yahamwe n'ibyaha byo kugira uruhare mu bwicanyi no guhungabanya umutekano w'igihugu, akatirwa adahari igifungo cya burundu.
Muri Nyakanga 2022, Compaoré yagarutse by'igihe gito muri Burukina Faso ku butumire bwa Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba, ariko ntiyatabwa muri yombi, hanyuma asubira muri Kote Divuwari. Muri uko kwezi, mu ibaruwa yashyizwe ahagaragara, yasabye imbabazi Abanyaburukina, atavuze neza ibyaha yakoze.
Mu 1985, Compaoré yashakanye na Chantal Terrasson de Fougères, Umufaransa-Umunyakotedivuwari; bafitanye umukobwa umwe, Djamila. Kuva yahunga, aba i Abidjan.

Robert Gabriel Karigamombe Mugabe (yavutse ku ya 21 Gashyantare 1924 i Kutama, apfa ku ya 6 Nzeri 2019 i Singapore) yari umunyapolitiki wa Zimbabwe, wabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe kuva mu 1980 kugeza mu 1987, hanyuma Perezida wa Repubulika kuva mu 1987 kugeza mu 2017. Umwarimu wari ufite ibitekerezo bya gikomunisiti, yafatanyije gushinga ishyaka rya Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU), maze ayobora urugamba rw'inyeshyamba rwo kurwanya ubutegetsi bw'Abazungu bake bwa Ian Smith muri Rodeziya, bimugira umwe mu «babyeyi b'ubwigenge» bwa Zimbabwe. Mu myaka ya mbere y'ubutegetsi bwe, yateje imbere cyane uburezi n'ubuzima, ariko ashinjwa ubwicanyi bwa "Gukurahundi" bwibasiye Abandebele mu myaka ya 1980. Kuva mu myaka ya 2000, ivugurura ry'ubutaka ryambuye ku ngufu abahinzi b'Abazungu, ihonyorwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu, ubushomeri n'izamuka rikabije ry'ibiciro byashegeshe igihugu, bituma ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba bimufatira ibihano. Mu Ugushyingo 2017, afite imyaka 93, yahatiwe kwegura nyuma ya kudeta y'igisirikare, maze apfa nyuma y'imyaka ibiri.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere n'amashuri.
Robert Mugabe yavukiye ku ya 21 Gashyantare 1924, akurira mu misiyoni Gatolika y'Abayezuwiti ya Kutama, mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bwa Salisbury (ubu ni Harare). Se, wari waraturutse muri Nyasaland (ubu ni Malawi), yataye umuryango Mugabe afite imyaka icumi, maze arerwa na nyina, Umushona. Yakuze akunda gusoma no kwiga.
Amaze kuba umwarimu afite imyaka 17, yize icyongereza n'amateka muri Kaminuza ya Fort Hare, muri Afurika y’Epfo, aho yahuriye n'abayobozi b'ahazaza nka Julius Nyerere na Kenneth Kaunda; yarangije mu 1951. Nyuma yaho, yabonye impamyabumenyi zindi zirimo iy'ubukungu muri Kaminuza ya Londres, yize ari kure. Yigishije muri Zambiya, hanyuma i Accra, muri Gana, aho yahuriye na Sally Hayfron, waje kuba umugore we.
Urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu.
Mu 1960, Mugabe yagarutse muri Rodeziya y'Amajyepfo afite ibitekerezo bya gikomunisiti, yinjira mu ishyaka rya Joshua Nkomo ryaje kwitwa Zimbabwe African People's Union (ZAPU). Mu 1963, yashinze ishyaka rye bwite, ZANU, hamwe na Ndabaningi Sithole na Herbert Chitepo, aba umunyamabanga mukuru waryo. ZAPU na ZANU byakomeje gutandukanywa n'amoko: Abandebele ku ruhande rumwe, Abashona ku rundi. Mu 1964, Mugabe yarafashwe, afungwa imyaka icumi; muri gereza, yize amategeko, maze mu 1974 aba umuyobozi wa ZANU. Muri icyo gihe, umuhungu we w'imyaka itatu yarapfuye, ariko ubutegetsi bwa Ian Smith bwanga ko ajya kumushyingura.
Amaze kurekurwa mu Ugushyingo 1974, Mugabe yahungiye muri Mozambike, aho yayoboye ingabo za ZANU, ZANLA, mu ntambara y'inyeshyamba yo kurwanya ubutegetsi bwa Ian Smith, afashijwe na FRELIMO. Iyo ntambara yahitanye abantu bari hagati ya 20 000 na 30 000. Mu Ukuboza 1979, amasezerano ya Lancaster House yatumye habaho amatora y'amoko yose mu 1980, ariko akomeza guha Abazungu uburenganzira bwihariye, harimo kimwe cya gatanu cy'imyanya mu Nteko n'umwanya wabo ku butaka mu gihe cy'imyaka icumi. Muri Werurwe 1980, ishyaka rya ZANU ryatsinze amatora, ryegukana imyanya 57 kuri 80 yagenewe Abirabura.
Minisitiri w'Intebe (1980–1987).
Ku ya 18 Mata 1980, Zimbabwe ibonye ubwigenge, Mugabe yabaye Minisitiri w'Intebe, mu gihe Canaan Banana yabaye Perezida. Mu ijambo rye, yasabye ubwiyunge, avuga ko ikibi gikomeza kuba ikibi, cyaba gikozwe n'Umuzungu ku Mwirabura cyangwa n'Umwirabura ku Muzungu; yashyize n'abaminisitiri babiri b'Abazungu muri guverinoma. Mu 1982, Salisbury yahinduriwe izina iba Harare. Ubutegetsi bwe bwashoye imari nyinshi mu buzima n'uburezi: hagati ya 1980 na 1988, umubare w'abana bakingiwe wavuye kuri 25% ugera kuri 67%, kandi abiga mu mashuri abanza bariyongera cyane nyuma y'uko uburezi bw'ibanze buba ubuntu.
Mu 1983, imyivumbagatanyo mu ntara ya Matabeleland yashyize iherezo ku bufatanye bwa ZANU na ZAPU. Mugabe yohereje burigade ya gatanu y'ingabo, yari yaratojwe n'abarimu bo muri Koreya ya Ruguru; mu bikorwa byiswe "Gukurahundi", abasivili b'Abandebele babarirwa mu bihumbi barishwe. Mu 1987, amasezerano y'amahoro yatumye ZAPU yihuza na ZANU, havuka ishyaka rya ZANU–PF, maze Mugabe aba Perezida ufite ububasha bwagutse, umwanya wa Minisitiri w'Intebe ukurwaho.
Perezida wa Zimbabwe (1987–2017).
Mu 1988, Mugabe yagize Joshua Nkomo visi-perezida. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, yemeye amabwiriza ya FMI na Banki y'Isi, agabanya amafaranga leta isohora n'imirimo myinshi ya leta, ibyo byateje ubushomeri n'umujinya mu baturage. Mu 1998, mu ntambara ya kabiri ya Kongo, yohereje abasirikare 20 000 gushyigikira Laurent-Désiré Kabila muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Ivugurura ry'ubutaka.
Igihe Mugabe yafataga ubutegetsi, 40% by'ubutaka bwo guhinga byari mu maboko y'abahinzi b'Abazungu 6 000. Mu 2000, kamarampaka ku Itegeko Nshinga rishya ryari kwemera kwambura ubutaka nta ngurane yatsinzwe n'amajwi 54,7%; ariko Mugabe yashyize mu bikorwa iryo vugurura akoresheje imitwe y'abiyita abahoze ari abarwanyi, bigarurira imirima, bamwe mu bahinzi b'Abazungu baricwa. Abazungu benshi bavuye mu gihugu: umubare wabo wavuye ku 250 000 mu 1980 ugera ku 40 000 mu 2015. Iryo vugurura ryagabanyije cyane umusaruro w'ubuhinzi, maze igihugu cyari kizwiho kohereza ibigori mu mahanga gitangira kubitumiza. Mugabe yanavuze amagambo menshi yafashwe nk'ay'ivangura rishingiye ku ruhu ryibasira Abazungu.
Igitugu n'ibihano mpuzamahanga.
Kuva mu 2000, ubutegetsi bwe bwakaje ihonyorwa ry'abatavuga rumwe na bwo, cyane cyane ishyaka rishya rya Movement for Democratic Change (MDC) rya Morgan Tsvangirai, n'ubwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru. Mu 2005, mu gikorwa cyiswe "Murambatsvina", abantu bagera ku 700 000 birukanwe mu nzu zabo i Harare. Mu 2002, ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba byamufatiye ibihano, kandi Zimbabwe ihagarikwa mu Muryango wa Commonwealth, maze mu 2003 Mugabe ayivanamo burundu. Yamaganwe na Desmond Tutu, wamwise «igisekeje cy'umunyagitugu w'Umunyafurika», nubwo bamwe mu bayobozi b'Afurika bakomeje kumushyigikira kubera urugamba rwe rwo kurwanya ubukoloni. Yarwanyaga yivuye inyuma abaryamana bahuje ibitsina.
Ubukungu bw'igihugu bwarashegeshwe: mu 2008, izamuka ry'ibiciro ryageze hafi kuri 165 000% ku mwaka, kandi bane mu bantu bakuru batanu nta kazi bari bafite.
Amatora ya 2008 n'aya 2013.
Mu matora ya perezida yo mu 2008, icyiciro cya mbere cyatsinzwe na Morgan Tsvangirai n'amajwi 47,9%, kuri 43,2% ya Mugabe. Nyuma y'urugomo rwakorewe abamushyigikiye, Tsvangirai yavuye mu cyiciro cya kabiri, maze Mugabe atorwa wenyine; Umuryango w'Afurika Yunze Ubumwe wavuze ko ayo matora atubahirije amahame ya demokarasi, usaba ko hashyirwaho guverinoma y'ubumwe. Ku ya 31 Nyakanga 2013, Mugabe yongeye gutorwa, nubwo hagaragaye amakosa menshi. Mu Ukuboza 2014, yirukanye Visi-Perezida Joice Mujuru, amusimbuza Emmerson Mnangagwa.
Mu 2017, Mugabe wari umaze kugira imyaka 93, yagaragaje ubushake bwo kuzasimburwa n'umugore we, Grace Mugabe. Ku ya 6 Ugushyingo 2017, yirukanye Visi-Perezida Mnangagwa, ibyo bitashimishije ingabo. Ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2017, ingabo zafashe ubutegetsi, Mugabe n'umugore we bafungirwa iwabo. Ku ya 18 Ugushyingo, ibihumbi by'abaturage bigaragambije i Harare basaba ko yegura, maze ku ya 19 Ugushyingo ZANU–PF imwirukana ku buyobozi bwayo. Ku ya 21 Ugushyingo 2017, ubwo Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yatangiraga inzira yo kumweguza, Mugabe yatanze ibaruwa yegura, asimburwa na Mnangagwa.
Nyuma y'ubutegetsi n'urupfu.
Mnangagwa yamwise «umubyeyi w'igihugu», kandi itariki y'amavuko ye, 21 Gashyantare, igirwa umunsi w'ikiruhuko. Ariko Mugabe yakomeje kuvuga ko yahiritswe na kudeta. Ku ya 6 Nzeri 2019, yaguye mu bitaro i Singapore, aho yari amaze amezi ane avurwa kanseri, afite imyaka 95. Nyuma y'impaka hagati ya guverinoma n'umuryango we, yashyinguwe mu mudugudu w'iwabo wa Kutama ku ya 28 Nzeri 2019. ZANU–PF yamuhaye icyubahiro cy'«intwari y'igihugu».
Mu 1961, Mugabe yashakanye na Sally Hayfron, wakomokaga muri Gana; umwana wabo w'umuhungu, Michael, yapfuye mu 1966. Sally yapfuye mu 1992, maze mu 1996 Mugabe ashakana na Grace Marufu, bari bafitanye abana babiri, Bona na Robert, kandi babyarana undi mwana, Chatunga, mu 1997. Yari Umukristo Gatolika.

Mobutu Sese Seko Kuku Ngbendu wa Za Banga (amazina y'amavuko: Joseph-Désiré Mobutu; yavutse ku ya 14 Ukwakira 1930 i Lisala, apfa ku ya 7 Nzeri 1997 i Rabat) yari umusirikare akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyekongo, wayoboye Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuva mu 1965, akayihindurira izina ikitwa Zayire mu 1971, kugeza mu 1997. Yafashe ubutegetsi muri kudeta yo mu 1965, ashyiraho ubutegetsi bw'ishyaka rimwe, Mouvement populaire de la révolution (MPR), n'umuco wo kumuramya. Mu rwego rwa politiki y'«umwimerere» ("authenticité"), yahinduye amazina y'igihugu, ay'umugezi n'ay'ifaranga, ndetse n'amazina y'abaturage. Ku butegetsi bwe, uburenganzira bwa muntu bwarahonyowe cyane, kandi ruswa yari ikabije ku buryo ubutegetsi bwe bwiswe «ubutegetsi bw'abajura» ("kleptocratie"). Mu gihe cy'Intambara y'Ubutita, ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba, cyane cyane Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, Ubufaransa n'Ububiligi, byaramushyigikiye kubera ko yarwanyaga ubukomunisiti. Muri Gicurasi 1997, inyeshyamba za AFDL ziyobowe na Laurent-Désiré Kabila zaramuhiritse, maze apfira mu buhungiro muri Maroke nyuma y'amezi atatu.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Joseph-Désiré Mobutu yavukiye i Lisala mu 1930, mu bwoko bw'Abangbandi. Nyina, Marie Madeleine Yemo, yari umukozi wo mu rugo, naho se, Albéric Gbemani, yari umutetsi w'umucamanza w'Umubiligi. Se yapfuye Mobutu afite imyaka umunani. Yize mu ishuri ry'abafurere Gatolika i Coquilhatville (ubu ni Mbandaka) ; yakundaga gusoma ibitabo by'amateka.
Mu 1950, yinjiye mu ngabo z'abakoloni ("Force publique"), aho yabaye su-ofisiye, akazivamo mu 1956. Nyuma yaho, yabaye umunyamakuru mu kinyamakuru "L'Avenir" cy'i Léopoldville (ubu ni Kinshasa). Mu 1957, yahuye na Patrice Lumumba, maze mu ntangiriro za 1960 yinjira mu ishyaka rye, Mouvement national congolais (MNC).
Muri Nyakanga 1960, igihugu kibona ubwigenge, Mobutu yabaye umunyamabanga wa leta muri guverinoma ya Patrice Lumumba, hanyuma umugaba wungirije w'ingabo. Mu gihe cy'amakimbirane hagati ya Lumumba na Perezida Joseph Kasa-Vubu, ku ya 14 Nzeri 1960 Mobutu yakoze kudeta ya mbere, ahirika guverinoma ya Lumumba yari yaratowe, ashyigikiwe na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'Ububiligi; guverinoma yashyizeho yatanze Lumumba muri Katanga, aho yiciwe ku ya 17 Mutarama 1961. Muri Mutarama 1961, yagizwe jenerali-majoro. Mu 1964–1965, ingabo zayobowe na Mobutu, zifashijwe n'Abanyamerika, zatsinze imyivumbagatanyo y'aba Simba n'iya Kwilu yari yigaruriye igice kinini cy'igihugu.
Ku ya 24 Ugushyingo 1965, Mobutu yakoze kudeta ya kabiri yahiritse Perezida Kasa-Vubu, afata ubutegetsi ubwe. Yatangaje ko nta bikorwa by'amashyaka bizabaho mu myaka itanu. Ububiligi na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika ni byo byabaye ibya mbere mu kwemera ubutegetsi bwe.
Ubutegetsi bw'ishyaka rimwe.
Muri Kamena 1966, abahoze ari abaminisitiri bane, barimo uwahoze ari Minisitiri w'Intebe Évariste Kimba, bamanitswe mu ruhame, bashinjwa umugambi wo guhirika ubutegetsi. Mu 1967, yashinze ishyaka rimwe ryemewe, Mouvement populaire de la révolution (MPR), rifite intero ivuga ko ritari «iburyo cyangwa ibumoso». Amashyirahamwe y'abakozi yahujwe mu rimwe rigenzurwa na leta. Yashyizeho imitwe myinshi y'ingabo ishinzwe kumurinda, nka Division spéciale présidentielle. Mu matora, yatorwaga ku majwi hafi yose; mu matora amwe, amajwi yarenze umubare w'abatora banditse. Mu 1983, yiyitiriye ipeti rya mareshali.
Politiki y'«umwimerere».
Mu 1971, Mobutu yahinduye izina ry'igihugu, iry'umugezi wa Kongo n'iry'ifaranga, abyita «Zayire». Yategetse abaturage gufata amazina y'Abanyafurika aho kuba ay'Abakristo, maze mu 1972 na we yiyita Mobutu Sese Seko Kuku Ngbendu wa Za Banga, bisobanura «intwari ishobora byose, igenda itsinda». Yaretse imyambaro ya gisirikare, yambara ikote ryiswe "abacost" («hasi ikoti») n'ingofero y'uruhu rw'ingwe.
Mu myaka ya mbere, ubukungu bwari bwifashe neza kubera umutungo kamere w'igihugu, ariko imishinga minini ihenze, igabanuka ry'igiciro cy'umuringa n'ubwigarurire bw'ibigo by'abanyamahanga bwiswe «zairianisation» mu 1973 byashegeshe ubukungu. Mobutu yashyizeho uburyo bwo kugura abamushyigikira binyuze mu gutanga imyanya n'amafaranga, kandi ruswa iba ikintu gisanzwe mu nzego zose. Abaturage benshi bari mu bukene, mu gihe we yakusanyije umutungo ugereranywa hagati ya miliyoni 50 na miliyari 5 z'amadolari. Mu 1991, ikinyamakuru "The Washington Post" cyavuze ko yanyereje hafi miliyari 5 z'amadolari. Yari afite amazu y'agaciro kenshi mu Burayi, ndetse yubakisha ingoro i Gbadolite, yiswe «Versailles y'ishyamba», n'ikibuga cy'indege gishobora kwakira indege ya Concorde, yakundaga gukodesha mu ngendo ze.
Ububanyi n'amahanga.
Mobutu yari inshuti ikomeye y'ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba mu kurwanya ubukomunisiti muri Afurika, ashyigikirwa cyane na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, Ubufaransa n'Ububiligi. Yagiranye kandi umubano ukomeye na Afurika y'Epfo y'ivanguraruhu, Isirayeli n'uBushinwa. Mu ntambara y'abenegihugu ya Angola, yashyigikiye inyeshyamba za FNLA na UNITA zarwanyaga MPLA. Mu 1977 no mu 1978, ubwo inyeshyamba zaturutse muri Angola zateraga intara ya Shaba, Ubufaransa n'Ububiligi byohereje ingabo zo kumutabara. Perezida Ronald Reagan yamushimiye mu 1983.
Intambara y'Ubutita imaze kurangira, ibihugu by'Iburengerazuba byaretse kumushyigikira. Muri Mata 1990, yemeye amashyaka menshi, maze Inama y'Igihugu yashyizeho itangira kunenga ubutegetsi bwe. Mu 1993, igihugu cyari gifite guverinoma ebyiri, imwe imushyigikiye n'indi iyobowe na Étienne Tshisekedi.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, abasirikare n'abarwanyi bayigizemo uruhare bahungiye mu burasirazuba bwa Zayire, bitwikira impunzi, bituma akarere kose kajya mu mutekano muke. Mu 1996, inyeshyamba za Alliance des forces démocratiques pour la libération du Congo (AFDL), ziyobowe na Laurent-Désiré Kabila kandi zishyigikiwe n'u Rwanda n'Ubugande, zatangiye intambara ya mbere ya Kongo. Nubwo Nelson Mandela yagerageje kumuhuza na Kabila, inyeshyamba zinjiye i Kinshasa ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1997, maze ku ya 23 Gicurasi igihugu cyongera kwitwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Mobutu yabanje guhungira muri Togo, ariko Perezida Gnassingbé Eyadéma amusaba kuvayo nyuma y'iminsi mike ; yahise ajya i Rabat, muri Maroke. Ku ya 7 Nzeri 1997, yaguye i Rabat azize kanseri ya porositate, afite imyaka 66, ashyingurwa mu irimbi ry'Abakristo ry'uwo mujyi.
Mu 1955, Mobutu yashakanye na Marie-Antoinette Gbiatibwa Yetene, wapfuye mu 1977; mu 1980, yashakanye na Bobi Ladawa. Yari afite abana benshi; umuhungu we w'imfura, Nyiwa, yateguraga kuzamusimbura, yapfuye mu 1994. Umwe mu bahungu be, Nzanga Mobutu, yaje kuba umunyapolitiki.

Laurent-Désiré Kabila (yavutse ku ya 27 Ugushyingo 1939 i Jadotville, ubu ni Likasi, apfa yishwe ku ya 16 Mutarama 2001 i Kinshasa), uzwi ku izina rya «"Mzee"» («Umukambwe» mu Giswahili), yari inyeshyamba akaba n'umunyapolitiki w'Umunyekongo, Perezida wa gatatu wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuva mu 1997 kugeza yishwe mu 2001. Yamenyekanye mu myaka ya 1960 nk'umwe mu barwanyaga ubutegetsi, mu myivumbagatanyo y'aba Simba, maze kuva mu 1967 kugeza mu 1986 ayobora agace k'inyeshyamba ka Fizi, mu Kivu y'Amajyepfo. Mu 1996, yabaye umuyobozi w'umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa AFDL, washyigikiwe n'u Rwanda n'Ubugande, wahiritse Mobutu Sese Seko mu ntambara ya mbere ya Kongo, maze ahindura izina ry'igihugu, Zayire, kigasubirana izina rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mu 1998, yategetse ingabo z'amahanga kuva mu gihugu, bituma intambara ya kabiri ya Kongo itangira. Muri Mutarama 2001, yiciwe n'umwe mu barinzi be, maze asimburwa n'umuhungu we, Joseph Kabila.
Ubuzima bwe bwa mbere.
Kabila yavukiye i Jadotville (ubu ni Likasi), muri Katanga, nubwo andi masoko avuga ko yavukiye i Baudouinville (ubu ni Moba). Se yari Umuluba, nyina akaba Umulunda. Yize amashuri yisumbuye i Élisabethville (ubu ni Lubumbashi); bivugwa ko yize no mu mahanga, i Paris, Tachkent, Belgrade cyangwa Dar es Salaam, ariko nta bimenyetso byabyo byabonetse.
Ibikorwa bya politiki n'inyeshyamba.
Nyuma y'ubwigenge bwa Kongo mu 1960, ubwo Katanga yiyomoraga iyobowe na Moïse Tshombe, Kabila yari umwe mu bayobozi b'urubyiruko rw'ishyaka Balubakat, rwarwanyije uko kwiyomora. Mu 1963, yinjiye mu Komite y'Igihugu yo Kwibohora (CNL), ihuriro ry'abashyigikiye Patrice Lumumba, maze yoherezwa mu burasirazuba bwa Kongo gutegura imyivumbagatanyo, yari igice cy'iyitwaga iy'aba Simba. Mu 1965, yahuye n'impinduramatwara w'Umunyakiba Che Guevara, wari waje gufasha inyeshyamba; Guevara yavuze ko Kabila yari afite imico y'umuyobozi w'abaturage, ariko amunenga kutagaragaza ubushake buhagije mu mpinduramatwara no gukunda kuba kure y'urugamba.
Mu 1967, Kabila yashinze ishyaka rya Parti de la révolution populaire (PRP), maze ashyiraho mu misozi ya Fizi-Baraka, muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo, agace kigenga kayoborwaga n'ibitekerezo bya gikomunisiti, gashyigikiwe n'uBushinwa. Yashinjwe kwigwizaho umutungo binyuze mu bucuruzi bwa zahabu n'amahembe y'inzovu. Ako gace karasenyutse mu myaka ya 1980, maze Kabila ararigiswa. Muri icyo gihe, yagiranye umubano n'abayobozi b'akarere, barimo Yoweri Museveni na Julius Nyerere, bamumenyekanishije kuri Paul Kagame.
Intambara ya mbere ya Kongo.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, abasirikare n'abarwanyi bayigizemo uruhare bahungiye muri Zayire, bituma inkambi z'impunzi zo ku mupaka ziba ibirindiro by'abarwanyi bashakaga gusubira gutera u Rwanda. Leta y'u Rwanda yafataga izo nkambi nk'ikibazo gikomeye cy'umutekano. Mu Ukwakira 1996, umutwe wa Alliance des forces démocratiques pour la libération du Congo-Zaïre (AFDL) washinzwe n'abanyapolitiki bane b'Abanyekongo bari mu buhungiro, ushyigikiwe n'u Rwanda, Ubugande na Angola; Kabila yabanje kuba umuvugizi wawo, hanyuma muri Mutarama 1997 aba umuyobozi wawo. Mu mezi make, AFDL yigaruriye igihugu hafi cyose. Nyuma y'ibiganiro by'amahoro byananiranye, Mobutu yahunze igihugu ku ya 16 Gicurasi 1997, maze ku ya 17 Gicurasi Kabila yitangaza Perezida. Yahinduye izina ry'igihugu, Zayire, kigasubirana izina rya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, maze arahira ku ya 29 Gicurasi 1997.
Perezida (1997–2001).
Kabila yatangaje ko amatora atazaba mbere y'imyaka ibiri. Nubwo bamwe mu bihugu by'Iburengerazuba babanje kumufata nk'umuyobozi w'«igisekuru gishya», abamunenga bavugaga ko imiyoborere ye itandukanye gake n'iya Mobutu, irangwa n'igitugu, ruswa n'ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu, ndetse ko yashakaga gushyiraho umuco wo kumuramya. Yafunze abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, barimo Étienne Tshisekedi, n'abanyamakuru.
Muri Nyakanga 1998, Kabila yategetse ingabo z'u Rwanda n'iz'Ubugande zari zaramufashije gufata ubutegetsi kuva mu gihugu. Ibyo byatumye intambara ya kabiri ya Kongo itangira: u Rwanda n'Ubugande byashyigikiye imitwe y'inyeshyamba ya Rassemblement congolais pour la démocratie (RCD) na Mouvement de libération du Congo (MLC), mu gihe Angola, Namibiya na Zimbabwe byashyigikiye Kabila. Mu 1999, yasheshe AFDL, ashyiraho Komite z'ubutegetsi bw'abaturage (CPP).
Ku ya 16 Mutarama 2001, Kabila yarasiwe mu biro bye, mu ngoro ya Palais de Marbre i Kinshasa, n'umwe mu barinzi be, Rashidi Mizele, wahise yicwa. Guverinoma yatangaje ko yari akiri muzima ubwo yajyanwaga kuvurirwa muri Zimbabwe, maze itangaza urupfu rwe ku ya 18 Mutarama ; ariko Minisitiri w'Ubuzima wari uhari yavuze ko yapfiriye aho. Nyuma y'icyumweru, umurambo we wagaruwe muri Kongo, maze umuhungu we, Joseph Kabila, aba Perezida ku ya 26 Mutarama 2001.
Iperereza ryatumye abantu 135, barimo abana bane, baburanishwa n'urukiko rwa gisirikare; mu Mutarama 2003, Koloneli Eddy Kapend, mubyara wa Kabila wafatwaga nk'uwayoboye umugambi, n'abandi 25 bakatiwe igihano cy'urupfu, kitigeze gishyirwa mu bikorwa. Abantu benshi bemeza ko urwo rubanza rwaranzwe n'amakosa, kandi ko benshi mu bakatiwe bari abere. Muri Mutarama 2021, Perezida Félix Tshisekedi yababariye abakatiwe bose, barimo Eddy Kapend.
Kabila yashakanye na Sifa Mahanya, babyarana abana benshi, barimo impanga Joseph na Jaynet Kabila.

Messan Hilaire Locoh-Donou (yapfuye ku wa 4 Ukwakira 2026 i Lomé) yari umwubatsi ("architecte"), inzobere mu igenamigambi ry'imijyi, umwarimu na rwiyemezamirimo mu by'amahoteli ukomoka muri Togo.
Yize mu ishuri rikuru ry'ubugeni rya Paris ("École nationale supérieure des beaux-arts"), hanyuma asubira muri Togo gukora umwuga w'ubwubatsi. Mu 1973 yashinze i Lomé ikigo AUBA gikora ibijyanye n'ubwubatsi, igenamigambi ry'imijyi n'inyigo za tekiniki. Mu nyubako yagizemo uruhare harimo icyicaro cy'icyahoze ari "Banque togolaise pour le commerce et l'industrie" (BTCI). Yigishije ubwubatsi imyaka myinshi mu ishuri EAMAU ("École africaine des métiers de l'architecture et de l'urbanisme") i Lomé. Kuva mu 1986 kugeza mu 1996 yayoboye Urugaga rw'abubatsi bo muri Togo ("Ordre national des architectes du Togo").
Yashinze i Lomé hoteli Eda-Oba, ifite ibyumba bigera kuri 200, aho gufatira amafunguro n'ibyumba by'inama. Mu gihe cy'icyorezo cya COVID-19, igabanuka ry'abakerarugendo ryatumye iyo hoteli ihagarika ibikorwa byayo mu 2021.
Yabaye perezida wa Rotary Club ya Lomé, anaba guverineri w'akarere 9100 ka Rotary International mu 1998–1999. Yapfiriye i Lomé ku wa 4 Ukwakira 2026.

Joseph Kabila Kabange (yavutse ku wa 4 Kamena 1971 i Hewa Bora II, muri teritwari ya Fizi, mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo) ni umunyapolitiki w’Umukongomani wabaye Perezida wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo kuva ku wa 26 Mutarama 2001 kugeza ku wa 24 Mutarama 2019. Kuva mu 2019 ni senateri ubuziraherezo.
Ni umuhungu wa Perezida Laurent-Désiré Kabila, yamusimbuye nyuma y’uko yicwa ku wa 16 Mutarama 2001, mu gihe cy’Intambara ya Kabiri ya Kongo. Afite imyaka 29, ni we Perezida muto kurusha abandi wayoboye igihugu. Yashinze ishyaka PPRD ("Parti du peuple pour la reconstruction et la démocratie") mu 2002, ayobora Guverinoma y’inzibacyuho nyuma y’amasezerano y’amahoro ya Pretoria, atorwa mu 2006, yongera gutorwa mu 2011 mu matora yanenzwe cyane.
Ashimirwa kuba yararangije Intambara ya Kabiri ya Kongo no kugarura umutekano mu gice kinini cy’igihugu, nubwo intambara yakomeje mu burasirazuba. Ubukungu bw’igihugu bwikubye inshuro eshanu ku butegetsi bwe, ariko ubukire ntibwasaranganyijwe, kandi ubutegetsi bwe bwaranzwe n’igitugu, ruswa n’ihohoterwa ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu. Kuba amatora yari ateganyijwe mu 2016 yarasubitswe byateje ikibazo gikomeye cya politiki. Mu 2019 yasimbuwe na Félix Tshisekedi mu ihererekanya ry’ubutegetsi rya mbere ry’amahoro mu mateka y’igihugu, nubwo amatora ya 2018 yashidikanyijweho cyane.
Kuva mu 2023, ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bumushinja gushyigikira ihuriro AFC/M23. Arabihakana. Mu 2025 ubudahangarwa bwe bwakuweho, maze urukiko rwa gisirikare rumukatira igihano cy’urupfu adahari. Mu 2026 yafatiwe ibihano na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Joseph Kabila na mushiki we w’impanga Jaynet Kabila bavutse ku wa 4 Kamena 1971 i Hewa Bora II, mu misozi ya Fizi. Ni bamwe mu bana icumi ba Laurent-Désiré Kabila n’umugore we Sifa Mahanya. Icyo gihe se yayoboraga umutwe w’inyeshyamba zarwanyaga ubutegetsi bwa Mobutu Sese Seko muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
Mu mpera z’imyaka ya 1970, umuryango wahungiye muri Tanzaniya, aho yize amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye i Mbeya no i Dar es Salaam. Kubera ko se yari umwanzi w’ubutegetsi bwa Mobutu, yitwaga irindi zina, "Hippolyte Kanambe Mtwale", kugira ngo atamenyekana. Yakuze avuga neza Icyongereza n’Igiswahili, ariko ubwo yabaga Perezida ntiyari azi neza Igifaransa cyangwa Ilingala. Yize kandi muri Kaminuza ya Makerere muri Ubugande.
Inkomoko ye yabaye impaka: abatavuga rumwe na we bavugaga ko nyina yari Umututsi wo mu Rwanda cyangwa ko atari umwana wa Laurent-Désiré Kabila. Nta bimenyetso simusiga byigeze bibigaragaza. Guverinoma yasohoye amafoto y’umuryango n’ubuhamya bwa Sifa Mahanya bwemeza ko ari nyina. Umushakashatsi Erik Kennes, mu gitabo cye ku buzima bwa Laurent-Désiré Kabila, na we yemeje ko ari umwana wa Kabila na Sifa Mahanya.
Mu gisirikare (1996–2001).
Mu Ukwakira 1996, se yatangije urugamba rwa AFDL rwo guhirika Mobutu, rwashyigikiwe n’u Rwanda, Ubugande na Angola. Joseph Kabila yinjiye muri urwo rugamba, atozwa n’umusirikare w’Umunyarwanda James Kabarebe. Yayoboye umutwe w’ingabo za AFDL, kandi bivugwa ko yari ari mu rugamba rwo gufata Kisangani. Nyuma y’intsinzi ya AFDL muri Gicurasi 1997, yakomereje amasomo ya gisirikare muri Kaminuza y’Igisirikare cy’Igihugu y’Ubushinwa i Beijing.
Yagizwe umwungirije w’umugaba mukuru w’ingabo za Kongo (FAC), ahabwa ipeti rya jenerali majoro. Intambara ya Kabiri ya Kongo itangiye muri Kanama 1998, yabaye umugaba mukuru w’ingabo by’igihe gito, asimburwa na Eddy Kapend mu Ukwakira 1998. Mu 2000 yabaye umugaba mukuru w’ingabo zirwanira ku butaka.
Perezida wa Repubulika (2001–2019).
Inzibacyuho (2001–2006).
Nyuma y’iyicwa rya se ku wa 16 Mutarama 2001, abari bamukikije bahisemo Joseph Kabila ngo amusimbure. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku wa 26 Mutarama 2001. Icyo gihe yari atazwi cyane, kandi yari ayoboye igihugu cyari hafi gusenyuka, igice cy’uburasirazuba cyigaruriwe n’ingabo z’u Rwanda n’iz’Ubugande. Mu cyumweru cya mbere yasuye Washington, Paris na Buruseli, ahura na Perezida Paul Kagame i Washington.
Muri Gashyantare 2001 yasubukuye amasezerano y’amahoro ya Lusaka, yemerera ingabo za MONUC kuza mu gihugu, kandi muri Gicurasi 2001 akuraho itegeko ryabuzaga amashyaka ya politiki. Ibiganiro hagati y’Abakongomani byatumye mu 2003 hashyirwaho Guverinoma y’inzibacyuho, yarimo abayobozi b’imitwe ibiri minini y’inyeshyamba babaye ba visi-perezida. Ku wa 28 Werurwe 2004, abashyigikiye Mobutu bagerageje guhirika ubutegetsi bwe ariko birananirana.
Manda ya mbere (2006–2011).
Mu 2006 yatsinze amatora ya perezida mu cyiciro cya kabiri, ahanganye na Jean-Pierre Bemba. Abatavuga rumwe na we bamushinjaga kutaba Umukongomani, ariko Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ntirwabyemeye. Mu Ugushyingo 2008, umuryango Human Rights Watch watangaje ko abantu barenga 500 bishwe, abandi barenga 1 000 bagafungwa bakanakorerwa iyicarubozo kuva amatora ya 2006 abaye.
Manda ya kabiri (2011–2016).
Mu 2011 komisiyo y’amatora (CENI) yatangaje ko yongeye gutsinda, ariko umukandida w’ishyaka ritavuga rumwe na Leta, Étienne Tshisekedi, yanze ibyavuye mu matora. Ikigo Carter Center n’indorerezi z’Ubumwe bw’Uburayi bavuze ko amatora yaranzwe n’amakosa menshi kandi atizewe. Ku wa 22 Werurwe 2013, ubutegetsi bwatangaje ko bwaburijemo umugambi wo kumwica no guhirika ubutegetsi.
Ubwo yageraga ku butegetsi, umwenda w’igihugu wanganaga na 150 % by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu; nyuma waragabanutse cyane. Ubukungu bwikubye inshuro eshanu ku butegetsi bwe, ariko izamuka ryabwo ryagabanutse mu myaka ye ya nyuma. Ubukire bwavuye mu mabuye y’agaciro (kobalti, diyama, zahabu) ntibwasaranganyijwe, kandi igihe yavaga ku butegetsi abaturage benshi bari bakiri munsi y’umurongo w’ubukene.
Uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Ku wa 22 Nyakanga 2015, Kenneth Roth, umuyobozi wa Human Rights Watch, yanenze cyane uburyo ubutegetsi bwa Kabila bwahohoteraga ababunenga. Inzego zashinjwaga ihohotera zirimo Ingabo zirinda Perezida ("Garde républicaine"), igipolisi gishinzwe guhosha imyigaragambyo (LENI) n’urwego rw’iperereza (ANR), rwashinjwaga gushimuta abatavuga rumwe na Leta, abanyamakuru n’abaharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu. Mu 2016, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’Ubumwe bw’Uburayi byafatiye ibihano abayobozi icyenda ba gisivili n’aba gisirikare. Mu Ugushyingo 2018, iperereza rya RFI n’ikinyamakuru "Le Monde" ryagaragaje ko ubutegetsi bwagize uruhare mu iyicwa ry’impuguke ebyiri z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye muri Werurwe 2017.
Kabila n’umuryango we, cyane cyane mushiki we Jaynet n’umugore we Olive Lembe, bari bafite cyangwa bayoboraga ibigo birenga 70 by’ubucuruzi, birimo amabanki n’ibirombe, byinjizaga amamiliyoni amagana y’amadolari. Mu Ugushyingo 2021, iperereza ry’ibinyamakuru byinshi ryiswe "Congo Hold-Up" ryashinje umuryango wa Kabila kunyereza miliyoni 138 z’amadolari y’ingengo y’imari ya Leta hagati ya 2013 na 2018, ufashijwe n’ishami rya banki BGFIBank muri Kongo. Minisitiri w’Ubutabera yahise asaba ko hatangizwa iperereza.
Ikibazo cya politiki n’ihererekanya ry’ubutegetsi (2016–2019).
Itegeko Nshinga ryamubuzaga kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu, kandi manda ye yagombaga kurangira ku wa 20 Ukuboza 2016. Amatora yarasubitswe, maze Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga rumwemerera kuguma ku butegetsi, nubwo abatavuga rumwe na Leta n’amahanga babyamaganye. Ku gitutu cy’imbere mu gihugu n’icy’amahanga, ku wa 8 Kanama 2018 yatangaje ko atazongera kwiyamamaza, ashyigikira Emmanuel Ramazani Shadary nk’umukandida w’ihuriro ry’ubutegetsi.
Amatora yo ku wa 30 Ukuboza 2018 yateje impaka nyinshi. Martin Fayulu yanze ibyavuyemo, naho Inama y’Abepiskopi Gatolika (CENCO), yari ifite indorerezi 40 000, yavuze ko bidahuye n’ibyo yabonye. Indorerezi zigenga zemeje ko Fayulu ari we watsinze, kandi ko Kabila yahisemo gutangaza intsinzi y’umukandida wari kumufasha kurusha abandi. Muri Mutarama 2019, Félix Tshisekedi yemejwe n’Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga, arahirira kuba Perezida.
Nyuma y’ubuperezida.
Kabila yavuye ku butegetsi ku wa 25 Mutarama 2019, aba senateri ubuziraherezo, ahabwa izina rya «Perezida w’icyubahiro». Ihuriro rye FCC ("Front commun pour le Congo") ryari rifite ubwiganze mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, muri Sena no mu ntara, maze akekwa kugumana ubutegetsi mu ibanga. Yagiye kuba mu isambu ye ya Kingakati, hafi ya Kinshasa.
Mu Ukuboza 2020, Tshisekedi yasheshe ubufatanye na FCC, akurura abadepite benshi ba Kabila mu ihuriro rishya ryitwa «Union sacrée». Perezida w’Inteko Jeannine Mabunda yakuweho ku wa 10 Ukuboza 2020, naho Minisitiri w’Intebe Sylvestre Ilunga Ilunkamba yeguzwa n’Inteko ku wa 27 Mutarama 2021.
Mu Ukuboza 2023, nyuma yo kwanga kwitabira amatora, yavuye muri Kongo mu ibanga. Yongeye kugaragara muri Afurika y’Epfo muri Mutarama 2024, aho yavugaga ko akora ubushakashatsi bwa dogitora muri Kaminuza ya Johannesburg.
Ibirego bijyanye na M23.
Mu 2021, umutwe wa M23 wongeye gufata intwaro mu burasirazuba bwa Kongo. Leta ya Kongo n’impuguke za Loni bavuga ko ushyigikiwe n’u Rwanda, ariko u Rwanda rurabihakana. Muri Werurwe 2024, Augustin Kabuya, umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyaka UDPS rya Perezida, yashinje Kabila gushyigikira M23 n’Ihuriro AFC rya Corneille Nangaa. Abo ku ruhande rwa Kabila bamaganye ibyo birego bavuga ko ari ugukura amaso y’abaturage ku byo Leta yananiwe. Muri Kanama 2024, Perezida Tshisekedi na we yamushinje gutegura imyivumbagatanyo, ariko ishyaka rye ribyita ibinyoma.
Muri Gashyantare 2025, Kabila yasohoye inyandiko mu kinyamakuru "Sunday Times", anenga Tshisekedi amushinja kuba nyirabayazana w’ikibazo cy’uburasirazuba. Muri Mata 2025, Minisitiri w’Umutekano yahagaritse ibikorwa bya PPRD, Minisiteri y’Ubutabera isaba ko akurikiranwa n’imitungo ye igafatirwa. Ku wa 22 Gicurasi 2025, Sena yamwambuye ubudahangarwa. Ku wa 25 Gicurasi 2025, yageze i Goma, umujyi wari mu maboko ya AFC/M23, ahura n’abayobozi b’amadini ari kumwe n’umuvugizi wa M23.
Urubanza n’igihano cy’urupfu.
Urubanza rwe rwatangiye ku wa 25 Nyakanga 2025 imbere y’Urukiko Rukuru rwa Gisirikare i Kinshasa, ariko ntiyitaba. Yashinjwaga ubugambanyi, ibyaha by’intambara, ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu no kugira uruhare mu mutwe w’abigometse, kubera uruhare bivugwa ko yagize mu ishingwa rya AFC. Bamwe babonye urwo rubanza nk’intambwe mu kubahiriza amategeko, abandi barimo ishyaka rye na Moïse Katumbi bavuga ko ari uburyo bwa politiki bwo kumukura mu nzira. Ku wa 30 Nzeri 2025 yakatiwe adahari igihano cy’urupfu, ategekwa no kwishyura Leta miliyari 33 z’amadolari.
Muri Mata 2026, Ishami rishinzwe kugenzura imitungo y’abanyamahanga (OFAC) rya Minisiteri y’Imari ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ryamufatiye ibihano, rimushinja gushaka guhungabanya Leta ya Kongo ashyigikira M23 na AFC.
Sitade ya Kalemie, mu ntara ya Tanganyika, yitiriwe izina rye.

John Pombe Joseph Magufuli (29 Ukwakira 1959 – 17 Werurwe 2021) yari umunyapolitiki w’Umunyatanzaniya wabaye Perezida wa gatanu wa Tanzaniya kuva mu 2015 kugeza apfuye mu 2021, amezi make nyuma yo kongera gutorerwa manda ya kabiri. Mbere yaho yari yarabaye minisitiri inshuro nyinshi, cyane cyane uw’Imirimo rusange, aho yamenyekanye ku izina rya «Tingatinga» («bulldozer» mu Giswahili) kubera kubaka imihanda myinshi. Kuva mu 2019 kugeza mu 2020 yayoboye Umuryango w’Iterambere ry’Afurika y’Amajyepfo (SADC).
Yatowe ku isezerano ryo kurwanya ruswa no kugabanya amafaranga Leta isesagura, ashora imari nyinshi mu bikorwa remezo. Ku butegetsi bwe, ubukungu bwa Tanzaniya bwazamutse ku kigero cya 6 % ku mwaka, igihugu kiva mu cyiciro cy’ibihugu bikennye cyane. Icyakora ubutegetsi bwe bwaranzwe n’igitugu: ubwisanzure bw’itangazamakuru n’ubwo kuvuga byarabujijwe, abatavuga rumwe na Leta baratotezwa. Mu gihe cy’icyorezo cya COVID-19, yahakanye uburemere bwacyo, ahagarika ibipimo n’ingamba z’ubuzima. Yapfuye ku wa 17 Werurwe 2021; Leta yavuze ko yazize indwara y’umutima. Yasimbuwe na Visi-Perezida we, Samia Suluhu Hassan.
John Magufuli yavukiye mu muryango ukennye mu 1959 i Chato, mu majyaruguru y’uburengerazuba bwa Tanzaniya (icyo gihe yitwaga Tanganyika), ku nkengero z’ikiyaga cya Victoria. Akiri umwana yaragiraga inka, akanacuruza amata n’amafi kugira ngo afashe umuryango we.
Yize amashuri abanza i Chato kuva mu 1967 kugeza mu 1974, akomereza mu iseminari ya Katoke i Biharamulo no muri Lake Secondary School, hanyuma muri Mkwawa High School. Yabonye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere mu burezi (shimi n’imibare) muri Kaminuza ya Dar es Salaam mu 1988, iy’icyiciro cya gatatu ("master") mu 1994 n’iy’ikirenga (dogitora) mu bya shimi mu 2009. Yari Umukirisitu Gatolika.
Urugendo rwa politiki.
Yabanje kuba umwarimu w’ubumenyi bwa shimi n’imibare mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Sengerema, nyuma akora nk’umuhanga mu bya shimi muri koperative Nyanza Cooperative Union kuva mu 1989 kugeza mu 1995. Mu 1995 yatorewe kuba umudepite uhagarariye Chato mu ishyaka Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM), ishyaka ryiganje mu gihugu, ahita agirwa Minisitiri wungirije w’Imirimo rusange.
Yabaye Minisitiri w’Imirimo rusange (2000–2005), Minisitiri w’Ubutaka n’Imiturire (2006–2008), Minisitiri w’Ubworozi n’Uburobyi (2008–2010), yongera kuba Minisitiri w’Imirimo rusange (2010–2015). Muri icyo gihe ni bwo yahawe izina rya «Tingatinga» kubera kubaka imihanda mishya.
Perezida wa Repubulika.
Ku wa 12 Nyakanga 2015, CCM yamutoranyije nk’umukandida wayo ku mwanya wa Perezida, nyuma y’amatora y’ibanze yari arimo abakandida 38. Mu matora yo ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2015, yahanganye na Edward Lowassa wari ushyigikiwe n’amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta, atsinda n’amajwi 58 %. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku wa 5 Ugushyingo 2015, asimbura Jakaya Kikwete, naho Samia Suluhu aba Visi-Perezida.
Kugabanya amafaranga ya Leta no kurwanya ruswa.
Akigera ku butegetsi, yafashe ingamba zo kugabanya amafaranga Leta isesagura: yabujije abayobozi ingendo zitari ngombwa zo mu mahanga n’ingendo z’indege mu cyiciro cy’icyubahiro, agabanya ingengo y’imari y’ibirori, anagabanya ingano y’intumwa zijya mu nama mpuzamahanga. Umushahara we yawugabanyije uva ku madolari 15 000 ugera ku 4 000 ku kwezi. Mu 2015 yahagaritse ibirori by’umunsi w’ubwigenge, avuga ko ari «igisebo gukoresha amafaranga menshi twizihiza imyaka 54 y’ubwigenge mu gihe abaturage bacu bicwa na kolera», ahubwo amafaranga ashyirwa mu bikorwa by’isuku byo kurwanya kolera. Guverinoma ye yari igizwe na minisiteri 19 aho kuba 30.
Ku wa 12 Mata 2016, urugendo rwe rwa mbere mu mahanga yarukoreye mu Rwanda, aho yahuye na Perezida Paul Kagame, batangiza ikiraro gishya n’umupaka uhuriweho wa Rusumo, anitabira kwibuka ku nshuro ya 22 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ubukungu n’ibikorwa remezo.
Tanzaniya yavuguruye amategeko agenga amasezerano y’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro, yiha uburenganzira bwo kuyasubiramo cyangwa kuyasesa mu gihe habayeho uburiganya. Impaka z’imisoro n’ikigo Acacia Mining, cyashinjwaga guhisha ingano nyakuri ya zahabu yacukurwaga, zarangiye Tanzaniya ihawe 16 % by’imigabane mu birombe byacyo. Mu 2017 yabujije kohereza mu mahanga amabuye y’agaciro atatunganyijwe. Icyakora, umunyapolitiki utavuga rumwe na Leta Zitto Kabwe yavuze ko iyo politiki yateye ubwoba abashoramari kandi igacogoza izamuka ry’ubukungu.
Guverinoma ye yashoye imari mu bikorwa remezo binini: umuhanda wa gari ya moshi ("Standard Gauge Railway"), urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwa Julius Nyerere rwagombaga gukuba kabiri amashanyarazi y’igihugu, imihanda n’ibiraro byinshi, ndetse no kongerera ubushobozi sosiyete y’indege ya Air Tanzania. Ku butegetsi bwe, ubukungu bwazamutse ku kigero cya 6 % ku mwaka nk’uko Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’Imari (IMF) kibivuga, maze mu 2020 Tanzaniya iva mu cyiciro cy’ibihugu bifite amikoro make ijya mu cy’ibifite amikoro aciriritse.
Igitugu n’ubwisanzure.
Nubwo ishyaka rimwe ryari ryarayoboye igihugu kuva cyabona ubwigenge, Tanzaniya yafatwaga nk’igihugu kirimo demokarasi ugereranyije. Nyuma y’amatora ya 2015, aho abatavuga rumwe na Leta bari babonye 40 % by’amajwi, Magufuli yatangiye guhashya itangazamakuru, abatavuga rumwe na Leta n’abo bahanganye mu ishyaka rye. Itegeko rirwanya ibyaha bikorerwa kuri murandasi ryakoreshejwe mu gufunga abantu bashinjwa «gutuka Perezida» ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Kuva mu 2016, televiziyo esheshatu, radiyo 21 n’ibinyamakuru byinshi byarahagaritswe bishinjwa kunenga ubutegetsi. Muri Werurwe 2018, abayobozi batandatu b’ishyaka Chadema, barimo umuyobozi waryo Freeman Mbowe, barafashwe. Muri Nzeri 2018, yasabye abaturage kutitabira kuboneza urubyaro, ibyo bikanengwa n’imiryango irimo Amnesty International.
Mu matora ya 2020, yongeye gutorwa ku majwi 84 %, naho ishyaka rye ritwara hafi 99 % by’imyanya mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko. Indorerezi nyinshi mpuzamahanga zavuze ko ayo matora yaranzwe n’uburiganya, ifatwa ry’abakandida n’abigaragambya, n’ifungwa ry’imbuga nkoranyambaga.
Icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Mu gihe cy’icyorezo cya COVID-19, Magufuli yanze gufata ingamba z’ubuzima zafatwaga ahandi ku isi, ategeka ko ibipimo bihagarara. Yavuze ko «virusi yarimbuwe n’Imana kubera amasengesho y’Abanyatanzaniya», kandi avuga ko ibipimo byakorewe ku ihene, ku ipapayi no ku ntama byagaragaje ko byanduye. Yanagaragaje ko adashira amakenga inkingo zakorewe mu Burayi no muri Amerika, ahitamo kwiringira amasengesho. Imibare y’abanduye yarekeye gutangazwa, naho Tanzaniya isubira inyuma mu rutonde rw’ubwisanzure bw’itangazamakuru rwa "Reporters sans frontières", iva ku mwanya wa 75 mu 2015 igera ku wa 124 mu 2020.
Kuva mu mpera za Gashyantare 2021, ntiyongeye kugaragara mu ruhame, maze abatavuga rumwe na Leta n’abanyamakuru bamwe bavuga ko yanduye COVID-19. Ku wa 17 Werurwe 2021, Visi-Perezida Samia Suluhu yatangaje kuri televiziyo ko Magufuli yapfuye afite imyaka 61, azize indwara y’umutima mu bitaro bya Emilio Mzena i Dar es Salaam. Samia Suluhu yahise amusimbura ku butegetsi.
Mu mpera za Werurwe, imihango yo kumusezeraho yitabiriwe n’abakuru b’ibihugu byinshi by’Afurika. Ku kibuga cya Uhuru i Dar es Salaam, abantu bagera kuri 40 bapfiriye mu mubyigano. Umurambo we wajyanywe i Zanzibar, Mwanza na Geita, ushyingurwa i Chato aho yavukiye.
Umunyamakuru Khalifa Said yavuze ko umurage we utavugwaho rumwe: bamwe bamubona nk’intwari yarwanyije ruswa n’ubukoloni bushya bw’ibigo by’amahanga, abandi bakamubona nk’umunyagitugu wasuzuguye amahame ya demokarasi.

Uhuru Mũigai Kenyatta (yavutse ku wa 26 Ukwakira 1961 i Nairobi) ni umunyapolitiki w’Umunyakenya wabaye Perezida wa kane wa Kenya kuva mu 2013 kugeza mu 2022. Ni umuhungu wa Jomo Kenyatta, Perezida wa mbere wa Kenya. Mbere yo kuba Perezida, yabaye umuyobozi w’abatavuga rumwe na Leta mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko (2003–2007), Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije (2008–2013) na Minisitiri w’Imari.
Perezida Daniel arap Moi yamuhisemo nk’uzamusimbura, ariko yatsinzwe na Mwai Kibaki mu matora ya 2002. Mu 2012, Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga (CPI) rwamushinje ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu bifitanye isano n’imvururu zakurikiye amatora ya 2007. Yatorewe kuba Perezida mu 2013 afatanyije na William Ruto, aba Perezida wa mbere uri ku butegetsi witabye CPI mu 2014; nyuma ibirego bye byaje guhagarikwa kubera kubura ibimenyetso bihagije. Yongeye gutorwa mu 2017 nyuma y’uko Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ruteshje agaciro amatora ya mbere.
Manda ye yaranzwe n’ibikorwa remezo, ariko kandi n’amahano ya ruswa n’umwenda w’igihugu wiyongereye. Mu 2021, izina rye n’iry’umuryango we byagaragaye mu nyandiko za "Pandora Papers". Mu 2022 yasimbuwe na William Ruto. Kuva mu 2025 ni umuhuza mu biganiro by’amahoro muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Uhuru Kenyatta yavutse ku wa 26 Ukwakira 1961, ari umwana wa Jomo Kenyatta n’umugore we wa kane, Mama Ngina Kenyatta. Umuryango we ni Abakikuyu. Izina rye «Uhuru» risobanura «ubwigenge» mu Giswahili, kandi yaryiswe mu gihe Kenya yiteguraga kubona ubwigenge. Yize muri St Mary’s School i Nairobi, kandi hagati ya 1979 na 1980 yakoze muri banki ya Kenya Commercial Bank. Se yapfuye afite imyaka 16. Yize ubukungu na siyansi za politiki muri Amherst College muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Agarutse muri Kenya, yashinze ikigo cyohereza ibikomoka ku buhinzi mu mahanga.
Urugendo rwa politiki.
Mu matora ya 1997, yiyamamarije kuba umudepite wa Gatundu y’Amajyepfo, aho se yigeze guhagararira, ariko aratsindwa. Mu 1999, Perezida Moi yamushyize ku buyobozi bw’Ikigo cy’Ubukerarugendo cya Kenya. Mu 2001 yagizwe umudepite, aba Minisitiri w’Inzego z’ibanze.
Mu 2002, Moi yatumye ishyaka KANU rimutoranya nk’umukandida waryo ku mwanya wa Perezida, bituma bamwe mu bayobozi b’iryo shyaka barivamo. Yatsinzwe na Mwai Kibaki, abona 31 % by’amajwi, maze aba umuyobozi w’abatavuga rumwe na Leta mu Nteko. Mu 2005 yatorewe kuyobora KANU. Mu matora ya 2007 yashyigikiye Kibaki. Nyuma y’imvururu zakurikiye ayo matora, hashyizweho Guverinoma y’ubumwe aho Raila Odinga yabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe, naho Kenyatta aba Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije akaba na Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi muri Mata 2008, nyuma aba Minisitiri w’Imari muri Mutarama 2009.
Mu 2012, CPI yamushinje ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu byakozwe mu mvururu zakurikiye amatora ya 2007, maze yegura ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w’Imari ku wa 26 Mutarama 2012, ariko akomeza kuba Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije.
Perezida wa Repubulika.
Manda ya mbere (2013–2017).
Mu matora yo ku wa 4 Werurwe 2013, ahagarariye ihuriro Jubilee afatanyije na William Ruto, yatsinze Raila Odinga ku majwi 50,07 %. Odinga yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ikirenga, ariko ku wa 30 Werurwe 2013 urukiko rwemeje ku bwumvikane busesuye ko amatora yari yemewe. Yarahiriye kuba Perezida ku wa 9 Mata 2013.
Ku wa 8 Ukwakira 2014, yitabye CPI, aba Perezida wa mbere uri ku butegetsi witabye urwo rukiko. Ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2014, umushinjacyaha mukuru Fatou Bensouda yatangaje ko ibirego bimuhagaritsweho kubera kubura ibimenyetso bihagije, ariko avuga ko iperereza ryabangamiwe cyane, harimo gutoteza no gukangisha abatangabuhamya.
Mu myaka yakurikiyeho yongeye kwakirwa neza ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ariko manda ye yaranzwe n’amahano ya ruswa n’izamuka ry’ubukungu ritari ku rwego rwari rwitezwe. Mu 2015, ubwo Perezida Barack Obama yasuraga Nairobi agasaba ko abaryamana bahuje ibitsina bubahwa, Kenyatta yasubije ko «bigoye guhatira abantu ibyo batemera ubwabo».
Manda ya kabiri (2017–2022).
Mu matora yo muri Kanama 2017, yongeye guhangana na Raila Odinga, atangazwa ko yatsinze n’amajwi 54 %. Ku wa 1 Nzeri 2017, Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwateshje agaciro ayo matora, ruvuga ko atakozwe hakurikijwe Itegeko Nshinga, rutegeka ko haba andi mu minsi 60. Odinga yasabye ko komisiyo y’amatora ivugururwa, hanyuma ku wa 10 Ukwakira 2017 atangaza ko akuyemo kandidatire ye. Mu matora yo ku wa 26 Ukwakira 2017, Kenyatta yatsinze n’amajwi 98 %, ariko abatoye bari 39 % gusa. Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwanze ibirego byayarwanyaga ku wa 20 Ugushyingo 2017, maze arahira ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 2017.
Ku wa 31 Mutarama 2018, Odinga yirahije nka «Perezida w’abaturage», maze Leta ihagarika televiziyo eshatu zari zerekanye uwo muhango. Ku wa 9 Werurwe 2018, Kenyatta na Odinga bagiranye amasezerano y’ubwiyunge azwi nka «handshake». Umushinga we wo kuvugurura Itegeko Nshinga (BBI) waje gufatwa nk’utemewe n’amategeko n’Urukiko Rukuru muri Gicurasi 2021, ibyo bishimangirwa n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire muri Kanama 2021.
Mu 2021, amapfa yateje inzara ikomeye, abantu barenga miliyoni 2,5 bahura n’ibura ry’ibiribwa; yabyise «icyago cy’igihugu», ariko anengwa kuba ubutabazi bwaratinze. Mu Ukwakira 2021, akajagari ka Mukuru Kwa Njenga i Nairobi kasenywe kugira ngo umuhanda waguke, abantu bagera ku 40 000 basigara batagira aho kuba.
Mu 2022 yasimbuwe na Visi-Perezida we William Ruto. Nk’uko "International Crisis Group" ibivuga, yasize ubukungu bumeze nabi, burangwa n’izamuka ry’ibiciro n’umwenda wiyongereye.
Mu Ukwakira 2021, Kenyatta n’abantu batandatu bo mu muryango we, barimo nyina Mama Ngina na murumuna we Muhoho, bagaragaye mu nyandiko za "Pandora Papers" nk’abafite ibigo n’imitungo yihishe mu bihugu bisonera imisoro. Bari bafite nibura miliyoni 30 z’amadolari muri ibyo bigo, harimo n’umuryango ("fondation") w’ibanga muri Panama. Ibyo byanenzwe cyane kuko byanyuranyaga n’«intambara yo kurwanya ruswa» yavugaga ko ayoboye.
Nyuma y’ubuperezida.
Ku wa 8 Gashyantare 2025, mu nama idasanzwe y’abakuru b’ibihugu by’Umuryango w’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC) n’uw’Afurika y’Amajyepfo (SADC), yagizwe umwe mu bahuza mu biganiro by’amahoro muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.

Inkombe za Lomé (mu Gifaransa: "Plages de Lomé") ni inkombe z'umusenyi ziri ku nkengero z'umurwa mukuru wa Togo, Lomé, ku Kigobe cya Gineya. Zirambuye ku birometero byinshi hagati y'icyambu cya Lomé mu burasirazuba n'uduce twa Baguida, Kpémé na Aného.
Zirangwa n'umusenyi woroshye, inyanja ikunze kugira imiraba n'imigezi ikomeye. Ikirere ni icy'ubushyuhe bwo mu turere dushyuha, kiri hagati ya 25 °C na 30 °C umwaka wose. Ibice bimwe by'inkombe byibasiwe n'isuri, ihangana na yo ikorwa binyuze muri gahunda y'akarere ya WACA ("West Africa Coastal Areas Management Program").
Inkombe zikoreshwa mu uburobyi gakondo, mu myidagaduro, mu mikino nk'umupira w'amaguru wo ku musenyi, "surf" na "kitesurf", ndetse no mu ubukerarugendo. Ni hamwe mu hantu nyamukuru abatuye umujyi baruhukira, kubera ko Lomé ifite pariki nke. Mu duce twa Kpémé na Aného, inyenzi zo mu nyanja ziza kuhatera amagi mu bihe bimwe by'umwaka.
Ku nkombe za Lomé hari ibisigazwa by'ikiraro cy'icyuma kinjira mu nyanja ("wharf"), cyubatswe hagati ya 1901 na 1904 ku gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abadage, gifite uburebure bwa metero 300. Cyakoreshwaga mu gupakurura no gupakira ibicuruzwa n'abagenzi kugeza ubwo icyambu cya Lomé cyafungurwaga mu 1964.
Kubera imigezi n'imiraba ikomeye, koga ahatarinzwe bishobora guteza akaga.

Amasumo ya Yikpa ni itsinda ry'amasumo y'amazi aherereye muri kantoni ya Yikpa, muri perefegitura ya Danyi, mu Ntara ya Plateaux, muri Togo, hafi y'umupaka na Gana. Atunzwe n'uruzi rwa Agumatsa, akaba ari amwe mu masumo maremare kurusha ayandi mu gihugu, kandi ni ahantu nyaburanga h'ingenzi mu bukerarugendo bwo mu majyepfo y'iburengerazuba bwa Togo.
Aho aherereye n'imiterere.
Amasumo ari ku misozi miremire ya Danyi, nko mu birometero 30 mu majyaruguru ya Kpalimé. Kugera aho ari bikorwa n'amaguru, unyuze mu tuyira two mu ishyamba duca mu mirima ya kawa na kakawo. Ako karere kazwiho imisozi ihanamye, ibimera byinshi n'ikirere gitose gikwiranye n'amashyamba y'inzitane.
Aha hantu harimo amasumo abiri afite uburebure bubarirwa hagati ya metero 70 n'izirenga 100, bitewe n'ibipimo byo mu karere. Isumo rimwe riri ku ruhande rwa Togo, mu gihe irindi rikomereza muri Gana, aho rizwi ku izina ry'amasumo ya Wli. Amasumo akora ikidendezi kamere abantu bashobora kogeramo. Ibidukikije biyakikije birimo urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rutandukanye rugizwe n'inyoni, udukoko n'inkende.
Amateka n'agaciro k'umuco.
Abaturage b'aho bafata Amasumo ya Yikpa nk'ahantu hatagatifu. Ahuzwa n'imyemerere gakondo ijyanye no kwisukura, uburumbuke no kurindwa mu buryo bw'umwuka. Kera hakorerwaga imihango n'ibirori bitandukanye. Kantoni ya Yikpa yatuwe kuva kera n'imiryango y'Abewe yaturutse mu buhunzi bwa Notsé, kimwe mu bihe bikomeye mu mateka y'ubwoko bw'Abewe. Imidugudu iriho ubu yagiye ishingwa buhoro buhoro hagati y'ibihe byabanjirije ubukoloni n'iby'ubukoloni.
Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga ibidukikije.
Muri iki gihe, amasumo ni hamwe mu hantu h'ingenzi h'ubukerarugendo bubungabunga ibidukikije mu Ntara ya Plateaux. Gusura aha hantu bikunze kuyoborwa n'abayobozi b'ingendo bo mu karere ndetse na komite y'umudugudu ishinzwe imicungire. Ibikorwa bihakorerwa birimo gutembera n'amaguru, koga, kumenya ibimera by'aho no kwitegereza imisozi. Iterambere ry'ubukerarugendo rigamije guhuza kubungabunga ibidukikije n'iterambere ry'ubukungu bw'akarere.
Kubera ko aha hantu horoshye kwangirika, abaturage bashyizeho ingamba zo kugabanya ingaruka ku bidukikije, cyane cyane kugenzura uko abantu binjira, gusana tuyira no gukangurira abashyitsi kubaha ibidukikije.

Hydrocephalus ni indwara aho amazi yo mu bwonko (CSF) yiyongera mu bwonko. Ibi bikunze gutera kwiyongera k'umuvuduko mu gahanga. Abantu bakuze bashobora kugira ikibazo cyo kuribwa umutwe, kutabona neza, kutabasha kwifata mu nkari, impinduka mu miterere y'umubiri, cyangwa ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Ku bana bato, bishobora kugaragara nk'ubwiyongere bwihuse bw'umutwe. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kuruka, gusinzira, gukubita no kumanuka amaso.
Hydrocephalus ishobora guterwa n'ubumuga bwo kuvukana cyangwa ikavuka nyuma y'ubuzima. Ubusembwa bujyanye n'igihe umuntu avukana burimo ubusembwa bw'imiyoboro y'ubwonko n'ibivamo stenosis y'amazi. Izindi mpamvu zirimo meningite, ibibyimba byo mu bwonko, imvune mu bwonko, kuva amaraso imbere mu mutima, no kuva amaraso munsi y'umugongo. Ubwoko bune bwa hydrocephalus ni itumanaho, kudatumana, "ibyuka bivamo umwuka", n'umuvuduko usanzwe. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bikorwa hakoreshejwe isuzuma ry'umubiri no gukoresha amashusho y'abaganga.
Hydrocephalus ikunze kuvurwa no kubagwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa shunt. Uburyo bwitwa ventriculostomy ya gatatu ni amahitamo kuri bamwe. Ingorane ziterwa na shunts zishobora kuba zirimo kuvoma amazi menshi, kuvoma amazi make, kwangirika k'ibikoresho, kwandura indwara, cyangwa kuziba. Ibi bishobora gusaba gusimburwa. Ibisubizo biratandukanye, ariko abantu benshi bafite shunt babaho ubuzima busanzwe. Hatabayeho kuvurwa, urupfu cyangwa ubumuga buhoraho bishobora kubaho.
Hafi umwe kugeza kuri babiri ku bana 1,000 bavutse bafite indwara ya hydrocephalus. Igipimo mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere gishobora kuba kiri hejuru. Igipimo cy’umuvuduko usanzwe wa hydrocephalus gifatwa nk’abantu 5 kuri 100.000, aho igipimo kigenda cyiyongera uko imyaka igenda ishira. Ibisobanuro bya Hippocrates ku ndwara ya hydrocephalus byatangiye mu myaka irenga 2.000 ishize. Ijambo "hydrocephalus" rikomoka ku kigereki, risobanura 'amazi' na, risobanura 'umutwe'.

Tingban-Paab ni umunsi mukuru gakondo wizihizwa buri mwaka mu Grand Tône (akarere ka Savanes, mu majyaruguru ya Togo) n'Abamoba, Abagourma, Abamossi, Abapeulh n'andi moko bafitanye isano.
Ugaragaza isozwa ry'isarura, ukaba umwanya wo gushimira abakurambere n'imyuka irinda ("Tingbana"). Uba ku wa gatandatu wa kabiri w'Ukuboza muri perefegitura za Tône, Tandjouaré, Cinkassé, Kpendjal na Kpendjal-Ouest. Izina risobanura «ituro rituwe abakurambere» ("Tingban": urutambiro; "Paab": ituro).
Kubera ko Imana ("Yendu") itiyambazwa mu buryo butaziguye, abaturage bashimira abakurambere n'imyuka irinda uburinzi n'umusaruro mwiza. Ibirori birimo amaturo gakondo, imbyino n'umuziki, kumurika umusaruro w'ubuhinzi no gusangira amafunguro gakondo, hakiyongeraho imikino n'amasengesho mu nsengero no mu misigiti. Uyu munsi ushimangira ubumwe, uraga umuco urubyiruko kandi uzamura ubukungu n'ubukerarugendo by'akarere.
Wizihizwaga buri mwaka kuva hagati mu myaka ya 2000 (muri 2019 wizihizwaga ku nshuro ya 14 ikurikiranye), nyuma ya 2019 uhagarikwa kubera Covid-19 n'umutekano muke, wongera kuba ku ya 13 Ukuboza 2025 i Tône, witabiriwe n'abayobozi bakuru b'igihugu n'intumwa zaturutse muri Ghana na Burkina Faso.

Udusimba tw'ibiheri ni ubwoko bw'udukoko dutungwa n'amaraso y'abantu, akenshi nijoro. Kurumwa kwazo bishobora gutera ingaruka nyinshi ku buzima zirimo uduheri ku ruhu, ingaruka zo mu mutwe, n'ibimenyetso by'ubwivumbure. Kurumwa udusimba tw'ibiheri bishobora gutera impinduka ku ruhu kuva ku duce tutagaragara kugeza ku duto tw'umutuku kugeza ku dusebe twinshi. Ibimenyetso bishobora gufata iminota cyangwa iminsi kugira ngo bigaragare kandi muri rusange hari ubwoba bugaragara. Hari abantu bashobora kumva bananiwe cyangwa bafite umuriro. Ubusanzwe, ibice by'umubiri bidatwikiriye birafatwa n'ingaruka kandi akenshi kurumwa gatatu bikurikirana. Ukurumwa n'udukoko two mu buriri ntabwo bizwi ko twanduza indwara iyo ari yo yose. Ingorane zishobora kuba zidakunze kuba zirimo ahantu hari uruhu rwapfuye cyangwa vasculitis.
Udusimba tw'ibiheri duterwa ahanini n'ubwoko bubiri bw'udukoko two mu bwoko bwa "Cimex": "Cimex lectularius" (udukoko dusanzwe two mu buriri) na "Cimex hemipterus", cyane cyane mu turere dushyuha. Ingano yabo iri hagati ya 1 na 7 mm. Bikwirakwira mu kugendagenda hagati y’ahantu hahegereye cyangwa mu gutwarwa mu bintu by’umuntu ku giti cye. Kwandura indwara akenshi ntibikunze guterwa n’isuku nke ariko bikunze kugaragara cyane mu duce turimo ubucucike bwinshi. Gusuzuma indwara bikubiyemo gushaka udukoko no kugaragaza ibimenyetso bihuye na byo. udusimba tw'ibiheri tumara igihe kinini ahantu hijimye kandi hihishe nko mu migozi ya matelas cyangwa mu mipfunyari y'urukuta.
Ubuvuzi bugamije ibimenyetso. Gukuraho udukoko two mu buriri mu rugo akenshi biragoye, kimwe mu bituma udukoko two mu buriri dushobora kumara umwaka wose tutarigaburira. Gusubiramo ubuvuzi bw'urugo bishobora kuba ngombwa. Ubu buryo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba bukubiyemo gushyushya icyumba kugeza kuri mu gihe kirenga iminota 90, gusukura isuku kenshi, kumesa imyenda ku bushyuhe bwinshi, no gukoresha imiti yica udukoko itandukanye.
udusimba tw'ibiheri tuboneka mu turere twose tw’isi. Igipimo cy'ubwandu bw'ibicurane kirakunze kugaragara, nyuma y'ubwiyongere kuva mu myaka ya 1990. Impamvu nyazo z’ubwiyongere bw’iyi ndwara ntizisobanutse neza; inyigisho zirimo kwiyongera kw’ingendo z’abantu, guhanahana ibikoresho byakoreshejwe kenshi, kwibanda cyane ku kurwanya utundi dukoko, no kongera ubudahangarwa bw’imiti yica udukoko. udusimba tw'ibiheri tuzwiho kuba udukoko duto mu bantu mu myaka ibihumbi ishize.

Amitriptyline, igurishwa ku izina rya Elavil n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura indwara nyinshi zo mu mutwe. Ibi birimo indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba no guhangayika, hamwe n'indwara idakunze kugaragara yo kudakora neza (ADHD) na indwara yo gucika intege. Izindi ngamba zirimo kwirinda indwara ya migraine, kuvura ububabare bw'imitsi nka fibromyalgia na neuralgia yo mu gihe cy'imitsi, ndetse no kudasinzira cyane. Iri mu bwoko bwa tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) kandi imikorere yayo nyayo ntabwo isobanutse neza. Amitriptyline ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kutabona neza, umunwa wumye, umuvuduko muke w'amaraso uhagaze, gusinzira no kutagira impatwe.
