Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo gucika intege, ibyago byinshi byo kwiyahura ku bantu bari munsi y'imyaka 25, kubura inkari, glaucoma, n'ibibazo byinshi by'umutima. Ntibikwiye gufatwa hamwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bwa MAO cyangwa umuti wa cisapride. Amitriptyline ishobora guteza ibibazo iyo ifashwe mu gihe cyo gutwita. Gukoresha mu gihe cyo konsa bisa nkaho ari byiza ku rugero runaka.
Amitriptyline yavumbuwe mu 1960 yemezwa n'Ikigo gishinzwe ibiribwa n'imiti muri Amerika (FDA) mu 1961. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cy'igurishwa ry'ibicuruzwa mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere yari hagati ya 0.01 na 0.04 by'amadolari ya Amerika kuri dose. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igura hafi amadolari y'Amerika 0.20 kuri buri dose. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 87 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n’abaganga barenga miliyoni icyenda.

Heroine, izwi kandi nka diamorphine n'andi mazina, ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane nk'umuti wo kwidagadura kubera ingaruka zawo z'ibyishimo. Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi mu bihugu byinshi mu kugabanya ububabare cyangwa mu kuvura indwara ya opioid. Ubusanzwe iterwa, akenshi mu mitsi, ariko ishobora no kunyobwa, gushongeshwa, cyangwa guhumeka. Ingaruka zitangira vuba kandi zimara amasaha make.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kwiheba mu myanya y'ubuhumekero (kugabanuka k'ubuhumekero), kuma mu kanwa, gusinzira, kudakora neza mu mutwe, impatwe, no kuba imbata. Ingaruka mbi zo gukoresha inshinge zishobora kuba zirimo ibibyimba, imiyoboro y'umutima yanduye, indwara ziterwa n'amaraso, na pneumonia. Nyuma y'amateka yo gukoresha opioid igihe kirekire, ibimenyetso byo kuyireka bishobora gutangira mu masaha make uhereye igihe wayikoresheje bwa nyuma. Iyo itewe mu mitsi, heroine igira ingaruka zikubye kabiri cyangwa gatatu z'umuti wa morphine ungana. Ubusanzwe iza ari ifu y'umweru cyangwa iy'umukara.
Kuvura ubusinzi bwa heroine akenshi bikubiyemo uburyo bwo kuvura imyitwarire n'imiti. Imiti ishobora kuba irimo buprenorphine, methadone, cyangwa naltrexone. Kunywa heroine irenze urugero bishobora kuvurwa na naloxone. Bigereranyijwe ko hari abantu 17 miliyoni z'abantu gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bw'ibiyobyabwenge, muri yo heroine ikaba ari yo ikunze kugaragara cyane, kandi gukoresha opioid byahitanye abantu 122.000. Umubare w’abakoresha heroine ku isi yose mu 2015 bikekwa ko wiyongereye muri Afurika, Amerika na Aziya kuva mu 2000. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abantu bagera kuri 1.6% bagiye bakoresha heroine mu gihe runaka, aho abantu 950.000 bayikoresheje mu mwaka ushize. Iyo abantu bapfa kubera gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge birenze urugero, ibiyobyabwenge akenshi biba ari opioid ndetse akenshi bikaba ari heroine.
Heroine yakozwe bwa mbere na CR Alder Wright mu 1874 ivuye muri morphine, umusaruro karemano wa opium poppy. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, heroine igenzurwa hakurikijwe gahunda ya I n'iya IV z'Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ku Biyobyabwenge, kandi muri rusange bitemewe n'amategeko gukora, gutunga, cyangwa kugurisha nta ruhushya. Mu 2016 hakozwe toni zigera kuri 448 za heroine. Mu 2015, Afuganisitani yakoraga hafi 66% by'umuti uhumanya ikirere ku isi. Heroine itemewe ikunze kuvangwa n'ibindi bintu nka isukari, sitashi, kafeyine, quinine, cyangwa indi miti nka fentanyl.

Ekpessosso (nanone witwa Epé-Ekpé cyangwa Ifatwa ry'ibuye ritagatifu) ni umuhango ukorwa buri mwaka n'Abaguin bo mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Togo, bizihiza umwaka mushya gakondo. Kuva mu 2025, uri ku Rutonde ruhagarariye umurage ndangamuco udafatika w'abantu bose wa UNESCO.
Ukorwa buri kwezi kwa Nzeri i Glidji, mu ntara ya Lacs. Mu ishyamba ritagatifu rya Gbatsomé, abaherezabitambo bakuru basohora ibuye ritagatifu; ibara ryaryo rifatwa nk'ubutumwa bw'imana ku mwaka ukurikiyeho. Umuhango urimo kwiyeza, kwambaza abakurambere, ifunguro ry'ubumwe na karinavali.
Amateka avugwa mu kanwa avuga ko Abaguin baturutse mu karere ka Accra (muri Ghana) mu kinyejana cya 17, bagashinga ubwami i Aného na Glidji.
Kwandikwa muri UNESCO.
Ku wa 11 Ukuboza 2025, i New Delhi, Ekpessosso yanditswe ku rutonde rwa UNESCO. Ni cyo kintu cya gatatu cya Togo kiri kuri urwo rutonde.

Endometriosis ni indwara aho uturemangingo gisa n'ibiri muri endometrium, urwego rw'ingirabuzimafatizo rusanzwe rutwikira imbere muri nyababyeyi, rukurira hanze yarwo. Akenshi ibi biba ku dusabo tw’intanga, imiyoboro y’inda, n’ingirangingo zikikije nyababyeyi n’intanga ngore; icyakora, mu bihe bidasanzwe bishobora no kugaragara mu bindi bice by’umubiri. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi ni ububabare bw'ikibuno no kutabyara. Hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'abarwaye bafite ububabare budakira mu kibuno, mu gihe 70% by'ububabare bubaho mu gihe cy'imihango. Ububabare mu gihe cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina nabwo bukunze kugaragara. Ubugumba bubaho kugeza kuri kimwe cya kabiri cy'abagore barwaye. Ibimenyetso bidakunze kugaragara birimo ibimenyetso byo mu nkari cyangwa mu mara. Abagore bagera kuri 25% nta bimenyetso bagira. Endometriosis ishobora kugira ingaruka ku mibereho no mu mitekerereze.
Impamvu ntirasobanuka neza. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo kuba ufite amateka y’iyi ndwara mu muryango. Uduce twa endometriosis duva amaraso buri kwezi, bigatera kubyimba no gukomereka. Ibibyimba biterwa na endometriosis si kanseri. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku bimenyetso bihujwe n'ishusho y'abaganga ; icyakora, biopsy ni bwo buryo bwizewe bwo gusuzuma indwara. Izindi mpamvu zitera ibimenyetso nk'ibi zirimo indwara yo kubyimba mu kibuno, indwara yo kurakara mu mara, cystite yo mu kibuno, na fibromyalgia. Endometriosis ikunze kwigwa nabi, kandi abagore bakunze kubwirwa nabi ko ibimenyetso byabo ari ibisanzwe cyangwa ko ari ibintu byoroheje.
Ibimenyetso by'ukuri bigaragaza ko gukoresha imiti ikoreshwa mu kuboneza urubyaro igabanya ibyago byo kurwara endometriosis. Gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri no kwirinda kunywa inzoga nyinshi nabyo bishobora kuba uburyo bwo kwirinda. Nta muti uhari wo kuvura indwara ya endometriosis, ariko uburyo butandukanye bwo kuvura bushobora kongerera ibimenyetso. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo imiti igabanya ububabare, imiti igabanya ububabare cyangwa kubagwa. Umuti w'ububabare usabwa akenshi ni umuti urwanya ububabare utari uwa steroide (NSAID), nka naproxen. Gufata ikinini cyo kuboneza urubyaro buri gihe cyangwa gukoresha icyuma gishyirwa mu mura gifite progestogen nabyo bishobora kuba ingirakamaro. Umuti ugabanya imisemburo ya gonadotropin (agonist ya GnRH) ushobora kongera ubushobozi bw'abatabyara bwo gutwita. Gukuraho endometriosis bishobora gukoreshwa mu kuvura abafite ibimenyetso bidashoboka mu bundi buryo bwo kuvura.
Endometriosis yibasira hafi 10% by'abagore bari mu kigero cyo kubyara. Icyigereranyo kimwe kivuga ko abantu miliyoni 10.8 ari bo bagizweho ingaruka ku isi yose. Andi masoko avuga ko abagore bari hagati ya 6–10% ari bo bibasiwe n’iki kibazo. Endometriosis ikunze kugaragara cyane ku bantu bari mu kigero cy'imyaka mirongo itatu na mirongo ine; icyakora, ishobora gutangira ku bakobwa bafite imyaka umunani. Bitera impfu nke. Endometriosis yamenyekanye bwa mbere ko ari indwara itandukanye mu myaka ya 1920. Mbere y'icyo gihe, endometriosis na adenomyosis byatekerezwagaho hamwe. Ntibiramenyekana neza uwasobanuye bwa mbere iyi ndwara.

Indwara yo mu mutwe nyuma yo kubyara (PPP) iterwa no gutangira gutunguranye ibimenyetso byo mu mutwe nyuma gato yo kubyara, akenshi mu byumweru bibiri nyuma yo kubyara ariko mu gihe kitarenze ibyumweru 4. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubona cyangwa guhumurirwa ibintu bitariho (ibintu bitagaragara), ibitekerezo bidashoboka ko biba ukuri (ibintu bidafite ishingiro), imitekerereze idasanzwe (mania), kwiheba, guhangayika, cyangwa urujijo. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo ibitekerezo bitagenda neza, kugorwa no gusinzira, hamwe n'imitekerereze n'ubwenge bihindagurika. Muri rusange, umuntu ubwe ntasobanukiwe neza uburemere bw'iyi ndwara. Abarenga kimwe cya kabiri cy'abanduye nyuma baza gusanganwa indwara ya bipolar.
Impamvu ntiramenyekana, nubwo ishobora kuba ifitanye isano n'impinduka mu misemburo, ibibazo by'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, ndetse n'imiterere y'uturemangingo. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo gutwita bwa mbere, gusaza, kubura ibitotsi, n'amateka y'umuntu ku giti cye cyangwa mu muryango we arwaye PPP cyangwa indwara ya bipolar. Imihangayiko mu buzima isa nkaho ntacyo ikora, ndetse n'ibimenyetso bifatika ku bibazo byo gutwita ntibigaragara. Nta bikoresho byo gusuzuma cyangwa gusuzuma bihari; bikorwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bigaragara, bigenzurwa n'ibipimo biri muri DSM-V nyuma yo gukuraho izindi mpamvu zishobora kuba zarabayeho. Mu gitabo cy’isuzuma n’ibarurishamibare ku ndwara zo mu mutwe, Umubumbe wa V (DSM-V TR) kiri mu gihe gito cy’indwara yo mu mutwe aho "peripartum itangira", aho kuba ikintu cyihariye.
Bifatwa nk'ikibazo cyo mu mutwe gisaba kujya mu bitaro byihutirwa. Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo imiti nka lithium, benzodiazepines, na antipsychotics, ndetse no kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe hakoreshejwe electroconvulsive therapy (ECT). Mu gihe umugore yigeze kugira umuti wa lithium, ashobora gutangira gukoreshwa mu buryo bwo kwirinda ako kanya nyuma yo kubyara. Ibimenyetso byo mu mutwe, cyane cyane ibyo kwibeshya ko umuntu atamenye neza, bitera impungenge ku mutekano w'umwana na nyina; iyo ndwara ikaba yatuma umwana apfa muri 4% by'abanduye ndetse ikaba ishobora no kwiyahura na nyina. Gutandukana Gutandukana bibaho kugeza kuri 20%.
Ihungabana ryo mu mutwe nyuma yo kubyara ribaho ku mwana 1 kugeza kuri 2 ku bana 1000 bavutse. Igipimo kigaragara kimwe mu mico itandukanye no mu byiciro bitandukanye by'imibereho. Kenshi na kenshi, igaragara mu gihe umuntu arwaye indwara ya bipolar izwi cyangwa nshya, izwi nka nyuma yo kuvuka. Iyi ndwara yasobanuwe kuva mu 400 mbere ya Yesu na Hippocrates.

Igifu ni ukubyimba kw'uruti rw'igifu. Bishobora kubaho nk'igihe gito cyangwa bikaba igihe kirekire. Nta bimenyetso bishobora kubaho ariko iyo ibimenyetso bigaragaye, ububabare bukunze kugaragara ni ububabare bwo mu nda yo hejuru. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kugaragara birimo isesemi no kuruka, kubyimba inda, kubura ubushake bwo kurya no kuribwa mu gifu. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kuva amaraso mu gifu, ibisebe byo mu gifu, n'ibibyimba byo mu gifu. Iyo habayeho ibibazo by’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri, uturemangingo dutukura duke duterwa no kubura vitamine B12 ihagije, indwara izwi nka anemia itera indwara.
Impamvu zikunze kugaragara zirimo kwandura "Helicobacter pylori" no gukoresha imiti igabanya ubushyuhe itari steroide (NSAIDs). Impamvu zidakunze kugaragara zirimo inzoga, kunywa itabi, kokayine, indwara zikomeye, ibibazo by’umubiri udafite ubushobozi bwo kwirwanaho, kuvurwa hakoreshejwe imirasire n’indwara ya Crohn. Endoskopi, ubwoko bwa X-ray buzwi nka " upper gastrointestinal series", ibizamini by'amaraso, n'ibizamini by'umwanda bishobora gufasha mu gusuzuma indwara. Ibimenyetso bya gastritis bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy'indwara y'umutima ifata imitsi. Izindi ndwara zifite ibimenyetso bisa zirimo kubyimba kwa pancreas, ibibazo by'agasabo k'inkari, n'indwara y'ibisebe byo mu gifu.
Kwirinda ni ukwirinda ibintu bitera indwara. Ubuvuzi burimo imiti nka antacids, H2 blockers, cyangwa proton pump inhibitors. Mu gihe cy'igitero gikomeye, kunywa lidocaine ifite viscous bishobora gufasha. Iyo indwara ya gastritis iterwa na NSAIDs, ishobora guhagarara. Iyo "H. pylori" ihari ishobora kuvurwa hakoreshejwe imiti ivanze ya antibiyotike nka amoxicillin na clarithromycin. Ku bafite ikibazo cyo kubura amaraso mu mubiri, imiti igabanya ubukana bwa Vitamine B12 irasabwa kunyobwa cyangwa guterwa inshinge. Abantu bakunze kugira inama yo kwirinda ibiryo bibabangamira.
Bivugwa ko indwara ya gastrite yibasira hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'abantu ku isi yose. Mu 2013 habayeho abarwayi bashya bagera kuri miliyoni 90 b'iyi ndwara. Uko abantu bagenda bakura niko indwara irushaho kugaragara. Iyo ndwara, hamwe n’indwara isa nayo mu gice cya mbere cy’amara kizwi nka duodenitis, yahitanye abantu 50.000 mu 2015. "H. pylori" yavumbuwe bwa mbere mu 1981 na Barry Marshall na Robin Warren.

Mastoidite ni indwara ifata uturemangingo tw’umwuka turi mu gahanga inyuma y’ugutwi. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba umutuku, kubyimba, no kubabara inyuma y'ugutwi hamwe n'umuriro n'ububabare mu matwi. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo meningite, ububabare bwo mu mutwe, na venous sinus thrombosis.
Indwara ya mastoidite ikunze kugaragara nk'ingaruka z'ubwandu bwo mu gutwi ko hagati. Ibintu bishobora gutera ingorane birimo imikorere mibi y'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bishingiye ku bimenyetso n'isuzuma. Gusuzuma ingoma yo mu matwi akenshi bigaragaza amabyi. Gufata amashusho y’ubuvuzi bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu bihe bitazwi neza.
Ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko nka ceftriaxone cyangwa vancomycin mu mitsi. Izindi ngamba zishobora gusabwa zirimo gukata ingoma yo mu matwi, imiyoboro ya tympanostomy, cyangwa gucibwamo mastoidectomy. Indi miti ishobora gukoreshwa irimo steroide.
Indwara ya mastoidite ntikunze kubaho, yibasira abana bagera kuri 2.7 ku bana 100.000 buri mwaka. Abana, cyane cyane abari munsi y'imyaka 2, ni bo bibasirwa cyane kurusha abantu bakuru. Mbere y’uko haboneka imiti yica udukoko n’urukingo rwa pneumococcal, indwara yari ikunze kugaragara cyane.

Salbutamol, izwi kandi ku izina rya albuterol kandi igurishwa nka Ventolin mu yandi mazina, ni umuti ufungura inzira z'ubuhumekero zo hagati n'izinini mu bihaha. Ikoreshwa mu kuvura asima, harimo indwara ya asima, kugabanuka k'imitsi y'amaraso bitewe n'imyitozo ngororamubiri, ndetse n'indwara zidakira zo mu bihaha (COPD). Ishobora kandi gukoreshwa mu kuvura urugero rwinshi rwa potasiyumu mu maraso. Salbutamol ikoreshwa mu buryo busanzwe hamwe n'icyuma gihumeka cyangwa imvange, ariko iboneka no mu binini, mu mazi no mu mitsi. Itangira ry'imikorere y'iyi mashini ihumekwa rikunze kuba mu minota 15 kandi rimara amasaha abiri kugeza kuri atandatu.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kunyara, kuribwa umutwe, gutera k'umutima vuba, kuzerera no kumva uhangayitse. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kwiyongera kwa bronchospasm, umutima utera nabi, hamwe n'urugero rwa potasiyumu mu maraso. Ishobora gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa, ariko umutekano wayo nturasobanuka neza. Ni agonisti y’ikirahure cya β2 adrenergic receptor ikora vuba, ikora mu gutuma imitsi yoroherwa n’imyakura igenda neza.
Salbutamol yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha patenti mu 1966 mu Bwongereza, itangira kugurishwa mu Bwongereza mu 1969. Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1982. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Salbutamol iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cyo kugurisha mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere cy'umuti uhumeka ufite dose 200 kiri hagati na. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ni hagati na ku giciro gisanzwe cy'ukwezi. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa cumi ukoreshwa cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni 50.

Kwihagarika impatwe bivuga kwihagarika amara gake cyangwa bigoye gutambuka. Imboro ikunze gukomera kandi yumye. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubabara mu nda, kubyimba inda, no kumva nk'aho umuntu atararangiza burundu inzira y'amara. Ingorane ziterwa no kutagira impatwe zishobora kuba zirimo hemorrhoids, imiyoboro y'ikibuno cyangwa imyakura. Inshuro isanzwe yo kwituma amara mu bantu bakuru ni hagati ya gatatu ku munsi na gatatu mu cyumweru. Abana bakunze kugira amara inshuro eshatu kugeza kuri enye ku munsi mu gihe abana bato bakunze kugira amara abiri kugeza kuri atatu ku munsi.
Impatwe ifite impamvu nyinshi. Impamvu zikunze kugaragara zirimo kugenda buhoro kw'imyenge mu mara, indwara yo mu mara iterwa n'imitsi, n'indwara zo mu gice cy'imbere cy'uruti rw'umura. Indwara zifitanye isano nazo zirimo, diyabete, indwara ya Parkinson, indwara ya celiac, indwara ya gluten idaterwa na celiac, kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, diverticulitis, n'indwara y'amara iterwa n'ububabare. Imiti ijyanye no kuvura impatwe irimo imiti igabanya ubukana bw'impatwe, imiti igabanya aside imwe n'imwe, imiti igabanya ubukana bw'imiyoboro ya kalisiyumu, hamwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bw'impatwe. Mu bafata imiti igabanya ubukana bw'ibiyobyabwenge (opioids) bagera kuri 90% barwara impatwe. Kwihagarika impatwe bihangayikishije cyane iyo umuntu agabanutse ibiro cyangwa afite amaraso make, amaraso ari mu mwanda, hari amateka y'indwara y'ububyimbirwe bw'amara cyangwa kanseri y'amara mu muryango we, cyangwa se bitangiye gushya ku muntu ukuze.
Uburyo bwo kuvura impatwe biterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru n'igihe zimaze. Ingamba zishobora gufasha zirimo kunywa ibinyobwa bihagije, kurya fibre nyinshi, no gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri. Iyo ibi bidakora neza, imiti yoroshya uburozi y’umuti utuma umubiri urushaho gukora neza, umuti utuma umubiri urushaho gukora neza, umuti woroshya umwijima, umuti woroshya umwijima, cyangwa ubwoko bw’amavuta yo kwisiga ashobora kuba ari ngombwa. Imiti yoroshya ububabare muri rusange ikoreshwa mu gihe ubundi bwoko bw'imiti budakora neza. Ubundi buryo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo biofeedback cyangwa mu bihe bidasanzwe byo kubaga.
Muri rusange, igipimo cy’indwara yo kutagira impatwe mu baturage ni 2–30 ku ijana. Mu bageze mu zabukuru baba mu kigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru, igipimo cy’indwara yo kutagira impatwe kiri hagati ya 50–75%. Abantu bakoresha, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, arenga ku miti ivura impatwe buri mwaka.

Ikirenge cy'ikirenge ni indwara ivuka aho ikirenge kimwe cyangwa byombi bizunguruka imbere no hepfo. Ikirenge n'ukuguru byafashwe bishobora kuba bito ugereranije n'ibindi. Hafi 50% by'abarwayi b'ikirenge kibabara ibirenge byombi. Akenshi, ntabwo bifitanye isano n'ibindi bibazo. Iyo hatabayeho kuvurwa, ikirenge gikomeza kuba kibi, kandi abantu bagenda ku mpande z'ibirenge byabo. Ibi bishobora gutera ububabare no kugorwa no kugenda.
Impamvu nyayo akenshi ntimenyekana. Ibintu byombi bigize imiterere y’umubiri n’ibidukikije byizewe ko bibigiramo uruhare. Iyo impanga imwe isa ifashwe, hari amahirwe angana na 33% ko indi nayo izafatwa. Uburyo bw'ibanze butuma imitsi cyangwa ingingo zo hasi zihungabana, bigatera ingingo gufungana. Izindi ndwara zikunze kugaragara kuri 20% by'igihe, aho ikunze kugaragara cyane ari arthrogryposis na myelomeningocele. Isuzuma rishobora gukorwa igihe umuntu avuka binyuze mu gusuzuma cyangwa mbere yo kuvuka mu gihe cyo gusuzuma hakoreshejwe ultrasound.
Uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura akenshi ni uburyo bwa Ponseti. Ibi bikubiyemo kwimura ikirenge ukagishyira mu mwanya mwiza hanyuma ugatera icyuma, ibyo bigasubirwamo buri cyumweru. Iyo umutsi wo mu nda umaze kumera neza, umutsi wo mu nda wa Achilles ukunze gucibwa, kandi imishumi irashyirwaho kugeza ku myaka ine. Mu ntangiriro, igitambaro cyo gupfuka amaguru cyambarwa hafi buri gihe hanyuma kikambarwa nijoro gusa. Mu manza zigera kuri 20%, hakenewe ubundi buryo bwo kubaga. Ubuvuzi bushobora gukorwa n'abatanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi batandukanye kandi muri rusange bushobora kugerwaho mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere nta bushobozi buke.
Ikirenge kibaho ku bana 1 kugeza kuri 4 mu bana 1.000 bavutse ari bazima, bigatuma kiba kimwe mu bibazo bikunze kugaragara ku maguru. Hafi 80% by'abanduye bagaragara mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere aho abantu batabona ubuvuzi buhagije. Ikirenge cy'umugongo gikunze kugaragara cyane mu bana b'imfura n'abahungu. Bikunze kugaragara cyane mu baturage ba Maori, kandi ntibikunze kugaragara cyane mu Bashinwa.

Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi, no gucibwamo. Ni gake cyane hashobora kubaho kugabanuka k'umusemburo w'amagufwa, bikaba byaviramo urupfu. Kugira ngo ugabanye ibyago byo kugira ingaruka mbi, igihe cyo kuvurwa kigomba kuba gito uko bishoboka kose. Abantu bafite ibibazo by'umwijima cyangwa impyiko bashobora gukenera dose nke. Ku bana bato, indwara izwi nka "gray baby syndrome" ishobora kubaho, bigatuma igifu kibyimba kandi umuvuduko w'amaraso ukaba muke. Gukoresha iyo ndwara hafi yo gutwita no mu gihe cyo konsa ubusanzwe ntibyemewe. Chloramphenicol ni umuti urwanya udukoko twinshi ukunze guhagarika gukura kwa bagiteri binyuze mu guhagarika ikorwa rya poroteyine.
Chloramphenicol yavumbuwe nyuma yo gukurwa muri "Streptomyces venezuelae" mu 1947. Imiterere yayo ya shimi yamenyekanye kandi yakozwe bwa mbere mu buryo bw'ubukorano mu 1949, bituma iba antibiyotike ya mbere yakorewe aho gukurwa mu turemangingo duto. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cy’umuti uterwa mu mitsi mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere ni hagati y’amadolari y’Amerika 0.40–1.90. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igipimo cyo guterwa mu mitsi kigura hafi $41.47.

Indwara ya sclerosis y'ibibyimba (TS) ni indwara iterwa n'uturemangingo itera kwiyongera kw'ibibyimba bitari kanseri mu bwonko no mu zindi ngingo nk'umutima, amaso, ibihaha n'uruhu. Ibimenyetso bisanzwe birimo gucika intege, ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, gutinda mu mikurire, ibibazo by'imyitwarire, na autisme. Ibibazo bikunze gutangira mu mwaka wa mbere w'ubuzima; nubwo bishobora kubaho nyuma. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo by'impyiko n'ibihaha.
Iterwa n'impinduka mu miterere ya gene ya "TSC1" cyangwa "TSC2", ari na yo ikora poroteyine hamartine na tuberin, uko bikurikirana. Nubwo ishobora kuragwa n'ababyeyi b'umuntu mu buryo busanzwe bwo kwigira ku mubiri, inyinshi muri zo ziba mu gihe cy'imikurire mishya. Izi poroteyine zifatwa nk'izigabanya gukura kwa kanseri. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bishingiye ku bimenyetso kandi bigashyigikirwa n'amashusho y'abaganga. Bishobora kandi kwemezwa no gupima imiterere y'uturemangingo.
Nta muti uhari, ubuvuzi bufasha mu buryo busanzwe. Ibikorwa bishobora kuba birimo ubuvuzi bw'umubiri, ubuvuzi bw'akazi, ubuvuzi bwo kuvuga, n'ubuvuzi bw'imyitwarire. Imiti igabanya igicuri, nka vigabatrin, ishobora gukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe. Ingaruka z'igihe kirekire zirahindagurika kandi biterwa n'uburemere bw'ibimenyetso.
Indwara ya sclerosis y'ibibyimba ishobora kwibasira abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 2 ku isi yose. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ifata abana bagera kuri 1 ku bana 6.000; mu gihe idakunze kugaragara cyane mu Burayi. Abagabo n'abagore barwara indwara imwe. Byasobanuwe bwa mbere n'umuhanga mu by'imitsi w'Umufaransa Désiré-Magloire Bourneville mu 1880. Izina ryerekeza ku kubyimba kudasanzwe mu bwonko, bishobora kuba bimeze nk'ibirayi.

Croup, izwi kandi nka laryngotracheobronchitis, ni ubwoko bw'indwara zo mu myanya y'ubuhumekero zikunze guterwa na virusi. Ubwandu butera kubyimba imbere mu muyoboro w'amaraso, ibyo bikaba bibangamira guhumeka neza kandi bigatera ibimenyetso bisanzwe byo " gukorora ", stridor, n'ijwi rituje. Umuriro n'izuru riva nabyo bishobora kuba biriho. Ibi bimenyetso bishobora kuba byoroheje, biri hagati, cyangwa bikomeye. Akenshi bitangira cyangwa bikarushaho kuba bibi nijoro kandi ubusanzwe bifata umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri.
Indwara ya Croup ishobora guterwa na virusi nyinshi zirimo parainfluenza na virusi ya grippe. Ni gake cyane biterwa n'ubwandu bwa bagiteri, buzwi nka tracheitis ya bagiteri. Ubusanzwe indwara ya Croup ipimwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso nyuma y’uko impamvu zishobora kuba zikomeye kurushaho, nka epiglottitis cyangwa umubiri wo mu nzira z’ubuhumekero, zitagaragaye. Ubushakashatsi bw'inyongera—nk'ibipimo by'amaraso, X-rays, no gupima—ubusanzwe ntabwo bikenewe.
Abantu benshi barwara indwara ya croup bashobora kwirindwa binyuze mu gukingira ibicurane na diphtheria. Ubusanzwe Croup ivurwa n'umuti umwe wa steroide ukoreshejwe mu kanwa (dexamethasone ku gipimo cya 0.15 kugeza 0.6 mg/kg). Mu bihe bikomeye cyane, epinephrine ihumekwa na yo ishobora gukoreshwa. Kwinjira mu bitaro ni ngombwa ku muntu umwe kugeza kuri batanu ku ijana by'abarwayi.
Indwara ya Croup ni indwara ikunze kwibasira abana bagera kuri 15% mu gihe runaka. Akenshi bibaho hagati y'amezi 6 n'imyaka 5 ariko bishobora kugaragara gake cyane ku bana bafite imyaka cumi n'itanu. Bikunze kugaragara gato ku bagabo kurusha abagore. Bikunze kubaho mu gihe cy'umuhindo. Mbere yo gukingirwa, indwara yo mu nda yakundaga guterwa na diphtheria kandi akenshi yahitanaga abantu. Iyi mpamvu ubu irakunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu by'Iburengerazuba bw'Isi bitewe n'uko urukingo rwa diphtheria rwagenze neza.

Ububabare bwo mu mugongo wo hasi (LBP) ni indwara ikunze kugaragara ku mitsi, imitsi, n'amagufwa y'umugongo. Ububabare bushobora gutandukana uhereye ku kubabara gukabije guhoraho kugeza ku kumva ubabaye mu buryo butunguranye. Ishobora gushyirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe igihe imara nk'ububabare bukabije (ububabare bumara munsi y'ibyumweru 6), ububabare budahoraho (ibyumweru 6 kugeza kuri 12), cyangwa ububabare budakira (ibyumweru birenga 12). Iyi ndwara ishobora gushyirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe impamvu nyamukuru nk'ububabare buterwa n'imikorere, ububabare buterwa n'imikorere, cyangwa ububabare buterwa n'imvugo. Ibimenyetso akenshi biragenda neza mu byumweru bike uhereye igihe byatangiriye, aho abantu 40–90% baba bakize neza mu byumweru bitandatu.
Mu bihe byinshi, impamvu yihariye itera iyi ndwara ntabwo imenyekana cyangwa ngo ishakishwe, aho ububabare bukekwa ko buterwa n'ibibazo by'imikorere nk'imitsi cyangwa ingingo. Niba ububabare budashira iyo umuntu avuwe mu buryo busanzwe cyangwa bugaherekezwa n' "ibimenyetso bitukura" nko kugabanya ibiro mu buryo budasobanutse, umuriro, cyangwa ibibazo bikomeye byo kumva cyangwa kugenda, hashobora kuba ngombwa ko hakorwa isuzuma ryinyongera kugira ngo hamenyekane ikibazo gikomeye cy’ingenzi. Kenshi na kenshi, ibikoresho byo gufata amashusho nka X-ray computed tomography ntabwo bifite akamaro kandi bifite ingaruka zabyo. Nubwo bimeze bityo ariko, gukoresha amashusho mu kuvura ububabare bwo hasi bwiyongereye. Ububabare bumwe na bumwe bw'umugongo wo hasi buterwa n'amadisiki yo mu gice cy'imbere cy'umutima yangiritse, kandi ikizamini cyo kuzamura amaguru agororotse ni ingirakamaro mu kumenya impamvu. Ku bafite ububabare budakira, uburyo bwo gutunganya ububabare bushobora gukora nabi, bigatera ububabare bwinshi bitewe n’ibintu bitari bikomeye.
Kubanza gukoresha imiti idashingiye ku miti ni byiza. Imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara zo mu mutwe (NSAIDs) irasabwa niba idakora neza. Ibikorwa bisanzwe bigomba gukomeza uko ububabare bushoboka kandi imyitozo ngororamubiri ni ingirakamaro mu kubabara igihe kirekire. Imiti irasabwa mu gihe cyose ifasha. Hari ubundi buryo butandukanye buhari ku bantu badakira neza bakoresheje uburyo busanzwe bwo kuvurwa. Opioide ishobora kuba ingirakamaro niba imiti yoroheje y'ububabare idahagije, ariko muri rusange ntabwo isabwa kubera ingaruka mbi. Kubagwa bishobora kuba ingirakamaro ku bafite ububabare budakira buterwa n'amadisiki n'ubumuga cyangwa stenosis y'umugongo. Nta nyungu igaragara yabonetse ku zindi ndwara z’ububabare bw’umugongo wo hasi butari ubwazo. Ububabare bwo mu mugongo wo hasi bukunze kugira ingaruka ku byiyumvo, bishobora kongerwa n'inama cyangwa imiti igabanya ubukana. Byongeye kandi, hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kuvura bushobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bw’umwimerere, ariko nta bimenyetso bihagije bihari kugira ngo umuntu abwizeze neza. Ibimenyetso by’ubuvuzi bwa chiropractic no gukora ubuvuzi bw’umugongo biravanze.
Hafi 9–12% by'abantu (632) miliyoni) bafite LBP mu gihe runaka, kandi hafi 25% bavuga ko bayirwaye mu gihe runaka mu gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe. Abantu bagera kuri 40% bafite LBP mu gihe runaka mu buzima bwabo, aho biteganijwe ko bagera kuri 80% mu bantu bo mu bihugu byateye imbere. Ingorane akenshi zitangira hagati y'imyaka 20 na 40. Abagabo n'abagore bagerwaho n'ingaruka zingana. Ububabare bw'umugongo wo hasi bukunze kugaragara cyane ku bantu bari hagati y'imyaka 40 na 80, kandi umubare w'abantu barwaye wiyongera uko abaturage bagenda bakura.

Uburyo bwo kuvura imisemburo (HRT), buzwi kandi nka ubuvuzi bw'imisemburo mu gihe cyo gucura, ni uburyo bwo kuvura imisemburo bukoreshwa mu kuvura ibimenyetso bifitanye isano no gucura. Ibi birimo ubushyuhe bwinshi, ibyuya byo mu ijoro, kuma kw'imyanya ndangagitsina, n'ibibazo byo kwiyumva nabi. Muri rusange ni uburyo bwo kuvura ibi bimenyetso busabwa Gukoresha muri rusange mu kwirinda ibibazo by'ubuzima by'igihe kirekire, nka kanseri, indwara z'umutima, cyangwa indwara yo gucika kw'amagufwa, ntibyemewe. Gukoresha bigirwa inama y'igihe gito kandi bishobora gukorwa mu nzira zitandukanye.
Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo indwara y'agasabo k'inkari, gucika imitsi, kunanirwa kwihagarika inkari, no kugabanya amaraso; ariko nta gihinduka mu byago byose byo kugira ingaruka mbi cyangwa urupfu. Ibimenyetso by'ishingiro bishyigikira inyungu nini kurusha ingaruka mbi ku bari munsi y'imyaka 60. Gukoresha iyi miti ntibyemewe ku bantu bafite ibibazo by'umwijima cyangwa kanseri y'ibere. Irimo estrogen na progestogen. Progestogen ikoreshwa, keretse iyo nyababyeyi yakuweho, kugira ngo hirindwe ibyago byinshi byo kurwara kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Androgens, kimwe na testosterone, rimwe na rimwe na zo zirakoreshwa.
Uburyo bwo kuvura imisemburo bukoreshwa kuva mu myaka ya 1890. Guhera mu 2024, ibiciro muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika biratandukanye kuva kuri 10 USD kugeza kuri 500 USD, bitewe n'ubwoko. Kwinjira kwa estrogen, estradiol, mu rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi ya OMS byamaganywe mu 2023, hamwe n'inama zo gutekereza cyane ku kuyishyiramo. Gusimbuza imisemburo isa n’iy’ibinyabuzima byamamaye cyane mu myaka ya za 2000 aho bavugaga ko ari "umwimerere" cyane; icyakora, inyungu n’umutekano ntibirasobanuka neza, kandi kuyikoresha ntibyemewe.

Élie Sagatwa (yapfuye ku ya 6 Mata 1994 i Kigali) yari umusirikare w'Umunyarwanda ufite ipeti rya koloneli mu Ngabo z'u Rwanda (FAR). Yari umunyamabanga wihariye wa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana kandi yari mu bantu ba hafi b'ubutegetsi bwe mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yaguye mu ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida ryabaye ku ya 6 Mata 1994.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Élie Sagatwa yari koloneli mu Ngabo z'u Rwanda ("Forces armées rwandaises", FAR). Yakoraga nk'umunyamabanga wihariye wa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana.
Nk'uko Human Rights Watch ibivuga, Sagatwa yari umwe mu bantu bari bafite ijambo rikomeye mu bari hafi ya Perezida, nubwo atagaragaraga cyane nk'abandi bayobozi ba politiki cyangwa b'ubukungu b'ubutegetsi. Iyo raporo kandi ivuga ko Ingabo zirinda Umukuru w'Igihugu ("Garde présidentielle"), umutwe wari ufite intwaro nyinshi kandi wigenga cyane mu Ngabo z'u Rwanda, wari uyobowe na Koloneli Sagatwa kugeza apfuye.
Élie Sagatwa avugwa mu bagize "Akazu", izina ryahawe itsinda ry'abantu ba hafi ya Perezida Habyarimana n'umugore we Agathe Kanziga, abashakashatsi benshi babona nk'itsinda ryari rifite ububasha bukomeye mu butegetsi bwa Repubulika ya Kabiri y'Rwanda.
Ubushakashatsi bwa Alison Des Forges kuri Human Rights Watch bumugaragaza nk'umwe mu bantu bo mu bari hafi ya Perezida bakoreraga inyuma y'amarido y'ubutegetsi. Mu buhamya bwatanzwe imbere y'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR) rwakoreraga mu mujyi wa Arusha muri Tanzaniya, na ho avugwa nk'umunyamabanga wihariye wa Perezida Habyarimana.
Ku ya 6 Mata 1994, Élie Sagatwa yari mu ndege "Dassault Falcon 50" yari itwaye Perezida w'u Rwanda Juvénal Habyarimana na Perezida w'Uburundi Cyprien Ntaryamira, hamwe n'umugaba mukuru w'Ingabo z'u Rwanda, Jenerali Déogratias Nsabimana. Iyo ndege yarashwe na misile igihe yari yegereye ikibuga cy'indege cya Kigali i Kanombe, maze abari bayirimo bose barapfa.
Urutonde rw'abagenzi rugaragaza Élie Sagatwa nka koloneli akaba n'umunyamabanga wihariye wa Perezida. Ikigo "Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archives" na cyo kimubara mu bagenzi baguye muri iyo mpanuka.
Ihanurwa ry'iyo ndege rifatwa nk'imbarutso ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, yakozwe n'abahezanguni b'Abahutu barimo Interahamwe.

Patrick de Saint-Exupéry (yavutse ku ya 16 Nzeri 1962) ni umunyamakuru akaba n'umwanditsi w'Umufaransa. Azwi cyane ku nkuru yanditse ku Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda no ku bitabo bivuga ku ruhare rw'Ubufaransa muri iyo jenoside.
Yatangiye itangazamakuru afite imyaka 19, akorera "France-Soir" na "L'Express", maze kuva mu 1989 aba umunyamakuru w'amakuru y'amahanga wa "Le Figaro". Yatangaje inkuru zo muri Liberiya, Afurika y’Epfo, Kambodiya, Irani, Rwanda n'ahandi, kandi kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2004 yari umunyamakuru wa "Le Figaro" mu Uburusiya. Mu 1991 yahawe igihembo cya "Prix Albert-Londres".
Mu 2008 yashinze, afatanyije na Laurent Beccaria, ikinyamakuru "XXI", na nyuma "Ebdo" mu 2017, cyahagaze mu 2018.
Mu 1994 yageze mu Rwanda anyuze ku ruhande rwa FPR-Inkotanyi, hanyuma mu gihe cy"'Opération Turquoise" ari kumwe n'ingabo z'Abafaransa, yibonera ibyabereye i Bisesero. Inkuru yanditse icyo gihe no mu 1998 zatumye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Ubufaransa ishyiraho komisiyo yo gucukumbura ku Rwanda.
Mu 2004 yasohoye igitabo "L'Inavouable: la France au Rwanda", cyongeye gusohoka mu 2009 cyitwa "Complices de l'inavouable". Abajenerali Christian Quesnot na Éric de Stabenrath bamureze gusebanya kubera icyo gitabo, maze inkiko zimuhamya icyo cyaha. Mu 2021, mu gitabo "La Traversée", yanyomoje igitekerezo cy'uko habayeho «jenoside ya kabiri».

Aminadabu Birara (1926 – 25 Kamena 1994) yari umworozi w'Umunyarwanda wo mu misozi ya Bisesero, uzwiho kuba yarayoboye ubwirwanaho bw'Abatutsi i Bisesero mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yiciwe muri iyo misozi ku ya 25 Kamena 1994.
Aminadabu Birara yavukiye i Bisesero, mu misozi y'Iburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu 1926. Yari umworozi kimwe n'abagabo benshi bo muri ako karere. Yarokotse ubwicanyi bwibasiye Abatutsi mu 1959, 1962, 1963 no mu 1973, bituma aba umuntu wubashywe mu karere kubera ubunararibonye bwe mu kurinda Abatutsi ba Bisesero.
Ubwirwanaho bwa Bisesero.
Jenoside itangiye muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi bahungiye mu misozi ya Bisesero. Birara, wari ufite imyaka 68, yabaye umwe mu bayobozi b'ubwirwanaho. Yasabye abaturage kujya ku mpinga z'imisozi kugira ngo babone abateye kandi babatere amabuye, ashyiraho n'amatsinda y'abarwanyi bitwaje amacumu, amabuye n'inkoni. Ayo matsinda yari ashyizwe ahantu hatandukanye ku misozi, Birara akayahuza.
Yiciwe i Bisesero ku ya 25 Kamena 1994, ahitanywe n'igisasu cya gerenade. Abantu barenga 50 000 biciwe i Bisesero, abarokotse bakaba batageze ku 1 000.
Ku ya 19 Ugushyingo 2021, Inama Njyanama y'umujyi wa Paris yemeje ku bwumvikane bwa bose ko ahantu hamwe mu karere ka 18 ka Paris hitirirwa Aminadabu Birara. "Place Aminadabu-Birara" yatashywe ku ya 13 Gicurasi 2022, iba ahantu ha cumi na hamwe mu Bufaransa hibukirwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Kaminuza Yigenga y'Ibihugu by'Ibiyaga Bigari y'i Butembo (mu Igifaransa: "Université libre des pays des Grands Lacs de Butembo", ULPGL-Butembo) ni kaminuza yigenga y'abaporotesitanti iri i Butembo, mu Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Yatangiye mu 2001 ari ishami rya ULPGL y'i Goma, iza guhabwa ubwigenge mu 2011. Ifite amashami atandatu.
ULPGL ikomoka i Goma, aho mu 1985 hashinzwe Ishuri Rikuru rya Tewolojiya y'Abaporotesitanti (ISTP), ryashinzwe n'amatorero atandatu yo mu Itorero rya Kristo muri Kongo (ECC), nyuma riza kuba kaminuza.
Ishami ry'i Butembo ryafunguwe mu 2001, ritangirana na tewolojiya, hakurikiraho andi mashami hagati ya 2002 na 2016. Kuva mu 2007 rikorera mu gace ka Makomo. Ryahawe ubwigenge mu 2011, rikaba ikigo cyigenga cy'amashuri makuru cyemewe na Leta.
ULPGL-Butembo ifite amashami atandatu:
Inshingano n'ubushakashatsi.
Inshingano yayo ni gutanga ubumenyi n'ubushakashatsi bufite ireme, ifatanyije n'abaturage bo hafi yayo, hagamijwe iterambere rusange. Intego yayo ni "Foi, Science, Action" (Ukwizera, Ubumenyi, Igikorwa).
Mu 2026, ishami ry'ubuhinzi ryagerageje, rifatanyije n'ishyirahamwe SYDIP, ubwoko bushya bw'ibirayi ku murima w'igerageza wa kaminuza.

Christian Quesnot (yavutse ku ya 24 Gicurasi 1938 i Vire) ni jenerali w'Umufaransa. Kuva mu 1991 kugeza mu 1995 yayoboye ibiro bya gisirikare bya Perezida w'Ubufaransa François Mitterrand, bituma agira uruhare rukomeye muri politiki ya gisirikare y'Ubufaransa mu Rwanda mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Umwuga wa gisirikare.
Yinjiye mu gisirikare mu 1960 mu ishami ry'ubwubatsi ("Génie"), aba injeniyeri w'imihanda n'ibiraro. Yakoze cyane mu mutwe w'abasirikare b'abaparakomando b'ubwubatsi (17e RGP), ayobora ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri Cade (1979–1980) no mu murwa mukuru wa Libani, Beyrouth (1983–1984). Yabaye jenerali mu 1987, nyuma aba jenerali w'ingabo ("général d'armée") mu 1995.
Kuva muri Mata 1991 kugeza muri Nzeri 1995, Quesnot yari umuyobozi w'ibiro bya gisirikare bya Perezida Mitterrand. Mbere ya jenoside, yafataga FPR-Inkotanyi nk'«Abakhmer b'abirabura» bashaka gushinga «Tutsiland» kuva muri Ubugande kugeza mu Uburundi. Mu nyandiko yandikiye Perezida mu gihe cya jenoside, yasabye ko Ubufaransa bukomeza gushyigikira ubutegetsi bwariho mu Rwanda.
Mu 2008, raporo ya Komisiyo Mucyo yamushyize ku rutonde rw'abantu 33 b'Abafaransa bavugwaho kugira uruhare rukomeye muri jenoside. Yareze Minisitiri w'Ubutabera w'u Rwanda, Tharcisse Karugarama, icyaha cyo gusebanya, ariko icyo kirego nticyagira icyo kigeraho. Yareze kandi umunyamakuru Patrick de Saint-Exupéry kubera igitabo "Complices de l'inavouable", maze mu 2014 urukiko ruhamya Saint-Exupéry icyaha cyo gusebanya.
Nyuma y'igisirikare.
Mu 1995 yagizwe umuyobozi w'ikigo SISIE ("Services Industries Stratégies International et Environnement"). Kugeza muri Mata 2008 yayoboraga ikinyamakuru "Défense nationale et sécurité collective".

Charles Habonimana (yavutse mu 1982) ni umwanditsi n'umuyobozi w'Umunyarwanda warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ni we wanditse igitabo cy'ubuhamya "Moi, le dernier Tutsi" (2019), kandi mu 2020 yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru w'ikigo "Rwanda Airports Company" gishinzwe ibibuga by'indege mu Rwanda.
Charles Habonimana yavukiye i Mayunzwe, mu Akarere ka Ruhango (Intara y'Amajyepfo), mu muryango w'abahinzi w'abana icyenda. Jenoside itangira yari afite imyaka 12. Ababyeyi be, batandatu mu bavandimwe be n'abenshi mu muryango we barishwe; we na mushiki we Yvonne ni bo bonyine barokotse. Yarokotse kubera ko umuyobozi w'abicanyi bo mu gace yari yafashe icyemezo cyo kumugumisha ari muzima nk'«Umututsi wa nyuma», ngo azereke ab'igihe kizaza uko Abatutsi basaga.
Nyuma ya jenoside yakomeje amashuri, abona impamyabumenyi y'icyiciro cya kabiri muri Kaminuza Yigenga ya Kigali (ULK) n'iy'icyiciro cya gatatu muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda.
Yakoze imirimo itandukanye y'ubuyobozi, harimo kuba umuyobozi w'abakozi mu kigo EUCL gishinzwe ingufu. Ku ya 25 Kamena 2020, Perezida Paul Kagame yamugize umuyobozi mukuru wa "Rwanda Airports Company".
Kuva mu 2012 kugeza mu 2016 yayoboye GAERG, umuryango w'abahoze ari abanyeshuri ba kaminuza barokotse jenoside, kandi akunze gutanga ubuhamya mu bihe bya Kwibuka.
Mu 2019 yasohoye, afatanyije na Daniel Le Scornet, igitabo "Moi, le dernier Tutsi" (Plon), kivuga ku iyicwa ry'umuryango we n'iry'Abatutsi bo mu cyaro cye. Cyamuritswe i Kigali muri Mata 2019, kandi cyagarutsweho n'itangazamakuru ndetse n'ubushakashatsi ku nkuru z'abana barokotse jenoside.

Milgitha Kösser (1936 – Gashyantare 2016) yari umubikira w'Umudage wakoreye mu Rwanda, ayobora ivuriro rya Kaduha. Azwiho kuba yarabaye umutangabuhamya w'ubwicanyi bwabereye kuri paruwasi ya Kaduha mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, no kuba yarakusanyije inyandiko n'amafoto byabwo.
Milgitha Kösser yabaga i Kaduha, muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro (ubu ni mu Akarere ka Nyamagabe). Kuva mu 1973 yayoboraga ivuriro rya Kaduha, ryari hamwe na paruwasi, amashuri n'ibitaro byatashywe mu 1986.
Mu gihe cya jenoside, yanze kuva ku ivuriro yari ashinzwe. Yiboneye ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi ku ya 21 Mata 1994 muri kiliziya, mu nyubako za paruwasi no hafi yazo. Mu rwibutso rwa Kaduha hashyinguwe imibiri y'abantu 47 311.
Ku ya 23 Kamena 1994, abana bari bahishwe mu ivuriro bavanywe yo n'umuryango "Terre des hommes", yari yaburiye ubwo yanyuraga mu Uburundi mbere yo gusubira mu Budage ku ya 26 Kamena 1994.
Inyandiko yakusanyije.
Nyuma ya jenoside, yakoze alubumu y'amafoto 193 yo kuva mu 1992 kugeza mu 1995, igaragaza ubwicanyi, isenywa ry'inyubako n'ihohoterwa ry'imibiri n'ahantu h'ubutagatifu. Umuhanga mu mateka Hélène Dumas yifashishije iyo alubumu mu bushakashatsi bwe kuri Kaduha. Ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2006, yakoze urutonde rw'abantu 103 barokokeye ku ivuriro, barimo abana 74.

Thierry Prungnaud (yavutse ku ya 5 Gicurasi 1956 i Poitiers) ni umujandarume w'Umufaransa wahoze mu mutwe w'intore wa GIGN. Yamenyekanye ku buhamya bwe ku ruhare rw'Ubufaransa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, aho yari mu "Opération Turquoise", ndetse no ku gitero cyo kubohora abari bafashwe bugwate mu ndege ya "Air France" i Marignane ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1994.
Mbere ya jenoside, Prungnaud yahuguye mu Rwanda umutwe w'Ingabo zirinda Umukuru w'Igihugu (GISGP), wari wubakiye ku miterere ya GIGN. Mu 1994 yari mu "Opération Turquoise".
Mu 2012 yasohoye, afatanyije n'umunyamakuru Laure de Vulpian, igitabo "Silence turquoise", ashinja ingabo z'Ubufaransa kuba zararetse abasivili b'Abatutsi bakicwa. Avuga ko yasuzuguye amabwiriza bityo agashobora kurokora Abatutsi amagana. Jenerali Jean-Claude Lafourcade, wayoboraga "Opération Turquoise", yahakanye ibyo avuga. Ubuhamya bwe nyuma bwashimangiwe n'undi musirikare w'Umufaransa, Guillaume Ancel.
Igitero cya Marignane.
Ku ya 26 Ukuboza 1994, ku kibuga cy'indege cya Marignane hafi ya Marseille, yabaye umujandarume wa kabiri winjiye mu ndege ya "Air France" (urugendo 8969) yari yafashwe bugwate n'abarwanyi ba GIA. Yakomerekejwe n'amasasu arindwi n'igisasu cya gerenade, ariko abasha guhagarika batatu muri bane mu bari bafashe bugwate abantu, ararokoka. Muri filime "L'Assaut" (2011), uruhare rwe rwakinwe na Vincent Elbaz.
Yahawe imidari myinshi, irimo "Légion d'honneur" (ku rwego rwa "officier", 2022), "Médaille militaire", "Croix de la Valeur militaire" n'Umudari w'Igihugu w'Amahoro w'u Rwanda.

Paul Barril (yavutse ku ya 13 Mata 1946 i Vinay) ni kapiteni w'Umufaransa wahoze mu ijandarumori, wungirije umuyobozi w'umutwe w'intore wa GIGN. Nyuma yashinze ibigo byigenga by'umutekano. Azwi cyane kubera impaka zishingiye ku ruhare rwe mu Rwanda mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Kuva mu 1974 kugeza mu 1982 yari umwungirije wa Christian Prouteau mu buyobozi bwa GIGN; mu 1979 yoherejwe muri Arabiya Sawudite gufasha guhosha ifatwa ry'Umusigiti Mutagatifu wa Maka. Mu 1982 yafatanyije na Prouteau gushinga ishami rirwanya iterabwoba ryo mu biro bya Perezida François Mitterrand. Nyuma yo kuva mu gisirikare, yashinze ibigo by'umutekano "Epsylon" na "SECRETS", akorera ibihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika, harimo Kote Divuwari.
Barril yivugaga ko yari umujyanama wa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana. Mu 1989 yitabajwe mu ivugurura ry'inzego z'iperereza z'u Rwanda, kandi yari hafi y'umugore wa Perezida, Agathe Habyarimana, n'abagize Akazu.
Nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida, Agathe Habyarimana yamuhaye akazi ko gukora iperereza kuri icyo gitero. Yabwiye itangazamakuru ko afite «agasanduku k'umukara» k'indege, ndetse ashyigikira igitekerezo cy'uko FPR-Inkotanyi ari yo yagabye icyo gitero; nyuma, mu 2012, yahakanye ko yigeze agira ako gasanduku.
Ku ya 28 Gicurasi 1994, mu gihe cya jenoside, yasinyanye na Minisitiri w'Intebe wa Guverinoma y'agateganyo, Jean Kambanda, amasezerano yo gutanga intwaro n'amasasu no guhugura abasirikare. Ayo masezerano yabonetse mu isaka ryakozwe iwe n'umucamanza Marc Trévidic mu 2012. Ku ya 25 Kamena 2013, imiryango FIDH, LDH na Survie yamureze icyaha cy'ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside, maze ku ya 27 Kamena 2013 ubucamanza bw'i Paris butangiza iperereza. Iryo perereza ntiryageze ku rubanza.

Vincent Duclert (yavutse ku ya 26 Gashyantare 1961 i Neuilly-sur-Seine) ni umuhanga mu mateka w'Umufaransa, umwarimu n'umugenzuzi mukuru w'uburezi.
Ni inzobere muri jenoside, cyane cyane jenoside yakorewe Abanyarumeniya na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, ndetse no mu kibazo cya Dreyfus.
Kuva mu 2019 kugeza mu 2021 yayoboye komisiyo y'abahanga mu mateka yashyizweho na Perezida w'Ubufaransa Emmanuel Macron ngo isesengure uruhare rw'Ubufaransa mu Rwanda.
Yabonye impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu mateka muri Kaminuza ya Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne mu 2009, ku nyandiko ivuga ku ruhare rw'abahanga mu kibazo cya Dreyfus. Yigishije mu ishuri rikuru "École des hautes études en sciences sociales" (EHESS), kandi kuva mu 2017 ayobora ikigo cy'ubushakashatsi Cespra. Mu 2013 yagizwe umugenzuzi mukuru w'uburezi bw'igihugu.
Yanditse ibitabo byinshi ku kibazo cya Dreyfus, kuri Jean Jaurès no kuri jenoside yakorewe Abanyarumeniya. Mu 2016 yayoboye ubutumwa bwo kwiga ku bushakashatsi no ku myigishirize ya jenoside mu Bufaransa.
Ku ya 5 Mata 2019, Perezida Emmanuel Macron yamushyize ku buyobozi bwa komisiyo y'abahanga mu mateka ishinzwe gusesengura, hifashishijwe ububiko bw'inyandiko z'Ubufaransa, uruhare rw'Ubufaransa mu Rwanda hagati ya 1990 na 1994. Kuba abahanga nka Stéphane Audoin-Rouzeau na Hélène Dumas batari muri iyo komisiyo byateje impaka.
Ku ya 26 Werurwe 2021, komisiyo yashyikirije Perezida raporo yayo, izwi nka «Raporo Duclert». Iyo raporo yemeza ko Ubufaransa bufite «inshingano zikomeye kandi ziremereye» mu byabaye, ariko igahakana ko bwagize ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside. Duclert yavuze ko ubuyobozi bw'Ubufaransa butigeze bwumva neza uko ibintu byari bimeze, bwirengagiza imiburo ku ihezanguni ry'ubutegetsi bwa Juvénal Habyarimana, kandi yamaganye igitekerezo cya «jenoside ebyiri».

Jean Hatzfeld (yavutse ku ya 14 Nzeri 1949 muri Madagasikari) ni umunyamakuru akaba n'umwanditsi w'Umufaransa. Yamenyekanye cyane ku nkuru z'intambara yanditse, cyane cyane ku ntambara yo muri Bosiniya, no ku ruhererekane rw'ibitabo by'ubuhamya ku Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, byanditswe ashingiye ku buhamya bw'abarokotse n'abicanyi bo mu misozi ya Nyamata.
Ni umwuzukuru w'umuhanga mu mateka ya kera witwa na we Jean Hatzfeld. Yakuriye i Chambon-sur-Lignon mu Bufaransa, umudugudu wamenyekanye kubera kwakira no guhisha Abayahudi ibihumbi mu gihe cy'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi.
Mu 1975 yatangiye gukorera ikinyamakuru "Libération" nk'umunyamakuru w'imikino, nyuma aba umunyamakuru w'amakuru mpuzamahanga. Urugendo rwe rwa mbere i Beyrouth muri Libani rwatumye aba umunyamakuru w'intambara; mu myaka 22 yatangaje inkuru ku ntambara zo muri Afurika, mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati no muri Bosiniya.
Yageze mu Rwanda nk'umunyamakuru nyuma gato ya jenoside, atangazwa no kubona uko itangazamakuru ryananiwe kumva guceceka kw'abarokotse. Yahisemo kumara igihe kinini i Nyamata, mu Bugesera, akorana n'Abatutsi barokotse.
Bimwe muri ibyo bitabo byahinduwe mu ndimi nyinshi, ndetse bikinwa no mu makinamico. "Une saison de machettes" yahawe ibihembo bya "Femina essai" na "Joseph Kessel" mu 2003, naho "La Stratégie des antilopes" ihabwa "Prix Médicis" mu 2007.

Boniface Ngulinzira (12 Nyakanga 1950 – 11 Mata 1994) yari umunyapolitiki w'Umunyarwanda, umwe mu bashinze ishyaka MDR rivuguruye ritavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana. Nka Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga (1992–1993), yayoboye intumwa za Guverinoma mu mishyikirano y'amasezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha na FPR-Inkotanyi. Yiciwe i Nyanza ya Kicukiro ku ya 11 Mata 1994, mu ntangiriro za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ngulinzira yari umuhanga mu ndimi n'uburezi. Kuva mu 1974 yakoze mu Biro by'Uburezi ("Bureau pédagogique"), aba umuyobozi wabyo mu 1984–1985, nyuma aba umuyobozi mukuru w'umuco muri Minisiteri y'Amashuri Makuru (1985–1989), n'umunyamabanga mukuru ushinzwe uburezi mu biro bya Perezida wa Repubulika (1989–1991). Mu 1991–1992 yayoboye inama y'ubuyobozi ya ORINFOR. Nyuma ya minisiteri, yabaye umwarimu w'indimi z'Afurika muri Kaminuza Nkuru y'u Rwanda.
Ubuzima bwa politiki.
Ubwo amashyaka menshi yemerwaga mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990, yari mu bashinze MDR rivuguruye. Mu 1991 yirukanywe mu biro bya Perezida, nyuma yo kubazwa impamvu yinjiye mu ishyaka ritari MRND. Mu 1992 yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga muri Guverinoma ihuriweho n'amashyaka, bityo ayobora intumwa za Leta mu mishyikirano ya Arusha.
Abashyigikiye Habyarimana bamushinje «kugurisha igihugu» kuri FPR; mu ijambo rye ry'urwango ryo ku Kabaya mu 1992, León Mugesera yamwise «inyenzi». Muri Mata 1993, Minisitiri w'Intebe mushya Agathe Uwilingiyimana yamusabye kuguma kuri minisiteri, ariko arabyanga; amasezerano ya Arusha yashyizweho umukono muri Kanama 1993.
Ku ya 7 Mata 1994, nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida, Ngulinzira n'umuryango we bahungiye mu ishuri ETO Kicukiro, aho ingabo z'Ababiligi za MINUAR zari zikambitse. Ku ya 11 Mata 1994, izo ngabo zavuye kuri ETO, zisiga impunzi zigera ku 3 000 mu maboko y'Interahamwe n'abasirikare. Abo bantu, barimo Ngulinzira, bajyanywe i Nyanza ya Kicukiro baricwa. Umugore we n'abana be barokotse jenoside. Ashyinguye mu Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro.
Mu 2004, umuryango we n'abandi barokokeye kuri ETO bareze Leta y'Ububiligi. Mu 2018, Urukiko rw'Ubujurire rw'i Buruseli rwemeje ko icyemezo cyo kuva kuri ETO cyafashwe n'ubuyobozi bwa MINUAR, atari ubw'Ububiligi.

Antoine Mugesera ni umushakashatsi akaba n'umwanditsi w'Umunyarwanda, inzobere mu mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Yahoze ari perezida w'umuryango Ibuka uharanira inyungu z'abarokotse jenoside.
Antoine Mugesera yavukiye kandi akurira mu Rwanda. Nyuma ya jenoside, yibanze ku bushakashatsi ku mateka y'u Rwanda, cyane cyane ku gihe cyabanjirije jenoside yo mu 1994. Ubushakashatsi bwe bwerekana amateka n'impamvu zatumye jenoside ishoboka, binyuze mu itotezwa ryakorewe Abatutsi kuva mu 1959.
Yayoboye umuryango Ibuka, kandi atanga ubuhamya ku butwari bwa Damas Gisimba, warokoreye abana n'abandi bantu benshi mu kigo cye cy'imfubyi i Nyamirambo mu gihe cya jenoside.

Jean Varret (yavutse mu 1935 i Paris) ni jenerali w'Umufaransa, wahoze ayobora ishami ry'ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare ("Mission militaire de coopération").
Yarwanyije politiki ya Perezida François Mitterrand mu Rwanda mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ava mu gisirikare mu 1993.
Mu 2021, raporo ya komisiyo yayobowe na Vincent Duclert yemeje ko imiburo ye yari ifite ishingiro.
Akomoka mu muryango w'abasirikare, yize mu ishuri rya gisirikare rya La Flèche no muri Saint-Cyr. Mu myaka 40 y'umwuga we mu bakomando b'abaparakomando, yakoreye muri Aligeriya, Gabon, Santrafurika no muri Cade. Nyuma yayoboye "Centre des hautes études militaires", maze Perezida Mitterrand amushyira ku buyobozi bw'ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare n'ibihugu by'Afurika.
Nk'umuyobozi w'ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare, yaburiye ubutegetsi bw'i Paris ku ihezanguni ry'ubutegetsi bwa Juvénal Habyarimana, ariko ntiyumvwa. Yavuye ku mirimo ye mu 1993, yanga kwikorera uruhare mu byemezo by'Ibiro bya Perezida ku Rwanda.
Mu 2021, raporo ya komisiyo ya Duclert yagaragaje ko imiburo ye yari ifite ishingiro; Varret yavuze ko iyo raporo «ituma havaho impaka z'ubusa zamaze imyaka 26». Muri Gicurasi 2021, yaherekeje Perezida Emmanuel Macron mu Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali. Mu 2023 yasohoye, afatanyije n'umunyamakuru Laurent Larcher, igitabo "Souviens-toi" cy'ibyo yibuka.

Kaminuza y'Abadivantisiti ya Lukanga (mu Gifaransa: "Université adventiste de Lukanga", UNILUK) ni kaminuza yigenga y'Idini ry'Abadivantitsi b'umunsi wa Karindwi iri i Lukanga, hafi y'umujyi wa Butembo, mu Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yakomotse ku ishami rya Kaminuza ya Griggs ryafunguwe mu 1994, yemererwa gukora mu 1996, ihabwa uburenganzira budasubirwaho mu 2006.
Ikigo cy'Abadivantisiti cya Lukanga cyashinzwe mu 1965. Mu 1975 cyemewe nk'ishuri ryisumbuye n'iry'amashuri makuru ritanga impamyabumenyi mu burezi, hamwe n'amasomo abiri ya tewolojiya. Mu 1990 hiyongeraho ikigo cy'imyuga.
Ishami rya Kaminuza ya Griggs (1994–1996).
Mu 1994, Kaminuza y'Abadivantisiti yo muri Afurika yo Hagati (AUCA) yari i Mudende mu Rwanda yarafunze kubera Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Abanyeshuri ba tewolojiya bari mu mwaka wa nyuma bakiriwe i Lukanga. Mu Ukwakira 1994, Kaminuza ya Griggs (yigishaga ku iyakure) yafunguye i Lukanga ishami rya tewolojiya, rifite abanyeshuri bagera kuri mirongo ine, riyobowe na Kasay Bisogho Laurent.
Ishingwa rya kaminuza (1995–1996).
Igitekerezo cyo gushinga kaminuza i Lukanga cyaganiriweho i Douala ku wa 6 Kamena 1995, no muri Abidjan ku wa 14 Ugushyingo 1995. Iteka ryo ku wa 22 Gashyantare 1996 ryayemereye gukora. Umwaka wa mbere w'amashuri watangiye ku wa 15 Ukwakira 1996, ufite abanyeshuri bagera ku 100, mu mashami arimo tewolojiya, ubukungu n'indimi. Umuyobozi wayo wa mbere yari Jose Dial.
Imyaka y'intambara (1997–2003).
Kaminuza yakomeje gukora mu gihe cy'intambara ya AFDL n'iy'inyeshyamba zakurikiyeho. Yigeze kwitwa "Adventist Wallace University", mu rwego rwo kwibuka Elton Wallace. Abanyeshuri ba mbere bahawe impamyabumenyi muri Gicurasi 1998. Ikigo cyagabweho igitero n'aba Maï-Maï ku wa 18 Werurwe 2001, kandi mu 2003 hashyizweho agace katarangwamo intambara karinzwe na MONUC.
Iterambere (2002–2022).
Mu mpera za 2002, kaminuza yashyizwe munsi ya Diviziyo y'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba n'iyo Hagati y'Itorero. Ivuriro ("polyclinique") ryafunguwe ku wa 27 Gicurasi 2007. Guhera mu 2008, amashami yose yageze ku rwego rwa "licence". Mu 2010, abanyeshuri bo mu mashami yafunzwe i Lubumbashi, Kinshasa na Kananga bimuriwe i Lukanga. Ishuri ry'ubuvuzi ("techniques médicales") ryemerewe gukora ku wa 29 Kanama 2021.
Uburenganzira bwo gukora.
Iteka rya Perezida ryayihaye uburenganzira budasubirwaho ryasinywe ku wa 12 Kamena 2006 (n° 06/0106). Ku rwego rw'itorero, yemewe n'Ishyirahamwe ry'Abadivantisiti rishinzwe kwemeza amashuri (AAA) ku wa 7 Mata 2005.
Kaminuza itanga amasomo ku rwego rwa "licence" na "master", mu by'ubuzima rusange, ubuforomo, uburezi n'imitekerereze, tewolojiya, ubuhinzi, ikoranabuhanga, ubukungu n'imari, n'imirire. Ifitanye isano na ISTM Lukanga na ISTA Lukanga.

Kaminuza ya Leta ya Semuliki (mu gifaransa: "Université officielle de Semuliki", mu magambo ahinnye UOS) ni ishuri rikuru rya Leta riherereye mu mujyi wa Beni, mu Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2004, ikaba ari yo kaminuza ya Leta yonyine mu karere ka Beni.
Kaminuza ya Leta ya Semuliki yashinzwe mu 2004. Ikora ishingiye ku iteka rya Minisitiri n°102/MINESU/CAB.MIN/MML/KOB/2011 ryo ku wa 21 Mata 2011. Yashyizweho kugira ngo ihaze icyifuzo cy’urubyiruko rw’umujyi n’akarere ka Beni cyo kubona amashuri makuru ya Leta hafi yarwo, mu karere gakunze kurangwa n’umutekano muke n’ubwigunge. Ifatwa nk’iyo kaminuza ya Leta yonyine mu karere ka Beni.
Imiterere n’amasomo.
Kuva hakoreshwa gahunda ya LMD ("Licence-Master-Doctorat"), amashami ("facultés") ya kaminuza asigaye yitwa "domaines", naho amashami mato ("départements") akitwa "filières".
Mu 2021, kaminuza yari ifite amashami umunani: amategeko, ubukungu, ubuhinzi, ubuvuzi, farumasi, itumanaho, ubuhanga bwa mudasobwa, n’ubumenyi mbonezamubano, politiki n’ubutegetsi. Itanga amasomo mu by’amategeko, ubumenyi bwa politiki n’ubutegetsi, imibanire mpuzamahanga, itangazamakuru n’itumanaho, ubuhanga bw’ubwubatsi n’ikoranabuhanga ("polytechnique"), ubuhinzi, ubukungu n’icungamutungo.
Kaminuza iyoborwa na komite y’ubuyobozi igizwe n’umuyobozi mukuru ("recteur"), umunyamabanga mukuru ushinzwe amasomo, umunyamabanga mukuru ushinzwe ubutegetsi n’umuyobozi ushinzwe ingengo y’imari. Mu Gashyantare 2021, komite y’ubuyobozi yari iyobowe na "recteur" José Wambale Mulwahili. Nyuma yaho, Porofeseri Jean-Baptiste Paluku Ndavaro, inzobere mu by’itangazamakuru n’itumanaho, yavuzwe nk’umuyobozi mukuru wayo.
Kaminuza ikorera mu karere kugarijwe n’umutekano muke. Mu 2018, itangira ry’umwaka w’amashuri i Beni ryatinze ukwezi kose kubera ibitero by’umutwe witwaje intwaro wa ADF; amasomo yongeye gutangira ku wa 19 Ugushyingo mu byumba by’amashuri bya UOS.
Muri Gashyantare 2021, mu gihe cy’icyorezo cya COVID-19, abakozi ba kaminuza (abarimu, abakozi bo mu butegetsi, abatekinisiye n’abakozi basanzwe) bakoze imyigaragambyo bashinja komite y’ubuyobozi kunyereza umutungo, ibyo ibiro by’umuyobozi mukuru byahakanaga. Ku wa 22 Werurwe 2021, habaye umwuka mubi hagati y’abanyeshuri n’ubuyobozi ubwo amasomo yasubukurwaga, imbere y’intumwa z’inama y’ubutegetsi ya za kaminuza (CAU).
Umwaka w’amashuri wa 2024–2025 watangijwe ku mugaragaro, itangira ryawo ryemezwa n’umunyamabanga mukuru ushinzwe amasomo.

Mburugu ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina iterwa na bagiteri "ya Treponema pallidum" subspecies "pallidum". Birashoboka ko nta bimenyetso bihari. Bitabaye ibyo, biratandukanye bitewe n'icyiciro muri bine kirimo (icy'ibanze, icya kabiri, icyahishe, n'icya gatatu).
Icyiciro cya mbere gikunze kugaragaramo chancre imwe (igisebe cyo ku ruhu gikomeye, kidatera ububabare, kandi kidatera gushyuha akenshi kiri hagati ya santimetero imwe cyangwa ebyiri (1 cm) na 2 cm) mu murambararo nubwo hashobora kuba hari ibisebe byinshi. Muri Mburugu ya kabiri, habaho uduheri twinshi, akenshi dufata ibiganza n'ibirenge. Hashobora kandi kuba hari ibisebe mu kanwa cyangwa mu gitsina. Mu ndwara ya syphilis igaragara mu gihe cy'imyaka myinshi, ibimenyetso byayo ni bike cyangwa ntibigaragare na gato. Muri Mburugu yo mu cyiciro cya gatatu, hari ishinya (ibibyimba byoroshye bitari kanseri), ibibazo by'imitsi, cyangwa ibimenyetso by'umutima. Sirifi izwi nka " umuyigana ukomeye " kuko ishobora gutera ibimenyetso bisa n'ibindi ndwara byinshi.
Indwara ya syphilis ikunze gukwirakwira binyuze mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Ishobora kandi kwanduzwa n'umubyeyi ku mwana mu gihe atwite cyangwa avutse, bigatera syphilis kuvukana. Izindi ndwara ziterwa na bagiteri "ya Treponema" zirimo yaws (ubwoko "busanzwe"), pinta (ubwoko busanzwe "bwa carateum"), na syphilis idakomoka ku gitsina (ubwoko busanzwe "bwa endemicum"). Izi ndwara eshatu ntabwo akenshi zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Ubusanzwe isuzuma rikorwa hakoreshejwe ibizamini by'amaraso; bagiteri zishobora no kumenyekana hakoreshejwe mikorosikopi y'umurima w'umwijima. Ikigo gishinzwe kurwanya no gukumira indwara (Amerika) gisaba abagore bose batwite kwipimisha.
Ingaruka zo kwandura syphilis mu mibonano mpuzabitsina zishobora kugabanuka hakoreshejwe agakingirizo ka latex cyangwa polyurethane. Mburugu ishobora kuvurwa neza hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko. Antibiyotike ikunzwe cyane mu manza nyinshi ni benzathine benzylpenicillin iterwa mu mitsi. Ku bantu bafite allergie ikomeye ya penisiline, doxycycline cyangwa tetracycline bashobora gukoreshwa. Ku bantu bafite neurosyphilis, benzylpenicillin cyangwa ceftriaxone ni byo byiza. Mu gihe cyo kuvurwa, abantu bashobora kugira umuriro, kuribwa umutwe, no kubabara imitsi, ibyo bikaba ari ingaruka izwi nka Jarisch-Herxheimer.
Mu 2022, abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 8 banduye sirupe ku bantu bakuru bari hagati y’imyaka 15 na 49 ku isi yose. Mu myaka 20 ishize hagaragaye ukwiyongera gukomeye kw'abandura ku isi. Mu 2015, hafi 45.4 abantu miliyoni banduye syphilis, hamwe n’abanduye miliyoni esheshatu. Mu mwaka wa 2015, byateje impfu zigera ku 107.000, zigabanuka ugereranyije n’izari 202.000 mu 1990.
Nyuma yo kugabanuka cyane bitewe n’uko penisiline yabonekaga mu myaka ya 1940, igipimo cy’ubwandu cyariyongereye kuva mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana mu bihugu byinshi, akenshi kikajyana na virusi itera SIDA. Ibi bikekwa ko biterwa n’ubwiyongere bw’ubusambanyi, uburaya, igabanuka ry’ikoreshwa ry’udukingirizo, n’imibonano mpuzabitsina idahwitse mu bagabo bakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina n’abagabo.

impiswi ni indwara ikunze kwandura iterwa n'itsinda rya virusi. Ubusanzwe bitangirana n'umuriro no kumva utameze neza muri rusange. Ibi bikurikirwa n'umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri nyuma y'aho habayeho utudomo cyangwa utubyimba dushobora kugaragara ku biganza, ku birenge no ku kanwa ndetse rimwe na rimwe n'amaguru, ku matako no mu nda. Ibimenyetso bikunze kugaragara nyuma y'iminsi 2-6 umuntu yanduye iyi virusi. Ubusanzwe ibibyimba bihita byisubiraho ubwabyo mu gihe cy'icyumweru kimwe. Kubura inzara n'ibinono by'urutoki bishobora kubaho nyuma y'ibyumweru bike, ariko bizasubira gukura uko igihe kigenda gihita.
Virusi zandura binyuze mu gukoranaho n'umuntu ku giti cye, binyuze mu mwuka uturuka mu gukorora no mu mwanda w'umuntu wanduye. Ibintu byanduye nabyo bishobora gukwirakwiza indwara. Virusi ya Coxsackie A16 ni yo ikunze kugaragara cyane, naho virusi ya enterovirus 71 ikaba ari yo ikunze kugaragara cyane. Izindi ndwara za coxsackievirus na enterovirus na zo zishobora kuba ari zo zitera. Hari abantu bashobora kwanduzanya virusi nubwo nta bimenyetso by'indwara bafite. Izindi nyamaswa ntizirimo. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishobora gukorwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso. Rimwe na rimwe, ikizamini cyo mu muhogo cyangwa mu ntebe gishobora gupimwa virusi.
Gukaraba intoki bishobora gukumira ikwirakwira ry’iyi ndwara, kandi abanduye ntibagomba kujya ku kazi, ku irerero cyangwa ku ishuri. Nta miti cyangwa urukingo birwanya virusi bihari, ariko hari ingamba zo guteza imbere iyi ndwara. Inshuro nyinshi nta buvuzi bwihariye busaba. Imiti yoroshye y'ububabare nka ibuprofen cyangwa gel yo kuvura indwara zo mu kanwa ishobora gukoreshwa. Rimwe na rimwe, abana badashobora kunywa bihagije bahabwa amazi yo mu mitsi. Ni gake cyane, meningite cyangwa encephalitis ishobora gutuma indwara irushaho kuba mbi.
HFMD ibaho mu bice byose by'isi. Ikunze kugaragara mu ndwara nto zifata abana bato mu mashuri y'incuke cyangwa mu mashuri y'incuke. Icyorezo gikomeye cyatangiye kugaragara muri Aziya kuva mu 1997. Akenshi bibaho mu mezi y'impeshyi, icyi n'impeshyi. Ubusanzwe bibaho mu bana bari munsi y'imyaka itanu, ariko rimwe na rimwe bishobora kubaho no mu bantu bakuru. HFMD ntigomba kwitiranywa n'indwara y'uburenge (izwi kandi nka indwara y'ibirenge), yibasira cyane amatungo.

Damas Gisimba Mutezintare (15 Ukwakira 1961 – 4 Kamena 2023) yari Umunyarwanda wayoboraga ikigo cy'imfubyi cya Gisimba i Nyamirambo, mu mujyi wa Kigali. Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, yahishe kandi arokora abantu bagera kuri 400, abenshi muri bo bakaba bari abana. Yahawe ibihembo bitandukanye, birimo Umudari w'Umurinzi.
Damas Gisimba yavukiye i Goma, muri Zayire (ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo), akaba imfura mu muryango we. Se, Pierre-Chrysologue Gisimba, yari yarahunze u Rwanda nyuma yo kwamagana ku mugaragaro ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu 1959; umuryango wamaze imyaka igera kuri 20 mu buhungiro.
Ababyeyi be, Peter na Dancilla Gisimba, bashinze ikigo cy'imfubyi i Nyamirambo mu 1980, gitangirana n'abana 18. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa se mu 1986, Damas yabaye umuyobozi w'icyo kigo.
Uruhare muri Jenoside.
Jenoside itangiye muri Mata 1994, Gisimba yacumbikiye mu kigo abantu bahigwaga, abahisha no mu gisenge cy'inzu, kandi yanga ko Interahamwe zibageraho. Igihe abicanyi bagabaga igitero, umumisiyoneri w'Umunyamerika Carl Wilkens yaraje arabafasha, maze abari bahahungiye bimurirwa ahatekanye. Abo Gisimba yarokoye barimo abana basaga 300 n'abantu bakuru bagera kuri 80.
Ikigo cyakomeje kwakira imfubyi kugeza ubwo Leta itegetse ko gifungwa mu 2012; cyahindutse urwibutso n'ikigo gifasha abana mu masomo ("Gisimba Memorial Centre"). Mu 2018, umufotozi w'Umunyamerika Brandon Stanton yakusanyije amafaranga yo kubaka ibigo bya Gisimba mu Rwanda no muri Ubugande.
Damas Gisimba yapfuye ku wa 4 Kamena 2023 mu bitaro bya Nyarugenge i Kigali, afite imyaka 61. Yashyinguwe ku wa 10 Kamena 2023 mu irimbi rya Rusororo, nyuma ya misa yabereye muri paruwasi ya Mutagatifu Karoli Lwanga i Nyamirambo.

Célestin Hakizimana (wavutse ku wa 14 Kanama 1963) ni umupadiri w'Umunyarwanda wa Kiliziya Gatolika, wagizwe Umwepiskopi wa Diyosezi Gatolika ya Gikongoro mu 2014. Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, yari umuyobozi w'ikigo cya Saint-Paul i Kigali, aho yafashije kurokora Abatutsi bagera ku 2 000 bari bahahungiye.
Célestin Hakizimana yavukiye muri paruwasi ya Saint Famille i Kigali, ku wa 14 Kanama 1963. Yize amashuri yisumbuye mu iseminari nto ya Mutagatifu Visenti i Rulindo (1977–1983) n'i Ndera (1983–1984), hanyuma yiga filozofiya na tewolojiya mu Iseminari Nkuru ya Nyakibanda i Butare. Yahawe ubupadiri ku wa 21 Nyakanga 1991. Kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2010, yakoze amasomo y'ikirenga i Napoli mu Ubutaliyani, abona impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (dogitora) muri tewolojiya.
Nyuma yo guhabwa ubupadiri, yabaye padiri wungirije i Rutongo (1991–1992), ahagararira uburezi gatolika muri diyosezi (1992–1994), hanyuma ayobora ikigo cy'igihugu cya Saint-Paul i Kigali (1994–1996). Kuva mu 1998 kugeza mu 2003 yayoboye umuryango GEMECA-Rwanda, naho kuva mu 2011 aba Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Inama y'Abepiskopi Gatolika mu Rwanda.
Ku wa 26 Ugushyingo 2014, Papa Fransisiko yamugize Umwepiskopi wa Gikongoro; yahawe ubwepiskopi ku wa 24 Mutarama 2015, kuri sitade ya Nyagisenyi i Gikongoro. Kuva ku wa 16 Werurwe 2018 kugeza ku wa 25 Werurwe 2021, yanayoboye by'agateganyo Diyosezi ya Cyangugu nk'umuyobozi wa Kitumwa.
Uruhare muri Jenoside.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside, Padiri Hakizimana yari ku kigo cya Saint-Paul i Kigali, aho Abatutsi bagera ku 2 000 bahungiye mu gihe cy'amezi arenga abiri. Yabahaye ibyo kurya n'amazi, ahagarara ku irembo yambaye ikanzu kugira ngo yamagane Interahamwe, kandi ahisha urutonde rw'impunzi, aha abicanyi urutonde rw'amazina y'impimbano. Yahaga Interahamwe amafaranga, ibyo kurya n'ibyo kunywa ngo zidakora ubwicanyi, nyamara zagarukaga kenshi zigatwara abantu bagera kuri 20 zikajya kubicira ahandi. Abari basigaye barokowe n'ingabo za FPR-Inkotanyi.
Yashimiwe ibikorwa bye, ahabwa umudari, inka icumi n'izindi mpano.

Joseph Niyomugabo (1941 – Mata 1994) yari umupadiri w'Umunyarwanda wa Kiliziya Gatolika, wayoboraga paruwasi ya Cyanika (Gikongoro). Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, yanze gutererana Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri paruwasi ye, maze yicwa n'abicanyi.
Joseph Niyomugabo yavukiye muri komini Muko, i Gikongoro, mu 1941. Yize mu iseminari nto ya Kabgayi guhera mu 1956, hanyuma mu Iseminari Nkuru ya Nyakibanda; yize filozofiya i Roma na tewolojiya mu Ububiligi, aba umupadiri ku wa 28 Nyakanga 1968 i Orval, mu Bubiligi.
Mu 1973, kubera ihohoterwa ryakorerwaga Abatutsi, yahungiye i Bujumbura mu Uburundi hamwe n'abanyeshuri yigishaga, agumana na bo kugeza mu 1976. Nyuma yaho yize i Paris muri Kaminuza ya Sorbonne (1976–1979). Yigishije kandi ayobora iseminari nto ya Kansi, akora muri paruwasi ya Gisagara, hanyuma muri Nzeri 1985 aba padiri mukuru wa paruwasi ya Cyanika.
Uruhare muri Jenoside.
Mbere ya Jenoside, Padiri Niyomugabo yari azwi nk'umubwiriza wamaganaga ivangura ryakorerwaga Abatutsi, bigatuma abategetsi b'aho bamwanga. Muri Mata 1994, ubwo abandi bapadiri bahungiraga i Butare, we yanze gutererana impunzi z'Abatutsi zari zahungiye kuri paruwasi ya Cyanika, nubwo bagenzi be bamusabaga kugenda. Yaziteyeho ibyo kurya, amazi n'aho kuba.
Nyuma y'ubwicanyi bwabereye i Cyanika ku wa 21 Mata 1994, yihishe mu bubiko bw'imiti bw'ikigo nderabuzima. Ku wa 24 Mata 1994 yarafashwe, arakorerwa iyicarubozo maze aricwa. Ikinyamakuru "The New Times" cyo kivuga ko yishwe ku wa 21 Mata 1994. Nyina, abavandimwe be n'abandi bo mu muryango we na bo bishwe muri Jenoside.
Imibiri ye yabonetse muri Mutarama 1995, maze ishyingurwa mu cyubahiro mu rwibutso rwa Cyanika ku wa 26 Gashyantare 2012.
Muri Mata 2012, umuryango African Rights washyize ahagaragara raporo imwibuka ishingiye ku buhamya bw'abarokotse. Abarokotse basabye ko ubutwari bwe bwamenyekana na Kiliziya Gatolika, u Rwanda n'amahanga.

Pentobarbital ni umuti wakoreshejwe mu kuvura indwara y'igicuri, gushyuha gukabije, kuvura ibibazo byo gusinzira by'igihe gito, kubaga, no gutera umuntu muri koma. Ikoreshwa mu gutera imitsi cyangwa imitsi. Uburyo bwo kuvura hakoreshejwe umunwa bwarahagaritswe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Itangira mu munota umwe iyo ishyizwe mu mitsi, mu minota 25 iyo igeze mu mitsi. Iyo ishyizwe mu mitsi ingaruka zimara iminota 15.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira, kuruka, no kuribwa umutwe. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zirimo kurota mu mutwe, gukoresha nabi, guhagarika guhumeka, no kubura umwuka. Gukoresha ntabwo byemewe mu gihe utwite. Iri mu muryango w'imiti ya barbiturate. Ikora binyuze mu kongera imikorere ya GABA mu bwonko.
Pentobarbital yatangiye gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1930 na John Lundy. Zakoreshejwe nabi cyane mu myaka ya 1970 kandi zizwi nka "amakoti y'umuhondo" bitewe n'ibara ryazo. Ikoreshwa mu kwica inyamaswa mu buryo bw’uburozi ndetse no muri leta zimwe na zimwe zo muri Amerika mu kwica abanyabyaha. Urupfu rwa Marilyn Monroe mu 1962 rwatewe no kunywa pentobarbital na chloral hydrate birenze urugero.

Indwara y'ibihaha ni indwara ikomeye iterwa n'agakoko kitwa "Yersinia pestis". Ibimenyetso birimo umuriro, kuribwa umutwe, guhumeka nabi, kubabara mu gatuza no gukorora. Ubusanzwe bitangira nyuma y'iminsi itatu kugeza kuri irindwi nyuma yo kugaragara. Ni bumwe mu bwoko butatu bw'indwara y'ibicurane, ubundi bubiri bukaba indwara y'ibicurane n'indwara y'ibicurane.
Ubwoko bw'indwara y'ibihaha bushobora kubaho nyuma y'ubwandu bwa mbere bw'indwara y'ibihaha cyangwa sepsis. Bishobora kandi guterwa no guhumeka ibitonyanga by’umwuka biturutse ku wundi muntu cyangwa injangwe yanduye indwara y’ibihaha. Itandukaniro riri hagati y’ubwoko bw’indwara ya plague ni aho yanduriye; mu ndwara ya plague y’ibihaha, indwara iba mu bihaha, mu ndwara ya plague y’ibihaha, no mu ndwara ya septicemic iri mu maraso. Gupima ni ugupima amaraso, amatembabuzi, cyangwa amazi yo mu gace k'imitsi.
Nubwo inkingo zirimo gukorwa, mu bihugu byinshi ntabwo ziraboneka ku isoko. Kwirinda ni ukwirinda gukora ku mbeba zanduye, abantu, cyangwa injangwe. Birasabwa ko abanduye bashyirwa mu kato ku bandi. Icyorezo cy'ibihaha kivura hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko.
Icyorezo cya Denda kigaragara mu mbeba muri Afurika, Amerika na Aziya. Icyorezo cy'umusonga ni kibi cyane kandi ntigikunze kugaragara nk'icyorezo cy'umusonga. Umubare wose w’abantu banduye ubwoko bwose bw’indwara y’icyorezo mu 2013 wari 783. Iyo icyorezo cy’ibihaha kidavuwe, hafi ya buri gihe kiba cyica. Bamwe bakeka ko indwara y’ibihaha ya diyabete ari yo ahanini yateye indwara y’umwijima yahitanye abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 50 mu myaka ya 1300.

Indwara yo kudakora neza kw'ibitekerezo (ADHD) ni indwara yo mu mutwe yo mu bwoko bw'imikurire y'ubwonko. Irangwa no kugorwa no kwita ku bintu, gukora ibintu byinshi cyane, no gukora utitaye ku ngaruka zishobora guterwa n’imyaka y’umuntu. Bamwe mu bantu bafite ADHD nabo bagaragaza ingorane zo kugenzura amarangamutima cyangwa ibibazo bijyanye n'imikorere y'ubuyobozi. Kugira ngo umuntu amenye ibimenyetso, ibimenyetso bigomba kugaragara mbere y'uko ageza ku myaka cumi n'ibiri, bikamara amezi arenga atandatu, kandi bigatera ibibazo nibura ahantu habiri (nk'ishuri, mu rugo, cyangwa mu myidagaduro). Ku bana, ibibazo byo kwita ku bana bishobora gutuma badatsinda neza mu ishuri. Byongeye kandi, hari isano iri hagati y’izindi ndwara zo mu mutwe n’ikoreshwa nabi ry’ibiyobyabwenge. Nubwo bitera ubumuga, cyane cyane muri sosiyete ya none, abantu benshi bafite ADHD bashobora gukomeza kwita ku mirimo babona ko ishimishije cyangwa ifite akamaro (izwi nka hyperfocus).
Nubwo ari indwara yo mu mutwe ikunze kwigwaho cyane mu bana n'ingimbi n'abangavu, impamvu nyayo ntabwo izwi mu bihe byinshi. Ibintu bigize imiterere y’umubiri (genetic factors) bivugwa ko bigize hafi 75% by’ibyago. Kwibasirwa na nikotine mu gihe utwite bishobora guteza akaga ku bidukikije. Bisa nkaho bitajyanye n'uburyo bwo kurera cyangwa guhana. Igira ingaruka ku bana bagera kuri 5–7% iyo bapimwe hakoreshejwe ibipimo bya DSM-IV na 1–2% iyo bapimwe hakoreshejwe ibipimo bya ICD-10. Kugeza mu 2015, byagaragaye ko byagize ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni 51.1 ku isi yose. Igipimo kirasa hagati y’ibihugu kandi ahanini giterwa n’uburyo cyasuzumwe. ADHD ikunze kugaragara ku bahungu inshuro ebyiri kurusha ku bakobwa, nubwo akenshi iyo ndwara ifatwa nk'aho idakunze kwirengagizwa ku bakobwa kuko ibimenyetso byayo bitandukanye n'iby'abahungu. Abantu bagera kuri 30–50% basanzwe barwaye indwara mu bwana bakomeza kugira ibimenyetso kugeza bakuze, naho hagati ya 2–5% by'abantu bakuru bakagira iyo ndwara. Ku bantu bakuru, umuntu ashobora kubura umutuzo mu mutima aho kugira umuvuduko mwinshi. Akenshi bakuramo ubuhanga bwo guhangana n'ibibazo, ibyo bikaba bibafasha mu bibazo bimwe cyangwa byose bafite. Iyi ndwara ishobora kugorana kuyitandukanya n'izindi ndwara, ndetse no kuyitandukanya n'ibikorwa byinshi bikiri mu rugero rw'imyitwarire isanzwe.
Inama ku bijyanye no gucunga ADHD ziratandukanye bitewe n'ibihugu kandi akenshi zikubiyemo uburyo bumwe na bumwe bwo kubagira inama, guhindura imibereho, n'imiti. Amabwiriza y’Ubwongereza atanga inama gusa ku miti nk’uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura abana bafite ibimenyetso bikomeye, kandi ko imiti igomba kwitabwaho ku bafite ibimenyetso biri hagati banze cyangwa bananirwa kunoza iyo bahawe inama, nubwo ku bantu bakuru imiti ari uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura. Amabwiriza ya Kanada na Amerika atanga inama ku bijyanye no gucunga imyitwarire ku bana bari mu kigero cy'incuke mu gihe imiti n'ubuvuzi bw'imyitwarire hamwe nabyo bigirwa inama nyuma y'ibyo. Kuvura hakoreshejwe imiti itera imbaraga bigira akamaro nibura ku myaka 14 amezi; icyakora, ingaruka z'igihe kirekire ntizisobanutse neza kandi hari ingaruka zishobora kubaho.
Ibitabo by'ubuvuzi byagaragaje ibimenyetso bisa n'ibya ADHD kuva mu kinyejana cya 18. ADHD, uburyo ipimwa, n'uburyo ivurwa byafashwe nk'ibitavugwaho rumwe kuva mu myaka ya 1970. Ibiganiro byagiye bireba abaganga, abarimu, abashyiraho amategeko, ababyeyi, n'itangazamakuru. Ingingo zirimo impamvu za ADHD n'ikoreshwa ry'imiti itera imbaraga mu kuvura. Abatanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi benshi bemera ko ADHD ari indwara nyayo mu bana no mu bantu bakuru, kandi impaka mu muryango w’abahanga zishingiye ahanini ku buryo ipimwa n’uburyo ivurwa. Iyi ndwara izwi nka ADD kuva mu 1980 kugeza mu 1987, mu gihe mbere yaho izwi nka hyperkinetic reaction of childhood.

Indwara za Ehlers-Danlos (EDS) ni itsinda ry'indwara zidasanzwe ziterwa n'uturemangingo. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo ingingo zifunguye, ububabare bw'ingingo, uruhu rusa neza, n'inkovu zidasanzwe. Ibi bishobora kugaragara mu gihe cyo kuvuka cyangwa mu bwana. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo gucika kw'imitsi ifunganye, gucika kw'ingingo, gucika kw'imitsi ifunganye, ububabare budakira, cyangwa osteoarthritis ikiri kare.
EDS iterwa n'ihindagurika ry'uturemangingo turenga 19 dutandukanye tubaho igihe umuntu avuka. Ingirabuzimafatizo runaka yagizweho ingaruka niyo igena ubwoko bwa EDS. Hari ubwo indwara zimwe na zimwe zituruka ku guhinduka gushya kugaragara mu gihe cy'ivuka rya mbere, mu gihe izindi zivuka mu buryo busanzwe cyangwa busanzwe. Ubusanzwe, izi mpinduka zitera inenge mu miterere cyangwa mu gutunganya poroteyine ya kolajeni. Isuzuma rikunze gushingira ku bimenyetso kandi ryemezwa n'ibizamini bya genetiki cyangwa biopsy y'uruhu. Ariko, mu ntangiriro abantu bashobora gufatwa nabi mu ndwara ya hypochondriase, kwiheba, cyangwa indwara y'umunaniro udashira.
Nta muti uzwi uhari. Ubuvuzi bufasha mu buryo busanzwe. Ubuvuzi bw'umubiri kandi gutera inkunga ingingo bishobora gufasha gukomeza imitsi no gushyigikira ingingo. Nubwo bumwe mu bwoko bwa EDS butuma umuntu abaho neza, ubwo bugira ingaruka ku mitsi y'amaraso muri rusange bugabanya igihe cyo kubaho.
EDS yibasira nibura umuntu umwe ku bantu 5.000 ku isi. Iteganyagihe riterwa n'indwara runaka. Gutembera cyane byasobanuwe bwa mbere na Hippocrates mu mwaka wa 400 mbere ya Yesu. Izi ndwara zitiriwe abaganga babiri, Edvard Ehlers wo muri Danemark na Henri-Alexandre Danlos wo mu Bufaransa, bazivuze mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20.

Indwara ya Asperger (AS), izwi kandi nka Asperger's, ni indwara y'iterambere irangwa n'ingorane zikomeye mu mibanire n'abandi no mu itumanaho ritari iryo mu magambo, hamwe n'imyitwarire n'ibyo umuntu akunda bitagira akagero kandi bisubirwamo. Kubera ko indwara yoroheje ya autism spectrum (ASD), itandukanye n'izindi ASD bitewe n'ururimi n'ubwenge bisanzwe. Nubwo bidakenewe kugira ngo umuntu amenye indwara, gukoresha imvugo mu buryo budasanzwe no kuyikoresha mu buryo budasanzwe ni ibintu bisanzwe. Ibimenyetso bikunze gutangira umuntu atarageza ku myaka ibiri kandi akenshi bimara ubuzima bwe bwose.
Impamvu nyayo ya Asperger ntabwo izwi. Nubwo ahanini irazwe, imiterere y’uturemangingo ntabwo iramenyekana neza. Ibintu bidukikije nabyo bikekwa ko bigira uruhare. Gusuzuma ubwonko ntabwo byagaragaje indwara isanzwe ishingiyeho. Mu 2013, gusuzuma indwara ya Asperger byakuwe mu "gitabo cy’indwara zo mu mutwe" (DSM-5), kandi abantu bafite ibi bimenyetso ubu bashyizwe mu ndwara ya autism spectrum hamwe na autisme n’indwara y’iterambere isanzwe itavuzwe ukundi (PDD-NOS). Iracyari mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga cy’indwara (ICD-11) nk'ubwoko bw'indwara ya autism spectrum.
Nta buryo bumwe bwo kuvura, kandi ubushobozi bw'ibikorwa runaka bugaragazwa n'amakuru make gusa. Ubuvuzi bugamije kugabanya gahunda zo gukora ibintu kenshi cyangwa zisubiramo, no kunoza ubuhanga bwo kuvugana no gukora ibintu mu buryo bugoye. Ingamba zishobora kuba zirimo guhugura abantu mu bijyanye n'imibanire n'abandi, ubuvuzi bushingiye ku myitwarire mu bwenge, ubuvuzi bw'umubiri, ubuvuzi bwo kuvuga, amahugurwa ku babyeyi, n'imiti ivura ibibazo bifitanye isano, nk'amarangamutima cyangwa imihangayiko. Abana benshi barakura neza uko bakura, ariko ibibazo byo mu mibanire n'abandi no mu itumanaho akenshi birakomeza. Bamwe mu bashakashatsi n'abantu bafite ikibazo cya autisme bashyigikiye impinduka mu myumvire ku gitekerezo cy'uko indwara ya autisme ari itandukaniro aho kuba indwara igomba kuvurwa cyangwa gukira.
Mu 2015, indwara ya Asperger yagaragaye ko yibasiwe n’abantu miliyoni 37.2 ku isi. Indwara ya Autism yibasira abagabo cyane kurusha abagore, kandi abagore bakunze kuyisanga mu myaka iri imbere. Iyi ndwara yitiriwe umuganga w’abana wo muri Otirishiya witwa Hans Asperger, wavuze mu 1944 ku bana yareraga bagorwaga no kugirana ubucuti, batumvaga ibimenyetso cyangwa ibyiyumvo by’abandi, baganiraga ku ruhande rumwe ku byo bakunda, kandi bakaba bari abantu badakunda. Igitekerezo cya none cya Asperger syndrome cyabayeho mu 1981 kandi cyanyuze mu gihe cyo gukwirakwira. Byabaye isuzuma risanzwe mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 1990. Ibibazo byinshi n'impaka biracyari byinshi. Hari gushidikanya niba bitandukanye na autisme ikora neza (HFA). Impamvu imwe ni uko igipimo cy'abantu bagizweho ingaruka kitaramenyekana neza.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyumba ni urwibutso ruherereye mu Murenge wa Gishamvu, mu Karere ka Huye, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y'u Rwanda. Rwibutsa Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994, kandi rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abazize iyo Jenoside.
Urwibutso rwa Nyumba ni hamwe mu hantu hibukirwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Karere ka Huye. Rukoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwibuka, guha icyubahiro abishwe no gusaba ko imibiri yabo itarashyingurwa mu cyubahiro yaboneka igashyingurwa.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Abatutsi bo mu gace ka Gishamvu no mu bice biyegereye bishwe muri ubwo bwicanyi. Nyuma ya Jenoside, imibiri y'abishwe yashyinguwe mu rwibutso rwa Nyumba, rukaba ahantu ho kubibuka no guha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside.Nk'uko byatangajwe mu gikorwa cyo kwibuka ku wa 20 Mata 2023, imibare yari mu bitabo by'Umuryango uharanira inyungu z'abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi (IBUKA) mu Murenge wa Gishamvu yerekanaga ko urwibutso rwa Nyumba rwari rushyinguyemo imibiri 59.999. Iyo mibare yatangajwe muri icyo gikorwa ikeneye kugereranywa n'inyandiko zemewe z'ubuyobozi bw'urwibutso.
Igikorwa cyo kwibuka cyo mu 2023.
