Ku wa 20 Mata 2023, ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyumba habereye igikorwa cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 29 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.Iki gikorwa cyitabiriwe n'abayobozi batandukanye, barimo Guverineri w'Intara y'Amajyepfo, Alice Kayitesi, abayobozi b'Akarere ka Huye, abahagarariye inzego z'umutekano, abahagarariye amadini n'abaturage.Muri icyo gikorwa, hashyinguwe mu cyubahiro imibiri 383 y'abantu bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Nk'uko byatangajwe n'abayobozi, imwe muri iyo mibiri yari yaravanywe mu irimbi ryo mu Janja, mu Kagari ka Nyakibanda, indi iboneka mu bice bitandukanye byo mu Murenge wa Gishamvu no mu Murenge wa Ngera, mu Karere ka Nyaruguru.Igikorwa cyaranzwe no kwibuka abazize Jenoside, gutanga ubuhamya n'ibiganiro ku mateka ya Jenoside, gushyira indabo ku rwibutso no gushyingura imibiri yabonetse.

Indwara ya Parkinson (PD), cyangwa Parkinson gusa, ni indwara ifata igihe kirekire yo mu bwonko bwo hagati ikagira ingaruka cyane cyane ku mikorere y'umubiri. Uko indwara igenda irushaho kwiyongera, ibimenyetso bitari ibyo mu mitsi bigenda birushaho kugaragara. Ibimenyetso bikunze kugaragara buhoro buhoro. Mu ntangiriro z'iyi ndwara, ibimenyetso bigaragara cyane ni ukunyeganyega, gukomera, kugenda buhoro, no kugorwa no kugenda. Gutekereza kandi ibibazo by'imyitwarire nabyo bishobora kubaho. Indwara yo mu mutwe (Dementia) biba ibisanzwe mu gihe indwara igeze mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Ihungabana kandi imihangayiko nayo ikunze kugaragara, ikaba igaragara ku bantu barenga kimwe cya gatatu cy'abafite PD. Ibindi bimenyetso birimo ibibazo byo kumva, gusinzira, n'amarangamutima. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi by'imitsi y'umubiri byitwa " parkinsonism ", cyangwa "parkinsonian syndrome".
Impamvu y'indwara ya Parkinson ntabwo izwi, ariko bikekwa ko iterwa n'ibintu bigize imiterere y'umubiri ndetse n'ibidukikije. Abafite umuntu wo mu muryango wabo wanduye bafite amahirwe menshi yo kurwara iyi ndwara ubwabo. Hari kandi ibyago byinshi ku bantu bahura n'imiti yica udukoko no mu bakomeretse ku mutwe mbere, mu gihe hari ibyago bike ku banywa itabi n'abanywa ikawa cyangwa icyayi. Ibimenyetso by'iyi ndwara bituruka ku rupfu rw'uturemangingo two mu gace k'ubwonko gafite igice cy'ubwonko cyo hagati. Ibi bituma dopamine idahagije muri aka gace k'ubwonko. Impamvu y'uru rupfu rw'uturemangingo ntabwo isobanutse neza, ariko ikubiyemo kwirundanya kwa poroteyine mu mibiri ya Lewy mu mitsi y'ubwonko. Gusuzuma indwara zisanzwe ahanini bishingiye ku bimenyetso, hamwe n'ibizamini nka neuroimaging bikoreshwa kugira ngo harebwe izindi ndwara.
Nta muti uhari wo kuvura indwara ya Parkinson. Ubuvuzi bugamije kunoza ibimenyetso. Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bwa mbere bukorwa hakoreshejwe imyitozo ngororamubiri n'imiti irwanya parkinson ya levodopa (L-DOPA), hanyuma hagakurikiraho imiti igabanya ubukana bwa dopamine iyo levodopa idafite imbaraga. Uko indwara ikomeza kwiyongera kandi uturemangingo tw’ubwonko dukomeza gutakaza ubushobozi, iyi miti iragabanuka, mu gihe kimwe itera ikibazo kirangwa no kwihinahina ku bushake. Indyo n'uburyo bumwe na bumwe bwo kuvura indwara byagaragaje ko bifite akamaro mu kugabanya ibimenyetso. Kubaga hakoreshejwe microelectrodes kugira ngo ubwonko burusheho gukanguka byakoreshejwe mu kugabanya ibimenyetso by'imikorere y'umubiri mu bihe bikomeye aho imiti idakora neza. Ibimenyetso by'ubuvuzi ku bimenyetso bya PD bifitanye isano no kudakora, nko kubura ibitotsi n'ibibazo by'amarangamutima, ntabwo bikomeye cyane.
Mu 2015, PD yibasiwe n’abantu miliyoni 6.2, bituma abantu bagera ku 117.400 bapfa ku isi yose. Indwara ya Parkinson ikunze kugaragara ku bantu barengeje imyaka 60, muri bo hafi kimwe ku ijana nibo bayirwaye. Abagabo ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore ku kigereranyo cya 3:2. Iyo igaragaye ku bantu batarageza ku myaka 50, yitwa PD yo mu ntangiriro. Impuzandengo y'igihe umuntu azakomeza kubaho nyuma yo gupimwa ni hagati y'imyaka 7 na 15. Iyi ndwara yitiriwe umuganga w’Umwongereza James Parkinson, wasohoye ibisobanuro birambuye bya mbere mu gitabo cyitwa "An Essay on the Shaking Palsy", mu 1817. Ubukangurambaga mu ruhame burimo Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wa Parkinson (ku isabukuru ya James Parkinson, 11 Mata) no gukoresha agati k'umutuku nk'ikimenyetso cy'indwara. Abantu barwaye Parkinson bongereye ubumenyi ku iyi ndwara barimo icyamamare mu iteramakofe Muhammad Ali, umukinnyi wa filime Michael J. Fox, umukinnyi wa siporo mu mikino Olempike Davis Phinney, n'umukinnyi wa filime Alan Alda.

Icyorezo cya Bubonic ni kimwe mu bwoko butatu bw'icyorezo giterwa na bagiteri "Yersinia pestis". Nyuma y'umunsi umwe kugeza kuri irindwi uhuye na bagiteri, ibimenyetso bisa n'ibicurane biragaragara. Ibi bimenyetso birimo umuriro, kuribwa umutwe, no kuruka. Utunyangingo tw’amaraso tubyimba kandi tubabaza tuba ahantu hegereye aho bagiteri yinjiye mu ruhu. Rimwe na rimwe, utunyangingo twa lymph twabyimbye dushobora gucika.
Ubwoko butatu bw'icyorezo ni ingaruka z'inzira yanduriyemo: indwara ya bubonic, indwara ya septicemic, n'indwara ya pneumonical. Indwara ya Bubonic ikwirakwizwa cyane cyane n'udusimba twanduye duturuka ku nyamaswa nto. Bishobora kandi guterwa no guhura n'amazi yo mu mubiri aturuka ku nyamaswa yapfuye yanduye indwara y'ibyorezo. Mu bwoko bwa plague ya bubonic, bagiteri zinjira mu ruhu binyuze mu kurumwa n'udusimba hanyuma zigaca mu miyoboro ya lymphatic zijya mu gace k'imiyoboro ya lymphatic, bigatuma zibyimba. Gusuzuma indwara bikorwa habonetse bagiteri mu maraso, mu mihogo, cyangwa mu mazi ava mu tunyangingo tw’imitsi.
Kwirinda ni ugukoresha ingamba z’ubuzima rusange nko kudafata inyamaswa zapfuye mu turere twakunze kugaragaramo icyorezo. Inkingo ntibyagaragaye ko ari ingirakamaro cyane mu gukumira indwara z'ibyorezo. Antibiyotike nyinshi zifite akamaro mu kuvura, harimo streptomycin, gentamicin, na doxycycline. Iyo hatabayeho kuvurwa, indwara y'ibicurane ihitana 30% kugeza 90% by'abanduye. Iyo bibayeho, akenshi urupfu rubaho mu minsi icumi. Iyo umuntu avuwe, ibyago byo gupfa ni hafi 10%. Ku isi yose hagati ya 2010 na 2015 hagaragaye abantu 3248 banduye iyi ndwara, ikaba yahitanye abantu 584. Ibihugu bifite umubare munini w’abanduye ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Madagasikari na Peru.
Icyorezo cyateye icyorezo cy’abirabura cyakwirakwiriye muri Aziya, i Burayi na Afurika mu kinyejana cya 14, kikica abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 50. Ibi byari hagati ya 25% na 60% by'abaturage b'i Burayi. Kubera ko icyorezo cyahitanye abaturage benshi bakoraga, imishahara yariyongereye bitewe n'ibyifuzo by'abakozi. Bamwe mu bahanga mu by'amateka babona ko ibi ari ihinduka rikomeye mu iterambere ry'ubukungu bw'u Burayi. Iyi ndwara kandi ni yo yateye icyorezo cya Justinian cyaturutse mu bwami bw’Abaroma bw’Iburasirazuba mu kinyejana cya 6, ndetse n’icyorezo cya gatatu cyibasira Ubushinwa, Mongoliya, n’Ubuhinde cyaturutse mu Ntara ya Yunnan mu 1855. Ijambo "bubonic" rikomoka ku ijambo ry'Ikigiriki βουβών, risobanura "igituba". Ijambo " buboes " rikoreshwa kandi mu kuvuga ku tunyangingo tw’imitsi twabyimbye.

Jean de Dieu Kamuhanda (wavutse ku wa 3 Werurwe 1953) ni umunyapolitiki w’Umunyarwanda wabaye Minisitiri w’Amashuri Makuru n’Ubushakashatsi mu bya Siyansi muri Guverinoma y’inzibacyuho mu 1994. Yahamijwe n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) icyaha cya Jenoside n’icyaha cyo kurimbura abantu nk’icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu, kubera uruhare rwe mu bwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu gace ka Gikomero mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994. Ku wa 19 Nzeri 2005, Urugereko rw’Ubujurire rwa ICTR rwemeje igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu yari yarakatiwe.
Mu ntangiriro za Mata 1994, nyuma gato y’uko Jenoside yo mu Rwanda itangiye, Kamuhanda yatanze ikiganiro i Gikomero aho yagaragaje ko ubwicanyi bw’Abatutsi i Gikomero bwari butaratangira kandi ko yari yiteguye gutanga intwaro zari kuba ngombwa kugira ngo ubwicanyi bube bwarakorewe aho. Mu gusoza ijambo rye, yahaye abari aho imbunda, gerenade n'imihoro, kandi yavuze ko azakurikirana abaturage ba Gikomero kugira ngo arebe ko ubwicanyi bwatangiye. Ku itariki ya 12 Mata 1994, Kamuhanda yahaye abapolisi amabwiriza ku mitwe y’Interahamwe yo gutangira kwica Abatutsi bari bahungiye mu ishuri ry’itorero ry’Abaporotesitanti i Gikomero.
Mu mpera za Nyakanga, Kamuhanda yahungiye mu Bufaransa. Abisabwe n'umushinjacyaha wa TPIR, yatawe muri yombi n'abayobozi b'Abafaransa i Bourges ku ya 26 Ugushyingo 1999. Ku itariki ya 7 Werurwe 2000, yoherejwe muri gereza ya TPIR i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya.
Mu rubanza rwe, Kamuhanda yahamijwe icyaha cya jenoside n'icyaha cyo gutsembatsemba nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Yagizwe umwere ku byaha byo gucura umugambi wo gukora jenoside, gufata ku ngufu nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu, n'ibyaha by'intambara n'ibindi bikorwa bibi nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Igihano cye cyemejwe n'Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rwa TPIR ku ya 19 Nzeri 2005, maze ku ya 7 Ukuboza 2008 yoherezwa muri Mali kurangiriza igihano cye.

Simbikangwa yavukiye i Karago mu mwaka wa 1959. Mu mwaka wa 1986, yagize ubumuga nyuma yo gukora impanuka y’imodoka. Yabaye umuyobozi w’urwego rw’ubutasi rw’u Rwanda, ndetse anaba kapiteni mu ngabo zirinda Perezida, mu gihe yari akiri muri uwo mwanya w’ubuyobozi bw’ubutasi.
Yakomeje kuba muri iyo myanya mu gihe cya jenoside, ahunga u Rwanda mu mpera z'impeshyi yo mu 1994. Simbikangwa yabanje guhungira mu birwa bya Comoros. Mu 2008, yasabye ubuhungiro bwa politiki muri Mayotte. Yatawe muri yombi ku ya 28 Ukwakira 2008 azira guhimba impapuro. Yaburanishijwe mu Bufaransa hakurikijwe itegeko ry’Ubufaransa ryemerera umuntu wese ushinjwa ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu koherezwayo.
Iburanisha rya 2014.
Mu rubanza rwe rwo mu 2014 mu Bufaransa, Simbikangwa yavuzweho kuba inshuti magara na mubyara wa Juvénal Habyarimana, wishwe byateje amakimbirane ashingiye ku moko mu Rwanda. Abashinjacyaha bagaragaje ko Simbikangwa yari umunyamigabane ukomeye muri Free Radio-Televiziyo ya Milles Collines, imwe mu nzego zikomeye za poropagande y’Abahutu, yasabaga ku mugaragaro ko habaho jenoside. Simbikangwa yashinjwe kandi afatwa nk'umunyabyaha kubera gukora urutonde rw'abayobozi b'Abatutsi n'Abahutu bari kwibasirwa n'itsembabwoko. Simbikangwa yahamwe n'icyaha ku ya 14 Werurwe 2014 cyo " ubufatanyacyaha mu itsembabwoko n'ubufatanyacyaha mu byaha byibasiye inyokomuntu." Yakatiwe imyaka 25 imyaka myinshi mu gifungo.

Indwara ya plague ni indwara yandura iterwa na bagiteri "Yersinia pestis". Ibimenyetso birimo umuriro, gucika intege no kuribwa umutwe. Ubusanzwe ibi bitangira nyuma y'umunsi umwe kugeza kuri irindwi nyuma yo guhura n'ikiyobyabwenge. Mu buryo bwa bubonic, hariho no kubyimba kw'uturemangingo twa lymph, mu gihe mu buryo bwa septicemic, uturemangingo dushobora guhinduka umukara tugapfa, kandi mu buryo bwa pneumonic, guhumeka nabi, inkorora no kubabara mu gituza bishobora kubaho.
Icyorezo cya Bubonic na Septicemia muri rusange gikwirakwizwa no kurumwa n'udusimba cyangwa gukora ku nyamaswa yanduye. Ubwoko bw'indwara y'ibihaha muri rusange ikwirakwira hagati y'abantu binyuze mu kirere binyuze mu bitonyanga byandura. Ubusanzwe isuzuma rikorwa binyuze mu gusanga bagiteri mu mazi ava mu gace k'imitsi, mu maraso cyangwa mu mashoka.
Abari mu kaga gakomeye bashobora gukingirwa. Abahuye n'indwara y'ibihaha bashobora kuvurwa n'imiti yo kuyirinda. Iyo yanduye, ivurwa hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko n'ubuvuzi bufasha. Ubusanzwe imiti igabanya ubukana ikubiyemo uruvange rwa gentamicin na fluoroquinolone. Ingaruka zo gupfa iyo umuntu avuwe ni hafi 10% mu gihe iyo atavuwe ari hafi 70%.
Ku isi yose, abantu bagera kuri 600 bandura iyi ndwara buri mwaka. Mu 2017, ibihugu byagaragayemo abarwayi benshi harimo Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Madagasikari na Peru. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ubwandu rimwe na rimwe bubera mu byaro, aho bivugwa ko bagiteri zikwirakwira mu mbeba. Mu mateka byagaragaye mu cyorezo gikomeye, aho kizwi cyane ari cyo cyorezo cy’umwijima cyo mu kinyejana cya 14, cyahitanye abantu barenga miliyoni 50.

Alprazolam, igurishwa ku izina rya Xanax, n'izindi, ni benzodiazepine ikora vuba. Ikoreshwa cyane mu kuvura indwara zo guhangayika mu gihe gito, cyane cyane indwara y'ubwoba cyangwa indwara yo guhangayika rusange (GAD). Izindi ngamba zirimo kuvura isesemi iterwa na chemotherapy, hamwe n'ubundi buryo bwo kuvura. Iterambere rya GAD ribaho muri rusange mu cyumweru kimwe. Alprazolam muri rusange ifatwa n'umunwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira, kwiheba, kuribwa umutwe, kumva unaniwe, umunwa wumye, no kugira ibibazo byo kwibuka. Bimwe mu biruhuko n'umunaniro bishobora koroha mu minsi mike. Bitewe n'impungenge zo gukoresha nabi imiti, bamwe ntibasaba alprazolam nk'uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura indwara y'ubwoba. Ibimenyetso byo kureka cyangwa kongera kugaruka bishobora kubaho iyo ikoreshwa rigabanutse mu buryo butunguranye; kugabanya buhoro buhoro igipimo mu byumweru cyangwa amezi bishobora kuba ngombwa. Izindi ngaruka zidasanzwe zirimo kwiyahura, bishobora guterwa no kubura ubushobozi bwo kwifata. Alprazolam, kimwe n'izindi benzodiazepines, ikora binyuze muri GABA A receptor.
Alprazolam yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imiti mu 1971, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1981. Alprazolam ni ikiyobyabwenge kigenzurwa na Schedule IV kandi ni ikiyobyabwenge gikunze gukoreshwa nabi. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cyo kugurisha muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za kuri dose imwe mu 2018. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 21 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni 25.

Athanase Seromba (wavutse mu 1963) ni umupadiri wa Kiliziya Gatolika w’Umunyarwanda wahamijwe icyaha cya jenoside n’ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu yakoze mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Yari padiri mukuru wa Paruwasi ya Nyange, aho Abatutsi bari hagati ya 1.500 na 2.000 biciwe muri kiliziya mu 1994. Nyuma yo kwihisha mu Ubutaliyani ku izina ry’irihimbano, yishyikirije Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) mu 2002, maze mu 2008 akatirwa igifungo cya burundu.
Uruhare muri jenoside.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Seromba yari padiri mukuru wa Paruwasi Gatolika ya Nyange, mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibuye, mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda (ubu ni mu Akarere ka Ngororero). Abatutsi bari hagati ya 1.500 na 2.000 bari bahungiye muri kiliziya ye. Urukiko rwemeje ko yemeye ko kiliziya isenywa na buldozeri abari bayihungiyemo bakiri imbere, bigamije atari ukwica abantu benshi gusa, ahubwo no kurimbura Abatutsi nk’ubwoko.
Guhungira mu Butaliyani.
Muri Nyakanga 1994, Seromba yahunze u Rwanda. Abihayimana Gatolika bamufashije kujya mu Ubutaliyani, guhindura izina no gukomeza ubupadiri muri paruwasi ya San Martino a Montughi, hafi y’umujyi wa Florence, yiyita Anastasio Sumba Bura.
Ku gitutu cya Carla Del Ponte, wari umushinjacyaha mukuru wa ICTR, Seromba yishyikirije urwo rukiko ku ya 6 Gashyantare 2002. Ku ya 8 Gashyantare 2002, yahakanye ibyaha yaregwaga: jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside, umugambi wo gukora jenoside, n’itsembatsemba nk’icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Urubanza rwe rwatangiye ku ya 20 Nzeri 2004 imbere y’Urugereko rwa Gatatu rw’urwo rukiko. Ku ya 13 Ukuboza 2006, yahamijwe gufasha mu gukora jenoside n’itsembatsemba, akatirwa igifungo cy’imyaka 15.
Icyo cyemezo cyarajuririwe. Ku ya 12 Werurwe 2008, Urugereko rw’Ubujurire rwasanze uruhare rwe rurenze ubufatanyacyaha, rumuhamya icyaha cyo gukora jenoside n’itsembatsemba, maze rumukatira igifungo cya burundu.
Ku ya 27 Kamena 2009, Seromba yimuriwe muri Bene kugira ngo arangirize igihano cye muri gereza ya Akpro-Missérété, hafi y’umujyi wa Porto-Novo.

Gabapentin, igurishwa ku izina rya Neurontin n'indi, ni umuti ugabanya ububabare bw'imitsi ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe, ububabare bw'imitsi, ubushyuhe, n'indwara yo kuruhuka kw'amaguru. Irasabwa nk'umwe mu miti myinshi yo ku rwego rwa mbere ivura ububabare bw'imitsi buterwa n'indwara ya diyabete, neuralgia yo mu gihe cy'imitsi, n'ububabare bw'imitsi yo mu gice cyo hagati. Hafi 15% by'abantu barwaye indwara ya diyabete cyangwa indwara ya neuralgia nyuma y'imitsi bafite inyungu ifatika. Ibimenyetso mu bundi bwoko bwinshi bw'ububabare ntibihagije. Gabapentin ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira no kuzerera. Ingaruka mbi zirimo kwiyongera k'ibyago byo kwiyahura, imyitwarire mibi, n'ibiyobyabwenge. Ntabwo birasobanuka neza niba ari byiza mu gihe utwite cyangwa wonsa. Ingano nto ni zo zisabwa abantu bafite imikorere mibi y'impyiko. Gabapentin ni gabapentinoid. Ifite imiterere ya molekile isa n’iya aside γ-aminobutyric (GABA) kandi ikora mu kubuza imiyoboro imwe n’imwe ya kalisiyumu.
Gabapentin yemejwe bwa mbere gukoreshwa mu 1993. Kuva mu 2004, iboneka nk'umuti usanzwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Igiciro cy'ibicuruzwa byinshi mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere yari hafi ku kwezi; muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yari hagati y'amadolari y'Amerika 100 na 200. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa cumi n'umwe ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni 46. Mu myaka ya 1990, Parke-Davis, ishami rya Pfizer, yatangiye gukoresha uburyo butandukanye butemewe n'amategeko kugira ngo ashishikarize abaganga bo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gukoresha gabapentin mu buryo butemewe. Bishyuye amamiliyoni y'amadolari kugira ngo batunganye imanza zijyanye n'ibi bikorwa.

Methylphenidate, igurishwa ku izina ry'ubucuruzi rya Ritalin n'indi, ni umuti utera imbaraga ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara yo kudakora neza kw'ibitekerezo (ADHD) na narcolepsy. Ni umuti wa mbere uvura ADHD. Ishobora gufatwa mu kanwa cyangwa igasigwa ku ruhu. Imiti itandukanye igira igihe gitandukanye cy'ingaruka.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara za methylphenidate zirimo kugorwa no gusinzira, kugabanuka k'ubushake bwo kurya, guhangayika no kugabanya ibiro. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zishobora kuba zirimo psychosis, allergie, guhagarara igihe kirekire, gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge, n'ibibazo by'umutima. Bivugwa ko Methylphenidate ikora mu gukumira dopamine na norepinephrine reuptake by’imitsi ikoresha neurons. Methylphenidate ni umuti utera imbaraga mu mitsi (CNS) ukomoka ku bwoko bwa phenethylamine na piperidine.
Methylphenidate yakozwe bwa mbere mu 1944, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1955. Yagurishijwe bwa mbere na sosiyete yo mu Busuwisi yitwa CIBA, ubu ikaba ari Novartis Corporation. Bivugwa ko mu 2013, dose miliyari 2.4 za methylphenidate zafashwe ku isi yose. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 47 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 16. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy’umuti usohoka ako kanya kiri munsi ya 0.30$ kuri dose imwe mu 2018.

Multiple sclerosis (MS) ni indwara itera gukuraho myelin aho ibice bikingira uturemangingo tw’imitsi mu bwonko no mu ruti rw’umugongo byangirika. Uku kwangirika kubangamira ubushobozi bw'ibice by'imitsi bwo kohereza ibimenyetso, bigatera ibimenyetso bitandukanye, harimo ibibazo by'umubiri, ibyo mu mutwe, ndetse rimwe na rimwe n'ibibazo byo mu mutwe. Ibimenyetso byihariye bishobora kuba birimo kureba kabiri, guhuma mu jisho rimwe, intege nke z'imitsi ndetse no kunanirwa kumva cyangwa guhuza imikorere y'umubiri. MS ifata imiterere itandukanye, ibimenyetso bishya bibaho mu bitero byihariye (uburyo bwo gusubira inyuma) cyangwa bikiyongera uko igihe kigenda gihita (uburyo bukomeza kwiyongera). Hagati y’ibitero, ibimenyetso bishobora gucika burundu; icyakora, ibibazo by’imitsi bidashira akenshi birakomeza, cyane cyane uko indwara ikomeza kwiyongera.
Nubwo impamvu idasobanutse neza, imikorere y’ibanze ikekwa ko ari ukurimbuka kw’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri cyangwa kunanirwa kw’uturemangingo dukora myelin. Impamvu zivugwa zirimo imiterere y’umubiri no kuba byaterwa n’ubwandu bwa virusi nka virusi ya Epstein-Barr. Ubusanzwe indwara ya MS ipimwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso n'ibimenyetso byayo ndetse n'ibisubizo by'ibizamini by'ubuvuzi.
Nta muti uzwi uvura indwara ya sclerosis nyinshi. Uburyo bwo kuvura bugerageza kunoza imikorere y'umubiri nyuma y'igitero no gukumira ibitero bishya. Imiti ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ya MS, nubwo ifite akamaro gake, ishobora kugira ingaruka mbi kandi ntibemererwe neza. Ubuvuzi bw'umubiri bishobora gufasha abantu mu bushobozi bwabo bwo gukora. Abantu benshi bahitamo ubundi buryo bwo kuvura nubwo nta bimenyetso bigaragaza akamaro kabwo. Ingaruka z'igihe kirekire ziragoye kumenya; ingaruka nziza zikunze kugaragara ku bagore, abarwara iyi ndwara bakiri bato, abasubiranyemo, ndetse n'ababanje guhura n'ibitero bike. Icyizere cy'ubuzima ugereranije, ubusanzwe buri munsi y’imyaka itanu kugeza ku icumi ugereranije n’abaturage badafite icyo bahungabanyije.
Indwara ya sclerosis nyinshi ni indwara ikunze kugaragara cyane iterwa n’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri ifata uturemangingo tw’imitsi yo hagati. Mu 2015, abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 2.3 bagizweho ingaruka ku isi, aho igipimo gitandukanye cyane mu turere dutandukanye no mu baturage batandukanye. Muri uwo mwaka, abantu bagera ku 18.900 bapfuye bazize indwara ya MS, bavuye ku 12.000 mu 1990. Iyi ndwara ikunze gutangirira hagati y’imyaka makumyabiri na mirongo itanu kandi ikunze kugaragara ku bagore inshuro ebyiri kurusha abagabo. MS yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1868 n'umuhanga mu by'imitsi w'Umufaransa Jean-Martin Charcot. Izina "multiple sclerosis" risobanura inkovu nyinshi za glial (cyangwa sclerae - cyane cyane plaque cyangwa ibisebe) zikura ku ngingo yera y'ubwonko n'umugongo. Uburyo bushya bwo kuvura no gusuzuma indwara burimo gukorwa.

Wenceslas Munyeshyaka (wavutse ku ya 30 Nyakanga 1958 i Butare) ni Umunyarwanda wahoze ari umupadiri wa Kiliziya Gatolika. Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yari padiri kuri paruwasi ya Sainte-Famille i Kigali, aho Abatutsi benshi bari barahungiye.
Mu 2006, urukiko rwa gisirikare rwo mu Rwanda rwamukatiye adahari igifungo cya burundu, rumuhamije icyaha cya jenoside. Mu Ubufaransa, aho yahungiye kuva mu 1994, inkiko zafashe icyemezo cyo kutamuburanisha ("non-lieu") kubera ibimenyetso bidahagije, icyo cyemezo kiba ntakuka mu 2019. Mu 2023, yambuwe burundu ubupadiri na Papa Fransisko, nyuma y'uko yemeye ko yabyaye umwana.
Munyeshyaka yavukiye muri komine Ngoma, muri Perefegitura ya Butare. Nyina, Félicité Mukarukaka, yari Umututsi, naho se, Gabriel Ngiruwonsanga, yari Umuhutu.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside.
Mu 1994, Munyeshyaka yari padiri kuri paruwasi ya Sainte-Famille i Kigali, aho impunzi zibarirwa mu bihumbi zari zahungiye. Abarokotse n'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR) bamushinja kuba yarafatanyije n'Interahamwe mu gutoranya no kuzishyikiriza Abatutsi bari bahahungiye, ndetse no gufata abagore ku ngufu. Muri Kamena 1994, abanyamakuru bamusanze yambaye ikoti ririnda amasasu kandi afite imbunda ku mukandara.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, yahungiye i Goma muri Zayire, ku ya 2 Kanama 1994 ashyira umukono ku ibaruwa abapadiri b'Abanyarwanda bari bahungiye i Goma bandikiye Papa Yohani Pawulo wa II, ihakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Yageze mu Bufaransa muri Nzeri 1994. Kuva mu 2001 kugeza mu 2021, yakoreye umurimo w'ubupadiri muri diyosezi ya Évreux, i Gisors, anaba umushumba w'abaskuti.
Muri Werurwe 2021, diyosezi ya Évreux yamubujije gukomeza umurimo w'ubupadiri no gutanga amasakramentu, nyuma y'uko yemeye ko afite umuhungu wavutse mu 2010. Ku ya 23 Werurwe 2023, Papa Fransisko yamwambuye burundu ubupadiri, nta bujurire bushoboka.
Mu Ugushyingo 2006, urukiko rwa gisirikare rw'u Rwanda rwamukatiye adahari igifungo cya burundu, rumuhamije jenoside no gufata ku ngufu. Yaburanishijwe hamwe na Jenerali Laurent Munyakazi, na we wakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Urukiko rwemeje ko bafatanyije gushyikiriza abicanyi Abatutsi bari bahungiye kuri Sainte-Famille.
Mu 2005, TPIR yamushinje jenoside, gufata ku ngufu, itsembatsemba, ubwicanyi n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Hashingiwe ku mpapuro zo kumuta muri yombi za TPIR, yafatiwe i Gisors ku ya 20 Nyakanga 2007, arekurwa n'urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris ku ya 1 Kanama 2007. Yongeye gufatwa ku ya 5 Nzeri 2007, nyuma arekurwa ategekwa kwitaba ubutabera. Ku ya 20 Ugushyingo 2007, TPIR yohereje dosiye ye mu butabera bw'u Bufaransa.
Ikirego cya mbere cyatanzwe mu Bufaransa muri Nyakanga 1995. Mu 1996, urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Nîmes rwemeje ko inkiko z'u Bufaransa zidafite ububasha bwo kumuburanisha, ariko Urukiko rusesa imanza rwasheshe icyo cyemezo ku ya 6 Mutarama 1998. Ku ya 8 Kamena 2004, Urukiko rw'Uburayi rurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu rwahamije u Bufaransa gutinza uru rubanza, rubisabwe na Yvonne Mutimura, umwe mu barega.
Muri Kanama 2015, umushinjacyaha wa Paris, François Molins, yasabye ko urubanza ruhagarikwa, avuga ko iperereza ritabashije kugaragaza ibikorwa byihariye bimuhamya uruhare muri jenoside. Ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2015, abacamanza b'iperereza bafashe icyemezo cyo kutamuburanisha. Bemeje ko yagaragazaga ibitekerezo by'urwango kandi yari afitanye umubano mwiza n'abasirikare n'Interahamwe, ariko ko ibyo bidahagije ngo bimuhamye uruhare mu byaha byakozwe. Guverinoma y'u Rwanda yanenze icyo cyemezo.
Icyo cyemezo cyemejwe n'urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris ku ya 21 Kamena 2018, maze ku ya 30 Ukwakira 2019 Urukiko rusesa imanza rurakemeza, bihagarika burundu ikurikiranwa rye mu Bufaransa.

Glioblastoma, izwi kandi nka glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), ni yo kanseri ikaze cyane itangirira mu bwonko. Mu ntangiriro, ibimenyetso bya glioblastoma ntabwo ari byo byihariye. Bishobora kuba birimo kuribwa umutwe, impinduka mu miterere y'umuntu, isesemi n'ibimenyetso bisa n'iby'indwara yo mu bwonko. Ibimenyetso bikunze kwiyongera vuba kandi bishobora kwiyongera bikagera aho umuntu ata ubwenge.
Impamvu y’icyorezo cya glioblastoma ntabwo izwi. Ibintu bidasanzwe bishobora gutera ibyago birimo indwara zikomoka ku ngirabuzimafatizo, nka neurofibromatosis na Li-Fraumeni syndrome, ndetse n'ubuvuzi bwakozwe mbere bushingiye ku mirasire. Glioblastomas zigize 15% by'ibibyimba byose byo mu bwonko. Bishobora gutangirira ku tunyangingo tw’ubwonko dusanzwe cyangwa bigakura bivuye kuri astrocytoma iriho yo mu rwego rwo hasi. Ubusanzwe indwara iterwa no guhuza CT scan, MRI scan na tissue biopsy.
Nta buryo buzwi bwo kwirinda kanseri. Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi busaba kubagwa, nyuma hagakoreshwa imiti igabanya ubukana n'imirasire. Umuti wa temozolomide ukunze gukoreshwa nk'igice cya chimiotherapie. Steroid nyinshi zishobora gukoreshwa mu kugabanya kubyimba no kugabanya ibimenyetso. Gukuraho ikibyimba cyane bifitanye isano no kuramba kwacyo.
Nubwo kanseri yavuwe neza cyane, ikunze kugaruka. Igihe gisanzwe cyo kubaho nyuma yo gupimwa ni amezi 12 kugeza kuri 15, aho abantu bari munsi ya 3 kugeza kuri 7% bamara igihe kirenze imyaka itanu. Iyo umuntu atavuwe, kubaho kwe ni amezi atatu. Ni kanseri ikunze kugaragara cyane itangirira mu bwonko ikaba n'ikibyimba cya kabiri gikunze kugaragara cyane mu bwonko, nyuma ya meningioma. Abantu bagera kuri 3 ku 100.000 barwara iyi ndwara buri mwaka. Akenshi bitangira mu myaka 64 kandi bikunze kugaragara ku bagabo kurusha abagore. Ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri irimo kwigwa nk'uburyo bwo kuvura kanseri.

Down syndrome, izwi kandi nka trisomie 21, ni indwara iterwa n'uko kopi ya gatatu ya chromosome 21 cyangwa igice cyayo kiba kirimo cyangwa se igice cyayo. Ubusanzwe bifitanye isano no gutinda gukura kw'umubiri, ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bworoheje kugeza ku buringaniye, hamwe n'imiterere y'isura iranga umuntu. Igipimo mpuzandengo cy'ubwenge cy'umuntu mukuru urwaye Down syndrome ni 50, bingana n'ubushobozi bwo mu mutwe bw'umwana w'imyaka 8 cyangwa 9, ariko ibi bishobora gutandukana cyane.
Ababyeyi b'umuntu wanduye ubusanzwe baba bameze neza mu buryo bw'uturemangingo. Amahirwe ariyongera kuva kuri 0.1% ku babyeyi bafite imyaka 20 kugera kuri 3% ku bafite imyaka 45. Kromosomu y'inyongera ikekwa ko ibaho ku bw'impanuka, nta gikorwa kizwi cy'imyitwarire cyangwa ikintu kidashingiye ku bidukikije gihindura amahirwe. Indwara ya Down syndrome ishobora kumenyekana mu gihe cyo gutwita binyuze mu gupima mbere yo gutwita, hagakurikiraho gupima indwara cyangwa nyuma yo kubyara hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kwitegereza no gupima imiterere y'umubiri. Kuva aho igikorwa cyo gupima gitangiriye, inda ziterwa n'ibizamini akenshi zirahagarikwa. Gusuzuma buri gihe ibibazo by'ubuzima bikunze kugaragara muri Down syndrome ni byiza mu buzima bwose bw'umuntu.
Nta muti uhari wa Down syndrome. Uburezi n'ubuvuzi bukwiye byagaragaye ko bitera imbere ireme ry'ubuzima. Bamwe mu bana bafite indwara ya Down syndrome biga mu masomo asanzwe yo ku ishuri, mu gihe abandi bakeneye uburezi bwihariye kurushaho. Hari abantu bamwe barwaye Down syndrome barangiza amashuri yisumbuye, abandi bake biga amashuri yisumbuye. Mu gihe cy'ubukure, hafi 20% muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakora akazi gahembwa mu buryo runaka, benshi bakaba bakeneye ahantu ho gukorera hihishe. Ubufasha mu bibazo by'imari n'amategeko bukunze gukenerwa. Imyaka yo kubaho ni hagati ya 50 na 60 imyaka myinshi mu bihugu byateye imbere hamwe n'ubuvuzi bukwiye.
Down syndrome ni kimwe mu bintu bikunze kugaragara mu miterere ya chromosome mu bantu. Bibaho ku bana bagera kuri 1 mu 1000 bavuka buri mwaka. Mu 2015, indwara ya Down syndrome yagaragaye mu bantu miliyoni 5.4 ku isi yose, bituma impfu 27.000 zigabanuka ugereranyije n’impfu 43.000 zabaye mu 1990. Yitiriwe umuganga w’Umwongereza witwa John Langdon Down, wasobanuye neza iyi ndwara mu 1866. Bimwe mu bintu bigize iyi ndwara byasobanuwe mbere na Jean-Étienne Dominique Esquirol, umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe w’Umufaransa mu 1838, n’umuganga w’Umufaransa Édouard Séguin mu 1844. Impamvu y’uturemangingo itera Down syndrome yavumbuwe mu 1959.

Kokayine, izwi kandi nka coke, ni ikiyobyabwenge gikomeye gikoreshwa cyane mu kwidagadura. Akenshi irashongeshwa, igahumekwa nk'umwotsi, cyangwa igashonga hanyuma igashyirwa mu mitsi. Ingaruka zo mu mutwe zishobora kuba zirimo gutakaza aho umuntu ahuriye n'ukuri, kumva afite ibyishimo byinshi, cyangwa guhangayika. Ibimenyetso by'umubiri bishobora kuba birimo gutera k'umutima cyane, ibyuya, n'amaso manini. Dose nyinshi zishobora gutera umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru cyane cyangwa ubushyuhe bw'umubiri. Ingaruka zitangira mu masegonda make nyuma y'iminota mike yo gukoreshwa kandi zimara hagati y'iminota itanu na mirongo icyenda. Kokayine ifite umubare muto w’imiti yemewe ikoreshwa mu buvuzi nko kugabanya ububabare no kugabanya kuva amaraso mu gihe cyo kubaga amazuru.
Kokayine irakurura abantu bitewe n’ingaruka igira ku nzira y’ubugororangingo mu bwonko. Nyuma y'igihe gito cyo kuyikoresha, hari ibyago byinshi byo kuba umuntu ashobora kuyikoresha. Gukoresha kwayo byongera ibyago byo kurwara indwara zo mu bwonko, indwara z’umutima zifata imitsi, ibibazo by’ibihaha ku bayinywa, ndetse n’urupfu rutunguranye rw’umutima. Kokayine igurishwa mu muhanda ikunze kuvangwa n'imiti igabanya ububabare, ibinyampeke, quinine, cyangwa isukari, ibyo bikaba bishobora gutera uburozi bw'inyongera. Nyuma yo gufata doze inshuro nyinshi, umuntu ashobora kuba afite ubushobozi buke bwo kumva ibyishimo no kunanirwa cyane.
Kokayine ikora mu kubuza kongera kwinjiza serotonin, norepinephrine, na dopamine. Ibi bituma ubwonko bugira uruhare runini mu mikorere y’ubwonko. Bishobora kwambuka byoroshye umugozi uva mu maraso n'ubwonko kandi bishobora gutuma umugozi usenyuka. Mu 2013, ibiro 419 byakozwe mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko. Bivugwa ko isoko ritemewe rya kokayine riri hagati ya miliyari 100 na miliyari 500 z'amadolari ya Amerika buri mwaka. Iyo habayeho gukomeza gutunganya, kokayine ishobora gukorwa ikoresheje kokayine.
Kokayine ni yo kiyobyabwenge bitemewe n'amategeko cya kabiri gikoreshwa cyane ku isi, nyuma ya cannabis. Abantu bari hagati ya miliyoni 14 na 21 bakoresha uyu muti buri mwaka. Ikoreshwa ryabyo riri hejuru cyane muri Amerika ya Ruguru, rigakurikirwa n'i Burayi na Amerika y'Epfo. Hagati ya kimwe cya gatatu ku ijana by'abantu bo mu bihugu byateye imbere bagiye bakoresha kokayine mu gihe runaka mu buzima bwabo. Mu 2013, ikoreshwa rya kokayine ryagize ingaruka ku buryo butaziguye ku rupfu rw’abantu 4.300, ugereranyije n’abapfuye 2.400 mu 1990. Yitirirwa igiti cya koka cyakuwemo. Amababi y'iki gihingwa yakoreshejwe n'Abanya-Peru kuva kera. Kokayine yakuwe ku mababi bwa mbere mu 1860. Kuva mu 1961, Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ku Biyobyabwenge asaba ibihugu gufata kokayine nk'icyaha cyo kwidagadura.

Indwara ya Marfan (MFS) ni indwara iterwa n'uturemangingo (genetic disorder) igira ingaruka ku ngingo zihuza umubiri. Abafite iyo ndwara bakunze kuba barebare kandi bananutse, bafite amaboko maremare, amaguru, intoki n'amano. Akenshi kandi bagira ingingo zoroshye kandi zifite scoliosis. Ingorane zikomeye cyane zirimo umutima na aorta, hamwe n'ibyago byinshi byo gucika intege kwa valve ya mitral na aneurysm ya aorta. Ibihaha, amaso, amagufwa, n'igipfundikizo cy'umugongo nabyo bikunze kwibasirwa. Uburemere bw'ibimenyetso biratandukanye.
MFS iterwa n'impinduka muri "FBN1", imwe mu ngirabuzimafatizo zikora fibrillin, bigatuma habaho ingirabuzimafatizo zidasanzwe. Ni indwara ifata umubiri cyane (autosomal dominant disorder). Hafi 75% by'igihe, iyi ndwara iragwa n'umubyeyi ufite iyi ndwara, mu gihe 25% by'igihe ari impinduka nshya. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku gupima indwara hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa molekile cyangwa ibipimo bya Ghent.
Nta muti uzwi uvura MFS. Benshi mu bafite iyi ndwara bagira igihe cyo kubaho gisanzwe iyo bavuwe neza. Gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bwa beta blockers nka propranolol cyangwa atenolol, cyangwa se iyo itihanganirwa, imiti igabanya ubukana bwa calcium channel blockers cyangwa ACE inhibitors. Kubagwa bishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo usanwe umuyoboro w'amaraso cyangwa usimbuze umuyoboro w'umutima. Kwirinda gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri isaba imbaraga nyinshi birasabwa.
Umuntu umwe kuri 5,000 kugeza kuri 1 kuri 10,000 afite MFS. Bibaho kimwe ku bagabo no ku bagore. Igipimo cy'iyi ndwara kirasa hagati y'amoko no mu turere dutandukanye tw'isi. Yitiriwe abaganga b'indwara z'abana b'Umufaransa Antoine Marfan, wayisobanuye bwa mbere mu 1896.

Lisdexamfetamine, igurishwa ku izina rya Vyvanse n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara yo kudakora neza kw'ibitekerezo (ADHD) ku bantu barengeje imyaka itanu ndetse no ku ndwara yo kurya cyane ku bantu bakuru. Lisdexamfetamine ifatwa mu kanwa. Mu Bwongereza ubusanzwe ntabwo ikundwa cyane kurusha methylphenidate. Ingaruka zabyo muri rusange zitangira mu masaha 2 kandi zimara amasaha 12.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kubura ubushake bwo kurya, guhangayika, impiswi, gusinzira nabi, kurakara no kugira isesemi. Ingaruka mbi zidasanzwe ariko zikomeye zirimo kurwara indwara yo kwishima (mania), urupfu rutunguranye rw'umutima ku bafite ibibazo by'umutima, hamwe n'indwara yo mu mutwe (psychosis). Bifite amahirwe menshi yo gukoresha nabi nk'uko DEA ibivuga. Indwara ya Serotonin bishobora kubaho iyo bikoreshejwe hamwe n'indi miti imwe n'imwe. Gukoresha iyo miti mu gihe cyo gutwita bishobora kwangiza umwana kandi kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo konsa ntibyemewe n'uwabikoze. Lisdexamfetamine ni umuti utera inshinge zo mu bwonko (CNS) ukora nyuma yo guhinduka dextroamphetamine n'umubiri. Mu rwego rwa shimi, lisdexamfetamine igizwe na aside amine -lysine, ifatanye na dextroamphetamine.
Lisdexamfetamine yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 2007. Kubona ibikoresho mu Bwongereza buri kwezi bitwara Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima cy’Ubwongereza amafaranga agera kuri £ 58 Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 264. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 91 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni umunani. Ni ikintu kigenzurwa na Gahunda ya II mu Bwongereza n'ikintu kigenzurwa na Gahunda ya II muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Trazodone, igurishwa ku mazina menshi y’ibirango, ni umuti uvura indwara zifata imitsi. Ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba, indwara zo guhangayika, ingorane zo gusinzira, ndetse n'indi miti, no kurwara inzoga. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuma mu kanwa, kumva nta cyo ushoboye, kuruka no kuribwa umutwe. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zishobora kuba zirimo kwiyahura, kwiheba, gutera k'umutima ku buryo butari bwo, no guhagarara igihe kirekire bitewe n'uburwayi. Ntabwo birasobanuka neza niba gukoresha iyi miti mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa nta kibazo bifite. Ni ikintu kigizwe na phenylpiperazine cyo mu bwoko bwa serotonin antagonist na reuptake inhibitor (SARI). Trazodone ifite ingaruka zo gutuza.
Trazodone yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1981. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ikiguzi cya NHS mu Bwongereza ni hafi £7.46 ku kwezi guhera mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cyo kugurisha ku giciro kinini ni hafi 4.53 ku kwezi guhera mu 2018. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 30 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 22.

Anthrax ni indwara iterwa na bagiteri yitwa "Bacillus anthracis". Bishobora kubaho mu buryo bune: uruhu, ibihaha, amara, n'urushinge. Ibimenyetso bitangira hagati y'umunsi umwe n'amezi arenga abiri nyuma yo kwandura. Uruhu rugaragara nk'urusenda ruto rufite kubyimba bikikije akenshi bihinduka igisebe kidababaza gifite hagati y'umukara. Uburyo bwo guhumeka bugaragaza umuriro, ububabare mu gituza, no kubura umwuka. Imiterere y'amara igaragaza impiswi ishobora kuba irimo amaraso, ububabare bwo mu nda, isesemi no kuruka. Uburyo bwo guterwamo urushinge bugaragaza umuriro n'ikibyimba aho umuti watewe.
Anthrax ikwirakwira iyo ikoze ku dukoko twa bagiteri, dukunze kugaragara mu bikomoka ku nyamaswa byandura. Gukoraho ni uguhumeka, kurya, cyangwa unyuze mu gace k'uruhu kavunitse. Ntabwo akenshi ikwirakwira mu bantu mu buryo butaziguye. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo abantu bakorana n'inyamaswa cyangwa ibikomoka ku matungo, abagenzi, abakozi ba posita, n'abasirikare. Isuzuma rishobora kwemezwa no kubona antibody cyangwa uburozi mu maraso cyangwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo gupima icyitegererezo cyavuye aho umuntu yanduye.
Urukingo rwa Anthrax irasabwa abantu bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwandura. Gukingira inyamaswa indwara ya anthrax birasabwa mu turere twagaragayemo ubwandu mbere. Gufata imiti ya antibiyotike nka ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, na doxycycline mu mezi abiri nyuma yo kuyikoresha bishobora no gukumira kwandura. Iyo habayeho kwandura, ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko ndetse n'uburozi bushobora kuba burwanya uburozi. Ubwoko n'umubare wa antibiyotike zikoreshwa biterwa n'ubwoko bw'ubwandu. Antitoxin irasabwa abantu bafite ubwandu bwinshi.
Nubwo indwara idakunze kugaragara, anthrax y’abantu, iyo ibayeho, ikunze kugaragara cyane muri Afurika no muri Aziya yo hagati n’iy’amajyepfo. Iboneka kenshi mu majyepfo y'Uburayi kurusha ahandi ku mugabane, kandi ntabwo ikunze kugaragara mu majyaruguru y'Uburayi na Amerika ya Ruguru. Ku isi yose, nibura abarwayi 2.000 babaho mu mwaka, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bagera kuri babiri mu mwaka. Indwara z'uruhu zirenga 95% by'abanduye. Iyo hatabayeho kuvurwa, ibyago byo gupfa biturutse ku ndwara ya anthrax y'uruhu ni 24%. Ku ndwara zo mu mara, ibyago byo gupfa ni 25 kugeza kuri 75%, mu gihe anthrax y'ubuhumekero ipfa iri hagati ya 50 na 80%, nubwo yavurwa. Kugeza mu kinyejana cya 20, indwara za anthrax zahitanaga abantu n'inyamaswa ibihumbi amagana buri mwaka. Indwara ya Anthrax yakozwe nk'intwaro n'ibihugu byinshi. Mu nyamaswa zirya ibimera, kwandura indwara bibaho iyo zirya cyangwa zihumeka utubuto tw’uturemangingo mu gihe zirisha. Inyamaswa zishobora kwandura iyo ziriye inyamaswa zanduye.

Emmanuel Rukundo (wavutse ku ya 1 Ukuboza 1959) ni umupadiri w’Umugatolika w’Umunyarwanda, wahamijwe icyaha cya jenoside n’ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) mu 2009 kubera uruhare rwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Rukundo yavukiye i Kabgayi, Intara ya Gitarama, mu Rwanda. Yahawe ubupadiri muri Kiliziya Gatolika y'i Roma mu 1991. Mu 1993, yabaye umupadiri mu gisirikare cy'u Rwanda.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Rukundo yari umuyobozi wa Seminari Nto ya Mutagatifu Léon i Gitarama. Nk’uko byagaragajwe n’ibyavuye mu rubanza rwaburanishijwe n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR), yategetse abasirikare b’Abahutu gushimuta no kwica impunzi z’Abatutsi zari zahungiye kuri Seminari ya Mutagatifu Léon. Afatanyije n’abasirikare b’ingabo z’u Rwanda, yanagize uruhare mu gushimuta no kwica Madamu Rudahunga, ndetse no gukubita bikomeye abana be babiri n’abandi basivili babiri b’Abatutsi. Byongeye kandi, Rukundo yahamwe n’icyaha cyo guhohotera ku gitsina umukobwa ukiri muto w’Umututsikazi.
Nyuma ya jenoside, Rukundo yahungiye mu Busuwisi, aho yahawe ubuhungiro nk'impunzi. Yatawe muri yombi n'abayobozi b'Ubusuwisi muri Nyakanga 2001 nyuma y'aho Urukiko rwa TPIR rumaze gusohora impapuro zimufunga. Rukundo yaburanye mu Rukiko rw'Ikirenga rw'Ubusuwisi, ariko urubanza rwe rwaraciwe, maze ku ya 20 Nzeri 2001 yoherezwa Arusha muri Tanzaniya, kuburana na TPIR.
Urubanza rwa Rukundo rwatangiye ku ya 15 Ugushyingo 2006, rurangira muri Gashyantare 2008. Muri Gashyantare 2009, Urugereko rw'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga rwa TPIR rwamuhamije icyaha kimwe cya jenoside n'ibyaha byinshi by'ubwicanyi nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Urugereko rw'iremezo rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 25, ariko cyagabanijwe kigera ku myaka 23 mu Ukwakira 2010.
Muri Nyakanga 2016, Rukundo yasabye ICTR kurekura hakiri kare kubera ko yari amaze igihe gito afunzwe, maze mu Kuboza 2016, arekurwa muri gereza yo muri Mali ari kumwe na Ferdinand Nahimana, amaze imyaka 16 muri 23 yakatiwe.

Sertraline, igurishwa ku izina rya Zoloft n'indi, ni umuti ugabanya ubukana bw'indwara zo mu bwoko bwa serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). Ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba, indwara yo guhangayika, indwara yo guhangayika nyuma yo guhungabana, indwara yo kudakora ku mutima mbere yo gusezera, n'indwara yo guhangayika mu mibanire y'abantu. Sertraline ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka zikunze kugaragara zirimo impiswi, imikorere mibi mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, no kugira ibibazo byo gusinzira. Ingaruka mbi zirimo kwiyongera k'ibyago byo kwiyahura ku bari munsi y'imyaka 25 ndetse n'indwara ya serotonin. Ntibirasobanuka neza niba gukoresha iyi miti mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa nta kibazo bifite. Ntibikwiye gukoreshwa hamwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bwa MAO. Bivugwa ko Sertraline ikora mu kongera ingaruka za serotonin mu bwonko.
Sertraline yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1991, igurishwa bwa mbere na Pfizer. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi yatanzwe n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima nk'umuti usimbura fluoxetine. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cyo kugurisha ku giciro kinini ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 1.50 ku kwezi guhera mu 2018. Mu 2016, ni wo muti ukunze kwandikirwa abantu benshi bo mu mutwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, hamwe n’imiti irenga miliyoni 37 yanditswe na muganga. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 14 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ufite imiti irenga miliyoni 38.

Dengue fever ni indwara iterwa n'umubu iterwa na virusi ya dengue. Ibimenyetso bikunze gutangira nyuma y'iminsi itatu kugeza kuri cumi n'ine nyuma yo kwandura. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo umuriro mwinshi, kuribwa umutwe, kuruka, kubabara imitsi n'ingingo, ndetse no kugira uduheri ku ruhu. Gukira muri rusange bifata iminsi ibiri kugeza kuri irindwi. Mu ngero nke z'abarwayi, iyi ndwara ihinduka indwara ikomeye ya dengue, izwi kandi nka dengue hemorrhagic fever, bigatuma habaho kuva amaraso, urugero ruto rw'ibinure mu maraso n'amaraso ava, cyangwa ikaba indwara ya dengue shock syndrome, aho umuvuduko w'amaraso uba uri hasi cyane.
Dengue ikwirakwizwa n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'imibu y'ingore yo mu bwoko bwa "Aedes", cyane cyane "A. aegypti". Iyi virusi ifite ubwoko butanu; kwandura ubwoko bumwe akenshi bitanga ubudahangarwa bw'ubuzima bwose kuri ubwo bwoko, ariko ubundi bugatanga ubudahangarwa bw'igihe gito. Kwandura indwara nyuma y’ubundi bwoko byongera ibyago bikomeye byo kurwara indwara. Hari ibizamini byinshi bihari kugira ngo byemezwe ko indwara yanduye harimo no kumenya abasirikare b’umubiri banduye virusi cyangwa RNA yayo.
Urukingo rwa dengue rwemewe kandi ruboneka ku isoko mu bihugu byinshi. Guhera mu 2025, urukingo rusabwa gusa ku bantu basanzwe baranduye, cyangwa mu baturage bafite igipimo kinini cy’ubwandu mbere bafite imyaka 6 kugeza kuri 16. Ubundi buryo bwo kwirinda burimo kugabanya aho imibu ihurira no kugabanya ibyago byo kurumwa. Ibi bishobora gukorwa binyuze mu gukuraho cyangwa gupfuka amazi ahagaze no kwambara imyenda itwikira igice kinini cy'umubiri. Kuvura indwara ya dengue ikabije birafasha kandi bikubiyemo gutanga amazi mu kanwa cyangwa mu mitsi ku ndwara yoroheje cyangwa iri hagati. Ku ndwara zikomeye cyane, guterwa amaraso bishobora kuba ngombwa. Abantu bagera kuri kimwe cya kabiri cya miliyoni bakenera kwakirwa mu bitaro buri mwaka. Parasetamol (acetaminophen) ni yo isabwa aho gukoresha imiti igabanya ububabare itari iya steroide (NSAIDs) kugira ngo igabanye umuriro kandi igabanuke ububabare ku ndwara ya dengue bitewe n’uko ibyago byo kuva amaraso biyongera bitewe no gukoresha NSAID.
Dengue yabaye ikibazo cy’isi yose kuva mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y’Isi Yose kandi ikunze kugaragara mu bihugu birenga 120, cyane cyane mu majyepfo y’uburasirazuba bwa Aziya, Aziya y’Epfo na Amerika y’Epfo. Hagati ya 100 na 400 abantu miliyoni bandura buri mwaka kandi abagera ku 40.000 barapfa. Mu 2019, umubare w’abandura wariyongereye cyane. Ibisobanuro bya mbere by'icyorezo ni ibyavuye mu 1779. Impamvu ya virusi n'ikwirakwira ryayo byasobanuwe mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20. Uretse kurandura imibu, hari n'akazi ko gufata imiti igamije kurwanya virusi. Ifatwa nk'indwara yo mu turere dushyuha yirengagijwe.

Agakoko gatera SIDA gakwirakwizwa cyane cyane no gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye (harimo no gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina mu kibuno no mu kanwa), guterwa amaraso yanduye, inshinge zo mu bwoko bwa “hypodermic”, no kuva kuri nyina kugeza ku mwana mu gihe atwite, abyara cyangwa yonsa. Amwe mu mazi yo mu mubiri, nk'amacandwe, ibyuya n'amarira, ntabwo yanduza virusi. VIH ni kimwe mu bigize itsinda rya virusi zizwi nka retroviruses.
Uburyo bwo kwirinda burimo imibonano mpuzabitsina itekanye, gahunda zo guhererekanya inshinge, kuvura abanduye, kwirinda mbere na nyuma yo guhura n'icyorezo, no gukebwa kw'abagabo. Indwara ku mwana ishobora kwirindwa binyuze mu guha umubyeyi n'umwana imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi itera SIDA. Nta muti cyangwa urukingo bihari; icyakora, imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara ishobora kugabanya igihe cy'uburwayi kandi igatuma umuntu abaho ubuzima busanzwe. Ubuvuzi bugirwa inama yo guhita butangira gupimwa. Hatabayeho kuvurwa, igihe mpuzandengo cyo kubaho nyuma yo kwandura ni 11 imyaka.
Mu 2021, abantu bagera kuri 38 Abantu miliyoni ku isi babana n'ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA kandi hapfuye abantu 650.000. Abagera kuri miliyoni 20.6 muri bo baba mu burasirazuba no mu majyepfo ya Afurika. Hagati y'igihe SIDA yamenyekanye (mu ntangiriro za 1980) na 2018, iyi ndwara yateye abantu bagera kuri 32 miliyoni z'abapfuye ku isi yose. VIH/SIDA ifatwa nk'icyorezo —icyorezo kigaragara mu gace kanini kandi kirimo gukwirakwira cyane. Agakoko gatera SIDA kavuye ku zindi nyamaswa z’inkende kagera ku bantu bo muri Afurika y’iburengerazuba bwo hagati mu ntangiriro kugeza hagati mu kinyejana cya 20. SIDA yamenyekanye bwa mbere n’Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gishinzwe kurwanya no gukumira indwara (CDC) mu 1981 kandi icyayiteye—ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA—yamenyekanye mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana.
VIH/SIDA yagize ingaruka zikomeye kuri sosiyete, haba nk'indwara ndetse n'ivangura. Iyi ndwara kandi igira ingaruka zikomeye ku bukungu. Hari ibitekerezo byinshi bitari byo kuri VIH/SIDA, nko kwizera ko ishobora kwanduzwa no gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina mu buryo busanzwe. Iyi ndwara imaze kuvugwaho impaka nyinshi zijyanye n'amadini, harimo n'uko Kiliziya Gatolika ifata icyemezo cyo kudashyigikira ikoreshwa ry'agakingirizo mu kwirinda. Yakuruye ibitekerezo mpuzamahanga by’ubuvuzi na politiki ndetse n’inkunga nini kuva yamenyekana mu myaka ya 1980.

Indwara ya Lyme, izwi kandi nka Lyme borreliosis, ni indwara yandura iterwa na bagiteri "ya Borrelia" ikwirakwizwa n'udukoko. Ikimenyetso gikunze kugaragara cy'ubwandu ni ahantu hagaragara ubutuku ku ruhu, hazwi nka erythema migrans, hagaragara aho inkende yarumwe nyuma y'icyumweru kimwe ibaye. Ubusanzwe ibibyimba ntibiba bishyushye cyangwa ngo bibabaza. Hafi 70–80% by'abantu banduye barwara uduheri. Izindi ndwara zo mu ntangiriro zishobora kuba zirimo umuriro, kuribwa umutwe, umunaniro no kubyimba kw'imitsi. Akenshi birakemuka muri iki cyiciro. Iyo batavuwe, bamwe bashobora kubura ubushobozi bwo kwimura uruhande rumwe cyangwa byombi rw'isura, kubabara ingingo, kuribwa umutwe cyane hamwe no gukomera kw'ijosi, cyangwa gutera umutima mu gifu, n'ibindi. Nyuma y'amezi cyangwa imyaka, ububabare bw'ingingo no kubyimba bishobora kubaho kenshi. Rimwe na rimwe, abantu bagira ububabare bwo kurasa cyangwa kuribwa mu maboko no ku maguru. Nubwo bavuwe neza, abantu bagera kuri 10 kugeza kuri 20% bagira ububabare mu ngingo, ibibazo byo kwibuka no kunanirwa byibuze amezi atandatu.
Indwara ya Lyme yandurira mu bantu binyuze mu kurumwa n'udusimba twanduye two mu bwoko bwa "Ixodes". Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, udukoko duhangayikishije akenshi tuba turi mu bwoko bwa "Ixodes scapularis", kandi tugomba gushyirwaho nibura amasaha 36 mbere yuko bagiteri ikwirakwira. Mu Burayi, udukoko two mu bwoko bwa "Ixodes ricinus" dushobora gukwirakwiza bagiteri vuba cyane. Muri Amerika ya Ruguru, bagiteri "Borrelia burgdorferi" na "Borrelia mayonii" ni byo bitera indwara ya Lyme. Mu Burayi no muri Aziya, "Borrelia afzelii" na "Borrelia garinii" nazo zitera indwara. Iyi ndwara isa nkaho idakwirakwira hagati y’abantu, izindi nyamaswa, cyangwa binyuze mu biribwa. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye, amateka y’uko umuntu yahuye n’udukoko, ndetse no gupima uturemangingo tw’umubiri mu maraso. Ibizamini by'amaraso akenshi biba ari bibi mu ntangiriro z'indwara. Gupima udukoko ku giti cyatwo ntabwo ari ingirakamaro.
Kwirinda birimo imbaraga zo gukumira kurumwa n'udukoko nko kwambara imyenda yo gupfuka amaboko n'amaguru, no gukoresha imiti yica udukoko ishingiye kuri DEET. Gukoresha imiti yica udukoko kugira ngo ugabanye umubare w'udukoko nabyo bishobora kugira akamaro. Udukoko dushobora gukurwaho hakoreshejwe udupira two gukururaho udupira. Iyo agakoko kakuweho kari kuzuye amaraso, doxycycline imwe ishobora gukoreshwa mu gukumira ubwandu, ariko muri rusange ntibyemewe kuko ubwandu bukunze kugaragara. Iyo habayeho ubwandu, imiti myinshi igabanya ubukana irakora neza, harimo doxycycline, amoxicillin, azithromycin, ceftriaxone, na cefuroxime. Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi busanzwe bumara ibyumweru bibiri cyangwa bitatu. Hari abantu bagira umuriro n'ububabare bw'imitsi n'ingingo nyuma yo kuvurwa, ibyo bikaba bishobora kumara umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri. Ku bantu bagaragaza ibimenyetso bidashira, imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara ya antibiyotike mu gihe kirekire ntiyagaragaye ko ari ingirakamaro.
Indwara ya Lyme ni yo ndwara ikunze gukwirakwizwa n'udusimba mu majyaruguru y'isi. Bivugwa ko yibasira abantu 300.000 buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n'abantu 65.000 ku mwaka mu Burayi. Kwandura indwara bikunze kugaragara cyane mu mpeshyi no mu ntangiriro z'impeshyi. Indwara ya Lyme yasuzumwe nk'indwara yihariye ku nshuro ya mbere mu 1975 i Old Lyme, muri Connecticut. Mbere yitiranyijwe n'indwara ya rubagimpande y'abana. Bagiteri irimo yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1981 na Willy Burgdorfer. Ibimenyetso bidakira nyuma yo kuvurwa birasobanuwe neza kandi bizwi nka "syndrome y'indwara ya Lyme nyuma yo kuvurwa" (PTLDS). PTLDS itandukanye n'indwara ya Lyme idakira; ijambo ritagishyigikiwe n'abahanga mu bya siyansi kandi rikoreshwa mu buryo butandukanye n'amatsinda atandukanye. Bamwe mu batanga serivisi z'ubuvuzi bavuga ko PTLDS iterwa n'ubwandu buhoraho, ariko ibi ntibyizerwa ko ari ukuri kuko nta kimenyetso cy'ubwandu buhoraho gishobora kuboneka nyuma yo kuvurwa bisanzwe. Urukingo rw'indwara ya Lyme rwagurishijwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hagati ya 1998 na 2002, ariko rwakuwe ku isoko kubera ko rwagurishijwe nabi. Ubushakashatsi burakomeje kugira ngo hakorwe inkingo nshya.

Synesthesia ni ikintu aho gukangura inzira imwe y'ibyumviro cyangwa iy'ubwenge binatuma habaho ubunararibonye butunguranye mu yindi nzira y'ibyumviro cyangwa iy'ubwenge. Ibintu bikunze gukangura ni inyuguti, imibare, cyangwa amagambo; naho ibintu bikunze kugaragara ni amabara cyangwa imiterere. Izindi ngero zishobora kuba zirimo iminsi, umuziki, uburyohe, cyangwa abantu. Abantu bashobora kuba bafite ubwoko burenze bumwe.
Impamvu ntirasobanuka neza. Indwara zishobora kuvuka kare mu buzima cyangwa zikavuka nyuma y’impanuka. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo amateka y'umuryango, gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kumva nk'ubuhumyi, n'ibintu nka aside lysergic diethylamide (LSD). Abagera kuri 40% by'abarwayi bafite uwo bafitanye isano yo ku rwego rwa mbere wafashwe n'iyi ndwara. Uburyo bw'ibanze bushobora kuba bukubiyemo kugabanuka kw'imitsi ibuza ubwonko cyangwa kugabanuka kw'imitsi ihuza. Haracyari ikiganiro gikomeje ku buryo bwiza bwo gusobanura iyo ndwara.
Hagati ya 2% na 20% by'abantu bagerwaho n'iki kibazo ku rugero runaka. Abagabo n'abagore basa nkaho bagerwaho n'ingaruka zimwe. Iyi ndwara ishobora kugira akamaro mu gutunganya ubwenge nko kugira ubushobozi bwo guhanga udushya. Bamwe bayikoresheje kugira ngo ifashe mu gufata mu mutwe.
Urubanza rwa mbere rwanditswe rushobora kuba urwo mu 1690 rwanditswe n'umuhanga mu bya filozofiya John Locke, wavuze ku mugabo w'impumyi wabonye ibara ry'umutuku ubwo yumvaga ijwi ry'impanda. Ariko, bamwe barahakana niba ibyo Locke yavuze ari urugero nyakuri rw'imimerere cyangwa ari ikigereranyo. Inkuru ya mbere y’ubuvuzi ivugwaho kuba yaranditswe n’umuganga w’Umudage witwa Georg Tobias Ludwig Sachs mu 1812. Iri jambo rikomoka ku Kigiriki cya kera, bisobanura "hamwe", na, bisobanura " ibyiyumvo ". Abafite amateka maremare y'ibyo bintu bazwi nka synesthetes.

Kuziba kw'imitsi y'ibihaha (PE) ni ukuziba kw'imitsi y'amaraso mu bihaha bitewe n'ikintu cyavuye ahandi mu mubiri kinyuze mu maraso (embolism). Ibimenyetso bya PE bishobora kuba birimo kubura umwuka, kubabara mu gatuza cyane cyane iyo umuntu ahumeka, no gukorora amaraso. Ibimenyetso by'amaraso yapfutse mu kaguru bishobora no kugaragara, nko kuguru gutukura, gushyuha, kubyimba no kubabara. Ibimenyetso bya PE birimo urugero rwa ogisijeni mu maraso ruke, guhumeka vuba, umutima utera cyane, ndetse rimwe na rimwe n'umuriro muto. Indwara zikomeye zishobora gutera gucika intege, umuvuduko w'amaraso ugabanuka cyane, ndetse n'urupfu rutunguranye.
Ubusanzwe PE iterwa no kuzura kw'amaraso mu kaguru kakajya mu bihaha. Ibyago byo kuvura amaraso byiyongera bitewe na kanseri, kuryama igihe kirekire ku buriri, kunywa itabi, gucika intege mu bwonko, indwara zimwe na zimwe zikomoka ku ngirabuzimafatizo, imiti ikomoka kuri estrogen, gutwita, umubyibuho ukabije, ndetse na nyuma yo kubagwa. Igice gito cy'ibibazo biterwa no kwiyongera k'umwuka, ibinure, cyangwa amazi yo mu nda. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso n'ibimenyetso bihujwe n'ibisubizo by'ibizamini. Iyo ibyago biri hasi, ikizamini cy'amaraso kizwi nka D-dimer gishobora kugaragaza ko nta kibazo kirimo. Bitabaye ibyo, CT pulmonary angiography, isuzuma ry’imitsi mu bihaha, cyangwa ultrasound y’amaguru bishobora kwemeza ko ari byo byagaragaye. Hamwe na hamwe, thrombosis y'imitsi yo mu bwonko iteye imbere na PE bizwi nka thromboembolism y'imitsi yo mu bwonko (VTE).
Mu bikorwa byo gukumira indwara ya PE harimo gutangira kwimuka vuba bishoboka nyuma yo kubagwa, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri yo hasi mu gihe cyo kwicara, no gukoresha imiti igabanya amaraso nyuma yo kubagwa ubwoko bumwe na bumwe. Ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya amaraso nka heparin, warfarin cyangwa imwe muri iyo miti igabanya amaraso mu kanwa (DOACs). Ibi bigirwa inama yo kubikoresha nibura amezi atatu. Indwara zikomeye zishobora gusaba ko habaho thrombolysis hakoreshejwe imiti nka tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) itangwa mu mitsi cyangwa binyuze muri catheter, kandi zimwe zishobora gusaba kubagwa (pulmonary thrombectomy). Niba imiti igabanya amaraso idakwiye, ushobora gukoresha akayunguruzo k'agateganyo ka vena cava.
Indwara yo mu bihaha yibasira abantu bagera ku 430.000 buri mwaka mu Burayi. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abantu bari hagati ya 300.000 na 600.000 bandura buri mwaka, bigatuma impfu ziri hagati ya 50.000 na 200.000. Igipimo cy’indwara y’igitsina gabo n’igitsina gore kirangana. Bigenda birushaho kuba byinshi uko abantu bagenda bakura.

Elizaphan Ntakirutimana (1924 – 22 Mutarama 2007) yari umushumba w’Umunyarwanda w’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi. Ni we mupadiri wa mbere wahamwe n'icyaha cyo kugira uruhare runini mu buyobozi muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994.
Muri Gashyantare 2003, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda rwahamije Ntakirutimana n'umuhungu we Dr. Gérard, umuganga warangije amasomo ye muri Amerika mbere yo kugaruka mu Rwanda, icyaha cyo gufasha no gushyigikira jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu byakorewe mu Rwanda mu 1994. Urukiko rwasanze byaragaragaye nta gushidikanya ko Ntakirutimana, na we wo mu bwoko bw’Abahutu, yari yaratwaye abagabye igitero bitwaje intwaro abajyana mu kigo cya Mugonero, aho bishe amagana y’impunzi z’Abatutsi. Ntakirutimana yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 10. Yahamijwe icyaha hashingiwe ku nkuru z’abatangabuhamya babonye. Ingero nyinshi z'ibyaha byahamijwe zateshejwe agaciro mu bujurire ariko igihano cyatanzwe nticyahindutse. Yarekuwe ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2006, nyuma yo kumara imyaka 10 afunzwe cyangwa muri gereza, maze arapfa mu kwezi kwakurikiyeho.
Ibaruwa yari yandikiwe Ntakirutimana n’abapasiteri b’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi b’Abatutsi, akaba yarayeretse umwanditsi Philip Gourevitch, ni yo yahaye umutwe igitabo cya Gourevitch cyasohotse mu 1998, cyitwa We Wish to Inform You That Tomorrow We Will Be Killed With Our Families (Turifuza kukumenyesha ko ejo tuzicwa turi kumwe n’imiryango yacu). Icyo gitabo gishinja Ntakirutimana kugira uruhare mu rupfu rw’impunzi.

Oxycodone, igurishwa ku izina rya OxyContin n'indi, ni umuti wa opioid ukoreshwa mu kuvura ububabare buri hagati kugeza ku bukomere. Ubusanzwe ifatwa mu kanwa, kandi iboneka mu buryo bworoshye kandi bugenzurwa. Gutangira kugabanya ububabare bitangira mu minota 15 bikamara amasaha agera kuri atandatu iyo umuti utangiye gusohoka ako kanya. Mu Bwongereza, iboneka hakoreshejwe inshinge. Ibikoresho bivanze biraboneka kandi hamwe na parasetamol (acetaminophen), ibuprofen, naloxone, na aspirine.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo impatwe, isesemi, gusinzira, isereri, uburyaryate, kuma mu kanwa no kubira ibyuya. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kuba umuntu urwaye indwara yo mu mutwe, kwiheba mu myanya y'ubuhumekero (kugabanuka k'umuvuduko w'amaraso), no kugabanuka k'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Abantu bafite ubwivumbure kuri codeine bashobora no kuba bafite ubwivumbure kuri oxycodone. Gukoresha oxycodone mu gihe cyo gutwita bigaragara ko nta kibazo kirimo. Kureka opioid bishobora kubaho iyo bihagaritswe vuba. Oxycodone ikora binyuze mu gukora receptor ya μ-opioid. Iyo inyowe mu kanwa, igira ingaruka zikubye inshuro 1.5 z'ingano ingana na morphine.
Oxycodone yakozwe bwa mbere mu Budage mu 1916 ivanywe muri thebaine. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi yatanzwe n'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima nk'umusimbura wa morphine. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cya buri dose kiri munsi ya 0.30$ y'Amerika mu 2018. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 52 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 15. Oxycodone yabaye ikiyobyabwenge gikunze gukoreshwa cyane. Hari imiti myinshi igabanya ubukana bw'ihohoterwa iboneka, urugero nk'iyo ivanze na naloxone.

Agoraphobia ni indwara yo guhangayika irangwa n'ibimenyetso by'ihungabana mu bihe aho umuntu abona ko aho atuye hatari umutekano kandi nta buryo bworoshye bwo kubihunga. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo ahantu hafunguye, ubwikorezi rusange, amaduka, cyangwa kuba hanze y'urugo rwabo gusa. Kuba muri ibi bihe bishobora gutera ubwoba. Ibimenyetso bigaragara hafi buri gihe iyo ikibazo kibonetse kandi bikamara amezi arenga atandatu. Abazagira ingaruka bazakora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo birinde ibi bibazo. Mu bihe bikomeye abantu bashobora kunanirwa burundu kuva mu ngo zabo.
Agoraphobia bikekwa ko iterwa n'uruvange rw'ibintu bigize imiterere y'umubiri n'ibidukikije. Iyi ndwara ikunze kugaragara mu miryango, kandi ibintu bibabaza cyangwa bibabaza nko gupfa k'umubyeyi cyangwa guterwa bishobora kuba imbarutso. Muri DSM-5, agoraphobia ishyirwa mu cyiciro cy’ubwoba hamwe n’ubwoba bwihariye hamwe n’ubwoba bwo mu mibanire. Izindi ndwara zishobora gutera ibimenyetso nk'ibyo zirimo guhangayika mu gihe umuntu atandukana n'undi, indwara yo guhangayika nyuma y'ihungabana, n'indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba. Abarwaye bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwiheba no kurwara indwara yo gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge.
Iyo hatabayeho kuvurwa, ntabwo ari byiza ko agoraphobia ikemuka. Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe ubwoko bw'ubujyanama bwitwa " cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT). CBT iratanga igisubizo ku bantu bagera kuri kimwe cya kabiri. Agoraphobia yibasira abantu bakuru bagera kuri 1.7%. Abagore bibasirwa inshuro ebyiri kurusha abagabo. Iyi ndwara ikunze gutangirira mu bwana bw’umuntu, ikagabanuka cyane mu gihe cy’izabukuru. Ni gake cyane ku bana. Ijambo "agoraphobia" rikomoka ku rurimi rw'ikigereki, bisobanura " ikibanza rusange," na, bisobanura "ubwoba."

Indwara yo kudahuza n'abandi (ASPD cyangwa APD) ni indwara y'imibanire irangwa no kwirengagiza uburenganzira bw'abandi igihe kirekire. Akenshi hari amateka y’ubugizi bwa nabi, kubeshya kenshi, gutegura nabi, imyitwarire mibi, kutita ku mutekano w’abandi, no kutita ku bandi nyuma yo kubagirira nabi. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo ubushomeri no kwiyahura.
Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo amateka y'umuryango, ubukene, n'ihohoterwa ry'abana cyangwa abatarubakiwe. Ibimenyetso bigaragara kuva umuntu afite nibura imyaka 15 kandi ikibazo cy’imyitwarire kigaragara mbere y’iyo myaka. Gusuzuma indwara ku mugaragaro bisaba ko umuntu aba afite imyaka irenga 17. Ibimenyetso by'indwara yo kudahuza abantu nabyo byavuzwe ko ari indwara yo mu mutwe, sociopathy, na disorder de personality (DPD). Ni indwara y’imiterere y’umuntu yo mu itsinda rya B.
Nta buryo bwihariye bwo kuvura, hashyirwaho imbaraga zigamije kunoza ibimenyetso. Kujyanwa mu bitaro ntibyagaragaye ko ari ingirakamaro. ASPD yagize ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri 0.2% kugeza kuri 3.3% mu mwaka runaka. Abagabo bibasirwa n’indwara inshuro eshatu kurusha abagore. Mu bagabo bafite inzoga ziterwa no gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge, igipimo cy’indwara gishobora kuba kirenze 70%. Iyi ndwara ishobora kugabanuka uko umuntu agenda akura. Abahuye n’iki kibazo bashobora gupfa bazize urugomo.

Indwara ya Guillain-Barré (GBS) ni intege nke z'imitsi zitangira vuba bitewe n'uko ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwangiza uturemangingo tw'imitsi yo mu gice cy'imbere cy'umubiri. Ubusanzwe, impande zombi z'umubiri ziba zirimo, kandi ibimenyetso bya mbere ni impinduka mu buryo umuntu yumva cyangwa agira ububabare akenshi mu mugongo hamwe n'intege nke z'imitsi, bitangirira ku birenge no ku biganza, akenshi bigakwirakwira mu maboko no hejuru y'umubiri. Ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragara mu gihe cy'amasaha menshi cyangwa ibyumweru bike. Mu gihe cy’ihungabana rikomeye, iyi ndwara ishobora gushyira ubuzima mu kaga, aho abantu bagera kuri 15 ku ijana bagira intege nke mu mitsi yo guhumeka, bityo bikaba ngombwa ko bahumeka hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa "mechanical breath". Bamwe bagerwaho n'impinduka mu mikorere y'imitsi ikora ku buryo bworoshye, ibyo bikaba byatera indwara ziterwa n'umuvuduko w'amaraso n'umutima.
Nubwo impamvu itazwi, imikorere yayo ishingiye ku ndwara y’ubwirinzi bw’umubiri aho ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri bwibasira imitsi yo mu mpande z’umubiri mu buryo butari bwo maze bukangiza ubwishingizi bwa myelin. Hari igihe ubu burwayi bw'umubiri buterwa n'ubwandu cyangwa, akenshi bitewe no kubagwa, kandi gake cyane bitewe no gukingirwa. Ubusanzwe indwara iterwa n'ibimenyetso n'ibimenyetso, binyuze mu gukuraho izindi mpamvu, kandi igashyigikirwa n'ibizamini nko kwiga uburyo imitsi ikora ndetse no gusuzuma amazi yo mu bwonko. Hari ubwoko butandukanye bushingiye ku bice by'intege nke, ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi ku mitsi ndetse no kuba hari ubudahangarwa bumwe na bumwe bw'umubiri. Ishyirwa mu cyiciro cya polyneuropathy ikabije.
Ku bantu bafite intege nke cyane, kuvurwa vuba hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ubukana bw’umubiri (immunoglobulines) cyangwa plasmapheresis, hamwe n’ubuvuzi bufasha, bizatuma abantu benshi bakira neza. Gukira bishobora gufata ibyumweru kugeza ku myaka, hafi kimwe cya gatatu kikaba gifite intege nke zidashira. Ku isi yose, impfu ziba hafi 7.5% by'abazirwaye. Indwara ya Guillain-Barré ikunze kugaragara, ku bantu 100.000 buri mwaka, umuntu umwe cyangwa babiri barwaye indwara nk'iyo. Imboro zombi ndetse n'ibice byose by'isi bifite igipimo kimwe cy'indwara. Iyi ndwara yitiriwe abaganga b'indwara z'imitsi b'Abafaransa Georges Guillain na Jean Alexandre Barré, basobanuye iyi ndwara hamwe n'umuganga w'Umufaransa André Strohl mu 1916.

Indwara y'umuntu urwaye indwara yo mu bwonko (SPS) iterwa no gukomera kw'imitsi no gucika intege bigakomeza kwiyongera uko igihe kigenda gihita. Bigira ingaruka cyane cyane ku gituza, amaboko n'amaguru. Gucika intege bishobora guterwa n'ijwi, gukorakoraho, cyangwa amarangamutima. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo imiterere mibi, kuvunika amagufwa, ububabare budakira, no kugwa kenshi.
Akenshi impamvu ntiramenyekana neza, nubwo bikekwa ko hari uburyo bwo kurwanya indwara ziterwa n’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri. Abantu benshi bahura n'izindi ndwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri, nka diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1. Nibisanzwe bibaho nk'indwara ya paraneoplastic. Gusuzuma akenshi ni ukumenya ko hari ubudahangarwa bwinshi cyane bwa aside glutamic decarboxylase (GAD) mu maraso cyangwa mu mazi yo mu bwonko. Electromyography bishobora kandi kuba ingirakamaro.
Ibimenyetso bishobora kuvurwa n'imiti nka diazepam, baclofen, cyangwa gabapentin. Immunoglobulin cyangwa plasmapheresis yo mu mitsi na byo bishobora gufasha. Muri rusange bitera ubuzima bubi, bigatuma umuntu agira ihungabana cyangwa imihangayiko. Icyizere cy'ubuzima kiragabanuka.
Indwara y’umuntu uhorana ubumuga ikunze kugaragara, ikaba igaragara ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni imwe. Indwara ikunze kugaragara cyane hagati y’imyaka 20 na 60, nubwo ishobora kugaragara ku bana mu buryo budasanzwe. Abagore bibasirwa inshuro ebyiri kurusha abagabo. Iyi ndwara yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1956 na Frederick Moersch na Henry Woltman.

Kanseri y'inkondo y'umura (CRC), izwi kandi nka kanseri y'amara, kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, cyangwa kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, ni ukwiyongera kw'uturemangingo tudasanzwe mu mara cyangwa mu mara manini. Ifite ubushobozi bwo kwinjira cyangwa gukwirakwira mu bindi bice by'umubiri. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo amaraso mu mwanda, impinduka mu mara, kugabanya ibiro, kumva umunaniro, no kubabara mu nda.
Kanseri nyinshi zo mu mara ziterwa n'izabukuru n'imibereho, aho umubare muto cyane w'abandura uterwa n'indwara zikomoka ku ngirabuzimafatizo. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera iyi ndwara zirimo imirire, umubyibuho ukabije, kunywa itabi, no kutagira imyitozo ngororamubiri. Ibintu byongera ibyago birimo inyama zitukura, inyama zatunganyijwe, n'inzoga. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera ibyago zirimo kuvurwa hakoreshejwe imirasire mu kibuno, n'indwara zo kubyimba amara Indwara ya Crohn na colitis y'ibisebe. Zimwe mu ndwara z’uturemangingo dushobora gutera kanseri y’inkondo y’umura zirimo polyposis yo mu muryango na kanseri y’inkondo y’umura idakomoka ku mara; icyakora, izi ni munsi ya 5% by’abanduye. Ubusanzwe itangira nk'ikibyimba kitarimo indwara, akenshi mu buryo bwa polyp, iyo igenda ihinduka kanseri. Kanseri zo mu mara zishobora kugabanywamo ibice bitandukanye n'aho zibera mu mara: uruhande rw'iburyo, uruhande rw'ibumoso n'urw'inyuma.
Kanseri y'amara ishobora gupimwa hakoreshejwe icyitegererezo cy'amara mu gihe cyo gupima sigmoidoscopy cyangwa colonoscopy. Hanyuma hagakurikiraho isuzuma ry’abaganga kugira ngo hamenyekane niba indwara yarakwirakwiriye. Gusuzuma ifite akamaro mu gukumira no kugabanya impfu ziterwa na kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Gusuzuma, hakoreshejwe bumwe mu buryo butandukanye, birasabwa guhera ku myaka 45 kugeza kuri 75. Mu gihe cyo gupima colonoscopy, polyps nto zishobora gukurwaho iyo zibonetse. Iyo habonetse polyp nini cyangwa ikibyimba, hashobora gukorwa biopsy kugira ngo harebwe niba ari kanseri. Aspirine n'indi miti igabanya ububyimbirwe itari steroide bigabanya ibyago byo kubyimba. Nubwo bimeze gutyo, ikoreshwa ryabyo muri rusange ntiryifuzwa kubera ingaruka mbi.
Uburyo bwo kuvura kanseri y'inkondo y'umura bushobora kuba burimo uburyo bwo kubaga, gukoresha imirasire, imiti ivura kanseri ndetse n'uburyo bwo kuvura hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Kanseri zifungiye mu rukuta rw'amara zishobora gukira hakoreshejwe kubagwa, mu gihe kanseri yakwirakwiriye cyane idakunze kuvurwa, aho uburyo bwo kuyivura bugamije kunoza ubuzima n'ibimenyetso by'indwara. Ku ndwara zo mu gace zigaragara hakiri kare, igipimo cyo kubaho mu myaka itanu ni hafi 90%, ariko iyo kanseri imaze gukwirakwira, igabanuka ikagera kuri 14%. Igipimo cy'imyaka 5 yo kubaho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kiri hafi 65%. Amahirwe yo kubaho ku muntu ku giti cye aterwa n’uko kanseri igeze ku rugero, niba kanseri yose ishobora gukurwaho hakoreshejwe kubagwa ndetse n’ubuzima bw’umuntu muri rusange.
Kanseri y'inkondo y'umura ni yo kanseri ikunze kugaragara cyane mu mara. Mu 2020, habayeho abarwayi bashya miliyoni 1.93 n'abapfuye 916.000 bazize iyi ndwara. Bigize hafi 10% by'abarwayi bose. Ni kanseri ya gatatu ikunze kugaragara cyane mu bagabo no ku mwanya wa kabiri mu bagore. Ntabwo bikunze kugaragara ku bagore kurusha abagabo. Bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu byateye imbere, aho abarenga 65% by'abanduye baboneka.

Fluoxetine, igurishwa ku mazina y’ibirango bya Prozac na Sarafem n’ibindi, ni umuti ugabanya ubukana bw’indwara zo mu bwoko bwa serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). Ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba, (OCD), bulimia nervosa, indwara yo gucika intege, n'indwara yo kudakora ku mutima mbere yo gushyingirwa. Bishobora kugabanya ibyago byo kwiyahura ku bantu barengeje imyaka 65. Yanakoreshejwe mu kuvura gusohora imburagihe. Fluoxetine ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kubura ibiribwa, gusinzira nabi, kudakora neza mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, kubura ubushake bwo kurya, kuma mu kanwa, kubyimba no kurota inzozi zidasanzwe. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zirimo serotonin syndrome, mania, igicuri, ibyago byinshi byo kwiyahura ku bantu bari munsi y'imyaka 25, ndetse n'ibyago byinshi byo kuva amaraso. Iyo ihagaritswe mu buryo butunguranye, indwara yo kwiheba ishobora gutera guhangayika, isereri, n'impinduka mu buryo umuntu yumva. Ntibirasobanuka neza niba ari byiza mu gihe utwite. Niba waramaze gufata umuti, byaba byiza gukomeza mu gihe cyo konsa. Imikorere yayo ntabwo isobanutse neza ariko bikekwa ko ifitanye isano no kongera imikorere ya serotonin mu bwonko.
Fluoxetine yavumbuwe na Eli Lilly and Company mu 1972, itangira gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1986. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cy’igurishwa ry’ibicuruzwa mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere kiri hagati ya 0.01 na 0.04 ku munsi guhera mu 2014. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igura hafi 0.85 ku munsi. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 31 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 21.

Propofol, yamamazwa nka Diprivan, mu yandi mazina, ni umuti ukora vuba utuma umuntu agabanuka mu bwenge ndetse no kubura kwibuka ibyabaye. Imikoreshereze yayo irimo gutangiza no kubungabunga uburyo bwo gusinziriza indwara rusange, gusinziriza abantu bakuru bafite umwuka uhagije, no gusinziriza indwara. Ikoreshwa kandi ku ndwara ya status epilepticus iyo indi miti itarakora. Itangwa binyuze mu gutera mu mitsi, kandi ingaruka ntarengwa zigera ku minota ibiri kugira ngo iboneke kandi akenshi imara iminota itanu kugeza ku icumi.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara za propofol zirimo umuvuduko w'umutima utari mwiza, umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi, kumva ubushyuhe aho umuntu atewe ndetse no guhagarika guhumeka. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo gucika intege, kwandura indwara ziterwa no gukoresha nabi, kuba imbata, ndetse no kugira indwara ya propofol infusion syndrome iyo ikoreshejwe igihe kirekire. Uyu muti usa nkaho ufite umutekano wo kuwukoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita ariko ntabwo wasuzumwe neza kugira ngo uwukoreshe muri iki kibazo. Ntibyemewe gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo kubagwa. Si umuti ugabanya ububabare, bityo imiti ya opioid nka morphine nayo ishobora gukoreshwa, ariko niba ihora ikenewe cyangwa idakenewe ntibirasobanuka neza. Bikekwa ko Propofol ikora nibura igice cyayo binyuze muri receptor ya GABA.
Propofol yavumbuwe mu 1977 yemererwa gukoreshwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1989. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima kandi iraboneka nk'umuti rusange. Igiciro cya buguzi mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya 0.61 na 8.50 USD kuri buri kapu. Byitwaga amata ya amnesia (ikinamico ku ' mata ya magnesia '), bitewe n'uko ikoreshwa mu mitsi rimeze nk'amata. Propofol ikoreshwa kandi mu buvuzi bw'amatungo mu gusinziriza.

Myasthenia gravis (MG) ni indwara y'imitsi ifata imitsi mu gihe kirekire iganisha ku ntege nke z'imitsi mu buryo butandukanye. Imitsi ikunze kwibasirwa cyane ni iyo mu maso, mu maso no mu mitsi yo kumira. Bishobora gutuma umuntu abona ibintu bibiri, amaso ye akagira amagufwa, avuga nabi, ndetse akagenda nabi. Gutangira bishobora kuba mu buryo butunguranye. Abarwaye akenshi baba bafite thymus nini cyangwa bakagira thymoma.
Myasthenia gravis ni indwara iterwa n’uturemangingo tw’umubiri dukingira cyangwa tugasenya uduce twa nikotine acetylcholine aho imitsi n’imitsi bihurira. Ibi birinda imitsi gutera imitsi gucika intege. Imiti imwe ishobora kongera intege nke. Ni gake cyane, inenge y’uturemangingo mu mikoranire y’imitsi itera indwara nk’iyo izwi nka myasthenia yo mu maraso. Abana b'ababyeyi bafite indwara ya myasthenia bashobora kugira ibimenyetso mu mezi yabo ya mbere y'ubuzima, bizwi nka myasthenia y'impinja. Gusuzuma bishobora gushyigikirwa n'ibizamini by'amaraso ku byerekeye uturemangingo twihariye, ikizamini cya edrophonium, cyangwa inyigo yo kuyobora imitsi.
Muri rusange, indwara ya Myasthenia gravis ivurwa n'imiti izwi nka acetylcholinesterase inhibitors nka neostigmine na pyridostigmine. Imiti igabanya ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, nka prednisone cyangwa azathioprine, nayo ishobora gukoreshwa. Gukuraho thymus bishobora kongerera ibimenyetso mu bihe bimwe na bimwe. Plasmapheresis na immunoglobulin yo mu mitsi ishobora gukoreshwa mu gihe habayeho kugurumana gutunguranye kw'indwara. Iyo imitsi yo guhumeka icitse intege cyane, hashobora kuba ngombwa guhumeka hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa "mechanical air conditioner". Iyo imiti ibuza acetylcholinesterase ikoreshejwe mu muyoboro ishobora gufatwa by'agateganyo kugira ngo igabanye imyuka y'ubuhumekero.
MG ifata abantu 50 kugeza kuri 200 kuri miliyoni. Ivurwa vuba mu bantu batatu kugeza kuri 30 kuri miliyoni buri mwaka. Gusuzuma indwara biri kugenda birushaho kwiyongera bitewe no kwiyongera k'ubumenyi. Ikunze kugaragara cyane ku bagore bari munsi y'imyaka 40 no ku bagabo bari hejuru y'imyaka 60. Ni ibidasanzwe ku bana. Iyo umuntu avuwe, abenshi mu barwaye babayeho ubuzima busanzwe kandi bafite igihe cyo kubaho gisanzwe. Iryo jambo rikomoka ku kigereki "mys" "muscle" na "astheneia" "weakness", naho mu kilatini "gravis" "serious".

Callixte Mbarushimana (24 Nyakanga 1963 - 4 Ukwakira 2026) yari Umukozi w’Abahutu n’Umuryango w’abibumbye (1992 – 2001) bivugwa ko yagize uruhare muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994. Ku itariki ya 28 Nzeri 2010, Mbarushimana yashinjwe n'Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha (ICC) i La Haye ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu n'ibyaha by'intambara bivugwa ko byakorewe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo mu 2009. Yatawe muri yombi mu Bufaransa mu Ukwakira 2010 yoherezwa muri ICC ku ya 25 Mutarama 2011. Ariko, yarekuwe ku ya 23 Ukuboza 2011 kubera ko ICC yasanze nta bimenyetso bihagije byo kumushinja.
Bivugwa ko yagize uruhare muri Jenoside yo mu Rwanda.
Mbarushimana bivugwa ko yayoboye kandi akagira uruhare mu iyicwa ry’abantu 32 mu 1994, barimo n’abakozi ba Loni yahawe inshingano zo kurinda. Yirukanwe muri Loni mu 2001 ariko mu 2004 yatsinze urubanza rwasabaga indishyi zo kwirukanwa kwe.
Mbarushimana yinjiye muri Loni mu 1992, akomeza kuba umukozi kugeza mu 2001 akorera muri Angola na Kosovo. Mu gihe cya Jenoside, Mbarushimana yasigiwe inshingano zo gutanga ibikoresho n'inkunga ku bakozi b'igihugu ba Loni bari basigaye inyuma nyuma y'uko Loni yirukanye abakozi mpuzamahanga b'abasivili. Callixte Mbarushimana, izina ridasanzwe nk'imyaka yabanjirije Jenoside, azwiho kwitabira imyigaragambyo yo kwamagana Abatutsi. Byongeye kandi, ibimenyetso byakusanyijwe n'itsinda rya TPIR ryateguraga inyandiko y'ibirego bimushinja byagaragaje ko mbere y'intambara yatoje umutwe w'ingabo ku giti cye. Mbarushimana ashinjwa kuba atari yarashyikirije ingabo z’u Rwanda imodoka n’ibikoresho bya Loni (urugero: Interahamwe) cyangwa igisirikare gusa, ahubwo anashinjwa kugira uruhare rutaziguye mu kwica no gutanga amategeko yo kwica abantu mu gihe cya jenoside. Mu bakozi ba Loni bivugwa ko Mbarushimana yaba yarishe harimo Florence Ngirumpatse, umuyobozi w’abakozi ku biro by’iterambere ry’umuryango w’abibumbye i Kigali.
Ubwo umushakashatsi ku byaha by’intambara Tony Grieg yakoraga ubushakashatsi ku rubanza rwa Mbarushimana, yabajije nibura abantu 20 babonye ubwo bwicanyi maze yemeza ko Mbarushimana yagize uruhare rutaziguye. Ariko, Mbarushimana ntiyigeze ashinjwa ibyo byaha, wenda kubera ko atari afatwa nk'umwe mu bateguye ubwicanyi.
Yashinjwe n'Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha.
Ku ya 11 Ukwakira 2010, Mbarushimana yatawe muri yombi mu Bufaransa hashingiwe ku mpapuro zo kumuta muri yombi zatanzwe n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha (ICC), akurikiranyweho ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara bivugwa ko byakorewe mu ntara za Kivu, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (RDC).
Izo mpapuro zo kumuta muri yombi zishingiye ku bitero byinshi bivugwa ko byagabwe n’ingabo za FDLR ku basivili bo muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru na Kivu y’Amajyepfo mu mwaka wa 2009. Abacamanza b’urukiko bavuze ko hari impamvu zifatika zituma bakeka ko Mbarushimana, wari Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa FDLR, yagize uruhare muri ibyo bitero. Mu byaha yashinjwaga harimo ubwicanyi, iyicarubozo, gufata ku ngufu, gutoteza n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubugome.
Inyandiko y’ibirego yanavugaga ko Mbarushimana yagize uruhare muri gahunda yari igamije guteza ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubutabazi n’ubuzima bw’abaturage, kugira ngo FDLR ibone imbaraga za politiki.
Ku itariki ya 25 Mutarama 2011, Mbarushimana yoherejwe mu Rukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha kugira ngo akurikiranweho icyaha i La Haye.
