Pica ni indwara irangwa no gushaka no kurya ibintu bitafatwa nk'ibiryo. Muri rusange irari ni ibintu bimwe na bimwe byihariye nk'ubutaka, ibirayi bibisi, urubura, umusatsi, cyangwa irangi. Akenshi ibimenyetso bike biragaragara nubwo ububabare bwo mu nda bushobora kubaho rimwe na rimwe. Pica ishobora gutera uburozi bwa lisansi, kuziba igifu, kugabanuka k'uturemangingo dutukura mu maraso, cyangwa kwandura indwara ziterwa n'udukoko.
Ku bana basanzwe, pica mu gihe muri rusange biyemeza kwigisha ibikwiye kurya. Ubujyanama, harimo n'ubuvuzi bw'imyitwarire, nabyo bishobora kuba ingirakamaro. Iyo habayeho ikibazo cyo kubura icyuma gihagije, ibi bigomba kuvurwa.
Pica igira ingaruka ku bana n'abagore batwite bagera kuri 30%. Ku bana, ikunze kugaragara cyane ku bafite hagati y'amezi 18 n'imyaka 6. Ivugwa kuri pica ni iya Hippocrates mu myaka irenga 2.000 ishize. Iri jambo ryitiriwe igisasu gisanzwe (Pica pica) kirya ibintu bidasanzwe.

Citalopram, igurishwa ku mazina nka Celexa, ni umuti uvura indwara y'agahinda wo mu bwoko bwa "selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor" (SSRI). Ifatwa mu kanwa, kandi yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1998.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Citalopram, igurishwa ku izina rya Celexa n'izindi, ni umuti uvura indwara y'agahinda wo mu bwoko bwa serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). Ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba, indwara yo kwiheba ishingiye ku bwenge, indwara yo gucika intege, no gutinya abantu. Ingaruka zo kugabanya ubukana bw'indwara zishobora gufata icyumweru kimwe kugeza kuri bine kugira ngo ziboneke. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi n'uko ikora.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi, gusinzira nabi, ibibazo by'imibonano mpuzabitsina, kuzuyaza, kumva unaniwe, no kubira ibyuya. Ingaruka mbi zirimo kwiyongera k'ibyago byo kwiyahura ku bari munsi y'imyaka 25, serotonin syndrome, glaucoma, na QT prolongation. Ntibikwiye gukoreshwa ku muntu uri kuri MAO inhibitor. Indwara yo guhagarika kwiheba ishobora kubaho iyo ihagaritswe. Hari impungenge ko kuyikoresha mu gihe utwite bishobora kwangiza umwana.
Citalopram yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1998. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi yatanzwe n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima nk'umuti usimbura fluoxetine. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Mu Bwongereza, igipimo gisanzwe gitwara NHS kiri munsi ya 20 GBP ku kwezi. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igura hagati ya 50 na 100 USD ku kwezi guhera mu 2016. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 26 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 24.

Lidocaine, izwi kandi nka lignocaine, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu gutera ikinya agace runaka k'umubiri ("anesthésie locale"), ukanakoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zimwe na zimwe z'umutima zituma utera nabi. Yavumbuwe mu 1946, kandi iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Lidocaine, izwi kandi nka lignocaine, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu gutera ikinya mu gace runaka (anesthesia yo mu gace). Ikoreshwa kandi mu kuvura tachycardia y'imitsi no mu gukora imitsi ifungana. Hari umuti witwa Lidocaine uvanze n'umuti muto wa adrenaline (epinephrine) uboneka kugira ngo ufashe abantu kugira ibinya, ugabanye kuva amaraso, kandi utume ingaruka zo kugira ibinya zimara igihe kirekire. Iyo ikoreshejwe nk'umuti uterwa n'urushinge, lidocaine itangira gukora mu minota ine ikamara igice cy'isaha kugeza ku masaha atatu. Uruvange rwa Lidocaine rushobora kandi gushyirwa ku ruhu cyangwa mu ruhu kugira ngo rushire ububabare muri ako gace.
Ingaruka mbi n'uko ikora.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara mu gukoresha imiti igabanya ububabare harimo gusinzira, kunyaragura imitsi, urujijo, impinduka mu byo umuntu abona, kugira ibinya, kuribwa mu nda no kuruka. Bishobora gutera umuvuduko w'amaraso muke ndetse n'umuvuduko w'umutima utera mu buryo budasanzwe. Hari impungenge ko kuyitera mu ngingo bishobora guteza ibibazo kuri karitsiye. Muri rusange bisa nkaho ari byiza gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo gutwita. Ku bafite ibibazo by'umwijima, dose nke ishobora kuba ikenewe. Muri rusange ni byiza kuyikoresha ku bantu bafite ubwivumbure kuri tetracaine cyangwa benzocaine. Lidocaine ni umuti urwanya arrhythmia yo mu bwoko bwa Ib. Ibi bivuze ko bikora binyuze mu kuziba imiyoboro ya sodium bityo bigabanura umuvuduko wo kugabanuka k'umutima. Iyo ikoreshejwe mu gace runaka nk'ikintu gitera indwara, ubwonko bwo mu gace ntibushobora gutanga amakuru ku bwonko.
Lidocaine yavumbuwe mu 1946 itangira kugurishwa mu 1948. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cyo kugurisha ku bucuruzi mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere mu 2014 cyari hagati na 1.05 kuri buri gacupa ka mililitiro 20 k'umuti. Igurishwa munsi y'amazina menshi arimo Xylocaine. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 208 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni ebyiri.

Tizanidine, igurishwa ku mazina nka Zanaflex, ni umuti woroshya imitsi ukoreshwa mu kuvura imitsi ifunganye bitewe n'imvune y'umugongo cyangwa "multiple sclerosis". Ifatwa mu kanwa, kandi yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1996.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Tizanidine, igurishwa ku izina rya Zanaflex n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura imitsi idakora neza bitewe n'imvune y'umugongo cyangwa multiple sclerosis. Kugira ingaruka ku mikorere bisa nka baclofen cyangwa diazepam. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi n'uko ikora.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuma mu kanwa, gusinzira, gucika intege, no kuzerera. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo umuvuduko muke w'amaraso, ibibazo by'umwijima, indwara yo mu mutwe, no kwangirika k'umuvuduko wa QT. Ntabwo birasobanuka neza niba gukoresha imiti mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa ari nta kibazo. Ni agonisti ya α2-adrenergic kandi uburyo ikora ntibusobanutse neza.
Tizanidine yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1996. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ku kwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri 3.45 £ mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 4.20. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 89 watanzwe cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni icyenda.

Deksamethasoni ("dexamethasone") ni umuti wo mu bwoko bwa corticosteroid ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara nyinshi, zirimo rubagimpande, indwara z'uruhu, ubwivumbure bukomeye, asima n'indwara z'ibihaha. Yakozwe bwa mbere mu 1957, kandi iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Dexamethasone ni ubwoko bw'umuti wa corticosteroid. Ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara nyinshi, harimo ibibazo bya rubagimpande, indwara nyinshi z'uruhu, ubwivumbure bukomeye, asima, indwara idakira y'ibihaha, croup, kubyimba ubwonko, ububabare bw'amaso nyuma yo kubagwa amaso, ndetse n'imiti yica udukoko mu gituntu. Mu gihe imikorere y’uturemangingo tw’inkondo y’umura idafite ubushobozi bwo gukora neza, igomba gukoreshwa hamwe n’umuti ufite ingaruka nyinshi za mineralocorticoid nka fludrocortisone. Mu gihe cyo kubyara mbere y'igihe, ishobora gukoreshwa mu kunoza umusaruro w'umwana. Ishobora gufatwa mu kanwa, nk'urushinge mu mitsi, cyangwa ikayiterwa mu mitsi. Ingaruka za dexamethasone zikunze kugaragara mu munsi umwe kandi zimara iminsi itatu.
Ingaruka mbi n'uko ikora.
Kuyikoresha igihe kirekire bishobora gutera indwara y'imitsi, gutakaza amagufwa, indwara ya kataract, gukomereka byoroshye, cyangwa intege nke z'imitsi. Yakunze gukoreshwa mu kanwa mu gihe cyo gutwita kandi ntibyagaragaye ko itera ibibazo umwana. Ntibikwiye gufatwa mu gihe cyo konsa. Dexamethasone ifite ingaruka zo kurwanya ububyimbirwe no gukumira ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri.
Dexamethasone yakozwe bwa mbere mu 1957, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1961. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Dexamethasone ntabwo ihenze. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, imiti y'ukwezi igura munsi y'amadolari 25 y'Amerika. Mu Buhinde, uburyo bwo kuvura abana bavutse mbere y'igihe butwara hafi amadolari y'Amerika 0.5. Iraboneka mu bice byinshi by'isi. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 321 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni imwe.

Costochondritis (izwi kandi nka "chest wall pain syndrome") ni ububabare bwo mu gituza buturuka ku rukuta rw'igituza. Ubusanzwe iyi ndwara irashira uko igihe kigenda, nubwo ishobora kongera kugaruka; ivurwa ahanini n'imiti igabanya ububabare.
Costochondritis ni ububabare bwo mu gituza ku rukuta rw'igituza Ububabare muri rusange buboneka aho umuntu ari kandi bushobora kongera kugaruka binyuze mu gusunika aho hantu. Uduce twinshi tw’agatsi dushobora kuba turimo. Ububabare bushobora kwiyongera bitewe n'ingendo zimwe na zimwe no guhumeka cyane. Ububabare bushobora kuba bukabije cyangwa butoroshye. Ubusanzwe indwara ya Costochondritis irashira uko igihe kigenda, nubwo ishobora kongera kugaruka.
Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri isubiramo cyangwa inkorora ibanje. Gusuzuma indwara bikubiyemo gukuraho izindi ndwara zishobora kugaragara nk'izo zirimo: indwara y'umutima, angina, kuribwa mu gifu, umusonga, na embolism y'ibihaha. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi muri rusange ni ibisanzwe. Bikekwa ko uburyo bw'ibanze bwo kubyimba buterwa no kubyimba. Iyo habayeho kubyimba, iyo ndwara yitwa Tietze's syndrome, ijambo rishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bumwe ariko rigafatwa nk'indwara itandukanye.
Ubuvuzi n'ikwirakwira.
Kubabara mu gituza bifatwa nk'ikibazo cyihutirwa cy'ubuvuzi kugeza igihe indwara zishobora guteza akaga zizaba zitakiriho. Kuvura costochondritis bishobora kuba birimo kuruhuka, barafu n'ubushyuhe, parasetamol (acetaminophen), n'imiti igabanya ubushyuhe itari steroide (NSAIDs). Ibibazo bidakira bishobora gukemurwa hakoreshejwe physiotherapy cyangwa inshinge za steroid zo mu gace runaka. Costochondritis igaragara hagati ya 13 na 36% by'abantu bababara mu gatuza. Abana n'abantu bakuru bashobora kugerwaho n'ingaruka.

Opération Koundjoaré ni igikorwa cya gisirikare cya Togo cyatangiye ku wa 11 Nzeri 2018 mu Ntara ya Savanes, mu majyaruguru y'igihugu, kugira ngo gihangane n'imitwe y'abajihadi ituruka muri Sahel.
Kiyoborwa n'Ingabo za Togo, kigamije kurinda ubusugire bw'igihugu n'abaturage ku mipaka ya Burukina Faso na Bene.
Igikorwa cyashyizweho mu gihe umutekano wazambaga muri Sahel. Igitero gikomeye cyabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa 10 rishyira ku wa 11 Gicurasi 2022 i Kpinkankandi: abasirikare 8 barapfuye, abandi 13 barakomereka. Muri Gicurasi 2026, igikorwa cyari kiyobowe na Koloneli Latièmbé Kombate.
Mu Mutarama 2025, abasirikare baguye muri iki gikorwa bahawe icyubahiro i Lomé, bambikwa nyuma y'urupfu umudari wa "Ordre du Mono".

Tharcisse Sinzi ni Umunyarwanda warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, umwarimu wa karate akaba n'umwanditsi.
Azwiho kuba yarayoboye irwanaho ry'itsinda ry'Abatutsi ku musozi wa Songa, mu karere ka Butare, muri Mata 1994, no ku buhamya bwe bwasohotse mu gitabo "Combattre" yanditse afatanyije n'umunyamakuru w'Umufaransa Thomas Zribi.
Tharcisse Sinzi yavukiye mu muryango w'Abatutsi mu majyepfo y'Rwanda, mu karere ka Butare, mu gihe Abatutsi bakorerwaga ivangura. Se yamwise izina «Sinzi», bisobanura ko atazi ahazaza h'abana b'Abatutsi muri icyo gihe.
Nubwo yahuye n'ivangura mu kwinjira mu mashuri yisumbuye, yakomeje amashuri, nyuma aza gukora nk'umukozi wa laboratwari mu Kigo cy'Ubushakashatsi mu by'Ubuhinzi (ISAR) i Songa, mu yahoze ari komini Rusatira. Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1970 yatangiye gukina karate abitewe na mukuru we; yageze ku mukandara w'umukara n'amapeti yo hejuru ("dan"), aba umwe mu bazwi cyane muri uwo mukino mu Rwanda.
Jenoside itangiye muri Mata 1994, Sinzi yakoraga muri laboratwari ya ISAR Songa. Ku wa 13 Mata 1994, ubwo Interahamwe n'ingabo z'ubutegetsi bwariho zateraga Abatutsi bari bahungiye muri ako gace, yiyemeje gutegura irwanaho kugira ngo «badapfa batirwanaho».
Abaturage bo mu mudugudu we bamwiyungaho, bitwaje ibikoresho by'ubuhinzi, amabuye n'inkoni gusa. Yifashishije ubumenyi bwe muri karate, yashyize ku murongo irwanaho, akomeza ikinyabupfura n'icyizere cy'impunzi. Itsinda ryahungiye ku musozi wa Songa, aho Abatutsi ibihumbi baturutse ku misozi ikikije bahuriye. Nk'uko inkuru zasohotse zibivuga, abantu bagera ku 3 400 bahurira i Songa bayobowe na we. Ibitero byari kenshi kandi bikaze cyane iyo abajandarume bazaga bitwaje imbunda na gerenade. Nubwo hapfuye benshi, iryo rwanaho ryatumye abantu barenga ijana barokoka.
Sinzi yarokotse jenoside, ariko benshi mu bagize umuryango we barishwe. Yakomeje gukora muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda, ku cyicaro cya Huye, nk'ushinzwe serivisi z'inyubako ("Director of Estates"), anakomeza kwigisha karate.
Yatanze ubuhamya ahantu henshi: mu bihe byo Kwibuka, mu nama z'amashyirahamwe y'abarokotse, no mu Burayi, harimo ku Nzu Ndangamateka ya Shoah ("Mémorial de la Shoah") i Paris n'i Chambon-sur-Lignon mu Bufaransa.
Igitabo "Combattre".
Mu 2025, inzu y'ibitabo Tallandier yasohoye "Combattre. Récit d'un résistant face au génocide des Tutsi", yanditse afatanyije n'umunyamakuru akaba n'umuyobozi wa filime w'Umufaransa Thomas Zribi. Kivuga urugendo rwe kuva mu bwana bwaranzwe n'ivangura, kugeza ku irwanaho ryo mu 1994 no kwiyubaka nyuma ya jenoside, ndetse n'uburyo bwo kubaho nyuma yo kubura abe batari bake atagize urwango. Icyo gitabo cyabaye intandaro y'ibiganiro mbwirwaruhame ku kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, cyane cyane mu Bufaransa no mu Ububiligi.

Roméo Antonius Dallaire (yavutse ku wa 25 Kamena 1946 i Denekamp, mu Ubuholandi) ni umusirikare w'Umunyakanada wageze ku ipeti rya "lieutenant-général", akaba n'umunyapolitiki n'umwanditsi.
Azwi cyane kubera ko yari umuyobozi w'ingabo z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye zari mu butumwa bwa MINUAR mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Yagerageje gukangurira umuryango mpuzamahanga ibyaberaga mu Rwanda ariko ntiyumvwa. Ibyo yabonye yabyanditse mu gitabo "Shake Hands with the Devil" ("J'ai serré la main du diable").
Dallaire ni umuhungu wa Roméo Louis Dallaire, wari umusirikare wo mu ngabo za Kanada, na Catherine Vermaessen, umuforomokazi w'Umuholandi. Yageze muri Kanada afite amezi atandatu, mu Ukuboza 1946, akurira i Montréal.
Yinjiye mu ngabo za Kanada mu 1964, abona impamyabumenyi mu bumenyi ("baccalauréat") mu Ishuri rya Gisirikare rya Saint-Jean, aba umusirikare mukuru mu mutwe w'imbunda nini ("Artillerie royale canadienne").
Ubutumwa bwa MINUAR mu Rwanda.
Mu Ukwakira 1993, Dallaire yoherejwe mu Rwanda nk'umuyobozi w'ingabo za MINUAR, ubutumwa bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye bwari bugamije gufasha igihugu gushyiraho guverinoma y'inzibacyuho ishingiye ku masezerano ya Arusha.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, indege ye imaze guhanurwa ku wa 6 Mata 1994, abahezanguni b'Abahutu bari ku butegetsi, bifashishije Interahamwe n'icengezamatwara rya radiyo RTLM, batangiye kwica Abatutsi n'Abahutu batavugaga rumwe na bo. Dallaire yari ayoboye ingabo nke zifite intwaro zoroheje, kandi yari yarategetswe kudakoresha ingufu keretse mu kwirwanaho. Abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi bari bashinzwe kurinda Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana bishwe n'ingabo zirinda Perezida (Urwibutso rw'Abasirikare b'Ababiligi); nyuma yaho Ububiligi bwakuyeho ingabo zabwo, MINUAR iracika intege. Mu minsi ijana, abantu hafi 800 000 barishwe.
Raporo y'impuguke z'Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Afurika (OUA) yashimye ibikorwa bya Dallaire. Ariko yanenzwe na bamwe, barimo umunyamakuru Robin Philpot, ndetse no mu Bubiligi ku byerekeye urupfu rw'abasirikare b'Ababiligi.
Agarutse muri Kanada, yahawe imyanya ikomeye mu ngabo z'igihugu. Kuva yava mu Rwanda arwaye ihungabana ("trouble de stress post-traumatique"), ibyo byatumye ava mu ngabo ku wa 22 Mata 2000 kubera impamvu z'ubuzima. Mu 2003 yagize ati: «Abantu ibihumbi magana inani bapfuye mu mpeshyi ya 1994, kandi nta n'umwe wagize icyo akora.»
Mu 2003 yasohoye igitabo "Shake Hands with the Devil: The Failure of Humanity in Rwanda", cyamuhesheje igihembo cya Guverineri Mukuru wa Kanada mu 2004. Muri Mata 2004, yatanze ubuhamya imbere y'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR) mu rubanza rwa Koloneli Théoneste Bagosora.
Ku wa 25 Werurwe 2005, Minisitiri w'Intebe Paul Martin yamushyize muri Sena ya Kanada, aho yicaye nk'umunyamuryango w'ishyaka ry'Aba-Libéraux. Yavuye muri Sena ku wa 17 Kamena 2014, kugira ngo yite ku bikorwa birwanya ikoreshwa ry'abana mu ntambara, ku basirikare bakomeretse no ku kwibuka imyaka 20 ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ibihembo no mu buhanzi.
Dallaire ni "officier" w'Iteka rya Kanada ("Ordre du Canada"), "commandeur" w'Iteka ry'Ubutwari bwa Gisirikare, na "grand officier" w'Iteka ry'Igihugu rya Québec.
Inkuru ye yakozwemo filime: "Hotel Rwanda" (2004), aho umukinnyi Nick Nolte akina umuntu ushingiye kuri we; filime mbarankuru "Shake Hands with the Devil: The Journey of Roméo Dallaire" (2004); na filime "Shake Hands with the Devil" (2007) yafatiwe i Kigali, aho Roy Dupuis akina uruhare rwe.

Kaminuza Divina Gloria ya Butembo (mu Igifaransa: "Université Divina Gloria de Butembo", impine: UDGB) ni ishuri rikuru na kaminuza byigenga biri i Butembo, mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2000, kandi yemewe na Minisiteri y'amashuri makuru na kaminuza.
UDGB yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 2000, ikaba yemewe na Minisiteri y'amashuri makuru na kaminuza ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Iri mu mujyi wa Butembo, umwe mu mijyi ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru ufite kaminuza nyinshi.
UDGB iyoborwa n'umuyobozi mukuru ("recteur") Mathieu Kirongozi Bometa, yungirijwe n'umuyobozi wungirije ("vice-recteur") ushinzwe ubuyobozi, Kakule Mumbere Kasindi.
Kaminuza ifite amashami arindwi:
Amasomo yigishwa mu Igifaransa. Kwinjira bisaba impamyabumenyi ya Leta ("diplôme d'État") isoza amashuri yisumbuye. Umwaka w'amashuri utangira mu Ukwakira ukarangira muri Kamena, ukagabanywamo ibihembwe bibiri (Ukwakira–Gashyantare na Werurwe–Kamena). Kaminuza itanga impamyabumenyi za "graduat" na "licence", cyane cyane mu ikoranabuhanga mu icungamutungo, mu mitekerereze ya muntu no muri tewolojiya. Yakira abanyeshuri b'abahungu n'abakobwa.
Ubuzima bwa kaminuza.
UDGB yakira ibikorwa byo gukangurira no guhugura abanyeshuri. Urugero, mu mwaka wa 2024, umuryango MAARIFA GLOBAL wahakoreye ikiganiro ku kamaro ko gukoresha ibicuruzwa bikorerwa iwabo, nk'uko wabikoze no mu zindi kaminuza za Butembo.

Kubura ibitotsi ("insomnia") ni indwara aho umuntu agira ingorane zo gufatwa n'ibitotsi cyangwa zo gukomeza gusinzira. Ikurikirwa no gusinzira ku manywa, imbaraga nke, kurakara n'agahinda.
Ishobora kubaho yonyine cyangwa igaterwa n'izindi ndwara, imiti cyangwa ibiyobyabwenge. Ivurwa mbere na mbere n'isuku y'ibitotsi no guhindura imibereho; ifata hagati ya 10% na 30% by'abantu bakuru.
Kubura ibitotsi ni indwara aho abantu bagira ikibazo cyo gusinzira. Bashobora kugira ingorane zo gufatwa n'ibitotsi, cyangwa zo gukomeza gusinzira igihe cyose babyifuza. Kubura ibitotsi bikunze gukurikirwa no gusinzira ku manywa, imbaraga nke, kurakara cyane, no kwiheba. Bishobora gutera ibyago byinshi byo impanuka z'ibinyabiziga, ndetse n'ibibazo byo kwibanda no kwiga. Kubura ibitotsi bishobora kumara igihe gito, bikamara iminsi cyangwa ibyumweru, cyangwa igihe kirekire, bikamara igihe kirenga ukwezi.
Kubura ibitotsi bishobora kubaho ku giti cyabyo cyangwa bigaterwa n'ikindi kibazo. Ibintu bishobora gutera kudasinzira birimo imihangayiko yo mu mutwe, ububabare budakira, kunanirwa k'umutima, hyperthyroidism, ikirungurira, indwara y'amaguru adatuza ("restless legs syndrome"), gucura, imiti imwe n'imwe, n'ibiyobyabwenge nka kafeyine, nikotine na alukolo. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera ibyago zirimo gukora akazi nijoro no guhumeka nabi mu gihe umuntu asinziriye.
Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku ngeso zo gusinzira no gusuzuma kugira ngo harebwe impamvu zibitera. Inyigo y'ibitotsi ishobora gukorwa kugira ngo harebwe ibibazo by'ibitotsi byihishe inyuma. Gusuzuma bishobora gukorwa hifashishijwe ibibazo bibiri: "ese uhura n'ingorane zo gusinzira?" na "ese uhura n'ingorane zo gufatwa n'ibitotsi cyangwa gukomeza gusinzira?"
Isuku y'ibitotsi no guhindura imibereho ni bwo buryo bwa mbere bwo kuvura indwara yo kudasinzira. Isuku yo gusinzira ikubiyemo kuryama buri gihe, kwishyira ku zuba ryinshi, icyumba gituje kandi cyijimye, no gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri ihoraho. Ubuvuzi bushingiye ku mitekerereze n'imyitwarire ("CBT") bushobora kongerwa kuri ibi. Nubwo ibinini bisinziriza bishobora gufasha, bifitanye isano n'impanuka zitera imvune, indwara yo kwibagirwa ("dementia") no kuba imbata yabyo. Iyi miti ntisabwa gukoreshwa mu gihe kirenze ibyumweru bine cyangwa bitanu. Akamaro n'umutekano by'ubuvuzi bw'ubundi buryo ntibirasobanuka neza.
Hagati ya 10% na 30% by'abantu bakuru bagira ikibazo cyo kudasinzira mu gihe runaka, naho abagera kuri kimwe cya kabiri cy'abantu bagira ikibazo cyo kudasinzira mu mwaka runaka. Abantu bagera kuri 6% bafite ikibazo cyo kubura ibitotsi kitatewe n'ikindi kibazo kandi kimara igihe kirenga ukwezi. Abantu barengeje imyaka 65 ni bo bibasirwa cyane kurusha abakiri bato. Abagore ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagabo.
Ibisobanuro by'indwara yo kudasinzira bigaragara nibura mu Ubugereki bwa kera.

Naloxone, igurishwa ku mazina nka Narcan, ni umuti uhagarika ingaruka za opioid nka morphine cyangwa heroyine. Ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu gutabara abantu bafashe opioid nyinshi, ubuhumekero bwabo bukagabanuka.
Iterwa mu mitsi, mu nyama cyangwa mu mazuru, kandi ikora mu minota mike. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rwa OMS kandi iboneka nk'umuti rusange.
Naloxone ni umuti ukoreshwa mu guhagarika ingaruka za opioid. Ikunze gukoreshwa mu kurwanya kugabanuka k'ubuhumekero mu gihe umuntu yafashe opioid nyinshi ("overdose"). Naloxone ishobora kandi kuvangwa na opioid (mu kinini kimwe), kugira ngo igabanye ibyago byo gukoresha nabi opioid. Iyo itewe mu mutsi w'amaraso, ingaruka zitangira mu minota ibiri, naho iyo itewe mu nyama zitangira mu minota itanu. Indi nzira ishobora gutangwa ni ukuyitera mu mazuru y'umuntu. Ingaruka za naloxone zimara hagati y'igice cy'isaha n'isaha imwe. Hashobora kuba ngombwa gukoresha doze nyinshi, kuko igihe cy'imikorere ya opioid nyinshi kiruta icya naloxone.
Kuyiha abantu babaswe na opioid bishobora gutera ibimenyetso byo guhagarika opioid, harimo kubura umutuzo, guhagarika umutima, isesemi, kuruka, umutima utera cyane, no kubira ibyuya. Kugira ngo hirindwe ibi, doze ntoya buri minota mike zishobora gutangwa kugeza igihe umusaruro wifuza ugezweho. Ku bantu bahoze bafite indwara z'umutima cyangwa bafata imiti igira ingaruka mbi ku mutima, habayeho ibindi bibazo by'umutima. Bigaragara ko nta kibazo iteza ku bagore batwite, nubwo yahawe umubare muto wabo.
Naloxone ni umuti urwanya ("antagonist") imyakiriro ya opioid utarobanura. Ikora mu gusubiza inyuma ihungabana ry'urwungano rw'imyakura rwo hagati n'urw'ubuhumekero riterwa na opioid.
Naloxone yahawe ipatanti mu 1961, yemererwa kuvura abafashe opioid nyinshi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 1971. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS).
Naloxone iraboneka nk'umuti rusange ("generic"). Igiciro cyayo mu bucuruzi bwinshi mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati ya $0.50 na $5.30 kuri doze. Uducupa twa naloxone ntabwo duhenze cyane (munsi y'amadolari 25) muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Mu 2020, igiciro cy'ipaki y'inshinge ebyiri zikoresha ubwazo ("auto-injectors") muri Amerika cyari $178. Igiciro cya 2018 cya NHS mu Ubwongereza ni hafi £5 kuri doze. Muri Ositaraliya, doze imwe iboneka nta rupapuro rwa muganga, kandi igura AU$20; abafite dose eshanu bashobora kuzigura AU$40, zingana n'amadolari umunani kuri doze imwe.

Osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), izwi kandi nka indwara y'amagufwa acika intege, ni itsinda ry'indwara z'uruhererekane zituma amagufwa avunika byoroshye. Ishobora kandi gutera amaso afite ibara ry'ubururu, uburebure bugufi no kutumva neza.
Ahanini iterwa no kubura kolajeni yo mu bwoko bwa I. Nta muti uyikiza uhari, ariko ubuvuzi bufasha kwirinda no kuvura amavunika; ifata umuntu umwe ku bantu 15.000.
Osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) ni itsinda ry'indwara ziterwa n'uturemangingo zifata cyane cyane amagufwa. Bituma amagufwa avunika byoroshye. Ubukana bwayo bushobora kuba buke cyangwa bukabije. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo ibara ry'ubururu mu gice cyera cy'amaso ("sclera"), uburebure bugufi, ingingo zirekuye cyane, kutumva neza, ibibazo byo guhumeka n'ibibazo by'amenyo. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo gucikamo kw'imitsi y'amaraso yo mu ijosi no kw'umutsi munini w'amaraso ("aorta").
Ikibazo cy'ibanze akenshi ni icy'uturemangingo dufatanya umubiri ("connective tissue") bitewe no kubura kolajeni yo mu bwoko bwa I. Ibi bibaho mu bantu barenga 90% bitewe n’impinduka mu miterere ya za jeni za "COL1A1" cyangwa "COL1A2". Ibi bibazo by’uturemangingo akenshi biragwa n’ababyeyi b’umuntu mu buryo busanzwe cyangwa bigaterwa n’impinduka nshya. Hari nibura ubwoko umunani bw'ingenzi, aho ubwoko bwa mbere ari bwo bworoheje cyane naho ubwoko bwa kabiri bukaba ari bwo bukabije cyane.
Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku bimenyetso kandi bishobora kwemezwa hakoreshejwe isuzuma rya kolajeni cyangwa irya ADN.
Nta muti uhari. Kugira ubuzima bwiza, hakorwa imyitozo ngororamubiri kandi hirindwa kunywa itabi, bishobora gufasha mu kwirinda kuvunika. Ubuvuzi bushobora kuba burimo kwita ku magufwa yavunitse, imiti igabanya ububabare, ubuvuzi bw'umubiri, ibyuma bifasha amaguru ("braces") cyangwa amagare y'abafite ubumuga ndetse no kubagwa. Ubwoko bw'ubuganga bushyira inkoni z'icyuma mu magufwa maremare bushobora gukorwa kugira ngo ayakomeze. Hari ibimenyetso bike bishyigikira ikoreshwa ry'imiti yo mu bwoko bwa bisphosphonate.
OI igira ingaruka ku muntu umwe kuri 15.000. Uko indwara izagenda biterwa n'ubwoko bwayo, ariko abantu benshi bagira ubuzima bwiza.
Iyi ndwara yasobanuwe kuva mu bihe bya kera. Ijambo "osteogenesis imperfecta" ryatangiye gukoreshwa mu 1895 kandi risobanura irema ry'amagufwa ridatunganye.

Gonorrhea, izwi kandi nka clap, ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina iterwa na bagiteri ya "Neisseria gonorrhoeae". Ishobora gutera ububabare iyo umuntu anyara no gusohora ibintu mu gitsina, ariko benshi mu bayirwaye nta bimenyetso bagira.
Yirindwa hakoreshejwe agakingirizo kandi ivurwa n'imiti ya antibiyotike, nubwo bagiteri zitangiye kwihanganira imiti imwe n'imwe.
Gonorrhea ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (STI) iterwa na bagiteri ya "Neisseria gonorrhoeae". Kwandura bishobora kuba mu myanya ndangagitsina, mu kanwa no mu kibuno. Abagabo banduye bashobora kumva ububabare cyangwa ubushye iyo banyara, gusohora ibintu mu gitsina cyangwa kubabara mu mabya. Abagore banduye bashobora kumva ubushye iyo banyara, gusohora ibintu mu gitsina, kuva amaraso mu gitsina hagati y’imihango, cyangwa kubabara mu nda yo hasi. Ingorane ku bagore zirimo ububyimbirwe bw'imyanya yo mu nda yo hasi ("pelvic inflammatory disease") naho ku bagabo zirimo kubyimba kwa "epididymis". Nyamara, benshi mu banduye nta bimenyetso bafite. Iyo idavuwe, gonorrhea ishobora gukwirakwira mu ngingo cyangwa mu dupfundikizo tw'umutima.
Gonorrhea yandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina n'umuntu wanduye. Ibi birimo imibonano mpuzabitsina yo mu kanwa, mu kibuno no mu gitsina. Ishobora kandi gukwirakwira kuva ku mubyeyi kugera ku mwana mu gihe cyo kubyara.
Isuzuma rikorwa hapimwa inkari, umuyoboro w'inkari ("urethra") ku bagabo, cyangwa inkondo y'umura ku bagore. Gupima abagore bose bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina kandi bari munsi y'imyaka 25 buri mwaka kimwe n'abafite abo baryamana bashya birasabwa; inama imwe irakurikizwa no ku bagabo bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina n'abagabo (MSM).
Indwara ya Gonorrhea ishobora kwirindwa hakoreshejwe agakingirizo, imibonano mpuzabitsina n'umuntu umwe gusa utarandura, ndetse no kudakora imibonano mpuzabitsina.
Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe ceftriaxone iterwa mu rushinge na azithromycin inyobwa. Bagiteri zatangiye kwihanganira imiti myinshi ya antibiyotike yakoreshejwe mbere kandi rimwe na rimwe hakenerwa doze nyinshi ya ceftriaxone. Gusubiramo ibizamini ni byiza amezi atatu nyuma yo kuvurwa. Abo umurwayi yaryamanye na bo mu mezi abiri ashize nabo bagomba kuvurwa.
Indwara ya Gonorrhea yibasira hafi 0.8% by'abagore na 0.6% by'abagabo. Buri mwaka, abantu bari hagati ya miliyoni 33 na 106 bandura gonorrhea, mu bantu miliyoni 498 z’abantu bandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina zivurwa – harimo na syphilis, chlamydia, na trichomoniasis. Kwandura indwara mu bagore akenshi bibaho iyo bakiri bato. Mu 2015, byateje impfu zigera kuri 700.
Ibisobanuro by'iyi ndwara bigaragara kuva mu Isezerano rya Kera. Izina ry'ubu ryakoreshejwe bwa mbere n'umuganga w'Umugereki Galen mbere y'umwaka wa 200, wayise "gutakaza intanga bitifuzwa".

Hepatite C ni indwara iterwa na virusi ya hepatite C (HCV) yibasira cyane cyane umwijima. Akenshi nta bimenyetso igaragaza mu ntangiriro, ariko uko imyaka ishira ishobora gutera cirrhose, kunanirwa k'umwijima cyangwa kanseri y'umwijima.
Yandurira ahanini mu guhura kw'amaraso. Nta rukingo rwayo ruhari, ariko imiti mishya ikiza abarenga 95% by'abarwayi; ku isi hari abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 71 bayirwaye.
Hepatite C ni indwara yandura iterwa na virusi ya hepatite C (HCV) yibasira cyane cyane umwijima. Mu gihe cyo kwandura bwa mbere abantu bakunze kugira ibimenyetso byoroheje cyangwa ntibagire ibimenyetso na bimwe. Rimwe na rimwe haboneka umuriro, inkari zijimye, ububabare bwo mu nda n'uruhu ruhinduka umuhondo. Iyi virusi ikomeza mu mwijima ku bantu bagera kuri 75% kugeza kuri 85% by'abanduye bwa mbere. Ubwandu budakira akenshi nta bimenyetso bugira mu ntangiriro. Ariko uko imyaka ishira, akenshi bitera indwara z'umwijima ndetse rimwe na rimwe na cirrhose. Mu bihe bimwe na bimwe, abafite cirrhose bazahura n'ingorane zikomeye nko kunanirwa k'umwijima, kanseri y'umwijima, cyangwa imiyoboro y'amaraso yagutse mu muhogo no mu gifu.
HCV yandurira cyane cyane mu guhura kw'amaraso, nko mu gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge biterwa mu mitsi, ibikoresho byo kwa muganga bidasukuye neza, imvune zo guterwa n'inshinge mu buvuzi, no guterwa amaraso. Aho amaraso atangwa apimwa, ibyago byo kwandura binyuze mu guterwa amaraso biri munsi ya kimwe kuri miliyoni ebyiri. Ishobora kandi gukwirakwira kuva ku mubyeyi wanduye kugeza ku mwana we mu gihe cyo kuvuka. Ntikwirakwira binyuze mu gukoranaho bisanzwe. Ni imwe muri virusi eshanu zizwi za hepatite: A, B, C, D, na E.
Isuzuma rikorwa hapimwa amaraso, harebwa abasirikare b'umubiri ("antibodies") barwanya virusi cyangwa RNA yayo. Birasabwa gupima abantu bose bafite ibyago byo kuyandura.
Nta rukingo rwa Hepatite C ruhari. Kwirinda birimo ingamba zo kugabanya ingaruka mbi ku bantu bakoresha ibiyobyabwenge biterwa mu mitsi no gupima amaraso yatanzwe.
Ubwandu budakira bushobora gukira ku barenga 95% hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi nka sofosbuvir cyangwa simeprevir. Peginterferon na ribavirin ni uburyo bwo kuvura bwakozwe mbere bwari bufite igipimo cyo gukira kiri munsi ya 50% kandi ingaruka mbi zikaba nyinshi. Ariko kubona uburyo bushya bwo kuvura bishobora kuba bihenze. Abarwaye cirrhose cyangwa kanseri y'umwijima bashobora gukenera guhindurirwa umwijima. Hepatite C ni imwe mu mpamvu nyamukuru zituma abantu bahindurirwa umwijima, nubwo virusi ikunze kugaruka nyuma yaho.
Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 71 (1%) ku isi yose bari barwaye hepatite C mu 2017. Mu 2013, habayeho abarwayi bashya bagera kuri miliyoni cumi n'imwe. Bikunze kugaragara cyane muri Afurika no muri Aziya yo Hagati n'iy'Iburasirazuba. Impfu zigera ku 167.000 ziturutse kuri kanseri y'umwijima n'impfu 326.000 ziturutse kuri cirrhose zatewe na hepatite C mu 2015.
Kuba hariho indwara ya hepatite C – yashoboraga kumenyekana gusa nk’ubwoko bw’indwara ya hepatite itari A itari B – byagaragajwe mu myaka ya 1970 kandi byemejwe mu 1989. Virusi ya hepatite C yandura abantu n'impundu gusa.

Midazolam, igurishwa ku mazina nka Versed, ni umuti wo mu bwoko bwa benzodiazepine ukoreshwa mu gutera ikinya, guturisha umurwayi, kuvura ingorane zo gusinzira n'ibitero by'igicuri.
Itera gusinzira, igabanya imihangayiko kandi ishobora gutera kwibagirwa ibibaye. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rwa OMS kandi ntihenze.
Midazolam ni umuti wo mu bwoko bwa benzodiazepine ukoreshwa mu gutera ikinya, guturisha umurwayi mu gihe cy'ibikorwa by'ubuvuzi, kuvura ingorane zo gusinzira no guhagarika umutima gukabije. Ikora mu gutera gusinzira, kugabanya imihangayiko, no gutuma umuntu atabasha kubika ibyibukwa bishya. Ni ingirakamaro kandi mu kuvura ibitero by'igicuri ("seizures"). Midazolam ishobora gutangwa mu kanwa, mu mutsi w'amaraso, mu rushinge mu nyama, mu mazuru cyangwa mu itama. Iyo itewe mu mutsi w'amaraso, akenshi itangira gukora mu minota itanu; iyo itewe mu nyama, bishobora gufata iminota cumi n'itanu kugira ngo itangire gukora. Ingaruka zimara hagati y'isaha imwe n'esheshatu.
Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kugabanuka k'imbaraga zo guhumeka, umuvuduko w'amaraso ugabanuka, no gusinzira. Umubiri ushobora kumenyera ingaruka zayo, kandi ibimenyetso byo kuyireka bishobora kubaho nyuma yo kuyikoresha igihe kirekire. Ingaruka zidasanzwe, nko kongera ibikorwa, zishobora kubaho cyane cyane ku bana no ku bantu bakuze. Hari ibimenyetso byerekana ibyago iyo bikoreshejwe mu gihe cyo gutwita ariko nta bimenyetso byerekana ingaruka mbi iyo hakoreshejwe doze imwe mu gihe cyo konsa.
Iri mu bwoko bwa benzodiazepine bw'imiti kandi ikora mu kongera imikorere ya neurotransmitter ya GABA mu ubwonko.
Midazolam yahawe ipatanti mu 1974, itangira gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1982. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS) nk'umuti usimbura lorazepam.
Igiciro n'amategeko.
Iraboneka nk'umuti rusange ("generic") kandi ntabwo ihenze cyane. Igiciro cy'agacupa mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere ni hafi 0.35$. Mu bihugu byinshi, ni umuti ugenzurwa n'amategeko.

Adenomyose ("adenomyosis") ni indwara y'abagore aho urukuta rw'imbere rwa nyababyeyi rukurira mu rukuta rw'imitsi yayo. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi ni ukubabara mu gihe cy'imihango no kuva amaraso menshi, nubwo hari abatagira ibimenyetso.
Ishobora gutera ubugumba kandi ikunze kujyana na endometriosis. Ivurwa n'imiti igabanya ububabare, imisemburo cyangwa kubagwa; yibasira hagati ya 20% na 35% by'abagore.
Adenomyose ("adenomyosis") ni indwara aho uturemangingo tw'urukuta rw'imbere rwa nyababyeyi ("endometrium") dukurira mu rukuta rw'imitsi ya nyababyeyi ("myometrium"). Ibimenyetso akenshi birimo kubabara mu gihe cy'imihango no kuva amaraso menshi mu mihango; ariko hari abarwayi batagira ibimenyetso. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo ububabare budakira mu nda yo hasi no kubabara mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo ubugumba, kandi akenshi ijyana na endometriosis.
Impamvu ntirasobanuka neza. Ibintu byongera ibyago birimo umubyibuho ukabije, ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro, kubagwa babyara ("césarienne"), gutwita mbere, no gukorerwa "curetage". Uburyo iterwa bushobora kuba bujyanye no gukomereka no gusanwa kw'aho endometrium ihurira na myometrium, cyangwa n'ibisigazwa by'imiyoboro ya Müller.
Indwara ikekwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso kandi ryemezwa hakoreshejwe ultrasound, MRI, cyangwa biopsy. Ishobora gufata agace gato cyangwa kanini ka nyababyeyi. Akenshi nyababyeyi irabyimba; nubwo atari kanseri.
Ibimenyetso bishobora kugabanywa n'imiti igabanya ububabare n'ububyimbirwe (NSAIDs), ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro, agapira ko mu mura (IUD) karimo imisemburo, cyangwa danazol. Ibikorwa by'ubuvuzi bishobora gufasha birimo gufunga imitsi y'amaraso igaburira nyababyeyi ("uterine artery embolization"), gutwika urukuta rw'imbere rwa nyababyeyi ("endometrial ablation") no kubagwa ("myomectomy"). Ku badashaka abandi bana, bashobora kubagwa bagakurwamo nyababyeyi ("hysterectomy").
Adenomyosis ivugwa ko yibasira hagati ya 20% na 35% by'abagore. Bikunze kugaragara cyane ku bagore bari mu myaka ya nyuma yo kubyara, kandi akenshi isuzumwa ku bafite imyaka 40 kuzamura.
Carl von Rokitansky, inzobere mu isuzuma ry'indwara ("pathologist") wakoreraga mu bihugu bivuga Ikidage, yasobanuye bwa mbere iyi ndwara mu 1860. Iri jambo rikomoka kuri "adenos" risobanura "gland" (urugingo rukora amatembabuzi), "myo" risobanura imitsi, naho "osis" risobanura indwara.

Kantano Habimana (wapfuye ahagana mu 1998-2002), bakunze kwita Kantano, yari umunyamakuru ("animateur") kuri radiyo yo mu Rwanda RTLM, yagize uruhare runini mu guteza imbere jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Kimwe n'abandi banyamakuru b'iyi radiyo, Habimana yashishikarije urugomo rw'Abatutsi n'Abahutu batavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi mu buryo busanzwe.
Ubuzima bwo hambere.
Itariki y’amavuko ya Habimana n’ibindi bisobanuro birambuye ku buzima bwe bwo hambere, mbere yo kwinjira muri RTLM, ntibizwi neza. Icyakora, amakuru ahari agaragaza ko yize itangazamakuru i Leningrad, umujyi ubu witwa Saint Petersburg, mu cyahoze ari Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyeti, aho yakuye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza (Masters). Nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo ye, yakoze mu binyamakuru byo mu Rwanda birimo "Imvaho" na "Umurwanashyaka".
Umukinnyi wa RTLM ukunzwe cyane mu bijyanye n'igihe cyo gutangaza amakuru, yakunze gukururwa n'uko "yakundaga gukoresha ikoranabuhanga risekeje kandi ritangaje". Mu gihe yamaze kuri radiyo, yamenyekanye kubera ubwiza bwe n'urwenya, kandi yamenyekanye kubera kuvuga cyane "nk'aho abantu bari imbere ye", ibyo bikaba byari byiza mu gukurura ibitekerezo byabo.
Habimana akunze kwitwa "animateur" ikunzwe cyane ya RTLM ndetse n"'animateur" ifite umwanya munini wo kureba amashusho, aho ibice bye byagize hafi 33% by'ibiganiro bya radiyo. Mu by’ukuri, mu bushakashatsi bumwe bwakozwe ku byerekeye abantu bwakozwe binyuze mu bushakashatsi bwakorewe mu Rwanda, Abahutu n’Abatutsi babajijwe bavuze ko yari azwiho ubuhanga bwe mu kuvuga.
Mbere ya jenoside, Habimana yafataga umurongo uciriritse ku bibazo by’ivanguramoko kurusha abayoboke benshi ba Hutu Power. Urugero, mu Ukuboza 1993, Habimana yavuze ibi bikurikira ubwo yari kuri radiyo:"Si Abatutsi bose ari babi; bamwe muri bo ni babi. Si Abahutu bose ari beza, abandi ni babi. Mu moko, hari bamwe ari babi... Ibi bigaragaza ko kamere muntu ikomeje kuba imwe mu moko yose yo mu Rwanda, mu bagabo bose bo mu Rwanda. Ariko se ni nde muntu wishyize mu mutwe we ko RTLM yanga Abatutsi?"
Ariko, mu gihe cya jenoside, Habimana yatangazaga aho aherereye neza, amazina na nimero za plaque by’abaregwaga kuba ibyitso bya FPR, yashishikarizaga urugomo rwibasiwe ndetse akenshi n’ubwicanyi ku bantu bavuzwe n’imitwe nka Impuzamugambi n’Interahamwe. Habimana yahaye abari aho inama ku buryo bwo kumenya Abatutsi, avuga ko uburebure bw'umuntu n'uko agaragara bishobora kugaragaza niba ari Abatutsi. Habimana yategetse abari bamuteze amatwi "[kureba] uburebure bw'umuntu n'uko asa... Reba izuru rye rito hanyuma urimene".
Ubuzima nyuma ya jenoside n'urupfu rwatangajwe.
Mu rubanza rwabereye mu rukiko mbere ya jenoside ku ya 15 Werurwe 1994, kubera "gushishikariza abaturage kwiyemerera", Habimana yavuze ko abatangazamakuru ba RTLM ari "abantu bato" ugereranije n'abayobozi ba RTLM nka Ferdinand Nahimana, bityo bakaba nta ruhare bagize muri jenoside.
Bivugwa ko Habimana yazize SIDA muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo hagati ya 1998 na 2002.

Rumatisime ya rubagimpande ("rheumatoid arthritis", RA) ni indwara idakira aho ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwibasira ingingo, cyane cyane iz'ibiganza n'intoki, zigashyuha, zikabyimba kandi zikababaza.
Impamvu yayo ntizwi neza. Nta muti uyikiza, ariko imiti nka DMARDs ifasha kugabanya ukwiyongera kwayo; yibasira hagati ya 0.5% na 1% by'abantu bakuru mu bihugu byateye imbere, abagore kurusha abagabo.
Rumatisime ya rubagimpande (RA) ni indwara idakira aho ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwibasira umubiri ubwawo, igafata cyane cyane ingingo. Akenshi bitera ingingo zishyushye, zibyimba kandi zibabaza. Ububabare no kugagara kw'ingingo bikunze kwiyongera nyuma yo kuruhuka. Akenshi ifata ingingo z'ikiganza n'iz'intoki, kandi ingingo zimwe zifatwa ku mpande zombi z'umubiri. Iyi ndwara ishobora no gufata ibindi bice by'umubiri. Ibi bishobora gutuma amaraso aba make, ububyimbirwe hafi y'ibihaha n'ububyimbirwe hafi y'umutima. Umuriro n'imbaraga nke bishobora kuba biriho. Akenshi, ibimenyetso biza buhoro buhoro mu gihe cy'ibyumweru cyangwa amezi.
Nubwo impamvu itera rubagimpande itazwi neza, bikekwa ko iterwa n’uruvange rw’ibintu bigize imiterere y’umubiri n’ibidukikije. Uburyo ikora ni uko ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwibasira ingingo. Ibi bitera ububyimbirwe no kubyibuha k'uruhu rupfunyika urugingo ("joint capsule"). Bigira ingaruka kandi ku magufwa no ku ruhenengeri rw'ingingo ("cartilage").
Isuzuma rikorwa ahanini hashingiwe ku bimenyetso umuntu agaragaza n'ibyo muganga abona amusuzuma. Amafoto y'imirasire ya X n'ibizamini byo muri laboratwari bishobora gushyigikira isuzuma cyangwa gufasha gutandukanya iyi ndwara n'izindi zifite ibimenyetso bisa. Izindi ndwara zishobora kugaragara nk'izo zirimo lupus erythematosus, psoriatic arthritis, na fibromyalgia n'izindi.
Intego zo kuvura ni ukugabanya ububabare, kugabanya ububyimbirwe, no kunoza imikorere y'umuntu muri rusange. Ibi bishobora gufashwa no kuringaniza ikiruhuko n'imyitozo ngororamubiri, gukoresha ibyuma n'ibipfuko bifata ingingo ("splints", "braces"), cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bifasha umuntu. Imiti igabanya ububabare, steroïdes na NSAIDs ikunze gukoreshwa mu gufasha ibimenyetso. Imiti ihindura imigendekere y'indwara ("DMARDs"), nka hydroxychloroquine na methotrexate, ishobora gukoreshwa mu kugerageza kugabanya ukwiyongera kw'indwara. Imiti ya DMARD y’ibinyabuzima ishobora gukoreshwa iyo indwara itavurwa n'indi miti. Ariko, bishobora kugira ingaruka mbi nyinshi. Kubagwa kugira ngo ingingo zisanwe, zisimburwe cyangwa zifatanywe bishobora gufasha mu bihe bimwe na bimwe. Uburyo bwinshi bw'ubuvuzi busimbura ("alternative medicine") ntibushyigikiwe n'ibimenyetso.
Mu 2015, RA yibasiraga abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 24.5. Ibi biri hagati ya 0.5 na 1% by'abantu bakuru mu bihugu byateye imbere, aho 5 na 50 kuri 100.000 batangira kurwara iyi ndwara buri mwaka. Indwara akenshi itangira mu myaka yo hagati y'ubuzima kandi abagore bayirwara inshuro 2.5 kurusha abagabo. Yateje impfu 38.000 mu 2013, zivuye ku 28.000 mu 1990.
Ibisobanuro bya mbere bya RA byatanzwe mu 1800 na Augustin Jacob Landré-Beauvais (1772–1840) wo i Paris. Izina "rheumatoid arthritis" rikomoka mu kigereki, risobanura ingingo zifite amazi kandi zibyimbye.

Mupirocin, igurishwa ku mazina nka Bactroban, ni antibiyotike isigwa ku ruhu ivura indwara z'uruhu ziterwa na bagiteri, nka impetigo, ikanakoreshwa mu gukura MRSA mu mazuru.
Ikora ibuza bagiteri gukora poroteyine. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rwa OMS kandi ntihenze.
Mupirocin ni antibiyotike isigwa ku ruhu, ivura indwara z'uruhu nk'impetigo cyangwa folliculitis. Ishobora kandi gukoreshwa mu gukuraho "Staphylococcus aureus" itavurwa na methicillin (MRSA) iri mu mazuru ariko idatera ibimenyetso. Kubera impungenge z'uko bagiteri zayimenyera ("resistance"), kuyikoresha mu gihe kirenze iminsi icumi ntibisabwa. Ikoreshwa nk'amavuta ("cream" cyangwa "ointment") asigwa ku ruhu.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuryaryata n'uduheri aho yasizwe, kurwara umutwe n'isesemi. Kuyikoresha igihe kirekire bishobora gutuma ibihumyo byiyongera. Kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa bigaragara ko nta kibazo biteza.
Mupirocin iri mu miti yo mu bwoko bwa aside karubokisilike. Ikora mu kubuza ubushobozi bwa bagiteri bwo gukora poroteyine, ibi bikaba bikunze gutuma bagiteri ipfa.
Mupirocin yavanywe bwa mbere muri bagiteri "Pseudomonas fluorescens" mu 1971. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS).
Igiciro cyo kugurisha mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere ni hafi $2.10 ku gacupa ("tube") ka garama 15. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, umuti w'ubuvuzi bwose ugura hagati y’amadolari 25 na 50. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 186 mu yandikwa kenshi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni eshatu.

Ezetimibe, igurishwa ku mazina nka Zetia, ni umuti unyobwa ukoreshwa mu kugabanya cholesterol nyinshi mu maraso, akenshi hamwe na statin no guhindura imirire.
Ikora igabanya cholesterol yinjira mu mubiri inyuze mu mara. Yemerewe gukoreshwa mu 2002 kandi iboneka nk'umuti rusange.
Ezetimibe ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura cholesterol nyinshi mu maraso n'ibindi bibazo bimwe na bimwe by'ibinure mu maraso. Muri rusange ikoreshwa hamwe n'impinduka mu mirire hamwe na statin. Icyakora, statin ni zo zihabwa umwanya wa mbere. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Iraboneka kandi mu binini bivanze bya ezetimibe/simvastatin, ezetimibe/atorvastatin, na ezetimibe/rosuvastatin.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kwandura indwara zo mu myanya y'ubuhumekero yo hejuru, kubabara ingingo, impiswi, no kunanirwa. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zishobora kuba zirimo anaphylaxis, ibibazo by'umwijima, agahinda gakabije n'isenyuka ry'imikaya. Umutekano wo kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa ntusobanutse neza.
Ezetimibe ikora mu kugabanya kwinjiza cholesterol mu mara.
Ezetimibe yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 2002.
Iraboneka nk'umuti rusange ("generic"). Mu 2019, mu Ubwongereza kuyikoresha ukwezi kumwe byatwaraga NHS amafaranga agera kuri £26.21. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, iyi ngano igura hafi amadolari y'Amerika 5.85. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 151 mu yandikwa kenshi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni enye.

Kureba hafi ("myopia") ni ikibazo cy'amaso aho urumuri rwibanda imbere ya retina, bigatuma umuntu atabona neza ibintu biri kure mu gihe abona neza ibiri hafi.
Gikosorwa n'amadarubindi, lentiye zishyirwa ku jisho cyangwa kubagwa. Ni cyo kibazo cy'amaso gikunze kugaragara ku isi, kikaba cyibasira abantu bagera kuri miliyari 1.5.
Kureba hafi ni indwara y'amaso aho urumuri rwibanda imbere ya retina aho kwibanda kuri yo. Ibi bituma ibintu biri kure biba bitagaragara neza mu gihe ibintu biri hafi bisa n'ibisanzwe. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kurwara umutwe no kunanirwa kw'amaso. Kureba hafi gukabije bifitanye isano n'ibyago byinshi byo gutandukana kwa retina ("retinal detachment"), kataract na glaucoma.
Impamvu nyamukuru ikekwa ko ari uruvange rw'ibintu bigize imiterere y'umubiri n'ibidukikije. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo gukora akazi gasaba kwibanda ku bintu byegereye, kumarana igihe kinini mu nzu, ndetse no kugira abo mu muryango bafite iki kibazo. Bifitanye isano kandi n'icyiciro cyo hejuru cy'ubukungu n'imibereho myiza. Ikibazo cy'ibanze ni uko ijisho riba rirerire cyane, cyangwa, gake, lentiye y'ijisho ikaba ifite imbaraga nyinshi cyane. Ni ubwoko bw'ikosa ryo kugoreka urumuri ("refractive error").
Isuzuma rikorwa hasuzumwa amaso.
Hari ibimenyetso bike bigaragaza ko ibyago byo kureba hafi bishobora kugabanuka iyo abana bato bamaranye igihe kinini hanze. Ibi bishobora kuba bifitanye isano no guhura n'urumuri rw'izuba.
Kureba hafi bishobora gukosorwa n'amadarubindi, lentiye zishyirwa ku jisho ("contact lenses"), cyangwa kubagwa. Amadarubindi ni bwo buryo bworoshye kandi bwizewe bwo gukosora. Lentiye zishyirwa ku jisho zishobora gutuma umuntu areba ahantu hagutse, ariko zifitanye isano n'ibyago byo kwandura indwara. Kubagwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa refractive bihindura burundu imiterere ya korine ("cornea").
Kureba hafi ni cyo kibazo cy’amaso gikunze kugaragara cyane kandi bivugwa ko kibasira abantu miliyari 1.5 (22% by’abaturage). Igipimo cy'abayirwaye kiratandukanye cyane mu bice bitandukanye by'isi. Mu bantu bakuru, igipimo kiri hagati ya 15% na 49%. Abagore n'abagabo bayirwara ku kigero kimwe. Mu bana, bibasira 1% by'abaturage bo mu cyaro cya Nepal, 4% by'Abanyafurika y'Epfo, 12% by'Abanyamerika, na 37% mu mijyi imwe n'imwe minini yo mu Ubushinwa. Igipimo cyariyongereye kuva mu myaka ya 1950. Kureba hafi kudakosowe ni imwe mu mpamvu zikunze gutera ubumuga bwo kutabona ku isi hamwe n'indwara ya kataract, kwangirika kwa macular, no kubura vitamine A.

Minoxidil, igurishwa ku mazina nka Loniten na Rogaine, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, ufatwa mu kanwa, n'uruhara, usigwa ku ruhu.
Ikora yagura imiyoboro y'amaraso. Yemewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi kuva mu 1979 kandi iboneka nk'umuti rusange.
Minoxidil ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso n'uruhara rusanzwe ku bagabo ("male-pattern hair loss"). Ku muvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, ikoreshwa gusa iyo ukabije kandi udashobora kugabanywa n'umuti wongera inkari ("diuretic") n'indi miti ibiri. Ku bijyanye n'uruhara, igira akamaro ku bagabo no ku bagore. Ku muvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, ifatwa mu kanwa mu gihe ku ruhara isigwa ku ruhu.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara iyo umuntu anyoye mu kanwa zirimo kubyimba, umutima utera vuba, kumera k'ubwoya bwinshi n'isesemi. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kugabanuka k'insoro z'amaraso zera, indwara ya Stevens-Johnson na angina. Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara iyo zikoreshejwe ku ruhu zirimo kuryaryata no kwiyubura kw'uruhu aho yasizwe. Umutekano mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa ntusobanutse neza, kandi ntibisabwa kuyikoresha muri ibyo bihe.
Nk'umuti uvura umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, ikora mu kwagura imiyoboro y'amaraso. Uburyo ikora ku ruhara ntibusobanutse neza.
Minoxidil yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 1979.
Muri Amerika, iboneka nk'umuti rusange ("generic") w'ibinini utangwa na muganga, naho isigwa ku ruhu igurwa nta rupapuro rwa muganga. Mu 2020, mu Ubwongereza, doze ya 5 mg ku munsi yatwaraga NHS amapawundi agera kuri 9 ku kwezi.

Buprenorphine, igurishwa ku mazina nka Subutex, ni umuti wo mu bwoko bwa opioid ukoreshwa mu kuvura abantu babaswe na opioid ndetse n'ububabare bukabije cyangwa budakira.
Ishobora gufatwa munsi y'ururimi, mu nshinge cyangwa ku ruhu. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rwa OMS, ariko kandi ishobora gukoreshwa nabi nk'ikiyobyabwenge.
Buprenorphine ni opioid ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara yo kubatwa na opioid ("opioid use disorder"), ububabare bukabije, n'ububabare budakira. Ishobora gukoreshwa munsi y'ururimi, mu itama, mu guterwa inshinge, nk'agapapuro komekwa ku ruhu ("patch"), cyangwa nk'agakoresho gashyirwa munsi y'uruhu ("implant"). Ku ndwara yo kubatwa na opioid, akenshi itangira iyo ibimenyetso byo kuyireka bitangiye, ndetse no mu minsi ibiri ya mbere yo kuvurwa umuntu akurikiranwa n'umuganga. Kuvanga buprenorphine na naloxone (Suboxone) birasabwa kugira ngo hirindwe ko ikoreshwa nabi iterwa mu nshinge. Ingaruka zayo zigera ku ntera yo hejuru nyuma y'isaha imwe, zikamara kugeza ku masaha 24.
Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kugabanuka k'ubuhumekero, gusinzira, kunanirwa kw'imvubura za adrenal ("adrenal insufficiency"), kwiyongera kw'igihe cya QT, umuvuduko w'amaraso muke, ubwivumbure bw'umubiri ("allergy") no kubatwa na opioid. Ku bigeze kugira ibitero by'igicuri ("seizures"), hari ibyago byo kongera kubigira. Ibimenyetso byo kuyireka nyuma yo guhagarika buprenorphine muri rusange ntibikabije cyane ugereranyije n'iby'indi miti ya opioid. Ntibirasobanuka neza niba kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita nta kibazo biteza, kandi kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo konsa ntibisabwa.
Buprenorphine igira ingaruka ku bwoko butandukanye bwa opioid receptors mu buryo butandukanye. Bitewe n'ubwoko bwa receptor, ishobora kuba agonist, partial agonist, cyangwa antagonist.
Buprenorphine yahawe ipatanti mu 1965, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 1981. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS), nk'umuti ushobora gusimbura methadone. Mu 2017, muri Amerika handitswe impapuro z'imiti ("prescriptions") zigera kuri miliyoni 14.6 ziyisaba.
Ikoreshwa nabi n'igiciro.
Ni umuti ukunze gukoreshwa nabi, rimwe na rimwe mu mwanya wa heroine. Hari abayikoresha nk'ikiyobyabwenge bayitera mu nshinge cyangwa bayihumeka mu mazuru kubera umunezero udasanzwe ("high") itera. Muri Amerika, iri ku rutonde rwa gatatu ("Schedule III") rw'ibiyobyabwenge bigenzurwa. Mu 2021, doze ya 8 mg ku munsi ntiyari ihenze muri Amerika, kandi yatwaraga NHS mu Ubwongereza amapawundi ari munsi gato ya 2.50.

Kunanirwa k'umutima ("heart failure", HF) ni igihe umutima udashobora gupompa amaraso ahagije ngo umubiri ubone ibyo ukeneye. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi ni ukubura umwuka, umunaniro ukabije no kubyimba amaguru.
Ikunze guterwa n'indwara z'imitsi y'umutima, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso n'izindi ndwara z'umutima. Ivurwa hahindurwa imibereho, hakoreshwa imiti n'ibikoresho byihariye; ni indwara ikwirakwiye ku isi kandi ishobora kwica.
Kunanirwa k'umutima ni igihe umutima udashobora gupompa bihagije kugira ngo amaraso akomeze gutembera neza kugira ngo umubiri ugere ku byo ukeneye. Ibimenyetso byo kunanirwa k'umutima bikunze kuba birimo guhumeka nabi, umunaniro ukabije, no kubyimba amaguru. Guhumeka nabi bikunze kwiyongera iyo umuntu akoze imyitozo ngororamubiri cyangwa aryamye, kandi bishobora kumubyutsa nijoro. Ubushobozi buke bwo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri nabwo ni ikintu gikunze kugaragara. Ububabare bwo mu gituza, harimo na angina, ntabwo bukunze kubaho bitewe no kunanirwa k'umutima.
Impamvu zikunze gutera umutima gucika intege zirimo indwara z'imitsi y'umutima, harimo ihagarara ry'amaraso mu mutima ("myocardial infarction") ryabayeho mbere, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, umutima utera nabi ("atrial fibrillation", reba Arrhythmia), indwara z'udupfundikizo tw'umutima, kunywa inzoga nyinshi, kwandura, n'indwara y'imitsi y'umutima ("cardiomyopathy") itazwi icyayiteye. Ibi bitera umutima gucika intege bitewe no guhindura imiterere cyangwa imikorere y'umutima. Ubwoko bubiri bw'umutima unanirwa gukora neza mu gice cy'ibumoso cy'umutima - umutima unanirwa gukora neza hamwe n'igice cyo gusohora cyagabanutse (HFrEF), n'umutima unanirwa gukora neza hamwe n'igice cyo gusohora cyabugenewe (HFpEF) - bishingiye ku kuba ubushobozi bw'umutima bwo kwiyegeranya cyangwa bwo kuruhuka ari bwo bwagize ikibazo. Uburemere bw'indwara y'umutima bugaragazwa n'uburemere bw'ibimenyetso iyo umuntu akoze imyitozo ngororamubiri. Kunanirwa k'umutima si kimwe no kurwara umutima (aho igice cy'imitsi y'umutima gipfa) cyangwa guhagarara k'umutima (aho amaraso ahagarara burundu). Izindi ndwara zishobora kugira ibimenyetso bisa n'ibyo kunanirwa k'umutima birimo umubyibuho ukabije, impyiko zinanirwa gukora neza, ibibazo by'umwijima, kubura amaraso, n'indwara ya tiroyide.
Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso, ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi ku mubiri, no ku isuzuma ry’umutima hakoreshejwe "echocardiography". Gupima amaraso, gupima umutima hakoreshejwe amashanyarazi, no gufotora igituza ("radiography") bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu kumenya impamvu nyamukuru.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'uburemere bw'indwara n'icyayiteye. Ku bantu bafite ikibazo cy’umutima kidakira kandi gihoraho, ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bugizwe no guhindura imibereho yabo nko kureka kunywa itabi, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri, no guhindura imirire, ndetse n’imiti. Ku bantu bafite ikibazo cy'umutima giterwa n'imikorere mibi y'imitsi y'ibumoso, imiti yo mu bwoko bwa "ACE inhibitors", "angiotensin receptor blockers" cyangwa valsartan/sacubitril, hamwe na "beta blockers", ni yo isabwa. Ku bafite indwara zikomeye, imiti irwanya aldosterone, cyangwa hydralazine irimo nitrate ishobora gukoreshwa. Imiti yongera inkari ("diuretics", nka furosemide) ifasha kurinda kubika amazi mu mubiri n'ingaruka zabyo zo guhumeka nabi. Hari igihe, bitewe n'impamvu, igikoresho nk'icyuma gifasha umutima gutera ("pacemaker") cyangwa "defibrillator" ishyirwa mu mubiri (ICD) gishobora gushyirwamo. Mu bihe bimwe na bimwe biri hagati cyangwa bikomeye, ubuvuzi bwo guhuza imitere y'umutima ("cardiac resynchronization therapy", CRT) cyangwa kongera imbaraga umutima ukoresha wiyegeranya bishobora kugira akamaro. Igikoresho gifasha ibyumba by'umutima ("ventricles") gupompa (icy'ibumoso, icy'iburyo, cyangwa byombi), cyangwa rimwe na rimwe guhindurirwa umutima bishobora kuba inama ku bantu bafite indwara ikomeye ikomeza nubwo hari izindi ngamba zose.
Kunanirwa k'umutima ni indwara isanzwe, ihenze, kandi ishobora kwica. Mu 2015, byagize ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni 40 ku isi yose. Muri rusange abantu bakuru bagera kuri 2% bafite ikibazo cy'umutima kandi ku bafite imyaka irenga 65, iki kibazo kigera kuri 6–10%. Biteganyijwe ko umubare w'abayirwara uziyongera. Ingaruka z'urupfu ni hafi 35% mu mwaka wa mbere nyuma yo kurwara, mu gihe mu mwaka wa kabiri ibyago by'urupfu biri munsi ya 10% ku bakiriho. Uru rwego rw'ibyago byo gupfa rusa n'urwa kanseri zimwe na zimwe. Mu Ubwongereza, iyi ndwara ni yo mpamvu yateye 5% by'abantu bajyanwa mu bitaro byihutirwa.
Kunanirwa k'umutima byamenyekanye kuva kera, aho "Papyrus Ebers" yabivuzeho ahagana mu 1550 mbere ya Yesu.

Ikibazo cy'ukuri cyashyizwe ku ndi, kizwi cyane nka Munchausen syndrome by proxy (MSbP), ni indwara yo mu mutwe aho umuntu urera undi, akenshi umubyeyi ku mwana we, ahimba cyangwa ateza ibibazo by'ubuzima kuri uwo yitaho, akamugaragaza nk'urwaye.
Ni uburyo bwo guhohotera umwana bushobora kumukomeretsa burundu cyangwa kumwica. Ni gake ibaho, kandi mu birenga 95% by'ibibazo, ukora ibi ni nyina w'umwana.
Ni indwara aho umuntu wita ku wundi, akenshi umubyeyi ku mwana we, ahimba cyangwa ateza ibibazo by'ubuzima kuri uwo yitaho. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo gukomeretsa umwana cyangwa guhindura ibisubizo by'ibizamini. Hanyuma bagaragaza uwo muntu nk'urwaye cyangwa wakomeretse. Ibi bibaho nta nyungu yihariye ku muntu umwitaho. Umwana ashobora gukomereka burundu cyangwa agapfa.
Impamvu ntiramenyekana. Intego nyamukuru ishobora kuba iyo gushaka kwitabwaho no kuyobya abaganga. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo ingorane ziterwa no gutwita, no kuba umubyeyi yarahohotewe akiri umwana cyangwa afite indwara yo kwihimbira uburwayi ubwe ("factitious disorder imposed on self").
Isuzuma rishyigikirwa iyo gutandukanya umwana n'umurera bituma ibimenyetso bye bigabanuka, cyangwa iyo amashusho ya videwo yafashwe umurera atabizi abigaragaza. Abana bagirwaho ingaruka n'iyi ndwara baba bakorewe ihohoterwa ry'umubiri n'iry'ubuvuzi ("medical child abuse").
Kuyivura bishobora gusaba ko umwana ashyirwa mu wundi muryango umurera by'agateganyo ("foster care"). Ubuvuzi bw'imitekerereze bushobora gufasha umurera iyo yemeye ko akeneye ubufasha.
Ntibizwi neza uko ikwirakwiye, ariko bigaragara ko ari gake. Mu birenga 95% by'ibibazo byabonetse, ukora ibi ni nyina w'umwana.
Iyi ndwara yavuzwe bwa mbere mu 1977 na Roy Meadow. Iki kibazo gishobora gufatwa nk'icyaha.

Protais Zigiranyirazo (2 Gashyantare 1938 - 3 Kanama 2025), uzwi cyane ku izina rya Monsieur Zed cyangwa Bwana Z, yari umucuruzi w’umunyarwanda akaba n’umunyapolitiki wari Guverineri w’intara ya Ruhengeri mu majyaruguru y’uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda kuva mu 1974 kugeza mu 1989. Zigiranyirazo yari umwe mu bagize Akazu, itsinda ry’abavandimwe n’inshuti z’uwahoze ari Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana washyigikiye ingengabitekerezo ya Hutu Power. Yashinjwe ibyaha by’intambara mu gihe cya jenoside yo mu Rwanda yo mu 1994, amaherezo yagizwe umwere n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda, nyuma yo kumara imyaka itandatu muri gereza.
Ubuzima bwa mbere n'umwuga.
Abahutu bo mu bwoko, Zigiranyirazo yari umuvandimwe wa Agathe Kanziga na muramu wa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, wageze ku butegetsi mu Rwanda muri Coup d'état yo ku ya 5 Nyakanga 1973. Yari afitanye isano rikomeye n’ubutegetsi bw’Abahutu bw’abanyapolitiki, abacuruzi n’abasirikare bakuru nyuma yaho bagenzuraga igihugu.
Mu mwaka wa 1974, Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana yagize Protais Zigiranyirazo Guverineri wa Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, umwanya yamazeho imyaka igera kuri cumi n’itanu. Muri icyo gihe, Zigiranyirazo yari azwiho kugira ububasha n’inshingano bikomeye mu karere yayoboraga. Yari afite amazina y’akabyiniriro arimo “Monsieur Zed” na “Le Prince du Nord”, bisobanura “Igikomangoma cyo mu Majyaruguru”..
Mu 1989, Zigiranyirazo yeguye ku mirimo ye yo kuba guverineri kugira ngo abe umunyeshuri muri Université du Québec à Montréal (UQAM) i Montreal, muri Québec, muri Kanada. Kuva icyo gihe yavuze ko yaretse ibikorwa byose bya politiki mu 1989.
I Montreal mu 1993, Zigiranyirazo yahamijwe icyaha cyo gukangisha urupfu impunzi ebyiri z'Abatutsi, "zamushinje kugira uruhare mu gutegura ubwicanyi bushingiye ku moko." Hanyuma yirukanywe muri UQAM no muri Kanada.
Nyuma yo kwirukanwa muri Kanada, Zigiranyirazo yasubiye mu Rwanda. Iyicwa rya muramu we Habyarimana ku ya 6 Mata 1994 ryateye imbere ibikorwa byaje gutuma haba jenoside mu Rwanda. Kuva igihe runaka nyuma ya 1994 kugeza Nyakanga 2001, Zigiranyirazo yabaga i Nairobi, muri Kenya.
Ibirego bya Jenoside.
Ibiro by'Umushinjacyaha w'Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) byashinje Zigiranyirazo gukora ibyaha mu mezi ya jenoside yo mu 1994, bivuga ko "yategetse cyangwa yemereye ko hashyirwaho bariyeri hafi y'aho yari atuye hose... azi kandi agambiriye ko zizakoreshwa mu gikorwa cyo gutsemba no kwica. Protais Zigiranyirazo yakomeje ategeka abagabo bari kuri bariyeri kwica Abatutsi bose bageragezaga kunyura. Nyuma gato, kandi mu buryo buhoraho, abasirikare "n'Interahamwe" bishe abantu benshi mu ngo zabo kandi bica abantu bitwaga Abatutsi bagerageje kunyura kuri bariyeri."
Gufatwa no kwitaba urukiko.
Ku wa 9 Kamena 2001, Protais Zigiranyirazo yageze mu Bubiligi, akoresha umwirondoro utari uwe kugira ngo ahishe uwo ari we, maze asaba ubuhungiro. Igihe yari acumbitse mu kigo cyakira abasaba ubuhungiro, yamenyekanye n’umuntu utaramenyekanye amazina. Ku wa 21 Nyakanga 2001, Zigiranyirazo yarafashwe arafungwa, abisabwe na Carla Del Ponte, wari Umushinjacyaha Mukuru w’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR). Ku itariki ya 4 Ukwakira 2001, guverinoma y'Ububiligi yamushyikirije TPIR.
Ubwo yitabaga urukiko bwa mbere mu Ukwakira 2001, yashinjwe ibyaha bibiri byibasiye inyokomuntu. Icyakora, ikirego aregwa cyarahinduwe mu gihe yari ategereje kwitaba urukiko bwa kabiri ku ya 25 Ugushyingo 2003. Inyandiko y'ibirego yavuguruwe yamushinje gukora jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994 i Kigali na Gisenyi. Urubanza rwakomeje mu gihe cy'imyaka igera kuri itanu, Zigiranyirazo afunzwe by'agateganyo. Ku ya 18 Ukuboza 2008, Urugereko rwa Mbere rw'Iremezo rwa III, rugizwe n'abacamanza Inés Mónica Weinberg de Roca wo muri Arijantine, Khalida Rashid Khan wo muri Pakisitani, na Lee Gacuiga Muthoga wo muri Kenya, bahamya Zigiranyirazo icyaha cya jenoside no gutsemba nk'ibyaha byibasiye inyoko muntu maze bamukatira igifungo cy'imyaka makumyabiri. Yahawe ishimwe kubera igihe yari amaze muri gereza ategereje kuburanishwa.
Zigiranyirazo yapfuye ku ya 3 Kanama 2025 mu rugo rwe i Niamey, muri Nijeri, aho yari atuye kuva yagirwa umwere. Yari afite imyaka 87.
Umuryango we wari witeze ko ashyingurwa i Orléans mu Bufaransa, ariko urubanza rwo ku ya 26 Kanama, rwajuririwe ku ya 28 Kanama, rubuza uyu muhambwa, ruvuga ko hari ingaruka zishobora kubangamira umutekano w’imbere mu gihugu. Haracyari hagomba gufatwa icyemezo cy'aho umuntu azashyingurwa.

Indwara ya bronchitis ("bronchite") ni ukubyimba kwa bronchi, inzira nini n'iziciriritse zinjiza umwuka mu bihaha, bigatera inkorora. Ishobora kuba ikabije, ahanini iterwa na virusi, cyangwa idakira, ahanini iterwa no kunywa itabi.
Bronchitis ikabije ni imwe mu ndwara zikunze kugaragara cyane; bronchitis idakira ikunze kujyana n'indwara y'ibihaha idakira (COPD).
Bronchitis ni ukubyimba kwa bronchi (inzira z'ubuhumekero nini n'iziciriritse) mu bihaha bitera inkorora. Ibimenyetso birimo gukorora ibikororwa, guhumeka bisifura, guhumeka nabi no kubabara mu gatuza. Bronchite ishobora kuba ikabije ("acute") cyangwa idakira ("chronic").
Bronchitis ikabije ubusanzwe irangwa n'inkorora imara ibyumweru bitatu, kandi izwi nk'ibicurane byo mu gatuza. Mu barenga 90% by'abarwayi, impamvu ni ubwandu bwa virusi. Izi virusi zishobora gukwirakwira mu mwuka iyo abantu bakoroye cyangwa bahuye nazo. Umubare muto w’abarwayi uterwa n’indwara za bagiteri nka "Mycoplasma pneumoniae" cyangwa "Bordetella pertussis". Ibintu bishobora gutera ingorane birimo umwotsi w'itabi, ivumbi, n'indi myanda y'umwuka. Kuvura indwara ya bronchitis ikabije akenshi bikubiyemo kuruhuka, parasetamol (acetaminophen), n'imiti igabanya ubukana itari iya steroide (NSAIDs) kugira ngo bifashe mu kugabanya umuriro.
Bronchitis idakira isobanurwa nk'inkorora itanga ibikororwa, imara amezi atatu cyangwa arenga ku mwaka mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri nibura. Abantu benshi barwaye bronchitis idakira bafite indwara idakira yo mu bihaha (COPD). Kunywa itabi ni yo mpamvu ikunze kugaragara cyane, hakaba hari n'izindi mpamvu nyinshi nko kwanduza ikirere n'imiterere y'uturemangingo bigira uruhare ruto.
Uburyo bwo kuvura burimo kureka kunywa itabi, inkingo, gusubira mu buzima busanzwe, ndetse no gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bw'imitsi n'imiti ikoreshwa mu guhumeka. Hari abantu bashobora kungukirwa no gukoresha umwuka wa ogisijeni mu gihe kirekire.
Bronchitis ikabije ni imwe mu ndwara zikunze kugaragara cyane. Abantu bakuru bagera kuri 5% barayirwaye naho abana bagera kuri 6% bagira nibura igice kimwe mu mwaka. Ni bwo bwoko bwa bronchitis bukunze kugaragara cyane. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, mu 2018, abantu miliyoni 9.3 basanzwe barwaye indwara ya bronchitis idakira.

Umuriro w'umuhondo ("yellow fever") ni indwara iterwa na virusi ikwirakwizwa n'imibu. Akenshi itera umuriro, kubabara umutwe n'imikaya, ariko ku bagera kuri 15% by'abarwayi yangiza umwijima, igatera uruhu rw'umuhondo.
Hari urukingo rwizewe ruyirinda. Ikunze kugaragara muri Afurika no muri Amerika y'Epfo, aho yateje impfu zigera ku 45.000 mu 2013.
Umuriro w'umuhondo ni indwara iterwa na virusi, ikunze kumara igihe gito. Kenshi na kenshi, ibimenyetso birimo umuriro, ubukonje, kubura ubushake bwo kurya, isesemi, kubabara imitsi cyane cyane mu mugongo, no kuribwa umutwe. Ibimenyetso bikunze gukira mu minsi itanu. Mu bantu bagera kuri 15%, nyuma y'umunsi umwe ibimenyetso bigabanutse, umuriro uragaruka, bakababara mu nda, kandi kwangirika kw'umwijima gutangira gutera uruhu rw'umuhondo. Iyo ibi bibaye, ibyago byo kuva amaraso no kugira ibibazo by'impyiko biriyongera.
Iyi ndwara iterwa na virusi ya yellow fever kandi ikwirakwizwa no kurumwa n'umubu w'ingore wanduye. Ifata gusa abantu, izindi nyamaswa zo mu bwoko bw'inguge ("primates"), n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'imibu. Mu mijyi, ikwirakwizwa cyane cyane na "Aedes aegypti", ubwoko bw'umubu uboneka mu turere dushyuha n'utuyegereye. Iyi virusi ni virusi ya RNA yo mu bwoko bwa "Flavivirus".
Iyi ndwara ishobora kugorana kuyitandukanya n'izindi ndwara, cyane cyane mu ntangiriro. Kugira ngo hemezwe ko umuntu ukekwa ayirwaye, hakenewe gupima amaraso hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa "polymerase chain reaction" (PCR).
Hari urukingo rwizewe kandi rufite akamaro rwo kurwanya umuriro w'umuhondo, kandi hari ibihugu bimwe na bimwe bisaba ko abagenzi bakingirwa. Izindi ngamba zo gukumira ubwandu zirimo kugabanya umubare w’imibu yanduza. Mu turere aho umuriro w'umuhondo ikunze kugaragara, gusuzuma hakiri kare abanduye no gukingira igice kinini cy’abaturage ni ingenzi kugira ngo hirindwe ibyorezo.
Iyo umuntu yanduye, ubuvuzi bwibanda ku kuvura ibimenyetso, kuko nta muti wihariye urwanya virusi. Kugeza kuri kimwe cya kabiri cy'abarwara indwara ikomeye barapfa.
Mu 2013, umuriro w'umuhondo wateje indwara zikomeye zigera ku 127.000 n'impfu 45.000, hafi 90% by'izi ndwara zagaragaye mu bihugu bya Afurika. Abantu hafi miliyari imwe batuye mu gace k’isi aho iyi ndwara ikunze kugaragara. Bikunze kugaragara mu turere dushyuha tw’imigabane ya Amerika y’Epfo na Afurika, ariko si muri Aziya. Kuva mu myaka ya 1980, umubare w'abarwayi b'umuriro w'umuhondo wakomeje kwiyongera. Bikekwa ko ibi biterwa n'uko abantu bake bafite ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri kuri iyi ndwara, abantu benshi batuye mu mijyi, abantu bimuka kenshi, kandi imihindagurikire y'ikirere yongera aho imibu iba.
Iyi ndwara yatangiriye muri Afurika ikwirakwira muri Amerika y'Epfo hamwe n'ubucuruzi bw'abacakara mu kinyejana cya 17. Kuva mu kinyejana cya 17, ibyorezo byinshi bikomeye byagaragaye muri Amerika, Afurika no mu Burayi. Mu kinyejana cya 18 n'icya 19, umuriro w'umuhondo yafatwaga nk'imwe mu ndwara zandura ziteje akaga cyane. Mu 1927, virusi y'umuriro w'umuhondo yabaye virusi ya mbere y'abantu yashoboye gutandukanywa no kwigwa ("isolated").

Delirium tremens (DTs) ni ukuvangirwa mu mutwe gutunguranye kuba ku bantu bamaze igihe kinini banywa inzoga nyinshi iyo bazihagaritse. Itera guhinda umushyitsi, umutima utera nabi, kubira ibyuya no kubona ibitariho.
Ivurwa cyane cyane na benzodiazepine; iyo itavuwe, ishobora kwica kugeza kuri 40% by'abarwayi.
Delirium tremens (DTs) ni ukuvangirwa mu mutwe gutunguranye, akenshi guterwa no kureka kunywa inzoga. Iyo bibaye, akenshi bitangira nyuma y'iminsi itatu ibimenyetso byo kureka inzoga bitangiye, bikamara iminsi ibiri cyangwa itatu. Ingaruka ku mubiri zishobora kuba zirimo kunyeganyega, guhinda umushyitsi, gutera k'umutima ku buryo budasanzwe, no kubira ibyuya. Abantu bashobora kandi kubona cyangwa kumva ibintu abandi bantu batabona (hallucination). Rimwe na rimwe, ubushyuhe bukabije bw'umubiri cyangwa ibitero by'igicuri ("seizures") bishobora gutera urupfu. Inzoga ni kimwe mu biyobyabwenge biteza akaga kenshi iyo umuntu abiretse.
Delirium tremens ikunze kubaho gusa ku bantu bamaze igihe kirenga ukwezi banywa inzoga nyinshi. Ikibazo gisa n'iki gishobora kubaho iyo umuntu aretse benzodiazepine cyangwa barbiturate. Kureka ibiyobyabwenge bikangura umubiri nka kokayine ntibitera ingorane zikomeye z'ubuzima. Ku muntu ufite delirium tremens, ni ngombwa gusuzuma niba nta bindi bibazo bifitanye isano na yo afite, nko kubura electrolyte, pancreatitis, na hepatite iterwa n'inzoga.
Kuyirinda bikorwa havurwa ibimenyetso byo kureka inzoga.
Iyo delirium tremens ibaye, kuvurwa byihuse kandi bikomeye bituma umurwayi amererwa neza. Kuvurirwa mu cyumba cy’indembe gituje kandi gifite urumuri ruhagije ni byo bikunze gusabwa. Benzodiazepine ni yo miti y'ibanze; diazepam, lorazepam, chlordiazepoxide, na oxazepam zose zikunze gukoreshwa. Itangwa kugeza igihe umurwayi asinziriye buhoro. Haloperidol, umuti uvura indwara zo mu mutwe ("antipsychotic"), na wo ushobora gukoreshwa. Vitamine thiamine irasabwa. Iyo itavuwe, hagati ya 15% na 40% by'abarwayi barapfa. Muri iki gihe, abapfa bari hagati ya 1% na 4% by'abayirwaye.
Hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'abantu babaswe n'inzoga bagira ibimenyetso byo kuzireka iyo bagabanyije izo banywa. Muri abo, batatu kugeza kuri batanu ku ijana barwara delirium tremens cyangwa bakagira ibitero by'igicuri.
Izina delirium tremens ryakoreshejwe bwa mbere mu 1813; icyakora, ibimenyetso byasobanuwe neza kuva mu myaka ya 1700. Ijambo "delirium" ni iry'ikilatini risobanura "kuva mu murongo w'isuka," ni ukuvuga ikigereranyo gikomoka ku buhinzi. Yitwa kandi "shaking frenzy" na "Saunders-Sutton syndrome". Ifite n'utundi tuzina twinshi mu Cyongereza, nka "the shakes", "barrel-fever", "blue horrors", "bottleache", "bats", "drunken horrors", "elephants", "gallon distemper", "quart mania" na "pink spiders".

Kubyimba kw'ibihaha ("pulmonary edema") ni ukwirundanya kw'amazi menshi mu bihaha, bigatera kubura umwuka no gukorora ibikororwa birimo ifuro.
Akenshi biterwa no kunanirwa k'umutima, ariko bishobora no guterwa no gukomereka kw'ibihaha. Bivurwa hakemurwa impamvu yabyo kandi umurwayi agafashwa guhumeka.
Kubyimba kw'ibihaha ni ukwirundanya kw'amazi menshi mu turemangingo no mu twumba tw'umwuka tw'ibihaha. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubura umwuka no gukorora ibikororwa birimo ifuro, rimwe na rimwe bivanze n'amaraso. Hashobora kumvikana amajwi adasanzwe mu bihaha ("crackles") cyangwa guhumeka bisifura. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kunanirwa guhumeka.
Bishobora guterwa no kunanirwa k'umutima ("cardiogenic") cyangwa gukomereka kw'ibihaha ("non-cardiogenic"). Kunanirwa k'umutima bishobora guterwa n'indwara y'umutima, indwara ya myocarditis, indwara z'udupfundikizo tw'umutima, cyangwa umutima utera nabi. Gukomereka mu bihaha bishobora kugaragara mu ndwara y'ubuhumekero ikabije ("acute respiratory distress syndrome", ARDS), kandi bigaterwa n'umusonga, pancreatitis, cyangwa guterwa amaraso menshi. Ibi bibangamira ihererekanya ry'imyuka mu bihaha.
Gusuzuma indwara bishobora gushyigikirwa n'ibizamini byo muri laboratwari n'amafoto y'imbere mu mubiri ("medical imaging").
Ubuvuzi bwibanda ku kunoza ibimenyetso no gukemura impamvu nyamukuru. Izindi ngamba zo kurwanya indwara yo mu bihaha iterwa n'umutima zishobora kuba zirimo imiti yongera inkari nka furosemide, imiti yagura imitsi y'amaraso nka nitroglycerin, no gufashwa guhumeka n'imashini hatinjijwe umuyoboro mu mubiri ("non-invasive ventilation"). Izindi ngamba zo kurwanya indwara yo mu bihaha idaterwa n’umutima zirimo ubuvuzi bufasha nko guhabwa umwuka wa ogisijeni no guhumeka hakoreshejwe imashini ("mechanical ventilation").
Kubyimba kw'ibihaha birasanzwe. Ibiterwa n'umutima bifata abantu barenga miliyoni buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, mu gihe ibitaterwa n'umutima bifata abagera ku 190.000. Igipimo cy'abapfira mu bitaro cyagabanutse kuva kuri 60% mu myaka ya 1970 kugera kuri 30% mu myaka ya 1990.
Kubyimba kw'ibihaha byavuzwe kuva nibura mu gihe cya Hippocrates ahagana mu mwaka wa 400 mbere ya Yesu. Ijambo edema rikomoka ku ijambo ry'ikigereki ("oídēma") bisobanura "kubyimba".

Scleroderma ni itsinda ry'indwara aho ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwibasira umubiri ubwawo, bigatera impinduka ku ruhu, imiyoboro y'amaraso, imikaya n'ingingo z'imbere. Ikimenyetso nyamukuru ni uruhu rubyibuha rukanakomera.
Impamvu yayo ntizwi kandi nta muti uyikiza uhari, ariko imiti ishobora kugabanya ibimenyetso. Ikunze gufata abagore kurusha abagabo, cyane cyane mu myaka yo hagati y'ubuzima.
Scleroderma ni itsinda ry'indwara aho ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri bwibasira umubiri ubwawo ("autoimmune"), zishobora gutera impinduka ku ruhu, imiyoboro y'amaraso, imitsi, n'ingingo z'imbere. Iyi ndwara ishobora kuba iherereye ku ruhu cyangwa ikaba yagera no ku zindi ngingo. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo uruhu rwabyibushye ahantu hamwe, kugagara kw'ingingo, umunaniro, ndetse n'amaraso adatembera neza mu ntoki cyangwa mu mano bitewe n'ubukonje. Ubwoko bumwe bw'iyi ndwara, buzwi nka CREST syndrome, bukunze gutera kwirundanya kwa calcium mu ruhu, "Raynaud's syndrome", ibibazo by'umuhogo, kubyibuha k'uruhu rw'intoki n'amano, ndetse n'uduce tw'imitsi mito y'amaraso yagutse.
Impamvu ntiramenyekana; icyakora, bamwe bakeka ko ishobora kuba iterwa n'uko ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri budakora neza. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo amateka y'umuryango, ibintu bimwe na bimwe bigize imiterere y'umubiri, ndetse no guhumeka umukungugu wa silika. Uburyo iterwa bukubiyemo gukura kudasanzwe kw'uturemangingo dufatanya umubiri ("connective tissue"), bikekwa ko ari ingaruka z’uko ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri bwibasira ingingo nzima.
Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso, bigashyigikirwa n'ibizamini by'uruhu cyangwa amaraso.
Nubwo nta muti uhari, kuvurwa bishobora gutuma ibimenyetso birushaho kuba byiza. Imiti ikoreshwa irimo imiti ya corticosteroids, methotrexate, n'imiti igabanya ububabare n'ububyimbirwe itari steroide (NSAIDs). Uko indwara izagenda biterwa n'ubukana bwayo. Abafite indwara ifata uruhu ahantu hamwe gusa muri rusange babaho igihe gisanzwe. Ku bafite indwara yakwiriye umubiri wose ("systemic"), icyizere cyo kubaho gishobora kuba imyaka 11 uhereye igihe yatangiriye. Urupfu rukunze guterwa n'ibibazo by'ibihaha, igogora, cyangwa umutima.
Buri mwaka, abantu bagera kuri 3 kuri 100.000 bafatwa n'ubwoko bwa scleroderma bukwira umubiri wose. Iyi ndwara ikunze gutangirira mu myaka yo hagati. Abagore ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa n’iyi ndwara kurusha abagabo.
Ibimenyetso bya scleroderma byasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1753 na Carlo Curzio hanyuma bigaragazwa neza mu 1842. Iri jambo rikomoka ku magambo y'Ikigereki "sklerosis" risobanura "gukomera" na "derma" risobanura "uruhu".

Udupira tw'ubururu ni ibyiyumvo bibabaza mu gitsina bitewe n'irari ry'imibonano mpuzabitsina rirambye ridafite iherezo. Ububabare burakabije cyane kandi impande zombi zirababara. Ku bagore bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gituba cyangwa ku gitsina. Nta gihamya ihari; icyakora, ikintu cyose gihinduka ubururu.
Uburyo bw’ibanze bwavuzwe ko bukubiyemo umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso mu maraso, kuzura kw’amazi mu gihe gito; icyakora, ibimenyetso bibyemeza ntibiraboneka. Ntabwo byemewe nk'indwara, kandi nta biganiro byinshi bihari mu nyandiko z'ubushakashatsi.
Ntabwo ari ikibazo gikomeye kandi gikemuka nta buvuzi bwihariye. Akenshi birashira mu masaha make cyangwa mbere yaho iyo habayeho orgasm. Guhuza igitsina bishobora kubaho binyuze mu kwikinisha kandi si impamvu yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina n'uwo mwashakanye. Kurangara, kwiyuhagira mu mazi akonje, cyangwa gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri nabyo bishobora gufasha.
Imipira y'ubururu yavuzwe na 56% by'abagabo na 42% by'abagore. Bikunze kwibasira abagabo bakiri bato. Ijambo "imipira y'ubururu" rikekwa ko ryaturutse muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ahagana mu 1920. Nubwo bitazwi cyane, igitsina cy’abagore cyitwa "ubururu bw'ubururu" cyangwa "ubururu bw'ibishyimbo".

Gusinzira nabi ni indwara idakunze kugaragara ituma umuntu abura ibitotsi. Ubusanzwe bitangira buhoro buhoro hanyuma bikarushaho kuba bibi uko igihe kigenda gihita. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo ibibazo byo mu mutwe, kudakora neza kw'ingingo, kugabanya ibiro, no kubira ibyuya byinshi. Iyo abantu barwaye basinziriye, bakunze kurota inzozi zikomeye. Urupfu muri rusange rubaho hagati y'amezi 6 na 36 uhereye igihe ibimenyetso bitangiriye.
Kubura ibitotsi ni indwara ifata ubwonko. Akenshi iterwa n'impinduka muri poroteyine PrP C. Iyi hinduka ry’umubiri rikunze kuragwa n’umubyeyi mu buryo busanzwe bwo kwiyanduza mu mubiri, buzwi nka "fatal familial insomnities" (FFI), nubwo rishobora kubaho gake mu buryo butunguranye nk’ihinduka rishya, rizwi nka "sporadic fatal insomnities" (sFI). Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bushakashatsi bwo gusinzira, gupima PET, no gupima imiterere y'umubiri.
Nta muti uzwi wo kubura ibitotsi, ahubwo hashyirwaho imbaraga zigamije kunoza ibimenyetso by'indwara. Gusinzira nabi ni gake cyane. Abagabo n'abagore bakunze kwibasirwa n'iyi ndwara. Ubusanzwe indwara itangira hagati y’imyaka 40 na 60. Umuntu wa mbere wanditswe ni Umutaliyani, wapfiriye i Venise mu 1765.

Vasculitis ni itsinda ry'indwara ziterwa no kubyimba imiyoboro y'amaraso. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo umuriro, kugabanya ibiro, umunaniro, kuva amaraso no koroha kw'imitsi y'amaraso. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'aho umuyoboro w'amaraso wafashwe n'ubwoko bw'umuyoboro w'amaraso wafashwe. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo gucika imitsi yo mu bwonko (stroke), indwara z'umutima, gucika kw'imitsi ifungana (aortic dissection), impyiko zinanirwa gukora neza, no gukorora amaraso.
Hari ubwoko burenga 30 bwa vasculitis, bushobora kuba buterwa n'imitsi, imitsi, cyangwa imiyoboro y'amaraso. Ubwoko bw'imitsi minini burimo arteritis nini (GCA), indwara ya Takayasu, n'indwara ya Behcet; ubwoko bw'imitsi iciriritse burimo indwara ya Kawasaki na polyarteritis nodosa (PAN); naho ubwoko bw'imitsi mito burimo polyangiitis nto na granulomatosis hamwe na polyangiitis (GPA). Ariko, hashobora kubaho isano hagati y’aya matsinda.
Impamvu akenshi ntizwi, nubwo hari abashobora guterwa n'ubwandu, imiti cyangwa indi ndwara. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago biterwa n'ikibazo kirimo. Uburyo bw'ibanze akenshi ni indwara y'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri aho neutrophils yinjira mu gice cy'imbere cy'imitsi.
