Isuzuma rishobora gukeka ko rishingiye ku bipimo by'amaraso, nka ESR cyangwa CRP, amashusho y'abaganga, na biopsy.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'ubwoko bw'indwara, nubwo akenshi ikoreshwa ari yo steroides mbere. Abantu bagera kuri 3 ku bantu 100.000 bashya barwara indwara ya vasculitis buri mwaka mu Burayi no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ku bantu barengeje imyaka 50, GCA ihitana abantu bagera kuri 24 kuri 100.000 buri mwaka. Ubwoko butandukanye bw'indwara bukunze kugaragara mu matsinda y'imyaka runaka. Muri rusange abagabo n'abagore barwara indwara imwe. Nubwo iyi ndwara yavuzwe kuva nibura mu kinyejana cya 11, ibisobanuro bya mbere birambuye byitirirwa Kussmaul na Maier mu 1866.

Isukari nke mu maraso, ni ukugabanuka kw'isukari mu maraso kugera ku rugero ruri munsi y'urusanzwe. Ibi bishobora gutera ibimenyetso bitandukanye birimo kunanirwa kuvuga neza, kutavuga nabi, urujijo, guta ubwenge, gucika intege cyangwa urupfu. Ukumva ufite inzara, ibyuya, kuzuyaza no gucika intege bishobora no kugaragara. Ibimenyetso akenshi biza vuba.
Impamvu ikunze kugaragara ni imiti ikoreshwa mu kuvura diyabete nka insuline na sulfonylureas. Ingaruka ziba nyinshi ku barwayi ba diyabete bariye bike kuruta uko bisanzwe, bagakora imyitozo ngororamubiri cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe cyangwa banyoye inzoga. Izindi mpamvu zirimo kunanirwa kw'impyiko, ibibyimba bimwe na bimwe (nka insulinoma), indwara z'umwijima, inzara, amakosa y'imikorere y'umubiri, hypoglycemia iterwa no kwiheba hamwe n'ibiyobyabwenge byinshi birimo n'inzoga. Isukari nke mu maraso ishobora kugaragara ku bana bari bazima kandi bamaze amasaha make batarya.
Igipimo cya glucose gisobanura hypoglycemia kirahinduka. Ku bantu barwaye diyabete, urugero ruri munsi ya 3.9 mmol/L (70 mg/dL) ni indwara zisuzuma indwara. Ku bantu bakuru badafite diyabete, ibimenyetso by'isukari nke mu maraso, isukari nke mu maraso, no koroherwa iyo isukari yo mu maraso igarutse ku buryo busanzwe ni byo byemeza ko barwaye. Bitabaye ibyo, urwego ruri munsi ya 2.8 kugeza kuri 3.0 mmol/L (50 kugeza 55 mg/dL) nyuma yo kutarya cyangwa nyuma yo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri ishobora gukoreshwa. Mu bana bavutse, urwego ruri munsi ya 2.2 mmol/L (40 mg/dL), cyangwa munsi ya 3.3 mmol/L (60 mg/dL) iyo ibimenyetso bigaragaye, bigaragaza ko umuntu afite hypoglycemia. Ibindi bizamini bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu kumenya impamvu birimo urugero rwa insuline na peptide ya C mu maraso.
Ku bantu barwaye diyabete, kwirinda ni uguhuza ibiryo biribwa n'ingano y'imyitozo ngororamubiri n'imiti ikoreshwa. Iyo abantu bumva ko isukari yabo iri hasi mu maraso, ni byiza gupima hakoreshejwe icyuma gipima isukari. Hari abantu bamwe bagaragaza ibimenyetso bike by’isukari nke mu maraso, kandi gupimwa buri gihe muri iri tsinda ni byiza. Uburyo bwo kuvura ni ukurya ibiryo birimo isukari nyinshi cyangwa gufata dextrose. Iyo umuntu adashobora gufata ibiryo mu kanwa, glukagoni iterwa cyangwa mu mazuru ishobora gufasha. Uburyo bwo kuvura budafite aho buhuriye na diyabete burimo no kuvura ikibazo cy’ingenzi ndetse n’indyo nziza. Ijambo "hypoglycemia" rimwe na rimwe rikoreshwa nabi mu kuvuga idiopathic postprandial syndrome, indwara ivugwaho rumwe ifite ibimenyetso bisa n'ibyo bibaho nyuma yo kurya ariko isukari isanzwe mu maraso.

Indwara yo mu mutwe (Cleidocranial dysostosis) (CCD), nanone yitwa cleidocranial dysplasia, ni indwara ivuka ikunze kwibasira amagufwa n'amenyo. Amagufwa yo mu ijosi akenshi aba adakuze neza cyangwa ntayo afite, ibyo bigatuma amatugu yegerana. Igice cy'imbere cy'agahanga akenshi ntigifunga kugeza nyuma, kandi abagirwaye akenshi baba ari bagufi ugereranyije n'ikigereranyo. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo agahanga kagaragara, amaso manini, amenyo adasanzwe, n'izuru rirambuye. Ibimenyetso biratandukanye mu bantu; icyakora, ubwenge ntabwo bukunze kugaragara.
Iyo ndwara umuntu ayikura ku babyeyi be cyangwa ikabaho nk'impinduka nshya. Iragwa mu buryo busanzwe bwo kwihitiramo. Biterwa n'inenge iri muri gene ya RUNX2 igira uruhare mu miterere y'amagufwa. Isuzuma rikekwaho hashingiwe ku bimenyetso na X-rays byemejwe n'ibizamini bya genetiki. Izindi ndwara zishobora gutera ibimenyetso nk'ibi zirimo indwara ya mandibuloacral dysplasia, pyknodysostosis, osteogenesis imperfecta, na Hajdu-Cheney syndrome.
Ubuvuzi burimo ingamba zo gushyigikira nko gukoresha igikoresho cyo kurinda umutwe n'ubuvuzi bw'amenyo. Kubagwa bishobora gukorwa kugira ngo hakosorwe ubumuga bumwe na bumwe bw'amagufwa. Icyizere cy'ubuzima muri rusange ni ibisanzwe.
Igira ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni imwe. Abagabo n'abagore bakunze kwibasirwa n'iyi ndwara. Ibisobanuro bya none by’iyi ndwara byatangiye nibura mu 1896. Iri jambo rikomoka kuri "cleido" risobanura igufwa ryo mu mutwe, "igufwa ryo mu mutwe" rikomoka ku kigereki κρανιὀς risobanura umutwe, naho "dysostosis" isobanura kurema igufwa ridasanzwe.

Sciatica ni ububabare bumanuka mu kaguru buturutse mu mugongo wo hasi. Ubu bubabare bushobora kumanuka inyuma, inyuma, cyangwa imbere y'ukuguru. Gutangira gukurura akenshi bitunguranye nyuma y’ibikorwa nko guterura ibintu biremereye, nubwo bishobora no gutangira buhoro buhoro. Ububabare bukunze kuvugwa nk'ubusasu. Ubusanzwe, ibimenyetso biba ku ruhande rumwe rw'umubiri gusa. Impamvu zimwe na zimwe zishobora gutera ububabare ku mpande zombi. Kubabara umugongo wo hasi rimwe na rimwe irahari. Intege nke cyangwa ibinya bishobora kubaho mu bice bitandukanye by'ukuguru n'ikirenge byafashwe.
Hafi 90% bya sciatica biterwa no gukomeretsa uruti rw'umugongo ku mizi y'imitsi yo mu ruhu cyangwa mu gice cyo hasi cy'umugongo. Spondylolisthesis, stenosis y'umugongo, indwara ya piriformis, ibibyimba byo mu kibuno, no gutwita ni izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera sciatica. Ikizamini cyo kuzamura amaguru agororotse gikunze gufasha mu gusuzuma indwara. Ikizamini kiba cyaragaragaje ko ari ukuri iyo, iyo ukuguru kuzamuwe mu gihe umuntu aryamye agaramye, ububabare butangira munsi y'ivi. Kenshi na kenshi amashusho y’ubuvuzi ntabwo akenewe. Ariko, amashusho ashobora kuboneka iyo imikorere y'amara cyangwa uruhago igize ikibazo, habayeho gutakaza ibyiyumvo cyangwa intege nke cyane, ibimenyetso bikaba bimaze igihe kirekire, cyangwa hari impungenge z'ikibyimba cyangwa ubwandu. Ibintu bishobora kugaragara nk'ibyo ni indwara zo mu kibuno n'indwara nka shingles hakiri kare (mbere yo kumera ibisebe).
Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bwa mbere bukoresha imiti igabanya ububabare. Ariko, ibimenyetso by'imiti igabanya ububabare n'imitsi igabanya ububabare birabura. Muri rusange abantu basabwa gukomeza gukora ibikorwa bisanzwe uko bashoboye kose. Akenshi igikenewe kugira ngo sciatica ikemuke ni igihe gusa; ku bantu bagera kuri 90% ibimenyetso birashira mu byumweru bitarenze bitandatu. Niba ububabare bukomeye kandi bugashira ibyumweru birenga bitandatu, kubagwa bishobora kuba amahitamo. Nubwo kubagwa akenshi byihutisha koroshya ububabare, ibyiza byabyo by'igihe kirekire ntibirasobanuka neza. Kubagwa bishobora kuba ngombwa iyo habayeho ingorane, nko kubura imikorere isanzwe y'amara cyangwa uruhago. Uburyo bwinshi bwo kuvura, harimo imiti ya corticosteroids, gabapentin, pregabalin, acupuncture, ubushyuhe cyangwa urubura, hamwe no gukoresha umugongo, bufite ibimenyetso bike cyangwa bike ku ikoreshwa ryabyo.
Bitewe n'uko byasobanuwe, munsi ya 1% kugeza kuri 40% by'abantu bagira sciatica mu gihe runaka. Sciatica ikunze kugaragara cyane hagati y'imyaka 40 na 59, kandi abagabo ni bo bayibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore. Iyi ndwara izwi kuva kera. Ikoreshwa rya mbere rizwi ry'ijambo "sciatica" ryatangiye mu 1451.

Arrhythmia, izwi kandi nka arrhythmia y'umutima cyangwa arrhythmia y'umutima, ni itsinda ry'indwara aho umutima utera mu buryo butari bwo, wihuta cyane, cyangwa ugenda buhoro cyane. Umuvuduko w'umutima wihuta cyane - hejuru ya beats 100 ku munota ku bantu bakuru - witwa tachycardia, naho umuvuduko w'umutima ugenda buhoro cyane - munsi ya beats 60 ku munota - witwa bradycardia. Hari ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bwa arrhythmias butagira ibimenyetso. Ibimenyetso iyo bigaragaye bishobora kuba birimo gukubita cyane cyangwa kumva umutima uhagaze hagati y’aho umutima utera. Mu bihe bikomeye cyane, hashobora kubaho kubabara umutwe, gucika intege, guhumeka nabi cyangwa kubabara mu gatuza. Nubwo ubwoko bwinshi bwa arrhythmia butari bukomeye, bumwe butera umuntu kugira ingorane nko gucika intege mu bwonko cyangwa kunanirwa k'umutima. Ibindi bishobora gutera urupfu rutunguranye.
Hari amatsinda ane y'ingenzi ya arrhythmia: extra beats, supraventricular tachycardias, ventricular arrhythmias na bradyarrhythmias. Imivuduko y'inyongera irimo kubyimba kw'imbere y'umutima, kubyimba kw'imitsi itaragera ndetse no kubyimba kw'amagufwa itaragera. Tachycardia yo mu gice cya kabiri cy'umutima irimo fibrillation y'umutima, flutter y'umutima na tachycardia yo mu gice cya gatatu cy'umutima. Indwara zo mu mitsi zirimo kugabanuka kw'imitsi mu mitsi no kugabanuka k'imitsi mu mitsi. Kudakora neza kw'umutima (Arrhythmias) biterwa n'ibibazo by'imikorere y'amashanyarazi mu mutima. Indwara zo kutagira umutima zishobora no kugaragara ku bana, ariko urwego rusanzwe rw'umuvuduko w'umutima ruratandukanye kandi ruterwa n'imyaka. Ibizamini byinshi bishobora gufasha mu gusuzuma indwara harimo electrocardiogram (ECG) na Holter monitor.
Indwara nyinshi zo kutagira icyo zivuga zishobora kuvurwa neza. Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo imiti, uburyo bwo kwa muganga nko gushyiramo pacemaker ndetse no kubagwa. Imiti ivura umuvuduko w'umutima ushobora kuba urimo imiti igabanya ubukana bw'umutima (beta blockers) cyangwa imiti igerageza kugarura umuvuduko w'umutima usanzwe nka procainamide. Iri tsinda rya nyuma rishobora kugira ingaruka mbi zikomeye, cyane cyane iyo rifashwe igihe kirekire. Utwuma dukoresha imbaraga zifasha umutima gutera buhoro. Abafite umutima utari mwiza bakunze kuvurwa n'imiti igabanya amaraso kugira ngo bagabanye ibyago byo guhura n'ibibazo. Abafite ibimenyetso bikomeye by’indwara yo kuruhuka kw’umutima (arrhythmia) bashobora kuvurwa byihutirwa bakoresheje amashanyarazi agenzurwa mu buryo bwo kuvura indwara z’umutima cyangwa indwara yo kuruhuka kw’umutima (defibrillation).
Indwara yo kutagira ubushake bwo kuruhuka (Arrhythmia) yibasira abantu babarirwa muri za miriyoni. Mu Burayi no muri Amerika ya Ruguru, guhera mu 2014, indwara ya atrial fibrillation yibasira abantu bagera kuri 2% kugeza kuri 3% by'abaturage. Gucika intege kw'imitsi no kugabanuka kw'imitsi byatumye abantu 112.000 bapfa mu 2013, ugereranyije n'abantu 29.000 mu 1990. Impfu z’umutima zitunguranye ni zo zitera hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’impfu ziterwa n’indwara z’umutima n’iz’umutima ndetse n’impfu zigera kuri 15% ku isi yose. Hafi 80% by'impfu zitunguranye z'umutima ziterwa no kugabanuka k'umutima mu mitsi. Indwara yo kutagira ubushake bwo kuruhuka (Arrhythmias) ishobora kubaho mu myaka iyo ari yo yose ariko ikunze kugaragara cyane mu bantu bakuze.

Guanfacine, igurishwa ku izina rya Tenex n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara yo kudakora neza kw'attention (ADHD) n'umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso. Ni uburyo bwo kuvura ADHD butari bwiza cyane ndetse n'umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira, kuribwa mu nda, kuma mu kanwa, ibibazo by'imibonano mpuzabitsina, no kuribwa umutwe. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo guhangayika, umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi, kwiheba, n'ibibazo by'inkari. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa. Bisa nkaho bikora binyuze mu gukora kwa α 2A receptors mu bwonko bityo bigabanura imikorere y'urusobe rw'imitsi.
Guanfacine yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1986. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ku kwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri £60 mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi 7.11 USD. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 131 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni eshanu.

Kuruka, bizwi kandi nka emesis, ni ugusohora ku ngufu ibiri mu nda binyuze mu kanwa cyangwa mu mazuru nta bushake. Bifitanye isano no kugira isesemi kandi akenshi bifata umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo umwuma, umuyaga uturuka ku ruhu, imikorere mibi ya electrolyte, kwangirika kw'amenyo, no gucika k'umuyoboro w'amaraso. Kuruka bitandukanye no kongera kunyara, kuko kongera kunyara bidasaba kubyimba igifu cyangwa isesemi.
Impamvu zikunze kugaragara zirimo indwara y'igifu n'imiti imwe n'imwe cyangwa uburozi. Izindi mpamvu zirimo indwara ya cannabis hyperemesis syndrome, indwara yo kuruka cyclic, kuziba amara, hepatitis, kwiyongera k'umuvuduko mu bwonko, migraine, ibibazo byo kurya, ketoacidosis ya diyabete, isesemi, isesemi no kuruka cyangwa gutwita, appendicitis, na labyrinthite. Ku bana, impamvu zishobora kuba zirimo reflux, volvulus, pyloric stenosis, indwara yo mu nzira y'inkari, na intussusception.
Ubuvuzi burimo kugerageza kunywa ibinyobwa bihagije. Indwara zo kurwanya emergency kwishyura bikoreshwa mu kugabanya ibimenyetso. Hariho kandi ibimenyetso bimwe na bimwe bigaragaza ko umuntu ahumeka inzoga ya isopropyl. Iyo habayeho umwuma mu mubiri, amazi yo mu mitsi ashobora kuba ingirakamaro. Ibimenyetso biteye impungenge birimo kubabara mu nda cyane, amaraso mu birutsi, kuribwa umutwe cyane, ibimenyetso byo kubura amazi mu mubiri, no kuruka icyatsi. Kuruka ni yo mpamvu igera kuri 1.6% by'abagana abaganga b'imiryango muri Ositaraliya.

Kanseri ya porositate ni kanseri ikura muri porositate, imvubura iri mu buryo bw'imyororokere bw'abagabo. Kanseri nyinshi za prostate zikura buhoro buhoro; icyakora, zimwe zikura vuba. Uturemangingo twa kanseri dushobora gukwirakwira mu bice by'umubiri, cyane cyane mu magufwa no mu tunyangingo tw'amaraso. Mu ntangiriro bishobora kutagira ibimenyetso bitera. Mu ntambwe za nyuma, bishobora gutera ingorane zo kunyara, amaraso mu nkari cyangwa ububabare mu kibuno, umugongo, cyangwa iyo uri kunyara. Indwara izwi nka benign prostatic hyperplasia ishobora kugaragaza ibimenyetso bisa. Ibindi bimenyetso bya nyuma bishobora kuba birimo kumva unaniwe bitewe n'urugero ruto rw'uturemangingo dutukura mu maraso.
Ibintu byongera ibyago byo kurwara kanseri ya prostate birimo gusaza, amateka y'umuryango warwaye iyi ndwara, n'ubwoko bw'abantu. Hafi 99% by'abandura iyi ndwara biba ku bagabo barengeje imyaka 50. Kugira uwo mu muryango we wo ku rwego rwa mbere urwaye iyi ndwara byongera ibyago byikubye kabiri cyangwa gatatu. Izindi mpamvu zishobora kuba zirimo indyo irimo inyama nyinshi zatunganyijwe, inyama zitukura cyangwa amata cyangwa imboga zimwe na zimwe nke. Habonetse isano ifitanye isano na gonorrhea, ariko impamvu y'iyi sano ntiramenyekana. Ingaruka ziyongera zifitanye isano n'impinduka za BRCA. Kanseri ya porositate ipimwa hakoreshejwe biopsy. Gufata amashusho mu buvuzi bishobora gukorwa kugira ngo hamenyekane niba kanseri yarakwirakwiriye mu bindi bice by'umubiri.
Gusuzuma kanseri ya prostate biravugwaho rumwe. Antigen yihariye ya prostate Gupima (PSA) byongera uburyo bwo gupima kanseri, ariko biravugwaho rumwe niba binoza umusaruro. Gufata ibyemezo ukurikije amakuru bigirwa inama iyo bigeze ku gusuzuma abantu bafite imyaka 55 kugeza kuri 69. Ikizamini, iyo gikozwe, kiba gifite ishingiro ku bantu bafite igihe kirekire cyo kubaho. Nubwo imiti igabanya kanseri ya 5α-reductase isa nkaho igabanya ibyago byo kurwara kanseri y’urwego rwo hasi, ntabwo igira ingaruka ku byago byo kurwara kanseri y’urwego rwo hejuru bityo ntigomba kwirindwa. Kongeramo vitamine cyangwa imyunyu ngugu bisa nkaho ntacyo bigiraho ingaruka ku ngaruka.
Ibibazo byinshi bicungwa hakoreshejwe igenzura ryimbitse cyangwa gutegereza neza. Ubundi buryo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo kubaga, gukoresha imirasire, gukoresha imisemburo cyangwa imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara. Iyo bigaragaye gusa muri prostate, bishobora gukira. Ku bantu iyi ndwara yakwirakwiriye mu magufwa, imiti igabanya ububabare, bisphosphonates n'ubuvuzi bugamije, n'ibindi, bishobora kuba ingirakamaro. Ibisubizo biterwa n'imyaka y'umuntu n'izindi ngorane z'ubuzima ndetse n'uburyo kanseri ikabije kandi ikaba nini. Abagabo benshi barwaye kanseri ya prostate ntibapfa bazize iyo ndwara. Igipimo cy'imyaka 5 yo kubaho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ni 98%. Ku isi yose, ni yo kanseri ya kabiri ikunze kugaragara cyane, ikaba n'impamvu ya gatanu y'impfu zikomoka kuri kanseri ku bagabo. Mu 2018, byagaragaye ku bagabo miliyoni 1.2 kandi byahitanye abantu 359.000. Ni yo kanseri ikunze kugaragara cyane mu bagabo mu bihugu 84, ikaba ikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu byateye imbere. Igipimo cyakomeje kwiyongera mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Gupima indwara byariyongereye cyane mu myaka ya 1980 na 1990 mu bice byinshi bitewe n’ubwiyongere bw’ibizamini bya PSA. Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe ku bagabo bapfuye bazize impamvu zidahuye bwagaragaje ko kanseri ya prostate iri hagati ya 30% na 70% by'abafite imyaka irenga 60.

Scoliosis ni indwara aho umugongo w'umuntu uba ufite imiterere y'uruhande. Ubusanzwe uruhererekane rugira ishusho ya "S"- cyangwa "C" mu ngero eshatu. Muri bimwe, urugero rw'umuvuduko rurahamye, mu gihe mu bindi, ruriyongera uko igihe kigenda gihita. Ubusanzwe scoliosis yoroheje ntabwo itera ibibazo, ariko indwara zikomeye zishobora kubangamira guhumeka. Ubusanzwe, nta bubabare bubaho.
Impamvu y’icyorezo kinini ntiramenyekana, ariko bikekwa ko iterwa n’uruvange rw’ibintu bigize imiterere y’umubiri n’ibidukikije. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo n'abandi bagize umuryango bagizweho ingaruka. Bishobora kandi guterwa n'indi ndwara nko kubabara imitsi, indwara yo mu bwonko, indwara ya Marfan, n'ibibyimba nka neurofibromatosis. Isuzuma ryemezwa hakoreshejwe imirasire ya X. Scoliosis ikunze gushyirwa mu byiciro bibiri: aho umugongo uba uhagaze, cyangwa aho umugongo uri munsi uba usanzwe.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'urugero rw'uburemere, aho buherereye, n'impamvu. Imirongo mito ishobora kurebwa buri gihe. Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo gutera inkunga umubiri, imyitozo ngororamubiri yihariye, no kubaga. Igikoresho cyo gukingira kigomba gushyirwa ku muntu kandi kigakoreshwa buri munsi kugeza igihe gukura kurangiye. Imyitozo yihariye ishobora gukoreshwa kugira ngo igabanye ibyago byo kugabanuka kw'ibinure. Bishobora gukorwa byonyine cyangwa hamwe n'ubundi buryo bwo kuvura nko gusimbuza. Ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko gukoresha imiti igabanya ubukana bw'imirire, inyongeramusaruro, cyangwa imyitozo ngororamubiri bishobora gukumira ko indwara ikomeza kwiyongera ni bike cyane. Ariko, imyitozo ngororamubiri iracyasabwa kubera izindi nyungu zayo ku buzima.
Indwara ya Scoliosis igaragara ku bantu bagera kuri 3%. Bikunze kubaho cyane hagati y'imyaka 10 na 20. Abagore bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagabo. Iri jambo rikomoka kuri risobanura "guhindagurika".

Gynecomastia ni ukwiyongera kw'ibere rimwe cyangwa yombi ku bagabo bitari kanseri. Bamwe bakoresha iri jambo gusa iyo kwiyongera kw'umubiri biterwa n'ingingo z'umubiri, kandi bagakoresha ijambo pseudogynaecomastia iyo kwiyongera kw'umubiri ari ingaruka z'ibinure byinshi. Rimwe na rimwe ububabare bushobora kugaragara. Iyi ndwara ishobora gutera ihungabana ryo mu mutwe.
Gynecomastia ishobora kuba isanzwe ku bana bavutse bitewe no guhura na estrogene n'umubyeyi, mu gihe cy'ubugimbi, no ku bagabo bakuze. Muri rusange izi manza ntizisaba andi maperereza. Bishobora kandi kujyana n'umubyibuho ukabije, indwara z'umwijima, impyiko zinanirwa gukora neza, kanseri zimwe na zimwe, indwara ya tiroyide, imiti imwe n'imwe n'imiti yo kwidagadura, indwara ya Klinefelter, hamwe n'imirire mibi. Uburyo bw'ibanze akenshi busaba kwiyongera kwa estrogen cyangwa kugabanuka k'urugero rwa androgen.
Indwara zibaho mu gihe cy'ubugimbi muri rusange zishira mu myaka ibiri kandi zisaba gusa kwitabwaho. Iyo ndwara ikunze gukemuka iyo impamvu nyamukuru ikemutse. Imiti nka tamoxifens cyangwa clomiphene igira akamaro iyo ikoreshejwe hakiri kare. Mu bihe bimaze igihe kinini, kubagwa, nko gukata amavuta cyangwa gukata amenyo, ni bwo buryo bwonyine bufatika.
Gynecomastia yibasira abagabo bagera kuri 35% kandi ikunze kugaragara cyane hagati y'imyaka 50 na 69. Iboneka mu bana bavutse bagera kuri 90% na 60% by'abahungu mu gihe cy'ubwangavu. Ni yo mpamvu ikunze gutuma abagabo bashaka ubufasha bw'abaganga kubera ikibazo cy'ibere. Ibisobanuro by'iyi ndwara byanditswe na Galen mu kinyejana cya 2.

Migraine ni indwara isanzwe y'imyakura irangwa no kurwara umutwe kenshi, ubusanzwe mu gice kimwe cyawo, bishobora kumara kugeza ku minsi itatu. Ishobora kujyana n'isesemi, kuruka no kutihanganira urumuri cyangwa amajwi.
Iterwa n'uruvange rw'ibidukikije n'uturemangingo, kandi ifata abagore kurusha abagabo. Ivurwa hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ububabare n'imiti yihariye; ifata hafi 15% by'abantu ku isi.
Migraine ni indwara isanzwe y'imyakura irangwa no kurwara umutwe kenshi, ubusanzwe ufite ubukana buri hagati cyangwa bukabije. Ubusanzwe, umutwe ufata igice kimwe cy'umutwe, uteragura, kandi umara amasaha make kugeza ku minsi 3. Ibimenyetso bijyana nabyo bishobora kuba birimo isesemi, kuruka, no kumva urumuri, amajwi, cyangwa impumuro. Ububabare muri rusange burushaho kwiyongera iyo umuntu akoze imyitozo ngororamubiri. Abantu bagera kuri kimwe cya gatatu barwaye indwara bafite aura: ubusanzwe ni igihe gito cyo kutabona neza kigaragaza ko umutwe ugiye gufata vuba. Rimwe na rimwe, aura ishobora kubaho igakurikirwa n'umutwe muto cyangwa ntihagire umutwe na mba.
Bikekwa ko indwara ya Migraine iterwa n'uruvange rw'ibintu bifitanye isano n'ibidukikije n'uturemangingo. Hafi bibiri bya gatatu by'abarwayi bafite abo mu miryango yabo nabo bayirwaye. Ihindagurika ry'urugero rw'imisemburo naryo rishobora kugira uruhare, kuko indwara ya migraine igira ingaruka ku bahungu benshi gato kurusha abakobwa mbere y'ubwangavu n'abagore bakubye inshuro ebyiri cyangwa eshatu ugereranyije n'abagabo. Ibyago byo kurwara migraine bikunze kugabanuka mu gihe cyo gutwita no nyuma yo gucura. Uburyo indwara ikora ntabwo buzwi neza. Icyakora, bikekwa ko bifitanye isano n'imyakura n'imitsi y'amaraso yo mu bwonko.
Uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura ni ugukoresha imiti yoroheje igabanya ububabare nka ibuprofen na parasetamol (acetaminophen) ku ndwara y'umutwe, imiti ivura isesemi, no kwirinda ibintu byayitera. Imiti yihariye nka triptans cyangwa ergotamines ishobora gukoreshwa ku bantu imiti yoroheje y'ububabare idakora. Kafeyine ishobora kongerwa kuri ibi byavuzwe haruguru. Imiti iterwa mu mitsi ("intravenous") mu bitaro by'ubutabazi nayo irashyigikiwe. Imiti myinshi ni ingirakamaro mu gukumira ibitero by'indwara, birimo metoprolol, valproate, topiramate, na anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody.
Ku isi yose, abantu bagera kuri 15% bibasirwa n'indwara ya migraine. Akenshi bitangira mu gihe cy'ubugimbi kandi bikaba bibi cyane mu myaka yo hagati y'ubuzima. Mu 2016, ni imwe mu mpamvu zikunze gutera ubumuga.
Ibisobanuro bya mbere bihuye na migraine biri mu nyandiko ya "Papyrus Ebers", yanditswe ahagana mu 1500 mbere ya Yesu mu Misiri ya kera. Ijambo "migraine" rikomoka mu kigereki ἡμικρανία ("hemikrania"), 'ububabare mu gice cy'umutwe', kuva ἡμι- ("hemi-"), 'igice', na κρανίον ("kranion"), 'igihanga'.

Cellulite ni indwara iterwa na bagiteri ifata ibice by'imbere by'uruhu. Bigira ingaruka ku buryo bwihariye ku ruhu rw'uruhu n'ibinure biri munsi y'umubiri. Ibimenyetso birimo agace k'umutuku kagenda kiyongera mu bunini mu minsi mike. Imbibi z'agace k'umutuku muri rusange ntabwo ziba zityaye kandi uruhu rushobora kubyimba. Nubwo umutuku ukunda guhinduka umweru iyo hashyizweho igitutu, si ko bigenda buri gihe. Agace k'ubwandu gakunze kubabaza. Imiyoboro y'amaraso ishobora kugira ingaruka rimwe na rimwe, kandi umuntu ashobora kugira umuriro no kumva ananiwe.
Amaguru n'isura ni byo bikunze kugaragara cyane, nubwo cellulitis ishobora kugaragara ku gice icyo ari cyo cyose cy'umubiri. Ukuguru gukunze kugira ingaruka nyuma yo kuvunika k'uruhu. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera ikibazo zirimo umubyibuho ukabije, kubyimba amaguru, no gusaza. Ku ndwara zo mu maso, akenshi si ko bibaho mbere y’uko uruhu rucika. Bagiteri zikunze kwibasirwa cyane ni streptococci na "Staphylococcus aureus". Bitandukanye na cellulitis, erysipelas ni indwara ya bagiteri ifata ibice by'uruhu biri hejuru cyane, ikaba ifite agace k'umutuku gafite impande zisobanutse neza, kandi akenshi ifitanye isano n'umuriro. Ubusanzwe indwara iterwa n'ibimenyetso n'ibimenyetso byayo, mu gihe gupima uturemangingo bidakunze kubaho. Mbere yo gusuzuma indwara, indwara zikomeye nka infection y’amagufwa cyangwa fasciitis yo mu igufwa igomba kwirengagizwa.
Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara zandurira mu mubiri, nka cephalexin, amoxicillin cyangwa cloxacillin. Abafite ubwivumbure bukomeye kuri penisiline bashobora guhabwa umuti witwa erythromycin cyangwa clindamycin. Iyo ikibazo kibangamiye S. aureus (MRSA) idashobora guterwa na methicillin, doxycycline cyangwa trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole ishobora kandi kuba yagirwa inama. Hari impungenge zijyanye no kuba hari amashyira cyangwa ubwandu bwa MRSA bwabayeho mbere. Kuzamura agace kanduye bishobora kuba ingirakamaro, kimwe n'imiti yica ububabare.
Ingorane zishobora kubaho zirimo kurema ibibyimba. Abantu bagera kuri 95% barushaho kuba beza nyuma y'iminsi 7 kugeza ku 10 yo kuvurwa. Abarwaye diyabete, ariko, bakunze kugira ingaruka mbi kurushaho. Indwara ya selulite yagaragaye ku bantu bagera kuri miliyoni 21.2 mu 2015. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika abantu bagera kuri 2 kuri buri 1.000 buri mwaka bafite ikibazo kigira ingaruka ku kirenge cyo hasi. Indwara ya selulite mu 2015 yahitanye abantu bagera ku 16.900 ku isi yose. Mu Bwongereza, indwara ya cellulitis ni yo yatumye 1.6% by'abantu bajyanwa mu bitaro.

Clopidogrel, igurishwa ku izina ry'ubucuruzi rya Plavix n'indi, ni umuti ugabanya platelet ukoreshwa mu kugabanya ibyago byo kurwara indwara z'umutima na stroke ku bafite ibyago byinshi byo kurwara. Ikoreshwa kandi hamwe na aspirine mu ndwara z'umutima no nyuma yo gushyiramo stent yo mu mitsi y'umutima (uburyo bwo kuvura indwara zo mu mitsi). Ifatwa mu kanwa. Ingaruka zitangira mu gihe cy'amasaha abiri kandi zimara iminsi itanu.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuribwa umutwe, isesemi, gukomereka byoroshye, kuribwa no gushya. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zirimo kuva amaraso no kuvura indwara ya thrombocytopenic purpura. Nubwo nta kimenyetso cy'ingaruka mbi zituruka ku gukoresha iyo miti mu gihe cyo gutwita, kuyikoresha ntibyigwa neza. Clopidogrel iri mu bwoko bwa thienopyridine bw’imiti igabanya ubukana bw’amaraso. Ikora mu gukumira bidasubirwaho receptor yitwa P2Y 12 kuri platelets.
Clopidogrel yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imiti mu 1982, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1997. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Igiciro cy'igurishwa ry'ibicuruzwa mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere ni hagati y'amadolari y'Amerika 0.77–31.59 ku kwezi. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ukwezi kw'ubuvuzi kugura munsi y'amadolari 25 y'Amerika. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 40 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abantu barenga miliyoni 19.

Baclofen, igurishwa ku izina rya Lioresal n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura imitsi idakora neza nko mu gukomereka k'umugongo cyangwa indwara ya sclerosis nyinshi. Ishobora kandi gukoreshwa mu kuvura imitsi no kubabara mu mitsi hafi y'iherezo ry'ubuzima. Ifatwa mu kanwa cyangwa igashyirwa mu muyoboro w'umugongo.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira, gucika intege, no kuzerera. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kubaho iyo baclofen ihagaze vuba harimo gukubita no gucika intege. Gukoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita ntabwo bisobanutse neza mu gihe gukoresha mu gihe cyo konsa bishobora kuba ari byiza. Bikekwa ko bikora mu kugabanya imikorere y'uturemangingo tw'ubwonko.
Baclofen yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1977. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ku gipimo cya 50mg ku munsi, gutanga ukwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri £5.50 mu 2020. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 8.40. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 140 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni enye.

Mathieu Ngirumpatse (wavutse mu 1939) ni umunyapolitiki w’Umunyarwanda, wari perezida wa MRND.
Mu gihe cy’amezi atatu mu 1994, Abatutsi bagera ku 800.000 bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, mu gihe Abahutu batari bashyigikiye iyo Jenoside na bo bishwe. Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwagaragaje ko ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi bwari bushingiye ku mugambi wo kubarimbura. Ngirumpatse yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu ku ya 21 Ukuboza 2011 kubera uruhare rwe muri jenoside.

Umurenge wa Rukara ni umwe mu mirenge 12 igize Akarere ka Kayonza, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, mu Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Rukara wari utuwe n'abaturage 38 231.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Rukara ni umwe mu mirenge 12 y'Akarere ka Kayonza.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Rukara wari utuwe n'abaturage 31 176. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 38 231.

Ferdinand Nahimana (wavutse ku ya 15 Kamena 1950) ni umuhanga mu by'amateka w'Umunyarwanda, wahamwe n'icyaha cyo gushishikariza abantu gukora jenoside kubera uruhare yagize muri jenoside yo mu Rwanda mu 1994.
Nahimana yari umwe mu bashinze radiyo ya Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines (RTLM), yatangazaga amakuru na poropagande byafashije mu guhuza ubwicanyi no gushishikariza urwango rwakorewe Abatutsi n'Abahutu baciriritse.
Ferdinand Nahimana yavutse ku ya 15 Nyakanga muri komini Gatonde, muri perefegitura ya Ruhengeri. Yubatse afite abana bane.
Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu mateka yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Paris Diderot. Hagati ya 1979 na 2007, yasohoye ibitabo byinshi n'inyandiko ku mateka y'u Rwanda.
Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda.
Hakurikijwe amasezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Uburezi bw'Amashuri Makuru ushinzwe Umuco n'Ubushakashatsi mu bya Siyansi. Nahimana yari umwe mu bagize ishyaka rya politiki rya Habyarimana, ishyaka ry’aba-repubulikani riharanira demokarasi n’iterambere.
Hagati ya 1979 na 1994, Nahimana bivugwa ko yanditse akanasohora inyandiko zishishikariza imyigaragambyo yo kurwanya Abatutsi n'Abahutu baciriritse.
Amaze kwirukanwa muri Radiyo y'Igihugu y'u Rwanda mu 1993, yagize uruhare mu ishingwa rya RTLM, kandi nk'uko Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rubivuga, yabaye umuyobozi wayo. Kubera ubwo bufatanye, yashinjwe kuba "yarashishikarije mu buryo butaziguye" ubwicanyi. Hagati ya Mata 1993 na 31 Nyakanga 1994, Ferdinand Nahimana yashinjwe gutegura, kuyobora no gushyigikira ibiganiro bya RTLM. Umushinjacyaha wa TPIR yavuze ko “yari azi gahunda n’ingaruka izo gahunda zigira ku baturage”.
Yanashinjwe kandi kuba yarateguye, abifashijwemo na murumuna we, inama hagati ya MRND n'igisirikare cy'Interahamwe muri Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri, agamije kuganira ku bwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi n'Abahutu.
Muri Mata 1994, ubwo imvururu zatangiraga mu Rwanda nyuma y'iyicwa rya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, ambasade y'Ubufaransa yafashe Ferdinand Nahimana. Ku itariki ya 12 Mata, ambasade y'Ubufaransa yarahungishijwe maze Nahimana, hamwe n'umuryango we n'abandi bari barahahungiye, bajyanwa mu Burundi. Uburundi ntibwari bwiteguye kwakira iri tsinda ry'impunzi, bityo Nahimana yoherezwa mu ndege ku ya 17 Mata i Bukavu. [5] Nahimana n'izindi mpunzi basubijwe mu Rwanda ku ya 23 Mata. [6] Nahimana yaje gutabwa muri yombi muri Kameruni ku ya 27 Werurwe 1996.
Ferdinand Nahimana yashinjwe gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside, aburanishwa n’Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR), mu rubanza rwari rufitanye isano n’uruhare rw’itangazamakuru muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yaburanye ari kumwe na Hassan Ngeze na Jean-Bosco Barayagwiza, na bo bari bafitanye isano na radiyo RTLM. Nahimana yahakanye ibyaha yashinjwaga, anavuga ko atari afite ububasha bwo kugenzura ibiganiro bya RTLM mu gihe cya Jenoside. Yagize ati: “Sinashoboraga kumenya RTLM yo muri icyo gihe n’iyo yariho mbere ya tariki ya 6 Mata. Yari yarigaruriwe n’abahezanguni, ubu bitwa intagondwa, bafite imyumvire n’uburyo bwo gukora ibintu ntari nsangiye na bo.”".
"Imanza z'urwango mu itangazamakuru " zavuzweho cyane kuko ari bwo bwa mbere kuva imanza za Nuremberg ziburanishwa nk'icyaha cy'intambara. Ku itariki ya 3 Ukuboza 2003, Ferdinand Nahimana yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu, icyaha cya jenoside, umugambi wo gukora jenoside, gushishikariza, mu buryo butaziguye kandi mu ruhame, gukora jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Hassan Ngeze nawe yahawe igihano cy'igifungo cya burundu, naho Jean Bosco Barayagwiza akatirwa igifungo cy'imyaka 35. Nubwo ibihano bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bwisanzure bw'itangazamakuru, Ikigo cy'Abanyamakuru Badafite Imipaka cyishimiye ibyavuye mu rubanza.
Nubwo umunyamategeko we w’Umufaransa Jean-Marie Biju-Duval yavuze ko Nahimana, washinze Radio Television Libre des Mille Collines (RTLM), atakigize uruhare na ruto kuri radiyo guhera ku ya 6 Mata 1994, yakatiwe kubera inshingano ze nk’umukozi mukuru muri RTLM.
Uyu muhanga mu by'amateka w'Umunyarwanda yahamijwe icyaha cyo kuba ntacyo yakoze kugira ngo ahagarike ibikorwa bibi bya radiyo ya RTLM nyuma y'itariki ya 6 Mata 1994, nk'uko urubanza rwabimutegetse, yari afite urwego rushinzwe abakozi ba radiyo.
Ferdinand Nahimana yajuririye icyaha cye, maze urubanza rwaburanishijwe n'Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rutangira ku ya 16 Mutarama 2007. Ku itariki ya 28 Ugushyingo 2007, Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rwamugabanyirije igihano cy'igifungo kigera ku myaka 30. Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rwatesheje agaciro bimwe mu byaha bye, cyane cyane ibyari byarabayeho mbere ya 1994. Urugereko rw'Ubujurire rwanatesheje agaciro umwanzuro wa mbere w'uko hari amasezerano hagati ya RTLM, CDR, na Kangura yo gufasha mu gukora jenoside. Bityo, yakuyeho ibirego byaregwaga Nahimana hakurikijwe ingingo ya 6 (1) ya Sitati, ariko ishyigikira ibyari bikubiye mu ngingo ya 6 (3)—ni ukuvuga ibyo "gushishikariza mu buryo butaziguye kandi mu ruhame gukora jenoside no gutoteza nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu" binyuze mu biganiro bya RTLM nyuma y'itariki ya 6 Mata 1994. Nk’uko JusticeInfo.net ibivuga:
Mu Kuboza 2008, yimuriwe muri Mali ava Arusha muri Tanzaniya. Mu 2016, yararekuwe.
Impaka ku cyaha cyo guhamwa n'icyaha.
Igitabo cyo mu 2010 cyanditswe n'umunyamakuru akaba n'umuhanga mu by'amateka Hervé Deguine kivuga ko impamvu zakoreshejwe mu rubanza rwa Nahimana zari zishingiye ku bimenyetso bike cyane uretse ko ari we washinze kandi akaba n'umwe mu ba nyiri radiyo, agaragaza ingingo n'ibimenyetso bifatika birwanya icyaha cye. Nubwo Deguine ubwe yagize uruhare mu guhamwa n'icyaha kwa Nahimana, asoza igitabo cye yemeza ko hashingiwe ku bimenyetso by'urukiko, Nahimana agomba kurekurwa. [10]

Melatonin ni imisemburo irekurwa cyane cyane n'agace ka pineal gatunganya uruziga rw'ibitotsi n'ibikanguro. Nk'inyongeramusaruro mu mirire, ikunze gukoreshwa mu kuvura ibibazo byo gusinzira by'igihe gito, nko mu gihe cyo gutinda mu ndege cyangwa akazi ko ku kazi, kandi akenshi inyobwa mu kanwa. Nyamara, ibimenyetso by'akamaro kayo kuri iyi mikoreshereze ntabwo bikomeye. Isuzuma ryakozwe mu 2017 ryagaragaje ko gusinzira byatangiye kwihuta iminota itandatu iyo umuntu akoreshejwe ariko nta gihindutse cyagaragaye mu gihe cyose asinziriye. Umuti wa melatonin receptor agonist ramelteon ushobora gukora neza kimwe n'inyongeramusaruro za melatonin.
Ingaruka mbi zituruka ku nyongeramusaruro ni nkeya iyo umuntu ahawe dose nke mu gihe gito. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo gusinzira, kuribwa umutwe, isesemi, impiswi, no kurota inzozi zidasanzwe. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa. Gukoresha kandi ntibikwiye ku bantu bafite ibibazo by'umwijima.
Mu nyamaswa (harimo n'abantu), melatonin igira uruhare mu guhuza imikorere y'umubiri, harimo igihe cyo gusinzira no kubyuka, kugenzura umuvuduko w'amaraso, no kororoka kw'ibihe bitandukanye. Ingaruka nyinshi zayo ziterwa no gukora kwa receptor za melatonin, mu gihe izindi ziterwa n'uruhare rwayo nk'ingufu zirwanya uburozi. Mu bimera, bikora mu kurinda stress ya oxidative. Iboneka kandi mu biribwa bitandukanye.
Melatonin yavumbuwe mu 1958. Igurishwa ku isoko muri Kanada na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika; mu Bwongereza, ni umuti utangwa na muganga gusa. Ibicuruzwa by'ukwezi bigura hagati y'amadolari ya Amerika 1 na 4 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Mu Bwongereza, ibicuruzwa bya buri kwezi bitwara NHS ibiro bigera kuri 15. Ntabwo byemewe n'Ikigo gishinzwe ibiribwa n'imiti muri Amerika (FDA) ku ikoreshwa ry'ubuvuzi iryo ari ryo ryose. Muri Ositaraliya no mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, ikoreshwa mu kugorana gusinzira ku bantu barengeje imyaka 54. Mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zo kubura ibitotsi ku bana. Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi mu 2007.

Haloperidol, igurishwa ku izina ry'ubucuruzi rya Haldol n'indi, ni umuti usanzwe uvura indwara zo mu mutwe. Haloperidol ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ya schizophrenia, tics muri Tourette syndrome, mania muri bipolar disorder, isesemi no kuruka, delirium, agitations, acute psychosis, hamwe no kubona ibintu mu buryo butunguranye mu gihe cyo kureka inzoga. Ishobora gukoreshwa mu kanwa cyangwa mu guterwa mu mitsi cyangwa mu mitsi. Haloperidol isanzwe ikora mu minota 30 kugeza kuri 60. Umuti ukora igihe kirekire ushobora gukoreshwa nk'urushinge buri byumweru bine ku bantu barwaye schizophrenia cyangwa izindi ndwara zifitanye isano, bibagirwa cyangwa bakanga gufata umuti mu kanwa.
Haloperidol ishobora gutera indwara yo kwimuka izwi nka tardive dyskinesia ishobora kuba ihoraho. Indwara y’imitsi itera indwara ya Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome hamwe no kongera igihe cya QT bishobora kubaho. Ku bantu bakuze bafite indwara yo mu mutwe iterwa no kwibagirwa, ibyago byo gupfa byiyongera. Iyo ifashwe mu gihe cyo gutwita ishobora guteza ibibazo ku mwana. Ntibikwiye gukoreshwa ku bantu barwaye indwara ya Parkinson.
Haloperidol yavumbuwe mu 1958 na Paul Janssen. Yakozwe muri pethidine (meperidine). Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Ni wo muti usanzwe ukoreshwa cyane wo kurwanya indwara zo mu mutwe. Birahendutse cyane. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 296 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni imwe.

Leptospirose ni indwara iterwa na bagiteri "Leptospira", ikwirakwizwa cyane cyane n'inkari z'imbeba n'izindi nyamaswa. Ibimenyetso byayo bishobora kuba bike, nko kuribwa umutwe n'umuriro, cyangwa bikomeye, nko kuva amaraso mu bihaha cyangwa "méningite".
Ikunze kugaragara mu turere dushyuha, cyane cyane nyuma y'imvura nyinshi. Ivurwa n'imiti yica bagiteri, kandi buri mwaka yandura abantu bagera kuri miliyoni imwe ku isi.
Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba bike (kuribwa umutwe, kuribwa imikaya n'umuriro) cyangwa bikomeye (kuva amaraso mu bihaha cyangwa "méningite"). Indwara ya Weil, ubwoko bukomeye bwa leptospirose, itera umuhondo (uruhu n'amaso bihinduka umuhondo), kunanirwa kw'impyiko no kuva amaraso. Kuva amaraso mu bihaha biterwa na leptospirose byitwa «"syndrome" ikomeye yo kuva amaraso mu bihaha».
Impamvu n'ikwirakwira.
Ubwoko burenga icumi bwa "Leptospira" butera indwara ku bantu. Inyamaswa zo mu gasozi n'izo mu rugo zishobora gukwirakwiza iyi ndwara, cyane cyane imbeba. Bagiteri yandurira ku bantu binyuze mu nkari z'inyamaswa, cyangwa mu mazi n'ubutaka byanduzwa n'izo nkari, iyo bigeze ku maso, ku munwa, ku mazuru cyangwa ku ruhu rwakomeretse.
Mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere, ikunze kwibasira abahinzi n'abakene batuye ahantu hafite isuku nke. Mu bihugu bikize, ibaho nyuma y'imvura nyinshi cyangwa mu bikorwa byo hanze mu turere dushyuha kandi dutose.
Isuzuma, kwirinda no kuvura.
Akenshi isuzumwa hapimwa "anticorps" zirwanya bagiteri cyangwa ADN yayo mu maraso.
Kuyirinda bikubiyemo kwambara ibikoresho byo kwirinda igihe ukorana n'inyamaswa zishobora kuba zanduye, gukaraba nyuma yo gukora ku mbeba no kugabanya imbeba aho abantu batuye n'aho bakorera. "Doxycycline" ifasha kwirinda kwandura. Inkingo z'abantu zigira akamaro gake, naho iz'amatungo ziraboneka cyane. Uwanduye avurwa n'imiti yica bagiteri nka "doxycycline", "pénicilline" cyangwa "ceftriaxone". Muri rusange, 5–10 % by'abarwayi barapfa, ariko iyo ibihaha byafashwe, ibyago byo gupfa bigera kuri 50–70 %.
Bivugwa ko buri mwaka abantu bagera kuri miliyoni imwe ku isi barwara leptospirose, abagera ku 58 900 bakayihitanwa na yo. Ikunze kugaragara mu turere dushyuha ariko ishobora kuboneka ahantu hose, kandi ibyorezo bishobora kuvuka nyuma y'imvura nyinshi. Yasobanuwe bwa mbere n'umuganga Adolf Weil mu 1886 mu Ubudage.

Konsa (mu Gifaransa: "allaitement maternel"; mu Cyongereza: "breastfeeding") ni uguha abana bato amata y'ibere ry'umubyeyi. Abahanga mu by'ubuzima basaba ko umwana atangira konka mu isaha ya mbere avutse, kandi akonka buri gihe abishatse.
Konsa bigirira akamaro umwana n'umubyeyi: birinda umwana indwara nyinshi kandi bihendutse kurusha amata y'ifu. Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima usaba konsa gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere, hanyuma bigakomeza kugeza ku myaka ibiri cyangwa irenga.
Konsa ni uguha abana bato amata y'ibere ry'umubyeyi. Bisabwa ko bitangira mu isaha ya mbere y'ubuzima bw'umwana, kandi bigakorwa kenshi uko umwana abishaka. Mu byumweru bya mbere, abana bashobora konka buri masaha abiri cyangwa atatu, buri gihe iminota icumi kugeza kuri cumi n'itanu kuri buri bere. Abana bakuru bonka gake. Ababyeyi bashobora gukama amata yabo kugira ngo azakoreshwe nyuma igihe konsa bidashoboka.
Konsa bigirira akamaro kenshi umubyeyi n'umwana, amata y'ifu atabasha gutanga. Konsa abana benshi byashobora kurinda impfu z'abana bagera ku 820 000 bari munsi y'imyaka itanu buri mwaka ku isi. Bigabanya ibyago by'indwara z'ubuhumekero n'impiswi, haba mu bihugu bikennye cyangwa ibikize. Bigabanya kandi ibyago bya asima, aleriji z'ibiryo na diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1, bishobora kongera imikurire y'ubwonko no kugabanya ibyago byo kubyibuha bikabije umuntu amaze gukura. Ababyeyi bashobora kumva bahatirwa konsa, ariko mu bihugu bikize abana bahabwa amata y'ifu muri rusange bakura neza.
Ku mubyeyi, konsa bigabanya kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara, bifasha umura gusubirana vuba no kugabanya agahinda gakabije gakurikira kubyara. Bitinza kandi kongera kujya mu mihango no gusama ("aménorrhée lactationnelle"). Mu gihe kirekire, bigabanya ibyago bya kanseri y'ibere, indwara z'umutima n'imitsi na rubagimpande. Konsa kandi birahendutse kurusha amata y'ifu.
Imiryango y'ubuzima, harimo n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima (OMS), isaba konsa gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere, ni ukuvuga nta bindi biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa, uretse wenda vitamine D. Nyuma yo gutangira guha umwana ibindi biribwa ku mezi atandatu, birasabwa gukomeza konsa kugeza ku mwaka umwe cyangwa ibiri, cyangwa birenga.
Indwara zibuza umubyeyi konsa ni nke cyane. Ababyeyi bakoresha ibiyobyabwenge bimwe na bimwe ntibagomba konsa. Kunywa itabi, inzoga nke cyangwa ikawa si impamvu zo kureka konsa.
Uko bihagaze ku isi.
Ku isi, hafi 47 % by'abana bari hagati y'amezi 0 na 6 ni bo bonka gusa (2018–2025). Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 2015, 83 % by'ababyeyi batangiye konsa, ariko ku mezi atandatu 58 % gusa ni bo bari bakonsa, naho 25 % bonsa gusa.

Ibibyimba (mu Gifaransa: "verrues"; mu Cyongereza: "warts") ni utubyimba duto, dukomeye, dufite ibara risa n'iry'uruhu, biterwa na virusi ya "papillomavirus" y'umuntu (HPV). Bikunze kuza ku biganza no ku birenge, kandi si kanseri.
Bikunze kugaragara cyane, kandi akenshi bishira ubwabyo mu mezi cyangwa imyaka. Kuvurwa bishobora kwihutisha gukira, hakoreshejwe nka "acide salicylique" cyangwa "cryothérapie".
Ibimenyetso n'ubwoko.
Ibibyimba ni utubyimba duto, dukomeye, dufite ibara risa n'iry'uruhu. Ubusanzwe ntibitera ibindi bimenyetso, keretse iyo biri munsi y'ibirenge, aho bishobora kubabaza. Akenshi biza ku biganza no ku birenge, ariko bishobora no kuza ahandi. Hashobora kuza kimwe cyangwa byinshi, kandi si kanseri.
Hari ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibibyimba: ibibyimba bisanzwe, ibyo munsi y'ibirenge, ibibyimba birebire kandi binanutse ("filiformes") n'ibyo ku myanya ndangagitsina. Ibyo ku myanya ndangagitsina akenshi byandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina.
Ibibyimba biterwa n'ubwandu bw'ubwoko bumwe bwa "papillomavirus" y'umuntu (HPV). Ibyongera ibyago ni ugukoresha ubwogero rusange, gukora ku nyama mbisi (nk'abacuruzi b'inyama), "eczéma" n'ubudahangarwa buke. Bikekwa ko virusi yinjira mu mubiri inyuze ahantu uruhu rwakomeretse gato.
Iyo bitavuwe, ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibibyimba bushira ubwabwo mu mezi cyangwa imyaka. Uburyo bwinshi bwo kuvura bushobora kwihutisha gukira, harimo "acide salicylique" isigwa ku ruhu na "cryothérapie" (gukonjesha cyane). Ku bantu bafite ubuzima bwiza, ubusanzwe ntibiteza ibibazo bikomeye. Ibibyimba byo ku myanya ndangagitsina bivurwa mu buryo butandukanye n'ubundi bwoko.
Ibibyimba birakunze kugaragara cyane, abantu benshi babirwara igihe runaka mu buzima bwabo. Ibitari ku myanya ndangagitsina bifata 1–13 % by'abaturage, cyane cyane urubyiruko. Ibyo ku myanya ndangagitsina bifata hafi 12 % by'abagore bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina. Ibibyimba byasobanuwe nibura kuva mu mwaka wa 400 mbere ya Yezu na Hippocrate.

Norepinephrine, izwi kandi nka "noradrénaline", ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura abantu bafite umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi cyane. Itangwa iterwa buhoro buhoro mu mutsi, kandi ni molekile imwe n'umusemburo n'umutumwa w'imyakura ("neurotransmetteur") witwa norepinephrine.
Yavumbuwe mu 1946, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 1950. Iboneka nk'umuti rusange.
Norepinephrine ikoreshwa mu kuvura umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi cyane. Ni umuti usanzwe ukoreshwa muri "sepsis" iyo umuvuduko w'amaraso utazamutse nyuma yo guterwa amazi mu mitsi. Ni molekile imwe n'umusemburo n'umutumwa w'imyakura norepinephrine. Ikora ifata kandi igakangura "récepteurs" za "alpha-adrénergiques".
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara ni ukuribwa umutwe, umutima utera gahoro no guhangayika. Izindi ni umutima utera nabi. Iyo umuti usohotse mu mutsi, ushobora gutera "ischémie" y'ingingo; icyo gihe gutera "phentolamine" ahangiritse bishobora gufasha.
Norepinephrine yavumbuwe mu 1946, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika mu 1950. Iboneka nk'umuti rusange ("générique"). Mu Ubwongereza, agacupa kamwe katwara NHS hafi £4,40.

Indwara z'ibihumyo (mu Gifaransa: "oreillons"; mu Cyongereza: "mumps") ni indwara iterwa na virusi y'ibihumyo. Irangwa no kubyimba kubabaza kw'imvubura z'amacandwe za "parotide", nyuma y'umuriro no kumva utameze neza.
Irandura cyane binyuze mu bitonyanga by'ubuhumekero. Ishobora kwirindwa n'urukingo rufatwa inshuro ebyiri, kandi ntigira umuti wihariye. Mbere y'urukingo yari indwara isanzwe y'abana ku isi hose.
Ibimenyetso n'ingorane.
Ibimenyetso bya mbere akenshi ni umuriro, kuribwa imikaya, kuribwa umutwe, kubura ubushake bwo kurya no kumva utameze neza. Bikurikirwa no kubyimba kubabaza kw'imvubura imwe cyangwa zombi za "parotide". Ibimenyetso bigaragara nyuma y'iminsi 16 kugeza kuri 18 umuntu yanduye, bigashira nyuma y'iminsi 7 kugeza kuri 10. Bikunze gukomera ku bantu bakuru kurusha ku bana, naho hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'abanduye bagira ibimenyetso byoroheje cyangwa ntibagire na kimwe.
Ingorane zishobora kuba "méningite" (15 %), "pancréatite" (4 %), kubyimba k'umutima, kutumva burundu no kubyimba kw'amabya, gake bigatera ubugumba. Abagore bashobora kubyimba udusabo tw'intanga, ariko ibyo ntibyongera ibyago byo kutabyara. Hafi umuntu umwe ku 10 000 banduye arapfa.
Ikwirakwira n'isuzuma.
Indwara irandura cyane kandi ikwirakwira vuba mu bantu babana hafi. Virusi yandurira mu bitonyanga by'ubuhumekero cyangwa mu gukoranaho n'uwanduye, kandi abantu ni bo bonyine bayandura bakanayikwirakwiza. Umuntu yanduza kuva ku minsi irindwi mbere y'uko "parotide" zibyimba kugeza ku minsi umunani nyuma yaho. Iyo umuntu akize, agira ubudahangarwa ubuzima bwe bwose; kongera kwandura birashoboka ariko bikaba byoroheje.
Ubusanzwe indwara ikekwa iyo "parotide" zabyimbye, ikemezwa no guhinga virusi ivuye mu muyoboro w'amacandwe wa "parotide". Gupima "IgM" mu maraso biroroshye kandi bifasha, ariko bishobora gutanga igisubizo kitari cyo ku bantu bakingiwe.
Indwara z'ibihumyo zirindwa n'urukingo rufatwa inshuro ebyiri. Ibihugu byinshi byateye imbere byarushyize muri gahunda yabyo yo gukingira, akenshi ruvanze n'inkingo z'iseru, "rubéole" na "varicelle". Nta muti wihariye uyivura. Ubuvuzi bugamije kugabanya ibimenyetso hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ububabare nka paracetamol. "Immunoglobulines" ziterwa mu mitsi zishobora gufasha mu ngorane zimwe na zimwe. Kujyanwa mu bitaro bishobora kuba ngombwa iyo havutse "méningite" cyangwa "pancréatite".
Gukingira byagabanyije umubare w'abarwara ku kigero kirenga 90 %. Indwara ikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere, aho gukingira bidakwiriye. Mbere y'urukingo, yari indwara isanzwe y'abana ku isi hose, ibyorezo bikaba buri myaka ibiri kugeza kuri itanu, cyane cyane ku bana bafite hagati y'imyaka 5 na 9. Mu bakingiwe, abari mu kigero cy'imyaka 20 ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa. Mu turere dushyuha, iboneka umwaka wose, naho mu turere tw'ubukonje ikunze kuboneka mu gihe cy'ubukonje n'urugaryi.
Kubyimba kubabaza kw'imvubura za "parotide" n'amabya byasobanuwe bwa mbere na Hippocrate mu kinyejana cya 5 mbere ya Yezu.

Anencephaly (mu Gifaransa: "anencéphalie") ni ukubura igice kinini cy'ubwonko n'agahanga, bitewe n'ikibazo cyo mu mikurire y'umwana akiri mu nda. Ni bumwe mu bumuga bw'umuyoboro w'imyakura ("tube neural").
Ishobora kugaragara mbere yo kuvuka. Kuyirinda bishingiye ku kongera aside folike mu ndyo y'umubyeyi. Abana bavukana na yo benshi bapfa mu masaha cyangwa iminsi mike.
"Anencéphalie" ni ukubura igice kinini cy'ubwonko n'agahanga bitewe n'ibibazo mu mikurire y'umwana akiri mu nda. Abana bafite iyi ndwara ntibabona, ntibumva kandi nta bwenge bagira, ntibashobora kumva ububabare. Ariko bashobora kugira ibikorwa by'ikiyoborere ("réflexes"), nko guhumeka cyangwa kwitaba amajwi n'ugukorwaho.
Bikekwa ko iterwa n'ibintu byinshi, birimo kubura "folate", imiti imwe n'imwe ivura igicuri, diyabete, vitamine A nyinshi n'ubushyuhe bwinshi mu gihe cyo gutwita. Ni ubwoko bw'ubumuga bw'umuyoboro w'imyakura, buterwa n'uko impera y'imbere y'uwo muyoboro idafunga neza.
Mbere yo kuvuka, ishobora gukekwa iyo urugero rwa "alpha-fœtoprotéine" mu maraso y'umubyeyi ruri hejuru, ikemezwa na "échographie".
Kuyirinda bishingiye ku kongera aside folike mu ndyo y'umubyeyi. Umuti uvura igicuri witwa "valproate" ugomba kwirindwa mu gihe cyo gutwita, niba bishoboka. Nta muti uyikiza; ubuvuzi butangwa ni ubwo kwita ku mwana gusa. Iyo umwana avutse ari muzima, akenshi apfa mu masaha cyangwa iminsi mike nyuma yo kuvuka.
Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, umwana umwe kuri 4 762 avukana "anencéphalie".

Herpes (mu Cyongereza: "herpes simplex") ni indwara iterwa na virusi ya "herpes simplex". Itera uduheri duto dukoranye tumeneka tukaba udusebe, cyane cyane ku munwa (herpes yo mu kanwa) cyangwa ku myanya ndangagitsina (herpes yo mu gitsina). Virusi iguma mu mubiri ubuzima bwose, indwara ikagenda igaruka.
Hari ubwoko bubiri bwa virusi, HSV-1 na HSV-2. Ntirakingirwa kandi ntirakira, ariko imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi ifasha kugabanya ibimenyetso. Abantu benshi ku isi baranduye, kandi abenshi ntibabizi.
Indwara zishyirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe igice cy'umubiri cyanduye. Herpes yo mu kanwa ifata isura cyangwa umunwa, ikaba ishobora gutera uduheri duto dukoranye bita «ibisebe by'umuriro» cyangwa ububabare mu umuhogo. Herpes yo mu gitsina ishobora kugira ibimenyetso bike cyangwa ikagira uduheri tumeneka tukaba udusebe duto, dukunze gukira mu byumweru bibiri kugeza kuri bine. Kuribwa cyangwa kumva ibishyushye bishobora kubanziriza udusebe.
Indwara igenda isimburana n'ibihe bitagira ibimenyetso. Ubwa mbere bikunze kuba bikomeye, bikajyana n'umuriro, kuribwa imikaya, kubyimba kwa "ganglions" no kuribwa umutwe; uko igihe gihita, ibihe by'indwara biragabanuka mu mubare no mu bukana. Virusi ishobora no gufata intoki, amaso, ubwonko cyangwa impinja zikivuka.
Impamvu n'ikwirakwira.
HSV-1 ikunze gutera indwara zo ku munwa, naho HSV-2 igatera iz'imyanya ndangagitsina. Zandurira mu gukora ku mazi cyangwa ku dusebe tw'umuntu wanduye, kandi zishobora kwandura no mu gihe nta bimenyetso bihari. Herpes yo mu gitsina iri mu ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, kandi ishobora kwanduza umwana mu gihe cyo kubyara.
Nyuma yo kwandura, virusi zijya mu turemangingo tw'imyakura aho ziguma ubuzima bwose. Indwara ishobora kugaruka bitewe n'ubudahangarwa bugabanutse, "stress" cyangwa izuba.
Ubusanzwe herpes isuzumwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso. Isuzuma rishobora kwemezwa no guhinga virusi cyangwa gushakisha ADN yayo (PCR) mu mazi ava mu dusebe. Gupima amaraso bishobora kwerekana ko umuntu yigeze kwandura, ariko ntibigaragaza ubwandu bushya.
Uburyo bwizewe bwo kwirinda herpes yo mu gitsina ni ukwirinda imibonano mpuzabitsina. Gukoresha agakingirizo bigabanya ibyago, kimwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi ifatwa buri munsi n'uwanduye. Nta rukingo ruhari, kandi nta muti uyikiza burundu.
Paracetamol na "lidocaïne" isigwa ku ruhu bishobora kugabanya ububabare. Imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi nka "aciclovir" cyangwa "valaciclovir" igabanya ubukana bw'ibimenyetso.
Ku isi, abantu bakuru bari hagati ya 60 % na 95 % banduye HSV-1 cyangwa HSV-2. HSV-1 ikunze kwandura mu bwana, kandi umubare w'abanduye wiyongera uko abantu bakura. Abanduye HSV-1 ni 70–80 % mu baturage bakennye, na 40–60 % mu bafite imibereho myiza.
Mu 2020, abantu bagera kuri miliyari 3,8 bari munsi y'imyaka 50 (64 %) bari banduye HSV-1, naho abantu miliyoni 520 bafite hagati y'imyaka 15 na 49 (13 %) bari banduye HSV-2. Abenshi mu banduye HSV-2 ntibazi ko banduye.
Izina "herpes" rikomoka ku Kigereki "herpēs", risobanura «gukwirakwira», ryerekeza ku buryo udusebe dukwirakwira.

Loratadine, igurishwa ku izina rya "Claritin" n'andi, ni umuti urwanya "histamine" ukoreshwa mu kuvura aleriji, nk'ibicurane biterwa n'ifu y'ibyatsi ("rhinite allergique") n'uduheri. Ufatwa mu kanwa.
Yahawe ipatanti mu 1980, igera ku isoko mu 1988. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima kandi iboneka nk'umuti rusange.
Loratadine ikoreshwa mu kuvura aleriji, harimo "rhinite allergique" (ifu y'ibyatsi) n'uduheri. Iboneka kandi ivanze na "pseudoéphédrine", umuti ugabanya kuziba kw'amazuru, ku izina rya loratadine/pseudoéphédrine. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Iri mu miti irwanya "histamine" yo mu gisekuru cya kabiri.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara ni ugusinzira, kuma mu kanwa no kuribwa umutwe. Izikomeye ntizikunze kubaho; zirimo aleriji, igicuri n'ibibazo by'umwijima. Kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita bisa n'aho nta kibazo biteza, ariko ntibirigwa neza. Ntisabwa ku bana bari munsi y'imyaka ibiri.
Loratadine yahawe ipatanti mu 1980, igera ku isoko mu 1988. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima kandi iboneka nk'umuti rusange ("générique"). Mu 2015, igiciro cyayo mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere cyari hagati ya 0,01 na 0,06 by'amadolari y'Amerika ku kinini. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika igurwa nta rupapuro rwa muganga. Mu 2024, wari umuti wa 101 wandikwaga cyane muri icyo gihugu, ufite impapuro z'abaganga hafi miliyoni zirindwi.

Finasteride, igurishwa ku mazina ya "Proscar" na "Propecia" n'andi, ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura "prostate" yabyimbye no gupfuka umusatsi (uruhara) ku bagabo. Ufatwa mu kanwa.
Ni umuti ubuza "5α-réductase", bityo ukagabanya ikorwa rya "dihydrotestostérone" (DHT). Wemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1992 kandi uboneka nk'umuti rusange udahenze.
Finasteride ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura "prostate" yabyimbye no gupfuka umusatsi ku bagabo. Ishobora kandi gukoreshwa mu kuvura ubwoya bwinshi ku bagore ("hirsutisme") no mu kuvura hakoreshejwe imisemburo ku bagore bahinduye igitsina. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ni umuti ubuza "5α-réductase", bityo ukaba urwanya "androgènes". Igabanya cyane ikorwa rya "dihydrotestostérone" (DHT), harimo no muri "prostate" no ku ruhu rw'umutwe.
Ingaruka mbi za finasteride ntizikunze kubaho, ariko bamwe mu bagabo bagira ibibazo mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, agahinda gakabije no kubyimba amabere. Ku bagabo bamwe, ibibazo mu mibonano mpuzabitsina bishobora gukomeza na nyuma yo guhagarika umuti. Ishobora kandi kongera ibyago byo kurwara ubwoko bumwe bwa kanseri ya prostate.
Finasteride yahawe ipatanti mu 1984, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1992. Iboneka nk'umuti rusange ("générique") kandi ntihenze. Mu 2019, ukwezi kw'imiti kwatwaraga NHS yo mu Ubwongereza hafi £0,90, naho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika igiciro cyayo cyari hafi amadolari 2,30. Mu 2024, wari umuti wa 81 wandikwaga cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ufite impapuro z'abaganga zirenga miliyoni umunani.

Lithiyumu (mu Cyongereza: "lithium salts") ni umuti ugizwe n'imyunyu ya lithiyumu, ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe, by'umwihariko indwara ya "bipolaire". Ufatwa mu kanwa kandi ushyirwa mu miti iringaniza imyumvire.
Ikoreshwa ryayo mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe ryatangijwe mu 1948 n'umuganga wo muri Ositaraliya John Cade. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima.
Lithiyumu ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura indwara ya "bipolaire" no mu kuvura agahinda gakabije ("dépression") kadakira nyuma yo gukoresha indi miti. Muri izi ndwara, igabanya ibyago byo kwiyahura. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Imyunyu ya lithiyumu ishyirwa mu miti iringaniza imyumvire ("régulateurs de l'humeur"). Uburyo ikora ntiburamenyekana neza.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara ni ukwihagarika kenshi, guhinda kw'amaboko no kugira inyota nyinshi. Izikomeye ni "hypothyroïdie", diyabete insipidus n'uburozi bwa lithiyumu. Birasabwa gupima kenshi urugero rwayo mu maraso kugira ngo hirindwe uburozi. Iyo urugero rwayo rubaye rwinshi cyane, hashobora kuza impiswi, kuruka, guhuza imikorere nabi, gusinzira cyane no kuvuza mu matwi.
Iyo ikoreshejwe mu gihe cyo gutwita, ishobora guteza ibibazo ku mwana. Bisa n'aho ishobora gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo konsa, ariko umwana agakurikiranwa.
Mu kinyejana cya 19, lithiyumu yakoreshwaga mu kuvura "goutte", igicuri na kanseri. Ikoreshwa ryayo mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe ryatangijwe mu 1948 na John Cade wo muri Ositaraliya.
Igiciro n'ikoreshwa.
Lithiyumu iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iboneka nk'umuti rusange ("générique"). Mu 2014, igiciro cyayo cyo kugurisha mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere cyari hagati ya 0,12 na 0,20 by'amadolari y'Amerika ku munsi. Mu 2024, wari umuti wa 167 wandikwaga cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ufite impapuro z'abaganga zirenga miliyoni eshatu.

Ubwivu bw'imitsi yo mu mpande (mu Cyongereza: "peripheral neuropathy") ni ukwangirika kw'imitsi yo mu mpande, ari yo mitsi ihuza ubwonko n'urutirigongo n'ibindi bice by'umubiri. Ibimenyetso biterwa n'ubwoko bw'imitsi yangiritse, kandi akenshi bitangirira ku maguru no ku maboko.
Ikunze guterwa na diyabete n'inzoga, ariko ifite izindi mpamvu nyinshi. Isuzumwa hashingiwe ku bimenyetso no ku bizamini, ikavurwa hakemurwa impamvu yayo no kugabanya ububabare. Ifata abantu bagera kuri 1 kugeza kuri 7 %.
Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba intege nke z'imitsi, guhindagurika kw'imitsi cyangwa kuyumva ishyuha; ibinya, ububabare cyangwa kuringaniza nabi; cyangwa kutihanganira ubushyuhe, kubira ibyuya byinshi n'ingorane zo kumira. Bishobora gutangira mu minsi mike cyangwa mu myaka myinshi. Akenshi bitangirira ku maguru yo hasi no ku maboko.
Ubwoko busanzwe burimo ubwivu buterwa na diyabete, ubuterwa n'inzoga, indwara ya Guillain-Barré n'imitsi ifatiwe ku kiganza ("carpal tunnel syndrome"). Izindi mpamvu zirimo ibikomere, amaraso adatembera neza, indwara z'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, indwara z'impyiko cyangwa z'umwijima, kubura vitamine B12 cyangwa B6, imiti imwe n'imwe irimo iyivura kanseri ("chimiothérapie"), uruhererekane rw'imiterere ("génétique"), "zona", indwara ya Lyme na VIH/SIDA. Rimwe na rimwe impamvu ntimenyekana.
Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso no ku isuzuma ry'umurwayi. Gupima amaraso bikorwa kugira ngo harebwe diyabete, vitamine, imikorere y'umwijima, ya tiroyide n'iy'impyiko; hashobora no gupimwa poroteyine zidasanzwe. Ibindi bizamini birimo gupima umuvuduko w'ubutumwa mu mitsi, "electromyography" cyangwa gufata agace k'umutsi ("biopsie").
Iyo impamvu nyamukuru ishobora gukemurwa, umurwayi ashobora gukira uko igihe gihita. Kureka kunywa itabi, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri no kugenzura isukari mu maraso nabyo bishobora gufasha. Ubwivu buterwa n'indwara z'ubudahangarwa bushobora kuvurwa n'imiti nka prednisone, cyclosporine cyangwa azathioprine, rimwe na rimwe na "plasmaphérèse". Imiti igabanya ububabare irimo nortriptyline, duloxetine na gabapentin.
Ikwirakwira n'amateka.
Ubwivu bw'imitsi yo mu mpande bufata abantu bagera kuri 1 kugeza kuri 7 %, bukaba bwiganje cyane ku barengeje imyaka 50; bufata kandi 25 kugeza kuri 50 % by'abarwayi ba diyabete. Ibisobanuro bya mbere bisobanutse by'iyi ndwara byanditswe n'umuganga w'Umufaransa Joseph Jules Dejerine guhera mu 1880.

Diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1 (mu Cyongereza: "type 1 diabetes", T1D), yahoze yitwa "diyabete y'abana", ni ubwoko bwa diyabete aho "pancreas" ikora insuline nke cyane cyangwa ntiyikore na gato. Insuline ni umusemburo umubiri ukenera kugira ngo ukoreshe isukari iri mu amaraso.
Ubusanzwe itangira mu bana no mu bakuru bakiri bato, ikagaragazwa no kwihagarika kenshi, inyota n'inzara nyinshi no kugabanuka ibiro. Nta buryo buzwi bwo kuyirinda; abayirwaye bakenera kuvurwa na insuline ubuzima bwabo bwose. Igize 5–10 % by'abarwayi bose ba diyabete.
Mbere yo kuvurwa, iyi ndwara itera isukari nyinshi mu maraso. Ibimenyetso bisanzwe ni ukwihagarika kenshi, inyota nyinshi, inzara nyinshi no kugabanuka ibiro. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba kutabona neza, umunaniro no gukira buhoro kw'ibikomere. Ibimenyetso bikunze kugaragara mu gihe gito.
Impamvu ya diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1 ntizwi neza, ariko bikekwa ko iterwa n'uruvange rw'imiterere karande n'ibidukikije. Kugira umuntu wo mu muryango uyirwaye byongera ibyago. Indwara iterwa no gusenyuka kw'uturemangingo twa beta two muri "pancreas" dukora insuline.
Diyabete isuzumwa hapimwa urugero rw'isukari cyangwa hemoglobine "glyquée" (HbA1C) mu maraso. Ubwoko bwa 1 butandukanywa n'ubwoko bwa 2 hapimwa "autoantibodies".
Nta buryo buzwi bwo kwirinda diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1. Kuvurwa na insuline ni ngombwa kugira ngo umurwayi abeho. Ubusanzwe insuline iterwa mu nshinge munsi y'uruhu, ariko ishobora no gutangwa hakoreshejwe pompe ya insuline. Indyo n'imyitozo ngororamubiri ni ingenzi mu kuyicunga.
Iyo idavuwe, diyabete iteza ingorane nyinshi. Izihutirwa ni "ketoacidose" ya diyabete na "coma hyperosmolaire". Iz'igihe kirekire ni indwara z'umutima, indwara z'imitsi yo mu ubwonko, kunanirwa kw'impyiko, ibisebe ku birenge no kwangirika kw'amaso. Isukari nke mu maraso na yo ishobora guterwa no gufata insuline nyinshi.
Diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1 igize 5–10 % by'abarwayi bose ba diyabete. Umubare w'abayirwaye ku isi ntuzwi, ariko bivugwa ko abana bagera ku 80 000 bayirwara buri mwaka. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, abayirwaye babarirwa hagati ya miliyoni imwe n'eshatu.
Umubare w'abarwara bashya uratandukanye cyane: umuntu 1 kuri 100 000 buri mwaka muri Aziya y'Iburasirazuba no muri Amerika y’Epfo, naho abagera kuri 30 kuri 100 000 muri Scandinavie no muri Koweti. Ubusanzwe itangirira mu bana no mu bakuru bakiri bato.

Kaminuza ya Gikristo y'Indimi Ebyiri ya Kongo (mu gifaransa: "Université chrétienne bilingue du Congo", UCBC) ni kaminuza yigenga iherereye i Beni mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Yafunguwe mu 2007 n’umuryango Congo Initiative.
Kaminuza yashinzwe ku gitekerezo cya David M. Kasali n’umugore we Kaswera Kasali, nyuma y’amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu yo mu 2006. Congo Initiative, yashinzwe mu 2005, yayifunguye mu 2007. Yahawe uruhushya rwo gukora mu 2006, yemerwa burundu ku wa 27 Mata 2010. David Kasali yayiyoboye imyaka 12; mu 2019 yasimbuwe na Honoré Bunduki Kwany wari umuyobozi wungirije. Mu 2023, abayobozi bayo bavuze ko umutekano muke watumye abanyeshuri bo mu yindi mijyi bareka kuhaza, kandi ko kaminuza itabona inkunga ya Leta.
UCBC ikoresha gahunda ya LMD kuva yatangira, ikigisha mu mashami arimo itangazamakuru n’itumanaho, tewolojiya, filozofiya n’ubuyobozi, ubukungu, ikoranabuhanga n’ubwubatsi, amategeko, ubumenyi bw’imitekerereze n’uburezi. Uburezi bwayo buhuza amasomo, akazi ("Work Program") n’umurimo ufitiye abaturage akamaro ("Service Learning"). Ikigo cyayo cya hegitari 36 gifite imirima y’igerageza, icyuzi, ibiraro by’amatungo na radiyo.

Rosa Parks (yavutse yitwa Rosa Louise McCauley, ku wa 4 Gashyantare 1913 – ku wa 24 Ukwakira 2005) yari umugore w’Umunyamerika w’umwirabura waharaniye uburenganzira bw’abaturage. Azwi cyane kubera ko ku wa 1 Ukuboza 1955, i Montgomery muri Leta ya Alabama, yanze guha umugabo w’umuzungu intebe ye muri bisi, nk’uko amategeko y’ivangura ry’amoko yabitegekaga.
Ifatwa rye ryateje imyigaragambyo yo kwanga gutega bisi z’i Montgomery yamaze iminsi 381, iba intangiriro y’urugamba rw’uburenganzira bw’abaturage muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Akenshi yitwa «nyina w’urugamba rw’uburenganzira bw’abaturage».
Rosa Louise McCauley yavukiye i Tuskegee muri Alabama, akurira i Pine Level hafi ya Montgomery. Mu 1932 yashakanye na Raymond Parks, wari umwe mu bagize umuryango NAACP ("National Association for the Advancement of Colored People"). Mu 1943, Rosa Parks na we yinjiye muri NAACP, aba umunyamabanga w’ishami ryayo ry’i Montgomery.
Ifatwa ryo mu 1955 n’imyigaragambyo ya bisi.
Ku wa 1 Ukuboza 1955, ubwo yatahaga avuye ku kazi, Rosa Parks yanze kubahiriza itegeko ry’umushoferi wa bisi wamusabaga guha intebe ye umugenzi w’umuzungu. Yahise afatwa, aracibwa ihazabu.
Iri fatwa ryatumye Abirabura b’i Montgomery batangiza imyigaragambyo yo kwanga gutega bisi, iyobowe na Martin Luther King Jr., wari umupasiteri ukiri muto icyo gihe. Yamaze iminsi 381, irangira mu Ukuboza 1956 nyuma y’uko Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika rwemeje ko ivangura muri bisi rinyuranyije n’Itegeko Nshinga.
Nyuma y’imyigaragambyo.
Kubera iterabwoba n’ibura ry’akazi, Rosa n’umugabo we bimukiye i Detroit muri Leta ya Michigan mu 1957. Kuva mu 1965 kugeza mu 1988, yakoreye umudepite John Conyers. Mu 1987, we n’umugabo we bashinze ikigo cyo guteza imbere urubyiruko.
Yahawe ibihembo byinshi, birimo umudari w’umukuru w’igihugu w’ubwisanzure ("Presidential Medal of Freedom") mu 1996 n’umudari wa zahabu w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ("Congressional Gold Medal") mu 1999.
Rosa Parks yapfiriye i Detroit ku wa 24 Ukwakira 2005, afite imyaka 92. Umurambo we washyizwe mu nzu y’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ("Capitole") i Washington kugira ngo abantu bamwunamire; ni we mugore wa mbere wahawe icyo cyubahiro.

Mission des Nations unies pour l'assistance au Rwanda
MINUAR (mu Gifaransa: "Mission des Nations unies pour l'assistance au Rwanda"; mu Cyongereza: "United Nations Assistance Mission for Rwanda", UNAMIR) yari ubutumwa bw'Umuryango w’Abibumye (Loni) bwo kubungabunga amahoro mu Rwanda, bwashyizweho ku ya 5 Ukwakira 1993 bukarangira ku ya 8 Werurwe 1996. Bwari bugamije gufasha mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'amasezerano y'amahoro ya Arusha, yashyizweho umukono ku ya 4 Kanama 1993 hagati ya Leta y'u Rwanda na FPR-Inkotanyi.
Ingabo zabwo zari ziyobowe n'Umunyakanada Roméo Dallaire. MINUAR ntiyashoboye gukumira cyangwa guhagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kubera manda itarayemereraga gukoresha ingufu n'abasirikare bake yari ifite, nubwo yarokoye ibihumbi by'abantu bari bahungiye mu bigo byayo.
Akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano ku isi kashyizeho MINUAR mu cyemezo nimero 872 cyo ku ya 5 Ukwakira 1993, hashingiwe ku gice cya VI cy'Amasezerano shingiro ya Loni: ntiyari yemerewe gukoresha intwaro uretse mu kwirwanaho. Inshingano zayo zari izi: gufasha mu mutekano w'umujyi wa Kigali, gukurikirana iyubahirizwa ry'agahenge, gufasha mu gukura mu butaka ibisasu bitaturitse, gukurikirana itahuka ry'impunzi no guhuza ibikorwa by'ubutabazi.
Intumwa yihariye y'Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Loni yari Umunyakameruni Jacques-Roger Booh-Booh, wasimbuwe muri Nyakanga 1994 na Shahryar Khan wo muri Pakisitani. Roméo Dallaire yayoboye ingabo kugeza muri Kanama 1994, asimburwa n'Umunyakanada Guy Tousignant. Abasirikare bari bateganyijwe bari 2 500, ahanini baturutse mu Ububiligi, muri Bangaladeshi, muri Gana no muri Tunisiya.
Ku ya 11 Mutarama 1994, Dallaire yoherereje icyicaro cya Loni i New York ubutumwa buvuga ko umwe mu batoza b'Interahamwe yamumenyesheje ko hari intwaro zihishwe, ko hakozwe amalisiti y'Abatutsi, kandi ko hari umugambi wo kwica abasirikare b'Ababiligi. Dallaire yasabye uburenganzira bwo gufata izo ntwaro, ariko Ishami rya Loni rishinzwe ibikorwa byo kubungabunga amahoro rirabyanga, rivuga ko birenze manda ya MINUAR. Mu mezi yakurikiyeho umutekano wakomeje kuzamba; ku ya 5 Mata 1994, Akanama gashinzwe umutekano kongereye manda ya MINUAR kugeza ku ya 29 Nyakanga 1994.
Mu gihe cya jenoside.
Nyuma y'ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana ku ya 6 Mata 1994, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yaratangiye. Bukeye bwaho, Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana yarishwe, kimwe n'abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi ba MINUAR bari bashinzwe kumurinda. Ku ya 11 Mata, abasirikare b'Ababiligi bari mu ishuri rya ETO i Kicukiro bararivuyemo, basiga abantu bagera ku 2 000 bari bahahungiye, bahita bicwa; muri bo harimo Boniface Ngulinzira.
Ububiligi bwahise buvana abasirikare babwo muri MINUAR, maze ku ya 21 Mata 1994 Akanama gashinzwe umutekano kagabanya umubare w'abasirikare bayo ukagera kuri 270. Nubwo yari ifite ubushobozi buke, MINUAR yarinze ibihumbi by'abantu bari bahungiye kuri Stade Amahoro no mu bindi bigo bya Loni.
Ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1994, icyemezo 918 cyaguye manda ya MINUAR (yiswe MINUAR II) kandi cyemeza abasirikare bagera ku 5 500, ariko abasirikare bashya batangiye kugera muri Kamena, abenshi bagera jenoside yararangiye.
Nyuma y'uko FPR-Inkotanyi ihagaritse jenoside muri Nyakanga 1994, MINUAR yakomeje gufasha mu kugarura umutekano no gufasha impunzi n'abavanywe mu byabo gutahuka. Manda yayo yongerewe inshuro nyinshi, kugeza ubwo, ku busabe bwa Leta y'u Rwanda, Akanama gashinzwe umutekano kemeje ko irangira burundu ku ya 8 Werurwe 1996. Abantu 27 bo muri MINUAR baguye muri ubwo butumwa.
Raporo ya komisiyo yigenga yakoze iperereza ku bikorwa bya Loni mu gihe cya jenoside (1999) yagaragaje ko MINUAR yari ifite abasirikare bake, ibikoresho bishaje na manda itajyanye n'ibihe, kandi ko ibihugu bigize Loni bitagaragaje ubushake bwo kuyiha ubushobozi. Iyo raporo yashimye ariko ubutwari bwa bamwe mu bagize MINUAR, by'umwihariko Jenerali Dallaire n'abasirikare bo muri Gana no muri Tunisiya bagumye mu Rwanda igihe cyose cya jenoside.

Heliconia rostrata (mu Cyongereza "hanging lobster claw" cyangwa "false bird of paradise") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Heliconiaceae". Gikomoka mu mashyamba ashyuha y'imvura yo muri Amerika yo Hagati no mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Amerika y’Epfo, kandi cyakwirakwiriye no mu tundi turere dushyuha tw'isi.
Ni ikimera cy'icyatsi kimara imyaka myinshi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 5 z'uburebure, gifite amababi manini asa n'ay'insina n'indabo zitukura n'umuhondo zimanuka zimanitse. Gihingwa cyane mu busitani bwo mu turere dushyuha kubera ubwiza bwacyo, kandi muri Boliviya ni kimwe mu ndabo z'ikirango cy'igihugu, aho cyitwa "patujú".
"Heliconia rostrata" ni ikimera cy'icyatsi kimara imyaka myinshi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 5 z'uburebure. Amababi yacyo, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 60 kugeza kuri metero 1,2, asa n'ay'insina.
Mu gihe ubundi bwoko bwinshi bwa "Heliconia" (nka "Heliconia bihai") bufite indabo zimeze nk'izamuka, zifite ibibabi bimeze nk'ibikombe bibika amazi y'imvura akoreshwa n'inyoni n'udukoko, "Heliconia rostrata" yo ifite indabo zimanuka zimanitse, ibibabi byazo by'amabara bireba hasi, n'indabo nto zihishe munsi yabyo. Kubera ko ibyo bibabi bitabika amazi y'imvura, indabo zitanga umutobe ("nectar") utavanze n'amazi. Abazihinga bazi "Heliconia" nk'indabo zisurwa n'inyoni nyinshi, cyane cyane "colibri" ("hummingbirds").
"Heliconia rostrata" ikomoka muri Amerika yo Hagati (Belize, Gwatemala, Hondurasi, El Salvador, Kosita Rika, Panama) no muri Amerika y’Epfo (Kolombiya, Venezuwela, Ekwateri, Peru, Boliviya, Burezile). Iboneka cyane mu mashyamba ashyuha y'imvura, kuko ikunda ahantu hashyuha kandi hahehereye. Yakwirakwiriye kandi mu tundi turere dushyuha, nka Porto Riko no ku kirwa cya Réunion mu Nyanja y'Abahinde.
Ikirango cya Boliviya.
Muri Boliviya, "Heliconia rostrata" yitwa "patujú" kandi ni imwe mu ndabo ebyiri z'ikirango cy'igihugu, hamwe na "cantuta" ("Cantua buxifolia").
"Heliconia rostrata" ikunze guhingwa mu busitani no mu mbuga zo mu turere dushyuha kandi duhehereye. Ikenera ubushyuhe n'ubuhehere bwo mu kirere; ni byiza kuyibika ahantu hari ubushyuhe burenze dogere 18 °C. Ikenera ubutaka bukungahaye ku ifumbire, urugero nk'inombe nziza, kandi igomba kuvomererwa buri gihe n'amazi meza, igihe cyose ubutaka bwumye hejuru.
Andi mazina y'ubumenyi.

Bougainvillea ni ubwoko ("genre") bw'ibihuru bifite amahwa byo mu muryango wa "Nyctaginaceae". Bikomoka mu mashyamba ashyuha y'imvura yo muri Amerika y’Epfo, ariko ubu bihingwa hirya no hino ku isi nk'ibimera by'imitako, kugeza no mu turere dufite ubushyuhe buringaniye.
Ibyo abantu benshi bita indabo zabyo z'amabara meza si indabo nyirizina, ahubwo ni ibibabi byihariye ("bractées") biri ku mitwe y'amashami; indabo nyazo ni nto, z'umweru, kandi zihishe hagati y'ibyo bibabi.
Philibert Commerson n'umufasha we Jeanne Barret ni bo bahanga mu bimera ba mbere basobanuye kandi bita izina iki kimera, cyari cyatoraguwe muri Burezile mu rugendo rwo kuzenguruka isi rwayobowe n'umushakashatsi w'Umufaransa Louis Antoine de Bougainville.
Commerson yacyise "Buginvillaea" mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Bougainville; iyo nyandiko yaje gukosorwa iba "Bougainvillea". Jeanne Barret, umurimo we wose wari warahawe Commerson, yategereje umwaka wa 2012 kugira ngo izina rye ryibukwe binyuze ku kimera "Solanum baretiae".
"Bougainvillea" ni ibihuru bifite amahwa, byurira kandi bifite amabara meza (umutuku, iroza, isine, umuhondo, umweru…). Ibice by'amabara bigaragara cyane si amababi y'indabo, ahubwo ni ibibabi byihariye ("bractées") biri ku mitwe y'amashami. Indabo nyazo ni nto, z'umweru, kandi ziri hagati y'ibyo bibabi.
Ibi bimera bikomoka mu mashyamba ashyuha kandi ahehereye yo muri Amerika y’Epfo, kandi bikoreshwa cyane nk'ibimera by'imitako kugeza no mu turere dufite ubushyuhe buringaniye. Hari amoko menshi yahinzwe ("cultivars") ameze nk'imigozi.

Agapanthus praecox (mu Gifaransa "agapanthe", mu Cyongereza "African lily" cyangwa "lily of the Nile") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Amaryllidaceae". Gikomoka muri Afurika y’Epfo, ariko ubu gihingwa cyane mu busitani hirya no hino ku isi nk'ikimera cy'imitako.
Ni ikimera cy'icyatsi kimara imyaka myinshi, gifite amababi maremare n'indabo z'ubururu, z'isine cyangwa z'umweru ziteranye ku mutwe w'uruti rurerure. Ibimera byinshi bya "Agapanthus" bihingwa ku isi bikomoka kuri ubu bwoko.
"Agapanthus praecox" ni ikimera cy'icyatsi gishobora kubaho imyaka igera kuri 75. Amababi yacyo afite ubugari bwa santimetero 2 n'uburebure bugera kuri santimetero 50. Uruti rwacyo rw'indabo rushobora kugera kuri metero 1 z'uburebure, kandi imizi yacyo irakomeye cyane ku buryo ishobora kumena sima.
Indabo zacyo, z'ubururu, z'isine cyangwa z'umweru, ziteranye nk'umutaka ("ombelle"). Zikurikirwa n'udusanduku ("capsules") twuzuyemo imbuto nto z'umukara. Ibice byose by'iki kimera ni uburozi.
"Agapanthus praecox" ikomoka mu ntara za Eastern Cape na KwaZulu-Natal muri Afurika y’Epfo. Iwabo, izwi ku mazina nka "agapant", "bloulelie", "isicakathi" na "ubani".
Ubu ihingwa cyane mu busitani ku isi yose, cyane cyane mu turere dufite ikirere cyo mu karere ka Mediterane. Mu turere tumwe na tumwe nka Ositaraliya na Nuveli Zelande, yabaye ikimera cyigabiza kibangamira ibimera kavukire.

"Agapanthus praecox" ikunda ubutaka butareka amazi kandi bukungahaye, ariko yihanganira n'ubutaka bukennye. Ikunda izuba ryinshi, ariko ishobora no gukura ahari igicucu gito. Ntikunda kwimurwa.
Ishobora gutuburwa hakoreshejwe imbuto (ikarabya nyuma y'imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 4) cyangwa kugabanya ibishyitsi. Iyo imaze gufata neza, yihanganira izuba ryinshi n'amapfa, nubwo ari byiza kuyuhira igihe izuba rimaze igihe kirekire.

Colette Sénami Agossou Houeto (6 Werurwe 1939 – 29 Nzeri 2026) yari umwarimu, umusizi uharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore n'umunyapolitiki wo muri Bene.
Yabaye Minisitiri w'Amashuri Abanza n'Ayisumbuye muri guverinoma ya mbere ya Perezida Boni Yayi mu mwaka wa 2006.
Yavukiye i Porto-Novo, yiga amashuri yisumbuye i Cotonou, hanyuma akomereza amasomo ya kaminuza i Strasbourg mu Ubufaransa, i München mu Ubudage n'i Aix-en-Provence, mbere yo kuba umwarimu w'Ikidage. Kuva mu 1977 kugeza mu 1981 yayoboye Ikigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Amahugurwa n'Ubushakashatsi mu Uburezi (INFRE), nyuma akorera Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere (1986–1991) na UNICEF.
Kuva muri Mata kugeza muri Kanama 2006 yari minisitiri w'uburezi, naho kuva mu 2008 kugeza mu 2015 aba umuyobozi wungirije wa mbere w'umujyi wa Porto-Novo. Igitabo cye cy'imivugo "L'Aube sur les cactus" (1981) kirata urugamba rwo kurwanya ubukoloni kandi kigaharanira uburenganzira bw'abagore. Yitabye Imana ku wa 29 Nzeri 2026 afite imyaka 87.

Spathodea campanulata (mu Gifaransa "tulipier du Gabon" cyangwa "tulipier d'Afrique", mu Cyongereza "African tulip tree") ni ubwoko bw'igiti kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Bignoniaceae", gikomoka mu mashyamba ashyuha yo muri Afurika.
Kirangwa n'indabo nini z'umutuku zimeze nk'itulipe, kandi giterwa cyane mu turere dushyuha tw'isi nk'igiti cy'imitako n'icy'igicucu. Ariko kandi, aho cyajyanywe, cyabaye ikimera cyigabiza gikomeye: kiri ku rutonde rw'amoko 100 y'ibinyabuzima byigabiza bibangamiye isi kurusha ibindi.
"Spathodea campanulata" yasobanuwe bwa mbere n'Umufaransa Ambroise Palisot de Beauvois mu gitabo cye "Flore d'Oware et de Bénin, en Afrique" (1805). Izina "Spathodea" rikomoka mu Kigereki, ryerekeza ku ishusho y'inkota y'igice cyo hasi cy'ururabo ("calice"), naho "campanulata" bisobanura mu Kilatini «gisa n'inzogera nto».
"Spathodea campanulata" ni igiti gishobora kugera kuri metero 10 kugeza kuri 35 z'uburebure, gifite umutwe w'amababi menshi kandi yijimye. Igihimba cyacyo gishobora kugira umurambararo wa santimetero 60. Igishishwa cyacyo kibanza kuba gisa n'ikijuju kandi kinyerera, hanyuma kigasaduka uko gisaza.
Amababi yacyo agizwe n'udutabi 9 kugeza kuri 15, buri kamwe gafite uburebure bwa santimetero 7 kugeza kuri 16. Indabo zacyo ni nini, zifite ibara ry'umutuku ryerurutse inyuma n'umuhondo cyangwa icunga imbere, ziteranye ku mitwe y'amashami. Hari n'ubwoko bufite indabo z'umuhondo. Utubumbe tw'indabo tutarabumbuka tubamo amazi atukura.
Imbuto zacyo ni udusanduku tw'igiti dushinze, dufite uburebure bwa santimetero 15 kugeza kuri 27, twijimye. Iyo dufunguka, dusohora imbuto nyinshi nto, zifite amababa abonerana atuma zitwarwa n'umuyaga.
"Spathodea campanulata" ikomoka mu mashyamba ashyuha yo muri Afurika, kuva muri Gineya kugera muri Angola ku nkombe y'iburengerazuba, ikagera mu majyepfo ya Sudani no muri Ubugande mu burasirazuba. Yajyanywe kandi mu turere twinshi dushyuha tw'isi, harimo Aziya, amajyepfo ya Afurika, Amerika na Oseyaniya.
