"Spathodea campanulata" iri ku rutonde rw'amoko 100 y'ibinyabuzima byigabiza bibangamiye isi kurusha ibindi, rwakozwe n'Umuryango mpuzamahanga wo kubungabunga ibidukikije (UICN). Yakwirakwiriye cyane mu birwa byo mu nyanja ya Pasifika (Hawayi, Fiji, Nouvelle-Calédonie…), aho yigabiza imirima n'amashyamba. Ikwirakwira binyuze ku mbuto zayo zifite amababa zitwarwa n'umuyaga, ndetse no ku mizi yayo imeraho ibindi bimera, bigatuma kuyirandura bigorana. Ku kirwa cya Réunion, kuva mu 2019 itegeko risaba ko irimburwa.
"Spathodea campanulata" ikunzwe kubera indabo zayo nziza, kandi iterwa cyane ahantu rusange nk'igiti cy'imitako, icyo ku mihanda cyangwa icy'igicucu. Ariko kandi, ibiti byayo byoroshye kuvunika bishobora guteza akaga ku bahisi igihe cy'imiyaga n'inkubi. Imbuto zayo ziribwa mu turere tumwe na tumwe twa Afurika, kandi igishishwa cyayo, amababi n'indabo bikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo.

Zantedeschia aethiopica (mu Gifaransa "arum blanc" cyangwa "calla", mu Cyongereza "calla lily" cyangwa "arum lily") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Araceae", gikomoka muri Afurika y’Epfo. Gikunze kumera ku nkombe z'imigezi no hafi y'ibidendezi.
Kirangwa n'ururabo runini rw'umweru rumeze nk'ingofero, ruzengurutse agati k'umuhondo, kandi gikoreshwa cyane mu gutaka kiliziya no mu ndabo z'abageni. Ibice byacyo bibisi ni uburozi iyo biriwe.
Izina ry'ubwoko "aethiopica" ryerekeza kuri Etiyopiya mu buryo bwa kera, bisobanura Afurika muri rusange. Nubwo amazina yacyo asanzwe ("calla", "arum") yatuma umuntu atekereza ko ari mu bwoko bwa "Calla" cyangwa "Arum", si ko biri: ayo ni amazina atari yo nubwo akoreshwa cyane n'abacuruza indabo.
"Zantedeschia aethiopica" ni ikimera cy'icyatsi kimara imyaka myinshi, gifite igitsinsi ("tubercule"). Amababi yacyo ahora ari mabisi aho imvura n'ubushyuhe bihagije, ariko agahunguka mu turere twumutse. Gifite uburebure bwa metero 0,6 kugeza kuri 1, n'amababi manini y'icyatsi kibisi cyijimye ashobora kugera kuri santimetero 45 z'uburebure.
Indabo zacyo ni nini, zikaboneka mu gihe cy'itumba, icy'izuba n'icy'umuhindo. Buri rurabo rugizwe n'ikibabi kinini cy'umweru ("spathe") gishobora kugera kuri santimetero 25, kizengurutse agati k'umuhondo ("spadice") gashobora kugera kuri milimetero 90. Ako gati gatanga impumuro nziza yoroheje.
"Zantedeschia aethiopica" irimo "oxalate de calcium". Kurya iki kimera kibisi bishobora gutera ububabare bukabije bwo kwokera no kubyimba iminwa, ururimi n'umuhogo, ndetse no kuribwa mu nda no gucibwamo.
Iki kimera gikenera amazi menshi kugira ngo gikure neza: gikunda ubutaka bw'ibishanga, kandi gishobora no kumera amaguru yacyo ari mu mazi agera kuri santimetero 30, ku buryo rimwe na rimwe gifatwa nk'ikimera cyo mu bidendezi. Mu butaka bwumutse, gikunze guhunguka amababi mu gihe cy'izuba.
Gitubururwa no kugabanya igitsinsi. Gishobora no guterwa hakoreshejwe imbuto, ariko ibimera bito bimara imyaka itatu mbere yo kurabya.
Imikoreshereze n'ikimenyetso.
Indabo zacyo zikoreshwa cyane nk'indabo zaciwe, mu gutaka kiliziya no mu ndabo z'abageni mu bukwe.
Muri Irilande, ku izina rya «ururabo rwa Pasika» ("Easter Lily"), iki kimera gikoreshwa n'abarepubulikani nk'ikimenyetso cyo kwibuka imyigaragambyo ya Pasika yo mu 1916.

Jean Fourastié (15 Mata 1907 – 25 Nyakanga 1990) yari umuhanga mu bukungu w'Umufaransa. Ni we wahimbye imvugo "Les Trente Glorieuses" ("Imyaka mirongo itatu y'icyubahiro"), isobanura igihe cy'iterambere Ubufaransa n'ibihugu byinshi bifite inganda byagize kuva Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose irangiye kugeza ku kibazo cya mbere cya peteroli (1947–1973).
Hamwe na Allan Fisher na Colin Clark, ni umwe mu bashyizeho igitekerezo cy'ibyiciro bitatu by'ubukungu, kivuga ko uko igihugu gitera imbere abakozi bacyo bagenda bava mu ubuhinzi no mu inganda bakajya muri serivisi.
Jean Fourastié yavukiye i Saint-Benin-d'Azy, mu ntara ya Nièvre mu Bufaransa. Yize muri École centrale, hanyuma atsinda ikizamini cyo kuba umugenzuzi w'ibigo by'ubwishingizi wa Leta, yandika n'igitabo cy'impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga (doctorat) ku igenzura Leta ikora ku bigo by'ubwishingizi.
Nyuma y'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, Jean Monnet yamuzanye mu kigo cya Commissariat général du Plan, cyateguraga isubirana ry'ubukungu bw'Ubufaransa, ahayobora komisiyo yita ku bakozi. Yabaye umwarimu muri Conservatoire national des arts et métiers (CNAM) i Paris n'umuyobozi w'amasomo muri École pratique des hautes études, anigisha muri École nationale d'administration no muri Institut d'études politiques. Yanditse kandi mu kinyamakuru "Le Figaro", atorerwa kuba umunyamuryango wa Académie des sciences morales et politiques. Yapfiriye i Douelle, mu ntara ya Lot, mu 1990.
Mu gitabo "Le Grand Espoir du XXe siècle" (1949), ashingiye ku ubushakashatsi bwa Colin Clark, yagaragaje ko iterambere ry'ubukungu risaba ko abakozi bimuka hagati y'ibyiciro bitatu by'ubukungu. Mu myaka ya 1950 yashyigikiye politiki yo kongera umusaruro w'umurimo, avuga ko hazaza «umuco wa serivisi ushingiye ku muntu».
Mu 1979 yasohoye igitabo "Les Trente Glorieuses, ou la révolution invisible de 1946 à 1975"; iyo mvugo yabaye iy'ibisanzwe mu Gifaransa.

Jacaranda mimosifolia (mu Gifaransa "flamboyant bleu" cyangwa "jacaranda", mu Cyongereza "blue jacaranda") ni ubwoko bw'igiti kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Bignoniaceae", gikomoka muri Boliviya, Arijantine na Paragwe, muri Amerika y'Amajyepfo.
Kizwi cyane kubera indabo zacyo z'ibara ry'isine ("violet") zitwikira igiti cyose, kandi giterwa mu mijyi myinshi yo ku isi nk'igiti cy'imitako n'icy'igicucu ku mihanda.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere n'umuhanga mu bimera w'Umwongereza David Don mu 1822, mu gitabo "Botanical Register". Mu bitabo bya kera bwitwaga kandi "Jacaranda acutifolia".
"Jacaranda mimosifolia" ni igiti gikunze kugera kuri metero 8 kugeza kuri 12 z'uburebure, gifite umutwe mugari. Igishishwa cyacyo ni ikigina kandi kiroroshye iyo kikiri gito, nyuma kikagenda kiba igikakaye.
Amababi yacyo ni maremare (santimetero 23 kugeza kuri 45), agizwe n'utubabi duto twinshi cyane, kandi aragwa mu gihe runaka cy'umwaka. Indabo zacyo z'isine, zimeze nk'impanda kandi zihumura gake, ziri mu matsinda manini ya santimetero 30 kugeza kuri 45. Urubuto rwacyo ni igishishwa gikomeye kimeze nk'isahani, gifite santimetero hafi 7.
Igiti gikomoka muri Boliviya no mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bwa Arijantine. Cyajyanywe mu bihugu byinshi bishyuha cyangwa bitagira ubukonje bukabije, nko muri Espanye, Megizike, Ositaraliya, Afurika y'Epfo n'ahandi.
Muri Afurika y'Epfo, cyahageze mu kinyejana cya 19 kandi kibaye ikimenyetso cy'impeshyi mu mijyi ya Pretoria na Johannesburg; ariko gifatwa nk'ikimera cyigabiza kuko gishobora gukura nta muntu ukitayeho.
Giterwa cyane ku mihanda, mu busitani no mu mbuga nk'igiti cy'imitako n'icy'igicucu. Ntigikwiriye guterwa hafi ya pisine kuko kigusha amababi n'indabo byinshi.
Mu Rwanda no mu buvanganzo.
Umuhanzi n'umwanditsi Gaël Faye yise igitabo cye "Jacaranda" (Grasset, 2024), kivuga ku kwiyubaka k'u Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, cyahawe igihembo cya Renaudot mu 2024. Avuga ko icyo giti cyazanywe n'abakoloni kivuye muri Amerika y'Amajyepfo kigaterwa ku mihanda, kandi akagikoresha nk'ikimenyetso cy'«imiterere y'ahantu h'abazima», ahagereranya n'impinduka zihuse z'umujyi wa Kigali aho ibiti bitemwa kugira ngo hubakwe imihanda n'inyubako nshya.

Strelitzia reginae (mu Gifaransa "oiseau de paradis", mu Cyongereza "bird of paradise" cyangwa "crane flower") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Strelitziaceae", gikomoka muri Afurika y’Epfo.
Ni ikimera cy'icyatsi gihora gifite amababi, kizwi cyane kubera indabo zacyo z'icunga n'ubururu zimeze nk'umutwe w'inyoni. Gihingwa cyane ku isi yose nk'ikimera cy'imitako mu busitani no mu nzu, kandi indabo zacyo zigurishwa n'abacuruza indabo.
"Strelitzia reginae" yasobanuwe n'Umwongereza Joseph Banks mu 1788. Izina "reginae" risobanura «cy'umwamikazi» mu Kilatini, rikaba ryibutsa umwamikazi w'Ubwongereza Charlotte wa Mecklembourg-Strelitz. Iwabo, mu ndimi z'Abanguni, cyitwa "isigude".
Izina "bird of paradise" («inyoni yo mu ijuru») rituruka ku buryo ururabo rufunguye rusa n'inyoni zitwa "oiseaux de paradis", naho "crane flower" rigereranya ururabo n'umutwe n'umunwa by'umusambi.
"Strelitzia reginae" ishobora kugera kuri metero 2 z'uburebure. Amababi yayo manini kandi akomeye, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 25 kugeza kuri 70 n'ubugari bwa santimetero 10 kugeza kuri 30, ari ku mitsi ishobora kugera kuri metero 1. Ahora ari mabisi kandi ateye nk'umufana.
Indabo ziri hejuru y'amababi, ku mitwe y'imitsi miremire. Zisohoka mu gisanduku gikomeye kimeze nk'umunwa w'inyoni ("spathe"), giteye ku buryo gisa n'umutwe w'inyoni; ni na cyo inyoni nto zinywa umutobe w'indabo ("souimangas") zihagararaho iyo zije kuzibangurira. Buri rurabo rugizwe n'ibibabi bitatu by'icunga n'ibindi bitatu by'ubururu cyangwa umweru. Iyo inyoni ihagaze ku rurabo inywa umutobe, ururabo rurafunguka maze amaguru yayo agasigwa ibyangurira ("pollen").
"Strelitzia reginae" ni ikimera cy'imitako gikunzwe cyane. Cyageze bwa mbere mu Bwongereza mu 1773, gihingwa mu busitani bw'ibimera bwa Kew, maze kikwirakwira ku isi yose, harimo Amerika na Ositaraliya, ahantu hose hari izuba n'ubushyuhe. Ni ururabo rw'ikimenyetso rw'umujyi wa Los Angeles muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika.
Gikunda ubutaka bukungahaye ku ifumbire n'ahantu hari izuba cyangwa igicucu gito. Ntikihanganira ubukonje bukabije: mu turere dukonje gihingwa mu nzu cyangwa mu nzu z'ibirahure.

Amoko mu Rwanda bivuga amatsinda atatu y'abantu yakunze kuvugwa mu Rwanda: Abahutu, Abatutsi na Abatwa. Bose bavuga ururimi rumwe, Ikinyarwanda, kandi basangiye umuco n'imyemerere.
Inkomoko n'imiterere y'aya matsinda ni ingingo itavugwaho rumwe n'abahanga mu mateka. Mu gihe cy'ubukoloni, Ababiligi bayagize ibyiciro bidahinduka byanditswe mu ndangamuntu, ibyo bigira uruhare mu macakubiri yagejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Abakurambere b'Abahutu n'Abatutsi batuye muri aka karere mu gihe cy'imyaka igera ku bihumbi bibiri, basangira ururimi, imyemerere, umuco n'intwari. Abenshi bari abahinzi, naho aborozi b'inka babanaga na bo. Mbere, ijambo «Umututsi» ryavugaga umuntu ukize ku nka, naho «Umuhutu» rikavuga umugaragu cyangwa umuntu uri munsi y'undi; buhoro buhoro «Abatutsi» ryaje kuvuga abategetsi, «Abahutu» rivuga rubanda.
Imbibi hagati y'Abahutu n'Abatutsi ntizari zidahinduka, kandi bamwe mu Bahutu bari mu butegetsi. Abatwa, bari hafi 1 % by'abaturage, bari abahigi n'abatoragura mu mashyamba.
Inkomoko itavugwaho rumwe.
Abahanga bamwe bavuga ko amatsinda atatu yaje mu Rwanda mu bihe bitandukanye: mbere Abatwa, hakurikiraho Abahutu, hanyuma Abatutsi baturutse mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba mu kinyejana cya 14 cyangwa cya 15. Abandi bemeza ko ayo matsinda yatandukanye buhoro buhoro mu gihugu, bitewe n'imibereho n'ubukungu.
Mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, Abanyaburayi bakwirakwije «igitekerezo cy'Abahami» ("Hamitic hypothesis"), cyavugaga ko Abatutsi ari ubwoko bwisumbuye bwaturutse mu majyaruguru ya Afurika. Kuva mu myaka ya 1960, abahanga mu mateka bagaragaje ko iyo nkuru yari ishingiye ku bitekerezo by'Abanyaburayi kurusha amateka nyayo y'u Rwanda.
Ubukoloni n'indangamuntu.
Ku butegetsi bw'Ababiligi, imyanya y'ubutegetsi n'amashuri makuru byahawe ahanini Abatutsi, ibyo byongera urwango hagati y'amatsinda. Mu myaka ya 1930, Ababiligi banditse ubwoko bwa buri Munyarwanda mu ndangamuntu: hafi 84 % Abahutu, 15 % Abatutsi na 1 % Abatwa. Iryo yandikwa ryatumye ibyiciro bidahinduka.
Nyuma ya revolisiyo yo mu 1959–1961, ubutegetsi bwa repubulika bwakomeje gukoresha iyo ndangamuntu mu guheza Abatutsi mu kazi no mu mashuri.
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ubwoko bwavanywe mu ndangamuntu. Mu 2013, Komisiyo y'Igihugu y'Ubumwe n'Ubwiyunge yatangije gahunda ya «Ndi Umunyarwanda», naho itegeko n° 59/2018 ryo ku wa 22 Kanama 2018 rihana icyaha cy'ingengabitekerezo ya jenoside n'ibyaha bifitanye isano na cyo.

Delonix regia (mu Gifaransa "flamboyant", mu Cyongereza "flame tree" cyangwa "royal poinciana") ni ubwoko bw'igiti kirabya cyo mu muryango w'ibishyimbo ("Fabaceae"), gikomoka muri Madagasikari.
Kizwi cyane kubera indabo zacyo nyinshi z'umutuku cyangwa icunga n'amababi yacyo ameze nk'aya "fougère". Giterwa hose mu turere dushyuha tw'isi nk'igiti cy'imitako n'icy'igicucu ku mihanda no ku bibuga rusange.
Izina ry'ubwoko "Delonix" rikomoka mu Kigereki "delos" («bigaragara») na "onux" («urwara»), kubera ko amababi y'indabo zacyo afite agati karekare; naho "regia" bisobanura «cy'umwami» mu Kilatini, rikaba ryerekana ubwiza bw'indabo zacyo.
"Delonix regia" ni igiti gisanzwe gifite uburebure bwa metero 5 kugeza kuri 8, ariko gishobora kurenga metero 15. Igihimba cyacyo kiba kinyerera kandi gisa n'ikijuju iyo kikiri gito. Umutwe wacyo umeze nk'umutaka, ufite amashami manini n'amababi agabanyijemo uduce duto twinshi, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 30 kugeza kuri 50.
Indabo zacyo zifite amababi ane y'umutuku agera kuri santimetero 8, n'irya gatanu rinini rihagaze hagati, rifite imirongo y'umweru cyangwa y'umuhondo. Kirabya cyane ku mpera z'igihe cy'izuba. Imbuto zacyo ni imiteja minini ifite uburebure bwa santimetero 40 kugeza kuri 60 n'ubugari bwa santimetero 5, buri wose urimo imbuto nka cumi.
Nubwo cyari kimaze ibinyejana byinshi gihingwa hirya no hino, aho cyakomotse ntihari hazwi neza kugeza mu 1932, ubwo umuhanga J. Leandri yavumburaga ibiti byacyo byimereye mu gasozi ku nkombe y'iburengerazuba bwa Madagasikari. Ubu giterwa mu turere twose dushyuha tw'isi, harimo Afurika, Aziya, Amerika n'amajyaruguru ya Ositaraliya.
"Delonix regia" yakoreshejwe nk'igiti gitanga igicucu mu mirima y'icyayi no mu nzuri, ku mihanda no ku bibuga rusange. Indabo zacyo zitanga umutobe ukoreshwa n'inzuki mu gukora ubuki. Igiti cyacyo cyoroshye gikoreshwa mu kubaka ibintu byoroheje nk'ubwato, nubwo cyangizwa n'imiswa; kenshi gikoreshwa nk'inkwi, kimwe n'imiteja yacyo.

Uruhare rw'Ubufaransa muri jenoside y'Abatutsi mu Rwanda ni ingingo ivugwaho impaka ku bijyanye n'ibyo Ubufaransa bwakoze mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ubufaransa bwashyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana mu bya gisirikare no mu bubanyi n'amahanga mu ntambara bwarwanaga na FPR-Inkotanyi.
Mu 2021, raporo ya komisiyo y'abahanga mu mateka iyobowe na Vincent Duclert yagaragaje «inshingano ziremereye kandi zikomeye» z'abategetsi b'Abafaransa, naho raporo yasabwe na guverinoma y'u Rwanda ivuga ko Ubufaransa bwafashije ko jenoside yashoboraga guteganywa iba. Muri uwo mwaka, Perezida Emmanuel Macron yaje i Kigali kwemera izo nshingano.
Mbere ya jenoside, abategetsi b'Abafaransa bahaye ubutegetsi bwa Habyarimana intwaro, bahugura ingabo zabwo kandi barabukingira, nubwo ubwo butegetsi bwatesheshaga agaciro Abatutsi. Ubwo bufatanye bwa gisirikare bwanyuze mu bikorwa nka Igikorwa cya Noroît.
Mu gihe cya jenoside.
Nk'uko raporo yasabwe na guverinoma y'u Rwanda ibivuga, Ubufaransa «nta cyo bwakoze» ngo buhagarike ubwicanyi muri Mata na Gicurasi 1994.
Ku wa 22 Kamena 1994, Akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano kemeje icyemezo 929 cyemerera Ubufaransa gukora igikorwa cya gisirikare cyiswe "Opération Turquoise", cyayobowe na Jenerali Jean-Claude Lafourcade. Raporo y'u Rwanda ivuga ko icyo gikorwa cyaje gikerewe ngo kirokore Abatutsi benshi.
Nk'uko imiryango FIDH, LDH na Survie ibivuga, mu misozi ya Bisesero, aho Abatutsi babarirwa mu bihumbi bishwe hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994, ingabo z'Abafaransa zari hafi zamenye amakuru ku wa 27 Kamena, ariko ubwicanyi bukomeza kugeza ku wa 30 Kamena ubwo zageraga ku barokotse. Iyo miryango yaregeye inkiko z'Ubufaransa ku cyaha cyo gufatanya na jenoside.
Raporo n'ijambo rya Macron.
Ku wa 26 Werurwe 2021, komisiyo y'abahanga mu mateka yashyizweho na Perezida Emmanuel Macron, iyobowe na Vincent Duclert, yamushyikirije raporo yayo. Yanzuye ko Ubufaransa bufite «inshingano ziremereye kandi zikomeye» ("responsabilités lourdes et accablantes"), inenga «ubuhumyi» bwa Perezida François Mitterrand n'abari bamukikije, ariko ntiyemeza ko Ubufaransa bwafatanyije n'abakoze jenoside.
Ku wa 19 Mata 2021, guverinoma y'u Rwanda yashyize ahagaragara raporo y'impapuro 600 yakozwe n'ikigo cy'abanyamategeko cyo muri Amerika, Levy Firestone Muse. Yanzuye ko Ubufaransa bufite uruhare rukomeye mu gufasha ko «jenoside yashoboraga guteganywa» iba, ko nyuma bwahishe uruhare rwabwo kandi bukingira abakoze ibyaha, ariko ko nta kimenyetso cyerekana ko Abafaransa bagize uruhare rutaziguye mu bwicanyi.
Ku wa 27 Gicurasi 2021, i Kigali, Macron yavuze ati «naje kwemera inshingano zacu» ("je viens reconnaître nos responsabilités"), ariko ntiyasaba imbabazi, kandi yongera kuvuga ko Ubufaransa butafatanyije n'abakoze jenoside.

Canna indica (mu Gifaransa "canna" cyangwa "balisier", mu Cyongereza "Indian shot" cyangwa "edible canna") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Cannaceae", gikomoka muri Amerika ishyuha.
Ni ikimera cy'icyatsi kimara imyaka myinshi, gifite amababi manini asa n'ay'insina n'indabo z'umutuku cyangwa umuhondo. Gihingwa ku isi yose nk'ikimera cy'imitako, kandi muri Amerika y'Epfo gihingirwa ibitsinsi byacyo biribwa, bikungahaye ku binyamafufu.
"Canna indica" ikomoka muri Amerika ishyuha, cyane cyane mu birwa bya Karayibe, kandi yakwirakwiriye mu turere twose dushyuha tw'isi, aho ikunze kwimerera ubwayo. Abacukumbuzi b'amateka basanze yarahingwaga muri Peru mu myaka 4 500 ishize.
"Canna indica" ishobora kugira uburebure bwa metero 0,5 kugeza kuri 2,5 bitewe n'ubwoko. Ifite igitsinsi kigabanyije amashami gishobora kugera kuri santimetero 60 z'uburebure. Amababi yayo manini, y'icyatsi cyangwa y'isine, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 30 kugeza kuri 60 n'ubugari bwa santimetero 10 kugeza kuri 25.
Indabo zayo ni nto ugereranyije n'iz'ubwoko bwahinzwe, zikaba z'umutuku cyangwa umuhondo. Imbuto zayo ni udusanduku turimo utubuto duto tw'umukara, dukomeye kandi tuzengurutse.
Muri Amerika y'Epfo, "Canna indica" (yitwa "achira") ihingirwa ibitsinsi byayo biribwa, bishobora gutekwa cyangwa kuribwa ari bibisi, kandi bikurwamo amidoni ("amidon"). Mu Burayi no mu bindi bihugu ikoreshwa cyane cyane nk'ikimera cy'imitako mu busitani.
Amababi yayo akoreshwa mu gupfunyika ibiryo, naho utubuto twayo dukomeye dukoreshwa mu gukora amasaro n'ibikoresho by'umuziki nka "maracas" cyangwa "kayamb" (ku kirwa cya Réunion).

Hibiscus rosa-sinensis (mu Gifaransa "hibiscus" cyangwa "rose de Chine", mu Cyongereza "Chinese hibiscus") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Malvaceae", giterwa ku isi hose mu turere dushyuha kubera indabo zacyo nini z'amabara menshi.
Ni ururabo rw'igihugu cya Maleziya. Buri rurabo rumara umunsi umwe gusa, ariko igihuru kirabya kenshi.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Species Plantarum" (1753). Inkomoko yacyo nyayo ntiramenyekana neza: "Plants of the World Online" ivuga ko ari ikimera cyahinzwe gikomoka ku mvange z'amoko yo mu birwa byo mu majyepfo y'inyanja ya Pasifika, naho izindi nkomoko zivuga ko gikomoka muri Aziya.
"Hibiscus rosa-sinensis" ni igihuru gishobora kugera kuri metero 1,2 kugeza kuri 3 z'uburebure. Amababi yacyo ni icyatsi kibisi cyijimye, arabagirana kandi ntagwa, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 7 kugeza kuri 15 n'impande zifite amenyo.
Indabo zacyo zishobora kugira diyametero ya santimetero 5 kugeza kuri 25, zikagira amabara menshi: umweru, umuhondo, oranje, iroza, umutuku cyangwa isine. Buri rurabo rumara umunsi umwe, ariko igihuru gikomeza kurabya igihe kirekire.
Aho kiboneka n'imikoreshereze.
Giterwa mu turere twinshi dushyuha two ku isi, harimo ibihugu byo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba nka Kenya, Tanzaniya na Uganda, ndetse no muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Giterwa cyane nk'igihuru cy'imitako mu busitani, ku nkengero z'inzu cyangwa nk'uruzitiro. Gikoreshwa kandi mu buvuzi, mu biribwa no mu kugaburira amatungo.

Bahutu Manifesto (mu Gifaransa "Manifeste des Bahutu") ni inyandiko yanditswe ku wa 24 Werurwe 1957 n'abize b'Abahutu icyenda, barimo Grégoire Kayibanda, yamagana ubusumbane hagati y'Abahutu n'Abatutsi ku butegetsi bw'Ababiligi.
Iyo nyandiko yagize uruhare runini mu ishingwa ry'imitwe ya politiki y'Abahutu no mu bikorwa byo mu 1959 byakuyeho ingoma ya cyami, kandi yongereye amacakubiri yagejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.
Mu 1957, igihe Inama nkuru y'igihugu yasabaga ko ubutegetsi bwahabwa Abanyarwanda vuba, itsinda ry'abayobozi b'Abahutu ryabonaga ko ibyo byari gukomeza ubutegetsi bw'Abatutsi. Ku wa 24 Werurwe 1957, i Kabgayi, Grégoire Kayibanda, Calliope Mulindahabi na Aloys Munyangaju n'abandi bashyize ahagaragara iyo nyandiko.
Umutwe wayo wuzuye wari "Note sur l'aspect social du problème racial indigène au Rwanda" («Inyandiko ku bijyanye n'imibereho y'ikibazo cy'amoko kavukire mu Rwanda»), ikaba yari igenewe Guverineri wa Ruanda-Urundi.
Iyo nyandiko yavugaga ko ikibazo nyamukuru cy'u Rwanda ari uko ubutegetsi, ubukungu n'imibereho byari byihariwe n'Abatutsi, kandi yashinjaga ubutegetsi bwa gikoloni bwakoreraga mu bami b'Abatutsi ("indirect rule"). Yasabaga ubumwe bw'Abahutu mu bya politiki.
Mu 1959, abayobozi ba politiki b'Abahutu, bafashijwe n'Ababiligi, bakuyeho ingoma ya cyami y'Abatutsi; Abatutsi ibihumbi bishwe, abagera ku 130.000 bahungira mu bihugu bituranye n'u Rwanda. U Rwanda rwabonye ubwigenge ku wa 1 Nyakanga 1962. Grégoire Kayibanda yabaye Perezida wa mbere wa Repubulika, ayoboye ishyaka Parmehutu.

Euphorbia pulcherrima (izwi cyane ku izina rya "poinsettia"; mu Gifaransa "étoile de Noël") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru cyo mu muryango wa "Euphorbiaceae", gikomoka muri Amerika yo Hagati no mu majyepfo ya Megizike.
Kizwi cyane kubera ibibabi byacyo by'umutuku werurutse bisa n'indabo, kandi kigurishwa cyane nk'ikimera cy'imitako mu gihe cya Noheli mu majyaruguru y'isi. Gifite amazi asa n'amata ashobora gutera indwara z'uruhu.
Izina ryacyo rya kera "Poinsettia" rikomoka ku izina rya Joel Roberts Poinsett, ambasaderi wa mbere wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika muri Megizike. Mu Gifaransa cyitwa «inyenyeri ya Noheli» ("étoile de Noël"), kuko ibibabi byacyo by'amabara biteye nk'inyenyeri kandi kigurishwa cyane mu gihe cya Noheli.
Aho gikomoka, "Euphorbia pulcherrima" ni igihuru gishobora kugera kuri metero 4 kugeza kuri 5 z'uburebure. Amababi yacyo ni ay'icyatsi kibisi cyijimye, afite umutsi muremure n'imitsi igaragara.
Ibibabi byo hejuru ("bractées") bifata ibara ry'umutuku werurutse (cyangwa andi mabara ku moko yahinzwe), bigakora nk'amababi y'indabo. Indabo nyazo ni nto, zitanga umutobe, kandi ziteranye hagati y'ibyo bibabi.
Kimwe n'ibindi bimera byo mu bwoko bwa "Euphorbia", iki kimera gifite amazi asa n'amata ("latex") mu bice byacyo byose. Kizwi n'abahinzi n'abacuruza indabo kubera indwara z'uruhu gishobora gutera. Abantu bafite ubwivumbure ku "latex" bashobora no kugira ubwivumbure kuri iki kimera.

Tecoma stans (mu Gifaransa "trompette d'or", mu Cyongereza "yellow bells" cyangwa "yellow trumpetbush") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Bignoniaceae", gikomoka muri Amerika ishyuha.
Gihingwa cyane nk'ikimera cy'imitako kubera indabo zacyo z'umuhondo zimeze nk'impanda, ariko mu turere twinshi tw'isi cyabaye ikimera cyigabiza gikomeye.
"Tecoma stans" ni igihuru gifite uburebure bwa metero 1 kugeza kuri 8. Amababi yacyo agizwe n'udutabi 3 kugeza kuri 6 tw'impande ebyiri, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 10 kugeza kuri 25.
Indabo zacyo z'umuhondo werurutse zimeze nk'impanda, ziteranye ku mitwe y'amashami. Imbuto zacyo ni imiteja miremire imanitse; iyo ifunguka isohora imbuto nyinshi zifite amababa zitwarwa n'umuyaga.
"Tecoma stans" ikomoka mu turere dushyuha twa Amerika, kuva mu majyepfo ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika (Texas, Arizona, Nouveau-Mexique) no muri Megizike kugeza muri Amerika y'Epfo. Ikunda uturere twumutse kandi turimo izuba, cyane cyane ku nkengero z'imihanda.
Kubera ko yajyanywe ahantu henshi ku isi kubera ubwiza bwayo, "Tecoma stans" ubu ifatwa nk'ikimera cyigabiza muri Afurika (cyane cyane muri Afurika y’Epfo), muri Amerika y'Epfo, muri Aziya, muri Ositaraliya no mu birwa bya Pasifika. Ikwirakwira binyuze ku mbuto zayo zitwarwa n'umuyaga no ku mishibuka imera ku gishyitsi.
Muri Nouvelle-Calédonie, aho bivugwa ko yageze mu 1904, yabaye ikibazo gikomeye ku buryo itegeko ribuza kuyitera, kuyitwara cyangwa kuyigurisha.

Callistemon ni ubwoko ("genre") bw'ibihuru byo mu muryango wa "Myrtaceae", bikomoka muri Ositaraliya. Mu Gifaransa byitwa "rince-bouteille", mu Cyongereza "bottlebrush", kubera ko indabo zabyo zimeze nk'uburoso bwo koza amacupa.
Bihingwa hirya no hino ku isi nk'ibimera by'imitako mu busitani no ku mihanda. Abahanga bamwe ubu babishyira mu bwoko bwa "Melaleuca".
Izina "Callistemon" rikomoka mu Kigereki "kallos" («ubwiza») na "stemon" («igice cy'ururabo gitanga ibyangurira», "étamine"), kubera "étamines" ndende z'amabara zigize indabo zabyo. Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere n'Umwongereza Robert Brown mu 1814.
"Callistemon" ni ibihuru cyangwa ibiti bito. Indabo zabyo ziteranye ku mashami zimeze nk'uburoso burebure, kandi ibara ryazo (akenshi umutuku) riterwa na "étamines" ndende. Imbuto zabyo ni udusanduku duto dukomeye tuguma ku mashami imyaka myinshi.
Ubwoko bwose bwa "Callistemon" bukomoka muri Ositaraliya, ariko buhingwa ahantu henshi ku isi kandi bwimereye ubwabwo ahantu hamwe na hamwe. Biboneka cyane cyane mu turere dufite ubushyuhe buringaniye bwa Ositaraliya, cyane cyane ku nkombe y'iburasirazuba, kandi amoko amwe aboneka no muri Nouvelle-Calédonie. Amoko amwe yihanganira amapfa.

Inshingano y'abinjira n'abasohoka muri Banyarwanda (mu Gifaransa "Mission d'immigration des Banyarwanda", MIB) yari gahunda y'ubutegetsi bwa gikoloni bw'Ababiligi yimuriye Abanyarwanda benshi muri Kongo Mbiligi, cyane cyane mu karere ka Masisi, muri Kivu y'Amajyaruguru y'ubu.
Iyo gahunda, yatangiye mu 1937, yari igamije kubona abakozi b'amasambu manini n'ibirombe. Ifatwa nk'imwe mu nkomoko z'amakimbirane y'ubutaka n'ay'ubwenegihugu akigaragara mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Nyuma y'uko Umuryango w'Ibihugu ("Société des Nations") uhaye Ububiligi u Rwanda n'u Burundi mu 1922, abategetsi b'Ababiligi bimuye abantu babarirwa mu bihumbi bavuye muri utwo turere twari dutuwe cyane, babajyana mu masambu yo muri Kivu y'Amajyaruguru y'ubu.
Iyo gahunda yatangiye ahagana mu 1937, ijyana Abanyarwanda i Masisi kugira ngo bakore mu masambu y'abakoloni; izina «MIB» ryatangiye gukoreshwa mu cyiciro cyayo cya kabiri. Abanyarwanda barenga 25.000 bimuriwe i Masisi hagati ya 1937 na 1945, abandi bagera ku 60.000 bahagera hagati ya 1949 na 1955. Umuhanga mu mateka Gillian Mathys agaragaza ko benshi muri bo bari abimukira babishaka, bakoresheje izo politiki za gikoloni mu nyungu zabo.
Abanyarwanda baje kuba hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'abaturage ba Kivu y'Amajyaruguru. Ukwimuka kwabo kwongereye ihangana ku butaka: abatware b'Abahunde ntibishimiye ko abimukira bahabwa ubutaka, akenshi bwakoreshwaga mu guhiga.
Ikibazo cy'ubwenegihugu bw'Abanyarwanda bo muri Kongo cyakomeje guhindagurika mu mategeko: kuva ku Itegeko Nshinga rya 1964, amategeko ya 1971–1972, itegeko ryo mu 1981 ryabikomeje, kugeza ku itegeko ryo mu 2004 n'Itegeko Nshinga ryo mu 2006. Ibihumbi amagana by'Abanyarwanda bagombye kuba Abanyekongo baracyagorwa no kubyemererwa.

Nerium oleander (mu Gifaransa "laurier-rose", mu Cyongereza "oleander") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru cyangwa igiti gito kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Apocynaceae", gikomoka mu karere ka Mediterane kugeza muri Aziya.
Giterwa cyane ku isi hose nk'igihuru cy'imitako kubera indabo zacyo z'iroza, umweru cyangwa umutuku. Ibice byacyo byose ni uburozi bukomeye.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Species Plantarum" (1753).
"Nerium oleander" ni igihuru gishobora kugera kuri metero 1,5 kugeza kuri 6 z'uburebure. Amababi yacyo ni maremare kandi mato mu bugari, akomeye, y'icyatsi kibisi cyijimye, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 10 kugeza kuri 18.
Indabo zacyo zihumura zifite amababi atanu, zikaba umweru, iroza ryijimye cyangwa andi mabara. Imbuto zacyo ni ibishishwa birebire (santimetero 13 kugeza kuri 18) birimo imbuto nto zifite ubwoya, zitwarwa n'umuyaga.
Ibice byose by'iki kimera ni uburozi bukomeye kuko birimo ibinyabutabire byitwa "glycosides cardiaques" bigira ingaruka ku mutima. Kukirya bishobora gutera iseseme, kuruka, gutera nabi k'umutima ndetse n'urupfu. Umwotsi wacyo iyo gitwitswe nawo ugira ingaruka mbi, kandi gishobora kubabaza uruhu. Ni uburozi kandi ku mbwa, injangwe n'amafarasi.
Aho kiboneka n'imikoreshereze.
Gikomoka mu karere ka Mediterane, mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati no muri Aziya kugeza muri Miyanimari. Cyajyanywe mu bihugu byinshi, birimo ibyo muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba nka Kenya na Etiyopiya.
Giterwa nk'uruzitiro cyangwa igihuru cy'imitako; kihanganira izuba, amapfa n'umunyu wo ku nkombe z'inyanja.

Plumeria rubra (mu Gifaransa "frangipanier", mu Cyongereza "frangipani") ni ubwoko bw'igiti gito kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Apocynaceae", gikomoka muri Amerika yo Hagati, kuva muri Megizike kugeza muri Venezuwela.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo zihumura neza, z'iroza, umutuku, umweru cyangwa umuhondo, kandi giterwa cyane mu turere dushyuha two ku isi nk'igiti cy'imitako.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Species Plantarum" (1753). Izina ry'ubwoko "Plumeria" ryitiriwe umuhanga mu bimera w'Umufaransa Charles Plumier.
"Plumeria rubra" ni igiti gito gishobora kugera kuri metero 8 z'uburebure, gifite umutwe mugari umeze nk'inkono. Amababi yacyo ni manini, akomeye kandi arabagirana, akagwa mu gihe runaka cy'umwaka.
Indabo zacyo zihumura, zifite amabara atandukanye bitewe n'ubwoko bwahinzwe; ntizigira umutobe w'isukari, kandi zibangurirwa n'udusimba nk'ibinyugunyugu bya nijoro. Urubuto rwacyo ni igishishwa cyumye gihinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina.
Iyo gikomeretse, kivamo amashira y'umweru ashobora gutera uruhu kwishimagura no kubyimba, kandi kuyamira bishobora gutera kuruka no gucibwamo.
Aho kiboneka n'imikoreshereze.
Gikomoka mu bihugu bya Amerika yo Hagati n'amajyaruguru ya Amerika y'Amajyepfo, kuva muri Megizike kugeza muri Kolombiya na Venezuwela. Cyajyanywe mu turere twinshi dushyuha two ku isi.
Giterwa nk'igiti cy'imitako mu busitani, ku nkengero z'imihanda no mu nkono, kubera impumuro nziza y'indabo zacyo.

Guverinoma y'agateganyo y'u Rwanda (mu Gifaransa "Gouvernement intérimaire rwandais", yitwa kandi «guverinoma Kambanda») ni guverinoma yashyizweho ku wa 8 Mata 1994, nyuma y'iraswa ry'indege ya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana ku wa 6 Mata 1994. Yari iyobowe na Minisitiri w'Intebe Jean Kambanda, naho Théodore Sindikubwabo ari Perezida.
Iyo guverinoma yayoboye u Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kugeza ubwo FPR-Inkotanyi yatsindaga intambara muri Nyakanga 1994. Minisitiri w'Intebe wayo yahamwe n'icyaha cya jenoside n'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda.
Ku wa 8 Mata 1994, Théodore Sindikubwabo, wari Perezida w'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, yatangaje ishyirwaho rya guverinoma y'agateganyo, Jean Kambanda agirwa Minisitiri w'Intebe. Byabaye nyuma y'iyicwa rya Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana ku wa 7 Mata 1994.
Ku wa 12 Mata 1994, iyo guverinoma yimukiye i Murambi muri Gitarama (Muhanga y'ubu), ivuye i Kigali.
Uruhare muri jenoside.
Jean Kambanda yashinjwaga gutanga intwaro ku bantu bari bazikoresha mu bwicanyi, no kudahagarika ubwicanyi nubwo yari afite ububasha ku bakozi bakuru ba Leta n'abasirikare bakuru.
Imbere y'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR), Kambanda yemeye ibyaha byose yaregwaga, birimo jenoside, umugambi wo gukora jenoside, gushishikariza abantu gukora jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Ku wa 4 Nzeri 1998, urukiko rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Yabaye uwa mbere muri urwo rukiko wemeye icyaha, kandi urugereko rw'ubujurire rwemeje icyo gihano ku wa 19 Ukwakira 2000.

Duranta erecta (mu Gifaransa "vanillier de Cayenne", mu Cyongereza "golden dewdrop" cyangwa "skyflower") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru cyangwa igiti gito kirabya cyo mu muryango wa "Verbenaceae", gikomoka mu turere dushyuha twa Amerika.
Giterwa cyane mu turere dushyuha tw'isi nk'uruzitiro n'igihuru cy'imitako kubera indabo zacyo z'ubururu n'imbuto zacyo z'umuhondo. Imbuto zacyo ni uburozi.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Species Plantarum" (1753). Buzwi kandi ku izina rya kera "Duranta repens".
"Duranta erecta" ni igihuru gihora gitoshye gishobora kugera kuri metero 3 kugeza kuri 4,5 z'uburebure, cyangwa igiti gito kigera kuri metero 6. Amashami amwe afite amahwa. Amababi yacyo arateganye, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 2,5 kugeza kuri 7,5.
Indabo zacyo ni ntoya, z'ubururu, z'umweru cyangwa z'iroza, zikurikiranye ku mashami maremare. Zikurura inzuki, ibinyugunyugu n'inyoni. Imbuto zacyo ni utubuto duto tw'umuhondo cyangwa tw'icunga, dufite nka santimetero imwe; inyoni zirazirya maze zigakwirakwiza imbuto.
Gikomoka muri Megizike kugeza mu majyaruguru ya Amerika y’Epfo, no kuva mu majyepfo ya Florida kugeza mu birwa bya Karayibe. Giterwa kandi cyamaze kwimenyereza mu turere twinshi dushyuha tw'isi, harimo Afurika y'Iburasirazuba (Kenya, Tanzaniya, Ubugande) n'Afurika y'Amajyepfo. Muri Afurika y’Epfo gifatwa nk'ikimera cyangiza ibidukikije (icyiciro 1b cy'itegeko NEMBA).
Imbuto n'amababi bya "Duranta erecta" birimo saponine na aside hidorosiyaniki. Kubirya bishobora gutera kuruka, impiswi n'ububabare bwo mu nda, ndetse bikaba byahitana abana cyangwa amatungo nk'imbwa.
Gikoreshwa cyane nk'uruzitiro no mu busitani bw'imitako. Hari ubwoko bwatoranyijwe bufite amababi y'umuhondo, nka 'Sheena's Gold' na 'Cuban Gold'.

Allamanda cathartica (mu Gifaransa "allamanda" cyangwa "liane à lait", mu Cyongereza "golden trumpet" cyangwa "yellow allamanda") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru kizamuka cyo mu muryango wa "Apocynaceae", gikomoka mu majyaruguru ya Amerika y'Amajyepfo.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo nini z'umuhondo zimeze nk'impanda, kandi giterwa mu turere dushyuha nk'ikimera cy'imitako. Amashira yacyo y'umweru ni uburozi.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Mantissa Plantarum" (1771).
"Allamanda cathartica" ni igihuru kizamuka nk'umugozi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 10 iyo cyurira ibindi. Amababi yacyo arabagirana, ni icyatsi kibisi cyijimye kandi akomeye, afite uburebure bwa santimetero 8 kugeza kuri 15, akaba ari mu matsinda ya 3 cyangwa 4 ku gice kimwe cy'uruti.
Indabo zacyo z'umuhondo zimeze nk'impanda, zifite diyametero ya santimetero 6 kugeza kuri 10 n'amababi atanu. Urubuto rwacyo ni rwiburungushuye (hafi santimetero 4), rutwikiriwe n'amahwa yoroshye, kandi rurimo imbuto ziringaniye zifite amababa mato.
Ibice byose by'iki kimera bifatwa nk'uburozi: kukirya bishobora gutera gucibwamo no kuruka, naho amashira yacyo y'umweru ashobora kubabaza uruhu.
Gikomoka mu majyaruguru ya Amerika y'Amajyepfo kugeza mu majyaruguru ya Boliviya, harimo Burezili, Venezuwela na Giyana. Cyajyanywe mu bihugu byinshi bishyuha, birimo Tanzaniya, Madagasikari na Zimbabwe. Muri Queensland (Ositaraliya) gifatwa nk'ikimera cyigabiza gikwirakwira mu mashyamba no ku nkengero z'imihanda.

Imbaraga z'Abahutu (mu Cyongereza "Hutu Power") ni ingengabitekerezo n'umutwe w'Abahutu b'intagondwa mu Rwanda, washyigikiraga ko ubutegetsi bwaharirwa Abahutu bonyine. Izina ryawo rikomoka ku nteruro «Hutu Power» yakoreshwaga n'abayobozi bawo mu myaka ya 1993–1994.
Uwo mutwe watumye amashyaka ya politiki yariho icyo gihe acikamo ibice, kandi wagize uruhare rukomeye muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Nyuma y'iyicwa rya Perezida w'Uburundi Melchior Ndadaye mu Kwakira 1993, Froduald Karamira, wari visi-perezida w'ishyaka MDR, na Justin Mugenzi, perezida w'ishyaka PL, bacamo kabiri amashyaka yabo: havuka «MDR Power» na «PL Power», mu gihe ibindi bice by'ayo mashyaka byari biyobowe na Faustin Twagiramungu na Landouard Ndasingwa. Mu mbwirwaruhame zabo bavugaga ko «Umuhutu ari we ufite ingufu».
Ku wa 23 Ukwakira 1993, Karamira yavugiye ijambo kuri sitade ya Nyamirambo i Kigali, ryakwirakwije cyane interuro «Hutu Power», yaje kuba intero y'Abahutu b'intagondwa mu gihe cya jenoside.
Mu gihe cya jenoside n'ingaruka.
Froduald Karamira, umwe mu bayobozi b'uyu mutwe, yari n'umuyobozi muri Interahamwe; interuro «Hutu Power» yakoreshejwe n'intagondwa mu gihe cyose cya jenoside.
Nyuma ya jenoside, Froduald Karamira yafatiwe mu Buhinde mu 1996, yoherezwa mu Rwanda. Ku wa 14 Gashyantare 1997, urukiko rwa mbere rw'iremezo rwa Kigali rwamuhamije icyaha cya jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu, rumukatira igihano cyo kwicwa; yarashwe ku mugaragaro ku wa 24 Mata 1998 kuri sitade ya Nyamirambo.

Vanny Bishweka (yavutse ahagana mu 1965) ni umucuruzi wo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, ukorera i Goma mu Kivu y’Amajyaruguru.
Ni nyiri hoteli Ihusi n’isosiyete y’amato yo ku Ikiyaga cya Kivu yitwa izina rimwe na yo, kandi yavuzweho kuba umucuruzi ukomeye kurusha abandi i Goma.
Ubwana n’intangiriro.
Yavukiye mu muryango ukennye i Birere, agace k’ubucuruzi k’umujyi wa Goma. Yatangiriye ku bucuruzi buciriritse no gutwara abantu n’ibintu, aho yari atunze moto ebyiri muri esheshatu zari mu mujyi icyo gihe, mbere yo kwagura ubucuruzi bwe mu mijyi ituranye na wo no mu Rwanda.
Mu 1992 yatangiye kubaka hoteli Ihusi ku nkombe y’Ikiyaga cya Kivu, yitiriwe umudugudu wa se wo mu Kivu y’Amajyepfo. Imirimo yarahagaze mu 1994 kubera umutekano muke i Goma; hoteli yuzuye mu 2001 ifungura imiryango mu 2002. Yakira cyane cyane imiryango itanga imfashanyo n’abagenzi bari mu bucuruzi. Mu 2016 yari arimo kubaka hoteli ya kabiri ya Ihusi i Goma.
Ishoramari rye ryatumye hubakwa Goma Serena Hotel, hoteli ya mbere y’inyenyeri eshanu muri uwo mujyi, yafunguwe mu 2020 nyuma y’imyaka icumi yubakwa.
Amato ye ya Ihusi ahuza Goma na Bukavu mu masaha agera kuri atatu, anyuze ku kirwa cya Idjwi. Ni umufatanyabikorwa w’isosiyete yo muri Tuniziya yitwa EPPM, icukura gaze metani yo muri icyo kiyaga, kandi afite 20 % by’imigabane ya Socodee, isosiyete ikwirakwiza amashanyarazi akorwa na Virunga Energie, ishami ry’ikigo gicunga Pariki ya Virunga. Yanateye inkunga iyubakwa ry’inyubako, sitasiyo za lisansi, imihanda n’amasangano y’imihanda i Goma. Mu 2023, Kaminuza Yigenga y’Ibihugu by’Ibiyaga Bigari (ULPGL) yamuhaye impamyabumenyi y’icyubahiro ("honoris causa").

Brugmansia suaveolens (mu Kinyarwanda "ikibutibuti", mu Gifaransa "trompette des anges" cyangwa "trompette du jugement dernier", mu Cyongereza "angel's trumpet") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru cyangwa igiti gito cyo mu muryango wa "Solanaceae", umuryango urimo n'ibirayi n'inyanya. Gikomoka mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Burezile.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo nini zimeze nk'impanda zitendera, z'umweru, iz'umuhondo cyangwa iz'iroza, zihumura cyane nijoro. Giterwa henshi ku isi nk'ikimera cy'imitako, harimo no mu Rwanda. Ibice byacyo byose ni uburozi bukomeye.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere ku izina rya "Datura suaveolens", nyuma y'ubushakashatsi bwa Alexander von Humboldt na Aimé Bonpland muri Amerika y'Amajyepfo; mu 1818 Robert Sweet abushyira mu bwoko "Brugmansia". Izina "suaveolens" risobanura mu Kilatini «gihumura neza».
"Brugmansia suaveolens" ni igihuru kitari igiti gikomeye, kireshya na metero 3 kugeza kuri 5, akenshi gifite igihimba kigabanyijemo amashami menshi. Amababi yacyo ni maremare ameze nk'igi, ashobora kugera kuri santimetero 25 z'uburebure na 15 z'ubugari.
Indabo zacyo zireshya na santimetero 24 kugeza kuri 32, zimeze nk'impanda ifite imitwe itanu migufi ihetamiye hanze. Ku manywa zitendera zifunze igice, nijoro zigafunguka neza kandi zigahumura kugira ngo zikurure ibinyugunyugu bya nijoro bizitera intanga. Igiti gito gikura gifite uruti rumwe, kikazarabya ari uko kimaze kugira ishami rya mbere ku burebure bwa santimetero 80 kugeza kuri 150.
Gikomoka mu mashyamba y'imvura yo ku nkombe z'inyanja mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Burezile, kuva muri leta ya Bahia kugeza muri Rio Grande do Sul. Abantu bakijyanye mu bihugu byinshi bishyuha, birimo u Rwanda, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Etiyopiya na Madagasikari.
Uburozi n'imikoreshereze.
Ibice byose by'iki kimera, cyane cyane imbuto n'amababi, birimo "alkaloïdes" zo mu bwoko bwa "tropane" nka scopolamine (hyoscine), zitera ibibonekerwa, umutima utera cyane n'ubundi burozi bushobora kwica.
Mu Rwanda, mu buvuzi gakondo bwakoreshwaga mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe, kandi giterwa nk'ikimera cy'imitako. Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe ku mbeba bwerekanye ko ibivuye mu ndabo zacyo bigabanya ububabare.

Gloriosa superba (mu Gifaransa "lis de Malabar" cyangwa "lis de flamme", mu Cyongereza "flame lily" cyangwa "glory lily") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kizamuka cyo mu muryango wa "Colchicaceae". Gikomoka muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara, harimo n'u Rwanda, no mu majyepfo ya Aziya.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo nziza z'umutuku n'umuhondo zimeze nk'ibirimi by'umuriro. Ni ururabo rw'igihugu cya Zimbabwe. Ibice byacyo byose ni uburozi bukomeye, cyane cyane igitunguru cyacyo.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere na Carl Linnaeus mu gitabo "Species Plantarum" (1753).
"Gloriosa superba" ni ikimera kimara imyaka myinshi, gikura kivuye mu gitunguru kinini kimeze nk'inyuguti V. Uruti rwacyo rushobora kugera kuri metero 5, kikurira ku bindi bimera gikoresheje imitwe y'amababi yacyo yizingira nk'imigozi.
Indabo zacyo nini zifite ibibabi bitandatu bihetamiye inyuma, bifite impera zihindagurika. Ibara ryazo riva ku mutuku ukeye ufite inkombe z'umuhondo kugeza ku muhondo werurutse, ndetse hari n'izera.
Gikomoka mu bihugu byinshi byo muri Afurika, birimo u Rwanda, Uburundi, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya na Zimbabwe, ndetse no mu Ubuhinde, Sri Lanka no mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Aziya. Cyajyanywe no muri Ositaraliya no ku birwa byo mu nyanja ya Pasifika.
Gikura mu mashyamba, mu bihuru, mu turere tw'urutare no ku bitaka by'imiswa, ku butumburuke bwa metero 300 kugeza ku 1 800.
Ibice byose by'iki kimera ni uburozi, cyane cyane igitunguru, kubera "colchicine" n'ibindi binyabutabire bikirimo. Kukirya bitera kuruka cyane, kuribwa mu nda no gucibwamo amaraso, kandi bishobora kwica. Igitunguru cyacyo gishobora kwitiranywa n'ibijumba cyangwa ibindi bitunguru biribwa.

Grand Prix ya Afurika (mu Cyongereza: "African Grand Prix") ni isiganwa ry'imodoka rya Formula One riteganyijwe kubera mu Rwanda, ku kibuga kizubakwa mu Akarere ka Bugesera, nko mu birometero 40 mu majyepfo ya Kigali.
Rizaba ari ryo siganwa rya mbere rya Formula One muri Afurika kuva muri 1993.
Afurika yakiriye amasiganwa ya Formula One muri Maroke (1958) no muri Afurika y'Epfo kugeza muri 1993. Mu Ukuboza 2024, ubwo i Kigali hafungurwaga inama rusange za FIA, Perezida Paul Kagame yatangaje ko u Rwanda rwifuza kwakira Grand Prix, umugambi washyigikiwe n'umushoferi Lewis Hamilton. Ku wa 13 Ukwakira 2026, yatangarije i Kigali amasezerano y'imyaka icumi na Formula One. Isiganwa, rimenyekanishwa na Visit Rwanda, riteganyijwe gutangira mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2030, ikibuga kimaze kuzura.
Ikibuga cyitwa RISE Motordrome kizubakwa i Bugesera mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba, hafi y'ikibuga mpuzamahanga cy'indege gishya. Cyashushanyijwe na Tilke GmbH na Wurz Design hakurikijwe ibipimo bya FIA Grade 1, kandi kizakurikiza imiterere y'imisozi y'aho kizubakwa. Uyu mushinga uyobowe n'Ikigo cy'Igihugu cy'Iterambere (RDB), ukaba uri mu mushinga mugari wa siporo, ubukerarugendo n'ubucuruzi.

Impatiens niamniamensis (mu Gifaransa "impatience du Zaïre" cyangwa "impatience bec-de-perroquet", mu Cyongereza "parrot plant") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera cy'indabo cyo mu muryango wa "Balsaminaceae". Gikomoka muri Afurika yo hagati n'iy'uburasirazuba, harimo n'u Rwanda.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo z'amabara atatu, umutuku, umuhondo n'icyatsi, zimeze nk'umunwa w'inyoni yitwa "perroquet". Giterwa henshi nk'ikimera cy'imitako, kandi amababi yacyo akoreshwa nk'imboga n'imiti.
"Impatiens niamniamensis" ni ikimera kimara imyaka myinshi, gihagaze, gishobora kugera kuri metero 1 z'uburebure. Uruti rwacyo rurimo amazi menshi, ariko rugakomera nk'igiti hasi. Amababi yacyo ateye nk'igi, ashobora kugera kuri santimetero 22 z'uburebure, afite inkombe zimeze nk'amenyo mato.
Indabo zacyo zimanitse munsi y'amababi, ziri hagati ya 2 na 6 ku ishami rimwe. Zifite umunwa w'icyatsi, hagati h'umuhondo n'umurizo w'umutuku uhetamye nk'inkoni, ureshya na santimetero 5. Urubuto rwacyo rurimo amazi menshi; iyo rukuze ruraturika rugasandaza imbuto.
Gikomoka muri Kameruni, Gabon, Repubulika ya Santarafurika, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Angola, Sudani y'Epfo, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya, Uburundi n'u Rwanda. Gikura ahantu hari ubuhehere n'igicucu cyinshi, mu bihuru, mu mashyamba y'ibishanga no ku nkombe z'imigezi, ku butumburuke bwa metero 350 kugeza ku 2 400. Ntikihanganira ubukonje bukabije.
Muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, amababi yacyo aribwa nk'imboga, kandi akoreshwa mu gukora umunyu w'ibimera. Akoreshwa kandi mu buvuzi gakondo mu kuvura indwara z'umutima, no gupfuka ibikomere n'ibisebe. Muri Afurika no mu bindi bice by'isi, giterwa mu busitani cyangwa mu nkono nk'ikimera cy'imitako.

Hypericum revolutum (mu Cyongereza "curry bush" cyangwa "forest primrose") ni ubwoko bw'igihuru cyangwa igiti gito cyo mu muryango wa "Hypericaceae". Gikomoka mu misozi miremire ya Afurika, harimo n'u Rwanda, no mu majyepfo y'iburengerazuba bw'umwigimbakirwa wa Arabiya.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo nini z'umuhondo ukeye, n'amababi ahumura nk'ikirungo cya "curry" iyo ashwanyujwe. Gikoreshwa nk'inkwi, mu bwubatsi no mu buvuzi gakondo.
Ubu bwoko bwasobanuwe bwa mbere n'umuhanga mu bimera Martin Vahl mu 1790. Izina "revolutum" risobanura mu Kilatini «gihinnye inyuma», ryerekeza ku nkombe z'amababi yacyo zihinnye.
"Hypericum revolutum" ni igihuru gikura vuba, akenshi gifite ibihimba byinshi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 3, rimwe na rimwe kikaba igiti cya metero 10. Igishishwa cyacyo ni ikigina gisa n'umutuku, kigenda gihunguka.
Amababi yacyo ni mato kandi maremare, ateganye ku mpera z'amashami, afite utudomo tw'umukara n'inkombe zihinnye. Iyo ashwanyujwe, ahumura nka "curry". Indabo zacyo z'umuhondo ukeye zigera kuri santimetero 5 z'umurambararo, zifite ibibabi bitanu n'ubudodo bwinshi hagati. Imbuto zacyo ziri mu gasanduku k'ikigina gasa n'umutuku.
Gikomoka muri Afurika, kuva muri Nijeriya no muri Eritereya kugeza muri Afurika y'Epfo, harimo u Rwanda, no muri Yemeni na Arabiya Sawudite. Gikura ku nkombe z'imigezi, ku nkengero z'amashyamba no mu byatsi byo mu misozi miremire, akenshi hamwe n'umugeshi ("Hagenia abyssinica"), ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 400 kugeza kuri 3 700.
Indabo zacyo zisurwa n'inyoni zinywa ubuki bw'indabo n'inzuki nini zibaza imbaho.
Igiti cyacyo gikoreshwa nk'inkwi no mu bwubatsi. Amababi n'ibiti byacyo bikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo, cyane cyane mu kuvura uburibwe bwo mu nda. Ni n'ikimera cy'ingenzi ku nzuki kandi gifasha mu kurwanya isuri. Kubera ko kidafatwa n'umuriro byoroshye, gifatwa nk'urukuta rusanzwe rurinda amashyamba inkongi.

Sir Lewis Carl Davidson Hamilton (yavutse ku ya 7 Mutarama 1985 i Stevenage, mu Ubwongereza) ni umushoferi w'amasiganwa y'imodoka w'Umwongereza, usiganwa muri Formula 1. Yegukanye igikombe cy'isi cya Formula 1 inshuro ndwi (2008, 2014, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019 na 2020), anganya agahigo na Michael Schumacher.
Ni umwe mu bashoferi batsinze cyane mu mateka ya Formula 1, akaba afite agahigo k'amasiganwa ya Grand Prix menshi yatsinze. Yakiniye amakipe ya McLaren (2007–2012) na Mercedes (2013–2024); kuva mu 2025 akinira Ferrari.
Lewis Hamilton yavukiye i Stevenage mu Ubwongereza ku ya 7 Mutarama 1985. Se, Anthony Hamilton, akomoka ku muryango wimukiye mu Bwongereza uvuye muri Grenade; ababyeyi be batandukanye afite nk'imyaka ibiri, maze arererwa na nyina.
Yatangiye amasiganwa ya "karting" (imodoka nto z'amasiganwa) ashishikarijwe na se, maze afite imyaka icumi yegukana igikombe cy'Ubwongereza cy'abato. Mu 1994 yahuye na Ron Dennis, umuyobozi wa McLaren, mu muhango wo gutanga ibihembo.
Mu 1998 yinjiye muri gahunda ya McLaren yo gutoza abashoferi bakiri bato. Yegukanye shampiyona ya Formula 3 Euroseries mu 2005, n'iya GP2 mu 2006 ari mu ikipe ya ART Grand Prix.
McLaren (2007–2012).
Hamilton yinjiye muri Formula 1 mu 2007 afite imyaka 22, mu ikipe ya McLaren iruhande rwa Fernando Alonso. Muri uwo mwaka wa mbere yatsinze amasiganwa ane, maze asoza ari uwa kabiri, arushwa inota rimwe gusa na Kimi Räikkönen. Mu 2008 yegukanye igikombe cy'isi ku nshuro ya mbere afite imyaka 23, ku isiganwa rya nyuma muri Burezile, aba icyo gihe nyampinga w'isi muto kurusha abandi bose.
Mercedes (2013–2024).
Mu 2013 yasimbuye Michael Schumacher mu ikipe ya Mercedes ku masezerano y'imyaka itatu. Hamwe n'iyo kipe yegukanye ibikombe bitandatu by'isi hagati ya 2014 na 2020, maze mu 2020 anganya na Schumacher agahigo k'ibikombe birindwi.
Mu 2021 yahatanye na Max Verstappen kugeza ku isiganwa rya nyuma i Abu Dhabi: imodoka y'umutekano ("safety car") imaze kwinjira habura amazenguruka make, Verstappen wari wahinduye amapine yamunyuzeho ku izenguruka rya nyuma, yegukana igikombe. Ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2024 yatsinze Grand Prix y'Ububiligi, iba intsinzi ye ya 105 muri Formula 1.
Ferrari (kuva 2025).
Ku ya 1 Gashyantare 2024, Ferrari na Mercedes byatangaje ko Hamilton azakinira Ferrari guhera mu 2025, iruhande rwa Charles Leclerc, nyuma y'imyaka cumi n'umwe muri Mercedes. Mu 2026 yabaye uwa gatatu muri Grand Prix y'Ubushinwa i Shanghai, bwa mbere ageze ku ruhimbi ("podium") ari kumwe na Ferrari.
Ibikorwa by'ubugiraneza.
Muri Kamena 2020, Hamilton yashinze "Hamilton Commission" afatanyije na Royal Academy of Engineering, igamije kumenya inzitizi zibuza Abirabura kwinjira no kuzamuka mu mwuga w'amasiganwa y'imodoka mu Bwongereza; raporo yayo yasohotse muri Nyakanga 2021 ifite ibyifuzo icumi.
Muri Nyakanga 2021 yatangije umuryango "Mission 44", ugamije gufasha urubyiruko rwo mu matsinda adahagarariwe neza mu Bwongereza mu burezi no mu kazi, awuha miliyoni 20 z'amapawundi ku giti cye.
Ku ya 15 Ukuboza 2021, Hamilton yagizwe "Knight" n'Igikomangoma cya Wales mu muhango wabereye mu ngoro ya Windsor, ari kumwe na nyina Carmen Larbalestier; kuva ubwo yitwa "Sir Lewis Hamilton".

Dombeya torrida (mu Kinyarwanda "umukore") ni ubwoko bw'igiti cyo mu muryango wa "Malvaceae", gikomoka mu misozi miremire ya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, harimo n'u Rwanda, no mu majyepfo y'umwigimbakirwa wa Arabiya.
Ni igiti cyo mu mashyamba y'imisozi miremire, kizwi kubera indabo zacyo nyinshi z'umweru cyangwa iroza zifite ubuki bwinshi. Gikoreshwa nk'inkwi, mu bwubatsi no mu buvuzi gakondo.
"Dombeya torrida" ni igihuru cyangwa igiti gifite amashami menshi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 12 kugeza kuri 15, gifite ikamba rimeze nk'umutaka. Igishishwa cyacyo ni ikijuju kandi kirashashagirana; imbere ni ikigina kirimo imigozi myinshi.
Amababi yacyo ni manini, afite ubwoya, ameze nk'umutima, ashobora kugera kuri santimetero 30, afite inkombe zimeze nk'amenyo. Indabo zacyo z'umweru cyangwa iroza ziri mu mitwe minini; buri rurabo rufite ibibabi bitanu n'umutima w'umutuku wijimye. Iyo zumye, ibibabi bisigara bizengurutse imbuto bigahinduka ikigina.
Gikomoka mu Rwanda, Uburundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya, Malawi, Zambiya, Etiyopiya, Eritereya, Sudani, Yemeni na Arabiya Sawudite. Kiboneka mu mashyamba atoshye yo mu misozi miremire, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 600 kugeza kuri 3 400.
Mu Rwanda, kiboneka mu turere tw'imisozi miremire, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 800 kugeza ku 3 000, harimo i Gishwati no mu Bugesera. Giterwa mu mirima no ku miringoti irwanya isuri.
Igiti cyacyo gikoreshwa nk'inkwi, mu gukora amakara, mu bwubatsi no mu gukora ibikoresho by'ubuhinzi. Indabo zacyo zifitiye akamaro inzuki, naho amababi yacyo afumbira ubutaka. Igishishwa cyacyo kivamo imigozi.
Mu buvuzi gakondo bwo mu Rwanda, igishishwa cyacyo gitekwa kikanyobwa mu kuvura igogora ribi, cyane cyane nyuma yo kurya inyama nyinshi.

Ipomoea cairica (mu Gifaransa "ipomée du Caire", mu Cyongereza "coastal morning glory" cyangwa "mile-a-minute") ni ubwoko bw'ikimera kizamuka cyo mu muryango wa "Convolvulaceae", umuryango urimo n'ibijumba. Gikomoka muri Afurika ishyuha, harimo n'u Rwanda, no muri Aziya.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo z'iroza cyangwa z'isine zimeze nk'impanda. Kubera ko gikura vuba cyane, mu bihugu byinshi cyajyanywemo gifatwa nk'ikimera cyigabiza, gitwikira kandi kikica ibindi bimera.
"Ipomoea cairica" ni ikimera kimara imyaka myinshi, kizamuka cyizingira ku bindi, gishobora kugera kuri metero 5 z'uburebure. Uruti rwacyo rukiri ruto rumeze nk'umugozi, rukura rugakomera; rurimo amashira y'umweru.
Amababi yacyo agabanyijemo ibice 5 kugeza kuri 7 bigera hafi ku ntangiriro yayo, areshya na santimetero 4 kugeza kuri 9. Indabo zacyo zimeze nk'impanda, zifite ibara ry'isine cyangwa iroza (rimwe na rimwe umweru), n'umutima wijimye; zireshya na santimetero 3,5 kugeza kuri 6. Zirabya umwaka wose, ariko buri rurabo rumara umunsi umwe gusa. Imbuto zacyo ziri mu gasanduku k'uruziga gafite umurambararo wa milimetero 10, karimo imbuto enye z'umukara zifite ubwoya.
Gikomoka mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika, birimo u Rwanda, Uburundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya, Zambiya, Angola na Madagasikari, ndetse no muri Aziya, kuva muri Arabiya kugeza muri Ubuhinde no mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Aziya. Cyajyanywe ku yindi migabane, harimo Amerika, Ositaraliya n'Uburayi bw'amajyepfo.
Gikura ahantu henshi hashyuha: ku nkombe z'inyanja, ku nkombe z'imigezi, mu mashyamba, no mu busitani aho kizamuka ku nzitiro.
Muri Ositaraliya, aho cyazanywe nk'ikimera cy'imitako, "Ipomoea cairica" gifatwa nk'ikimera cyigabiza: gikora ibirago binini ku butaka cyangwa kikazamuka ku biti, kigatwikira ibindi bimera kikabibuza urumuri. Uruti rwacyo rurimo ibinyabutabire bishobora kugirira nabi inka, ihene, intama n'ifarashi.

Igitembe ("Ensete ventricosum"; mu Gifaransa "bananier d'Abyssinie", mu Cyongereza "enset" cyangwa "false banana") ni ikimera kinini gisa n'urutoki, cyo mu muryango wa "Musaceae". Gikomoka mu misozi ya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba n'iy'Amajyepfo, harimo n'u Rwanda.
Mu Rwanda kiboneka mu mashyamba y'imisozi miremire, kandi gikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo no mu mitako. Muri Etiyopiya, ni igihingwa cy'ingenzi gitunga abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 20.
Igitembe ni ikimera kinini kimara imyaka myinshi, gisa n'urutoki ariko kidatanga imineke iribwa. Gishobora kugera kuri metero 6 z'uburebure, gifite amababi manini cyane afite umugongo w'umutuku. Kirabya rimwe gusa mu buzima bwacyo, nyuma kigapfa.
Gikomoka mu Rwanda, Uburundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Ubugande, Kenya, Tanzaniya, Etiyopiya, Malawi, Zambiya, Zimbabwe, Mozambike, Angola na Afurika y'Epfo. Mu Rwanda gikura mu bice by'amashyamba y'imisozi miremire byatemwe cyangwa hafi y'imigezi, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 900 kugeza ku 2 300.
Muri Pariki y'Igihugu ya Bwindi (Ubugande), ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko indabo zacyo zisurwa n'uducurama n'imbeba zo mu biti, naho imbuto zacyo zikaribwa n'ibisimba, inguge n'imbeba nini. Kubera ko kirabya kandi kikera umwaka wose, gishobora gutunga inyamaswa igihe ibindi biryo bibuze.
Mu buvuzi gakondo bwo mu Rwanda, amababi yacyo akoreshwa mu kuvura macinya, naho uruti rwacyo rutetse n'ivu ryarwo bigakoreshwa mu kuvura indwara z'umwijima. Giterwa kandi nk'ikimera cy'imitako.
Muri Etiyopiya, igitembe ni igihingwa gitunga abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 20. Ibinyamafufu biribwa bikurwa mu gice cyo hasi cy'uruti rwacyo kibyimbye, mu bibabi bigize uruti no mu mizi yacyo, bisarurwa nyuma y'imyaka 4 kugeza kuri 7 gitewe. Kihanganira amapfa kandi gishobora gusarurwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose cy'umwaka.

Rwiziringa ("Datura stramonium"; mu Gifaransa "stramoine" cyangwa "pomme épineuse", mu Cyongereza "jimsonweed" cyangwa "thorn apple") ni ikimera cyo mu muryango wa "Solanaceae", gikomoka muri Megizike ariko ubu kiboneka hafi ku isi hose, harimo no mu Rwanda.
Kizwi kubera indabo zacyo z'umweru zimeze nk'impanda n'imbuto zacyo zuzuyeho amahwa. Ibice byacyo byose ni uburozi bukomeye, cyane cyane imbuto.
Rwiziringa ni ikimera kimara umwaka umwe, gishobora kugera kuri santimetero 50 kugeza kuri metero 1,5 z'uburebure. Amababi yacyo ni manini, ateye nk'igi, areshya na santimetero 8 kugeza kuri 17, afite inkombe zimeze nk'amenyo manini.
Indabo zacyo zihagaze, zimeze nk'impanda, zireshya na santimetero 6 kugeza ku 10, zifite ibara ry'umweru cyangwa isine yerurutse. Urubuto rwacyo ni agasanduku k'uruziga kareshya na santimetero 3 kugeza kuri 4,5, kuzuyeho amahwa menshi; iyo gakuze kigabanyamo ibice bine, kakarekura imbuto nyinshi z'umukara.
Gikomoka muri Megizike, ariko cyakwirakwiye ku migabane yose, harimo no muri Afurika. Mu Rwanda gikura ahantu hadahinzwe, mu mirima yararaye no ku nkengero z'imihanda, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 400 kugeza ku 2 000.
Ibice byose by'iki kimera ni uburozi, byaba bibisi cyangwa byumye, cyane cyane imbuto. Birimo ibinyabutabire bya "alkaloïdes" nka atropine, hyoscyamine na scopolamine. Bitera umutima gutera vuba, imboni z'amaso kwaguka, umunwa kuma no kutabona neza; nyuma bishobora gutera guhumeka buhoro, kugagara na koma. Rwiziringa itera kandi ibibonekerwa. Amatungo, cyane cyane inka n'ingurube, ashobora kwicwa no kurya iki kimera.
Mu Rwanda, abavuzi gakondo bakoresha amababi yacyo mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe. Ahandi muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, umutobe w'imbuto zacyo ukoreshwa mu kuvura ububabare bw'amatwi, naho amababi agashyirwa ku ngingo zibyimbye. Kubera uburozi bwacyo, gukoresha iki kimera nk'umuti bishobora guteza akaga.

Ageratum conyzoides (mu Kinyarwanda "inkuruba" cyangwa "akaziraruguma", mu Cyongereza "billygoat weed") ni ikimera cyo mu muryango wa "Asteraceae", gikomoka muri Megizike ariko ubu kiboneka mu bihugu byinshi bishyuha, harimo n'u Rwanda.
Ni icyatsi gito gifite indabo nto z'isine cyangwa z'umweru, gikunze kumera mu mirima no ku nkengero z'imihanda. Mu Rwanda gikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo, cyane cyane mu kuvura ibikomere.
"Ageratum conyzoides" ni icyatsi gihagaze, gishobora kugera kuri santimetero 50 kugeza kuri metero 1, gifite amashami make cyangwa menshi n'ubwoya buke. Amababi yacyo ateye nk'igi, areshya na santimetero 2 kugeza kuri 6, afite inkombe zimeze nk'amenyo n'ubwoya ku mpande zombi.
Indabo zacyo ziteranye mu mitwe mito y'uruziga ifite umurambararo wa milimetero 5 kugeza kuri 6, ifite ibara ry'isine cyangwa umweru. Imbuto zacyo ni nto, z'umukara, zifite uduhembe dutanu tw'umweru tuzifasha gutwarwa n'umuyaga.
Gikomoka muri Megizike, ariko cyakwirakwiye mu turere dushyuha tw'isi yose, harimo u Rwanda n'ibindi bihugu byinshi bya Afurika. Mu Rwanda gikura mu mirima yararaye no ahantu hahinduwe n'abantu, ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 300 kugeza ku 2 300. Ahandi gifatwa nk'icyatsi kibi gikunze kumera mu nzuri no ahantu hadahinzwe.
Mu Rwanda, abavuzi gakondo bakoresha amababi yacyo mu kuvura ibikomere, kandi kizwiho kurwanya imiyege. I Kigali, umuvuzi gakondo akoresha amababi yacyo ashyizwe mu mazi ashyushye mu kuvura indwara z'impyiko.

Kimali ("Galinsoga parviflora"; mu Gifaransa "galinsoga à petites fleurs", mu Cyongereza "gallant soldier") ni icyatsi cyo mu muryango wa "Asteraceae", gikomoka muri Amerika yo hagati, ariko ubu kiboneka hafi ku isi hose, harimo no mu Rwanda.
Ni icyatsi gito gifite indabo nto z'umweru n'umuhondo, gikunze kumera mu mirima nk'icyatsi kibi. Mu bice bimwe bya Afurika amababi yacyo aribwa nk'imboga, kandi gikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo.
Kimali ni icyatsi kimara umwaka umwe, gihagaze, gishobora kugera kuri santimetero 20 kugeza kuri 60, rimwe na rimwe kikagera kuri metero 1,2. Amababi yacyo ateganye, areshya na santimetero 1 kugeza kuri 6,5, afite inkombe zifite amenyo mato.
Indabo zacyo ziteranye mu mitwe mito iri ku mpera z'amashami, akenshi ebyiri ebyiri. Buri mutwe ufite ibibabi bitanu bito by'umweru bizengurutse umutima w'umuhondo. Ikimera kimwe gishobora kubyara imbuto zirenga 7 000.
Gikomoka muri Amerika yo hagati no muri Amerika y'Amajyepfo, ariko cyakwirakwiye ku migabane yose, harimo u Rwanda. Muri Afurika ishyuha kiboneka kuva ku nkombe z'inyanja kugeza ku butumburuke bwa metero 2 400, ahantu hagwa imvura nyinshi. Mu Rwanda kimera ku nkengero z'imihanda, mu mirima yararaye, mu mirima ihinzwe no ahandi hahinduwe n'abantu.
Kubera ko imbuto zacyo zikenera urumuri kugira ngo zimere, gikunze kumera ahantu harangaye, cyane cyane mu mirima y'ibihingwa bikiri bito. Ni icyatsi kibi gikomeye mu mirima y'ingano, ibigori n'ipamba, kandi kibamo udukoko na virusi byangiza itabi, ibirayi n'amashu.
Amababi n'uduti twacyo tukiri duto bitekwa bikaribwa nk'imboga. Gihabwa kandi amatungo nk'inkoko, inkwavu n'ingurube. Mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda, ikimera cyose gikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo mu kuvura umunaniro w'ubwonko ("stress"). Muri Etiyopiya amababi yacyo apfuka ibikomere.

Indwara ya Conjunctivite, izwi kandi nka pink eye, ni ukubyimba kw'igice cy'inyuma cy'ijisho ryera n'imbere mu jisho. Bituma ijisho risa n'umutuku cyangwa ibara ry'umutuku. Ububabare, ubushye, gushwanyagurika, cyangwa gushyuha bishobora kubaho. Ijisho ryagize ikibazo rishobora kuba ryarize cyane cyangwa "rigafunga" mu gitondo. Kubyimba igice cy'ijisho cyera nabyo bishobora kubaho. Kuryarya bikunze kugaragara cyane mu gihe habayeho ubwivumbure. Indwara y'ikibyimba ishobora gufata ijisho rimwe cyangwa yombi.
Impamvu zikunze kwandura ni virusi zigakurikirwa na bagiteri. Ubwandu bwa virusi bushobora kubaho hamwe n'ibindi bimenyetso by'ibicurane bisanzwe. Ubwandu bwa virusi na bagiteri byombi bukwirakwira mu bantu byoroshye. Allergie iterwa n'umukungugu cyangwa ubwoya bw'inyamaswa nabyo ni impamvu ikunze kugaragara. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku bimenyetso n'ibimenyetso. Rimwe na rimwe, icyitegererezo cy'ibisigazwa byoherezwa kugira ngo bivurwe.
Kwirinda biterwa no gukaraba intoki. Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru. Mu ndwara nyinshi za virusi, nta buryo bwihariye bwo kuvura. Inshuro nyinshi ziterwa n'ubwandu bwa bagiteri nazo zirashira nta kuvurwa; icyakora, imiti yica udukoko ishobora kugabanya indwara. Abantu bambara indorerwamo z’amaso n’abafite ubwandu buterwa na gonorrhea cyangwa chlamydia bagomba kuvurwa. Abantu bafite ubwivumbure bashobora kuvurwa n'imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara cyangwa imiti igabanya ubukana bw'uturemangingo.
Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 3 kugeza kuri 6 barwara conjunctivitis buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ku bantu bakuru, impamvu ziterwa na virusi zikunze kugaragara cyane, mu gihe ku bana, impamvu ziterwa na bagiteri zikunze kugaragara cyane. Ubusanzwe, abantu bakira mu cyumweru kimwe cyangwa bibiri. Iyo umuntu atabona neza, afite ububabare bukabije, afite ubushobozi bwo kumva urumuri, ibimenyetso bya herpes, cyangwa niba ibimenyetso bidahindutse nyuma y'icyumweru, ashobora gukenera kwisuzumisha no kuvurwa. Indwara yo mu bwonko ku mwana ukiri mu nda, izwi nka conjunctivitis y’impinja, ishobora no gukenera ubuvuzi bwihariye.

Angina ni ububabare bwo mu gituza, umuvuduko, cyangwa gufungana bitewe n'uko amaraso adatembera neza mu mitsi y'umutima. Ububabare bushobora kugera mu musaya cyangwa ku kuboko. Hashobora kubaho kubura umwuka, ibyuya, cyangwa isesemi. Iyo bibaye gusa iyo umuntu akoze imyitozo ngororamubiri cyangwa stress, bigashira mu minota mike yo kuruhuka, anjine irahoraho. Iyo bibaye mu buryo butunguranye, mu gihe cyo kuruhuka, cyangwa bidahita bishira iyo umuntu aruhutse, biba ari angina idahindagurika.
Ubusanzwe angina iterwa no kuziba no kugabanuka kw'imitsi itanga amaraso mu mitsi y'umutima. Ibintu bishobora gutera indwara birimo hyperlipidemie, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, kunywa itabi, diyabete, n'umubyibuho ukabije. Izindi mpamvu zongera ibyago birimo kubura amaraso, imitsi y'umutima idasanzwe, umutima unanirwa gukora neza, n'umuvuduko w'amaraso ukabije. Izindi ndwara zishobora gutera ibimenyetso nk'ibi zirimo gucika kw'imitsi ifungana, gucika kw'imitsi ifungana mu bihaha, pericarditis, indwara yo kugabanuka k'umuyoboro w'amaraso mu gifu, pneumothorax, ububabare mu gituza, n'imihangayiko.
Ubuvuzi bushobora kuba burimo guhindura imibereho n'imiti. Imiti ikoreshwa mu gukumira ibitero n'ingorane irimo beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, aspirine, statins, na ACE inhibitors. Ibitero bikomeye bishobora kuvurwa na nitroglycerin. Niba ibi bidahagije, umuntu ashobora kubagwa. Ibisubizo bishobora kuba byiza iyo bivuwe.
Mu bihugu by'Iburengerazuba bw'isi, abantu 3.5% bafite indwara ya angina idahindagurika. Bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bantu bakuze aho abagabo barengeje imyaka 65 ari 15% naho abagore bakaba ari 11%. Iri jambo rikomoka ku ijambo ry'ikilatini "angere" ("kwima") na "pectus" ("igituza"), bityo rishobora guhindurwa nk'"ibyiyumvo byo kwima mu gituza".

Melanocytosis yo mu bwoko bwa Congenital dermal, izwi kandi nka Mongolian spot, ni ikimenyetso cy'ubururu n'imvi gifite ibara ridasanzwe. Ni ahantu harambuye kandi akenshi bigira ingaruka ku mugongo wo hasi; nubwo hari n'ahandi hashobora kuba harimo. Muri rusange barakura iyo bageze ku myaka itandatu; nubwo hari bamwe badakira burundu.
Biterwa no kwimuka kutuzuye kwa melanocytes mu gihe cy'ivuka rya mbere. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bishingiye ku kuntu igaragara. Bamwe babyitiranyije n'ibikomere. Muri rusange nta buvuzi bwihariye bukenewe. Abarwayi bavuwe hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa laser. Ntabwo ari abantu bakomeye.
Uduheri two muri Mongoliya turakunze kugaragara, tuboneka hafi 10% by'abazungu, 40% kugeza 70% by'abanya Hisipaniya, 80% by'abanya Aziya, na 98% by'abana b'Abanyamerika b'abirabura. Abagabo n'abagore barwara indwara imwe. Yasobanuwe kandi ihabwa izina ry’Abanyamongoliya na Erwin Bälz mu 1883, umuhanga mu by’imibanire y’abantu w’Umudage wari utuye mu Buyapani.

Udukoko tw'ubwonko yerekeza ku kwandura kw'imitsi yo hagati hakoreshejwe syphilis. Bishobora kubaho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose nyuma yo kwandura. Bishobora kubaho nta bimenyetso, cyangwa bigatera indwara ya meningitis, ibimenyetso bya stroke, paresis rusange, cyangwa tabes dorsalis. Meningite itera kuribwa umutwe, ijosi rigakomera, no kuruka. Guhagarara k'umutima mu buryo rusange bishobora gutera impinduka mu miterere y'umuntu, kwibeshya no gutigita. Ibice bya dorsalis bishobora gutera imikorere mibi y'umubiri, kubura ibinure, ibibazo by'uruhago, no kunyura mu maso mu buryo budasanzwe.
Impamvu ni bagiteri yitwa "Treponema pallidum". Bikunze kugaragara cyane ku bafite agakoko gatera SIDA. Gusuzuma indwara birimo gutobora mu ruhu kugira ngo haboneke amazi yo mu bwonko (CSF) kugira ngo akoreshwe mu isuzuma. Iyo ikizamini cya VDRL kuri CSF cyagaragaje ko ari icyanduye, ibi byemeza ko ari indwara; icyakora, igipimo cyo gupima ko ari kibi ntikibuza ko ari ikibazo. Ibi rimwe na rimwe byuzuzwa n'ikizamini cyo kwiyongerera ubushobozi bwo gufata antibody treponemal (FTA-ABS).
Ubusanzwe, ubuvuzi bwa neurosyphilis bukorwa hakoreshejwe penisiline G ku gipimo cya miliyoni 3 kugeza kuri 4 mu mitsi buri masaha ane mu gihe cy'iminsi 10 kugeza kuri 14. Penicilline ishobora kandi gutangwa rimwe ku munsi binyuze mu gutera mu mitsi hamwe na probenecide mu kanwa. Ku bantu bafite ubwivumbure kuri penisiline, ceftriaxone ishobora gukoreshwa. Iyo bivuwe hakiri kare, muri rusange ingaruka ziba nziza.
Udukoko two mu bwonko (Neurosyphilis) ni gake cyane, nubwo abarwayi bagiye biyongera. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, hafi 2% by'abantu barwaye syphilis hakiri kare, barwaye neurosyphilis. Nubwo mu bice bimwe bya Afurika, abaturage muri rusange bagera kuri 2% bashobora kwibasirwa n’iki kibazo. Abagabo ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore. Mbere y'uko imiti yica udukoko iboneka, abantu bagera kuri 30% by'abarwayi ba syphilis bari bafite neurosyphilis.

Indwara y’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri ni indwara iterwa n’uko ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri budashobora gukora neza ku gice cy’umubiri. Hari nibura ubwoko 80 bw'indwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri. Hafi igice icyo ari cyo cyose cy'umubiri gishobora kugira uruhare. Ibimenyetso bisanzwe birimo umuriro muke no kumva unaniwe. Akenshi ibimenyetso biraza hanyuma bikagenda.
Impamvu muri rusange ntabwo izwi. Zimwe mu ndwara ziterwa n’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri nka lupus zigaragara mu miryango, kandi zimwe na zimwe zishobora guterwa n’indwara cyangwa izindi mpamvu zishingiye ku bidukikije. Zimwe mu ndwara zikunze gufatwa nk'izishingiye ku bushobozi bw'umubiri zirimo indwara ya celiac, diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1, indwara ya Graves, indwara yo kubyimba amara, sclerosis nyinshi, rubagimpande, na lupus erythematosus. Indwara ishobora kugorana kumenya.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'ubwoko n'uburemere bw'indwara. Imiti igabanya ububyimbirwe idakoresha steroide (NSAIDs) hamwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bw'umubiri ikunze gukoreshwa. Immunoglobulin iterwa mu mitsi ishobora no gukoreshwa rimwe na rimwe. Nubwo ubusanzwe kuvurwa bigabanya ibimenyetso, ntabwo bivura indwara.
Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 24 (7%) muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bibasiwe n'indwara y’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri. Abagore ni bo bibasirwa cyane kurusha abagabo. Akenshi bitangira mu gihe cy'ubukure. Indwara za mbere ziterwa n’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri zavuzwe mu ntangiriro z’imyaka ya 1900.

Isotretinoin, igurishwa ku izina rya Accutane n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura ibiheri bikomeye. By’umwihariko ikoreshwa ku biheri bifite uduce duto kandi bitarakira hamwe n’ubundi buryo bwo kuvura. Izindi ngaruka zirimo, ichthyosis, na kanseri zimwe na zimwe. Ifatwa mu kanwa cyangwa igashyirwa ku ruhu.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kubyimba iminwa, triglycerides nyinshi mu maraso, kubabara ingingo, no kubabara imitsi. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo by'imibonano mpuzabitsina, kwiyongera k'ubushyuhe bw'izuba, gutakaza umusatsi, n'ibibazo by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Isotretinoin izwiho gutera ibibazo mu gihe cyo kubyara kandi uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukora neza busabwa guhera mu kwezi mbere yo gutangira kuvurwa. Ni retinoid, bivuze ko ifitanye isano na vitamine A na tretinoin. Bikekwa ko bikora binyuze mu guhindura imikorere y'uturemangingo tw'imisemburo ya sebaceous.
Yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha mu buvuzi mu 1969, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1982. Nubwo ikiri kuboneka hakurikijwe amazina menshi asanzwe, izina ry'umwimerere ryahagaritswe mu 2009 bitewe n'uruvange rw'ibicuruzwa bike byagurishijwe ndetse n'imanza nyinshi ku ngaruka mbi. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu Bwongereza hari gahunda zihariye zo kugabanya ibyago byo gutwita kw'abagore mu gihe bakoresha uyu muti. Mu Bwongereza, miligarama 20 ku munsi mu kwezi zitwara NHS ibiro bigera kuri 17.

Indwara yo kudakunda kwifata (ODD) ni indwara yo mu bwana iterwa n'ibibazo byo kugenzura amarangamutima n'imyitwarire. Bigaragaza imiterere y'igihe kirekire y'umujinya, imyitwarire yo gusuzugura, no kwihimura ku bandi. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo indwara zo guhangayika, indwara zo mu mutwe, ikibazo cyo kwitwara nabi, no gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge nabi.
Impamvu nyamukuru iterwa n’ibintu by’ingenzi bivugwa ko ishingiye ku miterere y’umubiri, ibidukikije n’imibereho. Bikekwa ko hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibyago byo kurwara iyi ndwara biterwa n'uturemangingo. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera ikibazo zirimo ihohoterwa rishingiye ku bana, ubukene, n'itsinda ry'abakene mu rungano. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku kiganiro n'abantu baganira n'umwana. Ibikoresho byinshi byo gusuzuma bishobora gufasha mu gusuzuma indwara. ODD itandukanye n'indwara yo kwitwara nabi kuko ibimenyetso byayo biba bike cyane.
Ubuyobozi bushobora kuba burimo amahugurwa y'ababyeyi, ubufasha mu ishuri, n'ubuvuzi bw'imyitwarire mu bwenge. Iyo ibi bidakora neza, imiti igabanya ubukana bw'indwara zo mu mutwe ishobora gukoreshwa. Indwara ifitanye isano nayo ishobora gusaba kuvurwa. Indwara yo kudahuza ibitekerezo igaragara ko yibasira abantu bari hagati ya 2 na 11%. Abagabo ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore. Gutangira kw'ishuri akenshi biba ahagana mu ntangiriro z'ishuri kandi bigenda bigabanuka uko imyaka igenda ikura.

Indwara ya XYY ni indwara iterwa n’uturemangingo tw’umubiri aho umugabo aba afite chromosome Y y’inyongera. Akenshi ibimenyetso ntibiba byinshi. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo kuba muremure ugereranije n'ibisanzwe, ibiheri, ndetse n'ibyago byinshi byo kugira ibibazo byo kwiga. Ubusanzwe umuntu aba ameze neza, harimo n'uburumbuke busanzwe.
Iyi ndwara muri rusange ntabwo ivuka ku babyeyi b'umuntu ahubwo iterwa n'ibintu bitunguranye mu gihe intanga ngabo zikura. Gupima indwara bikorwa hakoreshejwe isesengura rya chromosome, ariko abenshi mu bayirwaye ntibayisuzuma mu gihe cy'ubuzima bwabo. Hariho chromosomes 47, aho kuba 46 zisanzwe, zitanga karyotype ya 47,XYY.
Ubuvuzi bushobora kuba burimo uburyo bwo kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe cyangwa ubufasha bw'inyongera mu kazi ko ku ishuri, ariko muri rusange umusaruro uba mwiza. Iyi ndwara ibaho ku bana b'abahungu bagera kuri 1 mu 1000. Abantu benshi bafite iyi ndwara ntibazi ko bayifite. Iyo ndwara yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1961.

Ketoconazole, igurishwa ku izina rya Nizoral n'indi, ni umuti uvura indwara ziterwa n'imiti irwanya udukoko ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zitandukanye z'imiti. Iyo ikoreshejwe ku ruhu, ikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara z'uruhu ziterwa n'ibihumyo nka tinea, candidiasis y'uruhu, pityriasis versicolor, dandruff, na seborrheic dermatitis. Iyo uyinyoye ntabwo ari amahitamo meza cyane kandi ni byiza kuyikoresha gusa ku ndwara zikomeye mu gihe izindi miti zidashobora gukoreshwa. Izindi ngamba zirimo kuvura imikurire y'umusatsi ikabije ndetse n'indwara ya Cushing's syndrome.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara iyo zikoreshejwe ku ruhu zirimo gutukura, kuribwa no kuruma. Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara iyo umuntu anyoye zirimo isesemi, kuribwa umutwe, n'ibibazo by'umwijima. Ibibazo by'umwijima bishobora gutera urupfu cyangwa gukenera guterwa umwijima. Izindi ngaruka mbi zikomeye iyo umuntu anyoye zirimo gukomeretsa QT, kudakora neza kw'uturemangingo tw'amaraso, no kunanirwa k'umubiri. Ni imidazole kandi ikora mu kugira ingaruka ku ikorwa rya ergosterol ikenewe ku ruhu rw'uturemangingo tw'ibihumyo bityo igatuma gukura kugabanuka.
Ketoconazole yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imiti mu 1977, itangira gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1981. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe kandi imiti ikoreshwa ku ruhu igurishwa ku giciro cya muganga mu Bwongereza. Umuyoboro wa garama 30 mu Bwongereza utwara NHS munsi y'amapawundi 5 mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho amavuta yo mu bwoko bwa "topical cream" aboneka gusa ku muganga, ikiguzi cy'aya mafaranga ni hafi. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 219 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni ebyiri. Iyi ngingo ifatwa mu kanwa yakuweho mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi no muri Ositaraliya mu 2013 no mu Bushinwa mu 2015. Byongeye kandi, ikoreshwa ryayo ryaragabanijwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na Kanada mu 2013.

Indwara ya Cauda equina syndrome (CES) ni indwara ibaho iyo umutsi uri munsi y'umugongo uzwi nka cauda equina wangiritse. Ibimenyetso birimo kubabara umugongo wo hasi, ububabare bugera mu kaguru, gucika intege hirya no hino mu kibuno, no kubura uburyo bwo kugenzura amara cyangwa uruhago. Gutangira bishobora kuba vuba cyangwa buhoro buhoro.
Impamvu akenshi ni ukuvamo kwa disiki mu gice cyo hasi cy'umugongo. Izindi mpamvu zirimo stenosis y'umugongo, kanseri, ihungabana, ikibyimba cyo mu gice cy'imbere cy'umugongo, na hematoma yo mu gice cy'imbere cy'umugongo. Isuzuma rikekwaho hashingiwe ku bimenyetso kandi ryemezwa n'amashusho ya muganga nka MRI cyangwa CT scan.
Muri rusange, CES ivurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kubaga hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa laminectomy. Ibibazo bidashira by'inkari, imikorere mibi mu mibonano mpuzabitsina cyangwa ibinya bishobora kubaho nubwo haba habayeho kubagwa. Umusaruro mubi uboneka ku bantu bagera kuri 20% nubwo bavuwe. Umuntu umwe kuri 70.000 yibasirwa n’iki kibazo buri mwaka. Byasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1934.

Uduheri, tuzwi kandi nka wheals na urticaria, ni ubwoko bw'uduheri ku ruhu dufite uduheri dutukura, twazamutse kandi dusharira. Bishobora no gushya cyangwa kuruma. Akenshi uduce tw’ibisebe turagendagenda. Ubusanzwe zimara iminsi mike kandi ntizisiga impinduka zirambye ku ruhu. Abanduye munsi ya 5% bamara ibyumweru birenga bitandatu. Iyo ndwara ikunze kugaruka.
Udukoko dukunze kugaragara nyuma yo kwandura cyangwa bitewe n'ingaruka z'ubwivumbure nko ku miti, kurumwa n'udukoko, cyangwa ibiryo. Imihangayiko yo mu mutwe, ubukonje, cyangwa guhindagura bishobora kuba imbarutso. Mu kimwe cya kabiri cy'abarwaye indwara, icyayiteye ntikiramenyekana. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo kugira indwara nk'ibicurane cyangwa asima. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku kuntu igaragara. Gupima ibipande bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu kumenya ubwivumbure.
Kwirinda ni ukwirinda ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose cyatera iyo ndwara. Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe imiti igabanya ubukana nka diphenhydramine na ranitidine. Mu bihe bikomeye, imiti ya corticosteroids cyangwa leukotriene inhibitors nayo ishobora gukoreshwa. Gukomeza ubushyuhe bw'ibidukikije nabyo ni ingirakamaro. Ku bantu bamaze ibyumweru birenga bitandatu, imiti igabanya ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri nka ciclosporin ishobora gukoreshwa.
Abantu bagera kuri 20% nibo barwaye. Indwara z'igihe gito ziba ku bagabo no ku bagore mu gihe iz'igihe kirekire zikunze kugaragara ku bagore. Indwara z’igihe gito zikunze kugaragara mu bana mu gihe iz’igihe kirekire zikunze kugaragara mu bantu bari mu kigero cyo hagati. Udukoko tw’umuhondo twavuzwe nibura kuva mu gihe cya Hippocrates. Ijambo urticaria rikomoka ku ijambo ry'ikilatini "urtica" risobanura "nettle".

Topiramate, igurishwa ku izina rya Topamax n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura igicuri no gukumira migraine. Yanakoreshejwe mu gihe cyo kuba umuntu ukunda kunywa inzoga. Ku ndwara y'igicuri, ibi bikubiyemo kuvura indwara z'igicuri rusange cyangwa iz'icyorezo. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuribwa mu nda, kubura ubushake bwo kurya, kumva unaniwe, kubabara mu nda, gutakaza umusatsi, no kugorwa no kwibanda ku bintu. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kwiyahura, kwiyongera k'urugero rwa ammonia bigatera indwara ya encephalothy, ndetse n'amabuye y'impyiko. Gukoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita bishobora kwangiza umwana kandi ntibikwiye gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo konsa. Uburyo bikora ntabwo birasobanutse neza.
Topiramate yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1996. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ku kwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri £1.40 ku kwezi guhera mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 4.00. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 77 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni icumi.

Limfoma itari iya Hodgkin (NHL) ni itsinda rya kanseri y'amaraso irimo ubwoko bwose bwa limfoma usibye limfoma ya Hodgkin. Ibimenyetso birimo kwiyongera kw'uturemangingo tw'amaraso, umuriro, ibyuya nijoro, kugabanya ibiro no kunanirwa. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubabara mu magufwa, kubabara mu gituza cyangwa gushyuha. Hari ubwoko bukura buhoro buhoro, mu gihe ubundi bukura vuba.
Lymphoma ni ubwoko bwa kanseri buturuka kuri lymphocytes, ubwoko bw'uturemangingo tw'amaraso twera. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo imikorere mibi y'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, indwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri, ubwandu bwa "Helicobacter pylori", hepatitis C, umubyibuho ukabije, n'ubwandu bwa virusi ya Epstein-Barr. Umuryango w’Abibumbye wita ku Buzima ushyira limfoma mu matsinda atanu akomeye, harimo n’irya Hodgkin lymphoma. Mu matsinda ane ya NHL harimo ubwoko burenga 60 bwihariye bwa lymphoma. Gusuzuma indwara ni ugusuzuma umwongo w'amagufwa cyangwa lymph node biopsy. Gufata amashusho y'ubuvuzi bifasha mu kugabanya kanseri.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa no kumenya niba lymphoma ikura buhoro cyangwa vuba, kandi niba iri mu gace kamwe cyangwa mu duce twinshi.
