Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo imiti ivura indwara ya kanseri (chimiotherapie), imirasire (radiation), ubuvuzi bw’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri (immunotherapy), ubuvuzi bugamije, gutera uturemangingo tw’umubiri (stem-cell transplantation), kubagwa, cyangwa gutegereza urebye. Iyo amaraso abaye menshi cyane bitewe n'umubare munini w'abasilikare, plasmapheresis ishobora gukoreshwa. Ariko, imirasire na chimiotherapie bimwe na bimwe byongera ibyago byo kurwara izindi kanseri, indwara z'umutima, cyangwa ibibazo by'imitsi mu myaka yakurikiyeho.
Mu 2015, abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 4.3 barwaye kanseri iterwa na lymphoma itari iya Hodgkin, naho 231.400 barapfa. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, 2.1% by'abantu bagira ingaruka mu gihe runaka mu buzima bwabo. Imyaka ikunze kugaragara yo gusuzuma indwara ni hagati y'imyaka 65 na 75. Igipimo cy'imyaka itanu yo kubaho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ni 71%.

Uburozi bwa Mercure ni ubwoko bw'uburozi bw'icyuma buterwa no kwibasirwa na Mercure. Ibimenyetso biterwa n'ubwoko, urugero, uburyo, n'igihe umuntu yahuye nacyo. Bishobora kuba birimo intege nke z'imitsi, kudakora neza kw'ingingo, kugira ibisebe mu maboko no mu birenge, uduheri ku ruhu, guhangayika, ibibazo byo kwibuka, ibibazo byo kuvuga, ibibazo byo kumva, cyangwa ibibazo byo kubona. Guhura cyane na methylmercury bizwi nka Minamata disease. Guhura na Methylmercury mu bana bishobora gutera acrodynia (indwara y'umutuku) aho uruhu ruhinduka umutuku rukavamo. Ingorane z'igihe kirekire zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo by'impyiko no kugabanuka k'ubwenge. Ingaruka zo kwandura methylmercury ku gipimo gito igihe kirekire ntizisobanutse neza.
Ubwoko bw'ibintu bya mercure birimo icyuma, umwuka, umunyu, n'ibintu bikomoka ku bimera. Ibyinshi mu biyobyabwenge biterwa no kurya amafi, gusiga amenyo hakoreshejwe amalgam, cyangwa kuyakoresha ku kazi. Mu mafi, ayo hejuru mu ruhererekane rw'ibiribwa muri rusange agira urugero rwinshi rwa mercure. Akenshi, uburozi bushobora kubaho nk'uburyo bwo kugerageza kwiyahura. Ibikorwa bya muntu bisohora mercure mu bidukikije birimo gutwika amakara no gucukura zahabu. Ibizamini by'amaraso, inkari n'umusatsi birahari ariko ntibifitanye isano n'ingano iri mu mubiri.
Kwirinda birimo kurya indyo irimo mercure nkeya, gukura mercure mu bikoresho by'ubuvuzi n'ibindi bikoresho, guta mercure neza, no kudacukura mercure. Ku bantu bafite uburozi bukabije buturutse ku munyu wa mercure udakoreshwa, chelation irimo aside dimercaptosuccinic (DMSA) cyangwa dimercaptopropane sulfonate (DMPS) isa nkaho irushaho kuba myiza iyo itanzwe mu masaha make nyuma yo gukorerwa imibonano mpuzabitsina. Kuvura indwara y'umutima ku bantu bahura n'iyi ndwara igihe kirekire nta nyungu igaragara bifite. Mu turere tumwe na tumwe tubaho dukoresha uburobyi, igipimo cy’uburozi bwa mercure mu bana cyageze kuri 1.7 kuri 100.

Benzonatate, igurishwa ku izina rya Tessalon n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kugerageza gufasha ibimenyetso by'inkorora n'imiti iterwa n'inkorora. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Ntibyemewe gukoresha ibi biyobyabwenge ku bari munsi y'imyaka icumi. Ingaruka muri rusange zitangira mu minota 20 kandi zimara amasaha umunani.
Ingaruka mbi zirimo gusinzira, isereri, kuribwa umutwe, kubabara mu gifu, kurwara uduheri ku ruhu, kubona ibintu mu buryo butunguranye, ndetse no kugira ingaruka ku barwayi. Gukoresha imiti myinshi bishobora gutera indwara zo mu mutwe, gutera umutima ku buryo budasanzwe, ndetse no gupfa. Guhekenya cyangwa konka agapfukamunwa bishobora gutera laryngospasm, bronchospasm, no kugabanuka k'amaraso mu miyoboro y'amaraso. Ntabwo birasobanuka neza niba gukoresha iyi miti mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa nta kibazo bifite. Ikora mu kugabanya ibinyabutabire byo mu bihaha no guhagarika uburyo bwo gukorora mu bwonko.
Benzonatate yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1958. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igiciro cya buri kwezi ni hafi $0.12 kuri buri 100. igipimo cya mg. Ntabwo iboneka mu bihugu byinshi. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 148 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni enye.

Adenosine ni ikinyabutabire kiboneka mu nyamaswa zo mu bwoko bwa “belles”, kikaba gikoreshwa no mu kuvura. Nk'umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura cyangwa gusuzuma ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bwa tachycardia yo mu mutwe idakira iyo umuntu arwaye indwara yo mu nda. Muri rusange ikoreshwa mu gutera imitsi vuba vuba. Igikorwa gitangira mu masegonda 40 kandi ingaruka zimara igihe kiri munsi y'iminota 2.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kubabara mu gituza, kumva nta cyo ushoboye, guhumeka nabi, no gucika intege k'uruhu. Ingaruka mbi zirimo kugabanuka k'umuvuduko w'amaraso no kugabanuka k'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Nubwo ishobora gukoreshwa mu gihe cyo gutwita, umutekano wayo nturasobanuka neza. Adenosine ni imwe mu ngingo enye z’ingenzi za RNA. Ikora mu kugabanya inshuro ibimenyetso by'amashanyarazi bishobora kunyura mu gice cy'umutima cya AV.
Adenosine yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1989. Ariko, byagiye byigwa mu miterere y'ibinyabuzima kuva mu myaka ya 1920. Adenosine iboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ntabwo bihenze. Mu Bwongereza mu 2020, dose ya 6 mg yatwaye NHS hafi ikiro kimwe.

Dermatomyositis (DM) ni indwara y'ububyimbirwe bw'igihe kirekire ifata imitsi. Ibimenyetso byayo muri rusange ni uduheri ku ruhu no kugabanuka kw'imitsi uko igihe kigenda gihita. Ibi bishobora kubaho mu buryo butunguranye cyangwa bigakura mu mezi menshi. Ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kugabanya ibiro, umuriro, kubyimba ibihaha, cyangwa kumva urumuri. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo calcium iri mu mitsi cyangwa uruhu.
Impamvu ntiramenyekana. Ibitekerezo birimo ko ari indwara iterwa n’ubwiyongere bw’umubiri cyangwa ingaruka z’ubwandu bwa virusi. Ni ubwoko bwa miyopathie itera ububabare. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku bimenyetso bimwe na bimwe, ibizamini by'amaraso, electromyography, no gusuzuma imitsi.
Nubwo nta muti uzwi w’iyi ndwara, muri rusange uburyo bwo kuyivura butuma ibimenyetso birushaho kuba byiza. Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo imiti, ubuvuzi bw'umubiri, imyitozo ngororamubiri, ubushyuhe, uburyo bwo kuvura ingingo n'ibikoresho bifasha umubiri, ndetse no kuruhuka. Imiti yo mu muryango wa corticosteroids ikunze gukoreshwa hamwe n'indi miti nka methotrexate cyangwa azathioprine isabwa niba steroid idakora neza. Immunoglobulin iterwa mu mitsi bishobora kandi kunoza umusaruro. Abantu benshi barakira iyo bavuwe kandi muri bamwe iyo ndwara irakira burundu.
Dermatomyositis ikunze kwibasira umuntu umwe ku bantu 100.000 buri mwaka. Iyi ndwara ikunze kugaragara ku bantu bari mu kigero cy'imyaka 40 na 50, abagore bakaba ari bo bayirwara cyane kurusha abagabo. Ariko, abantu b'imyaka iyo ari yo yose bashobora kugerwaho n'ingaruka. Iyo mimerere yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu myaka ya 1800.

Indwara y’ibitekerezo iterwa n’indwara, izwi kandi nka Munchausen syndrome, ni indwara yo mu mutwe aho umuntu yirema ubwe, abizi, ibimenyetso by’indwara cyangwa iy’imitekerereze. Ibi bibaho nta cyifuzo cyo gushaka inyungu zo hanze. Ibimenyetso bishobora gutandukana cyane kuva ku bikomere by'uruhu, kugeza ku bisekera, kugeza ku isukari nke mu maraso, kugeza ku kubabara mu gatuza. Ibimenyetso bishobora guterwa no gufata ingamba nko kurya ibiryo byangiritse cyangwa gutera insuline. Bikunze kubaho mu bice.
Impamvu ntiramenyekana. Ibintu bishobora gutera ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, n'urupfu rw'umubyeyi akiri muto. Bikekwa ko ibibazo by'ubuzima bikomoka ku rwego rw'ubuvuzi kugira ngo bikurure abantu. Akenshi ibimenyetso bigaragara ntibihura n'ibyavuye muri laboratwari cyangwa mu mashusho ya muganga. Muri rusange kandi hari amateka menshi yo kujyanwa mu bitaro. Ni ubwoko bw'indwara y'ukuri kandi ifitanye isano n'indwara y'ukuri iterwa undi muntu, yerekeza ku ihohoterwa rikorerwa undi muntu, akenshi umwana, kugira ngo umuntu yitezweho.
Kuvura bikubiyemo kugira impuhwe no kugira inama. Benshi ariko, banze kuvurwa. Indwara y’ubugizi bwa nabi yibasira umuntu ku giti cye igaragara ko yibasira munsi ya 1% by’abashaka ubuvuzi. Bikunze kugaragara ku bagore kurusha abagabo. Gutangira akenshi biba mu bwana. Iyi ndwara yasobanuwe neza bwa mbere mu 1951, yitiriwe umukinnyi w’umuhimbano Baron Munchausen.

Ibitero by'ubwoba ni ibihe bitunguranye by'ubwoba bukomeye bishobora kuba birimo gucika intege, kubira ibyuya, guhinda umushyitsi, guhumeka nabi, kugira ibinya, cyangwa kumva ko hari ikintu kibi kigiye kubaho. Ibimenyetso byinshi bibaho mu minota mike. Ubusanzwe zimara iminota 30 ariko igihe gishobora gutandukana kuva ku masegonda kugeza ku masaha. Hashobora kubaho ubwoba bwo kubura ubushobozi bwo kwifata cyangwa kubabara mu gatuza. Ibitero by'ubwoba ubwabyo ntabwo biteje akaga ku mubiri.
Ibitero by'ubwoba bishobora guterwa n'indwara zitandukanye zirimo indwara y'ubwoba, indwara yo guhangayika mu mibanire y'abantu, indwara yo guhangayika nyuma y'ihungabana, indwara yo gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge, kwiheba, n'ibibazo by'uburwayi. Bishobora guterwa n'ingaruka cyangwa bikabaho mu buryo butunguranye. Kunywa itabi, kafeyine, no guhangayika mu mutwe byongera ibyago byo kugira ikibazo cy'ubwoba. Mbere yo gusuzuma indwara, indwara zisa n’izigomba kuvanwaho, nka hyperthyroidism, hyperparathyroidism, indwara z’umutima, indwara z’ibihaha, no gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge.
Uburyo bwo kuvura ibitero by'ubwoba bugomba kwerekezwa ku mpamvu nyamukuru. Ku bantu bakunze kurwara indwara, bashobora guhabwa inama cyangwa imiti. Imyitozo yo guhumeka no kuruhuka imitsi nabyo bishobora gufasha. Abahuye n'iki kibazo bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwiyahura.
Mu Burayi, abaturage bagera kuri 3% bagira ikibazo cy’ubwoba mu mwaka runaka, mu gihe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bibasira bagera kuri 11%. Zikunze kugaragara cyane mu bagore kurusha abagabo. Akenshi bitangira mu gihe cy'ubugimbi cyangwa mu ntangiriro z'ubukure. Abana n'abantu bakuze ntibakunze kwibasirwa n'iyi ndwara.

Inkingo za polio ni inkingo zikoreshwa mu gukumira poliomyelitis (polio). Hari ubwoko bubiri bukoreshwa: virusi ya polio idakora itangwa hakoreshejwe inshinge (IPV) na virusi ya polio idakora itangwa hakoreshejwe umunwa (OPV). Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima (OMS) usaba abana bose gukingirwa indwara ya polio burundu. Urukingo rubiri rwakuyeho indwara ya polio mu bice byinshi by'isi, kandi rugabanya umubare w'abarwayi bavugwa buri mwaka uva ku bantu bagera ku 350.000 mu 1988 ugera kuri 33 mu 2018.
Urukingo rwa polio rudakora rufite umutekano cyane. Gutukura gake cyangwa ububabare bishobora kugaragara aho umuntu atewe inshinge. Urukingo rwa polio ruterwa n'umunwa rutera abantu bagera kuri batatu barwaye poliomyelitis iterwa n'urukingo kuri buri doze miliyoni yatanzwe. Ibi bigereranywa n'abantu 5.000 kuri miliyoni barwaye indwara ya poliyo. Muri rusange byombi ni byiza gutanga iyo ndwara mu gihe utwite ndetse no ku bafite ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA ariko ubundi bakaba bameze neza.
Icyegeranyo cya mbere cy’urukingo rwa polio cyagenze neza cyakozwe na Hilary Koprowski mu 1950, hamwe na virusi nzima yagabanutse abantu banywa. Urukingo ntirwemerewe gukoreshwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ariko rwakoreshejwe neza ahandi. Urukingo rwa polio rudakora, rwakozwe nyuma y'imyaka mike na Jonas Salk, rwatangiye gukoreshwa mu 1955. Urukingo rwa polio rutandukanye, rukoreshwa mu kanwa, rwakozwe na Albert Sabin, rutangira gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi mu 1961. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Igiciro cya buri dose ku rukingo runyobwa mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere ni hafi 0.25$ y'Amerika guhera mu 2014. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, iyo fomu idakora igura hagati y’amadolari 25 na 50.

Hepatite B ni indwara yandura iterwa na virusi ya hepatite B (HBV), yibasira umwijima. Ni bumwe mu bwoko bwa hepatite iterwa na virusi, kandi ishobora gutera ubwandu bw'igihe gito cyangwa ubwandu budakira. Abenshi nta bimenyetso bagaragaza, ariko ubwandu budakira bushobora gutera cirrhose na kanseri y'umwijima.
Iyi virusi yandura binyuze mu amaraso cyangwa amatembabuzi y'umubiri, cyane cyane ku mwana mu gihe cyo kuvuka. Indwara yirindwa hakoreshejwe urukingo kuva mu 1982. Mu 2024, abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 240 ku isi bari bafite hepatite B idakira.
Bishobora gutera indwara z’ubwandu bw’igikatu n’ubwandu buhoraho. Mu ntangiriro nta bimenyetso bigaragara. Mu ndwara zikabije, bamwe bashobora kurwara vuba cyane, bakaruka, uruhu rw'umuhondo, umunaniro, inkari z'umukara n'ububabare bwo mu nda. Akenshi ibi bimenyetso bimara ibyumweru bike kandi ni gake cyane ubwandu bwa mbere butera urupfu. Bishobora gufata iminsi 30 kugeza kuri 180 kugira ngo ibimenyetso bitangire. Ku bantu bandura ahagana mu gihe cyo kuvuka, 90% barwara idakira mu gihe abatageze kuri 10% by'abandura nyuma y'imyaka itanu barwara. Abenshi mu bafite indwara zidakira nta bimenyetso baba bafite; icyakora, cirrhose na kanseri y'umwijima bishobora kugaragara. Kurwara cirrhose cyangwa kanseri y'umwijima bibaho hafi 25% by'abafite indwara zidakira.
Virusi ya hepatite B ni imwe muri virusi eshanu z’ingenzi za hepatite hamwe na A, C, D, na E. Iyi virusi ikwirakwira iyo umuntu ahuye n'amaraso yanduye cyangwa amazi yo mu mubiri. Kwandura indwara mu gihe cyo kuvuka cyangwa mu gihe cyo guhura n'amaraso y'abandi mu bwana ni bwo buryo bukunze gukoreshwa cyane mu kwandura indwara ya Hepatite B mu turere iyo ndwara ikunze kugaragaramo. Mu turere aho iyi ndwara idakunze kugaragara, gukoresha imiti iterwa mu mitsi no gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina ni byo bintu bikunze kwanduriramo abantu benshi. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera ibyago zirimo gukora mu buvuzi, guterwa amaraso, dialyse, kubana n'umuntu wanduye, gutembera mu bihugu aho igipimo cy'ubwandu kiri hejuru, no kuba mu kigo. Gushushanya tatouage no gushushanya acupuncture byatumye habaho umubare munini w’abantu barwaye mu myaka ya za 1980; icyakora, ibi byagiye bigabanuka cyane bitewe no kunoza uburyo bwo gusukura ibikoresho. Virusi ntishobora kwanduzwa no gufatana amaboko, gusangira ibikoresho byo kuriramo, gusomana, guhoberana, gukorora, kwitsamura, cyangwa konsa.
Ubwandu bushobora kumenyekana nyuma y'iminsi 30 kugeza kuri 60 nyuma yo kwandura. Ubusanzwe isuzuma ryemezwa no gupima amaraso kugira ngo harebwe ibice bimwe na bimwe bya virusi ndetse no kureba niba hari ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri burwanya virusi.
Abana bavutse ku babyeyi barwaye hepatite B bashobora guhabwa immunoglobulin ya hepatite B n'urukingo igihe bavuka. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima usaba inkingo ku munsi wa mbere w’ubuzima niba bishoboka. Hakenewe izindi doze ebyiri cyangwa eshatu nyuma kugira ngo zigire ingaruka nziza. Uru rukingo rukora hafi 95% by'igihe. Ibihugu bigera ku 180 byatanze uru rukingo nk'igice cya gahunda z'igihugu kugeza mu 2006. Birasabwa kandi ko amaraso yose apimwa hepatite B mbere yo guterwa amaraso, kandi agakingirizo kagakoreshwa mu kwirinda kwandura.
Mu gihe cyo kwandura ubwandu bwa mbere, kwitabwaho bishingiye ku bimenyetso umuntu afite. Ku bantu barwaye indwara zidakira, imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi nka tenofovir, entecavir, cyangwa interferon ishobora kuba ingirakamaro; icyakora, iyi miti irahenze. Gusimbuza umwijima rimwe na rimwe bikoreshwa ku ndwara ya cirrhose.
Hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'abatuye isi bamaze kwandura mu gihe kimwe mu buzima bwabo. Ku isi yose mu 2019, hari abantu miliyoni 296 barwaye indwara ya hepatite B, aho buri mwaka hagaragaye abantu bashya miliyoni 1.5. Impfu 820.000 zanditswe mu 2019. Mu 2024, Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima wagereranyije ko abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 240 bari bafite hepatite B idakira, abandura bashya bakaba hafi ibihumbi 900 buri mwaka, naho impfu zikaba hafi miliyoni 1,1, ahanini zitewe na cirrhose na kanseri y'umwijima. Iyi ndwara ikunze kugaragara cyane mu turere tw’Iburengerazuba bwa Pasifika no muri Afurika; abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 200 bose hamwe bakaba baribasiwe n’iyi ndwara mu 2019. Mu 2019, abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 14 bagizweho ingaruka n’iki cyorezo mu karere k’i Burayi na miliyoni 5 muri Amerika. Nanone kwandura virusi itera SIDA, hepatite C, cyangwa hepatite D ni ibintu bisanzwe aho hepatite B ikunze kugaragara. Serivisi zo gupima no gukumira indwara ya Hepatite B zakunze kugira ingaruka mbi mu gihe cy'icyorezo cya COVID-19.
Mbere byari bizwi nka "hepatitis yo mu maraso". Ubwandu bwakomeje kwirindwa hakoreshejwe inkingo kuva mu 1982.

Gutera kw'imitsi mu buryo bwimbitse (mu Cyongereza "deep vein thrombosis", DVT) ni indwara iterwa n'ikibumbe cy'amaraso ("thrombus") kirema mu mitsi yimbitse ijyana amaraso ku mutima, akenshi mu amaguru cyangwa mu kibuno. Ishobora gutera ububabare, kubyimba no gutukura kw'igice cyafashwe, ariko rimwe na rimwe nta bimenyetso igaragaza. Ingorane yayo ikomeye ni uko ikibumbe gishobora kwimukira mu bihaha ("pulmonary embolism", PE). DVT na PE bigize indwara imwe yitwa "venous thromboembolism" (VTE).
Isuzumwa ahanini hakoreshejwe "ultrasound", ikavurwa n'imiti igabanya kuvura kw'amaraso ("anticoagulants"). Ibyago byayo byiyongera uko umuntu asaza, nyuma yo kubagwa, ku barwaye kanseri, cyangwa iyo umuntu amara igihe kirekire adahaguruka.
Ibimenyetso n'ingorane.
DVT ni ikibumbe cy'amaraso kirema mu mitsi yimbitse, akenshi mu maguru cyangwa mu kibuno. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba ububabare, kubyimba, gutukura no kwaguka kw'imitsi mu gice cyafashwe, ariko bamwe nta bimenyetso bagira. Bigereranywa ko 4–10% bya DVT bifata amaboko.
Ingorane ikunze kubaho vuba ni uko igice cy'ikibumbe gitandukana, kikanyura mu ruhande rw'iburyo rw'umutima, kikaziba umutsi ujyana amaraso mu bihaha ("pulmonary embolism"). Mu gihe kirekire, DVT ishobora gutera "post-thrombotic syndrome": ububabare, kubyimba, kumva ukuguru kuremereye, uburyaryate ndetse n'ibisebe mu bihe bikomeye. VTE yongera kugaruka ku bagera kuri 30% mu myaka icumi ikurikira iya mbere.
Impamvu n'ibyongera ibyago.
Ikibumbe cy'amaraso kirema iyo amaraso adatembera neza, iyo amaraso arushaho kuvura vuba, cyangwa iyo urukuta rw'umutsi rwangiritse. Ibyongera ibyago birimo kubagwa vuba aha, gusaza, kanseri, umubyibuho ukabije, amateka y'umuntu cyangwa ay'umuryango we ya VTE, ibikomere, kumara igihe kirekire udahaguruka, imiti y'imisemburo yo kuboneza urubyaro, gutwita n'igihe gikurikira kubyara, ndetse n'indwara ya "antiphospholipid syndrome".
Uruhererekane rusobanura hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibyago. Muri izo mpamvu harimo ubwoko bw'amaraso butari O, kubura antithrombin, poroteyine C cyangwa poroteyine S, n'ihinduka rya "factor V Leiden" na "prothrombin G20210A".
Umuntu ukekwaho DVT abanza gusuzumwa hakoreshejwe amanota yo guhanura nk'aya Wells. Isuzuma ry'amaraso rya "D-dimer" rifasha gukuraho iyo ndwara cyangwa kwerekana ko hakenewe andi masuzuma. Isuzuma ryemezwa ahanini na "ultrasound" y'imitsi ikekwaho.
Kuvura bikorwa ahanini n'imiti igabanya kuvura kw'amaraso ("anticoagulants"), nka rivaroxaban, apixaban na warfarin. Gutangira warfarin bisaba indi miti ikora ako kanya, akenshi inshinge za heparin.
Kwirinda muri rusange ni ukwirinda umubyibuho ukabije no gukomeza gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri. Nyuma yo kubagwa, kubyuka no kugenda hakiri kare kandi kenshi ni uburyo bwo kwirinda budafite ingaruka mbi. Ku babagwa bafite ibyago byinshi, hakoreshwa imiti igabanya kuvura kw'amaraso cyangwa "aspirine", hamwe n'ibikoresho bikanda amaguru hakoreshejwe umwuka ("intermittent pneumatic compression").
Abantu bagera kuri 5–11% barwara VTE mu buzima bwabo, kandi iyo ndwara irushaho kuboneka uko imyaka yiyongera. Abafite imyaka 65 kuzamura bafite ibyago byikubye inshuro 15 ugereranyije n'abafite imyaka 40 cyangwa munsi yayo. Amakuru ahari ahanini yakusanyijwe mu Burayi no muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru; abakomoka muri Aziya n'Abanyamerika bakomoka mu bihugu bivuga Icyesipanyolo bafite ibyago bike ugereranyije n'abazungu cyangwa abirabura.

Indwara ya Chagas, izwi kandi nka "American trypanosomiasis", ni indwara yo mu turere dushyuha iterwa n'agakoko "Trypanosoma cruzi". Ikwirakwizwa cyane cyane n'udukoko twa "Triatominae", tuzwi nka «udukoko dusomana». Mu ntangiriro, ibimenyetso akenshi ntibigaragara cyangwa biba byoroheje, ariko nyuma y'imyaka myinshi indwara ishobora kwangiza umutima n'urwungano ngogozi.
Bivugwa ko abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 8 banduye, cyane cyane muri Megizike, Amerika yo Hagati na Amerika y’Epfo, kandi ihitana abarenga 10 000 buri mwaka. Yasobanuwe bwa mbere mu 1909 n'umuganga w'Umunyaburezile Carlos Chagas, ari na we yitiriwe.
"Trypanosoma cruzi" ikunze kwandurira mu bantu no mu zindi nyamaswa iyo zirumwe n'udukoko dusomana. Iyi ndwara ishobora kandi kwandurira mu guterwa amaraso, mu guterwa ingingo, mu kurya ibiryo byanduye, no kuva kuri nyina kugeza ku mwana we atwite cyangwa avuka. Agakoko gafata ubwoko burenga 150 bw'inyamaswa.
Ibimenyetso birahinduka uko ubwandu bugenda. Mu cyiciro cya mbere, kimara nk'amezi abiri, ibimenyetso akenshi ntibigaragara cyangwa bikaba byoroheje: umuriro, kubyimba kw'inturugunyu, kuribwa umutwe, cyangwa kubyimba aho umuntu yarumwe. Nyuma yaho, abantu binjira mu cyiciro cy'indwara idakira, akenshi idatanga ibimenyetso.
Nyuma y'imyaka 10 kugeza kuri 30, kugeza kuri kimwe cya gatatu cy'abanduye barwara indwara z'umutima, zishobora gutuma umutima unanirwa. Umwe ku icumi agira ingorane zo mu rwungano ngogozi (nko kwaguka k'umuhogo cyangwa k'urura runini), iz'imitsi cyangwa zombi.
Mu cyiciro cya mbere, indwara isuzumwa hashakishwa agakoko mu maraso hakoreshejwe mikorosikopi, cyangwa hashakishwa ADN yako hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa "polymerase chain reaction" (PCR). Indwara idakira ivumburwa no kubona antibodies za "T. cruzi" mu maraso.
Kwirinda bibanda ku kurandura udukoko dusomana no kwirinda kurumwa natwo, urugero hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko cyangwa inzitiramibu. Izindi ngamba zirimo gusuzuma amaraso n'ingingo bigiye guterwa abandi, no gusuzuma abana bavutse ku babyeyi banduye. Kugeza mu 2026, nta rukingo ruraboneka.
Ubwandu bwa vuba buvurwa n'imiti ya benznidazole cyangwa nifurtimox, ikora neza iyo itanzwe hakiri kare, ariko imbaraga zayo zikagabanuka uko umuntu amaze igihe kinini yanduye. Iyo ikoreshejwe mu ndwara idakira, ishobora gutinza cyangwa gukumira ibimenyetso bya nyuma. Iyi miti ikunze gutera ingaruka mbi (indwara z'uruhu, kurakara mu gifu, ibimenyetso by'imitsi) ku bantu bakuru bagera kuri 40%, kandi ntihabwa abagore batwite cyangwa abafite ibibazo by'impyiko cyangwa umwijima. Imiti mishya n'inkingo z'igerageza biracyakorwaho ubushakashatsi.
Indwara ya Chagas iboneka cyane cyane mu bihugu 21 byo muri Amerika y'Epfo n'iyo Hagati, ariko ubwandu bwabonetse mu bihugu 44. Abantu barenga miliyoni 100 bafite ibyago byo kwandura. Abenshi mu barwayi ni abakene, kandi abenshi ntibazi ko banduye. Ubwimukira bw'abaturage bwatumye iboneka no mu bindi bihugu, birimo ibyo mu Uburayi na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ishyirwa mu cyiciro cy'indwara zo mu turere dushyuha zirengagijwe.
Iyi ndwara yasobanuwe bwa mbere ku muntu ku wa 14 Mata 1909 n'umuganga w'Umunyaburezile (Burezile) Carlos Chagas, ari na we yitiriwe. Kuva mu 2019, tariki ya 14 Mata yizihizwa nk'Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w'Indwara ya Chagas.

Nakaayi Dorcus (wavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 2019) ni umukinnyi wa filime muto w’u Uganda. Akazi ke kaba mu gihe cyo gukura kw’inganda y’amashusho n’amashusho y’ubwigenge y’u Uganda, aho habayeho kongera kw’ikorerwa ry’amakinamico mu ndimi z’igihugu, kongera kw’ishoramari mu birimo by’igihugu n’ibikorwa by’abakinyi bato mu serisi zibanda ku muryango, uburezi n’ibibazo by’abaturage.
Ubuzima bwo hambere n’amashuri.
Nakaayi Dorcus yavutse ku ya 27 Nyakanga 2019 mu Karere ka Mpigi, Uganda. Yatangiye amashuri abanza ku Upendo Christian School hanyuma yinjira Kibibi Junior School mu Karere ka Butambala, aho yigira. Nakaayi ni umwana wa gatatu mu muryango wabo.
Dorcus yatangiye gukina binyuze mu birimo by’ubwigenge by’aho hantu mu 2024 mbere yo kugaragara mu makinamico ya televiziyo. Harimo "No Time" (Sezoni ya Mbere n’Iya Kabiri), "Omunanfusi" na "Jealous (S.1)" izwi kandi nka "Obujja", byose byerekana kuri Makula TV na Makula Kika. Gahunda ye yo gufata amafilime yateguwe hagereranywa n’ikarita y’ishuri kugira ngo uburezi bugume ari bwo butandukanye.

Lisinopril ni umuti wo mu bwoko bwa angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor ukoreshwa mu kuvura umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, kunanirwa k'umutima, ndetse no nyuma y'indwara z'umutima. Ku muvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, ubusanzwe ni uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura, nubwo ku bantu b'abirabura imiti igabanya umuvuduko wa kalisiyumu cyangwa imiti igabanya ubukana bwa thiazide ikora neza. Ikoreshwa kandi mu gukumira ibibazo by'impyiko ku bantu barwaye diyabete. Lisinopril ifatwa n'umunwa. Ingaruka zuzuye zishobora gufata ibyumweru bine kugira ngo ziboneke.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuribwa umutwe, isereri, kumva unaniwe, inkorora, isesemi, no kurwara ibisebe. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo umuvuduko muke w'amaraso, ibibazo by'umwijima, potasiyumu nyinshi mu maraso, na angioedema. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyose cyo gutwita kuko ishobora kwangiza umwana. Lisinopril ikora mu kubuza sisitemu ya renin-angiotensin-aldosterone.
Lisinopril yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imiti mu 1978, yemererwa gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1987. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ikiguzi cyo kugurisha ku kwezi cyari munsi y'amadolari y'Amerika 0.70 mu 2018. Mu Bwongereza byatwaye NHS amafaranga agera kuri ₤10 ku kwezi mu 2018. Mu 2017, ni wo muti wakunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni 104. Muri Nyakanga 2016, umuti wa lisinopril wo mu kanwa wemejwe gukoreshwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Sodium nitrite ikoreshwa nk'umuti hamwe na sodium thiosulfate mu kuvura uburozi bwa cyanide. Bigirwa inama gusa mu gihe habayeho uburozi bukomeye bwa cyanide. Ku bantu bafite uburozi bwa cyanide na carbon monoxide, uburozi bwa sodium thiosulfate ubwabwo bukunze kuba bwiza. Itangwa mu guterwa buhoro buhoro mu mitsi.
Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi, kuribwa umutwe, guhumeka nabi, guta ubwenge no kuruka. Abantu bafite indwara z'umutima bagomba kwitabwaho cyane. Igipimo cya methemoglobini mu bantu kigomba gusuzumwa buri gihe mu gihe cyo kuvurwa. Nubwo bitarasuzumwa neza mu gihe cyo gutwita, hari ibimenyetso bimwe na bimwe bigaragaza ingaruka zishobora kugaragara ku mwana. Bivugwa ko sodium nitrite ikora mu gukora methemoglobini hanyuma igafata cyanide bityo ikayikura muri mitochondria.
Sodium nitrite yatangiye gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu myaka ya 1920 na 1930. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi rw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Igiciro muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hamwe na sodium thiosulfate ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 110.

Indwara yo kongera kugaburira abana ni indwara ishobora kubaho nyuma yo kongera kurya nyuma y'igihe kirekire umuntu atarya. Bishobora kandi kubaho no mu mirire mu buryo bw'imirire yose ya parenteral. Bishobora gutuma fosifate nkeya, manyeziyumu nkeya, potasiyumu nkeya, na thiamine nkeya. Ibi bishobora gutera intege nke, kugabanuka k'ubuhumekero, kudahuza neza kw'imikorere y'umubiri, urujijo, gucika intege, no kurwara umutima.
Ibintu bishobora gutera ingorane birimo ibibazo byo kurya, ubusinzi, nyuma yo kubagwa, imirire mibi idakira, kubagwa ibibari, n'indwara zo mu mara ziterwa no kubyimba. Uburyo bw'ibanze bukubiyemo kwiyongera kw'isukari mu maraso bigatuma urugero rwa insuline rwiyongera bigatuma uturemangingo twinjiza potasiyumu na fosifate. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku kugabanuka k'urugero rwa fosifate, potasiyumu, cyangwa manyeziyumu mu maraso. Indwara yoroheje ni ukugabanuka kwa 10 kugeza kuri 20%, indwara iringaniye igabanukaho 20 kugeza kuri 30%, naho indwara ikomeye igabanukaho kurenza 30%.
Kuvura ni ukwiyongera buhoro buhoro kwa karori. Mu masaha 24 ya mbere, ni ngombwa gukoresha kcal 10 kugeza kuri 20/kg cyangwa se nturenze kimwe cya kabiri cy'ingufu umuntu akeneye. Inyongeramusaruro za Thiamine bigomba gutangwa hakiri kare. Inyongeramusaruro za Potasiyumu, fosifeta, kalisiyumu na manyeziyumu nazo zikunze gusabwa. Electrolyte zigomba gupimwa buri masaha 12 ku ikubitiro.
Inshuro indwara yo kongera kugaburira abana ntabwo iramenyekana neza. Ubushakashatsi bumwe bwagaragaje ko igipimo kiri hagati ya 0.5% na 18% mu bantu bari mu bitaro. Ibisobanuro bya none by'iyi ndwara byatangiye mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose. Nubwo bimeze gutyo, hari byinshi byasobanuwe mbere ku bantu bapfa nyuma yo kurya nyuma y’inzara mu mateka.

Methotrexate (MTX), yahoze izwi nka amethopterin, ni umuti uvura kanseri y'imiti kandi ugabanya ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri. Ikoreshwa mu kuvura kanseri, indwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri, gutwita hanze y'urugo, no mu gukuramo inda kwa muganga. Ubwoko bwa kanseri ikoreshwa harimo kanseri y'ibere, kanseri y'amaraso, kanseri y'ibihaha, kanseri ya kanseri y'imitsi, indwara yo mu gihe cyo gutwita, na kanseri y'ibihaha. Ubwoko bw'indwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri ikoreshwamo harimo, rubagimpande, na Crohn's disease. Ishobora gutangwa mu kanwa cyangwa mu guterwa inshinge.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi, kumva umunaniro, umuriro, ibyago byinshi byo kwandura, umubare muke w'uturemangingo tw'amaraso yera, no kwangirika k'uruhu mu kanwa. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo indwara y'umwijima, indwara y'ibihaha, lymphoma, n'uduheri twinshi tw'uruhu. Abantu bavurwa igihe kirekire bagomba gupimwa buri gihe ingaruka mbi. Ntabwo ari byiza mu gihe cyo konsa. Ku bafite ibibazo by'impyiko, hashobora kuba ngombwa ko bagabanya dose. Ikora mu kubuza umubiri gukoresha aside folike.
Methotrexate yakozwe mu 1947, itangira gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu kuvura kanseri, kuko yari ifite uburozi buke ugereranyije n’ubuvuzi bwakoreshwaga icyo gihe. Mu 1956 yatanze uburyo bwa mbere bwo kuvura kanseri yateye. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Methotrexate iboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ntabwo bihenze. Igiciro cyo kugurisha ku isoko mu 2014 mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere kiri hagati y'amadolari y'Amerika 0.06 na 0.36 ku munsi ku ifishi ifatwa mu kanwa. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ukwezi gusanzwe ko kuvurwa kugura hagati y'amadolari 25 na 50. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 117 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni esheshatu.

Colchicine ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ya goutte n'indwara ya Behçet. Ku ndwara ya goutte, ntabwo ikundwa cyane kuruta imiti igabanya ubukana bwa NSAID cyangwa steroid. Izindi ngamba zirimo kwirinda indwara ya pericarditis n'indwara y'imitsi yo mu muryango ya Mediterane. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kurwara igifu, cyane cyane iyo umuntu afashe dose nyinshi. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kugabanuka k'uturemangingo tw'amaraso no kwangirika kwa rhabdomyolysis. Umutekano w'ikoreshwa ry'iyi mashini mu gihe cyo gutwita ntuzwi neza mu gihe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo konsa bisa n'aho nta kibazo. Kugabanya urugero rw'ibinini bishobora gutera urupfu. Colchicine ikora mu kugabanya ububyimbirwe binyuze mu buryo butandukanye.
Colchicine, mu ishusho ya crocus yo mu gihe cy'umuhindo, yakoreshejwe kuva mu 1500 mbere ya Yesu mu kuvura kubyimba kw'ingingo. Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1961. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Mu Bwongereza, ibicuruzwa by'ukwezi bitwara NHS amapawundi 7 kugeza mu 2019 mu gihe muri Kanada ari amapawundi 10 kugeza mu 2021. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 252. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 201 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni ebyiri.

Indwara yo mu mitsi (AVN), yitwa kandi osteonecrosis cyangwa ihungabana ry'amagufwa, ni urupfu rw'imitsi y'amagufwa bitewe no kubura kw'amaraso. Mu ntangiriro, hashobora kuba nta bimenyetso bihari. Buhoro buhoro ububabare bw'ingingo bushobora kugaragara, ibyo bikaba bishobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kugenda. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kugwa kw'igufwa cyangwa igice cy'ingingo cyegereye.
Ibintu bikunze gutera ingaruka ni inzoga nyinshi n'imisemburo ya steroide nyinshi. Izindi ngaruka zirimo kuvunika amagufwa, gucika kw'ingingo, indwara ya sickle cell, lupus, no kwibira mu mazi ya SCUBA. Iyo ndwara ishobora no kubaho nta mpamvu igaragara. Igufwa rikunze kwibasirwa cyane ni femur. Izindi mbuga zikunze kugaragara zirimo igufwa ryo hejuru ry'ukuboko, ivi, urutugu, n'akaguru. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bikorwa hakoreshejwe amashusho ya muganga nka X-ray, CT scan, cyangwa MRI. Ni gake cyane hashobora gukoreshwa biopsy.
Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo imiti, kudakora ku kuguru kwangiritse, kunanura imitsi no kubagwa. Akenshi kubagwa biba ngombwa kandi bishobora kuba birimo gukuramo core decompression, osteotomy, grafting foromaje, cyangwa gusimbuza ingingo. Abantu bagera ku 15.000 bandura buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Abantu bafite hagati y'imyaka 30 na 50 ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa n'iyi ndwara. Abagabo ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore.

Aneurysm ni ikibyimba gisa n'ibendera ry'umuhondo, akenshi, mu mitsi. Akenshi mu ntangiriro nta bimenyetso biragaragara. Iyo ibimenyetso bigaragaye, biterwa n'aho aneurysm iherereye kandi bishobora kuba birimo kuribwa umutwe, kubabara mu nda, kubabara umugongo, no guhungabana kw'amaraso. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kurema kw'ibibyimba cyangwa gucika kw'ibibyimba.
Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo amateka y'umuryango, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, cholesterol nyinshi, kunywa itabi, no gukomereka k'imitsi y'amaraso. Nubwo imitsi iyo ari yo yose ishobora kugira ingaruka, ikunze kugaragara muri aorta (AA). Izindi ndwara zirimo ubwonko, umutsi wo mu bwoko bwa popliteal, umutsi wo mu bwoko bwa mesenteric, umutsi wo mu mutima, n'umutsi wo mu bwoko bwa splenic. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku isuzuma ry’indwara.
Uburyo bwo kuvura bushobora kuba burimo guhindura imibereho no kubagwa. Igihe kubagwa bisabwe biterwa n'imitsi ivugwa. Gusana AAA muri rusange bigirwa inama ku burebure bwa cm 5, mu gihe aneurysms zo mu bwonko muri rusange zisanwa iyo zifite uburebure bwa mm 7 cyangwa bunini cyangwa zigasaba inzira y'amaraso inyuma. Imitsi yo mu maboko muri rusange isanwa vuba iyo ibonetse mu gihe iyo mu maguru isanwa iyo ingano yayo ibaye inshuro ebyiri.
Imitsi y'ubwonko igira ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri 4%, mu gihe imitsi y'amaraso ifata imitsi y'ubwonko igira ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri 2.5%. Abantu bakuze ni bo bashobora kwibasirwa cyane. Ibisobanuro by'ibintu byizewe ko ari aneurysms biboneka mu nyandiko za kera zo mu Misiri no mu Buhinde. Iryo jambo rikomoka kuri, "aneurysma", bisobanura "ubugari".

Ephedrine ni umuti kandi utera imbaraga. Ikunze gukoreshwa mu gukumira umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hasi mu gihe cyo gusinziriza uruti rw'umugongo. Yanakoreshejwe mu kuvura asima, indwara yo kubura ibinure (narcolepsy), n'umubyibuho ukabije ariko si bwo buryo bwiza bwo kuvura. Nta kamaro gasobanutse neza mu kubyimba izuru. Ishobora gufatwa mu kanwa cyangwa mu guterwa mu mitsi, mu mitsi, cyangwa munsi y'uruhu. Gutangira gukoreshwa mu mitsi bihita byihuta, mu gihe gutera mu mitsi bishobora gufata iminota 20, kandi mu kanwa bishobora gufata isaha kugira ngo bigire ingaruka. Iyo itewe mu buryo bw'urushinge imara isaha imwe kandi iyo inyowe mu kanwa ishobora kumara amasaha ane.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kugorwa no gusinzira, guhangayika, kuribwa umutwe, kubona ibintu mu buryo butunguranye, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, umutima utera cyane, kubura ubushake bwo kurya, no kunanirwa kwihagarika. Ingaruka mbi zikomeye zirimo gucika imitsi y'amaraso mu bwonko, indwara z'umutima, no guhohoterwa. Nubwo bishobora kuba ari umutekano mu gihe cyo gutwita, ikoreshwa ryayo muri aba bantu ntiryizweho neza. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo konsa. Ephedrine ikora mu kongera imikorere ya α na β adrenergic receptors.
Ephedrine yakuweho bwa mbere mu 1885 itangira gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi mu 1926. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Igiciro cy'igurishwa ku giciro kinini mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 0.69–1.35 kuri buri dose. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ntabwo bihenze cyane. Ubusanzwe iboneka mu bimera byo mu bwoko bwa Ephedra. Inyongeramusaruro zirimo ephedrine ntizemewe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, usibye izikoreshwa mu buvuzi gakondo bw'Abashinwa, aho má huáng igaragara.

Urukingo rwa Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) ni urukingo rukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kurwanya igituntu. Mu bihugu aho igituntu cyangwa ibibembe bikunze kugaragara, ni byiza ko abana bazima barwara doze imwe gusa. Mu turere aho igituntu kidakunze kugaragara, abana bari mu kaga gakomeye ni bo bonyine bakunze gukingirwa, mu gihe abakekwaho kuba baranduye igituntu bapimwa kandi bakavurwa. Abantu bakuru badafite igituntu batarakingirwa mbere ariko bakunze guhura n’iki cyorezo nabo bashobora kukingirwa. BCG ifite kandi akamaro mu kurwanya igisebe cya Buruli n'izindi ndwara za mycobacteria zitari iz'igituntu. Hari igihe ikoreshwa nk'igice cy'ubuvuzi bwa kanseri y'uruhago.
Igipimo cy'uburinzi ku ndwara y'igituntu kiratandukanye kandi uburinzi bumara imyaka makumyabiri. Mu bana birinda hafi 20% kwandura indwara kandi mu bandura birinda kimwe cya kabiri cyazo kurwara. Urukingo rutangwa hakoreshejwe urushinge mu ruhu. Nta gihamya kigaragaza ko ingero z'inyongera ari ingirakamaro.
Ingaruka mbi zikomeye ni gake cyane. Akenshi habaho gutukura, kubyimba, n'ububabare buke aho watewe inshinge. Igisebe gito gishobora no kuvuka gifite inkovu nyuma yo gukira. Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara cyane kandi zishobora kuba zikomeye ku bantu bafite ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri budakora neza. Ntabwo ari byiza kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita. Urukingo rwakozwe bwa mbere rukomoka kuri "Mycobacterium bovis", ikunze kuboneka mu nka. Nubwo yacitse intege, iracyariho.
Urukingo rwa BCG rwakoreshejwe bwa mbere mu buvuzi mu 1921. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Hagati ya 2011 na 2014 igiciro cya bulijanseri cyari hagati ya 0.20 na 1.10$ y'Amerika kuri doze imwe mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bigura amadolari y'Amerika 100 kugeza 200. Guhera mu 2004, urukingo ruhabwa abana bagera kuri miliyoni 100 buri mwaka ku isi.

Kuvasectomy ni uburyo bwo kubaga abagabo kugira ngo bakureho burundu. Kugira ngo intanga zikore neza, nibura amezi 3 n'amezi 20 birakenewe, ibi bikaba bigomba kwemezwa no gusesengura amasohoro. Igipimo cy'inanirwa kuri iyi ngingo ni hafi 1 kuri 2.000. Muri rusange ni uburyo buhoraho bwo kuboneza urubyaro; ariko, uburyo bwo kugabanya imbyaro burimo guhindura intanga no kugarura intanga hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo guterateranya intanga mu buryo bwa vitro.
Nubwo muri rusange nta kibazo kirimo, ingaruka mbi ziri hagati ya 1 na 2% zishobora kuba zirimo hematoma cyangwa ubwandu. Indwara y'ububabare nyuma yo kuva mu ivuriro bishobora kugaragara kugeza kuri 6%. Ntabwo bihindura imikorere y'imibonano mpuzabitsina. Muri rusange bisaba gukuraho agace ka buri vas deferens no gufunga impera z'intanga ngabo, ibyo bigatuma intanga ngabo zitajya mu gitsina bityo bigatuma intanga ngabo zidakora.
Ubu buryo bukunze gukorerwa kwa muganga ushyushye. Amavuta yo kwisiga ashobora gushyirwaho mbere yo gukonjesha hakoreshejwe inshinge. Umusatsi urakurwaho hanyuma agace gasukurwa. Udukoko tw’imitsi dushyirwa hafi y’uruhu hagati y’intanga ngabo n’igitsina gabo. Kugira ngo ugere ku ruhu, uruhu ruri hejuru rushobora gucibwa n'icyuma cyo kuvura cyangwa gufungurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo gukata ibyuma mu buryo butarimo icyuma cyo kuvura. Igice cy'umuyoboro w'amazi gikurwaho impera zisigaye zigacibwa cyangwa zigafungwa hanyuma zigatwikwa. Parasetamol (acetaminophen) na NSAIDs bishobora gufatwa ku bubabare. Guterura ibintu biremereye no gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina ntibisabwa mu cyumweru kimwe nyuma yaho.
Ubu buryo bwakozwe bwa mbere mu 1899 na Reginald Harrison. Guhera mu 2020, ikoreshwa n'abagore miliyoni 17 bakuze kubyara (1.8%) nk'uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro. Iri ni igabanuka rivuye kuri 6% mu 1995. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ubu buryo muri rusange buhendutse munsi ya 1.000 USD mu 2021; buhendutse ugereranyije na tubal ligation.

Indwara ya Treacher Collins (TCS) ni indwara iterwa n'uturemangingo tw'amatwi, amaso, amagufwa y'amatako n'akananwa. Ariko, urugero umuntu agiramo ingaruka rushobora gutandukana kuva ku rugero rworoshye kugeza ku rugero rukomeye. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo byo guhumeka, ibibazo byo kutabona neza, gucikamo ibice mu kanwa no kutumva neza. Abagiraho ingaruka muri rusange baba bafite ubwenge busanzwe.
Ubusanzwe TCS ni yo ikoresha autosomal cyane. Inshuro zirenga kimwe cya kabiri bibaho bitewe n’impinduka nshya aho kuba byararazwe n’ababyeyi b’umuntu. Utunyangingo tw’umubiri dushobora kuba turimo "TCOF1", "POLR1C", cyangwa "POLR1D". Isuzuma muri rusange rikekwaho hashingiwe ku bimenyetso na X-rays, kandi rishobora kwemezwa n'ibizamini bya genetiki.
Indwara ya Treacher Collins ntabwo ivurwa. Ibimenyetso bishobora gukemurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kubaga, uburyo bwo kumva, uburyo bwo kuvura indwara, n'ibindi bikoresho bifasha umuntu. Icyizere cy'ubuzima muri rusange ni ibisanzwe. TCS ibaho ku muntu umwe mu bantu 50.000. Iyi ndwara yitiriwe Edward Treacher Collins, umuganga w’inzobere mu kubaga amaso w’Umwongereza, wasobanuye imiterere yayo y’ingenzi mu 1900.

Tadalafil, igurishwa ku izina rya Cialis n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura ikibazo cyo guhagarara k'uburemba (ED), hyperplasia y'uburemba (BPH), n'umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso mu bihaha. Ni ikinini gifatwa mu kanwa. Gutangira kwa muganga akenshi biba mu gihe cy'igice cy'isaha kandi igihe kigera ku masaha 36.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo kuribwa umutwe, kubabara imitsi, uruhu rusa n'isesemi. Kwitonda ni ngombwa ku bantu bafite indwara z'umutima n'imitsi. Ingaruka mbi zidasanzwe ariko zikomeye zirimo guhagarara igihe kirekire bishobora kwangiza igitsina cy'umugabo, ibibazo byo kutabona no kutumva neza. Tadalafil ntiyemerwa ku bantu bafata imiti igabanya ubukana bwa nitrovasodilators nka nitroglycerin, kuko ibi bishobora gutuma umuvuduko w'amaraso ugabanuka cyane. Tadalafil ni umuti ubuza PDE5 kongera amaraso ajya mu gitsina bitewe n'imibonano mpuzabitsina. Nanone kandi, bigabanya umuvuduko w'amaraso mu bihaha, bigatuma imitsi yo mu bihaha igabanuka.
Tadalafil yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 2003. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu Bwongereza. Mu Bwongereza byatwaye NHS amafaranga agera kuri 80p kuri dose imwe kugeza mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 1.91. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 282 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni imwe.

Temazepam, igurishwa ku mazina y'ikirango cya Restoril n'ibindi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura ibibazo byo gusinzira. Gukoresha bene ubwo buryo muri rusange bigomba kuba mu gihe kiri munsi y'iminsi icumi. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Ingaruka muri rusange zitangira mu isaha imwe kandi zimara amasaha umunani.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gusinzira, guhangayika, urujijo no kuzerera. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kubona ibintu nk'ibi, guhohoterwa, guhangayika no kwiyahura. Muri rusange ntibisabwa kuyikoresha hamwe n'imiti igabanya ubukana bw'ibiyobyabwenge (opioids). Iyo igipimo kigabanutse cyane, guhagarika imiti bishobora kubaho. Gukoresha iyo miti mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa ntibyemewe. Temazepam ni benzodiazepine ikora neza kandi ikora ku mutima. Ikora mu kugira ingaruka kuri GABA mu bwonko.
Temazapam yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha imiti mu 1962, itangira gukoreshwa mu buvuzi mu 1969. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. Ku kwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri £1.40 mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi amadolari y'Amerika 1.76. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 142 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni enye.

Ibintu bikunze gutera ubwivumbure birimo impongo n'ibiribwa bimwe na bimwe. Ibyuma n'ibindi bintu nabyo bishobora guteza ibibazo. Ibiryo, kurumwa n'udukoko, n'imiti ni byo bintu bikunze gutera ingaruka zikomeye. Iterambere ryabyo riterwa n'ibintu bigize imiterere y'umubiri ndetse n'ibidukikije. Uburyo bw’ibanze bugizwe n’uturemangingo twa immunoglobulin E (IgE), igice cy’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri, buhuza n’ikintu kitera ubwivumbure hanyuma bugahuza n’agace kabugenewe kari ku turemangingo twa mast cyangwa basophil aho gatuma habaho irekurwa ry’ibinyabutabire bitera ububyimbirwe nka histamine. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bishingiye ku mateka y'ubuzima bw'umuntu. Gusuzuma uruhu cyangwa amaraso bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu bihe bimwe na bimwe. Icyakora, ibizamini byagaragaje ko ari byiza bishobora kutagaragaza ko hari ubwivumbure bukomeye kuri iyi ngano.
Guhura n'ibintu bishobora gutera ubwivumbure hakiri kare bishobora kuba inzitizi. Uburyo bwo kuvura allergie burimo kwirinda ibintu bizwiho gutera allergie no gukoresha imiti nka steroide na antihistamines. Imiti ivura indwara zo mu mutwe (antihistamines) ikunzwe cyane ni imiti idatuma umuntu aruhuka nka loratidine. Mu gihe cy’ingaruka zikomeye, adrenaline (epinephrine) iterwa mu nganda irasabwa. Kuvura indwara ziterwa n'ubwivumbure bw'umubiri (allergen immunotherapy), ishyira abantu mu kaga gakomeye kandi gakomeye ku bintu bishobora gutuma umuntu arwara indwara ziterwa n’ubwivumbure, ni ingirakamaro ku bwoko bumwe na bumwe bw’ubwivumbure nk’ibicurane by’ibyatsi ndetse n’ingaruka zo kurumwa n’udukoko. Ikoreshwa ryayo mu ndwara ziterwa n'ibiribwa ntirirasobanutse neza.
Allergie ni ikintu gisanzwe. Mu bihugu byateye imbere, abantu bagera kuri 20% bibasirwa na rhinitis y’ubwivumbure, abantu bagera kuri 6% bafite nibura ubwivumbure bumwe mu biribwa, naho abagera kuri 20% bafite dermatitis y’ibicurane mu gihe runaka. Bitewe n'igihugu, abantu bagera kuri 1–18% barwaye asima. Anaphylaxis ibaho hagati ya 0.05–2% by'abantu. Igipimo cy'indwara nyinshi ziterwa n'ubwivumbure gisa n'aho kirimo kwiyongera. Ijambo "allergie" ryakoreshejwe bwa mbere na Clemens von Pirquet mu 1906.

Cannabidiol (CBD) ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe zifata ibice by'umubiri, Lennox-Gastaut na Dravet syndrome. Ikoreshwa hamwe na clobazam. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Ibimenyetso ntibihagije kugira ngo bishyigikire ikoreshwa ryayo mu guhangayika, indwara zo mu mutwe, cyangwa ububabare kugeza mu 2019.
Ingaruka zikunze kugaragara zirimo gushyukwa, impiswi, umunaniro, gusinzira nabi, no kugira ibisebe. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo by'umwijima no kwiyahura. Gukoresha iyo ndwara mu gihe utwite bishobora kwangiza umwana. Uburyo ikora ntabwo busobanutse neza. Ntabwo ifite ubushobozi bumwe bwo kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe nk'ubwa tetrahydrocannabinol (THC).
Cannabidiol yavumbuwe mu 1940. Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 2018 no mu Burayi mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, mililitiro 300 z'umuti wa 100 mg/ml zigura hafi 4,600 by'amadolari y'Amerika mu 2021. Yakozwe mu kimera cya "Cannabis sativa". Hari abantu bayikoresha mu buryo bw'amavuta ya CBD, muri rusange ikaba irimo urugero ruto rwa THC.

Aneurysm yo mu bwonko, izwi kandi nka aneurysm yo mu bwonko, ni igihe hari umuyoboro w'amaraso uherereye hafi y'ubwonko urimo kwigaragaza. Kenshi na kenshi nta bimenyetso biragaragara. Hari igihe umuntu ashobora kugira ibinya, ububabare, cyangwa kunanirwa kwimura uruhande rumwe rw'isura. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kuva amaraso muri subarachnoid, bigatera umuntu kurwara umutwe cyane.
Ibintu bishobora gutera indwara birimo umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, kunywa itabi, kunywa inzoga nyinshi, kokayine, gukomereka mu mutwe, indwara yandura yo mu mutima, n'amateka y'umuryango. Indwara nyinshi ziterwa n’uturemangingo, nk’indwara y’impyiko ya autosomal dominant polycystic na Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, zifitanye isano n’ibyago byinshi. Ubwoko burimo udukoko two mu bwoko bwa saccular, fusiform, na infectious. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bikorwa hakoreshejwe amashusho y’abaganga.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'ingano, aho umuntu aherereye, n'ubuzima bwe muri rusange. Muri rusange, ubuvuzi bugirwa inama iyo aneurysm ifite ingano irenga mm 7. Icyo wakora ku mitsi mito y'amaraso ntabwo kirasobanuka neza kandi ibi bishobora gukurikiranwa byoroshye kugira ngo harebwe uko bikura. Ibi bishobora gukorwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo gufunga imitsi yo mu nda cyangwa gukata igice cy'amaraso.
Abantu bagera kuri 3% nibo bagizweho ingaruka. Igipimo cy’indwara z’abagabo n’abagore kirangana. Bikunze kugaragara cyane ku bafite imyaka iri hagati ya 30 na 60. Ni bo batera hafi 0.5% by'impfu zose. Nyuma yo gucika kw'ivu, ibyago byo gupfa nyuma y'amezi atatu ni 50%. Indwara yo gucika kw'ubwonko yavuzwe bwa mbere mu 1765.

Igitero cy’indwara y’imitsi (TIA), kizwi kandi nka mini-stroke, ni igihe gito cy’imikorere mibi y’imitsi iterwa no kubura amaraso atembera neza (ischemia) mu gace k’ubwonko cyangwa retina, nta rupfu rw’ingingo. Bitera ibimenyetso bimwe n'indwara yo mu bwonko, nko kugira intege nke cyangwa kugira ibinya ku ruhande rumwe rw'umubiri, gutakaza amaso mu buryo butunguranye, kugorwa no kuvuga cyangwa kumva imvugo, kudahuza neza kw'ingingo, cyangwa urujijo. Ibimenyetso muri rusange bitangira mu buryo butunguranye kandi bimara igihe kitarenze isaha.
Ibintu bishobora gutera indwara birimo diyabete, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, kunywa itabi, ubusinzi, stress yo mu mutwe, no kutagira imyitozo ngororamubiri. TIA zifite uburyo busanzwe nk'ubwo gucika kw'imitsi mu maraso. Ibisobanuro byabanje gushingira ku gihe cy'ibimenyetso biri munsi y'amasaha 24; kandi ibisobanuro bishya nta bimenyetso by'indwara y'umutima birimo ku mashusho y'abaganga.
Ni ikibazo cyihutirwa cy’ubuvuzi. Ubuvuzi bushobora kuba burimo guhindura imibereho nko kureka kunywa itabi no kugabanya inzoga, ndetse n'imiti nka aspirine, clopidogrel, cyangwa imiti igabanya amaraso. Izindi ngamba zirimo gucunga umuvuduko w'amaraso, imiti ya statine, no kugenzura isukari mu maraso. Ku bantu bafite imitsi yo mu ijosi ifunganye, bashobora kubagwa carotid endarterectomy. Hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'abantu bafite TIA bazagira stroke mu gihe kizaza.
Abantu bagera kuri 2% bigeze kugira TIA kandi umuntu 1 ku bantu 1,000 niwe uba yibasiwe buri mwaka. Abantu bakuze (barengeje imyaka 60) ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane. Abagabo ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane kurusha abagore. Indwara za TIA zasobanuwe bwa mbere ahagana mu 400 mbere ya Yesu na Hippocrates kandi byagaragaye ko ari zo mpamvu zishobora gutera indwara yo mu bwonko nyuma yo gucika intege.

Vortioxetine, igurishwa ku mazina y'ubucuruzi ya Trintellix na Brintellix n'andi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ikomeye yo kwiheba. Kugira umusaruro bifatwa nk'ibisanzwe nk'iby'indi miti igabanya ubudahangarwa bw'imitsi. Mu Bwongereza, irasabwa gusa ku bantu bataragira uburwayi buhagije ku yindi miti ibiri igabanya ubukana bw'indwara. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo impatwe n'isesemi. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kwiyahura ku bari munsi y'imyaka 25, serotonin syndrome, kuva amaraso, mania, na SIADH. Indwara yo kwiyica ishobora kubaho iyo igipimo cyagabanutse vuba. Gukoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa ntabwo byifuzwa muri rusange. Ishyirwa mu cyiciro cy’umusemburo wa serotonin. Uburyo ikora ntabwo busobanutse neza ariko bikekwa ko bifitanye isano no kwiyongera k'urugero rwa serotonin.
Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 2013. Ku kwezi mu Bwongereza bitwara NHS amafaranga agera kuri £27.72 mu 2019. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ikiguzi cy'iyi ngano ni hafi 368.40 USD. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 312 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni imwe.

Urukingo rwa MMR ni urukingo rurinda iseru, mumps, na rubella (iseru yo mu Budage). Igipimo cya mbere gikunze guhabwa abana bari hagati y'amezi 9 na 15, ikindi gipimo kikaba kiri hagati y'amezi 15 na 6, nibura ibyumweru 4 hagati y'igipimo. Nyuma yo gupima inshuro ebyiri, 97% by'abantu barindwa iseru, 88% bakirwa indwara ya mumps, na nibura 97% bakirwa indwara ya rubella. Uru rukingo kandi rurasabwa ku bantu badafite ibimenyetso by’ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri, abafite agakoko gatera SIDA kagenzurwa neza, kandi mu masaha 72 nyuma yo kwandura iseru mu bantu batarakingirwa burundu. Itangwa binyuze mu gutera imitsi cyangwa munsi y'uruhu.
Urukingo rwa MMR rukoreshwa cyane ku isi yose, aho doze zisaga miliyoni 500 zimaze gutangwa mu bihugu birenga 100 kugeza mu 2001. Indwara ya serumu yahitanye abantu miliyoni 2.6 buri mwaka mbere y’uko inkingo zitangira gukoreshwa. Ibi byagabanutse bigera ku mfu 122.000 ku mwaka mu 2012, cyane cyane mu bihugu bikennye. Binyuze mu gukingira, kugeza mu 2018, igipimo cy'indwara ya measles muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru n'Amajyepfo kiri hasi cyane. Igipimo cy'indwara cyagaragaye ko cyiyongera mu baturage badakingiwe. Hagati ya 2000 na 2016, gukingira byagabanyije impfu za measles ku kigero cya 84%.
Ingaruka mbi muri rusange ziba zoroshye kandi zishira nta muti wihariye wavuwe. Ibi bishobora kuba birimo umuriro, ubusanzwe iminsi 7 na 10 nyuma yo gukingirwa, ndetse no kurwara uduheri, ibyumweru 2 nyuma yo gukingirwa. Izindi ngaruka mbi zirimo ububabare cyangwa gutukura aho bateye inshinge. Indwara zikomeye z'ubwivumbure biba ku bantu bagera kuri umwe muri miliyoni. Kubera ko irimo virusi nzima, urukingo rwa MMR ntirwemerwa mu gihe utwite, ahubwo rushobora gutangwa mu gihe cyo konsa. Uru rukingo ni rwiza gutanga mu gihe kimwe n'izindi nkingo. Kuba uherutse gukingirwa ntabwo byongera ibyago byo kwanduza abandi iseru, mumps, cyangwa rubella. Gukingirwa ntabwo byongera ibyago byo kurwara autisme. Urukingo rwa MMR ni uruvange rwa virusi zisanzwe zo mu bwoko bwa virusi eshatu.
Urukingo rwa MMR rwakozwe na Maurice Hilleman. Yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoreshwa na Merck mu 1971. Urukingo rwa surua, mumps, na rubella rwari rwarahawe uburenganzira bwo gukingira mu 1963, 1967, na 1969. Inama ku gipimo cya kabiri cyatanzwe mu 1989. Urukingo rwa MMRV runakingira inkoko rushobora gukoreshwa. Urukingo rwa MR, rudafite ubwishingizi ku ndwara ya mumps, narwo rukoreshwa rimwe na rimwe. Mu Bwongereza, dose imwe ya MMR yuzuye mbere itwara NHS hafi £10 guhera mu 2021.

Dermatitis, izwi kandi nka eczema, ni itsinda ry'indwara zitera kubyimba k'uruhu. Izi ndwara zirangwa no gushyuha, uruhu rutukura n'uduheri. Mu gihe cy'igihe gito, hashobora kubaho udusebe duto, mu gihe mu gihe kirekire uruhu rushobora kubyimba. Agace k'uruhu karimo gashobora gutandukana kuva ku gato kugeza ku gutwikira umubiri wose.
Dermatitis irimo dermatitis itera indwara ya atopic, dermatitis itera allergie, dermatitis itera irritant na dermatitis itera stasis. Impamvu nyayo y’iyi ndwara akenshi ntirasobanuka neza. Abarwayi bashobora kuba bafite uburibwe, allergie no kugaruka nabi kw'imitsi. Ubwoko bw'indwara y'uruhu muri rusange buterwa n'amateka y'umuntu n'aho yatewe n'ibisebe. Urugero, indwara y’uruhu ikunze kugaragara ku maboko y’abantu bakunze kuyatobesha. Dermatitis yo mu bwoko bwa allergie ibaho iyo umuntu ahuye n'ikintu kimutera allergie, bigatuma uruhu rugira allergie nyinshi.
Ubusanzwe kuvura dermatitis itera indwara ya atopic bikoreshwa mu kuvura ibinure n'amavuta yo mu bwoko bwa steroid. Amavuta ya steroid muri rusange agomba kuba afite imbaraga hagati kugeza kuri nyinshi kandi agakoreshwa mu gihe kitarenze ibyumweru bibiri icyarimwe, kuko ingaruka zishobora kubaho. Antibiyotike zishobora gukenerwa iyo hari ibimenyetso by'indwara z'uruhu. Ubusanzwe dermatitis yo mu bwoko bwa contact ivurwa hirindwa ibintu bishobora gutera ubwivumbure cyangwa ibintu bitera ubwivumbure. Antihistamines bishobora gufasha mu gusinzira no kugabanya kwiyahura nijoro.
Indwara y'uruhu yibasiye abantu miliyoni 245 ku isi mu 2015. Ubwoko bw'indwara ya atopic dermatitis ni bwo bukunze kugaragara cyane kandi muri rusange butangira mu bwana. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, igira ingaruka ku bantu bagera kuri 10–30%. Dermatitis yo mu bwoko bwa contact ikunze kugaragara ku bagore inshuro ebyiri kurusha abagabo. Dermatitis ifata abantu bagera kuri 7% mu gihe runaka mu buzima bwabo. Indwara yo kubabara mu mutwe irakabije, cyane cyane mu bantu bafite imirimo imwe n'imwe; igipimo nyacyo ntikizwi neza.

Amabuye ya tonsil, azwi kandi nka tonsilloliths, ni ubutare bw'imyanda iri mu myobo ya tonsil. Iyo hatashyizwemo amabuye y'agaciro, kuba hari imyanda bizwi nka tonsillitis idakira (CCT). Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kunuka mu kanwa. Muri rusange nta bubabare buhari, nubwo hashobora kubaho kumva ikintu runaka kirimo.
Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo indwara zo mu muhogo zigaruka kenshi. Amabuye yo mu tunyangingo akubiyemo biofilm igizwe na bagiteri zitandukanye. Nubwo akenshi biba mu tunyangingo twa palatine, bishobora no kugaragara mu tunyangingo two mu rurimi rumwe. Amabuye y'imitsi yanditsweho uburemere kuva kuri 0.3g kugeza kuri 42g. Bishobora kuboneka mu gihe cyo gufata amashusho y’abaganga kubera izindi mpamvu.
Iyo amabuye yo mu toni adateye ikibazo umuntu, nta muti ukenewe. Bitabaye ibyo, gusuka amazi y'umunyu no kuyakuraho n'intoki bishobora kugeragezwa. Chlorhexidine ishobora no kugeragezwa. Ubuvuzi bwo kubaga bushobora kuba burimo gukuraho igice cy'imitsi cyangwa burundu. Abantu bagera ku 10% bafite utubuye tw’imitsi. Abagabo n'abagore bagira ingaruka kimwe. Abantu bakuze ni bo bakunze kwibasirwa cyane.

Paresthesia, izwi kandi nka pins and injections, ni ukumva urimo gucika intege, gutobora, gushya, cyangwa kutabona neza. Bidakunze kugaragara bishobora kuvugwa nk'ubukonje cyangwa kumva umuntu anyaraguritse. Bibaho nta ruhu rukozweho. Nubwo bishobora kugaragara ahantu hose ku mubiri, akenshi amaboko n'amaguru birabagiraho ingaruka. Bishobora kuba igihe gito cyangwa kirekire.
Impamvu ikunze gutera ibihe bigufi ni igitutu ku mitsi. Indwara z'igihe kirekire zishobora guterwa n'indwara ya carpal tunnel syndrome, stroke, multiple sclerosis, transverse myelitis, ibibyimba, kubura vitamine B12, uburozi bwa lead, diyabete, Guillain-Barre syndrome, cyangwa encephalitis. Gusuzuma indwara bishingiye ku bimenyetso, isuzuma, n'ibindi bipimo.
Uburyo bwo kuvura buterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru. Mu rwego rwo kunoza ubukana bw'iyi ndwara, harimo amavuta ya capsaicin, carbamazepine, cyangwa gabapentin. Iri jambo rikomoka ku ijambo ry'Ikigiriki "para" risobanura iruhande rwaryo na "aesthesis" risobanura ibyiyumvo. Ijambo "dysesthesia" rifite ibisobanuro bisa; icyakora, bamwe barikoresha gusa iyo bakozweho bivamo kumva kudasanzwe.

Kuva amaraso mu bwonko (ICH), bizwi kandi nka kuva amaraso mu bwonko, ni ubwoko bw'amaraso ava mu bwonko cyangwa mu mitsi. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kuribwa umutwe, intege nke z'uruhande rumwe, kuruka, gucika intege, kugabanuka k'ubushobozi bwo gutekereza, no kunangira ijosi. Akenshi ibimenyetso birarushaho kwiyongera uko igihe kigenda gihita. Umuriro nabyo ni ibisanzwe. Kenshi na kenshi kuva amaraso biba biri mu bwonko no mu mitsi.
Impamvu zirimo gukomereka mu bwonko, imitsi itera amaraso mu bwonko, ubumuga bw'imitsi itera amaraso mu bwonko, n'ibibyimba byo mu bwonko. Ibintu bikomeye bishobora gutera kuva amaraso mu buryo butunguranye ni umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso na amyloidosis. Izindi mpamvu zishobora gutera iyi ndwara zirimo ubusinzi, cholesterol nke, imiti igabanya amaraso, no gukoresha kokayine. Gusuzuma indwara akenshi bikorwa hakoreshejwe CT scan. Ni ubwoko bw'indwara yo kuva amaraso mu bwonko. Izindi ndwara zishobora kugaragara nk'izo zirimo indwara yo mu bwonko ischemic.
Ubusanzwe ubuvuzi bugomba gukorerwa mu cyumba cy’indembe. Amabwiriza agamije kugabanya umuvuduko w'amaraso ukagera kuri systolic 130 kugeza kuri 140 mmHg. Imiti igabanya amaraso igomba guhindurwa uko bishoboka kose kandi isukari yo mu maraso ikaguma ku rugero rusanzwe. Kubaga kugira ngo hashyirweho umuyoboro w'amazi mu mitsi bishobora gukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ya hydrocephalus ariko imiti ya corticosteroid ntigomba gukoreshwa. Kubagwa kugira ngo amaraso akurweho ni ingirakamaro mu bihe bimwe na bimwe.
Kuva amaraso mu bwonko bifata abantu bagera kuri 2.5 kuri 10.000 buri mwaka. Bikunze kugaragara ku bagabo n'abantu bakuze. Abagera kuri 44% by'abanduye bapfa mu kwezi kumwe. Umusaruro mwiza uboneka hafi 20% by'abahuye n'iki kibazo. Kuva amaraso mu bwonko byatangiye gutandukanywa n'indwara zo mu bwonko bitewe n'uko amaraso atembera nabi, ibyo bikaba byaritwaga "kuvunika no gufungana", mu 1823.

Rickets ni indwara ituma amagufwa y'abana adakomera cyangwa yoroshye. Ibimenyetso birimo amaguru ahetamye, kugorana gukura, kubabara amagufwa, agahanga kanini, no kugorwa no gusinzira. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kuvunika kw'amagufwa, imitsi icikagurika, umugongo ugoramye ku buryo budasanzwe, cyangwa ubumuga bwo mu mutwe.
Impamvu ikunze gutera indwara ya rickets ni ukubura vitamine D. Ibi bishobora guterwa no kurya indyo idafite vitamine D ihagije, uruhu rwijimye, kutagira izuba ryinshi, konsa umwana gusa nta nyongera ya vitamine D, indwara ya celiac, n'izindi ndwara zimwe na zimwe zikomoka ku ngirabuzimafatizo. Ibindi bintu bishobora kuba birimo kalisiyumu cyangwa fosifore idahagije. Uburyo bw'ibanze bukubiyemo ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro budafite ubuziranenge ku gice cyo gukura. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bishingiye ku bipimo by'amaraso bigasangamo kalisiyumu nkeya, fosifore nkeya, na fosifore ya alkaline nyinshi hamwe na X-rays.
Kwirinda abana bonsa gusa ni inyongeramusaruro za Vitamine D. Bitabaye ibyo, ubuvuzi buterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru. Iyo umuntu arwaye indwara yo kubura vitamine D, ubusanzwe avurwa na vitamine D na kalisiyumu. Ibi muri rusange bitanga impinduka mu byumweru bike. Ubusembwa bw'amagufwa nabwo bushobora kwiyongera uko igihe kigenda gihita. Rimwe na rimwe hashobora kubagwa kugira ngo hakosorwe ubumuga bw'amagufwa. Ubwoko bw'indwara busanzwe bukenera ubuvuzi bwihariye.
Rickets ikunze kugaragara mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati, muri Afurika no muri Aziya. Muri rusange ntibikunze kugaragara muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu Burayi, uretse mu matsinda amwe n'amwe y'abantu bake. Bitangira mu bwana, akenshi hagati y'amezi 3 na 18. Igipimo cy'indwara kirangana ku bagabo no ku bagore. Ingero z'ibyo bivugwa ko ari indwara ya rickets zavuzwe kuva mu kinyejana cya 1, kandi iyo ndwara yari ikwirakwiriye mu bwami bw'Abaroma. Iyi ndwara yari isanzwe mu kinyejana cya 20. Uburyo bwo kuvura bwa mbere bwari bukubiyemo gukoresha amavuta y'umwijima w'ifi ya cod.

Igisebe ni uruhurirane rw'amashyira yishyize mu ngingo z'umubiri. Ibimenyetso by'ibibyimba birimo gutukura, ububabare, ubushyuhe, no kubyimba. Kubyimba bishobora kumva ko byuzuye amazi iyo bikandagiwe. Agace k'umutuku gakunze kurenga ku kubyimba. Karubuncle n'ibibyimba ni ubwoko bw'ibibyimba akenshi biba birimo uduce tw'umusatsi, aho karubuncle ziba nini.
Akenshi biterwa n'ubwandu bwa bagiteri. Akenshi ubwoko bwinshi butandukanye bwa bagiteri bugira uruhare mu kwandura kumwe. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu tundi duce twinshi tw’isi, bagiteri ikunze kugaragara cyane ni "Staphylococcus aureus irwanya methicillin". Ni gake cyane, udukoko dushobora gutera ibibyimba; ibi bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere. Ubusanzwe isuzuma rikorwa hashingiwe ku kuntu risa kandi ryemezwa no kuricamo. Ultrasound Gufata amashusho bishobora kuba ingirakamaro mu gihe indwara idasobanutse neza. Mu bibyimba bikikije ikibuno, computer tomography (CT) ishobora kuba ingenzi kugira ngo harebwe ubwandu bwimbitse.
Uburyo busanzwe bwo kuvura ibibyimba byinshi by'uruhu cyangwa ingingo zoroshye ni ukubikata no kubikuramo amazi. Bigaragara ko hari inyungu zimwe na zimwe zo gukoresha imiti yica udukoko; nubwo gukoresha iyo miti bifitanye isano n'ingaruka mbi. Ibimenyetso bike bigaragaza ko nta gupfunyika umwobo usigayemo gaze nyuma yo gusohora amazi. Gufunga iki kibonobono nyuma yo kugikuramo amazi aho kugisiga gifunguye bishobora kwihutisha gukira hatabayeho kongera ibyago byo kugaruka kw'igisebe. Gukuramo amabyi ukoresheje urushinge akenshi ntibihagije.
Ibibyimba by'uruhu birakunze kugaragara kandi byarushijeho kwiyongera mu myaka ya vuba aha. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo gukoresha imiti mu mitsi, aho igipimo cyavuzwe ko kiri hejuru cyane kigera kuri 65% mu bayikoresha. Mu 2005 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abantu miliyoni 3.2 bagiye mu ishami ryita ku barwayi barwaye ikibyimba. Muri Ositaraliya, abantu bagera ku 13.000 barwariye mu bitaro mu 2008 bafite iyo ndwara.

Dystonia ni indwara yo kwimuka aho kwifata kw'imitsi bidaturutse ku bushake bitera kwimuka buhoro buhoro cyangwa kwifata mu buryo budasanzwe. Hari n'ubwo bubabare cyangwa gutigita bishobora kubaho. Muri bimwe, ibimenyetso bigaragara gusa iyo umuntu akoze imyitozo ngororamubiri, afite stress, cyangwa ananiwe. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kwiheba cyangwa guhangayika.
Bishobora kuragwa n'ababyeyi, cyangwa bigaterwa n'imvune yavutse, gucika imitsi, ubwandu, uburozi bwa lisansi, uburozi bwa CO, ndetse n'ingaruka mbi z'imiti imwe n'imwe nka antidopaminergic agents. Uburyo bw'ibanze bukoresha ibice bimwe na bimwe by'ubwonko, akenshi ganglia y'ibanze. Ishobora gushyirwa mu byiciro nka generalized, focal, multifocal, segmental, cyangwa hemidystonia; cyangwa bitewe n'igice cy'umubiri cyagizweho ingaruka nka cervical, blepharospasm, stripping, na dystonia y'umucuranzi. Gusuzuma bishobora kuba birimo gupima imiterere y’umubiri, MRI, no gupima amaraso.
Iyo bibayeho bitewe n'imiti, guhagarika imiti bishobora gutuma umuntu akira neza. Bitabaye ibyo, ubuvuzi bushobora kuba burimo imiti nka anticholinergics, benzodiazepines cyangwa dopaminergic agents; inshinge za botulinum toxin; ubuvuzi bw'umubiri; cyangwa kubagwa, nko gukangura ubwonko mu buryo bwimbitse.
Indwara ya Dystonia yibasira abantu bagera ku 250.000 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ntibikunze kugaragara cyane nk'indwara zo mu mutwe ziterwa no gutitira no gucika intege (movement disorders) hamwe na Parkinson. Imyaka yose ishobora kugerwaho n'ingaruka. Iryo jambo ryahimbwe mu 1911.

Ubwoko bw'ubwandu bukunze kugaragara ni bagiteri, aho ubwandu bwa bagiteri butagira garama bugaragara muri 62% by'abanduye naho ubwandu bwa bagiteri butagira garama bugaragara muri 47%. Mu bihe biri munsi ya 5% by'abarwayi, virusi cyangwa udukoko tuba turimo. Ahantu hakunze kugaragara ubwandu ni ibihaha (42%), amaraso (21%), n'inkari (10%), nubwo kimwe cya gatatu cy'abarwayi aho hantu hatazwi neza. Ibintu bishobora gutera sepsis birimo diyabete, kanseri, ibibazo by'umwijima cyangwa impyiko, ikoreshwa rya corticosteroids, ubushye, imikorere mibi y'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, ndetse n'imyaka ikabije. Ni ubwoko bw'ihungabana rikwirakwira.
Ubuvuzi bukubiyemo uburyo bwo kuvura hakiri kare hifashishijwe intego, hakoreshejwe imiti yica udukoko, gukuramo ingirangingo zanduye, amazi yo mu mitsi, n'imiti itera imitsi nka norepinephrine. Izindi ngamba zishobora kuba zirimo guhumeka hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga na kortikosteroidi. Sepsis ikomeye ibaho ku bantu bagera ku 750.000 (300 kuri 100.000) buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ingaruka zo gupfa zirenze 40% kandi bamwe mu barokotse basigarana ubumuga bw'igihe kirekire.

Imiti igabanya ububabare idakoresha steroide (NSAIDs) ni ubwoko bw'imiti ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura ububabare, umuriro, no kubyimba. Aspirine ishobora kandi gukoreshwa mu gukumira indwara z'umutima cyangwa indwara zo mu bwonko. Bishobora gufatwa mu kanwa, mu guterwa inshinge, mu gusigwa ku ruhu, cyangwa mu buryo bwo gukamura. Bishobora gukoreshwa hamwe na parasetamol (acetaminophen). Ku bantu bafite ibyago byo kugira ibibazo byo mu gifu, bashobora gufatwa hamwe n'umuti ugabanya ubukana bwa pompe ya proton.
Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo ibisebe byo mu gifu, indwara z'umutima, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, n'indwara z'impyiko. Izindi ngaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo indwara ya asima n'uduheri. Ntibikwiye gufatwa mu mezi 3 ya nyuma yo gutwita. Hari ubwoko bubiri bw'ibidatoranywa n'ibidatoranywa bya COX-2. Nubwo imiti itoranya COX-2 ishobora kugira ibyago bike byo kubabara mu gifu, ifite ibyago byinshi byo kurwara indwara z'umutima. Zikora mu kubuza imikorere ya enzymes za cyclooxygenase (COX-1 cyangwa COX-2).
NSAID ya mbere yari aspirine, yatangiye gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi mu 1899, nubwo mbere yakoreshejwe mu buryo bw'igishishwa cy'umukungugu. Ibi byakurikiwe na ibuprofen mu myaka ya 1960 na naproxen mu myaka ya 1970. Inyinshi muri zo ziraboneka nk'imiti isanzwe kandi ntabwo ihenze cyane. Zimwe muri zo zishobora no kugurwa ukoresheje ikarita (OTC). Parasetamol ntabwo ifatwa nk'umuti urwanya indwara zo mu mutwe (NSAID).

Kunanirwa kw'impyiko (mu Gifaransa "insuffisance rénale", mu Cyongereza "kidney failure"), bizwi kandi nk'indwara y'impyiko yo mu cyiciro cya nyuma, ni indwara aho impyiko zigira imikorere iri munsi ya 15% by'ibisanzwe. Ishobora kuza vuba (kunanirwa gukabije) cyangwa buhoro buhoro (kunanirwa kudakira). Ivurwa hakoreshejwe dialyse cyangwa gusimbuza impyiko.
Ibimenyetso n'ingorane.
Kunanirwa kw'impyiko bishyirwa mu cyiciro cy'intege nke z'impyiko, zikura vuba kandi zishobora gukemuka; n'intege nke z'impyiko zidakira, zikura buhoro buhoro kandi akenshi ntizishobora gusubizwa inyuma. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubyimba amaguru, kumva unaniwe, kuruka, kubura ubushake bwo kurya, no kwitiranya ibintu. Ingorane zo kunanirwa gukabije no kudakora neza zirimo uremia, potasiyumu nyinshi mu maraso, no kwiyongera k'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Ingorane zo kudakora neza zirimo kandi indwara z'umutima, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, no kubura amaraso.
Impamvu zitera impyiko gucika intege cyane zirimo umuvuduko muke w'amaraso, kuziba kw'inzira y'inkari, imiti imwe n'imwe, kwangirika kw'imitsi, na hemolytic uremic syndrome. Impamvu zitera impyiko kudakora neza zirimo diyabete, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, indwara ya nephrotic, n'indwara y'impyiko ya polycystic. Gusuzuma indwara yo gucika intege mu buryo bwihuse akenshi bishingiye ku bintu bitandukanye nko kugabanuka k'umusaruro w'inkari cyangwa kwiyongera kwa creatinine mu maraso. Gusuzuma indwara idakira biterwa n'igipimo cyo kuyungurura glomerular (GFR) kiri munsi ya 15 cyangwa hakenewe ubuvuzi bwo gusimbuza impyiko. Bingana kandi n'indwara y'impyiko idakira yo mu cyiciro cya 5.
Kuvura kunanirwa gukabije kw'impyiko biterwa n'impamvu nyamukuru. Kuvura indwara idakira bishobora kuba birimo hemodialysis, dialysis ya peritoneal, cyangwa gusimbuza impyiko. Hemodialysis ikoresha imashini iyungurura amaraso hanze y'umubiri. Muri dialyse ya peritoneal amazi runaka ashyirwa mu nda hanyuma akavomwa, ibi bigasubirwamo inshuro nyinshi ku munsi. Gutera impyiko bikubiyemo kubagwa no gushyira impyiko y'undi muntu hanyuma ugafata imiti igabanya ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri kugira ngo wirinde kwangwa. Izindi ngamba zisabwa mu ndwara zidakira zirimo gukomeza gukora cyane no guhindura imirire ku buryo bwihariye.
Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, kunanirwa gukabije kw'impyiko kwibasira abantu bagera kuri 3 ku bantu 1,000 ku mwaka. 000, abantu 3 ku bantu 10.000 bashya barwara iyi ndwara buri mwaka. Iyo abantu benshi bafite indwara zidakira bavuwe neza bashobora gukomeza gukora.

Nyamweru cyangwa ubumuga bw'uruhu (mu Gifaransa "albinisme", mu Cyongereza "albinism") ni ikibazo umuntu avukana, kirangwa no kutagira ibara ry'uruhu, umusatsi n'amaso mu buryo bwuzuye cyangwa igice. Buterwa n'impinduka mu turemangingo zigabanya melanin, kandi bujyana n'ibibazo byo kureba ndetse n'ibyago byo kurwara kanseri y'uruhu. Bwibasira hafi umuntu 1 ku bantu 20.000.
Ubumuga bw'uruhu bufitanye isano n'ibibazo byo kureba birimo nystagmus. Abantu kandi bakunze kwibasirwa n'izuba ndetse na kanseri y'uruhu.
Ubumuga bw'uruhu buterwa n'impinduka mu miterere y'uturemangingo bigatuma ubushobozi bwo gukora cyangwa gukwirakwiza melanin bugabanuka. Nibura ubwoko 7 bw'impinduka z'uturemangingo (autosomal recessive) bushobora gutera ubumuga bw'uruhu, kandi iyi ndwara nayo igaragara mu ndwara zitandukanye zirimo Hermansky-Pudlak na Chédiak-Higashi syndrome. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bikorwa hashingiwe ku isuzuma kandi bishobora gushyigikirwa n'ibizamini by'uturemangingo.
Kwitabwaho n'ikwirakwira.
Ubuvuzi bukubiyemo kurinda izuba ubuzima bwose nko gukoresha imyenda yo kwirinda, imiti irinda izuba, indorerwamo z'izuba, no kwirinda urumuri rwa UV. Gusuzuma kanseri y'uruhu byibuze buri mwaka, byumvikana ko melanoma izaba ibara ry'umutuku aho kuba umukara. Gusuzuma amaso kenshi nabyo birasabwa. Hafi umuntu 1 kuri 20.000 yibasiwe n’iki kibazo. Ijambo "albinisme" rikomoka ku ijambo ry'ikilatini "albus" risobanura "umweru".

Donepezil, igurishwa ku izina ry'ubucuruzi rya Aricept n'andi, ni umuti ukoreshwa mu kuvura indwara ya Alzheimer. Ifatwa mu kanwa. Yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1996.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Bisa nkaho bitanga inyungu nto mu mikorere y'ubwonko n'ubushobozi bwo gukora. Icyakora, gukoresha uyu muti ntibyagaragaye ko bihindura uko indwara igenda ikura. Ubuvuzi bugomba guhagarikwa niba nta nyungu igaragara. Ifatwa mu kanwa.
Ingaruka n'uko ikora.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi, gusinzira nabi, impiswi, kumva unaniwe, no kuribwa mu mitsi. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo kugorwa no kuva inkari mu ruhago, no gucika intege. Donepezil ni umuti ubuza acetylcholinesterase gukora neza.
Donepezil yemerewe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1996. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. 52 mu 2019. 38. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 127 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni eshanu.

Kubyara umwana upfuye bisobanurwa nk'urupfu rw'umwana uri mu nda nyuma y'ibyumweru 20 cyangwa 28, bitewe n'aho byaturutse. Akenshi impamvu yabyo ntimenyekana. Mu 2015, ku isi habayeho abana bagera kuri miliyoni 2,6 bavutse bapfuye, cyane cyane muri Aziya y'Epfo no muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara.
Umwana avuka adafite ibimenyetso by'ubuzima. Kubyara umwana wapfuye bishobora gutuma umubyeyi yumva afite icyaha cyangwa agahinda. Iri jambo ritandukanye no gukuramo inda, ari byo gutakaza inda mbere y’igihe, no kubyara umwana ari muzima, aho umwana avuka ari muzima, nubwo yapfa nyuma gato.
Akenshi impamvu iba itazwi. Impamvu zishobora kuba zirimo ibibazo byo kuvukana, indwara nka malariya na syphilis, ndetse n'ubuzima bubi bw'umubyeyi. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago birimo kuba umubyeyi w’imyaka irenga 35, kunywa itabi, gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge, gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rifasha mu kubyara, no gutwita bwa mbere. Byemezwa hakoreshejwe ultrasound.
Kwirinda no kwitabwaho.
Hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'abana bapfa bavuka mu gihe cyo kubyara, ibi bikaba bikunze kugaragara mu bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere kurusha ibihugu byateye imbere. Bitewe n'igihe inda igeze, imiti ishobora gukoreshwa mu gutangira kubyara cyangwa ubwoko bw'ubuganga buzwi nka dilation and evacuation bushobora gukorwa. Nyuma yo kubyara umwana wapfuye, abagore baba bafite ibyago byinshi byo kubyara undi mwana; icyakora, inda nyinshi zikurikiraho ntabwo zigira ibibazo nk'ibyo. Ihungabana, igihombo cy'amafaranga, no gusenyuka kw'imiryango ni ingorane zizwi.
Ku isi yose mu 2015 habayeho abana bapfa bavuka bagera kuri miliyoni 2.6 nyuma y'ibyumweru 28 batwite (hafi 1 kuri buri mwana 45). Bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, cyane cyane muri Aziya y'Epfo no muri Afurika yo munsi y'ubutayu bwa Sahara. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kuri buri mwana 167 uvuka, umwana umwe uvuka yapfuye. Igipimo cy'abana bapfa bavuka cyaragabanutse, nubwo cyagabanutse buhoro buhoro kuva mu myaka ya 2000.

Phentermine, igurishwa ku izina rya Ionamin n'indi, ni umuti ukoreshwa hamwe n'imirire n'imyitozo ngororamubiri kugira ngo uvure umubyibuho ukabije. Ifatwa mu kanwa kugeza ku byumweru bike. Yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1959.
Ikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
Phentermine ikoreshwa mu kuvura umubyibuho ukabije, hamwe n'imirire n'imyitozo ngororamubiri, kandi ifatwa mu kanwa kugeza ku byumweru bike. Iraboneka kandi nk'umuti uvanze wa phentermine/topiramate.
Ingaruka n'ibibujijwe.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo gutera k'umutima vuba, umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso, kubura ibitotsi, isereri no kubura ituze. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso mu bihaha. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo gutwita cyangwa konsa. Ntibyemewe gukoresha hamwe na SSRI cyangwa MAO inhibitors.
Phentermine yemejwe gukoreshwa mu buvuzi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu 1959. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe. 55. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 210 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni ebyiri. Phentermine yakuwe ku isoko mu Bwongereza mu 2000 mu gihe umuti uvanze wa fen-phen, wari ugizwe na wo, wakuwe ku isoko mu 1997 kubera ingaruka mbi.

Lymphedema ni ukubyimba kw'igice cy'umubiri bitewe n'uko sisitemu y'imitsi yangiritse. Akenshi iterwa na kanseri n'uburyo ivurwa cyangwa n'indwara ya lymphatic filariasis. Nta muti uyikiza uhari, ariko ubuvuzi bushobora kugabanya ibimenyetso. Yibasira abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 200 ku isi.
Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba birimo kubabara, kuremererwa, gukomera kw'ingingo, no kubyimba k'uruhu. Ingorane zishobora kuba zirimo kwandura, na lymphangiosarcoma.
Akenshi ikunze kubaho bitewe na kanseri n'uburyo ivurwa cyangwa indwara ziterwa n'udukoko (lymphatic filariasis), ariko ishobora no kugaragara mu ndwara nyinshi ziterwa n'uturemangingo. Ibintu bishobora gutera ikibazo birimo umubyibuho ukabije. Gusuzuma indwara muri rusange bishingiye ku bimenyetso, nyuma y’uko izindi mpamvu zishobora kuyitera zitabonetse.
Ubuvuzi bukunze kuba burimo kwita ku ruhu neza, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri, no gusohora amazi mu mubiri hakoreshejwe intoki (MLD), bizwi nka "combined decongestive therapy". Ubusanzwe kubaga bikoreshwa gusa ku bantu batavuwe hakoreshejwe izindi ngamba.
Lymphedema yibasira abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 200 ku isi yose. Abagore ni bo bibasirwa cyane kurusha abagabo. Abagore 1 kuri 5 barokotse kanseri y'ibere na 40% by'abagore barwaye kanseri y'abagore barwara lymphedema. Impamvu ziterwa n’uturemangingo ntizikunze kugaragara cyane, zigaragara ku muntu umwe ku bantu 100.000. Iyo mimerere yasobanuwe mu mateka ya kera.

Phenylketonuria (PKU) ni indwara y'uruhererekane umuntu avukana, ituma umubiri udashobora gusenya neza aside amine yitwa phenylalanine. Iyo idavuwe, ishobora gutera ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, igicuri, ibibazo by'imyitwarire n'indwara zo mu mutwe.
Ivurwa hakoreshejwe indyo irimo phenylalanine nke, itangira vuba nyuma yo kuvuka igakomeza ubuzima bwose. Yavumbuwe mu 1934 n'umuganga w'Umunyanoruveje Ivar Asbjørn Følling.
Iyo idavuwe, PKU ishobora gutera ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, igicuri, ibibazo by'imyitwarire n'indwara zo mu mutwe. Ishobora kandi gutuma umubiri ugira impumuro idasanzwe, kandi uruhu n'umusatsi bikeruruka kurusha iby'abandi bo mu muryango. Umwana wavutse ku mubyeyi urwaye PKU utubahiriza indyo ashobora kuvukana ibibazo by'umutima, umutwe muto (microcephaly) n'ibiro bike.
PKU ni indwara y'uruhererekane umwana aragwa n'ababyeyi be. Iterwa n'ihinduka (mutation) rya gene ya "PAH", bigatuma enzyme ya phenylalanine hydroxylase igabanuka. Ibi bituma phenylalanine ituruka mu biryo yiyongera mu mubiri kugeza ku rugero rw'uburozi.
Ni autosomal recessive: kugira ngo umuntu arware, kopi zombi za gene zigomba kuba zarahindutse; abafite kopi imwe gusa yahindutse nta bimenyetso bagira. Hari ubwoko bubiri bw'ingenzi: PKU isanzwe (classic), ikomeye kurusha, na PKU yoroheje (variant), aho enzyme igikora igice.
