Ibihugu byinshi bifite gahunda zo gupima abana bakimara kuvuka kugira ngo PKU imenyekane hakiri kare.
Ubuvuzi bukorwa hakoreshejwe indyo irimo ibiryo bike birimo phenylalanine n'inyongeramirire zidasanzwe. Ibiryo bikungahaye kuri poroteyine nk'amata, amagi, inyama, amafi n'ibishyimbo biragabanywa, kimwe n'isukari y'ubukorano yitwa aspartame. Impinja zihabwa amata y'ifu yihariye ashobora kuvangwa n'amashereka make. Indyo igomba gutangira vuba bishoboka nyuma yo kuvuka kandi igakomeza ubuzima bwose; urugero rwa phenylalanine mu amaraso rugenzurwa buri gihe. Umuti wa sapropterin dihydrochloride ushobora gufasha bamwe.
Abasuzumwe hakiri kare bakubahiriza indyo bashobora kugira ubuzima bwiza n'icyizere cy'ubuzima gisanzwe. Mu 2014, ubuvuzi bwa gene (gene therapy) bwatangaga icyizere ariko bwari bugikeneye ubushakashatsi bwinshi.
PKU yibasira umwana umwe mu bana bagera ku 12.000. Abahungu n'abakobwa bayirwara ku rugero rumwe.
PKU yavumbuwe mu 1934 n'umuganga w'Umunyanoruveje Ivar Asbjørn Følling; akamaro k'imirire mu kuyivura kamenyekanye mu 1953.

Hypospadias ni ubumuga umwana w'umuhungu avukana, aho umwenge wa "urethra" (umuyoboro usohora inkari) udafunguka ku mpera y'igitsina gabo, ahubwo ukaba munsi yacyo: hafi y'umutwe wacyo, ku giti cyacyo cyangwa hafi y'agasaho k'intanga.
Impamvu zayo ntizizwi ku bantu benshi. Abenshi bavurwa no kubagwa bakiri bato, hagati y'amezi 3 na 18. Ni ubumuga bwa kabiri bukunze kugaragara ku bahungu bavuka, nyuma y'intanga zitamanutse ("cryptorchidie").
Umwenge w'inkari uba munsi y'igitsina gabo aho kuba ku mpera yacyo. Igitsina gishobora kugorama, kandi uruhu rwo hejuru ("prépuce") rukaba rutwikiriye uruhande rwo hejuru gusa. Iyo hypospadias ikomeye, umwana ashobora kugira ingorane zo kunyara ahagaze.
Ku bana benshi, impamvu ntizwi. Hypospadias ivuka iyo igitsina gikura nabi hagati y'icyumweru cya 8 n'icya 14 cyo gutwita. Ibyongera ibyago birimo amateka y'umuryango, nyina ufite imyaka 30 kuzamura, umubyibuho ukabije wa nyina, gusama hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, n'imiti y'imisemburo ya progestin mbere cyangwa mu gihe cyo gutwita. Ishobora kandi kuba kimwe mu bigize izindi ndwara zivukanwa.
Isuzuma rikorwa mu isuzuma ry'umubiri umwana akivuka. Hypospadias igabanywa hakurikijwe aho umwenge uri:
Abenshi bavurwa no kubagwa, akenshi hagati y'amezi 3 na 18, rimwe na rimwe mu byiciro byinshi. Kubaga bishobora kwimura umwenge, kugorora igitsina no gusana uruhu. Abana bafite hypospadias ntibagomba gukebwa mbere yo kubagwa, kuko uruhu rwo hejuru rushobora gukenerwa mu gusana. Nyuma yo kubagwa hashobora kuvuka ingorane nka "fistula" (umwenge mushya unyuramo inkari), kwifunga k'umwenge cyangwa k'umuyoboro. Abenshi bagira ubuzima busanzwe bw'imibonano mpuzabitsina bamaze kuba bakuru.
Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, hafi umwe ku bahungu 150 avukana hypospadias. Mu Burayi, nko muri Danimarike, igipimo kiri hagati ya 0,5 % na 0,8 %; ishobora kuba idakunze kugaragara mu bindi bice by'isi.

Kanseri y'igifu (mu cyongereza "stomach cancer" cyangwa "gastric cancer"), izwi kandi nka kanseri yo mu gifu, ni kanseri ituruka ku gahu k'imbere k'igifu, iterwa no gukura bidasanzwe kw'uturemangingo. Impamvu yayo ikunze kugaragara ni ubwandu bwa bagiteri "Helicobacter pylori". Ibimenyetso bya mbere ni nko kuribwa mu gifu, kubabara mu nda yo hejuru, isesemi no kubura ubushake bwo kurya.
Isuzumwa hakoreshejwe "biopsy" ifatwa mu gihe cya "endoscopy". Ivurwa no kubagwa, imiti ya kanseri n'imirasire; iyo itahuwe hakiri kare ishobora gukira. Ku isi, ni imwe muri kanseri eshanu zikunze kugaragara, ikaba ikunze kwibasira cyane Aziya y'Iburasirazuba n'Burayi bw'Iburasirazuba.
Ubwoko n'ibimenyetso.
Inyinshi muri kanseri z'igifu ni "carcinoma" (cyane cyane "adenocarcinoma") zituruka ku turemangingo tw'agahu k'imbere k'igifu. "Lymphoma" n'ibibyimba bya "mesenchyme" nabyo bishobora kugaragara mu gifu.
Ibimenyetso bya mbere bishobora kuba kuribwa mu gifu, kubabara mu nda yo hejuru, isesemi no kubura ubushake bwo kurya. Nyuma hashobora kuza kugabanuka kw'ibiro, guhinduka umuhondo k'uruhu n'umweru w'amaso, kuruka amaraso, kugorwa no kumira no kugaragara kw'amaraso mu musarani. Kanseri ishobora kuva mu gifu igakwirakwira mu bindi bice by'umubiri, cyane cyane umwijima, ibihaha, amagufwa, agahu gatwikiriye inda imbere n'imvubura z'amatembabuzi ("lymph nodes").
Impamvu ikunze kugaragara ni ubwandu bwa "Helicobacter pylori", bugaragara ku barwayi barenga 60%. Ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bwa "H. pylori" bufite ibyago byinshi kurusha ubundi. Kunywa itabi, imirire (nko kurya imboga zibitswe mu munyu) n'umubyibuho ukabije byongera ibyago. Hafi 10% by'abarwayi bafite abo mu muryango bayirwaye, naho hagati ya 1% na 3% bayiterwa n'indwara z'uruhererekane. Akenshi kanseri y'igifu ikura buhoro buhoro mu myaka myinshi.
Gusuzuma iyi ndwara bikorwa akenshi hafatwa agace k'urugingo ("biopsy") mu gihe cya "endoscopy". Hakurikiraho ibindi bizamini byerekana niba yarakwirakwiriye mu bindi bice by'umubiri. Ubuyapani na Koreya y'Epfo, ibihugu bibiri bifite igipimo cyo hejuru cy'iyi ndwara, bisuzuma abaturage kugira ngo iyi kanseri itahurwe hakiri kare.
Indyo yo mu karere ka Mediterane no kureka itabi bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara kanseri y'igifu. Hari ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko kuvura ubwandu bwa "H. pylori" bigabanya ibyago mu gihe kizaza.
Iyo kanseri y'igifu ivuwe hakiri kare, ishobora gukira. Ubuvuzi bushobora kuba kubaga, imiti ya kanseri ("chimiothérapie"), imirasire n'ubuvuzi bugamije ("targeted therapy"). Iyo itahuwe itinze, hatangwa ubuvuzi bugabanya ububabare. Ubwoko bumwe bwa "lymphoma" y'igifu bushobora kuvurwa no kurandura "H. pylori".
Akenshi iyi ndwara irangira nabi: mu bihugu by'Iburengerazuba, abarwayi bafite kanseri yageze kure barenga imyaka itanu bari munsi ya 10%, kuko abenshi bayitahura yaramaze gukomera. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, abarwayi bagera kuri 39,8% barenza imyaka itanu, mu gihe muri Koreya y'Epfo barenga 65% naho mu Buyapani barenga 70%, ahanini bitewe n'isuzuma rikorwa hakiri kare.
Ku isi yose, kanseri y'igifu ni imwe muri kanseri zikunze kugaragara n'izica abantu benshi. Mu 2022, abantu 968 350 bayirwaye bwa mbere, ihitana abantu 659 853. Mbere y'imyaka ya 1930, mu bice byinshi by'isi, harimo n'ibihugu byinshi byateye imbere by'Iburengerazuba, ni yo yari intandaro ya mbere y'impfu zikomoka kuri kanseri. Kuva icyo gihe, igipimo cy'impfu cyaragabanutse mu bice byinshi by'isi. Ibi bikekwa ko biterwa no kugabanuka kw'ibiryo birimo umunyu mwinshi n'ibibitswe mu munyu, bitewe n'iterambere rya firigo mu kubika ibiryo. Ikunze kugaragara cyane muri Aziya y'Iburasirazuba, igakurikirwa n'Uburayi bw'Iburasirazuba. Ifata abagabo inshuro ebyiri kurusha abagore.

Henri Blanchard ni umupadiri wa Kiliziya Gatolika. Ni Umufaransa. Ari mu muryango w'Abapadiri Bera (Abamisiyoneri ba Afurika). Mu 1994, yari umupadiri muri paruwasi ya Mutagatifu Andereya i Nyamirambo, muri Kigali.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Henri Blanchard yakiriye impunzi muri paruwasi ye. Yarinze abana benshi ari kumwe na Padiri Otto Mayer. Ku ya 10 Kamena 1994, Interahamwe zatwaye impunzi zari muri iyo paruwasi. Nyuma ya jenoside, Henri Blanchard yagarutse mu Rwanda.
Mu gihe cya jenoside.
Henri Blanchard yari umumisiyoneri i Kigali. Yabaga muri paruwasi ya Mutagatifu Andereya i Nyamirambo. Yakoranaga na Padiri Otto Mayer. Otto Mayer ni umupadiri w'Umudage.
Jenoside itangiye, Henri Blanchard yakinguriye kiliziya ye impunzi amagana. Bukeye bwaho, abasirikare n'interahamwe bamennye inzugi. Henri Blanchard yabaze abantu 15 bishwe.
Nyuma yaho, abo bapadiri bombi bacumbikiye abana 55 n'abagore bamwe. Shapeli ya paruwasi yahindutse aho abana bato baryama. Croix-Rouge yabazaniraga ibiribwa buri cyumweru. Henri Blanchard yavuze ko tudafite uburenganzira bwo kwibagirwa ubwicanyi nk'ubwo.
Ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 10 Kamena 1994, interahamwe zaje kuri paruwasi. Zavuze ko zije kwimura abasivili. Zarashe ku nzugi. Zateye mu nzu igisasu cy'ibyuka biryana mu maso. Interahamwe zatwaye impunzi zigera ku 170 imbere y'abo bapadiri bombi. Otto Mayer yarakomeretse. Nyuma, abapadiri babonye imirambo y'abantu bagera kuri cumi na babiri muri abo bajyanywe.
Henri Blanchard yavuye i Kigali muri Kamena 1994. Yasubiye mu Bufaransa gutanga ubuhamya. Ku ya 3 Nzeri 1994, yagarutse mu Rwanda. Ni we wa mbere mu Bapadiri Bera wagarutse kuba mu Rwanda nyuma ya jenoside. Mu 1997, yanditse ko kongera kubaka igihugu bizasaba imbaraga nyinshi n'ubutwari bwinshi.

Luc Marchal ni umusirikare w'Umubiligi uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru. Afite ipeti rya koloneli. Mu 1993–1994, yayoboye ingabo z'Ububiligi zari muri MINUAR. Yari kandi umuyobozi w'ingabo za MINUAR mu karere ka Kigali.
Muri Mutarama 1994, Luc Marchal yahuye n'umuntu wamenyesheje MINUAR ko Interahamwe zitegura kwica Abatutsi. Ku ya 7 Mata 1994, abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi yayoboraga bishwe i Kigali. Urukiko rwa gisirikare rw'Ububiligi rwamugize umwere mu 1996.
Umwuga mbere y'u Rwanda.
Mu 1994, Luc Marchal yari amaze imyaka 30 mu ngabo z'Ububiligi. Imyaka 15 muri yo yayimaze mu mutwe w'abakomando ("para-commandos"). Mbere yo kujya mu Rwanda, yari umuyobozi w'ibiro bya Minisitiri w'Ingabo w'Ububiligi. Yari yarakoze imyaka itanu muri Zayire, ubu ni Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Muri MINUAR (1993–1994).
Luc Marchal yageze mu Rwanda ku ya 9 Ukuboza 1993. Yayoboraga abasirikare b'Ababiligi bagera kuri 440 bari muri MINUAR. Abo basirikare ni bo bari bafite imyitozo n'ibikoresho byiza kurusha abandi. Umuyobozi mukuru wa MINUAR yari Roméo Dallaire.
Luc Marchal yari ashinzwe akarere ka Kigali. Inshingano ye ya mbere yari ukugenzura agace ka Kigali katagombaga kubamo intwaro. Ako gace kari gafite ibilometero 10 uvuye mu mujyi rwagati. Muri ako gace, ingabo zagombaga kubika intwaro zazo. Iki cyemezo cyari mu Masezerano ya Arusha.
Muri Mutarama 1994, Luc Marchal yahuye n'umuntu wiyitaga «Jean-Pierre». Uwo muntu yatozaga Interahamwe. Yavuze ko Interahamwe zihabwa intwaro. Yavuze kandi ko hari urutonde rw'Abatutsi bo kwica. Yerekanye aho intwaro zihishwe. Luc Marchal yateguye ibitero byo gufata izo ntwaro. Icyicaro cy'Umuryango w'Abibumbye i New York cyanze ko bikorwa.
Muri jenoside na nyuma yayo.
Ku ya 7 Mata 1994, abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi ba MINUAR biciwe muri Camp Kigali. Bari barinze Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana.
Mu Bubiligi, Luc Marchal yashinjwe uburangare mu rukiko rwa gisirikare. Bamushinjaga ko uburangare bwe bwatumye abo basirikare icumi bapfa. Mu 1996, urukiko rwamugize umwere.
Mu 2001, Luc Marchal yasohoye igitabo "Rwanda: la descente aux enfers". Muri icyo gitabo, avuga ibyo yabonye mu Rwanda.
Mu 2007, Luc Marchal yatanze ubuhamya mu rubanza rwa Bernard Ntuyahaga mu Bubiligi. Ntuyahaga yari majoro mu ngabo z'u Rwanda. Muri Nyakanga 2007, urukiko rwamuhamije kwica abo basirikare b'Ababiligi. Yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 20.
Muri Mutarama 2008, Luc Marchal yatanze ubuhamya mu Rukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda, i Arusha. Yatanze ubuhamya ashinjura jenerali Augustin Ndindiliyimana.

Bernard Ntuyahaga (yavutse ahagana mu 1952) ni Umunyarwanda wahoze ari majoro mu ngabo z'u Rwanda (FAR). Mu 2007, urukiko rw'i Buruseli mu Ububiligi rwamuhamije kwica abasirikare icumi b'Ababiligi ba MINUAR. Abo basirikare bishwe ku ya 7 Mata 1994, mu ntangiriro za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Bernard Ntuyahaga yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 20. Yarekuwe mu 2018. Ububiligi bwamwohereje mu Rwanda mu Ukuboza 2018.
Bernard Ntuyahaga yavukiye i Mabanza, muri Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Ubu ni mu Akarere ka Karongi. Ni Umuhutu. Mu 1972, yinjiye mu ishuri rya gisirikare ry'abofisiye i Kigali.
Mu 1994, Bernard Ntuyahaga yari majoro mu ngabo z'u Rwanda (FAR).
Ku ya 7 Mata 1994, abasirikare ba FAR bagose urugo rwa Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana. Urwo rugo rwarindwaga n'abasirikare 15 ba MINUAR. Batanu bari Abanyagana, icumi bari Ababiligi. Abo basirikare bambuwe intwaro. Agathe Uwilingiyimana n'umugabo we barishwe.
Urukiko rw'Ububiligi rwemeje ko Bernard Ntuyahaga yajyanye abo basirikare icumi b'Ababiligi muri Camp Kigali. Aho ni ho abasirikare b'Abanyarwanda babiciye. Uyu munsi, aho hantu hari Urwibutso rw'Abasirikare b'Ababiligi.
Muri Kamena 1998, Bernard Ntuyahaga yishyikirije Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (TPIR) i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya. TPIR yamureze jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Ku ya 18 Werurwe 1999, TPIR yakuyeho ibyo birego. Uwo munsi, Tanzaniya yaramufashe. U Rwanda n'Ububiligi byombi byasabaga ko abyoherezwamo.
Mu 2004, Bernard Ntuyahaga yagiye mu Bubiligi. Yishyikirije ubutabera bw'Ububiligi. Urubanza rwe rwatangiye ku ya 19 Mata 2007 imbere y'urukiko rwa rubanda ("Cour d'assises") rw'i Buruseli. Luc Marchal yatanze ubuhamya muri urwo rubanza.
Ku ya 4 Nyakanga 2007, urukiko rwamuhamije kwica abo basirikare icumi b'Ababiligi. Rwamuhamije kandi kwica abasivili b'Abanyarwanda batazwi umubare. Ntiyahamijwe kwica Agathe Uwilingiyimana. Yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 20.
Bernard Ntuyahaga yarangije igihano cye ku ya 2 Kamena 2018. Yashakaga kujya kubana n'umugore we n'umukobwa we muri Danimarike. Ntiyashakaga gusubira mu Rwanda.
Ku ya 21 Ukuboza 2018, Ububiligi bwamwohereje mu Rwanda. Leta y'u Rwanda yari yatanze icyizere cyanditse ko uburenganzira bwe buzubahirizwa. Mu Rwanda, Bernard Ntuyahaga ntiyafunzwe kandi ntiyongeye kuburanishwa. Yoherejwe mu kigo cya Mutobo. Aho yize amateka y'u Rwanda. Nyuma yahawe indangamuntu y'u Rwanda.

Ubwicanyi bwa Bagogwe ni ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abagogwe mu 1991. Abagogwe ni itsinda ry'Abatutsi b'aborozi bo mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba bw'u Rwanda. Ubwo bwicanyi bwabereye mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gisenyi n'iya Ruhengeri.
Abagogwe bagera ku 1 000 barishwe. Bishwe n'inzego z'umutekano n'udutsiko tw'Abahutu. Bamwe babona ubu bwicanyi nk'intangiriro ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Abagogwe ni aborozi babaga hafi y'ishyamba ry'Ibirunga. Kuva mu 1959, Abahutu bo mu majyaruguru babafataga nk'abantu bo hasi. Ubutegetsi bwose bwakurikiyeho bwabahejeje inyuma.
Mu 1990, FPR Inkotanyi yateye u Rwanda. Ku wa 23 Mutarama 1991, Inkotanyi zateye umujyi wa Ruhengeri. Zafunguye abafungwa barenga 700 bo muri gereza ya Ruhengeri. Nyuma y'icyo gitero, ubwicanyi bwibasiye Abagogwe. Ubwicanyi bukomeye bwabaye hagati ya Mutarama na Gashyantare 1991. Bwakomeje kugeza muri Werurwe 1991.
I Kinigi, abaturage bategetswe kurwanya «abanzi». Ibyo byiswe «umuganda wihariye». Samuel Ndagijimana yishwe atewe amabuye ku isoko rya Bisate. Bamushinjaga kuba Umututsi n'intasi. Imibiri imwe yajugunywe mu cyobo cy'imyanda cy'urugo rwa burugumesitiri wa Kinigi. I Gisenyi, imibiri imwe y'Abagogwe yajugunywe ahitwa Commune Rouge.
Mu 1992, Amnesty International yavuze ko Abagogwe bagera ku 1 000 bishwe. Yavuze ko bishwe n'inzego z'umutekano n'udutsiko tw'Abahutu. Umusirikare wahatangiye ubuhamya avuga ko yari i Bigogwe igihe cy'ubwicanyi. Avuga ko abasirikare b'u Rwanda babugizemo uruhare.
Leta yahishe amakuru. Yanze gutanga impapuro z'urupfu. Yavugaga ko abantu babuze bagiye muri FPR. Imiryango ine itegamiye kuri leta yashinze komisiyo mpuzamahanga y'iperereza. Iyo komisiyo yari igizwe n'impuguke icumi mu burenganzira bwa muntu. Umunyamategeko w'Umubiligi Eric Gillet yagize uruhare muri iryo perereza. Iperereza ryasanze imva rusange nto nyinshi. Buri mva yarimo abantu 10 kugeza kuri 20. Zimwe zari mu busitani bwa burugumesitiri wa Kinigi.
Bamwe babona ubwicanyi bwa Bagogwe nk'intangiriro ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu 1994, Abatutsi benshi bo mu karere ka Bigogwe barishwe. Abazize Jenoside bo muri ako karere bashyinguwe mu Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bigogwe.

Ubwicanyi bwa Kibilira ni ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu Kwakira 1990. Bwabereye muri komini Kibilira, mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gisenyi. Bwabaye nyuma gato y'igitero cya FPR Inkotanyi cyo ku wa 1 Ukwakira 1990.
Abatutsi barenga 300 barishwe. Abayobozi b'ibanze ni bo bashishikarije Abahutu kwica abaturanyi babo b'Abatutsi. Ubu bwicanyi ni bumwe mu bwa mbere bwabanjirije Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Ku wa 1 Ukwakira 1990, FPR Inkotanyi yateye u Rwanda iturutse muri Ubugande. Abayobozi bakwirakwije ibinyoma bivuga ko Abatutsi bashaka kurimbura Abahutu. Ubwicanyi bwa mbere bwakorewe Abatutsi bwatangiye nyuma y'iminsi icumi.
Mu Kwakira 1990, abayobozi b'ibanze bashishikarije Abahutu gutera abaturanyi babo b'Abatutsi. Abatutsi barenga 300 barishwe. Abandi benshi barakomeretse.
Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi bahunze ingo zabo. Amazu amagana y'Abatutsi yarasahuwe kandi aratwikwa. Imyaka yabo yarangijwe. Amatungo yabo yarasahuwe.
Abayobozi bohereje abapolisi babiri kuvuza amafirimbi. Ibyo byonyine byahagaritse ubwicanyi.
Leta yirukanye superefe na burugumesitiri. Yabafunze hamwe n'abandi bakekwaga. Nyuma y'ibyumweru bike, bose bararekuwe nta rubanza. Burugumesitiri wa kera yahawe akazi gashya ka leta muri ako karere. Nta muntu wahamijwe icyaha kubera ubwo bwicanyi.
Hagati ya 1990 na 1993, ubwicanyi nk'ubu bwahitanye Abatutsi bagera ku 2 000. Bwahitanye kandi Abahutu bamwe. Human Rights Watch ibona ubu bwicanyi nk'imyitozo ya Jenoside yo mu 1994.

Ubwicanyi bwa Bugesera ni ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu Werurwe 1992. Bwabereye mu Bugesera, mu majyepfo ya Kigali. Bwakurikiye itangazo ry'ibinyoma ryanyuze kuri Radiyo Rwanda.
Abatutsi bagera kuri 300 barishwe. Abantu barenga 15 000 barahunze. Ubu bwicanyi ni bumwe mu bwabanjirije Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Abatutsi benshi bari batuye mu Bugesera kuva mu 1959. Abahutu bavuye mu majyaruguru y'uburengerazuba nabo baje gutura hafi yabo. Abayobozi b'ibanze bavugaga ko urubyiruko rw'Abatutsi rujya mu Uburundi kwinjira muri FPR. Ibyo byongereye urwango rw'Abahutu.
Mu mpera za Gashyantare no mu ntangiriro za Werurwe 1992, Hassan Ngeze yasuye Bugesera inshuro nyinshi. Ngeze yari umwanditsi mukuru w'ikinyamakuru Kangura. Yakwirakwije impapuro n'ibihuha ku bitero by'«Inyenzi».
Itangazo rya Radiyo Rwanda.
Ku wa 3 Werurwe 1992, Radiyo Rwanda yatangaje inkuru y'ibinyoma inshuro eshanu. Iyo nkuru yavugaga ko Abatutsi bari bagiye kwica Abahutu bo mu Bugesera. Yavugaga cyane abanyapolitiki b'Abahutu. Icyo gihe, Radiyo Rwanda yari iyobowe na Ferdinand Nahimana, umuyobozi wa ORINFOR. Umunyamakuru Jean-Baptiste Bamwanga yirukanywe kuri Radiyo Rwanda mu 1992. Yashinjwaga kugira uruhare mu gushishikariza ubwo bwicanyi.
Ubwicanyi bwatangiye mu ijoro rikurikira iryo tangazo. Bwabereye muri Kanzenze, Gashora na Ngenda. Bwamaze iminsi igera ku icumi.
Abayobozi b'ibanze ni bo bayoboye ibitero. Ku nshuro ya mbere, ubutegetsi bwakoresheje Interahamwe mu kwica Abatutsi. Burugumesitiri wa komini Kanzenze, Fidèle Rwambuka, avugwa nk'umwe mu bayoboye abicanyi. Abasirikare bambaye imyenda ya gisivili bifatanyije n'abicanyi. Abasirikare bambaye impuzankano bambuye Abatutsi intwaro. Babagumishije aho bari kugeza abicanyi bahageze.
Abicanyi batwitse amazu y'Abatutsi. Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi bahungiye kuri paruwasi gatolika ya Nyamata. Abantu barenga 15 000 bahungiye mu maparuwasi yo hafi no mu Burundi. Abayobozi ntibateye abari bahungiye mu nsengero. Ahubwo babakumiriye ibiryo n'amazi kugira ngo basubire iwabo.
Urupfu rwa Antonia Locatelli.
Antonia Locatelli yari umukorerabushake w'Umutaliyani. Yakoraga mu Rwanda kuva mu 1972. Yaterefonnye ambasaderi w'u Bubiligi, RFI na BBC. Yababwiye ibyaberaga mu Bugesera. Ku wa 9 Werurwe 1992, Locatelli yarashwe arapfa i Nyamata. Amnesty International ivuga ko yarashwe n'umusirikare. Locatelli ashyinguwe i Nyamata.
Amashyirahamwe y'abahohotewe yajyanye abadipolomate mu Bugesera kureba ibyabaye. Abahutu benshi bateye barafashwe. Nta cyakorewe umusirikare warashe Locatelli. Nta muntu wahamijwe icyaha kubera ubwo bwicanyi.
Human Rights Watch ibona ubwicanyi bwa Bugesera nk'imyitozo ya Jenoside yo mu 1994. Hagati ya 1990 na 1993, ubwicanyi nk'ubu bwahitanye Abatutsi bagera ku 2 000. Mu 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi biciwe muri kiliziya ya Nyamata. Uyu munsi iyo kiliziya ni Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyamata.

Ubwicanyi bw'Ishuri rya ETO ni ubwicanyi bwabaye ku wa 11 Mata 1994, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Bwabereye ku ishuri rya ETO ("École technique officielle") i Kicukiro, muri Kigali, no ku musozi wa Nyanza.
Abantu barenga 2 000 bari bahungiye kuri iryo shuri. Bari barinzwe n'ingabo z'Ababiligi za MINUAR. Izo ngabo zagiye ku wa 11 Mata 1994. Hafi ya bose bahise bicwa.
Ubuhungiro kuri ETO.
Jenoside imaze gutangira, abasivili barenga 2 000 bahungiye kuri ETO. Muri bo harimo abana amagana. Bari Abatutsi ahanini. Ingabo z'Ababiligi za MINUAR zari zifite ikigo kuri iryo shuri. Zari ziyobowe na Kapiteni Luc Lemaire.
Ku wa 7 Mata 1994, u Ububiligi bwafashe icyemezo cyo gucyura ingabo zabwo. Ku wa 11 Mata 1994, ingabo z'Ababiligi zavuye kuri ETO. Zagiye ku kibuga cy'indege gufasha mu gucyura abanyamahanga. Impunzi zasigaye nta wuzirinda.
Interahamwe n'abasirikare ba leta bahise batera ETO. Bishe abari aho. Abarokotse bagerageje guhunga. Abasirikare babafashe babasubiza Interahamwe. Bajyanywe ku ngufu i Nyanza. Benshi biciwe mu nzira. Abandi bicirwa i Nyanza n'imbunda na gerenade. Mu bantu barenga 2 000, abagera kuri 50 gusa ni bo barokotse.
Abarokotse n'imiryango y'abishwe bareze Leta y'u Bubiligi. Ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2010, urukiko rwa mbere rw'i Buruseli rwemeje ko icyemezo cyo kuva kuri ETO cyafashwe n'ubuyobozi bw'u Bubiligi. Ku wa 8 Kamena 2018, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwahinduye icyo cyemezo. Rwemeje ko inshingano ari iz'Umuryango w'Abibumbye. Leta y'u Bubiligi n'abasirikare batatu bagizwe abere.
Buri mwaka, ku wa 11 Mata, abantu bibuka abiciwe kuri ETO. Bakora urugendo rwo kwibuka kuva ku ishuri ryahoze ari ETO kugera ku Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyanza-Kicukiro. Urwo rwibutso ni ikimenyetso cy'abatereranywe n'abari bashinzwe kubarinda. Ishuri ryahoze ari ETO ubu ni IPRC Kicukiro.

Ubwicanyi bwa Ndera ni ubwicanyi bwabaye muri Mata 1994, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Bwabereye i Ndera, mu burasirazuba bwa Kigali, cyane cyane ku bitaro by'indwara zo mu mutwe bya Ndera (CARAES Ndera).
Abatutsi benshi bari bahungiye kuri ibyo bitaro. Biciwe hamwe n'abarwayi n'abakozi b'ibitaro. Abantu bagera ku 17 000 biciwe hafi y'ibitaro.
Ubuhungiro ku bitaro.
Jenoside yatangiye i Ndera ku wa 7 Mata 1994. Abatutsi bo mu nkengero bahungiye ku bitaro. Bibwiraga ko bazarindwa kuko hari Ababiligi. Ibyumba by'ibitaro byari byuzuye. Abarwayi bavanze n'impunzi.
Ku wa 17 Mata 1994, abasirikare b'Ababiligi bimuye abanyamahanga. Uwo munsi, abicanyi bateye ibitaro. Batangiye kurasa abantu. Abicanyi bari Interahamwe n'abasirikare ba leta. Abatutsi bagerageje kwirwanaho. Abasirikare bo mu kigo cya Kanombe baje gufasha Interahamwe.
Abicanyi bakusanyije abantu mu mbuga. Batandukanyije Abahutu n'Abatutsi. Umubare nyawo w'abarwayi bishwe ntuzwi. Impamvu ni uko abarwayi bari bavanze n'impunzi.
Abantu bagera ku 17 000 biciwe hafi y'ibitaro bya Ndera. Imibiri yabo yajugunywe mu cyobo kirekire cya metero 30.
Urwibutso no kwibuka.
I Ndera hari urwibutso rwa Jenoside. Rushyinguyemo abantu ibihumbi byinshi, barimo abarwayi n'impunzi. Imibiri y'abantu barenga 15 000 iracyari mu cyobo hafi y'ibitaro. Abarokotse basaba ko ishyingurwa mu cyubahiro. Ibitaro byatanze ubutaka bwo kwagura urwibutso.
Buri mwaka, ku wa 17 Mata, abantu bibuka abiciwe ku bitaro bya Ndera.

Bisesero ni imisozi iri mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda, mu Akarere ka Karongi. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi bahahungiye. Barwanyije abicanyi amezi menshi.
Abatutsi barenga 50 000 biciwe i Bisesero. Abagera ku 1 000 gusa ni bo barokotse. Uyu munsi hari Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero. Ruri ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Ubuhungiro n'ukwirwanaho.
Kuva ku wa 7 Mata 1994, Abatutsi bagera ku 50 000 bahungiye i Bisesero. Bavaga i Kibuye no mu maperefegitura yegeranye. Abicanyi bageze i Bisesero ku wa 11 Mata 1994.
Impunzi zirwanyeho ubwazo. Zatoye Aminadabu Birara ngo aziyobore. Birara yari afite imyaka 68. Abagabo barwanaga n'amacumu n'amabuye. Abagore n'abana babazaniraga amabuye n'amahiri.
Kuva ku wa 9 Mata kugeza ku wa 30 Kamena 1994, Bisesero yatewe hafi buri munsi. Abicanyi bari abajandarume, abapolisi ba komini ya Gishyita na Gisovu, abasivili bitwaje intwaro n'Interahamwe.
Ku wa 13 Gicurasi 1994, igitero kinini cyagabwe ku musozi wa Muyira. Abatutsi ibihumbi byinshi barishwe. Abantu bagera kuri 300 baguye mu buvumo bwa Nyakavumu. Abicanyi bacanye umuriro ku muryango w'ubwo buvumo. Aminadabu Birara yishwe ku wa 25 Kamena 1994. Muri icyo gitero, Abatutsi bagera ku 5 000 barishwe.
Ingabo z'u Bufaransa.
Mu mpera za Kamena 1994, ingabo z'Ubufaransa zageze mu Rwanda mu gikorwa cyiswe "Turquoise". Icyo gihe i Bisesero hari hasigaye Abatutsi bagera ku 1 000 gusa.
Ku wa 27 Kamena 1994, abasirikare b'Abafaransa babonye impunzi za Bisesero. Ntibahise bazitabara. Bazitabaye ku wa 30 Kamena 1994. Hagati aho, Abatutsi amagana bariciwe.
Abarokotse n'amashyirahamwe bareze abasirikare b'Abafaransa mu nkiko z'u Bufaransa. Babashinjaga ubufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside. Mu Kwakira 2023, abacamanza bafashe icyemezo cyo kudakurikirana urubanza. Urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris rwemeje icyo cyemezo mu Kuboza 2024. Ku wa 9 Nzeri 2026, Urukiko rusesa imanza narwo rwacyemeje.
Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwahamije abantu benshi ibyaha byakorewe i Bisesero. Alfred Musema yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu mu 2000. Clément Kayishema nawe yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Obed Ruzindana yakatiwe imyaka 25. Eliézer Niyitegeka yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu mu 2003.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Bisesero rwashyizweho mu 1997. Ahantu ruri hashobora kuba harimo imibiri y'abantu 50 000 kugeza kuri 60 000. Ku wa 20 Nzeri 2023, UNESCO yashyize urwibutso rwa Bisesero ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi. Yarushyizeho hamwe n'inzibutso za Nyamata, Murambi na Gisozi.

Ubwicanyi bwo muri Mutarama 1998 i Gisenyi ni igitero cyagabwe kuri bisi y'abakozi b'uruganda rwa Bralirwa. Cyabaye ku wa 19 Mutarama 1998, hafi y'umujyi wa Gisenyi, mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda.
Abantu bagera kuri 35 kugeza kuri 40 barishwe. Abandi benshi barakomeretse. Abishwe bari Abahutu n'Abatutsi.
Mu gitondo cyo ku wa 19 Mutarama 1998, bisi yari itwaye abakozi ba Bralirwa. Bajyaga ku kazi. Bisi yatezwe ku muhanda munini, muri komini Nyamyumba, hafi ya Gisenyi.
Abicanyi bategetse abakozi kwitandukanya bakurikije amoko. Abakozi batinze kubikora. Abicanyi bahise barasa abantu bose. Batwitse bisi, maze bahungira mu bihuru. Abishwe bari Abahutu n'Abatutsi.
Umubare w'abishwe uratandukanye bitewe n'inkomoko. The Irish Times yavuze abantu 35 bishwe n'abarenga 30 bakomeretse. Amnesty International yavuze abantu bagera kuri 40 bishwe, muri bisi yari itwaye abantu bagera kuri 80.
Abenshi mu bo Amnesty International yabajije bavuze ko igitero cyakozwe n'imitwe yitwaje intwaro irwanya Leta. The Irish Times yavuze ko abicanyi bari inyeshyamba z'Abahutu. The New Times ibita «abacengezi».
Ku wa 19 Mutarama 2023, abishwe muri icyo gitero bibutswe nyuma y'imyaka 25. Hari urukuta rwo kubibuka hafi y'Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gisenyi.

Ikigeragezo cya Butare Bane (mu Gifaransa: "procès des Quatre de Butare") ni urubanza rwabereye i Buruseli, mu Ububiligi, mu 2001. Abanyarwanda bane baburanishijwe ku byaha byakozwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, mu karere ka Butare.
Ni ubwa mbere inteko y'abaturage basanzwe ("jury") yo mu gihugu kimwe yaburanishije ibyaha by'intambara byakorewe mu kindi gihugu. Abaregwa bose uko ari bane bahamijwe ibyaha.
Abaregwa bari bane. Bose bari batuye mu Bubiligi.
Ababikira bombi baregwaga gutanga Abatutsi bari bahungiye ku kigo cy'ababikira cya Sovu. Babashyikirije Interahamwe. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko ababikira batanze lisansi. Iyo lisansi yakoreshejwe mu gutwika igaraji ryari ryihishemo abantu bagera kuri 500. Abatutsi bagera ku 7 000 bishwe i Sovu muri Mata na Gicurasi 1994.
Vincent Ntezimana na Alphonse Higaniro baregwaga gushishikariza no gutegura ubwicanyi bw'Abatutsi mu karere ka Butare. Abaregwa bose bahakanye ibyaha.
Urubanza rwatangiye ku wa 17 Mata 2001, imbere y'urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Buruseli. Rwamaze hafi ibyumweru umunani. Inteko yari igizwe n'abaturage 12. Ububiligi bwakoresheje itegeko ryo mu 1993. Iryo tegeko ryemerera inkiko z'Ububiligi kuburanisha ibyaha by'intambara aho byakorewe hose.
Ku wa 8 Kamena 2001, abaregwa bose bahamijwe ibyaha.

Augustin Bizimana (1954 – Kanama 2000) yari umunyapolitiki w'u Rwanda. Yari Minisitiri w'Ingabo mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Mu 1998, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamureze ibyaha 13, birimo jenoside. Bizimana ntiyigeze afatwa. Mu 2020, byemejwe ko yapfiriye i Pointe-Noire, muri Repubulika ya Kongo.
Augustin Bizimana yavutse mu 1954. Yavukiye muri komine Gituza, muri perefegitura ya Byumba.
Ku ya 18 Nyakanga 1993, Bizimana yabaye Minisitiri w'Ingabo. Iyo guverinoma yari iya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana. Ku ya 6 Mata 1994, indege ya Habyarimana yarahanuwe. Icyo gihe Bizimana yari mu mahanga. Yagarutse mu Rwanda nyuma y'iminsi mike.
Bizimana yakomeje kuba Minisitiri w'Ingabo muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho. Iyo guverinoma ni yo yari ku butegetsi mu gihe cya Jenoside. Muri Nyakanga 1994, Bizimana yahunze u Rwanda.
Mu 1998, ICTR yareze Bizimana ibyaha 13. Muri ibyo byaha harimo jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside, ubwicanyi, gufata ku ngufu n'iyicarubozo. Yarezwe kuba nyirabayazana w'iyicwa rya Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana. Yarezwe kandi iyicwa ry'abasirikare 10 b'Ababiligi bo muri MINUAR. Yarezwe no kwica Abatutsi b'abasivili muri perefegitura za Gisenyi, Ruhengeri, Butare, Kibuye na Cyangugu.
Bizimana ntiyigeze afatwa. Ntiyigeze kandi aburanishwa.
Ku ya 22 Gicurasi 2020, umushinjacyaha Serge Brammertz yemeje ko Bizimana yapfuye. Ibisigazwa bye byabonetse mu mva i Pointe-Noire, muri Repubulika ya Kongo. Byamenyekanye hakoreshejwe isuzuma rya ADN. Bizimana yapfuye muri Kanama 2000.

Jean-Claude Lafourcade (yavutse mu 1943) ni jenerali w'Umufaransa uri mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru. Yayoboye igikorwa cya gisirikare cy'u Bufaransa cyiswe "Turquoise" mu Rwanda, mu 1994.
Lafourcade yahakanye ko ingabo z'u Bufaransa zafatanyije n'abakoze Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yumviswe n'ubutabera bw'u Bufaransa mu iperereza ku byabereye i Bisesero.
Lafourcade ni jenerali wo mu rwego rwa "général de corps d'armée". Ubu ari mu kiruhuko cy'izabukuru.
Lafourcade yayoboye igikorwa "Turquoise" kuva ku wa 22 Kamena kugeza ku wa 21 Kanama 1994. Mu 2010, yasohoye igitabo "Opération Turquoise". Muri icyo gitabo, avuga uko abona icyo gikorwa.
Lafourcade avuga ko kuvuga ko ingabo z'u Bufaransa zafatanyije n'abakoze Jenoside ari «umugani». Yemera ariko ko hari ubufatanye bwa gisirikare ("fraternité d'armes") hagati y'ingabo z'u Bufaransa n'ingabo zakoze Jenoside.
Abarokotse ba Bisesero n'amashyirahamwe bareze abasirikare b'Abafaransa. Babashinjaga gutererana Abatutsi i Bisesero hagati ya 27 na 30 Kamena 1994. Mu Mutarama 2016, Lafourcade yumviswe n'umucamanza nk'umutangabuhamya ufashijwe ("témoin assisté").
Lafourcade yavuze ko ingabo ze zari nke. Zari abasirikare bagera ku 120 cyangwa 130. Yavuze ko ababajwe n'Abatutsi bishwe mu minsi ibiri yakurikiyeho.
Mu Kwakira 2023, abacamanza bafashe icyemezo cyo kudakurikirana abasirikare. Ku wa 9 Nzeri 2026, Urukiko rusesa imanza rwemeje icyo cyemezo. Urwo rukiko rwavuze ko hari ugushidikanya ku byo Lafourcade yari azi icyo gihe.

Laurent Bucyibaruta (1944 – 6 Ukuboza 2023) yari umuyobozi w'u Rwanda. Yari perefe wa perefegitura ya Gikongoro mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Bucyibaruta yabaga mu Ubufaransa. Ku ya 12 Nyakanga 2022, urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Paris rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 20. Yahamijwe ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Yajuriye. Yapfuye mu 2023 mbere y'urubanza rw'ubujurire.
Laurent Bucyibaruta yavutse mu 1944. Yavukiye muri perefegitura ya Gikongoro.
Ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1992, Bucyibaruta yabaye perefe wa Gikongoro. Yagumye kuri uwo mwanya kugeza muri Nyakanga 1994. Muri Jenoside, Abatutsi benshi biciwe muri Gikongoro. Ubwicanyi bukomeye bwabereye i Murambi, i Cyanika n'i Kaduha. Muri ubwo bwicanyi hapfuye abantu bagera ku 75 000.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Bucyibaruta yahungiye mu Bufaransa. Yabaga i Saint-André-les-Vergers, hafi ya Troyes.
Mu 2005, ICTR yamureze jenoside. Mu 2007, Ubufaransa bwaramufashe. Ariko urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris rwamurekuye. Muri uwo mwaka, ICTR yahaye urubanza ubutabera bw'u Bufaransa.
Urubanza rwe rwatangiye i Paris ku ya 9 Gicurasi 2022. Ku ya 12 Nyakanga 2022, urukiko rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 20. Rwamuhamije ubufatanyacyaha mu bwicanyi bwabereye i Murambi, i Cyanika n'i Kaduha. Rwamuhamije kandi ubufatanyacyaha mu iyicwa ry'abanyeshuri b'ishuri rya Marie Merci i Kibeho. Ariko urukiko rwamugize umwere ku bwicanyi bwabereye kuri paruwasi ya Kibeho ku ya 14 Mata 1994.
Bucyibaruta yajuriye. Yarekuwe ategereje urubanza rushya. Yapfuye ku ya 6 Ukuboza 2023, afite imyaka 79. Kubera iyo mpamvu, urubanza rw'ubujurire ntirwabaye.

Jean-Baptiste Gatete ni umunyapolitiki w'u Rwanda. Yabaye burugumesitiri wa komine Murambi. Nyuma yaho, yabaye umuyobozi muri Minisiteri y'Umuryango n'Iterambere ry'Umugore.
Mu 2011, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije icyaha cya jenoside. Rwamuhamije kandi icyaha cyo kurimbura abantu. Mu 2012, igihano cye cyagizwe imyaka 40 y'igifungo.
Gatete yize ubuhinzi. Ni injeniyeri mu by'ubuhinzi.
Kuva mu 1987 kugeza muri Kamena 1993, Gatete yari burugumesitiri wa komine Murambi. Iyo komine yari mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Mu 1993, yavanywe kuri uwo mwanya. Yashinjwaga gutoteza Abatutsi. Nyuma yaho, yabaye umuyobozi muri Minisiteri y'Umuryango n'Iterambere ry'Umugore.
Muri Jenoside, Gatete yategetse Interahamwe, abasirikare n'abapolisi kwica Abatutsi. Ibyo byabereye mu murenge wa Rwankuba. Yategetse kandi igitero ku mpunzi z'Abatutsi kuri paruwasi ya Kiziguro. Yafashije n'igitero cyagabwe kuri paruwasi ya Mukarange.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Gatete yahungiye muri Repubulika ya Kongo. Yabagayo akoresha irindi zina. Muri Nzeri 2002, yafatiwe muri Kongo. Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2002, yajyanywe i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya.
Urubanza rwe rwatangiye ku ya 20 Ukwakira 2009. Ku ya 29 Werurwe 2011, ICTR yamuhamije jenoside no kurimbura abantu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu.
Ku ya 9 Ukwakira 2012, urugereko rw'ubujurire rwemeje ibyo byaha. Rwamuhamije kandi umugambi wo gukora jenoside. Ariko igihano cye cyagizwe imyaka 40 y'igifungo. Impamvu ni uko urubanza rwe rwatinze cyane.

Jean-Christophe Klotz (yavutse ku wa 14 Mata 1962) ni umunyamakuru akaba n'umukozi wa filime w'Umufaransa. Yari mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Yarakomeretse i Kigali.
Klotz yakoze filime nyinshi ku Rwanda no kuri Jenoside. Izizwi cyane ni "Kigali, des images contre un massacre" (2006) na "Retour à Kigali, une affaire française" (2019).
Klotz yize mu kigo cyigisha itangazamakuru cy'i Paris ("Centre de formation des journalistes").
Klotz yamaze imyaka myinshi ari umunyamakuru w'intambara. Yakoreraga cyane ikigo cya CAPA. Yageze mu Rwanda bwa mbere mu 1994.
Mu 1994, Klotz yari i Kigali afata amashusho. Abicanyi bateye paruwasi gatolika yari yihishemo abana b'Abatutsi. Klotz yarashwe isasu mu kibuno. Bamujyanye ku bitaro. Yasabye ko abo bana barindwa. Nyuma y'iminsi ibiri, abana barishwe.
Nyuma y'imyaka icumi, Klotz yasubiye i Kigali. Yashakaga abarokotse n'abantu yari yarahuye na bo. Yabonye abarokotse batarenze batanu. Ibyo yabibonye byavuyemo filime "Kigali, des images contre un massacre". Iyo filime yerekanywe mu 2006 mu iserukiramuco rya Cannes. Ubunararibonye bwe mu Rwanda bwanatumye akora filime "Lignes de front" (2009).
Mu 2019, Klotz yakoze filime "Retour à Kigali, une affaire française". Iyo filime ivuga ku ruhare rw'u Bufaransa muri Jenoside. Yanyuze kuri France 3 ku wa 25 Mata 2019.

Agathe Habyarimana (yavutse ari Agathe Kanziga mu 1942) ni umufasha wa Juvénal Habyarimana, wahoze ari Perezida w'u Rwanda. Yari umufasha wa Perezida kugeza mu 1994.
Agathe Habyarimana aba mu Ubufaransa kuva mu 1994. Imiryango myinshi imushinja kuba umwe mu bayobozi b'akazu. Kuva mu 2007, ubutabera bw'u Bufaransa bumukoraho iperereza ku bufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. We arabihakana. Ntiyigeze aregwa ku mugaragaro.
Agathe Kanziga yavutse mu 1942. Yavukiye i Karago, muri perefegitura ya Gisenyi.
Umufasha wa Perezida.
Agathe Kanziga yashakanye na Juvénal Habyarimana. Habyarimana yabaye Perezida w'u Rwanda kuva mu 1973 kugeza mu 1994. Inkuru nyinshi zivuga ko Agathe Habyarimana yari afite ububasha bukomeye mu gihugu. Avugwa nk'umwe mu bayobozi b'akazu. Akazu kari agatsiko k'abasivili n'abasirikare bari hafi y'ubutegetsi.
Ku ya 6 Mata 1994, indege ya Perezida Habyarimana yarahanuwe. Perezida yaguye muri icyo gitero. Ku ya 9 Mata 1994, abasirikare b'Abafaransa bavanye Agathe Habyarimana mu Rwanda. Yageze i Paris ku ya 17 Mata 1994.
Mu 2004, Agathe Habyarimana yasabye ubuhungiro mu Bufaransa. Mu 2007, ubusabe bwe bwaranzwe. Urukiko rwavuze ko hari impamvu zikomeye zo gukeka ko yagize uruhare muri Jenoside. Mu 2009, Inama y'Igihugu y'Ubutegetsi (Conseil d'État) yemeje icyo cyemezo.
Mu Ugushyingo 2007, ubutabera bw'u Bufaransa bwatangiye iperereza. Ryatangijwe n'ikirego cy'Ishyirahamwe ry'abaregera indishyi ku Rwanda (CPCR). Mu Ukwakira 2009, u Rwanda rwatanze impapuro zo kumuta muri yombi. Ku ya 2 Werurwe 2010, Agathe Habyarimana yafatiwe mu Bufaransa. Nyuma y'igihe gito, yararekuwe. Ku ya 28 Nzeri 2011, urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris rwanze kumwohereza mu Rwanda.
Mu 2016, Agathe Habyarimana yahawe sitati ya «témoin assisté». Ntiyigeze aregwa ku mugaragaro. Muri Kanama 2025, abacamanza b'iperereza bafashe icyemezo cyo guhagarika ikurikiranwa (non-lieu). Bavuze ko nta bimenyetso bihagije bihari.
Ku ya 6 Gicurasi 2026, urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris rwakuyeho icyo cyemezo. Rwasabye ko iperereza rikomeza. Agathe Habyarimana yajuririye mu Rukiko rusesa imanza (Cour de cassation).

Philippe Hategekimana (yavutse mu 1956) ni umujandarume w'u Rwanda. Yitwaga «Biguma». Mu Bufaransa yitwa Philippe Manier.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, Hategekimana yakoraga muri jandarumori ya Nyanza. Mu 2023, urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Paris rwamuhamije jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Icyo gihano cyemejwe mu bujurire mu 2024.
Philippe Hategekimana yavutse mu 1956.
Hategekimana yari adjudant-chef muri jandarumori ya Nyanza. Nyanza yari muri perefegitura ya Butare.
Muri Jenoside, yategetse ko hashyirwaho za bariyeri. Kuri izo bariyeri hicirwaga Abatutsi. Yagize uruhare runini mu iyicwa rya burugumesitiri wa komine Ntyazo. Uwo burugumesitiri yarwanyaga Jenoside. Yagize uruhare kandi mu bwicanyi bwabereye ku misozi ya Nyabubare na Nyamure.
Mu 1999, Hategekimana yahungiye mu Ubufaransa. Yahawe sitati y'impunzi. Mu 2005, yabonye ubwenegihugu bw'u Bufaransa. Yahinduye izina yitwa Philippe Manier.
Mu 2017, Hategekimana yahungiye muri Kameruni. Muri Mata 2018, yafatiwe i Yaoundé. Kameruni yamwohereje mu Bufaransa.
Urubanza rwe rwatangiye i Paris ku ya 10 Gicurasi 2023. Ku ya 28 Kamena 2023, urukiko rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Rwamuhamije jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu.
Hategekimana yajuriye. Urubanza rw'ubujurire rwabaye kuva ku ya 4 Ugushyingo kugeza ku ya 17 Ukuboza 2024. Ku ya 17 Ukuboza 2024, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje igifungo cya burundu. Abavoka be batangaje ko bazajya mu Rukiko rusesa imanza (Cour de cassation).

Ibuka ni umuryango uhuriza hamwe amashyirahamwe y'abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Washinzwe mu 1995 mu Rwanda. Izina «Ibuka» risobanura «wibuke».
Ibuka iharanira uburenganzira bw'abarokotse, ubutabera ku bazize Jenoside no kubungabunga urwibutso rwayo. Hari kandi amashyirahamwe yitwa Ibuka mu bihugu byo hanze, nk'Ububiligi n'Ubufaransa.
Ibuka yashinzwe mu 1995, nyuma y'umwaka umwe Jenoside irangiye. Ni umwe mu miryango ya mbere ihuriza hamwe amashyirahamwe y'abarokotse. Mu ntangiriro, Ibuka yafashaga abarokotse batagira aho baba, abakennye n'abafite ihungabana.
Ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2024, amashyirahamwe atatu y'abarokotse yemeje kwihuza. Ayo mashyirahamwe ni Ibuka, AERG na GAERG-Aheza. Bose bahurijwe mu muryango umwe witwa Ibuka. Philbert Gakwenzire, wari usanzwe ayobora Ibuka, yatorewe kuyobora uwo muryango mushya. Mu Gushyingo 2025, Ibuka yizihije imyaka 30 imaze ishinzwe.
Ibuka iharanira uburenganzira bw'abarokotse. Iharanira kandi ubutabera ku bazize Jenoside. Yashyigikiye inkiko Gacaca. Yifuzaga ko abarokotse bumvwa kandi ko abakoze Jenoside babiryozwa.
Ibuka ikora kandi ku nzibutso za Jenoside, ku burezi no ku bikorwa byo Kwibuka.
Mu bihugu byinshi, abarokotse n'inshuti zabo bashinze amashyirahamwe yitwa Ibuka. Urugero ni Ibuka – Mémoire et Justice mu Bubiligi. Uwo muryango uhagarariye abarokotse benshi baba mu Bubiligi. Ibuka France yo mu Bufaransa iharanira kwibuka, ubutabera no gufasha abarokotse. Irwanya kandi guhakana Jenoside.

Edouard Karemera (1951 – 31 Kanama 2020) yari umunyapolitiki w'u Rwanda. Mu 1994, yari Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Imbere mu Gihugu muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho. Yari kandi Visi-Perezida wa mbere w'ishyaka MRND.
Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije jenoside. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Yapfiriye muri gereza muri Senegali mu 2020.
Edouard Karemera yavutse mu 1951.
Mu 1994, Karemera yari Visi-Perezida wa mbere w'ishyaka MRND. Nyuma y'urupfu rwa Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana, yabaye Minisitiri w'Umutekano w'Imbere mu Gihugu. Yari muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho ya Jean Kambanda.
Karemera yaburanishijwe na ICTR hamwe na Mathieu Ngirumpatse, Perezida wa MRND. Mu 2011, ICTR yamuhamije jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Muri ibyo byaha harimo umugambi wo gukora jenoside, gushishikariza abantu gukora jenoside, gufata ku ngufu no kurimbura abantu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu.
Karemera yajuriye. Ku ya 29 Nzeri 2014, urugereko rw'ubujurire rwemeje igifungo cya burundu.
Mu 2017, Karemera yavanywe i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya. Yajyanywe muri gereza ya Sebikotane, hafi ya Dakar, muri Senegali. Yapfiriye muri iyo gereza ku ya 31 Kanama 2020. Yari afite imyaka 69.

Komisiyo y'Igihugu ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside (mu Gifaransa: "Commission nationale de lutte contre le génocide", CNLG) yari urwego rwa Leta y'u Rwanda. Yashinzwe mu 2007. Yari ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside n'ingengabitekerezo yayo.
Mu 2021, CNLG yavanyweho. Inshingano zayo zahawe Minisiteri y'Ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda n'Inshingano Mboneragihugu (MINUBUMWE).
CNLG yashyizweho n'itegeko No 09/2007 ryo ku wa 16 Gashyantare 2007. Iryo tegeko rivuga ko CNLG ari urwego rw'igihugu, rwigenga kandi ruhoraho.
Kuva muri Kamena 2015, CNLG yayobowe na Jean Damascène Bizimana nk'Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa. Yasimbuye Jean de Dieu Mucyo witabye Imana.
CNLG yari ishinzwe kwita ku mibereho myiza n'ihungabana ry'abarokotse. Yabikoraga ifatanyije na Minisiteri y'Ubuzima n'Ikigega gitera inkunga abarokotse (FARG). Yari ishinzwe kandi kubika inyandiko z'inkiko Gacaca. Yasabiraga abarokotse ubufasha n'indishyi.
Mu 2020, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yatangiye gusuzuma itegeko rishya. Iryo tegeko ryashakaga gukura kuri CNLG zimwe mu nshingano zayo. Minisiteri y'Ubuzima yari guhabwa ibijyanye n'ihungabana. FARG yari guhabwa ibijyanye n'inkunga y'abarokotse.
Ku wa 21 Nzeri 2021, Inama y'Abaminisitiri yemeje imishinga y'amategeko ivanaho CNLG. Yavanyeho kandi Komisiyo y'Ubumwe n'Ubwiyunge, Komisiyo y'Itorero ry'Igihugu na FARG. Inshingano zabyo zahawe Minisiteri nshya y'Ubumwe bw'Abanyarwanda n'Inshingano Mboneragihugu (MINUBUMWE). Jean Damascène Bizimana yagizwe Minisitiri w'iyo minisiteri muri Kanama 2021.

Clément Kayishema (1954 – 2016) yari muganga n'umuyobozi w'u Rwanda. Yari perefe wa perefegitura ya Kibuye mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994.
Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije icyaha cya jenoside. Mu 1999, rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Icyo gihano cyemejwe mu bujurire mu 2001. Kayishema yapfiriye muri gereza mu 2016.
Clément Kayishema yavutse mu 1954. Yavukiye muri komine Gitesi, muri perefegitura ya Kibuye. Yari muganga ku bitaro bya Kibuye.
Mu 1992, Kayishema yagizwe perefe wa Kibuye. Muri Jenoside, Abatutsi benshi biciwe muri perefegitura ya Kibuye. Kayishema yagize uruhare mu bwicanyi bwabereye i Bisesero.
Kayishema yafatiwe muri Zambiya. Ku ya 26 Gicurasi 1996, yajyanywe i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya. Yaburanishijwe na ICTR hamwe n'umucuruzi Obed Ruzindana.
Ku ya 21 Gicurasi 1999, ICTR yamuhamije jenoside. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Ruzindana yakatiwe imyaka 25 y'igifungo. Ku ya 1 Kamena 2001, urugereko rw'ubujurire rwemeje icyo gihano.
Kayishema yapfiriye muri gereza mu 2016.

Maria Kisito ni izina ry'ububikira rya Julienne Mukabutera. Ni umubikira w'Umunyarwandakazi. Mu 1994, yabaga mu kigo cy'ababikira b'Ababenedigitine cya Sovu, hafi ya Butare.
Mu 2001, urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Buruseli rwamuhamije uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 12. Mu 2007, yarekuwe ategekwa kuguma mu kigo cy'ababikira mu Ububiligi.
Julienne Mukabutera ni Umunyarwandakazi. Yinjiye mu babikira b'Ababenedigitine. Yafashe izina rya Maria Kisito.
Muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi benshi bahungiye mu kigo cy'ababikira cya Sovu. Uwari ukuriye ikigo yari Consolata Mukangango, wiswe Gertrude. Maria Kisito na Gertrude barezwe gutanga izo mpunzi ku nterahamwe. Impunzi ibihumbi zariciwe.
Maria Kisito na Gertrude bahungiye mu Bubiligi. Bombi baburanishijwe n'urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Buruseli hamwe n'abandi Banyarwanda babiri. Uru rubanza rwiswe «urubanza rw'abantu bane b'i Butare». Ku ya 8 Kamena 2001, Maria Kisito yakatiwe igifungo cy'imyaka 12. Gertrude yakatiwe imyaka 15. Mu 2002, Urukiko rusesa imanza rw'u Bubiligi rwanze ubujurire bwabo.
Maria Kisito yafungiwe i Namur. Muri Kamena 2007, urukiko rw'i Mons rwemeye ko afungurwa. Yategetswe kuguma mu kigo cy'ababikira cya Maredret.

Ihuriro ry'abarenganyijwe bo mu Rwanda (mu Gifaransa: "Collectif des parties civiles pour le Rwanda", CPCR) ni ishyirahamwe ryo mu Bufaransa. Rigamije kugeza imbere y'inkiko z'u Bufaransa abakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994 bahungiye mu Bufaransa.
CPCR yashinzwe mu 2001 na Alain Gauthier n'umugore we Dafroza Gauthier. Ni yo iri inyuma y'ibirego hafi ya byose byatanzwe mu Bufaransa ku Banyarwanda bakekwaho Jenoside.
CPCR yashinzwe mu Gushyingo 2001. Yashinzwe na Alain Gauthier na Dafroza Gauthier. Icyicaro cyayo kiri iwabo i Reims. Intego yayo ni uguca umuco wo kudahana abakoze Jenoside baba mu Bufaransa.
Alain na Dafroza Gauthier bamaze imyaka igera kuri 30 bazenguruka imisozi y'u Rwanda. Bakusanyaga ubuhamya. Dafroza Gauthier yapfuye mu Kwakira 2026 i Reims, afite imyaka 72.
CPCR itanga ibirego mu nkiko ku bakekwaho Jenoside baba mu Bufaransa. Ifasha kandi abarokotse. Hagati ya 2001 na 2019, yatanze ibirego bigera kuri 35. Kuva mu 2019, ubushinjacyaha bw'i Paris na bwo bwatangiye gukurikirana amadosiye. CPCR iyaregamo nk'uruhande rw'abaregera indishyi.
Mu 2014, Pascal Simbikangwa yakatiwe imyaka 25 y'igifungo. Bwari ubwa mbere umuntu akatirwa icyaha cya Jenoside mu Bufaransa.
Kugeza mu 2024, imanza esheshatu zari zimaze kuba. Abantu barindwi bari bamaze guhamwa n'ibyaha. Muri bo harimo Philippe Hategekimana wakatiwe igifungo cya burundu, na Sosthène Munyemana. Laurent Bucyibaruta na we yahamijwe ibyaha. Yapfuye mu Kuboza 2023, mbere y'urubanza rw'ubujurire.

Protais Mpiranya (yapfuye ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2006) yari umusirikare w'u Rwanda. Yari afite ipeti rya majoro. Mu 1994, yayoboraga batayo y'ingabo zirinda Perezida.
Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamureze jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Mpiranya ntiyigeze afatwa. Mu 2022, byemejwe ko yapfiriye i Harare, muri Zimbabwe, mu 2006.
Mu 1991, Mpiranya yimuriwe muri batayo y'ingabo zirinda Perezida. Mu 1993, yagizwe umuyobozi w'iyo batayo. Yayiyoboye kugeza muri Nyakanga 1994.
Ku ya 28 Mutarama 2000, ICTR yemeje ikirego cya mbere kuri Mpiranya. Yarezwe jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside, ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu n'ibyaha by'intambara. Ibyo byaha byakozwe mu Rwanda hagati ya 6 Mata na 17 Nyakanga 1994.
Abasirikare be barezwe kwica Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana. Barezwe kandi kwica abanyapolitiki benshi. Muri bo harimo Joseph Kavaruganda, Perezida w'Urukiko rurinda Itegeko Nshinga. Harimo kandi abaminisitiri Frédéric Nzamurambaho na Faustin Rucogoza. Mpiranya yarezwe kandi iyicwa ry'abasirikare 10 b'Ababiligi bo muri MINUAR.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Mpiranya yarahunze. Nyuma yaho, yoherejwe muri Zimbabwe gukorera umutwe wa FDLR. Mpiranya ntiyigeze afatwa.
Ku ya 12 Gicurasi 2022, ubushinjacyaha bw'Urwego mpuzamahanga (IRMCT) bwemeje ko Mpiranya yapfuye. Ibisigazwa bye byabonetse muri Zimbabwe. Yapfiriye i Harare ku ya 5 Ukwakira 2006. Ku ya 14 Nzeri 2022, umucamanza yahagaritse urubanza rwe.

Claude Muhayimana (yavutse mu 1961) ni Umufaransa ukomoka mu Rwanda. Mu 1994, yari umushoferi wa hoteli i Kibuye.
Mu 2021, urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Paris rwamuhamije ubufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 14. Ku ya 27 Gashyantare 2026, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje icyo gihano.
Claude Muhayimana yavutse mu 1961. Yavukiye i Kibuye, mu burengerazuba bw'u Rwanda.
Mu 1994, Muhayimana yari umushoferi wa hoteli i Kibuye. Muri Jenoside, yatwaye abajandarume n'Interahamwe. Yabajyanaga aho Abatutsi bicirwaga, harimo i Bisesero.
Muhayimana yahungiye mu Ubufaransa mu 2001. Mu 2010, yabonye ubwenegihugu bw'u Bufaransa. Yaba kandi agakorera i Rouen.
Mu 2021, urukiko rwa rubanda rw'i Paris rwamuhamije ubufatanyacyaha muri jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwamukatiye igifungo cy'imyaka 14. Yajuriye, kandi akomeza kuba hanze ya gereza.
Urubanza rw'ubujurire rwabereye i Paris muri Gashyantare 2026. Ku ya 27 Gashyantare 2026, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje igifungo cy'imyaka 14. Abavoka be bavuze ko bashobora kujya mu Rukiko rusesa imanza (Cour de cassation).

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kinazi ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri mu Murenge wa Kinazi, mu Akarere ka Ruhango, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo.
Urwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri y'abantu bagera ku 60 000. Abo bantu biciwe mu cyahoze ari komini Ntongwe, mu Mayaga.
Urwibutso rwa Kinazi ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside, Abatutsi bo mu karere bahungiye ahantu henshi. Ibihumbi byinshi muri bo biciwe aho bari bahungiye. Abicanyi bari Interahamwe. Bayoborwaga na burugumesitiri wa komini Ntongwe, Charles Kagabo.
Impunzi z'Abarundi zo mu nkambi ya Nyagahama na zo zagize uruhare mu bwicanyi. Abayobozi b'ibanze babahaye amafaranga n'ibindi bihembo. Iyo nkambi yari ku musozi witegeye ibiro bya komini Ntongwe. Ubu aho hari ibitaro bya Kinazi. Abarundi bagize uruhare muri ubwo bwicanyi basubiye iwabo. Nta n'umwe wakurikiranywe n'ubutabera.
Umuyobozi w'Interahamwe, Jacques Nsabimana, yacukuje icyobo. Yavugaga ko ari icy'inyubako y'abanyeshuri. Nyamara icyo cyobo cyajugunywemo imibiri y'Abatutsi.
Ku wa 19 Mata 2014, imibiri y'abantu bagera ku 60 000 yashyinguwe mu rwibutso rushya rwa Kinazi. Iyo mibiri yari yakuwe mu mva rusange y'i Rutabo.
Ku wa 26 Mata 2026, indi mibiri 35 yashyinguwe mu rwibutso rwa Kinazi. Muri icyo gihe, hari inzu ndangamurage yubakwaga kuri urwo rwibutso. Izaba irimo icyumba cyitwa «Chambre noire». Icyo cyumba kizagaragaza abateguye Jenoside.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Murugo Mutagatifu Jean (mu Gifaransa: "Home Saint Jean") ni urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ruri i Kibuye, mu Umurenge wa Bwishyura, mu Akarere ka Karongi. Ruri ku nkombe y'Ikiyaga cya Kivu.
Urwo rwibutso rwibuka Abatutsi biciwe muri kiliziya gatolika ya Kibuye no mu nzu ya Murugo Mutagatifu Jean, ku wa 17 Mata 1994.
Urwibutso rwa Murugo Mutagatifu Jean ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Mu ntangiriro za Jenoside, Abatutsi benshi bahungiye kuri kiliziya gatolika ya Kibuye no kuri Murugo Mutagatifu Jean. Kiliziya ikikijwe n'Ikiyaga cya Kivu ku mpande eshatu.
Ku wa 17 Mata 1994, abicanyi bateye impunzi. Abicanyi bari abajandarume, abapolisi ba komini ya Gitesi, Interahamwe n'abasivili bitwaje intwaro. Bakoresheje imbunda, gerenade, imipanga, amacumu n'amahiri. Abenshi mu bishwe bari Abatutsi. KT Press ivuga ko abantu barenga 11 000 biciwe muri kiliziya. Icyo gihe perefe wa Kibuye yari Clément Kayishema.
Iperereza n'ubutabera.
Hagati y'Ukuboza 1995 na Gashyantare 1996, impuguke zataburuye imva rusange imwe kuri iyo ngo. Basanzemo imibiri y'abantu benshi. Abagera kuri 70 % bari abagore n'abana. Abenshi bishwe bakubiswe ibintu biremereye. Ibyo bimenyetso byatanzwe imbere y'Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) mu rubanza rwa Clément Kayishema na Obed Ruzindana.

Angeline Mukandutiye (yavutse mu 1951) ni Umunyarwandakazi. Mu 1994, yari umugenzuzi w'amashuri abanza muri komine Nyarugenge, i Kigali.
Inkiko Gacaca zamuhamije uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Zamukatiye igifungo cya burundu adahari. Yamaze imyaka 25 muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mu Ukuboza 2019, yagarutse mu Rwanda arafatwa.
Angeline Mukandutiye yavutse mu 1951. Yavukiye i Gisenyi, mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda.
Mu 1994, Mukandutiye yari umugenzuzi w'amashuri abanza muri komine Nyarugenge, i Kigali. Yari umurwanashyaka w'ishyaka MRND.
Muri Jenoside, Mukandutiye yashinjwe kuyobora Interahamwe mu murenge wa Rugenge. Yashinjwe kujya kenshi kuri kiliziya ya Sainte-Famille. Yahatoranyaga abagabo n'abahungu b'Abatutsi bicwaga nyuma. Abarokotse bavuga kandi ko inzu ye yari ihuriro ry'Interahamwe.
Muri Nyakanga 1994, Mukandutiye yahungiye muri Kongo. Yabanje kuba mu nkambi ya Katale. Nyuma yaho, yabanye n'umutwe w'inyeshyamba z'Abanyarwanda mu mashyamba ya Kongo. Yahamaze imyaka 25.
Ku ya 23 Ugushyingo 2008, Inkiko Gacaca zamuburanishije adahari. Zamukatiye igifungo cya burundu.
Mu Ukuboza 2019, Mukandutiye yagaruwe mu Rwanda hamwe n'abandi bantu benshi bavuye muri Kongo. Yageze mu nkambi ya Nyarushishi, mu Akarere ka Rusizi. Abarokotse baramumenye. Polisi yaramufashe. Yafungiwe muri Gereza ya Mageragere.
Mu 2021, Mukandutiye yari mu baregwaga mu rubanza rwa MRCD-FLN, hamwe na Paul Rusesabagina. Ni we mugore wenyine wari muri urwo rubanza.

Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Nyange ruri mu Umurenge wa Nyange, mu Akarere ka Ngororero. Rwibuka Abatutsi biciwe muri kiliziya ya Nyange muri Mata 1994, mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Rwibuka kandi abanyeshuri b'Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange bishwe ku wa 18 Werurwe 1997. Abo banyeshuri banze kwitandukanya bakurikije amoko. Ubu ni intwari z'igihugu.
Urwibutso rwa Nyange ni rumwe mu nzibutso za Jenoside ziri hirya no hino mu gihugu, zifite uruhare rwo gushyingura mu cyubahiro, kwibuka no kubika amateka.
Ubwicanyi bwo muri kiliziya ya Nyange.
Muri Mata 1994, Abatutsi ibihumbi bahungiye muri kiliziya gatolika ya Nyange. Bibwiraga ko bazaharindirwa. Ahagana ku wa 12 Mata 1994, kiliziya yasenywe n'imashini ("bulldozer"). Abari bayirimo bose barapfuye. Umuryango w'Abibumbye uvuga ko bari abantu bagera ku 1 500 cyangwa 2 000.
Padiri Athanase Seromba ni we wabwiraga umushoferi w'imashini igihe cyo gutangira gusenya kiliziya. Yamweretse n'aho kiliziya yari idakomeye. Mu 2006, Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda rwamukatiye imyaka 15 y'igifungo. Ku wa 12 Werurwe 2008, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu.
Abanyeshuri b'i Nyange.
Ku wa 18 Werurwe 1997, nijoro, abacengezi bateye Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange. Bategetse abanyeshuri kwitandukanya, Abahutu ukwabo n'Abatutsi ukwabo. Abanyeshuri barabyanze. Bavuze bati «Twese turi Abanyarwanda». Abacengezi bahise babatera gerenade kandi barabarasa. Abanyeshuri batandatu n'umuzamu barapfuye.
Abanyeshuri batandatu biciwe muri icyo gitero ni aba:
Ferdinand Niyongira yapfuye muri Nyakanga 2001, azize ibikomere yatewe n'icyo gitero.
Ku wa 12 Nzeri 2001, abanyeshuri 47 b'i Nyange bashyizwe mu ntwari z'igihugu mu cyiciro cy'«Imena». Muri Mutarama 2016, Inama y'Abaminisitiri yemeje ko Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange riba «ikigo cy'intwari». Buri mwaka, ku wa 18 Werurwe, hizihizwa ubutwari bw'abanyeshuri b'i Nyange.
Ku wa 10 Mutarama 2014, Urumuri rw'Icyizere ("Kwibuka Flame") rwageze ku Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Nyange. Hari mu ntangiriro z'urugendo rwarwo mu gihugu hose, mbere yo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 20.

Bernard Munyagishari (yavutse mu 1959) ni Umunyarwanda. Mu 1994, yari umuyobozi w'ishyaka MRND n'uw'Interahamwe mu mujyi wa Gisenyi.
Mu 2017, Urukiko Rukuru rw'u Rwanda rwamuhamije icyaha cya jenoside. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Mu 2020, yemeye ibyaha bye. Mu 2021, Urukiko rw'Ubujurire rwagumishijeho igifungo cya burundu.
Bernard Munyagishari yavutse mu 1959. Mbere ya Jenoside, yari umwarimu w'amashuri abanza.
Kuva mu 1992 kugeza mu 1994, Munyagishari yari umunyamabanga mukuru w'ishyaka MRND i Gisenyi. Yari na perezida w'Interahamwe muri Gisenyi. Muri Mata 1994, Interahamwe ze zayoboye ubwicanyi bw'Abatutsi muri ako karere. Munyagishari yashakaga abarwanyi. Yabahaga intwaro. Yashyizeho na bariyeri.
Ibyaha aregwa byakorewe ahantu henshi muri perefegitura ya Gisenyi. Muri ho harimo Institut Saint-Fidèle, icyicaro cya Diyosezi Gatolika ya Nyundo n'ahantu hiswe «Komine Rouge».
Mu 2005, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamureze ibyaha bya jenoside. Mu Gicurasi 2011, Munyagishari yafatiwe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ku itariki ya 24 Nyakanga 2013, ICTR yamwohereje mu Rwanda kugira ngo aburanishirizwe yo. Ni we wa kabiri ICTR yohereje mu Rwanda.
Urubanza rwe rwabereye mu Rukiko Rukuru i Kigali. Munyagishari yanze kwitabira urubanza. Ku itariki ya 21 Gashyantare 2017, ubushinjacyaha bwamusabiye igifungo cya burundu. Ku itariki ya 20 Mata 2017, urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha cya jenoside n'icyaha cy'ubwicanyi cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Ntiyahamijwe icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu.
Munyagishari yajuririye icyo cyemezo. Ku itariki ya 12 Ugushyingo 2020, mu Rukiko rw'Ubujurire, yemeye uruhare rwe muri Jenoside. Yanditse inyandiko ya paji zirenga 50 isobanura ibyo yakoze. Yasabye imbabazi. Ku itariki ya 7 Gicurasi 2021, Urukiko rw'Ubujurire rwanze ubujurire bwe. Rwagumishijeho igifungo cya burundu.

Stele i Paris (mu Gifaransa: "Stèle à la mémoire des victimes du génocide des Tutsi au Rwanda") ni ikimenyetso cyo kwibuka abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Iri mu irimbi rya Père-Lachaise, i Paris, mu Bufaransa.
Iyo stele yatashywe ku wa 31 Ukwakira 2014. Yashyizweho n'Umujyi wa Paris n'ishyirahamwe Ibuka France.
Ishyirahamwe Ibuka France ryatangaje ko stele izatahwa ku wa 31 Ukwakira 2014, mu irimbi rya Père-Lachaise. Umuhango wari kuba imbere y'umuyobozi w'Umujyi wa Paris n'abandi bayobozi. Stele yatashywe kuri uwo munsi.
Ku wa 7 Mata 2015, Abanyarwanda n'inshuti zabo barenga 200 bahuriye imbere y'iyo stele. Ambasade y'u Rwanda, umujyi w'akarere ka 20 ka Paris na Ibuka France bashyize indabo kuri stele. Uwo munsi, umwungirije w'umuyobozi w'Umujyi wa Paris yemeye gushaka ahantu hanini ho kwibukira.
Mbere ya 2026, kwibuka i Paris byaberaga cyane cyane imbere y'iyi stele no muri pariki ya Choisy. Ku wa 2 Kamena 2026, urwibutso rushya rwitwa «L'Archive» rwatashywe i Paris. Rwatashywe na Perezida w'u Bufaransa Emmanuel Macron na Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame. Ruri ku nkombe y'uruzi rwa Seine. Rwakozwe n'umunyabugeni Grada Kilomba.

Mbaye Diagne (18 Werurwe 1958 – 31 Gicurasi 1994) yari kapiteni mu ngabo za Senegali. Yari indorerezi ya gisirikare ya MINUAR mu Rwanda.
Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, Mbaye Diagne yakijije abantu amagana. Yishwe ku wa 31 Gicurasi 1994 i Kigali. Umuryango w'Abibumbye wamuhaye icyubahiro ushyiraho umudari witwa izina rye.
Mbaye Diagne yavutse ku wa 18 Werurwe 1958 muri Senegali. Yize muri Kaminuza ya Dakar. Nyuma yize mu ishuri rikuru ry'abofisiye b'ingabo za Senegali.
Mbaye Diagne yabaye kapiteni mu ngabo za Senegali. Yarwanye mu ntambara ya Casamance kuva mu 1989 kugeza mu 1993. Mu 1993, yoherejwe mu Rwanda nk'indorerezi ya gisirikare. Nyuma yashyizwe muri MINUAR.
Jenoside imaze gutangira muri Mata 1994, Diagne yakijije abana ba Minisitiri w'Intebe Agathe Uwilingiyimana. Yabafashije guhunga igihugu. Nyuma yakoze ingendo nyinshi wenyine muri Kigali. Yahishaga Abatutsi mu modoka ye. Yabajyanaga ahantu harinzwe n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye. Bamwe yabahishe muri Hôtel des Mille Collines. Ibyo yabikoze nubwo amabwiriza ya MINUAR atabimwemereraga. Umubare w'abo yakijije ntuzwi neza. Bamwe bavuga ko barenga 1 000.
Ku wa 31 Gicurasi 1994, Diagne yasubiraga ku birindiro bye. Igisasu cyaguye hafi y'imodoka ye. Yahise apfa. Yari asigaje iminsi 12 ngo arangize igihe cy'akazi ke.
Mu 2005, Senegali yamugize umunyacyubahiro mu Rutonde rw'Igihugu rw'Intare ("Ordre national du Lion"). Muri Gicurasi 2014, Akanama gashinzwe umutekano ku isi k'Umuryango w'Abibumbye kashyizeho umudari witwa «Umudari wa Kapiteni Mbaye Diagne w'ubutwari bw'indashyikirwa». Ku wa 19 Gicurasi 2016, Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye yahaye uwo mudari wa mbere umupfakazi we, Yacine Mar Diop.

Édouard Kayihura ni Umunyarwanda warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Ni umunyamategeko, umwanditsi kandi aharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu.
Muri Jenoside, Kayihura yamaze iminsi 100 ari impunzi muri Hôtel des Mille Collines i Kigali. Yanditse igitabo "Inside the Hotel Rwanda" (2014) ku byabereye muri iyo hoteli.
Mu 1994, Kayihura yamaze iminsi 100 ari impunzi muri Hôtel des Mille Collines.
Kayihura yabaye umushinjacyaha mu Rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Kigali. Yakurikiranaga imanza za Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Yabaye kandi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa akaba n'uhagarariye mu mategeko umuryango Kanyarwanda uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu. Nyuma yimukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Atanga ibiganiro mu mashuri no muri za kaminuza.
Inside the Hotel Rwanda.
Mu 2014, Kayihura yasohoye igitabo "Inside the Hotel Rwanda". Yacyanditse afatanyije na Kerry Zukus. Cyasohowe na BenBella Books i Dallas. Icyo gitabo kivuga iminsi 100 Kayihura yamaze muri hoteli. Kirimo kandi ubuhamya bw'abandi barokotse, Abahutu n'Abatutsi, n'ubw'abasirikare b'Umuryango w'Abibumbye.
Igitabo kinenga filime "Hotel Rwanda". Abanditsi bacyo bavuga ko iyo filime itavuga ukuri ku byabereye muri hoteli. Bavuga ko Paul Rusesabagina yari umuntu ushaka ubutegetsi wungukiye ku mpunzi.

Jean-Paul Akayesu (yavutse mu 1953) ni Umunyarwanda wahoze ari burugumesitiri wa komini Taba. Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu.
Ku wa 2 Nzeri 1998, Akayesu yabaye umuntu wa mbere ku isi wahamijwe icyaha cya Jenoside n'urukiko mpuzamahanga. Urwo rubanza rwemeje bwa mbere ko gufata ku ngufu bishobora kuba uburyo bwo gukora Jenoside.
Akayesu yavukiye muri komini Taba mu 1953. Yabaye mwarimu. Yari afite abana batanu.
Mu 1991, Akayesu yatorewe kuyobora ishyaka MDR ku rwego rw'ibanze. Kuva muri Mata 1993 kugeza muri Kamena 1994, yari burugumesitiri wa komini Taba.
Jenoside imaze gutangira, Akayesu yabanje kubuza Interahamwe kwinjira muri Taba. Yabanje kurinda Abatutsi bo muri komini ye. Ku wa 18 Mata 1994, yagiye mu nama n'abayobozi ba guverinoma y'inzibacyuho. Nyuma y'iyo nama, yahinduye imyitwarire. Yashishikarije abaturage kwica Abatutsi. Ahantu Abatutsi bari barahungiye habaye aho bakorerwa iyicarubozo, aho bafatirwa ku ngufu kandi bakicirwa.
Nyuma ya Jenoside, Akayesu yahungiye muri Zayire, hanyuma muri Zambiya. Yafatiwe muri Zambiya mu Kwakira 1995. Yoherejwe i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya, kuburanishwa na ICTR.
Ku wa 2 Nzeri 1998, ICTR yamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Ni bwo bwa mbere urukiko mpuzamahanga rwahamije umuntu icyaha cya Jenoside. Ni na bwo bwa mbere urukiko mpuzamahanga rwasobanuye icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu. Rwemeje ko gufata ku ngufu bishobora kuba uburyo bwo gukora Jenoside.
Akayesu yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Ku wa 1 Kamena 2001, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwanze ubujurire bwe. Rwemeje igifungo cya burundu. Arangiriza igihano cye muri gereza yo muri Mali.

Valérie Bemeriki (yavutse ahagana mu 1955) ni Umunyarwandakazi wahoze ari umunyamakuru wa radiyo RTLM ("Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines"). Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994, yakoresheje radiyo ashishikariza abantu kwica Abatutsi.
Mu Kuboza 2009, urukiko Gacaca rwa Nyakabanda i Kigali rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu.
Mbere ya 1993, Bemeriki yari umunyamakuru w'ikinyamakuru "Umurwanashyaka". Icyo kinyamakuru cyari icy'ishyaka MRND ryari ku butegetsi. Mu 1993, yinjiye muri radiyo RTLM. Bamusabye «kurwanya umwanzi w'Umututsi akoresheje indangururamajwi».
Bemeriki yemeye mu rukiko ko yakoresheje iyo radiyo ahamagarira abantu gushakisha Abatutsi no kubica. Yavuze ko ku munsi wakurikiye ihanurwa ry'indege ya Perezida Habyarimana, intumwa z'umugaba mukuru w'ingabo zahuye n'abanyamakuru ba RTLM. Ubutumwa bwari ukurangiza «Revolisiyo yo mu 1959» no kwica Abatutsi bose.
Bemeriki yafatiwe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Yoherejwe mu Rwanda muri Kamena 1999. Izindi nkiko Gacaca zari zaramukatiye ibihano by'igifungo.
Mu Kuboza 2009, yaburanishijwe n'urukiko Gacaca rwa Nyakabanda, i Kigali. Yaregwaga gutegura Jenoside, gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside, no kugira uruhare mu iyicwa ry'abantu benshi n'imiryango. Mu rukiko, yasabye imbabazi abiciwe. Yavuze ko yakoze ibibi bidashobora gusanwa. Ku wa 12 Ukuboza 2009, urukiko rwamuhamije ibyaha kandi rumukatira igifungo cya burundu.

Sosthène Munyemana (yavutse ahagana mu 1955) ni umuganga w'Umunyarwanda. Mu 1994, yari umuganga w'indwara z'abagore muri perefegitura ya Butare.
Mu Bufaransa, urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside. Ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2023, yakatiwe imyaka 24 y'igifungo. Urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje icyo gihano ku wa 23 Ukwakira 2025.
Mbere ya Jenoside, Munyemana yari umuganga w'indwara z'abagore. Yakoreraga muri perefegitura ya Butare, mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda.
Munyemana yageze mu Bufaransa muri Nzeri 1994. Umugore we yari asanzwe ahaba. Yamaze imyaka irenga 20 ari umuganga mu by'ubutabazi bwihuse. Nyuma yabaye umuganga w'abasaza mu majyepfo y'uburengerazuba bw'u Bufaransa.
Munyemana yaregwaga gushyiraho bariyeri n'amarondo i Tumba, muri perefegitura ya Butare. Kuri izo bariyeri, abantu bafatwaga hanyuma bakicwa. Yaregwaga kandi gufata urufunguzo rw'ibiro bya segiteri. Abatutsi bafungirwagamo mbere yo kwicwa. Yaregwaga no gushyira umukono ku nyandiko ishyigikira guverinoma y'inzibacyuho.
Munyemana avuga ko yari Umuhutu utarangwaga n'ubuhezanguni. Avuga ko yagerageje guhisha Abatutsi.
Ikirego cya mbere cyatanzwe i Bordeaux mu 1995. Iperereza ryimuriwe i Paris mu 2001. Icyemezo cyo kumuregera urukiko cyafashwe mu 2018 gusa.
Ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2023, urukiko rwa rubanda ("cour d'assises") rw'i Paris rwamuhamije Jenoside n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwamukatiye imyaka 24 y'igifungo. Yabaye Umunyarwanda wa karindwi uhamijwe ibyaha bya Jenoside mu Bufaransa.
Munyemana yajuririye icyo cyemezo. Ku wa 23 Ukwakira 2025, urukiko rw'ubujurire rw'i Paris rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside n'ubugambanyi bwo gukora Jenoside. Rwamugize umwere ku byaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Rwemeje imyaka 24 y'igifungo. Munyemana yajuririye Urukiko rusesa imanza.

Beatrice Munyenyezi (yavutse ahagana mu 1970) ni Umunyarwandakazi wahamijwe ibyaha bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994. Ni umukazana wa Pauline Nyiramasuhuko.
Munyenyezi yamaze imyaka myinshi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Yakatiwe yo kubera kubeshya ku byo yakoze muri Jenoside. Mu 2021 yoherejwe mu Rwanda. Mu 2024, urukiko rwa Huye rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu.
Munyenyezi yashakanye na Arsène Shalom Ntahobali. Ntahobali yari umuyobozi w'Interahamwe i Butare. Nyina wa Ntahobali, Pauline Nyiramasuhuko, yari minisitiri muri guverinoma yakoze Jenoside. Mu 2011, Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda rwakatiye bombi igifungo cya burundu. Nyuma, mu bujurire, icyo gihano cyagabanyijwe kiba imyaka 47.
Abatangabuhamya bavuze ko Munyenyezi yagenzuraga bariyeri i Butare. Iyo bariyeri yari imbere ya hoteli y'umuryango w'umugabo we. Bavuze ko yatoranyaga Abatutsi bakicwa. Bavuze kandi ko yashishikarizaga abahezanguni b'Abahutu gufata abagore ku ngufu. Bamwitaga «komanda». Munyenyezi yahakanye ibyo byaha byose.
Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika.
Mu 2003, Munyenyezi yahawe ubwenegihugu bwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika muri leta ya New Hampshire. Mu 2013, urukiko rwemeje ko yabeshye mu nyandiko yasabagamo ubwenegihugu. Yari yarahishe uruhare rwe muri Jenoside. Yambuwe ubwenegihugu, akatirwa imyaka 10 y'igifungo.
Ku wa 15 Mata 2021, Munyenyezi yoherejwe mu Rwanda. Yahise afatwa n'inzego z'umutekano ageze i Kigali. Yaregwaga ibyaha birindwi bifitanye isano na Jenoside.
Muri Mata 2024, urukiko rw'i Huye rwamuhamije ibyaha byo kwica nk'icyaha cya Jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside, gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside, n'ubufatanyacyaha mu gufata ku ngufu. Rwamugize umwere ku cyaha cyo gutegura Jenoside. Rwamukatiye igifungo cya burundu.

Minisiteri y'Ububanyi n'Amahanga n'Ubutwererane ("Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation", MINAFFET) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe politiki y'u Rwanda mu mahanga.
Ishinzwe kandi umubano n'ibindi bihugu n'imiryango mpuzamahanga. Kuva muri Kamena 2024, Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga n'Ubutwererane ni Olivier Nduhungirehe.
Inshingano ya MINAFFET ni ugutegura gahunda zo gushyira mu bikorwa politiki y'u Rwanda mu mahanga. Ikurikirana kandi igasuzuma iyo politiki. Isobanura iyo politiki mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.
Icyerekezo cya MINAFFET ni u Rwanda rufite amahoro, rukize kandi rwigenga. U Rwanda kandi rugomba kuba ku isonga mu bufatanye bw'akarere, bwa Afurika n'ubw'isi.
Ibyo MINAFFET ishyira imbere ni ibi:
Louise Mushikiwabo yayoboye MINAFFET kugeza mu Ukwakira 2018. Icyo gihe, yari amaze gutorerwa kuyobora Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Ibihugu Bivuga Igifaransa (OIF). Richard Sezibera yamusimbuye.
Ku wa 4 Ugushyingo 2019, Vincent Biruta yasimbuye Sezibera. Mbere yaho, Biruta yari Minisitiri w'Ibidukikije.
Ku wa 12 Kamena 2024, Olivier Nduhungirehe yasimbuye Biruta. Mbere yaho, Nduhungirehe yari Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu Buholandi. Biruta yagizwe Minisitiri w'Umutekano mu Gihugu.
Ku wa 1 Ukuboza 2025, Usta Kaitesi yagizwe Minisitiri wa Leta muri MINAFFET.

Alfred Musema ni Umunyarwanda wahoze ayobora uruganda rw'icyayi rwa Gisovu, muri perefegitura ya Kibuye. Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside kubera ibyo yakoreye i Bisesero n'ahandi.
Ku wa 27 Mutarama 2000, ICTR yamukatiye igifungo cya burundu. Icyo gihano cyemejwe mu bujurire ku wa 16 Ugushyingo 2001.
Mu gihe cya Jenoside, Musema yari umuyobozi w'uruganda rw'icyayi rwa Gisovu. Urwo ruganda rwayoborwaga na Leta.
Ibyo yakoze muri Jenoside.
Musema yatwaraga abicanyi bitwaje intwaro, barimo abakozi b'uruganda. Yabajyanaga muri komini Gisovu na Gishyita. Bateraga Abatutsi bari bahahungiye. Yagiye ubwe mu bitero byabereye ku misozi ya Gitwa, Rwirambo, Muyira na Mumataba. Ibyo bitero byabaye mu mpera za Mata no hagati muri Gicurasi 1994. Mu rubanza rwe, byagaragaye ko abantu bagera kuri 300 baguye mu buvumo bwa Nyakavumu. Abicanyi bari bacanye umuriro ku muryango w'ubwo buvumo.
Ku wa 27 Mutarama 2000, ICTR yamuhamije ibyaha bya Jenoside, gutsemba nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu, no gufata ku ngufu nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu.
Musema yajuriye. Ku wa 16 Ugushyingo 2001, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje ibyaha bya Jenoside n'ibyo gutsemba. Rwakuyeho icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu, nyuma yo kumva abandi batangabuhamya babiri. Rwemeje igifungo cya burundu.

Augustin Ngirabatware (yavutse ku wa 12 Mutarama 1957) ni Umunyarwanda wahoze ari Minisitiri w'Igenamigambi kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 1994. Ni umukwe wa Félicien Kabuga.
Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside muri komini ye ya Nyamyumba. Mu bujurire, yakatiwe imyaka 30 y'igifungo.
Ngirabatware avuka muri komini Nyamyumba, muri perefegitura ya Gisenyi. Afite impamyabumenyi y'ikirenga mu bukungu yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Fribourg, mu Ubusuwisi.
Kuva mu 1986 kugeza mu 1994, Ngirabatware yari umwarimu muri Kaminuza y'u Rwanda. Muri Nyakanga 1990, yagizwe Minisitiri w'Igenamigambi. Yagumye kuri uwo mwanya muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho yo muri Mata 1994. Yari kandi umwe mu bagize komite ya MRND ku rwego rwa perefegitura ya Gisenyi no ku rwego rw'igihugu.
Ibyo yakoze muri Jenoside.
Mu 1994, Ngirabatware yashishikarije Interahamwe zo muri komini Nyamyumba kwica abaturanyi babo b'Abatutsi. Yazihaye intwaro. Yazibwiye ko atashaka kongera kubona Abatutsi muri iyo komini.
Ngirabatware yafatiwe mu Ubudage ku wa 17 Nzeri 2007. Yoherejwe kuri ICTR ku wa 8 Ukwakira 2009.
Ku wa 20 Ukuboza 2012, ICTR yamuhamije gushishikariza ku mugaragaro abantu gukora Jenoside, kubatera inkunga no kubafasha gukora Jenoside, ndetse no gufata ku ngufu nk'icyaha cyibasiye inyokomuntu. Yakatiwe imyaka 35 y'igifungo.
Ku wa 18 Ukuboza 2014, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwemeje ibyaha bijyanye na Jenoside. Rwakuyeho icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu. Igihano cyagabanyijwe kiba imyaka 30. Mu 2017, urukiko rwemeye gusubiramo urubanza. Bamwe mu batangabuhamya bari baravuguruje ubuhamya bwabo. Ku wa 27 Nzeri 2019, urukiko rwemeje ko icyemezo cy'ubujurire kigumaho uko cyari kiri.

Minisiteri y'Ubutabera ("Ministry of Justice", MINIJUST) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe ubutabera n'iyubahirizwa ry'amategeko.
Minisitiri w'Ubutabera ni na we Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta. Kuva muri Nzeri 2021, uwo mwanya urimo Emmanuel Ugirashebuja.
Inshingano ya MINIJUST ni ugutegura, kugenzura no guteza imbere ibikorwa bijyanye n'ubutabera. Igamije ko amategeko yubahirizwa kandi ko ubutabera bugera kuri bose.
Inshingano z'ingenzi za MINIJUST ni izi:
Ku wa 17 Nzeri 2021, Emmanuel Ugirashebuja yagizwe Minisitiri w'Ubutabera n'Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta. Yasimbuye Johnston Busingye. Busingye yari yagizwe Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda mu Bwongereza.
Mbere yaho, Ugirashebuja yari Perezida w'Urukiko rw'Ubutabera rw'Afurika y'Iburasirazuba (EACJ), kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2020. Muri 2026, aracyari Minisitiri w'Ubutabera.

Minisiteri y'Ingabo ("Ministry of Defence", MINADEF) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe kurinda ubusugire n'umutekano w'igihugu.
Iyobora Ingabo z'u Rwanda (RDF). Kuva muri Kamena 2023, Minisitiri w'Ingabo ni Juvenal Marizamunda.
Inshingano ya Minisiteri y'Ingabo ni ukurinda ubusugire bw'igihugu. Irinda kandi inyungu z'u Rwanda, ubutaka bwarwo, umutungo warwo n'indangagaciro zarwo. Intego yayo ni ukugira ingabo ziteguye kurwana, zishobora koherezwa vuba mu gihugu cyangwa hanze yacyo.
Inshingano z'ingenzi za Minisiteri y'Ingabo ni izi:
Ibigo bishamikiye kuri Minisiteri y'Ingabo ni ibi:
Mu Ukwakira 2018, Albert Murasira yasimbuye James Kabarebe ku mwanya wa Minisitiri w'Ingabo.
Ku wa 5 Kamena 2023, Juvenal Marizamunda yasimbuye Murasira. Mbere yaho, Marizamunda yari Komiseri Mukuru w'Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe Igorora (RCS). Yari kandi yarabaye Umuyobozi Mukuru Wungirije wa Polisi.

Hassan Ngeze ni Umunyarwanda wari umwanditsi mukuru w'ikinyamakuru "Kangura". Yari kandi umwe mu bashinze ishyaka CDR.
Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije icyaha cya Jenoside no gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside. Mu bujurire, yakatiwe imyaka 35 y'igifungo.
Ngeze akomoka muri komini Rubavu, muri perefegitura ya Gisenyi. Avuga ko yavutse ku wa 25 Ukuboza 1957. Inyandiko z'urukiko zo zivuga ko yavutse mu 1961.
Avuga ko yabaye umunyamakuru kuva mu 1978 kugeza mu 1997. Mbere yaho, yakwirakwizaga ikinyamakuru "Kanguka" i Gisenyi, akanacyandikira.
Ngeze yashinze ikinyamakuru "Kangura" mu 1990. Yari umuyobozi wacyo n'umwanditsi mukuru wacyo. Mu Ukuboza 1990, "Kangura" yasohoye inyandiko yitwa «Amategeko icumi y'Abahutu». Iyo nyandiko yaburiraga abagabo b'Abahutu ku Batutsikazi. Ikinyamakuru cyagaragazaga Abatutsi nk'abagome, abanyabinyoma n'abicanyi.
Ngeze yari kandi umwe mu bashinze ishyaka CDR mu 1992. Yari umujyanama w'ubuyobozi bw'iryo shyaka.
Ngeze yafatiwe muri Kenya ku wa 18 Nyakanga 1997. Uwo munsi nyine yoherejwe i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya.
Yaburanishijwe hamwe na Ferdinand Nahimana na Jean-Bosco Barayagwiza. Uru rubanza ruzwi nk'«urubanza rw'itangazamakuru». Ku wa 3 Ukuboza 2003, ICTR yamuhamije Jenoside, ubugambanyi bwo gukora Jenoside, gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside, n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Urukiko rwemeye ko yarokoye Abatutsi bamwe mu 1994.
Ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 2007, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwakuyeho bimwe mu byaha. Rwemeje icyaha cya Jenoside, icyo gushishikariza abantu gukora Jenoside, n'icyo gufasha mu itsembatsemba. Igihano cyagabanyijwe kiba imyaka 35.
Ku wa 3 Ukuboza 2008, Ngeze yoherejwe muri Mali kurangirizayo igihano cye.

Minisiteri y'Umutekano mu Gihugu ("Ministry of Interior", MININTER) ni minisiteri ya Leta y'u Rwanda. Ishinzwe umutekano imbere mu gihugu, amahoro n'igorora.
Ifite mu nshingano Polisi y'u Rwanda (RNP) n'Urwego rushinzwe Igorora (RCS). Kuva muri Kamena 2024, Minisitiri w'Umutekano mu Gihugu ni Vincent Biruta.
Inshingano ya MININTER ni ukubungabunga umutekano imbere mu gihugu, amahoro n'ituze. Ishinzwe kandi ko igorora rikorwa neza.
Inshingano z'ingenzi za MININTER ni izi:
Ibigo bishamikiye kuri MININTER birimo Polisi y'u Rwanda (RNP) n'Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe Igorora (RCS).
Ku wa 4 Ugushyingo 2019, Minisiteri y'Umutekano mu Gihugu yongeye gushyirwaho. Yahawe Patrick Nyamvumba. Muri Mata 2020, Nyamvumba yavanywe ku mirimo. Minisiteri nayo yavanyweho.
Ku wa 10 Ukuboza 2021, Alfred Gasana yagizwe Minisitiri w'Umutekano mu Gihugu. Mbere yaho, yakoraga mu Rwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe Iperereza n'Umutekano (NISS).
Ku wa 12 Kamena 2024, Vincent Biruta yasimbuye Gasana. Mbere yaho, Biruta yari Minisitiri w'Ububanyi n'Amahanga.

Eliézer Niyitegeka (12 Werurwe 1952 – 28 Werurwe 2018) yari Umunyarwanda w'umunyamakuru n'umunyapolitiki. Yabaye Minisitiri w'Itangazamakuru muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho yo mu 1994.
Urukiko Mpanabyaha Mpuzamahanga rwashyiriweho u Rwanda (ICTR) rwamuhamije uruhare mu bwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi i Bisesero mu gihe cya Jenoside. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Yapfiriye muri gereza muri Mali.
Niyitegeka yavukiye i Gitabura, muri komini Gisovu, muri perefegitura ya Kibuye. Yabanje kuba umunyamakuru kuri Radiyo Rwanda.
Mu 1991, yari umwe mu bashinze ishyaka MDR. Kuva mu 1991 kugeza mu 1994, yayoboye iryo shyaka muri perefegitura ya Kibuye.
Ku wa 9 Mata 1994, yarahiriye kuba Minisitiri w'Itangazamakuru muri guverinoma y'inzibacyuho. Yagumye kuri uwo mwanya kugeza mu mpera za Nyakanga 1994, ubwo yahungaga u Rwanda.
Ibyo yakoze muri Jenoside.
Hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994, Niyitegeka yagize uruhare mu bitero byagabwe ku Batutsi bari bahungiye i Bisesero, muri Kibuye. Urukiko rwemeje ko yashishikarije Interahamwe kwica Abatutsi. Rwemeje kandi ko we ubwe yagize uruhare mu kwica Umututsi witwa Kabanda n'umugore w'Umututsikazi.
Niyitegeka yafatiwe i Nairobi, muri Kenya, ku wa 9 Gashyantare 1999. Nyuma y'iminsi itatu, yoherejwe muri gereza ya Loni i Arusha, muri Tanzaniya.
Ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2003, ICTR yamuhamije Jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha muri Jenoside, gushishikariza ku mugaragaro abantu gukora Jenoside, n'ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu. Yakatiwe igifungo cya burundu. Urukiko rwemeye ko yarokoye Abahutu n'Abatutsi bamwe muri Jenoside. Rwasanze ariko ko ibyo bitaruta uburemere bw'ibyaha bye.
Ku wa 9 Nyakanga 2004, urukiko rw'ubujurire rwanze ubujurire bwe bwose. Igihano cya burundu cyagumyeho.
Niyitegeka yapfuye ku wa 28 Werurwe 2018, arangiriza igihano cye muri Mali.
