Mu 1986, Papa Wemba yagiye gutura mu Ubufaransa. Yakoranye na Peter Gabriel. Mu 1995, yasohoye alubumu "Emotion" kuri Real World, inzu y'umuziki ya Peter Gabriel. Yakoranye kandi na Stevie Wonder.
Mu 2004, urukiko rw'i Paris rwamuhamije icyaha cyo kwinjiza abimukira mu Bufaransa mu buryo butemewe. Bari bihishe mu bagize itsinda rye.
Ku wa 24 Mata 2016, Papa Wemba yaguye ku rubyiniro i Abidjan, muri Kote Divuwari. Yaririmbaga mu iserukiramuco ry'umuziki. Yapfuye afite imyaka 66.

Koffi Olomidé (yavutse ku wa 13 Nyakanga 1956) ni umuririmbyi wo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ni n'umuhimbyi w'indirimbo. Ayobora itsinda Quartier Latin International.
Ari mu bahanzi bakomeye ba rumba y'Abanyekongo. Yakoranye na Papa Wemba mu ntangiriro y'umwuga we.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Koffi Olomidé yavukiye i Kisangani, ku wa 13 Nyakanga 1956. Izina rye ry'amavuko ni Antoine Christophe Agbepa Mumba. Akiri ingimbi, yakurikiraga itsinda Zaïko Langa Langa. Icyo gihe, yabaye inshuti ya Papa Wemba. Nyuma yaho, Papa Wemba yayoboye itsinda Viva la Musica. Koffi Olomidé yaririmbye muri bimwe mu ndirimbo z'iryo tsinda.
Koffi Olomidé yatangiye umwuga we mu 1977. Nyuma ya 1978, yabaga i Kinshasa, ariko akajya kwiga kaminuza mu Ubufaransa.
Mu 1986, yasohoye alubumu ye ya mbere, "Dieu Voit Tout". Muri uwo mwaka, yashinze itsinda Quartier Latin. Mu 1987, alubumu "Tcha Tcho" yatumye amenyekana cyane muri rumba.
Izindi alubumu ze zizwi ni "Noblesse Oblige" (1994), "Ultimatum" (1997), "Effrakata" (2001) na "Danger de Mort" (2006). Kimwe na Papa Wemba, azwi mu muryango wa « La Sape », ukunda imyenda ihenze.

Fela Kuti (15 Ukwakira 1938 – 2 Kanama 1997) yari umuririmbyi n'umucuranzi wo muri Nijeriya. Ni we wahanze injyana ya Afrobeat. Yari azwi kandi ku izina rya Fela Anikulapo-Kuti.
Indirimbo ze nyinshi zanengaga ubutegetsi bwa Nijeriya. Kubera iyo mpamvu, yafunzwe inshuro nyinshi.
Fela Kuti yavukiye i Abeokuta, muri Nijeriya, ku wa 15 Ukwakira 1938. Nyina yari Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti. Yaharaniraga uburenganzira bw'abagore n'abakozi. Mu 1959, Fela Kuti yagiye kwiga umuziki i Londres, muri Trinity College. Icyo gihe, yacurangaga piyano mu matsinda ya jazz na rock.
Hagati mu myaka ya 1960, Fela Kuti yagarutse muri Nijeriya. Yongeye gushinga itsinda Koola Lobitos. Muri iryo tsinda ni ho injyana ya Afrobeat yavukiye. Afrobeat ivanga blues, jazz na funk byo muri Amerika n'umuziki gakondo w'Abayoruba. Itsinda rye ryitwaga Nigeria 70, Africa 70, nyuma riza kwitwa Egypt 80.
Fela Kuti yashinze urugo rusangiwe hafi y'akabari ke i Lagos. Yarwise « Repubulika ya Kalakuta ». Mu 1977, abategetsi ba Nijeriya bateye urwo rugo. Fela Kuti yafunzwe igihe gito. Indirimbo ye "Zombie" ni imwe mu ndirimbo ze za politiki zizwi.
Mu 1979, yashinze ishyaka Movement of the People. Yiyamamarije kuba perezida wa Nijeriya, ariko ntiyatsinda. Mu 1984, yongeye gufungwa.
Fela Kuti yapfuye ku wa 2 Kanama 1997, i Lagos. Yazize indwara zatewe na SIDA. Umuhungu we Femi Kuti yakomeje umuziki wa Afrobeat.

Angélique Kidjo (yavutse ku wa 14 Nyakanga 1960) ni umuririmbyi wo muri Bene. Ni n'umuhimbyi w'indirimbo. Avanga injyana nyinshi z'umuziki.
Yahawe ibihembo bitanu bya Grammy. Ni ambasaderi wa UNICEF kuva mu 2002.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Angélique Kidjo yavukiye i Ouidah, muri Bene, ku wa 14 Nyakanga 1960. Icyo gihe, icyo gihugu cyitwaga Dahomey. Yakuriye i Cotonou. Akiri muto, yumvaga umuziki gakondo w'aho yakuriye. Yumvaga kandi abahanzi nka Aretha Franklin, James Brown na Stevie Wonder.
Angélique Kidjo azwi kubera gukorana n'abahanzi bakomeye bo ku isi. Mu 1991, yasohoye alubumu "Logozo". Nyuma yaho, yasohoye "Fifa" (1995) na "Eve" (2014).
Mu 2008, alubumu ye "Djin Djin" yamuhesheje igihembo cya mbere cya Grammy. Yahawe ibindi bihembo bya Grammy kubera "Eve", "Sings", "Celia" na "Mother Nature". Muri rusange, afite ibihembo bitanu bya Grammy. Mu 2023, yahawe igihembo cya Polar Music Prize.
Ku wa 25 Nyakanga 2002, Angélique Kidjo yagizwe ambasaderi wa UNICEF. Aharanira cyane ko abakobwa biga. Yashinze umuryango Batonga Foundation. Uwo muryango ufasha abakobwa bo muri Afurika kwiga.

Youssou N'Dour (yavutse ku wa 1 Ukwakira 1959) ni umuririmbyi wo muri Senegali. Ni n'umuhimbyi w'indirimbo. Yamenyekanishije ku isi injyana ya mbalax.
Mu 2012, yabaye minisitiri w'umuco n'ubukerarugendo muri Senegali. Afite kandi ibitangazamakuru i Dakar.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Youssou N'Dour yavukiye i Dakar, muri Senegali, ku wa 1 Ukwakira 1959. Yavukiye mu muryango w'abagriyo. Abagriyo ni abaririmbyi n'abacuranzi babika amateka mu mvugo. Afite imyaka 12, yatangiye kuririmba mu itsinda Star Band. Se ntiyabishakaga.
Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1970, Youssou N'Dour yashinze itsinda Étoile de Dakar. Mu 1981, iryo tsinda ryabaye Super Étoile de Dakar. Mu ntangiriro y'imyaka ya 1980, yateje imbere injyana ya mbalax. Mbalax ivanga umuziki gakondo w'Abawolofu n'injyana zo muri Amerika y'Epfo. Yakoranye kandi na Peter Gabriel, Paul Simon na Sting.
Mu 1991, yabaye ambasaderi wa UNICEF. Mu 1994, indirimbo "7 Seconds" yaririmbanye na Neneh Cherry yamenyekanye cyane ku isi. Mu Bufaransa, iyo ndirimbo yamaze ibyumweru 16 ari iya mbere. Mu 1998, yaririmbye indirimbo y'Igikombe cy'Isi cy'umupira w'amaguru mu Bufaransa.
Alubumu ye "Egypt" yamuhesheje igihembo cya Grammy. Mu 2013, yahawe igihembo cya Polar Music Prize. Mu 2017, yahawe igihembo cya Praemium Imperiale.
Mu 2012, Youssou N'Dour yashatse kwiyamamariza kuba perezida wa Senegali. Kuva muri Mata kugeza mu Ukwakira 2012, yabaye minisitiri w'umuco n'ubukerarugendo. Nyuma yaho, kugeza muri Nzeri 2013, yabaye minisitiri w'ubukerarugendo n'imyidagaduro. Mu 2003, yashinze Groupe Futurs Médias. Iyo sosiyete ifite ikinyamakuru, radiyo na televiziyo.

Diamond Platnumz (yavutse ku wa 2 Ukwakira 1989) ni umuririmbyi wo muri Tanzaniya. Aririmba injyana ya Bongo Flava. Ni n'umucuruzi.
Yashinze inzu y'umuziki WCB Wasafi. Afite kandi radiyo na televiziyo byitwa Wasafi.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Izina rye ry'amavuko ni Nasibu Abdul Juma Issack. Yavutse ku wa 2 Ukwakira 1989. Yakuriye i Tandale, mu mujyi wa Dar es Salaam, muri Tanzaniya.
Diamond Platnumz ni umuririmbyi, umukinnyi wa filime n'umubyinnyi. Aririmba injyana ya Bongo Flava. Mu 2010, yasohoye alubumu "Kamwambie". Mu 2012, yasohoye "Lala Salama". Ku wa 14 Werurwe 2018, yasohoye alubumu "A Boy From Tandale".
Diamond Platnumz yashinze inzu y'umuziki WCB Wasafi, kandi ni we uyiyobora. Yashinze kandi sosiyete ya filime Zoom Extra. Afite televiziyo Wasafi TV na radiyo Wasafi FM.
Yahawe ibihembo byinshi, birimo MTV Awards, Channel O, Headies, AFRIMA na Kora. Yatoranyijwe kandi mu bihembo bya BET.

Bob Marley (6 Gashyantare 1945 – 11 Gicurasi 1981) yari umuririmbyi wo muri Jamayika. Yari n'umuhimbyi w'indirimbo. Ni we muhanzi uzwi cyane w'injyana ya reggae.
Indirimbo ze zahamagariraga amahoro n'urukundo. Yatumye umuziki wa Jamayika umenyekana ku isi yose.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Bob Marley yavukiye i Nine Mile, mu ntara ya Saint Ann, muri Jamayika, ku wa 6 Gashyantare 1945. Izina rye ry'amavuko ni Robert Nesta Marley. Yakuriye mu gace k'abakene.
Mu 1963, yashinze itsinda The Wailers. Abandi bari barigize ni Peter Tosh na Bunny Wailer. Indirimbo yabo ya mbere ni "Simmer Down". Muri Mutarama 1964, yabaye iya mbere muri Jamayika.
Mu myaka ya 1970, Bob Marley yavanze ska, rock steady na reggae n'umuziki wa rock. Mu 1973, The Wailers basohoye alubumu "Catch a Fire" kuri Island Records. Mu 1974, Peter Tosh na Bunny Wailer bavuye mu itsinda. Alubumu "Exodus" na "Kaya" zagurishijwe cyane ku isi.
Ku wa 22 Mata 1978, Bob Marley yaririmbye mu gitaramo One Love Peace Concert i Kingston. Mu 1980, yakoreye igitaramo gikomeye muri Zimbabwe, imbere y'abantu bagera ku 40 000. Icyo gihugu cyari kimaze kubona ubwigenge.
Mu 1977, abaganga basanze afite kanseri ku ino. Mu 1980, kanseri yakwiriye mu mubiri. Bob Marley yapfuye ku wa 11 Gicurasi 1981, i Miami. Yari afite imyaka 36. Mu 1994, yinjijwe muri Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

Piyano ni igikoresho cy'umuziki gifite utubuto twitwa « clavier ». Iyo ukanze akabuto, inyundo ntoya ikubita urudodo rw'icyuma. Urwo rudodo rugatanga ijwi.
Piyano yahimbwe mu Butaliyani ahagana mu 1700. Ubu ni kimwe mu bikoresho by'umuziki bikoreshwa cyane ku isi.
Piyano yahimbwe na Bartolomeo Cristofori ahagana mu 1700. Yakoreraga umuryango wa Medici i Florence, mu Ubutaliyani. Mu 1711, umwanditsi Scipione Maffei yayise « gravicembalo col piano, e forte ». Ni ho izina « pianoforte » ryavuye. Mu Gitaliyani, "piano" bisobanura « buhoro », naho "forte" bisobanura « cyane ». Iryo zina ryerekana ko piyano ishobora gucurangwa buhoro cyangwa cyane.
Piyano ya kera kurusha izindi zisigaye ni iya Cristofori yo mu 1720. Ibitswe mu nzu ndangamurage ya Metropolitan Museum of Art i New York. Ifite utubuto 54.
Piyano y'ubu ifite utubuto 88. Iyo ukanze akabuto, inyundo ipfutse ubwoya ikubita urudodo rw'icyuma. Hari ubwoko bubiri bw'ingenzi: piyano nini ("grand piano") na piyano ihagaze ("upright piano"). Mu kinyejana cya 19, piyano ihagaze yabaye iya mbere mu ngo.
Abahimbyi b'umuziki bazwi cyane bandikiye piyano ni nka Mozart, Haydn, Beethoven, Brahms na George Gershwin.

Filime ni urukurikirane rw'amafoto yerekanwa vuba vuba ku rukuta cyangwa kuri ekarani. Ijisho ribona ayo mafoto nk'ibintu bigenda.
Filime ya mbere yerekanywe ku mugaragaro i Paris mu 1895. Filime za mbere ntizagiraga ijwi.
Filime igizwe n'amafoto menshi atagenda. Ayo mafoto yerekanwa vuba vuba hakoreshejwe urumuri. Kubera uko ijisho rikora, umuntu abona ibintu bigenda nta guhagarara.
Mu 1891, Thomas Edison yari amaze gukora igikoresho cyitwa kinetoscope. Cyatumaga umuntu umwe areba amafoto agenda.
Ku wa 28 Ukuboza 1895, abavandimwe Lumière berekanye filime ku mugaragaro bwa mbere. Byabereye i Paris, muri Grand Café. Berekanye filime ngufi icumi. Bakoreshaga igikoresho cyitwa cinématographe.
Filime za mbere ntizagiraga ijwi. Mu 1927, sosiyete Warner Brothers yasohoye filime "The Jazz Singer". Ifatwa nka filime ndende ya mbere ifite amagambo yumvikana. Yatumye igihe cya filime zitavuga kirangira.

Igihembo cya Grammy (mu Cyongereza: "Grammy Award") ni igihembo gitangwa buri mwaka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Gihemba abakoze neza mu muziki.
Igihembo cya mbere cyatanzwe mu 1959. Icyo gihembo gisa na gramofone, igikoresho cya kera cyacurangaga disiki.
Ibihembo bya Grammy bitangwa na National Academy of Recording Arts &amp; Sciences, izwi kandi nka Recording Academy. Ibihembo bya Latin Grammy bitangwa na Latin Academy of Recording Arts &amp; Sciences.
Ku wa 4 Gicurasi 1959, ibihembo bya mbere bya Grammy byatanzwe i Los Angeles n'i New York. Icyo gihe hatanzwe ibihembo 28 gusa. Mu myaka ya vuba, hatangwa ibihembo birenga 90. Igihembo ubwacyo ni igishushanyo gito gisa na gramofone.
Abahanzi bamwe bahawe Grammy.
Bamwe mu bahanzi bahawe igihembo cya Grammy ni Michael Jackson, Elton John, Hans Zimmer, Miriam Makeba, Angélique Kidjo na Youssou N'Dour.

Igihembo cya Oscar (mu Cyongereza: "Academy Award") ni igihembo gitangwa buri mwaka. Gihemba abakoze neza mu bijyanye na filime.
Gitangwa na Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Abatsinze bahabwa agashushanyo gasizwe zahabu kitwa « Oscar ».
Ibihembo bya Oscar byatanzwe bwa mbere mu 1929. Ku wa 16 Gicurasi 1929, umuhango wa mbere wabereye muri Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel. Abantu 270 ni bo bawitabiriye. Gutanga ibihembo byamaze iminota 15 gusa. Hatanzwe udushushanyo 15. Filime "Wings" ni yo yahawe igihembo cya filime nziza kurusha izindi.
Inkomoko y'izina « Oscar » ntizwi neza. Iryo zina ryatangiye gukoreshwa ahagana mu 1934.
Bamwe mu bahawe igihembo cya Oscar ni Hans Zimmer na Elton John. James Newton Howard yatoranyijwe inshuro icyenda.

Quincy Jones (14 Werurwe 1933 – 3 Ugushyingo 2024) yari umutunganya w'umuziki w'Umunyamerika. Yari n'umuhimbyi w'umuziki n'umucuranzi.
Yatunganyije alubumu "Thriller" ya Michael Jackson. Yahawe ibihembo 28 bya Grammy.
Quincy Jones yavukiye i Chicago, muri Leta ya Illinois, ku wa 14 Werurwe 1933. Mu mashuri yisumbuye i Seattle, yacurangaga trompette. Nyuma yaho, yize muri Berklee College of Music.
Mu 1953, Quincy Jones yakoze ingendo z'ibitaramo mu Burayi hamwe na Lionel Hampton. Mu 1954, yagarutse i New York. Yibanze ku kwandika umuziki. Mu 1961, yabaye visi perezida wa Mercury Records. Ni we Munyamerika w'umwirabura wa mbere wabonye uwo mwanya.
Quincy Jones yahimbye umuziki wa filime nyinshi. Muri zo harimo "In the Heat of the Night" (1967), "The Italian Job" (1969) na "The Color Purple" (1985).
Yatunganyije alubumu eshatu za Michael Jackson: "Off the Wall" (1979), "Thriller" (1982) na "Bad" (1987). "Thriller" ni yo alubumu yagurishijwe cyane kurusha izindi mu mateka. Mu 1985, yatunganyije indirimbo "We Are the World". Yashinze kandi ikinyamakuru "Vibe".
Quincy Jones yahawe ibihembo 28 bya Grammy. Yapfuye ku wa 3 Ugushyingo 2024, iwe i Bel Air, muri Kaliforuniya. Yari afite imyaka 91.

The Jackson 5 ni itsinda ry'umuziki ryo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Ryari rigizwe n'abavandimwe batanu bo mu muryango wa Jackson. Muri bo harimo Michael Jackson.
Iryo tsinda ryamenyekanye cyane mu ntangiriro y'imyaka ya 1970. Ni ryo ryatangije umwuga wa Michael Jackson.
The Jackson 5 ryashinzwe na Joseph Jackson, se w'abo bana. Abarigize ni Jackie, Tito, Jermaine, Marlon na Michael Jackson. Michael Jackson yabaye umuririmbyi mukuru waryo afite imyaka icyenda.
Mu ntangiriro ya 1969, Berry Gordy, washinze Motown, yasinyishije iryo tsinda. Muri Ukuboza 1969, ryasohoye alubumu ya mbere, "Diana Ross Presents the Jackson 5". Indirimbo "I Want You Back" yabaye iya mbere ku rutonde rwa Billboard Hot 100. Indirimbo zabo zindi zizwi ni "ABC".
Mu 1976, itsinda ryavuye muri Motown. Michael Jackson yagumye muri iryo tsinda kugeza mu 1984. Mu 1997, The Jackson 5 ryinjijwe muri Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

Thriller ni alubumu y'umuririmbyi w'Umunyamerika Michael Jackson. Yasohotse mu Ugushyingo 1982. Yatunganyijwe na Quincy Jones.
"Thriller" ni yo alubumu yagurishijwe cyane kurusha izindi mu mateka. Yamuhesheje ibihembo umunani bya Grammy mu ijoro rimwe.
Michael Jackson yasohoye "Thriller" mu Ugushyingo 1982. Iyo alubumu yatunganyijwe na Quincy Jones. Ni yo alubumu ya kabiri bakoranye, nyuma ya "Off the Wall" (1979).
Mu 1983, indirimbo "Billie Jean" na "Beat It" zo kuri iyo alubumu zagaragaje uburyo bwa Michael Jackson bwo kubyina. Ku wa 2 Ukuboza 1983, hasohotse amashusho y'indirimbo "Thriller".
"Thriller" yamaze ibyumweru 37 ari iya mbere ku rutonde rwa Billboard 200. Mu mpera za 1983, yari imaze kugurishwa kopi zigera kuri miliyoni 32. Ubu imaze kugurishwa kopi zigera kuri miliyoni 67 ku isi.
Ku wa 28 Gashyantare 1984, Michael Jackson yahawe ibihembo umunani bya Grammy. Ni we muhanzi wa mbere wahawe ibihembo umunani mu ijoro rimwe.

Bernie Taupin (yavutse ku wa 22 Gicurasi 1950) ni umwanditsi w'amagambo y'indirimbo w'Umwongereza. Azwi cyane kubera gukorana na Elton John.
Yanditse amagambo y'indirimbo nyinshi zizwi za Elton John. Ni n'umunyabugeni.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Bernie Taupin yavukiye i Lincolnshire, mu Ubwongereza, ku wa 22 Gicurasi 1950. Izina rye ry'amavuko ni Bernard John Taupin.
Mu 1967, Bernie Taupin yasubije itangazo rya sosiyete yashakaga abanditsi b'indirimbo. Uwari uyoboye iyo sosiyete yahaye Elton John amagambo ya Taupin. Yamusabye kuyahimbira injyana. Ni uko batangiye gukorana.
Bernie Taupin yanditse amagambo y'indirimbo nyinshi za Elton John. Muri zo harimo "Your Song", "Tiny Dancer", "Crocodile Rock", "Goodbye Yellow Brick Road", "Daniel" na "Candle in the Wind". Mu 1985, yanditse kandi indirimbo "We Built This City" y'itsinda Starship.
Indirimbo "(I'm Gonna) Love Me Again", yanditswe kubera filime "Rocketman", yahawe Igihembo cya Oscar cy'indirimbo nziza. Bernie Taupin yabaye kandi umunyabugeni.

Umurenge wa Gatsata ni umwe mu mirenge 15 igize Akarere ka Gasabo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Gatsata wari utuwe n'abaturage 46 262. Ugizwe n'utugari 3. Muri uyu murenge hari urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Gatsata ni umwe mu mirenge 15 y'Akarere ka Gasabo. Ufite ubuso bwa km² 6,02. Ugizwe n'utugari 3:
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Gatsata wari utuwe n'abaturage 37 110. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 46 262. Abagabo bari 24 146. Abagore bari 22 116. Abaturage bose batuye mu mujyi.
Urwibutso rwa Jenoside.
Mu Murenge wa Gatsata hari urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ku rwibutso rwa Gatsata habarurwa abazize Jenoside 513.
Amagaraje yo mu Murenge wa Gatsata asohora imyanda ihumanya. Iyo myanda ijya mu gishanga no mu mugezi wa Nyabugogo.

Rwanda Movie Awards ni ibihembo bya buri mwaka bihabwa abakora filime mu Rwanda. Byatangiye mu 2012. Bitegurwa na Ishusho Arts.
Kuva mu 2020, ibi bihembo byitwa Rwanda International Movie Awards (RIMA). Kuva icyo gihe, bihemba kandi filime n'abakinnyi bo mu mahanga.
Rwanda Movie Awards.
Rwanda Movie Awards byatangiye mu 2012. Bitegurwa na Ishusho Arts. Jackson Mucyo ni we uyobora Ishusho Arts.
Mu Ukuboza 2014, Ishusho Arts yatangiye kwakira filime zo guhatanira ibihembo bya 2015. Byari ku nshuro ya kane. Filime zagombaga kuba zarakozwe n'Abanyarwanda mu 2014. Ibyiciro byari bine: filime ngufi, filime ndende, filime mbarankuru na filime z'uruhererekane. Icyiciro cya filime z'uruhererekane cyari gishya.
Ibihembo bibanzirizwa na Rwanda Movie Week. Muri iki cyumweru, abakinnyi ba filime bazenguruka igihugu. Bahura n'abakunzi babo. Mu 2015, Rwanda Movie Week yateganyijwe mu mijyi myinshi, nka Rubavu, Musanze, Huye na Rusizi.
Hari kandi igihembo cy'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane. Abaturage ni bo batora uwo mukinnyi. Mu 2017, Aline Munezero yari umwe mu bakinnyi b'abagore bahataniraga iki gihembo.
Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Mu 2020, ibihembo byabaye ku nshuro ya karindwi. Byahinduye izina biba Rwanda International Movie Awards. Jackson Mucyo yavuze ko ibihembo byabaye mpuzamahanga. Filime n'abakinnyi bo mu mahanga na bo bashobora guhembwa. Rwanda Movie Week ya 2020 yatangiriye i Nyamata ku ya 21 Gashyantare 2020. RIMA ya mbere yabaye muri Werurwe 2020.
Mu 2023, ibihembo byabaye ku nshuro ya munani. Byari ibihembo 30, mu byiciro bine: filime ndende, filime ngufi, filime z'uruhererekane na filime mbarankuru. Umuhango wabaye ku ya 1 Mata 2023, muri Crown Conference. Jeannette Bahavu yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi ukunzwe cyane. Yahawe imodoka. Emmanuel Mugisha yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza. Roger Niyoyita yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi wa filime mwiza. Mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga, Ini Edo na IK Ogbonna bo muri Nijeriya baratsinze.

Jackson Mucyo (cyangwa Mucyo Jackson) ni Umunyarwanda ukora mu ruganda rwa sinema. Ni umuyobozi wa Ishusho Arts.
Ishusho Arts itegura ibihembo bya Rwanda Movie Awards. Kuva mu 2020, ibi bihembo byitwa Rwanda International Movie Awards (RIMA).
Jackson Mucyo ayobora Ishusho Arts. Ishusho Arts ni ikigo cya sinema cyo mu Rwanda. Cyashinzwe muri Kanama 2011. Gitegura ibihembo bya Rwanda Movie Awards. Ibi bihembo byatangiye mu 2012. Ikinyamakuru "The New Times" cyo mu 2025 kivuga ko Mucyo ari we washinze RIMA.
Mu 2016, Rwanda Movie Awards zatanzwe ku nshuro ya gatanu. Mucyo yavuze ko abahatana bagomba no guturuka hanze y'u Rwanda. Yavuze ko ibihembo byahabwaga abantu bamwe buri gihe. Yasabye abakora filime kwita ku bwiza bw'ibikorwa byabo. Yasabye kandi abafana, abikorera na Leta gushyigikira sinema nyarwanda.
Mu 2020, ibi bihembo byabaye mpuzamahanga. Byiswe Rwanda International Movie Awards (RIMA). Mucyo yari umuhuzabikorwa wa RIMA. Yavuze ko abakora filime bo mu Rwanda batangiye guhatana mu maserukiramuco mpuzamahanga. Yavuze kandi ko hazabaho umunota wo guceceka bibuka umukinnyi Denis Nsanzamahoro.
Mu Gushyingo 2021, Mucyo yitabiriye itangizwa ry'urubuga Vugafrica.rw. Uru rubuga rugenewe abanditsi ba filime. Mucyo yavuze ko igihe kigeze ngo abanditsi ba filime bungukire mu byo bakora. Mu Kuboza 2021, yatangaje ko umukinnyi ukunzwe n'abantu ("People's Choice") azahembwa imodoka.
Muri Mutarama 2023, Mucyo yasobanuye ko ibihembo bya 2022 byasubitswe. Impamvu zirimo icyorezo cya COVID-19 n'amabwiriza yagongaga abashyitsi baturutse hanze.
Mu Kuboza 2025, Mucyo yitabiriye iKON Activate i Kigali. Iki gikorwa gitegurwa n'ibihembo bya iKON Awards byo muri Ubugande.

The Bride ni filime yo mu Rwanda yasohotse mu 2023. Yayobowe kandi yandikwa na Myriam Uwiragiye Birara. Ni yo filime ndende ya mbere yakoze. Ivuga ku muco wa «guterura», aho umukobwa ashimutwa agashyingirwa ku gahato.
Iyi filime yerekanywe bwa mbere mu iserukiramuco rya Berlinale mu 2023. Yahawe ibihembo mu maserukiramuco menshi, harimo FESPACO mu 2025.
Inkuru ibera mu cyaro cy'u Rwanda mu 1997, hashize imyaka itatu habaye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Eva ni umukobwa ukiri muto. Yifuza kwiga ubuvuzi. Umugabo witwa Silas aramushimuta, akamufata ku ngufu. Hanyuma Eva ashyingirwa ku gahato. Eva aba mu rugo rumwe n'umugabo we na mubyara w'umugabo we. Eva n'uwo mubyara baba inshuti. Eva amenya uko Jenoside yagize ingaruka ku muryango w'umugabo we.
Myriam Uwiragiye Birara yashingiye inkuru ku byabaye ku bagore bo mu muryango we, bashyingiwe ku gahato. Mbere yaho, yari yarakoze filime ngufi "HOME" (2021).
Sandra Umulisa, murumuna w'umuyobozi wa filime, ni we ukina Eva. Aline Amike yatoranyijwe binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Amashusho yafashwe na Bora Shingiro.

Ini Edo (amazina yose: Iniobong Edo) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Nijeriya. Akina muri filime za Nollywood, uruganda rwa filime rwo muri Nijeriya.
Mu 2023, Ini Edo yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Ini Edo yatangiye gukina filime mu 2000. Filime ye ya mbere ni "Thick Madam". Yamenyekanye cyane mu 2004, muri filime "World Apart". Mu 2019, ikinyamakuru "The Guardian" cyo muri Nijeriya cyamwise umwe mu bakinnyi ba Nollywood bakunzwe cyane.
Mu 2023, Ini Edo yari umwe mu batunganyije filime y'uruhererekane "Shanty Town". Iyi filime yacaga kuri Netflix. Ini Edo yakinnyemo uruhare rwa Inem.
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, Ini Edo yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga ("Best Actress International") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards. Umukinnyi w'umugabo watsinze muri icyo cyiciro ni IK Ogbonna, na we wo muri Nijeriya.
Mu 2024, Ini Edo yatangaje itariki filime y'uruhererekane "Fairytale Wedding" izasohokeraho.

IK Ogbonna (amazina yose: Ikechukwu Mitchel Ogbonna; yavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1984) ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Nijeriya. Akina muri filime za Nollywood. Ni n'umunyamideli.
Mu 2023, IK Ogbonna yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
IK Ogbonna yavutse ku ya 11 Mutarama 1984. Akomoka muri Leta ya Abia, mu majyepfo y'iburasirazuba bwa Nijeriya. Yize amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye muri Leta ya Lagos. Yize sosiyoloji muri Kaminuza ya Jos.
IK Ogbonna yatangiye gukina filime mu 2013. Filime ye ya mbere ni "Love Lorn".
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, IK Ogbonna yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza mu cyiciro mpuzamahanga ("Best Actor International") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards. Umukinnyi w'umugore watsinze muri icyo cyiciro ni Ini Edo, na we wo muri Nijeriya.
Mu 2015, IK Ogbonna yashakanye na Sonia Morales. Babyaranye umuhungu. Batandukanye mu 2019.

Roger Niyoyita ni umuyobozi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Ayobora filime z'uruhererekane, nka "The Bishop's Family" na "Shuwa Dilu".
Mu 2023, Niyoyita yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi wa filime mwiza muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Niyoyita yakuriye i Ruhengeri, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru. Se yari afite inzu yerekanirwamo filime. Niyoyita yakundiye filime muri iyo nzu akiri muto. Mu 2015, yari amaze gukora ku mishinga myinshi ya filime yo mu Rwanda.
Niyoyita yayoboye filime y'uruhererekane "The Bishop's Family". Iyi filime yakozwe na Zacu Entertainment. Yatambutse kuri Zacu TV no kuri YouTube. Niyoyita yakoze kandi filime ndende "Igeno ryanjye".
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, Niyoyita yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi wa filime mwiza wo mu Rwanda ("Best Local Director") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards, kubera "The Bishop's Family". "Igeno ryanjye" yatsindiye igihembo cy'inkuru nziza ("Best Screenplay").
Mu 2024, Niyoyita yayoboye filime y'uruhererekane isetsa "Shuwa Dilu". Iyi filime yakozwe na Zacu TV. Abakinnyi bayo barimo Niyitegeka Gratien.

The Bishop's Family ni filime y'uruhererekane yo mu Rwanda. Yakozwe na Zacu Entertainment. Yayobowe na Roger Niyoyita. Itambuka kuri Zacu TV no kuri YouTube.
Mu 2023, "The Bishop's Family" yatsindiye igihembo cya filime y'uruhererekane nziza muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Iki gihembo cyatanzwe muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
"The Bishop's Family" ivuga ku mupasiteri witwa Bishop Dan. Umugore we yitwa Jane. Abakirisitu b'itorero babona Jane nk'umupagani, kubera amateka ye. Amateka ya Jane akomeza kumukurikirana. Jane na Bishop Dan bagomba gukemura ibibazo byabo, kugira ngo umuryango wabo udasenyuka. Bafite abana batatu: umuhungu w'imfura n'abakobwa babiri.
Iyi filime yerekana uko imiryango ishobora kubana neza. Ivuga kandi ku kubabarirana hagati y'abashakanye.
Gufata amashusho no kuyatunganya byatangiye muri Nzeri 2022. "The Bishop's Family" yatangiranye na Zacu TV, kuri Canal+ (shene ya 38). Buri sezo ifite ibice 13. Buri gice kimara iminota itarenga 30.
Ku ya 2 Gashyantare 2023, Zacu Entertainment yatangiye kuyitambutsa kuri YouTube. Byari ku bantu bari hanze ya Afurika, badashobora kureba Zacu TV. Misago Nelly Wilson uyobora Zacu Entertainment yavuze ko ari filime nziza Abanyarwanda bakwitega kureba.
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023 habaye Rwanda International Movie Awards. "The Bishop's Family" yatsindiye igihembo cya filime y'uruhererekane nziza muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba ("Best Series East Africa"). Roger Niyoyita yatsindiye igihembo cy'umuyobozi wa filime mwiza ("Best Director"). Iradukunda Abouba Ibra yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza wungirije ("Best Supporting Actor").

Abouba Iradukunda ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Yakinnye muri filime z'uruhererekane nka "Bamenya", "City Maid" na "The Bishop's Family". Yanditse kandi ayobora filime ye ya mbere, "Indushyi".
Mu 2023, Abouba Iradukunda yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza wungirije muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Ubwana n'intangiriro.
Inshuti ya Abouba Iradukunda yashyize ifoto ye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Umuyobozi wa filime w'umugore yabonye iyo foto. Yabonye ko Abouba Iradukunda asa n'umukinnyi yashakaga muri filime ye. Nyuma, undi muyobozi wa filime yamuhaye uruhare. Abouba Iradukunda yasinye amasezerano ya filime ye ya mbere.
Ababyeyi be babanje kubyanga. Batinyaga ko gukina filime byamuteza ibibazo. Batinyaga kandi ko kwamamara byamuhindura. Nyuma babonye ko atahindutse, baramushyigikira.
Abouba Iradukunda yakinnye muri filime "Bamenya", "City Maid", "The Bishop's Family", "Agahinda ka Liza", "Maya" na "Isi Dutuye". Ni umwe mu bakinnyi bakuru ba "The Bishop's Family". Yanditse kandi ayobora filime ye ya mbere, "Indushyi".
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, Abouba Iradukunda yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugabo mwiza wungirije ("Best Supporting Actor") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards. Mu 2024, yavuze ko ashaka gukorera no ku isoko mpuzamahanga.

Umurenge wa Gashari ni umwe mu mirenge 13 igize Akarere ka Karongi, mu Ntara y'Uburengerazuba y’u Rwanda.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, Umurenge wa Gashari wari utuwe n'abaturage 21 263. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.
Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.
Umurenge wa Gashari ni umwe mu mirenge 13 y'Akarere ka Karongi. Ku rubuga City Population, uyu murenge witwa Gishari.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Gashari wari utuwe n'abaturage 19 904. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 21 263. Abagabo bari 10 156. Abagore bari 11 107. Abana bari munsi y'imyaka 18 bari 9 436.
Umurenge wa Gashari utuwe na 5,7 % by'abaturage b'Akarere ka Karongi. Abaturage bose batuye mu cyaro.

Umurenge wa Kibeho ni umwe mu mirenge 14 igize Akarere ka Nyaruguru, mu Ntara y'Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda.

Mu Rwanda, imitegekere y’igihugu igizwe n’inzego zikurikira: Intara → Uturere → Imirenge → Utugari → Imidugudu.

Ingoro ya Bikira Mariya.
Kibeho izwi kubera amabonekerwa ya Bikira Mariya. Amabonekerwa yatangiye ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 1981, ku ishuri ryo i Kibeho.
Ku wa 29 Kamena 2001, Musenyeri Augustin Misago wa Diyosezi Gatolika ya Gikongoro yemeje ko amabonekerwa y'abakobwa batatu ari ay'ukuri. Abo bakobwa ni Alphonsine Mumureke, Nathalie Mukamazimpaka na Marie-Claire Mukangango.

Mu Murenge wa Kimihurura hari inyubako ya Kigali Convention Centre. Iyi nyubako yatangiye kubakwa mu 2009. Yafunguwe muri Nyakanga 2016. Yatwaye amadolari y'Amerika arenga miliyoni 300.

Byumba ni umujyi uri mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda. Uri mu Akarere ka Gicumbi, mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru. Uyu mujyi witwa kandi umujyi wa Gicumbi.
Byumba iri nko muri kilometero 60 mu majyaruguru ya Kigali. Ni umujyi wa kabiri mu bunini mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru. Igice kinini cyawo kiri mu Murenge wa Byumba.
Kugeza mu 2006, Byumba yari umurwa mukuru wa Perefegitura ya Byumba. Mu 2002, perefegitura zahindutse intara. Ku wa 1 Mutarama 2006, u Rwanda rwavuye ku ntara 12 rujya ku ntara 5. Intara ya Byumba yavuyeho. Igice kinini cyayo cyashyizwe mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru.
Byumba iri mu karere k'imisozi miremire. Ubutumburuke bwaho buri hagati ya metero 1 800 na 2 500. Ikirere cyaho kirakonja.
Byumba iri nko muri kilometero 60 mu majyaruguru ya Kigali. Iri nko muri kilometero 30 z'umuhanda uvuye i Gatuna, ku mupaka n'Ubugande.
Umujyi wa Gicumbi ni wo mujyi wa kabiri mu bunini mu Ntara y'Amajyaruguru, nyuma ya Musanze. Igice kinini cyawo kiri mu Murenge wa Byumba. Ikindi gice kiri mu Murenge wa Kaniga.
Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, abaturage 19 270 bo mu Murenge wa Byumba babaga mu mujyi.
Abaturage benshi batunzwe n'ubuhinzi n'ubworozi. Ubucuruzi bwo mu mujyi ni bwo bubinjiriza amafaranga cyane. Mu mujyi hubakwa inyubako nshya. Hubakwa kandi imihanda ya kaburimbo.
Byumba ni icyicaro cya Diyosezi Gatolika ya Byumba. Iyi diyosezi yashinzwe ku wa 5 Ugushyingo 1981.
Kaminuza y'Ikoranabuhanga n'Ubugeni ya Byumba (UTAB) iri i Byumba. Ibitaro bya Byumba na byo biri muri uyu mujyi.
Umuryango "SOS Children's Villages" wita ku bana b'imfubyi. Watangiye gukorera i Byumba mu 1997.

Mireille Igihozo ni umukinnyi wa filime wo mu Rwanda. Azwi muri filime z'uruhererekane "Indoto" na "Ishusho ya Papa". Muri "Indoto", akina yitwa Phionah.
Mu 2023, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza wungirije muri Rwanda International Movie Awards.
Mbere ya 2019, Mireille Igihozo yari umutetsi. Yakundaga sinema. Yabonye kuri Facebook ko ishuri Kigali Film and Television School (KFTV) rishaka abakinnyi bashya. Yitabiriye icyo gikorwa. Yinjiye muri sinema mu mpera za 2019.
Yakinnye muri filime nka "Matayo High School", "Seven Friends" na "My Aunt". Muri "Ishusho ya Papa", akina yitwa Gihozo. Muri "Indoto", akina yitwa Phionah. Yakinnye kandi muri "Good Book, Bad Cover" ya Alliah Cool.
Ku ya 1 Mata 2023, yatsindiye igihembo cy'umukinnyi w'umugore mwiza wungirije ("Best Supporting Actress") muri Rwanda International Movie Awards, kubera "Indoto".
Mu 2024, yavuze ko akomeje akazi ko gukora imigati na keke muri hoteli. Agafatanya na sinema.

Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2012, Umurenge wa Nyamata wari utuwe n'abaturage 34 922. Mu ibarura rusange ryo mu 2022, wari utuwe n'abaturage 81 480. Abagabo bari 40 096. Abagore bari 41 384. Ikiyaga cya Birira ni ikiyaga cyo mu Rwanda. Giherereye mu Akarere ka Ngoma, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ikiyaga cya Birira kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cy'Akagera yo haruguru.
Ikiyaga cya Birira kiri mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, hafi y'Umurenge wa Rukumberi. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa m 1 330. Kizwi kandi ku mazina ya Bilira na Birara.
Ikiyaga cya Birira kiri mu itsinda ry'ibiyaga byo mu kibaya cy'Akagera yo haruguru. Iryo tsinda ririmo kandi Ikiyaga cya Mugesera, Ikiyaga cya Muhazi n'Ikiyaga cya Sake.

Ikiyaga cya Hago ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Kiri muri Pariki y'Akagera, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ikiyaga cya Hago gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 16,1. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo ntiburenga metero 5,8. Kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cy'Akagera yo hepfo. Muri iki kiyaga hakorerwa uburobyi.
Ikiyaga cya Hago kiri mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba. Kiri ku butumburuke bwa metero 1 285. Kiri ku ntera ya kilometero 32 mu majyaruguru y'uburasirazuba bw'umujyi wa Gahini.
Ikiyaga cya Hago kiri muri Pariki y'Akagera. Gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 16,1. Uburebure bwacyo ni kilometero 6. Ubugari bwacyo ni kilometero 5,8. Inkombe zacyo zifite uburebure bwa kilometero 33,5. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri metero 5,8. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugereranyije ni metero 4,5. Kirimo metero kibe miliyoni 45 z'amazi.
Ikiyaga cya Hago kiri mu itsinda ry'ibiyaga byo mu kibaya cy'Akagera yo hepfo. Ibyo biyaga biri hepfo y'Isumo rya Rusumo. Iryo tsinda ririmo kandi Ikiyaga cy'Ihema, Ikiyaga cya Kivumba n'Ikiyaga cya Nasho. Ibiyaga byose by'iryo tsinda bifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare 178,4.
Mu kiyaga cya Hago hakorerwa uburobyi. Mu 1975–1976, abarobyi bari 6. Muri icyo gihe, umusaruro w'amafi wari toni 90 ku mwaka.

Ikiyaga cya Karago ni ikiyaga gito cyo mu Rwanda. Giherereye mu Akarere ka Nyabihu, mu Intara y'Uburengerazuba.
Ikiyaga cya Karago kiri ku butumburuke burenga m 2 300. Mu mwaka wa 2022, bashyizemo amagi y'amafi kugira ngo umusaruro wiyongere.
Ikiyaga cya Karago giherereye mu Karere ka Nyabihu. Kiri ku butumburuke burenga m 2 300. Gifite ubuso bwa km² 0,3. Uburebure bwacyo ntarengwa ni km 1. Ubugari bwacyo ntarengwa ni m 500. Cyakira amazi y'umugezi wa Nyamukongoro. Nta mugezi ugisohokamo.
Ikiyaga cya Karago kiri hejuru cyane. Ni yo mpamvu kibamo amafi make.
Mu Gushyingo 2022, bashyizemo amagi 3 000 y'amafi yo mu bwoko bwa "carpe". Byari byitezwe ko azongera umusaruro.

Ikiyaga cya Kivumba ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Kiri muri Pariki y'Akagera.
Ikiyaga cya Kivumba kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cyo hasi cy'umugezi w'Akagera. Ntikigira ubujyakuzimu bunini.
Ikiyaga cya Kivumba kiri muri Pariki y'Akagera. Kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cyo hasi cy'Akagera. Ibyo biyaga bifite amazi ashyushye, adashinga kandi akungahaye ku ntungamubiri.
Ikiyaga gifite ubuso bwa km² 8,7. Gifite uburebure bwa km 5,2 n'ubugari bwa km 3,5. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri m 5,6. Ubujyakuzimu buringaniye ni m 4,2. Kibika amazi angana na m³ miliyoni 30,3. Inkombe zacyo zifite uburebure bwa km 18,2.
Mu 1975, ku Kiyaga cya Kivumba hari abarobyi 5.

Ikiyaga cya Mpanga ni ikiyaga cyo mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda. Kiri mu Umurenge wa Mpanga, mu Akarere ka Kirehe, mu Intara y'Iburasirazuba.
Ikiyaga cya Mpanga kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cyo hasi cy'umugezi w'Akagera. Kitwa kandi Rwampanga.
Ikiyaga cya Mpanga kiri mu biyaga byo mu kibaya cyo hasi cy'Akagera. Ibyo biyaga bifite amazi ashyushye, adashinga kandi akungahaye ku ntungamubiri.
Ikiyaga gifite ubuso bwa km² 9,5. Gifite uburebure bwa km 7 n'ubugari bwa km 2,2. Ubujyakuzimu bwacyo bugera kuri m 7. Ubujyakuzimu buringaniye ni m 5,2.
Mu 1975–1976, ku Kiyaga cya Mpanga hari abarobyi 30. Mu 1975, barobye toni 30 z'amafi.

Cécile Kyenge (amazina yose: Cécile Kashetu Kyenge; yavutse ku wa 28 Kanama 1964) ni umunyapolitiki w'Umutaliyani. Ni umuganga w'amaso. Yavukiye i Kambove muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo.
Kuva mu 2013 kugeza mu 2014, Cécile Kyenge yari Minisitiri ushinzwe kwinjiza abimukira mu muryango. Ni we mwirabura wa mbere wabaye minisitiri mu Butaliyani. Kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2019, yari umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Ubumwe bw'Ibihugu by'i Burayi.
Cécile Kyenge yavutse ku wa 28 Kanama 1964. Yavukiye i Kambove, muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Mu 1983, Cécile Kyenge yagiye mu Butaliyani kwiga ubuvuzi. Yize muri Kaminuza Gatolika y'Umutima Mutagatifu (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore) i Roma. Nyuma yaho, yize ubuvuzi bw'amaso i Modena. Yabaye umuganga w'amaso.
Mu 2002, Cécile Kyenge yashinze umuryango witwa DAWA. Uyu muryango uteza imbere imibanire y'imico itandukanye. Cécile Kyenge yinjiye muri politiki mu 2004, mu karere ka Emilia-Romagna. Mu 2009, yatorewe kuba umujyanama w'Intara ya Modena. Yari mu ishyaka Partito Democratico (Ishyaka rya Demokarasi).
Muri Gashyantare 2013, Cécile Kyenge yatorewe kuba umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Ubutaliyani. Ku wa 28 Mata 2013, Minisitiri w'Intebe Enrico Letta yamugize Minisitiri ushinzwe kwinjiza abimukira mu muryango. Cécile Kyenge yabaye umwirabura wa mbere wabaye minisitiri mu Butaliyani. Yavuye kuri uwo mwanya mu 2014.
Igihe yari minisitiri, Cécile Kyenge yibasiwe n'amagambo y'ivanguramoko. Bamwe bamuteye imineke mu nama za politiki. Mu 2013, umusenateri Roberto Calderoli yamugereranyije n'inguge yitwa orang-outan. Mu 2019, urukiko rw'i Bergamo rwakatiye Roberto Calderoli igifungo cy'amezi 18. Icyaha cye cyari ugusebanya gushingiye ku ivanguramoko.
Kuva ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2014 kugeza ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2019, Cécile Kyenge yari umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y'Ubumwe bw'Ibihugu by'i Burayi. Yari mu itsinda ry'Abasosiyalisiti n'Abademokarate (S&amp;D). Mu 2019, Cécile Kyenge yongeye kwiyamamaza. Ntiyatowe. Nyuma yaho, yasubiye mu buvuzi. Mu 2021, yabaye umuganga rusange hafi y'umujyi wa Padova.
Cécile Kyenge yashakanye n'injeniyeri w'Umutaliyani. Bafitanye abakobwa babiri.

Amsterdam ni umurwa mukuru w'Ubuholandi. Ni na wo mujyi utuwe cyane mu gihugu. Icyicaro cya guverinoma ntikiri i Amsterdam. Kiri mu mujyi wa Den Haag (La Haye).
Amsterdam iri mu Ntara ya Holland y'Amajyaruguru. Ituwe n'abaturage barenga 940,000. Uyu mujyi uzwiho imiyoboro y'amazi myinshi. Agace k'imiyoboro yo mu kinyejana cya 17 kari ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO.
Amsterdam yatangiye ari umudugudu muto w'abarobyi mu kinyejana cya 13. Kugira ngo birinde imyuzure, abaturage bubatse urugomero ku uruzi rwa Amstel. Byabaye ahagana mu 1270. Izina Amsterdam rikomoka kuri urwo rugomero rwo ku ruzi rwa Amstel. Amsterdam yahawe uburenganzira bwo kuba umujyi mu 1306.
Mu kinyejana cya 17, Amsterdam yabaye ihuriro rikomeye ry'ubucuruzi mu Burayi. Mu gihe cy'Intambara ya Kabiri y'Isi Yose, Ubudage bwigaruriye Amsterdam. Abayahudi 107,000 bajyanywe mu nkambi bavuye mu Buholandi. Nibura 102,000 muri bo bishwe. Anne Frank n'umuryango we bihishe mu nzu iri ku muyoboro wa Prinsengracht. Iyo nzu ubu yitwa Anne Frank Huis. Isurwa n'abantu barenga miliyoni buri mwaka.
Imiterere n'abaturage.
Imiyoboro y'amazi igabanya Amsterdam mu birwa bigera kuri 90. Ibiraro birenga 1,300 bihuza ibyo birwa. Agace k'imiyoboro kitwa Grachtengordel kubatswe mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 16 no mu kinyejana cya 17. Kashyizwe ku rutonde rw'Umurage w'Isi wa UNESCO mu 2010.
Ku itariki ya 1 Mutarama 2026, Amsterdam yari ituwe n'abaturage 942,504.
Meya wa Amsterdam ni Femke Halsema. Yatangiye uwo murimo mu 2018. Ni we mugore wa mbere wabaye meya w'uyu mujyi. Inama njyanama y'umujyi yasabye ko yongera gushyirwaho kugeza nibura mu 2030.
Amsterdam ifite inzu ndangamurage nyinshi. Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum na Stedelijk Museum ziri ku kibuga cyitwa Museumplein.
Amsterdam izwi nk'umujyi w'amagare. Muri uyu mujyi hari amagare menshi kurusha abaturage.

Moi, le dernier Tutsi (mu Kinyarwanda: "Jyewe, Umututsi wa nyuma") ni igitabo cy'ubuhamya. Cyanditswe na Charles Habonimana afatanyije na Daniel Le Scornet. Cyasohotse mu 2019 mu Bufaransa, gisohowe na Plon.
Igitabo kivuga ku buzima bw'umwanditsi mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Icyo gihe, Charles Habonimana yari afite imyaka 12.
Ibikubiye mu gitabo.
Charles Habonimana yavutse mu 1982. Yavukiye i Mayunzwe, mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda. Mu 1994, Charles yari afite imyaka 12.
Ku wa 19 Mata 1994, Théodore Sindikubwabo yavugiye ijambo i Butare. Igitabo kivuga kuri iryo jambo. Nyuma yaryo, abaturanyi b'Abahutu batangiye kwica Abatutsi.
Ku wa 24 Mata 1994, abicanyi bishe se, Célestin, imbere ye. Bishe kandi Fidel, wo mu muryango we. Nyina, Odette, n'abavandimwe be barindwi na bo barishwe.
Sebuhuku yari umuyobozi w'abicanyi ku musozi wabo. Sebuhuku yategetse ko Charles aticwa ako kanya. Yashakaga ko Charles aba «Umututsi wa nyuma». Charles yagombaga kwicwa nyuma y'Abatutsi bose bo mu gace.
Sebuhuku yishe umuryango wa Charles. Ariko Sebuhuku yabaye kandi umurinzi wa Charles. Francine, umugore wa Sebuhuku, yarinze Charles uko ashoboye. Charles yarokotse Jenoside.
Charles yatanze ubuhamya bwe mu magambo imyaka myinshi, mu nama zo ku isi hose. Mu ntangiriro z'imyaka ya 2000, yatangiye kwandika ubuhamya bwe mu Kinyarwanda. Mu mpera za 2016, yahuye na Daniel Le Scornet mu Bufaransa. Bombi biyemeje kwandika igitabo mu Gifaransa.
Plon yasohoye igitabo ku wa 21 Werurwe 2019. Ku wa 23 Mata 2019, Charles Habonimana yamuritse igitabo i Kigali. Muri Mata 2019 kandi, ikinyamakuru "Jeune Afrique" cyagiranye ikiganiro na Charles Habonimana ku gitabo cye.
Ku wa 22 Ukwakira 2020, Pocket yongeye gusohora igitabo. Mu 2024, ikinyamakuru "Le Grand Continent" cyashyize iki gitabo ku rutonde rw'ibitabo byo gusoma kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

Karbamazepini, igurishwa ku izina ry'ubucuruzi rya Tegretol n'andi, ni umuti ugabanya ububabare bw'imitsi ukoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuvura igicuri n'ububabare bw'imitsi. Ikoreshwa mu ndwara ya schizophrenia hamwe n'indi miti ndetse n'umuti wa kabiri mu ndwara ya bipolar. Carbamazepine isa nkaho ikora neza nka phenytoin na valproate mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe n’izisanzwe. Ntabwo bigira ingaruka nziza ku ndwara yo kubura cyangwa indwara yo mu mutwe.
Ingaruka mbi zikunze kugaragara zirimo isesemi no gusinzira. Ingaruka mbi zishobora kuba zirimo uduheri ku ruhu, kugabanuka k'umusemburo w'amagufwa, gutekereza kwiyahura, cyangwa urujijo. Ntibikwiye gukoreshwa ku bantu bafite amateka yo kugira ibibazo by'umusemburo w'amagufwa. Gukoresha imiti mu gihe utwite bishobora kwangiza umwana; icyakora, guhagarika imiti ku bagore batwite bafite igicuri ntibyemewe. Ntibyemewe kuyikoresha mu gihe cyo konsa. Abafite ibibazo by'impyiko cyangwa umwijima bagomba kwitonda.
Karbamazepini yavumbuwe mu 1953 n'umuhanga mu bya shimi w'Umusuwisi witwa Walter Schindler. Yatangiye kugurishwa mu 1962. Iraboneka nk'umuti usanzwe, kandi nta na kimwe muri byo gihembeye. Iri ku rutonde rw'imiti y'ingenzi y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye wita ku Buzima. Igiciro cy’igurishwa ry’ibicuruzwa mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere kiri hagati y’amadolari y’Amerika 0.07 na 0.24 ku munsi guhera mu 2015. Mu 2017, wari umuti wa 176 ukunze kwandikirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho wanditswe n'abaganga barenga miliyoni eshatu.

Kolera ni indwara iterwa n'udukoko tumwe na tumwe twa bagiteri ya "Vibrio cholerae". Ibimenyetso bishobora kuva kuri nta na kimwe, kugeza ku byoroheje cyangwa bikomeye. Ikimenyetso gisanzwe ni impiswi nyinshi y'amazi imara iminsi mike. Kuruka no kuribwa mu mitsi nabyo bishobora kubaho. Impiswi ishobora kuba mbi cyane ku buryo mu masaha make ishobora gutuma umuntu abura amazi menshi kandi akagira ikibazo cy’amashanyarazi adahagije. Ibi bishobora gutuma amaso agwa, uruhu rukonje, uruhu rugabanuka, ndetse n'amaboko n'ibirenge bikagira iminkanyari. Kubura amazi mu mubiri bishobora gutuma uruhu ruhinduka ibara ry'umukara. Ibimenyetso bitangira nyuma y'amasaha abiri kugeza ku minsi itanu nyuma yo guhura n'iki cyorezo.
Kolera iterwa n'ubwoko butandukanye bwa "Vibrio cholerae", hamwe n'ubwoko bumwe butera indwara zikomeye kurusha ubundi. Ikwirakwizwa ahanini n'amazi mabi n'ibiribwa bibi byandujwe n'imyanda y'abantu irimo bagiteri. Ibiryo byo mu nyanja bidatetse neza ni isoko ikunze kuboneka. Abantu ni bo nyamaswa bonyine bahura n’iki kibazo. Ibintu bishobora gutera iyi ndwara birimo isuku nke, amazi meza yo kunywa adahagije, n'ubukene. Hari impungenge ko kwiyongera k'amazi yo mu nyanja bizatuma indwara ziyongera. Kolera ishobora gupimwa hakoreshejwe ikizamini cy'umwanda. Ikizamini cyihuse cyo gupima amaraso kirahari ariko ntabwo ari cyo cy’ukuri.
Uburyo bwo kwirinda kolera burimo kunoza isuku no kubona amazi meza. Urukingo rwa kolera bitangwa mu kanwa bitanga uburinzi bukwiye mu gihe cy'amezi atandatu. Bafite inyungu yo kurinda ubundi bwoko bw'impiswi buterwa na "E. coli". Uburyo bw'ibanze bwo kuvura ni ukuvura amazi mu kanwa —gusimbuza ibinyobwa n'ibinyabutabire biryoshye kandi biryoshye gato. Ibisubizo bishingiye ku muceri ni byo byiza cyane. Inyongeramusaruro ya zinc ingirakamaro ku bana. Mu bihe bikomeye, hashobora kuba ngombwa ko umuntu ahabwa amazi yo mu mitsi, nka Ringer's lactate, kandi imiti yica udukoko nka doxycycline ishobora kuba ingirakamaro. Gusuzuma kugira ngo harebwe antibiyotike Kolera ishobora kwibasirwa n’indwara ishobora gufasha mu guhitamo.
Kolera yibasira abantu bagera kuri 1.3 kugeza kuri 4 miliyoni z'abantu ku isi yose kandi bigatuma abantu 21.000–143.000 impfu ku mwaka. Nubwo byashyizwe mu cyiciro cy'icyorezo, ni gake cyane mu bihugu byateye imbere. Abana ni bo bibasirwa cyane. Kolera igaragara haba mu bice bimwe na bimwe by’umubiri ndetse no mu bice bimwe na bimwe by’umubiri. Uduce dufite ibyago bikomeje kurwara harimo Afurika n'Amajyepfo y'Uburasirazuba bwa Aziya. Ingaruka z'urupfu mu bahuye n'iki kibazo akenshi ziba ziri munsi ya 1% ariko zishobora kugera kuri 5%. Kutabona uburyo bwo kuvurwa bitera impfu nyinshi. Ibisobanuro bya kolera biboneka mu kinyejana cya 5 mbere ya Yesu mu rurimi rw'Abasanskriti. Inyigo ya kolera mu Bwongereza yakozwe na John Snow hagati ya 1849 na 1854 yatumye habaho iterambere rikomeye mu bijyanye n'ibyorezo. Icyorezo kinini cy'indwara zirindwi byabayeho mu myaka 200 ishize, abantu babarirwa muri za miriyoni bapfuye.

Autism is a developmental disorder characterized by difficulties with social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior. Parents often notice signs during the first three years of their child's life. These signs often develop gradually, though some children with autism experience worsening in their communication and social skills after reaching developmental milestones at a normal pace.
Indwara ya Autism ifitanye isano n'uruvange rw'ibintu bigize imiterere y'umubiri n'ibidukikije. Ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago mu gihe cyo gutwita birimo indwara zimwe na zimwe, nka rubela, uburozi burimo aside valproic, inzoga, kokayine, imiti yica udukoko, lisansi, n'ihumana ry'ikirere, kugabanya imikurire y'umwana uri mu nda, hamwe n'indwara ziterwa n'ubwiyongere bw'umubiri. Impaka zishingiye ku zindi mpamvu zishingiye ku bidukikije zivugwa; urugero, igitekerezo cy’urukingo, cyamaze kwemezwa. Indwara ya Autism igira ingaruka ku itunganywa ry'amakuru mu bwonko n'uburyo uturemangingo tw'imitsi n'imiyoboro ya synapse bihurira kandi bigatunganywa; uburyo ibi bibaho ntabwo bwumvikana neza. Igitabo cy’Isuzuma n’Ibarurishamibare ku ndwara zo mu mutwe (DSM-5), gihuza autisme n’ubwoko budakomeye bw’iyi ndwara, harimo Asperger syndrome n’indwara y’iterambere ikwirakwira idasobanuwe ukundi (PDD-NOS) mu gusuzuma indwara ya autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
Uburyo bwo kuvura imyitwarire hakiri kare cyangwa uburyo bwo kuvuga bushobora gufasha abana bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe kwiyitaho, kubana neza n'abandi, no kuvugana n'abandi. Nubwo nta muti uzwi uhari, habayeho abana bakize. Bamwe mu bantu bakuru bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe ntibashobora kubaho bigenga. Umuco w’indwara ya autisme warateye imbere, aho bamwe bashaka ubuvuzi abandi bakemera ko autisme ikwiye kwemerwa nk'itandukaniro rigomba kwitabwaho aho gukira.
Ku isi yose, autisme ivugwa ko yibasira abantu miliyoni 24.8. Mu myaka ya 2000, umubare w’abantu banduye wabarirwaga kuri 1-2 ku bantu 1.000 ku isi yose. Mu bihugu byateye imbere, abana bagera kuri 1.5% basanzwe barwaye ASD, uvuye kuri 0.7% mu 2000 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ikunze kugaragara inshuro enye kugeza kuri eshanu ku bagabo kurusha abagore. Umubare w'abantu banduye wariyongereye cyane kuva mu myaka ya 1960, ibi bikaba bishobora kuba byaratewe n'impinduka mu mikorere yo gusuzuma indwara. Ikibazo cyo kumenya niba ibiciro nyabyo byiyongereye ntikirakemuka.

Indwara y'ibihaha yari indwara yandura iterwa n'imwe muri virusi ebyiri, imwe nkuru yitwa variyola na nindi yitwa variyola ntoya. Umurwayi wa nyuma usanzwe yagaragaye mu Ukwakira 1977, maze Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima (OMS) wemeza ko iyi ndwara yaciwe burundu ku isi mu 1980. Ingaruka z'urupfu nyuma yo kwandura iyi ndwara zari hafi 30%, aho umubare w'abana bato wari uri hejuru. Akenshi abarokotse iyi ndwara wasangaga bafite inkovu nyinshi ku ruhu rwabo, ikindi bamwe muri bo basigaranye ubuhumyi.
Ibimenyetso bya mbere by’iyi ndwara byari birimo umuriro no kuruka. Ibi bigakurwa no kugaragara kw'ibisebe mu kanwa no kuzana uduheri ku ruhu. Mu minsi myinshi, ibibyimba byo ku ruhu byahindutse utubyimba twuzuye amazi hamwe n'aho hagati hapfutse. Hanyuma ibibyimba byaracitse biragwa, bisiga inkovu. Iyi ndwara yakwirakwijwe hagati y'abantu cyangwa binyuze mu bintu byanduye. Kwirinda byakorwaga ahanini n'urukingo rwa smallpox. Iyo indwara imaze kugaragara, imiti imwe n'imwe igabanya ubukana bw'imiti ishobora kuba yarafashije.
Inkomoko y'indwara y'ingutu ntabwo izwi. Ibimenyetso bya mbere by'iyi ndwara ni ibyo mu kinyejana cya 3 mbere ya Yesu mu maremare yo mu Misiri. Iyi ndwara yakunze kubaho mu bihe by’icyorezo. Mu Burayi bwo mu kinyejana cya 18, bivugwa ko abantu 400.000 bapfaga buri mwaka bazize iyi ndwara, kandi kimwe cya gatatu cy'abarwayi barwaye indwara yavuyemo ubuhumyi. Aba bapfuye barimo abami batandatu. Indwara y'ibicurane iravugwa ko yahitanye abantu bagera kuri 300 abantu miliyoni mu kinyejana cya 20 n'abagera kuri 500 miliyoni z'abantu mu myaka 100 ishize imaze ibayeho. Vuba aha mu 1967, 15 abantu miliyoni banduye buri mwaka.
Gutera indwara y'inkorora bisa nkaho byatangiye mu Bushinwa ahagana mu myaka ya 1500. Uburayi bwafashe uyu muco ukomoka muri Aziya mu gice cya mbere cy'ikinyejana cya 18. Mu 1796, Edward Jenner yatangije urukingo rugezweho rwa smallpox. Mu 1967, OMS yongereye imbaraga mu kurandura iyi ndwara. Indwara y'inkorora ni imwe mu ndwara ebyiri zandura zaranduwe burundu, indi ikaba ari indwara y'inkorora mu 2011. Ijambo "inkongoro" ryakoreshejwe bwa mbere mu Bwongereza mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 16 kugira ngo ritandukanye indwara na syphilis, icyo gihe izwi nka "inkongoro nini". Andi mazina y’amateka y’iyi ndwara arimo pox, smallled monster, na red plague.

Kwiyahura ni igikorwa cyo kwiyahura ukiyambura ubuzima nkana. Indwara zo mu mutwe harimo kwiheba, indwara ya bipolar, autism, schizophrenia, indwara zo mu mutwe, indwara zo guhangayika, no gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge - harimo n'inzoga n'ikoreshwa rya benzodiazepine - ni ibintu bishobora gutera ibyago. Kwiyahura bimwe na bimwe ni ibikorwa bitunguranye bitewe n'imihangayiko, urugero nk'ibibazo by'amafaranga, ibibazo by'imibanire nko gutandukana, cyangwa gutotezwa. Abagerageje kwiyahura mbere bari mu kaga gakomeye ko kugerageza kwiyahura mu gihe kizaza. Ibikorwa byiza byo gukumira kwiyahura birimo kugabanya uburyo bwo kwiyahura— nk'imbunda, ibiyobyabwenge n'uburozi; kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe n'ikoreshwa nabi ry'ibiyobyabwenge; gutangaza amakuru yitonze ku bijyanye no kwiyahura; no kunoza ubukungu. Nubwo imirongo yo gusaba ubufasha ku bibazo by’ihungabana ikunze kugaragara, ntabwo yigwa neza.
Uburyo bukunze gukoreshwa mu kwiyahura buratandukanye bitewe n'ibihugu, kandi bufitanye isano n'uko hari uburyo bufatika bwo kubikora. Uburyo busanzwe bwo kwiyahura burimo kumanika, uburozi bw'imiti yica udukoko, n'imbunda. Kwiyahura byagize ingaruka ku rupfu rw’abantu 828.000 ku isi mu 2015, ubwiyongere buvuye ku rupfu rw’abantu 712.000 mu 1990. Ibi bituma kwiyahura ari byo bituma habaho impfu za 10 ku isi.
Abantu bagera kuri 1.5% bapfa biyahuye. Mu mwaka runaka, ibi biba hafi 12 kuri buri bantu 100.000. Igipimo cy’ubwiyahuzi bumaze kurangira muri rusange kiri hejuru mu bagabo kurusha mu bagore, kuva ku nshuro 1.5 kurusha mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere kugeza ku nshuro 3.5 mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Kwiyahura muri rusange bikunze kugaragara cyane mu bantu barengeje imyaka 70; icyakora, mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe, abafite hagati y'imyaka 15 na 30 ni bo bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwiyahura. Uburayi bwagize igipimo cyo hejuru cy’ubwiyahuzi ukurikije akarere mu 2015. Hari abantu babarirwa muri 10 kugeza kuri 20 miliyoni z’abantu bagerageza kwiyahura badapfa buri mwaka. Kugerageza kwiyahura bidahitana umuntu bishobora gutera imvune n'ubumuga bw'igihe kirekire. Mu bihugu by'Iburengerazuba bw'Isi, kugerageza ni ibintu bikunze kugaragara mu rubyiruko no mu bagore.
Ibitekerezo byo kwiyahura byagizweho ingaruka n'ingingo zagutse z'ubuzima nko idini, icyubahiro, n'icyo ubuzima buvuze. Amadini ya Aburahamu asanzwe abona kwiyahura nk'icyaha ku Mana, bitewe n'uko yemera ko ubuzima ari ubwera. Mu gihe cy'ubutegetsi bwa samurai mu Buyapani, ubwoko bw'ubwiyahuzi buzwi nka seppuku ("harakiri") bwubahwaga nk'uburyo bwo guhomba cyangwa nk'uburyo bwo kwigaragambya. Sati, imigenzo yabujijwe n'Umwongereza Raj, yiteze ko umupfakazi w'Umuhinde yiyahura mu gihe umugabo we yari ashyinguwe n'umuriro, yaba abishaka cyangwa ashyizweho igitutu n'umuryango we ndetse n'umuryango we. Kwiyahura no kugerageza kwiyahura, nubwo mbere byari bitemewe n'amategeko, ntibikibaho mu bihugu byinshi by'Iburengerazuba bw'Isi. Biracyari icyaha gihanwa n'amategeko mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe. Mu kinyejana cya 20 n'icya 21, kwiyahura byakoreshejwe mu bihe bidasanzwe nk'uburyo bwo kwigaragambya, naho ibisasu bya kamikaze n'ibisasu by'abiyahuzi byakoreshejwe nk'amayeri ya gisirikare cyangwa iterabwoba.

Remy credo Credo ni amwe mu mazina yose yumunyamakuru wa siporo witwa CYEMEZO MUCYO Remy Credo akaba akoresha imbugankoranyambaga mu bijyanye na sport akaba azwi cyane mu kuyobora ibiganiro bya siporo ndetse nubusesenguzi cyane cyane bushingiye kuri science kuko ari nabyo yize.Yabaye umunyamakuru wa City radio mu kiganiro city sports.
